kikuyu: Kaka ne iora e piny e kaka an bende aseorogi e piny.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nochiko jotichne ma jothieth mondo olos ringre wuon-gi, Israel gi yath. Kuom mano jothiethgo noloso ringre Jakobo.
english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

kikuyu: Jomecho ariyo bende negiguro kode, achiel e bathe korachwich to machielo e bathe koracham.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

kikuyu: Jaketh gik moko nobi e dala ka dala kendo onge dala ma notony. Holo noum kendo got mar mesa nomuki, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Enoduog chunje wuone ir nyithindgi, kendo chunje nyithindo ir wuonegi; nono to anabi kendo aketh piny gi kwongʼ!”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano to negineno ni Nyasaye ne osemiya tich mar yalo Injili ne joma ok jo-Yahudi, mana kaka Petro bende nosemi tich mar yalo ni jo-Yahudi.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

kikuyu: Kowuoyo to chiengʼ ok rieny kendo oumo ler mar sulwe.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

kikuyu: nyaka chop abi mi ateru e piny machal gi pinyu, ma en piny machiego cham gi divai manyien, piny mopongʼ gi makati kod mzabibu, piny man-gi yiende zeituni kod mor kich. Yieruru ngima, to kik uyier tho! “Kik uwinj wach Hezekia, nimar owuondou kowacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye biro resowa.’
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne wagero ohinga nyaka ne ochopo nus mar borne, nikech ji notiyo gi chunygi duto.
english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

kikuyu: Nochako wuodhe koa Babulon e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo, kendo nochopo Jerusalem e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abich, nimar lwedo mangʼwon mar Nyasache ne ni kuome.
english: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.

kikuyu: Eka ne aywak niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ngʼuonne jogi ma joka Jakobo. Ere kaka ginyalo tony, to ginok kama?”
english: Then I said, “Lord GOD, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

kikuyu: “Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech wiu osewil koda kendo usejwangʼa, koro nyaka uyud pok maromre gi timbeu mag chode.”
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”

kikuyu: nimar en mor ka ikanogi ei chunyi kendo bed kodgi moikore e dhogi.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

kikuyu: “Ka rwadh ngʼato ohinyo rwadh ngʼat machielo mi otho, to ginius rwath mangimano kendo ginipog pesa kaachiel gi ring rwath mothono marom.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

kikuyu: Jo-Naftali bende ne ok oriembo jogo mane odak Beth Shemesh kod Beth Anath, to negidak e dier jo-Kanaan mane weg pinyno kendo negiloko jogo mane odak Beth Shemesh kod Beth Anath wasumbinigi.
english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho wechegi, nongʼiyo polo bangʼe olamo kama: “Wuora, sa osechopo. Mi Wuodi duongʼ mondo Wuodi bende omiyi duongʼ.
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

kikuyu: Ahimelek nodwoko ruoth niya, “Ere ngʼat ma ja-adiera kuom jotiji duto machal gi Daudi ori ma jatend joma riti, kendo mogen moloyo e odi mangima?
english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?

kikuyu: Ahitub nonywolo Zadok, Zadok nonywolo Ahimaz,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

kikuyu: Kamano nobawo yo ka ii ot duto gi dhahabu, bende nobawo kendo mar misango mar kama ler mar lemo gi dhahabu.
english: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

kikuyu: Ahulone gik mathaga duto; anyise chandruokna duto ka abet e nyime.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo otieno ne adhi kaluwo Dhoranga Holo kochiko Soko mar Thuol kod Dhoranga Owuoyo, ka anono ohingni mag Jerusalem, mane osegore piny, kod dhorangeyigi mane osewangʼ gi mach.
english: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

kikuyu: Omiyo noluongo Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny mane ni kode kod ji duto chakre matin nyaka maduongʼ.
english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

kikuyu: Koro jatich Saulo moro ne nitie kanyo chiengʼno mane ogengʼne e nyim Jehova Nyasaye; ne en Doeg ma ja-Edom, mane jatend jokwadh Saulo.
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

kikuyu: Omiyo, ngʼama otamore winjo joma ni e loch, to otamore winjo gima Nyasaye ema oketo, kendo joma timo kamano biro yudo kum kuomgi giwegi.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

kikuyu: Hatush, Shebania, Maluk,
english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ruodh pinyno kelo chiwo mar hera ni Jehova Nyasaye, obed misango miwangʼo pep kata chiwo mar lalruok, to nyaka yawne rangach mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Enochiw misangone miwangʼo pepno kata chiwo mage mag lalruok mana kaka ojatimo chiengʼ Sabato. Eka enowuog odhi oko, kendo kosewuok odhi oko, to nolor rangach.
english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

kikuyu: Nomako ich kendo onywolo wuowi manochaki ni Er.
english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Sayun, kum mane okumugo biro rumo; bende ok nochak omed ndalou mar twech. To un jo-Edom, obiro kumou nikech richou kendo timbeu mamono obiro elo e lela.
english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.

kikuyu: Pinyni notingʼo: Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

kikuyu: An awuon ema asenyisou, aseresou kendo asewachonu ni an ema asetimo magi ma ok nyiseche manono ma un-go e dieru. Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Un e joneno maga ni an e Nyasaye.”
english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says the LORD, “and I am God.

kikuyu: Nyaka ine ni lopegi opog gi ombulu. Pok mar oganda ka oganda biro bedo kaluwore gi nying kweregi.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

kikuyu: Jomoko to chalo mana kaka kodhi mochwo kuonde motimo lwanda. Gin giwinjo Wach kendo girwake sano gi mor.
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo ngʼato kik wuondu.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Eka jotelogo nonyiso Baruk, “In kaachiel gi Jeremia, dhiuru kendo upondi. Kik uwe ngʼato ngʼe kuma untie.”
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

kikuyu: Keluru nyarwath machwe uyangʼ. Wachamuru wabed mamor.
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

kikuyu: Ogoro giko wi piny ewi pige kaka kiew mar ler gi mudho.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

kikuyu: Kik ucham ringʼo manumu kata motedi gi kado to nyaka ubul lemb chiayogo; wich, tielo kaachiel gi jamb-ich.
english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kony ngimana nikech nyingi iwuon; gola oko e chandruok nikech timni maber.
english: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

kikuyu: To oganda nodwokogi niya, “Ma en Yesu, janabi moa Nazareth, e piny Galili.”
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

kikuyu: To Josef ma jatend pinyno ema ji moa e pinje duto ne biro rundo kuome. Kuom mano, kane owete Josef ochopo, negikulore ne Josef nyaka e lowo.
english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

kikuyu: to giniwachi, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, mane ogolo nyithind Israel e piny ma yo nyandwat kendo e pinje duto mane oseriembogie.’ Bangʼe gibiro dak e pinygi giwegi.”
english: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”

kikuyu: Ruoth nolando wach kendo oganda mane okawo wachno mi okeye ne duongʼ mokalo:
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, adwaro mondo ungʼe malongʼo, owetena, ni kuom Yesu ema iyalonue yor weyo richo.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

kikuyu: Tongʼ-gi ma yo wuok chiengʼ nochakore Nam Chumbi modhi nyaka dho aora Jordan. Tongʼ-gi ma yo nyandwat nochakore kama aora Jordan donjogo e nam maduongʼ,
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Bende ingʼeyo gimomiyo asebiro iri? Onego adogi ma ok adeko mondo aked gi ruodh Pasia, to ka asedhi, ruodh jo-Yunani biro biro;
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.

kikuyu: Nyaka chil kawuono pod ok gibolore kata chiwo luor, bende pod ok girito chikena gi buchena mane amiyou kaachiel gi wuoneu.
english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.’

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok osiko kuoma, to ochalo gi bad yath motongʼ oko maner. Bede yath machal kamano ichoko kendo idiro e mach mi wangʼ.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

kikuyu: Opongʼo boche polo gi ngʼich mar pi kendo okeyo mil polo mare ei bochego.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

kikuyu: Ngʼaduru udhi Tarshish denguru, un joma odak e chula.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

kikuyu: Kuom mano negimiyo Jakobo nyiseche mag pinje mamoko mane gin-go kod stadi mane ni e itgi kendo Jakobo noyikogi e tiend yiend ober man Shekem.
english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

kikuyu: Isaka nowacho niya, “Koro asedoko moti kendo ok angʼeyo ndalo thona.
english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

kikuyu: To nokwere e nyimgi duto, kowacho niya, “Ok angʼeyo gima iwachono.”
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

kikuyu: kendo nogolo chik ni joma nodonjone okele iri]. Kuom mano, ka inone in iwuon, to ibiro ingʼeyo adiera kuom gik mwadonjonego duto.”
english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo niya, “Donge ji apar duto nopwodhi? Ere ji ochiko mamoko?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

kikuyu: Wechegi nowacho ayanga, mi Petro nokawe otere tenge mi okwere ni owe wuoyo kamano.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

kikuyu: To ka bede yath moko nolwer oko, mondo un, ma un kaka yadh bungu, ochomu kargi, eka omi un bende ucham mwandu kaachiel kodgi koa e tiend yadh Zeituni maduongʼ,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

kikuyu: Ji duto maneni biro ngʼiyi ka giwuoro, kendo penjo ka gihum kuom gima osetimore niya, “Bende ma e ngʼat mane yiengo piny kendo miyo pinjeruodhi tetni,
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

kikuyu: Ne en jadwar maratego e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Mano ema omiyo iwacho “Jadwar maratego e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka Nimrod.”
english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

kikuyu: momiyo koro daher mondo adera kendo atho, moloyo bedo gi ringruok ma an-goni.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

kikuyu: An awuon asingora ni abiro rite kendo en e lweta. Ka ok aduoge iri ka, to ikwana kaka jaketho e ndalo duto mag ngimana.
english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;

kikuyu: Dhako ma jakoko chalo gi kodh ajiki,
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

kikuyu: Joma timo neno ma wengegi tek sudo nyime; gipenja gik ma ok angʼeyo gimoro amora kuomgi.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Solomon kod jo-Israel duto notimo sawo kuom ndalo abiriyo. Ne en chokruok maduongʼ mochakore Lebo Hamath nyaka Wadi man Misri.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

kikuyu: kendo jo-Beth Shemesh nopenjo niya, “En ngʼa manyalo chungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasaye malerni? Ngʼatno ma Sandugni nodhine koa ka?”
english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before the LORD, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye kecho ji kendo ongʼwon, iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo en gihera mangʼeny.
english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

kikuyu: Jolweny nochopo chik mane omigi. Negikawo Paulo gotieno, mi gidhi kode nyaka Antipatris.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

kikuyu: Donge asendikoni weche mowachi piero adek, weche mag puonj kod ngʼeyo,
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

kikuyu: Ne oloko pach jo-Juda duto mane gibedo gi paro achiel. Ne giorone ruoth wach niya, “Duogi gi jogi duto.”
english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora ma ngʼat ma dende chwerno oidho kadhi wuoth bedo mogak,
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Petro nodwokogi niya, “Weuru richo kendo obatisu ngʼato ka ngʼato, e nying Yesu Kristo, mondo owenu richou. Ka mano otimore, to ubiro nwangʼo Roho Maler kaka mich.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: E ndalo ngimau kendo ka uneno anatiek koko mar ilo kae kod wende mag nyako midhi kendi kod wuowi madhi kendo.
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

kikuyu: Kuom mano joma neno sand kaluwore gi dwaro mar Nyasaye onego ochiw chunygi e lwet Jachwech ma ja-adiera kendo onego gidhi nyime gi timo timbe mabeyo.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

kikuyu: Eka negichiwo pesa ne jogedo kod funde bao, kendo gichiwo chiemo gi math gi mo ne jo-Sidon gi jo-Turo, mondo omi gikel sirni mag sida koluwo nam koa Lebanon nyaka Jopa, kaluwore gi thuolo mane ochiw gi Sairas ruodh Pasia.
english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

kikuyu: Oganda lweny omonjogi, gi ligengni mamil, kendo gi tonge mag lweny mamil! Joma ohinyore e lweny ngʼeny, kendo ringre joma otho ochok mangʼeny, ringre joma othogo okadho akwana, kendo joma ringo chwanyore kuom ringre joma othogo.
english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni piny Israel: “ ‘Giko osechopo! Giko osechopo e tunge piny duto angʼwen!
english: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

kikuyu: Saulo ne nigi dhako machielo ma nyinge Rizpa nyar Aiya. Kendo Ish-Boseth nopenjo Abner niya, “Marangʼo isedonjo e od wuora mi ikawo chiege miloko mari?”
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

kikuyu: Pok aweyo mak aluwo chike mowuok e dhoge; to asekawo weche mowuok e dhoge kaka mwandu maduongʼ moloyo chiemba mapile.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

kikuyu: Ogendini none timni makare, kendo ruodhi duto none duongʼ mari; bangʼe noluongi gi nying manyien, ma Jehova Nyasaye biro chaki.
english: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.

kikuyu: Negia malo mine giriembe gigole oko mar dala kendo tere e geng got kama nogerie dalano mondo gidhire olwar piny.
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Aram moa Damaski obiro konyo Hadadezer ruodh Zoba, Daudi nonego ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo kuomgi.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

kikuyu: Yesu noluongo jopuonjrene ire mowachonegi niya, “Akecho jogi nikech koro gisebedo koda kae kuom ndalo adek to gionge gi gima digicham. Ok adwar mondo gidhi ka gidenyo, nono to kech nyalo goyogi piny e yo.”
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

kikuyu: E thuolono Yesu nochungʼ e nyim ruoth, kendo ruoth nopenje niya, “In e ruodh jo-Yahudi koso?” To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ee, en kaka iwachono.”
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Ma e chier mokwongo. To joma otho mane odongʼ mane ok ochier e chierni, ne ok odoko mangima nyaka higni alufu achielgo norumo.
english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

kikuyu: Bende nitie oganda moro mosewinjo dwond Nyasaye kawuoyo e mach kaka usewinjoni ma obedo mangima?
english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

kikuyu: omiyo ruoth Joram nodok Jezreel mondo ochangi kuom hinyruok mane jo-Aram ohinyego e piny Ramoth ka nokedo gi Hazael ruodh Aram. Eka Ahazia wuod Jehoram ruodh Juda nodhi Jezreel mondo one Joram wuod Ahab nikech nosehinye.
english: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

kikuyu: nowachonegi niya, “Aseleko lek moro mosechanda ahinya kendo adwaro mondo angʼe tiende.”
english: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”

kikuyu: “Emomiyo chur, in wuod dhano! Chur e nyimgi gi chuny motur kod kuyo malit.
english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

kikuyu: Ka piny oru gokinyi unuwach niya, “Mad ne bedni en odhiambo” kendo godhiambo unuwach niya, “Mad ne piny bed ni en okinyi” nikech masira ma unune nopongʼ chunyu kod gik ma wengeu none.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

kikuyu: Ka usengʼado aora Jordan ma uchopo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, keturu kite moko kendo uwirgi maber.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

kikuyu: nikech abiro chuli maber kendo timoni gimoro amora miwacho. Bi mondo ikwongʼna ogandani.”
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

kikuyu: Ne ogero kende mag misengini e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho niya, “Nyinga nobed Jerusalem nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

kikuyu: Agombo nenou ahinya mondo apognue mich moko mag chuny mondo ategugo,
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

kikuyu: Eka negioro ni Jezebel wach kama, “Naboth osego gi kite motho.”
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

kikuyu: Jo-Amalek nobiro momonjo jo-Israel Refidim.
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

kikuyu: Eka jatijeno nokawo ngamia apar mag ruodhe, kod chiwo duto mabeyo mochako wuoth kodhi Aram-Naharaim (tiende ni, Mesopotamia) koluwo yo madhi dala matin mar Nahor.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

kikuyu: Kane oneno kaka welo yiero kuondegi mag bet moyiedhi, e kar mesa, nogoyonegi ngero kama:
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Sairas ruodh Pasia wacho: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach polo osemiya pinjeruodhi duto manie piny kendo oseyiera mondo agerne hekalu e Jerusalem manie piny Juda. Ngʼato angʼata kuom joge manie dieru, nyalo dhi kendo mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache bed kode.’ ”
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, the LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.’”

kikuyu: Usengʼado bura mi unego joma kare, mane ok ked kodu e yo moro amora.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

kikuyu: Abiro ngʼadone joga bura nikech timbegi mamono mar jwangʼa, kuom wangʼo ubani ne nyiseche mamoko kendo lamo gima lwetgi oseloso.
english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

kikuyu: E sa nogono mar otieno, jarit od twech nokawogi modhi olwokonegi adhondegi, bangʼe gikanyono nobatise, en kaachiel gi joode duto.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

kikuyu: Nikech kane awuotho kalworora ka anono malongʼo kuondeu mag lemo, to ne ayudo nyaka kendo mar misango mondikie niya, ‘Ne nyasaye ma ok ongʼe’. Koro gima ulamo kaka gima ok ongʼe ema adwaro yalonu.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

kikuyu: Kik ibed ngʼama chwanyore piyo e chunye; nikech joma ofuwo ema timo kamano.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

kikuyu: Pidhni kata sironi gin joneno ni ok nakadh pidhni mondo amonji kendo in bende ok nikadh pidhni kata sironi mondo imonja.
english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

kikuyu: Winjuru puonjna mondo ubed mariek, kik uchagi.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

kikuyu: Bed mamor, in wuowi matin, ka pod in rawera kendo tim gik moko duto ma chunyi dwaro. Tim gik moko duto ma chunyi gombo kendo wangʼi nyalo neno, to kata kamano nyaka ingʼe ni Nyasaye nongʼadni bura kuom gik moko duto mitimo.
english: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

kikuyu: Kata kamano noresogi nikech nyinge, mondo omi tekone maduongʼ ongʼere.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Resa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kuom joma richo, konya e lwet jo-mahundu,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

kikuyu: Ngeche muthoro mangʼenygo onge tich mana ka buch kendo; wecheu yomyom mana ka agulni mag lowo.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

kikuyu: Ka auka mager ofuto, to joricho otieko; to joma kare chungo motegno nyaka chiengʼ.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka gol chik mondo ngʼat matuono okelne winy ariyo maler mangima michamo gi yiend sida, gi usi makwar kod bad owino.
english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kikuyu: Eka Manoa nonono malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Nyingi ngʼa; mondo mi wabi wamiyi duongʼ ka wachni obedo adiera?”
english: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Bed motegno, yaye Zerubabel. Bed motegno, yaye Joshua wuod Jehozadak, ma jadolo maduongʼ.’ Jehova Nyasaye medo wacho ni, ‘Beduru motegno, un ji duto modak e pinyni kendo tiuru matek nimar an kodu,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Weruru ne Nyasaye, yaye pinjeruodhi mag piny, weruru wende pak ne Ruoth Nyasaye, Sela
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

kikuyu: Eka jadolo mowal nokaw remb rwadhno moko, mi nokele e Hemb Romo.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: To nikech gionge tiendegi Wach ok bedi eigi amingʼa. Ka chandruok kata sand obiro nigi nikech Wach Nyasaye to gipodho piyo piyo nono.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

kikuyu: To ka usiko ka utimo marach, to un kaachiel gi ruodhu ibiro tieku.”
english: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king.”

kikuyu: En e ma kongʼiyo piny to piny yiengni, kendo komulo gode to gode dhwolo iro.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo gabiriyo mar loch Jeroboam ruodh Israel, Azaria wuod Amazia ruodh Juda nobedo e loch.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Moloyo mano, amor, nikech in ngʼat molony e chike jo-Yahudi duto kod mbakagi ma ok rum, kendo makelo miero. Kuom mano, akwayi mondo iyie iwinj wechena gi ngʼwono, ma ok ijok.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

kikuyu: “Kaw gigi koa kuomgi, mondo iti kodgi e tij Hemb Romo. Migi jo-Lawi kaluwore gi tich ngʼato ka ngʼato.”
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

kikuyu: Wegiuru gitwi kaachiel giduto nyaka chiengʼ keyo. Ka kindeno ochopo to ananyis jokeyo mondo okuong ochok buya kendo otwegi pidhe pidhe mondo owangʼ-gi; eka bangʼe gichok ngano kendo gikel gikan e decha.’ ”
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

kikuyu: Kapo ngʼato openjou ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo utimo timni?’ To udwoke ni, ‘Ruoth dware, kendo obiro duoge bangʼ seche manok!’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

kikuyu: Kik ngʼat ma japiny moro moseyie kuom Jehova Nyasaye wachi ni, “Jehova Nyasaye biro kweda e kind ogandane adier.” Kendo ngʼato angʼata mabwoch kik wachi ni, “An mana ka yien motwo.”
english: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”

kikuyu: Miya jip gi olemb mzabibu mosemo e chiengʼ, duog chunya gi olemo mayom, nikech hera onura.
english: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ ndalo manok, wuowi machogono nokawo gige duto moloko pesa, eka nowuok modhi e piny mabor to kuro notiyo gi mwandune e yor dak e ngima mar anjawo.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

kikuyu: Nochako omako ich, kendo kane ochako onywolo wuowi nowacho niya, “Koro abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye.” Omiyo nochake ni Juda. Bangʼ mano noweyo nywolo nyithindo.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

kikuyu: Wach msalaba en fuwo ni joma lal, to ni wan joma iwaro, en teko Nyasaye,
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

kikuyu: Notingʼ lweti malo kiseloyo wasiki, kendo joma kedo kodi duto notieki.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, tho nobedo gi teko kuomgi chakre ndalo Adam nyaka ndalo Musa, kendo noloyo nyaka joma ne ok oketho chik kaka Adam, mane en kido mar Jal mane onego obi.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

kikuyu: Piny noyuso kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar adek.”
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nochako obirona kendo kama:
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Kik imi jatichni yud kum nimar onge kata ngʼato achiel matimo maber e nyimi.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko ogandano niya, “Kik ubed maluor. Chungʼuru motegno eka ubiro neno resruok ma Jehova Nyasaye biro kelonu kawuono. Jo-Misri ma uneno kawuononi ok unuchak une kendo.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya,“Donge asenyisou ni An e En. Ka an ema umanya, to weuru jogi odhi mondi.”
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

kikuyu: e kinde ka kinde madwaro changoe Israel, to richo mag Efraim elore kendo timbe mahundu mag Samaria fwenyore. Gihero wacho miriambo, jokwoge turo udi, jonjore mayo ji e yore;
english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel ne osewinjore gi joma nopondo ni ka gineno iro madhwolore e dalano,
english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora mane ruoth dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, joritogo ne tingʼo kuodigo kendo bangʼe negidwokogi e od jorito.
english: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

kikuyu: Liet mager mar chiengʼ nowangʼogi to negidhi nyime mana giyanyo nying Nyasaye man-gi teko mar gengʼo masichego, kendo negitamore hulo richogi mondo gimiye duongʼ.
english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

kikuyu: Maka motegno kaluwore gi singruokni, eka anabed mangima; kik iwe geno ma an-go lalna.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

kikuyu: Koro Mikal nyar Saulo nohero Daudi, omiyo kane ginyiso Saulo wachno, to Saulo nobedo mamor.
english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

kikuyu: nimar un duto mosebatisu kuom Kristo userwakoru gi Kristo.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noyawo dho pundano, kendo nowacho ne Balaam niya, “En angʼo masetimoni momiyo isegoya nyadidek?”
english: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

kikuyu: In miwacho ni ji kik terre, dibed ni to iterori? In ma ichayo nyiseche manono, dibed ni in to ikwelo ei hekalu mag nyiseche manonogo?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

kikuyu: piende rombe molok gi range makwar, piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe, yiend siala;
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

kikuyu: To mano kaka daher mondo Nyasaye odwoki kuom wachno,
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

kikuyu: kuom Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul kod Beth Mion,
english: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,

kikuyu: Musa bende nowacho ne Kora niya, “Koro Winjuru, un jo-Lawi!
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

kikuyu: Josia ne ja-higni aboro kane obedo ruoth kendo norito pinyno kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gachiel. Min mare ne nyinge Jedida nyar Adaya, mane aa Bozkath.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

kikuyu: Gengʼa kik adonji e yore mag miriambo, kendo ngʼwon-na ka ipuonja chikni.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

kikuyu: Negichako manyo yo mane ginyalo makego, to negiluoro oganda, nikech ji nokawe ni en janabi.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachonegi niya, “Winjuru, un jo-Benjamin! Bende wuod Jesse nomiu puothe gi puoth mzabibu? Bende enoketu jotend jolweny alufe kata jatend jolweny miche?
english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

kikuyu: Giwacho niya, “Ere kaka Nyasaye nyalo ngʼeyo? Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo to ongʼeyo angʼo?”
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Osenyisa kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye ni, ‘Kik ichiem kata kik imodh pi kanyo kata idog gi yo mane ibirogo.’ ”
english: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

kikuyu: “Omiyo ka uneno gima kwero makelo kethruok,mane owuo kuome gi dho janabi Daniel, kochungʼ kama ler, to dwarore ni jasomo owinj tiend wachni maber;
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

kikuyu: Kristo dipogre nyadi di? Paulo bende nogur e msalaba nikech un? Koso nuyudo batiso e nying Paulo?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

kikuyu: Edom to nyalo wacho niya, “Kata obedo ni miechwa osetieki kamano, to wabiro chako gerogi.” To ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Gibiro gedo to abiro muko miechgigo. Ibiro luong-gi ni oganda jopiny onjawre, jogo mosiko e bwo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” the LORD of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom the LORD shows wrath forever.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato machielo nodhi ei sinagogi kendo nopuonjo, to ngʼato ne ni kanyo ma lwete korachwich notal.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

kikuyu: eka ruodhi mabet e kom duongʼ Daudi nobi kakalo e rangeye mag dala maduongʼni gi jotendgi. Gin kod jotelo mag-gi ginibi ka giriembo geche kod farese, ka gin kaachiel gi jo-Juda kod jogo modak e Jerusalem, kendo dala maduongʼni enodage nyaka chiengʼ.
english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye notiek tuoche duto kuomu; bende ok nokelnu tuoche maricho mane uneno ka un Misri, to tuochego nomak mana wasiku mochayou.
english: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

kikuyu: Owetene nowachone niya, “Iparo ni inyalo telonwa? Bende inyalo telonwa adier?” Kendo negimedo bedo mamon kode nikech lekneno kod gimane owachonegi.
english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

kikuyu: Balak nopenjo Balaam niya, “En angʼo ma isetimona? Ne aomi mondo ikwongʼ wasika, to onge gima isetimo makmana gwedhogi!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

kikuyu: kendo owuok oketho nyinge komiye nying marach kendo owacho niya, “Ne anywomo dhakoni to kane ariwora kode to ne ok ayude gi gige ringre.”
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne oyie gi wachno mi otemogi kuom ndalo apar.
english: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

kikuyu: “To ngʼat mane sando nyawadgino nodhiro Musa gichien kowachone ni, ‘En ngʼa ma oketi ruoth kendo jangʼadnwa bura?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ji manie piny e kindeni nyombo kendo inyuomo.
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

kikuyu: kowacho ni, ‘Pak obed ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel mosemiyo wangʼa oneno ngʼama okawo lochna kawuono.’ ”
english: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Josef nodhi moyiko wuon mare. Jotich Farao duto nodhi kode, ma gin jok midewo mane tiyo e dalane kendo e piny Misri duto,
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

kikuyu: Jo-Nyasaye duto omosou.
english: All the saints greet you.

kikuyu: Magi e ruodhi mag pinyno mane Joshua kod jo-Israel oloyo yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, kochakore Baal Gad mantie e Holo mar Lebanon nyaka Got Halak mochakore yo Seir. Pinjegi duto Joshua nochiwo kaka girkeni ni dhout Israel kaluwore gi dhoutgi kaka opog-gi mondo obed mag-gi.
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

kikuyu: Jarit joma ni e od twech ne ok odewo rango gimoro amora mane oseketo e lwet Josef, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kod Josef kendo nogwedhe e gimoro amora mane otimo.
english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nowacho ne Laban, “Asetieko ndalo mane iketona, omiyo koro miya nyari mondo obed chiega.”
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

kikuyu: nimar Jal moritogi en ratego; obiro chwakogi e kindi kodgi.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

kikuyu: Kaka koro en gi duongʼ, kobet e bad Nyasaye korachwich, Wuoro osemiye Roho Maler mane osingore ni nochiw, kendo oseoro gima koro uneno kendo uwinjoni.”
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

kikuyu: Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Wuonu kod oweteni osebiro iri,
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

kikuyu: Koro omiyo, yier ji apar gariyo koa e dhout Israel, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot.
english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

kikuyu: gi lewni mochwe mag tij dolo mitiyogo e kama ler mar lemo ma gin lewni mag Harun jadolo kod lep yawuote ka gitiyogo kaka jodolo.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Ngʼama ochayo adiera bende nyalo rito loch adier? Ere gimomiyo iketo bura kuom ngʼama ja-ratiro kendo Jal Maratego?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

kikuyu: Kendo ka nyithindu nopenju gima tiend sawoni en,
english: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno, koro wan nyithind Nyasaye, to kaka wabiro bedo achien pok ongʼere. To wangʼeyo ni ka Kristo nofwenyre, to wanabed machal kode, nikech wananene kaka ochal.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

kikuyu: Mani ber kendo moro Nyasaye Jawarwa,
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

kikuyu: Negichokore Jerusalem e dwe mar adek e hik loch Asa mar apar gabich.
english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

kikuyu: Adier unyalo paro, jowetewa, kaka ne wanyagore kendo watiyo matek, ne watiyo odiechiengʼ gotieno mondo kik wami ngʼato angʼata tingʼ mapek e kinde mane wadak kodu ka wayalonu Injili mar Nyasaye.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

kikuyu: Nikech ne un gi kinde malach mokadho, nutimo gik ma jopiny ohero timo kaka: dwanyruok, gombo, mer, tugo e thum, math mar anjawo kod lamo nyiseche manono.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

kikuyu: Bende unukaw rombo achiel kugolo e kweth ka kweth mag rombe mia ariyo mogol e lege mag Israel kuonde ma lum ngʼichie mogik. Magi notigo kod mich mag cham, gi misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok mondo olosne ji yor pwodhruok, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, aseturo bad Farao ruodh Misri. Ok osemake mondo ochangi, kata riech pok orieye gi bepe mondo obed motegno, manyalo mako ligangla.
english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasach geno opongʼu gi mor kod kwe mogundho ka ugeno kuome, mondo omi upongʼ gi geno malach kuom teko mar Roho Maler.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Zebulun, en Elizafan wuod Parnak;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

kikuyu: Polo mondo obed moil, piny mondo obed mamor, we mondo giwachne e dier ogendini niya, “Jehova Nyasaye olocho!”
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

kikuyu: Donge an-gi ratiro mar timo gima adwaro gi pesana? Koso nyiego omaki koda nikech angʼwon?’
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

kikuyu: Nimar lodina ok pek kendo misika yot.”
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

kikuyu: Bed motegno kendo wakeduru motegno ne jowa kendo ni mier madongo mag Nyasachwa. Jehova Nyasaye notim gima ber e nyim wangʼe.”
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

kikuyu: Hathak nodok ir Esta monyise weche mane Modekai owacho.
english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

kikuyu: Eka Elija nochikogi kawacho niya, “Makuru jonabi mag Baal. Kik uwe ngʼato tony!” Ne gimakogi mi Elija nochiwo chik mondo tergi Holo mar Kishon kendo nonegogi kuro.
english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, lonyuru oko kit kethruok gi richo duto, ma kindegi opongʼo piny kendo bolreuru kurwako wach mopidhi e chunyu, manyalo konyou.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

kikuyu: Ne awinjo ma chunya noridore, dhoga nomoko kane awinjo kokono; chokena nonyosore kendo tiendena notetni. To kata kamano abiro rito ka ahora ni odiechieng masira mabiro mako oganda ma monjowa chopi.
english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

kikuyu: Ahaz nochoko gige lemo mag hekalu mar Nyasaye mogologi oko. Eka noloro dhout hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye bangʼe nogero kende mag misango e kamoro amora ma yore mag Jerusalem ogomoe.
english: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni unyalo fuyo malo mabor ka ongo, kendo ugero kar daku maber e kind sulwe malo, to koa kuno abiro dwokou piny,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Yawuot Reuel wuod Esau ne gin: Jaduongʼ Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza. Magi e jodongo ma nyikwa Reuel mane odak Edom; bende ne gin nyikwa Basemath chi Esau.
english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Giro mar farese mag wasigu iwinjo koa Dan; kendo ywak farese mathuondi miyo piny tetni. Gibiro tieko piny duto kod gik moko manie iye, dala maduongʼ kod ji duto modak kanyo.
english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell therein.”

kikuyu: “Dhiuru e kambi kendo unyis ji ni, ‘Ikuru gigeu mag lweny. Ndalo adek koa kawuono ubiro kalo aora Jordan gikae mondo udhi kendo ukaw mwandu mar piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka maru owuon.’ ”
english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess.’”

kikuyu: Moko kuom jopuonjrene nopenjore e kindgi giwegi niya, “Ere tiend gima owachonwa ni, ‘Bangʼ kinde matin ok ubi nena, to achien unuchak unena,’ kendo owacho bende ni ‘adhi ka Wuoro’?”
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo iparo ni iber moloyo ngʼat machielo? Angʼo ma in-go mane ok omiyi? To ka gima in-gono nomiyi, to angʼo momiyo isungori mana ka gima ne ok omiyigo?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni onge jatich maduongʼ moloyo ruodhe motiyone, kata jaote ok duongʼ moloyo ngʼama oore.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

kikuyu: Ka ruoth otimona ngʼwono kendo ihera kendo ka iyie mondo itim kwayona, to yie mondo ruoth gi Haman mondo obi e nyasi ma kiny nalosnu. Eka abiro dwoko ruoth penjoneno.
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

kikuyu: Eka Omri gi jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nowuok Gibethon mi gimonjo Tirza.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

kikuyu: “To e chuny otieno koko moro nogore matek ni, ‘Wuon kisera eri odonjo! Wuoguru oko mondo uromne!’
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

kikuyu: En ema nyaka umiye pak, nimar en Nyasachu ma osetimo timbe madongo kendo malich ma useneno gi wengeu.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: Ruoth Rehoboam nooro Adoniram mane jarit joma ichuno mondo oti githuon, to jo-Israel duto nochiele gi kite motho. Kata kamano ruoth Rehoboam nonwangʼo thuolo moidho gache nyaka Jerusalem mondo otony.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Kane ndalo ochopo mondo Nyasaye ochop singruok mane otimo ni Ibrahim, noyudo ka kar kwan jowa mane odak Misri ne osemedore.
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

kikuyu: Rituru chiengʼ Sabato kendo ukete obed maler, kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechikou.
english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

kikuyu: Rieko goyo koko matek e yore mag dala, ogoyo koko bende e kuonde chokruok;
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

kikuyu: Kech ok nokagi kata riyo ok nologi, bende liet mar kama otimo ongoro, kata chiengʼ marieny makech ok nomigi olo. Jal ma chunye opongʼ gi kech, ema notelnigi mi tergi kuonde sokni mag pi.
english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.

kikuyu: Joma ni e twech ma luoro omako ibiro gony machiegni; ok ginitho e kuondegi mag twech kendo ok ginichand chiemo.
english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

kikuyu: Stefano nodwoko niya, “Owetena kod wuonena, winjauru! Nyasaye man-gi duongʼ maber nofwenyore ni wuonwa Ibrahim kane pod odak e piny Mesopotamia, kane pok odar odhi odak Haran.
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

kikuyu: Piny tetni e nyimgi, polo bende yiengni, chiengʼ gi dwe lokore mudho, to sulwe bende ok rieny.
english: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

kikuyu: kaka terruok mau kod gombo mau mandhaga, kod chode mau maonge wichkuot! Aseneno timbeu mamono ewi gode matindo kod e pewe. Mano kaka nine malit, yaye Jerusalem! Nyaka karangʼo mibiro bedo mochido?”
english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”

kikuyu: Kiny gokinyi mangʼich ne giwuok mi gidhi e piny manie got. Negiwacho niya, “Wasetimo richo. Wabiro dhi nyaka kama Jehova Nyasaye nosingo.”
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”

kikuyu: Koro lokuru yoreu gi timbeu kendo uluor Nyasachu. Eka Jehova Nyasaye nolok pache kendo ok nokel masira kuomu mosechano timonu.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the LORD your God’s voice; then the LORD will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.

kikuyu: Berne malich norum mana ka maua maner, mopidhi ei holo momiyo, mi nochal ka olemb ngʼowu mokwongo chiek, ngʼato angʼata monene pone, kendo chame ka rikni morum chuth.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

kikuyu: Omiyo bolreuru e bwo Loch Nyasaye. Kweduru Satan, eka noringu.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

kikuyu: Nyaka ine ni igerogi machal gi kido mane onyisi ewi got.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Eber nonywolo yawuowi ariyo: Achiel nochak ni Peleg, nikech e ndalono ema nopogie piny; owadgi to ne nyinge Joktan.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Ne en chik ni mondo ogony ngʼat achiel motwe e kinde mag sawo mar Pasaka kaluwore gi kwayo mar jopiny.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

kikuyu: Gikanyono Safira nogore piny e tiend Petro mi otho. Eka yawuowi nobiro modonjo, to kane giyude ka osetho, ne gitingʼe gitere oko mi giike e bath chwore.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata modak e dala maduongʼni noneg gi ligangla, kech kod masira. To ngʼatno mowuok kendo otingʼo bade ne jo-Babulon molworou; notony gi ngimane.
english: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jo-Lawi ne ok okwan gi jo-Israel mamoko, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mwandu ngʼato sa moro nyalo reso ngimane, to jochan onge gima bwogo.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

kikuyu: Ji duto noneno moyie gimor; adieri negimor gi gik moko duto ma ruoth notimo.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka Ruoth Nyasaye nochiko mondo joma lando Injili oyud konyruok duto mag ngimagi koa kuom Injili ma giyalo.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

kikuyu: Aluor kendo denda tetni; kibaji ogoya matek.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

kikuyu: Dhoga wacho gima adiera nikech dhoga kwedo gik maricho.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

kikuyu: An e Nyasaye mane ofwenyoreni Bethel kamane iwiroe siro gi mo kendo kama ne isingori kikwongʼori ne an. Koro wuogi ia e pinyni kendo idog thuru.’ ”
english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro bedo nigi malich ka oketho nyiseche duto e piny. Ogendini duto modak e alwora mar dho nembe duto nolame, ngʼato ka ngʼato nolame e pinygi owuon.
english: The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nonyiso Harun gi yawuote kod jo-Israel duto wachno.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ka ubiro ir jo-Amon, to kik uchandgi kata dwaro tugo kodgi lweny, nimar ok anamiu gimoro amora e piny jo-Amon. Asechiwe kaka girkeni ne nyikwa Lut.”
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni chik ber mana ka ngʼato konyore kode e yo mowinjore.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

kikuyu: Kapod gidongo maber kendo pod ok ongʼolgi oko, to gitwo piyo moloyo lum.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

kikuyu: Ne nitie bende ohinga ma oko mane oringo e laini achiel mopimore gi utego kod laru ma oko; ohingano nochwalore e nyim udi mapinygo maromo fut piero abiriyo gabich.
english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

kikuyu: mondo ji duto omi Wuowi duongʼ mana kaka gimiyo Wuoro duongʼ. Ngʼat ma ok mi Wuowi duongʼ ok mi Wuoro mane ooro Wuowino duongʼ.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo ngʼado bura moro amora ne joma Nyasaye oseyiero? Nyasaye owuon ema keto ji kare.
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oselando wachne e tung pinje duto niya: “Wachne nyar Sayun ni, ‘Ne, Jaresni biro! Ne, michne ni e lwete kendo jogo mosegonyo wuotho kode.’ ”
english: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowinjo Lea kendo Lea nomako ich mi onywolone Jakobo wuowi mar abich.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

kikuyu: “Chunguru kendo umonj pinyni momewo, modak kodhil,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho, “piny maonge dhorangeye kata lodi; joge odak kendgi.
english: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says the LORD; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.

kikuyu: Kane giyuda e hekalu ka adhi timo mano, negiyudo ka asepwodhora kendo aler. Onge chokruok mar ji mane ni koda, kata tim koko moro mane asechako.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

kikuyu: Ogwendego nochikre kuomi, kuom jogi kendo kuom jodongi duto.”
english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

kikuyu: To Jakobo ne ok ooro Benjamin mowadgi Josef hie kodgi nikech noluor ni dipo ka gimoro ohinye.
english: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

kikuyu: Eka Hezekia nowacho niya, “Koro usechiworu ne Jehova Nyasaye, biuru mondo ukel misengni kod chiwo mag erokamano e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.” Omiyo joma nochokore nokelo misengini kod chiwo mag goyo erokamano kendo jogo duto ma chunygi ne oyie nokelo misango miwangʼo pep.
english: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the LORD’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

kikuyu: Kane Laban osedhi ngʼado yie rombe, Rael nokwalo nyiseche mag wuon-gi.
english: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mawacho niwuotho e ler to mon gi wadgi pod osiko e mudho.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

kikuyu: “Reuben, in e wuoda makayo, kendo in e tekona kendo in e ranyisi mokwongo mar tekra, bende in giluor mangʼeny kod teko mangʼeny.
english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Tarshish noloko kodi nikech mwandugi mangʼeny mag ohala; ne giwilo kodi fedha gi nyinyo gi chumbe, kod kite mamoko ma nengogi tek.
english: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

kikuyu: Koro bi gi jolweny duto mondo ilwor dala maduongʼ kendo ikawe. Ka ok kamano to abiro kawo dala maduongʼno kendo ibiro luonge gi nyinga.”
english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

kikuyu: Ne achiwo chik motegno mondo opwodh odno, bangʼe to ne adwoko gik milemogo mag od Nyasaye gi chiwo mar cham kod ubani.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro neno kendo golo mirimbe oko kuome.
english: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

kikuyu: To e laini ka laini mondo ukete ubani maler, mondo obed kaka rapar mar makati ma ichiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango miwangʼo pep.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane ji owinjo wachno, chunygi nongʼadonigi bura, mine giwachone Petro kod joote mamoko niya, “Owetewa, en angʼo ma dwatim?”
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

kikuyu: Emomiyo ngʼato angʼata mobolore kaka nyathini e ngʼat maduongʼ moloyo e pinyruodh polo.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Ochamo buru, chunye mobam wuonde; ok onyal resore kende, kata wacho ni, “Donge gima ni e lweta korachwich ni miriambo?”
english: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”

kikuyu: To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ikecha; chunga malo, mondo achulgi.
english: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

kikuyu: Joma kamago ema donjo e miech ji kendo gihoyo mon ma pachgi yomyom mogangore gi kit richo mayoreyore kendo ma gombo maricho ywayo pachgi koni gi koni,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

kikuyu: to jolwenj Babulon nolawo Ruoth Zedekia kendo ojuke e pewe mag Jeriko. Jolweny mage duto noringo oweye moke,
english: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

kikuyu: nyikwa Pahath-Moab (mowuok e dhood Jeshua gi Joab), ji alufu ariyo mia aboro gi apar gaboro (2,818),
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

kikuyu: Kane janabi mane odwoge chien e wuodhe owinjo ma nowacho niya, “En ngʼat Nyasaye mane ochayo wach Nyasaye. Jehova Nyasaye osechiwe ni sibuor mosekidhe kendo onege mana kaka wach Jehova Nyasaye nosesieme.”
english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”

kikuyu: Nochako olimo dala mar Kana, manie piny Galili, kama ne oloke pi divai. To ne nitie jatelo moro ma wuode ne tuo Kapernaum.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

kikuyu: Omiyo un bende, ka usetimo gik moko duto mane onyisu mondo utim, onego uwach ni, ‘Wan mana jotich aticha ma ok owinjore to wasetimo mana tijwa.’ ”
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

kikuyu: Ot maduongʼ mane nitie e nyim ot matin-no ne romo fut piero abich gochiko e borne.
english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

kikuyu: Omiyo Samuel nonyise weche duto ma ok opandone gimoro. Eka Eli nowachone niya, “En e Jehova Nyasaye, we otim gima oneno ni longʼone.”
english: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is the LORD. Let him do what seems good to him.”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye ma nono chunjewa, ongʼeyo gima Roho paro, nikech Roho kwayo ni jomaler kaluwore gi dwaro Nyasaye.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

kikuyu: Bende ne nitiere Ibhar, Elishua, Elifelet,
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

kikuyu: Koro, Jehova Nyasaye, mad imi singruok mane imiyo wuora Daudi ochopi, nikech iseketa ruoth kuom oganda mangʼeny ka buru manie piny.
english: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

kikuyu: Uzia noloso ni jolweny kuodi gi tonge gi ogute gi akor mag nyinyo gi atunge gi kite midiro gorujre.
english: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

kikuyu: Kapo ni ngʼato omonji, to ok nobed ni an ema aore; to ngʼato angʼata momonji nochiwre e lweti.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho nigi: Neuru, an awuon abiro ngʼado bura e kind rombe machwe kod rombe modhero.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

kikuyu: Enobed puodho mojwangʼ, motwo, kendo machalo gunda e nyima; pinyno duto noyugno nikech onge ngʼama dewe.
english: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.

kikuyu: Mar Daudi. Pak Jehova Nyasaye, yaye chunya; chunya maiye duto mondo opak nyinge maler.
english: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi nopwodhore giwegi kendo negiluoko lepgi. Bangʼ mano Harun nochiwogi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo mi notimonegi misango mondo opwodhgigo.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

kikuyu: “To in wuode, yaye Belshazar, pok ibolori, kata obedo ni ne ingʼeyo wechegi duto.
english: “You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

kikuyu: e kinde ma jodolo madongo ne gin Anas gi Kaifas, wach Nyasaye ne obiro ne Johana wuod Zekaria e thim.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

kikuyu: To Samuel nowachone niya, “Ok anyal dok kodi. Isedagi luwo wach Jehova Nyasaye, kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye bende osedagi ni kik ibed ruodh Israel!”
english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected the LORD’s word, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik mondo okelne jokor wach, joma riek ma jo-Kaldea kod jo-nyakalondo kendo nowachone jomariek ma Babulon niya, “Ngʼato angʼata mosomo ndikoni kendo onyisa tiende, to ibiro rwakne law maralik kendo ibiro ketne thiwni mar dhahabu e ngʼute, bende ibiro kete jalupna mar adek kuom duongʼ e pinyruoth.”
english: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing and shows me its interpretation shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

kikuyu: Kamano Daudi nokwero joge kendo ne ok oyienegi mondo gitug dhawo gi Saulo. Omiyo Saulo nowuok e rogo modhi e yore.
english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oseolo mirimbe mangʼeny ka iye owangʼ. Osemoko mach Sayun moketho mise mage.
english: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

kikuyu: An e makati mar ngima ma nobiro e piny koa e polo. Ka ngʼato moro amora ochamo makatini, to obiro bet mangima nyaka chiengʼ. Makatini en ringra, ma abiro chiwo mondo piny oyud ngima.”
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

kikuyu: Koa e nyikwa Harim: Maseya, Elija, Shemaya, Jehiel gi Uzia.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

kikuyu: “Aa ka, dhi yo wuok chiengʼ kendo ipondi e holo mar Kerith man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan.
english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

kikuyu: Jomaler gie chunygi gin joma ogwedhi, nimar ginine Nyasaye.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

kikuyu: Bond tongʼe ne chalo gi lodi, lew tonge to pekne ne romo kilo abiriyo. Jatingʼne okumba notelo nyime.
english: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.

kikuyu: Kane pod odongʼ ndalo auchiel mondo Pasaka ochopi, Yesu notundo Bethania, kama Lazaro nodakie, mane en ngʼat mane Yesu ochiero oa kuom joma otho.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Nikech ok wanyal timo gimoro amora makwedo adiera, to mana ma siro adiera.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

kikuyu: Mosnauru Maria, mosebedo katiyonwa matek ahinya e dieru.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

kikuyu: Kane Paulo ochopo e ndiri midonjogo ka jolweny, jogo koro ne ger marach mi nochuno askeche mondo otingʼe.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, jadolo nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre gi pi. Bangʼe onyalo donjo e kambi, makmana ni obiro bedo mochido nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Nyithindgi ma ok ongʼeyo chikni nyaka winji mondo opuonjre luoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ndalo ma udakgo e piny ma ubiro kawo ka usengʼado aora Jordan.”
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

kikuyu: Dwoko wach mamuol kweyo mirima, to wach makwiny jimbo ich wangʼ.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nokawo tongʼ kod puga mar pi mane nitie machiegni gi wi Saulo kendo negidhi. Onge ngʼama nonenogi kata mane ongʼeyo wachno, bende onge ngʼama ne ochiewo. Giduto ne ginindo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi nindo matut.
english: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it, or knew it, nor did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.

kikuyu: To ongʼere ni joma omi tich mar rito nyaka bed jo-adiera.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

kikuyu: Isetingʼo lwedo ma korachwich mar wasike malo; isemiyo wasike duto oil.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mag loch Josia kod mago duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitabu mag weche mag ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Bor polo mar Jehova Nyasaye noumogi godiechiengʼ kane giwuok e kargi mar bworo.
english: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

kikuyu: Kar romb jotelo mag anywola mane otelo ne jolweny ne gin alufu ariyo gi mia auchiel.
english: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno anago faras ka faras gi kihondko, to joriemb faras nolokre joneko,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho. “Abiro miyo dhood Juda rit makende, to farese mag ogendini mamoko analok muofni.
english: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mofuwo chayo kum mar wuon mare, to ngʼat mawinjo ka ikwere nyiso rieko.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
