kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro resi adier kuom gik mochikigo mondo ohinyi kendo kuom tuoche maricho maneko.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

kikuyu: Ket jo-Lawi ochungʼ e nyim Harun kod yawuote bangʼe ichiwgi kaka misango mifwayo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Musa gi Harun nodonjo e Hemb Romo, to kane giwuok oko to negigwedho ji, kendo duongʼ maler mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ni oganda duto.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ruoth nokwongʼore kowacho niya, “Adier akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ma oseresa e chandruok duto,
english: The king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

kikuyu: Kuom nyiseche duto mag ogendini mane kwerena otieko, en mane kuomgi mosereso joge e lweta? Angʼo momiyo uparo ni nyasachu biro resou e lweta?
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

kikuyu: Joma obolore nochak obed gi mor kuom Jehova Nyasaye; kendo joma ochando, bende nobed gi mor kuom Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: “Finehas wuod Eliazar, ma wuod Harun jadolo, osetieko mirimba kuom jo-Israel; nimar en gi nyiego machal gi mara; mano emomiyo ne ok atiekogi kata obedo nine an kod mirima kodgi kamano.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

kikuyu: Wuothuru e yore duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechikou mondo ubed mangima kendo ubed gi mwandu mondo omi ngimau omedre e piny ma ubiro kawo.
english: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nokwako owadgi Benjamin, kendo noywak kendo Benjamin bende nokwake kaywak.
english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

kikuyu: to e higa mar adek mar lochne noloso sawo ne jodonge gi jotije duto gi jotend lweny man Pasia gi Media gi joka ruoth, gi jodongo duto mag pinje bende ne nitie.
english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi dhako manie dwe, mano okuodo wi dhakono, nikech oele nyaka kama rembe wuokie, dhakono bende oseyie moel nyaka kama rembe wuokie. Giduto nyaka riembgi gia e dier ogandagi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo aore mol kawuok kuonde motwo, kendo sokni biro tuch e holni. Abiro miyo piny motimo ongoro bed gi pi thidhna, kendo kuonde motimo okak sokni nowuogie.
english: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

kikuyu: “Elam ni kuno, kaachiel gi ogandane duto kolworo liende. Giduto oseneg-gi, kendo gisepodho e dho ligangla. Ji duto mane osebedo ka bwogo ji e piny joma ngima osedhi piny ei lowo ka ok otergi nyangu. Wichkuot koro omakogi kaachiel gi joma ridore kochomo bur matut.
english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Anyiso giko mar gimoro mana e kinde mochakore, bende asebedo kahulo gik mapok otimore. Awacho ni: Gima awacho nyaka timre kendo abiro timo gimoro amora mahero.
english: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

kikuyu: Jotend Zoan osebedo joma ofuwo, jodong Memfis osewuondi; kendo jotelogi osewito jo-Misri.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

kikuyu: To mano gima ok nyal bwogowa nikech kata Satan bende wuondore ni en malaika mar ler.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

kikuyu: to pacha nolal kendo ne abedo mofuwo, ne achalo le maonge rieko e nyimi.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ka kawuono ibiro doko jatich mar jogi mondo itinegi kendo kimiyogi dwoko mowinjore, to gibiro bedo jotichni ndalo duto.”
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kanyo mondo gibuor, negidhi mi gibet e laru mar dala maduongʼ, to onge ngʼama norwakogi mondo giyud kar nindo.
english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

kikuyu: Jolweny duto mane ni kode ne wuotho ka gichomo dala maduongʼ nyaka negichopo machiegni kode. Negigero kambigi yo nyandwat mar Ai, ka holo ni e kindgi kod dala maduongʼ.
english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.

kikuyu: An gi geno kuom Ruoth ni ok ubi yie rwako paro moro mopogore moa kuom ngʼat machielo. To ngʼatno mosewitou gi puonj mobamno nyaka Nyasaye bi kume, kata bed ni en ngʼama nade.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

kikuyu: Kata, ka it nyalo wacho niya, “Kaka ok an wangʼ, ok an achiel kuom fuonde ringruok,” to mano ok nyal mone bedo achiel kuom fuonde ringruok.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Nikech un duto unyalo hulo wach, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato koro bangʼ nyawadgi, mondo ji duto oyud puonj kod jip.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

kikuyu: “Losne raum mar pwodhruok gi dhahabu maler ma borne romo fut angʼwen gi nus kendo lachne romo fut achiel gi nus.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: kuwacho niya, “Mad ndalo mag lemo mar dwe manyien rum piyo, mondo wayud thuolo mar uso cham.” Bende upenjoru niya, “Ndalo mag Sabato to biro rumo karangʼo mondo wagol chambwa warundi, eka wanyalo choro nengo malo, kendo tiyo gi rapim ma ok nikare, ma wawuondogo jongʼiewo!
english: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;

kikuyu: Herode ne dwaro nego Johana, to noluoro oganda nikech ne gikawe kaka janabi.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

kikuyu: Lowo mano gedoe nongʼiewo kuom yawuot Hamor ma wuon Shekem gi fedha madirom mia achiel.
english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Bende iwinjo gima nyithindogi wacho?” Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ee, awinjo. Kare pok usomo kama wacho ni, “ ‘Ne isechano mondo nyithindo kod nyithindo mayom omiyi pak’?”
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

kikuyu: Puonj nyathi e yo monego odhiye, to ka obedo maduongʼ to ok obi baro oa kuome.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

kikuyu: Ol mirimbi kuomgi; we mirimbi mager omakgi.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

kikuyu: Yesu nonyisogi niya, “Un duto ubiro ringo uweya, nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Abiro goyo jakwath mi rombe noke.’
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Paulo noweyo jowete e dala mar Korintho, kendo nokwangʼ kodhi Siria ka gin kaachiel gi Priskila kod Akula. Kane pok giwuok, ne oliel wi Paulo Kenkrea, nikech singruok moro mane osetimo.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

kikuyu: Ne amiye kinde mondo olokre owe richo mar chode to notamore.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

kikuyu: “Ok giluoro Nyasaye kata matin.”
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

kikuyu: Nyisie teko mar herani maduongʼ, in ma ireso ji gi lweti ma korachwich, joma pondo ne wasikgi kuomi.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

kikuyu: Kel jo-Lawi e nyim Hemb Romo kendo ichok oganda duto mar dhood Israel.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano los ludhe mag yiend siala kendo ibawgi gi dhahabu.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Konya kendo gola e chandruok, nikech timni makare; winja kendo iresa.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia ne ni ewi got moro to jo-Israel bende ne ni e got machielo to holo ne ni e kindgi.
english: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa niya, “Ma e ranyisi mar singruok ma asetimo e kinda kod gik mangima duto manie piny.”
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Bende ungʼeyo kaka ne ok aweyo mak anyisou wach moro amora mane nyalo konyou, to napuonjou e lela kendo e uteu, ka adonjo e ot ka ot.
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

kikuyu: napudh jo-Israel oko ma agolgi e pinya mane amiyogi kendo anakwed hekaluni ma asepwodho nikech Nyinga. Enobed ka ngero kendo gima ji duto jaro.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nopondo machiegni gi Gibea.
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

kikuyu: Nyasaye biro gwedhowa, kendo piny duto koni gi koni biro luore.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

kikuyu: Donge ne wanyisi e piny Misri ni, ‘Wewa, mondo watine jo-Misri?’ Dine bernwa tiyo ni jo-Misri moloyo tho e thim!”
english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

kikuyu: nimar yiende sida duto maboyo moriere man Lebanon kendo yiende mag ober duto man Bashan,
english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

kikuyu: Eka nonindo e tiend yien ma nindo otere. Mapiyo piyo nono malaika nomule mowachone niya, “Chungʼ malo mondo ichiem.”
english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

kikuyu: kaachiel gi jowetene ma jolupne e tich, mane gin: Zekaria, Jaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaya, Maseya, Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom kod Jeyel ma jorit rangeye.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

kikuyu: Nodhi ir Pilato, mokwayo ringre Yesu.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Turo osegero kar pondo mare motegno; kendo osechoko fedha, gi dhahabu modhurore ka pith.
english: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: un joma odhier kod joma idew, jo-mwandu gi jodhier machalre:
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kikuyu: Nokok gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya, “Yaye Babulon dala maduongʼ osepodho piny! Osepodho piny! Osedoko kar dak mar jochiende, kendo odoko gunda ma chuny duto mochido odakie, kaachiel gi winy duto ma ok ler kendo makwero.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

kikuyu: ka en gi kama otuch e diere ma wich wuokie. Kama otuch ma wich wuokieno nyaka twangʼ gi pien mondo kik oyiechi.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

kikuyu: Ner ne wuon Kish, Kish ne wuon Saulo, to Saulo ne wuon Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab kod Esh-Baal.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama twangʼo rabaw mar law manyien kuom law moti, nimar rabaw mar law manyien-no biro mich mi ywa law machon-no, mi omed yiech moloyo.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowachone jotije niya, “Dwaruru ngʼat magoyo thum maber mondo ukelna.”
english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

kikuyu: Laban nodwoko Jakobo niya, “Mon-go gin nyiga, nyithindogo gin nyithinda, kendo kwethgo gin kwethga. Gik moko duto minenogo gin maga. To koro en angʼo marach madatimne nyigagi, kata ne nyithindo ma ginywolo?
english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

kikuyu: Ma e ote mane Jehova Nyasaye owachone Jeremia janabi kuom biro Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon mondo omonj Misri:
english: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt:

kikuyu: Anaketh mier madongo manie pinyu mochiel motegno kendo anamuk ohingau.
english: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.

kikuyu: Jo-miriambo mathoth, modagi yie ni Yesu Kristo ne obiro e ringruok, osebiro e piny. Ngʼat ma kamano en jawuond, kendo en e Jasik Kristo.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

kikuyu: “Ka inyisogi magi duto, ok giniwinji; ka iluongogi, ok gini miyi dwoko.
english: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

kikuyu: Par Tobia kod Sanbalat, yaye Nyasacha, kuom gima gisetimo; par bende janabi madhako miluongo ni Noadia kod jonabi mamoko mosetemo bwoga.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo biro chiwogi kaka misango, achiel kuomgi mar misango migologo richo to machielo to mar misango miwangʼo pep. E yo machalo kama obiro tero kwayo mar weyo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne ngʼatno ma dende chwer mondo opwodhe.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.

kikuyu: To pod nyaka obedie e polo nyaka chop kinde ma Nyasaye ketoe gik moko duto kare, mana kaka nosesingore chon gi dho jonabi mage maler.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

kikuyu: Nopogo ji mia adekgo e migepe adek, komiyogi duto turumbete kod njagi maonge gimoro e iye e lwetgi, ka nitiere toch ei njagigo.
english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

kikuyu: Tongʼ ma yo podho chiengʼ nochopo nyaka e dho Nam Maduongʼ. Magi e tongʼ mar jo-Juda kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

kikuyu: Wayie ni Yesu notho mochier oa kuom joma otho, omiyo wayie ni Nyasaye biro chiero jomo oyie duto mosetho kaachiel kode.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

kikuyu: Koro angʼo momiyo isemuko ohinga mage, momiyo ji duto makadho pone ka olemo.
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

kikuyu: nimar ne ok giyie kuom Nyasaye kata geno kuom resruok mare.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro ka nyithind Ayub ne chiemo kendo metho e od owadgi maduongʼ,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: Waduto wan gi wuonewa e piny ka ma kumowa to eka pod wamiyogi mana luor. Koro donge onego wawinj Wuonwa mar chuny moloyo, mondo eka wabed mangima?
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

kikuyu: Gin jopiny, omiyo giwuoyo kuom pinyni kendo piny winjogi.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

kikuyu: Ne atingʼi malo ka agoli e buru mi aketi jatend joga Israel to niwuotho e yore mag Jeroboam mi nimiyo joga Israel otimo richo kendo ne uchwanya mi imiyo abet gi mirima nikech richo magu.
english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

kikuyu: Wadaguru e ngima mobidhore kaka joma ni e ler mar odiechiengʼ, ka waweyo kit richo duto kaka, tugo e thum, mer, terruok, anjawo, dhawo kod nyiego.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

kikuyu: Mier mag Juda kod jo-Jerusalem nodhi kendo ywakne nyiseche manono ma giwangʼone ubani, to ok ginikonygi ngangʼ ka masira ochopo.
english: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

kikuyu: Asebedo kaka nyarombo mamuol mitero kar yengʼo; ne ok afwenyo nine gisechano timona marach, kagiwacho niya, “Watiek yath kaachiel gi olembene; wagole oko oaye piny joma ngima, mondo nyinge kik par kendo.”
english: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en jalweny; Jehova Nyasaye e nyinge.
english: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.

kikuyu: Enopandi kuom dhok makwongʼi, kendo ok niluor kethruok mabiro.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

kikuyu: (Kata kamano Zelofehad wuod Hefer ne onge yawuowi; to ne en mana gi nyiri kende, ma nyingegi ne gin Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka gi Tirza.)
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Jehoyada jadolo nokawo sanduku moro, motucho raumne kendo nokete e bat korachwich mar kendo mar misango kama ochomore gi dhood hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Pesa duto mane donjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, jodolo ma jorit dhoot ne ketogi e sandukuno.
english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.

kikuyu: Abram noyie kuom Jehova Nyasaye, mi Jehova Nyasaye nokwane kaka ngʼama kare.
english: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.

kikuyu: To kama negigure Yesuno ne nitie puodho moro, kendo ei puodhono ne nitie bur manyien mapok oike ngʼato.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

kikuyu: Joash nonywolo Amazia, Amazia nonywolo Azaria, Azaria nonywolo Jotham,
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

kikuyu: kata kitamo ngʼato e ratiro mare e nyim Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
english: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

kikuyu: mondo gipondne jo-Babulon. Ne giluorogi nikech Ishmael wuod Nethania nosenego Gedalia wuod Ahikam, mane ruodh Babulon oyiero kaka jatelo e pinyno.
english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

kikuyu: Noywak kokwongʼo kendo misangono kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye: “Yaye kendo mar misango! Yaye kendo mar misango! Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ‘Wuowi miluongo ni Josia ibiro nywol e od Daudi. Kuomi e nochiwe jodolo mag kuonde motingʼore makoro chiwo misengini kuomi, kendo choke dhano ibiro wangʼ kuomi.’ ”
english: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

kikuyu: Ok ginichak gidwanyre gi nyisechegi ma giloso gi kido mamono, kata gi timo gik makwero, nikech anawargi kuom richogi duto mag dok chien, kendo anapwodhgi. Ginibed joga, to anabed Nyasachgi.’
english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

kikuyu: Negidhi ir ruodh Israel ka girwako lep pien gugru e nungogi kendo gitweyo tonde wigi mi giwachone niya, “Jatichni Ben-Hadad wacho niya, Yie iweya abed mangima.” Eka ruoth nodwoko niya, “Pod ongima? En owadwa.”
english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

kikuyu: Gi kitego nogero kendo mar misango e nying Jehova Nyasaye; kendo nokunyo bugo molwore matut manyalo tingʼo pi maromo lita apar gabich.
english: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

kikuyu: Omiyo Yesu koro ne ok nyal timo honni kanyo, makmana ni noketo lwete kuom joma tuo manok mi ochangogi.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

kikuyu: Magi duto gin tich mar Roho achiel machalre, kendo ochiwogi ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kaka ohero.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kikuyu: Wuonu nowacho ni, ‘Mago ma kitgi angʼech nobed pokni;’ eka jamni duto nonywolo mago ma kitgi angʼech kende, to bende kane owacho ni, ‘Mago ma kitgi rabok nobed pokni,’ eka jamni duto nonywolo mana mago ma kitgi rabok.
english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye rango piny gie polo kendo oneno dhano duto;
english: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

kikuyu: Mikaya nodwoke niya, “Ibiro fwenyo chiengʼ ma iniring kidhi pondo e ot maiye.”
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

kikuyu: Kane wachopo Rumi, Paulo noyudo thuolo mar dak e ode kende gi askari marite.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

kikuyu: Kik ipur gi rwath kod punda kitweyo e jok achiel.
english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

kikuyu: nikech dhoot oyaworena malach mar tiyo tich manyago olemo, to wasigu makedo koda bende ngʼeny.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

kikuyu: Geche mag lweny mag Nyasaye gin tara gi tara; gingʼeny mokalo akwana; Ruoth osebiro koa Sinai mondo odonji kare maler.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Awachonu adier, ni ngʼato ka ngʼato matimo richo, en misumba richo.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

kikuyu: Ka remb chiayo motimgo misango miwangʼo mar golo richo okel ei Hemb Romo mondo pwodhgo richo ei Kama Ler mar lemo, to misangono kik cham; nyaka wangʼe gi mach.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Iparo ni iduongʼ moloyo kwarwa Ibrahim? Ka en notho, to jonabi bende notho, in to iparo ni in ngʼa?”
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

kikuyu: Yawuowi madongo mojingʼ osema gik mane giyako koro ginindo nindogi mogik; kendo onge jolwenygo kata achiel, manyalo tingʼo kata mana bade.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

kikuyu: Nimar timbewa mamono opongʼo wangʼi kendo richowa elore e lela. Timbewa marichogo osiko kodwa kendo wayie timbewa mamonogo, ma gin:
english: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

kikuyu: Timuru machal kamano ni rwethu kod rombeu. Weuru gibed gi minegi kuom ndalo abiriyo, to chiengʼ mar aboro miyagiuru.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

kikuyu: to uriemb ji duto modak e pinyno. Kethuru gigegi duto mopa milamo bende uwit kido duto milamo ma giloso, kendo umuki kuondegi magiloso motingʼore gi malo mar lemo.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

kikuyu: initho gi kwe. Kaka ji noloso mach mar liel mar miyo wuonu luor; ruodhi machon mane otelo nyimi, mondo omi gilos mach mar miyi luor kendo mar ywak, “Aa, yaye jatelo!” An awuon aketo singoni, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.’ ”
english: You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says the LORD.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora mamol kik ucham nikech gin gik makwero.
english: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka ngʼama oluoro Jehova Nyasaye ogwedhi.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado bura ne piny gi tim makare; obiro rito ogendini gi adiera.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

kikuyu: kendo koa yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan, joka Reuben, joka Gad kod nus mar dhood joka Manase ma gin jogo moikore gi gige lweny mopogore opogore noromo ji alufu mia achiel gi piero ariyo (120,000).
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora motingʼore gi malo ne giwangʼoe ubani mangʼwe ngʼar, mana kaka pinjeruodhi mane Jehova Nyasaye oseriembo kuomgi ne timo. Negitimo timbe maricho mane omiyo Jehova Nyasaye mirima.
english: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom the LORD carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger;

kikuyu: Ogolo gode kuonde ma gintie ka ok gingʼeyo kendo ongʼielogi ka en gi mirima.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

kikuyu: Jonathan wuod Saulo ne nigi wuowi mane tiendene ariyo duto ongʼol. Ne en ja-higni abich kane wach Saulo gi Jonathan obiro koa Jezreel. Japite ne okawe mi oringo, kane orikni mondo owuogi nyathi nogore piny mobet rangʼol. Nyinge ne en Mefibosheth.
english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

kikuyu: Eka noparo lek mane oleko kuomgi kendo nowachonegi niya, “Un okwach kich! Kendo usebiro mondo une-ane kama pinywa nyapgodo.”
english: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

kikuyu: kendo ne gikane e od twech, nikech ne ok ongʼere malongʼo gima onego timne.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

kikuyu: Koro jolwenj jo-Filistia nosekadho modhi Mikmash.
english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne ineno ka oriw chuma gi lowo mowangʼ, e kaka jo-pinyruodhno nobed joma oriw, to ok ginisik ka giriwore, nikech chuma moriw gi lowo ok nyal siko koriwore.
english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

kikuyu: Ne gitwangʼo law akor e yo ma jatwengʼo molony twengʼogo ka olose gi dhahabu kod usi marambulu, gi maralik kod marakwaro kod law mayom mar katana kendo momin maber ka law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Rehoboam notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike kodgi e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Nying min-gi ne en Naama; ma nyar jo-Amon. Abija wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Koro jo-Filistia nosebiro ma gimonjo holo mar Refaim;
english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye notugo yamo mokelo aluru koa e nam. Yamo nokelogi ma gichokore e alwora mar kambi madirom fut adek koa piny, kendo kama ne gichokoreno ne nyalo romo wuoth mar ndalo achiel.
english: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼiyogi kochomo wangʼe kuomgi kendo nopenjo niya, “Kara ere tiend gino mondiki: “ ‘Kidi mane jogedo odagi osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot.’
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

kikuyu: Obiro resi kata ngʼama onge ketho; ngʼat ma kamano ibiro reso nikech in ngʼama kare.”
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

kikuyu: kar donjo mar Hemb Romo mi gichungʼ e nyim Musa, Eliazar jadolo, jotelo kod chokruok mar oganda duto, mi giwacho niya,
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: Kik ibed mabor koda, yaye Nyasaye; bi piyo mondo ikonya, yaye Nyasacha.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ongʼere nikech adier mare; joma timbegi richo omoko e gik ma giloso gi lwetgi giwegi. Higaion. Sela
english: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “An e chier kendo An e ngima. Ngʼat moyie kuoma kata otho to nodok mangima,
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

kikuyu: Kogir to ler pilore e dhoge to wengene ler ka wangʼ chiengʼ ma thinyore kogwen.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

kikuyu: Wuode ma Shemaya bende nonywolo yawuowi mane gin jotend dhood wuon-gi nikech ne gin joma olony.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kush ne gin: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Rama kod Sabteka. Yawuot Rama ne gin: Sheba kod Dedan.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, chan laini angʼwen mag kite ma nengogi tek kuom lawno. Laini mokwongo chanie kite kaka rubi, topaz gi beril;
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

kikuyu: Nyasaye nochako lowo ni “piny” kendo pige mane ochokore nochako ni “nembe.” Kendo Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: “Neuru, obiro gi boche polo,” kendo “wenge duto nonene, nyaka jogo mane ochwowe gi tongʼ”; kendo ogendini duto “manie piny noywagre nikech en.”
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano nobiro ka chiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, ‘Neyeuru jawuoro kendo jamer mosiep josol osuru gi joricho.’
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

kikuyu: Giduto ji ariyogi ne gionge gi pesa ma gichulego, omiyo noweyonegi gopegi. Koro en mane kuomgi mabiro here moloyo?”
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

kikuyu: To kane ikwero pigego to ne gileny nono, kane giwinji kimor to ne giwalore gia;
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

kikuyu: Asetemo konye motamore; chilo momoko kuome pek ma ok wuogi, kata wangʼ gi mach.
english: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.

kikuyu: Wasigu oseyako mwandune duto; oseneno ogendini ma jopiny ka donjoe kare maler mar lemo, jogo misekwero ni kik donji e kari maler mar lemo.
english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.

kikuyu: “Rituru chikena kendo uluwgi maber. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai moko ei oganda nowachone Yesu niya, “Japuonj, kwer jopuonjreni!”
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

kikuyu: Jodong Moab kod Midian nowuok, ka gikawo chudo mar koro. Kane gichopo ir Balaam, neginyise gima Balak nowacho.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

kikuyu: “Eka ruoth nonyiso joma ne rite ni, ‘Tweuru bedene mondo udire oko ei mudho mandiwa, kama ywagruok gi mwodo lak biro betie.’
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

kikuyu: Ler nowuok kama entie mamil ka mil polo.
english: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

kikuyu: Kinyne oganda mar jo-Israel duto nongʼurne Musa kod Harun. Negiwachonegi niya, “Usenego jo-Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”

kikuyu: Jo-Juda bende nokawo Gaza, Ashkelon kod Ekron, ka dala maduongʼ moro ka moro nigi gwengʼe.
english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

kikuyu: Jogo ma nyiera olwora koni gi koni; kendo asiko mana kaneno gero ma gin-go koda.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Satan niya, “Dipo ka iseparo wach moro kuom jatichna Ayub? Onge ngʼat machielo e piny ngima machalo kode nikech olongʼo chuth kendo en ngʼama kare moluora kendo motangʼ ne richo.” Pod osiko mana gi berne mapile, kata obedo ni ne idonjone ira mondo atieke kaonge gimomiyo.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

kikuyu: “Par gigi, yaye Jakobo, nimar in jatichna, yaye Israel. Asechweyi, in jatichna; yaye Israel, wiya ok nowil kodi.
english: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

kikuyu: “Bende Ruoth Nyasaye nyalo dagi ngʼato chuth? Bende en adier ni ok obi ochak ongʼwon kendo?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

kikuyu: Abija nodhi e kedo ka en gi jolweny molony alufu mia angʼwen to Jeroboam nochano jolweny moyier marateke alufu mia aboro.
english: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: “E sa ma baruwani nochopnue, nikech un gi yawuot ruodhu kod geche lweny gi farese, gi dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno kod gige lweny,
english: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, Amnon wuod Daudi nochako gombo Tamar, nyako ma jaber mane nyamin Abisalom wuod Daudi.
english: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma chunye ler kendo ma wuoyo gi ngʼwono biro bedo osiep ruoth.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Bed mabor chuth gi sigendini manono mag piny maonge tiende to moloyo tiegri ibed molony e luoro Nyasaye.
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

kikuyu: Ne aneno gima chalo gi nam mar kio mar rangʼi moruwore gi mach to e bathe kanyo ne aneno joma oseloyo ondiek malichno kod kido machalo kode to gi namba mar nyinge kochungʼ. Negitingʼo nyatiti mane omigi gi Nyasaye,
english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

kikuyu: Kuom bath Hemb Romo komachielo man koma ochomo yo nyandwat, bende ilosne sirni piero ariyo
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

kikuyu: Bangʼe naneno Dala Maduongʼ Maler, ma en Jerusalem manyien kalor piny oa e polo ir Nyasaye, ka oikore ka miaha morwakore maber ni chwore.
english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

kikuyu: Kane Musa openjo wach diel mane otimgo misango mar golo richo, kendo kane onyise ni ne osewangʼe, mirima nomake gi Eliazar kod Ithamar magin yawuot Harun mane odongʼ.
english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Jehoyakim, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nomonjo piny kendo Jehoyakim nobedo e bwo lochne kuom higni adek. To bangʼe noloko pache mokwedo Nebukadneza.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

kikuyu: Ne oyiera mondo aland Injilini kaka jaote kendo kaka japuonj.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Aluongi, yaye Nyasaye, nikech ibiro dwoka; chik iti kendo winj lamona.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

kikuyu: Eka nosidhone Harun kilemba e wiye, kendo oketone san mar dhahabu mopamore, ma en osimbo maler e nyim kilemba kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ochike.
english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: An to berna ka an but Nyasaye. Aseketo Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto kar pondona, kendo abiro lando gik moko duto mitimo.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

kikuyu: Apaka mag tho nolwora; kendo oula mar kethruok nohewa.
english: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

kikuyu: Uzia ne ni kod jolweny motiegore maber moikore dhiye kedo kaluwore kod migepegi mana kaka Jeyel jagoro kod Maseya jatelo nopogogi kaluwore kaka Hanania mane achiel kuom jodong ruoth nochikogi.
english: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka asechier to anatelnu adhi Galili.”
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Kik iyie mondo ngʼato ochayi nikech pod itin, to bed ranyisi ni joma oyie kuom weche miwacho, gi gik mitimo, kod hera miherogo ji kendo kuom bedo ja-adiera kendo kuom dak e ngima maler.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

kikuyu: Ka uketho singruok mane kindu gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ochikou, kendo mi udhi ma utiyo ne nyiseche manono kukulorunegi, to mirimb Nyasaye biro olore kuomu, kendo ubiro lal nono piyo e piny maber ma osemiyouni.”
english: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then the LORD’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

kikuyu: Ne giwangʼo miech jo-Midian mane gidakie, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag bworo.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

kikuyu: noloko puothe pesa mi okelo oketo e lwet joote.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: Simon Petro gi japuonjre machielo noluwo bangʼ Yesu. To nikech japuonjre machielono ne jadolo maduongʼ ongʼeyo, nodonjo gi Yesu nyaka ei laru mar jadolo maduongʼ,
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

kikuyu: Joma chamo chiemo mopogne joka ruoth notem mondo onege; jolweny mage notieki kendo thothgi noneg gi ligangla.
english: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.

kikuyu: Bel kod Nebo ma nyisechegi miywayo gi farese opodho piny. Nyisechegi mosebedo kitingʼo atingʼa osekelo chandruok ma giolo joma otingʼogi.
english: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.

kikuyu: “Kik uwinj wach Hezekia. Ma e gima ruodh Asuria wacho: Winjreuru koda kendo biuru ira oko. Bangʼe ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nocham mzabibu kod ngʼowu kendo nomodh pi moa e sokone owuon,
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

kikuyu: Ndalo biro chopo adier ma gik moko duto manie odi kod gik moko duto mane kwereni osekano nyaka chil kawuono, noter Babulon. Onge gimoro amora mane odongʼ, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Abram nodwoke niya, “Jatichni ni e lweti, tim kode gima iparo ni ber.” Eka Sarai nosando Hagar; mi noringo oa e wangʼe.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

kikuyu: Omiyo nondiko barupe kotiyo gi nying Ahab moketo kido mar ruoth kuomgi kendo mi oorgi ir jodongo kod joka ruoth mane odak kode e dala maduongʼ mar Naboth.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

kikuyu: kendo ka ikawo kitegi ma nengogi tek ka gima nono kendo ok ikwano dhahabu magi mabeyo mokuny Ofir ka gima gin lwendni manie rogo,
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ka ichiwo michni e nyim kendo mar misango to iparo ka in kanyo ni nyawadu ni kodi gi wach,
english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

kikuyu: E sa ma jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma en Ruoth Nyasaye mar piny duto, nonyon aora Jordan, pige-ge mamol koluwo aora tir nochungʼ kogingore ka pith.”
english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

kikuyu: Eka Juda nowacho ne Tamar chi wuode niya, “Dhi dag e od wuonu kaka dhako ma chwore otho nyaka chop Shela wuoda bed maduongʼ.” Nikech noparo niya, “En bende onyalo tho mana kaka owetene.” Kuom mano Tamar nodhi odak gi wuon mare.
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni joma ochayo ji osemiena gi miriambo, to pod arito yoreni gi chunya duto.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

kikuyu: Ler mar adier machiwo ler ni ji duto noyudo biro e piny e kindeno.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

kikuyu: Ne en piny gode, gi pinje mantiere e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, Araba, pewe manie tiend gode, gi thim kod Negev. Kuondego ema ne jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus odakie. Ruodhigo ne gin:
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

kikuyu: Ok enobed mangima ma one mo mar kich gi chak mamol ka aore.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Awachonu adier, dhako ma chwore otho modhierni osegolo chiwo moloyo joma moko duto.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

kikuyu: Kendo negidhi nyime, ma gichungʼ Geruth Kimham but Bethlehem ka gidhi Misri,
english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt

kikuyu: Chikeni osiko nyaka kawuono, nimar gik moko duto tiyoni.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

kikuyu: Noywak kodhi ir wuon niya, “Wiya bara! Wiya bara!” Wuon mare nowachone jotichne niya, “Tingʼeuru kendo utere ir min-gi.”
english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

kikuyu: nikech wangʼeyo ni Jal mane ochiero Ruoth Yesu oa kuom joma otho biro chierowa wan bende gi Yesu, kendo obiro kelowa kaachiel gi un, e nyime.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

kikuyu: “To jasol osuru nochungo mabor. Ne ok onyal kata mana ngʼiyo polo malo, to nogoyo kore kendo nowacho ni, ‘Nyasaye, kecha, an jaricho.’
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne wuoyo gi Musa wangʼ gi wangʼ mana ka ngʼato ma wuoyo gi osiepne. Bangʼ mano Musa noduogo e kambi, to Joshua wuod Nun, ma en wuowi mane konye nodongʼ mana e Hema.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

kikuyu: Negiloso kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani gi yiend siala. Ne oromre bathe duto koni gi koni ka borne gi lachne en fut achiel gi nus, to borne madhi malo ne gin fut adek, kendo tungene nyaka bed gimoro achiel kode.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Gweth sidho kondo mar loch ewi ngʼat makare, to timbe mahundu opongʼ e dho ngʼat marach.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Fuonde mabeyo moloyo, to ok dwar rit ma kamano. Nyasaye owuon oseriwo fuonde mopogore opogore moloso ringruok, kendo osemiyo fuonde mwachayo duongʼ,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

kikuyu: Israel osetiek duto; kendo sani en e kind ogendini, mana kaka gima nono.
english: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.

kikuyu: Paulo kod joma ne en-go ne oa Pafo mi okwangʼ nyaka Perga, e piny Pamfilia, kendo kanyo ema Johana noweyogie modok Jerusalem.
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Eka yawuot Harun nowangʼ-gi e kendo mar misango koketgi ewi misango miwangʼo pep man e yien moket e mach mondo obed misango miwangʼo madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane oneno oganda maduongʼ mane olwore, nokechogi, nikech ne ichandogi kendo gionge gi kony, mana ka rombe maonge gi jakwath.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

kikuyu: Kane Jehu odhi Jezreel, Jezebel nowinjo birone kanyo, mi obuko wangʼe kendo oloso wiye kongʼicho gie dirisa.
english: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

kikuyu: Eka Esau nowachone niya, “We awe joga moko kodi ka.” Jakobo nopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo idwaro timo kamano? Mad iyiena ayieya ayud ngʼwono e nyim ruodha.”
english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Kane malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho wechegi ne jo-Israel duto, ji noywak matek,
english: When the LORD’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nokawo nyithinde kod monde mi oketo ewi ngamia,
english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

kikuyu: Ne en chiengʼ ikruok mar jumb Pasaka, kar sa auchiel. Pilato nowachone jo-Yahudi niya, “Ma e Ruodhu!”
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

kikuyu: mondo omi pinyruodhno otieki ma ok nyal chungʼ kendo, kendo odhi nyime mana korito winjruok mane oketi.
english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

kikuyu: Kane joma odongʼ ma jolweny osetho,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

kikuyu: Nongʼiyo malo e dirisa mopenjo niya, “En ngʼa ma jakora? En ngʼa?” Eka ji ariyo kata adek mabwoch nongʼiye gi kwinyo.
english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

kikuyu: To nikech un nyithind Nyasaye, Nyasaye oseoro bende Roho mar Wuode e chunywa. Roho maywakne Nyasaye niya, “Abba! Wuora.”
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

kikuyu: Kane jatijno odich ka gi kacha ngʼatno nolal.” Ruodh Israel nodwoke niya, “Mano e bura mongʼadni nikech isewache iwuon.”
english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

kikuyu: Eka Jesse noluongo Abinadab kendo nokete okadho e nyim Samuel. Samuel to nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok oyiero kata ngʼatni.”
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”

kikuyu: To ne gikokne matek, kagiwacho riat niya, “Ooyo, ok en! Barabas ema imiwa!” Barabas ne en jamecho.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

kikuyu: Pashur, Amaria, Malkija,
english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

kikuyu: Kendo ogendini mangʼeny kod pinje maroteke nobi Jerusalem mondo odwar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego mondo gilame.”
english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD.”

kikuyu: nimar ngʼatni noromo gi nyakoni to kata nyako mosetimgo winjruokni ogoyo koko, ne onge ngʼama okonye.
english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

kikuyu: “Un duto ma usenego ngʼato angʼata kata mulo ngʼato angʼata motho nyaka ubed oko mar kambi kuom ndalo abiriyo. To e odiechiengʼ mar adek kod mar abiriyo nyaka upwodhru uwegi kendo upwodh jogo mumako.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

kikuyu: Ne giwuotho e chulano duto mi gichopo Pafo, kendo kanyo ne giyude ja-Yahudi moro ma ajwoga kendo mane wuondore ni janabi, ma nyinge Bar-Yesu.
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

kikuyu: Eka Pilato nowachone jodolo madongo gi oganda niya, “Ok ayudo ketho madidonjnego.”
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

kikuyu: Mano e gima Nyasaye ochano ne joma timbegi richo, mano e girkeni ma Nyasaye oikonegi.”
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

kikuyu: Genreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gihera mar owete. Ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo odhial nyawadgi moloyo kaka odhialore owuon.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

kikuyu: “E polo manyien-no kod piny manyien-no ok nochak oyudie nyathi minywolo bangʼe dak mana kuom ndalo manok; kata ngʼat maduongʼ ma ok nodag matiek hike duto, ngʼat manotho ka hike mia achiel, nokwan mana ni otho ka pod en rawera; kendo ngʼat manotho ka hike pok ochopo higa mia achiel, nokwan mana ka ngʼama okwongʼ.
english: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.

kikuyu: Joma obet e rangach jara, kendo alokora wer ma jokongʼo wero.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

kikuyu: Kargi ji ariyogi negisingore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Eka Jonathan nodhi dala to Daudi to nodongʼ Horesh.
english: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.

kikuyu: Ka umonjo dala maduongʼ ma ukedo kuom kinde mangʼeny kapok ukawe, to kik uketh yien mage ka utongʼogi gi le mi ugogi piny nikech unyalo chamo olembene. Bende yien manie piny gin ji madimi ukethgi?
english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

kikuyu: Omiyo Solomon notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ne ok oluwo Jehova Nyasaye gi chunye duto kaka Daudi wuon-gi notimo.
english: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne awacho niya, “Rieko ber moloyo teko.” To rieko mar ngʼama odhier ocha, kendo wechene ok winj ngangʼ.
english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

kikuyu: Ka joote noduogo neginyiso Yesu gima negisetimo. Eka nokawogi modhi kodgi ka gin kendgi giwegi e dala miluongo ni Bethsaida,
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

kikuyu: Bende kik uger udi, kata komo kodhi kata pidho mzabibu; gigi ok onego ubed godo, to nyaka udag e hembe. Eka unudag kinde marabora e piny kama unie jokwath.’
english: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land in which you live as nomads.’

kikuyu: “Kapok muoch ochako kaye, to osenywolo nyathi; kapok owinjo rem to osenywolo wuowi.
english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

kikuyu: mi nowuodho pet kiny motimo mo, mi nochamo kodhi. Kane oriwore gi jonywolne kendo, nomiyogi matin, kendo gin bende negichamo. To ne ok onyisogi nine ogolo mor kichno e choke sibuor motho.
english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.

kikuyu: Nyasach jo-Israel noyiero kwerewa kendo nomiyo ginyaa e thuolo mane gidak Misri. Nyasaye notelonigi kagologi Misri kuno gi tekone maduongʼ;
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne gitengʼo buch tiendgi ka gikwedo timgi eka negidhi Ikonio.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

kikuyu: Dobedo maberna moloyo ka ji duto obedo kaka an, to kata kamano, ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi michne ma Nyasaye omiye, ngʼat moro nigi michni, to ngʼat machielo bende nigi mich machielo.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho ni mano kaka nenore ni chunyi ok nigi chandruok kuom timbe mitimogi duto, kibedo ochot ma wangʼe tek!
english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord GOD, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

kikuyu: Eka nooro jotichne ir joma ne oluongi e nyasi mondo odhi oluong-gi gibi. To ne gidagi biro.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye wacho niya, “An e Alfa gi Omega, tiende ni Chakruok kendo Giko, Jal mantie, Jal mane nitie, kendo Jal mabiro betie, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.”
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

kikuyu: Luoro nomakogi mi gipenjore kendgi niya, “Ma en ngʼa, ma kata yamo gi apaka bende winje?”
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikaw asoya kuom ngʼato angʼata moringo odhi e dala mar tony koparo ni inyalo weye mondo odog e lope owuon kapok jadolo maduongʼ otho.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, wach ne dhood Israel ni, ‘Ma e gima uwacho: “Kethowa gi richowa pek turowa kendo ni dendwa dhi adhiya. Koro ere kaka dwabed mangima.” ’
english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

kikuyu: Bende kwereugo gi jonabi pod ngima nyaka sani?
english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

kikuyu: Ibiro riembi ia kuom ji kendo ibiro dak gi le mager; kichamo lum gi dhogi ka dhiangʼ kuom higni abiriyo kendo iningʼe ni Jal Man Malo Mogik nigi teko ewi pinjeruodhi duto kendo ochiwogi ni ngʼato angʼata mohero.”
english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.’”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ tieko magi to nowuogi oko mar kendo mar misango manie nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo nopwodh kendono. Enokaw remb rwath moko gi remb diel moko, kendo mienogi e tunge kendo duto mar misango.
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Kane giwuotho e dala ka dala, neginyiso ji mondo oluw gima buch joote gi jodongo nongʼado Jerusalem.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ngʼado bura osebiro e got mar mesa kuom Holon, Jaza kod Mefath,
english: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Mika ja-Moresheth e ndalo loch Jotham, Ahaz kod Hezekia Ruodhi mag Juda e fweny mane oneno kuom Samaria kod Jerusalem.
english: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kendo ginikel oweteni duto koa e ogendini duto, e goda maler ma en Jerusalem kaka gir misango ne Jehova Nyasaye ka moko oidho farese, geche lweny, pundane kod ngamia,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Gibiro kelogi mana kaka jo-Israel kelo misengini e od Jehova Nyasaye, ka gitingʼogi e tewni maler.
english: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Kane jotich Esta ma nyiri gi mago machwo mabwoch okelone wach mar Modekai nokuyo ahinya. Noorone lewni mondo orwaki kar rwako pien gugru, to notamore kawogi.
english: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho kane oyawo kido mar auchiel. Piny noyiengni matek. Mi wangʼ chiengʼ nolokore maratengʼ ti, machal gi lep gugru mirwako e kuyo molos gi yie diel, dwe bende nolokore makwar ka remo;
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

kikuyu: “Asebiro mondo amok mach e piny, to mano kaka agombo ni mad ne bed ni osemoke!
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

kikuyu: Ok abi weyou ka nyithi kiye; abiro biro iru.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

kikuyu: Ne achako apenje niya, “Bede ariyo mag yadh zeituni manie bath hotogoro ariyo mag dhahabu ma olo mor dhahabu oko-gi, gin angʼo?”
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mowangʼo nyaroyano bende nyaka luok lepe, kendo olwokre, en bende nobed mochido nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Un uwegi unyalo timo neno ni ne anyisou ni, ‘An ok an Kristo, to an ngʼat moor mondo otel nyime.’
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

kikuyu: Bende ne awachone niya, “Ka berne ruoth, to mad miya barupe mondo aterne jotelo man loka aora Yufrate, mondo omi gibi gimiya rit makare nyaka achopi Juda?
english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Achiwoni chunya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
english: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Mogik, jowetewa, lemnwauru mondo Wach Ruoth Yesu olandre piyo piyo kendo mondo ji omi wachno duongʼ, mana kaka notimore e dieru.
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

kikuyu: Joricho lal nono e piny ma ji odakie, mana kaka pe leny ka chiengʼ rieny e ndalo oro.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

kikuyu: Un ji duto makadho, onge lich muneno kuom gima timorenani? Lokreuru anena mondo unee, ka bende nitiere masira machielo machalo gi masira moyudani, ma Jehova Nyasaye oseketo kuoma e odiechiengʼ mar mirimbe mager?
english: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which the LORD has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

kikuyu: Iked nying yawuot Israel mana kaka jaked kidi molony kedo kido. Bangʼ mano ru kitego e tond dhahabu,
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

kikuyu: Nyaka iwach gik moko duto ma achiki, kendo Harun owadu nonyis Farao mondo owe jo-Israel owuog e pinye.
english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

kikuyu: “Nyis Harun kod yawuote ni, ‘Ma e kaka onego ugwedh jo-Israel. Wachnegi kama:
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata manocham ringʼono nokwan ka jaketho nikech osedwanyo kama ler mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ngʼatno nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandane.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Kendo ngʼama kwongʼore gi nying hekalu kwongʼore kode kaachiel gi Jal modak e iye.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

kikuyu: Gehazi jatich Elisha ngʼat Nyasaye nowacho e chunye niya, Ruodha ne oketone Naaman mayot ahinya, koweyo mich ma ja-Aram-ni okelo. Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni abiro lawe manyaka ayud gimoro kuome.
english: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano nodok e kare mar dak, kendo ne ok odewo wechegi.
english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

kikuyu: Ihero rach moloyo ber, miriambo mitni moloyo wacho adiera. Sela
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: mana kaka ondiki niya, “Nyasaye nomiyogi chuny ma nindo tero, wenge ma ok nen, kod it ma ok winj wach, nyaka chil kawuono.”
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni inono chunya kendo itema gotieno, kata ka itema to ok ibi yudo gimoro kuoma; asengʼado e chunya ni dhoga ok bi timo richo.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

kikuyu: To ngʼat manie wi tat ode kik lor piny mondo okaw gimoro amora manie ot mondo oago.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

kikuyu: kendo kama nokwongo geroe kendo mar misango. Kanyo Abram nolamoe Jehova Nyasaye.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Weche mokwe mar ngʼama nigi rieko iwinjo moloyo koko mar jatend joma ofuwo.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

kikuyu: Jogo michiko gi Roho mar Nyasaye gin nyithind Nyasaye.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

kikuyu: To rangajno tin kendo yorno diny matero ji e ngima, kendo mana joma nok kende ema yude.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

kikuyu: Kane Paulo gi Sila osewuok e od twech, negidhi od Ludia, kendo kuno ne girome gi jowete mi gijiwogi. Bangʼe negia gidhi.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

kikuyu: An onge gima anyalo timo gi tekona awuon, to angʼado bura ne ji mana kaluwore gi gima awinjo, kendo bura ma angʼado nikare, nimar ok atim kamano mondo atim dwarona awuon, to mondo atim dwaro Jal mane oora.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

kikuyu: Isaka wuon-gi nopenjo niya, “In ngʼa?” Nodwoke niya, “An Esau, wuodi makayo.”
english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

kikuyu: Kendo nowachona niya, ‘Abiro miyo inyaa kendo ibed gi nyithindo mangʼeny. Abiro timi oganda mar ji, kendo abiro miyo nyikwayi pinyni mondo obed girkeni manyaka chiengʼ.’
english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

kikuyu: Kawuru jambu kod kweth mag dhou mondo udhigo kaka usewacho kendo an bende lemnauru mondo ayud gweth.”
english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

kikuyu: To noyudo kerubigo ochungʼ yo milambo mar hekalu e kinde mane ngʼatno odonjo, kendo bor polo nopongʼo laru maiye.
english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

kikuyu: Nyingu nobed gir kwongʼ e dier joga mayiero, nimar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto notieku chuth, kendo nomi jotichne madiera nying machielo.
english: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

kikuyu: Kane oganda jo-Israel duto ochungʼ kanyo, ruoth nolokore mogwedhogi.
english: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

kikuyu: Mago duto e gik magi nyalo timoni kuom gik ma isechandorine ka itiyo matek nyaka aa tin-ni. Moro ka moro nokwangʼ, kochiko yore owuon kendo onge ngʼama noresi.”
english: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar keyo mokwongo, kinde ma uchiwoe misango mar cham manyien ne Jehova Nyasaye e Sawo mar Jumbe, losuru chokruok maler kendo kik uti tijeu mapile.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: E kindeno wich nowil gi Turo kuom higni piero abiriyo, marom kod ngima mar ruoth achiel, to giko mar higni piero abiriyogi, nobed ne Turo mana kaka wend nyako mochot mawero niya:
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

kikuyu: Mad lewa wer kuom wachni, nimar chikegi duto nikare.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

kikuyu: To achiel kuom Jodongogo nowachona niya, “We ywak! Nikech Sibuor moa e dhood Juda ma Nyakwar Daudi ema oselocho kendo en ema owinjore elo kitabu modin gi kido abiriyogo.”
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

kikuyu: to dhako moro ne ni kanyo mane jachien osemiyo obedo mongʼol kuom higni apar gaboro. Tuono nomiyo odolore ma ok nonyal riere tir kata matin.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

kikuyu: Giko koro ochopo kuomu, kendo abiro toyo mirimba kuomu. Abiro ngʼadonu bura kaluwore gi yoreu, kendo abiro chulou kuom timbeu duto mamono.
english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

kikuyu: Ne oorogi Bethlehem, kowacho niya, “Dhiuru kendo umany nyathino maber. E sa ma uyudeno to duognauru wach mondo an bende adhi alame.”
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “En angʼo ma uwacho kendu ka uwuothoni?” Negichungʼ kar tiendgi, ka gijowo wangʼ-gi ka gikuyo.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

kikuyu: Nyasaye en ja-adiera, omiyo wiye ok nyal wil gi tich maru kaachiel gihera musenyiso kukonyo joge, kendo ma pod udhi nyime kutimo.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, joma kare nosik koluwo yoregi makare, kendo joma yoregi oriere nomed bedo motegno.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

kikuyu: Atroth Shofan, Jazer, Jogbeha,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

kikuyu: Kuom mano jorit pinje, jochik jotich, ruodhi, jongʼad rieko, jokeno, jongʼad bura, joyal buche kod jotelo mamoko duto mag gwenge nochokore kaachiel mondo gigwedh kido ma ruoth Nebukadneza nosechungo, kendo negichungʼ e nyime.
english: Then the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

kikuyu: Ne osepuonje kuom yor Ruoth, kendo nopuonjo wach Yesu koketo chunye, kata obedo ni nongʼeyo mana batiso mar Johana kende.
