english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

kikuyu: Iniyud hoch ka ineno timbegi gi yoregi, nimar inifweny ni onge gima asetimone maonge gima omiyo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ka Ruoth Nyasaye osetieko tijene duto mag kumo Got Sayun gi jo-Jerusalem, enowach niya, “Abiro kumo ruodh Asuria nikech timbene mohero mag sunga gi ngʼayi.
english: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

kikuyu: Ne ujwangʼo lwanda ma en wuonu, kendo wiu nowil gi Nyasaye mane ochweyou.
english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

kikuyu: Eka negikelo hemb romono ir Musa: Ne en hema kod gigene duto gi ramakine gi sirnine gi bepene miriwo kod sirni gi rachungigi;
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gin e bath dala, Samuel nowachone Saulo niya, “Nyis jatichni mondo otel, in to dongʼ chien mondo amiyi wach moa kuom Nyasaye.” Omiyo jatijno notimo kamano.
english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”

kikuyu: Gimoro amora marach ma gichano timo ni Jehova Nyasaye obiro tieko; bende chandruok ok nobedie kendo.
english: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

kikuyu: mondo okel lep ruoth mag duongʼ moserwako gi faras ma ruoth oseidho, man-gi osimbo mar joka ruoth kosidhne e wiye.
english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo nitiere pogruok e kindu mondo joma Nyasaye oyiego ongʼere maler.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼato ok nochak opuonj jabathe, kata nyawadgi kowacho ni, ‘Ngʼe Jehova Nyasaye,’ nikech giduto giningʼeya kochakore ngʼat matinie moloyo nyaka ngʼat maduongʼie moloyo.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno ma Nyasaye morgo, omiyo rieko, ngʼeyo kod mor, to jaricho omiyo tich mar choko kendo kano mwandu mondo omi ngʼatno ma Nyasaye morgo. Ma bende ne ayudo ni onge tiende, mana ka ngʼama lawo bangʼ yamo.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: To Petro gi Johana nodwokogi niya, “Un ema ungʼad bura kendu, ka bende en gima ber e nyim Nyasaye mondo wawinju moloyo winjo Nyasaye.
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

kikuyu: To kata kamano an kod weche matin kuomi: In kod jomoko kanyo maluwo puonj mar Balaam mane opuonjo Balak kaka onyalo ywayo jo-Israel mondo otim richo ka gichamo chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono kendo kuom richo mar chode.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

kikuyu: E sa asaya momakue moteru e bura, kik uparru motelo kuom gima duwachi. Wachuru awacha gima omiu mondo uwachi e sa nogono, nikech Roho Maler ema nobed kawuoyo kuomu, to ok un uwegi.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: “ ‘To jogo duto motiekou notieki; wasiku duto noter e twech. Jogo momayou nomagi; jogo moketonu obadho anaketnegi obadho.
english: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.

kikuyu: Ne en Chiengʼ Ikruok kendo Sabato ne chiegni chakore.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

kikuyu: Kendo mbedo ma dhogi ariyo, ma moro ka moro bat achiel, ne ochwo e ohinga, kaluwore gi yo ka iye. Mesnigo ne mar keto ringʼo mag misengini.
english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

kikuyu: Kendo Mikal nyar Saulo ne ok onywolo nyithindo nyaka notho.
english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Idwaro mondo wadhi walose kanye?”
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

kikuyu: Ok nodew nyiseche kwerene, kata nyasach mon miluongo ni Tamuz, kata nyasaye moro amora, to enoketre malo moyombogi duto.
english: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho ni Joab niya, “Mano kare, abiro timo kamano. Dhiyo mondo iom wuowi ma Abisalom oduogi.”
english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

kikuyu: Ne otimo richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka kwerene notimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenje niya, “Donge Joab ni kodi e wechegi duto?” Dhakono nodwoke niya, “Akwongʼora e nyimi ni in ruodha ma en ruoth kendo ni gima iwachono en adier. Ee, ne en jatichni Joab mane onyisa mondo atim ma kendo en bende ema noketo wechegi e dho jatichni.
english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

kikuyu: Malaika ariyogo nochopo Sodom kar angʼich welo kendo Lut noyudo obet e dhoranga dalano. Kane onenogi, noa malo mondo mi opodho auma e nyimgi.
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

kikuyu: Eka Daudi noringo koa Nayoth e gwengʼ Rama mine odhi ir Jonathan mopenje niya, “Angʼo masetimo? Ere kethona? Rach mane ma asetimo ne wuonu, momiyo odwaro kawo ngimana?”
english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

kikuyu: Daudi kod joge nodak Gath ka gin gi Akish. Ngʼato ka ngʼato ne nigi joode, Daudi bende ne nigi monde ariyo: Ahinoam ma nyar Jezreel gi Abigael moa Karmel mane chi Nabal manosetho.
english: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nopogo jo-Lawi mier matindogi kod kuonde kwath, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko kokalo kuom Musa.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nogolo ji duto mondo odhi kuondegi mane opognigi.
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Yawuot, Isaka kod Ishmael noyike e rogo man Makpela machiegni gi Mamre e puoth Efron ma wuod Zohar ja-Hiti,
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼato ka ngʼato matingʼore malo kende nodwok piny, to ngʼato angʼato madwokore piny notingʼ malo.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

kikuyu: Uwacho ni un gi rieko kod teko mangʼeny mar lweny, to gik ma uwacho onge tiendgi. En ngʼa ma uketo genou kuome, mamiyo ungʼanyo uweya?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

kikuyu: ma en Misri, ma kony mare onge tiende. Kuom mano iluonge ni Rahab maonge nyalo.
english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat ma ruodh pinyno nowuoyo kodwa mager kendo nokawowa mana ka okwach kich modhi nono pinygi.
english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

kikuyu: Jolwenygo notelo e nyim jodolo mane goyo turumbete, to moko ne luwo bangʼ Sandug Muma, kendo e kindeno duto turumbete ne ywak.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

kikuyu: ne nitie ute apar gachiel man-gi yo miluwo e nyimgi. Utegi ne chalo gi ute mane ni yo nyandwat; borgi kod lachgi ne chalre, kendo kuonde wuok kod pim margi bende ne chalre. Dhoudi mag ute man yo nyandwat
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

kikuyu: Chiemo mane Solomon nwangʼo odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ ne romo gunde piero auchiel mag mogo mayom kod gunde mia achiel gi piero ariyo ariyo mag mogo amoga;
english: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

kikuyu: Kata kamano uwacho ni, ‘Ooyo, wabiro idho farese mondo waringi.’ To mano ber ubiro ringo! Bende nuwacho ni, ‘Wabiro idho faresewa mi waringi.’ Kuom mano joma lawou nobed jongʼwech molony.
english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

kikuyu: To ka gik moko duto oseketi e bwo loch Kristo, bangʼe en bende enobed e bwo loch Nyasaye, mane oketo gik moko duto e bwoye, mondo Nyasaye obed gi loch ewi gik moko duto.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

kikuyu: Chiwo mag cham kod misango miolo piny nyaka keti kaka chik dwaro maromre gi rwedhigo, imbego kod nyiimbego.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: An to awuoyo kuom makati moa e polo, ma ngʼato nyalo chamo mondo kik otho.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro tho ka pod otegno kodak maber kendo owinjo maber chuth,
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “E odiechiengno anaketh fareseu kendo nabanj gecheu mag lweny.
english: “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.

kikuyu: “E kindeno pinyruodh polo nopim gi nyiri apar manokawo techegi bangʼe owuok odhi romo ne wuon kisera.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ezra noa malo mi oketo jonabi gi jo-Lawi ma jotelo kod jo-Israel duto e bwo kwongʼruok mondo otim gima ne osepar. Omiyo negitimo kwongʼruokno.
english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

kikuyu: Jakonyno en Roho mar adier. Piny ok nyal rwake, nikech ok ginyal nene kendo gikiaye. Un to ungʼeye, nimar odak kodu kendo obiro bet eiu.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikaw asoya kuom ngʼatno moneko, nikech owinjore gi tho. Nyaka ngʼatno negi.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Anatim honni miwuoro e kor polo malo kod ranyisi mathoth e piny mwalo, remo gi mach kod iro madhwolore nobedie.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato openje ni, ‘To adhonde manie dendigi to manade?’ To enodwok ni, ‘Adhondegi ayudo e od osiepena.’ ”
english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

kikuyu: Negimiyo Barnaba nying ni Zeu, to Paulo negichako ni Hermes, nikech en ema ne en jayalo maduongʼ.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

kikuyu: Omiyo chuny Jehova Nyasaye nolendo mowacho niya, “Gima kamano ok bi timore.”
english: The LORD relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo Saulo nooro jogo mondo odogi one Daudi mowachonegi niya, “Keleuru ira ka utingʼe e kitandane mondo omi anege.”
english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

kikuyu: Nikech wangʼeyo Jal manowacho niya, “An awuon ema anachul kuor. Adier abiro chulo kuor maonge kiawa,” kendo niya, “Ruoth biro yalo joge.”
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

kikuyu: Anaketh pinyu kendo jowasiku mabiro dakie nohum nono.
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

kikuyu: to angʼo ma datim ka Nyasaye ochoma tir? En angʼo ma dadwoki ka Nyasaye obiro yala?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

kikuyu: Jomadongo kende ok ema nigi rieko, kata ok ni joma hikgi ngʼeny ema nigi ongʼeyo gima kare.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

kikuyu: Mier madongo man Negev nolor, kendo onge ngʼama noyawgi. Juda duto noter e twech, notergi mabor chuth.
english: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.

kikuyu: To Lut nonano ni nyaka ginind e ode. Eka ne olosonegi chiemo, kendo notedonigi makati ma ok oketie thowi mi gichiemo.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka non adholano, kendo ka yier mane iye olokore rachar, kendo onenore ni odholore, to en tuo malandore mowuok kama owangʼno. Jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ogak; nikech en tuo malandore mar del.
english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

kikuyu: En ngʼa misejaro kendo yanyo? Koso en ngʼa ma isegone koko, kijowo wangʼi gi sunga? Donge en mana Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Joab nooro joote ir Daudi, kowacho niya, “Asekedo gi Raba ma amako kargi mar pi.
english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

kikuyu: Paulo bende ikneuru farase mondo obi oidhi otere nyaka ir ruoth Feliks, ma ok gimoro otime e yo.”
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

kikuyu: Kuonde duto mag ongoro motingʼore gi malo mantiere kama otwo, joketho nopongʼ, nimar ligangla Jehova Nyasaye notiekgi, koa e tungʼ piny konchiel nyaka komachielo; maonge ngʼama notony.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼno jonabi duto, moro ka moro wiye nokuodi gi fweny moneno. Onge janabi ma norwak lep koro wach mondo owuond ji.
english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

kikuyu: Ne aneno Ruoth Nyasaye kochungʼ e bath kendo mar misango, mi owachona niya, “Muk sirni duto mag hekalu mondo agola oyiengni. Mukgi mondo gilwar ewi ji, to joma otony, to abiro tieko gi ligangla, kendo onge ngʼat ma noringi kata notony.
english: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.

kikuyu: Nikech wan wawegi ema waseyudo nyangu madiera, nikech walemo ka wan ei Roho mar Nyasaye, sungawa ni kuom Kristo Yesu, kendo ok waketo genowa kuom ringruok,
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mar adek, ne giwito ei nam gik moko duto michikogo yie.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

kikuyu: Piny Pasia, gi Kush kod Put bende nobed kodgi, ka giduto gitingʼo kuodi kendo girwako ogute mag lweny,
english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

kikuyu: Nyikwa Naftali kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Jazel, joka Jazel; koa kuom Guni, joka Guni;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

kikuyu: Achiewo dier otieno mondo aduokni erokamano kuom chikeni makare.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: “Joga osebedo rombe molal; jokwathgi osewitogi, kendo osemiyogi bayo e gode madongo. Negibayo e gode madongo gi gode matindo, kendo wigi ne owil gi kargi mar yweyo.
english: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.

kikuyu: Elienai, Zilethai, Eliel,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

kikuyu: Kane Juda onene, noparo ni en ochot nikech noumo wangʼe.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

kikuyu: Gomer ne omako ich kendo mi onywolo nyathi ma nyako. Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Hosea niya, “Luonge ni Lo-Ruhama nimar ok abi achak anyis hera ni dhood Israel kata mana ngʼwononegi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

kikuyu: Paruru weche ma nawachonu ni, ‘Onge jatich maduongʼ moloyo ruodhe motiyone.’Omiyo ka an ema gisesanda, to un bende gibiro sandou. Ka gimako puonjna, to puonju bende gibiro mako.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne awachone joka ruoth, jotelo kod joma moko niya, “Tich ngʼeny kendo pek, to wangelore e kor ohingani.
english: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and widely spread out, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.

kikuyu: Kamano bende bangʼ chiemo nokawo kikombe, mi owacho niya, “Kikombeni en singruok manyien motim gi remba; timuru ma, kinde duto mumadhee, mondo uparago.”
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Pilato nowacho niya, “Gima asendiko, asendiko.”
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

kikuyu: Jo-Juda gi jo-Israel nochak riwre kendo giniyier jatelo achiel kendo giniwuogi ka gia e pinje mane ginie wasumbini nimar odiechiengʼ mar Jezreel nobed maduongʼ miwuoro.”
english: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye ok en Nyasach koko, to en Nyasach kwe. To mana kaka timore ei kanisa mar jomaler,
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

kikuyu: To kane gia Misri, jo-Israel noluwo thim nyaka Nam Makwar kendo ma gichopo Kadesh.
english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

kikuyu: Apoya nono, koko machalo gi yamb kalausi makudho matek noa e polo mopongʼo ot mane gibetie.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

kikuyu: Kosewacho kamano to nongʼiyo joma ne obet kolwore bangʼe owacho niya, “Eri, magi e minwa gi owetena!
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: To kendo mar misango mar mula mane ni e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nogolo e kind kendone manyien gi hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mokete yo nyandwat mar kendo manyien-no.
english: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

kikuyu: Negingʼiewo gach lweny koa Misri e nengo mar kilo abiriyo mar fedha kendo Faras achiel e nengo maromo kilo ariyo mar fedha. Bende ne giusogi ni ruodhi duto mag jo-Hiti gi jo-Aram.
english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

kikuyu: Nopimo yo wuok chiengʼ gi gir pimo; mi noromo fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ageno biro iri mapiyo to andikoni wechegi mag puonj mondo;
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

kikuyu: We ayudnue chiemo moro matin mondo ucham omednu teko eka udhi nyime gi wuodhu mosekelou ir misumbauni.” Negidwoke niya, “Mano ber, tim kamano.”
english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

kikuyu: Omiyo sani achiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye. Kuom ngimane duto asechiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye.” Kendo Eli nopako Jehova Nyasaye kanyo.
english: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD. As long as he lives he is given to the LORD.” He worshiped the LORD there.

kikuyu: Un muluoro Jehova Nyasaye, pakeuru! Un nyikwa Jakobo duto, miyeuru duongʼ. Luoreuru, un koth jo-Israel duto!
english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

kikuyu: Koso uparo ni gin ngʼa gini mwakwano kaka genowa gi morwa, kata kaka osimbo marwa ma wanasungrego e nyim Ruoth Yesu Kristo koduogo? Donge en un?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

kikuyu: Kuonde duto masewuothoe gi jo-Israel duto, bende asewachoe gimoro ni jotendgi mane aketo mondo orit joga Israel niya, “Angʼo momiyo pok ugerona ot mar yiend sida?” ’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

kikuyu: “Wasenwangʼo ni ngʼatni en jakel koko, kendo okelo dhawo e kind jo-Yahudi duto modak e pinyni. En jatend kanyakla mar joma ongʼanyo ma jo-Nazareth,
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

kikuyu: “Ogwedh Ruoth mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye!” “Kwe obedi e polo, kendo duongʼ obed e polo malo!”
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

kikuyu: Joka Josef nowachone Joshua niya, “Ere gima omiyo isepogonwa kendo miyowa mana kamoro achiel kaka girkeni? Wasenyaa kendo Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhowa mogundho.”
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”

kikuyu: Ne gikok matek niya, “Idwaro angʼo irwa ka, Wuod Nyasaye? Dibed ni isebiro ka mondo isandwa ka ndalo moketi pok ochopo?”
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

kikuyu: Ne alingʼ alingʼa, kendo ne ok anyal yawo dhoga mondo awuo, nikech in ema isetimo ma.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

kikuyu: Kik ijog koda ka koro ati; kik ijwangʼa ka tekra orumo.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Gad, kaw Eliasaf wuod Dewel;
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mag tich e Hemb Romo, bed ni gin gik ma itiyogo tich moro amora, to gi loye duto mag hema kaachiel gi loye mag laru nyaka losgi gi mula.
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

kikuyu: Ne en-gi yawuowi piero angʼwen kod nyikwayo ma yawuowi piero adek, mane nigi punde piero abiriyo ma giidho. Notelo ne Israel kuom higni aboro.
english: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

kikuyu: Jo-Efraim oriwore gi nyiseche manono; weyeuru kamano!
english: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

kikuyu: Ruoth nomiyo fedha gi dhahabu obedo manwangʼo yot ka kidi akida Jerusalem kendo yiend sida ne ngʼeny mana ka yiend ngʼowu ma otwi e got.
english: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

kikuyu: Anachul kuor gi mirima kod gero kuom ogendini ma osedagi luora.”
english: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo dala maduongʼni bende kod ruodhe e lwet jo-Israel. Dala maduongʼni to gi jogo duto modak e iye Joshua nonego gi ligangla. Onge ngʼama notony kanyo. Notimone ruodhgi mana kaka notimone ruodh Jeriko.
english: The LORD delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Wuoro chiero joma otho, kendo miyogi ngima, e kaka Wuowi bende chiwo ngima ne ngʼato angʼata mohero.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye biro reso miech Juda mokwongo, eka duongʼ ma jo-dhood Daudi kod ma joma odak Jerusalem nigo kik lo dhout Juda mamoko.
english: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

kikuyu: Opogogi kuondegi; kendo lwetene chiwogi gi rapim. Enobed margi nyaka chiengʼ mi gidag kanyo ndalo duto mag ngimagi.
english: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

kikuyu: nimar Johana nobatiso ji gi pi, to un bangʼ kinde manok ibiro batisou gi Roho Maler.”
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

kikuyu: Omiyo puoth Efron man Makpela machiegni gi Mamre kaachiel gi lowo kod bur mosekuny gi yien duto mane ni e puodhono,
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

kikuyu: Ji duto moyie kuom Kristo noriwore kanyakla kendo negikonyore gi mwandugi duto kaachiel.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

kikuyu: Un ji, genuru kuome kinde duto; olneuru oko gik manie chunyu, nikech Nyasaye e kar pondo marwa. Sela
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

kikuyu: Eka ogendini nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema amiyo jo-Israel obedo maler ka kara maler mar lemo obedo e diergi nyaka chiengʼ.’ ”
english: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”

kikuyu: E sechego ji noyier mondo orit kuonde keno mag chiwruok, olembe mokwongo kod achiel kuom apar. Ne puothe machiegni gi mier matindo, negikelo e od keno bath gigo midwaro kuom Chik ne jodolo kod jo-Lawi, nimar Juda ne mor gi puonj mar jodolo gi jo-Lawi.
english: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.

kikuyu: Naomi nowachone chi wuode niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhe. Pok oweyo nyiso ngʼwonone ne joma ngima kod joma otho.” Nomedo wuoyo kowacho niya, “Ngʼat mosetimoni maberno en watwa hie, machiegni kodwa.”
english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

kikuyu: Nimar kama mwanduni nitie e kama chunyi bende nobedie.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

kikuyu: To ka ochopo odhiambo nyaka olwokre eka oduogi e kambi ka chiengʼ podho.
english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

kikuyu: To nitiere ji mangʼeny kae kendo en kinde koth, omiyo ok wanyal chungʼ oko. Ewi mano wachni ok nyal losi gi ndalo achiel kata ariyo, nikech wasetimo richo maduongʼ e gini.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

kikuyu: kendo kik ucha weche mokor moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno ni ngʼatno odwoke gi rieko, nowachone niya, “Ok in mabor gi pinyruoth Nyasaye.” Chakre kanyo onge ngʼato kata achiel manohedhore penje penjo moro kendo.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

kikuyu: Aseneno gik moko mitimo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ, giduto gionge tiendgi, kendo gichalo mana yamo.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Jeshurun ne odongo mobedo machwe; ne oyudo chiemo morome mi obedo machwe. Wiye nowil gi Nyasache mane ochweye, ma oweyo lwanda ma en warruok mare.
english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik waol gi timo timbe mabeyo, nikech ka ok waol to wabiro keyo, ka ndalo ochopo.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

kikuyu: Koa kuom yawuot Asaf noyier: Zakur, Josef, Nethania kod Asarela. Yawuot Asaf notelnigi gi Asaf mane jakor wach ni ruoth.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

kikuyu: Kuom wach chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono to awachoe kama: Wangʼeyo ni wan duto wan gi rieko. Rieko kelo sunga ni dhano, to hera to gero ji.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ok bi dagi joge; ok obi jwangʼo girkeni mare.
english: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

kikuyu: “To in kiwuotho e nyima kaka Daudi wuonu notimo kendo itimo duto ma achiko kendo rito chikena gi buchena,
english: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

kikuyu: Ka Ruth nobiro ir wuon odgi, Naomi nopenjo niya, “Weche nodhi nade, nyara?” Eka nowachone gik moko duto mane Boaz otimone,
english: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told her all that the man had done for her.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho, “Adier anaresi gi gima omiyo maber; adier anami wasiki sayi, e kinde mag masira kod kinde mag thagruok.
english: The LORD said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

kikuyu: Abiro bayi gi gik modwanyore kendo mochido, ka an kod chuny marach kodi, kendo abiro keti gima ji jaro.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

kikuyu: Jopiny mecho e yor wuond kendo mayo ji githuon; githiro joma odhier gi joma ochando kendo gisando jodak, ka gituonogi adiera margi.
english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ne owachone niya, “Chik iti ne weche duto ma ji wachoni; nikech ok in ema gikwedi, to An ema gisekweda kaka ruodhgi.
english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

kikuyu: “Kik imak gini,” kata niya, “Kik ibil gini,” kata niya, “Kik imul gini”?
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

kikuyu: Mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho, Nebukadneza nogolo mwandu duto mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo e kar dak ruoth, mi okawo gik molos gi dhahabu duto mane ruoth Solomon ruodh Israel olosone hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.

kikuyu: Oweteni ma jo-dalau bende osendhogi; kendo gisegolo ywak maduongʼ ka gikwedi. Kik igen kuomgi, kata obedo ni giwuoyo maber kuomi.
english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

kikuyu: Omiyo nyimine Lazaro nooro wach ni Yesu niya, “Ruoth, osiepni mihero tuo.”
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye! Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ober; kendo herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Jodolo ok oyienegi chamo gimoro amora motho kende kata ma ondiek onego, bed ni en winyo kata le.
english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

kikuyu: “Yaye Ruoth Nyasachwa, in mane igolo jogi e piny Misri gi teko mari, kendo imiyo nyingi obedo gi duongʼ mosiko nyaka kawuono, wasetimo richo e nyimi kendo wasetimo marach.
english: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Asengʼeyo dak ka achando gimoro kendo ka an-gi gik mathoth. Asepuonjora malingʼ-lingʼ mar dak ka aromo, omiyo anyalo bedo modhil kata ka ayiengʼ kata ka adenyo, kata ka an gi gik mathoth kata ka an gi gik manok.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

kikuyu: Owadgi ne nyinge Jubal, ma en ema nokwongo chako goyo thumbe mag nyatiti gi asili.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

kikuyu: Anati kodgi kuom temo Israel mondo ane ka ginyalo rito yo Jehova Nyasaye kendo wuothoe yorno kaka kweregi notimo.”
english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep the LORD’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

kikuyu: Eka enokel mogono ni jadolo eka jadolo nojuke sanja kaka rapar, mi nowangʼe e kendo mar misango ewi misengini miwangʼo gi mach ni Jehova Nyasaye. Mano en misango mar golo richo.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: To koro, yaye Ruoth, en angʼo ma amanyo? Genona aketo kuomi.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

kikuyu: Nimar adwaro ni ukech joweteu, to ok ni uchiwna misango, kendo ngʼeyo Nyasaye ber moloyo misengini miwangʼo pep.
english: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

kikuyu: nikech ne ok ginyal winjo chik mane Nyasaye omiyogi niya, “Ka chiayo moro ochopo e tiend godni to nyaka chiel gi kite.”
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni, obiro kete jarit mwandune duto.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Kata kamano mwandugigo ok giyudo gi tekregi giwegi, emomiyo apogora mabor gi pach joma richogo.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Yahudi noyie dhi nyime gitimo nyasi mane gisechako timo ka gitimo gima Modekai nosendikonegi.
english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

kikuyu: Omiyo negipenje niya, “Mano to en ngʼama nade manowachoni ni ikaw pieni kendo iwuothi?”
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

kikuyu: Gik moko duto ma Wuora nigo gin maga. Mano emomiyo ne awachonu ni gik moko duto ma Roho nowachnu nogol kuoma.”
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: Jeshua ne en wuon Joyakim, Joyakim ne en wuon Eliashib, Eliashib wuon Joyada,
english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

kikuyu: Luokri kendo wirri gi mo madungʼ tik mamit, kendo rwak lepi mabeyo mogik. Kisetimo kamano, to dhi mwalo nyaka kar dino cham, to kik iwe ongʼe ni in kanyo nyaka sa ma osetieko chiemo gi metho.
english: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

kikuyu: Gilengʼore ewi gode gi koko machalo koko mag geche lweny, kendo kaka mach makakni kawangʼo yugi, kendo mana kaka oganda mar jolweny maroteke machanore ne lweny.
english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.

kikuyu: Eka ne awalo jodolo motelo apar gariyo, kanyakla gi Sherebia, Hashabia kod owetegi apar,
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ ka nosekete kare chuth to nodoko wuon warruok mochwere ma ji duto mawinjo wachne yudo.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

kikuyu: Rabith, Kishion, Ebez,
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

kikuyu: Abiro bedo mamor kendo moil kuom herani, nikech ne ineno chandruokna, kendo ne ingʼeyo lit mar chunya.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu chiemo e od Mathayo, josol osuru mangʼeny kod joricho mangʼeny nobiro mochiemo kode kaachiel gi jopuonjrene bende.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ nowachonegi niya, “Donge ne wasiemou ni kik uchak upuonj ji e nying ngʼatni, to koro ere kaka usepongʼo Jerusalem duto gi puonju, kuramo ni nyaka bura lowa nikech remb ngʼatni?”
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

kikuyu: Jogo ne ondhiyo Yesu kendo negimake.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nooro jaote Turo ma oomo Huram,
english: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

kikuyu: en ema oweyoni richoni duto kendo ochango tuocheni duto,
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

kikuyu: Janabino kata jalekno nyaka negi nimar opuonjo tim ngʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mane oresou kagolou Misri kaka wasumbini; kendo osetemo golou e yore mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ochikou mondo uluw. Tim marachni nyaka ugol e dieru.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nosomo weche manie wendni kochake nyaka otieke ka oganda jo-Israel ochokore:
english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

kikuyu: “To kulokoru mi ok umako wechena kod chikena ma asemiyou kendo udhi mondo uti ne nyiseche mamoko kendo lamogi,
english: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

kikuyu: Ok ahero chiemo ma kamago; nimar chiemo ma kamago miya tuo.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

kikuyu: Kanyo ne nitie jatich jaduongʼ lweny, mane ruodhe ogeno ahinya, notuo kendo nochiegni gi tho.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

kikuyu: Omiyo negikelo tewni mag dhahabu mane ogol e hekalu mar Nyasaye mane ni Jerusalem, kendo ruoth kaachiel gi jodonge gi monde kod jotichne ma nyiri mane oloko monde nometho gi tewnigo.
english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ mondo kik wiu wil gi singruok mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu otimo kodu, kik ulos ne un uwegi kido moro amora milamo ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu okwero.
english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi nomi kandho marachar, kendo nowachnigi ni mondo girit kuom kinde matin, nyaka kwan mar jotich wetegi kod jowetegi mibiro nego kaka ne oneg-gi orom.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachni, jopuonjre Johana nobiro mokawo ringre kendo ne giike e bur.
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne ok olokore oweyo richo mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel odonje richo mar lamo nyaroya mar mula mochwe e Bethel kod Dan.
english: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

kikuyu: Onge gima asetimo marach, to kata kamano gin to giikore monja. Aa malo ikonya; ne chandruokna.
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

kikuyu: To nowachonegi niya, “An gi chiemo ma achamo ma ukia gimoro amora kuome.”
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

kikuyu: Abiro paki nyaka chiengʼ kuom gima isetimo; abiro paki e nyim jogi maler. Abiro keto geno mara kuom nyingi, nikech nyingi ber.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ka ringri duto bende opongʼ gi ler, kendo kaonge mudho kuome kamoro amora to obedo maler chutho, mana ka gima ler mar taya rieny kuomi.”
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

kikuyu: Joma oluoro Nyasaye noyiko Stefano kendo ne giywage malit.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

kikuyu: Ishmerai, Izlia kod Jobab ne gin yawuot Elpal,
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Juda, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, winj ywak jo-Juda; yie mondo iduog-gi ir jogi. Bednegi tekregi ma gisirorego kendo ikonygi kuom wasikgi!”
english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

kikuyu: Kik ulam nyiseche manono kaka moko kuomgi nolamo, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Ji nobet piny mondo gichiem kendo gimethi, kendo negia malo mondo gimiel miende dwanyruok mag oganda.”
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

kikuyu: Laban nowachone niya, “Mana nikech in watna, bende en gima ber tiyona maonge chudo? Nyisa gima dachul.”
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

kikuyu: joma lekegi chalo gi ligangla kendo nyipongʼ lekegi chalo pelni mabitho, mar chamo jochan manie piny, kod joma odhier manie dier ji.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

kikuyu: (To ere tiend wachni, “Nine oidho?” Donge onyiso ni nolor bende mwalo e bwo piny?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

kikuyu: To chakre chwech piny, Nyasaye nochweyogi dichwo gi dhako.
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

kikuyu: “Harun nochiw rwath mondo otimgo misango mar golo richone owuon kopwodhorego kaachiel gi joode.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

kikuyu: Abiro boli e piny motimo ongoro, in kaachiel gi rech duto manie aoreni. Ibiro podho e dier pap alanga kendo ok nochoki kata kwanyi. Abiro chiwi kaka chiemo ne le mager mag piny kendo ne winy mafuyo e kor polo.
english: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oromo gi nyako mapok otimo winjruok mar kend gi ngʼato mi oterore kode githuon mi ofwenygi,
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat moro nobiro mowachonegi niya, “Winjieuru! Joma ne uketo e od twech ka aneno kochungʼ ei hekalu ka puonjo ji.”
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

kikuyu: nowachone niya, “An Jehova Nyasaye. Nyis Farao ruodh jo-Misri gik moko duto manyisi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

kikuyu: nowacho ni Daudi niya, “Ok inidonj ka.” To kata kamano Daudi noloyogi mokawo ohinga mar Sayun, ma en Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

kikuyu: Moo mangʼwe ngʼar gi ubani kelo mor ne chuny, to ber mar osiep ngʼato wuok kuom ngʼado rieko gi adiera.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

kikuyu: Pak Jehova Nyasaye, yaye chunya. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, mano kaka iduongʼ, irwakori gi luor kod duongʼ.
english: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Joma kare mon gi joma ok jo-adiera, to joricho mon gi joma oriere tir.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

kikuyu: nimar oseparo dhier mar jatichne. Chakre kawuononi tienge duto biro luonga ni ngʼat mogwedhi,
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

kikuyu: Kanyo jatend jolweny nonwangʼo yie ja-Aleksandria moro madhi Italia, mi noketowa ei yieno.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

kikuyu: Eliashib ma jadolo maduongʼ kod jodolo wetene ne jochako tich mogere rangach miluongo ni Dhoranga Rombe. Ne gigwedhe mi girwako dhoute, negigero ohinga mochopo kama oger mabor mar ngʼicho mar Mea kendo nyaka kama oger mabor mar ngʼicho Hananel.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nopayo kite ariyo machal gi mane okwongo ka kendo nodhi ewi Got Sinai gokinyi kotingʼogi e lwete mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechike.
english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

kikuyu: “Bende chikwa oyie adier mondo ongʼad ne ngʼato bura kapok onone mokwongo mondo ongʼe gima otimo?”
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

kikuyu: Bed mos e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo rite kihori mos; kik chunyi chandre ka joma moko dhi nyime maber, ka gitimo chenrogi maricho.
english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

kikuyu: An-gi mor maduongʼ e nying Jehova Nyasaye; chunya opongʼ gi ilo kuom Nyasacha. Nimar oserwaka gi lep warruok, kendo oboya gi law mar tim makare, mana kaka wuon kisera boyo wiye ka jadolo, kendo ka miaha morwakore gi thiwni mabeyo.
english: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

kikuyu: Eka negidonjo ei hekaluno mondo gichiw misengini miwangʼo pep kod liswa. Noyudo Jehu oseketo ji piero aboro oko momiyogi siem kama: “Kapo ni ngʼato moro kuomu oweyo achiel kuom jogi otony, to ngimani nokaw kar ngimane.”
english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

kikuyu: e gwenge mag Gebal; to gi Lebanon duto ma yo wuok chiengʼ, kaachiel gi Baal Gad manie tiend Got Hermon nyaka Lebo Hamath.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

kikuyu: Nikech isechungʼna matek ka ichwaka isebet e kom duongʼ mari, kiyalo bura kare.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nopenjo niya, “Onge janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye ka mondo, mi wapenje wach mar Jehova Nyasaye?” Jatelo mar ruodh Israel nodwoke niya, “Elisha wuod Shafat mane tiyone Elija nika.”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

kikuyu: Kaw lewnigo magin kandho gi kandho moumo law akor miluongo ni efod, gi kandho mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kod law akor mondo irwakne Harun. Twe law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kuome gi okandane motwangʼ maber.
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: To dwol moro moa e polo nowacho niya, “Ma en wuoda, ma ahero, kendo chunya mor kode.”
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kuom adiera gin joga, yawuota ma ok nyal wuonda,” omiyo nobedo Jaresgi.
english: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.

kikuyu: Kane jatich Ibrahim owinjo gima negiwacho, nopodho auma e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka idhi kodwa, to wabiro pogoni gimoro amora maber ma Jehova Nyasaye omiyowa.”
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”

kikuyu: In iseluwo puonjna duto, gi kit ngimana, kod gik machano timo e ngimana; iseneno gi yiena, gi kindana, kod herana gi dhilna,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

kikuyu: To Maria nokano wechegi duto kendo nokanogi e chunye.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

kikuyu: Kane ji duto oneno mano, negipodho auma mi giywak kagiwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye e Nyasaye! Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye!”
english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘Okwongʼ Meroz kaachiel gi joge gi kwongʼ malit, nikech ne ok gibiro mondo gikony Jehova Nyasaye e lwet joma tek.’
english: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the LORD’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’

kikuyu: Abiro wero wend ngʼat ma ahero, wer mar puothe mar mzabibu niya: Jal ma ahero ne nigi puoth mzabibu e bath got kama omewo.
english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

kikuyu: Kane onyis Modekai weche mane Esta owacho,
english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni wan wasumbini kamano, to Nyasachwa pod ok ojwangʼowa e twech marwa. Osemiyowa ngʼwonone e nyim wangʼ ruodhi mag Pasia: Osemiyowa ngima manyien mondo oger manyien od Nyasachwa, to bende wager kuonde momukore, kendo osebedonwa kaka ohinga molworo Juda kod Jerusalem.
english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ kosegoyo erokamano nongʼingo, kowacho niya, “Ma en ringra mochiw nikech un, timuru ma ka uparago.”
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko Ahimelek jadolo niya, “Ruoth oseora e ote moro konyisa ni, ‘Kik ngʼato ngʼe gimoro amora kuom oteni kod gik monyisi mondo itim.’ Joga to asechiko mondo waromgo kamoro.
english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

kikuyu: Got Sayun oil, kendo mier mag Juda nigi mor, nikech iyalo ji maber.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

kikuyu: En ngʼa kuomu manyalo winjo wachni kata chiko ite malongʼo e ndalo mabiro?
english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

kikuyu: Ogwedhu un joma kech kayo sani, nimar unuyiengʼ. Ogwedhu un muywak sani, nimar ununyier.
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

kikuyu: to nyaka ichiw chiayo maonge songa, obedni en rwath, kata diel kata rombo, eka Jehova Nyasaye noyiego.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

kikuyu: “Ochawa, nimar oseyanywa kendo wichkuot oumo wengewa, nikech joma oa e pinje mamoko osedonjo e kuonde maler mar od Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.”

kikuyu: “Kaw im miwalogo ngʼato kiketo jadolo kendo ited ringe kama ler.
english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

kikuyu: Johana nodwokogi niya, “An abatisou gi pi, to nitie ngʼato e dieru ma ukia.
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: kendo nopenjo jatich Ibrahim niya, “Macha en ngʼa manie pap mabiro romonwa cha?” Jatich nodwoke niya, “En ruodha.” Eka nokawo nanga ma oumogo wangʼe.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

kikuyu: Weche moko duto mag loch Solomon, chakruokgi nyaka gikogi, donge ondikgi e kitabu mar Nathan janabi, e kitabu motingʼo weche Ahija ja-Shilo kod e kitap Ido janeno manofwenyorene kuom Jeroboam wuod Nebat?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

kikuyu: Unuwach angʼo ka Jehova Nyasaye oketo ewiu, jogo mane uparo ni osiepeu kaka jotendu? Donge rem nokayi kaka dhako mamuoch kayo?
english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

kikuyu: Sa ma giloso wer to giniwer niya, “Soknina duto ni e iyi.”
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye osebedo ohingana, kendo Nyasacha en lwanda ma aponde.
english: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

kikuyu: To ka gimakou to kik uparru kuom gima duwachi, kata kaka unyalo wuoyo kodgi. Nomiu gima uwacho e sechego,
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

kikuyu: Eka iketi agulu ma iye ninono ewi makaa mi odok maliet kendo nyinje lokre makwar, mondo omi chilone duto oleny oko kendo chinde wangʼ marum.
english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.

kikuyu: Abiro guro kothe nyaka chiengʼ, kendo lochne nosiki mana kaka polo osiko.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

kikuyu: Ginituomre kendgi giwegi mana ka joma wasigu lawo gi ligangla, kata obedo ni onge ngʼama lawogi. Omiyo ok unuyud teko mar kedo gi wasiku.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

kikuyu: Yesu noyudo nyathi kanyna moro moidho obetie, mana kaka Ndiko wacho niya,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: Nyasaye moseluongou mondo ubedi e lalruok gi Wuode Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa en ja-adiera.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama oseneno Nyasaye, to ka waherore ngʼato gi ngʼato to Nyasaye odak eiwa, kendo herane chopo kare eiwa.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato odenyo, to ber mondo ochiem dala, mondo kik chokruok ma ubedogo kelnu kum. Weche modongʼ anawachnu ka abiro.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

kikuyu: Abner nosiemo Asahel niya, “We lawa! En angʼo momiyo danegi? To katimo kamano, ere kaka dachungʼ e nyim Joab owadu?”
english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni joma noyalnegi Injili mokwongo ne ok odonjo e yweyo mar Nyasaye nikech tok teko, thuolo pod nitie mondo jomoko odonji e yweyono.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

kikuyu: Jo-Kiriath Jearim nobiro mokawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ne gitere e od Abinadab mane ni e got, kendo negiwalo Eliazar ma wuode mondo orit Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took the LORD’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the LORD’s ark.

kikuyu: Mokwongo ne anyiso joma nodak Damaski kendo joma odak Jerusalem nyaka joma odak Judea duto kaachiel gi joma ok jo-Yahudi ka ayalonegi mondo gilokre giwe richo kendo gidwog ir Nyasaye, mondo ginyis ni giseweyo richo adier gi kit ngimagi.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nodok ir jotije, kendo giduto negiwuok ka gidok Bersheba. Kendo Ibrahim nodak Bersheba.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom malaike abiriyo mane nigi tewni abiriyo nobiro ira, mowachona niya; “Bi mondo anyisi kum mar jachode maduongʼ mobet ewi pige mangʼeny.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

kikuyu: Jatichni biro rito nyaka karangʼo? Ibiro kumo joma sanda karangʼo?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

kikuyu: Nyis nyithindu wachni, kendo nyithindu onyis nyithindgi, kendo nyithindgi bende onyis tiengʼ maluwogi.
english: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

kikuyu: Paruru jachwechu kapod utindo, kendo pok ndalo mar chandruok obiro e piny. Kik urit nyaka ubed joma onge paro gi rieko, kata teko mar timo gimoro,
english: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

kikuyu: Zedekia wuod Josia noket ruodh juda gi Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon; nobedo gi loch kar Jehoyakin wuod Jehoyakim.
english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

kikuyu: Juda nokendone Er, wuode maduongʼ dhako kendo niluonge ni Tamar.
english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ere kaka yadh mzabibu ber moloyo bad yien moro amora manie bungu?
english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

kikuyu: joka ruoth mag Amon nowachone Hanun niya, “Iparo ni Daudi miyo wuonu duongʼ ka ooro ji iri mondo ogoni mos? Donge joge osebiro mana mondo ginon kendo gicheng pinywa mondo onwangʼ yo ma onyalo loyego?”
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

kikuyu: Chunyi to inyalo omo aoma mos, to kik itim timbe mag ywak kaka wuotho gi wich nono, wuotho gi tielo nono maonge wuoche bende kik ium lela wangʼi kendo kik icham chiemb liel.”
english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

kikuyu: Nimar onge ngʼato kuomwa mangimane en mare owuon, kendo onge ngʼato kuomwa mathone en mare owuon.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

kikuyu: Gilwore mana ka joma rito puodho, nikech osengʼanyona,’ ” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼe wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼat mofuwo wacho weche mofuwo, kendo opongʼ gi richo: Otimo timbe mag richo kendo olando miriambo kuom Jehova Nyasaye; mi omon joma odenyo chamo gik monego gicham kendo joma riyo oloyo otamoe pi.
english: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

kikuyu: Gode madongo yiengni e nyime kendo thuche leny nono. Piny tetni e nyime, piny kod ji duto madakie tetni.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Mano kaka odiechiengno lich! Nimar odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye chiegni, enobi kaka kethruok moa kuom Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Otienono nindo notamore tero ruoth; mi nochiko mondo okelne Kitabu mondikie weche mag ndalo, kendo mondikie gik mosetimore e kinde mag lochne, mondo okel kendo osomne.
english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

kikuyu: kuom mano, mana kaka antie, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto awacho kama: In bende abiro chwadi kaluwore gi mirimbi kod nyiego mane itimo gi joga kane ichayogi gi achaya maduongʼ, kendo kum ma abiro kumigo biro miyo gingʼeya.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

kikuyu: nyaka ne Nyasaye Maratego obiro mongʼado bura kachwako jomaler mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, kendo kinde koro nosechopo ma jo-Nyasaye yude loch mar rito piny.
english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhire gigole oko mar puoth mzabibu kendo neginege. “Angʼo ma wuon puoth mzabibu notimnegi?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

kikuyu: Beduru kungʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou Sabato, mano emomiyo chiengʼ mar auchiel omiyou Makati moromo ndalo ariyo. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka sik kama entie chiengʼ mar abiriyo, kendo onge ngʼama nodhi oko.
english: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

kikuyu: Enobed migawo mar lowo mowal ni jodolo machiwo misango e kama ler mar lemo kendo ka gisudo machiegni ka gitiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Enobed kama utegi mag dak nitie ma en bende e kama ler mogerie kar lemo.
english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Kane jodongo osetieko wuoyo gi jolweny negiyiero negi jotelo.
english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

kikuyu: “Ka uparo ni usetimo gima kare kendo mowinjore kuom keto Abimelek ruoth, bende ni usetimo maber ne Jerub-Baal kod joode, kendo usetimone gima romre gi timne,
english: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

kikuyu: Ne ok wadwar pak moa kuom dhano, bed ni gin un kata ji mamoko. Kaka joote mag Kristo, ne wanyalo miyou tingʼ mapek,
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

kikuyu: Negichako wuoth odiechiengʼ tir ka Ben-Hadad kod ruodhi piero adek gariyo moriwore kode ne nitie e hema metho.
english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

kikuyu: Nyathi madhoth notug machiegni gi dho bur thuond rachier, kendo rawera noso lwete e bur thuond fu.
english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

kikuyu: Kane Samuel ogoyo wangʼe kuom Saulo, Jehova Nyasaye ne owachone niya, “Ma e ngʼat mane awuoyoni kuome nibiro rito ogandana.”
english: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

kikuyu: kendo nogombo chamo ngʼinjo molwar e bwo mesa jamokono. Kata mana guogi bende ne biro minangʼ adhondene.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ofukune opongʼ kodgi en ngʼama ogwedhi. Ok ginine wichkuot ka gikedo gi wasikgi e dhorangach.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom yawuot Joyada wuod Eliashib ma jadolo maduongʼ ne en or Sanbalat ma ja-Horon. Emomiyo ne ariembe oa buta.
english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, Koko nowinjre e tungʼ piny ka tungʼ piny, nimar Jehova Nyasaye noyar gik modonjnego ogendini; nongʼadne ji duto bura kendo joma timbegi richo noneg gi ligangla.’ ”
english: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kane Daudi gi joge ochopo Ziklag, negiyudo ka osewangʼe gi mach kendo mondgi, yawuotgi gi nyigi nosemaki oter e twech.
english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

kikuyu: Nochuno ji duto mane oketogi wasumbini mondo okechgi.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

kikuyu: Omiyo e kindeno ne wakawo pinje mag ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor, mantie yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan, kochakore e holo mar Arnon mochopo nyaka Got Hermon.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Kane jatichni odak Geshur e piny Aram, ne asingora kama: ‘Ka Jehova Nyasaye noduoga Jerusalem, to anadhi alam Jehova Nyasaye Hebron.’ ”
english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Wach nobiro ne Jeremia kuom jo-Juda e higa mar angʼwen mar Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda, mane en higa mokwongo mar Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

kikuyu: to ok okele e dho Hemb Romo mondo otimgo ni Jehova Nyasaye misango e nyim Hema Maler mar Jehova Nyasaye, to ngʼatno nokwan mana kaka ngʼama oneko nikech osechwero remo, omiyo nongʼad kare oko kuom ogandagi.
english: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.

kikuyu: Nodwoke ni, ‘Owadu osedwogo, to wuonu osenego nyarwath machwe nikech osedwogo kongima kendo maber.’
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro mane ni ei oganda nowachone niya, “Japuonj nyis owadwa mondo opogna mwanduna.”
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

kikuyu: Pinje manie chula oseneno wachno mi luoro omakogi; kendo tungʼ piny nyaka tungʼ piny kirni. Gibiro ka gisudo machiegni.
english: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato otimo richo kendo ok obedo ja-ratiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka owuondo nyawadgi kuom gima osingne kata gima owene mondo oriti kata gima okwal,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

kikuyu: Gideon kod ji mia achiel mane ni kode nochopo e bath kambi chuny otieno, mana bangʼ kane gisewilo jorito. Negigoyo turumbetegi kendo gitoyo agulni mane ni e lwetegi.
english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

kikuyu: Kane Farao oneno ni oseyudo thuolo, noketo chunye matek mine ok onyal winjo Musa kod Harun, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

kikuyu: Gibiro chokoni jo-jendeke mi gichielgi gi kite kendo gibiro tongʼi matindo tindo gi liganglagi.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

kikuyu: Jakobo nopogo imbe mi oweyo mana mago ma kitgi rabok kod mago ma angʼech gi mago maratengʼ mondo oluw romb Laban. Mano e yo mane omedogo kwan jambe owuon bende ne ok oriwogi gi mek Laban.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo ja-Kush niya, “Bende wuowi ma Abisalom ngima?” Ja-Kush nodwoko niya, “Mad wasigu mag ruodha ma en ruoth gi ji duto mane ongʼanyo ka dwahinyi obed kaka wuowino.”
english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”

kikuyu: Bende ne amako ich mar jogi duto? Bende ne anywologi? Angʼo momiyo iwachona mondo akaw tingʼ-gi ka atingʼogi e kora mana kaka japidi tingʼo nyithindo matindo, mondo atergi e piny mane isingori ne kweregi ni nitergie.
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

kikuyu: Gwethgi duto nobed magu kamoro amora ma untie ka uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kendo magi e gin:
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jonathan ne gin: Peleth kod Zazar. Magi ema ne nyikwa Jeramel.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyaka karangʼo ma jogi biro jarae? Nyaka karangʼo ma jogi biro tamore yie kuoma, kata bangʼ timo honni mopogore opogore e kindgi?
english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

kikuyu: to ka ok wabedo jo-adiera, en pod obedo mana ja-adiera, nikech ok onyal kwedore owuon.
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

kikuyu: “Un joma oidho punde marochere, kobedo e matandiko molos gi ongede, kendo un joma wuotho e wangʼ yo, winjuru,
