english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.

kikuyu: Nyasaye wuok koa yo nyandwat ka en gi duongʼ malich machalo gi lich mar dhahabu.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

kikuyu: Joab nodwoke niya, “Ngangʼ, ok en kamano! Mano gima ok anyal timo kendo ok anyal kethe!
english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

kikuyu: Kik ukel misike koa ei uteu kata timo tich moro chiengʼ Sabato, to rit chiengʼ Sabato maler, mana kaka ne achiko kwereu.
english: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Jared, Mahalalel nodak higni mia aboro gi piero adek kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Masira mar tuoche notelo e nyime; to midekre noluwe.
english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodwoke niya, “Mano en adier Ruoth, to kata guogi bende chamo ngʼinjo molwar piny koa e mesa mar ruodhgi.”
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom yawuowi gi nyiri monywol e pinyni kendo kuom mon ma minegi kod chwo ma wuonegi:
english: For the LORD says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:

kikuyu: To moloyo ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo ojiw nyawadgi pile pile kapod wan gi kinde miluongo ni Kawuono, mondo kik richo gal ngʼato kuomu mi chunye bed matek.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

kikuyu: Ngʼat machungʼ e gowi ni ngʼat mokia biro hinyore adier, to ngʼat motamore chungʼ e gowi ni ngʼat mokia okonyore.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

kikuyu: Donge ngʼama nochomo it winjo wach? Donge ngʼat manoloso wangʼ neno?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

kikuyu: Bangʼe nochoko jo-Juda duto kod jo-Benjamin kaachiel gi jo-Efraim, jo-Manase kod jo-Simeon manodak e kindgi nimar ji mangʼeny noweyo jo-Israel mobiro ire kane gineno ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache nenikode.
english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

kikuyu: Nomiye duongʼ moloyo thuondi adekgi nyadiriyo ma okete jatendgi kata obedo nine ok en achiel kuomgi.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

kikuyu: Negimor kuom winjo wachni kendo negipako Nyasaye. Ne ok gichako giwuoyo kendo kuom dhi kedo kodgi mondo giketh piny ma dhood Reuben kod Gad odakie.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

kikuyu: kendo neginego gero mar mach; bende negitony e lak ligangla. Nyawo margi nolokore teko mi gidoko joma ger e lweny, ka giloyo jolwenj pinje mamoko duto mane kedo kodgi.
english: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

kikuyu: To malaika nowachone niya, “Kik iluor Maria, nikech Nyasaye osetimoni ngʼwono.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

kikuyu: Negingʼiewo gach lweny koa Misri e nengo mar kilo abiriyo mar fedha kendo faras achiel e nengo maromo kilo ariyo. Bende ne giusogi ni ruodhi duto mag jo-Hiti gi jo-Aram.
english: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne udoko ranyisi maber ne joma oyie duto man Makedonia gi Akaya.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

kikuyu: to jagedo ka jagedo notingʼo liganglane e bathe kodhi nyime kod tich. To ngʼatno mane goyo turumbete nodongʼ koda.
english: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

kikuyu: Wachni ne nenore ni ber ne Abisalom gi jodong Israel duto.
english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: To kane atemo winjo tiend gigi duto, to ne opek mohinga;
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

kikuyu: Koro kane oneno oganda maduongʼ, nodhi e bath got mi obet piny. Jopuonjrene nobiro ire,
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka none, kendo ka kama lit mokuot e wiye kata e thur wiye olokore mamarmar ka tuo del malandore,
english: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

kikuyu: to ka imanyo ngʼeyo malingʼ-lingʼ, kendo ikwayo ngʼeyo tiend wach,
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

kikuyu: Nyaka urit weche mag singruokgi mondo mi udongi kuom gik moko duto mutimo.
english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

kikuyu: An Paulo jaote mar Kristo Yesu kuom dwaro mar Nyasaye, kaluwore gi singo mar ngima man kuom Kristo Yesu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Donge tekone biro goyou gi kihondko? Donge mbi mare biro bwogou?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Anakume kuom ndalo duto mane owangʼo ubani ne Baal; korwakore gi gik mabeyo ahinya kolombogo joherane, to an ne wiye owil koda.
english: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kerubi mar ariyo bende bwombene ne romo fut apar gauchiel, nimar kerubi ariyogi ne chalre e romgi kendo losogi.
english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

kikuyu: nomiyo wabedo mangima kuom Kristo, kata obedo ni ne watho nikech kethowa, osewaru kuom ngʼwono.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nogolo chik mondo ochok jodak duto manie piny jo-Israel kendo koa kuomgi noyiero jangʼad kite mondo opa kite migerogo od Nyasaye.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

kikuyu: Ruoth gi ji duto mane ni kode nochopo kama negidhiyoe ka giol. Kendo noyweyo kanyo.
english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

kikuyu: Kuom rwedhi apar gadekgo kelnauru chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar mar mogo mayom moru gi mo; kuom imbe ariyogo, chiwuru kilo abiriyo ne moro ka moro;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

kikuyu: chiengʼ ma nowit ruodhigi piny koa ewi got mabor, eka joma timbegi richo nongʼe ni kare wechena ne gin adier.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

kikuyu: Otimo kamano mondo ji duto mane ochweyo, ongʼe kaka tichne chalo mi ji duto bed gi luoro nikech teko mare.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mowir mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane wakwano kaka ngimawa, nomaki e obadho mane gichiko. Ne waparo ni e bwo tipone wanyalo bedo mangima e dier ogendini.
english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka en kamano to angʼo momiyo ka Daudi wuoyo ka en ei Roho to oluonge ni, ‘Ruoth’? Nimar owacho ni,
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

kikuyu: Abiro miyou chuny manyien kod paro manyien; kendo anagol kuomu chuny matek ka lwanda mi amiu chuny mayom ka ringʼo.
english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

kikuyu: wuod Izhar, wuod Kohath, wuod Lawi, wuod Israel;
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

kikuyu: Nimar kane gikwano ji, negiyudo ni onge ngʼama noa jo-Jabesh Gilead.
english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nopoge kuom dhout Israel duto mi none masira kaluwore gi singruok duto mag kwongʼ mondiki ei Kitabuni mar Chik.
english: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

kikuyu: Josunga osejarowa moromo acheje bende osechayowa moromo.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

kikuyu: nyikwa Anathoth, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gaboro (128),
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: Ne ochiwo warruok ne joge, kendo ne oguro singruokne mosiko; nyinge ler kendo lich miwuoro.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

kikuyu: Ne en kod Daudi e Pas Damim kane jo-Filistia ochokore kanyo ne lweny. Ne nitiere puoth shairi kuno. Jolweny moko noringo jo-Filistia,
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima ngeroni nyiso: Kodhi en wach Nyasaye.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

kikuyu: Melkizedek mwawuoyo kuomeni ne en ruodh Salem kendo ne en jadolo mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo. Noromo gi Ibrahim ka Ibrahim noa e lweny mane oseloyoe ruodhi, mi nogwedhe,
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

kikuyu: Kecha, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, nimar aywakni odiechiengʼ duto.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

kikuyu: to ji duto ditho dichiel kendo dhano didogi e lowo.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

kikuyu: To ne nus mar dhood Manase, Musa nomiyogi piny mantiere Bashan, to nus machielo mar dhoodno, Joshua nomiyogi piny mantiere yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan kaachiel gi owetene. Kane Joshua osegologi mondo gidog e miechgi, nogwedhogi kowacho niya,
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

kikuyu: e kinde ma gibuto e gondgi kata ka gibuto e bungu?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

kikuyu: kendo Nebukadneza owuon nobiro nyaka dala maduongʼ ka jodonge olworo dala maduongʼno.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Israel ok nochak obedi gi jobutgi machalo kuth pedo machwopo malit kata machalo kudho mabith. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.
english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: Ka an e kitandana to apari; pacha osiko pari seche duto mag otieno.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma unyono, nobed maru, tongʼ maru noyarre koa e thim mar Lebanon kokalo Aora mar Yufrate nyaka nam man yo podho chiengʼ.
english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

kikuyu: mana kaka wuok chiengʼ bor gi podho chiengʼ, e kaka osepogowa mabor gi kethowa.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel ne owacho ne ji niya, “Biuru wadhi Gilgal kendo kuno wadhi guro loch Saulo.”
english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Arabu gi yawuot ruodhi mag Kedar duto bende ne gin jogi milokogo ohala. Negiloko kodi gi nyirombe, gi imbe, kod diek.
english: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.

kikuyu: Ne ochiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar cham, kaachiel gi misango miolo piny kendo nokiro remo mar lalruok ewi kendo mar misango.
english: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

kikuyu: (nikech ne en ngʼat makare, chunye ne chande malit kane oneno timbe maricho ma tiengʼ mane odakgo timo pile ka pile);
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar adek Laban nowinjo ni Jakobo osepondo modhi.
english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Paa kite ariyo machal gi mane okwongo ka, mondo ibi ira e got kendo ilos Sanduk bao.
english: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Abiro bedo kodi. Ranyisi ma ibiro neno ni An ema aori ema: Ka isegolo ogandani e piny Misri, to ubiro lamo Nyasaye ewi godni.”
english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”

kikuyu: Winjuru kaka koko wuok e gode; machalo mar oganda mangʼongo, en koko maduongʼ magore e kind pinjeruodhi, machalo mana gi ogendini mangʼeny mochokore kaachiel! Jehova Nyasaye Maratego choko oganda mangʼongo mar lweny.
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

kikuyu: Nenore ni ingʼeyo, nikech ne gichakore kosenywoli! Isedak amingʼa miwuoro!
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

kikuyu: Kane jodolo madongo oseromo gi jodongo mi gichano gima negidwaro timo, negimiyo askeche pesa mangʼeny,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Waduto nyoro waleko lek mopogore opogore, to onge ngʼama nyalo lokonwa tiendgi.” Eka Josef nowachonegi niya, “Donge fwenyo tiend lek aa mane kuom Nyasaye? Emomiyo yieuru unyisa lekugo.”
english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

kikuyu: Gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye timo oseketo gikogi, kendo giko mar joricho en tho.
english: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano wach ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Kata obedo ni ne ariembogi mabor ahinya e dier ogendini kendo ne akeyogi e dier pinje, to kuom kinde matin asebedonegi kama ler mar lemo e pinje ma gisedhiyego.’
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

kikuyu: Kendo noneno nyikwa Efraim nyaka tiengʼ mar adek. Bende noneno nyithind Makir wuod Manase kinywolo mokwanogi ka nyithinde.
english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ miwuoro e Sayun; otingʼe malo moyombo ogendini duto.
english: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

kikuyu: Eka kinde ma anatiek Misri gi mach, kendo aneg joma konye, eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They will know that I am the LORD when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

kikuyu: Yesu nogoyonegi ngero machielo kama: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi ngʼat mane okomo kodhi maber e puothe.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

kikuyu: kendo mane onego ruodhi maroteke; Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Magi duto notimore Bethania, loka mar aora Jordan, kuma Johana ne batisoe ji.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel nomiyo Daudi kod nyikwaye loch Israel nyaka chiengʼ kotimo kodgi singruok ma ok tow?
english: Ought you not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

kikuyu: gi Sandug Muma, gi ludhene, gi raum mar kar pwodhruok kod pasia mogengʼe;
english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

kikuyu: Eka jogo mane ooro nodok e ot to negiyudo jatich kangima.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

kikuyu: Yo milambo ne en piny Efraim, to yo nyandwat ne en mar Manase. Piny Manase nochopo e nam kendo mokiewo gi Asher yo nyandwat, to Isakar yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Gi gig wer man-gi tondegi. Mar Daudi. Winj ywakna, yaye Nyasaye; chik iti ne lamona.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

kikuyu: Ne abedo gi chwanyruok kendo ne awito gige Tobia mag ot duto oko mar kama nodakie.
english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.

kikuyu: Mach nolandore koa e achiel kuom bedene madongo mi nowangʼo olembene. Onge bade motegno mane owe kuome moromo bedo ludh loch mar jatelo.’ Ma en wend ywak kendo onego oti kode kaka wend ywak.”
english: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”

kikuyu: Jo-Zebulun nochiwo ngimagi ne tho; kamano bende Naftali noketo mare e kuonde kedo.
english: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom gik mangima angʼwen ka ne omiyo malaike abiriyogo tewni abiriyo mag dhahabu mopongʼ gi mirimb Nyasaye mosiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata monywol e pinyni ma ja-Israel nyaka tim gigi, ka okelo chiwo molos gi mach kaka gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria machielo to noweyo kobet piny kama omanyore kod liel.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

kikuyu: kendo ichik iti iwinj gima giwacho. Bangʼe, inibed gi mijingʼo mar monjo kambino.” Omiyo en kod Pura jatichne negidhi machiegni gi kambi.
english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

kikuyu: Mano notimre e odiechiengʼ ma Nyasaye nomi Yesu Kristo teko mar ngʼado bura kuom gik mopondo manie chuny dhano kaka Injili ma ayalo wacho.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo wach ngʼatno, nowuore, kendo kane olokore mongʼiyo oganda maluwe, nowacho niya, “Awachonu, pok ayudo kata ngʼat achiel ma nigi yie maduongʼ machal kama kata e Israel.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

kikuyu: Asewachonu wechegi mondo ka ndalo ochopo to upar ni nasesiemou motelo. Ne ok awachonu wechegi chon nikech ne pod an kodu.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

kikuyu: “Jo-Yahudi duto ongʼeyo ngimana kaka chalo nyaka aa e nyathi; bende gingʼeyo nyaka aa chakruok kaka ngimana osebet e pinywa kendo e Jerusalem.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

kikuyu: E wuodhe duto mag jo-Israel, e kinde moro amora ma bor polo ne oa ewi Hemb Romo negichako wuoth,
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

kikuyu: Chiwuru mier adek mag tony ni yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan to adek nobed Kanaan.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Kenania jatend jo-Lawi notelo ne wer, mano ne tije nikech nolony e wer ahinya.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

kikuyu: “To donge jogi biro kwede ka ngʼongʼone kendo jare kawacho niya, “ ‘Inine malit in ngʼama choko gik mokwal kendo mabedo ja-mwandu gi gige mecho. Nyaka karangʼo ma gigi nodhi nyime katimore?’
english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

kikuyu: Obiro umi gi bwombene, kendo ibiro yudo konyruok e bwo bwombene; adierane biro bedoni ka okumba kendo ka siro.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

kikuyu: Eka negiwachone ruoth niya, “Daniel ma en achiel kuom jo-Juda mane oter e twech, ok osedewi, yaye ruoth, bende ok osedewo chik mane iketo e ndiko. Pod olamo kido nyadidek e odiechiengʼ achiel.”
english: Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”

kikuyu: Tongʼ mar pinyno gi yo milambo nochakre koa Tamar michopi nyaka pige mag Meriba Kadesh, kendo nolandre koa kanyo nyaka Wadi mar Piny Misri nyaka ochopi Nam maduongʼ mar Mediterania. Ma ema nobed tongʼ man yo milambo.
english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

kikuyu: mi alok pinyruoth kagolo e dhood Saulo kendo kaguro motegno loch Daudi e Israel gi Juda chakre Dan nyaka Bersheba.”
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

kikuyu: Joma lando Injili gi chuny makarego lendo gihera, ka gingʼeyo ni oketa e twech mondo aked matek ni Injili.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe noa iri en kaachiel gi nyithinde, kendo odogi ir joodgi owuon kendo e lop kwerene.
english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ne chwore wachni niya, “Jatich ma ja-Hibrania manyocha ikelonwa nobiro ira mondo okuod wiya.
english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

kikuyu: Bathsheba nokulore piny mi ogoyo chonge e nyim ruoth. Ruoth nopenje niya, “En angʼo midwaro?”
english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

kikuyu: Un muofni mofuwogi! Mane maduongʼ: Dhahabu koso hekalu mamiyo chiwo bedo gima owal?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

kikuyu: Eka askeche ruoth nokawo Yesu motero nyaka e laru mar od ruoth, kendo negichokore oganda askeche duto mi gilwore gikete diere.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

kikuyu: loye mag hema gi loye mag laru gi tonde motwegigo,
english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

kikuyu: To koro chandruok osechoponi kendo chunyi onyosore omiyo ionge gi kwe.
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

kikuyu: To jotich Akish nowachone niya, “Donge ngʼatni e Daudi ma ruodh pinygi? Donge en ema gimielne ka giwer ni: “ ‘Saulo osenego ji alufe, to Daudi onego alufe gi alufe’?”
english: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

kikuyu: Noyiere gi ombulu kaka chik mar jodolo, mondo odonji ei hekalu mar Ruoth kendo owangʼ ubani.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi oneno malaika mane nego ji, nowachone Jehova Nyasaye niya, “An ema asetimo richo kendo aseketho. Magi to mana rombe, angʼo magiseketho? Akwayi ni an ema ikuma kaachiel gi joga to kik iwe masira odongʼ kuom jogi.”
english: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

kikuyu: ruodhigo noriwore giduto mondo giked gi Joshua kod jo-Israel.
english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

kikuyu: Abiro oro mach kuom Magog kendo kuom joma odak gi kwe e dho nembe, kendo gibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kod Samuel kaka nomedo dongo kendo weche duto mane owacho onge mane kadho ma ok otimore kamano.
english: Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

kikuyu: An bende miyauru thuolo mondo awuo, to ka asetieko wuoyo, to udhi nyime gijara.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

kikuyu: lemuru kinde duto;
english: Pray without ceasing.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Tamar nosedhi, nogolo law mane oumore godo kendo ochako orwako lawe mar chola.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

kikuyu: Timbe mahundu ma isetimone Lebanon nonyori kendo le mane inego marach biro miyi bwok. Nimar isechwero remb dhano, iseketho pinje gi mier madongo, kendo gi ji duto manie igi.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: E dwe mokwongo chiengʼ mokwongo nyaka ukaw nyarwath maonge songa mondo upwodhgo kama ler mar lemo.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Kendo nongʼade matindo tindo, eka jadolo nochan-gi ewi yien manie wi kendo mar misango wich kod boche.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

kikuyu: ma wuod Zerahia, ma wuod Uzi, ma wuod Buki,
english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

kikuyu: “Nopenja ni, ‘In ngʼa?’ “Ne adwoke ni, ‘An ja-Amalek.’
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

kikuyu: Ring iwe gombo maricho mag jomatindo kendo ket chunyi mar luwo ngima maler, gi yie, gihera, kod kwe, kaachiel gi joma lamo Ruoth Nyasaye gi chuny maler.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

kikuyu: Nikech weche opongʼo chunya, kendo gichuna nyaka anyisigi;
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Yie kuom Ruoth Yesu eka nikwo, in kaachiel gi joodi.”
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

kikuyu: Kit yiende mayoreyore manyago olembe nodongi e bath aorano koni gi koni. Itgi ok noner, kendo olembgi ok norem mak oyudore. Gininyag olemo dwe ka dwe, nikech pi mawuok e kama ler mar lemo mol nyaka irgi. Olembegi nokonyruokgo kaka chiemo, to obokegi notigo kuom thieth.”
english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

kikuyu: Ji duto modak e dho nembe dhogi omoko kuom gima osetimoreni; ruodhi mag-gi obwok matek kendo gitetni bende luoro omakogi.
english: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Benjamin nongʼeyo ni oloogi. Jo-Israel ne ringo e nyim jo-Benjamin mondo oywagi, nikech negingʼeyo ni jolwenjgi mane opondo but Gibea biro konyogi.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

kikuyu: Mad ibed mamor gi jatichni; resa gi herani ma ok rum.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Bende nyis Jehoyakim ruodh Juda ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ne iwangʼo kitabucha kendo iwacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ne indiko kuome ni ruodh Babulon enobi kendo keth pinyni kendo ogol ji kaachiel gi le kuome?”
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘The LORD says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”

kikuyu: Bangʼ twech e Babulon: Jekonia ne en wuon Shealtiel, Shealtiel ne en wuon Zerubabel,
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Omiyo kik iluor, yaye Jakobo jatichna; kik ibwogi, yaye Israel,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho. ‘Adier anaresi kia e piny mabor, in kaachiel gi nyikwayi koaye piny motwegie. Jakobo nobed gi kwe kendo norite maonge ngʼama nomiye luoro.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says the LORD. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

kikuyu: “Ne in kune chiengʼ mane achungo mise mag piny? Nyisa ane, bende ingʼeyo wachni!
english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

kikuyu: Gima kama notimore nyadidek eka sukano nokaw mana gisano moter e polo.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

kikuyu: Noyalo niya, “Sa osechopo kendo pinyruoth Nyasaye osekayo machiegni. Weuru richo kendo yieuru Injili.”
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

kikuyu: Winj ywak joga koa e piny man mabor: “Donge Jehova Nyasaye ni Sayun? Ruodhe bende pod ni kuno adier?” “Angʼo momiyo gisemiya ich wangʼ gigigo ma giloso, kod nyisechegi mag pinje mamoko?”
english: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t the LORD in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?” “Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign idols?”

kikuyu: “E dier joga nitiere joma timbegi mono ma buto ka jogo machiko winy, kendo kaka jogo maketo obadho mar mako ji.
english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

kikuyu: Molwar e dir yo gin jogo mawinjo, to jachien biro kendo golo wach ei chunygi, mondo kik giyie ma wargi.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

kikuyu: Eka giniket kite manyien kuonde duto mane gisegoloe moko-ka, kendo gimwon odno manyien.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

kikuyu: Riw pasia abich kanyakla mondo obed gimoro achiel kendo auchiel modongʼ riw obed achiel. Ban pasia mar auchiel nyadiriyo e nyim hema.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

kikuyu: Kinde duto mane oyie Sandug Muma piny, Musa ne wacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, duogi ir oganda jo-Israel mangʼenygi.”
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kik iringi nyaka tiendi dongʼ nono kendo dwondi two. To ne iwacho, ‘Onge tiende! Ahero nyiseche mag pinje mamoko, kendo nyaka aluw bangʼ-gi.’ ”
english: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne umer ewi goda maler e kaka ogendini duto, biro metho ametha, ginimeth ametha ma ginichal joma onge.
english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

kikuyu: “Chiwoni ema Harun gi Yawuote nokelne Jehova Nyasaye chiengʼ ma iwalogi: Mogo mayom moromo kilo angʼwen kaka chiwo mar cham mapile pile, nus mar mogono ginichiw gokinyi, to nus modongʼ ginichiw godhiambo.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

kikuyu: Nyaka obed ngʼat morito ode maber kendo nyaka one ni nyithinde winjo wachne gi luor mowinjore.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

kikuyu: Wegi mondo gimethi mondo wigi owil gi chan-gi kendo kik gichak gipar chandruokgi kendo.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

kikuyu: Ngimani nobed maler moloyo ler mar odiechiengʼ, kendo mudho nochalni gi ler mokinyi.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

kikuyu: Nikech iserito chikna ka ihoyori mos kuom masira, abiro riti maber e ndalo mar masira mabiro yudo piny duto mondo otemgo joma odak e piny.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Ben-Hadad noyie mowachone niya, “Abiro dwoko mier mane wuonwa okawo kuom wuonu.” Inyalo keto chirni magu uwuon Damaski mana kaka wuonwa notimo Samaria. Ahab nodwoke niya, “Kuom winjruok ma wabiro timo abiro weyi mondo idhi.” Kuom mano notimo kode winjruok moweye odhi.
english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

kikuyu: To joricho duto ibiro tieki, joma timbegi richo ibiro ngʼad ndalogi oko.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Farao nopenje niya, “In ja-higni adi?”
english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”

kikuyu: nyikwa Beth Azmaveth, ji piero angʼwen gariyo (42)
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

kikuyu: Nyalo bet ni igoyo erokamano maber chuth, to ngʼat machielo ok gerre.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma ukwayo e nyinga anatimnu.”
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

kikuyu: noluongo jotichge mag ot mowachonegi niya, “Neuru, ja-Hibraniani osekelnwa mondo okuod wiwa! Nodonjo ira ka mondo oriwre koda, to ne agoyo uwi matek.
english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Ne ok aoro jonabigi, kata kamano giseringo gi wechegi; ne ok awuoyo kodgi, to kata kamano gisekoro wach.
english: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni kata obedo ni ok onyal aa malo mondo omiye makati kaka osiepne, to nikech kinda mar ngʼatno, obiro aa malo mi omiye moromo kaka odwaro.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Ibrahim ne chalo ngʼama osetho kamano, to kothe nodoko mangʼeny mana ka sulwe manie polo kendo mana ka kwoyo manie dho nam.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, chik iti ne ywakna mar kech; bi mondo ikonya nikech in ja-adiera kendo itimo maber.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

kikuyu: Sani to pod an e wuodha adhi Jerusalem mondo adhi akony jomaler man kuno.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

kikuyu: mane jowacho niya, “Wakawuru pewe mag kwath mag Nyasaye mondo obed marwa.”
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Dan nooro jolweny abich moa Zora gi Eshtaol mondo onon pinyno kendo ongʼe kaka pinyno chalo. Jogi nochungʼne dhout gigo duto. Negiwachonegi niya, “Dhiuru mondo unon pinyno.” Jogo nodonjo e piny gode mag Efraim kendo negidhi e od Mika, kama ne ginindoe.
english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.

kikuyu: To ka angʼado bura to paro ma angʼadogo bura nikare nikech ok atime kenda, to atime gi paro mar Wuoro mane oora.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

kikuyu: kendo lowo manyak maber nodoko lowo motimo chumbi, maonge tich nikech timbe mamono mag joma nodak kuondego.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Nikech Jal mane owacho niya, “Kik iterri,” ema nowacho bende niya, “Kik ineki.” Kaponi ok iterri to nek to ineko to isedoko jaketh chik.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

kikuyu: Ji mia adek nogado pi gi lwetgi. Jogo modongʼ nogoyo chonggi piny mondo gimodhi.
english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

kikuyu: Donge kata kane ngʼato obiro iru ka ukayo cham koparo ni onyalo yudo ogunde piero ariyo, to oyudo apar kende? Kendo kane obiro kar biyo divai, koparo ni onyalo yudo chupni piero abich, to ne oyudo mana piero ariyo kende.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nonyiso Joshua niya, “Yier jomoko kuom jowa mondo idhi iked gi jo-Amalek. Kiny anachungʼ ewi got gi ludh Nyasaye e lweta.”
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

kikuyu: Koa kuom yawuot Heman noyier: Bukia, Matania, Uziel, Shubael kod Jerimoth, bende noyier Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalti kod Romamti-Ezer, bangʼe noyier Joshbekasha, Malothi, Hothir, kod Mahazioth.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

kikuyu: Huluru duongʼne e kind ogendini, kendo landuru tijene miwuoro ne ji duto.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Nobiro gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe, kendo iye machwer nochok gikanyono.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

kikuyu: Ma e ote mane Jeremia janabi omiyo jatend jotije Seraya wuod Neria, ma wuod Maseya, kane odhi Babulon gi Zedekia ruodh Juda e higa mar angʼwen mar lochne.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

kikuyu: Ewi mano, achiwo chik ni ka ngʼato oketho chikni, to nogol yiend tado mar ode mi gur piny kendo tweye e yien-no.
english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

kikuyu: Kawuru pesa moromo rundo nyadiriyo, nikech nyaka uduoki pesa mane oket ei ogundeu. Nyalo bedo ni mano nobothnigi.
english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

kikuyu: Kik uwe lemo moro dongʼ ma ok uchamo nyaka okinyi; to kapo nono moro odongʼ to nyaka wangʼe e mach chuth.
english: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

kikuyu: Ooyo! Chwo kende ema mondo odhi kendo olam Jehova Nyasaye nimar mano ema isebedo ka ikwayo.” Eka Musa gi Harun noriembi oko e nyim Farao.
english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve the LORD; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

kikuyu: Asenyiso jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi jo-Yunani ni nyaka gilokre giwe richogi kendo gidwog ir Nyasaye kendo giyie kuom Ruodhwa Yesu.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: “Bende inyalo golo chik ne boche polo mondo okel koth maduongʼ?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

kikuyu: To negiweyo Nyasach kweregi ma gindhogore kendgi gi nyiseche mag jopinyno mane Nyasaye owachonegi ni ginegi.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

kikuyu: Nimar ji yanya to alingʼ alingʼa nikech in, kendo wichkuot obako lela wangʼa.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Manase wuod Josef, en Haniel wuod Efod;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi ikwed Got Seir, kendo kor wach makwedogi
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

kikuyu: Yamb ahiti ne kudho, kendo pi nam ne gingore matek.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

kikuyu: Kane Ruoth onene, chunye nokeche kendo nowacho niya, “Kik iywagi.”
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

kikuyu: To kane owite oko, nyar Farao ne okwanye mi opidhe mana kaka nyathine owuon.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

kikuyu: Kamano umiyo wach Nyasaye bedo maonge gi teko nikech wach kitu gi timbeu mane kwereu omiyou. Bende utimo gik mamoko mathoth maket gi mano.”
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

kikuyu: “Luonguru oweteu ni ‘Joga,’ kendo luonguru nyimineu ni ‘Joma ahero.’ ”
english: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’

kikuyu: Eka noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha isekelo chandruok bende ni dhako ma chwore otho madakgo ni kimiyo wuode tho?”
english: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Isaya kama:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye kelo resruok maduongʼ ne ruoth moketo; onyiso ngʼwonone mogundho ma ok rum ne ngʼate mowir, ni Daudi gi nyikwaye nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel Jonathan wuod Saulo nowachone wuowi mane tingʼone gige lweny niya, “Bi mondo wadhi loka cha e kambi mar jo-Filistia.” To ne ok onyiso wuon-gi.
english: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.

kikuyu: Chutho, chik dwaro ni gik moko duto opwodh gi remo, kendo ka remo ok ochwer to golo richo onge.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wachonegi wechego, nokudho muche kuomgi, kowachonegi niya, “Nwangʼuru Roho Maler.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

kikuyu: Anakum Bel e Babulon kendo anami ongʼog gima ne osemuonyo. Ogendini ok nochak ochokre ire. Kendo ohinga mar Babulon nogore piny.
english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.

kikuyu: Joma moko nowacho niya, “Koro weyeuru mos, wane ka Elija biro mondo orese.”
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Jaresni, Jal mane ochweyoi e ich wacho: “An e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Jachwech gik moko duto, mane ochweyo polo malach, ma bende en owuon ema nochweyo piny,
english: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

kikuyu: Daudi nohoyo Bathsheba chiege, nodhi ire mobedo kode e achiel. Nonywolo wuowi kendo negichake ni Solomon. Jehova Nyasaye ne ohere;
english: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. The LORD loved him;

kikuyu: Kik utim misango mar Pasaka, e dala moro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye miyou,
english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you;

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo hedhore yawo dhoge, dhoge ma lekene mabitho kendo lich oridoe?
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka Daudi nowinjo wachni, nowacho niya, “An kod pinyruodha wanabed maler e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ kuom remb Abner wuod Ner.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

kikuyu: Onindo ka en gi mwandu, to ochiewo gi lwete nono; ka wangʼe yawore nii to mwandune duto oserumo.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

kikuyu: “Ka uwacho ni, ‘Mano kaka udhi nyime kungʼadona bura, mana ka gima oseyala moseyudi ni an jaketho,’
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

kikuyu: Jowetena, we koro alernu tiend wachni ka akonyora gi gima timore pile pile. Wach mwapimoni chalo kama: Ka ji ariyo owinjore e wach moro, to ok oyiene ngʼato badhore ni chopo singruokno kata mondo ngʼato omedie wach moro manyien.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

kikuyu: Kane asenono gigi maber, ne achungo malo kendo awachone joka ruoth, jotelo kod joma moko niya, “Kik uluorgi. Par Ruoth Nyasaye, maduongʼ kendo malich, kendo ukedne oweteu, yawuotu kod nyiu, mondeu, kod miechu.”
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

kikuyu: Tije Solomon duto notim kochakore chiengʼ manochakoe gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nyaka tiekne. Omiyo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye notiek gero.
english: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.

kikuyu: To neuru, nitiere nyasi mar higa ka higa mar Jehova Nyasaye e Shilo, man yo nyandwat mar Bethel, kod yo wuok chiengʼ mar yo madhi Shekem, kochomo yo milambo mar Lebona.”
english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

kikuyu: To gin bende, ka ok gisiko e tamruok yie, to ibiro chomogi kendo, nimar Nyasaye nigi teko mar chomogi kendo.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

kikuyu: Eka Hagai nowacho niya, “Ka ngʼato omulo ringre ngʼat motho, makoro obedo mogak, eka bangʼe ngʼatni ogere kuom gimoro, koro gino bende bedo mogak?” Jodolo nodwoke niya, “Obedo mogak.”
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

kikuyu: Musa nomiyo jo-Israel chik kama: “Ma e piny ma ubiro kawo kaka poku kokalo kuom goyo ombulu. Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo chik mondo pinyno opogi ne dhoudi ochiko gi nus,
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

kikuyu: to wuon odno nyaka dhi ir jadolo manyise niya, ‘Aseneno gimoro marach machalo pur e oda.’
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

kikuyu: Ok abi timonu ngʼwono; bende ok abi weyou ma ok akumou. Abiro chulou ma ok orem kuom wuodhu kendo kuom timbeu mamono. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’

kikuyu: Kane dhako mane osedak e ngima mar richo e dalano nowinjo ni Yesu ne chiemo e od ja-Farisai, nokelo chupa mar alabasta mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar,
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

kikuyu: to nyaka uchiw ni Jehova Nyasaye nyak mokwongo mar nyodo. Chiayo ka chiayo madichwo makayo gin mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: that you shall set apart to the LORD all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni angʼeyo kuma dayudie Nyasaye; kendo kata dabed ni anyalo dhi nyaka kuma odakie;
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo chwalore nyime matin mi noneno Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana ka jobet e yie kendo loso gokegi.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

kikuyu: Eka nokawo Kitabu mar Singruok mi osomo ni oganda. Negidwoko niya, “Wabiro timo gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osewacho; kendo wabiro rito chikego.”
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

kikuyu: Eka Harbona, achiel kuom jotich ruoth mabwoch nowacho niya, “Gir nek ma borne oromo fut piero abiriyo gabich ochungʼ e bath od Haman. Noselose mondo oneg-go Modekai, ma wachne ne osekonyo ruoth.” Ruoth nowacho niya, “Kawuru gima nolosono mondo ulierego!”
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo wuoyo kodgi niya, “Ok awuo kuomu un uduto, nimar angʼeyo joma aseyiero. To mano osetimore mondo ochop Ndiko mawacho ni, ‘Ngʼat machiemo koda bende osendhoga.’
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

kikuyu: Abiro wichi mi atweyi gi tol kendo aywayi e lowo. Abiro keli ka agoli tungʼ nyandwat kendo abiro ori mondo iked gi gode mag Israel.
english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.

kikuyu: Nikech ne ochikona ite, abiro luonge kinde duto ma angima.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

kikuyu: To ngima mochwere ema: ni mondo gingʼeyi in Nyasaye makende mar adier, kod Yesu Kristo, Jal miseoro.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ma e pokni ma asechiwoni,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho, “nikech wiu osewil koda kendo useketo genou kuom nyiseche manono.
english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says the LORD, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”

kikuyu: Itieko joma wacho miriambo; Jehova Nyasaye ok mor gi joma dwaro chwero remo, kod jo-miriambo.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

kikuyu: Bende ukel nus mar lita mar divai kaka misango miolo piny. Obiro bedo chiwo mowangʼ miwangʼo, ma en gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Un bende timuru kamano. Neuru ni ler maru rieny e dier ji, mondo gine timbeu mabeyo kendo gipak Wuonu manie polo.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: mondo omi gichiw misengini ma moro Nyasach polo kendo olam ne ruoth gi yawuote obed gi ngima maber.
english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

kikuyu: Gibiro poto ma gium lowo ma ok nen. Gibiro chamo gimoro amora matin mane pe oweyo kaachiel gi kit yien duto matwi e lowo.
english: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

kikuyu: kaka Misri, Juda, Edom, Amon, Moab gi jogo duto modak kuonde motimo ongoro man maboyo. Nimar ogendinigi duto ok oter nyangu adier, kendo kata od Israel duto bende ok oter nyangu e chunygi.”
english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

kikuyu: Oganda nokwerogi monyisogi ni gilingʼ, to gin koro eka negimedo kok matek moloyo niya, “Ruoth, Wuod Daudi, yie ikechwa!”
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: En e wuon teko gi loch; joma iwuondo gi joma wuondo ji gin mage kargi duto.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

kikuyu: Kane malaika noseweyo jogi kendo dhiyo e polo, jokwath nowacho kendgi niya, “Wadhiuru Bethlehem mondo wane gima osetimore, ma Ruoth osenyisowa kuome ni.”
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

kikuyu: Nimar awachonu ni jonabi kod ruodhi mangʼeny ne gombo neno gik munenogi, to ne ok gineno kendo winjo gik muwinjogi, to ne ok giwinjo.”
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Zadok jadolo gi Nathan janabi gi Benaya wuod Jehoyada ja-Kereth kod jo-Peleth nodhi mi oketo Solomon e punda Daudi ruoth mi gikowe nyaka Gihon.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

kikuyu: Higni abiriyo biro betie ma piny Misri duto nobedie gi yiengʼo ahinya,
english: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Dhi malo e Got Abarim kendo ingʼi piny ma asemiyo jo-Israel.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Anamonjgi mi ayiechgi matindo tindo mana ka ondiek ma omaa nyithinde. Anatiekgi mana ka sibuor, bende le mag bungu noyiechgi matindo tindo.
english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

kikuyu: To jamni duto kod gik moyaki moa e mier madongo mag-gi, ne watingʼo wadhigo.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

kikuyu: Gin e jo-Israel manyaka chiw chuth ne an. Asekawogi kaka meka awuon e lo kayo ma en nyodo mokwongo ma wuowi mar ja-Israel.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

kikuyu: To kata mana fedha mathoth kod dhahabu ma gin-go ok noresgi, odiechiengʼ mar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye. Chiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye ngʼadoe bura, nyiego mager ma en-go nowangʼ piny duto, mitiek pep.” Kamano e kaka notiek gik moko duto modak e piny mana kadiemo wangʼ.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

kikuyu: Luwuru tim makare kendo en kende ema uluwe mondo udagi amingʼa kendo ukaw piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ndiko mondik e wiye malo, mawacho niya: Ma en Ruodh Jo-Yahudi.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Inyalo neno kaka yie mane en-go kod timne ne tiyo kaachiel, mi yiene nobedo kare chuth kuom gima notimo.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

kikuyu: Eka Asa nokawo fedha gi dhahabu duto mane odongʼ e ute keno mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye gi mago mag ode. Nomiyogi jodonge mi oorogi ir Ben-Hadad wuod Tabrimon ma wuod Hezion ruodh Aram manodak Damaski.
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar mar mogo mayom moru gi mo; im to uchiw gi kilo abiriyo;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: Abiro miyo gibed oganda achiel e piny, ewi gode mag Israel. Ruoth achiel ema noritgi kargi duto, kendo ok ginichak gibed pinje ariyo, kata pinjeruodhi ariyo mopogore.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

kikuyu: Ji duto nolingʼ ka Paulo gi Barnaba ne hulonegi kuom honni gi ranyisi ma Nyasaye nosetimo e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi, kotiyo kodgi.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

kikuyu: Kuom higni adek ne onge lweny e kind Israel gi Aram
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

kikuyu: To koro ma e gima wabiro timo ne Gibea: Wabiro kedo kodgi kaka ombulu owacho.
english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

kikuyu: eka Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobed dhahabu mari, kendo nobedni fedha maberie mogik.
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

kikuyu: Abiro nyiso kaka nyinga marahuma musedwanyo e dier ogendini, ler, nyingno musechido e diergi. Eka ogendini nongʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, chiengʼ ma ananyisra kaka ngʼama ler ka uneno gi wangʼu, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondieg bungu mobuto karito, kata ka sibuor mopondo,
english: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

kikuyu: Olembego ne obi kinyonogi gi tielo e kar bichono e pap oko mar dala, to remo nochwer kamol kawuok kar bichono, mochopo mabor moromo kilomita mia adek koa e dala, to tut remono ne nyalo romo fut abich.
english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

kikuyu: E kindeno analuong jatichna Eliakim ma wuod Hilkia.
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: Jogo turumbete kaachiel gi jower ne wer gi chuny achiel ka gima ne en dwond ngʼato achiel ka gipako kendo goyone Jehova Nyasaye erokamano. Kaachiel ka gigoyo turumbete gi ongengʼo to gi thumbe mamoko negitingʼo dwondgi malo ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka giwer niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ber; kendo herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.” Eka hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼ kod bor polo,
english: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even the LORD’s house,

kikuyu: Mad Ruoth rit chunyi. Ngʼwono mondo obed kodu un duto.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Yore duto mag dhano nenorene ni longʼo, to Jehova Nyasaye ema ongʼeyo mopondo mag chuny.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ngero mawacho niya, “Thowi matin ema miyo mogo modwal kuot.”
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

kikuyu: Emomiyo awachonu ni richo gi ayany moyanygo Nyasaye duto nowe ne ji, to ngʼato angʼata mowuoyo marach kuom Roho Maler ok nowene richone.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

kikuyu: Ne olawo Abner, ka ok obaro korachwich kata koracham kolawe alawa.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

kikuyu: Kikombe duto mag Ruoth Solomon nolos gi dhahabu, kod gige ot duto mokonyorego e ode mane ni e Bungu mag Lebanon nolos gi dhahabu mopwodhi. Onge gima nolos gi fedha nikech fedha nokaw ni nengone yot e kinde Solomon.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne nitie mesni angʼwen e bath rangach midonjogo konchiel kod angʼwen mamoko e bathe komachielo, giduto gin, mesni aboro mane iyangʼoe misengini.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo negigoyo kambi ka gimanyore, kendo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo lweny norado. Jo-Israel nonego jolwenj Aram ma jotelo maromo alufu mia achiel odiechiengno.
english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

kikuyu: kod ji alufu apar gauchiel (16,000).
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

kikuyu: To Onan nongʼeyo ni nyithindogo ok bi bedo mage, kuom mano e sa asaya mane oriwore kod chi owadgino; ne oolo kothe oko e lowo mondo ne mi kik onywol nyathi ne owadgi.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

kikuyu: Jeyel wuon Gibeon ne odak Gibeon. Jaode niluongo ni Maaka,
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo jo-Israel ok nyal loyo wasikgi; giloko ngʼegi kendo giringo nikech oseketgi gir kethruok. Ok anabed kodu makmana ka uketho gigo manie dieru mowal ni kethruok.
english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.

kikuyu: To ne ok ginyal yudo yo mar timo kamano, nikech ji duto norwako wachne.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Kik ineg-gi. Bende dineg joma isemako gi liganglani kata tongʼ? Migi chiemo gicham kod pi mondo gimodhi, eka mondo gidog ir ruodhgi.”
english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mane Lut oa Sodom, mach kod kite maliel mager nolwar koa e polo kendo notiekogi duto.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: nikech nendwa kuom Kristo nosir e dieru.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

kikuyu: mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho janabi Isaya niya,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma kamano kik par ni onyalo kwayo Ruoth gimoro mi oyudi,
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

kikuyu: Negigure kanyo, kaachiel gi ji ariyo mamoko. Yesu ne ogur e diere, ka ngʼato achiel ni e bathe konchiel to moro e bathe komachielo.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

kikuyu: Joka Efraim e magi: Shuthela ma nonywolo Bered, Bered nonywolo Tahath, Tahath nonywolo Eleada, Eleada nonywolo Tahath,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

kikuyu: Anamigi jokwath manoritgi, kendo ok ginibed maluor kata ok ginibwogi, bende onge manolal,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: en wan ema wadendo Jehova Nyasaye tinende kendo nyaka chiengʼ. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Onego gipak nying Jehova Nyasaye kargi duto nimar nogolo chik mine gibetie.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, in ja-ratiro! Owewa odiechiengni kaka joma otony. Eri wan e nyimi kaka joricho ma bura oloyo, kendo nikech richowago, onge ngʼato kuomwa manyalo chungo e nyimi.”
english: LORD, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”

kikuyu: Kawuru nyiponge mondo ureg-go mogo; goluru leso ma uumogo wengeu. Ngʼwanuru lepu mondo ungʼadgo aore.
english: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.

kikuyu: E higa mar ochiko mar Zedekia ruodh Juda, e dwe mar apar, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nodhi gi jolweny mage duto momonjo Jerusalem kendo ne gigoyone agengʼa.
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

kikuyu: Eka unungʼe ni antie ei Israel, ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, kendo ni onge moro machielo; wi joga ok nochak okuod kendo.”
english: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am the LORD, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.

kikuyu: Abiro lando nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo abiro pako duongʼ mar Nyasachwa!
english: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

kikuyu: mar chako loso ndalo mag Purim e kindegi mowinjore, mana kaka Modekai ma ja-Yahudi gi Esta ma mikach ruoth nosechikogi. Barupego bende ne omiyo jo-Yahudi gi nyikwagi chike moko moket kuom wach tweyo chiemo kendo kuom wach ywak.
english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

kikuyu: Bucheni ochungʼ mongirore; kendo ler opongʼo odi, nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

kikuyu: Joshua nokawo mier madongo gi ruodhigi mi ginegogi gi ligangla. Notiekogi pep, mana kaka Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko.
english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma okethneno onge gi watne moro amora ma inyalo mi chudono, to chudono en mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyaka chiwe ne jadolo, ka itere gi im ma ikwayonego pwodhruok kuom richo.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar loch Jehoyakim, ruodh Juda, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nobiro Jerusalem molwore gi jolweny mondo okawe.
english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

kikuyu: Isemiyo olokwa ngero e dier ogendini; kendo ogendini kino wigi konenowa.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

kikuyu: Omiyo dalano nopongʼ gi mor maduongʼ.
english: There was great joy in that city.

kikuyu: E kinde mane giringo e nyim jo-Israel e yo moa Beth Horon kadhi Azeka, Jehova Nyasaye nolwaro pe madongo kuomgi koa e polo kendo thothgi nomedo tho nikech peno nonego ji mangʼeny moloyo mago mane jo-Israel onego gi ligangla.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, the LORD hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

kikuyu: ne En mane otelo ne joge e thim, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kata bangʼ timo magi duto kapod ok unyal winja, to anakumu nyadibiriyo kuom richo duto.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

kikuyu: “Chiemo en mar ich, ich en mar chiemo,” to Nyasaye biro ketho gik moko ariyo duto. Ringruok ok en mar terruok, to en mar miyo Ruoth duongʼ, mana kaka Ruoth bende en mar ringruok.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo jopuonjrene apar gariyo niya, “Dibed ni un bende udwaro weya koso?”
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

kikuyu: To ok anariembgi oko dichiel e higa, nikech piny nyalo bedo gunda kendo le mag thim nyalo bedonu mathoth mokalo akwana.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

kikuyu: nyikwa Kiriath Jearim, Kefira kod Beeroth, ji mia abiriyo gi piero angʼwen gadek (743)
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

kikuyu: Artaksases, ruoth mar ruodhi, Ne Ezra jadolo kendo japuonj mar Chik Nyasach Polo: Amosi.
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now

kikuyu: Kane jo-Farisai owinjo ni Yesu osengʼengʼo jo-Sadukai, ne gichokorene kaachiel.
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

kikuyu: Wiyi miyi duongʼ mana ka Got Karmel, yie wiyi to ochanore ka orengo mar ruoth, kendo omako pach ruoth.
english: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

kikuyu: Nyasaye osewuoyo gie kare maler kowacho niya, “Abiro pogo Shekem ne ji, kendo abiro pimo ne ji Holo mar Sukoth.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: E ndalo machon Nyasaye ne ok oelo tiend wachni ne ji, to koro oseele kuom Roho, kokonyore gi jootene maler kod jonabi.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Koro ne asebet e got kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno mana kaka ne atimo mokwongo mi Jehova Nyasaye ne ochako owinja kendo ok ne en dwarone mondo otieku.
english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

kikuyu: Zalmon ma ja-Ahohi, Maharai ma ja-Netofath,
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

kikuyu: “Ka Jakony ma abiro oronu koa ka Wuora, ma en Roho mar adier maa kuom Wuora nobi, enotim neno kuoma.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

kikuyu: Loch mar Feliks norumo bangʼ higni ariyo, eka Porkio Festo nokawo kare. To nikech Feliks ne dwaro mondo jo-Yahudi one ni en ngʼama ber, noweyo Paulo e od twech.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano wachnegi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Onge weche masewacho makoro biro deko, Gimoro amora ma awacho biro chopo kare, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”
