kikuyu: Eka jadolo nokaw remo moko gi lith lwete kendo nomiene tunge kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, eka remo modongʼ to nopuki e tiend kendo mar misango.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Wasetony mana ka winyo mowuok e wino mar jachik winy; wino osechodi, to wan wasetony.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

kikuyu: (Mano notimore nikech jo-Sadukai wacho ni chier, kata malaike kata Roho onge, to jo-Farisai to oyie gi puonjgi duto.)
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

kikuyu: Magi duto notimore ne Jerusalem kod Juda nikech mirimb Jehova Nyasaye, kendo giko to ne oriembogi oko e nyime. Koro Zedekia nongʼanyone ruodh Babulon.
english: For through the LORD’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Daudi nongʼiyo malo ma oneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye kochungo e kind polo gi piny ka otingʼo ligangla mager e lwete mane orieyo kuom Jerusalem. Bangʼe Daudi gi jodongo nopodho piny auma ka girwakore gi pien gugru.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Gima omuko mogoyo piny ok nyal ger kendo; kendo ngʼat motweyo ok nyal gony.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

kikuyu: “Dhano adhana to konyo Nyasaye gangʼo? Kata bed ni ngʼato riek mogik, angʼo ma dokonygo Nyasaye?
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

kikuyu: Negiluwo bangʼ-gi nyaka aora Jordan mine giyudo ka yo opongʼ gi lewni kod gik moko mane lwar ka jo-Aram ringo ka kihondko ogoyogi. Bangʼ mano jootego noduogo monyiso ruoth gima gisetimo.
english: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

kikuyu: E seche duto ka gik mangimago nedwoko erokamano ka gipako kendo puoyo Jal mane obedo e kom duongʼ kendo mangima nyaka chiengʼ;
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

kikuyu: mi nowachone joritne niya, “Ngʼatno nyaka bed Johana ja-Batiso. Nyaka bed ni osechier oa kuom joma otho! Mano emomiyo teko mar timo honni tiyo kuome.”
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

kikuyu: Kane un Horeb ne ujimbo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mane iye owangʼ modwaro tiekou.
english: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.

kikuyu: To ka higni modongʼ ngʼeny, to noware gi chudo mamalo.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

kikuyu: Nyasaye osemiyo chunya ool; Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osemiyo kibaji omaka.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

kikuyu: “Isakar en punda maratego ma nindo piny e dier misikene.
english: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

kikuyu: to abiro guro kom lochni kuom Israel nyaka chiengʼ mana kaka nasingo ni Daudi wuonu kane awachone ni, ‘Kinde duto ok inichand ngʼama nyalo bedo e kom loch mar Israel.’
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

kikuyu: to ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ok nochak oriemb ogendini e dieru kendo. Jogo nobednu obadho gi ramaki, boka mi chwadogo ngʼeu, kendo kudho e wengeu, nyaka chop ulal nono uae pinyni, ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou.
english: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.

kikuyu: ka ok okwan mier matindo mokiewo kodgi mochopo nyaka Baalath Beer (ma bende iluongo ni Rama e piny Negev). Magi e mier mane opog ne dhood Simeon kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

kikuyu: Ira ja-Ithri gi Gareb ma ja-Ithri,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

kikuyu: Ka usengʼado aora Jordan, to dhoudigi nobi e Got Gerizim mondo gigwedh ji: Simeon, Lawi, Juda, Isakar, Josef kod Benjamin.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Bath aorano mokwongo iluongo ni Pishon; en omol koluwo piny Havila duto kama ne nitiere gi dhahabu mangʼeny.
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar adek, e higa mar apar gachiel wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny bende nopedho lepgi e yo, to jomoko nopedho oboke mag yiende mane gingʼado e puothe.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

kikuyu: Kane piny chiegni imore, yie koro ne ni e chuny nam to Yesu to ne ni kende oko e lowo motwo kuma ne odongʼie.
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

kikuyu: Un ma uweyo joketho nikech asoya, to joma onge ketho ema utamo e adiera margi.
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

kikuyu: Omiyo gimoro amora mutimo, bed ni uchiemo kata umetho, to timgiuru duto mondo Nyasaye oyud duongʼ.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Yiende duto mag puodho biro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema amiyo yien marabora doko machiek, to yien machiek amiyo dongo mi dok marabora. Amiyo yien momiyo maralum two to amiyo yien motwo loth. “ ‘An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuoyo kendo abiro time.’ ”
english: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it.’”

kikuyu: Kanyo ji mathoth man-gi tuoche mopogore opogore kaka muofni, rongʼonde, kod joma nigi athany nohero riyo kanyo [kendo negirito mondo pi otugre.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

kikuyu: To koro gin ka, ka kihondko maduongʼ omakogi, kata obedo ni onge gima kelo kihondko. Nyasaye osekeyo choke joma nomonji; isemiyogi wichkuot, nikech Nyasaye nodagigi.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

kikuyu: Yawuot Helem ne gin: Zofa, Imna, Shelesh kod Amal.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye notingʼa malo, kendo ne awinjo koko maduongʼ malich. Mad duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye yud pak e kar dakne!
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”

kikuyu: Tiendena onyono kama opie; e chokruok mangʼongo abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone e higa mar apar gadek e loch Josia wuod Amon ruodh Juda,
english: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

kikuyu: “Ring chiayo mar misango nyaka cham mana e ot achiel, kik lemo kata achiel gol oko mar odno kendo kik utur choke moro amora.
english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

kikuyu: ma gin joma orito singruokne kendo jogo maparo mondo orit chikene.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nopenje niya, “Rabi, en ngʼa ma notimo richo; ngʼatni koso jonywolne, momiyo nonywole muofu?”
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruoth Yesu obed kodu.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: “Ochoko ngʼich mar pi kogolo ewi pige, kendo olokogi koth mi gichak gichue gipongʼ aore;
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

kikuyu: Koro Zedekia wuod Kenana noloso tunge mag nyinyo kolando niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ‘Gi chumbegi ibiro chwowo jo-Aram nyaka itiekgi chuth.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

kikuyu: Noloso pasia mar nanga marambulu, gi maralik, gi makwar kod law mayom motwangʼe kido mar kerubi.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

kikuyu: Ere kaka wanyalo wero wende Jehova Nyasaye kapod wan e piny ma wendo?
english: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

kikuyu: Hushai nonyiso Zadok gi Abiathar, ma jodolo niya, “Ahithofel osengʼado rieko ni Abisalom gi jodong Israel mondo otim ma gi macha, to an bende asengʼado rieko mondo gitim mana kama.
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼat machamo gik moko duto buon ngʼat ma ok cham, kendo ngʼat ma ok cham gik moko duto bende kik ngʼad bura ne ngʼat machamo, nikech Nyasaye oserwake.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

kikuyu: kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Okwongʼ mon mokwoyo bilo ma giritorego e ngʼut lwetgi kendo maloso kitembini ma borgi opogore opogore mar umo wiyegi mondo giket ngima ji e chandruok. Uparo ni dayienu uket ngima joga e chandruok to magu to urito maber?
english: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

kikuyu: Kendo Daniel nodhi nyime katiyo kanyo nyaka higa mokwongo mar loch mar ruoth miluongo ni Sairas.
english: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.

kikuyu: Yaye Israel, keturu genou kuom Jehova Nyasaye chakre tinende kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye otimo singruok gi jo-Israel, to nochikogi kama: “Kik ulam nyiseche mamoko kata kulorunegi, tiyonegi kata timonegi misango.
english: with whom the LORD had made a covenant and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;

kikuyu: Un joma odak Lakish tweuru fareseu e gecheu mag lweny. Un ema ne umiyo nyar Sayun odonjo e richo, nikech timbe jo-Israel maricho noa kuomu.
english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

kikuyu: Kar romb ji duto mane ni e yie ne gin mia ariyo gi piero abiriyo gauchiel.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

kikuyu: Abiro mana pakora kuom ngʼat machalo kamano, to ok anyal pakora kuoma awuon, makmana ka apakora kuom gigo manyiso nyawona.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

kikuyu: Laban nopenje, “Angʼo ma damiyi.” Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Kik imiya gimoro amora. To ka ihero to timna gimoro achiel, abiro dhi nyime gi kwayo kendo rito jambi.
english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

kikuyu: “Mana kaka Wuoro osehera, e kaka an bende aseherou. Koro sikuru e herana.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

kikuyu: Od ngʼat marach ibiro ketho to kar dak mar ngʼat makare biro dhiyo nyime.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

kikuyu: To nikech ne ok odwar nindo kanyo kendo, ngʼatno nowuok mi ochiko yo Jebus (tiende ni, Jerusalem), gi pundege ariyo kod dhako morono.
english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

kikuyu: Mad Jal maka wakwayo gimoro amora to chiwo mathoth moloyo kaka wakwaye kata kaka waparo, kuom tekone matiyo kuomwa,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

kikuyu: Nikech kata obedo ni an thuolo kendo ok an misumba ngʼato, to aselokora misumba ji duto mondo alok ji mangʼeny oyie kuom Kristo.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

kikuyu: Bende onge ngʼama olo divai manyien e piende moti mag tingʼo divai. Ka otimo kamano to divai manyien-no nyalo yiecho piend divaino mi divai pukre kendo piend divai kethre. Ooyo, divai manyien nyaka ol mana e piende manyien mag tingʼo divai.”
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

kikuyu: Abiro choko pinje duto mi akelgi mwalo e Holo mar paw Jehoshafat. Kanyono ema anangʼad nigi e bura, kuom girkeni mara, ma gin joga ma jo-Israel, nikech negikeyo joga e kind pinje kendo gikawo pinya gipogo.
english: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,

kikuyu: Kik uchal gi kwereu, mane jonabi machon oywak nigi kawacho ni: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho, ‘Lokreuru uwe yoreu maricho kod timbeu maricho.’ To negitamore winja kata dewa, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jokwadh angurogo noringo oa mine gidhi gitero wach ne ji duto modak e dala kendo e gwengʼno gima nosetimore, omiyo jogo duto nobiro mondo gin bende gineye gi wangʼ-gi.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Jaduongʼ, onge ngʼat modongʼ.” Yesu nokone niya, “Kata an bende ok angʼadni bura. Wuogi idhi, to kik ichak itim richo kendo.”]
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

kikuyu: To in, ngʼat Nyasaye, pogri gi mago duto kiketo chunyi kuom ngima makare kod luoro Nyasaye gi yie kod hera kendo kitimo kinda kod muolo.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

kikuyu: Nogoyonegi ngero machielo kama: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi koth karadali ma ngʼato nokawo mopidho e puothe.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

kikuyu: Heshbon kod Jazer kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Pok aweyo bedo jakwath mari; ingʼeyo ni pok agombo odiechiengʼ mar thagruok. Gima wuok e dhoga ingʼeyo.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.

kikuyu: Omiyo noa malo, mokawo nyathi gi min mare, kendo nodhi e piny Israel.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

kikuyu: “Ndalo keyo kod ndalo oro osekalo, to ok wakonyore.”
english: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”

kikuyu: Esta ne pok onyiso ngʼato ni en nyar oganda mane, kata nonro mar anywolane, nikech Modekai ne osekwere ni kik onyis ngʼato wachno.
english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.

kikuyu: Bangʼe kane Rehoboam nosegurore motegno kaka ruoth, en kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto negijwangʼo chike Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD’s law, and all Israel with him.

kikuyu: Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo kendo tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera.
english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

kikuyu: nikech mwandune duto oserumo. Mach ma lwet dhano ok omoko biro wangʼe molokre buru kendo biro tieko gimoro amora modongʼ e hembe.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jakobo nodhi mokelo nyidiek mopugno ne min mare kendo noloso chiemo mamit mana kaka wuon-gi ohero.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

kikuyu: Kik iyie gimoro amora marach ywa chunya, ma dimi an bende atim timbe maricho, kaachiel gi joma timbe gi richo; rita mondo kik acham chiembgi mabeyonegi.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

kikuyu: nyikwa Elam, Jeshaya wuod Athalia, kaachiel kode ji piero abiriyo;
english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

kikuyu: kendo negiluongo kanyo ni Bokim. Kanyo ne gichiwoe misengini ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne osiko e richo mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyogo jo-Israel odonjo e richo; kendo ne ok oweyogi kata matin.
english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

kikuyu: Gima Andrea notimo mokwongo ne en manyo owadgi ma Simon kendo nyise niya, “Waseyudo Mesia” (tiende ni Kristo).
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

kikuyu: Ne ayawone jaherana, mi ayudo ka jaherana osewuok kendo osea! Chunya norumo kane odhi oyomba. Ne amanye, to ne ok ayude. Ne aluonge, to ne ok odwoka.
english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.

kikuyu: Kane Balak owinjo ni Balaam biro, nowuok mondo oromne e dala jo-Moab mokiewo gi aora Arnon, e giko mar pinye.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

kikuyu: Kata jaricho chok fedha mangʼeny manade, kod lewni bende mangʼeny,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

kikuyu: Nohero kwongʼo ji to koro mad kwongʼneno dogne; ne ok ohero gwedho ji omiyo koro mad gweth bed mabor kode.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

kikuyu: Kawuono gibiro bworo kambigi Nob; gibiro kwadho bandera, e got mar nyar Sayun, machiegni gi got matin mar Jerusalem.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ringi idhi iromne mondo ipenje ni, ‘Bende in kare? Chwori bende nikare? To nyathi nikare?’ ” Dhakono nodwoke niya, “Gik moko duto nikare.”
english: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

kikuyu: Ka Judas, ngʼat mane ondhoge oneno ka osengʼadne Yesu buch tho, luoro nomake mi nodwoko pesa mamingli mag fedha piero adek ne jodolo madongo gi jodongo,
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

kikuyu: Omiyo Gideon nooro jo-Israel mamoko e hembegi, to ji mia adek mane odongʼ-go nokawo chiemo kod turumbete mag joma nodok e miechgi. Kambi jo-Midian ne ni e holo gi mwalo.
english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

kikuyu: Mane onywolne kod chiege Hodesh, ne gin Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

kikuyu: Thuondigo ne gin: Asahel owadgi Joab, Elhanan wuod Dodo ma ja-Bethlehem,
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kikuyu: Winjuru, Ruoth nobed gi loch makare kendo jotelo nobed gi telo mar adier.
english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata ma nindo e odno kata chiemo e odno, nyaka luok lepe.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

kikuyu: Saulo nopenje niya, “Wuowi matin in wuod ngʼa?” Daudi nodwoko niya, “An wuod Jesse ma ja-Bethlehem ma jatichni.”
english: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

kikuyu: To ubiro tho ka ji ajia; adier ubiro podho mana kaka jatelo moro amora ma ok otangʼ.”
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano e mier madongo duto mag ogendini ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni, kik uwe gimoro amora mayweyo kangima.
english: But of the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

kikuyu: Joma ofuwo masiko kokwakore, ketho ngimane owuon.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

kikuyu: Kik ibed mamor gi masiche mag jasiki, ka ochwanyore, kik iyie chunyi bed mamor;
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

kikuyu: Koso iparo ni mwanduni mathoth kata nyagruok minyagori, gi tekri iwuon nyalo siri mi goli e chandruok?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

kikuyu: to wuode makayo ne en Abdon, kiluwe gi Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

kikuyu: Eka kerubigo nohuyo kochomo malo. Magi e gik mangima angʼwen manoyudo aseneno e bath Aora Kebar.
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

kikuyu: Jonathan ne owacho ne wuowi matingʼo gige lwenje niya, “Bi mondo waidh wadhi e kambi joma ok oter nyangugi. Kamoro dipo ka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo tiyo kodwa. Onge gima nyalo tamo Jehova Nyasaye reso kata ka gin ji mangʼeny kata ka gin ji manok.”
english: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the LORD will work for us, for there is no restraint on the LORD to save by many or by few.”

kikuyu: Delila nohoyo Samson mi nonindo koteno wiye kuome, eka noluongo ngʼato mondo obi oliel yie wiye mane osekad nyadibiriyo. Bangʼ mano tekre norumo.
english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

kikuyu: Eka yawuot Harun jadolo nomok mach e kendo mar misango, kendo ginichan yien ewi mach.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

kikuyu: To Ruoth nochungʼ buta momiya teko, mine ayudo teko mar dhi nyime gilando wach nyaka chop joma ok jo-Yahudi duto winj wach maberno mar Injili. Noresa bende e dho sibuor.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

kikuyu: An awachonu gik ma aseneno kuom Wuora wangʼ gi wangʼ, to un usiko utimo mana gik ma useneno kuom wuonu.”
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

kikuyu: bangʼe nomako mach e yiw kibwego mi oweyogi mondo gidonj e puothe mag jo-Filistia. Nowangʼo puothe moseka to gi mago mapodi, kaachiel gi puoth mzabibu kod puothe zeituni.
english: When he had set the torches on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, and also the olive groves.

kikuyu: E bwo gima opedhoreno, bwombegi ne oyarore ka moro ka moro ochomo nyawadgi, kendo ka moro ka moro nigi bwombene moumogo dende.
english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

kikuyu: Bende kik umi Roho Maler mar Nyasaye chuny lit nikech en ema Nyasaye osemiyougo kaka ranyisi ni noresu chiengʼ resruok.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

kikuyu: Weuru kamoro oko mar kambi ma unyalo dhi losorue,
english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye notimnegi mana gima ne otimone Sihon kod Og, ruodhi ma jo-Amor kaachiel gi pinjegi.
english: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye odagi misango mar jaricho, to lamo mar ngʼat moriere tir miye mor.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

kikuyu: “Nikech Nyasaye nohero piny ahinya, omiyo nochiwo Wuode ma miderma, mondo ngʼato angʼata moyie kuome kik lal, to obed gi ngima mochwere.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Wede mag jo-Isakar machwo mane ni e lweny kokwan-gi kaluwore gi nonrogi mar nywolgi ne ji alufu piero aboro gabiriyo (87,000).
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Joma noluong nying-gigo nokawo jogo mane omaki kendo negimiyo joma ne niduge duto lewni mane gigolo kuom gik mane gipeyo. Ne gimiyogi lewni kod wuoche, chiemo kod math, ne giwiro kuonde manoriemo gi mo. Jogo duto mane ool notingʼ e punde ka giterogi Jeriko, ma bende iluongo ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Othidhe kuma jowetegi mamoko ne nitiere, bangʼe negidok Samaria.
english: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.

kikuyu: “Un joma ogwedhi ka ji yanyou kendo sandou kendo hangonu wach ni usetimo kit gik maricho duto nikech an.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Abram osedak Kanaan kuom higni apar, Sarai chiege nokawo misumbane ma nyako Misri, ma nyinge Hagar kendo nochiwe ne chwore mondo obed chiege.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo kanyo, nogoyo turumbete e piny gode mag Efraim, kendo jo-Israel nolor kode piny koa e got, ka otelonegi.
english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

kikuyu: Zedekia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gachiel kane obedo ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni apar gachiel. Min mare ne nyinge Hamutal nyar Jeremia ma aa Libna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kikuyu: Omiyo nyisuru jootewago ni un joma ohero ji, mondo kanisni duto ongʼe ni mor ma wan godo kuomu ok en mor manono.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochamo manna kuom higni piero angʼwen nyaka negichopo e piny mane ji odakie, negichamo manna nyaka negichopo e tongʼ mar piny Kanaan.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Abiro medi ngima moromo higni apar gabich kendo abiro resi kaachiel gi dala maduongʼni e lwet ruodh Asuria. Abiro rito dala maduongʼni nikech nyinga kod nying Daudi jatichna.’ ”
english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

kikuyu: Ne giwuotho e piny Juda duto ka gichoko jo-Lawi kaachiel gi jotend anywola mag Israel moa e mier duto. Kane gibiro Jerusalem,
english: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ne aweyogi bende mondo oritgi gi buche maricho kendo e bwo chike mane ok nyal rito ngimagi.
english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.

kikuyu: To apoya nono Yesu norado kodgi, mowachonegi niya, “Misawauru.” Kendo negisudo bute mi gimoko e tiendene, kendo gilame.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: bade nolodhi makee. Enobed maber ka yiend zeituni, kendo nodungʼ mangʼwe ngʼar ka yiend Lebanon.
english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

kikuyu: Kik imiri duongʼ iwuon e nyim ruoth, kata bedo kar jomadongo,
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

kikuyu: Neuru, anakel jo-Media, ma ok dew fedha kendo ok gomb dhahabu mondo omonjgi.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

kikuyu: Nimar usekawo fedha gi dhahabu mara, kendo usedar gi mwanduga mabeyo mogik e hekalu mau.
english: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,

kikuyu: Ka warito chike Nyasaye eka wabedo gi ratiro ni wangʼeye.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo Ndiko wacho niya, “Kane oidho odhi malo, nodhi kotelo ni joma nomako e lweny, kendo nomiyo ji mich.”
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

kikuyu: To ne le duto mag piny kod winy duto mafuyo e kor polo kod gik moko duto mawuotho e piny, gimoro amora mangima; amiyo lum duto mondo obed chiembgi.” Kendo nobedo kamano.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo ma, ne giywak kendo. Eka Orpa nogone wuon odgi oriti, to Ruth to notwere kode.
english: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni aseketo genona e dhahabu kata asewachone dhahabu maler ni in e kar pondona,
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruoth nogolo chik mondo olos sanduku, kendo okete e dhoranga hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Hoho ka hoho nobugi mapongʼ, gode madongo gi matindo duto nopie. Yore mobam biro bedo moriere, yore motimo gogni nobed mayom.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

kikuyu: Wach mar “kendo” nyiso ni Nyasaye biro golo oko gik mayiengni manyalo wuok, ma gin gik mochwe mondo gik ma ok nyal yiengni ema odongʼ kosiko.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

kikuyu: “Awachonu bende ni ka ji ariyo kuomu e piny-ka owinjore kuom gimoro amora mukwayo to Wuora manie polo notimnugo.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ginichak giger kuonde machon mane omukore, ka gidwoko kare kuonde mane okethore, kendo ginichak giger mier madongo mane okethore mosebedo kojwangʼ e tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
english: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane obiro ir Othniel, nojiwe mondo okwa wuon mare puodho. Kane olor oa e pundane, Kaleb nopenje niya, “En angʼo midwaro ni mondo atimni?”
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

kikuyu: Anathoth kod Almon, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Maritha nowacho ni Yesu niya, “Ruoth, ka dinyocha bed ni in ka, to owadwa dine ok otho.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

kikuyu: Ne ichweyo nyandwat gi milambo; Tabor gi Hermon pako nyingi gi wer gi mor.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

kikuyu: Ka iwacho niya, “Ne ok wangʼeyo gimoro kuom wachni,” donge ngʼatno mapimo chuny dhano ongʼeyo wachno? Donge ngʼat morito kendo ngʼiyo ngimani ongʼeyogo? To donge obiro chulo ngʼato ka ngʼato mowinjore gi timbene?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

kikuyu: Nyomburu mondo onywol yawuowi kod nyiri; yuduru mon ne yawuotu kendo uchiw nyiu mondo onyuom, magin bende ginywol yawuotgi kod nyigi mondo kwanu omedre kendo kik udog chien.
english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

kikuyu: Kane Nowa kongʼo orumo e wangʼe, mi ofwenyo gima wuode matin notimone,
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

kikuyu: “Asuria ni kanyo gi jolwenje duto, kolwore gi liete mag joma osenego duto, ma gin ji duto moseneg gi ligangla.
english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

kikuyu: Mano e kit ngima mane oluongue nikech Kristo nosandi nikech un, mine oweyonu ranyisi mondo un bende uluw timne.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

kikuyu: “Chandruok ma Nyasaye ochano ne ngʼama timo timbe mahundu, kendo girkeni mar ngʼama timo timbe marichogo yudo koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema:
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Magi e kit le gi jamni munyalo chamo: rwath, rombo, diel,
english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

kikuyu: En ema nochweyo sulwe madongo kaka, yugni, oluoro-budho, ratego, kod sulwe mogudore mathoth man yo milambo.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

kikuyu: kama jachien notemee kuom ndalo piero angʼwen. Kuom ndalo piero angʼwen-go ne ok ochamo gimoro e ndalogo duto, to bangʼ ka ndalogo noserumo kech nokaye.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Josef nowacho ne owetene niya, “An Josef! Bende wuora pod ngima?” To owetene ne ok nyal dwoke, nikech luoro nomakogi ahinya e nyim Josef.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

kikuyu: achano mar timo kamano kadhi Spania. Ageno mar limou ka abiro akadho mondo bangʼ bedo kodu moromo to ukonya e wuodhano.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

kikuyu: Dwar Jehova Nyasaye ka pod thuolo nitie minyalo yudego; chutho luonge kapod en machiegni.
english: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

kikuyu: Ket ranyisi kama yo pogorego mondo onyis yo madonjo Raba mar jo-Amon, to machielo madonjo Juda kendo moro madonjo Jerusalem mochiel motegno.
english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

kikuyu: Misri bubni ka aora Nael kendo mana ka aore ma pigegi bubni. Owacho ni, ‘Abiro gingora kendo anapongʼ piny; anaketh mier madongo kod ji modakie.’
english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’

kikuyu: Nimar owacho ne Musa niya, “Anakech ngʼama adwaro kecho, kendo anangʼwon-ne ngʼama adwaro ngʼwonone.”
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Josef nomiyo wuon-gi kod owetene kuonde mabeyo e piny Misri e gwengʼ mar Rameses mana kaka Farao nochike.
english: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

kikuyu: Hazor Hadata, Kerioth Hezron (tiende ni, Hazor),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

kikuyu: Kane ruoth madhako mar Sheba oneno rieko Solomon kaachiel kod ode mar dak manosegero,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

kikuyu: Winj ywakna mar dwaro kony, Yaye Ruodha kendo Nyasacha, nikech in ema alami.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

kikuyu: Pi nomedo gingore ahinya e piny, kendo gode maboyo duto man e bwo polo noimore.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

kikuyu: “Ka magi duto notimre kendo gibiro timore mak orem, eka giningʼe ni janabi moro kara ne ni e diergi.”
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo ne umanya? Ok ungʼeyo ni onego abed e od wuora?”
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

kikuyu: Kane ji owinjo wachno, joma nodak kama oger motingʼore gi malo mar Shekem nodhi kama oger motegno mar hekalu mar El-Berith.
english: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Benjamin: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma kamano nyalo wacho kuom Jehova Nyasaye niya, “En e kar pondona kendo en e ohingana, en e Nyasacha ma ageno kuome.”
english: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai ma muofnigi! Kuong ulwok i kikombe gi bakul, eka ngʼegi oko bende biro bedo maler.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

kikuyu: Koro angʼo momiyo udhi Misri mondo umodh pi moa Shihor? Kendo angʼo momiyo udhi Asuria mondo umodh pi moa e Aora?
english: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

kikuyu: Musa noyangʼo rwadhno kendo rembe moko nokawo gi lith lwete momieno e tunge kendo mar misango mondo opwodhgo kendo mar misango. Remo modongʼ to ne opuko e bwo kendo mar misango. Kamano nowalo kendo mar misangono mondo opwodhego.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

kikuyu: “Dine bed ni an in, to dine atero ywakna ne Nyasaye; kendo keto weche mathaga e nyime.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

kikuyu: An Johana, Andiko ni kanise abiriyo manie piny Asia: Ngʼwono kod kwe obednu koa kuom Jal mantie, Jal mane nitie kendo Jal mabiro betie, kendo koa kuom Roho abiriyo manie nyim kom duongʼne,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

kikuyu: Ahimaz norito Naftali (kendo nokendo Basemath nyar Solomon);
english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

kikuyu: Aseneno ngʼama timbene richo kendo makwiny kadhi maber mana ka yien mangʼich moti e lowo mowinjore kode.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

kikuyu: Osenyiso joge tekre kuom gik motimo komiyogi lope mag ogendini moko.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

kikuyu: “E tipo mar Heshbon joma noringo odongʼ ka ok nyal, nimar mach osemoko liel Heshbon kendo ligek mach osewuok e dier Sihon; owangʼo lela wangʼ Moab, kod choke wich mag jongʼayigo!
english: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

kikuyu: Kiny ne gokinyi mangʼich, Laban nogone nyige gi nyikwaye oriti kendo nogwedhogi. Eka nowuok modok dala.
english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

kikuyu: Yie bende ema nomiyo oloso Sap Ruoth, mi okiro remo e dhout jo-Israel mondo Malaika mane nego nyithindo makayo e piny Misri kik negi nyithi jo-Israel, makayo.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

kikuyu: nimar wachne nomiyo jo-Yahudi mangʼeny koro ne weyogi dhi ir Yesu kendo giyie kuome.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

kikuyu: Kaka koro usepwodhuru uwegi kuom luwo adiera, mondo eka uher joweteu, koro herreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gihera matut, kendo timuru kamano gi chunyu duto.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma osiko koluwo adiera, joma osiko katimo gima kare.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye kumo ngʼama ohero, kendo nyathine mohero ema ochwado.”
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro e dier oganda nodwoke niya, “Japuonj, ne akeloni wuoda ma jachien marach opongʼo kendo oloko momo.
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

kikuyu: “Eka wuon puoth mzabibu nowacho ni, ‘Abiro timo angʼo? Abiro oro wuoda mahero, kamoro dipo ginyalo winje!’
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

kikuyu: Kane Eliab mowadgi Daudi maduongʼ, owinje ka owuoyo gi ji, mirima nomake kode mopenje niya, “Ibiro ka nangʼo? To rombe manok ka to iweyo gi ngʼa e thim? Angʼeyo ni in jangʼayi bende pachi richo, isebiro mana ni mondo ine kaka lweny dhi.”
english: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”

kikuyu: kendo nodhi modak e dala miluongo ni Nazareth. Kamano gima nowachi gi dho janabi niya, “Enoluonge ni ja-Nazareth,” nochopo kare.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

kikuyu: Chokruok mar ogandani duto nodwoko gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “In kare! Nyaka watim kaka iwacho.
english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

kikuyu: Ka polo odudo, to koth chue e piny. Kata ka yien olwar yo milambo kata yo nyandwat, kama olwarieno, kanyo ema iyude.
english: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

kikuyu: Bende nogero Tadmor mane nitie e thim kaachiel gi mier madongo mag keno manogero Hamath.
english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, adiera wiya nowil kodu kendo ma agolu oko e nyim wangʼa kaachiel gi dala maduongʼ mane amiyou kod wuoneu.
english: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.

kikuyu: Tiuru kuom ndalo auchiel kendo uti tijeu duto,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

kikuyu: Ok ochiem ewi gode milame nyiseche manono kata ngʼiyo nyiseche manono mag dhood Israel. Kendo ok odwanyre gi chi nyawadgi kata bedo e achiel gi dhako manie kindene mar neno malo.
english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

kikuyu: Ka ruoth okecho kodi, to kik iwe tiji mitiyono; nimar kibolori to ruoth nyalo ngʼwononi kuom kethogi mangʼeny.
english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama paro joricho kendo wich wil kodgi; mi kudni chamgi kendo itiekogi chuth.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

kikuyu: mondo gibed moikore e odiechiengʼ mar adek, nimar chiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye biro lor ewi Got Sinai ka ji duto nene.
english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Petro nodhi kodgi, kendo kane ochopo to ne gitere nyaka ei ot man malo e gorofa kama ne ringre Tabitha nitie. Mon duto ma chwogi otho mane ni kanyo nochungʼ olwore, ka giywak kendo ginyise lep kandho kod lewni mamoko mane Dorka otwangʼo kapod ongima.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

kikuyu: We keto genoni kuom dhano nimar dhano, en mana muya kende mawuok e ume. Koso en angʼo man kuome maber?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

kikuyu: Kik unyis jo-Gath wachni bende kik uywagi kata matin. E dala Beth Ofra ngʼielreuru e buru.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.

kikuyu: To e piny Juda bende ema ne lwet Nyasaye ne nitie kuom jogo mondo omigi bedo e paro achiel mondo gitim gima ruoth gi jodonge nochiko kaluwore gi wach mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: To dhood Lawi ne ok omiyo girkeni, nikech chiwo mane ochiw kokalo e mach ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel e girkeni margi, mana kaka ne osingonigi.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa kuomu, wuone, ma ka wuodi okwayi rech, to imiye mana thuol?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

kikuyu: Ka lemo moro amora kuom ringʼoni ocham chiengʼ mar adek, to Jehova Nyasaye ok noyie kodu nikech en gima kwero.
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

kikuyu: Sibuor ne yangʼo le moromo nyithinde kendo ne gideyo le ma gichamo gi nyawadgi, ka opongʼo kar kano chiembe kod kuonde dakne gi gik monegi.
english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.

kikuyu: Nyaka giwinju kendo giti tije duto mag Hema, to kik gidhi machiegni gi gig kama ler mar lemo kata mag kendo mar misango, ka ok kamano to gin kod un duto ubiro tho.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

kikuyu: Petro nopenje niya, “Ruoth iwacho ngeroni ni wan koso ni ji duto?”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

kikuyu: Dishan nonywolo: Uz kod Aran.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Richona osetwe e ngʼuta ka jok; adier osetweyogi gi lwete owuon. Oseketgi e ngʼuta kendo Ruoth Nyasaye osetieko tekra, bende osejwangʼa e lwet joma ok anyal loyo.
english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

kikuyu: Ni ji duto man Rumi, ma Nyasaye ohero kendo oluongo mondo obed jomaler: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Jair ma nyakwar Manase nodhi mokawo mier madongo mane ni kanyo, kendo nochako kanyo ni Havoth Jair.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

kikuyu: Nooro joote odhi Manase duto, koluongogi mondo gitingʼ gige lweny, kendo gidhi ir Asher, Zebulun kod Naftali, mondo gin bende gidhi girom kode.
english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

kikuyu: Kane gin kuno kite nolokore ka gineno. Lela wangʼe norieny ka chiengʼ, kendo lepe nolokore rachar marieny ka ler.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

kikuyu: Agengʼo mirimba nikech nyinga awuon; kendo ahora mondo arit pakna, mondo omi kik atieku.
english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

kikuyu: Awacho ka aramo gi mirimba mager ni anami piny yiengni matek e piny Israel.
english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,

kikuyu: to Uzia ne en wuon Jotham, Jotham ne en wuon Ahaz, Ahaz ne en wuon Hezekia,
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

kikuyu: Nopodho piny e tiend Daudi mi owacho kama: “Ruodha we rach obed e wiya awuon. Kiyie to we jatichni owuo kodi; winj gima jatichni dwa wacho.
english: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.

kikuyu: To Manase ne ok oriembo jo-Beth Shan kata Tanak kata Dor kata Ibleam kata Megido kod alwora mar kuonde dak-gi, nimar jo-Kanaan noramo ni nyaka gidag e pinyno.
english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

kikuyu: Auru malo, dhiuru kucha! Nikech kae ok en kar yweyo maru, nimar odwanyore, kendo okethore ma ok nyal kony.
english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

kikuyu: Anas, jadolo maduongʼ, bende ne ni kanyo, kaachiel gi Kaifas, Johana, Aleksanda, kod jood jadolo maduongʼ mamoko.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

kikuyu: Joma hapgi rach momako otieko kendo podho chuth, gipodho e bwo tekone.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

kikuyu: E kor ohinga manie bethe gama mar hekalu ne nitie otuchi matindo tindo mane okedie yiend othidhe e bethegi koni gi koni. Udi matindo mag hekalu bende ne nigi gama moyware gi oko.
english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

kikuyu: Wan bende lemnwauru mondo Nyasaye oyawnwa dhoot mar yalo Injili, kendo lando wach modhiero ji ngʼeyo mar Kristo momiyo koro otweya gi nyororo.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

kikuyu: Elisha nowachone niya, “E kinde ma kama e higa mabiro, ibiro tingʼo nyathi ma wuowi e badi.” Dhakono nowachone niya, “Ruodha, kik iwuond jatichni, yaye ngʼat Nyasaye!”
english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

kikuyu: Kane Simon oneno ni ji ne yudo Roho Maler ka joote oyieyo lwetgi kuomgi, nomiyogi pesa kowacho niya,
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

kikuyu: Otienono Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kaw rwath mar ariyo koa e kweth wuonu, ma hike abiriyo. Muk kendo wuonu mar misango ne Baal kendo ingʼad siro mar Ashera man bute.
english: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

kikuyu: Koro wan gi chandruok, ok mana nikech ji biro chayo tijwani mi ohandwani podhi, to bende nikech hekalu mar nyasaye madhako marahuma, ma en Artemis owuon, ibiro chayo, mi Artemis owuon, ma ji lamo e piny Asia, nyaka e piny duto, ok bi ngʼe duongʼne kaka nyasaye!”
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

kikuyu: Giduto gin gik malal nono, nikech gin mana chike gi puonj mag dhano.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

kikuyu: To herana to ok nogol kuome kaka ne agole kuom Saulo, mane agolo e nyimi.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

kikuyu: Omiyo chiengʼno ji duto gi Israel duto nongʼeyo ni ruoth ne ok oriwore e wach nek mar Abner wuod Ner.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa kod Harun.
english: The children of Israel went and did so; as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

kikuyu: Makmana jo-Israel ne ok oriembo jo-Geshur gi jo-Maaka, omiyo pod gidak e dier jo-Israel nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon nobiro mi giriedo ne lweny e dhoranga dalagi maduongʼ kane ruodhi mane obiro konyogi ne nikendgi e pap.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

kikuyu: Kik agoyi gi mbi mi iluora, kiparo ni aloyi e yo moro amora.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato otho, bende dochak obed mangima kendo? Ndalona duto mag tichna matek abiro rito, an to abiro dhil gi thagruokna, nyaka kinde maber chopi.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Zenan, Hadasha, Migdal Gad,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi mamoko bende nodonjo kode e wuondruokneno, mi nyaka Barnaba bende noriwore kode e wuondruokno.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamono kendo jaricho mawuotho awuotha kowacho weche mogak,
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kikuyu: Shema nonywolo Raham, to Raham nonywolo Jorkeam. Rekem ne wuon Shamai.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa kuomgi mosechungoe kar ngʼado bura mar Jehova Nyasaye, mondo one kata owinji wachne?
english: For who has stood in the council of the LORD, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?

kikuyu: Jaherana, ijaber mana ka Tirza, ilongʼo mana ka Jerusalem, ichanori mana ka jolweny motingʼo bendeche.
english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno jo-Israel manok, ma nyikwa Jakobo mane odongʼ, nowe keto genogi kuom ngʼat mane tiekogi, to gini gen gi chunygi duto mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye, Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

kikuyu: Koa kuom oganda Juda, Simeon, kod Benjamin negipogogi mier mondik malogo.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: Jatichne nopenjo niya, “Ere kaka daket chiemo matin-gi ne ji mia achiel?” Elisha nomedo mana wachone niya, “Mi ji chiemo mondo ocham. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: ‘Gibiro chiemo kendo chiemo moko biro dongʼ.’ ”
english: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

kikuyu: ma udagi buchena kendo uchayo chikena, ma ok urito chikena duto ma uketho singruok mara mane atimo kodu,
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

kikuyu: Ji duto mane owinjo wachno nodhier nono kagiwacho niya, “Osetimo gik moko duto maber, koda ka joma itgi odino omiyo winjo wach, kendo momni bende omiyo wuoyo.”
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

kikuyu: Ji duto biro winjo wachno jo-Efraim kod joma odak Samaria duto, ma wuoyo gi sunga kod wangʼ teko kawacho niya,
english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

kikuyu: Ibiro chiwe ne joma ok jo-Yahudi. Gibiro jare, giniyanye, mi gingʼudh olawo kuome.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

kikuyu: Dhano tiyo matek mondo oyud gima ochamo, to kata kamano gik moyudo ok rome.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

kikuyu: Kina, Dimona, Adada,
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma kamano Jehova Nyasaye biro gwedho kendo obiro yudo ber moa kuom Nyasaye ma Jawarne.
english: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

kikuyu: E kinde mabiro ka wuodi openji niya, “Weche, buche kod chike mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa omiyi, tiendgi en angʼo?”
english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”

kikuyu: donge dakumgi kuom ma?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Donge dakel kum mara kuom oganda machalo kama?
english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma uwinjo ka turumbete oywakie, to yworwauru kanyo. Nyasachwa biro kedonwa!”
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

kikuyu: Ne giwinjore ni gihondho yiedhi mangʼeny mag loko ohala. Bangʼe kane oselosgi Ezion Geber,
english: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: “Los kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani gi yiend siala.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

kikuyu: Rituru Sabato maga e yo maler, mondo gibedi ranyisi e kinda kodu. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.”
english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’

kikuyu: To ringʼo kod piem to ne otero oko mar kambi mowangʼogi.
english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Mana kaka ne asechano mar kelonu masira, kendo kane kwereu owangʼo iya,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: For the LORD of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

kikuyu: nikech ibiro mako ich kendo ininywol wuowi. Wembe ok nokal e wiye, nikech wuowino nyaka bed ja-Nazir, mowal ne Nyasaye, koa nywolne, kendo nochak reso jo-Israel oa e lwet jo-Filistia.”
english: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Eka Agripa nowachone Paulo niya, “In thuolo mondo iwuo kuomi iwuon.” Eka Paulo notingʼo bade malo bangʼe ochako wuoyo kowacho niya,
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

kikuyu: nyaka uwuog kuma upondoe kendo ukaw dala maduongʼno. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro ketogi e lwetu.
english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

kikuyu: Enowach niya, “Winjuru, yaye jo-Israel kawuono udhi kedo gi wasiku, kik chunyu aa kata luoro maku, kik kihondko gou bende kik utetni e nyimgi.
english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny nowachna e odiechiengno ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth, donge ne wakoro wach e nyingi, kendo e nyingi donge ema ne wariembogo jochiende kendo watimogo honni mangʼeny?’
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

kikuyu: Kata obedoni pige manie nam wuo kendo golo buoyo kata obedo ni gode yiengni kendo dhwolore. Sela
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

kikuyu: To ka gisetieko hulo wechegi, ondiek mawuok e bur matut maonge gikone noked kodgi, mi nologi kendo negogi.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

kikuyu: Ne otimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka Jehoyakim notimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

kikuyu: Negidhi kendo negiyudo gik moko mana kaka Yesu nosewachonegi. Omiyo negiiko Sap Pasaka.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: To kapo ni unyalo tingʼoru malo moloya kendo uchuoya gi wach nikech chandruok ma an-go,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

kikuyu: Bed koda ka; kik iluor; ngʼato madwaro negino an bende odwaro nega. Onge gima nohinyi ka in koda.”
english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”

kikuyu: To ka opudhe oko kama otweyeno, to kanyo kwede kawacho ni, ‘An ne ok aneni!’
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde matin, joma nochungʼ kanyo nodhi nyaka but Petro mowachone niya, “Ka iwacho adier, to in achiel kuomgi, nikech yo miwuoyogo huli e iro.”
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

kikuyu: Bende nogero udi moko momakore gi kor kama ler mar lemo gi oko. Udigo nolworo kama ler mar lemo.
english: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

kikuyu: Oganda jo-Israel noluongo makatino ni manna nikech nochalo gi kodhi matindo tindo marachere, kendo ne en gi ndhandhu machal gi kek moted gi mor kich.
english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni un gi ji alufu apar ma ritou e Kristo, to uonge gi wuone mangʼeny, nikech kuom Kristo Yesu, an ema ne abedo kaka wuonu kane ayalonu Injili.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Solomon niya, “Nikech ma en pachi kendo ok iserito singruokna gi buchena mane achiki, chutho abiro pogo lochni kendo abiro miyo achiel kuom jotichni.
english: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Wuogi idhi e od Judas, mantiere kama iluongo ni Yo Moriere Tir, mondo ipenjgi ngʼat moro ma ja-Tarso, miluongo ni Saulo nimar olemo kuno.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

kikuyu: Abiro chiwo jo-Misri e lwet jatelo mager, kendo ruoth makwiny ema nobed gi loch kuomgi.” Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: To Ishbi-Benob ma en achiel kuom nyikwa Rafa, mane omanore gi tongʼ ma pek mula mane olosgo wiye ne romo kilo adek gi nus kendo ne en-gi ligangla manyien, nowacho ni obiro nego Daudi.
english: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mariek manyalo kwano boche polo? Koso en ngʼa manyalo lengʼogi mondo koth ochwe,
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

kikuyu: nyikwa Gibar, ji piero ochiko gabich (95),
english: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

kikuyu: Nimar niyierogi e kind ogendini duto mag piny mondo gibed girkeni, mana kaka ninyiso jatichni Musa kane igolo kwerewa e piny Misri; yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.”
english: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: To ma e chik Nyasaye: ni mondo wayie e nying Wuode Yesu Kristo kendo mondo waherre ngʼato gi ngʼato, mana kaka Kristo nochikowa.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

kikuyu: Negiyiero bath koma ber moloyo mondo obed margi, nikech gin ema nopognegi migap jatelo. Negibiro ir jatend ji, mi gingʼado bura makare mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kumo jo-Israel.”
english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”

kikuyu: Ne waoro Timotheo, ma en owadwa kendo jatich Nyasaye kaachiel kodwa e tij lando Injili mar Kristo, mondo ojiw chunyu ubed motegno kuom yie maru,
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

kikuyu: Iwacho ni, ‘An jamoko; kendo ni aseyudo mwandu mathoth bende onge gima achando.’ To ok ingʼeyo ni in ngʼat mathagore mogik; idhier, in ngʼat monego okechi; bende in muofu kendo in duk.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

kikuyu: Ne awinjo gima owacho, to ne ok angʼeyo tiendgi. Omiyo napenjo niya, “Ruodha, giko mag gigi duto biro chalo nadi?”
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

kikuyu: Godhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mar apar angʼwen mar dweno, jo-Israel nochokore Gilgal e pewe mag Jeriko kendo negitimo nyasi mar Pasaka.
english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie ngʼato ma nyinge Josef, mane en achiel kuom Buch Jodongo, ngʼat maber kendo makare,
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngimani nelongʼona kawuono, mad ngimana bende bed malongʼo ni Jehova Nyasaye mondo oresa e chandruok duto.”
english: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in the LORD’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”

kikuyu: anapar singruok e kinda kodi kaachiel gi gik mangima duto, tiengʼ ka tiengʼ. Pi ok nochak oketh gik mangima duto.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

kikuyu: “ ‘Timbeni mag chode osemiyo ibet modwanyore. Ne atemo luoki, to ne ok inyal bedo maler, koro ok ibi bedo maler nyaka mirimba mochomi rum.
english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

kikuyu: Elisha noluongo Gehazi mowachone niya, “Luong chi Shunem-cha.” Kendo Gehazi notimo kamano. Kane chi Shunam cha obiro, Elisha nowachone niya, “Kaw wuodi.”
english: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

kikuyu: Ben-Hesed norito Aruboth (Soko kod pinje duto mag Hefer).
english: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

kikuyu: Ahitub nonywolo Zadok, to Zadok nonywolo Shalum,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

kikuyu: Gik moko ma pinywani nyago dhi mana ne ruodhi miketo mondo otiwa nikech richowa. Gin gi teko kuom dendwa kendo gitimo mana gima gihero ni jambwa, to wan, to wan gi midhiero miwuoro.
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

kikuyu: Ikwero ji kikumogi nikech richogi; itieko mwandugi mana kaka thuth tieko oduma, dhano ka dhano en mana muya nono. Sela
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: E kindeno giniwach ni, “Adier ma en Nyasachwa; ne wageno kuome, kendo ne oresowa. Ma en Jehova Nyasaye, ne wageno kuome; wabeduru gi mor kendo gi ilo kuom warruokne.”
english: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

kikuyu: Bangʼ yiko wuon-gi, Josef nodok Misri kaachiel gi owetene kod ji mamoko mane odhi kode yiko wuon-gi.
english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

kikuyu: Nimar nyiego mamako chwor dhakono nyalo kelo tho, omiyo ka ochulo kuor, to nobed maonge ngʼwono kata matin.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Nikech Edom nochulo kuor ne dhood Juda mi gidoko joketho kuom timo mano,
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-ohala madongo moa Sheba gi Rama bende ne oloko kodi. Negikawo mwandugi mag ohala ka giwilo, gi yedhe maloso chiemo mamit gi kite ma nengogi tek kod dhahabu.
english: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.

kikuyu: Bangʼ odiechiengʼ achiel kane gisechamo chiemo moa e pinyno, chiemb manna ne ok ochako biro ni jo-Israel nikech e higano negichamo mana nyak mar Kanaan.
english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

kikuyu: “Bende inyalo ngʼeyo weche mopondo mag Nyasaye? Bende in gi teko mar ngʼeyo kuma duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ogikie?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

kikuyu: Noyudo Joshua orwakore gi lewni mochido sa mane ochungʼ e nyim malaika.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

kikuyu: Dine obedo maber manade ka dine ji ochamo gik mamoko moyaki kuom wasigu kawuono. Donge dine wanego jo-Filistia mangʼeny?”
english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

kikuyu: kendo negipenjore ngʼato gi ngʼato niya, “En ngʼa mabiro ngʼielonwa kidi e dho liel oko?”
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

kikuyu: Jodolo ne ok nyal donjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nikech duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼe.
english: The priests could not enter into the LORD’s house, because the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Pilato nopenjogi niya, “Nangʼo, en ketho mane mosetimo madimi gure?” To negimedo kok matek moloyo kagiwacho niya, “Gure!”
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Kane Saulo oneno kaka odhi maber, mine oluore.
english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

kikuyu: Nimar jomoko gin bwoch nikech ne onywolgi kamano, joma moko ji ema oloko bwoch, to mamoko to oseweyo kend nikech wach pinyruodh polo. Ngʼat mohero rwako wachni to mondo orwake.”
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

kikuyu: Wechegi manonogo bende nyalo hoyo ji malingʼ? Iparo ni onge ngʼama nyalo kweri kijaro ji kamano?
