english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

kikuyu: kendo kuom ndalo mangʼeny, joma ne wuotho kode koa Galili nyaka Jerusalem nonene. Jogo ema koro odoko joneno mag wechegi ni jowa.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

kikuyu: Negilamo Jehova Nyasaye to bende negilamo nyisechegi giwegi kaluwore gi timbe pinje manogolgie.
english: They feared the LORD, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.

kikuyu: Kik ichiwne Jehova Nyasaye chiayo ma muofu, ma rangʼol kata man-gi songa, kata man-gi kalanga, kata motimo aluny kata man-gi adhola machwer. Chiayo makamagi kik ket ewi kendo mar misango mondo obed misango miwangʼo pep gi mach ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

kikuyu: Abiro yiecho kitembini ma uumogo lela wengeu mi ares joga e lwetu, kendo ok ginichak gibed e bwo tekou. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane onyis Daudi wachni, nochoko jo-Israel duto ma ongʼado aora Jordan, kendo nochomogi mi giriedo ne lweny momanyore kodgi. Daudi noriedo joge mondo girad e lweny kod jo-Aram mi gikedo kode.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Israel osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech ungʼiewo joma kare gi fedha, to joma odhier ma ok nyal chudo, to ungʼiewo gi pat pat.
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;

kikuyu: Kane pok ayudo masira to ne abayo yo, to sani koro atimo gima wachni owacho.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo tucho ume mi isoe chuma kata tucho dhoge gi olowu?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma umo ketho mewo hera, to ngʼat mamedo timo gima kamano pogo osiepe moherore.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

kikuyu: Zebadia, Arad, Eder,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

kikuyu: Asayi kaw mich manokelnigo, nikech Nyasaye osebedona mangʼwon kendo an gi gik moko duto madwaro.” Nikech Jakobo noramo, Esau nokawo.
english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

kikuyu: Un chwo, heruru mondu, mana kaka Kristo bende nohero kanisa, mochiwore nikech en
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

kikuyu: Kane jotend Filistia wuotho dhi kaachiel gi jolwenjgi mane ochan e migepe mag miche gi alufe, Daudi gi joge kod Akish bende ne wuotho kaluwo bangʼ-gi.
english: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

kikuyu: Heshbon ne en dala maduongʼ mar Sihon ruodh jo-Amor mane osekedo gi ruoth machon mar Moab kendo nosemayo lopene duto mochopo nyaka aora Arnon.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

kikuyu: ka joma rito ruodhgi maduogo koa e nyasi mar arus, mondo kobiro kendo oduongʼo to giyawone dhoot piyo.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

kikuyu: Omiyo noluonge kowacho niya, ‘Wuora Ibrahim kecha kendo or Lazaro olut lith lwete e pi mondo okwena lewa, nikech an-gi rem malit e ligek majni.’
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

kikuyu: Mirima nochako omako Jehova Nyasaye kod Israel omiyo nochwalo Daudi motimo gimoro madihinygi, kowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo ikwan jo-Israel gi jo-Juda.”
english: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

kikuyu: ‘Ka idak e pinyni, anageru kendo ok anatieku; anapidhu to ok pudhou oko, nimar asebedo gi lit kuom masiche masekelo kuomu.
english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

kikuyu: bende ket karaya e kind Hemb Romo gi kendo mar misango mi iolie pi.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

kikuyu: Iye machwer nochok gikanyono mi nowinjo e dende ni ochango.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kata obedo ni nyingi en Jakobo to ok nochak oluongi kamano to koro ibiro luongi ni Israel.” Omiyo nochake ni Israel.
english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne alemo kama: “Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Polo, in Nyasaye maduongʼ kendo malich miwuoro, marito singruok mare mar hera gi jogo mohere kendo morito chikene.
english: and said, “I beg you, LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Lwet Jehova Nyasaye biro yweyo ewi godni, to Moab nonyon piny gi tiende, mana kaka inyono lum e dipo.
english: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

kikuyu: To gik mamoko duto mag loch Peka, gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: mondo afweny gima doduoka kendo angʼe gima onyalo wacho.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

kikuyu: Miriam nowernegi niya, “Weruru ni Jehova Nyasaye, nimar otingʼe malo ahinya. Oseimo faras gi jaithne ei nam.”
english: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”

kikuyu: Ka piny yawore to gik moko duto nenore maler; mana ka kido mogor e nanga.
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Adwaro owetena. Kinyisa kuma gikwayoe jambgi?”
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo mana kaka bayo yo mar ngʼato achiel nokelo kum ni ji duto, e kaka tim makare mar ngʼat achielno miyo ji duto bedo makare kendo yudo ngima.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

kikuyu: Loch Abija nomedo gurore motegno. Nokendo mon apar gangʼwen kendo ne en gi yawuowi piero ariyo gariyo kod nyiri apar gauchiel.
english: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

kikuyu: Joma isando nikech tim makare gin joma ogwedhi, nimar pinyruodh polo en margi.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: To Nyasacha biro miyou gik moko duto muchando, kogolo kuom mwandune maduongʼ manie Kristo Yesu.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ne afwenyo ni Nyasaye ne ok oore, to ne osekoro wach kuoma nikech Tobia kod Sanbalat ne osengʼiewe mar timo kamano.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

kikuyu: Tiendena osebedo kaluwo okangene adimba; asebedo ka aluwo yorene ma ok abar.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Saulo nomedo gerore kuom yie kendo nomedo bedo gi teko mangʼeny, kendo twak mane ochiwo konyisogo ni Yesu e Kristo nodhiero jo-Yahudi mane odak Damaski.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

kikuyu: Emomiyo weuru timbe maricho duto kod wuondruok duto, kod dondruok, gi nyiego kod kuoth e yo moro amora.
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo niya, “Angʼo mosetim kimiyogo Modekai duongʼ kuom gima notimono?” Jotichne nodwoko niya, “Onge gima osetimne.”
english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him said, “Nothing has been done for him.”

kikuyu: To nowachonegi niya, “Asedwaro ahinya mondo acham Sap Pasakani kodu kapok osanda.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kikuyu: Bende nosik kokwayi ngʼwono? Bende onyalo wuoyo kodi kobolore?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

kikuyu: mier matindogi ne gin mek nyikwa Harun mane oa kuom jo-Kohath e anywola mar jo-Lawi, nikech pok mokwongo nomigi.
english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane othono noa malo mobedo piny kendo nochako wuoyo, to Yesu nokawe momiye min-gi.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

kikuyu: Nokok gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya, “Luoruru Nyasaye kendo miyeuru duongʼ, nikech sa ma ongʼadoe bura osechopo! Lamuru Jal mane ochweyo polo gi piny kaachiel gi nam kod sokni mag pi.”
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

kikuyu: Nyaka teru nyangu kendo ma nobed ranyisi mar singruokna e kinda kodu.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

kikuyu: Aluongi gie tungʼ piny, aluongi ka chunya ool; telna nyaka lwanda mohinga gi bor.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nokawo makatigo mi nogwedhogi, bangʼe opogone joma nobedo piny, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nochiemo kaka odwaro. Kamano bende e kaka notimo gi rechgo.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

kikuyu: Ma e gima omiyo andikonu gigi ka aonge kodu, mondo ka achopo iru to kik abed makwiny kodu nikech teko ma Ruoth omiya en mar gerou to ok mar tiekou.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

kikuyu: Ne akoro chon gik makoro osetimoregi, dhoga nohulogi mi namiyo gingʼere; bangʼe ne akelogi piyo magitimore.
english: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.

kikuyu: kendo kaka gisetimo nyaka chakre ne ayier jotelo marito joga Israel. Bende abiro loyo wasiki duto. “ ‘Awachoni ni Jehova Nyasaye biro geroni ot:
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

kikuyu: Donge wan ema ne owuoyo kuomwa kowacho wachni? Ee, wachni ne ondiknwa, nikech ka japur puro kendo jakeyo keyo, to gitimo kamano ka gigeno ni ibiro pognigi cham moko.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ duto aserieyo bada ne oganda ma wigi tek, jogo mawuotho e yore ma ok beyo, ka gitimo dwarogi giwegi,
english: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

kikuyu: Omiyo negikawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gilworogo dala maduongʼno dichiel. Bangʼe ji noduogo e kambi margi mi otienono ginindo kanyo.
english: So he caused the LORD’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

kikuyu: To moloyo mano iparo ni asebiro monjo pinyni mana gi pacha awuon ka ok en wach moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye? Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema osenyisa mondo abi amonj pinyni kendo akethe.’ ”
english: Have I come up now without the LORD against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

kikuyu: Bende inyalo dwaro gik madongo ne in owuon? Kik idwargi. Nimar anakel masira ne ji duto, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, to kamoro amora midhiyoe anares ngimani.’ ”
english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says the LORD, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano anachak abwog chuny jogi gi masira bangʼ masira, mi rieko mar jorieko nolal kendo ngʼeyo mar joma ongʼeyo norum.
english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

kikuyu: To mano kaka litna nikech hinyruok mara! Adhonda ok thiedhre! Kata kamano awacho ne an owuon ni, “Ma en twona, kendo nyaka angʼi kode.”
english: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Yahudi owinjo wachno, negiwachone niya, “Koro wangʼeyo maonge kiawa ni in gi jachien! Ibrahim notho, kendo jonabi bende notho, to in to iwacho ni ka ngʼato orito wachni to ok notho.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼato mamoko taya kendo umo gi atonga kata kete e bwo kitanda. Kar timo kamano, to okete ewi rachungi taya, mondo jogo madonjo one ler.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

kikuyu: Masira maduongʼ mane iwacho ni inikel kuomwa kaachiel gi jatendwa isetimo. E bwo polo onge gima osetim machalo gi gima osetimore ne Jerusalem, e piny duto.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To negimedo wacho ka giramo niya, “Omiyo ji tungni kuonde duto e Judea kaluwore gi puonjne. Nochako e Galili to osebiro mochopo ka.”
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko niya, “Antie gi ji alufu mia achiel mawuotho gi tiendgi, to in to iwacho ni, ‘Abiro miyogi ringʼo moromogi chamo kuom dwe achiel mangima!’
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

kikuyu: Ma e kaka anywola mar Yesu Kristo ma wuod Daudi kendo wuod Ibrahim chalo:
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Zadok wuod Ahitub kod Abimelek wuod Abiathar to ne jodolo, Shavsha ne jagoro;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

kikuyu: Daudi noyudo ngʼwono e wangʼ Nyasaye, omiyo nokwayo mondo ogerne Nyasach Jakobo kar dak.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Ka bedowa kuom Kristo nyalo kelonwa hoch, kata hera maduogo chuny, kata lalruok kuom Roho, kata ngʼwono kod miwafu,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

kikuyu: Abiro tieko timbeu mag jwok ma ok unuchak ugo gagi kendo.
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.

kikuyu: Ode en yo malach matero ji e liel, otelo ni ji koterogi e kuonde mag tho.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

kikuyu: To Ruoth nowachone Anania niya, “Dhiyo! Ngʼatni en gir tichna ma aseyiero mondo oter nyinga e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi ma ok jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi ruodhigi; kendo e dier jo-Israel.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Simon Petro, mane ringo bangʼe bende notundo. En to nodonjo nyaka ei bur ik, mi noneno lewni mayom molir olir ka ni kanyo,
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

kikuyu: Chakre e nungone kadhi malo naneno kochalo gi mula maliet molut e mach kendo chakre e nungone kadhi piny nochalo gi mach kendo ler mangʼangʼni nolwore.
english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ni tich moro amora, kaachiel gi gimoro amora mopondo, bed ni ober kata orach.
english: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

kikuyu: To koro ohala moyudo kod chudo kuom tije noket tenge ne Jehova Nyasaye; ok nokan-gi kata kungogi ne en owuon. Ohala moyudo biro dhiyone jogo matiyone Jehova Nyasaye mondo ongʼiewgo chiemo mangʼeny kod lewni mabeyo.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

kikuyu: Pasiago duto ne romre ka borne romo fut piero angʼwen gariyo to lachne romo fut auchiel.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Ok imor gi misango mitimoni, nikech dine achiwonigo; misango miwangʼo pep ok miyi mor.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

kikuyu: Injili malando en ni Yesu Kristo ma Nyakwar Daudi ne ochier oa kuom joma otho.
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

kikuyu: nobedo mamor gi Josef kendo Josef notiyone, Potifa nokete jarit ode kod mwandu duto mane en-go.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

kikuyu: To Yesu noluongogi ire mowuoyo kodgi gi ngeche kowacho niya, “Ere kaka Satan digol Satan?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

kikuyu: “Kik ibed maluor; nikech ok iniyud wichkuot. Kik ibed gi luoro mar yudo wichkuot; nikech ok nojari. Wiyi nowil gi wichkuot mane iyudo ka in nyako, kendo ok inichak ipar chandruok mane ineno kane ibedo dhako ma chwore otho.
english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye nigi teko, dwond Jehova Nyasaye nigi duongʼ.
english: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

kikuyu: Dhoot midonjogo e ot mapiny ne nitie yo milambo mar hekalu to raidhi nochopo e ot madiere nyaka gorofa mar adek.
english: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

kikuyu: Otiego lwetena ne lweny; bedena nyalo ywayo atungʼ mar nyinyo.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nomiyo Ebed-Melek ja-Kush chik, “Kaw chwo piero adek koa kae kendo ugol janabi Jeremia e bur kapok otho.”
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”

kikuyu: Kendo Nowa gi yawuote gi chiege kod mond yawuote nodonjo ei yie mondo otony ne pi mar ataro.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

kikuyu: mondo oyal ji duto kendo mondo okum joma richo duto kuom timbegi maricho magisetimo e yo ma ok mi Nyasaye duongʼ kendo kuom weche maricho duto ma joricho mochayo Nyasaye oseyanyego.”
english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye noriembe e Puodho mar Eden mondo opur lowo kamane ogole.
english: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato onegi moyud ka oriere piny e pap kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou mondo ukaw kendo ok ongʼere malongʼo ngʼama onege,
english: If someone is found slain in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼama ofuwo ok par, e kaka ngʼama nigi rieko bende ok par; nikech e ndalo mabiro ok nopargi giduto. Ngʼama ofuwo gi ngʼama riek, giduto gibiro tho machalre!
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

kikuyu: Chuny ngʼat mamuomore nowinj wach gi tiende kendo ngʼat ma radwal nowuo maber kendo maliw.
english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

kikuyu: Ok in Nyasaye mamor gi timbe maricho. Joma richo ok nyal dak kodi kanyachiel.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

kikuyu: Ka turumbete oywak, to dhoudi mantie yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka chak wuoth.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo joma timbegi richo ngima angima, angʼo momiyo gidak amingʼa, kendo tekregi osiko medore ameda?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

kikuyu: Nikech ungʼeyo ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo kaka chal, ni kata obedo ni ne en gi mwandu, to nodoko modhier, nikech un, mondo un ubed jo-mwandu nikech dhierneno.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

kikuyu: Ne amiyo idongo ka yien mopidhi e puodho. Ne idongo kendo ne ibedo motegno, mine idoko yath motegno kendo ma jaber moloyo yedhe duto. Thundeni nobiro, kendo yie wiyi nodongo mabeyo, to kata kamano ne in duk thirith.
english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Chwo gi mon mahikgi ngʼeny biro bet e yore mag Jerusalem kendo, ka moro ka moro kuomgi sirore gi luth nikech hike ngʼeny.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mondo odogne Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo hulo gik madongo ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo kata manyalo nyiso pakne duto?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

kikuyu: “Tangʼnauru pesa ma un-go. Kido kod nying man kuome gin mag ngʼa?” Negidwoko niya, “Mag Kaisar.”
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Kendo kik okwanre ni ober maloyo owetene koweyo luwo chik. Bangʼe en kod nyikwaye nobedie loch ndalo mangʼeny e pinyruodh Israel.
english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

kikuyu: Weruru wende pak ne Nyasaye, weruru wende pak; weruru wende pak ne Ruodhwa, weruru wende pak.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

kikuyu: To kata kamano humbe nomedo landore moloyo, momiyo oganda mag ji nobiro winje kendo mondo ochang tuochegi.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

kikuyu: To ka udewo wangʼ ji to utimo richo kendo bura oseloyou kaka joketh chik.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

kikuyu: Donge pod un mana jopiny ka nyiego kod dhawo ni e kindu? Donge mano nyiso ni un jopiny kendo utimo timbe machalre gi timbe mag dhano?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

kikuyu: “Mano e lekno, kendo koro wabiro loke ne ruoth.
english: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

kikuyu: Koso gin malaike mage ma Nyasaye nonyiso niya, “Bed e bada ma korachwich, nyaka chop aket wasiki, e bwo tiendi”?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

kikuyu: kapo ni ne achomo wangʼa e ler mar wangʼ chiengʼ kata ka dwe ringo e tekone mos,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Benjamin noduogo e sechego kendo nomigi mond jo-Jabesh Gilead mane odongʼ. To mon-go ne ok nyal romogi duto.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye e Nyasaye maduongʼ, en e Ruoth maduongʼ moloyo nyiseche duto.
english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye e lerna kendo e warruokna; en ngʼa ma daluor? Jehova Nyasaye e kama ngimana opondoe. En ngʼa ma dibwoga?
english: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka ok usebedo jo-adiera e tiyo gi mwandu mar pinyni, en ngʼat mane mabiro genou gi mwandu madier?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

kikuyu: Dwaro maduongʼ mar ngimau onego obed ni mondo udag e ngima mokwe, ka urango mana tijeu kende, kendo kutiyo matek gi lwetu mana kaka ne wachikou,
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi ni: ‘Ka ungʼado Jordan mi uchopo Kanaan,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Gibea, oganda mar jonabi noromone, Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro mopongʼe gi teko eka nochako koro wach kodgi.
english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowachonegi niya, “Mad ne Jehova Nyasaye negwa e piny Misri! Kuno ne wabet kwalworo agulni mopongʼ gi ringʼo, kendo ne wachamo kit chiemo moro amora mane wadwaro, to isekelowa e thim ka mondo kech oneg ogandani duto.”
english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka jomoko kuomu ne chalo. To ne olwoku mi opwodhu, mi oketu udoko joma kare e nying Ruoth Yesu Kristo, kendo kuom Roho mar Nyasachwa.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

kikuyu: “Koro ka wadok ir wuonwa ma misumbani ka wuowini mangimane omakore kode onge to obiro tho,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

kikuyu: To yot mondo polo gi piny orum, moloyo ka nukta achiel matinie moloyo olal kuom Chik.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

kikuyu: Chur mar joma tho ochomo polo koa e dala maduongʼ kendo chunje joma ohinyore ywagore ka dwaro kony, to Nyasaye ok okum joma hinyogi.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

kikuyu: Nyaguru olemo manyiso ni uselokoru uweyo richo. Kendo kik upar e kindu uwegi ni, ‘Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.’ Nimar awachonu ni kata mana kitegi Nyasaye nyalo loko nyithind Ibrahim.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nyalo miyo ubed gi gweth mogundho, mondo kinde duto ubed gi gik moko duto munyalo konyorugo un uwegi, kod mamoko malangʼ munyalo konyogo joma moko.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

kikuyu: Negidoko jongʼayi nikech ne gin gi kite ma nengogi tek, kendo negitiyo kodgi kuom loso nyiseche manono. Negitiyo kodgi kuom loso kido manono; emomiyo abiro miyo gigi dokonegi gima ogak.
english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

kikuyu: Yawuot Bilha, jatich Rael madhako ne gin: Dan kod Naftali.
english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane asebaro, ne akwayo weruok; bangʼ kane wach osedonjona, ne agoyo agoga. Wiya nokuot kendo ne awinjo lit, nikech ne atingʼo wichkuot mar bedona rawera.
english: Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.’

kikuyu: Kane Ayub oselamo ne osiepene, Jehova Nyasaye nochako ogwedhe gi mwandu, kendo nomiye mwandu mathoth moloyo mane en-go mokwongo nyadiriyo.
english: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

kikuyu: Nikech angʼeyo maber ni iwinjo wach, andikoni ka an gi adiera ni ibiro timona maber moloyo kaka akwayi.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

kikuyu: Ok nariwra kodgi e buchegi, ok nariwra kodgi e chokruogegi, nikech ka mirima omakogi to ginego ji kendo gingʼado odond dhok sa asaya ka gihero.
english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

kikuyu: Daudi gi joge noywak matek ma tekregi norumo makoro ok ginyal ywak.
english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

kikuyu: Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni, nikech rombena onge jakwath kendo nikech mano osemiyo oyakgi mi gilokore chiemb ondiegi, kendo nikech joma kwayona ne ok omanyo rombena to ne giritore mana gin giwegi,
english: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

kikuyu: Gima Daudi nowacho nolandore mochopo ne Saulo eka Saulo noluonge.
english: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.

kikuyu: Solomon nonywolo Rehoboam, Rehoboam nonywolo Abija, Abija nonywolo Asa, Asa nonywolo Jehoshafat,
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

kikuyu: Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye misewacho ber.” Nodwoke kamano koparo niya, “Bende kwe kod rit makare nobedi e ndalo mar ngimana?”
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”

kikuyu: Ka Daudi noa kanyo nodhi Mizpa e piny Moab mowachone ruoth Moab niya, “Bende diyie mondo wuora gi minwa obi odag kodi nyaka angʼe gima Nyasaye biro timona?”
english: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mohinyo wadgi, nyaka timne gima otimono.
english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

kikuyu: Eka Balak nowacho ne Balaam niya, “Kare koro kik ikwongʼ-gi kata kik igwedhgi!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

kikuyu: E kindeno tuo nogoye mi otho, kendo noluok ringre bangʼe okete e ot man malo ewi gorofa.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

kikuyu: Eka Juda nodhi ire kendo owachone niya, “Yaye ruodha, yie mondo jatichni owuo kodi. Kik ikech gi jatichni kata obedo ni tekoni mar loch romre gi mar Farao owuon.
english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Tim kamano mondo ineane ka nitie gimoro marach kuoma, mondo itera e yor ngima mochwere.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Lony kilemba mitweyo e wiye kendo igol osimbo mar loch. Nikech gik moko ok bi bedo kaka ne gin chon: Joma ni piny ibiro tingʼ malo, to joma idewo wangʼ-gi ibiro dwok piny.
english: the Lord GOD says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

kikuyu: To jorit angʼwen madongo mag rangeye ma jo-Lawi ne otelo ne tich mar rito udi gi kuonde keno mag Od Nyasaye.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

kikuyu: Jo-Ai duto machwo kod mamon alufu apar gariyo notho chiengʼno.
english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma en Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Yaye jo-Israel, abiro kelo oganda moro mondo omonju, ka gisandou chakre Lebo Hamath nyaka e holo mar Araba.”
english: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says the LORD, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”

kikuyu: Ezer ne jatendgi, Obadia ne jalupne e telo, Eliab ne mar adek,
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ruodha ka ayudo ngʼwono e wangʼi, to kik ikadh jatichni.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Perez ne gin: koa kuom Hezron, joka Hezron; koa kuom Hamul, kod joka Hamul.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

kikuyu: To joma kare to mad bed mamor kendo moil e nyim Nyasaye; mad gibed mamor kendo gibed mamor chuth.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

kikuyu: Ka wuon ot nochungʼ kendo lor dhoot ubiro chungo oko ka uduongʼo kendo sayo ni, ‘Ruoth, yawnwa dhoot.’ “To obiro dwokou ni, ‘Ok angʼeyou kata kuma uae akia!’
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

kikuyu: Koro en angʼo ma wanyalo wacho kuom wachni? Ka Nyasaye en jakorwa, to en ngʼa ma diked kodwa mi lowa?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nogoyo ngero ne jopuonjrene mondo onyisgi gibed ka gilamo kinde duto kendo kik chunygi aa.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

kikuyu: Nowacho ni: “Jehova Nyasaye en lwandana, en ohingana kendo en e jaresna;
english: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

kikuyu: E sechego Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Piag pelni mabith mondo ichak terogo jo-Israel nyangu.”
english: At that time, the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, Ere baruwa mar weruok manyiso nine ariembo minu? Koso ngʼato nitie mane achiwene mondo achulgo gope ma an-go? Nousu nikech richou; kendo minu noriembi nikech ketho mage.
english: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.

kikuyu: To ne giwinjore kendgi niya, “Kik watim kamano ka Sawo pod dhi nyime, nono to ji ongʼanyonwa.”
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka lith tiendene nolos gi chuma mokikore gi lowo mowangʼ, e kaka pinyruodhni bende biro bedo matek kuonde moko, to kuonde moko nobed maonge teko.
english: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne gisemo jomoko lingʼ-lingʼ mondo owach niya, “Ne wawinjo Stefano kawacho weche mag ayany kuom Musa gi Nyasaye.”
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, abiro yawo miech Moab manie tungʼ pinje kuma omew mogik, ne wasike, chakre Beth Jeshimoth, gi Baal Meon kod Kiriathaim, ma gin duongʼ mar pinyno.
english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: Shemaya, Joyarib, Jedaya,
english: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

kikuyu: Hezekia nodwoke niya, “En gima yot ahinya mondo tipo odhi nyime tielo apar, maloyo duogo chien tielo apar.”
english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

kikuyu: Kendo gibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka jogi monegi opie e dier nyisechegi mopa kolworo kendegi mag misango, kendo kopongʼo kuonde motingʼore gi ewi gode malo kendo e bwo yiende duto motimo otiep gi yiende mag ober duto, kuonde mane gichiwoe ubani madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne nyisechegi mopa duto.
english: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

kikuyu: Gima usewacho e mudho biro winjore e odiechiengʼ e lela, kendo gima usekwodho e itu ei ot maiye nolandi ewi tat ot.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Yesu gi jopuonjrene nodhi e gwenge mag piny Judea, kendo nokawo kinde mogwarore kodgi kuno, kobatiso ji.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

kikuyu: Nikech ka kuom adier, ok okony malaike, to nyikwa Ibrahim ema okonyo.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho ne jogo duto mane atero e twech koa Jerusalem nyaka Babulon:
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

kikuyu: “Omiyo ka ngʼato nowachnu kindego ni, ‘Echago cha en e thim,’ to kik uwuogi udhi. Kata ni, ‘Eri go en ei ot maiye,’ to kik uyie wachno.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: to ngʼat modhier to ne onge gimoro makmana nyarombo ma sibini achiel mane osengʼiewo. Norite maber mana kaka norito nyithinde owuon. Nyarombono nopogone chiembe mochamo, ne omodho e okombene kendo nonindo e bade. Ne ochalne mana ka nyathine ma nyako.
english: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

kikuyu: Abiro tingʼo okumba mar warruok malo kendo abiro luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: “To koro wan wasumbini e piny mane imiyo kwerewa mondo omi gicham olembe moa kanyo kod gik moko mabeyo monyago.
english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

kikuyu: Ogendini nowangʼ, mi lokre pidhe mag buru, kendo mana kaka kudho mobet e bungu enowangʼ gi mach!”
english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

kikuyu: kendo gilor kode e holo kama pok opur kata pidhoe cham, kochomo aora ma pi molie, kendo kanyo ema mondo giture ngʼute.
english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora ma ngʼato angʼata osechiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye chuth kuom mwandune ma en godo, bedni en dhano kata chiayo kata lop anywola ok onego ngʼiew kata waro nikech gima osechiw ne Jehova Nyasaye ler moloyo.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo e kind jonabi mag Jerusalem aseneno gimoro malich mokadho: Giterore kendo gidak e ngima mar miriambo. Gijiwo joma timbegi mono, mondo omi kik ngʼato olokre owe timbene maricho. Giduto gichalo Sodom ne an; jo-Jerusalem chalo gi Gomora.”
english: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”

kikuyu: Eka Doeg ja-Edom, manoyudo ochungʼ gi jodong Saulo, nowacho niya, “Ne aneno ka wuod Jesse odhi ir Ahimelek wuod Ahitub man Nob.
english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

kikuyu: “Kik uwinj wach Hezekia. Ma e gima ruodh Asuria wacho: Winjreuru koda kendo biuru ira oko. Bangʼe ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nocham mzabibu kod ngʼowu kendo nomodh pi moa e sokone owuon,
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

kikuyu: Wachno nobwogogi mine gipenjo niya, “En angʼo misetimo?” (To negingʼeyo ni oringo oa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nikech ne oyudo osenyisogi kamano).
english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.

kikuyu: To ka ok ukwongʼoru to ok unubed joketho.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jomoko manok notony midongʼ, ma gin yawuowi gi nyiri ma nogol oko kuomgi. Ginibi iri, kendo ka ineno timbegi gi yoregi, to iniyud hoch kuom masira ma asekelo kuom Jerusalem, ma gin masiche duto masekelo kuome.
english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

kikuyu: E ndalono ji nogou ngero; kendo ginichuognu wer malit mar kuyo ni: ‘Osetiekwa chuth, mwanduwa osepog jomoko nono. Eri omayowagi! Opogo puothewa ne joma ndhogowa.’ ”
english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

kikuyu: Ne atelonegi gi ngʼwono mathoth kaachiel gihera ma ok rum; ne agolo jok mapek e ngʼutgi kendo akulora piny mondo apidhgi.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

kikuyu: E kindeno dhoudi manie piny noywag malich ka dhoot ka dhoot ywak kar kendgi. Joka Daudi noywag kar kendgi, ka mondgi bende ywak kar kendgi, joka Nathan noywag kar kendgi kendo mondgi bende noywag kar kendgi.
english: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni osekumogi kamano to ji pok odwogo ire bende pok gimanyo wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Ohola nohore gi timbe mag chode kane pod en mara; kendo ne en gombo mar chode mathoth gi joherane ma jolweny mag Asuria;
english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

kikuyu: Wechegi duto osejiwowa. Kaachiel gi jip mane wayudo koa kuomwa wawegi, moloyo to ne wamor kane waneno mor mane Tito nigo, nikech dhial mane umiye.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

kikuyu: To ere rachne ka Nyasaye noyiere mar nyiso mirimbe, kendo mar nyiso ji tekone, to osetimo kinda kohore mos amingʼa mak otoyo mirimbe kuom joma owinjore okum, ma gin joma noyik ne tho?
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

kikuyu: Liere gi rangʼaw molos gi dhahabu e sirni angʼwen mag siala mobaw gi dhahabu kendo mochungi ewi rachungi angʼwen mag fedha.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

kikuyu: “To wengeu kod chunyu ochikore mana e yor yudo ohala gi mecho, e chwero remo maonge gi wach kuom thiro ji kod lweny.”
english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”

kikuyu: To ka Kristo ni eiu, to kata obedo ni ringruok otho nikech richo, to chunyu ngima nikech tim makare.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

kikuyu: Kik udwar kodgi lweny nimar ok anamiu pinygi kata mana kama uketo e tiendu kende. Asemiyo Esau pinje mag gode man Seir kaka girkeni mare.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

kikuyu: Kendo Modekai nooro barupe ne jo-Yahudi duto man e gwenge mia achiel gi piero ariyo gabiriyo mag pinyruodh Ahasuerus, barupego notingʼo weche mag miyo chunygi mor kod jiwo chunygi,
english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

kikuyu: Werneuru wer manyien; werneuru kugoyone nyiduonge kendo weruru gi ilo.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

kikuyu: Shitrai ja-Sharon nochungʼne kweth mag dhok makwayo Sharon. Shafat wuod Aldai to ne ochungʼ ne kweth dhok manie holo.
english: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

kikuyu: Jasigu lawa matek, oserodha piny nyaka e lowo; ochuna ni nyaka adag kama otimo mudho mana ka joma notho chon gi lala.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho higni machien mag ngima Ayub moloyo kaka nogwedhe mokwongo. Ne en gi rombe alufu apar gangʼwen, ngamia alufu auchiel, rweth pur alufu achiel, kod punde alufu achiel.
english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

kikuyu: Nochungo sirnigo e agola mar hekalu. Siro ma yo milambo nomiyo nying ni Jakin (tiende ni osegurore), to siro ma yo nyandwat nomiyo nying ni Boaz (tiende ni teko nitie kuome).
english: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

kikuyu: Kane Musa odhi ewi got, boche polo noumo godno,
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

kikuyu: Kane Elisha tuo gi tuo mane biro nege, Jehoash ruodh Israel nodhi nene moywage niya, “Wuora! Wuora isebedonwa kaka geche lweny kod joidh farese mag Israel!”
english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

kikuyu: Kum malit orito ngʼat maweyo yo, ngʼat masin kikwere biro tho.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

kikuyu: Koso uparo ni muma wacho kayiem ni chuny Nyasaye moketo mondo odag eiwa nigi nyiego mager.
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

kikuyu: Azel ne nigi yawuowi auchiel kendo magi e nying-gi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Shearia, Obadia kod Hanan. Magi ema ne yawuot Azel.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Omiyo, un jokwath, winjuru gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
english: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”

kikuyu: Ma e kaka nenruok mar tiende garigo ne chalo kod kaka nolosgi. Ne gimil ka kit ombo marieny, kendo kargi angʼwen-go duto ne ginenore machalre. Moro ka moro kuomgi ne nenore ka gima olos machal gi tiend gari mochungʼ ariwa ewi tiend gari machielo.
english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

kikuyu: Ka gik mangimago ne sudo, ne awinjo ka bwombegi kwadhore, ka chalo gi mor mar pi mamol matek, kata gi dwond Jal Maratego, kata gi mahu mar jolweny. Kane gichungʼ gi tiendgi, to bwombegi ne lor piny.
english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

kikuyu: Mi ngʼama nothono nowuok oko, ka bedene gi tiendene onal gi lewni molir olir, kendo ka lela wangʼe bende otwe gi nanga alwora. Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Gonyuru lep liel oko kuome mondo uweye odhi.”
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar auchiel chiwuru rwedhi aboro, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Kendo abiro resi kaachiel gi dala maduongʼni e lwet ruodh Asuria. Abiro rito dala maduongʼni.
english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ngʼat moro mane odak e piny Uz mane nyinge Ayub. Ngʼatni ne en ngʼama longʼo chuth kendo ngʼama kare; ne oluoro Nyasaye kendo nokwedo gik maricho.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

kikuyu: Jatich Ibrahim nolingʼ thi ma ok owuoyo, karange lingʼ-lingʼ mondo one ane ka Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho wuodhe.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

kikuyu: kendo jodolo ne ok nyal tiyo tijegi nikech bor polo, nimar duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo hekalu mar Nyasaye.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.

kikuyu: Ka udonjo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, kik upuonjru timbe mamono mag ogendini man kuno.
english: When you have come into the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

kikuyu: Omiyo Abram nowacho ne Lut niya, “Kik dhawo bed e kindwa kata e kind jokwadhi kod jokwadha nikech wan wede.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

kikuyu: Jehoyakim ne ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni apar gachiel. Min mare ne nyinge Zebida nyar Pedaya; mane aa Ruma.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

kikuyu: To in wuod dhano, kik iluorgi, kendo kata wechegi kik iluor. Kik iluor, kata obedo ni pedo gi kuthe oluori koni gi koni, kendo idak kanyachiel gi thomoni; kik iluor gik ma giwacho kendo kata bwok kik gibwogi, kata obedo ni gin anywola mohero ngʼanyo.
english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iseneno, rach mosetimna, ngʼad bucha kare!
english: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Naftali; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen gabich mia angʼwen (45,400).
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: koro wan to dwatony nade ka wajwangʼo warruok maduongʼ ma kama? Ruoth Yesu owuon ema nokwongo olandonwa Wach warruokni eka bangʼe joma nowinjo wach warruokno nosironwa ni wechego gin adier.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka luor min gi wuon kendo nyaka urit Sabato maga. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Kar dakni ne ni e dho nembe madongo; joma nogeri nogeri ma jaber kendo malongʼo chuth.
english: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

kikuyu: Lweny mane ni e kind dhood Saulo gi dhood Daudi nodhi nyime kuom ndalo mangʼeny. Daudi nomedo bedo giteko ahinya, ka dhood Saulo to nomedo bedo manyap.
english: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi Harun gi yawuote kaachiel gi nyithind Israel duto kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ma e chik ma Jehova Nyasaye ochiwo
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:

kikuyu: Negidoko mamor ka nam nokwe, kendo notelonegi nyaka negichopo e dho wath maber, kama negidwaro chopoe.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

kikuyu: To kuom weche moko mondiki e ndalo loch Joash gi gik moko duto mane otimo donge gin e kitabu mondikie weche mag ndalo mag ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: joka Hashum, ji mia adek gi piero ariyo gaboro (328),
english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: kama noluonge Zebulun kod Naftali. Ji alufu apar noluwo bangʼe, kendo Debora bende nodhi kode.
english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

kikuyu: Dwaruru Jehova Nyasaye, un ji duto mobolore manie piny, kendo un ji duto matimo gik ma chik dwaro. Dwaruru tim makare, kendo beduru gi chuny mobolore, nimar dipo ka uyudo kar konyruok, odiechiengno ma Jehova Nyasaye biro olo mirimbe kuom ji.
english: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.

kikuyu: Kinyne kane jo-Filistia obiro mondo oyak gige joma otho, negiyudo Saulo gi yawuote kotho e Got Gilboa.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Kane wat dhakono owinjo wachno, nowacho niya, “Ka kamano to kare ok anyal ware nikech mano nyalo miyo akel chandruok ne mwanduna awuon. In ema mondo iware in iwuon. An ok anyal timo mano.”
english: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”

kikuyu: To un e nyikwa jonabigo, kendo un e weg singruok ma Nyasaye notimo gi kwereu. Nyasaye nowachone Ibrahim ni, ‘joma ok jo-Yahudi duto mag piny noyud gweth koa kuom kothi.’
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

kikuyu: Eka Farao nomiyo Josef teko kowachone niya, “An e ruoth, kendo onge ngʼama notim gimoro kata nodonji e piny Misri ma ok in ema iyiene.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Ahinadab wuod Ido norito Mahanaim;
english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Filistia gi jo-Arabu modak mokiewo kod jo-Kush obedo mamono kod Jehoram.
english: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

kikuyu: Gik moko ariyogi nochopni, e sa machwok kende e odiechiengʼ achiel: nyithindi notho kendo inibed dhako ma chwore otho. Masichegi duto nochopni, kendo timbe ajuoke gi ris miritorigo ok nokonyi.
english: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “Jaduongʼ, aonge gi ngʼama nyalo konya donjo ei yawo sa ma pi otugore. Kinde ka kinde ma atemo ni adonji to ngʼat machielo donjo kuongona.”
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

kikuyu: kendo nowachone wuowino niya, “Ringi mondo idwar aserni madirogi.” E sa ma wuowino ne ringo, nodiro asere mokadhe.
english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

kikuyu: Kikumo nyathi kod kede to obiro reso chunye aa e tho.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

kikuyu: “Wan joneno kuom gik moko duto mane otimo e piny jo-Yahudi kendo ei Jerusalem. Neginege ka gigure e msalaba,
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Bende ka adok ir Wuora, kuma ok ginyal nenae, to giningʼe ni an ngʼat makare;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego oyombowa mabor kendo en gi teko maduongʼ ok otim marach ne ji, nikech en ja-adiera kendo opongʼ gi tim makare.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

kikuyu: Rang mana nyimi tir, ka ichomo wangʼi moriere tir e nyimi.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

kikuyu: Kendo obiro bedoni kaka ranyisi e lweti kendo kido e lela wangʼi ni Jehova Nyasaye nogolowa e piny Misri gi lwete maratego.”
english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, awachonu ka aramo kuom Ruoth, ni neuru ni ok uwuothi kaka jopiny makia Nyasaye wuotho ka pachgi modinore wuondogi.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼat matimo ma, mangʼado bura makare kendo ngʼatno marito chiengʼ Sabato ka ok odwanye, kendo ok oyie lwete mulo gik mogak.”
english: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

kikuyu: Lemnauru mondo omiya ayale e yo maler kaka owinjore atim.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Obiro kelou e piny mane mar kwereu, mi unukawe. Enomi ubed gi mwandu bende ununyaa mangʼeny maloyo kaka ne kwereu romo.
english: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

kikuyu: Ne ojwangʼo Hemb Romo mane ni Shilo, mane en hema mane oguro owuon e dier ji.
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

kikuyu: Babulon nolwar apoya nono kendo notieke. Deng nikech en! Miye yath ne rem mare; sa moro onyalo chango.
english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

kikuyu: To kapo ni chier onge, to ere tiende batiso ji ewi joma osetho? Ka joma otho ok chier, to ibatiso ji e wigi nangʼo?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

kikuyu: To kulamo to kik usik kunuoyo weche kayiem kaka jopiny, nimar giparo ni ibiro winjgi nikech wechegi mathoth.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe ne achako aneno ondiek mar ariyo, mane chalo gi dubu. Ondiegino nonindo gibathe kotingʼo ngʼede adek e dhoge kendo ne awinjo dwol moro kanyise ni, ‘Aa malo kendo ichiem nyaka iyiengʼ!’
english: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’

kikuyu: Eka Agripa nowacho ni Paulo niya, “Iparo ni e sa machwokni inyalo loka abed ja-Kristo?”
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ Refaya wuod Hur, Jedaya wuod Harumaf nogero kama omanyore gi ode owuon, to Hatush wuod Hashabneya ne tiyo e dire.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

kikuyu: Ne oyie, kendo nochako manyo kinde maber mar keto Yesu e lwetgi ka oganda onge.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

kikuyu: Gokinyi mangʼich, jodolo madongo duto gi jodong oganda noporo wach ni mondo gineg Yesu.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

kikuyu: Nyasaye bende nonyiso Musa kama, “An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.

kikuyu: To negidwoke niya, “Wan koth Ibrahim kendo pok ne wabedo wasumb ngʼato nyaka nene. Ere gima omiyo iwachonwa ni ibiro miyowa wabed thuolo.”
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

kikuyu: Kik utim timbe ma jo-Misri mane udak e diergi timo kendo kik timbe moko mag jo-Kanaan makoro aterou e diergi yudre kuomu. Bende kik uluw timbe ma gitimo.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro riti kidonjo kendo kiwuok, obiro timo kamano sani kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

kikuyu: To ngʼe ni gin jogi owuon kendo ma girkeni mari mane igolo gi tekoni maduongʼ kod bat morie.”
english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

kikuyu: Akish nogeno Daudi kendo nowacho e chunye owuon niya, “Osebedo tik marach ne ogandane ma jo-Israel, omiyo obiro bedo jatichna nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”

kikuyu: Kaachiel gi makatino chiwne Jehova Nyasaye nyirombe abiriyo machwo maonge songa mahikgi en achiel, gi nyarwath matin kod imbe ariyo. Ginibed misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi misango mar cham gi misango miolo piny mondo obed misango miwangʼo pep madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ruodhi duto mane odak yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan nowinjo humb wechego; mane gin ruodhi moa e tiend gode mag pinyno, gi ruodhi moa yo podho chiengʼ mar gode gi mago moa e wedhe mag Nam Mediterania kaachiel gi ruodhi moa Lebanon (mane gin ruodhi mag jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod mago mag jo-Jebus);
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

kikuyu: Kendo norwako ludhego ei ratege mantie e bethe Sandug Muma mondo otingʼego.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo otanglo otwi modongo kendo oumo Jona mondo okel tipo ne wiye, ma dimi obed gi kwe, mi Jona nopongʼ gi mor kuom otanglono.
english: The LORD God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

kikuyu: Luwuru hera, kendo dwaruru mondo ubed gi mich mag chuny, to moloyo beduru johul wach.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

kikuyu: Nodwoka niya, “Daniel, koro dhi adhiya, nikech wechegi odin kendo okan nyaka chop chiengʼ giko.
english: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

kikuyu: Negiwuok e Thim mar Sinai mi gibworo Kibroth Hatava.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

kikuyu: Jehoyakim ne ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kuom higni apar gachiel kodak Jerusalem. Kendo notimo gik maricho e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight.

kikuyu: To eka Nyasaye ema ne opongʼo utegi gi gik mabeyo, omiyo an apogora gi rieko ma joma timbegi richo ngʼado.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni nyoro iwuok nikech siso ma in-go mar dok ir joodu. To angʼo momiyo nyoro ikwalo nyisechena?”
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

kikuyu: Ruoth nochiko Joab gi Abishai kod Itai niya, “Beduru mangʼwon ne wuoda Abisalom nikech an.” Oganda duto mag jolweny nowinjo ka ruoth chiko jotelo ni kik gihiny Abisalom.
english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

kikuyu: Ok nochak oluongi ni Abram; to enoluongi ni Ibrahim, nimar aseketi ibedo wuon ogendini mangʼeny.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: “Kata obedo ni osetieki midongʼ gunda kendo pinyi odongʼ nono, to koro ibiro yudo ni pinyi odoko matin ma ok oromo jogi dakie, kendo jogo mane otieki biro bedo kodi mabor.
english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼatni ma nyinge ne Mika neni gikare mar lemo, kendo noloso law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kod nyisechegi kendo noketo achiel kuom yawuote kaka jadolo.
english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

kikuyu: Jolupo nobed gi lit mi ywagi, to jogo duto matego golowu e aora Nael; kod joma chiko gokgi e pi nosienyre.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

kikuyu: Ka udhi to yaluru wach kama: ‘Pinyruodh polo ni machiegni.’
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

kikuyu: Kaka Feliks nongʼeyo weche mangʼeny kuom Yor Kristo, noloro bura, kowachonegi niya, “Ka Lusio ma jaduongʼ jolweny obiro, eka abiro ngʼado buchuni.”
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

kikuyu: Muche moko mach maliel, kendo legek mach makakni wuok e dhoge.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Yaye Juda nyathina, ichalo nyathi sibuor, modwogo koa dwar. Obuto ka sibuor madhako monindo piny, maonge ngʼama nyalo chiewo.
english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

kikuyu: Kendo nowacho niya, “Wuod Dhano nyaka yud sand mangʼeny, kendo ibiro kwede gi jodong oganda gi jodolo madongo kod jopuonj chik, bende nyaka nonege kendo chiengʼ mar adek nochiere obed mangima.”
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

kikuyu: Kaponi ngʼat mane osingoreno odhier ma ok nyal chulo nengo ma oketneno, to nokaw ngʼatni mondo otere e nyim jadolo, kendo jadolo noyiene mondo ochul mana gima nokwongʼore ni onyalo.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

kikuyu: Kik igen kuom ngʼama odak e bathi kata osiepni kik iyiego. Wuo kitangʼ kata gi chiegi ma ugenorugo.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Nyasach nyiseche: Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Joab kod jo-Israel duto nobedo kuno kuom dweche auchiel, nyaka negitieko chwo duto Edom.
english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

kikuyu: “Bende chunyi nyalo doko malit ka ngʼato okeloni wach moro nimar ok anyal lingʼ mak awuoyo?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

kikuyu: To Judas nodhi ir jodolo madongo kod jotend jorit hekalu kendo noloso kodgi kaka onyalo ndhogo Yesu.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: “Chik jo-Israel mondo gikelni mo maliw mar zeituni mobi mondo omi teyni osik kaliel pile.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Nonro manie anywolagi, notingʼo nying jotend dhoutgi kod jolweny alufu piero ariyo gi mia ariyo (20,200).
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Ne giike kendo Israel duto noywage mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho kaluwore gi dho jatichne janabi Ahija.
english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nowacho ne Farao niya, “Leknigo tiendgi achiel kendo gichalre. Nyasaye osenyiso gima oikore timo.
english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane ni Jerusalem nowinjo wachno, mine giluongo puodhono gi dhogi ni Akeldama, ma tiende ni, Puoth Remo.
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

kikuyu: Noweyogi modhiyo mochwalore mabor madirom diro kidi, mine ogoyo chonge piny kendo nolamo niya,
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

kikuyu: Abiro wachone Nyasaye niya: Kik ikuma, to nyisa rachna momiyo ikwana kaka jaketho.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

kikuyu: Dwaro mar joma kare gik mana e ber kende, to geno mar joricho gik mana e mirima.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

kikuyu: Adhonde moa kuom osiep inyalo geno, to jasigu medo mana nyoth mar masira.
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mamoko to ne omi tije mamoko duto e hema, e od Nyasaye.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

kikuyu: Eliud ne en wuon Eleazar, Eleazar ne en wuon Mathan, Mathan ne en wuon Jakobo,
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowacho ni Nyasaye niya, “Asetimo richo maduongʼ kuom gima asetimoni. To koro akwayi mondo igol richoni kuom jatichni. Asetimo gima ofuwo ahinya.”
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

kikuyu: Nyithinde ok nyal yudo konyruok kendo onge ngʼama chwakgi e od bura.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

kikuyu: Dhakono nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, nenorena ni in janabi.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

kikuyu: To Modekai nofwenyo wachgino monyiso Esta ma mikach ruoth, mane otero wach ne ruoth konyiso ni Modekai ema owachone.
english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane jo-Aram oneno ni jo-Israel oseloyogi, negioro joote moomo jo-Aram mane ni loka Aora kotelnegi gi Shofak mane jatend jolwenj Hadadezer.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

kikuyu: Adier, notingʼo sandruok-wa kendo chandruokwa ema ne ture, kata kamano wan to ne waparo ni kum mane oyudo, sandruok kod chandruok noa kuom Nyasaye.
