english: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

kikuyu: To kata mana yie wiu achiel onge manolal.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

kikuyu: Nimar achikou kawuono mondo uher Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kuwuotho e yorene kendo urito buchene kod chikene, eka unudag mi umedru mangʼeny kendo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nogwedhu e piny ma udonjoe mondo ukaw kaka girkeni.
english: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Jogi nyaka kwer mondo olingʼ, nikech giketho mier mangʼeny ka gipuonjo gik ma ok owinjore gipuonji; kendo gitimo kamano mana mondo giyudie ohala ma ok nikare.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre Johana nobiro ire mopenje niya, “Ere kaka wan kod jo-Farisai watweyo chiemo to jopuonjreni to ok twe chiemo?”
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: mane wan-go gi lalruok matut chon kane wawuotho e dier oganda maduongʼ e od Nyasaye.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni nondiki ni Ibrahim ne nigi yawuowi ariyo, ma achiel kuomgi nonywol gi dhako ma misumba, to machielo to nonywol gi dhako ma thuolo.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

kikuyu: kinde mar nywol kod kinde mar tho, kinde mar pitho kod kinde mar putho,
english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

kikuyu: To Musa nokwayo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasache kowachone niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, en angʼo momiyo mirimbi mager ditiek jogi mane igolo gi teko maduongʼ kod lweti maratego kawuok e piny Misri?
english: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

kikuyu: nimar ji mia ariyo nool ahinya mane ok ginyal ngʼado holono. To Daudi gi ji mia angʼwen nodhi nyime gi lepo.
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

kikuyu: Malaika moro machielo nobiro mochungo but kendo mar misango, kotingʼo tap ubani mar dhahabu. Nomiye ubani mangʼeny, kaluwore gi lemo mar jomaler duto, mondo ochiw ewi kendo mar misango molos gi dhahabu manie nyim kom duongʼ.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Emomiyo, joge matindo nogore piny e yore; jolweny mage duto nonegi odiechiengno.”
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne kit ngima joma onge ketho, non chal joma ngimagi oriere tir, ngʼama ohero kwe nigi geno mar dak amingʼa.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

kikuyu: Mano kaka jogi mor manade! En mor manade ne jotendi mosiko kachungʼ e nyimi kendo winjo riekoni!
english: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ka koro Nyasaye osekechowa momiyowa tijni mondo watim, chunywa ok nyosre.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

kikuyu: Gin gisegolo mana matin nono kuom mwandu ma gin-go, to dhakono kata obedo ni odhier, to osechiwo duto ma en-go, duto mane onego okonyrego.”
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Ibiro negogi gi ligangla kendo notergi kaka joma otwe e pinje duto. Jerusalem ibiro nyono piny gi joma ok jo-Yahudi nyaka chop kinde ma loch mar joma ok jo-Yahudi rume.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

kikuyu: Pache mondo olokre mi pogre gi pach dhano, to mondo omiye paro mar kit le moro, kuom higni abiriyo.
english: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him. Then let seven times pass over him.

kikuyu: “Gotieno wuod dhakoni notho nikech nonindo kuome.
english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ichiwogi e lwet wasikgi, mane omiyogi tingʼ mapek. To kane tingʼ mapek oromogi ne giywakni. Ne iwinjogi koa e polo, kendo gi ngʼwononi mogundho ne imiyogi jokony, mane oresogi giaye lwet wasikgi.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona niya: “En angʼo mineno, Jeremia?” Anto ne adwoke ni, “Aneno bad yath mar oyungu.”
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo akwayou ni kik chunyu nyosre nikech sand ma ayudo nikech un, ngʼeuru ni sandruokna ema miyou duongʼ.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

kikuyu: To owadwa modhier onego obed mamor ka Nyasaye otingʼe malo.
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma odak e odi; mosiko ka paki. Sela
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

kikuyu: Wan jodak kendo joma welo e nyim wangʼi, mana kaka kwerewa nobet. Ndalowa e piny ka chalo gi tipo, kendo waonge geno.
english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, donge dhood jo-Israel ma jongʼanyogo nopenji niya, En angʼo mitimoni?
english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

kikuyu: Dhakono nopenje niya, “Ruodha, bende dine akwayie nyathi ma wuowi? Donge ne akweri ni kik imiya abed gi geno?”
english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

kikuyu: Los ratege ariyo mag dhahabu kendo ichomgi e riak tonde ariyo mag gok yo ka nyime mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod machiegni gi kama oriwego but nungone.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi nyaka Nazareth kodgi kendo nomiyogi luor kowinjogi. To min mare nokano wechegi duto e chunye.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

kikuyu: Jarito nowacho niya, “Nenorena ni ngʼat mokwongo ringo ka Ahimaz wuod Zadok.” Ruoth nowacho niya, “En ngʼat maber. Obiro gi wach maber.”
english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”

kikuyu: Daudi noa malo e lowo. Kane oseluokore, nowirore gi mo moloko lewni mane orwako, nodhi e od Jehova Nyasaye mi olemo. Bangʼe nodhi e ode owuon, mine okwayo chiemo momiye mochamo.
english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

kikuyu: Chutho, ok dwaher mar ketore, kata pimore gi jogo matingʼore malo, kaka joma lich mokalo. Joma kamago ofuwo, kuom pimore gi rapim magin giwegi ema giketo, kendo kuom ngʼado buchgi kendgi, kaka joma lich.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noluongo ler ni “odiechiengʼ” kendo mudho noluongo ni “otieno.” Piny noyuso, kendo noru ma en chiengʼ mokwongo.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

kikuyu: Dalani ok winj puonj ngʼato angʼata, kendo ok owinj kata puonj mora amora. Ok ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye, bende ok osud machiegni gi Nyasache.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.

kikuyu: kendo nokawo ji duto mane ni e dalano, moketogi e tij ngʼeto gi musimeno kod tiyo gi chumbe gi ledhi; bende ne oketogi jolos matafare. Notimo ma ni mier duto mag jo-Amon. Eka Daudi gi jolwenje duto nodok Jerusalem.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Abiro pako nying Nyasaye gi wer kendo abiro miyo nyinge duongʼ gi erokamano.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moyie kendo obatisi nokwo, to ngʼat ma ok oyie bura nolo.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nochiwo chik ni jodolo niya, “Wuoguru oko mar aora Jordan.”
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

kikuyu: To negisiko mana ka giyanye ayanya.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

kikuyu: Abiro ndiko e kitego weche mane ni e kite mopa mokwongo mane itoyo, eka iketgi e sandugno.”
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Gad ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen gabich gi mia auchiel gi piero abich (45,650).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

kikuyu: E higa mokwongo mar loch Belshazar ruoth Babulon, Daniel noleko kendo noneno fweny mopogore opogore kane oyudo oyweyo e kitandane. Nondiko lekneno e kitabu.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

kikuyu: Owetena, kawuru jonabi mane owuoyo e nying Ruoth kaka ranyisi mar bedo gi horuok e kinde chandruok.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

kikuyu: “To wuon mare nowacho ne jotichne ni, ‘Timuru piyo kendo keluru law maberie moloyo mondo urwakne. Ketneuru tere e lith lwete kendo wuoche mondo urwakne e tiende.
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chike Daudi wuon mare, Solomon nochano migepe mag jodolo kuom tijegi kendo jo-Lawi notelo ni tich wer kod konyo jodolo kaluwore gi tije mopogore opogore mapile ka pile. Kendo nopogo jorit rangeye gi migepegi kuom rangeye mopogore opogore nikech ma e chik ma Daudi ngʼat Nyasaye nochiko.
english: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Amazia ruodh Juda nopenjo jongʼadne rieko mi nooro joote ir Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz ma wuod Jehu ruoth Israel kowacho niya, “Bi warom wangʼ gi wangʼ.”
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

kikuyu: Ruoth ne chunye ochandore ka nowinjo kwayono, to nikech noyudo osesingore e yor kwongʼruok, kendo nikech wende mane ni e nyasineno, nogolo chik mondo dwach nyakono otim,
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

kikuyu: Emomiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo ohul richone kendo olam ni nyawadgi, mondo eka uyud chang. Lamo mar ngʼat makare nigi teko kendo timo tich.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

kikuyu: “ ‘Koro mano e chik momi ja-Nazir ka kinde mokete tenge orumo kendo nyaka kele e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: Nopenje niya, “In ngʼa?” Nodwoke niya, “An Ruth jatichni. Yie iyar bath nangani konchiel iumago, nikech in watna mahie machiegni koda.”
english: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”

kikuyu: To ka ikendo, to ok itimo richo; kata ka nyako okendi bende ok otimo richo. To joma okendo gi mokendi biro neno chandruok mathoth e ngimani, to adwaro ni akonyu mondo kik une chandruokni.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iritwa maber kik gimoro ohinywa kendo reswa e lwet joma kamago nyaka chiengʼ.
english: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, negidhi e dala machielo.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jasunga nyalo dwaro rieko to ok oyud gimoro, ngʼeyo tiend wach to biro mayot ne ngʼat ma ongʼeyo pogo tiend weche.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

kikuyu: E higa mar angʼwen to olembege duto nobed maler, ma en chiwo mar pak ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne okonygi kuom kedo kendo Nyasaye nomiyogi e lwetgi jo-Hagri, to gi jogo duto mane oriwore kodgi nikech ne giywagorene e ndalo lweny. To ne odwoko lamogi nikech negiketo yie margi kuome.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

kikuyu: Asenyisou wachni mondo morna obed eiu kendo mondo mor maru obed moromo chuth.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi e od jachwe agulni, kendo ne ayude kar chwecho.
english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel ok nochak obar mi weya kendo ok ginidwanyre gi richogi duto kendo. Ginibed joga to an anabed Nyasachgi, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto Osewacho.’ ”
english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nowuok mondo orom ni jaduongʼne mi nokulore piny kendo onyodhe. Ne gimosore eka bangʼe gidonjo ei hema.
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

kikuyu: “Kik usand japiny moro modak e dieru; un uwegi ungʼeyo kaka bedo jadak chalo, nikech ne un jodak e piny Misri.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ndalo duto jachien make kendo ogoyo koko, bende ogoye piny moriere kogwecho, kendo dhoge wuok buoyo. Jachien-no sande kinde duto, kendo ohinye.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

kikuyu: Chwo ma nying-gi ondikgo nobiro e ndalo Hezekia ruodh Juda. Negimonjo jo-Ham kuma negidakie kod jo-Meun mane nitie kanyo ma gitiekogi duto mana kaka nyisore ratiro nyaka sani. Negidak ka nikech ne nitiere kar kwath ne jambgi.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, in ngʼatno manono joma ratiro, kendo manyo matut mar chuny kod paro, mad iol gero mari kuomgi, nimar ne in asetieko kora.
english: But the LORD of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.

kikuyu: Kik udwar winjruok e kindu kodgi e ndalo duto mag ngimau.
english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

kikuyu: kod ruodhi mae piny gode ma yo nyandwat e Araba ma milambo mar Kinereth, e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ kod e Nafoth Dor mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
english: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi Balak nokawo Balaam motero Bamoth Baal, kendo kanyo noneno bath oganda.
english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

kikuyu: kutiyo gi thuolo muyudo e yo maber, nikech ndalogi richo.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

kikuyu: Sa ma itimo richo ni joweteni e yo makamano, kihinyo chunygi mayom yom, ngʼeni itimo richo ni Kristo.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Kendo koth nochwe e piny ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Tije Jehova Nyasaye dongo adier; joma mor kodgi osiko kaparo kuomgi.
english: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nomiyogi chik ka oorogi ir Eliazar jadolo, kod Joshua wuod Nun kaachiel gi jotend dhout Israel.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Jona notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho modhiyo Nineve. To Nineve ne en dala maduongʼ kendo mogen ma limbene ne dwaro wuoth ndalo adek eka itiek iye duto.
english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to the LORD’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

kikuyu: Joab nowacho niya, “Anto ok abi rito kamano.” Ka Abisalom ne pod oliero e bad yiend ober kangima, nokawo tonge adek e lwete mochwoyo dho chuny Abisalom.
english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

kikuyu: Musa nogero kendo mar misango mochake ni “Jehova Nyasaye en banderana.”
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.

kikuyu: Chuny maparore miyo ngʼato bedo mool, to wach mamuol jiwe.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

kikuyu: kendo oride motegno gi pino. Noluonge kendo niya, “Samson, jo-Filistia osebiro monji.” Nochiewo oa e nindo mi opudho pino oko kod usi mar chwecho.
english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi chi wuonu, nikech kitimo kamano to ikelone wuonu wichkuot.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Negiloso gik mongʼinore kaka olemo molos gi usi marambulu gi maralik, law momin mayom e riak lawno.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

kikuyu: E dwe mokwongo mar hik lochne mokwongo noyawo dhout hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye moloso.
english: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the LORD’s house and repaired them.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne jodongo niya, “Ritwauru ka nyaka chop waduog iru. Harun kod Hur ni kodu kendo ngʼato angʼata man-gi wach madwaro loso mondo odhi irgi.”
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

kikuyu: Ahazia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gariyo kane obedo ruoth, kendo norito piny kuom achiel kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Athalia, ma nyakwar Omri ruodh Israel.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

kikuyu: Ruodhigi kaachiel gi jodong-gi ibiro daro miter e twech,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne nyikwa Shuthela: kokadho kuom Eran, ne gin joka Eran.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

kikuyu: An bende koro abiro wacho makora; kendo abiro nyisi gima angʼeyo.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

kikuyu: “Bende inyalo choko sulwe mag yugni mitue? Bende inyalo keyo yugni mochokore kanyachiel?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

kikuyu: Ne abedo ngʼama lich miwuoro moloyo ngʼato angʼata mane okuongona bedo jatelo e Jerusalem. E magi duto riekona matut nosiko koda.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

kikuyu: Omiyo gedo mar ohinga norumo e odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo gabich mar Elul, kendo gedono nokawo ndalo piero abich gariyo.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

kikuyu: Kuom rieko Jehova Nyasaye nochweyo mise mar piny kendo noketo polo kama entie kuom lony mare;
english: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

kikuyu: Kane jatelono owinjo mano, nodhi ir jatend jolweny maduongʼ monyise wachno. Nowachone niya, “Idwaro timo nangʼo? Ngʼatni en ja-Rumi?”
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

kikuyu: “Bende pinyruodh polo chalo gi ja-ohala mamanyo kite ma nengogi tek mondo owar.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

kikuyu: Luor chik ruoth, awacho kamano, nikech ni kwongʼori e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni jood Stefano e joma nokwongo yie kuom Kristo e piny Akaya, kendo gisechiwore mar tiyo ni jo-Nyasaye. Ajiwou, jowetena,
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

kikuyu: Nyamin mare miluongo ni Hamoleketh nonywolo Ishhod, Abiezer kod Mala.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye, kendo moro onge; onge Nyasaye moro makmana an. Anamiyi teko, kata obedo ni pok iyanga kamano,
english: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

kikuyu: Lea ne nigi wangʼ ma ok nenre maber, to Rael ne nigi chia kendo jaber.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

kikuyu: To ka wuon-gi onge gi owetene, to ipog watne moro amora machiegni kode e anywolagi, mondo oyud girkenino. Mae nobed chik ne jo-Israel, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.’ ”
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”

kikuyu: To ka iloso nyasi, iluong joma odhier, rangʼonde gi pudhe kod muofni,
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye ooronigi teko maduongʼ marundo pachgi mondo omi giyie gi weche mag miriambo,
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenja niya, “Amos, ineno angʼo?” Ne adwoke niya, “Aneno atonga mopongʼ gi olemo mochiek.” Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Mano e kaka joga Israel oseikore ni kum kendo ok anawegi ma ok akumogi.”
english: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Johana koro tieko tije, nowacho ni, ‘Uparo ni an ngʼa? Ok an Jal mane ugeno ni biro biro; to winjuru Jal moro biro bangʼa, kendo ok awinjora gonyo tond wuochene.’
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

kikuyu: Noha mar angʼwen kod Rafa mar abich.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

kikuyu: Pilato nopenje niya, “Adiera en angʼo?” Bangʼ penjo kamano to nochako odok oko ir jo-Yahudi, mi owachonegi niya, “Ok ayudo ketho kata achiel kuom ngʼatni minyalo ngʼadnego bura.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

kikuyu: Hezekia nopogo jodolo kod jo-Lawi migepe mondo gichiw misengini miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok kod tije lemo gi dwoko erokamano kod wero wende pak e dhorangeye mag kambi Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the LORD’s camp.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼat manochak obedi e iye kata dak kuno e tienge duto mabiro; onge ja-Arabu moro manodag kuno; bende onge jakwath mano kwa jambe kanyo.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

kikuyu: Kristo owuon e kwe marwa, nikech oseriwo jo-Yahudi gi joma ok jo-Yahudi obedo gimoro achiel kochiwo ringre owuon kendo osemuko ohinga mar sigu mane opogowa,
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

kikuyu: Kane gisewero wend pak, ne giwuok gidhi nyaka e Got Zeituni.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: ‘Kelna ring le kendo ilosna mamit mondo acham mondo agwedhi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kapok atho.’
english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’

kikuyu: An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kuom mano pwodhreuru kendo ubed jomaler, nikech an aler. Kik uchidru gi gimoro amora mamol kata malak e lowo.
english: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

kikuyu: Anachiwi ne jogo madwaro ngimani kendo miluoro. Abiro chiwou ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon kod jo-Babulon.
english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: E ndalogo ne ok yot mondo ngʼato owuothi ma ok onwangʼo chandruok e yo, ma ne timore nikech jopiny duto nopongʼ gi chandruok.
english: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko ka Jehova Nyasaye nosemiyo jo-Israel kwe e kindgi gi wasikgi duto, noyudo ka koro Joshua oseti kendo ne en gi higni moniangʼ,
english: After many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

kikuyu: To jonabi mane nyikwa Harun mane odak e puothe mipuro molworo miechgi kata mane odak e mier mamoko ne oyier joma ne pogo gik moko ne ngʼato angʼata mane nitie e diergi ma dichwo kaachiel gi jogo duto mane ondik nying-gi koa e dhood Lawi.
english: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

kikuyu: En ema noyiero owuon mondo onywolwa kokonyore gi wach mar adiera, mondo wabed kaka olemo mokwongo chiek e kind chwechne duto.
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

kikuyu: Ne ok atuono wangʼa gimoro amora mane onyalo gombo, kendo chunya bende ne ok atuono mor. Chunya nobedo gi mor kuom tijena duto mane atimo, kendo mano ema nobedo pok mar tijena duto.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

kikuyu: Emomiyo kor wach kendo iwachnegi ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Yaye un joga, abiro elo lieteu mi agolu oko kendo aduogu e piny Israel.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

kikuyu: To Musa nowacho niya, “Nyaka imiwa thuolo mar timo misengini gi misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.
english: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Mano kaka waparo rech mane wachamo Misri maonge chudo moro amora, bende waparo olembe mopogore opogore, kitungu kod kitungu marachar.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

kikuyu: Chikni ne rach ahinya e nyim wangʼ Nyasaye omiyo nokumo jo-Israel.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nodwoke niya, “Ne awacho e chunya ni, ‘Adier luor mar Nyasaye onge ka, kendo gibiro nega nikech chiega.’
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

kikuyu: “ ‘Pinyu ma yo milambo nochakre e Thim Zin manie tongʼ piny Edom. Tongʼu ma yo milambo mogik yo wuok chiengʼ nochakre e giko mar Nam Chumbi
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

kikuyu: Nimar jo-Makedonia gi jo-Akaya osechiwo kony gimor ne jomaler modhier man Jerusalem.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “En jahawi ngʼat ma Nyasaye kwero, omiyo kik icha kum mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nebukadneza, Nolando ni ji duto gi ogendini kod ji moa e dhoudi mopogore opogore modak e piny ngima niya: Mad udag e ngima maber kod kwe.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.

kikuyu: Nyisaneuru un joma dwaro bedo e bwo chik, donge ungʼeyo gima chik wacho?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

kikuyu: To wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kawacho ni, ‘Isechwero remo mangʼeny kendo isekedo lwenje mangʼeny. Ok iniger ot maluongo Nyinga nikech isechwero remo mangʼeny e nyima.
english: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

kikuyu: Jogo machweyo lewni mag tworo nobed mool kendo joma chweyo gik mabeyo chunygi nonyosre.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi ir Ruoth Nyasaye ka alamo, ka aywakne kendo ka ariyo kech, kendo ne arwako law kuyo ka abukora gi buru.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: kendo jo-Yahudi mangʼeny noyudo osebiro ir Maritha gi Maria mondo ohogi e kuyo margi kuom tho mar owadgi.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

kikuyu: Abisalom nopenjo Hushai niya, “Ma e kaka inyiso hera ne osiepni? Marangʼo ne ok idhi gosiepni?”
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

kikuyu: Owinjore gipak nyingi maduongʼ kendo miwuoro, nyinge ler.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

kikuyu: nikech nyi dhood Manase noyudo girkeni e kind owetegi. Piny jo-Gilead nobedo mar nyikwa Manase mamoko.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo timbeni ni ok ingʼich bende ok iliet. Dine ber kibedo maliet kata mangʼich!
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro kedonu; owinjore ubed gi kwe.”
english: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

kikuyu: Ka Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny duto mane ni kode nowinjo timbe njore duto mane Ishmael wuod Nethania nosetimo,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

kikuyu: Ngʼatno marito dhoge kod lewe ritore kuom masiche.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

kikuyu: Moko kuom joma nonegi ne gin Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur kod Reba mane gin ruodhi abich mag Midian. Bende neginego Balaam wuod Beor gi ligangla.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ikuyo, yaye chunya? Angʼo momiyo inyosori yaye chunya? Ket genoni kuom Nyasaye, nikech pod abiro pake, kaka Jawarna kendo Nyasacha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

kikuyu: Emomiyo wuone biro chamo nyithindgi e dieru, kendo nyithindo biro chamo wuonegi. Abiro miyou kum kendo abiro kiro jou motony ne yembe.
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jadai ne gin: Ragem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Efa kod Shaf.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

kikuyu: Kik ukulru e nyim nyisechegi kata lamogi kata luwo timbegi. Nyaka une ni umukogi kendo utoyo kite ma gilamo matindo tindo.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

kikuyu: joma lwetegi otingʼo chenro maricho ma lwetegi ma korachwich asoya opongʼo.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

kikuyu: koa kuom jo-Juda: Elihu owadgi Daudi notelonegi; koa kuom jo-Isakar: Omri wuod Mikael notelonegi;
english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

kikuyu: Odiwuor tir, gimoro nobwogo Boaz. To ka nolokore noyudo ka dhako moro onindo bute gi yo katiende.
english: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.

kikuyu: Nyaka wangʼiew pi mawamodho; yiendwa ma wachwako nyaka wachul nengo eka wayudgi.
english: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mokwongo bangʼ Sabato, jadolo biro fwayo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye cham mukwongo kayo kaka mich moyiedhi, eka Jehova Nyasaye noyie kodu.
english: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Adier odiechiengʼ biro manoliel ka mach mar kendo maliet. Joma timbegi mono kod joma timbegi richo nomokgo mach. Odiechiengno nobolgi e mach mi gundgi norum chuth.
english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says the LORD of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

kikuyu: Mana kaka dhoot marundore e pata, e kaka jasamuoyo lokore aloka e kitandane.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

kikuyu: Ibiro kecho kodwa nyaka chiengʼ koso? Koso ibiro choro mirimbi e tienge duto?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

kikuyu: Jo-Juda bende nomonjo Jerusalem kendo ne gikawe. Negimonjo dala maduongʼno gi ligangla kendo gimoko mach kuome.
english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

kikuyu: Bende negikawo agulni, opawo, gir ngʼado otambi mar taya, bakunde kod gik moko duto molos gi mula mane itiyogo e hekalu.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

kikuyu: Samuel nodwoko niya, “Ee, abiro e yor kwe. Asebiro mondo atim misango ni Jehova Nyasaye. Pwodhreuru mondo ubi e misango koda.” Eka nopwodho Jesse gi yawuote mi noluongogi e timo misangono.
english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nosemiyo jatelo maduongʼ obedo mangʼwon gi Daniel,
english: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano negiloso mag-gi giwegi kod misango mag jodolo nikech jodolo mane gin Nyikwa Harun ne timo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misango mag boche nyaka otieno, omiyo jo-Lawi noloso mag-gi giwegi kod mag jodolo ma nyikwa Harun.
english: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

kikuyu: Ne iketonegi tongʼ ma ok ginyal kadho; mondo kik gichak giim piny kendo.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

kikuyu: Ne achiwora mondo atiegra kendo anon matut kod rieko gigo duto mitimo e bwo polo. Mano doko tingʼ mapek ma Nyasaye oyieyo kuom ji!
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Ruoth Sairas nochiwo gigo mane mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane Nebukadneza oyudo osegolo Jerusalem mi otero e hekalu mar nyasache.
english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

kikuyu: Mano oganda maduongʼ manade, mano kaka gingʼeny ka ginie holo ma en kar ngʼado bura! Nikech odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye chiegni chopo e holo mar ngʼado paro.
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

kikuyu: Owachone en owuon niya, “Nyasaye wiye osewil; opando wangʼe kendo onge gima oneno.”
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

kikuyu: “To in, kiwuotho e nyima gi chuny makare kod bidhruok, kaka Daudi wuonu notimo, kendo timo mago duto machiki kendo kimako puonjna kod buchena,
english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

kikuyu: Gichiwo pi ne le mag bungu duto; kanyna mag bungu tieko riyo ma gin-go.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

kikuyu: “Kuonde modongʼ mapok okaw e magi: “gwenge duto mag jo-Filistia gi jo-Geshur,
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

kikuyu: Kuom tienge mabiro ngʼato angʼata madichwo monywol e uteu kata ongʼiew gi pesa ma ok kothu nyaka ter nyangu, e odiechiengʼ mar aboro bangʼ nywolne.
english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nodwoke niya, “Ere kuma ngʼato diyudie makati manyalo pidho jogi mayiengʼ e dier thim machal kama?”
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

kikuyu: To awachonu ni nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo hekalu.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

kikuyu: Kane Eber ja-higni piero adek gangʼwen, nonywolo Peleg.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Israel osomo baruwano, ne oyiecho lepe kowacho niya, “An e Nyasaye koso, ma anyalo nego ngʼato kata miye ngima? Ere kaka ngʼatni oro ngʼato ira mondo achang dhohone. Neye kaka odwaro chako koda lweny!”
english: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

kikuyu: Wuon-gi gi min-gi nodwoke niya, “Donge nitiere nyako modimbore kuom wedeni kata kuom jowa duto? Ochuno ni nyaka idhi ir jo-Filistia ma ok oter nyangu mondo iyude dhako?” To Samson nowachone wuon-gi niya, “Miya gouru. En ema owinjore koda.”
english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”

kikuyu: Onyisowa weche mak winjre ka mag jomomer ni: Tim ma, tim macha kendo tim ma, tim macha.”
english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

kikuyu: Bende en adier ni ufuwo kamano? Bangʼ chako gi Roho, ere kaka koro unyagoru mar chopo ngima mar Kristo e yor ringruok?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

kikuyu: To jogo nonyiere anyiera. Kane osegologi oko duto, nokawo wuon nyathi gi min-gi kaachiel gi jopuonjre mane ni kode, mi odonjo kodgi nyaka iye kuma nyathi ne nitie.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

kikuyu: Eka nongʼwel odhi e dhorangach, to kuno bende nyako machielo nonene mi owachone joma ne ni kanyo niya, “Ngʼatni ne nitiere gi Yesu ja-Nazareth.”
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe to nyaka giume gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe kaachiel gi gige duto kendo gikete e sirni mitingʼego.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokowo jaduongʼne e yo kendo Jethro nodok e pinygi.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

kikuyu: “E ndalono ji ok nochak owach kendo niya, “ ‘Wuone osechamo olembe ma wach-wach, to leke nyithindo ema tho.’
english: “In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye gie piny, un gik madongo mag nam kod kude matut duto mag ataro,
english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ji ok nyal olo divai manyien e piende moti mag tingʼo divai. Ka gitimo kamano to piendego biro barore, mi divai pukre oko, kendo piende mag tingʼo divai biro kethore. Ooyo, giolo divai manyien e piende mag tingʼo divai manyien, eka iritogi maber giduto kargi ariyo.”
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

kikuyu: To ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “Kata dine unyalo pimo shekel alufu achiel moket e lweta, anto ok datingʼ lweta mondo aket kuom wuod ruoth. Ne wawinjo gi itwa ka ruoth chiko in gi Abishai kod Itai ni, ‘Rituru wuoda Abisalom nikech an.’
english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

kikuyu: Kwanuru jumbe abiriyo ugol koa chiengʼ mane uchako kayoe cham mochungʼ.
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

kikuyu: akwayi kuom wach wuoda Onesimo mane odoko wuoda ka an e twech.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

kikuyu: To nyisechegi mopa gin fedha gi dhahabu, molos gi lwet dhano.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Gie kindeno, ji duto ne goyo nduru kendo Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Weuru ywak nimar ok otho to onindo aninda.”
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

kikuyu: Paulo nomedo penjogi niya, “Ka kamano, to kare batiso mane mane uyudo?” Negidwoke niya, “Ne wayudo batiso mar Johana.”
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

kikuyu: Bende negiloso gara kaka okode mag dhahabu maler mi gilierogi e riak aroyano ka gikikore gi gik mongʼinore kolemo.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

kikuyu: Nopenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Ere yie ma un-go?” Luoro nomakogi kendo negiwuoro mine gipenjore giwegi niya, “Ma en ngʼa? Ochiko nyaka yembe kod pi, mi giwinje.”
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

kikuyu: Nyasacha nokwedgi nikech ok gisewinje, ginibedi joma tangni e dier ogendini.
english: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

kikuyu: Nolamo Jehova Nyasaye kowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, donge ma e gima ne awacho kane pod an thurwa, ma bende ema nomiyo aringo piyo kachomo Tarshish, ne angʼeyo ni in Nyasaye ma jangʼwono kendo ma jakech, ihori mos kendo herani ogundho, Nyasaye maweyo kelo kum.
english: He prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please, LORD, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

kikuyu: Bende sibuor nyalo ruto e thim ka oonge gi gima ochamo? Bende nyathi sibuor nyalo ngʼur e gono mare kapok oyudo gima ochamo?
english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

kikuyu: “ ‘Daudi jatichna nobed ruodhgi kendo giduto ginibed gi jakwath achiel. Gibiro luwo chikena kendo gibiro rito buchena ka gitangʼ.
english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

kikuyu: Abiro manyo rombega molal mi aduog mago molal. Abiro mako mago motur kendo mago mool abiro medo teko, to mago machwe kendo ma tekogi ngʼeny abiro tieko. Abiro kwayo rombega gi adiera.
english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

kikuyu: Koro Rekab gi Baana, yawuot Rimon ja-Beeroth, ne owuok mondo odhi e od Ish-Boseth, negichopo odiechiengʼ tir sa ma piny liet, noyudo ka oyweyo.
english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

kikuyu: Kane arango gik mangimago maber, naneno tiend gari moro piny e lowo e bath moro ka moro kuomgi man-gi lela wenge angʼwen.
english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

kikuyu: Yawuot Hebron mane oyier ne gin: Jeria mokwongo, mar ariyo Amaria, mar adek Jahaziel kod mar angʼwen Jekameam.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Kanyo nodonjo ei rogo monindo kanyo. Kendo wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone mawachone niya, “En angʼo mitimo ka, Elija?”
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ temni, Ayub nodak higni mia achiel gi piero angʼwen; noneno nyithinde gi nyikwaye nyaka tiengʼ mar angʼwen.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

kikuyu: Gi pesani nyaka ine ni ingʼiewo rwedhi, imbe kod nyithi rombe machwo, kanyakla gi chiwo mag-gi mag cham kod misango miolo piny, kendo gitimgo misango ewi kendo mar hekalu mar Nyasachi e Jerusalem.
english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ere nyiseche mag Hamath gi Arpad? Ere nyiseche mag Sefarvaim, Hena kod Iva? Bende ne gireso Samaria e lweta?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

kikuyu: Kane osepando jomoko ei ot kanyo, noluonge kowacho niya, “Samson, jo-Filistia osebiro monji!” To ne ochodo tondego e yo mayot mana kaka tol chot kokete machiegni gi mach. Omiyo kuma tekone ae ne ok ofweny.
english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.

kikuyu: Eka Abishai wuod Zeruya nowacho niya, “Donge Shimei onego neg nikech ma? Nokwongʼo ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir.”
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”

kikuyu: Giniwach niya, “Mana kaka ngʼato puro kendo toyo lowo, e kaka chokewa osekere e dho bur liel.”
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

kikuyu: Chakre chiengʼno kadhi nyime, dhood Israel biro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.

kikuyu: kendo nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nyaka uchop e dier aora Jordan. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka kaw kidi e goke, kaluwore gi kwan mar dhout Israel,
english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

kikuyu: Ondiek mane anenono ne chalo gi kwach, to tiendene ne chalo tiende dubu, kendo dhoge ne chalo gi dho sibuor. To thuol mangʼongono nomiyo ondiegno tekone gi kome mar duongʼ gi lochne duto.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

kikuyu: Obiro biro moneg jopur puodhogo mi ogol puoth mzabibuno e lwetgi mi enomi joma moko.” Kane ji owinjo wachno, negiwacho niya, “Mad gima kama kik timre!”
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

kikuyu: Joma ni e liel ok nyal paki, tho ok nyal wero wendi mar pak, chutho joma dhi e bur ok nyal geno adiera mari.
english: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

kikuyu: Joma kare nokwed mon-go kuom timbegi mag terruok kod chwero remo, nikech terruok kod chwero remo ni e lwetgi.
english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasaye, parie kaka ngimana en mana muya nono; wengena ok nochak one mor kendo.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Ka jodolo osedonjo hekalu to ok oyienegi wuok kanyo mi gidonji e laru ma oko kapok gilonyo lepgi mag dolo giweyo kanyo, nikech lewnigo owal ni Nyasaye. Nyaka girwak lewni mamoko kapok gidhi but kuonde ma owe thuolo ni ji mamoko.”
english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nokecho gi jo-Israel kendo kuom ndalo mangʼeny noweyogi e bwo loch Hazael ruodh Aram kod Ben-Hadad wuode.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua kod jolweny duto nowuok mondo gimonj Ai. Noyiero joge alufu piero adek molony e lweny mi oorogi oko gotieno komiyogi chik niya,
english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

kikuyu: to kik chunyu bed mapek, kaka ne utimo e ndalo mane ungʼanyo e kinde mag tem e thim,
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Kane Yesu odonjo e od jatelono, moneno joma goyo asili kod oganda mane goyo koko,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

kikuyu: Lep nigi teko mar ngima kod tho, to jogo mohere biro chamo olembe.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

kikuyu: Koro miya piny manie godni mane Jehova Nyasaye nosingona odiechiengʼ cha. In iwuon ni iwinjo ni jo-Anak ni kanyo kendo miechgi madongo ne lach kendo ochiel gohinga makmana Jehova Nyasaye kokonya to abiro riembogi oko mana kaka nowacho.”
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”

kikuyu: “Los pasia mar law mayom momin mar range marambulu, maralik kod marakwaro ma en tich mar jachwecho molony mondo ongʼaw e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego mane opidhou kaka yath osegolo chik mondo unwangʼ masira, nikech od Israel kod od Juda osetimo maricho kendo gisechwanya ma iya owangʼ kuom wangʼo ubani ne Baal.
english: For the LORD of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anakelni masira kowuok e odi iwuon. Mana kineno kama gi wangʼi iwuon abiro kawo mondi kendo miyogi achiel kuom joma chiegni kodi, kendo obiro terore kod mondegi odiechiengʼ alanga.
english: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

kikuyu: Eliasaf wuod Dewel, ma jatend joka Gad nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar auchiel.
english: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

kikuyu: To kane ginyalo chungoe kara mar ngʼado bura, dine gilando wechena ne joga kendo gilokore gia e yoregi mamono, kod timbegi mamono.”
english: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

kikuyu: Duognwa gigewa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo wachal gi aore man Negev.
english: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre onene kowuotho ewi pi, ne gibuok ahinya. Luoro nomakogi matek, kendo ne gibuok kagiwacho niya, “En jachien!”
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

kikuyu: Ka ji ariyo larore e wach moro, to nyaka giter wachno e od ngʼado bura kendo jongʼad bura nongʼadnegi bura kare, ka giweyo ngʼat makare thuolo to ngʼat man giketho ikumo.
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

kikuyu: Israel ne en oganda maler ne Jehova Nyasaye, kaka olembege mokwongo chiek; jogo duto mane okidhe nomak kaka joketho, kendo masira nomakogi,’ ” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Israel was holiness to the LORD, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oa kanyo, jo-Farisai gi Jopuonj Chik nochako kwede gi gero kendo ne gichande gi penjo mangʼeny.
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

kikuyu: Kendo nodhi e got Karmel kendo koa kanyo noduogo Samaria.
english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

kikuyu: Kane gisewinjo wach ruoth, negichako wuodhgi mi gidhi, kendo sulwe mane oyudo giseneno yo wuok chiengʼ notelonigi nyaka nochopo mi ochungʼ ewi kama ne nyathi nitie.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

kikuyu: Denguru nimar odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye chiegni; odiechiengno biro ka gir kethruok maduongʼ mawuok e lwet Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo ruoth dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu angʼwen mia abich, gi gik mangʼeny mangʼwe ngʼar kaachiel gi kite ma nengogi tek. Ne pok obetie gik mangʼeny mangʼwe ngʼar marom gi mago mane Ruoth madhako mar Sheba omiyo Ruoth Solomon.
english: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane wadhi kar lemo, nyako moro ma jatich e ot, kendo man-gi jachien marach mane omiyo en gi teko mar koro gik mabiro timore, noromo kodwa. Nyakono ne kelo ni ruodhi mage pesa mangʼeny, kohulo ni ji gik mabiro timogi.
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

kikuyu: Bwomb kerubigo noyarore maromo fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus. Kerubigo nochungʼ ka ngʼiyo dir ot maduongʼ.
english: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nowa nowuok oko, kaachiel gi yawuote kod chiege kod mond yawuote.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik ibed maluor, nimar an kodi; bende kik kibaji goyi, nimar an Nyasachi. Abiro miyi teko kendo abiro konyi; bende abiro siri gi bada ma korachwich mar loch.”
english: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Angʼo mane Musa ochikou mondo utim?”
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

kikuyu: Eka nokalo e rangach man yo nyandwat kendo nopime. Pimne ne romre gi rangeje mamoko,
english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata mogoyo ngʼato kendo onego to adier nyaka negi.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

kikuyu: Kik ulos nyasaye milamo maket gi kido moro amora, e polo malo kata e piny mwalo kata e bwo pi.
english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

kikuyu: Abiro chulo kuor kuom Edom gi lwet joga Israel, kendo gibiro tiyo Edom kaluwore gi ich wangʼ mara kod mirimba mager; gibiro ngʼeyo kaka kuor mara chalo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.’ ”
english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nokawo yien mar misango miwangʼo pep kendo nomiyo Isaka, to en owuon notingʼo mach kod pala ka ji ariyogo ne wuotho.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

kikuyu: Ewi gik mangimago ne nitie gimoro machalo gima opedhore mane nyilni ka pe, kendo malich.
english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

kikuyu: nolonyo lawe mar chola oko, moumore gi suka mondo olok kite eka ne odhi mobet e dhorangach madonjo Enaim, mantie e yo madhi Timna. Nikech noneno ni kata obedo ni Shela koro osebedo ngʼama duongʼ, to ne ok omiyego mondo obed chwore.
english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Abiro neno ni aritora mondo ngimana obed malongʼo chuth, ibiro biro ira karangʼo? Abiro dak e oda gi chuny malongʼo chuth.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

kikuyu: Jodonge ok nobed gi gimoro miluongo ni pinyruoth, nyithi ruoth nolal nono.
english: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Rodo bende noloko kodi, kendo ogendini mathoth modak e dho nembe bende nongʼiewo gik moko kuomi, ka gichuli lak liech kod bepe marotenge motegno kendo mabeyo.
english: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

kikuyu: E mesana unuchamie farese gi joithgi; joma roteke gi jolweny mayoreyore,’ Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.
english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord GOD.’

kikuyu: Asher nonywolo Imna gi Ishva gi Ishvi kod Beria kod nyamin-gi ma nyinge Sera.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

kikuyu: Timbeni miwuoro bende ongʼere kama otimo mudhono, kata timbeni makare e piny ma ilalieno?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

kikuyu: Bangʼ ma owadgi nowuok kod lwete komako ofunj tiend Esau; kuom mano negichako Jakobo. Isaka ne ja-higni piero auchiel kane Rebeka onywolo yawuowigo.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

kikuyu: Yor Jehova Nyasaye e kar pondo ni joma kare, to en kethruok ni jogo matimo richo.
english: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: “Kik uchiwna remo motimgo misango kaachiel gi gimoro amora moketie thowi. “Bor chiayo modongʼ motimnago misango kik chop nyaka okinyi.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

kikuyu: Ok lichnu ni Nyasach Israel osegolou oko mar oganda jo-Israel mamoko kendo okelou bute owuon mondo uti e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo uchung e nyim oganda kendo utinegi?
english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

kikuyu: Eka nawacho nigi ni: Withur musiko kudhiye ni to nangʼo?’ ” Kanyo pod iluongo ni Bama nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’

kikuyu: Kane jolweny oseguro Yesu, negikawo lepe mi gipogogi nyadingʼwen, bangʼe gipogore moro ka moro, kargi ji angʼwen. Lawe mar kandho kende ema ne giweyo. En ne oonge gi wangʼ usi, to notwangʼe machalre, chakre malo nyaka piny.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

kikuyu: Mana kaka wasewinjo e kaka waseneno gi wengewa, e dala maduongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, e dala mar Nyasachwa: Nyasaye oselose kama dak berie nyaka chiengʼ. Sela
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Kane awacho niya, “Tienda kier,” to herani nojola, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyaka e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka en gi jo-Juda, jo-Jerusalem, jodolo, jo-Lawi, kaachiel gi ji duto momewo kod ma jochan. Nosomonegi weche duto mane ondiki e Kitabu mar Singruok mane osenwangʼ e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka giwinjo.
english: The king went up to the LORD’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: To Jonadab wuod Shimea ma owadgi Daudi, nowachone niya, “Ruodha kik par ni gisenego yawuot ruoth duto. En mana Amnon kende ema otho. Abisalom osebedo gi paroni e chunye chakre chiengʼ mane Amnon oterore gi nyamin-gi Tamar githuon.
english: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

kikuyu: Nikech adhondene ok thiedhre; kata mana Juda adhondenego osemako. Masira osechopo nyaka e dhoranga joga, nyaka ei Jerusalem.
english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho, “Wachne kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Abiro muko gik moko duto masegero kendo pudho gik moko duto masepidho e piny ngima.
english: “You shall tell him, the LORD says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

kikuyu: Neuru, kawuru nyara ma pod ok ongʼeyo chwo, kod dhako moroni. Abiro golonugi oko sani mondo uterru kodgi; to ngʼatni to kik utimne gima rachno.”
english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

kikuyu: Kane ji oneno tim hono ma Yesu notimono, negichako wacho niya, “Kuom adier, ma e janabi mane onego bi e piny.”
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Eka Manoa nolamo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, akwayi, mad iwe ngʼat Nyasaye mane ioro irwa obi kendo opuonjwa kaka wanyalo rito wuowini.”
english: Then Manoah entreated the LORD, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E odiechiengno abiro dwoko kwayou ma boche polo, nochiw koth ne piny,
english: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says the LORD. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;

kikuyu: Jatend migawo mokwongo mane tiyo e dwe mokwongo ne en Jashobeam wuod Zabdiel. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Bangʼ dweche adek Juda noyudo wach niya, “Tamar chi wuode tim chode osemiyo wichkuot kendo kuom mano koro en gi ich.” Juda nowacho niya, “Goleuru oko kendo uwangʼe nyaka otho!”
english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

kikuyu: Miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kaachiel koda; watingʼuru nyinge malo kaachiel.
english: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

kikuyu: Kata konindo e kitandane, to ochano timo gima rach; oseketo chunye mar luwo yor richo, kendo ok otamre gima rach.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeremia noluongo Baruk wuod Neria, kendo Jeremia ne wachone to ondiko weche duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osewachone, Baruk nondikogi e kitabu.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the LORD’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

kikuyu: Asechopo e giko mar kethruok marach e dier chokruok mangima.”
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

kikuyu: Tongʼno noluwo yo podho chiengʼ kokadho Aznoth Tabor kendo owuok Hukok. Gi yo milambo tongʼno nokiewo gi Zebulun, to yo podho chiengʼ nokiewo gi Asher; to yo wuok chiengʼ nokiewo gi aora Jordan.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

kikuyu: Gima utim en ni kik ungʼanyne Jehova Nyasaye. Kik uluor jopinyno, nikech wabiro mwonyogi duto. Jarit mag-gi osea, to wan to Jehova Nyasaye nikodwa kendo kik uluorgi.”
english: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”

kikuyu: In mitemo bet e winjruok gi Nyasaye kuom mako chik, ngʼeni isepogori gi Kristo; kendo isea kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

kikuyu: Kane owetene oneno ni wuon-gi ohero Josef moloyogi, negidoko mamon kode kendo ne ok ginyal wuoyo kode maber.
english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

kikuyu: Baruk wuod Neria notimo gik moko duto mane Jeremia janabi onyise mondo otim; e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nosomo weche Jehova Nyasaye koa e kitabu.
english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the LORD’s words in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Nimar ndiko mag jonabi gi mag chik nokoro nyaka ndalo Johana.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

kikuyu: Joka Benjamin ne gin: Salu wuod Meshulam, wuod Hodavia, wuod Hasenua;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Ne giwachonu niya, “E ndalo giko joma jaro ji nobedie ma noluw gombogi giwegi maricho.”
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

kikuyu: Kane jotich mamoko oneno gima notimoreno, chunygi nodoko malit ahinya kendo negidhi mi ginyiso ruodhgi gik moko duto mane osetimore.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

kikuyu: Kane Jehoshafat ruodh Juda noduogo ode Jerusalem kongima,
english: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ongʼere ni nitiere dhok mopogore opogore e piny, to onge kata achiel kuomgi maonge gi tiendgi.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, duongʼ kod teko, pak gi loch kod ber odogni, nimar gik moko duto manie polo gi piny gin magi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, pinyruoth en mari kendo omiyi duongʼ moloyo gik moko duto.
english: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.

kikuyu: kata ka iketho buch ngʼato, donge Ruoth Nyasaye neno gik ma kamago?
english: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

kikuyu: Un nyisecheu manono, nyiswa anena gima biro timore. Nyiswa anena tiend gik mane osetimore, mondo omi wangʼe ni gichalo nade, kendo nyiswa anena kaka gikogi nobedi. Kata nyiswa anena gik mabiro timore,
english: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie kaka asewuotho e nyimi gi adiera kod chuny modimbore kendo asetimo gigo makare e nyim wangʼi.” Bangʼe Hezekia noywak malit.
english: and said, “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Hana ne ok odhi. Ne owacho ne chwore niya, “Ka nyathi ma wuowi oseweyo dhoth to abiro tere e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo obiro dak kuno nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and stay there forever.”

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kendo mar ariyo:
english: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying,

kikuyu: Kane gi winjo wechegi duto, ne gingʼiyore giwegi ka giluor kendo giwachone Baruk niya, “Nyaka wanyis wechegi duto ne ruoth.”
english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

kikuyu: En angʼo momiyo usando kendo uthiro joga modhier?” Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Nimar ruodh Babulon biro chungʼ e akerkeke mar yo, kama yore ariyogo oriworego mondo ogo gagi kama: Obiro goyo ombulu gi ligangla kendo obiro penjo nyisechege molamo wach, bende obiro rango chuny chiayo motimgo misango mondo ongʼe yo monego oluw.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

kikuyu: Jaherana chalo gi mwanda manie thim. Nene kaka ochungʼ e tok ohinga, kongʼicho gie dirise manie kor ohinga, kendo kongʼicho gie bath dirisa.
english: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

kikuyu: Yo ka iye mag rachungigo ne nitie hoho molworore ma tutne nyalo romo fut achiel gi nus. Hohoni nolwore, kendo bwoye ne oloyo fut achiel gi nus matin. To alwora mar dhoge nolosie kido. Bepe momako sirnigo ne ok olworore to ne gin Skweya.
english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

kikuyu: ‘Kata bed ni Balak ne miya ode mar ruoth mopongʼ gi fedha gi dhahabu, to ne ok anyal timo gimoro amora gi pacha awuon mopogore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye bed ni ber kata rach?’
