english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima ondiki: Kristo nyaka ne masira kendo chiengʼ mar adek enochier oa kuom joma otho,
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye e Nyasaye madieri; en e Nyasaye mangima, Ruoth manyaka chiengʼ. Ka iye owangʼ, to piny tetni; ogendini ok nyal mirimbe.
english: But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ringi ia e piny man yo nyandwat, nikech asekeyou nyaka e tunge angʼwen mag polo.
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jakobo nowacho ne joode duto kod ji mane ni kode niya, “Wituru nyiseche mag pinje mamoko ma un-go kendo upwodhru mi urwak lewni maler.
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

kikuyu: to nyaka ogol chik mondo omuk kite duto ma gino osemako mi owitgi oko e tok pacho kama ok ler.
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

kikuyu: To abiro keto olowu e dhogi kendo abiro miyo rech duto manie aoreni mokie kalagaklani. Abiro goli oko e aoreni, ka rech duto omoko e kalagaklani.
english: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales.

kikuyu: Joma odak kuno nigi teko mangʼeny, kendo gidakie mier madongo mochiel motegno kendo malich. Bende ne waneno nyikwa Anak kuno.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

kikuyu: “An ja-Yahudi monywol Tarso, e piny Kilikia, to ne adongo Jerusalem ka. Ne ayudo tiegruok matut e chike mag kwerewa e bwo Gamaliel, kendo ne achiwora ne Nyasaye mana kaka koro un bende uchaloni.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

kikuyu: Ngʼama osiko mana ka ngʼiyo kor polo ok nokom; to ngʼama rito mana ni mondo koth ochwe, ok noke.
english: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

kikuyu: Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana (mane iluongo ni Boanerges, tiende ni yawuot Mor Polo);
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano joote nowuok modok Jerusalem, ka gia ewi got miluongo ni Zeituni, ma en kama bor madirom kilomita achiel koa Jerusalem.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

kikuyu: To asewinjo ni in inyalo loko tiend weche mopondo ka ikonyo e weche matek machando ji. Kinyalo somo ndikoni mi inyisa tiende to ibiro rwakni law maralik kendo ibiro ketni thiwni mar dhahabu e ngʼuti, kendo ibiro keti jalupna mar adek kuom duongʼ e pinyruoth.
english: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Mithka mi gibworo Hashmona.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

kikuyu: Bangʼeno jo-Farisai nowuok modhi kendo negichako chano kaachiel gi jo-Herodia kaka digineg Yesu.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Ne wapeyo Negev mar jo-Kereth kod gwengʼ Juda to gi Negev ma piny Kaleb mine wawangʼo Ziklag.”
english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

kikuyu: Jatendgi nobed achiel kuomgi; jatendgi noa e diergi. Anakele machiegni kendo enobi machiegni koda, nimar en ngʼa manyalo chiwore, mondo obed machiegni koda?’ ” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo piny noyuso, kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar abich.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

kikuyu: ‘Nikech ok giseluwa gi chunygi duto, onge kata ngʼato achiel ma ja-higa piero ariyo kadhi nyime mane oa Misri mabiro neno piny mane asingora ka akwongʼora ne Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo;
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mane oyudogi nokidhogi; wasikgi nowacho niya, ‘Ok wan joketho, nimar negitimo richo ni Jehova Nyasaye, kar kwadhgi madiera, Jehova Nyasaye, geno mar wuonegi.’
english: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of righteousness, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’

kikuyu: mondo orieny kuom jogo modak e mudho, kendo e tipo mar tho, mondo otel ne tiendewa e yor kwe.”
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

kikuyu: Koro in, Tatenai, jatelo mar Yufrate, kod Shetha-Bozenai kaachiel gi un, jotelo wetegi mar gwengʼno, suduru mabor gi kanyo.
english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Winji, abiro luongo Ogendini, abiro chungo bandecha ne oganda kaka ranyisi, gibiro kelo yawuoti ka gitingʼogi e badgi kendo ginikel nyigi ka gitingʼogi e gokgi.
english: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

kikuyu: Tinde ok wayud honni kata ranyisi, kendo onge jonabi modongʼ kata achiel, to onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomwa mongʼeyo ni mano biro bedo kamano nyaka karangʼo.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

kikuyu: To Esau nowacho niya, “An gi gik mathoth owadwa. Magi-gi bedgo abeda.”
english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

kikuyu: Kane osegony Petro gi Johana, negidok ir owete mamoko mi ginyisogi gik moko duto ma jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda nosewachonegi.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo onenogi, nowacho niya, “Ma en kambi mar Nyasaye!” Kuom mano nochako kanyo ni Mahanaim (tiende ni kembni ariyo).
english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

kikuyu: En ema noger ot miluongo gi Nyinga. Enobed wuoda, to anabed wuon mare kendo anagur loch mar pinyruodhe mar Israel nyaka chiengʼ.’
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

kikuyu: Un uwegi to ungʼeyo kaka Timotheo osenyiso ber mare malongʼo, nikech wasetiyo kode kaachiel mana kaka wuowi gi wuon mare, ka wachiwore ne tich mar Injili.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

kikuyu: Eka nalokora mondo ane ngʼat mane wuoyo koda. Kane alokora ne aneno rachungi teyni abiriyo mag dhahabu,
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

kikuyu: Ne asiko ka aoro jotichna ma jonabi, mane giwacho ni, ‘Kik utim gima mononi ma ok ahero!’
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Masiche mapok one biro makou! Neuru obiro!
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

kikuyu: Negiwachone kamano nikech kata gin giwegi ne ok giyie kuome.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

kikuyu: To Gideon nodwoke niya, “Ruodha, ka Jehova Nyasaye nikodwa, to angʼo momiyo magi duto osetimorenwa? Ere honni duto mane kwerewa onyisowa kagiwacho ni, ‘Donge Jehova Nyasaye ema nogolowa e piny Misri?’ To koro Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼowa mi oketowa e lwet jo-Midian.”
english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero budho biro bedo jachan; ngʼat mohero divai kod moo ok nyal bedo ja-mwandu.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

kikuyu: “To kane angʼingo makati abiriyo ne ji alufu angʼwen, nuchoko okepe adi mag ngʼinjo?” Negidwoke niya, “Abiriyo.”
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Chutho iniluong pinjeruodhi mane ok ingʼeyo mabi iri, kendo pinjeruodhi mane ok ongʼeyi malongʼo nobi iri, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, Jal Maler mar Israel osewiri kod duongʼne.”
english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

kikuyu: Eka Elija nowacho ni ji duto niya, “Biuru ira ka.” Negibiro ire mi nochako loso kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye mane osekethore.
english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.

kikuyu: Jogwengʼ-gi gi joma nosenene motelo kokwecho nopenjo niya, “Donge ma e ngʼat mosebedo kakwechocha?”
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

kikuyu: ‘Bi ira, kendo anaduoki, kendo ananyisi gik madongo ma ok ingʼeyo.’
english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

kikuyu: “Anariemb jolweny moa nyandwat madhi mabor kodu, anariembu nyaka e thim motwo, joge motelo nodhi e nam man yo wuok chiengʼ, to modongʼ nodhi e nam man yo podho chiengʼ. To jogi motho biro dungʼ, mi dungʼne nopongʼ piny.” Adiera osetimo gik madongo.
english: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.

kikuyu: Kik wiyi wil gi sibuoch wasiki, chom tir sigich wasiki mosiko medore ameda.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

kikuyu: Jogi duto notelnegi gi wuonegi e tijgi mar goyo thum e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ka gitiyo e od Nyasaye kuom goyo ongengʼo, orutu kod nyatiti. Asaf, Jeduthun, kod Heman to notelonegi kod ruoth.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

kikuyu: Anabed ka asin kodu mi wasiku nolou e lweny kendo gininegu; unubed e bwo loch jowasiku, kendo unubwogru gi ngʼwech kata kaonge joma lawou.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

kikuyu: Ji nodag kanyo; ok nochak okethe kendo. Jerusalem nobed kama ji odakie gi kwe.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

kikuyu: Nikech wuodani yande otho, to koro onwangʼe.’ Kamano negichako timo nyasi ka gimor.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

kikuyu: Adonija, Bigvai, Adin,
english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

kikuyu: ne ooro jombetre mane ongʼeyo ratiro ni Saulo nosechopo.
english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oyiero mar timo dwach Nyasaye, to obiro ngʼeyo ka bende puonjna oa kuom Nyasaye adier, kata ka awacho mana wechena awuon.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

kikuyu: Kik uwuondru. Ka ngʼato kuomu paro ni oriek e tiengʼni gi rieko mar pinyni, to onego olokre ngʼama ofuwo eka odok mariek.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Yahudi manoyudo nigi Maria ei ot, kahoye, nonene kochungʼ girikni modhi oko, negiluwo bangʼe, ka giparo ni odhi e liel mondo oywagi kuno.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

kikuyu: Yesu norieyo bade momulo ngʼatno. Nowachone niya, “Ayie, pwodhri!” Gikanyono nochango kuom dhohone.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

kikuyu: to koro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, akeloni gik mokwongo nyak mag puodho mane imiya.” Bangʼe ket okapu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo ikulrine.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Pige mag Nimrim oseduono, kendo lum bende osener, kendo oboke orumo, maonge gimoro amora modongʼ ka ngʼich.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

kikuyu: Tera nodak higni mia ariyo gabich kendo notho Haran.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nokone Baruk niya, “An otama; ok anyal dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: kendo kaka pi ywero kite kendo koth maduongʼ ywero lowo, kamano e kaka iketho geno ma dhano nigo.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

kikuyu: “Temuru matek mondo udonj e dhoot madiny, nikech awachonu ni, ji mangʼeny biro temo mondo odonj to ok gibi nyalo ngangʼ.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

kikuyu: Tarik apar, dwe mar apar, e higa mar ochiko, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ka wawacho ni waonge richo, to wawuondore kendwa wawegi, kendo adiera onge e chunywa.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

kikuyu: to Daudi ne jadok kinde ka kinde koa ir Saulo mondo odhi okwa romb wuon-gi Bethlehem.
english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Ne aneno hemb jo-Kushan ka nigi chandruok, kuonde dak mag jo-Midian nigi kihondko.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodwoke kowacho niya, “Mano en adier, Ruoth, to kata mana guogi man e bwo mesa bende chamo ngʼinjo ma nyithindo olwaro piny.”
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

kikuyu: kendo negiloko duongʼ mar Nyasaye ma ok tho e kido machalo gi dhano matho, gi winy, gi le gi gik mamol.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ pod ok opodho e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo, jo-dalano nowachone niya, “En angʼo mamit moloyo mor kich? En angʼo maratego moloyo sibuor?” Samson nowachonegi niya, “Kane ok upuro gi nyarocha, to dine ok uyudo tiend ngeroni.”
english: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”

kikuyu: Un kaachiel gi joma luwou duto usengʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye. Harun to en ngʼa ma ungʼurne?”
english: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

kikuyu: E ndalo mar abiriyo jatijno nowacho niya, “Bor polo matin machalo gi lwet dhano kowuok e nam.” Omiyo Elija nowacho niya, “Dhiyo mondo inyis Ahab ni, ‘Idh gachi kendo dhiyo kapok koth ogengʼoni.’ ”
english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

kikuyu: Kane osudo but kama ne achungʼe, luoro nomaka mine apodho piny auma. To nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, bed gi ngʼeyo ni fweny misenenoni wuoyo kuom ndalo giko.”
english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ohedhore ma okwongʼore mar timo gimoro, maber kata marach ka ok ongʼeyo, (e wach moro ma ngʼato thoro hedhore ka kwongʼore) mi bangʼe achien ofwenyo, to enodok jaketho.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

kikuyu: Kik uyie ngʼato wuondu e yo moro amora, nikech odiechiengʼno ok nobi nyaka ngʼanyo maduongʼ chopi, kendo nyaka ngʼat mochayo chik fwenyre, ma en jal mochanne tho e mach manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

kikuyu: Rech manie nam, winy manie kor polo, le manie piny, gimoro amora mamol piny e lowo kod ji duto modak e wangʼ piny notetni e nyima. Gode nomukre, kuonde modhi malo nonyumre piny kendo ohinga duto nogore piny.
english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosetimo kamano mochopo dwarone, koluongo tiengʼ ka tiengʼ nyaka chakre chon? En mana an Jehova Nyasaye, an ema akwongo kendo An ema agik.”
english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

kikuyu: Nimar fweny mag miriambo kod weche mikoro miwuondogo ji ok nochak obedi e dier jo-Israel.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Ka uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo urito adimba chikene duto ma amiyou kawuono, to Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro tingʼou malo moloyo ogendini duto modak e piny.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

kikuyu: Nengo mar piago kwer gi saruru ne en ariyo ewi adek mar Shekel, nengo mar piago uma gi le ne en achiel ewi adek mar Shekel, kata mar rieyo bidhi.
english: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

kikuyu: Magi e yawuot Shem kuom dhoutgi ka moro ka moro wacho dhogi giwegi.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

kikuyu: Nochiwo joge ne ligangla, kendo nokecho ahinya gi girkeni mare.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

kikuyu: Joma kare mondo obed moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo gipondo kuome; ji duto moriere tir gie chunygi mondo opake!
english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

kikuyu: Nyikwa jo-Keni ma jaduongʼ Musa, nodhi koa e Dala Maduongʼ mar Jeriko ka en gi jo-Juda mondo gidag e dier jogo mantiere e thim mar Juda man Negev but Arad.
english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

kikuyu: Kane ochako timo nonrono, ngʼat moro mane nigi gope moromo silingʼ tara gi tara ne okel e nyime.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

kikuyu: “Parie puonj mane imiyo jatichni Musa, kiwacho ni, ‘Ka ok ubedo jo-ratiro, to abiro keyou e dier ogendini,
english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;

kikuyu: Saulo bende nodhi dalagi man Gibea, ka en gi joma thuondi mane osemul chunygi gi Nyasaye.
english: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

kikuyu: Ka gitimo kamano to gibiro kano mwandu ne gin giwegi, kendo mano nodognegi mise motegno e ndalo mabiro, mondo omi gibed gi ngima madiera man-gi tiende.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

kikuyu: Ka jotend jolweny duto kod jogi mane pod ni e piny ma tambarare nowinjo ni ruodh Babulon noseyiero Gedalia wuod Ahikam kaka jatelo maduongʼ kendo okete jatelo mar chwo, mon kod nyithindo mane odhier moloyo e piny kendo mago mane ok oter e twech Babulon,
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,

kikuyu: “Mirimba lich kuom jokwath, kendo abiro kumo jotelo; nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego biro rito kwethne, ma gin jo-Juda, kendo enomi gichal faras mar lweny ma giro.
english: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ nywolo Serug, Reu nodak higni mia ariyo gabiriyo kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Adam chik niya, “In thuolo mar chamo olemb yien moro amora e puodho;
english: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

kikuyu: kendo mondo urwakru gi dhano manyien, mochwe mondo ochal gi Nyasaye kuom ngima makare mar adier kendo maler.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

kikuyu: Abidan wuod Gideoni, ma jatend joka Benjamin, nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar ochiko.
english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Wuogi mondo idhi ichungi ewi got e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nimar Jehova Nyasaye chiegni kadho.” Eka yamo maduongʼ makudho matek nobaro got mokeyo kite e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, to Jehova Nyasaye ne onge e yamono. Bangʼ yamono piny noyiengni, to Jehova Nyasaye ne onge e yiengni pinyno.
english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD.” Behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

kikuyu: kod rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich gi nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw misango mar lalruok. Magi e misengini mane Eliab wuod Helon ogolo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: “Wach ni jo-Israel ni: ‘E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abiriyo, nyaka ubed gi odiechieng yweyo; ma en odiechieng chokruok mowal kaka rapar kugoyo turumbete.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

kikuyu: To joka Benjamin mamoko gi jo-Juda mamoko bende nobiro ir Daudi e kare mar pondo.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: “Ne jogo duto modak kuonde motimo gode chakre Lebanon nyaka Misrefoth Maim, tiende ni, jo-Sidonia duto, an awuon abiro riembogi mondo giwene jo-Israel. Beduru gi adieri mar pogo ni jo-Israel pinyni kaka girkeni margi, mana kaka asechikoi.
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne atimo kaka ne ochika. Ne agolo misika mane aseiko ne wuodh dhi e twech godiechiengʼ. Eka godhiambo ka chiengʼ dhi podho ne akunyo kor ot gi lwetena. Ne akawo giga awuokgo ka piny oyuso, ka atingʼogi e gokena koni gi koni ka gineno.
english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato kuomu dibedi ni en gi rombe mia achiel, to achiel kuomgi olal, donge ngʼatno diwe piero ochiko gochikogo e pap kama ler kendo odhi omany rombo molal nyaka oyude?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

kikuyu: Mana kaka ok inyal ngʼeyo kama yamo luwo, kata ngʼeyo kaka nyathi chakore ei min, omiyo ok inyal ngʼeyo gima Nyasaye ma jachwech gik moko duto timo.
english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

kikuyu: “To koro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel rit singruok mane itimo gi jatichni Daudi wuora kiwachone niya, ‘Ok inibed maonge ngʼama bet e nyima e kom loch Israel ka nyikwayi onono kaka giwuotho e nyima kaka chikna dwaro mana kaka isetimo.’
english: “Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

kikuyu: Ka chiayono ne okidhi gi le mager, to enokel choke modongʼ kaka ranyisi kendo ok enochune mondo ochul chiayo mokidhino.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jalno mane olor bende ema noidho malo kuma bor moyombo polo duto, mondo opongʼ piny duto gi duongʼne.)
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

kikuyu: To ji apar kuomgi nowachone Ishmael niya, “Kik inegwa! Wan gi ngano kod shairi gi mo, kod mor kich, mwapando e puothe.” Omiyo noweyogi kendo ne ok onegogi gi joma moko.
english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata morwako janabi, nikech en janabi, noyud pok ma janabi yudo, kendo ngʼato angʼata morwako ngʼama kare, nikech en ngʼama kare, noyud pok ma ngʼama kare yudo.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

kikuyu: kendo jo-Israel nongʼado nam kawuotho e lowo motwo, ka pi ogingore e bathgi korachwich gi koracham.
english: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

kikuyu: Giduto gionge paro kendo gifuwo; ipuonjogi gi nyiseche manono mag bepe mopa maonge tich.
english: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.

kikuyu: “Yaye Nyasaye, dhano to en angʼo momiyo ikawe ka gima lich kendo isiko ipare ndalo duto,
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

kikuyu: Kane Rehoboam ochopo Jerusalem, nochoko dhood Juda gi dhood Benjamin, chwo maromo alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro kendo gidhi giked gi jo-Israel mondo gidwok loch ni Rehoboam wuod Solomon pinyruodhe.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

kikuyu: Kaka ute mopongʼ gi winy, e kaka utegi bende opongʼ gi wuondruok; gisebedo jo-mwandu, kendo joma nigi teko mangʼeny,
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Koro sani to atimo angʼo? Ok anyal kata wuoyoe?”
english: David said, “What have I now done? Is there not a cause?”

kikuyu: Yesu nolokore monenogi ka giluwo bangʼe, mi nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mudwaro?” Negiwachone niya, “Rabi” (ma tiende ni “Japuonj”), “idak kanye?”
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

kikuyu: Chokena tho omako kendo rama malit seche ma joma kedo koda yanya kochaya, ka giwachona odiechiengʼ duto niya, “Koro ere Nyasachino?”
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Mad timreni ka awachone nyako moro ni, ‘Asayi, yie dapigi piny mondo mi amodhie,’ kendo ka dowachna ni, ‘modhi kendo abiro chiwo pi ni ngamia-gi duto’ to en ema mondo obed nyako ma iseyierone Isaka jatichni. Kamano anangʼe ni isenyiso ngʼwononi ne ruodha.”
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

kikuyu: To mochwalore matin koa kama negintie, kweth maduongʼ mar anguro moko ne kwayo.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

kikuyu: makmana Kaleb wuod Jefune. En ema none pinyno kendo anamiyego kaachiel gi nyikwaye kamoro amora ma tiende nonyon nikech osebedo koluwo Jehova Nyasaye gi chunye duto.”
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”

kikuyu: Wena richona nikech nyingi kata obedo ni richona duongʼ ahinya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
english: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kikuyu: “To un, biuru un yawuot jojuogi, ma koth terruok kod chode!
english: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.

kikuyu: Paruruane kuom Ibrahim: “Ibrahim noyie kuom Nyasaye kendo mano nomiyo okwane kaka ngʼama kare.”
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Kane gisekelo ruodhigi ne Joshua, noluongo jo-Israel duto kendo owachone jotend lweny mane obiro kode niya, “Biuru ka kendo unyon ngʼut ruodhigi.” Omiyo negibiro mi ginyono ngʼutgi piny.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They came near, and put their feet on their necks.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro miyou mwandu e tije lweteu duto kod nyak mag kothu, nyiroye mag dhou kod cham mag piny. Jehova Nyasaye nobed mamor kodu kendo mi uchak uyud mwandu, mana kaka ne otimo ne kwereu,
english: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

kikuyu: Jopuonjre Johana nobiro mokawo ringre kendo ne giike. Eka negidhi ginyiso Yesu.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

kikuyu: kendo nyiseche manono notiek pep.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

kikuyu: ngʼat moro noromo kode ka owuotho awuotha e thim mi openje niya, “Imanyo angʼo?”
english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

kikuyu: Kokawo gimoro odhigo; to en ngʼa manyalo tame? En ngʼa manyalo penje ni, ‘Ma to angʼo ma itimoni?’
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

kikuyu: Kendo kuom timo kamano ananyis duongʼna gi lerna, kendo anami angʼera e nyim ogendini mathoth. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”’

kikuyu: To kara nudhi mondo une angʼo? Janabi? Ee, awachonu ni ne udhi neno ngʼat moloyo janabi gi duongʼ.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Simeon, ne en Shafat wuod Hori;
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

kikuyu: Tiend gima nowacho ni, ‘Ubiro manya to ok unuyuda’ kendo ni, ‘kama antie ok unyal bire’ en angʼo?”
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mangima pod nigi geno, mana kaka ngero moro wacho ni ber bedo guok mangima moloyo sibuor mosetho!
english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

kikuyu: Nimar tim ma mikach ruoth otimoni, ka mon mamoko ongʼeyo, to gibiro chayo chwogi kagiwacho ni, ‘Ruoth Ahasuerus nochiko mikache ma Vashti mondo okel e nyime, to nodagi biro.’
english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno unungʼe ni an ei Wuora; kendo ni un e iya, kendo an eiu.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nodwoke niya, “Kaw nyirombe abiriyogi kaka ranyisi ni nakunyo sokoni.”
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

kikuyu: Rech manie aora Nael notho, kendo aora nodungʼ marach ma jo-Misri ne ok nyal modho pige. Remo ne nitie kamoro amora e piny Misri.
english: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye chungo ji duto mopodho kendo omiyo joma piny otaro aa malo.
english: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gaboro mar loch Josia mondo neni opwodh piny kod hekalu nooro Shafan wuod Azalia gi Maseya jatend dala maduongʼ kaachiel gi Joa wuod Joahaz ma jachan weche mondo olos hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God.

kikuyu: Kik uchaya nikech an dichol, nimar chiengʼ ema oseloko denda kamano. Yawuot minwa nokecho koda, mine giketa jarit puothegi mag mzabibu; to puotha awuon mar mzabibu to ne ajwangʼo.
english: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

kikuyu: Balak notimo kaka Balaam nowacho, kendo negichiwo rwath gi im ewi kendo ka kendo mar misango.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

kikuyu: Jadolo nodwoke niya, “Ligangla Goliath ja-Filistia, mane inego e holo mar Ela, nika; oboye gi law en e tok law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod. Ka idware to kawe, onge ligangla moro makmana mano.” Daudi nowacho niya, “Onge moro amora machal kode; miyago.”
english: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”

kikuyu: Ne amiyi od ruodhi mondo obed mari, kendo naketo monde ruodhi e lweti. Ne amiyi dhout Israel gi dhood Juda. To ka magi ne ok oromi to pod ne anyalo miyi moko.
english: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

kikuyu: Nimar ei chunya maiye amor gi chik Nyasaye;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uchiwo achiel kuom apar mar gik ma milimili kaka kado, apoth kod onyulo. To ok usedewo gik madongo moloyo ma chik dwaro, kaka adiera gi kech kod yie. Owinjore ne utim gik ma achien-go ka ok uweyo mak utimo mokwongogo.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Koro jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nodongʼ kochungʼ e dier aora Jordan nyaka ji notieko timo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Joshua, mana kaka Musa nochiko Joshua. Ji nokadho mapiyo nono kadhi,
english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

kikuyu: Nowacho nowetene niya, “Osedwokna pesana, eri go en e dho ogunda.” Chunygi nobwok ma gibedo moluor kagiwacho niya, “Angʼo ma Nyasaye osetimonwa ni?”
english: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

kikuyu: To gweth miwuoyeni dobed mana mar joma oter nyangu kende, koso en mar joma ok oter nyangu bende? Wawacho ni yie mar Ibrahim nomiyo okwane kaka ngʼama kare.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

kikuyu: Ka nyako ma jatichno nochako onene e dhorangach, nochako owacho ne joma ochungʼ kanyo niya, “Ngʼatni en achiel kuomgi.”
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

kikuyu: Isepuonja nyaka aa e nyathi, yaye Nyasaye, kendo nyaka kawuono pod ahulo timbe miwuoro.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Kata ka Babulon ochopo e lwasi kendo ger ohingage motegno kuno, to anaor ji mondo okethe,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To ka sa mar wangʼo ubani nochopo, jolemo duto nochokore oko kendo negilamo.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

kikuyu: “ ‘To in, Bethlehem, manie piny Juda, ok itin ngangʼ e dier jotelo mag Juda; nikech kuomi ema jatelo mabiro kwayo joga ma jo-Israel biro ae.’”
english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Ne Jeduthun. Zaburi mar Daudi. Ne awacho niya, “Abiro ritora e yorena, kendo abiro rito lewa kik wach richo; abiro tweyo dhoga gi tol kinde duto ma joma timbegi richo ni buta.”
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

kikuyu: to Paulo noyiero Sila gidhigo, ka owete oketogi e bwo ngʼwono mar Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo ir ngʼat Nyasaye e got, nopodho e tiende, Gehazi ne obiro gole kanyo, to ngʼat Nyasaye nokwero Gehazi niya, Weye! En kod lit e chunye, makmana Jehova Nyasaye osepandona wachni kendo ok osenyisa gima omiyo.
english: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye ne ok okumo jodong Israel-go, negineno Nyasaye kendo negichiemo mi gimetho.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

kikuyu: Bangʼ sand gi tij achuna, Juda oseter e twech. Odak e dier ogendini kendo oonge kar yweyo. Jogo duto malawe osemake kapod en e chandruok malich.
english: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.

kikuyu: Bende Nyasaye nyalo yie kodu kudwaro loko adiera bedo miriambo?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Gima giwachono nikare.”
english: The LORD said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

kikuyu: Isemiyo dala maduongʼ omukore, modhurore pidhe pidhe, dalano mochiel motegno okethore, dala maduongʼ ma jopinje mamoko noketoe genogi oserumo; bende ok nochak ogere kendo.
english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

kikuyu: Ji duto biro winjo kendo nobed maluor bende ok ginichak gibed gi wich teko.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

kikuyu: Kamano ruoth notho kendo nokele Samaria moike kanyo.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye nochanonwa gima ber moloyo mondo oketwa kare mana ka wan kaachiel kodgi.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

kikuyu: Shalum nonywolo Hilkia, to Hilkia nonywolo Azaria,
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

kikuyu: To ka bangʼ yudo koth maber to ochiego mana kuthe gi buya to oonge tich, kendo ochiegni yudo kwongʼ. Giko ibiro wangʼe e mach.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

kikuyu: To yo wuok chiengʼ mar Aora Jordan (e piny mamalo momanyore gi Jeriko) negiyiero Bezer manie thim kuom piny dhood Reuben gi Ramoth mantiere Gilead kuom piny dhood Gad, kod Golan mantiere Bashan e dhood Manase.
english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Piny ma ogeno Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache ogwedhi, nikech gin oganda mane oyiero kaka girkeni mare.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Lweta biro sire, adier, bada biro miye teko.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

kikuyu: mi giwachone Musa niya, “Wuo kodwa in iwuon to wabiro winjo. Kik iwe Nyasaye wuo kodwa nono to wabiro tho.”
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano piny joma otho ongʼamo dhoge malach ka dande oyawore malich; kendo enomuony jotelo kod oganda mamoko e kinde ma gikokee gi mor.
english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

kikuyu: To un, jowetena, kik uol gi timo maber.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

kikuyu: Ngʼama nomi talanta abich nodhi sano sano moketo pesane e tich, kendo noyudo talanta abich mamoko kaka ohande.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jonabi moa Jeriko mane oneno gima notimoreno mowacho niya, “Roho mar Elija ni kuom Elisha.” Kendo negidhi ire mi gikulore piny e nyime.
english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

kikuyu: Ruoth nochiwore koa kuom mwandune gik mitimogo misengini miwangʼo pep mag chiengʼ Sabato gi mag chiengʼ dwe manyien kendo ndalo mag sewni moyier kaka ondiki e Chik Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Ka wuon-gi otamore chiwe ne ngʼatno, to ngʼatno pod nyaka chul mana gir keny.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kikuyu: Ji nodonjo lingʼ-lingʼ e dala maduongʼ chiengʼno mana kaka joma oloo e lweny duogo alucha ka wigi okuot.
english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nodok moluongo jodongo duto mag oganda mi oketo e nyimgi weche duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochike mondo owachi.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Yesu ne riembo jachien mamomo. Kane jachien osewuok, ngʼat ma momono nowuoyo, kendo oganda nohum nono.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

kikuyu: To kaka nyithindo nigi ringruok gi remo e kaka en bende nokawo kidono, mondo kuom thone oketh teko mar jal man-gi teko mar tho, ma en Satan,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

kikuyu: “Ka jogi odhi kedo gi jowasikgi kamoro amora ma ibiro orogie ka gilami kagichomo dalani miseyiero kendo hekalu masegero maluongo nyingi,
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

kikuyu: Kido mar malaika mar kerubigo noyaro bwombegi kochomo malo mondo giumgo raumno. Kerubigo nochungʼ momanyore ka ngʼiyore gi wi raumno.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Yaye Wuora, mi gibed achiel, mana kaka in e iya kendo an e iyi. Mad gin bende gibed e achiel kodwa, mondo piny oyie ni iseora.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

kikuyu: Abigael noidho punda piyo piyo ka jotije abich hike kendo rite, negidhi gi joote Daudi mobedo chiege.
english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

kikuyu: Weche Jehova Nyasaye liw, giliw ka fedha moleny e lowo mowangʼ maliet ha, mopwodhi ndalo abiriyo.
english: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka jo-Israel nodoko maroteke, negiketo jo-Kanaan obedo wasumbinigi mane ok giriembogi kata matin.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

kikuyu: To jotelo mag Sukoth nowacho niya, “Bende usemako Zeba kod Zalmuna? Ere kaka dwami jolweny magi moolgi makati?”
english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

kikuyu: Maua achiel noketi e bwo bede ariyo mokwongo mar rachungino, mar ariyo noketi e bwo mar ariyo, to mar adek noketi e bwo bede mar adek, giduto gin bede auchiel.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

kikuyu: Ne giywakni kendo ne iwarogi; negigeno kuomi mine ok gineno wichkuot.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

kikuyu: Gima lit ahinya machielo en: Kaka dhano nobiro e pinyni, e kaka obiro wuok e pinyni, koro ere ohala moyudo, kuom tichne matek konyagore mana ne yamo?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

kikuyu: to Yesu nopenje niya, “Judas, indhogo Wuod Dhano gi nyoth?”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama twangʼo rabaw mar law manyien kuom law moti. Ka otimo kamano to rabaw mar law manyien-no biro mich mi ywa law machon-no mi omed yiech moloyo.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Mise mar ohinga mar dala nokedi gi kite mabeyo duto ma nengogi tek. Mise mokwongo nolos gi jaspa, to mar ariyo ne safir, eka mar adek ne kalkedo kendo mar angʼwen ne emerald,
english: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

kikuyu: Kane joidh farese ochopo Kaisaria, negimiyo ruoth baruwa mane jatend jolweny maduongʼ ondiko, eka negiketo Paulo e lwete.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

kikuyu: giduto gimanore gi ligangla, giduto gilony e kedo, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi liganglane e bathe, koikore ne gik mabwogo ji gotieno.
english: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osewacho ayanga ka awinjo ni: “Kata kamano ute madongo biro dongʼ gunda, kendo ute madongo moger mabeyo biro dongʼ maonge joma odakie.
english: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

kikuyu: Kane osetieko luoko tiendegi, norieyo kandhone bangʼe nodok obet piny. Nopenjogi niya, “Bende ungʼeyo tiend gima asetimonuno?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

kikuyu: Iserito singruokni mane itimo gi jatichni Daudi wuora, ne isingori gi dhogi kendo isechopo singruokno gi lweti, mana kaka en kawuononi.
english: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

kikuyu: Samuel nopenje niya, “Angʼo misetimoni?” Saulo nodwoke niya, “Kane aneno ka ji ke to in bende pok ibiro e sa mane oketi, to jo-Filistia bende chokore Mikmash,
english: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

kikuyu: Omiyo noweyogi, mowuok odhi e dala maduongʼ mar Bethania, kuma ne oninde otienono.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

kikuyu: To jotelo machon, mane otiyo kapok achako tich, noketo tingʼ mapek ne ji mine gikawo nus kilo mar fedha koa kuomgi kaachiel gi chiemo kod divai. Jolupgi bende nomiyo ji tingʼno mapek. To nikech luor mane amiyo Nyasaye an to ne ok atimo kamano.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone oganda kod jopuonjrene niya,
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

kikuyu: Winjuru, nikech an gi gik mabeyo mangʼeny madwaro nyisou; ayawo dhoga mondo awach gima kare.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Abiro reso joga e lwet pinje man yo wuok chiengʼ gi yo podho chiengʼ.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

kikuyu: jo-Filistia nobedo maluor kagiwacho niya, “Nyasaye osebiro e kambi. Wan gi chandruok! Gima kama pok otimore nyaka nene.
english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

kikuyu: “To ka diponi jadolo oneno kama opurno ka ok olandore e lawno, kata e law mochwe kata motwangʼ, kata e pien,
english: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

kikuyu: Jogi gin joma keko akeka kendo gin jomany ketho kuom ji; giluwo dwachgi giwegi maricho, bende giwuoyo gi sunga mathoth kuomgi giwegi. Kendo giwuondo ji gi weche mamit mondo giyud gik magidwaro.
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

kikuyu: Puonjgi buche kod chike duto kendo nyisgi kaka onego gidagi kod tije monego gitim.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

kikuyu: Kowuoyo kuom malaike to owacho niya, “Omiyo malaikane bedo yembe, kendo jotichne kaka ligek mach.”
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

kikuyu: Chandruok osechopo kuomu, un joma odak e piny. Kinde osechopo! Odiechiengʼ okayo machiegni. Nitie luoro maduongʼ, ewi gode, to ok mor.
english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

kikuyu: ‘Anachung kothi nyaka chiengʼ kendo anagur lochni motegno e tienge duto.’ ” Sela
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

kikuyu: “Anaketi oganda maduongʼ kendo anagwedhi; anami nyingi bed gi huma, kendo anami ibed gweth ne ji.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

kikuyu: Aram nonywolo: Uz, Hul, Gether kod Meshek.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

kikuyu: In e kar pondona; ibiro rita e chandruok, kendo ibiro lwora gi wende mag loch. Sela
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

kikuyu: Negikawo mier madongo mochiel motegno gohinga kod lowo mamiyo; bende negikawo udi mopongʼ gi gik mangʼeny mabeyo, sokni mane osekuny, puothe mzabibu, gi mag zeituni kod yiende mag olembe mangʼeny. Negichiemo ma giyiengʼ kendo negibedo gi mor mogundho; negiil kuom berni maduongʼ mane itimonegi.
english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo owinjo wechegi, Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuome gi teko, mi iye nowangʼ ahinya.
english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

kikuyu: Nyithindgi wuotho kanyakla ka jamni; to nyithindgi matindo giro ka nyiroye.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

kikuyu: “Ne kaka osungore; dwarone ok nikare. To ngʼat makare nobed mangima kuom yie mare,
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

kikuyu: Wan joma otegno nyaka watingʼ nyawo mar joma yomyom ma ok watimo mana gik mamorowa wan wawegi.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

kikuyu: Jogi gin mbelni e sewni magu mag hera, kendo gichiemo kodu ka wengegi tek, gin jokwath mapidhore kendgi! Gichalo rumbi ma yamo tero to ok kel koth kendo gichalo olemo mopidhi kinde opon bende gichalo gi yien ma ok nyag olemo kendo mopudh gi tiendegi, gionge tich.
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

kikuyu: omiyo Sarai nowacho ne Abram niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok osemiya nyithindo. Dhiyo mondo iriwri gi jatichna ma nyako; dipoka ayudo joga koa kuome.” Abram noyie gi wach Sarai.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne jatichne maduongʼ mane rito gige ode duto niya, “Ket lweti e kind ema.
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e mich makende monego uchiw: Kuom debe achiel mar ngano unuchiw achiel ewi aboro mar gorogoro, to kuom debe achiel mar shairi unuchiw achiel ewi auchiel mar gorogoro.
english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

kikuyu: Olemba ber moloyo dhahabu maber, gino machiwo oloyo fedha moyier.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

kikuyu: ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Adier, anakum Shemaya ja-Nehelam kod gunde. Onge ngʼama nodongʼ kuom joge, kata neno gik mabeyo mabiro timo ne joga, nikech oselando mondo ji ongʼanyna. An Jehova Nyasaye ema awacho kamano.’ ”
english: therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says the LORD, “because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD.”’”

kikuyu: En ok ochune ni nyaka otim misango pile pile kaka jodolo madongo mamoko timo, kokuongo gi timo misango mare owuon eka otimo mar joma moko. En to notimo misango ni richogi dichiel kende kane ochiwo ringre owuon.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato ouso nyare kaka misumba, to ok noweye obed thuolo kaka iweyo misumba madichwo.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

kikuyu: to aluongo polo gi piny mondo obed joneno kuomu kawuono, ni ubiro rumo mapiyo nono e piny ma ubiro kawo loka Jordan.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

kikuyu: Eka noketo chiemo e nyim Saulo gi joge mine gichiemo. Bangʼe ne giwuok gotienono mi gidhi.
english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowacho niya, “Ngʼato moro omula; angʼeyo ma nikech teko osewuok kuoma.”
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat maler ema nyaka kir pi kuom ngʼat mochidono chiengʼ mar adek gi mar abiriyo, to kochopo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka opwodhe. Ngʼama ipwodhono nyaka luok lepe kendo luokre gi pi, kendo odhiambono nobed mapoth.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

kikuyu: Abram kod Nahor nokendo. Nying chi Abram ne Sarai kendo nying chi Nahor ne Milka; mane nyar Haran; wuon Milka kod Iska.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

kikuyu: kendo joma Jehova Nyasaye osereso nodwogi. Ginidonji Sayun ka giwer; kendo ka ilo mosiko opongʼo chunygi. Ginibed gi mor gi ilo mosiko, kendo kuyo kod parruok norum chuth.
english: Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Filipo, asebedo kodu kuom kinde mangʼeny, kare in pok ingʼeya? Ngʼato angʼata mosenena oseneno Wuoro, koro ere kaka ikelo wacho ni, ‘Nyiswa Wuoro’?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

kikuyu: Kane Yesu onene, noluonge mondo obi kendo nowachone niya, “Dhako ogonyi ibed thuolo ichangi e midekreni.”
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha wacho: “Kwa rombe moiki ne yengʼo.
english: The LORD my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

kikuyu: Gideon wuod Joash notho ka en-gi higni mathoth kendo noyike e liend wuon mare Joash man Ofra dala jo-Abiezer.
english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Reuben ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen gauchiel gi mia abich (46,500).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Nonuru konde duto mopondoe gi kuonde duto motiyogo, eka uduogna wach mobidhore. Bangʼe anadhi kodu; ka dipo ni en kanyo, to abiro dware e dhoudi duto mag Juda.”
english: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”

kikuyu: Ne giholo geche alufu piero adek gariyo gi joriembgi kaachiel gi ruodh jo-Maaka gi jolweny mage kendo negibiro ma gigoyo kambi but Medeba, to jo-Amon nochoki e miechgi mi negiyworone lweny.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

kikuyu: bakunde mag dhahabu piero adek, bakunde machalre mag fedha mia angʼwen gapar, gik mamoko mitiyogo alufu achiel.
english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

kikuyu: Kane wadok ir wuonwa ma jatichni, ne wanyise gima ruodha osewacho.
english: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

kikuyu: Kar kwan mar jamni mane ochiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep noromo nyirwedhi apar gariyo, imbe apar gariyo kod nyiimbe apar gariyo mahikgi achiel, kaachiel gi misango mag cham. Nywogi apar gariyo notigo kaka misango mar golo richo.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

kikuyu: To kuom wach owadwa Apolo, to awacho kama: Ne ajiwe matek mondo olimu kod jowete mamoko, to pok oyie chuth ni onego obi iru sani, to ka oyudo thuolo, to obiro biro achien.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

kikuyu: Miechi madongo maler olokore thim, kata mana Sayun owuon bende olokore thim, kendo Jerusalem odongʼ gunda.
english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane oseluoko wangʼe, noduogo kendo ka otemo oore nowacho niya, “Chiemuru.”
english: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Benjamin ne pod wacho niya, “Walogi kaka pile,” to jo-Israel ne wacho niya, “Wadoguru chien mondo wagolgi e dala maduongʼ ka wachiko kodgi wangʼ yore.”
english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

kikuyu: Mad sulwege mokinyi lokre mudho; mad piny mogeno ni biro ru tamre, kendo kik one ka ugwe chako wangʼ,
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

kikuyu: Hushai nowachone Abisalom niya, “Ooyo to mana ngʼat moyier gi Jehova Nyasaye, moyier gi jogi to gi jo-Israel duto mano e ngʼat mabiro bedo jakore mi asik kode.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever the LORD and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

kikuyu: Joma kare biro pako nyingi adier kendo joma ngimagi oriere tir biro dak kangima e nyimi.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

kikuyu: chenro magi dongo kendo timbegi lich. Wengeni oyawore ne yore duto mag ji; imiyo ngʼato mich kaluwore gi kite, kendo mowinjore gi timbene.
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

kikuyu: Kane giyiero nyiseche manyien, lweny nochakore e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ, kata mana okumba kod tongʼ ne ok oyudie kind jolwenj jo-Israel alufu piero angʼwen.
english: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

kikuyu: Noyudo osenyiso Rael ni en wat wuon Rael kendo ni en wuod Rebeka. Kuom mano Rael nodhi monyiso wuon mare.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

kikuyu: gi mesa kod gigene duto mag tich kod makati miketo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde negigoyo wiye gi luth, kendo ka gingʼulo kuome olawo, bende negikulore e nyime ka gigoyo chong-gi piny ka gilame.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

kikuyu: Kowuotho gotieno eka ochwanyore, nikech oonge gi ler.”
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

kikuyu: Judas nopusore piyo piyo nyaka ir Yesu, mowachone niya, “Misawa Rabi!” bangʼe to onyodhe.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka gol chik mondo gik moko duto manie odno ogol oko kapok odhi onono kama opurno mondo gimoro amora manie odno kik bed mogak. Bangʼ ma, jadolo nigi thuolo mar donjo kendo nono odno.
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo dalagi, nochako puonjo ji e sinagokegi, kendo negihum nono, ka gipenjore niya, “Rieko gi teko mar timo honni ma ngʼatni nigogi oyudo kanye?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “Gouru ombulu e kinda gi Jonathan wuoda.” Mi ombulu nolwar kuom Jonathan.
english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

kikuyu: Ngʼat achiel mane oyudo otony nobiro kendo onyiso Abram ja-Hibrania wachni. E ndalogo Abram nodak e tiend yiende madongo mag Mamre ja-Amor mane omin Eshkol kod Aner, osiepe Abram.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mofuwo ok mor kod winjo wach to omor mana gi wacho paroge owuon.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

kikuyu: ne aneno e dier joma ngʼeyogi tin, ne afwenyo e dier yawuowi matindo, rawera maonge gi rieko.
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

kikuyu: Joka Gershon ne gin: Gershon nonywolo Libni, Libni nonywolo Jahath, Jahath nonywolo Zima,
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye kumo jogo mohero mana kaka wuoro chiko wuode ma omorgo.
english: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

kikuyu: To kata kamano angʼeyo ni in kaachiel gi jodongi pod ok uluoro Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”

kikuyu: Rombena nobayo ewi gode madongo duto gi gode matindo. Ne gike e piny duto, kendo onge ngʼama nomanyogi kata manodwarogi.
english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

kikuyu: To kuom chik mane Ruoth Darius ooro, Tatenai, jatend Yufrate, kod Shetha-Bozenai gi joma negitiyogo kanyakla notimo kamano kuom tangʼ mathoth.
english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto ler mana ni jomaler, to kuom joma okethore ma ok oyie to onge gima ler. Chutho, pachgi kaachiel gi chunygi monego onyisgi kethogi osetho.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

kikuyu: Koro ma e tim mane jodolo timo ne ji kane ngʼato angʼata ne chiwo misango, kendo kane pod ringʼo chiek, to jatij jadolo ne biroga gi uma mabor man-gi leke adek e lwete.
english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

kikuyu: Kane gisechiemo giduto mi giyiengʼ, nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Chokuru ngʼinjo duto ma ji ochamo oweyo. Kik uwe gimoro dhi nono.”
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

kikuyu: Rohono en singo manyiso ni wanayud girkeni nyaka chopi kinde mar warruok mar jo-Nyasaye, mondo duongʼne oyud pak.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

kikuyu: “Asekawo jo-Lawi koa ei jo-Israel e lo wuowi makayo mar chi ja-Israel moro ka moro. Jo-Lawi gin meka,
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

kikuyu: nooro joote ni jo-Jabesh Gilead mondo owachnegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhu kuom timo tim ngʼwono ni Saulo ma ruodhu ka uike.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by the LORD, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

kikuyu: Kendo ka ngʼat ma timbene richo olokore oweyo timbene maricho motimo gima adiera kendo makare to obiro bedo mangima kuom timo kamano.
english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

kikuyu: Rang batha korachwich; mondo ine kaonge ngʼama dewa. Aonge kar pondo; bende aonge ngʼama rito ngimana.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

kikuyu: Moab en besen mara mar luok, to Edom e kama amoe wuochena; Filistia ema akoke ka aseloyo lweny.”
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, ‘Chiengʼno ngʼato ka ngʼata kuomu noluong wadgi mondo obi oywe e bwo yiende mag mzabibu kod mag ngʼowu.’ ”
english: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “An e yo kendo An e adiera bende An e ngima. Onge ngʼama nyalo biro ir Wuora ka ok okadho kuoma.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

kikuyu: ka imiyowa duongʼ kendo ichayowa; iketho nyingwa kendo ipwoyowa, kuom joma odimbore to ikawowa ka joma ketore;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

kikuyu: Rwath ongʼeyo wuon, kendo kanyna ongʼeyo kund wuon, to jo-Israel ok ongʼeya adier; joga awuon onge gi winjo.
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

kikuyu: To ka ok giidho kaachiel kodu ka gimanore gi gige lweny, to nyaka gikaw pok mag-gi kaachiel kodu Kanaan.”
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

kikuyu: Kane Pilato owinjo mano, nogolo Yesu oko kendo nobet piny e kome mar ngʼado bura kama iluongo ni Laru motingʼore malo mar kidi (miluongo gi dho jo-Hibrania ni Gabatha).
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un jopolo duto, un jotichne matimo dwarone.
english: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka kanisa ochokore kaachiel, to ji duto wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore, to ka nitie jomoko ma ok winj dhogino, kata ka joma ok oyie moko odonjo e chokruogno, donge digiwach ni wiu okethore?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

kikuyu: Omiyo nogolo joge, mi opogogi e migepe adek kendo nochako kedo kodgi. Kane oneno ji ka wuok e dala maduongʼ, ne owuok mondo oked kodgi.
english: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko niya, “Mano ok nyal bedo kare. Misengini ma wachiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nyalo bedo gima kwero ni jo-Misri. To ka wachiwo misengini makwerogo e wangʼ-gi, donge gibiro goyowa gi kite?
english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

kikuyu: To ka jadolo onone kendo onge yier marachar e adholano kendo ka ok odholore kendo oselal, eka jadolo nokete kar kende kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi omiyo jopuonjrene mondo opog ji. Rech ariyo ka bende nopogo matindo tindo ni ji duto.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
