kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nochokore mar kedo gi jo-Israel, ka gin gi geche alufu adek, gi geche mag farese alufu auchiel, gi jolweny mathoth ka kwoyo man e dho nam. Negiwuok mi gidhi gibworo Mikmash man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Beth Aven.
english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

kikuyu: Ubiro rwako arwaka kilembau ewiu kaka pile, kod pat pat magu e tiendeu. Ok ubi ywak kata goyo nduru, to chira biro makou kendo ubiro chur nikech richou.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

kikuyu: bende ni itayo joma ofuwo, kendo ni in japuonj nyithindo nikech Chik ma in-go otingʼo ngʼeyo kod adiera.
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

kikuyu: Nimar kane ongima to ne ok odewo timo ngʼwono, kar timo kamano to nosando jodhier, kaachiel gi joma ochando gi joma chunygi lit; nosandogi malit nyaka ne githo.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano dhako ma nyinge Herodia nomako sadha gi Johana, kendo nodwaro mondo onege. To kata kamano ne ok onyal,
english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Juda gi jo-Israel bende noloko kodi. Gin ne giwilo kodi ngano moa Minith gi kal, gi mor kich, gi mo kod yedhe madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mane giwilo gi mwandugi mag ohala.
english: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

kikuyu: Ok abi timonu ngʼwono; bende ok abi weyou ma ok akumou. Abiro kumou kaluwore gi yoreu kod timbeu mamono manie dieru. Eka unungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye, ema akumou.
english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik iyie mondo gima ikawo ni ber, ji wuoye kaka gima rach.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

kikuyu: Emomiyo awachonu kawuono ni koro remb ngʼato ok ni e wiya,
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

kikuyu: Eka Satan notere Jerusalem kendo nomiyo ochungo e osuch hekalu malo mogik. Eka nowachone niya, “Ka in Wuod Nyasaye to chikri piny.
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

kikuyu: Atimo singruok kodi ni: Ok nachak atiek gik mangima kod pi bende ok nachak aketh piny kuom pi.”
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Dwoguru e pachu maliw, daguru ngima makare kendo weuru timo richo, nikech nitie jomoko kuomu makia Nyasaye. Awacho kamano mondo akuodgo wiu.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

kikuyu: Ne oketo ji alufu piero abiriyo (70,000) kuomgi mondo obed jotingʼo to ji alufu piero aboro (80,000) opa kite e gode kaachiel gi ji alufu adek gi mia auchiel (3,600) ma nyipechegi mondo omi ji oti.
english: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.

kikuyu: Wachni e taya mar tienda kendo en ler mamenyona yo.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mane Nyasaye ochweyo nobedo kayiem nono, ok nikech dwarogi, to nikech dwaro Ngʼat mane ochweyogi, ka en gi geno
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

kikuyu: negiketo cham e ngʼe pundegi kendo gidhi.
english: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

kikuyu: “In, Nyasacha isefwenyo ni jatichni ni ibiro gerona ot omiyo jatichni osebet gi chir mondo olami.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji madirom alufu adek ema nodhi, to jo-Ai noriembogi,
english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

kikuyu: Nimar isemiye loch ewi ji duto mondo omi ji duto misemiye oyud ngima mochwere.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

kikuyu: Chik iti, yaye Nyasaye, mondo iwinj kwayowa, kendo ineye kaka dala maduongʼ mochungʼ kar nyingi okethore. Ok waketni kwayogi nikech wan joma kare, to watimo kamano nikech kechni maduongʼ.
english: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

kikuyu: Negiterogi e nyim jongʼad bura, mi giwacho niya, “Jogi gin jo-Yahudi, to gisekelo koko e dalawa-ka,
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

kikuyu: Nodonjo ei ot mopenjogi niya, “Koko gi nduru ni manade? Nyathi ok otho, onindo aninda.”
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

kikuyu: Kane Ruoth owinjo wachni, noa Judea mochako odok Galili.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

kikuyu: Omiyo nokwake mi onyodhe, gi wangʼ matek, nowachone niya:
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

kikuyu: E kinde duto ma pinyu nodongʼ gunda kamano, enobed ma ok opure, ka oritogo Sabato duto mane ok oyweyoe e kinde mane udak kuno.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

kikuyu: Negidwoko kendo niya, “Ok unyal luwo kae.” Eka Edom nochodo mar kedo kodgi gi jolweny mangʼeny kendo mager.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

kikuyu: Donge dibed ni notimo kamano mondo omi mwandu mar duongʼne ongʼe gi jogo modwaro kecho mane osechano chon ne duongʼ,
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

kikuyu: To koro, kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye, an gima an, kendo ngʼwono mane omiya ne ok orem mak ochopo tichne. Chutho, asetiyo matek moloyo joote mamoko duto, to ok asetimo mago duto gi tekra awuon, to mana kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye ma an-go.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

kikuyu: Nimar agulu mar mogono ne ok odongʼ nono kendo puga mar mo-no ne ok otwo kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye mane Elija owacho.
english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

kikuyu: To mano penjo mofuwo manade! Ka uchwoyo kodhi, to nyaka okuong otho eka bangʼe otwi.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

kikuyu: En morna mondo anyisu kuom honni gi ranyisi miwuoro ma Nyasaye Mamalo Mogik osetimona.
english: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo gigi duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokonyore gi janabi ma ogolo Israel oa Misri, adier ne ooro janabi mondo orite.
english: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

kikuyu: To jogi gin joma oyaki kendo omaa, giduto gisenyumore ma gimoko e bugni, kendo opandgi e ute mag twech. Gisebedo gik moyaki maonge ngʼama nyalo resogi; bende gichalo gik moyaki maonge ngʼama nyalo wacho niya, “Dwokgi.”
english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

kikuyu: Ariok notero Daniel ir ruoth sano, kendo nowacho niya, “Aseyudo ngʼat moro moa e dhood Juda, manie twech e pinywa, manyalo nyiso ruoth tiend lekneno.”
english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

kikuyu: Azaria wuod Hilkia, wuod Meshulam, wuod Zadok, wuod Merayoth, wuod Ahitub mane jatelo morito Od Nyasaye;
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

kikuyu: Adwaro ni mondo ungʼe ni owadwa Timotheo osegony kendo ka ochopo piyo to wanabi kode mondo waneu.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

kikuyu: To ka wuon odno dwaro waro odeno, to nyaka omed achiel ewi abich mar nengone, eka odno noduogne.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

kikuyu: Joash ne ja-higni abiriyo kane odoko ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higni piero angʼwen kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Zibia mane nyar Bersheba.
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nochokore mobiro mojot e Shunem, ka Saulo bende nochoko jo-Israel duto modhi ojot Gilboa.
english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Satan niya, “Ia kanye?” Satan nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Asebedo ka abayo abaya e piny, kendo alworora koni gi koni.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Wan wafuwo nikech Kristo, to un to uriek ei Kristo! Wan wanyap, to un to uroteke! Un imiyou duongʼ, to wan to ochawa!
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ji ne riyo mar pi oloyo kanyo, kendo ji nongʼur ni Musa. Negiwachone niya, “En angʼo momiyo nigolowa Misri mondo nyithindwa kaachiel gi jambwa otho?”
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

kikuyu: Saulo nooro ji mondo orit od Daudi kendo mondo onege gokinyi. To Mikal ma chi Daudi nosieme niya, “Ka ok iringo mi ikonyo ngimani otienoni to kiny nonegi.”
english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat makonyo jakuo mondo okwal ema bedo jasike owuon; nikech osekwongʼore kendo ok onyal bedo janeno.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

kikuyu: Kuom mano kik ungʼad bura kapok kinde ochopo, to rituru biro mar Ruoth. En owuon noel e lela gik masani opondo e mudho, kendo enonyis paro duto mopondo e chuny dhano. E kindeno ema ngʼato ka ngʼato noyud pak moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

kikuyu: Chik otweyo dhako gi chwore ndalo duto ma chwore ngima. To ka chwore otho, to en thuolo mondo onywome gi dichwo moro amora mohero, makmana ni nyaka nyuome gi ngʼat kuom Ruoth.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

kikuyu: Lingʼuru thi un joma odak e chula, kendo un jo-ohala madongo man Sidon, un ma jokwangʼ ji osemiyo umewo.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

kikuyu: Riw bepe ariyogo obed bao achiel mondo gibed gimoro achiel e lweti.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni jadolo odhi mondo onon odno mi oyudo ni gima rach makelo purno ok oselandore bangʼ kane osemwone, to jadolo nongʼad wach ni odno ler nikech gima rach makelo purno oserumo.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

kikuyu: Ibiro modho pi mowuok e soko kendo asechiko winyo mag agak mondo omiyi chiemo kanyo.”
english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

kikuyu: kendo ne ok oyiene ngʼato mondo otingʼ misigo mar ohala moro amora kakalogo e dier agola mar hekalu.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

kikuyu: “Wadhiuru kare modakie; wadhiuru mondo walame e nyim kom duongʼne, ka wawacho niya,
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, “ ‘Abiro ketho nyiseche ma dhano oloso kendo abiro tieko kido molosi man Memfis. Onge ruoth ma nobed gi loch e piny Misri, kendo abiro miyo luoro landre e pinyno duto.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Koro ne, gik machon osetimore bende anyisou gik manyien mabiro timore, to kapok gitimore to ahulonugi.”
english: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Naftali ne gin: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer kod Shilem ma joka Bilha.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kikuyu: To kaka ne amedo luongo Israel e kaka nomedo dhi mabor koda. Negichiwo misengini ne Baal kendo wangʼo ubani ne kido molosi.
english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

kikuyu: Negichako tich pwodho hekalu chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo to chiengʼ mar aboro mar dweno negichopo e agola mar Jehova Nyasaye. To kuom ndalo aboro mamoko ne gipwodho hekaluno mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne gitieke chiengʼ mar apar gauchiel mar dweno.
english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the LORD’s porch. They sanctified the LORD’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ne waikore mi wadhi nyaka Jerusalem.
english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Juda nodoko kama ler mar lemo mar Nyasaye, kendo Israel nobedo mwandune owuon.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

kikuyu: yaye Jehova Nyasaye. Nikech wach misewacho kendo koluwore gi dwaroni, isetimo tim maduongʼni bende isemiyo singruok madongogi ongʼere.
english: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

kikuyu: Makmana Joshua nosiemo ji niya, “Kik uywag ywak mar lweny, kik utingʼ dwondu malo, bende kik uwach wach moro amora nyaka odiechiengʼ ma anakonue mondo ugo koko. Bangʼe eka unukogi!”
english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

kikuyu: Ne en gi yawuowi abiriyo gi nyiri adek
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Nimar biro mar Wuod Dhano nobed machalo ka mil polo ma piatore e kor polo koa konchiel nyaka komachielo.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

kikuyu: To ne, Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu osemiyou piny. Dhiuru mondo ukawe mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu nowacho niya. Kik ubed maluor, chunyu bende kik nyosre.”
english: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

kikuyu: Achien bangʼe madirom sa achiel, ngʼat machielo nojiwo kowacho matek niya, “Adier chutho jali ne ni kode, nimar en ja-Galili.”
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

kikuyu: Koroni, yaye Ruoth, inyalo biro sa moro amora midwaro biroe, to obiro bedo wachwa mondo wachiwe ne ruoth.”
english: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”

kikuyu: Kane osetieko pimo gik moko mantie ei hekalu, notelona kotera oko gi yo rangach man yo wuok chiengʼ kendo nopimo alworane duto:
english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

kikuyu: Reaya wuod Shobal nonywolo Jahath, to Jahath nonywolo Ahumai kod Lahad. Magi ema ne anywola mar jo-Zorath.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

kikuyu: Omiyo aselor mondo aresgi e lwet jo-Misri kendo agolgi e pinyno mondo akelgi e piny maber kendo malach, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich. En piny jo-Kanaan gi jo-Hiti gi jo-Amor gi jo-Perizi gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus.
english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Nowachone Daudi niya, “An guok mibirona kitongʼona kete?” Ja-Filistia nokwongʼo Daudi gi nying nyisechene.
english: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.

kikuyu: nikech singruok ma kamano nigi teko mana ka ngʼatno osetho, to ok kapod ongima.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

kikuyu: Eka ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi e chandruokgino mi noresogi e pekgino.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Omiyo Babulon noyaki; jogo moyake nokaw gik moromogi.
english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: ka uguroru motegno kendo ugeroru kuome, kumedo bedo motegno e yie kaka nopuonju, kendo kupongʼ gigoyo erokamano.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Ngʼe malongʼo ni nyikwayi nobed jodak e piny moro ma ok margi, kendo nolokgi wasumbini mi nosandgi malit kuom higni mia angʼwen.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

kikuyu: Jaod Makir ma Maaka ne onywolo wuowi mochake Peresh. Owadgi ne iluongo ni Sheresh, to yawuote ne Ulam kod Rakem.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw okapuno e lweti mi okete piny e nyim kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi.
english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.

kikuyu: Chiege nokone niya, “Pod kitini itwerigo atweya kuom Nyasachini? Angʼo mamoni kwongʼo Nyasaye mondo itho!”
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

kikuyu: Gikanyono wuon wuowino noywagore kawacho niya, “An gi yie, to konya nikech yiena orem.”
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

kikuyu: Eka noriere kuom wuowino nyadidek moywak ni Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha yie ngima wuowini oduogne!”
english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gilor gia ewi got, Yesu nosiemogi ni kik giwachne ngʼato angʼata gima ne giseneno nyaka chop kinde ma Wuod Dhano nochier koa kuom joma otho.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: Abiro timo gima isekwayo. Abiro miyi chuny mar rieko kod mar ngʼeyo mondo kik bedie ngʼama chalo kodi kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

kikuyu: Joga mosebedo ka manya nokwa jambgi Sharon kendo Holo mar Akor nobed lek mar dhog-gi.
english: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

kikuyu: Joab gi Abishai owadgi nonego Abner nikech nosenego Asahel mowadgi e lweny mane oked Gibeon.
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

kikuyu: Gi tonge owuon isechwoyo wiye, kane jolwenje omonjowa mondo gikewa, ka gin gi ilo ka gima gichiegni tieko joma onge gi nyalo kama ne giponde.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

kikuyu: Kata kamano an bende an gi paro machal gi ma un-go; kik upar ni afuwo. Uparo ni en ngʼa ma ok ongʼeyo weche ma uwachogi?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

kikuyu: kod sand gi chandruok mara. Ingʼeyo gik moko duto mane otimorena Antiokia gi Ikonio kod Lustra, kendo ingʼeyo kaka ne adhil e sand mager! To Ruoth noresa kuom sandgo duto.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni asebedo mamor ka jasika ni e chandruok kata ka asenyiere ka masira obirone,
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

kikuyu: Tingʼuru bedeu malo e kare maler mar lemo kendo upak Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Rahab dhako ma jachode ne ok nonegi kane inego joma ok winj wach Nyasaye, nikech norwako jombetre mag Israel gi ngʼwono.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, paro moket kuom ringruok mon gi Nyasaye. Ok oyie bet e bwo loch mar chik Nyasaye, kendo ok onyal timo kamano.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

kikuyu: Kane Petro wuotho ei piny koni gi koni, nodhi limo jomaler mane odak Lida.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

kikuyu: Joma nomako Yesu nokawe motere nyaka ir Kaifas jadolo maduongʼ, kuma jopuonj chik kod jodongo noyudo osechokoree.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

kikuyu: Omiyo nokel Daniel e nyim ruoth, kendo ruoth nopenje niya, In e Daniel ma achiel kuom joma otwe mane wuora ma ruoth okelo koa e piny Juda?
english: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

kikuyu: Kendo Solomon noloso gik mitiyogo manie ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye: Kendo mar misango mar dhahabu; mesa mar dhahabu nikete makati e nyim Ruoth;
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in the LORD’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

kikuyu: Kane owach ne Tamar ni kwar mare owuok dhi Timna ngʼado yie rombe,
english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

kikuyu: Kane omigi chiemo koa e mesa mar Josef, chiemb Benjamin ne ngʼeny moloyo mar ngʼato angʼata nyadibich. Kuom mano negichiemo kendo gimetho ka gin thuolo kode.
english: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

kikuyu: Bende ineno ngʼat molony e tije? Obiro tiyo ne ruodhi, ok onyal tiyo ne ji ma ok ongʼere.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, giko nochopi, mi Kristo nolo joloch duto, nolo teko duto kendo nolo nyalo duto, eka nodwok pinyruoth ni Nyasaye Wuoro,
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

kikuyu: E ndalogo, Kaisar Agusto nogolo chik mondo okwan ji e piny Rumi duto.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

kikuyu: Pilato nopenjogi niya, “Nangʼo? En ketho mane mosetimo madimi gure?” To negimedo kok matek moloyo kagiwacho niya, “Gure!”
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye osekawo kweth mag jamni mag wuonu kendo osemiyagi.
english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

kikuyu: Abiro dwogogi ka agologi e dier pinje mi akelgi e lopgi giwegi. Abiro kwayogi ewi gode mag Israel, kendo e holni gi pewe duto manie pinygi.
english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

kikuyu: Ludhegi ne boyo ahinya kochakore e Sandug Muma ma gikogi ne inyalo ne koa e nyim kama ler mar lemo, to ne ok ginen gi oko mar Kama Ler kendo pod gin kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

kikuyu: Osetieko teko mar jo-Israel gi mirimbe mager, kendo osejwangʼogi e lwet wasikgi. Osewengʼo ka Jakobo kaka mach mager makakni ma wangʼo gik moko duto molwore.
english: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik uluw bangʼ nyiseche manono, kendo kik ubed gi nyiseche mothedhi mag nyinyo. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo maduongʼ nochungʼ malo e nyimgi mopenjo Yesu niya, “Dak idwok wachno? Ma wach manade ma jogi wacho kuomini?”
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Mi Jakobo nowinjo wach min gi wuon modhi Padan Aram.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

kikuyu: orito chokene duto, ma kata achiel kuomgi ok notur.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

kikuyu: Kane osea kanyo noyudo Jehonadab wuod Rekab, mane dhi romone. Jehu nomose mopenje niya, “Bende in koda e winjruok kaka an kodini?” Jehonadab nodwoke niya, Ee an kodi. Jehu nowachone niya, “Ka en kamano, to miya lweti.” Omiyo notimo kamano kendo nomako lwete moidho gach lweny.
english: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Zatu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Matania, Jeremoth, Zabad gi Aziza.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

kikuyu: Eka Hana nolemo kawacho niya, “Chunya oil gi Jehova Nyasaye; Jehova Nyasaye osetingʼa malo ma tekona onenore. Gi dhoga asungora ne wasika, nikech amor gi warruokni.
english: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.

kikuyu: Mirimbi duto ne iketo tenge, kendo ne ilokori iweyo mirimbi mager.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

kikuyu: Nomau jotiju machwo gi ma nyiri, kaachiel gi jambu mabeyo moloyo, kod pundeu nokawgi mondo giti tijene owuon.
english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Rahab nosekawo ji ariyogi kendo opandogi. Nowacho niya, “En adier, ni jogi nobiro ira, to ne ok angʼeyo ni gia kanye.
english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

kikuyu: Luoro maduongʼ nomako kanisa, kod ji duto mane owinjo gik mane otimore.
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Pith gi mwandu yudore e ode, kendo timne makare osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moluoro chikne ok noyud hinyruok moro amora, to chuny man-gi rieko biro ngʼeyo sa mowinjore mar timo gimoro kod chenro miluwo.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

kikuyu: Ne oloko nam lo motwo, mine gikalo pige ka giwuotho gi tiendegi, Biuru mondo wabed moil kuome.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kikuyu: Ahaz ne ja-higni piero ariyo kane obedo ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni apar gauchiel. To timbene ne ok longʼo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kaka timbe Daudi kwar mare ne chalo.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.

kikuyu: Ma e chik moketi ne ngʼama onego wadgi kobothne kendo ok ongʼeyo mi oringo odhi kanyo mondo ores ngimane.
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

kikuyu: Nyithindgi dongo motegno kendo mopugno ka gin e thim; kendo giwuok to ok giduogi.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

kikuyu: “Eka nonyisa niya: ‘Ondiek mar angʼwen en pinyruoth mar angʼwen mabiro bet e piny. Obiro pogore gi pinjeruodhi duto, kendo obiro mako piny duto, monyone kendo otieke chuth.
english: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces.

kikuyu: Bende joma nokiewo kodgi koa ka joka Isakar, joka Zebulun nyaka ka jo-Naftali nobiro kotingʼo chiemo e punde, ngamia, pundane kod rwedhi. Negikelo gik moko mangʼeny machalo mogo, olembe mag ngʼowu gi mag mzabibu motwo mongʼin gi divai, gi mo, dhok kaachiel gi rombe nikech ne nitiere mor e Israel.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

kikuyu: “Kudho nowachone yiende ni, ‘Ka adiera udwaro keta ruoth, to biuru kendo upond e tipona; ka ok kamano, to we mach owuog oa e kudho kendo owangʼ sida mag Lebanon!’
english: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

kikuyu: Filipo nowachone niya, “Ruoth, nyiswa Wuoro mondo kik wachak wachandi kendo.”
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

kikuyu: Eka jatend jogam divai nowacho ne Farao niya, “Aparo kethona kawuono.
english: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

kikuyu: To ka dhako ma chwore otho moro nigi nyithindo kata nyikwayo to ber mondo gitingʼ nying Nyasaye malo kuom rito joodgi ka gikonyo jonywolgi gi kweregi kod deyegi, nikech timo kamano longʼo ni Nyasaye.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Eka Elon notho, kendo noyike Aijalon mantiere e piny Zebulun.
english: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

kikuyu: “Omiyo achikou e nyim Israel duto kendo e nyim chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka Nyasachwa wacho kama: Beduru motangʼ mondo ulu chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mondo omi piny maberni osik maru kendo uchiwe kaka girkeni ne nyikwau nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

kikuyu: Negiwacho e chunygi niya, “Wabiro tiekogi chuth!” Ne giwangʼo kuonde duto e piny mane ilame Nyasaye.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

kikuyu: Lier pasiano gi ramaki kendo ket Sandug Rapar e tok pasiano. Pasiano biro pogo Kama Ler gi Kama Ler Moloyo.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

kikuyu: Magi duto ne gin jotend anywola kendo ruodhi kaka ondikgi e nonro mar anywola kendo negidak Jerusalem.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Uparo nade kuom Kristo? En Wuod ngʼa?” Negidwoke niya, “En Wuod Daudi.”
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

kikuyu: Joshua nokedo gi ruodhigi duto kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

kikuyu: Ndalone duto ochiemo e mudho, ka en gi chandruok malich, rem kod mirima.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

kikuyu: to we michnino piny kanyo e nyim kendo mar misango. Kuong idhi ilos kindi gi nyawadu; eka ibi ichiw michni.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

kikuyu: Chako wuodhgi mokwongo notimore bangʼ ka Jehova Nyasaye nosegolo chik kokalo kuom Musa.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Jatend lweny nowachonegi niya, “Wachneuru Hezekia kama: “ ‘Ma e gima ruoth maduongʼ, ma ruodh Asuria wacho: En kama nade miketoe genoni momiyo in-gi chir kama?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

kikuyu: Yor joma kare opie, yaye in Jal makare, iloso yor joma kare bedo maber.
english: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

kikuyu: Mirimb ruoth chalo gi ruto mar sibuor; ngʼat momiyo obedo gi gero lalo ngimane.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

kikuyu: Ka useketo tenge achiel kuom apar mag gik moko duto monyak e higa mar adek, ma en higa michiwoe achiel kuom apar mag gik monyak, to nyaka uchiw gigo ne jo-Lawi, gi jopinje mamoko modak e dieru kaachiel gi nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho mondo gibed gi chiemo moromogi.
english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

kikuyu: Kane awinjo ywakgi kod weche mane odonjnigigo, iya nowangʼ ahinya.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

kikuyu: Kuno ema meli kwangʼie koni gi koni, kendo ondieg nam mane ichweyo miluongo ni Leviathan tuge.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

kikuyu: Nimar enobed ngʼat maduongʼ e nyim Ruoth. Ok nomadh kongʼo kata gimoro amora makech, to enopongʼ gi Roho Maler chakre nywolne.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Maua achiel nobedi e bwo bede ariyo mokwongo mar rachungino, mar ariyo nobed e bwo mar ariyo, to mar adek nobed e bwo bede mar adek, giduto gin bede auchiel.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodhi e mier kod gwenge kopuonjo ji ka odhiyo Jerusalem.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Negiloso rachung taya gi dhahabu maler kendo ne othedh tiende gi kore gi kikombege machalo maua gi thiepege kod obokege kaka gimoro achiel.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ee, An. To unune Wuod Dhano kobet e bat korachwich mar Jal Maratego kendo kolor oa e boche polo.”
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Eka Ezra ma jadolo noa malo kendo owachonegi niya, “Usebedo joma ok nikare; usekendo mond dhoudi mamoko, mumedo ketho mar jo-Israel.
english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

kikuyu: Koso awuoyo awuoya ka dhano? Donge Chik bende jiwo wachni?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

kikuyu: makmana misengini mamoko mag cham moruw gi mo kata ma ok oruw, ema nopog maromre ne yawuot Harun duto.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi ji nogero kendo mar misango ma gichiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok.
english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

kikuyu: “Donge ma e kit tweyo chiemo ma aseyiero: ni ugony tonde mag timbe maricho gi mag jok, mondo uwe joma otwe obed thuolo kendo utur jok duto?
english: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

kikuyu: Kane odongʼ ndalo ariyo mondo Sap Pasaka kod Sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi ochopi, jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik ne manyo yo moro malingʼ-lingʼ mane ginyalo makogo Yesu mondo ginege.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

kikuyu: “To e sa ma ne achako wuoyo, ema Roho Maler nolor kuomgi, mana kaka wan bende noselor kuomwa mokwongo.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

kikuyu: Ngʼama mon gi owadgi en janek, to ungʼeyo ni janek onge gi ngima mochwere.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

kikuyu: Chunya biro romo mana ka ngʼama oromo gi chiemo mabeyo mogik; abiro yawo dwonda ka apaki gi wer.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

kikuyu: chikni ne omiyo jo-Lawi mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ, kendo chunguru motegno e yie maru, bende beduru jochir kendo motegno.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, piny noyiengni, kendo polo nogingore, mi koth ochwe kane iwuok Seir e piny Edom.
english: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.

kikuyu: minu wiye nokuodi malich; ngʼatno mane onywolou nobed gi wichkuot maduongʼ. En ema nobedie ngʼat matin kuom ogendini, nochal thim, piny motimo ongoro, kama otwo.
english: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni sungane chopo nyaka e polo kendo wiye mulo boche polo,
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

kikuyu: Abiro jiwo bede ruodh Babulon kendo abiro keto liganglana e lwete, to abiro turo bede Farao, kendo obiro chur e nyime ka ngʼat mohinyore marach machiegni tho.
english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.

kikuyu: Yor ngʼat ma jaketho ogondore, to kit ngʼat makare oriere tir.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

kikuyu: To ngʼat molocho kendo timo dwarona nyaka giko, abiro miyo loch kuom ogendini.
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

kikuyu: Chiayo mar apar mokadho e bwo ludh jakwath e kinde ma okwanogi, nobed mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye, bedni gin dhok kata rombe.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Paulo noluongo achiel kuom jotend jolweny, mowachone niya, “Kaw wuowino idhigo nyaka ir jatend jolweny maduongʼ nimar en-gi wach moro monego owachne.”
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

kikuyu: Anamuk udi mudakie e ndalo mag chwiri kaachiel gi mago mudakie ndalo mag oro; udi ma ukedo igi gi lak liech biro dongʼ gundni kendo uteu madongo duto abiro ketho,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Gikoronu miriambo ma biro miyo idarou mabor gi pinyu; anariembu kendo unutho.
english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.

kikuyu: Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jo-Israel, nikech Jehova Nyasaye nigi wach modonjonugo, un ji modak e piny: “Onge adiera, onge hera, bende udagi yie ni Nyasaye nitie e piny.
english: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

kikuyu: Boche mag polo mane otelonegi godiechiengʼ kata ligek mach mane otelonegi gotieno ne ok owuok kama ne entiere e nyim ogandano.
english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ka gima achamo nyalo miyo wadwa donjo e richo, to abiro weyo chamo ringʼo chuth mondo kik ami opodhi.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: Adier, oneno joma wuondore; kendo koneno richo, to donge ondiko piny?
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

kikuyu: Joma ngʼadona bura to adwoko kama.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

kikuyu: Abiro chungʼ e nyimi e bath lwanda mantie Horeb. Chwad lwanda to pi nowuog kuome mi oganda nomodhi.” Kuom Mano Musa notimo kamano e nyim jodong jo-Israel duto.
english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho, Ma en Jerusalem ma aseketo e dier ogendini, ka pinje duto olwore.
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

kikuyu: Neuru ni onge ngʼama chulo rach kuom rach motimne, to temuru mondo kinde duto utim maber ne joweteu kendo ne ji mamoko bende.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

kikuyu: Bende ruodh Babulon notero e twech jolweny duto madirom ji alufu abiriyo, kaachiel gi joma olony kuom tich lwedo kod jogoro alufu achiel; giduto ne gin roteke moromo kedo.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

kikuyu: To erokamano ni Nyasaye nikech kata obedo ni yande ne un wasumbini mag richo, to ne umako kit puonj mane omiu gi chunyu duto.
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

kikuyu: en piny ma otimo mudho mandiwa, kama kata ler chaloe mudho.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

kikuyu: Wuowi mar ariyo nochako ni Efraim kendo nowacho niya, “Ma en nikech Nyasaye osemiyo anya e piny mar chandruokna.”
english: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye omiyi rieko kod ngʼeyo e kinde moketi mondo irit jo-Israel kendo mondo mi irit chik Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi.
english: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye chiwo rieko kendo ngʼeyo gi winjo aa e dhoge.
english: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ingʼado tiend ngʼato kata kelo masira, chalo gioro ngʼama ofuwo mondo oter ote.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Balaam mopenje niya, “Magi ngʼa gini man kodigi?”
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

kikuyu: Kuom yawuowi duto mane onywolo onge moro amora mane nyalo taye kata mane nyalo telone komako lwete.
english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar adek kasenywolo nyathina, dhakoni bende noyudo nyathi. To ne onge ngʼato moro amora e ot makmana wan kendwa.
english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

kikuyu: Ne oneno kaonge ngʼato kata achiel, kendo nobwok ni onge kata ngʼato madikony; omiyo bade owuon nokelone en owuon warruok kendo timne makare ema norite.
english: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo rem mara ok rum kendo adhonda lich ma ok nyal thiedhore? Bende inyalo bedona ka aora modwono, mana ka soko motwo?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?

kikuyu: Ruodhi abich mag jo-Filistia noneno gik manotimore duto mine gidok odiechiengno nyaka Ekron.
english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

kikuyu: Omake itere ne ruoth gi law mochwe gi usi; nyiri masilili man kode luwo bangʼe kendo ikelonegi.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

kikuyu: Ka adhi e pinyno, aneno jogo monegi gi ligangla; ka adhi e dala maduongʼ, to aneno masiche ma kech okelo. Janabi kaachiel gi jadolo osedhi e piny ma ok gingʼeyo.’ ”
english: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”

kikuyu: Nimar ka idak kaka kido mar richo dwaro, to ibiro tho; to ka kuom Roho, inego timbe maricho mag ringruok, to ibiro bedo mangima.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

kikuyu: To ere ohand bedo ja-Yahudi kata ber tero nyangu?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

kikuyu: Rael nomako ich kendo nonywolo wuowi kendo nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osegolona wichkuot.”
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa bangʼ tho yawuot Harun ariyo ka gibiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Jaricho to onge gi kwe.”
english: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe anachop singo mane asingone kwereu, mar miyogi piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich’ ma en piny mauntiere kawuono.” Ne adwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Amin.”
english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, LORD.”

kikuyu: Nikech kamano e kaka mon maler machon mane oketo genogi kuom Nyasaye ne loso bergi maiye. Ne giwinjo wach chwogi,
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

kikuyu: Otieno chiegni rumo kendo ru piny chiegni. Omiyo waweuru timbe mag mudho, to wamanreuru gi gige lweny mag ler.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Un joneno maga ma wuoyo kuoma” kendo jotichna ma aseyiero, mondo mi ungʼe kendo uyie kuoma kendo ubed gingʼeyo ni An e Nyasaye. Onge Nyasaye moro ma nobetie kapok abet bende onge nyasaye moro manobi bangʼe.
english: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

kikuyu: kendo kogeno ni pachgi nyalo yawore mi gitony gia e obadho mar Satan moseketogi e twech mar timo dwarone.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin alufu achiel ne ni kode, kaachiel Ziba, ma jatend jorit mwandu mar od Saulo, to gi yawuote apar gabich kod jotije piero ariyo. Negireto ka gidhi Jordan, kuma ruoth ne nitie.
english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

kikuyu: “Ne uoro joote ne Johana kendo osetimo neno kuom adiera.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

kikuyu: Bed kingʼeyo ni wechena ok gin miriambo; ngʼeni ngʼama ongʼeyo gik moko malongʼo chuth ema ni kodi.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

kikuyu: Ginyalo mana tiyona e kara maler mar lemo ka girito dhorangeye mag hekalu kendo ka gikonyo tije moko e iye; ginyalo yangʼo jamni mitimogo misengini miwangʼo pep kendo ginyalo chiwo misengini ni ji ka gichungʼ e nyimgi kendo gitiyonegi.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

kikuyu: Ka otimoni richo nyadibiriyo odiechiengʼ achiel to obiro iri nyadibiriyo kendo owacho ni, ‘Alokora aweyo richo,’ to nyaka iwene.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

kikuyu: Gima agombo maduongʼ, owadwa, en ni mondo iyie itimna ngʼwono kuom Ruoth, kidwogo chunya kuom Kristo.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, un e joma ibiro kuongo daro kitero e twech, kendo mano ema biro bedo giko mar dhialruoku.”
english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.

kikuyu: En ngʼa makwere e wangʼe koketho? Koso ngʼa machule kuom gima osetimo?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

kikuyu: Farao nyaka ket jotend gwenge e piny Misri duto mondo ochoki achiel kuom abich mag chamb Misri kuom higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo.
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Chiengʼno anatiek nying nyiseche ma dhano oloso e piny, kendo ji ok nochak opargi. Anagol jonabi kaachiel gi chunje ma gombo timo timbe maricho e piny.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

kikuyu: Waserito gik moko duto mane kwarwa Jehonadab wuod Rekab ochikowa. Wan kod mondewa kata yawuotwa gi nyiwa pod ok omadho divai,
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

kikuyu: kaachiel gi nyaminwa Afia gi Arkipo jalweny wadwa, kod kanisa malemo e odi:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

kikuyu: Joma odak machiegni kod joma odak mabor kodi biro jari, yaye in dala maduongʼ ma humbe rach, kendo mopongʼ gi koko.
english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko Nyasaye niya, “Ka dipo ni adhi ir jo-Israel mi awachonegi ni, ‘Nyasach kwereu oseora iru,’ mi gipenja ni, ‘Nyinge en ngʼa?’ Koro to ananyisgi nangʼo?”
english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”

kikuyu: Maritha nodwoke niya, “Angʼeyo ni obiro chier kendo e ndalo chier, ma en chiengʼ giko piny.”
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokawo mor pwodhruok kod remo mane nitiere e kendo mar misango mi okiro kuom Harun gi yawuote kod lepgi mag dolo. Omiyo nopwodho Harun gi yawuote kod lepgi mag dolo.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moyie kuoma pi ngima nobubni koa kuome, mana kaka Ndiko owacho.”
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

kikuyu: Noorgi ni joma ne ni Bethel, Ramoth Negev gi Jatir,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

kikuyu: Ne adhi nikech fweny mane ayudo, ka aketonegi ler kuom Injili mane ayalo ni joma ok jo-Yahudi. To ne atimo mano lingʼ-lingʼ ni jogo mane chalo jotelo, nimar ne aluor ni dipo ka tija mar lando Injili obet kayiem nono.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nochiwo misango gi dhok alufu piero ariyo gi ariyo kod rombe gi diek maromo alufu mia achiel gi piero ariyo. Kamano ruoth kod ji duto nowalo hekalu mar Nyasaye.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Isebedo kigeno kuom otangloni, mane ok irito kata ne ok imiyo dongo, ne owuok mi odongo otieno achiel, kendo otho otieno machielo.
english: The LORD said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni e kindego, choke mag ruodhi kod jotelo mag Juda, choke mag jodolo kod jonabi, kendo choke mag jo-Jerusalem nogol oko e liete mag-gi.
english: “At that time,” says the LORD, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼato mongʼeyo odiechiengno kata sa, obed malaike manie polo kata Wuowi, makmana Wuoro kende.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Israel onenogi nopenjo Elisha niya, Wuora, anyalo negogi?
english: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

kikuyu: To e kuom lopno, ema unupim kendo uket tenge kama borne romo fut alufu piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich, to lachne romo fut alufu apar gabich. Iye kanyo ema kama ler mar lemo nobedie, ma en Kama Ler Moloyo.
english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero ni en owuon ruoth ni jo-Israel mabiro tieko dhood joka Jeroboam. Ma e odiechiengʼ! Angʼo? Ee, kata mana sani.
english: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

kikuyu: Kane giwuok e Got Hor negibuoro Zalmona.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

kikuyu: Nomedo wuoyo kowacho niya, “Gima wuok koa ei ngʼato ema miyo odoko mogak.
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

kikuyu: “To koro, Ayub winj wechena; chik iti maber ne gik ma awacho duto.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

kikuyu: En dwaro mar Roho Maler kod marwa bende mondo kik wamiu tingʼ mapek moloyo chike mwamiyou e baruwani.
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach joka Jakobo osekwongʼore ni wiye ok nowil gi timbegi maricho.
english: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.

kikuyu: Nimar an jatichni angʼeyo nine atimo richo, to koro asebiro kaka ngʼat mokwongo moa e dhood Josef mosebiro mwalo ka mondo aromni ruodha ma en ruoth?”
english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo owinjore gi pak; onego omiye luor moloyo nyiseche mamoko duto.
english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gichiemo, Yesu nokawo makati kendo bangʼ goyo erokamano, nongʼinge momiyo jopuonjrene, kowacho niya, “Kawuru, chamuru; ma en ringra.”
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

kikuyu: Kane osemake, nokete e od twech, kendo noketo migepe angʼwen mag askeche, ma moro ka moro otingʼo jorit angʼwen, mondo orite. Herode ne chano mondo ogole oko bangʼ Pasaka mondo oyale e nyim oganda.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

kikuyu: Kotimona kamano eka chunya noyud hoch, anabed gi kwe, kata obedo ni an gi rem malit; nikech ok asedagi weche mag Ngʼama Ler.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

kikuyu: Ka usomo barupano to ubiro medo ngʼeyo kaka winjona chal korka weche mopondo mag Kristo.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

kikuyu: Eka ne angʼiyo mi aneno ka hekalu mar Hemb Rapar oyawore e polo.
english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma ok onenore e thuolo mar ndalo adek biro lalo gige duto, kaluwore gi gima jotelo kod jodongo ongʼado, kendo enodire oko mar chokruok mar joma noa e twech.
english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

kikuyu: Notimo richo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye koluwo timbe mamono mag ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye oseriembo e dier jo-Israel.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Unyalo chamo kit le moro amora gi jamni ma ombongʼ tiendegi opogore ariyo kendo manyamo kambula.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nodwoke niya, “Gero hekaluni osekawo higni piero angʼwen gauchiel, to in to ere kaka inyalo gere gi ndalo adek?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

kikuyu: Noluongo jatije mowachone ni, Gol dhakoni oko ka kendo ilor dhoot matek bangʼe.
english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

kikuyu: To pod abiro dak Efeso-ka nyaka chiengʼ Pentekost,
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

kikuyu: kod pasia mag laru gi sirnine kod rachungigi kod pasia moumo kar donjo mar laru,
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

kikuyu: E nyim Nyasaye achal achala kodi nikech an bende nochweya mana gi lowo.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

kikuyu: Kane ruodhi duto mane ni e bwo loch Hadadezer oneno ni jo-Israel oseloyogi, negiloso kwe e kindgi gi jo-Israel mi gibedo e bwo lochgi. Omiyo jo-Aram nobedo maluor mar konyo jo-Amon kendo.
english: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ilworori mangʼeny kiloko yoreni? Ibiro kuod wiyi gi Misri kaka nokuod wiyi gi Asuria.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

kikuyu: Ibrahim noyie gi dwaro mar Efron kendo nomiye nengo mar puodho mane osewacho ka jo-Hiti winjo: ma en kilo angʼwen gi nus mar fedha kaluwore gi rapim mane jo-ohala tiyogo.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

kikuyu: Noyudo Herode osemako Johana mi otweye nikech wach Herodia ma chi owadgi ma nyinge Filipo,
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

kikuyu: Los ratege ariyo mag dhahabu ne kendono mar misangono e bwo ndiri ka gimanyore ariyo koni gi koni mondo omak ludhe mitingʼego.
english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

kikuyu: Koa kum nyikwa Juda: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: To Amazia notimo chir kendo nowuok motelone jolweny mage kagidhi e Holo mar Chumbi kama nonege jo-Seir alufu apar.
english: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

kikuyu: To bangʼe negiloko pachgi mi gikawo kendo wasumbinigi mane giseweyo thuolo mi giketogi gibedo wasumbini kendo.
english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

kikuyu: to kik uwe ringre dongʼ koliero ma piny ru. Une ni uike mana chiengʼno nikech ngʼato angʼata ma olier e yath en ngʼama Nyasaye okwongʼo. Kik udwany piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni.
english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

kikuyu: mondo ogol oko ogendini maroteke moloyou, kokelou e pinygi mondo omiu bedo girkeni kaka en kawuononi.
english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

kikuyu: Koro ka giyiengore e mbuyi, to mbuyi dikonygi adier, ma ok oyiech? Koso ka gimako usi, to usi diresgi ma ok ochot.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

kikuyu: “ ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni obiro tho e piny Babulon, ma piny mar ruoth mane okete e loch, mosechayo singruok mane otimo kode, kendo moseketho winjruok mane otimne.
english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo auchiel chamuru makati ma ok oketie thowi kendo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo beduru gi chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo kik uti tich moro amora chiengʼno.
english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

kikuyu: nikech chiengʼ ne ok rieny. To pasia mar hekalu noyiech e diere tir.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno man-gi rieko neno kuma odhiye, to ngʼama ofuwo to wuotho e mudho, to kata kamano ne afwenyo ni gimoro achiel ema timore ni ji ariyogi.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

kikuyu: Mirimbi mager oseywaya; thagruok mimiya osetieka.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

kikuyu: Le ka le madichwo kod madhako maler kod mochido, michamo kod ma ok cham, kaachiel gi winy kod gik mamol ariyo ariyo,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

kikuyu: Negiloso ludhego gi yiend siala kendo ne gibawogi gi dhahabu.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Jeshua gi yawuote kod owetene gi Kadmiel kod yawuote (ma nyikwa Hodavia) kod yawuot Henadad gi yawuote kod owetene, ma gin jo-Lawi duto, noriwore kanyakla ka gingʼiyo jogo matiyo e od Nyasaye.
english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

kikuyu: Yaye wuoda, yaye wuoda mane anywolo! Winja, in wuoda mane anywolo bangʼ ka Nyasaye osewinjo lemo mane atimonego singruok.
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

kikuyu: Esau nokendo nyi Kanaan: Ada nyar Elon ja-Hiti, kod Oholibama nyar Ana ma nyakwar Zibeon ja-Hivi,
english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

kikuyu: Mana kaka bor polo rumo mi lal nono, e kaka ngʼat miyiko e liel ok duogi.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

kikuyu: To ji duto nolingʼ thi maonge ngʼama dwoko nimar ruoth Hezekia nosegolo chik niya, “Kik udwoke.”
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

kikuyu: Bende nyaka uchiw chiwo mag cham kaachiel kode okinyi kokinyi, maromo achiel ewi auchiel mar debe kod mo maromo achiel kuom adek mar okebe, mar dwalo mogo. Chik mar chiwo mar chamni ne Jehova Nyasaye en chik mochwere.
english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.

kikuyu: Eka ne wachako wuoth kwangʼado thim kwachomo Nam Makwar mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochika. Kuom kinde mangʼeny ne wadigni e piny gode mag Seir.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

kikuyu: nimar dhiyo e lweny dwaro ni ongʼadni rieko, to bedo gi loch dwaro jongʼad rieko mangʼeny.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

kikuyu: Kamano, Saulo gi yawuote adek kod joode duto notho kaachiel.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

kikuyu: Nikech jomaler mar Nyasaye oserienynegi mi obilo mich mar polo kendo obedo e lalruok achiel gi Roho Maler;
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Mana kaka dhako man-gi ich machiegni nywol muoch kayo kendo ywak kawinjo rem mano, bende e kaka wanie nyimi yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.

kikuyu: Nimar wangʼeyo, owetewa ma Nyasaye ohero, ni oseyierou,
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

kikuyu: Ngʼat maber yudo pwoch kuom Jehova Nyasaye, to Jehova Nyasaye kwero ngʼat ma timbene richo.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

kikuyu: Koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Wanyalo wacho ni Nyasaye ok jangʼad bura makare koso? Ok nyal bet kamano ngangʼ!
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

kikuyu: “Mad wabed mabor gi ngʼanyone Jehova Nyasaye, mi walokre waa kuome kawuono ka wagero kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, chiwo mar cham kod misengini mamoko moloyo kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa mochungʼ e nyim kare maler.”
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn away today from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides the LORD our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mana kaka jakwath reso lemo ariyo kata it rombo modongʼ ma sibuor pok ochamo, e kaka Nyasaye nores, jo-Israel manok modak Samaria ka gin e dho kitandagi, kaachiel gi man Damaski ka gibet e kombegi.”
english: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

kikuyu: Giyawona dhogi maduongʼ kendo nyiera ka giwachona giwacho niya, “Haa! Haa! Wasenene gi wengewa wawegi.”
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

kikuyu: Giil odiechiengʼ duto nikech nyingi; gidhialo timni makare.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

kikuyu: Kuom yie e nying Yesu, ema ngʼat munenoni kendo ungʼeyoni oseyudoe chang. En mana nying Yesu, kaachiel kod yie maa kuome, ema osemiyo ngʼatni resruok moromo chuth, mana kaka un duto unenoni.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ka ayudo ji piero abich maonge ketho e dala mar Sodom, to abiro reso dalano nikech joma onge kethogo.”
english: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

kikuyu: nikech tiend hond makati ne pok odonjonigi. Pachgi ne pod odinore.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

kikuyu: Onge dala mane nyalo sirowa e lweny chakre Aroer, e dho holo mar Arnon kod dala manie holo hie nyaka chop Gilead kendo onge kata mana dala achiel mane ok wanyal kawo. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nochiwogi duto e lwetwa.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ngʼato ka ngʼato nowach ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache niya, “Asegolo koa e oda chiwo mowal kendo asemiyogi jo-Lawi, jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho, kaluwore gi chik mane imiyowa. Pok ajwangʼo chikeni kendo wiya bende pok owil gi gimoro amora kuomgi.
english: You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

kikuyu: To, “Ngʼat ma sungore mondo osungre kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Timbeu maricho biro kelonu kum; wech mane uweyago ema biro kelonu kum. Nonuru kendo ubiro ngʼeyo malongʼo, kaka en gima rach kendo lit ne un uwegi, ka ujwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kendo ubedo maonge kode gi luor kata matin,” Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, owacho kamano.
english: “Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing, that you have forsaken the LORD your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Winjuru anena wach mopondoni: Ok wanatho waduto, to nolokwa wan duto apoya nono
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

kikuyu: Owetena to oselokore joma ok nyal gen, mana ka aore matindo ma pigegi ok siki kata ka oula mogingore ndalo koth,
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

kikuyu: Hazael ruodh Aram notho kendo Ben-Hadad wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Moloyo an awuon, akwayou mondo ulamna mondo aduog iru mapiyo.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

kikuyu: Kosechiemo moyiengʼ, to Nyasaye biro olo kuome mirimbe maliel ka mach, kendo biro kelo kuome kum malich.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

kikuyu: Piny noyiengni kowinjo ni ologi; ywakgi nowinjre nyaka e Nam Makwar.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.

kikuyu: “Aseketo Ruoth ma adwaro e Sayun, goda maler.”
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

kikuyu: “Mano kaka ngʼama piem gi Jachwechne none malit, ngʼat ma en mana lowo mochwe, mantiere e kind lope mamoko. Bende lowo nyalo wachone jachwechne ni, ‘En angʼo ma iloso?’ Bende tich lweti nyalo wachoni ni, Onge gima iloso?
english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?
