kikuyu: To koro jogo osetho kendo koro gionge; chunje moseago ok nochier. Ne ikumogi mi itiekogi maonge ngʼama parogi.
english: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone Daudi niya, “In ngʼama kare maloya. Isetimona maber, an to asetimoni marach.
english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

kikuyu: Jotend miech jo-Lawi e ndalo mar Eliashib; Joyada, Johanan kod Jadua, kaachiel gi joma ne jodolo, nondik nying-gi e kinde loch mar Darius ruodh Pasia.
english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

kikuyu: An gi gik mangʼeny monego awachnu mondo angʼadnugo bura. To Jal mane oora en ja-adiera, kendo anyiso piny gik ma asewinjo kuome.”
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

kikuyu: Ok oyiene ngʼato angʼata bedo ei Hemb Romo chakre e kinde ma Harun odonjo ei Kama Ler Moloyo kopwodhore owuon, kopwodho joode, kopwodho nyithind Israel duto, nyaka sa ma owuokie, kosetieko tij pwodhruok duto.
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

kikuyu: Kwanuru ndalo piero abich bangʼ Sabato mar abiriyo, kendo chiengʼno unutim misango ni Jehova Nyasaye gi cham manyien.
english: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Onge hera maduongʼ ma ngʼato nyalo herogo osiepene moloyo chiwonegi ngimane.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

kikuyu: Amaria, Maluk, Hatush,
english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye oseyiecho pinyruodh Israel kogole kuomi kawuononi kendo osemiye ja-libambau moro maber moloyi.
english: Samuel said to him, “The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

kikuyu: Lero kar lero, wangʼ kar wangʼ, lak kar lak. Nyaka hiny ngʼatno mana kaka osehinyo nyawadgi.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

kikuyu: Paruru wachni, keturu e pachu kendo pareuru e chunyu un joma ongʼanyo.
english: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.

kikuyu: Kane Amasa osegol e yo, ji duto nodhi gi Joab mondo gilaw Sheba wuod Bikri.
english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

kikuyu: nimar amor gi chikeni nikech aherogi.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

kikuyu: Ok oyiene pogo mabeyo gi maricho kata wilogi. To kaponi owilo chiayo moro gi machielo, to chiayono kaachiel gi mowilegono, giduto ginibed gik maler e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo ok nyal wargi.’ ”
english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

kikuyu: Onge oganda moro machielo mosetimone kamano kendo gin ok gingʼeyo chikene. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Nimar abiro kelo jakwath moro machielo e piny ma ok bi dewo rombe molal, kata manyo rombe matindo, kata thiedho mago matuo, kata pidho mago ma dendgi ber, to kar timo kamano, to obiro chamo mago machwe kochamo nyaka orenge mag-gi.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

kikuyu: Angʼo madimi in kod jogi tho e dho ligangla, kech kod masira mano ma Jehova Nyasaye osechano timo ni ogendini ma ok bi tiyone ruodh Babulon?
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, aa malo ichungʼ mondo awuo kodi.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

kikuyu: Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye, pakuru nyinge; landuru warruokne odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

kikuyu: “To kata obedo kamano, jo-Israel nobed mathoth ka kwoyo manie dho nam ma ok nyal pim kata kwano. Kama ne owachnegi ni, ‘Ok un joga,’ ibiro luongogi ni ‘yawuot Nyasaye mangima.’
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo inyisgi ni: ‘Magi e sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye, magin chokruok mage maler, ma onego ulandi kuonde duto ma uchokorue.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

kikuyu: Negiiko mich mane gibiro godo mondo gi dhi gimi Josef sa auchiel, nikech negisewinjo ni gidhi chiemo kode.
english: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

kikuyu: “An Jehova Nyasaye ema anono chuny kendo apimo paro, mondo achiwne ngʼato kaluwore gi timne, kendo kaluwore gi kaka kite chalo.”
english: “I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”

kikuyu: Kane kwerewa ni Misri, ne ok giparo matut kuom honni magi; bende ne wigi owil gi kechni mathoth, ne gingʼanyoni e dho nam, ma en Nam Makwar.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa ne ool kuoma mogundho, kaachiel gi yie kod hera mayudore kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Emomiyo mana kaka richo nodonjo e piny nikech ngʼato achiel, kendo richono nokelo tho; e kaka tho nobiro kuom ji duto, nikech ji duto noketho,
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke kawacho niya, “Awachoni adier, ni onge ngʼama nyalo neno pinyruoth Nyasaye ka ok onywole nywol manyien.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Miriam nobedo oko mar kambi kuom ndalo abiriyo, kendo ji nochungʼ kar tiendgi nyaka ne odwogo.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

kikuyu: Kane iwuok idhi kitelo ne jogi, yaye Nyasaye, kane iwuotho e piny mokethore maonge tich, Sela
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

kikuyu: Omiyo abiro bole e kitanda mar thagruok bende abiro miyo joma terore kode yudo thagruok malich ka ok giyie loko chunygi mi giweyo timo richo.
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

kikuyu: An gi kuyo maduongʼ kod lit ma ok rum e chunya.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ruoth onego ngʼe ni ka dala maduongʼni oger kendo ohinga mage ochung kendo, to onge osuru mibiro chul, kata chiwo kod chudo moro amora kendo pesa ma joka ruoth yudo ok nogol.
english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

kikuyu: Tangʼ gi ngʼat ma buonjo kodi nikech onyalo bet ni ochano timoni marach, ngʼatno maluwo dhoge ochomo timbe maricho.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

kikuyu: Gikanyono malaika mar Ruoth nogoyo Herode piny, nikech ne ok omiyo Nyasaye duongʼ kendo kute nochamo ringre, mi otho.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

kikuyu: To dwaruru pinyruoth Nyasaye, eka gigi duto bende nomiu kaachiel gi mago.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

kikuyu: Eka un, ma un joga, unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka anael lieteu mi agolu oko kuomgi.
english: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Apenjou, ere gima chikwa oyie mondo otim chiengʼ Sabato, timo maber koso timo marach, reso ngima koso ketho ngima ngʼato?”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou e piny Misri momiyou piny Kanaan kendo mondo abed Nyasachu.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

kikuyu: wuod Enosh, wuod Seth, wuod Adam, wuod Nyasaye.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

kikuyu: Yawuote noikre ne lweny kendo ginichok oganda maduongʼ mar jolweny, ma noywe kamoro amora ma gichomo mana ka ohula ma ok gengʼre, kendo giniked mi gichop nyaka ei ohinga mare.
english: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress.

kikuyu: Gichungʼ achungʼa maonge gima giwachi, koro pod arit arita kata obedo ni gilingʼ kamano?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

kikuyu: Tingʼuru nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kendo lamuru e gode maler, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa ler.
english: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

kikuyu: “Loch gi luor gin mag Nyasaye; okelo kwe e piny koa e polo.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

kikuyu: To in Kapernaum bende ibiro tingʼori malo nyaka polo koso? Ooyo, ibiro lwar piny nyaka piny joma otho.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

kikuyu: Ok othir ngʼato angʼata kata mako gir ngʼato eka ohole gimoro. Ok omaa ngʼato gire githuon to ochiwo chiembe ne joma odenyo, kendo ochiwo lewni ne joma ni duk.
english: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

kikuyu: Lep makelo ber en yath mar ngima, to lep mar miriambo omiyo chuny bedo mool.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne gitemo Nyasaye, mine gingʼanyone Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo; ka gidagi rito chikene.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho ni ngʼat Nyasayeno niya, “Wadhi oda mondo iyud gimoro icham kendo abiro miyi mich.”
english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

kikuyu: Paulo gi Barnaba ne joyalo Injili e dala mar Derbe mi giloko jopuonjre mangʼeny. Bangʼe negidok Lustra, gi Ikonio kod Antiokia,
english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

kikuyu: Koro Zedekia wuod Kenana noloso tunge mag nyinyo kolando niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ‘Gi chumbegi ibiro chwowo jo-Aram nyaka itiekgi chuth.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

kikuyu: ma en wach manopandi kuom higni gi tienge mangʼeny, to koro oseel tiende ni jomaler.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

kikuyu: Unuchwo kothe mangʼeny to unuka manok, nikech bonyo nokethgi.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

kikuyu: Kuome ema ngʼato angʼata moyie iketo kare mi gony kuom gimoro amora ma Chik Musa ne ok nyal gonyoe ngʼato.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

kikuyu: to ne achiwo chikni: Luorauru, to anabed Nyasachu kendo unubed joga. Wuothuru e yore duto machikou, mondo duto odhi kodu maber.
english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

kikuyu: Omiyo ka oganda nosechokore kaachiel, Pilato nopenjogi niya, “En ngʼat mane mudwaro mondo agonynu: Barabas koso Yesu miluongo ni Kristo?”
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

kikuyu: Kaka sibuor enowe kare mar dak, kendo pinygi nodongʼ nono, nikech ligangla mar ngʼama thiro ji kendo ligangla mar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mager.
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

kikuyu: Rizpa nyar Aiya nokawo pien gugru mopedho ewi lwanda mondo obedie, chakre ndalo keyo nyaka koth nochako chue ka goyo ringre jogo. To noriembo winy mafuyo godiechiengʼ kod le mawuotho gotieno mondo kik cham ringregi.
english: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

kikuyu: Rawera moro noringo mi odhi ir Musa mowachone niya, “Eldad kod Medad koro wach e kambi.”
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

kikuyu: Enok nonywolo Irad: Kendo Irad ema ne wuon Mehujael, kendo Mehujael nonywolo Methushael kendo Methushael nonywolo Lamek.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Asa ne ok oketho kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo, chunye nochiwore chutho ni Jehova Nyasaye ndalo duto mag ngimane.
english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noluongo Samuel. Samuel nodwoko niya, “Era ee.”
english: The LORD called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: ni ok nakaw giri moro, kata mana tol kata pat kira, mondo kik chiengʼ moro iwachi ni, ‘An ema ne amiyo Abram obedo jamoko.’
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

kikuyu: Nikech richo ok honre ahona kayiem, kata chandruok bende ok bi kaonge gima omiyo.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

kikuyu: Giniwuo gi dwol achiel kagiwacho niya, “Kara in bende koro isebedo manyap, mana ka wan; isebedo machal kodwa.”
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

kikuyu: Kore wuod Imna ma ja-Lawi, jarit rangach ma yo wuok chiengʼ, ne jarit chiwo mar hera, ka opogo gik mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye kod chiwo mowal.
english: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute the LORD’s offerings and the most holy things.

kikuyu: Kata dine aluokra gi sabun mi aluok lwetena maler,
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

kikuyu: Koro, yaye ruoth, gol chikno, kendo ndike piny, ma ok nyal loke mana kaka chik jo-Medes gi jo-Pasia ma ok nyal loki.”
english: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

kikuyu: To negidwokogi mana kaka Yesu nonyisogi mondo gidwokgi mi jogo noweyogi gidhi.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

kikuyu: Gigombo mondo gibed jopuonj Chik to gikia tiend gik ma giwacho kata gik ma giwuoyo kuomgi.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

kikuyu: “To rieko to diyud kanye? Koso ere kuma ngʼeyo wuokie?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Ji mathoth mane ni e sawono ne wuoyo kuom Yesu. Jomoko nowacho niya, “En ngʼat maber.” To jomoko kuomgi to nowacho niya, “Ooyo, owuondo ji.”
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

kikuyu: Nimar kaka ungʼado ne ji mamoko bura e kaka ibiro ngʼadnu bura un bende, nimar rapim mupimogo ema ibiro pimnugo un bende.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni wan ringruok kod remo achiel kaka jopinyni to kata bed ni yawuotwa ber mana ka yawuotgi, to pod waketo yawuotwa kod nyiwa kaka wasumbini. Nyiwa moko to ne oseketi wasumbini, to waonge gi teko, nikech puothewa kod puothewa mag mzabibu koro gin mek jomoko nono.”
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

kikuyu: Dine aringo adhi mabor mi adhi adak e piny ongoro; Sela
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

kikuyu: Solomon noloso mier matindo mane Hiram omiye kendo noketoe jo-Israel mondo odagie.
english: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama oseneno Wuoro makmana Jal ma noa ka Nyasaye; En kende ema oseneno Wuoro.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

kikuyu: Nonyiso Musa timbe mane ochano timo, nomiyo jo-Israel oneno timbene.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Wachne Turo ma en dala moger e dho nam kendo maloko ohala gi ji duto modak e dho nam ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Yaye Turo, iwacho niya, “Ajaber kendo alongʼo chuth.”
english: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

kikuyu: Nikech kata bed ni gik miluongo ni nyisechego nitie, kata gibed e polo, kata e piny mana (kaka nitie “nyiseche” mangʼeny kod “ruodhi” mangʼeny),
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

kikuyu: Kata bed ni iyoko ngʼat mofuwo e pany, iyoke kaka cham miswago, ok inigol fupe oa kuome.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

kikuyu: ngʼatno, bende, nyaka nomadh divai mar mirimb Nyasaye, moseol mopongʼ giteko moo ei kikombe mar mirimbe. Noyud sand ei mach makakni e nyim malaika maler, kendo e nyim Nyarombo.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

kikuyu: To kane gituo magihewore to ne arwako law ywagruok kendo ne abolora katweyo chiemo. Kane lamona ok odwoki,
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noyako gik moko duto kod kweth jamni mag mier madongogi, kendo neginego ji duto maonge ngʼama notony kata achiel.
english: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

kikuyu: To keturu joma timbegi mono ariyo momanyore kode kendo ketgiuru mondo gihangne wach ni osekwongʼo Nyasaye kod ruoth. Eka ugole oko kendo uchiele gi kite nyaka otho.”
english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

kikuyu: Abiro chomi tir gi mirimba mopongʼ gi nyiego kendo gibiro tiyi gi mirima mapek. Gibiro ngʼado umi gi iti oko, to joma notony e lwetgi nopodhi e dho ligangla. Gibiro kawo yawuoti gi nyigi gidhigo, to jogo kuomu ma notony mach nowangʼ.
english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth nowachone niya, “Koro un jo-Farisai ulwoko ngʼe kikombe gi bakul to, gie chunyu to upongʼ gi wuoro kod timbe maricho.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

kikuyu: Adiera, joge matindo nopodh e yore; jolweny mage duto nolingʼ thi odiechiengno,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Onge ruoth minyalo reso nikech en gi jolweny mangʼeny; bende onge jakedo manyalo tony nikech tekone ngʼeny.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

kikuyu: Osiki mare gi tiendene to we kodongʼ ei lowo, kitweye gi nyinyo kod mula, e dier lum madongo e bungu. “ ‘Weye mondo thoo omiye ngʼich, kendo odag kaachiel gi le e dier yiende mag piny.
english: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals in the grass of the earth.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni osedwanyore en owuon kendo ok osebedo ja-ratiro ne chwore, to nokete omodh pigno makelo kwongʼ, kendo ma nomi obed gi sand mager; ma mi obwog nyathi ka ndalone pok ochopo kendo ngʼama okwongʼ e kind ogandane.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo odhiambo, jopuonjre nodhi nyaka e dho nam,
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo osetieko wacho wechegi ni yawuote kamano nodwoko tiende e kitanda, mi chunye nochot kendo noluwo kwerene.
english: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Nyiminegi ne Zeruya kod Abigael. Yawuot Zeruya adek ne gin Abishai, Joab kod Asahel.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

kikuyu: Bende e kinde ma un gi mor, ma gin kinde sewni moyier kaka nyasi mar Dwe Manyien, nyaka ugo turumbete e kinde muchiwoe misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag lalruok, nikech ginibednu rapar e nyim Nyasachu nimar An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.”
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼat man-go nomedne mi nobed gi gik mogundho; to ngʼat ma ongego kata mano ma en-go nomaye.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye timo gimoro amora mohero, e polo kendo e piny, ei nembe kendo e kudegi.
english: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

kikuyu: Ji duto monena jara; gidiro ayany ka gikino wigi.
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

kikuyu: Wakaw ni ngʼato odonjo e chokruok maru korwako bangli mar dhahabu gi lewni mabeyo, to ngʼat moro modhier morwako lewni mokidhore okidhore bende odonjo kode.
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

kikuyu: Usesandoru malich kamano mana kayiem adier, ooyo ok apar ni kamano?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nochiw chiemo mondo oogo joma goyo nduch joma otho kata mana newuoro kata miyo bende onge ngʼama nomigi math mondo oogi.
english: Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

kikuyu: Ka Mikaya wuod Gemaria, ma wuod Shafan, nowinjo weche duto mag Jehova Nyasaye moa e kitabu,
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the LORD’s words,

kikuyu: Abiro golo jogi motwe kagolo e bur matut maonge pi, nikech singruokna mane atimo kodu gi remo.
english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

kikuyu: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulam, Talmon kod Akub ne gin jorit dhorangeye ma bende ne ngʼiyo kuonde keno man yo rangach.
english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

kikuyu: Kane Musa ochungo Hema noketo rachungi kargi morwako bepe kendo ochungo sirni.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

kikuyu: Chiw jo-Lawi e lwet Harun gi yawuote nikech gin e joma owal e dhood Israel mondo okonye tich.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjrene nowacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Dibed ni ngʼato osekelone chiemo?”
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

kikuyu: Timbene ne richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok olokore oweyo timbe maricho mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Rituru chiengʼ Sabato kendo ukete obed maler.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

kikuyu: To beduru mangʼwon kendo uholgi gimoro amora magidwaro.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

kikuyu: Duog ira kendo bedna mangʼwon, nikech adongʼ kenda kendo an gi kuyo.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

kikuyu: Lamnauru mondo Nyasaye oresa e lwet joma odagi yie man Judea, kendo mondo jomaler man Jerusalem orwak tich ma atimo e diergi,
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: ‘Ka ibiro luwo yorega kendo rito dwaroga, eka ibiro rito oda kendo ibiro rito hekalu mara, kendo abiro miyi kari ka, kaka achiel kuom joma chungʼ e nyima.’
english: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

kikuyu: Ne ochako ogero kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo ma wuon mare Hezekia nomuko, to bende nogero kende mag misengini miwangʼoe liswa ne Baal kaachiel gi sirni milamo mag Ashera. Bende nokulore kolamo gik moko duto mochwe man e kor polo.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he raised up altars for the Baals, made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

kikuyu: E kindeno kanisa man Judea moyie kuom Kristo ne pok oyanga malongʼo ni an ngʼa.
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

kikuyu: Ringra e chiemo madier kendo remba e math madier.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka un jo-Kristo, to mano nyiso ni un koth Ibrahim, kendo un jocham girkeni ma nosingi.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

kikuyu: Ma e dwoko mane gimiyowa: Wan jotich mar Nyasach polo kod piny, kendo wagero hekalu manyien mane oger higni mangʼeny mokalo, mano mane ruoth maduongʼ mar Israel ogero kendo otieko.
english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

kikuyu: Un osiepena mana kutimo gik ma achikou.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ka gima otimono obothne, ma en dwach Nyasaye mondo mi otimre; to Nyasaye nomiye kar tony moseikone.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo piny Misri doko piny mokethore e dier pinje mokethore, kendo mier mage madongo biro bedo kanyakla mar mier madongo ma ji odarie kuom ogendini, ka akeyogi e kind pinje.
english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo nindo matut otero Adam; kendo kane onindo, nogolo achiel kuom ngʼedene mi nodino kanyo gi ringʼo.
english: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

kikuyu: “Ka law moro amora opur; bed ni en mar pamba kata mar usi,
english: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

kikuyu: “Nikech kwerewago ne nyiego omako gi Josef, ne giuse kaka misumba ne jo-Misri. To nikech Nyasaye ne ni kode,
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Abiro riembo jo-Juda e nyima mana kaka ne ariembo jo-Israel kendo abiro kwedo Jerusalem dala maduongʼ mane ayiero kaachiel gi hekaluni, mane awuoyoe ni, ‘Kanyo ema Nyinga nobedie.’ ”
english: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

kikuyu: kendo kuome Nyasaye nomiyo gik moko duto obedo gi winjruok kaachiel kode, kata gibed gik moko manie piny gi gik manie polo, kokelo kwe kuom remb Wuode mane ochwer e msalaba.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

kikuyu: Hezekia nooro wach ni jo-Israel duto gi jo-Juda kendo nondiko barupe ni jo-Efraim kod jo-Manase kokwayogi mondo gibi Jerusalem e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo gitim Sap Pasaka ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel.
english: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom higni auchiel oyienu pidho cham e puotheu, gi loso tiend yiendeu mag mzabibu kendo oyienu kayo chambu kendo pono olembeu.
english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

kikuyu: Janek nyaka sik e dalane mar tony nyaka jadolo maduongʼ tho; to en mana bangʼ tho mar jadolo maduongʼno ema onyalo dok chamo mwandune.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Abiro rese nikech ohera; abiro rite nikech ohulo nyinga.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

kikuyu: Ruoth noloso nyasi maduongʼ mirwakogo Esta, nolose ne jodonge gi jotelo duto, noloso chiengʼno mondo obed chiengʼ yweyo maonge tich e pinyruodhe duto ka ooro ni ji mich mabup.
english: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.

kikuyu: kod gimoro amora ma mach ok nyal wangʼo noleny e mach, eka enopwodhgi mi gibed maler. To bende nyaka luokgi gi pi mondo gibed maler. Omiyo gimoro amora ma mach ok nyal lenyo nyaka luok gi pigno.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat ma ok oyie ojok noa, to weye aweya odhi. Dichwo moyie kata dhako moyie ok otwe e weche ma kamago, nikech Nyasaye oseluongowa mondo wadag gi kwe.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

kikuyu: Parie gima ne jo-Edom otimo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie gima negitimo chiengʼ mane Jerusalem opodho. Ne gikok matek niya, “Mukeuru ogoye piny. Mukeuru ogore piny gi mise mare duto!”
english: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

kikuyu: Dhial Jehova Nyasaye, yaye Jerusalem; pak Nyasachi, yaye Sayun.
english: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

kikuyu: To ruoth nowacho niya, “Nyaka itho, in Ahimelek gi joodu duto.”
english: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

kikuyu: Joote matero barupegi noor e pinje duto manie bwo loch ruoth kogolo chik ni jo-Yahudi duto nyaka negi matiek pep, bed ni gin jomatindo, joma oti, mon gi nyithindo matindo e odiechiengʼ achiel tarik apar gadek, dwe mar apar gariyo, miluongo ni Adar, kendo mondo oyak mwandugi.
english: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.

kikuyu: Otienono wach mar Jehova Nyasaye ne obiro ni Nathan, kawacho niya,
english: That same night, the LORD’s word came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: Koro ngʼatno nyalo biro e nyim ji mi owachnegi ni, Ne atimo richo mi aloko ber obedo rach, to Nyasaye ne ok ochula gi gima owinjore gi kethona.
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

kikuyu: En ema ne ogero kuonde mane omukore mag Elath, mi odwoke ne Juda bangʼ ka ruoth Amazia nosetho moike gi kwerene.
english: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

kikuyu: Adier, resruokne ni machiegni gi joma omiye luor, kendo duongʼne biro bet e pinywa.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

kikuyu: Eka jodong Jabesh nowachone niya, “Miwa ndalo abiriyo mondo waor joote e piny Israel duto kaonge ngʼama oyie biro konyowa to wabiro chiwore e lweti.”
english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

kikuyu: Ka moro amora mudakie, kik ucham remo moro amora bed ni en mar winy kata en mar le.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

kikuyu: Yore duto mag Jehova Nyasaye opongʼ gihera kod adiera ni joma rito gik moko duto ma singruokne dwaro.
english: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, wadwaro winjo paroni, nikech wangʼeyo ni ji wuoyo kuom kanyakla marach kuonde duto.”
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano jatend jogam divai ne ok oparo Josef; wiye nowil kode.
english: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo wuoyo kendo miyo gimoro timre ka ok en Ruoth Nyasaye ema owacho?
english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

kikuyu: Kane jogi odhi e od Mika ma gikawo kido mopa, law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, nyiseche manono mag udi kod nyiseche mopa, jadolo nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo mutimono?”
english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

kikuyu: Fweny ma wuoyo ewi Juda kod Jerusalem mane Isaya wuod Amoz oneno e ndalo loch Uzia gi Jotham gi Ahaz kod Hezekia mane gin ruodhi Juda.
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

kikuyu: Anami pinjeruodhi duto mag piny bed gibuok kuomgi nikech gima Manase wuod Hezekia ruodh Juda notimo e Jerusalem.
english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ka kech nodonjo e piny Misri duto, ji noywak ne Farao mondo omigi chiemo. Eka Farao nonyiso jo-Misri duto niya, “Dhiuru ir Josef kendo utim gima owachonu.”
english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

kikuyu: Kane giselamo, kama ne gichokoreno noyiengni, kendo Roho Maler nopongʼogi giduto, mi giyalo Wach Nyasaye gi chir.
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osewacho kamano, nomedo loso kodgi kowacho niya, “Osiepwa ma Lazaro nindo osetero, to adwaro dhi kuno mondo achiewe.”
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

kikuyu: Shalun wuod Kol-Hoze, ma jatend gwengʼ Mizpa, nogero Dhoranga Thidhia moketone tado kendo orwako dhoute, radedi kod lodi mage. Noloso bende ohinga mar Dago mar Siloam, machiegni gi Puoth Ruoth, nyaka e raidhi mabor koa Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

kikuyu: Kendo enowach niya: “Buguru yo, bugeuru kendo ulose maber! Goluru gik madichwany joga e yo.”
english: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”

kikuyu: Noloso raum mar pwodhruok gi dhahabu maler ma borne romo fut angʼwen gi nus kendo lachne romo fut achiel gi nus.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Omiyo Elija nowuok kanyo modhi oyudo Elisha wuod shafat. Nopuro gi rwedhi motwe e jok apar gariyo kendo en owuon ema nochwado rwedhi machien. Elija nodhi machiegni kendo nobolo lawe mar abola kuome.
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

kikuyu: Rangach midonjogo lachne noromo fut apar gabich, kendo ohinga mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko mane ni e bathe koni gi koni noromo fut abiriyo gi nus. Bende nopimo kama ler man-gi oko, ma borne ne en fut piero auchiel, to lachne ne en fut piero adek.
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

kikuyu: Kane ji duto osechiemo moyiengʼ, ne giwito cham duto modongʼ e nam mondo yie odongʼ mayot.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

kikuyu: “Kama odongʼ, ma lachne romo kilomita ariyo gi nus, to borne romo kilomita apar gariyo gi nus notigo tije mapile mag dala maduongʼ, kuom gero udi kendo kaka lek mar jamni. Dala maduongʼ nobed e diere tir,
english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone Zedekia niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Ka ichiwori ne jotelo mag ruodh Babulon, ngimani noweni kendo dala maduongʼni ok nowangʼ, in kod joodi unubed mangima.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “The LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.

kikuyu: Warruok mar joma kare aa mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye; En e kar pondo margi e ndalo mar chandruok.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

kikuyu: nowachonegi niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Oda noluongi ni od lamo,’to un to uloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Tung Moab ongʼad oko; bade otur,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Un yawuota kik koro ujwangʼe, nikech Jehova Nyasaye oseyierou mondo uchungʼ e nyime kendo utine kuwangʼone ubani.”
english: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Pahath-Moab (mowuok e dhood Jeshua gi Joab), ji alufu ariyo mia aboro gi apar gariyo (2,812),
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

kikuyu: “Wachne oganda ma jongʼanyogo ni, ‘Donge ungʼeyo tiend gigi?’ Wachnegi ni, ‘Ruodh Babulon nodhi Jerusalem momake ruodhe kod joge momew mi nodhi kodgi nyaka Babulon.
english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Abiro keyo jodonge, joma ngʼadone rieko, kod joma rite ne yembe, kendo ji nodwar mondo oneg-gi to ok noyudgi.
english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato ogoyo dichwo kata dhako ma misumba gi luth kendo misumbano otho kaluwore gi gochono, nyaka kume.
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye noyawo wengene kendo oneno soko mar pi. Kuom mano nodhi mopongʼo puga gi pi kendo nomiyo nyathi omodho.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

kikuyu: Nimar en higa mar piero abich, kendo mosewalnu maler ni Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka ucham gik monyak e puothe.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

kikuyu: Twe liganglani e bathi, yaye ngʼat maratego; rwakri gi ler kod duongʼ.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

kikuyu: Bende imedo wacho ni kata ji ok okum gi mirimbe mager kendo kata mana richo ma ji timo ok obadhe.
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

kikuyu: Nimar hera ma iherago duongʼ, kendo isegola ei chuny bur matut.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

kikuyu: Kamano kane Ahija owinjo tiende e dhoot nowacho niya, “Donji, chi Jeroboam. En angʼo momiyo iwuondori? Oseora iri gi wach marach.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jo-Damaski osebedo katimo richo mangʼeny, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech gisesando jo-Gilead, ka gigoyogi kod gima bith molos gi nyinyo,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

kikuyu: Abiro kelo piny ma timbene mono mogik mondo okaw miechgi. Abiro tieko ngʼayi mar joma roteke, kendo ibiro dwanyo kuonde maler mag-gi.
english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mon gi rapim mag miriambo, kendo rapim ma ok kare ok miye mor.
english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

kikuyu: Eka malaikano nowachona niya, “Wechegi gin weche mogen kendo ma adiera. To Ruoth ma Nyasach chunje mag jonabi, nooro malaikane mondo onyis jotichne gik mabiro timore mapiyo.”
english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

kikuyu: Kik chunyi nyosre bende kik ibed maluor. Donge ne asewacho mae kendo ne afwenye chon? Un joneno maga. Bende nitiere Nyasaye moro ma ok An? Ooyo, onge Lwanda moro amora mangʼeyo.”
english: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”

kikuyu: Gideon nodhi koluwo yo jokwath mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Noba kod Jogbeha mi nodonjo kuom jolweny mamoko apoya.
english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye. Pakuru nying Jehova Nyasaye; pakeuru, un jotich mag Jehova Nyasaye,
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

kikuyu: To ka atimogi, to yieuru kuom honnigo, kata ka an ok udwar yie kuoma, mondo ungʼe maber ni Wuoro ni e iya kendo an ei Wuoro.”
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny ibiro pwodhi mi gidok maler kendo maonge songa, to joma richo nomed bedo maricho. Joma richo ok nowinj tiend wechegi kata achiel, to jomariek to nowinj tiendgi.
english: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

kikuyu: Nyalo bet ni Onesimo nowuok iri kuom kinde manok mondo iyud thuolo mar kawe chuth bangʼe,
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

kikuyu: Tij jo-Gershon e Kar Hemb Romo ne en rito Kama Ler mar Lemo kod hema, kaachiel gi gik moumego, kaka pasia mantiere e dhorangach mar Hemb Romo.
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: Jo-Merari (ma gin jo-Lawi modongʼ) nonwangʼo magi: Koa kuom oganda Zebulun neginwangʼo Jokneam, Karta, Rimono kod Tabor kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath;
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: An Paulo, moluongi mondo obed jaote mar Kristo Yesu kaluwore gi dwaro mar Nyasaye kaachiel kod owadwa Sostheno,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

kikuyu: Kendo jogo ma gikorone nowit oko e yore mag Jerusalem nikech kech kod ligangla. Onge ngʼama noikgi kata mondegi, yawuotgi kata nyigi. Anaol kuomgi masiche mowinjore kodgi.
english: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.

kikuyu: Jo-Gad nodak e bathgi e piny Bashan nyaka chop Saleka.
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Ayub nowuoyo ka kwongʼo chiengʼ mane onywole.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

kikuyu: Pilato nochako owuok oko kendo mowacho ni jo-Yahudi niya, “Neuru, eri akele e nyimu mondo ungʼe ni ok ayudo ketho kata achiel kuome minyalo ngʼadnego bura.”
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: mowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwerewa, donge in e Nyasaye mantie e polo? In ema itelone pinyruodhi duto mag ogendini. Teko gi nyalo ni e lweti, kendo onge ngʼato manyalo siri.
english: and he said, “LORD, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

kikuyu: nikech ok inijwangʼa ei liel, to bende ok niyie Ngʼati Maler tow.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

kikuyu: Ne ubiro machiegni ma uchungʼ e tiend got. Godno mach ne liele mochopo nyaka e polo, ka en-gi rumbi maratengʼ kod mudho mandiwa.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

kikuyu: An aherogi to gin to gimon koda. Gitimona kamano kata obedo ni an to alemonegi.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

kikuyu: Kane owetene owachone jo-Shekem wechegi duto, to negiramo ni koro nyaka gilu Abimelek, nimar negiwacho niya, “En owadwa.”
english: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

kikuyu: Gibiro nyiso kuom tekoni mitimogo gik malich miwuoro, to an abiro hulo kuom tijeni madongo.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

kikuyu: Koa e dhout Juda kod Simeon negipogo mier matindogi gi nying-gi kama:
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nogolo chik mondo okelne ajuoke, jokor wach, jo-nyakalondo kod jorieko ma jo-Kaldea mondo onyise gima noleko. Kane gidonjo mi gichungʼ e nyim ruoth,
english: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

kikuyu: Abiro keyo jo-Misri e dier ogendini bende anami gikeree e kind pinje. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Winjauru un joma odak e dho nembe, winjuru un pinje man mabor: Kane pok onywola Jehova Nyasaye ne oluonga koa e nywolna ne oluongo nyinga.
english: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.

kikuyu: mi osemiyo wadoko oganda mag pinyruodhi kod jodolo matiyone Nyasache kendo Wuon mare kendo wuon-gi, mad duongʼ odogne manyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Nochako onywolo wuowi machielo kendo nochake ni Shela. Wuowini nonywolo ka en Kezib.
english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

kikuyu: “Kik upar ni asebiro mondo akel kwe e piny. Ne ok abiro mondo akel kwe, to nabiro mondo akel ligangla.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

kikuyu: Nimar kuom wecheni iwuon miwacho ema ibiro ketigo thuolo kendo kuom wecheni iwuon miwacho ema ibiro ngʼadonigo bura.”
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

kikuyu: “Ne ineno kaka kwerewa nosandore e piny Misri; kendo ne iwinjo ywakgi kane gichopo e Nam Makwar.
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

kikuyu: Ka ingʼiewo lop wadu nyaka ikwan higni kochakore e higa mar piero abich mokadho. Nyaka oket nengo lopno mana maromre gi higni ma pod ibiro keyoe.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

kikuyu: Mano kaka in gi lony e dwaro hera! Kata mana mon ma timbegi richo, nyalo somo timbegi.
english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.

kikuyu: Gitingʼo dwondgi malo, ka gigoyo koko gimor koa yo podho chiengʼ, kendo ka gihulo teko mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

kikuyu: gima odongʼ en mana kibaji, kwangʼeyo ni wachomo kum gi mirima mar mach, mabiro tieko joma kedo gi Nyasaye chuth.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E nyim wangʼu anachul Babulon kod jogo duto modak Babulon kuom gigo maricho magisetimo e Sayun.”
english: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To bende, dichwo ne ok ochwe ne dhako, to dhako ema ne ochwe ni dichwo.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

kikuyu: Jootego noduogo kendo mowacho niya, “Ma e gima Ben-Hadad owacho: ‘Naoro mondo akaw dhahabu magi kod fedha magi kaachiel gi mondi gi nyithindi.
english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ngʼat moro ne oloso nyasi maduongʼ kendo noluongo welo mangʼeny.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo wach ngʼatno, nohum nono kendo nowachone joma ne luwo bangʼe niya, “Awachonu adier ni pok ayudo kata ngʼat achiel e piny Israel ma nigi yie maduongʼ machal kama.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi tok matek kaka kwereu nobedo, bolreuru ni Jehova Nyasaye. Biuru e kama ler mar lemo ma osepwodho nyaka chiengʼ. Tineuru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mondo mi mirimbe mager owuog kuomu.
english: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve the LORD your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona: “Dhi kendo ingʼiew kamba mar law kendo itweye e nungoni, to kik iweye omak pi.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”

kikuyu: Mar Solomon. Sidh ne ruoth adiera mari, yaye Nyasaye, sidh ne wuod ruoth timni makare.
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

kikuyu: To kuom yawuota duto ma bende Jehova Nyasaye osemiya mangʼeny, noyiero wuoda Solomon mondo obedi e kom loch mar pinyruodh Jehova Nyasaye e Israel.
english: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Eri wadhi nyaka Jerusalem, kendo Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi chiw e lwet jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik. Gibiro ngʼadone buch tho mi gichiwe ne joma ok jo-Yahudi,
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

kikuyu: mondo omi gilwori kendo giwuoth e yoreni ndalogi duto ma gin-go e piny mane imiyo kwerewa.
english: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

kikuyu: Aseneni ei kari maler kendo asengʼeyo tekoni gi duongʼni.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

kikuyu: In to in ngʼa ma inyalo ngʼado bura ne jatich ngʼat machielo? Kochungʼ kata kopodho, to obadho mana ruodhe owuon, kendo obiro mi ochungʼ motegno nimar Ruoth nigi teko mar miyo ochungʼ.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

kikuyu: gi kendo mar misango mochwe gi dhahabu, gi mor pwodhruok, gi ubani mangʼwe ngʼar gi pasia molier e dhood hema;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nochokore e mier madongo e gwenge duto manie pinyruoth Ahasuerus mondo gimonj joma ne dwa tiekogi. Ne onge ngʼama ne nyalo chungʼ e nyimgi nikech ogendini mamoko duto noluorogi.
english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kor wach ni, ‘An Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kama: “ ‘Ywaguru kendo uwach niya, “Mano kaka masira maduongʼ nobed chiengʼno!”
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’

kikuyu: Kanyo ema ne oike Ibrahim kod Sara chiege, kanyo bende ema ne oikie Isaka kod Rebeka chiege, kendo kanyo ema ne aikoe Lea.
english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

kikuyu: Ne achokogi e bath aora mamol kochiko Ahava, kendo ne wabuoro kanyo kuom ndalo adek. Kane arango e dier ji kod jodolo, ne ok ayudo jo-Lawi kanyo.
english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

kikuyu: Nikech en gima ber ka dhano oyie tingʼo rem mar chandruok moyudo kayiem nikech ongʼeyo ni Nyasaye ni kode.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

kikuyu: Wer. Zaburi mar Asaf. Kik ilingʼ, yaye Nyasaye; kik iywe, yaye Nyasaye, bende kik ibed mos.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

kikuyu: Neuru, sani koro uketo genou kuom Misri, machalo odundu mobarore ma ka ngʼato orere to opilore mochwo ngʼatno kendo kelo adhola! Mano e kaka Farao ruodh Misri chalo ne joma ogeno kuome.
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

kikuyu: To Joab nodwoke niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye med jolweny madirom nyadi mia achiel. Ruodha kendo jatenda, to donge gin duto gin jo-ruoth? To en angʼo momiyo ruoth ma en ruodha didwar timo richo machal kama ni Israel?”
english: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

kikuyu: Ka en dhako modhier ma ok nyal yudo nyaim, to oyiene mondo okel akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo. Achiel kuomgi notim godo misango miwangʼo pep, to machielo notimgo misango mar golo richo. Jadolo notim misenginigo, ka opwodhogo dhakono, kendo dhakono nobed maler.’ ”
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

kikuyu: Hazar Shual, Bala, Ezem,
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

kikuyu: Ma e wach mokor kuom Holo mar Fweny: Koro angʼo mathagou momiyo un duto uidho ewi udi,
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

kikuyu: nikech jo-Misri noyudo yiko nyithindgi makayo mane Jehova Nyasaye onego ka ngʼadogo bura ne nyisechegi.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

kikuyu: Emomiyo chunywa ok nyosre. Kata obedo ni ringrewa ma oko rumo kamano, to chunywa iloko manyien odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

kikuyu: Bed ni en Paulo kata Apolo, kata Kefa, kata piny, kata ngima, kata tho, kata gik ndalogi, kata gik mantiere, kata gik moko mabiro giduto gin mau.
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

kikuyu: to Jakobo ne en wuon Josef mane chwor Maria mane onywolo Yesu, miluongo ni Kristo.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo tarik piero ariyo gabiriyo ema ne piny otuoe.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni chwech Nyasaye duto osebedo ka chur nyaka sani gi rem machal gi muoch makecho.
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

kikuyu: Adier, nowachi kuom Sayun niya, “En min ogendini mathoth, kendo Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo owuon biro chunge.”
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

kikuyu: Koro ruoth ne ohero Esta kendo chunye ne otwere kuome moloyo nyiri duto, nolombo wangʼ ruoth, kendo ruoth noyie kode moloyo nyiri mamoko. Mine osidhone osimbo mar duongʼ, mi okete obedo mikache kar Vashti.
english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

kikuyu: Yawuot Benjamin ne gin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Mupim, Hupim kod Ard.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka un bende onego ubed moikore, nikech Wuod Dhano biro biro sa ma ok ungʼeyo.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

kikuyu: kendo nyaka ohul richo mosetimono. Nyaka ochiw chudo duto mar kethone, omed achiel kuom abich ewi chudono bangʼe ochiwe duto ne ngʼat mosekethone.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “ ‘Her Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi gi chunyi duto, kendo gi paroni duto, kendo gi riekoni duto.’
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

kikuyu: Biuru uchik itu, un duto muluoro Nyasaye; we anyisue gik ma osetimona.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kikuyu: To achiel kuomgi, mane nyinge Kaifas, mane en jadolo maduongʼ e higano nowachonegi niya, “Un joma ok riek kata matin!
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

kikuyu: Kaka makaa miyo mach ngʼangʼni, to yien bende miyo mach liel, e kaka ngʼat makwiny kelo miero.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

kikuyu: Ka dipo owadu hie, wuodi, nyari kata chiegi mihero kata osiepni migeno hoyi lingʼ-lingʼ kawachoni niya, “We wadhi mondo walam nyiseche mamoko” (ma gin nyiseche ma in kata kwereni ne ok ongʼeyo;
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

kikuyu: Wachne Nyasaye niya, “Mano kaka timbe mitimo dongo! Tekoni duongʼ manade, mamiyo wasiki duto leny nono koneni.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

kikuyu: To wuon mare to biro tho nikech richone owuon, nikech ne ongʼanyo ni ji kendo ne omayo owadgi githuon kendo nikech ne otimo gik maricho e dier jo-dalagi.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

kikuyu: Ok giywagna koa e chunygi makmana gidengo e kitendinigi. Gichokore kanyakla ne cham kod divai manyien to giringo gijwangʼa.
english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

kikuyu: Koro Jal machiwo kodhi ne jachwoyo kendo machiwo chiemo michamo biro chiwonu kendo medonu nyadi mangʼeny kodhi michwoyo kendo obiro miyo timu makare medore.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

kikuyu: To e sinagogi ne nitie ngʼat moro mane nigi jachien marach. Ngʼatni noywak kogoyo koko matek kowacho niya,
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

kikuyu: Onge richo moro amora mosetimo ma nopar mi kwan e wiye. Osetimo gima adier kendo makare, obiro bedo mangima adier.
english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

kikuyu: nyarwath achiel, im achiel kod nyaim achiel ma hike achiel kaka misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ungʼeyo maber ni chikwa ok oyie mondo ja-Yahudi obed e achiel kata mondo olim ngʼat moro ma ok ja-Yahudi. To Nyasaye osenyisa ni kik aluong ngʼato ni ogak kata ni ok ler.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

kikuyu: noporo wach gi jodonge kod jotend lweny mondo gigengʼ pi soko moa oko mar dala maduongʼ kendo ne gikonye.
english: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

kikuyu: Kut luongore gi kut ei abururu mar pi; apaka magi duto gi ahiti mager oseywera motera.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

kikuyu: Ka achiedh-nade nopongʼo chunya, to hochni noduogo mor e ngimana.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

kikuyu: Nimar obiro biro ne ji duto modak e wangʼ piny mangima.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro gwedhou kaka osewacho, kendo ubiro olo ogendini mangʼeny mwandu to un ok unuol kuomgi. Ubiro bedo gi loch kuom pinje mamoko to un onge manobed kod loch kuomu.
english: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

kikuyu: Kuomi ema wuonewa noketoe genogi; ne gigeni kendo ne iresogi.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne arango gigi duto kendo atieko ni ngʼama kare kod ngʼat man-gi rieko to gi gima gitimo ni e lwet Nyasaye, to onge ngʼama ongʼeyo ni hera kata achaya rite.
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

kikuyu: Osemiye law mayom, mapichni kendo maler, mondo orwaki.” Law maberno ochungʼ kar timbe makare mag jomaler.
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

kikuyu: “Koro winjuru tiend ngero mar jakomo,
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

kikuyu: bende achalo gi chupa ma divai opongʼo iye kendo ka pien divai manyien madwaro barore.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

kikuyu: En kod joge duto ne nodhi Baala e piny Juda mondo giom Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye kuno, miluongo gi nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, mobet e kind kerubi manie Sandug Muma.
english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

kikuyu: Miyae ranyisi mar berni, mondo wasika one mi wigi okuodi, nimar in ema isebedo ka ikonya kendo ihoya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

kikuyu: Wan gi chir kuom Ruoth ni utimo gik ma wawacho kendo ni ubiro medo timo kamano.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

kikuyu: Norito Got Hermon, Saleka, Bashan duto, nyaka e tongʼ mar jo-Geshur gi Maaka, kendo gi nus mar Gilead nyaka e tongʼ-gi gi Sihon, ruodh Heshbon.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane oneno ma nochako ngʼur kagiwacho niya, “Osedhi bedo wendo jaricho!”
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Eka iwir kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep kod gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono, iwal kendo mar misangono to obiro bedo maler.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gilamo Ruoth Nyasaye kendo gitweyo chiemo, Roho Maler nowachonegi niya, “Walnauru Barnaba gi Saulo mondo gitina tich mane aluongogi mondo giti.”
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

kikuyu: Dwoka piyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nimar chunya ool. Kik ipandna wangʼi nono to dipoka achalo gi joma ridore e bur matut.
english: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Ochiwo chiemo ne dhok kendo ne agege ka giywakne.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ni kod odiechienge mar chulo kuor, ma en higa mar chiwo kum ne jogo, mosetimo marach ne Sayun.
english: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

kikuyu: Kik ilokrina masira; in e kar pondana e kinde mar thagruok.
english: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendo mar misango nolos gi mula. Gigo ne gin agulni, opawo, bakunde mikirogo remo, gi uma michiwogo ringʼo kod tegni mag mach.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: dhahabu moa Ofir ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia achiel, fedha mopwodhi ma pekne romo kilo alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen mondo obawgo kor udi,
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

kikuyu: Weuru yoreu maonge rieko, eka unubed mangima, wuothuru e yor winjo kod ngʼeyo.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

kikuyu: Negiringo gidhi e mier machiegni man e alworano duto ka gitingʼo joma tuo konindo e kitendini. Negikelone jotuo kamoro amora mane giwinjo ni entie.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

kikuyu: Giko mar gimoro ber moloyo chakruokne kendo bedo mos ber moloyo sunga.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

kikuyu: ne agolou e tungʼ piny gi tungʼ piny, kendo ne aluongou kagolou mabor. Ne awacho ni, ‘In jatichna’; aseyieri bende pok akwedi.
english: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

kikuyu: To apoya nono, ahiti mangʼongo notugore e nam, mi apaka nochako tago yie koni gi koni. To Yesu noyudo nindo otero.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to wangʼni abiro oro masichena madongo dongo kuomi, kuom jodongi kod kuom jogi mondo ingʼe ni onge ngʼat machal koda e piny ngima.
english: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

kikuyu: Chiw achiwa mwanduni ni ji mangʼeny, nikech ikia gima kiny notimreni.
english: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

kikuyu: Kendo nokwongʼore kowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ka inine masich jatichni kendo ipara ma wiyi ok owil gi jatichni ma imiye wuowi, eka anachiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye e ndalo duto mar ngimane, kendo wembe ok nolielgo wiye.”
english: She vowed a vow, and said, “LORD of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro manyo romba an awuon kendo abiro kwayogi.
english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

kikuyu: Baana wuod Ahilud norito Tanak, gi Megido nyaka Beth Shan duto machiegni gi Zarethan man mwalo mar Jezreel, koa Beth Shan nyaka Abel Mehola man loka mar Jokmeam.
english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

kikuyu: Kweth mag ngamia nopongʼ pinyi, ma gin ngamia matindo moa Midian gi Efa. Jogo duto moa Sheba ka gikelo dhahabu kod ubani, nobi ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye gi wer.
english: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of the LORD.

kikuyu: wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Ezekiel jadolo, ma wuod Buzi, ka en piny Babulon e bath Aora Kebar, e piny jo-Babulon. Kanyo ema bad Jehova Nyasaye nobetie kuome.
english: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.

kikuyu: Eka napenjo malaika niya, “Yiende zeituni ariyo mantie bath rachung taya korachwich gi koracham, to gin angʼo?”
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

kikuyu: kendo osepongʼe gi Roho mar Nyasaye, mondo obed gi lony, gi rieko, gi nyalo kod ngʼeyo tije duto mag lwedo;
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
