kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo niya, “Wachnane, angʼo manotimore?” Nodwoke niya, “Ji noringo kawuok e lweny. Ngʼenygi nonegi kendo Saulo gi Jonathan wuode bende otho.”
english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”

kikuyu: Negitingʼo bedegi kaka singruok mar riembo mondegi, kendo kuom ketho mag-gi negichiwo im ngʼato ka ngʼato koa e kweth kaka misango mar pwodhruok e ketho.
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo joma sandou nocham ringregi giwegi mi anami gimer gi rembgi ka joma omadho kongʼo. Eka koth dhano duto manie piny nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye e Jawarni, Jaresni kendo Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo.”
english: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

kikuyu: Kane achopo kanyo, naneno yiende mathoth mokalo akwana e bath aora koni gi koni.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

kikuyu: “Owetena gi wuonena, koro winjuru wechena manyisou ni aonge ketho.”
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

kikuyu: Jogo mane oriworene ne gin Zabad wuod Shimeath nyar Amon kod Jehozabad wuod Shimrith nyar Moab.
english: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

kikuyu: to koro ere kaka dodew dhano adhana ma timbene richo kendo okethore, mamodho richo ka pi!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka Jeremia ne pod ok owuok, Nebuzaradan nomedo kawacho niya, “Dog ir Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, ma ruodh Babulon oseyiero mondo orit mier mag Juda, kendo idag kode kaachiel gi ji, ka ok kamano to idhi kamoro amora mihero.” Eka jatend lweny nomiye gik moko kod mich bangʼe noweye odhi.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

kikuyu: To kochopo higa mar abiriyo to puodho nyaka yud yweyo mar Sabato, ma en Sabato mar Jehova Nyasaye. E higano lowo nyaka yud yweyo ma kik upidh gimoro amora e puotheu mag cham gi mag mzabibu.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

kikuyu: nokawe kendo nochame e nyimgi.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uketho chik Nyasaye nikech wach chikeu gi timbeu?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

kikuyu: Nyaka gimak adiera matut mar yie gi chuny maler maonge richo moro amora.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

kikuyu: Negikete e od twech ka girito gima Jehova Nyasaye biro nyisogi.
english: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

kikuyu: Dibed ni wiu osewil gi timbe maricho mane wuoneu otimo kod mago mane otim gi ruodhi kaachiel gi monde ruodhi mag Juda to gi richo mane utimo kaachiel gi mondeu e piny Juda kod e yore mag Jerusalem?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Adiera mara sudo machiegni piyo, warruokna chiegni, kendo abiro ngʼado bura makare ne ogendini. Joma odak e dho nembe biro ngʼiya ka gin gi geno ni abiro resogi gi tekona.
english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.

kikuyu: Nimar Johana Ja-batiso nobiro ka ok ocham makati kata madho divai, to uwacho ni, ‘En gi jachien.’
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Oganda moro ne kedo gi oganda machielo kendo dala moro bende ne kedo gi dala moro, nikech Nyasaye nooronigi chandruok mangʼeny.
english: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

kikuyu: “ ‘To kuom gik moko duto modakie nam gi aore to unyalo chamo mana mago man kod thuokgi kod kalagakla.
english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

kikuyu: “Sanduru jo-Midian kendo uneg-gi,
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

kikuyu: koa e dhood Asher, ne en Sethur wuod Mikael;
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

kikuyu: Twe gima ondikie wechego gi tol marambulu e kilemba mar jadolo gi yo ka nyime.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nolawo Saulo gi yawuote matek, ma neginego yawuote magin Jonathan, Abinadab kod Malki-Shua.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Rem machalo gi mar dhako mamuoch kayo nobine, to en nyathi maonge gi rieko, ma ka sa ochopo monego owuog e ich to okia kama iwuok godo.
english: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.

kikuyu: omiyo ne aoronegi jaote gi dwoko niya, “An kod tich maduongʼ kendo ok anyal lor piny. Ere gima tangʼ mi tich chungʼ mi aweye kendo alor piny abi iri?”
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

kikuyu: Eka Gideon nowachone Nyasaye niya, “Kik iyi wangʼ koda. We mondo akwayi kwayo achiel makende. Yiena mana tem achiel kende gi pien. E kindeno, pien mondo obed kotwo, to lowo molwore obed gi thoo.”
english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo pod owuoyo, jatich machielo nobiro mowacho niya, “Maj Nyasaye nolwar koa e polo mowangʼo rombe kaachiel gi jotich, kendo an kenda ema asetony mondo anyisi wachni!”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Kane nyathi pod ngima ne atweyo chiemo kendo aywak. Nikech ne aparo ni, ‘Ngʼama dingʼe? Dipo ka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo timona ngʼwono miwe nyathi obed mangima.’
english: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

kikuyu: Kane obatisu, to noyiku kode kendo nochieru kode nikech yie ma un-go kuom teko mar Nyasaye ma nochiere oa kuom joma otho.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

kikuyu: Kawuru rombe koa Sela kungʼadogo thim mondo uterne ruodh piny, modak e got mar Nyar Sayun kaka gir chiwo.
english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: “En yien mane man Eden minyalo pimo kodi kuom duongʼ gi lich? To kata kamano, in bende ibiro dwoki piny kaachiel gi yiende mag Eden nyaka e piny mamwalo. Ibiro rieri piny e dier joma ok oter nyangu, kendo iki gi joma noneg e lweny.” Mano en Farao kod jokedo mage duto, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: En mana Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema konya. En ngʼa mabiro ngʼadona bura? Gibiro ti mana ka law, ma olwenda ochamo.
english: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne gilandone jo-Israel dwoko marachni kuom piny mane gidhi nono. Negiwacho niya, “Piny mane wadhi nono nego joma odak eigi. Ji mane waneno kuno gin joma robede.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

kikuyu: Ok onego ocham gimoro amora mowuok kuom mzabibu, kata madho divai moro amora kata madho gimoro amora mamero ji kata chamo chiemo moro amora mogak. Nyaka otim gik moko duto masechike.”
english: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”

kikuyu: To nyaka iyier joma niginyalo ma gin ji moluoro Nyasaye, joma ogen ma ok kaw asoya, kendo iketgi gibed jotend ji maromo alufu alufu, mia mia, piero abich abich, kod apar apar.
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: “To gie kindeno ji none Wuod Dhano kabiro koa e boche polo gi teko mangʼongo kod duongʼ.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

kikuyu: Nogolo lepe mokoro wach e nyim Samuel. Nonindo kamano odiechiengʼ gotieno. Mano ema omiyo ji wacho niya, “Kare Saulo bende en achiel kuom jonabi?”
english: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, wuod dhano, wuo gi Israel kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ma e yo machielo ma kwereu noweyago kayanya:
english: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

kikuyu: kendo ne aorogi ir Ido, jatelo Kasifia. Ne anyisogi gima giwachne Ido kod joge, jotij hekalu man Kasifia, mondo omi gikelnwa ji ne od Nyasachwa.
english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

kikuyu: Koro ninduru ka otienoni kaka jowadu mamoko ka notimo, mondo abi awinjiane gima nyien ma Jehova Nyasaye biro nyisa kuom wachni.”
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”

kikuyu: Timo gima kare kod mowinjore ema Jehova Nyasaye oyiego moloyo misango.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

kikuyu: Alamo Nyasaye mondo kuom duongʼne mosiko omiu teko e ngimau duto kuom teko mar Roho mare,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

kikuyu: Chikene duto ni e nyima; pok alokora aweyo buchene.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

kikuyu: To ka kinde mane Nyasaye ochano nochopo, to nooronwa Wuode mane dhako onywolo, kendo mane onywol e bwo Chik,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

kikuyu: Nikech giwacho weche manono mag sunga mopongʼ gi gombo maricho mag kit dhano mohero richo, mondo gimi joma tinde eka tony aa kuom joma olal tim richo.
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

kikuyu: Bende Jehova Nyasaye dwaro ni mondo urit buchene gi chikene ma amiyou kawuononi mondo okonyu.
english: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

kikuyu: Ihewe dichiel kendo mogik, kendo olal nono; iloko kit wangʼe, kendo igole e dier ji chuth.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

kikuyu: Mano kaka weche madier lit kaka kudho! To weche mihango mathothgo, to nyiso angʼo?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

kikuyu: To ne ok gichiko itgi kata winja; makmana, negiluwo timbegi mag tok teko mag chunjegi maricho. Negidok chien ma ok gidhi nyime.
english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

kikuyu: Bende en gima kare mondo wagol osuru ne Kaisar koso ok owinjore?”
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: E litgi duto en bende ne en gi lit kendo malaika mane ni e nyime ne oresogi. Kuom herane kod ngʼwonone neresogi; mi otingʼogi malo nyaka aa ndalo machon.
english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

kikuyu: Jatelo e migawo mar dwe mar ariyo ne en Dodai ja-Ahohi, Mikloth ne jatend migape. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ne awuok e ich mondo ane thagruok kod lit, kendo atiek odiechiengega e wichkuot?
english: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

kikuyu: Ok anyal tingʼo jogi duto kenda awuon; gipek mohewa.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

kikuyu: Kendo nopenjo niya, “Hagar jatich Sarai, ia kanye to idhi kanye?” Hagar nodwoke niya, “Aringo aa e wangʼ Sarai matiyone.”
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ja-Israel moro amora kata japiny moro modak e diergi ochamo remb chiayo moro amora to anabed jasike, kendo anangʼade oko kuom ogandani.
english: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

kikuyu: Naomi nowachone Ruth niya, “Ne, nyieki osewuok dok ir jogi kendo ir nyisechegi. In bende dog kode.”
english: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”

kikuyu: Negiloso ramaki mag mula piero abich mondo gitwego hemano kanyakla mondo obed gimoro achiel.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

kikuyu: Jethro, jaduongʼ Musa, kaachiel gi yawuot Musa gi chi Musa, ne jobiro ire e thim kama ne ojotie but got mar Nyasaye.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

kikuyu: Jotend ogandani osemiyo gilal kendo joma otelnegi bende oserwenyo.
english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ogendini manie piny, wachuru ni Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo en gi teko.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

kikuyu: nimar negiketho chunye mi weche maricho nowuok e dhoge.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

kikuyu: En e chakruok mar ngimau ei Kristo Yesu, mane obedonwa rieko moa kuom Nyasaye, tiende ni tim makare, pwodhruok, kod resruok.
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

kikuyu: Josef nopenjogi kaka gidhi eka nowachonegi niya, “Jaduongʼ ma wuonu mane uwachona wach kuome ni nade? Bende pod ongima?”
english: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

kikuyu: Kanyono, Elija gi Musa nothinyore e nyimgi kanyo, kendo ne giwuoyo gi Yesu.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

kikuyu: kendo ne apimonegi pek chiwo mar fedha gi dhahabu kod gik mane ruoth, jongʼadne rieko, jotende kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kanyo nosechiwo ne od Nyasachwa.
english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

kikuyu: Obiro dak e ngima momew, kendo nyikwaye nokaw piny kaka girkeni margi.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

kikuyu: Josef ne en ja-higni piero adek kane ochako tich mane Farao ruodh Misri omiye. Kendo Josef nowuok ir Farao mowuotho e piny Misri duto.
english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kane piny oru, Yesu nodhi kar kende. Ji ne manye to kane gibiro kama ne entie, negitemo tame mondo kik owegi.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Od Israel kod od Juda ok osebedona jo-ratiro chutho.”
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ere gima ngʼato disungrene? Onge gimoro nikech sunga osegol oko chuth. Ogole e yor timo gima chik dwaro koso? Ooyo, ogole e yor yie.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

kikuyu: Ka ndalogo noserumo, ruoth notimo sawo ni ji duto mane odak e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno mar Susa. Sawono notim e siwandha mar dala ruoth kendo nokawo ndalo abiriyo.
english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Sisera, noringo nyaka e hemb Jael, ma chi Heber ja-Keni, nikech ne nitie osiep e kind Jabin ruodh Hazor kod anywola Heber ja-Keni.
english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

kikuyu: Mise mage noyie e angʼo? Koso en ngʼa mane oketo kidi momake motegno?
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo iywak kuom adhondi, to in-gi rem ma ok thiedhre? Asekumou kamano nikech richou ngʼeny, kendo nikech timbeu maricho lich.
english: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.

kikuyu: Ngʼiuru polo malo mondo unee boche polo kaka ni kuma bor.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

kikuyu: Negimiyo Musa nonro machalo kama: “Ne wadhi e piny mane iorowae, kendo en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich! Olemo moa kuno eri.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ndiko nochopo kare, mawacho niya, “Ibrahim noyie kuom Nyasaye, kendo mano nomiyo Nyasaye okwane kaka ngʼama kare.” Kuom mano, Ibrahim ne iluongo ni osiep Nyasaye.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar angʼwen, e dwe mar angʼwen ne en Asahel owadgi Joab. Bangʼe Zebadia wuode nokawo kare. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Kane pok gidhi e nindo, chwo madongo kod matindo moa kuonde duto mag dala maduongʼ mar Sodom, nobiro molworo odno.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

kikuyu: Gin oganda marateke, mangʼeny kendo ma roboche mana ka jo-Anak. Jehova Nyasaye ne otiekogi e nyim jo-Amon, mane oriembogi mi gidak kuondegigo.
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

kikuyu: to ne pod aonge gi kwe e chunya nikech ne ok ayudo owadwa Tito kuno. Omiyo ne agoyo oriti ne jogo, mi adhi Makedonia.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

kikuyu: Jakobo nodhi ir wuon mare kendo owachone niya, “Wuora.” Eka Isaka nopenje niya, “Wuoda, to in ngʼa?”
english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

kikuyu: “Ee, angʼeyo ni gima iwachono en adier. To ere kaka dhano mangima nyalo bedo kare e nyim Nyasaye?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, wan ma pod wadongʼ ka wangima noyudhwa kaachiel kodgi mi terwa malo e boche polo mondo warom gi Ruoth e polo. Omiyo wanabed gi Ruoth nyaka chiengʼ.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

kikuyu: Bende nitiere kodhi ma pod ni ei dero? Nyaka kawuononi mzabibu gi ngʼowu gi olemo mongʼinore kod zeituni pod ok nyag olemo. “ ‘Chakre kawuono abiro olo gwethna kuomu.’ ”
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

kikuyu: Kendo Mika nowacho niya, “Koro angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye biro timona maber, nikech ja-Lawi osebedo jadolo mara.”
english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the LORD will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo moko Kain nokelo nyak mag lowo kaka misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Omiyo neginege, en kaachiel gi yawuote kod jolweny mage duto, maonge ngʼama otony mane odongʼ. Kendo negikawo pinye.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

kikuyu: Hazar Shual, Bersheba kod gwenge mokiewo kode,
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Ooyo. Riemba kama biro bedo marach moloyo kata mana rach misetimona.” To nodagi winje.
english: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye noketo gik moko duto e bwo tiende, kendo nomiyo obedo wi kanisa;
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

kikuyu: Mon ariyo noyudi karego cham kaachiel, achiel nokaw, to machielo nowe. [
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

kikuyu: Teko mopondo mar tij chayo chik koro osechako tich. To ka jal motamo ngʼat mochayo chik ogol oko, to tekono nofwenyre.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

kikuyu: To sani, nikech wasetho ne gima notweyowa chon, mondo wabed wasumbini, ok manie bwo chik machon mondiki, to manie ngima manyien kuom Roho.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

kikuyu: Nochopo ira piny koa malo mi okawa; ne ogola oko e kude mag pi matut.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

kikuyu: Lamuru Nyasaye mondo gino kik timre e ndalo chwiri,
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

kikuyu: Ichalo gi puodho ma thidhna ni e iye, bende ichalo gi soko mar pi mamol, kendo ichalo gi aore mamol kawuok ewi gode mag Lebanon.
english: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.

kikuyu: Ne giwuok e miechgi kanyakla nyaka Gibea mondo giked gi jo-Israel.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Winjuru un joma sando jochan, kendo mosiko mana kamayo joma odhier puothegi,
english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “To anaor jolupo mangʼeny kendo ginimakgi. Bangʼ mano anaor jodwar mangʼeny, kendo ginidwargi e got maduongʼ kod mago matindo kendo e kuonde pondo mokunyore e lwendni.
english: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says the LORD, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

kikuyu: Kamano un bende sani en sau mar kuyo, to ubiro bedo mamor ka ananeu bangʼe, kendo onge ngʼama nomau mor maru.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro chopona chenroge; yaye Jehova Nyasaye, herani osiko nyaka chiengʼ: kik ijwangʼ tije ma iloso gi lweti.
english: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

kikuyu: Ruodhi duto biro kulorene kendo ogendini duto biro tiyone.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kikuyu: Ne giwangʼo kari maler mar lemo molokore buru, kendo ne gidwanyo kama nyingi dakie.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

kikuyu: Eka yiedhi moko moa Tiberia nogowo but kama ne ji ochame makati, mane Ruoth Yesu ogwedho.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomi buche maremo ma ok thiedhi mak chongeni gi tiendeni kendo ginilandre koa e pat tiendi nyaka e wiyi.
english: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo nokaw mo, kendo ool moko e pat lwete owuon ma koracham,
english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodong Israel noromo kamoro achiel mine gidhi ir Samuel Rama.
english: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata muweyone richone an bende aweyone. Nikech ka aweyone ngʼato richone; ka dipo an bende onego awene ngʼato e wach moro amora, to atimo kamano kuom Kristo, nikech un,
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

kikuyu: Wuoro moseorano osetimo neno kuoma en owuon. Pok uwinjo dwonde nyaka nene kendo pok uneno kite.
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

kikuyu: Pasaka machal kamano ne pok otim e Israel chakre ndalo mag Samuel janabi; kendo onge ruodh Israel moro amora ma nosetimo Pasaka machal gi mane Josia kaachiel gi jodolo, jo-Lawi kod jo-Juda duto gi jo-Israel mane oriwore gi jo-Jerusalem otimo.
english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: mondo giikna yiende mangʼeny nikech hekalu magero nyaka bed maduongʼ kendo miwuoro.
english: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

kikuyu: Ngʼat matuono dhoge bedo marach, ma kata chiemo mamit manade koro dungʼne mana marach.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye to nodwoke niya, “An gi joga alufu abiriyo marito mapok okulore ka go chong-gi ne Baal.”
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

kikuyu: Ka dichwo kata dhako modak e dieru e achiel kuom dalane ma Jehova Nyasaye omiyou oyud katimo richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo koketho singruokne,
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

kikuyu: mi Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni nikech isetimona ma kendo ok isetama e wuodi ma miderma,
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

kikuyu: Jonathan nowachone Daudi niya, “Dhi gi kwe nimar wasesingore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ni osiep man e kindwa kodi ka wakwongʼore niya, Jehova Nyasaye obed janeno e kindi koda kendo e kind nyikwayi kod nyikwaya nyaka chiengʼ” Eka Daudi nowuok to Jonathan bende nodok dala.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘The LORD is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

kikuyu: Solomon ne en wuon Rehoboam, Rehoboam ne en wuon Abija, to Abija ne en wuon Asa.
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

kikuyu: Jehoyakim nochulo Farao Neko fedha kod dhahabu mane odwaro. Notimo kamano kogolo osuru kuom jopinyno kuom fedha gi dhahabu kaluwore gi yuto mar ngʼato ka ngʼato.
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

kikuyu: Iwacho ni ingʼeyo gima Nyasaye dwaro, kendo inyalo pogo gima ber moloyo nikech isepuonjori chik.
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

kikuyu: Kane ogo turumbete, to ji ne goyo koko matek, kendo ka turumbete noywak, mi ji nogoyo koko matek, to ohinga mar Jeriko nopodho, omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato nodonjo e dala maduongʼno mi gikawe.
english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi mono gi, motamore winjo wechega, matimo gima chunygi ema ohero, ma bende luwo bangʼ nyiseche manono mondo gitine kendo gilamgi, biro chalo gi kambani makoro onge tich chuth!’
english: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona: “Los jok gi tol kod lodi moriw kendo ikete e ngʼuti.
english: the LORD says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.

kikuyu: Nikech chike Musa osebedo kiyalo nyaka nene e mier duto, kendo kisomo e sinagoke Sabato ka Sabato.”
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

kikuyu: “Fweny mag okinyi godhiambo mosenyisi gin adier, to kik ihulgi ni ngʼato nikech gin gik mabiro timore bangʼe e ndalo mabiro.”
english: “The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.”

kikuyu: Ne waneno Nefilim kuno (nyikwa Anak aa kuom jo-Nefilim). Ne wanenore mana ka ongogo, to bende mano e kaka ne wachalo e nyimgi.”
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

kikuyu: Ji modongʼ nowinj wachni mi nobed maluor kendo tim mamonono ok nochak otimre kendo e dieru.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Efeso, Paulo noweyo Priskila gi Akula. Nodonjo e sinagogi ka en kende en owuon ei sinagogi mi owuoyo kod jo-Yahudi mane ni kanyo.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

kikuyu: Ne achiwora ne joma goya, ne joma pudho yie tika; kendo ne ok apando wangʼa ne joma nyiera kendo ngʼulo kuoma olawo.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

kikuyu: Weche mag ndalo mamoko mag loch Josia kod tichne maber manotimo koluwore gi gima ondiki e Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the LORD’s law,

kikuyu: Anamiye rayaw mar od Daudi, ma gima oyawo ngʼato ok lor, to bende gima oloro onge ngʼama yawo.
english: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

kikuyu: Ka ok imor kode, to iweye odhi kamoro amora ma ohero. Ok onego iuse kata kete jatichni, nimar isemiye wichkuot.
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Israel duto nobiro Misri; Jakobo nodoko jadak e piny Ham.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Nduru gi ywak mag dengo nopongʼ dhorongeye mag Sayun, kendo dalano nodongʼ nono kokethore.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

kikuyu: Mi obed e kom loch e nyim Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ; ket herani kod adierani mondo orite.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

kikuyu: wuod Jahath, wuod Gershon, wuod Lawi;
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Obiro miyo miriambo medore, kendo obiro kawore ni oyombo ji. E seche ma giparo ni gidhi maber, obiro nego ji mangʼeny kendo obiro chungʼ mondo oked gi Ruoth mar ruodhi. Kata kamano ibiro tieke, to ok gi teko mar dhano.
english: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes, but he will be broken without human hands.

kikuyu: “Nyaka utim Sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi, nikech chiengʼno ema ne agoloue piny Misri. Timuru nyasini odiechiengni kaka sawo mochwere ne tiengeu duto mabiro.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

kikuyu: Bed motangʼ, Jehova Nyasaye chiegni ngʼwasi mi owiti oko, yaye in ngʼat maratego.
english: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Juda nowal ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), koa e dhood Reuben ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa e dhood Gad ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000),
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Nimar nongʼeyo ni ich lit ema nomiyo giketo Yesu e lwete.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

kikuyu: nyaka nochopo kinde ma gik mane okoro notimore, nyaka wach Jehova Nyasaye nochopo kare.
english: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

kikuyu: Ne gilonyo lepe kendo ne gikaw wiye gi gige mag lweny, bangʼe negioro joote e piny jo-Filistia duto mondo oter wach ne nyisechegi kendo ni jopinygi.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: ‘An Nyasach Ibrahim, Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo.’Nyasaye ok en Nyasach joma otho, to en Nyasach joma ngima.”
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

kikuyu: Donge usekelo ma kuomu uwegi, ka ujwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kane otelonu e yo?
english: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken the LORD your God, when he led you by the way?

kikuyu: Mokwongo, adwokone Nyasacha erokamano, kuom Yesu Kristo nikech un duto, nimar yie maru landore e pinje duto.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

kikuyu: “Winjie wachni, Ayub; bed mos ipar gik miwuoro mag Nyasaye.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

kikuyu: Negiwachone Josef niya, “Ruoth isekonyo ngimawa, omiyo ka ineno ni mano ber to wabiro bedo wasumb Farao.”
english: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe chuny Daudi nochandore nikech nosengʼado riak law Saulo.
english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

kikuyu: Kapod wan e kiruni to wachur ka wagombo mondo orwakwa gi odwa mar polo
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

kikuyu: “Bedo gi yiende mag sida mangʼeny nyalo miyo ibed ruoth? Donge wuonu ne nigi chiemo kod math? Notimo gima ratiro kendo nikare, omiyo duto nobedo maber kode.
english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.

kikuyu: Eka Juda nowacho niya, “We obed gi gik mane asingonego, nono to ji biro nyierowa. To bende aseorone nyadiendno, to ok inyal yude.”
english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Ne ioro barupe e nyingi iwuon ne ji duto man Jerusalem, ne Zefania wuod Maseya jadolo, kendo ne jodolo mamoko duto. Ne iwachone Zefania ni,
english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

kikuyu: Esta nodwoko ruoth niya, “Ka ihera kendo ineno ni ber miya gima akwayo, to yie ibi gi Haman e nyasi maselosonu.”
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

kikuyu: Ka ukelone Jehova Nyasaye misango mar cham kod cham mokwongo nyak, to nyaka uchiw wiye cham manyien mobul e mach kendo moyoki.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nitie moko manyamo kambula kende kata moko ma ombongʼ tiendegi kende ema opogore ariyo, mago to kik ucham. Ngamia kata obedo ni onyamo kambula kamano, to nikech ombongʼ tiende ok opogore, chik ok oyieni mondo uchame nikech ogak.
english: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat ma ok oyie, kata ngʼat moro ma ok winj tiend gik miwacho odonjo e chokruoku, to oyudo ka ji duto hulo wach, weche mowinjo nyalo loye gi bura, mi olokre,
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

kikuyu: To kane oyudo Paulo dwaro wuoyo, Galio nowacho ni jo-Yahudi niya, “Dine bedi ni ywaku ni kuom wach ketho chik kata tim achach ma ngʼatni osetimo, to dine awinjou.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

kikuyu: Tobia ma ja-Amon, mane ochungʼ e bathe, nowacho niya, “Ohinga ma gigerono, kata ka kibwe ema oidho, to obiro ruombore piny!”
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

kikuyu: Pok umedo rombe mool teko, pok uthiedho matuo, kendo kata mago mohinyore pok umako nigi kuonde mowil. Pok udwogo mago morwenyo kendo pok umanyo mago molal. Useritogi gi kwinyo kod gero.
english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jo-Farisai gi jopuonj chik nopenjo Yesu niya, “Angʼo momiyo jopuonjreni ketho chikwa kod puonj mag kwerewa, ka gichiemo gi lwedo mochido?”
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Kanaan modak kuno oneno ywak man kar dino cham man Atad, negiwacho niya, “Jo-Misri nigi kuyo mar ywak.” Mano ema omiyo iluongo loka Jordan kono ni Abel Mizraim.
english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Omiyo wasekelo mich ne Jehova Nyasaye kuom gik molos gi dhahabu mane wayako kaka; thiwni, manyonge, tere, stadi kod tigo mondo omi wapwodhrego e richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Ka jopon olemb mzabibu obiro iru, donge digiwe olemb mzabibu matin? Ka jokwoge obiro gotieno, donge gibiro kwalo mwandu magu kaka ginyalo?
english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?

kikuyu: “An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mane ogolou e piny Misri, ka uwuok e piny mane unie wasumbini.
english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Noyudo jandhok osechano kodgi ranyisi mobiro timo kowacho niya, “Ngʼat ma wangʼ ananyodhi e en; makeuru.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

kikuyu: To ok gingʼeyo kata matin ni joma otho ni kuno; bende ni joma lime ni e liel matut.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

kikuyu: Nyamin Tapenes nonywolone wuowi miluongo ni Genubath mane Tapenes opidho e dala ruoth maduongʼ. Kanyo Genubath nodak gi nyithind Farao.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Nomako wuod Sukoth mi openje penjo, kendo wuowino nondikone nying ruodhi piero abiro gabiriyo mag Sukoth.
english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

kikuyu: Daudi nokecho nikech mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye nomwomore kuom Uza, omiyo nochak kanyo ni Perez Uza, nying ma pod iluongogo kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar aboro, nyathino nyaka ter nyangu.
english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

kikuyu: Ji to pod ne timo misengini e kuonde motingʼore nikech od lemo ne pok oger ni nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Mosnauru Rufus, ngʼat ma Ruoth oyiero kod min-gi mosebedona kaka minwa an bende.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Ibiro madho kikombe mar nyaminu, kikombe moyarore kendo matut; en kikombe mabiro keloni achaya gi wichkuot nikech otingʼo gik mangʼeny.
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘You will drink of your sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You will be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ ka isepwodho jo-Lawi kendo ichiwogi kaka misango mifwayo, to nyaka gibi mondo gitim tijgi e Hemb Romo.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

kikuyu: Bedona e twech osemiyo jowete mathoth odoko thuondi kuom Ruoth, mi giyalo Wach Nyasaye gi chir maonge luoro.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

kikuyu: Ibiro yudo ni nyocha adhi Jerusalem kuom ndalo apar gariyo mosekalo mondo alem.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi modak Susa nochokore tarik apar gadek kod apar gangʼwen, to kane ochopo tarik apar gabich ne giyweyo mi odiechiengno nobedonegi odiechieng mor kod nyasi.
english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: “An Jehova Nyasaye angʼeyo timbeni gi paroni achiegni biro mondo achok ogendini duto kod dhoudi mawacho dhok mopogore opogore kendo ginibi mi ginine duongʼ mara maler.
english: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

kikuyu: Nyithindo duto makayo ma yawuowi mag Misri biro tho, kochakore gi wuod Farao makayo mobet e kom duongʼ nyaka wuod nyako ma jatich makayo ma jarego, kaachiel gi nyithind jamni mokwong nywol.
english: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda duto nokawo Azaria mane hike apar gi auchiel mokete ruoth kar wuon mare Amazia.
english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

kikuyu: To mana kaka e kindeno wuowi mane onywol kuom dwaro mar dhano nosando wuowi mane onywol gi teko mar Roho Maler, e kaka timore bende e kindeni.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

kikuyu: Jorito mag dala noyuda ka girito dala, mine apenjogi niya “Bende usenenonae ngʼat ma chunya ohero?”
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”

kikuyu: To Abram nowacho ne ruodh Sodom, “Asetingʼo lweta ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, Jachwech polo gi piny kendo asekwongʼora
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokelo masira kuom jo-Israel chakre okinyino nyaka kinde mane oketi norumo, kendo ji alufu piero abiriyo notho chakre Dan nyaka Bersheba.
english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

kikuyu: Uwach ne wuon ot modonjeno ni, ‘Japuonj penjo niya, ere oda mar welo monego achamie Sap Pasaka kod jopuonjrena?’
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Solomon nokelo farese koa Misri kod pinje mamoko duto.
english: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

kikuyu: Kuom herane, nowalowa chon mondo wabed yawuote kuom Yesu Kristo nikech mano ema ne chenrone kod dwarone.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

kikuyu: Omiyo ka ngʼato obironu mapuonjo gima opogore gi puonjni to kik iyiene odonj e odi kata rwake,
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

kikuyu: To ka Jehova Nyasaye okelo gima nyien mopogore gi mago duto mapile, kendo ma piny oyawo dhoge mi omwonyogi, gi gik moko duto ma mekgi, kendo ma gidhi ei bur ka gingima, eka unungʼe ni jogi osewuotho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi achaya.”
english: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”

kikuyu: mi lepe nolokore rachar marieny macharo wangʼ, nodoko rachar dherr maonge ngʼato angʼata e piny mangima mane nyalo luoko law mi rieny maler kamano.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

kikuyu: Ka ruoth obedo e kome mondo ongʼad bura; opiedho weche maricho duto gi wangʼe.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

kikuyu: Ahero jogo mohera, to jogo ma manya yuda.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nogolo terene e lwete mi omiyo Haman wuod Hamedatha, ja-Agag, ma jawasik jo-Yahudi.
english: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

kikuyu: joka Lawi ne gin ji alufu angʼwen gi mia auchiel (4,600),
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Asoya en bilo ne ngʼat machiwe, kamoro amora modhiye, odhi maber.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

kikuyu: Nying ja-Israel mane onegi gi nyar jo-Midian ne en Zimri wuod Salu, mane en jatend dhood Simeon.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek neno masira kabiro kendo opondo, to ngʼat mofuwo dhiyo adhiya nyime ma ohinyre.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: piny mar Negev kod paw Holo mar Jeriko miluongo ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Othidhe nyaka Zoar.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osegwedho tich lwetu. Oseritou ka uwuotho e thim malichni kendo kuom higni piero angʼwen-gi duto Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osebedo kodu mi ok uchando gimoro.
english: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

kikuyu: Chunye noduogo, kendo nochungʼ oa malo gisano. Eka Yesu nowachonegi mondo gimiye gimoro ocham.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: Eka nooro akuru mondo ofweny ka pi osedok chien e piny.
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

kikuyu: kiwacho ni, ‘Yaye gode mag Israel, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni gode madongo gi matindo, kendo ni bugni gi holni: Achiegni kelo ligangla mabiro kidhou, kendo abiro ketho kuonde motingʼore malo magu.
english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

kikuyu: Kuom mano chwech polo gi piny norumo gi gik mane ni eigi duto ka moro ka moro oket kare.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

kikuyu: Los ludhego gi yiend siala kendo bawgi gi dhahabu kendo iti kodgi kuom tingʼo mesa.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Nathan osedhi dala, Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo nyathi ma chi Uria nosenywolo ni Daudi gi tuo.
english: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

kikuyu: “Giwacho ni, wachoduru nyorochegi; kendo wawit ratekegi kucha.”
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

kikuyu: “Kiyie to tem ane jotichni kuom ndalo apar; ka ok imiyowa gimoro amora makmana alot gi pi modho.
english: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Udwoko kare, koro miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.”
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aluongo Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaya, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekaria kod Meshulam, mane gin jotelo, kod Joyiarib gi Elnathan, mane gin joma osomo,
english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

kikuyu: nikech kuome ema dhoudi mag joma oyie kuom Kristo duto manie polo gi piny yudoe nyinge madier.
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

kikuyu: Elisha noa kanyo modhi Bethel to kane oyudo owuotho e yo, yawuowi moko noyudo wuotho koa Bethel kendo ne giyanye kagiwacho niya, “Rabondoni, dhiyo adhiya! Rabondoni, dhiyo adhiya!”
english: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

kikuyu: “Luong Harun owadu kaachiel gi yawuote ma gin Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar kowuok kuom jo-Israel mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

kikuyu: (Omer en achiel kuom apar mar efa.)
english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.

kikuyu: Nonyisogi niya, “Kik usol osuru moloyo kaka idwaro ni mondo usol.”
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre apar gachielgo nodhi Galili, ewi got kama Yesu nonyisogi ni gidhiye.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

kikuyu: Koro weuru ajara mondo kik tol motweugo ridre, nimar Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, osenyisa wach mar kethruok mabiro kwako piny duto.
english: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.

kikuyu: Neginyiso Jakobo niya, “Josef pod ngima kendo koro en e ruodh Misri duto.” Jakobo ne dhoge omoko, mi ok noyie gi wachgino.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: nodwoko kowacho niya, “Kik ipar ni in kendi ema inikwo e dhood jo-Yahudi duto nikech in e od ruoth.
english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

kikuyu: Bednegi ranyisi e yore duto kitimo gik mabeyo. Kipuonjo to nyis ni in ngʼama ngimane oriere tir kendo ma ok dwar oyuma,
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

kikuyu: Asa notimo gik mabeyo kendo makare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God’s eyes,

kikuyu: To kik ucham remo, nikech remo en ngima, to ok onego ucham ngima gimoro kod ringe.
english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

kikuyu: Ere kaka idwaro ni Nyasaye otimni maber, to in to idagi lokori? In ema nyaka ingʼad e pachi iwuon, ok an, omiyo koro nyisane gima ingʼeyo.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

kikuyu: To ka kethogi kelo mwandu ni piny kamano kendo ka rem margi kelo mwandu ne joma ok jo-Yahudi, to mano kaka warruok margi nobed mwandu maduongʼ moloyo manade?
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

kikuyu: Un ji duto manie piny, beduru gi e nyime! Piny osegur motegno kendo ok noyienge.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Omiyo Senakerib ruodh Asuria noweyo lweny moloro kambi kendo nodok Nineve kuma nodakie.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

kikuyu: “Amaria jadolo maduongʼ ema notelnu e weche duto mag Jehova Nyasaye, to Zebadia wuod Ishmael ma jatend dhood Juda to notelnu e weche duto mag ruoth, to jo-Lawi noti kaka jotelo kuomu. Tiuru ka un gi chir, kendo Jehova Nyasaye obed gi jogo matimo maber.”
english: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good.”

kikuyu: Wuo kode kendo iwachne ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Adagi, in Farao ruodh Misri, ichalo gi thuond rachier modak e aore magi. In to iwacho niya, “Aora Nael en mara, mane aloso gi lweta awuon.”
english: Speak and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has said, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’

kikuyu: Lweny nobed e piny Misri kendo Kush nobed gi rem malit. Ji notho e piny Misri, to mwandugi noyaki, kendo mise mag-gi nomuki.
english: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.

kikuyu: Bende anaduog kae Jehoyakin wuod Jehoyakim ruodh Juda kod jogo mamoko duto mane oter e twech koa Juda mane odhi Babulon,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ‘nimar anatur jok mar ruodh Babulon.’ ”
english: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says the LORD; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jopuonjre nowinjore mar oro kony kaluwore gi nyalo margi, ni jowete mane odak Judea.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

kikuyu: To Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny noweyo e piny Juda joma odhier, mane onge gi gimoro; kendo e ndalogo nomiyogi puothe mzabibu kod puothe mamoko.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

kikuyu: Ruoth Joash ne ok oparo ngʼwono mane Jehoyada wuon Zekaria notimone, to nonego wuode mane otho kaywak niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye ne gima itimona kendo ochulni kuor.”
english: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May the LORD look at it, and repay it.”

kikuyu: Nimar achiegni podho, kendo rem ma an-go osiko koda.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

kikuyu: Omiyo negimake kane ochopo e dhorangaj Farese e kar od ruoth kendo kanyo ema neginege.
english: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

kikuyu: Agoyo erokamano ni Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa mosemiya teko nikech ne okwana kaka ja-adiera mi oyiera e tichne.
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

kikuyu: Manase ne ja-higni apar gariyo kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kuom higni piero abich gabich kodak Jerusalem.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Wandikonu kuom Wach mar ngima, mane nitie nyaka aa chakruok, ma wasewinjo kendo waseneno gi wengewa, kendo waserange maber mi wamule gi lwetewa.
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye dhi chiwo jo-Israel kaachiel kodi ni jo-Filistia, kendo kiny in kod yawuoti unubed koda. Jehova Nyasaye biro chiwo jolweny mag Israel ni jo-Filistia.”
english: Moreover the LORD will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The LORD will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: kata kamano un jo-Keni ibiro negu ndalo ma Ashur oterou e twech.”
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

kikuyu: Asebedo kodi kuonde duto misedhiye, kendo asetieko wasiki duto e nyimi. Koro abiro miyo nyingi bed maduongʼ kaka humb jomadongo manie piny.
english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

kikuyu: Kowe mabup gi chuny ma thuolo kimiye jamni, kar dino cham kod divai. Bedne mangʼwon kendo imiye kaluwore gi kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi osegwedhi.
english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

kikuyu: Nyaka iwachnegi wechena, kata giyie winjo kata gidagi, nikech gihero ngʼanyo.
english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

kikuyu: Omiyo mwandu mane giseloso kendo kano negitingʼo magingʼadogo Holo ma Omburi otiye.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

kikuyu: Kane Nahor ja-higni piero ariyo gochiko nonywolo Tera.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Kadesh mi gibworo e Got Hor, mantiere e tongʼ mar Edom.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato nyalo tingʼo mach e kore, ma lepe ok owangʼ?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

kikuyu: Ruoth Zedekia, kata kamano, nooro Jehukal wuod Shelemia gi jadolo Zefania wuod Maseya ir janabi Jeremia gi wachni: “Kiyie to lamnwa Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.”
english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to the LORD our God for us.”

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼwono mar Nyasaye makelo warruok osefwenyore ne ji duto.
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

kikuyu: “Eka joma karego nodwoke ni, ‘Ruoth, karangʼo mane wanenie kidenyo mi wamiyi chiemo, kata ka riyo oloyi, mi wamiyi gimoro imodho?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

kikuyu: chike mane amiyo kwereu kane agologi Misri, e kendo maliet makakni mach.’ Ne awacho ni, ‘Luora kendo itim gigo duto machikou to unubed joga, an bende nabed Nyasachu.
english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

kikuyu: Yesu nochako wuoth kendo koluwo tie Nam to oganda maduongʼ nobiro ire mi opuonjogi.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

kikuyu: Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye gi chunyi duto, kendo kik igen kuom ngʼeyoni iwuon;
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

kikuyu: Dibed ni wachako pwoyorenu kendo? Koso wachako dwaro barupe mag pwoch moa kuomu, kata mwabirogo iru, kaka jomoko ohero timo?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

kikuyu: Koso gin jomage mane okechogo kuom higni piero angʼwen? Donge nokecho gi joma notimo richo ma ringregi nodongʼ e thim kosetho?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato onego ter e twech to twech machalo kamano ema nyaka odhiye. Kendo ka ngʼato onego negi e lweny gi ligangla to liganglano ema nyaka negego. Ma e kinde ma jo-Nyasaye onego timie kinda kendo bed gi yie motegno.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Joma ngima ok ema dwar jathieth makmana joma tuo.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: “Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Jumbe gi keyo mar nyak mokwongo mar ngano kod Sawo mar Pono Olembe e rumb higa.
english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

kikuyu: Jo-Efraim nopenjo Gideon niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo isetimonwa kama? Angʼo ma notami luongowa kane idhi kedo gi jo-Midian?” Omiyo negidhawo kode matek.
english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

kikuyu: Koro Josef gi owetene duto kod tiengʼno duto notho,
english: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Macha remo! Nyaka bed ni ruodhigo osekedo kendgi giwegi monegore. Koro wadhi wayak Moab!”
english: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel mane oa e twech nochamo Pasakano, kanyakla gi jogo duto mano ngʼanyone timbe mochido mag ogendini mamoko modak machiegni kodgi mondo omi gidwar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, ate,

kikuyu: Kendo ne wawachone ruodha ni, ‘Rawerano ok nyal weyo wuon-gi! Ka oweye to wuon-gi biro tho.’
english: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

kikuyu: Jo-Reuben, Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nodwoko jotend anywola mag jo-Israel niya,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

kikuyu: To ne jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad, ne amiyogi kochakore Gilead nyaka e holo mar Arnon (e dier holono tir nobedo tongʼ) kendo koa Aora Jabok ma en tongʼ mar jo-Amon.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Ei magi duto ne ok uketo genou kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu,
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,

kikuyu: kendo giduto ne gimodho pi achiel mar chuny, nikech ne gimodho e lwanda mar chuny mane wuotho kodgi; to lwandano ne en Kristo.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, abiro nyiso herana ne dhood Juda kendo abiro resogi to ok abi resogi gi atungʼ, kata ligangla kata gige lweny kata gi farese kata gi jomoidho farese, to an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi ema anaresgi.”
english: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

kikuyu: Noloso kido mar malaika mar kerubi achiel e giko raumno kendo malaika mar ariyo e giko komachielo; kendo noriwogi ma gibedo gimoro achiel ewi raumno.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kaw ringʼono kod makati ma ok oketie thowi, ketgi e lwandani, kendo iol kado piny.” Kendo Gideon notimo kamano.
english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.

kikuyu: Eka Bildad ja-Shua nodwoko niya:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: Joma jaro ji kelo koko e dala, to jomariek ringo aa e mirima.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone Jonathan ma wuode to gi jotije duto mondo gineg Daudi. To Jonathan nohero Daudi ahinya,
english: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik koro uyie chir mane un-go lalnu, nikech obiro kelonu pok maduongʼ.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Pasia, gi jo-Lidia kod jo-Put ne gin jolweny magi makedoni. Negiliero okumbnigi gi ogutegi mag lweny e ohingagi kendo mano nomiyi duongʼ.
english: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.

kikuyu: An ema ne anyisogi yo monego gilu kendo nabedo kaka ruodhgi; ne achalo ruoth e dier jokedo mage; bende ne achalo ngʼat mahoyo joma ywak.”
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

kikuyu: Daudi noneno ka jotije kuodho wach kendgi mine ongʼeyo ni nyathi osetho. Nopenjo niya, “Nyathi osetho?” Negidwoke niya, “Ee, osetho.”
english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”

kikuyu: Lokreuru kendo uringi, ponduru e rogo mopandore, un joma odak Dedan, nimar anakel masira ne Esau e kinde ma anakume.
english: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.

kikuyu: Achien nofwenyore ne Jakobo; bangʼe nofwenyore ne joote duto,
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

kikuyu: Yesu nowuok e gwengʼ mar Turo kaluwo Sidon, mi nolor nyaka Nam Galili mondo ochopi e gwengʼ mar Dekapoli.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

kikuyu: to ngʼato ka ngʼato matimo maber noyud duongʼ gi pak kod kwe, mokwongo ni jo-Yahudi, eka bangʼe ni joma ok jo-Yahudi bende;
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: Adier, ka itimo kamano to inibed gi geno e ndalo mabiro, kendo genoni ok nongʼad oko.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Ne ipenjo ni, ‘En ngʼa ma umo riekona gi weche mofuwogi?’ Adier asewacho gik ma ok angʼeyo tiendgi, gik miwuoro modhiera ngʼeyo.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Noketho mier piero ariyo kochakore e aora Aroer nyaka Minith, mochopo nyaka Abel Keramim. Mano e kaka jo-Israel nokawo Amon.
english: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Kik ibed maluor. Angʼo ma ineno?” To dhakono nowachone niya, “Aneno chuny ngʼama nosetho kawuok e lowo.”
english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”

kikuyu: Joma wacho weche ma kamagi nyiso malongʼo ni gigeno yudo pinygi giwegi.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

kikuyu: “ ‘An e girkeni kende ma jadolo nigo. Kik umigi mwandu moro amora e piny Israel. An ema abiro bedo mwandugi.
english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

kikuyu: Nimar Ezra nosechiwore owuon ne somo matut kendo rito Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye, kod puonjo chikene gi buchene e Israel.
english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the LORD’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mogik mar Sawo, mane en odiechiengʼ maduongʼ ahinya, Yesu nochungʼ mowacho gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Ngʼat ma riyo oloyo mondo obi ira omodhi.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

kikuyu: Omako mil polo gi lwete kendo otimogo gima odwaro.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

kikuyu: Nenore malongʼo ni onge ngʼama inyalo keto kare e nyim Nyasaye nikech omako Chik, nikech, “Ngʼat makare nobed mangima kuom yie.”
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

kikuyu: Epafra bende nonyisowa kuom hera ma Roho Maler osemiyou.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Ne ijwangʼowa mondo ongamwa ka rombe kendo isekeyowa e dier pinje.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

kikuyu: Weche moko mag loch Abija, timbene duto kod gik mane owacho ondiki e kitap Ido janabi.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi weche mag Injili, to gin wasik Nyasaye, nikech un, to kaluwore gi yiero, to ohergi nikech kweregi
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

kikuyu: Un ema Ngʼama Maler osewirou omiyo ungʼeyo adiera.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

kikuyu: Okwongʼ ngʼatno mane okelone wuonwa wach, manomiye obedo gi mor, kowacho, “Nyathi monywolni en wuowi!”
english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.

kikuyu: Noloso mesni apar moketogi e hekalu, ka abich oket yo milambo to abich yo nyandwat. Bende noloso tewni mia achiel mag dhahabu mikirogo.
english: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

kikuyu: Ywari gi rem, yaye Nyar Sayun, mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo, nikech koro ochuni ni nyaka iwe dala maduongʼ mondo idhi idagie pap nono. Ibiro dhi Babulon kendo kuno ema nokonyie. Jehova Nyasaye noresi kuno kogoli e lwet wasiki.
english: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom ji apar gariyogo, mane iluongo ni Judas Iskariot, nodhi ir jodolo madongo,
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

kikuyu: Joge Daudi gi Joab noduogo koa pecho e sechego kendo negikelo gik mangʼeny moyaki. Abner to ne osewuok oweyo Daudi Hebron nikech Daudi ne oseweye thuolo mondo odhi, kendo noweye odhi gi kwe.
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

kikuyu: Kain nobedoe achiel gi chiege mi chiege nomako ich kendo nonywolo Enok. Noyudo Kain gero dala maduongʼ kendo nochako dalano nying wuode ma Enok.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
