kikuyu: To ka jo-Moab nobiro e kambi mar Israel; jo-Israel nowuok mokedo kodgi nyaka negiringo. Omiyo jo-Israel nomonjo pinyno monego jo-Moab.
english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

kikuyu: Eka iwachnegi ni Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni, ‘Nikech wuoneu nojwangʼa, mi giluwo bangʼ nyiseche manono mi gitiyonegi kendo lamogi. Ne gikweda kendo ok girito chikna.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says the LORD, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.

kikuyu: Nochiwogi ni jo-Gibeon mano onegogi moweyogi ewi got nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Giduto ji abiriyogo notho kanyakla kane oneg-gi e kinde mokwongʼo mag keyo, mana ka ichako kayo shairi.
english: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

kikuyu: Dwarowa ok en mondo jomoko odongʼ gi tingʼ mayot, to un wamiu tingʼ mapek, to dwarowa en ni ji duto ochiw maromre.
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

kikuyu: Mosnauru Priskila gi Akula, ma jotich koda kaachiel e Kristo Yesu.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Inyalo kawo nyithinde to iwe winyono odhi, mondo omi idhi maber kendo idag amingʼa.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

kikuyu: To kata kamano nitie tim maber ma apwoyigo, to isin gi timbe maricho mag jo-Nikolao ma an bende asin-go.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

kikuyu: Omiyo Saulo nopenjo Nyasaye niya, “Bende anyalo lawo jo-Filistia? Ibiro ketogi e lwet jo-Israel koso?” To Nyasaye ne ok odwoke chiengʼno.
english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

kikuyu: Nikech hera maduongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye osiko mochwere, kendo ngʼwonone ok rum omiyo ok otiekwa.
english: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo kamoro, nobworo gotieno nikech chiengʼ nosepodho. Nonindo kanyo moteno wiye gi kidi moro mane okwanyo kanyo.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

kikuyu: Kaka yamb nyandwat kelo koth, e kaka lep mafuongʼo wach kelo miero.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

kikuyu: Koro Jeremia ne nigi thuolo mondo obi kendo odhi e dier ji, nimar ne pod ok okete e od twech.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

kikuyu: Kuonde motingʼore gi malo kata kamano ne ok omuki kendo ji nodhi nyime mana gi chiwo misengini kendo wangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kanyo.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

kikuyu: Epafra ma jathuru kendo ma misumba Kristo Yesu bende omosou. Osiko olemonu matek ma ok oywe, mondo omi uchungʼ motegno, e dwaro Nyasaye duto kendo ka un gi adiera chutho.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

kikuyu: To ngʼat moro noywayo atungʼ mare modiro asere ma nochwowo ruodh Israel e kind law lweny mane orwako. Ruoth nonyiso jariemb gache niya, “Lok garini mondo igola ka, nimar ahinyora marach.”
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

kikuyu: Ruoth medo wacho niya, “Richogi kod timbegi mamono ok anachak apar kendo.”
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

kikuyu: “Mi Harun gi yawuote chikni: ‘Magi e chike mag misango miwangʼo pep: Misango miwangʼo pep nyaka nind e kendo mar misango otieno duto nyaka okinyi, bende mach kik tho e kendo mar misangono.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, e ndalogo ne aneno joma chwo moa Juda mane okendo nyi Ashdod, Amon kod Moab.
english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;

kikuyu: Isetimo kinda kendo isehori e bwo chandruok nikech nyinga, to ok iseol.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

kikuyu: Saulo nochungʼ oa malo, to kane oyawo wengene, to ne ok onyal neno gimoro. Omiyo negimako bade kagitaye gitere Damaski.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

kikuyu: Barak nowachone niya, “Ka idhi koda, abiro dhi; to ka ok idhi koda, to ok abi dhi.”
english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo weche Yesu mane oyudo osewacho kuom tho mane obiro thogo ochop kare.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: En kende ema en lwandana kendo warruokna; en e ohingana, onge gima biro bwoga.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Daudi nochungo kar tiende mowacho niya, “Winjauru jowetena kendo jothurwa. Ne achano e chunya mondo ager ot kaka kar yweyo mar Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed raten mar tiend Nyasachwa kendo ne an gi chenro mar gere.
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

kikuyu: gi sirni angʼwen kod rachungi mag mula angʼwen. Ramekigi gi rangʼawgi nolos gi fedha.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi pache nochandore, kuom mano nooro mondo oluongne ajuoke duto kod jorieko duto mag Misri. Farao nonyisogi lekne, to onge ngʼato angʼata mane nyalo lokone tiend lekgo.
english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: to ka udwogo ira kendo urito chikena, to kata obedo ni jou oke e tungʼ piny ka tungʼ piny, abiro chokogi ka agologi kuondego mi akelgi kama aseyiero kaka kar dak mar Nyinga.’
english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

kikuyu: kowacho niya: Nying Nyasaye mondo opaki mochwere manyaka chiengʼ; nikech rieko kod teko gin mage.
english: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

kikuyu: Eka Elkana nodok dalane Rama to wuowino noweyo katiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e bwo Eli jadolo.
english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served the LORD before Eli the priest.

kikuyu: To chiengʼ moro achiel jachien nodwokogi niya, “Yesu to angʼeyo, kendo Paulo bende angʼeyo, to un, to un ngʼa gini?”
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

kikuyu: Nikech ka ngʼato obiro e dieru ma oyalonu Yesu mopogore gi mano mane wayalonu, kendo kata uyudo Roho machielo gi mano mane uyudo, kendo uyie gi Injili moro amora mopogore gi mane uyudo, kendo uchikone itu gimor,
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

kikuyu: “Kone jo-Israel oyier miechgi madongo mag tony, kaka ne asenyisou kokalo kuom Musa,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

kikuyu: Koro jo-Midian duto gi jo-Amalek kod jogo moa yo wuok chiengʼ noriwore e lweny ma gingʼado aora Jordan kendo gigo kambi e Holo mar Jezreel.
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

kikuyu: To Balaam nonyiso Nyasaye niya, “Balak wuod Zipor, ma ruodh Moab, noorona ote ni:
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

kikuyu: Tiek tijeni ma oko kendo ik puothegi; bangʼ mano, eka iger odi.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mogeno kuom mwandune biro podho; to joma kare nodhi nyime mana ka oboke mangʼich.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

kikuyu: To Petro nochako okwer kendo, kendo gikanyono thuon gweno nochako kok.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: To ka chiengʼ nowuok, chamgo nowangʼ, kendo nikech ne gionge tiendegi, ne gitwo.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

kikuyu: nimar omuko rangeye mag mula, kendo ongʼado lodi mag nyinyo.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

kikuyu: Juda oseketho winjruok osetimo gima mono e Israel kendo e Jerusalem: Osechido kama ler mar lemo ma Jehova Nyasaye ohero kuom kendo nyar joma lamo nyiseche mamoko.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

kikuyu: Eka ne awacho, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, mano kaka isewuondo jogi kod Jerusalem ka iwacho ni, ‘Unubed gi kwe,’ mana sa ma ligangla ni e dwondwa.”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Asher ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa dhood Naftali ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa dhood Manase ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000),
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Omiyo Ahab nodok dala kokuyo kendo ka iye owangʼ nikech Naboth ja-Jezreel nodwoke niya, “Ok anamiyi gir mwandu mar kwerena.” Nonindo e kitandane ka oparore kendo notamore chiemo.
english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

kikuyu: Un ungʼeyo kaka ne wadak Misri kendo kaka ne wakalo e kind pinje ka wabiro ka.
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

kikuyu: Lweny nobedo mager kama Saulo ne nitie kendo kane jodir asere ojuke to ne gihinye marach.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: “E kindeno duongʼ mar Jakobo nolal; kendo nodok manok.
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

kikuyu: Eka negichako donjone kagiwacho niya, “Waseyudo ngʼatni kokelo tulo e pinywa. Okwedo golo osuru ni Kaisar kendo owacho owuon ni en Kristo, ma Ruoth.”
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

kikuyu: Enobed pinyruoth mayom yomie moloyo pinjeruodhi duto kendo ok nochak otingʼre oyombi pinje mamoko kendo. Abiro miyo obed manyap mogik ma ok nochak obed gi loch ewi pinje mamoko.
english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.

kikuyu: Masira mokwongo osekadho, to masiche ariyo mamoko pod biro.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

kikuyu: Laban kod Bethuel nodwoke niya, “Ma-oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ok wanyal wachoni gimoro amora.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from the LORD. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

kikuyu: Nikech richo ma gitimo gi dhogi kuom wuoyo, nikech weche mawuok e dhogi, wegi mondo sungagi ogajgi. Nikech gikwongʼo ji kendo gi wuondo ji,
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

kikuyu: Nimar asiko achandora seche duto, kendo ayudo kum okinyi kokinyi.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

kikuyu: To wuoguru udhi unyis jopuonjrene, kaachiel gi Petro ni, ‘Otelo nyimu odhi Galili. Kuno ema ubiro nenee mana kaka nosenyisou motelo.’ ”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

kikuyu: Ipuka oko ka pi, kendo chokena duto osewil. Chunya olokore odok; oseleny morumo e iya.
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

kikuyu: Nimar pinyruodh Nyasaye ok en chiemo gi metho, to en ngima makare gi kwe kod mor ei Roho Maler,
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Onge jo-Anak mane odongʼ e piny jo-Israel; makmana joma nodongʼ Gaza, Gath kod Ashdod.
english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka japiny moro odak e dieru, to kik usande.
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nopenjo dhakono kuom wach nyathineno kendo nowachone ni en kamano. Eka ruoth nogolo chik ne jatelo kuom dhakono kowacho niya, “Dwokne dhakono gige duto, kaachiel gi ohala duto mosewuok e puotheno chakre chiengʼ mane oa e pinyni nyaka chiengʼ mane oduogoe.”
english: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

kikuyu: Jogo duto nowuoro ahinya, magipenjore niya, “Ma to en angʼo? Puonj manyien kendo man-gi teko! Ngʼatni chiko koda ka jochiende kendo giwinje.”
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

kikuyu: Yo milambo, ma pimne romo kilomita ariyo, rangeye adek nobedie, ma gin: rangaj Simeon, rangaj Isakar gi rangaj Zebulun.
english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

kikuyu: Ka wan kuom Yesu kendo wayie kuome to wanyalo dhi e nyim Nyasaye ka wan thuolo chutho kendo ka wan gi chir.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

kikuyu: Ok enoyie chudo moro amora; ok enoyie asoya kata obedo ni en gima duongʼ manade.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane obedo ruoth kendo norito Jerusalem kuom higni piero ariyo gochiko. Min mare ne nyinge Jehoadin, nyar Jerusalem.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To negiringo gia e nyim jo-Israel kendo Daudi nonego jolwenjgi alufu abiriyo ma joidho geche miywayo gi farese to gi jolweny mawuotho gi tiendgi alufu piero angʼwen. Bende nonego Shofak mane jatend jolwenjgi.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

kikuyu: Yaye, mad wiya bed ka soko mar pi kendo pi wangʼa mol ka aora! Dwaywak odiechiengʼ kod otieno nikech nek mar joga.
english: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikwongʼri gi miriambo ni ngʼato gi nyinga nimar kitimo kamano to ichayo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata wawuoyo kama, osiepewa mwageno, to wan gi gigeno kuomu kuom gik mabeyo moloyo, ma gin olembe mabeyo ma warruok nyago.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo yiend sida gi siala, gi ochwoga kod zeituni twi e piny motimo ongoro. Abiro pidho yiende kuonde ma yande ojwangʼ, bap ndege gi obudo nodongʼ kaachiel,
english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Lawi kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ka uyudo koa kuom jo-Israel achiel kuom apar ma amiyou kaka girkeni magu, to nyaka un bende ugol achiel kuom apar mar achiel kuom aparno kaka chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye reso jotichne; onge ngʼato kata achiel mopondo kuome ma bura biro loyo.
english: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Eka Ezra noa e nyim od Nyasaye mi odhi e agoch Jehohanan wuod Eliashib. E sa mane en kanyo, ne ok ochamo chiemo kendo ne ok omodho pi, nikech nodhi nyime kokuyo kuom bedo maonge ratiro mar joma noa e twech.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abiriyo kane divai oromo ruoth Ahasuerus nochiko jotichne mabwoch abiriyo magin Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar gi Karkas,
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato moluwo mano, chiegni ji duto modak Antiokia nochokore mondo owinj wach Ruoth.
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Nonuru timbeu.
english: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Ee, ochulo.” Ka Petro nochopo e ot, Yesu ema nokwongo wuoyo kode kapenje niya, “Iparo nade kuom wachni, Simon? Ruodhi mag piny choko osuru mopogore opogore kuom nyithindgi koso kuom jomoko?”
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

kikuyu: Jonathan nopenjo wuon-gi niya, “Angʼo momiyo nyaka otho? Angʼo mosetimo?”
english: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”

kikuyu: “Ket jo-Lawi mondo obedna kaka kayo e lo jo-Israel, kendo jamni mag jo-Lawi e lo jambgi. Jo-Lawi nyaka bed maga. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Negikwangʼ nyaka Ofir kendo negikelo dhahabu maromo kilo alufu apar gangʼwen mine gikelo ne ruoth Solomon.
english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.

kikuyu: “Yaye, in got maduongʼ, in to in angʼo? Ibiro pieyi piny michal gi pap e nyim Zerubabel. Bangʼe obiro keto kido mogik mar gedo ka ji kok gimor ni, ‘Nyasaye mondo ogwedh odni! Nyasaye mondo ogwedh odni!’ ”
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

kikuyu: Shem nonywolo Arfaksad, Arfaksad nonywolo Shela.
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni adek, keluru achiel kuom apar duto mosechiw e higano mondo ukan-gi e miechu,
english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho mano, Yesu noluongo gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Lazaro, wuog oko!”
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mano kaka unune malit un jokwath maketho kendo keyo romba kar kwadhgi!”
english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Chunye nomako weche Jehova Nyasaye, to bende nogolo e Juda kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo e Juda kaachiel gi sirni milamo mag Ashera.
english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu owuon biro riembo wasiku e nyimu. Omiyo riembgiuru gia e nyimu, kendo unukaw pinygi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nosingonu.
english: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as the LORD your God spoke to you.

kikuyu: Gikanyono noluwe kodhi kode mana ka rwadh bwoch mitero kar yengʼo, kata ka mwanda madonjo e obeto
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

kikuyu: Ka ok oloko pache to obiro piago liganglane; obiro dolo okumbane mi otwe tondene.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

kikuyu: Nimar ne ok awuoyo gi dwacha awuon, to Wuoro ma noora ema nochika mondo awachi gik ma asebedo ka awacho kendo kaka onego awachgi.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

kikuyu: E dhoudi ariyogo mag yiend zeituni nopayoe kerubi, gi yiend othidhe kod thiepe maupe, kendo nobawo kerubi kod yiend othidhego gi dhahabu moleny.
english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

kikuyu: Ok anachak ayie uwinj siboi mar ogendini; kendo ok unuchak une malit ka ji jarou kata ka gimiyo pinyu podho, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.’ ”
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni enoresi odiechiengʼno, ok nochiwi ne jogo miluoro.
english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says the LORD; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

kikuyu: Ka noyudo owuotho e pap godhiambo chiengʼ moro ka owuoyo gi Nyasaye, kendo kane orango malo, noneno ngamia kabiro.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

kikuyu: Asewuoyo moromo, to ok ayudo dwoko omiyo koro ok abi wuoyo kendo.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

kikuyu: To kuom misango mar lalruok ma jo-Israel golo, asekawo agoko miliero kendo ifwayo kod bam michiwo kaka pok kendo asemiyogi Harun jadolo kod yawuote kaka pokgi mapile pile kuom jo-Israel.’ ”
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Kar romb jogo ne gin chwo apar gariyo.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noketogi e kor polo mondo gi chiw ler e piny,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

kikuyu: Kane Solomon osetieko lamogi duto kod kwayogi ni Jehova Nyasaye, nochungʼ oa e nyim kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye, kama nogoyoe chonge kotingʼo bade kochomo polo.
english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

kikuyu: Koda ka osiepna mane ageno kuome, ngʼat mane chiemo koda, bende osendhoga.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat maratego moloye omonje mi oloye to omayo ngʼatno gige lweny mane okete e genone, kendo oyako gige odhigo.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Jaresni, Ngʼat Maler mar Israel wacho: “An e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi, mapuonji gima owinjore kodi kendo manyisi yo monego iluw.
english: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo auchiel, Yesu nokawo Petro gi Jakobo, kod Johana owadgi Jakobo mi notelonegi ma gidhi ewi got malo kar kendgi.
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

kikuyu: Lokri, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo iresa; resa nikech herani ma ok rum.
english: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: To in, Kora, kod joma luwou duto nyaka tim ma: Kawuru ubani
english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo, nyaka ne awinj wach yie ma un-go kuom Ruoth Yesu kendo kuom hera ma uherogo joma oyie duto,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Ka idok ir Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, to ibiro geri kendo. Ka igolo timbe maricho mabor gi dalani,
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

kikuyu: Abiro moko mach kuom Misri; to Pelusiuma biro bedo gi rem malit. Koth maduongʼ nochwe Thebes mamuk ohinga mare; to Memfis biro bedo gi chandruok ma ok rum.
english: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime.

kikuyu: kendo kik iwe timo ngʼwono ni jooda kata mana ka Jehova Nyasaye osetieko wasik Daudi e wangʼ piny.”
english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the LORD has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Bebai, ji mia auchiel gi piero ariyo gaboro (628)
english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: kata jokuo, kata jowuoro, kata jomer, kata joketh nying ji, kata jomecho, ok noyud gweth mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ notedna rwath achiel, rombe auchiel machwe, kod gwen, to ndalo apar ka ndalo apar divai mopogore opogore nokel mangʼeny. To kata kamano, ne ok adwaro chiemo mane opog ne jatelo, nikech gigo mane idwaro ne ohewo jogi tingʼo.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

kikuyu: Koro Sarai chi Abram ne pok onywolone nyithindo. To ne en gi misumba ma nyako ma nyar Misri, ma nyinge ne Hagar;
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

kikuyu: Nyaka itiek od Ahab ma ruodhi, kendo abiro chulo kuor nikech remb jotichna ma jonabi kendo nikech remb jotich Jehova Nyasaye mane ochwer gi Jezebel.
english: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

kikuyu: Omiyo Gehazi nolawo Naaman, kane Naaman onene kolawe, ne olor piny oa e gache mondo oromne, kopenje niya, Gik moko duto nikare?
english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”

kikuyu: Kaka winyo ma butno e tongʼ mane ok onywolo, e kaka ngʼatno mayudo mwandu gi yore ma ok kare. Ka nus ngimane oserumo, mwandune noweye, kendo gikone nonere malongʼo ni en ngʼama ofuwo.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye olocho nyaka chiengʼ, oseguro kom loch mare mar ngʼado bura.
english: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne awinjo malaika mochungʼne pige kawacho niya, “In kare kuom kelo kumgi, yaye Nyasaye mantie kendo mane nitie bende in e Jal Maler, nikech isengʼado bura kare;
english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

kikuyu: kowacho niya, “Aseketho, nimar asendhogo remo maonge ketho.” To negidwoke niya, “Mano obadhowa e angʼo? Mano en wachni iwuon.”
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

kikuyu: Nikech in ngʼat makare kendo mogen e nyima kendo nikech aheri, abiro chiwo ji kar loi mondo aresigo kendo abiro chiwo ji mamoko mondo ochungʼ e loi.
english: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.

kikuyu: Lum ner kendo maua tuo mi lwar piny, to wach Nyasachwa osiko manyaka chiengʼ.”
english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

kikuyu: Daudi noloyo jo-Moab bende kendo negibedo e bwo lochne kendo negigolone osuru.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

kikuyu: Koro kech nomako pinyno kendo Abram nodhi Misri mondo odhi odag kuno kuom kinde matin nikech kech ne duongʼ.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Oriembe ogole e ler mi otere e mudho, kendo humbe orumo e piny.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

kikuyu: To onge wach, chiwruok gi mor ber abera, makmana ni nyaka utim kamano kuom timo gima ber. To dine ber moloyo kutimo kamano kinde duto, kata antie kata aonge.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo achiel moro ma nengone tek ahinya to noa modhi kendo nouso gige mane en-go duto mongʼiewego.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Bezalel, Oholiab kod jotich duto molony mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo rieko gi nyalo mar ngʼeyo kaka itiyo tich duto mar gero kama ler mar lemo nyaka ti mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osechiko.”
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iseneno timgini; kik ilingʼ. Kik ibed koda mabor, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: ‘Ngʼat molochono norit ogendini gi ludh nyinyo, kendo notogi matindo tindo ka ngʼama toyo agulu,’ mana kaka Wuora osemiya teko mar loch.
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

kikuyu: Kendo yiende mag bungene nodongʼ manok, ma nyathi matin nyalo kwanogi.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

kikuyu: To in Daniel, um kitabuni kendo idine godok nyaka chop ndalo giko. To e ndalono ji mangʼeny nodhi koni gi koni ka gimanyo rieko.”
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Jethro oseorone wach niya, “An, jaduongʼni Jethro abiro iri gi chiegi kaachiel gi nyithindi ariyo.”
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

kikuyu: Shimei nokwongʼe kawacho niya, “Wuog idhi, wuog idhi in ngʼat mosechwero remo, kendo mofuwoni.
english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

kikuyu: Koro abiro turo jok ma giketo e ngʼuti kendo abiro chodo nyororo motweyigo.”
english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

kikuyu: kendo Asa kod jolweny mage nolawogi nyaka Gerar. Jo-Kush mangʼeny nonegi mane ok ginyal konyo nikech Jehova Nyasaye gi jolweny mage ema notimo mano. Jo-Juda noyako gik mangʼeny ahinya.
english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

kikuyu: Kamano ngʼat Nyasaye noduogo kode mochiemo kendo metho e ode.
english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

kikuyu: Kik uwegi gidagi e pinyu, ka ok kamano to ginimi utim richo e nyima, nikech lamo nyisechegi nobednu obadho.”
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

kikuyu: Ibiro chamo olemb luchi; iniyud gweth kendo inidhi maber.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

kikuyu: Ei baruwano nondikoe niya, “Ket Uria e laini manyime kama lweny gerie ahinya. Eka weyeuru kende mondo ogoye manege.”
english: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

kikuyu: Ne asedage kendo jopinje moko mager notongʼe mowite kucha. Bedene madongo nopodho ewi gode kendo ei holni duto; bedene mamoko noriere piny kotur otur e holni madiny mag piny. Ogendini duto mag piny nowuok oa e bwo tipone modar oweye.
english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

kikuyu: “Anajwangʼ oda, anabol girkeni maga; anachiw ngʼatno mahero e lwet wasike.
english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

kikuyu: Nyaka ipuonj weche mowinjore gi puonj ma adiera.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

kikuyu: Fweny ma gineno ok gin adier kendo gikoro weche mag miriambo. Giwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osewacho,” to Jehova Nyasaye to ok oorogi, kendo pod gin gi geno ni weche ma gikorogo biro timore.
english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

kikuyu: Joka Jakobo duto noromo ji piero abiriyo, nikech Josef to noyudo osechopo e piny Misri.
english: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.

kikuyu: Elisha ne ooro jatichne mondo odhi okone niya, “Dhiyo, inyumri e aoro Jordan nyadibiriyo, to dendi biro chango kendo ibiro pwodhori.”
english: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”

kikuyu: Kanyo ema inyis Zadok jadolo gi Nathan janabi ni gibiro wire obed Ruoth ewi Israel duto. Gouru atungʼ turumbete kukok ni, ‘Ruoth Solomon obed mangima amingʼa!’
english: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

kikuyu: Samson nowachone jatich mane omako lwete niya, “Keta ane kama anyalo muloe sirni mosiro hekaluni, mondo omi ayiengra kuomgi.”
english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”

kikuyu: Andikonu kuom Kristo un owetewa maler kendo ma jo-adiera man Kolosai: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa obed kodu.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Solomon ne nigi udi alufu piero angʼwen moger ni Farese kod Farese alufu apar gariyo.
english: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

kikuyu: Los tonde milierogo pasia e riak pasia man-gi range marambulu kendo itim kamano e riak pasia matungʼ komachielo.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Adier timbe mamono chalo gi mach maliel; ma wangʼo pedo kod kuthe, kendo omiyo bungu modinore wangʼ mi dhuol iro maduongʼ mochomo malo.
english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

kikuyu: Pile weche matek olworowa koni gi koni, to ok chunywa ool; wadhier nono, to ok wajogi;
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

kikuyu: Sewni mutimo ka dwe opor kod sewni moyier chido chunya, giselokore tingʼ mapek matura bende aol gi tingʼogi.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

kikuyu: Anapwodhgi kuom richo magisetimona kendo anawenegi richogi duto mag ngʼanyona.
english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.

kikuyu: Ne owachonu singruokne, ma gin Chike Apar, mane ochikou mondo uluw kendo ne ondikogi e kite mopa ariyo.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

kikuyu: Eka Rebeka nowacho ne Isaka niya, “ajok gi ngima nikech nyi jo-Hiti-gi. Ka Jakobo bende nyalo kawo dhako mana kuom nyi jo-Hiti-gi, to owinjore atho.”
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi nodiro ludhe piny kendo nolokore thuol. To ludh Harun nomwonyo ludhegigo.
english: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

kikuyu: mondo oreswa e lwet wasikwa kendo omi watine maonge luoro,
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

kikuyu: Ne giorona wach achielni nyadingʼwen, to seche duto ne amiyogi dwoko machalre.
english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

kikuyu: “Omiyo ne asudo bute mi anege, nikech ne angʼeyo ni kaka ne osepodho ne ok onyal chungʼ malo mi otony. Ne akawo osimbo mar loch mane ni e wiye gi bangli mane ni e kor bade kendo asekelogi ka ni ruodha.”
english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, jo-Juda nodhi mondo giked gi jo-Kanaan modak e piny manie got Negev kod tiend gode mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

kikuyu: Koro iparo ni ngʼat monyono Wuod Nyasaye piny gi tiende, makawo remo mar singruok mane opwodhego ka gima nono, kendo ma yanyo Roho mar ngʼwono, to biro yudo kum malich machal nade?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

kikuyu: Ma e kaka ibiro gere: Borne en fut mia angʼwen gi piero abich, lachne en fut piero abiriyo gabich kendo tutne fut piero angʼwen gabich.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

kikuyu: Gik ma wasewinjo kendo ma wangʼeyo, mane wuonewa onyisowa.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nonano, mochako ooro ngʼat machielo, to en neginege. Nomedo oro jotichne mamoko mangʼeny, mamoko kuomgi negigoyo to moko ginego.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

kikuyu: Lemo mare kod kaka Nyasaye nowinjo ywakne kaachiel gi richone kod kethone duto kod kuonde manogeroe kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo kaachiel gi sirni mag Ashera milamo, kod nyiseche manono kapod ok olokore, magi duto ondiki e kitap jonen.
english: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro goyou gi tuoche mi otieku e piny ma udhi kawo.
english: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: To richou ema osepogou gi Nyasachu; richou ema omiyo osepandonu wangʼe mondo kik owinju.
english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

kikuyu: Owetewa, gik mosetimorenu chal gi gik mane osetimore ni kanisa mar jo-Nyasaye man kuom Kristo Yesu e piny Judea, nimar ne usandoru e lwet ogandau mana kaka gin bende negisandore e lwet jo-Yahudi wetegi.
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokaw Juda kaka girkeni mare e piny maler, kendo enochak oyier Jerusalem.
english: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Jeriko nooro wach ni Rahab niya, “Gol oko jogo mane obiro iri kendo odonjo e odi, nikech gisebiro mondo gitim nonro ma lingʼ-lingʼ e pinyni duto.”
english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

kikuyu: To ka wuod nyamin Paulo nofwenyo gima jogo ne chano timo, nodhi nyaka kama jolweny odakie monyiso Paulo wachno.
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

kikuyu: Ji duto ma oneni biro ringi kawacho ni, ‘Nineve osepodho ere ngʼama noywage?’ Ere kama danwangʼie ngʼama nyalo hoyi?”
english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

kikuyu: Jotend pinyni kata achiel ok nowinjo tiend rieko mwayaloni, nikech ka dine giwinje, to ok dine giguro Ruodh Duongʼ.
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

kikuyu: Bed kingʼeyo gadiera ni ngʼama kamano en Jaricho ma pache okethore kendo en ngʼama ketho kongʼeyo.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

kikuyu: Par jotichni ma gin Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo kendo kik ine wich teko margi, timbegi maricho kod richo mag-gi
english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

kikuyu: Paruru kawuononi puonj mane uyudo kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nimar kata obedo ni nyithindu pok ongʼeyo kata neno puonjno, to un to ungʼeye. Bende paruru duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye gi tekone kod bat morie;
english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

kikuyu: “ ‘Jodolo ok oyienegi mondo giliel wigi, kata tito yie tikgi bende kik gisar dendgi.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

kikuyu: Musa nokawo agoko mi ofwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo; ma ne pok mar misango mar im miwalogo Harun, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Malaike ok ema Nyasaye osemiyo teko mar bedo gi loch e piny mabiro.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

kikuyu: Un joma osetonyne ligangla, auru kendo kik ugalru! Paruru Jehova Nyasaye e piny mabor, kendo upar Jerusalem.”
english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember the LORD from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

kikuyu: “Higni mia angʼwen gi piero ochiko en kar romb kinde moseketi ne jou kendo ne dalau maler mondo otiek ketho mondo one ni richo orumo mondo opwodh ji kuom richo. Osechiw thuolono mondo tim makare mochwere obi, mondo oum fweny kod koro, kendo mondo owir Kama Ler Moloyo.
english: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

kikuyu: Bende kik iwe wadonj e tem, to reswa e lwet ngʼat marach.’
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

kikuyu: Dhiyo e kweth mag jamni kendo ikelna nyidiek ariyo mopugno, mondo mi atedne wuonu ringʼo mamit kaka ohero-cha.
english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

kikuyu: To ne, ginibi ka gia mabor; moko kawuok yo nyandwat, moko kawuok yo yimbo, moko to nowuogi e gwenge mag Aswan.”
english: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto ma jo-higni piero ariyo kadhi nyime mane nyalo tiyo e lwenj Israel nokwan kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

kikuyu: Yaye ruoth, in e ruoth mar ruodhi. Nyasach polo asemiyi loch gi teko gi nyalo kod duongʼ;
english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

kikuyu: wuod Maath, wuod Matathias, wuod Semein, wuod Josek, wuod Joda,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: “Nyaka gikaw nanga marambulu kendo gium rachungi taya ma en kar keto gima chiwo ler, kaachiel gi techene, gi gima ingʼadogo otambi kod odheru, kod njage duto mikanoe mo.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

kikuyu: To bende le disungre ne ngʼat matongʼo kode, koso musimeno dinyisre ne ngʼat ma ngʼeto kode? Bende arungu digo ngʼato kaonge ngʼama odire, koso okwajo diwuothi kaonge ngʼama osirore kode?
english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

kikuyu: Wuod dhako ma ja-Israel noyanyo Nying Jehova Nyasaye mi ojare; omiyo negikele e nyim Musa. (Min-gi ne nyinge Shelomith, nyar Dibri mane oa e dhood Dan.)
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Un to ne utho e timbeu ma ok kare kod richou,
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

kikuyu: wangʼi ne oneno ringra ei minwa; ndalona duto e piny-ka ne ondiki chon gi lala, e kitabu mari kane pok kata achiel kuomgi obetie.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

kikuyu: Abiro chokou kendo abiro riembou gi mirimba mager, mi unuleny nono ka un e iye.
english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.

kikuyu: Bangʼe janabi nobiro ir ruodh Israel monyise niya, “Koro jiw jolweny magi mondo ine gima onego itim nimar ruodh Aram biro monji kendo e chwiri mabiro.”
english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

kikuyu: Manna-no ne chalo gi kothe matindo tindo marachere kendo ma kitgi ne chalo gi duogo.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Asaf. Jal Manyalo Duto, Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye, wuoyo kendo luongo ji duto modak e piny mondo ochokrene kaachiel, chakre wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

kikuyu: “Ok alam ni gin kendgi, to alamo bende ni jogo mabiro yie kuoma bangʼ ka gisepuonjogi.
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne iye owangʼ gi Harun mi odwaro tieke, to e kindeno ne alemone Harun bende.
english: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro winjo kwayo jo-Israel kendo mi atimnegi kama: Abiro miyo ogendini doko mangʼeny ka rombe,
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

kikuyu: Dibed ni ngʼato osekendi? Ka kamano, to kik idwar mondo iweri gi chwori. Dibed ni pok ikendo? Kichal kamano, to kik imany nyako mondo ikendi.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye enochule kuom remo mane ochwero, nikech nonego ji ariyo gi ligangla ka wuonwa Daudi kia. Nonego Abner wuod Ner jatend lweny mar Israel kod Amasa wuod Jetha jatend lweny mar Juda mane gin joma ber kendo mobidhore moloye.
english: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

kikuyu: Kendo notimore mana kaka ne olokonwa tiendgi kama: An niduoka e tija, to jatend joted makati nolierie yath.”
english: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Isakar ne romo ji alufu piero abich gangʼwen gi mia angʼwen (54,400).
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Angʼo ma omiyo ikoro e nying Jehova Nyasaye ni odni biro chalo ka Shilo kendo ni dala maduongʼni nojwangʼ kendo nokethi maonge ngʼama nodagie?” Kendo ji duto nochokore kolworo Jeremia e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Why have you prophesied in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: To weche mamoko mag loch Amazia, donge ondikgi e kitap weche ruodhi mag Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Chakre remb Abel nyaka remb Zekaria, mane onegi e kind kendo mar misango kod kama ler mar lemo. Ee awachonu ni tiengʼni ibiro kumo nikech mago duto.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

kikuyu: Ngimane ner mi rum adier, kendo yiende mamoko ema twi e lowo mane entiereno.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

kikuyu: Ok inichak ine jonjorego kendo, jogo ma wechegi oyombore, kendo mawacho dhok matek winjo.
english: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

kikuyu: Gibiro wangʼo uteni kendo gibiro kumi e nyim mon mangʼeny. Abiro tieko timbegi mag chode kendo ok inichak ichul joherani.
english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi ne pod ok oyie ni ngʼatni nonywol ka en muofu, kendo ni wengene noseyawore, nyaka negioro wach mondo oluong jonywol ngʼatno.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

kikuyu: Nikech jochologo noluoro Nyasaye, Nyasaye nogwedhogi gi nyithindo.
english: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.

kikuyu: Kaka ne asiemou e limbena mar ariyo, e kaka amedo siemou sani ka aonge kodu ni ka abiro to ok nawe ma ok akumo jogo mane otimo richo motelo kod joricho mamoko duto
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

kikuyu: Omiyo kanisa nobedo motegno e yie, kendo kwan joma oyie kuom Kristo ne medore pile.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu nofwenyore ne ji ariyo kuomgi kinde machielo, ka giwuotho e gwengʼ.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

kikuyu: Ringregi noriere koriyo e yo mar dala maduongʼno, ma iluongo gi ngero ni Sodom kod Misri, dalano e kama nogurie Ruodhgi.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

kikuyu: Kane osetelonegi mogologi oko ma gidhi machiegni gi Bethania, notingʼo lwetene kendo nogwedhogi.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono nowachone niya, “Chutho ingʼeyo gima Saulo nosetimo. Osetieko jo-nyakalondo gi ajuoke e piny. Angʼo momiyo ichiko obadho ne ngimana, mondo okelna tho?”
english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kendo niya, “Nyis jo-Israel kama, ‘Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu, kendo ma Nyasach Ibrahim gi Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo; oseora iru.’ “Ma e nyinga manyaka chiengʼ, ma en nying manyaka parago, kuom tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.

kikuyu: Yaye Jerusalem, aseoro jorit e ohinga mari ok ginilingʼ odiechiengʼ gotieno. Un muluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye kik unyosru,
english: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,

kikuyu: Eka Joab gi jolweny mane ni kode nodhi mondo oked gi jo-Aram, kendo negiringo e nyimgi.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

kikuyu: Koriwore duto nyaka umi jo-Lawi mier piero angʼwen gaboro, kaachiel gi lege mag kwath.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Eka Jehu wuod Jehoshafat ma wuod Nimshi nochano lingʼ-lingʼ mondo omonj Joram. (Koro Joram gi jo-Israel duto nosebedo kakedo mondo gisir Ramoth Gilead kuom monj moa kuom Hazael ruodh Aram,
english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

kikuyu: Jarmuth, Adulam, Soko, Azeka,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

kikuyu: nikech Herode ne oluoro Johana kendo ne ok odwar ni ngʼato ohinye, nikech nokawe kaka ngʼama kare kendo maler. Kinde ka kinde ka Herode nowinjo yalo Johana to dhoge ne moko; to pod nogombo mana mondo omed winjo yalone.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Akelo adiera mara machiegni, ok en mabor; kendo warruokna ok nodeki. Abiro kelo resruok ni Sayun, kendo duongʼna nobed Israel.
english: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.

kikuyu: “Mana kaka notimore e ndalo mag Nowa, e kaka biro bedo bende e ndalo mag Wuod Dhano.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

kikuyu: Eka thuol malichno nowit kidire mwalo e piny, thuol mangʼongo machon miluongo ni Jachien kata Satan, mawuondo piny ngima. Nowite modire e piny, kaachiel kod malaike mage bende.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jo-Manase ne ok nyal kawo e mier matindogi, nikech jo-Kanaan noramo ni nyaka gidag kanyo.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

kikuyu: Chi Kaleb machielo ma nyinge Maaka ne min Sheba kod Tirhana.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

kikuyu: Mier madongo mag Aroer nodongʼ gunda nodongʼ kar nindo jamni kendo onge ngʼama nobwog-gi.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

kikuyu: Fweny mane Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto okelona ema: Ne aneno atonga mopongʼ gi olemo mochiek.
english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.

kikuyu: Kane osudo machiegni gi dhoranga dalano, to noromo gi joma otingʼo ngʼat motho ka igolo oko idhi yiko. Ngʼatno ne en wuowi achiel kende ma wuod dhako ma chwore otho. To oganda maduongʼ moa e dalano ne ni kode.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

kikuyu: Omiyo jopuonjre notimo kaka Yesu nochikogi kendo negiiko Sap Pasaka.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Ka gineno iro mar Babulon kadum kowangʼ, negiwacho ni, ‘Bende ne nitie dala moro machalo gi dala maduongʼni?’
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

kikuyu: Kane oyudo ngʼatno ochungʼ e batha, nawinjo dwond ngʼat moro kawuoyo koda koa ei hekalu.
english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

kikuyu: Yaye joka Jakobo angʼo momiyo uwuoyo, angʼo momiyo ungʼur, yaye jo-Israel, kuwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok dew yorena; kendo ni yorena ok okwan ka gimoro gi Nyasacha.”
english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

kikuyu: Omiyo Abimelek nogolo chik ne ji duto niya, “Ngʼato angʼata ma omulo ngʼatni kata chiege to nyaka negi.”
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

kikuyu: Jomaricho ok ongʼeyo adiera, to jogo madwaro Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo adiera chutho.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

kikuyu: Gik mamoko manotimore ndalo loch Jehoshafat gi gik mane otimo kaachiel gi humbe lwenjene, donge ondikgi e kitepe rapar mar ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Giduto ji ariyo ne gin joma kare e nyim Nyasaye, negirito chike Ruoth Nyasaye kod buchene, maonge ketho.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

kikuyu: mana kaka jamni maridore kochomo holo, negiyudo yweyo koa kuom Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ma e kaka nitelo ne jogi kimiyorigo duongʼ.
english: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi nyaka Troa, ka giluwo Musia.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

kikuyu: Karatas moban noyudi e kama oger motegno mar gengʼo wasigu mar Ekbatana e gwengʼ Media, kendo ma e gima nondik kuome: Chenro mar gima biro:
english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: nikech ndalogo nobed kinde mag chandruok ma ok nyal pim gi moro nyaka aa chakruok, chiengʼ mane Nyasaye ochweyoe piny, nyaka sani; kendo onge chandruok moro mibiro pimo kode kendo.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

kikuyu: Aa malo, Aa malo! Chiew, yaye Jerusalem, in misemetho e kikombe mar mirima mager, moa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye, kendo isemadho kikombe mamero ji milungʼo nyaka duro.
english: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the LORD’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

kikuyu: to kar timo kamano to udwaro mana nega nikech asebedo kanyiso weche mag adiera mane Nyasaye omiya. Ibrahim to ne ok otimo gik ma kamago.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

kikuyu: Nyithind nyaminu ma Nyasaye oyiero ooroni mosgi.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka isekawo agoko mar im mitimogo nyasi mar walo Harun, fwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo kendo mano nobed lemo ma kori.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.

kikuyu: To jogo ma notelo e yo nokwere kendo nowachone ni olingʼ thi, to nomedo goyo koko niya, “Wuod Daudi, yie ikecha!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuoma mochunga malo. Ne owuoyo koda mowacho niya, “Dhiyo mondo ilorri e odi.
english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Ndik e kitabu weche duto masewachoni.’
english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

kikuyu: Adiera gi rieko gi puonjruok kod ngʼeyo tiend wach ema nyaka iyudi, kata dabed ni ingʼiewogi gi nengo matek.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

kikuyu: Wengena nongʼigi mondo gidhi maber, kendo anadwog-gi e pinyni. Anagergi kendo ok anamukgi; anapidhgi kendo ok anapudhgi.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

kikuyu: Winy duto mafuyo e kor polo nopiyo e yath mopodhono, kendo le duto mag bungu nonyonore e bedene madongo mopodhogo.
english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

kikuyu: Ochal gi koth karadali, ma ngʼato nokawo mopidho e puothe. Kodhino nodongo mobedo yien, to winy mafuyo e kor polo nopiyo e bedene.”
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼ ka ja-Nazirno oselielo yie wiye mane osewal tenge, jadolo nomiye bad im mosechwaki, kod kek kod chapat mogoloe okapu, mago molos ma ok oketie thowi.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Daudi, ne nitie kech kuom higni adek moluwore; omiyo Daudi nolamo koywak ni Jehova Nyasaye. To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni, “Ma ne otimore nikech remo mane Saulo gi ode ochwero, nikech nonego jo-Gibeon.”
english: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kowacho niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Nojwangʼ Israel nikech richo mane Jeroboam otimo kendo mosemiyo Israel otimo.”
english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

kikuyu: Mach wengʼo nyimgi, to bangʼ-gi ligek mach bebnie. Piny chalo gi puoth Eden yo ka nyimgi to ka bangʼ-gi piny otwo modongʼ nono, onge gimoro manyalo pusorenegi matony.
english: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat ma ok ni koda kedo koda, kendo ngʼat ma ok konya choko ji, keyo ji.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

kikuyu: Omiyo jotije Abisalom notimo ni Amnon kaka nosechikgi. Eka yawuot ruoth duto nochungʼ moidho kanjegi moringo.
english: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

kikuyu: Negipogogi maonge dewo wangʼ ka gigoyo ombulu nikech ne nitie jotelo mag kama ler mar lemo, to gi mag Nyasaye e kind nyikwa Eliazar kod Ithamar.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

kikuyu: “Yaye, mad ne ngʼato mak wechegagi, kendo ndikgi e kitabu,
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

kikuyu: Ket misango miwangʼo pep e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ringʼo kaachiel gi remo. Remb misenginigo nyaka ol e bath kendo mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, to ringʼo to unyalo chamo.
english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the LORD your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the LORD your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

kikuyu: Ka kamano, to kare bidhriane, kirwakori gi duongʼ, luor kod ber.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Joritgo, ka moro ka moro nigi gire mar lweny e lwete, chakre yo milambo nyaka yo nyandwat mar hekalu ka gilworo kendo mar misango kod hekalu.
english: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama chalo kodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; iduongʼ, kendo nyingi maratego nigi teko.
english: There is no one like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is great in might.

kikuyu: Kawuru nus mar pokni kendo umi Eliazar jadolo kaka chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

kikuyu: Nowuoyo kode modembore kendo nomiye kom duongʼ moloyo ruodhi mamoko mane ni kode e twech Babulon.
english: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

kikuyu: Jodolo noyie ni ok gibi choko pesa kendo kuom ji kendo gin giwegi bende ok gibi loso kuonde mokethore mag hekalu.
english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

kikuyu: “Piny Zebulun gi piny Naftali, man Yor Nam modak loka aora Jordan, Galili mar joma ok jo-Yahudi,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

kikuyu: Makmana singruokna abiro chopo gi Isaka ma Sara biro nywolone e kinde maka ma e higa mabiro.”
english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

kikuyu: Migawo mar jower mar ariyo nowuotho kochiko komachielo. Ne aluwogi nyaka ewi ohinga malo, kaachiel gi nus mar ji ka gikalo kama Oger Motingʼore gi Malo mar Kendo mag Mach nyaka e Ohinga Malach,
english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikuod wi wuonu kuom terruok gi chiege, nikech en minu.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Isaya niya, “Wuogi in kaachiel gi wuodi miluongo ni Shear-Jashub udhi mondo urad gi Ahaz kama oula madonjo e yawo mamalo ogikie mantie but yo miluongo ni Puoth Jaluok lewni.
english: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noloso kom loch maduongʼ ma iye obaw gi lak liech kendo ngʼeye obaw gi dhahabu mopwodhi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

kikuyu: Ne wachiwore ni Misri kod Asuria mondo wayud chiemo moromo.
english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: to ruoth Joram noduogo Jezreel mondo ochangi kuom adhonde mane oyudo kuom lweny mane ni e kinde gi Hazael ruodh jo-Aram). Jehu mowachone niya, “Ka ma e kaka uparo, to kik iyie ngʼato angʼata wuogi e dala maduongʼ ka mondo odhi ohul wachni e piny Jezreel.”
english: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

kikuyu: Ibrahim ne en wuon Isaka, Isaka ne en wuon Jakobo, to Jakobo ne en wuon Juda gi owetene.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano donjuru e ot in kaachiel gi yawuoti kendo ulor dhoot. Ol morno e agulnigo duto, kendo ka moro ka moro osepongʼ, to iket tenge.”
english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

kikuyu: Koro luong jo-Israel duto mondo orom koda e Got Karmel. Kendo kel jodolo mag Baal mia angʼwen gi piero abich kod jonabi mia angʼwen mag Ashera, machiemo e mesa Jezebel.”
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

kikuyu: nogologi gi lwedo motegno kod bat morie; Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: moringo otony ka en duk, moweyo nyaka sukane kanyo.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

kikuyu: Gokinyi mangʼich Joshua kod jo-Israel duto nowuok koa Shitim, mi gidhi nyaka e aora Jordan, negibiro kanyo kapok giidho loka.
english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

kikuyu: Ezra japuonj chik nochungʼ ewi bao motingʼore gi malo mane oger nikech nyasini. E bathe yo korachwich ne nitie Matithia, Shema, Anaya, Uria, Hilkia, kod Maseya; to yo koracham ne nitie Pedaya, Mishael, Malkija, Hashum, Hashbadana, Zekaria kod Meshulam.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

kikuyu: Nyasaye Wuoro noyierou chon kaka dwarone obet mondo opwodhu gi Roho, umak chik Yesu Kristo kendo mondo rembe okir kuomu. Ngʼwono kod kwe mogundho obed kodu.
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

kikuyu: Gisano Yesu nochiko jopuonjrene mondo odonji e yie kendo gitel nyime gingʼad gidhi loka nam komachielo, ka en to ne pod odongʼ chien kogonyo oganda.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Israel orito chike duto mane amiyogi kendo rito buche duto mane Musa jatichna omiyogi, to ok anachak awe gia e piny mane amiyo kweregi.”
english: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

kikuyu: Omiyo nowuondore ni en janeko e nyimgi kanyo, kane en e lwetgi notimo timbe mag janeko, kogwaro dhorangach kendo koweyo olawo wuok e dhoge nyaka e yie tike.
english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

kikuyu: Eka nokel chiemo ne jatich Ibrahim to nowachonegi niya, “Ok abi chiemo kapok anyisou gima onego awachnu.” Laban nowachone niya, “Kara nyiswa.”
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

kikuyu: Jolweny mag polo ne luwo bangʼe, ka giidho farese marochere kendo ka girwakore gi lewni mayom marochere kendo maler.
english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

kikuyu: “Eka jatich machielo nobiro kendo owacho ni, ‘Jaduongʼ, silingʼ alufu achiel eri, ne asekane kapande kaboyogo gi nanga.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

kikuyu: Karangʼo mane wanenie ka in wendo mi warwaki ei ot, kata kichando lewni mi warwaki?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

kikuyu: Mier mane jo-Filistia omayo jo-Israel kochakore Ekron nyaka Gath nodwoknegi, Israel noreso gwenge mane okiewo kode koa e loch jo-Filistia. Kendo kwe nobedo e kind Israel gi jo-Amor.
english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

kikuyu: ma gonya e lwet wasika. Nitingʼa malo moloyo wasika; ne iresa e lwet jo-mahundu.
english: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kikuyu: Mano ema omiyo jo-Yahudi modak e gwenge to moloyo modak e mier pod rito tarik apar gangʼwen mar dwe mar Adar kaka chiengʼ mor mar timo nyasi, kendo en odiechiengʼ ma gimiyoe ngʼato ka ngʼato mich.
