english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

kikuyu: Oganda maduongʼ nopedho kodegi e yo, to jomoko to nongʼado bede yiende, kendo gin bende negi pedhogi e yo.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

kikuyu: Kuom mano otieno biro choponu ma ok nune fweny, mudho nojuku ma ok nungʼe weche mopondo. Chiengʼ biro podho ne jonabi kendo odiechiengʼ nolokrenegi mudho.
english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

kikuyu: Uneno gik moko mana gi wangʼ mar dhano. To ka ngʼato paro ni en ngʼat Kristo, to kik chunye wuonde ni en ngʼat Kristo moloyowa!
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

kikuyu: Mi mondo joma ketho nying jowetegi kik dhi maber e piny, ee, ne ni masira olawo jo-mahundu mi ojukogi.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

kikuyu: to yie ni wasikano mondo olawa mi juka; we ginyon ngimana piny e lowo, mi gimi anind e buru mar lowo. Sela
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuom mano chuny Farao nomedo bedo matek kendo ne ok oyie ni jo-Israel mondo odhi kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye osewacho kokalo kuom Musa.
english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

kikuyu: Kane ongʼiyo moneno jawuoth e laru mar dala maduongʼ, jaduongʼno nopenje niya, “Ua kanye, to udhi kanye?”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

kikuyu: “Eka ruodhno nowachonwa ni, ‘Ma e kaka abiro ngʼeyo kata ka un joma kare: Achiel kuomu odongʼ ka kendo joma odongʼ oter chiemo ne joodu makoro chandore ka.
english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne watedo wuoda kendo wachamo. Kinyne ne awachone niya, In bende gol wuodi mi wacham, kare en to nosepando wuode.
english: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

kikuyu: Eka ne giwuok Oboth mi gigo kambi kama iluongo ni Iye Abarim, mantiere e thim mochomo piny Moab kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

kikuyu: Anabed jasik ngʼama oweya modhi odwanyore gi jo-nyakalondo kod lang chunje maricho; kendo anangʼad kare oko kuom ogandagi.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

kikuyu: Rehum, Hashabna, Maseya,
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

kikuyu: Ere ruodhu mondo koro oresu? Ere jotendu e miechu, mane usekwayo ni, ‘Miwa ruodh kod jotendwa?’
english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mochamo remo nyaka ngʼad kare kuom ogandane.’ ”
english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano, kane pod aleko ne aneno ondiek mar angʼwen. Ne en ondiek manenore malich kendo man-gi teko ma kineno to ibuok malich kendo luoro maki. Ne en gi leke madongo machalo nyinyo; nosiko kochiemo achiema kendo gimoro amora mane odongʼ nonyono piny gi tiendene. En nopogore gi ondiegi adek mokwongo ka bende ne en gi tunge apar.
english: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome, powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.

kikuyu: Chungʼuru motegno kuom yie ma un-go kendo tameuru, nikech ungʼeyo ni joweteu moyie e piny ngima bende neno chandruok machal gi ma uneno.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

kikuyu: kendo en owuon ema nobed kwe margi. Ka jo-Asuria omonjo pinywa, kendo ka ginyono kuondewa mochiel motegno, to wabiro yiero jokwath abiriyo mondo oked kodgi; adier jotendwa aboro norad kodgi.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

kikuyu: kendo ne gikawe mi giwite e bugo. Bugono ne ninono kendo pi ne onge e iye.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Doguru mondo udwok wach ne Johana gik muwinjo kendo uneno:
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

kikuyu: “Odiechiengʼ mar ariyo nyaka ichiw nywok maonge songa kaka misango mar golo richo, kendo kendo mar misango nyaka pwodhi kaka ne opwodhe gi remb nyarwath.
english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

kikuyu: kaluwore gi chik mane Musa ogolo kuom chiwo migolo pile ka pile mag odiechienge Sabato, Wuok Dwe, kaachiel gi sewni moyier adek mag higa ka higa ma gin Sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi, gi Sawo mar Jumbe kod Sawo mar Kiche.
english: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Nikech Jehova Nyasaye en Ngʼama Kare, kendo ohero adiera; joma timbegi oriere biro neno wangʼe.
english: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

kikuyu: Magi duto notimore mondo ochop gima ne Ruoth owacho gi dho janabi niya,
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: To diel ma ombulu oyiero kaka diend bungu nyaka kel kangima e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo ti godo kaka gir pwodhruok kiweye odhi e pap kaka diend bungu.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

kikuyu: makmana ne pod nitiere dhout Israel abiriyo mane pod ok oyudo girkeni margi.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

kikuyu: Wach nochopo ne ruodh Asuria niya, “Ji mane idaro midwoko e miech Samaria, ok ongʼeyo gima nyasaye mar pinyno dwaro. Kuom mano, oseoro sibuoche e diergi mondo oneg-gi nikech ji ok ongʼeyo gima nyasachgino dwaro.”
english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

kikuyu: Miechgi abich mamoko mane olworogi ne gin Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token kod Ashan,
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

kikuyu: Musa gi Eliazar jadolo kod jotend oganda duto nodhi mondo orom kodgi e oko mar kambi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Yawuowi auchielgi ne onywol ni Daudi ka en Hebron, kuma ne obedoe ruoth kuom higni abiriyo gi dweche auchiel. Daudi nobedo ruoth korito piny ka en Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gadek,
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

kikuyu: to akwongʼora gi Nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni kata dabed ni ji adekgi ni e iye, to ok digires kata mana ngima yawuotgi kata nyigi giwegi. Gin kendgi ema noresgi, to piny to noketh chuth.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora mane ruoth dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, joritogo ne tingʼo kuodigo kendo bangʼe negidwokogi e od jorito.
english: As often as the king entered into the LORD’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

kikuyu: Wichkuot maduongʼ biro mako joma donjona kendo gibiro rwako wichkuot ka kandho.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

kikuyu: Kik itamri kecha, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; mad herani gi adierani osik ka rita.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora mane Yesu odhiye; e mier madongo kata matindo kata e gwenge, ji ne kelo joma tuo e chirni kendo negisaye mondo oyie jotuogo omul kata mana riak lawe. Ji duto mane omule nochango.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

kikuyu: Gima wangʼi oseneno kik ikel mapiyo kirikni e nyim od bura; nimar ibiro timo angʼo achien ka jabuti oketi e wichkuot?
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

kikuyu: Nimar, ka ok kamano, to anyalo bedo gi mwandu mangʼeny mi akwedi ka awacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye to en ngʼa?’ Kata anyalo bedo jachan mi akwel, mi ami nying Nyasacha wichkuot.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

kikuyu: Koro odiechiengʼ mar adek ne en odiechieng rapar mar nywol Farao, kendo noloso nyasi ne jotije duto. Nogonyo jatend jogam divai kod jatend joted makati moketogi e nyim jodonge.
english: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar abiriyo nogoyo turumbetene, to dwonde moko nokok matek ei polo, kagiwacho niya, “Pinyruodhi mar pinyni koro osedoko pinyruodhi mar Ruodhwa kendo mar Kristo, kendo enolochi nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

kikuyu: Omiyo osiep Daudi ma Hushai nochopo Jerusalem e sa mane Abisalom donjoe e dala maduongʼ.
english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kuom gik mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Jehoyakim kod gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ni Isaka kendo owachone niya, “Kik idhi Misri; to dag mana e piny kama abiro nyisi.
english: The LORD appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

kikuyu: “Kik ikwan dhood Lawi kata riwogi e kweno mar jo-Israel mamoko.
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

kikuyu: Marangʼo un gi wengeu to ok unyal neno, kendo un gi it to ok unyal winjo? Donge uparo gik mane atimo?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

kikuyu: Lach mar laru mar hekalu man yo wuok chiengʼ, kaachiel gi yo ka nyim hekalu, noromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

kikuyu: Sirnigo duto molworo laruno nobed gi ramaki gi rangʼaw molos gi fedha kaachiel gi rachungi mag mula.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: Miechgi oriti maber maonge gima bwogogi; kendo kum mar Nyasaye onge kuomgi.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

kikuyu: Sheshan ne onge gi yawuowi, nonywolo nyiri kende. Ne en gi misumba ma ja-Misri miluongo ni Jarha.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel wigi osewil gi Jachwechgi, mi gigero ute mag ruodhi; Juda osechielo mier madongo mangʼeny. To anaor mach e miechgi madongogo mitiek kargi mar pondono.”
english: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”

kikuyu: To ewi mago duto, tingʼ mapek ma an-go en paro kanisni duto.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Goluru ji alufu achiel achiel (1,000) moa e dhoot ka dhoot mar Israel.”
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

kikuyu: Ma e tich ma dhout Gershon onego tim e Hemb Romo. Ithamar wuod Harun jadolo ema notelne tijegi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Abiro keyou e dier ogendini mi ateru e pinje mopogore opogore; bende abiro neno ni gak mugakgo orumo.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde ne oluwo bangʼ Paulo kod wan bende, kokok niya, “Jogi gin jotich Ruoth Nyasaye man Malo Moloyo, kendo ginyisou yor yudo warruok.”
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

kikuyu: Ungʼado bura gi rieko mar dhano, an to ok angʼad bura ni ngʼato.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

kikuyu: negibiro ir Zerubabel to gi jotend anywola mi giwacho niya, “We wakonyu gedo nikech Nyasachuno ema wan bende wasebedo ka wachiwone misango nyaka aa kinde Esarhadon ruodh Asuria, mane okelowa kae.”
english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

kikuyu: Luoro musemiyo ji kod sunga manie chunyu osewuondou, un jogo modak e kind lwendni, modak kuonde motingʼore gi malo mar got. Kata obedo ni ugero uteu mabor ka od otenga, koa kuno abiro dwokou piny,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo Wuod Dhano en Ruodh Sabato bende.”
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Mad wengegi dinre mondo kik ginen kendo oguchgi odolre nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

kikuyu: Geno yudo resruok kuom faras en gima nono kata obedo ni en giteko mangʼeny to ok onyal reso ngʼato.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

kikuyu: “Bende isefwenyo ni jogi wachoni ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye osekwedo dhoudi ariyo mane oyiero’? Omiyo gijaro joga kendo ok gikawo joga ka oganda achiel.
english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has the LORD cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”

kikuyu: Sairas ruodh Pasia nowacho ni okelgi gi jakeno, Mithredath, mane okwanogi ne Sheshbaza jatend Juda.
english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “An gi sigu kodu. Abiro elo lepu maum wengeu. Abiro nyiso ogendini duto dugu, kendo pinjeruodhi biro neno wichkuot maru.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

kikuyu: “Kuom magi duto, waketo winjruok motweyowa, kwandiko wechegi piny, kendo jotendwa, gi jo-Lawi mawa kod jodolo mawa keto lwetgi kaka joneno.”
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

kikuyu: tingʼuru lodiu malo, yaye dhorangeye; tingʼreuru malo, yaye rangeye machon, mondo Ruodh duongʼ odonji.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Ji duto ne mor gi ilo kuom chiwo mar jotendgi nikech negichiwo gi mor kendo gi chuny achiel ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ruoth Daudi bende nomor ahinya.
english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

kikuyu: Kane Modekai owinjo gigo duto mane osetimore, noyiecho lepe morwako pien gugru mobukore gi buru, kodhi e dala maduongʼ koywak kendo kogoyo nduru matek ka chunye lit.
english: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.

kikuyu: Agoyoni erokamano, kendo apaki, yaye Nyasach kwerena: Isemiya rieko gi teko, isemiyo angʼeyo gima ne wakwayi, isemiyo wangʼeyo tiend lek mar ruoth.
english: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”

kikuyu: Eka nochako kanyo ni Masa kod Meriba nikech jo-Israel nogwandore kanyo to bende nikech ne gitemo Jehova Nyasaye kagiwacho niya, “Bende Jehova Nyasaye ni e dierwa koso?”
english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni jo-Juda osetimo timbe maricho e nyima. Giseketo nyisechegi manono e ot ma Nyinga nitiere kendo gisenjawe.
english: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says the LORD. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

kikuyu: To ka wan nyithind Nyasaye, to mano nyiso ni wan jocham girkeni. Wan jocham girkeni mar Nyasaye kendo wan jocham girkeni kaachiel kod Kristo, ka en adier ni wayie neno masira kode mondo eka wan bende obi omiwa duongʼ kode.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

kikuyu: Paulo nowachonegi niya, “Batiso mar Johana ne en mar lokruok weyo richo. Nonyiso ji mondo oyie kuom Jal mane biro bangʼe, ma en Yesu.”
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

kikuyu: Nimar ne awacho niya, “Kik iyie mondo gisungrena, kata gigona siboi ni tienda okier.”
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

kikuyu: “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, isechweyo polo gi piny kuom tekoni maduongʼ kod badi malach. Onge gima tekni.
english: “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

kikuyu: Omiyo Hiram nodwoko Solomon kawacho niya, “Aseyudo wach mane iorona kendo abiro timo duto midwaro kuom chiwo yiend Sida gi bao.
english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

kikuyu: Daudi ne ok okawo kwan ji ma jo-higni piero ariyo, kata matin ne mano nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne osesingore ni nomi jo-Israel bed mangʼeny mana ka sulwe manie kor polo.
english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

kikuyu: Piny duto nowangʼ gi mach kendo notim chumbi, maonge gima opidhi manobedie, kata gima dongo ok none, bende onge kata mana alode manodongie. Nokethre mana ka Sodom gi Gomora gi Adma kod Zeboim mane Jehova Nyasaye oketho ka mirima nomake.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi fedha gi dhahabu duto ma unyalo yudo koa e gwengʼ mar Babulon, kanyakla gi chiwo ma ji kod jodolo golo ma en chiwo mar hera ne hekalu mar Nyasachgi e Jerusalem.
english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: Malon gi Kilion bende notho, kendo Naomi koro nodongʼ kende maonge yawuote ariyo kaachiel gi chwore.
english: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.

kikuyu: Kane oneno kaka dalane ber, kendo kaka pinyno ber, noyie tingʼo misigo modoko misumba matiyo tich matek.
english: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

kikuyu: Iluongogi ni fedha mojwangʼ, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼogi.”
english: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”

kikuyu: Jopuonjre ne ok owinjo tiend wechegi kata matin. Tiend wechegi nopandnegi, kendo ne ok gingʼeyo gima ne owuoyo kuome.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

kikuyu: Kane Musa oneno mach malielno, nodoko maluor. Kane osudo machiegni mondo onene maber, nowinjo dwond Ruoth Nyasaye kawacho niya,
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

kikuyu: To ka ngʼatno hike pok ochopo abich to osekadho dwe achiel, to noware gi shekel abich mar fedha ka en nyathi ma wuowi, to ka en nyako to noware gi shekel adek.
english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

kikuyu: “Wachnegi wachni: “ ‘Mad wangʼa pongʼ gi pi wangʼ otieno gi odiechiengʼ ma ok rum; ne nyara mangili, joga, osewinjo lit mar adhola, gi hinyruok mapek.
english: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa e pewe mag Moab momanyore gi Jeriko mokiewo gi Jordan kowacho niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Ka en kamano, to ere kaka dhano dibed ngʼat makare e nyim Nyasaye? Koso ere kaka dhano ma dhako onywolo nyalo bedo maler?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

kikuyu: Negikelo wi Ish-Boseth ni Daudi e piny Hebron mi giwachone ruoth niya, “Ma en wi Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo ma jasiki, mane dwaro negi. Odiechiengni Jehova Nyasaye osechako chulo kuor ni Saulo gi kothe ne ruodha ma en ruoth.”
english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

kikuyu: Negiluongo Lut ka gipenje niya, “Ere chwo mane obiro iri ka gotieno? Golnwagi oko kae wadwa terore kodgi.”
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

kikuyu: Nikech nyiseche duto mag ogendini gin mana gik ma dhano oloso to Jehova Nyasaye ema nochweyo polo.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasaye mane ochweyo polo, kendo mane ochweyo piny mondo ji odagie to ok ni mondo piny obed maonge ji, owacho niya: “An e Jehova Nyasaye kendo onge moro machielo.
english: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.

kikuyu: To ji moa kamoro amora ma joma otony nyalo bet ni koro odakie mondo ochiwne fedha gi dhahabu, kod gik miuso gi kweth mag dhok, to gi chiwo mar hera ne hekalu mar Nyasaye e Jerusalem.’ ”
english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

kikuyu: Nimar ka oketo mise to ok onyal tieke, ji duto manene biro nyiere,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

kikuyu: Kendo gwenge mag Og ruodh Bashan, achiel kuom mago mogik mag jo-Refai, ma lochne ne nitie Ashtaroth kod Edrei.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

kikuyu: Kendo wachne Amasa ni, ‘Donge in wadwa ma remba? Mad Nyasaye kuma malit ahinya ka dipo ni ok aketi jatend jolweny sani kar Joab.’ ”
english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

kikuyu: Joram nogolo chik niya, “Ikna gacha.” To kane giseikone gache, Joram ruodh Israel kod Ahazia ruodh Juda noriembo gechegi, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato ni e gache owuon mondo girom gi Jehu. Negiromo kode e puodho mane mar Naboth ja-Jezreel.
english: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

kikuyu: To kuom Abiathar jadolo, ruoth nowacho niya, “Dog e puotheni mantie Anathoth. Iwinjori gi tho, to ok ananegi sani, nikech nitingʼo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto e nyim Daudi wuonwa kendo nineno chandruok duto mane wuonwa oneno.”
english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord GOD’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

kikuyu: Ne alawo wasika mi ajukogi; kendo ne ok alokora aweyogi nyaka ne atiekogi pep.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

kikuyu: Omiyo Chik ler, kendo chike moketi bende ler, kendo nikare, to kendo ber.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

kikuyu: nikech osepwodhe maler gi wach Nyasaye kod lamo.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

kikuyu: Sa moro ka jo-Juda owinjo kuom masichegi ma achano mar kelo kuomgi, to giduto ginilokre giwe yoregi mamono; eka anawenegi timbegi mamono kod richo mag-gi.”
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Awachonu adier, ni umanya ok nikech nyoro uneno honni, to mana nikech makati manyoro uchamo ma uyiengʼ.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

kikuyu: Ne abiro ir joma otwe mane odak Tel Abib but Aora Kebar. Kendo kanyo, kama ne gidakieno; nabet e diergi kuom ndalo abiriyo ka adhier nono.
english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

kikuyu: Jokwangʼ ngai magi teri oko nyaka e nembe madongo. To kata kamano yamb ugwe biro ngʼinji matindo tindo e chuny nam.
english: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mamiyo agak chiemo ka nyithinde ywagore ne Nyasaye, kendo bayo koni gi koni ka dwaro chiemo?
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

kikuyu: Oganda mamoko mathoth bende nodhi kodgi kaachiel gi kweth mangʼeny mag chiayo ma gin jamni kod kweth mangʼeny mag dhok.
english: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

kikuyu: Giniyak chambu kod chiembu, ginitiek yawuotu gi nyiu; kendo ginineg jambu kod dhou, bende giniketh yiende mzabibu mau kod yiende mag ngʼopeu. Miechu madongo mochiel gohinga motegno mugeno kuomgi nokethi gi ligangla.”
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

kikuyu: Puonj maduongʼ mogik mane ayudo kuom Ruoth mi amiyou ema: Kristo notho nikech richowa kaluwore gi Ndiko,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Waduto wan yawuot ngʼat achiel. Jotichgi gin joma kare, ma ok okwach kich.”
english: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Abiro konyora gi oganda mar ji mangʼeny, mi abol gogo mara kuomi, kendo gibiro maki gi gogono ma ok inyal bwodho.
english: The Lord GOD says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nodwoko niya, “Angʼeyo ratiro ni utemo mana ketho seche, nikech ungʼeyo ni gima asengʼado e chunya ma ok anyal loko ema:
english: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

kikuyu: Gisano ne giweyo gogo mag-gi gisano mi giluwe.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasaye nooro wach ne ruodh Israel kama: “Bed motangʼ kikalo kanyo nikech jo-Aram dhi buto kuno.”
english: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

kikuyu: Ka dera omako piny, to obiro resi e tho, kendo ka lweny gore to obiro resi e dho ligangla.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

kikuyu: Sandug Muma nobudho Kiriath Jearim kuom higni piero ariyo, jo-Israel duto nokuyo mi odok ir Jehova Nyasaye.
english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.

kikuyu: Jomoko ogeno kuom gechegi to jomoko kuom faresegi, to wan to wageno kuom nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Yesu nochako oketo lwetene e wenge ngʼatno kendo, mi wengene noyawore mi koro nonyalo neno gik moko duto maler.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

kikuyu: To ji duto mane orwake, mi oyie kuome, nomiyogi teko mar doko nyithind Nyasaye,
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

kikuyu: Kendo Injilini mar pinyruoth noyal e piny duto mondo ongʼad bura ne ogendini duto, eka giko nobi.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

kikuyu: Dhiuru kendo umed ikoru. Nonuru mondo ungʼe kuma Daudi jadhiyoe kod ngʼat mosenene kuno. Gisenyisa ni en ngʼama yoreyore ahinya.
english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.

kikuyu: Omiyo jotend jo-Moab nodok ir Balak mi owacho niya, “Balaam nodagi biro kodwa.”
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

kikuyu: Nam kod gik moko duto man e iye bende omor, beduru mamor un pewe kod gik manie iwu.
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

kikuyu: Noliere e lela wangʼ Harun kendo notingʼ ketho duto ma dipo kobetie kuom mich maler ma jo-Israel chiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye. Kamano e kaka nobedi e lela wangʼ Harun kinde duto mondo Jehova Nyasaye oyie gi chiwogo.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: resgiuru ka ugologi e mach mondo ures ngimagi, to moko kuomgi to kechuru kutangʼ kendo kuluor, ka umon kata mana gi lepgi ma gombogi mag richo osechido.
english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

kikuyu: Joma otony e dieru mane odongʼ kangima e pinje mag wasiku nobed ka dendgi dhi adhiya nikech richogi kendo nikech richo mag kweregi, mana machal kaka notimore ni kweregi.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Finehas wuod Eliazar ma jadolo, kod jotelo noduogo Kanaan koa e romogi gi jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad mane nitiere Gilead kendo ne gidwokone jo-Israel wach.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

kikuyu: inisik ka iyi owangʼ? Bende mirimbi biro bedo manyaka chiengʼ? Ma e kaka iwuoyo, to itimo timbe mamono duto minyalo.”
english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

kikuyu: Musa moyangʼo imno kendo nokawo remb imno moko momieno e it Harun ma korachwich, gi lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, donge dingʼadni Jerusalem bura? Donge dingʼadni dala maduongʼ michwere remoni bura? Ka inyalo timo kamano to chome tir gi timbene mamono duto
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

kikuyu: Ruoth Ahasuerus nopenjo Esta ma mikache niya, “En ngʼa? Ngʼatno ni kanye mosehedhore timo gima kamano?”
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi mondo aom Jazania wuod Jeremia, ma wuod Habazinia gi owetene kod yawuote duto, anywola duto mag joka Rekab.
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

kikuyu: Ne atemo bedo mamor kuom madho kongʼo, kendo bedo mofuwo, ka pacha pod telona gi rieko. Ne adwaro fwenyo ni en angʼo mowinjore mondo ji otim e bwo polo e ndalo matin mar ngimani.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

kikuyu: Angʼo machielo mane onego otim e puotha mar mzabibu maloyo mano mane atimone? Kane adwaro olembe mabeyo to angʼo mane omiyo onyago mana mago maricho?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

kikuyu: Los chenro ka ikonyori gi ngʼado rieko; ka ichako lweny to dwar ikruok maber.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kikuyu: Ahiam wuod Sakar ja-Harar, Elifal wuod Ur,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

kikuyu: Ka in gi gimoro amora minyalo wacho, to dwoka; wuo awuoya, nikech adwaro lero kori,
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

kikuyu: To Anania nodongʼ gi bath pesa moko lingʼ-lingʼ mondo okonyrego, ka chiege bende nongʼeyo wachno maber. Pesa modongʼ, to nokelo oketo e lwet joote.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo, inyis Farao ruodh jo-Misri mondo owe jo-Israel owuogi e pinye.”
english: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

kikuyu: Daudi nonyise niya, “Yie imiya laru mar dino cham mondo angʼiew mondo agerie kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye eka tho manego ji orum. Yie iusnago e kar romb nengone duto.”
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

kikuyu: Noidho kerubi mi ofuyogo ka kalausi.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: “Ibiro dhi nyime kiwacho gik ma kamago nyaka karangʼo? Wecheni chalo mana ka yamo makudho matek.
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

kikuyu: Chiayo mar misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho nyaka yangʼ mana kama iyangʼoe chiayo mar misango miwangʼo pep kendo rembe nyaka kir e bethe kendo mar misango koni gi koni.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

kikuyu: mondo ka Nyasaye oyie to abi iru ka amor kendo mondo ka an kodu to uduog chunya, to an bende aduog chunyu.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi biro somone jo-Israel gi dwol maduongʼ niya,
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

kikuyu: Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Balaam kendo Balaam nowachone niya, “Aseloso kende abiriyo mag misango, kendo ewi kendo ka kendo asechiwe misango mar rwath kod im.”
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

kikuyu: To chiengʼ nyasi mar nywol Herode, nyar Herodia nomielnegi maber, kendo miendeno nomoro Herode ahinya,
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama hore mapar, onge ngʼama nigi ngʼeyo kata winjo makare manyalo wacho niya, “Nus mare ne atiyogo kaka gir chweko; to bende ne atedo makati katiyo gi mirnigo, kendo ne abulo ringʼo mi achamo. Bende anyalo loso gima ok oher kuom gima odongʼ? Bende anyalo kulora piny ne osiki?”
english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”

kikuyu: Nokwongʼ atongeu gi dakuondeu.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

kikuyu: ‘Bende dhano mangima nyalo bedo makare moloyo Nyasaye? Dhano bende dibed maler moloyo jachwechne?
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

kikuyu: Wuond ni e chuny jogo machano timo marach, to mor en mar jogo mohero kwe.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

kikuyu: Opowo kor gode modhi mabor gi kuonde ma ji odakie, mochop nyaka kuonde ma ji ok wuothie; ka giliero e tonde marundore koni gi koni.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

kikuyu: Koso en ngʼa e kor polo minyalo pimo gi Jehova Nyasaye? En ngʼa e dier chwech mag polo machalo gi Jehova Nyasaye?
english: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

kikuyu: Wachne ruoth kod min ruoth niya, “Loruru uaye kombeu mag duongʼ, nimar osimbo mau mag duongʼ nolwar koa e wiyeu.”
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.

kikuyu: kendo ne anyisi niya, “Yie iwe wuoda odhi, mondo olama.” To nikech nidagi weye mondo odhi; koro abiro nego wuodi makayo.’ ”
english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”

kikuyu: Ne ariera piny ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno nikech Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni obiro tiekou.
english: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

kikuyu: Wuowi mofuwo kelo kuyo ni wuon mare kod chuny lit ne ngʼat mane onywole.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

kikuyu: Nimar kane pod ringruok chikowa, chik ne chiewo gombowa maricho, kendo negitiyoe ringrewa, omiyo ne wanyago olemo makelo tho.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

kikuyu: Nimar Daudi nosewachone niya, “Rembi obedi e wiyi iwuon. Dhogi ema osebedo janeno mari ka iwacho ni, ‘Asenego ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir.’ ”
english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain the LORD’s anointed.’”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nochungʼ moweyo divai mane omadho ka mirima ohinge modhi oko e puoth joka ruoth. To Haman, kane oneno ni ruoth osengʼado buche kuom gima onego timne, nodongʼ chien kokwayo Esta mikach ruoth mondo ores ngimane.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ duto wasika kinya ka gijara; joma dhawona konyore gi nyinga kaka gir kwongʼruok.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

kikuyu: Mano en adier. To ngʼeni notongʼ-gi oko nikech ne gidagi yie, to un to udongʼ ka uchungʼ nikech yie. Omiyo weuru pakoru, to ubed moluor.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

kikuyu: “Eka namedo winjo weche mag achaya mane wuok e tungʼno, kendo nomedo timo kamano nyaka ondiegno nonegi mi ringre nokethi kendo obol e mach makakni.
english: “I watched at that time because of the voice of the arrogant words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Kalausi biro tingʼogi matergi mabor, kendo misenginigi nokelnegi wichkuot.”
english: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.

kikuyu: Magi e joote apar gariyo mane oyier: Simon (mane omiyo nying machielo ni Petro);
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

kikuyu: to enochiw chik mondo luok mochidono. Eka nyaka okete tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo mamoko.
english: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

kikuyu: Nyar farao nodwoke niya, “Ee, dhiyo.” Kuom mano nyakono nodhi mokelo mana min nyathino.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.

kikuyu: Eka ilos ramaki mag mula piero abich kendo iketgi e tonde mitweyogo hema mondo oriwgi kaka gimoro achiel.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

kikuyu: Magi e joka Harun: Harun nonywolo Eliazar, Eliazar nonywolo Finehas, Finehas nonywolo Abishua,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

kikuyu: Mana kaka wuonegi ne ok giwinje kendo ne ok gin jo-adiera kendo ne gichalo atungʼ mobam ma ok nyal gen.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kikuyu: Joma ahero ema akwero kendo akumo. Omiyo bed ja-adiera kendo ilok chunyi iwe timo richo.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel kod jo-Juda mane odak e dalane mag Juda bende nokelo achiel kuom apar mag dhok gi jamni kaachiel gi achiel kuom apar mar gik maler mane gichiwone Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachgi kendo nochokgi e pidhe.
english: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid them in heaps.

kikuyu: “Koso, ere kaka ngʼato nyalo monjo od ngʼat maratego mi omaye gige odhigo, ka ok otweyo ngʼatno mokwongo? Kosetimo kamano eka dohedhre mar yako gik moko e odno.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: An ngimana chalo gi misango miolo piny e kinde mar misango kendo kinde mar wuokna e pinyni osechopo.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

kikuyu: Paruru jotendu ma nokwongo yalonu Wach Nyasaye. Paruru kaka kit ngimagi ne chalo mondo ulu kit yie margi.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

kikuyu: Ne, wuora, ngʼi ine riak lawi ma an-go e lweta! Ne angʼade e riak lawi to ne ok anegi. Sani koro inyalo neno kendo fwenyo ni aonge gi paro mar timoni marach kata ngʼanyoni. Pok akethoni to in to ilawa mondo inega.
english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni kane pod un jopiny, makia Nyasaye, to ne chalo nine oywau gi nyiseche manono ma ok wuo mi ulal.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

kikuyu: Nokawo nyithindogo motingʼo e bade, eka noketo lwete kuomgi, mi ogwedhogi.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

kikuyu: Jo-Zif nodhi Gibea ir Saulo mi giwachone ne, “Donge Daudi opondo kuomwa e kuonde pondo Horesh ewi got Hakila, mantie yo milambo mar Jeshimon?
english: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

kikuyu: (E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nochako oro Rezin ruodh Aram to gi Peka wuod Remalia mondo omonj jo-Juda.)
english: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

kikuyu: Eka ne gikawe mi gidhi kode kar romo margi miluongo ni Areopago, bangʼe gipenje niya, “Donge dinyiswae tiend puonj manyien mikelo kaeni?
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

kikuyu: Emomiyo, neguru dwaro duto mag ringruok manie ngimau, kaka: terruok, dwanyruok, gombo, tim ma ok ler, kod wuoro, ma en lamo nyiseche manono.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jadolo maduongʼ e kind owetene, kendo moseol mor pwodhruok e wiye, kendo owal mondo orwak lep dolo, kik owe wiye obed mogar, kata kik orwak law moyiech.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

kikuyu: To Esau noringo oromone Jakobo mokwake; nokwako ngʼute kendo onyodhe mine giywak giduto.
english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma nigi yie yudo gweth kaachiel gi Ibrahim ngʼat yie.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

kikuyu: Wan ma wangima tho ochomowa kinde duto nikech wach Yesu, mondo omi ngima mar Yesu onere e ringrewa matho.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

kikuyu: Joab ne owuok oweyo Daudi mi ooro joote mi olawo Abner, kendo ne gijuke ka en e soko man Sira mi giduoge. To Daudi ne ok ongʼeyo wachni.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

kikuyu: Asa ne iye owangʼ gi janen nikech wachni, nokecho kode ahinya mokete e twech. To bende e ndalogo Asa nochako sando jomoko malit.
english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

kikuyu: Lochni nosik nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Nyasaye; kendo tim makare ema nobed kaka ludh loch e pinyruodhi.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

kikuyu: mondo iyaw wengegi, kendo mondo ilokgi gia e mudho, giduogi e ler, kendo gia e teko Satan, giduogi ir Nyasaye; ka gitimo kamano eka richogi nowenegi, kendo gibedi e achiel gi ji duto mosepwodhi, nikech giyie kuoma.’
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

kikuyu: “Donge gima kamano biro miyo piny yiengni mi ji duto modak e iye ywagi? Piny duto biro pongʼ ma oo oko mana ka aora Nael manie piny Misri.”
english: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nowuotho e yore duto mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat kod richone mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo, mine gimiyo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel mirima gi nyisechegi manono.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa ne iye owangʼ kodwa e kinde mokwongo nikech un jo-Lawi ne ok udhi ome bende ne ok wapenje kaka dine wakele e yo mowinjore.”
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

kikuyu: Kelnauru Jehova Nyasaye chiwo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mar misango miwangʼo pep mar rwedhi apar gadek, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen mahikgi achiel, maonge songa.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Nobiro gi geche lweny alufu achiel gi mia ariyo kod jolweny moidho farese alufu piero auchiel kod jolweny mangʼeny ma ok kwanre mawuotho mag jo-Libya gi jo-Suk kod Kush bende nobiro kode koa Misri,
english: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “ ‘Abiro dhi mondo abed roho mar miriambo e dho jonabi mage duto.’ ” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “ ‘Dhiyo kendo itim kamano nikech in ema ibiro hoye mi iloye.’
english: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

kikuyu: To nyithindogo nongʼanyona kama: Ne ok giluwo buchena, ne ok girito chikena, kata obedo ni ngʼat moritogi bedo mangima, kendo ne ok girito Sabato maga. Omiyo ne awacho ni ne abiro olo mirimba kuomgi kendo tiekogi e thim.
english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: “E kinde ma ngʼato nigi chandruok kama, to osiepne onego okeche, kata obedo ni oseweyo luoro Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

kikuyu: kendo Solomon nochiwo ni Hiram gunde alufu mia achiel gi piero ariyo gabich mag ngano mondo obed chiemb joode kod mo madirom lita mia angʼwen gi piero aboro. Solomon nomedo dhi nyime katimo maa ne Hiram higa ka higa.
english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni amor gi richo manie chunya, to Ruoth dine ok ochikona ite,
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho niya, “Wuora, wenegi, nikech gikia gima gitimo!” To ne gipogore lepe ka gigoyo ombulu.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

kikuyu: An Petro ma jaote Yesu Kristo, Andikonu un jo-Nyasaye moyiero ma gin welo e piny, kendo mokere kuonde duto mag Ponto, gi Galatia, gi Kapadokia, gi Asia kod Bithinia.
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

kikuyu: To kane Hiram owuok Turo modhi mondo one mier mane Solomon osemiye ne ok omor kodgi.
english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

kikuyu: Unyiso ni un barupe moa kuom Kristo, ma tijwa okelo, ma ok ondiki gi wino, to mondiki gi Roho Maler mar Nyasaye mangima, bende ok ma ondiki e kite mopa, to mondiki e chuny dhano.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ma Wuon Ruodhwa Yesu ma ipako nyaka chiengʼ, ongʼeyo ni ok ariambi.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

kikuyu: nodonjo e yie, kaachiel gi jopuonjrene, mi gidhi e gwengʼ mar Dalmanutha.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

kikuyu: mago duto noket tenge mana kaka iketo boche mogol kuom rwedhi mitimogo misengini mag lalruok. Eka jadolo nowangʼ-gi pep ewi kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi nokelo mirima e chuny mon moluoro Nyasaye man-gi nying kod joma chwo midewo mane odak e dalano. Jogi nothuwo ji mondo osand Paulo gi Barnaba, kendo negiriembogi e gwengʼno.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

kikuyu: Joma kare biro neno mano mi gibed maluor; gibiro nyiere kagiwacho ni,
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

kikuyu: Ne aparo ni kane osetimo magi duto to ne odhi duogo ira makmana ne ok odwogo, kendo kata mana nyamin mare ma Juda ma ok ja-ratiro noneno mano.
english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

kikuyu: Joricho to owinjore orum e piny; joma timbegi richo ok onego obedie piny kata achiel. Pak Jehova Nyasaye, yaye chunya. Pak Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: abiro miyo unyaa mi udok mangʼeny. Mier matindo ji biro dakie, kendo kuonde momukore ibiro gero kendo.
english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

kikuyu: Abiro wer ne Jehova Nyasaye e ngimana duto, adier, abiro wero wende pak ne Nyasacha e kinde duto ma pod angima.
english: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

kikuyu: Kuom mano gikelo kum kuomgi giwegi, nikech giseketho singruokgi mokwongo.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

kikuyu: To wuod Harun mano kir remo kendo wangʼ boche mar misango mar lalruok nyaka kaw bam korachwich kaka pokne.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

kikuyu: Gin gik mochwe sani, kendo mapok obudho; bende gin gik mapok iwinjo nyaka chil kawuono. Omiyo ok inyal wacho ni, ‘Ee, ne angʼeyogi.’
english: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

kikuyu: Ok anaol mirimba mager bende ok analokra mi aketh Efraim bende. Nimar an Nyasaye, ok an dhano, Jal Maler e dieru. Ok anabi gi mirima.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

kikuyu: To ne walamo Nyasachwa mi waketo jorito odiechiengʼ gotieno mondo gigengʼ kihondkoni.
english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

kikuyu: Yawuotgi nodonjo mi gikawo pinyno. Niloyonegi jo-Kanaan, mane odak e pinyno; ne ichiwonegi jo-Kanaan, kaachiel gi ruodhi mag-gi gi jopinyno, mondo gitimgi kaka bernegi.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

kikuyu: Saulo noparo e chunye niya, “Abiro miyego, mondo obedne obadho mondo omi jo-Filistia oyude.” Omiyo Saulo nowachone Daudi niya, “Koro in-gi thuolo mar ariyo mondo ibed ora.”
english: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”

kikuyu: Kendo ma e kaka ibiro temu: Akwongʼora e nying Farao ni ok unuwuok ka makmana ka ukelo owadu ma chogo ka.
english: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

kikuyu: Joma nodhi kode ne gin ji kaka Sopata wuod Puro ja-Berea, gi Aristarko kod Sekundo, ma ja-Thesalonika, gi Gayo ja-Derbe, kod Timotheo bende, gi Tukiko kod Trofimo mane gin jo-Asia.
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

kikuyu: To kweth maduongʼ mag anguro ne kwayo e bath got kanyo. Jochiendego nosayo Yesu mondo oyie gidonji eigi, mi nomiyogi thuolo.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ machielo, malaike nochako obiro mondo gichungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Satan bende nobiro kodgi.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rituru Sabato nikech enobednu odiechiengʼ maler. Ngʼato angʼata ma ok orito odiechiengno nyaka negi bende ngʼato angʼata motiyo chiengʼ Sabato nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandane.
english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

kikuyu: Kaw remo moko mantie e kendo mar misango gi mor pwodhruok moko kendo kire kuom Harun gi lepe kendo kuom yawuote gi lepgi. Eka en gi yawuote gi lepgi nobed maler.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

kikuyu: “Ma e kaka Harun nodonj e Kama Ler Moloyo: Enokaw nyarwath mar misango mar golo richo kod im mar misango miwangʼo pep.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: un mugero Sayun gi remo, to Jerusalem gi timbe mamono.
english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato osingo girkeni mage, to mwandunego ok pogi kapok otho,
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, ruoth ne miyo Jehoyakin pok mowinjore kode ndalo duto mag ngimane.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

kikuyu: Bende en gima owinjore mondo onyise ka adwaro wuoyo? Donge ngʼama ohedhore timo kamano dotieki?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kikuyu: Mzabibu mari osetongʼ mi owangʼ gi mach, jogi lal nono nikech isekwerogi.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

kikuyu: Rituru Sabato maga, kendo luoruru kara maler mar lemo. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka yore ngʼato moro Jehova Nyasaye, to omiyo kata wasike dak kode gi kwe.
english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

kikuyu: Kochomo yo milambo, koluwore gi bor mar ohinga mar laru ma oko, kendo momakore gi laru mar hekalu kendo ka omanyore gi ohinga ma oko,
english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

kikuyu: Chikuru itu kawuoyo, yaye polo; to in piny winj weche mawuok e dhoga.
english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya; “Nyis Harun kama: ‘Rie ludhi ewi aore, sokni kod yewni, kendo ogwende nowuog maim piny Misri duto.’ ”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Joma chulo rach kuom ber ma asetimonegi kuodho nyinga ka an to alawo gima ber.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

kikuyu: Giniluonga, to ok anadwokgi; ginimanya to ok giniyuda.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

kikuyu: Kethruok mosiko osejuko jasigu, isemuko miechgi madongo; kendo wi ji osewil kodgi.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno makelo chandruok ni joge ok nonwangʼ gimoro, to ngʼat mofuwo nobed misumba ngʼat mariek.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

kikuyu: Un chwo bende nyaka udag gi mondeu kuweyonegi korgi. Migiuru luor kaka chwech mangʼaw kendo kaka jouteu muchamogo mich mar ngima momiu kuom ngʼwono. Kutimo kamano to onge gima biro mono lemou chopo e nyim Nyasaye.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata manomul gima obetie, nyaka luok lepe, kendo olwokre, en bende nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Kane Farao ooro ji mondo onon wachno, to negiyudo kaonge kata achiel kuom jamb jo-Israel mane otho. To kata kamano wi Farao nomedo bedo matek mine ok onyal weyo ogandano mondo odhi.
english: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

kikuyu: Nogero kar kambi jolweny ei Edom kendo jo-Edom nobedo e bwo loch Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Daudi olocho kamoro amora mane odhiye.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Yawuot Uziel ne gin: Mika mane wuowi makayo kod Ishia wuowi mar ariyo.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

kikuyu: Bende, jo-Memfis gi jo-Tapanhes oselielo osimbo mar wiyi.
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

kikuyu: nyikwa Adin, ji mia auchiel gi piero abich gabich (655),
english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.

kikuyu: Israel nofwenyo kendo owacho niya, “Ma en kandho wuoda! Le moro mager nonege. En adier ni le mager onego Josef mokidhe matindo tindo.”
english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

kikuyu: Bende farese nyalo ringo e kite, koso ngʼato nyalo puro wi kitego gi dhok? Kata kamano, un to uloko bura makare bedo gima kech, bende tim makare uloko gima rach.
english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,

kikuyu: Omiyo ok wachom wengewa kuom gik mineno, to kuom gik ma ok ne. Nikech gik mineno gi wangʼ rumo, to gik ma ok ne siko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

kikuyu: Winjuru wachna, yaye od Jakobo, un jo-Israel duto modongʼ, un duto ma aseyiero nyaka aa chakruok kendo ma aserito nyaka aa e nywolu.
english: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.

kikuyu: nikech jo-Beeroth noringo modhi Gitaim mi gibedo kuno kaka jodak nyaka chil kawuono.
english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

kikuyu: Eka Jehoyada nomiyo ruoth kod jo-Israel osingore ne Jehova Nyasaye ni ginibed jo-Jehova Nyasaye. Nomiyo ruoth gi ji otimo singruok e kindgi giwegi.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; also between the king and the people.

kikuyu: Res jogi kendo gwedh jogi moyier bed Jakwadh jogi kendo telnegi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

kikuyu: Nyise ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kama: ‘Ma e ngʼat ma nyinge iluongo ni Bad Yath, kendo obiro dongo maber kama entie mi oger hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.

kikuyu: Ruodhigi duto noriwo tekogi mi gichokore kanyakla e Sokni mag Merom, mondo giked gi jo-Israel.
english: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

kikuyu: Ok anyal kawo ngʼwono Nyasaye ka gir tugo, nikech ka dipo ni ngima makare inyalo yudo kuom mako Chik, to kare Kristo notho kayiem nono!”
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

kikuyu: nowacho niya, “Dinuru dho rogono gi kidi maduongʼ kendo uket jomoko kanyo mondo orite.
english: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;

kikuyu: adier, Jal marito Israel ok nur kendo ok nindi.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat wuode nobedo ruoth kare kendo nogurore motegno mondo osir Israel.
english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

kikuyu: Daudi noluonge mochiemo mi ometho kode kendo Daudi nomiye math momer. To kotieno nochopo Uria nowuok modhi onindo e pare kaachiel gi jotij ruodhe; to ne ok odhi ode.
english: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Ma e gima Hezekia wacho: Odiechiengni en odiechieng kuyo, siem kod wichkuot machalo gi nyithindo ma ndalogi mar nywol osechopo to onge teko minywologigo.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom malaike abiriyogo mane nigi tewni abiriyo motingʼo masiche abiriyo mogik nobiro ira mowachona niya, “Bi, mondo anyisi miaha ma en chi Nyarombo.”
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno nowacho niya, “Nyingi ok nochak oluongi ni Jakobo, to noluongi ni Israel nikech ise ii gi Nyasaye kod ji mi iseloyo.”
english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka wuoro kecho nyithinde, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye kecho joma omiye luor;
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Shafan jagoro nowachone niya, “Hilkia jadolo osemiya kitabu moro.” Mi Shafan nosomo kitabuno e nyim ruoth.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

kikuyu: Midekre osemako Efraim, kendo tiendene ner, ok ginyag olemo. Kata ka ginywolo nyithindo, to ananeg nyithindgi ma gihero ahinyago.”
english: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”

kikuyu: Joote ne oa e nyim buch Sanhedrin kamor ahinya, nikech ne okwan-gi kaka joma oromo yudo sand nikech Nyingno.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

kikuyu: Opak Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ!
english: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

kikuyu: Kane ginene to negilame; to moko kuomgi noriwo gi kiawa.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat mar ariyo nobiro kendo nowacho ni, ‘Ruoth, silingʼ alufu achiel osenywolo silinge alufu abich moko.’
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

kikuyu: Kochakore kinde mane akelo kwereu koa Misri nyaka kawuono, ne asiemogi nyadingʼeny, ka awacho niya, “Luorauru.”
english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo mar loch Jotham wuod Uzia; Hoshea wuod Ela nojamo Peka wuod Remalia monege kendo nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

kikuyu: Kendo negimedo bedo kinde duto ei hekalu, kagipako Nyasaye.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka nongʼanyo ni ruoth: Solomon nosegero ohinga kendo nosedino otuchi duto mane ni e kor ohinga e dala maduongʼ Daudi wuon-gi
english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

kikuyu: Ka unyago olemo mangʼeny, to Wuora yudo duongʼ, kendo mano nyiso ni un jopuonjrena.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼatni Jehoyakin en ngʼama ojar, agulu motore, gino maonge ngʼama dwaro? En angʼo momiyo en kod nyithinde nyaka witgi oko e piny ma ok gingʼeyo?
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka magi duto nosetim, jotelo nobiro ira kendo owacho niya, “Jo-Israel kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi, ok osethegore gi joma ne gikiewogo kuom yoregi mamono, kaka mago mag jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, jo-Jebus, jo-Amon, jo-Moab, jo-Misri kod jo-Amor.
english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye e Ruoth, omiyo piny mondo obed mamor; dho nembe man mabor mondo obed moil.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

kikuyu: Nopimo yo milambo, gi gir pimo mi noromo fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

kikuyu: Nobiro moyalo kwe ne un mane un mabor, kendo oyalo kwe ni jogo mane ni machiegni.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

kikuyu: Emomiyo masichene chiengʼ moro achiel noloye; masichego gin tho gi ywagruok kod kech. Nowangʼe gi mach, nikech Ruoth Nyasaye mangʼadone bura, nigi teko maduongʼ moloyo!
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

kikuyu: nimar mich Nyasaye kod luongne ok lokre.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

kikuyu: Landuru wachni e dier pinje, Ikreuru ne lweny! Jolweny magu duto oikre ne kedo! Jokedo duto mondo osudre machiegni mondo gitug lweny.
english: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.

kikuyu: mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike kokalo kuom Musa. Ma ne parone jo-Israel ni onge ngʼato angʼata makmana nyikwa Harun ema onego bi mondo owangʼ gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ka ok kamano to obiro chalo kaka Kora kod jolupne.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before the LORD, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kod chiwo mar cham, kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Chokuru giu duto mondo ua e pinyno, un joma ogengʼnigi.
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

kikuyu: Kamano negichwanyore nikech en. To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Janabi onge gi duongʼ mana e dalagi kendo gi ode owuon.”
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Ka wachni okel e nyimu, to nyaka unon tiende malongʼo. Ka unono wachni ma uyudo ni gima kwerono otimore e Israel adier,
english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia bende nosemonjo mier mane ni e bwo gode matindo kod man Negev ei Juda. Negimako kendo gikawo Beth Shemesh, Aijalon kod Gederoth kaachiel gi Soko, Timna kod Gimzo koriwore gi mier matindo molworogi.
english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

kikuyu: Weruru ne Nyasaye, weruru wende pak ne nyinge, miyeuru duongʼ, En moriembo gechene e boche polo, nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye, beduru moil e nyime.
