english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

kikuyu: To kata kamano nikech Daudi, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache nomiye taya Jerusalem koyiero wuode mondo okaw lochne kendo oket Jerusalem obed motegno.
english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isenona kendo ingʼeya.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

kikuyu: Piny ywak kendo dok chien, Lebanon ni e wichkuot kendo okethore, Sharon olokore ongoro ka Araba, kendo Bashan gi Karmel oyaki modongʼ nono.
english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

kikuyu: Nikech e pinyni waonge gi dala mosiko, to warito dala machielo mwabiro nwangʼo achien.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

kikuyu: Magi e weche mag Agur wuod Jake, ma gin weche matut. Magi e weche ma Agur wachone Ithiel; adier owuoyo ne Ithiel niya, “Aol marumo, yaye Nyasaye, to pod anyalo wuoyo.
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

kikuyu: mane wuon mare ne ok otimo kaka: “Ochiemo ewi gode milame nyiseche mamoko. Odwanyore gi chi nyawadgi.
english: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

kikuyu: To wanasiki ka wawacho adiera e hera kendo ka wadongo e gik moko duto kuom Kristo ma en ewi ringruok.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

kikuyu: Mana kaka Adam, giseketho singruok mane atimo kodgi, ne ok gibedo jo-adier koda e ndalono.
english: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.

kikuyu: Anto atego wangʼa kuomi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto; In e kar pondona, omiyo kik iwe atho.
english: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

kikuyu: ka gikawe duto chakre e aora Arnon nyaka e aora Jabok kendo koa e thim nyaka e aora Jordan.
english: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

kikuyu: Nochano yien, mongʼado rwadhno e lemo lemo mokete e yien. Eka nowachonegi niya, “Pongʼuru dopige angʼwen mag pi mondo uolie misango kod yien.”
english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo koro iywak matek kamano, ionge gi ruoth koso? Dipo ka jangʼadni rieko osetho, marem chami mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo?
english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

kikuyu: Gokinyi mangʼich, Jerub-Baal (mano en Gideon) kod joge duto nojot e soko mar Harod. Kambi jo-Midian ne nitiere yo nyandwat margi e holo man but got More.
english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato moro ei oganda odonjo e richo ka ok ongʼeyo kendo otimo gima chik Jehova Nyasaye ok oyiego, to en jaketho.
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Kane Elisha ochopo e odno wuowi pod ne nindo e kitandane.
english: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

kikuyu: Ewi got malo kuma idhiyoeno ema inithoe, mi iki gi ogandau, mana kaka owadu Harun notho e got Hor mi oike gi kwerene.
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

kikuyu: Nyingi mondo otingʼ malo moyombo polo, yaye Nyasaye; mad duongʼ mari opongʼ piny duto.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

kikuyu: ongʼiyo ji duto modak e piny gie kar dakne e polo,
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

kikuyu: Kata moko kuom jotend pinyno mane osiepene, noorone wach kakwaye mondo kik odonj e paw tugono.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

kikuyu: Eka naparo kaka Ruoth nosewacho motelo ni, ‘Johana nobatiso ji gi pi, to un ibiro batisou gi Roho Maler.’
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Zebadia, Meshulam, Hizki, Heber,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

kikuyu: En angʼo ma ngʼato yudo kuom tije matek motimo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: mar bedo Jatich Kristo Yesu e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi, ka atiyo tich dolo mar lando Injili Maber mar Nyasaye mondo ogendini obed misango maler ma Nyasaye oyiego kendo ma Roho Maler opwodho.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka Jehoshafat norito Juda. Ne en ja-higni piero adek gabich kane obedo ruodh Juda kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero ariyo gabich. Min mare ne nyinge Azuba nyar Shilhi.
english: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane ni e dala maduongʼno noneg gi ligangla. Negitiekogi pep maonge gima yweyo mane odongʼ, Hazor bende ne giwangʼo.
english: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nokawo pinyno duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa, mi nochiwe kaka girkeni ni jo-Israel kaluwore gi migepe mag dhoutegi. Bangʼe pinyni nobedo gi kwe.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier, ni ka ok uchamo ringre Wuod Dhano kendo umadho rembe, to uonge gi ngima.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

kikuyu: Rieko noresi kuom yore mag joma mono, kuom jogo mawacho weche mochido,
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

kikuyu: to ngʼama kamano koro ogony kuom ‘luoro wuon gi min’ gi michneno. Kamano umiyo wach Nyasaye bedo maonge teko nikech wach kitu gi timbeu.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

kikuyu: momiyo koro iwuoyo gi Nyasaye ka in gi mirima kendo iwacho weche machalo kamano gi dhogi?
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nochiwo Gilead e lwet jo-Makir, ma nyikwa Manase, kendo negidak kanyo.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

kikuyu: Kendo nowachonegi niya, “Winjauru un jo-Lawi! Koro pwodhreuru kendo chiwreuru ni hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu. Goluru chilo maricho e kama ler mar lemo.
english: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

kikuyu: Yamo nokudh kuomgi ka giringo kendo tekone malich nomi kihondko makgi.”
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat mane ochungʼ e dier yiend kuth ochwoga nonyisa niya, “Gin e joma Jehova Nyasaye oseoro mondo odhi e piny koni gi koni.”
english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

kikuyu: Uzi nonywolo Zerahia, to Zerahia nonywolo Merayoth,
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowacho ni Shimei niya, “Ok ibi tho.” Kendo ruoth nosingore kokwongʼore.
english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

kikuyu: Janabi Jeremia nodwoko niya, “Asewinjou. Adier nyaka analamnu Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha kaka usekwayo; ananyisu gimoro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye owacho kendo onge gima anapandnu.”
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to the LORD your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing the LORD answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”

kikuyu: To kata bangʼ kane gisechamogi, to onge ngʼato angʼata mane nyalo yie ni gin ema gichamo dhogo; ne ginenore modhero moloyo kaka ne gin mokwongo. Bangʼe ne achiewo.
english: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

kikuyu: Magi e chike mag misango ma ipwodhruokgo e ketho, ma en misango maler moloyo:
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

kikuyu: Kendo Abimelek nopenjo Ibrahim niya, “En angʼo miparo momiyo itimo gini?”
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

kikuyu: Owinjore uket chunyu kuom mich madongo. Koro abiro nyisou yo moro maber moloyo.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

kikuyu: Urbano, ma en jatich Kristo wadwa, kod Stakus ma osiepna mageno bende mosnauru.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

kikuyu: Tim makare mar joma kare resogi, to jogo ma ok jo-adiera imako gi gombogi maricho.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

kikuyu: To ka awachone rawera ni, ‘Ne, aserni ni nyimi,’ eka nyaka idhi nikech Jehova Nyasaye dwaro ni idhi adhiya.
english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for the LORD has sent you away.

kikuyu: Eka noyieyo lwete kuome mi opwodhe, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama ne loso bangʼa; wechena ne lwar e itgi mos ka ngʼidho.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

kikuyu: E kindeno jodong Nebukadneza ruoth Babulon nodonjo e Jerusalem mokawe,
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ber, Jehova Nyasaye e kar pondo e kinde mag chandruok, orito joma ogeno kuome.
english: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: “Kwan jo-Lawi kaluwore gi joutgi kod anywolagi. Kwan chwo duto chakre ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime.”
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

kikuyu: “Dhiuru upenj Jehova Nyasaye gima biro timorena, jo-Israel kod jo-Juda modongʼ kaluwore gi weche mantiere e kitabu mosenwangʼno. Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye maliel ka mach osechomowa nikech kwerewa ok oserito wach Jehova Nyasaye; kendo ok gisetimo timbe moluwore gi gik moko duto mondiki e kitabuni.”
english: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the LORD’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

kikuyu: Negichiwore ne tich mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gigolo dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia achiel gi piero ochiko kod machielo ma pekne romo kilo piero aboro gangʼwen, gi fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia adek gi piero abiriyo gabich kod mula ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia auchiel gi piero abiriyo gabich kaachiel gi nyinyo ma pekne romo kilo gana adek, alufu mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

kikuyu: Eka unudhi kode kendo enobi mi obedi e kom lochna mondo olochi kara. Asekete jatelo kuom jo-Israel kod jo-Juda.”
english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

kikuyu: Ka wawacho ni wabiro dhi e dala maduongʼ, to kech ni kuno kendo wabiro tho. To bende ka wabet ka, pod wabiro mana tho. Kuom mano wadhiuru e kambi jo-Aram mondo wachiwre e lwetgi. Ka giweyowa to wanabed mangima, to ka ginegowa to wanatho.”
english: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

kikuyu: To ngʼat ringruok ok nyal rwako gik moa kuom Roho mar Nyasaye, nikech onenogi kaka fuwo kendo ok onyal winjo tiendgi, nikech iwinjogi kuom Roho.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

kikuyu: Omiyo negioro joote ir Jeroboam, mi nobiro ir Rehoboam kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto mi giwachone niya,
english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

kikuyu: nikech ngʼato angʼata madonjo e yweyo mar Nyasaye nyaka ywe e tijene, mana kaka Nyasaye bende noyweyo e tijene.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

kikuyu: Nowangʼ boche duto ewi kendo mar misango mana kaka nowangʼo mo mar misango mar lalruok ma en tik madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodh ketho mar ngʼatno kendo nowene richone.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Holo mar Sidim nopongʼ gi buche mag chwodho, kendo kane ruodhi mag Sodom kod Gomora ringo, moko nopodho e buchego to moko noringo otony e gode.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

kikuyu: Ka ruodhe omiye dhako kendo onywolone yawuowi gi nyiri, dhakono kaachiel gi nyithinde nobed mwandu ruodhe kendo mana misumbano kende ema nobed thuolo.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

kikuyu: Ngimani nofwenyore mine wanene, omiyo wawuoyo kuome, kendo wanyisou wach ngima mochwere mane nigi Wuoro kendo mane onyiswa.
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

kikuyu: Manase nokawo piny Tapua, to Tapua owuon, mane nitiere e tongʼ Manase, nobedo mar jo-Efraim.
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Bangʼe rwak Harun gi lepe maler mag dolo, wire kendo wale mondo otina kaka jadolo.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: mondo omi ji ongʼe ni koa wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ, onge ngʼat moro amora makmana an. An e Jehova Nyasaye, kendo moro onge.
english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.

kikuyu: Oumore gi ler mana kaka nanga; oyaro polo mana kaka hema
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

kikuyu: Omiyo Lebanon chikore ka nyaroya, Sirion lengʼore ka jowi ma pod tin.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

kikuyu: To ka iro nochako dhwolore malo koa e dala maduongʼ, jo-Benjamin nolokore moneno ka iro madhwolore e dalano ochomo polo.
english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

kikuyu: Aore iru mondo ungʼe kaka wachal, kendo mondo ojiw chunyu.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

kikuyu: Nimar dikoro ayweyo gi kwe; kendo dikoro anindo kendo ayweyo,
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

kikuyu: Eka owetene nobiro ire kendo ogoyo chongegi piny e nyime: Negiwachone niya, “Wan wasumbinigi.”
english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

kikuyu: Sara nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero ariyo gabiriyo.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

kikuyu: Osenyisu gigi duto mondo ungʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye; onge Nyasaye moro ma ok en.
english: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.

kikuyu: Nyaka orwak kandhone mopwodhi mar dolo miluongo ni tunik gi sati maiye, bangʼe to otwe okanda kendo otwe kilemba e wiye. Magi gin lep dolo; kuom mano nyaka olwokre kapod orwakogi.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

kikuyu: Pien nyarwadhno gi ringe duto, kaachiel gi wiye kod tiendene, jamb-iye kod wen,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

kikuyu: “Aywagorani, yaye Nyasaye, to itamori dwoko; achungʼ e nyimi to ingʼiya angʼiya.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

kikuyu: Erokamano ni Nyasaye, ma kinde duto telonwa kaka joma oselocho kuom Kristo, kendo ma konyore kodwa kuom keyo tik mamit mar ngʼeyo Kristo.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Ji moko ne orito Yesu kanyo ka gidwaro yo ma digiyudgo ketho kuome. Kuom mano ne girange ahinya mondo gine ka dochang ngʼatno chiengʼ Sabato.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: nimar ji duto oseketho kendo girem kuom duongʼ mar Nyasaye,
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho kendo naneno ka leche gi ringʼo chako bet e chokego, kendo pien noumogi, to kata kamano ne pod gionge gi ngima.
english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Dhi iluong chwori eka iduogi.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

kikuyu: “Juda, oweteni biro paki; bende inimak wasiki gi ngʼutgi, kendo oweteni biro kuloreni.
english: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

kikuyu: Ariel, Ariel, inine malit, in dala maduongʼ mane Daudi odakie! Meduru dhi nyime ka utimo sewni higa ka higa.
english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Kik itweri kuoma, nimar pok adok ka Wuora, to dhi ir owetena mondo inyisgi ni, ‘Adok ir Wuora ma en Wuoru un bende, kendo Nyasacha ma en Nyasachu.’ ”
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

kikuyu: Negituro kunde dhok kendo negipeyo rombe, diek kod ngamia mathoth bangʼe negidok Jerusalem.
english: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Benaya ja-Pirathon, gi Hidai moa e holo man Gash,
english: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

kikuyu: Chiwuru ne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep, misango mowangʼ mar nyirwedhi ariyo, im achiel kod nyiimbe abiriyo mahikgi achiel kendo maonge songa.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ji nodhi nyime kod timo misengini e kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo to negitime ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi kende.
english: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ondiki niya, “Adam ma en dhano mokwongo, nobedo ngʼat mangima” to Adam mogik nodoko chuny machiwo ngima.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ogwedhi adier, Simon wuod Jona, nimar dhano ok ema osefwenyoni tiend wachni, to Wuora manie polo ema osefwenyonigo.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: jogo mano chokore notimo winjruok gi ruoth e hekalu mar Nyasaye. Jehoyada nowachonegi niya, “Wuod ruoth nobed e loch kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingore kuom nyikwa Daudi.
english: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as the LORD has spoken concerning the sons of David.

kikuyu: Ofwenyo gik matut mopondo ei mudho kendo okelo ler kuonde motimo mudho.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ne okawo kothe moko moa e puotheu kendo noketogi e lowo mamiyo. Nopidhe e tiend aora kama pi ngʼenyie mana kaka ipidho yien ma bedene odolore-odolore mati kuode ma pi nitie,
english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

kikuyu: To notho ni ji duto mondo joma ngima koro kik bed mangima mana ni gin giwegi, to mondo gibed mangima ni Jal ma notho mochako ochier nikech gin.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

kikuyu: Yesu nosiemogi matek mondo kik ginyis, ngʼato angʼata wachni.
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

kikuyu: Nokaw boche duto mi nowangʼ-gi ewi kendo mar misango,
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

kikuyu: Juda wuod Jakobo, gi Judas Iskariot, mane olokore obedo jandhok.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

kikuyu: Nobiro ir joge owuon, to joge ne ok orwake.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

kikuyu: ginimi itangʼ ni dhako ma jachode, inibed mabor gi dhako mabayo kaachiel, kod wechene malombo ji.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

kikuyu: Isaka nopenje niya, “To ne iyude piyo nade wuoda?” Nodwoke niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasaye nogwedha.”
english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Jediael duto ne gin jotend anywolagi. Ne nitiere ji ma jolweny alufu apar gabiriyo gi mia ariyo (17,200) mane oikore dhi e lweny.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

kikuyu: Wuonwa noketo kuomu tingʼ mapek; an to abiro medo pekne moloyo. Wuonwa nochwadou gi boka, an to abiro chwadou malit makecho ka thomoni.’ ”
english: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

kikuyu: “Anaresi e lwet joma timbegi mono kendo akonyi e lwet joma ger.”
english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosemiyo Nyasaye gimoro ma dobandh Nyasaye mondo ochule?
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

kikuyu: Rehoboam nodhi Shekem nimar jo-Israel duto nodhi kuno mondo okete ruoth.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

kikuyu: jogo moweyo yore moriere mag bidhruok, mondo giwuothi e yore mag mudho,
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

kikuyu: ma gin chike mane omiyou kokalo kuome, chakre e kinde mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiwogie kendo ka gidhi nyime nyaka e tienge mabiro;
english: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

kikuyu: Anakegi e dier ogendini ma gin kata wuonegi ok ongʼeyo, kendo analawgi gi ligangla manyaka atiekgi.”
english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

kikuyu: Ne uneno gi wengeu uwegi gima Jehova Nyasaye ne otimo Baal Peor. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu notieko koa kuomu jogo duto mane oluwo Baal mar Peor,
english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

kikuyu: Aweyonu kwe; kwe mara ema amiyou. En kwe ma pinyni ok nyal miyou. Kik chunyu parre kendo kik ubed maluor.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

kikuyu: Yier Harun kod yawuote mondo obed jodolo; ngʼato angʼata mosudo machiegni gi kama ler mar lemo nyaka negi.”
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

kikuyu: mad yore ma giluwo bed gi mudho bende yoregigo obed makierogi ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye lawogi.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

kikuyu: Nus modongʼ mar joka Manase, gi jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad noseyudo girkeni mag-gi mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye osemiyogi yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan.
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gachiel e dwe mar Bul, dwe mar aboro hekalu notieki chutho kaka nochan ni onego gere. Notieko higni abiriyo kigere.
english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

kikuyu: Koro yieuru koda mondo uchamie gimoro matin mondo ubed mangima. Awachonu ni onge ngʼato kata achiel kuomu mabiro wito kata mana yie wiye achiel.”
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

kikuyu: “Ranyisi biro bedo e wangʼ chiengʼ gi dwe kod sulwe. E piny, to ogendini nobed kodhier kendo kongʼengʼ, nikech nam mawuo kendo apaka magore.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

kikuyu: E kindeno abiro chopo weche mane awacho kuom Eli ka akwede kod mane awacho kuom ode aa chakruok nyaka giko.
english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

kikuyu: Obiro tho nikech ok oyie mondo orieye, obayo yo nikech fupe maduongʼ.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

kikuyu: Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni kata mana nyameru ma Sodom gi nyige ne ok otimo gik maricho machal gi gik ma in kod nyigi usetimoni.
english: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Jogo mogwedhi gin mana joma winjo wach Nyasaye kendo rito.”
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

kikuyu: Ochalo bende gi thoo momoko e Got Hermon maridore ewi Got Sayun. Nimar kanyo ema Jehova Nyasaye chiwe gwethne, ma en ngima mochwere.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Anaket rachwany e nyim jogi. Wuone kod yawuowi nochwanyre kuomgi; jogo modak mokiewo kodgi kod osiepe nolal nono.”
english: Therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”

kikuyu: Chikuru itu uwinja, un jo-mwandu! Ywaguru kendo gouru nduru nikech masiche mathoth mochomou.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar joka Harun kod Musa e kinde mane Jehova Nyasaye owuoyo gi Musa e Got Sinai.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Dhano mangima ok ongʼeyo kaka iyude; kendo ok oyudre e piny joma ngima.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Joma ok jo-Yahudi ok nochak oyak gigi kendo, le makwiny ok nochak oneg-gi. Ginidag kaonge gima giluoro, kendo onge ngʼama nomigi luoro.
english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

kikuyu: Kik uchul ngʼato angʼata rach kar rach. Neuru ni utimo gima ji duto oyiego ni ber.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

kikuyu: Dhakono nosembo pundano kendo nowachone jatichne niya, “Tel nyima kendo kik irita makmana kawachoni.”
english: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, to un ema uwuondo joweteu kendo utimonegi marach, to eka utimo kamano mana ni joweteu kuom yie.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

kikuyu: “Aserito warruok yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.

kikuyu: Bende ogendini oseloko nyiseche nyaka nene? (Kata kamano bende ok gin nyiseche.) To joga osewilo duongʼ mar Nyasachgi, gi nyiseche manono maonge tiendgi.
english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.

kikuyu: To Stefano, kopongʼ gi Roho Maler, nongʼiyo malo e polo mi oneno duongʼ mar Nyasaye, kod Yesu kochungʼ e bad Nyasaye korachwich.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: Joma timbegi ni kare yudo kwe; kendo giyudo yweyo ka ginindo e liel.
english: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

kikuyu: Ginibed ranyisi kod midhiero kuomu kod nyikwau nyaka chiengʼ.
english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: Jogo madeko oko ka kongʼo, madhi mondo gibil kongʼo mokik mayoreyore.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

kikuyu: “Abiro loko kar dakne ochal gi kar dak tula, kendo kar siany; mi anayweye oko kendo tieke chuth.”
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Dan nodhi nyime gi wuoth, kendo ka Mika noneno ka tekregi pekne, nowuok mi odok dalane.
english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

kikuyu: donge Nyasaye dine ofwenyo wachno, nikech ongʼeyo gik malingʼ-lingʼ manie chuny?
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

kikuyu: Bethuel, Horma, Ziklag,
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

kikuyu: To koro pinyruodhi ok bi siko, Jehova Nyasaye oseyudo ngʼat ma chunye chal gi mare kendo osekete, mondo otel ne joge, nikech in ok iserito chik mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But now your kingdom will not continue. The LORD has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which the LORD commanded you.”

kikuyu: Nokwero Nam Makwar, mi Nam Makwar notwo; kendo nomiyo gikalo kama tut mana ka gima ne giwuotho kama otwo.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

kikuyu: Chiwuru misango miwangʼo pep mar nyarwath achiel, im achiel kod nyiimbe abiriyo moromo higa achiel, ma duto onge songa mondo obed kaka misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Luoro nomake mi owacho niya, “Ma kama lich manade! Nyaka bedni ma en od Nyasaye; ma en dhoranga polo.”
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowuoyo kodgi kendo gi ngeche, kowacho niya,
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar adek ngʼato nobiro koa e kambi mar Saulo korwako lewni moyiech to wiye otimo buru, kane ochopo ir Daudi nokulore nyaka piny komiye duongʼ.
english: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

kikuyu: Joma ohero chikeni nigi kwe maduongʼ kendo onge gima nyalo miyo gichwanyre.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

kikuyu: nikech mirimbi maduongʼ, nimar isekawa mi iwita gichien.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Wadhiuru kamachielo e gwenge man machiegni, mondo kuno bende ayalie.” Mano emomiyo asebiro.
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

kikuyu: Eli nodwoke kawachone niya, “Dhi gi kwe, mad Nyasach Israel miyi gima isebedo kikwaye.”
english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Ka e kama jodolo biro chiwoe misango mar pwodhruok e ketho gi misango mar golo richo kendo ma gibiro tedoe chiwo mar cham, mondo ogengʼ-gi kik gibi e laru ma oko mi gimi ji dok mogak.”
english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

kikuyu: Ruodh Makeda, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Bethel, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

kikuyu: Abner ne iye owangʼ ahinya nikech wach mane Ish-Boseth owachone mine odwoke niya, “Kare aromra mana gi wich guok e kind Juda? Kawuononi abolora e bwo loch wuonu ma Saulo gi joode kod osiepene. Pok achiwi e lwet Daudi. To kata kamano, iketho nyinga ni atimo richo gi dhakoni!
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

kikuyu: Wachni mondo ondik piny ne tiengʼ mabiro, mondo joma pok onywol opak Jehova Nyasaye:
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

kikuyu: To kata kamano pod nitie jomoko kuomu ma ok oyie.” Yesu nowacho kamano nikech nosengʼeyo nyaka aa chakruok joma ok oyie kaachiel gi ngʼat mabiro ndhoge.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

kikuyu: Kane dhako oneno ni olemb yien-no ne ber kuom chiemo kendo moro wangʼ kendo nyalo miyo ibed gi rieko, nokawo moko mochamo, to bangʼe nomiyo chwore ma en bende nochame.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni jotheth moko mach matek mondo oleny fedha, kendo opwodhi, to mano en mana kayiem nono; kamano bende joma richo ok nyal pwodhore.
english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech koro ok abi kecho joma odak e piny, abiro chiwo ngʼato ka ngʼato e lwet ngʼat ma gidakgo machiegni kaachiel gi ruodhe. Gibiro sando piny, kendo ok anaresgi e lwetgi.”
english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says the LORD; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

kikuyu: Rombena winjo dwonda, bende angʼeyogi kendo giluwo bangʼa.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

kikuyu: nikech negilokore giweyo luwe kendo ne ok gidewo yorene kata achiel.
english: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye adier, kendo onge jawar moro machielo makmana an.
english: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.

kikuyu: Pinyu odongʼ gunda, miechu madongo osewangʼ gi mach; puotheu jopinje mamoko osemau mana kuneno gi wangʼu, ma gidongʼ gundni mana ka joma wasigu oseriembo.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

kikuyu: “Winjuru, abiro chweyo polo manyien kod piny manyien. Gik mosekadho ok nochak opar bende ok ginibi kata e paro.
english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

kikuyu: Isaka nochako oyawo sokni mane osekuny e ndalo Ibrahim wuon mare, mane jo-Filistia odino bangʼ tho Ibrahim, kendo nochakogi nying mane oyudo wuon-gi Ibrahim osechakogi chon.
english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

kikuyu: To wach maduongʼ mar Chikni en hera mawuok e chuny maler kendo maonge bura kod yie mar adier.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Kik iluore nimar asechiwe e lweti, en kaachiel gi jolweny mage duto kod pinye. Timne kaka ne itimone Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, mane obedo gi loch e piny Heshbon.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Gin giwegi ema ne giwuoyo gi Farao ruodh jo-Misri mondo ogol jo-Israel e piny Misri. Ne en mana Musa kod Harun.
english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: kama Yesu ma nosetelonwa nosedonjoe. Osedoko jadolo maduongʼ manyaka chiengʼ, koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: To kata kamano polo nodudo kendo yamo nokudho mi koth maduongʼ nochako oo kendo Ahab nodhi Jezreel.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo ywak Elija mi ngima wuowino noduogone mi nobedo mangima.
english: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

kikuyu: Aseketo chunya mondo ayal Injili kuonde ma ji pok ongʼeyoe Kristo, mondo kik agedi ewi mise ma ngʼat machielo ema nochako.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

kikuyu: Kwero ngʼato ratiro ber moloyo hera mopandi.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

kikuyu: Ne angʼiyo iye mi aneno kit le mopidhi man-gi tiende angʼwen manie piny, gi le mager mag bungu, kod le mamol, gi winy mafuyo e kor polo.
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: kendo chunya oil kuom Nyasaye Jawarna,
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

kikuyu: Mwandu moyudi gi lep mariambo en mana tho malal piyo kendo en obeto mar tho.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

kikuyu: Un to usechayo joma odhier! Donge gin jo-mwandu ema mayou giu kendo materou e ute mag ngʼado bura mondo okumu?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

kikuyu: to pod ibiro luta mana e chwodho mi nyaka lepa bende biro jok koda.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

kikuyu: Lop dhood Naftali ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Asher, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

kikuyu: go milome ne ji ni, ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma luoro omako ogom kendo oa e Got Gilead.’ ” Omiyo ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo noa, to ji alufu apar nodongʼ.
english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

kikuyu: Anamiu kwe e pinyu, mi ununindi maonge ngʼama nomiu luoro. Anatieki ondiegi duto e dieru kendo ligangla ok nomonju kata matin.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

kikuyu: Kane Musa otieko wuoyo kodgi, noketo ragengʼ e wangʼe.
english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

kikuyu: to nyaka aa e tin-na asekonyo nyithind kiye mana kaka akonyo nyithinda awuon, kendo chakre tin-na asebedo ka atayo mon ma chwogi otho.
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

kikuyu: Lop Manase ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Naftali, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

kikuyu: kendo piny Misri ni e lweti, ket wuonu kod oweteni odag kama berie moloyo. We gidag Goshen kendo ka ingʼeyo moko kuomgi man kod mich mar kwath ketgi mondo gibed jorit jamba.”
english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

kikuyu: Noluwo timbe ruodhi mag Israel kendo nochiwo wuode mondo otimgo liswa kaka misango miwangʼo pep koluwo timbe mamono mag ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye oriembo e nyim jo-Israel.
english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Piend divai mane wapongʼo bende ne nyien, to koro neye kaka giyiech. Lepwa kod wuochewa bende oseti nikech wuoth marabora ahinya.”
english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

kikuyu: Nimar ne anyise ni abiro ngʼado bura ne joode nyaka chiengʼ nikech richono mane ongʼeyo, yawuote ne timo timbe maricho, to ne ok okwerogi.
english: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier, ni ngʼato ka ngʼato ma oyie kuoma biro timo gik ma asebedo ka atimo. Bende obiro timo gik madongo moloyo magi, nikech adhi ka Wuora.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

kikuyu: Dhorangeye adek ne ni yo wuok chiengʼ, to adek yo nyandwat, kendo adek yo milambo bende adek mamoko yo podho chiengʼ.
english: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

kikuyu: Goch kod adhonde pwodho richo, to chwat loso maler chuny maiye.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Enokum joma okia Nyasaye kendo ma ok orito puonj mar Injili mar Ruodhwa Yesu.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: To koro inyisa mondo adhi ir ruodha kendo awachne ni, ‘Elija ni ka.’ Donge ingʼeyo ni obiro nega!”
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

kikuyu: Eka Rezin ruodh Aram kod Peka wuod Remalia ruodh Israel nowuok dhi gore gi Jerusalem mi omako Ahaz, to ne ok ginyal loye.
english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

kikuyu: Jowetena, kaka un e sungana kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo awachonu ka aramo, ni tho ochoma pile!
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

kikuyu: Winja, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kecha; yaye Jehova Nyasaye bed konyruok mara.”
english: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

kikuyu: “Koro Nyasachwa, winj lamo gi kwayo mar jatichni. Nikech nyingi, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, yie itim ngʼwono mondo kari maler mar lemo ochak oger.
english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

kikuyu: Osiepna, kik iluw timbe maricho, to luw tim maber. Ngʼat matimo gima ber en ngʼat Nyasaye, to ngʼat matimo gima rach pok oneno Nyasaye.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye rito maber ji duto mohere, to ji duto ma timbegi richo obiro tieko.
english: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

kikuyu: jodongo kod joma ogen e wich jo-Israel, to jonabi mapuonjo miriambo e iwe.
english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

kikuyu: To jogo ne luoro omako kane otergi e od Josef. Negiparo niya, “Osekelwa ka nikech pesa ma wayudo koduok e ogundewa, chiengʼ mane wabiro kae mokwongo. Odwaro ni mondo oichwa kendo olowa mondo mi oketwa wasumbini, bangʼe okaw pundewa.”
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

kikuyu: Iparo ni ok anyal kwayo Wuora mi oketna tenge migepe apar gariyo mag malaike mondo okedna sani sani?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

kikuyu: To kuom nyithindu mane uwacho ni ibiro kaw kaka gik moyaki, gin to abiro kelogi mondo giyud mor mar piny mane udagi.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

kikuyu: Kane sa chiemo ochopo, Boaz nowachone niya, “Bi ka ichiem. Kaw makati mondo iluti e divai makech.” Kane obet piny gi jokeyo, ne omiye ondelo moko. Ne ochiemo moyiengʼ mi chiemo moko nodongʼ.
english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She sat beside the reapers, and they passed her parched grain. She ate, was satisfied, and left some of it.

kikuyu: Nopenje ni, ‘Osiepna, ne idonjo e iye ka nade kionge gi lep arus?’ To dho ngʼatno nomoko.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

kikuyu: Ben-Abinadab norito Nafoth Dor (kendo nokendo Tafath ma nyar Solomon).
english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Ayub kama:
english: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

kikuyu: En ngʼa mabiro radona gi joma timbegi richo? Ngʼatno mabiro chwaka kakedo gi joricho?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

kikuyu: Eka Balaam nowacho ne Balak niya, “Bed but misango ka, ka an to alengʼora e bathe ka; nimar sa moro dipo ka Jehova Nyasaye ofwenyorena. Gimoro amora monyisa to abiro nyisi.” Eka nowuok modhi kama otingʼore gi malo motwo.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

kikuyu: Koro ka an ma an Ruodhu kendo Japuonju ema aselwoko tiendeu, un bende nyaka ulwok tiendeu ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

kikuyu: To Daniel noloyo jotend jorit pinje mamoko duto, nikech lony mamalo mane en-go, mi ruoth koro ne chano mondo omiye teko mar rito piny duto.
english: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

kikuyu: To gik mawuok e dhok aa e chuny, kendo gin ema gimiyo ngʼato doko ‘mogak.’
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ne awinji e puodho kendo luoro nomaka nikech ne an duk, koro ne apondo.”
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

kikuyu: kendo iwachne ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Yaye dala maduongʼ makelo ni en owuon chandruok kuom chwero remo e dier joge, kendo dwanyore owuon kuom loso nyiseche manono,
english: You shall say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!

kikuyu: Kane jodolo osewuok ei Kama Ler, bor polo noimo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye,
english: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,

kikuyu: Nebukadneza notero Jehoyakin e twech Babulon, kaachiel gi min ruoth, monde, jodonge kod jodong gwengʼ kogologi Jerusalem.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

kikuyu: “Ji ariyo nodhi lemo ei hekalu, achiel ne en ja-Farisai to machielo ne jasol osuru.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

kikuyu: Nyasach kwe mondo obed kodu uduto. Amin!
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Kane achano kamano, uparo nine atimo kamano ka atugo? Koso uparo ni aloso chenrona ka japiny, ma anyalo kiko wach ka ayie niya, “Ee, Ee” kendo achako akwer ni “Ooyo, Ooyo?”
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

kikuyu: Jomatindo gi jomadongo nindo e yore motimo buru; yawuota gi nyiga oseneg gi ligangla. Isenegogi ka in gi mirima kendo isetiekogi ka ok idewo.
english: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.

kikuyu: Jatelo noa e oganda joka Jakobo, kendo enotiek joma otony mag dala maduongʼ.”
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

kikuyu: Ere ngʼama jarieko? Ere japuonj chik? Ere jatwak molony moloyo e pinyni? Donge Nyasaye osemiyo rieko mar pinyni odoko fuwo?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

kikuyu: Eka Judas, ma ok Judas Iskariot, nowachone niya, “To Ruoth, angʼo momiyo wan ema idwaro fwenyorinwa to ok ni piny?”
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

kikuyu: To kane pod owuoyo kamano, Jonathan wuod Abiathar jadolo nochopo. Adonija nowachone niya, “Donji, ngʼat mowinjore kaka in nyaka bed ni okelo wach maber.”
english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

kikuyu: Simon Petro nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, ka kamano, to kik ilwok mana tienda kende, to luok bedena kod wiya bende!”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

kikuyu: Pand wangʼi mondo kik ine richona kendo gol kethona duto oko.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

kikuyu: E dala Wuora nitiere udi mangʼeny, kendo ka dine ok en kamano, to dikoro asenyisou. Adhi kuno mondo alosnu kar dak.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

kikuyu: Kendo Hezekia nolamo Jehova Nyasaye kowacho kama: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, modak e kind kerubi, in kendi e Nyasaye mar pinjeruodhi duto manie piny, kendo in ema ne ichweyo polo gi piny.
english: Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, “LORD, the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho niya, “Un osewalu ni Jehova Nyasaye kawuono nimar ne ulokoru gi oweteu gi yawuotu kendo Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhou kawuono.”
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

kikuyu: Pile ka walemonu to wadwoko erokamano ni Nyasaye ma en Wuon Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo,
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

kikuyu: Yawuot Beker ne gin: Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abija, Anathoth kod Alemeth. Magi duto ne gin yawuot Beker.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

kikuyu: To kuom jou modongʼ ka ngima e piny wasikgi, ginto anagogi kod kihondko e piny wasikgi, ma kata ka yamo okwadho it oboke maponi giwinjo, to giniwuog gi ngʼwech. Giniringi mana ka joma wasigu lawo gi ligangla mi gipodh piny kata obedo ni onge ngʼama lawogi.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

kikuyu: Ne oneno gik mane biro timore nyime, omiyo nowuoyo kuom chier mar Kristo ni ne ok bi jwangʼo ringre ei liel mi ringre tow.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

kikuyu: Awachonu, kuom jogo duto mamon onywolo onge ngʼato maduongʼ moloyo Johana; kata kamano ngʼatno matinie moloyo e pinyruoth Nyasaye duongʼ moloye.”
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

kikuyu: To Nebuzaradan noweyo jopinyno moko mane odhier ahinya mondo oti e puothe mag mzabibu kod puothe mamoko.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane odak e dala Reuben, kaluwore gi migepe mag-gi, noromo ji alufu mia achiel gi piero abich gachiel, mia angʼwen gi piero abich (151,450). Gin ema giniwuogi mar ariyo.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Dhiuru ei dala maduongʼ ir ngʼat moro kendo uwachne ni, ‘Japuonj wacho niya, sana mane ochanna chiegni chopo, omiyo abiro timo nyasi mar Sap Pasaka kod jopuonjrena e odi.’ ”
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo chunyu pek kaka jo-Misri gi Farao notimo? Kane osandogi, donge negiweyo jo-Israel odhi kuma ne onego gidhiye?
english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

kikuyu: Mano e chir ma wan-go kuom Nyasaye nikech Kristo.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ayie nyawo, ayany, chandruok, sand, midhiero nikech Kristo, nimar ka anyap eka atek.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo piero angʼwen pi nomedo pongʼo piny kendo kaka pi ne medore, motingʼo yie kalewore ewi pi.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

kikuyu: Ka aidho e polo, to in kuno; ka aloso kitandana e bur matut, to in kuno.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

kikuyu: To ka jo-Yahudi noneno ogandano, nyiego nomakogi mi gichako wuoyo marach kuom gik mane Paulo wacho.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

kikuyu: Omiyo aywak mana kaka Jazer ywak nikech mzabibu mag Sibma. Yaye Heshbon, yaye Eleale, analuoku gi pi wangʼ. Mor ma un-go nikech olembeu mosechiek kendo nikech keyo maru osetieki.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

kikuyu: “Pwodh lemo mag im mane otimgo misango mar walo Harun kod yawuote ma gin agoko kaka misango mifwayo gi em mane ochiw.
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

kikuyu: Pi nomol molworo kendo mar misango kendo nopongʼo kata mana okuta.
english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka noloso rachungi apargo. Giduto nolenygi machalre e gimoro achiel bende ne gichalre e romgi kod losogi.
english: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

kikuyu: Negimedo wachone niya, “Wasebiro mondo wadag e pinyni matin, nikech kech ger e piny Kanaan maonge kata mana lum ma jamb jotichni dikwae. Kuom mano, koro yie jotichgi odag e gwengʼ Goshen.”
english: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”

kikuyu: Ginibed joga, kendo anabed Nyasachgi.
english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

kikuyu: To mondo wagengʼ wachni kik landre malach e dier ji, nyaka wasiem jogi ni kik gichak giwuo kuom nyingni ne ngʼato angʼata.”
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

kikuyu: Gamaliel wuod Pedazur, ma jatend joka Manase, nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar aboro.
english: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo moko jagam divai kod jated makati mar Farao ruodh Misri nochwanyo ruoth.
english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Bani: Meshulam, Maluk, Adaya, Jashub, Shil gi Jeremoth.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

kikuyu: Analuong ligangla moro manotiek Gog e gode maga duto, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho. Ligangla ma ngʼato ka ngʼato nigo nokedgo mana gi owadgi.
english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord GOD. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

kikuyu: ne aparo wendena mag otieno. Ne aloso gi pacha awuon, kendo chunya nopenjo kama:
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

kikuyu: Gimoro amora modak ei pi to gionge thuokgi kata kalagakla nyaka gibednu gik makwero.
english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

kikuyu: Koa kuom chiwo mar lalruok nyaka timne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo gi mach ma gin: bochene gi sembe duto mogol koa e lumbru gi bor moumo jamb-ich kaachiel gi boche man kuom jamb-ich,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

kikuyu: Yawuowi mane onywolne Shaharaim ei Moab bangʼe kane oseriembo monde, Hushim kod Baara.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Hebron noyier Hashabia kod wedene. Ne gin ji alufu achiel mia abiriyo motegno, mane rito jo-Israel modak yo podho chiengʼ mar Jordan ka girito tije duto mag Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka gitiyone ruoth.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

kikuyu: Giwacho ni gingʼeyo Nyasaye to gikwedo Nyasaye nogo gi timbegi manono. Gin acheje ma wigi tek kendo ok ginyal timo gimoro amora maber.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

kikuyu: “Kane ochopo odhiambo, wuon puoth mzabibu nowachone nyapache ni, ‘Luong jotich mondo ichulgi misachgi, kichako gi joma ne ondiki achien mogik, eka idok ir joma nondiki mokwongo.’
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

kikuyu: Omiyo koro un yawuota, winjauru, kik uwe gima awachonu.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Uchwanyoru odiechiengʼ gotieno to jonabi bende chwanyore mana kaka un. Omiyo abiro tieko minu.
english: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

kikuyu: Joel ne jatendgi ka iluwe gi Shafam, Janai kod Shafat, e piny Bashan.
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rituru yorena. “ ‘Kik uwe jamni mopogore opogore luwre ma nywol nyithindo. “ ‘Kik uriw kodhi e puodho achiel, kendo kik urwak nanga motwangʼ gi usi ariyo mopogore opogore.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

kikuyu: To gisesiko ka gimemore kendo onge gima gingʼeyo. Giwuotho koni gi koni e mudho; kendo gimiyo mise duto mag piny yiengni.
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

kikuyu: “Lew jadolo nyaka puonj rieko kendo ji onego dhi puonjre Chike Nyasaye kuome nikech en jaote mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi yawuote ariyo. Wuowi achiel niluongo ni Gershom nimar Musa nowacho niya, “Asebedo jadak e piny ma ok marwa,”
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

kikuyu: to Ahira wuod Enan notelo ne dhood Naftali.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Nowuoyo kuom kit yien kochako gi yiende Sida mag Lebanon nyaka owino magawore e kor udi. Bende nopuonjo ji kuom le kod winy gi le mamol kod rech.
english: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

kikuyu: Ojwangʼa kaachiel gi joma otho, mana kaka joma onegi monindo e bur, makoro ok ipar kuomgi kendo, joma ongʼad kargi oko e ritni.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo chuny Farao bedo mapek, mi owuogi kolawo jo-Israel. To abiro yudo duongʼ ne an awuon kuom Farao kaachiel gi jolwenje duto, eka jo-Misri nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye.” Eka jo-Israel notimo kamano.
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.

kikuyu: Isegoyo ohingane duto piny kendo isemuko kuondege mochiel motegno mi olokore gunda.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

kikuyu: nikech kane jotelo mariembo geche lweny noneno ni ok en ruodh Israel, negiweyo lawe.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

kikuyu: Kaka en owuon nosande kendo nokadho e bwo tembe, en gi teko mar konyo joma itemo.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi malo kendo ingʼi koni gi koni: mondo ine kaka yawuoti chokore kaduogo iri.” Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon ni nyithindi nochal gi thiwni madhako rwako kata ka law maber ma miaha rwako.
english: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says the LORD, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.

kikuyu: Ka udonjo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye biro miyou kaka ne osingorenu, to neuru ni utimo nyasi mar sawoni.
english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar polo kod piny kane ochwegi. Kane Jehova Nyasaye ochweyo piny kod polo;
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Omiyo nolorogi piny gi tol ka giluwo dirisa, nikech ot mane odakie ne ochwogi e kor ohinga mar dala maduongʼ.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

kikuyu: Mana kaka soko motimo chwodho kata aora moduwore chalo e kaka ngʼat makare machiwo thuolo ne jaricho.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

kikuyu: E kinde mane wawuok Kadesh Barnea nyaka wangʼado Holo mar Zered nokawowa higni piero adek gaboro. E kindeno tiengʼ mar jolweny duto notho e kambi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne osesingorenegi.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

kikuyu: Wachni nomiyo jogo oluoro Jehova Nyasaye ahinya, mine gichiwo misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne gisingorene.
english: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows.

kikuyu: Arungu oneno mana ka lum moro matin nono; kendo kobaye gi tongʼ to onge gima bwoge.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

kikuyu: Notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kowuotho e yor wuon mare kod richone mane omiyo Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Ne apuonjora kuom chikeni chon gi lala, ni ne igurogi mondo gisiki nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

kikuyu: Jogo duto notho ka nigi yie. Ne ok giyudo gik mane Nyasaye osingore ni nomigi, to ne ginenogi kendo ne girwakogi mana gichien, ka gikwanore mana kaka welo gi jowuoth makadho akadha e pinyni.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

kikuyu: To magi gin mana dir tijene ma oko kende; kendo gin mana gik manok kende mikuodho kuome! Koro en ngʼa mongʼeyo gima Nyasaye nyalo timo gi tekone?”
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

kikuyu: Rituru ruoth ka ulwore ka ngʼato ka ngʼato otingʼo gige lweny e lwete. Ngʼato angʼata mosudo machiegni kodu nyaka negi. Beduru machiegni gi ruoth kamoro amora modhiye.”
english: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

kikuyu: Apaka nodirogi malo e kor yamo, kendo nonyumogi kuonde matut mogik; mi chir mane gin-go noleny nono kane ginie masira ma kamano.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

kikuyu: Eka abiro oro rawera kawachone ni, ‘Dhi idwar aserni.’ To kawachone ni, ‘Ne, aserni ni e bathi koni; kelgi ka, eka ibi, nikech akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni onge gima biro hinyi kendo onge gima rach.’
english: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as the LORD lives.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth Herode owinjo wechegi, nowacho niya, “Johana ngʼat mane asengʼado wiye osechier oa kuom joma otho!”
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: “Kik ungʼad ne ji bura, ka ok kamano to un bende ibiro ngʼadnu bura.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

kikuyu: Iwacho niya, “An ema ayiero ndalo mowinjore, kendo an ema angʼado bura kare.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

kikuyu: Asemanyo wangʼi gi chunya duto; ngʼwon-na kaluwore gi singruok mari.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

kikuyu: Mwandu gi duongʼ aa kuomi; kendo in e jarit gik moko duto. E lweti nitiere teko gi nyalo mondo omi itingʼ ji malo kendo imigi teko.
english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

kikuyu: Wiya ok bi wil gi bucheni, nimar gin ema iseritogo ngimana.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

kikuyu: Nikech aseketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ayie tingʼo mirimbe, nyaka chop oket kwayona kare, mi oyud ni aonge ketho. Obiro kela e ler mi ane adierane.
english: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

kikuyu: Ne giwuok gi jolweny mangʼeny ka kuoyo manie dho nam ka gin-gi farese kod geche lweny mangʼeny.
english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

kikuyu: Wach mane giorone ne chalo kama: Ne Ruoth Darius: Wamosi ahinya.
english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written: To Darius the king, all peace.

kikuyu: Jopuonj Chik mane obiro kanyo koa Jerusalem to nowacho kuom Yesu niya, “Opongʼ gi teko mar Belzebub! Ogolo jochiende gi teko mar ruodh jochiende.”
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nokum teko duto manie polo malo, kaachiel gi ruodhi duto manie piny.
english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kuom Edom: “Bende pod nitie rieko ei Teman? To puonj oselalne jorieko? To rieko mag-gi osetop?
english: Of Edom, the LORD of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

kikuyu: ‘Ayub osewuoyo maonge rieko; osewacho weche ma ok oparo maber.’
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseriembo kendo otieko ogendini ma omiyou pinygi ma udakie,
english: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

kikuyu: Reuben nodwokogi niya, “Donge ne akwerou ni kik utimne rawerano marach? To ne ok unyal winja! Koro nyaka chulnwa kuor nikech rembe.”
english: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseriembogi oko e wangʼu ka uneno, to kik uwach e chunyu niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osekelowa ka mondo wakaw pinyni nikech timwa makare.” Ooyo en mana nikech timbe maricho mag ogendinigo emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye dhi riembogi ka uneno.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni ji mangʼeny biro biro koa yo wuok chiengʼ gi yo podho chiengʼ kendo ginikaw keregi kaachiel gi Ibrahim, Isaka gi Jakobo e nyasi mar chiemo manobed e pinyruodh polo.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

kikuyu: “To un bende jo-Juda kinde ma ingʼadonue bura osechopo. “Abiro gwedho ogandana e kinde manaduogie ka gia e twech,
english: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.

kikuyu: Nochiwogi e lwet ogendini, mine gibet e bwo loch joma ne mon kodgi.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi dwaro ni nyaka timnegi honni, to jo-Yunani to manyo rieko,
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

kikuyu: Uchiegni ngʼado Jordan mondo ukaw piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou. Ka usekawe ma udakie,
english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

kikuyu: to ji duto noyud wichkuot kuom jogo ma ok nyal konyogi, jogo ma ok nyal konyogi kata kelonegi ber to mana wichkuot kod achaya.”
english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

kikuyu: To kaka Yesu nongʼeyo ni negichano biro make mondo gikete ruoth githuon, noa kanyo kendo nodhi ewi got moro kar kende.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

kikuyu: to chwore mokwongo mane oriembe cha kik kende kendo nikech osedoko mogak. Tim ma kamano en kwero e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye. Kik umi richo bedi e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni.
