english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

kikuyu: Samuel nowacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ipenja wach ka Jehova Nyasaye oseweyi mobedo jasiki?
english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since the LORD has departed from you and has become your adversary?

kikuyu: Ji kwongʼo ngʼat mapando cham, to gweth bedo ni ngʼatno moyie golo chambe mondo ji ongʼiew kuome.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

kikuyu: Mirima mager omaka nikech joma timbegi richo, mosejwangʼo chikeni.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai moko nobiro moteme kapenje niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo ngʼato oketh keny gi chiege?”
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

kikuyu: “Ndik ne Malaika morito kanisa man Filadelfia kama: Magi e weche mag Jal maler kendo ma ja-adiera, motingʼo kifungu mar Daudi. Gima oyawo to onge ngʼama nyalo loro; kendo gima oloro to onge ngʼama nyalo yawo.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

kikuyu: Gibiro luongo ji e gode kendo kanyo ema negi timie misengini makare; ginitim nyasi gi mwandu mabeyo miyudo e dho nam kod gik mabeyo mopondo e kwoyo.”
english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

kikuyu: Magi e nying chwo mane Musa ooro mondo onon piny Kanaan. (Musa nomiyo Hoshea wuod Nun nying ni Joshua.)
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

kikuyu: Ibiro luongo, kendo abiro dwoki; ibiro gombo neno chwech ma lweti osechweyo.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

kikuyu: un muluongoru ni weg dala maduongʼ maler kendo moketo genogi kuom Nyasach Israel, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, e nyinge:
english: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: To Yesu ne ok ochiwore e lwetgi, nimar nongʼeyo pach ji duto.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

kikuyu: Elija nodwoke niya, “Miya wuodi.” Nokawe koa e lwete motingʼe nyaka ei ot mamalo mane odakie mopiele e kitandane.
english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

kikuyu: “Tekel: Osepimi e ratil moyudi ni irem.
english: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka unune malit un jo-Korazin! Mano kaka unune malit, un jo-Bethsaida! Nimar ka dine honni motimnugi dinetim ne Turo gi Sidon to dine giseweyo richo chon ka girwakore gi lep gugru kendo ka gibukore gi buru.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Ka nyathi punda inyalo nywol ka muol, to kara ngʼama ofuwo bende nyalo bedo mariek.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

kikuyu: Bende ne atengʼo nangana mi awacho niya, “Kamano bende e kaka Nyasaye onego omaa od ngʼato angʼata motamore rito singruokni mwandune. Omiyo mad ngʼama chalo kamano tengʼe oko mi odongʼ gi lwete nono!” Kuom mano, kanyakla mar oganda nodwoko niya, “Amin,” kendo negipako Jehova Nyasaye. Kendo ji notimo mana kaka ne gisesingono.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. The people did according to this promise.

kikuyu: omiyo ne giwangʼo i Jehova Nyasaye gi timbegi marichogo, mi masira nomakogi.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

kikuyu: mane udakie ka uluwo timbe piny, kod timbe ruodh pinyni man-gi loch e kor polo, ma bende tekone tiyo e chuny joma ok winj wach Nyasaye.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Jal ma ok tho kendo modak e ler ma dhano ok nyal ngʼiyo tir; kendo Jal maonge ngʼama oseneno kata manyalo neno. Duongʼ gi loch duto odogne nyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

kikuyu: To Paulo nodwoko niya, “Owetena, ne ok angʼeyo ni en jadolo maduongʼ, nikech ondiki ni, ‘Kik iwuo marach kuom jatend jou.’”
english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noluongo jodongo duto mag Juda kod Jerusalem kaachiel.
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Rogo man e puodho man Makpela, machiegni gi Mamre e piny Kanaan, ema ne Ibrahim ongʼiewo kaka kar yiko kaachiel gi puodhono duto koa kuom Efron ja-Hiti.
english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

kikuyu: Kane oneno wasigu kalor biro machiegni kode, Elisha nolamo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Lok jogi muofu.” Omiyo noloko jogi muofni mana kaka Elisha nosekwayo.
english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

kikuyu: Nodwoko kama, “Ka gibiro gi kwe, makgiuru ka gingima; to ka gibiro ni lweny, to bende makgiuru ka gingima.”
english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

kikuyu: Dibed ni gima ber ema nomiyo atho koso? Ok kamano kata matin! Richo notiyo gi gima ber, mi onega, mondo richo ongʼere malongʼo ni en angʼo. Kamano chik nyiso ni richo en gima rach moloyo.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

kikuyu: Ber mondo idhi e od kuyo moloyo ot mitimoe nyasi, nimar tho e giko ngʼato ka ngʼato; joma pod ngima nyaka ngʼe ma e chunygi.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

kikuyu: Mad joma mor kuom loch ma imiya okog gi ilo kod mor; mad gisiki kagiwacho kinde duto niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo otingʼ malo nikech omiyo jatichne locho.”
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

kikuyu: Noketogi e lwet jotichne ka moro ka moro otelone kweth ka kweth kendo nowachonegi niya, “Teluru nyima kuweyo thuolo e kind kweth ka kweth.”
english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nopiago pelni mabith mi otero jo-Israel nyangu kama iluongo ni Gibeath Haraloth.
english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

kikuyu: Kane kinde keyo koro chiegni, nooro jotichne ir jorit puothego mondo oomne olembe mowuok e puothe.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

kikuyu: Ma e singruok ma anatim gi dhood jo-Israel bangʼ ndalogo, Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Abiro keto chikena e pachgi kendo ndikogi e chunygi. Anabed Nyasachgi, kendo ginibed joga.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

kikuyu: Neye kaka joma timo gik maricho oriere piny kopodho osedirgi piny ma ok ginyal aa malo!
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

kikuyu: Un uwegi un joneno, kaachiel gi Nyasaye bende, kaka ne wadak e dieru ka ngimawa ler kendo nikare, kendo ka waonge ketho e kindu un joma oyie.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

kikuyu: Ahab wuod Omri notimo timbe mamono mangʼeny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye moloyo joma notelo ne.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nowuok, to odiechiengʼ mar adek negichopo e miechgi madongo kaka: Gibeon, Kefira, Beeroth, kod Kiriath Jearim.
english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: chi owadgino nodhi ire e nyim jodongo mi olony wuochene achiel e tiende kendo ongʼudh olawo e wangʼe kowachone niya, “Ma e gima itimo ne ngʼat modagi rito dala owadgi mondo ochungi.”
english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi nyalo mag-gi negichiwone kar keno kuom tijni drachmas alufu piero auchiel gachiel (61,000) mar dhahabu (marom gi kilo mia abich mar dhahabu), minas alufu abich (5,000) mar fedha (marom gi kilo alufu adek mar fedha) kod lep dolo mia achiel.
english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

kikuyu: Fedha magu oselokore chuoth nyinyo bende divai magu mogen oseruw gi pi.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

kikuyu: Kata mana ondiegi chiwo thundegi mondo nyithindgi odhodhi, to joga osebedo jogo maonge chuny, gichalo udo manie thim.
english: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato ne wawuok oko mar dalano mi wachopo e dho aora, kuma ne waparo ni diwayudie kar lemo. Ne wabet piny kanyo mi wawuoyo gi mon moko mane oyudo osechokore kanyo.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

kikuyu: Magi e nying nyithindo mane onywolo ka en Jerusalem: Shamua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma ok jadolo okendo nyar jadolo, nyakoni ok oyiene mondo ocham mich moyiedhi mogol kuom chiwo maler.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo achikou mondo uket tenge mier adekgo ne un uwegi.
english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

kikuyu: Nyakwar Harun moro amora man-gi songa kik sud machiegni mar timo ne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo. Nikech en gi songa ok onego osud machiegni mondo ochiw chiemo ne Nyasache.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodok moywak e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka odhiambo, kendo negimanyo wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye. Negiwacho niya, “Bende wanyalo dhi kendo mondo waked gi jo-Benjamin, owetewa?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Dhi uked kodgi.”
english: The children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening; and they asked of the LORD, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” The LORD said, “Go up against him.”

kikuyu: Ne otingʼo kitabu matin moel e lwete. Nonyono nam gi tiende ma korachwich, to tiende ma koracham nonyonogo piny,
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

kikuyu: Lida ne chiegni gi Jopa, omiyo ka jopuonjre nowinjo ni Petro ni kuno, ne giorone ji ariyo, ka gikwaye niya, “Yie ibi irwa piyo ma ok odeko!”
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

kikuyu: Ininwangʼ wichkuot, yaye Sidon, yaye in, ma in ohinga mar nam, nimar nam osewuoyo niya, “Ok asewinjo rem mar muoch bende pok anywol, ok asepidho yawuowi kata nyiri pok abedogo.”
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

kikuyu: Kinde duto beduru joma muol chutho, modimbore, kendo ma hore mos ka ukawo tingʼ joweteu kuom hera.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

kikuyu: nikech ka uchiemo to ngʼato ka ngʼato rikni gichamo chiembe owuon, ma ok orito jowetene; omiyo jomoko kuomu denyo, to jomoko kuomu to mer.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

kikuyu: “Jael ma chi Heber ja-Keni en dhako mogwedhi kuom mon duto, kendo ogwedhe moloyo mon duto modak e hema.
english: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Filistia owinjo ni Daudi osewir bedo ruodh jo-Israel, negiwuok kar rombgi mondo gidware, to ka Daudi nowinjo wachno omiyo nowuok mondo orom kodgi.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

kikuyu: An to an ohinga, kendo thundena ochungʼ, ka ohinga moger motingʼore gi malo. Kuom mano, asebedone wangʼ monenogo, kendo asemiyo obedo gi kwe.
english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

kikuyu: Noidho kerubi eka ofuyo; ne ofuyo matek komoko e bwomb yamo.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nochoko pesa kuom joma ne omedore e kwan mane jo-Lawi oreso.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

kikuyu: Nimar joma wuondore ni gin Kristo to ok gin kod joma wuondore ni gin jonabi to ok gin nothinyre mi tim ranyisi kod honni mondo giwuondgo koda ka joma oyier, ka dipo mano ditimre.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: to ngʼat ma ochungʼ motegno nyaka giko ema noresi.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Ka Jehova Nyasaye ok konyi, ere kama dayudnie konyruok.” Dobed kar dino cham, koso kar biyo divai?
english: He said, “If the LORD doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

kikuyu: kod Maseya wuod Baruk, ma wuod Kol-Hoze, ma wuod Hazaya, ma wuod Adaya, ma wuod Joyiarib, ma wuod Zekaria, ma nyakwar Shela.
english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Itai niya, “Wuoth wadhi.” Omiyo Itai ja-Giti nowuotho gi joge duto gi joutegi mane ni kode.
english: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

kikuyu: Ne gipogore e kindgi giwegi mi gichako wuok ka Paulo nowachonegi weche mogik niya, “Roho Maler nowacho adier ni kwereu, kane owuoyo gi dho Isaya janabi, kowacho kama:
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

kikuyu: Winjo wach en soko mar ngima ne jogo man kode, to fuwo kelo kum ne joma ofuwo.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

kikuyu: Donge jachwe agulu nigi ratiro mar tiyo gi lop chwecho kaka ohero; kochweyo kode agulni moko ni tich mogen, to moko ni tich aticha mapile?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi mathoth noyie, kaachiel gi mon mathoth ma jo-Yunani mongʼere, kod jo-Yunani mangʼeny machwo.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

kikuyu: Koso en ber mane ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare to ngimane to olalne? Koso en angʼo ma ngʼato dichiw mondo owil gi ngimane?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: to yawuot Eliab ne gin Nemuel, Dathan kod Abiram. Dathan-no kod Abiram ne jotend oganda, to kata kamano negikwedo Musa kod Harun kendo gijiwo joma ne luwo Kora kuom kwedo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

kikuyu: “To ka giko koro chiegni, ruodh Milambo notug kode lweny, kendo ruodh Nyandwat bende nowuogne gi geche mathoth mag lweny, gi farese kod yiedhi moriedo. Enomonj pinje mathoth kendo enoywegi ka ohula.
english: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

kikuyu: Achalo ngʼama ite odino, ma ok nyal winjo wach, mana ka momo ma ok nyal yawo dhoge;
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikend nyamin chiegi mondo obed nyieke ma iriwri kode ka nyamin pod ngima.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

kikuyu: Jarito yawone dhorangach kendo rombe winjo dwonde. Oluongo rombene owuon gi nying-gi kendo otelonegi kagiwuok oko moro ka moro.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

kikuyu: Joma dwaro kawo ngimana ochiko obadhogi, joma dwaro hinya chano kaka ginyalo tieka chuth. Gichano miriambo odiechiengʼ duto.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata kuomu manocham bor chiayo ma lembe moko osetimgo misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka ngʼad kare kuom ogandane.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Haman nomako chunye mi nodhi dala. Noluongo osiepene kamoro achiel gi Zeresh ma jaode.
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼe ne ungʼado aora Jordan mi ubiro Jeriko. Joma odak Jeriko, kaka jo-Amor, jo-Perizi, jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Girgash, jo-Hivi, gi jo-Jebus nokedo kodu, to ne achiwogi duto e lwetu.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

kikuyu: Los ratege molworore angʼwen mag dhahabu ne mesano kendo twegi e konde angʼwen mag mesa kama tiende angʼwen-go nitie.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

kikuyu: Andikoni in Timotheo nyathina mahero: Ngʼwono gi kech kod kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa obed kodi.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo kitandane nyaka luok lepe, kendo olwokre, kendo en bende nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Kane ji koro oseriyo kech kuom ndalo mangʼeny, Paulo nochungʼ malo e nyimgi mowachonegi niya, “Jowadwa ka dine uwinj wachna ma wawe kwangʼ ka waa Krete, to dine utony mi ok uneno chandruok gi lal maduongʼ ma kama.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye chunye nodoko malit kuom keto dhano e piny kendo chunye nopongʼ gi lit.
english: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

kikuyu: Dwoguru ire, yaye un jo-Israel mosengʼanyo mabor kode.
english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro hoyo chuny Sayun adier; kendo obiro bedo gi kech kuom kuondene mokethore; enolok kuondene motimo ongoro chal ka Eden, kendo kuondene modongʼ gunda chal ka puoth Jehova Nyasaye. Mor gi ilo kaachiel gi erokamano gi wer mamit noyud kuome.
english: For the LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: Bende rombega nyalo chamo lum ma usenyono kendo modho pi ma useduwo gi tiendu?
english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

kikuyu: An to ananyieru bangʼe ka un e chandruok; Anajaru ajara ka masira oloyou,
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

kikuyu: Oganda jo-Juda gi jo-Israel ne ngʼeny machalo ka kuoyo manie e dho nam; negichiemo, mi negimetho kendo negimor.
english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

kikuyu: Kamano Nyasaye nochweyo gik madongo mag nam kod gik mangima duto kod gik malak mag pi, kaka kitgi obet kod winy duto man-gi bwombegi kaka kitgi obet. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom adek tuo mosieko biro nego, to ka ok kamano to kech biro negogi e dieru; achiel kuom adek mamoko ligangla biro nego ka gin oko mar ohinga maru; kendo achiel kuom adek abiro kiro ne yembe kendo abiro lawo gi ligangla mowuodhi e olalo mare.
english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

kikuyu: To jatend lweny noweyo jopinyno moko mane odhier ahinya mondo oti e puothe mag mzabibu kod puothe mamoko.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ritreuru un uwegi; asenyisou gik moko duto motelo kapok kindego ochopo.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, abiro luongi nyaka karangʼo mondo ikonya to ok iwinji? Koso nyaka karangʼo maywakni kawacho, “Timbe maricho omedore!” To kata kamano ok ires ji?
english: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Efraim noweye mana ka winyo ma huyo mi lal nono, omiyo ok ginichak ginywol nyithindo, mondegi ok nobed ma yach kendo onge nyathi manomak ichne.
english: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.

kikuyu: Ok awach kamano nikech ayie gi nend dhano, to awacho kamano mondo uyud warruok.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

kikuyu: Ruodhi duto mag ogendini onindo komi luor, ka moro ka moro ni e liende owuon.
english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

kikuyu: Alokora gima ijaro ne joma donjona; ka ginena to gitwenyona umgi ka gigoyona siboi.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

kikuyu: To mana kaka nyocha anyisou, usenena to pod udagi yie kuoma.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

kikuyu: Jayalo wacho niya, “Ma e gima asefwenyo kane adwaro tiend wechegi achiel kachiel,
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

kikuyu: Kuom riekone kod ngʼeyone, oseelonwa dwarone mopondo, mana kaka nochano chon ni notimrenwa kuom Kristo,
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

kikuyu: Nikech jo-Midian ne keto ji gi tich matek mar achuna, jo-Israel nogero kuonde pondo e tiend got, rogo kod kuonde moko ma ginyalo dakie.
english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

kikuyu: Jo-Asuria bende ni iterorigo, nikech gombo mari nokalo konyo, kendo kata gin bende ne ok giromi.
english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

kikuyu: “Ka en kamano, to kara koro ere tiende hoya gi wecheu manonogo? Onge adiera kata achiel modongʼ kuom dwokougo, makmana miriambo lilo!”
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

kikuyu: Kane Paulo odonjo, jo-Yahudi mane oyudo obiro koa Jerusalem nochungʼ olwore, ka gidonjone gi weche maricho ahinya, to ne ok ginyal nyiso ni wechego gin adier.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

kikuyu: Damaski kanyo ne nitie japuonjre moro miluongo ni Anania. Ruoth nowuoyo kode e fweny, kaluonge niya, “Anania!” Nodwoko niya, “Antie, Ruoth.”
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

kikuyu: Jonathan nokwongʼore gi Daudi nikech ne ohere mana kaka oherore owuon.
english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi negichungʼ mine gilemo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye eka negidok dalagi Rama. Elkana nobedo e achiel gi chiege ma Hana eka Jehova Nyasaye nopare.
english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

kikuyu: “Chwog wend ywak moro mondo iywag-go yawuot ruodhi mag Israel,
english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

kikuyu: Bangʼe joge ne oparo ndalo machon, ndalo mag Musa kod ogandane mi gipenjore niya, “Ere Jal mane otelonegi ka jakwadh rombe ka gikalo nam makwar? Ere Jal mane oketo Roho Maler mare kuomgi?
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ne wanyalo thiedho Babulon, to ok onyal chango; waweyeuru, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato odhi e pinye owuon, nimar osengʼadne bura mochopo e polo, ogingore mochopo e polo.’
english: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

kikuyu: kendo nowitgi ei mach makakni, kama ywagruok gi mwodo lak nobedie.”
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Bende nyiseche mag ogendini mane kwerena oketho pinygi kaka nyiseche mag Gozan, Haran, Rezef kod jo-Eden man Tel Assar nokonyogi?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

kikuyu: Gilama kayiem nono, to gik ma gipuonjo gin mana chike mag dhano.’
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jal Man Malo Moloyo ma en Jal modak nyaka chiengʼ, ma nyinge ler wacho, “Adak kama ler man malo, kaachiel gi ngʼat mofwenyo richone kendo man-gi chuny mobolore, mondo aduog chuny ngʼat moboloreno kendo ajiw chuny ngʼat mofwenyo richone.
english: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano bucha wacho ni ok owinjore waket chik matek ni joma ok jo-Yahudi makoro olokore oyie kuom Nyasaye.
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

kikuyu: Koro Jehova Nyasaye notimo ngʼwono ne Sara kaka nosewacho kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochopo kare singruok mane osenyiso Sara.
english: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.

kikuyu: Lwandano nolokre chula ma jolupo moye tondegi nikech an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto asewacho kamano. In Turo, ogendini noyaki,
english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Mar Solomon. Ka Jehova Nyasaye ok ema ger ot, to joma gere nyagore gi tich matek kayiem nono. Ka Jehova Nyasaye ok ema orito dala, to jorito ochungʼ karito kayiem.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

kikuyu: Eka Joshua nogero kendo mar misango e got Ebal ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel,
english: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

kikuyu: “To en chodene noyombore. Kane oneno pichni mag joma chwo mogur e kor ot, ma gin pichni mag jo-Kaldea mogor makwar,
english: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoke niya, “Ok en mahu mar loch kata ywak mar joma olo e lweny; to en mana koko mar wer ema awinjo.”
english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

kikuyu: Kendo gino nodoko richo; nimar ji nodhi kata mana nyaka Dan mondo gilam gimane ni kuno.
english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

kikuyu: Yawuot owadgi ma Eshek ne gin: Ulam wuode makayo, Jeush wuode mar ariyo to gi Elifelet mar adek.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kikuyu: Muma wacho niya, “Ne ayie emomiyo ne awuoyo.” Gi chuny mar yie machalre, wan bende wayie kendo wawuoyo,
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

kikuyu: Obiro loko ringrewa matho mondo obed gi duongʼ machal gi ringre, kotiyo gi teko maduongʼ mamiyo oketo gik moko duto e bwo lochne.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

kikuyu: Ruodh Debir, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Geder, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

kikuyu: Magi e yawuot Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Lawi, Juda, Isakar, Zebulun,
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi duto niya, “Ka ngʼato dwaro luwo bangʼa, to nyaka okwedre owuon kendo otingʼ msalape ndalo duto eka oluwa.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Koro Elija ja-Tishbi moa Tishbe e piny Gilead nonyiso Ahab niya, “Mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye mangima, ma Nyasach Israel matiyone nitie, tho kata koth ok nobedi kuom higni manok nyaka chop achak awach kendo.”
english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

kikuyu: Koro, chiengʼ chier dhakoni nobed chi ngʼa, nimar ji abiriyogo nokende?”
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Ka Lamek ne ja-higni mia achiel gi piero aboro gariyo, nonywolo wuowi moro.
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, jatelo maduongʼ nomiyogi chik mondo kik gicham chiemo moro amora mopwodhi manyaka jadolo bedie ma puonjogi gi Urim kod Thumim.
english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

kikuyu: kendo ka asepiago liganglana mamil, to anakum jogo mochaya, kendo ka asechako ngʼado bura to anachul kuor ne wasika.
english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo mano, to ne dhogi omoko. Omiyo ne giweye mi gia gidhi.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

kikuyu: To kuom weche moko mane otimore e ndalo loch Jehoram, kod gik moko duto mane otimo, ondiki e kitepe motingʼo weche mag ndalo mag ruodhi Juda.
english: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Kuom mano, beduru gi chir, jowadwa, nikech ayie ni Nyasaye biro timo mana kaka nonyisa.
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

kikuyu: Mana ka ondanyo motwi e dier kuthe e kaka jaherana chalo e dier nyiri.
english: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

kikuyu: nyikwa Shefatia, ji mia adek gi piero abiriyo gariyo (372),
english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jal mochayo chik nofwenyre, to Ruoth Yesu nobi gi duongʼne duto miwuoro, nonege gi muya moa e dhoge kendo notiek tekone duto.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

kikuyu: Ne agora piny kendo ne awinjo dwol moro kawachona ni, ‘Saulo! Saulo! Isanda nangʼo?’
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

kikuyu: Olawogi matek nyaka e yore mane pok owuothoe kendo okadho yorego maber mak ohinyre.
english: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

kikuyu: Giret piyo mondo gidengnwa, nyaka wengewa pongʼ gi pi wangʼ ma oo kendo pi wangʼwa mol ma luokwa.
english: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ndalo biro, kendo koro osechopo, ma joma otho biro winjo dwond Wuod Nyasaye, kendo joma owinjo dwolno biro doko mangima.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

kikuyu: mondo omi un kaachiel gi jomaler duto ungʼe hera mar Kristo, ma lachne, gi borne, kod borne modhi malo kod tutne odhiero dhano ngʼeyo.
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

kikuyu: nikech gik mangima duto ngimagi ni e rembgi. Mano emomiyo asewacho ne jo-Israel niya, “Kik ucham remb gimoro amora, nikech gima ochwe ngimane ni e rembe, kendo ngʼato angʼata mochame nongʼad kare oko.”
english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

kikuyu: Un e nyithind Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Kik usar dendu kata uliel yie wiu, kuywago ngʼama otho, kata lielo pat wangʼu,
english: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moyie kuome ok nobed gi bura. To ngʼat ma ok oyie kuome bura oseloyo, nikech pok oyie kuom nying Wuowi ma miderma mar Nyasaye.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

kikuyu: Jo-Gibeon nodwoke niya, “Waonge ratiro mar dwaro fedha kata dhahabu kuom joka Saulo, to bende waonge gi teko mar nego jo-Israel.” Eka Daudi nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mudwaro mondo atimnu?”
english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Jabesh Gilead nowinjo gima jo-Filistia osetimo ni Saulo,
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: To Kristo en ja-adiera kaka jatend od Wuon mare. To wan e jood Nyasaye, ka wamako matek chir kod geno ma wan-go.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

kikuyu: Mishma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

kikuyu: Nowachone joge niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok oyie mondo atim gima kamano ni ruodha, ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir, kata tingʼo lweta mondo ahinye; nikech en ngʼat mowir ma Jehova Nyasaye oyiero.”
english: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”

kikuyu: Wuololo, minwa, angʼo momiyo ne inywola, an ngʼat ma piny ngima piemgo kendo kedogo! Pok aholo ngʼato kata an bende pok ohola, to kata kamano ji duto kwongʼa.
english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.

kikuyu: Dhiyo sani kendo indiknegi wach e kidi mopa, Ndike e kitabu, mondo omi obed janeno, manyaka chiengʼ e ndalo mabiro.
english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

kikuyu: Miluma ma jatich nigo miyo otiyo matek, kendo kech makaye miyo omedo tiyo matek.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

kikuyu: gin ji mane achweyo ne an awuon, mondo omi gipaka.
english: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.

kikuyu: Nikech weche mokor manie Muma ne ok owuok e pach dhano, to Nyasaye ema nomiyo ji owuoyo, ka gin e bwo teko mar Roho Maler.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: To Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Minwa gi owetena to gin ngʼa gini?”
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

kikuyu: Jower ma nyikwa Asaf ne nitiere keregi kaluwore gi chik mar Daudi gi mar Asaf gi mar Heman kod mar Jeduthun janen mar ruoth. Jorit dhorangeye ne ok owuok kuondegi mag rito nikech owetegi ma jo-Lawi nosetedonigi.
english: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

kikuyu: Zekaria nopenjo malaika niya, “Ere kaka anyalo ngʼeyo ni wachni en adier? An ngʼat moti kendo chiega bende hike oniangʼ.”
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

kikuyu: Bolreuru e nyim Ruoth Nyasaye eka obiro otingʼou malo.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

kikuyu: Nikech abiro nego joma kare kod joma timbegi richo, ligangla biro wuodhore e olalo mare mitiek ngʼato angʼata, chakre yo milambo nyaka yo nyandwat.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato jamoko to oneno owadgi kochando to ok okeche, ere kaka ngʼama kamano nyalo wacho ni en gihera mar Nyasaye?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Japuonj, Musa nondikonwa ni ka ngʼato owadgi otho moweyo dhako ma pod onge gi nyithindo, to ngʼatno nyaka kend dhako ma chwore othono mondo onywolnego nyithindo.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Ne oriembo jodolo mag nyiseche manono mane ruodhi mag Juda oketo mondo owangʼ ubani kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag miech Juda kod mago molworo Jerusalem kendo noriemb joma ne wangʼo ubani ne Baal, gi chiengʼ, dwe kod sulwe.
english: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata motimo misango ni nyasaye moro makmana Jehova Nyasaye nyaka negi.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosewinjo wach machal kamano? En ngʼa moseneno gik machalo kamano? Bende piny dichwe godiechiengʼ achiel koso ogendini dichok dichiel? To mana e seche mane muoch ochako kayo Sayun ema nonywoloe nyithinde.
english: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.

kikuyu: “Kawuononi ubiro kalo e gwenge mag Moab manie piny Ar.
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

kikuyu: Chunya opongʼ kod siso mar chikeni kinde duto.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nomiyogi chik niya, “E giko mar higa mar abiriyo ka mar abiriyo, ma en higa mar weyo gope, ma bende en kinde mar Sawo mar kiche,
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

kikuyu: Wengena koro ok nen maber nikech kuyo ma an-go; denda duto olokore choke lilo.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: Ne aketo winjruok gi kwereu mane agologi gia Misri, e piny mar bedo misumba. Ne awacho ni,
english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying:

kikuyu: Omiyo Elisha noweye modok. Nokawo rwethe mag pur moyangʼogi. Nowangʼo gik mane opurogo mondo ochwakgo ringʼo mi nomiyo ji kendo gichamo. Eka nochako wuoth moluwo bangʼ Elija kendo nobedo jakonyne.
english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

kikuyu: To chunywa koro odwogo nikech uchungʼ motegno kuom Ruoth.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kenan notho ka en ja-higni mia ochiko gapar.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

kikuyu: Josef nowacho ne wuon mare niya, “Gin yawuowi ma Nyasaye osemiya ka.” Eka Israel nowacho niya, “Kelgi ira ka mondo agwedhgi.”
english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

kikuyu: Nyaka okelne jadolo im man-gi nengo kendo maonge songa kaka misango mipwodhogo ketho. Kamano jadolo nopwodhe kuom ketho mosetimo kokia kendo nowene.
english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Musa donge nomiyou chik? Kata kamano, onge kata achiel kuomu ma orito chik. Ka en kamano, to angʼo momiyo udwaro nega?”
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

kikuyu: Koko mag mor gi mag loch winjore ei hembe mag joma kare kama: “Lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma korachwich osetimo gik madongo!
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

kikuyu: Koro adwaro timo singruok gi Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel mondo mi mirimbe mager owuog kuomwa.
english: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

kikuyu: Adiera biro aa piny kochomo malo, kendo tim makare biro ngʼiyo piny gie polo.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

kikuyu: Nodak e ngima maber ka en-gi mwandu kod duongʼ, bangʼe notho ka hike noniangʼ moloyo. Wuode ma Solomon nobedo ruoth kare.
english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “Awachonu osiepena, kik uluor jogo manego ringruok to bangʼe onge gima ginyalo medo timo.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

kikuyu: Romwa gokinyi gi herani ma ok rem, mondo wawer gi ilo kendo wabed mamor ndalowa duto.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

kikuyu: Giko mar dhano gi le en ni gimoro achiel ochomogi duto machalre. Kaka achiel tho e kaka machielo bende. Giduto giyweyo machalre; dhano ok winj maber maloyo le. Gik moko duto onge tiendgi.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

kikuyu: Sayun nopwodh gi bura makare bende joma oyie modak e iye norit kod adiera.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

kikuyu: Jochiendego nosayo Yesu kawacho niya, “Orwa ir anguro ka mondo wadhi wadonj eigi.”
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Suduru machiegni uchiem.” Onge japuonjre kata achiel mane ohedhore penje niya, “In ngʼa?” Negingʼeyo ni en Ruoth.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

kikuyu: Negilando chiengʼ tweyo chiemo kendo negiketo Naboth obet piny e nyim ji kama oyiedhi.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nodhi nyime gi wuoth kendo nochopo e piny ogendini man yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

kikuyu: Kane Petro odonjo e ot, Kornelio noromone mi opodho e tiende kamiye duongʼ.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero pesa ok bed gi pesa morome; kendo ngʼat mohero mwandu, mwandu moyudo ok rome. Ma bende onge tiende.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Joshua noloyo jolwenj jo-Amalek mana gi ligangla.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Giduto ginibi kendo ginidagi kuonde holo kod buche mag lwendni kendo e bungu mag kuthe kod sokni duto.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

kikuyu: “Ka jogi Israel olo e lweny gi jowasikgi nikech gisekethoni to bangʼe gilokore mi gipako nyingi, ka gilamo kendo gikwayo e hekaluni,
english: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

kikuyu: Ok andiknu wechegi mondo akuodgo wiu, to andikonugi mondo ajiwu, kaka nyithinda mageno.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi koro oseti kendo hike ne ngʼeny, ne oketo wuode Solomon obedo ruodh Israel.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

kikuyu: “Kata kawuono pod aywagora ka an gi chuny malit; nikech kum mapek ma Nyasaye oketo kuoma miya achur ka an gi rem malich.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

kikuyu: Eka malaika machielo nowuok oa e hekalu kaluongo jal mobedo e bor polono gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Kaw pandi mar keyo mondo ike, nikech sa mar keyo osechopo, nimar cham manie piny, osechiek.”
english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

kikuyu: Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye chakore godhiambo tarik apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ ma chandruok omaka to abiro luongi mondo ikonya, nimar ibiro dwoka.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

kikuyu: Duog ira mondo ikecha; med jatichni tekoni, kendo res jatichni mogeni.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

kikuyu: Nyasaye kochungʼ malo to joma roteke luoro mako; gitony kata kapok omulogi.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

kikuyu: Ka ber ne ruoth to mondo ogol chik mondo otiekgi, an to abiro golo fedha maromo kilo alufu mia angʼwen mondo okete kar keno mar joka ruoth mondo ochul joma biro tiyo tijno.”
english: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi chi wuode to giduto nyaka neg-gi. Gima gitimono en tim makwero to rembgi nobedi e wigi giwegi.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Koro aseneno mano kotimore omiyo anyisou ni en Wuod Nyasaye.”
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

kikuyu: yaye un nyikwa Ibrahim jatichne, yaye yawuot Jakobo joge moyiero.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Anakum ruodh Babulon gi pinye kaka ne akumo ruodh Asuria.
english: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato kuomu wuond wadgi, nikech uselonyo kit dhano machon kod timbene duto,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

kikuyu: Norwakore tim makare ka law akor mar nyinyo, kendo ne orwako warruok ka ogut lweny; bende ne orwako chulo kuor ka ngʼama rwako law, kendo nobolo mirima mager kuome ka law abola.
english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

kikuyu: Abiro loso kar dakna e dieru kendo ok anajwangʼu kata matin.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni ne pok atimo honni ma ngʼato angʼata pok otimo e diergi, to buch richo dine ok oloyogi, to sani koro giseneno honnigi duto, eka pod gichaya kaachiel gi Wuora bende.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

kikuyu: Kik ber mare mineno gi wangʼ omi chunyi gombe kata weye oywayi kolombi gi wangʼe.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, adhi kelo chandruok ne od Jeroboam. Abiro ngʼado yawuowi duto mawuok e od Jeroboam man Israel bed ni gin wasumbini kata ok gin wasumbini. Abiro wangʼo od Jeroboam mana kaka ngʼato wangʼo owuoyo nyaka oliel duto.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

kikuyu: Chwo ariyo nobedi e puodho, achiel nokaw to machielo nowe.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: E paradiso kuno nowinjoe weche malich ma ok oyiene dhano wuoyoe.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

kikuyu: Joshua wuod Nun kod Kaleb wuod Jefune, ma gin achiel kuom joma ne odhi nono piny Kanaan, noyiecho lepgi
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

kikuyu: Ka odiechiengno ochopo, unuywagi ka ukwayo kony kuom ruoth mane uyiero, to Jehova Nyasaye ok nomiu dwoko.”
english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”

kikuyu: to jotelogo duto nowacho niya, “Wasemiyogi singruok marwa e nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, omiyo koro ok wanyal mulogi.
english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

kikuyu: Omiyo ayie ni mondo ji owinj maber e ngima margi, nikech onge gima ber ne dhano e piny moloyo chiemo, metho kod bedo gimor. Bangʼe obiro bedo mamor kuom tije matek motiyo e kinde mar ngimane ma Nyasaye omiye ngima e piny ka.
english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai gi jopuonj Chik nochako paro kendgi giwegi niya, “Mae to en ngʼa ma yanyo Nyasaye? Ere ngʼat manyalo weyone ngʼato richone makmana Nyasaye kende?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mangʼeyone tin thoro yie gimoro amora, to ngʼat mariek paro gik motimo.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

kikuyu: kendo jodongogo nokaw ngʼatno mi kume.
english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

kikuyu: To en mana kaka ondiki niya, “Onge wangʼ moseneno, kata it mosewinjo, kata paro mosengʼeyo gima Nyasaye oseiko ne joma ohere.”
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat machiko ite kikwere biro bedo thuolo e kind joma riek.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

kikuyu: Daudi, korwako law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, nomiel aduwa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi tekre duto,
english: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

kikuyu: To Amasa ne onge gi paro moro amora kuom ligangla mane ni e lwet Joab, kendo Joab nochwowo bund iye gi liganglano molal, mi nyimbiye noredhore piny. Amasa notho ma ok ochako ochwowe kendo. Eka Joab gi owadgi ma Abishai nolawo Sheba wuod Bikri.
english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

kikuyu: Ok ber mondo icham ringʼo kata imadh divai, kata itim gimoro amora manyalo miyo nyawadu podhi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne giwuok giweyo oganda, mine gidhi kode mana kaka ne En-no, mi gichako kwangʼ kode ei yie. Ne nitie yiedhi mamoko bende mane kwangʼ kodgi e nam.
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Odiechiengʼno donge abiro tieko jorieko mag Edom, jogo man-gi winjo e gode mag Esau?
english: “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

kikuyu: abiro oronu gima Wuonwa osesingo, to beduru ei dala ka nyaka norwaku gi teko moa malo.”
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

kikuyu: Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo ne ja-higni piero angʼwen kano bedo ruodh Israel, nobedo ruoth kuom higni ariyo. Dhood Juda, to ne luwo Daudi.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, Nyis ruodh Turo niya, Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Sunga manie chunyi omiyo iwacho niya, “An nyasaye; Abet e kom duongʼ mar nyasaye moro modak e chuny nembe.” To chutho in mana dhano, to ok in nyasaye, kata obedo ni iketori ni iriek kaka nyasaye.
english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, chomgi tir, mi igogi piny; resa e lwet joma richo gi liganglani.
english: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

kikuyu: Chuny man-gi kwe kelo ngima ni ringruok, to nyiego towo choke.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: kendo iwachne joma ni e twech ni, ‘Wuoguru oko,’ to joma ni e mudho ni, ‘Beduru thuolo!’ “Gibiro chiemo e bath yo kendo giniyud kuonde kwath e gode matindo.
english: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.

kikuyu: Giniriembu e sinagogi; chutho ndalo biro ma ngʼama nonegu notim kamano kaparo ni otiyo ni Nyasaye.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

kikuyu: Mbui margi ok nyal twangʼ-go nanga, bende ok ginyal umore giwegi gi gik ma giloso. Timbegi gin timbe richo; kendo timbe mag mahundu ni e lwetgi.
english: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

kikuyu: Oloso lewni marep-rep mi ousgi, kendo omiyo johala gik moko.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

kikuyu: Kar dakna nobed kodgi; anabed Nyasachgi, kendo ginibed joga.
english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

kikuyu: Awinjo ywak kaka mar dhako mamuoch kayo, lit mana ka dhako ma nywolo nyathine makayo, ywak mar Nyar Sayun ka gamo yweyo, kotengʼo bedene kendo owacho, “To mano kaka apodho; ngimana omi jonek.”
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Yaye un joga modak Sayun, kik ubed maluor nikech jo-Asuria, kata obedo ni gichwadou gi ludhegi kendo gigoyou gi rungegi kaka jo-Misri ne timo.
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

kikuyu: Nolor kodgi piny kendo nochungo kama opie. Oganda maduongʼ mar jopuonjrene ne ni kanyo kod ji mangʼeny moa kuonde duto mag Judea, moa Jerusalem, kendo moa e dho nam mar Turo gi Sidon,
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

kikuyu: To donge wechena gi yorena mane achiko jotichna ma jonabi nojuko kwereu? “Omiyo negilokore kendo giwacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osetimonwa gima owinjore gi yorewa kod timbewa, mana kaka nochano timo.’ ”
english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

kikuyu: Ekron gi mier molworo bende ne margi.
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano biro dhi adier mana kaka nondiki kuome. To ngʼat mandhogo Wuod Dhano none malit! Dine obedo maber moloyo kane ok onywole.”
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Eka negiloso tonde milierogo pasia piero abich e giko riak pasia konchiel kendo tonde piero abich e giko riak pasia komachielo.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Nyaka gitwe kilemba molos gi lewni marep-rep e wiyegi, kendo nyaka gitwe lewni marep-rep e nungogi. Ok oyienigi rwako gimoro amora manyalo miyo luya chamgi.
english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

kikuyu: “Bende pinyruodh polo chalo gi gogo mane ochiki e nam momako kit rech duto mopogore opogore.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

kikuyu: To Yesu noluongogi duto kaachiel mowachonegi niya, “Ungʼeyo ni joma ikwano kaka jotelo e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi rito jogegi gi angʼenge, kendo jotendgi madongo tiyogi githuon.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat ma timbene richo olokore oweyo timbene maricho mosetimo, mi otimo tim makare kendo adier, to ok obi otho.
english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nokendo dhako machielo mane nyinge Ketura.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

kikuyu: Faresegi ringo mapiyo moloyo kwach, kendo giger moloyo guo sudhe e sa ma piny imoree. Faresegi mag lweny lengʼore ka gitingʼo wiyegi malo; joidh faresegi aa kuma bor. Gihuyo ka achuth madwaro kawo chiemo,
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

kikuyu: Ok nine oluwo richo mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat kende, to bende nine okendo Jezebel nyar Ethbal ruodh Sidon mi nochako tiyo ni Baal kendo lame.
english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Dhano to tho kendo iike e bwo lowo; oyweyo mogik, kendo kare rumo chuth.
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

kikuyu: Eka ji nopenja niya, “Donge inyalo nyisowae yo ma gik mitimogi omakowago?”
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi tim makare kendo ma ja-adiera nobed mangima, to ngʼat maluwo richo dhiyo e thone.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nomedo wachone niya, “Koro in gi ich kendo ibiro nywolo nyathi ma wuowi, mi inichake Ishmael, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osewinjo chandruokni.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mongʼeyo ka chuny dhano dum dhi malo to chuny le ridore dhi e lowo?”
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

kikuyu: Eglon kaachiel gi jo-Amon kod jo-Amalek, nobiro momonjo jo-Israel, mi gikawo Dala Maduongʼ mar Jeriko.
english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

kikuyu: To kar odiwuor tir, kane oyudo Paulo gi Sila jolemo kendo pako Nyasaye gi wende, ka joma otwe mamoko winjogi,
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

kikuyu: Gikanyono thuon gweno nokok kendo mar ariyo. Eka Petro noparo wach mane oyudo Yesu osewachone niya, “Kapok thuon gweno okok nyadiriyo to wangʼ inikweda nyadidek.” Wachno nobedone malit mi nochako ywak.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne achiko kawachone Joshua niya, “Iseneno gi wangʼi gik ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi osetimo ni ruodhi ariyogi. Jehova Nyasaye biro timo mana machal kamano ne pinjeruodhi duto kuma udhiyoeno.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne yawuot Esau (ma tiende ni Edom), kendo magi ema ne jodong-gi.
english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

kikuyu: Oganda duto mane odwogo koa e twech nogero kambi mag dak mi gidakie. Kochakore ndalo Joshua wuod Nun nyaka e odiechiengno, jo-Israel ne pod ok obedo gi nyasi machalo gi ma; kendo ne gin gi mor maduongʼ miwuoro.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

kikuyu: Ka bath mogo modwal ochiw kaka olemo mokwongo ler, to mano nyiso ni mogo modwal duto ler; kendo ka tiend yath ler, to bede yath bende ler.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo jopuonjreni ketho chike gi timbe mag jodongo? Ok giluok lwetgi kapok gichiemo!”
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

kikuyu: Eka Boaz nowacho niya, “E odiechiengʼ ma iningʼiewie puodhono kuom Naomi kendo kuom Ruth nyar Moab, ema inikawie chi ngʼat mothono, mondo ichung nying ngʼat mothono kaachiel gi mwandune.”
english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Petro obet oko e laru, achiel kuom nyiri matiyone jadolo maduongʼ nobiro machiegni.
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

kikuyu: Magi e nying yawuot Esau: Elifaz wuod Esau mane Ada onywolone, kod Reuel wuod Esau mane Basemath onywolone.
english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

kikuyu: “Wuonwa oseketo gik moko duto e lweta. To onge ngʼama ongʼeyo Wuowi makmana Wuoro kende, bende onge ngʼama ongʼeyo Wuoro makmana Wuowi kaachiel gi joma Wuowi oyiero mondo ofwenynegi.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

kikuyu: Arito warruokni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo aluwo chikeni.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

kikuyu: “Wuowi moro eri nika man-gi makati matindo abich motedi gi shairi, kod rech matindo ariyo, to magi dikony angʼo kuom pidho oganda machal kama?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

kikuyu: Mad herani ma ok rum osik kuomwa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka waketo genowa kuomi.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

kikuyu: nowachone min mare niya, “Fedha ma pekne romo kilo apar gadek mane omayi kendo mane awinjo kikwongʼogo ngʼat mane okwale; an ema an kodgi.” Eka min mare nowachone niya, “Wuoda, mad Jehova Nyasaye gwedhi!”
english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May the LORD bless my son!”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gichiele gi kite, Stefano nolamo kowacho niya, “Ruoth Yesu, kaw chunya.”
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

kikuyu: Lweti ne ok otwe, tiendeni ne ok otwe gi ratege. Isepodho mana kaka ngʼato podho e lwet joma richo.” Kendo ji duto notugore ka ywage kendo.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato osingore ne Jehova Nyasaye kata kokwongʼore mar timo gimoro to kik olokre, to nyaka one ni ochopo singruokneno.
english: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, kane owinjo ni Lazaro tuo, nomedo bedo kama ne entie kuom ndalo ariyo.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

kikuyu: “Nitie kama ikunyoe fedha kod kama ilenyoe dhahabu.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

kikuyu: Eka joma ok jo-Yahudi kod jo-Yahudi, kaachiel gi jotendgi nochano lingʼ-lingʼ mondo gisand joote kendo gichielgi gi kite.
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

kikuyu: Jogo ok gin joote madier. Gin joote mag miriambo, kendo giriambo kuom tich ma gitimo, ka giketore mondo gichal gi joote madier mag Kristo.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

kikuyu: kendo abiro nyisogi kuom kum mabiro, nikech ruodh pinyni koro bura oseloyo.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

kikuyu: “Koro abiro iri, to awacho gigi kapod an e piny, mondo gibed gi morna mogundho eigi.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

kikuyu: To joma lokore luwo yore mobam Jehova Nyasaye biro kumo kaachiel gi joma timo timbe maricho. Israel mondo obed gi kwe.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

kikuyu: bende joma wuondore ni gin jonabi to ok gin nobi mangʼeny kendo giniwuond ji mangʼeny.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Ok inichungi e kitanda mar midekre minindeni nyaka itho!’ ” Bangʼ mano Elija nodhi.
english: Now therefore the LORD says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

kikuyu: Giniyar badgi kuome, mana kaka ngʼama goyo abal yaro bedene ka kwangʼ. Nyasaye biro tieko sungagi kata obedo ni lwetgi riek e yor goyo abal.
english: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

kikuyu: Nokawo siro milamo mar Ashera mane oseloso mochungo ei hekalu, to Jehova Nyasaye noyudo osewuoyoe ne Daudi kod wuode Solomon niya, “Aseyiero hekaluni gi Jerusalem e kind ogendini duto mag Israel kendo, abiro keto nyinga kanyo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

kikuyu: Los turumbete ariyo mag fedha mothedhi, kendo ti kodgi kuom choko oganda duto kanyakla mondo mi gichak wuoth.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

kikuyu: rwath matin achiel, im achiel kod nyaim achiel matin ma hike achiel, nochiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Kik ulam nyasaye moro amora nikech Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma janyiego.
english: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

kikuyu: Yaye un oganda mag Sayun, modak Jerusalem, ok unuchak uywag kendo. Mano kaka notimnu ngʼwono e kinde ma unuywagne mondo okonyu! E sa moro amora mowinjo ywaku, to nokonyu.
english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

kikuyu: Ne oriembo wasike gi goch, kendo nomiyo giyudo wichkuot mosiko.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

kikuyu: Asedwaro resruok mari matek, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kendo chikni e morna.
english: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Nopayo kerubi gi yiend othith kod maupe moyarore kuomgi mobawogi gi dhahabu mothedhi maromre duto.
english: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

kikuyu: mondo kit ngimau mapile oywa chuny joma pok oyie mi gimiu luor, kendo kik uket genou kuom ngʼato angʼata.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

kikuyu: E giko higni piero ariyo mane Solomon ogerogo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod kare owuon mar dak,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house,

kikuyu: Ka Kain ochulne kuor nyadibiriyo to kara Lamek to nochul ne kuor nyadi piero abiriyo gabiriyo.”
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

kikuyu: Chutho, mano ema biro kelona resruok nikech onge ngʼama okia Nyasaye, manyalo hedhore michopi e nyime.
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

kikuyu: To nokwera kowachona niya, “Kik itim kamano. An bende an jatich wadu matiyo kodi kaachiel gi joweteni ma jonabi gi jogo duto morito weche manie kitabuni. Mi Nyasaye duongʼ!”
english: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

kikuyu: Jotichne nokawe gi gach lweny nyaka Jerusalem moike kod kwerene e bure mantiere e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

kikuyu: Nyathino nodongo kendo nowe dhoth, kendo chiengʼ mane Isaka oweyoe dhoth Ibrahim notimo nyasi maduongʼ.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

kikuyu: Donge malaike duto gin roho ma Nyasaye oketo mondo oti ni joma Nyasaye biro reso?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

kikuyu: Ji duto malamo gik mokedi wigi okuot; jogo gin joma sungore kuom nyiseche mopa; nyiseche duto mondo olame!
english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
