kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Ruodha kama: “Bed e bada korachwich, nyaka chop aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.”
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

kikuyu: Ka Nyasaye ok ogeno kata malaika mage, kendo kata mana polo bende ok ler e nyime,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

kikuyu: Kane Rabshake jatend lweny owinjo ni ruodh Asuria osewuok Lakish, ne oringo oa kanyo moyudo ka ruoth kedo gi jo-Libna.
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

kikuyu: Nowa notimo gik moko duto mana kaka Nyasaye nochike.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mane higni mia angʼwen gi piero adekgo orumo ema ne oganda Jehova Nyasaye duto owuokie piny Misri.
english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of the LORD’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kothe otop motwo ei lowo. Ute keno okethore, dere osego piny, nikech cham onge.
english: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.

kikuyu: “Mano e kaka nobed gi ngʼato angʼata mokano gik moko ne en owuon to ok omew e yor Nyasaye.”
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

kikuyu: To piny ma ungʼado Jordan mondo udhi ukaw en piny gode kod holo ma mwonyo pi moa e polo.
english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

kikuyu: Mano ema mondo obed chudo, ma Jehova Nyasaye chulo joma donjona; mano e kaka onego otim ne joma wuoyo marach kuoma.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kikuyu: E kinde machon e piny Israel, mondo ne gimoro owar ma mi ngʼat machielo, ne chuno ni ngʼato achiel kuom jogo nyaka lony wuochene kendo omi ngʼat machielo, mano ne miyo winjruogno ok nyal loki. Mano e yo mane igurogo gimoro amora mane iwilo gi chik e piny Israel.
english: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

kikuyu: Jogo mane nigo koro tiyo mondo oyud chiemo, to jogo mane denyo koro kegi orumo. Mano mane migumba osenywolo nyithindo abiriyo to mano mane nigi yawuowi to koro odongʼ nono.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nyalo bedo kod nyithindo mia achiel kendo odak higni mangʼeny; to kata bed ni odak mangʼeny maromo nade, ka ok onyal yudo mor kuom mwandune kendo ok oike maber ka otho, to awacho ni nyathi monywol kosetho ber moloye.
english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye ogolo chik, to jo-Israel ne chako wuoth, kendo kane ogolo chik to negigoyo kambi. E kinde duto ma bor polo nosiko ewi kar lemo, negisiko e kambi.
english: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

kikuyu: We ngʼat matimo richo odhi nyime kod timo richo; kendo ngʼat ma chunye ochido odhi nyime timo timbe mochido; to ngʼat matimo tim makare bende odhi nyime gi timo tim makare, to ngʼat maler odhi nyime gibedo maler.”
english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo apar wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia.
english: After ten days, the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah.

kikuyu: Wigi nowil gi gik mane osetimo, ranyisi mane osenyisogi.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

kikuyu: mi kuno bende ne giyaloe Injili.
english: There they preached the Good News.

kikuyu: Ogendini duto ok gimoro e nyime, okwanogi ka gik manono, maonge tich.
english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane owinje nowuoro ka gipenjore niya, “Donge ma e ngʼat mane sando joma ne luongo Nying Yesu Jerusalem? Donge osebiro ka mana mondo okawgi kaka joma otwe mondo otergi ni Jodolo madongo?”
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

kikuyu: Nokawo jotend migepe mag jolweny mia achiel-ka, jo-Kari, jorito kod jopinyno duto kendo giduto kanyakla negikelo ruoth koa e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mi gikowe nyaka kare mar dak, ka giluwo dhoranga jorito. Bangʼ mano Joash nobedo e kome mar loch.
english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the LORD’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

kikuyu: Kane ruodhno oneno gima notimoreno, noyie kuom Yesu, kendo nohum nono kuom gik mane owinjo kuom Ruoth Yesu.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

kikuyu: kendo iwachne ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Adagi, yaye Sidon, kendo abiro donjora kodi ka ayudo duongʼ. Gibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, chiengʼ ma akumo Sidon, mi anyisra kaka An ngʼama ler e diergi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.

kikuyu: “Land e Juda kendo ior wach e Jerusalem kiwacho ni: ‘Gouru turumbete e piny duto!’ Ywag matek kendo iwachi: ‘Chokreuru kaachiel! Waringuru wadhi e mier madongo mochiel motegno!’
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’

kikuyu: Nywok moyugnono en ruodh jo-Yunani, to tung marangʼongo manie pat wangʼe e ruoth mokwongo.
english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

kikuyu: Jowetena, gima awachonu en ni sa odongʼ matin. Chakre sani koro joma nigi mon onego odag ka gima giongego;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

kikuyu: Jatelo mar apar gachiel, e dwe mar apar gachiel ne en Benaya ja-Pirathon ma ja-Efraim. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Bende ne opimo ohingane, mi oyudo ni pek mar kore oromo bede mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gangʼwen, kipimo gi bat mar dhano, ma en rapim mane malaika otiyogo.
english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

kikuyu: Jodong Gilead nodwoke niya, “Kata kamano, wabiro iri koro; bi kodwa mondo waked gi jo-Amon, kendo inibed jatendwa kaachiel gi jogo duto modak Gilead.”
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano rituru yorene, buchene kod chikene adimba ma amiyou kawuono.
english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

kikuyu: Kik uywag ruoth motho kata goyo nduru ne lal mare; to onego, uywag malit ne ngʼatno moter e twech, nikech ok enoduogi kata neno piny mane onywole kendo.
english: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.

kikuyu: Donge asekano wachni kendo aume e mirimba?
english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

kikuyu: Ka oneno geche lweny miywayo gi farese, gi joma oidho punde kata ngamia, to oikre kendo obed motangʼ.”
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ne gidhuro kite kuom Akan, ma mano pod ni kamano nyaka chil kawuono. Eka mirima mar Jehova Nyasaye norumo. Kuom mano kanyo pod iluongo ni Holo mar Akor nyaka chil kawuono.
english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. The LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

kikuyu: Yaye un jodolo, rwakreuru gi pien gugru kuywak; denguru kendo gouru nduru, un joma tiyo e nyim kendo mar misango. Biuru, mondo uywagru otieno duto, un joma tiyo e nyim kendo mar misango, nikech cham mag misango kod misengini miolo piny, onge e od Nyasachwa.
english: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.

kikuyu: E dire koni gi kocha kuma ne Jonathan dwa ngʼado eka ochop e kambi jo-Filistia ne nitie geng got miluongo ni Bozez, to komachielo ne iluongo ni Sene.
english: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

kikuyu: Jatelo moro nopenje niya, “Japuonj maber, en angʼo monego atim mondo ayud ngima mochwere kaka girkeni mara?”
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: To in, kitweyo chiemo to ol mo e wiyi kendo luok wangʼi,
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

kikuyu: Omiyo Elija nodhi monyisore ne Ahab. Koro kech ne lich ahinya e piny Samaria,
english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

kikuyu: Jolweny ne dwaro nego joma otwe mondo ogengʼ gi kik gigo abal mi giring gitony.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

kikuyu: Joge duto nowuotho mokadho ka gin kaachiel gi jo-Kereth duto kod jo-Peleth; to gi jo-Giti duto mia auchiel mane obiro kode koa Gath bende ne wuotho e nyim ruoth.
english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

kikuyu: Joma gombo mondo obed gi mwandu nwangʼo tem kendo gimoko e obadho kuom gik mofuwo mangʼeny kod gombo mathoth kendo gombo ma kamano kelo kethruok kendo miyo ji lal.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

kikuyu: kinde mar nek kod kinde mar chang, kinde mar muko kod kinde mar gero,
english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

kikuyu: Koro dhiyo imonj jo-Amalek kendo itiek gimoro amora ma mekgi. Kik iwegi; neg chwo gi mon, gi rowere gi nyithindo madhoth, dhok, rombe, ngamia gi punde.’ ”
english: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

kikuyu: “ ‘Dedan noloko kodi piende mipedho ne farese.
english: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo moko, Ben-Hadad ruodh Aram nochoko jolweny mage duto momonjo Samaria.
english: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

kikuyu: “Kata mana an awuon naketo chunya mar timo duto manyalo mondo akwed nying Yesu ja-Nazareth.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

kikuyu: Lweti biro mako wasiki duto; lweti ma korachwich biro ndhiyo joma kedo kodi.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

kikuyu: nonyisogi ni ne obiro miyo nyikwagi podhi e kind ogendini, kendo ni ne obiro keyogi e pinje duto.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

kikuyu: “ ‘E ndalogo kendo e kindeno anami Bad Yath makare owuog e koth Daudi; enotim gima ratiro kendo nikare e piny.
english: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

kikuyu: “Neuru abiro mapiyo! Ngʼatno en ngʼat mogwedhi momako weche mokor manie kitabuni!”
english: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

kikuyu: Duog irwa, yaye Nyasaye Maratego! Ngʼi piny gie polo mondo ine! Ngʼi mzabibu maber,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: Musa nodwoke niya, “Nikech ji biro ira mondo omany dwach Nyasaye.”
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e tekona kod ohingana, kar pondona e ndalo chandruok, in ema ogendini nobi iri koa e tungʼ piny ka tungʼ piny mi giwachi ni, “Wuonewa ne onge gimoro to mana nyiseche manono mag miriambo, nyiseche mopa maonge tich mane ok otimonegi ber moro amora.
english: LORD, my strength, my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth, and will say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.

kikuyu: Hazael ruodh Aram ne osando jo-Israel ndalo duto mag loch Jehoahaz.
english: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo e od Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem, jotend mier mamoko nochiwo chiwo mar hera ne gedo mar od Nyasaye e kare mane entiere chon.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

kikuyu: Nikech in e konyruokna, awer ka an e bwo tipo mar bwombeni.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Koro Abisalom nopo koromo gi jolwenj Daudi koidho pundane. To kane oyudo kanyna kadho e bwo yiend ober man-gi tipo malach, wi Abisalom nomoko e bad yadhno, mi nodongʼ koliero e kor yamo, ka kanyna mane oidho to ne dhiyo nyime gi wuoth.
english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

kikuyu: mondo mi uchiem kendo umethi e mesana e pinyruodha kendo ubedi e kombe mag loch, kungʼado bura ne ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kane pod girito, Ehud noluchore mi owuok odhi. Ne okalo machiegni gi gik mopa mi opondo odhi Seira.
english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

kikuyu: To ubiro yudo teko ka Roho Maler obiro kuomu; kendo unubed joneno maga ei Jerusalem kendo ei Judea duto gi Samaria, kod tungʼ piny gi tungʼ piny.”
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

kikuyu: Nimar ka dagi mane Nyasaye odagi gigo ema omiyo koro osiep obetie kind Nyasaye gi piny duto, donge rwakgi to nokel mana chier aa kuom joma otho?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

kikuyu: Joma noke e pinje maokogo noyalo Injili kamoro amora mane gidhiye.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom kar dak mar ruodh Juda: “Kata obedo ni in kaka Gilead ne an, kaka wi got Lebanon, adiera analoku kaka kama otwo, ka mier maonge joma odakie.
english: For the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

kikuyu: Mano nochopo gima ne owach gidho janabi niya, “Abiro yawo dhoga mondo awuo gi ngeche, abiro hulo gik mosebedo kopondo nyaka aa chakruok piny.”
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

kikuyu: Ne ochiwo chudo ne Eglon ruodh Moab, mane ngʼat machwe ahinya.
english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

kikuyu: Mano nobedi tij ruodh Israel mondo misengini miwangʼo pep, chiwo mag cham kod misango miolo piny, Sawo mar Dwe manyien kod mago mag Sabato e kinde mag sawo moyier duto mag jo-dhood Israel. En ema obiro chiwo misengini mag golo richo, gi chiwo mag cham gi misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag lalruok mondo olosgo yor pwodhruok ni dhood Israel.
english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Aa malo mondo isir tichni, yaye Nyasaye; parie kaka joma ofuwo jari odiechiengʼ duto.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

kikuyu: Heruru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo urit dwarone, buchene, kod chikene ndalo duto.
english: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

kikuyu: Juda nowacho ne owetene niya, “Ere ohala ma wabiro yudo ka wanego owadwa kendo wapando rembe?
english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

kikuyu: To moloyo mano, koro akwano gik moko duto ka gik maonge tich nikech aseyudo ni ngʼeyo Kristo Yesu Ruodha nigi ohala maduongʼ moloyo. Nikech en, ne aweyo gik moko duto olalna, kendo akwanogi mana kaka yugi, mondo eka ayud Kristo kaka pokna,
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

kikuyu: Beduru kungʼeyo ni deko mar Ruodhwa oweyo mana thuolo mar yudo warruok, mana kaka Paulo owadwa mwageno bende osendikonu gi rieko mane Nyasaye omiye.
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

kikuyu: Abiro miyo ogandani podhi e dho ligangla mag joma roteke; gin joma ger maonge joma ipimogo e piny ngima. Gibiro tieko sunga mar Misri kendo ogandane duto ibiro tieko.
english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Daudi kod joge nochopo Ziklag chiengʼ mar adek. Koro jo-Amalek noyudo osemonjo Negev gi Ziklag. Negipeyo Ziklag mi giwangʼe,
english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel duto nodok Bethel, kendo negibet piny kanyo ka giywak e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Ne giriyo kech ka gilemo chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo kendo negichiwo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mar lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

kikuyu: “To koro yie ichomie wangʼi kuoma kendo iranga maber iparo ni anyalo wuondi e wangʼi?
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ok osejwangʼ dala maduongʼ mongʼere; dala mamor godo?
english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

kikuyu: Nikech mirimbe bedo mana kuom kinde matin kende, to ngʼwonone osiko nyaka chiengʼ; ywak nyalo bedo gotieno to mor biro mana gokinyi.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

kikuyu: Yawuot Tola ne gin: Uzi, Refaya, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsam kod Samuel, mane en jotend anywolagi. Ndalo loch Daudi, joka Tola kokwan chwo ma jolweny koluwore gi nonro mar nywolgi ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo gi mia auchiel (22,600).
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: “Joga ofuwo; ok gingʼeya. Gin nyithindo maonge wigi gionge rieko, gilony mana kuom timo timbe maricho; kendo ok gingʼeyo; kaka digitim maber.”
english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “We wachwe dhano e kido machal kodwa kendo gibed gi teko ewi rech mae nam kendo gi winy mae kor polo, ewi jamni, ewi piny duto kendo ewi chwech duto mawuotho ewi lowo.”
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

kikuyu: Eka jadolo maduongʼ nochungʼ malo mopenjo Yesu niya, “Dak idwok wachno? Ma wach manade ma jogi wacho kuomini?”
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Eka Abner nowachone Joab niya, “We yawuowi oa malo mondo omakre achingʼ gachingʼ e nyimwa ka.” Joab nodwoko niya, “Kare gitim kamano.”
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

kikuyu: Konyruokwa ni e nying Jehova Nyasaye, Jachwech polo gi piny.
english: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi joge maromo mia auchiel, nowuok Keila mine giwuotho koni gi kocha ka gisiko gidar. Kane Saulo owinjo ni Daudi nosetony mowuok Keila ne ok odhi kuno.
english: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi nonro mar anywolagi ne gin gi chwo alufu piero adek gauchiel (36,000) mane nyalo dhi e lweny, nimar ne gin gi mon gi nyithindo mangʼeny.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

kikuyu: Nyak mar piny itiyogo gi ji duto; ruoth bende yudo ohala e nyak mar puothego.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

kikuyu: To kata kamano an kodi gi wach; iseweyo hera mane iherago mokwongo.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye kik sin koda, to oyie awach wach achiel mogik. Ka dipo ni ji apar kende ema oyudi e dalano?” Ruoth Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Nikech ji apar maonge ketho ok natiek dalano.”
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

kikuyu: Negiloso mesa gi yiend siala ma borne romo fut adek to lachne romo fut achiel gi nus kendo borne madhi malo romo fut ariyo gi robo.
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

kikuyu: mondo koluong nying Yesu to ji duto nogo chong-gi piny, e polo kendo e piny, kendo e bwo piny,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

kikuyu: Kelneuru Jehova Nyasaye chiwo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mar misango miwangʼo pep mar nyarwath, im achiel kod nyiimbe abiriyo ma jo-higa achiel, mago maonge songa.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Negiwuok Pi Hahiroth mi gingʼado nam nyaka e thim, kendo kane gisewuotho kuom ndalo adek e Thim mar Etham, negibuoro Mara.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno gima jopuonjrene timo, nokecho kodgi, mi owachonegi niya, “Weuru nyithindo matindo obi ira kendo kik utamgi, nikech pinyruoth Nyasaye en mar ji machal ka magi.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Mani en adiera kuom jogo machopo dwaro mochido mag ringregi ka gichayo loch. Jopuonj mag miriambogi wengegi tek kendo opongʼ gi achaya, bende ok giluoro kata mana wuoyo marach kuom joma nigi joloch mag polo,
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

kikuyu: kata ka okwanyo gima olal bangʼe oriambo kendo oriyo dhoge, kata ka otimo richo ma ngʼato angʼata nyalo timo;
english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

kikuyu: Yesu norieyo bade mana gisano momake. Nowachone niya, “Ne iriwo gi kiawa nangʼo, yaye ngʼama nigi yie matin-ni?”
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ yiengni pinyno mach nobiro, to Jehova Nyasaye ne onge ei majno. To bangʼ majno yamo makudho mos nobiro.
english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata matimo dwaro Nyasaye e owadwa gi nyaminwa kod minwa.”
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne owachna niya, “Nyaka ichak ikor wach kuom ogendini mangʼeny, gi pinje mangʼeny kod joma wacho dhok mopogore opogore gi ruodhi mangʼeny.”
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

kikuyu: Omiyo adhil kuom duto nikech adwaro ni joma Nyasaye oyiero bende oyudie warruok miyudo kuom Kristo Yesu, kendo makelo duongʼ mochwere.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

kikuyu: Eka Shekem nowacho ne wuon Dina kod owete Dina niya, “timnauru ngʼwono kendo abiro miyou gimoro amora ma ukwayo.”
english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni kwan joma onge ketho oromo mana ji piero angʼwen gabich, dikech dalano nikech ji abich kende?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Kayudo ji piero angʼwen gabich kanyo, to ok nakethe.”
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kwauru Ruodh keyo mondo oor jotich odhi e puothe mar keyo.”
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

kikuyu: Jonathan nodwoke niya, “Ok kamano ngangʼ! Ruodhwa Daudi oseketo Solomon ruoth.
english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

kikuyu: Nyaka nachak dhi ir Farao mondo awuo e nyingi, osekelo chandruok ni ogandani bende ok isereso ogandani ngangʼ.”
english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”

kikuyu: Petro nodwoko niya, “Omera, ok angʼeyo gima iwuoyo kuome!” Mana kaka nowuoyono, thuon gweno nokok.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Mier manie dho nembe noyiengni matek, ka jokwangʼ mag-gi ywak matek.
english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.

kikuyu: Kendo enoor malaikege mi ochok joge moyiero moa e tunge piny nyaka chop giko polo.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nokel kidi modin-go dho bur, kendo ruoth noketo sei gi lwete owuon gi mar jodonge, mondo kik ngʼato angʼata ores Daniel.
english: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.

kikuyu: Ruoth nosomo baruwano, eka nopenjo Paulo ni en japiny mane. Bangʼ ngʼeyo ni ne en japiny Kilikia,
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

kikuyu: Mirimbi mager osemiyo ringra obedo maonge ngima maber; chokena ok winj maber nikech richona.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

kikuyu: Ji ariyo ber moloyo ngʼato achiel nikech giyudo ohala kuom tich ma gitiyo.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

kikuyu: omiyo ka un ei Kristo to un gi gik moko duto, nikech en e jatelo moloyo jotelo duto, kendo en e teko moloyo teko gi loch duto.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kikuyu: Kane gisetieko wuoyo, Jakobo nochungʼ mowuoyo kowacho niya, “Winjauru, owetena.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato osepidho mzabibu ma ok ochako chamo olembe? Onego odog dala nikech dipoka otho e lweny ma ngʼat machielo ema bi cham olemono.
english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel, ka Yesu nochungo but nam mar Genesaret, kendo ji kochokore molwore ka giwinjo wach Nyasaye.
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: Mano kaka wechegi mit ka abilogi, gimit e dhoga moloyo mor kich!
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

kikuyu: in ema anegogo dichwo gi dhako, in ema anegogo jaduongʼ kod rawere, in ema anegogo wuowi kod nyako,
english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

kikuyu: Kane gisebiro, nowachonegi niya, “Ungʼeyo maber kaka ngimana ne chalo e kinde mane an kodu ka, kochakore odiechiengʼ mokwongo mane adonjo e piny Asia.
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

kikuyu: “ ‘Losnauru kendo mar misango mochwe gi lowo kendo timieuru misenginiu miwangʼo pep kod mag lalruok gi rombeu gi dieu kod dhou. Kinde moro amora ma amiyo nyinga oyudo duongʼ, to anabi iru mi agwedhu.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

kikuyu: Kuom Jatend Wer. Kaluwore Gi Gitith. Zaburi Mar Daudi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Ruodhwa, mano kaka nyingi nigi duongʼ e piny duto! Iseketo duongʼni maler milamo, moyombo polo.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

kikuyu: Wan to Nyasaye oseelonwa tiend wachne mopondo kuom teko mar Roho mare. Roho Maler fwenyo gik moko duto, nyaka weche matut mag Nyasaye.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

kikuyu: Anaketh dala maduongʼni kendo mi obed gima ijaro; jogo duto makalo bute nohum nono kendo gininyiere ka gineno adhondene duto.
english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

kikuyu: Chik ma osemiyowa en ma: Ngʼat mohero Nyasaye nyaka her wadgi bende.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo auchiel nyaka uti to odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo nobed odiechiengu maler, ma en Sabato mar yweyo ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼato angʼata motimo tich chiengʼ Sabato nyaka negi.
english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Nyako mane ni e dhootno nopenjo Petro niya, “Donge in bende in achiel kuom jopuonjre ngʼatni, koso ariambo?” Nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, ok an.”
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane oseriembo Adam oko, ne oketo kerubi gi ligangla mamil koni gi koni yo wuok chiengʼ mar Puodho Mar Eden mondo orit yo mochomo yadh ngima.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

kikuyu: Ne owacho ne jatichne Gehazi niya, “Luongna chi Shunam-no.” Omiyo noluonge mi dhakono nobiro mochungʼ e nyime.
english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

kikuyu: Ashur wuon Tekoa ne nigi mon ariyo, Hela kod Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

kikuyu: Nikech Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto konya, ok anayud wichkuot. Kuom mano, asechomo wangʼa tir kuome maonge luoro kendo angʼeyo maber ni ok nayud achaya.
english: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

kikuyu: To ne giwero wer manyien ka gichungʼ e nyim kom duongʼ, kendo e nyim gik mangima angʼwen kod jodongogo. Bende ne onge ngʼato mane nyalo puonjore wero wendni makmana ogendini alufu mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gangʼwen (144,000) mane gin joma nores koa e piny.
english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

kikuyu: ka gichiwo thuolo ni joma gingʼeyo ni ok jodolo chamo chiemo mowalgo, nikech mano miyo jogo bedo joketho kendo gidonjo e kum mowinjore gi chudo. An Jehova Nyasaye mapwodhogi.’ ”
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Okwongʼ ngʼatno ma genone ni kuom dhano, ngʼatno mogeno kuom ringruok mondo omiye teko, kendo ma chunye aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from the LORD.

kikuyu: Mad jogo masanda ne wichkuot, to an kik wiya kuodi; mad gibed gi bwok maduongʼ to an kik ibwoga. Kel gigi kuomgi e kinde mar masira; kethgi gi kethruok manyadiriyo.
english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but don’t let me be disappointed. Let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

kikuyu: Ka wangʼ ruoth nenore mamor to nitiere ngima, ngʼwonone chalo gi rumbi mag koth e ndalo chwiri.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

kikuyu: Idak e kind jo-miriambo; e wuondruokgino gisedagi yie kuoma.” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: “Nyithinda, pod abiro bedo kodu kuom thuolo matin. Bangʼe ubiro manya, to mana kaka ne anyiso jo-Yahudi e kaka anyisou sani, ni kama adhiye un ok unyal bire.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noringo akeya nono e nyim jo-Juda nikech Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwet jo-Juda.
english: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

kikuyu: Saulo ne dhi e bath got konchiel to Daudi gi joge ne ni e bathe kumachielo, ka giringo mondo gi yomb Saulo. Ka Saulo gi jolwenje ne chiegni juko Daudi gi joge mondo gimakgi,
english: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

kikuyu: Kane dhakono oneno ni Josef oweyo lawe e lwete kendo oringo owuok oko mar ot,
english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

kikuyu: Kuom mano nodhi kodgi. Negidhi Jordan ma gichako tongʼo yien.
english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

kikuyu: Mwandugigo gin: dhahabu gi fedha kod kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek gi lulu kod lewni mabeyo, gi lewni maralik, lewni mayom kod lewni makwar gi yien duto madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, gi gik moko duto molos gi lak liech, gi yien ma nengogi tek kod molos gi nyinyo, kod mula kendo molos gi kite mabeyo,
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

kikuyu: To koro ere tij Chik? Chik nomedi mondo onyis dhano kaka en jaketho, nyaka chop kinde ma nyakwar Ibrahim mane osingi nobi. Malaika nokelo Chik moketo e lwet jathek.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

kikuyu: Mowachone niya, “Ma en kar yweyo, joma ool mondo oywe.” Kendo niya, “Ma en kar kwe,” to ne ok ginyal winjo.
english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

kikuyu: “To ne wawacho niya, ‘Ka dipo ni giwachonwa ma, kata ne nyikwawa to wabiro dwoko kama: Neuru kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane kwerewa ogero, mondo obed kaka ranyisi e kindwa kodu, to ok ni chiwo misango miwangʼo pep.’
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of the LORD’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

kikuyu: Milome. Ma e wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kuom Israel. Jehova Nyasaye mane ochweyo polo moketo mise mar piny kendo omiyo dhano much ngima, wacho kama:
english: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

kikuyu: Eka ibiro yudo mor kuom misengni mag joma kare, kuom misango miwangʼo pep mochiw duto, kendo ibiro chiw rwedhi e kendoni mar misango.
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

kikuyu: Ne iwacho niya, “Asetimo muma gi ngʼata ma ayiero, asesingora ne Daudi jatichna ni,
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

kikuyu: Chakre Teba kod Kun, mane gin miech Hadadezer, Daudi nokawo mula mangʼeny, mane Solomon olosogo gima iluongo ni Nam mar mula gi sirni, to gi gik mopogore opogore molos gi mula.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Maskil mar Asaf. Chiknauru itu, yaye un joga, winjuru weche mawuok e dhoga.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Harun nochiw misango mar pwodho tunge kendono dichiel e higa. Chiwo mar higa ka higa mar pwodhruok nyaka tim gi remb misango mar golo richo ni tienge duto mabiro. Kendono nobed maler moloyo ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”

kikuyu: To jo-Israel nodwoko Joshua niya, “Ooyo! Wabiro tiyone Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”

kikuyu: Giloso chenro ka giriwo pachgi bedo achiel, gilosoni riwruok mondo giked kodi.
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo idagi ngʼwonona kuom ketho maga kendo itamori wena richoga? Nikech koro abiro tho machiegni; ibiro manya, to ok enonwangʼa.”
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Gomer ne gin: Ashkenaz, Rifath kod Togarma
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: Jo-Pathrus, jo-Kaslu (ma jo-Filistia nowuok kuomgi) kod jo-Kaftor.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: To koro ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, Nyasaye mane ochweyi, yaye Jakobo, Nyasaye mane ochweyi, yaye Israel: “Kik ibed maluor, nimar aseresi; kendo aseluongi gi nyingi ni in mara awuon.
english: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

kikuyu: Ne iriembo ogendini mamoko gi lweti iwuon kendo ne iguro kwerewa kargi; ne itieko ogendinigo mi imiyo kwerewa okar.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Zebulun ne romo ji alufu piero abich gabiriyo gi mia angʼwen (57,400).
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka gigi nosetimore, ruoth Ahasuerus nomiyo Haman wuod Hamedatha, ja-Agag duongʼ moloyo jodongo duto.
english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.

kikuyu: Ka gitimo kamano, to ginyalo puonjo mon matindo kaka onego giher chwogi gi nyithindgi;
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

kikuyu: To kuom gik moko duto modakie pi, unyalo chamo mago man kod thuokgi kod kalagakla.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

kikuyu: Kane yawuot Jakobo owinjo gima nosetimore, negidwogo dala mapiyo nono ka gia kuonde mag kwath. Igi nowangʼ ahinya kendo negikuyo, nikech tim anjawo mane Shekem osetimo ni Dina nyamin-gi e piny Israel, tim mamono ma ok owinjore.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ok ungʼeye, anto angʼeye. Ka anyalo wacho ni ok angʼeye, to anyalo bedo ja-miriambo mana ka un, to angʼeye adier kendo pile angʼeyo wachne.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

kikuyu: Janabi, kaachiel gi Nyasacha e jarit mar Efraim, kata kamano obadho rite e yorene duto, kendo akweda bende rite e od Nyasache.
english: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

kikuyu: “Gik moko ariyo makwayi; yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kik itama biro buti kapok atho.
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

kikuyu: To kuonde motimo thidhna gi otodo, to ok nolokre mi dok maliw. Ginibed kuonde ma ji yude bala kod chumbi.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

kikuyu: kendo odhiyo dala. Eka oluongo osiepene gi jogwengʼ-gi kaachiel, kowacho ni, ‘Moruru koda, aseyudo nyarombona ma yande olal.’
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

kikuyu: Abiro goyoni erokamano e chokruok maduongʼ; abiro paki e dier oganda maduongʼ mochokore kaachiel.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai nobiro mochako mino wach gi Yesu. Ne gikone mondo omigi ranyisi moa e polo, ka giteme.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mane loso koda noa, kendo malaika machielo nobiro mondo oromne
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

kikuyu: Nobet kare mane ojabetie but kor ot, ka gimanyore gi Jonathan, Abner to nobet bath Saulo, kom Daudi to ne ninono.
english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

kikuyu: Bende ineno ngʼato ma wuoyo ka rikni mapiyo piyo? Nitie geno mathoth kuom ngʼat mofuwo maloye.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Gotienono negimiyo wuon-gi kongʼo mi omer, kendo nyare maduongʼ nodonjo moriwore kode. Lut nomer mane ok ongʼeyo seche mano ochako kata tieko riwore gi nyare.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

kikuyu: Eka Bildad ja-Shua nodwoko kama:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: Pundano nopenjo Balaam niya, “Donge an mana pundani owuon, ma isebedo ka iidho, nyaka kawuononi? Bende iseneno ka an gi kido mar timoni gima chalo kama?” Nodwoke niya, “Ooyo.”
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

kikuyu: “Kik uchiwna remo motimgo misango kaachiel gi gimoro amora moketie thowi, kendo misango moro amora mochiw chiengʼ nyasi mar Pasaka kik dongʼ nyaka okinyi.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

kikuyu: Ne gidagi winjo buchene kod chikene mane otimo gi kweregi to gi siem mane omiyogi, negiluwo nyiseche maonge tich, ma gin bende gibedo ji manono. Negidonjo e kit timbe ogendini mane odak e diergi, kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye nosekwerogi ni kik gitim kaka gitimo kendo negitimo gik mane Jehova Nyasaye nokwerogi mondo kik gitim.
english: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom the LORD had commanded them that they should not do like them.

kikuyu: Ruoth nochungʼ malo, noyiecho lepe mi onindo piny kendo jotijene duto nochungʼ bute ka lepgi oyiech.
english: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

kikuyu: Debe achiel nyaka pongʼ gi gorogoro maromre kendo gorogoro aboro ema nyaka pongʼ debe achiel, ka debe to bedo gorogoro nyadi boro. Gorogoro ema nyaka bed gir pimo moyiedhi mipongʼogo gik moko.
english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

kikuyu: Negikawo gik monyak e pinyno, mi gikelonwa, kagiwacho niya, “En piny maber ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa biro miyowa.”
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai moko nobiro ire mondo oteme. Negipenje niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo ngʼato oketh keny gi chiege nikech wach moro amora?”
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

kikuyu: “Mana kaka polo bor gi piny e kaka bende yorena boyo maloyo mau, kendo e kaka parona ohewo parou.
english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo pach dhano; ongʼeyo ni gionge tich.
english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

kikuyu: Joma kare biro loth maber ka yiend othith, gibiro dongo ka yiend sida mar Lebanon;
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

kikuyu: Giwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok ne; Nyasach Jakobo ok dew gik ma watimo.”
english: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ichungʼ gichien, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Angʼo momiyo ipondo ne ji e ndalo mag chandruok?
english: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

kikuyu: “Ji moa e pinje mangʼeny nokal e dala maduongʼni kendo ginipenjre kendgi giwegi ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye timo gima chalo kama ne dala maduongʼni?’
english: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this great city?’

kikuyu: “Bangʼe inind gi bathi koracham kendo ket richo mar dhood Israel kuomi. Nyaka itingʼ richogi kuom ndalo mininde gi bathigo duto.
english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

kikuyu: Kik udwany nyinga maler. An kenda ema jo-Israel nyaka miya luor kaka ngʼama ler. An e Jehova Nyasaye mapwodhogi,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,

kikuyu: Musa notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike, kendo oganda jo-Israel duto nochokore e dho Hemb Romo.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka wuowino nosedhi, Daudi nowuok yo milambo mar dir kidi, mi okulore piny e nyim Jonathan nyadidek ka lend wangʼe mulo piny. Eka ne gimosore ma giywak giduto to Daudi noywak moloyo.
english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

kikuyu: Dhako mofuwo en jakoko, ok oritore kendo ngʼeyone tin.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

kikuyu: “Ne isiemogi mondo gidwog kuom chikni, to negibedo jongʼayi kendo ma ok oluoro chikeni. Negitimo richo kuom chayo puonj magi, maka ngʼato orito to kelone ngima. Negilokore giweyi ka tokgi tek ta mi ok girito chikeni.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

kikuyu: kendo gitwe ruodhigi gi nyoroche, kod jotendgi gi opingo mag chuma,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

kikuyu: to wuode Ishmael ne ja-higni apar gadek.
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Eka nokelo misango mar cham kendo nojuko sanja mowangʼo e kendo mar misango kaachiel gi misango miwangʼo pep mar okinyi.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

kikuyu: Ngʼat manie wi tat ode bende kik lor piny kata donji ei ot mondo okaw gimoro amora oago.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

kikuyu: Ne oike e liende mane ni e puodho mar Uza kendo Josia ma wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ngʼat machano gima rach biro ngʼere kaka ja-andhoga.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

kikuyu: Arauna nowacho ne Daudi niya, “Kawe! Mad ruodha ma jatenda okawe kendo otim kode gima chunye dwaro. Ne, anamiyi rwedhi mondo ichiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep, kod gige dino kaka yien kaachiel gi ngano kaka cham michiwo; abiro chiwogi duto.”
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

kikuyu: To kane odwogo, nochako oyudogi ka ginindo, nikech nindo noingogi. Ne ok gingʼeyo gima diginyise.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

kikuyu: “Yaye ruoth ma ruodha koro adwaro lokoni tiend leknino bende lekno nyiso bura ma Jal Man Malo Mogik osengʼadoni.
english: “This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:

kikuyu: E ndalo mokadho kata ka Saulo ne ruoth in ema ne itelo ni jo-Israel e lwenjegi. Kendo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi nowachoni niya, ‘In ema nibed jakwadh joga Israel, kendo inibed jatendgi.’ ”
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

kikuyu: To nikech jatendgi ne dwaro reso ngima Paulo, notamogi ni kik gineg-gi. Nogol chik mondo ngʼato angʼata mane nyalo goyo abal nyaka e dho wath okuong ochikre e pi mondo odhiyo.
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

kikuyu: “Eka ogendini duto noluongu ni joma ogwedhi nikech pinyu nobed piny maber,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Obed ne wuon Jehu, to Jehu ne wuon Azaria,
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

kikuyu: To Gedalia wuod Ahikam nowachone Johanan wuod Karea niya, “Kik itim gima chalo kamano! Gima iwacho kuom Ishmael ok adiera.”
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”

kikuyu: Pak obed ne Nyasaye, ma ok osedagi lamona, kata golo herane kuoma.
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

kikuyu: Nyaka chil kawuono jo-Edom pod ongʼanyo ne jo-Juda. Jo-Libna bende nongʼanyo e ndalono nikech Jehoram noweyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwerene.
english: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.

kikuyu: Ka ndaloni orumo mitho kendo iluwo kwereni to abiro keto kothi moro mondo okaw kari, manobed kothi owuon kendo anagur pinyruodhe.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

kikuyu: Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Nyis oweteni, oyie misikegi kuom pundegi mondo gidog Kanaan,
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: koa kuom nyikwa Elizafan, Shimri gi Jeyel, koa kuom nyikwa Asaf, Zekaria kod Matania;
english: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

kikuyu: kendo nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi kod min mare mondo idhi e piny Israel, nikech joma netemo kawo ngima nyathi osetho.”
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

kikuyu: kuonde mikalogo aora osemuki, odundu wangʼ, kendo jolweny luoro omako.”
english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

kikuyu: Kendo mach nowuok koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye mi owangʼo ji mia ariyo gi piero abich mane oyudo chiwo misango mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

kikuyu: Chik achielno ema oket ne ngʼato angʼata motimo richo ka ok ongʼeyo, bed ni en jakanyo ma ja-Israel kata japiny moro.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gimor mana ka pi mogingore, to ka akwerogi to giniring ma gidhi mabor, mana machal gi mihudhwe mipiedho e gode ma yamo tero, kata ka yamo mar kalausi.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

kikuyu: Timbe mag ringruok nenore ratiro, gin kaka: chode, timbe mochido, anjawo,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kikuyu: “Bende losuru yiende miriwo mag yiend siala; ka abich oket ne sirni mantie bathe konchiel mar Hemb Romo,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: ngʼato angʼata miluongo gi nyinga, ngʼat mane achweyo mondo omiya duongʼ, ngʼat mane achweyo kendo amiyo ngima.”
english: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano ibiro dhi Gibea miluongo ni Got mar Nyasaye kama nitie kambi mar jo-Filistia. Ka ichopo machiegni gi dala to ibiro romo gi oganda jonabi kalor koa kar lemo kotelnegi gi joma goyo orutu, gi tamborin, asili gi nyatiti, kendo jonabi biro biro ka gikoro wach.
english: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Simeon ne gin: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zera kod Shaul;
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

kikuyu: Hurai moa e holo man Gash, Abiel ja-Arbath, gi
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mopodho kuom kidino notur matindo tindo, to ngʼatno ma kidino ogore kuome noregre ka buru.”
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu gi jopuonjrene ni e yo, nochopo gwengʼ kama dhako miluongo ni Maritha norwake e ode.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

kikuyu: Kendo dhoudigi nochungʼ e Got Ebal ka gihulo weche mag kwongʼ: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan kod Naftali.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

kikuyu: E kinde duto ma pinyu nodongʼ gunda, ka un to asekeyou udak e kind wasiku; pinyu nobed ma ok opur mondo ochulgo Sabato maga duto mane ok urito.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

kikuyu: Aseneno chandruok chakre tin-na mi adwa tho; asewinjo malit nikech thagruok misekelona, kendo chunya oseol.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

kikuyu: Anami gibed gi chuny achiel kod tim achiel, mondo omi giluora manokel negiber kod nyithindgi manobi bangʼ-gi.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

kikuyu: Negitimo ranyisi mag honni e diergi, ee, negitimo timbene miwuoro e piny Ham.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Konania bende, kaachiel gi Shemaya kod Nethanel ma owetene kod Hashabia gi Jeyel kod Jozabad mane jatend jo-Lawi nomiyo jo-Lawi nyirombe kod diek alufu abich kod dhok mia abich mondo otimgo misango mar Pasaka.
english: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.

kikuyu: Ka isingori e nyim Nyasaye, to kik ideki mar timo kamano. Ok omor gi joma ofuwo; omiyo chop singruokni.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

kikuyu: punde alufu piero adek gi mia abich (30,500),
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

kikuyu: “E ndalogo kendo e sano, ka anadwok ni Juda gi Jerusalem mwandugi mane olalnegi.
english: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone ji duto, chwo kaachiel gi mon, mane dwoke niya,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people—to the men and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

kikuyu: Chiengʼno negitimone Jehova Nyasaye misango gi dhok mia abiriyo kod rombe kod diek alufu abiriyo mane gin gik mane giyako.
english: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

kikuyu: Anami nyikwa Daudi jatichna kod jo-Lawi ma yalo e nyima bed mangʼeny mokalo akwana ka sulwe manie kor polo kendo ma ok nyal pim ka kwoyo manie dho nam.’ ”
english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nosewuotho e thim kuom thuolo maromo higni piero angʼwen manyaka ji duto mahikgi oromo kedo e lweny mane giwuokgo Misri nosetho nikech ne ok giseluoro Jehova Nyasaye. Jehova Nyasaye nosekwongʼorenegi ni ok gininee piny mane osingo ne kweregi mondo omigi, piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice. The LORD swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Neginwangʼo kuonde kwath mabeyo, piny ne lach kendo kwe ne nitie. Jo-Ham moko nodak kae mokwongo.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo chiko ongo mi fu kochomo polo, kata miyo oger ode ewi yien?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

kikuyu: Ajarano ne dhi nyime higa ka higa, to moloyo, e kinde ka kinde mane Hana dhi e od Jehova Nyasaye. E kindego nyieke ne osiko kawangʼo iye gi wechego manyaka oywagi ma ok onyal kata chiemo.
english: So year by year, when she went up to the LORD’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

kikuyu: kata ka en rakuom kata othwogo, kata ka en rachiero, kata ka wangʼe chwero pi, kata ka en gi adhola monyaa kata ka en bwoch.
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone ni Uria niya, “Dhi mwalo e odi mondo ilwok tiendi.” Omiyo Uria nowuok oa e dala ruoth, eka bangʼe ruoth noorone mich.
english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

kikuyu: Chon e piny Israel kane ngʼato dhi penjo Nyasaye wach ne owacho niya, “Bi wadhi ka Janen,” nikech ngʼat miluongo ni janabi ndaloni ne iluongo ni janen.
english: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)

kikuyu: Jomecho ariyo bende negiguro kode, achiel e bathe korachwich to machielo e bathe koracham. [
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘En ngʼa mabiro hoyo Ahab ruodh Israel mondo oked gi jo-Ramoth Gilead kendo onege kuno?’ “To ngʼato ka ngʼato nochiwo pache.
english: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nigi teko ewi yamo mondo ochike, omiyo onge ngʼama nigi teko e odiechieng thone. Mana kaka jalweny ok mi thuolo mar yweyo e kinde mag kedo, e kaka joricho bende ok yud thuolo kuom timbegigo.
english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

kikuyu: Kendo ka yamb milambo kudho to uwacho ni oro biro to kamano e kaka timore.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

kikuyu: Gima ungʼeyo, an bende angʼeyo; kik upar ni afuwo.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

kikuyu: Kechuru joma riwo gi kiawa,
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

kikuyu: Daudi chunye nochandore bangʼ kane osekwano jolweny, mi nowachone Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Asetimo richo maduongʼ kuom gima asetimoni. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, akwayi mondo igol richoni kuom jatichni, nimar asetimo gima ofuwo.”
english: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “To ne awinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye ma atimo dwarone kendo atimo tich mane omiya mondo atim. Ne anego jo-Amalek pep kendo ne akawo Agag ruodhgi mi abirogo.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed the LORD’s voice, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

kikuyu: To kuom mamoko mag loch Nadab kaachiel gi timbene duto donge ondiki e kitepe mag ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Ne ok anyal winjo kendo timo weche jopuonjna, kata chiko ita ni jopuonjna.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kikuyu: Ka uchokoru e nying Ruodhwa Yesu, kendo an kodu kuom chuny, kendo teko mar Ruodhwa Yesu bende ni kodu,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, angʼo momiyo wachandore e yoregi kendo chunywa pek ma ok wanyal chiwo luor ne in? Yie iduog irwa nikech wan jotichni, oganda ma gin girkeni mari.
english: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

kikuyu: Mad iriembgi gi dhi mabor, mana kaka yamo riembo iro tero mabor; mad joma timbegi richo lal nono e nyim Nyasaye mana kaka odok leny kowinjo mach.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

kikuyu: Kik ibed ngʼatno matimo singruok kata machungʼ ne ngʼato e gope;
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

kikuyu: Mukuru kendegi mag misango, touro kitegi ma gilamo kendo wangʼuru sirni mag-gi mag Ashera e mach; ngʼaduru matindo tindo kido mag nyisechegi kendo ugol nying-gi oko kuonde duto.
english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nopenje niya, “Chike mage?” Yesu nodwoko ni, “ ‘Kik ineki, kik iterri, kik ikwal, kik ihang wach,
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

kikuyu: Ewi godni obiro walo law moumo wangʼ ji duto, law mogengʼo ogendini duto;
english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

kikuyu: Ne awinjo gima chalo gi dwol e dier gik mangima angʼwen-go kawacho niya, “Koro gorogoro mar ngano ibiro ngʼiew gi nengo maromre gi chudo michulo jatich e odiechiengʼ achiel kendo gorogoro adek mar shairi bende chal gi chudono, to nengo mo zeituni gi divai kik medi.”
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

kikuyu: Kendo ma e singruokna kodgi, ka anagol richogi.”
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

kikuyu: En emomiyo mil polo menyo kor polo duto, chakre tungʼ piny konchiel nyaka komachielo.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone Itai ja-Giti niya, “Angʼo momiyo idhi kodwa? Dogi mondo ibed gi Ruoth Abisalom. In ngʼama wendo, moringo koa e pinygi.
english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

kikuyu: Anaor ji moa e pinje mamoko Babulon mondo odhi opiedhe ka miudhwe kendo mondo oketh pinye; ginikwede e yo mora amora e odiechienge mar masira.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

kikuyu: Odhiambono, ka piny noseyuso, ji nokelo ne Yesu jotuo duto kaachiel gi joma nigi jochiende.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

kikuyu: to Ram ne en wuon Aminadab. Aminadab ne en wuon Nashon, Nashon ne en wuon Salmon,
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

kikuyu: Yawuot Isakar ne gin: Tola, Pua, Jashub kod Shimron.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

kikuyu: Jerusalem yiengni, bende Juda mukore; wechegi kod timbegi opogore gi dwach Jehova Nyasaye, nimar ok omi duongʼne nenre e diergi.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

kikuyu: Eka jomariek duto mag ruoth nodonjo e ot, to ne ok ginyal somo ndikono kata nyiso ruoth tiende.
english: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼno, Jehova Nyasaye notingʼo Joshua malo e nyim jo-Israel, mi gimiye luor ndalo duto mag ngimane, mana kaka negimiyo Musa luor.
english: On that day, the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo luto lwete malal ei tawo; kendo ok onyal gole oko moduoge e dhoge!
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

kikuyu: lewni mayom gi kode gi mifuke mag lwedo,
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ma en Nyasachi machwako joge e bura wacho, Ne, asegolo oko e lweti kikombe mane miyo ithembo, bende ok inichak imethi e kikombe mar mirimba kendo.
english: Your Lord GOD, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.

kikuyu: Jo-dalano nowachone Joash niya, “Gol wuodi oko. Nyaka otho nikech oseketho kendo mar misango mar Baal kendo ongʼado yiend Ashera man bute.”
english: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼiyo wuowino mohere, eka owachone niya, “Gimoro achiel ema iremo. Wuogi idhi ilok mwanduni duto ma in-go pesa mondo ipog joma odhier, eka inibed gi mwandu mokan e polo. Bangʼ timo kamano to bi mondo iluwa.”
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata mohulo ni ongʼeya e nyim ji, an bende abiro hulo ni angʼeye e nyim Wuora manie polo.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ikwero joma ochayo ji, ma gin joma okwongʼ, kendo gin joma osebaro oweyo chikeni.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Dhi e puothege mag mzabibu kendo ichadhgi, to kik ikethgi chuth. Lwer bedene, nimar jogi ok gin mek Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not the LORD’s.

kikuyu: gibet e dier liete joma otho otieno duto ka, gipondo kuonde mobuto, gichamo ring anguro, kendo agulnigi otingʼo chiemo moko makwero;
english: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

kikuyu: Nooro mudho mi nomiyo piny olil nimar donge ne gisengʼanyo ne wechene?
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

kikuyu: Eka ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi e chandruokgino mi noresogi e pekgino.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: nyikwa Elam, ji alufu achiel mia ariyo gi piero abich gangʼwen (1,254),
english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

kikuyu: To Josef nowachonegi niya, “Kik ubed maluor. An dakaw kar Nyasaye?
english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

kikuyu: Donge nodonjo e od Nyasaye, kendo nokawo makati ma nosepwodhi moket tenge ma chik ok oyiene ngʼato angʼata mondo ocham makmana jodolo. Kendo nochiwo moko ne jogo mane ni kode.”
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noloyo jo-Juda kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato noringo kochomo dalane.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.

kikuyu: Nikech isewinjo singruokna kodi, yaye Nyasaye; isemiya gweth mikano ne joma oluoro nyingi.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

kikuyu: Eka Hamor ma wuon Shekem nodhi mowuoyo gi Jakobo.
english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

kikuyu: Kaachiel gi timbeu mamono mamoko duto, ne ukelo ogendini mamoko ma ok oter nyangu gie chunygi gi ringregi nyaka ei kara maler mar lemo, mine udwanyo hekaluna kane uchiwona chiemo gi boche kod remo, kendo ne uketho singruokna kodu.
english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

kikuyu: Gokinyi ka joma ni e dalano nochiewo, negiyudo ka kar wangʼo misango mar Baal omuki, ka yiend Ashera mane ni bute bende ongʼadi kendo ka rwath mar ariyo ochiw ka misango e kendo mar misango mane oger manyien!
english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

kikuyu: mane obiro mondo giwinje kendo ochang midekregi. Jogo mane jochiende thago nochangi,
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

kikuyu: Koro yie mondo remba kik oo piny kuma bor gi kama Jehova Nyasaye nitie. Ruodh Israel osewuok mondo odwar kikun mana kaka ngʼato dwaro winyo e gode.”
