english: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of the LORD; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anatiek sunga mar Juda kod sunga malich mar Jerusalem mana e yo machalre kamano.
english: “The LORD says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo itamoe ler, kendo lwetegi ma gitingʼo malo jony ma ok nyal timo gimoro.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

kikuyu: To kapo ni otimo kamano, to ochune ni nyaka osik maonge dichwo, to ka ok kamano to odog ir chwore, kendo dichwo bende kik riemb chiege.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo wuode dhoot achiel mondo Daudi jatichna obed gi taya e nyima ndalo duto e Jerusalem, dala maduongʼ mane ayiero mondo aketie Nyinga.
english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata manolos mo machal kamano kata manowir ngʼato angʼata ma ok jadolo nongʼad kare oko.’ ”
english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye mantie e diergi, to en ngʼat makare, ok otim gimoro amora marach. Okinyi ka okinyi to ongʼado bura gi adier, kendo odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ ok rem, to kata kamano, jaricho to onge wichkuot.
english: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom joketho mane ogur kanyo nodhuole gi ayany kowacho niya, “Donge in Kristo? Resri iwuon koda wan!”
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma holo ji pesane ma ok odwaro ni odwokne gi gimoro e wiye kendo ma ok yie kaw asoya kuom joma onge ketho. Ngʼat matimo gik makamagi gimoro amora ok nyal yiengo.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

kikuyu: To wabiro timo kamano, ka Nyasaye oyie.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

kikuyu: To kiwuotho e yorena kendo rito buchena kod chikena kaka Daudi wuonu notimo bende anamiyi idak amingʼa.”
english: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata ma okwongʼo wuon kata min nyaka negi.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Puonjuru nyithindu wechegi, ka uwuoyo kuomgi ka ubet e dala, ka uwuotho e yo, ka unindo kata ka uchiewo.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

kikuyu: Jowetena, kaka un joma oyie kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo ma en Ruodh duongʼ, kik udew wangʼ ji.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

kikuyu: Nadab gi Abihu ma yawuot Harun nokawo tewnigi mag mach mi giketoe mach, kendo ne gioloe ubani, kendo ne gimoko makwero e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma chik Jehova Nyasaye ok oyie.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.

kikuyu: Kane gia Atalia, negikwangʼ mi gidok Antiokia, kuma ne giyudo e pwoch kuom tich maber mane gisetimo kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

kikuyu: Ka uchiegni chako lweny, jadolo nosud nyime mondo owuo gi jolweny.
english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

kikuyu: Kik ijwangʼ michni mane omiyi kaka nokor kuomi chiengʼ mane jodongo oketo lwetgi kuomi.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

kikuyu: Ka okudhogi gi muche to giner mi kalausi dhi kodgi ka mihudhwe, nikech gichalo gi kodhi mokom machiegni, ma tiendgi pok ochwowo lowo.
english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

kikuyu: Ka Daudi nochopo Ziklag nooro joote gi gik mope ne jodong Juda mosiepene, kowacho niya, “Ero aoronu mich kuom gik mope mag jowasik Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nowachone Jona niya, “Bende in gi ratiro mar kecho nikech otanglo?” To nodwoko niya, “Ee, ber ka akecho, kendo iya owangʼ ahinya, monego atho.”
english: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”

kikuyu: Wenwa richowa, kaka wan bende waweyone joma timonwa marach.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

kikuyu: Unuwinj kuom pinje magore koni gi koni kod humbe mag lwenje, to neuru ni kik kibaji gou. Gik ma kamago nyaka timre, to giko piny to pod ni nyime.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo yie asoya kama opondo mondo oketh gima kare.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

kikuyu: Eka iniwach ni Farao kama, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Israel e wuoda makayo,
english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘The LORD says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

kikuyu: nyikwa Adonikam, mago mogik, nyingegi ne Elifelet, Jeuel kod Shemaya, kaachiel kodgi ji piero auchiel;
english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

kikuyu: Omiyo mano e gima ne jo-Benjamin notimo. Ka nyirigo ne miel, ngʼato ka ngʼato nomako nyako achiel kuom nyirigo moloko chiege modhigo dala. Bangʼe negidwogo e lopgi mi gigero mier kanyo midakie.
english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

kikuyu: Ok oyieni mondo iterri gi nyamin mamau, nikech mano en tim maketho wat. Joma timo timbegi nyaka migi kum.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

kikuyu: Geno mar joma kare en mor, to geno mar joricho nolal nono.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Kendo ne achiwo Gilead ne Makir.
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

kikuyu: Ndalowa en piero abiriyo kata piero aboro, ka ringrewa otegno; to kata kamano ndalogo duto opongʼ gi chandruok kod kuyo, nimar gikalo piyo, kendo gilal nono.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

kikuyu: Kar kogwen negiwuok ma gidhi e kambi jo-Aram. Kane gichopo e dho kambi, kata mana ngʼat achiel ne onge kanyo,
english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okelone Jehova Nyasaye misango mar lalruok mar dhiangʼ kata rombo mondo ochopgo singruokne, kata obed ni en chiwo mar hera, to nyaka obed chiayo maler maonge songa eka Jehova Nyasaye noyie kode.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, ka piny moro otimona richo kuom bedo joma ok jo-ratiro kendo; ka arieyo bada kuomgi mi angʼado oko chiembgi mapile, mi aoro kech kuomgi kendo anego joge kaachiel gi jambgi,
english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

kikuyu: Kowacho niya, “Ndik gik moko duto mineno e kitabu kendo orgi ne kanise abiriyogi: Efeso, gi Smurna, gi Pergamo, gi Thuatira, gi Sarde gi Filadelfia kod Laodikia.”
english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

kikuyu: Kik uchwer remo moro amora, witeuru e bugo manie thim kaeni, to kik uket lwetu kuome.” Reuben nowacho mondo ores Josef kendo odwoke ir wuon-gi.
english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

kikuyu: Ne oweyo bende Obed-Edom kod jowetene piero auchiel gaboro mondo joti kodgi. Obed-Edom wuod Jeduthun to gi Hosa bende ne jorit rangeye.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

kikuyu: joka Isakar mane obedo gi rieko kuom gima timore kendo nongʼeyo gima jo-Israel onego otim ne nigi jotelo mia ariyo (200) koriw gi anywolagi mane gitelonegi;
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka Yesu noseywak kendo matek gi dwol maduongʼ, chunye nochot.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

kikuyu: Nikech owuoyo kuom odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo kamachielo kowacho niya, “To e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo Nyasaye noyweyo kuom tijene duto.”
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

kikuyu: Nobedo e loch kuom higni piero ariyo gariyo bangʼe to noyweyo gi kwerene. Kendo Nabad wuode nokawo lochne.
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek negiyude ei agolni mag hekalu, kobedo e kind jopuonj, kowinjogi kendo penjogi penjo.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

kikuyu: Kendo jo-Amor noramo ni nyaka gidag e Got Heres, Aijalon kod Shalbim, to ka teko mar od Josef nomedore, gin bende nolokgi wasumbini.
english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Chunya gombi gotieno kendo chunya dwari gokinyi. Ka buchi makare biro e piny, ogendini mag piny puonjore yo makare.
english: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato ochiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye puodho mosengʼiewo, ma ok en lop anywola,
english: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

kikuyu: Kane gisechoko owetegi mi gipwodhore eka negidonjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo gipwodhe kaka ruoth nochiko kaluwore gi wach mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by the LORD’s words, to cleanse the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, koro ok un welo kata jodak, to un oganda achiel gi jomaler duto, kendo jood Nyasaye,
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

kikuyu: kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Ne omiya gorogoro auchiel mag shairi kowacho ni, ‘Kik idog ir wuon odu gi lweti nono!’ ”
english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”

kikuyu: kendo ka honono kod ranyisino ma ohulo otimore bangʼe owacho niya, “We walu nyiseche mamokogi (ma gin nyiseche ma ok ungʼeyo) kendo ka owacho ni we walamgi,”
english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

kikuyu: kendo ka owachona niya, “Modhi, kendo abiro omo pi nyaka ne ngamia-gi bende,” to en ema mondo obed nyako ma Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero ne wuod ruodha.’
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.’

kikuyu: Joma riek norieny ka ler mar polo, kendo jogo mane opuonjo ji mangʼeny mondo otim gik makare norieny ka sulwe nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ingʼeya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; inena kendo ipimo pacha kaka aparo kuomi. Ywagi tenge kaka rombo mitero kar yengʼo! Ketgi tenge ne odiechieng yengʼo!
english: But you, LORD, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

kikuyu: Jaduongʼ kanisa nyaka bed ngʼat ma wach moro amora marach onge kuome, kendo ngʼatno man-gi dhako achiel, ngʼat ma nyithinde oyie kendo ma ok nyal kwan kaka nyithindo maricho kendo ma wigi tek.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon nodhi Hamath Zoba mokawe.
english: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne ariwora gi chiega ma janabi madhako kendo ne omako ich mi onywolo wuowi kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Chake wuowino ni Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

kikuyu: Ngʼatno notingʼo wiye, mongʼicho bangʼe owacho ni Yesu niya, “Aneno ji, ka gichalo gi yiende mawuotho koni gi koni.”
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nodwoke kama:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mutimo, to timuru ma ok ungʼur kata mino wach,
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

kikuyu: Ludh loch mar joma timbegi richo ok bi siko korito piny mopog ne joma kare, nimar ka mano otimore to joma kare nyalo tiyo gi lwetgi kuom timo marach.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

kikuyu: Tero ngʼato nyangu nigi ohala mana ka omako Chik, to ka oketho Chik to ochalo ngʼat mane ok oter nyangu.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Kinyne ne wakwangʼ ka waa kanyo mi watundo machiegni Kios. To chiengʼ machielo ne wangʼado nam nyaka Samos, to bangʼe ne wachopo Mileto.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

kikuyu: Nyaka wakaw wuodh ndalo adek e thim mondo wachiw misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa mana kaka ochikowa.”
english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”

kikuyu: Joma oketo genogi kuom mwandu kendo masungore kuom mwandugi mathoth?
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

kikuyu: Omiyo kik uchik itu ne jonabi magu, jokor wach magu, joloknu lek, jo-nyakalondo kata ajuoke magu manyisou ni ok unutine ruodh Babulon.
english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”

kikuyu: To moro ka moro kuomgi nowach mana ni, ‘An ok an janabi. An mana japur, kendo asebedo ka ayudo chiemba kowuok e lowo chakre aa e tin-na.’
english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

kikuyu: To koro gin rotenge moloyo oyare ma kata irom kodgi e wangʼ yore to ok nyal ngʼegi, nimar pien ringregi osejowore kuom chokegi; kendo osebedo motwo ka yien.
english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ber ne jogo ma genogi ni kuome, kendo ne ngʼatno madware,
english: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

kikuyu: Negitugo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye chiengʼno mi nokwongʼore kama:
english: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

kikuyu: kendo mane ogonyowa e lwet wasikwa, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: “Bangʼe, anaol Roho Maler mara kuom ji duto. Yawuotu gi nyiu nokor wach, jodongu nolek lek, jou matindo none fweny.
english: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.

kikuyu: Aseketoni kar romb odiechiengʼ marom gi higni magisetimoe richo. Omiyo ibiro tingʼo richo mag dhood Israel kuom ndalo 390.
english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Nikech ka alamo gi dhok mayoreyore, to chunya ema alamogo, to pacha ok ti.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye ma dolo yiend bungu miyo mwanda nywol kendo omiyo yiend bungu dongʼ kolwerore. Ji duto kok ei hekalu mare kagiwacho niya, “Duongʼ odog ni Jehova Nyasaye!”
english: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

kikuyu: To kata kamano Manase nochwero remb joma onge ketho mi remb jogo nopongʼo Jerusalem duto, kiweyo richo mane omiyo jo-Juda otimo, mine gitimo richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Musa noweyo Farao mi olamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD.

kikuyu: Noresowa mondo gweth mane Nyasaye omiyo Ibrahim ochop ni joma ok jo-Yahudi kuom Kristo Yesu, mondo kuom yie wan duto wanwangʼ singo mar Nyasaye, ma en Roho Maler.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye noluok richo mag mond Sayun; kendo enopwodh remo manochwer Jerusalem gi roho mar ngʼado bura kod roho mar mach.
english: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

kikuyu: Kibaji nogogi malich, rem gi kuyo bende noneg-gi; ginibed gi rem mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nongʼi wadgi malich ka midhiero omako.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

kikuyu: Ka osepwodhore, to nyaka orit kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

kikuyu: “Eka ubiro wacho ni, ‘Ne wachiemo kendo metho kodi, bende ne ipuonjoe yorewa mag dala.’
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

kikuyu: Jotij hekalu kod nyikwa jotij Solomon ji mia adek gi piero ochiko gariyo (392).
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

kikuyu: Kane giluongo ruoth, to Eliakim wuod Hilkia jatend od ruoth, Shebna jagoro kendo Joa wuod Asaf mane jachan weche nodhi irgi.
english: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

kikuyu: to koro ere kaka dodew dhano molos gi lowo, ma mise mag-gi en mana buru, ma inyalo duny marum mana ka oguyo!
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro miyou janabi machal koda kowuok e dier ogandau, kendo un bende nyaka uwinj gimoro amora mowachonu.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

kikuyu: Omiyo nangʼiewo kamba, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochika, mi atweye e nungona.
english: So I bought a belt according to the LORD’s word, and put it on my waist.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Libna mi gibworo Risa.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

kikuyu: Filipo ne nigi nyiri angʼwen mapok okendi mane gin johul wach.
english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

kikuyu: E sa ma ne otieko chiwo misangono, Samuel nochopo kendo Saulo nodhi mondo omose.
english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

kikuyu: Kedemoth kod Mefath kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath;
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: “Un e ler mar piny. Dala matin moger ewi thur ok nyal pandi.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: “Ka un gi winjo adier to winjuru wachni; kendo chikuru itu ne gima awacho.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

kikuyu: Ka le dik kendo lewe ok opiagi, to nyaka oti kode gi teko mathoth eka obar yien, kuom mano chan gik moko chon kapod ok itimo.
english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

kikuyu: Onge sibuor manoyud kuno kata mana ondieg bungu mager manade, ok nosud machiegni kanyo. To mana joma Nyasaye osewaro ema nowuothie,
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

kikuyu: Lek mathoth kod weche mangʼeny duto onge tiendgi. Kuom mano chungʼ motegno kiluoro Nyasaye.”
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

kikuyu: Jotend mier mane ni e dier nyikwa Lawi nyaka e ndalo mar Johanan wuod Eliashib nondik nying-gi e kitap weche mag ndalo.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

kikuyu: Pinygi opongʼ gi fedha kod dhahabu; kendo mwandugi okadho akwana. Pinygi opongʼ kod farese; ngechegi mag lweny okadho akwana.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼatno ma Jehova Nyasaye ok nokwan-ne richone.”
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

kikuyu: Parieuru ndalo mokwongo mane uyudo ler mar Nyasaye. E kindeno nunyono piny motegno kukedo matek e dier sand mathoth.
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne osetimo mano ne nyikwa Esau, mane odak Seir, e kinde mane otieko jo-Hori ka gineno. Negiriembogi oko kendo gidak kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

kikuyu: Ne ok odwar mondo ngʼato onyise wach moro kuom dhano wadgi nimar nongʼeyo gik manie chuny dhano.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

kikuyu: Kane jotich osetingʼe motere ir min mare, wuowino nonindo e tie min nyaka odiechiengʼ tir, eka notho.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

kikuyu: ma gin jogo mane omi piny kendgi giwegi kinde mane onge jopinje mamoko mane kadho e diergi.
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

kikuyu: Gikadho piyo mana ka yiedhi molos gi oundho maringo e nam, kendo ka ongoe mafuyo e kor polo karango piny mondo omak nyagweno.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

kikuyu: Beth Gilgal, kod e gwengʼ Geba gi Azmaveth, nimar jower nosegero miechgi giwegi machiegni gi Jerusalem.
english: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

kikuyu: gi ruodhi kaachiel gi jongʼad rieko mag piny, mane ogero kuondegi madongo mag dak matinde olokore gundni,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

kikuyu: Kuom higni apar gariyo negisebedo e bwo loch Kedorlaomer, to e higa mar apar gadek ne gingʼanyo.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi, kane oringo oa ir wuode Abisalom. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mano kaka wasika thoth! Mano kaka joma lawa ngʼeny!
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Osewenu richou mi koro udoko wasumbini ni tim makare.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano, to akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ma Nyasach Israel, mosegengʼa mondo kik ahinyi, ka dine ok ibiro piyo mondo iromna, to dine ok odongʼ dichwo moro amora ka Nabal.”
english: For indeed, as the LORD the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

kikuyu: kendo ngʼato angʼata madwaro bedo ngʼat mokwongo nyaka bed misumbau,
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

kikuyu: ma gin nyithindo mane ok onywol koa e koth dhano, kata kuom pach dhano, kata kuom dwach dichwo, to nonywolgi kuom Nyasaye.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

kikuyu: Petro kaachiel gi jowadgi ne nindo oingo ahinya, to kane gichiewo maber, negineno duongʼne kod ji ariyo kochungo kode.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ni kanisa.”
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

kikuyu: Nokulore mongʼicho, kendo noneno lewni mayom molir olir kod law ik ma nonalgo wi Yesu kani ei bur kanyo. To kata kamano, ne ok odonjo e iye.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

kikuyu: Anatimnu ngʼwono mondo omi en bende ongʼwonnu kendo odwoku e pinyu.’
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

kikuyu: Ne atiyo ni Ruoth gi chuny mamuol, kendo gi pi wangʼ, kata obedo ni naneno masiche madongo ka jo-Yahudi chano mondo ohinya.
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni tiengʼni ok norum ngangʼ kapok gigi duto otimore.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Lew ngʼat mofuwo kelone dhawo, to dhoge luongo goch.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

kikuyu: kendo nyaka ipuonj jo-Israel chike duto mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyogi koa e dho Musa.
english: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”

kikuyu: Ji duto modak e piny noikgi, kendo odiechiengʼ ma anayudie duongʼ nobed odiechiengʼ ma giparo kinde duto, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye e chakruok mar ngʼeyo to joma ofuwo chayo rieko gi ritruok makare.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

kikuyu: Nimar ne ok uyudo Roho mamiyo udoko wasumbini mamiyo ubedo maluor kendo, to ne uyudo Roho maketou ubedo nyithind Nyasaye, momiyo uywakne Nyasaye kuluonge niya, “Abba, Wuora!”
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

kikuyu: Pile kane gisechako wuoth gi Sandug Muma, Musa ne wacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, aa malo! Mad wasiki okee; kendo jomamon kodi oringi oa e nyimi!”
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

kikuyu: Nyaka urit chikena kendo luwuru yorena, nikech an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo gik mawacho ok nyal donjonu kendo ok unyal winjo tiendgi?
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

kikuyu: ‘Ne akeyogi ka kalausi e kind ogendini ma ok gingʼeyo. Piny mane giweyo nolokore gunda bangʼ-gi mane onge ngʼama kadhe kata dhiye. Kamano e kaka negimiyo piny majaberno olokore gunda.’ ”
english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

kikuyu: Eka Zedekia wuod Kenana noa malo mopamo lemb Mikaya. Nopenje niya, “En yo mane ma Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye noluwo kobiro wuoyo kodi?”
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

kikuyu: Bende Josia notieko jomeny, jo-nyakalondo, nyiseche manono mag udi gi kido milamo kaachiel gi gik moko duto mamono mane oyud Juda kod Jerusalem. Ma ne otimo mondo ochop chik mondiki e kitabu mane Hilkia jadolo ofwenyo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Ooyo, wawuoyo kuom rieko mopondo mar Nyasaye, ma en rieko mosebedo kopandi kendo mane Nyasaye oikonwa nyaka aa chakruok piny mondo wayud duongʼ.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

kikuyu: Miye pak moromo kode mondo onwangʼ kendo we mondo tijene okelne pak e dhorangach mar dala maduongʼ.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-miriambo ok notony ma ok okume, to ngʼatno malando miriambo biro lal nono.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

kikuyu: Paro miparogo ngʼat makare nobed gweth, to nying ngʼat marach nolal.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

kikuyu: Ka tuono olandore e dende duto, kaka jadolo nene, kendo ka tuono olandore e dende duto chakre e wiye nyaka tiende,
english: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

kikuyu: “ ‘Asingora adier ni abiro rieyo bada mi akumu kuom ohala museyudo e yo ma ok kare, kendo kuom remo musechwero e dieru.
english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.

kikuyu: kendo jo-Samaria duto, jomatindo gi jomadongo, noyie kode. Negiluwo bangʼe ka gikok niya, “Ngʼatni nigi teko Nyasaye miluongo ni Teko Maduongʼ.”
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

kikuyu: Osemaya kwe; kendo wiya osewil kod mor ma yande an godo.
english: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

kikuyu: Eka uluong nying nyasachu kendo an bende abiro luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye. Nyasaye modwoko gi mach en e Nyasaye madier.” Eka ji duto nowacho niya, “Gima iwachono ber.”
english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni un uwegi un e hekalu mar Nyasaye, kendo ni Roho mar Nyasaye odak eiu?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

kikuyu: Mier matindo duto mane opog ni anywola jo-Merari mane gin jo-Lawi modongʼ, ne gin apar gariyo.
english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo gi jodongwa nochiwe mondo ongʼadne buch tho, kendo negigure;
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

kikuyu: Eka faras machielo ma silwal nobiro. Ngʼat moidhe ne omi teko mondo ogol kwe e piny, mondo ji onegre kendgi. Ngʼatno nomi ligangla maduongʼ!
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

kikuyu: Ka ruoth Daudi nochimo Bahurim, ngʼat moro moa e dhoodgi Saulo nobiro koa kuno. Nyinge ne Shimei wuod Gera, nowuok kowacho weche mag kwongʼ.
english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

kikuyu: Ji mathoth noluw kit ngimagi mag anjawo makelo wichkuot, kendo ginimi ji nocha yo mar adiera.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

kikuyu: to mo moko to nokir nyadibiriyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi lith lwete ma korachwich.
english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar mar mogo mayom moru gi mo; im to chiw gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo abiriyo mar mogo mayom moru gi mo;
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

kikuyu: Bende par, ni nitie Shimei wuod Gera, ja-Benjamin moa Bahurim mane okwongʼa malit kane adhi Mahanaim. Kane obiro romona e dho Jordan, ne akwongʼorane gi nying Jehova Nyasaye niya, Ok ananegi gi ligangla.
english: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

kikuyu: Biuru mondo wanege kendo wawite e bungu moro achiel kendo wawach ni le moro mager nyonege. Eka mondo wane gima lekne biro timone.”
english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osetieko timo misango miwangʼo pep gi misengini mag lalruok, nogwedho ji e nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: To dhako moro modhier ma chwore notho nobiro moketo pesa mamingli ariyo matindo tindo, pesa matinie mogik ma en ndururu.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mondo ongʼad bura ne ogendini. Ngʼadna bura, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kaluwore gi ngimana makare, ngʼadna bura, yaye Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, kaluwore gi ngimana moriere tir.
english: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

kikuyu: Nowacho ni: “Adwaro nyisi gigo mabiro timore e kinde mag masiche, nikech fweny mosenyisini nyiso gik mabiro timore e ndalo giko.
english: He said, “Behold, I will make you know what will be in the latter time of the indignation, for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.

kikuyu: “An e jakwath maber. Jakwath maber chiwo ngimane ne rombe.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

kikuyu: To ewi gima opedhore mane ni e wigino ne nitie gimoro machalo gi kom duongʼ molosi gi kidi ma nengone tek miluongo ni safir, kendo malo kanyo e kom duongʼno, gimoro nobetie machalo dhano.
english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

kikuyu: Heruru Jehova Nyasaye un joge maler duto! Jehova Nyasaye rito ngima joma jo-adiera, to josunga to ochulo moromo chuth.
english: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehoram nodhi kuno gi jotende kod gechene duto mag lweny. Jo-Edom nolwore kaachiel gi jotend gechene mag lweny, to nochiewo gotieno momwomogi.
english: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Beth Togarma nowilo kodi farese mag tich, gi farese mag lweny kod kenje ka giwilo gi gig-gi mag ohala.
english: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

kikuyu: E higa mar abiriyo Jehoyada nooro jotend lweny mag migepe mag ji mia achiel, jo-Kari kod jorit, mokelgi ire ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ne otimo singruok kodgi mi oketogi gikwongʼore e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Bangʼ mano nokelo wuod ruoth mondo gingʼeye.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into the LORD’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in the LORD’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

kikuyu: wuod Melea, wuod Mena, wuod Matatha, wuod Nathan, wuod Daudi,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jopiny Judea duto kod ji duto moa Jerusalem nowuok odhi ire. Ne gihulo richogi mi Johana nobatisogi e Aora Jordan.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, dhiuru ulos jopuonjre e ogendini duto, kubatisogi e nying Wuoro gi Wuowi kod Roho Maler,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aloko pacha mondo anon kendo awinj tiend rieko, kaachiel gi chenro mar gik moko, bangʼe to ne ayudo ni ngʼat mofuwo en jaricho kendo janeko.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

kikuyu: To ka ok uweyo ni ji richogi, to Wuonu manie polo bende ok nowenu richou.]”
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano negia malo kar kogwen ma giringo ka giweyo hembegi, farese kod punde. Negiweyo kambigi gi mwandu duto mondo gitony gires ngimagi.
english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

kikuyu: Kane ja-Farisai mane oluonge oneno ma, nowacho owuon niya, “Ka dine bed ni ngʼatni en janabi, to nine ongʼeyo ni ngʼat ma muleni en ngʼat machalo nade kendo ni en dhako machalo nade nikech en jaricho.”
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Negitimo singruok ni gibiro manyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi gi chunygi kod ngimagi duto.
english: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

kikuyu: Ngʼi mwandu mana matin nono, to bangʼe gidhi, nimar adiera gibiro bedo gi bwombe, kendo gifu gidhi e kor polo ka ongo.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

kikuyu: Musa nooro joote moa Kadesh ir ruodh Edom, kowacho kama: “Ma e gima owadu Israel wacho: Ingʼeyo tije matek duto ma wasebedo godo.
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

kikuyu: Nyisuru Arkipo kama: “Ne ni itieko tich Ruoth mane omiyi.”
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Lut nodhi mowuoyo gi chwo nyige mane osetimo winjruok mar kend gi nyige. Nowachonegi niya, “Timuru piyo piyo mondo uwuog oko e dalani, nikech Jehova Nyasaye oseikore mar ketho dala maduongʼni!” To chwo nyige ne paro ni otugo.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

kikuyu: to abiro kelonu koth e kinde mowinjore, kendo pinyu nochieg cham mi yiendeu nonyag olembe.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

kikuyu: Ginidongi mana ka lum man kama ngʼich kata ka omburi manie bath aore.
english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jingʼuru bedeu mobengore gi chongeu monyosore.
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

kikuyu: Nomiyo tiende gechegi owuok mine ok ginyal riembogi. Eka jo-Misri nowacho niya, “Waringuru waa kuom jo-Israel! Jehova Nyasaye ema kedonegi kod jo-Misri.”
english: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”

kikuyu: Sheba gi Dedan kod jo-ohala madongo mag Tarshish kaachiel gi sibuochegi madongo biro wachoni niya, “Mit ka isebiro mar ketho gik moko? Isechoko jolweny magi mondo iyeki; mondo itingʼ fedha gi dhahabu, kendo ikaw jamni gi gik moko idhigo kendo ikaw gik moyaki mathoth?” ’
english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’

kikuyu: Ok onego ibwogi kuom gima awacho ni, ‘Nyaka nywoli nywol manyien.’
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

kikuyu: Kata Jehova Nyasaye miyou chiemo mar chandruok kod pi mar masira, to jopuonju ok nochak opondnu kendo, to ununegi gi wengeu uwegi.
english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nojiwo chuny Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel mane jatend piny Juda, chuny Joshua, kod chuny joma moko mane oa e twech. Negibiro kendo gichako tich e od Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasachgi,
english: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,

kikuyu: Eka noneno jo-Keni kendo ochiwo oteneni: “Kar dak mari nigi kwe, kari mar pondo ni e bwo lwanda;
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

kikuyu: Kuno joma timbegi richo weyoe timbegigo, kendo kuno joma ool yudoe yweyo.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth chiemo e mesane, mo mangʼwe ngʼar man-gi tik mamit nopongʼo ot kadonjo.
english: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

kikuyu: Zilpa jatich Lea nonywolo ne Jakobo wuowi mar ariyo.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

kikuyu: E sechego chi Samaria moro nobiro umbo pi, mi Yesu nowachone niya, “Yie imiya pi amodhi.”
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

kikuyu: Omiyo chan yien kendo imok mach. Ted ringʼono maber, kiriwe gi apilo; kendo ne ni chokegi otedore maber.
english: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.

kikuyu: Mana kaka winy mafuyo malo, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nochiel Jerusalem; nogengʼe kendo norese, noume kendo nokonye.
english: As birds hovering, so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

kikuyu: Mizraim ne en wuon jo-Lud, jo-Anam, jo-Lehab, jo-Naftu,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

kikuyu: Yaye, iya nyawni, iya nyawni! An gi rem malit. Yaye, lit mager mar chunya! Chunya ridore, ok nyal lingʼ thi. Nimar asewinjo koko mar turumbete; asewinjo ywak mar kedo.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, pod ok ikelowa e piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich kata miyowa girkeni mag puothe kod puothe mag mzabibu. Ubiro lodho wenge jogi oko? Ngangʼ, ok wanabi!”
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

kikuyu: Ket Urim gi Thumim bende kuom law akor mondo omi gibed kondikgi e agog Harun kinde duto ma odonjo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kuom mano kinde duto ma Harun ni e nyim Jehova Nyasaye notingʼ gir ngʼado bura ne jo-Israel e agoge.”
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi magiluongo jorit rangeye mag dala maduongʼ kendo giwachonegi niya, “Ne wadhi e kambi jo-Aram to ok wayudo kata ngʼato achiel kata dwond ngʼato ne ok wawinjo to mana farese motwe gi punde kod hembe mowe mana kaka ne gin.”
english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

kikuyu: Joab wuod Zeruya nochako kwano ji, to ne ok otieko. Kwenono nokelo mirimb Nyasaye kuom jo-Israel, omiyo ne ok ondik kwenono e kitap Weche mag Ndalo mag loch Ruoth Daudi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

kikuyu: Nyasaye gwedho ngʼat ma ok lu pach joma richo, kata luwo yor joricho kata bedo e kom jojaro.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

kikuyu: Enokaw remb rwadhno kendo okir gi lith lwete e bath raum mar misango koma ochomo yo wuok chiengʼ kendo okir remono nyadibiriyo gi lith lwete e nyim raum mar misango.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

kikuyu: Eka Elifaz ja-Teman nodwoko niya,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: Chiege ne nyinge Ahinoam nyar Ahimaz. Jatend jolweny ne Abner wuod Ner, Ner ne en owadgi wuon Saulo.
english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

kikuyu: Abiro goli e kari mar tich kendo goli e loch mari.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi chuny marach ok nyal dhi maber; ngʼat ma lewe riambo podho e chandruok.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

kikuyu: “Nyinga ma ongʼeyago en; Jehova Nyasaye! Ok anawe duongʼ mara ne nyasaye moro, bende pak ma ipakago ok nopakgo nyiseche mopa.
english: “I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

kikuyu: Sara nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osekelona mor kendo ji duto mowinjo ma biro bedo mamor koda.”
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

kikuyu: Wangʼa ojony nikech ywak, chunya ool, kendo chandore malit nikech joga osetieki, kendo nyithindo kod nyithindo mayom kech nego e yore mag dala maduongʼ.
english: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

kikuyu: Kata mana jodolo ma osudo ir Jehova Nyasaye nyaka pwodhre ka ok kamano to Jehova Nyasaye nomwomre kuomgi.”
english: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”

kikuyu: Nyithind Amram ne gin: Harun, Musa kod Miriam. Yawuot Harun ne gin: Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Ahero hekalu kama idakie, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kama duongʼni nitie.
english: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

kikuyu: “Wachne jo-Lawi kama: ‘Ka ichiwo mano maber, to ibiro kwane ne in kaka gima oa e kar dino cham kata kar biyo divai.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

kikuyu: Abiro olo Roho mara kuomu, mi aket ulu buchena kendo uket chunyu mar rito chikena.
english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

kikuyu: mondo eka ubed yawuot Wuonu manie polo. En omiyo chiengʼ mare wuok ni joma richo gi joma beyo machalre, kendo ooro koth ne joma kare gi joma ok kare.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

kikuyu: Kane Hezekia gi jodonge nobiro moneno pidhego negipako Jehova Nyasaye kendo negigwedho jo-Israel.
english: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD and his people Israel.

kikuyu: kendo rwedhi magwa biro ywayo misike mapek. Jokwoge ok nodonj e kundewa, bende ok noterwa e twech, kendo yoreyore ok nogo e gwengʼwa.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

kikuyu: Ngʼat marach chano timo timbe maricho, to wechene chalo mach mager.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

kikuyu: Mon osemak githuon e Sayun, to nyiri e miech Juda.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nodwoko min niya, “Angʼo momiyo ikwayo Abishag nyar Shunam ni Adonija? Inyalo anyala kata mana kwayone pinyruoth nimar en owadwa maduongʼ, bende inyalo kwaye ni Abiathar jadolo kod Joab wuod Zeruya!”
english: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”

kikuyu: Eka Amazia nochoko jo-Juda kod jo-Benjamin kaachiel mopogogi tich kaluwore gi anywolagi kendo noyiero jotend migepe mag jolweny alufu achiel kod migepe mag mia achiel. Bangʼe nokwano jogo mahikgi piero ariyo ka dhi nyime kendo nonwangʼo ni ne gin ji alufu mia adek mane nyalo dhi e lweny kendo mane nyalo kedo gi tongʼ kod okumba.
english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.

kikuyu: To bende mano ne ok otim maonge kwongʼruok! Jomoko nobedo jodolo maonge kwongʼruok,
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

kikuyu: “Angʼeyo maber gik ma uparo, angʼeyo gik muchano e chunyu mondo ukinyago.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyaka ichiw luor kichungone jaduongʼ ma wiye oti lwar kendo uluor Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Odhiambo gi okinyi kod odiechiengʼ aywagora ka chunya lit, kendo owinjo dwonda.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno, ka pinje duto mag piny ochokorene mar monje, anami Jerusalem bed lwanda mapek ma kata piny duto riwne to ok odhirre. Ji duto manotem dhire to nohinyre gin giwegi.
english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowuok modhi kendo nochako hulo e puothe bangʼ jokeyo. To nopo nono ni otiyo mana e puoth Boaz, mane wuok e anywola mar Elimelek.
english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

kikuyu: Tongʼ mar pinyno gi yo wuok chiengʼ noring e kind Hauran gi Damaski, koluwo ariwa mar Jordan, e kind Gilead gi piny Israel, nyaka nam man yo wuok chiengʼ, kendo nochopi nyaka Tamar. Ma ema nobed tongʼ man yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

kikuyu: Ahazia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gariyo kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higa achiel kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Athalia ma nyakwar Omri.
english: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

kikuyu: Kane Shaul otho, Baal-Hanan wuod Akbor nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

kikuyu: E kindeno jo-Misri nochal mana ka mon. Gibiro kirni ka luoro omakogi ka gineno kum maa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

kikuyu: nikech wan fuonde mag ringre.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka ayalo Injili, to ok onego asungra, nikech ochuna ni nyaka ayal. Mano kaka dibed malitna ka ok ayalo Injili!
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

kikuyu: “Kel Harun gi yawuote gi lepgi mag dolo, gi mor pwodhruok, gi rwadh misango mar golo richo gi imbe ariyo, kod odheru motingʼo makati ma ok oketie thowi,
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

kikuyu: Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode nodhi Eglon koa Lakish mi gimonje.
english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

kikuyu: Oganda mane ni kode chiengʼ mane oluongo Lazaro oa e liel, ka nochiere oa kuom joma otho, nomedo lando wachno.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

kikuyu: Polo malo mogik en mar Jehova Nyasaye, to piny to osechiwo ne dhano.
english: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye miyo joge teko; Jehova Nyasaye gwedho joge gi kwe.
english: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

kikuyu: Eka Petro mane oyudo opongʼ gi Roho Maler nowachonegi niya, “Jotelo gi jodongo mag oganda!
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

kikuyu: E kindeno nachiko jongʼad bura mau niya, Winjuru weche manie kind oweteu kendo ungʼad bura kare poni nitie bura e kind jo-Israel kendgi kata e kind ja-Israel kod japiny moro.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

kikuyu: Shalmaneser ruodh Asuria nokedo gi Hoshea moloye kendo nobedo e bwo lochne kogolone osuru.
english: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.

kikuyu: Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni en mosegura e kom loch mar Daudi wuora kendo mosesingo ni nyikwaya pinyruoth ni Adonija nyaka negi kawuono!”
english: Now therefore as the LORD lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

kikuyu: Mago mane oa kuom jodolo ne gin: nyikwa Hobaya, Hakoz kod Barzilai (ngʼatno mane okendo nyar Barzilai ma ja-Gilead to kendo ne iluonge gi nyingno).
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

kikuyu: Shalum wuod Jabesh nobedo ruoth e higa mar piero adek gochiko mar loch Uzia ruodh Juda, kendo nobedo ruoth Samaria kuom dwe achiel.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi nobet e mudho, kendo e tipo mar tho, ne gin joma thagore motwe gi nyoroche mag chuma,
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

kikuyu: “Ere ngʼama nokechi, yaye Jerusalem? Ere ngʼama biro ywagi? Ere ngʼama nochungʼ ma penji kaka idhi?”
english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?

kikuyu: Uwacho ni un gi rieko kod teko mangʼeny mar lweny, to gik ma uwacho onge tiendgi. En ngʼa ma uketo genou kuome, mamiyo ungʼanyo uweya?
english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ochiwe ka gir goyo erokamano, to ochiwe kaachiel gi makati ma ok oketie thowi moted gi mo, kod chapat ma ok oketie thowi mowir gi mo, gi kek moted gi mogo mayom kendo modwal gi mo.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

kikuyu: Eka ja-Israel moro nobiro gi nyar jo-Midian e hembe ka Musa neno kaachiel gi oganda jo-Israel duto mane oyudo ywak e dho Hemb Romo.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Fweny mag Obadia. Magi e weche ma Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kuom Edom. Wasewinjo wach; koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye. Jaote oseor ir ogendini mondo owach niya, “Chunguru, wadhi waked kode.”
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

kikuyu: Masira machal kamano bende nogo farese, nyithi punde, ngamia, punde, kaachiel gi le duto ma noyudre e kembnigo.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

kikuyu: Kaachiel gi Paulo gi Barnaba kod ji mamoko, ka gipuonjo kendo giyalo wach Ruoth.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji nowuok kendo negidwogo gi bede yien mi gigero kambi ewi tat utegi giwegi, e laru mag-gi, e laru mar od Nyasaye kod laru man but kama iluongo ni Dhoranga Pi, to machielo manie Dhoranga Efraim.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

kikuyu: Ka ok urito weche duto manie chikni ma ondiki e kitabuni kendo ka ok uchiwo luor ne nyinge man-gi teko ma en Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu,
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,

kikuyu: Omiyo bed motangʼ, ndalo biro, Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ma ji ok nochak oluonge ni Tofeth kata Holo mar Ben Hinom, to ni Holo mar Yengʼo, nimar giniyik joma otho ei Tofeth maonge thuolo modongʼ.
english: Therefore behold, the days come”, says the LORD, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

kikuyu: Ne gitemo Nyasaye kinde mangʼeny, kendo negimiyo Jal Maler mar Israel osin.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: To jokwath mag Gerar nolaro pig-no gi jokwadh Isaka kagiwacho niya, “Pigni en marwa.” Kuom mano Isaka nochako sokono ni Esek (tiende ni kar dhawo) nikech ne gilare kode
english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare dak gi osiepene e yo mowinjore, to yor ngʼat marach terogi kama rach.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

kikuyu: Misengini miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mag golo richo ne ok imorgo.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

kikuyu: To ruoth nodwoke niya, “Angʼo machandou koda un yawuot Zeruya? Ka okwongʼa nikech Jehova Nyasaye nowachone ni, ‘Kwongʼ Daudi,’ to en ngʼa madipenj ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo itimo kama?’ ”
english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because the LORD has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

kikuyu: Moko kuom jogo gin Humenayo gi Aleksanda, ma aseketo e lwet Satan mondo opuonjre ni kik giyany Nyasaye.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

kikuyu: Kaw kuodi gi okumbani; aa malo mondo ibi ikonya.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

kikuyu: Achiwonu pinyruoth, mana kaka Wuora bende nomiya moro,
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

kikuyu: Kik obed gi mon mathoth nikech mano dipoka oketho parone. Bende kik obed gi fedha kod dhahabu mangʼeny.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

kikuyu: To kata ka kama odholoreno ok olokore kendo ok olandore e del to oselal, en kama okuot moa kuom kama owangʼ, omiyo jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ler; nikech en mbala mowuok kama owangʼ.
english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

kikuyu: Eka iger kendo mar misango malongʼo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ewi kama otingʼore maloni mondo ichiw rwath mar ariyo kaka misango miwangʼo pep, kitiyo gi yiend Ashera mane ingʼado.”
english: Then build an altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

kikuyu: Koa kuom chiwo mar lalruok nyaka otimne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo gi mach ma gin: boche moimo jamb-ich, gi kuonde machiegni kode,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: Ka itimo kamano, ibiro choko chuk mach maliel e wiye, kendo Jehova Nyasaye biro miyi pok.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

kikuyu: Terreuru nyangu uwegi ni Jehova Nyasaye, teruru chunjeu nyangu, un jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem, ka ok kamano to mirimba biro muoch mi liel ka mach, nikech tim mamono ma usetimo manowangʼu, maonge ngʼama nyalo kweye.”
english: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

kikuyu: Ne abedo wangʼ muofni kendo tiende pudhe.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Nikech jo-Filistia nochulo kuor gi ich wangʼ ka gigoyo siboi e chunygi kendo ka giramo ni nyaka gitiek Juda nikech sigu machon ma ok rum,
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

kikuyu: Yaye mano kaka mwandu kendo rieko gi ngʼeyo mar Nyasaye tut miwuoro! Mano kaka buchene oyombo parowa, kendo yorene fwenyo tek!
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni wiwa nosewil gi Nyasachwa kata ni ne waseyaro lwetwa ne nyasaye moro ma wendo,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

kikuyu: “Kawuru mogo mayom kendo utedgo makati apar gariyo, ma moro ka moro oted gi mogo moromo kilo abiriyo.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Musa gi Harun nodhi ir Farao mi giwachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel wacho kama: ‘We joga odhi, mondo gilosna sawo e thim.’ ”
english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”

kikuyu: Yaye Israel, winjuru, uchiegni ngʼado Jordan ka udhi riembo oganda maduongʼ kendo maroteke moloyou, man-gi mier madongo ma ohingagi chopo nyaka e kor polo.
english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

kikuyu: kagiwacho niya, “Wabiro dok kodi thuru ir jou.”
english: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”

kikuyu: Ka nochopo seche mag odhiambo, ja-mwandu moro ma ja-Arimathaya, ma nyinge Josef nobiro. En bende noselokore japuonjre Yesu.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

kikuyu: Kendo Ibrahim nodak e piny jo-Filistia kuom kinde mangʼeny.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

kikuyu: En bende kane ojaro jo-Israel to Jonathan wuod Shimea ma owadgi Daudi nonege.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

kikuyu: In tho, koro ere lochni? In tho, lit mikelo ni kanye?
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

kikuyu: eka nopenjogi niya, “Kido man kuomeni en mar ngʼa? To ndikogi to gin mag ngʼa?”
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

kikuyu: To Shama nochungʼ kar tiende e dier puodhono. Norite monego jo-Filistia, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nokelo loch maduongʼ.
english: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.

kikuyu: Ihero tim makare to imon gi timbe maricho; emomiyo Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi, osetingʼi malo moyombo jowadu nikech osewiri gi mo mamiyi mor.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

kikuyu: Misangono ibiro chame e odiechiengno muchiwee kata kinyne, to ringʼo mane odongʼ nyaka chiengʼ mar adek nyaka wangʼ e mach.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Kane ogoyo lwanda to pi nothinyore oko kendo aore nochako mol mogundho. To chiemo bende domiwa adier? Ringʼo bende onyalo kelo mi opog ne joge adier?”
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

kikuyu: Oluongo jolweny mage moyiero, to gichwanyore ka gidhi. Giringo ka gidhi e ohinga mar dala; ka gigengʼore gi okumba.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

kikuyu: Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Kik ibed janeno e wach jabuti kaonge gima omiyo, kata tiyo gi dhogi mondo iriambi.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

kikuyu: Ne joma lal wadum tik mar tho, to ni joma iwaro to wadumnegi tik mar ngima. Koro en ngʼa mowinjore gi tich machal kamano?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

kikuyu: Kane chwo mane wan-go osekete ei yie maduongʼ mane wantie, negitweyo yie gi tonde molwore mondo kik obarre. To nikech negiluor ni yie ne nyalo terogi kuonde mathany-thany motimo kuoyo man e dho nam mar Afrika, ne giloro nanga mar yie mi giweye mondo yamo otere atera.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ji machwo kanyo ma dirom alufu abich. To nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Nyisgiuru gibed piny e migepe mag ji madirom piero abich, moro ka moro.”
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

kikuyu: Isaya nowacho niya, “Swag ngʼowu kendo iwirie kama bur okuodono, to obiro chango.”
english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

kikuyu: Napenjo niya, “Jogi obiro timo angʼo ka?” Nodwoko niya, “Magi e tunge mane okeyo jo-Juda mondo kik ngʼato angʼata kuomgi tingʼ wiye; to jothethgi osebiro mondo obwog-gi kendo gilo ogendini mane oikore kedo gi piny Juda.”
english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”

kikuyu: Dichwo ne ok oa kuom dhako, to dhako ema ne oa kuom dichwo.
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

kikuyu: Negiloso ratege ariyo mag dhahabu e bwo ndiri ka gimanyore ariyo koni gi koni mondo omak ludhe mitingʼego.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

kikuyu: to unuchame kuom dwe achiel, manyaka othingʼu mi ungʼogi nikech usedagi Jehova Nyasaye modak e kindu kendo useywak e nyima, kuwacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ne waa Misri?” ’ ”
english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

kikuyu: Kane pok ochwe piny, noyierowa kuom Kristo mondo wabed maler kendo maonge songa e nyime.
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka jangʼwech mapiem e ngʼwech ok nyal yudo mich mar jaloch ka ok oringo kaluwore gi chike moketi.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

kikuyu: Negikawo gik moko duto ma oyaki kod mane ope, kaachiel gi ji kod jamni,
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

kikuyu: Abishai owadgi Joab wuod Zeruya ne en thuon moloyo thuondi adekgo. Nokawo tongʼe monego ji mia adek, kendo nomiyo obedo gi huma mana kaka thuondi adek ka.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare chiwo kony ne gik ma jambe dwaro, to timbe mag ngʼwono mag ngʼat marach gin mana gero.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

kikuyu: Negichokore giduto mondo gibi giked gi Jerusalem kendo gimi ji obed gi luoro.
english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

kikuyu: To timbe mamoko mag loch Abija kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche mag ndalo mar ruodhi mag Juda? Ne nitie lweny e kind Abija kod Jeroboam.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka non-gi, kendo ka kidogo nenore marachar ma tangʼ-tangʼ, to en kama roch mawuok e del ma ok nyal hinyo ngʼato; kendo ngʼatno ler.
english: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nolokre ochom pinje manie dho nam, kendo nokaw thothgi, kata kamano jatend jolweny moro notiek achaya mochechogono, kendo nodwok achayagego e wiye owuon.
english: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

kikuyu: Koro ma e anywola joka Perez: Perez ne en wuon Hezron,
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,

kikuyu: Onge gima ochuno ni Nyasaye nyaka non dhano amingʼa eka okelgi e nyime mondo oyalgi.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nomi polo tetni, kendo piny noyiengni milengʼre; e chiengʼ onogo mar mirimbe mager.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

kikuyu: mondo jadolo onon ka ober kata ka orach. Nengo moro amora ma jadolo oketo ema nobed nengo chiayono.
english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

kikuyu: Inyalo yiko faras ne ndalo mar lweny; to loyo lweny en mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ok mor gi rapim ma ok nikare, to rapim makare ema omorgo.
english: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

kikuyu: Yawuot Shimei ne gin: Shelomoth, Haziel kod Haran, giduto ne gin ji adek. Magi ema ne jotend anywola mar Ladan.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

kikuyu: To kopogore gi wuon mare ma Manase ne ok obolore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nikech nomedo timo gik maricho.
english: He didn’t humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.

kikuyu: Joma kamago onego ngʼe ni weche ma andikonu e barupena ka aonge, ema bende abiro timo ka an kodu.
