english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

kikuyu: Nomiyo kodhi olokore pe kendo mil polo nokwako pinygi;
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

kikuyu: kata dhako manie kindeno mar neno malo kaachiel gi dichwo kata dhako machwer kod dichwo moriwore gi dhako mogak.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Aa malo! Kaw pieni mondo iwuothi.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo gik maricho lingʼ-lingʼ ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi. Chakre kuonde mingʼichogo gi malo nyaka kuonde mochiel motegno mag dala maduongʼ, negigero kuondegi motingʼore gi malo e miechgi duto.
english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the LORD their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

kikuyu: omiyo Ruoth nongʼad bura ni ji duto motamore yie adiera, ka gihero mana timo timbe maricho.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, kwongʼrenauru gi Jehova Nyasaye ni ubiro ngʼwonone jooda, nikech an bende asetimonu ngʼwono. Singrenauru
english: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

kikuyu: To gi weche moko mangʼeny Johana nojiwo ji kendo noyalo Injili ne ji.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

kikuyu: Ewi Sandug Muma ne nitie kido mag malaika miluongo ni kerubi mar Duongʼ, kendo bwombegi noumo kama igoloe richo. To sani ok wanyal wuoyo matut kuom gigo duto.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joab nogoyo tungʼ mi ji duto nobiro mochungʼ, ne ok gimedo lawo jo-Israel, kata lweny bende ok ne gidhiyogo nyime.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

kikuyu: Nitie batiso monego ayudi. To mano kaka chunya chandore nyaka chop otimre!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

kikuyu: Nyaka ipar mon ma chwogi otho modongʼ kendgi madwaro kony e yor adiera.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: “Angʼo ma jaherana timo e hekalu mara kochano timbe mamono gi ji mathoth? Bende ringʼo mowal tenge nyalo loko kum mari? Seche mitimo timbe marichogo, ema inie gi mor.”
english: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”

kikuyu: Eka Harun nokelo misango mane ji ochiwo. Nokawo nywok mane ibiro timgo misango mar golo richo ni oganda, noyangʼe kendo nopwodhogo richogi mana kaka notimo gi misango mokwongo.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik ni ji duto kama: “Losuru chokruok mar Pasaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mana kaka ondiki e Kitap Singruokni.”
english: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

kikuyu: Nolwoko jamb-ich kaachiel gi tielo kendo nowangʼogi kuom misango miwangʼo pep ewi kendo mar misango.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro oro mach mi wangʼ ohinga mag Turo mochiel motegno.”
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”

kikuyu: Ma e kaka onego iwal jo-Lawi e kind jo-Israel mamoko mondo obed maga.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne omiyogi gima negidwaro, to kata kamano nooronegi tuo machiyo del.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Kare ber ka koro uyie!
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

kikuyu: E kindeno Ruoth Herode nowinjo humb Yesu,
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aloso Sandug Muma gi yiend siala, mine apayo kite ariyo machal gi mane okwongo ka, eka ne adhi e got gi kite ariyogo katingʼo e lweta.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

kikuyu: Bangʼe to anadog kar dakna, nyaka chop kinde maginiyie ni giseketho. Giniduog ira ka gidwara gi chunygi duto nikech thagruok malit magiseyudo.”
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

kikuyu: Musa nokecho gi jotend lweny duto; mago mane otelo ne migawo mar lweny mar alufe alufe kod mag miche miche mane odwogo koa e lweny.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo miyo sulwe maratego mondo owuogi e kindene mowinjore kata chiko sulwe mar olworo budho yo monego oluw?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

kikuyu: Mad wengegi dinre mondo kik ginen, kendo oguchgi odolre nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano kaka lew mach wangʼo yugi kendo kaka lum motwo lal nono e mach, e kaka tiendgi notow bende maua mawuok e itgi nolwar mana ka buru, nikech gisedagi chik mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego kendo chayo wach Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼwasi motweyi matek kendo owiti e piny malach mana ka mipira mowiti. Kuno ema nithoe, kendo kuno ema gecheni mag lweny mabeyo nosikie in mikelo wichkuot ne od ruodhi.
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.

kikuyu: Ngʼat manyiso ngʼwono ne jochan, holo mana Jehova Nyasaye, obiro gwedhe kuom gik mosetimo.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Gik moa Misri gi gige ohala mag Kush, to gi jo-Sabea ma roboche nobi iri, kendo ginibed magi; ginilu bangʼi ka gibiro, ka moro ka moro otwe gi nyororo. Ginikulre e nyimi kendo ka gisayi, kagiwacho ni, ‘Adiera Nyasaye ni kodi, kendo onge moro amora; onge Nyasaye moro amora.’ ”
english: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

kikuyu: Ibiro biro ka ia e gwengʼi man tungʼ mar nyandwat, in kaachiel gi pinje mangʼeny ma jokori, ka giduto giidho farese, ka gin jolweny kendo maroteke.
english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

kikuyu: Judas nongʼiewo lowo gi pesa mane oyudo kuom richone, to kanyo ema noruomboree piny, kendo bund iye nobarore mi nyimbi iye opukore oko.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

kikuyu: Anaketu ubed wasumbini ne wasiku e piny ma ok ungʼeyo, nimar mirimba biro moko mach mabiro wangʼou.”
english: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

kikuyu: To ok mano kende; kwarwa Isaka nonywolo nyithindo ariyo gi Rebeka chiege.
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka non wuodhe owuon eka doyud gima dopakrego kuom tich maber mosetimo kik ipiem gi ngʼat machielo,
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno ranyisi machielo malich ahinya ei polo: Ne aneno Malaike abiriyo, motingʼo masiche abiriyo, mago ne masiche mogik nikech ka girumo to mirimb Nyasaye chopo kare.
english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

kikuyu: Weuru baro wiya gi wendeu mag pak, nikech ok adwar winjo thumbe mugoyogo.
english: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

kikuyu: Jo-Misri biro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye ka ayudo duongʼ kuom Farao gi gechene kod joidh faresene.”
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

kikuyu: Adaya, Beraya kod Shimrath ne gin yawuot Shimei.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

kikuyu: ma gin joma osechiwo ngimagi ni Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: To jo-Israel duto gi jo-Juda duto ne ohero Daudi nikech notelonegi e lwenjegi.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

kikuyu: To ere kaka ngʼato diyud pak ka uyudo chwat michwadougo nikech ujoketho? To ka isandou nikech tim maber ma utimo, kendo ka unano e bwo sand ma kamano, to Nyasaye pwoyou.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Harun niya, “Ok iniyud girkeni mora amora e piny jogi, kata pok moro amora ok inibedgo e kindgi nimar an e pok maru kendo girkeni maru e kind jo-Israel.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ok onego imodh pi kende, to madh divai matin mondo okonyni iyi nikech midekre ma in-go pile.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Nonuru timbeu.
english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

kikuyu: Tarik apar dwe mar abich e higa mar abiriyo, jodong Israel moko nobiro ira mondo openj wach kuom Jehova Nyasaye mine girito mondo giwinj tiend wachno.
english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.

kikuyu: to Paulo ne paro ni ne ok en gima ber mondo gidhi kode, nikech noseweyogi Pamfilia mi ok odhi kodgi nyime e tich.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

kikuyu: mowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Kunyuru buche mathoth e holoni.
english: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

kikuyu: Omiyo Lut noyiero pewe duto mag Jordan kendo nowuok kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Mano e kaka ji ariyogi nopogore.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

kikuyu: Kane giseyangʼo rwath ne gitero wuowino ir Eli.
english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

kikuyu: Osemiyowa nyalo mar bedo jotich mag singruok manyien, ma ok otenore kuom chik mondiki, to motenore kuom chuny, nikech chik kelo tho, to Roho to chiwo ngima.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

kikuyu: “Eka nyiri duto nochiew kendo negiiko techegi.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

kikuyu: to bangʼ yalo Injili Perga, negidhi mwalo nyaka Atalia.
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

kikuyu: Farao nopenjo owete Josef-go niya, “Utiyo angʼo?” Negidwoko Farao niya, “Jotichgi gin jokwath.”
english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Gik makamagi biro miyo ubed mogak, kendo ngʼato angʼata momulo ring chiayo motho kendeno nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Bebai: Jehohanan, Hanania, Zabai gi Athlai.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

kikuyu: Ogandano nochiko itgi kawinjo gik mane Paulo wacho, eka negichako kok giduto kagiwacho niya, “Neguru ngʼatni! Ok owinjore obed mangima!”
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

kikuyu: Emomiyo anachiw mondegi ne joma moko kendo puothegi ne jomanyien. Kochakore kuom ngʼat matin nyaka ngʼat maduongʼ, giduto giwuor ne yudo ohala; jonabi gi jodolo machalre, giduto gitimo timbe wuondruok.
english: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “Biuru ka, un duto ma un jotelo mag jolweny, mondo wayud ni richo mane mosetim kawuono.
english: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.

kikuyu: Bezalel noloso Sandug Muma gi yiend siala ma borne romo fut angʼwen gi nus to lachne romo fut achiel gi nus kendo borne madhi malo romo fut achiel gi nus.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: mondo anyis pakni e dhorangeye mag Nyi Sayun, kendo abed mamor kuno nikech warruokni.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Winy duto mafuyo e kor polono gedo e bedene, kendo le duto mag bungu nonywol e bwo bedene; to pinje duto maroteke ne yweyo e bwo tipone.
english: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.

kikuyu: Mesa duto opongʼ gi ngʼok, onge kamoro amora ma ok dungʼ tik marach.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

kikuyu: Winjauru, un mumanyo tim makare kendo udwaro Jehova Nyasaye: Ngʼi aneuru lwanda mane ogolue, ranganeuru kama ne okuny mogolue;
english: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek the LORD. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ nolokre mudho to dwe nolokre remo, kapok odiechiengʼ maduongʼ kendo man-gi duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

kikuyu: To ne nitie ngʼato kanyo mane osebedo gi midekre kuom higni piero adek gaboro.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni tielo nyalo wacho niya, “Kaka ok an lwedo, ok an achiel kuom fuonde ringruok,” to mano ok nyal mone bedo achiel kuom fuonde ringruok.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne wadhi nyime gi tich ka nus mar jowa otingʼo tongʼ, kochakore kogwen nyaka sa ma piny imore.
english: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

kikuyu: Ruoth Rehoboam nooro Adoniram mane jarit joma ichuno mondo oti githuon to jo-Israel duto nochiele gi kite motho. Kata kamano Ruoth Rehoboam nonwangʼo thuolo moidho gache nyaka Jerusalem mondo otony.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne pok owacho ni obiro golo nying jo-Israel e piny, nomiyo Jeroboam wuod Jehoash oresogi.
english: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

kikuyu: Nobed piny kaka jachung kendo japwodh fedha; nopwodh jo-Lawi kendo nochung-gi mana ka dhahabu gi fedha. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nobedi gi joma kare manokelne chiwo,
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nyi Lut ariyogo nomako ich kod wuon-gi.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokawo gechego kod rwedhi ma buochgo mi ochiwogi ne jo-Lawi.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Aserni mag Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechwoyo denda, ringra opongʼ gi kwiri marach ma asernigo okelo; kendo masiche mag Nyasaye olwora koni gi koni.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

kikuyu: kokwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi, ne romo ji alufu ariyo mia abiriyo gi piero abich (2,750).
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodhi motimo kaka ngʼat Nyasaye nowacho, en kod joode ne giwuok ma gidhi mabor e piny jo-Filistia ma gidakie higni abiriyo.
english: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nodhi Baal Perazim kendo noloyogi kanyo. Nowacho niya, “Kaka pi muomo, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye osemwomore ni wasika e nyima.” Mano emomiyo kanyo nochak ni Baal-Perizim.
english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochako owachone Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Kikombe adek molos kaka maupe mag oyungu gi thiepene kod obokene nobed e bade achiel kendo adek e bade maluwe kendo bedene auchielgo nochwogore kawuok e rachungi taya.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, anyiso jo-Israel kama: “Ngʼato angʼata kuomgi kik cham remo kendo jodak manie dieru bende kik cham remo.”
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

kikuyu: To bende un gi thuolo mar ngʼiewo nyithind jodak manie dieru, kaachiel gi joma ginywolo e dieru, makoro ginibed mwandu magu uwegi,
english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

kikuyu: E ndalone Juda noresi kendo Israel nodag gi kwe. Ma e nying ma ibiro luongego: Jehova Nyasaye mamiyo wabedo jo-ratiro.”
english: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: The LORD our righteousness.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo otieno, malaika mar Ruoth noyawo dhoudi duto mag od twech mogologi oko.
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

kikuyu: Kamoro machielo bende ondikie kama: “ ‘Ok niyie Ngʼati Maler tow.’
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

kikuyu: Joote nodhi nyime gi hulo wach kuom chier mar Ruoth Yesu gi teko mangʼongo, kendo ngʼwono maduongʼ ne ni kodgi duto.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

kikuyu: Kuom hera, loch nogur; kuom adiera ngʼato nobedie lojno, ngʼatno nowuogi e od Daudi, ma en ngʼat mangʼado bura kare, kendo ojiwo timbe mag adieri.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

kikuyu: Eka ruodhi abich mar jo-Amor; ruodhi ma Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish to gi Eglon noriwo jolwenjgi kaachiel. Negidhi kod jolweny mag-gi mi gimonjo Gibeon kendo gikedo kodgi.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

kikuyu: Kendo nokawo makati kendo bangʼ goyo erokamano nongʼinge momiyogi kowacho niya, “Ma e ringra mochiw nikech un, timuru ma ka uparago.”
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Negibolo kuom Yesu kandho makwar, eka ne gikado osimbo mar kudho kendo gisidho e wiye.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

kikuyu: Inidag gi kwe maonge luoro, nikech geno ma in-go, kendo Nyasaye noriti mamiyi yweyo.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

kikuyu: Eka negikelone ngʼat man-gi jachien kendo ma muofu bende mamomo; eka Yesu nochange, momiyo koro nonyalo wuoyo kendo neno.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

kikuyu: Oganda jo-Israel duto nochako wuoth kawuok Elim mi gidhi e thim mar Sin mantie e kind Elim gi Sinai, chiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dwe mar ariyo bangʼ kane gisewuok Misri.
english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Abiro resou kuom gik moko duto ma dimi ubed mogak. Abiro kelonu cham mi ubed gi cham mogundho kendo ok anawe ubed gi kech.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ne ok okwedo joge mane ongʼeyo chakre chon. Donge ungʼeyo gima Ndiko wacho kuom Elija, kaka noywagore ni Nyasaye nikech wach jo-Israel:
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

kikuyu: Kane Esau ja-higni piero angʼwen, nokendo Judith nyar Beeri ma ja-Hiti, kod Basemath nyar Elon ma ja-Hiti.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma dichwo obedoe achiel gi dhako mi kodhi mar nyodo owuok e diergi, nyaka giduto giluokre, kendo ginibed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nogolo pache kuomgi moweyogi mondo gilam chwech mag polo kaka nyisechegi, mana kaka ondiki e kitap jonabi niya, “ ‘Yaye jo-Israel, bende ne ukelona misengini kata chiwo moro amora kuom higni piero angʼwen mane un e thim?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to abiro lonye duk modongʼ kaka ne onywole; anakete ochal kaka lop ongoro, analoke kaka lowo motwo mobaro okak, kendo ananege kod riyo mar pi.
english: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.

kikuyu: Ka Joshua noseti kendo hike koro noniangʼ, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Iseti ahinya, to pod nitie kuonde madongo mar pinyni monego kaw.
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. The LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

kikuyu: “ ‘Polo e koma mar duongʼ to piny e raten tienda. Koro en ot machal nade ma dugerna? Ruoth Nyasaye owacho. Koso kar yweyo mara nobed kanye?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

kikuyu: “Wachne Hezekia ruodh Juda kama: Kik iyie nyasaye migeno kuomeno wuondi kowacho ni, ‘Jerusalem ok nochiw e lwet ruodh Asuria.’
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye! Abiro miyo Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ gi chunya duto, abiro miye duongʼ e buch joma kare kendo e dier chokruok.
english: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

kikuyu: ma gin kuonde ma ka ngʼato onego wadgi ka ok ochano, to onyalo ringo dhi pondo kuondego mantie e miechgi madongo mondo ores ngimane.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

kikuyu: to ngʼeyo to medeuru ritruok, to ritruok medeuru horuok, to horuok to medeuru luoro Nyasaye,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Jares ji kendo Ngʼat Maler mar Israel wacho, ne ngʼat mane ogendini ochayo kendo ma en misumba jotend piny: “Ruodhi nochungʼni malo koneni, kendo jotelo koneno ma to nopodhni auma, nikech Jehova Nyasaye, jal ma ja-adiera ma en Ngʼat Maler mar Israel ema oseyieri.”
english: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “We nyithindo ema okuong ochiem mayiengʼ, nikech ok en gima kare kawo chiemb nyithindo mondo idir ne guogi.”
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Negichiemo kendo metho gimor maduongʼ odiechiengno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Bangʼe negichako giketo Solomon wuod Daudi kaka ruoth, kendo ne giwire gi mo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed ruoth, to Zadok, to nowir kaka jadolo.
english: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

kikuyu: Kane chi Uria owinjo ni chwore otho, noywage.
english: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

kikuyu: koa kuom Zera, joka Zera; koa kuom Shaul, joka Shaul.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jo-Misri noketo nyipeche mondo ochun jo-Israel gi tich matek, kendo negigero Pithom gi Rameses kaka miech keno mag ruoth Farao.
english: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Abisalom oseringo modhi opondo. Koro ngʼat mane rito notingʼo wangʼe moneno ji mangʼeny moa yo podho chiengʼ ka gilor e bath got. Jaritno nodhi ir ruoth monyise ni, Aneno ji kalor e bath got, yo Horonaim.
english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

kikuyu: Nyakono nowuok modhi openjo min mare gima dokwa ruoth kowacho niya, “En angʼo manyalo kwayo?” To min mare nodwoke niya, “Wi Johana Ja-batiso.”
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Ler mar taya ok norieny kendo e iyi chutho. Dwond wuon kisera gi dwond miaha bende ok nochak owinj e iyi ngangʼ. Jolok ohala magi ne gin ji madongo e piny. To pinje duto nobaro mokethore nikech wuondni kod timbeni mayore mag jwok.
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Koro kwanwauru Nyasaye mondo otimnwa ngʼwono. To ka chiwo ma aye lwetu, chalo kamano, bende dorwaku adier?
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ogandano mane oluwogi nosiko kakok niya, “Negeuru.”
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo manok Joash noparo mondo olos hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: After this, Joash intended to restore the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Eka noluonge niya, “Samson, jo-Filistia osebiro mondo omonji!” Kane ochiewo to ne owacho e chunye niya, “Abiro wuok kaka pile mondo abed thuolo.” To ne ok ongʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye noseweye.
english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that the LORD had departed from him.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Hono achiel kende ema ne atimo mi ubwok uduto.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

kikuyu: “Ka dine joga yie winja, ka dine Israel yie lu yorena,
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma ok nyal riyo kech odiechiengʼno to nongʼad kare oko chuth e kind ogandane.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Magi e chike momako dichwo ma dende chwer kata mobet mogak nikech wuok mar nyote,
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

kikuyu: Kwerewa ne nigi yie machal kamano omiyo Nyasaye noyie kodgi.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

kikuyu: Wengena neno otieno duto, mondo omi apar matut kuom singruok magi.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

kikuyu: ka ok okwan mago mag osuch jo-ohala gi johono. To ruodhi mag piny Arabu kod jotend piny bende nokelone Solomon dhahabu kod fedha.
english: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

kikuyu: Abiro rieyone tonda mondo amakego mi kawe komoko e obadhona. Abiro tere nyaka Babulon, piny jo-Kaldea, to kata kamano ok none pinyno gi wangʼe, kendo kuno ema nothoe.
english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

kikuyu: Kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ mar laruno bende lachne ne romo fut piero abiriyo gabich.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

kikuyu: Un joma madho divai mangʼeny gi agwetni madongo, kendo uwiroru gi modhi mangʼwe ngʼar ma nengogi tek, to ok ane ka un gi lit kata ka joka Josef rumo kamano.
english: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

kikuyu: Idak gi acheje moikore ne chwero remo, kaachiel gi joma chiemo ewi gode mitime lisweche, kod joma timo timbe ma ok owinjore.
english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.

kikuyu: En adier ni in ema ihero ji, jomaler duto ginie lweti. Giduto gikulore e nyimi kendo kuomi ema gikawe chike,
english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

kikuyu: Bende neginego Parshandatha, Dalfon, Aspatha,
english: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

kikuyu: Jotend ogendini ochokore kaachiel kaka jo-Nyasach Ibrahim, nikech ruodhi mag piny gin mag Nyasaye; omiyo Nyasaye oyud duongʼ.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Usedhi mabor moromo, yaye yawuot ruodhi mag Israel! Weuru mahundu mau kendo weuru tiyo ji githuon, to timuru gik ma adier kendo makare. Weuru sando joga, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “Ok abi weyo mak awuoyo kuom tiende nyangʼni, tekre kendo kaka oduongʼ.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

kikuyu: Kamano nokawo yo machielo mine ok odok gi yo mane obirogo Bethel.
english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

kikuyu: Nikech ne utho kendo ngimau koro opandi ei Kristo, kuom Nyasaye.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

kikuyu: To ka itamori weyogi mondo gidhi kendo isiko kiketogi e tich misumba,
english: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

kikuyu: Nomiyo ngʼat mane otelo chik niya, “Ka owadwa Esau oromo kodi mopenji ni, ‘In jatich ngʼa, to idhi kanye kendo ni jamni duto misembogi gin mag ngʼa?’
english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

kikuyu: Ne agolou e piny Misri kendo agonyou thuolo e piny wasumbini. Ne aoro Musa, mondo otelnu, bende naoro Harun gi Miriam.
english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

kikuyu: To owad gi Rebeka kod min-gi nodwoke niya, “We nyakoni odongʼ kodwa kuom ndalo apar kata moloyo kanyo; eka udhi.”
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo Nyasaye nojwangʼogi e paro modwanyore ma chunygi ne gombo timo, ka giketho dendgi gi kit chode duto e kindgi ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

kikuyu: Kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo chik ni jatichne Musa, omiyo Musa bende nochiwo chik ne Joshua, mi Joshua notimo mano. Onge gima noweyo ma ok otimo kuom gigo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ere kaka welo mag wuon kisera nyalo kuyo adier kapod en kodgi? Kata kamano ndalo nobi ma wuon kisera nogol e kindgi; eka ginitwe chiemo e kindeno.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ondiki bende ni, ‘Kik item Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi.’”
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

kikuyu: Bangʼe, ka jo-Amon nochako lweny gi jo-Israel,
english: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

kikuyu: kendo ka utuonoru mondo ukony joma kech kayo mi uchopo dwaro mar joma isando. Eka ler maru norieny e mudho kendo otieno maru nochal mana ka dier odiechiengʼ tir.
english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nooro Finehas wuod Eliazar jadolo, e piny Gilead, ir jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase,
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

kikuyu: Nyis jodolo matingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok ni, ‘Ka uchopo e geng pige mag aora Jordan, to dhiuru kendo uchungʼ ei aora.’ ”
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo jotelo duto kod ji mane odonjo e winjruokni noyie ni giniwe thuolo wasumbini mag-gi machwo kod mamon kendo ok ginibed e twech kendo. Ne giyie, kendo ne giwegi thuolo.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,

kikuyu: mi gineno ka jopuonjrene moko chiemo gi lwedo mochido, tiende ni lwedo ma ok olwoki e yor pwodhruok.
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

kikuyu: Mirimb Nyasaye nyalo tieka kendo onyalo miyo adhondena medore kayiem nono.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

kikuyu: nyaka ogengʼ lewe kik wuo marach kendo ogengʼ dhoge kuom wacho miriambo.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

kikuyu: Nam nogolo joma otho manie iye, to Tho gi Piny Joma otho nogolo joma otho manie igi, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nongʼadne bura koluwore kod gik mane osetimo.
english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

kikuyu: Dhogi ne rach ma ok ginyal chamo chiemo moro amora, kendo ne gichiegni tho.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kikuyu: “Daher mondo adwoki in kaachiel gi osiepenigo.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka joma nondiki mokwongo nobiro, negigeno yudo mangʼeny. To moro ka moro kuomgi bende noyudo mana dinari achiel.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

kikuyu: Juda notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kuom richo mane gitimo, negimiyo Nyasaye mirima omako kodgi moloyo kaka kweregi notimo.
english: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

kikuyu: To jodolo mamoko ema ne omi tij ruwo gik mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

kikuyu: Kane gineno mano ne giyiecho lepgi, eka ne giyieyo pundegi kendo gidok dala Josef.
english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

kikuyu: To ka jo-Farisai nowinjo wachno, negiwacho niya, “Ngʼatni golo jochiende gi teko mar Belzebub, ruodh jochiende.”
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Johana norwakore gi lewni molos gi yie ngamia kendo notweyo kamba mar pien e nungone. Nochamo bonyo kod mor kich manie thim.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Koa yo nyandwat nobedi migepe mag kuonde dak mag Dan, kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi. Jatend dhood Dan en Ahiezer wuod Amishadai.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Gisechiwo ringre jogi motho mondo obed chiemb winy manie kor polo, ring jogi maler gisechiwo ne ondiegi mag piny.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Kendo gik mangima angʼwen-go nowacho niya “Amin” eka jodongogo nopodho piny mi gidende.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

kikuyu: Yesu kaachiel gi jopuonjrene nowuok oa kanyo mi gidhi e dho nam, to oganda maduongʼ moa Galili noluwo bangʼe.
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

kikuyu: To jamni mane owal mondo otimgo misengini ni ruoth ne gin rwedhi mia auchiel kod rombe gi diek alufu adek.
english: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata morwako achiel kuom nyithindo matindogi e nyinga, orwaka An awuon, to bende ngʼato angʼata morwaka ok An ema orwaka, to orwako jal mane oora.”
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Bende in gi ratiro mondo iyi owangʼ?”
english: The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

kikuyu: “To koro, owetena, angʼeyo ni ne utimo gigo ka ok ungʼeyo, mana kaka jotendu bende notimogi kane ok gingʼeyo.
english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo Rumi ne omanya matek nyaka nonwangʼa.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

kikuyu: Daniel nowacho niya, “E fwenyna ma naneno gotieno, ne angʼicho, kendo e nyima ne nitie yembe angʼwen mag polo mane yuko nam maduongʼ.
english: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.

kikuyu: Isaka nodak higni mia achiel gi piero aboro.
english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

kikuyu: To Edom nodwoko niya, “Ok unyal luwo ka; ka utemo, to wabiro wuok riat kendo wamonju gi ligangla.”
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

kikuyu: Anywola mar Juda nobiro, mi oyier joka Zera. Joka Zera nobiro ot ka ot mi od Zabdi ema noyier.
english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

kikuyu: Ne! Achungʼ e dhoot kendo aduongʼo, ka ngʼato angʼata owinjo dwonda mi oyawona dhoot to abiro donjo ire mi achiem kode to en bende ochiem koda.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kaleb owadgi Jeramel ne gin: Mesha mane wuode makayo mane wuon Zif to gi wuode Maresha mane en wuon Hebron.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

kikuyu: Nikech aneno ka chunyi opongʼ gi nyiego mangʼeny, kendo richo oloki misumbane chuth.”
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

kikuyu: Ne aketo seyi kendo agoyo amuri, ka joneno obedo, kendo apimo fedha e ratil.
english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Nam Makwar mi gibworo e Thim mar Sin.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

kikuyu: “Uparo ni ka wuon puoth mzabibu obiro to angʼo mobiro timo? Obiro biro moneg jopur puodhogo mi ogol puoth mzabibuno e lwetgi mi enomi joma moko.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: Kuom nyiso ni uchungʼ kodwa e tijni, umiyo Nyasaye duongʼ nikech mano nyiso ni umako chik mar Injili mar Kristo mwalando, kuom ngʼwono mane omiyo uyie pogo kodgi giu, kaachiel gi jomoko bende.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni pe nolwer bunge kendo dala maduongʼ nopodh chuth,
english: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

kikuyu: Mad ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed kodu un duto. Amin.]
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

kikuyu: to onge ngʼama nyalo boyo lep. En gima rach ma ok ywe mopongʼ gi kwiri marach.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

kikuyu: Eka noloso Nam mar mula moleny, molworore kaka karaya ma lachne romo fut apar gabich, to tutne romo fut aboro. Alworane duto ne romo fut piero angʼwen gangʼwen.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, jowetena, meduru bedo gi siso mar rito luong mane oluongugo kod yiero maru ka un gi adier. Nikech ka utimo gigi to ok unupodhi,
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

kikuyu: Eka nowach ne od Daudi niya, “Jo-Aram osetimo winjruok gi jo-Efraim,” omiyo chuny Ahaz gi joge kihondko osemako, mana ka yien manie bungu ma yamo yiengo.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

kikuyu: Riw gigi duto mondo ilos mor pwodhruok maler madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mana kaka ngʼat molony e loso gik mangʼwe ngʼar loso. Enobed mor pwodhruok maler.
english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

kikuyu: Donge kwereu notimo mana gik machalre gi gigi, ma nomiyo Nyasachwa okelo masiragi duto kuomwa kendo kuom dala maduongʼ? Omiyo koro umedo kelo kwongʼ kuom jo-Israel kuom njawo chiengʼ Sabato.”
english: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Eka negichiwo nying ji ariyo: Josef miluongo ni Barsaba (ma bende niluongo ni Justo) kod Mathias.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde ma Jehova Nyasaye nokelonegi jangʼad bura, nokonyo jangʼad burano kendo noresogi e lwet wasikgi ndalo duto mane jangʼad burano pod ngima; nimar Jehova Nyasaye ne kechogi nikech wasikgi ne thirogi kendo hinyogi malit.
english: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

kikuyu: Ohinga mane gigengʼogo pi madonjo e dala ruoth omukore, bende od ruoth ogore piny.
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni mudho odino wangʼa kamano, to mudhono ok nyal miya luoro.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro kecho Jakobo mi enochak oyier Israel, kendo enomi gidag e pinygi giwegi. Jopinje mamoko nobi irgi mi riwre gi od Jakobo.
english: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

kikuyu: Mapiyo bangʼ ka Judas nosekawo makatino, nowuok oweyogi. Koro ne en seche mag otieno.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jawar margi en ratego; Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge. Enokonygi gi nyalone duto mondo omi gibed gi yweyo e pinygi; to jo-Babulon nomi obed gi tungni.”
english: Their Redeemer is strong. The LORD of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

kikuyu: Rituru buchena kendo uluwgi, nimar An e Jehova Nyasaye mapwodhou.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

kikuyu: En e Nyasaye ma chulona kuor, maketo ogendini e bwoya,
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Wuowi miyo wuon mare luor kendo jatich bende timo kamano ne ruodhe. Omiyo ka an wuoro, to ere luor mowinjore koda? To ka an Ruoth, to ere luor mowinjore koda?” “Yaye, jodolo, un ema ujaro nyinga. “To upenjo ni, ‘Ere kaka wajaro nyingi?’
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

kikuyu: “Los karaya mar luok molos gi mula to gi rachungi miketoe karayano bende olos gi mula. Kete e kind Hemb Romo kod kendo mar misango bangʼe iol pi e iye.
english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi duto mane ni kanyo noriwore gi Tertulo ka donjone, kendo ka giramo ni gik mane odonjnego ne gin adier.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

kikuyu: Ka ringʼo moro mar misango odongʼ nyaka chiengʼ mar adek, to nyaka wangʼe e mach.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Ruoth Zedekia nowachone Jeremia niya, “Aluoro jo-Yahudi mosedhi ir jo-Babulon, nimar jo-Babulon nyalo chiwa e lwetgi mi gisanda.”
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”

kikuyu: mondo gingʼe ngeche, sigendini, kod weche ma tiendgi tek mag jorieko.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka Jeremia nosetieko nyiso ji duto gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochike mondo owachi, jodolo, jonabi kod ji duto nomake kendo owachone niya, “Nyaka itho!
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!

kikuyu: “Ka chwo gore kendo achiel kuomgi ogoyo nyawadgi gi kidi kata gi adhongʼ to ok otho, to obedo mana matuo kosiko e pien,
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

kikuyu: Kane Solomon osetieko gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod od ruoth mar dak kendo nosetieko timo gik moko duto manochano mondo otim e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod ode owuon;
english: Thus Solomon finished the LORD’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the LORD’s house and in his own house.

kikuyu: Nomuko kende mag misango mane ruodhi mag Juda ogero ewi tat od Ahaz, bende nomuko kende mag misango mane Manase ogero e laru ariyo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Nogologi kanyo, motoyogi matindo tindo kendo opuko ngʼinjogo e holo mar Kidron.
english: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: mon makamagi oikore mar winjo puonj to kata kamano ok ginyal chopo e okangʼ mar rwako adiera.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Inyalo wacho niya, “To donge notongʼ bede yath moko oko mondo ochoma kargi?”
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

kikuyu: Abiro riembou oko e dala maduongʼni mi aketu e lwet ogendini mamoko mabiro sandou.
english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

kikuyu: Piny osebarore, piny oselal nono, kendo piny yiengni malich.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

kikuyu: Bende neginego teyni kendo loro dhout agola kendo ne ok giwangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kata chiwo misango miwangʼo pep e kama ler mar lemo mar Nyasach Israel.
english: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar abich nogoyo turumbete, mine aneno sulwe moro mane oselwar e piny koa e polo. Sulweno ne omi kifungu mar bur matut maonge gikone.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ngʼama osemako kwer dhok to pod ngʼiyo chien ok owinjore ni tich mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: “Wuonu nomiyowa tingʼ mapek, to koro yie iket tingʼ mapekno kod tij achunano obednwa mayot, to wabiro tiyoni.”
english: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,

kikuyu: Timneuru kaka osetimono! Medneuru nyadiriyo kuom gik ma osetimo! Losneuru mathne mane omiyo ji e kikombene nyadiriyo.
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negioro wach ne Josef kagiwacho niya, “Kane pok wuonu otho noweyonwa wach niya,
english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

kikuyu: Koro magi e gik monego ipuonji. Jiw ji kendo ikwergi gi teko duto. Kik iwene ngʼato thuolo mondo ochayi.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

kikuyu: Kendo unuchak une pogruok mane kind joma kare kod joma timbegi richo, kendo e kind joma tiyone Nyasaye gi joma ok tine.”
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

kikuyu: Kik ucham ring-gi kata kik umul ringregi motho. Gin gik makwero ne un.
english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

kikuyu: Abiro tieko chuth joma kedo kode koneno gi wangʼe, kendo abiro goyo wasike duto piny.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

kikuyu: Kane ogandano ofwenyo ni Yesu gi jopuonjrene ne onge kanyo, negidonjo ei yiedhigo, mi gidhi Kapernaum, mondo gimany Yesu kuno.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

kikuyu: Jatijno none ber ka ruodhe odwogo to noyude kotimo gima noweye notim.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Ne ok otimonigi gima opogore gi ma notimonwa, nikech gin bende nopwodho chunygi kuom yie.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

kikuyu: Nowacho mano mondo onyisgo kit tho ma nobiro thogo.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: “An to ne adwoko ni, ‘Ooyo Ruoth! Onge gima kwero kata mochido mosedonjo e dhogani nyaka nene.’
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

kikuyu: Nyikwa Kohath mane odongʼ nopog mier matindo apar koa e anywola mar dhout Efraim, Dan kod nus mar dhood Manase.
english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Kane Ahab owinjo wechegi duto, noyiecho lepe, morwako lep gunia kendo notweyo chiemo. Nonindo gi lepe mag guniago kendo nowuotho kokuyo.
english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

kikuyu: Nikech kaka tamruok winjo wach mar ngʼat achiel nomiyo ji mangʼeny odoko joricho, e kaka winjo wach mar ngʼat achielno biro miyo iketo ji mangʼeny kare.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo kelo mana miero, to jakwoth pogo osiepe moherore.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

kikuyu: ni joma ongʼere to wachal joma ok ongʼe, kendo wachalo joma chiegni tho, to pod ineno mana ka wangima angima, igoyowa to ok negwa;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

kikuyu: Ka joma nodak yo podho chiengʼ nowinjo gima notimoreno luoro nomakogi, to joma odak yo wuok chiengʼ, kihondko nogoyo.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye notelnu ndalo duto, obiro chopo dwarou e piny motwo, kendo motimo ongoro mi enomi dendu bed mojingʼ. Unuchal mana ka puodho mayudo pi maber, kendo ka soko ma pige ok rum.
english: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

kikuyu: Nikech ok wandiknu gik matek ma ok unyal somo mi uwinj tiendgi. Omiyo ageno ni,
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

kikuyu: Ochalo gi yien motwi kama otimo pi to chiengʼ goyo ma bedene yarore piyo piyo e puodho;
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

kikuyu: Kane Abram ne ja-higni piero ochiko gochiko, Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorene mi nowachone niya, “An Nyasaye Maratego; bed ngʼama odimbore e nyima kendo maonge ketho.
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

kikuyu: omiyo ruoth nopenja niya, “Ere gima omiyo ikuyo to ok ituo? Ma ok en kuyo akuya makmana ni en mar chuny.” Ne aluor ahinya,
english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ne ok iwinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye? Angʼo momiyo ne imuomori mi iyeko kendo itimo richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: Why then didn’t you obey the LORD’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight?”

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat maketho buch japiny moro, nyathi kich kod dhako ma chwore otho.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Osiepena gi anywolana ok dwar nena nikech adhondena; joma odak buta otangʼ koda.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

kikuyu: Ka gik moko duto nosechan kamano, jodolo ne donjoga e hema ma oko pile mondo giti tichgi mar lemo.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni ngʼama Nyasaye onywolo ok sik katimo richo, nikech Wuod Nyasaye orite kendo ngʼama rach ok nyal mule.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

kikuyu: “Gimoro amora mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye chuth nobed magu.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

kikuyu: Yesu koro ne ok oyie mondo ngʼat moro oluwe makmana Petro gi Jakobo kod Johana owadgi Jakobo.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

kikuyu: E dala mar Jopa ne nitie japuonjre moro miluongo ni Tabitha (ma dho jo-Yunani luongo bi Dorka tiende ni Nyakech) mane osiko katimo maber ni ji kendo nokonyo joma odhier.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nomedo wuoyo kode kendo niya, “To ka dipo ni ji piero angʼwen kende ema oyudore kanyo?” Ruoth Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Kayudo ji piero angʼwen kanyo, to ok nakethe.”
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

kikuyu: Hekalu mane ruoth Solomon ogero ni Jehova Nyasaye borne noromo fut piero aboro gochiko kendo lachne ne romo fut piero adek to borne madhi malo ne romo fut piero angʼwen gangʼwen.
english: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

kikuyu: Ne iwacho niya, Abiro dhi nyime kaka ruoth madhako nyaka chiengʼ! To ne ok iparo gigi maber bende ne ok igo machiemo kuom gik manyalo timore.
english: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.

kikuyu: Gik ma atimo odhiera ngʼeyo. Nimar ok atim gik ma adwaro, to atimo mana gik ma ok adwar.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

kikuyu: Igal wuod Nathan moa Zoba, gi Bani wuod Hagri,
english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

kikuyu: To nodwokogi niya, “Tiengʼ ma timbene richo kendo mamono manyo ranyisi mar hono! To ok bi miye moro amora makmana ranyisi mar janabi Jona.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: e kaka noywaya oko e yo mokidha kendo oweya maonge kaka dakonyra.
english: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

kikuyu: Ka nyathino nosedongo mobedo maduongʼ nokawe motere ne nyar Farao kendo nyathino nodoko wuod nyar Farao. Nochake ni Musa kowacho niya, “Ne agole e pi.”
english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

kikuyu: nikech angʼeyo ni kuom lemo mulemonago kod kony ma ayudo kuom Roho mar Yesu Kristo, gik mosetimorenago ema bende biro kelona resruok.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Kaw bende chak mopoto mongʼin apar mondo itergi ne jatendgi. Nenane kaka oweteni dhi mondo iduogna wach maber moa kuomgi.
english: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

kikuyu: Ada nonywolone Esau Elifaz, to Basemath nonywolo Reuel,
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato mowere gi chiege mokendo dhako machielo, odonjo e richo mar terruok, to ngʼat mokendo dhako ma chwore oweyo, bende odonjo e richo mar terruok.
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

kikuyu: To kane oyudo gipiele piny mondo gichwade, Paulo nowacho ni jatend jolweny manoyudo ochungʼ kanyo niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo uchwad ngʼat ma ja-Rumi kapok oyale mi oyudi ni en jaketho?”
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo nokwanyo ngʼinjo mag fedhago kendo giwacho niya, “Chik ok oyie mondo okan gini kar keno, nikech en pesa remo.”
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Adin, Ebed wuod Jonathan, kaachiel kode ji piero abich;
english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

kikuyu: Kochakore e odiechiengno, nus mar joga notiyo tijno, to nus modongʼ nomanore gi tongʼ, okumba, atungʼ kod gige lweny mag akor. Jotelo nochungʼ e tok jo-Juda duto
english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Abiro dhi nyime ka an gi pek manie pacha kod kuyo manie chunya odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ nyaka karangʼo? Wasika biro locho kuoma nyaka karangʼo?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

kikuyu: Omiyo neginego Haman e gima noseiko mondo oneg-go Modekai. Eka mirimb ruoth norumo.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

kikuyu: Abiro wuotho ka an thuolo, nimar chikeni ema asebedo ka amanyo.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Daudi to nowacho ka kwongʼore niya, “Wuoru ongʼeyo malongʼo kaka igena mi osewacho e chunye ni, ‘Jonathan ok onego ngʼe wachni nikech chunye nyalo bedo gi lit.’ Kata kamano akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima to gi nyingi ni kinda gi tho odongʼ mana ondamo achiel.”
english: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”

kikuyu: Chuny mamor miyo wangʼ bedo gi mor, to chuny mokuyo miyo dhano bedo mool.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

kikuyu: Kane osudo machiegni gi Jerusalem kendo moneno dala maduongʼno noywage,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

kikuyu: Daudi nopenje niya, “Ngʼa mabiro wachona ka wuonu odwoki gi gero?”
english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

kikuyu: Anachwadu gi masiche kendo anapwodhu maler, mi agol timbeu mamono duto.
english: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora mochwe gi lowo nyaka to, kendo gimoro amora molos gi bao ma ngʼatno omulo nyaka luok gi pi.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

kikuyu: Gotieno nogo Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Solomon mowachone niya, “Kwa gimoro amora midwaro mondo amiyi.”
english: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

kikuyu: “Nimar joma iluongo ngʼeny, to joma iyiero to tin.”
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

kikuyu: Joga nodag kuonde ma kwe nitie, e mier moger motegno, kendo kuonde ma kwe nitie ma koko ongee.
english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

kikuyu: Donge en fundi bao-cha ma wuod Maria kendo ma owetene gin Jakobo gi Josef kod Judas gi Simon? Nyiminene donge nikodwa ka?” Kamano negichwanyore kode.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

kikuyu: Eka wuon nongʼeyo ni mano e sa nogono mane Yesu owachone niya, “Wuodi dhi bedo mangima.” Kuom mano, en kaachiel gi joode duto ne giyie kuom Yesu.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

kikuyu: Chik mane ruoth ogolono noyiene jo-Yahudi man e mier madongo duto mondo giritre kendgi; kendo mondo giketh kendo ginegi mi gitieki joma obiro nigi gi gige lweny moa e oganda moro amora, kata gwengʼ moro momonjogi gi mondgi gi nyithindgi kendo gipe mwandu mag wasikgi.
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

kikuyu: Bende abiro tieko ji duto makulore ewi tat udi kalamo chiengʼ, dwe gi sulwe. Ji duto makulore ka kwongʼore gi nying Jehova Nyasaye, to bangʼe gikwongʼore gi nying Molek nyasach jo-Amon.
english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Gi teko ma in-go, dhiyo kendo ires jo-Israel e lwet jo-Midian. Donge an ema aori?”
english: The LORD looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

kikuyu: To mirimb Jehova Nyasaye ne ger gi Uza nikech tim mane otimo ma ok ber omiyo Nyasaye nogoye motho but Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

kikuyu: Lamuru Nyasaye mondo kik masira yudu e ndalo chwiri kata chiengʼ Sabato.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

kikuyu: Isemiyo piny oyarore kendo isemedo morgi, mi gibedo gi ilo e nyimi mana kaka oganda bedo gi mor e ndalo keyo, kendo mana kaka ji bedo gi mor ka gipogo gik ma oyaki.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

kikuyu: Notime machalre ne jodolo kata ne joma moko, misumba kata ne ruodhe, ne dhako man-gi jatich kata ne nyako matiyone, ne jahono kata ne jangʼiewo, ne ngʼat ma holo ji, kata ne ngʼat ma holo, ne ngʼat man-gi gowi kata ngʼat ma holo ji.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

kikuyu: To dhogi noyawre sa nogono; mi iniwuo kode kendo ok inilingʼ. Kuom mano, inibednegi ranyisi, kendo giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Simon Petro, Thoma (ma bende iluongo ni Didimas), Nathaniel mane aa Kana e piny Galili, yawuot Zebedi, kod jopuonjre mamoko ariyo, noyudo ochokore kanyakla.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

kikuyu: Roho nenore e ngima ngʼato ka ngʼato e yo mopogore opogore, mondo okel konyruok ni ji duto.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Tich ma Nyasaye dwaro en ni mondo uyie kuom Jal moseoro.”
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

kikuyu: Yaye, Ruoth Nyasaye, en angʼo ma dwawachi ka jo-Israel oseriemb gi wasikgi kama?
english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?

kikuyu: Sa moro anyalo bedo kodu kuom ndalo mogwarore, to sa moro anyalo bedo kodu mana e ndalo mag chwiri kende mondo omi ukonya e wuodhena duto mabiro dhiyoe.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

kikuyu: Dhako ma kite longʼo en ngʼa manyalo nwangʼo? Nengone oloyo kite ma nengogi tek.
english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodum oa ewi kerubi modhi nyaka kama idonjogo e hekalu. Bor polo nopongʼo hekalu, kendo laru nopongʼ gi ler mar duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka none malit ngʼatno magero kare mar dak maonge ratiro, utene mamalo e yor mecho koketo jothurgi tiyo maonge chudo.
english: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

kikuyu: Gikanyono gima chalo gi ololo nolwar oa e wenge Saulo mi koro nonyalo neno. Noa malo mi nobatise,
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

kikuyu: Wagouru erokamano ne Nyasaye kuom michne maduongʼ mokalo apima!
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

kikuyu: Nimar awachonu ni ka ok ber maru oyombo mano mar jo-Farisai gi mar jopuonj chik to ok unudonji e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: To Harun gi joge ema ne chiwo misango e kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, kendo ne giwangʼo ubani e kendo mar ubani, kendo negitimo misango mipwodhogo richo jo-Israel. Negitiyo tije duto mag Kama Ler Moloyo, kaka Musa jatich Nyasaye nochiko.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto e tekona; en ema omiyo tienda bedo mayot ka tiend mwanda, en ema omiyo awuotho kuonde motingʼore malo. Ne jatend wer. E thuma mar kamba.
english: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

kikuyu: Negisiko gipako Nyasaye, kendo ji duto ne mor kodgi. To Ruoth ne medo kwan mar joma oyie kuom Kristo e chokruokgi pile ka pile.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

kikuyu: En Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kende ema onego uluw kendo en kende ema owinjore umiye luor. Rituru chikene, luoreuru, tineuru kendo upadru kuome.
english: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

kikuyu: Omiyo Israel noriwore kodgi e yor lamo Baal mar Peor. Kendo mirima nomako Jehova Nyasaye ahinya kodgi.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

kikuyu: To ka Jakwath Maduongʼ obiro to unuyud osimbo mar duongʼ ma ok kethre ma nosik karieny nyaka chiengʼ.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

kikuyu: bakul achiel mar dhahabu ma pekne en shekel apar, mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

kikuyu: Ka dine Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok oweyo jomoko kuomwa otony, to dine wachalo gi jo-Sodom, adier dikoro ne wachalo kaka jo-Gomora.
english: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

kikuyu: Nowachonigi, “Kik uhiny piny, kata nam, kata yiende nyaka chop waket kido e lela wangʼ jotich Nyasachwa.”
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

kikuyu: Kuondegi mochiel motegno nopodhi mi gidhier nono, kendo jotendgi mag lweny, kibaji nogo ma ok ginyal ringo,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho, en ma maye liel koa Sayun, kendo maye mangʼangʼni ni Jerusalem.
english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “To kata ka adhi yo wuok chiengʼ to oonge kuno; ka adhi yo podho chiengʼ bende ok ayude.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

kikuyu: Yaye gunda, yaye gunda, abiro miyo obed gunda adier! Ok nolose kendo nyaka chop ngʼat ma wuon-go hie nobi, kendo en ema anamiyego.’
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

kikuyu: Negiketogi e lwet joma otelo ne gedo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Jogi nochulo jotich mane oloso kendo odwogo hekalu kaka ne ochalo chon.
english: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and the workmen who labored in the LORD’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ma onego obed ranyisi e kindwa kodu to gi tiengʼ mabiro bangʼwa, ni wabiro lamo Jehova Nyasaye e kare maler mar lemo ka wachiwone misango miwangʼo pep, misengini mamoko kod misango mar lalruok. Bangʼe ndalo mabiro nyikwau ok nowach ne nyikwawa ni, ‘Uonge gi pok kuom Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in the LORD.’

kikuyu: kuma nobetie kuom dweche adek. To nikech jo-Yahudi ne chano timo ne marach kane oyudo oikore mar dhi Siria, noloko pache mondo odog chien, koluwo Makedonia.
