english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

kikuyu: Dhok abiriyo maricho kendo odherogo nochamo dhok abiriyo machwe kendo mabeyo mane okwongo wuok.
english: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

kikuyu: wuod Jakobo, wuod Isaka, wuod Ibrahim, wuod Tera, wuod Nahor,
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

kikuyu: Dhiuru e piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich. To ok anadhi kodu nikech un oganda ma tokgi tek kendo dipo ka atiekou e wangʼ yo.”
english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

kikuyu: In Nyasacha, omiyo abiro goyoni erokamano; in Nyasacha omiyo abiro miyi duongʼ.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

kikuyu: Enochan mondo obi gi teko mar pinyruodhe duto, kendo enolos winjruok gi ruoth mar Milambo, kendo enomiye nyare mondo okendi, eka olo pinyno, to chenrogego ok noti, kendo ok nokonye.
english: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni nitie wach moro machielo ma udwaro nolosi, to nyaka lose mana e chokruok ma chik oyiego.
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

kikuyu: To e seche mane ok awuo kendo alingʼ mos, kane ok awach gimoro amora maber, pek manie chunya nomedore.
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

kikuyu: Ka osesomnu baruwani, to neuru ni osome ni kanisa mar jo-Laodikia bende. To Un bende ukaw barupgi mondo usom.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

kikuyu: Abiro olo mirimba mager kuom Pelusiuma en kar konyruok mar Misri, kendo abiro tieko oganda maduongʼ modak Thebes.
english: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato kuomu nyalo donjona ni an jaketho? Ka en kamano, to abiro lingʼ kendo kata tho ayie tho.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noolo kite maliel makakni koa e polo mowangʼo Sodom gi Gomora.
english: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.

kikuyu: Ruoth nochungʼ e bath siro kendo noketo winjruok mane oselal obedo kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kosingore ni enoluw Jehova Nyasaye kendo norit chikene gi wechene kod buchene gi chunye duto, mondo omi oritgo weche mag singruok mondiki e kitabuni. Omiyo ji duto noyie gi singruogno.
english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

kikuyu: To pesa mane ogol kuom misango mar pwodhruok e ketho gi mag chiwo migolo kuom richo motim ok ne kel ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, mago ne iwene jodolo.
english: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.

kikuyu: Ere ber ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare, to olalo kata owito ngimane.
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

kikuyu: kod mich mabeyo mawuok e gode machon, kod kuonde ma omew mag gode manyaka chiengʼ;
english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

kikuyu: Otieno gi odiechiengʼ ne gibedonwa ka ohinga molworowa kinde duto ka wakwayo rombewa butgi.
english: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

kikuyu: To koro aa malo ichungʼ gi tiendi. Asefwenyorani mondo awali kaka jatich kendo janeno kuom gik miseneno kuoma kendo kuom gik mamoko ma abiro nyisi.
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

kikuyu: Adier, ananene gi wangʼa awuon mana an ma ok ngʼat moro. Mano kaka chunya ogeno odiechiengno!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

kikuyu: Ichwako nyithi kiye kod joma isando, mondo dhano ma ochwe gi lowo, kik dhi nyime gi bwogo ji.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

kikuyu: To Yesu nolokore, mokwerogi.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

kikuyu: Kane Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye osebet e piny jo-Filistia kuom dweche abiriyo,
english: The LORD’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, kuom Ruoth, dhako ok nyal dak maonge dichwo mana kaka dichwo bende ok nyal dak maonge dhako.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, nikech in, abiro kawi kendo ibiro locho kuom mago duto ma chunyi dwaro, ibiro bedo ruoth kuom Israel.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo chike mawacho ni: ‘Kik ineki, kik iterri, kik ikwal, kik ihang wach, kik imechi, luor wuonu gi minu.’”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

kikuyu: To ngʼat ma terore gi chi ngʼat machielo onge gi rieko, ngʼat matimo kamano ketho ngimane owuon.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

kikuyu: E bwo dhoge nolwore gi pugni ma kindgi romo fut achiel gi nus, pugni nochan e laini ariyo ka gimakore gi Namno.
english: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

kikuyu: kod anywola mar jondiko mane odak Jabez: jo-Tira, jo-Shimea kod jo-Suka. Magi ne jo-Keni mane owuok e anywola mar Hamath, ma wuon jo-Rekab.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nolwokre gi pi e kama ler mar lemo kendo norwak lepe mag dolo, eka enochiw misango miwangʼo pep mondo otimgo pwodhruok ni en owuon kod oganda jo-Israel duto.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

kikuyu: Koro olamo Nyasaye mitimne ngʼwono, opongʼ gi mor koneno Nyasaye, kendo Nyasaye tingʼe malo kuom tim makare.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

kikuyu: Negingʼado kar dho wath mondo gikaw ruoth gi joode mane ni loka kendo gitim gimoro amora modwaro. Kane Shimei wuod Gera nongʼado Jordan, nopodho auma e nyim ruoth
english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Donge nitie seche apar gariyo e odiechiengʼ? Ngʼat mawuotho godiechiengʼ ok chwanyre, nimar ler mar piny miyo oneno.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

kikuyu: Wangʼ yo maduongʼ nobedi ne joge manok mane odongʼ koa e piny Asuria, mana kaka wangʼ yo nobedone jo-Israel kawuok Misri.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Koro yie iwinj jatichni mondo iyiena amiyi chiemo moro minyalo chamo mondo iyud teko mar dok.”
english: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

kikuyu: Chiwuru magi kaachiel gi misango miolo piny, kumedo gi misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile kod chiwo mar cham. Neuru ni jamnigo onge songa.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

kikuyu: Zelek ja-Amon, Naharai ja-Beroth mane jatingʼ gige lweny mag Joab wuod Zeruya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

kikuyu: gi Basemath nyar Ishmael kendo ma nyamin Nebayoth.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

kikuyu: Chutho mago e gik matimore ne joma timbegi richo mokia Nyasaye.”
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

kikuyu: Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel Samson nodhi Gaza, kama nonenoe nyako moro ma jachode mi odhi mondo oterre kode.
english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.

kikuyu: Ginigoyi piny, in gi nyithindi ei ohingani ok giniwe kidi moro ewi wadgi, nikech ne ok ingʼeyo kinde mane Nyasaye biroe iri.”
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

kikuyu: nimar yawuowi makayo duto gin meka. Kane anego yawuowi makayo duto e piny Misri, ne awalo ne an awuon kayo moro amora e Israel, obed mar dhano kata mar le mondo gibed maga. An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Mago ema ne nying yawuot Harun, mane gin jodolo mowir kendo mopwodhi mondo obed jodolo.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre Yesu nowachone niya, “Ero koro iwuoyo kodwa maler ma ok itiyo gi ngeche.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

kikuyu: Omiyo negimake kane ochopo kama farese donjogo e dala ruoth kendo kanyo ema ne onege.
english: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

kikuyu: to ne wan gi geno ni en e jal mane biro reso jo-Israel. To moloyo bende, kawuono en ndalo adek nyaka ma notimore.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu pod puonjo ei hekalu, nopenjo niya, “Ere kaka Jopuonj Chik nyalo puonjo ni Kristo en wuod Daudi?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone ji duto, kaachiel gi mon, “Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jo-Juda duto modak Misri.
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear the LORD’s word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

kikuyu: Kata kamano in ok niger hekalu, to wuodi, ma en ringri gi rembi iwuon; en ema noger hekalu ni Nyinga.’
english: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa notimo gik moko duto mana kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ochike.
english: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho, ‘Pod odongʼ mana kinde matin, abiro chako yiengo kendo polo kod piny, gi nam, kaachiel gi piny motwo;
english: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

kikuyu: Kaka negisudo machiegni gi dala mane gidhiye, Yesu notimore ka gima pod odwaro dhiyo nyime.
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

kikuyu: Mier madongo mane dhood Benjamin nitierego kaluwore gi anywolagi e magi: Jeriko, Beth Hogla, Emek Keziz,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni awuotho e dier chandruok, to irito ngimana; irieyo lweti kuom mirimb joma kedo koda, kendo iresa gi lweti ma korachwich.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

kikuyu: Nochikowa mondo wayal ni ji kendo mondo watim nende ni en ema Nyasaye oseyiere kaka jangʼad bura mar joma ngima gi joma otho.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ne nyaka kete ochal gi owetene e yore duto, mondo eka obed jadolo maduongʼ ma jakech kendo ma ja-adiera matiyo e nyim Nyasaye, kotimo misango migologo richo mag ji.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

kikuyu: Wasewinjo humbgi, kendo bedewa onge gi teko. Rem malich osemakowa, ka rem mar dhako mamuoch kayo.
english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

kikuyu: kendo sulwe manie polo nolwar e piny mana kaka olemo mag ngʼowu mapok ochiek lwar koa kuom yadhe ka yamo mager kudho.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

kikuyu: Nikech nenorena ni Nyasaye oseketowa wan joote, ka joma odongʼ chien bangʼ ji, kendo mana ka joma osengʼadnegi buch tho mondo onegi e dier pap. Oseketwa wabedo joma piny duto rango kendo malaike kod ji bende rangowa.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

kikuyu: nyaka Jehova Nyasaye migi yweyo, mana kaka osetimoni, kendo nyaka gin bende gikaw mwandu mar piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu dhi miyogi. Bangʼ mano, unyalo dok kendo udagie pinyu owuon, mane Musa, jatich Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou bath aora Jordan ma yo wuok chiengʼ.”
english: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno Ruoth Nyasaye biro mayogi gik ma gilichorego kaka: bangli gi kitembini mag wich kod tigo mag ngʼut,
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel kod Jehoshafat ruodh Juda noyudo orwako lepgi mag ruoth ka moro ka moro kuomgi obet e kom duongʼne e kar dino cham mantie e dhoranga Samaria, kendo ne gin kod jonabi duto mane koro e nyimgi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

kikuyu: Ne ituono joma ool pi modho kendo ne ipando chiemo ne joma odenyo,
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

kikuyu: To ok enokume ka misumbano ochungo oa malo bangʼ ndalo achiel kata ariyo, nimar misumbano en mwandune.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

kikuyu: Tiend wach mopandi mar sulwe abiriyo mane ineno e lweta ma korachwich, kod rachungi teyni abiriyogo mag dhahabu ema: Sulwe abiriyogo e malaike mag kanise abiriyo, to rachungi teyni abiriyo gin e kanise abiriyogo.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

kikuyu: Ne ichweye mapiny ne malaike kendo isesidhone osimbo mar duongʼ kod luor.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Nimar kama mwanduni nitie e kama chunyi bende nobedie.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato kuomu ngʼur gi nyawadgi owetena, nono to ibiro ngʼadnu bura kaka joketho. Neuru ni Jangʼad bura ochungʼ e dhoot!
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

kikuyu: Wuoda, ka chunyi riek, eka chunya biro bedo mamor,
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

kikuyu: Negidwoko niya, “Wadwaro Yesu ma jo-Nazareth.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An e en.” (To Judas mane ndhoge bende nochungʼ kodgi kanyo).
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

kikuyu: E sa ma usedonjo e dala to ubiro yudo kapok oidho odhi malo kama owal mondo ochiem. Ji ok bi chako chiemo nyaka ochopi, nikech nyaka ogwedh gir timo misango eka bangʼe jomo oluongi nyalo chiemo. Returu mapiyo sani ema unyalo yude.
english: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho janabi kama:
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Mano kaka dhok chur! Kweth mag jamni tangni koni gi koni, nikech gionge lek; kata mana kweth mag rombe sandore.
english: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

kikuyu: Ne uneno gik mamono ma gilamo kod kido mag nyisechegi manono molos gi yien kod kite, kaachiel gi mago mag fedha gi dhahabu.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

kikuyu: Elija ne luor kendo noringo nikech ngimane. Kane obiro Bersheba e Juda, noweyo jatichne kanyo,
english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

kikuyu: Sunga omake ma ok onyal manye; onge thuolo kata matin mochiwo ne Nyasaye e chunye.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

kikuyu: Eka ne okawo law mar abola mane olwar koa kuom Elija mi ochwadogo pi kowacho niya, “Ere Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Elija?” Kane ochwado pi, pi nopogore diere tir koni gi koni, mi Elisha nongʼado odhi komachielo.
english: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

kikuyu: Kuom yie nodar e piny Misri, ka ok oluoro mirimb ruoth kendo nodhi nyime gichir mana ka ngʼama oneno Nyasaye ma ok ne.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

kikuyu: eka apoya nono yamo maduongʼ nomwomore koa e piny motimo ongoro kendo nogoyo konde angʼwen mag ot. Odno norwombore kendo giduto gisetho ma an kenda ema asetony mondo anyisi wachni!”
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Kata bedni ilwoko lweti gi magadi kendo itiyo gi sabun mangʼeny, chilo mar ketho mari pod nitiere e nyima,” Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Kain niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo in-gi mirima? Angʼo ma omiyo wangʼi ojuol?
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

kikuyu: Kendo mondo onege e bath kendo mar misango yo nyandwat nyim Jehova Nyasaye, eka jodolo magin yawuot Harun nokir rembgi ewi kendo mar misango bathe koni gi koni.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Josef nongʼiewo lope duto mag Misri ne Farao. Jo-Misri noloko puothegi duto pesa nikech kech ne duongʼ ahinya. Piny Misri duto nobedo mar Farao,
english: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

kikuyu: Daguru ka joma ni thuolo, to kik uti gi thuolo ma un-go obed gima uumogo richou, daguru kaka jotich Nyasaye.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Neye kaka jotend Israel modak e dieru konyore gi tekogi mar chwero remo.
english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

kikuyu: Gisedak e pinyni kendo gisegeroni kama ler mar lemo maluongo Nyingi kagiwacho ni,
english: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

kikuyu: Girkeni mawa osemi jopinje mamoko, to miechwa to osekaw gi ji ma welo.
english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye noneno wach moro morem kuomgi mi owacho niya, “Kinde biro, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ma anatim singruok manyien, gi dhood jo-Israel kod dhood jo-Juda.
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

kikuyu: Eka dhano wuok oko chako tijene, kendo nyagore gi tich nyaka odhiambo.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

kikuyu: Omiyo Saulo noluongo joge Telaim mokwanogi kendo negiromo jolweny alufu mia ariyo mawuotho gi tiendegi to gi alufu apar moa Juda.
english: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

kikuyu: En bende ema nochiwo mich ni ji koyiero jomoko mondo obedi joote, to jomoko jonabi, to moko joland Injili, to jomoko jokwath gi jopuonj,
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

kikuyu: Kik uwe ngʼato angʼata mamor kuom dembruok mar miriambo kod malamo malaike omi ubed maonge pok. Ngʼat makamano wacho mathoth konyiso ji kuom fweny moseneno, kendo pache mar dhano miyo otingʼore malo kowuoyo kuom gik mokia tiendgi.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

kikuyu: “Yaye, mad ngʼato dwoka e ndalona machon kendo kinde mane Nyasaye orita maber,
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

kikuyu: Koro Barzilai ne en jaduongʼ moti ahinya, ma hike ne romo piero aboro. Ne okonyo ruoth gi chiemo e kinde mane en Mahanaim, nimar ne en ngʼat ma jamoko ahinya.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

kikuyu: Pilato nopenjogi niya, “To koro atim angʼo gi Jal muluongo ni ruodh jo-Yahudini?”
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Ne aywak ne Jehova Nyasaye kane chunya lit, kendo ne odwoka mine ogonya thuolo.
english: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

kikuyu: Eka negipenje niya, “Angʼo ma notimoni ma wangʼi oneno? Ere kaka noyawo wengeni?”
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

kikuyu: kinde mar yiecho gimoro kod kinde mar twangʼo, kinde mar lingʼ kod kinde mar wuoyo,
english: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, yie aa kuom wach miwinjo, kendo wach miwinjono en wach Kristo.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

kikuyu: Jadolo nokele e kendo mar misango, kendo nochod wiye, eka owangʼe ewi kendo mar misango, kendo rembe nobii michwer e bath kendo mar misango.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

kikuyu: Ngʼat madwaro ber winjo maber, to kethruok biro ni ngʼatno madware.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

kikuyu: To mon, nyithindo, jamni kod gik moko duto manie iye kawgiuru duto ka gik muyako kendo unyalo kawo gik muyako ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu omiyou koa kuom wasiku.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone niya, “Kik iluor, nimar gadiera abiro timoni tim ngʼwono nikech wuonu Jonathan. Abiro dwokoni puothe duto mane mag kwaru Saulo, kendo inichiem e mesana kinde duto.”
english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

kikuyu: To ka nochopo okinyi ka Nabal kongʼo noserumo e wangʼe, chiege nowachone gik moko duto, mi chunye notho mochalo ka kidi.
english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

kikuyu: Ne ok giparo tekone, kendo ne ok giparo odiechiengʼ mane owarogi e lwet jasigu,
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

kikuyu: Andikonu wechegi kuom jogo matemo mondo owuondu.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Ruoth nobiro irgi kendo duongʼ mar Ruoth Nyasaye norieny, molworogi, mine giluor.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kikuyu: Eka Samson nowacho niya, “Gi chogo mar lemb punda aselokogi punde mangʼeny. Gi chok lemb punda asenego ji alufu achiel.”
english: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”

kikuyu: Puonja mondo ane gik mopondona; kapo asetimo gimoro marach, to ok abi achak atim kamano kendo!’
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

kikuyu: kowacho niya: “Ne aa ei minwa ka an duk, kendo abiro dok ka an aduk. Jehova Nyasaye ema nochiwo kendo Jehova Nyasaye ema osekawo; mad nying Jehova Nyasaye opaki.”
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Kama onge lek, to ji chunygi aa to ngʼama orito chik en ngʼat mogwedhi.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nomulo ringʼo kod makati ma ok oketie thowi gi wi luth mane otingʼo e lwete. Mach nowuok e lwanda, mowangʼo ringʼo kod makati pep. Kendo malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nolal nono e wangʼe.
english: Then the LORD’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the LORD’s angel departed out of his sight.

kikuyu: Omiyo jotich nowuok odhi e yore madongo mag dala mine gichoko ji duto mane ginyalo yudo, joma beyo gi joma richo, mi joma nobiro e arus nopongʼo od budho.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua wuod Nun nooro jonon piny ariyo lingʼ-lingʼ moa Shitim. Nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru, ungʼi pinyni, to moloyo Jeriko.” Omiyo negidhi ma gidonjo e od dhako moro mandhaga ma nyinge Rahab, mi gidak kanyo.
english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

kikuyu: mowachona ni, ‘Kik iluor Paulo, ibiro chopo nyaka nyim Kaisar mi yali kuno, nikech Nyasaye osemiyi kuom ngʼwonone, ngima ji duto makwangʼ kodi.’
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

kikuyu: To bende Adam ok ema ne owuondi, to dhako ema ne owuondi, mi odoko jaketho.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

kikuyu: Koro kane Abner osedwogo Hebron, Joab notere tenge e dhorangach; ka gima odwa wuoyo kode lingʼ-lingʼ. To kendo gikanyo, ema nochuloe kuor mar Asahel, mi Joab nochwowo iye motho.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

kikuyu: Eka napenjo niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, mano notimre nyaka karangʼo?” Kendo nodwoko niya, “Nyaka chop mier madongo ruombre piny madongʼ gunda maonge joma odakie, bende mi udi ma ji odakie ojwangʼ kendo puothe duto kethre mi jwangʼ-gi,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

kikuyu: Nimar timbeni miya mor, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; awer gi mor nikech tije ma lweti otimo.
english: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

kikuyu: To eka ibet e kom duongʼ kaka Ngʼama Ler; in e pak mar jo-Israel.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

kikuyu: Kinde mane en Misri nogombo joma ne timo kode hera, joma duongʼ-gi ne chalo gi mar punda, kendo ma nyodo mane gigolo ne chalo mar faras.
english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

kikuyu: Mano biro miyou thuolo mondo ubednegi joneno.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Asebedo ka awuoyo e lela ni oganda, kendo asebedo ka apuonjo ei sinagoke gi hekalu, kuonde ma jo-Yahudi duto chokoree. Onge gimoro amora masewacho lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Reuben, ma en wuod Israel makayo, ne gin: kokadho kuom Hanok, ne gin joka Hanok; kokadho kuom Palu, ne gin joka Palu;
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

kikuyu: Eka jadolo maduongʼ noyiecho lepe, kowacho niya, “Oseyenyo! Pod wadwaro joneno mamoko nangʼo? Neuru, koro wasewinjo gi itwa ayanjeno.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

kikuyu: Musa ne onono tijno mi oneno ni negisetimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko. Omiyo Musa nogwedhogi.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

kikuyu: Yaye piny, yiengni ka Ruoth Nyasaye ni machiegni kodi, yiengni e nyim Nyasach Jakobo,
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

kikuyu: Omiyo ji duto nodhi Gilgal kendo negiguro Saulo kaka ruoth e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kuno ne gichiwoe misengini mag lalruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Saulo kod Israel noloso budho malich ahinya.
english: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, nyis dhood Israel ngero moro.
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

kikuyu: Isechayo giga maler moket tenge ne tichna kendo isedwanyo Sabato maga.
english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

kikuyu: Ne nitie kendo mar misango molos gi bao ma borne ne oromo fut angʼwen gi nus, to borne modhi malo gi ariwa ne oromo fut adek maromre, kondene gi bathe moriere piny kod bethene nolos gi bao. Ngʼatno nowachona niya, “Ma en mesa manie nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Kik utingʼ gimoro ka udhi e wuoth obed luth kata ofuku kata chiemo, kata pesa, kata law machielo miloko.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

kikuyu: Kane odichienge piero angʼwen kod otieno piero angʼwen oserumo, Jehova Nyasaye nomiya kite mopa ariyo, ma gin kite mag singruok.
english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

kikuyu: “Auru malo e duongʼu ulor piny kendo ubedi e lowo motwo, yaye jodak mar Nyar Dibon, nimar ngʼama oketho Moab nobi mondo oked kodu, kendo otiek miechu madongo mochiel motegno gohinga.
english: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

kikuyu: Omiyo ajuoke, gi jokor wach, gi jorieko ma jo-Kaldea, gi jo-nyakalondo duto nobiro, mine anyisogi lekno, to ne ok ginyal lokona tiende.
english: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told them the dream, but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.

kikuyu: Neginego yawuot Zedekia e wangʼe koneno. Bangʼe negigolo wengene oko magitweye gi nyoroche mag nyinyo mi gitere Babulon.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Nogero mier e gode matindo mag Juda kod kuonde moger motegno mag jolweny gi kuonde moger motingʼore gi malo mag ngʼicho e bunge.
english: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny marito ruoth nomako Seraya jadolo maduongʼ, gi Zefania jadolo maluwe kod ji adek ma jorit dhoot hekalu moterogi e twech.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

kikuyu: Ruodhi ohero joma wacho adiera kendo gigeno ngʼat mawacho adiera.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

kikuyu: Kane Harun oneno kamano, nogero kendo mar misango e nyim nyaroyano kendo nolando niya, “Kiny notim sawo ne Jehova Nyasaye”
english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”

kikuyu: Nimar ji mangʼeny Juda nokwongʼorene, nikech ne en or Shekania wuod Ara, to wuode Jehohanan nonywomo nyar Meshulam wuod Berekia.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro nowachone Yesu niya, “Minu gi oweteni ochungʼ oko, gidwaro neni.”
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

kikuyu: “Kik iluor; yaye jatichna Jakobo; bende kik ibwogi, yaye Israel. Adiera abiro resi e piny mabor, kaachiel gi nyikwayi e piny mane otergie twech. Jakobo nodhi nyime ka nigi kwe gi dak maonge luoro, kendo onge ngʼama nobwoge.
english: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

kikuyu: Jodolo, jonabi kod ji duto nowinjo Jeremia kawacho wechegi e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: kendo nochiko mondo opuonj jo-Juda wend ywak mar atungʼ mondiki e Kitabu mar Jasher kama:
english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

kikuyu: Kane osepongʼ to joywecho noywaye nyaka e dho nam. Eka negibedo piny mi gichoko rech mabeyo duto giketo ei okepni, to maricho to giwito.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

kikuyu: “Ngʼatni wuoyo nade? Oyanyo Nyasaye! Ere ngʼat manyalo weyone ngʼato richone makmana Nyasaye kende?”
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

kikuyu: kendo ka uwacho ni, ‘Ooyo, wanadhi kendo wadag Misri, kama ok wana neye lweny kata winjo turumbete kata bedo gi kech mar makati,’
english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there we will dwell;”’

kikuyu: Ne uneno ka kuonde mangʼeny mar ohinga mar Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi omukore, omiyo ne uchiko pi odhi e soko mamwalo.
english: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

kikuyu: Joab nodhi kama dhakono ne nitie, mi nopenjo niya, “In e Joab?” Nodwoke niya, “En an.” Nowachone niya, “Chik iti ni gima jatichni dwaro wachoni.” Joab nowacho niya, “Awinjo.”
english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”

kikuyu: Oyundi abich donge ingʼiewo otonglo ariyo kende? To kata kamano kata achiel kuomgi wi Nyasaye ok wilgo.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

kikuyu: Pilato nodwokogi niya, “Kawuru jarito mondo udhi urit liel kaka un ema ungʼeyo uwegi.”
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi moko ma notamore yie kuom Yesu noketho chuny joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo negiketo kwiri marach e chunygi, mondo giked gi jowete.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

kikuyu: Eka naneno ondiek malichno gi ruodhi mag piny kod ogendinigi mag lweny kochokore kaachiel mondo giked gi Jal moidho faras kod ogandane mar lweny.
english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

kikuyu: To negimedo jaro joote Nyasaye ka gichayo wechene kendo ka ginyiero jonabi mage nyaka mirima nomako Jehova Nyasaye kod joge maonge kaka dikony.
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until the LORD’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

kikuyu: “En ohala manade miyudo kuom nyiseche manono nimar dhano ema opayogi? Kata kido mapuonjo miriambo? Ngʼat malose oketo genone, kuom gima oloso owuon; oloso nyiseche manono ma ok nyal wuoyo.
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

kikuyu: To ka en wangʼi ema miyo itimo richo to lodhe oko. Ber moloyo kidonjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye gi wangʼ achiel kar bedo gi wenge ariyo to owiti e gehena,
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

kikuyu: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain kod Rimon. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo piero ariyo gochiko.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

kikuyu: Jonjoregi monja gie batha korachwich; gichikona obadho, kendo gikunyona buche mondo apodhie.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

kikuyu: Nimar joma nok modongʼ nowuog Jerusalem, kendo oganda mar joma otony nowuogi koa e Got Sayun. Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, notim ma kuom tekone owuon.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.’

kikuyu: Koro Hiram noseoro ni ruoth dhahabu maromo kilo alufu angʼwen.
english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

kikuyu: Nikech chunye wuonde kendo owuondore kende, chunye wuonde ma ok onyal neno richone mosin-go.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

kikuyu: Lewnigo nyaka gilosi gi dhahabu, gi law man-gi range marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kikuyu: Bende nogero Baalath kaachiel gi mier duto madongo mag keno kod mier duto madongo mag geche lweny to gi faresegi, Solomon nogero gimoro amora mane odwaro gero Jerusalem gi Lebanon kod gwenge duto mane nitie e bwo lochne.
english: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno waherreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato nikech hera aa kuom Nyasaye. Ngʼat man gihera en nyathi Nyasaye kendo ongʼeyo Nyasaye.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

kikuyu: To ma e gima Kristo owuon nosingore ni nomiwa, ma en ngima mochwere.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

kikuyu: kendo ka ineno dhako moro ma jaber e kind mon momaki, ma idwaro kendo to inyalo kawe obed chiegi.
english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

kikuyu: Hilkia jadolo maduongʼ nowachone Shafan ma jagoro niya, “Aseyudo kitap chike e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.” Nomiye mosome.
english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

kikuyu: to kara ngʼeuru ni Nyasaye osechwanya kendo gogo mare osemaka.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

kikuyu: “Piaguru aserni, kauru okumbini! Jehova Nyasaye osethuwo ruodhi mag Media kodgi, nikech chenro mare en ketho Babulon. Jehova Nyasaye nochul kuor ni hekalu mare.
english: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! The LORD has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Ondiegi noywagre kuondegi mane gigeno, kibwe to noywe e ute mabeyo mag ruoth. Ndalo mag Babulon osekayo machiegni ma ok notony.
english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

kikuyu: Ogendini ma uriworugo biro sembou nyaka giko mar tongʼ; osiepeu biro wuondou ma lowu; kendo joma chamo chiembu biro ketonu obadho, to ok unufweny.”
english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

kikuyu: Yaye, mad warruok mar Israel obi koa Sayun! Kinde ma Jehova Nyasaye duogo ne joge mwandugi, onego joka Jakobo obed moil kendo Israel obed mamor!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Koth bende nigi wuon mare? Wuon thoo mamoko e lum en ngʼa?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Shela, Arfaksad nodak kuom higni mia angʼwen gadek kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Isedaga. Isiko mana kibaro iweyo yo. Omiyo anaket lweta kuomi kendo tieki; ok anatimni ngʼwono kendo.
english: You have rejected me,” says the LORD. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.

kikuyu: To Abiathar wuod Ahimelek ma wuod Ahitub notony moringo odhi ir Daudi.
english: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mongʼeyo chikena kendo orito, e ngʼama ohera. Ngʼat mohera, Wuora biro hero, kendo an bende abiro here, mi afwenyrane.”
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

kikuyu: Eka Pilato nodok e ode, kendo noluongo Yesu ire mopenje niya, “In e ruodh jo-Yahudi?”
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa niya,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

kikuyu: Pile ka pile ne aoro jotijena ma jonabi duto iru. Negiwacho niya, “Uduto nyaka uwe yoreu mamono kendo ulok timbeu; kik ulu bangʼ nyiseche manono mondo utinegi. Eka udag e piny ma asemiyou kod wuoneu.” To pod ok uchiko itu kata winja.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them. Then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers;’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

kikuyu: Iningʼigi angʼiya gi wengeni kendo inine kikumo joma timbegi richo.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro dak e kind jo-Israel bende ok anajwangʼ joga Israel.”
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

kikuyu: Kendo mad wechenagi maselamo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, obed machiegni gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa odiechiengʼ gotieno, mondo okony jatichne kendo okony joge Israel kaluwore gi dwaro mar odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ;
english: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

kikuyu: Jeroboam wuod Nebat ma ja-Efraim moa Zereda kendo ma min mare niluongo ni Zeruya ne en dhako ma chwore otho bende nongʼanyo ni ruoth. Ne en achiel kuom jodong Solomon.
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

kikuyu: Malaika ma oseresa e chandruok duto mad gwedh raweregi. Mad nyinga kod nying Ibrahim kwara kod Isaka wuora sik kuomgi, kendo gimedre gibed oganda maduongʼ e piny.”
english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”

kikuyu: Koro ruodhi abichgo noringo kendo gipondo e rogo mantiere Makeda.
english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

kikuyu: kane timbeni maricho pok oel. To kata kamano, sani koro ochayi gi nyi Edom kaachiel gi joma odak bute kod nyi jo-Filistia, jogo duto modak e alwora mari ochayi.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

kikuyu: Tuo noneg joma otony e lweny, kendo mon ma chwogi otho ma giweyo ok noywag-gi.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

kikuyu: an Daniel nafwenyo tiend Ndiko, kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye mane oyudo osemiyo Janabi Jeremia, ni kethruok mar Jerusalem biro tieko higni piero abiriyo.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

kikuyu: ka gitego chuny jopuonjre kendo gijiwogi mondo gisiki e yie. Negipuonjogi kagiwacho niya, “Wan duto nyaka wane sand mathoth eka wadonji e pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: En ema nyaka omed yudo duongʼ moloyo, to an nyaka adog piny.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

kikuyu: kod un yawuowi matindo gi nyiri matindo, gi jodongo kod nyithindo.
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wabiro tho! Waserwenyo, kendo wan duto waselal!
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane obirone Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gabiriyo mar twech Jehoyakin ruodh Juda, e higa mane Evil-Merodak obedo ruodh Babulon, nogonyo Jehoyakin ruodh Juda kendo oweye thuolo koa e od twech e odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo gabich mar dwe mar apar gariyo.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mana kaka Sodom gi Gomora nokethi, kaachiel gi mier mokiewo kodgi, e kaka en bende nobedi maonge ngʼato angʼata modak kanyo kendo.
english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

kikuyu: Gikanyono Yesu noluongogi, kendo ne giweyo wuon-gi ma Zebedi e yie, kaachiel gi jotich mane konyogi, mi giluwe.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ja-Benjamin moro mongʼere ma nyinge Kish wuod Abiel, ma wuod Zeror, ma wuod Bekorath, ma wuod Afia ma ja-Benjamin.
english: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Roho noyudha kendo malaika nokawa motera e thim. Mana gikanyono naneno dhako moro koidho ondiek malich makwar, ma dende duto nochadhore gi nyinge mag ayany, kendo ne en gi wiye abiriyo kod tunge apar.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane okete jarit piny? En ngʼa mane oketo piny duto e bwo tekone?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

kikuyu: Kuom mano unyiso ni uyie gi gima kwereu notimo, neginego jonabi, to un to koro umwono lietegi.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

kikuyu: Weche mag muomruok chwoyo chuny mana kaka ligangla, to lew ngʼat mariek kelo ngima.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

kikuyu: Ne abedo mamor kuom ngʼeyo ni nyithindi moko wuotho e adiera ka giluwo chik mane wayudo kuom Wuoro.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

kikuyu: Gima waneno sani chal mana gi kido matip-tip mineno e rangʼi, to chiengʼno wananene wangʼ gi wangʼ. Gima angʼeyo sani en mana bath adiera, to chiengʼno anangʼe Nyasaye malongʼo chuth, mana kaka en bende ongʼeya.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

kikuyu: Chutho, yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan, moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye!”
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Nochako openjogi niya, “En ngʼa mudwaro?” Kendo neginwoyone niya, “Wadwaro Yesu ma jo-Nazareth.”
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Kel misango mar cham molos gi gigi ne Jehova Nyasaye, kele ne jadolo, mabiro chiwe e kendo mar misango.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nochako okulore e nyim jo-Hiti,
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

kikuyu: Ruoth nobwok motetni. Noidho malo e ot man ewi rangach mi oywak. Noywak kowacho niya, “Yaye wuoda Abisalom, wuoda, wuoda Abisalom! Onego an ema ne atho kari, yaye Abisalom wuoda, wuoda!”
english: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

kikuyu: Eka Amazia nowachone Amos niya, “Dhi kucha, jakoroni! Dhiyo e piny jo-Juda mondo ikor weche kuno eka iyudgo kaka dichiem.
english: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,

kikuyu: Nodonjo iye nyaka Kama Ler Moloyo, to ne ok odhi gi remb diek gi rwedhi. Notimo misango dichiel kendo mogik gi rembe owuon ma nokelonwago warruok mosiko.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar ariyo negilworo dala maduongʼno dichiel bangʼe gidok e kambi kendo negitimo kamano kuom ndalo auchiel.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

kikuyu: Un nyi Jerusalem, asiemou gi nying nyakech kod mwanda manie e thim, ni kik utug hera kata chiewe ka sa ne pok oromo.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love, until it so desires.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ngʼat ma wuoyo gi dhok moro amora ma ji kia, olem mondo obed gi nyalo mar loko tiend gik mowacho.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

kikuyu: Kendo jo-Israel nodwaro wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye. (E ndalogo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Nyasaye ne ni kanyo,
english: The children of Israel asked the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

kikuyu: Mana kaka wenge wasumbini rango lwet ruodhgi, kendo kaka wenge jatich ma nyako mar ot rango lwet ruodhe madhako, e kaka wengewa rango Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nyaka chop okechwa.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “In ok inyal dhi kedo gi ja-Filistia nikech in mana rawera, to en to osebedo kokedo chakre tin-ne.”
english: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”

kikuyu: Kata giyie winji kata gidagi, nikech gin anywola ma jongʼanyo, to gibiro ngʼeyo ni janabi moro osebet e diergi.
english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi nokawo mula mogundho chakre Teba nyaka Berothai mane gin miech Hadadezer.
english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

kikuyu: Tim makare nobed okanda mare kendo adiera nobed misip motweyo e nungone.
english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

kikuyu: Kane ginyiso Sisera ni Barak wuod Abinoam nosedhi Got Tabor,
english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

kikuyu: Kaponi ochiwe ka Higa mar Piero Abich oserumo, to jadolo mondo okwan higni modongʼ nyaka chop ndalo mar Higa mar Piero Abich, kendo nengone obed mana maromo gi higni modongʼ-go.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko niya, “Ooyo owetena, ok onego utim kamano gi gik ma Jehova Nyasaye osemiyowa. Oseritowa mi ochiwonwa joma nomonjowa.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nosekwongʼore e piny Mizpa niya, “Onge kata achiel kuomwa mabiro chiwo nyare mondo okendi gi ja-Benjamin.”
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

kikuyu: Koro gima onego utim ema: Achiel kuom adek mar jodolo kod jo-Lawi mabiro dhiyo e tich chiengʼ Sabato biro rito dhoudi,
english: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

kikuyu: An Johana ma owadu, ma bende achiel kodu e sand gi pinyruoth kod dhil e kinda marwa kuom Yesu, ne an e chula mar Fatimo nikech wach Nyasaye, kod timo neno kuom Yesu.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kawuono e dwe mar Abib, ema uwuokie.
english: Today you go out in the month Abib.

kikuyu: Eka Eliakim wuod Hilkia, Shebna kod Joa nowachone Rabshake jatend lweny niya, “Yie iwuo gi jotichni gi dho jo-Aram, nimar wawinjo dhokno. We wuoyo kodwa gi dho jo-Hibrania nikech joma ni e ohinga nyalo winjo gik miwachonwa.”
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

kikuyu: Kaka Jotich kaachiel gi Nyasaye wakwayou mondo kik ukaw ngʼwono mar Nyasaye ma osemiyou ka gir tugo.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

kikuyu: To Neko noorone joote mondo owachne niya, “En angʼo ma walaro kodi yaye ruodh Juda? In ok ema abiro amonji e kindeni, to amonjo dhoot ma wakedogo. Nyasaye osenyisa mondo atim piyo omiyo kik ipiem gi Nyasaye ma jakora ka ok kamano to obiro tieki.”
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Manase: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Ne, anami jogi cham chiemo makech kendo modh pi sum.
english: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

kikuyu: Chik ji ka ipuonjogi wechegi.
english: Command and teach these things.

kikuyu: Ka anyiso ngʼat makare ni kuom adier obiro bedo mangima, kaeto ngʼatno ogeno timne makareno kendo otimo richo, to gik mosetimo mabeyogo duto ok nopar. Enotho nikech gima rach mosetimo.
english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

kikuyu: To Juda nodwoke niya, “Singo mar angʼo ma idwaro?” To Tamar nodwoke niya, “Miya banglinino gi tonde kod luth manie lwetino.” Kuom mano Juda nomiyo Tamar chi wuode gigo kendo noriwore kode mi Tamar nomako ich kod Juda kwar mare.
english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

kikuyu: Nyithinda mageno, kik wawach mana gi dhowa ni wahero ji, to waher ji gi tim kendo gi adiera.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

kikuyu: Eka noyangʼ rwadhno kaka misango miwangʼo pep kendo enopoge matindo tindo.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma janyiego kendo machulo kuor. Jehova Nyasaye chulo kuor kendo en gi mirima. Jehova Nyasaye chulo kuor ne joma kwede kendo kumne osiko kuom jowasike.
english: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

kikuyu: Nomuko kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo, mi otoyo kite milamo kendo ongʼado sirni milamo mag Ashera. Ne otoyo matindo tindo thuond mula mane Musa oloso, nikech nyaka chop ndalono jo-Israel nosebedo kawangʼo ne ubani (ne iluonge ni Nehushtan).
english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

kikuyu: To Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Ruodha, ingʼeyo ni nyithindogi pod tindo to bende nyaka wapar nyithi rombe kod nyiroye ma pod dhoth. Kaponi osembgi matek odiechiengʼ achiel to jamni duto nyalo tho.
english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni irito chikena, kwe mari domol mana ka aora, kendo timni makare digingre mana ka apaka mar nam.
english: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

kikuyu: Kaponi odhi mopondo e dala moro, to jo-Israel duto nokel tonde e dalano kendo wanaywa ohinga mar dalano mi wamuke kwatere e holo ma kata mana bathe matin ok noyudi.”
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka tere mar dhahabu kata tigo mar dhahabu maber e kaka siem mar ngʼat mariek mokwerogo ngʼat machiko ite.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

kikuyu: Jogi nigi teko mar loro polo mondo koth kik chue e ndalo ma gihuloe wach. To bende gin gi teko mar loko pi obed remo kendo kelo tuoche yembe mopogore opogore e piny e kinde mora amora magidwaro.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juta,
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

kikuyu: Ka uparo ni udwaro chalo gi ogendini mamoko, kata ka dhoudi moa e pinje mamoko malamo gik mopa ma gin bao kod kidi, to mano ok bi timore.
english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’

kikuyu: Negiwuok Kibroth Hatava mi gibworo Hazeroth.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Jaote mane odhi luongo Mikaya nowachone niya, “Jonabi duto osekoro wach achiel machalre, kagiwacho ni gima ber biro timore ni ruoth. In bende yie ikor wach maber kaka gisekorono.”
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

kikuyu: Kech ok nokagi ngangʼ kendo bende kata riyo ok nomak gi kendo. Liet mar wangʼ chiengʼ ok norieny kuomgi kata liet moro mager ok nowangʼ-gi.
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

kikuyu: Bangʼe Farao nogolo chik ne joge kowacho niya, “Nyathi ma wuowi moro amora monywol nyaka udir e aora Nael, to nyithindo ma nyiri to uwe odongi.”
english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”

kikuyu: Lembi nenore maber ka sitadi olierie; ngʼuti bende nenore maber ka olierie tigo ma nengogi tek.
english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

kikuyu: Jo-Midian nokelone jo-Israel dhier maduongʼ mane giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi.
english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.

kikuyu: “To kapok magi duto otimore, to gibiro makou kendo sandou. Giniteru e sinagoke kod ute mag twech, kendo nokelu e nyim ruodhi gi jotelo, to mago duto notim nikech nyinga.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: kuom mano ka otimo richo kendo odoko jaketho, to nyaka odwok gima osekwalo kata mochamo malangʼ, kata gima ne osingne, kata gima ne okwanyo molal,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

kikuyu: Kendo inibed gi chandruok e kar dakna kata obedo ni jo-Israel none ber to ei anywolani to onge ngʼat manodag amingʼa mabed moti.
english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

kikuyu: Omiyo kit terruok mari opogore adier gi terruok mag ji mamoko, nikech in ok chwo manyi mondo ichopnegi gombogi. Ipogori ndi, nikech in ema ichulo ji mondo oterre kodi to in ok gichuli.
english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

kikuyu: Eka apoya nono dhakono nowuok mondo oromne, korwakore kaka ochot mopongʼ gi paro marach.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

kikuyu: Keturu tenge ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu jamni duto machwo mokwong nywolo e kweth jambu. Kik uket rwedhi ma dhou okwongo nywolo e jok bende kik ungʼad yie rombu mokwong nywolo.
english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

kikuyu: kuom Kerioth gi Bozra, kuom mier duto mag Moab, man mabor kod mago man machiegni.
english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

kikuyu: Gimachielo mutimo ema: Upongʼo kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye gi pi wangʼu. Uywak kendo udengo nikech Jehova Nyasaye ok dew misengni ma umiye, kata bedo mamor gi gik moa lwetu.
english: “This again you do: you cover the LORD’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

kikuyu: Ka achien richono ofwenyore, to nyaka gichiw nyarwath mitimogo misango mar golo richo, kendo gikel nyarwath e nyim Hemb Romo.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Bangʼe yawuote nokelone remo, mi onyumoe lith lwete, nomienogo tunge mag kendo mar misango, eka remo modongʼ to ne opuko e tiend kendo mar misango.
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

kikuyu: Abiro miyo pinyno lokore gunda, kendo tekre mosungorego biro rumo, kendo gode mag Israel nobed moyugno maonge ngʼama nyalo wuothe mi ngʼadi.
english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

kikuyu: Omiyo aa malo, wamonjgi gotieno kendo waketh ohingane motegno!”
english: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Rael chi Jakobo ne gin: Josef kod Benjamin.
english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Winjuru, yaye jo-Israel, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, en Jehova Nyasaye achiel.
english: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, osekwongʼore kosingore owuon niya, “Asin gi sunga mar joka Jakobo, kendo asin nyaka gi ohinga mag-gi moger motegno; omiyo abiro chiwo dalagi kod gik moko manie iye e lwet wasigu.”
english: “The Lord GOD has sworn by himself,” says the LORD, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.

kikuyu: Ruoth ma dhako mar piny ma milambo nochungʼ chiengʼ bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo enongʼadnegi bura kaka joketho, nimar nobiro koa e tungʼ piny kuma bor mondo owinj rieko Solomon, to sani koro nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo Solomon.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo ngʼeyo dweche ma igi pongʼie? Bende ingʼeyo sa ma ginywolie?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

kikuyu: Nyasacha e lwandana, kuome ema apondoe, kendo en e okumbana kendo en e teko mar warruokna. En e ohingana, kar pondana, kendo jawarna en ema oresa kuom jo-mahundu.
english: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo kwerewa noneg gi ligangla kendo yawuotwa gi nyiwa gi mondwa oter e twech.
english: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokendo Maaka nyar Abisalom mane onywolone Abija, Atai, Ziza kod Shelomith.
english: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

kikuyu: Farao nomiyo Abram rit maber nikech Sarai, kendo nomiyo Abram rombe, dhok, pundane machwo gi mamon, wasumbini machwo gi mamon kod ngamia.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona niya, “Aseneno jogi, kendo gin joma tokgi tek adier!
english: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

kikuyu: E kindeno ka ngʼato owachonu ni, ‘Ne, Kristo ni ka!’ kata ni, ‘Ne, En kucha!’ to kik uyie wachno.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Ot mogero yomyom ka mbuyi mar otiengʼ, kata ka abila ma jarito ogero.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

kikuyu: An, owetena kod joga bende waholo ji pesa kod cham to ok wakaw ohala, omiyo hola midwoko gohala nyaka rum!
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

kikuyu: Chikni oket ne jo-Israel duto gi jopinje mamoko duto machalre.”
english: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

kikuyu: An to apongʼ gi teko, apongʼ gi Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye, kod adiera kod nyalo mar hulo ne joka Jakobo kethogi, mar nyiso jo-Israel richogi gi kethogi.
english: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato ochiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye bath lope moro, to nyaka nengone romre gi nengo kodhi ma inyalo chwo e puodhono. Nengo kodhi mar shairi midhi chwo e lowono nyaka rom abiriyo ma en shekel piero abich mar fedha.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Bende ne afwenyo ni bath pok mane oket ne jo-Lawi ne pod ok omigi, to kendo ni jo-Lawi gi jower mane ochungʼ ne tich nosedok e puothegi giwegi.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

kikuyu: Negidwoko niya, “En morwa mondo wachiwgi.” Omiyo ne gipedho nanga, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nodiro stadi koa kuom gik mane giyako e nangano.
english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

kikuyu: Nonreuru ane ka bende un gi yie. Adier, ngʼireuru ane uwegi! Bende un gi ratiro adier ni Yesu Kristo ni eiu, makmana ka uonge yie?
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

kikuyu: Donge en ni mondo upog chiembu ne joma kech kayo kendo urwak joma odhier maonge kuonde dak, bende ni mondo umi joma wuotho duk lewni, kendo kik upand wangʼu ne wedeu?
english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

kikuyu: Omiyo thoro marwa maduongʼ en mondo watim dwarone, bed ni pod wan e ringruogni kata ka wasetho.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo nowachone ruoth niya, “Ngʼatni onego negi. Onyoso chuny jolweny modongʼ e dala maduongʼ ni, kaachiel gi ji duto, gi gigo mowachonegi. Ngʼatni ok dwar dhi maber mar jogi to mana kethruokgi.”
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ podho, Abram nogore e nindo matut kendo mudho mandiwa noime.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nowachona ni, ‘Ok iniger ot miluonge Nyinga nikech in jalweny kendo isechwero remo.’
english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik iyie mondo dhano olochi; ne ni ogendini ongʼadnegi bura e nyimi.
english: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ ji ne medo biro ir Daudi mondo okonye, nyaka nobedo gi jolweny mangʼeny machalo gi jolweny mag Nyasaye.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

kikuyu: To ere kaka anyalo tingʼo chandruoku, tingʼ magu mapek kod dondruokgo kenda awuon.
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

kikuyu: Mapiyo bangʼ ka janabi Hanania ne oseturo jok e ngʼut janabi Jeremia, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: Ma en wach madiera mowinjore ji oyiego chuth,
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Dhiyo e kar dak mar ruodh Juda kendo iland wachni kanyo:
english: The LORD said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:
