kikuyu: Ka janeno ma ja-miriambo ochungʼ mondo odonjne ja-mahundu,
english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Emomiyo amon gi jonabi makwalo weche ma giwacho ni oa kuoma e kindgi giwegi.”
english: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.

kikuyu: Kane ia malo mondo ingʼad bura, yaye Nyasaye, mondo ikony ji duto mawinjo marach e piny. Sela
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Joma noketo lwetgi kaka joneno e magi: Nehemia ma jatelo maduongʼ, ma wuod Hakalia. Zedekia,
english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

kikuyu: Luoro onge e hera; hera mar adier riembo luoro oko nikech luoro ema kelo kum. Ngʼat man-gi luoro pok ochopo e hera mar adier.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

kikuyu: Nimar adiera kinde biro ma anakum nyiseche manono mag Babulon; pinye duto nobed gi wichkuot kendo joge duto mosenegi nolware iye.
english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

kikuyu: pok aweyo goyo erokamano ni Nyasaye nikech un, ka aparou e lemona.
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: Nomedo wachone niya, “To yie itimna kwayo achiel kende. Miya dweche ariyo mondo aba ewi gode kendo aywagi gi osiepena, nikech ok bi kenda.”
english: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Ahaz nogolo gik moko michungogo besen kogolo kuom mago minyalo gol kuondegi. Bende nogolo gima ne iluongo ni Nam kuom mula molos ka rwath mane osire, mokete kar kende e kidi.
english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

kikuyu: Nogore piny, mi owinjo dwol moro kawachone niya, “Saulo, Saulo, isanda nangʼo?”
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

kikuyu: Kik uwe Hezekia hou mondo ugen kuom Jehova Nyasaye kowachonu ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye biro resowa adier, kendo dala maduongʼni ok nochiw e lwet ruodh Asuria.’
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: To kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, ne ok ukawo piny jo-Amon moro amora kata mana piny mokiewo gi Jabok kata mago molworo dalane manie gode.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Onge ngʼama kare, onge kata achiel;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

kikuyu: “Koro aketo singruokna kodu gi nyikwau,
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

kikuyu: Kuom joma nodhi nono pinyno, Joshua wuod Nun kod Kaleb wuod Jefune kende ema notony.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

kikuyu: Samuel nobedo jangʼad bura e piny Israel e ndalo duto mag ngimane.
english: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Gehazi nyiso ruoth kaka ne Elisha ochiero ngʼato motho, to dhako mane Elisha ochiero wuode cha nochopo kanyo mondo okwa ruoth odwokne ode kod lope. Eka Gehazi nowachone ruoth niya, “Ruodha, ma e dhakono, kendo ma e wuode mane Elisha odwogone ngimane.”
english: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ruoth Belshazar nomedo bedo maluor, kendo lela wangʼe nomedo jowore, kendo jodonge nodhier nono.
english: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

kikuyu: Nyasache nyise yo monego oluw kendo puonje yo maber.
english: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.

kikuyu: Lopno, to chalo nade? En lowo mamiyo koso motwo? Bende en gi yiende koso oongego? Temuru beru mondo ukel olembe moko mag pinyno.” (Ndalono ne en kinde keyo mokwongo mar mzabibu.)
english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

kikuyu: Bedo gi chiemo moromo lwedo achiel gi chuny mokwe ber moloyo bedo gi chiemo moromo lwedo ariyo gi tich matek, mature kayiem nono.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

kikuyu: nimar otieko riyo mar joma riyo oloyo kendo omiyo joma odenyo yiengʼ gi gik mabeyo.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

kikuyu: An Paulo ngʼat motwe nikech Kristo Yesu kod owadwa Timotheo, Wandikoni osiepwa mwageno kendo jatich wadwa Filemon,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Ahaz nokawo gik moko mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye gi od ruoth kod ute joka ruoth momiyo ruodh Asuria to mano ne ok okonye.
english: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the LORD’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Dina, nyar Jakobo mane Lea onywolone nodhi limo nyi pinyno.
english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka Uzia wuon mare nosetimo, to mopogore kod wuon mare ne ok odonjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Kata kamano ji nosiko katimo timbe maricho.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into the LORD’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Miwero gi gig wer man-gi tondegi. Kaluwore gi sheminith. Zaburi Mar Daudi. Kik ikwera, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ka iyi owangʼ kata kum kik ikuma ka mirima omaki.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

kikuyu: Daudi kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Baala e piny Juda, ma bende iluongo ni Kiriath Jearim mondo giom Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, mobet e kind kerubi, en sanduku mar muma miluongo gi nyinge.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

kikuyu: kod rwedhi ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe abich mahikgi oromo higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Magi e misengini mane Nashon wuod Aminadab ogolo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: “To An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mane ogolou ua e piny Misri. Ok unyal yango Nyasaye moro amora ma ok An, onge Jawar machielo makmana An.
english: “Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

kikuyu: Polo ne mil kendo mor kariadore koa e kom duongʼno, E nyim kom duongʼno ne nitie teyni abiriyo maliel. Magi e roho abiriyo mag Nyasaye.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Dhi ir Farao mondo iwachne kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Hibrania wacho: “We joga odhi mondo olama!”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Giko gik moko duto chiegni. Emomiyo beduru gi paro maler kendo ritreuru mondo ulam.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

kikuyu: To kata mana kinyne, ma en chiengʼ mar ariyo mar dwe, kom Daudi ne pod ninono. Eka Saulo nowachone Jonathan wuode niya, “Angʼo momiyo wuod Jesse ok obiro e chiemo, chakre nyoro nyaka kawuono?”
english: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”

kikuyu: Joel, Jehu wuod Joshibia, ma wuod Seraya ma wuod Asiel,
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

kikuyu: Wach nofwenyore kuom jo-Moab ni: Ar manie Moab okethi, omuke ei otieno achiel! Kir manie Moab bende okethi, omuke ei otieno achiel!
english: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo adiera bedo tol mipimogo kendo tim makare kaka rapim mirieyogo ot; to kodh pe biro yweyo karu mar pondo, un jo-miriambo kendo pi biro pongʼo kuondeu mag tony.
english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ruoth, jatichna aweyo koriere piny dala, ka ok onyal chuth, kendo kowinjo marach moloyo.”
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

kikuyu: E thuolono jadolo maduongʼ nomiyo Yesu penjo kuom wach jopuonjrene kod puonjne.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kod Harun niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: mondo openje niya, “In e jalno mane onego obi, koso warit ngʼat machielo?”
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Kane Sila gi Timotheo obiro koa Makedonia, Paulo nochiwore ni tich mar lando Injili kende ma ok oriwo gi gimachielo; kotimo neno ne jo-Yahudi ni Yesu e Kristo.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka orito ogendini kendo omiyogi chiemo mogundho.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Yesu ne lamo kamoro. Kane otieko, achiel kuom jopuonjrene nowachone niya, “Ruoth, puonjwa lamo, kaka Johana bende nopuonjo jopuonjrene.”
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

kikuyu: Miriambo ne ok owuok e dhogi, bende gionge gi ketho moro amora.
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Punon mi gibworo Oboth.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Ne antie kane oketo polo kama entie, kata kane oketo giko mar nembe,
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nowacho niya, “Ne, Ruoth, ligengni ariyo eri ni ka.” Nodwoko niya, “Mano oromo.”
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

kikuyu: Achien bangʼe matin, ngʼat moro nonene kendo nowacho niya, “In bende in achiel kuomgi.” Petro nodwoko niya, “Omera, ok an.”
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

kikuyu: Chutho, Judas ne en achiel kuomwa, kendo en bende ne en-gi kare e tichwani.”
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

kikuyu: Jodongo onge e dhoranga dala maduongʼ; kendo jomatindo oseweyo wero wendegi.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Salu ne en Kalai; koa e anywola Amok ne en Eber;
english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

kikuyu: Dhakono nonywolo wuowi kendo nochake ni Samson. Nodongo kendo Jehova Nyasaye nogwedhe,
english: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

kikuyu: Kinyne ne wagowo Sidon, kendo kanyo Julias notimo ngʼwono ni Paulo mi nomiye thuolo mar dhi ir osiepene mondo gimiye gik mane ochando.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

kikuyu: “In e Jehova Nyasaye, mane oyiero Abram mi igole oa Ur mar jo-Kaldea bangʼe imiye nying ni Ibrahim.
english: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo usungoru kuom holo mau, sungruok kuom holo mau manyak? Yaye nyako ma ok ja-ratiro, igeno kuom mwandu magi kendo iwacho niya, Ngʼama biro monja?
english: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’

kikuyu: Anami nyikwayi bed mangʼeny mana ka buru mae lowo; ma ka ngʼato nyalo kwano buru, to nyikwayi bende inyalo kwan.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dwe mar aboro, dwe mane oyiero en owuon, notimo misengini e kendo mar misango mane oloso Bethel. Kamano bende noketo nyasi mar sawo ni jo-Israel mi nodhi e kendo mar misango mondo otim misengini.
english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

kikuyu: Nimar daher mondo an awuon ema okwongʼa kendo ongʼad kara oko kuom Kristo, nikech wach owetena, kendo ogandana korka ringruok, ma gin jo-Israel.
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

kikuyu: Palal wuod Uzai nogedo komanyore gi kama ohinga ogomogo kod kama oger motingʼore gi malo kochakore ewi od ruoth machiegni gi kama jarito betie. Pedaya wuod Parosh,
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

kikuyu: Anagengʼ kute ma ok noketh chambu, kendo mzabibu manie puotheu olembgi ok notow mi lwar kapok ochiek,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ne oketo Karaya Maduongʼ e bathe ma yo milambo momanyo kind yo wuok chiengʼ kod milambo.
english: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

kikuyu: Eliazar notho kapok onywolo yawuowi, ne en mana gi nyiri kende. Owetegi ma yawuot Kish nokendogi.
english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

kikuyu: Nikech joma nindo, nindo gotieno, kendo joma mer bende mer gotieno.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek, e dwe mar angʼwen, e odiechiengʼ mar abich, kane an kod joma ni e twech e bath Aora mar Kebar, polo ne oyawore mi naneno fweny moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

kikuyu: Koro abiro nyiso ayanga gombo mare mar chode e lela e nyim joherane; kendo onge ngʼama nogole e lweta.
english: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.

kikuyu: Eka Gideon nobiro mi owachone jo-Sukoth niya, “Eri Zeba gi Zalmuna, mane osemiyo uchaya kuwacho ni, ‘Bende usemako Zeba gi Zalmuna? Ere kaka dwami jolweny magi moolgi makati?’ ”
english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

kikuyu: Negitemo mondo gitiek ngimana ka giluta ei bur; kendo negibaya gi kite;
english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

kikuyu: Koro gidigni e wangʼ yore ka joma muofni. Gidwanyore gi remo maonge ngʼato madihedhre mulo lepgi.
english: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

kikuyu: Mijamin, Moadia, Bilga,
english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni chokegi: Abiro kudho much ngima kuomu, mi unudok mangima.
english: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

kikuyu: Kane malaika mane wuoyo kodeno osedhi, Kornelio noluongo jotichne ariyo kod achiel kuom jolweny modimbore ma en achiel kuom jomane rite.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

kikuyu: Kane waa kanyo, ne wadhi nyaka Filipi, mane en dala maduongʼ e bath piny Makedonia ma kono, kendo joma odakie ne ni e bwo loch jo-Rumi. Kanyo ne wadakie kuom ndalo mogwarore.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ok otimo honni mangʼeny kanyo nikech ne gionge gi yie.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

kikuyu: Ooro chikne e piny, kendo wachne ringo matek ka diemo wangʼ.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kikuyu: E ndalo mokadho, kane pod Saulo ruodhwa in ema ne itelo ni jo-Israel e lwenjegi. Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachoni niya, ‘In ema nibed jakwadh joga Israel, kendo inibed jatendgi.’ ”
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. The LORD said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

kikuyu: Kochakore odiechiengni abiro kelo luoro kod kibaji ne ogendini duto modak e piny. E kinde ma giniwinjie humbu, gibiro kirni kendo kihondko biro makogi.”
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, jowetena, ajiwou kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye, mondo uchiw ringreu kaka misango mangima maler kendo ma Nyasaye morgo, nikech mano e yor lemo makare.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

kikuyu: Kel mesa kendo ichanie gik moko duto monego bedi e wiye. Bangʼe ikel rachungi taya kendo imok teynige.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

kikuyu: Abiro chikone obadho mondo amakego. Abiro kele nyaka Babulon mi akume kuno nikech ne ok orito adierana.
english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

kikuyu: Musa ne ok nyal donjo ei Hemb Romo nikech bor polo ne nitie kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo kar lemo.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: To janabi makoro kwe nowinji mana ka ngʼatno moor gi Jehova Nyasaye adier mana ka gima okoro otimore.”
english: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.”

kikuyu: e laini mar ariyo ne ochanie kite kaka tarkus, gi safir kod emerald,
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: Abiro yeko kendo mecho kendo anamonj kuonde mane okethore chon to tinde ji odakie. Gin joma ne osechaki kigolo e pinje mamoko momew kod jamni kod mwandu mamoko e dier pinje mamoko.”
english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’

kikuyu: Onge tiend dhano kata le ma noluwe; onge ngʼama nodag kanyo kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timona misango mar erokamano miya duongʼ mondo olos yo moriere tir, kendo anyise kaka warruok mar Nyasaye chalo.”
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

kikuyu: Chiwo mare ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mokuoyogo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Magi nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka chiwo mar cham;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel owuok Misri, ee, kane joka Jakobo owuok e kind joma wacho dhok mopogore,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

kikuyu: Mano e kaka ubiro golo kuomu tim marach mar chwero remo maonge ketho, nikech usetimo gima kare e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: To kodhi mane ochwo kuonde motimo lwanda ochungʼ kar ngʼama winjo wach kendo rwake sano gi mor.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

kikuyu: Par jotichni Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo mane ikwongʼorini in iwuon kiwacho ni, ‘Abiro keto nyikwayi mondo obed mangʼeny kaka sulwe mar kor polo bende abiro miyo nyikwayi pinyni duto mane asingonegi ni nobed mwandugi nyaka chiengʼ.’ ”
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Biuru mondo udhi une.” Omiyo negidhi mine gineno kama ne odakie, kendo negibet kode kanyo odiechiengʼ ngima. Ne en kar sa apar mar odhiambo.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

kikuyu: Nobayo Daudi gi jodong ruoth gi kite, kata obedo ni jolweny gi thuondi ne ogengʼo bath Daudi korachwich gi koracham.
english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

kikuyu: E kindeno ruoth Ahaz nokwayo ruodh Asuria mondo okonye.
english: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

kikuyu: nimar yawuot Josef ne osepogore mi obedo dhoudi ariyo ma gin, Manase gi Efraim. Jo-Lawi ne ok oyudo pok moro e pinyno makmana mier mag dak, to gi lege ma rombgi kod dhogi nyalo kwayoe.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Ne nitie ongo moro maduongʼ man kod bwombe madongo dongo kendo man-gi yier mokiko okiko kendo maboyo, nobiro Lebanon. Ongono nopiyo ewi yiend sida,
english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

kikuyu: Jal ma olo mirimbe kuom ruodhi nomiyo gibayo koni gi koni e thim.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: Koa kuom remb joma nonegi, koa kuom ringre joma rateke, atungʼ mar Jonathan ne ok odwogo, ligangla mar Saulo ne ok odwogo nono.
english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe achien nyiri mamokoka bende nobiro. Ne gidwongʼo kagiwacho ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth, yawnwa dhoot!’
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

kikuyu: Ne okela moketa kama lach; ne oresa nikech chunye ne mor koda.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Kinyne ka Gedalia nosenegi, ka pod ngʼato angʼata ne ok ongʼeyo wachni,
english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

kikuyu: Wach mane uwinjo nyaka aa chakruok ema: Nyaka waherreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

kikuyu: Ramoth kod Anem, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath,
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Bende Nyasaye dimiu Rohone mi otim honnige e dieru nikech urito Chik, koso nikech uyie kuom gik mane uwinjo?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Eshton nonywolo Beth Rafa, Pasea kod Tehina mane wuon Ir Nahash. Magi ne jo-Reka.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

kikuyu: An to an mana kudni ma ok dhano, ngʼama ji duto jaro kendo ma ji ochayo.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro gero Sayun kendo obiro thinyore e lela e duongʼne.
english: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowacho ni ngʼat mane rito puodho ni, ‘Kuom higni adek asebedo kabiro kae ka dwaro olemo e ngʼowuni to ok aseyudo moro amora. Ngʼole igoye piny. Ere gima dimi ocham lowo?’
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

kikuyu: E kindeno abiro choki, e ndalono anakeli dala. Abiro miyi pak gi huma, e kind ogendini manie piny mangima, ka adwokoni gweth mane agwedhigo chon mana ka ineno,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kama: “Kelna jodong Israel piero abiriyo ma ingʼeyo ni jotelo kendo ruodhi. Kelgi e Hemb Romo kendo gichungʼ kodi kanyo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

kikuyu: Nikech in bende ne ibedo mamor kane iketho girkeni mar dhood Israel, kamano e kaka abiro timoni in bende. Ibiro dongʼ gunda, yaye Got Seir, in kaachiel gi Edom duto. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Eka anasik ka apako nyingi gi wer kendo abiro chopo singruokna kodi odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

kikuyu: An Klaudio Lusio, amosi ahinya in ruoth Feliks.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

kikuyu: kendo negitimo kamano e Thim mar Sinai e kinde mag odhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo. Jo-Israel notimo gik moko duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

kikuyu: Kara ere oganda machielo maduongʼ man kod buche gi chike makare machal gi chike mamiyou kawuononi?
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

kikuyu: Ji baro lwanda matek ka chuma kendo thulo gode oko gie tiendegi.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

kikuyu: Sibuor osewuok e kare mar pondo; jatiek ogendini osewuok oko. Oseweyo kare mondo otiek pinyu. Miechu nomuki madongʼ gunda, maonge ngʼama nodagie.
english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Makmana nagolo wuonu Ibrahim oa e pinyno machiegni gi Aora Yufrate mi atelone e piny Kanaan duto kendo amiye nyikwayo mathoth. Ne amiye Isaka,
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

kikuyu: Solomon nodwoko penjoge duto maonge matek mane ok onyal dwoke.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

kikuyu: Nomako Agag ruoth jo-Amalek kangima to joge duto to nonego gi ligangla pep.
english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Josunga chikona obadho; giseyarona gogo mondo amokie, kendo gisechikona otegu e yorega ma aluwo. Sela
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

kikuyu: Kaka faras owinjore gi chwat, to dho punda owinjore gi tweyo e kaka ngʼe joma ofuwo owinjore gi goch.
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

kikuyu: Nengo ka nengo nopim gi nengo shekel mitiyogo e kama ler mar lemo ma shekel achiel romre gi gera piero ariyo.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

kikuyu: To nomako lwet nyakono kendo nowacho niya, “Nyathina, chungi ia malo.”
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi kod jodong Israel kaachiel gi jotend lweny mane orito jolweny alufu achiel ne odhi mondo okel Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye koa e od Obed-Edom gi ilo.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

kikuyu: Wasumbini magu machwo kata mamon, unyalo mana ngʼiewo koa ir ogendini mukiewogo.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

kikuyu: mar apar gachiel ne Eliashib, to mar apar gariyo ne Jakim,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

kikuyu: En ngʼa kuomu ma parruok moparorego nyalo miyo omed bedo mangima kata mana kuom sa achiel kende?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

kikuyu: nooro wuode Hadoram ir Ruoth Daudi mondo oterne omose kendo opake kuom locho e kedo kod Hadadezer mane osebedo kakedo gi Tou. Hadoram nokelo gik mopogore opogore ma olos gi dhahabu gi fedha kod mula.
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Juda ne gin ji alufu piero abiriyo gangʼwen gi mia auchiel (74,600).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nonego jo-Kush e nyim Asa kod Juda. Jo-Kush noringo
english: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Hezekia, gi gik moko duto mane otimo kod kaka ne oloso soko kod kuonde pi mokelo e dala maduongʼ, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Daudi nogero kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye kanyo kendo nochiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mar lalruok. Noluongo Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke gi mach moa e polo kalwar e kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kane adhi Jerusalem, jodolo madongo gi jodong jo-Yahudi nodonjone ka gidwaro mondo angʼadne buch tho.
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

kikuyu: Kum oket mana ne jo-achaya, to chwat ne ngʼe joma ofuwo.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

kikuyu: Ogendini duto notine kod wuode kod nyakware ma wuowi nyaka kinde mar pinye chopi; eka pinje mangʼeny kod ruodhi maroteke nokete obed jatichgi.
english: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.

kikuyu: Ma ema nobed hekalu mopwodhi ni jodolo. Enobed kilomita apar gariyo gi nus kuom borne man yo nyandwat, lachne kilomita abich yo podho chiengʼ kendo lachne ma yo podho chiengʼ bende kilomita abich, bangʼe borne mochomo yo milambo nobed kilomita apar gariyo gi nus. E dier lowono tir e kama nogerie kama ler mar lemo mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.

kikuyu: Gipenjo wach kuom nyasaye molos gi bao kendo idwokogi gi yien mopa. Chuny mar chode terogi mabor; ok gin jo-adier ne Nyasachgi.
english: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Zebulun, ne en Gadiel wuod Sodi;
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

kikuyu: Okwongʼu ka ji duto wuoyo maber kuomu, nimar mano e kaka kweregi notimone jonabi ma jo-miriambo.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

kikuyu: Kuom magi osemiyowa singruokne maduongʼ kendo ma nengogi tek, mondo e kuom gigo unyalo kawo kit Nyasaye kendo mondo utony ua e kethruok ma gombo maricho ma pinyni kelo.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne jodong joka Esau: Yawuot Elifaz ma wuod Esau makayo gin: Jaduongʼ Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

kikuyu: Bangʼe yawuot Harun ma jodolo nochan lemo duto kaka wich gi boche ewi yien manie mach mar kendo mar misango.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

kikuyu: ne nitie kendo mar misango molos gi dhahabu miwangʼoe ubani kod Sandug Muma mowir gi dhahabu gi ludh Harun mane chako loth, kod kite mopa mondikie singruok.
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

kikuyu: Wuowino miluongo ni Samuel ne tiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e bwo Eli. E kindeno wach Jehova Nyasaye ne nok kendo ne onge fweny mangʼeny.
english: The child Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. The LORD’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Samuel niya, “Kik ingʼi ber mar dende kata borne nikech asedage. Jehova Nyasaye ok ngʼi gik ma dhano ngʼiyo. Dhano ngʼiyo ber ma oko, Jehova Nyasaye to ngʼiyo chuny.”
english: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mane oneno ma nowacho niya, “Gima chalo kama ne pok one kata timore, chakre ndalo mane jo-Israel oa Misri nyaka chil kawuono. Paruruane wachni kendo noneuru mondo unyiswa ane gima onego watim!”
english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono kod kwe mar Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo, obed kodu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ne en odiechiengʼ motelo ne odiechieng Pasaka. Nikech jo-Yahudi ne ok dwar mondo owe ringre Yesu koliero e msalaba chiengʼ Sabato, ne gikwayo Pilato mondo one ni otur tiende joma nogur, kendo olor ringregi.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Jerusalem, Yesu nodonjo ei hekalu mi noriembo oko joma ne ngʼiewo kendo uso gik moko kanyo. Noloko mesni mag jowil pesa ataro kod kombe mag joma ne uso akuche,
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Mirima ma in-gono biro hinyi mana in iwuon, iparo ni piny biro rumo nikech in? Koso nyaka gol lwendni kuonde magintie?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

kikuyu: Ne amiyogi buchena kendo ne amiyo gingʼeyo chikena, nikech ngʼat marito buchena gi chikena ema biro bedo mangima.
english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

kikuyu: E dier odiechiengʼ tir ubiro rundoru ka muofni e mudho. Onge gima unutim manodhi maber, ndalo duto nothiru kendo noyak giu maonge ngʼama noresu.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

kikuyu: To Joshua nowachone od Josef, ma gin Efraim kod Manase niya, “Usenyaa kendo un joma nigi teko. Ok unubed gi pok achiel kende,
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

kikuyu: Ruoth Uzia nobedo ja-dhoho nyaka chiengʼ thone, emomiyo nodak e ot kar kende ka en gi dhoho kendo ne ok oyiene donjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Jotham wuode ema ne rito dala ruoth kendo norito piny.
english: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

kikuyu: In mipuonjo ji mamoko, dak ipuonjri iwuon? In miyalo ni kuo rach, dibed in to ikwala?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

kikuyu: Wuothi ei Sayun, luorri e iye koni gi koni, kwan osuche duto,
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

kikuyu: to Jehova Nyasaye noyierou nikech noherou kendo orito singruok mane otimo gi kwereu kane ogolou gi tekone maduongʼ kendo warou e piny mane unie wasumbini, e lwet Farao ruodh Misri.
english: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Malaika mar ariyo nogoyo turumbetene, mi gima chalo gi got maduongʼ, maliel gi mach, nowiti e nam. To bath nam moromo achiel kuom adek nolokore remo,
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

kikuyu: Kane owinjo ka oganda kadho, nopenjo ni en angʼo matimore.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

kikuyu: Baasha wuod Ahija ja-dhood Isakar nomonje mi nogoye monege e Gibethon e dala jo-Filistia ka Nadab kod jo-Israel duto ne dwaro monjo dalano.
english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

kikuyu: Joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye mondo owach niya, “Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Aonge gi ich wangʼ. Ka dine pedo kod kuthe ok gwara, to dine amonjogi; mi awangʼogi duto e mach.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

kikuyu: Obiro bedo gi loch chakre nam nyaka nam kendo kochakore Aora maduongʼ nyaka kuma piny ogikie.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Riemb chwo kod mon duto mondo giwuok oko mar kambi; kik ginjaw kambi nikech adak e diergi.”
english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

kikuyu: Kar chakruok, Wach ne nitie, kendo Wach ne ni kod Nyasaye, kendo Wach ne en Nyasaye.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Reuben; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen mia abiriyo gi piero adek (43,730).
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: An e ngʼat moseneno masira mane ayudo koa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

kikuyu: To Shem kod Jafeth nokawo nanga mi oketo e gokgi; eka negidonjo ei hema ka giwuotho gi ka ngʼegi mi giumo dug wuon-gi. Wengegi ne ngʼiyo komachielo mondo omi kik gine dug wuon-gi.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Kar chande to golneuru cham moko mapok oka kuonde mochung-gie kendo uwene mondo oka odhigo, kendo kik utame.”
english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”

kikuyu: Nembe tingʼore malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nembe dhwolore malo ka giwuo; nembe tingʼore ka apaka gore matek.
english: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

kikuyu: Nikech wan bende chon ne wan joma ofuwo ma ok winj wach kendo wasumbini mag kit gombo gi mor mayoreyore mag ringruok. Ngimawa mapile nopongʼ gi ichlit gi nyiego; ka ji mon kodwa kendo wan bende onge winjruok e kindwa.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

kikuyu: ‘Fedha magi gi dhahabu magi gin maga kendo mondi mabeyo kod nyithindi gin maga.’ ”
english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

kikuyu: Tiendego nolos kaka tiende gach faras; chumbe ma tiende lworore, tiende molworore, weche momake kod dag waya nolos gi mula moleny.
english: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

kikuyu: Kendo ne giike e lope mane opogne, mantiere Timnath Sera e piny gode mag Efraim, mantiere yo nyandwat mar Gash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

kikuyu: Joma nochokore duto nokulore piny ka gilemo ka jower wer to jogo turumbete goyo turumbete. Mano nodhi nyime nyaka notiek chiwo misango miwangʼo pep.
english: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

kikuyu: Naomi nokone Ruth chi wuode niya, “Nyara, biro bedoni maber ka idhi ibedo kaachiel gi nyige, nikech kidhi e puoth ngʼat moro machielo, to gimoro marach nyalo hinyi.”
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”

kikuyu: Giruto ka sibuor kendo gingʼur ka sibuoche matindo, bende gimor ka gidwaro mako le, mi gitingʼ-gi e dhogi maonge ngʼama nyalo resogi.
english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, abiro rieyo bada mi agoo jo-Misri gi kit masiche duto ma anakel e diergi. Bangʼ mano, to enoyienu mondo udhi.
english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.

kikuyu: Kamano notimo gima Jehova Nyasaye nochike. Nodhi e holo mar Kerith yo ka wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan kendo nobedo kuno.
english: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

kikuyu: Kik uwinjgi mana mondo umor wangʼ-gi seche ma ginenou, to mana ka wasumb Kristo, timuru dwaro Nyasaye koa e chunyu.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

kikuyu: Uzia ja-Ashterath, Shama kod Jeyel yawuot Hotham ja-Aroer,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

kikuyu: Nowachone jo-Sukoth niya, “Miuru joga ma jolweny makati nikech giol, kendo pod alawo Zeba kod Zalmuna, ma gin ruodhi jo-Midian.”
english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

kikuyu: Koso donge ungʼeyo ni wan duto mane obatiswa kuom Kristo Yesu, nobatiswa e thone?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

kikuyu: ka diponi omaki nikech gima ne iwacho, mi idwodori kod weche mane oa e dhogi,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Ezra nopako Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasaye Maduongʼ, kendo ji duto notingʼo bedegi malo mi gidwoko niya, “Amin! Amin!” Bangʼe negipodho auma mi gilamo Jehova Nyasaye ka gikulo wiyegi piny.
english: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

kikuyu: “Ingʼeyo ni nikech lwenje duto mane Daudi wuora kedogo koni gi koni mane miyo ok onyal gero hekalu moluongo Nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache nyaka chop Jehova Nyasaye ket wasike duto e bwo tiende.
english: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

kikuyu: emomiyo ok unuchak une fweny mag miriambo kendo kata koro mag wuondo ji ok unutim. Abiro reso joga e lwetu. Kendo ka atimo kamano eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: kata bedni ngʼat makare ogore piny nyadibiriyo, pod obiro chungo kendo; to joricho igoyo piny gi masira.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo giloyo pinjeruodhi kendo girito ji gi bura makare, mi giyudo gik ma Nyasaye nosingo. Ne giumo dho sibuoche,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

kikuyu: Esta nochako ohombo ruoth mopodho e tiende koywak. Ne okwaye mondo oketh chenro marach mane Haman ja-Agag oseloso, mondo otimne jo-Yahudi.
english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

kikuyu: Kiloso sirnigo, to nyaka ilos sirni piero ariyo migerogo bath Hemb Romo mochomo yo milambo
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

kikuyu: Giniduogi ka giywak; gini lem sa ma aduogogi. Anatelnegi e bath aore man-gi pi, e kuonde mopie ma ok ginichwanyre, nikech an wuon Israel, kendo Efraim e wuoda makayo.
english: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

kikuyu: Hera gi adiera biro riwore kanyakla, kendo tim makare gi kwe biro nyodhore.
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

kikuyu: To chenro duto mag Jehova Nyasaye to siko kochungʼ nyaka chiengʼ; ochopo dwaro duto manie chunye e tienge duto.
english: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

kikuyu: janabi Jeremia kendo owachone niya, “Kiyie to iwinj kwayowa kendo ilamnwa Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ne joma otonygi duto. Nimar kaka ineno sani, kata obedoni chon ne wangʼeny, to koro sani ji matin ema odongʼ.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to the LORD your God, even for all this remnant, for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes see us,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya,
english: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Jotham nonywolo Ahaz, Ahaz nonywolo Hezekia, Hezekia nonywolo Manase,
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

kikuyu: Malaika nowachone niya, “Kik iket lweti kuom wuodi, kendo kik itimne gimoro amora. Koro asengʼeyo ni iluoro Nyasaye, nikech ok isetama e wuodi ma miderma.”
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

kikuyu: To kaka ne imedo sandgi, e kaka negimedo nyaa kendo gimedore; omiyo jo-Misri nomedo luoro jo-Israel,
english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eli nopenje niya, “En angʼo mane owachoni? Kik ipanda wach. Mad Nyasaye chwadi matek ka dipo ni ipandona gimoro amora ma onyisi.”
english: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”

kikuyu: To joma luor, gi joma ok oyie kod jo-koko gi jonek kod joma terore, gi jojuogi gi joma lamo nyiseche manono kod jo-miriambo duto, kargi nobed mana ataro mar mach maliel mager, ma en tho mar ariyo!”
english: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

kikuyu: Buni, Azgad, Bebai,
english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

kikuyu: Kane Petro pod wuoro kuom tiend fweny mane onenono, joote mane Kornelio ooro nochopo e od Simon, mochungʼ e dhorangach oko.
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anachiw Farao Hofra ruodh Misri ne wasike madwaro ngimane, mana kaka ne achiwo Zedekia ruodh Juda ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon jasike mane dwaro ngimane.’ ”
english: The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jonabi mane odak Bethel nodhi ir Elisha mopenje niya, bende ingʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye dhi kawo ruodhi kawuono? Elisha nodwokogi niya, ee angʼeyo, to lingʼuru gi wachno.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

kikuyu: Osemiyo denda odoko mool kendo chokena osetur.
english: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

kikuyu: Josef ja-Arimathaya, mane en ngʼat mogen e Buch Jodongo, kendo mane en owuon orito neno pinyruoth Nyasaye, nodhi ir Pilato gi chir mokwayo ringre Yesu.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Chakre ndalo mane okete jarit ode kendo jarit gik moko duto ma en-go, Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho gik moko duto mane ni e od ja-Misri nikech Josef. Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho gimoro amora mane Potifa nigo e ot kod e puodho.
english: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo ni Yesu ni e bwo loch mar Herode, noore ir Herode, ma bende ne ni Jerusalem e kindeno.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, e dwe mar abiriyo Ishmael wuod Nethania, ma wuod Elishama mane koth joka ruoth, nobiro gi ji apar ma ginego Gedalia kod jo-Juda gi jo-Babulon mane ni kode Mizpa.
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

kikuyu: Migepe mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi oseikore ne tije duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo joma ochiwore molony e tije mopogore opogore oikore konyi e tije duto. Jotelo kod ji duto nowinj weche duto miwacho.
english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

kikuyu: Bende ne gin jodong Ruoth Solomon madongo ma kar rombgi ne jotelo mia ariyo gi piero abich mane orito ji.
english: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Janabi imiyo duongʼ kuonde duto, makmana e kind jogwengʼ-gi gi wedene kod joode owuon.”
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ onogo Farao nogolo chik ni jorit wasumbini kod nyipeche kowachonegi niya,
english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Kata mana buch dalau momoko e tiendewa watengʼo oko. To beduru kungʼeyo maler ni: Pinyruoth Nyasaye osekayo machiegni.’
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne giwuok mi gidhi Zif motelone Saulo. Daudi gi joge to ne ni e Thim Maon man Araba yo milambo mar Jeshimon.
english: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.

kikuyu: Eka noketo ringreno e kar bure owuon mi giywage kagiwacho niya, “Yaye, owadwa!”
english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

kikuyu: Teko mar Nyasaye maduongʼ osemiyowa gik moko duto ma wadwaro mondo wabed mangima ka waluoro Nyasaye, kuom ngʼeyo Jal mane oluongowa kuom duongʼne owuon kod berne.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

kikuyu: Ne olokore mongʼiyogi mi noluongo kwongʼ e nying Jehova Nyasaye. Eka ondiegi ariyo mag dubu nopore oa e bungu mochamo rowere piero angʼwen gariyogo.
english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

kikuyu: Nikech wach od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, adwaro ni idhi maber.
english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

kikuyu: Iseketa ei bur matut mogik, ei piny mogik, kama olil ti.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye owinjo gima ne uwacho, mirima nomake mi okwongʼore niya,
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

kikuyu: kod kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, gi singʼengene molos gi mula man kod ludhene gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono kaachiel gi karaya kod rachungine,
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nolamo Nyasaye, kendo Nyasaye nochango Abimelek, chiege kod jotichne ma nyiri mondo omi ginywol nyithindo kendo,
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

kikuyu: Negia kanyo mi gikadho e dier Galili, to Yesu ne ok dwar mondo ngʼato ongʼe kuma negintie,
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

kikuyu: Pasia mar hekalu noyiech e diere tir, chakre malo nyaka piny.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

kikuyu: Bende ne ok gilokore giweyo richo mar nego ji, kata timbe jwok kata terruok kata kuo mane gibedo ka gitimo.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

kikuyu: Obiro kelo jo-Israel mangʼeny ir Ruoth Nyasachgi.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

kikuyu: Chon jo-Hori nodak e piny Seir, to nyikwa Esau noriembogi oko. Negitieko jo-Hori mane ni kanyo mi gidak kuondegi mana kaka jo-Israel notimo e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyogi kaka girkeni.)
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)

kikuyu: Shekania nonywolo Shemaya: Yawuot Shemaya ne gin: Hatush, Igal, Baria, Nearia kod Shafat. Giduto ne gin ji auchiel.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo owachona wachni ne akulo wiya piny, kendo dhoga nomoko.
english: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, chuny Farao ne odoko matek kendo ne ok onyal winjogi mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne osewacho.
english: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni wuonwa gi minwa ojwangʼa to Jehova Nyasaye biro rwaka.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

kikuyu: Negitimo kamano nikech Haman wuod Hamedatha, ma ja-Agag, ma jasik jo-Yahudi duto, nosechano mondo otiek jo-Yahudi kogoyo ombulu (miluongo ni pur) mondo oneg-gi kendo otiekgi.
english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

kikuyu: Godiechiengʼ ka piny ler, kendo ka gineni, kaw gigi miseiko mar dhi e twech. To kochopo odhiambo e kinde ma chiengʼ podho, to we mondo gineni mana ka ngʼama itero twech.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘An e Jehova Nyasaye kendo abiro golou e tije mapek ma jo-Misri oketo kuomu. Abiro miyo ubed thuolo e tij bedo wasumbini mag-gi kendo abiro resou kakumogi malit mondo awaru.
english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

kikuyu: Kik ulos ubani moro amora e yo machal kama ne un uwegi, nikech en gima ler mowalne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.

kikuyu: Itiekogi apoya nono gi much Nyasaye; kendo sa ma mirimbe obiro to gilal nono.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

kikuyu: Twangʼ gik mongʼinore kaka olemo molos gi usi marambulu gi maralik kod makwar kendo ket gara mar dhahabu e kindgi
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

kikuyu: Enopog moko kaka pok mar rapar kendo chiw moko e kendo mar misango kaka misango miwangʼo pep madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, remo makare duto mosebedo kichwero e piny, chakre remb Abel nyaka remb Zekaria wuod Berekia, mane unego marach e kind hekalu gi kendo mar misango, ibiro keti ewiu.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye ema kelo tho, kendo chiwo ngima; en ema onego kendo ochiero.
english: “The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kosenywolo Seth, Adam nodak higni mia aboro kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuom Gideon, kendo nogoyo turumbete, kowachoni jo-Abiezer mondo oluw bangʼe.
english: But the LORD’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

kikuyu: Jotendgi ne gin Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Azaria, Ramia, Nahamani, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, kod Baana. Kar kwan mar nying jo-Israel machwo e magi:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

kikuyu: abiro gwedhe gi gik moko mogundho, kendo joge modhier abiro romo gi chiemo.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

kikuyu: Kamano bende kane pod wan nyithindo, ne oketwa wasumbini mag timbe machon mag piny.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

kikuyu: Unune malit, un joma mayo ji utegi ma gisegero kendo umayo ji puothegi, maonge kama odongʼ ma udongʼ ka udak kendu e pinyno.
english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

kikuyu: Kane jo-Ashdod ochiewo kinyne gokinyi mangʼich negiyudo ka Dagon, nogore piny auma e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye! Negichungo Dagon mi gidwoke kare.
english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

kikuyu: To ok mano kende, wamor bende kuom Nyasaye, nikech Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, ma kuome oseketwa wabedo e winjruok gi Nyasaye.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe mahu mar oganda ma ok dew gimoro nowinjo; ne gin jo-Sebea moa e thim kaachiel gi joma chwo mojwangʼore. Ne girwakonegi bangli kendo ne gitweyonegi otembini mabeyo e wigi.
english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

kikuyu: to beduru motangʼ mondo kik wiu wil kod Jehova Nyasaye mane ogolou Misri; e piny mane unie wasumbini.
english: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane oketo rieko e obwongo dhano kata mane oketo winjo e pache?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

kikuyu: Kane wechego olandore mochopo ni Joab mane joriwore gi Adonija kata obedo ni ne ok oriwore gi Abisalom, ne oringo modhi e Hemb Jehova Nyasaye mi nomako tunge kendo mar misango.
english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to the LORD’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Piny notwo kendo noner, piny nojwangʼ miner, kendo polo gi piny nojwangʼ.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

kikuyu: Tongʼno nodhi nyaka e tiend got momanyore gi Holo mar Ben Hinom, kod yo nyandwat mar Holo mar Refaim. Nodhi nyime nyaka e Holo mar Hinom koluwo yo milambo mar pewe mar dala maduongʼ mar jo-Jebus kendo mochopo En Rogel.
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ne igolowa Misri mondo ikelwa e piny malichni? Pinyni onge gi cham kata ngʼowu, mzabibu kata olembe mongʼinore to bende onge kata mana pi modho!”
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

kikuyu: An e jaote matinie mogik, to bende ok awinjora mondo oluonga ni jaote, nikech ne asando kanisa Nyasaye.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

kikuyu: In gi jotich mangʼeny kaka jopa kite, jogedo gi jopa bao kaachiel gi ji molony e tije mopogore opogore,
english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Yunani, gi jo-Tubal kod jo-Meshek ne oloko kodi; ne giwilo kodu wasumbini kod gik molos gi mula ka gingʼiewogo gigi mag ohala.
english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nogolo chik mine gilando wachni e kambi duto kagiwacho niya, “Onge dichwo kata dhako manochak okel chiwo moro amora ne tich gero kama ler mar lemo.” Kuom mano notam ji mondo kik gimed kelo gige tich,
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

kikuyu: Maupego kod bedego duto nobedo gimoro achiel gi rachungi taya mothedh gi dhahabu maler.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Githiedho adhonde mag joga mana ka gima ok en gima lich. Giwacho niya, “Kwe, kwe,” kata kwe onge.
english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.

kikuyu: Ne anyono ogendini kakecho; mi kuom mirimba ne amiyo gimer, kendo ne aolo rembgi e lowo.
english: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

kikuyu: Omiyo akwayou mondo koro unyise hera moloyo.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu mi unyaa moromo alufu gi alufu kendo enogwedhu mana kaka nosingore.
english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

kikuyu: Oseparo herane kod adierane ne dhood Israel; kuonde duto ma piny ogikie oseneno warruok mar Nyasachwa.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: nowachonegi niya, “Winjuru wechena: “Ka janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye nitie e dieru, to abiro afwenyorane, kendo awuoyo kode e lek.
english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo chiko ite ne dhok mopongʼ gi richo, ja-miriambo winjo lep mar ajara.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kikuyu: Joma nochungʼ but Paulo nowachone niya, “Wangʼi tek manade minyalo yanyo jadolo maduongʼ mar Nyasaye?”
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

kikuyu: Useluwo buche mag Omri kod timbe duto mag jood Ahab, kendo useluwo kitgi gi timbegi. Emomiyo abiro weyou ne kethruok kendo jowu ibiro chaa. Ubiro tingʼo ajara mag ogendini duto.”
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni onge gimoro mopandi ma ok nofweny, to bende onge gimoro amora mitimo lingʼ-lingʼ ma ok noket e lela.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Giduto nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wuoguru ka in kaachiel gi jok mane igolo e piny Misri kendo dhiuru e piny mane asingo ka akwongʼora ne Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo kawachonegi ni, ‘Anamiye nyikwau.’
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

kikuyu: Kik uneg dhiangʼ gi nyathine, kata rombo gi nyathine odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

kikuyu: Asewinjo wach koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye kama: Jaote oseor mondo owach ne ogendini niya, “Chokreuru mondo umonje! Chungʼuru malo wadhi e kedo!”
english: I have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”

kikuyu: Joka Kohath ne gin: Kohath nonywolo Aminadab, Aminadab nonywolo Kora, Kora nonywolo Asir,
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: Ruodha, jo-Israel duto ngʼiyi mondo gingʼe kuomini en ngʼa mabiro bedo e kom duongʼ ruodha bangʼe.
english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

kikuyu: Eka duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyre kendo ji duto biro nene. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema osewacho kamano.”
english: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nonyise ratiro niya, “An ma awuoyo kodini An e En.”
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

kikuyu: Yesu, ma nyinge machielo en Justo, bende ooronu mos. Magi kende e jo-Yahudi wetena matiyo koda ni wach pinyruoth Nyasaye, kendo gisehoyo chunya e yore mangʼeny.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

kikuyu: to anakum richogi gi luth, kendo anago kethogi gi chwat.
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

kikuyu: Eka jotich Isaka nokunyo soko moro kendo, to ne gilarore kuom mano bende; kuom mano nochake ni Sitna (tiende ni sadha).
english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

kikuyu: Nikech aserito yore Jehova Nyasaye; pok atimo marach kuom lokora weyo Nyasacha.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kikuyu: Nochiko ite kowinjo kaka Paulo ne wuoyo. Paulo nongʼiye tir moneno ka en-gi yie mane nyalo miyo ochangi,
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, miwae makati pile pile kochakore kawuono.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

kikuyu: Eka rombe nokwa e legegi giwegi; to nyirombe nokwa e gundni mane mag jomoko.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

kikuyu: Kane jatend jorit hekalu owinjo wachno, nowuok mana gisano gi askechene mi gidhi giomo joote gikelo. Ne ok gitiyo githuon, nikech negiluor ni ji nyalo chielogi gi kite.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nokaw bochene duto, kaka sembe gi boche moumo jamb-ich,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

kikuyu: “Benjamin en ondiek ma kech kayo; gima osenego ochamo gokinyi, kendo godhiambo okidho matindo tindo gima osemako.”
english: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano, to ka ruodha osenindo gi kwerene, to an gi wuoda Solomon ibiro kaw kaka joketho.”
english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowuoyo gi jo-Israel mi gigolo ngʼat mane oyenyocha oko mar kambi kendo negichiele gi kite. Jo-Israel notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Korintho, wawuoyonu ka wan kodu thuolo kendo ka chunywa oyaworenu malach.
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

kikuyu: Mano nobed chik mochwere ne tienge duto mabiro e kamoro amora manudagie; kendo kik ucham bor kata remo.
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo piny nobedo gi kwe kuom higni piero angʼwen; nyaka Othniel wuod Kenaz notho.
english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

kikuyu: Kik ibed gi nyiego e chunyi nikech joricho; to kinde duto bedi gi dwaro mar luoro Jehova Nyasaye moloyo.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

kikuyu: In iwuon nibed gi tuo marach manocham nyimbiyi, kendo tuoni nomi nyimbiyi wuog oko.’ ”
english: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

kikuyu: kendo ne ok giparo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi, mane oseresogi e lwet jowasikgi duto koni gi koni.
english: The children of Israel didn’t remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

kikuyu: “To bende ka ngʼato omiyo jomatindo moyie kuomagi odonjo e richo, to dibed maber ka otwene pongʼ marangʼongo e ngʼute ma onyumego e nam.
