english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

kikuyu: Ka gigi duto ibiro kethi kamano, koro to onego ubed jomachal nadi? Onego udag e ngima maler kendo moluoro Nyasaye,
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

kikuyu: Tongʼ-gi ma yo nyandwat nochakore e aora Jordan, kochomo pewe man yo nyandwat mar Jeriko, mi oluwo piny godego kochomo yo podho chiengʼ nyaka ochomo e thim mar Beth Aven.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

kikuyu: Kom duongʼ, motingʼ malo aa chakruok, e kama ler mar lemo marwa.
english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nomiyo Solomon rieko gi ngʼeyo matut moloyo kod winjo ma ok nyalo pimore mana ka kwoyo manie dho nam.
english: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

kikuyu: ka ndalo moseyier pok ochopo en odiechiengʼ ma ibiro teroue kuma bor ka mihudhwe mar cham. Adier, chokreuru kapok mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye obiro kuomu, kata kapok odiechiengʼ mar mirimbe ochopo.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.

kikuyu: Nongʼiewo gode mag Samaria gi Shemer gi fedha ma dirom kilo piero abiriyo kendo mogero dala maduongʼ e got, miluongo ni Samaria, kochake Shemer nying wuon godno.
english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni pod giketo pachgi kuom piny mane giseweyo, to dine giyudo thuolo mar dok chien kuma ne giaye.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

kikuyu: “Ka jachien marach owuok kuom ngʼato, owuotho kuonde motwo koni gi koni, komanyo kama doyudie yweyo, to ok oyudi.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

kikuyu: Wachore e lela ni nitie terruok e dieru, kendo ni en kit terruok ma kata jopiny ok tim; nikech ngʼato terore gi chi wuon.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

kikuyu: “To koro sani ichano mondo itamri loch Jehova Nyasaye mantiere e lwet nyikwa Daudi. Adieri un kod jolweny mangʼeny kendo un kod nyiroye mag dhahabu mane Jeroboam oloso mondo obed nyisecheu.
english: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

kikuyu: “Chwoyo gi keyo, ngʼich kod liet, oro kod chwiri, odiechiengʼ kod otieno ok nobed maonge nyaka giko piny.”
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

kikuyu: Omiyo noloko pi mapiyo nono e besen, moringo odok e soko omo pi kendo noomo moromo ngamiagego duto.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

kikuyu: Nimar joma kamago ok ti ne Kristo Ruodhwa, to gitiyo mana ne igi giwegi. Giwuoyo gi weche mayom ka giolo ji mondo giwuond chunje joma pachgi thany thany.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye in e Ruodha nyaka chakre chon, yaye Nyasaye, kendo isebedo kikelo resruok e piny.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

kikuyu: Chik iti ka ingʼadoni rieko kendo rwak puonj, to giko ni inibed mariek.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

kikuyu: To anawe joma muol e dieru kendo ma obolore, ma gin jogo ma oyie kuom nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: “Kuonde tony mag wuokie dala maduongʼ e magi: “Kochakore yo nyandwat, ma borne romo kilomita ariyo,
english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

kikuyu: Ngʼatno makwero ngʼato gikone obiro yudo pwoch mangʼeny moloyo ngʼatno man-gi lep mawuondo.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

kikuyu: To kane pod ok ne giyie nikech mor kod wuoro, nopenjogi niya, “Bende un gi gimoro amora ka eri madicham?”
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

kikuyu: Chiwgi mana e kama Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero e kind jo-dhoutu, kendo kanyo ema itimie gik moko duto ma achiki.
english: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

kikuyu: Kik uwe chike ma amiyou kawuononi, ka udhi e bat korachwich kata koracham kendo ka uluwo nyiseche manono kendo utiyonegi.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

kikuyu: to jatend joted makati nonego, mana kaka Josef noselokonegi tiend lekgi.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

kikuyu: Mula mane oyudi e misango mifwayo ne romo kilo alufu ariyo mia angʼwen (2,400).
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

kikuyu: Ok adwar mondo anenu mana ayuka ka akadho, to ageno mar bedo kodu amingʼa, ka Ruoth oyie.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

kikuyu: Winjuru, yaye un ogendini duto. Chik iti yaye piny gi ji duto modakie iye, mondo Jehova Nyasaye mar oganda lweny obed janeno kuomu, mondo Ruoth Nyasaye otim kamano gie hekalu mare maler.
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro sani Jehova Nyasaye oseketo roho mar miriambo e dho jonabigi. Jehova Nyasaye osengʼadoni buch masira.”
english: “Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

kikuyu: Kristo ema nogolo kit dhano machon kuomu mana kaka tero nyangu golo kit dhano machon, ma nyangu motim gi lwet dhano, to nyangu motim gi Kristo.
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

kikuyu: Eka malaika mane wuoyo koda nowachona niya, “Ywagri kiwacho ne ji kama: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho, ‘Nyiego omaka matek nikech Jerusalem gi Sayun,
english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

kikuyu: “Land ma ne od Jakobo kendo go milomeno ne Juda:
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

kikuyu: kendo gisano ne giweyo yie kod wuon-gi mi giluwe.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

kikuyu: Kain nowacho ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Kum mi miyano ohinga.
english: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

kikuyu: ne oromo gi wede Ahazia ruodh Juda moko mopenjogi niya, “Un ngʼa gini.” To negidwoko niya, “Wan wede Ahazia kendo ne walor mondo wamos joka ruoth kod min ruoth.”
english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

kikuyu: Abiro choko pinje duto mi akelgi Jerusalem mondo giked kode. Dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem nokaw, udi manie iye noyaki, kendo mon noterruokgo githuon. Nus mar joma odak e dala maduongʼno noter e twech, to ji duto modongʼ ok nogol e dala.
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

kikuyu: Abiro oronu le mag bungu mondo oked kodu kendo ginineg nyithindo kaachiel gi jambu mi unudongʼ manok kendo yoreu nodongʼ nono maonge joma wuothoe.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

kikuyu: to ka ngʼato kuom jogi ma jo-Israel olemo kata okwayi, ka gingʼeyo gima chando chunygi kendo ka girieyo bedegi kochomo hekaluni,
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

kikuyu: Ruoth notiyo gi yiend Algumo kuom loso raidhi mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi ode mar loch bende notiyo kodgi kuom loso nyatiti kod orutu ni jothum. Yien machalo kama ne pod ok one e piny Juda nyaka nene.)
english: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

kikuyu: Adolora kendo akulora piny chuth odiechiengʼ duto, awuotho koni gi koni, ka akuyo.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

kikuyu: Jowetena mageno, kik ngʼato wuondu.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

kikuyu: Koro ongʼere malongʼo ni chudo ma imiyo ngʼato bangʼ tich ok miye kaka mich; to imiye kaka gir luche mosetiyone.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

kikuyu: Solomon nokelo farese koa Misri kod e piny miluongo ni Kue, johala mag ruoth nongʼiewogi e piny Kue.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano abiro puodho Hemb Romo gi kendo mar misango mondo obed maler kendo abiro puodho Harun gi yawuote mondo otina kaka jodolo.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Kaponi nitie ji piero abich maonge ketho e dalano? Dikethe koso diweye nikech ngima ji makare piero abichgo?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

kikuyu: “Wasingore ni ok wanachiw nyiwa mondo okendi gi jogo modak mokiewo kodwa to kata mana mondo yawuotwa okend nyigi.
english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

kikuyu: rachungi teyni molos gi dhahabu maler kaachiel gi techegi monego liel e nyim kama ler mar lemo kaka nondiki;
english: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Onge tiende mondo gia. Migiuru gimoro gicham un uwegi.”
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobi kuome, en Roho makelo rieko gingʼeyo, kendo mangʼadone ji rieko kendo miyogi teko, bende en Roho mapuonjo ji luoro Jehova Nyasaye,
english: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Utege matindo mag rito, gi ohinga mage mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko kod agola mare ne pimgi romre gi mamoko duto kuom pim. Rangach midonjogo kod agola mare ne nigi otuchi moriedo kolwore duto. Borne noromo fut piero abiriyo gabich to lachne ne en fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

kikuyu: Jowetewa, kane ochunowa ni nyaka wawere kodu kuom kinde machwok (ne wapogore mana e ringruok to ok kuom chuny), omiyo siso mane wan-go mar chako limou osemiyo watemo gi yore duto mondo waneu wangʼ gi wangʼ.
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne angʼado e chunya, ni ok anachak alimu kendo ka limbena dikelnu kuyo.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

kikuyu: kendo ni in, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, ihero ji. Kuom adier, ibiro chiwo pok ne ngʼato ka ngʼato kaluwore gi gima osetimo.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

kikuyu: Ji matimo richo ketho chik; chutho, richo en ketho chik.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

kikuyu: Tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen mar dwe mar apar gachiel, miluongo ni Shebat, e higa mar ariyo mar loch Darius, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni janabi Zekaria wuod Berekia, ma wuod Ido.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

kikuyu: Dwe norieny ka wangʼ chiengʼ, kendo ler mar chiengʼ nobed maler moloyo kaka orieny pile nyadibiriyo, machal mana gi ler mar chiengʼ mar ndalo abiriyo, e kindeno ma Jehova Nyasaye nowir kuonde duto moriemo mag joge kendo nochang adhondegi.
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro rieyo bada kuomgi mi ami piny lokre kama ok nyal dagie kendo, kochakore piny motwo nyaka Dibla, kamoro amora ma gidakie. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi kendo niya, “Abiro dhi aweyou, kendo ubiro manya, to unutho mana e richou. Kuma adhiye ok unyal bire.”
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

kikuyu: Gijiwore ngʼato gi ngʼato kuom chenrogi maricho, giwuoyo kaka ginyalo pando obadhogi, kagiwacho niya, “En ngʼa mabiro nenogi?”
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noneno kaka joma ni Israel ne sandore malit, bedni ne gin wasumbini kata ok gin wasumbini; maonge ngʼama ne nyalo resogi.
english: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

kikuyu: Dichwo nobed maonge ketho moro amora, to dhakono ibiro kum ne richo mage.’ ”
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

kikuyu: Noloso ni hekaluno dirise mogaji modiyore matindo.
english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

kikuyu: to ji mane tho ma kamano onego ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000).
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel notimo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa; mano e yo mane gichokore godo e rangʼiny mag-gi giwegi, kendo mano e kaka negichokore, moro ka moro gi dhoodgi kod joge.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Eka Satan nodonjo kuom Judas, miluongo ni Iskariot, achiel kuom ji apar gariyo.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

kikuyu: Bed moikore gokinyi kendo ibi ira ewi Got Sinai kendo kanyo ema anaromie kodi.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

kikuyu: Kik ipand wangʼi ne jatichni; dwoka piyo, nikech anie chandruok.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

kikuyu: ‘Wuod Dhano nyaka ket e lwet joricho, kendo nogure to chiengʼ mar adek nochiere kendo.’ ”
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

kikuyu: kata mondo uresa e lwet wasika, kata resa e lwet jo-mahundu?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

kikuyu: ma kuome waseyude kuom yie yor chopo e ngʼwono makoro wan-goni. Bende wail kuom geno mar duongʼ mar Nyasaye.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

kikuyu: To jogo ma timbegi richo, gi jojuogi, gi joma terore kod jonek, gi joma lamo nyiseche manono kod ji duto ma ohero miriambo kendo matimo gik ma ok adiera, duto nobed oko.
english: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

kikuyu: Enokaw tap mach moketie mach mogol e kendo mar misango manie nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi ubani mangʼwe ngʼar madirom lwedo ariyo, kendo nokelgi kama ogengʼ gi pasia.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

kikuyu: Nodwoko ni, “Dhiuru uwach ne kibweno niya, ‘Abiro golo jochiende kendo chango ji kawuononi gi kiny, to chiengʼ mar adek abiro chopo dwarona.’
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

kikuyu: Ne nitie janabi madhako bende, Ana, nyar Fanuel ma ja-dhood Asher. Ne oti ahinya; bende noyudo osedak gi chwore higni abiriyo bangʼ kendne,
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

kikuyu: Yie ema miyo wangʼeyo ni Wach Nyasaye ema nochweyo gik moko duto manie polo gi piny, mi nomiyo gik mantie mineno gi wangʼ owuok kuom gik ma ok ne.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

kikuyu: “To ngʼowu nodwoko ni, ‘Ere kaka dawe olembena mabeyo kendo mamit mondo abed ruodh yiende?’
english: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

kikuyu: Dhakono nomi bwombe ariyo mag ongo maduongʼ mondo ohugo ochopgo kama nolosne e thim, kuma ne idhi ritee kimiye chiemo kuom higni adek gi nus kama thuol ok ne nyal chopoe ire.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

kikuyu: Herode nosingore ne nyakono e yor kwongʼruok niya, “Gimoro amora mikwaya abiro miyi, kata obed mana nus pinyruodha.”
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye, ma jiwo joma chunygi onyosore, nojiwowa kane Tito obiro irwa,
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

kikuyu: Elifaz nonywolo Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam kod Kenaz. Timna ma ne en chi Elifaz machielo nonywolo Amalek.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nomedo wuoro mi giwacho kendgi niya, “Kare en ngʼa manyalo kwo?”
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Puonj ma kamago aa kuom jo-miriambo mawuondore, jogo ma pachgi manyiso ni gin joketho osetho mana ka gima orew gi nyinyo maliet.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

kikuyu: Kane waa kanyo, ne wakwangʼ mi wachopo Regiam, to kinyne, ka yamb milambo nochako kudho, ne wadhi nyime nyaka ne wachopo Puteoli, bangʼ kwangʼ kuom ndalo ariyo.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

kikuyu: Ket okangega mondo gilure gi wachni; kik iwe richo moro amora loya.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

kikuyu: To Esta ne pok owacho ne ngʼato angʼata nonro mar anywolane kata oganda mowuokie mana kaka ne Modekai osechike mondo otim, ne pod orito chik mane omiye gi Modekai mana kaka ne otimo kane pod odak kode kopidhe.
english: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.

kikuyu: ne oseromo higni piero ochiko gaboro kendo wengene nosedinore makoro ok onen.
english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

kikuyu: Hoch ma Nyasaye hoyigo kod weche mosebedo kinyisi gi ngʼwono, donge oromi?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

kikuyu: Chwor dhako nyalo guro kata ketho singruok kata kwongʼruok ma chiege dwaro sandorego.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

kikuyu: We jo-Moab moringo lweny odag kodu kendo bednegi ragengʼ kuom jakethgi.” Ngʼatno masandogi tekone norum, kendo kethruok notieki; mi jathir ji nolal nono e piny.
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye nosin ahinya gi kwereu.
english: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, achiwo chik mar gima onego itimne jodong jo-Yahudi e gedo mar odni mar Nyasaye: Gigo ma jogi otiyogo nyaka chul duto koa e keno mar ka ruoth, moa e pesa mochoki kuom Yufrate, mondo omi tich kik chungʼ.
english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

kikuyu: Nikech mano en tim wichkuot maduongʼ kendo en richo marach manyaka kum,
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

kikuyu: Bende in gi teko machalo gi mar Nyasaye koso dwondi bende nyalo mor kaka mare?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

kikuyu: “Kata ka dibed ni ruoth moro dwaro dhiyo e lweny e kinde gi ruoth machielo. Donge mokwongo onego obed piny mondo opar anena ka ji alufu apar ma en-go bende onyalo kedogo gi jal mabiro monje man-gi ji alufu piero ariyo?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

kikuyu: Ber mar bungene kod puothene momewo, nowangʼ chuth, mana ka ngʼat matuo ochamo dende motieko.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

kikuyu: “Chungʼ ane ka dichwo; mondo idwoka weche, ma adwaro penjigi.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

kikuyu: Ka sibuor oruto, to ere ngʼama ok dibed maluor? Kata ere janabi madilingʼ alingʼa ma ok ohulo gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto onyise?
english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

kikuyu: Ayub nomedo wuoyo kawacho niya,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: To ne giriwore ka gikwedo Zekaria mi negichiele kod kite e laru mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaka ne ruoth omiyogi chik; mi notho.
english: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “We otimre kamano sani; en gima ber ne an kodi mondo watim ma, eka wachop tim makare duto.” Eka Johana noyie.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mokwongʼo wuon kata min, nyaka negi; nikech timneno; rembe nodongʼ e wiye owuon.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

kikuyu: Ka ruodhe nowinjo gima chiege owachone kuom gima jatichne osetimone, iye nowangʼ matek.
english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Jodolo, jo-Lawi, jower, jorit dhorangeye kod jotij hekalu nodak Jerusalem, kaachiel gi joma moko, to jo-Israel mamoko nodak e miechgi.
english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

kikuyu: Ne imako wengena mi ok oimore, kendo ne an gi pek ma ok anyal wuoyo.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

kikuyu: Nogero mier madongo mag Juda mochiel gohinga motegno nimar piny ne nigi kwe. Onge ngʼama ne kedo kode ndalogo nikech Jehova Nyasaye nomiye yweyo.
english: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because the LORD had given him rest.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, Jal manoloso yo e dier nam, kendo manoketo yo e kind pi mogingore,
english: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,

kikuyu: To jopuonjrene nolingʼ ma ok odwoke nikech e yo ne oyudo gigoyo mbaka ni en ngʼa kuomgi maduongʼ moloyo.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

kikuyu: Joab nodwoke niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Nyasaye mangima, ni ka dine ok iwuoyo, to jogi dodhi nyime gi lawo owetegi nyaka gokinyi.”
english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

kikuyu: Ne giwuok Midian kendo negidhi Paran. Bangʼ kawo chwo mag Paran kodgi negidhi Misri, ir Farao ruodh Misri, mane omiyo Hadad ot gi lowo kod chiemo.
english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, agolo chik ni ogendini duto gi ji moa e dhoudi mopogore opogore ma dipo ni owacho gimoro marach kuom Nyasach Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego mondo negi kendo utegi mondo omuki mi lokre pidhe, nikech onge nyasaye moro machielo manyalo reso ji e yo machal kama.”
english: Therefore I make a decree that every people, nation, and language which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill, because there is no other god who is able to deliver like this.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe negioro jo-Farisai gi jo-Herodia ir Yesu mondo odwar wach mawuok e dhoge mondo gimakego.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

kikuyu: Bi piyo mondo ikonya, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye kendo Jawarna.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

kikuyu: ne jomaler, inyisori kaka ngʼama ler, to ne joma yoregi obam, inyisori kaka ngʼama rach.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

kikuyu: Un dhiuru adhiya e sawo. An pod ok adhi e sawono mondi nikech sa mowinjore adhi kuno pok ochopo.”
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Isemiya okumba mar warruokni, kendo lweti korachwich osesira; kony mari osemiyo abedo gi duongʼ.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

kikuyu: Warruok ni mabor gi joma timbegi richo, nimar ok giket chunygi kuom dwaro chikeni.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

kikuyu: Daudi nomako geche lweny alufu achiel gi joidh farese alufu abiriyo, gi jolweny mawuotho gi tiendgi alufu piero ariyo. Nongʼado odond farese duto.
english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

kikuyu: Nodhi Nazareth kuma nodonge, kendo chiengʼ Sabato nodhi e sinagogi, kaka nobedo kite kendo nochungo mondo osom.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

kikuyu: Nikech gik ma osetimorenwagi, chunywa ool kendo wengewa osejony,
english: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

kikuyu: eka enolut lith lwete ma korachwich e mo manie pat lwete ma koracham, kendo kire nyadibiriyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

kikuyu: Debora, chiew, chiew! ‘Chungi kendo ia malo mondo ichak wer! Aa malo, yaye Barak! Ter jogo miseloyo e twech, yaye wuod Abinoam.’
english: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’

kikuyu: kendo bangʼe wuowi mar adek ne jokende, to machalre kamano nyaka wuowi mar abiriyo notho, ma ok ginywolo nyithindo.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

kikuyu: “An to ne adwoke niya, ‘Ruoth, jogi ongʼeyo kaka nawuotho e sinagogi ka sinagogi mondo atwe kendo asandi joma oyie kuomi.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, koro kuny kor ot.” Omiyo ne akunyo kor ot kendo ne aneno dhoot kanyo.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

kikuyu: Noneno ka ja-Misri moro goyo ja-Israel wadgi, omiyo ne odhi okonye mi nogoyo ja-Misrino monego.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

kikuyu: Kik iwe hera kod adiera weyi; twegi e ngʼuti, kendo ndikgi e chunyi maiye.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Wabeduru moil kendo mamor ahinya kendo wamiyeuru duongʼ! Nikech kinde kisera mar Nyarombo osechopo, kendo chiege oseikne.
english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

kikuyu: isandowa, to ok jwangʼwa; idwaro negwa, to ok tiekwa.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath, im ka im, rombo ka rombo, kata nyadiel ka nyadiel, nyaka losi e yo machal kamano.
english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo loka komachielo e gwengʼ mar Gadarena, chwo ariyo mane nigi jochiende nowuokne e gunda mar liete moromo kode. Ne giger ahinya maonge ngʼama ne nyalo kalo kanyo.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

kikuyu: ne iloso ni in iwuon kama otingʼore gi malo kendo ne igero kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag kamoro amora.
english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni Elija ja-Tishbi:
english: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

kikuyu: Abiro weroni wer manyien, yaye Nyasaye; abiro weroni wer mamit ka agoyoni thum man-gi tonde apar,
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: Ringuru utony ni terruok. Richo duto ma ngʼato timo otimo oko mar ringre, to ngʼat machodo timo richo ni ringre owuon.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemedo tongʼ maru kaka ne osingorenu, mi ugombo chamo ringʼo ma uwacho niya, “Agombo chamo ringʼo,” to nucham ringʼo mangʼeny kaka unyalo.
english: When the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

kikuyu: Misri nobed piny ma ji odar oweyo, kendo Edom nobed piny ongoro maonge tich, nikech timbe mahundu mane otimone jo-Juda, mane gichweroe remo maonge ketho e pinygi.
english: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo uwuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye? Koso uparo ni miriambou biro konyo Nyasaye?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

kikuyu: Ahazia gi Joram wuod Ahab nodhi kedo gi Hazael ruodh Aram e piny Ramoth Gilead. Jo-Aram nohinyo Joram;
english: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

kikuyu: Obiro siko ka wangʼ chiengʼ, obiro siko ka dwe e tienge duto.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: “Jogo duto mamon kodi wigi biro kuot ma dhier nono, adier jogo duto makwedi biro lal nono.
english: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Un gi makati adi?” Negidwoke niya, “Abiriyo kende gi rech matindo manok.”
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

kikuyu: Ginitangni e piny ka githagore kendo ka gidenyo, kendo e kindeno ma kech onurogi, igi nowangʼ matek mi gikwongʼ ruodhgi kod Nyasachgi.
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

kikuyu: To jogo mane dongʼ e dhoodi nobi ire kakulore e nyime mondo omi fedha gi kuon kendo nokwaye niya, “Yie imiya tich dolo moro mondo ayud kaka dayud chiemo machamo.” ’ ”
english: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ ka Jehova Nyasaye osekelou e piny jo-Kanaan mi omiyougo, kaka ne osingo ka okwongʼorenu kaachiel gi kwereu,
english: “It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

kikuyu: Negiwachone Samuel niya, “Kik iwe ma ok ikwayonwa Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa mondo omi oreswa e lwet jo-Filistia.”
english: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: gi oniks kod kite moko miketo kuom law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kod law akor.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

kikuyu: “ ‘To un rombena, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro ngʼado bura e kind rombo achiel gi nyawadgi, kendo e kind imbe kod nywogi.
english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

kikuyu: “Jolwenje momanore gi gig lweny nowuog mondo gidwany kama ochiel motegno mar hekalu kendo ginitiek misengini mitimo pile pile. Eka ginichung gima kwero makelo kethruok kanyo.
english: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.

kikuyu: Dwaro mar chuny dhano chalo gi pi matut, to ngʼat man-gi winjo twomogi.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

kikuyu: “ ‘Dwok ligangla e olalone. Kama ne onywolie, e lop kwereni, ema abiro ngʼadonie bura.
english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

kikuyu: Bed gi geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo luw yore. Obiro tingʼi malo mi omi piny bed mari; ka joma richo ongʼad kargi oko to ibiro neno gi wangʼi.
english: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

kikuyu: To ka chiayono ne okwal koa kuom wadgi, to nyaka wadgino chule nengo moromo gi chiayono.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

kikuyu: To ngʼeyo tiend wachni dwaro rieko, Ngʼat man-gi rieko, mondo okwan namba mar ondiek, nikech nambano ochungʼ kar nying dhano. Nambano en mia auchiel gi piero auchiel gauchiel.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

kikuyu: Jowetewa, ok wadwar mondo ubed ka ukia gima timore ne joma osetho, kata mondo ubed gi kuyo ka joma moko, maonge gi geno.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nogolo odunga duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mi okelone jo-Israel duto. Ne gingʼiyogi, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nokawo odungane owuon.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano bed kingʼeyo kendo kiwinjo tiend wachni kama: Chakre chiengʼ mane ogolie chik mondo ochak oger Jerusalem, nyaka chop biro mar Jal Mowir, ma Ruoth, biro bedo kinde maromo higni mia angʼwen gi piero ochiko kod higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek gangʼwen. Ibiro gere kendo, ka en gi yorene mag dala kod buche matut molwore, to nogere e kinde mag chandruok.
english: “Know therefore and discern that from the going out of the commandment to restore and build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, the prince, will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

kikuyu: To noluok jamb-ich gi tiendene kod pi, eka jadolo nokelgi duto mi nowangʼ-gi ewi kendo mar misango. En misango miwangʼo pep, madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo kendo mathiro ji neno chandruok e kinde duto mag ngimane.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

kikuyu: Ahaz notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike e dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem; to ne ok oike e liete ruodhi mag Israel. Kendo Hezekia wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nimar awachonu adier ni jonabi gi joma kare mangʼeny nogombo neno gik muneno, to ne ok ginene, kendo winjo gik muwinjogi, to ne ok giwinjo.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi machielono Jehu nowuok modhi ochungʼ e nyim oganda mowachonegi niya, “Un to uonge ketho makmana ni an ema ne ariwora gi ji ma andhogo ruodha kendo anege, to koro joma othogi duto, to ngʼama onego?
english: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

kikuyu: To nyaka chil kawuono pok Jehova Nyasaye imiyou paro mar ngʼeyo, mar neno kata it mar winjo.
english: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

kikuyu: mi ji ariyogo nobed ringruok achiel.’ Omiyo koro ok gin ji ariyo, to gin ringruok achiel.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

kikuyu: Rachungi ka rachungi ne nigi tiende angʼwen mag mula, man kod chumbe mag mula molworore kendo moro ka moro ewi rachungi angʼwen-go nokete karaya molosi e kido mar maua koni gi kocha.
english: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

kikuyu: Nimar ka ji timo gigi ka yath numu, angʼo mabiro timore ka otwo?”
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

kikuyu: Cham mar misango mane odongʼ koro nobedi mar Harun gi yawuote, ma en gima ler moloyo kuom misengini mag Jehova Nyasaye miwangʼo gi mach.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: ruodhi duto mag Arabu kod ruodhi duto mag welo modak kama otwo;
english: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

kikuyu: Samson nodwoke niya, “Ka ngʼato otweya gi tonde abiriyo manyien mapok otiyo, to abiro bedo manyap machal gi ngʼato angʼata.”
english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”

kikuyu: Kik uchiw chiayo man-gi songa nikech Jehova Nyasaye ok bi yie kode.
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

kikuyu: Eka iluonga e nyimi kendo abiro dwoki, kata iyiena awuo mondo idwoka.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

kikuyu: Gibiro rwakore gi piende gugru kendo midhiero biro pongʼo chunygi. Ginibed gi wichkuot, kendo ibiro liel yie wigi.
english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Abigael niya, “Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, moseori kawuononi mondo irom koda.
english: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo niya, “En kanye?” Ziba nodwoke niya, “En e od Makir wuod Amiel modak Lo Debar.”
english: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde mane jo-Israel opidho cham mag-gi, jo-Midian, jo-Amalek kod jogo moa yo wuok chiengʼ ne monjo piny.
english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kohath ne gin: Amram, Izhar, Hebron kod Uziel. (Kohath nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek gadek.)
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

kikuyu: Yawuot joma ne osandi nobi iri kakulore e nyimi; jogo duto mane ojari biro kulore e tiendi, kendo giniluongi ni Dala Maduongʼ ma en mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Sayun mar Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Sibekai ma ja-Hushath, Ilai ma ja-Ahohi,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni osejwangʼi kendo osechayi, maonge ngʼama limi, abiro miyo ibed dala man-gi duongʼ mosiko kendo mor mar tiengʼ mabiro mangʼeny.
english: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo wuoyonegi gi ngeche machal gi mago e thuolo moro amora mane ginyalo winje.
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

kikuyu: Balaam nowacho ne Balak niya, “Bed but misangoni ka, ka anto adhi romo gi Nyasaye bathe kocha.”
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

kikuyu: Chikuru itu kendo winjuru gima owacho. Kik ungʼanyne; nimar Nyinga ni kuome, nikech ka utimo kamano to ok enowenu.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

kikuyu: Jowetena, akwayou ni mondo uchal koda, mana kaka an asebedo machal kodu. Pok uchwanya e yo moro amora.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato dwaro mondo obed rahuma to ok otim gik moko lingʼ-lingʼ. Omiyo kaka isebedo ka itimo honnigi, koro nyenyri ane e lela mondo piny oneni.”
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

kikuyu: ka piny ngʼiringʼiri, ka piny dwaro yuso, e kindeno ma mudho mako piny.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

kikuyu: nikech hera matut ma aherogo odi tieka, kendo ayenje mag joma yanyi lwar kuoma.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Josef ja-Arimathaya nokwayo Pilato mondo omiye ringre Yesu. Josef ne en japuonjre Yesu to nobedo kamano lingʼ-lingʼ nikech noluoro jo-Yahudi. Kane Pilato osemiye thuolo, nobiro mokawo ringre Yesu.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, koro osengʼere malongʼo ne askeche dala ruoth duto, kod ji mamoko duto ni otweya nikech Kristo.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo Nyasaye nosetieko tichne mane osebedo ka otimo; omiyo odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo noyweyo kuom tijene duto.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

kikuyu: Kane Josef oneno owetene, nofwenyogi to nowuondore mondo kik gingʼeye. Kendo nowuoyo kodgi gi gero kopenjogi niya, “Ua kanye?” To negidwoke niya, “Waa e piny Kanaan mondo wabi warund chiemo.”
english: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

kikuyu: Kane Reuben owinjo ma notemo mondo ores Josef e lwet owetene. Nowachonegi niya, “Kik wanege.
english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone niya, “Isetimo tim mofuwo. Ok iserito chik mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi omiyi; ka dine iriti, to doguro pinyruodhi e Israel nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which he commanded you; for now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Israel maonge gi yie ler moloyo Juda ma ok ja-adiera.
english: The LORD said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne aketo pacha mondo angʼe pogruok manie kind rieko, memruok kod fuwo. En angʼo ma ruoth mokawo kar ruoth machielo nyalo timo moloyo mano mosetim?
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

kikuyu: nyaka chop chiengʼ mane okawe motere e polo, bangʼ chiwo chik ni joote mane oseyiero kuom teko mar Roho Maler.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Kik ipuonjri yore ogendini kata ibed gi bwok gi ranyisi manie kor polo, kata obedo ni gibwogo ogendini.
english: The LORD says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

kikuyu: Eka nokok kowacho niya, “Reti! Dhi piyo! Kik ichungʼ!” Wuowino nokwanyo asereno mi odok ir ruodhe.
english: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

kikuyu: Tito to anyalo wuoyo kuome kaka ngʼat mwagenorego kendo jatich mwatiyogo kaachiel e dieru, to jowetewa mamokogo to gin joma kanisa ooro, mondo omi Kristo duongʼ.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

kikuyu: E ndalono ema Hazael ruodh Aram ne odhi momonjo Gath mi omake. Eka ne odhi mondo omonj Jerusalem bende.
english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowuok Rameses kendo negibuoro Sukoth.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto modak Misri nongʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye. “ ‘Isebedo mayom yom ka odundu ni dhood Israel.
english: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Jo-Moab duto nowinjo ni ruodhi ka osebiro mondo oked kodgi, omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato, obed ngʼat matin kata ngʼat maduongʼ mane nyalo tingʼo gige lweny noluongi mi oketi e tongʼ.
english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

kikuyu: Negikwere niya, “Mano en miriambo, wachnwa adier.” Jehu nodwokogi niya, “Ma e gima nonyisa: ‘Ni Jehova Nyasaye owacho: Asewiri mondo ibed ruodh Israel.’ ”
english: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘The LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano nobiro ka chiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, ‘Neyeuru jawuoro kendo jamer mosiep josol osuru gi joricho.’ To rieko ifwenyo adimba kuom timbene.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

kikuyu: “Gin jotichgi kendo jogi, mane ireso gi tekoni maduongʼ kod badi maratego.
english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

kikuyu: Ka koro nochiegni chopo e miech Bethfage kod Bethania manie Got Zeituni, nooro jopuonjrene ariyo, nowachonegi niya,
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato owachonu gimoro amora to unyise ni Ruoth dwarogi, kendo gikanyono obiro miyougi mondo ukelnagi.”
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

kikuyu: Maria-ni ma owadgi Lazaro makoro tuoni ema noolo mo mangʼwe ngʼar e tiend Ruoth mi oyweyo gi yie wiye.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nyalo biro ira ka ok Wuora mane oora ema okele, kendo anachiere chiengʼ giko piny.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kikuyu: Nimar higni alufu achiel e nyimi chalo gi odiechiengʼ manyoro mosekalo, kata gi sa mar otieno.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Ok anachak ane Jehova Nyasaye owuon, e piny joma ngima; bende ok anachak aket genona kuom dhano wadwa, kata bedo gi joma koro odak e pinyni.
english: I said, “I won’t see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

kikuyu: To kane gisejare ne gilonyo kandho makwar mane girwakone mi girwakone lepe owuon. Bangʼe ne gitere oko mondo gigure.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

kikuyu: Jatichne ma nyako ma nyinge Reuma bende nonywolone yawuowi, ma gin: Teba, Gaham, Tahash kod Maaka.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nokawo chiayo mar timo misango miwangʼo pep kendo nochiwe mana kaka ne chik dwaro.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasaye notelonegi ma giluwo yo malworo thim mochomo Nam Makwar. Jo-Israel nowuok e piny Misri ka oikore ne lweny.
english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: We angʼadi adhi ane piny maber loka Jordan piny gode kod Lebanon.”
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, temuru matek kaka unyalo mondo umed ber e yieu, to bende medeuru ngʼeyo;
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

kikuyu: Kuom mano jo-Moab dengo, gidengo kaachiel nikech Moab. Ywaguru kendo ubed gi lit nikech jo-Kir Hareseth.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

kikuyu: Omiyo Sara nohum kanyiero gie chunye niya, “Bende ma ditimre adier ka an kod ruodha wasedoko joma oti ka ma?”
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

kikuyu: Nikech Musa nomiyou chik mar mondo oteru nyangu (to chutho Musa ok ema nomiyou chikni, to noa kuom kwereu), omiyo utero ji nyangu nyaka chiengʼ Sabato.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

kikuyu: Noneno obadho mane gichikone to nowachonegi niya,
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

kikuyu: nikech teko mar joma timbegi richo ibiro kethi, to Jehova Nyasaye tingʼo ngʼat makare malo.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

kikuyu: Eka Miriam janabi madhako ma nyamin Harun, nokawo oyieke e lwete kendo mon duto noluwo bangʼe ka gin gi oyieke kendo ka gimiel.
english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

kikuyu: Holo ka holo nobugi mapongʼ, gode madongo gi matindo duto nopie; yore motimo gogni nobed maler, kendo kuonde motimo gode nobed pewe.
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

kikuyu: nyikwa Imer, ji alufu achiel gi piero abich gariyo (1,052),
english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

kikuyu: Ka iwinjo ka iwacho e achiel kuom miechu ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou mondo udagie
english: If you hear about one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there, that

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato madhi ire maduogo kata yudo yor ngima.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

kikuyu: Mana kaka bungu mar kudho e lwet ngʼat momer, e kaka ngero moa e dho ngʼat mofuwo.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kata kamano bangʼ ka owetene nosewuok odhi e sawo, en bende nodhi, to nodhi lingʼ-lingʼ ka ji ok ongʼeyo ni odhi.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

kikuyu: Notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kowuotho e yore mag Jeroboam kod richone mane omiyo Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Mana kaka dhano wuok ei min-gi ka en duk, e kaka obiro dok. Onge gino moago kuom tichne matek monyalo tingʼo e lwete.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

kikuyu: Obiro mayogi nyisechegi, kido molos gi chuma kod gigegi mamoko ma nengogi tek molos gi fedha gi dhahabu mi odhi kodgi nyaka Misri. Kuom higni moko enowe kedo gi ruodh Nyandwat.
english: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.

kikuyu: To koro sani, yaye Israel, en angʼo ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu dwaro makmana miye luor kendo wuotho e yorene kendo hero tiyone gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto.
english: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero Sayun, osehere kaka kar dakne, osewacho ni,
english: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

kikuyu: Wachne bende onge eiu, nimar udagi yie kuom Jal mane ooro.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nopenje niya, “Onge ngʼat ma dipo kodongʼ e dhood Saulo ma anyalo timo ne tim ngʼwono mar Nyasaye?” Ziba nodwoko ruoth kowacho niya, “Nitie wuod Jonathan; to tiendene duto ongʼol.”
english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

kikuyu: Mapiyo nono ka wachni nochopo ni ji, jo-Israel nochiwo cham magikwongo kayo, gi divai magikwongo loso gi mor Zeituni mokwongo nyak gi mor kich kod gik moko duto mag puodho.
english: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.

kikuyu: Gibiro kedo kodi to ok gini loyi, nimar an kodi kendo abiro resi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”

kikuyu: Bende noornu koth kuom kodhi muchwowo e lowo kendo chiemo mawuok e piny nobed mamiyo kendo mangʼeny. E kindeno jambu nokwa e lege madongo.
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en kar pondo ne joma idiyo, en e kar pondo e kinde mag chandruok.
english: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

kikuyu: Obiro loyo piny jo-Edom e lweny mi okaw; kendo Seir ma wasike, nokaw, to Israel nomed bedo motegno.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

kikuyu: “An mana jadak kendo wendo e kindu. Miyauru kamoro angʼiew moromo kar yiko.”
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jotende miluongo ni Zimri mane otelo ni nus gechene nochano mar nege. Ela ne nitie Tirza e kindeno, komer e dala Arza, ngʼat motelo ni od ruoth man Tirza.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro man-gi dhoho nobiro mogoyo chonge piny e nyim Yesu, kendo nowachone niya, “Ruoth, kiyie to inyalo pwodha.”
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Mosnauru watna ma Herodion. Mosnauru jood Narkiso, mohero Ruoth.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

kikuyu: “En ngʼatno ma chunyu ogeno ahinya kendo uluoro, momiyo usebedona jo-miriambo, kendo ok usepara kata mana paro wechena e chunyu? Koso en nikech uneno ni aselingʼ ahinya, momiyo ok useluora?
english: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ nigi kit ler ma mare owuon, to dwe bende nigi machielo, kendo sulwe bende nigi mare. Sulwe ka sulwe chiwo ler mopogore gi nyawadgi.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

kikuyu: “To jopur puodhogo nomako jotichnego mi ogoyo achiel, to machielo ginego to mar adek gichielo gi kite.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

kikuyu: E nyim Nyasachwa kendo Wuonwa, wasiko kwaparo yie ma un-go mosemiyo utimo gik mabeyo gi herau momiyo utiyo ne Nyasaye matek, kod geno ma un-go kuom Ruoth Yesu Kristo, momiyo uchungʼ motegno kutimo kinda.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

kikuyu: To ngʼat man-gi mwandu bende onego bed mamor ka Nyasaye odwoke piny, nikech ja-mwandu biro lal nono mana ka maua moti e thim.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

kikuyu: kod Judas Iskariot, jal ma nondhoge.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

kikuyu: To wayudo koa kuome, gimoro amora mwakwaye nikech wamako chikene kendo watimo gik mamore.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

kikuyu: Kochopo otieno to chokena muodore amuoda, kendo rem ma an-go ok miya yweyo.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye notimo mana kaka Musa nokwaye. Ogwende notho ei udi kod laru gi pewe.
english: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nowachone riwruok duto mar jo-Israel niya, “Ka wachni bernu kendo ka en dwaro mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, to waor wach ne jowetewa mamoko kamoro amora ma gintiere e kuonde mag Israel kaachiel gi jodolo gi jo-Lawi man kodgi e miechgi to gi lege mag kwath mondo gibi irwa.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yaye ruodh jo-Israel ma timbene mono kendo richo, in bende ndaloni osechopo ma ibiro kumie mogik.
english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mane ichungʼ tenge ka joma moko donjo e dhorangeyene, kendo gigoyo ombulu ne Jerusalem, ne ichal mana kodgi.
english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

kikuyu: Kendo kuome ema un bende igeroue kaachiel mondo udok kar dak mar Nyasaye kuom Rohone.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Eka Haman nowachone ruoth Ahasuerus niya, “Nitie oganda moro moke e kind ogendini manie pinyruodhi ma timbegi opogore gi mag ogendini duto ma ok oluoro kata mana chike mag ruoth; omiyo ok en wach maber ka ruoth oweyogi aweya.
english: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Kikombena to en adier ni ubiro methoe, to bedo e bada ma korachwich kata ma koracham ok an ema achiw. Kuondego gin mag joma Wuora ochano negi chon.”
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

kikuyu: Kama alosonue misangono ubiro chamo boche ma uyiengʼ kendo ubiro madho remo mi umer.
english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

kikuyu: to bangʼe ubiro kendo uchungʼ e nyima e odni, ma Nyinga nitie, kendo uwacho ni, “Wasetony” utony mondo utim gik mamonogi?
english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?

kikuyu: Jowa nyaka puonjre keto chunygi kuom timo gik mabeyo, mondo eka giyud gik ma gikonyorego e ngimagi mapile kendo kik gidagi e ngima ma ok kel konyruok.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

kikuyu: “Nyaka karangʼo ma un joma ngʼeyogi tin nusik kuhero yoreu mag ngʼeyo matin?” Nyaka karangʼo ma jojaro pod nosik kamor, e jaro kendo joma ofuwo nosiki kochayo puonj?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

kikuyu: Nowachone ogandago mondo obed piny e lum. Bangʼ mano nokawo makati abiriyogo, kendo kane osegoyo erokamano, nongʼingogi bangʼe omiyogi jopuonjrene mondo opog ji, mine gitimo kamano.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

kikuyu: Nanyisogi niya, “Ka uparo ni en gima ber, to miyauru misacha, to ka ok kamano to beduru kode.” Omiyo ne gichula pesa mamingli mag fedha moromo piero adek.
english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Wer. Zaburi. Go koko gi mor ne Nyasaye, in piny duto!
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

kikuyu: onego giwer e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nimar obiro mondo ongʼad bura ne piny. Obiro ngʼado bura ne piny e yo makare kendo obiro yalo ji maonge dewo wangʼ.
english: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo koda kendo kawacho niya,
english: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,

kikuyu: Omiyo nochungʼ malo chuny otieno kendo okaw wuoda e batha ka jatichni ne nindo. Nokete e kore to okawo wuode mothono oketo e kora.
english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

kikuyu: To Nowa nonywolo Shem, Ham kod Jafeth.
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Denda tetni nikech oluori, kihondko omaka nikech chikeni.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

kikuyu: Kanyo ema unuparie timbeu kod yoreu duto ma usedwanyorugo, kendo ok unubed mamor gi timbe mamono duto musetimo.
english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Mano kaka nobed marach moloyo kuom Jerusalem ka anaor kum maga angʼwen ma gin ligangla gi kech, gi le mager kod dera, mondo aneg joge kod le mage duto!
english: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “So lweti ei lawi.” Kuom mano, Musa nosoyo lwete ei lawe kendo kane ogole oko, to lwete nolokore dhoho, marachar ka pe.
english: The LORD said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mane sulwe mokinyi wer kanyakla kendo mane malaike duto kok gimor?
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

kikuyu: Ma e kaka notimre ne un bende, yaye Bethel, nikech anjawo maru duongʼ. Ka odiechiengno ochopo, ruodh Israel notiek chuth.”
english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Bangʼe pach Petro noduogo mi owacho niya, “Koro angʼeyo maonge kiawa ni Ruoth nooro malaikane mi oresa e twech Herode, kendo osemiyo atony e gimoro amora marach ma jo-Yahudi ne chano timona.”
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

kikuyu: omiyo Daudi nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach kendo Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Kik ichomgi tir lwor gi yo ka ngʼegi kendo imonjgi kama omanyore gi omburi.
english: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: To notamore winje, to kaka notek moloye, noterore kode githuon.
english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

kikuyu: ne an wendo, to ne ok urwaka ei ot; ne achando lewni, to ne ok urwaka; ne atuo kendo ne an e od twech, to ne ok ulima?’
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

kikuyu: To kane oorne joote gi jotend Babulon mondo openje kuom ranyisi mar hono mane otimore e piny, Nyasaye noweye mondo oteme mondo eka ongʼe gima ne nitiere e chunye.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

kikuyu: Bed modhil e chandruok kaachiel kodwa kaka jalweny maber mar Kristo Yesu.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: “ ‘E thuoloni duto ma en e bwo singruok mar bedo tenge ne Jehova Nyasaye, ok onego osud machiegni gi ringre ngʼama otho.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.

kikuyu: ‘Jehova Nyasaye ne ok nyal chopo gi jogi e piny mane osingorenegi kokwongʼore, momiyo ne onegogi e thim.’
english: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

kikuyu: Piny duto ma inenono abiro miyi gi nyikwayi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: kod kuonde mobokore e del gi kuonde moluro kata mamarmar.
english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

kikuyu: “Nyis Harun gi yawuote kod jo-Israel duto kiwachonegi ni: ‘Ka ngʼato moro amora kuomu, bed ni en ja-Israel kata jadak manie dieru okelo misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye, bedni en mar chopo singo kata chiwo mar hera,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:

kikuyu: Eka ne awacho niya, “Winjuru un jotelo maka Jakobo, un jotelo mag dhood Israel. Donge onego ungʼe ngʼado bura kare.
english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

kikuyu: Nezia kod Hatifa.
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

kikuyu: Vashti mikach ruoth bende ne oloso sawo ne mon modak e dala ruoth Ahasuerus.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: Daudi nochano joma ne ni kode kendo noyieronigi jotend lweny mag alufe to gi mag miche.
english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

kikuyu: Eka Manoa nokawo nyadiel, kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham, mi otimone Jehova Nyasaye misango ewi lwanda. Kendo Jehova Nyasaye notimo gima hono ka Manoa gi chiege neno.
english: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to the LORD. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.

kikuyu: Chikeni e thoro mar wenda, kamoro amora ma abwore.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

kikuyu: “Nyaka aa ndalo mar Gibea, isebedo ka itimo richo, yaye Israel, to kanyo ema isesike. Donge lweny notieko jotim richo man Gibea?
english: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ne aneno Satan kalor aa e polo mana ka mil polo.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

kikuyu: Jokor wach wigi biro kuot kendo jo-nyakalondo none wichkuot. Dhogi nomoki nikech ok giniyud dwoko moa kuom Nyasaye.”
english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

kikuyu: ka en to nodhi e wuodh ndalo achiel e thim. Nochopo e tiend yien ma wiye opedhore mobedo e tiende kendo nolamo ni mad otho. Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, aseneno moroma, kaw ngimana, ok aber moloyo kwerena.”
english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

kikuyu: Herode ne chunye chandore nikech en owuon ema nogolo chik mondo omak Johana, kendo kuom chikneno askechene nomako Johana moketo e od twech. Notimo kamano nikech wach Herodia mane en chi owadgi ma nyinge Filipo. Herode nomayo owadgino dhako mi oloko chiege owuon.
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Yahudi mane odak mokiewo kodgi nobiro kendo okonewa nyadipar niya, “Gibiro monjou kamoro ma udhiyoe.”
english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

kikuyu: Nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Obiro miyo malaika mage chik nikech in mondo oriti maber;
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

kikuyu: “Ngʼat ma ipwodhono nyaka luok lepe, kendo noliel yie dende duto, bangʼe nolwokre gi pi, eka nobed ngʼama opwodhore. Bangʼ mae eka oyiene mar donjo ei kambi to ok oyiene mondo onindi ei hema nyaka chop bangʼ ndalo abiriyo.
english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ere kaka giwacho ni Kristo en Wuod Daudi?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

kikuyu: Nyis Harun gi yawuote kama: Magi e chike mag misango mar golo richo: Chiach misango mar golo richo nyaka yangʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kama iyangʼoe chiach misango miwangʼo pep nikech en gima ler moloyo.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Omiyo jolweny nongʼado tonde ma notwego yie matin mar resruok, mi giweyo yieno okwangʼ modhi.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

kikuyu: En gima ber ka en dwaro Nyasaye, mondo osand ngʼato kuom timo maber moloyo ka ngʼato yudo sand kuom timo richo.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

kikuyu: “Usewacho kama, ‘Tiyone Nyasaye onge tiende. En ohala mane ma wayudo kuom timo dwache kendo kuom wuotho ka waywagore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Maratego?
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of Armies?
