kikuyu: Olal nono mana ka lek, kendo ok chak yud ndache iriembe modhi mabor, mana ka lek mar otieno.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

kikuyu: To mana kaka jager ot nigi duongʼ moloyo duongʼ mar ot mogero, e kaka Yesu onego omi duongʼ moloyo Musa.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu medo dhi nyime koa kanyo, muofni ariyo ne luwo bangʼe, ka goyo koko kawacho niya, “Yie ikechwa wuod Daudi!”
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

kikuyu: Manoa nowachone malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Dwaher mondo ibed kodwa matin nyaka wayangʼnie nyadiel moro.”
english: Manoah said to the LORD’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Ere ngʼatno?” To nodwokogi niya, “Ok angʼeyo kuma entiere.”
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

kikuyu: Anaketi ibed ohinga ne jogi, ohinga moger motegno mar mula; giniked kodi to ok gini loyi, nimar an kodi mondo akonyi kendo resi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane osebatiso Yesu to nowuok oa ei pi. To gisano polo noyawore kendo noneno Roho mar Nyasaye kalor e kido mar akuru, kendo piyo kuome.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowinjo ngʼurgi mi oparo singruokne gi Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo.
english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

kikuyu: Ee, in bende akwayi, jatich wadwa, mondo ikony mon-go e wachni. Gisetiyo koda ka gikedo matek ne Injili, kaachiel gi Klement kod jotich wetena mamoko ma nying-gi ondiki e kitap ngima.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

kikuyu: Sibuoche oseruto; kendo gisemorne. Giseketho pinye; dalane owangʼ kendo odongʼ gunda.
english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Yaye oganda ma timbegi mono, bende wiya pod diwil awila gi mwandu-u muyudo e yor mecho, kod giu mag pimo mokwongʼ?
english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

kikuyu: Emomiyo jiwreuru gi wechegi.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

kikuyu: Daudi noparo e chunye kowacho niya, “Anatim ngʼwono ni Hanun wuod Nahash, nikech wuon mare bende notimona ngʼwono.” Omiyo Daudi nooro joote mondo otimne Hanun mos kuom tho wuon mare. Kane joote Daudi nobiro ir Hanun e piny jo-Amon mondo gitimne mos,
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

kikuyu: Kata Ruoth Agripa ongʼeyo wechegi maler, omiyo anyalo wuoyo kode gi chir. Angʼeyo maonge kiawa ni wechegi duto ok opondone, nikech ok osetimgi lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

kikuyu: Elisha nokonegi niya, “Ma ok en yo kendo ma ok en dala maduongʼ. Luw-uru bangʼa kendo abiro terou nyaka ir ngʼat ma udwarono.” Kendo noterogi nyaka Samaria.
english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

kikuyu: gitimo gik manenore ni gin joma oluoro Nyasaye to ngimagi nyiso ni gionge gima luoro Nyasaye kelo. In to nyaka ipogri chuth gi joma kamago.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

kikuyu: Un Ruodhi timneuru wasumbiniu machalre. Kik ubwog-gi, nikech ungʼeyo ni Ruoth motelonegi, kaachiel kodu ni e polo, kendo ok odew wangʼ ngʼato.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

kikuyu: Piny opongʼ gi herani, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; yie ipuonja chikeni.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

kikuyu: E sechego Joshua noduogo mi okawo Hazor kendo onego ruodhe kod ligangla. Hazor ema ne jatend pinjegi duto.
english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

kikuyu: Gibiro podho e dier joma onegi gi ligangla. Oseik ligangla ni lweny mondo mi otieke gi ogandane duto.
english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.

kikuyu: Kata ka kong-gi orumo, to gidhi nyime gi timbegi mag chode; jotendgi ohero timbe makelo wichkuot.
english: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne abole e lwet jatend pinje mondo otiye kaluwore gi timbene maricho.
english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

kikuyu: E kanyono giniwach ni, ‘Farao ruodh Misri en mana jakoko matek, nikech thuolo mane en-go nobaye.’ ”
english: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’

kikuyu: Jo-Midian, jo-Amalek kod jogo moa yo wuok chiengʼ nojot e holo mane oyugno ka kama bonyo ochokore. Ne gin gi ngamia mangʼeny mane ok nyal kwan mana ka kwoyo manie dho nam.
english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ochuni mondo ikowe kilomita achiel gi nus to dhi kode kilomita adek.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

kikuyu: Dhano nigi chenro mangʼeny e chunye, to dwaro mar Jehova Nyasaye ema timore.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Magi e nying yawuot Ishmael kaluwore gi nywolgi: Nebayoth, wuod Ishmael makayo, Kedar, Adbel, Mibsam,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

kikuyu: Nochano ji duto mondo orit ruoth ka moro ka moro nigi gire mar lweny e lwete, chakre yo milambo nyaka yo nyandwat mar hekalu ka gilworo kendo mar misango kod hekalu.
english: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

kikuyu: Kata ndalo mane pod gin e bwo loch ruodhigi giwegi, kane pod gichamo mwandu mogundho mane imiyogi kendo gidak e piny malach kendo momewo mane ipogonegi, ne ok gitini bende ne ok giweyo timbegi maricho.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

kikuyu: Ne oyale angʼaya kimiye wichkuot. Bende en gi kothe ma ji noparego? Nikech ngimane nogol oko e piny.”
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

kikuyu: “Nyis Harun ni: ‘Kuom tiengeu duto, onge ngʼama ongʼol ma oyiene mondo ochiw chiemo ni Nyasache.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka jopuonjre Johana nosea odhi, Yesu nochako wuoyo gi oganda kuom Johana kowacho niya, “Angʼo mane udhi mondo une e thim? Ne udhi neno odundu ma yamo tero koso?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Yamo noriemb jokwadhu duto, kendo joma osiepeni noter e twech. Eka wiyi nokuodi kendo nogengʼni nikech timbegi maricho.
english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

kikuyu: Ochalo gi yiedhi mag ohala, kokelo chiemo moa kuma bor.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

kikuyu: Mogik tik ne ooro negi wuode, koparo ni, ‘Wuoda to gibiro miyo luor.’
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: Ne afwenyo ni rieko matut ber moloyo fuwo, mana kaka ler ber moloyo mudho.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

kikuyu: Noiko nyinyo modhuro mondo olosgo musmande migedogo kendo mirwakogo dhoudi mag rangeye gi mula mathoth mokadho apima.
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

kikuyu: Oganda maduongʼ nochokore kendo ne gigengʼo sokni duto aore mane kadho e piny kagiwacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ruodhi mag Asuria biro mondo onwangʼ pi mangʼeny.”
english: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”

kikuyu: Sirni momako agola mare nochomo laru ma oko; sirnige nogorie yiende mag othidhe oko gi iye, kendo raidhi mi idho eka ichop kanyo ne gin aboro.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ka oyaro bwombene mondo oringi, to oyombo kata mana faras maringo matek moloyo ma jaithne riembo.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth noluongo Jehoyada jadolo maduongʼ mopenje niya, “Angʼo mosemoni oro jo-Lawi mondo osol osuru manoket gi Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye kod jodong Israel kuom jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem mondo olosgo Hemb Romo?”
english: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

kikuyu: To kata kamano kik ucham remo, to pukgiuru piny mana ka pi.
english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

kikuyu: to kaw riwi kendo ituchgo ite kiteno e dhoot mondo koro obed misumbani nyaka chiengʼ tim kamano bende nyaka ne jatichni madhako.
english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ne Turo: Donge pinje manie dho nembe biro tetni kowinjo koko mar podho mari, chiengʼ ma joma ohinyore marach nochur gi rem kendo ka inego ji e pinye?
english: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

kikuyu: Kane pesa jo-Misri kod jo-Kanaan orumo, jo-Misri duto nobiro ir Josef kendo owachone niya, “Miwa chiemo, dangʼ watho e nyimi nangʼo to pesawa orumo?”
english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

kikuyu: Jo-Amor mane odak e pinje godego ne omonjou, mi gilawou ka kich ma ogodak kagi goyou chakre Seir nyaka Horma.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

kikuyu: mowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wacho: ‘Ne agolo Israel koa Misri, kendo ne aresou e teko mar loch Misri kod pinjeruodhi duto mane thirou.’
english: and he said to the children of Israel, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

kikuyu: Ka gin gi larruok moro amora e kindgi, to ikelona kendo athego joma ochwanyorego mi anyisgi buche kod chike mag Nyasaye.
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

kikuyu: omiyo nochako odok e ode, mopenjo Yesu niya, “In jakanye?” To Yesu ne ok odwoke.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

kikuyu: Ne gipuore kendo gitagore ka joma omer; kendo pachgi nolalnegi.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro abiro olo mirimba kuomgi kendo abiro tiekogi gi mirimba mager, ka aketo e wigi giwegi gik moko duto maricho gisetimo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.”
english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: To ka adhi mi alosonu kar dak, eka abiro duogo kawou mondo un bende ubed koda kama antiere.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kod Harun niya, “Jukuru buch kendo mopongʼo lwetu mondo Musa okire e kor yamo e nyim Farao.
english: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Ka ndaloni orumo mitho kendo iluwo kwereni, to abiro keto kothi moro mondo okaw kari, achiel kuom yawuoti minywolo kendo anagur pinyruodhe.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

kikuyu: Kata Kamano, Jehova Nyasaye ne ok oweyo mirimbe mager, mane liel kochomo Juda nikech mago duto mane Manase otimo komiyo mirimbe jimbore.
english: Notwithstanding, the LORD didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

kikuyu: Kane higni ariyo osekadho, Farao noleko lekni ochungʼ e bath aora Nael,
english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

kikuyu: “Geruru udi kendo udag kanyo; pidhuru puothe kendo ucham gik ma ginyago.
english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

kikuyu: Nikech ka richo mar ngʼat achiel nomiyo tho olocho kuom ngʼat achielno, koro joma yudo ngʼwono mogundho kod mich mar ngima makare donge biro bedo gi loch mar ngima maduongʼ moloyo kuom ngʼat achielno, ma en Yesu Kristo.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek Jeroboam kod oganda duto noduogo ir Rehoboam mana kaka ruoth nosewacho niya, “Dwoguru ira bangʼ ndalo adek.”
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

kikuyu: Mzabibu margi wuok e mzabibu ma Sodom kendo wuok e puothe mag Gomora. Olembegi opongʼ gi kwiri kendo olembegi kech.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

kikuyu: Kora, Gatam kod Amalek magi e jodongo ma nyikwa Elifaz mane odak Edom; bende ne gin nyikwa Ada.
english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

kikuyu: Ruoth marito piny nyaka wuog e laru oko midhiyo e ot maduongʼ manie dhorangach ma yo wuok chiengʼ mi ochungʼ e bath sirni mag dhorangajno. E kindeno jodolo notimne misengini miwangʼo pep kod mag lalruok. Nyaka olam Nyasaye kochungʼ e bath siro mar rangach eka owuog odhi oko, to rangach nyaka sik koyaw nyaka piny imre.
english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho, “ ‘Ok giniyud thuolo, bende ok notimre,
english: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama kunyo kite inyalo hiny gi kitego; to ngʼama baro yien inyalo hiny gi yien.
english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jodonge nowacho niya, “Ruodha onge ngʼatwa moro makonye, makmana Elisha janabi man Israel ema nyiso ruodh Israel gik moko duto miwacho kata ka in e odi mar nindo.”
english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

kikuyu: kagiwacho ni, ‘Joma ne ondiki achien mogikgi osetiyo kuom sa achiel kende, to isemiyo gidoko marom kodwa, wan mwasetingʼo pek tich ka watiyo odiechiengʼ duto gi chiengʼ makech.’
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ mondo kik wiu wil kod Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ka uweyo luwo yorene, chikene kod buchene ma amiyou kawuononi.
english: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

kikuyu: ni chwech duto chiengʼ moro nowe thuolo mondo kik gitow to giyud thuolo maduongʼ ma nyithind Nyasaye nigo.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

kikuyu: Omiyo onge ngʼato kata achiel manohedhore penje penjo moro kendo.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

kikuyu: “Ruoth Nyasaye osekwedo jolweny maga duto; osechoko jolweny mondo omonja, kendo otiek yawuota ma jolweny. Ruoth Nyasaye osekumo nyar Juda mapok ongʼeyo chwo e kare mar biyo olemb mzabibu.
english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Kare in ngʼa? In Elija koso?” To nowacho niya, “Ok an.” “Koso in e janabi?” Nodwoko niya, “Ooyo.”
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Mad joma timbegi richogo moki e gokegi giwegi ka anto akadho maber mak gimoro otima.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

kikuyu: To Hamor nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Wuoda Shekem chunye oseketo kuom nyari. Asayi yie ichiw nyari obed jaod Shekem.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Nyororo mar rangeyeni nobed mag chuma kod nyinyo kendo tekoni nomedre ndalo duto mag ngimani.
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

kikuyu: Eka ubi mondo wadhiuru Bethel, kuma abiro dhi geroe kendo mar misango ne Nyasaye, mane odwoka e kinde mane an e chandruok malich kendo ma osebedo koda kamoro amora ma asedhiyoe.”
english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

kikuyu: Kane gidhi Gilead, ir dhood Reuben, Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase, negiwachonegi niya,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

kikuyu: En adier chutho ni nonywola e richo asebedo ka an jaricho chakre chiengʼ mane minwa omake ichna.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Lawi ne gin: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaya (tiende ni Kelita), Pethahia, Juda gi Eliezer.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

kikuyu: Chunya dwaro timo dwaroni, yaye Nyasacha; chikni ni ei chunya.”
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

kikuyu: kendo uchamo chiemb pinyno, to uchiw bathe moko kaka misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Waketho mbekni kod riekni mag wuondruok duto mag sunga dhano, ma dino ni ji yor ngʼeyo Nyasaye, kendo watweyo paro ka paro mobam, mondo omi wami owinj Kristo.
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

kikuyu: Ochulo dhano kaluwore gi timbene okelone mana gima owinjore gi timbene.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

kikuyu: Eka Rael nowacho niya, “Asebedo gi chandruok maduongʼ gi nyamera, kendo koro aseloyo.” Omiyo nochako nyathini ni Naftali.
english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Boaz nokawo Ruth mine odoko chiege. Bangʼe noriwore kode, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo omako ich, kendo nonywolo nyathi ma wuowi.
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

kikuyu: kendo irit gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi dwaro: Kiwuotho e yorene kendo irit puonjne gi chikene kod gik moko duto modwaro kaka ondiki e chik Musa mondo idhi nyime maber e gik moko duto mitimo, kendo kamoro amora midhiye,
english: and keep the instruction of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.

kikuyu: Noromo Samson gi wachni pile ka pile manomiyo koro odwaro mana dere.
english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ochako oluongo Samuel mar adek kendo Samuel noa malo modhi ir Eli mowachone niya, “Era ee nikech iluonga.” Eka Eli nofwenyo ni kara Jehova Nyasaye ema, luongo wuowino.
english: The LORD called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

kikuyu: “E kindeno ji mathoth nowuogi mondo oked gi ruoth mar milambo. Jo-mahundu modak e dieru nongʼany mondo fweny mane iseneno ochop kare to ok gininyal.
english: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.

kikuyu: Kaka Solomon ne medo bedo moti, monde noloko chunye moluwo nyiseche mamoko kendo chunye ne ok ochiwore chuth ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache, kaka chuny Daudi wuon-gi ne en.
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.

kikuyu: Berekia kod Elkana to ne gin jorit dhout od Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nigi loch ewi ogendini; Nyasaye obet piny e kom lochne maler.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

kikuyu: “Eka nowachone jogo mane ochungo kanyo ni, ‘Kawuru silinge alufu achiel ugol kuome kendo umi jalno man-gi silingʼ alufu apar.’
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

kikuyu: Harun gi yawuote nyaka rwak lewnigo kinde duto ma gidonjo e Hemb Romo, kata ka gidhi e kendo mar misango mondo giti tich dolo e Kama Ler mondo kik gibed giketho mi githo. “Ma nobed singruok mosiko ne Harun gi nyikwaye duto.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

kikuyu: Eli negwedho Elkana gi chiege kowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye miyi nyithindo gi dhakoni mondo ochul kar mane olamo kokwayo kendo omiyo Jehova Nyasaye.” Bangʼe negidok dalagi.
english: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona e kindeno mondo apuonju buche kod chike ma onego uluw e piny ma udhiye loka Jordan mondo ukaw.
english: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

kikuyu: Joma riek yudo luor kaka girkeni to joma ofuwo enonyis wichkuotgi ayanga.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

kikuyu: Jair mawuok e dhood Manase ne okawo gwenge duto mag Argob ma ochopo nyaka e tongʼ man e kind jo-Geshur kod jo-Maakath; ne ochake nyinge owuon, manyaka kawuononi Bashan pod iluongo ni Havoth Jair.)
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

kikuyu: Gomboni mar chode ema osekeloni chandruokni, nikech ne ihawo ogendini mamoko gi gombo, kendo nikech ne idwanyori gi nyisechegi manono.
english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nonyiso anywola mar joka Rekab niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Userito chik mar kwaru Jehonadab kendo useluwo puonjne duto kendo usetimo gik moko duto mane ochikou.’
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane obirone Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Negiwuok Bene Jaakan mi gibworo Hor Hagidgad.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

kikuyu: Kamoro dipo ruoth biro yie mondo okony jatichne e lwet ngʼat madwaro tieka an kaachiel gi wuoda e girkeni mane Nyasaye omiyowa.’
english: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

kikuyu: Bangʼ loch Abimelek ja-Isakar, Tola wuod Pua, ma wuod Dodo, nowuok mondo ores jo-Israel. Nodak Shamir, e piny got mar Efraim.
english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Puonj mara mamiyou beyo, omiyo kik ujwangʼ puonjna.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

kikuyu: Kane uchopo ka, Sihon ruodh Heshbon kod Og ruodh Bashan ne omonjowa to ne waloyogi.
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

kikuyu: Neye kaka ahero bucheni; omiyo rit ngimana, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kaluwore gi herani.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirana kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: To in kod yawuoti kende ema onego bed jodolo kaluwore gi gik moko duto manie kendo mar misango kod mago mantiere ei pasia. Amiyou tich mar bedo jodolo kaka chiwo. Ngʼato angʼata ma osudo machiegni gi kama ler mar lemo nyaka negi.”
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

kikuyu: Ja-Farisai moro nochungo malo mi olamo ka opwoyore ni, ‘Nyasaye, agoyoni erokamano ni ok an kaka ji mamoko, ma jomecho, joma timo timbe maricho, jochode, kata mana kaka jasol osuruni.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

kikuyu: Bende nomiyo ngʼat mar ariyo, gi ngʼat mar adek kod jogo duto mane luwo bangʼ kweth chik niya, “Un duto wachuru ne Esau mana gima chalre kuromo kode.
english: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Kor wach ni chokegi kiwachonegi niya, Choke motwo, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye!
english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Yesu nowuotho kodhi e dala ka dala kod gwengʼ ka gwengʼ ka olando Injili mar pinyruoth Nyasaye. Jopuonjrene apar gariyo ne ni kode,
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

kikuyu: Nikech oseketo chiengʼ mobiro ngʼadoe bura ne piny duto gadiera, kokalo kuom ngʼat moseyiero. Bende osenyiso ji malongʼo ni obiro timo mano ni ji duto, nikech nochiere oa kuom joma otho.”
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Sihon ne ok nigi adiera gi jo-Israel mondo gikal e pinye. Nochoko joge duto kendo mi gichokore Jahaz mondo giked gi jo-Israel.
english: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

kikuyu: nyikwa Zatu, ji mia ochiko gi piero angʼwen gabich (945),
english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: Kik usand dhako ma chwore otho kata nyathi kich, kata jadak, kata jadhier. Kik upar timo marach ni jowadu gie chunyu.’
english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

kikuyu: E kinde mag masira mopore ok ginibed moner, bende gibiro bedo gi chiemo mathoth ndalo kech.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

kikuyu: Omiyo wuok kae kendo idog gi kwe, kik itim gima diwangʼ ii jotend jo-Filistia.”
english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Ne alamo Jehova Nyasaye kawacho niya, “Yaye Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, kik itiek jogigi, ma gin girkeni mari iwuon mane ireso gi badi maratego e piny Misri.
english: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

kikuyu: Ben-Deker norito Makaz; Shalbim, Beth Shemesh kod Elon Bethhanan;
english: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi paro en ngʼat mariek, kendo weche mowacho gin mana puonj.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ma en remba mar singruok, ma ochwer ne ji mangʼeny.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

kikuyu: To nyaka uduog ir Nyasachu; beduru johera kendo joma ngʼado bura makare, bende keturu chunyu kuom Nyasachu kinde duto.
english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto gin tingʼ mapek, moingo ngʼato wacho. Kata obedo ni wangʼ neno, to gik moneno ok rome, to it bende kata obedo ni owinjo gik moko, to gik mowinjo ok rome.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noketo odiechiengʼ ma gigo notimre kowacho kama: “Kiny Jehova Nyasaye notim ma e pinyni.”
english: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”

kikuyu: To dhako moa Tekoa nowachone niya, “Ruodha ma en ruoth, we mondo ketho odongʼ e wiya kendo ewi dhood wuora, to mondo ruoth gi kom ruodhe obed maonge ketho.”
english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

kikuyu: Yaye jaherana, ichalo gi puodho mochiel; kendo ka soko molor dhoge modin motegno.
english: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.

kikuyu: Obiro chamo mana mor dhiangʼ kod mor kich nyaka chop orom pogo rach gi ber.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

kikuyu: “Ruoth Nyasaye, to wan jo-Juda, joma odak Jerusalem kod jo-Israel, modak machiegni kod modak maboyo, e pinje duto misekeyowae wichkuot osemakowa kawuononi, nikech wasebedoni joma ok jo-ratiro.
english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

kikuyu: Negibiro ir Filipo, mane aa Bethsaida, e piny Galili, mi gikwaye niya, “Jaduongʼ, wadwaro neno Yesu.”
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

kikuyu: Podho mar Moab osechopone; masichene nobi mapiyo.
english: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Tera mi gibworo Mithka.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

kikuyu: Abiro jiwo bede ruodh Babulon, to bede Farao thudhno biro mako. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka anaket liganglana e lwet ruodh Babulon mi omonjgo jo-Misri.
english: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Gimanore gi atungʼ kod tongʼ; giger kendo gionge ngʼwono. Gimor ka nam mogingore ka giriembo faresegi; gibiro ka ji mochanore komanore gi gige lweny mondo gimonju, yaye Nyar Sayun.”
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Mokwongo joga nodhi Misri mondo odagie, bangʼe jo-Asuria nosandogi.
english: For the Lord GOD says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.

kikuyu: Ne apari mine ahum, yaye Nyasaye, ne aol kendo chunya nonyosore. Sela
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

kikuyu: Johana nodwokogi niya, “Onge gima ngʼato nyalo yudo makmana mano momiye koa e polo.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

kikuyu: Arwako tim makare kod adiera ka lepa.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, wuo gi jothuru kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘Ka akelo lweny e piny moro, kendo ka jopinyno oyiero achiel kuom jogi mi okete kaka jarito margi,
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

kikuyu: Eka ruoth notingʼo ludhe mar dhahabu ne Esta bangʼe noa malo mochungʼ e nyim ruoth.
english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya:
english: The LORD said to Moses,

kikuyu: To kanyna ne okwere kuom timne marachno, kata obedo ni en le ma ok wuo kamano, to ne owuoyo gi dwond dhano mi ogengʼo neko janabino.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo giaa e liel, neginyiso gigi duto ne ji apar gachiel kod ji duto mamoko.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

kikuyu: Noloso mudho obedo ka hema molwore, ma en rumbi motwere mar koth manie polo.
english: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: “Ket jo-Israel otim nyasi mar Pasaka e kinde moketne mowinjore.
english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

kikuyu: Sani koro nyaka uwene richone kendo uhoye, mondo kik kuyo mareno nege.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

kikuyu: Kik wiyi wil mak ipako tijene ma gin tijene ma ji osepako gi wer.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

kikuyu: Negichungo kite moyiedhi kod sirni mag Ashera ewi gode maboyo duto, kendo e tiend yiende duto motimo tipo.
english: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;

kikuyu: Yaye Nyar Jerusalem, en angʼo madawach kuomi? Koso en angʼo ma dapimigo? Yaye Nyar Sayun mapok ongʼeyo dichwo, en angʼo ma dapimigo, koso en angʼo ma dahoyigo? Adhola ma in-go tut mana ka nam. Ere ngʼama dithiedhnigo?
english: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo Ahimelek niya, “Donge dibedie gi tongʼ kata ligangla moro amora ka? Ne ok akawo ligangla kata gir lweny moro amora, nikech ote ruoth nobirona mapiyo.”
english: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”

kikuyu: “To rieko to diyud kanye? Koso ere kuma ngʼeyo wuokie?
english: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Omiyo koro keturu chunyu gi ngimau kuom dwaro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Koro chakuru gero kama ler mar lemo mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo omi ukel Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kod gigo mopwodhi mag Nyasaye ei hekalu mibiro gero ne Nying Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: ka joma odak e pinjeruodhi ochokore mondo olam Jehova Nyasaye.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi kane oyudo giwuotho negineno yiend ngʼowu mane Yesu okwongʼo cha kosetwo, chakre tiendene.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo gabich kane wan e twech; odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mokwongo, mane en higa mar apar gangʼwen bangʼ podho mar dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem; chiengʼno bad Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kuoma, kendo ne otera kuno.
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, the LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

kikuyu: Ligangla nomil e miechgi madongo manoketh lodi mag rangeyegi, kendo chenro duto magin-go norum.
english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mawacho ni en ei Nyasaye nyaka kit ngimane mapile chal gi mar Yesu.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

kikuyu: To nikech negitiyo nigi e nyim nyisechegi manono, mi gimiyo jo-dhood Israel opodho e richo, omiyo asekwongʼora chuth ni nyaka giyud kum maromre gi richogi, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord GOD, “and they will bear their iniquity.

kikuyu: Jatelono nopenjo Filipo niya, “Yie inyisae ni Janabi wuoyo kuom ngʼa e Ndikoni? Owuoyo kuome owuon, koso owuoyo kuom ngʼat machielo?”
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo gauchiel mar loch Asa Ruodh Juda, Ela wuod Baasha nodoko ruodh Israel kendo nobedo ruodh Tirza kuom higni ariyo.
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne yawuot Seir ja-Hori, mane odak e gwengʼno: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Ana,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

kikuyu: Ne ok orwako mana kwayowa kende, to ne ochiwore kende en owuon mar konyou, mi koro ero obiro iru kuom dwarone owuon.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mane otimore e ndalo loch Jehoash, gi gik moko duto mane otimo kod teko mane okedogi Amazia ruodh Juda, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Udi mag rito mane oger adek e bathe konchiel kendo adek e bath yo momwon motegno koni gi koni, gi ohingage moliero gi malo kod agola mare ne pimgi romre kod mago manie rangach midonjogo mokwongo. Ne en fut piero abiriyo gabich kuom borne kod fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus kuom lachne.
english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

kikuyu: En ema ochano ndalo mag chwiri kod opon; bende en ema oketo ruodhi e loch kendo ogologi. Ochiwo rieko ne joma riek kod ngʼeyo ne joma nigi winjo.
english: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.

kikuyu: Kuome ema gedo duto oriwore kaachiel kendo dongo mibed hekalu maler man kuom Ruoth.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

kikuyu: Wengegi onyiedhore gi bor kendo miriambo maricho mopongʼo pachgi onge gikogi.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

kikuyu: Kane Gaal onenogi, nowachone Zebul niya, “Ne joma biro koa ewi gode!” Zebul nodwoko niya, “Tipo mag gode ema bwogi ni ji.”
english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Abiro penjou penjo achiel. Ka udwoka, to abiro nyisou teko ma atimogo gigi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: “Wachni kik bwogu, nimar ndalo biro ma ji duto manie bur nowinj dwonde
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

kikuyu: E Ikonio bende, Paulo gi Barnaba ne jodhi e sinagogi mar jo-Yahudi kaka negijatimo. Kanyo bende ne giyale gi teko, mi jo-Yahudi gi joma ok jo-Yahudi mathoth noyie kuom Yesu.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

kikuyu: Kik uher piny kata gimoro amora manie pinyni. Ka ngʼato ohero piny, to hera mar Wuoro onge e iye.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Omiyo negitimo kamano. Negikawo dwesni ariyo machal kamano mi gitweyo e gari kendo gitweyo nyiroye e loch.
english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

kikuyu: Kinyne jo-Shekem nowuok oko kama oyangore kendo ne gikone Abimelek wachni.
english: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

kikuyu: Osedino yora gohinga moger gi kidi; omiyo awuotho e yore mobam.
english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

kikuyu: gi nyamnaha gi ngʼangʼa, tula kod olik tiga.
english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

kikuyu: Wabiro loyo lweny ka Nyasaye nikodwa, kendo obiro nyono wasikwa piny.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Kaw barupegi, mago momwon kod ma ok omuon, kendo iketgi e agulu mar lowo mondo omi gibed amingʼa.
english: the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’

kikuyu: to giniwach ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, manogolo jo-Israel e piny ma yo nyandwat kendo koa e pinje duto kama ne oseriembogie.’ Nimar anadwog-gi e piny mane amiyo kweregi.”
english: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chwog wer miywagogo Turo.
english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

kikuyu: To ka jaritono oneno ka wasigu biro, to ok ogoyo tungʼ mondo ji oikre, mi wasigugo obiro monego ngʼato achiel kuomgi, to ngʼatno notho nikech richone, to anaket rembe ewi jaritono.’
english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

kikuyu: to nikech ngʼol mare ok onego osud machiegni gi Pasia kata gi kendo mar misango, nikech dipo ka omiyo kara maler mar lemo obedo mogak nimar en gi songa. An e Jehova Nyasaye mapwodhogi.’ ”
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Mad ihoya gi herani ma ok rem, kaluwore gi singruok mane imiyo jatichni.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

kikuyu: Simon nodwoko niya, “Aparo ni ngʼat mane nigi gowi maduongʼ mowene.” Yesu nowacho niya, “Isengʼado bura makare.”
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

kikuyu: Kuom higni mia adek Israel nodak Heshbon, gi Aroer, gi alwora mar kuondego kod mier duto mokiewo gi aora Arnon. En angʼo ma nomonou kawogi e hignigo?
english: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

kikuyu: Wachne nyithind Israel kiwacho kama: Ka ngʼato kuomu kelo chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye, to onego okel chiwo mag chiayo kaka dhok kata rombe.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

kikuyu: Kane Hadad otho, Samla ja-Masreka nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Musa kod Eliazar jadolo nokawo dhahabu koa kuom jotend jolweny mag alufe alufe kod mago mag miche miche mi negiterogi e Hemb Romo kaka rapar mar jo-Israel e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

kikuyu: Tukiko biro nyisou gik moko duto matimorena. En owadwa mageno, jatich ma ja-adiera kendo jatich Ruoth kaachiel koda.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ruoth Nyasaye owuon biro miyou ranyisi machal kama: Nyako ngili biro mako ich minywol wuowi, ma noluonge ni Imanuel (tiende ni Nyasaye nikodwa).
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo uwangʼo iya gi gik ma lwetu oloso, uwangʼo ubani ne nyiseche manono ei Misri, kama osebiroe mondo udagie? Unutiekru kendu uwegi ka uloso ne un uwegi gigo mag kwongʼ gi ajara e dier ogendini duto manie piny.
english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

kikuyu: nikech magi e timbe ma joma nodak e pinyni kapok ubiro notimo kendo negiketho pinyni.
english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

kikuyu: An to ne ayudo kaonge gima osetimo mowinjore githo, to nikech odwaro mondo Kaisar ema oyale, asengʼado mondo otere Rumi.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

kikuyu: Ne owacho niya, “Weyeuru, kendo kik ngʼato mul chokene.” Eka ne giweyo chokene to gi mag janabi mane oa Samaria.
english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno, anakum ji duto mamiel e laru mar dino cham, kendo mapongʼo hekalu mar nyiseche manono gi timbe mahundu kod wuond.”
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

kikuyu: Simon Petro nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, en ngʼa madwadhi ire? In ema in gi weche makelo ngima mochwere.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

kikuyu: Eka nochako okulore piny mondiko e lowo.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nowachone chokruok duto niya, “Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu.” Omiyo giduto negipako Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi, negikulore piny auma kendo ginindo piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo e nyim ruoth Daudi.
english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo gik mopondo mag pinyruoth Nyasaye, to ji mamoko awuoyonegi gi ngero, mondo omi, “ ‘kata ka obedo ni gingʼicho, to ok ginine gimoro; kendo gibiro siko ka giwinjo weche miwacho, to wach ok nodonjnegi.’
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

kikuyu: To ne jo-Yahudi, ne en kinde mar mor, gi ilo kod pak.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

kikuyu: Kendo e giko mar raumno los kido mar malaika ariyo miluongo ni kerubi gi dhahabu mothedhi.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

kikuyu: “Chakre ngʼama tin nyaka ngʼama duongʼ, giduto girikni ka gidwaro mwandu e yor miganga; jonabi kod jodolo chalre, giduto gin jo-miriambo.
english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

kikuyu: To dhako ma bende hike romo kamano to nowar gi shekel piero adek.
english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

kikuyu: We ji duto moketi kar pondo margi obed mamor; we gisiki ka giwer gimor. Umgi gi rit mari, mondo joma ohero nyingi omor kodi.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

kikuyu: Nowachone jogo niya, “Neuru! Kidini biro bedo janeno kuomu. Osewinjo weche duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osewachonwa. Obiro bedo janeno kuomu ka ubedo jo-miriambo ne Nyasachu.”
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

kikuyu: Ne, jatichna biro tiyo gi rieko; enotingʼe malo moloyo kimiye duongʼ mangʼongo.
english: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.

kikuyu: Kawuononi ubiro neno ranyisi ni Nyasaye mangima nikodu kendo enoriemb e nyimu jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Hivi, jo-Perizi, jo-Girgash, jo-Amor kod jo-Jebus.
english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

kikuyu: Jehoyada jadolo nogolo chik ne jotend lweny morito migepe mag jolweny mia achiel-ka, ma bende ne gin jotend jolweny kowachonegi niya, “Keleuru e dierwa ka kendo neguru ngʼato angʼata maluwe.” Nimar jadolo nosewacho niya, “Dhakono ok onego negi ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in the LORD’s house.”

kikuyu: Mokwongo nyaka ungʼe ni e ndalo mogik jomoko machayo ji nobi ka gichayou kendo ka giluwo gombogi maricho.
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

kikuyu: omiyo ogendini mangʼeny nobwogi kendo ruodhi nolingʼ thi nikech en. Nimar gik mane ok owachnegi, gibiro neno, kendo gik mapok giwinjo, nodonjnegi.
english: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi malo mondo ingʼiane kuonde motimo ongoro motingʼore mondo ine. Bende nitiere kamoro amora modongʼ e piny mapok iterorigo? E dir yo ne ibet piny ka irito johera magi, ibet piny ka jakwath mamanyo pi ne dhoge e piny motwo. Isedwanyo piny gi chode mari, kod timbegi mamono.
english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

kikuyu: Petro nokawe otere tenge mi okwere ni owe wuoyo kamano. Nowachone niya, “Ruoth, gima kamano ok nyal timoreni ngangʼ!”
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

kikuyu: Puonja yoreni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; telna e yo moriere tir, nikech joma sanda.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Gima chal kamano notimore ne owadgi mar ariyo gi mar adek, kendo mamokogi duto nyaka mar abiriyo.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

kikuyu: Baala, Iyim, Ezem,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

kikuyu: Ne en-gi yawuowi piero adek mane nigi punde piero adek mane giidho. Negitelone mier piero adek man Gilead, manyaka kawuononi pod iluongo ni Havoth Jair.
english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: To sa asaya ma ngʼato olokore odhi ir Ruoth to ragengʼno igolo oko.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

kikuyu: Eka Filipo nochako gi Ndiko kama ne ja-Ethiopiano somo, mi odhi nyime gi yalone Injili mar Yesu.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

kikuyu: Israel nooro joote mondo owach ne Sihon ma ruodh jo-Amor kama:
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

kikuyu: “Bende nitiere chik misegolo mondo piny oyawre, kata nyiso kogwen mondo obedie?
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

kikuyu: To geno ok kuod wiwa, nikech Nyasaye oseolo herane ei chunywa kuom Roho Maler, ma osemiyowa.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

kikuyu: Ne mirima omake ka oneno Benjamin owadgi. Josef noreto kadhi oko kendo orango kamane onyalo pondoe ka oywak. Nodonjo e kachiende kendo ne oywak kuno.
english: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

kikuyu: To aneno ni owinjore mondo akwong aor owadwa Epafrodito mondo oduog oneu. En jatich Kristo wadwa ma wakedogo lweny mar Injili, kendo en jaoteu mane uoro mondo okonya e rem mane an-go.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

kikuyu: We jotendwa otime e lo chokruokni duto. Eka we ngʼato ka ngʼato mosekendo nyi joma ok jo-Yahudi obi e sa moketi, kaachiel gi jodongo kod jongʼad bura moa dala ka dala, nyaka mirima mager mar Nyasachwa kuom wachni ogol kuomwa.”
english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ruoth oil nikech teko ma imiye. Mano kaka en gi mor maduongʼ nikech isemiyo olocho!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

kikuyu: Jogo mane ochokore nowinjore mondo gimed timo sawoni ndalo abiriyo mamoko, omiyo kuom ndalo abiriyo mamoko negitimo kamano gi mor.
english: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Gino ma ok nyalre gi dhano, nyalore kuom Nyasaye.”
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

kikuyu: To nikech chak mangʼeny manonyiedh kuomgi enonwangʼ mor dhiangʼ mochamo. Jogo duto manodongʼ e pinyno nocham mana mor dhiangʼ kod mor kich.
english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

kikuyu: Itingʼa malo nikech timna makare kendo ichunga e nyimi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

kikuyu: Seche moko bor polo neumo kar lemo kuom ndalo manok kende; to ka Jehova Nyasaye nogolo chik to negidak, bangʼe kochako ogolo chik to gichako wuoth.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.

kikuyu: Abisalom nodhi ir ruoth mowachone niya, “Jatichni osechoko joge mangʼado yie rombe. Bende ruoth kod jodonge diyie bi?”
english: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi nyime kogoyonegi ngero niya, “Ngʼat moro ne opidho mzabibu, ne okete e lwet jopur moko kendo nodhi kamoro kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maber golo gik mabeyo mawuok kuom ber mokano e iye, to ngʼat marach golo gik maricho mawuok kuom rach mokano e iye.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ajiwi mondo ichier mich ma in-go mane Nyasaye omiyi chiengʼ mane aketo lweta kuomi.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

kikuyu: Sunga ma yawuowi nigo e teko margi, to lwar en duongʼ ne jodongo.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

kikuyu: Onego gigo ne Jehova Nyasaye erokamano kuom herane ma ok rem kendo kuom timbene miwuoro motimo ne ji.
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Dhout Israel duto nobiro Hebron ir Daudi ma giwacho niya, “Wan ringreni kendo wan remo achiel.
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa machalo gi Ayub; mamodho ajara kaka pi?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato oterore gi misumba ma nyako mapok okendi mosewinjore gi ngʼama onego kende, kata mapok omi thuolo mar dhi, to wachno nyaka none maber. Kik neg nyakono gi ngʼat moterore kodeno nikech pod en misumba.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

kikuyu: Udi mane ni e gorofa mar adek ne onge gi sirni kaka mago mane ni e laru; kuom mano dier utegi ne tindo moloyo mago mapiny gi madiere.
english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Jomoko wacho ni in Johana ja-Batiso, to jomoko wacho ni in Elija to jomoko bende wacho ni in achiel kuom jonabi machon ema osedwogo mobedo mangima kendo.”
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

kikuyu: Ne upuonjoru wachni kuom owadwa mwageno Epafra ma en misumba Kristo, kendo ma jatich Kristo ma ja-adiera matiyonu karwa.
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iketh buch ngʼato, to ngʼad bura kare ma kik idogne jachan kata luoro wangʼ ngʼama duongʼ, to ngʼadne wadu bura makare kichungʼ e adiera.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

kikuyu: Kane ji duogo dala bangʼ ka Daudi nosenego ja-Filistia, mon nowuok e mier matindo duto mag Israel mondo oromne Ruoth Saulo ka giwer kendo gimiel, ka igoyo tamborin gi asili.
english: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.

kikuyu: Kane oneno gigo mopa man Gilgal ne olokore en owuon kendo owacho niya, “An kodi gi wach ma lingʼ-lingʼ, yaye ruoth.” Ruoth nowacho niya, “Lingʼ thi!” Kendo joge duto mantie noa moweye.
english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

kikuyu: Isechweyo nam maduongʼ kendo malach mopongʼ gi le mamol mathoth mokalo akwana, gik mangima madongo gi matindo.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

kikuyu: Yawuot Gad ne gin: Zefon, Hagi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi kod Areli.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane nyathi oseweyo dhoth nokawo wuowi modhi kode kata obedo ni pod otin kamano, nodhi gi nyarwath ma hike adek gi mogo madirom depe ariyo gi divai lita piero ariyo gariyo, eka nokele e od Jehova Nyasaye man Shilo.
english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

kikuyu: Jo-Babulon nowangʼo kar dak ruoth kod ute ji kendo negimuko ohinga mag Jerusalem.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nyaka ichiw pok mar Jehova Nyasaye gino maber kendo maler moloyo mar gik moko duto ma omiu.’
english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ikuyo, yaye chunya? Angʼo momiyo inyosori, yaye chunya? Ket genoni kuom Nyasaye, nikech pod abiro pake, en e Jawarna kendo Nyasacha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

kikuyu: Omanyo kuonde ma aore ochakoree, mi okel gik mopandi e lela.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

kikuyu: To in, wuod dhano winj gima anyisi. Kik ingʼany kaka jogo mohero ngʼanyo; yaw dhogi mondo icham gima amiyi.”
english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

kikuyu: Nyaka uket pogruok e kind gik makwero kod gik ma ok kwero, kendo mondo upog gik mangima michamo kod mago ma ok cham.’ ”
english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Rael notho kendo nokunye e yo madhi Efrath (ma tiende ni Bethlehem).
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Asa ne ok oketho kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo e Israel, chunye nochiwore chutho ni Jehova Nyasaye ndalo duto mag ngimane.
english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

kikuyu: Eka nopenjogi niya, “Ka ngʼato kuomu nigi wuode kata rwadhe to wuodeno kata rwadheno olwar e soko chiengʼ Sabato, donge diywaye igole oko mana gikanyono?”
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Owad gi ngʼat monegno noneg janekno; koromo kode to nonege.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane odak e dala Dan noromo ji alufu mia achiel gi piero abich gabiriyo, gi mia auchiel (157,600). Gin ema giniwuogi mogik kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe malaika nokawo tap ubani, mi opongʼo gi mach moa e kendo mar misango, eka nobole e piny. Bangʼ mano polo nomil malich kariadore matek ka mor, kendo piny noyiengni.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

kikuyu: “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego mosetamore ngʼadona bura makare, kendo mosemiyo chunya obedo malit,
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Magi e misengini mane Eliasaf wuod Dewel ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

kikuyu: “Asengʼado ogendini oko, kuondegi ma gigengʼorego bende asemuko. Yoregi osedongʼ nono, maonge ngʼama wuothoe. Miechgi madongo osekethi; maonge ngʼama nodongʼ kodakie kata achiel.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

kikuyu: Kuonde motingʼore malo mag anjawo nokethi, en emomiyo jo-Israel timo richo. Kuthe kod buya ema biro dongo maim kendegi mag misango. Eka giniwach ne gode madongo niya, “Umwauru!” Kendo ne gode matindo niya, “Rwombreuru kuomwa!”
english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nochoko jolweny duto modhigo Raba mi omonje kendo okawe.
english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

kikuyu: Abiro medo masiche mangʼeny kuomu, kendo anaked kodgi gi aserni.
english: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

kikuyu: Ka useneno chandruok kuom kinde moromo, Nyasach ngʼwono duto, mane oluongou e duongʼne mochwere kuom Kristo Yesu, nomi ubed maler chuth, kogurou udoko motegno e mise ma ok yiengni.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

kikuyu: Aparogi maber, kendo an kod kuyo e chunya.
english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

kikuyu: Kane pok gode obetie kata kane pok ichweyo piny gi ji modak e iye, to isebedo ka in Nyasaye nyaka nene kendo manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado bunge moyugno kod le; bende Lebanon biro podho e nyim, Nyasaye Maratego.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

kikuyu: Kik itim misango ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi gi rwath kata gi rombo man-gi songa kata mbala, nimar mano en gima kwero e nyime.
english: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Jakobo nokawo joge kaachiel gi gige mi nokowogi nyaka loka aora Jabok.
english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

kikuyu: koa e nyikwa Gershon, ne gin ji mia achiel gi piero adek kotelnegi gi Joel,
english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

kikuyu: Kata otem ringo mondo otony ne gir lweny molos gi chuma, to asere ma dhoge olos gi mula biro chwowe.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

kikuyu: Joab wuod Zeruya ne jatend jolweny; Jehoshafat wuod Ahilud ne jachan weche;
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

kikuyu: kochikogi mondo gitim nyasini higa ka higa, tarik apar gangʼwen gi apar gabich mar dwe mar Adar,
english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

kikuyu: Tongʼ mar jo-Amor nochakore Akrabim nyaka Sela kendo mokalo kanyo.
english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nitie e hekalune maler; piny duto mondo olingʼ e nyime.
english: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

kikuyu: Ji duto mochokore ka biro ngʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye ok res joge gi ligangla gi tongʼ nimar lweny en mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo obiro chiwou uduto e lwetwa.”
english: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

kikuyu: Hezekia noyudo baruwano mane joote okelone mosome. Bangʼe nodhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, moyaro baruwano e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.

kikuyu: Par nigi wechegi kisiemogi e nyim Nyasaye ni giwe dhawo kuom weche maonge ohala maketho mana chuny joma winjogi.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

kikuyu: mondo gichiwne Jehova Nyasaye misengini pile pile e kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, gitim kamano okinyi kod odhiambo mana kaka ondikgi duto e Chik Jehova Nyasaye mano mi jo-Israel.
english: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

kikuyu: Rit ngimana, nikech achiworani. In e Nyasacha, omiyo res ngima jatichni, mogeno kuomi.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Kidi pek to kuoyo bende pek, to chandruok ma ngʼat mofuwo kelo pek moloyo gik moko ariyogo.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Bed gi kwe! Kik iluor. Ok nitho.”
english: The LORD said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

kikuyu: kendo gi kit winy duto machwo abiriyo kod mamon abiriyo mondo okan kitgi e piny ngima.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Wuowi mariek winjo puonj wuon mare, to ngʼat ma wangʼe tek ok winj wach kikwere.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

kikuyu: Kendo ne angʼado ni joma ne osetho moyiki, gin johawi moloyo joma pod ngima.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi dwond Jehova Nyasaye, Musa noorogi ka gia e Thim mar Paran. Jogi duto ne gin jotend jo-Israel.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo gik mogakgo nobed mogak nyaka chiengʼ podhi. Ok onego ocham chiemo mowal moro amora motimgo misango nyaka chop olwokre.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

kikuyu: Migi ote mar jotendgi kendo iwachi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma, Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Nyisuru jotendu kama:
english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:

kikuyu: Nyasaye noluongo gima nopogo pigno ni “polo.” Piny noyuso kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar ariyo.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

kikuyu: Obiro luonga ni, ‘In Wuonwa kendo in Nyasacha, lwandana ma Jawarna.’
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

kikuyu: Wer miwero ka ji dhi e hekalu. Ka an e chandruok to aluongo Jehova Nyasaye, kendo odwoka,
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

kikuyu: Uria ja-Hiti, Zabad wuod Alai,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

kikuyu: Negitiyo e ndalo Joyakim wuod Jeshua, wuod Jozadak, to kendo e ndalo jatelo Nehemia kod Ezra ma jadolo kendo jandiko.
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo iywagorine kiwacho ni ok odew weche ma dhano ywaknego?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

kikuyu: Ne abedo misumba mar Injilini kuom mich mar ngʼwono mane Nyasaye omiya kaluwore gi tekone matiyo kuoma.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka jomecho mane ogur kode bende nodhuole gi ayany.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

kikuyu: Yesu nomako lwet ngʼatno mi otere oko mar dalano. Ka nosengʼulo olawo e wangʼ muofuno noketo lwete kuome, eka nopenje niya, “Bende ineno gimoro?”
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

kikuyu: Kik ubed ka kwereu gi oweteu mane oweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu momiyo gidoko gima iluoro mana kaka uneno sani.
english: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.
