kikuyu: To kata kamano ne ok ongʼiewo puothe jodolo nikech negiyudo pokgi mapile pile koa kuom Farao kendo ne gin gi chiemo moromogi kuom pok mane Farao miyogi. Mano ema omiyo jodolo ne ok ouso puothegi.
english: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

kikuyu: Eka owete Josef apar nodhi Misri mondo odhi ongʼiew cham.
english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko Ayub gi ei yamo maduongʼ. Nowacho kama:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

kikuyu: Eka ikel Harun gi yawuote e dhoranga Hemb Romo kendo ilwokgi gi pi.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: To Abishai wuod Zeruya nobiro moreso Daudi mi nogoyo ja-Filistia monego. Eka jolweny mag Daudi nosingorene kawacho niya, “Ok inichak iwuog kodwa kidhi e lweny, nikech dipo ka tach Israel otho.”
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

kikuyu: Eka Balak nowachone niya, “Bi wadhi kamoro machielo kama inyalo nenogie; ibiro mana neno moko kuomgi to ok giduto. To ka isenenogi, to ikwongʼnagi.”
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

kikuyu: Nimar wasika wuoyo marach kuoma; jogo marita mondo onega loso wach kaachiel.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

kikuyu: Notimore mana kaka ngʼat Nyasaye ne osewacho ni ruoth niya, “Kiny e sa maka ma, nengo mar mogo gorogoro achiel nongʼiew silingʼ achiel to mogo mar shairi gorogoro ariyo nongʼiew silingʼ achiel e dhoranga Samaria.”
english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

kikuyu: Ji ne mino wach kendgi e dhout Israel duto kagiwacho niya, “Ruoth noresowa e lwet wasikwa; en ema noresowa e lwet jo-Filistia. To koro sani oseringo oa e pinywani nikech wach Abisalom;
english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

kikuyu: Eka inine mano mi inibed mamor ka chunyi opongʼ gi ilo, mwandu mogundho nokelni kokalo nam, kuomi ema mwandu mag ogendini noae.
english: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dogi ir ngʼat ma itiyone kendo ichiwri e lwete.”
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

kikuyu: Kane Josef gi Maria josetimo duto mane dwarore kaluwore gi chik mar Ruoth, negidok Galili e dala margi Nazareth.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

kikuyu: En adier ni jomoko lando wach Kristo ka gin-gi ich lit kod miero, to jomoko to lande ka chunygi ni kare.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ma jakonyna motegno, in migengʼona wiya sa ma lweny ger.
english: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Ka okum ngʼat ma jaro ji, to joma ngʼeyogi tin yudo rieko, ka ngʼat mariek opuonji, to oyudo ngʼeyo.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

kikuyu: Simon Petro nogwelo japuonjreno kawacho niya, “Penje ane ngʼama owuoyo kuome.”
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

kikuyu: Kendo ma e lamona mondo herau omedre mathoth ahinya kuom rieko kod ngʼeyo,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

kikuyu: Ere kaka diwach ne owadu ni, ‘Yie mondo agolni ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼi,’ ka in to pilni maduongʼ mar yath osiko ngolni e wangʼi iwuon?
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

kikuyu: koro yie ichak iwena richona kendo lam ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi mondo ogol masira marachni kuoma.”
english: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to the LORD your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

kikuyu: Negibiro gi jambgi kod hembegi machal gi kweth mar dede. Kar kwan jogo kaachiel gi ngamia mag-gi ne tek ngʼeyo, kendo negimonjo pinyno mi gikethe.
english: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.

kikuyu: Watangʼuru, nono to gibiro medore ahinya kendo bedo maratego, ma ka lweny owuok ginyalo dok ne wasikwa mondo giked kodwa, mi giring gia e pinywa.”
english: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka Jehova Nyasaye noreso Hezekia kod jo-Jerusalem motony e lwet Senakerib ruodh Asuria kendo e lwet ruodhi mamoko bende. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye noritogi kuom pinje duto mane olworogi.
english: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.

kikuyu: Yesu nobiro irgi momulogi, kowacho niya, “Auru malo, kendo weuru bedo maluor.”
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Onego oyud pok maromre kodgi, kata obedo ni oseyudo pok makore koa e ndalo wuon-gi.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

kikuyu: “In Ayub, luong ane ka bende nitiere ngʼama nyalo dwoki? Bende nitie kuom jo-malaika minyalo ringo irgi?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

kikuyu: Wachni nofwenyore e higa mane ruoth Ahaz othoe.
english: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

kikuyu: To Koro un ji mamoko duto modongʼ man Thuatira ma ok oseluwo puonjne kendo mapok ongʼeyo gima jomoko luongo ni weche mopondo mag Satan, ‘Ok aketnu tingʼ moro mapek,
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

kikuyu: Solomon nogolo nyar Farao e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi mokelo e od ruoth manogerone kowacho niya, “Chiega ok nyal dak e od ruoth Daudi ma ruodh jo-Israel nikech kuonde ma Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye mar singruok osedonje gin kuonde maler.”
english: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the LORD’s ark has come are holy.”

kikuyu: Chutho, an ok ema atim gino, to richo manie iya ema time.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni wechene lombo chuny, kik iyie kode, nimar gik maricho abiriyo opongʼo chunye.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

kikuyu: To ruoth Agripa, kane an e yo awuotho kar odiechiengʼ tir, ne aneno ler moa e polo mangʼangʼni moloyo wangʼ chiengʼ kendo nomenya kaachiel gi joma ne awuothogo.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

kikuyu: opiage mondo oneki kendo oyweye mondo omil ka polo! “ ‘Bende dwamor adier kuom ludh loch mar Juda wuoda? Nikech mano to kede akeda ma ligangla ohewo.
english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Joab nodhi nyime kedo gi Raba e piny jo-Amon kendo nomako kar ruoth mochiel motegno.
english: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

kikuyu: Kane wach ochopo ne ruodh Nineve, ne oa malo e kom duongʼ mare molonyo lepe mag loch mi norwako pien gugru nobet piny e buru.
english: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

kikuyu: Koa e nyikwa Imer: Hanani gi Zebadia.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

kikuyu: Bende kaw achiel kuom makati ma ok oketie thowi moketi ei okapu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi kek molos gi mo kod chapat.
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ginipidh ngano makmana ginikaa kuthe; gini nyagre gi tich to onge ohala ma giniyudi. Omiyo yuduru wichkuot mar keyo maru nikech mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mager.”
english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of the LORD’s fierce anger.”

kikuyu: kendo sirni mamoko nokete e konde man yo tok Hemb Romo.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

kikuyu: Mogik, beduru motegno kuom Ruoth, kendo kuom tekone maduongʼ.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

kikuyu: To Jerusalem moger malo ni thuolo kendo en e minwa,
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nomedo timo richo duto mag Jeroboam kendo ne ok giweyo timogi,
english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

kikuyu: Eka nowuok modhi oyudo ringruokno kowit piny e yo ka punda gi sibuor ochungʼ bute. Sibuor ne ok ochamo ngʼatno kata kidho punda.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

kikuyu: To kar timo kamano to nonuru chike Nyasaye kod wechene! Ka ok ginyal wuoyo kaluwore gi wachni to ok ginyal konyo ngʼato.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mad iyie ineg joma timbegi richo! Ayiuru buta, un joma rich chwero remb ji omakogi!
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

kikuyu: Doguru thucheu, nyiga; aseti ma ok anyal bedo gi dichwo machielo. To kata dine bed ni pod aparo ni an gi geno, kata dine bed ni abedo gi dichwo otienoni mi anywolo yawuowi
english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

kikuyu: To joka Kohath, Musa ne ok omiyogi gimoro amora nikech tich mane omigi ne en mar tingʼo gik maler.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

kikuyu: Jotend mier moko nochiwore tiyo tijno. Jatelo nochiwo e od keno dhahabu moromo kilo aboro gi nus, bakunde piero abich kod lep jodolo maromo mia abich gi piero adek mag jodolo.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne giporo wach mondo giti gi pesago kuom ngʼiewo puoth jachwe agulni mondo obed kama iyike jodak.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

kikuyu: Gin joma ji oluoro kendo magoyo ji gi kihondko, giloso chikegi giwegi, kendo gichuno luor mag-gi giwegi.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

kikuyu: Yath ka yath ingʼeyo kod olembe owuon. Ji ok pon olemb ngʼowu kuom yiende mag kudho, kata olemb mzabibu bende ok pon kuom otanglo.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Solomon nooro ji mi gikele koa e kendo mar misango. Adonija nobiro mokulore piny e nyim Ruoth Solomon kendo Solomon nowachone niya, “Dhi dalani.”
english: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”

kikuyu: Nikech timbeni mamono, abiro timoni gima ne pok atimo nyaka nene kendo ma ok nachak atim kendo.
english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni jomaler ema biro ngʼadone piny bura? Ka un ema onego ungʼadne piny bura, to donge mano nyiso ni unyalo ngʼado bura kuom weche matindo man e kind ji?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye kelowa e pinyni mondo negwa gi ligangla? Mondewa kod nyithindwa ibiro kaw mana kaka gik moyaki. Donge deber ka wadok Misri?”
english: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

kikuyu: Onge kama otimo mudho kata kama olil gi tipo ma joricho nyalo pondoe.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

kikuyu: Ne ooro wachne mi nochangogi kendo noresogi e lak tho.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin nowuok Gibea kendo neginego jo-Israel alufu piero ariyo gariyo e paw kedo odiechiengno.
english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

kikuyu: E dala mar Lustra, ne nitiere ngʼat moro ma tiendeni ongʼol. Ngʼatni nongʼol nyaka aa nywolne kendo ne pok owuotho nyaka nene.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech yadhno nodongo marabora kochomo polo kendo kane odongo marabora kamano sunga nomake.
english: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne igola oko e liel, ne iresa kane oyudo aridora piny e bur matut mar joma otho.
english: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, wadhiuru nyime kod ngima mawasenwangʼo.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Bangʼ ka usetieko higni piero abiriyo e Babulon, to anabi iru kendo achop singo mara mar ngʼwono mondo aduogu ka.”
english: For the LORD says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

kikuyu: To jo-Daudi nowachone niya, “Ka Juda ka ema waluorie. Dobednwa machalo nade ka wadhi Keila mondo waked gi jolweny mag Filistia!”
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”

kikuyu: Jogi noduogo monyiso joma moko wachni; to kata kamano ne ok giyie kodgi.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

kikuyu: Teyni manie rachung taya maler molos gi dhahabu nyaka rit pile ka pile e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Dwoka, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, dwoka, nikech herani ber; lokri ira kuom kechni maduongʼ.
english: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe mirimba biro rumo kendo gero mara kodgi biro kwe mos, nikech anatiek mirimba kenda, kendo ka asetoyo mirimba kuomgi to giningʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuoyo kuom nyiego mara.
english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

kikuyu: Adiera en ni isebedo gi chwo abich, kendo ngʼat makoro in-go sani bende ok chwori. Gima isewachono en adier.”
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

kikuyu: Kane ogwedhogi, noweyogi kendo nokawe motere e polo.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nowacho niya, “Ma e kama od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasaye nobedie, kendo kae ema jo-Israel nogerie kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep.”
english: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ok inyal winjo tiend gima atimo, to ibiro winjo tiende bangʼe.”
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

kikuyu: Dhiuru kendo uywagne nyisecheu ma useyiero. Weuru giresu sa ma un e thagruok!”
english: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼno ne ogone agengʼa nyaka higa mar apar gachiel mar Ruoth Zedekia.
english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon bende nohondho yiedhi kama iluongo ni Ezion Geber machiegni gi Elath e piny Edom e dho Nam Makwar.
english: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: To kwan mar dhahabu molos ka oyieyo ne chal gi kwan dalane mag jo-Filistia mag Ruodhi abich, ne gin mier matindo mochiel motegno man-gi mieregi. Lwanda maduongʼ, mane giketoe Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, pod ochungʼ kanyo ka ranyisi e puoth Joshua ja-Beth Shemesh nyaka chil kawuono.
english: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down the LORD’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

kikuyu: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

kikuyu: “Japur moro nodhi chwoyo kodhi. Kane oyudo ochwoyo kodhi, moko nolwar e yo mi nonyon-gi kendo winy mafuyo e kor polo nochamogi duto.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Weuru ngʼur e kindu uwegi.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

kikuyu: Kata kamano unyalo yangʼo chiayo meku kamoro amora e miechu, ma ucham ringʼo kaka udwaro, mana ka gima en ring mwanda kata ogunde. Kaluwore gi gweth ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, joma ogak kod jomaler nyalo chamo ringʼogo.
english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nyaka rit Sabato ka gitimoe nyasi kuom tienge duto mabiro kaka singruok mosiko.
english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

kikuyu: “Min Sisera ne ngʼicho gie dirisa; kaywak kama: ‘Angʼo momiyo gache odeko kapok obiro? Angʼo momiyo mor mar gechene ok winjre?’
english: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’

kikuyu: Saulo ne okecho ahinya nikech wendno nochwanye, mi nowacho e chunye niya, “Ere kaka gisemiyo Daudi alufe gi alufe; to an to gimiya mana alufe kende. Angʼo modongʼne makoro ok doyudi ma kata bedo ruoth?”
english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”

kikuyu: Higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo e piny Misri norumo,
english: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo opar kaka dojiw nyawadgi omed bedo gihera kod timbe mabeyo.
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

kikuyu: Mad chunya bed maonge ketho, kuom rito chikeni, mondo kik ane wichkuot.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

kikuyu: Nosidho ogut mula e wiye kendo norwako koti mar lweny mar mula ma pekne oromo kilo piero abich gi abiriyo,
english: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Joshua nosegolo jo-Israel, negidhi mondo gikaw pinyno, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato yudo pokne.
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

kikuyu: Hoshea, Hanania, Hashub,
english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

kikuyu: Mana kaka usebedo gima ikwongʼo e dier ogendini, yaye Juda gi Israel, e kaka koro abiro resou, mi udok joma ji yudo gweth kuomgi. Kik ubed maluor, to beduru gi chir.”
english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mawinjo puonj dhi maber, to ojahawi ngʼatno moketo genone kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Riekone tut kendo tekre ngʼeny. En ngʼa mosepiem kode miloye?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

kikuyu: To Daudi noparo e chunye owuon niya, “Chiengʼ moro natho e lwet Saulo. Gima ber monego atim en ni onego atony karingo adhi e piny jo-Filistia. Eka Saulo nowe manya e Israel duto kendo natony e lwete.”
english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

kikuyu: An kodi, kendo onge ngʼato mabiro buki mi hinyi, nikech an gi ji mangʼeny e dalani.”
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

kikuyu: Jodong oganda mar Israel noket lwetgi ewi nyarwadhno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo enoyangʼe mana kanyo.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka ji nonene, negipako nyasachgi, kagiwacho niya, “Nyasachwa osechiwo jasikwa e lwetwa, ngʼatno mane oketho pinywa mi omiyo onegwa mangʼeny.”
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”

kikuyu: Jodolo abiriyo mane otingʼo turumbete abiriyo nodhi nyime, ka gipangore e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka gigoyo turumbete. Ji momanore gi gige lweny notelo e nyimgi, to moko ne luwo bangʼ Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka turumbete dhi nyime gi ywak.
english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the LORD’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after the LORD’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, an kodi gi wach moro ma ok ber kuomi; iyie gi dhako miluongo ni Jezebel maluongore ni janabi madhako. En ema omiyo jotichna lal kopuonjogi mondo giterre, kendo mondo gicham chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

kikuyu: kendo negiloso rachungi mar taya piero angʼwen mag fedha miketo e bwogi, ka rachungi ariyo iketo e bwo sirni ariyo momanyore.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: yo milambo; pinje duto mag jo-Kanaan, kochakore Meara mar jo-Sidonia nyaka ochopo Afek, gi tongʼ mar jo-Amor;
english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

kikuyu: Omiyo ne amiyi kum mi adiyo kiewo mari; ne ajwangʼou e lwet wasiki ma jowuoro, ma gin nyi jo-Filistia, kendo gin bende timbegi manjore nobwogogi.
english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

kikuyu: Magi e weche mane jayalo ma wuod Daudi, mane ruodh Jerusalem owacho.
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

kikuyu: Kush ne en wuon Nimrod, mane en jalweny maratego e piny.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny mar adek, e dwe mar adek ne en Benaya wuod Jehoyada ma jadolo. Ne en jatelo maduongʼ kendo notelo ne jolweny alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Nikech Muma timo neno kuome niya, “In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Ndalona chalo gi tipo modhiambo; aner adwaro two ka lum.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

kikuyu: Eka Malaika mar ariyo noolo tape e nam mi pi nam nolokore remo machalo gi remb ngʼat motho, kendo gik mangima duto modak e nembego ne otho.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

kikuyu: Anakel luoro kuomu koa kuom jogo duto man butu,” Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho. “Un duto noriembu, kendo onge ngʼama nochok joma noringo moke.
english: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nonyisogi niya, “Otienoni un duto ubiro ringo uweya, nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Abiro goyo jakwath, mi kweth mag rombe noke.’
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Kane Haman osedonjo, ruoth nopenje niya, “Angʼo monego tim ne ngʼat ma ruoth dwaro miyo duongʼ?” Koro Haman noparo kende niya, “Ere ngʼama ruoth dimi duongʼ ma ok an?”
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now Haman said in his heart, “Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?”

kikuyu: Yaye, unune malit un joma loso chike ma ok nikare, un joma keto chike maricho mathiro ji,
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

kikuyu: Eka giningʼe ni, an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi antie kodgi, kendo ni gin, jo-dhood Israel, gin joga, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Kane olokore monena, noluonga, mine apenje ni, Angʼo midwaro mondo atim?
english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

kikuyu: Owacho ne en owuon niya, “Onge gima nyalo yienga; abiro dak gi kwe kinde duto kaonge gima thaga.”
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ema noluonga ka akwayo rombe, mine owachona ni, ‘Dhiyo mondo ikor wach ne joga Israel.’
english: and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

kikuyu: Ruoth Belshazar noloso nyasi maduongʼ ne jodonge alufu achiel kendo nomadho kodgi divai.
english: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ ma iniwuogi ma ingʼadi Holo mar Kidron, to bed gadiera ni initho; kendo rembi enobed e wiyi.
english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasaye. En Nyasaye ma ja-adiera; marito singruokne mar hera ne tienge gana gi gana mohere kendo rito chikene.
english: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

kikuyu: gi chiemo mane ni e mesane, gi bet mar jodonge, gi rwakruok mar jotije mapogo chiemo, gi rwakruok mar jotije machiwo divai kod misango miwangʼo pep mane otimo e hekalu Jehova Nyasaye, dhoge nomoko.
english: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

kikuyu: Lo nigi okak nikech onge koth e piny; jopur luoro omako kendo giumo wiyegi.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.

kikuyu: Dhiyo, icham chiemo gi mor, kendo imadh divai mari gi chuny moil, nimar sani ema Nyasaye jakori kuom gik mitimo.
english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

kikuyu: Chunguru e bath yo kendo ungʼi, un joma odak Aroer. Penj dichwo maringo kod dhako maringo, ni, Angʼo mosetimore?
english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo abich, jadolo maduongʼ miluongi ni Anania nodhi nyaka Kaisaria, kaachiel gi jodongo moko, kod jangʼad bura mane iluongo ni Tertulo, mine gikelo weche mane gidonjonigo Paulo e nyim ruoth.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

kikuyu: Un nyithind wuonu ma Satan kendo dwach wuonuno ema uhero timo. Ne en janek nyaka aa chakruok, kendo ok odwar adiera nikech adiera onge kuome. Koriambo to otimo gima ongʼiyogo, nimar en ja-miriambo, kendo en e wuon miriambo duto.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

kikuyu: An bende aseweyo rembeno ewi lwandano ma ok oume mondo owangʼ iya, mi achul kuor.
english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”

kikuyu: Eka nogoyo chonge piny mokok matek niya, “Ruoth, kik ikwan richoni e wigi.” Kane osewacho kamano, to chunye nochot.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

kikuyu: ‘Kane wuora chiegni tho, nomiyo asingorane ni abiro yike e bur mane okunyo e piny Kanaan. Kuom mano yie adhi aike eka abiro duogo.’ ”
english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

kikuyu: Kamano bende puonj mon madongo mondo kit ngimagi obed ranyisi maber, ma ok jokuoth, kata joma ohero madho kongʼo, to nyaka gibed gi puonj mabeyo.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

kikuyu: Kane amedo nono tiend wachni, to notamo wangʼa, omiyo napenje ka doyie odhi Jerusalem mondo oyale kuno kuom wechegi.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

kikuyu: To e sechego jopuonjrene nosiko kajiwe niya, “Rabi, chamie gimoro.”
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

kikuyu: Chiwe ne Eliazar jadolo; kendo nyaroyano nyaka gol oko mar kambi mi yangʼe ka oneno.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

kikuyu: Piny notetni kendo oyiengni; kendo mise mag gode notetni; ne gikirni nikech ne okecho.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

kikuyu: Joma kare ok nopudh ngangʼ, to joricho ok nodongʼ e piny.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

kikuyu: An Paulo gi Sila kod Timotheo, Wandikonu un kanisa mar jo-Thesalonika, man kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: “Koma odok yo podho chiengʼ mar laruno lachne norom mita piero ariyo gadek kendo nobed gi pasia mongʼaw e sirni apar morwakie rachungi apar.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼat ma ok oter nyangu e yor ringruok, to oluwo chik, biro ngʼadoni bura, in ma ingʼeyo Ndiko kendo oteri, to iketho chik.
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Paulo oseneno fwenyno, ne waikore piyo piyo mondo wadhi e piny Makedonia, nikech ne wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye dwarowa loka kono mondo wayalnegi Injili.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

kikuyu: Ne githedho dhahabu marep-rep kendo ne gilire matindo tindo mondo olosgo law marambuluno gi maralik kod marakwaro kolose gi jatwengʼo molony.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osekwongʼore kendo ok nolok pache, osesingore niya, “In jadolo nyaka chiengʼ, koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
english: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Ka chiengʼ ne pok opodho e dhorangeye Jerusalem kendo ka Sabato pok ochopo, ne achiwo chik mondo dhoudi olor kendo mondo kik yawgi nyaka Sabato rum. Ne oketo joge owuon e rangeye mondo kik misigo moro amora kel chiengʼ Sabato.
english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Ka kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oyiero mondo nyinge obedie bor kodu, to unyalo yangʼo chiayo moa e kweth jambu kod dhou moa e miechu kaka asechikou kendo ucham ringʼo kaka udwaro.
english: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

kikuyu: Nyasaye mangima gi kite duto odak ei Kristo, tiende ni e ringre Kristo,
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

kikuyu: Mad joma dwaro ketho ngimana, ne wichkuot gi achaya. Mad joma chanona hinyruok, chunygi nyosre mi giweya.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

kikuyu: To koro tim makare mar Nyasaye ma ok otenore kuom chik, oseelore, mana kaka Ndiko mag Musa gi Jonabi nyiso.
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

kikuyu: Adier isewinjo gik ma ruodhi mag Asuria osetimo ni pinjeruodhi duto kotiekogi chuth. In to iparo ni ibiro tony?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

kikuyu: Abiro wachoni weche mawuok e chunya kendo wechenago gin adiera.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisea ir Farao, negiyudo Musa gi Harun karitogi mondo orom kodgi,
english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Kane osetieko wuoyo, nowachone Simon niya, “Kiew yie odhi e chuny pi kama tut, mondo uchik tondeu omak rech.”
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

kikuyu: dipo nono ka ipuonjori yorene, ma iwuon idonj e obadho.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

kikuyu: Kar romb dhood Dan ne gin ji alufu piero auchiel gariyo gi mia abiriyo (62,700).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Israel orito chike duto kendo otimo gik moko duto mane achikogi, kendo oluwo buche gi chike duto mane Musa onyisogi, to ok nariembgi e piny mane amiyo kweregi.”
english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

kikuyu: Sikuru kuoma, kaka an bende asiko kuomu, nikech onge bad yath manyalo nyago olemo kende owuon ka ok osiko e mzabibu. Un bende ok unyal nyago olemo ka ok usiko kuoma.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kaw rwedhi abiriyo gi imbe abiriyo mondo idhigo ir jatichna Ayub kendo utim misango miwangʼo pep ne un uwegi. Jatichna Ayub biro lamonu, kendo anawinj lemone ma ok anatimnu gima owinjore gi timbeu mofuwogi. Ok usewacho kuoma gik ma adier, kaka jatichna Ayub.”
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

kikuyu: Oseiko gige mag lweny mager; oiko asernige makakni ka mach.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

kikuyu: Mogik, jowetewa, ne wapuonjou kaka onego udag malongʼo ne Nyasaye, mana kaka ngimau chalo sani. To koro wakwayou kendo wajiwou kuom Ruoth Yesu mondo umed timo kamano moloyo.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

kikuyu: Ahithofel ne en jangʼad rieko ne ruoth. Hushai ja-Arki to ne en osiep ruoth.
english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Anakelnu wichkuot manyaka chiengʼ ma en wichkuot ma wich ok nowilgo.”
english: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo askeche nokawo pesago, kendo negitimo kaka nonyisgi. Kendo wachni koro oselandore kuonde mathoth e dier jo-Yahudi nyaka odiechiengni.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

kikuyu: E dwe mokwongo oganda jo-Israel duto nochopo e Thim mar Zin, kendo negidak Kadesh. Kanyo ema Miriam nothoe moike.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

kikuyu: Awachoni ni ok niwuog oko nyaka ichul faini duto monego ichul ma ok orem kata ndururu.”
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

kikuyu: Shubael ma nyakwar Gershom wuod Musa mane jatelo manorito kuonde keno.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

kikuyu: Barnaba ne dwaro mondo Johana miluongo ni Mariko odhi kodgi,
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

kikuyu: Joma nodongʼ kuomgi notony modhi Afek kama ohinga nomukore monego ji alufu piero ariyo gabiriyo. To Ben-Hadad noringo modhi e dala maduongʼ mopondo ei ot maiye.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

kikuyu: Eri achungʼ ka. Hulieuru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kod ngʼate mowir ketho ma asetimo. Rwadh ngʼa masekawo? Punda ngʼa masekawo? Ngʼatno ma asethiro? Asekawo asoya koa kuom ngʼa mondo odin wangʼa? Ka dipo ni asetimo achiel kuom gigi, to aikora mar loso.”
english: Here I am. Witness against me before the LORD and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”

kikuyu: Kendo negiketo jodolo kuondegi kod jo-Lawi e migepe mag-gi ne tich Nyasaye e Jerusalem, kaluwore gi gima ondikie Kitap Musa.
english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

kikuyu: Merayoth nonywolo Amaria, to Amaria nonywolo Ahitub,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Eka Daniel ma bende nochaki ni Belteshazar wachni nobwogo molingʼ kendo luoro nomake. Omiyo ruoth nowacho ni Belteshazar niya, “Kik kibaji goyi nikech lekno kata nikech gima tiende nyiso.” Belteshazar nodwoko niya, “Ruodha, ka dine bed ni lekni ne ni kuom wasiki kendo tiende ne ni kuom joma kedo kodi, to dine ber!
english: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, “Belteshazzar, don’t let the dream or the interpretation trouble you.” Belteshazzar answered, “My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries.

kikuyu: Weche mag kuoth chalo gi chiemo mamit; gidhiyo e chuny dhano ma iye.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Nochako gedo odiechiengʼ mar ariyo e dwe mar ariyo e higa mar angʼwen mar lochne.
english: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni tiuru gi mwandu mag piny mondo umakgo osiepe ne un uwegi, mondo ka chiengʼ ma mwandugo orumo, norwaku e kar dak mochwere.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

kikuyu: Pok mar abich ne mar Nethania gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: “Abiro chulou kuom higni ma bonyo osechamo; bonyo madongo gi matindo, gi bonyo mamoko gi mony mar bonyo; ma gin oganda maduongʼ mar jolweny mara mane aoro e dieru.
english: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aolo mirimba kuomgi nikech ne gisechwero remo e piny, kendo nikech ne gisedwanye gi nyisechegi mopa.
english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

kikuyu: To bangʼ tho Ahab, ruodh Moab nongʼanyo ne ruodh Israel.
english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

kikuyu: Joge duto chur kaywagore ka gimanyo chiemo; giloko mwandugi mondo giyud chiemo, mondo gibed mangima. “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, neye kendo iparae, nimar ji ochaya.”
english: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, LORD, and see, for I have become despised.”

kikuyu: Mefibosheth, nyakwar Saulo bende nodhi mondo orom ne ruoth. Ne pok olwoko tiende kata buso yie tike kendo luoko lepe chakre chiengʼ mane ruoth owuokie nyaka chiengʼ manoduogo ka ok ohinyore.
english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

kikuyu: “Chokreuru kanyakla kendo ubi; chokreuru, un joma otony moa e pinje. Joma ofuwo gin jogo mawuotho kotingʼo nyiseche mopa mag yien, malamo nyiseche ma ok nyal resogi.
english: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.

kikuyu: To Nadab kod Abihu notho motelone wuon-gi kendo ne gionge gi yawuowi; omiyo Eliazar kod Ithamar ema ne otiyo kaka jodolo.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

kikuyu: Changa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo anachangi; resa kendo anaresra, nimar in kendi ema apaki.
english: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

kikuyu: Kanisa nokowogi, kendo kane oyudo gidhi, ka gikadho e dier Foinike kod Samaria, neginyiso ji kaka joma ok jo-Yahudi bende ne yudo warruok. Wachno nomiyo owete odoko mamor.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

kikuyu: Omiyo Hosea nodhi mokendo Gomer nyar Diblaim, mine omako ich monywolone wuowi.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Perez maroteke mane odak Jerusalem noromo kwan-gi noromo ji mia angʼwen gi piero auchiel gaboro (468).
english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

kikuyu: Jo-Elam kawo aserni mag-gi, kaachiel gi joriemb geche mag lweny gi farese; to jo-Kir to nokawo kuodigi.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

kikuyu: Chik ma amiyou kawuononi ok en chik matek to bende ok en kuma bor ma ok unyal chopoe.
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

kikuyu: Ka uchiwo mich kendo uchiwo yawuotu kaka misango miwangʼo e mach, to mano nyiso ni pod udwanyoru mana gi nyisecheu manono nyaka kawuono. Bende dayienu mondo upenja wach adier, yaye dhood Israel? Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni ok abi yienu upenja wach.
english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you!

kikuyu: Nopenjo niya, “Wadhi monje koa kon mane?” Nodwoke niya, “Ka wangʼado e piny ongoro mar Edom.”
english: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa noparo e chunye owuon niya, “Abiro sudo machiegni mondo ane hono maduongʼni. Angʼo momiyo bunguni ok wangʼ kata obedo ni mach lielie.”
english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”

kikuyu: Wan to ne watelo nyime nyaka ei yie, mi wakwangʼ nyaka Asos, kuma ne wadhi kawoe Paulo. Nosechano kamano nikech ne odwaro ni mondo odhi kuno kowuotho gi tiende.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

kikuyu: Bende norito yo wuok chiengʼ mar Araba kochakore e Nam mar Kinereth nyaka e Nam mar Araba (tiende ni, Nam Chumbi), to nyaka Beth Jeshimoth, bangʼe nyaka yo milambo e tiend gode mag Pisga.
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

kikuyu: “Beduru motangʼ ni jopuonj chik. Gihero wuotho koni gi koni ka girwako lewni maboyo mayware piny kendo gihero ni omosgi e chirni kendo gihero bedo e kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke kod kuonde ma imiyoe ji duongʼ e sewni.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

kikuyu: Ka Yesu nosetero ngʼatno tenge, kogole oko e kind oganda, nosoyo lith lwetene e ite. Eka nongʼulo olawo mi omulo lew ngʼatno.
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼat mamako guok gi ite, e kaka ngʼat makadho akadha madonjo e dhawo ma ok mare.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

kikuyu: Mondo ungʼe ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo.” Yesu nowachone ja-athanyno niya,
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

kikuyu: Ka dichwo kata dhako nigi adhola e wiye kata e tike,
english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

kikuyu: Ogendini duto chokore kanyakla kendo ji duto chokore kamoro achiel. En ngʼa kuomgi mane ofwenyo gima kama kapok otimore kendo mane owachonwa gigo mane otimore chon? Wegiuru gikel joneno mag-gi mondo onyiswa ane ni ne gin kare, eka joma owinjo owachi niya, “En adier.”
english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

kikuyu: Timbene ne richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok olokore weyo yore mag richo mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Giwacho weche polo gi dhogi to lewgi to gimakogo mwandu mag piny.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi, kata kamano, nyaka gur hembegi e alwora mar Hemb Romo mar Rapar mondo omi mirimb Jehova Nyasaye kik lwar kuom oganda mar jo-Israel. Jo-Lawi nobed karito Hemb Romo mar Rapar.”
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

kikuyu: Ne abedo mamor ahinya ka jowete moko nobiro kendo mowachona kaka isiko kiwuotho e adieranogo.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

kikuyu: Joma chon ok par ngangʼ mana kaka tiengʼni bende, ok nopar gi joma biro luwo bangʼ-gi.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

kikuyu: An jatichni, omiyo yie imiya nyalo mar ngʼeyo gik mopondo eka awinj tiend chikeni.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

kikuyu: Tonde mag tho ne orida matek; kendo ohula mangʼongo mar tho nouma.
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

kikuyu: Askechego nodwoko wachno ni jongʼad bura, to kane giwinjo ni Paulo gi Sila ne gin jo-Rumi, luoro nomakogi.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata mochwero remb dhano, en bende nyaka rembe chwer koa e lwet dhano; nikech e kit Nyasaye nochweyo dhano.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

kikuyu: ka ok okwan osuru misolo kuom jo-ohala kod joyiedhi madongo mag ruodhi duto mag Arabia kod jotend piny.
english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

kikuyu: Ruodh Asuria nooro jatend jolweny mare maduongʼ, jatend jolweny maluwe to gi jatend lweny motelo e kar kedo kaachiel gi jolweny mangʼeny ir Hezekia Jerusalem ka gia Lakish. Negidhi nyaka Jerusalem ma gichopo e bath Soko man malo nyaka e puoth jaluoko.
english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼat ma nochanga ema nowachona ni, ‘Kaw pieni mondo iwuothi.’ ”
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

kikuyu: Nikech nidagi winjo Jehova Nyasaye kendo timo kaka nochiki mondo itim ne jo-Amalek mane en-go gi mirima maduongʼ, mano emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye osetimoni gini kawuono.
english: Because you didn’t obey the LORD’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you today.

kikuyu: Timni makare ochopo nyaka ei kor polo, yaye Nyasaye, in misetimo gik madongo. En ngʼa ma dipim kodi, yaye Nyasaye?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

kikuyu: Gihero bedo e kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke, kod kuonde ma imiyoe ji duongʼ e sewni.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

kikuyu: Jarit notimo mana kaka Josef nokone kendo notero jogo nyaka e od Josef.
english: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

kikuyu: Dibed ni ngʼato noluongi koseter nyangu? Kik ogomb ni ne ok otere nyangu. Dibed ni ngʼato noluongi kapok oter nyangu? Ngʼat ma kamano kik ter nyangu.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

kikuyu: Jonabi duto owuoyo kuome ni ngʼato angʼata moyie kuome yudo weruok mar richo e nyinge.”
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

kikuyu: “To ka jopur puodho nowacho e kindgi giwegi ni, ‘Ma e jacham girkeni, biuru mondo wanege mondo girkeni odongʼnwa.’
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

kikuyu: mana kaka an awuon atemo moro ji duto e gik moko duto matimo, ka ok amany mana gik makonya an awuon, to atimo gik makonyo ji mangʼeny, mondo kanyalore to giyud warruok.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Ka ja-Lawi moro ok owaro ode manie dalagi, to odni nyaka duogne e higa mar piero abich, nikech udi manie miech joka Lawi e mwandu kende ma gin godo e piny Israel.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni Jehu wuod Hanani kuom Baasha mowachone niya, “Nayieri.”
english: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

kikuyu: Ka Elizabeth nowinjo mos mar Maria nyathi notugo e iye kendo Elizabeth nopongʼ gi Roho Maler.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: To kuom joma ok jo-Yahudi moyie, wasendikonegi kuom gimane buchwa ongʼado ni kik gicham chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono, kik ucham remo, gi ring jamni mode, kendo ni kik giterre.”
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

kikuyu: E kindeno ji nongʼi Jachwechgi kendo gichom wengegi kuom Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: E dwe mar abiriyo mar higa onogono, Hanania janabi notho.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Dibed ni Nyasaye wiye osewil gi kecho ji? Koso mirimbe mager osemiyo ok okech joge?” Sela
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

kikuyu: Yesu nohero Maritha gi nyamin mare kod Lazaro.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

kikuyu: Uz wuowi makayo, Buz owadgi, Kemuel (wuon Aram),
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

kikuyu: Ka awachone ngʼama timbene richo ni, ibiro tho ma ok itony, to in ok isieme kata ok iwuoyo kode mondo igole e yorene maricho, eka ires ngimane, to ngʼat ma timbene richono biro tho nikech richone, to abiro keto rembe e wiyi.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kar dino mar Nakon, Uza notero lwete mosiro Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye nimar rwedhi nochwanyore.
english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

kikuyu: ka gineno bidhruok gi luor mar ngimau.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

kikuyu: Okwongʼ mirimbgi nikech en mirima mager kendo makwiny. Anakegi e kind joka Jakobo kendo akegi e piny Israel duto.
english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

kikuyu: Isaka nolamo Jehova Nyasaye ne chiege, nikech en migumba. Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko lamone, kendo chiege Rebeka nomako ich.
english: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren. The LORD was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

kikuyu: “Eka ranyisi mar Wuod Dhano nothinyre e kor polo, kendo ogendini duto mag piny noywagi ka gineno Wuod Dhano kalor biro e boche polo, ka en gi teko kod duongʼ malich.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nodwoke niya, “Asingora ni anatim kamano.”
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

kikuyu: Nikech un, Jehova Nyasaye ne okecho koda mi owachona niya, “Ok inidonji e pinyno.”
english: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo giwuotho gidhi ka gin kaachiel, apoya nono gach lweny mar mach kod farese mag mach nothinyore ma opogo kindgi kendo Elija noter e polo gi kalausi.
english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

kikuyu: Un uwegi usewinjo koyanyo Nyasaye. Uparo nade?” Giduto ne gikwede kaka ngʼat mowinjore githo.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

kikuyu: “Abiro miyo od Juda bedo gi teko kendo reso joka Josef. Abiro dwogogi ira nikech asekechogi. Abiro dwoko kwayogi mi gichal joma ne pok akwedo, nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi, nikech awinjo kwayogi.
english: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

kikuyu: Jowetena, bende yiend ngʼowu nyalo nyago zeituni? Koso mzabibu bende nyalo nyago ngʼowu? Kamano bende e kaka pi makech ok nyal lokore pi mamit.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

kikuyu: “Kuom kinde mangʼeny ne aoro dera mi oketho chambu gi puotheu mag mzabibu. Bonyo noketho puotheu mag ngʼowu kod mag zeituni, to kata kuom mago duto pod utamoru duogo ira,” mano e wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata kapok wach moro owuok e dhoga to ingʼeye malongʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

kikuyu: to ka giromo higni piero abich, to giniwe tich.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

kikuyu: Kata kamano jogi noritowa maber ahinya. Ne ok gitimonwa marach, to bende e kinde mane wan oko e pap kodgi onge gimoro mane olal.
english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyaka Abdon, Rehob, Hamon kod Kana, mochopo nyaka Sidon Maduongʼ.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

kikuyu: Nikech it temo weche mana kaka lep bilo chiemo.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

kikuyu: Bende anyisou ni yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruodh Nyasaye.”
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Okwayo ewi gode eka oyud lum mochamo kendo omanyo gimoro amora mangʼich.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

kikuyu: Jodolo ne ok openjo, ‘Ere Jehova Nyasaye?’ Jogo matiyo gi chik ne ok ongʼeya; jotelo nongʼanyona. Jonabi nokoro gi Baal, ka giluwo nyiseche manono.”
english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.

kikuyu: Kik iwuothi e yor joma timbegi mono kata kik iluw yor jomaricho.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

kikuyu: Seir nonywolo Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer kod Dishan.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

kikuyu: Ei hekalu mari, yaye Nyasaye, ema wabetie ka waparo kuom herani ma ok rem.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Laban noloso nyasi kendo nogwelo ji duto mae pinyno.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

kikuyu: Gin jo-Edom gi jo-Ishmael, jo-Moab gi jo-Hagri,
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

kikuyu: Herani ochopo nyaka e polo malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; adierani chopo nyaka e polo,
english: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Pang gigi mar dhiyoe twech, un joma odak Misri, nimar Memfis nowe gunda, kendo tieke chuth maonge ngʼama nodagie.”
english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero Jakobo, mondo obed gire owuon; oseyiero Israel, mondo obed mwandune mogeno.
english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kikuyu: “Kisetieko mano to chak inind piny kendo; to koro tim kamano gi bathi korachwich, mondo itingʼ richo mag dhood Juda. Aseketoni ndalo 40, ka odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ ochungʼ kar higa achiel.
english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

kikuyu: Shalum wuod Kore, ma wuod Ebiasaf, wuod Kora, to gi jorit rangeye kaachiel kode moa e anywolane, ma jokora, tijgi ne rito rangeye man gohinga mag Hema mana kaka wuonegi nosebedo katimo tijno mar rito rangach midonjogo e kar dak mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye gi nyatiti; werneuru wer mamit gi nyatiti.
english: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: To unyalo chamo gik mafuyo gi buombgi ma ok kwero.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

kikuyu: Eka moro ka moro kuomgi nowuok modok e dalane.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

kikuyu: Gibiro lielo wiyegi nikech in kendo gibiro rwako lep ywak. Gibiro ywagi malit ka chunygi nigi kuyo mapek.
english: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.

kikuyu: Winjruok mane ma Kristo nigo gi Satan (nying machielo mar Satan en Belial)? Ere winjruok manyalo bedo e kind ngʼama oyie gi ngʼama pok oyie?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

kikuyu: Otieno kata odiechiengʼ, kata ka onindo kata oneno, to kodhigo twi atwiya mi dongi, ka jachwoyo ok ongʼeyo kaka mano timore.
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni Bozra nokethi kendo nobed gir bwogo ji, gir jaro kendo nobed gir kwongʼ, kendo mieche duto nokethi chuth.”
english: For I have sworn by myself,” says the LORD, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”

kikuyu: Onego oromre duto ka borne gi lachne romo bat achiel kendo nobane nyadiriyo.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat ma winjou, winja, ngʼat modagiu odaga, kendo ngʼat modaga odagi jal ma noora.”
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

kikuyu: To mana gie sechego gik mane owachi kuom Nebukadneza notimore. Noriembe oa kuom ji kendo nochamo lum gi dhoge ka dhiangʼ. Tho noloko dende mangʼich mi yie wiye nodongo ka yie ongo kendo kokene nodongo maboyo machal gi kok winyo.
english: This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men and ate grass like oxen; and his body was wet with the dew of the sky until his hair had grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda ne ok nyal daro jo-Jebus, mane odak Jerusalem; jo-Jebus gi jo-Juda pod odak kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho ewi ruodh Asuria: “ ‘Ok nodonji e dala maduongʼni kata diro asere. Ok nomonj dalano kotingʼo kuot kata lwore gi jolweny mondo omonje.
english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nokechi kata mane nigi ngʼwono moromo mar timoni achiel kuom gigi. Kar yudo kech to ne odiri oko e pap, nikech odiechiengʼ mane onywolie ema ne ochak chayie.
english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

kikuyu: Kane osewacho kamano, nongʼudho olawo piny, mi olosogo chwodho, kaeto oketo e wangʼ ngʼatno.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

kikuyu: Nimar achamo buch kendo kaka chiemba kendo ariwo mathna gi pi wangʼa,
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

kikuyu: Alamo mondo ungʼe hera modhiero ngʼeyo gi rieko duto, eka upongʼ gi kit Nyasaye duto.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

kikuyu: Lieluru wiyeu mapoth ka udengo nikech nyithindo muketo e chunyu ibiro mau miter e twech kaka wasumbini; keturu bondou mapoth mana ka achuth.
english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!

kikuyu: Kendo enoor malaikege, koluongogi matek gi turumbete, kendo ginichok joge moyiero moa e tunge piny, chakre giko polo konchiel nyaka komachielo.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: ‘Ka eri, mamono kendo maonge ji kata le, tiende ni e dalane duto nobedi kar kwath ma jokwath kwayoe rombegi.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

kikuyu: Nethanel wuod Zuar, ma jatend Isakar nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar ariyo.
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

kikuyu: Kane osedonjo ei ot, muofni ariyogo nobiro nyaka ire, kendo nopenjogi niya, “Bende uyie ni anyalo timo ma?” Ne giyiene niya, “Ee, wayie Ruoth.”
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Ogendinigo ne gin: ruodhi abich mag jo-Filistia, jo-Kanaan duto, jo-Sidon, kod jo-Hivi mane odak e gode mag Lebanon kochakore got Baal Hermon nyaka got Lebo Hamath.
english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

kikuyu: To koro ogendini mangʼeny osechokore mondo giked kodi. Giwacho niya, “Wamiye obed mogak, wagouru siboi ni Sayun.”
english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nowuoyonigi kama: “Jo-Israel, paruru matut kuom gima udwaro timo ni jogi.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

kikuyu: Jachan nindo mamuol, kata ka ochiemo matin kata ka ochiemo mathoth, to jo-mwandu parore ma ok nyal nindo.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

kikuyu: Koro or jomoko Jopa mondo oomni Simon miluongo ni Petro. En wendo e od Simon ma janyongʼ piende, modak e dho nam.’
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

kikuyu: rachungi apargo kod karechegi apar;
english: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

kikuyu: Saulo noyiero ji alufu adek kuom jo-Israel; to kuom joma noyierogo ji alufu ariyo ne ni kode Mikmash gi pinje gode mag Bethel, to ji alufu achiel ne nigi Jonathan e gwengʼ Gibea e piny Benjamin. To ji duto modongʼ nonyiso nodog miechgi.
english: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

kikuyu: Gibiro tingʼo pasia moumgo kar lemo, Hemb Romo, gik moumego kod piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nam moumgo wiye, moumgo dhoranga Hemb Romo,
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: Ere gima nomiyo iringo lingʼ-lingʼ ka akia? Angʼo ma nomoni nyisa, mondo omi asewi gi mor kiwerni kendo igoni thum?
english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

kikuyu: Ka en kamano, to koro marangʼo udwaro temo Nyasaye, kuketo jok mapek e ngʼut jopuonjre ma wan kata kwerewa ne ok nyal tingʼo?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

kikuyu: Ne akecho gi timbene mamono ma ok rum, ne amiye kum, kendo apandone wangʼa ka an-gi mirima, to kata kamano nomedo mana dhiyo nyime gi timbene mamonogo.
english: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

kikuyu: Fweny machielo mane Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto okelona ema: Ne aneno kooro mach maduongʼ mondo owangʼ nam manie bwo piny, kendo otiek gik moko duto manie piny.
english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.

kikuyu: kata kapo ni asechamo cham monyakie puothe ka ok achulo, to eka jopur mane opure to kech nego,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

kikuyu: Tweyo chiemo maru rumo mana gi dhawo kod chuny malit, bende miyo ugoru e kindu uwegi. Ok unyal tweyo chiemo kaka utimo e ndalogi kuparo ni lemou nowinj e polo malo.
english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

kikuyu: Abiro lor mondo awuo kodi kanyo, kendo abiro kawo teko mar loch moko kuomi mane amiyi kendo ami jogo. Gibiro konyi rito ogandano makoro tingʼno ok noturi kendi.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

kikuyu: Lwokreuru mondo ubed maler. Goluru timbeu mamono e wangʼa!
english: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

kikuyu: Kisetieko pwodhe to nyaka ichiw nyarwath ma pod tin kod im mogol e kweth, maonge songa duto kargi ariyogo.
english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

kikuyu: Mapiyo nono bangʼ ka baruwa machal gi mane oor ne Ruoth Artaksases nosesom ne Rehum kod Shimshai ma jagoro gi joma gitiyogo kanyakla, negidhi mana gisano Jerusalem ir jo-Yahudi kendo ne gichunogi mondo giwe tich.
english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

kikuyu: Kuom yawuot Josef: Koa e dhood Efraim: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Pok mar adek ne mar dhood Zebulun kaluwore anywolagi. Tongʼ mar pok margi nochopo nyaka Sarid.
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

kikuyu: Eka Eliazar jadolo nowacho ne jolweny mane odhi e lweny niya, “Chik mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa ema:
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Koso uparo ni ka wapuonjo yie kamano, to wamiyo Chik bedo maonge gi tich? Ooyo, ok kamano ngangʼ! Koro eka waketo Chik bedo motegno.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

kikuyu: gi Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo; gi Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Thadayo, Simon ma ja-Zilote,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

kikuyu: Ka dwondi omor to ji ringo; ka ia malo to ogendini ke.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
