kikuyu: Weuru mondo kwe mar Kristo obed jaloch e chunyu kaka fuondi ringruok achiel, noluongu e kwe, omiyo gouru erokamano.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

kikuyu: Eka nyipeche ma jo-Israel nofwenyo ni gin e chandruok ka nonyisogi niya, “Ok unyal dwoko kar kwan matafare musebedo kuloso pile.”
english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

kikuyu: Magi duto timore nikech bayo yo mar Jakobo, nikech richo mar dhood Israel. Bayo yo mar Jakobo to en angʼo? Donge en Samaria? Koso kama otingʼore mar Juda to kanye? Donge en Jerusalem?
english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Koro ere jogi mariekgo? Koro ginyisiane mondo ingʼe gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego chano timo ne Misri.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

kikuyu: To kata obedo kamano, ok akwan ngimana ka gima lichna; gima ochuna maduongʼ en mana tieko ngʼweya kendo chopo tich ma Ruoth Yesu osemiya mondo atim, ma en tich mar lando Injili mar ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

kikuyu: Ne Tito, wuoda mar adier kuom yie moriwowa e achiel: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Kristo Yesu ma Jawarwa obed kodi.
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

kikuyu: “Mika maa Moresheth nokoro e ndalo Hezekia ruodh Juda. Nonyiso jo-Juda duto ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “ ‘Sayun ibiro pur ka puodho, Jerusalem biro dongʼ gunda, got matin mogerie hekalu nobed ka bungu motwere moyugno.’
english: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “‘Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.’

kikuyu: Obiro miyo udok jo-mwandu e yore duto, mondo ubed mangʼwon kinde duto, kendo mondo ji mangʼeny odwok erokamano ni Nyasaye kuom mich mane watero nigi koa kuomu.
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

kikuyu: Ka ibedo mondo ichiem gi ruoth, non maber gima ni e nyimi,
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

kikuyu: nimar ne udagi puonj maga duto kendo ne ok uwinjo siem mara.
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

kikuyu: Nikech gimane nigi duongʼ sani kindecha koro onge gi duongʼ minyalo pimo gi mano maduongʼ moloye.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

kikuyu: “To bende, med nyiso ji ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ne, aketo e nyimi yor ngima kod yor tho.
english: “You shall say to this people, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano to ipimwa gi yawuowi mamoko machamo chiemo moa e od ruoth mondo ineane ka bende nitie pogruok, eka itim ne jotichni kaluwore gi gima ineno.”
english: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

kikuyu: To dhiuru ir rombe molal mag jo-Israel kende.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Ere ngʼama nyalo kwano kar romb oganda joka Jakobo machalo gi buru kata ngʼama nyalo kwano migawo mar angʼwen mar Israel? Weuru atho kaka joma kare tho, kendo mad giko mara ochal kod margi!”
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

kikuyu: Yawuot Merari ne gin: Mali kod Mushi. Magi ema ne dhout jo-Lawi kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka nondikgi kaluwore gi anywolagi: Koa kuom jo-Juda jotend migepe mag jolweny alufu achiel (1,000) ne en Adna mane otelo ne jolweny maroteke alufu mia adek (300,000);
english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

kikuyu: Gibiro mosi kendo miyi makati ariyo, mibiro kawo kuomgi.
english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

kikuyu: Nyodo mokwongo mar ich, obed dhano kata chiayo, mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye en mari. To nyaka uwar wuowi makayo moro amora kod kayo madichwo moro amora mar jamni ma ok ler.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to the LORD, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

kikuyu: Modekai nondiko gigo mane otimore, nooro barupe ni jo-Yahudi duto e gwenge maboyo kod machiegni mane ni e bwo loch ruoth Ahasuerus,
english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

kikuyu: To Juda nodwoke niya, “Abiro oroni nyadiel magolo e kwethna.” To Tamar nomedo penje niya, “Ibiro singona angʼo kapok ioro nyadiendno?”
english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

kikuyu: Koro pinje manie dho nam tetni e odiechiengʼ mar podho mari; kendo chula manie nam luoro omako nikech podho mari.’
english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka non kama lit manie dende, kendo ka yier mantiere kama litno oselokore rachar kendo kama litno nenore ni odonjo ei ringʼo ahinya, to kare en tuo malandore mar del. Ka jadolo onone, to enolande ni ogak.
english: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

kikuyu: Weruru gimor ni Jehova Nyasaye, un joma kare; en gima owinjore mondo joma kare opake.
english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane obedo ruoth, kendo norito piny kuom higni piero ariyo gochiko, kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Abija nyar Zekaria.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.

kikuyu: Miyeuru sand kod ywagruok mangʼeny marom gi duongʼ kod dhialruok mar ngima moyombore mane odakie kendo mane omiyore owuon. Ne osungore kowacho e chunye niya, ‘Abedo kaka ruoth ma dhako, ok an dhako ma chwore otho kendo ok ane gima dimi aywag ngangʼ.’
english: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

kikuyu: E kinde mane gichano chiemb odhiambo, noyudo Jachien oseketo paro marach e chuny Judas Iskariot, ma wuod Simon, mondo ondhog Yesu.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

kikuyu: Paulo nodwoke niya, “An ja-Yahudi monywol Tarso, e piny Kilikia. Kuom mano, ok aa e dala moro matin minyalo chayo. Kiyie, to miya thuolo awuo gi jogi.”
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Le moro amora ma ombongʼne ok obarore duto kata ma ok nyam kambula nobednu gima kwero, kendo ngʼato angʼata momulo ring-gino nobed mogak.
english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Joote mane oidho farese maka ruoth noringo matek kadhi kaluwore gi chik mane ruoth ogolo. Milomeno bende nogo e ohinga mar Susa.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo ineno ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼ wadu to pilni maduongʼ mar yath manie wangʼi iwuon to ok idew?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye kedi gi joma kedo koda; ked gi joma lawa.
english: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

kikuyu: Ne nitiere ngʼama ne ni kende; ne oonge wuowi kata owadgi. Ne otiyo matek ma ok oywe, to kata kamano ne oneno ni mwandune tin. Nopenjo niya, “En ngʼa ma atiyone matek kendo angʼo omiyo atwonora mor?” Ma bende onge tiende, ohala maonge mor!
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

kikuyu: Mad bidhruok gi ngima moriere rita nikech genona ni kuomi.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Mama, angʼo momiyo idwaro mondo atim ma to sana pok ochopo?”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

kikuyu: Nyaka ubed maler e nyima nikech an Jehova Nyasaye aler, kendo asewalou e kind ogendini mondo ubed joga awuon.
english: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Satan nowuok oa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo nogoyo Ayub gi buche maremo malit, kochakore e tiende nyaka e wiye.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

kikuyu: Eka abiro puonjo joketho yoreni kendo joricho biro lokore duogo iri.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni gimoro amora ma Nyasaye timo osiko manyaka chiengʼ, onge gima inyalo mede kata inyalo gol kuome. Nyasaye timo kamano mondo omi ji oluore.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

kikuyu: Ne giywaye mi gigole oko mar dala maduongʼ kendo gichako chiele gi kite. Joneno mag miriambo nohangone wach moketo lepgi e tiend wuowi moro ma nyinge Saulo.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

kikuyu: ma Nyasaye nokel e kinde mochano owuon; Nyasaye mipako, ma en wuon Loch makende, kendo ma en Jaloch mar joloch kendo Ruoth mar ruodhi;
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

kikuyu: punde alufu piero auchiel gachiel (61,000),
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

kikuyu: Yorene gin yore mag mor kendo yorene duto gin mag kwe.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

kikuyu: Jo-Nefilim ma gin joma robede miwuoro ne nitie e piny e ndalogo kendo kod ndalo maluwe, e kindeno ma yawuot Nyasaye kod nyi dhano nonywomore monywolo nyithindo. Nyithindogo ne thuondi kendo joma ne nigi huma e ndalogo.
english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

kikuyu: Wuoda, chik iti malongʼo ne riekona, mondo iwinj maber puonj mago mopondo,
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

kikuyu: ma gin jo-Babulon, gi jo-Kaldea, chwo duto moa Pekod gi Shoa kod Koa, kaachiel gi jo-Asuria duto kodgi; yawuowi maber neno, ma giduto gin jotelo, jotend jolweny, gi joriemb farese, kod jotelo madongo, ka giduto giidho farese.
english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

kikuyu: mi oketo kido kuomwa manyiso ni wan joge bende oseketo Roho mare e chunywa kaka singo mar gima biro.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nodhi ire, kane Arauna ogoyo wangʼe monene, nowuok kar dino mokulore auma nyaka e lowo e nyim Daudi.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Salamis, ne giyalo Wach Nyasaye e sinagoke mag jo-Yahudi. Johana ne ni kodgi kaka jakonygi.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

kikuyu: Kane Jeroboam wuod Nebat nowinjo wachni (ne en Misri kuma noringo odhiye koa kuom Ruoth Solomon), noduogo koa Misri.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Bende wakwayou, jowetewa, mondo usiem joma budho abudha, kendo mondo ujiw joma luor, kendo ukony joma yomyom. Horeuru mos gi ji duto.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

kikuyu: nikech nopuonjo ka ngʼat man-gi teko, to ok ka jopuonjgi mapile mag chik.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

kikuyu: “Yaye lowo, kik iyie iyik remba; mad ywak ma aywakgo kik rum!
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

kikuyu: To nopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo idwaro dhi ire kawuono, to pok ochopo Sawo mar Dwe Manyien kata Sabato?” En to nodwoke niya, “Onge rach moro.”
english: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”

kikuyu: Oganda maduongʼ moa Galili gi gwengʼ mar Dekapoli gi Jerusalem gi Judea kod gwengʼ man loka Jordan ne oluwe.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

kikuyu: To ne ok oyudi ngʼato angʼata e polo kata e piny mane nyalo elo kitabuno, kata mane nyalo rango iye.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: Jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nongʼado ka gimanore gi gige lweny e nyim jo-Israel, mana kaka Musa nosechikogi.
english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.

kikuyu: Hezekia norwako joote mi onyisogi gik moko duto mane nitiere utege mag keno kaka fedha, dhahabu, gik mangʼwe ngʼar kod modhi ma nengogi tek kaachiel gi kar kenone mar gige lweny duto kod gik moko duto mane yudore kuom mwandune. Onge gimoro amora mane odongʼ e ode kata e pinye mane ok onyisogi.
english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ Yesu ne puonjo e hekalu, kendo odhiambo kodhiambo nodhi monindo e Got miluongo ni Zeituni gotieno.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osekelo nindo matut kuomu, oseumo wengeu (un jonabi); kendo oseumo wiyeu (un jokor wach).
english: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

kikuyu: Nimar dhano nyalo tiyo tije gi rieko, gi ngʼeyo kod lony mar tich, to bangʼe nyaka owe gik moko duto ma en godo ne ngʼato nono mane ok otiyo tijego. Ma bende onge tiende kendo en hawi marach miwuoro.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

kikuyu: Koro josol osuru gi joricho nochokore machiegni mondo giwinje.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

kikuyu: To ne gionge gi nyithindo, nikech Elizabeth ne migumba, kendo ji ariyogo ne hikgi oseniangʼ.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

kikuyu: Omiyo negisudo mabor gi hembe mag Kora, Dathan kod Abiram. Dathan kod Abiram nosewuok oko kendo negichungo gi mondegi, nyithindgi kod rowere mag-gi e dhoranga hembegi.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

kikuyu: “Aol gi ngima; mano emomiyo ok abi lingʼ ma ok awuoyo, to abiro wacho lit duto manie chunya.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro chiwo piny ni joga Israel kendo abiro gurogi mondo gibed gi pinygi giwegi mondo kik chandgi kendo. Jomahundu ok nochak osandgi kendo kaka negitimonegi mokwongo,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

kikuyu: “To koro jo-Amon gi jo-Moab kod jo-Got Seir mane ok iyiene jo-Israel mondo omonj pinygi kane gia Misri; kuom mano ne giweyogi ma ok gitiekogi.
english: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;

kikuyu: “Onge kido magalagala moyud kuom Jakobo, kata tim moro marach moyud kuom Israel. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi ni kodgi; teko mar Ruoth ni kodgi.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo asekwayo mondo ubi awuoye kodu matin. En mana nikech geno mar jo-Israel emomiyo otweya gi nyororo.”
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

kikuyu: Giwer ka gigoyo oyieke gi asili; kendo gimiel ka gigoyo orutu.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

kikuyu: Negidwoko niya, “Jotichni oa e piny mabor ahinya nikech humb Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi. Wasewinjo humb gik mane otimo Misri,
english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of the LORD your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

kikuyu: mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa. Kuom mano ma e kaka Musa nokwanogi e Thim mar Sinai.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: ler mar fweny ne joma ok jo-Yahudi, to mar duongʼ ni jogi Israel.”
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

kikuyu: Chi wuod Juda ma Tamar nonywolone Perez kod Zera. Yawuot Juda duto ne gin yawuowi abich.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

kikuyu: Bangʼe wangʼ imno duto ewi kendo mar misango. En misango miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, ma en misango motim ni Jehova Nyasaye gi mach.
english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane Musa osedoko ngʼat maduongʼ, chiengʼ moro nodhi ir owetene ma jo-Israel kendo noneno kaka negitiyo tich matek. Noneno achiel kuom jo-Hibrania wetene, ka igoyo kod ja-Misri.
english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

kikuyu: Nikech kata e kinde mane wan kodu ne wamiyou chik niya, “Ka ngʼato budho abudha ma ok odwar tiyo to kik ochiem.”
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

kikuyu: Jehu nowacho niya, “Timuru chokruok maduongʼ mar Baal.” Omiyo negilando wachno.
english: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

kikuyu: Pok odeko ka Theuda nyocha osieko ka, kowacho ni en ngʼat moro malich, kendo kar ji mia angʼwen noluwe. Ne onege, kendo jolupne ne oke, mi wachno orumo kamano.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

kikuyu: Ubiro dino cham nyaka chop kinde muponoe mzabibu kendo ubiro pono mzabibu nyaka chop kinde muchwoyoe bende ubiro bedo gi chiemo moromou kendo ubiro dak gi kwe e pinyu.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Omiyo nitiere geno kuom ndaloni mabiro. Nyithindu nodwogi e pinygi giwegi.
english: There is hope for your latter end,” says the LORD. “Your children will come again to their own territory.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo ngʼato kik wuondu.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Bende ne gipogone chwo mahikgi adek kadhi nyime mane nying-gi ondiki e nonro margi mar anywola, jogo duto mane nyalo donjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo gitim tijegi mapile mopogore opogore kaluwore gi tich manomigi kaachiel gi migepegi.
english: in addition to those who were listed by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into the LORD’s house, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;

kikuyu: Min-gi ok osebedo ja-ratiro kendo osemako ich gi anjawo. Owacho ni, ‘Abiro luwo bangʼ joherana, mamiya chiemba kod piga, yie rombe gi pamba michweyogo lewni, mo kod math.’
english: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywol Yesu e dala mar Bethlehem e piny Judea, e ndalo loch Ruoth Herode, Joma Riek moko moa yo wuok chiengʼ nobiro Jerusalem,
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: Parie kaka ngimana rumo piyo. Neye kaka ne ichweyo dhano duto kayiem!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

kikuyu: Kornelio nodwoke niya, “Ndalo angʼwen mosekalo ne oyudo alamo Nyasaye e oda kar sa ochiko odhiambo. To napo ka ngʼat moro morwako lewni marieny ochungʼ buta mowachona niya,
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

kikuyu: To bangʼe jo-Israel biro duogo ka gidwaro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi gi Daudi ruodhgi. Ginibi ka gitetni e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo e gwethne e ndalo mogik.
english: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.

kikuyu: Anywola mar jo-Lawi, kata kamano, ne ok okwan gi joma moko.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

kikuyu: Losuru gik machal gi buche kod machal gi oyieyo maketho pinyu, kendo miuru Nyasach jo-Israel duongʼ. Dipo ka ongʼwononu moweyo sandou kaachiel gi nyisecheu gi pinyu.
english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

kikuyu: Masiche oola; mi duongʼna osekadho ka yamo, kendo kwe ma an-go osekadho ka boche polo.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

kikuyu: “Hazor nobed thim mar ondiegi, kama ojwangʼ nyaka chiengʼ. Onge ngʼama nodag kanyo; onge ngʼama nodag e iye.”
english: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mane otimo ei hekalu mar Nyasaye kaluwore gi bura kod chike, notimo komanyo Nyasache gi chunye duto. Omiyo nogwedhe.
english: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

kikuyu: E kinde ma Babulon nomaki piny noyiengni; ywakne nowinjre e dier pinje.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.

kikuyu: Unyalo wacho e chunyu niya, “Tekona kod lucha kod tich lweta ema omiyo ayudo mwandugi.”
english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

kikuyu: Ne ok iolo mo e wiya, to oseolo mo mangʼwe ngʼar e tiendena.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar auchiel, ngʼato ka ngʼato nochoko morome nyadiriyo, bangʼe to jotend dhoudi nobiro mokelo ne Musa wachni.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Gilead e magi: koa kuom Iezer, joka Iezer; koa kuom Helek, joka Helek;
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyamin mamau nikech en bende en mamau.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

kikuyu: Kik ingʼi kongʼo kochiek mowalo, ka obabni e kikombe, ka omadhore mos kolor piny!
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼ timbeni mamonogo duto, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, yaye, yaye in ngʼama okwongʼ! Kaachiel gi kethogi mamoko duto,
english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord GOD—

kikuyu: Mwandu mar jomoko e ohinga mochiel motegno ma gigengʼorego, to dhier e kethruok mar jochan.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ochiwo misango kuom gogo mar lupo kendo owangʼo ubani ne obadho mar chiko rech, nikech gogo mare miyo odak e ngima maber kendo ochamo chiemo moyier maber.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

kikuyu: To jodolo madongo gi jodongo mag oganda nojiwo oganda mondo Barabas ema gikwa ogonynegi to Yesu to mondo onegi.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

kikuyu: To negiwachone niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ruodha wacho gigo? Jotichgi bor gi tim ma kamano!
english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

kikuyu: Joma ok jo-Yahudi duto nochokre e nyime, kendo enopog ji, kopogo ngʼato ka ngʼato gi wadgi, mana kaka jakwath pogo rombe kogolo e dier diek.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Wan pok wayudo baruwa moro amora moa Judea ma wuoyo kuomi, kendo kata mana owete manyocha oa kuno machiegni pok okelonwa wach moro, kata wacho pok giwachonwa gimoro misetimo marach.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

kikuyu: Kane Hiram owinjo ote Solomon ne omor ahinya mine owacho niya, “Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye kawuono nikech osemiyo Daudi wuowi mariek mondo olochi kuom oganda maduongʼni.”
english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

kikuyu: Tim nyasini e kinde moketne, ma en kinde mag odhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dweni, kaluwore gi chikene kod buchene duto.”
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa Asher kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Imna, joka Imna; koa kuom Ishvi, joka Ishvi; koa kuom Beria, joka Beria;
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

kikuyu: Kik ucham makati, kata makati mowangʼ kata cham manyien ma pod numu, kapok ochopo chiengʼ ma uchiwone Nyasachu michni. Kendo mae en chik momakou kaachiel gi nyikwau nyaka chiengʼ kamoro amora manudagie.
english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: To mirima nomako Nyasaye ahinya kane odhi, kendo malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼ e yo mondo ogengʼne. Balaam noidho pundane, kendo jotijene ariyo bende ne ni kode.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane obirone Jeremia koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye e higa mar apar mar Zedekia ruodh Juda, ma ne en higa mar apar gaboro mar Nebukadneza.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kush ne gin: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Rama kod Sabteka. Yawuot Rama ne gin: Sheba kod Dedan.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Yaye od Israel, donge anyalo timonu kaka jachwe agulni timo? Kaka lowo manie lwet jachwe agulni, e kaka un bende e lweta, yaye od Israel.
english: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says the LORD. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

kikuyu: Chiwo mar cham michiwo kaachiel gi im nyaka rom debe achiel, to chiwo mar cham michiwo kaachiel gi nyirombe to ngʼato nyalo chiwo kaka osengʼado e chunye, kaachiel gi kube achiel mar mo kuom debe ka debe.
english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ngʼato ka ngʼato onego odag ngimano mane Ruoth oluonge kendo owuoth wuodhno mane Nyasaye oluongee. Ma e chik ma aseketo ne kanisa.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Negidhi mondo giked gi jo-Benjamin chiengʼ mar adek kendo negiriedo jolwenjgi Gibea mana kaka negisetimo mokwongo.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

kikuyu: Ne wakawo pinygi mi wamiyo jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood jo-Manase kaka girkeni.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nooro joote ir ruodh jo-Edom, kawacho niya, ‘Miya thuolo mondo wakal e pinyu,’ to ruodh Edom ne ok nyal winjogi. Nochako ooro joote ir ruodh Moab, to en bende nodagi. Kuom mano jo-Israel nodak Kadesh.
english: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

kikuyu: Muche chalo gi oula mopongʼ, mopongʼ nyaka dwonde. Oyiengo ogendini gi rapiedhi mar kethruok; kendo oywayo ji gi chuma mamiyo girwenyo.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nogolo chik ni Benaya wuod Jehoyada, mi nowuok modhi mogoyo Shimei monege. Pinyruoth koro nogurore e lwet Solomon.
english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

kikuyu: Kendo nokadho e nyim Musa kohulo niya, Jehova Nyasaye, Jehova Nyasaye, ma jangʼwono kendo ma kecho ji, ahora mos bende agundho gihera kod adiera,
english: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mipuonjo Kristo nyaka pogne japuonjne gik moko duto mabeyo.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ok wanyal timo kamano kapok jokwath duto ochokore ma wangʼielo kidi manie dho soko oko mondo jamni omodhi.”
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isewinjo ayany mag-gi, kaachiel gi timbe mamono ma gichano timona,
english: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,

kikuyu: Ok unuchame mana kuom ndalo achiel kende, kata ndalo ariyo, kata ndalo abich, kata apar kata piero ariyo,
english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

kikuyu: Ma e baruwa machalo gi baruwa mane giorone. Ne Ruoth Artaksases. Koa kuom jotichgi modak loka Yufrate.
english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River.

kikuyu: Otieno moro Ruoth Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Paulo e yor fweny kawachone niya, “Kik iluor. Dhi adhiya nyime gi wuoyo ma ok ilingʼ.
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata mosedhi e polo makmana Jal mane olor oa e polo, ma en Wuod Dhano.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo, jodolo nyaka pwodh kendo mar misango mondo obed maler; kendo kamano e kaka giniwale.
english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

kikuyu: An e Jal Mangima; ne atho, to koro angima nyaka chiengʼ! An-gi rayaw mar tho kod mar piny joma otho.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

kikuyu: Okinyi kokinyi abiro tieko joma timbegi richo modak e piny. Abiro nego ngʼato angʼata matimo richo ka agologi e dala mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane opimo borne gi lachne? Ero iwacho ni ingʼeyo! En ngʼa mane orieyo tol kane ipime?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

kikuyu: Notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nikech nowuotho e yore mag wuon-gi gi min-gi kendo e yore mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat mane omiyo Israel otimo richo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Kane jochiendego nowuok oa ei ngʼatno, negidhiyo gidonjo ei angurogo, kendo kweth angurogo noringo matek koluwo aridiridi mochomo nam mi giduto ne githo ei pi.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

kikuyu: Omiyo Saulo nokawo ji alufu adek; ji moyier kowuok e Israel duto, eka noikore mowuok kodhi dwaro Daudi gi joge but Rogo ma Nyakech pondoe.
english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

kikuyu: Dirise noketi adek adek modhi malo momanyore moro gi moro.
english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

kikuyu: Horuok mos nyalo loko chuny ruoth, to lep mamuol nyalo toyo chogo.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho niya, “Achiegni kelo kum kuom Amon ma nyasach Thebes, kuom Farao, kuom Misri gi nyisechene kod ruodhi mage, kod jogo mogeno kuom Farao.
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.

kikuyu: Eka Nebukadneza nosudo machiegni gi mach makaknino kendo nokok matek niya, “Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego, ma jotich Nyasaye Mamalo Mogik, wuoguru oko! Biuru ka!” Omiyo Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego nowuok e mach kabiro ire,
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!” Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out of the middle of the fire.

kikuyu: nyikwa Adin, ji mia angʼwen gi piero abich gangʼwen (454),
english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

kikuyu: Mi Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ gi mwanduni kichiwone cham mabeyo ma ikayo e puotheni;
english: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

kikuyu: Kane owuok oko, to ne ok onyal wuoyo kodgi. Negingʼeyo ni noseneno fweny ei hekalu, nimar nosiko konyisogi gik moko gi lwete to ne ok onyal wuoyo.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

kikuyu: Omiyo chunya nochako hum nono kuom tije duto mane asenyagorago e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nochungʼ e nyim chokruok mane ni ei Areopago mochako wuoyo kowacho niya, “Un jo-Athene, ayudo ni un joma ohero lemo e ngimau duto.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

kikuyu: “Chakre chiengʼ ma misengini mitimo pile nokethie, nyaka chop chiengʼ ma gima kwero makelo kethruok nochungie, nokaw higni adek gi nus kata odiechienge alufu achiel mia ariyo gi piero ochiko (1,290).
english: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

kikuyu: koa kuom Jashub, joka Jashub; koa kuom Shimron, joka Shimron.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Winjuru wachni, un ji duto: chikuru itu, un duto mudak e pinyni,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

kikuyu: Eka Asa noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache kowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, onge ngʼato moro machalo kodi manyalo konyo joma nyap kuom joma roteke makmana in. Yie ikonywa nikech wageno kuomi yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kendo wabiro rado gi jolweny mangʼenygi nikech Nyingi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye in Nyasachwa kik iwe dhano adhana loyi.”
english: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

kikuyu: Kane divai orumo, min Yesu nowachone niya, “Divai mane jogi nigo oserumo.”
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

kikuyu: kendo gimako mon kod ji duto mane ni kanyo, jomatindo kod jomadongo ma giteroe twech. To ne ok ginego ngʼato kuomgi, to ne gikawogi ma gidhi kodgi.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nogou gi tuo mag buche mag Misri, akuodi, gwonyo kod kalanga ma ok thiedhi.
english: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro man-gi dhoho nobiro mogoyo chonge piny e nyim Yesu kosaye niya, “Kiyie to inyalo pwodha.”
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Nikech kata mana Wuod Dhano ne ok obiro mondo ji otine, to nobiro mondo otine ji kendo mondo ochiw ngimane obed gima iwarogo ji mangʼeny.”
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Neuru! Jehova Nyasaye biro kowuok e kar dakne; olor piny kendo onyono kuonde ma otingʼore mag piny.
english: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

kikuyu: Kik uyie mondo ngʼato angʼata omak pachu gi riekni manono mag piny gi wuond manono ma wito ji, ma gin rieko ma aa kuom puonj dhano gi timbe mag piny, to ok kuom Kristo.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel modongʼ ok notim gima rach, ok giniriambi, bende miriambo ok nowuog e dhogi. Gibiro chiemo kendo nindo maonge ngʼama nomi gibed maluor.”
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

kikuyu: E chakruok mar loch Zedekia wuod Josia ruodh Juda, wachni nobiro ne Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Jonathan nowachone niya, “Mano ok nyal timore! Ka dine angʼeyo kata mana matin ni wuora dwaro timoni marach, donge danyisi?”
english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

kikuyu: Nimar ka kuom adier, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ka kuom adier to wasiki duto biro lal nono; joricho duto ibiro ke mel.
english: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar auchiel, e dwe mar auchiel ne en Ira wuod Ikesh ja-Tekoi. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Abiro penjou penjo achiel. Dwokauru, to abiro nyisou teko ma atimogo gigi.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Yawuoti noreti kaduogo iri kendo jogo manoyako gigi noringi kaduogo iri.
english: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.

kikuyu: Omiyo Manoa nopenje niya, “Ka wechegi ochopo kare, to chike mage mabiro rito ngima kod tich wuowini?”
english: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”

kikuyu: nyikwa Bigvai, ji alufu ariyo gi piero abich gauchiel (2,056),
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

kikuyu: Kapo ni ne aneno ngʼato angʼata ka koyo nego, kata ka jachan moro onge gi law,
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

kikuyu: Tem ane ikaw gik moko duto ma en-go ka ok dokwongʼi e wangʼi?”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Gin joma ok tim gimoro amora marach, to gisiko ka giwuotho e yorene.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Ji ne pod rito gi geno ahinya kendo giduto ne giwuoro ka giparo e chunjegi ni nyalo bedo ni Johana e Kristo.
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro nowachone Yesu niya, “Minu gi oweteni ochungʼ oko gidwaro wuoyo kodi.”
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

kikuyu: “Ayie ni un joma lich kendo angʼeyo ni ka utho to rieko bende nyalo tho kodu!
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

kikuyu: kagiwacho niya, “Hul ane, yaye Kristo. En ngʼa mogoyi?”
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

kikuyu: Joka Zera: Jeul. Jo-Juda ne gin ji mia auchiel gi piero ochiko (690).
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

kikuyu: Kendo neginyiso ruoth niya, “Nathan janabi ni ka.” Kuom mano nodhi e nyim ruoth mi okulore piny auma.
english: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: un to ok un kamano. Kar timo kamano to ngʼato angʼata madwaro bedo maduongʼ e dieru nyaka bedi jatichu,
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: en ema olochonwa e chandruok duto mamakowa, mondo wabed gi nyalo mar hoyo joma moko manie chandruok, ka wahoyogi gi hoch ma Nyasaye osehoyowago wan wawegi.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

kikuyu: Oganda joka Benjamin kaka ochan-gi e nonro mar anywolagi kwan-gi ne romo ji mia ochiko gi piero abich gauchiel (956). Jogi duto ne gin jotend anywolagi.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Nanga kata pien moro amora ma koth nyodono dilwarie nyaka luok gi pi, kendo nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: tiendene olawore e lwendni, kendo kere e dier kama otimo kite.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kikuyu: kokwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi, ne romo ji alufu ariyo mia auchiel gi piero adek (2,630).
english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Borne gi lachne nyaka bed maromre ma gin nus mita moro ka moro, to borne madhi malo nyaka bed mita achiel, kendo tungene nyaka bed gimoro achiel kode.
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Mana kaka un ma kinde moko ne ok uluoro Nyasaye, to koro osekechu nikech tamruok yie margi,
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

kikuyu: Dine obedo maber ka otwene pongʼ e ngʼute, mi onyumego e nam moloyo komiyo achiel kuom jomatindogi timo richo.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

kikuyu: Gin e joma Nyasaye oseyiero mondo onyis ogendini mwandu gi duongʼ man kuom wach mane opandino, en Kristo modak e chunyu kendo ma en e geno mar duongʼ.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

kikuyu: Koa kuom dhano achiel, nochweyo ogendini duto mag ji, mondo gipongʼ piny duto, kendo en ema oketo ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kar romb higni monego odag-go e piny, kod kuonde monego gidagie.
english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

kikuyu: Notimo misango kochiwo wuode mondo owangʼ e mach, kotimo timbe mag ajuoke gi nyakalondo, kopenjo jomeny wach kod chunje jo-mirieri, notimo timbe maricho e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye momiye ich wangʼ.
english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

kikuyu: To ka ukaru kendo ukidhoru kendu mana ka ondiegi, to tangʼuru, nono to ubiro tiekoru.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

kikuyu: Gik manyiso ni ngʼato jaote mar adier, magin ranyisi gi honni kod gik madongo dongo miwuoro, ne atimo e dieru ka ahora mos ahinya.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi ranyisi mane otimo kod honni mane onyiso e dier jo-Misri, ne Farao ruodh Misri kod pinye duto.
english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

kikuyu: nikech koro usebilo Ruoth mi uyudo ni ober.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

kikuyu: Kane pod en gichien, noneno yadh ngʼowu moro ma ite odhukno mi odhi machiegni kode mondo oyudie olemo kuome ocham. Kane ochopo but yadhno ne ok oyudo gimoro kuome makmana ite kende, nikech ne ok en kinde ma ngʼowu chiekie.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

kikuyu: Joma kare neno kendo gidoko mamor; To joma timbegi richo dhogi moko.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

kikuyu: “Joma moko duto ma gin, jodolo, jo-Lawi, jorit dhorangeye, jower, jotij hekalu, to gi jogo duto mane owalore koa kuom jogo mokiewo kodgi nikech Chik mar Nyasaye, kaachiel gi mondegi kod yawuotgi kod nyigi duto manyalo winjo tiend chike,
english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—

kikuyu: To kihondko ne ogoyogi magiwacho niya, “Ka ruodhi pinje ariyo ne ok nyal sire, wan to bende dwasire?”
english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

kikuyu: Emomiyo iseyie mondo igwedh od jatichni mondo osik e nyimi nyaka chiengʼ nikech isegwedhe kendo inigwedhe nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni asepakora moloyo teko ma Ruoth osemiyowa mar gerou mondo udongi moloyo thirou, to wiya ok nokuodi e wachno.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

kikuyu: To ka koro usengʼeyo Nyasaye, kata kawacho e yo machielo maber moloyo ka koro Nyasaye osengʼeyou, to ere kaka uchako udok e timbe machon mag piny, mayom yom kendo maonge teko? Udwaro ni timbegi ochak oketu wasumbini kendo?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

kikuyu: To yawuot Shimei ne gin: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush kod Beria. Magi ema ne yawuot Shimei, giduto ne gin ji angʼwen.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

kikuyu: nyikwa Adonikam, ji mia auchiel gi piero auchiel gauchiel (666),
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.

kikuyu: Shimei ja-Rama to ne orito puothe mzabibu. Zabdi ja-Shifmi to norito olemb mzabibu e kar loso divai.
english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

kikuyu: Ewi rachungino ne nitie gima olworore, ma tutne ne ok oromo kata mana nus fut. Rachungi gi bepe nomako siro koago malo.
english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

kikuyu: To ruoth noketho winjruok ma notimo kode kooro joote Misri mondo oom farese kod jolweny mangʼeny. To bende onyalo loyo lweny adier? Bende ngʼama timo gik ma kamago nyalo tony adier? Bende doketh winjruok mi otony?
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

kikuyu: Kendo enoyangʼ nyarwath e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, eka yawuot Harun ma bende gin jodolo nokel remo, kendo ginikir remo molworo kendo mar misango kendo mochomore gi dho Hemb Romo.
english: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: To owete kowuok e anywola, kaka ondikgi e chenro mar nywolgi ema: Jeyel ne jatelo, Zekaria,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

kikuyu: Jasigu wuondore koumore kod dhoge, to ei chunye okano miriambo.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

kikuyu: Nobiro kaka janeno mondo otim nend lerno, mondo kanyalore to ji duto oyie kuom lerno.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

kikuyu: to ochalo gi ler mar okinyi ka chiengʼ wuok, okinyi maonge boche polo, machalo gi ler polo bangʼ chue koth mamiyo lum loth.
english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’

kikuyu: Kaka weche bedo mathoth, e kaka gibedo maonge tiendgi. To ere kaka mano miyo ngʼato ohala?
english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

kikuyu: Bangʼe ngʼato ka ngʼato ma ja-Israel, dhako kata dichwo nomiyo makati achiel, gi ringʼo mayom kod olembe motwo mongʼin.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

kikuyu: mondo ji duto manie piny ongʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye e Nyasaye kendo ni onge moro.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok orwako puonjnani, to en bende ok norwake.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

kikuyu: Kane ne en Misri, Hadad nowinjo ni Daudi noyweyo gi kwerene kendo ni Joab jatend jolweny bende nosetho. Eka Hadad nowachone Farao niya, “We adhi mondo adogi e pinywa.”
english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama ne nyalo pogo dwol mar goyo koko mar ilo gi dwol mar ywak, nikech ji nogoyo koko matek, kendo dwolno nowinj gi kuma bor.
english: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi kanyakla mar Israel duto kendo inyisgi ni: ‘Beduru maler nikech an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu aler.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.

kikuyu: Gik ma wangʼi neno noloki neko.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

kikuyu: Negidoko mogak nikech gik mane gitimo; negibedo joma odwanyore, nikech timbegigo.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

kikuyu: Ne osiepna Theofilo: E kitapa mokwongo ne andikoe gik moko duto mane Yesu otimo kendo opuonjo,
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

kikuyu: To Josef nowacho niya, “Abor gi timo gima kamano! Mana ngʼatno mane oyudi gi kikombena ema biro bet misumbana. Ji modongʼ duto doguru ir wuonu gi kwe.”
english: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

kikuyu: Kendo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Dala maduongʼni nyaka chiwne jolweny mar ruodh Babulon ma nokawe.’ ”
english: The LORD says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’”

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chike mogik mar Daudi, jo-Lawi nokwan kochakore jo-higni piero ariyo kata moloyo kanyo.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jaricho ohero mana miero, jaote makwiny ema ibiro orone.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

kikuyu: Ka ahero to abiro kumogi; ogendini nonywaknegi, maketgi e twech kuom richogi duto.
english: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.

kikuyu: Chwo mondik nying-gi malogo ne jotelo mar anywolagi. Anywolagi nomedore ahinya
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

kikuyu: Negidok ir Balaam mi giwachone kama: “Ma e gima Balak wuod Zipor wacho: Kik iwe gimoro amora tami biro ira,
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

kikuyu: Kuom higni ariyo, Paulo nodak e ode owuon mochulo, kendo norwako ji duto mane obiro ire mondo onene.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

kikuyu: Ber pondo kuom Jehova Nyasaye moloyo geno kuom dhano.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

kikuyu: Notho Kiriath Arba (ma tiende ni Hebron) e piny Kanaan, kendo Ibrahim noywago Sara kendo nodengo ahinya.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

kikuyu: Gideon nodwoko niya, “Ka koro ayudo ngʼwono e nyim wangʼi, to miya ranyisi ni in ema iwuoyo koda.
english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

kikuyu: Kik uchiw fuonde ringreu mondo obed gima itimogo richo, to chiwreuru ni Nyasaye kaka joma osegol e tho moter e ngima; kendo chiwneuru fuonde mag ringreu mondo obed gik mitimogo timbe makare.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

kikuyu: weruru mamit ne Jehova Nyasaye kugoyo nyatiti; werneuru mamit kugoyo nyatiti gi dwond wer molungi,
english: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: Ok ir ogendini mathoth ma dhogi ikia kata ma dhogi winjo tek, ma ok inyal winjo tiend weche ma giwacho. Chutho gin ka dine aori irgi to dine giwinji.
english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo manok, ruoth Agripa kod Bernike nobiro Kaisaria mondo omos Festo.
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Dhiyo kendo inyis chwo ma Juda kod jo-Jerusalem ni, ‘Donge unyalo puonjoru kuom ma mi urit wechena?’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Baruwa mane okawo koterone ruodh Israel nondik kama: “Gi baruwani aoro jatichna Naaman iri mondo ichange kuom dhoho man kuome.”
english: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, wachne od joka ruoth mar od Juda ni, ‘Winj wach Jehova Nyasaye;
english: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear the LORD’s word:

kikuyu: Goluru thowi machon-no oko e dieru mondo ubed maler chutho, eka unubed ka mogo modwal manyien ma ok oketie thowi, nimar kamano e kaka uchalo. Kristo, ma en nyarombowa mar Pasaka, osetimgo misango.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachona: Mana kaka sibuor ngʼur konyono chiayo mosemako piny, kendo kata obedo ni jokwath duto oyworo ka goyo koko, to ok odew bende ok oluor, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, biro biro mondo oked ewi got Sayun.
english: For the LORD says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nowuok kaachiel gi ji duto kaluwo bangʼe, negidhi ma gichungʼ matin kamoro mochwalore.
english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

kikuyu: To onge ngʼama bangʼ madho divai machon dwaro divai manyien, nimar giwacho ni, ‘Divai machon ber moloyo.’ ”
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

kikuyu: ka siro ka siro ochungʼ momanyore gi nyawadgi. Negiloso sirni duto mag Hemb Romo machalre kamano.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobednegi okumba. Ginilo lweny mi ginyon kite mag orujre piny. Ginigo koko ka joma ometho momer kendo ginineg ji ma rembgi chwer, mana ka remb misango miolo e tunge kendo mar misango.
english: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

kikuyu: “To giduto machalre negichako wacho weche ma ginyisogo wuon nyasi gimomiyo ok ginyal biro. Ngʼat mokwongo nowacho ni, ‘Koro eka asengʼiewo puodho moro, to nyaka adhi mondo anene. Yie ingʼwon-na.’
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: Andrea mowadgi Simon Petro ne en achiel kuom ji ariyo mane owinjo gima Johana nowacho mi noluwo bangʼ Yesu.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

kikuyu: Diendno notingʼ kuome owuon richo mar jo-Israel nyaka kar kende kendo ngʼatno nyaka gony diendno kosechopo e thim kuno.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nodwoko jo-Juda duto niya, “Wan dhoudi apar e loch Daudi, to ewi mano, wan gi ratiro maduongʼ kuom Daudi moloyou. Koro angʼo momiyo ujarowa kamano? Donge wan ema ne wakwongo paro wach mar duogo ruodhwa?” To kata kamano jo-Juda nobedo mager moloyo jo-Israel.
english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owuok oko e dho wath, ngʼat moro man-gi jochiende moa e dalano noromo kode, kuom kinde mangʼeny ngʼatni ne pok orwako law kata dak ei ot, to nodak e dier liete.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

kikuyu: Kane Zimri oneno ni dalano osekaw, nodhi kama tek mar dala ruoth, nomoko dalano mach molwore. Mine otho,
english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

kikuyu: Mirimba nosik kuom pinyni kendo ok norum nikech gisejwangʼa ka giwangʼo ubani ne nyiseche manono kendo ka gimiya mirima kuom lamo nyiseche mopa gi lwedo.’
english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, yaye wuod dhano, kor wach kendo ikor wach kuomgi mak iweyo.”
english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

kikuyu: Kendo Jakobo notimo kamano. Notieko jumb kend mar Lea. Eka Laban nomiye Rael nyare mondo obed chiege.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: Eka Musa gi Harun nochoko jodong jo-Israel duto kanyakla,
english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kwongʼ-gi duto nobi kuomu. Kwongʼ-gi nolaw bangʼu mijuku manyaka urum uduto, nikech ne ok uwinjo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kata rito chikene kod buchene duto mane omiyou.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano negiwinjo dwol maduongʼ koa e polo kawachonegi niya, “Biuru malo ka!” Mine gidhi e polo malo ei bor polo moumogi, ka wasikgi nenogi.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho niya, “Kimham biro ngʼado koda nyaka loka. Kendo abiro timo ne gimoro amora mihero. Bende abiro timoni gima chunyi diher mondo atimni.”
english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

kikuyu: Beduru mamor pile kuom Ruoth, kendo amedo jiwou ni beduru mamor!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

kikuyu: Ne ok gipenjo ni, ‘Ere Jehova Nyasaye, mane ogolowa Misri, kendo otelonwa e thim ma ok nyag gimoro, ka wakalo piny motwo kod piny motimo bugni, piny ongoro kod mudho, piny maonge ngʼama wuothoe, kendo onge ngʼama odakie?’
english: They didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Isebedo ngʼama wiye tek moloyo ogendini moluori kendo pok iluwo yorena kata rito chikena. Kata mana chike mag ogendini molwori otamoi rito.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

kikuyu: Koro anami iywe gi kwereni kendo noiki gi kwe. Ok inine masiche mabiro kelone pinyni gi joma odakie.’ ” Omiyo negidwoko wach ne ruoth.
english: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.

kikuyu: Masira biro maki, mi ok ningʼe kaka digole kuomi. Adier kwongʼ nogore kuomi ma ok initieki gi misango, ee chandruok maduongʼ ma ok inyal neno sani biro choponi.
english: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.

kikuyu: To kuom joma ne odongʼ e dala maduongʼno, nomako jatelo mane ochungʼ ne jolweny kod ji abich ma jongʼad rieko ne ruoth. Bende nomako jagoro mane tichne en ndiko nying joma onego bed jolweny kod jodonge piero auchiel mane oyudi e dala maduongʼno.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi notho gi wuonene kendo noyike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.

kikuyu: Dwaruru ber, to ok rach, mondo ubed mangima, eka Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Nyasaye Maratego nobed kodu mana kaka uparono.
english: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

kikuyu: Dhako moro mane chwore otho ma chworeno ne en achiel kuom kanyakla mag jonabi notero ywakne ne Elisha niya, “Jatichni ma en chwora otho kendo ingʼeyo ni ne oluoro Jehova Nyasaye. To koro sani, jabendho mane en-gi gope dwaro kawo yawuota ariyo mondo obed wasumbini mage.”
english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

kikuyu: Bende, ka ji ariyo onindo kanyakla, to gibiro yudo liet. To ere kaka ngʼato nyalo yudo liet ka en kende?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

kikuyu: To ka ok ochiwone gik moko adekgi, to dhakono, ni thuolo mar dhi, maonge chudo moro amora mar pesa.
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

kikuyu: Saulo ne ok owacho gimoro chiengʼno, nikech noparo e chunye niya, “Nyaka bed ni Daudi osetimo gimoro marach, omiyo ok oler adiera emomiyo ok obiro e nyasi.”
english: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”

kikuyu: gi tigo miliero e it gi bangli mag lwetgi kod kitamba miliero e ngʼut,
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

kikuyu: Wasika wuoyo kuoma ka chunygi rach koda, kagiwacho niya, “Obiro tho karangʼo mondo nyinge olal chuth?”
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

kikuyu: Adier, kuodi marwa en mar Jehova Nyasaye, ruodhwa en mar Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Jotij hekalu nodak e got mar Ofel, to Ziha kod Gishpa ema ne joritgi.
english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

kikuyu: “Joma okia Nyasaye chunygi opongʼ gi mirima ma kata ka okumgi to ok giywagre mondo oresgi.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

kikuyu: Nimar weche duto ma nondiki e ndalo machon, nondiki mondo opuonjwa, mondo kwachungʼ motegno kendo ka wajiwore gi Ndiko, to wanyalo bedo gi geno.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

kikuyu: To koro, dhiyo mondo itelne ji kiterogi kama ne awacho kendo malaikana biro telo nyimu. To kata kamano, ka kindena mar kum ochopo to anakumgi nikech richogi.”
english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

kikuyu: To kane nyathino odwoko lwete iye, owadgi machielo nowuok mi owacho niya, “Kama e kaka ithinyori oko!” Omiyo nochake ni Perez.
english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

kikuyu: “Ka Ruoth dine ok ongʼado ndalogo machiek, onge ngʼama dine otony; to nikech joma oyier, joge owuon ma osewalo, osengʼado ndalogo odoko machiek.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ipenja kuom gima ber? Nitie mana Ngʼat achiel kende maber. Ka idwaro donjo e ngima to rit chike.”
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Kik iluor. Saulo wuora ok bi timi gimoro. Ibiro bedo ruodh Israel, to an abiro bedo jalupni. Kata Saulo wuora ongʼeyo mano.”
english: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

kikuyu: “Nyaka gigol buru oko e kendo mar misango mar mula bangʼe gipedh suka maralik e wiye.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

kikuyu: Ok en gima ber kumo ngʼat maonge ketho kata goyo joote nikech dimbruokgi.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

kikuyu: mopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mubiro miya ka achiwe e lwetu?” Omiyo ne gikwanone pesa mamingli mag fedha piero adek.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo ne jo-Israel jares, mi gitony gia e loch jo-Aram. Eka jo-Israel nochako odok modak e miechgi mana kaka ne gisebetie mokwongo.
english: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako oywak ne Jehova Nyasaye mi nomiyogi jakony, Ehud, wuod Gera ja-Benjamin, mane racham. Jo-Israel noore gi chudo ir Eglon ruodh Moab.
english: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

kikuyu: Luoro gi obadho ritowa kendo kethruok gi masira ochomowa.”
english: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

kikuyu: to dine aterone ywakna, kendo anyise gik mopongʼo chunya,
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowuoyo gi jo-Israel, kendo jotendgi nomiye odunga apar gariyo, ka moro ka moro en mar dhoutgi, kendo odunga mar Harun ne achiel kuomgi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

kikuyu: Ne wadonjo ei yie moro moa Adramutio mane onego ogow e mier mamoko manie dho nam molworo piny Asia. Bangʼe ne wasiayo yie mi wawuok. Aristarko ja-Makedonia moa Thesalonika bende ne nikodwa.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

kikuyu: Jotelo kod thuondi madongo kaachiel gi yawuot Ruoth Daudi nochiwore moyie bedo e bwo loch Ruoth Solomon.
english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

kikuyu: Neye kaka dala maduongʼ ma yande oluoro Nyasaye koro oselokore ochot! Kinde moko ne en kama adiera odakie, tim makare ne yudore, to tinde jonek ema opongʼe.
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.

kikuyu: Obiro chiwo ruodhi mag ogendinigo e lwetu kendo unutiek nyingegi e bwo polo. Onge ngʼama nochungʼ masiru kendo unutiekgi duto.
english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

kikuyu: To Israel Jehova Nyasaye noresi gi warruok manyaka chiengʼ; wiwu ok nokuodi bende ok nochau nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

kikuyu: Lew ngʼat makare en fedha mowal, to chuny ngʼat marach nigi ohala matin.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ngima! Lwandana mondo ogwedhi. Kendo Nyasaye mar Warruokna mondo otingʼ malo!
english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
