kikuyu: Ka jo-Israel moko ne pod ok obiro koa ir Jakobo, Petro ne thoro chiemo gi joma ok jo-Yahudi. To kane gichopo, Petro nongʼwony mi opogore gi joma ok jo-Yahudi nikech ne oluorogi.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

kikuyu: Jowetena mageno, winjuru wachni malongʼo ni: Ji duto onego bed mapiyo e winjo wach, kik urikni e wuoyo kendo kik ubed joma igi wangʼ piyo,
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

kikuyu: Ooro wachne kendo pego leny nono; ee, otugo yembene mi pego lokre pi mamol.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

kikuyu: Kata mwanda manie puodho jwangʼo nyathine nikech onge lum.
english: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni okelo kuyo, to obiro nyiso ngʼwono, nikech herane ma ok rum duongʼ ahinya,
english: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro punde mag Kish wuon Saulo nolal kendo Kish nowachone wuode ma Saulo niya, “Kaw achiel kuom jotich mondo udhigo udwar punde.”
english: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”

kikuyu: Mad gichal gi mihudhi ma yamo tero, ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye riembogi mabor;
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

kikuyu: En bende nonywolo Shaf mane wuon Madmana to Sheva nonywolo Makbena kod Gibea. Nyar Kaleb niluongo ni Aksa.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

kikuyu: “Paruru chik mar jatichna Musa, buchena gi chikena mane amiye e got mar Horeb ne jo-Israel duto.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

kikuyu: Neye kaka wasiki piem kodi gi koko maduongʼ. Neye kaka joma kedo kodi ngʼanyoni.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

kikuyu: Nikech kaponi Ibrahim noket kare kuom tijene, to dine obedo gi gima onyalo pakorego, to ok e nyim Nyasaye.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Ngʼat ma sungore mondo osungre kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Joma ne kadho kanyo nojare ka giyanye ka gikino wiyegi,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Yesu nowacho ne jopuonjrene niya, “Wadhiuru loka nam komachielo.” Omiyo negidonjo ei yie kendo giwuok gidhi.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

kikuyu: “Uparo ni aywagora ne dhano? En angʼo ma dimi abed mos?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Ogendini mopogore opogore mathoth kod ji modak e mier madongo bende nobi,
english: The LORD of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

kikuyu: E kindeno Amrafel ruodh Shinar, Ariok ruodh Elasar, Kedorlaomer ruodh Elam kod Tidal ruodh Goyim
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

kikuyu: Emomiyo aywak kadengo kuom Moab, nimar kuom Moab duto aywak, aywago jo-Kir Hareseth.
english: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, odiechieng yweyo mar Sabato pod nitie ne jo-Nyasaye;
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

kikuyu: Wachnegi, ‘Winj wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ruodhi mag Juda kod jo-Juda duto gi ngʼato angʼata modak e Jerusalem madonjo gie rangeyegi.
english: Tell them, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

kikuyu: Kane achiel kuom jogo noneno ma, nonyiso Joab niya, “Aneno Abisalom koliero e bad yiend ober.”
english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

kikuyu: kendo gininegi joma odak e miechi gi ligangla ma ok ni e chula. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’

kikuyu: “To Nyasaye nowachone ni, ‘In ngʼat mofuwoni! Kawuono gotienoni wangʼ nokaw ngimani. En ngʼa mabiro kawo mago miseloso ne in iwuon?’
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

kikuyu: Ka uchwoyo, to ok en cham hie mabiro wuok bangʼe, to en mana kodhi kende. Onyalo bedo koth ngano kata koth cham moro amora.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

kikuyu: Pasia apar gachielgo duto nyaka romre ka bor moro ka moro romo fut piero angʼwen gabich to lachgi romo fut auchiel.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: joma piem gi Jehova Nyasaye ibiro tur matindo tindo. Obiro mornegi gie polo; kendo Jehova Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ne tunge piny. “Obiro miyo ruodhe teko kendo obiro miyo teko mar ngʼate mowir onenre.”
english: Those who strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “The LORD will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”

kikuyu: “En to ochungʼ kar kende, koso en ngʼa madipiem kode? Otimo gima en owuon ema ohero.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

kikuyu: Ne irieyo badi ma korachwich ma piny omwonyogi.
english: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

kikuyu: E kor udi ma yo ka iye gi yo ka oko mar kama ler mar lemo kadhi malo nyaka kuonde duto ma iye molworo kama ler mar lemo,
english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Isetimo angʼoni? Winji! Remb owadu ywakna koa e lowo.
english: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

kikuyu: bangʼe enoornu Yesu Kristo, Jal mane owalnu.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

kikuyu: To kapo ni ok giyie gi ranyisi ariyogo kata winjo wachni, to kaw pi mar aora Nael, kendo iole e lowo motwo. Pi migolo e aorano biro lokore remo e lowo motwo.”
english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

kikuyu: To Jachien, mane owuondogi ne owit e ataro mar mach maliel mager, kama ondiek malichno kod janabi mar miriambo nowitie. Kanyo gini sandre odiechiengʼ gi otieno nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kinyne, oganda maduongʼ mane oyudo obiro e Sawo nowinjo ni Yesu ni e yo biro Jerusalem.
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Eka jarit od twech noterogi e ode momiyogi chiemo. Joodno duto nopongʼ gi mor, nikech koro ne giseyie kuom Nyasaye.
english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

kikuyu: Usechwoyo mangʼeny, to ukayo mana matin; uchiemo, to gima uchamo ok nyal yiengʼou, umetho, to ok romu; urwakoru gi lewni, to onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomu mayudo liet; to nyaka un joma nwangʼo chudo, bangʼ ka unwangʼo chudo to uketo mana ei ofuku motuch.”
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

kikuyu: koa kuom Jezer, joka Jezer; koa kuom Shilem, joka Shilem.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

kikuyu: Kochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar laruno lachne ne romo fut piero ochiko gaboro kendo ne en gi pasia mongʼaw e sirni apar morwakie rachungi apar kaachiel gi ramaki molos gi fedha kod rangʼaw miriwogo sirnigo.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Bor siro ka siro ne en fut apar gabich, to lachne ne en fut ariyo gi nus;
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

kikuyu: Ne aa ka Wuoro mi adonjo e piny, to sani koro aweyo piny kendo adok ir Wuoro.”
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

kikuyu: Un nyi Jerusalem, asiemou ni kik utug hera kata chiewe ka sa ne pok oromo.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Benjamin noromo ji alufu piero adek gabich gi mia angʼwen (35,400).
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: To ka itemo ngʼato to kik owach niya, “Nyasaye tema.” Nikech Nyasaye ok nyal tem gi gik maricho, to en owuon bende ok otem ji
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

kikuyu: To Musa kod Harun nopodho auma moywak niya, “Yaye Nyasaye, mongʼeyo chunje duto mag dhano, iyi diwangʼ gi kanyakla mar ogandagi duto ka en mana ngʼato achiel ema otimo richo?”
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Efraim; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero adek mia abich. Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Josef kaluwore gi anywola mag-gi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

kikuyu: Kuom mano mach nomuoch e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mowangʼogi kendo ne githo mana kanyo.
english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nopenjo jatich Farao mane ni kode e od twechgo niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo uol kawuono?”
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

kikuyu: chwo piero aboro mane olielo tikgi mapoth, manoyiecho lepgi kendo mongʼado dendgi nobiro koa Shekem, Shilo kod Samaria, ka gikelo chiwo mar cham gi ubani e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Omiyo wasumbinige nowachone niya, “Yie iwe wadwar nyako matin ma pod ok oriwore gi dichwo mondo orit ruoth kendo otine, bende onyalo nindo e bath Ruoth mondo ruodhwa obed maliet.”
english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

kikuyu: Ahulo kethona; richona chando chunya.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

kikuyu: Kom duongʼno ne nigi raidhi mag kuonde minyono auchiel kendo yo kangʼeye ne nigi wich molworore. Bethene ariyo ne nigi bede miyienge bat, ka kido mar sibuor molosi ochungʼ e bath moro ka moro.
english: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

kikuyu: Wachni nobirona gotieno e yor lek, e sa ma nindo goye ji ngoga,
english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

kikuyu: Ne alamo Ruoth nyadidek kuom wachni, ka asaye mondo ogolna kudhono;
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

kikuyu: Ewi tat udi duto man Moab kendo e laru mar galamoro onge gimoro makmana ywak, nimar aseketho Moab ka agulu motore maonge ngʼama dwaro,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi kama, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ochiko, ‘Kiny en odiechieng yweyo, ma en Sabato maler mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye. Teduru mago mudwaro tedo kendo bokuru mago mudwaro boko, to modongʼ to ukan nyaka kiny.’ ”
english: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

kikuyu: mier matindo duto mantiere e pewe kod kuonde duto mag Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, ma bende norito Heshbon. Musa noseloyo Sihon ruodh jo-Amor kaachiel gi Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur gi Reba mane jodong jo-Midian. Jodongogo nodak e pinyno ka gin e bwo loch Sihon.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel wacho: ‘Ngʼato ka ngʼato okaw liganglane. Wuothuru ei kambi duto koni gi koni ka ngʼato ka ngʼato nego owadgi, osiepne kod ngʼat modak bute.’ ”
english: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi malaika mine odwoko liganglane e olalo mare.
english: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

kikuyu: Eka Musa ne oidho got Nebo koa e pap mar Moab nyaka ewi Pisga ka ongʼado Jeriko. Kanyo ema Jehova Nyasaye nonyise piny Kanaan duto, chakre Gilead nyaka Dan,
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

kikuyu: Kaka nyinyo piago nyinyo, e kaka ngʼato piago nyawadgi.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

kikuyu: Obiro dwoko lamo mar ngʼama ok nyal kendo ok obi chayo lamogi.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

kikuyu: Jonadab nowachone niya, “Dhiyo inind e kitanda ka iwuondri ni ituo. Ka wuonu obiro neni, to wachne ni, ‘Daher mondo nyamera ma Tamar obi omiya gimoro acham. Yie mondo obi otedna chiemo kaneno mondo mi anene kaka otedo; kendo acham chiemo kotingʼo e lwete.’ ”
english: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye e chakruok mar rieko, to ngʼeyo Jal Maler miyo ngʼato ngʼeyo tiend wach.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

kikuyu: nikech angʼeyou maber ni uonge gihera mar Nyasaye e chunyu.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

kikuyu: Ibiro chiwgi ne ligangla kendo gibiro doko chiemb ondiegi.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

kikuyu: Dichwo nyaka chop dwach chiege kaka joma okendore, kendo dhako bende nyaka tim kamano ni chwore.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

kikuyu: kendo kik upa kidi milamo nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mon kodgi.
english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.

kikuyu: Kik jadir asere rid atungʼ mare, kata kik orwak okumba mare. Kik ingʼwon-ne joge matindo; tiek jolweny mage duto.
english: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!

kikuyu: Joka Manase mane odok ir Daudi koa ir Saulo mane odhi Ziklag ne gin: Adna, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu kod Zilethai mane jotend jolweny alufu achiel (1,000) kuom joka Manase moro ka moro.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Yawuot Onam ne gin: Shamai kod Jada. Yawuot Shamai ne gin: Nadab kod Abishur.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

kikuyu: Solomon noweyo gigi duto ma ok opimo nikech negingʼeny ahinya, pek mar mulano ne ok ongʼere.
english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

kikuyu: Puonj ji wechegi bende, mondo kik ngʼato obed gi bura.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

kikuyu: Nochwoyo chunya gi aserene mowuodho e olalo mare.
english: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

kikuyu: Nikech uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kurito chikene duto ma amiyi kawuono kendo ka utimo gik makare e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: when you listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

kikuyu: Jeremia noketi e od twech manie bwo ot, kama ne obetie kuom kinde marabora.
english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,

kikuyu: “Chik jo-Israel mondo gimi jo-Lawi mier ma gibiro dakie kuom pok ma jo-Israel biro yudo. Kendo umigi lege mag kwath molworo miergo.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ka dine bed ni un muofni, to dine ok ubedo joketho nikech richo; to nikech uketoru ni uneno, koro kethou osiko.”
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

kikuyu: Mad joma wachona niya, “Haa! Haa!” Dog kuma giaye ka wichkuot omakogi.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Negiwachone ruoth Nebukadneza niya, “Yaye ruoth, dag nyaka chiengʼ!
english: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, live for ever!

kikuyu: Joricho osewiti kendo gilal nono, to od ngʼat makare osiko ogurore motegno.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

kikuyu: Enoluoki jamb-ich gi tiendene gi pi, kendo jadolo nowangʼ-gi duto ewi kendo mar misango. En misango miwangʼo pep, madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Penuel nonywolo Gedor kod Ezer ma wuon Husha. Magi ne nyikwa Hur, mane en wuod Efratha makayo mane wuon Bethlehem.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Kik iyie mondo joma timbegi richo oyud gik ma chunygi gombo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kik iyie mondo chenrogi otimre. Sela
english: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

kikuyu: Beth Peor, pewe mag Pisga, kod Beth Jeshimoth,
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

kikuyu: Simon Petro nopenje niya, “Ruoth, idhi kanye?” Yesu nodwoke niya, “Kuma adhiye ok inyal luwae sani, to ibiro luwa kuno bangʼe.”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ngʼato achiel ema otimo richo ka ok ongʼeyo, to nyaka ochiw diel madhako ma ja-higa achiel kaka misango mar golo richo.
english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Anawuoth e dieru mi nabed Nyasachu, kendo unubed joga.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

kikuyu: Kane pod gidhi negiloso kambi but Kiriath Jearim manie piny Juda. Mano ema omiyo piny mantiere yo podho chiengʼ mar Kiriath Jearim pod iluongo ni Mahane Dan nyaka chil kawuono.
english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jo-Shekem noketo ji ewi gode mondo omonje kendo omaa ngʼato angʼata mane okalo machiegni, kendo wachni noterne Abimelek.
english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

kikuyu: To ka dine bed ni uyie kuom Musa, to An bende dine uyie kuoma, nimar nondiko kuoma.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

kikuyu: “ ‘Abiro miyo nyinga maler ngʼere e dier joga ma jo-Israel. Ok abi yie kendo mondo nyinga maler odwany, bende ogendini biro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye An Ngʼama Ler mar Israel.
english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

kikuyu: Noresogi e lwet joma ne kedo kodgi, adier, nowarogi e lwet wasigu.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Kane Petro oduongʼo dhoot ma oko, to nyako moro ma jatich miluongo ni Roda nobiro mondo oyawne.
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

kikuyu: Joma nokawo loch bangʼ Jehoyakim ne gin yawuote miluongo ni: Jehoyakin kod Zedekia.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

kikuyu: Ubiro siko kumonjo ngʼat achielni nyaka karangʼo? Angʼo momiyo uduto unywakone mondo ugoye piny? En ngʼat machalo mana gi chiel mayiengni madwaro mukore.
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

kikuyu: To en, kaka en ngʼama kecho ji, noweyonegi kethogi, kendo ne ok otiekogi. Kinde ka kinde nogengʼo mirimbe kendo ne ok otoyo mirimbe duto kuomgi.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

kikuyu: Tingʼuru lodiu malo, yaye un dhorangeye; tingʼ-giuru malo, un dhorangeye machon, mondo Ruodh duongʼ odonji.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Dhako makare kendo man-gi lony mamalo e dieru, ngʼat modimbore kendo man-gi ngʼwono malach ma bende ok osewuotho e lowo gi tiende nono, nobed ka iye kwar kod chwore owuon kata mana gi yawuote kod nyige ma en owuon ema onywolo.
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

kikuyu: nooronegi janabi, mane owachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Nagolou e piny Misri, kuma ne unie wasumbini.
english: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Ne aluori, nikech in ngʼat makoch. In ikawo gino mane ok ikano, kendo ikayo mano mane ok ichwoyo.’
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

kikuyu: Ka ja-Israel wadu moro obedo modhier e dieru, to nyaka ukonye mana kaka ukonyo jadak kata wendo molimou kuma udakie kuom ndalo machwok mondo omi osik kodak kodu.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Akwongʼora ni ogendini molworou noyud wichkuot.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano wi cham moko abiriyo motho kendo ma yamb oro otwoyo nowuok ewi tiangʼno.
english: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

kikuyu: Ne ogurogi kuondegi nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ kaluwore gi chikne mochwere.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: Mefibosheth nowachone ruoth niya, “Makoro ruodha ma en ruoth osedwogo dala ma ok ohinyore, weye okaw gigo duto.”
english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie kech maduongʼ e piny; bangʼ kech mokwongo mane obedo e ndalo Ibrahim kendo Isaka nodhi Gerar ir Abimelek ruodh jo-Filistia.
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

kikuyu: ma gin joma ne kargi olal nono kapok ndalogi ochopo kendo ma mise margi ne ohula oywero modhigo?
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone jotich niya, “Pongʼuru degnigi gi pi”; mine gipongʼogi thich.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osingore niya, “Adier, notimre mana kaka asechano kendo nobedi mana kaka aseparo.
english: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

kikuyu: Chokreuru ne lweny, un ogendini, ka luoro omakou! Chikuru itu un ji duto manie pinje maboyo! Bende ikreuru ne lweny ka luoro omakou! Bende ikreuru ne lweny ka luoro omakou!
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

kikuyu: Kuomi ema aseponde, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kik iwe ayud wichkuot.
english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Omiyo githo ka kapod gitindo ka ngima marach otieko tekregi.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

kikuyu: mondo mi wan mane wakwongo geno kuom Kristo, wadag ngima mamiyo ipako duongʼne maler.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat kwe ni kanyo to kwe maru nobed kuome; to ka ok kamano, to kweuno noduognu.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

kikuyu: Ka owacho ni, ‘Mano ber,’ eka anabed gi adieri ni jatichni nigi kwe. To ka mirima omake, to ibiro bedo gi adiera ni oseketo chunye ni nyaka to onega.
english: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.

kikuyu: To mana ka dhako ma ok ja-ratiro ne chwore, omiyo usebedo maonge gadieri kuoma, yaye od Israel,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ osepodho kendo piny oyuso, tago mar mach madum iro kod chuk mach maliel nothinyore mi okadho e kind lemo mag gik manoyangʼ ka.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

kikuyu: Nikech wan bende oseyalnwa Injili mana kaka gin bende noyalnegi, to kata kamano wach mane giwinjo ne ok okelonegi konyruok, nikech ne ok girwake kuom yie.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono kod kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ka diyude kuom jatichni moro amora, to obiro tho; kendo joma odongʼ biro bedo wasumb ruodha.”
english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

kikuyu: Donge gin ema gijaro Nying moluor mar Jal muyie kuome?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi nodhi kwangʼ e nam gi meli; ne gin jo-ohala ma yoro nembe madongo dongo.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

kikuyu: ka uparo kaka wuonwa nokedonu, kochiwo ngimane mondo oresu e lwet jo-Midian;
english: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

kikuyu: Kendo e kindeno tungʼ maduongʼ noywagi. Jogo mane olal e piny Asuria nobi kendo joma ni e twech e piny Misri nochopi ma lam Jehova Nyasaye e gode maler man Jerusalem.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Osekonyo jatichne Israel, koparo bedo mangʼwon,
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nochulo Arauna pesa mag dhahabu ma dirom kilo abiriyo mane nengo kar dinono.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo apar, eka Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo Nabal mi notho.
english: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, so that he died.

kikuyu: Nam nonenogi mi oa gi ngʼwech, kendo Jordan ne odar oweyonigi piny,
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

kikuyu: En ngʼa machalo gi ngʼama nigi rieko matut? En ngʼa mongʼeyo wacho tiend gik moko? Rieko miyo ngʼato bedo mamor kendo otieko ich wangʼ ma en-go.
english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

kikuyu: Nikech nosebedo ka itweyo lwetene gi tiendene to nyoroche mane itweyego nochodo achoda mi ongʼiny matindo tindo chumbe mane iridogo tiendene. Koro ne onge ngʼato ma tekre ngʼeny mane nyalo make.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

kikuyu: Ne en gi mon ariyo ma moro ne nyinge Hana to machielo nyinge Penina. Penina ne nigi nyithindo to Hana ne ongego.
english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoke niya, “Wabiro dhi gi jowa duto jomatindo kuom jomadongo gi yawuotwa gi nyiwa kaachiel gi jambwa kod dhowa duto, nimar nyaka watim nyasi ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to the LORD.”

kikuyu: Unyalo wacho e kindu uwegi niya, “Ere kaka wanyalo ngʼeyo ni wach mowachno oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?”

kikuyu: Atingʼo bada malo kawacho niya, Akwongʼora ni kapod angima,
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

kikuyu: Wuod ruoth kende ema oyiene mar bet piny gi ei rangach mondo ochiem e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. To nyaka odonji koluwo bwo gama mar kar donjo kendo kanyo ema ochak oluw kodok.”
english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

kikuyu: Gibiro negi gi nek marach mi giboli e bur matut, kendo ibiro tho tho marach, e chuny nam.
english: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.

kikuyu: Bende nogoyo deche mikane cham mokaa gi divai molos manyien kod mo kendo nogero kunde ne dhok mopogore opogore kod abila mag rombe.
english: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

kikuyu: Masira mar ariyo osekadho, neuru, masirano mar adek biro biro piyo.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

kikuyu: Jadolo nowangʼ bochego e kendo mar misango, makmana ni agoko to nodongʼ ni Harun gi yawuote.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

kikuyu: Ka ruoth thoro chiko ite ne miriambo, to jootene duto bedo joma timbegi richo.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

kikuyu: “Timbegi omonogi duogo ir Nyasachgi. Tim marach mar chode ni e chunygi; ok giyie kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.

kikuyu: Abimelek kod kanyakla mane ni kode noreto kochiko kamoro e dhoranga dala maduongʼ. Eka migepe ariyo noreto odhi ir ji duto mane ni e pewe mine ginegogi duto.
english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

kikuyu: Usungoru niya, “Wasetimo singruok gi tho wasedonjo e winjruok gi liete omiyo, ka masira miwachono nolandre e piny to ok nomulwa, nimar waseketo miriambo ragengʼ-wa, kendo wuondruok ka kar pondo.”
english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

kikuyu: Anami chiembu doko manok kendo mon apar notedi e agulu achiel. Ginipimnu chiemo e rapim, kendo kata kuchiemo to onge ngʼama noyiengʼ.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

kikuyu: Onyalo dembo joma kia gi joma orwenyo, nikech en owuon bende nyawo obembe.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

kikuyu: Kristo nogonyowa mondo wabed joma ni thuolo. Omiyo chungʼuru motegno, kendo kik uyie tingʼ mapek kurwako jok mar wasumbini kendo.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

kikuyu: jogi nobed joma onge hera kendo joma ok wene ji richogi, joma ketho nying ji; joma ok ritre, jo-mahundu, kendo joma ok ohero ber,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-go nomedne mi nobed gi gik mogundho; to ngʼat ma ongego kata mano ma en-go nomaye.”
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

kikuyu: To ka joma nodonjone nochungʼ mondo owuo, ne ok gihulo gima oketho kata mahundu moro ma notimo kaka ne aparo.
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

kikuyu: Ka uneno jakuo to uriworu kode kendo uchodo mana kaka joma moko timo.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Reuben ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen gauchiel gi mia abich (46,500).
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Kane gisetieko, negikelo pesa mane odongʼ ne ruoth kod Jehoyada mi negiloso gik moko mitiyogo e lemo ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaka: gik mitiyogo e misango miwangʼo pep kaachiel gi dise to gi gik mamoko molos gi dhahabu kod fedha. Negitimo misengini miwangʼo pep mapile pile e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kinde duto ka Jehoyada pod ngima.
english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for the LORD’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in the LORD’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

kikuyu: Kane gioro ji mondo onon Bethel (machon yande iluongo ni Luz),
english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

kikuyu: Ka gineni kamano, pow kor ot kendo gol misiki midhigo e twech gi kama ipowono.
english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

kikuyu: bende nokawo nus mar jo-Gilead, gi Ashtaroth kod Edrei (ma gin mier madongo mag Og ruodh Bashan). Magi e pok mane omi nyikwa Makir wuod Manase, tiende ni nus mar dhood Makir konchiel.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

kikuyu: “Ka Farao onyisou ni mondo utim hono moro, to in Musa nyis Harun ni, ‘Kaw ludhi kendo dire piny e nyim Farao,’ kendo obiro lokore thuol.”
english: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Kuom adiera, Elija nyaka bi mondo oket gik moko duto kare.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto koa Dan nyaka Bersheba, nofwenyo ni Samuel oseromo bedo janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.

kikuyu: Dhako machielono nokwer kawacho niya, “Ooyo! Mangimani e wuoda; to mothono e mari.” To dhako mokwongono notwoyo dhoge kawacho niya, “Ooyo! Wuowi mothono e mari; to mangimano to mara.” Omiyo ne gimino wach e nyim ruoth.
english: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.

kikuyu: Ne ogolo chike ne joka Jakobo kendo noguro chik e piny Israel, chike mane omiyo kwerewa mondo opuonj nyithindgi,
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

kikuyu: Nyaparano nodwoko niya, “En nyar Moab manyocha odwogo gi Naomi koa e piny Moab.
english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

kikuyu: mar ochiko ne Jeshua, to mar apar ne Shekania,
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

kikuyu: Wer kipako duongʼ mar nyinge; mi pakne obed gi duongʼ!
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Donge in ema ne awuoyo kuomi ndalo mokalo ka atiyo gi jotichna ma jonabi mag Israel? Kindeno ne gikoro wach kuom higni mangʼeny nine abiro miyo iked kodgi.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

kikuyu: Kane gigolo oko pesa mane oseter e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, Hilkia jadolo nonwangʼo Kitap Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye mane ochiw ne Musa.
english: When they brought out the money that was brought into the LORD’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the LORD’s law given by Moses.

kikuyu: Mad joma nyiera niya, “Haa! Haa!” Ngʼengʼ ka gineno wichkuot.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it mar winjo wach mondo owinji.]”
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: kendo ka Nyasaye noreso Lut ngʼat makare, mane chunye chandore malit nikech ngima mochido mar joma ne ochayo chik
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

kikuyu: To uparo ni An ema gichwanyo? Jehova Nyasaye penjo. Donge gihinyore kendgi, kendo gikelo wichkuot ne gin giwegi?
english: Do they provoke me to anger?” says the LORD. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi ne wacho niya, “Wasingo ni ji puothewa, puothewa mag mzabibu, kod miechwa mondo wayud cham ndalo mar kech.”
english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

kikuyu: to mano nyiso ni en tuo malandore mosedak mar del kendo jadolo noland ngʼatno ni ogak. Kik okete kar kende nikech osebedo mogak.
english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

kikuyu: Chulgi kuom timbegi maricho kendo kuom tijegi maricho; chulgi kuom gik ma lwetgi osetimo kendo dwok kuomgi gik mowinjore gi timbegi.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

kikuyu: Orwakore gi teko kod dimbruok; omiyo onyalo bedo mamor e ndalo mabiro.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

kikuyu: eka nodoko dhako ma chwore otho nyaka koro ne en ja-higni piero aboro gangʼwen. Ne ok oa e hekalu to nolemo otieno gi odiechiengʼ, kotweyo chiemo kendo olamo.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

kikuyu: To ka Sap jo-Yahudi mar Kiche ne chiegni chopo,
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

kikuyu: Pile ago chonga piny e nyim Wuoro,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: tiende ni, Nyasaye notimo winjruok gi piny kuom Kristo, ka ok okwano richo ji e wigi. To wan ema osemiyowa wach manyiso ji kaka digibed e winjruok gi Nyasaye.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

kikuyu: Ka lweti kata tiendi miyo idonjo e richo to ngʼade oko kendo iwite mabor. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima ka ionge lweti kata kingʼol moloyo bedo gi lwetegi ariyo kata tiendeni ariyo to owiti e mach manyaka chiengʼ.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

kikuyu: Ooyo! Awacho ni misango ma jopiny makia Nyasaye timo, gitimo ni jochiende, to ok ni Nyasaye. To ok adwar mondo ubedi e lalruok achiel gi jochiende.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Ulwoko ngʼe kikombe gi bakul, to gi e chunygi to gipongʼ gi wuoro kod anjawo.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Kata ka gitweyo chiemo; ok anawinj ywakgi; kata bed ni gichiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mag cham, ok anarwakgi. To kata kamano ananeg-gi gi ligangla, kech kod dera.”
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”

kikuyu: Geche powore e yore mag dala, ka giringo koni gi koni e tunge mag dala. Gichalo gi rameny maliel mager, ka gipiachore ka mil polo.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

kikuyu: Ka ohinga oruombore piny, to donge ji nopenju niya, “To lowo marachar mane uwirego cha koro ere?”
english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Nikech Moab gi Seir nowacho niya, “Neye, dhood Juda koro chalre gi ogendini mamoko duto,”
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi Balaam noa malo mi owachone jotend Balak niya, “Doguru e pinyu, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osedagi weya mondo adhi kodu.”
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”

kikuyu: Dhako ma kite longʼo en osimbo mar chwore, to dhako ma timbene richo chalo gi nyamuoda manie choke.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

kikuyu: giduto negibiro e piny Juda, e Mizpa ir Gedalia, ka gia e pinje duto mane okegie. Kendo negikayo divai mathoth kod olembe mag ndalo oro.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

kikuyu: ka giterore mos kendo gidak e ngima maler bende ka girito e utegi. Nyaka gibed mon mangʼwon kendo moluoro chwogi mondo kik ngʼato angʼata yany wach Nyasaye.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Nochake ni Nowa mi owacho niya, “Wuowini biro hoyowa kuom tich kendo kuom tich malit mar lwetwa mobet nikech lowo ma Jehova Nyasaye osekwongʼo.”
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nonyiso Harun weche duto mane Jehova Nyasaye oore mondo owachi, kendo nonyise honni duto mane Jehova Nyasaye oore mondo otim.
english: Moses told Aaron all the LORD’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.

kikuyu: Nogombo mondo ocham opokla ma anguro chamo, to bende onge ngʼato mane omiye gimoro.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

kikuyu: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi ruoth moro mane oloso nyasi mar arus ne wuode.
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye odagi jogo ma chunygi opongʼ gi richo, to omor gi jogo ma yoregi ler.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

kikuyu: “Los pasia apar gachiel mag yie diek ne hema mondo oumgo Hemb Romo.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

kikuyu: “Omiyo mano e kaka abiro tieko timbe mag chode e pinyno, mondo obed siem ni mon duto kik terre kaka mon ariyogo osetimo.
english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat moro ma jatend sinagogi ma nyinge Jairo nobiro kanyo. Kane oneno Yesu nogoyo chonge piny e tiende
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

kikuyu: nywok achiel mar kaka misango mar golo richo;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: Yaye Samaria, wit oko nyasachi mar nyaroya! Mirimba ger kodgi. Nyaka karangʼo ma ok ginyal bedo maler?
english: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?

kikuyu: Los kendo mar misangono gi bao mayom, to ituch bugo e chuny sandukuno mondo iwe iye obed thuolo, kendo lose mana kaka nonyisi ewi got.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Yawuot Lawi ne gin: Gershon, Kohath kod Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Kane sa ochopo, Yesu kod jootene nobet kachiemo.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oketo ringʼo mowal ni Nyasaye e riak nangane, ma riak nanganeno ogere kuom makati, kata kuom kado, kata kuom divai, kata kuom mo, kata ei chiemo moro amora, to koro gima ogere kuomeno bende inyalo walo ni tich Nyasaye?’ ” Jodolo nodwoko niya, “Mano ok kamano.”
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Yaye tiengʼ maonge gi yie kendo mokethoreni, anabed kodu nyaka karangʼo? Abiro chandora kodu nyaka karangʼo? Kel ane wuowino ka.”
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

kikuyu: To Solomon ne ok oketo ja-Israel moro amora obedo kaka misumbane, to noketogi kaka jolwenje, gi nyipechene kod jodonge mag pinygi gi jotend lweny, jotelo mag geche lweny kod joriemb gechene.
english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni kamoro amora ma noyalie Injili e kind ogendini duto mag piny, gima dhakoni otimo bende nohul, kiparego.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Adoniram to notelo ni joma tiyo tich achuna, Jehoshafat wuod Ahilud ne jandiko;
english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne wawinjore waduto mondo wayier jomoko waor iru kod osiepewa mwageno, Barnaba gi Paulo,
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

kikuyu: To ma e yo ma Nyasaye nochopogo chenrone mane osenyiso chon gi dho jonabi duto, kowacho ni Kristo nyaka sandi.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoko jogo gi gero. Notamore tiyo gi rieko mane jodongo ongʼadone,
english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

kikuyu: Nimar aserito yore Jehova Nyasaye; ok asetimo marach kuom weyo Nyasacha.
english: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kikuyu: Yande eka ibiro ka. To koro tinendeni ere kaka diwuoth kodwa kamoro amora, to an akia kuma adhiye? Dogi mondo ikaw jothuru idhigo. Mad ngʼwono gi adieri bed kodi.”
english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, reswa ruoth! Dwokwa ka waluongi!
english: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

kikuyu: Dimna kod Nahalal, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Jaduongʼne, ma wuon nyako, nosaye mondo omed limogi; omiyo nobedo kanyo kuom ndalo adek, kochiemo kendo kometho, kendo konindo kanyo.
english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

kikuyu: Magi e joma kelo pogruok e kindu, kendo gombogi mag ringruok ema chikogi, gionge Roho.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

kikuyu: to wendo moro mobuoro iru kata jatichu ok onego chame.
english: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

kikuyu: Teko Nyasaye ne ni kodgi, omiyo ji mathoth noyie kendo olokore kuom Ruoth.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: “Kwan jo-Merari kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

kikuyu: Ka ruodhe nochiewo gokinyi kendo oyawo dhoot mondo mi owuog oko odhi nyime gi wuodhe, noyudo ka chiege onindo kanyo, kogore piny e nyim dhoot, ka lwetene oriere piny e kar dino cham.
english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

kikuyu: Negiwacho ni Kristo nyaka sandi, kendo nyaka obed ngʼama okwongo chier oa kuom joma otho, mondo okel ler ni jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi joma ok jo-Yahudi.”
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

kikuyu: Kendo orwakore gi kandho molingʼ e remo, to nyinge en Wach Nyasaye.
english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nokecho gi Uza kendo ne ochwade nikech nomako Sandug Muma omiyo notho e nyim Nyasaye.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

kikuyu: To joma richo ibiro wit tenge ka kuthe ma ok nyal chok gi lwedo.
english: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho ni, ‘Abiro ore mondo odonji e od jakuo kendo e od ngʼat makwongʼore gi miriambo gi nyinga. Kwongʼno nosik e udigo matiekgi nyaka kite mogerego duto.’ ”
english: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

kikuyu: gode nolengʼore ka imbe, to thuche to nochikore ka nyirombe.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

kikuyu: Kowinjore kata ka ok owinjore, wanaluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, ma waori ire, mondo omi obed maber kodwa, nimar wanaluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.”
english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.”

kikuyu: Kwanwa Jehova Nyasaye nimar mor polo gi pe oromowa. Abiro weyou mondo udhi, nimar onge tiende mondo umed bedo ka.”
english: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

kikuyu: Kinde osechopo, kendo odiechiengʼ osetundo. Kik jangʼiewo bed mamor kata jauso kik bed mokuyo, nikech mirimba ni kuom oganda duto.
english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

kikuyu: Kodh ajiki mag gode olwoko dendgi kendo gitwere e lwendni nikech gionge kuonde dak.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

kikuyu: To ngʼat Nyasaye nodwoko ruoth niya, “Kata ne bed mana ni inyalo miya nus mwanduni duto ok anadhi kodi kata chamo chiemo kata modho pi ka.
english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama romo gi Nyasach Jeshurun, mawuotho e kor polo e duongʼne, mondo okonyi.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi ngʼeyo konyore gi weche kotangʼ; to ngʼat man-gi winjo wach to ritore maber.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

kikuyu: Wuora, mi nyingi duongʼ!” Eka dwol moro noa e polo, kawacho niya, “Asemiye duongʼ kendo abiro chako amiye duongʼ.”
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

kikuyu: “An e jakwath maber; angʼeyo rombena kendo rombena bende ongʼeya.
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, watemuru matek kaka wanyalo mondo wadonji e yweyono, mondo kik ngʼato podhi kuom luwo ranyisi marach mar wich teko.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

kikuyu: Eka owetene kod joka wuon mare duto nodhi mondo okawe. Negikele ma gi hike e kind Zora gi Eshtaol e liend Manoa wuon mare. Notelo ne Israel kuom higni piero ariyo.
english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike but kwerene e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi kendo Jehoram wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kane gia Perga, to negimedo dhi nyaka negichopo Antiokia manie piny Pisidia. Chiengʼ Sabato negidonjo e sinagogi mi gibet piny.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

kikuyu: Kane odiechiengʼ ochopo ma Elkana chiwoe misango, ne omiyo Penina gi yawuote kod nyige lemo mar ringʼo.
english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

kikuyu: Koro Adonija wuod Hagith nodhi ir Bathsheba min Solomon. Bathsheba nopenje niya, “Ibiro gi kwe?” Eka nodwoko niya, “Ee abiro gi kwe.”
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.

kikuyu: Lut kod nyige ariyo nowuok Zoar kendo negidhi gidak e gode nikech noluor dak Zoar. En kod nyige ariyo negidak e rogo.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

kikuyu: oyud duongʼ e kanyakla mar joma oyie kendo kuom Kristo Yesu e tienge duto manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: E giko mar higa mar abiriyo gope duto nyaka we.
english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

kikuyu: eka wan wachiwre chuth ni tijwa mar lamo gi yalo Wach Nyasaye.”
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

kikuyu: Omiyo noluongo jotichne moko apar kendo ne omiyogi silingʼ alufu achiel, achiel. Nowachonegi ni, ‘Lokuru ohala gi pesagi, nyaka chop aduogi.’
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

kikuyu: Dhakono nomako ich mi nooro ni Daudi wach kowacho niya, “Ayach.”
english: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

kikuyu: to yie iwinji gie polo, kama idakie. Wenegi richogi kendo tim ne ngʼato ka ngʼato gima owinjore gi gik motimo nikech ingʼeyo chunygi (nikech in kendi ema ingʼeyo chuny dhano),
english: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jo-Israel nongʼanyona e thim. Ne ok giluwo buchena, kendo ne gidagi rito chikena. Ne ok girito chikena kata obedo ni chikego miyo gibedo mangima ok girito Sabato maga. Omiyo ne awacho ni abiro olo mirimba kuomgi kendo abiro tiekogi e thim.
english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono nowachone niya, “Yie iwe jatichni owach wach moro ni ruodhe ma en ruoth.” Nodwoke niya, “Wachi.”
english: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e ranyisi ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiyi ni obiro timo gima osesingo:
english: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken.

kikuyu: to ka en kamano, to kare Ruoth ongʼeyo kaka dores joma omiye luor kuom tembe ma giyudo kendo ongʼeyo kaka okano joma richo ni kum chiengʼ Bura, ka gidhi nyime kod kumgi.
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

kikuyu: Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye un ji duto modak e piny, landuru warruokne odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

kikuyu: nokonye e chandruok duto mane oyudo. Ne omiyo Josef rieko ma kinde gi Farao ruodh Misri obedo maber. Omiyo Farao nokete jatelo maduongʼ morito piny Misri duto, nyaka od ruoth bende.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

kikuyu: (En wuodh ndalo apar gachiel kia Horeb nyaka Kadesh Barnea kiwuok e got maluwo yo Seir.)
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: An ngʼat kwe; to ka awuoyo, to giikore ni lweny.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone ne Saulo niya, “An ema Jehova Nyasaye noora mondo awiri ibed ruodh joge Israel; omiyo koro lingʼ iwinj wach moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of the LORD’s words.

kikuyu: del mowangʼ kar del mowangʼ kendo adhola kar adhola, kendo kama ogwar kar kama ogwar.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel gi Jehoshafat ruodh Juda nodhi Ramoth Gilead.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

kikuyu: Kaka in lwandana kendo ohingana, telna kendo itaya nikech nyingi.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

kikuyu: Kane gibet gichiemo negineno oganda mar jo-Ishmael koa Gilead. Ngamia notingʼo gik mangʼwe ngʼar, gi mane-mane kod yiende moko, kendo negiterogi Misri.
english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

kikuyu: Koro, jowetena, uparo ni ka abiro iru mi awuoyonu gi dhok mayoreyore, en konyruok mane ma duyudi, ka ok akelonu fweny moro kata ngʼeyo, kata wach mihulo kata puonj?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

kikuyu: Nimar jo-Israel biro dak ndalo mangʼeny ka gionge gi ruoth kata jotelo, ka ok gitim misango maonge kido moro milamo, kata law akor mar dolo miluongo ni efod kata nyiseche manono.
english: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

kikuyu: Kidagi chiko iti ne puonj in wuoda, to ibiro bayo mabor kuom weche mag ngʼeyo.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: ka gipenjo jodolo mag od Jehova Nyasaye Maratego kod jonabi niya, “Bende owinjore aywagi kendo atwe chiemo e dwe mar abich kaka asebedo ka atimo kuom higni mangʼeny?”
english: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

kikuyu: Kik uchul richo kar richo, kata ayany kar ayany kar timo kamano to gwedhuru agwedha, nikech mano omiyo noluongou, mondo uyud gweth.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

kikuyu: Nikech watemo matek mondo watim maber, ok e wangʼ Ruoth kende, to e wangʼ dhano bende.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

kikuyu: Ruoth noluongo jo-Gibeon mowuoyo kodgi. To koro jo-Gibeon ne ok gin achiel kuom jo-Israel to ne gin jo-Amor ma notony, kendo jo-Israel nosekwongʼore ni biro weyogi ma ok onegogi, to Saulo kane dwaro gi chunye duto mondo jo-Israel gi jo-Juda ogurre motegno, notemo tiekogi.
english: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano iterne wuonu mondo ocham bangʼe ogwedhi kapok otho.”
english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

kikuyu: Kane Boaz osetieko chiemo gi metho, kendo kane chunye koro mor, nodhi kare mar nindo machiegni gi kama nochokie ngano. Ruth nodonjo kanyo mos, moelo tiende kendo onindo kanyo.
english: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.

kikuyu: Ok awuo kamano nikech adwaro mich, to gima duongʼ madwaro ni chiwo maru obednu ohala.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

kikuyu: Ndalo mane Jehu obedo gi loch e piny Israel ka en Samaria noromo higni piero ariyo gaboro.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

kikuyu: Joma chwo kod mondgi notingʼo dwondgi ka giywak matek ne owetegi ma jo-Yahudi.
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

kikuyu: Uluonga kare ni ‘Japuonj’ kendo ni ‘Ruoth,’ kendo utimo kare, nikech mano e ngʼama an.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

kikuyu: An Jehova Nyasaye, aketo wangʼa kuome; kendo amiye pi pile. Arite odiechiengʼ gotieno mondo kik ngʼato kethe.
english: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Polo hulo duongʼ mar Nyasaye; kor polo nyiso tich mar lwete.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

kikuyu: “Omiyo sani ikuru gari manyien, gi dwesni ariyo ma osenywol to pok otwe e jok. Tweuru dwesnigi e gari, nyiroye to tweuru e loch.
english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

kikuyu: Kane pod gidigni, malaika ariyogo nomako lwete gi lwet chiege kod lwet nyige ariyo ma gigologi oko mar dala maduongʼni, nikech Jehova Nyasaye nokechogi.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

kikuyu: Kata mana bangʼ ma, Jeroboam ne ok oloko yorene maricho to nomedo yiero jodolo koa kuom ji mopogore opogore mondo oti kuonde motingʼore. Ngʼato angʼata mane dwaro bedo jadolo nowalo ni kuonde motingʼore.
english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

kikuyu: Negiketo wachno e nyim Yesu mondo gigajego kendo giyud yo mane ginyalo donjonego. Yesu to nokulore piny kendo nochako ndiko e lowo gi lith lwete.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: par maber kuom ohinga mage, nee udi mag ruodhine, mondo ibi inyis tienge mabiro.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

kikuyu: Zabad ne wuon Eflal, to Eflal ne wuon Obed,
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

kikuyu: Kendo ne gipogone jodolo mane ondik nying-gi kaluwore gi ndiko mar chenro mar nonro mar anywolagi kendo jo-Lawi ma jo-higni piero ariyo kadhi nyime bende notimnigi kamano kaluwore gi tije mag-gi kod migepegi.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’ houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;

kikuyu: Kar dak mar nyisecheni ni e kind hoho motimo lwendni mapoth, kuno ema ogandau nitie. Ee, kuondego ema usechiwoe misengini miolo piny, kod misengini mag cham. Kaluwore gi gigi duto, bende anyalo weyonu?
english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?

kikuyu: Jopinyno duto nobedo gi mor kendo dala maduongʼ nobedo gi kwe, nikech Athalia nosenegi gi ligangla.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gochiko mar loch Azaria ruodh Juda, Menahem wuod Gadi nobedo ruoth Israel, kendo nobedo ruoth Samaria kuom higni apar.
english: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

kikuyu: Resruok aa mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye. Mad igweth jogi. Sela
english: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

kikuyu: nyaka chop Jehova Nyasaye mi oweteu kwe, mana kaka osemiyou kendo gin bende gikaw piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, loka mar Jordan. Bangʼ mano ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu odogi kare ma asemiye kaka girkeni.”
english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

kikuyu: Abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye e ngimana duto; abiro wero wende pak ne Nyasacha kinde duto ma angima.
english: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne onge ruoth e piny Edom, jalupne ema ne ni e loch.
english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre owinjo wachno, luoro nomakogi mi gipodho piny ka gikulo wiyegi piny.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

kikuyu: “Adier, ok obi yudo yweyo kuom gombone malach; nikech ok onyal warore owuon gi mwandu mangʼeny mokano.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

kikuyu: Asin gi joma lamo nyiseche manono ma dhano oloso; an to aketo genona kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka jonon piny ariyogi nolor oa e gode. Negingʼado aora, mi gidhi ir Joshua wuod Nun, kendo giwachone gigo duto mane otimorenigi.
english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

kikuyu: Wuod Uziel mane oyier ne en, Mika, to kuom yawuot Mika noyier Shamir.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

kikuyu: To ka oyude, oluongo osiepene gi jogwengʼ-gi kaachiel, kowacho ni, ‘Moruru koda, aseyudo pesana manolal.’
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

kikuyu: Ok abi yie ngangʼ ni un kare; ok anasiki mana ka awacho ni aonge ketho nyaka atho.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

kikuyu: “Bende ngʼama riek nyalo dwoko ji gi paro manono kata pongʼo it ji gi weche ma ok nikare?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

kikuyu: Kane giketo ndirigi mag timo misango but ndiriga mag misango kod sirnigi e bath sirniga, ma ohinga kende ema opoga kodgi, ne gidwanyo nyinga maler gi timbegi mamono. Omiyo mirima nomaka mi atiekogi.
english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ubiro tamoru rito chikena kod puonjna nyaka karangʼo?”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ka siro e rumbi, kendo rumbi nochungʼ e dhood Hema.
english: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Yahudi nokawo Yesu koa ir Kaifas motere nyaka e od ruoth Pilato. Sechego koro piny nosechako yawore, omiyo jo-Yahudi ne ok odonjo ei dala ruoth, mondo kik gibed mogak. Negidwaro ni gicham Pasaka ka giler.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuoma, kendo nonyisa kama: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, yaye dhood Israel, angʼeyo gik ma uwacho kendo gik ma uparo e chunyu.
english: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

kikuyu: An gi rombe moko ma ok ni e abich rombegi. Gin bende nyaka akelgi kendo giniwinj dwonda, eka rombe duto nobed kweth achiel man-gi jakwath achiel.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mon gi joma timo gik ma kamago; ngʼat matimo gi mibadhi.
english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ni kuom joma kare kendo ite winjo ywakgi;
english: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ok en ja-Yahudi mana kuom nenruokne ma oko kata nikech otere nyangu e ringre ma oko.
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

kikuyu: Golna achaya ma aluoro, nimar chikeni beyo.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

kikuyu: Jowetena ka uyudo tembe mayoreyore to kwanreuru ka johawi kendo beduru gi mor mar adier
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

kikuyu: Ok oyienigi kawo chudo moro kata wilo bath lopno kata matin. En e lowo maber mogik kendo ok nyal chiwe e lwedo mamoko, nikech oler kendo owale ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny nowacho niya, “Ngʼatni nigi jachien kendo ojaneko, en angʼo momiyo uchiko itu ni wechene?”
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

kikuyu: Tukiko, ma en owadwa ma wageno kendo matiyo ni Ruoth gi adiera duto biro nyisou weche duto, kaka achal to gi gima atimo.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

kikuyu: “ ‘Pile ka pile nyaka uchiw ni Jehova Nyasaye nyaim ma hike achiel maonge songa kaka misango miwangʼo pep; nyaka uchiwe okinyi kokinyi.
english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

kikuyu: Okumba mag jolweny osebedo makwar ka remo; kendo lewni ma girwakorego bende kwar. Chuma manie ewi gechegi mil ka giikore ne chiengʼ lweny; tongegi opiag mabith kendo milni ka gikedogo.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo, “koro gin e nyim kom duongʼ mar Nyasaye, ka gitiyone odiechiengʼ gi otieno ei hekalune; to Jalno mobet e kom duongʼ noumgi korieyo hema mare kuomgi.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

kikuyu: Ne owarowa koweyonwa richowa.
english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

kikuyu: kiwacho ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi in Got Seir, kendo abiro rieyo bada kuomi mi aloki gunda.
