english: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

kikuyu: Bor mar yo moa e dhorangach nyaka e laru ne romo fut piero adek.
english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Wan ok wanadwar mondo opognwa piny kodgi loka machielo mar aora Jordan nimar osepognwa lopwa yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan lokani.”
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

kikuyu: kendo riwgi milosgo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar ma en tich jalos gik mangʼwe ngʼar. Ketie chumbi mondo obed gima ler mowal.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

kikuyu: Kochakore e sechego, Pilato notemo gonyo Yesu, kata kamano jo-Yahudi nomedo kok matek kagiwacho niya, “Kiweyo ngʼatni thuolo modhi, to ok in osiep Kaisar. Ngʼato ka ngʼato ma ketore ni en ruoth, kedo gi Kaisar.”
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

kikuyu: kuom mano, yaye un gode mag Israel, winjuru gima an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni gode madongo gi matindo, kaachiel gi aore kod holni, gi kuonde modongʼ gundni, mane ogendini mokiewo gi jo-Israel oyako kendo oyiero.
english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

kikuyu: Magi e joma Jehova Nyasaye nochiko mondo opog jo-Israel girkeni e piny Kanaan.
english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Kane ngamia-go osetieko modho, ngʼatno nogolo tere mar um mar dhahabu ma pekne romo achiel kuom apar mar kilo kod bangli ariyo mag dhahabu mapekgi oromo nus kilo.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

kikuyu: “To neuru, abiro miyo udok matin e kind ogendini, bende ibiro chau ahinya.
english: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

kikuyu: To ngʼato nyalo wacho niya, “In to in-gi yie, to an to an-gi tim.” Ngʼat ma wuoyo kamano mondo onyisa ane yie ma en-go maonge tim, mondo eka anyise yie ma an-go kuom timbe ma atimo.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

kikuyu: “Koro ikreuru kendo ukadh holo mar Arnon. Neuru, asechiwo e lwetu Sihon ja-Amor ma ruodh Heshbon kod pinye. Chakuru kedo kodgi mondo ukawe.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Wasigu nogoyonu siboi kawacho niya, “Donge uwuoro! Gode machon maboyo koro osedoko mawa.” ’
english: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

kikuyu: Ka ok unyisa lek maseleko, to chandruok achiel kende ema ochomou. Usewinjoru e kindu mondo unyisa gik manyalo wita kod gik maricho, kuparo ni mano biro miyo alok pacha. Kuom mano, nyisauru leknano, eka abiro ngʼeyo ni unyalo lokona tiende.”
english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

kikuyu: Kata ka aora opongʼ moo oko, to ok bwoge; chunye ngʼich angʼicha kata ka aora Jordan opongʼ kendo mwomore marach.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

kikuyu: Mad ne kik nywola, ka ok kamano to ne onego nywola ka asetho kendo chom koda bur tir!
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

kikuyu: Jawuodha monjo osiepene; oseketho singruok mane otimo kodgi.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane ofwenyo wachni nyaka aa chakruok, mondo wangʼe wachni kata en ngʼa mane fwenye kapok otimore mondo ne wawachi ni, ‘Ne owacho adier’? Onge ngʼato mane owacho ma kata mane owuoyo kuome chon, bende onge ngʼato mane owinjo wach moro amora koa kuomi.
english: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nooro yamo maduongʼ e nam, kendo ahiti mager notugore ma yie koro ne dwaro barore.
english: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

kikuyu: Eka nochako wuoyo koyanyo Nyasaye kendo koketho nyinge kod kar dakne, kaachiel gi joma odak e polo.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

kikuyu: Kinyalo yie mondo Benjamin odhi kodwa, to wabiro dhi mondo wadhi warund cham.
english: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

kikuyu: En ngʼa mongʼeyo kaka boche polo ringo, kata kaka polo mor?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

kikuyu: Chuny ngʼat makare pimo dwokoge, to dho ngʼat ma timbene richo hulo gik maricho.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

kikuyu: Abiro boyo oganda mar Daudi nikech ma, to ok nyaka chiengʼ.’ ”
english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye mor, omor ka mil polo.
english: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

kikuyu: Nokawo kweth mag jamni kod mag dhok mi joge nosembogi e nyim kweth mag jamni mamoko kowacho niya, “Magi gin gik ma Daudi opeyo.”
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

kikuyu: Koth nochwe maduongʼ, aore nopongʼ mogingore kendo yamo nokudho matek mogoyo odno, mi norwombore piny gi ruombruok matek.”
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

kikuyu: Koro hekalu nopongʼ gi chwo kod mon; jotend jo-Filistia duto ne ni kanyo, kendo ne nitie chwo gi mon alufu adek mane ni ewi tado ka ngʼiyo Samson kamiel.
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.

kikuyu: To kata kamano Nyasaye biro wuoyo gi jogi gi dho welo kod dhok mayoreyore.
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo jadolo nyaka non adholano, kendo ka ilni ok omedore kendo onge yier maratongʼ e iye kendo ok onenre ni odhe,
english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

kikuyu: Abiro nyisou kaka ngʼat mabiro ira, mawinjo wachna kendo timo chalo.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

kikuyu: kendo kik uyie kawo chiayo machal kamano kuom jadak manie pinyu mondo uchiwe ni Nyasachu ka chiembe. Jehova Nyasaye ok bi yie kodgi nikech gin-gi songa kendo gingʼol.’ ”
english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nogolo chik mondo ochokne jorit pinje gi jochik jotich, gi jotelo, gi jongʼad rieko, gi jokeno, gi jongʼad bura, gi joyal buche kod jotelo duto mag gwenge, mondo gibi e nyasi mar pwodho kido mane osechungono.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negigolo oko kido milamo e hekalu mar Baal mi giwangʼe.
english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

kikuyu: Miyo man-gi nyithindo abiriyo nobed mool matho. To chiengʼ marienyne nopodhi kapod en odiechiengʼ; wiye nokuodi kendo chunye nochandre. Ananeg jogo motony gi ligangla, e nyim wasikgi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bende nadwaro ngʼeyo kuom tunge apar mane otwi e wiye kendo kuom tungʼ machielo mane owuok bangʼe momuko tunge adek mamokoka; tungʼno ne nigi wenge kendo weche mag sunga ne wuok e dhoge. Tungʼno ne nenore maduongʼ moloyo tunge moko.
english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes and a mouth that spoke arrogantly, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nowachone niya, “Nyaka ine ni ok idwoko wuoda kuno.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

kikuyu: Nyiego omaka kodu ma en nyiek Nyasaye. Ne asingou ni dichwo achiel kende, ma en Kristo, mondo omi achiwu kaka nyako mangili ni en.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

kikuyu: Gichomo dala maduongʼ gireto, giringo ka gilwenyo ohinga, giidho nyaka ei udi; kendo gidonjo gie dirisni mana ka jokwoge.
english: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.

kikuyu: Ne aneno kaka en bende nodwanyore; giduto kargi nyiri ariyo negiluwo yo machalre.
english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ka adwaro ni osik kongima nyaka aduogi, to mano chandi nangʼo? In to luwa!”
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

kikuyu: Mad lamona osiki e nyimi mana ka ubani miwangʼo, kendo bedena osik koriere kochomo malo mana ka misango mitimoni godhiambo.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

kikuyu: Kapo ni joma oluwo chik ema bedo jocham girkeni, to yie obedo kayiem nono, kendo singruok onge tiende,
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

kikuyu: To awachonu adier ni dhi ma adhigo biro kelonu ber. Ka ok adhi, to Jakony ok bi bironu; to ka adhi eka abiro oronugo.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

kikuyu: Lok wangʼi ochom agengʼa mar Jerusalem kendo irie badi kikoro wach kuome.
english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

kikuyu: Anakwa Wuoro, kendo obiro miyou Jakony machielo mondo obed kodu nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

kikuyu: Ginineg jambu ma pod tindo kendo giniketh chambu e puothe mi nyaka ginitieku chuth. Ok ginicham, divai manyien kata mo, kata mana nyiroye mag dhou kod nyirombe mag jambu nyaka chop gitieku chuth.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

kikuyu: Modekai ma ja-Yahudi ne en jalup ruoth Ahasuerus, noyudo duongʼ mongʼere e kind jo-Yahudi; kendo ogandane mangʼeny nohere, nikech notiyo matek mondo jo-Yahudi duto odag maber.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

kikuyu: Aa malo, ywagi otieno duto, e kindego mag arita ma otieno chakore, kendo weche duto manie chunyi ol oko ka pi e nyim Ruoth Nyasaye. Tingʼ bedeni malo kilame nikech nyithindi, ma kech nego e wangʼ yore duto.
english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Tho mar wuowi.” Zaburi mar Daudi. Abiro paki gi chunya duto, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; abiro nyiso timbegi madongo duto.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kikuyu: Kendo ne alemo kama: “Nyasacha, an-gi wichkuot malich kod kuyo ma ok anyal tingʼo wangʼa malo kangʼiyi, nikech richowa boyo moyombo wiyewa kendo kethowa osechopo e polo.
english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

kikuyu: Eka Joshua noorogi ma gidhi gipondo e kind Bethel gi Ai, ma en yo podho chiengʼ mar Ai, kendo otienono nosiko gi ji kanyo.
english: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel nokalo kanyo kotangʼ kaluwore gi wach mane ngʼat Nyasaye onyise. Kinde ka kinde Elisha ne siemo ruoth, mondo obed motangʼ ne kuondego.
english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

kikuyu: “Ka ja-Israel moro amora kata ka japiny moro modak e piny Israel opogore koda mi oketo geno kuom lamo nyiseche manono kendo oketo rachwany marach mamiyo ji podho e nyime, bangʼe to odhi ir jakor wach mondo openje wach, to an Jehova Nyasaye awuon ema nadwoke.
english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.

kikuyu: Kawuononi aluongo polo gi piny mondo obed joneno ni aseketo gik moko ariyo e nyimu ma gin ngima gi gweth, kata tho kod kwongʼ. Koro yieruru ngima mondo un kaachiel gi nyikwau udag maber
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

kikuyu: Rehoboam notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike kodgi e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Abija wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To akuru ne ok nyal yudo kama opiyoe nikech pi ne pod okwako piny duto; omiyo noduogo ir Nowa ei yie. Nowa notero lwete oko kendo ogame mine odwoge ire ei yie.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

kikuyu: Eka Sarai nowacho ne Abram niya, “In ema ikelona achayani. Ne aketo jatichna e lweti, kendo ka koro ongʼeyo ni osemako ich to ochaya mad Jehova Nyasaye bed jangʼad bura e kinda kodi.”
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”

kikuyu: Bende nyiseche manono maonge tich mar ogendini bende nyalo kelo koth? Bende boche kendgi kelo ngʼidho? Ooyo, en in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa. Emomiyo genowa ni kuomi, nimar in ema itimo magi duto.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, the LORD our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

kikuyu: Mano kaka itiekogi apoya nono, mi masiche malich lal kodgi nono!
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

kikuyu: wakwayou mondo kik uparru kendo kik chunyu chandre ni weche mokor, kata weche mokelnu, kata baruwa moro miwacho ni oa irwa, mawacho ni odiechiengʼ mar Ruoth osechopo.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

kikuyu: kendo twegi e lep akor mag law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod mondo gibed kaka kite rapar ne nyithind Israel. Harun enotingʼ kitego e goke kaka rapar e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.

kikuyu: “Angʼo ma nomone hono mo mangʼwe ngʼarno mondo pesa moyudi omi joma odhier? Onge tiende ketho mo ma nengone tek kama, moromo chulo misach ngʼat achiel kuom higa ngima.”
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

kikuyu: E dhood Kohath ne nitiere jo-Amram, jo-Izhar, jo-Hebron, jo-Uziel; magi ema ne anywola joka Kohath.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

kikuyu: Bangʼeno min Yesu gi owetene nobiro ire. Negioro ngʼato mondo oluongnegi Yesu ka gin to gidongʼ gioko.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ chier ji ok nokendi kata kendgi ngangʼ to ginichal gi malaike manie polo.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Jakobo nowinjo ni yawuot Laban ne wacho niya, “Jakobo osekawo gik ma wuonwa nigo duto kendo oseyudo mwandugi duto koa kuom wuonwa.”
english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

kikuyu: Tienge mabiro noti ne Jehova Nyasaye, kendo nonyis ogendini mabiro wachne.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

kikuyu: Yawuot Asher ne gin: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi kod Beria. Nyamin-gi ne en Sera. Yawuot Beria ne gin: Heber kod Malkiel.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato nigi mon ariyo, kendo ohero moro maloyo machielo mi giduto ginywolone yawuowi, to wuowi mokwong nywol en wuod dhako ma ok ohero,
english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Ruodh Israel kendo Jawarne wacho: Anie mokwongo kendo e mogik; onge Nyasaye moro kendo mopogore koda.
english: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel, ngʼat moro molony e chik nochungʼ mondo otem Yesu, nopenjo niya, “Japuonj, en angʼo monego atim eka ayud ngima mochwere kaka girkeni mara?”
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Ne, Ruoth Nyasaye nigi ngʼato man kod loch gi teko. Mana kaka pe kod yamo maketho piny, e kaka obiro kelo koth machwe mabubni giteko matiek gik moko duto manie lowo.
english: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

kikuyu: To ere kaka digiluong ngʼat mapok giyie kuome? Koso digiyie nadi kuom Ngʼat mapok giwinjo kuome? To giniwinj kuome nadi kaonge ngʼama oyalonigi?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

kikuyu: Yiende Jehova Nyasaye yudo pi moromogi, yiendego gin sida mag Lebanon mane opidho.
english: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

kikuyu: Kata ne bed ni nyithinde ngʼeny manade, to ligangla ema ochomogi; kendo nyithinde ok noyud chiemo moromogi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Jotend lweny mag jo-Filistia ne medo dhi e lweny, kendo kaka negimedo dhi e kaka Daudi bende ne locho moloyo jotelo mamoko mag Saulo kendo nomedo ngʼere.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye wacho niya: Jogi sudo ira mana gi weche manie dhogi kendo gipaka mana gi dhogi kende, to chunygi bor koda. Yo ma gilamago gin mana chike mipuonjo gi dhano.
english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

kikuyu: Oketho chenro mar joma paro timo timbe mamono mondo omi gik ma giparogo kik timre.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ruoth Nyasaye ok nobed mamor gi jomatindo bende ok nokech nyithi kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho, nikech ji duto opongʼ gi richo kendo timo timbe mamono bende dhogi opongʼ gi weche mochido. To Kata ka magi duto osetimore to mirimbe ok orumo kuomgi kendo pod odhi nyime mana gikumogi.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negipenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo jopuonj chik wacho ni Elija nyaka bi mokwongo?”
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: Joma notimo kwongʼruokni noloyo ji piero angʼwen.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ibrahim noreto kadhi ir Sara ei hema mowachone niya, “Kaw mogo mayom gorogoro adek, idwale kendo itedgo makati piyo piyo.”
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

kikuyu: Kane gichopo machiegni gi od Mika, ne giwinjo dwond ja-Lawi moro ma wuowi; omiyo negidonjo kanyo mi gipenje niya, “Ngʼama nokeli ka? Angʼo ma itimo ka? Angʼo ma omiyo in ka?”
english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

kikuyu: Iro mar ubani motingʼo lamo mag jomaler nodum kadhi malo e nyim Nyasaye koa e lwet malaika.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

kikuyu: Sibuoche nyalo ruto kendo sibuoche mager nyalo goyo asumbi, to kata kamano leke sibuoche maroteke osemuki.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Mano e gino mane awachonu kane pod an kodu: Gik moko mane ondiki kuoma e Chik Musa gi Jonabi kod Zaburi, nyaka timre.”
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Sena, ji alufu adek mia auchiel gi piero adek (3,630).
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Jael, ma chi Heber, nokawo sigingi mar hema kod nyundo kendo nodhi ire mapiyo kama nindo nogoye ngoga, kendo ool. Nopowo iye gi sigingino nyaka e lowo, mi otho.
english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

kikuyu: Ka hignigo ngʼeny to nyaka imed nengo, to ka higni nok, to nyaka idwok nengo piny, nikech gima ingʼiewo kuome en mana cham mibiro kayo.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

kikuyu: Kane Amazia odwogo koa nego jo-Edom nokelo nyiseche mag jo-Seir moketogi ka nyisechege kokulore nigi kendo notimonigi misango.
english: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano abiro hoye, mi adhi kode e piny motimo ongoro, kendo abiro wuoyo kode gi muolo.
english: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Gideon nosetho jo-Israel nochako timo timbe dwanyruok kalamo Baal. Negiketo Baal-Berith kaka nyasachgi,
english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

kikuyu: Eka Adoni-Zedek ruodh Jerusalem nowinjo ni Joshua osekawo Ai mi okethe chuth kendo onego ruodhe mana kaka nosetimone Jeriko kendo ni jo-Gibeon osetimo winjruok mar kwe gi jo-Israel mi gidak butgi.
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

kikuyu: Yaye, winjuru mahu mar ogendini mangʼeny, giwuo mana ka apaka mar nam! Yaye, winjuru koko mar ji, ka gimor mana ka apaka mar nam!
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

kikuyu: Ahiya, Hanan, Anan,
english: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,

kikuyu: Nobedi mar joma odongʼ mar dhood Juda; kanyo gini yudie lek ma gikwae. Godhiambo gibiro nindo e ute mag Ashkelon. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi biro ritogi kendo obiro dwokonegi gweth mane ogwedhogigo.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.

kikuyu: joma mor kuom timo maricho kendo giil e duwruok mar richo,
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

kikuyu: Kamoro amora mane Roho mar Nyasaye dhiye, gin bende negidhiye, kendo tiende bende ne aa dhi kodgi, nikech chuny gik mangima ne ni e tiendego.
english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

kikuyu: Eka Samson nomako sirni ariyo mane ni e chuny hekalu mane osiro hekalu. Kosirogi moro ka moro, ka lwedo korachwich osiro achiel to lwedo koracham e machielo,
english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.

kikuyu: Kane Jehu ngʼado bura ni dhood Ahab, nonwangʼo yawuot ruoth moa e dhood ruodhi mag Juda kaachiel gi yawuot wede Ahazia mane osebedo katiyone kendo nonegogi.
english: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.

kikuyu: Ma donge e Daudi mane giwero e miendgi niya, “ ‘Saulo osenego ji alufu to Daudi osenego ji alufe kod alufe?’ ”
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

kikuyu: kendo ne ok adhi Jerusalem mondo ane jogo mane okuongona bedo joote, to ne adhi moriere tir nyaka e piny jo-Arabu eka bangʼe naduogo Damaski.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

kikuyu: Omiyo noolo mirimbe mager mar lweny kuomgi. Ne olworogi gi mach mawengʼo to ne ok gidewe; bende majno ne owangʼogi to ne ok gidewe.
english: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”

kikuyu: kowacho kama: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, onge Nyasaye moro amora machal kodi e polo malo kata e piny mwalo, in e Nyasaye marito singruok mar herane ni jotichne maluwo yoreni gi chunygi duto.
english: and he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

kikuyu: To ji mangʼeny masani okwongo nobed chien mogik, kendo joma sani ni chien mogik, nobed mokwongo.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko nonywolo nyako kendo nochake ni Dina.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

kikuyu: to chuny ruodha ok nochandre nine ochwero remo mane ok onego chwer kata chulo kuor ne en wuon. To ka Jehova Nyasaye osemiyo ruodha loch to mondo ipar jatichni.”
english: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When the LORD has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”

kikuyu: En ngʼa mabiro kela e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno? En ngʼa mabiro telona nyaka Edom?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

kikuyu: Jal mane ochweyo gode bende ema nochweyo yamo, onyiso dhano parone, bende en ema oloko ler mar odiechiengʼ bedo mudho, en e ruodh piny duto; nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego.
english: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: The LORD, the God of Armies, is his name.”

kikuyu: Nyasachwa biro kendo ok obi lingʼ mach ni e nyime mawangʼo gik moko pep, kendo ahiti mager olwore.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Riyo kech mitimo e dwe mar angʼwen, gi mar abich, gi mar abiriyo, gi mar apar biro bedo kinde mag mor gi ilo kendo gibiro doko kinde mag sewni moyier mag mor ne jo-Juda. Emomiyo heruru adiera kod kwe.”
english: The LORD of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

kikuyu: E kindeno duto mokete tenge nyaka ochiwre ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo okel nyaim ma hike achiel kaka misango michiwo mar pwodhruok e ketho. To kinde mane osetieko kowale ok nokwan nikech yie wiye mane nyiso ni owaleno ne odoko mogak.
english: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

kikuyu: Wasewinjo sunga mar Moab, kaka otingʼore malo gi wuondruok, kopongʼ gi sunga kod achaya, to dhialruokneno en kayiem nono.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

kikuyu: Ma en gima yot ahinya e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, nimar jo-Moab obiro chiwo e lwetu.
english: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼ mano bura nongʼadi, mi nomaye lochne duto mondo otieke chuth.
english: “‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

kikuyu: gigombo tho, to tho ok neg-gi, adier, gidwaro tho moloyo mwandu mopandi,
english: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma okawo asoya mondo oneg ngʼat maonge ketho.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: to yawuowi ne weyona yo ka onena to jodongo to ne oana malo.
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oseketo aora Jordan mondo opog kindwa kodu, un joka Reuben kod joka Gad! Uonge kod pok moro kuom Jehova Nyasaye.’ Omiyo nyikwau nyalo miyo nyikwawa weyo luoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne ok abedo e kanyakla mar jojaro, ne ok atimo nyasi kodgi; to ne abedo kenda nikech lweti ne ni kuoma kendo ne ipongʼa gi mirima.
english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.

kikuyu: Kane en kinde mane Elizabeth onego yudie nyathi, nonywolo nyathi ma wuowi.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

kikuyu: Ka yie wi ngʼato oluny duto kendo odongʼ rabondo, to oler.
english: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

kikuyu: Mon mane nigi yie nochiernegi jogi manosetho mi gikawogi ka gingima. Jomoko kuomgi kata ne isando malich to nodagi ni kik wegi thuolo, nikech negigeno ni nochiergi e ngima maber moloyo.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

kikuyu: Shalum wuod Halohesh, ma jatend dir gwengʼ Jerusalem komachielo ne gedo e dir jogo ka nyige konye.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

kikuyu: Kwe gi ngʼwono obed ni ji duto moyie luwo chikni, kendo kata ni Israel mar Nyasaye.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone niya, “To koro inine gi wangʼi gima jatiji nyalo timo.” Akish nodwoke niya, “Mano ber, abiro keti jaritna e ndalo duto mar ngimana.”
english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”

kikuyu: Piny duto, chakre Geba nyaka Rimon, yo milambo mar Jerusalem nobed machal gi Araba. To Jerusalem notingʼ malo, kendo enosik kama entie, chakre dhoranga Benjamin kidhi e Dhorangach Mokwongo nyaka e Dhorangach manie kona; kendo koa e ohinga mar Hananel ma gin kuonde biyo mzabibu mar ruoth.
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kumane Nyasaye osenyiso Ibrahim, Ibrahim nogero kendo mar misango kanyo kendo nopango yien e wiye motweyo Isaka wuode kendo nopiele ewi kendo mar misango, ewi yien.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

kikuyu: Eka ne onyisa Joshua jadolo maduongʼ kochungʼ e nyim malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye, ka Satan ochungʼ e bathe korachwich mondo ohangne wach.
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

kikuyu: omiyo nadhi nyaka e holo gotieno, kanono ohinga. Mogik, ne alokora mi achako adonjo kendo gie Dhoranga Holo.
english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

kikuyu: In kaachiel gi jokedo magi duto kod pinje mathoth ma jokori duto biro dhi malo, ka gidudo ka koth maduongʼ madwa chue; inichal gi bor polo moimo piny.
english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

kikuyu: Ji nodhi kuno gi atungʼ kod asere nikech pinyno duto nopongʼ gi pedo kod kuthe.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

kikuyu: nono to jomoko nono, ema nocham mwanduni kendo tichni matek nokony od ngʼat moro nono.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

kikuyu: Abiro medo bedo mofuwo maloyo mae, bende abiro medo dwokora matin e wangʼa awuon. To wasumbini ma nyiri miwachogi, to biro miya duongʼ.”
english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ok ja-Nyasaye hinyo jabathe gi dhoge owuon, to rieko miyo ngʼat makare tony.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato kuomgi mane ochando gimoro, nikech kinde ka kinde jogo mane nigi puothe kata udi ne loko gigegigo pesa, kendo negikelo pesa mane giyudo mi
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

kikuyu: “Kik iland wach ma ok adiera. Kik ikony ngʼat marach kidoko janeno mar miriambo.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mongʼeyo? Onyalo lokore mi okechu kendo owenu gweth, kendo ubed gi chiwo mag cham kod misengini miolo piny muchiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasachu.
english: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God.

kikuyu: abiro gwedhi adier kendo anami nyikwayi bed mangʼeny ka sulwe mae polo kendo ka kuoyo manie dho nam. Nyikwayi nokaw mier mag jowasikgi mondo obed margi,
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

kikuyu: to Ruoth Nyasaye nyiero joma timbegi richo, nimar ongʼeyo ni odiechieng-gi biro.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

kikuyu: Negitiyo kode kuom loso rachungi mag dho Hemb Romo gi kendo mar misango mar mula gi singʼengene gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono,
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

kikuyu: Rangajno ne nigi agola malach motingʼo ute mag jorito mane fut apar maromre to kindgi nopogi gi kor ot ma lachne ne fut aboro kuom borgi gi lachgi. To agola mar ohinga mane nitie e dhorangajno ne romo fut apar.
english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

kikuyu: Ok awach kamano nikech achando gimoro, to asepuonjora dak ka aromo e gik ma an-go.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar joka Jakobo. Kane Josef ja-higni apar gabiriyo, nohero kwayo jamb wuon-gi ka en kaachiel gi owetene ma yawuot Bilha kod yawuot Zilpa ma magi gin monde wuon-gi. To Josef nonyiso wuon-gi timbe moko maricho ma owetene ne timo.
english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

kikuyu: Ne oyud kuome remb jonabi gi remb jomaler, kod remb ji duto mane osenegi e piny.”
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

kikuyu: to en to nobedo Jadolo gi kwongʼruok ka Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osekwongʼore kendo ok nolok pache, osesingore niya, ‘In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ.’”
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

kikuyu: Eka ne awachonu niya, “Kik ubwogi, kik uluorgi
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi Perath mi akunyo kambano kendo akawe kama ne apande, makmana nosekethore kendo obedo maonge tich chuth.
english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato nyap, to donge an bende adoko manyap kode? Koso ka ngʼato odonjo e richo, to donge litna?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

kikuyu: Omiyo nonyisogi, kendo neginego ji duto mane ni e dala maduongʼno gi ligangla makmana ngʼat cha gi joge duto ema notony.
english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

kikuyu: “Kata obedo ni ngʼatni chwe kendo en jamoko,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye nongʼiyo piny gie kare maler man malo, nongʼiyo piny gie polo,
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

kikuyu: Mach liel e nyime kendo wangʼo wasike e alworane duto.
english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel yiende nowuok mondo oyier ruodhgi. Negiwachone yadh zeituni ni, ‘Bed ruodhwa.’
english: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

kikuyu: Ere kaka nokwane ni en ngʼat makare, kosetere nyangu koso ka podi? Nokwane ni en ngʼat makare kapok otere nyangu.
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: “Adiera asewinjo ywak Efraim: Ne imiya kum ka nyaroya ma lelo, kendo osekuma. Duoga, kendo anaduogi, nikech in Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha.
english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are the LORD my God.

kikuyu: “Ruoth nodwoko ni, ‘Isetimo maber, jatichna maber! Nikech isebedo ngʼat mogen e gima tin ahinya, koro bed jarit mier madongo apar.’
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

kikuyu: Bangʼe ngʼama kelo chiwo mare nokelne Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mar cham maromo achiel kuom apar mar efa mar mogo mayom moruw gi achiel kuom angʼwen mar lita mar mo.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

kikuyu: Ne gichiegni yweya oko e piny, to kata kamano pok aweyo chikeni.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

kikuyu: Eka Melkizedek ruodh Salem nokelo makati gi divai. Ne en jadolo mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo owinjo ni cham yudore e piny Misri, nowacho ne yawuote niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ubet urangoru aranga?”
english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

kikuyu: Kendo gima ne otimone Dathan kod Abiram yawuot Eliab mawuok e dhood Reuben kane piny oyawo dhoge e dieru tir e kind jo-Israel duto ma omwonyogi duto kod joutgi, hembegi kod gik moko duto ma mekgi.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

kikuyu: Eka janabi Jeremia nowachone janabi Hanania, “Winji Hanania! Jehova Nyasaye pok oori, to isehoyo ogandagi mondo ogen kuom miriambo.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.

kikuyu: Koro Heber ja-Keni noseweyo jo-Keni ma nyikwa Hobab, ma en or Musa, kendo oguro hembe machiegni gi yien maduongʼ man Zananim but Kedesh.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

kikuyu: Magi e nying-gi, koa e dhood Reuben ne en Shamua wuod Zakur;
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Tahath mi gibworo Tera.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

kikuyu: Yesu nopuonjogi gik mangʼeny e yor ngeche. E puonjnego nowacho niya,
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

kikuyu: Elifelet wuod Ahasbai ja-Maaka gi Eliam wuod Ahithofel ja-Gilon,
english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

kikuyu: “To in, dogi dala, ka inyono dala. Ka inyono dala maduongʼ, to nyathino notho.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

kikuyu: To kuom weche mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Jotham, gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitap weche ruodhi mag Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Kane ibatiso ji duto, Yesu bende ne obatisi. To kane olemo, polo noyawore
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

kikuyu: Osimbo ma jomer man Efraim sungorego ibiro nyono gi tielo.
english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ nywolo Enok, Jared nodak higni mia aboro kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka jolwenj Babulon nose aa Jerusalem nikech jolwenj Farao,
english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni: ‘Winjuru wach ma Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Un jo-Amon ne ubedo mamor ka kara maler mar lemo odwany, kendo ka piny Israel okethi, kendo ka jo-Juda oter e twech,
english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

kikuyu: Pile ka pile an kodu ka apuonjo e laru mag hekalu, to ne ok umaka. To koro ndiko nyaka chop kare.”
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Achalo ngʼama nonywol kaachiel gi ondiegi, bende achalo osiep tula.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wachone nyar Sayun niya, “Koguru matek kendo beduru mabor nikech abiro dak e dieru.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jo-Nineve, nolokore moyie kuom Nyasaye kendo negingʼado wach mondo ji duto otwe chiemo, kochakore jomadongo e diergi nyaka jomatindo duto, ka girwako pien gugru.
english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

kikuyu: Kane Petro onenogi, nowachonegi niya, “Un jo-Israel, angʼo momiyo gima otimoreni obwogou? Angʼo momiyo uchomo wangʼu kungʼiyowa mana ka gima tekowa wawegi kata timwa makare ema omiyo ngʼatni owuotho?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

kikuyu: Kane kinde mane gitimoe nyasigo oserumo, Ayub ne luongogi mondo opwodhgi. Okinyi kogwen notimo misango miwangʼo pep ne moro ka moro kuomgi, koparo ni dipo ka achiel kuomgi osetimo richo mi giyanyo Nyasaye gie chunygi. Ma ne en tim Ayub mane otimo kinde ka kinde.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

kikuyu: Nitie bende chwech mag polo gi chwech mag piny, kendo kit duongʼ mar chwech mag polo opogore gi kit duongʼ mar chwech mag piny.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

kikuyu: Wan to Roho ema miyo wabedo gi geno ni wabiro bedo e winjruok gi Nyasaye kuom yie.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny, kod okapu mopongʼ gi makati ma ok oketie thowi kaka kek molos gi mogo mayom moru gi mo, kod chapat mowir gi mo.
english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Chur ma achurgo matek omiyo adhero alokora choke lilo.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

kikuyu: Ok usechiwo rombe mondo otimnago misango miwangʼo pep, bende ok usemiya duongʼ gi misengini magu. Ok asemiyou tingʼ mapek mag chiwo mag cham, kata dwaro ni uwangʼna ubani.
english: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

kikuyu: Magi koro e chike mag misango miwangʼo pep, misango mar cham, misango mar golo richo, misango ma ipwodhruokgo e ketho gi misengini mitimo chiengʼ miketo jadolo e tich kaachiel gi misengini mag lalruok.
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

kikuyu: kata nyamin-gi manie lwete mapok okendi. Nyamin-gi mapok okendino kende ema nyalo miyo obed mogak.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

kikuyu: Negingʼado nam nyaka loka e gwengʼ miluongo ni Gerasi.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

kikuyu: To kidok e dala maduongʼ miwachone Abisalom ni, ‘Abiro bedo jatiji, yaye ruoth; nikech ne an jatij wuonu ndalo mokadho, to sani koro abiro bedo jatiji,’ to kitimo ma to inyalo konya ketho ngʼado rieko mar Ahithofel.
english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

kikuyu: To mad ji duto madwari bed moil kendo mamor kuomi; mad joma ohero warruok mari osik kawacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo oyud duongʼ!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo paro e chunye ni oriek moloyo ji abiriyo ma dwoko wach gi rieko.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: “ ‘Dhi ir jogo mondo iwachnegi ni, “Ubiro siko kuwinjo weche miwacho, to wach ok nodonjnu ngangʼ; ubiro siko kungʼicho, to ok unune gimoro.”
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

kikuyu: Kaw mor pwodhruok mondo ipwodhgo Hemb Romo kod gik moko duto mantie; iwale kod gigene duto kendo obiro bedo maler.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

kikuyu: Fuwo otwere e chuny nyathi, to ludh kum biro riembe mabor kode.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nochiwo Oreb kod Zeb, jotend jo-Midian, e lwetgi. En angʼo mane anyalo timo kipimo gi gima usetimo?” Kuom mano, ich wangʼ margi norumo.
english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

kikuyu: To chutho ber maru onego obed mano maiye, ma en ber madier mar chuny mamuol kendo mokwe ma en gima duongʼ moloyo e wangʼ Nyasaye.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

kikuyu: Ngʼat madhi oko kaywak, kotingʼo kodhi mikomo, biro duogo ka wero wende mor, kotingʼo cham mosechiek.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

kikuyu: Kane akwayi ni mondo ikonya to ne iwinjo ywakna.
english: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “En ngʼa manochweyo dho dhano? En ngʼa mamiyo odoko momo kata ite odino? Koso en ngʼa mamiyo oneno kata obedo muofu? Donge en an Jehova Nyasaye?
english: The LORD said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, the LORD?

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Donge aseyierou duto karu ji apar gariyo, to kata kamano, ngʼato achiel kuomu en jachien!”
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

kikuyu: To bende asewinjo kwayo mikwayo nikech Ishmael, omiyo anagwedhe, kendo anamiye nyithindo gi nyikwayo mangʼeny.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

kikuyu: Ngʼama odagi Wuowi odagi Wuoro bende, to ngʼama orwake nigi Wuoro bende.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

kikuyu: Onge jo-Juda mane odongʼ mane odhi dak Misri ma notony kata kwo ma ok odwogo e piny Juda, ma gigombo duogoe kendo dakie; onge manoduogi makmana ji moko manok manoringo lweny.”
english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ne nitie e achiel kuom mier, ngʼat moro ma dhoho omako dende duto nobiro ire, kane oneno Yesu, nopodho piny ka okulore e lowo kendo nosaye niya, “Ruoth, kiyie, to inyalo pwodha.”
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Adiera ok nyal yudi, kendo ngʼat motangʼ ne richo chuny ji ojokgo. Jehova Nyasaye norangogi kendo nokecho nikech ngʼado bura makare onge kuomgi.
english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

kikuyu: Nonwangʼo ka Daudi osenyisi niya, “Ahithofel en achiel kuom jo-andhoga mane oriwore gi Abisalom.” Omiyo Daudi nolemo niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, lok ngʼado rieko mar Ahithofel obed fuwo.”
english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni piero adek gariyo kane obedo ruodh Juda, kendo norito Jerusalem kuom higni aboro.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To kane polo abiriyogo osemor kamano, ne adwaro ndiko gima ne awinjo kagiwacho, eka nawinjo dwol moro moa e polo mowachona niya, “Kik indik gima polo abiriyogo osewacho to lingʼ-go mana ei chunyi.”
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

kikuyu: “Eka ne apenjo ruodha ni, ‘Datim nangʼo ka nyakono ok oyie biro koda?’
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

kikuyu: Joka Gad nodak Gilead, Bashan to gi mier mokiewo kode kod lek mar Sharon duto.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

kikuyu: To kuom mago manyamo kambula kata mago ma ombongʼ tiendegi opogore ahinya, ok onego ucham kaka ngamia, apwoyo, gi ogwangʼ terere kata obedo ni ginyamo kambula, ombongʼ tiendegi ok opogore, to gin gik mogak ne un.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye chiko herane godiechiengʼ, to gotieno to wende ni e chunya; ma e lamo ma alamogo Nyasach ngimana.
english: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

kikuyu: Injilini ema kelonu warruok, ka umako matek wach mane ayalonu mokwongo. Ka ok kamano, to kara ne uyie kayiem nono.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

kikuyu: Odhiambono jaduongʼ moro moa e piny gode mag Efraim, mane odak Gibea (joma nodak kanyo ne gin jo-Benjamin), nobiro kanyo koa tiyo e puothe.
english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Atimo kodi singruok. E nyim jogi duto abiro timo honni madongo mapok otimie oganda moro amora e piny. Jogo mudak e kindgi biro neno kaka timbe ma an Jehova Nyasaye abiro timo dongo.
english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

kikuyu: To mar ariyo bende chal kode kamano, ni, ‘Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.’
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nyiego nomaki nikech pinye kendo nokech joge.
english: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.

kikuyu: Jodonge nowachone niya, “Ne, wasewinjo ni ruodhi mag jo-Israel ngʼwon. Yie wadhi ir ruodh Israel ka watweyo pien gugru e nungowa kendo ka watweyo tonde e wiwa. Dipo ka okechi.”
english: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa Salma ne gin: jo-Bethlehem, jo-Netofath; Atroth Beth Joab, nus jo-Manahath, jo-Zor,
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

kikuyu: Eka askeche mag hekalu nodok ir jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai, kendo ne gipenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo ok usekele ka?”
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

kikuyu: Mach nomuoch kuom joma luwogi; mach maliel mager nowangʼo joma timbegi richogo motiekogi pep.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

kikuyu: Rieko ema igerogo ot, to kuom winjo ogurore mosiko;
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

kikuyu: Jowetena, jood Kloe moko osekelona wach ni nitie dhawo e dieru.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

kikuyu: to chiengʼ mar abiriyo en Sabato ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Chiengʼno ok unutim tich moro amora, bed ni un kata yawuotu kata nyiu kata jotiju machwo kata mamon, kata rwethu, pundau kata jambu moro amora, kata jodak manie dieru mondo jotiju ma yawuowi kata ma nyiri oyudie thuolo mar yweyo kaka in.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

kikuyu: Hezekia noyudo osepenjo, “Ere gima biro bedona ranyisi ni abiro dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD’s house?”

kikuyu: Malaika nodwoko niya, “Roho Maler biro biro kuomi, kendo teko mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo biro umi. Kuom mano jal maler monego nywol ibiro luongo ni Wuod Nyasaye.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho niya, “Nyisuru ji obed piny.” Kanyo ne nitie lum mangʼeny, omiyo ji nobedo piny (ka joma chwo kuomgi noromo ji alufu abich).
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

kikuyu: Jatend kanyakla mar jo-Kristo nyaka bed ngʼat ma wach moro amora marach onge kuome, chwor dhako achiel kende, ngʼat mobidhore, moritore, kendo modimbore, ngʼat moluor, mohero rwako welo kendo japuonj molony,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

kikuyu: To awachonu ni Elija koro osebiro, to kata kamano ne ok giyange, kendo gisetimone gimoro amora mane gihero. Wuod Dhano bende ibiro sandi e lwetgi e yo machalre.”
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

kikuyu: Daudi nodak e piny Filistia kuom higa achiel gi dweche angʼwen.
english: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

kikuyu: Nogero ode gi Bungu mar Lebanon ma borne romo fut mia achiel gi piero abich gachiel to lachne romo fut piero abiriyo gabich gi nus kendo borne madhi malo romo fut piero angʼwen gangʼwen. Nogure ewi laini angʼwen mag sirni mag sida moriwie bape mag sida.
english: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, akwayou mondo ulu timna.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

kikuyu: Kane gimiel, ne giwer niya, “Saulo onego ji alufe, to Daudi onego ji alufe gi alufe.”
english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jogi notwe, ka girwako kandho mag-gi, sirwechegi, kilemba mag-gi kod lewni mamoko, mi nodirgi ei mach makakni.
english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

kikuyu: Omiyo mirima nomaka kodgi mi nasingora ka akwongʼora ni, “Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.”
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo osetuonu koth, kendo kodh chwiri pod ok ochwe. Kata kamano in gi neno machalo gi mar ochot; wiyi bende ok kuodi nikech ionge gi wichkuot.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, inidag amingʼa mi itho gi kwe kiluwo kwereni.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

kikuyu: Koro angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ moloyo nyiseche moko duto, nimar notimo kamano ne joma nosando jo-Israel marach.”
english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

kikuyu: Yore mag dhano nenore ratiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo onono kamoro amora ma odhiyoe.
english: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

kikuyu: kod ruodhi duto moa yo nyandwat, machiegni kod man maboyo, achiel bangʼ machielo, pinjeruodhi duto mantiere e wangʼ piny. Eka mogik, ruodh Sheshak bende nomadhe.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ji nobedo piny e migepe, ka migepe moko otingʼo ji mia achiel to moko otingʼo ji piero abich.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

kikuyu: To mondo ungʼe ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo.” Eka nowachone ja-athanyno niya, “Aa malo kaw pieni mondo idhi dala.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Eka noyawo pachgi mondo giwinj tiend Ndiko.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

kikuyu: to ngʼama kamano koro ok uyiene mondo okony wuon kata min.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

kikuyu: To ka wuon mare okwero e kinde mosingoreno, to onge kwongʼruok kata singruok mare ma osingorego manitimre; Jehova Nyasaye noweye thuolo nikech wuon mare osedagi.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

kikuyu: Ruoth nolokore kendo nongʼiyo Petro tir. Eka Petro noparo wach mane oyudo Ruoth osewachone niya, “Kapok thuon gweno okok tinendeni, to wangʼ inikweda nyadidek.”
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Kanyo ema nogeroe kendo mar misango kendo nochake ni El-Elohe-Israel (tiende ni Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel).
english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo ngʼicho ei oganda mondo one ngʼat mane omule.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

kikuyu: Koro Joshua wuod Nun ne opongʼ gi roho mar rieko nimar Musa ne oseketo lwetene kuome. Omiyo jo-Israel nochiko itgi kowuoyonegi kendo negitimo gik mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ma nyiso ni nyithind ringruok ok ema nyithind Nyasaye, to mana nyithind singruok ema ikwano kaka koth Ibrahim.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

kikuyu: Ka Higa mar Piero Abich osechopo, to puodho nodwok ir ngʼat mane ongʼiewe kuome, ma en wuon lowo hie.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye e Ruoth, ogendini mondo okirni; obet e kom lochne e kind kerubi, piny mondo oyiengni.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

kikuyu: Masichegi duto osebiro kuomwa, mana kaka ondiki e Chik Musa, to kata kamano pok wakwayo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa ngʼwono, ka walokore waweyo richowa kendo waketo chunywa mar luwo adiera mare.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of the LORD our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

kikuyu: To ne ok ginyal dewo kendo tokgi ne tek mana kaka kweregi mane ok oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Josia ne ja-higni aboro kane obedo ruoth kendo norito pinyno kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gachiel.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: mondo itingʼ achaya mari kendo ine wichkuot kuom gik moko duto misetimo kuom miyogi hoch.
english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

kikuyu: Kawuono abiro wuotho ei jambi duto kendo abiro walo diek gi rombe ma kitgi rabok kod mago ma angʼech gi mago maratengʼ. Magi ema nobed chudo maga.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

kikuyu: Ruodha ma en ruoth ok onego kaw wach mar tho yawuot ruoth ka gimoro. En mana Amnon kende ema otho.”
english: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

kikuyu: Nobiro kochomo im man-gi tunge ariyo mane aseneno kochungʼ e bath aora, kendo nochome gi ngʼwech tir ka en gi mirima mager.
english: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.

kikuyu: Kik igol kidi mar kiewo machon mane oket gi kweregi.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

kikuyu: mi owachone niya, “Dhi e dala Jerusalem duto mondo iket kido e lela wangʼ joma okuyo kendo ma chunygi chandore kuom gik mamono mitimonigi.”
english: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo bende ni Wuod Nyasaye osebiro kendo osemiyowa rieko mar winjo tiend wach, mondo wangʼe ngʼat ma ja-adiera, ngʼat makoro wanie iye, en wuode Yesu Kristo. En e Nyasaye madier kendo en e ngima mochwere.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

kikuyu: Nowachona kendo niya, “Wuod dhano, bende ineno gik ma dhood Israel timo ka, ma gin gik mamono mokalo awacha, gik mabiro riemba mabor gi kara maler mar lemo? To ibiro medo neno gik moko maricho moloyo mago.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Rituru yorena duto kod chikena kendo uluwgi. An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Dedan, Tema, Buz kod jogo duto mantiere kuonde maboyo;
english: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

kikuyu: Nitie yore mathoth mitiyogo tich Nyasaye, to Nyasaye achiel ema chiwone ngʼato ka ngʼato teko mar tiyogi.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

kikuyu: ni kothe nodhi nyime nyaka chiengʼ kendo lochne nosiki e nyima ka wangʼ chiengʼ;
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorene mi owacho niya, “In migumba kendo ionge nyathi to ibiro mako ich mi inywol wuowi.
english: The LORD’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

kikuyu: Ka noyudo ngimana dhi maber to nomiyo tekona odok chien kendo nongʼado ngimana odoko machiek.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

kikuyu: Rieko mar jorieko en bedo gi paro ne yoregi, to fup joma ofuwo en wuondruok.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Asenyisou, to utamoru yie. Honni ma atimo e nying Wuora bende nyiso gima An,
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

kikuyu: un to ubiro bedona oganda mar jodolo kendo oganda maler.’ Magi e weche manyaka iwachne jo-Israel.”
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Nyimineni ma gin Sodom gi nyige kod Samaria gi nyige, biro lokore mi gibed gima ne gin chon; kendo in bende, kaachiel gi nyigi ibiro lokori mi ibed kaka ne ichalo chon.
english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne watweyo chiemo kendo wakwayo Nyasachwa kuom ma, kendo nodwoko lamowa.
english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

kikuyu: Emomiyo an kaachiel gi jonabi maga wangʼadou matindo tindo, ne anegou gi weche mawuok e dhoga; buche mane angʼadonu nobiro kuomo mapiyo mana ka mil polo.
english: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.

kikuyu: To an, bangʼ kosetingʼa malo mogola e pinyni, to anaywa ji duto ira.”
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

kikuyu: Chwo duto mahikgi piero adek nyaka piero abich mane obiro tich e Hemb Romo,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: Mad gichal gi lum moti ewi tado maner kata kapok odongo maber.
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “AN MANTIE. Ma e gima onego iwach ni jo-Israel, ‘AN MANTIE oseora iru.’ ”
english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno Laban nowalo nywogi duto ma kitgi rabok kod mago ma angʼech, gi diek mamon (ma dikiyo) kod nyirombe marotenge mine oketogi e lwet yawuote mondo oritgi.
english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa norieyo ludhe e piny Misri, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo yamb wuok chiengʼ okudho matek e pinyno odiechiengno kod otienono duto. Kane ochopo gokinyi, yamono nokelo bonyo;
english: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

kikuyu: Kaka koro aseikora dwoko wach makora, angʼeyo ni ubiro kwana kaka ngʼama kare.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

kikuyu: Kuom joma nodak Jabesh Gilead negiyudo nyiri mia angʼwen mapok ongʼeyo chwo kendo negiterogi e kambi mar Shilo man Kanaan.
english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Mad joma ochayo ji ne wichkuot kuom kwinya maonge gima omiyo, an to abiro paro matut kuom yoreni.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

kikuyu: Werneuru Jehova Nyasaye wer manyien, kupako nyinge e piny duto, un joma kwangʼ e nam kaachiel gi gik manie yie gi pinje mag chula mar nam kod ji duto modak.
english: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

kikuyu: To koro kuom wach choko chiwo ni jo-Nyasaye; to awachoe kama: Timuru gima ne akone kanisa man Galatia mondo otim.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma iye lit dwaro ahinya ni mondo obed gi mwandu to ok ongʼeyo ni chan orite.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

kikuyu: nimar ngʼat morwake doko jakore e timbene maricho.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
