kikuyu: To Nyasaye nowacho ne Balaam niya, “Kik idhi kodgi. Kik ikwongʼ jogo, nikech gin joma ogwedhi.”
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

kikuyu: Piny motingʼo Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimra, Heshbon, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo kod Beon
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼat madichwo kothe mar nyodo owuok, nyaka olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Un uwegi ungʼeyo ni lwetenagi osetiyo matek mi ochopo dwarona duto, nyaka dwaro mag jowadwa mwayalogo Injili.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

kikuyu: “Winjuru wechena, un joma riek; chiknauru itu, un joma osomo.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Gik miwergo man-gi tondegi. Zaburi. Wer. Mad Nyasaye timnwa ngʼwono kendo owinjwa; mad omi wangʼe rienynwa maber, Sela
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

kikuyu: Diek mamon mia ariyo kod nywogi piero ariyo, rombe mamon mia ariyo gi imbe piero ariyo,
english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Bende ungʼeyo Laban nyakwar Nahor?” Negidwoke niya, “Ee, wangʼeye.”
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

kikuyu: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimon,
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

kikuyu: Noga, Nefeg, Jafia,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Ber bangʼo kuon gi kwe kod mor moloyo ot mopongʼ gi chiemo mathoth kod dhawo.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: kuom mano, nyis joma wire gi lowo marachar ni obiro podho. Koth maduongʼ biro chue, kendo abiro oro pe madongo dongo, kod yamb ahiti makudho matek.
english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

kikuyu: Ji duto biro sin kodu nikech an.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: To kawuononi aweyi thuolo ka agonyo nyoroche manie ngʼut lweti. Dhi koda Babulon, ka ihero, kendo anariti; to ka ok idwar, to kik ibi. Ne, piny ngima ni e lweti; dhi kamoro amora midwaro.
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

kikuyu: Jakobo mirima nomako mi odhawo gi Laban. Nopenje niya, “En richo mane masetimo momiyo ilawa matek kama?
english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

kikuyu: Jehoahaz ne ja-higni piero ariyo gadek kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kuom dweche adek kodak Jerusalem. Min mare nyinge ne Hamutal nyar Jeremia; mane aa Libna.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo Jehoram gi tuo malich momako nyimbiye ma ok thiedhre.
english: After all this the LORD struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel kod jo-Filistia nochanore koni gi kocha ka gimanyore.
english: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.

kikuyu: Kendo dhakono nowacho niya, “Kara en angʼo momiyo isengʼado wach marach kama kuom jo-Nyasaye? Ka ruoth wacho kama, donge ongʼado bura ne en owuon, nikech ruoth pok odwogo wuode mane oriembi.
english: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Mar Daudi. Ne amor gi joma nowachona niya, “Wadhiuru e od Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

kikuyu: Jehoshafat bende ne nigi kwe gi ruodh Israel.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

kikuyu: nowacho niya, “Ma donge e Babulon maduongʼ masegero gi tekra kod nyalona kaka kar dakna mondo onyis duongʼ mar lochna?”
english: The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

kikuyu: “In kaachiel gi jo-Israel dhi uked gi jo-Midian, eka bangʼe ibiro tho miluw bangʼ kwereni.”
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

kikuyu: Nowachone joma moko ka awinjo niya, “Luweuru kamoro amora modhiye e dalano kendo uneg ngʼato angʼata ma ok ukechogi kata ngʼwononegi.
english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

kikuyu: Pi mane olwora nobwoga kendo kude mag nam bende noima kendo buya mag nam nogajore e wiya.
english: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

kikuyu: Seche moko ne iyanyou kendo isandou e lela e dier ji, to seche moko nuchungʼ kaachiel kod joma ne itimonegi kamano.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, nodog kuonde mochiel motegno manie pinygi, to kata kamano noloye ma ok nochak owinje kendo.
english: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye oserito singruok mane otimo. Asekawo loch wuora Daudi kendo asebet e kom loch mar Israel mana kaka Nyasaye nosingo kendo asegero hekalu ni Nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
english: “The LORD has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Negidonjo Jerusalem e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gigoyo nyatiti gi asili kod turumbete.
english: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: “To apoya nono kane giseyudo yweyo, negitimo gima ok owinjore e nyim wangʼi. Bangʼe ne ijwangʼogi e lwet wasikgi mondo omi wasikgigo obed ruodhgi. To kane gichak giywakni kendo ne iwinjogi ka in e polo, to e ngʼwononi mogundho ne iresogi kuom kinde ka kinde.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Benjamin, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Weuru joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye obed gi kwe, nimar oritogi kinde duto, bende ngʼatno ma Jehova Nyasaye ohero yudo yweyo kuome.”
english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Asher, en Ahihud wuod Shelomi;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

kikuyu: Mwandu moyudi e yo marach onge gi ohala; to tim makare reso ji e tho.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Oyiengo piny gie mise mare kendo omiyo sirni mage yiengni.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kikuyu: ma kata obedo ni loth ka ngʼich gokinyi to godhiambo to ner kendo two.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

kikuyu: Musa ne ja-higni mia achiel kod piero ariyo kane otho, to kata kamano wengene ne ok ojony kata tekone bende ok orumo.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo maber kaka nokonya e yore mathoth e dala ma e Efeso. Akwayo mondo Ruoth okeche e odiechiengʼno mar Ruoth.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

kikuyu: Kane Ahithofel oneno ni rieko mane ongʼado ok oluw, noidho pundane modok dalagi e ode. Noloso weche mag ode; bangʼe ne odere. Omiyo notho moike e bur wuon mare.
english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

kikuyu: Nyis Shemaya ja-Nehelam,
english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,

kikuyu: “Jotich mane ondiki kar sa apar gachiel odhiambo nobiro kendo moro ka moro kuomgi noyudo dinari achiel.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Asher, kaw Pagiel wuod Okran;
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Pek dhahabu mar musmal mane otiyogo ne romo nus kilo. Nobawo udi mamalo bende gi dhahabu.
english: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone jodonge duto mane ni kode Jerusalem niya, “Biuru! Nyaka to waring waa ka, ka ok kamano onge ngʼato kuomwa mabiro tony e lwet Abisalom. Nyaka wawuog mapiyo, nono to enobi mapiyo mojukwa mi otiekwa kendo oneg ji e dala maduongʼ gi ligangla.”
english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

kikuyu: To kuom weche moko mag loch Azaria to gi mane otimo e ndalone donge ondikgi e kitepe mag ruodhi Juda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode noduogo mi omonjo Debir.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

kikuyu: Jakobo nochako kanyo mane Nyasaye owuoyoe kodeno ni Bethel.
english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

kikuyu: Mbesene mane odongogo nodwoke niya, “Dwok jogo mosekwayi ni, ‘Wuonu noketo tingʼ mapek kuomwa, yie iket tingʼni obed mayot.’ Koro nyisgi ni, ‘Lith lweta matin duongʼ moloyo nungo wuonwa.
english: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

kikuyu: Suduru machiegni, un ogendini kendo chikuru itu; winjuru, un ogendini! Mad piny kod gik moko manie iye winja!
english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.

kikuyu: Ringuru! Ringuru ukony ngimau; muchal gi bungu manie thim!
english: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Ok ber bedo gi gombo maonge gi ngʼeyo, kata bedo ka irikni kae to ibayo yo.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, wach ni jo-Israel kaka hekalu chalo, eka wigi okuodi kuom timbegi maricho. We gipar matut kuome kaka ochalo,
english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon gi jo-Moab noriwore mochako kedo kod jo-Got Seir monegogi kendo otiekogi pep. Kane gitieko nego jo-Got Seir, negikonyore kuom tiekore kendgi giwegi.
english: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.

kikuyu: Noketo karaya mar logo e kind Hemb Romo gi kendo mar misango mi noolo pi e iye.
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jakobo mamoko nomonjo joma ne owetegi osenego mi giyako dala maduongʼni nikech jogo nosekuodo wi nyamin-gi.
english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nonyiso Musa niya, “Bi ira ewi got mondo ibed ka kendo anamiyi kite mopa masendikoe chike kod buche mondo ipuonj oganda.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

kikuyu: Ashkelon biro neno mi oluor; piny Gaza kod Ekron biro yware e masira, nikech geno margi biro rumo. Ruodh Gaza biro tho kendo dala mar Ashkelon biro dongʼ gunda.
english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar apar, e dwe mar apar ne en Maharai ja-Netofath ma ja-Zera. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: kendo ka un duto unudhi ka utingʼo gige lweny loka Jordan e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mi ubed kuno nyaka chop Jehova Nyasaye riemb wasike duto e nyime,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

kikuyu: Ka dine ibedna owadwa mahie, mane wadhodhogo thuno achiel, to dine anyodhi, kapo ni ayudi oko, kendo onge ngʼama dine ochaya.
english: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

kikuyu: Ma nomiyo mirima omako ruoth kendo nodoko mager, mi nogolo chik mana gisano mondo oneg joma riek duto manie piny Babulon.
english: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

kikuyu: Omiyo negiringo gia e nyim jo-Israel ka gichiko yo thim, to ne ok ginyal tony ne lweny. Kendo jo-Israel mane oa e mier nonegogi kanyo.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

kikuyu: Magi duto notimorena, kata obedo ni wiwa ne pok owil kodi, kata riambo ne singruok mari.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

kikuyu: Chunya lit; omiyo abiro pari, ka an e piny mar Jordan, gi kuonde motingʼore mar Hermon kod e got Mizar.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

kikuyu: Ochodo chuny jotelo, kendo ruodhi duto mag piny oluore.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Eka chiengʼ moro jogi nodhi ire ka gin kanyakla mine giyudo Daniel ka lemo kendo kwayo Nyasache mondo okonye.
english: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok owinjo wechena ma janabino hulo e nyinga, to an awuon ema natere e bura.
english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

kikuyu: To Abisalom nowacho niya, “Luonguru Hushai ja-Arki, mondo en bende wawinj gima owacho.”
english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

kikuyu: Kuom joka Dan, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Dan to en nyathi sibuor mawuok Bashan.”
english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

kikuyu: Ne openja niya, “Wuod dhano, chokegi bende nyalo bet mangima adier?” Ne awacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, in kendi ema inyalo ngʼeyo.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”

kikuyu: Iwe noywayo achiel kuom adek mar sulwe manie polo mi opudho kendo owitogi e piny. Thuol mangʼongono nochungʼ e nyim dhakono mane chiegni nywol, mondo ocham nyathine kosenywole.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

kikuyu: Ne awinjo kiluongo tiendegi niya, “Tiende malworore.”
english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

kikuyu: Jal maluongou biro chopo mano nikech en ja-adiera.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

kikuyu: To jogi bende kwangʼ nikech divai kendo gibayo nikech kongʼo: Jodolo kod jonabi mer makwangʼ nikech kongʼo kendo gitagore nikech divai, githembo ka gineno fweny, gichwanyore ka gingʼado bura.
english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

kikuyu: Jatichne nopenje niya, “Datim angʼo ka nyakono ok oyie biro koda e pinyni? Dadwok wuodi thuru kumane iayeno?”
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

kikuyu: Rehoboam noyiero Abija wuod Maaka obed jatelo e kind owetene mondo omi obed ruoth.
english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

kikuyu: Bende mbaka, nowuok e kindgi ni en ngʼa kuomgi mikwano ni duongʼ moloyo.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Joshua niya, “Chungʼ malo! Angʼo ma ikulone wiyi piny ka?
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?

kikuyu: Kik chunyu nyosre, to meduru bedo motegno, kutiyo ni Ruoth.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Pilato obet e kom jongʼad bura, chiege nokowone wach niya, “Walri iaye wach ngʼat maonge kethono, nimar wachne nochanda ahinya kawuono e lek mane aleko kuome.”
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat masudo tongʼ mar jakiepe.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: To mano ma ok ongʼeyo to otimo gik mowinjore gi kum, to nochwad manok. Ngʼato ka ngʼato ma osemi mangʼeny nodwar kuome gik mangʼeny, to jal ma osemi mangʼeny mondo oriti, enopenje mangʼeny moloyo.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

kikuyu: Jou biro podho piny koseneg-gi e dieru, kendo unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ringʼo morere e gimoro amora mogak, kik cham, to nyaka wangʼ e mach. To ringʼo mamoko modongʼ to inyalo cham gi ngʼato angʼata maler.
english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

kikuyu: achiel kuom joma ne en godo kuno ne en Ahija mane orwako law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod. Ne en wuod owadgi Ikabod miluongo ni Ahitub wuod Finehas, ma wuod Eli, jadolo mar Jehova Nyasaye modak Shilo. Ne onge ngʼama ongʼeyo ni Jonathan ne osewuok.
english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Asher noromo ji alufu piero angʼwen gachiel gi mia abich (41,500).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: E ndalo giko got mogerie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed gi teko e kind gode duto molwore, kendo ibiro tingʼe malo moyombo gode duto kendo ogendini duto nobi ma pongʼe.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

kikuyu: kod ruodhi duto mag Zimri, Elam kod Media;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

kikuyu: Eka nokawo ludhe mi oyiero kite mapoth abich ei aora kendo noketogi e ofukune mar kwath mi otingʼo orujre e lwete kendo osudo machiegni gi ja-Filistiano.
english: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.

kikuyu: Abiro wuok kendo adog ir wuora mi anawachne ni: Wuora, asetimo richo e nyim polo kendo e nyimi.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

kikuyu: Eka ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi e chandruokgino mi noresogi e pekgino;
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

kikuyu: Oseriemba mabor kendo miyo awuotho e mudho kar wuotho e ler;
english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

kikuyu: Anager kuondeni mag gige lweny gi rubi, dhorangeyeni to naketie kite ma nengogi tek, kendo ohingani naketie kite mabeyo.
english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

kikuyu: Mariko bende omosou kaachiel gi Aristarko gi Dema kod Luka, ma gin jotich wetena.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

kikuyu: Lit mar tho en richo, to teko mar richo en chik.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

kikuyu: Pok mar aboro ne mar Jeshaya gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Ka usechiemo ma uyiengʼ, to pakuru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom piny maber ma osemiyou.
english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.

kikuyu: Saulo notoyo mirimbe kuom Jonathan mowachone niya, “In wuod dhako ma wiye tek kendo ma ja-mahundu! Donge angʼeyo ni isebedo jakor wuod Jesse makelo wichkuot ne in iwuon kendo ne minu monywoli?
english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

kikuyu: Eka Musa nodhi mowuoyo ne jo-Israel kowacho niya,
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego, in Nyasach Israel, aa malo ikum ogendini duto; kik ikech andhoke ma timbegi richo. Sela
english: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma osepuonjore goyoni sigio mar mor, jogo mawuotho buti e lerni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

kikuyu: Gigo mane giyudo kondik ei Chik mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kokalo kuom Musa, ni jo-Israel nyaka dagi e kambi e kinde mar nyasi mar dwe mar abiriyo,
english: They found written in the law how the LORD had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

kikuyu: nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Bende owinjore adhi kendo amonj jo-Filistia-gi?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo, mondo imonj jo-Filistia kendo ires Keila.”
english: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” The LORD said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”

kikuyu: Kata bedni achiel kuom apar mar jogi nodongʼ e piny, to gin bende notiekgi pep. To mana kaka yiende mag ngʼowu kod yiend ober motongʼ mowe osiki loth, kamano e kaka jo-Nyasaye mabiro dongʼ e piny nochal gosikino.”
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

kikuyu: wangʼ kar wangʼ, kendo lak kar lak, kendo lwedo kar lwedo kendo tielo kar tielo,
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

kikuyu: Un to uparo nade?” Negidwoko niya, “Owinjore gi tho.”
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

kikuyu: Japur matiyo matek bende ema owinjore ocham nyak mokwongo mar cham.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom jogi: “Gihero bayo alanda kendo tiendegi ok ywe. Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye ok orwakogi; omiyo koro obiro paro timbegi mamono, kendo okumgi kuom richogi.”
english: The LORD says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore the LORD does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”

kikuyu: Utegi ibiro miyo joma moko, kaachiel gi puothegi kod mondegi, ka arieyo lweta kuom jogo modak e piny,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kel dhakono e odi, bangʼe liel wiye kendo ingʼad kokene,
english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

kikuyu: Elisha nochomo wangʼe tir kuom Hazael, mi Hazael wiye nokuot. Bangʼe ngʼat Nyasaye nochako ywak.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

kikuyu: kendo maonge gi miriambo e dhoge, kendo ma ok tim ne wadgi gimoro amora marach kendo ok dir weche makwodo wi dhano wadgi,
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo iwacho ni: “Chiew in ngʼama nindo, chier ia kuom joma otho, to Kristo norieny kuomi.”
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

kikuyu: Kecha, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech aol; changa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech chokena rama malit.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

kikuyu: yien ma lweti ma korachwich ema nopidho gi tiende, ma en wuodi misepidho in iwuon.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Winja, Yaye Nyasaye e kinde manyisi chandruokna; rit ngimana kuom jasigu ma bwoga.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, isechako nyiso jatichni badi mar loch kod tekoni maduongʼ. Nimar en nyasaye mane manie piny kata e polo manyalo timo gik marateke kaka misetimo?
english: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

kikuyu: E kindeno kar kwan mar jopuonjre ne medore, omiyo jo-Yahudi mane wacho dho jo-Yunani nochako ngʼur gi jo-Yahudi wetegi mane wacho dho Hibrania. Jo-Yahudi mane wacho dho jo-Yunani ne ywak ni mon ma chwogi othogi ne ojwangʼ kaluwore gi kony mar chiemo mane ipogo mon ma chwogi otho.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

kikuyu: “Omiyo kik ilamne jogi kata chiwo kwayo moro amora kata kwayonegi lamo; kik isaya, nimar ok anawinji.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

kikuyu: Ma e fweny mane Isaya wuod Amoz noneno kuom Juda kod Jerusalem:
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Eka nopenjo Zeba kod Zalmuna niya, “Ne inego ji machalo nade Tabor?” Negidwoke niya, “Ji machalo kodi, ma ngʼato ka ngʼato ne nigi kido machalo mar ruoth.”
english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

kikuyu: Abner ne oiki e piny Hebron, kendo ruoth noywak malit e liende. Ji duto bende noywak.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

kikuyu: nyaka ochul wuon nyakono sekel piero abich mar fedha. Nyaka okend nyakono nimar osekethone, kendo ok noriembe e ndalo duto mar ngimane.
english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

kikuyu: Kik ulu bangʼ nyiseche manono mondo utinegi kendo ulamgi; kik umi mirima maka gi gik ma lwetu oseloso. Eka ok anahinyu.”
english: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”

kikuyu: Kane gisetieko pogo pinyno e migepe ka migepe, jo-Israel nomiyo Joshua wuod Nun pok e diergi,
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kod Jehoshafat nikech e ndaloge mokwongo nowuotho e yore mane Daudi wuon mare owuothoe. Ne ok oluwo Baal
english: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nodonjo ei bor polono kane odhi ewi got, kendo nobedo ewi got kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Resa e ketho mar chwero remo, yaye Nyasaye, tim kamano, yaye Nyasaye ma wara, eka lewa biro wer kuom timni makare.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Isetimo richo moloyo ji duto mane odak kapok idak. Iseloso ne in iwuon nyiseche mamoko, nyiseche mag chuma; isemiyo iya owangʼ mi idhira ka ngʼeyi.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

kikuyu: “ ‘Malaike ma jorit ema ongʼado kalando wachni ni nyaka otimre, mondo joma ngima ongʼe ni Nyasaye Mamalo Mogik nigi teko ewi pinjeruodhi, kendo en ema ochiwogi ni ngʼato angʼata mohero, kendo onyalo keto dhano adhana mondo otel ni ji.’
english: “‘The sentence is by the decree of the watchers and the demand by the word of the holy ones, to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.’

kikuyu: Chiw nyarombo mar ariyo godhiambo, kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham machalo kamano kod misango miolo piny ma iloso gokinyi. Ma en chiwo miwangʼo pep, misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: En jachwech mar polo gi piny, gi nam kod gik moko duto manie igi, osiko ka en ja-adiera nyaka chiengʼ.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

kikuyu: Ngʼama ofuwo chako gi weche mag fuwo; to gikone ni gin weche neko,
english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

kikuyu: Obiro nenore kaka chich mar miriambo ni joma oseloso kode winjruok, to obiro paronigi kethogi mi okawgi kaka wasumbini.
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

kikuyu: Koro dhakoni, ma nyakwar Ibrahim, ma Satan oseketo kotweyo higni apar gaborogi duto kama donge ber kogonye obed thuolo chiengʼ Sabato oa e gima notweye?”
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Piny ma udonjoe mondo ukaw ok chal gi piny Misri muwuokie, ma en kama nuchwoyoe kothe ka uolonegi pi mana kaka iolone puoth alot.
english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

kikuyu: To nodwokogi niya, “Angʼo ma asetimo kipimo gi gima usetimo? Donge mzabibu mag Efraim modongʼ ber moloyo keyo maduongʼ mar mzabibu mar Abiezer?
english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

kikuyu: Anaor joma tiekou, ngʼato ka ngʼato gi gige lweny, kendo ginitongʼ sirniu mabeyo mag sida mi giwitgi ei mach.
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

kikuyu: “Nyiswa ane gima dwanyis Nyasaye machalo kamano ka kata mana pek ma wan-go ok wanyal ketone e yo mayot.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

kikuyu: Un nyithindo, luoruru jonywolu e gik moko duto, nikech mano ema longʼo ni Ruoth.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

kikuyu: Harun ne en wuon Nadab gi Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai moko nopenjo niya, “Angʼo momiyo utimo gima chik ok oyiego chiengʼ Sabato?”
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Chuny ruoth ni e lwet Jehova Nyasaye, ochike mana kaka kuonde ma pi luwo kendo kaka ohero owuon.
english: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo mano, kendo en gima iwuoro ka waneno.’”
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

kikuyu: “En ngʼa machal kodi e kind nyiseche, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? En ngʼa machalo kodi: in miler moloyo, in ma in-gi duongʼ moloyo kendo matimo honni?
english: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

kikuyu: Kuom ndalogo odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ nyaka itim misango mar golo richo gi rwath mondo pwodhgigo kuom richo, kamano inipwodh kendo mar misango, kiwire gi mo kendo iwalego ne tich Nyasaye.
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

kikuyu: Ginibed gi gik ma giholou, to un ok nubed gi gima unyalo hologi. Ginibed jotelo, to un nubed joma itelonegi.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

kikuyu: Eka Johana notimo nenoni kama: “Ne aneno Roho kalor piny koa e polo e kido mar akuru kendo kapiyo kuome.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre noyango ni nowuoyo kodgi kuom Johana ja-Batiso.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

kikuyu: Adier, wabiro kumo ji duto motamore winjo wach, nyaka chop un duto ubed joma olokore chuth.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

kikuyu: “Mwandu magu kod mago ma ukano anachiw mondo yaki, maonge chudo, nikech richo magu duto e pinyu mangima.
english: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

kikuyu: “Eka wuon-gino nodhi ir wuowi machielo monyise gima nonyiso wuowi mokwongo. To en nodwoko ni, ‘Abiro dhi, jaduongʼ, to ne ok odhi.’ ”
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Misri ok odhi e dalano to koth ok nochwenigi. Jehova Nyasaye nokel kuomgi kit masiche machal gi mago mane oketo kuom oganda mane ok dhi mondo otim Sawo mar Kiche.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘To mana kaka ngʼope maricho, ma ok nyal cham, e kaka anatimne Zedekia ruodh Juda, jotende kod jogo motony moa Jerusalem, kata obedo ni gidongʼ e pinyni kata gidak Misri.
english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely the LORD says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ginichal mana kaka ongʼwengʼo mokinyi, bende kaka thoo mar okinyi malal nono ka nyango owuok, bende kaka mihudhwe ma yamo keyo kar dino, bende kaka iro mawuok e dirisa.
english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi jatich Jehova Nyasaye. An-gi wach e chunya mowuok kuom Nyasaye, kuom gima joricho timo: Ok giluoro Nyasaye kata matin.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nooro wach ni Joab niya, “Orna Uria ja-Hiti.” Eka Joab noore ir Daudi.
english: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

kikuyu: Eka natingʼo wangʼa, mi napo kaneno mon ariyo ka huyo e kor yamo. Ne gin gi bwombe ariyo machalo gi mag nyamnaha, kendo negikawo atonga mi gidhigo e kor polo malo.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

kikuyu: Onge rieko, onge neno matut, onge chenro manyalo loyo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

kikuyu: mopogore gi chikena molamo nyiseche mamoko, kokulorenegi, bed ni en chiengʼ, dwe kata sulwe marieny e kor polo.
english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

kikuyu: Mon mane obiro kod Yesu koa Galili noluwo Josef kendo negineno burno bende ka ringre ne oketi e iye.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

kikuyu: Bangʼ tich maber mane Hezekia otimo, Senakerib ruodh Asuria nobiro momonjo Juda. Ne ogoyo agengʼa ne mier mochiel gohinga koparo ni onyalo kawogi mondo gidok mage.
english: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.

kikuyu: To nyisgiuru kaka pi aora Jordan noduono kane Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kadho. Kane ongʼad kode aora Jordan, to pige mag aora Jordan noduono. Kitegi mondo obed rapar ni jo-Israel nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the LORD’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

kikuyu: Lep achielni ema wapakogo Ruodhwa kendo Wuonwa, en bende ema wakwongʼogo ji mochwe e kit Nyasaye.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

kikuyu: “Mad chiengʼ mane onywolaeni lal nono, kaachiel gi otieno mane owachie ni, ‘Onywol nyathi ma wuowi!’
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

kikuyu: “Koro, uparo ni ka wuon puoth mzabibu obiro to angʼo mobiro timo ne jopur puothego?”
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

kikuyu: Jakobo nowachone, “Ooyo, asayi! Ka isengʼwonona to yie ikaw michgi. Nikech neno wangʼi chalo mana gi neno wangʼ Nyasaye, ka koro iserwaka gi ngʼwono kama.
english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

kikuyu: Bi wamondi gokinyi wadhi, e puothe mzabibu mondo wangʼiane, ka mzabibu oseolo, bende wangʼiane ka gisechako thiewo, kendo ka olembe mongʼinore oselokore makwar; kuno, ema abiro miyie herana.
english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.

kikuyu: To abiro biro mapiyo ka Ruoth Nyasaye oyie, kendo kabiro, to anadwar ngʼeyo ok mana kaka josungago wuoyo kende, to bende napenjgi teko ma gin-go.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

kikuyu: Emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokecho gi joge kendo chunye noa kuom girkeni mare.
english: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

kikuyu: To jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen mane obedo e kombegi mag duongʼ e nyim Nyasaye, nokulore piny auma kendo ne gidendo Nyasaye,
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

kikuyu: Noparo e chunye ni, ‘Angʼo monego atim? Aonge kama dakanie chamba.’
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

kikuyu: Ok wanyal miyogi nyiwa obed mondegi, nimar wan jo-Israel wasekwongʼore kama: ‘Okwongʼ ngʼatno mochiwo nyare mondo okend gi ja-Benjamin.’
english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

kikuyu: Daudi nobedo ruodh jo-Israel duto, kotimo maber kendo makare ni joge duto.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

kikuyu: “In gi Eliazar jadolo kod jotend anywola mag oganda nyaka kwan ji duto kod jamni mane ope.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

kikuyu: Omiyo manreuru mogik gi gige lweny mag Nyasaye, mondo ka kinde mag richo ochopo to uyud teko mar chungʼ kar tiendu kendo kusetimo madwarore duto to mondo uchungʼ.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mobidhore wuotho kaonge luoro, to ngʼatno maluwo yore mobam ibiro yudo mapiyo.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

kikuyu: Puonj wasumbini mondo owinj ruodhi mag-gi e weche duto, kendo gitem timonegi mana gik malongʼo ma ok gidwokore kodgi,
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

kikuyu: Omiyo notho mana kaka wach Jehova Nyasaye mane Elija owacho. Nikech Ahazia ne onge wuowi, Joram nobedo ruoth kare e higa mar ariyo mar loch Jehoram wuod Jehoshafat ruodh Juda.
english: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

kikuyu: Enochung bandera ne ogendini mi ochok jo-Israel mane oriembi e pinygi; kendo enochok jo-Juda kanyakla ka ogologi e tunge angʼwen mag piny.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo Lebanon kendo iywag matek, mad dwondi winjre Bashan, ywagi ka ia Abarim, nimar joma osiepenigo oseduny matindo tindo.
english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.

kikuyu: Owacho kendo niya, “Abiro keto genona kuome.” To bende owacho ni, “Eri an ka, kaachiel gi nyithindo ma Nyasaye osemiya.”
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

kikuyu: Kane oluongo joma wach Nyasaye nobironigi ni ‘nyiseche,’ to ongʼere ni Ndiko ok nyal kethi,
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

kikuyu: Noa kanyo kodhi Peniel kendo ochiwonegi kwayo makamano, to negidwoko mana kaka jo-Sukoth nowacho.
english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

kikuyu: Eka nakawo ludha miluongo ni Ngʼwono mine ature, ka aketho winjruok mane asetimo motelo gi pinje duto.
english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo dwol maduongʼ moa e polo, kawacho niya, “Koro warruok gi teko kod pinyruodh Nyasachwa, gi loch mar Kristo osechopo. Nikech jahang jowetewa, mahangonegi e nyim Nyasachwa odiechiengʼ gi otieno, osewit modir e piny.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

kikuyu: Eka ne apango bakunde mopongʼ gi divai kod kikombe moko e nyim chwo mag anywola mag Rekab kendo awachonegi niya, “Madhuru divai.”
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”

kikuyu: Wuon-gi nodhi mondo one nyakono. Kendo Samson noloso nyasi kanyo, nikech mano ema ne en kit wuowi madwaro nyombo.
english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.

kikuyu: To jomoko kuomgi mane oa Saipras kod Kurene, nodhi Antiokia ma gichako wuoyo gi jo-Yunani bende, ka ginyisogi Injili ma wuoyo kuom Ruoth Yesu.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ji mane ni kanyo duto nonywako ni Paulo gi Sila ka gidonjonegi, omiyo jongʼad bura nochiko mondo olony lepgi mondo ochwadgi.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

kikuyu: To kane pok gimuonyo ring alurugo, mirimb Jehova Nyasaye nomedore kuomgi, kendo nonegogi gi masira malich.
english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.

kikuyu: “Chik jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mondo giwuog oko mar aora Jordan.”
english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Ibiro mako ich kendo ininywol wuowi, to inimiye nying ni Yesu.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

kikuyu: Ok en gima ber chwako ngʼat ma timbene richo kata ketho buch ngʼato maonge ketho.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

kikuyu: Yoreni duto ne ler maonge ketho kata achiel chakre chiengʼ mane ochweyie, nyaka chop chiengʼ mane oyudie ketho kuomi.
english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Iyie mana nikech aa wachoni ni nende aneni e tie yiend ngʼowu. To ibiro neno gik madongo mohingo mano.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

kikuyu: An Johana asiemo ngʼato ka ngʼato mawinjo wechegi mokor mag kitabuni kama: Ka ngʼato moro nomed wach moro amora kuom wechegi, Nyasaye nomedne ngʼatno masiche mondik e kitabuni.
english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

kikuyu: Jo-Jeriko to ne ogero kuonde momakore gohingago kendo, to Zakur wuod Imri nogedo machiegni kodgi.
english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

kikuyu: Amram wuod Kohath nokendo nyamin wuon-gi ma nyinge Jokebed, mane onywolone Harun kod Musa. (Amram nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek gabiriyo.)
english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

kikuyu: To dhood Israel ok oikore winji nikech ok oikore winja, nimar gin joma chunygi tek kendo tokgi tek.
english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gaboro mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, Ahab wuod Omri nobedo ruodh Israel, kendo nobedo ruodh Israel kuom higni piero ariyo gariyo kodak Samaria.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

kikuyu: Sa ngʼado bura mar Jehova Nyasaye kuom jodongo kod jotend joge osechopo, kowacho niya, “Un ema useketho puotha mar mzabibu kendo gik ma uyako kukawo e ut joma odhier opongʼo uteu.
english: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

kikuyu: Ngʼat motimo kode tim makamanono nyaka kel im e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo mondo timgo misango mar pwodhruok e ketho.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Adier, onge gima nyalo yienge, ngʼat makare ibiro par nyaka chiengʼ.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

kikuyu: Shama ja-Harod, gi Elika ja-Harod.
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ok ijwangʼogi kata obedo nine gitimo timbe mag anjawo, ka giloso kido mar nyaroya mi giwacho niya, ‘Ma en nyasachu, mane ogolou e piny Misri.’
english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

kikuyu: ne gimol ewi gode, ka giridore gidhi e holni, kuonde mane ochan-negi.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi gowi mar ngʼato, makmana gowi mar hera, nimar ngʼama ohero wadgi osechopo Chik.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

kikuyu: Abiro lwori koni gi koni, mi anagoni agengʼa kendo namonji gi tekona.
english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

kikuyu: Bede duto biro wengni; kendo chonge duto biro nyosore.
english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

kikuyu: Gik ma nengogi tek molos gi dhahabu gi fedha mane amiyi bende ne ikawo mi ilosogo nyisechegi machwo mondo ichodi.
english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni pod en e piny ka, to dine ok obedo jadolo, nikech nitie jodolo moromo machiwo mich duto kaka chik dwaro.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

kikuyu: To kaw ludhni e lweti nimar ibiro timo kode honni gi ranyisi.”
english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

kikuyu: Loch marach bende inyalo riworigo adier, loch mamiyo ji chandore malit nikech chikene maricho?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma an-go e polo makmana in? Piny bende onge gi gimoro amora madwaro moloyi.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

kikuyu: Opak Jehova Nyasaye nikech osewinjo ywakna ma akwayogo kony.
english: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Efeso kama: Magi e weche Jal motingʼo sulwe abiriyo e lwete korachwich kendo mawuotho e kind rachungi teyni abiriyo mag dhahabu:
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

kikuyu: mondo okel Vashti ma mikache ire ka orwako osimbo mar mikach ruoth, kendo mondo onyis ji to gi jotelo kaka ojaber, nikech nober neno.
english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

kikuyu: kata ka dine in ngʼama ler kendo ngimani oriere tir, to dine oani malo mokonyi, kendo dine oduogi kari mowinjore kodi.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: to nyiimbe abiriyo-ka, to uchiw gi kilo adek.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Ngʼe ni an-gi teko mar hinyi, to Nyasach wuonu ne onyisa otieno manyoro ni, ‘Ne ni ok iwachone Jakobo gimoro amora, maber kata marach.’
english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

kikuyu: Kamano ruoth Solomon nobedo ruodh Israel duto.
english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka Hiram nochiwo ni Solomon gi yien duto mag Sida gi bao mane odwaro,
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo apargo ndendgi ne ber moloyo mar yawuowi mane chamo chiemo moa e od ruoth.
english: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

kikuyu: To kochopo orucha kar odhiambo kanyo to idhi kama ne ipondoe mokwongo ka wechegi nochakore kendo irit but kit Ezel.
english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

kikuyu: To in ma kinde ma yamb milambo kudho mi two piny, to isiko mana ka luya chami ei lewni mirwakogi,
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

kikuyu: Kendo pigno osesiko ka ber nyaka chil kawuono kaluwore gi wach mane Elisha owacho.
english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Naftali noromo ji alufu piero abich gadek gi mia angʼwen (53,400).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: “Ji duto parogi ok ti kendo gionge ngʼeyo; jotheth duto wigi kuot gi nyisechegi manono, ma githedho. Kido mage moloso gin gik manono; gionge muya eigi.
english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Lingʼ iwe ywak kendo ywe pi wangʼi, nimar nochuli kuom tichni. Giniduogi ka gia e piny wasigu.” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: The LORD says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says the LORD. “They will come again from the land of the enemy.

kikuyu: E ndalogo jo-Filistia nochoko jolwenjgi mondo oked gi Israel. Akish nowacho ni Daudi niya, “Nyaka ingʼe ni in gi jogi udhi koda e lweny.”
english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

kikuyu: “Kaw kitabu machielo kendo indikie weche duto mane ni e kitabu mokwongo-cha, mane Jehoyakim ruodh Juda owangʼo.
english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

kikuyu: Modekai nonyise gik moko duto mosetimorene, nonyise koda kar romb pesa ma Haman nosesingore nodhi chulo e kar keno mar joka ruoth mondo otiekgo jo-Yahudi.
english: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.

kikuyu: In ema ne aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; Ruoth Nyasaye ema ne aywakne mondo okecha.
english: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

kikuyu: Kendo kinde moko jachiendno osebedo ka chumbe ei mach kata e pi, mondo onege. Omiyo kinyalo timo gimoro to yie ikechwa kendo ikonywa.”
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

kikuyu: Joma Jehova Nyasaye osereso nodwogi. Ginidonji e dala Sayun ka giwer; mor mochwere nobed kuomgi. Ginibed gi mor kod ilo, kendo kuyo gi parruok nolal nono kuomgi.
english: Those ransomed by the LORD will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

kikuyu: gi kit agak duto,
english: any kind of raven,

kikuyu: Piny joma otho otuk duto ka romoni kidonjo kuno, kendo ochiewo chunje joma ne osetho mondo omosi, ma gin jogo duto mane jotelo e piny; omiyo jogo duto mane ruodhi mag ogendini aa malo e kombegi mag loch.
english: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

kikuyu: Nimar aseyiere mondo ochik nyithinde kod nyikwaye mondo oluw yore Jehova Nyasaye ka gitimo timbe mabeyo kendo makare. Kamano Jehova Nyasaye biro timo ne Ibrahim gik moko duto mane osingone.”
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhu kuom timona maber.
english: Saul said, “You are blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.

kikuyu: Ka Jared ne ja-higni mia achiel gi piero auchiel gariyo, nonywolo Enok.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

kikuyu: Notimo richo nikech ne ok oketo chunye mondo odwar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek the LORD.

kikuyu: Bende nochwogo okumbni matindo mia adek mobaw gi dhahabu, okumba ka okumba nobaw gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo adek gi nus. Magi duto ruoth noketo e ode manogero e Bungu mag Lebanon.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Piny dhi kodgi maber higa ka higa, kendo githo ka gin gi kwe.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

kikuyu: nyikwa Harim, ji alufu achiel gi apar gabiriyo (1,017).
english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

kikuyu: Baruwa mane ioronwa osesomnwa kendo oloki e nyima.
english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

kikuyu: “Ne antiere e dala mar Jopa ka alemo, to ka ayula wangʼ notera, ne aneno fweny. Ne aneno gima chalo suka malach kiloro piny koa e polo, komak kondene angʼwen. Nolor sukano nyaka kama ne antie.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

kikuyu: Kane Jezebel nego jonabi mag Jehova Nyasaye, Obadia nokawo jonabi mia achiel mopandogi e buche mag pondo ariyo ka ji piero abich abich e moro ka moro kendo nomiyogi pi gi chiemo.
english: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

kikuyu: E tok dhoutu kod ewi sirni mag dhoutu useketoe kido mar nyisecheu manono. Adier useweya mabor muchalo nyiri molonyore duk kendo unindo e kitanda malach ma useloso; usetimo winjruok gi joma uhero kitendinigi kendo ne uneno dugegi.
english: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.

kikuyu: Ka uchiko itu ne chikegi kendo uritogi adimba, eka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu norit singruokne mar hera kodu kaka ne osingore ne kwereu.
english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

kikuyu: Abiro bedo mamor kendo abiro bedo moil kodi; abiro pako nyingi gi wer, yaye Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

kikuyu: To Hezekia nolokore moweyo timo richo mar sungruok e chunye mana kaka jo-Jerusalem bende notimo, omiyo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye ne ok ochako omake kodgi e ndalo Hezekia.
english: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the LORD’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowachone Ziba niya, “Gik moko duto ma mag Mefibosheth koro gin magi.” Ziba nowachone niya, “Erokamano. Mad ayud ngʼwono e wangʼ ruodha ma en ruoth.”
english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Pergamo kama: Magi e weche Jal man-gi ligangla mabith ma dhoge ariyo:
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

kikuyu: Ne giloye gi remb Nyarombo, kendo gi Wach Nyasaye mane gihulo, bende ne ok gidew ngimagi ahinya mane nyalo miyo giluor tho.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

kikuyu: Koa kuom yawuot Rehabia noyier Ishia mokwongo.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

kikuyu: Ji nobi koa e dala mag Juda kod mier molworo Jerusalem, koae gwengʼ Benjamin gi tiend gode matindo ma yo podho chiengʼ, koa e piny manie gode matindo kod Negev, ka gikelo misango miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko, chiwo mag cham, ubani gi chiwo mag goyo erokamano e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: kama Azmon ogomoe, moriwre gi Wadi mar Misri kendo gikone en Nam Mediterania.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en osiep joma miye luor; omiyo gingʼeyo singruok mage.
english: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, “Ndalo biro ma abiro kelo kech e piny, to ok nobed kech mar chiemo, kata riyo mar pi, to nobed riyo mar winjo wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the LORD’s words.

kikuyu: Jehoyada nogamone mon ariyo manonywologo yawuowi kod nyiri.
english: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Ihero joma ochayi to ichayo joma oheri. Kawuono inyiso ratiro ni jotend lweny gi jolwenygi ok gimoro e nyimi. Aneno ni dine imor ka Abisalom ngima kawuono to wan duto ne watho.
english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo ooro ji mondo omak Daudi, Mikal nowacho niya, “Otuo.”
english: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Gad nodhi ir Daudi mowachone niya, “Diyier mondo kech omak piny kuom higni adek? Koso diyier dweche adek kiringo wasiki malawi? Koso diyier ndalo adek mag masira? Koro par ane mondo imiya dwoko matero ni ngʼama ne oora.”
english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

kikuyu: kendo ma ite beyo, manyago olemo mangʼeny, mamiyo gik moko duto chiemo, machiwo kar dak ne le mag bungu kendo ma winy mafuyo e kor polo e in.
english: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation—

kikuyu: to obiro dak e mier mokethore, kendo e udi maonge joma odakie, ma gin udi mosemukore molokore gunda.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

kikuyu: Jomoko moa Judea nobiro Antiokia kendo negipuonjo jowete kagiwacho niya, “Ka ok oteru nyangu kaluwore gi chik mane Musa opuonjo to ok unyal yudo warruok.”
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa noluongo Dathan kod Abiram, ma yawuot Eliab. To negiwacho niya, “Ok wanabi!
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

kikuyu: Ondiegi mamoko noyudo osetiek lochgi, to makmana nine pod owegi mangima kuom ndalo manok.
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

kikuyu: “Kaw kite ariyo mag oniks kendo ikedgi kaka ikedo kido ka indiko nying yawuot Israel,
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Dichwo moro amora mane obet e achiel gi dhakono e kinde moneno malo nobed mogak kuom ndalo abiriyo, kendo nyaka kitanda monindoe bende nobed mogak.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Kane Paulo dhi nyime gi wuoyo kamano, Festo nokok matek niya, “Wiyi okethore, Paulo! Somo misomo mangʼeny oseloki janeko!”
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

kikuyu: Isengʼado ndalo mag tin-ne odoko machiek; isemiyo oneno wichkuot maduongʼ. Sela
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un gik moko duto mochweyo, manie bwo lochne kuonde duto. Pak Jehova Nyasaye, yaye chunya.
english: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

kikuyu: mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye, kendo Ahio ne wuotho e nyime.
english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni kamano e kaka mor nobedi e polo kuom jaricho achiel molokore, moloyo mor kuom ji piero ochiko gochiko mabeyo ma ok dwar weyo richo.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

kikuyu: Nowacho bende ni japuonjreno niya, “Neye mamau!” Chakre chiengʼno japuonjreno nokawe odhi kode dalane owuon.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

kikuyu: Ka osejaru e dier ogendini, eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi ne gin: Jeshua wuod Azania, Binui ma nyakwar Henadad, Kadmiel,
english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

kikuyu: “Koro mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingo, osemiya ngima kuom higni piero angʼwen gabich nyaka nowach ne Musa wachni, e kinde mane jo-Israel ne pod wuotho e thim. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye oserito ngimana, makoro an gi higni piero aboro gabich!
english: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

kikuyu: Yawuot Gomer ne gin: Ashkenaz, Rifath, kod Togarma.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, joka Kora ne ok orumo.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moketo genone kuome owuon ofuwo, to ngʼatno mawuotho e rieko, oritore maonge hinyruok.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

kikuyu: “Ka aywak ni, ‘Itimona marach!’ Onge ngʼama dewa; to kata ka adwaro kony, to ok anyal yudo.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

kikuyu: E Kama Ler Moloyo nopayo kerubi ariyo kendo obawogi kod dhahabu.
english: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne ineno ka tiend kidono gi lith tiendene olos gi chuma mokikore gi lowo mowangʼ mano e kaka nobed pinyruoth mopogore kende; to kata kamano, enobed gi teko moko mag chuma e iye, mana kaka ne ineno chuma mokikore gi lowo mowangʼ.
english: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

kikuyu: To e sechego jolweny mane Amazia oriembo ni ok inyal dhi kode e lweny nomonjo miech Juda chakre Samaria nyaka Beth Horon. Neginego ji alufu adek kendo negipeyo gik moko mangʼeny.
english: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.

kikuyu: E kinde mane Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye donjo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, Mikal nyar Saulo nongʼicho gie dirisa. Kendo kane oneno Ruoth Daudi kachikore kendo miel aduwa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nochaye gi chunye.
english: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ onogo jotich Isaka nobiro ire monyise kuom soko mane gisekunyo. Negiwachone niya, “Waseyudo pi!”
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

kikuyu: To kagiwacho ni, ‘Biuru irwa,’ to wabiro idho malo, nikech mano biro bedonwa ranyisi ni Jehova Nyasaye oseketogi e lwetwa.”
english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for the LORD has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

kikuyu: Eka abiro bedo jaloch ka aloyo wasigu duto molwora; abiro timo misango mar pak ka akok gimor e hembe maler. Abiro wer kendo abiro loso wende mamit ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

kikuyu: Wuowino nokwerogi niya, “Weuru bwok. Umanyo Yesu ja-Nazareth, mane ogur. Oonge ka, osechier! Neuru kamane gipiele.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

kikuyu: Kamano, dhakono nowuonde gi weche mamit; mi nohoye kendo odhi kode.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone niya, “Yaye ruodha, akwongʼora e nyimi ni an e dhako mane ochungʼ buti cha kalamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.

kikuyu: kendo enokwan chakre higni mane ouse lopeno, kendo chulo ngʼatno pesa moromo gi higni ma pod odongʼ nyaka chop higa mar mor, eka koro oyiene kawo lopno obed mare kendo.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: To mana kaka Jona ne en ranyisi ne jo-Nineve e kaka Wuod Dhano biro bedo ne tiengʼni.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

kikuyu: Jotend Isakar ne nigi Debora; adier, Isakar ne nigi Barak, koreto bangʼe ka gichiko holo. To e gwenge mag Reuben ne nitiere nono chuny matut.
english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.

kikuyu: Mogik en owuon nowuok modhi Rama ka nochopo e Soko maduongʼ man Seku. Nopenjo niya, “Ere Samuel gi Daudi?” Negidwoke niya, “Gin Nayoth e gwengʼ Rama.”
english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”

kikuyu: Kendo Ibrahim nowacho ne Nyasaye niya, “Mano nyalo mana timore kaponi Ishmael odak e bwo ngʼwono mari!”
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okwongʼo wuon mare kata min mare, to ngimane norum mana ka taya motho e mudho molil.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato madineyudre kuomgi monego duogi mondo omi Nyasaye pak, mana japiny moro nononi kende ema odwogo?”
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

kikuyu: Res ngimana kuom ligangla, res ngimana e teko guogi.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

kikuyu: “Gibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, e kinde ma anabolgi e dier ogendini kendo akegi e dier pinje.
english: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

kikuyu: Nochielogi motegno moketo jotend jolweny kuno kaachiel gi kar kano chiemo, mo zeituni kod divai.
english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

kikuyu: Waduto ne waleko lek otieno moro achiel, kendo lek ka lek ne nigi tiende.
english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

kikuyu: Koro winj gima giwacho; makmana isiemgi matek, kendo mondo inyisgi mondo gingʼe gik ma ruoth mabiro ritogi biro timo.”
english: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

kikuyu: Ji duto mane nigi chandruok kata mane nigi gowi kata nigi ngʼur moro amora nochokore modhi ire, mine obet jatendgi. Ne gin chwo madirom mia angʼwen mane ni kode.
english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

kikuyu: Wuon mare ne pok otale kata penje niya, “En angʼo momiyo itimo kamano?” Bende ne en gi chia kendo nonywole koluwo bangʼ Abisalom.
english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowachonegi niya, “Onge ngʼato manokan chiemono kata matin nyaka okinyi.”
english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

kikuyu: to en nochungʼ kar tiende mi nonego jo-Filistia nyaka bade nojony ma lwete omoko e ligangla. Jehova Nyasaye nokelo loch maduongʼ chiengʼno, jolweny noduogo ir Eliazar to mana ni yako gige joma otho.
english: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

kikuyu: En ema ruodhi mag piny noterore kode, kendo ji duto modak e piny bende osemadho divai mar terruokne mi omer.”
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell on the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
