kikuyu: Abiro miyo ji mangʼeny dhogi moki ka gineni, kendo ruodhigi luoro nomaki, nikech en chiengʼ ma nomonjgie. E odiechiengʼ ma inipodhie, moro ka moro kuomgi notetni, seche duto ka giparo ni gin bende gibiro tho.
english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa jotij Solomon ne gin: nyikwa Sotai, Hasofereth, Peruda,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Satan niya, “Kare ber, gimoro amora ma en-go ni e lweti, to en owuon kik imule kata gi lith lweti.” Eka Satan nowuok oa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

kikuyu: To kaka en kitu mondo agonynu achiel kuom joma otwe e kinde mag sawo mar Pasaka, duher mondo agonynu ‘ruodh jo-Yahudi’ koso?”
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Ka giwinjo wachne mi gitiyone, to gibiro dak e mwandu ndalogi mabiro, kendo gibiro dak ka gin gi gimoro amora e higni mabiro.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

kikuyu: Ne ok ginyal chalo gi kweregi; mane tiengʼ ma tokgi tek kendo ma jongʼanyo, ma chunjegi ne ok ochiwore ne Nyasaye kendo ne ok luwe gi adiera.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

kikuyu: Eka Esta nooro dwoko ne Modekai kama:
english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

kikuyu: Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Wan kod lum kod chiemb ngamia mangʼeny kaachiel gi ot ma unyalo nindoe.”
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

kikuyu: Jomatindo tiyo matek kuonde mag rego, to yawuowi chandore ka gitingʼo yien mapek.
english: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

kikuyu: To e nyime kanyo ne nitie ngʼato mane bur okuodo ngʼute maduongʼ.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

kikuyu: Neuru ni ok utamoru winjo dwond Jal ma wuoyo kodu. Nikech ka gin bende ne ok gitony kane gidagi winjo dwond Musa mane osiemogi e piny-ka, wan to koro dwatony nade ka wadagi winjo Jal masiemowa gie polo?
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

kikuyu: Kik ogalre koketo genone kuom gima onge tich nikech onge ohala mobiro yudo kuom timo kamano.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowuok modhi kuma Saulo nojotie. Noneno kama Saulo gi Abner wuod Ner ma jatend jolwenje, noyudo osenindoe. Saulo ne nindo ei kambi, ka jolweny olwore.
english: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.

kikuyu: Bende ber mondo soknigi omol ka oo oko e yore mag dala, kata aoregi mag pi e kuonde chokruok manie dier dala?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

kikuyu: “Emomiyo wachne dhood Israel ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ok abi timo gigo nikech un, yaye dhood Israel, to abiro timogi nikech nyinga maler, ma usedwanyo e dier ogendini kuonde duto musedhiyoe.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

kikuyu: Jochan gin wasumb jo-mwandu, to ngʼat moholo gimoro bedo misumba ngʼat mohole.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kikuyu: Dhakono nopenjo Elija niya, “En rach mane ma in-go koda, ngʼat Nyasaye? Ne ibiro mondo iparna richona kendo mondo ineg wuoda?”
english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona niya,
english: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: joka Anathoth, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gaboro (128),
english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: Jo-Turo mane odak Jerusalem ne kelo rech kod gige ohala mopogore opogore bangʼe gihonogi ei Jerusalem ne jo-Juda chiengʼ Sabato.
english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Wuowi moro ma min mare ja-Israel to wuon mare ja-Misri nowuok e dier jo-Israel kendo dhawo nowuok e kambi e kinde gi ja-Israel moro.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

kikuyu: E barupego nondikoe kama: “Luonguru odiechieng tweyo chiemo kendo keturu Naboth obed piny e nyim ji kama oyiedhi.
english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gabiriyo mar twech Jehoyakin ruodh Juda, e higa mane Evil-Merodak obedo ruodh Babulon, nogonyo Jehoyakin e twech e odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo gabiriyo, e dwe mar apar gariyo.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

kikuyu: Ne aparo e chunya niya, “Koro, asedongo kendo amedora e rieko moloyo ngʼato angʼata moserito Jerusalem motelona; kendo asebedo gi lony e rieko kod ngʼeyo.”
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

kikuyu: Herode nomedo timo gima rachie moloyo kendo nomako Johana motero e od twech.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

kikuyu: Eka janabi Jeremia nodwoko janabi Hanania e nyim jodolo kod ji duto mane ochungʼ e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the LORD’s house,

kikuyu: Kane Mikaya ochopo, ruoth nopenje niya, “Bende wanyalo dhi mondo waked gi jo-Ramoth Gilead, koso kik wadhi?” Nodwoke niya, “Ked kodgi kendo iyud loch nimar ibiro chiwgi e lweti.”
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

kikuyu: Lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma korachwich otingʼ malo; lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma korachwich osetimo gik madongo!”
english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

kikuyu: Petro nomedo dak Jopa e od janyongʼ piende moro miluongo ni Simon kuom kinde mogwarore.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

kikuyu: Kuom mano mich Jakobo noter motelo, ka en to nodongʼ ei kambi.
english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye biro mako dho jo-Asuria; to gi odungane obiro negogi.
english: For through the LORD’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

kikuyu: Ne nitiere gik mongʼinore ongʼinore piero ochiko gauchiel e bethe sirni, kwan gik mongʼinore ongʼinore duto ne gin mia achiel mane olworo gima otwangʼ mongʼith.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

kikuyu: Wir karaya kod rachungine kendo iwalgi.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

kikuyu: Kane Pilato owinjo mano, luoro nomedo make moloyo,
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

kikuyu: Gin bende negipenjo niya, “Joma gero odni nying-gi ngʼa?”
english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.

kikuyu: Dhako ma chwore otho keto genone duto kuom Nyasaye, kendo osiko olamo odiechiengʼ gotieno kokwayo Nyasaye mondo okonye.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

kikuyu: mi owacho ne chokruok mar oganda jo-Israel duto niya, “Piny mane wakalo e iye kendo wanono ber miwuoro.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

kikuyu: Yawuot Shomer ne gin: Ahi, Roga, Huba kod Aram.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

kikuyu: Denda kute gi adhonde opongʼo, pien denda mbala omako kendo chwer tutu.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro gwedho decheu kaachiel gi gimoro amora ma uchiworu timo, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro gwedhou e piny ma omiyou.
english: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: to ka gidwogo iri gi chunygi duto kod ngimagi duto e piny mane otergi e twech, kendo gilemo ka girango pinygi mane imiyo kweregi, kod dala maduongʼ miseyiero kod hekalu ma asegero ni nyingi,
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jodonge, ma en Peka wuod Remalia nojame mondo otimne marach. Nokawo ji piero abich moa Gilead odhigo monego Pekahia kaachiel gi Argob kod Arie, e kind siro mar kar od ruoth man Samaria. Omiyo Peka nonego Pekahia mobedo ruoth kare.
english: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni wan nyithind Nyasaye, kendo piny duto ni e bwo loch mar ngʼama rach.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

kikuyu: Bende ka ngʼato angʼata omiyo achiel kuom jomatindogi kata mana pi mangʼich gi kikombe, nikech en japuonjrena, to awachonu adier ni pokne ok nobaye ngangʼ.”
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

kikuyu: Un oganda jo-Israel duto mane agolo e piny Misri, winjuru wach ma an Jehova Nyasaye awachonu:
english: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

kikuyu: ma en ringre Kristo. En e Jal mapongʼo kendo romo gik moko duto.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

kikuyu: Ere kaka ngʼama pod tin nyalo rito ngimane mondo osik ka oler? Onyalo rito mana ka odak moluwore gi wachni.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

kikuyu: Kane Balaam ongʼiyo oko mi oneno jo-Israel kochokore e dhoot ka dhoot, Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuome
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

kikuyu: Tim matek mondo ikony Zena ngʼat molony e chik kod Apolo e wuodhgi, kendo ne ni giyudo gik moko duto magidwaro.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

kikuyu: to nongʼiewu gi nengo matek. Omiyo miuru Nyasaye duongʼ gi ringreu.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

kikuyu: Ne okete e bur e kind joricho kendo gi jo-mwandu e thone, kata obedo ni ne ok otimo tim mahundu moro amora bende miriambo nine ok owuok e dhoge.
english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

kikuyu: Wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi mahalath leanoth.Maskil mar Heman ja-Ezra. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e Nyasacha ma resa, aywagora e nyimi odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼ ka dweche abiriyogo oserumo, noyier ji ma nosik kawuotho e piny mondo oik ringre joma otho ma giyudo ka pod oriere ewi lowo mondo gipwodh piny obed maler.
english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.

kikuyu: kama kwereu noteme gi tem, kata obedo ni ne giseneno gima ne atimo.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

kikuyu: Simon Petro nodonjo ei pi, mi noywayo gogo nyaka dho wath. Nopongʼ gi rech madongo dongo ma dirom rech mia achiel gi piero abich gadek, to kata negingʼeny kamano, to gogo ne ok oyiech.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

kikuyu: Nodwoka niya, “Gitere e piny Babulon mondo gigerne ot kuno. Ka odno oseikore, to noket atongano kare moselosne kanyo.”
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

kikuyu: Kata mana gik maonge ngima kuomgi, kaka asili, kata nyatiti, to dingʼe ywakgi nadi ka ok ipogo dwondgi?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

kikuyu: To nodwokogi niya, “An ja-Hibrania kendo alamo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach polo, mane ochweyo nam kod piny.”
english: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

kikuyu: Ket ketho e wigi kuom ketho ka ketho ma gitimo; kendo kik iyie giyud warruok mari.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Bende joma timo timbe maricho dipuonjre adier? Gin joma kidho joga kaka ji chamo kuon; kendo gin joma ok luong Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi.
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Anaket jok mar chuma e ngʼut ogendinigi mondo gitine Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, kendo ginitine. Kendo anamiye teko ewi le mag bungu.’ ”
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”

kikuyu: Ne, koro eri achungo e bath sokoni, kama nyi dalani biro umboe pi.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

kikuyu: To onego ulam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, en ema obiro resou e lwet wasiku duto.”
english: But you shall fear the LORD your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”

kikuyu: Wuone ok nonegi nikech ketho mag nyithindgi, bende nyithindo kik negi nikech ketho mag wuonegi, to ngʼato ka ngʼato nonegi nikech richone owuon.
english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni asetimo gimoro mowinjore gi tho, to ok atamora mondo kik nega. To ka nyalo bet ni ketho ma jo-Yahudigi odonjonago gin miriambo, to onge ngʼato man-gi teko mar chiwa e lwetgi. Kuom mano, akwayo mondo otera e nyim Kaisar.”
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kuom sirni, Nam, gik minyalo tingʼ kod gik mamoko modongʼ e dala maduongʼni,
english: For the LORD of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,

kikuyu: Jadolo nodwokogi niya, “Dhiuru gi kwe. Wuodhu osepwodhi gi Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kik uwuondru kendu, Nyasaye ok nyal wuondi. Ngʼeuru gima ichwoyo ema ikayo.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

kikuyu: Noluongo Barak wuod Abinoam moa Kedesh man Naftali kendo owachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, chiki ni, ‘Dhiyo, ikaw ji alufu apar mag Naftali kod Zebulun kendo itelnegi ka udhi e Got Tabor.
english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Tera, Nahor nodak higni mia achiel gapar gochiko kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: mar apar gabich ne Bilga, to mar apar gauchiel ne Imer,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

kikuyu: Eka Harun noyangʼo rwath kod im mane itimogo misango mar lalruok ni oganda. Yawuote nogamone remo mokiro e bethe duto mag kendo mar misango.
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

kikuyu: To dwoko nobed: ‘Nikech gisejwangʼo singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi kendo giselamo kendo tiyone nyiseche mamoko.’ ”
english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mar adek, Josef nowachonegi niya, “Timuru ma mondo mi udagi, nikech aluoro Nyasaye:
english: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

kikuyu: “Kik ungʼad ne ji bura, eka ok nongʼadnu bura. Kik uwuo kuom ngʼato marach, to ok bi wuo kuomu. Weuru ne ji richogi, to ibiro weyonu richou.
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

kikuyu: Odheru mare mar piedho cham ni e lwete mondo opiedhgo cham duto maler e kar dino cham, kendo ochok cham koketo e deche, to obiro wangʼo mihudhi gi mach ma ok nyal negi.”
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Refidim mi gibworo e Thim mar Sinai.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Manreuru gi gige lweny duto mag Nyasaye, mondo eka uchungʼ motegno kutangʼ ne wuond mar Jachien.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

kikuyu: Ne giwuok ka gidhi e pinje mag gode ma gichopo e Holo mar Eshkol mondo ginon kaka pinyno obet.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

kikuyu: Abiro pidhe e piny ne an awuon; abiro nyiso herana ni ngʼat mane aluongo ni ‘Ok jaherana.’ Anawach ni joma iluongo ni, ‘Joma ok joga,’ ni, ‘Un joga’; kendo ginidwoka ni, ‘In Nyasachwa.’ ”
english: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”

kikuyu: Nikech hera mar Kristo chunowa mondo watim gik ma watimo, nikech wan gi ratiro ni ngʼato achiel notho ni ji duto; omiyo ji duto notho.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

kikuyu: To min nyathi nowacho kama, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye kod nyingi iwuon ni ok anaweyi.” Omiyo noa malo moluwo dhakono.
english: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

kikuyu: Mano kaka an ngʼama chandore! En ngʼa mabiro resa kuom ringruokni mar tho?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

kikuyu: Wuoda, chik iti ni puonj wuonu, kendo kik ijwangʼ puonj mar minu.
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka higni abiriyogo noserumo, an Nebukadneza nangʼiyo polo, kendo pacha noduogo kare. Eka napako Jal Man Malo Mogik, mangima manyaka chiengʼ kamiye luor kod duongʼ kendo napake.
english: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Siem yo Ai gi tongʼ mitingʼo e lwetino, nikech e lweti abiro chiwoe dala maduongʼno.” Omiyo Joshua nosiemo tongʼe kochiko Ai.
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.” Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.

kikuyu: Kik uti gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e yo ma ok owinjore, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ok nongʼwon ne ngʼato angʼata matiyo gi nyinge e yo marach.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno ne asingoranegi ni anagolgi e piny Misri mi atergi e piny mane asemanyo mi ayudonegi, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich kendo piny maber moloyo pinje duto.
english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat ma ok ni koda kedo koda, kendo ngʼat ma ok konya choko ji keyo ji.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

kikuyu: Ji chunogi gitoyo zeituni kuonde ma gin ema gikunyo, kendo gibiyo olemb mzabibu to gin riyo negogi.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kikuyu: Abiro gologi Misri mi aduog-gi kendo abiro chokogi ka agologi Asuria. Abiro kelogi Gilead kod Lebanon, kendo ginibed mathoth mohingo kama omigi.
english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

kikuyu: Balaam nodwoko pundano niya, “Isemiya achalo ngʼama ofuwo! Kane bed ni an-gi ligangla e lweta, to dikoro asenegi.”
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

kikuyu: nikech ndiko wacho niya, “oseketo gik moko duto e bwo tiende.” To ka ndiko wuoyo kuom “gik moko duto” to ongʼere ni mano ok oriwo Nyasaye owuon nikech en ema oketo gik moko duto e bwo loch Kristo.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowachone e lek niya, “Ee angʼeyo ni nitimo ma kod paro malongʼo omiyo aseriti mondo kik iketh e nyima. Mano ema nomiyo ok ayieni mondo iriwri kode.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ kapok chiengʼ opodho chule kar tichne mosetiyo, nikech odhier ma chudono ema ogeno, ka ok kamano to onyalo ywak ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech in kendo inibed jaketho.
english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ne osingorenegi kosiemogi gi lwete nine obiro miyo gipodhi e thim,
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye ema nomi ibed jachir kendo norit tiendi mondo kik odonji e obadho.
english: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

kikuyu: Gigi duto notimore mondo obednwa ranyisi masiemowa mondo kik wagomb gik maricho kaka ne gigombo.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

kikuyu: Noyie uwinjo dwonde gie polo mond opuonjugo. Bende noyienu ma uneno mach makakni e piny, kendo nuwinjo dwonde ei majno.
english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

kikuyu: mondo uyie bet e bwo joma kamago, kendo e bwo joma tiyo kaachiel kodgi.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

kikuyu: Nimar ibiro piru maber kudhodho thunde; kendo unumethi gi ilo mi ubed gi mor mogundho.”
english: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokwongʼore kendo osingore ne Daudi, kendo ne en kwongʼruok ma ok enoloki ngangʼ; nokwongʼorene niya, “Abiro keto achiel kuom kothi e lochni,
english: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

kikuyu: kendo kane osechiemo matin, to tekone noduogo. Saulo nodak gi jopuonjre Damaski kuom ndalo mogwarore,
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

kikuyu: koa kuom jo-Zebulun: Ishmaya wuod Obadia notelonegi; koa kuom jo-Naftali: Jerimoth wuod Azriel notelonegi;
english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

kikuyu: Mano e gima timore ne joma oweyo Nyasaye; kamano e kaka geno mar joma okia Nyasaye rumo.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

kikuyu: To roho marach ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo thuolo nobiro kuom Saulo kama nobetie piny ei ode ka otingʼo tongʼe e lwete. Kane Daudi ne goyo nyatiti,
english: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

kikuyu: Eka nawacho niya, “Eri an ka, asebiro mana kaka ondiki kuoma e Muma.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

kikuyu: Jatend dhout Merari ne en Zuriel wuod Abihail. Nonego gidagi yo nyandwat mar kama ler.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Wuon-gi nopenjogi niya, “Noluwo yo mane?” To yawuote nonyise yo mane ngʼat Nyasaye moa Juda noluwo.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

kikuyu: to achiel kuom adek machielo to orit od ruoth, to achiel kuom adek modongʼ to orit Ranga Mise to ji mamoko modongʼ duto to nobed e laru mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi malo ingʼi polo, bende rang piny gie polo, nikech polo nolal nono mana ka iro, to piny bende biro ti mana ka law kendo oganda modak e iye notho mana ka lwangʼni. To resruok makelo nosiki nyaka chiengʼ kendo adiera mara ok norum.
english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

kikuyu: Ngʼato achiel noringo okawo siponj ma onyume e kongʼo makech, kendo nochome ewi odundu mabor bangʼe omiyo Yesu mondo omadhi. Kowacho niya, “Koro weyeuru mos, wane ka Elija biro mondo orese.”
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

kikuyu: Nimar geno machal kama ema ne oreswae. To geno mineno ok en geno ngangʼ. Koso en ngʼa manyalo geno gima osebedogo?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

kikuyu: To negidwoko niya, “Ee entie, ero odhi nyimu kanyo, returu. Koro eka odonjo e dalawa kawuono nimar jowa timo misango e kama owal.”
english: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.

kikuyu: Muk lekegi ei dhogi, yaye Nyasaye, yiech kwiri mag sibuoche oko, yaye Jehova Nyasaye!
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

kikuyu: To ka joote notero wach ma ruoth nochiko, Vashti ma mikach ruoth notamore dhi. Eka ruoth nobedo makwiny kendo iye nowangʼ ahinya.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

kikuyu: “Wachnwa ane, gigi biro timore karangʼo, koso en ranyisi mane manotimre ma nonyis ni gigi duto chiegni chopo kare?”
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Josef noleko, kendo kane onyiso owetene lekno, to owetene nomedo bedo mamon kode.
english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane obedo e buch Sanhedrin ne ngʼiyo Stefano ma wengegi ok diemre, kendo negineno ka lela wangʼe chal gi lend wangʼ malaika.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

kikuyu: Ngʼat molocho anami thuolo mar bedo koda e kom duongʼna mana kaka an bende kane aselocho ne abedo gi wuora e kom duongʼne.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

kikuyu: Kik igol wach mar adiera e dhoga chuth, nimar aseketo genona e chikeni.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

kikuyu: Wechegi nodonjo e chuny Daudi mi nomiyo oluoro Akish ruoth Gath ahinya.
english: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

kikuyu: Eka notiyo matek koloso kuonde mane omukore mag ohinga kendo nogero kuonde maboyo mag ngʼicho. Nogero ohinga machielo e tok mokwongo kendo nomedo loso ndiri mosiro Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Bende noloso gig lweny kod okumbni mangʼeny.
english: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

kikuyu: To nikech ka ilingʼ e kinde ma kama, to jo-Yahudi noyud resruok e yo moro machielo, to in kod jood wuonu notieku. To ngʼama dingʼe ni ne ibiro e od ruoth e sa ma kama mana ni mondo ikonywa?”
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

kikuyu: To thuol ne onge teko moromo, omiyo nologi kendo ne oriembgi e polo.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

kikuyu: Neginyiso Harun ni, ‘Losnwa nyiseche moko mondo otelnwa, nikech wakia gima osetimo Musa mane ogolowa Misri!’
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

kikuyu: Ji moa e pinje duto nobiro mondo owinji rieko Solomon koorgi gi ruodhi mag piny mane osewinjo humb riekone.
english: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

kikuyu: Ka dine uwinj siem mara, dine abedo kodu thuolo, kendo damiyo ungʼeyo pacha.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik uti gi rapim ma ok nikare ka upimo bor kata pek mar gimoro kata kupimo ngʼeny mare.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

kikuyu: Isejwangʼo wuone gi mine marach; ithiro jopinje mamoko modak e dieru; nyithind kiye gi mon ma chwogi otho bende isando.
english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.

kikuyu: “Nyak mokwongo mar nyodo e kind jo-Israel en mara, bed ni en dhano kata jamni.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ne aoroni wach piyo piyo mondo ibi, kendo isetimo maber kuom biro. Koro eri wan ka waduto e nyim Nyasaye, mondo wawinji weche duto ma Ruoth osechiki mondo inyiswa.”
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi moko mane wuotho koni gi koni kagolo jochiende notemo tiyo gi nying Ruoth Yesu mondo giriemb jochiende kuom ji. Ne gitemo wacho niya, “E nying Yesu ma Paulo yalo, wachiki mondo iwuog oko!”
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

kikuyu: Achikonu obadho, yaye Babulon, kendo nomaku kapod ok ungʼeyo; noyudu kendo omaku nikech ne ukwedo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Emomiyo yoregi nobed mapoth poth; notergi e mudho kendo kanyo ginipodhie piny. Anakel masira kuomgi e higa mokumgie.
english: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni nobed maber-ber ne Sodom maloyo dalano.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

kikuyu: Emomiyo lokri iwe richo! Nikech ka ok ilokori to abiro biro mapiyo mondo aked kodgi gi ligangla mawuok e dhoga.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

kikuyu: Gideon nochopo mana ka ngʼat moro ne nyiso osiepene lek. Ngʼatno ne wachone osiepene niya, “Ne aleko ni makati molos gi mogo mar shairi molworore nobiro e kambi jo-Midian. Nogoyo hema gi teko ma hema olokore kendo olwar piny.”
english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

kikuyu: Kinyne Musa nodonjo ei Hemb Rapar kendo noneno odunga mar Harun, mane ochungʼ e lo Lawi, ne pok ochako loth kende to thuokene bende nosechako dongo, ka gingʼich mamoro wangʼ kendo gigolo olembe mag oyungu.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni ariembo jochiende gi teko mar Belzebub, to jou to kara gologi gi teko mar ngʼa? Emomiyo ginibed jongʼadnu bura.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Nochiwo chikegi ne Hilkia gi Ahikam wuod Shafan gi Abdon wuod Mika gi Shafan jagoro kod Asaya jarit mar ruoth kowachonegi niya,
english: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

kikuyu: dine areto adhi nyaka kara mar pondo, kuma ni mabor gi apaka kod ahiti.”
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

kikuyu: Solomon nokelo farese koa Misri kod e piny miluongo ni Kue, johala mag ruoth nongʼiewogi e piny Kue.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

kikuyu: Asetimo kamano kuom rito nyinga, mana kuom rito nyinga awuon, emomiyo asetimo ma. Ere kaka dayie mondo nyinga oyany? Ok ayie mondo duongʼ ma imiya, omi ngʼato machielo.”
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

kikuyu: To un bende nokwanu kaka joma oyie kane uwinjo wach mar adier ma en Injili mar warruok. Kane useyie kuome noketonu kido mar Roho Maler mane osingi,
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Ezer nonywolo Bilhan, Zavan kod Akan. Dishan nonywolo Uz kod Aran.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Daudi noweyo Zadok jadolo kod jowetene ma jodolo e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye e kama otingʼore gi malo man Gibeon,
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

kikuyu: Jal mane oyaro piny ewi pige, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wechenagi to ok otimgi chalo gi ngʼat mane ogero ode e kwoyo.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

kikuyu: Jogi loko otieno mi bed odiechiengʼ; ka piny otimo mudho to giwacho ni, ‘Ler ni machiegni.’
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

kikuyu: Eka ne aparo e chunya niya, “Gima yudo ngʼama ofuwo biro yuda an bende. Koro en ohala mane ma abiro yudo kuom bedo gi rieko?” Bangʼe ne awacho e chunya niya, “Kata mana ma bende onge tiende.”
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nyaka chiel gi kite, kata chwowe gi asere; to kik ngʼato angʼata ket lwete kuome. Bed ni en dhano kata le, ok noweye mondo obed mangima.’ To ji nyalo idho godno mana ka tungʼ oywak kuom thuolo malach.”
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ne ok irito singruokni ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo rito chik mane amiyi?”
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Ibrahim machiegni kod yiende madongo mag Mamre kane obet e dho hembe kar odiechiengʼ tir.
english: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma ngʼama ogakni omulo kapok ologo lwete to nyaka olwok lepe kendo olwokre kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Negiiko mesa mondo gimethi kendo gichiem, to apoya nono negipo kinyisogi, ni mondo giik gigegi mag lweny.
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

kikuyu: Shelomith gi wedene to nochungʼne keno duto mag gik mane Ruoth Daudi owalo gi jotend dhoudi mane gin jotend jolweny alufe kod jotend jolweny miche to gi jotend jolweny mamoko.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

kikuyu: An bende lamnauru mondo sa moro amora ma ayawo dhoga to omiya weche mondo ayal gichir wach mopondo mar Injili,
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

kikuyu: Chunye ok chandre kendo oonge gi luoro moro amora; ongʼeyo ni obiro neno ka olo wasike ka en to olocho.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gisingore niya, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima,’ pod gikwongʼore mar miriambo.”
english: Though they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo kik wuondu. Nimar ji mangʼeny nobi e nyinga ka hedhore ni, ‘An e en,’ kendo ni, ‘Sa chiegni,’ kik uluwgi.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Wer. Oseguro mise mare ewi got maler;
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Rangajni nyaka sik kolor. Ok onego yawe, kendo ok oyie ni ngʼato mondo oluwe kadonjo. Nyaka osik kolore nikech Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, oseluwe kadonjo.
english: The LORD said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Asher, Musa nowuoyoe kama: Wuowi mogwedhi e kind yawuowi en Asher, we oyud pak e kind owetene, kendo olwok tiendene gi mo.
english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

kikuyu: Jamonj ji-cha notim gima en ema ohero; onge ngʼama nonyal chungʼ e nyime mondo oked kode. Enomanre maber mar kedo gi Piny Maber, kendo enobed gi teko mar kethe.
english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo nobedo gi mor. Nokawo law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, nyiseche manono mag udi kod kido mopa kendo nodhi gi jogo.
english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi ne ochwada kiboko piero adek gochiko nyadibich.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

kikuyu: Kikombe adek molos kaka maupe mag oyungu gi thiepene kod obokene nobedo e bade achiel, kendo adek e bade maluwe kendo bedene auchielgo nochwogore kawuok e rachungi taya.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata monego chiayo nyaka chul chiayo, to ngʼato angʼata monego nyawadgi nyaka negi.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nochiwo Og ruodh Bashan gi jolwenje duto e lwetwa, kendo ne watiekogi mi wanegogi duto maonge ngʼama nodongʼ.
english: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

kikuyu: “Ka udonjo e dala mi orwaku to chamuru gino ma oket e nyimu.
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

kikuyu: Notingʼo: Bersheba (kata Sheba), Molada,
english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

kikuyu: nowachonegi niya, “Rituru wechegi ma asomonu kawuononi mondo chiengʼ moro upuonj nyithindu mondo oluw adimba wechegi duto manie chike.
english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

kikuyu: Wiye cham abiriyo mothogo nomwonyo wiye cham abiriyo mochiek. Ne anyiso ajuoke, to onge ngʼato mane nyalo lokona tiendgi.”
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

kikuyu: Lwendinigo ema kite ma nengogi tek miluongo ni Safir wuokie kendo buru ema otingʼo dhahabu.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

kikuyu: Iyudha kendo iliera e kor yamo, irunda ewi apaka.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

kikuyu: Bedene auchiel noa e bath rachungi tayano, ka adek nitie e bathe konchiel kendo adek nitie komachielo.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

kikuyu: Wan kaka wasumbinigi wan gi lum ma pundewa nyalo chamo kod makati gi divai moromowa; onge gima waremo.”
english: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”

kikuyu: Gokinyi mangʼich negiwuok gidhi e piny Tekoa motwo. Kane giwuok Jehoshafat nochungʼ kawacho niya, “Chikuru itu un jo-Juda kod joma odak Jerusalem! Beduru kod geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu eka unukuwo, bende yieuru gi jonabi mage eka unulo.”
english: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

kikuyu: ma ok oyie mondo ringre oowre gi gombo mathoth kaka jopiny makia Nyasaye timo.
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

kikuyu: Nochungʼ mogwedho chokruok duto mar Israel gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya,
english: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano jadolono nomien remo moko e tunge kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani e nyim Jehova Nyasaye manie Hemb Romo. To remb rwadhno modongʼ nopuki e tiend kendo mitimoe misango miwangʼo pep manie dho Hemb Romo.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni en gi wuowi mohero lweny, kata mohero chwero remo kata matimo achiel kuom gigi
english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre nobiro ir Yesu lingʼ-lingʼ mi openje niya, “Angʼo momiyo wan ne ok wanyal golo jachiendno?”
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

kikuyu: Joma moko to ne wacho niya, “En Elija.” To joma moko bende noramo niya, “En janabi machal gi jonabi machon gi lala.”
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: to kata kamano, gikano chiembgi e ndalo oro, kendo gichoko chiembgi e ndalo keyo.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

kikuyu: Un koth thuonde fu-gi, ere kaka un ma un jomaricho kamano unyalo wacho gima ber? Nimar gik mopongʼo chuny ngʼato ema wuok e dho ngʼato.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

kikuyu: Okinyi mangʼich ka ugwe chako wuok, ruoth noa malo moreto nyaka e bur sibuoche.
english: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo nyaka ucham makati ma ok oketie thowi. Odiechiengʼ mokwongo nyaka ugol oko thowi ma ukano e ute, nikech ngʼato angʼata ma ochamo gimoro amora ma oted gi thowi chakre chiengʼ mokwongo nyaka chiengʼ mar abiriyo to nongʼad kare oko kuom oganda jo-Israel.
english: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

kikuyu: Ketgi e goki mana ka gineni kendo itingʼ-gi ia kodgi ka piny yuso. Um lela wangʼi, mondo kik ine piny giwangʼi, nikech aseketi ranyisi ne dhood Israel.”
english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, chik iti mondo iwinji, yaw wangʼi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye mondo ine, kendo winjie weche duto ma Senakerib oseoro joge kayanyigo in Nyasaye mangima.
english: Incline your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

kikuyu: Nyiseche mopa mag ogendini gin fedha gi dhahabu, molos gi lwet dhano.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa mongʼeyo? Dipo ka mirimb Nyasaye odok chien, mi owe ich wangʼ kendo ongʼwon-nwa mi ok otiekowa.”
english: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

kikuyu: Ok kamano ngangʼ! Nikech ka en kamano, to Nyasaye dingʼad bura ni piny nade?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa kod Harun kochikogi mondo gidhi ir Farao ruodh Misri, mondo gigol jo-Israel e piny Misri.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chwog wend ywak kuom ruodh Turo kiwachone ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto Wacho: “ ‘Ne in ranyisi maber ni ji, ne ipongʼ gi rieko kendo ne iber neno.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jo-Farisai, nikech uchiwo ne Nyasaye mich mar achiel kuom apar mar gik ma milimili kaka apoth gi odielo, kod alode mamoko mag puodho, to ujwangʼo ngʼado bura kare kod hero Nyasaye. Owinjore ne utim gik ma achien-go, ka ok uweyo mak utimo mokwongogo.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼat maa nyawadgi, to luoruru Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Nywol mar nyathi ma kamano en kayiem nono, olal e mudho kendo kata nying ok chake.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

kikuyu: Kata kamano en bende en gi rieko kendo onyalo kelo chandruok; bende ok olok pache e gima osewacho. Obiro kumo joma timbegi mono, kaachiel gi joricho makonyogi.
english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

kikuyu: En mana kaka Isaya nowacho motelo ni, “Ka dine Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok oweyonwa nyikwayo, to dine wachalo gi jo-Sodom, adier, dikoro ne wachalo kaka jo-Gomora.”
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

kikuyu: “Ne oreso jomoko, to en koro ok onyal resore owuon! Donge en Ruodh Israel? Dak koro oa ewi msalaba olor piny ka sani mondo wayie kuome.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

kikuyu: To nochune ni nyaka okadh e piny Samaria.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

kikuyu: omiyo negikwedo Nyasaye kod Musa, mi giwacho niya, “En angʼo momiyo ne igolowa Misri mondo watho e thimni? Waonge chiemo, waonge pi! Ok wadwar chiemo marachni!”
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

kikuyu: Josef nomiyo jarit ode chik niya, “Ket cham mathoth e gunde jogo ma ginyalo tingʼo, kendo itwe pesa e dho ogund ngʼato ka ngʼato.
english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

kikuyu: Nowuok kuno modhi e piny Asuria kuma nogeroe Nineve, Rehoboth-Ir, gi Kala,
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw remo moko kuom remo mipwodhruokgo e ketho, kendo nomien remono e dho it ma korachwich mar ngʼat mipwodhono kaachiel gi lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich, kod lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: Tem matek mondo ibi ira piyo,
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

kikuyu: Un to kik uchungʼ kanyo, lawuru wasiku, monjgiuru kua gichien kendo kik uwegi gichop e miechgi madongo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechiwogi e lwetu.”
english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.”

kikuyu: Joma ni e twech kuno bende winjo maber; nikech gionge gi nyapara ma chikogi kuno.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

kikuyu: E kinde mane Jehova Nyasaye dwaro tero Elija e polo kotingʼe gi kalausi, noyudo ka Elija gi Elisha osewuok Gilgal.
english: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

kikuyu: En ohala mane ma jatich yudo kuom tich matek?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Jangʼad bura mar piny; chul josunga gima owinjore kodgi.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

kikuyu: “Adier wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto rango pinyruoth motimo richo. Abiro ketho pinyruodhno e wangʼ piny, to kata kamano, ok anatiek joka Jakobo duto,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka winjruok nosetim Bersheba, Abimelek kod Fikol ma jatend jolwenje nodok e piny jo-Filistia.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ram nonywolo Aminadab, to Aminadab nonywolo Nashon mane jatelo mar jo-Juda.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

kikuyu: Wuod Uzi ne en: Izrahia. Yawuot Izrahia ne gin: Mikael, Obadia, Joel kod Ishia. Yawuowi abichgo ne gin ruodhi.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

kikuyu: Negigure sa adek okinyi.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

kikuyu: Johana ne en taya maliel makelo ler, kendo kuom kinde moko nuyie mondo omiu lerno.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel osebedo motegno, negiloko jo-Kanaan wasumbinigi kendo ne ok giriembogi kata matin.
english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

kikuyu: Donge tondegi ma gitweyogo hema igonyo, mondo omi githo ka gionge rieko?’
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Weuru mer gi kongʼo nikech mano kelo anjawo. Kar timo kamano to upongʼ gi Roho Maler.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

kikuyu: ma gin yawuowi matindo man-gi chia maonge songa, molony e migepe duto mag rieko, mosomo malach, ma wach donjonegi piyo kendo mowinjore gi tiyo e od ruoth. Ne onego opuonjgi dho jo-Babulon kaachiel gi weche mamoko mag jo-Babulon.
english: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Kane Laban oseneno tere e um nyamin kod bangli ka ni e lwet nyamin kendo kane owinjo gima Rebeka wacho ni ngʼatno onyise, Laban nodhi ir ngʼatno moyude ka ochungʼ e bath ngamia-go machiegni gi soko.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

kikuyu: Gigo duto mane ochiw gi jogo modongʼne romo kilo mia achiel gi piero abiriyo mar dhahabu, kilo alufu achiel gi robo mar fedha kod lep jodolo maromo piero auchiel gabiriyo.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

kikuyu: “Winjuru un joma itgi odino un muofni ngʼiuru mondo une!
english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo ma ibiro bayo, yaye nyako maonge adiera? Jehova Nyasaye enochwe gima nyien e piny, dhako nokwak dichwo.”
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing on the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”

kikuyu: Nonyiso Sara bende niya, “Asemiyo owadu shekel mar fedha maromo alufu achiel mondo obed ranyisi ne jou duto ni ionge gi ketho; nikech ok isetimo gimoro amora marach.”
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

kikuyu: Apoya nono malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore, mi ler norieny ei od twech. Noyuko Petro mochiewe kowacho niya, “Aa malo piyo.” Gikanyono nyoroche mane otwego Petro nolwar piny.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

kikuyu: Omiyo wayie ni kaka wayudo warruok kuom ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu, e kaka gin bende iwarogi.”
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

kikuyu: Farao nowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo iyik wuonu mana kaka nomiyo isingorine.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

kikuyu: To thuol ne riek moloyo le duto mag bungu mane Jehova Nyasaye ochweyo. Omiyo nopenjo dhako niya, “Bende en adier ni Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘Kik ucham olemb yien moro amora manie puodho?’ ”
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kitanda moro amora ma ngʼatni onindoe kata moro amora ma ngʼatni obetie ka dende chwer bedo mogak.
english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre nodok e miechgi.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Thuatira kama: Magi e weche mag Wuod Nyasaye ma wengene chalo gi mach makakni bende tiendene chal ka mula mapakni.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

kikuyu: Ne adwokogi niya, “Nyasach polo biro miyowa loch. Wan jotichne wabiro gedo kendo, makmana un, to uonge gi pok e Jerusalem kata dwaro moro amora kata rapar moro amora kuome.”
english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Ber maru ok onego onenre mana kuom gik mulichogo dendu ma oko: kaka kado wich gi rwako bangli mag dhahabu kod lewni ma nengogi tek.
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

kikuyu: Eka ukaw oboke mag raywechi ulute remo mar chiayono manie karaya kendo ukir moko ewi sirni mag dhoudi, to moko ukir e sirni mag dhoutu koni gi koni. Kik ngʼato angʼata kuomu wuog oko mar dhoot nyaka okinyi.
english: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

kikuyu: “Eka wuonwa nowacho ni, ‘Doguru mondo udhi ungʼiew chiemo moko kendo.’
english: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

kikuyu: Ma ema nobed lop jo-Zadok, ma gin jodolo maler mopwodhi, mane otiyona gadiera, kendo mane ok obaro oweyo yo kaka jo-Lawi mamoko notimo, kane jo-Israel obaro oweyo yo.
english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

kikuyu: Ok enie polo malo madimi uwach niya, “Ere ngʼama didhinwa e polo malo mondo oomnwago kendo opuonjwa eka warite?”
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

kikuyu: Mier auchiel muchiwogi nobed mier mag tony.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Joma kare koywak to Jehova Nyasaye winjogi; oresogi e chandruokgi duto.
english: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

kikuyu: Yaye, nyi Galim, gouru nduru! Yaye, Laish chikuru itu! Yaye, Anathoth mar midhiero!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

kikuyu: ok kuom tich ngʼato maber, mondo mi ngʼato kik sungre.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuom Jeftha. Noluwo piny Gilead gi Manase, kokalo Mizpa mar Gilead, kendo koa kanyo nodhi momonjo jo-Amon.
english: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Kane Arauna dino ngano, notingʼo wangʼe ma oneno malaika, yawuote mane ni kode nopondo.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

kikuyu: kotweyo kamba madongo e nungogi kendo korwako kilemba mabeyo e wigi; ka giduto gichalo jotend farese lweny maywayo geche mag, jo-Babulon modak Kaldea.
english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Ka ngʼato dwaro luwo bangʼa to nyaka okwedre kende owuon kendo otingʼ msalape eka oluwa.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Jomoko to nowacho niya, “En e Kristo.” Ji mamoko to nopenjo niya, “Ere kaka Kristo nyalo aa Galili?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

kikuyu: to eka bangʼe giloko pachgi e piny motwegieno mi chunygi olokore giweyo richo, kendo gikwayi ka gin e piny wasikgi niya, ‘Wasetimo richo kendo waseketho bende wasetimo tim mamono.’
english: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

kikuyu: Enochal ka bungu manie thim; ok enowinj maber ka ber obiro. Enodag kuonde motwo motimo ongoro, kama otimo chumbi maonge ngʼama odakie.
english: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.

kikuyu: “Ne akelo kech e miechu duto, kendo nubedo maonge chiemo, to kata kamano pod utamoru duogo ira,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro dhi mondo ane ka gik magisetimo richo kaka ywak osechopo ira, eka abiro ngʼeyo adiera.”
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

kikuyu: Kuom bathe komachielo man koma ochomo yo nyandwat, negiloso sirni piero ariyo,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nokawo pinyni duto; kaka, piny manie got, piny Negev duto, gwenge duto mag Goshen, tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, Araba kod gode duto mag Israel kaachiel gi pewe mag
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

kikuyu: kendo pim mare nochal kama: Bathe mochomo nyandwat, kilomita ariyo, bathe mochomo milambo, kilomita ariyo, bathe mochomo wuok chiengʼ, kilomita ariyo, kendo bathe mochomo podho chiengʼ, kilomita ariyo.
english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo chano timo marach ni joma kare kendo gimwodo lekegi ka gin gi mirima;
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

kikuyu: Joma paro ni gin joma kare kibaji omako; kendo joma paro ni ler wacho ni ok angʼeyo Nyasaye.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

kikuyu: E odiechieng Ruoth, ne an kuom Roho, ne awinjo dwol maduongʼ makok ka turumbete yo kangʼeya.
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

kikuyu: Neye gik ma gingʼudho koa e dhogi, gingʼudho ligengni gi dhogi, kendo giwacho niya, “En ngʼa manyalo winjowa?”
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

kikuyu: Mana kaka lowo miyo cham twi, kendo kaka cham mae puodho thiewo, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto nomi tim makare kod pak thiew e dier ogendini duto.
english: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon nochako gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye Jerusalem e got Moria kama Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Daudi wuon mare. Ne en e kar dino cham mar Arauna ja-Jebus kama Daudi nochiwo.
english: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: “Abiro kelo luoro kod achiedh-nade kuom oganda kendo gibiro wuotho mana ka muofni, nikech gisetimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Rembgi nochwer piny kendo nyimbiye igi nopukre oko ka ngʼwe.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

kikuyu: Pilato nopenjogi niya, “To koro atim angʼo gi Yesu miluongo ni Kristo?” Negidwoke riat niya, “Gure!”
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: To Solomon ne ok oloko jo-Israel wasumbini kuom tije, to noketogi kaka jolwenje, jotelo mag jotend lweny kod jotelo mag geche lweny kod joriemb gechene.
english: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

kikuyu: Eka Musa kod Harun nopodho auma e nyim chokruok mar oganda Israel duto mane ochokore kanyo.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne giwangʼo i Jehova Nyasaye, e dho sokni mag Meriba, mi timgino nokelone Musa chandruok;
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro gi dwond janabi Hagai kawacho niya:
english: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Musa nomiyo Eliazar jadolo ma kor Jehova Nyasaye, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Gin gi jogegi negitelone rit mar rangeye mag od Jehova Nyasaye, ma en ot miluongo ni Hema.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

kikuyu: Wuoda, ka isechiwo singo ni jabathi, kata ka isingori ni inichul ni ngʼat mikia gope,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

kikuyu: Kik irikni ka ia e nyim ruoth. Kik ichwak ngʼama timo richo, nimar obiro timo gimora amora mohero.
english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

kikuyu: Ruoth notiyo gi yiend almugo mondo olosgo sirni mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod od ruoth kendo mondo olosgo thumbe nyatiti gi orutu ni jower. Nyaka chakre ndalono ok osekelie kata nenoe yiend almugo mangʼeny marom gi mago.
english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

kikuyu: To Laban ne nigi nyiri ariyo: nyako maduongʼ ne nyinge Lea kendo nyako matin ne nyinge Rael.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

kikuyu: Lew joma kare ongʼeyo gima owinjore, to dho joricho wacho mana gik mochido.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

kikuyu: Fuwo mar ngʼato owuon ketho ngimane; to bende chunye bedo mager gi Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

kikuyu: Moab en besen mara mar luok, to Edom e kama amoe wuochena; Filistia ema akoke ka aseloyo lweny.”
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nondiko wendno chiengʼno mopuonje jo-Israel.
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kor wach kuom piny Israel, kendo wach ni gode madongo gi matindo, kaachiel gi rogo kod holni kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Awuoyo ka an gi mirima mager, nikech usewinjo marach ka ogendini jarou.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Lea ne gin: Reuben wuod Jakobo makayo, Simeon, Lawi, Juda, Isakar kod Zebulun.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

kikuyu: Jonathan nochungʼ moa e mesa ka mirima mager omake chiengʼ mar ariyo mar dwe mane ok ochiemo, nikech chunye ne lit kod timbe wuon-gi mag wichkuot mane otimone Daudi.
english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

kikuyu: “Med lendo kiwacho kama: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: ‘Miecha duto biro pongʼ gi mwandu, kendo Jehova Nyasaye biro hoyo Sayun kendo obiro chako oyiero Jerusalem!’ ”
english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

kikuyu: Ligangla nodonjo e iye molal kuno gi loge duto motuch nyaka e dier ngʼeye oko. Ehud ne ok opudho liganglano oko, kendo bor noume.
english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka wangʼ lawno, kata mano mochwe kata motwangʼ kata gir pien moro amora mane osepur, nikech pur osekethe; gino nyaka wangʼ.
english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

kikuyu: Misango mare mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne ne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: To mano notimore nikech richo mag jonabi mage, kod kethruok mag jodolo mage mane ochwero remb joma kare.
english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.

kikuyu: Kendo Abram nowacho niya, “Pod ok imiya nyithindo; omiyo achiel kuom wasumbini maga ema nobed jacham girkeni maga.”
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

kikuyu: kendo nochiko moko kuom askechege maroteke mane ni e oganda mar jolweny mage mondo gitwe Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego kendo gidirgi ei mach makakni.
english: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

kikuyu: E kaka un bende nyaka ukwanru ni utho ne richo, to ungima ne Nyasaye ei Kristo Yesu.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Kata ka jomoko ok okawa kaka jaote, to un owinjore ukawa kamano, nikech un e ranyisi mar bedona jaote kuom Ruoth.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

kikuyu: “Magi e chike manyaka iketi e nyimgi.
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

kikuyu: Kane piny oyawore, negidonjo e hekalu mana kaka nonyisgi, mi gichako puonjo ji. To ka jadolo maduongʼ gi joge nochopo, negichoko jobuch Sanhedrin, ma en chokruok mar jodong Israel duto, mi gioro wach mondo ogol joote e od twech okel e nyimgi.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

kikuyu: Jokwangʼ notemo mondo gitony gia e yie, kendo negitemo mondo giket yie matin mar resruok e pi, ka giwuondore ni gidwaro bolo nanga moko yo ka wi yie.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

kikuyu: Kothe duto mondo kargi olal nono, kendo nying-gi oruchi kik bedi e tiengʼ mabiro.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

kikuyu: ruoth noluongo Shimei mowachone niya, “Donge ne akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ka asiemi ni chiengʼ ma iniwuogi mondo idhi kamoro amora to ibed kingʼeyo ni initho? To e kindeno niwachona niya, ‘Gima iwacho ber, abiro luwo.’
