english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by the LORD and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’

kikuyu: “Abiro thuwo jo-Misri kendgi, ngʼato noked mana gowadgi, joma odak mokiewo noked kendgi, mier madongo noked kendgi, kendo pinjeruodhi bende noked kendgi.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoke niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, ka iyie to or ngʼat machielo.”
english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

kikuyu: Jakobo noketo siro ewi liend Rael kendo nyaka chil kawuono sirono obet kar liend Rael.
english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodhi nyime giwuoth mi gigo kambi kama iluongo ni Oboth.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: kendo iyike kaka ringruok mar pinyni, to ichiere kaka ringruok mar polo. Ka nitiere ringruok mar piny, to nitiere bende ringruok mar polo.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

kikuyu: Ka aluongo jatichna moro kata bed mana ni asaye gi dhoga awuon, to ok odewa.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

kikuyu: Natingʼo wangʼa kendo, mi napo kaneno geche angʼwen mag lweny kabiro kowuok e kind gode ariyo ma gin gode mag mula!
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

kikuyu: Notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka jood Ahab nosetimo nikech bangʼ tho wuon mare gin ema ne gingʼadone rieko marach mane okethe.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

kikuyu: Kane gimaki gi lwetgi to ne ipilori mi ichwo gokgi; to kane giyiengore kuomi to ne itur ma imiyo odingʼ-gi owil.
english: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Aa kuoma, Satan! Nikech ondiki ni, ‘Lam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo en kende ema itine.’”
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Eka ruodhi mag piny, gi ji madongo, kod jotelo mag lweny, gi jo-mwandu, kod joma roteke, kaachiel gi ji duto ma wasumbini, gi joma ni thuolo, giduto ne gipondo e rogo kendo e bwo lwendni mag gode.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

kikuyu: mad kethruok jukgi apoya ka gikia mad obadhogi ma gisechikona makgi; mad gilwar ei bur ma kargi lal nono.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

kikuyu: Kaw jogi mondo idhi ipwodhri kaachiel kodgi, bangʼe ichulnegi nengo mar misengini monego gichul bangʼ pwodhruok, eka oliel yie wigi. Kitimo kamano, to ji duto biro kawo weche duto ma ji wacho kuomi kaka miriambo, kendo gibiro kawi kaka ngʼat moluwo Chik Musa.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

kikuyu: Chik iti kapok idwoko wach; ka ok itimo kamano to ibedo mofuwo kendo ikelo wichkuot.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

kikuyu: To ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa kuom dhano.’ ” (Negiluoro ji, nikech ji duto nokawo ni Johana ema janabi adier.)
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noduogo chien momonjo jo-Benjamin mane odongʼ, mi ginegogi duto kaachiel gi jamni kod gimoro amora mane giyudo. Mier duto mane gineno e nyimgi ne giwangʼo.
english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.

kikuyu: Kite mag kor ot noywagnu matek to yiend tado nokow ywagno.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nooru dok Misri gi yiedhi, e wuoth mane awacho ni ok onego udhiye. Kuno unuchiwru ne wasiku kaka chwo kod mon ma jotich to onge ngʼama noyie ngʼiewou.
english: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

kikuyu: Beduru mamor e sawoni, yawuoti kod nyigi, jotichni machwo gi mamon, jo-Lawi, jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho modak e miechu.
english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

kikuyu: Lweny nochako owuok kendo, mi Daudi nowuok modhi kedo gi jo-Filistia. Nonego ji mangʼeny ma joma odongʼ noringo oa.
english: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

kikuyu: Gimomiyo Wuora ohera en nikech ayie chiwo ngimana, eka achako akawe kendo.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano anaduog mwandu Elam e ndalo ma biro,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says the LORD.”

kikuyu: Choknauru jodongo mag ogandau to gi jotendu duto, mondo awuo e wechegi e itgi kendo mondo aluong polo gi piny obedna janeno kuomgi.
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

kikuyu: e laini mar adek chanie kite kaka jasinth gi agat kod amethist;
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: Joma nodak e chulano norwakowa duto gi ngʼwono mathoth, mi gimokonwa mach mondo wao, nikech koth ne chue kendo piny ne ngʼich.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

kikuyu: Emomiyo wagouru erokamano ne Nyasaye nikech wasenwangʼo pinyruoth manyien ma ok nyal yiengni. Chunywa mondo omi Nyasaye duongʼ kod luor, kendo walame e yo modwaro, ka wapongʼ gi kibaji,
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

kikuyu: Yawuowi mane Hezron onywolo ne gin: Jeramel, Ram kod Kaleb.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano jo-Babulon nobirone, modhi kode nyaka e kitanda mar chode, kendo ne gidwanye ka gipongʼ gi gombo. Kane jogo osedwanye kamano to ne olokore oweyogi kopongʼ gi mirima.
english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

kikuyu: Joma oyie kuom Kristo ma jo-Yahudi, mane obiro gi Petro, nowuoro ka Roho Maler nobiro nyaka kuom joma ok jo-Yahudi,
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro dhiuru nyime gi tijno nyaka utieke! Beduru gi ikruok mar tieke mana kaka nubedo gi chenro mar chake, to timuru kamano mana gi giu maun-go.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

kikuyu: To waneno mana Yesu mane odwok piny moloyo malaike, makoro sani osidhne osimbo mar duongʼ kod luor, nikech noneno lit mar tho. Yesu nobilo tho ni wan duto kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

kikuyu: Jatich nowachone kendo niya, “An-gi pesa moko manok. Abiro miye ngʼat Nyasaye mondo onyiswa yo monego waluw.”
english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko Musa niya, “Ngʼato angʼata motimo richo e nyima ema anaruch nyinge oko e kitabu mara.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

kikuyu: Winy duto mafuyo e kor polo, kod rech manie nam, gi le duto mamol kaluwo yore manie nembe iketo e bwo lochne.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

kikuyu: Ka janabi kata jadolo kata ngʼato angʼata owacho ni, ‘Ma en wach mar Jehova Nyasaye,’ to anakum ngʼatno kod joode duto.
english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ I will even punish that man and his household.

kikuyu: Rituru chike duto ma amiyou kawuononi mondo ubed gi teko kendo ukaw piny man loka mar Jordan mudhi kawono;
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

kikuyu: Ka ok uchiko itu malongʼo, kendo ka ok uketo chunyu mar miyo nyinga luor, to abiro oro kwongʼ kuomu kendo abiro kwongʼo gweth mau. Ee, asekwongʼo-gi nimar ok useketo chunyu mondo omiya duongʼ,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says the LORD of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “E piny ngima, ariyo kuom adek mar ji biro tho mi ngʼad kargi oko; to kata kamano, achiel kuom adek mar jogo to nowe kangima.
english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says the LORD, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.

kikuyu: Wuod Karmi ne en: Akar mane okelo chandruok ne Israel kuom ketho chik mane orito gigo mowal.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noket wasiku ma monjou e lwetu mi unulogi. Ginimonju ka gin oganda achiel, to ginike ka gia iru ka gin migepe abiriyo.
english: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

kikuyu: Kethruok gi tho jowacho ni, ‘Humbe kende ema osechopo e itwa!’
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo asekwanora ni ok awinjora biro iri. To wach mana wach to jatichna biro chango.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Abishai nowachone Daudi niya, “Kawuono Nyasaye oseketo jasiki e lweti. Koro yiena mondo achwowe dichiel gi tonga; ok abi chwowe diriyo.”
english: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”

kikuyu: Tekona osetwo ka balatago, kendo lewa omoko e danda; isepiela e lop tho.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

kikuyu: ok waseluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, kata rito chike mane omiyowa kokalo kuom jotichne ma jonabi.
english: We haven’t obeyed the LORD our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Kata ka gipidho nyithindo, to namigi gibed gi kuyo kuom moro ka moro. Okwongʼ-gi, ka alokora mi ajwangʼogi!
english: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny nokelo ni Jehova Nyasaye mich mag-gi Jerusalem kendo Hezekia ruodh Juda bende negikelone mich ma nengogi tek, kendo chakre kanyo ogendini duto nomiye luor maduongʼ.
english: Many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

kikuyu: Ayub nowacho kama:
english: Job answered:

kikuyu: Ne ok waluwo sigendini ma dhano ochuogo gi riekone kane wanyisou teko kod biro mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, to wawegi ne wan joneno mar duongʼne.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

kikuyu: Gineno maber kuom kinde matin kende to bangʼe gilal nono kadiemo wangʼ, kendo ichokogi mi giner ka buya mopudhi; kendo ingʼadogi oko mana kaka ingʼado wiye cham.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Kane Joab gi jolweny duto mane ni kode odonjo, ne owachne ni Abner wuod Ner ne osebiro ir ruoth, mi ruoth ne osemiye thuolo modhi, kendo bende nine osedhi gi kwe.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

kikuyu: “Koro kama e kaka onego ulam: “ ‘Wuonwa manie polo, nyingi mondo omi duongʼ,
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

kikuyu: Nomuko kuonde motingʼore malo kod kende mag misango miwangʼoe ubani e miech Juda, kendo pinyruoth nobedo gi kwe e ndalone.
english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

kikuyu: to dhier biro monji ka janjore kendo chan ka jalweny momanore.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

kikuyu: Eka Agripa nowachone Festo niya, “Daher mondo awinje weche ngʼatno an bende.” Nodwoke niya, “Kiny niwinje.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

kikuyu: Eka Daniel nodhi ir Ariok, ngʼat mane ruoth oketo mondo oneg joma riek man Babulon, kendo nowachone niya, “Kik itiek joma riek man Babulon. Tera ir ruoth mondo alokne tiend lekneno.”
english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

kikuyu: Gik mamoko manotimore e ndalo loch Jehoshafat aa chakruok nyaka gikogi ondikgi e weche mag ndalo mag Jehu wuod Hanani kaka ochan-gi e kitap ruodhi mag Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is included in the book of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Joge duto ruto ka sibuoche matindo, gilengʼore ka nyithi sibuor.
english: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.

kikuyu: Ruodh jo-Aram nogolo chik ne jotende mariembo geche niya, “Kik uked gi ngʼato angʼata bed ni otin kata oduongʼ makmana ruodh Israel.”
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

kikuyu: Musa nokulore nyaka e lowo mapiyo nono mi olamo.
english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne aywak malit nikech ne onge ngʼama nyalo elo kitabuno mondo onyiswa gima ondiki e iye.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jerusalem, Jerusalem, in ma inego jonabi kendo ichielo joma oorni gi kite! Mano kaka asegombo amingʼa mondo achok nyithindi kaachiel, kaka gweno choko nyithinde e bwo bwombene, to ok useyie.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

kikuyu: Kuome ema ringruok duto ochomore, leche omakore gi fuoni ka fuoni, kendo ka fuoni moro ka moro tiyo tichne kaka dwarore. Kuom mano ringruok dongo kendo gerore kuom hera.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

kikuyu: Yaye jaherana, bi wadhi kodi ka waa e got Lebanon, adier bi koda walor ka waa Lebanon. Lor piny ia e chuny got Amana, lor ia ewi got mar Senir gi Hermon, wuog e bur sibuoche kendo wuog ewi got kama kwach oloko miechgi.
english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

kikuyu: Nyasaye osejwangʼa e lwet joma timbegi richo adier Nyasaye osewita e lwet jo-mahundu.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

kikuyu: “Jaduongʼ, winjwa in jatelo maduongʼ e kindwa. Ik aika ngʼati e bur-wa moro amora miyiero. Onge ngʼato e dierwa mabiro tami yiko ngʼati e bure.”
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Ji ywagore e wangʼ yore nikech divai onge, mor duto olokore kuyo, piny duto odongʼ gi lit.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

kikuyu: Fweny moro machielo mane okelona ema: Ne aneno Ruoth Nyasaye kochungʼ e kor ot kotingʼo tol mar rapim mipimogo kor ot e lwete mondo one ane ka kor ot oriere tir.
english: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.

kikuyu: Nimar awachoni ni ok ininena kendo nyaka chop chiengʼ ma iniwach ni, ‘Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye.’”
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Lowo owuon ema golo kodhi; mokwongo tiendene wuok, eka wiye gulo oko kaeto bangʼe kodhi dongo mi chieg cham.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

kikuyu: Agulni gi opewni kod tewni mag kiro remo. Gigi duto mane Huram oloso ni ruoth Solomon ni hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nolos gi mula moleny.
english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for the LORD’s house, were of burnished bronze.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ka anami ibed dala maduongʼ modongʼ gunda, machal gi mier madongo matinde ji ok odakie, kendo ka analuong nembe matut mondo oimi gi ataro mar pi,
english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

kikuyu: Mano kaka Jehova Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo lich, en Ruoth Maduongʼ man-gi loch e piny duto!
english: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

kikuyu: Yesu nodonjo ei hekalu mi noriembo oko joma ne ngʼiewo kendo uso gik moko kanyo. Noloko mesni mag jowil pesa ataro kod kombe mag joma ne uso akuche, kendo
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Koro wanyalo wacho nangʼo mogik? Bende waber adier? Ok kamano ngangʼ! Wasengʼado bura ni jo-Yahudi kod joma ok jo-Yahudi gi joricho mana machalre.
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

kikuyu: “ ‘To jo-Lawi mane odhi mabor koda ka jo-Israel nobaro oweya, mago mane obaro oweya ka giluwo nyisechegi manono, nyaka yud kum maromre gi richogi.
english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

kikuyu: “Kane abiro e soko kawuono, nawacho ni, ‘Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach ruodha Ibrahim, kalongʼoni, to gwedh wuodhani.
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘The LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

kikuyu: “Amiyou chik manyien mawacho kama: Herreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato. Mana kaka aseherou e kaka nyaka uherru ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

kikuyu: Nikech ok wanyal lingʼ ma ok wawuoyo kuom gik ma waseneno kendo ma wasewinjo.”
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

kikuyu: Adwoko erokamano ne Nyasaye ni ne ok abatiso ngʼato kuomu kata achiel makmana Krispo gi Gayo,
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

kikuyu: Jotend jo-Gilead nowacho kendgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼato angʼata ma nemonj jo-Amon ema nobed jotend jogo duto modak Gilead.”
english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osegolo Saulo e ruoth, noketo Daudi obedo ruodhgi, kendo kuom Daudi ema ne Nyasaye owuoyoe kowacho ni, ‘Aseyudo Daudi wuod Jesse, ngʼat ma chunye chal gi mara, obiro timo gik moko duto ma adwaro mondo otim.’
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

kikuyu: Ji duto makalo bute oseyake; osedoko ngʼama jobute nyiero.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

kikuyu: Kaka Yesu nongʼeyo chenrogino, nowuok kanyo. Ji mangʼeny noluwe, kendo nochango ji duto mane tuo,
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

kikuyu: Ok alam mondo igolgi oko e piny, to alamo ni iritgi mondo kik Ngʼama Rach timnegi marach.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

kikuyu: To jogo mowal ni owinjore mondo obed e piny mar tiengʼ mabiro bangʼ chier aa kuom joma otho ok nokendi kata nokendgi ngangʼ,
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

kikuyu: To un, Jehova Nyasaye noresou mogolou e mach mager kuwuok e piny Misri mondo ubed kaka girkeni mare nyaka chiengʼ, mana kaka un sani.
english: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

kikuyu: Ngʼat matinie kuomu nolokre oganda mangʼeny, kendo oganda matin nolokre piny maduongʼ man-gi teko. An Jehova Nyasaye ema nami gino timre piyo piyo ka kinde ochopo.
english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”

kikuyu: Kane osegwedh kendo mar misango, jotelo nokelo chiwo mag-gi mag gweth kendo nochiwgi e nyim kendo mar misango.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato nondhogi gi owadgi mondo onegi, kendo wuoro nondhog nyathine. Nyithindo nongʼany ne jonywolgi kendo nomi neg-gi.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: To beduru gigeno kawuono ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ema dhi telo nyimu mana ka mach mawengʼo. Obiro tiekogi kendo obiro nyonogi mana ka uneno, kendo unuriembgi mi girum chutho mapiyo nono mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osechiko.
english: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.

kikuyu: Heka apar mar mzabibu nogol mana olemo karaya achiel kende, kendo kodhi moromo gorogoro nonyag cham maromo debe kende.”
english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

kikuyu: “Ka Wuod Dhano nobi e duongʼne, kaachiel gi malaike duto, enobed e kom lochne, man-gi duongʼ mar polo.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

kikuyu: Abiro loko loch mag ruodhi; kendo abiro ketho teko mag pinje mamoko, abiro goyo geche mag lweny piny, kaachiel gi joma oidhogi. Ngʼato ka ngʼato biro kedo gi owadgi, kendo farese kod joma oidhogi nonegi.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehu noketho lamo Baal e piny Israel.
english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone ngʼat mane orwako law mayom niya, “Dhiyo e kind tiende kerubi kendo ijow mach maliel manie kind kerubi gi lweti mondo ikegi e dalano duto.” Kendo ne odhi modonjo kaneno.
english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

kikuyu: Singruogni ne Jehova Nyasaye ok otimo gi wuonewa, to notime gi wan wawegi, ma kawuono nika kangima.
english: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

kikuyu: Wach ma ok adiera kik aa e dhogi; weche mag miganga kik wuogi e dhogi.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

kikuyu: Mad ji duto mamor nikech chandruokna oyud wichkuot kendo pachgi olal; mad joma kaworena oyud wichkuot gi achaya.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

kikuyu: Wayudo chiembwa e yo matek manyalo hinyo ngimawa nikech lweny manie thim.
english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Ofir, Havila kod Jobab. Jogo duto ne gin yawuot Joktan.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: “An Jehova Nyasaye, aseluongi mondo anyisi adierana; abiro mako lweti. Abiro riti kendo ibiro keti gir singruok e kinda gi ji kendo abiro keti ler mar ogendini duto,
english: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi ne gin, Maria ma aa Magdala, Maria min Jakobo gi Joses, kod min yawuot Zebedi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Manase ne gin ji alufu piero adek gariyo gi mia ariyo (32,200).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne jotend dhout Israel niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ochiko kama:
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

kikuyu: Wuowi ema rieny gi duongʼ maler mar Nyasaye, kendo en e kit Nyasaye hie momako gik moko duto gi wachne man-gi teko. Kane oseloso yor pwodhruok e richo to nobet piny e polo, e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo duto.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, kuom gigi duto ma wasechiwo ne geroni hekalu ne Nyingi Maler, oa e lweti, kendo giduto gin magi.
english: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noketo Jal mane onge richo obedo richo mondo kuome wabed joma kare mag Nyasaye.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Ji ne kelo nyithindo matindo ir Yesu mondo ogwedhgi, to jopuonjre nokwerogi.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ngʼiyo ji duto gie polo; mondo oneye ka bende nitie moro kuomgi ma nigi winjo, kata ka bende nitie moro kuomgi mamanyo Nyasaye.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

kikuyu: Ka isando nyiga kata ikendo nyiri mamoko bangʼ nyigagi, kata obedoni onge janeno kae, to ngʼe malongʼo ni Nyasaye e janeno e kindwa.”
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: Ere kuma wanyalo dhiyoe? Owetewa osechido chunywa, ka giwachonwa niya, “Jogo tek kendo boyo moloyowa, mier madongo lach kendo nigi ohinga, bende ne waneno jo-Anak.”
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

kikuyu: To Krispo, mane en jatend sinagogi, kod joode duto, noyie kuom Ruoth kendo jo-Korintho mamoko mangʼeny bende nowinjo Paulo moyie kendo obatisi.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

kikuyu: Kuom mano thoth jolweny nobworo yo nyandwat mar dala maduongʼno, to joma nopondo ne ni yo podho chiengʼ. Otienono Joshua to nonindo e holo.
english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

kikuyu: Yawna rangeye mag tim makare; mondo adonji kendo ago erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nobiro koa e piny Galili nyaka e aora Jordan mondo Johana obatise.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

kikuyu: To Paulo notengʼo thuondno oko molwar e mach, kendo onge gima notime.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

kikuyu: Ka moko kuom joma nochungʼ kanyo owinjo mano, negiwacho niya, “Oluongo Elija.”
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Harun gi yawuote mane odongʼ magin Eliazar gi Ithamar niya, “Kawuru misango mar cham mane odongʼ kuom misengini mane ochiwne Jehova Nyasaye gi mago miwangʼo gi mach kendo uchame ka ok oketie thowi but kendo mar misango, nikech en gima ler moloyo,
english: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar ariyo noluwe kawacho niya, “Yaye Babulon dala maduongʼ osepodho piny! Osepodho Piny! En e dhako cha mane omiyo ogendini duto omadho divai mar mer mar terruokne.”
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

kikuyu: Ji biro dwoko kawacho ni, ‘Nikech gisejwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi mane ogolo kweregi oa Misri, kendo giseluwo bangʼ nyiseche mamoko, ka gilamogi kendo gitiyo nigi, kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nokelo chandruok duto kuomgi.’ ”
english: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them.’”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Musa ne kwayo jamb Jethro jaduongʼne ma Jadolo mar jo-Midian, mi nongʼado thim gi jamni nyaka Horeb got mar Nyasaye.
english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.

kikuyu: Benjamin nonywolo Bela, wuode makayo, Ashbel wuode mar ariyo, Ahara mar adek,
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

kikuyu: Luor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, en kende ema itine ka ikwongʼori mana gi nyinge owuon.
english: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

kikuyu: Yie iwinj lemona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego; chikna iti, yaye Nyasach Jakobo. Sela
english: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Noluwo timbe mag ruodhi Israel mana kaka jood Ahab notimo nimar nokendo nyar Ahab. Notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: To wuowi Samuel nomedo dongo; kendo Jehova Nyasaye kod ji ne mor kode.
english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with the LORD and also with men.

kikuyu: Eka joma muofni nonen kendo joma itgi odino nowinj wach.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nowachone Joab kod jotend jolweny mane ni kode niya, “Dhiuru e dhoudi duto mag Israel kochakore Dan nyaka Bersheba mondo ukwan jolweny, eka angʼe ni gin ji adi.”
english: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

kikuyu: To in ne ok inyodha, to dhakoni chakre sa mane adonjo, ne ok oweyo nyodho tiendena.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

kikuyu: Kata nobedo ni timbegi mamono duto nooli kamano; to ne ok inyal wacho ni, ‘Gionge tich.’ Nibedo gi teko kendo omiyo chunyi ne ok onyosore.
english: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano to nyaka ogol chik mondo kor odno ochwer maler, kendo gik magisechwero opuk kama ok ler e tok pacho.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

kikuyu: Mula mane ogolo e sirni ariyo, gi Karaya Maduongʼ kod rachungi mag taya, mane Solomon olosone hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ne pek ma ok nyal pim.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, mich mar wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore en ranyisi miywayogo joma pok oyie, to ok joma oseyie. Mich mar hulo wach to en mar joma oseyie ok joma pok oyie.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodhi gi jopuonjrene nyaka kama iluongo ni Gethsemane, kendo nowachonegi niya, “Beduru ka kapod adhi nyime kucho mondo alam.”
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

kikuyu: Mier mane omi jo-Gershon maa e dhood Lawi ne gin: Koa e nus mar dhood Manase, nomigi, Golan mantiere Bashan (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), kod Be Eshtara, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ariyo.
english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

kikuyu: En kaachiel gi ngʼat mane ongʼieweno nyaka kwan kar romb higni chakre chiengʼ mane ongʼiewe nyaka chop higa mar piero abich. Pesa monego dwokne ngʼat mane ongʼieweno nyaka bed maromre gi pok ma dine ngʼatno ondikogo jatich kuom higni ma ngʼatno osetiyogo.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nooro malaika mondo oketh Jerusalem. To kane malaikano timo kamano Jehova Nyasaye noneno mano mi okuyo nikech tim malichno mi nonyiso malaika mane nego ji niya, “Oromo! Koro dwok lweti.” Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noyudo ochungʼ e kar dino cham mar Arauna ja-Jebus.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Koro ok obi bedo gi mwandu, kendo gik ma en-go ok bi dongʼ ne nyikwaye.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka chiayo mitimogo misangono en im, to mogo mitimogo misango mar cham nyaka bed kilo angʼwen gi nus moruw gi mo moromo lita achiel gi nus,
english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

kikuyu: Kirango pi, to wangʼi iwuon ema ineno, kendo kinono chunyi, to in iwuon ema inenori.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka gigo nosetimore, Yesu nochako onenore kendo ni jopuonjrene e dho Nam Tiberia. To nenruokne kodgi nobet kama:
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

kikuyu: kendo uwachne ni, ‘Gima ruoth wacho ema: Ket ngʼatni e od twech kendo kik imiye gimoro amora makmana makati kod pi nyaka aduogi kangima.’ ”
english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Hobab wuod Reuel ja-Midian, ma en jaduongʼne niya, “Wawuok wadhi kama Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni obiro miyowa. Kuom mano bi kodwa mondo wadhi e piny maber mane Jehova Nyasaye osingo ne jo-Israel kendo wabiro miyi kar dak.”
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”

kikuyu: Ok nokwane jaketho kuom richo duto mosetimo. Nikech gik makare mosetimo, obiro bedo mangima.
english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

kikuyu: To mano kaka wan gi masira! En ngʼa mabiro resowa e lwet nyiseche maratekegi? Gin nyiseche mane ogoyo jo-Misri gi masiche mayoreyore e thim.
english: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Chunya otegno, yaye Nyasaye, chunya otegno; abiro paki gi wer kendo abiro loso wer mamit.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Kuom wach moro amora mane okel e nyimu gi joweteu modak e mier, bedni en wach nek kata weche moko mag chik, yorene kata weche mag buchene to nyaka usiemgi ni kik giketh e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ka ok kamano to mirimbe nobi kuomu kod kuom joweteu. Kutimo ma, to ok unutim richo.
english: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward the LORD, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

kikuyu: To e iyeno bende ipenjo ni, ‘Mano to konya gangʼo, koso ohala mane ma ayudo ka ok atimo richo?’
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka koro wan gi geno machal kama, wawuoyo gi chir mathoth.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

kikuyu: “Eka nochiwu mondo osandu kendo onegu, kendo ogendini duto nochau nikech an.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: To yor joricho chalo gi mudho mandiwa; ok gingʼeyo gima miyo gichwanyore.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

kikuyu: Osimbo mar duongʼ oselwar oa e wiwa. Yaye, masira omakowa, nikech wasetimo richo.
english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

kikuyu: mondo unyum tiendeu e remb joma kedo kodu, seche ma guogi magu olodho lewgi ka gichamo makorgi.”
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kod chunyu. Amin.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ruoth, wadwaro ni wanen.”
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

kikuyu: Ne ok girito singruok mar Nyasaye kendo ne gidagi dak ka giluwo chik Nyasaye.
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

kikuyu: Kendo mar misangono bende nobarore diere ariyo kendo buru mage nopukore oko kaluwore gi ranyisi mane ochiw gi ngʼat Nyasaye kod Wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ngʼaduru bura makare kendo utim gima kare, nikech warruokna osekayo machiegni kendo timna makare chiegni fwenyore.
english: The LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

kikuyu: momiyo an jambetre motwe. Lamuru mondo awuo kuome gi chir kaka owinjore atim.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Koro angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye reso ngʼate mowir; odwoke gie kare maler mar lemo manie polo, gi teko ma waro ji mar lwete ma korachwich.
english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

kikuyu: Ka dabed ni Nyasaye ogolo muche makelo ngima kuom dhano,
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e piny duto mondo uyal Injili ne chwech duto.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moketo Jehova Nyasaye kaka kar geno mare en ngʼat mogwedhi, ngʼat ma ok many kony kuom josunga, bende ok omany kony kuom joma lokore mondo olam nyiseche mag miriambo.
english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

kikuyu: To ji ne ok odewo kendo Manase ne obaro kodgi mane gimedo timo timbe maricho moloyo ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye otieko e nyim jo-Israel.
english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: ‘Jehova Nyasaye oseyieri jadolo kar Jehoyada mondo ibed jarit od Jehova Nyasaye; omiyo koro ngʼato ma janeko mawuondore ni janabi onego itwe gi nyororo kod chuma molworo ngʼute.
english: “The LORD has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the LORD’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

kikuyu: Noriembo chwo ma jochode mag kuonde lemo modarogi e pinye kendo noketho nyiseche manono mane kweregi oloso.
english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

kikuyu: Ber dak e kona mar wi ot moloyo dak gi dhako maralep.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Gima odol ok nyal rie; kendo gima onge ok kwan.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokawo odunga e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka ne ochike.
english: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ma e gima ruoth mabiro ritou notim: Nokaw yawuotu mi noketgi mondo giti e gechene gi faresene, kendo giniringi e nyim gechene.
english: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

kikuyu: miseiko e nyim ji duto,
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

kikuyu: Iloso mesa e nyima ka wasika neno. Iwiro wiya gi mo; kikombena opongʼ moo oko.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

kikuyu: To ne oyudo Abimelek pok oriwore kode. Eka nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye bende dineg joma onge ketho?
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodhi nyaka Bethel kendo gimanyo wangʼ Nyasaye. Negiwacho niya, “En dhoot mane kuomwa mabiro dhi mokwongo mondo oked gi jo-Benjamin?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Jo-Juda biro dhi mokwongo.”
english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” The LORD said, “Judah first.”

kikuyu: Chutho, kata obedo ni sani koro onego bed ni un jopuonj, to pod udwaro ngʼat machielo mondo ochak opuonju nonro michako ngʼeyogo adiera mar wach Nyasaye. Kar chamo chiemo motegno to pod umadho chak kende!
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

kikuyu: Kar odiechiengʼ tir, Elija nojarogi kawacho niya, “Koguru matek moloyo!” Adier en nyasaye! Sa moro en e paro matut; kata odich kata odhi wuoth! Kamoro dipo ka onindo matut manyaka chiewe.
english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Kohath nochako wuoth ka gitingʼo gik maler nikech Hemb Romo nyaka ne gur kapok gichopo.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

kikuyu: Nyasaye owuon nyalo timo nenda kaka chunya gombou duto ka an-gi hera matut mar Kristo Yesu.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: gimiyo joma ngʼeyogi tin bedo mariek, kendo gimiyo jomatindo ngʼeyo tiend weche kendo pogo tiend wach.
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

kikuyu: To tinde ere mor mane un-go mokwongo? Anyalo wacho ni kane alimou mokwongo, to ne urwaka gi mor maduongʼ ma kata mana wengeu ne unyalo miya.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

kikuyu: To ka achako awuoyo kodi kendo to abiro yawo dhogi, kendo ibiro wachonegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho.’ Ngʼat mohero winji obi owinji awinja, to ngʼat motamore winji bende otamre otama; nikech gin dhoot mohero ngʼanyo.
english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

kikuyu: To dhoga dine ojiwou; kendo hoch mawuok e dhoga dine odwogo chunyu.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

kikuyu: Eka nodonjo e yie mobet kodgi, kendo yamo nokwe mos. Jopuonjrene nohum nono,
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasayeno nowacho niya, “Ok anyal lokora ma adog kodi dala kata chiemo kata modho pi kodi ka.
english: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

kikuyu: “Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi kuom ndalo abiriyo kaka nachikou. Timuru mano e kinde moketi e dwe mar Abib, nimar e dweno ema ne agoloue e piny Misri.
english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Rang kendo inon ogendini mag piny mondo ibed gi bwok maduongʼ. Nimar abiro timo gimoro e ndalou ma ok ubi yiego, kata ka owachni.
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

kikuyu: mine giywaye gi tol ma gigole oko mar bur. Kendo Jeremia nodongʼ e laru mar jarito.
english: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

kikuyu: Paulo nodwoke niya, “Kata obed sa machwok kata malach, to alamo Nyasaye ok mana ne in kende, to nyaka ni ji duto mawinjo wachna kawuono, mondo gichal koda, makmana nyoroche motweyagogi ema kik tweugo un bende.”
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ikelo oganda Jehova Nyasaye e thimni, mondo mi wan kod jambwa watho kaye?
english: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

kikuyu: Solomon noidho malo kar kendo mar misango mar mula e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ei Hemb Romo, mochiwo misengini miwangʼo pep alufu achiel.
english: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi man Susa nobiro kaachiel tarik apar gangʼwen dwe mar Adar, mine ginego ji mia adek e Susa, to ne ok giyako girgi mora amora.
english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Machalre bende, bwomb kerubi achiel machielo borne ne romo fut aboro kendo nomulo bath hekalu komachielo, to bwombe machielo ma bende borne ne romo fut aboro nomulo bwomb kerubi mokwongo.
english: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

kikuyu: Nogolo osimbo mar duongʼ ewi ruodhgi, ma pek dhahabu mane olosego ne romo kilo piero adek gangʼwen kendo noduse gi kite ma nengogi tek mi osidhne Daudi. Noyako gik mangʼeny e dala maduongʼno
english: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

kikuyu: Eka malaika moro machielo, mane nigi teko kuom mach, noa e kar kendo mar misango kendo noluongo gi dwol maduongʼ jalno mane nigi pala mabith mar keyo kowachone niya, “Kaw pandi mabithno mar keyo mondo ikago olemb mzabibu mag piny, nikech olembene ochiek ahinya!”
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

kikuyu: Nimar mana kaka mil polo ji duto neno chakre wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ, e kaka dwok Wuod Dhano bende nobedi.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni ok atim gik ma Wuora timo, to kik uyie kuoma.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Ne giyaro jogo mondo omak tiendena, kane chuny lit odola. Ne gikunyo bugo e yora, to kata kamano gin giwegi ema giselutore e iye. Sela
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

kikuyu: ka amor e pinye mangima kendo ail gi ji duto.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

kikuyu: Okiyo ji e bath yore mag gwengʼ, onego ji apoya koa kuonde moponde, osiko ongʼicho mondo wangʼe omaki joma onge ketho mondo ohiny.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

kikuyu: Ka gima janabi owachono ok otimore kata ochopo kare, to mano en wach ma Jehova Nyasaye ok owacho. Janabino rodho arodha wach, kik uluore.
english: When a prophet speaks in the LORD’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

kikuyu: Jodolo, magin jo-Lawi, adier oganda duto mawuok e dhood Lawi ok noyud pokgi kata girkeni gi jo-Israel. Gibiro dak kuom chiwo motimne Jehova Nyasaye gi mach, nimar mano e pokgi.
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion.

kikuyu: Jotend jo-Lawi ariyo ma tijgi en tich ma oko mar od Nyasaye ne gin, Shabethai kod Jozabad.
english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nowacho niya, “We adhi, nikech en odiechiengʼ.” To Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Ok abi weyi idhi nyaka igwedha.”
english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

kikuyu: Bende ne akawo giru mar kethono, ma en kido mar nyaroya mane uloso, mine awangʼe e mach. Bangʼe ne atoye matindo tindo narege mayom kaka mogo, eka ne akire e aora mamol koa e got.
english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

kikuyu: Geng got achiel ne ni yo nyandwat mane omanyore gi Mikmash, to machielo ne ni yo milambo momanyore gi Geba.
english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo inyisgi ni: ‘Ka uchopo e piny ma asesingonu mi ukayo cham, to nyaka ukelne jadolo cham ma ukwongo kayo.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo wabet ka? Chokreuru kaachiel! Waringuru wadhi e mier madongo mochiel motegno gohinga kendo watho kuno! Nimar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa osejwangʼowa mondo watho, kendo osemiyowa pi moketie sum mondo wamodhi, nikech wasetimo richo e nyime.
english: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for the LORD our God has put us to silence, and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nopenje niya, “Nyingi ngʼa?” Nodwoke niya, “Jakobo.”
english: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

kikuyu: Ka ihulo gi dhogi ni “Yesu en Ruoth,” kendo iyie ei chunyi ni Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho, to iniyud warruok.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

kikuyu: Kane gisudo to neginyalo luwo yore angʼwen mane gik mangimago ochomo, ka ok tiendegi obayo yorego.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

kikuyu: Ok ginichak giluongi ni Kama Ojwangʼ kata chako pinyi ni kama Odongʼ Gunda. To noluongi ni Hefziba kendo pinyi noluongi ni Beula; nimar Jehova Nyasaye nobed kodi gi mor kendo pinyi nochal gi dhako mokendi.
english: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.

kikuyu: Bwomb kerubi achiel mokwongo ne romo fut aboro kendo bwombe machielo ne romo fut aboro kamano bende bwombene duto ne romo fut apar gauchiel.
english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

kikuyu: kendo ne osemiye ot malach kama yande ikanoe chiwo mar cham kod gik ubani kod gige hekalu, bende nikanoe achiel kuom apar mar cham, divai manyien gi mo kaka pok jo-Lawi, jower kod jorit dhorangeye, kaachiel gi chiwo mag jodolo.
english: had prepared for him a great room, where previously they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi chiwo mar cham mar mogo mayom maromo kilo adek gi nus moru gi mo; im to ichiw gi mogo mayom maromo kilo ariyo moru gi mo;
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ne oreso jo-Israel chiengʼno, eka lweny nosudo mokadho Beth Aven.
english: So the LORD saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

kikuyu: Kane gidhi e dala maduongʼ, Ishmael wuod Nethania kod chwo mane ni kode nonegogi mi owitogi ei bur.
english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Eka enogol nyarwadhno oko mar kambi mi ochiwe kaka misango miwangʼo mana kaka mochiwo mokwongo-cha. Mano en misango mar golo richo ni oganda.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

kikuyu: Jonabi mag-gi wacho niya, “Kik ukor wach. Kik ukor wach kuom gigi; wichkuot ok nomakwa.”
english: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

kikuyu: “Eka napenjo ni, ‘In ngʼa, Ruoth?’ “Ruoth to nodwoka ni, ‘An e Yesu misando.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: Daudi nobedo ruodh dhood Juda kuom higni abiriyo, gi dweche auchiel kane en Hebron.
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-adiera reso ji e tho, to janeno ma hango wach en jawuond.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

kikuyu: To ma e gima Nyasaye osewacho: Nyasaye osemiyowa ngima mochwere kendo ngimano ni kuom wuode.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

kikuyu: To nikech wuonewa nowangʼo ii Nyasach Polo, nochiwogi ne Nebukadneza ja-Kaldea, ruodh Babulon, ma nomuko hekaluni kendo oriembo ji nyaka Babulon.
english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.

kikuyu: Unudwara kendo unuyuda ka udwara gi chunyu duto.
english: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

kikuyu: To ngʼato kuomu nyalo nyisa niya, “Ka kamano to Nyasaye pod kwanowa kaka joketho nangʼo? Koso en ngʼa ma ditam dwarone timore?”
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

kikuyu: Nyithinde matindo to remo e chiembgi, kendo kama gima otho nitie, ema iyudogie.”
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anami ibed masira ni in iwuon kaachiel gi osiepeni duto; gi wengeni iwuon ininegi ka inegogi gi ligangla mar wasikgi. Anachiw jo-Juda duto ni ruodh Babulon, manotergi e piny Babulon kata negogi gi ligangla.
english: For the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nomiyo jo-Gad, jo-Reuben kod nus mar dhood Manase wuod Josef pinyruodh Sihon ma ruodh jo-Amor kod pinyruodh Og ma ruodh Bashan; pinyno duto kaachiel gi miechgi kod gwenge molworogi.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

kikuyu: Okumbana en Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, ma reso joma chunygi oriere tir.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Abiro jwangʼogi kendo jomecho biro dwanyo kara mageno. Gibiro donjo e iye kanyo mi gidwanye.
english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Yien moro amora ma Wuonwa manie polo ok opidho ibiro pudh oko gi tiendene.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

kikuyu: Rituru chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kuwuotho e yorene bende ka umiye luor.
english: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

kikuyu: Ne atingʼo wangʼa kendo angʼicho mi naneno ngʼat moro motingʼo tond pimo e lwete!
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

kikuyu: Ruodhi mag piny osebiro kanyakla kendo jotelo pimo wach kaachiel, mondo giked gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo giked gi ngʼate mowir.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

kikuyu: Kane en e yore odhi, sibuor noromo kode e yo monege kendo ringe nowit piny e yo, ka punda kod sibuor ochungʼ bute.
english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

kikuyu: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath kod Beth Shemesh. Giduto ne gin mier matindo kod gwenge apar gochiko.
english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Jo-Misri nolawogi kendo farese Farao duto gi gechene kaachiel gi joidh gechene nolawogi nyaka ei nam.
english: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

kikuyu: Magi e joma nobiro koa e mier mag Tel Mela, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Adon, kod Imer, to ne ok ginyal nyiso malongʼo ni anywolagi ne gin nyikwa Israel.
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

kikuyu: Jopuonjre mamoko to ne luwo bangʼe ka gin ei yie, kendo ka giywayo gogo ma rech opongʼo, nimar ne koro ok gin mabor gi dho nam, kendo nodongʼnegi mana fut mia ariyo gi piero ochiko gabich kende to gichop oko.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

kikuyu: Gidangʼni ei mudho maonge ler; kendo omiyo gikwangʼ ka joma omer.”
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

kikuyu: Dhako ma chunye ngʼwon yudo luor, to ji ma kitgi richo yudo mana mwandu kende.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

kikuyu: Mano kaka inine malit in dala maduongʼ ma jasand ji, ma toke tek kendo mogak.
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

kikuyu: Pinje duto nopenjre niya, “Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye otimo ma ne pinyni? Angʼo momiyo mirima mager omake malich kama?”
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

kikuyu: Eka janabino nodhi mochungʼ e bath yo korito ruoth. Noumo wangʼe gi kilemba mar wiye mondo kik fweny ni en ngʼa.
english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

kikuyu: kata obedo ni ok onyal pogore kode kendo okane ei dande iye,
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

kikuyu: Kane Zebul ma jatend dala maduongʼno nowinjo gima Gaal wuod Ebed owacho, iye nowangʼ ahinya.
english: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

kikuyu: Enoket dhakono mondo omodh pi makech makelo kwongʼ, kendo pigni nodonj e iye mi kelne sand mager.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

kikuyu: To Injili nyaka kuong landi e pinje duto.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

kikuyu: Ne gipuro puothe kendo ne gipidho puothe mzabibu, mane ochiego cham maber;
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

kikuyu: “ ‘Eka giniwach ne gode madongo niya, “Rwombreuru kuomwa!” Kendo ne gode matindo niya, “Umwauru!” ’
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

kikuyu: Ne otelonu kokalo piny malach mar ongoro piny motwo maonge kata pi, motingʼo thuonde kwiri kod thomoni, ne omiyou pi koa e lwanda matek.
english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjrene ma Jakobo gi Johana ne oneno ma, negipenjo niya, “Ruoth, idwaro ni mondo waluong mach oa e polo obi otiekgi koso?”
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

kikuyu: Ne atingʼo wangʼa kendo, mi napo ka aneno kalatas mafuyo e kor yamo!
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo asere maga tim remo ka liganglana powo dendgi; ma en remb joma onegi kod joma ni e twech, ma gin jotend wasikgi.”
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ere kaka ok iwinj tiend wechegi, to in japuonj jo-Israel?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone Daudi niya, “Ma en Merab nyara maduongʼ. Abiro miyigo mondo ikende; to mana ka inyalo kedona gi chir ka ikedo lwenje mag Jehova Nyasaye.” Nimar Saulo nowacho e chunye niya, “Ok abi keto lweta kuome. We jo-Filistia ema otim mano!”
english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

kikuyu: Bor mar kama ler mar lemo ne romo fut piero adek to lachne ne romo fut piero adek kendo borne madhi malo ne romo fut piero adek. Ne obawo ot maiye gi dhahabu lilo, bende noloso kendo mar misango gi bap sida.
english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

kikuyu: Rehum ma jatend lweny kod Shimshai ma jagoro nondiko baruwa marach kuom Jerusalem ne Artaksases ma ruoth kama:
english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

kikuyu: Kuom ranyisi ngʼato nyalo dhi kod nyawadgi e bungu mondo gitongʼ yien kendo kongʼayo leye malo mondo otongʼ-go yien, to wi le nyalo bwodhore ma tongʼ ngʼatno manege, ngʼatni nyaka ring dhi e mier mag pondogi mondo ores ngimane.
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

kikuyu: Malaikana biro telonu materu e piny jo-Amor, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, jo-Kanaan, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus kendo anatiekgi duto.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

kikuyu: To ka ok uchiwo luor ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo ok urito chikene duto adimba kod buchene ma amiyou kawuononi, to kwongʼ-gi duto biro makou.
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat maler nochok buru mag nyaroyano kendo oketgi kar misango maler e oko mar kambi. Ginikan-gi gi dhout oganda mar jo-Israel mondo ti kodgi e pi pwodhruok; nikech en mar pwodho ji aa e richo.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Kane gin kuno, kinde mar nywolo nyathi nochopo,
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

kikuyu: Abiro dwogogi mondo gichak gidag Jerusalem; gibiro bedo joga, kendo kaka Nyasachgi abiro bedonegi ja-adiera kod tim makare.”
english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomi nam makwar mar jo-Misri dwon, eka norie lwete e Aora Yufrate, mi okel yamo maliet. Nopog aorano nyadibiriyo, mondo omi ji ongʼade ka girwako mana pat pat.
english: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Benjamin mane oa Geba nodak Mikmash, Aija, Bethel kod gwenge mokiewo kodgi,
english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

kikuyu: ruodhi duto mag Turo kod Sidon; ruodhi mag pinje mokiewo e dho nam loka kocha;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

kikuyu: Kuom mano joga biro ngʼeyo nyinga; kendo odiechiengno giningʼe maber ni an, ema ne asewacho wechegi chon. Adier, en An.”
english: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”

kikuyu: “ ‘To ok anagol loch duto e lwet Solomon, asekete jatelo ndalo duto mag ngimane nikech Daudi jatichna, mane ayiero kendo mane orito chikena kod buchena.
english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

kikuyu: Salma wuon Bethlehem kod Haref wuon Beth Gader.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata kuomu manodonji e piny mane asingone katingʼo bada malo mondo obed dalau, makmana Kaleb wuod Jefune kod Joshua wuod Nun.
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny noyie kuome seche ma nowuoyono.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

kikuyu: Bet e laru mari kuom odiechiengʼ achiel ber moloyo bet kamachielo kuom higni alufu achiel; daher bedo jarit dhoot e od Nyasacha, moloyo dak e hembe joma timbegi richo.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nondiko baruwa machalo kama:
english: He wrote a letter like this:

kikuyu: Ka ochopo, to oyudo ka odno oywe maler kendo ochan maber.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne nyinge yawuot jo-Lawi: Gershon, Kohath gi Merari.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Opak Jehova Nyasaye nikech chunya nigi jotend jo-Israel, kaachiel gi jogo mochiwore!
english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD!

kikuyu: Hezekia nochiko mondo oik kuonde keno mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mi notim kamano.
english: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in the LORD’s house, and they prepared them.

kikuyu: To wan jotichni, ngʼato ka ngʼata ma jalweny biro ngʼado loka Jordan mondo oked e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka ruodhwa osechiko.”
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ka ibiro duogo, yaye Israel, to duog ira. Ka igolo nyisechegi mopa mamonogo e nyima ma ok ubaro,
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says the LORD, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;

kikuyu: E sa nogo Yesu nongʼeyo ni teko osewuok kuome. Nolokore mi ochomo oganda, kopenjogi niya,“En ngʼa momulo lepa?”
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

kikuyu: Anathoth, Nob kod Anania,
english: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

kikuyu: to ka ngʼato kuom jogi ma jo-Israel olemo kata okwayi, ka gingʼeyo gima chando chunygi kod lit ka girieyo bedegi kochomo hekaluni,
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

kikuyu: “An Jehova Nyasaye Nyasachu mane ogolou e piny Misri, anami udagi e hembeu kendo, mana kaka ndalo mane utimoe nyasi mag sawo mau.
english: “But I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

kikuyu: Josef nogolo chik mondo oket cham e ogundegi, odwokne ngʼato ka ngʼato pesane mane obirogo e ogunde, kendo mondo omigi gima ginyalo chamo e wangʼ yo ka gidok. Bangʼ kane osetimonegi ma,
english: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

kikuyu: wuod Tahath, wuod Asir, wuod Ebiasaf, wuod Kora,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

kikuyu: Bende negikelo jotije hekalu mia ariyo gi piero ariyo, ma en riwruok mane Daudi kod jotelo nochako mondo okony jo-Lawi. Giduto nondik nying-gi piny.
english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

kikuyu: To ka dende ochako dholore, to enobed mogak.
english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Kane onyis Daudi wachni, nooro joote mondo odhi orom ni jogo, nikech nokuod wigi marach. Ruoth nowachonegi niya, “Beduru Jeriko nyaka yie tiku ti, eka uduogi.”
english: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

kikuyu: Pewe motimo lum mag piny ongoro ngʼich oromo; kendo gode opongʼ gi mor.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ok diyiena ni mondo ater lweta kuom ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir. Koro kaw tongʼ gi puga mar pi machiegni gi wiye kaeto wadhi.”
english: The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”

kikuyu: To Petro nonyiso Yesu niya, “An ok abi weyi kata ka ji duto oringo oweyi.”
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasaye, bende diweye ngʼiya, kata kuom thuolo matin kende?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka uneno ka gigi timore to ngʼeuru ni kindeno chiegni, mana ka gima en e dhoot.
