english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

kikuyu: An Nebukadneza, noyudo ka an e dalana mar loch ka adhi maber kendo achano mwanduna.
english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne oweyogi, kendo nochako owuok modok mi olemo mar adek, kowacho gima chalre.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: mondo omi gilwori ndalogi duto ma gin-go e piny mane imiyo kwerewa.
english: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Kora niya, “In kaachiel gi jolupni duto kod Harun bende nyaka ubi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni joma tiyo e hekalu yudo chiembgi koa e hekalu, kendo ni joma chiwo misango ewi kendo mar misango ipogonegi misangogo?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

kikuyu: Eka Balak nowacho ne Balaam niya, “Bi wadhi kamachielo. Dibed ni biro bedo maber ne Nyasaye mondo ikwongʼnagi kanyo.”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

kikuyu: Dhakono nodhi dala moyudo nyathineno konindo e kitanda kendo ka jachien osea.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

kikuyu: “Yaye gode mag Gilboa, mad ibed maonge thoo kata koth, kata puothe machiego cham michiwo. Nimar kanyo ema ne odwanye kuodi mag joma rateke, kuodi mag Saulo, tinde ok wir gi mo.
english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

kikuyu: Dhorangeye apar gariyogo ne gin kite mag lulu ma nengogi tek, kendo dhorangach ka dhorangach nolos gi lulu achiel achiel moriwore. Yor dalano ne dhahabu lilo marieny maler ka kio.
english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

kikuyu: Mana kaka koth gi pe lwar koa e polo, kendo ok dog nono ka ok omiyo piny ngʼich, ma cham twi kendo nyag kothe ne jachwoyo, kendo cham ne jachiemo,
english: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

kikuyu: Balaam nowachonegi niya, “Ninduru ka kawuono kendo abiro miyou dwoko ma Jehova Nyasaye omiya.” Omiyo jotend jo-Moab nobedo kode.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

kikuyu: “To ka ngʼat ma timbene richo olokore oweyo richone mosetimo mi orito buchena kendo otimo gima ber kendo makare, to obiro bedo mangima kuom adier; ok obi tho.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

kikuyu: Omanyo puodho maber mi ongʼiew, kendo kuom ohala moloko opidhogo puothe mag olembe.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

kikuyu: mane gero ohinga. Joma ne otingʼo gige gedo ne tiyo gi lwetgi, to lwetgi komachielo otingʼo gir lweny,
english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobi kuomi gi teko, inikor kaachiel kodgi kendo noloki mibed ngʼato mopogore.
english: Then the LORD’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.

kikuyu: Achayo ngimana; ok agomb kata medo bedo mangima. Weya mos; ndalo mag ngimana onge gi tiende.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

kikuyu: Ka Kenan ne ja-higni piero abiriyo nonywolo Mahalalel.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wuod ruoth noyud lowo mogoyo tongʼ gi alwora mar gwengʼ maler kod kama ogerie dala maduongʼ. Yo podho chiengʼ lop wuod ruoth nochop nyaka e dho nam, to yo wuok chiengʼ lopno nogiki e tongʼ piny. Kuom mano borne koa yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ nobed maromre gi lowo mopogne dhoot ka dhoot mar Israel.
english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

kikuyu: Ka Nyasaye luongo singruokni ni “manyien” to mano nyiso ni osemiyo singruok mokwongo odoko machon maonge tich; to kaka oonge tich kendo oti, to obiro lal nono machiegni.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

kikuyu: Herani bende inyiso joma ni ei liel; adier, koso adierani bende yudore e kethruok piny?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

kikuyu: Jotelo mangʼeny nonwangʼ e nyikwa Eliazar moloyo nyikwa Ithamar kendo nopog-gi kaluwore gi tichgi. Jotend anywola apar gauchiel nowuok kuom nyikwa, Eliazar to gi jotend anywola aboro nowuok kuom nyikwa Ithamar.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

kikuyu: “Ka uchiwo misango mar goyo erokamano ni Jehova Nyasaye, to chiweuru kaka chik dwaro eka Jehova Nyasaye noyie kodu.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

kikuyu: Gichamo chiemo mangʼeny e hekalu mari ka gimor; imiyogi math moa e aorani mar mor.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

kikuyu: Nochokgi kaachiel kendo nolornegi mana kaka jo-jela molornegi e od twech kendo nolornegi e od twech, mi giyud kum kuom kinde mangʼeny.
english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nowuok modhi Rama, to Saulo bende nodok dalane Gibea.
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

kikuyu: Nyaka gibed jomaler e nyim Nyasachgi, kendo kik gicha nying Nyasachgi. Nikech gin ema gichiwo misengini miwangʼo e mach ni Jehova Nyasaye, ma en chiemb Nyasachgi, omiyo nyaka gibed maler.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

kikuyu: “Asenyisou gigi mondo uyud kwe moa kuoma. E pinyni ubiro neno chandruok, to beduru gi chir nikech aseloyo piny.”
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

kikuyu: Negitiyo kaka jongʼad bura mar oganda kinde duto. Buche matek negikelo ne Musa, to buche mayot negitieko giwegi.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

kikuyu: Ot moro amora mudonje, to dagieuru nyaka udar e dalano.
english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

kikuyu: Kane owach ni Daudi wachno, nochoko jo-Israel duto, mongʼado aora Jordan modhi Helam. Jo-Aram nochanore ni lweny mondo girad gi Daudi kendo negikedo kode.
english: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

kikuyu: Eka ne ahulo richona kendo ne ok apando timbena mag ketho. Ne awacho niya, “Abiro hulo ketho chik maga ne Jehova Nyasaye.” Omiyo ne iweyona ketho mane richona okelo. Sela
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Gi adiera ema ruoth miyo piny bet mochungʼ motegno, to ngʼat mawuor ne asoya muke magoye piny.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

kikuyu: Otucho kor lwanda; mi wengene ne mwandu duto manie kor gode.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

kikuyu: Eka jotich ma nyiri nomiel kendo bed mamor, yawuowi matindo kod joma oti machalre. Analok ywakgi obed mor; anahogi kendo anamigi ilo kar kuyo.
english: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo lewi moki e dandi, mondo eka ilingʼ ma ok inyal kwerogi, kata obedo ni gin dhoot mohero ngʼanyo kamano.
english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

kikuyu: Nimar kane agolo kwereu Misri kendo awuoyo kodgi, ne ok amiyogi mana chike kuom misango miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko,
english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;

kikuyu: Ka Ariok, jatend askeche morito ruoth nosewuok oko mondo oneg joma riek mag Babulon, Daniel nowuoyo kode gi rieko kod paro matut.
english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

kikuyu: Nogolo joge gi ilo, adier, nomiyo joge moyier owuok kakok gi mor;
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

kikuyu: Omedo sirni manie dhorangeyeni teko, kendo ogwedho jogi modak e iyi.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachno, mirima nomakogi mi gichako goyo koko kagiwacho niya, “Artemis mar jo-Efeso duongʼ!”
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

kikuyu: Kinyne nodok mi oneno jo-Hibrania ariyo ka dhawo. Nopenjo ngʼat ma nokwinyo nyawadgino niya, “Marangʼo igoyo ja-Hibrania wadu?”
english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”

kikuyu: Bende diket genoni kuom tekone mangʼenygo? Bende inyalo weye ne tiji matek mondo otimni?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

kikuyu: “Emomiyo ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wechenagi kendo otimogi chalo gi ngʼama riek mane ogero ode e lwanda.
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

kikuyu: kendo alamo ni ka Nyasaye oyie to mondo ayud thuolo mar biro iru.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

kikuyu: Ogendini modak e piny ongoro biro kulorene kendo wasike biro nangʼo lowo gi dhogi.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

kikuyu: Chwore ogenogo chutho kendo onge gima oreme.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

kikuyu: nomiyo Jeremia janabi ogo mi otweye e lodi mar Dhorangach Mamalo mar Benjamin mantiere e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia kane owinjo koko negipenjo niya, “Mano to koko manade magore e kambi mar jo-Hibrania?” Kane gifwenyo ni Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye osekel e kambi,
english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that the LORD’s ark had come into the camp.

kikuyu: kendo Josef nodaro jo-Misri e miechgi koa koni nyaka komachielo.
english: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

kikuyu: Bende Nyasaye nyalo ngʼado bura ma ok nikare? Bende Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nyalo weyo timo gima kare?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikwal. “ ‘Kik iriambi. “ ‘Kik iwuond nyawadu.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro mon ariyo ma jochode nobiro ir ruoth mochungʼ e nyime.
english: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.

kikuyu: To Josef nodagi mowachone niya, “Ruodha ongʼeyo gimoro amora manie odni, gimoro amora ma en-go oseketo e lweta.
english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Filipo nochako wuoth, to kane oyudo odhi, noromo gi ja-Ethiopia mabwoch, mane en jatelo maduongʼ morito mwandu duto mag Kandake, “ruoth ma dhako mar jo-Ethiopia.” Ngʼatni noa lemo Jerusalem,
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

kikuyu: Gik machalo gi dhahabu, fedha, mula, nyinyo, chuma
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ema nochweyo Yugni gi Ratego, en ema omiyo piny ru, kendo yuso, en bende ema oluongo pi nam mondo obi, kendo ologi e piny, nyinge iluongo ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,

kikuyu: Ruoth Ahasuerus nodwoko Esta ma mikache gi Modekai ma ja-Yahudi niya, Nikech Haman ne obuko jo-Yahudi ma ema omiyo asemiyo Esta mwandune, to en to osenege, kongʼawe e yath.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

kikuyu: “Pogreuru gi kanyakla mar ogandani mondo omi atiekgi chuth.”
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ne jonabi mane omiyo joga obaro oweyo yo, ka ngʼato omiyogi chiemo to giwacho ni, ‘kwe nitie,’ to ka ok omiyogi chiemo, to giikore tugo kode lweny.
english: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

kikuyu: pek mar dhahabu mar mesa ka mesa miketoe makati mopwodhi kaachiel gi pek mar fedha mag mesni molos gi fedha;
english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

kikuyu: Singruokno ok nochal gi mano mane atimo gi kweregi, kane amako lwetgi mi atelonegi kagologi e piny Misri, nikech negiketho singruokna, kata obedo nine an chworgi,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jolweny duto mag Babulon mane ichiko gi jatend jolweny marito ruoth ne omuko ohinga moluoro Jerusalem.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oganda maduongʼ nobiro ire, kendo negikelone rongʼonde, muofni, pudhe, momni gi ji matuo mamoko mangʼeny, mine giketogi e tiende kendo nochangogi.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

kikuyu: Shamsherai, Sheharia, Athalia,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu owuon biro telo e nyimu. Enotiek dhout pinjego duto kendo unukaw pinjegigo duto. Omiyo Joshua notelnu mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Tera nokawo Abram wuode, gi Lut nyakware ma ka wuode Haran kod Sarai, chi Abram mi giwuok Ur e piny Kaldea ka gidhi Kanaan. To kane gichopo Haran, negidak kanyo.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

kikuyu: Mon mondo opuonjre kolingʼ kendo koyie winjo wach.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone jaote niya, “Wachne Joab kama: Kik wachno chandi; ligangla nego jakoni gi jakocha. Med kedo matek gi dala maduongʼno mi ikethe chuth. Wachne wechegi mondo ijiwego.”
english: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Abimelek noluongo jotichne duto kendo kane onyisogi gik moko duto mane osetimore, negibedo maluor ahinya.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone jatich niya, “To ka wadhi, en angʼo ma wabiro miyo ngʼatni? Chiemo mane ni e mifukewa oserumo. Waonge kod mich ma wanyalo tero ne ngʼat Nyasaye. En angʼo ma wan-go?”
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”

kikuyu: Isekwero ogendini kendo isetieko joma richo; iserucho nying-gi oko manyaka chiengʼ.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ikwana kaachiel gi joma ridore piny ei bur matut; achalo ngʼama onge teko.
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

kikuyu: Mokwongo kane chik onge, to ne angima, to ka Chik nobiro, to richo nochier kuoma mi atho.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

kikuyu: “Kwereu ne ni kod Hema miluongo ni Hemb Rapar. Hemano nolosi mana kaka Nyasaye nonyiso Musa mondo olose, koluwo ranyisi mane omiye.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

kikuyu: Nimar joma kare ema nodag e piny kendo jogo maonge bura ema nosiki e piny;
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka Wuowi ema omiyo ubedo thuolo, to ubiro bedo thuolo chutho.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

kikuyu: nowuok Bethlehem mondo omany kama onyalo dakie. Kane pod odhi nyime gi wuoth, nodhi e od Mika mantiere e piny gode mag Efraim.
english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gichiemo, nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni achiel kuomu biro ndhoga, en ngʼat machiemo koda.”
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

kikuyu: Omiyo malaikano notiyo gi pande mar keyo e piny, ne okayo olembe mzabibu kendo noketogi kar biyo mzabibu maduongʼ mar mirimb Nyasaye.
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

kikuyu: Kamano bende Rahab dhako mane jachode nokwan kaka ngʼama kare kuom gima notimo kane orwako jombetre kendo okonyogi tony gi yo machielo.
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

kikuyu: Eka Saulo noweyo lawo jo-Filistia mine gidok thurgi.
english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, ka ber ne ruoth to mondo ogol chik maka ruoth kendo mondo ondiki wachni e chike mag Pasia gi Media, mosiko ma ok nyal gol ni Vashti kik chak bi e nyim ruoth Ahasuerus kendo. Bende ruoth onego ket ngʼato kare malongʼo man-gi chia moloye.
english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nodwoko kama:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Eka ringre jogi nobed chiemo mar winy mafuyo e kor polo kod le mag bungu manie piny, kendo onge ngʼama nobwog-gi mondo gia.
english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni ringreu gin fuonde Kristo owuon? Bende dakaw fuonde Kristo mondo ariw gi dhako ma jachode? Mano ok nyal timore ngangʼ!
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nodwoko Jehoshafat niya, “Pod nitie ngʼato achiel manyalo penjonwa Jehova Nyasaye wach, to ok adware nikech ok okor gimoro amora maber kuoma, to kinde duto mana gik maricho. Nyinge en Mikaya wuod Imla.” Jehoshafat nodwoko niya, “Ruoth, ok onego iwach kamano.”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

kikuyu: Kendo Elisha nolemo niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, yaw wangʼe mondo onen.” Eka Jehova Nyasaye noyawo wangʼ jatijno, kendo noneno farese kod geche lweny ewi got kolworo Elisha.
english: Elisha prayed, and said, “LORD, please open his eyes, that he may see.” the LORD opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne angʼiewe kuom shekel apar gabich mag fedha gi gunde ariyo mag shairi.
english: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ka dine ingʼe mich Nyasaye kendo ingʼe jal makwayi pi mondo omodhi, to dikwaye pi momiyi pi mar ngima.”
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

kikuyu: Niluta kuma tut mar nam, nyaka kama tutne ogikie piny, mi ataro noketa diere; kendo apaka kod ahiti madongo duto nokadho kuoma.
english: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

kikuyu: Nyisauru gik ma onego anyuomnu kata ma onego amiu kaka uhero, kendo abiro chulou gimoro amora ma ukwaya ka uyie miye nyaminu.
english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: “To mzabibu nodwoko ni, ‘Ere kaka dawe divai mara mamiyo nyiseche kod ji mor mondo abed ruodh yiende?’
english: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

kikuyu: Omiyo Harun notimo kaka Musa nowachone, kendo noringo modhi e dier chokruok. Masira ne osechakore e dier ji, to Harun nochiwo gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kendo nokwayonegi ngʼwono kuom gima gisetimo.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

kikuyu: Anamiyi nyikwayo mathoth; ginidog ogendini madongo kendo ruodhi nowuog kuomgi.
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

kikuyu: Abiro kumogi kata obedo ni gisewuok e mach, to mach pod biro mana wangʼogi. Kendo kinde ma abiro kumogi to unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼatni kata jonywolne ne ok otimo richo, to ma notimore mondo teko mar Nyasaye onenre e changne.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

kikuyu: To jo-Daudi nosenego jo-Benjamin mia adek gi piero auchiel mane nigi Abner.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

kikuyu: In e Nyasaye matimo honni, inyiso tekoni e dier ji mopogore opogore.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Bende kothe moko nolwar e lowo maber. Ne gitwi kendo neginyago cham, nyadi mia moloyo kaka nochwoyo.” Kane owacho ma, nogoyo koko niya,“Ngʼat man-gi ite mar winjo wach mondo owinji.”
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Nogomo kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ koa Sarid nyaka e piny Kisloth Tabor kendo odhi nyime nyaka Daberath mi ogik Jafia.
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

kikuyu: Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye wer manyien; piny duto mondo ower ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

kikuyu: Nam nogingre kuom Babulon; apakane mawuo noume.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno nokela nyaka e rangach mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ,
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

kikuyu: To ji mia auchiel noringo mi gidhi e thim nyaka e lwanda mar Rimon, kama negidakie kuom dweche angʼwen.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

kikuyu: Othniel wuod Kenaz, ma owadgi Kaleb matin, noloyo pinyno, omiyo Kaleb nomiye nyare Aksa mondo okendi.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye biro reso Sayun kendo obiro gero dala mag Juda kendo. Eka ji nodag kanyo kendo ginikawe kaka margi;
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

kikuyu: Usemedo jolok ohala magu, makoro githoth moloyo sulwe ma e polo, kendo kaka det bonyo chamo piny, e kaka giweyo piny duk bangʼe to gihuyo ma gia.
english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

kikuyu: Nogogi gi kite, nongʼadgi malit bende moko nonegi gi ligangla. Ne giwuotho ka gi kacha, ka girwako piende rombe gi piende diek, kagidhier kisandogi kendo kichandogi malit;
english: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada ne jalweny mathuon moa Kabzel, notimo timbe madongo. Nonego ji ariyo mag Moab mane ger ka sibuor. Chiengʼ moro nodonjo e bur ka piny otimo pe mi onego sibuor.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

kikuyu: Odongo piyo piyo ka maua bangʼe to oner; mana ka tipo makadho ma ok siki.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it, mondo owinji!
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

kikuyu: Kweth mag jamni biro nindo piny motimo kanyo, kod kit chwech mopogore opogore. Tula mar thim kod agak nobed gi nyasi. Ywakgi nowinjre ka wuok gie dirisni, kite moger godo udi nomukre mabiwre e dhoudi, kendo sirni nodongʼ kongʼiengore.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

kikuyu: Eka nonyisogi gik mangʼeny e yor ngeche, kowacho niya, “Japur moro nodhi chwoyo kodhi.
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Misango duto mag cham mobul e kendo kata motedi e sufuria, kata e dakuon, nodongʼne jodolo motime;
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Yesu nochako odonjo e sinagogi, to ne nitie ngʼato kanyo ma lwete otal.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

kikuyu: Karaya mar Namno norenji e ngʼe rwedhi apar gariyo, ka adek ngʼiyo yo nyandwat, to adek ngʼiyo yo podho chiengʼ, to adek ngʼiyo yo milambo bende adek ngʼiyo yo wuok chiengʼ. Karaya mar Namno noyiere kuomgi kendo tiendegi machien nochomo ka iye.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

kikuyu: Hera ok mor gi gik maricho, to omor gi adiera.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

kikuyu: kendo negiluongo gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Yesu, Ruoth! Kechwa!”
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

kikuyu: Pok mar angʼwen ne mar Izri gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: nyikwa Rama kod Geba, ji mia auchiel gi piero ariyo gachiel (621),
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

kikuyu: Negiloko mwandugi kod gik mane gin-go pesa kendo ne gipogore kaka ne ngʼato ka ngʼato dwaro.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jaricho wangʼe tek to ngʼat moriere tir tiyo gi paro e yorene.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

kikuyu: Nimar richo nokawo thuolo mane chik okelo, mowuonda, kendo okonyore gi chikno mondo onega.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

kikuyu: Nyaka gichok kendo gikan e mier madongo chiemo duto moyudi e higni abiriyo mag yiengʼogo e bwo chik Farao.
english: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

kikuyu: To eka pod negidhi mana nyime ka gitimo richo e nyime ka gingʼanyo e thim ne Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

kikuyu: Kindeno Ruoth Nyasaye norie bade kendo koresogo joge mane odongʼ e lwet jo-Asuria, koa Misri mamwalo nyaka mamalo, koa Kush, Elam, Babulon, Hamath to gi chula manie ii nam.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Ruodhi ema nobed kaka wuoneu kendo mond ruodhi ema nobed kaka mineu ma ritou. Ginikulre auma e nyimu ka wengegi ngʼiyo piny; kendo gininangʼ buru manie tiendu. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye kendo joma oketo genogi kuoma ok noyud wichkuot.”
english: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko sokono notwo nikech koth ne pok ochuwe e piny.
english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

kikuyu: “Nitie gik moko adek mamiya awuoro ahinya, angʼwen ma ok anyal ngʼeyo tiendgi.
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada ne jatend jo-Kereth gi jo-Peleth; to yawuot Daudi to ne jangʼad rieko mar joka ruoth.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Hashum: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manase gi Shimei.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

kikuyu: Negiketo gige mag lweny e hekalu mar nyisechegi, to wiye, to negiliero e hekalu mar Dagon.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

kikuyu: Koko mag bwombe kerubi ne nyalo winjore nyaka e laru ma oko, mana kaka dwond Nyasaye Maratego.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

kikuyu: e kaka gin bende sani gingʼanyo, mondo kuom kech mosekechugo, gin bende koro okechgi.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho ne Musa niya, “Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ jatelo achiel nyaka kel misango mare mar gwedho kendo mar misango.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

kikuyu: Udi matindo mane ni e gorofa ma malo ne diny moloyo mago mane ni e gorofa madiere kod mapiny ma piny, nikech kuonde miluwo mochiel nokawo kama duongʼ moloyo.
english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

kikuyu: Kuom mano daher mondo mon ma chwogi otho matindo okendi, mondo ginywol nyithindo, kendo girit utegi mondo kik gimi jasigu thuolo mar ketho nying joma oyie.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

kikuyu: Kochakore e kinde mane kwereu oa Misri nyaka sani, odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, ne asiko aoronegi jotich ma jonabi.
english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ma atiyone gi chunya duto, ka alando Injili mar Wuode, en janenona kaka asiko aparou e lamona kinde duto
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

kikuyu: To jotend lweny mag jo-Filistia nokecho kode ma giwacho niya, “Riemb ngʼatni odogi mondo odog kama ne imiye. Ok onego odhi kodwa e lweny, nikech e kinde ma lweny dhi nyime onyalo lokore kodwa. Donge mano e yo monyalo morogo ruodhe konego jowa moko?
english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

kikuyu: Ma en wach mar adiera ni ka ngʼato oketo chunye mondo obed jatend kanisa to odwaro tich mogen.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Asaf. Adier Nyasaye timo maber ni jo-Israel, otimo maber ne jogo maler ei chunygi.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

kikuyu: Bende gihero kuonde ma imiyoe ji duongʼ e sewni kendo bedo e kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke.
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

kikuyu: Nyi Zelofehad miluongo ni Mala, Tirza, Hogla, Milka kod Nowa nonywom gi ominegi ma yawuot owadgi wuon-gi.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

kikuyu: Wach niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: “ ‘Ringre joma otho nopie ka owuoyo e pap alanga, kaka cham mokaa gi jakeyo, maonge ngʼama nyalo chokogi.’ ”
english: Speak, “The LORD says, “‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’”

kikuyu: Balaam nochiewo gokinyi, moidho pundane kendo nodhi gi jotelo mag Moab.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Kane awinjo wechegi, to ne abet piny mi aywak. Kuom ndalo manok nakuyo kendo natweyo chiemo kalamo e nyim Nyasach polo.
english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,

kikuyu: Jakobo nokecho gi Rael kendo nowachone niya, “Iparo ni an e Nyasaye mosetami nywolo nyithindo?”
english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, masira biro make maloye apoya nono; notieke apoya nono, maonge resruok.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

kikuyu: Un to kik uwuogi ua e dho Hemb Romo, nono to ubiro tho, nikech un Jehova Nyasaye osewalou.” Omiyo negitimo mana kaka Musa nosewachonegi.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

kikuyu: Kokalo kuom jooteni usegango weche mag ayany kuom Ruoth Nyasaye. Bende usewacho niya, “Gi gechena mangʼeny mag lweny aseidho gode maboyo mag Lebanon mi achopo ewi got mabor moloyo. Asetongʼo yiendene mag sida maboyo kendo mabeyo. Asechopo nyaka e chuny bungu ma iye mogik kuma yien odiche.
english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

kikuyu: Nyaka upog pinyni e migepe abiriyo. Jo-Juda nyaka dongʼ kargi man yo milambo kendo joka Josef bende odongʼ kargi man yo nyandwat.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

kikuyu: Nikech gichikona obadhogi kayiem nono kendo gikunyona bur kayiem mondo alwarie;
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

kikuyu: Ne isechano mondo nyithindo kod nyithindo mayom omiyi pak, nikech wasiki, mondo jawasigu kod jachul kuor olingʼ kawuoro timni.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ka ruodh pinyno ogolo mich moro kuom girkeni mare momiyo achiel kuom yawuote, to michno nobed girkeni mar nyikwaye bende, kaka girkeni margi.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

kikuyu: Timuru ma ne misengini duto mag jamni moro ka moro.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka tiengʼ mar joma dware chalo, mamanyo wangʼi, yaye Nyasach Jakobo. Sela
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Mbaka nowuok e kind jopuonjre ni en ngʼa kuomgi manobed maduongʼ moloyo.
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

kikuyu: Kendo Yesu nochako puonjo e dho nam. To oganda maduongʼ nochokore molwore omiyo nodonjo ei yie mi obetie ka ji duto to ochungʼ oko e dho nam.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka jadolo notimnego misango mipwodhogo kethoneno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo enowene kuom ketho duto ma osetimo, mane omiyo obedo jaricho.”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

kikuyu: Mad ibar polo mondo ilor piny, mondo gode otetni e nyimi,
english: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

kikuyu: bende duritgi nyaka gibed jomadongo? Bende dusiki ma ok okendu kapod uritogi? Ooyo, nyiga. An ema an-gi lit moloyou, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osekuma!”
english: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for the LORD’s hand has gone out against me.”

kikuyu: nikech tiendgi reto piyo piyo mar timo richo kendo gimwomore mondo gichwer remo.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kikuyu: “Beduru motangʼ ne timo winjruok gi jogo modak e pinyno; nimar ka gilamo nyisechegi e yor dwanyruok kendo gitimo misengini gibiro luongou kendo ubiro chamo chiembgi mag misengini.
english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

kikuyu: Nikech ne uwinjo wach kendo uboloru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kane uwinjo weche mane owacho kuom Jerusalem kod joma odakie ni gibiro yudo kwongʼ mi gidongʼ kama ojwangʼ, kendo nikech ne uyiecho lepu kuywak e nyima, omiyo asewinjo ywaku, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: kowuoyo kuom Wuode, ma en Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa ma en nyakwar Daudi kuom ringruok.
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

kikuyu: Eka inyise ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Hibrania, oseora mondo anyisi niya: We joga odhi, mondo gilama e thim. To nyaka chop koroni pok iwinjo.
english: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

kikuyu: “Ne atimo singruok gi wangʼa mondo kik arang nyako moro gi wangʼa mi agombi.
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

kikuyu: Anangʼadne bura ka kelone masiche kod tho, anakel koth maduongʼ gi pe madongo kod kite maliel mach kuome kendo kuom pinje mangʼeny ma jokore.
english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

kikuyu: Koro sani timuru kamano! Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ne osingore ni Daudi ni, Ka akonyora gi jatichna Daudi abiro reso joga Israel oa e lwet Filistia kendo e lwet wasikgi duto.
english: Now then do it! For the LORD has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

kikuyu: “Chiwo manyaka ikaw kuomgi e magi: “dhahabu, fedha kod mula;
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “To un, to uwacho ni An ngʼa?”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Pak obed ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mosetimo gi lwete gima ne osingo gi dhoge ni Daudi wuonwa. Nikech nowacho niya,
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Akwongʼora ni ma e singruokna kodgi. Roho mara man kuomu kod wechena ma aseketo e dhou nosik kodu chakre kawuono nyaka tiengʼ mabiro bangʼu koa kuom nyikwau kadhi nyaka kuom nyithindgi, wach ok nowuogi e dhog-gi ndalo duto nyaka chiengʼ,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”

kikuyu: “Koro lingʼ thi, in ngʼat moowre marach makawore ni nigi ngima mamalo, kendo iwacho e chunyi iwuon ni, ‘An ema antie kendo onge moro ma dirom koda, ok nachal gi dhako ma chwore otho kata nyithinda ok notho.’
english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Chungi e laru mar od Jehova Nyasaye kendo iwuo gi ji duto manie dala mar Juda ma lemoga e od Jehova Nyasaye. Nyisgi gik moko duto manyisi; kik iwe kata wach achiel.
english: “The LORD says: ‘Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.

kikuyu: Elisha janabi noluongo achiel kuom jonabi mowachone niya, “Ngʼwan lawi e nungoni, kendo ikaw morni idhigo e piny Ramoth Gilead.
english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka wan duto, bed ni wan jo-Yahudi kata jo-Yunani, kata wasumbini, kata joma ni thuolo, nobatiswa kuom Roho achielnogo mi wadoko ringruok achiel, kendo osemiwa Roho achielno mondo wamodhi waduto.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

kikuyu: kendo ok unulos winjruok moro gi jopinyni, to unumuk kendegi mag misango. Kata kamano, ok useluora. En angʼo momiyo usetimo ma?
english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gabich mar loch Azaria ruodh Juda, Pekahia wuod Menahem nobedo ruodh Israel ka en Samaria kuom higni ariyo.
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

kikuyu: “Jodong jo-Israel biro winjo gima iwacho. Bangʼ mano in kaachiel gi jodongo unudhi ir ruodh Misri mi uwachne kama: ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Hibrania oseromo kodwa. Omiyo yie iwe wadhi e thim kama kawo wuodh ndalo adek mondo wachiwne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa misengini.’
english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD, our God.’

kikuyu: Ichalo ngʼama nyalo goyo ombulu mar nego nyathi kich kendo inyalo ndhogo kata mana osiepeni.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi nyime mowachonegi niya, “Sabato noketi nikech dhano, to dhano ne ok ochwe nikech Sabato.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Yawuot Reuben wuod Israel makayo ne gin: Hanok, Palu, Hezron kod Karmi.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Molwar e lwanda gin jogo ma rwako wach gi mor ka giwinje, to gionge gi tiendegi. Giyie kuom kinde moromo, to e kinde mag tem gipodho giaa.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

kikuyu: Omiyo Bathsheba nodhi neno ruoth makoro hike ne ngʼeny e agola mare mar nindo kama Abishag nyar Shunam ne rite.
english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

kikuyu: Jomoko richogi ongʼongʼore kendo otelo nyimgi ka terogi e bura to richo jomoko to opondo kendo luwo bangʼ-gi.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

kikuyu: To Jonathan wuod Saulo nodhi Horesh ir Daudi mokonye koduogo chunye mondo oyud teko moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

kikuyu: Jogo mane otonyne ligangla kendo odwogo e piny Juda koa Misri nobed manok. Eka jo-Juda duto mane odongʼ mane obiro dak Misri nongʼe ni en wach ngʼa matiyo, mara koso margi.
english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

kikuyu: Wan okumwa kare, nimar wayudo gima owinjore gi timbewa. To jali onge gima rach mosetimo.”
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

kikuyu: Parie teko mangʼeny ma en-go, kendo parie teko maduongʼ manie leche mag dende!
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

kikuyu: Ombulu mokwongo nolwar ne Jehoyarib, to mar ariyo ne Jedaya,
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni onge gima orem kuom winjruok machon, to winjruok manyien ok dobiro kare.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

kikuyu: Koriwore duto, jogo mane oyier mondo obed jorit rangeye man gohinga kar kwan-gi ne mia ariyo gi apar gariyo (212). Ne ondik nying-gi kaluwore gi nonro mar anywolagi e miechgi. Jorit rangeye ne omii tijni mogen koa e lwet Daudi gi Samuel ma jakor wach.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

kikuyu: akonyora kodi kuom tieko faras gi jaithne, in ema atiekogo gach lweny kod jariembe,
english: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye notimo kaka Musa nokwayo: Lwangʼni noweyo Farao kod jodonge kaachiel gi joge: Kata lwangʼni achiel ne ok odongʼ.
english: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

kikuyu: “Abiro keto tongʼ mar pinyu kochakore Nam Makwar nyaka e tongʼ Nam mar Mediterania, kendo chakre e thim nyaka e Aora mar Yufrate.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo iya nowangʼ gi tiengʼno kendo nawacho ni, ‘Chuny jogi ohero rwenyo, kendo pok gingʼeyo yorena.’
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

kikuyu: Aonge gi kwe, chunya chandore; aonge yweyo, kendo thagruok lilo ema aneno.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

kikuyu: kod rwedhi ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe mahikgi oromo higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Magi e misengini mane Elizur wuod Shedeur ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Resa kuom ketho maga duto; kik imi abedi ngʼama joma ofuwo jaro.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

kikuyu: Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh Asuria nobiro ire to kar konye to nomonje.
english: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

kikuyu: mane osandogi kendo othirogi e higano. Kuom higni apar gaboro negisando jo-Israel duto mane nitie yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan e piny Gilead, ma en piny jo-Amor.
english: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

kikuyu: Mi ji nowuok mondo gine gino mosetimore. Kane gibiro ir Yesu, negiyudo ngʼatno ma yande jochiende nosewuok kuome, kobedo piny e tiend Yesu, korwakore kendo ka parone ni kare; mi luoro nomakogi.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Iseguro chikeni ni nyaka lu kaka gin.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kikuyu: Asekeyo timbeni manono mana ka boche polo, kendo aserucho richogi modwono mana kongʼwengʼo. Duog ira, nimar aseresi.”
english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

kikuyu: Kata kamano jo-Israel nonege gi ligangla kendo gikawo puothe koa aora Arnon nyaka Jabok, ma en tongʼ mar jo-Amon kendo ne giyudo e pinyno ka jogo roteke.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

kikuyu: nyikwa Azgad, Johanan wuod Hakatan, kaachiel kode ji mia achiel gapar;
english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

kikuyu: ‘Duongʼ ma hekaluni biro bedogo achien, biro loyo mano mane en godo mokwongo,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho. ‘Anakel kwe gi mwandu kae,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.”
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Bende dapand ne Ibrahim gima adwaro timo?
english: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Weyeuru mos. Uchande nangʼo? Osetimona gima ber miwuoro.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharath,
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, jatich machielo nobiro mowacho niya, “Jo-Kaldea noloso migepe adek mag jolweny mi gimonjowa ma gikawo ngamia-gi duto kendo gidhigo. Gisenego jotichni duto gi ligangla, kendo an kenda ema asetony mondo anyisi wachni!”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Petro nowacho niya, “Nyiswae tiend ngerono.”
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono kod kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo,
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego to en ngʼa, ma dwatine? Koso en ohala mane mwabiro yudo kwalame?
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

kikuyu: Ne gitero ne wuon-gi kandho Josef mane olos maber kendo ma nengone tek kagiwacho niya, “Ne wayudo kandhoni. Range ane maber ka en mar wuodi.”
english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe negiluongo joma ne nitie Jerusalem e ohinga ka gikok gi dwol maduongʼ gi dho jo-Hibrania mondo obwog-gi kendo omi gibed gi luoro eka mondo gikaw dala maduongʼno.
english: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.

kikuyu: kendo nyiswa anena ni angʼo mabiro timore, mondo wangʼe ni un nyiseche. Timuru ane gimoro, bed ni ber kata rach, manyalo bwogowa kendo kelo luoro kuomwa.
english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

kikuyu: Kamano tienge duto mane nitie chakre Ibrahim nyaka Daudi ne gin apar gangʼwen; to chakre Daudi nyaka ndalo twech e Babulon ne tienge apar gangʼwen kendo chakre ndalo twech nyaka kinde mag Kristo bende ne tienge apar gangʼwen.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

kikuyu: Gihero bende mondo omosgi e chirni, kendo mondo ji oluong-gi ni, ‘Rabi.’
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

kikuyu: “Jatich wadgino nogoyo chonge piny e nyime moywagorene ni, ‘Yie itimna ngʼwono, abiro chuli gopi.’
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

kikuyu: Ligangla ema nomiyi chiemo kendo inibed jatij owadu. To ka iyudo loch to iningʼanyne, kendo nia e bwo lochne.”
english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

kikuyu: Norito ndalo abiriyo moko kendo nochako ooro akuruno, to ne ok odwogo ire kendo.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

kikuyu: Ne iritogi e thim kuom higni piero angʼwen; onge gimoro amora mane gionge godo, lepgi ne ok oti kata tiendegi bende ne ok okuot.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

kikuyu: Tim makare tingʼo oganda malo, to richo en wichkuot ne ji.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

kikuyu: to wasuduru but Nyasaye gi chuny mar adier, kendo ka wan gi yie ma ok wariwo gi kiawa, bende ka chunywa manyisowa ni wan joketho opwodhi kendo ka ringrewa olwoki gi pi maliw.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

kikuyu: Osiepena jara to pi wangʼa chwer ka akwayo Nyasaye mondo odwok lamona;
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

kikuyu: Bende gibiro lonyi duk mi gikaw gik milichorigo ma nengogi tek mi gidhigo.
english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

kikuyu: Malaika nomedo wachone niya, “Abiro medo ogandani mabed mangʼeny ma ok nyal kwan.”
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodonjo e laru mar hekalu, kendo kane oyudo opuonjo, jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda nobiro ire. Negipenje niya, “Itimo gigi gi teko mane, koso ngʼa momiyi teko ma in-goni?”
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nowangʼ boche chiayo motimgo misango mar golo richo e kendo mar misango.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

kikuyu: Gi mor malach, ibiro tuomo pi koa e sokni mag resruok.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

kikuyu: jaduongʼ lweny nogolo chik mondo oter Paulo kama jolweny odakie. Nogolo chik mondo ochwade kendo onone kuom gima omiyo ji goyone koko kamano.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

kikuyu: Eka Petro nowachone Anania niya, “Ere kaka iseweyone Satan thuolo e chunyi momiyo isewuondo Roho Maler, ka idongʼ gi bath pesa mane iyudo kuom puodho?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

kikuyu: To ne iwachone jotichni ni, ‘Ka ok ubiro gi owadu matin, to ok unuchak une wangʼa kendo.’
english: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

kikuyu: “Asewachonu wechegi duto mondo kik ulal.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

kikuyu: Asa notho moyweyo kod kwerene e higa mar piero angʼwen gi achiel mar lochne,
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho ni rawera mane okelone wach niya, “In jakanye?” Nodwoke niya, “An wuod jadak ma ja-Amalek.”
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

kikuyu: isetimo kamano mondo awuothi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, e piny joma ngima.
english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Ka gik mangimago ne sudo, to tiende mane ni bathgi bende ne sudo, kendo kane gik mangimago aa malo, to tiendego bende ne aa malo.
english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

kikuyu: Aseywak mi pi wangʼa osechalo chiemba odiechiengʼ gotieno, ka ji to wachona odiechiengʼ duto niya, “Koro ere Nyasachino?”
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Nikech ka weche mane malaike owuoyoe ne gin weche migeno, kendo ngʼato angʼata mane ok oritogi noyudo kum mowinjore gi timne,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

kikuyu: Ne ok owe dichwo kata dhako kangima mane inyalo kel Gath, nimar noparo e chunye niya, “Ginyalo hulowa kagiwacho ni, ‘Ma e gima Daudi notimo.’ ” Kendo ma netimne e kinde duto mane odak e piny Filistia.
english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

kikuyu: Ka bur omako ngʼato mi ochango,
english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

kikuyu: Jo-Gershon nonwangʼo magi: Koa kuom nus anywola mar joka Manase, neginwangʼo Golan man Bashan kod Ashtaroth bende, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath;
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Ezra nochopo Jerusalem e dwe mar abich mar higa mar abiriyo mar ruoth.
english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abich mar dweno, kane ruoth Jehoyakin osetieko higni abich e twech,
english: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

kikuyu: Yie wiye ne rachar ka yie rombo, bende ne rachar ka pe, to wengene ne chalo gi mach makakni.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ngʼat mariek lingʼ alingʼa e kinde ma kama nikech gin kinde mag richo.
english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik ngʼato sungre kuom dhano! Gik moko duto gin mau.
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

kikuyu: Omiyo jotije nowachone niya, “Haman ema ochungʼ e laru.” Ruoth nogolo chik niya, “Kele ira ka.”
english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”

kikuyu: kendo jorit pinje, jochik tich, jotelo, kod jongʼad rieko mag ruoth nosudo butgi machiegni molworogi. Negineno ka mach ne ok owangʼogi, onge yie wigi kata achiel mane mach oreyo, kandho mag-gi bende ne ok orewore, to bende ne ok gidungʼ kata mana iro.
english: The local governors, the deputies, and the governors, and the king’s counselors, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power on their bodies. The hair of their head wasn’t singed. Their pants weren’t changed. The smell of fire wasn’t even on them.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto noneno mach koa e polo kabiro piny kod duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye kani ewi hekalu negigoyo chongegi e ndiri ka gikulore auma. Negilamo kendo goyone Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, kagiwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ber kendo herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.”
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and the LORD’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

kikuyu: Ka en tiyo ni ji, to mondo oti, ka en puonj, to mondo opuonji.
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

kikuyu: kendo ji mangʼeny nobiro ire. Negiwacho niya, “Kata obedo ni Johana ne ok otimo tim hono moro amora, to gik moko duto manowacho kuom ngʼatni ne gin adier.”
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

kikuyu: Jotich molony duto mane nigi jotich mamoko nogero Hemb Romo gi pasia apar mar law mayom momin man-gi rangi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro ka ogorie kido mar malaika mar kerubi gi jagoro molony.
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: mar adek ne en Abisalom wuod Maaka nyar Talmai ruodh Geshur, mar angʼwen, Adonija wuod Hagith;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Ibrahim niya, “Angʼo momiyo Sara nonyiero kawacho ni, ‘Bende danywol nyathi kaka asetini?’
english: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka uchiwo misango mar lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye, to timeuru e yo mowinjore ma Jehova Nyasaye oyiego.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

kikuyu: Ka wuonu ok onena e nyasini, to nyise ni, ‘Daudi nokwaya mondo amiye thuolo odhi dalagi Bethlehem mapiyo piyo, nikech anywolagi duto nigi misango mar higa ka higa.’
english: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ka gin oganda achiel, mawacho dhok achiel ema gisechako timo ma, kara gimoro amora ma gichano timo ok nyal tamogi.
english: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

kikuyu: Ka Daudi owuon nowuoyo kuom teko mar Roho Maler kolero niya: “ ‘Ruoth nowachone Ruodha ni, “Bed e bada korachwich, nyaka aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Yawuot Merari ne gin: Mali kod Mushi. Dhout jo-Lawi kaluwore kweregi e magi:
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Abiro biro iru e boche polo mondo omi oganda owinj kaka awuoyo kodi kendo mano biro miyo giket genogi kuomi ndalo duto.” Eka Musa nonyiso Jehova Nyasaye gima oganda nowacho.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Chikego wacho niya, “Kik iterri, kik ineki, kik ikwal, kik igomb gir wadu,” kod chike mamoko duto moriw e chik achiel mawacho niya, “Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.”
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: To kane pod ongima, nochiwo mich ne yawuot monde ma jotichge kendo nodarogi mondo gia kuom Isaka koterogi e piny man yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

kikuyu: Ne ilosone lowo maber, kendo nochwoyo tiendene piny mi opongʼo piny.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

kikuyu: Rehoboam nohero Maaka nyar Abisalom moloyo mondege mamoko kod mon mamoko. Ne en kod mon apar gaboro kaachiel gi mon mamoko piero auchiel, bende ne en gi yawuowi piero ariyo gaboro kod nyiri piero auchiel.
english: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

kikuyu: Boche nowuok e ler marieny mane aa kuome, kaachiel gi pe madongo dongo kod mil polo ma tiarore.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka onego utimne mier madongo duto man mabor, to kik utim kamano ne mier machiegni kodu.
english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, in ok niger hekalu, to wuodi, ma en ringri gi rembi iwuon, en ema noger hekalu ni Nyinga.’
english: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

kikuyu: nyikwa Bebai, ji mia auchiel gi piero ariyo gadek (623),
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Lamek nokendo mon ariyo, achiel ne nyinge Ada to machielo Zila.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

kikuyu: Jotelo mamoko mag dhoudi notero dhahabu maromo kilo mia achiel gi piero abiriyo e od keno ne tijno kod fedha moromo kilo alufu achiel gi nus.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

kikuyu: Tho ma nothogo notho ne richo dichiel kendo mogik; to ngima ma ongimago, ongima ne Nyasaye.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

kikuyu: Anadaru e nyima, mana kaka ne atimone oweteu duto, ma jo-Efraim.’
english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi, ineye tiende ngʼat makelo Injili, kendo malando kwe ewi gode! Tim nyasi mar mor, yaye Juda, chopuru singruoku. Jomaricho ok nochak omonju kendo; nikech ibiro tiekgi pep.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

kikuyu: eka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro chopo gweth mare kuomu obiro bedo gi miwafu ne un ma ochoku duto ka uwuok e pinje duto mane okeyoue.
english: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

kikuyu: Osiepne nodwoko niya, “Ma ok en wach moro machielo makmana ligangla mar Gideon wuod Joash, ma ja-Israel. Nyasaye osechiwo jo-Midian kod kambi duto e lwete.”
english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

kikuyu: Mon nowachone Naomi niya, “Opak Jehova Nyasaye kawuononi nikech ok osejwangʼi, nimar osemiyi nyakwari. Mad obed ngʼat marahuma e piny Israel duto!
english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Harun notingʼo lwete malo kochomo oganda mi nogwedhogi. Bangʼe nolor piny oa kama notimoe misengini mag golo richo gi misengini miwangʼo pep, kod misengini mag lalruok.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

kikuyu: mi gitere ir Anas. Anas ne en jadolo maduongʼ e higano bende ne en jaduongʼ Kaifas.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo Kristo notho mochako odoko mangima kendo mondo obed Ruodh joma ngima gi joma otho duto kaachiel.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Israel, un joma ogwedhi! En ngʼatno machal kodu, oganda mores gi Jehova Nyasaye? En e okumbani kendo jaresni kendo en e liganglau mar duongʼ. Wasiku nobed gi luoro e nyimu, kendo unumuk kuondegi motegno mag pondo.”
english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

kikuyu: “Yawuot ruodhi duto modak yo nyandwat kaachiel gi jo-Sidon duto bende ni kuno. Gin bende giselal gi joma onegi ka wigi okuot, kata obedo ni negigoyo ji gi kihondko kuom tekogi mangʼeny. Koro giriere piny ka ok otergi nyangu, kaachiel gi joma ligangla onego, kendo wigi okuot kaachiel gi joma ridore kochomo bur matut.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

kikuyu: To nodwokogi niya, “Donge usesomo ni kar chakruok Jachwech ‘nochweyogi dichwo gi dhako,’
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

kikuyu: Donge aparo ni in e ja-Misri manyocha ochako koko e dalani kotelo ni jo-mahundu alufu angʼwen momanore gi gige lweny, nyaka e thim?”
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

kikuyu: Jokshan nonywolo Sheba kod Dedan; nyikwa Dedan ne gin jo-Ashur, jo-Letush kod jo-Leum.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

kikuyu: makmana Musa kende ema nobi machiegni gi Jehova Nyasaye. Oganda modongʼ kik bi kode.”
english: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jotich duto molony e tije mag lwedo mane timo tije ei kama ler mar lemo noweyo tijegi
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

kikuyu: “Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Bed jarit mier madongo abich.’
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

kikuyu: Awuotho e yo mobidhore makare, e yore mag bura makare,
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

kikuyu: To ere kaka onyalo yweyo ka Jehova Nyasaye owuon osechiko, ka osechiwo chik mondo omonj Ashkelon to gi dho nam?”
english: “How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”

kikuyu: Ka piny noru gokinyi, bura mar jodong oganda kaachiel gi jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik, nochokore kaachiel, kendo Yesu nokel irgi.
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

kikuyu: Kane agolo wuoneu Misri, ne uchopo e nam, kendo jo-Misri nolawou gi geche kod jogo mariambo farese nyaka e Nam Makwar.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Lemnwauru bende mondo Nyasaye oreswa e lwet joma timbegi mono kendo ma joricho, nikech ji duto ok nigi yie motegno.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
