kikuyu: Yo makare nitie gi ngima, e yorno nitie ngima mochwere.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

kikuyu: Ka uyiengo yiend zeituni, kik utengʼ bedene diriyo, to weuru olembe modongʼ e zeituni ne jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho.
english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

kikuyu: “To penj kata mana le kendo gibiro puonji, kata winy manie kor polo, to gibiro nyisi;
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: Tur bad ngʼama rach ma timbene richo; luonge mondo onyis ji gik maricho mosetimo lingʼ-lingʼ, ma ji ok nyal fwenyo mi ngʼe.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

kikuyu: In e Ruodha kendo Nyasacha, magolo chik mondo Jakobo olochi.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

kikuyu: Bende negikawo Lut, wuod owadgi Abram kod mwandune duto nikech noyudo odak Sodom.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

kikuyu: Nobawe gi dhahabu maler oko gi iye kendo nochwene ndiga mar dhahabu mothedhi molwore.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

kikuyu: Omiyo nochiwo chik mondo gari ochungʼ. Eka ne gilor gidhi e pi mi Filipo nobatise.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

kikuyu: Esta nodwoko niya, “Ka berni ruoth, to yie mondo jo-Yahudi man Susa kiny ochak otim gima gisetimo kawuononi kendo yie mondo ringre yawuot Haman apar-ka mondo olier e yath minegoe ji.”
english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

kikuyu: Ka umedo timo richo, to obadhe gangʼo? Kata ka richou ngʼeny to mano nyalo timone angʼo?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

kikuyu: Dwoguru ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, yaye Israel. Richou ema osemiyo upodho.
english: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

kikuyu: Ibrahim noseti kendo hike noniangʼ, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nosegwedhe e yore duto.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

kikuyu: Giduto gin jongʼanyo ma tokgi tek ta, ka gidhi ka gi kacha mar kuotho. Gin nyinyo kod chuma; giduto gin jomecho.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

kikuyu: To joricho duto gi joma acheje mane ni ei joma luwo Daudi nowacho niya, “Nikech ne ok gidhi kodwa, ok wabi pogo kodgi gik mope ma wadwoko. To kata kamano ngʼato ka ngʼato okaw chiege gi nyithinde mondo odhigo.”
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

kikuyu: Ka chiwo mare en diel, to nyaka ochiwe e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

kikuyu: To kare ne ochwowe mana nikech kethowa, nosande malit nikech richowa; kum mane oyudo kuome ema nokelnwa kwe, kendo moriemo mage ema nochangowa.
english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

kikuyu: To eka in iwacho ni, ‘Nyasaye to ongʼeyo angʼo? Ere kaka onyalo ngʼadonwa bura to boche polo oime?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

kikuyu: Lamuru Jehova Nyasaye ka umor; biuru e nyime kuwero wende mamor.
english: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

kikuyu: e hik Nebukadneza mar apar gaboro, ji mia aboro gi piero adek gariyo moa Jerusalem;
english: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

kikuyu: Seth bende nonywolo wuowi, kendo nochake ni Enosh. E ndalono ema ne ji ochako luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato okwayo jambe e puodho kata e puoth mzabibu kendo oweyogi ma gi chodo kendo gikwayo e puoth ngʼato, nyaka ochul kawuok kuom puothe kata puothene mag olembe mabeyo.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

kikuyu: Kane Josef odwogo dala, negimiye mich mane gikelone, kendo negikulore e nyime nyaka e lowo.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

kikuyu: E kindeno mon abiriyo biro laro dichwo achiel, kagiwacho niya, “Wanacham chiembwa wawegi kendo wanarwak lepwa wawegi, makmana yienwa mondo oluongwa gi nyingi mondo igolnwa wichkuot!”
english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

kikuyu: Kuonde dino cham nopongʼ gi cham; kendo degi nopongʼ mi-oo oko gi divai manyien kod mo.
english: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, ok anadhi kodu; to adok thurwa ir jowa.”
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

kikuyu: mi nosieme niya, “Tangʼ, Saulo wuora manyo yo ma donegigo. Omiyo kiny gokinyi dhiyo ipondi kendo bed mana kuno.
english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

kikuyu: “Ondiek mokwongo ne chalo gi sibuor, kendo bwombene ne chalo gi mag ongo. Kane pod angʼiye to ne aneno ka bwombene olwar piny kendo ondiegino nochungʼ gi tiendene ka dhano, kendo nomiye paro ka mar dhano.
english: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man’s heart was given to it.

kikuyu: Kik uparru kuom gimoro amora, to kwauru Nyasaye gik moko duto muchando, kulamo, kendo kugoyone erokamano, kuketo kwayou mondo ongʼere ni Nyasaye.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

kikuyu: Kane mirimb ruoth Ahasuerus noserumo, noparo gima ne Vashti otimo, to gi chik mane osegolo.
english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

kikuyu: Lweny machielo nochako owuok Gath, kama ne nitie ngʼat marabet mane nigi lith lwedo auchiel gi lith tielo auchiel koni gi koni, lith lwetene gi mag tiendene koriw to ne romo piero ariyo gangʼwen. En bende ne en nyakwar Rafa.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

kikuyu: Angʼo ma dimi nying wuonwa lal nono e anywolagi nikech ne ok onywolo wuowi? Yie upognwa kamoro e kind wede wuonwa.”
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

kikuyu: Kane bonyogo osechamo gimoro amora mangʼich e piny, ne aywak kawacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ngʼwon-ne jogi ma joka Jakobo. Ere kaka ginyalo tony, to ginok kama?”
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord GOD, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

kikuyu: “Ngʼatno nodwoke ni, ‘Jaduongʼ, yie iweye higani kende bangʼe to abiro pure kendo medo ketone owuoyo.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

kikuyu: Shamoth ja-Haror, Helez ja-Pelon,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye biro miyo wasik Rezin teko mondo oked kodgi, adier obiro thuwogi kod wasigu.
english: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nokwayo mondo buche oter e nyim Kaisar. Omiyo nyocha agolo chik mondo odwoke e od twech nyaka chop aore ir Kaisar.”
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

kikuyu: Ji duto none ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asemoko majno, kendo ok notho.
english: All flesh will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”

kikuyu: nikech Jehova Nyasaye rango yor joma kare, to yor joma richo to biro kethore.
english: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

kikuyu: Dwoko maratiro nyiso ni mano osiepni mar adier.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

kikuyu: Un ma ungʼeny ka sulwe manie polo unudongʼ matin nikech ne ok urito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni ngʼato matimo richo, noyud pokne kuom richo mosetimo, kendo onge dewo wangʼ nikech Nyasaye ok dew wangʼ ngʼato.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

kikuyu: Negiwachone dhakono niya, “Koro wayie, ok nikech weche mane iwacho kende; to wasewinje gi itwa wawegi, kendo wangʼeyo gadier ni jalni en Jawar mar piny.”
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

kikuyu: mi Bilha nomako ich kendo nonywolone Jakobo wuowi.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

kikuyu: Ketura, ma chi Ibrahim machielo, nonywolo Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak kod Shua. Yawuot Jokshan ne gin: Sheba kod Dedan.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Naaman nowachone Gehazi niya, “Kuom ngʼwono duto yie ikawgi fedha ma pekne romo kilo piero auchiel gaboro.” Nokwayo Gehazi mondo okawgi kendo notweyo fedha ma pekne romo kilo piero auchiel gaboro e mifuke ariyo kod lewni motwe otwe nyadiriyo. Naaman nomiyo jotijene ariyo gigo mondo otingʼ ka gitelo e nyim Gehazi.
english: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.

kikuyu: Dir yadhno ochwako e kendo mi olosgo chiemo, kendo obule ringʼo moyiengʼ. Bende ooyo majno kowacho ni, “Adier, awinjo maber kendo denda yudo liet.”
english: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”

kikuyu: To Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Kare un bende wach pod ok donjnu?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

kikuyu: Donge dowachne mana ni, ‘Losna chiemba mar otieno, ikri mondo imiya acham kendo metho, eka bangʼe inyalo chiemo kendo metho’?
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

kikuyu: Eka nodhi e piny jo-Hiti, kama nogeroe dala maduongʼ mi ochake ni Luz, ma mano e nyinge nyaka chil kawuono.
english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

kikuyu: Nonyis Saulo wachno, mi nooro ji moko to gin bende ne gikoro. Eka Saulo nooro joote kendo mar adek, to gin bende negimedo mana koro.
english: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nitiere e dalane mochiel motegno kendo osenyisore ni en e ohingane.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

kikuyu: Ne wapodho piny waduto, eka ne awinjo dwol moro kawuoyo koda gi dho jo-Hibrania ni, ‘Saulo, Saulo, isanda nangʼo? Riwi mabith migweyono biro mana hinyi in iwuon.’
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

kikuyu: to notimore ka gima nono kodoko misumba, mi nokawo kido machal gi mar dhano.
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

kikuyu: Ochalo thowi mane dhako moro okawo kendo oruwo ei mogo mangʼeny, mi bangʼe okuodo mogono.”
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Rit ngimani gi weche mipuonjo maber. Tim kinda kodgi mak iweyogi, nikech ka itimo kamano eka inires ngimani iwuon kaachiel gi ngima joma winjo weche mipuonjo.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

kikuyu: Negibet gi jopuonjre kuno kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

kikuyu: Bedo ni ngʼato oter nyangu kata ok oter nyangu ok en gimoro. Gima duongʼ en rito Chike Nyasaye.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

kikuyu: Kik wiu owil gi singruok mane atimo kodu bende kik ulam nyiseche mamoko.
english: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.

kikuyu: Kaparo polo mari ma gin tich lweti, kaparo dwe gi sulwe miseketo kargi,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

kikuyu: E bath rangach man yo nyandwat e laru maiye, ne nitie ot moro mochomo yo milambo; to e bath rangach man yo milambo ne nitie ot machielo machal gi mano mochomo yo nyandwat.
english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

kikuyu: Laruno borne norom fut mia achiel gi piero abich, to lachne norom fut piero abiriyo gabich kendo borne modhi malo en fut abiriyo gi nus gi pasia molos gi law mayom kendo rachungi duto nyaka bed mag mula.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: To joma pok okendi gi joma pok okendo, kod mon ma chwogi otho, to awachonegi kama: En gima ber moloyo ka gisiko ma ok gikendo kata okendgi, mana kaka an.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki: “An Jehova Nyasaye, ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni ji duto nogo chong-gi piny e nyima kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nohul ni an e Nyasaye.’ ”
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

kikuyu: Koro in iwuon ingʼeyo gima Joab wuod Zeruya notimona, gima notimo ni jotend lweny ariyo mag Israel, Abner wuod Ner gi Amasa wuod Jetha. Ne onegogi, kochwero rembgi e ndalo kwe mana ka ndalo mag lweny kendo remono nomienogo okandane mane otweyo e nungone kod wuochene manie tiendene.
english: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

kikuyu: Kendo ne omiyi ote, kowacho ni, ‘Dhiyo mondo itiek chuth jo-Amalek marichogi; ked kodgi nyaka ine ni itiekogi pep.’
english: and the LORD sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’

kikuyu: bende nyaka mier matindo mar Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, mane jatelo Heshbon, mantiere e tongʼ mar jo-Amon.
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Pige mag Dimon opongʼ gi remo, to kata kamano named kelo masiche ne Dimon, ne joge maringo koa Moab mondo opondi kod jogo modongʼ e pinyno nomak gi sibuor.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

kikuyu: to ne ok ginyal loyo riekone kod teko mar Roho mane owuoyogo.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Eber, Shela nodak higni mia angʼwen gadek kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: (Mano notimore ka Johana ne pok oter e od twech.)
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

kikuyu: Ndalona osekadho, chenrona duto osekethore, kaachiel gi gik moko duto ma chunya gombo.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

kikuyu: Kane pod gikok ka gikwadho lepgi kendo gikiro bura e kor yamo,
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

kikuyu: To kodhi moko to nolwar e lowo maber, mine gitwi kendo gichiego cham; moloyo kaka nochwoyo, moko nyadi mia, moko nyadi piero auchiel kata nyadi piero adek.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

kikuyu: En ngʼat ma wuodhe obidhore kendo matimo gima kare, ngʼat mawacho adiera gi e chunye
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ber kendo yorene oriere tir; mano emomiyo opuonjo joricho yorene.
english: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

kikuyu: Dhakono norwakore gi lewni maralik gi makwar, kendo nolichore gi dhahabu kod kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek gi lulu. To notingʼo kikombe mar dhahabu e lwete, mopongʼ gi gik makwero kod timbe mochido mag terruokne.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

kikuyu: To osiepena mageno, paruru gik mane joote mag Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo okoro chon.
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Piny tetni kendo nigi rem mapek, nimar chenro mar Jehova Nyasaye kuom Babulon osiko mondo piny Babulon odongʼ gunda, maonge ngʼama nodag kanyo.
english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of the LORD against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Nokawo boche gi nyiroke kod jwala mabor manie wi chuny mag chiayo mane itimogo misango mar golo richo, kendo nowangʼogi pep ewi kendo mar misango mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Eka Mika nowachone niya, “Dag koda kendo ibed wuonwa kod jadolo, kendo abiro miyi fedha ma pekne romo robo mar kilo, gi lewni kod chiemo e higa.”
english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.

kikuyu: Polo mondo obed moil, piny mondo obed mamor; nam mondo owuo kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye;
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

kikuyu: E Tapanhes kuno wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia niya:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

kikuyu: Kata bed ni oseyako mwandu mangʼeny kamano; to mwandugo ema biro kelone masira; kendo midhiero maduongʼ biro biro kuome mi hewe.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ tir nokalo kendo negidhi nyime ka gikoro kendo gidhum nyaka nochopo kinde mar misango mar odhiambo. To ne onge dwoko, kata ngʼama nodwoko kata ngʼama nowinjogi.
english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo auchiel nyaka uti, to odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo en Sabato mar yweyo ma en chiengʼ maler ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼato angʼata ma otimo tich moro amora chiengʼ Sabato nyaka negi.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Kaw odunga, kod owadu Harun mondo uchok jo-Israel kaachiel. Wuo kod lwanda ka gineno kendo pi biro chwer koa kuome. Ibiro golo pi kowuok e lwandano ne oganda mondo gin kod jambgi gimodhi.”
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

kikuyu: Chandruok luwo jaricho, to mwandu e ohand ngʼat makare.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

kikuyu: Ok awach wechegi mondo angʼadnu bura kaka joketho, nikech mana kaka nasewachonu motelo, wagenou gi genruok maduongʼ e chunywa, kendo waikore tho kodu kendo bedo mangima kodu.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

kikuyu: To ngʼat miwacho wechegi kuomeni to noa e dhoot machielo ma ngʼato ne pok oyie mondo oti tich dolo e kendo mar misango.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

kikuyu: An Jaduongʼ, Andikoni in miyo moyier kaachiel kod nyithindi mahero gadiera, ok an kenda, ema aheri to bende ji duto mongʼeyo adiera oheri
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

kikuyu: (Pinygi mane gi dakie nochakore Mesha kochomo Sefar e gode man yo wuok chiengʼ.)
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: To Farao nopenje niya, “Angʼo michando kae momiyo idwaro dok e pinyu?” Hadad to nodwoke niya, “Onge, to yie iweya aweya adhi!”
english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

kikuyu: Bende dagony ngʼat man-gi rapim mag mayo ji gi gorogoro modi?
english: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?

kikuyu: “Kuom mano an angʼadoni rieko kama: Chok jo-Israel duto, chakre Dan nyaka Bersheba gin joma ngʼeny ka kwoyo man e dho nam, to in mondo itel nyimgi ka ukedo.
english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

kikuyu: To jopur puodho nomake, mogoye, moriembe gi lwete nono.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Joma nipiny gin mana muya nono; joma ni malo gin mana miriambo; ka opimgi e ratil, to gin nono; gin duto gin mana muya nono.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

kikuyu: Neginwoyone weche mane oyudo giwacho mi giwachone niya, “Ma e gima ibiro timo ne ngʼat manonege.”
english: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”

kikuyu: Kar winjo tik mangʼwe ngʼar to unuwinj mana tik madungʼ marach; kar bedo gi okanda to tol ema nutwerugo; kar bedo gi yie wich molos maber to bondo ema unudongʼ-go; kar bedo gi lewni mabeyo to unurwak mana pien gugru, kar bedo gi wangʼ man-gi chia to adhonde nopongʼ dendu.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

kikuyu: mar apar gadek ne Hupa, to mar apar gangʼwen ne Jeshebeab,
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

kikuyu: Eka nooro yawuot Israel matindo kendo negichiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mag rwedhi matindo kaka misango mag lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mabiro monji ochomi, yaye Nineve, omiyo rit dala mochiel motegno, rit yoreni, bed gi ikruok maber, kuom tekoni duto!
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

kikuyu: mondo ka oseketwa kare kuom ngʼwonone to wabed jocham mwandune, ka wan gi geno mar yudo ngima mochwere.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

kikuyu: Nowachone wuon kod min ni, ‘Aonge gi geno kodgi.’ Ne ok oyie gi jowetegi kata yie kod nyithinde owuon, to ne orito wecheni kendo rito singruokni.
english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

kikuyu: Eka Nathaniel nodwoke niya, “Rabi, in Wuod Nyasaye adier; in Ruodh Israel.”
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar loch Hoshea wuod Ela ruodh Israel, Hezekia wuod Ahaz ruodh Juda nodoko ruoth.
english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Negiriwo pasia abich kanyakla kendo abich modongʼ bende negiriwo.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne gichare achara gi dhogi, ka giwuonde gi lewgi.
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

kikuyu: Lop dhood Asher ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Dan kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

kikuyu: Kuom mano owetena, nikech koro wan gi chir mar donjo e Kama Ler Moloyo kuom remb Yesu,
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

kikuyu: Bende Daudi nokedo gi Hadadezer ma ruodh Zoba nyaka ochopo Hamath kane odhi mondo ogur lochne e dho Aora Yufrate.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ketho chenro duto mag pinje; othiro dwaro ma ogendini nigo.
english: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

kikuyu: Koko mag masiche opongʼo ite kendo jomecho biro monje e kinde moparo ni gik moko dhi maber.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

kikuyu: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf kod Bethuel.”
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mapando richone ok dhi maber, to ngʼat ma hulo richone kendo oweyogi yudo ngʼwono.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

kikuyu: Kik ibed maluor nikech joricho kata kik nyiego maki kod joma timbegi richo,
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

kikuyu: Obiro miyo ichako inyiero kendo ibiro bedo mamor.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

kikuyu: Eka nokel nywogi mag misango mar golo richo e nyim ruoth kod joma nochokore mine giyieyo lwetgi kuomgi.
english: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.

kikuyu: Matania, Matenai gi Jasu.
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

kikuyu: Lwet dhano nothinyore mondiko e kor ot apoya nono, but kama ichunge taya ei od ruoth. Ruoth noneno lwedono kandiko.
english: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko ngʼat morwako law mayomno niya, “Jow mach gi lweti e kind kerubi,” kendo nodhi mochungʼ e bath tiend moro.
english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

kikuyu: Kuom mago duto mosetimorenwa, isebedo jangʼad bura makare; isebedo ja-adiera, ka wan ne watimo marach.
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro, kane openje gi jo-Farisai kinde ma pinyruodh Nyasaye nobiye, Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Pinyruoth Nyasaye ok bi mana mineno gi wangʼ,
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

kikuyu: Dwach Jal mane oora en ni kik awit kata achiel kuom ji duto mosemiya, to ni mondo achiergi chiengʼ giko.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Kane aneno gik miketho kaka njora maber moa Babulon, gi fedha ma pekne dirom kilo ariyo, to gi dhahabu ma pekne oromo nus kilo, to chunya nogombogi mi akawogi kendo apandogi e bwo lowo ei hemba ka fedha ema oket piny mogik.”
english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”

kikuyu: Gibiro witogi e mach makakni, kama ywagruok gi mwodo lak nobedie.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

kikuyu: Ne imiyo yawuotgi obedo mangʼeny ka sulwe manie lwasi, mi ikelogi nyaka e piny mane isingone kweregi mondo odhiye kendo okaw.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Eka Moab wiye nokuodi gi Kemosh, mana kaka od Israel wiye nokuot, kane gin-gi geno kuom Bethel.
english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

kikuyu: Dhoranga Owuoyo noger gi Malkija wuod Rekab, ma ruodh Beth Hakerem. Norwako dhoute, radedi kod lodi mage.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: To Yesu nolokore mongʼiyo jopuonjrene, bangʼe to okwero Petro kowacho niya, “Wuog oko e nyima Satan! Iketo pachi kuom dwaro dhano, to ok kuom dwach Nyasaye.”
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

kikuyu: Kendo Damaski bende osebire ka jodolo madongo omiye teko mar mako ji duto maluongo nyingi.”
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

kikuyu: Ne asin gi gik moko duto mane asenyagora godo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ, nikech nyaka ne awegi ne ngʼatno mabiro bangʼa.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

kikuyu: Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye ok nodog chien nyaka one ni ochopo thoro mar chunye. E ndalo mabiro iniwinj tiende malongʼo.
english: The LORD’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.

kikuyu: Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak mora amora modak e diergi ma nonego ngʼato ka ok ochano kendo ka oonge gi paro mar nege mondo odhi e mier madongo mowal mar tony mondo kik neg-gi gi ngʼatno madwaro chulo kuor kapok otergi e bura e nyim kanyakla.
english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

kikuyu: Gideon nopenje niya, “To Ruoth, ere kaka anyalo reso jo-Israel? Anywolana ema nyape mogik ei Manase, kendo an ema atin e odwa.”
english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Abiro miyo kwe ma en-go mol ka aora kendo mwandu mag pinje namiye mamol ka oula; unubed mamor ka odhodhou kotingʼou e bade kendo kopirou e chonge.
english: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

kikuyu: Ndalo mag joma kare ongʼere ni Jehova Nyasaye, kendo girkeni margi biro siko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

kikuyu: Kendo kane achiedh-nade omaka, to ne awacho niya, “Dhano duto riambo.”
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼado bura ne janjore ok otim, to chuny ji pongʼ gi chenro mar timo marach.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

kikuyu: Eka nodwoko Elija niya, “Mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ngima aonge gi kuon moro amora makmana mogo matin e agulu kod mo matin e puga. Amodo yien matin mondo ater dala kendo alosgo chiemba kod mar wuoda mondo wacham bangʼe watho.”
english: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

kikuyu: “To ne iwacho ni jotichni ni, ‘Keleuru ka mondo anene an awuon.’
english: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyis Harun ni, ‘Kaw ludhi mondo irie badi ewi pige mag Misri, ma gin aore matindo kod madongo, yewni kod kuonde duto mag kano pi, kendo gibiro lokore remo.’ Remo biro bedo kamoro amora e piny Misri nyaka ei agulni molos gi kite.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

kikuyu: Nikech usedwanyo kara maler mar lemo gi nyisecheu manono kod timbeu mamono, mana kaka antie, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni abiro golo ngʼwonona kuomu. Ok abi ngʼiyou gi kech, kendo kata wech ok abi weyou mak atimonu marach.
english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

kikuyu: Abiro siko ka ahere nyaka chiengʼ, kendo winjruok ma atimo kode ok norem mak ochopo ngangʼ.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro wach ni jatichna Daudi niya, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kama: Ne agoli e lek kuma ne ikwayoe rombe mondo ibed jatend joga Israel.
english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

kikuyu: Ka ungʼeyo ni Kristo en ngʼama kare to onego ungʼe bende ni ngʼato ka ngʼato matimo gima kare en nyathi Nyasaye.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

kikuyu: Joma ne obiro motelone ne onge gikogi. To jogo mane obiro bangʼe ne ok mor kod ruoth mane okawo kare. Ma bende onge tiende, ochalo gi lawo bangʼ yamo.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Mago e timbe mag thuon mane Benaya wuod Jehoyada otimo, en bende ne en rahuma ka thuondi adek ka.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona, “Nitiere winjruok ma lingʼ-lingʼ e kind jo-Juda kod jogo modak Jerusalem.
english: The LORD said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mier matindo duto ma ji odakie biro dongʼ nono li kendo piny biro dongʼ gunda. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom jo-Amon kendo kor wach kuomgi kikwedogi.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

kikuyu: Magpiash, Meshulam, Hezir,
english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

kikuyu: Negipenjo Ibrahim niya, “Ere Sara chiegi?” Ibrahim nodwokogi niya, “En ei hema.”
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

kikuyu: Jo-dalano nopogore nyadiriyo ka moko odok ni jo-Yahudi, to moko nodok ni joote.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

kikuyu: Dier ot mapiny lachne ne en fut apar, dier ot madiere ne en fut aboro, to dier ot mar adek lachne ne en fut apar. Kendo ne giweyo thuolo e kind kor ot ma oko mondo kik yien moriw pow kor ot.
english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

kikuyu: To nitie jo-Yahudi moko moa e piny Asia mane onego bedi e nyimi ka, ka dipo ni giseneno ketho moro kuoma ma dimi gidonjna,
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

kikuyu: To Gaal nowachone kendo niya, “Ne joma biro koa e dier piny, kendo oganda maduongʼ biro koa yo koma opidhie yadh ajwoga.”
english: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuome, mi nobedo jangʼad bura mar jo-Israel kendo negidhi e lweny. Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo Kushan-Rishathaim ruodh Aram e lwet Othniel, mane oloye.
english: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

kikuyu: Kik umul tich moro amora. Ma en chik ma omakou nyaka nyikwau duto kamoro amora ma unudagie.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “Gisewuok ka. Ne awinjo kagiwacho ni gidhi Dothan.” Kuom mano Josef noluwo bangʼ owetene kendo noyudogi machiegni gi Dothan.
english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Musa noweyo Farao mi olamo Jehova Nyasaye,
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo koluongo gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Kel jorito mag dala maduongʼ kae, ka moro ka moro nigi gir kedo lweny e lwete.”
english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

kikuyu: kendo onyise niya, “Kaw gigi kendo idhi mi ikan-gi e hekalu man Jerusalem. Kendo iger manyien od Nyasaye e kare machon.”
english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’

kikuyu: In to inyoso chuny ji mondo kik giluor Nyasaye kendo imonogi lame.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Sa ma piny duto biro bedo mamor kodi ema abiro tiekie.
english: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

kikuyu: Ji duto wuoyo maber kuom Demetrio, nikech adiera ema wachore kuome. Wan bende wawuoyo kuome maber, kendo ungʼeyoni nendwa en adier.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

kikuyu: Ka kamano, to ere kaka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa winjogi mana e dhowa wawegi?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

kikuyu: ka giluwo timbe mag ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye osedaro oa kuomgi, to gi timbe moko mane ruodhi mag Israel noketo.
english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro tiyo kodi kaluwore gi gima onego iyudi, nikech iseketho winjruok mane an-go kodi kuom ketho singruok.
english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

kikuyu: To joma ongʼanyo kod joricho duto gi joma oweyo Jehova Nyasaye notiek chuth.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

kikuyu: “Tingʼuru bandera e piny! Gouru turumbete e dier ogendini! Ikuru ogendini mondo oked kode; luonguru pinjeruodhigi Ararat, Mini kod Ashkenaz mondo oked kode. Yieruru jatend lweny mondo oked kode; oruru farese mangʼeny ka bonyo.
english: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

kikuyu: Efraim sungore kawacho ni, “An jamoko momewo, kendo asebedo ja-mwandu. Gi mwanduna duto ok giniyud gimoro kuoma ma miganga kata richo.”
english: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

kikuyu: Ne aywakne gi dhoga; pakne ne ni e lewa.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

kikuyu: Kendo notel nyim Ruoth, gi chuny kod teko mar Elija, koduogo chunje wuone ir nyithindgi, kendo koloko joma wigi tek mondo oluw rieko mar ji makare, koiko oganda mowinjore ni Ruoth.”
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokelonigi jotend jolweny mag ruodh Asuria momako Manase otero e twech kotuch ume kod olowu kendo otweye kod rateke mag mula motere Babulon.
english: Therefore the LORD brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Kristo e giko mar Chik kendo en ema okelo ngima makare ni ji duto moyie.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

kikuyu: Adina wuod Shiza e piny Reuben, mane jatend jo-Reuben to gi thuondi piero adek mane ni kode.
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

kikuyu: To ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa kuom dhano,’ ji duto biro chielowa gi kite, nikech ne giyie ni Johana ne en janabi.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

kikuyu: Elisha nowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo ikwa joma udakgo machiegni mondo omiyi dapige man nono, kendo kik ikwa manok.
english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

kikuyu: To ka wahulo richowa, to oweyonwagi kendo opwodhowa kuom timbe duto ma ok odhi kare nikech en Ja-adiera kendo otimo gima kare.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Ne otayogi maber omiyo ne gionge gi luoro, to wasikgi to ne nam omwonyo.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

kikuyu: En ngʼama ogwedhi ngʼat moluoro Jehova Nyasaye kinde duto, to ngʼatno ma chunye tek donjo e chandruok.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Eka Isaka nogolo Jakobo modhi kendo Jakobo nodhi Padan Aram, ir Laban wuod Bethuel ja-Aram, owad gi Rebeka, mane min Jakobo kod Esau.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

kikuyu: Bedene ne otegno, kendo noromo bedo ludh loch mar ruoth. Nodongo marabora moyombo yiende duto, kendo nochungʼ maonge yien mipimego nikech bedene mathoth mane en-go,
english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

kikuyu: gik mongʼinore mia angʼwen mag thiwni ariyo moluwore (laini ariyo mag thiwni oketi e laini ariyo mag gik mongʼinore mane okedgo gik machalo agulni molos kaka tawo ewi sirni);
english: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

kikuyu: To bangʼ biro mare, pinyruodhe nopogi matindo tindo, e migepe angʼwen. Ok nopoge ne nyithinde, kendo kata teko mane en-go motelo ok nobedgo, nikech pinyruodhe nopudh oko kendo nomi joma moko.
english: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.

kikuyu: kendo naneno duongʼ mar Nyasach Israel kabiro koa yo wuok chiengʼ. Dwonde ne chalo gi mor mar pi maringo matek, kendo lerne nomiyo piny rieny.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

kikuyu: Joma ngʼiewogi negogi kendo gidhi ma ok okumgi. Giloko ring-gi pesa kendo giwacho ni, ‘Opak Jehova Nyasaye nikech wasemewo!’ Jokwadhgi giwegi bende ok kechgi.”
english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

kikuyu: koa kuom nus machielo mar jo-Manase mane ni e piny Gilead: Ido wuod Zekaria notelonegi; koa kuom jo-Benjamin: Jasiel wuod Abner notelonegi;
english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

kikuyu: Winjuru, yaye Israel, kendo beduru motangʼ kurito chikena mondo omi umedru e piny ma opongʼ gi chak kod mor kich, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu nosingorenu.
english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Mad oganda duto bed jotichni kendo ji duto omiyi duongʼ. Bed ruoth ewi oweteni duto kendo mad yawuot minu omiyi duongʼ. Ngʼato angʼata mokwedi mondo okwede kendo ngʼato angʼata mogwedhi nogwedhi.”
english: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

kikuyu: Jonabi chalo mana yamo kendo wach onge eigi; omiyo we gima giwacho otimre ne gin giwegi.”
english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

kikuyu: koa e anywola Abija ne en Zikri; koa e anywola Miniamin kod Moadia ne en Piltai;
english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

kikuyu: Kuom mano negibiro ma gitingʼogi kendo gigologi oko mar kambi kaka Musa nochiko kapod girwako lepgi mag dolo miluongo ni tunik.
english: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Ibrahim obedo wuoro, kata obedo ni noseti ahinya, kendo Sara chiege ne migumba, to nomiye teko mar bedo wuoro nikech nogeno ni ngʼat mane omiye singruok ne en ja-adiera.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

kikuyu: kuom mano, oruru jotendu moko adhigo mondo gidhi gidonjne kuno, kaponi osetimo gimoro marach.”
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

kikuyu: Jatend Gershon ne en Eliasaf wuod Lael.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Omiyo piny biro dengo kendo polo malo notim mudho, nikech asewuoyo kendo ok analok pacha, asengʼado wach chuth kendo ok anadog chien.”
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

kikuyu: Malit ochoma adier nikech adak Meshek, hapa rach nikech adak e dier hembe mag Kedar!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

kikuyu: Ne ogolo siro mar Ashera e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mi otere e bath Jerusalem e holo mar aora Kidron kendo nowangʼe kanyo. Norege molokore buru mi okiro burugo ewi liete joma odhier.
english: He brought out the Asherah from the LORD’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, onge yath moro kata bed ni oyudo pi mangʼeny manade manochak odong mabor ma wiye chop e polo kamano. Giduto nyaka githo mana kaka dhano tho mi gidhi e piny joma otho.
english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

kikuyu: Eka kerubi, kaachiel gi tiende ka ni e bathgi, noyaro bwombegi, kendo duongʼ mar Nyasach Israel ne ni e wigi gimalo.
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

kikuyu: Parane gima Nyasaye osetimo: En ngʼa manyalo rieyo gima osedolo?
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

kikuyu: Bende, e ndalogo joka ruoth ma Juda ne oro barupe mangʼeny ne Tobia, kendo dwoko mag Tobia ne medo bironegi.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

kikuyu: Negidhi mi giyudo nyathi kanyna kotwe oko e yo matin e dhorangach. To kane oyudo gigonye,
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

kikuyu: Bende Israel en jatich, ngʼat monywol ka misumba? Kare en angʼo momiyo iyake?
english: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive?

kikuyu: Mise mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye noketi e higa mar angʼwen e dwe mar Zif.
english: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

kikuyu: “Usegombo yudo mangʼeny, to osetamore ma uyudo mana matin; to kata mana mano mago ma usechoko mukeloe dala, abiro kudho oko. Mani notimore nikech angʼo?” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego penjo. “Nikech hekaluna ma uweyo odongʼ gunda, ka un uwegi to uringo kudhi e uteu molos mabeyo.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

kikuyu: Yesu noweyogi mi odok odonjo e yie mongʼado nam odok loka machielo.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

kikuyu: Mach nomuoch e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo nowangʼo misango miwangʼo pep kaachiel gi migepe mag boche manie wi kendo mar misango. Kane ji oneno gima notimoreno, negipongʼ gimor mi gipodho auma.
english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Kendo pigno nolokore ataro ma Nyasaye nokethego piny machon.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

kikuyu: Omiyo Judas nobiro e puodhono, kotelone migawo mar jolweny kod jotelo moko ma noa ir jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai. Negitingʼo toje gi teyni kod gige lweny.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

kikuyu: Ja-Zora moro, ma nyinge Manoa, moa e anywola joka Dan, ne en gi dhako ma migumba kendo nobedo maonge nyathi.
english: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.

kikuyu: E kindeno, jonabi moko nobiro Antiokia ka gia Jerusalem.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

kikuyu: Ka joma moko to nigi ratironi mar yudo konyruokgi koa kuomu, donge wan onego wabed gi ratiro makamano moloyogi? Wan to pok wakonyore gi ratironi. Kar timo kamano, to wasetuonore yuto mawa mondo kik waket obadho moro amora manyalo gengʼo Injili mar Kristo.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: mi odak kodgi kendo tiyo kodgi nikech en bende ne en jatwangʼ hema mana kaka gin.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

kikuyu: Gibeyo moloyo dhahabu, moloyo dhahabu malerie moloyo; gimit moloyo mor kich moa e pedni.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ kane asechiwo barup ngʼiepo ne Baruk wuod Neria, ne alamo Jehova Nyasaye kama:
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Omiyo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko, jo-Israel nomiyo jo-Lawi mier matindogi kod kuonde kwath koa kuom pokgi giwegi.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: makmana ngʼato ka ngʼato itemo mana ka gombone owuon maricho oywaye kendo tere e richo.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

kikuyu: To kuom higni mangʼeny ma dhano nyalo dak, we mondo obed mamor kuom hignigo duto. Makmana wiye kik wil gi ndalo mag mudho nikech kosetho to ndalo mag mudho nobed mangʼeny moloyo. Gimoro amora mabiro bangʼe onge tiende.
english: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.

kikuyu: Shem mane owadgi Jafeth matin ma bende en kwar jo-Eber bende nonywolo yawuowi.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

kikuyu: Ogandano nodwoko niya, “Jachien ni kodi! En ngʼa madwaro negi?”
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

kikuyu: “Kane jo-Yahudi ne pod rango, kaw kite moko madongo mondo iyik gi lowo e kind matafare mochan e dhoranga dala Farao man Tapanhes.
english: “Take great stones in your hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

kikuyu: Noketo rachungi taya ei Hemb Romo komanyore gi mesa man yo milambo mar Hemb Romo
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi lewni motwangʼ, ka lewni mopwodhi mag Harun jadolo kod lep yawuote kane gitiyo kaka jodolo;
english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

kikuyu: Chiayo ma uyiero nyaka bed madichwo ma ja-higa achiel maonge songa kendo unyalo yierogi kuom rombe kata diek.
english: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nochako omonjo joma odak e holo kanyo,
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo noweyo lawo Daudi mi odhi rado gi jo-Filistia. Mano emomiyo iluongo kanyo ni Sela Hamalekoth.
english: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

kikuyu: Nyaka oket lwete ewi misango miwangʼo pep, mi Jehova Nyasaye noyie gi misangono mondo obed gima opwodhgo richone.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kikuyu: Teko Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuom Elija kendo kokunjo kandhone ei okandane, noringo e nyim Ahab nyaka negichopo Jezreel.
english: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

kikuyu: En piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro ritoue; kendo orange pile ka pile higa ngima.
english: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

kikuyu: Enodogi mana gi yo mane obirogo; kendo ok enodonj e dala maduongʼni,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Wach mane Johana yalo ne chal kama: “Ngʼat moro biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ok awinjora gonyo kata tond wuochene.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo niya, “To angʼo masetimo? Rach mane miyudo kuom jatichni nyaka chakre chiengʼ mane abiroe nyaka chil kawuono? Angʼo mamona kedo gi wasik ruoth ma ruodha?”
english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

kikuyu: Tongʼno noyarre kochakore e nam nyaka Hazar Enan, kogoyo tongʼ gi Damaski kod Hamath man yo nyandwat. Ma ema nobed tongʼ man yo nyandwat.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

kikuyu: Ok giwach e kindgi giwegi, ‘Mad waluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, mamiyowa kodh chwiri kod kodh opon e kinde mowinjore, ma singonwa gadiera jumbe mag keyo.’
english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

kikuyu: Kane kinde ochopo monego terego malo e polo, Yesu noramo ni nyaka ochop Jerusalem.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

kikuyu: Chambu duto ne aketho gi dera kod pe, to kata bangʼ timo magi to pod ne udagi duogo ira,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: To in, Wuoda, bed motegno kuom ngʼwono ma wan-go kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: We wanind piny e wichkuot marwa, kendo we timbewa maricho oumwa. Wasetimo richo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, wan kaachiel gi wuonewa; chakre ndalo mane wan rowere nyaka odiechiengni pod ok waluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.”
english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed the LORD our God’s voice.”

kikuyu: Nikech jo-Israel gin wasumbiniga mane agolo an awuon e piny Misri, ok onego ngʼiewgi kaka wasumbini.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

kikuyu: “Ringuru ua Babulon! Ringuru ukony ngimau! Kik tieku nikech richo mag-gi. En kinde ma Jehova Nyasaye chuloe kuor; enochule gima owinjore kode.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of the LORD’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

kikuyu: Nyithinda mageno, tangʼuru ni nyiseche manono ma dhano oloso.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Yaye mad ne bed ni an gi bwombe ka akuru! Dine afuyo aa ka mi ayudo yweyo.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

kikuyu: kuom mano, mana kaka antie, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto awacho kama: Abiro jwangʼi ni chwero remo, kendo chwero remo biro lawi ma ok noweyi.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

kikuyu: ka masira machalo yamb ahiti obiro kuomu, kendo ka chandruok oyweyou ka yamb kalausi. Ka lit kod thagruok ohingou.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

kikuyu: Ibiro yudo kum kuom kethruok mari kendo ibiro tingʼo chandruok ma richoni mar lamo nyiseche manono okeloni. Eka iningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.”
english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Lewgi en asere man-gi kwiri; owacho miriambo. Gi dhoge owuoyo mamuol ne jabathe, to e chunye oketone obadho.”
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

kikuyu: Dhano to en angʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, momiyo iketo chunyi kuome, koso wuod dhano to en angʼo, momiyo isiko ipare?
english: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

kikuyu: “An, Yesu aseoro malaikana mondo ohulni wechegi ikonygo kanise. An nyakwar Daudi bende an Sulwe Maler mar Okinyi.”
english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

kikuyu: Giduto negichiemo mi giyiengʼ chuth,
english: They all ate and were filled.

kikuyu: “Yaye ruoth, ne ineno malaika ma jarit koa e polo, kawacho ni, ‘Tongʼ yien-no oko kendo ilwer bedene, to osiki odongʼ ei lowo, kitweyo gi nyinyo kod mula, e dier lum madongo e bungu. We mondo thoo omiye ngʼich kendo odag gi le adier yiende mag piny kuom higni abiriyo.’
english: “Whereas the king saw a holy watcher coming down from the sky and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.’

kikuyu: Ne ooro bonyo mag lwangʼni mane omwonyogi, gi ogwende mane oketho pinygi.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

kikuyu: Chanreuru e migepe kaluwore gi anywolau kaka chik mane Daudi ruodh jo-Israel kod Solomon wuode ondiko.
english: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

kikuyu: Timni makare osiko kendo chikni en adier,
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maonge hera kia Nyasaye, nikech Nyasaye en hera.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar auchiel nyaka gitedi gima gichoko, mano nyaka bed marom nyadiriyo kuom gima gisebedo ka gichoko odiechienge moko odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

kikuyu: Kane Festo osekuotho gi jobuche, nongʼado bura kowacho niya, “Isekwayo mondo oteri e nyim Kaisar omiyo kuno ema ibiro dhiye!”
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

kikuyu: Par kaka asechiki. Bed motegno kendo gi chir. Kik iluor kendo kik chunyi nyosre; nikech an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi abiro bedo kodi kamoro amora midhiye.”
english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

kikuyu: Bende uwacho ni, ‘Ka ngʼato okwongʼore gi nying kendo mar misango to onge wach, to ni ka ngʼato okwongʼore gi chiwo moket kuome to ni kwongʼruokneno otweye.’
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: “ ‘Magi e sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye, ma gin chokruok maler, manyaka ulandi e kindegi mowinjore.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

kikuyu: Enobed luor maduongʼ ne ngʼatno ma dagi dhawo, to joma ofuwo duto ohero dhawo.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Rehoboam nonono jodongo manotiyo e bwo wuon-gi Solomon kapod ongima. Nopenjogi niya, “Ere kaka unyalo ngʼadona rieko mondo adwok jogi?”
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

kikuyu: To ka gitamore kawo kikombe e lweti kendo ok gimetho, to nyisgi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: Nyaka umadhe!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mane okelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mokwongo ne en Nashon wuod Aminadab moa e dhood Juda.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

kikuyu: Jakobo nomiyogi chik niya, “Ma e gima onego udhi uwach ne ruodha Esau: Misumbani Jakobo wacho ni, ‘Asebedo ka adak gi Laban kendo asebedo kuno nyaka chil kawuono.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in Nyasacha; abiro miyi duongʼ kendo anapak nyingi, nimar kuom adiera mowinjore isetimo gik makare, mago mane osechan chon.
english: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

kikuyu: Penjreuru un uwegi ni: Bende en gima kare mondo dhako olam Nyasaye ka ok otweyo kitamba e wiye?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

kikuyu: Noketo ngamia onindo piny machiegni gi soko but dala; ne en kar angʼich welo, seche mamon dhi umbo.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

kikuyu: Nineve chalo dago, kendo pige mol kadhi. Giywak kagiwacho niya, “Chungʼ! Chungʼ!” to onge ngʼama lokore duogo.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

kikuyu: warruok ae lwet wasikwa, kendo ae lwet jogo duto mamon kodwa,
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomor gie polo; dwond Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo nowuo.
english: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

kikuyu: Nimar kuom ndalo auchiel Jehova Nyasaye nochweyo polo gi piny, gi nembe kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie igi, to noyweyo chiengʼ mar abiriyo. Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho chiengʼ Sabato mi okete maler.
english: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

kikuyu: Kane Josef oneno ka wuon mare keto lwete ma korachwich ewi Efraim ne ok obedo mamor; kuom mano, nogolo lwet wuon-gi ewi Efraim moketo ewi Manase.
english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jonathan noketo Daudi mochako ojiwo kwongʼruokne nikech nohere, nimar nohere mana kaka oherore owuon.
english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ma otelo e nyimu, biro kedonu mana kaka ne okedonu e piny Misri kod e thim ka uneno gi wengeu uwegi.
english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

kikuyu: kendo kane gia Bamoth negidhi e holo mar Moab kama omanyore gi wi got Pisga minyalo nenogo kama otwo.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Ibiro madho chak mag pinje mi nopiri gi thuno mar joka ruoth. Eka iningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Jawarni, Jaresni, Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo.
english: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

kikuyu: Gisebaro giweyo yo makare mi girwenyo ka giluwo yor Balaam wuod Beor, mane ohero misach richo.
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

kikuyu: “Ogwedh jogo ma kethogi owenegi, kendo ma richogi oseruchi.
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

kikuyu: Eka negilame kendo negidok Jerusalem kod mor maduongʼ.
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

kikuyu: to bende ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka puonjre rito ringre e yo maler kendo malongʼo,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

kikuyu: Tongʼno nodhi nyime koa Shefam nyaka Ribla mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Ain kendo nomed dhi nyaka kuonde moridore mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Nam Kinereth.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

kikuyu: Eka nodok ir Juda kendo owachone niya, “Ok ayude. To ji modak kanyo ne owachona ni, ‘Onge ochot madhako ka.’ ”
english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Juda nobiro kama omanyore gi kama otimo ongoro kendo gingʼiyo oganda lweny maduongʼ, negineno mana ringre joma otho koriere piny kendo ne githo maonge ngʼama notony.
english: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo gokinyi, dhakono nodok e ot kama ruodhe ne oninde, mogore piny e wangʼ dhoot kendo nonindo kanyo nyaka chiengʼ ochako rieny.
english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

kikuyu: Emomiyo jogegi doknegi kendo pakogi kendo ok giyud rach moro amora kuomgi.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

kikuyu: Chiwreuru gi chuny man thuolo, to ka utimo kamano to Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro gwedho tijeu duto kod gimoro amora ma udwaro timo.
english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel, ka iweyo jo-Benjamin oko, ne nitiere gi jo-ligangla alufu mia angʼwen, giduto ne gin jokedo.
english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

kikuyu: Donge Kalno osechalo gi Karkemish? Donge Hamath chal mana gi Arpad, kendo Samaria mana ka Damaski?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ gi jodongo duto nyalo bedo joneno ni awacho adier. Gin ema negimiya barupe mane omiya thuolo mar mako owetegi man Damaski, kendo ne adhi kuno mondo amak joma oyie mondo kel Jerusalem kaka joma otwe mondo okumgi.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

kikuyu: nikech ne gidagi luwo chikena gi buchena kendo ne ok girito Sabato maga. Ne ok atimo kamano nikech chunjegi ne otwere kuom nyisechegi manono.
english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

kikuyu: Yawuot Hela ne gin: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

kikuyu: gi mesa kod ludhene kaachiel gi gigene duto mag tich kod makati miketo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye;
english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

kikuyu: Emomiyo ngʼama ochamo makatini kata ometho e kikombeni e yo ma ok owinjore, bura biro loyo kodoko jaketho kuom ringre Ruoth gi rembe.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

kikuyu: Kwiri margi chalo gi kwich thuol, chalo gi kwich thuond rachier ma tege oyienyo,
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

kikuyu: Nimar Johana Ja-Batiso nobiro ka ok ochiem kata metho, to giwacho ni, ‘En gi jachien.’
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Emomiyo kaka Kristo noneno sand e ringruok, un bende nyaka umanru gi paro machal gi mare, nikech ngʼat maneno sand e ringre koro oseloyo richo.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ni Harun niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyoe kawacho kama, “ ‘Ananyis kaka an Nyasaye Maler ne jogo masudo buta, kendo nyaka miya luor e nyim ogendini duto.’ ” Wachni nomako dho Harun.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

kikuyu: “Kata ka yawuote nowe chikna ma ok giluwo yorena,
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

kikuyu: Kaka nomedo lamo Jehova Nyasaye, Eli ne ngʼiye ka nono dhoge.
english: As she continued praying before the LORD, Eli saw her mouth.

kikuyu: Ji noluor kuonde motingʼore gi malo kendo wuoth nobednigi matek e wangʼ yore. Maua mar oyungu thiewo kendo ongogo lak mondo odhi ocham it yien-no, to oyudo ka it yien-no onge gi ndhandhu. Kamano e kaka dhano dhiyo e dalane mosiko ka joywak to dengo e wangʼ yore.
english: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets;

kikuyu: Abiro goyoni erokamano, nikech ne idwoka; mi idoko warruokna.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

kikuyu: Ka ongʼad lum oko eka manyien twi, to ka ichoko ne jambi lum manie kor got,
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, nyis Jerusalem timbene mamono duto e wangʼe,
english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

kikuyu: Eka Jehu nondikonegi baruwa mar ariyo mawacho niya, “Ka un jokora kendo ubiro winjo wachna, to ngʼaduru wiye yawuot ruodhu kendo kiny kochopo sa maka ma to ubi ira Jezreel.” E kindeno yawuot ruoth piero abiriyo ne ni kod jorit mag-gi mane gin jotend dala maduongʼno.
english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.
