kikuyu: Riw pasia abich kanyakla kendo abich modongʼ bende iriw
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel to nongʼado nam kawuotho e lowo motwo, ka pi ogingore e bathgi korachwich gi koracham.
english: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

kikuyu: Ketne tado kiweyo thuolo mar fut achiel gi nus e kind tado kod kore. Ketne dhoot kendo ipog iye gorofa adek.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

kikuyu: Ne akelou e piny momewo mondo ucham olembege kod nyak mage momewo. To ne ubiro mi unjawo pinya kendo umiyo girkeni maga obedo gima odwanyore.
english: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokwanogi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nomiye chik.
english: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.

kikuyu: Joma odonjonagi ne ok oyuda ka amino wach gi ngʼato angʼata e hekalu, kata ka aketho chuny ji mondo okel koko ei sinagogi kata kamoro amora ei Jerusalem.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “En angʼo mudwaro?” Nowachone niya, “Gol chik mondo moro ka moro kuom yawuota ariyogi obi obed kodi e pinyruodhi, moro e badi korachwich to machielo e badi koracham.”
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Wach mokor kuom Duma: Ngʼato obiro ira koa Seir, kendo openja monwore niya, “Jarito odongʼ seche adi mondo piny oru? Jarito odongʼ seche adi mondo piny oru?”
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

kikuyu: Ka sa ma jadolo onone, to oyudo ni pur oselal ka gino oselwoki, to nyaka oyiech kama opurno oko, bedni en kuom law, kata kuom pien, kata kuom usi mochwe kata law motwangʼ.
english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye miyo muofni neno. Jehova Nyasaye miyo joma piny otaro aa malo, kendo ohero joma kare.
english: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

kikuyu: Lewni manyaka gitwangʼ e magi: law akor, law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, kandho, law akor mogor, kilemba mar wich kod okanda. Nyaka gilos lewni mowal mag dologi ne owadu Harun kod yawuote mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Esau nowacho niya, “Kara ma emomiyo nochake ni Jakobo? Osewuonda koro nyadiriyo: Nokawo duongʼ mar nywolna kendo koro okawo gwethna!” Eka Esau nopenjo wuon mare niya, “Bende gweth moro didongʼna?”
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

kikuyu: Aparo gigi duto ka chunya opongʼ giywak: aparo kaka ne adhi gi oganda maduongʼ ka atelo ni ji madhi e od Nyasaye, Ka akok gimor kendo agoyo erokamano E dier oganda maduongʼ matimo nyasi gi mor.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

kikuyu: Omiyo Saulo nodhi Nayoth e gwengʼ Rama. To en bende Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuome mi owuotho kokoro wach nyaka ochopo Nayoth.
english: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

kikuyu: Nimar piny biro pongʼ gi ngʼeyo mar duongʼ Jehova Nyasaye kaka pi kwako nam.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

kikuyu: Ranguru ane winy ma huyo e kor polo. Ok chwo cham to bende ok gikee kata giken e dere, to eka Wuonu manie polo pod pidhogi apidha. To un donge un gi nengo mamalo moloyogi?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

kikuyu: Nimar onge gima ne wakelo e pinyni kendo onge gima wabiro kawo wadhigo.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

kikuyu: Daudi gi joge mia auchiel nochopo e Holo mar Besor, joge moko nodongʼ kanyo,
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

kikuyu: Chuny ngʼato sire e tuo, to chuny mool, en ngʼa manyalo konyo?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

kikuyu: Ka onyago olemo higa mabiro, mano ber, to, ka ok onyago, to nongʼole oko.’ ”
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

kikuyu: eka Azaria jadolo maduongʼ ma anywola Zadok nodwoke niya, “Nyaka ji chak kelo chiemo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, wasechiemo mawayiengʼ kendo chiemo mangʼeny pod odongʼ nikech Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho joge, mano emomiyo magi odongʼ.”
english: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into the LORD’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for the LORD has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo jonywol Musa opande kuom dweche adek bangʼ nywolne, nikech negineno kopogore gi nyithindo minywolo mamoko; kendo negitimo kamano ka ok giluoro siem mar ruodh Misri.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma Nyasach polo osechano, we otime gi chia ne hekalu mar Nyasach polo. En angʼo momiyo mirima dibed kuom pinyruoth gi yawuote?
english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato nigi wuowi ma jendeke ma ok winj wuon kod min kendo ok owinjgi ka okume,
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye Maratego notingʼ malo gi timne makare, kendo Nyasaye maler nonyis lerne gi timne makare.
english: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

kikuyu: Rit ngimana kaluwore gi herani, mondo alu chike mowuok e dhogi.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

kikuyu: Eka Musa nogolo Harun gi yawuote e dier oganda mi olwokogi gi pi.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

kikuyu: Solomon nodwoko Nyasaye niya, “isenyiso ngʼwono maduongʼ ni Daudi wuora kendo iketa abedo ruoth kare.
english: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane ogandagi gi Zekaria ne ni e tich to notiyo kaka jadolo e nyim Nyasaye,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

kikuyu: ka gia Matana negidhi Nahaliel, ka gia Nahaliel negidhi Bamoth,
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

kikuyu: chutho osekuma kinde ka kinde ndalo duto.
english: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

kikuyu: Luor wuonu gi minu mondo udagi amingʼa e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi nomiyo pesa moromo talanta abich, to machielo nomiyo talanta ariyo, kendo machielo talanta achiel; komiyo moro ka moro kuomgi pesa maromre gi nyalone. Eka nodhi e wuodhe.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

kikuyu: Ne oolo kuomgi mirimbe maliet, kokecho kendo iye owangʼ kendo oger; oganda malaike ma jonek.
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

kikuyu: Ne amiyou siem e kinde mane uparo ni uritoru maber, to ne iwacho ni, ‘Ok anachik ita!’ Ma osebedo yori chakre ibed rawera; ok iseluora.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Jehoyakin mane onywol ka en e twech ne gin: Shealtiel,
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

kikuyu: An, jayalo, asebedo ruodh Israel kadak Jerusalem.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To ajuogano mane iluongo ni Elima (nikech mano e tiend nyinge) notamogi, kotemo gengʼo ruoth mondo kik olokre oyie kuom Yesu.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

kikuyu: Ne girita ka joma rito koth ndalo oro, kendo negimor gi wechena mana ka joma rito kodh chwiri.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu ni Bethania, kochiemo e mesa e dala ngʼat moro miluongo ni Simon ja-dhoho, dhako moro nobiro gi chupa mar alabasta mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar kendo ma nengone tek. Notoyo ngʼut chupano mi oolo morno duto ewi Yesu.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

kikuyu: E dwe mar adek bangʼ ka jo-Israel nosewuok Misri, negichopo e thim Sinai e odiechiengʼno.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Nimar wangʼeyo ni ngimawa machon nogur kode mondo ringruok mar richo okethi, kendo kik koro wabed wasumbini mag richo,
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

kikuyu: Abiro gwedhogi, kaachiel gi kuonde molworo goda matin. Abiro oro koth machwe piyo kinde ma idware; adier, gweth miwuoro nobedie.
english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

kikuyu: Eka jokor wach nodwoko ruoth gi dho jo-Aram niya, “Mad idag amingʼa, yaye ruoth nyis jotichni lek ma iseleko eka wabiro nyisi tiende.”
english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

kikuyu: Nyikwayi dine obedo mana ka kwoyo, to nyithindi dobedo mangʼeny mokalo akwana; nying-gi ok nongʼad oko kendo ok noruch e wangʼa.”
english: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom jodolo mane oter twech Samaria nobiro modak Bethel kendo opuonjogi kaka ilamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

kikuyu: Magi e gik mane Hezekia otimo e piny Juda duto kotimo maber kendo makare kendo mowinjore ni Jehova Nyasaye ma ok obagni.
english: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before the LORD his God.

kikuyu: Nowacho ni ruoth niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: ‘Iseweyo ngʼat mane awacho ni nyaka tho odhi thuolo. Kuom mano inichul ngimane gi ngimani kendo jogi kuom joge.’ ”
english: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

kikuyu: An, Jehova Nyasaye, asewacho, kendo abiro timo gigi adieri ne oganda ma timbegi richogi, moseriwore mar kweda. Giko mar ngimagi notimre e thim; kendo kae ema gibiro thoe.”
english: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

kikuyu: Gisewito nyisechegi e mach mi gitiekogi, nikech ne ok gin nyiseche to ne gin mana yien kod kidi molos gi lwet dhano.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

kikuyu: To koro andikonu mondo kik ubedi e kanyakla gi ngʼato angʼata maluongore ni owadu kuom Ruoth, to pod terore, kata ma jawuoro, kata malamo nyiseche manono, kata ma jaketh nying ji, kata ma jamer, kata ma jamecho. Ngʼat ma kamano kata chiemo kik uchiemgo.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

kikuyu: To Yesu nokwere gi dwol matek niya, “Lingʼ thi! Wuogi ia kuome!”
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

kikuyu: En ngʼa mongʼeyo teko mar mirimbi? Nimar gero mari nigi teko machalo gi teko ma luori kelo.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kikuyu: Winji kendo ichik iti, kik ibed jangʼayi, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osewuoyo.
english: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Malaike abiriyo motingʼo masiche abiriyo nowuok e hekalu. Ne girwakore gi lewni maler mapakni kendo manyilni to negitweyo okanda mar dhahabu e korgi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

kikuyu: Jou machwo duto nyaka chopi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ma Nyasach Israel nyadidek e higa.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ere ngʼama nyalo ngʼeyo gima ber ma dhano onego tim e ngima machiekni kendo manono makadho mana ka tipo? Koso ere ngʼama nyalo nyise gima biro timorene e piny bangʼ thone?
english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

kikuyu: Ne wangʼawo thumbewa ewi omburi mane ni kanyo,
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

kikuyu: Kane Samuel pod chiwo misango miwangʼo pep, jo-Filistia noyworo machiegni mondo oked gi jo-Israel. To chiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo polo omor matek kuom jo-Filistia manomiyogi luoro ma gikee ka gikia kuma gidhiye, kendo negiringo e nyim jo-Israel.
english: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.

kikuyu: Maluwogi ne en dhood Gad. Jatend dhood Gad ne en Eliasaf wuod Reuel.
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

kikuyu: Jo-Jerusalem gi jotendgi ne ok ongʼeyo ni Yesu e Jawar, to kata kamano, kane gingʼadone buch tho, to negichopo mana weche jonabi misomo pile chiengʼ Sabato.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

kikuyu: “To koro Jehova Nyasaye rit singruok misetimo gi jatichni kod ode osik nyaka chiengʼ. Tim mana kaka ne isingori,
english: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

kikuyu: Nyaka olokre owe timbe maricho mi otim tim maber; nyaka omany kwe kendo oluwe.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Magi e kuonde tedo ma joma tiyo e hekalu biro tedoe misengini mag ji.”
english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

kikuyu: Karaya mar Namno norenji e ngʼe rwedhi apar gariyo, ka adek ngʼiyo yo nyandwat, to adek ngʼiyo yo podho chiengʼ, to adek ngʼiyo yo milambo, bende adek ngʼiyo yo wuok chiengʼ. Karaya mar Namno noyiere kuomgi kendo tiendegi machien nochomo ka iye.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Hanani janen nobiro ir Asa ruodh Juda mowachone niya, “Nikech nigeno kuom ruodh Aram ma ok kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, jolweny mag ruodh Aram osetony oa e lweti.
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

kikuyu: Jowete Hashabia nogedo e dirgi, ne gin jo-Binnui ma wuod Henadad, jatend dir gwengʼ Keila machielo.
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

kikuyu: to nyaim ka nyaim, to chiw gi cham maromo kilo adek mar mogo mayom moru gi mo. Ma en misango miwangʼo pep, gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom okapu mar makati ma ok oketie thowi mane ni e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nokawo makati gi kek molos gi mo kod chapat achiel mi oketogi ewi boche kod bam ma korachwich.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

kikuyu: Chik achielni ema oriwo misango mar golo richo kod misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho. Misenginigo nodongʼ ni jadolo motimogi, kopwodhogo richo.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Ibiro kecho nyaka chiengʼ koso? Nyaka karangʼo ma nyiego mari biro lielie ka mach?
english: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

kikuyu: Polo hulo timne makare, kendo ji duto neno duongʼne.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

kikuyu: kendo ongʼad kite duto gi payo bao kendo mondo otim kit tije duto mag lwedo.
english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

kikuyu: Joshua nomako ruodhigo duto kaachiel gi pinjegi e lweny achielno nimar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nokedo ni joge.
english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

kikuyu: E kinde mane an gi mirima mangʼeny ne apandoni wangʼa kuom ndalo manok, to koro gi ngʼwono mochwere an-gi kech kuomi,” Jehova Nyasaye ma Jaresni ema owacho.
english: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼatno madwaro reso ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼatno mowito ngimane nikech an, abiro rese.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

kikuyu: “Ji ywak malit nikech tingʼ mapek moyie kuomgi; giywak mana ni mondo ogolgi e bwo loch joma thirogi.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kikuyu: Ruodhi duto mag pinje ne biro ir Solomon mondo oyud rieko mane Nyasaye oketo e chunye.
english: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

kikuyu: Koa kuom jodolo ne gin: Jedaya wuod Joyarib; Jakin;
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

kikuyu: Eka Laban noketo thuolo e kinde gi Jakobo madirom wuodh ndalo adek Jakobo to ne odongʼ kakwayo romb Laban mane odongʼ.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

kikuyu: Ne ochiwo jambgi ne pe, kendo nomiyo dhogegi polo ogoyo.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro dwoko duongʼ mar Jakobo, mana ka duongʼ mar Israel, kata obedo ni joma omonje osekethe kendo oseketho puothegi mag mzabibu.
english: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.

kikuyu: Jopa bepe kod jogedo bende nomi pesa mondo gingʼiewgo kite mopa kod yiend ripo kod sirni mondo gilosgo udi mane ruodhi Juda oweyo okethore.
english: They gave it to the carpenters and to the builders to buy cut stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in iwinjo kwayo mar joma chandore; ijiwogi, kendo ichiko iti ni ywakgi,
english: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nochiwe e lwetwa kendo ne watieke gi nyithinde kod jolwenje duto.
english: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

kikuyu: Higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo ok nopar, nikech kech mano luweno nobed malich miwuoro.
english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

kikuyu: Huma mara biro siko kalandore kendo tekra nosiki!’
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

kikuyu: Jo-Misri kod farese Farao gi gechegi, gi joidh farese kod jolweny nolawo jo-Israel mi gijukogi ka gibworo e bath nam machiegni gi Pi Hahiroth mochomore gi Baal Zefon.
english: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

kikuyu: Noloso gik mongʼinore e laini ariyo molworo thiwnigo mongʼawogi kuom gik machalo agulni manie ewi siro. Notimo mano ewi moro ka moro.
english: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

kikuyu: Mad miechgi dongʼ gundni; kendo kik iyie ne ngʼato angʼata dag e hembgi.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Kane Azuba otho, Kaleb nonywomo Efrath mane onywolone Hur.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo jo-Gibeon niya, “Atimnu angʼo? Ere kaka dalos winjruok mane okethore mondo ugwedhi oganda Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”

kikuyu: Asekunyo sokni e pinje mamoko mi amodho pige man kuno. Asemiyo aore duto mag Misri bende oduono ka anyonogi gi tienda.’
english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Nikech gik ma asewachonu, omiyo un gi kuyo.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

kikuyu: To an Jehova Nyasaye anawach gima adwaro kendo gino notimre ma ok orem. Nimar e ndalou, un dhood mohero ngʼanyo, abiro timo gimoro amora ma asewacho, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.”
english: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane iyi owangʼ kod wan ma jotichni, kendo ne irwakowa e od twech kaachiel gi jatend joted makati e od jatend askeche.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

kikuyu: Lokri ichom kuonde mosebedo kokethore nyaka nene, lokri ichom kethruok maduongʼ ma jasigu osekelo e kari maler mar lemo.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

kikuyu: An kod Wuora wan achiel.”
english: I and the Father are one.”

kikuyu: Ne onge gimoro ei Sandug Muma makmana kite ariyo mopa mane Musa oketo e iye kane en Horeb kama Jehova Nyasaye ne otimoe singruok kod jo-Israel kane gisewuok Misri.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowuoyo kod jo-Yahudi gi jo-Yunani moluoro Nyasaye e sinagogi. Bende pile pile nowuoyo gi ji mane budho e chiro e dalano.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

kikuyu: Nikech gige lweny mwakedogo ok gin mag pinyni, to gin gige lweny mager mag Nyasaye, mwakonyorego kuom muko kuonde mochiel motegno.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

kikuyu: Winj ywak jokwath, dengo mar jokwadh rombe, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ketho kuondegi mag kwath.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for the LORD destroys their pasture.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: “Misengini mangʼeny mutimogi amon-go.” Aol gi misengini miwangʼo pep mag imbe kaachiel gi boche mag jamni machwe. Ok amor gi remb rwedhi gi mag imbe kod mag nywogi.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo joma nochungʼ machiegni kode niya, “Ibiro tim angʼo ne ngʼat monego ja-Filistiani magol wichkuodni e Israel? Ja-Filistia ma ok oter nyangu to en ngʼa manyalo jaro jolweny mag Nyasaye mangima?”
english: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

kikuyu: An to awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moriembo chiege nikech wach moro amora makmana richo mar terruok, miyo chiegeno donjo e richo mar terruok, kendo ngʼato angʼata mokendo dhako makamano bende donjo e richo mar terruok.
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

kikuyu: Koro sani asayi ni iwena richona kendo wadog kodi mondo mi alam Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.”

kikuyu: Aseyudo Daudi jatichna; asewire gi moya maler.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

kikuyu: Ruoth en ja-adiera, omiyo obiro miyou teko kendo obiro ritou e lwet Ngʼama Rach.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

kikuyu: Nokaw nyiwu mondo obed jolos modhi mangʼwe ngʼar to moko obed joted chiemo kod makati.
english: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Richoni oweni.”
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Asebedo katiyo matek ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego. Jo-Israel osekwedo singruokni, gisemuko kende mag misengini kendo nego jonabigi gi ligangla. An kenda ema adongʼ kendo koro gidwaro nega.”
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi iye nowangʼ ahinya kane owinjo wechegi duto.
english: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

kikuyu: “Iseresa e lwet jowa mane monja; iserita kaka jatelo mar ogendini. Joma ne ok angʼeyo nobet e bwo lochna,
english: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro ma ja-Kurene miluongo ni Simon, mane wuon Aleksanda gi Rufus, noyudo kadho kanyo koa e gwengʼ moro. Ne gichune mondo otingʼ msalaba.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

kikuyu: Jogi nobedo gi Daudi ndalo adek ka gichiemo kendo metho nikech jowetegi noseikonigi gik moko.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

kikuyu: To kowacho ni, ‘Ok amor kodi,’ to aikora; we mondo otim gima oneno ni berne.”
english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

kikuyu: Joma kecho ji gin joma ogwedhi, nimar ibiro kechgi.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Liganglana osetieko tichne e kor lwasi, neuru, olor mondo ongʼad bura ne Edom, oganda ma asetieko chuth.
english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

kikuyu: An awuon ok lichna ka uyala kata ka oyala e od bura moro amora mar dhano. Chutho kata an awuon ok anyal yalora kenda.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi e piny Galili duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth kendo kochango kit tuoche gi midekre duto e dier ji.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi ni Horesh man e thim Zif noyudo wach ni Saulo nosewuok mondo otiek ngimane.
english: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.

kikuyu: Zif, Telem, Biloth,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

kikuyu: Omiyo Yesu nodhi ire, momako lwete kokonye mondo ochungʼ. Midhusi noweye kendo nochungʼ mochako miyogi chiemo.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

kikuyu: kata kamano achiya mar pi ne wuok koa ei lowo kendo ne omiyo piny duto obedo mangʼich.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

kikuyu: Nikech ma e gima ne upenjo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e got Horeb e chiengʼ chokruok kane uwacho niya, “Kik wawinj dwond Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kata neno mach makakni kama dipo ka watho.”
english: This is according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again the LORD my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

kikuyu: Unuchiwne jadolo bam ma korachwich mar chiayo kaka misango mar lalruok.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

kikuyu: Yesu nochungo kendo nochiko mondo okel ngʼatno ire. Kane obiro machiegni, Yesu nopenje niya,
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

kikuyu: Kuom winy machamo ringʼo, onge moro amora mongʼeyo yore manie buchego, kendo onge achuth mosenene gi wangʼe.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mano e chik momako ja-Nazir mosekwongʼore kaluwore gi pwodhruok mare kendo mano e misango manyaka otimne Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi gimoro monyalo chiwo. Nyaka ochop singo mar kwongʼruok mane ochiwo, kaluwore gi chik mar ja-Nazir.’ ”
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

kikuyu: Koro ka wasetho gi Kristo, wan gi yie ni wabiro bedo mangima kode bende.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

kikuyu: Jareshia, Elija kod Zikri ne gin yawuot Jeroham.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

kikuyu: Nowacho ni oganda niya, “Kuneno ka boche polo chokore yo podho chiengʼ to piyo piyo uwacho ni, ‘Koth biro chue,’ to timore kamano!
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

kikuyu: Kanuru wechenagi e chunyu kod pachu, twegiuru e bedeu ka ranyisi kendo e pat wengeu.
english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Kapo ni awachone gimoro amora marach to hul ane gino. To kapo nawacho adier to ithala nangʼo?”
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

kikuyu: Wuod Shamai ne en Maon, to Maon ne wuon Beth Zur.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

kikuyu: To ka chiwo mari mar cham en gima otedi e tawo, inilose gi mogo mayom kod mo.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel oneno kaka wach chal kuomgi kendo ni jolwenjgi othungʼ marach, ne gipondo e rogo, e bunge, e kind lwendni, e buche matut, e soko.
english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

kikuyu: Nikech ahero chikeni moloyo dhahabu, kendo moloyo dhahabu maler mogik,
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

kikuyu: Nyasaye miyo dhano mwandu, ngima maber kod luor makende, mondo kik obed maonge gimoro amora ma chunye dwaro, makmana Nyasaye ok miye thuolo mar bedo gi mor kuomgi, kendo ngʼato nono ema bedo mamor kodgi. Maonge tiende, kendo en richo marach moloyo.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, ni Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema nonege; kata ndalone chiengʼ moro nochopi mi otho kata nodhi e lweny mi notho kuno.
english: David said, “As the LORD lives, the LORD will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.

kikuyu: Efraim en nyaroya mobo mohero dino cham; omiyo anatwe jok e ngʼute maberno. Anariemb Efraim, to Juda nyaka pur, kendo Jakobo biro baro lowo.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

kikuyu: Kochakore odiechiengʼ mane ogere nyaka sani, dala maduongʼni osemedo wangʼo iya kendo miya mirima ma chuna ni nyaka agole e nyim wangʼa.
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

kikuyu: Omiyo wach Jehova Nyasaye mane ohul kowuok kuom Jehu nochopo kare mawacho niya, “Nyikwayi nobedi e loch mar Israel nyaka tiengʼ mar angʼwen.”
english: This was the LORD’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

kikuyu: Ka joma richo lawa mondo oketh ngimana, ka wasika kod joma kedo koda monja, to gibiro kier mi gipodhi.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

kikuyu: Ngʼat molocho noyud gigi duto kaka girkeni, kendo anabed Nyasache, to enobed wuoda.
english: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

kikuyu: Moro ka moro ne huyo kochomo nyime tir. Kamoro amora mane Roho mar Nyasaye dhiye ema gin bende negidhiye ma ok gilokre ka gingʼiyo chien.
english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

kikuyu: Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jogo matetni kuwinjo dwonde: “Oweteni mochai kendo ok kwani ka gimoro nikech ihero nyinga osewacho niya, ‘Mad Jehova Nyasaye mi duongʼ, mondo omi wane morni!’ Kata kamano gin giwegi ema ginine wichkuot.
english: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

kikuyu: Ishmael nonego bende jo-Yahudi duto mane nigi Gedalia Mizpa, kaachiel gi jolwenj Babulon mane ni kanyo.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.

kikuyu: Eka negiwacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo pod wadwaro joneno moko kendo? Wasewinjo mano koa e dhoge owuon.”
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

kikuyu: Kane Ahab owinjo ni Naboth osetho, noa malo modhi mondo okaw puoth Naboth mar mzabibu obed mare.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

kikuyu: Bende noloso dhoudi ariyo gi yiend saipras kamoro ka moro nigi pata ariyo.
english: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

kikuyu: Petro, kata kamano, noa malo kendo noringo odhi e liel. Kokulore e liel, noneno lewni kodongʼ kanyo kendgi, noa modok, kowuoro owuon gima osetimore.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ gi dwe bende opake, kaachiel gi sulwe duto marieny.
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

kikuyu: to mon madongo kaw ka mineni, kendo mon matindo kaw ka nyimineni, e yo maler chutho.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

kikuyu: Nimar in ema in gi soko mar pi mar ngima; kuom lerni ema wanenoe ler.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un ogendini duto; dendeuru, un ji duto manie piny.
english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

kikuyu: “Wuowino nowachone ni, ‘Wuora, asetimo richo e nyim polo kendo e nyimi. Ok awinjora koro mondo oluonga ni wuodi.’
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

kikuyu: Eka an Daniel nangʼicho, kendo e nyima kanyo ji mamoko ariyo nochungʼe, achiel e geng aora koni to machielo e geng aora komachielo.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

kikuyu: Idwoko dhano e lowo, kiwacho niya, “Doguru e lowo un koth dhano.”
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

kikuyu: E kinde mar chiwo misango, Elija janabi nosudo nyime molemo kowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Israel, we ongʼere kawuono ni in e Nyasaye e Israel kendo ni an jatichni bende ni asetimo magi duto kaluwore gi chikni.
english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo oganda medore, Yesu nowacho niya, “Ma en tiengʼ marach. Gikwayo ranyisi mar hono, to ok bi miye moro amora makmana ranyisi mar Jona.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne mirima omako matek. Nooro jolweny mage mine gidhi gitieko jotich ma jonekgo kendo giwangʼo miechgi.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo ngʼato angʼata mangima ngʼur ka okume nikech richoge?
english: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

kikuyu: “Kata obedo ni asebedo ka awuoyonu gi ngeche, to ndalo biro ma ok nawuo kodu kamano, to ananyisu maler kuom Wuora.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

kikuyu: Kane oseluongo jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik duto mane otelo ne ji, nopenjogi kama nowinjore nywolie Kristo, Mesia.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

kikuyu: Eka gouru turumbete kamoro amora e odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar abiriyo, kendo Odiechieng Pwodhruokno gouru turumbete e gwengeu duto.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

kikuyu: Ring misango mar goyo erokamano nyaka cham mana odiechiengno mochiwe ma ok oriyo nyaka okinyi.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

kikuyu: Jodak nobed jokwadh jambu, jopinje mamoko nopurnu puotheu mag cham, kod mago mag mzabibu.
english: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel Elisha nodhi Shunem. Dhako moro ma jamoko ahinya mane odak e pinyno nokwaye mondo oraw e ode mondo ochamie gimoro. Omiyo kinde duto mane oyudo okalo kanyo, norawo e odno mondo ochiem.
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

kikuyu: Kane oneno Yesu kabiro gi kuma bor, noringo odhi ire mopodho piny e nyime.
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo dwol kawuok e kendo mar misango kawacho niya, “En adieri Ruoth Nyasaye Maratego ni kumni nikare kendo gin adieri.”
english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

kikuyu: Ger Hemb Romoni gi gigene duto machalre mana gi kido ma abiro nyisi.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo yo ka Malo mar Misri doko gunda, Zoan to abiro chinyoe mach, to Thebes to abiro kumo.
english: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.

kikuyu: Kane gige tich duto oseikore, jodolo nochungʼ keregi kendo jo-Lawi nobedo e migepegi kaka ne ruoth osechiko.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

kikuyu: An to aluongo Nyasaye, kendo Jehova Nyasaye resa.
english: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

kikuyu: Eka malaika cha nopenja niya, “Angʼo miwuoro kamano? Abiro nyisi tiend wach mopondo mar dhakono kod mar ondiek malich moidho gi wiye abiriyo kod tunge apar.
english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

kikuyu: Kwan-giuru kaka jomaler, nikech gin ema gichiwo chiemo ni Nyasachu. Kawgiuru kaka jomaler nikech an Jehova Nyasaye aler; an mamiyo ubedo maler.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: Dhi ir Zedekia ruodh Juda kendo inyise kama, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Achiegni chiwo dala maduongʼni ne ruodh Babulon, kendo enowangʼe pep.
english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, the LORD says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.

kikuyu: kane ochiwo kuonde giko mag nam matin mondo pi kik okadh kama oketee, kendo kane oloso mise mar piny.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

kikuyu: Machalre kamano bende, jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik kod jodong oganda bende nojare, kagiwacho niya,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

kikuyu: to Nyasaye mondo opima e ratil madier kendo obiro yudo ni aonge ketho,
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

kikuyu: En angʼo mane atimo ni kanisni mamoko mane ok atimonu, makmana ni un ne ok amiyou tingʼ mapek mar konya? Ka dipo ni mano ne rachnu to mondo uwena!
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

kikuyu: Kane osewacho mano, to nodok oluongo Maria nyamin-gi tenge, mowachone niya, “Japuonj nika, kendo oluongi.”
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

kikuyu: “To kane oyudo gin e yo gidhi ngʼiewo mafuta, wuon kisera nochopo. Nyiri mane oikore nodonjo kode e nyasi mar arus; kendo nolor dhoot.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ndik wechegi piny nimar kaluwore gi wechegi asetimo singruok kodi kaachiel gi jo-Israel.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

kikuyu: Kuonde motimo ongoro kendo mobaro okak nobed mamor; kuonde thimbe nobed moil kendo momiyo ka maua mathiewo, mana kaka ondanyo,
english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

kikuyu: Osedino yorena ma ok anyal kalo; kendo osemiyo kuonde maluwo otimo mudho.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

kikuyu: Yesu nomiyogi thuolo mi jochiendego nowuok kuom ngʼatno mi gidonjo ei angurogo. Kwethgo duto ma kar rombgi ne nyalo chopo alufu ariyo, noringo matek koluwo aridiridi mochomo nam mi giduto ne githo ei pi.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo kaka nonyisgi; jomoko nochoko mangʼeny, to jomoko nochoko matin.
english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

kikuyu: It yien ayiena ma yamo teroni to isando nangʼo? Mihudhi motwo ma yamo tero, to ilawo nangʼo?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

kikuyu: Nimar kuom kinde mangʼeny aselingʼ, asehora kendo aseterora mos. To koro sani, abiro chalo mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo, maywak ka gamo yweyo matek.
english: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

kikuyu: “Wuothi e yore mag Jerusalem duto, rang koni gi koni kiparo, kendo kimanyo kuondege duto. Kinyalo yudo kata mana ngʼato achiel, ma ja-ratiro kendo madwaro adiera, to abiro ngʼwonone dala maduongʼni.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

kikuyu: Kata ji apar gaboro ka manotho kane ohinga man Siloam nopodho kuomgi, uparo ni ne gin joketho moloyo ji mamoko duto madak e Jerusalem?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Manase notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo ne oike e puoth joka ruoth, ma en puoth Uza, kendo Amon wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Uria nowachone Daudi niya, “Sandug Muma gi Israel gi Juda dak e hembe, to jatenda ma Joab gi jo-ruodha obuoro oko e pap. Ere kaka anyalo dhi e oda mondo achiem, kendo amethi, mi ariwra e achiel gi chiega? Akwongʼora e nyimi ni ok datim gima kamano.”
english: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

kikuyu: Othniel wuod Kenaz, ma owadgi Kaleb noloyo pinyno, omiyo Kaleb nomiye nyare Aksa mondo okendi.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: ma uchungʼ ka kodwa kawuononi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, to atime nyaka gi joma onge kodwa ka kawuono.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

kikuyu: Ne joma jo-adiera, inyisori kaka ja-adiera, kendo ne joma longʼo, inyisori kaka ngʼama longʼo,
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono obed kod jogo duto mohero Ruoth Yesu Kristo gihera ma ok rum.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

kikuyu: kongʼado milambo mar Akrabim, kodhi nyime nyaka Zin, kendo ochwe nyaka milambo mar Kadesh Barnea. Bangʼe to ne ongʼado Hezron nyaka Adar kendo gomo kochiko Karka.
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi mangʼeny nosomo ndikono, nimar kama nogure Yesu ne ni machiegni gi dala maduongʼ, kendo milomeno nondiki e dho jo-Hibrania, gi Latin kod dho jo-Yunani.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

kikuyu: Kane pod an wuowi e od wuora, kane pod an rawera kendo nyathi achiel kende mar minwa,
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kane itimona ngʼwono, ne imiyo achungʼ motegno kaka got; to kane ipando wangʼi, to piny nochama.
english: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

kikuyu: Riemb ngʼat ma jaro ji, to lweny bende aa, dhawo kod kinyruok rumo.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

kikuyu: mondo girit odiechiengʼ gotieno, kendo gipog ler koa kuom mudho. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Yo momwon motegnono noringo e bath yo maduongʼ midonjogo, kendo lachne ne romre gi borne. Yo momwon motegnono ne en yo mapiny.
english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Ka ngʼato angʼata kuomu kata nyikwau obedo mogak nikech ringruok motho kata ka gidhi wuoth, to pod ginyalo mana timo nyasi mar Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

kikuyu: Negilamo kido mag nyisechegi, ma bangʼe nolokorenegi obadho.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

kikuyu: Dhano mokwongo nochwe gi lowo, to dhano mar ariyo noa e polo.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kikuyu: Wuoda, cham mor kich, nimar ober; mor kich moa e pedni mar kich nigi ndhandhu mamit.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

kikuyu: Ndalo chwiri osekalo; koth osechok kendo oserumo.
english: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

kikuyu: Ibiro aa malo mi ikech Sayun, nimar sa osechopo monego ongʼwonee; sa mochanne osechopo.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

kikuyu: Yie iusnwa chiemo mwachamo kod pi mwamodho nikech nengogi romre gi fedha, kendo iwewa aweya wakadhi kwawuotho gi tiendwa,
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

kikuyu: Nyaka omak motegno puonj migeno, mana kaka osepuonje e kinde motelo, mondo eka ojiw joma moko gi puonj madier kendo okwer joma kwedo puonjno.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

kikuyu: Bed abeda mos, yaye chunya, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osebedo katimoni maber ndalo duto.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

kikuyu: Negipeyo kwethgi gi dhogi gi pundegi kod gigegi duto mane ni e dala kod mago mane ni oko e pap.
english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi jokwath bende abiro keto chandruok mag rombena e wigi. Abiro gologi e tij rito romba mondo kik giyud gik ma giritorego gin giwegi. Abiro reso romba e dhogi, kendo romba koro ok nobed chiembgi kendo. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.
english: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Balaam ote kowachone niya, “Dog ir Balak kendo imiye wachni.”
english: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

kikuyu: Koro ee aoro owetegi mondo pwochwa kuomu kuom wachni kik lokre mana weche manono; to mondo giyudu kuikoru mana kaka ne asewachonegi.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

kikuyu: Eltolad, Bethul, Horma,
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

kikuyu: To Sayun nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼa; kendo Ruoth Nyasaye wiye osewil koda.”
english: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

kikuyu: Jolwenj Farao ne osewuok oa Misri, kendo ka jo-Babulon mane gero pidhe kolworo Jerusalem nowinjo wach mar biro margi, ne gidar gia Jerusalem.
english: Pharaoh’s army had come out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼat moro miluongo ni Anania, kaachiel gi chiege Safira, bende noloko puothgi moro pesa.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

kikuyu: “Kamano e kaka ne chalre e ndalo mag Lut, ji ne chiemo, kendo metho, negingʼiewo kendo negiloko ohala, bende negipitho kendo gedo.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

kikuyu: To Stefano mane en ngʼat mopongʼ gi ngʼwono kod teko mar Nyasaye, notimo ranyisi madongo miwuoro kod honni e dier ji.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

kikuyu: To wuon-gi nodagi mowachone niya, “Angʼeyo mano nyathina. Manase bende biro bedo oganda maduongʼ. To kata kamano owadgi matin nobed giduongʼ moloye kendo nyikwaye nobed ogendini mangʼeny.”
english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

kikuyu: Laban nowachone niya, “Bi, in ngʼama Jehova Nyasaye ogwedho. Angʼo ma omiyo ichungʼ oko ka? Aseikoni ot kendo nitie kar ngamia bende.”
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

kikuyu: En ema nomiyo gik moko duto ochwe; kendo ka dine onge en, to onge gima dine ochwe mosechwe.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

kikuyu: Yesu nokechogi, mi nomulo wengegi. Gikanyono negichako neno, kendo ne giluwe.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

kikuyu: To ka tich ngʼato owangʼ e mach, to ok noyud michne. En owuon to norese, to norese mana ka ngʼat matony aa e mach maliel.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

kikuyu: Anto an e lweti; timnauru gima uneno ka ber kendo nikare.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.

kikuyu: Owacho ni: “En gima tin ahinya mondo ibed jatichna kata mondo iduog dhood joka Jakobo, kendo mondo iduog jo-Israel manok mane odongʼ. Abiro miyo ibed ler mar ogendini, mondo iter wach warruokna e tunge piny duto.”
english: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

kikuyu: Nimar ne adenyo, to onge gima numiya mondo acham; riyo noloya, to onge gima numiya mondo amodhi;
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

kikuyu: Josef nowachone niya, “Ma e tiend leknino. Atonge adek nyiso ndalo adek.
english: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gin gi jotelo Zoan kendo jootene osechopo Hanes,
english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

kikuyu: “Ka sibuor mabiro koa e bungu moyugno mar Jordan nyaka kar kwath man-gi lum, anariemb Edom oa e pinye kadiemo wangʼ. En ngʼa mowal manyalo yiero ne ma? En ngʼa machalo koda kendo manyalo chungʼ koda? Koso jakwath mane manyalo chungʼ koda?”
english: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”

kikuyu: Roho Maler wacho ni e ndalo giko jomoko nowe yie mi giluw weche chunje mawuondo ji kod puonj mayoreyore mag jochiende.
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

kikuyu: Nodok maratego ahinya, to ok gi tekre owuon. Enokel kethruok maduongʼ kendo enolochi e gimoro amora motimo. Enotiek joma roteke kod jomaler.
english: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa e pewe mag Moab momanyore gi Jeriko mokiewo gi Jordan kowachone niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Beduru moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye, kendo beduru mamor, un joma kare; weruru, un duto ma urieru tir gie chunyu!
english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

kikuyu: Eka ruoth kod ji duto nochiwo misengini e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mae to dhakono nyaka rit kuom ndalo piero adek gadek, mondo pwodhe kuom rembe. E kindeno ok oyiene mulo gimoro amora mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye, kata donjo e kama ler mar lemo, nyaka ndalone mag pwodhruok rum.
english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

kikuyu: Kain, Gibea, kod Timna. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Kuom Nyasaye ma apako wachne, in Nyasaye ema aketo genona kuomi omiyo ok abi bedo maluor. Dhano adhana to nyalo timona angʼo?
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

kikuyu: Elihoref kod Ahija yawuot Shisha jogoro; Jehoshafat wuod Ahilud jachan weche.
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

kikuyu: yaye, un nyikwa Israel jatichne, yaye, un yawuot Jakobo joge moyiero.
english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Kar dewo nyisechegigo, to obiro mana miyo duongʼ mana nyasaye mar kuonde mochiel motegno, to nyasaye ma kwerene ne ok olamo obiro miyo duongʼ gi dhahabu kod fedha, gi kite ma nengogi tek kod mich ma nengogi tek.
english: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

kikuyu: Kata kamano soko kata yawo motingʼo pi nosik ka ler, to ngʼato angʼata momulo gimoro amora motho nobed mogak.
english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Mosuru jowete duto gi yogruok mar jomaler.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Ne ayudo chik mondo achiw gweth; osegwedhogi, kendo ok anyal loko mano.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

kikuyu: Omiyo Gad nodhi ir Daudi mowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: ‘Kaw achiel kuomgi:
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:

kikuyu: Kuom wach warruokni ema ne jonabi onono matut kendo omanyo matek, kane gikoro wach gweth mane Nyasaye biro miyou.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, nomako osiep hera gi nyako ma nyinge Delila e Holo mar Sorek.
english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

kikuyu: Sikuru ei hera Nyasaye ka urito ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo mondo okelu e ngima mochwere.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

kikuyu: Obil ja-Ishmael to nochungʼne ngamia, Jedeya ma ja-Meronoth to nochungʼne punde.
english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

kikuyu: Kiwinjo ka wi omburi yiengni, iwuog mapiyo idhi e lweny nikech mano biro nyiso ni Nyasaye osetelo e nyimi mondo otiek jolweny mag jo-Filistia.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo mangʼeny, jo-Yahudi nochano mondo oneg Saulo,
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

kikuyu: Nimar odiechiengno osudo machiegni, adier odiechiengʼ Jehova Nyasaye chiegni; enobed odiechiengʼ ma piny dudoe, ma en kinde mar masira ne ogendini.
english: For the day is near, even the LORD’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne gotieno mowachone niya, “An e Nyasach wuonu Ibrahim. Kik iluor nikech an kodi; abiro gwedhi kendo abiro medo nyikwayi nikech singruok mane atimo gi Ibrahim jatichna.”
english: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

kikuyu: Musa nokawo nus remo kendo oketo e tewni, kendo nus modongʼ nokiro kuom kendo mar misango.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

kikuyu: Shelumiel wuod Zurishadai, ma jatend joka Simeon nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar abich.
english: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,

kikuyu: Negioro jopuonjregi ire, kaachiel gi jo-Herodia, mi negipenje niya, “Japuonj, wangʼeyo ni in ngʼama ja-ratiro kendo ipuonjo yor Nyasaye kaluwore gi adierane. Ji ok nyal ywayi maloki nikech ok iluoro wangʼ ngʼato.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

kikuyu: Eka Joshua kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Lakish koa Libna; mi gimonje.
english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne ooro Jerub-Baal (ma bende iluongo ni Gideon), Barak (ma bende iluongo ni Bedan), Jeftha gi Samuel, kendo ne oresou kuom wasiku mane omonjou koa koni gi koni, momiyo udak gi kwe.
english: The LORD sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.

kikuyu: Negiketo ngimagi e chandruok nikech an. Ok an kenda, to kanise duto mag joma ok jo-Yahudi, bende pako timgino.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “An Jehova Nyasaye ok alokra ngangʼ. Omiyo un, yaye nyikwa Jakobo, ok osetieku.
english: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

kikuyu: ne chode, ne kongʼo machon kod kongʼo manyien, magolo winjo mar joga.
english: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

kikuyu: Nimar nosechango ji mangʼeny, omiyo jomane tuo ne dhirore mondo omule.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

kikuyu: Nimar obiro miyo malaika mage chik nikech in mondo giriti e yoreni duto;
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

kikuyu: “Twangʼ law kandho mar law mayom mar katana kendo ilos kilemba gi law mayom mar katana. Okanda to mondo ogor gi ngʼama olony.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Nyikwayo gin osimbo ne joma oti, to jonywol e mor mar nyithindgi.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne iwuonda kendo nowuonda; ne ihewa kendo iloya giteko. Itugo koda odiechiengʼ mangima; kendo ji duto nyiera.
english: LORD, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mondo opaki gie Sayun, Jal modak Jerusalem mondo opaki. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Ok gin mag pinyni, mana kaka an bende ok an mar pinyni.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kikuyu: nikech ungʼeyo ni Ruoth biro chulo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom gimoro amora maber ma ngʼato timo, bed ni en misumba kata ngʼama ni thuolo.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

kikuyu: To mago mariek to notingʼo mafuta e kubni kaachiel gi techegi.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

kikuyu: Ruth nodwoke niya, “Abiro timo gimoro amora minyisa.”
english: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”

kikuyu: Rehoboam wuod Solomon ne ruoth e Juda. Ne en ja-higni piero angʼwen gachiel kane obedo ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kuom higni apar gabiriyo e Jerusalem, e dala maduongʼ mane Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero kuom dhoudi duto mag Israel mondo oketie Nyinge. Nying min-gi ne en Naama nyar jo-Amon.
english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Mikaya ne osenyisogi gik moko duto mane osewinjo ka Baruk somo ne ji koa e kitabu,
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

kikuyu: Efron ja-Hiti noyudo obet piny e kind jog-gi kendo nodwoko Ibrahim ka jo-Hiti duto ma nobiro e dhoranga dalano winjo.
english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

kikuyu: Kane pod en ei min nomako tiend owadgi, kaka dhano nomako amen gi Nyasaye.
english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

kikuyu: Ka ja-miriambo ma jawuond obiro kawacho niya, ‘Abiro koronu wach mondo ubed gi divai gi kongʼo mangʼeny,’ to ngʼat makamano ema bedo janabi ma jogi ohero!
english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.

kikuyu: unugo agoro ni ruodh Babulon ka uwacho niya: Neyeuru kaka giko mar jatend ji chalo, kendo kaka gerone orumo!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

kikuyu: To bende, jo-Yahudi mia achiel gi piero abich kod jotelo nochiemo e mesana, kaachiel gi ogendini mane obiro irwa koa machiegni kodwa.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nooro joote mondo oom Ahimelek jadolo ma wuod Ahitub kaachiel gi joodgi duto, mane gin jodolo e Nob, kendo giduto negibiro ir ruoth.
english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mane oyier ne jo-Yahudi mondo otimie magi e gwenge duto mag pinyruodh Ahasuerus ne en tarik apar gadek dwe mar apar gariyo dwe miluongo ni Adar.
english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

kikuyu: kendo mana kaka ondiki niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo pach joma riek ni onge tich.”
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

kikuyu: kod Uria ja-Hiti. Giduto ne gin ji piero adek gabiriyo.
english: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

kikuyu: “Kuom tekoni maduongʼ, ne iloyo jogo mane opiem kodi. Ne inyiso mirimbi mager mi nomwonyogi kaka lum.
english: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.

kikuyu: Ruoth noywagi, wuod ruoth makawo loch kare chunye nonyosre, kendo bede ji manie piny notetni. Abiro tiyo kodgi kaluwore gi timbegi, kendo abiro ngʼadonegi bura kaluwore gi chikegi. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, kaluwore gi gik moko duto makare mitimo, yie iwe bedo gi mirima kod gero gi Jerusalem dalani maduongʼ kendo godi maler. Richowa gi timbe mamono mag kwerewa osemiyo Jerusalem kod jogi obedo joma ijaro gi jogo modak mokiewo kodwa.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

kikuyu: “Kik uwe jajwok madhako bed mangima.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

kikuyu: In ema ne ipogo nam e diere ariyo gi tekoni, kendo ne itoyo wiye ondiek marach ei pi.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

kikuyu: Eka chokruok mangima duto nochungo kendo negitere ir Pilato.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

kikuyu: Negigero kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep gi yiend siala ka borne madhi malo romo fut angʼwen gi nus; to lachne kod borne romo fut abiriyo gi nus maromre.
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

kikuyu: Donge Israel ema ne ijaro? Bende nomake e dier jokwoge, ma itengʼone wiyi gi achaya sa moro amora miwuoyo kuome?
english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

kikuyu: To Omri notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo notimo richo mathoth moloyo joma notelo ne.
english: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jolwenygi noweyo joma negimako kaachiel gi mwandu mane gipeyo ka gin e nyim jotelo kod joma nochokore duto.
english: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.

kikuyu: Koro chiew gokinyi in kaachiel gi jotich ruodhi mane obiro kodi mondo umond udhi ka piny yawore.”
english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

kikuyu: Omiyo pokni nowene joka Manase mane odongʼ, kaka, anywola mar Abiezer, Helek Asriel, Shekem, Hefer, kod Shemida. Magi e nyikwa Manase ma wuod Josef mamoko machwo kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

kikuyu: Kar romb chwo mane ochiemo ne gin ji alufu abich.
english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

kikuyu: Mano kaka pachi tutna, yaye Nyasaye! Mano kaka gingʼeny mokalo akwana kargi duto!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kikuyu: Chiengʼno ok unukwaya gimoro amora. Awachonu adier ni Wuora biro miyou gimoro amora mukwayo e nyinga.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

kikuyu: Ruodh Misri ne ok owuok kendo e pinye nikech ruodh Babulon nokawo tongʼ mage duto chakre Wadi manie piny Misri nyaka e Aora Yufrate.
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Solomon niya, “Wuoda naparo e chunya mondo ager ot miluongo gi Nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasacha.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

kikuyu: Bende nyaka ichok jolweny marom gi mago mane wawito farese kar farese mane walalo kod geche kar geche mane walalo eka mondo waked gi Israel e pewe. Eka adier wanabed matek moloyogi.” Noyie kodgi motimo kaka owinjore.
english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

kikuyu: Nowachone jo-Lawi mane osepwodhi ni Jehova Nyasaye mondo opuonj jo-Israel duto niya, “Keturu Sanduku Maler e hekalu mane Solomon wuod Daudi ruodh Israel nogero. Ok onego utingʼe e goku. Omiyo tineuru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo ni joge Israel.
english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel.

kikuyu: Omiyo Benaya wuod Jehoyada nodhi monego Joab kendo noyike mana e lope e thim.
