english: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Mad rembe bed ewi Joab gi ewi dhood wuon-gi duto! Mad e dhood Joab kik bedi ni onge ngʼama nigi adhola machwer kata ja-dhoho kata ngʼama wuotho gi luth kata ngʼama inego gi ligangla kata ngʼama ochando chiemo.”
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, anawitu oko mar pinyni nyaka e piny ma un kata wuoneu ok osengʼeyo, kendo kanyo unutine nyiseche moko manono odiechiengʼ gi otieno, nimar ok anangʼwon-nu.’ ”
english: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

kikuyu: Paro manie chunyu nyaka bed machal gi paro mane Kristo Yesu nigo.
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Daudi nopogo jo-Lawi e migepe kaluwore gi yawuot Lawi ma gin Gershon, Kohath kod Merari.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Lochni nogur chon gi lala; ionge chakruokni kata gikoni.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

kikuyu: Mad cham bed mangʼeny e piny duto, bende gikwak nyaka wi godo matindo duto. Mad olembene ol mathoth ka Lebanon, kendo mad onyagi ka lum manie pap.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

kikuyu: (Emomiyo nochak odiechiengego ni Purim kaluwore gi nying ombulu miluongo ni pur.) Nikech gik moko duto mondiki e baruwani kendo nikech gik moko mane gineno kod mane otimorenegi,
english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar aboro negichokore nikech negisepwodho kendo mar misango kuom ndalo abiriyo kendo sawo bende kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

kikuyu: Jou ema nochak oger kuondeu mane omukore, kendo gini gedi ewi mise machon mane oketi, mi noluongi ni Jager Ohinga mane Omukore kendo ni Jalos Yore Matindo mane ji odakie.
english: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.

kikuyu: “Eka ruoth mar milambo noyar ne lweny mondo oked gi ruoth mar nyandwat ma bende nigi oganda maduongʼ mar jolweny, to giko en ni bende noloye.
english: “The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwogi ire, mana ka dhako manoyudo osejwangʼ, kendo ma chunye nigi lit ahinya, en dhako mane okend ka nyako ngili kae to bangʼe ojwangʼ,” Nyasachi ema owacho mano.
english: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi bilo muritorugo mamiyo uketo ngima ji e chandruok mana ka winy mochik gobadho, kendo abiro yudhogi oko e lwetu, mi agony joma usemako otony ka winyo.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

kikuyu: Ere kaka ngʼato achiel nyalo riembo ji alufu achiel, kata ji ariyo miyo ji alufu apar ringi, makmana ka ok Jehova Nyasaye ma Lwandagi ema oweyogi mi oketogi e lwet wasikgi.
english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

kikuyu: E odiechiengno, ruodh piny nyaka chiw rwath kaka misango mogologo richone owuon kod richo ji duto modak e pinye.
english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Jores noidhi ewi got mar Sayun, mi ginibed kod loch ewi gode mag Esau, kendo pinyruoth duto nobed e lwet Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.

kikuyu: En angʼo momiyo ne usiko ka uoyo maj jokwath mondo omi uwinj ka jokwath liyo ni rombe? To e gwenge mag Reuben ne nitiere nono chuny matut.
english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.

kikuyu: “Ngʼe ni aseyiero Bezalel wuod Uri, ma wuod Hur, maa e dhood Juda,
english: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: Dilean, Mizpa, Jokthel,
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

kikuyu: En yadh ngima ne jogo morwake; jogo mopadore kuome biro yudo gweth.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi ir jotelo man loka aora Yufrate mi amiyogi barupe ruoth. Ruoth noora gi jotend jolweny kod jolweny makedo koidho farese.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

kikuyu: Jowete nooro Paulo e dho nam ma ok odeko, ka Sila gi Timotheo to jodong Berea.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

kikuyu: Ngʼat matiyo e puothe biro bedo gi chiemo mogundho, to ngʼat mabayo abaya onge gi rieko.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, jatich machielo bende nobiro mowacho niya, “Yawuoti gi nyigi ne jochiemo kendo metho e od owadgi maduongʼ,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: Eka janabi Hanania nogolo jok e ngʼut janabi Jeremia kendo oture,
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

kikuyu: Chunya gombo kendo njawni ka agombo bedo e od Jehova Nyasaye; Chunya gi denda duto wer gi mor ne Nyasaye mangima.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

kikuyu: Mago e weche mwawuoyo kuomgi, ka ok wakonyre gi weche mopuonjwa gi rieko dhano, to wakonyore gi weche ma Roho ema opuonjo, kwalero adiera mag chuny gi weche mag chuny.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

kikuyu: To donge Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura kare ni joge moyier, maywakne odiechiengʼ gi otieno? Bende obiro tamore ma ok owinjogi?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

kikuyu: Jamni matin mane in-go kapok abiro osemedore ahinya, kendo Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhi e gik moko duto ma asetimo. To koro anatine oda awuon karangʼo?”
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

kikuyu: “Omiyo kik uluorgi. Onge gimoro mopandi ma ok nofweny, kata malingʼ-lingʼ ma ok nongʼere.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Ne giywak giduol maduongʼ kagiwacho niya, “Warruok oa kuom Nyasachwa mobedo e kom duongʼ mar loch kendo oa kuom Nyarombo.”
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

kikuyu: Jotend jotich duto mag ruoth, kaachiel gi jochik jotich, gi jorit pinje, gi jongʼad rieko kod jotend jorit pinje osewinjore ni ruoth onego ogol chik, kendo one ni chikno otiyo, mondo ngʼato angʼata molamo nyasaye moro amora kata dhano moro amora kuom ndalo piero adek mabiro, ma ok in, yaye ruoth, to mondo obol e bur sibuoche.
english: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

kikuyu: Negibuoro e pewe mag Moab mokiewo gi Jordan chakre Beth Jeshimoth nyaka Abel Shitim.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

kikuyu: Nimar iduongʼ kendo itimo timbe miwuoro; in e Nyasaye kende.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamiyo jochan ok nochand gimoro, to ngʼat ma gengʼo wangʼe ne jochan noyud kwongʼ mangʼeny.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni, onge kata ngʼato achiel kuom jogo mane oluongi manobil chiemba.’ ”
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

kikuyu: Gath, Maresha, Zif,
english: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

kikuyu: ‘Kuom mano, dichwo nowe wuon kod min kendo nopadre gi chiege,
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

kikuyu: Kendo kik upar e kindu uwegi ni, ‘Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.’ Awachonu ni kata mana kuom kitegi Nyasaye nyalo loko nyithind Ibrahim.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

kikuyu: Magi e nying-gi: Ben-Hur norito pinje mag gode mag Efraim:
english: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

kikuyu: “Tach joma timbegi richo osenegi; kendo mae oseweyo liel.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

kikuyu: Jorito mag Saulo mane ni Gibea ei Benjamin noneno ka jolweny jo-Filistia ringo koni gi koni.
english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

kikuyu: E ndalogo od Juda biro riwore gi od Israel, kendo giduto ginibi ka gia e piny ma yo nyandwat nyaka e piny mane amiyo kwereu kaka girkeni.
english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

kikuyu: Unudag ka ukia gima biro timorenu; ka un gilworo odiechiengʼ kod otieno, ka ukia gima biro timore ne ngimau.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin duto mane oneg odiechiengno ne gin jolweny marahuma alufu piero ariyo gabich.
english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

kikuyu: To yie itimna ngʼwono mana machal gi ngʼwono mosiko mar Jehova Nyasaye e ndalo duto mag ngimana, mondo kik nega,
english: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of the LORD while I still live, that I not die;

kikuyu: Migiuru duongʼ ahinya kendo hergiuru moloyo nikech tich ma gitimo. Daguru gi kwe e kindu.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

kikuyu: Nolwaro ringʼo piny kuomgi ka buru, adier, winy mafuyo nolwar kuomgi ka kwoyo manie dho nam.
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

kikuyu: Japecho pimo bao gi tol kendo oketo kido kuome; opaye gi koyo; kendo ogoro kuonde modwaro loso. Olose e kido machalo gi dhano, e kido mar dhano gi duongʼne duto, mondo omi ochunge e od lemo.
english: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

kikuyu: En owuon ema obiro waro jo-Israel kuom richogi duto.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

kikuyu: Pwodhgi gi adierani, nikech Wachni en adiera.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

kikuyu: mokawo miech Juda mochiel motegno mobiro nyaka Jerusalem.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi weche mamoko mag lochne kod teko, to gi gik moko mane olwore gi jo-Israel kod loch jopinje mamoko.
english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mana kaka Nyasaye noketho Sodom gi Gomora, kaachiel gi mier mokiewo kodgi, e kaka en bende nobedi maonge ngʼato angʼata, modak kanyo kendo.
english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

kikuyu: “To puonjreuru wachni kuom yiend ngʼowu. Mapiyo ka bedene chako loth kendo itgi chako wuok to ungʼeyo ni ndalo oro chiegni.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

kikuyu: Abisalom nodak Jerusalem kuom higni ariyo kapok osudo machiegni but ruoth.
english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

kikuyu: Un to Roho mane Kristo omiyou osewirou, omiyo ok uchando ngʼat mapuonjou. To kaka Roho museyudono puonjou kuom gik moko duto, kendo dak ma Roho odak godo e iwu en adiera ma ok miriambo mana kaka osepuonjouno, sikuru kuome.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

kikuyu: Joma odhier ubiro bedogo kinde duto to an ok ubi siko ka un koda ndalo duto.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

kikuyu: Ok dineg joma onge ketho machal gi joma oketho, adier ok inyal timo kamano nikech kaponi itimo kamano to joma onge ketho diyud kum mana maromre gi joma nigi ketho. To mano ok nyalre nikech jangʼad bura nyaka ngʼad bura kare?”
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

kikuyu: “Kata ka dibed ni nitie dhako man-gi silinge mamingli apar, to achiel olalne. Donge domok taya, kendo yweyo ot, ka omanye maber mondo omi oyude?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

kikuyu: Ka pod an e piny, to an e ler mar piny.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Jachien machal kama inyalo golo mana kuom lamo kod tweyo chiemo.”
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: E sa nogo piny noyiengni matek, mi achiel kuom apar mar bath dalano nomukore mogore piny, kendo ji alufu abiriyo notho e yiengni mar pinyno to joma nodongʼ nobwok malich, kendo negimiyo Nyasach Polo duongʼ!
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Jadolo mochiwo misangono nyaka chame kama ler mar lemo, ma nitie e laru mar Hemb Romo.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Negiwachonegi niya, “Ka uyie kodwa, to miwauru pinyni wasumbiniu obed marwa mondo kik wakadh wadhi loka Jordan.”
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Kik ibed ngʼama timbene mono ahinya kata ngʼama ofuwo, nimar angʼo momiyo idwaro ni itho ka ndaloni pok ochopo?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia:
english: The LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: E bath aore mag Babulon ne wabet piny kendo ne waywak kane waparo Sayun.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: Joricho dwaro gik moyaki mag jogo mamono, to tiend joma kare kelo mwandu.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

kikuyu: Harun gi yawuote nocham modongʼ, to nyaka gichame ma ok oketie thowi e kama ler mar lemo; kendo ginichame e laru mar Hemb Romo.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ka Timotheo obiro iru, neuru ni obedo kodu kaonge gima oluoro, nikech otiyo ni Ruoth, mana kaka an.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

kikuyu: Nomedo wachonegi niya, “Timuru kamano kendo mine gitimo kamano kendo.” Eka nogolo chik kowacho niya, “Timeuru mar adek” mine gitime mar adek.
english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

kikuyu: “Kwan ogendini mag jo-Israel duto kaluwore gi anywolagi, mago mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime manyalo bedo jolweny e Israel.”
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ka ok uwinja kendo uluwo chikena, ma aseketo e nyimu,
english: You shall tell them, “The LORD says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,

kikuyu: to bangʼ mano higni abiriyo moko nobedie mag kech kendo wi ji nowil gi higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo e piny Misri, kendo kech noketh piny.
english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

kikuyu: Jaote marach donjo e chandruok, to jaote modimbore kelo konyruok.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

kikuyu: Eka Mikal nogolo Daudi gie dirisa, mine oringo motony.
english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

kikuyu: Par wachni mane iwacho ne jatichni, nimar isemiya geno.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowacho niya, “Kik utame, nimar ngʼat ma ok mon kodu en jakoru.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

kikuyu: Kinyne ne wawuok kanyo mi wachopo Kaisaria, kendo ne wabet e od Filipo jayalo, mane en achiel kuom jokony abiriyo.
english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

kikuyu: Bende Jehova Nyasaye osekumo Israel kaka nokumo joma nosandogi? Bende osenego Israel kaka nonego joma ne onegogi?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

kikuyu: Kik udhi e puothe kata uwuothie yore, nimar jasigu nigi ligangla, kendo nitie luoro kamoro amora.
english: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima nondiki: mene, mene, tekel, parsin.
english: “This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu nodonjo e ot moro to oganda maduongʼ nochokore kanyo kendo ma kata mana thuolo mar chiemo gi jopuonjrene ne ok onyal yudo.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny marito ruoth nokawo besen, gima iwangʼoe ubani, tewni mag kwoyo remo, agulni, rachung taya, dise kod bakunde mitiyogo e misango miolo piny, ma gin gik moko duto molos gi dhahabu maler kata fedha.
english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat mariek odhiyo gi ngʼat mofuwo e od bura, to ngʼat mofuwo goyo koko kendo jero, kendo kwe bedo maonge.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kikuyu: Kaifas e ngʼama noyudo osengʼado rieko ni jo-Yahudi ni ber mondo ngʼato achiel otho ni ji duto.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Tera nosedak higni piero abiriyo nonywolo Abram, Nahor kod Haran.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel gi Abisalom nojot e piny Gilead.
english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: Eka iket ei Sandug Muma kite mopa mag chike ma abiro miyi.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

kikuyu: Jo-Nineve biro chungʼ e bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadnegi bura kaka joketho; nimar gin ne giweyo richo kane giwinjo yalo mar Jona, to sani koro nitie ngʼato maduongʼ moloyo Jona.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Ket gimoro amora mitimo e lwet Jehova Nyasaye, to chenrogi biro dhi maber.
english: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

kikuyu: Eka Rebeka kod jotije ma nyiri noikore moidho ngamia-gi mi gidhi gi jatich Ibrahim. Kuom mano jatich Ibrahim nokawo Rebeka kendo gidhi.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

kikuyu: Ne omiye kit gedo duto mag laru mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye to gi udi molwore kod mago mag keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo kuonde keno mag gik mopwodhi mana kaka Roho mar Nyasaye noketo e pache.
english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

kikuyu: Gigi duto usetimo ka an to alingʼ; useparo ni an bende achalo kodu. To koro akwerou kendo anyisou e wangʼu ni useketho kuom timo gigo duto.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

kikuyu: nono ka gimetho to wigi diwil gi gima chik ochiko, ma gihiny joma ok nyal ka gitamogi e ratichgi.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ gilando wach; otieno kotieno ginyiso rieko.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Josef nooro wach mondo okelne Jakobo wuon mare kaachiel gi wedene duto, mane romo kar kwan ji piero abiriyo gabich.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane odongʼ e pinyno koa kuom jo-Hiti, gi jo-Amor kod jo-Perizi, gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus (ogendinigi ne ok jo-Israel),
english: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

kikuyu: “Nyisuru nyar Sayun niya, ‘Nee, Ruodhi biro iri, obiro komuol, kendo koidho kanyna; koidho kanyna matin, adier en mana nyathi punda.’”
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

kikuyu: ‘Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, aa malo ibi kari mar yweyo, in kaachiel gi Sandug Muma ma en kido mar tekoni.
english: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

kikuyu: To ka ringʼo kata makati mopwodhgigo odongʼ nyaka okinyi, to nyaka wangʼe. Ok owinjore chame nikech en gima ler.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ne nitie ongo moro machielo maduongʼ ma bwombene otegno kendo opongʼ gi yier. Yiend mzabibuno koro tiendene ne lak koa kamane opidhe kochome kendo bedene bende nochako yarore kochome mondo oyud pi.
english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

kikuyu: Asetimo kodi singruok, yaye Nyasaye; abiro chiwoni chiwo maga mag erokamano.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

kikuyu: Eka nawacho niya, “Tweneuru kilemba maler e wiye.” Omiyo ne gitweyone kilemba maler e wiye mi girwakone lewni, ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye ochungʼ e bathgi.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.

kikuyu: Chongena onyosore nikech onge gima acham, kendo adhero alokora choke lilo.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

kikuyu: Mefibosheth nokulore piny mowacho niya, “An mana misumbani, ngʼat machalo gi guok motho, to angʼo momiyo itimona maber kama?”
english: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

kikuyu: Eli nowinjo nduru mopenjo niya, “Nduru magoreni nyiso angʼo?” Ngʼatno noreto piyo kodhi ir Eli ma hike
english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mutimo kata ma uwacho, to timuru e nying Ruoth Yesu, kugoyo erokamano ni Nyasaye Wuoro e nying Yesu.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

kikuyu: Nyaka sani pok ukwayo gimoro amora e nyinga. Kwauru to nomiu, eka nubed mamor chuth.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik, mi joma nohango ne Daniel wach nokel nobol e bur sibuoche, kaachiel gi mondgi gi nyithindgi. To sibuoche nongamogi gi ewi yamo kapok gichopo piny, kendo noturo chokegi duto matindo tindo.
english: The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions—them, their children, and their wives; and the lions mauled them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they came to the bottom of the den.

kikuyu: Singruok mokwongo ne nigi chike matayo lemo kaachiel gi kama ler mar lemo e piny-ka.
english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

kikuyu: “Koro jawuoth moro nobiro ir jamoko-cha, to jamokono ne ok okawo achiel kuom rombe kata dhoge mondo oyangʼ ni jawuodhno mane obiro ireno. Kata kamano, nyarombo ma sibini mar jadhierno ema noyangʼone wendo mane obiro ire.”
english: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okwayi gimoro to miyeuru, kendo kik ilok kiti ne ngʼat madwaro ni ihole gimoro.
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya: Ewi goda maler, ma en got mabor mar Israel, kendo e piny nogono, dhood Israel duto kar rombgi biro tiyonae, kendo kanyo ema anarwakgie. Kanyo ema anadwarie chiwo mau kod mich mau mabeyo moloyo, kaachiel gi misengni mau duto maler.
english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

kikuyu: Koro wan duto mwaonge gi ragengʼ e wengewa wachalo gi rangʼi kendo wamiyo ler mar ruoth nenore ratiro kendo lerno medore ameda pile ka kitwa medo bedo machal kode; mano en tich Ruoth ma en Roho.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

kikuyu: Koro noyudo Elisha obet e ode ka en gi jodonge. Ruoth nooro jootene motelo e nyime, to kane pok ochopo, Elisha nowachone jodonge niya, “Donge uneno ka koro janekni oro ngʼato mondo obi onega? Winjuru, ka jaote ochopo, to ulor dhoot matek ma kik odonji, nimar ruodhe luwo bangʼe machiegni.”
english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

kikuyu: E seche mane gin-gi ilo mathothno, negigoyo koko niya, “Keluru Samson mondo omielnwa.” Omiyo negigolo Samson oko mar od twech, mi omielnegi. Kane oyudo gichunge e kind sirni,
english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;

kikuyu: Asebedo ka ayiengora kuomi nyaka ne nywola; in ema ne igola ei minwa. Abiro apaki nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

kikuyu: Usiko uwuoyo marach kuom joweteu kendo ukuotho koda ka oweteu mahie ma uago e ich achiel.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

kikuyu: Eka nangʼigi kendo nachik ita ni lemo molam ka.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

kikuyu: To kane thuol mangʼongono oneno ni osewite modire e piny, ne olawo dhako mane onywolo nyathi ma wuowi cha.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

kikuyu: Thedhne ratege angʼwen molworore mag dhahabu machalo gi bangli kendo twegi e tiendene angʼwen-go, ka ratege ariyo bedo e bathe konchiel to ariyo mamoko e bathe komachielo.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

kikuyu: “Bende ingʼeyo kinde ma diek manie got nywolie? Bende iseneno gi wangʼi ka ngao nywolo nyathine?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

kikuyu: Kane Rael oneno nine ok nywolne Jakobo nyithindo, nyiego nomake gi nyamin mare. Kuom mano nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Miya nyithindo, nono to abiro tho!”
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gabiriyo mar loch Joash ruodh Juda, Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz nobedo ruodh Israel ka en piny Samaria kendo nobedo ruoth kuom higni apar gauchiel.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

kikuyu: kendo noluwo bangʼ ja-Israelno nyaka e hema. Nochwowogi duto moriwogi gi tongʼ. Eka tho mane osenego jo-Israel norumo;
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼinjore matindo tindo mana ka agulu molwar piny motore, ma ok nyal yud kata dire moro kodongʼ minyalo kwanygo mach e dwol kata pate mitwomogo pi.”
english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

kikuyu: Kaka ne anyisi mondo itim kane an e wuodha madhiyo Makedonia, adwaro mondo imed bedo Efeso nikech jomoko ni kuno mapuonjo ji puonj mag miriambo manyaka ikwergi mondo giwe timo kamano.
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

kikuyu: Mano kaka usengʼado rieko ne ngʼama onge gi rieko ka an kama, kendo uyie puonjo ngʼama ofuwo ka an kama!
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jachan ywak kokwayo ngʼwono, to ngʼat ma jamoko dwoko gi gero.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane oyudo ochiemo kodgi, nowachonegi niya, “Kik uwuog Jerusalem, to rituru mich mane Wuonwa osingore ni nomiu, ma usewinja ka awuoyo kuome;
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

kikuyu: Mon madhoth notedo nyithindgi giwegi, mobedo chiembgi ka joga ne inego itieko.
english: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

kikuyu: Ubiro chiemo to ok unuyiengʼ; unusik mana ka udenyo. Unukan gik moko to ok ginikonyu, nikech gik mukano nachiwne jowasiku.
english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro riembou, to ruoth ma unuyier notelnu noteru e lwet piny ma kata kwereu ne ok ongʼeyo. Kuno unulamie nyiseche mamoko, ma gin nyiseche mopa gi yien kod kite.
english: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

kikuyu: “Omiyo mad wasikgi duto rum, yaye Jehova Nyasaye! To mad joma oheri chal gi chiengʼ, mawuok gi teko.” Bangʼ mano piny Israel nobedo gi kwe kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: “So let all your enemies perish, LORD, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.

kikuyu: E sechego noyudo Saulo duogo koa e puodho ka owuotho bangʼ rwethe eka nopenjo ni, Angʼo marach gi ji? Angʼo momiyo giywak? Eka negiwachone kendo weche mane jo-jabesh owacho.
english: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

kikuyu: Nimar duongʼ ok nyal medore ne ngʼato koa wuok chiengʼ kata podho chiengʼ kata e thim.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

kikuyu: Ochayo le duto mokawore ni lich; en ruodh le duto ma ji oluoro.”
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

kikuyu: mondo oked gi Kedorlaomer ruodh Elam, Tidal ruodh Goyim, Amrafel ruodh Shinar kod Ariok ruodh Elasar mi ruodhi angʼwen-go nokedo gi ruodhi abich.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

kikuyu: Onge nyasaye moro amora e dier nyiseche machalo kodi, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye; onge timbe minyalo pimo gi magi.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mond Sayun sungore kendo kawore, gingʼayo ngʼutgi malo, kendo giningʼo wengegi. Bende giwuotho ka gingʼadore, ka gara manie tiendgi ywak.
english: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

kikuyu: Magi e yawuot Daudi mane onywolo ka en Hebron: Amnon wuode makayo wuod Ahinoam nyar Jezreel, mar ariyo ne en Daniel wuod Abigael nyar Karmel;
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

kikuyu: Nyis oganda duto mar Israel ni odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dweni, ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka gol achiel kuom nyirombe ne joode, nyarombo achiel ne ot ka ot.
english: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

kikuyu: Chenro mar ngʼat makare nikare, to puonj mar joricho en wuondruok.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

kikuyu: “Land wachni e piny Misri, kendo igo milome e Migdol; Memfis gi Tapanhes ni: ‘Kawuru kereu kendo ikreuru, nimar ligangla nego jogo molwori.’
english: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’

kikuyu: “Bende inyalo mako nyangʼ miluongo ni Leviathan gi olowu kata tweyo lewe gi tol?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ kendo lamuru mondo kik udonj e tem. Chuny oikore makmana ringruok to nyap.”
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Nikech chandruok mantie sani, aparo ni ber mondo usik kaka uchal.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

kikuyu: Gotienono Belshazar ruodh jo-Babulon nonegi,
english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

kikuyu: Abner ne owuoyo gi jo-Benjamin en owuon. Eka ne odhi Hebron mondo onyis Daudi weche duto ma jo-Israel gi dhood Benjamin duto ne dwa timo.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

kikuyu: “Ma e singruok ma anatim gi dhood jo-Israel bangʼ ndalogo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Abiro keto chikena e pachgi kendo ndikogi e chunygi. Anabed Nyasachgi kendo ginibed joga.
english: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the LORD: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

kikuyu: Eka nowinjo dwol moro kawachone niya, “Petro, aa malo, mondo ineg gimoro kuom gigo icham.”
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

kikuyu: “Nachako aneno e lek wiye cham abiriyo mochiek maber kadongʼ e tiangʼ achiel.
english: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

kikuyu: To ne gionge gima digiwachi.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

kikuyu: Nimar wach ruoth nigi teko, en ngʼa manyalo wachone niya, “Angʼo ma itimo?”
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

kikuyu: Ka en kamano, to ngʼama noluongou ji ariyogi ka, biro wachoni ni, ‘Mi jali komi.’ Kamano eka wiyi nokuodi nyaka inidhi ikaw kom kar bet man chien moloyo.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

kikuyu: Kinde duto mane jo-Israel odhi kedo, lwet Jehova Nyasaye ne kelonegi chandruok, mana kaka ne osekwongʼorenigi, kendo ne gin e chandruok maduongʼ.
english: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

kikuyu: Gisekawo nyi joma ok jo-Yahudi, makoro odak e pinygi, kendo yawuotgi bende gisekendonegi nyi jogo. Kamano, oganda maler mar Nyasaye osedwanyore gi joma ok jo-Yahudi. To jotelo gi jodongo ema osebedo joketho moloyoe jomoko.”
english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oyudo nyako ngili e dala matin ma osetimo winjruok mar kend kod ngʼat machielo ma oterore kode,
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo kaka Nyasaye chiko boche polo kendo kaka omiyo polo mil?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

kikuyu: Kamano Josef notho ka en ja-higni mia achiel kod apar. Kendo bangʼ kane gisewiro ringre gi yath, negikete e sanduku e piny Misri kuno.
english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osechiko, ‘Kaw mana moromo ngʼato achiel chamo kendo kane ni tienge mabiro mondo gine Makati mane amiyou uchamo e thim kane agolou e piny Misri.’ ”
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Gideon nodhi, moyangʼo nyadiel kendo otedo, bangʼe nokawo mogo madirom kilo piero ariyo gariyo mi olosogo makati ma ok oketie thowi koketo ringʼo e adita kod kate e tawo, nokelogi oko kendo ochiwogi ne Jehova Nyasaye e tiend yiend ober.
english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼeuru ni onge wach ma Jehova Nyasaye osewacho ewi od Ahab ma ok nochop kare. Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gima ne osingo kokalo kuom jatichne Elija.”
english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD’s word, which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

kikuyu: Nochikogi kama, Nyaka uti tijeu gi adiera kendo gi chunyu duto ka uluoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

kikuyu: Chunya winjo malit e iya kendo luoro mar tho osemaka.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, winj gima Jehova Nyasaye osechano timo ne Edom, gima oseramo ni nyaka otimne joma odak Teman: Nyithi rombe bende nokaw; enoketh chuth kuondegi mag kwath nikech gin.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

kikuyu: Bende chwe bathe ma lachne romo gi pat lwedo achiel kendo ichwe dir batheno gi dhahabu.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

kikuyu: Sa asaya mane iluwo chiayo madhako, Jakobo ne keto ketego ei karaya mane gimodhoe mondo omi imbe oluwgi kanyo mi gimak ich,
english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

kikuyu: Kane ochopo machiegni gi bur sibuoche, noluongo Daniel gi dwol maduongʼ ka chunye parore niya, “Daniel, jatij Nyasaye Mangima, bende Nyasachi mitiyone ndalo duto oseresi e dho sibuochego?”
english: When he came near to Daniel in the den, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?”

kikuyu: Ne aorone dwoko niya, “Gima iwachono ok en adier; mano iparo mana gi pachi owuon.”
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

kikuyu: Musa nogolo lep Harun mi orwako ne wuode ma Eliazar. Kendo Harun notho ewi godno. Eka Musa kod Eliazar nolor oa ewi got,
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gabich mar Amazia wuod Joash ruodh Juda, Jeroboam wuod Jehoash ruodh Israel nobedo ruodh Samaria kendo nobedo ruoth kuom higni piero angʼwen gachiel.
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

kikuyu: To ok mano kende, to wanamor bende kuom chandruok mwayudo, nikech wangʼeyo ni chandruok kelo kinda,
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

kikuyu: Parono ne aneno kaber omiyo ne ayiero ji apar gariyo kuomu ka ngʼato ka ngʼato oa e dhoodgi.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

kikuyu: Asebedo kodi kuonde duto misedhiye, kendo asetieko wasiki duto e nyimi. Koro abiro miyo nyingi bed kaka humb jomadongo manie piny.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

kikuyu: Jonathan ne idho got kokonyore gi lwetene gi tiendene, to jatingʼ gige lwenje luwo bangʼe. Jo-Filistia nopodho e nyim Jonathan, ka jatingʼ gige lwenje luwo bangʼe kendo negogi.
english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

kikuyu: Magi e joma Daudi noketo mondo ochungʼ ne weche mag wer e od Jehova Nyasaye bangʼ kane osekel Sandug Muma kanyo.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

kikuyu: kaponi asetimo marach ni ngʼama onge koda gi wach kata kapo ni asemayo wasika kaonge gima omiyo,
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

kikuyu: Min Yesu gi nyamin min-gi, gi Maria ma chi Kiliopa kod Maria ma aa Magdala nochungʼ but msalaba.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

kikuyu: Cham moko ok din gi twor to bende kal ok wuothie wiye gi gari; moko to idino gi luth kendo kal itengʼo gi kede.
english: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

kikuyu: Wan magi kochakore chon to ok isebedo ruodhgi, to bende ok oseluong-gi gi nyingi.
english: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.

kikuyu: Jogo mane gin jothum kod jotelo mag dhood Lawi ne odak e ute mag hekalu kendo ne ok omigi tije mamoko nikech gin ema negirito tich odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo bor momanyore gi laru manie tok hekalu, kaachiel gi lach mar kor udi mane ni e bethene koni gi koni; moyudo ni oromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich. Laru maduongʼ gi kama ler mar lemo kod agola mangʼiyore gi laru,
english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

kikuyu: Winj gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Chungʼ malo, ket kwayoni e nyim gode; thuche mondo owinj wach ma in-go.
english: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ne dwarore mondo kido mag gig polo opwodhi gi misengini machalo kamago, to kata kamano gig polo hie to dwaro misengini mabeyo moloyo magi.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

kikuyu: Koa yo podho chiengʼ nochiko Marala mochopo nyaka Dabesheth, kendo oyarore kochomo holo matut mantiere but Jokneam.
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

kikuyu: Nochako ooro jatichne machielo irgi, to en bende ne gindayo wiye kendo timone tim wichkuot.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

kikuyu: Nikech aparo kuom yie mar adier ma in-go. Yienino chalo gi yie mane Lois dani nigo mokwongo. Kendo mane Yunike minu nigo. An gi ratiro ni in bende in gi yie makamano
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

kikuyu: Abiro golou gi tekona duto gi mirimba mager e dier ogendini ka ua e pinje duto mosekeue.
english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.

kikuyu: mana kaka ondiki ni: “Bed mamor, in dhako ma migumba, in ma ok inywol nyithindo; tingʼ dwondi malo ka igoyo koko gi ilo, in mane muoch ok okayi; nimar dhako ma migumba nobed gi nyithindo mangʼeny, moloyo dhako man-gi dichwo.”
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

kikuyu: Chik achielno ema nyaka tigo ka rwadh ochwowo nyathi ma wuowi kata ma nyako
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

kikuyu: To eka pod nogolo chik ne kor polo malo kendo noyawo dhoudi mag polo;
english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

kikuyu: “Kwongʼruok kata singruok moro amora ma dhako ma chwore otho kata dhako ma mowere gi chwore otimo nosiki.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

kikuyu: Magi e chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa ewi Got Sinai ne jo-Israel.
english: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Kane Abimelek owinjo nine gisechokore kanyo,
english: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osebet kodgi kuom ndalo aboro kata apar, nolor odhi Kaisaria, eka kinyne nochoko bura mogolo chik mondo okel Paulo e nyime.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

kikuyu: Hadad bende ne otho. Jodong Edom ne gin: Timna, Alva, Jetheth
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: to e ndalo mogikgi osewuoyo kodwa kokalo kuom Wuode owuon. Wuodeno ema oseketo mwandune duto e lwete, kendo en ema nochweyo gik moko duto kuome.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

kikuyu: Jesse noketo yawuote abiriyo okadho e nyim Samuel mi Samuel nowachone ni onge ngʼama Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero kuomgi.
english: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “The LORD has not chosen these.”

kikuyu: Ka jo-Yahudi duto man Moab, Amon, Edom kod pinje mamoko nowinjo ni ruodh Babulon noweyo joma notony ei Juda kendo noyiero Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, kaka jatendgi,
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,

kikuyu: mondo wayal Injili e pinje maboyo moyombo thuru. Nikech ok wadwar pakore kuom tich ma ngʼat machielo ema otimo e kare mar tich.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ne ukawo nyiseche mane aloso, kod jadolo matiyona kendo mi uwuok. En angʼo kendo makoro an-go? Ere kaka unyalo penjo, ‘En angʼo marach kodi?’ ”
english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”

kikuyu: kendo tongʼ piny mar Kanaan nochakore Sidon kadhi Gerar nyaka Gaza kendo kadhi Sodom, Gomora, Adma kod Zeboim nyaka Lasha.)
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

kikuyu: Negikawo bede othidhe mi giwuok oko mondo giromne, ka gikok niya, “Hosana!” “Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye!” “Ogwedh Ruodh Israel!”
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nochike niya, “Kik inyis ngʼato wachni to dhiyo, mondo inyisri ne jadolo kendo ichiw misengini ma Musa nochiko nikech pwodhruokni, mondo obed ranyisi ne gin.”
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Bende nyaka ikaw jatend dhoot ka dhoot mondo okonyi e tijno.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ lochni, pinyruoth moro machielo nobi, ma lochne ok nobed maduongʼ ka mari. Bangʼ mano pinyruoth molos gi nyinyo nobed gi loch ewi piny duto.
english: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

kikuyu: Wach ne rieko niya, “In e nyaminwa,” to luong ngʼeyo tiend wach ni watni;
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

kikuyu: Un joma odak Maresha, abiro ketou e lwet wasiku mabiro loyou. Ruodh Israel biro pondo e rogo man Adulam.
english: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

kikuyu: Lamuru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kendo anagwedhu gi chiemo kod pi. Anatiek tuoche kuomu,
english: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni asemayo ngʼato puothe mi apuro,
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

kikuyu: Kane girite ma ok giweyone thuolo, negioro jombetre, mane wuondore ni gin jo-adiera maonge wach marach. Negigeno niginyalo mako Yesu e gimoro mowacho mondo omi gimake gitere e bwo loch kod teko mar ruoth.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne gilemo niya, “Ruoth, ingʼeyo chuny ji duto. Nyiswae kuom ji ariyogi ngʼat miseyiero
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho wechegi duto, nowachone jopuonjrene niya,
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Kilo piero adek gangʼwen mar dhahabu maler ema notigo kuom loso rachungi mar taya kod gigene duto.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

kikuyu: Walak mana ka ondiegi kendo wadengo malit mana ka akuru. Wadwaro ngʼado bura makare to ok wayud kata achiel, kendo wamanyo ngʼama reswa to obor kodwa.
english: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka none, kendo ka kama olurono oselandore e del, to enolande kaka ngʼama ogak; nikech en tuo malandore.
english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

kikuyu: To jatend jolweny ne ok odewo chik kata winjo gima Paulo ne owacho, makmana nowinjo mana wach wuon yie kod jatend yie.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

kikuyu: Eka Adonija nochiwo misengini mag rombe gi dhok kod nyiroye machwe ewi kidi mar Zoheleth machiegni gi En Rogel. Nogwelo owetene duto, ma yawuot ruoth kod jodong Juda duto,
english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne adhi nyime nyaka e Dhoranga Thidhia kod Dago mar Ruoth, makmana ne onge thuolo kama farasa ne nyalo kadhogo;
english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

kikuyu: To jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen gi gik mangima angʼwen-go, nopodho piny auma kendo gidendo Nyasaye mane obedo e kom duongʼ mar loch. Ne giywak niya, “Amin! Haleluya!”
english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

kikuyu: Eka negichako jare niya, “Ber Ruodh jo-Yahudi.”
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Magi e migepe mag jorit rangeye: Koa kuom joka Kora, noyier Meshelemia wuod Kore, ma en achiel kuom yawuot Asaf.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to jachul kuor nyalo lawe gi mirima ma juke kakanyo ochwalore, kendo nege kata obedo ni ok owinjore gi tho, nimar notimorene ka ok en-gi paro mar timo mano.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

kikuyu: Oseketho ngima ji mangʼeny, kendo osemiyo ji mathoth mak kwanre otho.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jo-Joab nochungʼ but Amasa mowacho niya, “Ngʼama jakor Joab; kendo moyie gi Daudi mondo oluw bangʼ Joab!”
english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

kikuyu: Ogwetho piny gi mirima gi tekre duto, kendo ogiro gi tekre duto kochomo kar lweny.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo odhiambo, Laban nokawo nyare ma Lea mi omiyo Jakobo mondo obed chiege.
english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

kikuyu: (Jehoyada wuod Benaya kod Abiathar nokawo kar Ahithofel.) Joab to ne jatend jolweny.
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

kikuyu: joma ketho nying ji, joma ochayo Nyasaye, jokwinyo, joma wigi tek, kendo josunga, jogo mapile fwenyo yore manyien mag timo richo; kendo ok giwinj jonywolgi;
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

kikuyu: E ndalo mar chandruokne ruoth Ahaz nomedo weyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.

kikuyu: Wuone kik umi nyithindu bedo gi mirima; to ritgiuru maber, kurieyogi kendo upuonjogi kuom Ruoth.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

kikuyu: Johala mag akuche to nowachonegi niya, “Goluru gigi oko ka! Ngʼa monyisou mondo ulok od Wuora chiro!”
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

kikuyu: ka ok en mana wach achiel mane agoyoe koko ka awacho ni, ‘Iyala kawuono nikech ayie ni joma otho biro chier!’ ”
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

kikuyu: “Yaye Nyasaye, yie itimna mana gik moko ariyogi mondo kik apondni.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

kikuyu: Jogo nowacho niya, “Ma e odiechiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo kuome kowacho ni, ‘Abiro keto jowasiki e lweti mondo itimne kaka idwaro!’ ” Eka Daudi nosudo lingʼ-lingʼ mongʼado riak law Saulo.
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

kikuyu: Ka anyalo wacho ni wiya owil gi gik maricho ma Nyasaye osetimona, to abiro loko pacha mi abed mamor.
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo ruoth gi dhoho nyaka chiengʼ thone, kendo nodak e ot kar kende. Jotham wuod ruoth ema ne rito dala ruoth kendo norito piny.
english: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

kikuyu: Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ e kar konyruoku kendo tekone osiko manyaka chiengʼ. Obiro riembo wasiku duto ka uneno kowacho ni, ‘Tiekgiuru!’
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

kikuyu: To koro ibarori e nam mi isikori piny e chuny pige; mwanduni mag ohala duto kaachiel gi jokwangʼ magi osenimo kodi piny.
english: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno owete ariyo, Simon miluongo ni Petro gi owadgi ma Andrea. Noyudo gibolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Kabon, Lamas, Kitlish,
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

kikuyu: Omiyo osechano thuolo machielo moluongo ni Kawuono, ma en e odiechiengno mane owuoyo kuome bangʼe achien gi dho Daudi, mana kaka waseneno motelo, niya, “Kawuono ka uwinjo dwonde to kik chunyu bed mapek.”
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

kikuyu: To bende Muma wacho niya, “Ka jasiki odenyo, to miye chiemo; ka riyo oloye, to miye gimoro omodhi, ka itimo kamano, ibiro choko chuk mach maliel e wiye.”
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

kikuyu: kik uchan timo marach ni joma ukiewogo, kendo kik uher kwongʼoru gi miriambo. Ok adwar gigi duto,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache nochiwe e lwet ruodh Aram mi jo-Aram noloye kendo nomako joge mangʼeny kaka joma otwe kendo noterogi Damaski. Bende nochiwe e lwet ruodh Israel, mane onego joge mangʼeny.
english: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

kikuyu: Eliasa ne wuon Sismai, Sismai ne wuon Shalum,
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

kikuyu: Omiyo Judas nowito pesago ei hekalu bangʼe oa odhi. Eka nodhi modere.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

kikuyu: Dak ma kamano chalo gi mo ma nengone tek mool e wich kendo mamol piny nyaka e tik, mamol piny koluwo tik Harun kamol piny mos mos nyaka e ngʼut kandhone.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

kikuyu: To jolwenj Babulon nolawogi kendo ojuko Zedekia e pewe mag Jeriko. Negimake mi gitere Ribla e piny Hamath ir Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, kama nongʼadone bura.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

kikuyu: Waduto waseyudo gweth mogundho kuom ngʼwonone mathoth.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

kikuyu: Ji duto modak e piny osenene adier gisenene gi kuma bor.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

kikuyu: Nochako nyasi mar sawo chiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dwe mar aboro machal gi nyasi mar sawo mitimo Juda, mi notimo misengini e kendo mar misango. Ma notimo Bethel kotimo misango ni nyiroye mane oseloso. Kendo bende noketo jodolo Bethel e kuonde motingʼore mane oseloso.
english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

kikuyu: Kendo nying mane ondik e lela wangʼe ne en gima iwuoro: Babulon maduongʼ Min jochode duto kendo min gik makwero mag piny.
english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

kikuyu: Okwongʼ piny ma ruodhe ne en jatich kendo ma jotende mondo e nyasi gokinyi.
english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ngʼat moseluokore onego olwok mana tiendene kende, nimar dende duto ler. Un usedoko maler, makmana ngʼato achiel kuomu kende ema ok ler.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

kikuyu: Dine ok aneno wichkuot nikech aketo chunya e chikeni duto.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kaw wuodi, wuodi ma miderma Isaka, kendo mi ihero mondo idhigo e gwengʼ mar Moria. Chiwe kanyo kaka misango miwangʼo pep ewi got moro ma abiro nyisi.”
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

kikuyu: Koro ok nachak aloknegi ngʼeya, nikech abiro olo Roho mar Nyasaye mara e dhood Israel, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: To Yesu noluongo nyithindo ire kendo nowacho niya, “Weuru nyithindo matindo obi ira, kendo kik utamgi, nikech pinyruoth Nyasaye en mar ji machal ka magi.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Elija nowachone niya, “Kik ibed maluor dhi dala kendo tim kaka isewacho. To mokwongo losna kuon matin kuom gima in-go mondo ikelna eka ilos gimoro ni in kaachiel gi wuodi
english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

kikuyu: Solomon nooro wachne Hiram kowacho niya,
english: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mani ne angʼicho, mi naneno oganda mar ji mangʼeny ma ok kwanre moa e pinje duto gi dhoudi kod ogendini kod dhok duto kochungo e nyim kom duongʼ, kendo e nyim Nyarombo. Negirwako kandhe marochere bende negitingʼo othidhe e lwetgi.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

kikuyu: Bende kaw mogo mar ngano mayom ma ok oketie thowi modwal gi mo mondo ilosgo makati kod kek kaachiel gi chapat mowir gi mo.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat makare mewo, dala maduongʼ bedo mamor, ka joricho otho, to nitie koko mar mor.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

kikuyu: ogwendene nolos gi chuma, to tiendene nolos gi chuma mokikore gi lowo mowangʼ.
english: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar abiriyo beduru gi chokruok mowal. Nyaka utwe chiemo kulamo kendo kik uti tich moro amora.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

kikuyu: Pi noduono e piny mos mos. Bangʼ ndalo mia achiel gi piero abich pi noduono,
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

kikuyu: To Daudi nowacho ni Saulo niya, “Jatichni osebedo kakwayo romb wuon-gi. Ka sibuor kata ondiek omako achiel kuom rombwa,
english: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma utimo, to timuru gi chunyu duto ka gima utimo ni Ruoth to ok ni dhano,
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

kikuyu: “Teko mane ma an-go ma dimi pod abed gi geno? Ber mane ma pod ni e nyima madimi abed mos?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye noyawo holo e Lehi, kendo pi nowuok kanyo. Kane Samson omodhe, tekone noduogo. Omiyo thidhiano nochako ni En Hakore, kendo pod entiere Lehi.
english: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.

kikuyu: Abiro nego kweth mag dhogi duto kamoro amora ma gimodhoe, bangʼe pi ok nochak odure nikech dhano kata jamni ma diduwe nobed maonge.
english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.

kikuyu: Negiloso ludhe angʼwen mag yiend siala mobaw gi dhahabu. Ne gilosonegi rangʼaw mag dhahabu kendo ne girwakonegi rachungigi angʼwen mag fedha.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

kikuyu: mar abiriyo ne Hakoz, to mar aboro ne Abija,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

kikuyu: Gikanyono nyakono nodok ir ruoth koreto mi okwaye kowacho niya, “Adwaro ni mondo imiya wi Johana ja-batiso sani sani e san.”
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

kikuyu: Ogendini biro nenogi mi wigi kuodi ka osemagi tekogi duto. Giniket lwetgi e dhogi kendo itgi biro dino.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, koro weya mondo mirimba mager otiekgi. Bangʼe to anaketi ibed oganda maduongʼ.”
english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

kikuyu: Jo-Misri nobed gi kuyo ka wach nochopnegi koa Turo.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowachone ni, ‘Dar iwe pinyu gi jou mondo idhi e piny ma abiro nyisi!’
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

kikuyu: Lony lep Harun kendo irwakne wuode ma Eliazar, nimar Harun biro riwore gi jogi; mi otho kanyo.”
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

kikuyu: E sechego Daudi notimo misengini kanyo kane oneno ni Jehova Nyasaye osedwoke e laru mar dino mar Arauna ja-Jebus.
english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

kikuyu: Yor ngima telo kadhi malo ni ngʼat makare, mondo ogengʼe kik odhi mwalo kar tho.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

kikuyu: Ne giwuok kanyo, en kaachiel gi mond yawuote ariyo, kendo negimako wuoth ka giluwo yo mane dwokogi nyaka e piny Juda.
english: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

kikuyu: Abiro ngʼadone Jerusalem bura machal mana gi mane angʼadone Samaria kendo machal bende mana gi bura mane angʼadone dhood Ahab. Abiro yweyo Jerusalem matieki ka ngʼama yweyo dis moluoki mamoye oko e chiengʼ kuome piny mondo otwo.
english: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nokawo kidi mochungo e kind Mizpa gi Shen. Nochake ni Ebeneza kowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osekonyowa nyaka ka.”
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “The LORD helped us until now.”

kikuyu: mondo okel ngʼich kama onge dhano modakie ma en piny motimo ongoro maonge dhano kata achiel,
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

kikuyu: Abiro miyo rongʼode dongʼ kangima, to joma odhi e twech nobed oganda motegno, Jehova Nyasaye noritgi e got mar Sayun chakre odiechiengno nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa gi jo-Israel nowero wendni ni Jehova Nyasaye: “Abiro wer ni Jehova Nyasaye, nimar nyinge oromo mi duongʼ. Oseumo faras kod jariembne ei nam.
english: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mane aneno konyono nam kod piny cha notingʼo bade korachwich kochomo polo.
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

kikuyu: Ka noyudo owuoyo, Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuoma mi ochunga gi tienda, mine awinje kowuoyo koda.
english: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.

kikuyu: Rieko ma in-go mangʼeny kuom loko ohala osekonyi medo mwandu ewi mwandugi, kendo nikech mwandunigo koro isebedo gi sunga e chunyi.
english: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”

kikuyu: Ne en otieno mane Jehova Nyasaye oritogie mondo ogolgie piny Misri. Otieno onogono en otieno moket mondo jo-Israel duto obed kaparo Jehova Nyasaye nyaka ne tienge mabiro.
english: It is a night to be much observed to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of the LORD, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

kikuyu: Nikech wuowi koro ochayo wuon mare, kendo nyako noked kod min mare; chi wuowi bende noked gi damare, wasik ngʼato nobed joode owuon.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

kikuyu: Yaye Ruoth yaw pien dhoga, eka dhoga biro hulo pakni.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato achiel kuomu nyalo wachone niya, “Dhi gi kwe, Nyasaye mondo ogwedhi, kendo koyo kik chami, kendo ichiem maber,” to ok otimo gimoro mokonyo ngʼatni, to ere berne?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

kikuyu: To koro amor, ok nikech ne amiyo ukuyo, to mana nikech kuyouno nomiyo uyudo lokruok muweyo richo. Nimar ne ukuyo kaka Nyasaye dwaro, omiyo ne ok uyudo chandruok moro amora nikech wan.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, kane jo-Gibeon owinjo gima Joshua notimone Jeriko kod Ai,
english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

kikuyu: “To nodwoko ni, ‘Ooyo, kik utim kamano nikech seche ma upudho buyago unyalo pudho ngano bende kaachiel kodgi.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

kikuyu: Kane kinde mar nywol ochopo, to ne nitie rude ma yawuowi e iye.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
