kikuyu: Ka Wuode owuon ema ne ok okecho, to nochiwonwago wan duto, koro en angʼo ma dimone miyowa gik moko duto, kaachiel kode kuom ngʼwonone?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

kikuyu: Chakre chiengʼno kadhi nyime Judas nochako manyo kinde maber mar kete e lwetgi.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

kikuyu: Matania wuod Mika, wuod Zabdi, wuod Asaf, notelo ne dwoko erokamano ni Nyasaye kod lamo; gi Bakbukia mane jatelo mar ariyo e kind jotich kaachiel kode; kod Abda wuod Shamua, wuod Galal, wuod Jeduthun.
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

kikuyu: to e laini mar adek ne gichane kite kaka jasinth, gi agat kod amethist
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: Refaya wuod Hur, mane jatend dir dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem, nogero migape mokiewo gi migap Hanania.
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nowacho niya, “Jalno en ngʼat man-gi wach Jehova Nyasaye.” Omiyo ruodh Israel, Jehoshafat kod ruodh Edom nolor modhi ire.
english: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

kikuyu: Oruru achiel kuom oweteu mondo odhi oom owadu; to joma odongʼ ibiro kano e od twech, mondo mi wane anena ka weche ma uwacho gin adier. To ka ok gin adier, to akwongʼora gi nying Farao, ni un okwach kich!”
english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

kikuyu: To kuom magi duto, nyamin mare ma Juda ma ok ja-adiera ka en ne ok odwogo ira gi chunye duto, to mana kuom wuondruok,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni en kitanda, kata bed ni en gima nyocha obete, to ngʼato angʼata manomul gigi, en bende nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: kendo nochiw rwadhno mana kaka nochiwo rwath mitimogo misango mar golo richo. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodhnigi kethogi mi nowenegi.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Jomoko to ni Elija osefwenyore, to joma moko bende ni achiel kuom jonabi machon osebedo mangima kendo.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

kikuyu: Kane Abner gi ji piero ariyo mane obirogo ir Daudi ochopo Hebron, Daudi ne olosone nyasi mar chiemo kaachiel gi joge.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

kikuyu: to ok ne pinyno kende, to ne nyithind Nyasaye duto mokere, mondo ochokgi kaachiel, kendo omi gibed gimoro achiel.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane odak Lida gi Sharon nonene moyie kuom Ruoth.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne mor ni Solomon nokwayo mano.
english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

kikuyu: Ginitamre winjo adiera ka gichiko itgi ni sigendini manono.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

kikuyu: To joma odongʼ mane masichego ok onego pod ne ok oweyo richo mar lamo gik mane giloso kendo gichweyo gi lwetgi; kendo ok giweyo lamo jochiende gi nyiseche manono molos gi dhahabu gi fedha kod mula gi kidi kod bao, ma gin gik ma ok nen bende ma ok winj wach, kendo ok wuothi.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Aa malo idhi Bethel kendo idag kuno mi iger kendo mar misango ne Nyasaye, mane ofwenyoreni kane iringo ia kuom Esau owadu.”
english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

kikuyu: Nimar asebiro e piny ka aa e polo, ok ni mondo atim dwacha, to mondo atim dwach Jal mane oora.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

kikuyu: Ka okawo loch mar pinyruodhe, to nyaka ondik chikgi kogologi e kitap chik ma jodolo ma gin jo-Lawi nigo.
english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

kikuyu: mondo ofwenyna Wuode, mondo ayal Wach Maber e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi, to ne ok apenjo ngʼato angʼata,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

kikuyu: Bende ber mondo odhi nyime kogolo gik momako e gogo mare, kotieko ogendini ka oonge ngʼwono?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

kikuyu: Omiyo anagengʼ yore kod bungu maduongʼ mar kudho; abiro dinone chuth ma ok noyud yo mowuok godo oko.
english: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.

kikuyu: Nodhi motimo kaka Elija nowachone. Kamano ne nitie chiemo pile ka pile ne Elija gi dhakono kod joode.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

kikuyu: Kane gidhi e bungu negineno mor kich ka chwer piny, to kata kamano onge ngʼama ne otero lwete mondo otere e dhoge, nikech negiluoro kwongʼ.
english: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne aneno malaike angʼwen kochungʼ e tunge angʼwen mag piny, ka gimako yembe angʼwen mag piny, mondo gigengʼ yamo kik kudhi e piny kata e nam kata e yath moro amora.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi kane en e thim mar Juda. Yaye Nyasaye, in e Nyasacha, adwari gi tekra duto; chunya riyo oloyo mar neni kendo denda duto dwari, e piny motwo kendo maliet, maonge pi modho.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu gi jopuonjrene ne jowuok modhi e gwenge mag Kaisaria Filipi. To kane gin e yo gidhi, nopenjogi niya, “Uwinjo ji wacho ni An ngʼa?”
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

kikuyu: Ruodhi ariyogo nobedi e mesa achiel ka gichano timo gik maricho kendo ka moro ka moro wuondo nyawadgi, to parogino ok notimre, nikech gikogi pod nobi abiya, ka kinde ochopo.
english: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.

kikuyu: Ahazia wuod Ahab nobedo ruodh Israel e Samaria e higa mar apar gabiriyo mar loch Jehoshafat ruodh Juda, kendo nobedo ruodh Israel higni ariyo.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

kikuyu: mondo oduog chuny piny motwo kendo omi lum mangʼich twi?
english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

kikuyu: Odiechiengno em ngʼat ma notony nobi iri kendo nonyisi gik mosetimore.
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

kikuyu: Kendo anatiek ngʼato angʼata momulo tich moro amora chiengʼno, kendo anagole e kind ogandane.
english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

kikuyu: Un tiengʼ masani, paruru wach mar Jehova Nyasaye mawacho niya: “Bende asebedo piny motwo ne Israel kata ka piny motimo mudho mandiwa? Angʼo momiyo joga wacho kama: ‘Wan thuolo mondo waba abaya; ok wanabi iri kendo?’
english: Generation, consider the LORD’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?

kikuyu: ‘Un uwegi useneno gima ne atimone piny Misri kendo kaka ne atingʼou mana kaka ongo tingʼo nyithinde mi akelou ira awuon.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano chom wangʼi kuom gode mag Israel. Kor wach kuomgi,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

kikuyu: kendo ka wigi okuot kuom gik moko duto magisetimo, to nyisgi goro mar hekaluni kaka ochane, kuonde wuok kod kuonde donjo mage, goro mare duto kod tongʼ mage gi chikene. Ndik gigi piny e nyimgi mondo omi gibed jo-adiera kuom luwo goro mar hekalu kod chikene duto.
english: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

kikuyu: ‘Adier, wasikwa osetieki, kendo mach osewangʼo mwandugi motieko pep!’
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

kikuyu: E bathe korachwich gibiro mecho to pod gidenyo adenya; to e bathe koracham gibiro chiemo to ok giniyiengʼ. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nocham mana ringre nyathine owuon.
english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

kikuyu: Kane Yesu pod wuoyo gi oganda mane ochokore, min-gi kaachiel gi owetene nochungʼ oko ka gidwaro wuoyo kode.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

kikuyu: Yesu nooro ji apar gariyogi gi ote machal kama: “Kik udhi e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo kik udonj e dala moro amora mar jo-Samaria.
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Ruoth noketo jatend lweny mane oyiengore goke cha mondo orit dhorangach, to ji nonyone ka gimwomore e dhorangach motho mana kaka ngʼat Nyasaye ne osekoro e kinde mane ruoth obiro neno janabino e ode.
english: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni olokore bangʼe modagi kosewinjogi, to ketho mar chiege nobed e wiye owuon.”
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

kikuyu: “Angʼo midwaro mondo atimni?” Nodwoko niya, “Ruoth, adwaro mondo anen.”
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Joma kelo kwe gin joma ogwedhi, nimar noluong-gi ni nyithind Nyasaye.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

kikuyu: kendo ikonegi mondo gikaw kite apar gariyo e dier aora Jordan yo korachwich koma jodolo ochungoe kendo gitingʼ-gi mi giketgi piny kama gidhi dakie otieno ma kawuono.”
english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

kikuyu: Par matut kuom gima awacho. Ruoth biro miyi rieko mar winjo tiend weche duto.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny mane owinjo puonj jootego noyie, kendo kar romb chwo mane oyie nomedore moromo chwo alufu abich.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

kikuyu: Elisha nowachone Gehazi niya, “Nyis dhakono ni, ‘Kaka isekawo tingʼwani, koro en angʼo ma dwatimni? Dibedie gi kwayo moro ma dwatimni e nyim ruoth kata jatend lweny?’ ” To dhakono nodwoko niya, “Adak gi kwe e kind ogandana.”
english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

kikuyu: Osemaya duongʼna mi ogolo osimbo e wiya.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

kikuyu: Omiyo achano gero hekalu ni Nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Daudi wuonwa kowacho ni, ‘Wuodi ma anaketi e kom loch kari biro gero hekalu ni Nyinga.’
english: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

kikuyu: “In e odungana mar lweny, gira mar kedo, in ema atiekogo ogendini, in ema akethogo pinjeruodhi,
english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

kikuyu: Rit chikena to ibiro bedo mangima; rit puonjna mana kaka dirit tong wangʼi.
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

kikuyu: Bende Daudi nokedo gi Hadadezer wuod Rehob, ma ruodh Zoba, eka nodhi mondo ogur lochne e dho Aora Yufrate.
english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar ariyo chiwuru nyirwedhi apar gariyo, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen mahikgi achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Jo-Emi kod jo-Anak ji ne luongogiga ni jo-Refai, to jo-Moab to ne luongogi ni jo-Emi.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

kikuyu: Winjuru jo-Israel maringo kod matony koa Babulon, mawacho e Sayun ni mano kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa osechulo kuor, kuor nikech hekalu mare.
english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

kikuyu: Kaleb wuod Hezron ne nigi nyithindo mane onywolo gi chiege Azuba (ma bende ne iluongo ni Jerioth). Magi ema ne yawuote: Jesher, Shobab kod Ardon.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kwan nyithindo ma yawuowi makayo duto mag Israel kochakore ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime kendo indik nyingegi piny.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

kikuyu: Kuom timbeni duto mamono gi chode mane idonje, ne ok iparo ndalo mane pod itin, kindego mane in duk, kane ayudi ka remo olwoki.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

kikuyu: oningʼo wangʼe, owuoyo gi tiendene ka ogoro piny, kendo ogwelo ji gi lith lwetene,
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

kikuyu: Sibuor koro tho nikech gima ocham onge, kendo nyithi sibuor oringo ma oke.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: In ema ne iketo tongʼ duto mag piny kende ne iguro oro gi chwiri.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano dichwo nowe wuon kod min, kendo nopadre gi chiege, mi ji ariyogo nodok ringruok achiel.”
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Sulwe mag polo kod lergi ok nonenre. Wangʼ chiengʼ nolokre mudho, kawuok kendo dwe bende ok norieny.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

kikuyu: To ongʼeyo yora maluwo; bangʼ tema to abiro wuok aa e tem ka achalo dhahabu.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

kikuyu: Kane osepimo wach gi joge, Jehoshafat noyiero joma onego owerne Jehova Nyasaye mondo gipak berne mokalo apima mar lerne ka gitelo e nyim jolweny ka giwer niya, “Dwokneuru Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, nikech herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”

kikuyu: Eka Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Nikech Nyasaye osenyisi wechegi duto, onge ngʼat man-gi ngʼeyo matut kendo riek ka in.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

kikuyu: Koro lokreuru uwe richou, udog ir Nyasaye, mondo richou owenu, eka Ruoth noduog chunyu mi uyud kwe,
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

kikuyu: Oganda noked gi oganda machielo, kendo pinyruoth gi pinyruoth machielo. Kech nobedi kuonde mangʼeny kendo piny noyiengni kuonde mopogore opogore.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘Luor wuonu gi minu’kendo ni, ‘Ngʼato angʼata mokwongʼo wuon kata min nyaka negi.’
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Kane Yesu obiro e od Petro, noneno min chi Petro ka onindo e kitanda, ka en-gi midhusi.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owuok e yie, to ngʼat moro man-gi jochiende manodak e kar liete noromone.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Rehoboam nodak Jerusalem kendo nogero mier masiro Juda ndalo lweny kaka:
english: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

kikuyu: Ka kamano e kaka Nyasaye rwako lum aluma manie pap, ma kawuono nitie to kiny iwite e mach, donge obiro rwakou maber moloyo, yaye un joma yiegi tin-gi?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

kikuyu: Jehoyada koro noti kendo hike noniangʼ mine otho ka en ja-higni mia achiel gi piero adek.
english: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo kibaji maduongʼ omaka e nyime, kendo kaparo gigi duto to amiye luor.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

kikuyu: Eka Judas, ngʼat mane biro ndhoge nowacho niya, “Rabi, dobed an koso?” Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ee, en in.”
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ok uremo mich moro amora mar Roho kuritogo odiechiengʼ ma Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo nofwenyree.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: To gigi nyaka timre e yo mochanore: Kristo mane okwongo chier kaka olemo mokwongo chiek, eka bangʼe joma ni kuome bende nochier chiengʼ manoduogi.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo kata mana singruok mokwongo ne ok nyal chako tich kaonge remo.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

kikuyu: Abiro dwoko tipo mar wangʼ chiengʼ manie raidhi mar dhood Ahaz ondamo apar chien.’ ” Omiyo wangʼ chiengʼ ne odok ondamo apar chien e raidhi mane oselorie.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bani, ji mia auchiel gi piero angʼwen gariyo (642),
english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.

kikuyu: Ka dhako ok dwar tweyo kitamba, to ber kata mondo oliel yie wiye. To kaka en wichkuot ka dhako olielo yie wiye mapoth, to ber otwe kitamba.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ikawowa ka dhok kendo wachalo joma ofuwo e nyimi?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

kikuyu: Dhood Isakar notelnegi gi Nethanel wuod Zuar,
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

kikuyu: “Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon osetiekowa, oserundo pachwa, oselokowa agulu ma iye ninono. Ka thuol osemuonyowa kendo osepongʼo iye gi chiembwa, mi osengʼudhowa oko.”
english: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, Oholiba, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro wako joherani mondo oked kodi, jogo mane ilokori iweyo ka iyi owangʼ, kendo abiro kelogi mondo giked kodi ka gia koni gi koni;
english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka jo-Gad kod jo-Reuben noidh kaachiel kodu Jordan e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato omanore mar kedo, to bangʼ ka useloyo piny, to unumigi piny Gilead kaka pok margi.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye mor ewi pige; Nyasaye mar duongʼ mor ka polo, Jehova Nyasaye mor ewi pige madongo.
english: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

kikuyu: Kik nyiego maki gi ja-mahundu, kata wuotho e yore moro amora.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

kikuyu: Ne apimonegi pek mar fedha mane en talanta mia auchiel gi piero abich, gige fedha pekgi ne en talanta mia achiel, pek dhahabu ne en talanta mia achiel,
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

kikuyu: Omiyo ji ariyogo nobedo piny mochiemo kendo ometho. Bangʼe jaduongʼne nowachone niya, “Yie iri kawuono mondo iyud mor.”
english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

kikuyu: Piny opongʼ gi joma terore; nikech kwongʼ, piny obaro okak kendo kuonde kwath otimo ongoro. Jonabi luwo bangʼ timbe mamono kendo gitiyo gi teko mag-gi e yo ma ok nikare.
english: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

kikuyu: Nyasaye mane osetimo honni e piny Ham kod timbe miwuoro e dho Nam Makwar.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, isemiyowa kwe; kendo gik moko duto ma wasetimo in ema isetimonwa.
english: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

kikuyu: Gima osebedo biro bedo kendo, gima osetim ibiro tim kendo; kendo onge gino manyien e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

kikuyu: Warruok mara gi luor ma ayudo aa kuom Nyasaye; en e lwandana manyalo duto, en e kar pondona.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo isechwado pundani nyadidek? Abiro mondo agengʼi nikech yoreni obam e nyima.
english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

kikuyu: Kik ucham gimoro amora makwero.
english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

kikuyu: Kane abiro Troa mondo ayal Injili mar Kristo ne ayudo ka Ruoth noseyawona dhoot,
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

kikuyu: nikech mirima ok mi wabed joma kare kaka Nyasaye dwaro ni wabedi.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Wamakuru motegno geno ma wan-go ma ok wamindni, nikech Nyasaye mosemiyowa singruok en ja-adier.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

kikuyu: Inine malit in piny man-gi bede mag aore mamor mag Kush,
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

kikuyu: Ezer wuod Jeshua, ma jatend Mizpa, nochako ogero migawo machielo e dir jo-Binnui kama omanyore gi yo ma idho kochomo kar keno mar gige lweny man kama ohinga ogomogo.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

kikuyu: Pien denda olokore ratengʼ kendo opokore; kendo wich bar oowo denda ka mach.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno Jehova Nyasaye notimo singruok gi Abram mowachone niya, “To ne nyikwayi, amiyogi pinyni, koa e aora mar Misri nyaka aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate.
english: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

kikuyu: Eka Isaka wuon mare nowachone niya, “Bi ka wuoda mondo inyodha.”
english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

kikuyu: Nyaka koroni kech kayowa kendo riyo oloyowa. Warwako lewni mokidhore okidhore, kendo isandowa malit, ka waonge kata kar dak.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

kikuyu: Joma thagougo, to daher mondo gidhi nyime ka gitimo mano nyaka gihinyre kendgi giwegi!
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

kikuyu: nomuko kende mag misango gi sirni mag Ashera milamo kendo notoyo nyisechegi mongʼinyore ka buru kendo nongʼado matindo tindo kende miwangʼoe ubani e piny Israel duto, bangʼe noduogo Jerusalem.
english: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Lweny nochako bet kendo e kind jo-Filistia gi jo-Israel. Daudi nodhi gi joge mondo oked gi jo-Filistia, kendo nobedo mool.
english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

kikuyu: Ziklag, Beth Makaboth, Hazar Shusa,
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

kikuyu: An Tertio, ma jandiko mar baruwani, bende amosou kuom Ruoth.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kata mana sani ngʼat matimo nenda maber ni e polo, ngʼat mabiro chungʼ ka chwaka ni malo.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Kik iluor, kendo kik chunyi nyosre. Kaw jolweny duto mondo udhi umonj Ai, nimar asechiwo e lwetu ruodh Ai, joge, dalane maduongʼ kod pinye.
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

kikuyu: “Bende in wuoda ma Esau adier?” Isaka nopenje. Eka Jakobo nodwoke ni, “Ee en an.”
english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

kikuyu: “Wachne Rehoboam wuod Solomon ruodh Juda kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto modak Juda kod Benjamin,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

kikuyu: Kane obiro Jerusalem, notemo mondo odonji e kanyakla mar jopuonjre, to giduto ne giluore, nikech ne gichich kode ni sa moro pok nolokore adier.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

kikuyu: Hana nowacho niya, “Mad jatichni yud ngʼwono e wangʼi.” Eka nodhi e yore owuon mochamo gimoro, kendo wangʼe ne koro onge kuyo.
english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

kikuyu: En gima ongʼere ni ngʼat matin igwedho gi ngʼat maduongʼ.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

kikuyu: Gipongʼ gi kit timbe mamono duto, gi richo, gi wuoro kod timbe mobam. Bende gipongʼ gi ich lit, gi nek, gi dhawo, gi wuond kod himruok. Gin jokuoth,
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

kikuyu: Achiel kuom adekgi abiro ketogi e mach; abiro pwodhogi kaka ipwodho fedha, kendo abiro temogi kaka itemo dhahabu. Gibiro luongo nyinga kendo abiro dwokogi; abiro wacho ni, ‘Gin joga,’ to gin bende gibiro wacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasachwa.’ ”
english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’”

kikuyu: Isaka nodwoko Esau niya, “Asekete ruodhi kendo wedene duto aseketo obed jotichne bende asegwedhe gi cham kod divai. Koro ere gima anyalo timoni wuoda?”
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

kikuyu: Jakobo kod ji duto mane ni kode nochopo Luz (ma tiende ni Bethel) e piny Kanaan.
english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

kikuyu: Kane awacho ni, ‘Ka ema onego ichopie ma ok ikalo; ka e kama apaka magi nyalo dhwolore mi gike’?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

kikuyu: To kane budho dhi nyime, nyar Herodia nobiro momiel e nyim Herode mi miendeno nomoro ruoth gi wende. Ruoth nowachone nyakono niya, “Kwaya gimoro amora ma chunyi dwaro mondo amiyi.”
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Odiechiengno Nyakwar Jesse nochungʼ kaka ranyisi ne ji; mi ogendini nobi ire, kendo kare mar yweyo nobed gi duongʼ.
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye ema ageno kuome. Koro ere kaka duwachna ni: “Ringi ka winyo nyaka ewi got mari.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

kikuyu: Kuom mano wangʼ ok nyal wachone lwedo niya, “Ok adwari!” Kata wich bende ok nyal wachone tielo niya, “Ok adwari.”
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

kikuyu: To ka onywolo nyathi ma nyako, to nobed mogak kuom ndalo apar gangʼwen, mana kaka obedo mogak e ndalone mar neno malo. Bangʼ mano to nyaka orit kuom ndalo piero auchiel gauchiel mondo opwodhe kuom rembe.
english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

kikuyu: Negichiemo mi chiemo otamogi tieko, nimar nomiyogi gima ne chunygi gombo.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

kikuyu: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

kikuyu: mar angʼwen ne en Adonija wuod Hagith; mar abich ne en Shefatia wuod Abital;
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi duto mane jothum kaka Asaf, Heman, Jeduthun kod yawuotgi gi jowetene nochungʼ e bath kendo mar misango yo wuok chiengʼ ka girwako lewni mar katana maber ka gigoyo ongengʼo gi nyatiti kod orutu. Jodolo mia achiel gi piero ariyo to ne goyo turumbete.
english: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

kikuyu: Jasigu manotieki achien mogik en tho,
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

kikuyu: kendo ne aneno Ruoth mowuoyo koda kowachona ni, ‘Wuog mapiyo ia Jerusalem sani sani nikech ok gibi yie gi neno mitimo kuoma.’
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

kikuyu: Jotende ngʼado bura ka omigi asoya. Jodolo mag-gi bende puonjo weche mag chik komigi chudo, kendo jonabi mage koro wach mana komigi chudo. To pod giyiengore mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye kagiwacho niya, “Donge Jehova Nyasaye ni e dierwa, onge masira mabiro makowa.”
english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”

kikuyu: Joka Shilo ne gin: Asaya makayo to gi yawuote.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

kikuyu: “Ka rwath ochwoyo dichwo kata dhako monego, rwadhno nyaka go gi kite ma tho, kendo ringe kik cham. To wuon rwadhno wachno ok nomake.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

kikuyu: To jopuonjrene nodwoke niya, “Ineno ka ji olwori moketi diere to pod ipenjo apenja ni, ‘En ngʼa momulo lepa?’ ”
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Koro wayie ni ingʼeyo gik moko duto kendo ni onge tiende mondo ngʼato ochandi gi penjo mathoth. Mano omiyo wayie ni ne ia ka Nyasaye.”
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

kikuyu: Koro e thagruokne nokwayo ngʼwono kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasache kobolore ahinya e nyim Nyasach kwerene.
english: When he was in distress, he begged the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

kikuyu: Koso wiu osewil gi weche mag jip ma Nyasaye wuoyogo kodu kaka nyithinde niya, “Wuoda kik ikaw kum ma Ruoth kumigo ka gima nono, kendo kik chunyi jogi ka okweri,
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye owuon ema tiyo e chunyu mondo omi umanye kendo utim dwarone maber.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

kikuyu: Bangʼ dweche ochiko gi ndalo piero ariyo kane gisewuotho e piny duto, negidwogo Jerusalem.
english: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

kikuyu: Tekreni osiko medore ameda, nyaka chop moro ka moro kuomgi chop Sayun e nyim Nyasaye.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

kikuyu: We jogi owuogi mondo gidhi e gwenge kod mier machiegni mondo gingʼiew gima digicham.”
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

kikuyu: Eka Solomon nonyisi niya, “Adonija oluoro ruoth Solomon kendo omako tunge mag kendo mar misango. Owacho ni, ‘Ruoth Solomon mondo okwongʼrena kawuono ni ok enoneg jatichne gi ligangla.’ ”
english: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”

kikuyu: “Yaye, Jerusalem, Jerusalem, in ma inego jonabi kendo ichielo joma oorni gi kite! Mano kaka asegombo amingʼa mondo achok nyithindi kaachiel, kaka gweno choko nyithinde e bwo bwombene, to ok useyie.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

kikuyu: To kaponi ok odwar waro lopeno, kata ka oseuse ni ngʼato machielo, to koro ok oyiene ware.
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

kikuyu: Balaam nowacho niya, “Gerna kende abiriyo mag misango kae, kendo ikna rwedhi abiriyo kod imbe abiriyo.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

kikuyu: Kaka Paulo nongʼeyo ni moko kuom jogo ne gin jo-Sadukai, to moko jo-Farisai, nokok ne bura mar Sanhedrin kowacho niya, “Owetena, an ja-Farisai kendo an wuod ja-Farisai. Achungʼ kae kawuono mondo oyala nikech geno ma an-go kuom chier mar joma otho!”
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Nimar gik moko duto manie piny, kaka gombo mar wangʼ kendo gombo mar ringruok kod sunga ma ji sungorego kuom gik ma gin-go, ok aa kuom Wuoro, to gin mana mag pinyni.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo loso kodgi kowachonegi niya, “Ere kaka ok unyal winjo tiend ngeroni? Ka kamano to bende ubiro winjo tiend ngero moro amora?
english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

kikuyu: Kane Abram ochopo Misri, jo-Misri noneno Sarai kaka ne en dhako ma jaber miwuoro.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

kikuyu: Pasiago duto molworo laruno molos gi law mayom momin.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero abich gariyo mar loch Azaria ruodh Juda, Peka wuod Remalia nobedo ruodh Israel ka en Samaria, kendo nobedo ruoth kuom higni piero ariyo.
english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

kikuyu: Ka ioro Roho mari, to gibedo mangima; kendo imiyo piny bedo gi ngima manyien.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

kikuyu: To dhood Israel pod wacho mana ni, ‘Yore mag Ruoth Nyasaye ok nikare.’ To winjuru, yaye dhood Israel: Bende yorena ok nikare adier? Donge yoreu ema ok nikare?
english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka asegologi, anakechgi kendo, bende anaduog moro ka moro ir girkeni mare owuon kod pinye owuon.
english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

kikuyu: Abiro dwokogi kata kapok giluonga, kendo abiro winjogi kata kapok giwuoyo.
english: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne akoro kaka ne ochika, mi much ngima nodonjo kuomgi; kendo negidoko mangima; ma gichungʼ malo gi tiendgi, ka gin oganda lweny maduongʼ miwuoro!
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ ka jo-Lawi oseketo lwetgi ewi rwedhigo, to chiw achiel kuomgi ne Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mar golo richo, to machielo chiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep mipwodhogo jo-Lawi mondo ngʼwon-nigi.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mamoko mane okwan ne gin: joka Libni, joka Hebron, joka Mali, joka Mushi, joka Kora. (Kohath ne kwar Amram;
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

kikuyu: Yaye in miwinjo lamo, in ema ji duto biro biro iri.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

kikuyu: To un gode to ne ulengʼoru ka imbe nangʼo? Koso thuche to nochikore ka nyirombe nikech angʼo?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

kikuyu: Moro kuomgi nowacho ni, ‘An ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye.’ To machielo to noluongre gi nying Jakobo. Moro machielo nondik e lwete ni, ‘Mar Jehova Nyasaye,’ kendo giduto giniluongre gi nying Israel.
english: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to the LORD,’ and honor the name of Israel.”

kikuyu: Luoro nomako Daudi chiengʼno nikech Jehova Nyasaye mopenjo niya, “Ere kaka dakel Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka?”
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

kikuyu: Ji duto nohum kendo nowacho niya, “Dibed ni ma e Wuod Daudi?”
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

kikuyu: Ka osegolo rombene duto oko, to otelo e nyimgi, kendo rombene luwo bangʼe nikech gingʼeyo kit dwonde.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni ok amor ka ngʼat ma timbene richo otho, to amor ka gilokore giweyo yoregi maricho mondo gibed mangima. Lokreuru! Lokreuru uwe yoreu maricho! Udwaro tho nangʼo, yaye dhood Israel?’
english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

kikuyu: kendo luoro gi kibaji nogoya momiyo denda duto onyosore.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

kikuyu: kendo kikwongʼori gi adiera gi bura makare kendo gi tim malongʼo ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima,’ eka abiro gwedho ogendini duto manie piny kendo ogendini duto biro miya duongʼ.”
english: and you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

kikuyu: to jo-Sabea nobiro momonjowa kendo okawogi duto. Bende gisenego jotiji duto gi ligangla ma an kendo ema atony mondo anyisi wachni!”
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Kik iyie mondo joma idiyo ringa ka wigi okuot, to mad joma odhier gi joma ochando opak nyingi.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

kikuyu: Mosnauru bende Asunkrito, Filgona, Hermes, Patroba, Hermas, kod Jowete duto man kodgi.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

kikuyu: Koro neuru, an kod nyiri ariyo mapok ongʼeyo chwo; weuru agolnugi oko mondo utim kodgi kaka uhero; to kik utim marach ni jogi, nimar gin wenda.”
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama ofuwo nyagore gi tich matek ma ok konye; nimar kata kuma oaye ok onyal paro.
english: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar ochiko e dwe mar angʼwen kech mane ni e dala maduongʼno nomedore makoro ne onge chiemo mane ji nyalo chamo.
english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, “Dala maduongʼ mane ooro joge mag lweny alufu achiel mondo oked ne jo-Israel, mia achiel kende ema biro duogo, to mano mooro joge mag lweny mia achiel, apar kende ema biro duogo.”
english: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: “Nyamin mare ma Oholiba kata obedo ni noneno gik mane otimore ni nyamin, to gombone gi chode mare nomedore mi nokethore moloyo nyamin.
english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno ka ji moko ringo biro kama gintie, nochiko jachien marachno kowacho niya, “In jachien ma ite odino kendo ma momoni, achiki ni aa kuome kendo kik ichak idonj kuome kendo.”
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, jowetena mageno, chunguru motegno. Kik uyie gimoro oyiengu. Chiwreuru chuth kinde duto ni tich Ruoth, nikech ungʼeyo ni tich mutiyo matek ne Ruoth ok obedo kayiem nono.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

kikuyu: Jehoram ne ja-higni piero adek gariyo ka nodoko ruoth, kendo norito piny kuom higni aboro kodak Jerusalem. Notho maonge ngʼama nokuyo kuom thone kendo noyike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi to ok kuma iyikoe ruodhi.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

kikuyu: to Benaya kod Jahaziel ma jodolo to ne goyo turumbete e sa ka sa e nyim sanduk singruok mar Nyasaye.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

kikuyu: “Ka jogo modak machiegni kodwa okelo gigegi mag ohala kata chambgi mondo giusi chiengʼ Sabato, ok wabi ngʼiewo kodgi chiengʼ Sabato kata e odiechiengʼ moro maler. E higa mar abiriyo ka mar abiriyo wabiro weyo tiyo e puodho kendo wabiro weyone ji gopegi duto.
english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.

kikuyu: Eka ne awachone jodolo kod jogi duto niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Kik uchik itu ne jonabi mawacho ni, ‘Machiegnini koro gigo duto moa e od Jehova Nyasaye ibiro duogi koa Babulon.’ Gikoronu miriambo.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, the LORD says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of the LORD’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

kikuyu: Eka jatich Ibrahim kod jogo mane ni kode nochiemo kendo ometho kendo ne ginindo kanyo. Kane gichiewo kinyne gokinyi nowacho niya, “Weuru adog ir ruodha.”
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

kikuyu: Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode nodhi Hebron koa Eglon, mi gimonje.
english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

kikuyu: Sara, jaod ruodha osenywolone wuowi ka hike oniangʼ kendo ruodha osemiyo wuodeno mwandune duto.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

kikuyu: gouru erokamano kata piny ber kata rach, nikech mano ema Nyasaye dwaro ni utim ei Kristo Yesu.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

kikuyu: Nomedo wuoyo kowachone niya, “Chon gi lala ji ne jawacho ni, ‘Dhi Abel mondo ngʼadnie rieko,’ kendo wachno ne rumo kamano.
english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

kikuyu: (Ma ne en kweno mokwongo mane otimore ka Kwirinio ne en ruodh Siria.)
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

kikuyu: Ere Nyasaye moro makmana Jehova Nyasaye? Kendo en ngʼatno ma en Lwanda makmana Nyasachwa?
english: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?

kikuyu: Bende ne aguro singruokna kodgi ni anamigi piny Kanaan, kama negidakie kaka jodak.
english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

kikuyu: Dhood Asher notelne gi Pagiel wuod Okran,
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Yesu nosewacho mani, nodhi nyime, kochomo Jerusalem.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jehoash ruodh Israel nomako Amazia ruodh Juda, ma wuod Joash, ma wuod Ahazia e Beth Shemesh. Bangʼe Jehoash nodhi Jerusalem kendo nomuko ohinga mar Jerusalem chakre e dhoranga Efraim nyaka kama ohinga ogomogo; bor kama ne omuko ne romo fut mia abich gi piero ochiko gachiel.
english: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka abiro kumo jo-Misri, mi giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”’”

kikuyu: Chiwo yawo yo ne ngʼat machiwo kendo tere e nyim jomadongo.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar ariyo mar dwe, jotend anywola duto, kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi, nochokore but Ezra jandiko mondo gichik itgi malongʼo ni weche manie Chik.
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

kikuyu: “Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Farisai gi Jopuonj chik moko nobiro ir Yesu koa Jerusalem mi openje niya,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie janabi moro moti mane odak Bethel ma yawuote nobiro mowachone duto mane ngʼat Nyasayeno otimo kanyo chiengʼno, bende neginyiso wuon-gi gima nowacho ni ruoth.
english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

kikuyu: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

kikuyu: Remb joma odhier ma unego yudore e lepu, kata obedo nine ok umakogi ka gituro uteu.” To kuom magi duto,
english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is because of all these things.

kikuyu: We ochiw lembe ne ngʼatno ma digoye kendo oyie bedo ngʼat ma ji jaro,
english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Mano ber, obed mana kaka uwachono. Ngʼato angʼata manoyud kode nobed misumbana, to joma odongʼ nobed thuolo.”
english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Kik ubed maluor. Dhiuru unyis owetena mondo gidhi Galili; kuno ema gibiro nena.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

kikuyu: Puoth mzabibu mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego en od jo-Israel, kod jo-Juda e puodho mamiye mor. Osedwaro mondo ngʼado bura makare obedie, to oneno mana nek kendo osedwaro mondo one tim makare, to owinjo mana ywak mar lit.
english: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

kikuyu: Ngʼatni nodak kar yiko joma otho, kendo onge ngʼat mane nyalo make mi tweye kata mana gi nyororo.
english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

kikuyu: Joma yoreyore mane obiro kodgi nochako dwaro chiemo mamoko, kendo jo-Israel nochako ywak kawacho niya, “Mad debed ni wan gi ringʼo ma wanyalo chamo!
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

kikuyu: Zekaria, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Maseya kod Benaya nonego go nyatiti kaluwore gi chenro wer miluongo ni alamoth,
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

kikuyu: Ji ne kelo nyithindo matindo ir Yesu, mondo ogwedhgi. Kane jopuonjre noneno mano negikwerogi.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

kikuyu: Jatelo mahinyo jochan chalo kaka kodh oula maywero cham oko.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

kikuyu: Taya e yo mar chikeni, nimar kanyo ema ayudoe mor.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

kikuyu: to goluru dichwono kata dhakono mosetimo gima mononi e dhorangach mar dala maduongʼ kendo mondo uchiele gi kite nyaka otho.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

kikuyu: To joma nodhi kode kuno nowacho niya, “Ok wanyal monjo jogo; gitek moloyowa.”
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

kikuyu: “Chiwri ni Nyasaye mondo ibed kode gi kwe, ma biro miyo idhi nyime maber.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

kikuyu: To jogegi mane odongʼ noneg gi ligangla mane owuok e dho jaidh faras, kendo winy duto nokidho ringregi.
english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

kikuyu: En Nyasaye mane machalo kodi ma ngʼwono ne joge modongʼ, kendo weyonegi richogi? Iyi ok wangʼ nyaka chiengʼ, to imor mar kecho jogi.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

kikuyu: Ne ochwalore nyime matin bangʼe to ogoyo chonge piny mi olamo ni kanyalore to sa mar masirano okadhe.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, yaye dhood Israel, abiro ngʼadonu bura, ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu kaluwore gi yorene owuon, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho. Lokreuru! Weuru ketho duto musetimo, eka richo ok nobednu obadho.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

kikuyu: En wichkuot kata mana owacho gik ma joma richo timo lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

kikuyu: To kaka ne ok onyal chulo gopeno, ruodhe nogolo chik mondo en kaachiel gi chiege gi nyithinde, kod gik moko duto mane en-go ousi mondo ochul gowino.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

kikuyu: To Daudi nowachone Abishai niya, “Kik inege! En ngʼa manyalo keto lwete kuom ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir ma ok oket ne bura?”
english: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?”

kikuyu: Ne giwuotho mi gidhi nyaka dala, to kane gidonjo kanyo to negineno Samuel, kabiro gwenyore kodgi kochiko kama owal.
english: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro yawo polo, ma en kar keno mag mwandune, ka ochiwo koth e piny e ndalo mowinjore, kendo ka ogwedho tije duto mag lwetu. Ubiro chiwo hola ne pinje mangʼeny to un ok unuhol gimoro kuomgi.
english: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

kikuyu: Giduto ne gin e achiel ka ginano e lamo, kaachiel gi mon moko, kod Maria min Yesu gi owete Yesu.
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

kikuyu: Ne giywak mondo okonygi to onge ngʼama ne nyalo resogi; ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye to ne ok odwokogi.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

kikuyu: “Ka polo olor kendo koth onge nikech jogi osekethoni to ka gilemo kaeni ka gipako nyingi kendo ka gilokore giweyo richogi nikech isekelonegi chandruok,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

kikuyu: To ka noneno yamo to luoro nomake, kendo kane koro ochako nimo, noywak matek niya, “Ruoth, resa!”
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka usedak e pinyno kuom higni mangʼeny mi ubedo gi nyithindo kod nyikwau, bangʼe ubedo jo-mibadhi ma uloso kido mopa kendo utimo gik mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ka umiye mirima;
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

kikuyu: Aa malo yaye Jehova Nyasaye! Tingʼ badi malo, yaye Nyasaye. Kik wiyi wil gi joma ok nyal.
english: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

kikuyu: Mana kaka userwako Kristo Yesu ka Ruoth, dhiuru nyime ka udak kuome,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

kikuyu: Filipo gi Bartholomayo; Thoma gi Mathayo ma jasol osuru; Jakobo wuod Alfayo, gi Thadayo;
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

kikuyu: Imiyo yo mawuothoe bedo malach, mondo tiendena kik ba yo.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Kane Josef owuok irgi, noywak ahinya, bangʼe noduogo irgi mochako wuoyo kodgi. Nokawo Simeon mi otweye e nyimgi ka gineno.
english: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

kikuyu: To Jeremia nodwokogi niya, “Nyisuru Zedekia,
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Isaka nosetieko gwedho Jakobo kendo Jakobo ne pok odhi mabor, to gikanyono Esau nochopo koa dwar.
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno wachne wuodi ni, ‘Atimo ma nikech gima Jehova Nyasaye notimona kane awuok e piny Misri.’
english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

kikuyu: Nobet kamano, nikech jomoko mawuondore ni jowete nobiro kanyo lingʼ-lingʼ mondo onon ane thuolo manade ma wan-go kuom bedo jo-Kristo Yesu, nikech jogi ne dwaro lokowa wasumbini.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Wasebiro mondo watweyi kendo wachiwi e lwet jo-Filistia.” Samson nowacho niya, “Kwongʼrenauru ni un uwegi ok ununega.”
english: They said to him, “We have come down to bind you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines.” Samson said to them, “Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves.”

kikuyu: Ok obi dhawo kata goyo nduru; bende onge ngʼama biro winjo dwonde e wangʼ yore.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

kikuyu: “An Daniel, chunya nochandore, kendo fweny mane aneno mopogore opogore nodhiera nono.
english: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

kikuyu: Apoya nono oganda maduongʼ mar jopolo nothinyore kod malaika ka gipako Nyasaye kendo wacho niya,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada nodwoko ruoth niya, “Amin! Mad Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach ruodha ma jaloch otime kamano.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.

kikuyu: Hezekia ne nigi mwandu mangʼeny kod luor mi noloso kuondege mag fedha gi dhahabu gi kite ma nengogi tek gi gik mangʼwe ngʼar, gi okumbni kod gik moko mopogore opogore mabeyo mage.
english: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels;

kikuyu: Eka jarito nodwoko niya, “Piny chiegni ru, to otieno bende biro chopo. Kidwaro penjo, to penji kendo imed penjo.”
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

kikuyu: Josef nodak Misri, kaachiel gi jood wuon-gi. Nodak higni mia achiel kod apar.
english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

kikuyu: Abiro keto chuny Farao bedo matek, ma kata obedo ni abiro nwoyo honni kod ranyisi e piny Misri,
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nogero od kom duongʼ, Od ngʼado Bura kama ne ongʼadoe bura kendo noume gi sida koa piny nyaka e tado.
english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

kikuyu: kaka Nyasaye nowiro Yesu ja-Nazareth gi Roho Maler kod teko, kendo kaka nowuotho koni gi koni kotimo maber kendo kochango ji duto mane ni e bwo loch mar Satan, nikech Nyasaye ne ni kode.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

kikuyu: Obiro nyodho kwiri mag thuonde madongo; kendo leke thuond fu man-gi kwiri maricho biro nege.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

kikuyu: Werne Jehova Nyasaye! Pak Jehova Nyasaye! Oreso ngima joma nigidwaro, e lwet joma timbegi mono.
english: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

kikuyu: Noketo jolweny e mier mochiel duto mag Juda kendo nogero kuonde jolweny Juda kaachiel gi miech Efraim mane Asa wuon mare okawo.
english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

kikuyu: kendo uwachne ni, ‘Gima ruoth wacho ema: Ket ngʼatni e od twech kendo kik imiye gimoro amora makmana makati kod pi nyaka aduogi kangima.’ ”
english: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Dan noromo ji alufu piero auchiel gariyo gi mia abiriyo (62,700).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Musa, jatich Jehova Nyasaye kod jo-Israel noloyogi kendo Musa ma jatich Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo pinygino ne jo-Reuben, jo-Gad gi nus mar dhood Manase mondo obed kaka girkeni mag-gi.
english: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasach Jakobo noturo atungegi, kendo Jakwath, ma Lwanda mar Israel, nochodo leche mag ogich bedegi.
english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

kikuyu: “ ‘Adier tem biro ma ok olew, kendo ludh loch mar Juda ok bi siko. Ere gima odongʼ maditim ni joma ochayo ligangla, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.’
english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Joga itieko nikech chando ngʼeyo. “Nikech utamoru dwaro ngʼeyo, an bende adagiu kaka jodolona; nikech usejwangʼo chike mag Nyasachu, an bende anajwangʼ nyithindu.
english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.

kikuyu: Keturu pachu kuom gik man malo to ok kuom gige piny.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Musa noseoro jonon piny Jazer, jo-Israel nokawo kuonde dak molwore kendo ne giriembo jo-Amor mane ni kanyo.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

kikuyu: Yesu nochako owuoyo kodgi, kowacho niya, “An e ler mar piny, ngʼato angʼata ma luwa ok nyal wuotho e mudho, to enobed gi ler mar ngima.”
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

kikuyu: Lamo mar Musa ngʼat Nyasaye. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isebedo kar dak marwa nyaka nene e tienge duto.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

kikuyu: “Ngʼadnwauru rieko, nyiswa gima onego watim. Pandwauru mondo kik yudwa kendo panduru jowa moringo lweny, kendo kik uyie mondo omaki joma oseringo.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

kikuyu: Nyasaye to yore longʼo chuth; wach Jehova Nyasaye onge rem moro amora. En okumba ne ji duto ma pondo kuome.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Ka ikayo cham e puothi ma cham moro odongʼni ka ok ikayo, to kik idog iome. Weye ne jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho, mondo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ogwedhi e kuom gik mitimo.
english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Ne ni jatichni dhi maber, kendo kik iyie joma ochayo ji osanda.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

kikuyu: Kuonde mowe kaka lek mikwaye mag dala maduongʼ nobed fut mia angʼwen gi apar, bathe mochomo yo nyandwat, fut mia angʼwen gi apar, yo milambo, fut mia angʼwen gi apar, yo wuok chiengʼ kod fut mia angʼwen gi apar yo podho chiengʼ.
english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Dwe pogo kinde mag chwiri gi kinde mag opon kendo wangʼ chiengʼ ongʼeyo sa monego opodhie.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

kikuyu: Dhiuru! Aorou mondo udhi mana kaka rombe e dier ondiegi.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo Ziba niya, “Angʼo momiyo ikelo gigi?” Ziba nodwoke niya, “Pundegi gin ma jood ruoth nyalo idho, makati gi olembe to gin mar jogi mondo ocham, divai to en mar duogo chuny joma ool e thim mondo omadhi.”
english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”

kikuyu: Eliaba ja-Shalbon, gi yawuot Jashen, Jonathan
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

kikuyu: Yawuowigo nodongo, kendo Esau nobedo jadwar molony, ngʼat ma jathim, to Jakobo to ne ngʼama muol madak ei hema.
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

kikuyu: Josef nochoko chiemo duto mane ochiek e higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo e piny Misri kendo okanogi e mier madongo. Nokano cham mochiek e puothe molworogi e dala ka dala maduongʼ.
english: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro mobet e tiend yiend ober moro mantiere Ofra mane mar Joash ma ja-Abiezer, kama wuod Gideon ne dinoe ngano mondo kik jo-Midian yude.
english: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

kikuyu: To kata kamano kik ucham remo, to pukgiuru piny mana ka pi.
english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

kikuyu: Chiw nyarombo mokwongono gi mogo mayom moromo gorogoro achiel gi nus moruw gi mo mobi e olemb zeituni moromo lita achiel, kendo ichiw divai moromo lita achiel kaka misango miolo piny
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ji ok nyal biro ewi Got Sinai nimar in iwuon ema ne isiemowa ni mondo waket kiewo molworo got mondo owale obed maler.”
english: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

kikuyu: kuom dhok alufu piero adek gauchiel (36,000), pok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne gin dhok piero abiriyo gariyo (72);
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

kikuyu: To kapo ni upando nyiego mopongʼ gi mirima, gi gombo maricho mag chopo ichlit ma un-go e chunyu, to kik usungru kuom dwarou marichogo kukwedo adiera.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

kikuyu: Nyaka chame duto maonge modongʼ mana godiechiengno. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Chiwo mag cham kod misango miolo piny nyaka keti kaka chik dwaro maromre gi rwadhno, imno kod nyiimbego.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Ka chiayo moro nigi songa, ongʼol kata en muofu kata ka en gi mbala moro amora to ok onego utim kode misango ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Koro Zedekia ruodh Juda nokete e twech kanyo, kawacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ikoro wach kamano? Ka iwacho ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: Achiegni chiwo dala maduongʼni ne ruodh Babulon, kendo enoloye.
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

kikuyu: To ka dhako yie wiye boyo, to en duongʼ mare, nikech yie wich maboyo omiye kaka raum.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

kikuyu: Negijwangʼo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi kendo negilamo sirni milamo mag Ashera kod nyiseche manono. Mirima nomako Nyasaye gi jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem nikech richogi.
english: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

kikuyu: Wach maberni mar Yesu nolandore e Judea mangima kod gwenge mokiewo kode.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

kikuyu: “Jatich nowacho ni, ‘Jaduongʼ gima nende ichikowa osetim, to pod thuolo nitie.’
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

kikuyu: Chiwuru, to ibiro chiwonu. Ubiro yudo rapim maber, moiki kendo motiel mapongʼ thich, kendo oo oko. Nimar rapim mupimogo ema ibiro pimnugo un bende.”
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Bende ngʼato nyalo pondo kuonde mopandore mondo omi kik anene? Donge apongʼo polo gi piny?”
english: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says the LORD. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: mondo ngimani odhi maber, kendo udag amingʼa e piny.”
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

kikuyu: Jaote mane odhi luongo Mikaya nowachone niya “Jonabi duto osekoro wach achiel machalre, kagiwacho ni gima ber biro timore ni ruoth. In bende yie ikor wach maber kaka gisekorono.”
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chik ruoth, jootego nowuok piyo piyo mine oket milomeno e ohinga mar dala Susa. Ruoth gi Haman nobet piny mondo omethi, to dala maduongʼ mar Susa nobwok kowinjo wachno.
english: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.

kikuyu: To ji duto ok ongʼeyo wachni. Jomoko pod ongʼiyo gi nyiseche manono ma ka gichamo chiemo makamano to giparo mana ni en motimnigo nyasaye manono misango; to nikech chunygi mar pogo ber gi rach otho, gidoko mochido.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kikuyu: ma nonyiso kuom Kristo kane ochiere oa kuom joma otho, mi omiyo obedo e bade ma korachwich e polo,
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: Asemiyogi wachni, kendo piny ochayogi, nimar ok gin mag pinyni, mana kaka an bende ok an mar pinyni.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
