kikuyu: Saulo ne ja-higni piero adek kane ochako bedo ruoth kendo nobedo ruodh Israel kuom higni piero angʼwen gariyo.
english: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato ogoyo wadgi gi gima olos gi chuma, motho, to en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: ma en richo magu kaachiel gi richo mag kwereu,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Nikech negitimo misengini e gode mine gidwanyo nyinga e gode matindo, omiyo abiro kumogi chuth ka gineno kuom timbegi mosekadho.
english: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”

kikuyu: Enochal gi yien mopidh but pi ma tiende nyaa e tiend aora. Ok obed gi luoro ka liet obiro; ite osiko mana ka ngʼich. Oonge gi parruok e higa mar oro kendo ok owe ma ok onyago olemo.”
english: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

kikuyu: “Koro, wuod dhano, kaw matafare kendo ikete e nyimi mi igor dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem kuome.
english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

kikuyu: ma en piny machiego ngano kod shairi, mzabibu kod ngʼowu, olemo mongʼinore, zeituni kod mor kich.
english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

kikuyu: Kuom mano negidhi ir jarit od Josef kendo giwuoyo kode e dhoot.
english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

kikuyu: Gichalo nyithindo mobedo e chiro kendo luongore kendgi moro ka moro kagiwacho niya, “ ‘Ne wagoyonu asili, to ne ok umiel; bende ne wadengo ka wawero wend tho, to ne ok uywak.’
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

kikuyu: Ruoth Hezekia gi janabi Isaya wuod Amoz noywagore ka lemo e nyim polo kuom wachni.
english: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

kikuyu: Kane pod Jeremia oketi e agola kamane irite, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone mar ariyo ni:
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,

kikuyu: Eka nokela nyaka e laru maiye, kokalo koda e rangach man yo milambo, kendo nopimo rangajno. Pimne ne romre gi pim mar rangeye mamoko duto.
english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

kikuyu: Elihu nomedo wuoyo kawacho niya:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

kikuyu: Kane gineno chir mane Petro gi Johana nigo, kendo kane ginwangʼo ni gin ji ajia ma ok osomo, ne giwuoro ahinya, eka negifwenyo ni jogi yande nigi Yesu.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

kikuyu: “Donjuru gi dhorangach madiny. Nimar rangajno oyarore kendo yorno lach madhi e kethruok, kendo ji mathoth donjo koluwe.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

kikuyu: Yawuot Gershon kaluwore gi dhoodgi ne gin: Libni kod Shimei.
english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

kikuyu: Anywolana oseringo oweya; kendo osiepena wigi osewil koda.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Mara mi gidhi Elim, kuma ne nitie sokni apar gariyo kod yiend othidhe piero abiriyo, kendo negibuoro kanyo.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

kikuyu: “Ma e Musa mane onyiso jo-Israel ni, ‘Nyasaye noyiernu janabi machal koda kowuok e dier ogandau.’
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

kikuyu: Odongʼ nono, omaye gik moko duto, bende olonye modongʼ duk. Kibaji ogoyo chunygi, bende chongegi onyosere, kendo dendgi tetni ka ngʼato ka ngʼato wangʼe ojowore.
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel ne ok omonjogi, nikech jotend kambi nosesingore ka kwongʼore kodgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel. Kata kamano, ji duto nongʼur gi jotendgi,
english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi misango mar cham gi mogo mayom madirom kilo abiriyo moruw gi mo. Kendo misangono mondo owangʼe modungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye. Misango miolo piny to obed divai maromo lita achiel.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

kikuyu: Obiro nyisogi ni tamruok yie Kuoma en richo.
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

kikuyu: Nikech ich wangʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye, ok nobed gi joma odak e iye, to enobed gunda chuth. Jogo duto makalo Babulon, nobed gi bwok maduongʼ kendo nyiere nikech adhondene duto.
english: Because of the LORD’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

kikuyu: Ruoth nyalo, ohero bura makare, isechungo adiera; isetimo ne joka Jakobo gima adier kendo makare.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

kikuyu: Chunya riyo oloyo mar dwaro Nyasaye. En riyo mar dwaro Nyasaye mangima. Abiro dhi romo kod Nyasaye karangʼo?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

kikuyu: Bangʼe nodok ir jopuonjrene monwangʼo ka ginindo. Nopenjo Petro niya, “Joka ma, ne ok unyal rito koda kata kuom sa achiel kende?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

kikuyu: “Neuru! Jolweny biro koa yo nyandwat; oganda maduongʼ kod ruodhi mangʼeny itugo koa e tunge piny.
english: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Kik imed gimoro e wachne, to nono obiro kwedi mi onyis ni in ja-miriambo.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

kikuyu: To kata kamano kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo ne ok omuki kendo ji ne pok oketo chunygi kuom Nyasach kweregi.
english: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Eka negipenje niya, “Mano notimre kanye, Ruoth?” Nodwokogi niya, “Kama ringruok motho nitie, ema achudhe chokore.”
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

kikuyu: To Jehoshafat nopenjo niya, “Donge nitie janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye ka ma dwapenj wach?”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?”

kikuyu: “Yienwauru wakal e pinyu nikech wabiro luwo yo tir kendo ok wanabar e bat korachwich kata koracham.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Dwok odunga mar Harun e nyim Sandug Rapar, mondo kane kaka ranyisi ne joma ongʼanyo. Mano biro tieko chuth kitgi mar ngʼur koda, mondo omi kik githo.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne ne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Ibiro chalo ngʼat ma nindo e nam mar apaka matek, ka inindo ewi apaka.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

kikuyu: To moloyo mago duto, nyaka ungʼe ni onge wach mokor mar Muma ma janabi nyalo loko tiendgi gi pache owuon.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

kikuyu: Omiyo ritreuru uwegi. “Ka owadu otimo richo, kwere, to ka olokore oweyo richo, to wene.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

kikuyu: “Ruodhi mag Kanaan nobiro, mokedo; Tanak machiegni gi pige mag Megido, to ne ok gidhi gi fedha, kata kawo gimoro amora moyako.
english: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.

kikuyu: Bangʼe idhi ir ruoth kendo iwachne wechegi.” Joab nomiye weche monego owach.
english: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

kikuyu: Enoyike ka punda, moywa kendo owit oko mar dhorangeye Jerusalem.”
english: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Yaye Israel, jokoro magu chalo mana gi ondiegi modak e gunda.
english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

kikuyu: Anto awachonu kama: Heruru wasiku kendo lamuru ne joma sandou,
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼata otimo richo kendo otimo gima okwer e chik moro amora mar Jehova Nyasaye, kata obedo ni ok ongʼeye, to en richo kendo en okwane jaketho.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: Nomedo owacho niya, “Bi, mondo watem ka wanyalo chopo Gibea kata Rama mondo wabuor wanindi e achiel kuom miergo.”
english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

kikuyu: mi wuon mare owinjo singruokneno to ok owacho gimoro, to kwongʼruokneno nyaka siki.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: bende namiyo geche lweny kod farese odonjo kuno, kaachiel gi jolweny duto maroteke, kendo negirumo kuno ma ok gichako gitingʼo wigi mi githo mana ka taya monegi.
english: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:

kikuyu: mi nodhi gi jotelo apar mag dhout Israel kamoro ka moro ochungʼ ne dhoot ka dhoot.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Eliazar wuod Harun nokendo achiel kuom nyi Putiel, kendo nonywolone Finehas. Magi ema ne jotend dhout joka Lawi.
english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

kikuyu: Negimedo penje niya, “Ka en kamano, to wengeni nokelo yawore nade?”
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa, Harun kod jotend Israel nokwano jo-Lawi duto kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi.
english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: to nikech Yesu ngima nyaka chiengʼ, tich dolo mare osiko.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

kikuyu: Boaz nokawo jodongo apar mag dala kendo nowachonegi niya, “Beduru ane ka,” mine gitimo kamano.
english: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Satan niya, “Mano ber, koro en e lweti; makmana ni ngimane ema kik imul.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

kikuyu: “Eka ruodhno noluongo jatichneno ire, mowachone ni, ‘An ne aweni gopa mane in-go duto nikech ne iywagorina mondo atim kamano.
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

kikuyu: Jatend anywola mar joka Gilead wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase, mane oa e dhout nyikwa Josef, nobiro mi owuoyo e nyim Musa kod jotelo, ma gin jotend anywola mag jo-Israel.
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne ok onego yawuot jogo nikech noluwo chik manie Kitap Chik mar Musa mane Jehova Nyasaye oketo mawacho niya, “Wuone ok nonegi nikech ketho mag nyithindgi, bende nyithindo kik negi nikech ketho mag wuonegi, to ngʼato ka ngʼato nonegi nikech richone owuon.”
english: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

kikuyu: Higa ka higa ngʼato ka ngʼato manobiro nokelo mich kaka gik molos gi fedha kod dhahabu, kandho, gige lweny, gik mangʼwe ngʼar, farese kod punde.
english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

kikuyu: To ruoth noumo wangʼe, koywak matek niya, “Yaye Abisalom wuoda! Yaye Abisalom wuoda, wuoda!”
english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

kikuyu: Hera timo kinda, kendo ongʼwon, oonge nyiego, ok osungre, bende ok opakre.
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

kikuyu: “To ruodhi mag piny mane oterore kode, kendo bedo kode e ngima moyombore noywage kendo sedo kod nyinge ka gineno yiro madum ka owangʼ.
english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

kikuyu: “Moab oseyweyo chakre tin-ne, ka divai mowe mos e aguche, ma ok ool koa ei agulu achiel kiloko machielo kendo pod ok odhi e twech. Omiyo ndhathe pod nikare, kendo tik mare ok olokore.”
english: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

kikuyu: Kane Isaka oseti kendo wengene noseimore makoro ok nyal neno, noluongo Esau wuode makayo kendo owachone niya, “Wuoda.” Eka Esau nodwoke niya, “An ka.”
english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Joshua nokedo gi jo-Amalek mana kaka Musa nochiko, kendo Musa gi Harun kod Hur nodhi ewi got.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

kikuyu: To mae ok e gima oparo timo to bende ma ok e gima ni e pache; to dwarone en ketho kendo tieko ogendini mangʼeny.
english: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

kikuyu: nimar ongʼeyo kaka ochweyowa, ongʼeyo e pache ni wan mana buch lowo.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

kikuyu: Ngʼat molony gi chik nodwoko niya, “En ngʼat mane okeche.” Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Dhi kendo itim kamano.”
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

kikuyu: “To ka uwacho, ‘Ok wanadagie pinyni,’ mamano mi ubed ma ok uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu,
english: “‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land,” so that you don’t obey the LORD your God’s voice,

kikuyu: Isemiyo gichamo pi wangʼ ka kuon kendo isemiyo gimodho pi wangʼ agwetni modhuro.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

kikuyu: Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi, Nyasaye Maler mar Israel, ma Jawarni; achiwo Misri gi Kush kod Seba ka gir chudo mondo oresigo.
english: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

kikuyu: Omiyo noluonge ire kendo nopenje ni, ‘En angʼo mawinjo kuomini? Chiw ane kwan kuom gigo duto mirito, nikech ok inyal bedo jarit giga kendo ngangʼ!’
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorene kanyo e ligek mach maliel e dier bungu. Musa noneno ni kata obedo ni mach nomako bunguno, bunguno to ne ok wangʼ.
english: The LORD’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

kikuyu: “Ka owadu ochwanyi to dhi kendo inyise kethone, mana e kindu kode ji ariyo. Ka ochikoni ite mowinjo to mano iseloso kindi gi owaduno.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

kikuyu: “Ka uhera to ubiro timo gima achikou.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Eka dala maduongʼni nomi abed gihuma, ilo, pak kod luor e nyim ogendini duto manie piny mawinjo gik moko duto mabeyo masetimone; kendo ginibed gi luoro mi ginitetni kuom gweth mogundho kod kwe masechiwone.’
english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

kikuyu: Eka Solomon nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osewacho ni enodag ei bor polo motimo mudho.
english: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamayo wuon mare kata min, to owacho niya, “Timo kamano ok rach,” ochal gi ngʼat maketho gimoro.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa, koro reswa e lwet Senakerib mondo pinjeruodhi duto manie piny ongʼe ni in kendi e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye.”
english: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the LORD, even you only.”

kikuyu: To Mikaya nowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni, anyalo mana nyise gima Nyasacha owacho.”
english: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”

kikuyu: Ratege molwororego noket machiegni gi bethe mesano mondo omak ludhego mitiyogo kuom tingʼo mesa.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Tiendene ochomo kar tho, to ondamo mage ochiko bur tir.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nopenje niya, “To ere nyakwar ruodhi?” Ziba nowachone niya, “Odongʼ Jerusalem, nikech oparo ni, ‘Kawuononi jo-Israel dhi dwokona loch kwara.’ ”
english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”

kikuyu: Runduru musmeno, nikech cham ochiek. Biuru, unyon yiend Zeituni nikech kar biyo mzabibu opongʼ, kendo degni opongʼ mopukore. Mano kaka timbegi maricho dongo!”
english: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”

kikuyu: mane otelo nyimu e wuodhu, gotieno notelonu gi mach to godiechiengʼ notelonu gi rumbi mondo umany kuonde monego ubworie kendo onyisu yo monego uluw.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni e sa ma jadolo nono adhola makamano, ok onenore ni odholore kendo onge yier maratengʼ kuome, eka jadolo noket ngʼama tuoni kar kende kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

kikuyu: Nodhi kedo kod jo-Filistia momuko ohinga mar Gath gi Jabne kod Ashdod. Bangʼe nogero mier machiegni kod Ashdod, kod kuonde mamoko ei piny Filistia.
english: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ka chiengʼ wuok gokinyi, to suduru machiegni gi dala maduongʼ, mondo ka Gaal gi joge wuok e dala maduongʼ mondo omonju, to timnegiuru gimoro amora ma unyalo timo.”
english: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”

kikuyu: Ere ngʼama dihinyu ka uikoru mar timo gima ber?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

kikuyu: kendo ilos rachungi mar taya piero angʼwen mag fedha miketo e bwogi, ka rachungi ariyo iketo e bwo sirni ariyo momanyore.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Ok osik komanyo ketho kuom ji, bende ok okan mirimbe nyaka chiengʼ;
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma otamore rito chik Musa ne inego ma ok okechi e nyim joneno ariyo kata adek.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Kata mana nyamnaha manie kor polo ongʼeyo kindene moketne, kendo akuch odugla, opija gi ongo-wangʼ bende ongʼeyo ndalo mar dargi. To joga ok ongʼeyo dwach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Pige matut oseimogi duto, kendo gisenimo nyaka e bwo pi mana ka kidi.
english: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.

kikuyu: Mich mochiw lingʼ-lingʼ kweyo mirima to asoya mopandi ei law jiwo mirima maduongʼ.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

kikuyu: Nimar abiro kelo koth ne piny mobaro okak kendo loso aore e piny motwo; bende anaol Roho mara ne nyikwayi kendo anagwedh kothi.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

kikuyu: Yesu noluongo oganda ire kendo mowachonegi niya, “Chikuru itu mondo uwinj tiend wach.
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

kikuyu: Yawuowi gi nyiri nopongʼ yore mag dala ka gitugoe.”
english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel ne ok obedo jo-ratiro kaluwore gi gik mane owal ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼat mane nyinge Akan wuod Karmi, ma wuod Zabdi, ma wuod Zera, mar dhood Juda nokawo moko kuom gik mane owalgi. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nobedo gi mirima gi jo-Israel.
english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Mondo omi ibed gi geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye; apuonji tinendeni, in bende.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mochamo ringʼono nyaka luok lepe, kendo enobed mogak nyaka chop seche mag odhiambo. Kata ngʼato angʼata motingʼo chiayono bende nyaka luok lepe, bende nosik mogak nyaka chop seche mag odhiambo.
english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobi gi mor polo gi yiengni mar piny kod koko maduongʼ, gi ahiti kod kalausi kendo gi mach mager.
english: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

kikuyu: Ne en Chiengʼ Ikruok (ma en odiechiengʼ motelone Sabato). Omiyo ka nochopo seche mag odhiambo,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo nyaka kawuono jo-Israel ok cham ringʼo moriwo fuond bam ka giparogo wil mar fuond bam Jakobo.
english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto nongʼur ne Musa kod Harun, kendo chokruok mar oganda duto nowachonegi niya, “Donge dine ber ka watho Misri? Kata mana e thim ka!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

kikuyu: Giketho yora, gidwaro tieka chuth. Giwacho ni, ‘Onge ngʼama nyalo konye.’
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

kikuyu: “Anachang-gi kuom baro margi mane gibarogo, kendo anahergi maonge achuna, nimar mirimba osewuok kuomgi.
english: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.

kikuyu: “Saulo gi Jonathan ne oher kendo ne gin joma longʼo kane gingima, kendo e kinde thogi ne ok gipogore. Negiringo matek maloyo ongo, kendo ne gitek maloyo sibuor.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

kikuyu: Adwaro mondo ungʼe kaka akedonu matek, kaachiel gi joma ni Laodikia gi ji mamoko duto mapok onena gi wangʼ-gi.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

kikuyu: Eka kerubi achiel norieyo bade nyaka e mach mane ni butgi. Nopogo mach moko mi oketo e lwet ngʼat mane orwako law mayomno, kendo ngʼatno nokawo majno mowuok odhi.
english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

kikuyu: Apoya nono Musa gi Elija nothinyore e nyimgi kanyo kendo ne giwuoyo gi Yesu.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

kikuyu: Wuoda, winji kendo yie gima awacho eka higni mag ngimani nobed mangʼeny.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo isechayo wach Jehova Nyasaye ka itimo gima rach machal kama e wangʼe? Ne inego Uria ja-Hiti gi ligangla mi ikawo chiege mondo obed mari iwuon. Ne inege gi ligangla jo-Amon.
english: Why have you despised the LORD’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne en dwaro Jehova Nyasaye mondo sande malit koyudo chandruok, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo ngimane mondo obed misango mar pwodhruok e ketho, to enone nyikwaye kendo omedne ndalo, kendo dwaro mar Nyasaye nochop kare nikech en.
english: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

kikuyu: Donge ne en nikech kend ma kamagi mane omiyo Solomon ruodh Israel otimo richo? E dier ogendini duto ne onge ruoth machal kode. Nohere gi Nyasache, kendo Nyasaye nokete ruoth ewi jo-Israel duto, to kata kamano mon ma ok jo-Yahudi nomiyo otimo richo.
english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anakelnegi masira ma ok ginyal tonye. Kata bed ni giywakna, ok anawinjgi.
english: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

kikuyu: Ikuru ogendini mondo oked kod ruodhi mag Medes, jotendgi kod jodong-gi duto, kaachiel gi pinje duto ma gitelonegi.
english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!

kikuyu: “Yienwauru wakal e pinyu. Ok wanabar tenge e puothu moro amora kata e mago mag mzabibu, kata modho pi moa e soko moro amora. Wabiro wuotho e yor ruoth moriere tir nyaka wakal pinyruodhi.”
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

kikuyu: eka gidhi gikel wuonu kod joode duto mondo gidwog ira. Abiro miyogi kama ber moloyo e piny Misri kendo ginicham gik machiek e lopni.”
english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

kikuyu: kuma nodakie nyaka chop tho mar Herode. Kamano gima Ruoth nowacho chon gi dho janabi nochopo kare niya, “Ne aluongo wuoda ka agolo Misri.”
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek orito ngʼeyone e iye, to chuny joma ofuwo wuoyo ma ok opimo.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

kikuyu: E kindeno: “Nuwerne puoth mzabibu mamiyo kama:
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye norwak chiwo mag Juda kod Jerusalem mana kaka ndalo mokadho.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

kikuyu: To kaka nosesiemgi e lek ni kik gidog ir Herode, negidok thurgi gi yo machielo.
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

kikuyu: Adieri gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ma reso Israel, kata ka en wuoda Jonathan ema wachni omako to nyaka otho.” To onge ngʼat machielo mane owuoyo.
english: For as the LORD lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

kikuyu: kendo kama bur ne nitiereno, kido marachar mokuot kata mobokore mamarmar onenore, to nyaka odhi ir jadolo.
english: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

kikuyu: E kindeno ngʼato biro yudo konyruokne koa kuom nyaroya kod diek ariyo.
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “Asetimo richo. To kiyie to miya luor e nyim jodong joga kendo e nyim jo-Israel; dog koda mondo mi alam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi.”
english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: “To kata kamano ne ok uluonga mondo akonyu, yaye Jakobo, useol koda, yaye Israel.
english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

kikuyu: Kik iket tekri kuom mon, kata nyalo mari kuom jogo maketho ruodhi.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

kikuyu: “Kane Musa koro ja-higni piero angʼwen, noparo e chunye mondo odhi olim owetene ma jo-Israel.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni onge piny moro kata pinyruoth moro ma ruodha pok oseore ngʼato mondo omanyi. To e kinde moro amora mane piny moro kata pinyruoth moro owacho ni ionge kuno, nomiyo gikwongʼore ni ne ok ginyal yudi.
english: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

kikuyu: Ruodhi angʼwen-go noyako gik moko duto mag Sodom kod Gomora kod chiembgi duto mi gidhi.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

kikuyu: Luong Jesse e sawo mar misango, to abiro nyisi gima onego itim. Ibiro wirona ngʼat mabiro nyisi.”
english: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

kikuyu: enogol maua mabeyo, mi nobed gi mor ka ogoyo koko gi ilo. Enobed gi duongʼ mar Lebanon, gi mor mar Karmel kod Sharon; ginine duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa maber.
english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ruoth notamo Joab gi jotelo mag lweny; kuom mano ne giwuok e nyim ruoth mondo gidhi gikwan jolweny e Israel.
english: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

kikuyu: Nosoyo lwete ei mifukune mogolo kidi; eka noketo kidino e orujre mine odiro mogoyogo lend wangʼ ja-Filistiano. Kidi nodonjo e lend wangʼe mine opodho piny auma.
english: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

kikuyu: Noriek moloyo ngʼato angʼata moriwo kata mana Ethan ja-Ezra kendo riek moloyo Heman gi Kalkol kod Darda yawuot Mahol. Kendo humbe nolandore e pinje molwore duto.
english: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo chike mawacho ni: ‘Kik iterri, kik ineki, kik ikwal, kik ihang wach, luor wuonu gi minu.’”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone wuowi mane okelone wach niya, “Ere kaka ingʼeyo ni Saulo gi wuode Jonathan osetho?”
english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo noluongou kane urwako Injili mane wayalonu mondo un bende uyud duongʼ mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Koseriw-wa kode kamano e thone, to ochuno ni ibiro riwwa kode bende e chierne.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

kikuyu: “Kuom kinde moko moromo nodagi, to bangʼe mogik nowacho kende owuon ni, ‘Kata obedo ni ok aluoro Nyasaye kendo ok adewo ji kamano
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

kikuyu: Nothedhne ratege angʼwen molworore mag dhahabu machalo gi bangli kendo notwegi e tiendene angʼwen-go, ka ratege ariyo bedo e bathe konchiel to ariyo mamoko e bathe komachielo.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

kikuyu: Eka Bathsheba nokulore piny auma nyaka e lowo ka ogoyo chonge piny e nyim ruoth kowacho niya, “Mad ruodha Daudi Jaloch dag amingʼa!”
english: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia, kawacho niya:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, en ema nochweyo piny, Jehova Nyasaye mane olose kendo oketo mise mare, Jehova Nyasaye e nyinge:
english: “The LORD who does it, the LORD who forms it to establish it—the LORD is his name, says:

kikuyu: Bangʼ mago duto, Joshua wuod Nun, jatich Jehova Nyasaye, notho ka en gi higni mia achiel gapar.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, donge in ema nyaka nene? Yaye, Nyasacha, Nyasaye Maler, ok wanatho. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iseyierogi mondo gibednwa jongʼad bura. Yaye Nyasaye ma Lwanda, isewalogi mondo gikel kum.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

kikuyu: Gimoro achiel ema timore ni ngʼat makare gi ngʼat ma jaricho, ngʼat maler, gi ngʼat ma ok ler, ngʼat malamo Nyasaye, gi ngʼat ma ok lam Nyasaye. Bende onge pogruok mantie e kind ngʼat malongʼo, gi ngʼat ma timbene mono, kata manie kind ngʼat makwongʼore ni biro chiwo misango ni Nyasaye kod ngʼat moluoro kwongʼruok ma kamano.
english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

kikuyu: Nyiri mofuwo nowachone mago mariek ni, ‘Pognwauru mafuta matin, nikech techewa dwa tho.’
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

kikuyu: Jariemb faras noringo moromo gi Jehu mowachone niya, “Ruodha penjo kama: ‘Bende ubiro e yor kwe?’ ” Jehu nodwoke niya, “Kwe to obadhi angʼo? Luw bangʼa.” Jangʼicho nodwoko wach ni Joram ni, “Jaote osechopo irgi, to ok ane koduogo.”
english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

kikuyu: Gilwora koni gi koni gi weche mag achaya; gibuka maonge gima omiyo.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

kikuyu: Ne onge gimoro ei Sandug Muma makmana kite ariyo mopa mane Musa oketo e iye kane en Horeb kama Jehova Nyasaye ne otimoe singruok kod jo-Israel kane gisewuok Misri.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Jo-Aram mane oa yo wuok chiengʼ kod jo-Filistia mane oa yo podho chiengʼ; osetieko jo-Israel pep. Kata ka magi duto osetimore, to mirimbe pod ok orumo kuomgi kendo pod odhi nyime mana gikumogi.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo ir Hilkia jadolo maduongʼ kendo oik pesa mosekel e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane jorit dhoot nosechoko kuom ji.
english: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into the LORD’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.

kikuyu: Ne watimo kamano ok nikech ne waonge gi ratiro mar yudo kony moa kuomu, to ne wadwaro mondo wabednu ranyisi maber ma unyalo luwo.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

kikuyu: Ngima kuom ndalo mangʼeny ni e lwete korachwich; to e lwete koracham nitiere mwandu kod duongʼ.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

kikuyu: Ka iyanyou nikech nying Kristo to kwanreuru kaka joma ogwedhi, nikech Roho mar duongʼ kendo mar Nyasaye ni kuomu.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

kikuyu: Koguru gi mor ni Jehova Nyasaye, un piny duto, weruru kod ilo gi dwol mamit;
english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

kikuyu: Mikaya nodwoke niya, “Ibiro fwenyo chiengʼ ma iniring kidhi pondo e ot maiye.”
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato omak pongʼ rego kata nyapongʼ kaka gir singo mar gowi, nikech mano chalo kaka ngʼama okawo ngima ngʼato owuon kaka gir singo.
english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

kikuyu: ok otimnwa mowinjore gi richowa bende ok ochulwa kaluwore gi kethowa.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

kikuyu: mane oresa e lwet wasika; ne itingʼa malo e kind wasika ne iresa e lwet jo-mahundu.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kikuyu: Ka girito mondo gimake gi gimoro amora mane onyalo wacho.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼat mane okomo kodhi mabeyo en Wuod Dhano.
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

kikuyu: Nikech kata obedo ni tuke mag rieyo del konyo ji e yore moko, to luoro Nyasaye nigi gweth mathoth moloyo, en gi ohala e ngima masani kendo e ngima mabiro bende.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

kikuyu: To kuom Moab: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel wacho: “Mano kaka nobed malit ne Nebo, nimar enokethe. Kiriathaim nokuod wiye kendo enomake; kar pondogi nobed kama inyiero kendo nomuke.
english: Of Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

kikuyu: Mad dhoga pongʼ gi pak, nimar isepuonja chikeni.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Nochweyo wangʼ chiengʼ mondo orit odiechiengʼ, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Magdiel kod Iram. Magi e jodongo mag Edom.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

kikuyu: Pasia mag hemano nobed fut achiel gi nus e bathe koni gi koni; to bathe modongʼ nolier e bath Hemb Romo mondo oume.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye odagi ji duto man-gi sunga e chunygi. Ngʼe ma malongʼo: Ok ginitony ni kum.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat mariek mayo ji to obedo ngʼama ofuwo, to ngʼama kawo asoya kethore kende owuon.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo chuny ji mangʼeny chandre, chiengʼ ma anakel kethruokni e dier ogendini, kendo e dier pinje mapok ingʼeyo.
english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

kikuyu: mana kaka koro usengʼeyowa moromo, e kaka ubiro medo ngʼeyowa chuth, mondo uchop e okangʼ munyalo sungoru nikech wan, mana kaka wan bende wabiro sungore nikech un e odiechieng Ruoth Yesu.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Owetena, ka ngʼato kuomu obaro oweyo adiera, mi ngʼat moro odwoke e yo,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

kikuyu: koa kuom oganda Asher neginwangʼo Mashal, Abdon,
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Nimar ne adenyo to ne umiya gimoro achamo; riyo noloya, to ne umiya gimoro amodho; ne an wendo; kendo nurwaka ei ot;
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

kikuyu: Ka giyie ma giyawo dhorangeyegi, to ji duto man kanyo nobed e bwo loch e tich matek kendo ginitinu.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

kikuyu: Mond Daudi ariyo bende ne osemaki ma gin Ahinoam nyar Jezreel gi Abigael ma dhako ma chwore otho mane jaod Nabal ja-Karmel.
english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua wuod Nun noluongo jodolo mowachonegi niya, “Tingʼuru Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo beduru gi jodolo abiriyo kotingʼo turumbete e nyime.”
english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the LORD’s ark.”

kikuyu: eka iniwinj malongʼo tiend luoro Jehova Nyasaye, kendo iniyud rieko mar ngʼeyo Nyasaye.
english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

kikuyu: Twegiuru e ngʼut lweteu kaka ranyisi kendo bawgiuru e lela wengeu.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

kikuyu: Jalno ma en Pok mar Jakobo ok chal kodgi, nimar en e Jachwech mar gik moko duto, nyaka Israel, ma en dhood girkeni mare, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: Kik uluorgi; nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu owuon nokednu.”
english: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”

kikuyu: Yesu noidho yie mi ongʼado nam nyaka loka komachielo, mi nochopo e dala kama ne onywole.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

kikuyu: Kane owinjo ka agoyo uwi matek mondo okonya, noringo moweyo lawe sa ma noringo owuok oko mar ot.”
english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jonathan noluongo Daudi monyise weche duto mane giwacho. Nokele ir Saulo, mi Daudi nobedo gi Saulo kaka nosebet mokwongo.
english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

kikuyu: Hukok kod Rehob, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath;
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Lepu ne ok oti kendo tiendeu ne ok opudhore kata okuot kuom higni piero angʼwen-go duto.
english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osechiko, ‘Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka chok mangʼeny kaka odwaro. Kaw moromo ngʼato ka ngʼato ma udakgo.’ ”
english: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

kikuyu: Meshelemia ne nigi yawuowi kod wedene, giduto ne gin ji apar gaboro man-gi nyalo.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda nodhi gi jo-Simeon mowetegi mi gimonjo jo-Kanaan modak Zefath, kendo negiketho dala maduongʼno chuth. Emomiyo noluonge ni Horma.
english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

kikuyu: ne oolo mana piny ka koth mondo ji ocham, adier, nomiyogi chiemb polo.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

kikuyu: Onyalo chamo chiemb Nyasache, bedni ogol chiemono kuom gik maler kata kuom gik maler moloyo;
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

kikuyu: Kaka wangʼeyo gima luoro Ruoth en, wajiwo ji mondo gidwog ire. Wan to Nyasaye ongʼeyowa malongʼo, kendo ageno ni un bende ungʼeyowa malongʼo chuth e chunyu maiye.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

kikuyu: Ok obi goyo koko kata nduru, dwonde bende ok nowinji e wangʼ yore.
english: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

kikuyu: Kik uwe mak urwako welo e uteu, nikech jomoko kuom timo kamano oserwako koda ka malaike ka ok gingʼeyo.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

kikuyu: Azor ne en wuon Zadok, Zadok ne en wuon Akim, to Akim ne en wuon Eliud.
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

kikuyu: Omiyo Abram nowuok kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosenyise kendo Lut nodhi kode. Abram ne ja-higni piero abiriyo gabich kane owuok Haran.
english: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

kikuyu: Ne owachonegi niya, “Kelnauru bakul manyien kendo uket chumbi e iye.” Omiyo negitimo kamano.
english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

kikuyu: Godiechiengʼ Jehova Nyasaye netelonegi gi bor polo mondo otelnegi e yorgi kendo gotieno notelonegi gi ligek mach mondo omigi ler, mondo mi negiwuothi odiechiengʼ kata otieno.
english: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

kikuyu: Ne iyangʼo nyithinda kendo ichiwogi kaka misango ne nyiseche ma dhano oloso.
english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

kikuyu: Emomiyo nowacho ni nobiro tiekogi ka dine Musa, ngʼate moyiero, we chungʼ kaywagore e nyime mondo ogengʼ mirimbe kik otiekgi.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

kikuyu: Nyaka temgi mokwongo, to ka oyud ni onge wach moro marach kuomgi eka mondo yienegi bedo jokony.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

kikuyu: Lworuru dala maduongʼno dichiel ka un gi giu mag lweny kendo timuru ma kuom ndalo auchiel.
english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

kikuyu: Kane obiro irgi e kindeno, nogoyo erokamano ni Nyasaye kendo nowuoyo kuom nyathi ni ji duto mane ogeno kuom resruok mar Jerusalem.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kawuono iseriemba e lowo kendo ibiro pandona wangʼi; abiro bet ngʼat maonge kar dak mabayo abaya e piny kendo ngʼato angʼata moyuda nonega.”
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo useyiene mon mondo obed mangima?”
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

kikuyu: Magi ema ne jodong jo-Hori: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Ana,
english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

kikuyu: E ngima madakie maonge tiendeni asefwenyo ni ngʼat ma ja-ratiro rumo nikech ratiro mare kendo ngʼat ma jaricho dak ndalo mangʼeny kotimo richo.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

kikuyu: Omiyo Gideon noterogi e dho pi. Kanyo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Pog jogo magado pi gi lewgi kaka guok kuom jogo magoyo chong-gi piny mondo omodhi.”
english: So he brought down the people to the water; and the LORD said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano nokechogi e chandruokgi kane owinjo ywakgi;
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Magi duto abiro miyi ka ikulorina piny kendo ilama.”
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

kikuyu: Eka nochako ooro jotich mamoko irgi; jotich mangʼeny moloyo mago mane ooro mokwongo, kendo gin bende negitimonegi machalre.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

kikuyu: Yawuowi ma ngʼato onywolo kapod otin, chalo gi asere manie lwet jakedo.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

kikuyu: “Ka onywome bangʼ ka osekwongʼore kata orikni ochiwo singruok motweye
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

kikuyu: Chikeni miyo abedo gi winjo; emomiyo achayo yo moro amora marach.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

kikuyu: Ka malaika nofwenyore ne Gideon, nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ni kodi, in jalweny maratego.”
english: The LORD’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

kikuyu: Nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “En angʼo momiyo isekelo chandruok ma kama ne jatichni? En angʼo ma asetimo ma ok mori momiyo imiya tingʼ mapek mar jogi duto?
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

kikuyu: To ka ok iweyo joga mondo odhi, to abiro kelo lwangʼni kuomi, kuom jodongi, kuom jogi kod ei uteu duto. Ute jo-Misri biro pongʼ gi lwangʼni kata mana e lowo kama gintie bende biro pongʼ.
english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

kikuyu: Ka ochopo Higa mar Piero Abich mi oweyo puodhono, to nobed gima ler kaka puodho moyangne Jehova Nyasaye chuth, kendo puodhono nodongʼne jadolo kaka mwandune chuth.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

kikuyu: Nobawo hekalu gi dhahabu koda ka sirni, gi Sirni mag dhoudi gi yiend tado, kor udi gi dhoudi, kendo nogoro malaika mar kerubi e kor udi.
english: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

kikuyu: Ere kaka diwach ne owadu ni; owadwa, yie mondo agolni ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼi, ka in iwuon ok inyal neno pilni maduongʼ mar yath manie wangʼi iwuon? In ngʼat mawuondoreni, mokwongo gol pilni maduongʼ mar yath manie wangʼi iwuon oko, eka ibiro neno maler mar golo ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼ wadu oko.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw nyaim mar misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho kaachiel gi morno, kendo nochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Manase ne ja-higni apar gariyo kane odoko ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero abich gabich. Min mare ne nyinge Hefziba.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gabich ne mar Jerimoth gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kane ngʼatno oneno Petro gi Johana kadonjo ei hekalu, nokwayogi kony.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

kikuyu: Chutho, kaka an gi adiera mar Kristo, onge ngʼama biro mona pakora e gwenge mag Akaya.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

kikuyu: Chwo duto mahikgi piero adek nyaka piero abich mane obiro tiyo e tij Hemb Romo,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Daniel, in ngʼat ma Nyasaye ogeno ahinya, aa malo kendo par matut kuom weche ma adwaro nyisigi, nikech koro oseora iri.” To ka nowachona kamano, nachungʼ malo ka atetni.
english: He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

kikuyu: Eka oganda mane ochokore duto nooro chiwo mar kwe ne jo-Benjamin e lwanda mar Rimon.
english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

kikuyu: Jo-ohala madongo manie pinje mamoko liyo ka wuoro; giko mari obedo marach miwuoro, kendo ok nochak oneni kendo.’ ”
english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”

kikuyu: Bangʼ tho Ibrahim, Nyasaye nogwedho wuode Isaka, mane kindeno odak Beer-Lahai-Roi.
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

kikuyu: Ei Israel duto ne onge ngʼama ipako ni jaber ka Abisalom. Koa e wiye nyaka e pat tiende ne oonge gi mbala moro amora kuome.
english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

kikuyu: Ngima makareni mar Nyasaye, yudore e yor yie kuom Yesu Kristo ne ji duto moyie. Onge pogruok;
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Gad; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen mia abich (40,500).
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

kikuyu: To gimoro amora ma ok ler, kata ngʼato matimo gik makwero, kata mariambo, ok nodonjie, makmana jogo ma nying-gi ondiki e kitap Nyarombo mar ngima kende.
english: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

kikuyu: Joma oa yo podho chiengʼ mar pinje manie dho nam nobi gi yiedhigi mondo oked kode mi luoro nomake. Bangʼ mano nodog ka en gi mirima mager mondo oked gi ngʼat man-gi singruok maler. Enoluw weche mag joma oseweyo luwo singruok malerno.
english: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

kikuyu: Pak odogne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi mosebedo mamor kodi moketi e kom lochne kaka ruoth mondo itine Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi. Nikech hera ma Nyasachi oherogo Israel to gi dwarone mondo oritgi nyaka chiengʼ omiyo oseketi ruodhgi mondo ingʼad bura makare.”
english: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

kikuyu: Nyithindo ne olarore e iye mi nowacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ma timorena?” Omiyo nodhi mondo openj Jehova Nyasaye wachni.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, negisiko ka gikelona wach mar timne maber kendo nyise gima awacho. To Tobia nodhi nyime ka orona barupe mondo gibwogago.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu kik par mana kuom gik makonye en owuon, to nyaka upar bende kuom gik makonyo jomoko bende.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

kikuyu: Ok iniluor masira mar otieno, kata asere machielore godiechiengʼ,
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasacha, aywagora odiechiengʼ duto to ok idwoka, aywagora gotieno bende ma ok alingʼ.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

kikuyu: Ne imiyo waringo e nyim wasigu kendo joma kedo kodwa oseyakowa.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodongo kod joka ruoth mane odak e dala maduongʼ mar Naboth notimo kaka Jezebel nochikogi e barupego mane osendikonigi.
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo bende ni chik ok oket ni joma kare, to okete ni joketh chik gi jonjore; gi joma okia Nyasaye, kod joricho, gi joma timbegi ochido, kod joma odagi lemo; bende ni joma nego wuonegi kata minegi. Bende chikno oket ni jonek
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

kikuyu: Omiyo abiro guro singruok mara kodi, kendo ibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;

kikuyu: Jomoko mane kadho machiegni noneno ringreno kowit piny kanyo, ka sibuor ochungʼ but ringruokno kendo negidhi mi gilando wachno e dala mane janabi moticha odakie.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

kikuyu: Chiw kongʼo ne jogo ma chunygi ool, to math makech ne jogo ma chunygi lit.
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

kikuyu: Piny biro dongʼ nono, nikech timbe maricho mag ji modak e iye.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo chunyu maiye mar parou oloki obed manyien,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

kikuyu: Nikech ka joma otho ok chier, to kata Kristo bende pok ochier.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Ka masira obiro, to ginidwar kwe to ok giniyudi.
english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare nyalo bedo gi chandruok mangʼeny, to Jehova Nyasaye rese kuomgi duto;
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

kikuyu: Nikech chik keto joma nyap mondo obed jodolo madongo, to weche kwongʼruok mane obiro achien bangʼ chik, noketo Wuowi, makoro oseket kare chuth nyaka chiengʼ.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

kikuyu: Ochoko pige mag nembe madongo e tawo; oketo kut e dere.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ne Harun kod yawuote ma Eliazar gi Ithamar niya, “Kik uwe wiu bed mogar, bende kik uyiech lepu, nono to ubiro tho kendo Jehova Nyasaye iye biro wangʼ gi ogandani duto. To wedeu kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto to nyalo ywago joma Jehova Nyasaye osetieko gi mach.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.

kikuyu: Ne asingoranegi e thim kakwongʼora ni abiro keyogi e dier ogendini e piny ngima,
english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,

kikuyu: Kar chakruok Nyasaye nochweyo polo gi piny.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: Nikech wangʼeyo ni ka olok tich dolo to chik bende nyaka loki.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

kikuyu: Kinyne, mane en odiechiengʼ maluwo Chiengʼ Ikruok, jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai nodhi ir Pilato.
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

kikuyu: Bangʼe jodolo bangʼe nowuok oa Kama Ler. Jodolo duto mane ni kanyo nopwodhore ka ok odewo ni gin e migepe mage mag tich.
english: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

kikuyu: Isaka nogero kendo mar misango kuno kendo noluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye. Nogero hembe kanyo mi jotichne nokunyo soko moro kanyo.
english: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Amon oneno ka jo-Aram ringo tony, gin bende negiringo ka gitony e nyim Abishai mi gidonjo e dala maduongʼ. Omiyo Joab noweyo kedo gi jo-Amon modok Jerusalem.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ma e kwan gik mane ochiw: Dise mag dhahabu piero adek, dise mag fedha alufu achiel, kareche mag fedha piero ariyo gochiko,
english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kuom jonabi: “Anami gicham chiemo makech kendo modh pi motimo sum, nikech koa kuom jonabi mag Jerusalem kia Nyasaye oselandore e piny ngima.”
english: Therefore the LORD of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”

kikuyu: To nikech weche mag terruok ngʼeny, ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka bed gi chiege owuon kendo dhako ka dhako obed gi chwore owuon.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

kikuyu: Nimar ka Nyasaye ne ok okecho bede madier, to kata un bende ok obi weyou.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano nimar nowacho gie chunye niya, “Ka anyalo mulo mana riak lawe kende to abiro chango.”
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Kanyo negimiye divai moru gi yath makweyo rem miluongo ni mane-mane mondo omadhi, to nodagi.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

kikuyu: Ngai to ne giseloso gi bepe mag yiend ober moa Bashan, to bepe mag saipras moa e dho nembe mag saipras ema ne gilosogo kuonde bet magi, mane olangi gi lak liech.
english: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.

kikuyu: kod dwe gi sulwe mondo orit otieno; Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Nowachone ruoth niya, “Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Nyasaye onge e Israel ka koso mamiyo uoro joote mondo upenj Baal-Zebub ma nyasach Ekron wach? Nikech isetimo ma ok inichungi e kitanda mar midekre minindeno, nyaka itho!”
english: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

kikuyu: omiyo noa malo oweyo chiemo, kendo nongʼwano kandhone bangʼe otweyo taulo e nungone.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

kikuyu: Eka hekalu mar Nyasaye noyaw e polo, kendo Sandug Muma mar singruok nonenore ei hekalu; to mil polo marieny mager gi riadruok, koko kod mor polo gi yiengni mar piny nobetie kendo kodh pe nochwe mangʼeny.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

kikuyu: Saulo nopenje niya, “Marangʼo useriworuna, in kod wuod Jesse, ka imiye makati, kod ligangla kendo ka ipenjone wach kuom Nyasaye, mi koro osengʼanyona kendo obuto korita, mana kaka otimo kawuononi?”
english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

kikuyu: Dichwo to ok owinjore oum wiye nikech en ranyisi mar Nyasaye gi duongʼne; dhako to en ranyisi mar duongʼ mar dichwo.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Yahudi owinjo wachno, negichako gikwanyo kite mondo gichielego,
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

kikuyu: nimar Kristo nyaka bed gi loch nyaka chop Nyasaye lo wasigu duto, mi oketgi e bwo tiende.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ema ongʼeyo yo miyudego kendo en kende ema ongʼeyo kama odakie,
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

kikuyu: Waluru Sabato abiriyo mag higni abiriyo nyadibiriyo, tiendeni higni piero angʼwen gochiko.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

kikuyu: Kamano nodhi Zarefath. Kane ochopo e dhoranga dalano, dhako ma chwore otho moro ne ni kanyo ka choko yien. Noluonge mopenje niya, “Bende inyalo kelonae pi matin e agwata agulu mondo amodhi?”
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

kikuyu: Punda nonena nyadidek mobaro oa yo. To ka dine ok obaro, to dine asenegi, to en to aweye odhi.”
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Simeon; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo mia ariyo (22,200).
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Kwan ngʼatni ka ngʼama onge nyathi, ngʼatno ma ok nyal dhi nyime maber, e kinde mar ngimane, nimar onge gunde mane dhi maber, onge manobed e kom duongʼ Daudi, kata bed gi loch kendo ei Juda.”
english: The LORD says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa gi Harun ka gin Misri niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: Wakaw ane kaka ranyisi ni owadwa kata nyaminwa kuom Kristo moro wuotho duk kendo oonge gi chiemo monyalo chamo.
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

kikuyu: Kane odhi kelo pi, Elija noluonge mowachone niya, “Kendo kiyie, to kelna kuon matin.”
english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

kikuyu: Farao Neko noketo Eliakim wuod Josia ruoth kar wuon mare Josia kendo noloko nying Eliakim ni Jehoyakim. To nokawo Jehoahaz mi otero e twech Misri kuma nothoe.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

kikuyu: Kaka Musa ne osesingo, Hebron nomi Kaleb, mane oriembo yawuot Anak adek.
english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak manie dieru modhi dwar, momako le kata winyo mondo ocham, nyaka ol rembe piny mi oik kod lowo,
english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

kikuyu: Abiro kwayogi e lek maber, kendo ewi gode ma roboche mag Israel nobed lek ma gikwaye. E lek kuno ema giniyweye bangʼ ka giseyiengʼ, kendo kuno ginichiemie lek momew manie ewi gode mag Israel.
english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Pi manie bwo polo mondo ochokre kaachiel, kendo lowo motwo obedie.” Kendo notimore kamano.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Joab ma wuod Zeruya ne jatend jolweny, to Jehoshafat wuod Ahilud ne jachan weche,
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

kikuyu: Bende, kata mana yie wiu duto osekwan mongʼe kar rombgi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, luonguru nyinge, landuru ne ogendini duto gima osetimo.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Donge wan gi ratiro mar wuotho gi mondewa e wuodhewa mag Injili kaka joote mamoko, kendo kaka jowete Ruoth kod Petro johero timo?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

kikuyu: Chuny Amnon ne chandore mobedo matuo nikech wach nyamin-gi Tamar, nimar ne en nyako ngili, kuom mano ne tek mondo otim kode gimoro.
english: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo yiene “nomiyo okwane kaka ngʼama kare.”
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Ka jo-Israel noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech jo-Midian,
english: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian,

kikuyu: Jomatindo gi jomadongo ni kuno kata wasumbini bende bedo maonge e bwo chik.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

kikuyu: Divai en jajaro to kongʼo en koko; ngʼat motelne kodgi onge rieko.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

kikuyu: Hosa ja-Merari ne nigi yawuowi, mokwongo Shimri (kata obedo ni ne ok en wuode makayo, wuon-gi noyiere mokwongo),
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka wuon-gi Amazia nosetimo.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidwoko niya, “Ok wangʼeyo kuma ne oaye.”
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

kikuyu: nikech chiemo gi pi nodog manok. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nowuor kaka nyawadgi chal, kendo dendgi nochire nikech richogi.
english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
