kikuyu: Balaam nodwoko niya, “Mano ber, eri asebiro. Koso iparo ni anyalo wacho gimoro amora? Ooyo, nyaka awach mana gima Nyasaye oketo e dhoga.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

kikuyu: En mana jo-Lawi ema oyienegi mar tiyo tij Hemb Romo kendo kaw tingʼ duto mag richo motimie Hemb Romo. Ma en chik mogik makende ne tiengʼ mabiro. Ok giniyud girkeni moro amora kuom jo-Israel.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Nyasaye “nochul ngʼato ka ngʼato kaluwore gi timbene.”
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

kikuyu: Bende negikelo gik madum mangʼwe ngʼar gi mor zeituni miolo e taya to gi mor pwodhruok kod ubani mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ji ok mok taya bangʼe giume gi bakul. Kar timo kamano to gikete ewi rachungi taya kendo ochiwo ler ne ji duto mantiere ei ot.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

kikuyu: Koro, un jo-Israel duto, wuouru kendo ungʼad bura e wachni.”
english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

kikuyu: Noywayo atungʼe kendo oketa thoro mar aserni mage.
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

kikuyu: kendo negidak nyaka oko mar Gedor koma omanyore gi wuok chiengʼ mar holo ka gimanyo kar kwath ne jambgi.
english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ngʼat moro miluongo ni Simon. Ngʼatni nosebedo katimo timbe jwok e dala mar Samaria, kendo timbene nomako dho ji duto. Nosungore ni en ngʼama lich,
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

kikuyu: moseidho e polo kendo koro obet e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye, ka malaike duto gi loch kod teko duto winjo chikne.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

kikuyu: Kapo ni jooda ne pok owacho nyaka nene ni, ‘Ere ngʼama pok Ayub omiyo chiemo moyiengʼ?’
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

kikuyu: Abiro bako wasike gi wichkuot, to en osimbo manie wiye biro medo rieny.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

kikuyu: Joshua nondiko gigo duto piny e Kitabu mar Chik mar Nyasaye. Bangʼe nokawo kidi maduongʼ mi okete maber e tiend yiend ober but kama ler mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

kikuyu: “To ogwedh ngʼatno moketo geno mare kuom Jehova Nyasaye, kendo oyie kuome.
english: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gaboro mar loch Jeroboam, Abija nobedo ruodh Juda,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

kikuyu: Ka bede Musa nojony, to negikawo kidi mi giketone mondo obedie. Harun gi Hur ne ojuko bedene kotingʼo malo, ka ngʼato achiel omako bade konchiel, to machielo omako komachielo, omiyo bedene nosiko kochungʼ tir nyaka podho chiengʼ.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

kikuyu: oganda maneno makwiny maonge gi luor ne joma oti kata joma pod tindo.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

kikuyu: Joote kod owete modak Judea duto nowinjo ni joma ok jo-Yahudi bende noserwako Wach Nyasaye.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osesande, ne onyisore en owuon ne jogi, kendo nochiwo ranyisi mangʼeny masiro ni ongima. Ne ofwenyorenigi kuom ndalo piero angʼwen ka owuoyo kuom pinyruodh Nyasaye.
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: To koro yie mondo igwedh od jatichni, mondo osik e nyimi nyaka chiengʼ; nimar, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, isewuoyo to gi gwethni, isegwedho dhood jatichni gweth mosiko.”
english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

kikuyu: Ji duto mane odhi gi Jakobo Misri, tiende ni nyithinde hie ka ok okwan mond yawuote ji piero auchiel gi auchiel.
english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

kikuyu: “Penj jo-Shekem duto ni, ‘Ere gima ber: bedo gi yawuot Jerub-Baal piero abiriyo kaka jotendu, koso bedo e bwo loch ngʼato achiel?’ Ngʼeuru malongʼo ni an rembu.”
english: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

kikuyu: Mizpa, Kefira, Moza,
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

kikuyu: Kendo Uria jadolo notimo mana kaka ruoth Ahaz nochiko.
english: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

kikuyu: Asa ne en wuon Jehoshafat, Jehoshafat ne en wuon Jehoram, Jehoram ne en wuon Uzia,
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

kikuyu: Beduru mamor kuom geno, kutimo sinani e sand muyudo, kendo ulamo ma ok uywe.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

kikuyu: To Festo mane dwaro mondo omor jo-Yahudi nowachone Paulo niya, “Bende inyalo yie mondo idhi Jerusalem mondo kuno ema adhi ayalie kuom wechegi?”
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

kikuyu: Abiro dhi oko kendo anachungʼ but wuora machiegni gi kama ipondoeno. Abiro wuoyo kode kuomi kendo abiro nyisi gima ayudo.”
english: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

kikuyu: Yori nongʼado dier nam, yo miluwo nokadho e dier pige maringo matek, kata obedo ni kuonde mane tiendeni onyono ne ok nyal ne gi wangʼ.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

kikuyu: Eka negichano laini angʼwen mag kite ma nengogi tek kuom lawno. Laini mokwongo ne gichane kite kaka rubi, topaz gi beril;
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngero mawacho ni, ‘Ngʼato achiel chwoyo, to ngʼato machielo keyo’ en adier.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

kikuyu: Iniban-gi giduto mana kaka ibano kandho, kendo inilokgi mana kaka iloko nanga. In to isiko ichalri mana kaka in, kendo hiki ok norum.”
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua noyiecho lepe mi opodho auma e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, moriyo kanyo nyaka odhiambo. Jodong Israel bende notimo kamano kendo ne giolo buru e wigi.
english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before the LORD’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

kikuyu: Daudi nodak e kuonde mag pondo manie thim kendo e gode mag Thim Zif; odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ Saulo ne osiko ka dware, to Nyasaye ne ok oketo Daudi e lwete.
english: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

kikuyu: Jael nowuok mondo orom gi Sisera kendo owachone niya, “Bi, ruodha, donji. Kik iluor.” Omiyo nodonjo ei hembe, kendo noume.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

kikuyu: kasia maromo kilo auchiel, kendo giduto nyaka pimgi gi rapim ma itiyogo e kama ler mar lemo, to bende ikel lita angʼwen mar mo zeituni.
english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

kikuyu: “Amiyou mo zeituni mayom duto kod divai manyien mayom duto kod cham ma gichiwone Jehova Nyasaye kaka olemo mokwongo mar keyo margi.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Kik itim gima rach nikech ji mangʼeny time. Ka in janeno e bura, to kik iketh bura mana nikech idwaro chwako koma ji ngʼenyie,
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kata kamano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Bangʼ higni piero angʼwen anachok jo-Misri kagologi e pinje mane akeyogie.
english: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

kikuyu: “Chandruok ochomou un jo-Farisai, nikech uhero kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke kod mos e chirni.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

kikuyu: Biuru piyo, un ogendini duto moa kuonde duto, mondo uchokru kanyo. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye kel jokedo magi olor kanyo!
english: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, LORD.

kikuyu: (Nowuoyo kuom Judas ma wuod Simon Iskariot mane biro ndhoge bangʼe, kata obedo ni ne en achiel kuom jopuonjrene apar gariyo.)
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

kikuyu: Ne openja niya, “Ineno angʼo?” To ne adwoke niya, “Aneno rachung taya molos gi dhahabu lilo, koket bakul e wiye malo mogik, kod teyni abiriyo maliel, to teynigo nigi kuonde abiriyo mirwakoe kitambi.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

kikuyu: Abiro timo kodi singruok mar kend mondo ibed mara chuth; abiro timo kodi singruok mar kend e yo maler kendo maratiro, gihera kod kech.
english: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.

kikuyu: Samson nowacho niya, “Mad iyie atho gi jo-Filistia-gi!” Eka nodhiro sirnigo gi tekone duto, kendo hekalu norwombore piny kuom jotelo kod ji duto mane ni e iye. Omiyo nonego ji mangʼeny sa ma notho moloyo kane ongima.
english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Joshua, nomiyo Kaleb wuod Jefune bath piny Juda miluongo ni, Kiriath Arba, ma tiende ni, Hebron. (Arba ne en kwar Anak.)
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

kikuyu: Ne agoyogi ma giregore ka buru mayom mar lowo; nanyonogi mawuotho kuomgi ka chwodho man e yo.
english: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Eka noyaro hema ewi Hemb Romo mi oketo raum e wiye kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Notimo liswa e Holo mar Ben Hinom kendo nochiwo nyithinde e mach kaka misango miwangʼo pep koluwo timbe mamono mag ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye oriembo e nyim jo-Israel.
english: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Negiloso ratege ariyo mag dhahabu mi gichomogi e konde ariyo mamoko mag law akor gi yo ka iye e riake kama otwangʼ-go law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Harun nosudo machiegni but kendo mar misango, kendo noyangʼo nyarwath mane obiro gologo richone owuon.
english: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

kikuyu: An Jehova Nyasaye anabed Nyasachgi, to jatichna Daudi nobed kaka ruoth e diergi. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho.
english: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.

kikuyu: Aram, Efraim kod wuod Remalia osechikoni obadho mondo otieki, kagiwacho niya,
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

kikuyu: To kata ka opidhe kendo, bende dolodh maber? Donge obiro ner chuth ka yamb ugwe ogoye moner e puodho kamane odonge?’ ”
english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

kikuyu: Donge jo-Kush kod jo-Libya ne ni kod jolweny motegno man kod geche lweny mangʼeny kod joriemb farese? To kane igeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye, to nochiwogi e lweti.
english: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nopenja niya, “Amos, en angʼo mineno?” Ne adwoke niya, “Aneno tol mar rapim mipimogo kor ot.” Eka Ruoth Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Apimo chuny joga Israel gi rapim kendo ok anachak awenegi.
english: The LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

kikuyu: Dho wath kanyo ne ok ber betie ndalo chwiri, omiyo thoth ji mane wan-go nongʼado wach mondo wadhi nyime gi kwangʼ, ka giparo ni ne wanyalo chopo Foinike mondo wabedie ndalo chwiri. Foinike ne en dho wadh Krete, momanyore gi milambo ma yo podho chiengʼ kod nyandwat ma yo podho chiengʼ.
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

kikuyu: To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro siko kimiyi duongʼ nyaka chiengʼ.
english: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

kikuyu: “Ne, abiro miyo ichal gi gir dino ngano manyien kendo ma pod lekene bith. Ibiro muko gode madongo kitoyogi matindo tindo kendo inimi gode matindo lokre buru.
english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

kikuyu: “To Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Abiro ngʼadoni bura koluwore kod gima iwacho, in jatich marach! Kara in ne ingʼeyo ni an ngʼat makoch, kendo ni akawo gima ne ok akano, bende akayo gima ne ok achwoyo!
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nokawo tungʼ mar mo mi oolo ewi Saulo eka nonyodhe mowacho niya, “Donge Jehova Nyasaye osewiri mondo ibed jatelo ne joge moyiero.
english: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

kikuyu: Dhi machiegni mondo iwinji gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa wacho. Eka iwachnwa gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa owachoni, wabiro winjo kendo timo.”
english: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

kikuyu: To bangʼ higni adek jotich Shimei ariyo noringo modhi ir Akish wuod Maaka, ruodh Gath kendo nowach ne Shimei niya, “Wasumbinigi ni Gath.”
english: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”

kikuyu: Kar kwan jo-Israel duto ne romo ji alufu mia auchiel gachiel, mia abiriyo gi piero adek (601,730).
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Kawuono asetieko ajara mar jo-Misri kuomu.” Omiyo kanyo iluongo ni Gilgal nyaka chil kawuono.
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.

kikuyu: Joka Dan nochungo kido manono kanyo mondo gilam, kendo negiketo Jonathan wuod Gershom, ma wuod Musa, kod yawuote obedo jodolo ne dhood joka Dan nyaka ne ochopo kinde mane oter pinyno e twech.
english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

kikuyu: singruok mane otimo gi Ibrahim, Muma mane okwongʼorego ni Isaka.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata moyangʼo rwath katimogo misango chal gi ngʼat monego dhano, kendo ngʼato angʼata motimo misango mar rombo, chal gi ngʼama oturo ngʼut guok, kendo ngʼato angʼata mochiwo misango mar cham chal gi ngʼat mochiwo remb anguro, bende ngʼato angʼata mowangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar mar rapar, chal gi ngʼama lamo nyiseche manono. Giseyiero yoregi giwegi kendo chunygi mor gi timbegi mag rondogo;
english: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka uneno ka gigi timore to ngʼeuru ni pinyruoth Nyasaye ni machiegni.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

kikuyu: Jonathan nomonjo kambi man Geba mar jolwenj jo-Filistia kendo jo-Filistia nowinjo wachno. Eka Saulo nochiko mondo ogo tungʼ e piny duto mi owacho niya, “We jo-Hibrania owinji!”
english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

kikuyu: Ne giwer gi dwol maduongʼ niya: “Duongʼ obed ni Nyarombo manonegi, mondo oyud loch gi mwandu, gi rieko gi luor, gi duongʼ kod pak.”
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

kikuyu: Kamano nowacho ni yawuote niya, “Gawnauru punda.” Kane gisegawone punda, noidhe
english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

kikuyu: nikech mano emomiyo watiyo matek kendo wakedo, ka waketo genowa kuom Nyasaye mangima, ma en Jawar mar ji duto, to moloyo en Jawar joma oyie.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo jonywolne nowacho niya, “Tinde oduongʼ, penjeuru.”
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nobed gi loch e piny duto. Chiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye nobed achiel, kendo nyinge nobed achiel kende.
english: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.

kikuyu: Omiyo negiguro hema ne Abisalom ewi ot malo kendo noterore gi monde wuon-gi mamoko mana ka jo-Israel duto neno.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi law ik mane onalgo wi Yesu. Nangano noban maber, kendo ne en kar kende, mopogore gi kama lewni mayom molir olir ne nitie.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

kikuyu: kod okanda mayom mitweyo marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Jal mane oloso rameny madongo dongo, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Asehulonegi nyingi, kendo pod abiro medo nyiso ji ngʼama in, mondo hera miherago obed kuomgi, kendo an awuon bende abed kuomgi.”
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

kikuyu: Kaka ne en timgi mondo ruoth openj wach kuom joma olony e weche mag chike gi kaka ingʼado bura kare, nowuoyo gi joma riek, manongʼeyo weche mag ndalo,
english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

kikuyu: Ne otimo richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, to ok kaka wuon kod min notimo. Noketho kido milamo mar Baal mane wuon oseloso.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

kikuyu: Yaye geno mar Israel, Jares mare e kinde mag thagruok, en angʼo momiyo ichalo wendo e piny, kaka jawuoth mobuoro otieno achiel?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

kikuyu: “ ‘E ndalo ma pwodhruokne kuom nyathi ma wuowi kata ma nyako oserumo, to enokel nyaim ma hike achiel mitimogo misango miwangʼo pep Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel kata nyathi akuru gi akuch odugla, mondo otimgo misango mar golo richo, kendo enochiwe ni jadolo e dho Hemb Romo.
english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Farao noluongo Musa kod Harun mi owachonegi niya, “Kwauru Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogol ogwendegi kuoma kod joga, eka anawe jogi mondo odhi otim misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”

kikuyu: To ka wawuotho e ler, kaka en bende enie ler to wan e lalruok ngʼato gi ngʼato, kendo remb Yesu Wuode pwodhowa kuom richowa duto.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

kikuyu: Ne awuoyo kod jonabi, ka anyisogi fweny mangʼeny, kendo kawacho ngeche kokalo kuomgi.”
english: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

kikuyu: Ka pinyruoth moro opogore kendo joge gore kendgi to pinyruodhno ok nyal chungʼ.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

kikuyu: Negiloso sirni mochungʼ mag yiend siala ne Hemb Romo.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

kikuyu: Tuo marach omako dende duto, kendo miyo bedene kod tiendene kethore.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

kikuyu: To ere ngʼama ongʼeyo ni ngʼat mabiro luwano nobed ngʼama ofuwo kata ngʼama riek? Kata obed mariek kata mofuwo, to obiro kawo gimoro amora mane aloso gi lucha. Ma bende ne ayudo ni onge tiende.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano ni monde mag pinje mamoko mane wangʼo ubani kendo ne chiwo misango ni nyisechegigo.
english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato kata achiel e piny ngima matimo mana gik mabeyo lilo ma ok oketho.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

kikuyu: “Koro Nyasacha, yie mondo wengegi oyawre kendo itgi mondo owinj maber lemo ma wachiwo kaeni.
english: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

kikuyu: To bende gin ruodhi abiriyo. Ma abich kuomgi osepodho, to achiel pod nitie, to machielo pod ok obiro; to ka obiro to nobedi kuom thuolo matin.
english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, ‘Winji, yaye Joshua jadolo maduongʼ, in kaachiel gi jodolo weteni mobet piny e nyimi, ma gin ranyisi mag gik mabiro timore achien; ni abiro kelo jatichna ma en Bad yath.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

kikuyu: Jogo man-gi ruodhi moyie kuom Kristo kik nyisgi achaya moro amora nikech gin jowete kuom Kristo. Kar timo kamano to owinjore gitinegi maber moloyo, nikech jogo mayudo ohala e tichgi gin owete kuom Kristo ma gihero. Magi e gik manyaka ipuonj ji kijiwogi matek.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

kikuyu: Ne odonjo e ot mi oloro dhoot modongʼ kende gi nyathino mondo olam Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane Elkana gi jaode jodhi timo misango mar higa ka higa ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo chopo singruokne,
english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

kikuyu: Eka Shafan jagoro nonyiso ruoth niya, “Hilkia janabi osemiya kitabu.” Kendo Shafan nosomo kitabuno e nyim ruoth.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Abiro pandonegi wangʼa” mondo aneye kaka gikogi nobedi, nimar gin tiengʼ mobaro, nyithindo ma ok jo-adieri,
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

kikuyu: ni kawuono abiro timo gima ne akwongʼorani gi nying Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel ni anatim: Kamano Solomon wuodi biro bedo ruoth bangʼa kendo obiro bedo e kom lochna.”
english: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

kikuyu: Anatel ne muofni mondo owuothi e yore mane ok gingʼeyo, kuonde mapok giwuothoe ema anatagie; kendo anami mudho olokrenegi ler, kendo analos kuonde bugni bed mopie. Magi e gik ma abiro timo; kendo ok najwangʼ-gi.
english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

kikuyu: nyiimbe abiriyogo moro ka moro uchiw gi kilo adek.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho ni, ‘Penj jodolo mondo odwoki gima chik wacho:
english: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

kikuyu: Nikech dichwo mapok oyie inyalo pwodho nikech chiege, to dhako mapok oyie bende inyalo pwodho nikech chwore moyie. Ka ok kamano, to nyithindu dibed mogak, to koro sani to ginenore ni giler.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

kikuyu: Edom, Moab kod Amon;
english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Wuoda, luor Jehova Nyasaye kod ruoth morito piny, kendo kik iriwri gi joma kwede,
english: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

kikuyu: Un ji duto manie piny, un mudak e piny, ka bandech lweny otingʼ malo ewi gode, to ununene kendo ka turumbete noywagi to unuwinje.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

kikuyu: Muolo maru mondo onenre ni ji duto nikech Ruoth chiegni duogo.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Omiyo kwaya gima idwaro mondo aket ogendini duto obed girkeni mari, mondo piny ngima obed mwanduni.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

kikuyu: to jolwenj Babulon nolawo ruoth mojuke e pewe Jeriko. Jolwenje duto noringo oweye moke,
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nochiko Doeg niya, “Lokri mondo ineg jodolo.” Omiyo Doeg ja-Edom nonegogi. Chiengʼno nonego joma orwako lewni mayom mag dolo miluongo ni efod maromo ji piero aboro gabich.
english: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

kikuyu: To jathek ok chungʼ kar ngʼat achiel; to Nyasaye to en achiel.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

kikuyu: Farao nodwoko niya, “Abiro yienu mondo udhi uchiw misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e thim to mana ka ok udhi mabor. Omiyo lamnauru.”
english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

kikuyu: Mor mar nyiduonge norum, koko mar joma nigi mor kod ilo nolal, kendo mor mar thum ok nowinji.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

kikuyu: To abiro miyo wangʼi bed matek kendo wiyi bed matek mana kaka gin.
english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

kikuyu: Eliel ja-Mahavi, Jeribai kod Joshavia ma yawuot Elnam, Ithma ja-Moab,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

kikuyu: Kane gik mangimago ochungʼ kar tiendgi; to gin bende negichungʼ kar tiendgi, kendo kane gik mangimago aa malo, to tiende garigo bende ne aa malo kodgi, nikech roho mar gik mangimago ne ni e tiendegi.
english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

kikuyu: Eka kwe mar Nyasaye modhiero ji duto ngʼeyo norit chunyu gi pachu ka un kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kuom mano weuru bedo mofuwo, to ngʼeuru gima Ruoth dwaro.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

kikuyu: Moko to enoket jotelo mag lweny marito ji alufe alufe to moko motelo ni piero abich abich, moko nopur puothene gi dhok kendo kayo chambe, to bende moko noket mondo olos gige mag lweny to gi gik milosogo gechene.
english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

kikuyu: Bende negichungʼ pile ka pile mondo gidwok erokamano kendo gipak Jehova Nyasaye. Nonego gitim kamano godhiambo bende,
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

kikuyu: Jotendu duto oseringo kaachiel, osemakgi ma ok oti gi gige lweny moro amora. Un duto mane uringo ka wasigu ne pod ni mabor, osemaku kanyakla moteru e twech.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

kikuyu: Elisha nodwoke niya, “Ere kaka anyalo konyi? Nyisa ane angʼo ma in-go e odi?” Nodwoke niya, “Jatichni onge gimoro amora makmana mo matin.”
english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

kikuyu: Ooyo, divai manyien nyaka ol mana e piende mag tingʼo divai manyien.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

kikuyu: Anyalo kwano chokena duto; ji ranga amingʼa kendo jara.
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Nikech isekwayo mana ma to ok ikwayo ngima mathoth kata mwandu ni in iwuon, bende ok isekwayo tho mar wasiki to isekwayo mana rieko kuom ngʼado bura kare,
english: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel duto noweyo Daudi mondo oluw Sheba wuod Bikri. To jo-Juda to nodongʼ gi ruodhgi ka gia Jordan nyaka gichopo Jerusalem.
english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Roho mar Nyasaye notingʼa motera nyaka ir jogo mane ni e twech e piny Babulon, ka an e fweny mane Roho mar Nyasaye omiya. Eka fweny mane asenenono noa moweya,
english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

kikuyu: Ee An ema asebetie nyaka aa chakruok. Gima amako onge ngʼama nyalo golo e lweta. En ngʼa manyalo ketho gima atimo?
english: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

kikuyu: Wan gi mich mopogore opogore kaluwore gi ngʼwono momiwa. Ka mich ngʼato en koro wach, to mondo oti kode kaluwore gi yie mare.
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

kikuyu: Amon ne ja-higni piero ariyo gariyo kane obedo ruoth, kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni ariyo. Min mare ne nyinge Meshulemeth ma nyar Haruz, kendo noa Jotba.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

kikuyu: Nyaka uwar nyathi punda ka nyathi punda mokwong nywol ka uchiwo nyarombo kare, to ka ok iware, to tur ngʼute. Waruru kayo duto mag yawuotu.
english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

kikuyu: “Wachnegi kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon ni joma odongʼ e dala mosemuki biro tho e lweny, to joma ni oko e gwengʼ abiro chiwo ni le mag bungu mondo onegi. Joma oringo opondo kuonde mochiel motegno kod rogo biro tho kod tuoche malandore ma ok rum.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ owuok gokinyi, Nyasaye nokelo yamo maliet moa yo wuok chiengʼ, mi chiengʼ ochamo wi Jona, kendo chiengʼno nomiyo dende onyosore. Kuom mano, nogombo mondo otho, kowacho niya, “Dine obedo maber katho moloyo bedo mangima.”
english: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

kikuyu: Moko ne ojar kendo ochwadi gi del, to moko bende noketi e od twech.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

kikuyu: e nyim Efraim, gi Benjamin gi Manase. Nyis tekri, kendo bi mondo ireswa.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny kane oneno gima notimore, nomiyo opako Nyasaye kendo wacho niya, “Adier chutho, jali ne en ngʼat makare!”
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

kikuyu: kendo ka nyiego omako chwor dhakono mi ochich kode, to chiegeno ochido, kata kapo ni nyiego omake kode kendo ochich kode kata obedo ni ok ochido,
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye muko yiende mag sida, Jehova Nyasaye turo yiende sida mag Lebanon matindo tindo.
english: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Aseketo ligangla mar nek e dhorangeyeni duto, mondo omi chunygi onyosre kendo ji mangʼeny notho. Abwogo dalagi gi ligangla mamil ka polo, kendo moikore mondo oneki.
english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.

kikuyu: Joab wuod Zeruya gi jo-Daudi nodhi moromo kodgi e yawo man Gibeon. Negibet ka gingʼiyore jomoko koni to jomoko kocha.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iwinjwa! Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iwenwa! Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, winjwa kendo ikonywa ma ok ideko, nikech dalani maduongʼ kod jogi miluongo gi nyingi.”
english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Ka dipo ni pod ok aketo singruokna godiechiengʼ gi otieno kod chike mogurore mar polo kod piny,
english: The LORD says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

kikuyu: Ne owachona niya, “In e jatichna, Israel, kuomi ema abiro nyisoe duongʼ mara.”
english: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

kikuyu: Eka Anas nochiwo Yesu mondo oter ir Kaifas, jadolo maduongʼ, ka pod otweye.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

kikuyu: Ma e gima biro timore e odiechiengno: Ka Gog nomonj piny Israel, mirimba maliet nochiew, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.

kikuyu: Omiyo nopenjo Jesse niya, “Magi kende e yawuoti?” Jesse nodwoko niya, “Pod nitiere wuowi ma chogo, en to okwayo rombe.” Samuel nowachone niya, “Or ngʼato mondo oome, nikech ok wabi bet piny ka kapok ochopo.”
english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kama: “Nikech utamuru winjo wechena,
english: Therefore the LORD of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

kikuyu: To in isekwedo, kendo iseweya, iyi osewangʼ matek gi ngʼati mowir.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

kikuyu: Ka wasiko watimo atima richo mana mar oyiem bangʼ ngʼeyo adiera, to onge misango moro ma pod odongʼ,
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

kikuyu: ka arwako law ywak, to ji oloka ngero.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

kikuyu: Nojiwogi mondo gikwa Nyasach polo mondo okechgi kuom midhieroni, mondo en, kaachiel gi osiepene, gi joma riek mamoko man Babulon kik neg-gi.
english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

kikuyu: “gisesanda malit nyaka aa e tin-na, to kata kamano pok gibedo gi loch kuoma.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Harun niya, “In gi yawuoti kod od wuonu nyaka ukaw tingʼ mag richo motimne kama ler mar lemo, kendo in-gi yawuoti kende ema nyaka ukaw tingʼ richo motimne jodolo.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

kikuyu: Dhood Simeon notelnegi gi Shelumiel wuod Zurishadai,
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nawinje kowuoyo, mine achikone ita; nindo matut notera, kendo napodho piny auma.
english: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat masingore ni nigi chiayo mowinjore ochiwna, to kar timo kamano to ochiwo man-gi songa ne Ruoth Nyasaye. Nikech an ruoth maduongʼ, kendo nyinga nyaka mi luor e kind ogendini duto,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says the LORD of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

kikuyu: Eka Zofar ja-Namath nodwoko niya,
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

kikuyu: Joywa rech biro riedo e dho aora; chakre En Gedi nyaka En Eglaim, kuonde miyare gogo noyudre. Rech noyudre kanyo mopogore opogore, mana kaka rech mayudore e Nam Mediterania.
english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osewacho wechegi, nogonyo chokruok.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chik mar Jehova Nyasaye, Musa nondiko nonro maber mar migepe mag wuodhgi. Ma e kaka ne giwuotho e migawo ka migawo:
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

kikuyu: Nongʼicho moneno ruoth kochungʼ e bath siro kaka chik jo-Israel ne dwaro. Jotelo gi jogo turumbete nochungʼ e bath ruoth kendo ji duto mag pinyno ne mor kendo negigoyo turumbete. Eka Athalia noyiecho lepe kakok niya, “Andhoga! Andhoga!”
english: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

kikuyu: Kerioth nomaki kendo kuondegi mag pondo nokaw. E odiechiengno chunje mag jolwenj Moab nochal gi chuny dhako mamuoch kayo.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

kikuyu: (Kuomgi ema ogendini modak e dho nembe nowuokie kadhi e pinjegi, dhoot ka dhoot, e pinjegi ka moro ka moro wacho dhogi.)
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

kikuyu: Mapiyo ka osechako locho kendo mobetie e kom loch, nonego anywola Baasha duto. Ne ok ongʼwono kata ni nyathi ma wuowi, bed ni ne en wat kata osiep.
english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

kikuyu: To nowachona niya, “Onge wach, kara abiro yieni mondo ited makatini e maj owuoch dhiangʼ kar tedo gi oko mar dhano kaka owuoyo.”
english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

kikuyu: Jo-Juda modongʼ biro chalo gi yath matero tiendene piny kendo nyago olemo e bedene.
english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

kikuyu: Kibzaim kod Beth Horon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Adhero mi adongʼ choke lilo; kendo gima adongʼ-go en mana ring laka.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

kikuyu: Eka Pilato nokawo Yesu mi ochiwe mondo ochwade.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo gima nowachi gi dho Janabi Isaya, niya,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Mad koro teko Jehova Nyasaye oyangre malongʼo, mana kaka isewacho:
english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

kikuyu: Nimar joka Jakobo en pok Jehova Nyasaye owuon kendo mwandune.
english: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

kikuyu: Much Nyasaye kelo pe kendo pige mopongʼo wi lowo poto mabed matek ka lwanda.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, migi kum moromo gi timbegi kaluwore gi gik ma lwetgi osetimo.
english: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.

kikuyu: Wagol koso kik wagol?” To kaka Yesu nongʼeyo wuondruokgi, nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo utema? Kelnauru ane dinari ka, mondo anone maber.”
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

kikuyu: Kane jobura owinjo weche mane Stefano owacho, igi nongʼondore mi gikayone lekegi.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

kikuyu: Ondiek malichno ma yande nitie, to tinde onge, en ruoth mar aboro. Bende en achiel kuom ruodhi abiriyogo, kendo odhiyo e kar kethruokne.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

kikuyu: Saulo nonyiso joma ne ni kode niya kwanreuru mondo une ni ngʼatno mosewuok e dierwa ka, kane gisetimo kamano negiyudo ni en Jonathan gi jatingʼ gige lwenje ema onge kanyo.
english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.

kikuyu: Jangʼiewo wacho niya, “Ok ber ngangʼ, ok ber ngangʼ!” To bangʼe owuok odhiyo ka osungore ni ongʼiewo gi nengo mayot.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

kikuyu: Un e joma noyudo chik mane okel gi malaike to usetamoru rito chikno.”
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

kikuyu: Nikech Kristo notho ni richo dichiel kendo mogik, ngʼat makare notho kar joma richo mondo okelu ir Nyasaye. Ne oneg ringre, to kata kamano nomiye bedo mangima kuom Roho.
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni en ohinga, to dine wagero osuch fedha kuome. To ka dine obed ni en dhoot, to dine walore gi thigo mar bap sida.
english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

kikuyu: Bedo gi adiera ni inyalo loye en miriambo; nikech nene kende ema nyalo miyi luoro migori piny.
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

kikuyu: Bangʼeno Hagar nochako Nyasaye mane osewuoyo kode nying ni El-roi (ma tiende ni Jehova Nyasaye Maneno); nimar nowacho niya, “Koro aseneno Jalno manena.”
english: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka un bende unenoru ne ji ni un joma beyo gioko, to gie iu to upongʼ gi wuondruok kod timbe maricho.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

kikuyu: Gima awachonu ema: Ka jacham girkeni pod en nyathi, to oonge pogruok gi misumba, kata obedo ni mwandu duto mar wuon dala osedongʼne.
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasach jo-Israel nojiwo chuny Pul ruodh jo-Asuria (ma bende iluongo ni Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh jo-Asuria), mane otero jo-Reuben, jo-Gad, kod nus mar dhood jo-Manase e twech. Ne oterogi Hala, Habor, Hera kod but aora Gozan kuma gidakie nyaka chil kawuono.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

kikuyu: “To in Daniel, sik kuom Nyasaye nyaka ndalo giko. Bangʼe initho, to achien inichier miyud pokni chiengʼ giko piny.”
english: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

kikuyu: Nikech Ruoth owuon nolor koa e polo, mi nogol chik gi dwol maduongʼ, ka malaika maduongʼ kok, kendo ka turumbete mar Nyasaye ywak matek; eka joma nosetho kani kuom Kristo nochier mokwongo.
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo, un jo-Yahudi, ok unyal yie ni Nyasaye chiero joma otho?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

kikuyu: Kata ka pod odhi nyime gichwer kata kodinore, to gino biro miyo obedo mogak. Ma e kaka gik machwergo biro miyo obedo mogak.
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

kikuyu: To nikech usechwoyo anjawo, usekayo timbe maricho, kendo usechamo olemb miriambo. Nikech usegeno kuom tekou uwegi kendo kuom jolwenju mangʼeny,
english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

kikuyu: Anabed kodi kendo anariti kamoro amora ma idhiye nyaka adwoki e pinyni. Ok anaweyi nyaka chop atim mana ma asesingorani.”
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

kikuyu: Samson nowachonegi niya, “Nikech usetimo gima kama, ok analingʼ nyaka achulnu kuor.”
english: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”

kikuyu: Koma odok yo wuok chiengʼ mar laruno lachne norom mita piero ariyo gadek.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

kikuyu: kendo negi yike e liel mane okunyo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Negipiele e kitanda mopongʼ kod gik mangʼwe ngʼar moruw maber kendo negiloso magenga maduongʼ ka imiyego duongʼ.
english: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.

kikuyu: to sani koro osefwenynwago kuom biro mar Jawarwa, Kristo Yesu. En ema osetieko tho mi okelo ngima kod ngima mak rum e ler kuom Injili.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

kikuyu: Gola e lwet joma timo gik maricho kendo resa kuom joma riyo mar chwero remo omako.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

kikuyu: Ooyo, uchano mayo ji ratiro magi e chunyu, kendo lwetu chano kelo dhawo e piny.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, Bende unukwal kendo uneki, uterru kendo ukwongʼru gi miriambo, uwangʼ ubani ni Baal kendo ulu bangʼ nyiseche manono ma pod ok ungʼeyo,
english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

kikuyu: Nikech anjawo mar Israel nonenore gima tin, ne gidwanyo piny ka gilamo kite kod bepe.
english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen e higa mar ariyo mar loch Darius, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro gi dwond janabi Hagai kawacho niya:
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Koro onge ngʼama nyalo rango wangʼ chiengʼ tir, nikech polo olendo kendo orieny makech; yamo oseriembo boche duto moweyo kor polo nono.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

kikuyu: Ka noyudo giwuok gia, nokelne Yesu ngʼat moro mane nigi jochiende kendo mane ok nyal wuoyo.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

kikuyu: Magi e joma chwo mane oyier koa e dhoudi, mane gin jotend dhoudigo. Gin ema ne gin jotend dhout Israel.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Mana kaka olemo maber inyalo yudi e saga marach, ma ji wach ni, ‘Kik wite, nimar pod nitie gima ber kuome, e kaka anatim e lo jotichna kendo ok anatiekgi duto.’
english: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

kikuyu: “Ne umiyo jo-Nazir omadho divai, kendo nukwero jonabi ni kik gikor wach.
english: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’

kikuyu: Janabi nopenjo niya, “Angʼo mane gineno e odi?” Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Giseneno gik moko duto manie oda. Onge gimoro amora modongʼ e mwanduna mane ok anyisogi.”
english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

kikuyu: eka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo rito singruokne mane omiya ni, Ka nyikwayi onono kaka gidak kendo ka giwuotho gi adiera e nyima gi chunygi duto kod parogi duto to ok nibedi maonge ngʼat manyalo bedo e kom duongʼ e Israel.
english: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Chiengʼ ma yadhno dhi e piny joma otho, anami pi manie bwo lowo ime kendo ywage. Anagengʼ aore mondo kik mol kendo anakel mudho e got Lebanon mana nikech en mi ami yien manie bungu duto two mana nikech en.
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

kikuyu: wuod Mathat, wuod Lawi, wuod Melki, wuod Janai, wuod Josef,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik nowinjo wachni mochako chano yo mar nege, nimar ne giluore nikech oganda duto nowuoro puonjne.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane jo-Aram oneno ni jo-Israel oseloyogi, negichokore kendo.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

kikuyu: Ja-Israel moro amora motimo misango gi rwath kata nyaim, kata diel ei kambi kata oko mar kambi,
english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

kikuyu: Mana kaka singo duto maber mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osebedo adiera, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye biro kelo kuomu gigo maricho duto mobwogou godo, nyaka one ni otiekou pep e piny maberni ma osemiyou.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,

kikuyu: To ruoth ok onego obed gi farese mangʼeny kata chuno ji mondo odog Misri dhi omo moko, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osewachonu niya, “Ok onego udog gi yorno kendo.”
english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because the LORD has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

kikuyu: Nimar an bende an ngʼama ni e bwo loch kod jolweny manie bwoya. Ka awacho ne moro ni, ‘Dhiyo’ to odhi, kendo machielo ni ‘Bi’ to obiro. Bende ka anyiso misumbana ni, ‘Tim ma,’ to otimo kamano.”
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: “Kare jatich ma ja-adiera kendo mariek en ngʼa, ma ruodhe omiyo tich mar rito jotije manie ode, ka miyogi chiembgi e sa mowinjore?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

kikuyu: Efron nodwoko Ibrahim niya,
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo Yesu bende nogur oko mar dala mondo opwodh joge odok maler gi rembe owuon.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Misri oneni, gibiro wacho, ‘Ma en chiege.’ Mi gininega to inires ngimani.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

kikuyu: Jatichni Joab notimo ma mondo okel lokruok kuom gik matimore sanigi. Ruodha nigi rieko ka mar malaika mar Nyasaye kendo ongʼeyo gik moko duto matimore e pinywa ka.”
english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are on the earth.”

kikuyu: Nimar gisetimo gik mamono ei Israel; giseterore gi monde jobathgi kendo e nyinga gisewacho miriambo, mane ok anyisogi mondo giwachi. Angʼeye kendo an janeno kuom wachno,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Pi nomedo dwono nyaka dwe mar apar, to chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar aparno wi gode nochako neno.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

kikuyu: Ka gin jonabi kendo gin-gi wach Jehova Nyasaye, to mondo gikwa Jehova Nyasaye Maratego gigo mabeyo modongʼ e od Jehova Nyasaye kod e kar dak mar ruodh Juda kod e Jerusalem kik ter Babulon.
english: But if they are prophets, and if the LORD’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of Armies, that the vessels which are left in the LORD’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

kikuyu: E Jerusalem kanyo, but ranga Rombe, miluongo ni Bethesda gi dho jo-Hibrania, ne nitiere yawo moro ma nigi raidhi abich midonjogo.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

kikuyu: Tula noger ode kanyo monywol tongʼ, motogi kendo norit nyithinde, koumo e tipo mar bwombene; kanyo bende ema otenga nochokre, moro ka moro gi nyawadgi.
english: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

kikuyu: Bangʼe abiro miyo joga Israel duogi. “Kendo gibiro gero miechgi mane olokore gundni ma ginidagie, eka gibiro pidho yiend mzabibu, kendo madho divai mare. Gibiro puro puothegi, kendo chamo nyak margi.
english: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon ne nigi mwandu mangʼeny kod rieko moloyo ruodhi mamoko duto mag piny.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

kikuyu: nyikwa Zatu, Shekania wuod Jahaziel, kaachiel kode ji mia adek;
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Daudi ok nobed maonge gi ngʼato manobedi e kom duongʼ mar od Israel,
english: For the LORD says: “David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Kaka sibuor maruto kata ondiek madwaro kecho e kaka ngʼat marach motelone joma ok nyal.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

kikuyu: pi noima mine aparo ni achiegni tho.
english: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

kikuyu: Samuel nonyiso joma ne kwaye mondo omigi ruoth weche duto mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

kikuyu: abiro werne Jal mamiyo ruodhi locho, kendo makonyo Daudi jatichne e dho ligangla mager.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

kikuyu: To kaka Judas ne en jakeno mar pesa, jomoko ne paro ni Yesu nonyise mondo odhi ongʼiew gik mane dwarore e sawo, kata ni mondo ochiw gimoro ni jodhier.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

kikuyu: ok awinjora gi kech kod adieragi duto misenyiso jatichni. Ne an mana gi ludha kende kane angʼado aora Jordan, to koro aseduogo gi ogendini ariyo.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

kikuyu: Dhahabu kata kite mamil ma nengogi tek ok nyal pimego bende ok nyal pime gi gima olos gi dhahabu.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo mano kendo en gima iwuoro ka waneno.
english: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

kikuyu: Ogendini oselutore e buche ma gikunyo; tiendegi ogajore e tondegi ma gichokogo ji.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ipogo pinyni ni dhout Israel kaka girkeni, to nyaka uwal tenge lowo ma borne romo fut alufu piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich, to lachne en fut alufu piero adek. Kama owal ni Jehova Nyasaye duto nobed maler.
english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to the LORD, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nodwoko Jehoshafat niya, “Pod nitie ngʼato achiel manyalo penjonwa Jehova Nyasaye wach, to ok adware nikech ok okor gimoro amora maber kuoma, to kinde duto mana gik maricho. Nyinge en Mikaya wuod Imla.” Jehoshafat nodwoko niya, “Ruoth ok onego iwach kamano.”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

kikuyu: Ne iwuoyo kuom Roho Maler gi dho jatichni, ma en kwarwa Daudi, kiwacho niya: “ ‘Angʼo momiyo ogendini igi owangʼ kendo ji chano jiemo kayiem nono?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Joma owar mag Jehova Nyasaye mondo owach kama joma ne owaro e lwet jasigu,
english: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

kikuyu: Kristo to notimo misango mar golo richo dichiel kende, mi obet piny e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye.
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: Gikanyono, kane pok asudo mabor kodgi, ne ayudo ngʼat ma chunya ohero. Ne amake matek, kendo ne adagi weye thuolo mondo odhi mine akele nyaka e od minwa, kama ne onywolae.
english: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.

kikuyu: Gin giwegi ginibed wasumbini pinje mangʼeny kod ruodhi maroteke; anachulgi kaluwore gitimbegi kod tije mag lwetgi.”
english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

kikuyu: Ka Yesu nowinjo ni Johana oseter e od twech, nodok Galili.
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi osetieko chiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok, ne ogwedho jo-Israel ka oluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kuom gik mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Jehoyakim, timbe maricho manotimo kod ketho malingʼ-lingʼ mane ofweny kuome, ondiki e kitap ruodhi mag Israel kod Juda. Kendo Jehoyakin wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To nyaka obed ngʼat mohero rwako welo, mohero gigo mabeyo, ngʼat ma terore mos, ma ja-ratiro, moluoro Nyasaye; kendo mawinjo puonj.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane obetie komno ne kite nenore ka kite ma nengogi tek miluongo ni jaspa gi sardus. Kit lihudu mar koth man-gi kido machalo emerald ne olworo kom duongʼno.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

kikuyu: Bende negirito pasia mag laru, pasia mar dhorangach mar laru molworo kama ler gi kendo mar misango kod tonde, kaachiel gi gik moko duto mitwechogo.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

kikuyu: Kik ucham pok mar achiel kuom apar mar cham, divai manyien, kod mo, kata chiwo mag nyithindo makayo mag dhou kod jambu kata chiwo mar kwongʼruok kata chiwo mar hera kata chiwo mogen e miechu.
english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

kikuyu: Ngʼama kunyo bur matut nyalo lwar e iye; to ngʼama muko kor ot thuol nyalo kayo.
english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

kikuyu: Wasedongʼ kiye, to minewa chalo mon ma chwogi otho.
english: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi ne manye e sawono ka gipenjo niya, “Ere ngʼatno?”
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

kikuyu: Eka naneno jochiende adek machalo ogwende, ka wuok e dho thuol mangʼongono kendo e dho ondiek malich kendo e dho janabi mar miriambo.
english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

kikuyu: eka anakwed nyikwa Jakobo kod Daudi jatichna kendo ok anayier achiel kuom yawuote mondo obed jatelo ewi nyikwa Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo. Nimar anaduognegi mwandugi mi anangʼwon-negi.’ ”
english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.”

kikuyu: Ne ubet ka unono pinyno kuom ndalo piero angʼwen, omiyo unuchul richou kuom higni piero angʼwen, ka higa achiel ikwano kar ndalo achiel, mi unufweny malongʼo gima omiyo akwedou.’
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

kikuyu: “Bende jowi ma e thim yie tiyoni? Bende inyalo kete mobed mos e kund jambi gotieno?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

kikuyu: To bende, nyaka idhi gi fedha kod dhahabu ma ruoth gi jongʼadne rieko osechiwo kuom hero mag-gi giwegi ne Nyasach Israel, ma kar dak mare en Jerusalem,
english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ikwed ngʼatno misewiro.
english: “LORD God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

kikuyu: Ilich miwuoro ka in kari maler, yaye Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel chiwo teko gi nyalo ne joge. Pak mondo obed ne Nyasaye!
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

kikuyu: Ngʼado rieko kod ngʼado bura malongʼo gin maga; an-gi winjo tiend wach kod nyalo.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

kikuyu: Mwandu ma un-go osetop, kendo olwenda osechamo lepu otieko.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

kikuyu: Kuomi ema thoro mara mar pak e chokruok maduongʼ aye; abiro chopo singruok maga e nyim joma oluori.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

kikuyu: bende kanyo ema abiro romoe gi jo-Israel, mi duongʼna nomi kanyo bed maler.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

kikuyu: Eka malaika maratego nokawo kidi machalo gi pongʼ rego maduongʼ, notingʼe kendo nobole e nam, kowacho niya, “Kamano e kaka Babulon dala maduongʼ nobol piny, mi ok nonene ngangʼ.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, Judas, mane en achiel kuom jopuonjrene apar gariyo nothinyore gi oganda mane omanore gi gik lwenje kaka ligangla gi arunge. Ne oorgi koa ir Jodolo madongo, jopuonj chik kod jodong oganda.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

kikuyu: Pogri chuth gi mbekni mofuwo maonge rieko, kingʼeyo ni gikelo dhawo.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

kikuyu: Omiyo rawere mane odhi nono pinyno nodhi Jeriko e od Rahab mi ogole kaachiel gi wuon-gi, min-gi, owetene kod joodgi duto. Negigolo anywolane duto oko mi giketogi oko mar kambi jo-Israel.
english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka negimanyo ei piny Israel duto nyako ma jaber mine giyudo Abishag nyar Shunam mine gikele ni ruoth.
english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nooro joote ir Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo konyise niya, “Miya Mikal chiega mane anywomo an awuon gi ringre jo-Filistia mia achiel.”
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: to mana kaka antie an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni kata dabed ni ji adekgi ni e iye, to ok digires kata mana ngima yawuotgi kata dine bed ni adekgi ni e iye, to ok digires kata mana ngima yawuotgi kata mar nyigi giwegi. Gin kendgi ema noresgi.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

kikuyu: Beduru gi jodolo abiriyo motingʼo turumbete molos gi tunge imbe e nyim Sandug Muma. E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo, lworuru dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo, ka jodolo goyo turumbetego.
english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

kikuyu: To enobed gi loch kuom od Jakobo nyaka chiengʼ, pinyruodhe ok norum ngangʼ.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: “To kwerewa, nobedo jongʼayi kendo joma tokgi tek, mine ok giluoro chikegi.
english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

kikuyu: Esau nowacho ne wuon mare niya, “In mana kod gweth achiel kende wuora? Yie igwedha an bende!” Eka Esau noywak matek gi dwol maduongʼ.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

kikuyu: To jo-Misri nosandowa mi omiyo wathagore ka giketowa e tich matek.
english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

kikuyu: Kane aneno ni wuondruokgino opogore gi adiera mar Injili, ne awacho ne Petro ka giduto giwinjo niya, “Ka in iwuon in ja-Yahudi, to itimo timbe joma ok jo-Yahudi, koro marangʼo ichuno joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo oluw timbe jo-Yahudi?
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

kikuyu: Osepongʼo chunya gi gik makech kod olo.
english: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye okelou e piny jo-Kanaan gi jo-Hiti gi jo-Amor gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus, piny ma nosingore ne kwereu ni nomiu, piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich; to nyaka utim sawoni e dweni:
english: It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

kikuyu: Kik iher nindo nono to ibiro bedo jachan, bed kineno to ok ibi chando chiemo.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: pewe mondo okog gi mor, kod gik moko duto manie igi. Eka yiende duto manie bungu nower gi mor;
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

kikuyu: To kane Judas osekawo makatino, Satan nodonjo kuome. Yesu nokone niya, “Gima idwaro timono, tim piyo.”
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

kikuyu: An jatichni, ne an gi yawuowi ariyo. Negigore ka gin oko e pap, ne onge ngʼato machiegni mane nyalo thegogi. Achiel nogoyo machielo mi onege.
english: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

kikuyu: Ne ok ginyal time e kinde mane onego otime nimar jodolo moromo ne pok opwodhore to ji bende ne pok ochokore Jerusalem.
