english: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ka ineno punda jasiki ka lodi motingʼo ogoye piny, to kik iweye kanyo; nyaka ine ni ikonye.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

kikuyu: Jokwangʼ duto ne luoro omako mi ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi ne oywak ne nyasache owuon. Ne gidiro mwandu duto mane gin-go e nam mondo yie odongʼ mayot. To ne oyudo Jona oselor e ot ma piny mar yie, kuma ne oriere mi nindo okwanye mogoye ngoga.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

kikuyu: Omiyo kata bed ni an ema ne ayalonu Injili kata gin ema ne giyalonu, to ma e gima waduto wayalo kendo ema ne uyie.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kikuyu: Aore iru mondo onyisu chalwa kendo mondo ojiw chunyu.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

kikuyu: Notiyo ni Baal kendo nolame mi nomiyo Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, obedo gi mirima mana kaka wuon-gi nosetimo.
english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.

kikuyu: Kone joma kare ni gin johawi, nimar giniyud pok kuom tichgi matek.
english: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

kikuyu: Nyis ji wechegi kiwachonegi ni, ‘Uchiegni kalo e piny joweteu ma nyikwa Esau modak Seir. Gibiro bedo gi kibaji nikech un, to beduru motangʼ.
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato chulo rach kar ber, rach ok nowe ode.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

kikuyu: Koro Jeriko nolor motegno nikech jo-Israel kendo onge ngʼama ne nyalo wuok oko kata donjo iye.
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

kikuyu: Tiendene ne pakni ka mula mopwodhi gi mach, bende dwonde ne mor ka pi mopongʼ mawuo.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata manomaki nochwo matho, jogo duto momaki noneg gi ligangla.
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

kikuyu: Kata ka orere kuom gimoro makwero moa kuom dhano ka ok ongʼeyo, mi ofwenyo achien, to enodok jaketho.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: Omiyo Shekem mane omi duongʼ e od wuon-gi, ne ok odeko timo gima ne yawuot Jakobo owacho, nikech nomor gi Dina nyar Jakobo.
english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Juda ne gin: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur gi Shobal.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

kikuyu: Dalano noger ma bethene angʼwen romre, ka borne ne rom gi lachne. Nopimo dala gi luth kendo noyudo ni borne gi lachne kod borne modhi malo ne romo kilomita alufu ariyo gi mia ariyo (2,200) maromre.
english: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

kikuyu: Koro min Yesu gi owetene nobiro mondo ginene, to ne ok ginyal sudo machiegni kode nikech oganda.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye oserito singruok mane otimo: Asekawo loch wuora Daudi kendo asebet e kom loch mar Israel, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingo, kendo asegero hekalu ni Nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne ikawo moko kuom lewni mabeyo mane amiyi mi idhi ipedho kuonde motingʼore gi malo, kuma ne itime timbegi mag chode. Gik ma kamago ne pok owinji, kendo ok owinjore gitimre ngangʼ.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

kikuyu: Eka min yawuot Zebedi nobiro ir Yesu kaachiel gi yawuote, kendo bangʼ goyo chong-gi piny e nyime, ne gikwaye ni otimnegie ngʼwono.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

kikuyu: “Simeon gi Lawi gin owete, gisetimo timbe mag lweny gi liganglagi.
english: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

kikuyu: Dan kod Naftali; Gad kod Asher.
english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

kikuyu: Eka piny biro chiego cham kaka owinjore kendo Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa, biro gwedhowa.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

kikuyu: Nikech Daudi jatichni, kik idagi ngʼati miseyiero.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Paruru nine un wasumbini e piny Misri kendo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ne oresou kua kuno. Mano emomiyo achikou mondo utim kamano.
english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo weche mane Yesu oyudo osewacho ochop kare. Nonyisogi niya, “Onge kata ngʼato achiel moselal kuom joma ne imiya.”
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

kikuyu: Eka nolokore mochako wuoyo gi ngʼama chielo konono mana wachno kendo ji nodwoke mana wach machalre gi manosewinjo.
english: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.

kikuyu: Amazia wuod Joash ruodh Juda nodak higni apar gabich bangʼ tho Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz ruodh Israel.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okendo machiegni, kik tere e lweny kata kete e tich moro. Kuom higa achiel miuru ngʼatno thuolo momiyogi chiege mokendono mor.
english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

kikuyu: Joma riek okano ngʼeyo, to dho joma ofuwo kelo kethruok.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

kikuyu: Jaherana nosoyo lwete e otuchi mar dhoot; chunya nochako gwecho ka dware.
english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.

kikuyu: mane gin yawuowi apar mag Haman wuod Hamedatha, jawasik jo-Yahudi. To jo-Yahudi ne ok oyako gimoro amora.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Eri koro isenene; kendo en ema owuoyo kodini.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

kikuyu: To ne gin gi rech moko manok bende. Rechgi bende Yesu nogwedho momiyo jopuonjrene mondo opog ni ji.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

kikuyu: Ka uhero mana joma oherou kende, to pok mane muyudo? Donge kata josol osuru bende timo mano?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Los tonde milierogo pasia piero abich e giko riak pasia konchiel kendo tonde milierogo pasia e giko riak pasia komachielo.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Im matunge ariyo mane inenono ochungʼ kar ruodhi mag Media gi Pasia.
english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

kikuyu: Nomiye kitap Isaya janabi, ka oelogo, noyudo kama nondikie ni:
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne giyanye mangʼeny kagiwacho niya, “In e japuonjrene! Wan to wan jopuonjre Musa.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

kikuyu: Ubiro mako ich to unywolo yamo; muya muyweyo en mach ma tiekou.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye! Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye gie polo, ee, pakeuru gi malo kuma bor.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

kikuyu: Joma nodak e bwo tipone kod pinje mane jokore bende notho kaachiel kode, kendo ne giriwore gi joma ne otho e lweny.
english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mar ariyo gokinyi kane gichiewo, negiyudo Dagon kanyo kosegore piny auma e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye. Wiye gi lwetene ne osetur kendo ne ni e ndiri, dende kende ema ne odongʼ.
english: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.

kikuyu: Enomuk sirni mowal milamo mag hekalu mar chiengʼ man Misri kendo enowangʼ hekalu mag nyiseche jo-Misri.’ ”
english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”

kikuyu: omiyo anamiyi rieko kod ngʼeyo. Kendo abiro miyi mwandu kod duongʼ kod pak maonge ruoth kata achiel kuom mago moteloni kata mabiro bangʼi nobedgo.”
english: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

kikuyu: mondo gichulgo kuor ni ogendini kendo gikum ogendini mamoko,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ni koda, omiyo ok analuor. Ere gima dhano ditimna?
english: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: “To nodwoko achiel kuomgi ni, ‘Osiepna, onge gima rach ma asetimoni. Donge ne iyie ni itiyone dinari achiel?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

kikuyu: Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego nodwoko ruoth niya, “Yaye Nebukadneza, onge tiende mondo wapwore e nyimi kuom wachni.
english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.

kikuyu: Anamiyi mwandu mopandi e mudho, mwandu mokan kuonde mopondo, mondo omi ingʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, maluongi gi nyingi.
english: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Kik iwe tich bari ndasi ni mondo ibed ja-mwandu, bed gi rieko mondo iritri.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

kikuyu: Jadolo Maduongʼ moro amora iyiero mondo ochiw mich kaachiel gi misango, omiyo kata jadolowani bende ne nyaka chiw gimoro.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

kikuyu: Modhi miwirorigo dungʼ mamit; kendo nyingi chalo gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar ma pukore oko. Kare mano emomiyo nyiri duto oheri!
english: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

kikuyu: Kane ahulo yorena to ne idwoka; puonja chikeni.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Nathan nonyiso Daudi weche duto mane ofwenyne.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Mad Nyasaye chwada malit ka dipo kawuono ok angʼado wi Elisha wuod Shafat oko!”
english: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Donge ma en Yesu, ma wuod Josef, ma wangʼeyo wuon gi min? Ere kaka dobukre kowacho sani ni, ‘Ne abiro e piny ka aa e polo’ ?”
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

kikuyu: Miye tekoni moko mondo mi oganda jo-Israel duto omiye luor.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

kikuyu: Kane Sihon kod jolwenje duto nobiro mondo ochak kodwa lweny e piny Jahaz,
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

kikuyu: Ee, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Kik iwe jonabi kod joma neno wach e lek manie dieru wuondu. Kik uchik itu ne lek ma gileko nikech mano miyo gimedo leko.
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

kikuyu: Gouru tungʼ e Sayun; kendo gouru milome e goda maler. Ji duto modak e piny mondo otetni, nikech odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye biro. Osesudo machiegni.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD comes, for it is close at hand:

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Lor piny iom Harun ibigo ira. To jodolo gi ji kik rire mondo one Jehova Nyasaye, nono to abiro mwomora kuomgi.”
english: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”

kikuyu: “To ka ngʼato omiyo achiel kuom jomatindo moyie kuomagi odonjo e richo to dibed maber ka otwene pongʼ marangʼongo e ngʼute bangʼe onyumego e chuny nam.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

kikuyu: Midhiero oikore mar chame kendo chandruok okichore mar muonye sa ma opodho.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

kikuyu: Ruodhi mon gi timbe maricho, nikech kom mar loch obedo mana kuom tim makare.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

kikuyu: Kendo Nowa notimo duto ma Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: “Kik iwach wachni e piny Gath, kik ihul wachni e yore man Ashkelon, nono to dimi nyi jo-Filistia bed moil, bende dimi nyi joma ok oter nyangu bed moil.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ngʼat moro mane odak Ramathaim Zuf e piny gode mag Efraim. Ngʼatno ne nyinge Elkana wuod Jeroham ma wuod Elihu wuod Tohu, wuod Zuf ma ja-Efraim.
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Ere gima omiyo iwacho ni, ‘Kinyalo?’ Gik moko duto nyalo timore ni ngʼat moyie.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

kikuyu: Omiyo mirima osemako Jehova Nyasaye gi jo-Juda kod Jerusalem; kendo nomiyo gibedo gima lich; miwuoro kendo mocha mana kaka uneno giwengeu uwegi.
english: Therefore the LORD’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

kikuyu: Nikech mana kaka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa nigi ringruok achiel man-gi fuonde mangʼeny, to kendo fuondegi duto ok tim tich machalre,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

kikuyu: Un to un mag Kristo, to Kristo en mar Nyasaye.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

kikuyu: “Israel ma en nyako ngili koro osepodho, kendo ok nochak oa malo, nimar osepodho e pinye owuon maonge ngʼama nyalo chunge.”
english: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

kikuyu: To kik uchik mana itu ni winjo wach kende, nono to uwuondoru kendu uwegi to timuru mana gima Muma puonjo.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

kikuyu: Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo, ma en Nyasach kwerewa, ema osemiyo Yesu jatichne duongʼ. Ne uchiwe mondo onege, kendo ne ukwede e nyim Pilato, kata obedo ni Pilato ne dwaro gonye.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

kikuyu: Esau nopenjo niya, “Kweth maduongʼ mane aromogo cha tiendgi angʼo?” Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Ne aorogi mondo gibi gi kwana ngʼwono kuom ruodha.”
english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowacho ni jo-Hivi niya, “To ka dipo ni udak kodwa machiegni, ere kaka dwa los kodu winjruok?”
english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”

kikuyu: Bende anaweye kojwangʼore ma ok olose kata doye kendo ongʼono, kod kuthe ema nodongie. Abiro chiko boche polo mondo kik koth ochwene.”
english: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

kikuyu: ne Ibrahim kod nyikwaye nyaka chiengʼ, mana kaka nowachone kwerewa.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

kikuyu: Un to ogwedh wengeu nikech gineno, itu bende nikech giwinjo wach.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

kikuyu: Mano kaka en gima nono chiko obadho ka winy duto neno.
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

kikuyu: Ma e gima usebedo ka unyiso janabi: ‘Jehova Nyasaye miyi dwoko mane?’ kata, ‘Jehova Nyasaye osewacho angʼo?’
english: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and, ‘What has the LORD spoken?’

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ji miye luor, nikech ok opak joma pachgi wuondo ni riek.”
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywolo Enosh, Seth nodak kuom higni mia aboro gabiriyo kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Ondiek malichno nomi dhok mar wacho weche mag sungruok kod ayany, kendo ne oyiene bedo gi loch kuom dweche piero angʼwen gariyo.
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maber weyo mwandu ne nyithind nyithinde, to mwandu jaricho okan ni joma kare.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo, ichok jodong jo-Israel mondo iwachnegi kama. ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu; ma en Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo; nofwenyorena mi owachona kama: Aserangou mi aseneno gino mosetimnu e piny Misri.
english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Benjamin, ne en Palti wuod Rafu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

kikuyu: Pien dende oriw motegno gimoko matek ma ok gingʼingʼni.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Kete ochungʼ e nyim Eliazar jadolo kod chokruok duto mar oganda kendo ipwodhe e nyimgi.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka ne okelogi nyaka e tongʼ mar pinje maler, nyaka ne gitundo e piny motimo gode, ma lwete ma korachwich nosekawo.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

kikuyu: Kik gimiu luoro nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu manie dieru duongʼ kendo en Nyasaye man-gi teko.
english: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

kikuyu: Miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ mowinjore gi nyinge; kelneuru mich kendo biuru e laru mage.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

kikuyu: Ne ingʼado bura gie polo, mi piny ne luoro omako molingʼ thi.
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

kikuyu: Herana obed kodu un duto ei Kristo Yesu. Amin.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye kendo mi Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke ne, “Lor idhi Keila nimar adhi chiwo jo-Filistia e lweti.”
english: Then David inquired of the LORD yet again. The LORD answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kata sani bende pod nitie jomodongʼ, moyier kuom ngʼwono.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

kikuyu: Hezro ja-Karmel, Naarai wuod Ezbai,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Non ane ni wuowini en wuod ngʼa?”
english: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

kikuyu: Noyudo joka Jakobo kama otimo ongoro, ma en kama otwo kendo mojwangʼ. Nochielogi koni gi koni moritogi maber, mana ka ngʼama ochielo tong wangʼe,
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

kikuyu: Landuru teko mar Nyasaye ma nigi duongʼ kuom Israel, kendo ma nigi teko e kor polo.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

kikuyu: nyikwa Netofa, ji piero abich gauchiel (56),
english: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko mane ni e got ne gin: Shamir, Jatir, Soko,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

kikuyu: Pok adak e ot chakre ndalo mane agolo jo-Israel e piny Misri nyaka kawuono. Asebedo kawuotho kuonde miguroe hema mopogore kaka kar dakna.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

kikuyu: To Sihon notamo jo-Israel kalo e pinye. Nochoko ogandane mar lweny duto kendo negidhi e thim mondo giked gi Israel. Kane ochopo Jahaz, nokedo gi Israel.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

kikuyu: Ubed e ot moro amora mudonje, nyaka ua e dalano.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

kikuyu: To ka kama opurno ochako othinyore e lawno, kata e usino mochwe kata e lawno motwangʼ, kata e pien, kolandore, kendo gima kamano mopur nyaka wangʼ e mach.
english: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

kikuyu: Luoruru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo utine. Rituru adiera mare ka ukwongʼoru e nyinge.
english: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

kikuyu: Ok ginibed gi pok e kind jowetegi, nimar Jehova Nyasaye e pok margi mana kaka nosesingorenegi.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The LORD is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, “Chiengʼno anami chiengʼ podhi e chuny odiechiengʼ tir, kendo anami piny lokre mudho godiechiengʼ.
english: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord GOD, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

kikuyu: eka ibiro gwedhoi kata obedo ni ok ginyal chuloi, to nochuli chiengʼ chier mar joma kare.”
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

kikuyu: Wabiro yienu mana ka utimo gimoro achielni: mondo ubed kaka wan ka utero yawuotu duto nyangu.
english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

kikuyu: Abisalom nosechiko jotijene niya, “Winjuru! Ka Amnon osemetho momer, to anawachnu ni, Goyeuru ma unege. Kik ubed maluor. Donge an ema asechikou? Beduru motegno kendo ma jochir.”
english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

kikuyu: Winjeuru ywak mar jokwath; nimar kuondegi mabeyo mag kwath osekethi. Winjeuru kaka sibuoche ruto, nimar bunge mag Jordan ma gidakie osekethi!
english: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.

kikuyu: Nodiro aserni mokeyo wasigu, mor polo gi mil polo noriembogi.
english: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

kikuyu: Chandruok kod malit osebirona, kata kamano chikeni e morna.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, neye ngʼwono kod gero mar Nyasaye: oger gi joma ne opodho, to onyiso ngʼwonone ne un, to mana ka usiko e ngʼwonone; nono to un bende ibiro ngʼadou oko.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nogolo chik mondo obatisgi e nying Yesu Kristo. Bangʼ mano ne gikwayo Petro mondo omed bet kodgi kuom ndalo moko.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Gi dwol mar “Ondanyo.” Maskil mar yawuot Kora. Wend Arus. Chunya bedo mamor gi wer mamit e kinde mawero Zaburi maga ne Ruoth; kendo lewa chalo kalamb jandiko mongʼith.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

kikuyu: Joma dwaro kawo ngimana ibiro tieki; gibiro dhi piny nyaka ei bur kama tut.
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Ooro wach gie polo kendo oresa, kokwero joma lawa gi tekregi duto; Sela Nyasaye oro herane gi adiera mare.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uchalo liete mowir marachar, manenore maber gi oko, to gie iyegi to gipongʼ gi choke joma otho kod gimoro amora mogak.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

kikuyu: Gik mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Pekahia, to gi weche duto mane otimo, ondiki e kitepe weche mag ruodhi Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Kendo ji duto manowinjo wachni, nowuoro gima jokwath nowachonegi.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

kikuyu: “Asewinjo ayenje mag jo-Moab kod ajara mag jo-Amon, moseyanyo joga kendo obwogogi e lopgi.”
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne apwodho jodolo kod jo-Lawi kuom gimoro amora ma wendo, mi amiyogi tije, moro ka moro gi kare owuon.
english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

kikuyu: Okwongʼi, yaye Moab, otieku duto, yaye jo-Kemosh! Oseweyo yawuote e lwet nono mobedo jonjore kendo nyige obedo joma oter e twech, ir Sihon ruodh jo-Amor.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

kikuyu: Kristo to noresowa kuom kwongʼ ma Chik kelo, ka en owuon nobedonwa kaka ngʼama okwongʼ nikech wan, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Okwongʼ ngʼato ka ngʼato molier e yath.”
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ noyiecho lepe kowacho niya, “Pod wadwaro joneno mamoko nangʼo?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

kikuyu: E kindeno ji mangʼeny nolokre mawe yie kendo ginindhogre ka gichare kendgi,
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

kikuyu: Laban nomedo wacho ne Jakobo niya, “Ne pidhni kendo ne sironi maseketo e kinda kodi.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

kikuyu: kendo e ndalono ema ne Jehova Nyasaye owuoyo kokalo kuom Isaya wuod Amoz. Nowachone niya, “Gony pien gugru manie dendi kendo ilony wuocheni oko e tiendi.” Kendo notimo kamano kowuotho duk gi tiende nono.
english: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Kara koro ruoth osingre gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ni odhi tamo jachul kuor mondo kik omed ketho kendo mondo wuoda kik negi.” Nowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni onge yie wi wuodi kata achiel manolwar piny.”
english: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Israel kata obedo ni ungʼeny, ka kwoyo manie dho nam, to ji manok kuomu kende ema nodwogi. Nimar oseketo bura makare mabiro tieko ji duto.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

kikuyu: Negikwere kagiwacho niya, “Uzia, ok en tiji wangʼo ni Jehova Nyasaye ubani; nimar mano en tij jodolo ma nyikwa Harun mane opwodhi mondo giwangʼ ubani. Wuogi e kama ler mar lemo nikech iseketho, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ok nogwedhi.”
english: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from the LORD God.”

kikuyu: Gisando mon ma chwogi otho kendo ok gikech mon maonge nyithindo.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

kikuyu: Tiend gima awacho ema: Chik mane Nyasaye ochiwo higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek bangʼe ok nyal ketho winjruok ma Nyasaye nokwongo timo ma mi oketh singruok mane otimo motelo.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

kikuyu: To dhok maricho kendo modherogo nochamo dhok mabeyo machwego. Eka Farao nochiewo.
english: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

kikuyu: Kata mana sa ma inindo but mach kama liet, to bwombe mag akuchena oum gi dhahabu, kendo yierene oum gi fedha maleny.”
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

kikuyu: Jo-Babulon nomuko sirni mag mula, rachungi mag taya kod Karaya Maduongʼ mar mula mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne gitero mulago nyaka Babulon.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua noduogo gi jo-Israel duto e kambi man Gilgal.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

kikuyu: Un, jo-Lawi, kod jodak manie dieru biro bedo gimor kuom gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou kod joutu duto.
english: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel odwogo koa lawo jo-Filistia, ne giyako kargi mar bworo.
english: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto noa ka ngʼato ka ngʼato dok e dalane, kendo Daudi bende nodhi dalane mondo ogwedh joge.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Wer gi thumbe man-gi Waya. Maskil mar Daudi. Winj lamona, yaye Nyasaye, kik itamri winjo ywakna;
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nokwane kaka ngʼama kare nikech timneno, kendo ibiro kwane kamano nyaka tienge mabiro.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

kikuyu: Abiro siko mana ka awacho ni an kare ndalona duto; kendo pacha ler e wachni e ndalo duto.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

kikuyu: Menahem nochuno joma ne nigi mwandu e Israel mondo ogol pesano. Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi nyaka ne chiw pesa ma pekne romo nus kilo mar fedha mondo mi ruodh Asuria. Omiyo ruodh Asuria noa e pinyno modok thurgi.
english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

kikuyu: Gimoro achiel mane gikwayowa mondo kik wiwa wilgo ne en ni mondo wadhi nyime gi konyo joma odhier, gima an awuon ne aikora timo.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

kikuyu: To ne gingʼanyona kendo negitamore winja; ne ok giwito kido manono mane gisechomo wengegi kuome kagilamo, bende ne ok giweyo nyiseche manono mag jo-Misri. Omiyo ne awacho ni abiro olo mirimba mager kuomgi ka aketo mirimba kuomgi e piny Misri.
english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Musa nosepogo yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan ni dhoudi ariyo gi nus kaka girkeni, to ne ok opogo jo-Lawi girkeni e dier ogendini moko,
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane giseketo kitabu ei od Elishama jagoro, negidhi ir ruoth e laru kendo giwachone gimoro amora.
english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

kikuyu: Omiyo Abram nopudho hembene mi odhi odak but yiende madongo mag Mamre ei Hebron, kamane ogeroe kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Richo mar Juda ondik gi kalamb chuma; ogor gi gima bith e chunygi, kendo e tunge kende mag misango miwangʼoe liswa.
english: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel oneno ka Abimelek otho, ne giwuok mi gidok e miechgi.
english: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.

kikuyu: Joka ruoth oro jotichgi manyo pi; gidhi e sokni to ok giyud pi. Gidwogo gi agulni mag-gi ka ok otuome pi, ka giluor kendo gibuok, giumo wiyegi.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

kikuyu: kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo wi Got Sinai. Kuom ndalo auchiel boche polo noimo godno kendo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo Jehova Nyasaye noluongo Musa ka en ei bor polo.
english: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

kikuyu: Wadwaro ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu odhi nyime katimo maber nyaka giko, eka ubed gi ratiro mar yudo gik mugeno yudo.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

kikuyu: Omiyo nooro yawuowi apar mowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru Karmel ir Nabal mondo umosnago.
english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

kikuyu: Kane jolup Yesu noneno gima ne dhi timore, negiwacho niya, “Ruoth, owinjore waked gi ligengniwa koso?”
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

kikuyu: kane ngʼato owachona ni, ‘Saulo otho,’ noparo ni okelona wach maber. Ne amake mine onege Ziklag. Mano e mich manamiye kuom kelona wach.
english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

kikuyu: Hefer ja-Mekerath, Ahija ja-Pelon,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata moriwore gi chiayo nyaka negi.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni kane pok onywol Ibrahim, to ne Antie!”
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

kikuyu: Joshua kod jo-Israel duto nowuondore ni ologi, mi giringo ka gichiko thim.
english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Kochopo odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo to ulwok lepu kendo ubiro bedo maler. Bangʼe unyalo biro e kambi.”
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

kikuyu: Nochungʼ e batha mowachona niya, ‘Owadwa Saulo, nen!’ Kendo gikanyono ne aneno mi angʼiye.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

kikuyu: mondo opwodhe maler, koluoke gi pi kuom wach
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

kikuyu: “Kik upar ni asebiro mondo aketh Chik kata Jonabi. Ok asebiro mondo akethgi, to asebiro mar chopogi.
english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

kikuyu: Eka Mikaya nodwoke niya, “Ne aneno jo-Israel duto koke ewi gode mana kaka rombe maonge jakwath, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘Jogi onge gi ruoth. Yie iwe ngʼato ka ngʼato odhi e dalane gi kwe.’ ”
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

kikuyu: Kata ka gitony e kethruok, Misri nochokgi, kendo Memfis noikgi. Mwandu mag fedha noum gi pedo kendo kuthe noum hembegi.
english: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.

kikuyu: Koro Hagai janabi kod Zekaria janabi, nyakwar Ido, nokorone jo-Yahudi e Juda gi Jerusalem e nying Nyasach Israel, mane nitiere kuomgi.
english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo dok e bur matut, nyaka ogendini duto ma wigi wil gi Nyasaye.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ ka urito chike ma amiyou mondo udhi maber kaachiel gi nyikwau nikech mano utimo gima ber kendo malongʼo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

kikuyu: Unyalo wacho kendu niya, “Ogendinigi tek moloyowa. Ere kaka wanyalo riembogi oko?”
english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

kikuyu: Ginindo piny e lewni mosing but kende mag misango. Divai ma gikawo kuom joma gigoyo faini gimadho e od nyasachgi.
english: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

kikuyu: “Bende nitiere ngʼat mapiem gi Jehova Nyasaye Maratego manyalo kwere? Mad koro ngʼat mamino wach gi Nyasaye oduokeane!”
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

kikuyu: ma ok obwogu e yo moro amora, gi joma kwedou. Mano biro bedonegi ranyisi ni ibiro tiekgi, to un ibiro resu kendo Nyasaye ema biro timo mano.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

kikuyu: To muofni ariyo mane oyudo obet e bath yo kane owinjo ni Yesu ne kadho machiegni kanyo, nokok matek niya, “Ruoth, Wuod Daudi, yie ikechwa!”
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne oneno ma mi oweyogi nikech iye nowangʼ gi yawuote kod nyige.
english: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

kikuyu: Jo-Zif nodhi Gibea ir Saulo ma giwachone niya, “Donge Daudi opondo ewi got Hakila momanyore gi Jeshimon?”
english: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”

kikuyu: Bende nuneno gima notimone jolwenj Misri, faresegi kod gechegi kane gilawou mi Nam Makwar oimogi kendo mi Jehova Nyasaye otiekogi pep.
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how the LORD has destroyed them to this day;

kikuyu: mi chwore owinje to olingʼ alingʼa, to kwongʼruokneno nobed kamano.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Nyiswa ka in e Kristo.” Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ka awachonu, to ok ubi yie gima awachonuno,
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo owinjo ni Dina nyare osedwany to ne ok owacho gimoro nyaka yawuote noduogo dala koa kwayo jambe.
english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

kikuyu: Jeroboam noseoro jolweny mondo oluor e tokgi mondo ni kane en e nyim Juda to jolweny moko mondo omonjgi gi ka tokgi.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

kikuyu: Magi duto timore nikech gombo mandhaga mar ochot, maywayo ji ire, en e chot ma jo-nyakalondo dhi ire, en ema ne oketo ogendini misumbinine kuom timbene mag chode kendo oywayo ji kuome gi timbene mag jwok.
english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

kikuyu: Aminadab ne en wuon Nashon, Nashon ne en wuon Salmon,
english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka asechier to anatelnu adhi Galili.”
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: To ka nodoko jasunga ma wiye tek, kendo mopongʼ gi achaya, nogole oko e loch kendo omaye duongʼne.
english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.

kikuyu: Abiro rwakou kaka ubani madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ka anagolu ua e dier ogendini kendo ka anachoku ua e pinje ma osekeue, kendo ananyisranu kaka ngʼama ler e dieru ka ogendini neno gi wengegi.
english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Wecheni iwuon ema ngʼadoni bura, to ok an, kendo gik ma lewi wacho ema nyiso kiti marach.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

kikuyu: Kane piny dwaro yawore Jehova Nyasaye nonenogi gie ligek mach, mine omiyo jolwenj jo-Misri odigni.
english: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

kikuyu: Omiyo, ka iparo ni ichungʼ motegno bed motangʼ, nono to ipodho!
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo Got Seir doko gunda ma gimoro onge, kendo abiro riembo joma donjo e iye kendo wuokie.
english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

kikuyu: Kanaan nonywolo Sidon wuode makayo, kendo jo-Hiti,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo chamuru Makati ma ok oketie thowi kendo chiengʼ mar abiriyo timuru nyasi ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.

kikuyu: Warruok ok nyal yud kuom ngʼat moro machielo; nikech onge nying moro machielo e bwo polo mosechiw ni mondo ji oyud warruok kuome.”
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

kikuyu: To jogo ma oketo genogi kuom nyiseche mopa, mawacho ni kido mopa niya, Un e nyisechewa, jogo nokwed magiyud wichkuot.
english: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Kaw Kitabu mar Chikegi mondo ikete but Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi. Kitabuni nodongʼ kaka janeno e kinda kodu.
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

kikuyu: Jakobo nowachone niya, “Asayi nyisa nyingi.” To nodwoko Jakobo niya, “Angʼo momiyo ipenjo nyinga?” Eka nogwedho Jakobo kanyo.
english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.

kikuyu: Ndaloge duto mag tich en lit gi kuyo; kata mana gotieno pache onge gi kwe. Ma bende ne ayudo ni onge tiende.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Kuom jonabi: Chunya maiye ool; chokega duto tetni. Achalo ngʼama omer, mana ka ngʼama divai osemero, nikech Jehova Nyasaye kod wechene maler.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD, and because of his holy words.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ok odewo kata mana wangʼ ruodhi kendo ok otim maber ne jo-mwandu to jochan to oweyo, nikech gin duto gin chwech lwete?
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

kikuyu: Bende dwachak waketh chikegi kendo wanywomre gi joma timo timbe mamono kama? Donge iyi diwangʼ kodwa matek madimi itiekwa, maonge ngʼama ditony kata achiel?
english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osechikou mondo utim, mondo duongʼne maler ofwenyrenu.”
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano chik iti ni lamo jatichni gi kwayone mar ngʼwono yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha. Winji ywak gi lemo ma jatichni lamo e nyimi.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Gad ma jokor wach mar Daudi niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: to ngʼeuru ni ngʼat ma kamano wuondore kende owuon bende onge gima ongʼeyo. Ngʼat ma kamano kasore gi mino wach kendo gigoyo mbaka manono makelo nyiego, gi dhawo, gi kuoth, kod chich maricho;
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

kikuyu: To ne inyono nam gi faresegi, ka iduwo pi.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

kikuyu: Gin ema negingʼado aora Jordan e dwe mokwongo kane aora opongʼ moo ma gimiyo jogo mane odak e holo oringo matek kadhi wuok chiengʼ to moko podho chiengʼ.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro luongo Uria jadolo kod Zekaria wuod Jeberekia mondo gibedna joneno mar adier.
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

kikuyu: Ne oike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi gi ruodhi nikech gigo mabeyo mane osetimo ni Nyasaye kod hekalu e Israel.
english: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

kikuyu: Jopinyno duto nobedo gi mor kendo dala maduongʼ nobedo gi kwe nikech Athalia nosenegi gi ligangla e kar dak ruoth.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Kwayo mar Daudi. Ret piyo mondo iresa, yaye Nyasaye; bi piyo mondo ikonya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Usekelo jogi ka, kata obedo ni ok gisekwalo gimoro e hekalu, kata yanyo nyasachwa madhakoni.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nochako kwedo mier mane thoth honnige osetimoree, nikech negitamore weyo richo.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

kikuyu: Ne iluonge ni Nabal to chiege ne iluongo ni Abigael. Ne en dhako mariek kendo ne ojaber, to chwore ne ja-dhood Kaleb, ne en ngʼama koch, jagwondo kendo ma timbene richo.
english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

kikuyu: To nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, aikora dhiyo kodi e od twech kendo e tho.”
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

kikuyu: Omiyo Gaal notelo ne jo-Shekem kendo mi gikedo gi Abimelek.
english: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

kikuyu: Kik ikaw jatichni ka dhako ma timbege mono. Asebedo kalamo ka nikech chandruok gi kuyona.
english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

kikuyu: Nikech igwedho joma kare adier, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; igengʼogi gi hapi mana ka okumba.
english: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mano dwar gweth e piny nyaka luong mana nying Nyasaye madiera; kendo ngʼato angʼata ma nokwongʼre e piny, nokwongʼre mana gi nying Nyasaye madiera. Nimar chandruok machon wich nowilgo, kendo ginilal e wangʼa.”
english: so that he who blesses himself on the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears on the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

kikuyu: Kane Esau owinjo weche wuon mare, noywak malit ka en-gi mirima mager kowachone wuon mare niya, “Wuora, gwedha an bende!”
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

kikuyu: Ne en-gi ich, kendo noywak ka en girem nikech muoch ne kaye kodwaro nywol.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

kikuyu: Ere kaka pod ok uwinjo ni ne ok awuo kodu kuom makati? To ritreuru kuom thowi mar jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.”
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Jotelo kod ji duto nokelo pokgi gi mor ka giketogi e sandugno nyaka nopongʼ thich.
english: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo anyisou ni pinyruodh Nyasaye ibiro gol kuomu kendo mi oganda machielo ma biro nyago olemo mare.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

kikuyu: “To e ndalono, bangʼ masirano maduongʼno, “ ‘Wangʼ chiengʼ noimre, kendo dwe ok norieny;
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

kikuyu: Amor ahinya gi chikeni; ok abi jwangʼo wachni.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

kikuyu: Anto amanyo Jehova Nyasaye gi wangʼa ka an kod geno, arito Nyasaye ma Jawarna; kendo Nyasacha biro winja.
english: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

kikuyu: Omiyo wan ne wadongʼ e bath holo machiegni gi Beth Peor.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kikuyu: oketho ranyisi mag jonabi mariambo kendo miyo joma neno gik moko nenore mofuwo, bende odwoko weche jomariek chien mi ginere gik maonge tich,
english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

kikuyu: Ka utimo kamano ma giywakna, adier anawinj ywakgi
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kikuyu: Ndalona rumo mos mos ka tipo mar odhiambo kendo yamo uka ka det bonyo.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

kikuyu: To negiwacho niya, “Ruoth, jotichni ne yawuowi apar gariyo, yawuot ngʼat achiel, wadak e piny Kanaan. Owadwa ma chogo nyo odongʼ gi wuonwa, to achiel to ne olal.”
english: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

kikuyu: Makmana asetingʼi malo mana ne wachni, ni mondo anyisigo tekona kendo mondo nyinga olandi e piny duto.
english: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

kikuyu: Joab nokelo ne ruoth kar kwan jolweny kama: Kuom jo-Israel ne nitie ji alufu mia aboro maroteke mane nyalo kedo gi ligangla to kuom jo-Juda ne nitie ji alufu mia abich.
english: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

kikuyu: Puonj mane wayudo kuom Kristo kendo koro wanyisou ema: Nyasaye en ler, kendo mudho onge kuome kata matin.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo mano, negipako Nyasaye, eka giwacho ni Paulo niya, “Owadwa Paulo, inyalo neno kaka jo-Yahudi gana gi gana oseyie kuom Ruoth Yesu, kendo kargi giduto giketo chunygi kuom luwo Chik.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ufuwo nadi to mano kaka chunyu kawo kinde mondo uyie duto mane jonabi osewacho!
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

kikuyu: “Ka jogi odhi kedo gi jowasikgi, kamoro amora ma ibiro orogie, ka gilamo Jehova Nyasaye ka gichomo dalani miseyiero kendo hekalu masegero maluongo nyingi;
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to the LORD toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

kikuyu: Kuom mano yawuot Jakobo kaachiel gi jo-Kanaan nodhi ngʼiewo cham nikech kech momako pinygi.
english: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: “Wach ni jo-Israel ni: ‘Chakre tarik apar gabich e dwe mar abiriyo en Sawo mar Kiche mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo nobedi kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

kikuyu: Chikgi nyaka obedgo kosomo pile ndalo duto mag ngimane mondo opuonjrego miyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache luor korito chikenegi kod buchene duto.
english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

kikuyu: ne En mane onego nyithindo makayo mag Misri, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Polo nolal nono ka kitabu mibano kendo gode duto gi chula duto nogol oa kuonde mane gintie.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Ok onego ulam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kaka gilamo nyisechegi, nikech Jehova Nyasaye mon gi kit lamo ma gilamogo nyisechegigo, kendo gitimo giko mamono duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osin-go. To bende gitimo misango gi yawuotgi kod nyigi e mach ka gichiwo ne nyisechegi.
english: You shall not do so to the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye kama:
english: Then Job answered the LORD:

kikuyu: Ka jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai nowinjo ngeche mag Yesu, negingʼeyo ni gin ema nowuoyo kuomgi.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

kikuyu: Eka Jehoshafat nochungʼ e nyim oganda mar Juda kod Jerusalem e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye e nyim laru manyien
english: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the LORD’s house, before the new court;

kikuyu: To kaka chandruoku otenore gi weche gi nyinge kod chikeu uwegi, koro unyalo loso wecheugo kendu. Adagi bedo jangʼad bura e weche ma kamago.”
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Neuru, jolweny biro koa e piny man yo nyandwat; oganda maduongʼ itugo koa e tunge piny.
english: The LORD says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

kikuyu: nikech Chik kelo mirimb Nyasaye. To kama Chik onge, ketho chik bende onge.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

kikuyu: Eka jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda nochokore e dala jadolo maduongʼ, mane nyinge Kaifas,
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

kikuyu: Chuny jo-Misri nonyosre kendo anaketh gik moko duto ma gichano timo; ginidwar wach kuom nyiseche mopa kod lang chunje mane osetho, ajuoke kod nyakalondo.
english: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

kikuyu: “ ‘Koro asewinjo ni ingʼado yie rombi e kindeni. Kane jokwadhi ni kodwa, to ne ok watimonegi marach, kendo e kinde duto mane gin Karmel onge girgi manolal.
english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

kikuyu: Kendo kane en gi kit dhano kamano, to nobolore, ka owinjo Nyasaye nyaka kar tho, kata mana tho mar msalaba!
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

kikuyu: Nyirombe mag Pasaka nochinji kendo jo-Lawi nomiyo jodolo remo kapod giyangʼo chiayogo mi jodolo nokiro remogo.
english: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

kikuyu: Un joma okwongʼ! Ok unuwe tiyonwa kaka jobar yien gi joumb pi e od Nyasacha.”
english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

kikuyu: Donge masiche kod ber wuok mana koa kuom Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo?
english: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

kikuyu: Paruru kaka asepogo ni dhoutu pinje duto mag ogendini mane odongʼ kaka girkeni, ogendini mane aloyo, modak e kind aora Jordan kod Nam Maduongʼ mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

kikuyu: Donge oda nikare e nyim Nyasaye? Donge Osesingore koda gi singruok mochwere, mochan kendo morit chuth? Donge obiro kelo olemb warruokna kendo miya gik ma chunya dwaro duto?
english: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?

kikuyu: Ne nitie mor maduongʼ Jerusalem mapok nobedo Jerusalem chakre ndalo Solomon wuod Daudi ma ruodh Israel.
english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mi mondo chandruok ma joma olwora bwogago, odog e wiyegi.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

kikuyu: Bende Josef nomiyo wuon-gi kod owetene kod jood wuon-gi duto gi chiemo kaluwore gi kar romb nyithindgi.
english: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.

kikuyu: Kane piny chiegni yawore, Paulo nosayo jokwangʼ duto mondo ochiem, kowachonegi niya, “Kuom ndalo apar gangʼwen mosekadho, usebedo ka unie chandruok ma ok nunyal chiemo.
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

kikuyu: Omiyo kamano e kaka un bende onego ubed moikore, nikech Wuod Dhano biro biro sa ma ok ungʼeyo.”
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

kikuyu: Mak motegno gima isepuonjori, kik iweye, olalni to irite maber, nikech en e ngimani.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

kikuyu: E higa mokwongo mar loch mar Ruoth Sairas, ruoth nochiwo chik kuom hekalu mar Nyasaye man Jerusalem kama. We hekalu ger kendo kaka kar chiwo misango, kendo we mise mare keti. Nyaka obedi fut piero aboro gaboro gi nus e bor mare kendo fut piero aboro gaboro e lach mare,
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits;

kikuyu: To Jehoash ruodh Israel nodwoko Amazia ruodh Juda gi ngero niya, “Kuth alii man Lebanon nooro wach ne yiend sida man Lebanon ni, ‘Yie ichiw nyari ne wuoda mondo okendi.’ To le moro mar bungu mowuok Lebanon nokadho kanyo monyono kuth aliino gi tiende.
english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

kikuyu: Ka nitie jachan e kind owete moa e mier mag piny ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiu, to kik ubed gi chuny mapek kata lep ma wuoyo marach ewi owadu modhierno.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

kikuyu: “Kum mane akumogo jou nobedo kayiem nono; kendo ne ok gilokore. Liganglani osekidho jonabi magi mana kaka sibuor modenyo.”
english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Jakobo nokawo kete moko mag omburi, gi oyungu kod yiende makorgi poth mi nopoko kuonde moko e korgi mondo igi marachar onen.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

kikuyu: rwedhi apar machwe mopongʼ, rwedhi piero ariyo machwe kod rombe gi diek mia achiel kaachiel gi mwanda; ogunde, ring ngawo kod awendo machwe.
english: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

kikuyu: Eka wenge joma neno ok nochak ogengʼ, kendo joma ochiko itgi nowinj wach.
english: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

kikuyu: Yawuot Oholibama ma chi Esau gin: Jaduongʼ Jeush, Jalam kod Kora. Magi ema ne jodongo mowuok kuom Oholibama ma chi Esau nyar Ana.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Yie idwoka, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech aywakni gi chunya duto kendo abiro timo kaka chikni dwaro.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

kikuyu: Kinyne nomiyo ji thuolo mar ke. Negigwedho ruoth mi gidhi e miechgi, ka gimor kendo giil e chunygi nikech gik moko duto mabeyo mane Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni jatichne Daudi kod joge Israel.
english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

kikuyu: Ngima duongʼ moloyo chiemo, kendo del duongʼ moloyo lewni.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

kikuyu: Bende ne nitiere Maseya, Shemaya, Eliazar, Uzi, Jehohanan, Malkija, Elam kod Ezer. Jower nower kotelnegi gi Jezrahia.
english: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

kikuyu: Ombongʼ faresene nonyon yore duto mag dalani maduongʼ, obiro nego jogi duto gi ligangla, kendo siro magi maroteke nopodh piny.
english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

kikuyu: Kagiwacho niya, “Amin! Pak gi duongʼ kod rieko gi erokamano gi luor kod teko gi nyalo obed ni Nyasachwa, nyaka chiengʼ. Amin!”
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

kikuyu: Tamar noolo buru e wiye mi noyiecho lawe manyilni mane otwangʼ maber mane oyudo orwako. Nomako wiye gi lwete kendo nodhi koywak matek.
english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

kikuyu: Mana kaka lwangʼni motho miyo gima dungʼ mangʼwe ngʼar bedo gi tik marach, e kaka miriambo matin ketho rieko kod luor.
english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

kikuyu: Ne ochwalore nyime matin bangʼe ogoyo chonge piny kokulore nyaka e lowo eka olemo niya, “Wuora, kanyalore to yie mondo kikombeni ogol kuoma. To ok kaka an ema adwaro to mana kaka in ema idwaro.”
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: To moloyo mago duto, herreuru gihera matut ngʼato gi ngʼato, nikech hera umo richo mangʼeny.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: (Dhahabu mar pinyno ber; duogo manyilni maber kod kite mabeyo miluongo ni oniks bende yudoree.)
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko Petro niya, “Awachoni adier ni otieno ma kawuononi, kapok thuon gweno okok diriyo in iwuon wangʼ inikweda nyadidek.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Nowachone chwore niya, “Angʼeyo ni ngʼat ma jabiro ka en ngʼat Nyasaye maler.
english: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Neuru, koro achiwo Sihon kod pinye e lwetu, koro monjeuru mondo ukaw pinyeno.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

kikuyu: Kendo e nyima kanyo, ne nitie duongʼ mar Nyasaye mar Israel, mana kaka nobet e fweny mane aseneno e holocha.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

kikuyu: Yo milambo mar lowo mopogne Gad nochakore Tamar nyaka e sokni mag Meriba Kadesh, eka bangʼe nochom Wadi manie piny Misri nyaka e Nam maduongʼ mar Mediterania.
english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny dwaro mondo girom gi ruoth, to en mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye ema adiera yudoree.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

kikuyu: nikech singruok ma Nyasaye osetimo kodwa duto kar rombgi gin, “Ee kuom Kristo.” Mano emomiyo kwamiyo Nyasaye duongʼ kwalamo e nying Kristo to wawacho niya, “Amin.”
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

kikuyu: Kata ka obedo ni awuotho e hoho mar tipo mar tho, to ok analuor gimoro marach, nimar in koda; ludhi gi odungani ema hoya.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

kikuyu: Eka nokela nyaka kama idonjogo e dhorangach man yo nyandwat mar od Jehova Nyasaye, kendo naneno mon kobet kanyo, ka ywago Tamuz.
english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

kikuyu: Kane Jehoram nosegurore motegno e kom duongʼ wuon mare, nonego owetene gi ligangla kaachiel gi joka dhood ruoth mamoko mag Israel.
english: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni, ‘An ranyisi ni un!’ “Mana kaka asetimono e kaka ibiro timo nigi. Gibiro dhi e twech kaka joma omaki.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

kikuyu: Kitanda nobed machiek ma ok nyal rieye tielo tir, kendo onget nobed matin ma ok nyal umo ngʼato maber.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

kikuyu: Ok gini chandre kayiem nono, kata nywolo nyithindo mokwongʼ; nimar ginibedi oganda ma Jehova Nyasaye, ogwedho gin kod nyikwagi.
english: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ohinga mar dala maduongʼno nomuki, kendo jolweny duto noringo ka tony gotieno ka gikalo e rangach man e kind ohinga ariyo man but puoth ruoth, kata obedo ni jo-Babulon nolworo dala maduongʼno kamano. Negiringo ka gichomo Araba,
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

kikuyu: Mad otienono bed migumba; mad kik winj koko moro amora mar mor e iye.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oyudi ka mako ja-Israel wadgi moketo obedo misumbane kata ongʼiewe gi ngʼato, ngʼat motimo kamano nyaka tho. Nyaka ugol tim marachno e dieru.
english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasachwa kecho ji kendo oweyo ne ji richogi, kata obedo ni wasengʼanyone kamano;
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

kikuyu: Ne giumo lowo mi piny olokore maratengʼ. Negichamo gimoro amora ma pe noweyo, mane gin gimoro amora matwi e puothe gi olembe ma nitie ewi yien. Onge kata it oboke manodongʼ e yien kata yath moro e piny Misri.
english: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo mag jo-Filistia nokelone Delila tonde abiriyo manyien mapok otiyo, eka notweye gi tondego.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ungʼado buchu uwegi ni un nyikwa joma nonego jonabi.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo noyiecho lepe, morwako pien gugru kendo noywago Josef wuode kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

kikuyu: Eka jodolo nokelo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kama ne olosne ei kama ler mar lemo mar hekalu, ma en Kama Ler Moloyo mi gikete e bwomb kerubi.
english: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

kikuyu: Aramo mar timo ne dala maduongʼni marach ma ok maber, Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Enochiwe e lwet ruodh Babulon, kendo enotieke gi mach.’
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says the LORD. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’

kikuyu: “Chik iti ne chike mag singruokni kendo inyis jo-Juda kod mago modak Jerusalem.
english: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
