kikuyu: omiyo ne angʼiewo puodho man Anathoth kuom wuod owadgi wuonwa Hanamel kendo apimone shekel apar gabiriyo mar fedha.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jadua,
english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

kikuyu: Abram noriwore gi Hagar kendo nomako ich. Kane ofwenyo ni en gi ich, nochako chayo ruodhe madhako.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

kikuyu: Angʼo mamoni duogowa iri kendo, mondo eka jogi obed mamor kuomi?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

kikuyu: Ogendini duto mane ongʼeyi, to dhogi omoko koneni; giko mari osebedo marach miwuoro kendo ok nochak oneni kendo.’ ”
english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nobed kar gengʼruok ne kalausi mana ka aore mamol e piny ongoro, kendo mana ka tipo mar Lwanda maduongʼ e piny motwo.
english: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu pod wuoyo, ngʼato moro nobiro moa e od Jairo, ma jatend sinagogi, mowacho niya, “Nyari osetho, omiyo kik ichand japuonj kendo.”
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

kikuyu: Usebedo ka ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye ndalo duto ma asengʼeyoue.
english: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

kikuyu: “Eka yawuoti ariyo mane inywolo e piny Misri kane pok abiro iri ka ibiro kwan kaka nyithinda; Efraim kod Manase biro bedo nyithinda mana kaka Reuben kod Simeon.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

kikuyu: To ka onyise kit richo ma osetimo, to nyaka okel nywok maonge songa mondo otimnego misango kuom ketho chik.
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

kikuyu: Kane gisea, negidhi nyaka e gode mi gidak kuno kuom ndalo adek, manyaka joma ne lawogi otieko manyo kuonde duto ka giluwo yo mi gidwogo ma ok giyudogi.
english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

kikuyu: “Dhano ma dhako onywolo ndalone nok kendo oneno chandruok mathoth.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

kikuyu: Go koko nikech mor, yaye polo, bed gi ilo, yaye piny, weruru matek, un gode! Nimar Jehova Nyasaye kweyo chuny joge kendo obiro bedo gi kech ne joge machandore.
english: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

kikuyu: E ndalo mag ngima mar Solomon Juda gi Israel chakre Dan nyaka Bersheba nodak gi kwe ka ngʼato ka ngʼato tiyo e puothe mar mzabibu kod ngʼope.
english: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

kikuyu: Onge gima nyalo chango adhondeni, ihinyori marach. Ji duto mowinjo wach man kuomi pamo lwetgi kuom podho mari, nimar ere ngʼama pok oneno sand ma ok rum mane isandogo ji?
english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

kikuyu: To kane pok gitieko chiembgi mar gombono, chutho, ka chiemo ne pod opongʼo dhogi,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

kikuyu: Mi wuond gi miriambo obed mabor koda; kik imiya chan kata mwandu, to miya mana chiemba mapile.
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aweyogi nikech chunygi ne tek, kendo negiluwo yoregi giwegi.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Almon Diblathaim mi gibworo e gode mag Abarim, man but Nebo.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo jo-Jerusalem duto kod jo-Benjamin okwongʼore ni ginirit singruokno kendo jo-Jerusalem notimo mano kaluwore gi singruok mar Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Kane odhi nyime kochodo gi wangʼ teko kendo koelo duge ne chwo, ne alokora aweye ka apongʼ gi mirima, mana kaka ne alokora aweyo nyamin.
english: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.

kikuyu: Gideon noloso kido mar nyasaye manono mar efod gi dhahabu, ma noketo e dalane miluongo ni Ofra. Jo-Israel duto notimo timbe mag dwanyruok e kindgi giwegi ka gilamo kidono kanyo kendo nobedo obadho ni Gideon kod dalane.
english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

kikuyu: Ok wachal gi Musa mane umo wangʼe mondo kik jo-Israel ne ka ler manie pat wangʼe rumo.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oyud ka terore gi chi wadgi, to dhakono kod ngʼatno nyaka negi. Tim marachno nyaka gol e dier jo-Israel.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

kikuyu: Nimar anyisou ni Kristo osedoko jatich jo-Yahudi mondo ochop adiera mar Nyasaye, mondo omi singruok mane omi kwerewa otimre,
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

kikuyu: Jogo chunygi noduogo, mi ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi nokawo chiemo mondo ocham.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

kikuyu: Kane kokono oserumo, Paulo noluongo jopuonjre ire mojiwogi, to bangʼe nogoyonegi oriti, mi ochako wuodhe mar dhi Makedonia.
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

kikuyu: mi urwako dhano manyien mamedo bedo manyien pile mondo obed machal gi kit jachwechne.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Un gi makati adi?” Negidwoke niya, “Abiriyo kende.”
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Giwacho niya, “Nyasaye oseweye; laweuru mondo umake, nikech onge ngʼama biro rese.”
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

kikuyu: Enoket lwete ewi chiayono, kendo enoyangʼe kaka misango mar golo richo kama itimoe misango miwangʼo pep.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negikawo gigo mane Mika oseloso, kod jadolo mare, kendo negidhi Laish, mondo giked gi jogo man-gi kwe kendo maonge gi ikruok moro amora mar kedo. Negimonjogi gi lingangla kendo negiwangʼo dala maduongʼno gi mach.
english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

kikuyu: Fweny malich osenyisa ni: Jandhoko biro ndhoko, to jayeko biro yeko. Elam mondo omonje! Media mondo olwore koni gi koni! Abiro tieko lit duto mane okelo.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

kikuyu: “Asetwangʼo pien gugru mi arwako kendo asebuko lela wangʼa gi buru.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

kikuyu: Kane Jehu odonjo e dhorangach nopenjo niya, “Ibiro e yor kwe, in Zimri ma janek ruodheni?”
english: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

kikuyu: “E kindeno Mikael, malaika maduongʼ marito jou, biro thinyore. Kindeno nobed kinde mag chandruok malich mapok one nyaka ne ogendini chak bet e piny. Ka kindeno ochopo to nores jou ma nying-gi oyud kondiki e kitap Nyasaye.
english: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

kikuyu: Mano e gima biro timore ne joma ogenore kendgi giwegi, kendo ne joma luwogi, moluwo wechegi. Sela
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

kikuyu: Notimo liswa ni nyiseche manono mag jo-Damaski mane oseloye. Noparo niya, “Nikech nyiseche manono mag ruodhi jo-Aram nokonyogi, abiro timo nigi liswa mondo mi gikonya.” To negimiyo opodho kaachiel gi jo-Israel.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼatno nowachone niya, “We mondo boche okuong owangʼ mondi eka ikaw gimoro amora midwaro,” to jatijno nedwoko niya, “Ngangʼ miyago sani; ka ok imiyago, to abiro kawe githuon.”
english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gangʼwen ne mar Matithia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kowacho niya, “Ka dine in iwuon bed ni ingʼeyo tinendeni gima nyalo keloni kwe, to koro ogengʼore ne wangʼi.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

kikuyu: Wecheu moywarego biro rumo karangʼo? Koso utuo, momiyo usiko gi mino wach?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

kikuyu: Musa kod Harun notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochikogi. Notingʼo ludhe e nyim Farao kod jodonge duto mi ochwado aora Nael kendo pige duto nolokore remo.
english: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ma Jachwech polo malach, gi piny kod gik moko duto manie iye. En ema ochiwo muya ne dhano kod ngima ne joma wuotho e piny. Owacho kama:
english: God the LORD, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

kikuyu: Jakobo nodak e piny Kanaan, kuma ne wuon-gi odakie.
english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Ogwende nopongʼ aora Nael kendo giniwuogi ka gidhi e odi nyaka kor nindo. Bende ginipongʼ nyaka kitandani, ute jodongi kod mag jogi, kaachiel gi kuonde tedo gi dwalo makati.
english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Wach Ruoth nomedo landore kendo ne medo bedo gi teko.
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mangʼwon yudo ohala mana ne en owuon, to ngʼat makwiny kelo chandruok ni en owuon.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

kikuyu: Ruoth mor gi jatich mariek, to jatich makwodo wich yudo mirimbe.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

kikuyu: Ngʼat modhier ma ok nyal golo chiwo machalo kama, yiero yien ma ok tow. Omanyo japecho molony mondo olosne kido ma ok nyal podho piny.
english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi tingʼ e nyim Nyasaye mondo osik mana kaka Nyasaye noluongeno.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

kikuyu: Ne wasedwaro gamingʼa mondo wabi walimu, to moloyo an Paulo ne atemo matek to Satan ne omona.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

kikuyu: E kinde mag higni piero angʼwen kane atelonu e thim lepu ne ok oti kata wuocheu bende ok oti.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Isaka nolosonegi nyasi mi gichiemo kendo gimetho.
english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

kikuyu: Nyaka ipoge maromre moro ka moro kuomgi. Nikech ne asingora ka akwongʼora ni anachiwe ni kwereu, kendo pinyni nobed girkeni maru.
english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

kikuyu: Jotelo nokelo kite mag oniks kod kite mamoko miketo e law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kendo kuom law akor.
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

kikuyu: Magi duto nokawo higni madirom mia angʼwen gi piero abich. “Bangʼ mano, Nyasaye nomiyogi jongʼad bura mane oritogi nyaka kinde mag Samuel janabi.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en lwandana, en kar pondo mara kendo en jawarna; Nyasacha en lwandana ma apondo kuome. En okumbana, en tungʼ mar warruokna, kendo en ohingana.
english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo Abner wuod Ner; osebiro mondo owuondi kendo mondo onon kendo ongʼe kaka iwuotho mondo ongʼe gik moko duto ma itimo.”
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

kikuyu: mag dhahabu, kod fedha, mula kod nyinyo kaachiel gi jopecho mokadho akwana. Koro chak tich, mad Jehova Nyasaye obed kodi.”
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”

kikuyu: To kata mana Mikael malaika maduongʼ kane gilaro gi Satan ringre Musa, ne ok ohedhore wuoyo kuome marach kohangone wach, to nowachone mana niya, “Ruoth mondo okweri!”
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mangʼwon noyud gweth, nimar opogo chiembe kod jochan.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

kikuyu: Lopni nobed mwandune e piny Israel. Kendo joma aketo ruoth ok nochak oti joga githuon, to ginimi jo-dhood Israel thuolo mar kawo piny kaka margi kaluwore gi ogandagi.
english: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

kikuyu: “To in, yaye Israel jatichna, un joka Jakobo ma aseyiero, un nyikwa Ibrahim osiepna,
english: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,

kikuyu: Uparo ni ji ariyo nyalo wuotho kaachiel kapok giwinjore?
english: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

kikuyu: Eka negimiyo jomanenie dhoot oko-go obedo muofni, jomatindo gi jomadongo, mane ok ginyal yudo dhoot.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

kikuyu: Jadolo mar Zeu, ma hekalune noger machiegni gi dalano, nokelo rwedhi kod maua mi giketo e dhoranga dalano mondo en, kaachiel gi oganda, gitim misango ni Paulo kod Barnaba.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

kikuyu: Nikech Pilato ne dwaro mondo omor oganda, nogonyonegi Barabas. Yesu to nogolo chik mondo ochwadi bangʼe nokete e lwetgi mondo gigure.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

kikuyu: Nikech ok en morna ka ngʼato tho, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho. Weuru timo richo mondo ubed mangima!
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

kikuyu: Chunygi nodoko malit, mi moro ka moro nochako wachone niya, “Dobed an koso?”
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

kikuyu: Nyaka tergi nyangu bedni onywolgi e uteu kata ongʼiewogi gi pesa. Singruokna man kuom ringreu nyaka bed mosiko.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

kikuyu: Koro temie kimulo dende gi chokene ka ok dokwongʼi e wangʼi.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Wasiki noruto kama iromoe kodwa; kendo negichungo bendechegi mochungʼ kar timbegi maricho.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

kikuyu: Kaka Paulo ne jatimo pile, ne odonjo e od lemono, kendo kuom Sabato adek moluwore, nopimo kodgi wach kuom weche mondiki e Muma.
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Bende noloso thiwni mogaji mane omako gik machalo agulnigo ewi sirnigo, thiwnigo noketi abiriyo abiriyo ewi gik machalo agulnigo.
english: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wuo kodgi kendo inyisgi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ka ja-Israel moro amora oketo chunye kuom lamo nyiseche manono kendo oketo rachwany mamiyo ji podho e nyime, bangʼe to odhi ir jakor wach, to an Jehova Nyasaye awuon anadwoke kaluwore gi kethone maduongʼ mar lamo nyiseche ma dhano oloso.
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

kikuyu: “Yien ber nyalo bedo gi geno: ka osetongʼe to nitie geno ni onyalo loth, kendo chunye maloth manyien ok rem mak odongo.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato okwalo rwath kata rombo kendo onege kata ouse, nyaka ochul dhok abich kuom rwath kendo kweth rombe angʼwen kuom rombo.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nongʼado Jordan modok kama Johana ne batisoe ji kinde motelo. Nodak kanyo,
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

kikuyu: Kata kamano kinde biro, kendo osechopo, ma joma lemo gadier nolam Wuoro e yo ma Roho dwaro kendo gadiera, joma lamo kamano ema Wuoro dwaro.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

kikuyu: Jagoro Shemaya wuod Nethanel ma ja-Lawi nondiko nying-gi e nyim ruoth, to gi jotelo, ne gin Zadok jadolo, Ahimelek wuod Abiathar kod jotend anywola mag jodolo kod mag jo-Lawi ka gikawo ngʼato achiel koa e anywola mar Eliazar, to machielo koa e anywola mar Ithamar.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno machayo jabute timo richo, to ogwedhi ngʼatno mangʼwon gi jogo mochando.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

kikuyu: Obed ne en wuon Jesse, to Jesse ne en wuon Daudi.
english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

kikuyu: Ber mondo ngʼato otingʼ jok kapod en ngʼama tin.
english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo noket dhakono kwongʼre kowacho niya, “Kaonge dichwo moseterore kodi kendo pod ok ibedo ja-adiera mibedo modwanyore kendo weyo yo ma ibedo mogak ka ingʼeyo ni in dhako man kod chwore, to mad pi makechni makelo kwongʼ kik hinyi.
english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

kikuyu: Omiyo ogendini bedo gi teko, to bangʼe oloyogi mi otiekgi.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

kikuyu: Ok ginimod yien e thim kata tongʼo yien e bunge nikech giniti kod gigegi mag lweny kuom chwako mach. Giniyak gige joma ne oyakogi kendo ginipe jogo mane opeyogi; Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik idwar chulo kuor, kendo kik ibed ngʼama mon gi jowadgi, to her wadu kaka iherori iwuon. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mane osetiek gero kar lemo, ma en Hema mar Singruok, bor polo noume. Chakre odhiambo nyaka okinyi bor polo mane oumo kar lemo ne chalo ka mach.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

kikuyu: Gima Chik ne ok nyal timo nikech ringruok manyap mar dhano, ema Nyasaye notimo kuom oro Wuode owuon, e kido mar dhano ma jaricho mondo obed misango magolo richo. Osetimo kamano mondo omi bura olo richo,
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

kikuyu: Gidwogo ka piny imore, ka gingʼur ka guogi, kendo giwuotho koni gi koni e dala ka gingʼanjo.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ka ngʼato ohera to obiro rito puonjna, Wuora biro here, kendo wabiro biro ire mi walos kar dakwa kode.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

kikuyu: Joash notimo gima ber e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye e higni duto mane Jehoyada jadolo ne ngʼadone rieko.
english: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Wan Ibrahim e Wuonwa.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ka dine bed ni un nyithind Ibrahim adier, to dine utimo gik ma Ibrahim notimo;
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

kikuyu: Donge onego atimne Jerusalem kod nyisechene manono mana kaka asetimone Samaria kod kido mage manono?
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

kikuyu: Obiro wuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo kendo obiro sando jo-Nyasaye koloko chike mag lemogi kod sewni mag-gi. Jo-Nyasaye nobed e bwo lochne kuom higni adek gi nus.
english: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

kikuyu: Kuom nus pok mar jo-Israel, Musa noyiero achiel kuom piero abich mar ji kod jamni, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike, mi nomiyogi jo-Lawi, ma tijgi ne en rito hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Jaote nobiro mowachone Daudi niya, “Chuny jo-Israel nigi Abisalom.”
english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kata ka ngʼato omulo gimoro makwero, bed ni en le mar bungu motho kata gik mamol motho, ka ok ongʼeyo, mi ofwenye achien, to enodok jaketho.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: Kik uriwru gi ogendini modongʼ e dieru, kik uluong nying nyisechegi kata kik ukwongʼru gi nying-gi. Kik utinegi kata kik ukulrunegi.
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

kikuyu: Naara nonywolone Ahuzam, Hefer, Temeni kod Hahashtari. Magi ema ne nyikwa Naara.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar angʼwen, e od Nyasachwa, ne wapimo pek fedha gi dhahabu kod gigo mowal ma waketo e lwet Meremoth wuod Uria, ma jadolo, Eliazar wuod Finehas ne ni kode, kod jo-Lawi bende kaka Jozabad wuod Jeshua gi Noadia wuod Binui.
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

kikuyu: “Pok makende mowinjore ichiw ni Jehova Nyasaye nobed kilomita apar gariyo gi nus kuom borne kendo nobed kilomita abich kuom lachne.
english: “The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

kikuyu: Isaka ne ok nyal fwenye nikech lwetene ne rayier ka mag Esau owadgi, kuom mano nogwedhe.
english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo, ma bende niluongo ni Paulo, nopongʼ gi Roho Maler, mi nongʼiyo wangʼ Elima tir, bangʼe owachone niya,
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

kikuyu: Notiyo gi teko duto mar ondiek malich mokwongo ka en e nyim ondiegino. Eka nomiyo piny gi ji duto modak e iye olamo ondiek malich mokwongono, ma wiye ne nigi adhola malich mane ogo lero mar tho, to nosechango.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nobedo gi mirima gi jo-Israel mochiwogi e lwet wasikgi mondo omonjgi. Ne ochiwogi e lwet wasikgi kuonde duto mane ok ginyal tony.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

kikuyu: Gin mudho odino pachgi, momiyo gipogore gi ngima mar Nyasaye nikech kia margi mawuok e chunygi.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Ka ngʼope mabeyogi, akawo jogo moa Juda kodhi e twech kaka joma beyo, mane agolo kae kadhi e piny jo-Babulon.
english: “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.

kikuyu: Ne otelonegi kogologi Misri, kendo notimo honni madongo gi ranyisi e piny Misri, e Nam Makwar, kendo timo honni mamoko bende e thim kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

kikuyu: Kik ichak ikor wach moro amora e Bethel-ka nikech ma en kama ler mar lemo mar ruoth kod hekalu mar pinyruoth.”
english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e chik mar tieko chich ka dhako ok ja-adiera kendo odwanyore, kongʼeyo ni pod en dhako man-gi chwore,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Anatur jok mar ruodh Babulon.
english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
english: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ngʼwon kendo kecho ji, iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo en gihera mangʼeny.
english: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kikuyu: Kane Musa osetieko ndiko wechegi e kitabu manie chik koa e chakruok nyaka giko,
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuomgi nowacho niya, “Adier anaduog iri e kinde maka ma higa mabiro kendo Sara chiegi biro nywolo nyathi ma wuowi.” To kara Sara ne winjo wachno kobet e dho hema e ngʼe welogo.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel wigi tek mana ka roya bwongʼ ma wiye tek. Ere kaka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo kwayogi e lek kaka ikwayo rombe e lek man-gi lum?
english: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?

kikuyu: Eka Malaika mar Nyasaye, mane osebedo kotelo e nyim jolwenj jo-Israel, nodok chien bangʼ jo-Israel. Bor polo bende ne osudo machiegni e nyim jo-Israel mi odok ka ngʼegi,
english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

kikuyu: Koro ere ngʼat ma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye? Obiro puonje luwo yo moyierne.
english: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

kikuyu: Ji nobiro ir Musa mi giwachone niya, “Ne watimo richo e kinde mane wakwedo Jehova Nyasaye kod in. Lamnwa mondo Jehova Nyasaye ogol thuondegi oa kuomwa.” Omiyo Musa nolamone jogo.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

kikuyu: To negidwoke niya, “Ooyo ruodha. Jotichgi obiro mana mondo orund chiemo.
english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

kikuyu: Nitie Ngʼat mangʼado bura ne ngʼama odaga kendo ma ok oyie wechena. Ngʼama kamano wachna mane awacho ema biro ngʼadone bura marach chiengʼ giko piny.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

kikuyu: E kindeno ji nojwangʼ nyiseche manono molos gi fedha kod dhahabu ma yande gilamo, kaachiel gi oyieyo kod olik tiga.
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,

kikuyu: Ere kaka an, jatichni, dawuo kodi, in, ruodha? Tekra orumo kendo kata yweyo otama.”
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”

kikuyu: Omiyo kik ubed e kanyakla gi joma kamago.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka nochan-gi mondo giti kane gidonjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaluwore gi chike mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel nochiko Harun kwargi.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi, ma nyinge Kleopa, nopenje niya, “In mana wendo e Jerusalem ka kendo ok ingʼeyo gik mosetimore kuno e ndalogi koso?”
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

kikuyu: Adhondena otimo tutu kendo dungʼ marach nikech fupa mar timo richo.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

kikuyu: “Chwe nigi nyiri ariyo. Giywak ni, ‘Miwa! Miwa!’ “Nitie gik moko adek ma ok rom ngangʼ! Angʼwen ma ok wach ni, ‘Oromo!’
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

kikuyu: to ngʼatno tuo kendo ogak. Jadolo noland ni ogak nikech kama lit manie wiye.
english: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi joge nodhi nyaka Baal Perazim kendo noloyogi kanyo. Eka nowacho niya, “Mana kaka pi muomo, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye osemwomore ni wasika gi lweta.” Mano emomiyo kanyo nochak ni Baal Perazim.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Omiyo Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny duto kod ji duto ne ok oluwo chik Jehova Nyasaye mar dak e piny Juda.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey the LORD’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

kikuyu: To piny noyawo dhoge, momwonyo pi duto mane thuol mangʼongono nosengʼudho, mi nokonyo dhakono.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo ir Elisha mane oyudo odak Jeriko, nowachonegi niya, “Donge ne akwerou ni kik udhi?”
english: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

kikuyu: Omiyo koro in e bwo kwongʼ kendo oseriembi e piny mosengʼamo dhoge mondo omwony remb owadu koa e lweti.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

kikuyu: bangʼe anami odni obed ka Shilo kendo dala maduongʼni ka gima okwongʼ e dier ogendini duto mag piny.’ ”
english: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”

kikuyu: Daudi kaachiel gi jotend jolweny noyiero yawuot Asaf mamoko gi yawuot Heman gi yawuot Jeduthun ne tich koro wach ka gigoyo nyatiti, gi orutu kod ongengʼo. Ma e chenro mar jogo kaka negitiyo:
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

kikuyu: Higa mar piero abichno nobednu uduto hik mor, kik upidhe cham, kendo kik ukaye orowe, kata kik uponie mzabibu monyak kende e yien mane ok uloso.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

kikuyu: Daudi nogolo osimbo ewi ruodhgi, ma pek mar dhahabu molosego nonwangʼ ni dirom kilo piero adek gangʼwen, kendo nochom kuome kite ma nengogi tek mi nosidhe ewi Daudi. Nokawo gik mangʼeny mane oyako e dala maduongʼno
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

kikuyu: Ok unyal fwenyo ni en gima ber moloyo mondo ngʼato achiel otho ni ji duto, moloyo ka oganda duto otho.”
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Sena, ji alufu adek mia ochiko gi piero adek (3,930).
english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kata gigo turumbete, kendo giik gik moko duto mag lweny, to onge ngʼama biro dhi e lweny, nikech mirimba ni kuom oganda duto.
english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

kikuyu: “Nitie jomoko mangʼanyo ne ler, ma ok ongʼeyo yore ler, kata ma ok dwar ler.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nochoko jolwenje mondo oked matek gi piny Turo; wiyegi noluny kendo gokgi nobuth. To kata kamano en kaachiel gi jolweny mage ne ok giyudo mich moro amora kuom tijno mane otele mar kedo gi Turo.
english: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

kikuyu: Ne ooro jaote mine okele. Ne en silwal man-gi ngima maber, ne dende nenore maber kendo ne en jachia. Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Chungi iwire gi mo; nikech ngʼatni e en.”
english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. The LORD said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

kikuyu: Ka gineno nyithindgi ma tich lweta e kindgi, to gibiro rito nyinga obed maler, kendo gibiro yie kuom ler mar Jal Maler mar Jakobo, kendo gichungʼ e nyim Nyasach Israel gi luor maduongʼ.
english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

kikuyu: kendo Zadok jadolo kod Nathan janabi osewire obedo ruoth e Gihon. Ka gia kanyo gisebedo ka gigoyo koko kendo dala duto mor. Mano e koko ma uwinjo.
english: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

kikuyu: Atingʼo bedena malo ne chikeni ma ahero kendo asiko aparo matut kuom yoreni.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

kikuyu: Magi e pok mane Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun kod jotelo mag dhout Israel nopogo lowo gombulu ka gin Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dhoranga Hemb Romo. Omiyo negitieko pogo pinyno.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

kikuyu: Okuod wi Moab, nimar ongʼinje matindo tindo. Dengi kendo iywag matek! Land e Arnon ni Moab okethi.
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu notwoyo aora Jordan e nyimu nyaka ukalo loka kocha. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu notimo ni aora Jordan mana gima notimone Nam Makwar e ndalo mane otwoye e nyimu nyaka ne ungʼado loka kocha.
english: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

kikuyu: Eka Lea nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osemiya pokna nikech nachiwo jatichna ma nyako ne chwora, omiyo nochake ni Isakar.”
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

kikuyu: Dag kae matin, kendo abiro bedo kodi mi agwedhi. Nimar in kod nyikwayi abiro miyou pinyni kendo nachop singruok mane atimo gi wuonu Ibrahim.
english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Awachonu ni, kata ka dine gilingʼ, to kitegi biro goyo koko.”
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

kikuyu: kendo e nyoroche ariyo mokedi gi dhahabu maler kaka tol mondo itwe nyorochego e thiwni.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

kikuyu: Malaika nodhi ire momose niya, “Amosi, in nyako mogwedhi moloyo! Ruoth ni kodi.”
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

kikuyu: Koro Ruodh kwe owuon mondo omiu kwe mare pile e yore duto. Ruoth mondo obed kodu uduto.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

kikuyu: Musa nobiro gi Joshua wuod Nun kendo nosomo weche mag wendni ka ji winjo.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Eka Amnon nowachone Tamar niya, “Kel chiemo kor nindona koni mondo mi achiem kitingʼona chiemo e lweti.” Kendo Tamar nokawo makati mano tedo motero ni Amnon owadgi kor nindone.
english: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

kikuyu: mondo en ema ne otieg jotende kaka ohero kendo opuonj jodonge.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

kikuyu: Nimar nangʼeyo wich tekou; ka leche mag ngʼutu ochungʼ, kendo pat wengeu tek ka nyinyo.
english: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre oneno gima notimoreno, ne giwuoro, ka gipenjore niya, “Ere kaka yadh ngʼowuni ne oner mapiyo kamano?”
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Sa osechopo mondo Wuod Dhano omi duongʼ.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka chiw nyiimbe ariyogo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo, kaachiel gi makati mag cham mokwongo. Magi nobed mich mowal michiwo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ginidongʼ ni jadolo.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

kikuyu: Ipandogi e bwombi iwuon mondo joma richo kik hinygi; iritogi maber e kar dak mari kuom lew joma hangonigi wach.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

kikuyu: Jowetena, angʼeyo chutho ni un joma beyo kendo mariek kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyalo puonjo nyawadgi.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo gitiyone Baal.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.

kikuyu: jomamon onego olingʼ e kanisa. Ok oyienigi wuoyo, nyaka giwinj puonj mana ka gilingʼ kaka chik wacho.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

kikuyu: Mana kaka ungʼeyo, noyudo osesandwa kendo oyanywa e dala mar Filipi to kata kamano Nyasaye nomiyowa chir mar yalonu Injili mare e dier lweny gi akweda mager.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

kikuyu: kod wuoro; kaachiel gi timbe maricho, wuond, anjawo, ketho nying, sunga kod fuwo.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

kikuyu: koa e nyikwa Merari, ne gin ji mia ariyo gi piero ariyo kotelnegi gi Asaya,
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

kikuyu: bende obed gi sirni piero ariyo gi rachungi piero ariyo mag mula kod ramaki mag fedha kod rangʼaw miriwogo sirnigo.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wasebedo ka wapwoyou e kind kanisa Nyasaye, kawanyisogi kuom kindau kod yieu motegno momiyo udhil e dier sand kod tem duto muyudo.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

kikuyu: Joma chanona gik maricho ni koda machiegni, kata kamano gin mabor gi chikni.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma nyinge ne ok onwangʼ kondiki e kitap ngima, nowit e ataro mar mach.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

kikuyu: Anamonj Elam gi yembe angʼwen moa e tunge angʼwen mar polo; anakegi e yembe angʼwen-go kendo onge piny ma jo-Elam momaki ok nodhiye.
english: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.

kikuyu: Joma odak kaka ringruok dwaro oketo pachgi kuom gik ma ringruok dwaro, to joma odak kaka Roho dwaro, oketo pachgi kuom Roho.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nofwenyore ni jowete moloyo mia abich, ka gin kanyachiel, kendo thothgi pod ngima nyaka sani, kata obedo ni moko kuomgi osetho.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

kikuyu: to koro sani ok abi timo ne joma odongʼ kuom jogi kaka ne atimo e kinde mokalo,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Enonon kuonde ma opur e kor odno kendo ka dipo nitie kuonde mopudhore molokore ratiglo kata Rakwaro manenore nodonjo matut e kor ot,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka isenene, to in bende ibiro tho miluw kwereni, mana kaka owadu Harun notho,
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

kikuyu: E thuolono Boaz nodhi e dhoranga dala mobet kanyo. Ka wat Ruth mahie mane owachocha ne kadho kanyo, Boaz noluonge kawacho niya, “Rawane ka, osiepna, kendo bed piny ka.” Omiyo ngʼatno nodhi ire mobet piny.
english: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.

kikuyu: Kane owacho kamano, to Anania jadolo maduongʼ nogolo chik ni joma nochungʼ bute mondo ogo dhoge.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

kikuyu: Ulitna ahinya, kendo timbeu miyo aparo ni dipo nine ayalonu Injili kayiem nono.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

kikuyu: To koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Dwasik mana ka watimo atima richo nikech wan e bwo ngʼwono, to ok e bwo Chik? Ooyo, gima kamano kik timre!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

kikuyu: Jomoko to noteme kakwaye ranyisi moa e polo.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Kik irikni yieyo lwedo kuom ji, kendo kik iriwri e richo ji mamoko. Ritri mondo ngimani osik kaler.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne ne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Ahiti nomedo goyo yie matek mi kinyne negichako wito gik mane ni ei yie e nam.
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mayweyo mondo opak Jehova Nyasaye. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Gibiro timonu kamano nikech nyinga, nimar gikia Jal mane oora.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

kikuyu: Kuome gik moko duto nochwe; gik manie polo gi manie piny; gik mineno kod gik ma ok ne; kata bed ni gin duongʼ kata teko, kata ruodhi, kata loch. Mago duto Nyasaye nochweyo kuom Kristo kendo nochweyogi ni Kristo.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

kikuyu: Kane okinyi ochopo, noluongo jopuonjre ire kendo noyiero apar gariyo kuomgi, mane owalo obedo joote:
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

kikuyu: Kendo joma ni mabor nobi mi gedi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo iningʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema oseora iri. To mano notimre mana ka uyie winjo wach Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi.”
english: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”

kikuyu: To gie kindeno gibiro neno Wuod Dhano kabiro koa e bor polo gi teko kod duongʼ malich.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Eka Abisalom noluongo Joab mondo oore ir ruoth, to Joab nodagi dhi ire. Omiyo nochako ooro wach mar ariyo to nochako odagi.
english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osedonjo e ot, jopuonjrene nopenje kar kende niya, “Angʼo momiyo wan ne ok wanyal golo jachiendno?”
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

kikuyu: Jopuonjre moko moa Kaisaria bende nodhi kodwa nyaka dala Manason, kama nonego wadagie. Manason ne en ja-Saipras, kendo ne en achiel kuom jopuonjre mane okwongo yie kuom Ruoth.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi ni, ‘Un bende dhiuru uti e puotha mar mzabibu, kendo abiro chulou gimoro amora mowinjore.’
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowachone Samuel niya. “Asetimo richo. Asetamora luwo chik Jehova Nyasaye kod wecheni bende. Ne aluoro ji kendo ne atimo dwarogi.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

kikuyu: Kane kech koro oselandore e piny duto, Josef noyawo deche duto kendo nouso cham ne jo-Misri, nikech kech ne lich ahinya e pinyno Misri duto.
english: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Chakre tinwa nyiseche manono mag wichkuot osechamo olemb tije wuonewa, ma gin kweth mar jamni, kod kweth mag dhok, yawuotgi kod nyigi.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osewinjo ywak mar kwayo kech; Jehova Nyasaye orwako lamo mara.
english: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

kikuyu: “Bende isewuotho michopo nyaka e sokni manie bwo nam kata wuotho ei kude kuonde mogajore?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

kikuyu: Eka ne gitweye gi tol marambulu e kilemba kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, dichwo nowe wuon kod min kendo nopadre gi chiege; mi gidok ringruok achiel.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

kikuyu: Ji nogoyo erokamano ne joma nochiwore mondo odag Jerusalem.
english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Pi noimo wasikgi; ma kata achiel kuomgi ne ok otony.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

kikuyu: Kitepe chik duto kod Jonabi omoko e chike ariyogi.”
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokawo mor pwodhruok mowirogo Hema kod gik moko duto manie iye, kendo nopwodhogi.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

kikuyu: Eka Harun noduogo ir Musa e dhoranga Hemb Romo, nimar masiche noserumo.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: To kane ok ginyal yudo yo mar timo kamano nikech oganda mane ni kode, negiidho ewi tado kendo powo wi tado, eka negilore gi par e dier oganda e nyim Yesu.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

kikuyu: E kindeno ja-Yahudi moro monywol Aleksandria, ma nyinge Apolo, nobiro Efeso. Ne en gi ngʼeyo matut e puonj mag Muma.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

kikuyu: Jotelo mag pinyno chalo ondiegi makidho le ma gimako; gichwero remo kendo ginego ji mondo owenigi thuolo mar yudo ohala e yor mecho.
english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

kikuyu: jo-Arvad, jo-Zemar kod jo-Hamath.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

kikuyu: Tiengʼ achiel biro pako tijeni ne tiengʼ machielo; adier, gibiro nyiso ji kuom tijeni madongo.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

kikuyu: Joma oyie kuom Kristo noketo chunygi kuom puonj joote, kendo kuom lalruok, gi ngʼingo makati kod lamo.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

kikuyu: Barnaba ne en ngʼat maber, mopongʼ gi Roho Maler kod yie kendo ji ma kwan-gi thoth ahinya nolokore obiro ir Ruoth.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Jakobo ahero, to Esau nasin-go.”
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Chiengʼ Sabato, chiwuru misango mar nyiimbe ariyo maonge songa mahikgi achiel, kaachiel gi misango miolo piny kod chiwo mar cham maromo kilo abiriyo mar mogo mayom moru gi mo.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

kikuyu: Joma onge yie ibiro mi pok moromo gi timbegi, to ngʼat maber bende pok moromo kode.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye otieko e wangʼu kuneno, omiyo un bende ibiro tieku nikech ok uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Anabed wuon-gi, to enobed wuoda. Ok nagol herana kuome kaka ne agolo herana kuom ruoth mane ikawo loch kuome.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

kikuyu: Un to beduru motegno kendo chunyu kik ol nimar nochulu kuom tiju.”
english: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Israel duto nobiro machiegni kode kendo ne omiyogi chike duto ma Jehova Nyasaye nosemiye e Got Sinai.
english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: “Kaka ungʼeyo, odongʼ ndalo ariyo kende mondo chiengʼ Pasaka ochopi, kendo Wuod Dhano ibiro chiwo mondo ogur.”
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

kikuyu: “To koro, yaye jodolo, siemni en maru.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

kikuyu: Joyada ne wuon Jonathan, to Jonathan ne wuon Jadua.
english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

kikuyu: Nimar en ngʼatno maduongʼ, ngʼatno mobedo e mesa koso ngʼatno machiwo chiemo? Ok en ngʼatno manie mesa koso? An to anie dieru kaka ngʼatno matiyo.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

kikuyu: Ka jangʼicho mane ni ewi ohinga man Jezreel noneno jolweny Jehu kabiro, nogoyo koko niya, “Aneno ka jolweny biro.” Joram nokone niya, “Or ngʼato gi faras mondo odhi openjgi ka gibiro e yor kwe.”
english: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

kikuyu: Koro winjuru ane gima awacho; chikuru itu ne ywakna.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

kikuyu: Nyaka aa e tin-na mi koro adoko ngʼama duongʼ pok aneno ka joma kare ojwangʼ, kata ka nyithindgi kwayo chiemo.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

kikuyu: Mano biro miyo Jehova Nyasaye mor moloyo rwadh pur, moloyo rwath mabwoch man-gi tungene kod ombongʼne.
english: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

kikuyu: Omiyo Samuel nokawo tungʼne mar mo mine owire e nyim owetene kendo kochakore chiengʼno Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuom Daudi gi teko. Bangʼe Samuel to nodok Rama.
english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

kikuyu: Neuru ni ‘Ee maru’ obedo ‘Ee,’ kendo ‘Ooyo’ obedo ‘Ooyo.’ Gimoro amora mopogore gimaa en gima oa kuom ngʼat marach.
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

kikuyu: Shabania, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaya kod Eliezer ma jodolo, to nonego go turumbete e nyim Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye. Obed-Edom kod Jehia bende ne jorit od Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: “Akecho jogi nikech koro gisebedo koda kae kuom ndalo adek to gionge gima digicham.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

kikuyu: gi karache mag dhahabu mopwodhi, gi makas mingʼadogo otambi, tewni mag kiro remo, dise, gi tawo mar ubani; gi dhoudi molos gi dhahabu mag udi mar ot maiye gi Kama Ler Moloyo, kaachiel gi dhoudi mar laru mar hekalu.
english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

kikuyu: Ma e baruwa machal gi mane Tatenai, ruodh Yufrate, kod Shetha-Bozenai gi joma negitiyogo kanyakla, kod jotend Yufrate, noorone Ruoth Darius.
english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

kikuyu: bende kik utingʼ ofuku mar wuoth, kata law machielo miloko, kata opato, kata ludh wuoth; nikech jatich owinjore yud chiembe kuom ngʼama otiyone.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

kikuyu: kendo ne anyiso jogo mane ni e twechgo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osenyisa.
english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.

kikuyu: Eka Lea nowacho niya, “An jahawi.” Omiyo nochako nyathino ni Gad.
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wayudo ni ka Nyasaye dwaro kecho ngʼato to okeche, kendo ka odwaro miyo chuny ngʼato doko matek to otimo kamano.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo nyaka ungʼe wachni malongʼo, un jo-Israel duto ni Nyasaye oseketo Yesu mane uguro Ruoth kendo Kristo.”
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

kikuyu: En ema ne ruoth mar Jeshurun, ka jotend oganda ne ochokore, kaachiel gi dhout Israel.”
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

kikuyu: To ka chwore odagi kwongʼruokneno, to onge gimoro amora mane chiege owacho manyalo make. Chwore osekethogi, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nokete thuolo.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Kido mar sibuoche apar gariyo nochungi e kuonde auchiel minyono kiidho kidhi e kom duongʼ ka moro ka moro ochungi e giko raidh auchiel koni gi koni. Onge pinyruoth moro amora manoseloso kom ruoth machalo kama.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

kikuyu: Wirgi mana kaka ne iwiro wuon-gi mondo mi gitina kaka jodolo. Wir margi biro miyo gibedo jodolo maga kuom tiengegi duto manyaka chiengʼ
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, mondo omi kik abed gi sunga e chunya kuom gik malich miwuoro mane aneno e fweny, ne omiya kudho machwoyo ringra. Kudhono ne en jaote mar Satan, ma noor mondo osanda.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “In iyie nikech isenena, to ogwedh joma pok onena, to oseyie.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

kikuyu: Luoro mar dhano biro nyisore ni en gima duodo ngʼato, to ngʼat mogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye orite maonge hinyruok.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

kikuyu: Chik iti, yaye Jehova Nyasaye mondo iwinji, yaw wangʼi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye mondo ine; kendo winjie weche duto ma Senakerib oseoro joge kayanyigo in Nyasaye mangima.
english: Turn your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

kikuyu: E kit rieko duto gi lony kuom winjo tiend weche matek mane ruoth otemogie gi penjo, noyudo ka giriek moloyo ajuoke gi jokor wach duto mane ni e pinyruodhe duto nyadipar.
english: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

kikuyu: Otiego lwetena ne lweny; momiyo bedena nyalo dolo atung nyinyo.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

kikuyu: Ok anabed ka adhawo ndalo duto, kata bedo gi ich wangʼ kinde duto, nimar katimo kamano, to chuny dhano biro nyosore e nyima, ma en muya mane aketo kuom dhano.
english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.

kikuyu: Yawuot Eli ne timbegi mono kendo ne ok gidew Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know the LORD.

kikuyu: Ywaguru ka ugoyo agogu nikech puothe momewo, nikech olembe mag mzabibu,
english: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

kikuyu: kinde mar hera kod kinde mar sin, kinde mar lweny kod kinde mar kwe.
english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

kikuyu: Gin ema gimiyo jatichni bedo motangʼ; kendo bedogi kanyo kelo pok maduongʼ.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

kikuyu: Ne ogure ne Jakobo kaka chik, kendo nogure ni Israel kaka singruok mochwere:
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: Ruodh Sodom nowacho ne Abram niya, “Miya ji to idongʼ gi gik moko duto.”
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

kikuyu: Chi Kaleb machielo ma nyinge Efa ne min Haran, Moza kod Gazez. Haran ne wuon Gazez.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

kikuyu: “Kwa Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ranyisi moro amora moa mwalo e bur piny kata moa e polo malo.”
english: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

kikuyu: Eka Abner ne owacho ni Daudi niya, “We mondo adhi piyo mondo achok jo-Israel duto ni ruodha ma ruoth, mondo giwinjre kodi, mondo ibed ruodhgi giduto kaka chunyi dwaro.” Omiyo Daudi ne oweyo Abner oa ire modhi gi kwe.
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

kikuyu: Misumba moro amora mungʼiewo nyalo chame to mana bangʼ kusetere nyangu,
english: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

kikuyu: “Omiyo awachonu kama: Kwauru to nomiu; dwaruru to unuyudi kendo dwongʼuru to noyawnu dhoot.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

kikuyu: Ruodh Asuria nodaro jo-Israel motero e twech e piny Asuria kendo noketogi gidak Hala, Gozan man e bath Aora Habor kaachiel gi mier mag Medes.
english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Gad ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen gabich, mia auchiel gi piero abich (45,650).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Omiyo chuny Jehova Nyasaye nolendo. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto nowacho niya, “Mae bende ok bi timore.”
english: The LORD relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ne gimiyogi Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), gi kuonde kwath, mantiere e piny manie got mar Juda. Arba ne en kwar jo-Anak.
english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

kikuyu: Nyaka opwodh odno gi remb winyo, pi soko gi winyo mangima, gi yiend sida gi owino kod usi makwar.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

kikuyu: Joma mokogi duto nogolo mana matin nono kuom mwandu ma gin-go, to dhakoni kata obedo ni nodhier to ne ochiwo duto mane onego okonyrego.”
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Kane Johana owinjo ka en od twech gik ma Kristo ne timo, nooro jopuonjrene
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: Owete Josef nobet e mesa e nyime kaluwore kaka nywolgi nobet, chakre wuowi maduongʼ nyaka wuowi matin kendo e kinde mane gibet kamano chunygi noparore.
english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.

kikuyu: Mana kaka pe e ndalo oro kata koth e kinde keyo, e kaka luor ok owinjore ni ngʼat mofuwo.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

kikuyu: Kata mana an awuon an-gi adiera kuom Ruoth ni abiro biro iru machiegni.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Piny mondo onywol gik mangima kaka kitgi obet: Jamni, kod gik moko duto mamol e lowo, kod le mag bungu, mana kaka kit moro ka moro obet.” Kendo nobet kamano.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Petro noluwo bangʼe gichien, modonjo kode nyaka e laru mar jadolo maduongʼ. Kanyo nobetie piny kaachiel gi jorito, kooyo mach e dwol.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

kikuyu: Kane uwinjo dwol kawuok e mudho, to got bende wangʼ gi mach, jotend dhoutu gi jodongu nobiro ira.
english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

kikuyu: Koro jowetena, adwaro paronu wach Injili mane ayalonu, mi urwako kendo koro uchungoe motegno.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

kikuyu: Gibiro ka gia e pinje man mabor, manie tungʼ piny mogik, Jehova Nyasaye kod gige mager mag lweny, biro mondo otiekgo pinyno duto.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

kikuyu: Wuoro mokalo tongʼ nomakogi e thim, kendo ne gitemo Nyasaye e piny motwo.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

kikuyu: Yaye, mad warruok mar Israel obi koa Sayun! Kinde ma Nyasaye duogo ne joge mwandugi, onego joka Jakobo obed moil kendo Israel obed mamor!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Nikech wach misewacho kendo koluwore gi dwaroni, isetimo tim maduongʼni bende isemiyo ongʼere ni jatichni.
english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

kikuyu: Ka iwinjo wachna, eka iningʼe gima kare, kendo mowinjore ma gin yore duto mabeyo.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma ok onego miyi luor, yaye Ruodh ogendini? Ma gima iwinjori godo. Kuom jorieko duto mag ogendini kod kuom pinjeruodhigi duto, onge ngʼama chalo kodi.
english: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

kikuyu: Gichula rach kar ber, kod achaya kar osiep.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

kikuyu: Un e barupewa, mondiki e chunywa, kendo ma ji duto ongʼeyo, kendo somo.
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

kikuyu: To ngima makare maa kuom yie to wacho niya, “Kik iwach e chunyi ni, ‘Ere ngʼama didhinwa e polo malo?’ ” (tiende ni, mondo olor Kristo piny),
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

kikuyu: Jodonge bende nokelo chiwo kuom herogi ni ji gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi. Hilkia gi Zekaria kod Jehiel ma jotelo madongo mag hekalu mar Nyasaye nochiwo ni jodolo nyirombe kod diek alufu ariyo gi mia auchiel kod dhok mia adek mondo otimgo misango mar Pasaka.
english: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma ok oaye oganda jadolo kik cham chiwo maler, kata bedni en wendo molimo jadolo, kata obed jatich jadolo ma ondiko kaka jotich.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

kikuyu: kendo nodiro tongʼ kowacho e chunye niya, “Abiro chwowo Daudi mariw gi kor ot.” To Daudi nolengʼe nyadiriyo.
english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

kikuyu: To weche moko mag loch Ahazia kod gik mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mochanie nonro mag ruodhi Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Mishma, Duma, Masa,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

kikuyu: kendo Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nochako bedo kode ka en Mahane Dan, e kind Zora gi Eshtaol.
english: The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

kikuyu: Ket chuny jogi obed modhil, kendo mi itgi dinre ma ok winj wach, bende wengegi obed ma ok nen. Nono to dipo ka wengegi oneno, kendo itgi owinjo wach, kendo mi chunygi ofwenyo tiend weche, mi gilokre ma chang-gi.”
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

kikuyu: Eka jopinyno noriwore monego jogo duto mane onego ruoth Amon kendo negiketo Josia wuode obedo ruoth kare.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

kikuyu: Noyiera aa chakruok manyaka chiengʼ, kapok piny kobetie.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

kikuyu: Johana nowachone niya, “Japuonj, ne waneno ngʼato ka golo jochiende e nyingi, to ne watame mondo owe timo kamano nikech ne ok en achiel kuomwa.”
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

kikuyu: To Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ne oluongou odiechiengno mondo uywagi kendo udengi, ka upudho yie wiu kendo urwako pien gugru.
english: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;

kikuyu: Koro ndik chik machielo gi nying ruoth kar jo-Yahudi kaka ineno ni berni, kendo iketie sei mar nying ruoth bangʼe ketie ranyisi mar tere mar ruoth, nimar gik moko duto mondiki e nying ruoth kendo oketie tere mar ruoth ok nyal loki kata kethi.
english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

kikuyu: Joherana, chik ma andikonuni ok en manyien. En chik musebedogo nyaka aa chakruok. Chikno en e wach ma usewinjo.
