english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

kikuyu: Daudi gi Abishai nodhi ir jolweny gotieno, Saulo nonindo kanyo e kambi kochwoyo tonge piny yo ka wiye. Abner gi jolweny nonindo kolwore.
english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

kikuyu: Ere kaka wanyalo miyo jogo modongʼ mon, nimar wasekwongʼore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ni ok wanamigi nyiwa mondo gikendi?”
english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

kikuyu: Jadolo nochiw achiel kaka misango mar golo richo to machielo kaka misango miwangʼo pep mar kwayone ngʼwono nikech notimo richo kuom bedo kama ringre ngʼama otho nitie. E odiechiengno nyaka opwodh wiye.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, owetewa, yieruru ji abiriyo e dieru ka; joma ongʼere ni opongʼ gi Roho Maler kod rieko mondo waket tijni e lwetgi,
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

kikuyu: kendo isidhnegi kilemba e wiyegi. Bangʼe twe okanda kuom Harun gi yawuote. Tich dolo en margi kaluwore gi singruok mochwere. “Mano e kaka inipwodh Harun gi yawuote.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

kikuyu: Nochwade gi del malit, ka tiende geche magoyo koko, ka tiend farese maringo mamor matek, kendo ka geche maringo mag farese makakni ka mach!
english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

kikuyu: Taya mar Jehova Nyasaye manyo chuny dhano, kendo omanyo chunye ma iye.
english: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

kikuyu: Abiro timoni misango gi jamni machwe kendo abiro miyi chiwo mar imbe; bende abiro chiwoni rwedhi gi diek. Sela
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

kikuyu: Kinyne, oganda mane ni kode loka nam noyudo ni yie achiel kende ema ne ni kanyo, kendo ni Yesu ne ok odonjo ei yieno gi jopuonjrene, to ni negidhi adhiya kendgi.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

kikuyu: Eka malaika nodwoka niya, “Magi gin chunje angʼwen mag polo machungʼ e nyim Ruoth Nyasaye mar piny ngima kendo oseorogi mondo gidhi gitine.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka e kinde mane olo jo-Midian e lweny, iseturo jok mane turogi, kaachiel gi lodi mane gitingʼo e gokni, ma gin ludh ngʼama sandogi.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

kikuyu: Nolicho hekalu gi kite ma nengogi tek, kendo notiyo kod dhahabu mogol Parvaim.
english: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Nyiero en fuwo kendo en angʼo ma mor makamano konyo?”
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

kikuyu: Giwacho niya, ‘Angʼo momiyo wasebedo ka waweyo chiemo to ok ine? Bende angʼo momiyo wasebedo ka wahore malich to ok ikwan ma ka gimoro?’ “To kata kamano e kindeu mar tweyo chiemo, utimo mana kaka udwaro, kendo ukonyoru gi jotichu e yo marach.
english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

kikuyu: Kik uluor jogo manego ringruok to ok nyal nego chuny. To ngʼama onego uluor en Jal manyalo tieko chuny kaachiel gi ringruok e gehena.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

kikuyu: Puteoli kanyo ne wayude owete moko ma norwakowa mondo wadag kodgi kuom juma achiel. Bangʼe ne wamedo kwangʼ nyaka Rumi.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

kikuyu: Kane jo-dala maduongʼno owuok mondo oked gi Joab, jolwenj Daudi moko nonegi; to Uria ja-Hiti bende nonegi.
english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

kikuyu: To ndalo biro, kendo osechopo ma unukerue, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ringo dok dalane. Unuweya mi adongʼ kenda, kata kamano ok an kenda, nimar Wuora ni koda.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

kikuyu: E otienono Farao ne oluongo Musa kod Harun mowachonegi niya, “Wuoguru gi jo-Israel piyo mondo uwe joga mondo udhi ulam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kaka usekwayo.
english: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as you have said!

kikuyu: Resa nimar an mari; nikech asiko amanyo chikeni ndalo duto.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: “Ka dine bed ni inyalo pimo chandruok ma an-go, kata pimo masira duto momaka e ratil,
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

kikuyu: Kendo apenjo kama: Bende debed ni Israel ne ok owinjo tiend wach? Mokwongo, Musa wacho niya, “Anami nyiego maku gi joma ok owinjore kwan ka oganda; anami mirima maku gi oganda maonge winjo.”
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

kikuyu: Un e jogo mosesiko kochungo koda e masichena.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

kikuyu: Nikech ka dine bed ni Joshua ne nyalo miyogi yweyo, to Nyasaye ok dine owuoyo bangʼe kuom odiechiengʼ machielo.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

kikuyu: Aseneno Efraim, mana kaka ne aneno Turo, ka opidhi kama omiyo, to Efraim nokel nyithinde ni janek.”
english: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.

kikuyu: Ka kech ne kayogi to ne imiyogi makati koa e polo kendo ka riyo noloyogi to ne ikelo pi koa e kor lwanda; bende ne inyisogi mondo gidhi gikaw pinyno mane isesingo kikwongʼori ni ibiro miyogi.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

kikuyu: Iparo ni mano e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mapenjonee Nyasaye wach? Ooyo ok en kamano! Ruoth kik iketne jatichni bura kata joodgi bura, nikech jatichni ok ongʼeyo gima dhi nyime ka.”
english: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”

kikuyu: “Dhiyo e dala maduongʼ mar Nineve, kendo iwachne jo-dalano weche mane anyisi.”
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

kikuyu: Koro Ruoth e Rohonogo; kendo kama Roho mar Ruoth nitie, thuolo nitie.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

kikuyu: To moloyo, bende dibed ni asebiro monjo kendo ketho dalani ka ok en kuom wach Jehova Nyasaye? Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema osenyisa mondo abi amonj pinyni kendo akethe.’ ”
english: Have I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”

kikuyu: Nikech ka remb diek gi rwedhi gi buch nyiroye mane ikiro ne nyalo pwodho joma ogak, mi gibed maler gi oko,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

kikuyu: Andhokegi! Ka ulony kuom rango chal mar piny gi polo to angʼo momiyo ok unyal ngʼeyo gik matimore ndalogi?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

kikuyu: Donge amon gi jomamon kodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, koso donge ok awinjra gi joma chungʼ mondo oked kodi?
english: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

kikuyu: Koro Ben-Hadad ruodh Aram nochoko jolwenje duto. Koriwore gi ruodhi piero adek gariyo man-gi farese kod geche nodhi molworo Samaria kendo omonje.
english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

kikuyu: Jadolo biro kawo akuru achiel otimgo misango mar golo richo to machielo to otimgo misango miwangʼo pep. Kamano jadolo biro pwodho dhakono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kuom gakne kaluwore gi dende machwerno.
english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.

kikuyu: Adwoko erokamano ni Nyasaye moseketo, e chuny Tito, dwaro mar konyou, mana kaka an bende an-go.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

kikuyu: Daudi nowuok Gath moringo odhi e rogo mar Adulam. Kane owetene kod joodgi duto owinjo wachno, negidhi ire kuno.
english: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nowachonegi niya, “Nikech pesau oserumo, keluru jambu mondo uwilgo cham mabiro miyou.”
english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

kikuyu: Kane ochopo kanyo, nowachonegi niya, “Lamuru mondo kik udonj e tem.”
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Koro eka joma ni Judea oring odhi ewi gode, kendo joma ni e dala maduongʼ nyaka wuog oko, to jogo man oko ei piny kik donjie dala maduongʼ.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

kikuyu: Ne aparo wechego matut mi adonjone joka ruoth kod jotelo. Ne anyisogi niya, “Uyudo ohala kuom jowadu uwegi!” Omiyo ne aluongo buch galamoro mondo awuo kodgi,
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

kikuyu: Ne utingʼo kuonde lemo mag ruodhu malo, ne utingʼo nyiseche manono, mag sulwe ma Sakuth gi Kaiwan, mane uloso ni un uwegi,
english: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

kikuyu: Rieko mar pogo tiend wach noriti, kendo winjo tiend wach nobedni okumba.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

kikuyu: to awachonu kawuononi ni nyaka notieku. Ok unudag amingʼa e piny ma ubiro donjoe mondo ukaw ka usengʼado aora Jordan.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodolo madongo noloso chenro kaka digineg Lazaro kaachiel kode,
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

kikuyu: joka Juda, mane otingʼo kuodi gi tonge ne gin ji alufu auchiel gi mia aboro (6,800) mane oikore ne lweny;
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

kikuyu: To in ingʼeyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, chenrogi duto mar nega. Kik ingʼwon-negi kuom timbegi mag jendeke, kata rucho richo mag-gi e nyim wangʼi. Mad logi e nyimi; kendo kumgi e kinde mag mirimbi.
english: Yet, LORD, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger.

kikuyu: Nyis jo-Israel ni: Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak moro amora manie dieru manochiw nyathine moro amora ni nyiseche manono miluongo ni Molek, nyaka negi. Oganda jo-Israel duto mondo ogoye gi kite nyaka otho.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

kikuyu: “Adier, Nyasaye ok kwed ngʼama onge ketho, bende ok ochwak joma timbegi richo.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

kikuyu: Naketo chunya nono gino mane aneno to napuonjora kuom gino mane aneno.
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Kaka asekelo masiche malich kama ne jogi, omiyo koro anamigi mwandu mane asingonegi.
english: For the LORD says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

kikuyu: Tich matek duto kelo ohala, to wuoyo awuoya maonge tim kelo dhier.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kikuyu: ayenje ma wasiki osejerogo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ayenje ma gisejarogo okangʼ kokangʼ mar jatichni mowir.
english: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Eka noloso kareche mag mula apar ka moro ka moro tingʼo pi maromo lita mia aboro gi piero aboro, kendo ma lachne nyalo romo fut auchiel gi nus, ka karaya ka karaya noketo ewi rachungi apargo moro ka moro.
english: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

kikuyu: Misengini miwangʼo pep ne ngʼeny moloyo kaachiel gi boche miwangʼo mar lalruok kod misango miolo piny mane ochiw kaachiel gi misango miwangʼo pep. Kamano e kaka lemo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nodwok kare.
english: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the LORD’s house was set in order.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar Dwe Mowuok Manyien, nyaka ochiw nyarwath gi nyirombe auchiel kod im, maonge songa kargi duto.
english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie owete moko abiriyo e dierwa. Wuowi makayo nokendo to bangʼe notho, to kaka ne oonge gi nyithindo, noweyo chiege ne owadgi.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

kikuyu: Asewinjo kwer mikwerago, manyisa ni ichaya, omiyo kaluwore gi ngʼeyo ma an-go, to chuna ni nyaka adwoki.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

kikuyu: E higa mokwongo mar loch Sairas ruodh Pasia, mondo ochop singo mar wach Jehova Nyasaye mane Jeremia okoro, Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi chuny Sairas ruodh Pasia mondo ogol lendo e pinye duto koketo e ndiko kama:
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

kikuyu: Yore duto mag dhano nenorene ni nikare, to Jehova Nyasaye ema pimo chuny.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

kikuyu: to koro asayi mondo itim kamano nikech hera. Koro an Paulo awuon, ma jaduongʼ, kendo motwe nikech wach Kristo Yesu,
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ne mor mondo kite duto obed kuom Wuode,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

kikuyu: Eka Reuben nowacho ne wuon-gi niya, “Inyalo nego yawuota ka ok aduogoni Benjamin. Weye e lweta kendo abiro duoge.”
english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

kikuyu: Kamoro konyo nyawadgi, kendo jiwo wadgi kowachone niya, “Bed gichir!”
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

kikuyu: Ruoth nochiko Haman kowacho niya, “Dhi piyo.” Kaw law gi faras mondo itim duto misewacho ne Modekai ma ja-Yahudi, mabetga e dhoranga ruoth. Kik iwe kata mana gimoro achiel kuom gik ma isewacho.
english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

kikuyu: kendo ngʼat mane ochangi e yor honono ne hike oloyo piero angʼwen.
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

kikuyu: In ema gigo duto ngʼiyi mondo imigi chiembgi e kinde mowinjore.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Kendo nyikwayi moko mowuok e ringri kendo rembi iwuon, noter e twech mi nolokgi wasumbini mabwoch e od ruoth mar ruodh Babulon.”
english: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

kikuyu: “Ingʼeyo maber chal gik moko nyaka aa chon, chakre kinde mane oket dhano e piny,
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

kikuyu: mondo oyieru adimba kaka joge, ka obedo Nyasachu kaka ne osingore ne kwereu ma Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo.
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

kikuyu: to yie mondo iwinjgi gie polo kendo iwene jotichni ma jo-Israel richogi. Puonjgi yo makare mar dak kendo iornegi koth e piny mane imiyo jogi kaka girkeni margi.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

kikuyu: E dwe mar ariyo mar higa mar ariyo bangʼ kane gichopo e od Nyasaye e Jerusalem, Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel, Jeshua wuod Jozadak kod owetege mamoko (jodolo gi jo-Lawi kod jogo duto mane odwogo Jerusalem koa e twech) nochako tich, ka giyiero jo-Lawi moromo higni piero ariyo kod jomadongo mondo ginon gedo mar od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Kar romb nyithindo ma yawuowi duto makayo ma ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime, kondik nying-gi moro ka moro ne romo ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo, mia ariyo gi piero abiriyo gadek (22,273).
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

kikuyu: Eka Israel wuon-gi nowachonegi niya, “Ka en ni nyaka obed kamano, to timuru kama. Keturu gik moko mabeyo mag pinyni e ogundeu kendo utergi ne ngʼatno kaka mich; ma gin yiende moko, gi mor kich gi gik mangʼwe ngʼar gi mane-mane kod oyungu.
english: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

kikuyu: Kuom Damaski: “Hamath gi Arpad luoro omako, nimar giwinjo wach marach, chunygi omoko, kendo nigi chandruok ka nam mogingore.
english: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.

kikuyu: Mad omiyi gima chunyi gombo kendo omi chenro magi duto odhi maber.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

kikuyu: Ka aidho yamb kogwen mondo otera e tok nam komachielo,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kikuyu: to ot mochomo nyandwat en mar jodolo matiyo e kendo mar misango. Jodologo duto nyaka bed jo-Lawi ma nyikwa Zadok, kendo gin kendo gin kende ema moyienigi sudo machiegni gi Jehova Nyasaye mondo gitine.”
english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister to him.”

kikuyu: “Mana kaka pi ywero got kendo barore kendo kaka lwanda chorore kawuok kare,
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

kikuyu: Rieko en tipo mana kaka pesa bende en tipo, nimar rieko kelo ngima ni ngʼama ni kode.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼno anachung od Daudi mosepodho. Analos ohingane kod kuondene momukore duto. Anachak agere mi ochal kaka, ne entie chon,
english: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

kikuyu: E odiechiengno Nyasaye nomako Jabin, ruodh Kanaan, e nyim jo-Israel.
english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

kikuyu: Neyeuru kaka lweta awuon ema ondikonu baruwani gi nukta madongo dongo!
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

kikuyu: Jogo duto makiewo ngai nowe yiedhigi; Jolweny makedo e pi kod jokwangʼ duto nochungʼ kodhier e dho nam.
english: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,

kikuyu: Jehoyakin ne ja-higni apar gaboro kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom dweche adek kod ndalo apar. Notimo richo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Eka nogol lewnigo kendo norwak mamoko, bangʼe notingʼ buru kotero oko mar kambi kama ler mar pwodhruok.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Ahaz kendo kawacho niya,
english: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

kikuyu: “Ka ikwano jo-Israel, to ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka chul nengo ne Jehova Nyasaye mowarogo ngimane e sa ma ikwane. Eka onge masira mane ogore kuomgi ka ikwanogi.
english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

kikuyu: to jodongu gi jongʼad bura nodhi mondo opim gi tol chakre kama ringre ngʼatno nitie nyaka e mier machiegni kode.
english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kane gisechokore kaachiel, negipenje niya, “Ruoth, kindeni ema ibiro duogo pinyruoth e lwet jo-Israel koso?”
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

kikuyu: Ruodh Kedesh, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Jokneam man Karmel, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

kikuyu: Yath tinde orumo Gilead koso? Jathieth tinde onge kanyo koso? Kare ere gima omiyo adhond joga ok nyal chango?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

kikuyu: kokonyore gi kit wuond maricho duto mondo owitgo joma lal. Jogo lal nikech negitamore hero adiera makelo warruok.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni nyaka chop chiengʼ ma polo gi piny nolal nono, onge nukta matinie mogik kata kido moro amora mar kalam manolal kuom Chik, nyaka gik moko duto chop kargi.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo mano nowachonegi niya, “Joma ngima ok ema dwar jathieth makmana joma tuo. Ok ne abiro mondo aluong joma kare, to nabiro mondo aluong joricho.”
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokelo yawuot Harun morwakonegi kandho, eka otweyonigi okanda e nungogi kendo osidhonegi kilemba mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Adier, ber gihera biro luwa ndalo duto mag ngimana, kendo abiro dak e od Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

kikuyu: Dhiangʼ gi ondiek nokwa kaachiel, kendo nyithindgi nonind kanyakla, kendo sibuor nocham lum ka rwath.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Josia osetieko loso hekalu, Neko ruodh Misri nodhi mondo oked e dala mar Karkemish man but Yufrate mi Josia nodhi mondo orad kode e lweny.
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

kikuyu: Noketo jodolo e tijegi kendo nojiwogi kuom tich hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Ka osechieru gi Kristo, to keturu chunyu kuom gik manie polo, kuma Kristo obetie e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

kikuyu: E dhood Merari ne nitiere jo-Mali kod jo-Mushi; magi ema anywola joka Merari.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

kikuyu: Remeth, En Ganim, En Hada kod Beth Pazez.
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

kikuyu: Eka Esta noluongo Hathak, achiel kuom jotich ruoth mabwoch manoketi mondo otine, noore ir Modekai mondo onone kuom gima chande.
english: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.

kikuyu: Lokri iwe timbe maricho kendo itim tim maber; many kwe kendo iluwe.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

kikuyu: Nikech ok odonji e chunye, to odonjo mana e ich bangʼe owuok oko mar dende.” (Ka Yesu nowacho ma, ne opwodho chiemo duto ni ler.)
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

kikuyu: Wachnegi ni: Ka ngʼato moro mogak osudo machiegni kod kama jo-Israel chiwoe chiwo maler ni Jehova Nyasaye, to nangʼad kare oko kendo ok nobed gimoro e nyima. Mano en chik manyaka uriti chakre sani kod tiengʼ mabiro. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Kaka girkeni ne Israel jatichne; Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: modak higni gana gi gana to onge gi mor. Donge giduto gidhi mana kamoro achiel?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

kikuyu: Herode nogolo chik mondo omany Petro, to ne ok ginyal yude. Kuom mano, nonono jorit od twech mondo ginyise kuma Petro odhiye, eka nogolo chik mondo oneg joritogi. Kindeno Herode nodar Judea modhi odak Kaisaria kuom ndalo manok.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

kikuyu: Bende nitie gimoro amora matek ne Jehova Nyasaye? Abiro duogo iri e kinde mowinjore e higa mabiro kendo Sara biro nywolo nyathi ma wuowi.”
english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Jonathan, owadgi wuon Daudi ne en jangʼad rieko, ngʼat man-gi paro matut, kendo jagoro. Jehiel wuod Hakmon norito yawuot ruoth.
english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

kikuyu: Andikoni baruwani gi lweta awuon an Paulo, ka anyisi ni abiro chuli, kata ka ok aparoni ni in kod gopa ma en ngimani owuon.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

kikuyu: Kata mana e dieru ka, jomoko biro wuokie kendo gibiro puonjo weche mobam ma gichwogo kendgi giwegi mondo giywago jopuonjre irgi.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi nokone koramo niya, “Wan gi chik, kendo kaluwore gi chikwano, nyaka otho, nikech noketore ni en Wuod Nyasaye.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

kikuyu: nyaka asere chwowe mahob chunye, kata ka winyo madhiyo e obadho ma ochikne, ka ok ongʼeyo ni ngimane ni e tho!
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

kikuyu: nyaka Jehova Nyasaye nogologi kuome mana kaka ne osesiemogi kokadho kuom jotichne duto ma jonabi. Omiyo jo-Israel nogol oa e pinygi modhi e twech e piny Asuria kendo pod gin kuno nyaka chil kawuono.
english: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

kikuyu: kata obedo ni ne okawore kaka ngʼama ogwedhi kane pod ongima nikech ji nyaka paki ka mwanduni medore,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

kikuyu: Pinje duto oyudo yweyo kod kwe omiyo ji kok gi mor.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

kikuyu: To angʼo momiyo obedo mangʼwon koda momiyo min Ruodha dibi ira?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

kikuyu: Jodong Israel moko nobiro ira kendo negibet e nyima tir.
english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kohath ne gin: Amram, Izhar, Hebron kod Uziel.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: “Kaponi iu owangʼ, to kik utim richo.” Kik uwe chiengʼ podhi ka pod un gi ich wangʼ
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

kikuyu: Ne ochungʼ motegno ne joma odhier kendo ni gidwaro, kendo duto nobedo maber kode. Donge mano e tiend ngʼeya?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: E kindeno duto ma okete tenge, en ngʼama owal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodwoko niya, “Wabiro luwo yo maduongʼ tir, kendo ka wan kata jambwa omodho piu mora amora, to wabiro chulo. Wadwaro mana kalo kanyo ka wawuotho gi tiendwa; maonge gimoro amora machielo mwadwaro timo.”
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

kikuyu: Eka jatich Ibrahim nogolo gik moko mag dhahabu kod mag fedha kod lewni mi nomiyogi Rebeka; kendo nochiwo mich ma nengogi tek ne owadgi kod min-gi.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

kikuyu: Paro mar jaricho en tho, to paro ma Roho ema chiko kelo ngima kod kwe.
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

kikuyu: To noyudo ka janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye ma nyinge Oded ne ni kanyo kendo nodhi moromo kod jolweny kane gidwogo Samaria. Nowachonegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu osechiwo jo-Juda e lwetu nikech nokecho kodgi, to un to koro usenegogi gi ich wangʼ marach omiyo wachni osetundo ira e polo.
english: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because the LORD, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

kikuyu: Yaye, mano kaka nobed malit ne joricho nikech masira nobed kuomgi. Enokumgi kuom gik maricho ma lwetgi osetimo.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

kikuyu: Ahab bende noloso siro mar Ashera kendo notimo mangʼeny mamoko mondo ochwanygo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, kendo owangʼ iye moloyo ruodhi duto mag Israel mane nitiere motelone.
english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

kikuyu: to joma timbegi mono nogol oko e piny kendo jogo ma ok jo-adiera ok nobedie ngangʼ.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo negisudo nyime kendo gimonjo joma odak Debir (machon ne iluongo ni Kiriath Sefa).
english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

kikuyu: Joma timbegi mono nolal nono, jo-jar ji bende nolal nono, kendo jogo duto ma timbegi mono notieki;
english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

kikuyu: Par singruok mari nikech timbe mahundu opongʼo kuonde duto motimo mudho e piny.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

kikuyu: To chik Jehova Nyasaye ema more, kendo osiko oparo kuom chikene odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Joma oyie kuom Kristo duto ne timo gik moko gi chuny achiel kod paro achiel. Onge ngʼato kuomgi kata achiel mane okawo mwandune kaka gige owuon, to ngʼato ka ngʼato ne pogo gige duto ni nyawadgi, ka gikonyore ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

kikuyu: Obiro bedo ranyisi kendo rapar ne Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e piny Misri. Ka giywagore ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech joma sandogi, to obiro oronegi jawar kendo jakony, mi enoresgi.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuome gi teko. Nodhi Ashkelon, monego ji piero adek ma omagi gigegi mi ochiwo kandhe ne jogo mane owacho tiend ngero. Nodhi e od wuon ka en gi mirima.
english: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.

kikuyu: Mier matindo duto mane omi jodolo ma nyikwa Harun, ne gin apar gadek, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: kwerogo chalo gi gengʼo yamo kata mako moo gi lwedo.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moweyo yor winjo wach dhiyo kar yweyo mar oganda mar joma otho.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Ok gini olne Jehova Nyasaye misango mar divai, bende misengini ma gichiwo ok nomor Jehova Nyasaye ngangʼ. Misengini machalo kamano nochal negi mana kaka chiemb joma ywak; kendo jogo mochamogi nobed mogak. Chiemoni nobed margi giwegi; omiyo ok nokele e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They won’t pour out wine offerings to the LORD, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Pinje mangʼeny noriwre gi Jehova Nyasaye e odiechiengʼno kendo ginibed joga. Anadag e dieru kendo unungʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema oseora iru.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Ooyo yawuota; ok en huma maber ma awinjo kalandore e kind oganda Jehova Nyasaye.
english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD’s people disobey.

kikuyu: Ruodh jo-Misri noluongo jochologo mi openjogi niya, “En angʼo momiyo utimo kama? Angʼo momiyo ok uneg nyithindo ma yawuowi?”
english: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”

kikuyu: Nyisuru wuora luor ma omiya e piny Misri duto kod gik moko duto ma useneno. Kendo keluru wuora kae piyo.”
english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Abiro kelo masira e pinyni kendo kuom joma odakie, kaluwore gi kwongʼ duto mondikie kitabu mosesom e nyim ruodh Juda.
english: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

kikuyu: Gidak mabor gi mier, omiyo ok giwinj koko ma ji goyo; kendo ok owinj koko mar jariembo.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Ruoth Nyasaye nofwenyorene, kochungo yo korachwich mar bath kendo mar misango mar wangʼo ubani.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

kikuyu: Kane Satan osetieko temgi duto, noweye nyaka kinde moro machielo.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

kikuyu: Omiyo lop jo-Lawi gi lowo mogerie dala maduongʼ nobedie dier lowo mar ruoth. To lop ruoth nobed e kind tongʼ mar Juda kod kiep Benjamin.
english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

kikuyu: Yesu nochiko joma nenikanyo ni kik ginyis ngʼato wachni. To kaka nomedo kwerogino e kaka gin bende negimedo lando wachno.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

kikuyu: Ogendini nochokgi mi duog-gi e gwengegi giwegi. Kendo od Israel nolok ogendini jotichgi, machwo kod mamon e piny Jehova Nyasaye. Ginilok joma noketogi wasumbini, obed wasumbinigi mi giti joma ne thirogi.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

kikuyu: “Chik hekalu ema: Wi got mogerie hekaluni nobed maler moloyo. Mano e chik mar hekalu.
english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Musa nondikonu chikni nikech chunyu matek.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

kikuyu: Joma nodak e chulano nomiyowa luor e yore mangʼeny kendo kane koro wadwaro aa, ne gikowowa gi gige konyruok duto mane wachando.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

kikuyu: Nimar Wuoro ohero Wuowi, kendo onyise gik moko duto motimo. Ee, obiro medo nyise nyaka gik madongo moloyo magi mi unuwuor.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

kikuyu: iwacho ni, “ ‘Aonge ketho, kendo iye ok owangʼ koda.’ To abiro ngʼadoni bura nikech iwacho ni, ‘Pod ok atimo richo.’
english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

kikuyu: Saulo notho nikech ne ok orito singruokne gi Jehova Nyasaye. Ne ok orito chike Jehova Nyasaye, kendo nodhi mana ir jo-nyakalondo mondo onyise wach,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: Koro anywola duto orido ni jatichni matek; kagiwacho ni, Gol ngʼat mane onego owadgi, mondo wanege, kaka ne onego owadgi; eka wanatieki nyaka jarit girkeni bende. Koro gidwaro nego mirni maliel madongʼ-go, ka giweyo chwora dongʼ maonge nying kata kothe modongʼ e wangʼ piny.”
english: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

kikuyu: mondo uterie misango miwangʼo pep, kod misango magu kaachiel gi chiwo mar achiel kuom apar kod chiwo moyiedhi, kaachiel gi chiwo mar kwongʼruok kod chiwo mar hera, gi chiwo mag nyithindo makayo mag dhou kod jambu.
english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gangʼwen mar loch Ruoth Hezekia, Senakerib ruodh Asuria nomonjo mier madongo duto mochiel motegno mag Juda mokawogi.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

kikuyu: Kane an Damaski, jatelo manie bwo ruoth Aretas noketo jorit e ranga dala mar jo-Damaski mondo omaka.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “To koroni ka uonge gi ofuku mar pesa kaweuru, kendo sanduku bende, to ka uonge ligangla olok lawe pesa mondo ingʼiewgo ligangla.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone jopuonjre niya, “Ndalo biro ma unugomb nenoe chiengʼ achiel kuom ndalo mag Wuod Dhano, to ok ununene.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

kikuyu: Yesu nodonjo Jeriko, kendo nowuotho kokadho e dier dalano.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat mayom yom e tich Jehova Nyasaye! Okwongʼ ngʼat ma okano liganglane ma ok ochwerogo remo!
english: “Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

kikuyu: “Kamano e kaka ginihul nyinga kuom jo-Israel, kendo anagwedhgi.”
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

kikuyu: “Asenyisou ni, ‘Un “nyiseche;” kendo ni un duto un yawuot Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.’
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

kikuyu: Ne gikwano ute mag Jerusalem kendo ne gimukogi mondo olosgo ohinga motegno.
english: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo? Koso pok uwinjo? Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ kendo Jachwech mar piny duto. Ok nobed mool bende ok nonyosre, kendo pache onge ngʼama nyalo ngʼeyo.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Werne Jehova Nyasaye nikech osetimo gik madongo; kendo mano nyaka ngʼere e piny duto.
english: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

kikuyu: kendo nowacho ne Efron ka giwinjo niya, “Ka iyie to winja. Abiro chulo nengo mar puodhono. Yie achuli mondo mi aik ngʼata kanyo.”
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

kikuyu: Daudi nobiro ir Saulo mi nodonjo mochako tiyone. Saulo nohere ahinya, kendo Daudi nobedo achiel kuom jatingʼne gige lweny.
english: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, wuod dhano, kaw gigi midhigo e twech, mana godiechiengʼ ka gineni, wuogi ia kama intie idhi kamachielo. Dipo ka mano omiyo giwinjo tiend wach, kata obedo ni gin anywola ma jongʼanyo kamano.
english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Samuel niya, “Ibiro kuyo ne wach Saulo nyaka karangʼo nikech asedage mondo kik obed ruodh Israel? Pongʼ tungʼ mari gi mo mondo ichak wuoth; aori ka Jesse ma ja-Bethlehem. Aseyiero achiel kuom yawuote mondo obed ruoth.”
english: The LORD said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka jo-Israel noseneno teko maduongʼ mane Jehova Nyasaye onyiso kokedo gi jo-Misri, oganda noluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo negiketo genogi kuome kaachiel gi kuom Musa jatichne.
english: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi jatich Jehova Nyasaye. Nowerone Jehova Nyasaye weche mag wendni kinde mane Jehova Nyasaye orese e lwet wasike duto kendo e lwet Saulo. Nowacho niya: Aheri, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e tekra.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.

kikuyu: Negiwachonegi niya, “Ok wanyal timo gima kamano; ok wanyal chiwo nyaminwa ne ngʼama ok oter nyangu, mano dibed wichkuot ne wan.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

kikuyu: To kar sa ochiko, Yesu noywak gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (ma tiende ni, “Nyasacha, Nyasacha, iweya nangʼo?”).
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Aseneno joma timbegi richo ka iyiko, jogo mane osiko kadonjo kendo wuok e kama ler kendo ne yudo pak e dala maduongʼ kuom gik ma ok mi Nyasaye duongʼ. Ma bende en tim manono.
english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: nikech Muma wacho niya, “Piny kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye, gin mag Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

kikuyu: mana kaka Sara, mane winjo Ibrahim kendo luonge ni ruodhe. Un udoko nyige ka utimo gik mabeyo gi chir ma ok uluoro gimoro.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

kikuyu: Kapod usikona mana gi wich teko kendo udagi winja, to anakelnu masiche moloyo nyadibiriyo maromre gi richou.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

kikuyu: Kane magi duto oserumo, jo-Israel duto mane ni kanyo nodhi e miech Juda ma gitoyo kite milamo kendo negingʼado sirni milamo mag Ashera. Negimuko kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo kaachiel gi kende mag misango miwangʼoe liswa e piny Juda gi Benjamin kod piny Efraim gi Manase. Bangʼe kane gisemukogi duto, jo-Israel nodok kuondegi mag dak e miechgi.
english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

kikuyu: Iseloso kitanda mari kama otingʼore gi malo; kanyo ema isechiwoe misenginigi.
english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ahab nodhi mochiemo kendo metho, to Elija noidho ewi Got Karmel mokulore piny kendo osoyo wiye e kind chonge.
english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

kikuyu: Nikech Josef chwore ne en ngʼat makare, kendo ne ok odwar ni okuod wiye e nyim ji, omiyo nochano e pache mar weye ma lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

kikuyu: Asekiro moo e kitandana, gin modhi mangʼeny mangʼwe ngʼar gi mane-mane kod obala ndago.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

kikuyu: “Jatich noduogo kendo nowacho wechego ni ruodhe. Eka wuon ot nobedo mager kendo nowacho ni jatichne ni, ‘Wuogi idhi mapiyo e yore madongo kod yore matindo mag dala mondo ikel joma odhier gi rangʼonde, muofni kod pudhe.’
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

kikuyu: Magi e buche, chike kod yore mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo jo-Israel e Got Sinai kokadho kuom Musa.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

kikuyu: Kane nyithindi otimo richo e nyime, noweyogi mondo giyud kum mowinjore gi richogi.
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jo-Farisai nowacho e kindgi ngʼato gi ngʼato niya, “Uneno ka wachni e muomowa. Neyeuru kaka piny duto osewuok luwo bangʼe!”
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

kikuyu: Kikombe duto mag Ruoth Solomon nolos gi dhahabu, kod gige ot duto mokonyorego e ode mane ni e Bungu mag Lebanon nolos gi dhahabu mopwodhi. Onge gima nolos gi fedha nikech fedha nokaw ni nengone yot e kinde Solomon.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kar dino cham man Atad, machiegni gi Jordan, negiywago wuon-gi matek kendo malit ahinya; kendo Josef nokawo ndalo abiriyo koywago wuon-gi.
english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

kikuyu: Yie iwinj dwonda gokinyi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; aketo kwayona e nyimi gokinyi, kendo arito dwoko ka an gi geno.
english: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osemiyo apongʼ kod puonj, mondo omi angʼe wach manyalo hoyogo ngʼama ni e chandruok. Ochiewa pile okinyi kokinyi, kendo oyawo ita mondo abed gi winjo ka ngʼat mipuonjo.
english: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka we miriambo duto kendo wach adiera ne nyawadgi, nikech wan duto wan fuond ringruok achiel.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

kikuyu: Eka natingʼo wangʼa, mi napo kaneno tunge angʼwen!
english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

kikuyu: To Ruoth Zedekia nokwongʼore gi kwongʼruokni lingʼ-lingʼ ne Jeremia: “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, mosemiyowa muya, ok ananegi kata chiwi ne jogo madwaro ngimani.”
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As the LORD lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”

kikuyu: ma akano ne kinde mag chandruok, ne odiechienge mag lweny gi kedo?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

kikuyu: Kik ulos nyiseche manono mondo opiem koda; bende kik ulos nyiseche mag kido mag fedha kata dhahabu.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

kikuyu: To ne wawachone ni, ‘Wan joma kare; ok wan okwach kich.
english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

kikuyu: To ka chwore owinjo wachni mokwere, to oketho kwongʼruok motweye kata singruok mane orikni chiwo, kendo Jehova Nyasaye kete thuolo.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji mangʼeny moko bende noyie kuom Yesu nikech weche mane owachonegi.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto nowuok kuonde mane gipondoe moriedo jolwenjgi Baal Tamar, kendo jo-Israelgo nochako kedo koa yo podho chiengʼ mar Gibea.
english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

kikuyu: Mano kaka en gima ber neno tiend joote maringo ewi gode kakelo wach maber, mar kwe, mar resruok, kod mar warruok kagiwachone Sayun niya, “Nyasachu olocho!”
english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

kikuyu: to wach Ruoth osiko manyaka chiengʼ.” Ma e Injili mane oyalnu.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo Nyasaye nooro lwedo mondo ondik wechego.
english: Then the part of the hand was sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

kikuyu: kendo nokir remb winyono moko e kor kendo mar misango, to remo modongʼ to mondo ochwer e tiend kendono, nikech en misango mar golo richo.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Ji nochak odag e tipone. Nonyaa maber mana ka cham, kendo nonyag maber ka mzabibu mi nobed gi huma ka divai moa Lebanon.
english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Girkeni osebedona ka sibuor manie bungu. Orutona; omiyo amon kode.
english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.

kikuyu: nyikwa Shekania; nyikwa Parosh, Zekaria, kaachiel kode ji mia achiel gi piero abich;
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Jolwenygi duto nochiwore mondo giti kode. Negibiro Hebron ka gingʼado e chunygi ni Daudi nyaka bed ruodh jo-Israel duto. To jo-Israel mamoko bende ne nigi paro achiel mondo Daudi oket ruoth.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Kane pod gin e yo, wach nochopo ne Daudi niya, “Abisalom osenego yawuot ruoth duto; maonge kata achiel kuomgi modongʼ.”
english: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

kikuyu: An to pok akonyora gi ratiro mawan-gogi kata achiel, kendo kata sani ok andiknu wechegi mondo akwau kony monego ayudi koa kuomu. Dine obedo maberna ka atho moloyo ka ayiene ngʼato oketho sunganani.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho mi aneno faras marachar. Ngʼat moidhe ne otingʼo atungʼ kendo ne osidhne osimbo. Ne owuok gi farase ka jaloch madhi mondo olochi.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

kikuyu: Chunywa mor kuome, nikech wageno kuom nyinge maler.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

kikuyu: To ka ariembo jochiende gi lith lwet Nyasaye to kare pinyruoth Nyasaye osebironu.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

kikuyu: Ater, Hezekia, Azur,
english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

kikuyu: Koro ne gitero Yesu kama iluongo ni Golgotha (tiende ni “Hanga Wich”).
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne owuoyo koda ka bade maratego ni kuoma, kosiema ni mondo kik awuothi e yore mag ogandani. Nowacho niya,
english: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

kikuyu: Musa nomiyogi chiwo duto mane jo-Israel osekelo kuom gero kama ler mar lemo, kendo ji nomedo kelo chiwo mar hera okinyi kokinyi.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Galio en ruodh Akaya, jo-Yahudi noriwo ni Paulo mi negimake gitere e od bura,
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

kikuyu: Machalre kamano bende jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik e kindgi giwegi bende nojare kagiwacho niya, “Ne oreso jomoko to en koro ok onyal resore owuon!
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

kikuyu: Eka dwolno nowacho ni malaika mar auchiel man-gi turumbete niya, “Gony malaike angʼwen motwe gibed thuolo gia e aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate.”
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

kikuyu: Pinyno kaachiel gi mier matindo mokiewo kodgi nobedo girkeni mar joka Gad.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

kikuyu: Loye duto mag Hemb Romo kod loye mag alwora mar laru nolos gi mula.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

kikuyu: To kodhi manie lowo maber, ochungo kar jogo man-gi chuny malongʼo kendo maber, mawinjo wach, gikane, kendo gibedo modhil ma ginyag cham.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

kikuyu: kendo noorogi oko mondo giyal pinyruoth Nyasaye kendo chango joma tuo.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

kikuyu: Kane awinjo wachno, ne ayiecho kandhona kod lepa, apudho yie wiya kod yie tika mi abedo piny ka an-gi bwok malich.
english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.

kikuyu: Kare koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Chik en richo koso? Ok kamano ngangʼ! Adiera, dine ok angʼeyo gima richo en ka dine onge chik. Nimar bende dine ok angʼeyo gima chik en ka dine ok owacho niya, “Kik igombi gir wadu.”
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

kikuyu: Ka atiyo e dier jo-Yahudi, to adoko machal kodgi mondo alokgi. Ka atiyo e dier joma luwo chik, to achalo ngʼama luwo chik (kata obedo ni an awuon ok an e bwo chik), eka alok joma luwo chik.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

kikuyu: Baasha nonego Nadab e higa mar adek mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, kendo nokaw lochne kaka ruoth.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ka dala mudonjeno en dala mowinjore, to kwe maru nodongʼne, to ka ok kamano, to kweuno noduognu.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidwoko Yesu niya, “Ok wangʼeyo.” Eka nowachonegi niya, “An bende ok abi nyisou kuma agole teko ma atimogo gigi.
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Noparo e chunye niya, “Ka Esau omonjo migawo achiel, to migawo machielo modongʼ nyalo tony.”
english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

kikuyu: nimar en gohala moloyo fedha kendo okelo gik mabeyo moloyo dhahabu.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

kikuyu: “Wuoguru oko uayi kuome, joga! Ringuru ukony ngimau! Ringuru uaye mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from the LORD’s fierce anger.

kikuyu: Ok anawe mak achopo winjruokna kode kata loko gima asewacho gi dhoga.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

kikuyu: Kelub, owadgi Shuha nonywolo Mehir mane wuon Eshton.
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

kikuyu: Jogi onge gi wichkuot mana ka apaka mager mar nam, madhwolo buoyo kendo gibagni mana ka sulwe mabayo, gin joma osekan-negi kum mar mudho mandiwa manyaka chiengʼ.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Joel wuod Zikri ema ne jatendgi maduongʼ, to Juda wuod Hasenua norito gwengʼ mar ariyo mar dala maduongʼno.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

kikuyu: Gikanyono achiel kuom joma ne nigi Yesu nowuodho liganglane oko, kendo notongʼo jatij jadolo maduongʼ, mi ochodo ite oko.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: To ja-Farisai moro ma nyinge Gamaliel, mane en japuonj chik ma ji duto ogeno, nochungʼ e nyim buch Sanhedrin mi ogolo chik mondo ogol joote oko matin.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

kikuyu: Jatelo maduongʼ mar jo-Lawi ne en Eliazar wuod Harun jadolo. En ema ne oyiere bedo jatelo mag joma rito kama ler mar lemo.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: “Inine malit in jakwath manono ma jwangʼo rombe! Jakwath ma kamano onego bedene tal kendo wangʼe ma korachwich ochor! Mad bedene tal, kendo wangʼe ma korachwich ochor chuth!”
english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Asher; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero abich gadek mia angʼwen (53,400).
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Koro ruoth ma ruodha oyie owinj weche ma jatije wacho. Ka diponi Jehova Nyasaye ema thuya kodi, to madoyie okaw misango. To ka dipo ni ji ema timo mano to mondo okwongʼ-gi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye! Koro giseriemba mondo kik ayud girkeni ma Jehova Nyasaye omiya kagiwacho ni, ‘Dhi iti ne nyiseche mamoko.’
english: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that the LORD has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before the LORD; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to the LORD’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

kikuyu: “Yie iorna ngʼama olony e tij dhahabu kod fedha, kod mula kod nyinyo kendo mongʼeyo loso law maralik gi makwar kod marambulu kendo man-gi ngʼeyo kuom goro gik mamoko mondo oti gi jotichna molony man Juda gi Jerusalem mane Daudi wuora oketo.
english: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

kikuyu: Nowuoyo kendo nogoyo mbaka gi jo-Yahudi moluwo timbe jo-Yunani, to jogo notemo nege.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

kikuyu: Achiewo kogwen ka piny pok oyawore kendo aywagora mondo ayud kony; aseketo genona e wachni.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

kikuyu: Nikech ji duto mangima gin maga, wuoro kaachiel gi wuowi, giduto machalre. Ngʼato ka ngʼato biro tho mana nikech richone owuon.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

kikuyu: Ne, Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro dhi nyimu nyaka aora Jordan.
english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

kikuyu: Kik utam Roho Maler tiyo e dieru,
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kane Rabshake jatend lweny owinjo ni ruodh Asuria osewuok Lakish, ne oringo oa kanyo moyudo ka ruoth kedo gi jo-Libna.
english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

kikuyu: Chokruok nonjawni. Ji moko ne wacho gimoro achiel, to jomoko ne wacho gimachielo. Ji mangʼeny ne ok ongʼeyo kata gima omiyo ne gin kanyo.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

kikuyu: Elishama, Eliada, kod Elifelet; giduto ne gin ji ochiko.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

kikuyu: Kane Athalia min Ahazia noneno ni wuode osetho, nodhi mondo otiek anywola mar joka ruoth mar Juda duto.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo chuth ni piny duongʼ maromo nade? Nyisa ane ka ingʼeyo gigi duto?
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone jotije niya, “Dhiuru nyime an abiro bangʼu.” To ne ok onyiso chwore ma Nabal.
english: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

kikuyu: Chur ma achurgo ojonya otieno duto abudo kitandana gi ywak, kendo pi wangʼa olwoko piendena.
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

kikuyu: Gibiro nege, to chiengʼ mar adek ibiro chiere mobed mangima kendo.” Kendo jopuonjre nokuyo ahinya.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka iserwako lewnigi kuom owadu Harun gi yawuote, to wirgi gi mo kendo ipwodhgi. Walgi mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Jakobo manok mane odongʼ noduog ir Nyasaye Maratego.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Yaye od Israel, akelo oganda moa mabor mondo oked kodu, gin oganda machon kendo man-gi sinani, jogo ma ok ungʼe dhogi, bende wechegi ok unyal winjo tiendgi.
english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says the LORD. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.

kikuyu: An awuon aseneno ngʼama ofuwo ka odak e ngima maber, to apoya nono opo ka ode okwongʼ.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ayawo dhoga, mi nomiya weche mondikie kalatasni mondo acham.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

kikuyu: Eka nogolo chik mondo ji obed piny e lum. Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo, nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi nomiyo jopuonjre kendo jopuonjre nomiyogi ji.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno morito chike Jehova Nyasaye kendo timo gik mopuonje biro dak amingʼa, to ngʼat mochayo chikene biro tho.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Dhiyo, yie mari osechangi. Gikanyono ngʼatno nochako neno, kendo noluwo bangʼ Yesu kowuotho e yo.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

kikuyu: Joshua nochano kite apar gariyogo mane ni e dier aora Jordan kama jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nosechungʼe kendo kitego pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

kikuyu: Bende nitie yiend Zeituni ariyo e bathe, achiel e bath bakul korachwich to machielo e bathe koracham.”
english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

kikuyu: to ka an e kind kanisa, to daher wacho weche kata abich kende gi dhok ma ji duto winjo mondo apuonj moloyo weche alufu apar gi dhok mayoreyore ma ji ok winji.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

kikuyu: kendo kudhi losoru kanyo, to beduru gi kwer, ukunygo bur, mi ka uselosoru to uiko.
english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

kikuyu: Gin olembe mopogore opogore kaka nad kod safron, gi kalmas kod sinamon, kod yedhe mangʼwe ngʼar, kaka ubani gi mane-mane, kod apilo mamit mag tedo.
english: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices,

kikuyu: Ka udhi kedo gi wasigu kendo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ochiwogi e lwetu ma umakogi ka wasumbini magu,
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

kikuyu: Kik imi ja-Israel wadu chuli gi ohala kuom gima oholo bedni en pesa kata chiemo kata gimoro amora monego gol ohala.
english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

kikuyu: Negitiyo tich Nyasachgi kod tich mar pwodhruok, mana kaka jower gi jorit Rangeye notimo, kaluwore gi chike mag Daudi kod wuode Solomon.
english: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.

kikuyu: Negiketo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye e gari bende negiketo Sanduku motingʼo dhahabu molos ka oyieyo gi dhahabu molos ka buche.
english: They put the LORD’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

kikuyu: Jogo nokaw wachno kaka ranyisi maber kendo negikawo wachno piyo piyo ma giwacho niya, “Ee, owadu Ben-Hadad!” Ruoth nowachonigi niya, “Dhiuru mondo uome.” Kane Ben-Hadad osewuok oko, Ahab noluongo mondo oidh gache.
english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

kikuyu: Ohingano noger gi jaspa, to dalano noger gi dhahabu lilo marieny ka kio maler.
english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo e dala jatend sinagogi, Yesu noyudo ka dala otimo koko; ka ji ywak kendo goyo nduru matek.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

kikuyu: Jorito makonyou koro tetni, jou maroteke koro gumbo, rego biro chungʼ nikech jorego nok, kendo wengeu biro lokore boo ma ok unyal neno maber.
english: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

kikuyu: Uolo Jehova Nyasaye gi wecheu. To upenjo niya, “Ere kaka wechewa oole?” Uole kuom wacho niya, “Joma timo marach gin joma beyo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, kendo omor kodgi,” kata uwacho niya, “Ere Nyasaye mangʼado bura makare?”
english: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

kikuyu: To bangʼ ndalo adek gi nus much ngima mar Nyasaye nodonjo eigi, mine gichungʼ gi tiendegi, kendo luoro maduongʼ nomako joma ne onenogi.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni dhood Israel niya, “Dwarauru eka unubed mangima,
english: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

kikuyu: Ruoth nomiyo fedha obedo manwangʼo yot ka kidi akida Jerusalem kendo yiend sida ne ngʼeny mana ka yiend ngʼowu ma otwi e got.
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

kikuyu: Kata kamano an kodi ndalo duto, kendo imaka gi bada korachwich.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

kikuyu: Kane awuoyo kodu kendo ayalonu, to ne ok akonyora gi weche mamit kata mariek maywayo ji, to teko mar Roho ema onyisou ni wach mane ayalonu ne en adier
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu noket kwongʼ-gi duto ne wasiku ma ochayou kendo sandou.
