english: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

kikuyu: Nam mare, nimar en ema nolose, kendo lwetene ema noloso lowo motwo.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

kikuyu: E sa mane okawoe kitabuno gik mangima angʼwen ka gi Jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen-go ne opodho auma e nyim Nyarombo. Moro ka moro kuomgi ne nigi nyatiti kod tewni mag dhahabu ma ubani opongʼo. Tewni mag ubanigo ochungʼ kar lemo mar jomaler.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Adhola mari ok nyal thiedhi, hinyruok mari okalo chango.
english: For the LORD says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.

kikuyu: “Ka irodhno gi rwadh jasiki kata pundane ka bayo abaya molal, nyaka idwoke ne wuon-gi.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu oa e hekalu, achiel kuom jopuonjrene nokone niya, “Neye, Japuonj! Kitegi dongo manade! Magi gedo malich manade!”
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

kikuyu: Werneuru, pakeuru gi wende; nyisuru kuom tijene duto miwuoro.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Omiyo Hezekia nomiye fedha duto mane oyud e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye to gi ute keno duto mag od ruoth.
english: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.

kikuyu: Masira bangʼ masira; piny duto okethi. Ka diemo wangʼ nono hembena omuki, kara mar dak ka mil polo.
english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

kikuyu: “Nodwoko ni, ‘Jasigu ema notimo ma.’ “Jotich nopenje ni, ‘Diher mondo wadhi wapudhgi oko?’
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

kikuyu: Musa notiyo gi adiera e od Nyasaye gi chunye duto, mobedo janeno kuom gik mane ibiro ler tiendgi bangʼe.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjrene ariyogo owinjo kowacho mano, negiluwo bangʼ Yesu.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

kikuyu: Eka ne angʼicho mi aneno Nyarombo kochungʼ ewi Got Sayun. To ne en kod ji alufu mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gangʼwen (144,000) kendo nyinge owuon gi nying Wuon-gi nondiki e lela wengegi.
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

kikuyu: Kare ere nyisecheu mane uloso ne un uwegi? We mondo gibi ka ginyalo resou ka un e thagruok! Nimar un gi nyiseche mangʼeny, mana kaka un gi dala mangʼeny, yaye Juda.”
english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble, for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

kikuyu: Kapo ni gima ichamo miyo wadu hinyore, to mano nyiso ni iseweyo wuotho e hera. Kik iyie gima ichamo chwany ngʼat mane Kristo othone.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

kikuyu: Wengene chalo akuru mopiyo but aore mamol, moluoki gi chak, kendo ochan kaka kite ma nengogi tek.
english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.

kikuyu: Jesse nonywolo Eliab, wuode makayo; wuode mar ariyo Abinadab, mar adek Shimea,
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nodok ir Jethro jaduongʼne mowachone niya “Yie iweya adog Misri ir joga mondo ane kapo ni nitie moro kuomgi ma pod ngima.” Jethro nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo kendo ibed gi gweth.”
english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Daniel to nongʼado e chunye ni ok nobed mogak kuom chamo chiemo kendo madho divai moa e od ruoth, omiyo nokwayo jatelo maduongʼ thuolo mondo oweye kik ocham chiemo mogakgo.
english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

kikuyu: Ka ndaloni mag goyo agengʼa orumo, wangʼ achiel kuom adek mag yierego gi mach e dier dala Jerusalem. Kaw achiel ewi adek mamoko ingʼad gi ligangla, kilworogo dala. Achiel ewi adek moko to ke mondo yamo odhigo. Nikech abiro lawogi gi ligangla moseywa oko e olalo mare.
english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

kikuyu: Achalo gi yath, madongo e bath aora madongo ka ngʼich nikech tiendene ochwo pi kendo thoo biro bedo e bedena gotieno.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

kikuyu: Wuon-gi nosemiyogi mwandu mangʼeny mag fedha gi dhahabu gi gik moko ma nengogi tek kaachiel gi mier mag Juda mochiel gohinga motegno, kata kamano loch pinye nomiyo Jehoram pinyruoth nikech ne en wuode makayo.
english: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

kikuyu: mondo omi gilu yorene kendo girit chikene. Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye!
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Donge ne iola oko ka chak kendo ne ipuoya mi apoto ka mo,
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

kikuyu: Jolweny nowuok modhi e paw lweny mondo giked gi Israel, kendo lweny nogore e bungu mar Efraim.
english: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosefwenyo pach Jehova Nyasaye, koso en ngʼa mosebedo kaka jangʼadne rieko?
english: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

kikuyu: eka ununyis nyithindu kod nyikwau kaka ne adoko makwiny gi jo-Misri bende kaka ne atimo ranyisina e kindgi, eka mondo ungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ka ngʼato opwodhore kuom puonj mochido to enobed kaka gir tich mitiyogo tije mogen. Enodok ngʼat maler ma Ruoth oyiego kaka jatichne makare kendo moikore tiyo tich moro amora maber.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

kikuyu: Ngʼato mokadho tongʼ, ma ok sik e puonj Kristo, oonge gi Nyasaye, to ngʼat mosiko gi puonj nigi Wuoro kaachiel gi Wuowi.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Rieko ma kamano lichna miwuoro, kendo otutna moyombo pacha.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gichiemo, Yesu nokawo makati, kendo bangʼ goyo erokamano, nongʼinge momiyo jopuonjrene kowacho niya, “Kawuru, ma e ringra.”
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

kikuyu: kendo Moab ne nigi bwok maduongʼ nikech jogo ne ngʼeny ahinya. Adiera, Moab luoro nomako ahinya nikech jo-Israel.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka un duto nubiro ira muwachna niya, “Waor jomoko nyimwa mondo odhi onon-nwa piny kendo odwoknwa wach e yo ma onego walu gi dala ma wabiro chopoe.”
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, jo-Lawi nobiro tiyo tijgi e Hemb Romo kotelnegi gi Harun kod yawuote. Negitimone jo-Lawi mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

kikuyu: Haman nosungorenegi kaka en-gi mwandu mathoth, gi yawuowi mangʼeny, to gi kaka ruoth osemiye duongʼ moloyo jotelo gi jodongo mamoko.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Donge usesomo Ndiko mawacho niya, “ ‘Kidi mane jogedo odagi osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot, Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo mano, kendo en gima iwuoro ka waneno?’
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

kikuyu: Duongʼ duto ma joodgi noyudi ma gin, nyithinde gi nyikwaye, gige duto ma ok ogen, machalo kaka bakunde nyaka agulni duto nowuog kuome.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

kikuyu: Kar romb chwo duto kochakore ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime noromo ji alufu abiriyo mia abich (7,500).
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Rwadhi noyangʼ kineno, to ok ni cham ringe. Kanyna mari nokaw kuomi githuon, to ok noduognigo. Rombe magi nomi wasiki, to onge ngʼama noresgi.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

kikuyu: Asenyisou gi yore duto ni nyaka wati matek wan wawegi mondo wakonygo joma chandore, ka waparo wach mane Ruoth Yesu owachonwa ni, ‘Chiwo kelo gweth moloyo kawo!’ ”
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

kikuyu: Eka nyaka oket lwete ewi chiayono kendo oyangʼe e dho Hemb Romo. Yawuot Harun nokaw remo, kendo ginikire e bethe kendo mar misango koni gi koni.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Elisha noweyo rwethe mag pur moringo koluwo bangʼ Elija. Nowachone niya, “Yie iwe ago ne wuonwa kod minwa oriti bangʼe to abiro dhiyo kodi.” Elija nodwoke niya, “Dogi, en angʼo ma asetimo?”
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

kikuyu: Ere mayot wacho, wacho ni, ‘Richoni oweni,’ koso wacho ni, ‘Aa malo mondo iwuothi?’
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

kikuyu: Puodhono kod rogo duto mane ni e iye nongʼiew koa kuom jo-Hiti.”
english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano nokawo wuode makayo, mane onego okaw ruoth kare mi otimogo misango e kor ohinga mar dala maduongʼ. Mirima maduongʼ nomako jo-Israel; kendo mano nomiyo giweyo kedo kodgi mi gidok e pinygi.
english: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

kikuyu: Joma kido mar richo chiko ok nyal moro Nyasaye.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

kikuyu: To ka ogandano nofwenyo nine en ja-Yahudi, ne gikok gi dwol achiel kuom seche ariyo kagiwacho niya, “Artemis mar jo-Efeso duongʼ!”
english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

kikuyu: misumba modoko ruodh piny, kata ngʼat mofuwo mochiemo moyiengʼ,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kikuyu: Buya nonyak e piny: Cham nonywolo kothegi kaka kitgi nobet kendo yiende nonywolo olembe man-gi kodhi kaka kitgi nobet. Kendo Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ber mondo ichik iti ne siem ngʼat man-gi rieko, moloyo chiko iti ne wend joma ofuwo.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

kikuyu: Donge chiemo osegol oko e nyim wangʼwa; donge ilo kod mor onge e od Nyasachwa?
english: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

kikuyu: Eka Naomi nowacho niya, “Rit mondi, nyara, nyaka ingʼe gima timore. Nikech ngʼatno ok bi bedo mos kapok otiek wachno kawuono.”
english: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”

kikuyu: Yesu nopenje niya, “Nyarwa, iywago angʼo? En ngʼa mimanyo?” En to noparo ni mano jarit puodho ema wuoyo kode, omiyo nopenje niya, “Jaduongʼ, ka dipo ni in ema ne ikawe idhi kode, to nyisa kama iseketee, mondo adhi akawe.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel mochwere manyaka chiengʼ. Eka ji duto nowacho niya, “Amin” kendo ni “Opak Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye winjo joma ochando kendo ok olok ngʼeye ne joge motwe.
english: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gangʼwen, Kedorlaomer kod ruodhi mane oriwore kode nodhi omonjo kendo oloyo jo-Refai man Ashteroth Karnaim, jo-Zuzim e Ham gi jo-Emi man Shave Kiriathaim,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: Omiyo kane Balaam oneno ni berne Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedh Israel, ne ok otimo tim jwok kaka ne osetimo e kinde mokalo, to nolokore kongʼiyo yo thim.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

kikuyu: kendo ongʼeye kuom timbene mabeyo kaka oserito nyithindo e yo mowinjore kendo osebedo kohero rwako welo e ode, kendo osebedo ka olwoko tiend jomaler kendo ka okonyo joma ni e chandruok, kochiwore chuth ni timo gik mabeyo duto.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nowacho kendo niya, “Kaka koro asebedo gichir ma awuoyo gi Ruoth Nyasaye, kata obedo ni ok an gimoro to makmana lowo kod buru.
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Masiche nomakgi ka ohula motuch apoya; kendo yamb otieno nokegi mabor.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

kikuyu: Kane Rebeka onyisi gima Esau wuode makayo paro timo, noluongo Jakobo wuode ma chogo kendo owachone niya, “Esau owadu nigi paro mar negi.”
english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

kikuyu: Kendo Solomon nochako ogero Gezer). Nogero Beth Horon ma yo ka mwalo,
english: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

kikuyu: ne ruodhi gi joma nitie e loch duto mondo eka wadag gi kwe maonge tungni, ka waluoro Nyasaye kendo ka wan jomaler chuth.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni atingʼo ngimana e lweta kinde duto, to wiya ok bi wil gi chikeni.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Nokawo Petro kod yawuot Zebedi ariyo modhigo, eka nochako bedo gi kuyo kod paro mangʼeny.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Gad nomi: Ramoth mantiere Gilead (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), gi Mahanaim,
english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Chunya rito Ruoth Nyasaye, moloyo kaka jorito rito ru piny, chunya riti, yaye Nyasaye, moloyo kaka jorito rito ru piny.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Wawinjore! Kendo mondo obed kaka uwachono.” Omiyo ne ogologi mi gidhi. Bangʼe notweyo tol makwar e dirisa.
english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

kikuyu: Mad opar misengni magi duto kendo oyie gi misengini miwangʼo pep magi. Sela
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

kikuyu: Eka ne gingʼulo olawo e lela wangʼe, kendo negigoye ngum. Jomoko to nopame,
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

kikuyu: Winj ywak moa Horonaim, ywak mar duwruok maduongʼ gi kethruok.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

kikuyu: Ibiro podho e pap, nikech asewuoyo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: E mirimbi ne iwuotho e piny duto, to kuom mirimbi ne inyono ogendini.
english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

kikuyu: Noyawo lwanda, mi pi nowuok gi teko; kendo pigno nomol ka aora mamol e piny motwo.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

kikuyu: To malaika machielo nowuok oa e hekalu manie polo, en bende ne en gi pala mabith mar keyo.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Emomiyo abiro kumou kendo. Bende abiro kumo nyikwau.
english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says the LORD, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

kikuyu: “Aluongo Jehova Nyasaye, mowinjore pako, kendo oresa kuom wasika.
english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi notimo kaka Nyasaye nochike kendo neginego jolweny mag jo-Filistia kochakore Gibeon nyaka Gezer.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

kikuyu: E kinde duto mane Musa osiko kotingʼo bedene malo, to jo-Israel ne loyo, to kane Musa odwoko bedene piny, to jo-Amalek ema ne loyo.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owuok oko korwako osimbo mar kudho gi kandho makwar, Pilato nowachonegi niya, “Eri ngʼatno!”
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

kikuyu: Donge unyalo paro ni ne anyisou gigi kane an kodu?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

kikuyu: to jogo mano kagi ema nochamgi, ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye, bende jogo ma choko olemb mzabibu ema nomadhgi e laru mar kara maler mar lemo.”
english: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nochiwo chik ni jotend Israel niya,
english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

kikuyu: to ne nitie ngʼato kanyo ma lwete notal. Negipenjo Yesu, ka gidwaro yo ma digiyudgo ketho kuome, niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo ochang ngʼato chiengʼ Sabato?”
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Kendo Hezekia nolamo Jehova Nyasaye kowacho kama:
english: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Kar wacho kamano to onego uwach mana niya, “Ka Ruoth oyie to wabiro bedo mangima mi watim ma kata macha.”
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

kikuyu: Kuno bende ne uneno kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu okawo tingʼu mana kaka wuoro kawo tingʼ wuode, kotelonu e wuodhu duto nyaka uchopo ka.”
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

kikuyu: Dhakono nonywolo nyathi ma wuowi, nyathi ma wuowi mabiro locho korito ogendini gi ludh nyinyo. To nyathineno noyudhi moter malo ir Nyasaye e kom duongʼne.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

kikuyu: Ot ma dhoode nochomo yo nyandwat borne ne oromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich, to lachne ne romo fut piero abiriyo gabich.
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Eka odok kendo oomo jochiende abiriyo mamoko maricho moloye, kendo gibiro gidonj mi gidag kanyo. Bangʼe achien ngima ngʼatno bedo marach moloyo kaka nochal mokwongo.”
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Abigael ne en min Amasa ma wuon-gi ne en Jetha ja-Ishmael.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

kikuyu: to yamo motegno moloyo mano aa kuoma. Koro asengʼadonegi bura.”
english: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Biuru sani mondo uwinjru gi ruodha, ma en ruodh Asuria: Abiro miyou farese alufu ariyo, ka unyalo yudo joma riembogi!
english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

kikuyu: Keturu mo gi ubani nikech en misango mar cham.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Yienwa wakal e pinyi. Ok wananyon puodho moro amora kata puoth mzabibu, kata modho pi moa e soko moro amora. Wabiro mana luwo yor ruoth tir kendo ok wanagom yo korachwich kata koracham nyaka wakal pinyi duto.”
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

kikuyu: Eka Bildad ja-Shua nodwoko Ayub niya,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: Jo-Misri duto nokunyo bath aora Nael mondo giyud pi modho, nikech ne ok ginyal modho pi aorano.
english: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

kikuyu: To bende osemiye teko mondo ongʼad bura, nikech en e Wuod Dhano.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat makare olokore oweyo timbene mabeyo motimo richo, to obiro tho nikech timneno.
english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

kikuyu: Ok ne iwuotho e yoreni kendo iluwo timbeni mamono, to ne ikethori moloyogi mapiyo nono kuom timbeni duto mobam.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

kikuyu: Ne gin Maria nyar Magdala, gi Joana kod Maria min Jakobo, gi mon moko mane ni kodgi, ema nonyiso joote wachni.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

kikuyu: Wan wawegi ne wawinjo dwolno mane oa e poloni, kane wan kode ewi got maler.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

kikuyu: Kane Josef oneno Benjamin kani kodgi, nowacho ne jarit ode niya, “Kaw jogi iter oda, yangʼnegi chiayo kendo ilosnegi chiemo mondo gichiem koda sa auchiel.”
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, wanyalo paro ni ka ja-miriamboni ne pod ngima to nowacho ni, ‘Bangʼ ndalo adek to abiro chier kendo.’
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ne oyal Injili nyaka ni joma koro osetho, mondo eka obi ongʼadnegi bura, kaka nongʼad ni ji duto manie ringruok, to chunygi mondo obed mangima kaluwore gi dwaro Nyasaye.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wan kaachiel gi ruodhi mawa, gi yawuot ruodhi, kod wuonewa, wichkuot omakowa nikech waseketho e nyimi.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ Nea, tongʼno nochomo yo nyandwat mochopo nyaka Hanathon bangʼe to ogik e holo mar Ifta El.
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

kikuyu: Eka duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodar moa e dho hekalu mochungʼ ewi kerubigo gi yo ka malo.
english: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

kikuyu: Kane Haman oneno ni Modekai ok nyal goyone chonge piny kata miye luor, mirima nomake.
english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nopenjore niya, “Angʼo matimoreni! Jehova Nyasaye osekelowa ka ruodhi adekgi duto mondo ochiw-wa e lwet Moab?”
english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

kikuyu: Awachonu ni ooyo! To ka ok ulokoru uweyo richou, un duto unutho kamano.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

kikuyu: Fedha maromo kilo alufu adek mia angʼwen-go (3,400) notigo kuom loso rachungi mag kama ler mar lemo kod mag pasia, ka rachungi ka rachungi kawo kilo piero adek gangʼwen (34,000).
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Ruth nobet machiegni gi jotich Boaz ma nyiri kohulo nyaka chop keyo mar shairi gi mar ngano norumo. Kindeno duto Ruth nodak gi wuon odgi.
english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.

kikuyu: Jadolo matimone pwodhruok nokel ngʼat mipwodhono kaachiel gi misenginine mag pwodhruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo.
english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: To kuom hera maduongʼ mane Nyasaye oherowago kod kechne mogundho,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “Jolweny nokelogi koa kuom jo-Amalek; negiweyo rombe kod dhok mabeyo mondo gitimgo misango ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, to modongʼ wanego pep.”
english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to the LORD your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

kikuyu: Mad joma kalo bute kik wachnegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhi, kata ni, wagwedhi e nying Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Ewi godni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego biro loso nyasi mar chiemo mamiyo ne oganda duto, sawo mar divai mosekan, kod chiemo mabeyo gi divai molos maber.
english: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

kikuyu: nodoko mwandu mag Ibrahim e nyim jo-Hiti duto mane obiro kaka joneno e dhoranga dala.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Un mudak mabor, winjuru gima asetimo, un mudak machiegni ngʼeuru tekona!
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

kikuyu: Samuel notimo gima Jehova Nyasaye nowacho. Kane ochopo Bethlehem, to jodong dala ne luoro omako kane giromo kode. Negipenje niya, “Bende ibiro e yor kwe?”
english: Samuel did that which the LORD spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

kikuyu: kendo jaod Amram ne nyinge Jokebed, ma nyakwar Lawi, mane onywol ne jo-Lawi e Piny Misri. Amram nonywolo Harun, Musa kod nyamin-gi Miriam.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye enolok koth machwe e pinyu obed mana lo kod buru malich, gini olre koa e polo nyaka unurum.
english: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

kikuyu: Nochikogi kowacho niya, “Ma e gima nyaka utim: Achiel kuom adek maru matiyo chiengʼ Sabato nyaka rit kar dak ruoth.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

kikuyu: “Ka ucholo mond jo-Hibrania mi uneno ka onywolo nyathi ma wuowi, to negeuru, to ka en nyathi ma nyako, to kik unege.”
english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, Baasha wuod Ahija nodoko ruoth kuom Israel duto e Tirza kendo nobedo ruoth kuom higni piero ariyo gangʼwen.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Yahudi gi jo-Yunani mane odak Efeso nowinjo wachno luoro nomakogi, kendo nying Ruoth Yesu noyudo duongʼ.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

kikuyu: Aseneno gi wengena ka iloyo wasika kendo asewinjo gi itena ka joma oramona ma timbegi richo itieko.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Weche mane iwinjo kuoma, ritgi kaka ranyisi mar puonj maber, kod yie gihera kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kata ngʼat manie puodho bende kik dog dala mondo okaw kode.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

kikuyu: Ka udak e lowo mubiro yudo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu dwaro miyou mondo ukaw kaka girkeni maru, to kik ngʼato kuomu keth kiewo mane kwereu oketo e kind ngʼato gi wadgi.
english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that the LORD your God gives you to possess.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Haran, jo-Kanne, jo-Eden kod jo-ohala madongo moa Sheba gi Ashur kod Kilmad bende ne oloko kodi.
english: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gauchiel, Hanania gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Nowa ne ja-higni mia auchiel kane pi opongʼo piny.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Ka Nyasaye oyudo duongʼ kuome, eka Wuowi bende biro yudo duongʼ kuome, kendo obiro miye duongʼ sani sani.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

kikuyu: E kindeno Yesu noyudo kadho e kind puothe mag cham chiengʼ Sabato. To jopuonjrene nodenyo, omiyo negichako jako wi ngano moko mochiek mondo gicham.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

kikuyu: Diek mag bungu odak e gode maboyo, to lwendni morokore gin kuonde pondo mag aidha.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

kikuyu: Ok oluor kendo onge gima goye kibaji, kendo kata mana ligangla ok obadhrene.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

kikuyu: Ne omiyo nam opogore diere ariyo mi nomiyo gikadho kendo nomiyo pi ochungʼ molingʼ thi ka ohinga.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

kikuyu: Neye mudho okwako piny, kendo ogendini ni e mudho mandiwa, to Jehova Nyasaye oserieny kuomi kendo duongʼne osenenore kuomi.
english: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abiriyo losuru chokruok mowal kendo kik uti tijeu mapile. En odiechiengʼ mugoyoe turumbete.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

kikuyu: “Ubiro chando chunya nyaka karangʼo ka uchuoya gi weche?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

kikuyu: wuod Elkana, wuod Jeroham, wuod Eliel, wuod Toa,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

kikuyu: Ka jotend jo-Juda nowinjo wechegi, negia kar dak mar ruoth ma gidhi nyaka e od Jehova Nyasaye kendo negikawo keregi e kar donjo mar Dhorangach Manyien mar od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the LORD’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Ondiek kod rombo nokwa kaachiel, sibuor nocham lum mana kaka faras, to lowo ema nobed chiemb thuol. Onge gima ginikethi e godega duto maler,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jonywolgo nodwokogi niya, “Wangʼeyo ni ma en wuodwa, kendo wangʼeyo ni nonywole muofu.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

kikuyu: Wan gi nyaminwa moro matin, kendo thundene pok obedo madongo. Angʼo mwanyalo timone nyaminwa chiengʼ ma wuowi obiro dware?
english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka wuogi oko mar odno kendo olor odno kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

kikuyu: Jakobo nobedo machiegni gi wuon mare Isaka, mano mule kendo owachone niya, “Dwol to mar Jakobo, to lwedo to gin lwet Esau.”
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

kikuyu: To kane pok gikwangʼ mabor, yamb ahiti miluongo ni Yurakulo, nochako kudho matek koa e chulano.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mane loso koda nosudo machiegni mowachona niya, “Tingʼ wangʼi malo mondo ine gima bironi, ni en angʼo?”
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon noluongo jodong jo-Israel, jodong dhoudi duto gi jotend anywola mag Israel mondo odhi ire Jerusalem mondo gikel Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye koa e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi miluongo ni Sayun.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

kikuyu: Pogruokno nomedo kelo dhawo gi dwokruok makwiny, mi jaduongʼ jolweny nodoko maluor ni jogo ne nyalo kidho Paulo matindo tindo. Omiyo nogolo chik mondo jolweny ogol Paulo oko githuon e nyim bura, mondo odwoke ei kama jolweny nodakie.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negikawo keregi mapile kaka ondikie chike Musa ngʼat Nyasaye. Jodolo nokiro remo manomigi kod jo-Lawi.
english: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

kikuyu: Negiloso sirni auchiel ne bathe mochwalore mochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar Hemb Romo,
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

kikuyu: Jopuonj chik moko nodwoko niya, “Iwacho maber, japuonj.”
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

kikuyu: Yesu Kristo ok lokre en achiel, kawuono kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

kikuyu: Kane Apolo dwaro mondo odhi Akaya, jowete nojiwe mine gindiko baruwa ne jopuonjre man kuno mondo orwake maber. Kane ochopo kuno, nokelo konyruok mangʼeny ne joma noseyie kuom ngʼwono mar Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

kikuyu: Ginitingʼ dwondgi mi giywag malit nikech in; kendo ginibuk wiyegi gi buru ka gingʼielore e buru.
english: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye ne ok omiyowa chuny mar bedo ngoche, to nomiyowa chuny mar bedo gi teko, gihera kod ritruok.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Alush mi gibworo Refidim, kama ne onge pi ma ji ne nyalo modho.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Eka ne giwuoyo gi wuon mare gi lwetgi, mondo giyud ni en nying mane madoher luongogo nyathi.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye osemiyowa chik niya, “ ‘Asemiyo udoko ler ne Ogendini, mondo uland warruok e tunge piny duto.’”
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

kikuyu: Gol kuoma ajara gi achaya nimar arito chikeni.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

kikuyu: Kendo polo hulo timne makare, nikech Nyasaye owuon e jangʼad bura. Sela
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

kikuyu: to abich modongʼ oketi e bathe komachielo, to abich modongʼ nomako sirni mane omakgo katoke mochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar Hemb Romo.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

kikuyu: Joka Kohath ne gin: Amram, Izhar, Hebron gi Uziel.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Chunya bwok, denda tetni nikech luoro; gombo ma an-go mondo piny imre oselokorena masira.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

kikuyu: Ok ogol wangʼe oko kuom joma kare; oketogi e loch kaachiel gi ruodhi kendo otingʼogi malo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

kikuyu: koa kuom jo-Efraim: Hoshea wuod Azazia notelonegi; koa kuom nus mar dhood jo-Manase: Joel wuod Pedaya notelonegi;
english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

kikuyu: Eka malaike abiriyo mane nigi turumbete abiriyogo ne oikore goyogi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, reswa yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mi walochi.
english: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

kikuyu: Omiyo jogi duto nobed joma kare kendo piny nobed margi nyaka chiengʼ. Ginichal gi bad yath ma an ema apidho gi lweta awuon mondo omiya duongʼ.
english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

kikuyu: Koro, in minwa ma aluoro, akwayi ni mondo waherre ngʼato gi ngʼato; Chik ma andikonini ok en chik manyien; en mana chik mwasebedogo nyaka aa chakruok. Akwayo mondo waherre ngʼato ka ngʼato.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nopenje niya, “Nyingi ngʼa?” Nodwoke niya, “Nyinga Oganda, nikech wangʼeny.”
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

kikuyu: Singruok mane Nyasaye otimono en maru kaachiel gi nyithindu; kendo en mar ji duto modak kuma bor, ma gin jogo duto ma Ruoth Nyasachwa noluong ire.”
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

kikuyu: Kane orango ma oneno owadgi Benjamin, wuod min-gi hie, nopenjogi niya, “Ma e owadu ma chogo, mane uwachona wachne?” Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Nyasaye mad gwedhi wuoda.”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

kikuyu: Ruodh Jerusalem, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Hebron, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

kikuyu: Ringregi ne okel nyaka Shekem mine oyikgi e bur ma Ibrahim nosengʼiewo kuom yawuot Hamor man Shekem.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

kikuyu: Magi e yawuot Nowa kaluwore gi anywolagi e pinjegi. Kuomgi ema ogendini mopogore opogore nochakore bangʼ ataro.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

kikuyu: To angʼeyo ni ruodh Misri ok noyienu mondo udhi makmana kochune gi bat maratego.
english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Ne itimo maber ne piny, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; ne iduogone Jakobo mwandune.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

kikuyu: “Anatim ranyisi e kindgi kendo anaor jomoko manok ma notony mane pok owinjo humba kata mane pok oneno duongʼ mara maler ma gin: Tarshish, Libya, Lud (mongʼere gi nying mar jolweny mongʼeyo kedo gi asere), jo-Tubal kod jo-Yunani kaachiel gi joma odak e dho nembe man kuonde maboyo. Gibiro nyiso duongʼna e kind ogendini.
english: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “We janabi man-gi lek owach lekne, to we ngʼat man giwachna owache gadiera. Nimar en angʼo ma miudhwe nyalo timo gi cham?”
english: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: E ndalogo naneno jomoko e piny Juda kabiyo mzabibu milosogo divai chiengʼ Sabato kendo gikelo cham ka giketo e ngʼe punda, kaachiel gi divai, mzabibu, ngʼowu kod misike mopogore opogore. To negikelo gigi duto ei Jerusalem chiengʼ Sabato. Omiyo ne akwerogi ni kik gihon chiemo odiechiengʼno.
english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu noluongo gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Wuora, aketo chunya e lweti.” Kane osewacho mano, chunye nochot.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

kikuyu: Un joma terore! Donge ungʼeyo ni hero piny en chayo Nyasaye? Ngʼato angʼata moyiero e chunye mondo obed osiep piny doko jasik Nyasaye.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

kikuyu: Un e owetena kendo une remba. Marangʼo un ema dudongʼ chien kuom duogo ruoth?’
english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel mondo okelna chiwo. Inichokna chiwogo moro amora kuom ji duto moyie golo kuom herogi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nowuotho e pewe mag Moab mi gibworo e dho Aora Jordan momanyore gi Jeriko.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Chuny wiye oluny mi odongʼ rabondo, to oler.
english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

kikuyu: Donge girkeni maga osebedona ka kweth mag achudhe, ma achudhe mamoko lworo mondo okedgo? Dhi kendo ichok le mag bungu duto; kelgi mondo gikidh joga.
english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.

kikuyu: “Abiro puonji kaka teko Nyasaye chalo; ok abi pandoni yore mag Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ngʼatno mayiero chiengʼ mondo orieny godiechiengʼ, machiko dwe gi sulwe mondo orieny gotieno, mamiyo apaka mag nam ruto, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge:
english: The LORD, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar— the LORD of Armies is his name, says:

kikuyu: kendo e laini mar angʼwen ne gichane kite kaka krisolit gi oniks kod jaspa. Kidigo duto negichano kaka thiwni mag dhahabu.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

kikuyu: “Kuom higni auchiel unupur puotheu kendo unuka cham monyakie,
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

kikuyu: Timuru misengini mag lalruok kanyo, ka uchiemo kendo ubedo gi mor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi e Got Zeituni.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Kamano noketho mier madongogo gi pawno duto, kaachiel gi ji duto manodak e miergo kod gik moko duto manyak e lowo.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

kikuyu: To kata kamano kuomi nitiere weyo richo; kuom mano watiyoni gi luor.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

kikuyu: Magi e nyithind Bithia nyar Farao mane Mered okendo. Jaode ma nyar Juda to nonywolo Jered ma wuon Gedor, Heber nonywolo Soko, to Jekuthiel nonywolo Zanoa.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

kikuyu: Nikech wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ni kuom joma kare kendo ite winjo lamogi, to Jehova Nyasaye mon gi joma timo gik maricho.”
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noweye. (E kindeno ema Zipora nowachoe niya, “Wuon kisera mar remo,” ma tiende ni tero nyangu.)
english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

kikuyu: Negigolo lepgi piyo piyo ma gipedho ewi raidhi mondo Jehu owuothie. Eka negigoyo turumbete ka gigoyo koko niya, “Jehu en ruoth!”
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi chi ngʼama udakgo mokiewo, dipo ka omiyo ibedo mogak.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

kikuyu: Denguru un yiedhi moa Tarshish, nikech karu mochiel motegno osemuki!
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

kikuyu: kaachiel gi joode gi jood owetene kod jood wuon-gi. Nyithindo kod jamni gi dhok kende ema ne owe Goshen.
english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

kikuyu: Uparo ni koro adwaro pak moa kuom dhano? Ooyo, adwaro pak moa kuom Nyasaye. Koso uparo ni atemo moro dhano? Kane bed ni pod ne adwaro moro dhano, to dine ok abedo jatich Kristo.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

kikuyu: Sukano notingʼo kit le man-gi tiende angʼwen duto, kod le mamol duto mag piny kod koth winy duto mafuyo e kor polo.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Ka usepono mzabibu e puothu, kik uchak udog utengʼ yiendgi, to weuru modongʼne jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho.
english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

kikuyu: Koro Jeroboam ne en ngʼat momi luor kendo kane Solomon oneno kaka ngʼat matin-no timo tichne maber, nokete jatend jotich duto ma od Josef.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nowacho niya, “Kaka koro asebedo gi chir ma wuoyo gi Ruoth Nyasaye, angʼoma ditim ka ji piero ariyo ema oyudore e dalano?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Nikech ji piero ariyo maonge ketho ok anakethe.”
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

kikuyu: bende ne gin joma ruoth ogeno ahinya mane bet machiegni kode kaka Karshena, Shetha, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena gi Memukan, mane gin jodongo abiriyo mag Pasia gi Media mane nyalo donjo ir ruoth e sa asaya bende ne gin joma oluor kendo ogen e pinyruoth.
english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

kikuyu: Ok nodwogi e ode kendo; kar dakne ok nongʼeye kendo.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne ayudo ni dhako ma jachode rach moloyo, tho nimar chunye en obadho, to lwetene gin nyororo. Ngʼat moluoro Nyasaye notony e lwete, to jaricho to nokelne mana chandruok.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo ka Musa nosedoko ngʼama duongʼ to nodagi ni kik luonge ni wuod nyar Farao.
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

kikuyu: to nyaka liele makmana kama tuo nitiereno, kendo jadolo nyaka kete kare kende kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

kikuyu: E kindeno Saulo nochako sando kanisa kodonjo e ot ka ot kendo omako chwo gi mon moter e od twech.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

kikuyu: Nimar joma ne Nyasaye ongʼeyo chakre chon ema bende ne owalo mondo okaw kit Wuode, eka mondo odok nyathi makayo e kind jowetene mangʼeny.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

kikuyu: Atimo gima chikeni dwaro, nimar aherogi gihera maduongʼ.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

kikuyu: Omiyo wangʼ chiengʼ nochungʼ kar tiende, to dwe bende ne ok osudo, nyaka oganda mar jo-Israel nochulo kuor kuom wasikgi, mana kaka nondike e Kitap Jashar. Wangʼ chiengʼ nosiko kochungʼ e polo kuom thuolo madirom odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

kikuyu: Andikonu un wuone nikech ungʼeyo Jalno mane nitie nyaka aa chakruok. Andikonu, un jomatindo, nikech useloyo ngʼama rach.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

kikuyu: To kata kamano jo-Asher moko kod jo-Manase kaachiel gi jo-Zebulun nobolore modhi Jerusalem.
english: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano jo-Moab kod jo-Amon kaachiel gi jo-Meun moko nobiro mondo oked gi Jehoshafat.
english: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negidhawo gi Musa kagiwacho niya, “Miwa pi wamodhi.” To Musa nodwokogi niya “En angʼo momiyo udhawo koda? En angʼo momiyo uketo Jehova Nyasaye e tem?”
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jonabi kod jodolo ok oluoro Nyasaye; kata mana ei hekalu mara ayudoe timbegi maricho.”
english: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane Elija owinje noumo wangʼe gi law abola mowuok oko kochungʼ e dho rogo. Eka dwol nowuoyo kode kawacho niya, “En angʼo mitimo ka Elija?”
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni Yesu nosetimo honnigo duto ka gineno gi wengegi, to pod ne gidagi mana yie kuome.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

kikuyu: “Kar dier odiechiengʼ tir kane achiegni chopo Damaski, ne apo ka ler mangʼangʼni moa e polo nomenya molwora.
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

kikuyu: To ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi, omiyo ne oketo mudho e kindu gi jo-Misri; mi nam oimogi. Ne uneno gima ne atimone jo-Misri. Bangʼ mano nudak e thim kuom ndalo marabora.
english: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

kikuyu: Kane ochak ochan nyiri mabeyogi kendo Modekai noyudo obet e dhoranga ruoth.
english: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.

kikuyu: Ka itamori weyo joga mondo odhi, to abiro kelo ongogo e pinyi kiny.
english: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

kikuyu: To e ndalo mag keyo, nyaka umi Farao achiel kuom abich. To angʼwen ewi abich modongʼ unyalo kano kaka kodhi kendo kaka chiembu gi nyithindu kod joodu duto.”
english: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

kikuyu: ei hekalu mara, anami nying-gi bedo rapar moloyo bedo gi yawuowi kod nyiri; bende anamigi nying ma ok norum nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone Ahija ni kel Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye mane jo-Israel nigo e kindeno.
english: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.

kikuyu: “Jotij wuon puodho nobiro ire mowachone ni, ‘Jaduongʼ, donge ne ikomo kodhi mabeyo lilo e puothi? Ka kamano to buya to oa kure?’
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

kikuyu: Omiyo neguru yawuowi duto. Kendo uneg dhako moro amora moseriwore gi dichwo,
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Kaponi obiro apoya nono to kik oyudi kinindo.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

kikuyu: “To kane ruoth obiro mondo one welo, wangʼe norado gi ngʼat moro kanyo mane ok orwako lep arus.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye ok winj jaricho. Owinjo mana ngʼatno matimo dwarone.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

kikuyu: To usejwangʼa mutiyone nyiseche mamoko, omiyo koro ok anachak aresu.
english: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

kikuyu: ka Finehas wuod Eliazar, ma wuod Harun, ne jadolo mare.) Negipenjo niya, “Bende wanyalo kedo gi Benjamin ma owadwa, koso kik watim kamano?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwokogi niya, “Dhiuru kinyne anachiwgi e lwetu.”
english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” The LORD said, “Go up; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand.”

kikuyu: Jowetena, akwayou mondo uyie gi wach ma ajiwougoni nikech andikonu mana baruwa machwok kende.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyime nyaka yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Beth Araba mochopo nyaka Araba.
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

kikuyu: kendo ni ngʼato angʼata ma ok opodho piny auma mondo olam kidono to ibiro dir e mach makakni.
english: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.

kikuyu: Nimar makati ma Nyasaye chiwo en Jal malor koa e polo kendo ochiwo ngimane ni piny.”
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

kikuyu: Ilwora koni gi koni mi iketa diere; adier, iseuma duto gi lweti.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

kikuyu: Nokiro remono kuom Hemb Romo kendo kuom gimoro amora mane itiyogo e lemo machalre kamano.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

kikuyu: Koro sani, chungʼuru ka, mondo anyisu ratiro kendo aparnu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye timbe duto makare mane otimonu kaachiel gi wuoneu.
english: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before the LORD concerning all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom Jehoyakim ruodh Juda: Ok nobed gi ngʼama bedo e kom duongʼ Daudi; ringre nowit oko kendo nomo oko ne liet mar odiechiengʼ kendo ne thoo mar otieno.
english: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

kikuyu: Kane Baasha owinjo mano, nochungo gero Rama kendo nojwangʼo tije.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

kikuyu: Kapo ni ngʼat morwakore gi lewni mabeyo ema umiyo luor, kuwachone niya, “Eri, kaw kom maberni ema ibedie,” to ngʼat modhier to unyiso niya, “In chungʼ chien kucha,” kata niya, “Bedi piny e lowo e tienda ka,”
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

kikuyu: To jogo nokwere kawacho niya, “Wiyi rach!” Ka nyakono nomedo ramo ni Petro ne ni e dhoot adier, negiwachone niya, “Mano nyaka bedi mana malaikane!”
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

kikuyu: E dwe mar aboro, e higa mar ariyo mar loch Darius, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni janabi Zekaria wuod Berekia, ma wuod Ido, kawacho niya,
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

kikuyu: Aserwenyo ka rombo molal, omiyo yie imany jatichni, nimar wiya pok owil gi chikeni.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, Turo ogoyo mahu kuom Jerusalem kama: Dhorangeye mag ogendini osekethore, kendo dhoudi mage koro oyaworena malach; mi odongʼ gunda, omiyo koro abiro dhi maber.
english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

kikuyu: Kel yawuote kendo irwaknegi kandho
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Ngʼat masando jochan nyiso achaya ne Jal mane ochweyogi, to ngʼato angʼata mangʼwon ni jogo mochando miyo Nyasaye luor.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

kikuyu: Kane oa e lamo mi odok ir jopuonjre, noyudogi ka ginindo, ka giol kendo ka gin gikuyo.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

kikuyu: Nitie richo ma aseneno e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ, ketho moro mawuok kuom jatelo:
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye notingʼa malo mokela nyaka e dhoranga od Jehova Nyasaye mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. E dhorangach kanyo, ne nitie ji piero ariyo gabich, to ji ariyo kuomgi ne gin Jazania wuod Azur kod Pelatia wuod Benaya, mane gin jotend ji.
english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

kikuyu: “Unune malit nikech uchalo gi liete moumore ma ji wuotho kuomgi ka ok gingʼeyo.”
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

kikuyu: Un ema umiyo atimora kaka ngʼama ofuwo. To joma onego opwoya gin un, nikech kata ka achalo ngʼama ofuwo kamano, to joote mudhialo ni lichgo ok oloya kata matin.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

kikuyu: Gik marichogi duto wuok e chuny dhano kendo miyo ngʼato bedo mogak.”
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “Donge an ja-Benjamin, oganda matin ahinya ei Israel, to donge dhoodwa bende e dhoot matin, moloyo ei oganda mar Benjamin? Angʼo momiyo iwacho wechegi kuoma?”
english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

kikuyu: Rita adimba kaka tong wangʼi, panda e bwo tipo mar bwombi,
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie ji angʼwen ma jodhoho, mane bet e dhoranga dala maduongʼ. Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo dwabed ka nyaka watho?
english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

kikuyu: Nikech ne oyudo luor kod duongʼ kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kane dwol obirone moa e Duongʼ Mamalo Moloyo, kawacho niya, “Ma e Wuoda mahero, en ema chunya mor kode!”
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Eka nogoyonegi ngero machalo kama: “Onge ngʼama nyalo yiecho dir law manyien mondo obawgo mano moti. Ka otimo kamano, to obiro bedo ni oyiecho law manyien, kendo dir law manyien mobawgo law moti ok bi winjore gi moti.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oseyawo kare mar kano gige lweny, kendo ogolo gige mag lweny mag mirimbe, nimar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto kendo Maratego nigi tich monego ti e piny jo-Babulon.
english: The LORD has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Eka gima Jeremia janabi nowacho niya, “Negikawo pesa mamingli mag fedha moromo piero adek, mane en nengo mane jo-Israel oketone,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

kikuyu: Duongʼ odogne ndalo duto manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata matiyona nyaka luwa, kendo kama antie ema jatichna bende nobedie. Ngʼat matiyona Wuora biro miyo duongʼ.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Petro gi japuonjre machielono nowuok modhi kama noyike.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

kikuyu: Wamulo kor udi mana ka muofni, kendo wamulo kuonde ma wawuothe, mana ka joma onge wengegi. Wachwanyore godiechiengʼ, mana ka gima en otieno kendo wachalo joma otho e kind joma rateke.
english: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

kikuyu: Ngʼat matimo kinda kiteme en ngʼat mogwedhi, nikech kochungʼ motegno mi oloyo temno, to obiro yudo osimbo mar ngima, ma Nyasaye osesingore ni nomi joma ohere.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

kikuyu: Nowuok Nazareth modhi odak Kapernaum, mane ni e dho nam e gwengʼ mar Zebulun gi Naftali,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

kikuyu: Soko Jakobo ne ni kanyo, kendo Yesu ne koro ool gi wuoth, omiyo nobet piny e dir sokono. Ne en kar sa auchiel mar odiechiengʼ.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

kikuyu: kendo dimi jotichni mi wuon-gi chuny lit ma otho ka en gi kuyo to oseti.
english: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, to yudore ni ja-Kristo donjo ne ja-Kristo wadgi e od bura kendo utimo mano e buch jopiny!
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

kikuyu: Jo-Israel gi jo-Juda osechwanya gi timbegi duto mamono magisetimo, gin ruodhi mag-gi kod jotelo, jodolo kod jonabi mag-gi, joma chwo mag Juda kod Jerusalem.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Emomiyo sunga chalonegi thiwni mar ngʼut, kendo girwako mahundu ka law.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

kikuyu: To Anania nodwoko niya, “Ruoth, asewinjo weche mangʼeny kuom ngʼatno, gi timbene maricho mosebedo kotimo ni jogi maler modak Jerusalem.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: wuog ane e msalaba ilor piny kendo iresri kendi ane!”
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruoth Yesu Kristo, gihera mar Nyasaye Wuoro, gi lalruok mar Roho Maler obed kodu un duto.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: “ ‘Omiyo ligangla ema koro iyweyo mondo ochak tich, ipiage kendo iyweye mondo okete e lwet janek.
english: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’

kikuyu: Wuo kendo ngʼad bura kare, chwak ratich jogo ma jochan kod jogo mochando.
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

kikuyu: Negidonjo gi le duto mag buya kaka kitgi obet, jamni duto kaka kitgi obet, gik mangima duto mamol e lowo kaka kitgi obet, kod kit winy duto kaka kitgi obet, gimoro amora man-gi bwombene.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo itamo lweti tiyo tichne, mana lweti ma korachwich? Gole oko kama isoye ei lepi mondo itiekgi!
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

kikuyu: Umadho chak, urwakoru gi yie rombe kendo uyangʼo chiayo machwe mabeyo mondo ucham, to ok urit rombe.
english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi chi owadgi, to mano en dwanyruok nikech oelo dug owadgi, kendo ok giniyud nyithindo.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

kikuyu: Pok abaro aweyo chikeni, nimar in iwuon ema isepuonja.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

kikuyu: Chunya ywago Moab mana kaywak mar nyatiti, kendo chunya ma iye ywago Kir Hareseth.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Ngʼato angʼata mochiwo misango mar lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka kel migawo mar misango kaka chiwo mare ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

kikuyu: Jogo mane opondo bende nowuok oko mar dala maduongʼ moromo kodgi kendo omonjogi, omiyo nogengʼnegi e diere ka jo-Israel ni koni gi koni. Jo-Israel notiekogi pep maonge ngʼama notony kata achiel.
english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

kikuyu: Ere mayot wacho kuom weche ariyogi, ‘Richoni oweni,’ koso wacho ni, ‘Aa malo mondo iwuothi’?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

kikuyu: Zaburi mar goyo erokamano. Gouru koko gi mor ne Jehova Nyasaye, un piny duto.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

kikuyu: Wachni nomiyo jo-Yahudi oramo ni nyaka ginege, nimar negineno ni ok Sabato kende ema noketho, to bende noluongo Nyasaye ni Wuon-gi, manyiso ni ne oketore ni orom gi Nyasaye.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

kikuyu: Kane osetieko wuoyo, nowito chok lemb punda; kendo kanyo nochaki ni Ramath Lehi.
english: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.

kikuyu: nyikwa Hashum, ji mia ariyo gi piero ariyo gadek (223),
english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Ajuoke ne ok nyal chungʼ e nyim Musa nikech buche mane ni kuomgi kaachiel gi jo-Misri duto.
english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Petro nopenje niya, “Nyisa ane ka bende ma e nengo mane Anania oyudo kuom puodho manende oloko pesa?” Safira nodwoke niya, “Ee, mano e nengone.”
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

kikuyu: Joma iyiero gin joma ogwedhi, jogo ma ikelo machiegni mondo odag e hekalu mari! Gik mabeyo mowuok e odi oromowa chuth, mana gigo moa e hekalu mari maler.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

kikuyu: Kane gisewuotho otieno duto ka gia Gilgal, Joshua nomonjogi apoya.
english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

kikuyu: Timni makare chalo gi gode madongo, ratiro mari chalo gi kut matut. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in ema irito ngima dhano gi le.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

kikuyu: Kuom mano chik ok nyal tiyo, kendo adiera ok nenre. Joma richo olworo joma kare, kuom mano adiera ok nyal betie.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone niya, “Chungi kendo idhi, yieni osemiyo ibedo mangima.”
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa Manase ne gin: koa kuom Makir, joka Makir (Makir ne en wuod Gilead); koa kuom Gilead, joka Gilead.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu odonjo Jerusalem to dala duto ne iye osakni kendo ji nopenjore kendgi niya, “Ma to ngʼa?”
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

kikuyu: Kane ngʼatni owinjo ni Yesu osechopo Galili koa Judea, nodhi ire mosaye mondo odhi ochang wuode mane chiegni tho.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

kikuyu: Nyaka ubed maonge ketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Ne ok oweyo ngima mar chode mane ochako kapod en Misri, kuma ne chwo teroree kode kane pod otin, kendo nodwanyo ringrene mane pod silili, kendo nochopo gombo duto mag ringregi kuome.
