english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.

kikuyu: Ne adhi Jerusalem, kendo bangʼ kane asetieko ndalo adek kanyo,
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

kikuyu: Mano to ngʼa mabiro koa e piny motimo ongoro machalo ka iro madhwolore, mowirore gi modhi mangʼwe ngʼar, kendo molosi gi gik madungʼ mangʼwe ngʼar mag jo-ohala madongo?
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant?

kikuyu: Nyasaye nomiyo yawuowi angʼwen-go, ngʼeyo gi lony mar winjo tiend kit ndiko duto gi puonjruok. Kendo Daniel ne nigi rieko matut mar loko tiend fweny ka fweny kod lek ka lek.
english: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

kikuyu: Ruoth gi jogo duto mane en godo mane owinjo wechegi ne ok obedo gi luoro moro, kata lepgi ne ok giyiecho.
english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.

kikuyu: Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni abiro tiyou gi tekona duto gi mirimba mager.
english: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

kikuyu: Ka ja-Hibrania wadu madichwo kata madhako ochiwore mondo ingʼiewe kendo otini kuom higni auchiel, to e higa mar abiriyo nyaka iweye obed thuolo.
english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye ne ok oyierowa mondo wayud kum mar mirimbe mager, to noyierowa mondo wayud warruok kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Kanuru pi ka kinde mar agengʼa pok ochopo, meduru keto ohinga obed motegno! Nywasuru lowo kendo chweyeuru motegno, mondo matafarego ugergo kuonde momukore mag ohinga obed motegno!
english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

kikuyu: Jaduongʼno nowachonegi niya, “Orwaku e oda. We amiu gimoro amora ma udwaro. To kik unind e laru mar dala maduongʼni.”
english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

kikuyu: “Ma e lowo monego ipogi ni dhout Israel kaka girkeni margi, kendo lowo mopogne dhoot ka dhoot ema nobed margi.” Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Gin gi lwetegi, to ok ginyal mulo, kendo gin gi tiende to ok ginyal wuotho, bende ok ginyal kata temo loso gi dwondgi.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

kikuyu: Nochungʼ e kind joma ngima gi joma otho, mi masiche norumo.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

kikuyu: Nimar awachonu, ok anachame kendo ngangʼ, nyaka chop time e pinyruodh Nyasaye.”
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Kik chunyi thagre ka ngʼato mwandune medore, kata ka duongʼ mar ode medore;
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

kikuyu: Yawuot Merari ne gin: Mali kod Mushi. Yawuot Mali ne gin: Eliazar kod Kish.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

kikuyu: Dhood joka Reuben nowuok bangʼ-gi ka gin e bwo bandechgi, kotelnegi gi Elizur wuod Shedeur.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

kikuyu: Omiyo kata kane andikonu, to ne ok en nikech wach ngʼat mane otimo marach, kata nikech joma notimnigi marach, to ne andikonu mondo, e nyim Nyasaye, uneye kaka ugenowa.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

kikuyu: piny noyiengni kendo polo noolo koth e piny, e nyim Nyasaye, Jal man Sinai, e nyim Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: gi nyiroke kaachiel gi boche mogawogi man but oguro, kod jwala mabor man ewi chuny nogol oko kaachiel gi nyiroke.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: ni kata obedo ni joma timbegi richo nyalo loth kaka lum kendo joricho nyalo dhi maber, to ibiro tiekgi chuth nyaka chiengʼ.
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

kikuyu: Chakuru wer, yiekuru oyieke; gweluru nyatiti gi asili mamit.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

kikuyu: Kendo kane jodong Farao oneno Sarai, negiwuoro berne ne Farao kendo nokawe motere kar dak ruoth.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Winji gima Jehova Nyasaye wachoni, yaye od Israel.
english: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, house of Israel!

kikuyu: To pogri gi mbekni mofuwo gi sigendini mag anywola gi mino wach kod dhawo kuom weche mag chike, nikech gik ma kamago ok kel konyruok kendo gionge tich.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

kikuyu: ne En mane oparowa ka piny ochamowa, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Nikech bedo gi gombo mar yudo gik malangʼ, jopuonj mag miriambogo noywau gi sigendini magiseloso mag miriambo malombo ji; mondo gimau mwandu. To kum margi mane oiknegi chakre chon ritogi, kendo kethruokgi ok nodeki ma ok ochoponegi.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno min-gi gi japuonjre ma nohero kochungʼ machiegni kanyo, nowachone min-gi niya, “Mama, neye wuodi!”
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

kikuyu: Ok ne abiro mondo aluong joma kare, to nabiro mondo aluong joricho mondo gilokre giwe richo.”
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

kikuyu: Eka joma noyud kotony e Sayun kod Jerusalem noluong ni jomaler, ma gin kar romb ji duto moyud kangima e Jerusalem
english: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Gone koko kuonde duto! Otingʼo bade kanyiso ni oloye, kuondene mag ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo podho, ohinga mage imuko. Nikech ma e chulo kuor mar Jehova Nyasaye, chulneuru kuor; timneuru kaka osetimo ni joma moko.
english: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of the LORD. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.

kikuyu: kendo noketo teyni kuome e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kane Efraim owuoyo, to ji ne tetni, nodhiale e piny Israel. To notimo richo kuom lamo Baal, mi notho.
english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

kikuyu: Omedo dhi nyime gi timo richo koyanyo Nyasaye e nyim ogandane, kendo omedo wuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye.”
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoko niya, “Abiro timo gima uneno ni bernu.” Omiyo ruoth nochungʼ but rangach sa ma ne oganda lweny duto ne wuok e migepegi mag miche gi mag alufe.
english: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.

kikuyu: Kuom mano wachnegi ni: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: ‘Dwoguru ira,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho. ‘Eka an bende anaduog iru,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho kamano.
english: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ne oyieronwa girkeni marwa, gik mabeyo mogik ne Jakobo mane ohero. Sela
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

kikuyu: Kendo ogwedh Nying Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo mane oketo wasiki e lweti.” Eka Abram nomiye achiel kuom apar mar gik moko duto.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Minwa kod owetena gin jogo mawinjo wach Nyasaye kendo timo.”
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma wito muofu e yo.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Maskil mar Daudi. Kane noyudo Doeg ja-Edom nosedhi ir Saulo kendo onyise niya, “Daudi osedhi e od Ahimelek.” Angʼo momiyo isungori kuom tim marach, yaye ngʼat maratego? Angʼo momiyo isungori odiechiengʼ duto, in ma in gir wichkuot e nyim Nyasaye?
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny, Nebushazban ma jatelo maduongʼ, Negal-Shareza ma jatelo mamalo kod jotelo duto mag ruodh Babulon
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

kikuyu: Adek kuom jotelo piero adek madongo nobiro ir Daudi e lwanda manie rogo man Adulam ka jolweny mag jo-Filistia to nojot e holo mar Refaim.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Nyithindo, winjuru jonywolu kuom Ruoth nikech timo kamano en gima kare.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

kikuyu: An Paulo ema andikonu mosni gi lweta awuon, en kido maketo e barupena duto kendo mano e kaka andiko.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

kikuyu: Dho ngʼat makare en soko mar ngima, to timbe mahundu opongʼo dho ngʼat marach.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek e chunye rwako chike, to ngʼat mofuwo ma wachne ngʼeny dhi e kethruok.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Ne opure maber mogolo kite duto manie iye kendo opidhoe olembe mabeyo ahinya moyier. Ne ogero kama otingʼore gi malo mar ngʼicho e chuny puodhono bende noloso kama ibiyoe mzabibu. Eka nomanyo olembe mabeyo to kata kamano neginyago mana olembe maricho.
english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo en gi teko maduongʼ. Jehova Nyasaye ok nowe joketho ma ok okumo. Yore moluwo ni ei kalausi gi ahiti, bende boche polo gin buch tiende.
english: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

kikuyu: kata ka gimoro otimore ma chwore ochich kode. Jadolo nokete ochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyaka oket chikni ne dhakoni.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

kikuyu: Giramo ni nyaka to gigole oko kama entie e duongʼne; miriambo ema morogi. Dhogi gigwedhogo ji, to gi ei chunygi to gikwongʼo ji. Sela
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Aonge gi dichwo.” Yesu nowachone niya, “In kare kuom wacho ni ionge gi dichwo.
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

kikuyu: Eka ne ooro jatend jolweny kaachiel gi jolweny piero abich ir Elija. Jatelono nodhi ir Elija moyude kobet piny ewi got kendo nowachone niya, “Ngʼat Nyasaye, ruoth owacho ni mondo ilor piny!”
english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, isefwenyo ni jatichni wechegi kiwacho ni, ‘Abiro geroni ot.’ Omiyo jatichni osebet gi chir mar lami gi lemoni.
english: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

kikuyu: abiro konyo jogo man-gi lit Sayun, kendo gik mabiro miyogi e magi: ketonegi maua mabeyo kar buru magi bukorego, kendo mor kar lit ma gin-go, kendo chiwo lewni mag pak kar chuny mool. Enoluong-gi ni yiend ober mag tim makare, mopidh gi Jehova Nyasaye, konyiso godo duongʼne.
english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.

kikuyu: Omiyo odiechiengno negichako Gideon ni Jerub-Baal, kagiwacho niya, “We Baal otiek kode,” nikech nomuko kendo mar misango mar Baal.
english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

kikuyu: Janabi Gad nowachone Daudi niya, “We dak kar pondo, dhi e piny Juda.” Omiyo Daudi nowuok modhi e bungu man Hereth.
english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

kikuyu: Jolwenj ruodh Babulon ne monjo Jerusalem, kendo Jeremia janabi ne otwe e agola moriti e kar dak mar ruodh Juda.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

kikuyu: Cham chiemono mana kaka dicham kek mar shairi, kendo tede e nyim ji ka gineni, kitiyo gi oko dhano kaka owuoyo.”
english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

kikuyu: Nogwedhu gi nyithindo mangʼeny gi cham mogundho kod jamni mathoth ma gin kweth mag nyiroye kod mag nyirombe.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

kikuyu: Aristarko motweyago e od twech ooronu mos, kaachiel gi Mariko ma owad gi Barnaba. (Usewinjo wachne, omiyo kobiro to urwake.)
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

kikuyu: Joma odhier moloyo e kind jodhier noyud kuonde kwath kendo joma ochando noywe gi kwe. To kothi natiek gi kech, kendo kejno noneg joma nok modongʼ kuomi.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo gabiriyo mar Asa ruodh Juda, Zimri nobedo ruodh Tirza kuom ndalo abiriyo. Jolweny nogoyo kambi but Gibethon e dala mar jo-Filistia.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

kikuyu: Nodhi e dala wuon mare man Ofra kendo nonego owetene piero abiriyo, ma gin yawuot Jerub-Baal ewi lwanda achiel. To Jotham, ma wuod Jerub-Baal ma chogo, nopondo motony.
english: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

kikuyu: Joma ohero Jehova Nyasaye mondo osin gi gik maricho nimar orito ngima joge ma jo-adiera, kendo oresogi e lwet joma richo.
english: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

kikuyu: “Wachnegi kama: ‘Ka ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak manie diergi otimo misango miwangʼo pep, kata misango moro amora,
english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

kikuyu: Donge Ndiko wacho ni Kristo biro aa e anywola joka Daudi, kendo ni obiro aa Bethlehem, dala mane Daudi odakie?”
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

kikuyu: Ketgi e Hemb Romo e nyim Sandug Rapar, kama aromoe kodi.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

kikuyu: “Makmana jothuru pod wacho ni, ‘Yore mag Ruoth Nyasaye ok nikare!’ To chutho yoregi ema onge adiera.
english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

kikuyu: Jower ne gin: nyikwa Asaf, ji mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gaboro (148).
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

kikuyu: Musa nolor koa e got kotingʼo kite ariyo mag Rapar e lwete kendo kitego nondik koni gi koni.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

kikuyu: “Ywagruok biro bedo kanyono, kod mwodo lak, ka uneno Ibrahim, Isaka gi Jakobo gi jonabi duto manie pinyruoth Nyasaye to un uwegi nowitu oko.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

kikuyu: Jo-Babulon nomuko sirni mag mula, rachungi mag taya kod Karaya Maduongʼ mar mula mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne gitero mulago duto nyaka Babulon.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

kikuyu: kendo Ahija nokawo law mane orwako moyieche nyadipar gariyo.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

kikuyu: Jomatindo ema thiro joga kendo mon ema jotendgi. Yaye joga, jotendu osewuondou, momiyo ubaro uweyo yo.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kor wach kuom Gog, kendo iwach ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi, in Gog, ruoth maduongʼ moloyo mar Meshek gi Tubal.
english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo kogwen, malaika nojiwo Lut, kawacho niya, “Tim piyo kaw chiegi gi nyigi ariyo man kae, nono to ubiro rumo ka dala maduongʼni iketho.”
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

kikuyu: Wach mopondoni en ni kaluwore gi Injili, joma ok jo-Yahudi bende koro osebedo jocham girkeni kaachiel gi Israel, ka gin kaachiel kaka ringruok achiel, kendo giriwore kodwa e singruokni kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

kikuyu: Nodwoko ngʼatno niya, “Minwa to en ngʼa, koso owetena to gin ngʼa gini?”
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

kikuyu: “Mano kaka unune malit un joma odak maber e Sayun, kod un joma nigi geno ni gode mag Samaria nyalo resogi, kaachiel gi un joma omi luor mag oganda maduongʼ, ma jo-Israel dhi irgi mondo oyud konyruok!
english: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ja-mahundu wuondo jabute mi otere e yorno ma ok ber.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

kikuyu: Jogi to yanyo gimoro amora ma ok gingʼeyo to gik ma giketore ni gingʼeyo mana kaka le maonge rieko nyalo timo, mago e gik mabiro tiekogi.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

kikuyu: Eka ne udwoko niya, “Wasetimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Wabiro aa malo kendo kedo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa ochikowa.” Omiyo ji duto norwako gige lweny ka giparo ni en gima yot monjo piny godeno.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Atingʼo jo-Babulon malo, en oganda maonge gi ngʼwono kendo mager, gin oganda mayweyo piny duto kendo gikawo kuonde dak ma ok mekgi.
english: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

kikuyu: Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ne owe e od Obed-Edom ja-Giti kuom dweche adek, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nogwedhe gi ode duto.
english: The LORD’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyonegi, jaote nochopo ire. Kendo ruoth nowachone niya, “Masirani oa mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo onge tiende medo geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ruto koa Sayun, kendo dwonde mor koa Jerusalem; lege ma jokwath kwayoe two, kendo wi got Karmel mosebedo ka ngʼich koro ner.”
english: He said: “The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”

kikuyu: Harun nogo ombulu e kind diek ariyogo, kendo diel achiel biro bedo mar Jehova Nyasaye to machielo nobed mar bungu.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

kikuyu: Abiro biro mondo anyis ji timbeni madongo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto; abiro nyiso ji timni makare, timni makare in kendi.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Izhar noyier Kenania kod yawuote manomi tije oko mar hekalu kaka jotelo kendo jongʼad bura e piny Israel.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼni ok nobednu agulu, to un bende ok nubed ringʼo e iye. Abiro kelonu chandruok e tongʼ duto mag Israel.
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny ne wuotho kod Yesu, eka nolokore irgi mowachonegi niya,
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

kikuyu: Kane un wasumbini mag richo, ne un thuolo korka tim makare.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

kikuyu: Kane Abram owinjo ni watne oseter e twech, noluongo jotichge machwo motiegore mia adek gapar gaboro kendo olawogi nyaka Dan.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

kikuyu: Kane Amasa odhi luongo jo-Juda nokawo ndalo mangʼeny moloyo ndalo mane ruoth omiye.
english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

kikuyu: Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, chik iti ni lamona ma adwarogo kony; kik idin iti ne ywakna, nikech adak kodi mana ka japiny moro, an mana wendo kaka kwerena duto ne gin.
english: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

kikuyu: Kata ka udoko moti ma wiu otimo lwar, to pod An mana en, An ema abiro tingʼou mi aresu.
english: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

kikuyu: “Kik ilam ne jogi kata chiwonegi kwayo moro amora kata sayonegi, nikech ok anawinji ka gibiro ira e seche mag masira.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ gi dwe nolokre mudho, kendo sulwe ok nochak orieny.
english: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

kikuyu: Nyakono nowachone chi Naaman niya, “Ka dipo ni ruodha ne nyalo dhi ir janabi modak Samaria, to donge ne onyalo change kuom dhohone.”
english: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Agripa nowacho ni Festo niya, “Ngʼatni dine wagonyo thuolo ka dine bed ni pok okwayo mondo otere e nyim Kaisar.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

kikuyu: Joma nyap ne abedonegi manyap eka alokgi. Asetimora gimoro amora ni ji duto mondo atem reso moko kuomgi e yo moro amora manyalore.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

kikuyu: “Japuonj, chik maduongʼ mogik kuom Chike en mane?”
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

kikuyu: Usi momin molier e riak lepugo nomi unupar chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye, mondo omi uritgi ma ok uteroru gi gombo mag chunjeu kod wengeu uwegi.
english: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

kikuyu: Eka ne giywak gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Nyaka karangʼo ma ibiro ngʼado bura ni joma odak e piny ka ichulo kuor kuom rembwa, yaye Ruoth Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, in miler kendo ja-adiera?”
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

kikuyu: Jeroboam noparo kende owuon mowacho niya, “Loch nyalo dok e lwet dhood Daudi.
english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

kikuyu: Koa yo wuok chiengʼ, migepe mag joka Juda nodag kanyo kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi. Jatend Juda ne en Nashon wuod Aminadab.
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ubiro neno malit, un nyithindo ma wigi tek, un jogo mosieko gi riekni ma ok maga, ka uloso riwruok ka ok owuok e dwond Roho mara, kendo ka ubiwo richo ewi richo;
english: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says the LORD, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;

kikuyu: Openjo niya, Donge jotenda duto gin ruodhi?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

kikuyu: mi dipo chunya nogombo lingʼ-lingʼ kendo ne atingʼonegi bada ka agombo lamogi,
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

kikuyu: Gima omiyo notimo kamano en nikech ji duto mane oa Misri; ma gin jogo mahikgi noromo kedo e lweny, notho e thim ka gisewuok gia Misri.
english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ka ring misango mar lalruok ocham chiengʼ mar adek, to misangono ok noyiego. Bende Nyasaye ok nokwan misangono ka gima ber, nimar en gima kwero, kendo ngʼama ochame nobed jaricho.
english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: “Wuon mare nowacho niya, ‘Wuoda, in koda ndalo duto, kendo gik moko duto ma an-go gin magi.
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

kikuyu: Mad ji duto madwaro ketho ngimana wigi kuodi kendo pachgi olal; mad ji duto ma chunygi gombona tho oriemb kadok gi wich okuot.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

kikuyu: Koro un yawuota winjauru, chikuru itu ne gima awacho.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Jadolo nochiw winyo machielo modongʼ kaka misango miwangʼo pep e yo ma chik dwaro kendo mondo opwodhego kuom richo mosetimo mi nowene.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Nimar Daudi nosewacho niya, “Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel osemiyo joge yweyo kendo osebiro mondo odag Jerusalem nyaka chiengʼ,
english: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

kikuyu: Umonjo monde joga kendo uriembogi e miechgi mabeyo. Umayogi chuth gweth ma asegwedhogo nyithindgi.
english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

kikuyu: To kaka nongʼeyo gima negiwacho, Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uwacho ni uonge gi makati? Kare pok uneno kata wach pok odonjonu? Dipo ni chunyu odinore?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

kikuyu: Negiwuok Sukoth mi gibworo Etham, mantiere e bath thim.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Isedino pachgi mondo kik gifweny adiera; omiyo ok ibi yie mondo gibed joloch.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

kikuyu: Ere kaka dwago ne Nyasaye erokamano nikech un ma dirom gi mor duto ma umiyo wamorgo e nyim Nyasaye?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

kikuyu: “Biuru mondo ukonya monjo Gibeon nikech oseloso kwe kod Joshua gi jo-Israel.”
english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Weuru ngʼado bura kuom gik muneno gioko, to ngʼaduru bura makare.”
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

kikuyu: Kane sa ochopo mondo onywolie, nofwenyo ni en kod rude ma yawuowi e iye.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

kikuyu: Ot mane ngʼiyore gi laru mar hekalu gi yo podho chiengʼ ne lachne oromo fut mia achiel gabich. Ohinga molworo odno ne lachne oromo fut abiriyo gi nus; to borne noromo fut mia achiel gi piero adek gabich.
english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

kikuyu: Gouru tung im ka dwe manyien ochakore, ma en ka dwe osetegno, e odiechiengʼ mar Nyasiwa mogen.
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye iye nowangʼ gi jo-Israel mi nogologi e nyime. Dhood joka Juda kende ema ne odongʼ,
english: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom ndalo abiriyogo duto mag sawo, machakore e dwe mar abiriyo, chiengʼ tarik apar gabich, nyaka ochiw gik moko machalre, ma gin, misengini mag golo richo, misengini miwangʼo pep, kaachiel gi chiwo mag cham gi mo.
english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

kikuyu: Enobi kendo omonj Misri, konego jogo monego negi, komako jogo monego maki, kendo konego gi ligangla jogo monego negi gi ligangla.
english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ok ber mondo Adam obed kende, abiro losone jakony mowinjore kode.”
english: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

kikuyu: Ham wuon Kanaan noneno dug wuon kendo nodhi mowachone owetene ariyo mane ni oko.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowinjo Manoa, kendo malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noduogo ir dhako sa ma ne en e puodho; to Manoa chwore ne ok ni kode.
english: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.

kikuyu: Joma kare tho, to onge ngʼama wachno chando e chunye, joma ogeno kuom Nyasaye bende tho, to onge ngʼama dewo kendo joma kare igolo mondo kik richo yudgi.
english: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.

kikuyu: Ka iyudo od winyo e bath yo, manie yien kata e lum piny kendo winyo madhako onindo e tongʼe kata oumo nyithinde, to kik ikaw winyono gi nyithinde.
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼato angʼata mowere gi chiege mokendo dhako machielo odonjo e richo mar terruok nikech chiege moriembono.
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jeramel wuod Hezron makayo ne gin: Ram wuode makayo, Buna, Oren, Ozem kod Ahija.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

kikuyu: “Giniwuogi mi gine ringre joma otho mosepiem koda, kudni machamogi ok notho kata mach mawangʼogi ok notho kendo ginibed gik ma piny ngima ojokgo.”
english: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”

kikuyu: Kendo Rebeka nokawo piende diego moumogo bede Jakobo kod ngʼute kuonde maonge yier.
english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

kikuyu: Nindo matin, ayula wangʼ matin, kwakruok matin kiyweyo,
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

kikuyu: Ber chamo alot kama hera nitie, moloyo chamo ringʼo machwe kama achaya nitie.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

kikuyu: mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko. Negimiye dalano mane okwayogi, ma en, Timnath Sera manie piny Efraim. Kuom mano, nogero dala kanyo modakie.
english: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

kikuyu: E kindeno joma itgi odino nowinj weche manie kitabu, mi joma osebedo kokuyo, kendo manie mudho mandiwa wengegi nonen.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

kikuyu: omiyo makmana gima in-go matek nyaka abi.’
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

kikuyu: Jatijno none ber ka ruodhe odwogo to noyude kotimo gima noweye notim.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mad ilawgi gi mirima, kendo itiekgi gia e piny mane ichweyo.
english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

kikuyu: Pok mar piero gariyo ne mar Gidalti gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Bangʼe kaluwore gi gima ondiki, negitimo nyasi mar Sawo mar kiche ka gin gi kwan mar misengini miwangʼo pep mowinjore mar odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ.
english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

kikuyu: Ahab ruodh jo-Israel nopenjo Jehoshafat ruodh Juda niya, “Ibiro dhi konya kedo gi jo-Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshafat nodwoke niya, “Wan joka ngʼato achiel, kendo joga gin jogi, wabiro konyi kedo.”
english: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Oholibama, chi Esau ma nyar Ana kendo nyakwar Zibeon mane onywolone Esau ne gin: Jeush, Jalam kod Kora.
english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Jona nowuok modhi obedo piny yor wuok chiengʼ mar dala maduongʼno, mi nogero kiru kanyo nobetie tipone koyweyo kendo korito neno gima dhi timore ne dalano.
english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

kikuyu: Ne iwacho ni, ‘Mano kaka awinjo malit! Jehova Nyasaye osemedona rem; arumo nikech rem mapek ma an-go kendo aonge gi yweyo.’ ”
english: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’

kikuyu: Omiyo Eliazar jadolo nochoko tawo mar mula mane okel gi jogo mane osewangʼ, kendo nochokogi kanyakla monywasogi mondo muon-go kendo mar misango,
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ mane Esta onego dhi ir ruoth ochopo, ne ok okwayo gimoro mondo odhigo, makmana gik mane Hegai, jatich ruoth mabwoch mane rito mon, omiye. Esta ne en nyar Abihail, ma owadgi wuon Modekai, mane Modekai opidho kaka nyare. Ji duto mane oneno Esta ne mor kode.
english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.

kikuyu: Aparo higni machon mosekalo; aketo pacha mos kuom tijeni duto, kendo ageno gik ma lweti osetimo.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kikuyu: An, Daniel, kane oyudo pod aparo kuom wachni kendo angʼe tiende, napo kaneno gima chalo gi dhano kochungʼ e nyima.
english: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me someone with the appearance of a man.

kikuyu: Ka tekri orumo mipodho e kinde mar lweny, to mano kaka tekri tin!
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

kikuyu: Kane ruodhe oneno ni Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kode kendo ni Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho gik moko duto ma otimo,
english: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.

kikuyu: Jadolo nokir remo e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye manie dho Hemb Romo, kendo owangʼ boche madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Uketo chiemo mogak ewi kendona mar misango. “To pod upenjo ni, ‘Ere kaka wasenjawi?’ “Kuom wacho ni mesa mar Jehova Nyasaye en gima nono.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘The LORD’s table is contemptible.’

kikuyu: Wachikou jowetewa e nying Ruoth Yesu Kristo mondo upogru gi jowete ma budho abudha kendo ok lu puonj mane uyudo kuomwa.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

kikuyu: Ringra gi chunya nyalo doko manyap, to Nyasaye ema miyo chunya teko, kendo en e girkeni mara nyaka chiengʼ.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

kikuyu: Negilworo jo-Benjamin, ka gilawogi mi gimakogi e alwora duto man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Gibea.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

kikuyu: Tiendewa ochungʼ e dhorangeyeni, yaye Jerusalem.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

kikuyu: ‘Fedha gi dhahabu gin maga,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Negiloso chuma molworore mag mula mondo omak ludhe ma itingʼego e kondene angʼwen-go.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

kikuyu: To kaka weche chal sani, gik mutimogi biro ketowa e chandruok, nikech ibiro ngʼadnwa bura kaka joma kelo koko. Kuom mano, onge yo moro amora ma wanyalo tonygo e wachni, nikech wasegoyo koko maonge tiende.”
english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne awinjo gima chalo gi koko mar oganda mangʼeny machalo gi koko mar pige maringo matek, bende machalo gi polo mamor matek, kawacho niya, “Ruoth omi duongʼ! Haleluya! Nimar Ruoth Nyasaye Maratego olosecho.
english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Naomi ma wuod odgi nowachone niya, “Nyara, donge dibed maber ka anwangʼoni odi, kama inyalo chopnie dwarogi e yo maber?
english: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?

kikuyu: Kane ngʼat Nyasayeno otieko chiemo kendo metho, janabi mane odwoge chienno nogawone pundane.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

kikuyu: Ka urito chikena, to ubiro siko e herana, mana kaka an bende aserito chike Wuora kendo asiko e herane.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

kikuyu: kotiyo gi teko mar honni gi ranyisi kuom teko mar Roho Maler mar Nyasaye. Kamano aselworora e piny Jerusalem nyaka Iliriko, kalando Injili mar Kristo.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

kikuyu: Mano en ndalo ma wangʼ chiengʼ, dwe kod sulwe lokore mudho, kendo angʼwengʼo kwako piny bangʼ ka koth osechwe.
english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;

kikuyu: Nyithinda mahero, andikonu wechegi mondo kik utim richo. To ka ngʼato otimo richo, to wan gi Jabura machwakowa kendo kwayonwa Wuoro; Jali en Yesu Kristo, Ngʼat Makare.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

kikuyu: Bed mariek, wuoda kendo imi chunya mor eka anyalo dwoko ngʼato moro amora machaya.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

kikuyu: Efraim wuon-gi ne oywagogi kuom ndalo mangʼeny, to wedene ne obiro mondo ohoye.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye, kendo osemiyo lerne orieny kuomwa. Riwreuru gi oganda moriedo katimo nyasi, nyaka uchopi e tunge mag kendo mar misango.
english: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Joma ni piny otingʼo malo, kendo ohoyo joma ywak.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi mil polo gi pe gi theluji gi boche, kod yembe maringo matek mawinjo wachne;
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

kikuyu: To Samuel nopenje niya, “Dadhi nade? Saulo biro winjo wachno to obiro nega.” Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kaw nyaroya idhigo kendo iwachne ni abiro timo misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” The LORD said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’

kikuyu: pok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne gin rombe mia auchiel gi piero abiriyo gabich (675);
english: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: Weuru mondo bura makare ema mondo omol ka pi aora, kendo tim makare ema omol ka aora ma ok dwon.
english: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

kikuyu: gi kitembini mag wich, gi thiwni mag ofunj tielo, gi misip gi chupni motingʼo gik mangʼwe ngʼar kod ris,
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

kikuyu: Saulo gi joge nochako dwero, ka nowach ne Daudi wachno, nolor mwalo e lwanda mi nobet e Thim man Maon. Kane Saulo owinjo ma, nodhi e Thim man Maon kolawo Daudi.
english: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.

kikuyu: Josef nodwoko Farao niya, “Ok anyal time, to Nyasaye biro dwoki kaka odwaro.”
english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

kikuyu: Kane ochiegni chopo Lehi, jo-Filistia nobiro kakok kochome. Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuome gi teko. Tonde mane otweyego nochalo ka usi mowangʼ, kendo gik mane otweyego nolwar oa e lwete.
english: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.

kikuyu: Pongʼ wengegi gi wichkuot mondo ji omany nyingi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

kikuyu: Noloko mudho kaka raum mare, mudhono nobedo hema molwore, kendo nokawo rumbi mar koth moloko raumne.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: Kik iterri.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

kikuyu: “Jaduongʼ ma ruodha, jogi osetimo gima mono kuom gigo duto magisetimone janabi Jeremia. Giwite e bur, kama kech biro nege motho ka makati duto orumo e dala maduongʼ.”
english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”

kikuyu: “Ikri mar kedo kode! Wuoguru, wadhi wamonjgi e dier odiechiengʼ! To mano kaka ler mar odiechiengʼ bedo ma dimdim, kendo tipo mag odhiambo yware.
english: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

kikuyu: Joma osetho ok ema pak Jehova Nyasaye, joma oseiki molingʼ thi e bur ok pake;
english: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

kikuyu: ka gitemo gi tekregi duto mondo gitamwa yalo Injili ne joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo oyud warruok. Kuom tim ma gitimoni, gimiyo richogi medore ameda kendo mirimb Nyasaye koro osejukogi!
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

kikuyu: “En angʼo ma Daudi dimed wachoni? Nimar ingʼeyo jatichni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.
english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.

kikuyu: An to an gi puotha awuon mar mzabibu; to in Solomon in to bed abeda gi kilo apar gachiel, gi nusgo miyudo kuom jopur, to un jopur un bende beduru abeda gi kilo, ariyo gi nusgo moyudo kuom poku.
english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

kikuyu: Kuno ema inyalo winjoe tik mar mandrake, kendo e odwa kanyo okanni gik mamit, motingʼo gik machon gi manyien, ma asebedo ka akanoni, yaye jaherana.
english: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.

kikuyu: Kane Baasha owinjo mano, nochungo gero Rama modok Tirza.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

kikuyu: Pok mar piero ariyo gachiel ne mar Hothir gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Oganda noked gi oganda machielo, kendo pinyruoth noked gi pinyruoth machielo. Piny noyiengni kuonde mopogore opogore kendo kech nobedi e piny. Magi e chakruok mar rem mar muoch ma nobedie.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: eka ngʼat Nyasaye obed molony chuth ne tich moro amora maber.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

kikuyu: Nimar noparo singruokne maler mane omiyo Ibrahim jatichne.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye muko od ngʼat masungore, to orito kiep dhako ma chwore otho ma ok omul.
english: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon ne nigi mwandu mangʼeny kod rieko moloyo ruodhi mamoko duto mag piny.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

kikuyu: Bende asemiyi chik mondo inyisgi niya, “Kawuru geche miywayo gi punde e piny Misri mondo udhi uomgo nyithindeu gi mondeu kod wuonu kendo ubi kodgi ka.
english: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodak Misri e gwengʼ Goshen. Negiyudo mwandu mangʼeny kuno kendo ne ginyaa mi kwan-gi omedore ahinya.
english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osetimo mana gima nakoroni. Jehova Nyasaye osegolo loch e lweti mi omiye achiel kuom jobathi ma en Daudi.
english: The LORD has done to you as he spoke by me. The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, oganda nobiro, to ngʼatno mane iluongo ni Judas, achiel kuom ji apar gariyo, notelonegi, nosudo ir Yesu mondo onyodhe,
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

kikuyu: Magi e kuondegi mane gidakie kod gwenge mane omigi (tiende ni, mane omi joka Harun mane jo-dhood Kohath nikech pok mokwongo ne margi).
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

kikuyu: Kodhi mane olwar e kind kudho to ochungʼ kar ngʼat mawinjo wach, to parruok kuom ngima mar pinyni gi wuond ma mwandu kelo thungʼo wachno kendo mone nyak.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Kane jogo owinjo ka Paulo wuoyo kuom wach chier aa kuom joma otho, moko kuomgi nojare, to moko to nowachone niya, “Wabiro dwaro mondo iwuo kodwa kendo e wachni.”
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

kikuyu: “Adongʼ gi higni matin nono, bangʼe to abiro dhi kama ok duogie.
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Winjruok mondo obedie kindi koda, mana kaka nobedo e kind wuonwa gi wuonu. Aoroni mich mag fedha gi dhahabu, koro keth winjruok mantie e kindi gi Baasha ruodh Israel mondo mi owe kedo koda.”
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nowuok Bersheba, kendo yawuot Israel noketo wuon-gi kod nyithindgi, kod mondgi e geche mane Farao oseorone.
english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mangima ariyo ariyo nobiro ir Nowa kendo negidonjo ei yie.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

kikuyu: Solomon notemo nego Jeroboam, to Jeroboam noringo odhi Misri ir ruoth Shishak, mobedo kuno nyaka tho Solomon.
english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

kikuyu: jogo monego madh divai gin, Farao ruodh Misri, jotije, jotende, kod joge duto;
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;

kikuyu: Nikech, e kinde mowinjore, kane pod ok wanyal, to Kristo notho ne joricho.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

kikuyu: Ka uyie kuoma muboloru kendo umako chikena duto, to unucham gik mabeyo mag piny;
english: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;

kikuyu: Eka dwol noa e kom duongʼ mar loch, kawacho niya, “Pakuru Nyasachwa, un jotichne duto, un joge moluore, jomatindo kod jomadongo!”
english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo oganda maduongʼ chokore kendo ji ne biro ir Yesu moa e dala ka dala nogoyonegi ngero niya,
english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne awacho niya, “Weyauru aweya mondo aywag malit. Weuru hoya nikech jowa osetieki.”
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

kikuyu: mar apar gabiriyo ne Hezir, to mar apar gaboro ne Hapizez,
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

kikuyu: (Noyudo giseneno Trofimo ja-Efeso ka nigi Paulo e Jerusalem mi giparo ni dipo ka Paulo nosedonjo nyaka ei hekalu.)
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

kikuyu: Kendo nokir remono nyadibiriyo kuom ngʼat man-gi tuo malandoreno, kowachoni ngʼatni koro ler, eka gikone nowe winyo mangima-cha kendo dire mondo odhi e pap.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

kikuyu: To wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Shemaya ngʼat Nyasaye niya:
english: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

kikuyu: Bende doyud adiera kuomu kononou? Bende duwuonde kaka uwuondo dhano?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

kikuyu: Elisha nokone niya, “Yaw dirisa mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ,” minoyawe. Bangʼ mano nokone niya, “Dir asere.” Kane osediro asere, Elisha nokone niya, “Mano asech loch Jehova Nyasaye kendo onyiso adier ni ibiro loyo jo-Aram modak Afek.”
english: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

kikuyu: Jotije nopenje niya, “Itimori kama nangʼo? Kane nyathi pod ngima, ne itweyo chiemo kendo ne iywak. To ka nyathi koro osetho, to ichungʼ kendo ichiemo!”
english: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

kikuyu: To ka inyalo dok ir Nyasaye mi iket kwayoni ne Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ne iluongo masira koa kuonde duto mana ka ji mabiro e nyasi moro maduongʼ. E odiechiengʼ mar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye onge ngʼato mane otony kata mane odongʼ kangima. Kuom joga mane apidho kendo arito, wasika osetieko.
english: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.

kikuyu: To koro kik ikwane ka ngʼama onge ketho. In ngʼama riek; iningʼe gima nitimne. Kik iwe lwar mantie e wiye dhi e bur gi kwe.
english: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ok onyal yudo kata mana akuche odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo, to chunoni nyaka ochiw kilo angʼwen mar mogo mayom kaka misango mar golo richo. Kik oolie mo kata kik oketie ubani, nikech en misango mar golo richo.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “In ngʼa?” Yesu nodwokogi niya, “An mana ngʼama asebedo ka awacho ni an nyaka aa chakruok.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

kikuyu: To oko mar dala, pimuru fut alufu angʼwen mia abich kod piero ochiko gadek koa yo wuok chiengʼ, fut alufu angʼwen mia abich kod piero ochiko gadek koa yo milambo, fut alufu angʼwen mia abich kod piero ochiko gadek koa yo podho chiengʼ, kod fut alufu angʼwen mia abich kod piero ochiko gadek koa yo nyandwat, ka dala oger e dier lowono tir. Ginikaw kanyo kaka lek mar kwath ne joma odak e miergo.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokelo masira kuom jo-Israel kendo nonego jo-Israel alufu piero abiriyo.
english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

kikuyu: To we dhano kod le oumre gi pien gugru, ngʼato ka ngʼato oluong Nyasaye piyo piyo, to kendo giwe timbegi maricho ma achach.
english: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

kikuyu: Amazia ema ne oloyo jolweny jo-Edom alufu apar e holo mar Chumbi kendo nomako Sela e lweny, moloko nyinge ni Jokthel, kendo pod iluonge kamano nyaka chil kawuono.
english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

kikuyu: “Jo-Reuben mondo obed mangima kendo kik githo, to bende kik gibed manok.”
english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

kikuyu: Mi gibed gi chuny matek kendo mad kwongʼ mari obed kuomgi.
english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Nyasaye nojwangʼogi moweyogi e gombo maricho makelo wichkuot. Mondegi noweyo riwore gi chwogi e yo mowinjore, to negichako riwore gi mon wetegi.
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane oyie, chwo kod mon, nobiro mokelo bangli gi sitadi mag dhahabu. Ji duto nokelo ne Jehova Nyasaye misango mifwayo mar dhahabu,
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane Jobab otho, Husham mane oa e piny jo-Teman nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jowetena, un ma aherou kendo chunya ogenou; bende un e morna kod osimbona, kamano e kaka onego uchungʼ motegno, ka un kuom Ruoth, yaye osiepena mageno!
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

kikuyu: Yawuot Bela ne gin: Adar, Gera, Abihud,
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ ruodh Babulon ne miyo Jehoyakin pok mowinjore kode ndalo duto mag ngimane, nyaka odiechiengʼno mar thone.
english: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

kikuyu: “Ketgi gilos sanduku maber molos gi yiend siala ma borne romo fut angʼwen gi nus to lachne romo fut achiel gi nus kendo borne madhi malo romo fut achiel gi nus.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Eka Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Ne aleko nine achungʼ e bath aora Nael,
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

kikuyu: Angʼeyo chandruokni kod dhierni to kata kamano in jamoko. Bende angʼeyo ayany ma joma wuondore ni jo-Yahudi yanyigo to gin mana joma lamo Satan.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

kikuyu: (Chutho ka joma ok jo-Yahudi maonge gi Chik, timo gik ma Chik dwaro, kata obedo ni gikia Chik, to gidoko chik ne gin giwegi kata obedo ni gionge gi chik kamano
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

kikuyu: Anguro bende en gima ogak kata obedo ni tiendene opogore kamano, ok onyam kambula. Kik ucham ring-gi kata kik umul ringregi motho.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

kikuyu: Benjamin, Maluk gi Shemaria.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

kikuyu: Nowangʼo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kar dak ruoth kod udi duto man Jerusalem. Bende nowangʼo udi duto moger mabeyo.
english: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

kikuyu: Omiyo nomiyo ngimagi orumo kaonge ber kendo higni mag-gi nopongʼ gi masiche mabwogo ji.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

kikuyu: Bende, chiemo ma An awuon ema ne amiyi kaka mogo mayom, mor zeituni kod mor kich mane amiyi mondo icham mi ichiwonegi kaka misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar. Mano e gima notimore, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kendo ka achiel kuom jokor wachgo okoro wach moro, to an Jehova Nyasaye abiro rundo pache, ma wachneno ok notimre, kendo anatiek jakor wachno mi agole kuom joga ma jo-Israel.
english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

kikuyu: Konyruokna aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye, Jachwech polo gi piny.
english: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Omiyo Gideon nokawo jotijene apar kendo notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone. Notimo tijno gotieno ma ok odiechiengʼ nikech noluoro jo-dalagi kod joodgi.
english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

kikuyu: jodong Gilead nodhi mondo ogol Jeftha e piny Tob.
english: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo oseweyo Samuel, Nyasaye ne oloko chuny Saulo, kendo ranyisi duto nochopo kare chiengʼno.
english: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.

kikuyu: To Petro nowacho koramo niya, “Kata ka ochuno ni nyaka atho kodi, to ok abi kwedi ngangʼ.” Kendo jopuonjre mamoko duto bende nowuoyo machalre gi Petro.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okunyo bur, obiro lutore e iye; to ka ngʼato ngʼielo kidi, to kidino biro ngʼielore kaduogo ire.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

kikuyu: Ne osengʼiewe mondo obwoga eka atim richo mar timo ma, bangʼe gimiya nying marach mar njawo kita.
english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

kikuyu: Kane jonywolne onene, negihum. Min-gi nowachone niya, “Wuoda, angʼo momiyo isetimonwa kamano? An kod wuonu wasedwari ka wan gi parruok.”
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

kikuyu: koa e nyikwa Hebron, ne gin ji piero aboro kotelnegi gi Eliel
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

kikuyu: “To unjawe kuom wacho ni, ‘Mesa Ruoth Nyasaye ogak,’ kendo, ‘Chiembe en gima nono.’
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The LORD’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abiriyo, dwe mar achiel, e higa mar apar gachiel, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: To Yesu nongʼiyogi tir mi owachonegi niya, “Mano en gima ok nyalre kuom dhano, to kuom Nyasaye to gik moko duto nyalore.”
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

kikuyu: Jogo mane oneno gima notimore nonyiso ji kaka ngʼat mane nigi jochiende nochangi
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

kikuyu: Koso chunyi wuondi ni iriek moloyo Daniel? Iparo ni onge gima opondoni?
english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.

kikuyu: Eka negiparo wechene.
english: They remembered his words,

kikuyu: Chamgiuru mana kaka ducham mwanda kata ogunde. Joma ogak kod jomaler duto manie dieru nochiem duto.
english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

kikuyu: Yawuot Benjamin ne gin adek: Bela, Beker kod Jediael.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

kikuyu: Kane gibiro ka, to ne aluongo bura ma ok odeko, kendo agolo Chik mondo kel ngʼatno e nyima.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka Nyasaye omiyo ngʼato mwandu gi ngima maber, kendo oyiene mondo ocham gigo to onego obed mamor kochamogi, nimar mano en mich ma Nyasaye ema chiwo.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato angʼata otamore luwo weche mawandikonu e baruwani to ngʼiuru ngʼatno maber. Kik uriwru kode, mondo eka wiye okuodi kuom timne mobam.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

kikuyu: Gidwogo ka piny imore ka gingʼur ka guogi, kendo giwuotho koni gi koni e dala ka gingʼanjo.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ibed gi mirima mokadho apima, kik ipar richowa ndalo duto. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wakwayi, yie irangwa, nimar wan duto wan jogi.
english: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

kikuyu: Wechegi nomedo kelo pogruok e kind jo-Yahudi.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni wasikgi oterogi e twech, to kata mana kuno abiro oro ligangla mondo otiekgi. “Anachom wangʼa kuomgi mondo atimnegi marach to ok maber.”
english: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.

kikuyu: Kawuononi ka iseweya ibiro romo gi ji ariyo machiegni gi liend Rael e gwengʼ Zelza e tongʼ jo-Benjamin. Gibiro wachoni ni, ‘Punde mane iwuok idhi dwaro oseyudi. Kendo wuonu oseweyo parogi koro chunye chandore ni wachne kopenjo niya, “Abiro timo angʼo ne wach wuodani?” ’
english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

kikuyu: Abiro miyo aore mag Nael dwon, kendo abiro jwangʼo pinyno e lwet joma richo. Abiro loko piny gunda, kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye ka atiyo gi lwet ogendini mamoko. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho.
english: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”

kikuyu: Jaketh nobi ketho Babulon; jolweny mage nomaki, kendo atungʼ mag-gi notur. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye machulo kuor ni ji kuom richogi; enochul duto.”
english: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for the LORD is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

kikuyu: Negidhi nyime ka gitiyone nyiseche manono mane Mika oseloso, to kindegi duto od Nyasaye neni Shilo.
english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.

kikuyu: Baal nonywolo Beera mane Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh Asuria otero e twech. Beera ema ne jatend joka Reuben.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼat maratego, momanore gi gige lweny orito ode owuon to gige duto ritore maber.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nolwoko jamb-ich kod tiende imno gi pi, kendo nowangʼo imno pep e kendo mar misango kaka misango miwangʼo pep, ma en misango miwangʼo gi mach ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ka ranyisi otimore to mondo itim atima gima lweti oyudo ni onego tim; nikech Nyasaye ni kodi.
english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

kikuyu: “To ka jopur nonene, ne giwuoyo kuome kagiwacho ni, ‘Ma e jacham girkeni. Wanegeuru, to mondo girkeni odongʼnwa!’
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

kikuyu: to ka ma otim maonge chenro ka oganda ok ongʼeyo, to oganda duto nochiw nyarwath matin kaka misango miwangʼo pep ma en gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny, kod nywok kaka misango mar golo richo.
english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

kikuyu: To nikech gima isetimo, isemiyo jowasigu ojaro Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo wuodi monywolno biro tho.”
english: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora mokwong nywol kuom jambi gin mag Jehova Nyasaye, bedni gin dhok, kata rombe, omiyo kik ichiwgi kaka gima iwalo ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aneno ni onge gima ber ni dhano moloyo tichne, nikech mano e pokne. Kare en ngʼa manyalo keche mondo one gima biro timorene bangʼe kosetho?
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Ahira wuod Enan ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: Negidwogo chunya, kaachiel kod un bende. Joma kamago onego omi duongʼ.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye nopenje niya, ‘Ere kaka ibiro hoye?’ “Nodwoke niya, ‘Abiro dhi mondo abed roho mar miriambo e dho jonabi mage duto.’ “Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, ‘Dhiyo kendo itim kamano nikech in ema ibiro hoye mi iloye.’
english: The LORD said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

kikuyu: Kar romb dhood Naftali ne gin ji alufu piero abich gadek gi mia angʼwen (53,400).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Adier chutho ubiro wachona ngeroni ni, ‘Jathieth, changri iwuon! Tim e dalau ka gigo ma wasewinjo ni ne itimo Kapernaum.’ ”
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

kikuyu: Negiloyo Sihon ma ruodh jo-Amor manodak Heshbon. Pinye nochakore Aroer man but holo mar Arnon koluwo holono nyaka e Aora Jabok, manie tongʼ mar jo-Amon. Ma noriwo nyaka nus mar Gilead.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: “To beduru motangʼ gi ji, nimar gibiro ketou e lwet buche mag gwengʼ, kendo gibiro rodhou gi del e sinagokegi.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

kikuyu: Ne amiyo Zedekia ruodh Juda wach achielni. Ne awacho niya, “Kul wiyi e bwo jok mar ruodh Babulon; tine kod joge, to ibiro dak.
