english: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

kikuyu: Donge in ema isedagiwa, yaye Nyasaye, kendo tinde ok idhi gi jolwenjwa e lweny?
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nogwedhogi kendo owacho niya, “Nywolreuru kendo umedru kuom kwan kendo upongʼ pi mag nembe kendo winy bende omedre e piny.”
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: To kaka koro onge kuonde modongʼ ma anyalo tiye e gwengegi, kendo nikech asebedo ka anenou kuom higni mangʼeny,
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

kikuyu: Kane Daudi pok ochiewo kinyne gokinyi, wach Jehova Nyasaye nosebiro ne Gad janabi, mane en jakor wach mar Daudi:
english: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: Mano kaka dala maduongʼ mane ji ngʼenyie odongʼ nono! Kinde moro ne en dala malich miwuoro to koro ochalo gi dhako ma chwore otho! Ne en ruoth madhako e kind pinje, to tinde osebedo misumba.
english: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!

kikuyu: Yaye le manie thim, weuru luor; nikech pewe kwath koro loth, yiende nyago olembegi; Ngʼowu gi mzabibu golo mwandugi.
english: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nonyodho Rael kendo noywak gi dwol maduongʼ.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Joka Lawi kod joka Shimei bende noywag kamano, ka mondgi bende ywak kar kendgi.
english: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

kikuyu: To ngʼato nyalo penjo niya, “Joma otho ichiero nadi? To jogi nobed gi ringruok machalo nade?”
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

kikuyu: To Ira ja-Jair ne jadolo mar Daudi.
english: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

kikuyu: Ka ok ingʼeyo, yaye jaber moloyo mon mamoko, lu bangʼ rombe kuonde ma gikwayoe, mondo ikwa nyidiek ma pod tindo e bath hembe mag jokwath.
english: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

kikuyu: Kuom gik mane ope, jolweny nokawo rombe alufu mia auchiel gi piero abiriyo gabich (675,000),
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

kikuyu: Ogwende nosieko mopongʼo pinygi, kendo negidonjo nyaka ei ute nindo mag ruodhigi.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

kikuyu: kendo manogolou e piny Misri mondo abed Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kata ka yawuote yudo duongʼ bangʼe, to en okia kendo kata ka giyudo wichkuot, to ok one gi wangʼe.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

kikuyu: wuod Mikael, wuod Baseya, wuod Malkija,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

kikuyu: Jogo mane gitelonegi ne gin jolweny mane otieg ne lweny ne gin ji alufu mia adek gabiriyo kod mia abich, joma ngʼeny moloyo madikony ruoth kedo gi wasike.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

kikuyu: Zima nonywolo Joa, Joa nonywolo Ido, Ido nonywolo Zera to Zera nonywolo Jeatherai.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

kikuyu: To kichiwo kony ne joma ochando to kik iyie lweti ma koracham ongʼe gima lweti ma korachwich timo,
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nodhi e polo moweye kama ne giwuoyoe kodeno.
english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

kikuyu: Nyaka une ni utimo mana kaka giwachonu ma ok uweyo kata matin. Kik ukwan ka nono gik ma giwachonu.
english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

kikuyu: Ka udonjo e dala to moseuru.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

kikuyu: kendo kochopo odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo negitieko gi chwo mane okendo mon moa e dhoudi mamoko.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

kikuyu: To moko bende gin jo-Krete gi jo-Arabu. Ere kaka wawinjogi ka gihulo gik madongo ma Nyasaye osetimo e dhowa wawegi!”
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

kikuyu: Ireso joma muol, to wangʼi rango josunga mondo idwokgi piny.
english: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nodhi koni gi koni e piny Galili, kotemo bedo mabor gi Judea nikech jo-Yahudi ne rite kuno mondo ginege.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

kikuyu: Kik ucham gima olos gi thowi. Kamoro amora mudakie nyaka une ni uchamo makati ma ok oketie thowi.”
english: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nokonye loyo jo-Filistia kod jo-Arabu mane odak Gur Baal kod jo-Meun.
english: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma terore gi chi wuon, nimar odwanyo kitanda wuon.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo moko Paulo nowachone Barnaba niya, “Wadogi mondo walim jowete e mier matindo duto kuonde mwaseyale wach Ruoth, mondo wane kaka gidhi.”
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

kikuyu: Nyithinda mageno, giko chiegni kendo kaka usewinjo ni jasik Kristo biro, koro wasik Kristo mangʼeny osefwenyore. Ma e kaka wangʼeyo ni giko chiegni.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ibiro keto remb jonabi mosechwer duto ewi tiengʼni nyaka aa remb jonabi mosechwer aa chakruok piny.
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi norwako wechene, to moko notamore yie.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

kikuyu: Kik ima jachan nikech gin jochan kendo kik ihiny joma ochando man-gi dwaro e kar bura,
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ayie ni alamo Nyasach kwerewa, kendo an achiel kuom joma oluwo Yor Kristo, ma jo-Yahudi luongo ni kanyakla mar joma ongʼanyo. Ayie gi gik moko duto mowinjore gi Chik Musa kod gik mane Jonabi ondiko,
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

kikuyu: Higa ka higa, ngʼato ka ngʼato manobiro nokelo mich kaka gik molos gi fedha kod dhahabu, kandho, gige lweny, gik mangʼwe ngʼar, farese kod punde.
english: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek neno masira kabiro kendo opondo, to ngʼat mofuwo dhiyo adhiya nyime ma ohinyre.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: nikech onge gima obiro kawo odhigo ka otho, duongʼ ma en-go ok bi dhi kode e liel,
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodonjo ei hekalu koluwo rangach mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: The LORD’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye oseoronu jotichne ma jonabi duto pile ka pile, pod ok uchiko itu kata winjo.
english: The LORD has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),

kikuyu: Gisepogo gigegi ne joma odhier, bergi osiko nyaka chiengʼ; duongʼne gi luor ma ji oluorego, biro siko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

kikuyu: Bed ka ingʼeyo ni jaricho ok notony ma ok okume, to jogo makare nobed thuolo.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ochan ni dhano nyaka tho dichiel kende to bangʼe Nyasaye yale,
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

kikuyu: “ ‘Donge usewinjo ni an ema ne achano chon mondo gigo otimre? An ema ne achanogi chon, to koro amiyo gitimore; kendo an ema ne achanogi chon mondo imuk mier madongo mochiel motegno mondo olokre pidhe mag kite.
english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

kikuyu: To kane odwogo, nochako oyudogi ka ginindo, nikech nindo noingogi.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

kikuyu: Kiawa moro amora ne ok omiyo okier oweyo singruok Nyasaye, to nomedo bedo motegno e yie mare komiyo Nyasaye duongʼ,
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

kikuyu: Ka tije duto mane Solomon osetimo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye noserumo, nokelo gik duto mane Daudi wuon-gi osewalo kaka fedha gi dhahabu kod gik mitimogo lemo kendo noketogi e od keno mar hekalu mar Nyasaye.
english: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

kikuyu: Abiro keti jatend od ruoth kendo joga duto biro winjo chikni kendo kom duongʼ mar ruoth ema nobed maduongʼ moloyi.”
english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Sara nowacho ne Ibrahim niya, “Riemb dhako ma misumbani kod wuode, nimar wuod dhako ma misumbani ok nobed jacham girkeni kaachiel gi wuoda Isaka.”
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

kikuyu: Ji duto mane obiro motelona ne gin jokwoge kendo jomecho, to rombe ne ok owinjogi.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

kikuyu: ma e wach ma Jehova Nyasaye osewacho kuom Senakerib: “Nyar Sayun Mangili ochayi kendo jari. Nyar Jerusalem kino wiye koneni kiringo.
english: this is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

kikuyu: Nokawo wedene molawo Jakobo; kuom ndalo abiriyo; kendo nojuke e piny gode mag Gilead.
english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: to nyaka uwachne ni, ‘Jotichgi osebedo jokwath chakre tindowa, mana kaka kwerewa notimo.’ Eka ibiro yienu mondo udag e gwengʼ Goshen, nikech jo-Misri ok ohero jokwath.”
english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

kikuyu: To gik machalo agulni mane ni ewi sirni mag agola nolosi e kido mag ondanyo ka borgi romo fut auchiel gi nus.
english: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

kikuyu: Chikegi Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Musa e Got Sinai, chiengʼ mane ochoko jo-Israel mondo ochiwne Jehova Nyasaye misengini mag-gi, ka gin e Thim mar Sinai.
english: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Nimar ogendini kata pinjeruodhi ma ok notini norum; adier ibiro tiekgi chuth.
english: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

kikuyu: Kane gigonyo ogundegi, ngʼato ka ngʼato noyudo ofuku mar pesane e dho gunde! Kane gineno pesago, giduto ne gibuok ahinya kaachiel gi wuon-gi.
english: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

kikuyu: Owetene gi nyiminene kod ji duto mane ongʼeye mokwongo nobiro mochiemo kode e ode. Ne gihoye kendo gidwogo chunye kuom chandruok duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osekelone, kendo moro ka moro kuomgi nomiye pesa moko kod tere mar dhahabu.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo gibedo motegno kuom Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kuom nyinge giniwuoth gichir,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Gigi duto notimore ne ruoth Nebukadneza.
english: All this came on the King Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro wan tho tiyo kuomwa, to un, ngima tiyo kuomu.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

kikuyu: Koro jo-Filistia ne kedo gi jo-Israel kendo jo-Israel noringo e nyimgi kendo joma ngʼeny nonegi e Got Gilboa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Iningʼe ni hembi oriti maber; inikwan mwanduni achiel achiel, kendo ok niyud kaonge moro kuomgi molal.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

kikuyu: Kane jotije Saulo onyise gima Daudi nowacho,
english: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”

kikuyu: Kwan chwo duto mahikgi en piero adek nyaka piero abich, ma gin joma obiro konyo tich mar Hemb Romo.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ka itimo kama kaka Nyasaye dwaro, to ok ibi ol kendo jogi biro dok e miechgi kamor.”
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

kikuyu: Chok tekoni kaachiel, yaye Nyasaye; nyiswa tekoni, yaye Nyasaye; kaka isebedo kitimo nyaka aa chon.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

kikuyu: Ok nikech timu mabeyo kata lony maru emomiyo udhi kawo pinyno mondo obed maru; to mana nikech timbe maricho mag ogandagi ema miyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro riembogi oko e wangʼu mondo ochop gima nowachone kwereu ma Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenje niya, “In ngʼat ngʼa? To in jakanye?” Nowacho niya, “An ja-Misri ma misumba ja-Amalek. Ruodha nojwangʼa moweya, ka tuo nogoya ndalo adek mokadho.
english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

kikuyu: Parieuru kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ne otelonu ka ukalo e piny motwo kuom higni piero angʼwen-gi duto, mondo opuonju bolruok, kopimo paro ma un-godo e chunyu ka bende unyalo rito chikene.
english: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

kikuyu: Laru maduongʼ noluor gi ohinga mar kite mopa ma lachne en kite adek gi laini achiel mar bap sida mobar machal mana gi laru maiye mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye gi agolane.
english: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.

kikuyu: To chiemo ok kelwa machiegni gi Nyasaye. Kata ka ok wachiemo, to ok wabed jomaricho, to bende ka wachiemo, to onge ohala ma wayudo.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

kikuyu: Ruoth wacho niya, “Abiro gologi oko Bashan; abiro gologi oko kama tut mar nam,
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

kikuyu: E higa mokwongo mar Darius wuod Ahasuerus (ma ja-Media), mane en ruodh Babulon duto,
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

kikuyu: Ne imiyo jogi ma jo-Israel obedo jogi iwuon nyaka chiengʼ to bende in Jehova Nyasaye isebedo Nyasachgi.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

kikuyu: Negilosone rachungino teyni abiriyo, kaachiel gi gik mingʼadogo otambi kod gigene mag jowo buru molos gi dhahabu maler.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

kikuyu: to imbe abiriyogo moro ka moro to chiw gi kilo adek.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Mano kaka ijaber, jaherana! Yaye, mano kaka ijaber! Wengeni neno mamuol ka akuru.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

kikuyu: mor zeituni miolo e taya mondo okel ler, gik milosogo mor pwodhruok kod ubani mangʼwe ngʼar,
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: Negiwuok Hor Hagidgad mi gibworo Jotbatha.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

kikuyu: Udi moriedo machiegni gi bath laru ma oko borgi ne oromo fut piero abiriyo gabich, to udi mane oriedo machiegni mogik gi kama ler mar lemo noromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

kikuyu: To timuru kamano ka uwinjo tiend gik matimore ndalogi. Sa osechopo mondo uchiew ua e nindo maru, nikech warruok marwa koro okayo machiegni moloyo chiengʼ mane wayie mokwongo.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

kikuyu: Kane gisenene, negilando wach mar gima ne owachnegi kuom nyathini,
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

kikuyu: Ne oloso kendo mar misango ne Baal e hekalu mar Baal mane osegero e Samaria
english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

kikuyu: Piny thembo ka jakongʼo, kendo ohukni ka kiru ma yamo yiengo, kethruok kod timbene mamono omiyo opodho ma ok nochak oa malo.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ok unubed gi ngʼato kata achiel e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma nogo ombulu kipogo lowo.
english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.

kikuyu: To Joab nodwoko ruoth niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi med jolweny nyadi mia achiel ka ruodha ma en ruoth neno gi wangʼe. To en angʼo momiyo ruoth ma en ruodha didwar timo gima chal kama?”
english: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

kikuyu: To kane oweyogi mondo odhi, nowachonegi niya, “Ka en dwaro mar Nyasaye, to abiro duogo.” Bangʼe nokwangʼ oa Efeso.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

kikuyu: Nimar richo koro ok nobed gi loch kuomu, nikech koro ok un e bwo chik, to un e bwo ngʼwono.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

kikuyu: Abiro loki lwanda lilo, mi ilokri kama jolupo moyoe tonde. Ok nochak ogeri kendo, nikech an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema asewacho kamano.
english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Wachnegi niya, ‘Misengini miwangʼo ne Jehova Nyasaye e magi: nyirombe ariyo ma jo-higa achiel maonge songa, kaka chiwo mapile mowangʼ odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Go milome mar wechegi duto e mier mag Juda kod jogo manie yore mag Jerusalem: ‘Chikuru itu ne chike mag singruokni kendo ulugi.
english: The LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

kikuyu: Wuogi e polo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wuogi mondo ilor piny; lor piny imul gode, mondo gidhuol iro.
english: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osewacho mano, Yesu nochandore gie chunye mi nohulonigi niya, “Awachonu adier, ni achiel kuomu biro ndhoga.”
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Kwongʼruok mane asingoni e chunya kendo awacho gi dhoga kane an e thagruok.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

kikuyu: Jogi gin jokwath; gikwayo jamni, kendo gisebiro kod kwethgi kod dhogi kod gigegi duto.’
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

kikuyu: “Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho ewi ruodh Asuria: “Ok nodonji e dala maduongʼni kata diro asere. Ok nomonj dalano kotingʼo kuot kata lwore gi jolweny mondo omonje.
english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

kikuyu: “Usewinjo bende ni nowachi ni, ‘Kik iketh kwongʼruok, to riti kwongʼruok moro amora misetimone Ruoth Nyasaye.’
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

kikuyu: Joricho kulore e nyim joma beyo, to jo-ajendeke e dhorangeye mag joma kare.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

kikuyu: Noneno yiedhi ariyo e dho wath, mane owe kanyo gi jolupo mane luoko tondegi.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

kikuyu: sa moro amora ma chunywa ngʼadonwa bura. Nikech Nyasaye duongʼ moloyo chunywa, kendo ongʼeyo gik moko duto.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

kikuyu: Ket tongʼ ne oganda molworo got kendo nyisgi ni, ‘Beduru motangʼ mondo kik ngʼato idh got kata mulo tie got, nimar ngʼato angʼata mochopo e tiend godni to nyaka negi.
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: Ja-miriambo to kara en ngʼa? En ngʼama wacho ni Yesu ok en Kristo. Ngʼatno e Jasik Kristo, nikech odagi Wuoro kaachiel gi Wuowi.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Nimar rieko nodonj e chunyi, kendo ngʼeyo nomi ngimani bedo mamor.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nogomo kochiko yo nyandwat, modhi nyaka En Shemesh, kendo nyaka Geliloth, momanyore gi Adumim, kendo oridore kadhi piny nyaka Kit Bohan ma wuod Reuben.
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

kikuyu: joka Naftali ne nigi jotelo alufu achiel (1,000) kaachiel gi ji alufu piero adek gabiriyo (37,000) motingʼo kuode kod tonge;
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Johala mag piny noywage ka gidengo, nikech onge ngʼat manochak ongʼiew mwandugi kendo.
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo medo miero, to ngʼat ma terore mos kweyo dhawo.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

kikuyu: Ok wanaduogi e miechwa nyaka wane ni jo-Israel duto oseyudo pinyno kaka pok margi.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

kikuyu: An, kendo en An adier, ema asewacho kamano; ee, an ema aseluonge. Abiro kele, kendo enobed gi loch kuom gik mochano timo.
english: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

kikuyu: Eka ji ariyo ma timbegi mono nobiro mobedo momanyore kode e nyim ji, mohangone wach kawacho niya, “Naboth osekwongʼo Nyasaye gi ruoth.” Omiyo ne gigole oko mar dala mi gigoye gi kite ma otho.
english: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

kikuyu: Oluongo joma odak e polo malo kaachiel gi joma odak e piny, mondo oyal joge:
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

kikuyu: Opak Ruodhwa mochwere! En Ruoth ma ok tho, kendo ma ok ne. En e Nyasaye kende. Duongʼ kod pak odogne nyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye nobiro koa Sinai mochopo irgi koa Seir, mi ofwenyore koa e got Paran. Nobiro gi oganda maler kowuok yo milambo e kor gode mage.
english: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

kikuyu: Kane koro gisekiewo yie kama nyalo romo kilomita abich kata auchiel; negineno Yesu kawuotho ewi pi kochiko irgi; mi luoro nomakogi.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to gibiro puonjou mondo utim gik mamono ma gitimo kagilamo nyisechigi kendo unutim richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against the LORD your God.

kikuyu: To jateloni nowachone ngʼat Nyasaye niya, “Winji, kata ka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo yawo dhorangeye mag polo, bende manyalo timore adier?” Ngʼat Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Ibiro nene gi wangʼi, to ok inicham gimoro amora kuome!”
english: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

kikuyu: To ka jopuonj Chik ma jo-Farisai nonene kochiemo gi joricho gi josol osuru, negipenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo ochiemo gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Josef nowachone niya, “Ooyo, wuora ma e wuowi ma kayo: ket lweti ma korachwich e wiye.”
english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Chiengʼ moro kane akalo machiegni kodi ne ayudo ka ithachori gi rembi iwuon kendo kata obedo ni nitimo remo kamano to ne awachoni ni ibed mangima.
english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

kikuyu: Neuru ni onge dichwo kata dhako, anywola kata dhoot moro e dieru kawuono ma chunye lokore weyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kadhi lamo nyiseche mag jopinjego; bende neuru ni onge yath manyago olemo makech mar richo.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

kikuyu: Mana kaka polo bor kendo piny tut, e kaka chuny ruodhi ngʼeyo tek.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni dende modholoreno olokore rachar, to nyaka odhi ir jadolo.
english: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

kikuyu: Ka giwachonwa ni, ‘Rituru kanyo nyaka wabi iru,’ to wabiro chungʼ achungʼa kama wantie kendo ok wanadhi irgi.
english: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.

kikuyu: Negiwuok e Thim mar Sin mi gibworo Dofka.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu obet ewi Got Zeituni, momanyore gi hekalu, Petro gi Jakobo, gi Johana kod Andrea nopenje lingʼ-lingʼ ni,
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

kikuyu: Mana kaka ji duto tho nikech Adam, e kaka ji duto nobed mangima nikech Kristo.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano biro dhi adier mana kaka nondiki kuome. To ngʼat mandhogo Wuod Dhano none malit! Dine obedo maber moloyo kane ok onywole.”
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: To ka dine atim mano, to dine aketo ngimana e chandruok nikech onge gima opondo ne ruoth bende dine ok ikonya.”
english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

kikuyu: Donge ngʼatni en wuod fundi bao-cha? Donge min-gi nyinge Maria, koso owetene donge gin Jakobo gi Josef gi Simon kod Judas?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

kikuyu: “Ok wanawinj wach miwachonwa e nying Jehova Nyasaye!
english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in the LORD’s name, we will not listen to you.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye oneno ni Lea ne ok oher, ne oyawo iye to Rael noketo obedo migumba.
english: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

kikuyu: Mach osemoki gi mirimba, en mach mawangʼo nyaka kuonde joma otho e bwo lowo. Obiro ketho piny kod nyakne duto kendo ka omoko mach nyaka e konde mag gode.
english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

kikuyu: To jogo mochaye obiro kumo motiekgi mana ka gineno, adier ok obi deko ma ok okumo jogo mochaye.
english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

kikuyu: Bende nogolo dagi ma Maaka e kome mane entie kaka min ruoth nikech noloso sirni milamo mar Ashera. Asa nongʼado yien-no mowangʼe e holo mar Kidron.
english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: Mana kaka gima ibwogogo gik moko e puothe mag budho, e kaka nyisechegi manonogo ok nyal wuoyo; nyaka tingʼ-gi nikech ok ginyal wuotho. Kik uluorgi; ok ginyal hinyou kata timonu gima ber.”
english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Isakar: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Gimoro machielo ma bende aseneno e pinyni en ni jongʼwech maringo matek ok yomb e ngʼwech pile, kata joma thuondi e lweny ok lo lweny pile, joma riek ok yud chiemo ma gichamo pile kata joma nigi paro mariek ok bed jo-mwandu, kendo joma ongʼeyo tich ok bed jotelo; to kata kamano hawi marach mako ji duto.
english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

kikuyu: “Singruok matimo kodi ema: Inibed wuon ogendini mangʼeny.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: To joma odongʼ duto noketo e bwo Abishai mowadgi mondo oked gi jo-Amon.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Gionge dhok kata weche kata dwondgi ok winji.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

kikuyu: To e giko mar ngimani inichur achura, ka ringri gi dendi chamore rumo.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

kikuyu: “Ere kuma dayudie weche ma dawachne? Koro ere kaka damin kode wach?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

kikuyu: To geno Nyasaye gi chuny modhil en ohala maduongʼ.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nodhi Kapernaum kaachiel gi min-gi gi owetene kod jopuonjrene. Negibet kuno kuom ndalo manok.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

kikuyu: Joab nopodho piny auma e nyime mondo omiye duongʼ, kendo nogwedho ruoth. Joab nowacho niya, “Kawuononi jatichni ongʼeyo ni ogene gi ruodha ma en ruoth, nikech ruoth oseyie timo gima jatichne okwaye.”
english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

kikuyu: Kane Hezekia oneno ni Senakerib nosebiro kendo noparo mar kedo kod Jerusalem,
english: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Kane Abimelek osebedo ruodh Israel kuom higni adek,
english: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye mi imedri, in kaachiel gi nyithindi.
english: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno nochal mana gi ngʼat ma sibuor lawo, to oromo gi ondiek, kata nochal gi ngʼat modonjo e ot, moyiengo lwete e kor ot, mi thuol okaye!
english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

kikuyu: Ne okwayi ngima kendo ne imiye; ne imede ndalo mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

kikuyu: Joka Merari ne gin: Merari nonywolo Mali, Mali nonywolo Libni, Libni nonywolo Shimei, Shimei nonywolo Uza
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

kikuyu: Kinyalo timo kamano to an owuon ema anakuong paki ni tekri iwuon ema omiyo iloyo.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

kikuyu: To apoya nono, dhako moro mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo nopore gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

kikuyu: To enobed maber-ber ne Turo gi Sidon e ndalo mar ngʼado bura moloyo ne un.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

kikuyu: To ka ok umiya luor mondo urit Sabato maler ma ok utingʼo misigo ka udonjo e rangeye Jerusalem chiengʼ Sabato, to anamok mach ma ok tho e rangeye mag Jerusalem manowangʼ kuondegi mochiel motegno.’ ”
english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”

kikuyu: mondo omi gibed mangima kendo kik githo ka gibiro machiegni gi gik maler moloyo. Timnegiuru kama: Harun gi yawuote mondo odhi ei kama ler mar lemo kendo gimi ngʼato ka ngʼato tije kod gima onego otingʼ.
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

kikuyu: Ginigolu oko mar dala ka giluwo kodu kuonde momukore mag ohinga, kendo gibiro witou oko kuchomo Hamon,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: bende ka iweyo timo richo kendo ingʼado ni richo moro amora ok bed e dalani,
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

kikuyu: Dendgi duto kaka, diengʼegi, bedegi, bwombegi, kod tiendegi angʼwen-go ne nigi wenge maneno maler.
english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

kikuyu: Jonathan nodwoko niya, “Daudi nohomba kokwaya thuolo mondo odhi Bethlehem.”
english: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Negichako giluongo ngʼat ma nonywol ka en muofuno mi gikone niya, “Wach adier e nyim Nyasaye! Wan wangʼeyo ni ngʼatni en jaricho.”
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Bi mondo ibed jatendwa mar lweny, mondo mi waked gi jo-Amon.”
english: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Benjamin, kaw Abidan wuod Gideoni;
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: kendo kidi ma asechungo kaka sironi, nobed od Nyasaye kendo duto ma imiya, namiyi achiel kuom apar.”
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

kikuyu: En Lwanda, tijene ler kendo yorene duto nikare; Nyasaye ma ok tim marach, ngʼat modimbore kendo makare.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar loch duto mane nyar Sayun nigo oserumo. Jodonge chalo gi mwanda modenyo ma ok yud lum machamo, giringo ka gionge gi teko e nyim joma lawogi.
english: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.

kikuyu: “Koro angʼeyo ni onge ngʼato kuomu maseyalone wach kuom pinyruoth manochak onena.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

kikuyu: Koko maduongʼ nowuok kendo jopuonj Chik moko mane gin jo-Farisai, nochungʼ malo mochako goyo mbaka matek kagiwacho niya, “Ok waneno gima rach ma ngʼatni osetimo. Donge nyalo bet ni roho kata malaika ema wuoyo kode?”
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

kikuyu: Eka noringo odhi e dipo kendo noyiero nyarwath mopugno kendo nomiyo jatich molose piyo.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

kikuyu: Kaka mwanduni medore, e kaka joma tiyo kodgi medore. In to ohala miyudo en ngʼeyo mana ni in jamoko?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

kikuyu: Jogo duto motenore kuom rito Chik ni e bwo kwongʼ, nikech ondiki niya, “Okwongʼ ngʼato ka ngʼato ma ok chop chike duto mondiki e kitap Chik.”
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

kikuyu: Wan duto, waselal mana ka rombe, ka ngʼato ochomo mana yore owuon; kendo Jehova Nyasaye oseketo kuome richowa duto.
english: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno, ka Nyasaye noherowa kamano, to wan bende waherre ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

kikuyu: Kane Shekem wuod Hamor ja-Hivi ma jatend gwengʼno, nonene, nomake moterore kode.
english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

kikuyu: to gik mochokogo joma kare ema biro rwako, kendo joma onge ketho nopogre mwanduge mag fedha.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

kikuyu: Dende dhiyo adhiya, mi chokene ma yande opondo koro nenore oko.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

kikuyu: Eka ginilu buchena kendo ginibed gi chuny mar rito chikena. Ginibed joga, kendo anabed Nyasachgi.
english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Angʼeyo chenro ma an-go kodu. Chenro mar dhi maber to ok mar hinyou, chenro mar miyou geno kod ngima mabiro.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

kikuyu: Nathan nodwoko Daudi niya, “gimoro amora manie chunyi to dhi nyime mondo itim nikech Nyasaye ni kodi.”
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

kikuyu: Joma kech oloyo chamo chamb ngʼat mofuwono, nyaka mago madongo e kind kuthe, kendo joma riyo oloyo dwaro yako mwandune.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, geno mar Israel, jogo duto mojwangʼi noyud wichkuot. Jogo molokoni ngʼegi nondik nying-gi e buru nikech gisejwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye, soko mar pi ngima.
english: LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living waters.

kikuyu: Jaode Jezebel nobiro ire e ot mopenje niya, “En angʼo momiyo ikuyo? En angʼo momoni chiemo?”
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Gad nodhi ir Daudi mowachone niya, “Dhi malo mondo iger kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye e laru mar dino mar Arauna ja-Jebus.”
english: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa gi Harun niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Mi ngʼatno noa malo kendo odhi dala.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasach kwe ma nochiero Ruodhwa Yesu, ma en Jakwath Maduongʼ mar rombe, kuom remo mar singruok mosiko,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane otimo kamano kane aume gi boche kaka nangane kendo kane aboye ei mudho mandiwa;
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

kikuyu: nyikwa Lod, Hadid kod Ono, ji mia abiriyo gi piero ariyo gachiel (721),
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

kikuyu: To par Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, nimar en ema omiyi teko mar loso mwandu, kochopogo singruok mare mane osingore gi kwereu mana kaka en kawuononi.
english: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

kikuyu: Ji mamoko to nowacho niya, “Magi ok gin weche ma ngʼama nigi jachien nyalo wacho. Jachien bende nyalo yawo wangʼ muofu adier?”
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

kikuyu: Bende inyalo tugo kode ka winyo manie sigol, kata ka gimoro miywayo gi tol, ma digalgo nyiri matiyoni?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone Abiathar niya, “E odiechiengʼno ka Doeg ja-Edom ne ni kanyo ne angʼeyo adier ni nyaka ne onyis Saulo. An ema akelo tho ne joka wuonu duto.
english: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

kikuyu: To en mana kaka ondiki e muma niya, “Dhano to en angʼo momiyo ipare, koso wuod dhano to en ngʼa momiyo isiko idewe?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Dhoga biro nyiso ji kuom timbeni makare odiechiengʼ duto, nimar joma ne dwaro hinya oseneno wichkuot kendo osengʼengʼ.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Eka jomoko nochako ngʼulo olawo kuome. Negitweyo wangʼe mi gigoye ngum, kagiwacho niya, “Hul ane ngʼa mogoyi.” Askeche to nongʼwane ka girodhe.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

kikuyu: To ka chiwo mari mar cham en gima otedi e tawo, to enobedi mogo mayom ma ok oketie thowi, kendo moru gi mo.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

kikuyu: To kaka koro onyalo neno sani, kata ngʼama noyawo wengene, to wakia. Penjeuru, tinde oduongʼ. Obiro wacho wach kuome owuon.”
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

kikuyu: Fedha mane oyudi koa kuom oganda duto mane okwan e kweno maduongʼ ne romo kilo alufu adek mia angʼwen (3,400) kaluwore gi rapim mar kama ler mar lemo,
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

kikuyu: to udagi yie nikech ok un rombena.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼatno nowuok odhi mi nochako lando e gwenge mag Dekapoli konyiso ji gik ma Yesu nosetimone. Ji duto nowuoro wechego.
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

kikuyu: To ka Kristo nobiro kaka jadolo maduongʼ mar gik mabeyo moloyo makoro wan-go sani, nodonjo e hema maduongʼ kendo malongʼo chuth. En hema ma lwet dhano ok oloso manyiso ni ok en chwech mar pinyni.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

kikuyu: Tiende joma ithiro kod mag joma odhier nyone piny.
english: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

kikuyu: Malaika nowachone mon-go niya, “Weuru luor, nikech angʼeyo ni umanyo Yesu mane ogur.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kikuyu: Ne ok onego ungʼigi kod achaya chiengʼ masichgi, bende ne ok onego ubed mamor chiengʼ mane ikethoe Juda, kata bedo gi ngʼayi chiengʼ chandruokgi.
english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

kikuyu: Hanan wuod Maaka, Joshafat ja-Mithni,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kama:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Timbeu maricho osetamou nwangʼo gigi; richou osetamou neno maber.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

kikuyu: Magi e oganda mane Jehova Nyasaye oweyo mondo otem jo-Israel duto mane ok osekalo e lweny moro amora e piny Kanaan.
english: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

kikuyu: Gilama kayiem nono; to gik ma gipuonjo gin mana chike mag dhano.’”
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasacha ma jahera. Nyasaye biro telona kendo obiro miyo asungra ne joma ketho nyinga.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

kikuyu: Ruoth nomiyo fedha obedo manwangʼo yot ka kidi akida Jerusalem kendo yiend sida ne ngʼeny mana ka yiend ngʼowu ma otwi e got.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

kikuyu: mi awachonegi niya, “Wasetemo kaka wanyalo ma waduogo owetewa mane joma ok jo-Yahudi ongʼiewo kuomu kaka wasumbini. Koro sani uuso oweteu, to mano biro chunowa ni nyaka wawargi kendo!” Negilingʼ thi, nikech onge gima neginyalo wacho.
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowacho ne jo-Israel mondo otim nyasi mar Pasaka,
english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

kikuyu: Nokete ruodh ode, manorito gik moko duto mane en-go,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

kikuyu: Kane ruodhi duto ma jo-Amor modak yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan to gi ruodhi duto mag jo-Kanaan modak e dho nam nowinjo kaka Jehova Nyasaye notwoyo aora Jordan e nyim jo-Israel nyaka negingʼado, chunygi nobwok kendo ne gionge gi chir mar chomo jo-Israel tir.
english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ruodhi magwa, jotendwa, jodolo mawa kod kwerewa ne ok oluwo chikni; ne ok gichiko itgi ne puonj magi kata siem mane imiyogi.
english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

kikuyu: “Jowadwa, utimonwa kamano nikech angʼo? Wan mana ji kaka un. Wakelonu Injili manyisou mondo ua e gik manonogi mondo ungʼe Nyasaye Mangima, manochweyo polo gi piny gi nam kod gik moko duto manie igi.
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: Negiyudo ja-Misri moro e pap mi gikele ir Daudi. Negimiye pi mondo omodhi gi chiemo mondo ocham
english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni pod en-gi tuono pod ogak. Nyaka odag kende; kendo odag oko mar kambi.
english: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Gisebedo ka gingʼeya kuom higni mangʼeny, kendo ginyalo timo nenda, ka gihero, ni kaluwore gi chike ma tiendgi tek mag ogandawa, naluwo kit jo-Farisai.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom jodongogo nopenja niya, “Joma orwakore gi lewni marocheregi gin ngʼa gini, to gia kanye?”
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

kikuyu: Asebedo maonge ketho e nyime, kendo aseritora mondo kik atim richo.
english: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

kikuyu: “To ka ok utimo kamano, to ubiro timo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye; kendo bed ka ungʼeyo ni richou nofwenyre e lela.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

kikuyu: Gedalia nokwongʼore kosingorenegi niya, “Kik uluor jotend Babulon, to daguru e pinyni kendo mondo uti ne ruodh Babulon eka unudhi maber.”
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

kikuyu: Beduru gi adieri mar rito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kaka omiyou e chikene kod buchene.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

kikuyu: Josef noiko gache kendo oikore mar dhi Goshen mondo odhi oromne wuon-gi Israel. Kane Josef ochopo ire, nokwako wuon-gi kendo oywak kuom kinde malach.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

kikuyu: “Gichwoyo yamo to gikayo kalausi. Gin gi cham ma ok ket wiye; kendo ok onyal kelo mogo. To kane onyalo nyago cham, to jopinje mamoko dochame duto.
english: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.

kikuyu: kendo paro malingʼ-lingʼ mopondo e chunye elore e lela, mi opodh auma kolamo Nyasaye, kowacho niya, “Adier, Nyasaye ni kodu!”
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

kikuyu: Salmon ne en wuon Boaz, ma min-gi ne en Rahab. Boaz ne en wuon Obed ma min-gi ne en Ruth, Obed ne en wuon Jesse,
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

kikuyu: Inirit gi kwe ngʼatno ma parone oriere tir, nikech ogeno kuomi.
english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

kikuyu: kendo okawo weche jotichne mi omi weche jootene, “ma giwacho kuom Jerusalem chop kare kama: ‘Ibiro dak e iyi,’ kendo ne miech Juda ni, ‘Ibiro gergi kendo,’ to bende ne kuonde momukore ni, ‘Abiro loso kuonde mane omukore obed maber kendo,’
english: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’

kikuyu: Chi Samaria-no nowachone niya, “In ja-Yahudi, an to an chi Samaria. Ere kaka ikwaya pi modho?” (Donge ingʼeyo ni jo-Yahudi ok winjre gi jo-Samaria.)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

kikuyu: To nitie ngʼama chielo matimo neno ma chwaka, kendo angʼeyo ni neno motimo kuoma nikare.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

kikuyu: Arango joma onge yie ka chunya ochido kodgi, nimar ok girit chikni.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

kikuyu: Daniel nodwoko niya, “Yaye ruoth, mad idag amingʼa!”
english: Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!

kikuyu: Nikech dichwo ewi dhako mana kaka Kristo en wi kanisa, ma en ringre to en ema en Jawarne.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ni koda; en e Jakonyna. Abiro neno gi wangʼa ka olo wasika.
english: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Asemiyi duongʼ e piny kuom tieko tich mane imiya mondo atim.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

kikuyu: Ginyiero ruodhi kendo gijaro jotelo. Ginyiero mier mochiel gi ohinga motegno; gigero pidhe mag lowo ma giidhogo ohinga kendo gimako mier mochiel motegno.
english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho ni Musa niya, “Farao biro tamore winji mondo honnina omedre piny e Misri.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Iber, kendo gima itimo ber; omiyo puonja chikeni.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Osenyisgi ni ipuonjo jo-Yahudi modak e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi duto mondo kik gilu Chike Musa, kisemogi mondo kik giter nyithindgi nyangu kata kik gilu timbewa.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

kikuyu: Hanania, Elam, Anthothija,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nee kaka anie chandruok malich! Iya nyawni, kendo chunya chandore malich, nikech ok aseluoro chikeni. Lweny nego ji oko mar dala to ei dala bende tho nekoe.
english: “Look, LORD; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.

kikuyu: Jakobo nowachone niya, “Ingʼeyo kaka asetiyoni kendo kaka aserito jambi.
english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

kikuyu: Ngʼat modak ei kar pondo mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo biro yudo yweyo e bwo tipo mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Kendo moko kuomgi bende nayier mondo obed jodolo kod jo-Lawi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka negikawo Jona mi gibolo e nam, kendo apaka mar nam mane ger nokwe.
english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

kikuyu: Pasiago duto nyaka bed maromre ka borne romo fut piero angʼwen gariyo to lachne romo fut auchiel.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Koro noyudo ka jo-Israel osebedo kawacho niya, “Donge uneno kaka ngʼatni osiko wuok? Owuok, mana mar jaro, Israel. Ruoth biro chiwo mwandu mathoth ne ngʼat monege. Bende obiro miye nyare mondo okendi, joodgi bende ok nogol osuru e Israel.”
english: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and will make his father’s house tax-free in Israel.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano, Nyasaye noketo fuoni ka fuoni e ringruok mana kaka ne odwaro ni mondo gibedi.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

kikuyu: Kaka uluongo nying Wuoro mangʼado bura ne tich ngʼato ka ngʼato machalre ka ok odew wangʼ ngʼato, daguru kaka welo e piny-ka, kod luor mowinjore.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

kikuyu: ni ubiro ngʼwonone wuonwa kod minwa, owetena kod nyiminena, kod jogegi duto, kendo ni ubiro resowa mondo kik watho.”
english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

kikuyu: “En angʼo ma Daudi dimed wachoni kuom duongʼ ma isemiyo jatichni? Nikech ingʼeyo jatichni,
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo ochop wach mane Isaya janabi osewacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye, en ngʼa moseyie wach mwalando, koso en ngʼa ma Jehova Nyasaye osenyiso tekone?”
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

kikuyu: Asegolo chik ne joga maler; asechiko joga ma jolweny kakecho mondo gitim gima adwaro, jogo mamor kaloyo.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Piny kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye gin mag Jehova Nyasaye, bende ji duto modakie piny gin mage;
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Chikeni duto inyalo geno; omiyo yie ikonya, nikech ji sanda maonge gima omiyo.
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

kikuyu: Kik uriwru gi jopiny. Nimar en winjruok mane ma ber gi rach dibedgo e achiel? Koso ere kaka ler gi mudho didag kaachiel?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

kikuyu: Bende jo-ohala nyalo goyo nengone kata yangʼe mondo ji ongʼiew ringe?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

kikuyu: To gima bende aparo mamiyo abedo gi geno ema:
english: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

kikuyu: “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni ok unuchak ugo ngeroni e piny Israel.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

kikuyu: Mwandugi ne ngʼeny makoro ne ok ginyal dak kamoro achiel; piny mane gidakie ne tin ma ok nyal romogi nikech kwethgi.
english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ni koda kaka jalweny maratego; omiyo jogo masanda nochwanyre kendo ok giniloya. Ok ginilo kendo ginibedi gi wichkuot malich; wichkuot margi wich ok nowil godo.
english: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro oro mach e piny Juda, kod kuonde mochiel motegno mag Jerusalem.”
english: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: To ka koro ne ok onyal medo pande, nokawo osera mochwe gi togo momuono gi lowo kod odok. Bangʼe noketo nyathino ei oserano kendo noketo oserano ei odundu e tiend aora Nael.
english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

kikuyu: kik giketh nying ngʼato angʼata, gibed joma ohero kwe, kendo ma paro mar konyo jowetegi, ka ginyiso muolo madier ne ji duto.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo mia achiel gi piero aboro nonyisogi mwandu mathoth mag pinyruodhe gi ber kod teko miwuoro mar lochne.
english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

kikuyu: Kendo ji apar matingʼo gige lweny mag Joab nolworo Abisalom, negigoye, ma ginege.
english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

kikuyu: kendo Ruoth Solomon kod oganda jo-Israel duto mane ochokore molwore nochopo e nyim Sandug Muma; kendo negichiwo rombe kod dhok mangʼeny mane kwan-gi ok nyal ndiki kata kwan kaka misango.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

kikuyu: Bende nomuko kama oger motingʼore gi malo mar Peniel mi onego jo-dalano.
english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo gi jo-Israel owinjo weche ja-Filistia, kibaji nogoyogi mi luoro nomakogi.
english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato ochiwo ode mondo obed gima owal ni Jehova Nyasaye, to jadolo mondo onon odno kober kata korach. To nengo moro amora ma jadolo oketo ema nobed nengo odno.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

kikuyu: Isehero tim makare to imon gi timbe maricho; emomiyo Nyasaye ma Nyasachi osetingʼi malo moyombo jowadu, nikech osewiri gi mo mamiyi mor.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

kikuyu: ni onge kata mana ngʼato achiel kuomgi mane oneno duongʼ mara kod ranyisi mag honni mane atimo Misri kendo e thim, to ne ok owinja kendo otema nyadipar; ma nochopi e piny mane asingonegi.
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

kikuyu: Polo pako timbeni miwuoro kod adierani, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, e dier chokruok mar jomaler.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

kikuyu: Nyikwaye nodak e gwengʼ manie kind Havila nyaka Shur, machiegni gi tongʼ Misri kochomo yo Ashur kendo negidak kagimonre gowetene.
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ nywolo Methusela, Enok nowuotho gi Nyasaye kuom higni mia adek kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Ne gikalo jorit mokwongo, gi mar ariyo mi gichopo e ranga chuma mane iwuokgo e od twech kidonjo e dala maduongʼ. Rangano noyawrenigi kende mine gikadho. Kane gisewuotho mabor mochwalore gi od twech, to nopo ka malaika oseweye.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

kikuyu: Yangʼe e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich, kod nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Gamaliel wuod Pedazur ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachona niya, “En angʼo midwaro?” Bangʼe to ne alamo Nyasach Polo,
english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Chik achiel ema omakou machalre gi jopinje mamoko modak e dieru.’ ”
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

kikuyu: E kedo mokwongono Jonathan kaachiel gi jatingʼ gige lwenjene nonego ji piero ariyo e alwora mar nus heka.
english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

kikuyu: Kane Ruoth Herode owinjo wachno, chunye nochandore, en kaachiel gi ji duto modak Jerusalem.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

kikuyu: Eka Daniel nowachone jarit mane jatelo maduongʼ oketo mondo orit Daniel, Hanania, Mishael gi Azaria niya,
english: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

kikuyu: Asemiyogi duongʼ mane imiya, mondo gibed achiel kaka wan achiel,
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

kikuyu: “Kaponi nitie ngʼat moro makare moluwo adiera kendo timo gima kare.
english: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,

kikuyu: Adiera bad Jehova Nyasaye ok chiek ma ok dores joge, bende ite ok odino ma ok dowinj wach.
english: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

kikuyu: To nyaka urit yorena kod chikena. Onge ngʼato kuomu manotim timbe makwerogo kata obed ja-Israel kata jadak e dieru,
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

kikuyu: Moko to chal mana gi kodhi mochuo e lowo maber, giwinjo Wach mi girwaki. Kendo ginyak maber mana ka kodhi manyak nyadi piero adek, nyadi piero auchiel, nyaka nyadi mia achiel.”
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Ot mochomo milambo en mar jodolo matiyo ei hekalu,
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

kikuyu: To Herode nowacho niya, “Johana ne asengʼado wiye, koro ma, to en ngʼa ma awinjo gik ma kamagi kuome?” Kendo notemo mondo onene.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

kikuyu: To ne awacho niya, “Bende dichwo machalo koda kama diringi? Koso ngʼato kaka an nyalo dhi ei hekalu mondo ores ngimane? Ok abi dhi kata nade!”
english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

kikuyu: “Keluru cham mabeyo mokwongo nyaknu e lowo e od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. “Kik uted nyadiel ma pod dhodho cha min.”
english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

kikuyu: Koro wuoda chik iti malongʼo kendo tim gima awachoni.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

kikuyu: Kendo Balak nokawo Balaam nyaka ewi Peor, momanyore gi kama otwo.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Nyaka obed gi okanda ariyo mag gok mitweyego e gok chien gi nyime
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

kikuyu: Kapok ngʼato opodho, to sunga bedo e chunye, to muolo kelo pak.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

kikuyu: nyikwa Zatu, ji mia aboro gi piero angʼwen gabich (845),
english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: Abija nolawo Jeroboam mokawo mieche kaka Bethel gi Jeshana kod Efron kod mier matindo mokiewo kode.
english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Kaluwore gi chik, angʼo monego timne Vashti ma mikacha? Nikech osedagi winjo chik mar ruoth Ahasuerus mane oorogo jotichne mabwoch ire.”
english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

kikuyu: To ni dhood Lawi, Musa ne ok opogonigi girkeni, nikech Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, e girkeni margi, mana kaka nosesingonegi.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

kikuyu: Mano notimo mana mondo opuonjgo nyikwa jo-Israel lweny, mago mane onge gi lony e kedo.
english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

kikuyu: Chik mosiko ne gin ema. “Ngʼat mokiro pi mar pwodhruok nyaka luok lepe bende, kendo ngʼato angʼata momulo pi mar pwodhruok nobed mochido nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

kikuyu: Bangʼe achien, ka Hezron ne ja-higni piero auchiel ne okendo nyar Makir ma wuon Gilead. Nobedo e achiel kode ma nonywolone Segub.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

kikuyu: Ee, mano kaka agombo ndalogo mane pod ategno, kinde mane Nyasaye gwedho oda nikech ne en osiepna,
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

kikuyu: Ma e wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obirone janabi Jeremia kuom Elam, e ndalo chakruok mar loch Zedekia ruodh Juda:
english: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo fupa, yaye Nyasaye; kethona ok opondoni.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

kikuyu: Jolweny moa Aram nodhi momako nyako matin ma nyar Israel kendo ne en jatij chi Naaman.
english: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

kikuyu: E pachi inipar masiche machon: “Ere jatelo maduongʼ cha? Ere ngʼatno mane okawo osuru? Ere jatelo mochungʼne kuonde ngʼicho man malo?”
english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

kikuyu: To ka timbewa maricho konyo kuom guro tim makare mar Nyasaye, to koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Wanyalo wacho ni Nyasaye timo marach kokumowa gi mirimbe mager? (An awuoyo mana kaka dhano.)
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

kikuyu: Nokawo chiege Sarai, gi Lut wuod owadgi, gi mwandu duto mane gisechoko kod wasumbini duto mane gin-go Haran, kendo negichako wuoth mar dhi Kanaan mi negichopo kuno.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, tingʼ wichkuot mari kendi, nikech isegonyo nyiminegi mobedo thuolo kaka joma beyo moloyi. Nikech richogi ne richo moloyo mag-gi, omiyo koro ginenore joma kare mohingi. Omiyo koro ne wichkuot kendo tingʼ achaya mochayigo kendi iwuon, nikech in ema isemiyo nyiminegi onenore joma kare moloyi.
english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
