kikuyu: Jachiendno nokok gi dwol ma liyore mi nogoye piny kogwecho matek, bangʼe noa kuome. Noweyo wuowino mana ka gima otho, mi ji mangʼeny owacho niya, “Otho.”
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

kikuyu: Ne giwangʼo hekalu mar Nyasaye kendo negimuko ohinga mar Jerusalem; mane giwangʼo ute ruoth duto kendo negiketho gimoro amora ma nengogi tek mane ni kanyo.
english: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

kikuyu: En jahawi ngʼatno moyudo rieko, ngʼatno man-gi winjo,
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kikuyu: To jo-Berea ne nigi kido maber moloyo jo-Thesalonika, nikech negirwako wach gi chuny mamor, kendo neginono Ndiko pile ka pile, mondo gine ane ka gik mane Paulo wacho gin adier.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

kikuyu: Koro gingʼeyo ni gik moko duto ma isemiya oa kuomi.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

kikuyu: Aseketo Sandug Muma ma moketie singruok mane Jehova Nyasaye otimo e kinde gi jo-Israel.”
english: There I have set the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Nitie ber mangʼeny! Mokwongo, gin ema ne omigi wechegi mag Nyasaye.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

kikuyu: nikech nongʼad bura maonge kech ni ngʼato angʼata maonge kech. To kech loyo ngʼado bura.
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

kikuyu: Nimar onge gimoro mopandi ma ok nofweny, to bende onge gima lingʼ-lingʼ ma ok nongʼere kata noket e lela.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona kama: “Kata dabed ni Musa gi Samuel ema nyalo chungʼ e nyima, to ok anyal weyonegi richogi. Golgi oko e nyima! Wegi gidhi!
english: Then the LORD said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!

kikuyu: Noyudo jandhok osechano kodgi ranyisi mobiro timo kowacho niya, “Ngʼat ma wangʼ ananyodhi e En, makeuru mondo udhi kode kurite ma ok onyal ringo otony.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ji mathoth kuomu ool kendo tuo; kendo moko kuomu osetho.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

kikuyu: In kaachiel gi joma osebiro irigi ubiro mana ool. Tijni pek mohewi; ok inyal time kendi.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasaye winjo weche Nyasaye, to un ok uwinj wach Nyasaye nikech ok un joge.”
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

kikuyu: Un timbe wuonu ema utimo.” Ne gikone ka gikwere niya, “Wan ok wan kimirwa. Wuoro ma wan-go en Nyasaye owuon.”
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

kikuyu: Nowuotho e gwengʼno kojiwo ji gi weche mangʼeny, eka nochopo e piny jo-Yunani,
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

kikuyu: Jo-Ai nongʼiyo chien ma gineno ka iro dhwolore e dala maduongʼ kochiko polo, makmana ne gionge gi thuolo mar pondo e yo moro amora nikech jo-Israel mane osebedo kawuondore ni ringo kochiko thim nolokore kod jogo mane lawogi.
english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.

kikuyu: “Nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho: Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, ma en ruoth maduongʼie moloyo ruodhi mag pinyni, biro biro koa nyandwat ka en gi farese mathoth gi geche mag lweny, gi joidh farese gi oganda lweny maduongʼ mondo omonj Turo.
english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

kikuyu: Yawuot Nowa mane owuok e yie ne gin: Shem, Ham kod Jafeth. (Ham ne wuon Kanaan.)
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

kikuyu: To ka wuon chiayo nigi chiayono, to jaholono ok nochun mondo ochul. Ka chiayono ne ichuloe gimoro, to pesa mochulno norom nyaka lalno.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

kikuyu: Dhi mondo iland wachni yo nyandwat ni: “Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, ‘Duogi in Israel maonge gi yie, ok anabed gi mirima kodi kendo, nimar an jangʼwono, iya ok bi wangʼ kodi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says the LORD; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says the LORD. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

kikuyu: Kik uchik itu ne jonabi mawachonu ni, ‘Ok ubi tiyone ruodh Babulon,’ nimar gikoronu miriambo.
english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, wacho: “Ne, anatur atung Elam, girgi maduongʼ mar tekogi.
english: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

kikuyu: Ji osewinjo ywakna, to onge ngʼama dewa. Wasika duto osewinjo chandruokna; kendo gimor kuom gik ma isetimona. Mad ikel odiechiengʼ mane iselando mondo omi gichal koda.
english: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noguro lochne motegno kendo jo-Juda duto nokelo mich ni Jehoshafat mi nobedo kod mwandu mangʼeny kod huma maduongʼ.
english: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni misenginigo nyalo miyo ji bedo makare, donge dine osewetimgi chon? Nikech joma lemogo dine osepwodhi dichiel kende, mi ok gibedo joketho ma bura oloyo kendo.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni osene fweny mag miriambo kuomi kendo osego gagi mag miriambo kuomi, to ibiro yieyogi e ngʼut, joma timbegi richo mibiro negi, joma odiechieng-gi ochopo kendo e kinde ma onego kumgie osechopo.
english: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

kikuyu: Chutho urwako koda ka joma lokou wasumbini mag-gi, kata makawo giu e yor mecho, kata ma gajou, kata ma tiyou githuon, kata ma diyou piny kendo thalo lembu!
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

kikuyu: To kuom weche duto mane ondiki e ndalo loch Jehoash; gi gik moko duto mane otimo, kod teko mane okedogo gi Amazia ruodh Juda, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Ma e remba mar singruok, mochwer ne ji mangʼeny mondo okel warruok kuom richo.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

kikuyu: Nikech tich ma utimo ok chop mana dwaro jo-Nyasaye kende, to bende omiyo ji dwoko erokamano ne Nyasaye nikech kony ma giyudo.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

kikuyu: Dhakono nokawo nyathino modhi opielo e kitanda jatich Nyasaye, eka noloro dhoot mi owuok.
english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

kikuyu: Parono nonenore maber ni Farao kod jodonge duto.
english: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

kikuyu: Jochan ok dwar kata gi jobutgi, to jo-mwandu nigi osiepe mangʼeny.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

kikuyu: kinde mar dwaro gimoro kod kinde ma gimoro lalie, kinde mar kano gimoro kod kinde mar wito gimoro,
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho kamano nodongʼ Galili.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

kikuyu: Ne akelo jotend Juda nyaka ewi ohinga. Bende ne ayiero migepe ariyo madongo mag jower mondo odwok erokamano ni Nyasaye. Achiel kuomgi ne ochungʼ ewi ohinga korachwich, kochiko kama iluongo ni Dhoranga Owuoyo.
english: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

kikuyu: “Kane oyudo inindo kanyo, yaye ruoth, pachi nolokore momako gik mabiro timore, kendo Jal mafwenyo tiend midhierni nonyisi gik mabiro timore.
english: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

kikuyu: Ne ok gidwar ni mondo olernegi kaka pesa otiyo e lwet joma ne omi mondo ochul jotich, nimar ne gin joma ogen.
english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

kikuyu: Weche mamoko duto mag loch Asa, gi lochne, gi gigo duto mane otimo gi mier duto mane ogero donge ondikgi e kitepe mag ruodhi mag Juda? Kata kamano ka hike noseniangʼ tiende nobedo gituo.
english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone ngʼatno niya, “Dhiyo ilwok wangʼi e yawo mar Siloam” (tiende ni “Ote”). Omiyo ngʼatno nodhi moluoko wangʼe, kendo noduogo dala koneno.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: “Neuru! Abiro apoya mana kaka jakuo! Ngʼatno en ngʼat mogwedhi ma nonwangʼ kaneno kendo ma orwako lepe mondo wiye kik kuodi ka oyude duk.”
english: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

kikuyu: Eka nawinjo dwol moro machielo moa e polo kawacho niya, “ ‘Un joga, wuoguru ua kuome,’ mondo kik ubed achiel kode e richone, mondo kik unwangʼ masichene,
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

kikuyu: Kane ochopo tarik apar gadek mar dwe mokwongo, noluong jogoro mag joka ruoth. Negindiko barupe madhi e piny ka piny kendo e dhok mar oganda ka oganda gik mane Haman ochiko mondo ondiki ne jotelo morito pinje mopogore opogore gi jodongo mag ogendini. Barupegi nondik gi nying ruoth Ahasuerus owuon mi ogo sei gi tere mar ruoth.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

kikuyu: Ruodh jatijno nobi e odiechiengʼ ma ok opar ni dobie kendo e sa ma ok ongʼeyo, enongʼade matindo tindo mi okete kaachiel gi joma ok oyie.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwerewa Ibrahim, Isaka kod Israel, mad herani osiki ei chuny jogi ndalo duto kendo imi chunygi osik kuomi.
english: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

kikuyu: Anto tiendena nodwaro kier. Ne achiegni aa kama ne anyono.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

kikuyu: To an aketo mana genona kuomi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kendo awacho niya, “In e Nyasacha.”
english: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

kikuyu: Abiro miyo toki bed matek ka lwanda matek mogik, kendo matek moloyo kit ombo. Kik iluorgi kendo kata bwok kik ibwogi, kata obedo ni gin dhoot mohero ngʼanyo.
english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowinjou kane uwuoyo koda ka uwacho niya, “Asewinjo gima jogi osewachoni, gik moko duto magiwacho beyo.
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

kikuyu: In to nyaka ine ni iritori kinde duto; kidhil e chandruok kendo kitimo tiji kaka jaland wach. Tim tijegi duto monego itim kaka jatich Nyasaye.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

kikuyu: kata ka gimoro amora mochwe mamol e lowo kata ka rech manie pi.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

kikuyu: Mana kaka mach wangʼo bungu maduongʼ kata kaka mach wangʼo wi got,
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

kikuyu: Kwan mar jolweny moidho farese ne oromo tara mia ariyo. Ne awinjo kar kwan-gi.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenje niya, “Mano en angʼo mantie e lwetino?” Musa nodwoko niya, “En luth.”
english: The LORD said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Amiyou kothe duto manyago cham e wangʼ piny duto kod yiende duto man kod olemo gi kodhi eigi. Ginibed magu kuom chiemo.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

kikuyu: Winji lamo mar jatichni kaachiel gi jogi Israel ka gilamo ka gichomo odni. Winji gi e polo kar dakni, kendo kiwinjo, to iwenwa richowa.
english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

kikuyu: Ubiro chalo kaka yiend ober ma ite ner kendo kaka puodho ma ok yud pi.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

kikuyu: Ok initony ngangʼ e wachni to adiera enomaki kendo nochiwi ne en. Inine ruodh Babulon gi wengeni iwuon, kendo enowuo kodi wangʼ gi wangʼ kendo inidhi Babulon.
english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’

kikuyu: Kuome kendo e nyinge ema waseyudoe ngʼwono gi teko mar bedo joote, mondo wami ogendini duto oyie kuome kendo oluore.
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai nowinjo ka oganda wacho gik ma kamago kuome, omiyo jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai nooro askeche mag hekalu mondo omake.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoke kawacho niya, “Awachonu adier ni onge ngʼato moseweyo dalane, kata owetene, kata nyiminene, kata min-gi, kata wuon-gi, kata nyithinde, kata puothene, nikech An kendo nikech Injili,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

kikuyu: Methusela nodak kuom higni mia ochiko gi piero auchiel gochiko kendo bangʼe notho.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

kikuyu: Ne ogero kare maler mar lemo, ka gode maboyo, kendo mana ka piny mane oguro nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

kikuyu: Nimar an bende an ngʼama ni e bwo loch kod jolweny manie bwoya. Ka awacho ne moro ni, ‘Dhiyo,’ to odhi; kendo ka awacho ne machielo ni, ‘Bi,’ to obiro. Bende, ka anyiso misumbana ni, ‘Tim ma,’ to otimo kamano.”
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Nikodemo mane oseyudo odhi ir Yesu gotieno chiengʼ moro nodhi gi Josef. Nikodemo nokelo yien moko mangʼwe ngʼar moru kaachiel mane-mane madirom kilo piero adek gangʼwen.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

kikuyu: Musa kod Eliazar jadolo noyie okawo dhahabugo irgi, ma gin gik mothedhi maber.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo ariyogo, nowuok modhi Galili.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

kikuyu: Israel nowacho ne Josef niya, “Koro kata ka atho, to onge wach, nikech aseneno an awuon ni kara pod ingima.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

kikuyu: Mano kaka nobed malit ne joma luongo tim mamono ni ber to tim maber ni rach; jogo maketo mudho kar ler to kar ler gikete mudho, joma keto gik makech kar mamit to mamit giketo kar makech.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

kikuyu: To ka uwachona niya, “Wan waketo genowa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa” to donge en ema kuondene motingʼore malo kod kendene mag misango Hezekia nogolo kowachone jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem niya, “Nyaka ulam mana e nyim kendo mar misangoni kende”?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”

kikuyu: Ok ochuno ni uked e lwenyni. Kawuru kuondeu, chunguru motegno mondo une loch ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiu, yaye Juda kod Jerusalem. Kik ubed maluor, kendo kik chunyu nyosre. Kiny dhiuru mondo urad kodgi nimar Jehova Nyasaye nobed kodu.’ ”
english: You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo nyikwa Harun jadolo negimiyo Hebron (ma en dala maduongʼ mar tony mar ngʼama oneko), Libna,
english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Nyikwa Eliezer ne gin: Rehabia mane wuowi makayo. Eliezer ne onge gi yawuowi mamoko, to yawuot Rehabia ne ngʼeny moloyo.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

kikuyu: Nimar angʼeyo ni bangʼ thona an gi adiera ni udhi bedo jo-mibadhi mi unuwe yore mane achikou. E ndalo mabiro masira nomaku nikech unutim richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo unujimb mirimbe gi gik ma lwetu oseloso.”
english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

kikuyu: “Asin kendo amon gi sewni mutimona, bende ok amor gi chokruok mau ma ulosona.
english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

kikuyu: To bende ka ngʼato moro nogol oko weche mokor manie kitabuni, Nyasaye nogol kuome kamaye pokne manie yath mar ngima kendo manie Dala Maduongʼ Maler, mondiki e kitabuni.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone ruodh Israel niya, “Kaw atungʼ e lweti.” Kane osekawo atungʼno, Elisha noketo lwetene kuom lwete ruoth.
english: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

kikuyu: Koro ero isemanyo giga duto, angʼo ma iyudo ma mari? Kete e lela e nyim oweteni kod owetena kendo we gingʼad bura e kindwa.
english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

kikuyu: Yawuowi mane Daudi onywolo ka en Hebron e magi: Wuode makayo ne en Amnon wuod Ahinoam nyar Jezreel;
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

kikuyu: Magi e weche mag Hezekia ruodh Juda bangʼ kane osechango e tuone:
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼe e dhoranga Hemb Romo, ja-Nazirno nyaka liel yie wiye mane osewal tenge. Enokaw yie wiyeno mi olute e mach mantiere e bwo misango mar chiwo mar lalruok.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: Koa e Dhoranga Faras, jodolo nogedo kanyo, moro ka moro e nyim ode owuon.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

kikuyu: Gidonjo kuoma ka pi madonjo e hotogoro maduongʼ kata ka joma muomo ohinga kama ogore piny.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mad iyud pak; yie ipuonja chikeni.
english: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Gin ema ne gitedo makati mane iketo e mesa, mogo mar chiwo mar cham, makati ma ok oketie thowi, losogi kendo pimogi, bende rito gik moko duto mane ipimogo ngʼeny kod pek gik moko.
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi nyime giwuoth, kendo chiengʼ nopodho ka gichiegni chopo Gibea e piny Benjamin.
english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

kikuyu: Magi gin oganda mongʼanyo nyithindo ma jo-miriambo, ma ok oikore winjo puonj Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD’s law;

kikuyu: Wach mokwongo ma jiwo en ni ji duto mondo oter kwayogi e nyim Nyasaye ka gilamo kendo ka gigoyo erokamano ni Nyasaye
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

kikuyu: mane imiyowa kokalo kuom jotichni ma jonabi, kiwacho ni, ‘Piny ma udonje mondo ukaw en piny mopongʼ gi anjawo mag joge. Kuom timbegi mamono gisepongʼo pinyni gi chido margi koa giko koni nyaka giko kocha.
english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.

kikuyu: Yaye, in kama oger motingʼore mar rito rombe, in ohinga mar Sayun, ibiro duogni duongʼ mari machon; nyar Jerusalem nobed jatelo.”
english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jotham nogero kendo Rangach Mamalo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye bende nongʼinyore gi tich e ohinga e got matin mar Ofel.
english: He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

kikuyu: Mano en wach manade ka uloko bura makare bedo lit, kendo utuono joga gik monego giyudi.
english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

kikuyu: Ka Seth ne ja-higni mia achiel gabich, nonywolo Enosh.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

kikuyu: Ket kar hembi obed maduongʼ, yar ragengʼ mar hembi obed malach, kendo kik idog chien; tud tondene obed maboyo bende igur loyene motegno.
english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

kikuyu: Obiro chopo gima nosechano chon, kendo pod en gi chenro machal kamago mokanona mathoth.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko niya, “Nyiego omaki nikech wachna? Mad ne oganda duto mag Jehova Nyasaye bed jonabi mi oket Roho mare kuomgi!”
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”

kikuyu: Omiyo nogolo Daudi mondo oa bute mi nokete mondo obed jatend jolweny alufu achiel, kendo Daudi notelonegi e lwenje mane gidhiye.
english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

kikuyu: Negiwuoyo kuom thone, mane koro ochiegni chopo ei Jerusalem.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kane Jehu ochopo Samaria, nonego jood Ahab duto mane odongʼ, notiekogi kaluwore gi wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owachone Elija.
english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

kikuyu: To ngʼat moriwore gi Ruoth doko chuny achiel kode.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Yesu nosetieko tiego jopuonjrene apar gariyo, nodhi nyime koa kanyo mondo opuonj kendo oyal e mier mag Galili.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

kikuyu: Joge machwo momewo gin joma ohero lweny. To joge mamoko duto gin jo-miriambo kendo lewgi wacho miriambo.
english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

kikuyu: Lal pach joma timbegi richo, yaye Ruoth, mi lewgi moki e dandgi, nikech aneno ka mahundu gi dhawo opongʼo dala maduongʼ.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

kikuyu: Negikelo gik moko duto mane Musa ochikogi e dho Hemb Romo, kendo oganda duto mar Israel nosudo mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

kikuyu: “Ruoth, gisenego jonabi magi kendo gisemuko kendeni mag misango ma an kenda ema adongʼ, kendo gidwaro nega?”
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ Kenan, Enosh nodak higni mia aboro kod apar gabich kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gochiko ne mar Malothi gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Nikech ok gidew tije mag Jehova Nyasaye kod gik ma lwetene osetimo, obiro mukogi mi ogogi piny kendo ok nochak ogergi mi gichungʼ kendo.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

kikuyu: Ogwende nodar kawuok e uteni, e ute jodongi kod ute mag jogi; to e aora Nael ok giniwuogie.”
english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Okwongʼ jokoro mofuwo maluwo mana gik ma chunjegi giwegi oparo to onge gima giseneno!
english: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

kikuyu: Gitamo ji mondo kik okendre, kendo gisiemogi mondo kik gicham chiemo mamoko ma Nyasaye ochiwo mondo joma oyie kendo mongʼeyo adiera okaw gi erokamano.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

kikuyu: E chuny dhano ochano yore, to Jehova Nyasaye ema telone ondamo mage.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

kikuyu: Nyare mokwongo nochako ni Jemima, mar ariyo Kezia, to mar adek ne en Keren-Hapuk.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

kikuyu: Onego umigi keyo mokwongo mag puotheu kaka cham, divai manyien, gi mo kod yie rombe mukwongo ngʼado,
english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

kikuyu: We chokruoge mag ogendini olwori koni gi koni. Ngʼad negi bura gie kom loch mari man malo;
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osefwenyona ma kawinjo: “Richoni ok nopwodhi nyaka chop thou,” Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Yie mondo michni, ma jatichni osekelo ni ruodha, mondo omi joma luwi.
english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

kikuyu: Onego pak mar Nyasaye obed e dhogi kendo gitingʼ ligangla ma dhoge ariyo e lwetgi,
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudigo nokwaye mondo omed bedo kodgi kanyo to notamore.
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ber mondo wayier ngʼato achiel e kind joma osebedo kodwa, chakre kinde mane Ruoth Yesu ochako bedo kodwa nyaka chop kinde mane okawe e dierwa.
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

kikuyu: Kik uwe Hezekia hou mondo ugen kuom Jehova Nyasaye kowachonu ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye biro resowa adier; kendo dala maduongʼni ok nochiw e lwet ruodh Asuria.’
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

kikuyu: Bangʼe nonyise niya, “Koro dwok lweti ei law.” Kuom mano, Musa nodwoko lwete ei law, kendo kane ogole, lwete nochango modoko machal gi dende duto.
english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.

kikuyu: “Ket turumbete e dhogi mondo igo! Ongo ni ewi od Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ji oseketho singruokna kendo gisekwedo chikna.
english: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

kikuyu: Gisin koda kendo ok gidwara butgi; ok lich negi kata ka gingʼulo olawo e wangʼa.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ka ngʼato orito wachna, to ok notho nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

kikuyu: to kane oyude, nodok kode Antiokia. Kuom higa achiel mangima, Barnaba gi Saulo ne chokore gi kanisa ka gipuonjo ji ma kwan-gi ngʼeny ahinya. Antiokia kuno ema ne okuong luongoe jopuonjre ni jo-Kristo.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

kikuyu: Ne gipogore lepa e kindgi giwegi kendo gigoyo ombulu ne nangana.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

kikuyu: Kik uketh adiera kata dewo wangʼ ngʼato, kik ukaw asoya, nikech asoya dino wenge joma riek kendo omiyo ngʼat makare bedo ngʼama rach.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo gik moko matimore, bed ni en Tho kata Kethruok, omiyo dhano ok dipandne paro manie chunye!
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

kikuyu: Kuom ma, richo mar Jakobo nopwodhi, kendo ma ema nobed ranyisi mar golo richone duto: Komiyo kite duto milosogo kar kendo mar misango chalo mana gi matafare motore matindo tindo, bende onge sirni mag Ashera kata kendo miwangʼoe ubani mane odongʼ kochungʼ.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

kikuyu: Dhorangeye momanyore gi wangʼ yore nolor kendo koko mar rego ok nowinjre maber; kendo kata mana ywak winy machiewou e nindo ok unuwinji.
english: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;

kikuyu: Bende nyaka okel ni jadolo misango mar pwodhruok e richo ni Jehova Nyasaye im maonge songa ma nengone oromo timo misango mipwodhego e kethoneno.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

kikuyu: Kik utim gimoro amora mondo upiem gi ji kata mondo unyisru ne ji, to beduru joma obolore, ka kinde duto ukwano joma moko kaka joma beyo moloyou.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

kikuyu: kod jotij hekalu modak e thur mar Ofel nogedo nyaka kama omanyore gi Dhoranga Pi kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ kod kama otingʼore gi malo maneno.
english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

kikuyu: Bende nochuno ji duto, jomatindo gi jomadongo, jo-mwandu kod jochan, wasumbini gi joma ni thuolo, mondo oket kido e lwetegi ma korachwich kata e lela wengegi,
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

kikuyu: Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Adier kum ni waseyudo nikech owadwa. Ne waneno ka chunye chandore kane osayowa mondo wares ngimane to ne ok wanyal winje. Ma ema omiyo chandruogni osebironwa.”
english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Jehoram, Edom nongʼanyo ne Juda mi gibedo gi ruodhgi giwegi.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

kikuyu: Ngʼama loso bur kendo kunye maber podho e bure mokunyono.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

kikuyu: To nyaka udwar kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseyiero e kind dhoutu duto, mondo Nyinge obedie kaka kar dak mare. Kanyo ema onego udhiye
english: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

kikuyu: “To bende Nyasaye nyalo dak e piny? Kata polo malo kata polo mabor moloyo ok nyal romi. To koro hekalu mageroni, to diromi nade!
english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

kikuyu: Jowetena, adwaro ni mondo ungʼe ni Injili mane ayalonu ok en gimoro ma dhano ema ochuogo.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ ma iyike e liel to liende irito maber.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

kikuyu: Kane iidho idhi malo to ne itelone joma nimako e lweny; kendo ne ikawo mich mane ji omiyi, nyaka mich mane jongʼanyo omiyi, mondo in Jehova Nyasaye, idag kanyo.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

kikuyu: Hazar Gada, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

kikuyu: Anto abiro wer kuom tekoni abiro wero herani gokinyi; nikech in e ohingana, in e kar pondona e kinde mag thagruok.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

kikuyu: “Nyaka gikaw gik moko duto motiyogo e tij dolo e kama ler mar lemo, kendo gibogi gi suka marambulu, kod piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe, bangʼe giketgi e sirni mitingʼego oliero liero.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Gad kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Zefon, joka Zefon; koa kuom Hagai, joka Hagi; koa kuom Shuni, joka Shuni;
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

kikuyu: To Rabshake jatend lweny nodwokogi niya, “Uparo ni un kod ruodhu kendu ema ne ruodha oora iru mondo awachnu wechegi, to ok ne joma obedo ei ohinga; bende ungʼeyo ni jogo kaachiel gi un biro bangʼo chiethgi kendo madho lachgi?”
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

kikuyu: Chutho notuo marach, mi odwa otho. To Nyasaye nokeche, kendo kuom kech mane okechego, an bende nokecha, mondo kik abed gi kuyo manyadiriyo.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

kikuyu: Amiyogi ngima mochwere, kendo ok ginilal ngangʼ, bende onge ngʼama nyalo kawogi kagologi e lweta.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

kikuyu: ok kaka misumba to kaka owadu migeno ma en ngʼat moloyo misumba. En ohala ne an, to angʼeyo ni en ohala moloyo ne in bende, ok mana kaka ngʼato angʼata, to kaka owadu kuom Ruoth.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno ma owangʼogi nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre, bangʼe to onyalo donjo e kambi.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

kikuyu: Aore mondo oduog iri, kata obedo ni chunya ogene ahinya.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

kikuyu: Jo-Avi to noloso Nibhaz kod Tartak, to jo-Sefarvi nochiwo nyithindgi kaka misango ne Adramelek kod Anamelek mane gin nyiseche mag Sefarvaim.
english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhawone jotelogo kendo apenjogi niya, Angʼo momiyo od Nyasaye ojwangʼ? Bangʼe ne aluongogi kanyakla kendo aketogi kuondegi.
english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

kikuyu: Ka iwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye e kar pondona,” kendo iketo Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo kar dakni,
english: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Ma e piny mane asingora ka akwongʼora ne Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo kane awachonegi ni, ‘Pinyni anami nyikwau.’ Aseyie mondo ine pinyni gi wangʼi, to kata kamano ok iningʼad loka midonjie.”
english: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

kikuyu: Jo-ohala mane oloko gigegi kendo obedo momewo nikech gigegego nochungʼ mabor, ka giluor nikech sandruokne. Giniywagi kagidengo,
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

kikuyu: Ji abich mane osetimo nonro matut mar pinyno nodonjo ei ot mokawo kido mopa machalo gi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, gi nyiseche manono mag udi, kod mago mopa, ka jadolo kod jolweny mia auchiel to ochungʼ e dhorangach.
english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

kikuyu: “Yo miluwo kidhi dala ler en mane? Mudho to odak kanye?
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

kikuyu: E kindego jogi kod Jerusalem nonyisi niya, “Yamo maliet moa kama gimoro ok nyagie mana kama otwo futo kadhi ir joga, to ok mondo okwadhgi kata pwodhogi;
english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

kikuyu: Ne nitiere farese mia abiriyo gi piero adek gauchiel (736) kod kanyna mia ariyo gi piero angʼwen gabich (245)
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

kikuyu: Gibutno e tong thuonde, kendo gichweyo mbuyi mar otiengʼ-otiengʼ. Ngʼato angʼata mochamo tongʼ-gi biro tho kendo kamoro oto to nyathi fu ema wuokie.
english: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

kikuyu: nyikwa Ara, ji mia auchiel gi piero abich gariyo (652),
english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi odhi Filistia mondo giked gi Saulo, jo-Manase moko noweyo Saulo moriwore gi Daudi. Daudi to gi joge ne ok okonyo jo-Filistia nimar ka jotendgi ne osewuoyo kendgi negiriembe kagiwacho niya, “Onyalo negowa ka dipo ni odok ir ruodhe Saulo.”
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ja-Lawino noyie dak kode, kendo wuowino ne chalone mana kaka achiel kuom yawuote.
english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

kikuyu: Asenyono olemo mibiyo kenda; kendo ngʼato angʼata moa kuom ogendini mane ni koda. Ne anyonogi piny kakecho kendo ka an-gi mirima mager; mi rembgi okirore e lepa kendo omiyo lepa duto otimo remo.
english: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

kikuyu: To ka ok unyal yie mondo oteru nyangu to wabiro kawo nyaminwa mi wadhigo.”
english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

kikuyu: “Wachne jo-Israel ni, ‘Ka dichwo otho ma ok onywolo wuowi, to ipog nyathine ma nyako girkeni mare.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

kikuyu: Eka Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel kod Jeshua wuod Jozadak nowuok mondo oti tij gedo mar od Nyasaye e Jerusalem. Kendo jonabi mag Nyasaye ne ni kodgi, kakonyogi.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

kikuyu: Nabal nodwoko jotich Daudi niya, “Daudi-ni to en ngʼa? Wuod Jesseni to en ngʼa? Jotich mangʼeny ndaloni ngʼanyo ne ruodhigi.
english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Josef kaluwore gi anywola margi kokalo kuom Manase kod Efraim ne gin:
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Mwandu onge gi ohala e ndalo mar mirima, to tim makare reso ngʼato e tho.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: kata obedo ni an awuon an-gi gimomiyo anyalo bedo gi genono. Kapo ni ngʼato nyalo bedo gi gimomiyo dodhialre e ringruok, an awuon daloye:
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

kikuyu: Gedor, Ahio, Zekaria kod Mikloth.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

kikuyu: ngamia mia angʼwen gi piero adek gabich (435) kod punde alufu auchiel mia abiriyo gi piero ariyo (6,720).
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

kikuyu: Jonathan nowachone niya, “Koro bi, wangʼad wadhi irgi mondo omi ginewa.
english: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

kikuyu: kendo kupuonjogi mondo gitim gik moko duto ma asechikou. To awachonu adier ni an kodu ndalo duto, nyaka giko mar ndalo.”
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

kikuyu: Kata mana sani kisomo chik Musa to ragengʼno pod oumo chunygi.
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny penjo niya, “En ngʼa manyalo timonwa gimoro maber?” Mad ler moa e lela wangʼi rieny kuomwa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

kikuyu: Kata kamano jodolo ne nok ahinya mane ok nyal yangʼo chiayo mar misango miwangʼo pep; omiyo jowetegi ma jo-Lawi nokonyogi nyaka negitieko tich kendo nyaka jodolo moko notieko pwodhore, nimar jo-Lawi ne jokinda kuom pwodhruokgi moloyo jodolo.
english: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

kikuyu: Ka iyawo lweti to gik mangima duto yudo konyruokgi duto.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Isebedo ka iwachona ni, ‘Telne jogi,’ to pok imiya ngʼeyo ngʼatno ma ibiro oro koda. Isewacho niya, ‘Angʼeyi gi nyingi kendo amor kodi.’
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

kikuyu: To ne aparo ni, “Magi gin mana joma odhier; kendo gifuwo; nimar ok gingʼeyo yor Jehova Nyasaye kod dwaro mar Nyasachgi.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the LORD’s way, nor the law of their God.

kikuyu: “Yesu ja-Nazareth, en angʼo midwaro timonwa? Isebiro mondo itiekwa koso? Angʼeyo ni in Ngʼat Maler Mar Nyasaye!”
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Joma odhier ubiro bedogo e dieru kinde duto, to an ok ubi siko koda ndalo duto.”
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

kikuyu: Ruoth nongʼad rieko ne joma oseweyo singruokgi, to kata kamano joma ongʼeyo Nyasachgi nochungʼ motegno.
english: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.

kikuyu: nikech le moro amora manie bungu en mara, kaachiel gi jamni makwayo ewi gode gana achiel.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

kikuyu: Abisalom noringo modhi ir Talmai wuod Amihud ruodh Geshur. To Ruoth Daudi noywago wuode pile pile.
english: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

kikuyu: Azaria wuod Nathan ma jatend jodong gwengʼ, Zabud wuod Nathan jadolo kendo jangʼad ni ruoth rieko;
english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;

kikuyu: To ne ok gichiko itgi kata winja. Tokgi ne tek ta kendo negitimo gik maricho moloyo mag kweregi.’
english: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar joma oyie kuom Kristo man Asia ooronu mos. Akula gi Priskila, kaachiel gi kanisa machokore e odgi, ooronu mos gi mor kuom Ruoth.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

kikuyu: To boche duto mogol kuom rwath mochiw kaka misango mar golo richo noket tenge gi boche moumo jamb-ich kod boche mamoko molwore,
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: Ka jadolo Pashur wuod Imer, jatelo maduongʼ manie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, nowinjo Jeremia kakoro gigie,
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the LORD’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

kikuyu: To Saulo nowacho niya, “Onge ngʼama inego kawuono nikech kawuono Jehova Nyasaye osereso Israel.”
english: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today the LORD has rescued Israel.”

kikuyu: Abiro paki e dier ogendini, yaye Jehova Nyasaye. Abiro werni e dier ogendini.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

kikuyu: Kane Petro pod wacho wechegi, Roho Maler nolor kuom ji duto mane oyudo winjo wachne.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aa malo mi awuok adhi oko e pap, kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼ kanyo, machal gi duongʼ manoyudo aseneno e bath Aora Kebar, mine apodho auma.
english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

kikuyu: Nyaka ichiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo jodolo nyaka kir chumbi kuomgi kendo otim kodgi misango kaka misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall bring them near to the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kapod in kanyo iwuoyo gi ruoth, abiro donjo kanyo kendo siro weche duto misewacho.”
english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada ne jalweny mathuon moa Kabzel, notimo timbe madongo. Nonego ji ariyo mag Moab mane ger ka sibuor. Chiengʼ moro nodonjo e bur ka piny otimo pe mi onego sibuor.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Ayub notho, ka en jaduongʼ moti ma hike oniangʼ.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

kikuyu: Ne iume gi kut mana kaka nanga mi pige obiwore moyombo gode.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

kikuyu: Mad joma oluori bed mamor ka ginena, nimar aseketo genona e wachni.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

kikuyu: Kefa Amoni, Ofni kod Geba. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gariyo.
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Jogi ok omer kaka uwachono nikech pod en mana sa adek okinyi sani ok ngʼato nyal merie!
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi Misri ka ok giluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma gichopo nyaka Tapanhes.
english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey the LORD’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.

kikuyu: E kinde mane gidak kuno mokwongo ne ok gilamo Jehova Nyasaye; omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nooro sibuoche e diergi monego jogi moko.
english: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear the LORD. Therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo jadolo nyaka none kendo, to ka kama litno oserumo kendo pod ok olandore e del, to jadolo noland ni oler; en mana kama oluro. Ngʼatno nyaka luok lepe, kendo enobed maler.
english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

kikuyu: To sano sano ka ji duto noneno Yesu, negiyil mi giringo ire mondo gimose.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

kikuyu: Kane oneno Elija, nowachone niya, “Mano en in, jakel chandruok ni Israel-ni?”
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

kikuyu: Singruok maru gi tho nobed maonge; kendo winjruok mane utimo gi liete ok nobedi. Ka masira nomwomre, to mano ema nochwadu piny.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

kikuyu: e hike mar piero ariyo gadek, jo-Yahudi mia abiriyo gi piero angʼwen gabich mane oter e twech gi Nebuzaradan jatend lweny. Giduto ne gin ji alufu angʼwen mia auchiel.
english: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo odwogo koa e puodho godhiambono, Lea nodhi moromone. Lea nowachone niya, “Nyaka ibed koda e achiel kawuono, nikech asechulo nengo mar nindoni e oda gi mandrake mar wuoda.” Kuom mano Jakobo nobedoe achiel gi Lea otienono.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

kikuyu: Chwo bende noluwo mana yo machalre; kar riwruok gi mon e yo mowinjore, to dendgi noowore gi gombo chwo wetegi. Chwo notimo timbe dwanyruok gi chwo wetegi, kendo timgino nomiyo giyudo kum e dendgi giwegi mowinjore gi kethogino.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo nying winyo ka winyo manie wi gode, kendo gik mochwe duto manie pewe gin maga.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

kikuyu: Uchamo ringre joga, uyiecho pien dendgi, kendo utoyo chokegi matindo tindo. Ukengogi ka ringʼo midwa chielo, ka ringʼo midwa tedo e agulu?”
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

kikuyu: Atai mar auchiel, Eliel mar abiriyo,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

kikuyu: To ngʼat ma jaketho machielo nokwere niya, “Ok iluoro Nyasaye, nomedo wachoni, nimar in e bwo kum achielno?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

kikuyu: To noyudo kweth maduongʼ mag anguro moko kwayo e bath got mane ni machiegni kanyo.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ununyon joma timbegi richo piny; kendo ginibed buru e bwo tiendu odiechiengʼ ma anatimie gigi,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Sharaim, Adithaim, kod Gedera (kata Gederothaim). Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo apar gangʼwen.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Bende nogolo koa e hekalu mar Babulon gige dhahabu gi fedha mar od Nyasaye, gigo mane Nebukadneza okawo koa e hekalu man Jerusalem kendo okelo e hekalu man Babulon. Bangʼe Ruoth Sairas nomiyogi ngʼat ma nyinge Sheshbaza, mane osewalo jatelo,
english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

kikuyu: Gi dwol maduongʼ nomor kowacho niya, “In dhako mogwedhi kuom mon, kendo nyathi ma ibiro nywolo bende ogwedhi!
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

kikuyu: Weuru wanon timbewa kendo wapar ane kaka gichalo, eka wadog ir Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka misango mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kod chiwo mar cham gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Yieuni kod herau owuok kuom gima ugeno yudo mokannu maber e polo. Ma en e Injili mane obironu mokwongo ma uwinjo kendo urwako, en e wach geno mane akelo.
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

kikuyu: Dhorangeyeni biro siko ka oyaw, ok nochieg-gi odiechiengʼ kata otieno, mondo owe thuolo ogendini okelni mwandu moa e pinje ka ruodhigi otelonegi.
english: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

kikuyu: Wasiki biro rwako wichkuot ka law, kendo miech joma timbegi richo ok nochak one kendo.”
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Hezekia ruodh Juda nooro wach ne ruodh Asuria ka en Lakish kowacho kama: “Aseketho, koro yie iwe kedo koda nikech abiro chulo gimoro amora midwaro.” Ruodh Asuria nokawo kuom Hezekia ruodh Juda fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu apar gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu achiel.
english: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Musa niya, “Ndaloni mar tho koro chiegni. Omiyo biuru gi Joshua mondo uchungʼ e dho Hemb Romo kama abiro miye tich.” Eka Musa kod Joshua nobiro mochungʼ e dho Hemb Romo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Mondeu, nyithindu kod kweth mag jambu nyalo dak e piny mane Musa omiyou yo ka wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, makmana jou makedo duto, moikore gi gige lweny, nyaka uidh loka kutelo e nyim oweteu ma jo-Israel. Konyuru oweteu,
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

kikuyu: Ka Kristo, ma en ngimau nofwenyre, to un bende unubi kode e duongʼne maler.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

kikuyu: Kendo kane Nyasaye ochika mondo awuog e od wuora mondo awuoth e pinje mamoko, nawachone Sara ni, ‘Mae kaka inyalo nyisa ni ihera: Kamoro amora ma wadhiye wach niya, “An owadu.” ’ ”
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

kikuyu: Kata kamano dwondgi chopo kuonde duto e piny, wechegi osechopo nyaka e tunge piny. Osechungo hema e kor polo ne wangʼ chiengʼ,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

kikuyu: Negiwachonegi niya, “Jogi gin osiepewa. We gidag e pinywa kendo gilokie; pinywani duongʼ moromogi. Wanyalo kendo nyigi kendo gin bende ginyalo kendo nyiwa.
english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

kikuyu: “Un duto weyauru kendo dhiuru mabor nikech ok aneno ngʼama riek kuomu-ka.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ler mondo obedie,” mi ler nobetie.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

kikuyu: Daudi nogero kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye kanyo kendo nochiwo misengini miwangʼo pep kaachiel misengini mag lalruok. Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo lamo mane olemogo ni piny, kendo nogengʼo masira mane ni e piny Israel.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

kikuyu: Kik iwuo ne ngʼat mofuwo, nikech obiro chayo rieko mag wechegi.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

kikuyu: Goshen, Holon, kod Gilo. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gachiel.
english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye iye nowangʼ gi Solomon nikech chunye noselokore moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel mane osefwenyorene nyadiriyo.
english: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

kikuyu: To kaka ne en gi chuny malit kochandore, nolemo matek ahinya, kendo luya ne chotne kandongʼ piny mana ka remo.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Misri otimo ngʼwono ne jo-Israel kendo ne gimiyogi gimoro amora mane gikwayogi; kamano e kaka jo-Israel noyako gige jo-Misri.
english: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

kikuyu: “ ‘Weuru lowo tenge ma lachne romo fut alufu abiriyo gi mia abich, to borne romo fut alufu piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich ni dala maduongʼ, enobed mogoyo tongʼ gi lowo mowal ni Nyasayeno kendo nobed mar jo-Israel duto.
english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nokano wachni e chunygi, ka gipenjore e chunygi tiend “chier aa kuom joma otho.”
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

kikuyu: Joma noa Juda, Benjamin, Efraim kod Manase mane odak Jerusalem ne gin:
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

kikuyu: Ochomgi motegno moro gi moro; kendo gimoko ma ok nyal pog-gi.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

kikuyu: Nokiro mo moko ewi kendo mar misango nyadibiriyo, mowire kaachiel gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono gi karaya mar luokruok gi rachungine, kendo nopwodhogi.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

kikuyu: Jeftha nodwoko niya, An kod joga ne wanie kedo mager gi jo-Amon, ne waluongou to ne utamoru biro resowa e lwetgi.
english: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.

kikuyu: Ogandani ger mana ka sibuor madhako; kendo gijuol ka sibuor madichwo, ma ok nyal nindo piny nyaka ocham gima onego momadh rembe.”
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

kikuyu: Maluwogi ne en dhood Asher. Jatend dhood Asher ne en Pagiel wuod Okran.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Ne olosone mirimbe yo maluwo, kendo ne ok okechogi e tho, to ne ojwangʼogi, mondo tho otiekgi.
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni usengʼeyo tiend wach mawacho ni, ‘Gima adwaro en ni ukech joweteu to ok ni uchiwna misango,’to dine ok ungʼado bura ne joma onge ketho.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼeyo parogi mi nowachonegi niya, “Pinyruoth moro amora mopogore owuon nyaka kethre, kendo ot mantiere gi pogruok biro gore piny.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

kikuyu: Mano kaka ijaber kendo imiya mor, mano kaka imora, yaye jaherana!
english: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Kik uchik itu ne gigo ma jonabi koronu; gipongʼo itu gi geno mag miriambo. Giwachonu fweny moa e pachgi giwegi, ok moa e dho Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.

kikuyu: Piny Juda nomi luoro maduongʼ omak jo-Misri. Ji duto ma nowinj nying Juda kihondko nogo, nikech gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechano timonegi.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.

kikuyu: Ne otelonegi e yo moriere tir, nyaka negichopo e dala, mane ginyalo dakie.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

kikuyu: E sa ma pilni mach ne dhwolore koa e kendo mar misango kochiko polo, malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nodhi malo koluwo pilni mach. Kane gineno ma, Manoa gi chiege nopodho piny auma.
english: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, the LORD’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

kikuyu: Jo-Sidon gi Arvad ema ne kiewoni ngai; yaye Turo, jogi molony ema ne jokwangʼ kaka jogi ma jonam.
english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osekelou e piny mudhiye mondo ukaw obed maru, to nyaka uhul weche gweth e got Gerizim, to weche mag kwongʼ to uhul e got Ebal.
english: It shall happen, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

kikuyu: Puonja mondo alu yoreni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, eka abiro ritogi nyaka giko.
english: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

kikuyu: Wabiro ngʼado ka wadhi loka Kanaan e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka wamanore gi gige lweny, to pok ma wabiro yudo biro bedo loka koni mar Jordan.”
english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano joma ni chien mogik nobed mokwongo, to joma okwongo nobed chien mogik.”
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

kikuyu: “To kuom jadak ma ok achiel kuom jogi Israel moa e piny mabor nikech nyingi,
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Dhano koro osebedo machal kodwa, kongʼeyo ber kod rach. Kik yiene mondo oter lwete kendo okaw olemb ngima kendo ocham madimi odag nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

kikuyu: To in, kendo kaka ngʼama duongʼne owetene, amiyi lowo mane akawo kuom jo-Amor gi ligangla kod atungʼ.”
english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

kikuyu: Zipora nonywolo wuowi mi Musa nochako nyinge ni Gershom, kowacho niya, “Asedoko jadak e piny ma ok marwa.”
english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”

kikuyu: omiyo Daudi nooro ngʼato mondo odhi onon ni en dhako mane. Ngʼatno nowacho, “Donge mano en Bathsheba, ma nyar Eliam ma chi Uria ja-Hiti?”
english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

kikuyu: To dhood Dan ne nigi pek kuom kawo pok mar pinygi, omiyo negidhi ma gimonjo Leshem mi gikawe, bangʼe ginegogi gi ligangla. Negidak Leshem kendo ma gichake ni Dan mane en kwargi.
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

kikuyu: Joka Manase ne gin: Asriel ne nyakware koa kuom dhako machielo ma nyar Aram. Dhakoni nonywolo Makir mane wuon Gilead.
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Heshbon kod Jazer, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

kikuyu: Ka tuono landore e del, to jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ogak; nikech en tuo malandore.
english: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne waluoro Musa, bende e kaka wabiro luoroi. Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu bed kodi kaka nobedo gi Musa.
english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

kikuyu: Kane giwuotho ka gikalo negiwacho niya, “Otieno ma kawuono wabiro bworo Geba.” Jo-Rama kibaji ogoyo; to Gibea ma jo-dala Saulo joringo dhi.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

kikuyu: To ka gima kamano ok oromo e nyim wangʼi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, to isewuoyo kuom gima biro timore e od jatichni. Isengʼiya mana ka gima an ngʼat motingʼ malo moloyo ji duto, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.

kikuyu: Adier wiyi nowil gi chandruokni, Mana ka koth mochwe ochok ma wich osewilgo.
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

kikuyu: Kiep piny gi yo podho chiengʼ nogiki e Nam Mediterania nyaka kama ngʼiyore gi Lebo Hamath. Ma ema nobed tongʼ man yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

kikuyu: Kata kama nitiere ber moko kuomi nikech isegolo e piny sirni milamo mag Ashera kendo chunyi bende iseketo mondo omany Nyasaye.”
english: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

kikuyu: Piny nobedo mamor koyudo yweyone mag Sabato, kinde duto mane odongʼ gunda, nyaka higni piero abiriyo orumo mana kaka wach Jehova Nyasaye nowacho gi dho Jeremia.
english: to fulfill the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo gik moko duto kuom Efraim; onge gima opondona kuom jo-Israel. Efraim, un to usedoko kaka ochot; to jo-Israel timo timbe modwanyore.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

kikuyu: moro ka moro kuom ji ariyogi mane gin jatend jogam divai kod jatend joted makati mar ruodh Misri mane oyudo otwe, noleko lek otienono moro ka moro, kendo lek ka lek ne nigi tiende mopogore gi machielo.
english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

kikuyu: kendo ok okele e dho Hemb Romo mondo otimgo ni Jehova Nyasaye misango, to ngʼatno nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandagi.
english: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Eka norango Daudi konone moneno ni en mana rawera ma silwal, ma jaber, mine obuone.
english: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.

kikuyu: Daudi notweyo liganglane ewi law mi notemo wuothogo nikech ne ok ongʼiyo gi gigo. Nowachone Saulo niya, “Ok anyal dhi gi gigi nikech ok angʼiyo kodgi.” Omiyo nogonyogi oko.
english: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.

kikuyu: Kane uyudo utho e richou gi kit ngimau ma ok ter nyangu, Nyasaye ne omiyo udoko mangima kuom Kristo. Noweyonwa richowa duto,
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

kikuyu: Pagiel wuod Okran, ma jatend joka Asher, nokelo misango mare odiechiengʼ mar apar gachiel.
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

kikuyu: Omiyo Solomon nobet e kom loch wuon mare Daudi, kendo lochne nogurore.
english: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.

kikuyu: To jadolo maduongʼ moro mar jo-Yahudi miluongo ni Sekewa ne nigi yawuowi abiriyo mane timo kamano.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

kikuyu: Nochweyogi dichwo gi dhako kendo ogwedhogi kendo kane ochwegi, nochakogi ni “dhano.”
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

kikuyu: Eka Daniel nodok e ode kendo nonyiso osiepene ma Hanania, Mishael kod Azaria wachno.
english: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik ni mondo oyiene ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo omadh gima odwaro, nimar ruoth nosegolo chik ne jotich mapogo divai ni mondo omi ngʼato ka ngʼato math modwaro.
english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

kikuyu: Abiro muko ohinga ma usewiro gi lowo maracharno mi opie piny kendo mise mare ema none kodongʼ. E kinde ma ohingano noruombre piny, to un bende notieku; kendo unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
