english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: To kane giwachone gik moko duto mane Josef osewachonegi kendo kane oneno geche mane Josef oseoro mondo odhi otere ire, chuny Jakobo wuon-gi noduogo.
english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kosekawo kikombe, nogoyo erokamano kendo wacho niya, “Kawuru ma kendo upogru uwegi.
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

kikuyu: Farao biro paro kowacho ni, ‘Jo-Israel digni e piny korwenyo e thim.’
english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

kikuyu: Kawuononi iseneno gi wangʼi kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne oketi e lweta ei rogo. Jomoko ne owachona ni anegi, to ne aweyi; mi awacho ni, ‘Ok natingʼ lweta mar hinyo ruodha nikech en ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir.’
english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the LORD’s anointed.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “E kindeno sigingi mane ogur motegno kendo mongirore biro pudhore, nongʼade mi olwar kendo gik moko duto mongʼaw kuome bende nolwar.” Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Koro piny nokethore e nyim Nyasaye kendo opongʼ gi timbe mahundu.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisejare kamano, ne gilonyo kandhono oko bangʼe girwakone lepe owuon. Eka ne giwuok gidhi kode mondo gidhi gigure.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ochiwo dala maduongʼno e lwetu, to neguru ji duto man kanyo gi ligangla.
english: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

kikuyu: rwakreuru gi ikruok mar lando Injili makelo kwe kaka wuoche e tiendu.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kikuyu: Bende noloso agulni gi opewni kod tewni mag kiro remo. Kamano Huram notieko tich duto mane otimo ne ruoth Solomon e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye:
english: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD’s house:

kikuyu: Ere tiende mondo ngʼat mofuwo obed gi pesa nimar oonge gi dwaro mar bedo mariek?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Jehu niya, “Nikech isetimo maber mondo ichop gima nikare e wangʼa kendo isetimo ne od Ahab gik mane ni e pacha, ogandani nobed e loch mar Israel nyaka tiengʼ mar angʼwen.”
english: The LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

kikuyu: Omiyo noringo modhi ir Simon Petro kod japuonjre machielo mane Yesu ohero, kendo nowachonegi niya, “Gisekawo ringre Ruoth gigolo e liel kama noyike, kendo koro wakia kama giketee!”
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ber kendo herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ; adierane ochwere e tienge duto.
english: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nomako owetegi alufu mia ariyo mane gin mon kod yawuowi kod nyiri. Bende ne giyako mwandu mangʼeny mane gitingʼo gidwoko Samaria.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

kikuyu: Nowachone ruoth niya, “Kare humb timbeni kod riekoni mane awinjo e pinya awuon en adier!
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

kikuyu: Kane Barnaba gi Saulo nosetieko tijgi, negidwogo ka gia Jerusalem ka gin gi Johana ma bende iluongo ni Mariko.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

kikuyu: To koro Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha osemiya yweyo kuom pinje duto molwora bende onge Jawasigu kata masira moro amora.
english: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

kikuyu: “Rapim mar kendo mar misango mar hekalu ne chalo kama: bor mar wi gima noketie kendo mar misango ne romo fut achiel gi nus, kendo nolach moloyo kendono gi nus mar fut. Bethene koni gi koni notingʼore malo moloyo nus mar fut. To bor modhi malo mar kendo mar misango ema:
english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

kikuyu: To kaka pod ithago joga kendo itamori weyogi mondo gidhi,
english: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka her chiege mana kaka oherore owuon kendo dhako nyaka luor chwore.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

kikuyu: Moko kuom joma ne ni kanyo nyiego nomako mi gikuotho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Morni iketho malit kayiem nangʼo?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

kikuyu: Ok en Nyasach joma otho, to mar joma ngima, nikech kuome ji duto ngima.”
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

kikuyu: Pi noimo gode kendo omedo gingore moloyo fut piero ariyo
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

kikuyu: Omiyo Obadia nodhi romo ne Ahab monyise ni Elija ni ka. Omiyo Ahab nodhi oromo ne Elija.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

kikuyu: Ikonyo joma nigi mor mar timo gik makare, ma gin joma paro yoregi. To kane wadhi nyime gi ketho e nyimi, to iyi nowangʼ. To koro ere kaka inyalo reswa?
english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

kikuyu: Nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach, to Jehova Nyasaye ne ok odwoke e yor lek kata gi Urim kata gi dho jonabi.
english: When Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

kikuyu: kendo Roho Maler mane obiro e kido mar akuru nolor mopiyo kuome, to dwol noa e polo mawacho niya, “In e Wuoda, ma ahero; chunya mor kodi.”
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Amor ahinya ni anyalo bedo gi geno kuomu chuth.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

kikuyu: “Ka oringo mi obiro e achiel kuom mier madongogi, to nyaka ochungʼ e dhorangach mar dala maduongʼ mondo owach malongʼo chandruok mare e nyim jotend dala maduongʼno. Bangʼ mano to girwake ei dalagi maduongʼno kendo gimiye kama odakie kodgi.
english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

kikuyu: Paruruane chiengʼ mane uchungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e Horeb, kane owachona niya, “Chok ji e nyima ka mondo giwinj wechena mondo mi gipuonjre luora ndalo duto mag ngimagi kendo bende gipuonj nyithindgi wechegi.”
english: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

kikuyu: Ne ok owacho wachni gi pache owuon, to kaka ne en jadolo maduongʼ e higano, nokoro wach ni Yesu ne biro tho ne piny jo-Yahudi,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

kikuyu: Amazia wuod Joash ruodh Juda nodak higni apar gabich bangʼ tho Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz ruodh Israel.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

kikuyu: Erokamano ne Nyasaye kuom Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa! Kuom mano, an awuon gi ei pacha an misumba mar chik Nyasaye, to kuom kita mar richo, an misumba mar chik mar richo.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

kikuyu: Gouru turumbete e Sayun, landuru lemo mar riyo kech maler, luonguru chokruok maler.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.

kikuyu: Noneno bende dhako moro modhier ma chwore notho ka keto pesa mamingli ariyo matindo tindo.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Nitie wi lwanda moro buta ka ma inyalo chungʼie.
english: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

kikuyu: Nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Chunya opongʼ gi lit nyaka kar tho. Beduru ka mondo uriti.”
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

kikuyu: Ne ogoyo nyithindo makayo mag Misri, nyithindo makayo mag dhano kod le.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

kikuyu: Tiekgi duto kaka jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechikou.
english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the LORD your God has commanded you;

kikuyu: Yie iwinj ywakna, nimar an-gi chandruok maduongʼ; resa e lwet joma lawa nimar gitek moloya mabor.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noloso puodho ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar Eden, kendo noketoe dhano mane osechweyo.
english: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

kikuyu: Musa, Harun kod jotend oganda mar jo-Israel nokwano jo-Kohath kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi.
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: mondo mi ogurre kendo nyingi obed maduongʼ nyaka chiengʼ. Eka ji biro wacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, en Nyasach jo-Israel!’ Kendo dhood jatichni Daudi nogurre e nyimi.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

kikuyu: Dhi sani ir jopinyu manie twech kendo iwuo kodgi, bed ni giyie winji kata gidagi. Wach nigi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho, kata giyie winji kata gidagi.”
english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

kikuyu: Ajuoke nowacho ne Farao niya, “Ma en lwet Nyasaye!” To kata kamano chuny Farao ne tek kendo ne ok onyal winjo wach Musa gi Harun mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho.
english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

kikuyu: kendo negichokore mondo giked gi Musa. Kaachiel kodgi ne nitiere jo-Israel mia ariyo gi piero abich, ma jotend oganda mongʼere mane oseyier kaka jakanyo mar bura.
english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

kikuyu: Ka jatend lweny noyudo Jeremia, nowachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi nochiko masirani ne pinyni.”
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God pronounced this evil on this place;

kikuyu: Wangʼ teko, chuny mar sunga kod taya mar jo-mahundu, gin richo!
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

kikuyu: Giyiengʼ gi richo mag joga, bende gimor gi timbegi maricho.
english: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nochiko jopuonjrene mondo ochan ji e migepe matindo tindo, ka gibet e lum mangʼich.
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

kikuyu: Nimar ka uweyo ne ji ka gikethonu, eka Wuonu manie polo biro weyonu.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

kikuyu: Kamano, ji mangʼeny noyie kuom Yesu kanyo.
english: Many believed in him there.

kikuyu: To mondo kik wachwanygi, dhi e nam mondo ichik olopi; kaw rech mimako mokwongo; yaw dhoge, kendo ibiro yudo pesa moromo shekel achiel. Kawe imiye jogo kaka osucha kod mari.”
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

kikuyu: Eka japuonj chik nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Japuonj, abiro luwi kamoro amora midhiye.”
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

kikuyu: Ne, nitie dala moro matin machiegni manyalo ringo mondo atonyie. En mana dalano omiyo yienwauru mondo omi wachop kuno kendo wares ngimawa.”
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “An akia kata ka en jaricho kata ka ok en. Gimoro achiel kende ema angʼeyo: Ni chon ne an muofu, to sani koro aneno!”
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Jal Maler mar Israel, kendo Jachwechne wacho: Kuom gigo mabiro timore, bende inyalo penja kuom nyithinda, kata miya chik kuom tich lweta?
english: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!

kikuyu: Kuom mano puodhono gi bur mane nitie jo-Hiti nomiyo Ibrahim kaka kare mar yiko.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko Daudi nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach niya, “Bende anyalo dhi e achiel kuom miech Juda?” Jehova Nyasaye ne odwoke niya, “Dhiyo.” Daudi nopenjo niya, “Adhi kanye?” Jehova Nyasaye ne odwoke niya, “Dhi Hebron.”
english: After this, David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” The LORD said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

kikuyu: To un, nyaguru kendo umedru; nywolreuru e piny kendo upongʼe.”
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

kikuyu: Eka ne afwenyo ni ber kendo longʼo mondo dhano ochiem kendo omethi, kendo mondo oyud mor e tichne matek motimo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ e kinde matin mar ngimane ma Nyasaye osemiye, nimar mano e pokne kende.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

kikuyu: Kaw pesa mar pwodhruokno kuom jo-Israel kendo kete e tich mar Hemb Romo. Enobed Rapar ni jo-Israel e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka utimogo pwodhruok ni ngimau.”
english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”

kikuyu: To nikech piny ne ngʼich, jotich gi jotelo nochungʼ kolworo mach manoyudo gisemoko mondo gio. Petro bende nochungʼ kodgi kanyo kaoyo mach.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

kikuyu: Laru ma iye bende ne nigi rangach moro mochomo yo milambo, kendo ne opimo rangajni nyaka rangach ma oko man yo milambo. En noromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich.
english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

kikuyu: Nikech chuny ema gik maricho kaka; paro maricho, nek, terruok, chode, kuo, hango wach, gi ketho nying ji wuokie.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

kikuyu: Bende nitie gimoro amora marach ma lewa osewacho? Donge an gi rieko mar ngʼeyo gima ok owinjore?
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

kikuyu: mane gisandogo ogendini pile gi gero ka gigoyogi maonge yweyo, kendo ka gitiyogi gi gero malich maonge giko.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

kikuyu: Aidha kata obedo ni onyamo kambula to ombongʼ tiende ok opogore, kik uchame nikech ok oler.
english: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Mosnauru Filologo gi Julia gi Nerea kod nyamin mare; gi Olumpa kod jomaler duto man kodgi.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

kikuyu: “Tiuru tijeu kuom ndalo auchiel, to e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo kik uti tich moro amora mondo omi rwethu kod pundeu oyud yweyo kendo misumba monywol e uteu kaachiel gi jodak bende nyalo yudo yweyo.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

kikuyu: Bende nitiere ngʼama nyalo kwano jolweny mag Nyasaye? En ngʼa ma ok nyal neno ler Nyasaye karieny?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

kikuyu: Ruodhi mag piny osebiro kanyakla kendo jotelo pimo wach kaachiel, mondo giked gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo giked gi Ngʼate mowir.’
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

kikuyu: An maua madungʼ tik mamit mag Sharon, bende an ondanyo madongo e holo.
english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

kikuyu: ka dende orito maber, kendo chokene otegno.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

kikuyu: Kamano un bende mon luoruru chwou, mondo ka moko kuomgi pok oyie to gilokre, ok nikech wecheu to nikech timbeu maler,
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

kikuyu: “Nochweyo piny gi tekone; ne ochako piny gi riekone, kendo oyaro polo gi ngʼeyo mare.
english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

kikuyu: Jogi ochiko obadho ne gin giwegi, kendo gin ema ginimokie!
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

kikuyu: mago notigo tije madwaro dhahabu kod fedha kod tije duto ma jotich molony dwaro timo. To koro ere ngʼat moyie mondo ochiwre ne Jehova Nyasaye kawuono?”
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne gingʼielo kidino oko. Eka Yesu nongʼiyo malo mowacho niya, “Wuora, agoyoni erokamano nikech isewinja.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Ji duto ne luoro omako kendo negipako Nyasaye. Negiwacho niya, “Janabi maduongʼ osewuok e dierwa. Nyasaye osebiro konyo joge.”
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

kikuyu: Nikech riyo nohewe ahinya, noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Isemiyo jatichni loch maduongʼ kama. Tangʼ atho gi riyo kendo alwar e lwet joma ok oter nyangu?”
english: He was very thirsty, and called on the LORD and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

kikuyu: “Abiro golo kuomi masiche mane ochan ni biro timore kuomi e kinde mag sewni moyier, nikech gisebedo tingʼ mapek kuomi kendo gisemiyi wichkuot.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

kikuyu: Paulo nodondo yien moko mokelo mondo omedi e mach, to kane oyudo oketo yien-go e mach, thuol moro ne liet mar mach ogolo momoko e lwete.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

kikuyu: Gin gi it, to ok ginyal winjo wach, kendo kata mana muya onge e dhogi.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, joote noor modhi nyaka Antiokia. Bangʼ chopo, negichoko kanisa kaachiel mi gimiyogi baruwano.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny marito ruoth nokawo gik moko duto molos gi dhahabu kata fedha ma gin gima iwangʼoe ubani kod bakunde mitimogo misengini.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik mondo neg-gi Ribla kanyo, e piny jo-Hamath. Omiyo Juda noter e twech mabor gi pinye owuon.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

kikuyu: Jogi nowachonegi niya, “Jo-Galili, angʼo momiyo uchungʼ ka ungʼiyo polo? Yesu owuon-ni, makoro osegol kuomu oter e polo, biro duogo kendo, mana kaka usenene kodhino.”
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

kikuyu: Johanan nonywolo Azaria. En ema ne otiyo kaka jadolo e hekalu mane Solomon ogero Jerusalem.
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nikech “odongʼ mana kinde matin kende, eka Jal monego bi, nobi, kendo ok nodeki.”
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

kikuyu: E dwe mar abich mar higa nogono, higa mar angʼwen, e chakruok mar loch mar Zedekia ruodh Juda, janabi Hanania wuod Azur, manoa Gibeon, nowachona e od Jehova Nyasaye e nyim jodolo kod ji duto ni:
english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the LORD’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

kikuyu: Eka ne gipuonje Wach Ruoth, kod ji duto mane ni e ode.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

kikuyu: Bepe mag tat odwa gin mag sida; kendo bede yien mokar mag obudo nobednwa tado.
english: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.

kikuyu: “Ne uwinjo ka awacho niya, ‘Adhi to abiro duogo iru kendo.’ Ka dine bed ni uhera, to dine ubedo mamor ni adhi ka Wuora, nimar Wuora duongʼ moloya.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

kikuyu: Ne imiyo ji onyono wiyewa; kendo ne wakalo mach gi pi, kata kamano ne ikelowa nyaka kama omew.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kikuyu: Eka iwachi ni, ‘E kaka Babulon nonim ma ok nochak ochungʼ kendo nikech masira ma anakel kuome. Kendo joge nopodhi.’ ” Weche Jeremia ogik kae.
english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

kikuyu: Ain, Juta kod Beth Shemesh, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ochiko koa e dhoudi ariyogi.
english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

kikuyu: Anywola jo-Merari (ma gin jo-Lawi mamoko) nomi: Koa e dhood Zebulun nomi: Jokneam, Karta,
english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: “In ema imiyo faras teko ma en-go koso in ema ne irwakone pien man-gi yier maboyo e ngʼute?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Musa nokelo im machielo, ma en im miwalogo jodolo ne tich kendo Harun gi yawuote noyieyo lwetgi e wiye.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Pinje duto ne biro ir Solomon mondo oyud rieko mane Nyasaye oketo e chunye.
english: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

kikuyu: To ni jo-Israel mane odak e mier mag Juda, Rehoboam ne pod jatendgi.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka jadolo duog manon odno. Kaponi purno olandore e kor ot,
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde ka gidonjo e Hemb Romo, to nyaka giluokre gi pigno mondo kik githo. Bende kinde ka kinde ma gidhi kar kendo mar misango mondo gichiw misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye,
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Chunyi nobedo gi sunga nikech ber mane ibergo, kendo ne iketho riekoni nikech duongʼ mane in-go. Omiyo ne adiri makeli nyaka e piny; mibedo gima ruodhi mag piny rango amingʼa ka wuoro.
english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼe ne aoro Musa gi Harun, kendo ne agoyo jo-Misri gi tuoche kanyo, bangʼe agolou oko.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Abiro paki gi chunya duto, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; abiro paki gi wer e nyim nyiseche.
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: To ka jadolo ongʼiewo jatich kod pesa to oyiene chiemo kaachiel gi wasumbini monywol e dalane.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

kikuyu: Ne en-gi yawuowi piero abiriyo ma mage owuon, nimar ne en-gi mon mangʼeny.
english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

kikuyu: to sikuru ka ungʼiye. Ka odhi mochomo thurgi nyaka, Beth Shemesh, to kara Jehova Nyasaye ema osekelo sand maduongʼni kuomwa. To ka ok otimore kamano to wabiro ngʼeyo ni lwete ok ema osesandowa to ni mani obironwa abira.”
english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

kikuyu: Nopenje kamano mana mondo otemego nimar nongʼeyo gima nobiro timo.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

kikuyu: Anyisou adier ni negichiwo kaka ginyalo, kendo moloyo kar tekregi, maonge achuna.
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

kikuyu: Ne gibulo jamni mag Pasaka ewi mach kaka chik owacho to ring misengini maler ne gitedo e agulni gi pipni kod sufuriache kendo negipogo ji mapiyo piyo.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

kikuyu: law marambulu, maralik, marakwaro, law mayom kod law mar yie diek;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: Puonj madier ema ne ni e dhoge kendo miriambo kata achiel ne ok oyud e dhoge. Nowuotho koda gi kwe kod ratiro, kendo noloko ji mangʼeny oa e richo.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

kikuyu: To kuom ngʼat ma ok otimo gimoro, to oketo mana genone kuom Jal maketo jomaricho kare, yie ma kamano ikwano kaka tim makare.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

kikuyu: Aseneno wasumbini e ngʼe farese, to jotelo wuotho gi tiendgi ka wasumbini.
english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

kikuyu: To dhiuru nyime kudongo e ngʼwono kod ngʼeyo ma un-go kuom Ruodhwa kendo Jawarwa Yesu Kristo. En ema oyud duongʼ tinende kendo nyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Paulo nowuotho mochopo Derbe gi Lustra, kama japuonjre moro nodakie miluongo ni Timotheo. Min Timotheo ne ja-Yahudi moyie kuom Yesu, to wuon-gi ne ja-Yunani.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

kikuyu: Jowetena, gima chunya dwaro kendo alamoe Nyasaye ne jo-Israel, en ni mondo giyud warruok.
english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Esau nomako sadha gi Jakobo nikech gweth mane wuon-gi osemiyo Jakobo. Nowacho e chunye niya, “ndalo mag tho wuora chiegni, bangʼe abiro nego Jakobo owadwa.”
english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

kikuyu: Mano kaka unune malit un osimbo mar jomer man Efraim, maber mare malich biro rumo ka maua maner, mopidhi ei holo momiyo mana kaka josunga malwokore gi kongʼo!
english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

kikuyu: nikech ne ok aweyo ma ok anyisou gik moko duto ma Nyasaye dwaro ni utim.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

kikuyu: Koro magi e jodong joka Esau gi nying-gi, kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod pinjegi: Timna, Alva, Jetheth,
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: Noyudo Saulo ojot oko mar Gibea e tiend yadh moro man-gi olemo mongʼinore e Migron. Ji madirom mia auchiel ne ni kode kuno,
english: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,

kikuyu: Kuom odiechiengʼ achiel Peka wuod Remalia nonego jolweny mag Juda alufu achiel nikech Juda nosejwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Jodolo gi jo-Lawi nosepwodhore giwegi kendo giduto negiikore mapoth ne nyasi. Jo-Lawi noyangʼo nyarombo mar Pasaka ne joma noa e twech duto, ne owetegi ma jodolo kod gin giwegi.
english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

kikuyu: kendo ne en gi rombe alufu abiriyo, ngamia alufu adek, rweth pur mia abich, gi punde mia abich, kendo ne en gi jotich mangʼeny. Kuom mano, ne en ngʼat marahuma moloyo ji duto modak yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

kikuyu: Ok lichni ni isegolowa e piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich mondo inegwa e thim? Kendo sani koro idwaro miyowa tingʼ mapek?
english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mane opuonjo ji chike ka jogo ochungʼ kanyo ne gin: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebia, Jamin, Akub, Shabethai, Hodia, Maseya, Kelita, Azaria, Jozabad, Hanan kod Peleya.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

kikuyu: mane ondike niya: “Oselandi e dier ogendini, kendo Geshem osewacho ni en adier ni in kod jo-Yahudi uchano mar monjowa, to ma emomiyo ugero ohingani. Kendo kaluwore gi wach moselandore en ni idwaro bedo ruodhgi
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

kikuyu: Ne itimo ranyisi kod honni e piny Misri kendo isiko kodgi nyaka kawuono, ei Israel kendo e dier ji duto, kendo pod in ngʼat marahuma nyaka chil kawuono.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

kikuyu: Kane oneno Yesu, noywak matek kendo nopodho piny e tiende, kogoyo koko gi dwol mamalo niya, “Yesu Wuod Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, angʼo milaro koda? Asayi, kik isanda!”
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

kikuyu: Kendo Solomon nobedo ruodh pinyno duto chakre Aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate nyaka e piny jo-Filistia mochweyo nyaka giko piny Misri. Pinjegi duto ne kelo osuru ni Solomon bende ne gin e bwo lochne ndalo duto.
english: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

kikuyu: Mach makakni kaachiel gi pilni mach wuok e dhoge.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

kikuyu: Jopinje mamoko nokaw Ashdod milok margi kendo abiro tieko sunga mar jo-Filistia.
english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ne giywak niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, angʼo momiyo ma osetimore ne Israel? Angʼo ma omiyo dhoot achiel nyalo lal e Israel kawuono?”
english: They said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

kikuyu: Joma sand nokeyo nikech wach nek Stefano nodhi Foinike, Saipras nyaka Antiokia, ka gilando Injili ne jo-Yahudi kende.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Daudi obet e kind rangach maiye gi ma oko, jarito noidho wi dhoranga ohinga mar ngʼicho. Kane ongʼiyo oko, noneno ngʼato karingo kende.
english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

kikuyu: (Nyaka ae thuolono ne pok gingʼeyo, koa e Ndiko, ni nochuno ni Yesu nyaka ne chier mi aa kuom joma otho.)
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

kikuyu: Kinyne negikete e lwet jolweny moidho farese mondo odhi kode, to gin negidwogo kama jolweny odakie.
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

kikuyu: To Zakayo nochungo malo kendo nowachone Ruoth niya, “Ne Ruoth! Sani kendo koroni abiro chiwo nus mar giga ne jochan, to kapo ni ne asewuondo ngʼato e gimoro amora, abiro chule ka adwokone maromo nyadingʼwen.”
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

kikuyu: Solomon nopwodho dier laru mane nitie e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo kanyo nochiwoe misengini miwangʼo pep kod boche miwangʼo mag misango mar lalruok nikech kendo mar misango mar mula manoloso ne ok nyal tingʼo misengini miwangʼo, gi chiwo mag cham kod boche.
english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before the LORD’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ gi dwe nochungʼ kargi e kor polo ka gineno asernigi mibayo; ka mil polo machalo tongʼ mobaa.
english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

kikuyu: To koro dwawinj ni un bende utimo timbe dwanyruok malich kama kendo ubedo joma ok jo-ratiro ne Nyasachwa kuom nyuomo mon ma welogi?”
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

kikuyu: Gimane otimono ne gima kwero e nyim Jehova Nyasaye; kuom mano en bende Jehova Nyasaye nonege.
english: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.

kikuyu: Abiro golo geche mag lweny oko e Efraim gi farese mag lweny bende abiro golo Jerusalem, kendo atunge mag lweny ibiro tur. Obiro kelo kwe ni ogendini. Lochne biro chakore e bath nam konchiel nyaka komachielo, kendo kochakore e Aora Yufrate nyaka e giko mar piny.
english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Gima omiyo ne andikonu ne en mondo atemu ane kendo angʼe ka bende un joma nigi luor e gik moko duto.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osedonjo ei Kapernaum, ja-Kenturo moro nobiro ire, kakwaye kony.
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

kikuyu: Nyikwa Parosh, ji alufu ariyo mia achiel gi piero abiriyo gariyo (2,172),
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

kikuyu: “Ibiro weyo weche miwachogi karangʼo? Bed ngʼama odimbore eka wawuo.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, chunya medo jiwa mondo aore, mondo ka unene kendo kongima, to ubed mamor, mondo an bende parruok ma an-go odog chien.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

kikuyu: gin joma opongʼ gi mor kendo gibedo moil ka gitundo ei liel?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyaminu moa e ot machielo, nikech en nyaminu.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye, nimar ober; kendo herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: kata kamano, joma richo kod joma wuondore nomed bedo joma richo moloyo, ka gi wuondo ji to gin bende iwuondogi.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Paulo nodak kuno kuom higa achiel gi nus, kopuonjo ji wach Nyasaye.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

kikuyu: Dwe norieny matip-tip kendo wangʼ chiengʼ noimre nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, nogur lochne kod duongʼne e Got Sayun kod Jerusalem e nyim jodongo.
english: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

kikuyu: Eka iwachi ni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isewacho ni ibiro ketho kae, mondo omi dhano kata le kik dag e iye; enodongʼ gunda nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and say, ‘LORD, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Abiro dhi mi achange.”
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

kikuyu: Omiyo kane Petro odhi Jerusalem, to joma oyie kuom Kristo ma jo-Yahudi nokwere
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne awachonegi niya, “Uneno thagruok ma wantiere godo: Jerusalem osemuki, to dhorangeyege osewangʼ gi mach. Biuru wager ohinga mar Jerusalem kendo, to ok wanachak wabed e wichkuot kendo.”
english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

kikuyu: Jeftha ja-Gilead ne jalweny mager. Wuon mare ne en Gilead, to min mare ne en ochot.
english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.

kikuyu: Nimar adhier kendo achando, kendo chunya winjo marach e iya.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

kikuyu: Gin jomage ma nokwongʼorenegi ni ok ginidonji e kar yweyone, ka ok gin joma notamore winjo wachne?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

kikuyu: Nikech remb diendno ne ok oter e Kama Ler mar lemo, mano emomiyo ne onego uchame ei hekalu kaka nachikou.”
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ok onego kend chi wuon, kendo kik odwany kitanda wuon mare.
english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno Nyarombo machalo ka gima ne osenegi kochungo e dier kom duongʼ, kolwore gi gik mangima angʼwen kod jodongo. Ne en gi tunge abiriyo gi wenge abiriyo ma gin Roho abiriyo mag Nyasaye moseor e piny mangima.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

kikuyu: An ok adwar mondo umiya duongʼ, to nitie Jal machielo madwaro mondo ayud duongʼ, kendo en e jangʼad bura.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

kikuyu: Ochalo gi yien mopidhi e bath aora, manyago olembe e kinde molemo chieke, kendo ma bedene ok ner. Gimoro amora motimo dhi maber.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

kikuyu: Ere kare ngʼama chal koda? Ochungane owachi. Ohulane kendo olerane e nyima gik mosetimore, nyaka ne ayier joga aa chon, kendo mabiro timore; adier we onyiswa gigo mabiro timore.
english: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.

kikuyu: Winjuru gima awachonu maber! An Paulo asiemou ni ka uyie mondo oteru nyangu, to bedo ja-Kristo ok nokonyu.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

kikuyu: Ngeche mag Solomon wuod Daudi, ruodh Israel:
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

kikuyu: Kuom mano Pilato nongʼado bura mondo dwarogi otimnegi.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

kikuyu: Ngʼama timbene achach mondo owe yorene, kendo ngʼama parone opongʼ gi timbe richo mondo owe. Onego oduog ir Jehova Nyasaye, kendo enobed gi ngʼwono kuome mi enowene richone.
english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Amon oneno ka gisechido chuny Daudi, negichulo jo-Aram mondo omigi jolweny mawuotho gi tiendgi ji alufu piero ariyo moa Beth Rehob gi Zoba, to gi ruodh Maaka bende nomiyogi jolweny alufu achiel to gi jolweny alufu apar gariyo moa Tob.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

kikuyu: Onego ikaw nyarwath mar misango mar golo richo kendo iwangʼe kama oyangne ei alwora mar hekalu gioko mar kama ler mar lemo.
english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Gisedhi nyaka Asuria mana kaka kanyna mar bungu mabayo abaya. Efraim oseusore ne joherane.
english: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.

kikuyu: En ema noger ot ni nyinga, kendo anagur lochne gi pinyruodhe nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

kikuyu: to nochako kowachonegi niya, “Kawuono ndikoni chopo kare ka uwinjo.”
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

kikuyu: “Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom jo-Anathoth madwaro ngimani, ‘Kik ikor e nying Jehova Nyasaye ka ok kamano to ibiro tho e lwetwa.’
english: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in the LORD’s name, that you not die by our hand’—

kikuyu: Kata makati abiriyo mane opidho ji alufu angʼwen, kod kar romb okepe mane uchoko?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

kikuyu: Nyaka upogi gik mane ope maromre ne joma nodhi e lweny kod joma nodongʼ.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

kikuyu: Ochwako ngʼat misando kendo ochiwo chiemo ne joma odenyo. Jehova Nyasaye gonyo joma otwe mi gibed thuolo,
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

kikuyu: Jogo mane rito tich ne ngʼiyo tich maber kendo tich nodhi maber e lwetgi. Negiloso hekalu mar Nyasaye kaluwore gi kaka nogere chon kendo negimedo sire mondo omed bedo motegno.
english: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

kikuyu: Eka Rael nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osengʼadona bura; osewinjo kwayona mi omiya nyathi ma wuowi.” Omiyo nochake ni Dan.
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Un joma wuondore! Donge ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu gonyo rwadhe kata pundane e dipo kotere oko mondo omiye pi chiengʼ Sabato?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Los thuond mula kendo ikete ewi luth; ma ngʼato angʼata ma thuol okayo kongʼiye to chango.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

kikuyu: Eka noyiero Daniel gi ji ariyo mamoko mondo obed jotend jotelogo. Jorit pinjegi nomi chik ni nyaka gidwok wach ni jotelo adekgi, mondo kik gimoro dhi marach ne ruoth.
english: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

kikuyu: Ngangʼ, ok en kamano! To gima timore en ni ngʼat moro miluongo ni Sheba wuod Bikri, moa e piny gode mag Efraim, ema piem gi ruoth Daudi. Omiyo miya ngʼatno kende, to abiro weyo dala maduongʼni.” Dhakoni nowachone Joab niya, “Wiye ibiro dirni gi ewi ohinga.”
english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

kikuyu: Ok wasechiko itwa ne jotichni ma jonabi mane owuoyo gi ruodhi mawa gi yawuot ruodhi kod wuonewa, gi jopinywa duto, e nyingi.
english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo ma gigi nosik e chunje jonabi mariambogi, makoro gigo moa e pachgi giwegi?
english: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?

kikuyu: E kaka obedo ni nitie fuonde mangʼeny, to ringruok en achiel.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osewacho ni unubed jok man-gi pak, huma kod luor maduongʼ moloyo ogendini mamoko duto mosechweyo kendo unubed jomaler e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kaka nosesingo.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.

kikuyu: E dhorangach kanyo ema nyaka ochiwe misangone ne Jehova Nyasaye ma gin: nyaim ma hike achiel maonge songa kaka misango miwangʼo pep, sibini ma hike achiel maonge songa kaka misango migologo richo; im maonge songa kaka chiwo mar lalruok,
english: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

kikuyu: To koa e dhood Benjamin ne gimiyogi Gibeon, Geba,
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ngʼatno nyalo chango mi pien dende chak dog ka pien dend nyathi matin mana kaka nochal kotin.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

kikuyu: Elija to nodwoke niya, “Ee. Dhiyo inyis ruodhi ni, ‘Elija nika.’ ”
english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

kikuyu: Ne ok giloyo pinyno gi liganglagi kendo kata bedegi bende ne ok okelonigi loch; to mana badi iwuon ma korachwich, kod ler mar wangʼi ema nomiyo gilocho nimar ne iherogi.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Hosea wuod Beeri e ndalo loch Uzia, gi Jotham gi Ahaz kod Hezekia, ruodhi mag Juda, e ndalo loch Jeroboam wuod Jehoash ruodh Israel.
english: The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu onene koywak, kendo ka jo-Yahudi mane gibirogo ire bende ne ywak, chunye nodoko malit kendo nochandore.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼat mane Ruoth oluongo ka misumba koro bedo ngʼat man thuolo kuom Ruoth, to bende ngʼat mane ni thuolo kane Ruoth oluongo doko misumba Kristo.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato en jaland wach, to wach molando Obed mana mar Nyasaye kende. Ka ngʼato tiyo ni ji, to onego otim kamano gi teko ma Nyasaye chiwo, mondo kuom gik moko duto ji opak Nyasaye kuom Yesu Kristo. Duongʼ gi teko mondo obed mare mochwere manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato ne onego we misumbane ma ja-Hibrania, madichwo kod ma dhako; onge ngʼama ne dongʼ gi ja-Yahudi wadgi e twech.
english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.

kikuyu: Gima owinjo en mana rem manie dende owuon kendo oywagore kende owuon.”
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye noparo Rael, mi odwoko kwayone kendo ogwedhe gi nyathi.
english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osegolo kuomi kum mosekumigo bende oseriembo wasika. Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Ruodh jo-Israel ni kodi ok inichak iluor gimoro amora manyalo hinyi.
english: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Awachonu adier ni, Wuod Dhano ok nyal timo gimoro kende owuon; to onyalo mana timo gima oneno ka Wuoro timo, nikech gimoro amora ma Wuoro timo ema Wuowi bende timo.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

kikuyu: kata ka ochwanyore to ok obi podho; nikech Jehova Nyasaye omako lwete.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

kikuyu: Aketo chunya kuom rito chikeni ma ok aweyo nyaka giko.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

kikuyu: Hera ma Jehova Nyasaye oherogo joma omiye luor, to osiko manyaka chiengʼ, kendo osiko otimo maber ne nyithind nyithindgi,
english: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

kikuyu: Eka Laban nopenjo Jakobo niya, “En angʼo ma isetimoni? Isewuonda kendo iseringa gi nyiga mana ka joma omak e lweny.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

kikuyu: Kane onyis Jotham wachni, nodhi ewi Got Gerizim kendo nokok kowachonegi niya, “Winjauru, un jo-Shekem, mondo omi Nyasaye owinju.
english: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

kikuyu: Ne okelowa ka mi omiyowa pinyni, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich;
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Nikech Jehova Nyasaye nohulona marach mane gichano timo, ne angʼeyo wachno, nimar e kindeno nosefwenyona gima negitimo.
english: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.

kikuyu: Irwakogi e ot gi ilo kod mor maduongʼ; gidonjo e dala ruoth.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mawuotho e ratiro kendo wacho gima adiera, ma tamore yudo ohala e yor mecho kendo ok oyie kawo asoya, ngʼatno ma ok chik ite e chenro mar neko, kendo odino wengene e neno timbe mamono,
english: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

kikuyu: To koro ibiro bedo momo kendo ok iniwinj nyaka ndalo ma gini notimre, nikech ne ok iyie wechena mabiro bedo adiera e kindegi mowinjore.”
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

kikuyu: Koa e nyikwa Kohath, ne gin ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo kotelnegi gi Uriel,
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye ne obiro ni Jona mar ariyo kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

kikuyu: Helkath kod Rehob, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Ubiro bedo gima piny nyiero, mamako dho ji, mamiyo ji tangʼ kendo mabwogo ogendini mokiew kodu; ka amiyou kum gi mirima, gi gero kendo ka akwerou ka akecho. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho.
english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Akuru mopiyo e onera man mabor.” Miktam mar Daudi. Kane jo-Filistia osemake Gath. Kecha, yaye Nyasacha, nikech wasika dwaro monja; odiechiengʼ duto gidiya ma ok aywe.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

kikuyu: To ligengligi biro chwoyo adundogi giwegi, kendo atungegi biro tur.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

kikuyu: Kristo ma Ruodh jo-Israel koro olor ane oa ewi msalaba mondo wane, eka wayie kuome.” Jok mane ogur kode bende nodhuole gi ayany.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

kikuyu: Nyasaye obet e kom duongʼne kuma bor moyombo piny kendo joma ni e polo ngʼeny machalo kama ongogo ochokoree. Oyaro polo mana ka tipo maduongʼ kendo oyarogi mana ka hema midakie.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

kikuyu: “Kuom mano analok Samaria obed pith mar yugi, kama ipidhoe mzabibu. Abiro olo kite mag dalano nyaka e holo kendo abiro weyo mise mage nono li.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

kikuyu: bende asingora ni kapod angima kendo kapod Nyasaye omiya muya ma ayweyo,
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoke niya, “Adier wasebedo mabor gi mon, mana kaka wajatimo kinde ma awuok oko. Ringre chwo to ler kata mana e ote moko ma ok ler. To koro kawuononi digibed maler maromo nade!”
english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

kikuyu: “Bed moikore! Chungʼ malo kendo wachnegi gimoro amora machiki. Kik iwe gibwogi, ka ok kamano to abiro bwogi e nyimgi.
english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

kikuyu: Yawuot Reuben ne gin: Hanok, Palu, Hezron kod Karmi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Japiny moro modak e dieruno nyaka udag kode mana kaka wuodu. Hereuru mana kaka uheroru uwegi nikech ne un jodak e piny Misri. An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Ogendini biro luoro nying Jehova Nyasaye, ruodhi duto mag piny biro luoro duongʼni.
english: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

kikuyu: nikech Roho Maler biro puonjou e sano gima onego uwachi.”
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

kikuyu: E kinde mane jogi owuok mondo gidhi ginon piny, Joshua nomiyogi chik niya, “Dhiuru kendo utim nonro malongʼo mar pinyni kendo undik gik moko duto muyudo e iye. Bangʼe dwoguru ira kendo abiro miyou pok maru Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”

kikuyu: Ne agolou e piny Misri, mi atelonu higni piero angʼwen e thim, ni mondo amiu piny jo-Amor.
english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

kikuyu: Omiyo Hanun nomako joote Daudi molielo bath yie tik moro ka moro nyakonchiel; nongʼado lepgi e diere tir chakre e nungogi nyaka piny, moriembogi gidhi.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

kikuyu: Winjuru ma, un jodongo; chikuru itu, un duto ma udak e piny. Bende gima chalo kama osetimore e ndalou, kata e ndalo mag kwereu?
english: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

kikuyu: Un joma odak machiegni gi pige mangʼeny kendo momewo gi mwandu mangʼeny, gikou osechopo, sa ma itiekoue.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

kikuyu: Giniwach kuoma ni, ‘Kuom Jehova Nyasaye kende ema iyudoe adieri kod teko.’ ” Jogo duto manopiem kode nochungʼ e nyime gi wichkuot.
english: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.

kikuyu: Otelo ni joma muol kuom gima nikare kendo opuonjogi yore.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

kikuyu: Anami olembeu kod cham mag puotheu nyag mangʼeny, kendo ok unuchak une wichkuot e dier ogendini nikech wach kech.
english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

kikuyu: Hazael nopenjo Elisha niya, “Ruodha, iywago angʼo?” To nodwoke niya, “Aywak nikech angʼeyo masira ma ibiro kelone jo-Israel. Ibiro wangʼo kuondegi mochiel motegno, ibiro nego yawuotgi matindo gi ligangla, ibiro nyono nyithindgi matindo kendo ibiro baro iye mon ma yach.”
english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye e tekrena bende en e wenda; kendo osebedo warruokna. Anapake nimar en Nyasacha, ma Nyasach wuora, kendo abiro miyo nyinge duongʼ.
english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

kikuyu: Maluwogi ne en dhood Benjamin. Jatend dhood Benjamin ne en Abidan wuod Gideoni.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: ka en gi otuchi e diere kaka ngʼut law kendo notwangʼ ngʼuteno gi pien mondo kik oyiechi.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

kikuyu: Ne amiye thim motwo kaka dalane, kendo namiye kuonde motimo chumbi mondo odagie.
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

kikuyu: Yesu nolokore mowachonegi niya, “Nyi Jerusalem, kik uywaga, to ywaguru ne un uwegi kendo nikech nyithindu.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

kikuyu: Bende ne aneno joma otho, jomadongo gi jomatindo, negichungʼ e nyim kom maduongʼ mar loch, kendo kitepe noel. Kitabu moro noel, ma en kitap ngima. Joma otho nongʼadnigi bura kaluwore kod gik mane gisetimo kaka ondiki e kitepego.
english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone ngʼat mane oluongeno niya, “Ka ichiwo chiemb odiechiengʼ kata chiemb otieno, kik iluong mana osiepeni, oweteni kata wedeni, kata jogwengʼu momew, nimar ka itimo kamano, kamoro giniluongi chiengʼ moro, mi gichuli kar luong mane iluongigono.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywolo Reu, Peleg nodak higni mia ariyo gochiko kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Biye onge jatelo kata jaloch kata ruoth,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Dhano ok bed mangima nikech chiemo kende, to nikech wach ka wach moa e dho Nyasaye.’”
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

kikuyu: Magi e joma chwo mane okaw koa kuom yawuot Josef: koa kuom Efraim, kaw Elishama wuod Amihud; koa kuom Manase, kaw Gamaliel wuod Pedazur;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye, nimar ober. Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: mapuonjowa gik mathoth moloyo kaka opuonjo le manie piny kendo mamiyo wabedo mariek moloyo winy mafuyo e kor polo?’
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

kikuyu: Kane en e Piny Joma otho kisande malit, nongʼiyo malo to noneno Ibrahim gi kuma bor kod Lazaro e bathe.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo dwol moro moa e polo ka wuo ka pi aora maringo matek kendo ka mor mar polo. Dwolno mane awinjo ne chalo gi jo-thumbe mag nyatiti magoyo nyatiti.
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

kikuyu: nogerie kerubi kod yiende mag othith. Yiende mag othithgo noger molworo ot e kido mar kerubi kod kido mar othidhe. Kerubigo moro ka moro ne nigi lela wenge ariyo:
english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

kikuyu: Ere ngʼato kuomu ka manyalo ngʼengʼa ni an jaricho? To ka awachonu adier to angʼo momiyo udagi yie kuoma?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

kikuyu: Kata ka aluongo kata kaywak ka dwaro kony, to ogengʼo lamona.
english: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ipando wangʼi kendo ikawa kaka jasiki?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

kikuyu: Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Elisha nopenjo Gehazi niya, “Angʼo ma onego timne?” Gehazi nodwoke niya, “Oonge wuowi kendo chwore bende oseti.”
english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke kawacho niya, “Chik achiel maduongʼ moloyo en ma: ‘Winjuru, yaye jo-Israel, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa en Jehova Nyasaye achiel.
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

kikuyu: kendo nosembo jambe duto e nyime kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane osechoko e piny Padan Aram, mondo odhi ir Isaka wuon-gi e piny Kanaan.
english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Mon duto mane odongʼ kar dak mar ruodh Juda nokelne jotelo mar ruodh Babulon. Mon-go nowachni ni: Osiepegi mane igenogo nowuondi kendo noloyi. Tiendegi oselingʼore e chwodho; osiepegi oseweyi.
english: ‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “Your familiar friends have turned on you, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away from you.”

kikuyu: Ji noring kapondo e buche manie kind lwendni to gi buche manie lowo, ka luoro omakogi nikech duongʼ malich mar Jehova Nyasaye, kod e kindeno mano thinyre mondo oyieng piny.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

kikuyu: Kane jotelo mariembo geche lweny noneno Jehoshafat negiwacho e chunygi niya, “Nyaka bed ni ma e ruodh Israel.” Omiyo negilokore mondo giked kode, to kane Jehoshafat oywak, Jehova Nyasaye nokonye. Nyasaye nogologi kuome,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mowacho wach moro marach kuom Wuod Dhano nowene, to ngʼato angʼata mowuoyo marach kuom Roho Maler ok nowene richone, e tiengʼni kata e tiengʼ mabiro.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Eka jatend dala ruoth, jatend dala maduongʼ, jodongo kod jorit mag nyithind Ahab nooro wachni ne Jehu kama: “Wan mana jotichni omiyo wabiro timo gimoro amora miwacho. Ok wabi yiero ngʼato e dierwa mondo obed ruoth, tim gima chunyi oneno ni ber.”
english: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

kikuyu: Kane oterone chiemo mondo ocham nomake githuon koywaye mowachone niya, “Nyamera, bi wanind e kitandana ka.”
english: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

kikuyu: Eka ngʼato moro ma nyinge Jairo, jatich sinagogi, nobiro mogoyo chonge piny e tiend Yesu, kosaye mondo odhi ode,
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

kikuyu: Nokawo geche mia auchiel mabeyo mag lweny, kod geche mamoko mag jo-Misri ka moro ka moro nigi jatend lweny.
english: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jotelo mag anywola mag dhout jo-Lawi nobiro ir Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun, kod jotelo mag dhout anywola mamoko mag Israel,
english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Oorwa gi jatend jolweny moro miluongo ni Kornelio. En ngʼat makare moluoro Nyasaye, kendo ma jo-Yahudi duto omiyo luor. Malaika maler nonyise mondo oluongi idhi ire e ode mondo owinj gima inyalo wachone.”
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

kikuyu: To mier mane nitiere e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ ne gin: Eshtaol, Zora, Ashna,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

kikuyu: Puoth ngʼat ma jachan sa moro nyalo nyago chiemo mangʼeny, to tim ma ok kare tiekogi duto.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane ochwe gi lowo ema ji duto oa kuome, kamano bende e kaka jopolo duto oa kuom Jal mane oa e polo.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

kikuyu: joka Zebulun ma gin jolweny molony kendo moikore ni kedo gi gige lweny mopogore opogore mondo omi gikony Daudi gi chuny achiel ne gin ji alufu piero abich (50,000);
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho, ‘Ngʼaduru bura madier; nyisuru tim ngʼwono kod kech ni jowadu.
english: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

kikuyu: Ka noneno yiend ngʼowu moro e bath yo, nobaro kochomo yien-no, to ne ok oyudo gimoro amora kuome, makmana ite. Eka nowachone niya, “Kik ichak inyag olemo kendo!” Gikanyono yien-no noner.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

kikuyu: To chunyu nyaka chiwre chuth ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kudak moluwore gi yorene kendo kurito chikene kaka e kindeni.”
english: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

kikuyu: Zaburi mar pak. Mar Daudi. Abiro tingʼo nyingi malo, yaye Nyasacha ma Ruoth; abiro pako nyingi nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, Judas, mane en achiel kuom jopuonjrene apar gariyo, nochopo. Ne en gi oganda maduongʼ mane omanore gi gik lwenje kaka ligangla gi arunge. Ne oorgi koa ir jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

kikuyu: Ma e wach ma Jehova Nyasaye osewacho kuom Senakerib: “ ‘Nyar Sayun Mangili ochayi kendo jari. Nyar Jerusalem kino wiye koneni kiringo.
english: This is the word that the LORD has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

kikuyu: Dhakono noringo modhi e thim kuma ne Nyasaye oselosone mane ibiro ritee kuom ndalo alufu achiel gi mia ariyo kod piero auchiel.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye tero ji e ngima; eka ngʼato yweyo kodhil, ma ok omule gi chandruok.
english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

kikuyu: Kik uyie mondo chunyu odhi e yorene, kata bayo e yorene.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

kikuyu: Ere kaka ngʼato dingʼe ni imor koda kaachiel gi jogigi makmana ka idhi kodwa? Koso en angʼo ma dipoga gi jogigi kod ogendini mamoko mantie e piny?”
