english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

kikuyu: Nikech jatend kanyakla mar jo-Kristo en ngʼat marito tich Nyasaye, omiyo nyaka obed ngʼat ma wach moro amora marach onge kuome. Kik obed ngʼat mamiyo kanyakla mar joma oyie tingʼ mapek. Bende kik obed ngʼat mochayo ji kata ma ja-mirima, kata ngʼat mamer gi kongʼo, kata ngʼat mohero dhawo, kata ngʼat moyudo mwandu e yor mibadhi.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ mondo pachu kik maki gi gik ma kamago ma ulam nyiseche mamoko ka ukulorenegi.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

kikuyu: “Joma nigi rieko e kindeno nopuonj ji mangʼeny, kata obedo ni ginipodhi e dho ligangla kuom kinde matin; kendo nowangʼ-gi gi mach, kendo omakgi, kendo oyakgi,
english: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.

kikuyu: Kendo Daudi humbe nolandore koa nego jo-Edom alufu apar gaboro e Holo mar Chumbi.
english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

kikuyu: Noyako mwandu hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi mwandu mag od ruoth. Nokawo gimoro amora, kaachiel gi kuodi mag dhahabu mane Solomon ochuogo.
english: and he took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

kikuyu: “Koro mondo Farao oyier ngʼat mariek kendo molony e gik moko duto motimo mondo okete jatend piny Misri.
english: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ne oketo Matania, ma owadgi Jehoyakin mondo obed ruoth kare kendo noloko nyinge ni Zedekia.
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

kikuyu: To tich ma Yesu oseyudo duongʼ moloyo margino, mana kaka winjruok mokelo, ma en e jathek ber moloyo winjruok machon, nikech en winjruok ma singruok mabeyo moloyo ema guro.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni angʼo motimore, to usik kudak e kit ngimau mapile mowinjore gi Injili mar Kristo. Kata ka abiro nenou, kata ka ok abiro, to adwaro winjo ni uchungʼ motegno gi chuny achiel kendo gi paro achiel mondo ukedni adiera mar Injili,
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

kikuyu: Koso winyo nyalo moko e obadho nade ka ok ochike gi kudni? Koso obadho dimeki nade kaonge gima otuge?
english: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nokawo mo gi chak mar adila kod ring nyarwath mane osetedi maber mi oketogi e nyimgi. Kane gichiemo, Ibrahim nochungʼ butgi e tiend yath.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

kikuyu: “Ne wagoyonu asili, to ne ok umiel; bende ne wadengo ka wawero wend tho, to ne ok uywak.
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne giwangʼo dala maduongʼno duto, to gi gimoro amora manie iye, makmana fedha gi dhahabu, gi gik molos gi mula kod molos gi nyinyo noketi e kar keno mar od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Koro aseywak mondo okonya mi aol; dwonda rewni. Wengena pek, ka amanyo Nyasacha.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

kikuyu: Kaachiel kodgi ne nitie jo-Lawi moko kaka: Shemaya gi Nethania gi Zebadia gi Asahel gi Shemiramoth gi Jehonathan gi Adonija gi Tobija kaachiel gi Tob-Adonija kod jodolo Elishama gi Jehoram.
english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

kikuyu: Jodong-gi duto biro biro ira ka gikulorena kendo kagiwacho ni, ‘Dhiyo, in kaachiel gi jogo maluwi!’ Bangʼ mano to anadhi.” Eka Musa nowuok e nyim Farao ka en gi mirima.
english: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

kikuyu: nyikwa Jeriko, ji mia adek gi piero angʼwen gabich (345),
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: yawuot Nyasaye noneno ni nyi dhano beyo kendo negikendo moro amora mane chunygi ogombo.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

kikuyu: Joge teko orumonegi mi gibuok kendo gidongʼ gi wichkuot. Gichalo gi cham manie puodho kata ka maua mangʼich mathiewo, kata ka lum madongo ewi tado, to ner kapok odongo.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.

kikuyu: Chakre kindeno kadhi nyime, Yesu nochako yalo niya, “Weuru richo nikech pinyruodh polo osekayo machiegni.”
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

kikuyu: Eka ruodh Asuria ne ooro jatend lweny gi ogandane mag lweny koa Lakish mondo odhi ir Ruoth Hezekia Jerusalem. Kane jatend lweny ochopo kuno, ne ochungʼ but Soko Mamalo mantie e yo miluongo ni Puoth Jaluoko.
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho mano, nokawe motere e polo, mana ka ginene, kendo polo noime mi olalnegi, makoro ne ok ginyal nene.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

kikuyu: “Omiyo lingʼuru uwinja, un joma nigi winjo. Nyasaye ok nyal timo gima rach kata dichiel, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok tim gima ok owinjore.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko e ndalo mar kayo ngano, Samson nokawo nyadiel kendo nodhi limo chiege. Nowacho niya, “Adhi od nindo mar chiega.” To jaduongʼne ne ok nyal yiene mondo odonji.
english: But after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat. He said, “I will go in to my wife’s room.” But her father wouldn’t allow him to go in.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai nodwokogi niya, “Kare un bende useyie gi miriambone.
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

kikuyu: Omiyo koro achiegni tieko Baasha kod ode kendo abiro keto odi kaka mano mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

kikuyu: Obadia to nopenje niya, “En angʼo masetimo marach makoro omiyo ichiwo jatichni ni Ahab mondo onegi?
english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

kikuyu: “Ne amanyo ngʼato moro e diergi mane nyalo gero ohinga kendo mane nyalo chungʼ e nyima kaka ogayi mochungʼne piny, mondo kik akethe, to ne ok ayudo ngʼato.
english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.

kikuyu: Nyikwa jotij Solomon ne gin: nyikwa Sotai, Sofereth, Perida,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

kikuyu: Koro bi mondo ikwongʼ jogi, nikech tekregi thoth. Dibed ni bangʼ ma anyalo loyogi mi ariembgi gia e pinyni. Nimar angʼeyo ni joma igwedho ogwedhi, kendo joma ikwongʼo okwongʼ.”
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

kikuyu: Kinde mag kum biro kendo kinde mag ngʼado bura osechopo. Omiyo jo-Israel nyaka ngʼe wachni. Nikech richou ngʼeny kendo kinyou lich miwuoro, janabi ikwano ka ngʼama ofuwo, to ngʼat matiyo gi much Nyasaye ka janeko.
english: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.

kikuyu: “Gik mangʼwe ngʼar monego ikaw gin: kilo auchiel mar mane-mane, kilo adek mar dalasini, gi obala ndago maromo kilo adek,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

kikuyu: ne itimo kamano kata obedo nine in ngʼama duongʼ, ne in gi lopi iwuon midakie, kendo ji noluori.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

kikuyu: “Usewinjo ni nowachi ni, ‘Her waduto jasiki to isin-go.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

kikuyu: Omiyo ritreuru mondo gima usetiyone kik lalnu, eka unuyud mich magu duto.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

kikuyu: Jerusalem ne irito gi owadwa, Hanani kaachiel gi Hanania ma jatend kama ochiel motegno, nikech ne en ja-ratiro kendo noluoro Nyasaye moloyo joma moko.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nagolo chik mondo okel jomariek duto mag Babulon e nyima mondo olokna tiend lekno.
english: Therefore I made a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.

kikuyu: Iparo ni iduongʼ moloyo Jakobo kwarwa mane omiyowa sokoni, kendo nomodho pige en owuon kaachiel gi yawuote, gi jambe kod dhoge?”
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

kikuyu: Kaponi ngʼat mane ochiwo lopeno nigi chuny mar ware, to nyaka ochul achiel ewi abich mar nengone, eka puodhono nobed mare.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo okwanogi Bezek, jo-Israel ne oromo alufu mia adek to jo-Juda ne oromo alufu piero adek.
english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

kikuyu: Jatelo maduongʼ nomiyogi chik mondo kik gicham chiemo moro amora mopwodhi manyaka jadolo bedie ma puonjogi gi Urim kod Thumim.
english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

kikuyu: nikech adiera manie iwa biro siko kodwa nyaka chiengʼ:
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Ruoth Yesu nosewuoyo kodgi nokawe motere e polo, mobedo e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

kikuyu: bangʼe singruokna gi Daudi jatichna kod singruokna gi jo-Lawi ma gin jodolo ma yalo e nyima inyalo kethi to Daudi ok nobed gi nyakware manobed gi loch e kom duongʼ mare.
english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo aoronu Timotheo, ma en wuoda mahero, kendo ma ja-adiera kuom Ruoth. Obiro paronu kit ngimana kuom Kristo Yesu, ma ok opogore gi gik mapuonjo kuonde duto, e kanisa.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

kikuyu: Awacho adiera kuom Kristo kendo ok ariambi; chunya bende bedo janeno kuom wach ma awachoni ni en adier kuom Roho Maler.
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

kikuyu: E kinde machon jonabi mane obiro moteloni kendo otelona nokoro kuom lweny, chandruok kod masira kuom pinje mangʼeny kod pinjeruodhi madongo.
english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.

kikuyu: Chakre chiengʼ mane obetie piny, orito odiechiengʼ mibiro ket jowasike duto obed raten tiende;
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

kikuyu: To upenjo niya, “Nangʼo?” En kamano nikech Jehova Nyasaye obedo kaka janeno e kindi kod chiegi mane ikendo ka in wuowi, nikech useketho singruok mane ni e kindu koda. Kata obedo ni en chiegi mane itimogo singruok mar kend.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

kikuyu: Otienono wach mar Nyasaye nobiro ni Nathan kawacho niya,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: Bende ji duto nigi mich mar chango joma tuo? Bende ji duto wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore? Bende ji duto nyalo loko tiend weche joma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Nikech Muma wacho niya, “Ka en gima tek mondo owar joma timbegi beyo, koro joma kia Nyasaye gi joricho to nobed machalo nadi?”
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

kikuyu: Pige mag aoregi nodwon matuo. Nimar en piny mopongʼ gi nyiseche manono, ma gin nyiseche mamiyo neko nomaku.
english: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,

kikuyu: Jeremia nondiko e kitabu kuom masiche duto mano bi kuom Babulon, mago duto mane osendiki kuom Babulon.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

kikuyu: Pien dhogi chalo gi law marakwaro; kendo dhogi ber ahinya. Lembi moum gi law yom machalo mana gi olemo mongʼinore.
english: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye mane obirone janabi Jeremia kuom jo-Filistia kapok Farao nomonjo Gaza:
english: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

kikuyu: Kowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, onge Nyasaye moro e polo kata e piny machal kodi. In e Nyasaye marito singruok mar herane ni jotichne maluwo yoreni gi chunygi duto.
english: Then he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

kikuyu: jomoko mane ochungʼ kanyo nopenjogi niya, “Utimo angʼono, ugonyo nyathi kanynano nangʼo?”
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Dhiyo kendo ingʼiew njage mar lowo kuom jachwe agulni. Dhi gi jodong ji moko kod jodolo
english: Thus said the LORD, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Ginibed joga, odiechiengʼno kendo anaketgi kaka mwanduna mageno. Anakechgi mana kaka ngʼato kecho wuode matiyone.
english: They shall be mine,” says the LORD of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

kikuyu: Dhok abiriyo maricho modhero mane obiro bangʼe nyiso higni abiriyo, kendo kamano e kaka wiye cham abiriyo motho ma yamb oro otwoyo; gin higni abiriyo mag kech.
english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

kikuyu: Kuom mano winj ma, in miseyudo masira midoko ngʼama omer to ok gi kongʼo.
english: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone Abiathar jadolo, ma wuod Ahimelek niya, “Kelna law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.” Abiathar nokelone,
english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

kikuyu: Ber bedo mamor gi gik ma in-go moloyo bedo gi gombo kuom gima iongego. Ma bende en gima onge tiende kendo ochalo mana kalawo bangʼ yamo.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Kendo Jeremia nodongʼ e laru mar jarito nyaka odiechiengʼ ma Jerusalem nokaw. Ma e kaka Jerusalem ne okaw:
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

kikuyu: Adoni-Bezek noringo mondo oyombgi, to ne gilawe ma gimake kendo gingʼado lith lwetene mathuon kod lith tiendene mathuon.
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

kikuyu: Yala kichwaka kuom timni makare, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha; kik iyienegi gisungre ni gisenyala.
english: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

kikuyu: Jatend dhout jo-Kohath ne en Elizafan wuod Uziel.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

kikuyu: Wuon Saulo ma Kish gi wuon Abner ma wuon Ner ne yawuot Abiel.
english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

kikuyu: Ma e wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obirone janabi Jeremia kuom ogendini:
english: The LORD’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

kikuyu: Kinde biro ma giniywag ne Jehova Nyasaye to ok enodwokgi ngangʼ. Kindeno enopandnegi wangʼe nikech gik maricho magisetimo.
english: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

kikuyu: “Meshek gi Tubal bende ni kuno, kaachiel gi ogandagi duto kolworo lietegi. Gin duto ok otergi nyangu, kendo ligangla osenegogi, nikech ne gichando ji e piny joma ngima.
english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An e makati mar ngima. Ngʼama obiro ira kech ok noka, kendo ngʼama oyie kuoma riyo ok nolo ngangʼ.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

kikuyu: Nikech ka wamako geno mane wachakogo matek nyaka giko to wanabed jocham girkeni kaachiel gi Kristo.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

kikuyu: Elija nochungo nyathino motingʼe kogole oko ewi tado motere e ot. Nomiye min-gi mowachone niya ne wuodi ngima!
english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni negingʼeyo Nyasaye kamano, to ne ok gimiye duongʼ kaka Nyasaye, kendo ne ok gidwokone erokamano, to pachgi nobedo manono kendo chunygi mofuyo nodinore.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

kikuyu: Ewi gik machalo agulni manie wi sirni ariyogo, ewi kama olosi ka tawo but thiwni, noketie gik mongʼinore mia ariyo e laini molwore.
english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

kikuyu: Koro alamonegi. Ok alam ni piny, to alamo ni joma isemiya, nimar gin magi.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

kikuyu: To Naomi nowacho niya, “Nyiga, doguru thucheu. Angʼo momiyo udwaro dhi koda? Bende pod anyalo nywolo yawuowi ma dikendu?
english: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

kikuyu: Nyikwa Gershom ne gin: Shubael mane wuowi makayo.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

kikuyu: Ka iwuotho, to gibiro chiki; to ka inindo, to giniriti; to ka ichiewo, to giniwuo kodi.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

kikuyu: Ji nodag kaachiel e kanyakla ei Juda kod miechgi duto, jopur kod jogo mawuotho ka gi kacha gi jambgi.
english: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.

kikuyu: Mach notieko yawuotgi matindo, kendo nyigi ne ok owernegi wende kisera;
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

kikuyu: Elisha nowacho niya, “Keluru mogo matin.” Kendo kane okiro mogono e agulu nowacho niya, “Koro tokeuru ne ji mondo ochame.” Bangʼ mano koro ne onge gima kech ei agulu.
english: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata ma madho chak kende pod en nyathi mayom, omiyo oonge gi lony kuom puonj mar tim makare.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

kikuyu: Masira ma Jehova Nyasaye biro goyogo pinje duto mosebedo kakedo gi Jerusalem en ma: Ringregi biro tow ka gichungʼ, wengegi biro tow, kendo lewgi biro tow ei dhogi.
english: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

kikuyu: kendo napodho auma kalamo Jehova Nyasaye. Namiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach ruodha Ibrahim duongʼ, mane telona e yo maber mayudo nyako ma nyakwar owad gi ruodha ne wuode.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni ka abiro iru to anabi katingʼo gweth mogundho mar Kristo.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: To un ok onego ubed machal kodgi. Kar bedo kamano, to ngʼat maduongʼ moloyo e dieru onego obed kaka jal matinie moloyo, to ngʼat motelo obed machal gi ngʼatno matiyo.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

kikuyu: Yie wigi ne chalo gi yie wi mon, kendo lekegi ne chalo gi leke sibuoche.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato onge gi watne manyalo warone lowo, to kata en owuon ndalo moyudo pesa onyalo ware,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

kikuyu: Joshua wuod Nun, jatich Jehova Nyasaye, notho ka en ja-higni mia achiel gapar.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon kod duongʼ mara mopongʼo piny,
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—

kikuyu: Pilato nowacho niya, “Kare in ruoth?” Yesu nodwoko niya, “In kare kuom wacho ni an ruoth. Chutho mano emomiyo nonywola, kendo mano emomiyo ne abiro e pinyni, mondo atim neno kuom adiera. Ngʼato ka ngʼato ma jakora adiera winja.”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

kikuyu: Kik ibed gi wach e bura mar miriambo kendo kik umi ngʼat maonge ketho ngʼadne buch tho, nimar ok anangʼwon ne ngʼat ma bura oloyo.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

kikuyu: To koro, ne, odi oweni kodongʼ gunda.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

kikuyu: Ei lwete otingʼo yie rombe kendo omako gir chwecho gi lith lwetene.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

kikuyu: Winji yaye polo! Chik iti, yaye piny! Nikech Jehova Nyasaye osewuoyo: asepidho nyithindo mobedo madongo, to gisepiem koda.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for the LORD has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jotich nonyiso chi Nabal ma Abigael niya, “Daudi nooro joote koa e thim mondo obi omos jaduongʼwa, to nobayonegi wach.
english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.

kikuyu: Waluru higa mar piero abich, kendo ugo milome e piny duto ni en higa ma joma otwe igonyo iweyogi gibedo thuolo. Enobed hiku mar mor; ngʼato ka ngʼato nodog thurgi ir joode kendo ir anywolane.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

kikuyu: Kane giyude loka nam komachielo, negipenje niya, “Rabi, ne ichopo sa adi?”
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

kikuyu: “Paruruane kaka ondanyo dongo. Ok ginyagre gi tich kata gi chwecho. To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich duto ne ok orwakore ka achiel kuomgi.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

kikuyu: Hekalu notieki gero e odiechiengʼ mar adek mar dwe mar Adar, e higa mar auchiel mar loch Ruoth Darius.
english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Simeon, kaw Shelumiel wuod Zurishadai;
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: Chuny mamor en yath maber, to chuny mool tuoyo choke.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ngʼatno nokela nyaka kama ler ma oko, kendo nopimo sirnine, lach sirnigo ne romo fut ochiko bathe koni gi koni.
english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

kikuyu: To hera ma awuoyo kuomeni en ni mondo wawuoth kaka chik Nyasaye dwaro. To mana kaka ne usewinjo nyaka aa chakruok, chik Nyasaye en ni wuothuru e hera.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Israel nonene, negipenjore kendgi niya, “Ma en angʼo?” Nimar ne ok gingʼeyo gima ne en. Musa nowachonegi niya, “En e Makati ma Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou mondo ucham.
english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mowachone jaketho niya, “In kare ionge ketho” ji biro kwongʼe to piny kwede.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

kikuyu: Kane ja-Filistiano osudo machiegni mondo oked kode, Daudi ne oringo mapiyo piyo kochiko kar kedo mondo orom kode.
english: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyaka e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka en gi jo-Juda, jo-Jerusalem, jodolo, jonabi kaachiel gi ji duto momewo kod ma jochan. Nosomonegi weche duto mane ondiki e Kitabu mar Singruok, mane osenwangʼ e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka giwinjo.
english: The king went up to the LORD’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nokawo Adam kendo nokete e puoth Eden mondo olose kendo orite.
english: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Kel ane ywakni.” Ruodh Jakobo wacho niya, “Wuouru ane kuom wachni.
english: Produce your cause,” says the LORD. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar Tera. Tera nonywolo Abram, Nahor kod Haran. Kendo Haran nonywolo Lut.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

kikuyu: Daudi nosewacho niya, “Ngʼat ma nokwong kedo gi jo-Jebus ema nobed jatend jolweny.” Joab wuod Zeruya ema nodhi mokwongo nokete jatelo.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

kikuyu: Nimar gima ochwe ngimane nitie e remo, omiyo asemiyougo mondo utim-go misango e kendo mar misango mondo upwodhrugo nikech remo ema itimogo misango mar pwodho ngima ngʼato.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

kikuyu: Mano e dhoranga Jehova Nyasaye ma joma kare nyalo donjogo.
english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

kikuyu: To kum ma ji mathoth kuomu osemiyo ngʼatni koro oromo.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

kikuyu: Tingʼuru wangʼu malo kendo une joma aa yo nyandwat. Ere kweth mane oket e lwetu, rombe mane usungorugo?
english: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?

kikuyu: Chunya ywago jo-Moab; nimar ogandane ringo kadhi pondo Zoar, ma gichopo nyaka Eglath Shelishiya. Gidhi ka giluwo yo mochomo Luhith ka giywak, e yo madhi Horonaim giywak malit nikech kethruokgi.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

kikuyu: Ei agola mar rangach midonjogo ne nitie mesni ariyo bathe koni gi koni, ewi mesnigo ema ne iyangʼoe jamni mitimogo misengini mopogore opogore kaka misengini miwangʼo pep, misengini mag golo richo, kod misengini mag pwodhoruok e richo.
english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Kane Daniel owinjo ni oseket sei e chikno nodhi e ode kama ne nitie ot moro man-gi dirise mochomo yo Jerusalem. Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ Daniel ne goyo chonge piny kodwoko erokamano ni Nyasache nyadidek mana kaka nosebedo kotimo pile.
english: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “ ‘E odiechiengʼno anatur jok manie ngʼutgi, kendo anachod nyoroche motwegigo; joma welo ok nochak oketgi wasumbini mag-gi kendo.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa e Thim mar Sinai e dwe mokwongo mar higa mar ariyo bangʼ kane gisewuok Misri. Nowachone niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: Eka notuom pi maler e agulu kendo nojow buru moa e dier kama ler mar lemo mi okwo e pigno.
english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

kikuyu: “Ne ilor e Got Sinai; mane iwuoyo kodgi gie polo. Ne imiyogi puonj kod chike makare kendo madiera kendo ne imiyogi puonj maber.
english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

kikuyu: Pilato nowuoro ka nowinjo ni Yesu osetho, omiyo noluongo jatend jolweny mopenje kapo Yesu nosetho adier.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

kikuyu: Kwongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ni e od jaricho, to ogwedho dala ngʼat makare.
english: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Koro nowachona niya, Wuod dhano, koro dhi ir dhood Israel mondo iwach nigi wechena.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nooro ngʼat moro ma nyinge Johana.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

kikuyu: Ne akelogi e od Jehova Nyasaye, e agola mar yawuot Hanan wuod Igdalia ngʼat Nyasaye. Ne entiere machiegni gi agola mar jotelo, mane okalo mano mar Maseya wuod Shalum ma jarit dhood hekalu.
english: and I brought them into the LORD’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

kikuyu: Ka mokwongo ne oonge tich kane pok gimoro otime, donge en gima tek moloyo mondo olose obed gima nigi tich bangʼ ka mach, osewangʼe kendo orewore?
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

kikuyu: Mano kaka nobed malit ne thuondi mag madho kongʼo kendo molony e ruwo kongʼo makech.
english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

kikuyu: joma konyore gi gige piny bende kik yie chunygi gedi e gigo, nikech piny ma waneno sani-ni biro kadho.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

kikuyu: Maknwauru nyithind bwe ma pod tindo, maketho puothewa mag mzabibu; nikech dipo ka giketho mzabibuwa mosechako thiewo.
english: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

kikuyu: to gi Beria kod Shema mane jotend anywola mar jogo mane odak Aijalon kod jogo mane oriembo joma nodak Gath.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi nowacho ni mano en. Ji mamoko to nowacho niya, “Ooyo, ngʼatni chal mana kode.” Ngʼatno owuon to nowacho koramo niya, “En mana an.”
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

kikuyu: Moruru kuom Jehova Nyasaye un joma kare, kendo pakuru nyinge maler.
english: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

kikuyu: Oganda manobet kolworo Yesu nowachone niya, “Minu gi oweteni ni oko ka gidwari.”
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

kikuyu: Kokalo kuom ruodh Asuria, Jehova Nyasaye biro kelo kuomi gi kuom jogi kod od wuonu masira mane pok oneye nyaka ne Efraim pogre gi Juda.”
english: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Ji noring kapondo e buche manie kind lwendni kod buche manie kor lwanda, ka luoro omakogi nikech duongʼ malich mar Jehova Nyasaye kod tekone, e kindeno mano thinyre mondo oyieng piny.
english: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe negiwuotho e thim, ka ginono pinje mag Edom gi Moab, ka gikalo yo wuok chiengʼ mar piny Moab mine gidhi gibworo e bath aora Arnon. Ne ok gidonjo e alap mar jo-Moab, nimar Arnon ema tongʼ mare.
english: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

kikuyu: Kik isungri kuom kiny, nikech ok ingʼeyo gima odiechiengʼ nyalo kelo.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

kikuyu: nikech Injili marwa ne ok obironu gi wach miwacho gi dhok kende, to nobironu gi teko kendo gi Roho Maler, kod yie motegno. Ungʼeyo kaka ne wachalo kane wadak e dieru, ne wadak kamano nikech un.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

kikuyu: Eka naneno kom mar loch maduongʼ marachar kaachiel gi jal manobedo e komno. Piny gi polo noringo oa e nyime mi olal nono ma ok nonegi kendo.
english: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda duto nokelo achiel kuom apar mar cham, divai manyien kod mo e ute keno.
english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

kikuyu: Kinde duto rwakri gi lewni marochere, kendo kinde duto wir wiyi gi mo.
english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

kikuyu: Eka nodonjo ei yie kendo jopuonjrene noluwe.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: ka ochungʼ e kind jolwenj jo-Misri kod jo-Israel. Otienono duto bor polono nokelo mudho ne konchiel to komachielo nokelo ler; omiyo onge oganda mane osudo machiegni gi machielo otienono duto.
english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

kikuyu: onyalo wuoyo e tie itgi mi obwog-gi gi siem mayoreyore,
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

kikuyu: “ ‘Jogi paka mana gi dhogi kende, to chunygi bor koda.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Wuoda, koro kelna ring le mondo acham, mondo mi agwedhi.” Jakobo nokelone ringʼo mi ochamo bende nokelone divai mi omadho.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

kikuyu: Nopenjo niya, “Ne uiko ringre kanye?” Negidwoke niya, “Ruoth, bi wadhi wanyisi.”
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano ok anagol herana kuome, bende ok anatimne gima opogore gi adierana.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

kikuyu: Yaye, dine ber ka chunygi osiko koluora kendo orito chikena duto mondo omi gidhi maber kaachiel gi nyithindgi nyaka chiengʼ!
english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

kikuyu: Nikech herani maduongʼ chopo nyaka e polo; kendo adiera mari chopo nyaka ewi lwasi.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

kikuyu: imiyo ngʼama kamano resruok e ndalo chandruok, nyaka chop kuny bur ne joma richo.
english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

kikuyu: Bende isechiko piny mondo oyawre maler mamiyo joricho wuok kuonde ma gipondoe?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: Chuny dhano chano gik modwaro timo, to dwoko margi aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane ohulo wach mar Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye, Eli nogore piny ataro koa e kom manobetie e bath rangach. Ngʼute ne otur mi notho, nikech ne oti kendo ne ochwe. Ne osetelo ne Israel kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nogoyo jowasikgi duto ka ginegogi gi ligangla kendo negitiekogi, mine gitimo gima gihero ne joma ne ochayogi.
english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

kikuyu: “Koro neyeuru ngʼatno, mane ok okawo Nyasaye obedo kar pondo mare, to nogeno mana kuom mwandune mathoth kendo notieko joma moko mondo eka omed bedo gi teko!”
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Abiro timo gini nikech gisejwangʼa mi gilamo Ashtoreth nyasaye madhako mar jo-Sidon gi Kemosh nyasach jo-Moab kod Molek nyasach jo-Amon kendo ok gisewuotho e yorena; kata timo gima kare e nyima, kata rito buchena kod chikena kaka Daudi, wuon Solomon notimo.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

kikuyu: We puonjna ochwe ka koth kendo wechena olor ka thoo, kendo a ngʼidho machwer e lum manyien mana ka koth mangʼeny ne yien matindo.
english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

kikuyu: Fuonde mag ringra ne ok opondoni, kane ochweya ei minwa, kane ochwe ringra e kama opondo,
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Ka kamano e kaka Nyasaye rwako lum aluma manie pap, ma kawuono nitie to kiny iwite e mach, to koro un dorwaku, machal nade, yaye un joma yiegi tin-gi?
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

kikuyu: Lietegi ema biro siko kaka utegi nyaka chiengʼ kendo ema gibiro dakie higni gi higni ma ok rum, kata obedo ni negimako lope mathoth koni gi koni.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

kikuyu: Esau nofwenyo kaka Isaka wuon mare ne ok mor gi nyi jo-Kanaan.
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Yesu nooro jopuonjrene ariyo kowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru ei dala maduongʼ mondo urom gi ngʼato motingʼo dapi. Luweuru nyaka ot modhiye.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

kikuyu: “Aa malo mondo inyis jo-Israel opwodhre kinyisogi ni, ‘Pwodhreuru kuikoru ni odiechiengʼ ma kiny nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wacho kama: Gik mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye nitie e dieru, yaye Israel, omiyo kapod ok ugolo gigo kuomu, to ok unulo wasiku.
english: Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, “There is a devoted thing among you, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you.”

kikuyu: Abiro miyo ji pari e tienge duto nyaka chiengʼ; kuom mano ogendini biro paki mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nopondo oko kendo kane Sawo mar Dwe manyien ochopo, to ruoth nobet piny mondo ochiem.
english: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.

kikuyu: To abiro dhi nyime katimo gima atimoni mondo agengʼ joote mamoko mag miriambo madwaro duongʼ mondo nenre ni gitiyo tich machalre gi marwa.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

kikuyu: Ehud nothedho pand ligangla ma dhoge ariyo ma borne dirom fut achiel gi nus, mane oliere e bamne korachwich ei lepe.
english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

kikuyu: Oseketho kare mar dak mana ka puodho moketh chambe modongʼ nono, kendo osemuko kare mar romo. Jehova Nyasaye osemiyo Sayun wiye owil kod sewni moyier gi Sabatoge; kendo kuom mirimbe mager, osejwangʼo ruoth kaachiel gi jadolo.
english: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. The LORD has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.

kikuyu: Ruodhi abichgi duto noriwo jolwenjgi ne kedo e Holo mar Sidim (miluongo ni Nam chumbi).
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato dende kamoro owangʼ kendo kido mamarmar kata marachar owuok e adhola mar kama owangʼno,
english: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

kikuyu: “An gi misango mar lalruok e oda, kawuononi asechopo singruok maga.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negikelo gadiera chiwo gi achiel kuom apar kod mich mowal. Konania ja-Lawi ne jarit mar gigo to jatelo maluwe ne owadgi Shimei.
english: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni tiendene towo kendo miyo osikene tho,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kikuyu: “Beduru mamor e ndalono kendo chikreuru ka uil, nikech poku duongʼ e polo. Nimar mano e kaka kweregi notimo ne jonabi.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

kikuyu: E ndalono wendni nower e piny Juda ni: Wan gi dala maduongʼ man-gi teko; Nyasaye kelo resruok e ohingane gi kuonde molwore.
english: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

kikuyu: Ibiro muomori ir joga Israel mana ka boche polo moumo piny. E ndalo mabiro, yaye Gog, abiro miyo iked gi pinya, mondo eka ogendini mamoko ongʼeya ka ananyisra kaka ngʼama ler ka atiyo kodi ka gineno gi wengegi.
english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar joka Shem. Higni ariyo bangʼ ataro ka Shem ja-higni mia achiel nonywolo Arfaksad.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

kikuyu: Musa noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Jo-Misri ongʼeyo wachni malongʼo ni in ema nigolo jo-Israel oa kuomgi gi tekoni iwuon.
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

kikuyu: Kawuononi uchungʼ uduto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ka un kaachiel gi jotendu, jou madongo, jodongu, jotendu mamoko, kod jo-Israel duto machwo,
english: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

kikuyu: Chwore to noluwo bangʼe kaywak nyaka gichopo Bahurim, eka Abner ne owachone niya, “Dog dala!” Mi nodok.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

kikuyu: To en mana in, dichwo kaka an in jawuodha kendo osiepna,
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

kikuyu: Noyudo en-gi mirima kod jo-Turo gi jo-Sidon. Kuom mano jo-Turo kod jo-Sidon ne joriwore mi giloso thuolo mar romo gi Herode. Ne gitudore gi Blasto, mane en jatich ruoth mogeno, eka negiyudo yo mar loso kwe gi ruoth, nikech chiembgi ne wuok e piny Herode.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone ja-Kenturo niya, “Dhiyo! Biro timoreni mana kaka iseyie ni notimreno.” Kendo jatichne nochango e sa nogono.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

kikuyu: kendo kapo ni tienda osebaro moweyo yo, kata wengena osewuondo chunya, kata ka gimoro osechido lwetena,
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

kikuyu: Abimelek nodhi e kama oger motegnono mondo omi omonje. To kane ochopo machiegni gi dhoranga kama oger motegnono mondo omokie mach,
english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

kikuyu: Donge Jehova Nyasaye neno kisando ji duto manie twech,
english: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

kikuyu: Noter Zedekia Babulon, kama enosikie nyaka atimne gima adwaro, Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Ka ukedo gi jo-Babulon, to ok unulogi.’ ”
english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says the LORD, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi mano, waoro bende Judas gi Sila mondo onyisu gi dhogi weche mwandikonu e baruwani.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo piyo piyo nyaka Zarefath e piny Sidon kendo ibed kanyo. Asechiko dhako ma chwore otho moro kanyo mondo omiyi chiemo.”
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

kikuyu: Nikech osenywolu nywol manyien, ok gi kodhi ma towo, to gi kodhi ma ok tow, gi wach Nyasaye mangima kendo mochwere.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

kikuyu: Ido, Ginethon, Abija,
english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

kikuyu: Kendo Joshua nochungo kite apar gariyogo Gilgal, ma gin kite mane ogolo e aora Jordan.
english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo Galili, jo-Galili norwake. Ne giseneno gik moko duto mane osetimo Jerusalem chiengʼ Sap Pasaka, nimar gin bende ne gin kuno.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

kikuyu: To Ahab nopenjo niya, “To en ngʼatno mabiro timo mano?” To janabi nodwoke niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Rowere ma jolweny mag jotend lweny mar gwenge ema biro timo mani.’ ” Nopenjo niya, “En ngʼa mabiro chako lweny?” To janabi nodwoke niya, “In ema ibiro timo kamano.”
english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “The LORD says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

kikuyu: Ma e chik ma Jehova Nyasaye chiwo kuom nyi Zelofehad: Inyalo nywomgi gi ngʼato angʼata ma gihero moa e dhoodgi.
english: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

kikuyu: “Angʼo mamonou ngʼado bura mar gima kare?
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

kikuyu: Ogendini nigi chandruok, kendo pinjeruodhi podho; otingʼo dwonde mi piny leny nono.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

kikuyu: Ma e chik mane Musa omiyo jo-Israel.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kane gisengʼado loka komachielo, negichopo Genesaret.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: “ ‘Biuru sani mondo uwinjru gi ruodha, ma en ruodh Asuria: Abiro miyou farese alufu ariyo, ka unyalo yudo joma riembogi!
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

kikuyu: Solomon nongʼiewo geche mag lweny kod farese; ne en gi geche lweny alufu achiel mia angʼwen kod farese alufu apar gariyo mane oketo e mier madongo mag geche lweny to moko bende noketo Jerusalem kama nodake.
english: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ruoth Aram nenie e lweny gi jo-Israel. Bangʼ kane osewinjore gi jodonge, nowacho niya, “Abiro goyo kambina kama chalo kama.”
english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

kikuyu: Jotend jo-Israel kod ruoth nobolore kawacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ni kare.”
english: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “The LORD is righteous.”

kikuyu: To jopuonjre nodwoke mayot niya, “Ruoth dware.”
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

kikuyu: To kata ka ukwayo Nyasaye, to ok uyud gik mukwayo nikech ukwayo gi paro maricho mondo utimgo dwarou uwegi.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka jolweny mag wasike osenegi, sunga nomak ruoth mar milambo mi nomed nego ji gana gi gana, to kata kamano lochneno nobed mar kinde matin.
english: The multitude will be carried off, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro ma nyinge Lazaro ne tuo. Ne en ja-Bethania, dala gi Maria gi Maritha nyamin mare.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

kikuyu: Winj ywakna, kendo bi piyo mondo iresa; bed lwandana mar pondo, kendo ohinga motegno manyalo resa.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

kikuyu: Eka Abimelek noluongo Ibrahim ire mi openje niya, “Angʼo ma isetimonwani? Ere gima rach ma asetimoni ma omiyo isekelo richo maduongʼni kuoma kod pinyruodha? Isetimona gik moko ma ok onego tim ne ngʼato.”
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

kikuyu: Kendo kik udhi e kendona mar misango ka uwuotho e kuonde motingʼore ma iidhogo malo, dipo ka dugu onenorene.’
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

kikuyu: Timuru ne ji mamoko mana kaka duher mondo gin bende gitimnu.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

kikuyu: Bende ichiko iti ne rieko mar Nyasaye? Koso iloko rieko giri iwuon?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

kikuyu: An to ngimana onge ketho; yie iwara kendo ikecha.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

kikuyu: Eka nawinjo dwol moa e polo kawacho niya, “Ndik ni: Chakre kawuononi, jogo gin joma ogwedhi matho kogeno kuom Ruoth!” Roho bende wacho ni, “Ee, gin johawi adier, nikech giniywe kuom tichgi matek, nimar timbegi noluwgi.”
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

kikuyu: Bi machiegni mondo ikonya, resa nikech joma kedo koda.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Donge dakumgi ne ma? Donge dachul kuor ne oganda ma kama?”
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?

kikuyu: Bangʼe, gomboni mandhaga ne oywayi mi iterori nyaka gi jo-Babulon, ma gin johala madongo, to kata gin bende ne ok giromi.
english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

kikuyu: Duongʼ gi mwandu mag ogendini mag pinje nokel e iye.
english: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

kikuyu: Obiro timo winjruok gi ji mangʼeny kuom kinde maromo higni abiriyo. To e nus mar higni abiriyogo, enomi ji we timo misengini kod kelo chiwo. Gima kwero makelo kethruok nochungʼ e osuch hekalu, nyaka ngʼat mane okete kanyo chop e giko mane Nyasaye oketone.”
english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik udwanyru kutimo timbe ma kamago nikech timbego ema ogendini mabiro riembo e nyimu ne timo.
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

kikuyu: kendo enobed mamor gi joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye. Ok nongʼad bura kuom gima oneno giwangʼe, kata chiwo parone kod gima owinjo gi ite;
english: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoko niya, “Wachneuru Daudi ni, ‘Ruoth ok dwar ni inyombne, eka ikaw nyare, to odwaro mana ni mondo ikelne ringre jo-Filistia mia achiel (ma en pien duongʼ-gi), mondo ochulgo kuor ne wasike.’ ” Chenro mar Saulo ne en ni mondo Daudi opodhie lwet jo-Filistia.
english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo in to ne itamori kecho jatich wadu kaka an bende ne akonyi?’
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

kikuyu: Miechu madongo biro bedo gundni, kuondeu maler mag lemo abiro ketho, kendo ok anayie winjo tik mangʼwe ngʼar mag misengini mau.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

kikuyu: to un bende asiemou ni ibiro kumou; nikech paro marach ma un-gono, eka unungʼe ni nitiere chiengʼ ngʼado bura.”
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

kikuyu: “Kindeno kane adonjo gie ranga dala mi abet e koma ei paw bura,
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno okode motwe e ngʼut farese bende nondikie ni mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo agulni mitedogo ei hekalu bende nowal ne tich Jehova Nyasaye mana ka tewni mitiyogo e kendo mar misango.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nawachonegi ni, ‘Ngʼato ka ngʼato man-gi bangli mag dhahabu okaw mondo okel.’ Eka negimiya dhahabu kendo nakete e mach mi aloso nyaroyani!”
english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano abiro dak kod jo-Israel kendo abiro bedo Nyasachgi.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

kikuyu: kendo asepongʼe gi Roho mar Nyasaye mondo obed gi lony, gi rieko, gi nyalo kod ngʼeyo tije duto mag lwedo;
english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

kikuyu: Abiro dhi kodi Misri kendo nachak aduogi ka adier kendo Josef ema noyuo wangʼi sa thoni.”
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe tungʼ moro nochako otwi koa kuom tunge angʼwen-go, nochako kotin to bangʼe achien nodongo ka en gi teko kochomo yo milambo gi yo wuok chiengʼ kod yo Piny Maber mar Israel.
english: Out of one of them came out a little horn which grew exceedingly great—toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Simeon ne romo ji alufu piero abich gochiko gi mia adek (59,300).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nyaka gur hembegi e migepe, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato nitiere kare owuon kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

kikuyu: Para e chunyi kinde duto, kendo wiyi kik wil koda; nikech hera nigi teko mana ka tho, kendo nyiego ma hera nigo tut mana ka bur tho. Herano liel ka mach mabebni, kendo mana ka ligek mach maduongʼ.
english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.

kikuyu: mi nochiwo ote mare kama: “Ote Balaam wuod Beor, ote mar ngʼat ma wengene neno maber,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye ne itingʼo tingʼna, kendo ne ireso ngimana.
english: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

kikuyu: Ka piny kaachiel gi ji duto modakie yiengni, to an ema amako sirnige motegno. Sela
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi piny kochakore Janoa nyaka Ataroth gi Naara, momulo Jeriko mokadho e aora Jordan.
english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

kikuyu: Donge lweta ema osechweyo gigi duto?’
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

kikuyu: To ruoth ne ongʼwono ma ok ochiwo Mefibosheth wuod Jonathan, ma wuod Saulo, nikech singruok mane Daudi gi Jonathan wuod Saulo otimo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

kikuyu: “Ka jokwoge obironu, jomecho mag otieno, to mano kaka masira malich ritou, donge gibiro kwalo mwandu magu kaka ginyalo? Ka jopon mzabibu obiro iru donge digiwe olemb mzabibu matin?
english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

kikuyu: Singruokni miya mor, mana ka ngʼama oyudo mwandu maduongʼ mope wasigu.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

kikuyu: (Kata kamono, Geshur kod Aram ne omako Havoth Jair, kaachiel gi Kenath kod kuonde mag dak molwore, mane gin mier piero auchiel). Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Makir wuon Gilead.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Malaike duto nochungʼ kolworo kom duongʼ kendo kolworo jodongo kod gik mangima angʼwen. Negikulore piny e nyim kom duongʼ mine gidendo Nyasaye.
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

kikuyu: Nikech wan wamor ka wanyap, to un utek. Omiyo walamonu mondo ubed joma kare.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Dhi gi kwe.” Omiyo nodhi Hebron.
english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.

kikuyu: “Bende anami jo-Misri bed gi ngʼwono kuom jogi, mondo ka uwuok to ok unua gi lwetu nono.
english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka dipo ni ngʼato otho bute, mi yie wiye mosewal ogak, to nyaka oliel yie wiyeno chiengʼ mar abiriyo mipwodhee.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

kikuyu: To nying nyar jo-Midian mane onegi ne en Kozbi ma nyar Zur, ma wuon-gi ne en jatend dhood jo-Midian.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

kikuyu: “Eka, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho, omera Hanamel nobiro ira e agola mar jarito kendo owacho ni, ‘Ngʼiew puotha man Anathoth kama Benjamin orito. Nikech en ratiro mari mondo ingʼiewe kendo ikawe, ngʼiewe ne in owuon.’ “Ne angʼeyo ni ma ne en wach Jehova Nyasaye;
english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to the LORD’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “Then I knew that this was the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: ka gikok niya, “Jo-Israel, konywauru. Ma e ngʼat mapuonjo ji duto kamoro amora modhiye mondo gibed mamon kod jowa, gi chikewa kod hekaluwani. Kata sani osekelo nyaka jo-Yunani ei hekalu ka, mi odwanyo kama lerni.”
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

kikuyu: e gikone, yawuowi abiriyogo duto notho ma ok onywol gi chigino. Bangʼe achien dhakono bende ne otho.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni atimo nenda awuon to nenda ok nikare.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

kikuyu: Yaye un ogendini, mwandu noyaki mana ka kama nyithi bonyo omonjo; kendo ji noyak mwandugi, mana kaka bonyo monjo piny.
english: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

kikuyu: Ngʼuti chalo gi kar ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo molos gi lak liech. Wengeni nyawni ka pi Yawo mar Heshbon but rangach mar Bath Rabim. Umi chalo gi kar ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo mar Lebanon momanyore gi Damaski.
english: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

kikuyu: Kata ka ngʼato nigi kidi e lwete manyalo nego ngʼato, mi ogoyogo wadgi motho, to en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, un koro ok udak e ngima maru mar pinyni mondo uchop gombo maricho mag dhano, to udak mar timo dwaro Nyasaye.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

kikuyu: Koa yo wuok chiengʼ, negidak e piny mokiewo gi thim kadhi nyaka Aora Yufrate nikech jambgi ne omedore e piny Gilead.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: kendo Ibrahim nomiye achiel kuom apar mar gik moko duto. Tiend nying Melkizedek gin ariyo, mokwongo en ni ruoth makare, kendo mar ariyo en Ruodh Salem tiende ni Ruodh kwe.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

kikuyu: Ne ok adewo wach jogo mane nenore ka jotelo, nimar ne ok gimiya wach moro manyien nikech Nyasaye ok odewo nenruok ma oko mar dhano.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

kikuyu: Dhood Manase ema nobed butgi. Jatend dhoodno ne en Gamaliel wuod Pedazur.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni kech kaya to ok dak anyisu, nikech piny en mara, kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

kikuyu: Negiloso kandho marambulu mirwakogo law dolo mar efod, ma en tij jatwengʼo molony,
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

kikuyu: Norangogi duto, to eka nowachone ngʼatno niya, “Rie lweti.” Notimo kamano, kendo lwete nochango chuth.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owuon osekeyogi e pinje; kendo koro ok odewgi. Jodolo ok yud duongʼ, kendo jodongo ok mi luor.
english: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka nopwodh Kama Ler Moloyo nikech timbe mogak kod ngʼanyo mar oganda jo-Israel, bed ni gisetimo richo moro mora. Mano bende e kaka nopwodhi Hemb Romo manie diergi kuom timbegi mogak.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

kikuyu: Suduru but Nyasaye, eka nosud butu. Luokuru lweteu, un jorichogi, kendo pwodhuru chunyu, un joma nigi paro ariyogi.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowuok mondo oked gi jo-Benjamin kendo negiriedo jolwenjgi mag kedo gi jo-Benjamin e piny Gibea.
english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Ywak biro winjore e yore duto mag dala, kendo ji magoyo nduru ibiro winjo kuonde mag chokruok; jopur bende noluong mondo oywagi kaachiel gi joma olony e ywak.
english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

kikuyu: Zedekia ruodh Juda ok notony e lwet jo-Babulon to enochiwe ne ruodh Babulon, kendo enowuo kode wangʼ gi wangʼ mi enonene gi wengene owuon.
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Jakobo nosea Padan Aram, Nyasaye nochako ofwenyorene kendo nogwedhe.
english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

kikuyu: Ka giriwore kaachiel, ginichal gi jolweny maroteke manyono wasigu e yore motimo chwodho sa lweny. Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ni kodgi, gibiro gore mi gilo jo-farese.
english: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora michano timo biro dhi maber, kendo yoreni miluwo nobed maber.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

kikuyu: Jadolo nowangʼ gigi duto ewi kendo mar misango kaka chiemo, ma en chiwo miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Gikanyono dhoho norumo kuom ngʼatno mochango.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo kaka ne wakonyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu mana kaka wuoro konyo nyithinde owuon,
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

kikuyu: Mefibosheth ne nigi wuode matin miluongo ni Mika, to jood Ziba duto ne gin jotij Mefibosheth.
english: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

kikuyu: to kik uwinj wach janabino kata jalekno. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu temou mondo ongʼe ane ka uhere gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto.
english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Kochakore chiengʼno Saulo nochako bedo gi nyiego gi Daudi.
english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

kikuyu: “An kende e jal magolo richou duto kendo ok achak apargi nikech mano e gima ahero timo.
english: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo osehononu oro mondo otwo piny kaachiel gi gode, mi cham gi mzabibu kod mo zeituni, gi gik moko duto ma piny nyago ner, mondo kech omak dhano gi jamni, kendo oketh tije duto ma dhano oloso.”
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Efraim nochako wuoth ka gin e bwo bandechgi kotelnegi gi Elishama wuod Amihud.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

kikuyu: Pururu lowo manie bath aora Nael, yaye Nyar Tarshish, nikech koro uonge gi dho wath.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

kikuyu: kendo negikelo Sandug Muma gi Hemb Romo kod gik moko duto maler manie iye. Jodolo mane jo-Lawi notingʼogi;
english: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

kikuyu: Nikech ne uwinjo wach kendo uboloru e nyim Nyasaye kane uwinjo weche mane owacho kuom pinyni kod joma odakie, kendo nikech ne uboloru e nyima, ma uyiecho lepu kuywak e nyima, omiyo asewinjo ywaku, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Piny noyiengni malich, kech kod tuoche nobedie kuonde mopogore opogore, kendo gik malich mabwogo ji gi honni madongo notimre koa e polo.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel kaachiel gi jo-Lawi, nyaka kel chiwo margi mar cham, divai manyien kod mo nyaka e kar keno kama gigo mag kama ler mar lemo ikanoe kendo kama jodolo, jorit dhorangeye kod jower odakie. “Ok wanajwangʼ od Nyasachwa.”
