english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

kikuyu: Joram wuod Ahab nobedo ruodh Israel e piny Samaria e higa mar apar gaboro mar kinde loch Jehoshafat ruodh Juda kendo nobedo e loch higni apar gariyo.
english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e kinde ma kum bedoe mondo ochop kare gigo duto mane ondiki.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda kod jo-Benjamin bende nodak Jerusalem. Koa kuom nyikwa Juda ne gin: Athaya wuod Uzia, ma wuod Zekaria, ma wuod Amaria, ma wuod Shefatia, ma wuod Mahalalel, ma nyakwar Perez;
english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

kikuyu: Ondiki e chiku ni nend ji ariyo nyalo bedo adiera mi yiego.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

kikuyu: Rowere ma jotend lweny mag gwenge nodhi mokwongo. Koro Ben-Hadad nooro jombetre mane odwogone wach kama, “Jomoko biro kowuok Samaria.”
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

kikuyu: To pachgi nosiko kodinore, nikech nyaka chil kawuono ragengʼno pod oumo chunygi ka isomo singruok machon. Pod ok ogole nikech ragengʼno igolo mana ka ngʼato ni kuom Kristo.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

kikuyu: Ka un gi gima chalo kama e pachu, to mano emomiyo walamonu kinde duto, mondo omi Nyasachwa okwanu kaka joma owinjore gi luongne, mondo tekone ochop dwaro mabeyo duto ma un-go kod tije duto mutimo nikech yie ma un-go.
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

kikuyu: Kane abiro iru, angʼo momiyo ne ok ayudo ngʼato? Kane aluongou, ere gima omiyo ne ok ngʼato odwoka? Koso uparo ni bada ne chiek ma ok nyal konyou? Uparo ni aonge gi teko mar resou? Wuoyona matin nomiyo nam oduono, kendo ne amiyo aore obedo piny motwo mi rech manie eigi otho kendo otop nikech onge mar pi.
english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

kikuyu: Enochungʼ mi okwa rombe gi teko mar Jehova Nyasaye, ka en gi duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache. Joge nodag maonge luoro nikech duongʼne nochop e tunge piny,
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: nyaka chop wan duto wabed achiel e yie mawan-go kuom Wuod Nyasaye kendo wamed ngʼeye chutho. Kamano otimore eka wanabed joma otegno chutho, kendo wanachop e rangʼiny mogik kuom Kristo.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

kikuyu: Negilamo Jehova Nyasaye, to bende negiyiero jogi giwegi mopogore opogore mondo obednegi jodolo e kuonde lemo motingʼore gi malo.
english: So they feared the LORD, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

kikuyu: Filipo nodhi nyaka e dala mar Samaria mi olando Wach Kristo kuno.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

kikuyu: nikech giduto ne ginene ma luoro nomakogi. To Yesu noloso kodgi gisano kowachonegi niya, “Beduru gi chir! En mana An! Kik uluor.”
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Kuonde dak man-gi kwe iketho nikech mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

kikuyu: Makatini nyaka kete e nyim Jehova Nyasaye pile ka pile chiengʼ Sabato ka chiengʼ Sabato. Gin mich ma ichiwo e lo jo-Israel kaka singruok manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Sigu kelo miero, to hera umo maricho duto.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

kikuyu: Ne ogonyo yamb ugwe moa e polo, kendo nogolo yamb milambo gi tekone.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

kikuyu: Kendo mad Nyasaye Maratego timnu ngʼwono e nyim ngʼatno mondo mi owe owadu kod Benjamin mondo oduog kodu. To an to kochuno ni nyaka abed mokuyo to abiro kuyo.”
english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

kikuyu: Chik moa e dhogi berna moloyo ngʼinjo gana gi gana mag fedha gi dhahabu.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: To kamane wabuoroe gotieno ne wagonyo gundewa kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa noyudo pesane mana kaka ne wabiro kodgi e dho ogunde. Kuom mano waseduogogi.
english: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

kikuyu: Negichiwo yawuotgi gi nyigi kaka misango, kendo negichiwogi ne jochiende.
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

kikuyu: Ne orwako kwongʼ ka nangane; mad kwongʼno koro donji e dende ka pi, mad gibud chokene ka mo.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasachwa kendo Wuonwa owuon, kod Ruodhwa Yesu, losnwa yo ma wanyalo birogo iru.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

kikuyu: Wuouru gi muolo ne Jerusalem, kendo uwachne, ni ndalone mag chandruok oserumo, bende ni richone osewene, kendo oseyudo kum nyadiriyo koa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye nikech richone duto.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, kaka koro oseketwa kare kuom yie, wan gi kwe gi Nyasaye kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo,
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: Kuno nonwangʼoe ngʼat moro miluongo ni Ainea, mane osebedo kosiko onindo e kitandane kuom higni aboro, ka tuo mar athany onure.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

kikuyu: Yaye ogandana mosenyon piny ka cham midino anyisou gima asewinjo koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

kikuyu: Koro Jesse nowachone Daudi wuode niya, “Kaw atonga mopongʼ gi bando mobul kod makati apar mondo ireti iterne oweteni e kambigi.
english: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nowachona niya, “Gik moko osetimore. An e Alfa gi Omega, Chakruok gi Giko. Ngʼat ma riyo oloyo anami omodh pi soko mar ngima nono ma ok ochulo gimoro.
english: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

kikuyu: In to koro bed ja-adiera ne jatichni, nikech isekwongʼori kode e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. To ka an jaketho to nega in iwuon! Angʼo ma dimi iketa e lwet wuonu?”
english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

kikuyu: Kane Jabin ruodh Hazor owinjo ma, nooro wach ne Jobab ma ruodh Madon, kod ruodhi mag Shimron gi Akshaf,
english: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

kikuyu: Kendo kik ukwongʼru gi wiu, nikech ok unyal loko yie wich achiel bedo marachar kata maratengʼ.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

kikuyu: Ne giwuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye kagiwacho ni, “Nyasaye bende nyalo chano mesa e nyimwa e thim ka?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

kikuyu: E dwe mar abiriyo Ishmael wuod Nethania, ma wuod Elishama, mane aa e anywola mar joka ruoth kendo ma bende ne achiel kuom jotend ruoth, nobiro Mizpa gi ji apar ir Gedalia wuod Ahikam. E kinde mane gichiemo kanyakla kanyo,
english: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

kikuyu: Nokela nyaka e agola mar hekalu kendo nopimo sirni mag agolano; bethene ne romo fut abiriyo gi nus koni gi koni. Lach mar kama idonjogo ne romo fut piero ariyo gachiel kendo ohinga mage mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko ne romo fut angʼwen gi nus bathe koni gi koni.
english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

kikuyu: gi kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani, kaachiel gi ludhene, kod mor pwodhruok gi ubani mangʼwe ngʼar, gi pasia molier e dhood Hemb Romo,
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo kanyo iluongo ni Bersheba nikech ji ariyogo notimo singruok kanyo.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

kikuyu: Gikanyono achiel kuomgi noringo okawo siponj. Nonyume e kongʼo makech, kendo nochome ewi odundu mabor, bangʼe omiye Yesu mondo omadhi.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: Jopecho mongʼith moa Gebal noidhi kaka jokiew ngai kendo jochung nanga mari. Yiedhi duto manie nam kaachiel gi joma gitingʼo nobiro iri mondo gilok ohala gi mwandugi.
english: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

kikuyu: Jogo manowinjo mani nopenjo niya, “Kare en ngʼa manyalo kwo?”
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Yawuot Perez ne gin: Hezron kod Hamul.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Kata kamano nowuotho awuotha kokadho e kind oganda modhi kuma nodhiyoe.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

kikuyu: Wuo ka ichwako joma ok nyal wacho wachgi gin giwegi, ka ichwako jogo maonge nyalo.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

kikuyu: Kihondko kod kibaji nogogi e miechgi; to liganglana notiek nyithindgi e yore. Yawuowi gi nyiri biro tho, kaachiel gi nyithindo ma pod yom kod jodongo moti.
english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jo-Gaza osebedo katimo richo mangʼeny, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech gisemako ogendini duto mi giterogi e twech e piny Edom,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia noweyo nyisechegi kanyo kendo Daudi gi joge notingʼo gi modhigo.
english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

kikuyu: Kodagi winjogi, to nyis kanisa wachno; to kodagi winjo nyaka kanisa, to kawe kaka dikaw ngʼat ma japiny kata jasol osuru.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

kikuyu: Yawuot Amram ne gin: Harun kod Musa. Harun gi nyikwaye to nowal nyaka chiengʼ mondo opwodh gik maler moloyo, kendo ochiw misango e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo gitine kendo gigwedh ji e nyinge nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachone ji duto niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel wacho, Chon gi lala kwereu, motingʼo nyaka Tera ma wuon Ibrahim kod Nahor, nodak but Aora Yufrate kendo negilamo nyiseche manono.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

kikuyu: “Kane pok achweyi e ich ne angʼeyi, kane pok onywoli ne asewali tenge; ne ayieri kaka janabi ne pinje.”
english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nokaw winyo ma pod ngima gi yiend sida, gi usi makwar kod bad owino, kendo lutogi duto e remb winyo mane osenegno.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

kikuyu: Usemiyo nyinga oyany e dier joga mondo uyudgo mogo matin mar shairi gi ngʼinjo mar makati. Kuom wuondo joga mohero miriambo, usenego jomane ok onego otho to useweyo joma ok owinjore obed mangima.
english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

kikuyu: Un to usebiro e Got Sayun, e Jerusalem manie polo, ma en dala maduongʼ mar Nyasaye mangima. Useriworu gi malaike gana gi gana mochokore e nyasi mar mor
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ngʼama okwongʼore gi nying polo okwongʼore bende gi kom loch mar Nyasaye, kaachiel gi Ngʼama obet e komno.
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

kikuyu: To korka jodolo mag joka Lawi wayudo ni achiel kuom apar ichoko gi dhano matho; to kuom Melkizedek to wayudo ni achiel kuom apar nochoki gi jal ma ikwano ni ngima, mana kaka ndiko wacho.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

kikuyu: Jokwath mangʼeny biro ketho puotha mar mzabibu kendo ginyon puotha; gibiro loko puotha mamiyo bedo puodho motwo mojwangʼ.
english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

kikuyu: To Petro nowachone niya, “Aa malo, an mana dhano kaka in.”
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

kikuyu: Owete Jehoram ma yawuot Jehoshafat ne gin Azaria gi Jehiel gi Zekaria kod Azariahu gi Mikael kod Shefatia. Magi duto ne gin yawuot Jehoshafat ruodh Israel.
english: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne jolweny magi; gin mana mon lilo! Dhorangeye mag dalani oyaw malich ni wasiki; mach osewangʼogi.
english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

kikuyu: “Bende iparo ni itimo gima ber kiwacho ni, ‘In kare e nyim Nyasaye?’
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

kikuyu: Bende nyaka uchiw achiel kuom angʼwen mar lita mar divai mondo obed misango miolo piny kuom nyarombo ka nyarombo mutimogo misango miwangʼo pep kata misango mar nyasi.
english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

kikuyu: to Jehova Nyasaye mor gi joma omiye luor; joma oketo genogi kuom herane ma ok rem.
english: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

kikuyu: Kane owete Josef oneno ni wuon-gi osetho, negiwacho niya, “Mit ka Josef iye nowangʼ kodwa, mi ochulnwa kuor kuom richo duto mane watimone?”
english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ kendo ritreuru ne thowi mar jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: “Jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai bet e kom Musa.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

kikuyu: E wuodhena mathoth, aseneno masiche e aore mopongʼ, asethagora e lwet jomecho, e dier jo-Yahudi wetena kod joma ok jo-Yahudi. Masiche ne olwora e mier madongo, e thimbe, e aore, kendo e dier Jowete mawuondore.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

kikuyu: Kane Ruoth Daudi oseti kendo hike ne ngʼeny, kata ne oume gi lep nindo to ne ok onyal yudo liet.
english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

kikuyu: Gigi duto mane Solomon oloso duto ne ngʼeny omiyo kata pek mula mane olosgo gigo ne ok nyal ngʼere.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

kikuyu: To kata kamano abiro monjo Ariel mi enobedi gi ywagruok kod kuyo, kendo enochalna mana ka kendo mar misango.
english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.

kikuyu: Daudi bende wacho ni: “Mad mesagi bednegi obadho gi otegu, kod kidi mar chwanyruok kendo gir chulo kuor ne gin.
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo gi chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo kod misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile mikelo gi chiwo mar cham, kod misango miolo piny.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane opuonjo ji ei laru mar hekalu, kendo noyalo Injili, jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik, kaachiel kod jodongo nobiro ire.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

kikuyu: Nomulo lwete mi midhusi noweye, kendo noa malo mochako miyogi chiemo.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

kikuyu: Kane omedo dhi nyime koa kanyo, nodhi nyaka ei sinagogi,
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie gima osetimorenwa; rangwa mondo ineye wichkuot ma wan-go.
english: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

kikuyu: Omiyo mirima nomaka kodgi, mi nasingora ka akwongʼora ni, ‘Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.’”
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

kikuyu: Eka nogolo wenge Zedekia oko kendo notweye gi rateke mag mula mondo notere Babulon.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Onego gichiwne misango mar goyo erokamano kendo ginyis kuom gik mosetimo ka giwer gi mor.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

kikuyu: Inyiso herani ne ji alufu to ikelo kum mar wuone ni nyithindgi. Yaye Nyasaye maduongʼ kendo maratego, ma nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, the LORD of Armies is your name:

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, gwedh riekogi duto kendo ibed mamor gi tij lwetegi. Tiek joma wasikgi ma monjogi; kendo tiekgi chuth ma ok ginichak gibed gi teko.”
english: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

kikuyu: Kane pok higni mag kech ochopo, Asenath nyar Potifera ma jadolo mar On nonywolone Josef yawuowi ariyo.
english: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

kikuyu: kendo nonyiso Zeresh ma chiege gi osiepene duto gik moko duto mane otimorene. Joma ngʼadone rieko gi Zeresh ma chiege nowachone niya, “Mano kaka rumo mari osechakore e nyim Modekai ma to en ja-Yahudi, ok ininyale kendo adier obiro miyo irum chuth!”
english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

kikuyu: Saulo noluoro Daudi nikech Jehova Nyasaye noseweye, to ne ni kod Daudi.
english: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and had departed from Saul.

kikuyu: Negitimo gima in iwuon ne isechano chon gi tekoni kod ngʼeyoni ni nyaka timre.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

kikuyu: Mano e kar romb jogo duto mane oa e dhout jo-Kohath mane otiyo e Hemb Romo. Musa kod Harun nokwanogi kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye ogolo kokalo kuom Musa.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Ot moro man-gi dhoot ne ni e bath agola e dhorangeye maiye mag donjo moro ka moro, kama ne ilwokoe ringʼo mitimogo misengini miwangʼo pep.
english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

kikuyu: Kane owinjo wach gie piny Moab ni Jehova Nyasaye osekecho joge komiyogi chiemo, Naomi kod mond yawuote ne joikore mar dok thurgi ka gia kanyo.
english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato angʼata en jaketho e achiel kuom wechegi, to nyaka ohul kaka oseketho,
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

kikuyu: Hana to ne lemo gie chunye to dhoge to ne diemore adiema to dwonde to ok winji. Eli noparo ni omer
english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

kikuyu: Koa e ndalo mag jongʼad bura mane otelo ne Israel, kata e ndalo duto mag ruodhi mag Israel gi Juda, pok ne otim chokruok mar Pasaka ma kama.
english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

kikuyu: Chokuru ji, chwo, mon kod nyithindo kaachiel gi jopinje mamoko modak e miechu mondo giwinj chikego eka mondo giwinj kendo gipuonjre luoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo girit wechene duto maber.
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

kikuyu: We oik wiye ei buru, dipoka pod en gi geno.
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nowuotho moa kanyo modhi e gwenge mag Negev kendo odak e kind Kadesh kod Shur. Nodak Gerar kuom kinde matin,
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼe ne achako akalo machiegni, kendo kane arangi to ne aneno ni ne isebedo mopongʼ moromo hero, omiyo ne ayaro bath nangana mi aumogo dugi. Natimo kodi singruok kakwongʼora midoko mara, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.

kikuyu: Omiyo Pilato nowuoknigi oko mopenjogi niya, “Ngʼatni udonjone gi ketho mage?”
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

kikuyu: Wandikonu wachni mondo morwa obed mogundho kendo moromo chuth.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: “E nyimgi ne amiyo Baruk puonjgi:
english: “I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

kikuyu: Joma ofuwo jaro kowachnegi mondo giwe richo, to ngʼwono iyudo kuom joma kare.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

kikuyu: Nyisgi gikaw nyarwath kaachiel gi misango mar cham mar mogo mayom moru gi mo; bangʼe ikaw nyarwath matin mar ariyo kaka misango mar golo richo.
english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Kendo kik wiu wil kod joka Lawi modak e miechu, nimar gionge gi pok margi kata girkeni mowalnegi.
english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

kikuyu: “Kik umi guogi gima ler; bende kik udir ne anguro kite magu ma nengogi tek. Kutimo kamano to ginyalo nyonogi piny e bwo tiendegi mi gilokre kodu kendo gikidhu matindo tindo.
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

kikuyu: Ka piny toke tek, to en gi jotelo mangʼeny, to ngʼat mawinjo wach kendo man-gi ngʼeyo rito chik.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

kikuyu: Nyingi mondo otingʼ malo moyombo polo, yaye Nyasaye, mad duongʼ mari opongʼ piny duto.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osewacho kawuoyo kuom Shalum wuod Josia, mane okawo loch bangʼ wuon-gi kaka ruodh Juda, “Osea ka kendo ok nodwogi.
english: For the LORD says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.

kikuyu: Nyiseche ma dhano oloso wuondo ji, jokor wach neno fweny mag miriambo; ka ginyiso ji lek ma ok adier, kendo gichiwo hoch manono. Mano emomiyo ji bayo abaya ka rombe maonge jakwath.
english: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

kikuyu: Kane ononogi mondo ongʼe ni en sa mane mane wuode ochangoe, negiwachone niya, “Midhusi nyoro oweye kar sa abiriyo.”
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

kikuyu: Ne oreso ngimana mondo kik adhi e piny joma otho, omiyo koro abiro medo bedo mangima, mi ane ler.
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

kikuyu: Ka Jair notho, noyike Kamon.
english: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

kikuyu: Ket raum mar pwodhruok ewi Sandug Rapar ei Kama Ler Moloyo.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

kikuyu: Ne iturogi matindo tindo ka meli mag Tarshish ma yamb wuok chiengʼ ongʼinjo.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

kikuyu: Yiedhi madongo mathoth nobi koa e dho nam mar Kitim; gibiro mako Ashur kod Eber, to kata gin bende ibiro tiekgi.”
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Kane pok Isaya owuok e laru madiere wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone mawacho niya,
english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, the LORD’s word came to him, saying,

kikuyu: Losne hemano raum mar pien rombe molok gi range makwar kendo iniume gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nam.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Pok achamo dir pok mowalni kata e kinde mane an e kuyo, kata gologi e oda ka agak; kendo ok asechiwogi ne ngʼat motho. Aseluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha, kendo asetimo gik moko duto mane iwachona.
english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

kikuyu: Eka wuowi matin ma janabi nodhi Ramoth Gilead.
english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

kikuyu: “Eri wadhi nyaka Jerusalem, kendo Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi chiw e lwet jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik. Gibiro ngʼadone buch tho,
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

kikuyu: To ka chiwono en misango miwangʼo pep nowuogi kuom jamni kata kuom rombe kata diek, to nyaka ochiw mano madichwo maonge songa.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

kikuyu: Kata obedo nine giluoro joma ne olworogi kamano, negigero kendo mar misango e mise mare mi gichiwo misango miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye, misango mokinyi kaachiel gi modhiambo.
english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

kikuyu: Eka notho moyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike e dala Daudi wuon-gi. Rehoboam wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Joel owadgi Nathan, Mibhar wuod Hagri,
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

kikuyu: Mano nomiyo jotend jorit pinje gi jodongo notemo mondo ondhog Daniel e tije mar rito piny, to ne otamogi yudo. Ne ok ginyal yudo ketho moro amora kuome, nikech ne en ja-adiera e yore duto, kendo ne oonge gi tim mar kawo malangʼ, kata mar jwangʼo tich.
english: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

kikuyu: Misri ok nochak obedi kama jo-Israel okete genogi kendo, to nobedi gima paronigi richogi sa asaya ma ginilokre ire mondo gikwae kony. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.’ ”
english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”’”

kikuyu: “To bende dhako wiye diwil gi nyathi modhodho mi ok obedo gi kech e kothe mane onywolo. Kata ka dipo ni wiye nyalo wil, An to wiya ok nowil kodi.
english: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo yorega ma aluwo kod kuonde ma ayweyoe; yorena duto oyangoreni maber.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nogwedhogi mi oorogi, kendo negidok e miechgi.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

kikuyu: To Josef nomedo wachonegi niya, “Ooyo! Usebiro mana ni mondo ungʼe kama pinywa nyapgodo.”
english: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

kikuyu: Joka Kohath mamoko to nopog mier apar koa e nus dhout oganda Manase.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

kikuyu: To in ema ariti, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo angʼeyo ni ibiro dwoka, yaye Ruoth Nyasacha.
english: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

kikuyu: mar ariyo ne en Hilkia, mar adek ne en Tabalia, to mar angʼwen ne en Zekaria. Yawuot Hosa kod wedene giduto ne gin ji apar gadek.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

kikuyu: Wachni nokelo pogruok e kind Paulo gi Barnaba, mine gipogore. Barnaba nokawo Mariko mi gikwangʼ gidhi Saipras,
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

kikuyu: Koro aikora biro limou e limbena mar adek. Ka abiro to ok abi miyou tingʼ mapek, nikech un ema adwarou, to ok gigeu. Mano en gima ongʼere, nikech nyithindo ok ema onego okan mwandu ni jonywolgi, to jonywol ema onego oken ni nyithindgi.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

kikuyu: Magi e gweth mane Musa ngʼat Nyasaye owacho ne jo-Israel kapok otho.
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

kikuyu: Emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kama: Ringre joma otho ma usepuko kanyo e ringʼo, to dala maduongʼni e agulu, kaka uwachono, to abiro riembou mi agolu oko.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

kikuyu: Jochiende nowuok kuom ji mangʼeny ka giywak malit, kendo jo-athany kod pudhe nochangi.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

kikuyu: Nyis jo-Juda ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kuom joma odak Jerusalem kod piny Israel: Gibiro chamo chiembgi gi kibaji kendo gibiro modho pigegi ka chunygi parore, nikech ibiro lony pinygi mi we nono li nikech timbe mahundu mag ji duto modak kanyo.
english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie ngʼat moro ma nyinge Mika mane oa e piny gode mar Efraim,
english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok ohero Ruoth, to mondo okwongʼe! Yaye Ruoth, bi.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

kikuyu: Emomiyo, kik uchiw nyiu mondo kend gi yawuotgi, kata kawo nyigi ne yawuotu. Kik ubed gi singruok mar osiep kodgi sa moro amora, mondo omi ubed motegno kendo ucham gik mabeyo mag pinyni kendo uweye ne nyithindu kaka girkeni manyaka chiengʼ.’
english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

kikuyu: En gi joge ne gibuok ahinya kuom wachni nikech Gibeon ne en dala maduongʼ mongirore, mana kaka achiel kuom mier madongo maka ruoth. Ne oduongʼ moloyo Ai, kendo joge duto ne gin jokedo mabeyo.
english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e miech Manase gi Efraim kod Simeon nyaka chop Naftali kaachiel gi kuonde molworogi mane osekethi,
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

kikuyu: “Rwakreuru ka uikoru ne tich kendo techeu osik kaliel,
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

kikuyu: Mi wabed mamor amingʼa mana kaka isemiyo waneno malit, marom gi higni ma wasenene chandruok.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

kikuyu: Un jo-Samaria ulamo gima ukia, nimar warruok aa kuom jo-Yahudi.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nomiyogo pok margi Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo gikanyono nopogo jo-Israel pinyno kaluwore gi dhoutgi.
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

kikuyu: Simon osenyisowa kaka Nyasaye nokwongo olimo joma ok jo-Yahudi, kokawo joge owuon e diergi.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ulam ne thuondi ma jochir mane nyalo tiyo gi atungʼ. Ne gin gi yawuowi gi nyikwayo mangʼeny; giduto ne gin ji mia achiel gi piero abich. Magi duto ne gin joka Benjamin.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

kikuyu: “Koro abiro miyo udok matin e kind ogendini, kendo joma ijaro e dier ji.
english: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno Nathaniel ka biro kochomo ire, nowuoyo kuome kowacho niya, “Neuru ja-Israel adier, maonge miganga moro amora kuome.”
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa niya, “Abiro tieko dhano duto nikech piny opongʼ gi timbe maricho nikech gin. Adier abiro tiekogi kaachiel gi piny.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Ibzan notho, kendo noyike Bethlehem.
english: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar apar gabich e dwe mar abiriyo, losuru chokruok mowal kendo kik uti tijeu mapile. Losneuru Jehova Nyasaye sawo kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man mabor tuoche nonegi, to ngʼat man machiegni nopodhi gi ligangla, kendo ngʼat motony, ma nores ngimane, kech nonegi. Kamano e kaka abiro toyo mirimba kuomgi.
english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bebai, Zekaria wuod Bebai, kaachiel kode ji piero ariyo gaboro;
english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

kikuyu: To e kinde moro amora mane odhi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo owuo kode, to nogolo ragengʼno nyaka owuog e nyime. Kane owuok oko mi onyiso jo-Israel gima Jehova Nyasaye osewachone, negineno wangʼe karieny.
english: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

kikuyu: Mi Sayun odhi maber kuom herani; chak iger ohinga mag Jerusalem kendo.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kare asetemo ritora mondo chunya osik kaler kayiem, kendo asetemo gengʼo lwetena ni kik omul richo kayiem.
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Lawi noyiero Heman wuod Joel kuom owetene, Asaf wuod Berekia, to kuom owetegi ma joka Merari, negiyiero Ethan wuod Kushaya
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

kikuyu: Tahan nonywolo Ladan, to Ladan nonywolo Amihud, Amihud nonywolo Elishama,
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

kikuyu: Lachne ne romo bat achiel morie, to dhoge ne chalo gi dho kikombe mana ka ondanyo mathiewo. To notingʼo pi manyalo romo lita alufu piero auchiel gauchiel.
english: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ka in gi mirima aa malo irad gi gero mar wasika. Chiew, Nyasacha; chiew inyis adierana.
english: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

kikuyu: To nyaka aa kinde mane waweyo wangʼo ubani ne Ruoth ma Dhako mar Polo kendo chiwone misango miolo piny, wasebedo maonge gimoro amora kendo ligangla gi kech osenegowa.”
english: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowacho niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Kochopo dier otieno tir, to abiro dhi e piny Misri.
english: Moses said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

kikuyu: To bangʼ paro mar timo kamano, Malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyorene e lek mowachone niya, “Josef wuod Daudi, kik iluor dhi gi Maria dala kaka chiegi, nikech gima otingʼo e iye owuok kuom Roho Maler.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: kendo kaka gisetimo nyaka chakre ne ayier jotelo marito joga Israel. Bende abiro miyo ibed gi kwe e kindi gi wasiki duto. “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni en Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema obiro geroni ot.
english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house.

kikuyu: Eka Simon nodwoko niya, “Lamna Ruoth Nyasaye mondo gima rach misewacho kuomano kik timrena.”
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

kikuyu: (Jo-Hiram kod jo-Solomon nokelo dhahabu moa Ofir bende negikelo yiend Algumo kod kite ma nengogi tek.
english: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

kikuyu: To ok ginyal luwo bangʼ ngʼama gikia. Adier, giringo gia bute nikech ok gingʼeyo dwonde.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

kikuyu: Nodonjo ei achiel kuom yiedhigo, mane mar Simon, mi nokwaye mondo osiane yie matin oa e dho wath. Eka nobedo piny kendo puonjo ji ka enie yie.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

kikuyu: “Kamano e kaka Wuora manie polo biro timo ne ngʼato ka ngʼato ka ok oweyo ne nyawadgi gie chunye.”
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noketo Daniel e telo mamalo kendo nomiye mich mathoth. Nokete jatelo e piny Babulon duto, kendo nomiye teko ewi joma riek duto man Babulon.
english: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

kikuyu: (Jo-Israel nowuotho koa e sokni mag Jaakan nyaka Mosera; kanyo ema ne Harun othoe mi oike kendo Eliazar wuode nokawo tichne kaka jadolo.
english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

kikuyu: “Eka Ruoth nowach ne joma ni e bade korachwich ni, ‘Biuru, un joma ogwedhi mag Wuora; kawuru girkeni maru, pinyruoth mane oiknu nyaka aa chwech piny.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

kikuyu: Ngeche mag Solomon: Wuowi mariek kelo mor ni wuon mare, to wuowi mofuwo miyo min mare chuny lit.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

kikuyu: “Ok anakum nyiu ka gibedo ochode, kata mond yawuotu ka terore, nikech chwo giwegi ema dhi ir mon ma jochode, gi mon manie hekalu mar Baal. Joma onge ngʼeyo biro yudo chandruok!
english: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

kikuyu: Yesu nobedo piny kama omanyore gi kama ne ji ketoe sadakagi mi nonono kaka ji ne keto pesagi e kar keno mar hekalu. Jo-mwandu mangʼeny ne diro pesa mojuol ojuol.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel ne oywago Musa e pap man Moab kuom ndalo piero adek nyaka ndalo mag kuyo kod ywak orumo.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

kikuyu: Nikech ne wawinje gi itwa kowacho ni Yesu ma ja-Nazarethni biro ketho hekaluni mi olok tim mane Musa omiyowa mondo waluw.”
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo nodonjone gi weche mathoth.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

kikuyu: Kendo dwarone bende opogore nyadiriyo. Dhako ma ok okendi, kata nyako ngili, paro kuom weche Ruoth. Thorogi maduongʼ en mondo gibed maler e ringregi gi chunygi. To dhako mokendi, to pache ni kuom gige piny, kaka onyalo miyo chwore mor.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

kikuyu: Ariera piny mondo anindi; kendo achako aa malo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye orita.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Donge in bende ia Galili? Non maber, to ibiro yudo ni onge janabi manyalo aa Galili.” [
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

kikuyu: kod Ruodh Tirza, ngʼato achiel. Ruodhi duto mane onegi ne oromo piero adek gachiel.
english: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.

kikuyu: kendo negitweyo lak thiwnigo komachielo e laini ariyo mochan kaka dhahabu ka gichomego e tond law akor kuom law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi yo ka nyime.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka jatelo moro odonjo e richo ka ok ongʼeyo kendo otimo gima chik ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache okwero to obedo jaketho.
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Kane gihulo richogi, ne obatisogi e Aora Jordan.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Eka Juda nowacho ne Onan wuode niya, “Kaw chi owadu kendo ibed kode kaka yuori mondo inywol kode nyithindo ichung godo wi owadu.”
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

kikuyu: “Parsin: Pinyruodhi osepogi kendo osemiye jo-Medes gi jo-Pasia.”
english: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Efraim ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen gi mia abich (40,500).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: “Gur Hemb Romono kaluwore gi kaka ne anyisi ewi got.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Jo-Jerusalem noketo Ahazia wuod Jehoram ma chogo nobedo ruoth kare nikech joma nomonjogi kaachiel gi jo-Arabu manobiro e lwenyno nosenego yawuot Jehoram madongo duto. Omiyo Ahazia wuod Jehoram ruodh Juda nochako rito loch.
english: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat mochido ok opwodhore owuon, nyaka gole oko e dier oganda, nikech osemiyo kama ler mar lemo mar Jehova Nyasaye ochido. Pi pwodhruokgo pod ok okir kuome, omiyo ochido.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ibiro luong dhakono ni jachode ka odak gi dichwo machielo ka chwore pod ngima. To ka chwore otho, to ogonye kuom chikno kendo ka dichwo machielo okende to ok kwane kaka jachode.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

kikuyu: Paulo ne dwaro dhi e diergi mondo owuo kodgi, to jopuonjre notame.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

kikuyu: Koro ka Daudi ema luonge ni, ‘Ruoth’ to ere kaka onyalo bedo Wuode kendo?”
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

kikuyu: “Bende isefwenyo kaka sani Ahab osebolore e nyima? Nikech osebolore, ok anakel masirani e ndalone, to abiro kele e ode e kinde mag wuode.”
english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

kikuyu: Kane chandruok omaka to ne awacho ni, “Opoga kodi!” Kata kamano ne iwinja ka aywakni mondo ikecha kane aluongi mondo ikonya.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

kikuyu: to machielo nochiko Beth Horon mar adek nodhi e tongʼ mochiko Holo mar Zeboim mochimo kuma otimo ongoro.
english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

kikuyu: Nikech oganda maduongʼ nochokore molwore, nodonjo ei yie mi obetie, ka ji duto to ochungʼ oko e dho nam.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

kikuyu: to jadolo nokwongʼ dhakono niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo omi iyi ogore piny, kata omi ibwog nyathi ka kindene mar nywol pok ochopo, kibedogo ranyisi ne jou kuom wach kwongʼruok.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

kikuyu: Ne ayie; emomiyo ne awacho niya, “Sand oromo chunya.”
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe kuny buche molwore duto, mi idhurne lowo kendo iketne kambe mag jolweny moikore monje, kod lodi mitwomogo ohinga.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kawacho niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Petro nolor piny ir jogo monyisogi niya, “An e ngʼat mudwaro. Ere wach ma un-go?”
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Ineno kare, nimar arito mondo ane ni wachna ochopo kare.”
english: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

kikuyu: Kuom ngʼwono ma Nyasaye osemiya, ne aketo mise kaka jagedo molony, kendo koro ngʼat machielo ema gedo e miseno. To ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka ged kotangʼ.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

kikuyu: To Ruoth nowacho niya, “Winjeuru gima ne jangʼad bura ma ok kareno owacho!
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

kikuyu: To ngʼe ni inie wuonwa kata obedo ni Ibrahim ok ongʼeyowa kendo Israel ok kwan ni wan joge, in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, e wuonwa, Jareswa manyaka nene e nyingi.
english: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

kikuyu: Eka ahiti mangʼongo notugore mi apaka nochako tago yie koni gi koni mi pi nochako pongʼe.
english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

kikuyu: Yesu nolokore mowachone Petro niya, “Wuog oko e nyima, Satan! In kidi mar chwanyruok ne an; nikech iketo pachi kuom dwaro dhano to ok kuom dwach Nyasaye.”
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

kikuyu: Magi duto ne jotend anywola mag jo-Lawi, ruodhi kaka ondikgi e nonro mar anywolagi kendo negidak Jerusalem.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Harun niya, “Sud machiegni gi kendo mar misango, kendo itim misango mar golo richo, gi misango miwangʼo pep, mondo ipwodhrigo kaachiel gi oganda; eka ichiw misango kipwodhogo oganda kaka Jehova Nyasaye osechiko.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”

kikuyu: Oweyo yo moluwo karieny, kendo kama oluwono lokore buoyo.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

kikuyu: Yesu noluonge niya, “Maria!” Nolokore mi ongʼiye koluonge matek gi dho jo-Hibrania niya, “Raboni!” (tiende ni “Japuonj”).
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

kikuyu: Kane ochwer remb jatichni Stefano, ne achungʼ kanyo kayie gi nekne kendo ne arito lep joma ne nege.’
english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

kikuyu: Negibiro mi giywagore nigi, eka ne gigologi oko e od twech, ka gisayogi mondo gia e dalano.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jakobo nooro Juda mondo odhi ir Josef mondo obi oromnegi ka gidhi Goshen. Kane gichopo e gwengʼ mar Goshen,
english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ka jaod ruoth nowinjo dwond ruoth gi jodonge, nobiro ei ot kama ne nyasi timore. Nowacho niya, “Yaye ruoth, dag amingʼa! Chunyi kik chandre! Lela wangʼi owe jowore!
english: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ram wuod Jeramel makayo ne gin: Maaz, Jamin kod Eker.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

kikuyu: Ne ooro mach koa e polo, modonjo e chokena. Nochiko obadho momako tiendena kendo nodwoka chien. Nomiya abedo modhier kadongʼ kenda ka aol maonge teko odiechiengʼ duto.
english: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, watemuru matek mondo watim gima kelo kwe kendo ma wanyalo jiworego ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

kikuyu: Luwuru timna, mana kaka an bende aluwo tim Kristo.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

kikuyu: Ne inyalo loke pesa mangʼeny moloyo chudo mar ngʼato kuom higa achiel mi pesago pogi ne joma odhier.” Ne gikwero mamano gi dwol makwiny.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

kikuyu: Geruru kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi kite ma ok opa, kendo utim misango miwangʼo pep kanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Omiyo e odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar apar e higa mar ochiko mar loch Zedekia, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nodhi gi jolweny mage duto momonjo Jerusalem. Nolworo dala maduongʼno mi ogoyone agengʼa koni gi koni.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo okepe apar gariyo mopongʼ mag makati gi rech.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

kikuyu: Eka Farao nogolo tere mar loch e lwete morwako e lwet Josef. Ne orwako ne Josef law mayom mar duongʼ miluongo ni bafta kendo orwako ne tigo mar dhahabu e ngʼute.
english: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

kikuyu: Abiro chiko ita ne gima Nyasaye, ma Jehova Nyasaye biro wacho; osingo kwe ne joge ma joratiro, to nyaka gine ni ok gidok e timbe mofuwo.
english: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jakobo nooro wach ne Rael kod Lea mondo gibi e lek kumane okwayoe.
english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

kikuyu: “Ka jogi, kata janabi kata jadolo, openji ni, ‘Wach mar Jehova Nyasaye en mane?’ To penjgi ni, ‘Wach mane? Anajwangʼu, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.’
english: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from the LORD?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says the LORD.’

kikuyu: Mwandugi noyaki kendo utegi nomuki. Gibiro gero udi, to ok ginidagie, bende gibiro pitho puothe mzabibu to ok gini madh divai moa kuomgi.”
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

kikuyu: Kochakore odiechiengʼno Akish nomiye Ziklag, mosebet ka osiko e lwet ruodhi Juda nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

kikuyu: Parie Asuria, machon ne chalo yiend sida e piny Lebanon, ne en gi bede mabeyo mokar moimo bungu duto. Nodongo marabora kodhi malo ma wiye oyombo wi yiende duto manie bungu.
english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

kikuyu: E kinde mar nyasino nooro jatichne mondo onyisi jogo mane oluongi, ‘Biuru, nikech gik moko duto koro oseikore.’
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

kikuyu: Humb Daudi nolandore e piny duto kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo ogendini duto oluore.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni chunya osegombo dhako moro, kata kapo ni asebuto karito chi ngʼato,
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

kikuyu: To bangʼ higni adek ne adhi nyaka Jerusalem mondo angʼera gi Petro, kendo ne adak kode kuom ndalo apar gabich.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

kikuyu: Mano e singruok ma dhoutwa apar gariyo geno mondo one kochopo kare, ka gisiko gitiyo ni Nyasaye odiechiengʼ gotieno. To koro ruoth Agripa, en mana wach genoni, emomiyo jo-Yahudi kwana kaka jaketho.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

kikuyu: kod puonj kuom kit batiso mopogore opogore, kata kuom keto lwedo ewi ji, kata kuom wach chier aa kuom joma otho, kata kuom bura mabiro.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

kikuyu: To Petro nowachone niya, “Ere kaka ne unyalo winjoru mondo utem Roho mar Ruoth? Ne! Tiend joma ne oyiko chwori pod ni e dhoot, in bende gibiro tingʼi giteri oko.”
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

kikuyu: To kane olamo, kit wangʼe nolokore, kendo lepe nolokore marieny ka ler mar mil polo.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

kikuyu: Ne wan yawuowi apar gariyo, yawuot ngʼat achiel. Achiel kuomwa nolal, kendo ma chogo to odongʼ gi wuonwa e piny Kanaan.’
english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

kikuyu: Herana mar adier nobed kode, kendo tungene nomi duongʼ nikech nyinga.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: “Los mesa mar yiend siala ma borne romo fut adek to lachne romo fut achiel gi nus kendo borne madhi malo romo fut ariyo gi robo.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka ngʼat ma terore gi chi ngʼat machielo chalo; ngʼato angʼata ma omule ok notony ma ok okum.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Kane Musa olor koa e Got Sinai gi kite ariyo mopa mag Sandug Muma kotingʼo e lwete to ne ok ongʼeyo ni lela wangʼe ne rieny nikech nosewuoyo gi Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

kikuyu: Jodongo mag Amon nowinjore monego ruoth e kar dakne.
english: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

kikuyu: An gi winjo moloyo jopuonjna duto, nimar arito chikeni.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

kikuyu: Jatij ngʼato ok en jakwath ma wuon rombe. Omiyo koneno ondiek kabiro, to oringo oweyo rombe kanyo. Eka ondiek monjo rombe kendo keyogi.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

kikuyu: Eka nogolo chik niya, “Makgiuru” Omiyo negimako ji piero angʼwen gariyogo ma gidhi kodgi e bath soko man Beth Eked ma ginegogi, kendo onge moro amora mane otony.
english: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngero migoyo e piny Israel ni, “Nyako okawo kit min, nowach kuomi.”
english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

kikuyu: “Un e chumbi mar piny. To chumbi ka ndhathe orumo, to ere kaka dimiye obed gi ndhathe kendo? Koro onge konyruok mokelo, makmana ni ipuke oko kendo ji nyone piny gi tiendegi.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

kikuyu: to nomanyo Nyasach wuon mare kendo noluwo chikene kopogore gi kaka jo-Israel ne timo.
english: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Zebulun kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Sered, joka Sered; koa kuom Elon, joka Elon; koa kuom Jalel, joka Jalel.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon nodhi Ezion Geber kod Elath manie dho nam e piny Edom.
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: kuom mano ginicham olemo mag yoregi kendo giniyiengʼ gi olemo mar riekogi maricho.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel noluongo jodongo duto mag piny mowachonegi niya, “Neuru kaka ngʼatni dwaro chandruok! Kane odwaro dhahabu maga gi fedha maga kaachiel gi monda gi nyithinda ne ok atame.”
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

kikuyu: Oseturo lekena gi kite mimuodo kendo osenyona piny e buru.
english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

kikuyu: Jopinyno duto nyaka ti kaachiel e chiwo makendeni mondo ruoth oyud kaka konyore e Israel.
english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

kikuyu: To wach Nyasaye nobiro ne Shemaya ngʼat Nyasaye niya:
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

kikuyu: Winjuru, kawuononi aketo gweth kod kwongʼ e nyimu.
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

kikuyu: Omiyo ne akawo kikombe mane ni e lwet Jehova Nyasaye kendo ma aketo ogendini duto mane oora irgi omadhe.
english: Then I took the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:

kikuyu: Weche mamoko mag loch Uzia koa chakruokgi nyaka gikogi ondikgi e kitap janabi Isaya wuod Amoz.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, mondgi nyaka bed joma owinjore mi luor, kik gibed mon mohero kuoth, to owinjore gibed mon moritore kendo ma jo-adiera e weche duto.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

kikuyu: Negikelo rwedhi abiriyo, gi imbe abiriyo gi nyirombe abiriyo kod nywogi abiriyo mondo gichiw kaka misango mar golo richo mar pinyruoth, gi mar kama ler mar lemo kod Juda. Ruoth nochiko jodolo ma nyikwa Harun mondo gichiw gigo e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the LORD’s altar.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru!” Omiyo jochiendego nowuok kuom ji ariyogo mi gidonjo ei angurogo, kendo kweth duto kar rombgi noringo matek koluwo aridiridi mochomo nam mi giduto ne githo ei pi.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

kikuyu: Angʼo makelo goruok gi dhawo e kindu? Donge gia kuom gombou makedo matek e chunyu?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

kikuyu: Jonabi mage gin josunga, kendo gin joma wuondore. Jodolo mage njawo kama ler mar lemo, kendo giketho chik.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

kikuyu: mondo dwaro makare mar Chik ochopi kare chuth kuomwa, wan ma wadak kaka Roho dwaro to ok kaka ringruok dwaro.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mane okwan kaluwore gi anywola ne gin: koa kuom Gershon, joka Gershon; koa kuom Kohath, joka Kohath; koa kuom Merari, joka Merari.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

kikuyu: to dhood joka Juda ema ne oyiero, ee, noyiero mana Got Sayun, mane ohero.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

kikuyu: En angʼo makoro wanyalo wacho? Dwadhi nyime ka watimo richo mondo eka ngʼwono omedre?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

kikuyu: Nikech kama nyiego gi piem nitie e kama koko gi timbe maricho duto nitie.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

kikuyu: Omiyo lwenje rumo e tungʼ piny koni gi koni; oturo atungʼ kendo ochodo tongʼ matindo tindo, bende owangʼo kuodi gi mach.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma tiendu nonyon anamiu, kaka nasingora ni Musa.
english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

kikuyu: Magi e gik monego utim: Wachuru adiera ne joweteu kendo ngʼaduru bura makare kendo mowinjore e uteu mag ngʼado bura;
english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

kikuyu: Gin joma oa Israel! Nyaroyani oselos mana gi lwet dhano omiyo ok en Nyasaye. Nyaroya mar Samaria-no noto matindo tindo.
english: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

kikuyu: Ionge gi migawo moro amora e tijwani, kendo kwan-ni onge e iye, nikech chunyi ok nikare e nyim Nyasaye.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

kikuyu: To Joash ruodh Juda nokawo gik moko duto mowal mane kwerene kaka Jehoshafat, Jehoram kod Ahazia mane gin ruodhi mag Juda osechiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye. Gigo duto Joash noorone Hazael ruodh Aram, kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane en owuon osechiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye; kaachiel gi dhahabu duto mane ni e kar keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod kar keno mar od ruoth kendo Hazael ne ok omonjo Jerusalem.
english: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wechegi, oganda mane osechokore kanyo kod jotelo mag dalano nogoyo koko.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai nobiro ir Yesu mi oteme kapenje ka gidwaro mondo onyisgie ranyisi moa e polo.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Iselawowa ka in gi mirima; mi inegowa ka ok idewo.
english: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

kikuyu: Noger hekalu gi kite mopa mana kuma okuny but kendo kata ywak nyundo kata mar le kata mar gir tich moro amora ne ok owinji e kar gedo mar hekalu.
english: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

kikuyu: En ema ne odwoko tongʼ mag Israel chakre Lebo Hamath nyaka chop Nam mar Araba, kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mane owacho koa e dho jatichne Jona wuod Amitai, mane janabi moa Gath Hefer.
english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

kikuyu: Daudi kod jo-Israel duto ne miel gi tekregi duto e nyim Nyasaye ka gimor gi-ilo ka giwer gi thumbe gi nyatiti gi orutu gi oyieke gi kayamba kod turumbete.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

kikuyu: nikech ka chunygi ochot to gidok e lowo; kendo chiengʼono chenrogi ogik gikanyono.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

kikuyu: kendo iwachne ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Adagi. Abiro wuodho ligangla oko e olalo mare mi aneg joma kare gi joma timbegi richo, ka agologi kuomi.
english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

kikuyu: Yor joma kare chalo ka ugwe mar kogwen, omedo rieny maler nyaka chiengʼ wuogi.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kikuyu: owacho niya, “Abiro hulo nyingi ne owetena; abiro paki gi wer e dier chokruok.”
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

kikuyu: kod gik moko kaka obala ndago gi gik mangʼwe ngʼar; kaka ubani gi mor pwodhruok madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kod uvumba gi divai kod mo mzabibu gi mogo mayom gi ngano kod dhok gi rombe gi farese gi geche lweny kod ringruok gi chunje ji bende.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

kikuyu: To Hezekia ne nigi sunga e chunye kendo ne ok odwoko erokamano kaluwore gi ngʼwono manotimne; omiyo mirima nomako Jehova Nyasaye kode kaachiel gi Juda gi Jerusalem.
english: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Chungi idin cham, yaye nyar Sayun, nikech abiro sidhoni tunge mag chuma. Abiro rwakoni ombongʼ tielo mag nyinyo kendo ibiro toyo matindo tindo pinje mangʼeny.” Mwandu magiseyudo e yore mobam ubiro walone Jehova Nyasaye, mwandugi nochiwne Ruoth Nyasaye mar piny duto.
english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to the LORD, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Koro angʼo momiyo in ingʼado bura ni nyawadu? Koso in ijaro nyawadu nangʼo? Nimar wan duto wabiro chungʼ e nyim kom bura mar Nyasaye.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidwoko Yesu niya, “Ok wangʼeyo.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An bende ok abi nyisou kuma agole teko ma atimogo gigi.”
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Rie lweti koa e polo nyaka piny, mondo ikonya, kendo igola, e pige ma tekregi ngʼeny, kendo e lwet jopinje mamoko,
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

kikuyu: Joma ochayo Jehova Nyasaye dine okulorene gi luoro, kendo kum margi osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

kikuyu: Nikech ne othiro joma odhier, kendo nomayogi gigegi mi gidongʼ nono osemayo ji udi ma en ne ok ogero.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
