kikuyu: Josia notimo Sap Pasaka ni Jehova Nyasaye e Jerusalem kendo ne oneg nyarombo mar Pasaka chiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo.
english: Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

kikuyu: Donge morni ne inyalo loke pesa e nengo mamalo mondo omi jodhier pesago.”
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

kikuyu: Kamano bende ka lweti ma korachwich miyo itimo richo, to ngʼade oko iwite. Ber moloyo ka iwito fuon-ni achiel moloyo ka ringri duto odhi e gehena.
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: omiyo abiro reso rombega kendo ok unuchak usandgi. Abiro ngʼado bura e kind rombo gi wadgi.
english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

kikuyu: To heruru wasiku, timnegiuru maber, kendo holgiuru ka ok ugeno ni ubiro yudo gimoro bangʼe. Eka poku biro bedo maduongʼ kendo ubiro bedo yawuot Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, nikech ongʼwon gi jogo ma ok dewe kendo jomaricho.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

kikuyu: Kuom adiera pinje manie dho nembe ngʼiya, motelonegi kabiro gin yiedhi mowuok Tarshish, makelo yawuotu koa mabor ka gitingʼo fedha kod dhahabu, magi biro miyogo nying Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ, Jal Maler mar Israel, nikech oseumi gi duongʼne.
english: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

kikuyu: “Wengena oseneno magi duto, kendo ita osewinjo tiendgi maber.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

kikuyu: Koro magi e kuonde mane jo-Israel oyudo kaka girkeni e piny Kanaan, ma Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun to gi jotend dhout Israel nopogonegi.
english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

kikuyu: hulo herani gokinyi kod adierani gotieno,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

kikuyu: Maskil mar Daudi. Kane en ei bur. Lamo. Aywak matek ne Jehova Nyasaye; atingʼo dwonda ne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okecha.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

kikuyu: Negiwachone Joshua niya, “Adiera, Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo pinyni duto e lwetwa, bende jogo modak e pinyno kihondko osemako nikech wan.”
english: They said to Joshua, “Truly the LORD has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”

kikuyu: Kanyakla duto mag jo-Israel nochokore Shilo ma giguro Hemb Romo kanyo. Pinyno nobedo e bwo lochgi,
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

kikuyu: nyikwa Elam moko, ji alufu achiel mia ariyo gi piero abich gangʼwen (1,254),
english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osemiya pokna mowinjore gi timna makare, mana machal gi kaka aler e wangʼe.
english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

kikuyu: Omiyo Sara noluor mokwer niya, “Ne ok anyiero.” To kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “En adier ni ninyiero.”
english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

kikuyu: To ka sa koro ne oniangʼ, jopuonjrene nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Ka en thim kendo sa koro olewo ahinya.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

kikuyu: E konde ariyogi nyaka riw sirni ariyo chakre e tiende nyaka e wiye malo, kendo oriwgi gi nyange modol, giduto ariyogo ginibed machal kamano.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

kikuyu: Koroni eka isewachona tim maber misetimona; Jehova Nyasaye noketa e lweti to ne ok inega.
english: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when the LORD had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

kikuyu: Kata mana ngʼat maber kendo ngʼwon ahinya e dieru ok nobed gi miwafu ne owadgi owuon kata mana ne chiege mohero kata nyithinde modongʼ,
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

kikuyu: “Kaka jakuo wiye kuot ka omake, omiyo od Israel wiye okuot, gin gi ruodhigi kod jotendgi, jodolo mag-gi kod jonabi mag-gi.
english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed— they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets,

kikuyu: Kuom pinje moko mane wakawo e kindeno, ne amiyo joka Reuben kod joka Gad tongʼ mokiewo gi Aroer man e bath holo mar Arnon, komedi gi nus mar piny gode manie Gilead kod miechgi duto.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

kikuyu: An to napaki kod wend goyo erokamano mi natimni misango. Gima asesingora nachop kare nikech warruok wuok kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kawuru lodina mondo utingʼ kendo puonjreuru kuoma, nimar chunya muol kendo ahora mos, eka unuyud yweyo ne chunyu.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

kikuyu: to Eli noluonge mowachone niya, “Samuel wuoda.” Samuel nodwoke niya, “Era ee.”
english: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Ibrahim nonywolo Isaka. To Isaka nonywolo Esau kod Israel.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom joma nochiko itgi mowinjowa kwaloso ne en dhako moro moa Thuatira, ma nyinge Ludia, mane loko lewni makwar ma nengogi tek kendo noluoro Nyasaye. Ruoth noyawo chunye mondo orwak puonj Paulo.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

kikuyu: Mier matindo duto mar anywola jo-Gershon ne gin apar gadek, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Mano kaka berni duongʼ, ber mikano ne joma oluori, mimiyo joma opondo kuomi ka ji duto neno.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

kikuyu: Nimar onge ngʼat ma osenyiso tekone maduongʼ kata timo timbe makare mane Musa otimo ka jo-Israel duto neno.
english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

kikuyu: To chiege nodwoko niya, “Ka dipo ni Jehova Nyasaye ne nigi paro mar negowa, to dine ok oyie misango miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mar cham moa e lwetwa, kata nyisowa gigi duto kata nyisowa masani.”
english: But his wife said to him, “If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”

kikuyu: “Mano emomiyo nwawacho ni, ‘Waikreuru kendo wager kendo mar misango, to ok mar misango miwangʼo pep, kata ni sewni mamoko.’
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

kikuyu: Mano kaka nodok malit ne mon ma yach kod mago madhodho nyithindo e ndalogo!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

kikuyu: Nimar chuny Jehova Nyasaye mor gi joge kendo osidho joma obolore gi warruok.
english: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

kikuyu: Bende ginyalo yiengʼ ka kweth mag jamni kod kweth mag dhok oyangʼ duto? Bende ginyalo yiengʼ ka rech duto manie nam omaknegi?”
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ok unuwinj yamo kata neno koth, to kata kamano holoni biro pongʼ gi pi kendo un, jambu, gi chiayo mamoko nomodh ka.
english: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

kikuyu: Kane gidonjo ei bur, negineno wuowi moro matin morwako kandho marachar kobet e bath bur korachwich, kendo ne gibuok ahinya.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

kikuyu: To waneno ni joma timbegi richo ema igwedho. Chutho joma timbegi richo dhi maber kendo kata gikwedo Nyasaye to gitony.’ ”
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

kikuyu: kendo mondo kik gichik itgi ni sigendini mag jo-Yahudi kata ni chike mag joma odagi adiera.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka kong awayo machamo lak kendo ka iro malungo wenge, e kaka jasamuoyo ni jogo moore.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

kikuyu: En kod Harun nochoko chokruok kanyakla e nyim lwanda kendo Musa nowachonegi niya, “Winjuru, un jongʼanyogi, bende ochuno ni nyaka wamiu pi kowuok e lwandani?”
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

kikuyu: mar abich ne en Elam, mar auchiel ne en Jehohanan, to mar abiriyo ne en Eliehoenai.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

kikuyu: Paruru jachwechu kapod utindo, kendo kapok ndalo mag chandruok obiro, ma ubiro wachoe niya, “Onge gima tinde bernwa e piny.”
english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

kikuyu: Ruoth gi joge nodhi Jerusalem momonjo jo-Jebus mane odak kanyo. Jo-Jebus nowacho ni Daudi niya, “Ok inidonj ka; kata mana muofuni gi rangʼonde notami donjo.” Negiparo niya, “Daudi ok nyal donjo kanyo.”
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

kikuyu: Nam mondo owuo, kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye, kod piny duto, gi ji duto modak e iye.
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

kikuyu: mar auchiel Ozem, to mar abiriyo Daudi.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

kikuyu: Eka Jotham noringo odhi Beer, kendo nodak kanyo nikech noluoro Abimelek owadgi.
english: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

kikuyu: Ngʼi jatichni gi wangʼ maber kendo puonja chikeni.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Kane ji oywak ne Musa, ne olamo Jehova Nyasaye mi mach notho.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.

kikuyu: Idwaro siko e yore machon kuonde ma joma richo osewuothe,
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

kikuyu: Kane gidhi, ne gichomo kuonde angʼwen mane kerubi ochomo. Tiendego ne ok dhi kuma opogore gi kuma ne kerubi dhiye. Kerubigo ne chomo mana kuma wiyegi ochomo tir, ma ok gilokore sa ma gidhi.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negikano chiemo nyaka okinyi mana kaka Musa nochikogi kendo chiemono ne ok owichore kata timo kudni.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

kikuyu: Achalo gi ngʼat ma ok winj wach, ma dhoge ok nyal dwoko wach.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

kikuyu: Gin joma kelo chandruok kendo timo timbe maricho; kendo chunygi opongʼ gi miriambo kinde duto.”
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

kikuyu: Noketo kambi mag jolwenje e dala maduongʼ mar Damaski e piny jo-Aram kendo jo-Aram nobedo e bwo lochne kendo negikelone osuru. Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Daudi olocho kamoro amora mane odhiye.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: ka giwero wend Musa jatich Nyasaye gi wend Nyarombo kama: “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye Maratego, mano kaka tijeni dongo kendo lich. Yaye Ruodh Nyasaye ogendini, yoreni nikare kendo gin adiera.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

kikuyu: Kane Peleg ja-higni piero adek, nonywolo Reu.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kikuyu: “Yaye, mad dine ngʼato bedie manyalo winja, nikech koro e akwongʼora ni weche ma awachogi gin adier mondo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego obed janeno mara; to ka ok kamano, to ngʼat modonjona oket wechegego e ndiko.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kikuyu: Bangʼ tho Joshua, jo-Israel nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ere ngʼama biro dhi mokwongo mondo okednwa gi jo-Kanaan?”
english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

kikuyu: Anakumu moromo gi timbeu, Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Anamok mach e bunge magu manowangʼ gimoro amora machiegni kodu.’ ”
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’”

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nochako omiyo Rezon wuod Eliada mane oringo oa ir ruodhe ma Hadadezer ruoth Zoba obedo jasik Solomon.
english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

kikuyu: Kik ulos nyasaye milamo maket gi kido moro amora e polo malo kata e piny mwalo, kata e bwo pi.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

kikuyu: Rapim mopogore opogore makare aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye, to gik mipimogo manie mifuke gin meke moloso.
english: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

kikuyu: Mad kwe yudre ei alworani, adier kwe mondo obedi ei ohinga mochieli.”
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ bedo maonge kuom higni mangʼeny, ne abiro Jerusalem mondo akelne ogandawa mich kendo atim ni Nyasaye misango.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

kikuyu: Kapo ni imake gi lweti to nisik kiparo amendno kendo ok nichak itim kamano kendo!
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

kikuyu: Aikora mar konyou kendo abiro rangou gi ngʼwono; mi puotheu pur mi pidhie kothe, un oganda mar dhood Israel duto,
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

kikuyu: Oseyiengʼo jokech gi gik mabeyo to oseriembo jo-mwandu gi lwetgi nono.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano dwol mane awinjo kawuoyo koa e polo cha ne ochako wuoyo koda kendo kawacho niya, “Dhiyo, ikaw kitabu moel manie lwet malaika ma onyono nam kod piny.”
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko ruodh jo-Amon notho, mi Hanun wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ere kaka uparo ni unyalo loyo achiel kuom jotend jolweny matinie moloyo mag ruodha ka uketo genou mana kuom jolwenj Misri gi faresegi?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owalo odiechiengʼ manokumie josunga, joma kawore gi jogo matingʼore malo duto (mi nodwokgi piny),
english: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

kikuyu: Kuom mano Josef nokete kaka chik e piny Misri nyaka chil kawuono, ni achiel kuom abich mar cham nyaka bed mar Farao. Puothe jodolo kende ema ne ok Farao okawo.
english: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

kikuyu: Igwedho higa gi cham mogundho, kendo gechegi mwandu opongʼo.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

kikuyu: Poge matindo tindo, ol mo kuome, nikech en misango mar cham.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek gangʼwen Jal Mowir noneg kayiem nono. Jatelo moro nobi manoketh dala maduongʼ gi kama ler mar lemo. Giko nobi mamuomore ka ohula maduongʼ kendo lweny kod masiche madongo dongo nobedie mana kaka Nyasaye nosechano.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okendo chiege bangʼe bangʼ riwore kode chunye oa kuome kata oyudo ni ok ohere,
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

kikuyu: To Yesu nolingʼ alingʼa thi. Jadolo maduongʼ nowachone niya, “Achiki mondo ikwongʼri gi nying Nyasaye Mangima ni inyiswa ka in e Kristo ma Wuod Nyasaye.”
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

kikuyu: “Yaye jo-Israel, bende ne ukelona misengini kata chiwo moro amora kuom higni piero angʼwen mane un e thim?
english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

kikuyu: bende osechano kumo Hamath mokiewo kode kaachiel gi Turo kod Sidon kata obedo ni gin gilony ahinya kamano.
english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

kikuyu: E Ribla ruodh Babulon nonego yawuot Zedekia koneno bende nonego jo-Juda duto ma joka ruoth.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

kikuyu: Omiyo aa malo ilor piny irgi. Kik ideki ma ok idhi kodgi nikech an ema aorogi.”
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

kikuyu: Eka nomiye teko gi duongʼ kod loch; kendo ogendini duto gi pinje duto kod jogo duto mawacho dhok mopogore opogore nolame. Lochne en loch mosiko nyaka chiengʼ, kendo pinyruodhe en pinyruoth ma ok nyal tieki ngangʼ.
english: Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom one that will not be destroyed.

kikuyu: Daudi bende wuoyo kuom wachni koloso kuom gweth ma ngʼama Nyasaye kwano kaka ngʼama kare ma ok tim gimoro nigo.
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

kikuyu: Eka ior wach ne ruodhi mag Edom, Moab, Amon, Turo kod Sidon kokalo kuom jombetre mosebiro Jerusalem ir Zedekia ruodh Juda.
english: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

kikuyu: Ibrahim kod Sara nosebedo moti kendo hikgi noniangʼ kendo ndalo Sara mag nywol nosekadho.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mondo oyud opak, en kende ema otimo gik miwuoro.
english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ni oganda jo-Israel duto niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ochiko:
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowacho niya, “Asebiro e piny mondo angʼadne bura, mondo joma muofni onen, to joma neno olokre muofni.”
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

kikuyu: Laban nodwoke niya, “Ayie, obed kaka iwachono.”
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

kikuyu: Nooro joote ei dala ir Ahab ruodh Israel kawacho niya, “Ma e gima Ben-Hadad wacho:
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

kikuyu: Koro kane Yesu odwogo, oganda norwake nimar negirite giduto.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

kikuyu: Aa malo, Aa malo, yaye Sayun, jiw badi motegno! Rwak lepi mabeyo, yaye Jerusalem dala maduongʼ maler. Nimar joma ok oter nyangu kendo mogak, ok nochak odonji e Jerusalem kendo.
english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

kikuyu: Isechido kara maler mar lemo kuom richoni mathoth mag ohandi mimayogo ji. Omiyo ne amoko mach kuomi, mine owangʼi motieki, bende ne amiyo ilokori buru manie lowo e nyim ji duto mane rangi.
english: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.

kikuyu: mine odongo modoko yiend mzabibu molak kendo oriere gi piny. Bedene nodongo modolore ochomo ongono, to tiendene to nomako lowo motegno. Omiyo nodoko yiend mzabibu ma bedene otimo otiep.
english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

kikuyu: Jaduongʼ sinagogi, mirima nomako nikech Yesu nochango dhakono chiengʼ Sabato, nowacho ni ji niya, “Nitie ndalo auchiel mitiyoe. Omiyo biuru mondo ochangu e ndalogo, to ok chiengʼ Sabato.”
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Lemo mar kwayo kony. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ikwera ka in gi mirima bende kik ikuma ka mirima mager omaki.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

kikuyu: Daudi noringo mochungʼ kuome. Nokawo ligangla ja-Filistia mowuodho e olalone kane osenege, nongʼado wiye gi ligangla. Kane jo-Filistia oneno ni thuon-gi osetho negilokore mi gichako ngʼwech.
english: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

kikuyu: kendo gidonjone kagiwacho niya, “Ngʼatni loko ji mondo olam Nyasaye e yo ma chik ok oyie.”
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

kikuyu: Weche moko duto mag loch Shalum, kendo kaka nojamo Zekaria, ondiki e kitepe mag weche ruodhi Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato oketho mi otimo richo mar oyiem kaluwore gi chike maler mag Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka okel ne Jehova Nyasaye im maonge songa kendo man-gi nengo kaluwore gi rapim mar shekel mar kama ler mar lemo. En misango michiwo mar pwodhruok e ketho.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Ne otimo honni ka wuonegi neno e gwengʼ mar Zoan, e piny Misri.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

kikuyu: Okwongʼ chiengʼ mane onywola! Mad odiechiengʼ mane minwa onywola kik gwedhi!
english: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

kikuyu: Dho ngʼat mofuwo ema tieke, to lewe ema bedo obadho ne ngimane.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

kikuyu: to yie iwinji gie polo lamogi kod kwayogi kendo konygi.
english: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

kikuyu: eka jo-Juda nongʼiyo kendo kane gigiyo kamano Nyasaye nokeyo Jeroboam kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto e nyim Abija kod jo-Juda.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi dwol mar mahalath.Maskil mar Daudi. Ngʼat mofuwo wacho e chunye niya, “Nyasaye onge.” Gin joma okethore, kendo yoregi obam; onge kata ngʼato achiel matimo maber.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Nikech gima wangʼeyo en ni ngʼato iketo kare kuom yie to ok kuom rito Chik.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

kikuyu: Eka nomedo wacho niya, “Awachonu adier ni ubiro neno ka polo oyawore, kendo ka malaike mag Nyasaye idho kendo lor kuom Wuod Dhano.”
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: “Mad wasika duto mapiem koda, yud kum mana ka joricho!
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

kikuyu: Osenyisi gima ber yaye dhano. To angʼo ma Jehova Nyasaye dwaro ni itim? Odwaro ni iti gadiera kendo iher kecho ji kendo iwuoth mobolore e nyim Nyasachi.
english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

kikuyu: “Kata kamano ka ichiworine kendo imiye chunyi,
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik ngʼato angʼata otamre ma ok orwake, to konyeuru mondo odhi nyime e wuodhe gi kwe, mondo oyud yo mar duogo ira nikech arite en kaachiel gi jowete mamoko.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

kikuyu: Kane joma ok jo-Yahudi owinjo wachno, negimor kendo negirwako wach Ruoth Nyasaye, kendo joma nochan-negi yudo ngima mochwere noyie kuom Yesu.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

kikuyu: E odiechiengno Ibrahim nokawo wuode Ishmael kod jogo duto machwo monywol e ode kata mane ongʼiewo gi pesa, kendo noterogi nyangu, mana kaka Nyasaye nonyise.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

kikuyu: Miye duongʼ, to enotingʼi malo; rwake chutho, to obiro miyi duongʼ.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

kikuyu: Pige mathoth ok nyal nego hera; kendo kata aore maringo ok nyal ywere. Ka dipo ni ngʼato dichiw mwandu duto mag ode mondo oyud hera, to mano dibed fuwo maduongʼ.
english: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

kikuyu: Duongʼ obed ne Nyasaye ma wuon Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo nikech kuom kechne maduongʼ, osenywolwa manyien mi wayudo geno mangima kuom chier mane Yesu Kristo ochiergo oa kuom joma otho.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ne opudhe gi mirima mager mi ogoye piny. Yamo ma aa yo wuok chiengʼ nomiyo oner; olembege ne olwer mogol kuome; kendo bedene maroteke bende notwo mi mach nowangʼogi.
english: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.

kikuyu: Kendo jodongo duto mag gwenge, gi askeche, gi jotelo, gi jorit chik mag ruoth nokonyo jo-Yahudi nikech negiluoro Modekai.
english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Kane Husham otho, Hadad wuod Bedad, mane oloyo jo-Midian e piny jo-Moab nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Avith.
english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomi oganda winj dwonde mar duongʼ kendo enomi gine lwete kabiro piny, gi mirima mager kod mach mawengʼo, bende gi rumbi motwere gi polo mariadore kod pe.
english: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

kikuyu: Kane odwokone min mare fedha ma pekne romo kilo apar gadekgo, min-gi nowachone niya, “Achiwo fedha maga duto ne Jehova Nyasaye mondo mi wuoda olosgo kido mopa mar nyasaye, omiyo koro aduogonigo.”
english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

kikuyu: “Jo-Israel nyaka chokre kolworo Hemb Romo kochwalore matin kode, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato ni e bwo jatendgi kod gima ondikie nying dhoodgi.”
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

kikuyu: Nobiro mi okawo kitabuno e lwedo korachwich mar Jalno mane obedo e kom duongʼ.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

kikuyu: Dhoot matin mar joka Benjamin otelonegi, oganda maduongʼ mar ruodhi moa e dhood Juda bende ni kodgi, eka nitie ruodhi moa e dhout Zebulun gi Naftali.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Angʼo madimi abed e chandruok, ka atiyo gi ngimana mana kaka an ema ahero?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

kikuyu: Jatem nobiro ire kendo nowachone niya, “Ka in Wuod Nyasaye adier to nyis kitegi mondo olokre kuon.”
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Ai oneno ma, en kod ji duto mar dala maduongʼ nowuok oko mapiyo nono gokinyi mangʼich mondo girom kod jo-Israel e lweny kama omanyore gi Araba. To ne ok ongʼeyo ni kar pondo noseketi e ngʼe dala maduongʼno.
english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

kikuyu: Wuoyo mar ngʼama ofuwo kelone mana goch e ngʼeye, to dho jomariek bedonegi ragengʼ.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

kikuyu: Ka ineno ka joma odhier isando e gwengʼ moro, kata ok ngʼad buchgi gadiera kod ratiro, to kik gik ma kamago bwogi; nimar jatelo ka jatelo nigi ngʼama duongʼne kendo kargi ji ariyogi gin gi ngʼama otelonegi.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

kikuyu: Onego ichiwe kaka girkeni maru kendo ni jodak modak e dieru man-gi nyithindo. Nyaka ikawgi gin bende kaka nyithind Israel mahie. Gin bende nyaka chiwnegi girkeni kaachiel kodu kaka imiyo oganda jo-Israel mamoko.
english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: fedha madirom kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen, gunde mag ngano ma pek romo kilo alufu apar gaboro, divai maromo lita alufu ariyo gi mia ariyo, mo maromo lita alufu ariyo gi mia ariyo, kod chumbi mathoth ma ok nyal pim.
english: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

kikuyu: Kane koro ji ngʼur ne Jehova Nyasaye kuom chandruok mane gineno, kendo kane owinjo ngʼurgino mirimbe nomedore. Kuom mano mach mane oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye noliel e kindgi mi owangʼo bath kambi konchiel.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

kikuyu: Teche mangʼeny ne liel e od gorofa malo kuma ne wachokore.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

kikuyu: Twangʼne Harun owadu lewni mopwodhi mag dolo mondo omi omiye duongʼ gi luor.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Chik ma amiyou ema: Herreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato, mana kaka an bende aseherou.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Nen! Yieni ema ochangi.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne okela nyaka e laru ma oko kendo notelona kolworo koda kondene angʼwen, mi naneno ei kona ka kona laru machielo.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

kikuyu: Joma ofuwo imiyo tije madongo dongo, to jo-mwandu to iketo e mago matindo.
english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

kikuyu: Eka negichiwo joneno mag miriambo, mane ojimbo wach kuome kawacho niya, “Ngʼatni osiko wuoyo marach kuom kama ler, kendo kuom Chik.
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Ido ne en Zekaria; koa e anywola Ginethon ne en Meshulam;
english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

kikuyu: Angʼeyo timbeni. Omiyo aseyawoni dhoot kendo onge ngʼama nyalo lore. Angʼeyo ni in giteko matin to kata kamano iserito wachna bende ok isekweda.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

kikuyu: Jo-Moab nowacho ne jodong Midian niya, “Oganda mangʼenyni biro tieko gimoro amora ma wan-go, mana kaka rwath tieko lum manie pap.” Omiyo Balak wuod Zipor, mane ruodh Moab e kindeno,
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

kikuyu: Isemiyo duongʼne orumo kendo isewito lochne piny.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

kikuyu: Ne en manyalo ritou mondo kik upodhi e richo, kendo manyalo kelou e nyim duongʼne ka uonge ketho kendo ka un gimor maduongʼ
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

kikuyu: Ogwedh jogo makech kayo kendo riyo mar tim makare oloyo, nimar gibiro yiengʼ.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ema kelo dhier gi mwandu, josunga odwoko piny, to joma muol otingʼo malo.
english: The LORD makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

kikuyu: “An e mzabibu madier, kendo Wuora e japur mar mzabibuno.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya wuod Amoz ne ooro wach ne Hezekia kama: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel wacho: Asewinjo lamoni kuom Senakerib ruodh Asuria.
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.

kikuyu: Koro chiwuru jo-Gibea ma timbegi monogo mondo mi waneg-gi kendo mondo wapwodh richoni e kind Israel.” To jo-Benjamin ne ok owinjo jowetegi ma jo-Israel.
english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Cham-go onego okan e kuonde keno mag pinyni, mondo obi otigo e higni abiriyo mag kech mabiro mako piny Misri, mondo mi kik kech keth piny.”
english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

kikuyu: “Gibiro dok e piny Israel mi gigol nyiseche manono kod kido mopa mage.
english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

kikuyu: “Los san mopamore gi dhahabu maler kendo indikie wechegi: Kama owal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’

kikuyu: Rieko nigi duongʼ moloyo, omiyo yud rieko. Kata obedo ni mwanduni duto nyalo rumo, to bed gi winjo tiend wach.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

kikuyu: To kodhi mane olwar e lowo maber ochungʼ kar ngʼat mawinjo wach kendo make, mi ochieg cham mangʼeny mohingo kodhi mane okomgo nyadi mia, nyadi piero auchiel kata nyadi piero adek.”
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

kikuyu: Joma wuotho e mudho oseneno ler maduongʼ; jogo modak e piny man-gi mudho mandiwa, ler oserienynegi.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Kuom adier gigi notimore ne Juda mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko, mondo mi ogolgi e nyime nikech richo mar Manase kod gik moko duto mane osetimo,
english: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

kikuyu: Gwengʼi nochakre e kuonde motwo nyaka Lebanon, kendo koa e aora maduongʼ, ma en Yufrate; piny mar jo-Hiti duto; nyaka chop e Nam Mediterania mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

kikuyu: Bende negiloso mor pwodhruok maler kod ubani maliw madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, ma en tich jalos mo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo puonjogi kowacho niya, “Tangʼuru ne jopuonj chik. Gihero wuotho koni gi koni ka girwako lewni maboyo mayware piny, kendo kimosogi e chirni.
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Nyaka karangʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Wiyi biro wil koda nyaka chiengʼ koso? Ibiro pandona wangʼi nyaka karangʼo?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: In e ohingana kendo okumbana; omiyo aseketo genona e wachni.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Ok awuo kuom jopiny mapok oyie ma terore, kata ma jowuoro, kata ma jomecho, kata malamo nyiseche manono, nikech mano to dichunwa ni wadar e pinyni.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

kikuyu: Ogolo oko osimbo ma ruodhi orwako kendo otweyo pien gugru e nungogi.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

kikuyu: nowacho niya, “Aiuru kae; nimar nyakoni ok otho, onindo aninda.” To gin neginyiere anyiera.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Bilga ne en Shamua; koa e anywola Shemaya ne en Jehonathan;
english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

kikuyu: Eka jomoko to ne wacho niya, “Chunowa ni nyaka wahol pesa mondo wachul godo osuru mar ruoth e puothewa kod puothe mzabibu.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

kikuyu: Datim nangʼo ka diponi wuora omula? Donge abiro nenora ngʼama wuonde kendo biro kelona kwongʼ kar gweth.”
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano odiechiengʼno Esau nochako wuodhe ka odok Seir.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

kikuyu: Eka ruodh Israel nowuok ka gin kod ruodh Juda kendo gi ruodh Ekron e piny Edom. Kane giselworore kuom ndalo abiriyo, jolweny ne onge gi pi mar modho kata mag jamni mane oyudo gin-go.
english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

kikuyu: Norito ruodhi manie bwo lochne chakre Aora Yufrate nyaka e piny jo-Filistia nyaka chop e giko tongʼ gi kod Misri.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Nikech nawacho ni Naboth ja-Jezreel ni, ‘Yie iusna puothi mar mzabibu; to ka ok kamano, to anyalo miyi puoth mzabibu machielo kare.’ En to nodwoke ni, ‘Ok anamiyi puotha mar mzabibu.’ ”
english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

kikuyu: Waseneno kendo wanyiso ji ni Wuoro oseoro Wuode mondo obed Jawar mar piny.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

kikuyu: Nibshan, Dala Maduongʼ mar Chumbi, kod En Gedi. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo auchiel.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

kikuyu: To ne okalo kamano piyo piyo nono kendo ne ok ochak onene, kata ne omanye to ne ok nyal yude.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, to rwakreuru gi Ruoth Yesu Kristo, kendo kik uchan e pachu kaka unyalo timo gik ma ringruok gombo.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

kikuyu: Ka ber mondo an bende adhi, to ginidhi koda.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Ezra ne en Meshulam; koa e anywola Amaria ne en Jehohanan;
english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

kikuyu: Kane ndalo abiriyo orumo, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat mogak ochamo ring misango mar lalruok mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye, ngʼatni nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandagi.
english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Milambo nolwar ne Obed-Edom, to ombulu mar od keno nolwar ne yawuote.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom Gog manie piny Magog, ma en ruoth maduongʼ e kind ruodhi mamoko mag Meshek gi Tubal, kor wach kuome
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

kikuyu: Abiro negogi gi masira mi atiekgi chuth, to un to abiro miyou ubed oganda maduongʼ kendo motegno moloyogi.”
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

kikuyu: Magi e chike moketi ni ngʼatno man-gi tuo malandore mar del, kendo ma ok nyal yudo chiwo mitimogo misengini mipwodhego.
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosepimo pi e chuny lwete kata mana pimo lach mar polo gi lwete? En ngʼa ma osechoko buru manie piny e atonga, kata pimo gode madongo gi matindo e rapim?
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

kikuyu: E piny Samaria ne nitie yawuowi piero abiriyo mawuok e dhood Ahab. Kuom mano Jehu nondiko barupe mooro Samaria ne jotend Jezreel, ne jodonge kod jorit mag nyithind Ahab kowachonegi niya,
english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nowacho kore, kodwokogi niya, “Onge gima aseketho kuom chik jo-Yahudi, kata kuom hekalu, kata kuom Kaisar.”
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

kikuyu: kendo goyo nduru kagiwacho niya: “ ‘Mano kaka lit! Mano kaka lit, yaye dala maduongʼ, morwakore gi lewni mayom kod lewni marep-rep gi makwar, mapakni gi dhahabu gi kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek kod lulu!
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

kikuyu: Ruoth nochungʼ e bath siro kendo noketo winjruok mane oselal obedo kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kosingore ni enoluw Jehova Nyasaye kendo norit chikene gi wechene kod buchene gi chunye duto kod pache duto kendo norit weche mag singruok mondiki e kitabuni.
english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

kikuyu: Omiyo tangʼ, kinde biro, Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ma ji ok nochak oluong kae ni Tofeth kata Holo mar Ben Hinom, to noluonge ni Holo mar Nek.’
english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.

kikuyu: Negikawo dala maduongʼno mi ginego ruodhe kod gimoro amora mangima mane ni kuno kaachiel gi mago mane nitie e mier matindo mokiewo kode. Onge ngʼama notony, mana kaka ne otimone Eglon.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo abiriyo koa sani abiro kelo koth e piny kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gi otieno, kendo abiro tieko gik moko duto mangima mane achweyo.”
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

kikuyu: Noketo jotend lweny mondo otel ne ji kendo nochokogi e nyime e laru mar dhoranga dala maduongʼ kendo nojiwogi gi wechegi:
english: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Zedekia nooro mondo okele e kar dak ruoth, kama ne openje akwala niya, “Bende nitiere wach moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye?” Jeremia nodwoko ni, “Nitiere, nikech nochiwi ni ruodh Babulon.”
english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from the LORD?” Jeremiah said, “There is.” He also said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”

kikuyu: Ka ogendini goyo wangʼni kuomgi, to gidhier nono kendo wengegi lil.
english: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.

kikuyu: Dhahabu duto mane oa ir jotend lweny mag alufe alufe kod mago mag miche miche mane Musa kod Eliazar jadolo ochiwo kaka mich ne Jehova Nyasaye pekgi ne romo kilo mia ariyo.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro oro mach e od Hazael, ma biro wangʼo ohinga mochiel motegno mag Ben-Hadad.
english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

kikuyu: E kinde mane muoch kayeno, jacholo nowachone niya, “Kik iluor nikech inywolo wuowi machielo.”
english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisedhi, malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore ne Josef e lek. Nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi gi min mare mondo itony idhi Misri. Dag kuno nyaka aduogni wach, nikech Herode biro manyo nyathini mondo onege.”
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nochiwo ni Hiram ruoth Turo mier piero ariyo manie piny Galili, nikech Hiram nomiye yiend sida gi saipras kod dhahabu mane odwaro.
english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

kikuyu: Kane piny oimore, jowete nooro Paulo gi Sila Berea. Kane gichopo, negidonjo e sinagogi mar jo-Yahudi.
english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

kikuyu: Ruodh Madon, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Hazor, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

kikuyu: Esau nowachone niya, “Ne achiegni tho. Ere ohala ma ayudo kuom duongʼ mar nywolna?”
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

kikuyu: Unyalo chamo kit le moro amora ma ombongʼ tiendegi opogore ariyo kendo manyamo kambula.
english: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

kikuyu: To yawuotego ne ok oluwo timbene. Ne gibaro kuom dwaro mwandu malangʼ kendo ka gikawo asoya bende ka gingʼado bura marach.
english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

kikuyu: Neuru, sani koro uketo genou kuom Misri, machalo odundu mobarore ma ka ngʼato orere to opilore mochwo ngʼatno kendo kelo adhola! Mano e kaka Farao ruodh Misri chalo ne joma ogeno kuome.
english: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.

kikuyu: Koso gin malaike mage mane Nyasaye onyiso niya, “In Wuoda; kawuono asedoko Wuonu”? Kata ni, “Anabed Wuon-gi to enobed Wuoda”?
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

kikuyu: Mbesene mane odongogo nodwoke niya, “Dwok jogo mosekwayi ni, ‘Wuonu noketo tingʼ mapek kuomwa, yie iket tingʼni obed mayot.’ Koro nyisgi ni, ‘Lith lweta matin duongʼ moloyo nungo wuonwa.
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

kikuyu: Gibayo koni gi koni ka gidwaro chiemo kendo ka ok giyiengʼ to gingʼur.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

kikuyu: kendo unuyud rwak malich ei pinyruoth mochwere mar Ruodhwa kendo Jawarwa Yesu Kristo.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Koro jo-Filistia nochoko jolweny mag-gi mondo gikedi kendo negichokore kama iluongo ni Soko e piny Juda. Negijot Efes-Damin man e kind Soko gi Azeka.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.

kikuyu: Eka, e ote mar abich, Sanbalat noorona jakonyne mana gi wach achielni, kendo e lwete ne nitie baruwa ma ok omuon
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

kikuyu: Aywagou, kaka Jazer ywak, yaye mzabibu mag Sibma. Bedeni kar machopo e nam; negichopo nyaka e nam mar Jazer. Jaketh gik moko osepodho e olembegi mochiek kod olemo mar mzabibu.
english: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka unune malit un jo-Korazin! Mano kaka unune malit un jo-Bethsaida! Nimar ka dine honni motimnugi dinetim ne Turo gi Sidon to dine giseweyo richo chon ka girwakore gi lep gugru, kendo gibet ka gibukore gi buru.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: gi yawuot Hashem ja-Gizon, Jonathan wuod Shage ja-Harar,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

kikuyu: Kata kamano ginibed e bwo lochne mondo gingʼe pogruok manie kind tiyona kod tiyone ruodhi mag pinje mamoko.”
english: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

kikuyu: kamoro mirima nyalo mako ruoth, mi openji ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo ne usudo machiegni ahinya gi dala maduongʼ mondo ukedi? Donge ne ungʼeyo niginyalo chielou gi aserenigi ewi ohinga?
english: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?

kikuyu: Musa notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike. Nokawo Joshua mi otero e nyim Eliazar jadolo gi chokruok duto.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

kikuyu: telna gi adierani, kendo puonja, nikech in Nyasaye ma Jawarna, kendo genona ni kuomi odiechiengʼ duto.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

kikuyu: Kuom mano unyalo chamo kit bonyo, osialo gi kit onjiri kaachiel gi kit ongogo duto.
english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

kikuyu: Ruoth Asa nogolo damare Maaka e kome mane entie kaka min ruoth nikech noloso sirni milamo mar Ashera. Asa nongʼado yien-no mokinge matindo tindo mowangʼe e holo mar Kidron.
english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, ruodhi mamoko ma ok in osetiyowa, makmana nyingi kende ema wamiyo luor.
english: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

kikuyu: Daudi nooro wach ne Tamar e dala ruoth kama: “Dhi e od owadu Amnon mondo itedne chiemo.”
english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

kikuyu: “Osedino wengegi kendo osemiyo chunygi odoko matek, mondo kik gine gimoro gi wengegi, kendo kik giwinj tiend weche gi chunygi, mi gilokre gidwog ira mi achang-gi.”
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

kikuyu: jo-Hivi, jo-Arki, jo-Sini,
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

kikuyu: “Los law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi dhahabu, gi law man-gi range marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro momin gi law mayom, ma en tich jatwengʼo molony.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nochiwo misengini e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne ok ginyal winjo jongʼad bura mag-gi, to negidhi nyime gitimo timbe dwanyruok kendo lamo nyiseche manono. Piyo piyo nono ne gibaro mi giweyo rito chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo kweregi kendo ne ok gimiye luor.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

kikuyu: To un nudhi mondo une angʼo? Janabi? Ee, awachonu, ni ne udhi neno ngʼat moloyo janabi gi duongʼ.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: nyikwa Joab, Obadia wuod Jehiel, kaachiel kode ji mia ariyo gi apar gaboro;
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-miriambo ok notony ma ok okum, to ngʼatno malando miriambo ok nobed thuolo.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

kikuyu: kod migawo adek mag kite mochwe kadhi malo gi migawo achiel mag bepe mochungi. Chudo margi mondo chul gi keno moa ka ruoth.
english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

kikuyu: Ruodha nomiyo akwongʼora kowacho ni, ‘Kik iyudne wuoda nyako kuom nyi Kanaan ma adakie lopgini,
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

kikuyu: kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono, gi karaya kod rachungi mare.
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

kikuyu: Kane uol kendo tekou norumo, negimonjou e yo ma ginego joma ne wuoth oolo; kendo ne ok giluoro Nyasaye.
english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Ibrahim noiko chiege Sara e bur mane ni e puodho ma Makpela machiegni gi Mamre (man Hebron) e piny Kanaan.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: To ka ukwayo to nyaka ubed gi yie ma ok uriwo gi kiawa, nikech ngʼat mariwo gi kiawa chalo gi apaka mar nam ma yamo riembo kendo tago.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

kikuyu: Giketo ruodhi e loch ka ok gipenja; kendo giyiero jotelo ka ok gingʼeyo parona. Giloso nyiseche manono kuom fedha gi dhahabu ma gin-go, to magi kelonegi mana kethruok.
english: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.

kikuyu: mondo omany kuonde mokanie gik machon mag ruodhi miluwo bangʼ-gi. E ndiko machon mokan ibiro yudo ni dala maduongʼni en dala maduongʼ mangʼanyo, ma thago ruodhi kod gwenge, ma en kar ngʼanyo chakre chon. Mano emomiyo dala maduongʼni nokethi.
english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

kikuyu: Wuoda, kik idhi kodgi ngangʼ kendo kik iwuoth e yoregigo,
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

kikuyu: Ne asando joma luwo Yor Kristo mi anego moko kuomgi, to ne amako chwo gi mon mi atero e od twech.
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

kikuyu: “Ngʼat machielo nowacho niya, ‘Koro eka angʼiewo rweth pur moromo jok abich, to adwaro dhi mondo atemgi, yie mondo ingʼwon-na.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: ma min-gi ne en dhako ma chwore otho, nyar dhood Naftali kendo wuon-gi ne ja-Turo kendo ngʼat molony e loso mula. Huram ne en ngʼat mariek, ngʼat man-gi ngʼeyo kendo molony ahinya e kit tije duto mag mula. Nobiro ir ruoth Solomon motimo tije duto mane omiye.
english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai gi jo-Yahudi duto ok chiem kapok gilwoko lwetgi e yor pwodhruok, kaluwore gi kit kweregi machon.
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

kikuyu: Nikech wan ok wachal gi ji mathoth mamoko, magajo wach Nyasaye mondo giyudie ohala. Wan to wan joma Nyasaye oseoro kendo wawacho adiera e nyime kuom Kristo.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

kikuyu: Chiwne Nyasach Jerusalem gigo duto moket e lweti mar dendo Nyasaye e hekalu mar Nyasachi.
english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Neginyiere, nikech negingʼeyo ni osetho.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼeni Elizabeth ma watni biro bedo gi nyathi kata e hike moniangʼno, to dhako mane iluongo ni migumbano, koro en gi ich mar dweche auchiel.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka ji noke oa e kambi mag-gi mondo gingʼad aora Jordan, jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok notelo nyimgi.
english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

kikuyu: nikech Ruoth Nyasaye nosekelo luoro e chuny jo-Aram ma giwinjo geche, farese kod jolweny mangʼeny, mani nomiyo giwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Neyeuru kaka ruodh Israel osengʼiewo pinje mag jo-Hiti gi ruodhi mag Misri mondo omonjwa!”
english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “Wadhiuru mwalo mondo walaw jo-Filistia gotieno, mondo watiekgi nyaka kogwen kendo moro amora kuomgi kik dongʼ kangima.” Negidwoko niya, “Tim gima ineno ni berni.” To jadolo nowacho niya, “Wapenjuru Nyasaye wach mondi.”
english: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”

kikuyu: Daudi bende nowuoyo kuome niya, “ ‘Ne aneno Jehova Nyasaye e nyima ndalo duto. Nikech ka entie e lweta korachwich, to onge gima nyalo yienga.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

kikuyu: “Donge ginidog Misri kendo Asuria nobedi gi loch kuomgi, nikech gitamore weyo richogi?
english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

kikuyu: Kamano nodwoko joote mag Ben-Hadad niya, “Nyis ruodha ma jaloch kama, ‘Jatichni biro timo duto mane idwaro mokwongo, to dwaronini ok anyal.’ ” Negia gitero ni Ben-Hadad dwoko.
english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

kikuyu: Jodolo mane odak e gwengʼ e molworo Jerusalem nogedo e dir Meremoth.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

kikuyu: Epafra motwe koda kaachiel nikech wach Kristo Yesu ooronu mos.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kikuyu: Ne nitie jatend jolweny moro e dala mar Kaisaria mane nyinge Kornelio. Ngʼatni norito oganda lweny moro mar jo-Rumi miluongo ni Oganda Italia.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

kikuyu: In giteko ewi nam magingore; ka apakane dhwolore malo, to ikweyogi.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

kikuyu: Babulon nobed pith mar kethruok, kar dak ondiegi, gima bwogo ji, kendo gima inyiero, kama onge ngʼama odakie.
english: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Ka idhi michopo ir jowa to singruogni ok nomaki, to bende ka gitamore miyi nyakono mondo ibigo, to kwongʼruokni ok nobed e wiyi.’
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

kikuyu: Ochopo dwaro mag joma omiye luor; adier, owinjo ywakgi kendo oresogi.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jasamuoyo e tich en owadgi ngʼat maketho gik moko.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

kikuyu: Isenyisa yore mag ngima; kendo inipongʼa gi mor mogundho, ka an e nyimi.’
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

kikuyu: “Angʼeyo ni inyalo gik moko duto; onge chenroni ma ngʼato nyalo gengʼo.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

kikuyu: Wachneuru ruodh Juda, mane oorou mondo upenja gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel wacho kaluwore gi weche musewinjo:
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, you shall tell him this, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

kikuyu: Nebuzaradan jatend lweny nomakogi duto mokelogi Ribla ir ruodh Babulon.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ne! Otenga fuyo kochiko piny, oyaro bwombene ewi Moab.
english: For the LORD says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, Wuodi Solomon e ngʼat manogerna ot gi laru mare nikech aseyiere mondo odok wuoda kendo anabed wuon-gi.
english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye chalo gi jasigu; kendo osetieko Israel! Osemuko ute Israel duto mag ruoth kendo oseketho mieche mochiel motegno. Osemedo ywagruok kod kuyo ne Nyar Juda.
english: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.

kikuyu: Ber bedo jachan ma wuodhe ok nyal cha, moloyo ngʼat mofuwo ma lewe timo richo.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ne kanisa. Ngʼat molocho to anami adiera mar chamo olemb yadh ngima manie puotho mar Nyasaye.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

kikuyu: Abiro wuondo Sisera, jatend jolwenj Jabin, kanyakla gi gechene kod ogandage mag lweny nyaka e Aora Kishon kendo achiwe e lweti.’ ”
english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

kikuyu: Mad gwedhi kuom ngʼado buchi maber kendo kuom gengʼa mondo kik achwer remo kawuononi mar chulo kuor gi lwetena awuon.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

kikuyu: Wuoda, ka joricho hoyoi mondo itim marach, kik iyienegi.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

kikuyu: Eka ranyisi machielo bende nonenore ei polo: ne en thuol mangʼongo, makwar man-gi wiye abiriyo kod tunge apar gi osimbo abiriyo mosidhi e wiyene.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

kikuyu: Gweth mar joma kare kelo pak ne dala, to kuom dho joricho dala kethore.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Un bende biuru ire kaka kite mangima, mondo oger kodu hekalu mar chuny mondo ubed jodolo maler machiwo misango mag chuny ma Nyasaye oyiego kuom Yesu Kristo.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo sa misango mar odhiambo, ne achungo aa kama ne abetie, gi kandhona kod lepa koyiech, mi apodho gi chonga ka atingʼo bedena malo ne Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha.
english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God;

kikuyu: Mirima nomaki gi aore, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Koso mirima nomaki gi aore matindo? Koso ne ikecho gi nam kane iidho farese, ma en gachi mar loch?
english: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

kikuyu: Noloso kama ler mar lemo ei hekalu mondo oketie Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.

kikuyu: Nowachone Saulo niya, “Angʼo momiyo ichiko iti ka ji wachoni ni, ‘Daudi dwaro hinyi’?
english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

kikuyu: to kane oyudo gimadho divai chiengʼ mar ariyono, ruoth nopenjo mikache ma Esta niya, “Kwayoni en angʼo? Kwaya akwaya ma kata ka en nus mar pinya to ibiro miyigo?”
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

kikuyu: kendo dhogi chal mana gi divai mamit. Nyako Mad divai lor mos e dwond jaherana, kamol mos e kind lewe kod lekene komadhe.
english: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka Roho konyowa e nyawo ma wan-go. Ok wangʼeyo gima owinjore wakwa sa ma walamo, to Roho owuon ema kwayonwa gi chur ma ok wanyal wacho.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

kikuyu: “Anene, to ok sani; asudo machiegni, to ok bute. Sulwe biro wuok koa kuom Jakobo; ludh loch biro wuok ei Israel. Obiro toyo wiye jo-Moab, kod wiye yawuot Sheth duto.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

kikuyu: Eka ne angʼicho, kendo ne aneno lwedo morie kochoma. Lwedono notingʼo ndiko modol,
english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nokelone Jehoshafat mich mopogore opogore to gi fedha; to jo-Arabu nokelone jamni madirom imbe alufu abiriyo gi mia abiriyo kod diek alufu abiriyo gi mia abiriyo.
english: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuodho liganglana kagolo e olalo mare. Ok nodogi e olalone kendo.’
english: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego, mirimbi biro siko koyienyo, gi lamo mar jogi nyaka karangʼo?
english: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

kikuyu: To negidhiyo nyime ka gikok niya, “Gure! Gure!”
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Nodwoka niya, “Ikia gigi adier?” Nawachone niya, “Ooyo ruodha, akiagi.”
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

kikuyu: “To koro Jehova Nyasaye, mi singruok misetimo kuom jatichni kod ode mondo ogurre nyaka chiengʼ. Tim mana kaka ne isingori,
english: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

kikuyu: Kinyne Musa nowacho ni ji niya, “Usetimo richo maduongʼ to koro abiro dhi ir Jehova Nyasaye nimar dipoka akwayonu Jehova Nyasaye mondo owenu richou.”
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasaye moro nobiro ir Eli mowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ‘Donge ne afwenyora ratiro ni od wuonu kane pod gin Misri e bwo loch Farao?
english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

kikuyu: “Ne imiyogi loyo pinyruodhi kod ogendini, mi ipogogi nyaka kuonde motimo ongoro. Negikawo piny Sihon ma ruodh Heshbon kod piny Og ma ruodh Bashan.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

kikuyu: Owinjore ubed gikuyo kendo uywagi, ka ugoyo nduru. Nyiero munyierogo onego olokre ywak, kendo mor mumorgo onego olokre kuyo.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

kikuyu: E higa mar abich mar loch ruoth Rehoboam, Shishak ruodh Misri nomonjo Jerusalem.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;
