kikuyu: Kar chakruok ne iketo mise mag piny, kendo polo bende gin tij lweti.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Ok opar ngangʼ yor ngima; yorene ogondore, to ok ongʼeyo kamano.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.” Jogo ne dhogi omoko.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

kikuyu: Ok ginidongʼ e piny Jehova Nyasaye; Efraim nodog Misri, kendo ginicham chiemo ma ok opwodhi e piny Asuria.
english: They won’t dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

kikuyu: bangʼe okaw yiend sida gi owino gi usi makwar, kaachiel gi winyo machielo ma pod ngimacha, kendo olutgie remb winyo mosenegno, kod pi soko, eka kendo okirgie odno nyadibiriyo.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokeyogi koa kanyo nyaka e piny duto kendo ne giweyo gero dalano.
english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

kikuyu: To koro nyaka ulony oko kit richo duto kaka: ich wangʼ gi mirima gi himruok gi ketho nying ji kod weche mochido.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

kikuyu: Makmana pinyruodh Pasia nogengʼona kuom ndalo piero ariyo gachiel. Eka bangʼe Mikael, ma en achiel kuom malaike madongo, nobiro mondo okonya, nikech ruodh Pasia ogengʼona.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.

kikuyu: Isaka notero Rebeka e hemb Sara min-gi, kendo Isaka nokendo Rebeka. Kuom mano Rebeka nobedo chi Isaka, kendo Isaka nohero Rebeka gihera mamalo; kendo Isaka ne ok obedo gi parruok bangʼ tho min mare.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

kikuyu: mondo ka un gi chuny achiel kendo uwacho gi chuny achiel kamano, to umi Nyasaye ma wuon Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo duongʼ.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo lach mar kor dhorangach mi noromo fut piero ariyo gi ariyo, to bor mar aripe ne en fut apar gaboro.
english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

kikuyu: Koro wuoda nitiere gimoro machielo ma bende onego ingʼe. Tich ndiko kitepe ok norum kendo somo mangʼeny biro olo pachi.
english: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Ruodha ma en ruoth, nikech jatichni en rangʼol, ne awacho ni, ‘Abiro ikoni pundana mondo otingʼa adhi gi ruoth.’ To Ziba ma jatija nondhoga.
english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

kikuyu: Bende itimo honni magi ne joma otho? Joma otho bende nyalo chier kendo mi paki? Sela
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyime kowacho niya, “Awachonu adiera, onge janabi mirwako e dalagi owuon.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

kikuyu: Chakre kindeno ngʼeny jopuonjrene nodok chien moweyo luwe.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

kikuyu: Enomiya duongʼ, nikech gik ma enowachnu nokaw kuoma.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Daudi nosekelo Sandug Nyasaye koa Kiriath Jearim nyaka kama noselosone, nikech nosegurone hema Jerusalem.
english: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: nikech awinjo kuom yie ma in-go kuom Ruoth Yesu, kendo kuom hera miherogo jomaler duto.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe mirimba biro rumo kendo nyiego mara mager biro weyi; chunya biro lendo kendo mirimba biro rumo.
english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

kikuyu: Wuoda, winja, eka inibed mariek, kendo ket chunyi e yo moriere tir.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nolor kuom Jahaziel wuod Zekaria ma wuod Benaya, ma wuod Jeyel ma wuod Matania ma ja-Lawi kendo nyakwar Asaf kane ochungʼ e dier chokruok.
english: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;

kikuyu: Abiro paki e dier ogendini, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, abiro werni e dier ogendini.
english: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni adek, jo-Asuria nokaw Samaria. Omiyo Samaria nokaw e higa mar auchiel mar loch Hezekia mane en higa mar ochiko mar Hoshea ruodh Israel.
english: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

kikuyu: E kindeno Ahazia nosegore piny koa ewi ode mar gorofa man Samaria mi ohinyore, ne ooro joote kowacho niya, “Dhiyo mondo ipenj Baal-Zebub ma nyasach Ekron, mondo iwinji ane ni bende abiro chango e hinyruoknani.”
english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness.”

kikuyu: Tarik angʼwen mar dwe mar ochiko, e higa mar angʼwen mar loch Darius, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni Zekaria.
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

kikuyu: Lop dhood Simeon ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Benjamin kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

kikuyu: Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi mamako badi ma korachwich, omiyo awachoni niya, “Kik ibed maluor; abiro konyi.
english: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

kikuyu: Ngʼat masiko katoke tek bangʼ siem mangʼeny ibiro tieko apoya nono maonge konyruok.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

kikuyu: Anatim honni miwuoro e kor polo to e piny, remo gi mach kod iro madhwolore nobedie.
english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto mane oyudo opondo e piny gode man Efraim owinjo ni jo-Filistia ringo, negidonjo e lweny kendo ne gilawogi matek.
english: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

kikuyu: To ngʼat mane ochangino ne ok ongʼeyo nying ngʼat mane ochange, nimar noyudo ka Yesu osedonjo ei oganda mane ni kanyo.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka dhako ni e kindene mar neno malo, to dhakono nobed mogak nyaka otiek ndalo abiriyo, kendo ngʼato angʼata momule nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma ool teko kendo omedo joma tekregi orumo bedo motegno.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

kikuyu: Joma odhier tiyo matek kamanyo chiemo e thim, mana ka punda; nikech onge kama ginyalo yudoe chiemo ni nyithindgi.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

kikuyu: nikech buchene gin adiera kendo kare. Osengʼado bura ni jachode maduongʼ mane oketho piny gi terruokne. Adier Nyasaye osekume nikech nonego jotich Nyasaye.”
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi manosebedo katimo timbe jwok nokelo kitepegi mag thieth mi nowangʼ-gi e lela ka ji duto neno. Kane gikwano nengo kitepego duto mane giwangʼo, neginwangʼo ka nengogi oromo silingʼ alufu piero abich.
english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

kikuyu: E higani mar piero abich nyaka ngʼato ka ngʼato odog thurgi.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

kikuyu: kendo joma ok jo-Yahudi omi Nyasaye duongʼ kuom kechne, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Emomiyo anapaki e kind ogendini, kendo anawer wende mapako nyingi.”
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

kikuyu: En angʼo ma dabigo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo akulrago e nyim Nyasaye moloyo? Dabi e nyime gi misengini miwangʼo pep koso gi nyiroye ma jo-higa achiel?
english: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mane onego giromieno, Herode ne orwako lepe mag ruoth mi obet e kome mar loch mi ochako wuoyo gi ji.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

kikuyu: Eka jotend lweny duto, kaachiel gi Johanan wuod Karea kod Jezania wuod Hoshaya, kod ji duto chakre matin nyaka maduongʼ nodhi ir
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

kikuyu: kata bonyo onge ruodhgi, to ka giringo gidhiyo nyime kaachiel ka gichanore ka ogend lweny.
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

kikuyu: Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Wuok Chiengʼ nolwar ne Shelemia. Nogo ombulu ne wuode Zekaria, ma jangʼad bura mariek kendo noyudo Rangach ma yo Nyandwat.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mane otimore e ndalo loch Jeroboam kod lochne e lwenje duto, kaachiel gi kaka noduogo Damaski kod Hamath mane ni e lwet Juda ne Israel; donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Kinde biro ma anatim singruok manyien gi dhood jo-Israel kod dhood jo-Juda.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

kikuyu: Ahimaz wuod Zadok nochako wacho ne Joab niya, “Kata bed ni angʼo matimore, to yiena alaw ja-Kush.” To Joab nodwoke niya, “Wuoda, angʼo momiyo idwaro dhi? Ionge gi wach maber manyalo keloni mich.”
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”

kikuyu: Nimar nobedo gi loch kuom pinjeruodhi duto man yo podho chiengʼ mar Aora maduongʼ chakre Tifsa nyaka Gaza kendo ne en gi kwe gi joma olwore duto.
english: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

kikuyu: Magi e weche mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kuom Israel gi Juda:
english: These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

kikuyu: “Koro sani an ja-higni mia achiel gi piero ariyo kendo koro ok anyal dhi nyime gi telonu. Jehova Nyasaye osewachona ni, ‘Ok iningʼad Jordan.’
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

kikuyu: Kane gisewuok Sukoth, ne gibworo Etham e lak thim.
english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Hagar nonywolone Abram nyathi ma wuowi kendo nochako nyinge ni Ishmael.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

kikuyu: Omiyo Eli nowacho ni Samuel niya, “Dhiyo inindi, to ka oluongi to iwach ni, ‘Wuo Jehova Nyasaye, nikech jatichni winjo.’ ” Samuel ne odok monindo kare.
english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, LORD; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

kikuyu: Gitamore duogo ir Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo; gichalo atungʼ ma ok nyal tigo. Jotendgi noneg gi ligangla nikech wechegi mag nyadhi. Kuom mano nojargi e piny Misri.”
english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Okandane mochwe maber nyaka bed machal kode kendo obed gimoro achiel gi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod bende nyaka lose gi dhahabu kod law momin mayom man-gi range marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Kaka un nyithind Nyasaye mohero, temuru mondo ubed machal kode,
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

kikuyu: Kane Solomon osetieko gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod dala maduongʼ ma ruoth dakie kendo nosetimo duto mane chunye dwaro,
english: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

kikuyu: nywok achiel kaka misango mar golo richo;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: to uwach ne wuon ot ni, ‘Japuonj penjo kama: Ere od welo monego achamie Sap Pasaka kod jopuonjrena?’
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: nyikwa Adonikam, ji mia auchiel gi piero auchiel gabiriyo (667),
english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

kikuyu: E kindego oganda maduongʼ machielo nochokore. To nikech ne gionge gi gima digicham, Yesu noluongo jopuonjrene ire mowachonegi niya,
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

kikuyu: Nikech ne ohero kwereu mi oyiero nyikwagi bangʼ-gi, ne ogolou Misri en owuon kod tekone maduongʼ,
english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

kikuyu: Ashdod gi mier molwore bende ne margi kochakore yo podho chiengʼ mar Ekron.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

kikuyu: ni obiro riembonu wasiku duto e dieru mana kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Eka Musa norieyo bade ewi nam, kendo otienono duto Jehova Nyasaye notugo yamo ma aa yo wuok chiengʼ mopogo pi nyadiriyo mi kanyo olokore lowo motwo. Pige nopogore,
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

kikuyu: “Los weche piyo piyo gi ngʼama odonjoni madwa teri e od bura. Tim kamano kapod un kode e yo, nono to onyalo keti e lwet jangʼad bura to jangʼad bura nyalo keti e lwet askari, kendo inyalo boli e od twech.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Eliazar jadolo nyaka kaw rembe moko e lith lwete kendo okwoye nyadibiriyo kochiko nyim Hemb Romo.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

kikuyu: Eka Solomon nochungʼ e nyim kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye e nyim oganda duto mar jo-Israel, kendo norieyo bedene kochomo polo
english: Solomon stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

kikuyu: Ne ojare mokwede gi oganda, en ngʼat mane neno chandruok mangʼeny, kendo mosiko kawinjo rem. Ji nojare kendo wan bende ne ok wamiye luor, mana ka ngʼama ok dwar neno.
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

kikuyu: Ruoth mondo omi chunyu obed motegno mondo ubed joma onge ketho kendo jomaler e nyim Nyasaye Wuonwa, chiengʼ ma Ruoth Yesu biroe kaachiel gi joge maler duto.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

kikuyu: emomiyo abiro chiwi ni joma aa wuok chiengʼ kaka girkeni margi. Gibiro gero kambi mag-gi kendo gibiro guro hembegi e dieru; gibiro chamo olembeu kendo gibiro madho chak maru.
english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

kikuyu: Ka isandowa, to mano timorenwa mondo uyud hoch kod warruok; to ka wayudo hoch, to en mana ni mondo Nyasaye okonyu mondo udhil gi sand ma wan bende wayudo.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

kikuyu: To jodolo machon kod jo-Lawi gi jotend anywola, mane oseneno hekalu mokwongo, noywak matek ka gineno kiketo mise mar hekalu, to ji mamoko nokok gi ilo.
english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,

kikuyu: Weche mag joricho opondo karito chwero remo, to wach mar joma kare resogi.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nyalo kawe kuoma, to achiwe nikech ahero. An gi teko mar chiwe bende an gi teko mar kawe kendo. Tekoni ne ayudo kuom Wuora.”
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

kikuyu: To kik penjgi kaka gitiyo gi pesa momigi nikech gin joma ogen.”
english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Efraim noromo ji alufu piero angʼwen gi mia abich (40,500).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo agola mochomo kama idonjogo,
english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowacho niya, “Asetimo marach, omiyo duogi, Daudi wuoda. Nikech ne ineno ni ngimana ber kendo owinjore bedie kawuono. Ok nachak atem mondo ahinyi kendo. Adieri asetimo tim ngʼat mofuwo kendo aseketho marach.”
english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ wuok kendo chiengʼ podho, kendo oridore piyo piyo kodok kuma owuokie.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Emomiyo koro rita, nyaka ndalo ma anangʼadnie bura. Asechano mondo achok ogendini gi pinjeruodhi, mondo aol mirimba kuomgi, ma en mirimba mager. Piny ngima ibiro wangʼo gi mach mar mirimba mager.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

kikuyu: to Jesse ne en wuon Ruoth Daudi. Daudi ne en wuon Solomon, ma min-gi, kane pok Daudi okawe, ne en chi Uria,
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

kikuyu: Omiyo noweyo gik moko duto mane en-go e lwet Josef kaka jarit; makoro Potifa ne ok odewo rango gimoro amora makmana chiemo mane ochamo. Josef ne nigi chia kendo jaber.
english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

kikuyu: Omiyo wawacho weche jonabi mane gikoro makoro oselernwa tiendgi. Ka uchiko itu ne wechegi to ubiro konyoru, nikech gichalo gi ler marieny kawuok e mudho, nyaka chop odiechiengʼno yawre mi ler mar sulwe mokinyi meny chunjeu.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

kikuyu: Koro abiro nyisou gima abiro timo ne puotha mar mzabibu: Abiro golo chiende oko, kendo ibiro kethe, abiro muko ohingane kendo nonyone piny.
english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

kikuyu: To wenge joma timbegi richo biro jony kendo yore mag tony biro lalnegi; to geno margi biro lal nono.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni magi duto nosetimore, pod negidhi mana nyime gitimo richo; pod ne ok giyie kuome, kata obedo ni ne osetimo ranyisi mathoth e diergi.
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

kikuyu: Gibiro kalo nam chandruok; nam madhwolore ibiro pie, kendo kude duto mag aora Nael biro dwono. Sunga mar Asuria ibiro dwok piny kendo kondo mar Misri biro lal.
english: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ok angʼeyo wuoyo; an mana rawera matin.”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

kikuyu: higni adek mag kech, dweche adek ma wasiku biro lawoue gi ligangla ka negou kata ndalo adek mar ligangla mar Jehova Nyasaye (ma en ndalo mag dera marach e piny), ka malaika Jehova Nyasaye neko kamoro amora e piny Israel.’ Koro par ane mondo imiya dwoko matero ni ngʼama ne oora.”
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ok ungʼeyo gima ukwayo. Bende unyalo madho kikombe ma adhi madhoni?” Negidwoke niya, “Wanyalo.”
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

kikuyu: Bende ne ok iweyo agoyoni oriti gi nyiga gi nyikwaya. Kuom mano isetimo gima ofuwo.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

kikuyu: kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro golo jo-Israel oko e dier ogendini kuonde ma gisedhiyoe. Abiro chokogi kagologi koni gi koni mi aduog-gi e pinygi giwegi.
english: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

kikuyu: kagiwacho niya, “Wagoyoni erokamano, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye Maratego! Jal mantie, kendo Jal mane nitie, nikech isekawo teko mari maduongʼ, mi koro ichako locho.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Hazeroth mi gibworo Rithma.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

kikuyu: koa kuom oganda Isakar neginwangʼo Kedesh, Daberath,
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Eka anadhi e kendo mar misango mar Nyasaye, nyaka achopi e nyim Nyasaye, Nyasaye ma kelona mor kendo ilo. Abiro paki gi nyatiti, yaye Nyasaye kendo Nyasacha.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

kikuyu: “E odiechiengʼ mitimoe misango mar Jehova Nyasaye abiro kumo joka ruoth, yawuot ruoth, kaachiel gi ji duto morwakore gi lewni mag jopinje mamoko.
english: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich gi nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Ahiezer wuod Amishadai ogolo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Ginine malit! Giseluwo tim Kain, kendo gisemwomore e ketho mar Balaam nikech gihero pesa, omiyo osetiekgi kaachiel gi Kora nikech gisengʼanyo kaka Kora nongʼanyo.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

kikuyu: Koda ka le mag thim bende tangni ka dwari nikech aore duto oseduono, kendo mach osewangʼo pewe mag kwath.
english: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Oiko loch ni joma kare, en okumba ni jogo ma wuodhgi ler,
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

kikuyu: To anakum piny ma noketgi wasumbini, bangʼe giniwuogi gia gi mwandu mogundho.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

kikuyu: wangʼeyo ni dhano ok nyal ket kare kuom mako Chik, to mana kuom yie kuom Yesu Kristo. Omiyo kata mana wan bende waseketo yiewa kuom Kristo Yesu, mondo eka oketwa kare kuom yie kuom Kristo, to ok kuom mako chik, nikech onge ngʼama ibiro ket kare nikech mako chik.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasaye makare, In ema inono pach ji gi chunje ji, tiek timbe mamono mag joma richo mondo imi joma kare odag gi kwe.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

kikuyu: Kar romb chwo duto kochakore ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime ne romo ji alufu aboro mia auchiel (8,600). Tij jo-Kohath ne en rito kama ler mar lemo.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo uluonga ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth,’ to ok utim gima awacho?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

kikuyu: Kendo kuom rachungi taya ne nitie kikombe angʼwen molos machal gi maupe mag oyungu mathiewo kendo golo thuoke.
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: Watiyo matek gi lwetewa. Ka ikwongʼowa, to wagwedho joma kwongʼowa; kisandowa, to wayie isandowa asanda;
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

kikuyu: To ne awinjo dwol maduongʼ moa e kom duongʼ mar loch mawacho niya, “Koro Nyasaye osebiro dak gi ji kendo enodag kodgi, ginibed joge, to Nyasaye owuon enobed kodgi kendo nobed Nyasachgi.
english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nowacho ne owetene niya, “Biuru machiegni buta.” Kane gisetimo kamano, nowachonegi niya, “An owadu Josef mane uuso e piny Misri!
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, anachiw Zedekia ruodh Juda, jotende kod joma ni e dala maduongʼni ma notony e masira, ligangla kod kech, ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon to gi wasikgi madwaro ngimagi. Enoneg-gi gi ligangla; ok enowenegi kata kechogi kata ngʼwononegi.’
english: Afterward,” says the LORD, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’

kikuyu: Israel nochako odhi nyime giwuoth kendo noguro hembe tok oinga mar Migdal Eder.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo oti kod mich moro amora mosemiye mondo okonygo jomoko. Ka utiyo gi kinda kaka jorit mag ngʼwono mopogore opogore ma Nyasaye omiyo kuom konyo ji.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon nobiro mi giriedo ne lweny e dhoranga dalagi maduongʼ, ka jo-Aram moa Zoba gi Rehob gi jo-Tob gi Maaka ne nikendgi e pap oko.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, dwogwa iri; kendo ndalowa obed manyien kaka ne wan chon.
english: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

kikuyu: Wach kuom jo-Amon: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Onge yawuowi e Israel? Oonge gi jarit girkeni mage? To kare angʼo momiyo Molek osekawo mwandu Gad? Angʼo momiyo joge odak e dalane?”
english: Of the children of Ammon. The LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?

kikuyu: Jo-Gilead nomako kuonde miyorogo Jordan mondo jo-Efraim kik ngʼadi. Sa moro amora mane ja-Efraim dwaro ngʼado kanyo to ne okwayo ni yiene okadhi odhi loka cha. To kane okwayo kamano; to ja-Gilead ne penje ka bende en ja-Efraim. To kane odwoko ni ok en ja-Efraim,
english: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”

kikuyu: E higa mar ariyo mar loch Nebukadneza, noleko lek mayoreyore, kendo lekgo nochando chunye ma omone nindo.
english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

kikuyu: Kata kamano nitie jomoko manok e dala mar Sarde ma ok osechido lepgi. Gin to gini wuothi koda ka girwakore gi lewni marochere nikech gin joma owinjore.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

kikuyu: Yawuot Merari mane oyier ne gin: Mali kod Mushi. To kuom yawuot Jazia noyier Beno.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

kikuyu: Kata kokwayi tongʼ gweno, imiye mana thomoni?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

kikuyu: Gehazi nodwoke niya, “Gik moko duto beyo. Ruodha oora mondo anyisi ni, ‘Ji ariyo matindo moa e kanyakla mar jonabi obiro ira koa e gode mag Efraim. Yie imigi fedha moromo kilo piero adek gangʼwen kod lewni motwe otwe nyadiriyo.’ ”
english: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

kikuyu: To Itai nodwoko ruoth niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kendo akwongʼora ni ruodha ma en ruoth ni kamoro amora ma ruodha ma en ruoth nobedie, bed ni en kar ngima kata kar tho, to kanyo bende ema jatichni nobedie.”
english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

kikuyu: Gininene wangʼ gi wangʼ kendo nyinge nobed e lela wangʼ-gi.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

kikuyu: Nikech Hana ne nigi chuny malit noywak ahinya kolamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly.

kikuyu: Agulni duto man Jerusalem kod Juda nobed maler ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, kendo ji duto mabiro mondo otim misango nokaw agulnigo moko mi gitedie igi. To chiengʼno jo-Kanaan moro amora ok nobedi e od Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: To un chakuru wuoth kudok chien e thim kuchomo Nam Makwar.
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

kikuyu: Nyasaye en jangʼad bura makare; en e Nyasaye matoyo mirimbe pile ka pile.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

kikuyu: An to ok anyal sungora e ringruok ngangʼ. Gima dimi asungra en mana msalap Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, mosemiyo piny kod dwarone ogur e ngimana.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

kikuyu: Amazia nopenjo ngʼat Nyasaye niya, “To wabiro timo angʼo kuom fedha mapekgi romo kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen mane wachulo kuom jolweny mag jo-Israel?” Ngʼat Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye nyalo miyi mangʼeny moloyo mano.”
english: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”

kikuyu: To bende moloyo ne mano duto, e kindwa kodi nitie hoho mangʼongo moseketi, mondo otam jogo madwaro aa ka obi iru kata ngʼato ok nyal ngʼado oa koru obi irwa koni.’
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

kikuyu: Kane jatend joted makati oneno ni Josef oloko tiend lek maber, nowachone Josef niya, “An bende ne aleko kama: Atonge adek mag makati ne ni e wiya.
english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

kikuyu: ma nobare mak oyudo nyadi mia: mier, owete, nyimine, mine, nyithindo, kod puothe, kaachiel gi sand bende e ndaloni, to kod ngima mochwere e piny mabiro.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

kikuyu: Kik iluor, yaye Jakobo jatichna, nimar an kodi. Kata obedo ni atieko ogendini duto ma asekeyou e diergi, ok anatieku chuth. Anakumu to mana gi bura makare; ok anaweu ngangʼ ma ok akumou,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says the LORD, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

kikuyu: Adhier kendo achando; bi ira piyo, yaye Nyasaye. In e konyruokna kendo jaresna; kik ideki, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oseluongo ji apar gariyogo kaachiel, nomiyogi nyalo kod teko mar golo jochiende duto kendo chango tuoche,
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “To kinde biro, ma anakume nyisechege manono, kendo e pinye mangima joma nigi adhonde nobed gi rem malit.
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.

kikuyu: E higa mar abich mar Joram wuod Ahab ruodh Israel, kane Jehoshafat ne ruodh Juda, Jehoram wuod Jehoshafat nochako tich kaka ruodh Juda.
english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Kane akelogi e piny mane asingora ni anamigi, to kane gineno wi thur moro amora gi yien moloth to negitimo misenginigi kanyo, kendo negigolo chiwo mag-gi mane ochiewo mirimba, kendo ne giwangʼo ubani madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kendo gipuko misangogi miolo piny.
english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Norieyo gimoro mane chalo gi bat mine okawa gi yie wiya. Roho mar Nyasaye notingʼa malo nyaka kind piny gi polo, kendo ka an ei fweny mag Nyasaye, notera Jerusalem, nyaka kama idonjogo e rangach man yo nyandwat, mar agola maiye, kama ne nitie kido mar nyasaye manono ma Nyasaye mon-go.
english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa kuomu ma ka wuode okwayo kuon to omiye kidi?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

kikuyu: Dadhi kure eka apond ne Roho mari? Koso kanye ma daring adhiye mondo apondni?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

kikuyu: Eka ruoth gi jodonge nogolo chik e Nineve kawacho niya: “Kik dhano kata chiayo kata dhok bil gimoro, bende kik yienegi gichiem kata modho.
english: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;

kikuyu: Notimo kamano mondo onyis ratiro e ndalogi ni en owuon en kare, kendo ni oketo kare joma nigi yie kuom Yesu.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Harim ne en Adna; koa e anywola Meremoth ne en Helkai;
english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

kikuyu: Chik mokwongo man-gi singruok wacho niya, “Luor wuonu gi minu
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar adek chiwuru rwedhi apar gachiel, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jaritono ne ok omiyogi chiemb od ruoth kod divai, to ne omiyogi mana alot kende.
english: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

kikuyu: Adier, Nyasaye ok chik ite ne ywakgi maonge tiendgi Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok dewgi.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye biro piedho joge kochakore Aora Yufrate nyaka aore mag Wadi mar Misri, to un, yaye jo-Israel nochoku achiel kaachiel.
english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

kikuyu: E kinde mag Abiathar jadolo maduongʼ, donge nodonjo e od Nyasaye mi ochamo makati ma nosepwodhi moket tenge ma chik ok oyiene ngʼato angʼata mondo ocham, makmana jodolo. Kendo nochiwo moko ne jogo mane ni kode.”
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

kikuyu: Ne utingʼo malo hemb Molek kod sulwe mar nyasachu ma Refan ma gin, nyiseche manono mane uloso mondo ulam. Omiyo abiro darou mi ateru e piny twech mabor mayombo Babulon.’
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

kikuyu: Omiyo Adoni-Zedek ruodh Jerusalem nokwayo Hoham, ruodh Hebron, Piram ruodh Jarmuth, Jafia ruodh Lakish kod Debir ruodh Eglon niya,
english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

kikuyu: Gode mag Bashan gin gode madongo miwuoro; godego mag Bashan ojuothore adier.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nyalo waro ngima nyawadgi kata manyalo chulo Nyasaye nengo moromo ware.
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

kikuyu: Maria nyar Magdala nodhi ir jopuonjre monyisogi Injili niya, “Aseneno Ruoth!” Kendo Ruoth ema osenyisa weche ma awachonugi.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

kikuyu: Ka gikadho e Holo mar Baka to gimiyo obedo kama opongʼ gi sokni; kendo kodh opon bende pongʼe gi yewni.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

kikuyu: Kane aduogo aa Padan, nabuok malich ka Rael minu otho e piny Kanaan kane pok wachopo Efrath. Kuom mano ne aike e bath yo madhi Efrath” (ma tiende ni Bethlehem).
english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

kikuyu: Juda nodwoke niya, “Dwa wach angʼo ne ruodha? Dwa wach angʼo? Ere kaka wanyalo nyiso jatichwa? Nyasaye oseelo richo jatichni. Koro wan wasumbi ruodha; wan wawegi kod ngʼatno moseyud kikombeni kuome.”
english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa Bela kokalo kuom Ard gi Naaman ne gin: koa kuo Ard, joka Ard; koa kuom Naaman, joka Naaman.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

kikuyu: ma en ndalono ma Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ne pod ni koda kendo nyithinda noketa diere,
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

kikuyu: Pok mar Manase ne en lope apar kapok okwan piny Gilead kod piny Bashan mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan,
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

kikuyu: Jatend askeche noketogi e lwet Josef mondo oritgi. Bangʼ kane gisebedo e od twech kuom kinde moko,
english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

kikuyu: To jo-Israel noloyogi mi giringo, kendo Daudi nonego joidh gechegi mag farese mia abiriyo kod jolweny mag-gi mawuotho gi tielo alufu piero angʼwen. Nochwowo Shobak jatend jolweny, motho kanyo.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

kikuyu: Kido mochweno ne olos gi dhahabu lilo, to kore gi bedene nolos gi fedha. Bund iye gi embene to nolos gi nyinyo,
english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

kikuyu: Ne awachone nyithindgi e thim niya, “Weuru luwo puonj mane wuoneu oketo kata rito chike mag-gi, kendo kik udwanyru gi nyisechegi manono.
english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

kikuyu: Moza nonywolo Binea, Binea nonywolo Rafa, Rafa nonywolo Eliasa, to Eliasa nonywolo Azel.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Ne jogo mongʼeyo pogo tiend wach, gigi duto nikare, giber ni jogo man-gi ngʼeyo.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

kikuyu: Yie iwe ni jogi mosetimo richo e nyimi, wenegi kethogi duto magisetimo e nyimi kendo mi joma ne omakogi okechgi.
english: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

kikuyu: Eka negigomo ma giluwo yo madhi Bashan, kendo Og ruodh Bashan gi jolweny mage duto nowuok riat mokedo kodgi e lweny Edrei.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Negiloso karaya mar mula gi rachungi miketoe karayano mag mula ka gitiyo gi kiyo mag mon mane tiyo e dho Hemb Romo.
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: to Hezekia ne en wuon Manase. Manase ne en wuon Amon, Amon ne en wuon Josia,
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

kikuyu: To koro uneno kendo uwinjo kaka ngʼat miluongo ni Pauloni oseloko ji mathoth Efeso-ka, nyaka e piny Asia duto. Owacho ni nyiseche ma dhano oloso ok gin nyiseche mar adier.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

kikuyu: kata kapo ni chunya osetingʼore nikech mwandu mangʼeny ma an-go, kata ka asemor kuom mwandu mathoth ma lweta osechoko,
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro riembo ogendini ma ubiro monjo kendo kawo pinygi ka uneno. To ka useriembogi oko mi udak e pinygi,
english: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

kikuyu: Nogero kende mag misengini miwangʼoe liswa ne gik mochwe mae kor polo e laru ariyo mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: oserito ngimawa kendo osegengʼo tiendewa ni kik kier.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

kikuyu: Ngʼwonono puonjowa mondo wakwed timbe maricho kod gombo mochido mag piny, kendo mondo wabed kawaritore e ngima makare mamiyo Nyasaye duongʼ e kindeni,
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

kikuyu: Ka koro Joshua ne chiegni chopo Jeriko, nongʼiyo nyime mi oneno ngʼato mochungʼ kotingʼo ligangla e lwete. Joshua nosudo machiegni kode mopenje niya, “In jakorwa koso jasikwa?”
english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

kikuyu: Mano bende e kaka tim ngʼato makare bende ongʼongʼore, kendo kata mana mago motimo mopondo fwenyore bangʼe.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: En awuoyo kode wangʼ gi wangʼ, awuoyo kode maler ma ok gi ngeche; kendo oneno tich Jehova Nyasaye. Angʼo momiyo ne ok uluor ka uwuoyo kuom jatichna Musa?”
english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

kikuyu: Eka ji nodwoko niya, “Mad gima chal kamano kik timrenwa ka wajwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye, mondo watine nyiseche manono!
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

kikuyu: higa ka higa mon matindo mag Israel nyaka dhi e got kuom ndalo angʼwen mondo otim rapar mar nyar Jeftha ma ja-Gilead.
english: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Benjamin ne gin Eliada, jalweny mathuon ka en gi ji alufu mia ariyo (200,000) motingʼo atungʼ kod okumbni;
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

kikuyu: Negigoyo ombulu kuom joga kendo negiloko ohala mar hono yawuowi ka giwilo gi ochode; nyiri to negiuso ka giwilo gi divai, mondo gimadhi.
english: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

kikuyu: Oganda podho nimar onge puonj, to jongʼad rieko mangʼeny miyo loch mar adier bedo.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

kikuyu: Jodolo, matiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, mondo oywagi, e kind agola gi kendo mar misango mar hekalu. Giywag kagiwacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik itiek jogi. Kik imi girkeni mari obed gima ichayo, ma ogendini wuoyo kuome marach. Angʼo ma dimi giwachi e dier ogendini niya, ‘Ere Nyasachgi?’ ”
english: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, LORD, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”

kikuyu: Nikech herani ber moloyo ngima, dhoga biro miyi duongʼ.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel, kar sa ochiko odhiambo, mane en sa mar lemo noyudo ka Petro gi Johana odhi e hekalu.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo duto modak e piny ipuko oko ka yugi; emomiyo ahero chikeni.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

kikuyu: Yamb ugwe tingʼe midhi kode, mi olal nono; oywere mi ogole kare.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

kikuyu: To kata dhako ema owere gi chwore mokendore gi dichwo machielo to odonjo e richo mar terruok.”
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Eka nopimo bor man e kind yo ka ii kama idonjogo nyaka oko mar agola ma iye. Nonwangʼo ni oromo fut apar gabich yo ka bathe mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ kod bathe mochomo yo nyandwat.
english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

kikuyu: Malaika nomedo wachone niya, “Rwak lepi gi wuocheni.” Petro notimo kamano. Malaika nochako okone niya, “Koro rwak kodi mondo iluwa!”
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

kikuyu: Ji moko manok nodok kor Paulo, mi giyie kuom Kristo. Achiel kuom joma noyie ne en Dionusio, mane en jabuch Areopago, gi dhako moro ma nyinge Damaris, kod ji mamoko manok.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

kikuyu: Kane jatich ngʼat Nyasaye ochiewo mo mondo kiny gokinyi, jolweny man-gi farese kod geche lweny ne oseluoro dala maduongʼno. Jatich nopenjo niya, “Yaye, ruodha, wabiro timore nade?”
english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okelone Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mar cham, to nyaka obed mogo mayom. Onego ool mo kuom mogono kendo ochwo ubani kuome,
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

kikuyu: Rwethgi koluwo dhok mamon to nyaka nywol; dhogegi nywolo nyiroye madongo duto kendo onge minywolo kobwogi.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

kikuyu: piny Naftali kod piny Efraim gi Manase, piny Juda duto nyaka chopi e Nam Mediterania man yo podho chiengʼ;
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

kikuyu: Nyasaye noneno kaka piny nosekethore, nikech ji duto mae piny nodak e richo.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

kikuyu: Gikwalo punda nyathi kich kendo gikawo rwadh pur achiel kende mar dhako ma chwore otho ka gir singo.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

kikuyu: Ere kaka dachul Jehova Nyasaye kuom berne duto mosetimona?
english: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho ni, ‘Anakumgi. Rowere mag-gi noneg gi ligangla, yawuotgi kod nyigi kech nonegi.
english: therefore the LORD of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noloso le mag bungu kaka kitgi obet; jamni kaka kitgi obet kendo gi gik mamol e lowo kaka kitgi obet. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Donge wigi kuot gi timbegi mamono? Ooyo, gionge wichkuot kata matin; bende gionge leny kata wichkuot. Omiyo ginipodhi e dier joma opodho; enolwargi piny ka ikumogi, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo wuotho koni gi koni kendo gima rach ema ji puoyo.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

kikuyu: Eka inipar yoreni mi wiyi kuodi, kendo inirwak nyimineni madongo mohingi kod matindoni. Anamiyigi kaka nyigi, to ok natim kamano kotenore kuom singruok mara kodi.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato nokawo tape owuon ma mach nitie iye kendo oketoe ubani mangʼwe ngʼar mine gichungʼ kod Musa gi Harun e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth, kaachiel gi mikache kobedo bathe nopenja niya, “Wuodhino biro kawo thuolo maromo nade, to ibiro duogo karangʼo?” Ne berne ruoth mondo oora; omiyo ne achiwo odiechiengʼ monego awuogie.
english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nochweyo piny gi tekone; ne ochako piny gi riekone, kendo oyaro polo gi ngʼeyo mare.
english: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek timo timbe mabeyo, to ngʼat mofuwo timo timbe maricho.
english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.

kikuyu: Yawuot Javan ne gin: Elisha, Tarshish, jo-Kitim kod jo-Rodan.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

kikuyu: Nomiyo jo-Gershon geche ariyo kod rwedhi mabwoch angʼwen, kaluwore gi tijgi,
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, abiro gengʼo chiemo kik donji Jerusalem. Ji biro chamo chiemo mopim ka gin gi parruok mathoth kendo gibiro modho pi mopim ka midhiero omakogi,
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni uluongowa e nyimu ka mondo waler gimomiyo otim tim maber ne puth, kendo mondo upenjwa kaka nende oyudo chang,
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

kikuyu: Elihu norito mondi eka oloso gi Ayub nikech ne en ngʼama tin e diergi.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

kikuyu: Adier mwandu duto ma Nyasaye osegolo kuom wuonwa gin mawa kod nyithindwa. Omiyo tim gimoro amora ma Nyasaye osenyisi.”
english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

kikuyu: Nooro wach bende ni jo-Kanaan man yo wuok chiengʼ kod podho chiengʼ, kaachiel gi jo-Amor, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, kod jo-Jebus mantiere e piny gode; kendo ni jo-Hivi modak e tiend got Hermon e gwenge mag Mizpa.
english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

kikuyu: Abiro timonegi ranyisi kaluongogi mi achokgi. Adier, abiro resogi; mi gidog joma thoth mana kaka ne gin chon.
english: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

kikuyu: Wuoda, kik icha kum mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo kik ingʼur kokweri kuom gik maricho;
english: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyakwari maka wuodi kata maka nyari, nikech kitimo kamano to ikelo wichkuot ni in iwuon.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

kikuyu: Eka ginikulre ka gingʼiyo piny, to chandruok gi mudho kod chuny malit ema ginine kendo noriembgi mawitgi e mudho mandiwa.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

kikuyu: Nikech pok ochayo kata ojaro sandruok mar joma winjo malit; pok opandone wangʼe to osewinjo ywakne mar dwaro kony.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

kikuyu: kendo Harun nonyisogi gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye onyiso Musa. Bende notimo honni duto e nyim ji,
english: Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi achaya e kindu gi jo-Edom nimar gin oweteu. Kik ukwed jo-Misri nikech ne udak e pinygi ka wasumbini.
english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

kikuyu: Paulo gi Barnaba nobedo kuno kuom ndalo mogwarore, ka giwuoyo gi chir kuom Ruoth Yesu, kendo Nyasaye nodoko janeno kuom wach ngʼwonone, komiyo joote timo honni gi ranyisi.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ni kodwa; en e jatendwa. Jodolo mage biro goyo turumbete miluong ji mondo oked kodu. Jo-Israel, kik uked gi Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu nikech ok ubiloyo.”
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

kikuyu: En angʼo momiyo iweya mondo ane timbe maricho? Koso en angʼo momiyo idhil gi timbe maricho? Kethruok kod timbe maricho ochoma pile; lwenje mangʼeny nitie kendo sigu medore.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

kikuyu: To dala moro miluongo ni Hamona bende nobed kanyo. Kendo kamano e kaka ginipwodh piny.’
english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

kikuyu: nikech un uwegi ungʼeyo malongʼo ni chiengʼ Ruoth nobi apoya mana kaka jakuo poyo ji gotieno.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

kikuyu: Ruth nyar Moab, ma chi Malon, bende asekawo kaka chiega, mondo achung-go nying ngʼat motho gi mwandune, mondo nyinge kik lal e dier anywolane, kata e kitabu mondikie nying joma odak e dala-ka. Kawuononi udoko joneno!”
english: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

kikuyu: Baasha ruodh Israel nodhi kedo kod Juda kendo nochielo Rama motegno mondo ogengʼ ni ngʼato angʼata kik wuogi kata donji e piny Asa ruodh Juda.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

kikuyu: Alamo ni mondo iresa e lwet owadwa Esau nikech aluor ni obiro biro ma omonja kaachiel gi mon kod nyithindgi.
english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

kikuyu: Lach mar agola ne en fut piero adek, kendo chakre nyime nyaka toke noromo fut apar gaboro. Ne inyalo chopi kanyo kiidho raidhi man-gi raidhi mangʼeny, kendo ne nitie sirni mochungi motegno mane osiro bath gama koni gi koni.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

kikuyu: “Nowachone ni, ‘Ka ok ginyal winjo Musa gi Jonabi, ok ginyal yie winjo kata ngʼato mochier oa kuom joma otho.’ ”
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

kikuyu: Nikech kuom Injilino ema Nyasaye ketoe dhano kare kuom yie kende ma ok omedie gimoro machielo, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Ngʼat makare nobed mangima kuom yie.”
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mosiko katimo richo en ngʼat Satan, nikech Satan osiko katimo richo nyaka aa chakruok. Gimomiyo Wuod Nyasaye nobiro ne en ni mondo otiek tich Satan.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

kikuyu: “Kik ngʼato kel wach mar donjo, kik ngʼato donjne wadgi, nimar jou chalo mana ka joma donjo ni jadolo.
english: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

kikuyu: Jarit od twech nokwayo taya, mi noringo ir Paulo gi Sila, mopodho e nyimgi kokirni.
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

kikuyu: Onge gimoro man oko mar dhano ma kodonjo e iye to nyalo miyo odok mogak. En adier ni gima wuok e dho ngʼato ema miyo odoko mogak. [
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, go nduru kendo dengi, nikech liganglano ochomo joga; ochomo yawuot ruodhi mag Israel duto. Osedirgi e dho ligangla kaachiel gi joga. Emomiyo go nduru kindego nikech wachno!
english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.

kikuyu: Joma dagi puonjne nyaka orie gi muolo, ka en gi geno ni Nyasaye nyalo miyogi thuolo mar lokruok mar weyo richo mi gingʼe adiera,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

kikuyu: “An, kendo en An e Jal mahoyo chunyu. Angʼo momiyo uluoro yawuot dhano adhana matho, kendo maner mana ka lum,
english: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?

kikuyu: Kendo kik uket chunyu kuom gima dicham kata madi madhi, kik uparru kuom mago.
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro locho nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachone niya, “In luwa, kendo we joma otho oik jogegi motho gin giwegi.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

kikuyu: Onge moro amora kuomgi mane okwan gi Musa kod Harun jadolo e kinde mane gikwano jo-Israel e Thim mar Sinai.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Kut wacho ni, ‘Oonge e iya;’ to nam wacho ni, ‘Oonge koda ka.’
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Abiro lwaronu makati koa e polo malo. Ji nyaka wuogi pile pile mondo ochok moromogi odiechiengno. Kuom yorni abiro temogigo mondo ane kata ka gibiro luwo chikena.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

kikuyu: Jehoram nonwangʼo baruwa koa ir Elija janabi mawacho niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwaru Daudi wacho, ‘Ok iseluwo yore wuonu Jehoshafat kata mago mag Asa ruodh Juda.
english: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “the LORD, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

kikuyu: Kokel buche matek e dieru ma ok unyal ngʼado, bedni gin buche mag nek, larruok kata mag goruok, to tergiuru kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yiero.
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.

kikuyu: To neuru, ugeno kuom weche mag miriambo maonge tich.
english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

kikuyu: Jaduongʼ Musa nodwoko kawacho niya, “Gima itimoni ok ber.
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

kikuyu: Chi Potifa ne omake gilawe kendo owachone niya, “Bi mondo ibed koda e achiel!” To Josef noringo mowuok oko mar odno kendo noweyo lawe e lwet chi Potifa.
english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

kikuyu: Negitingʼo ringre nyaka Kanaan kendo giike e rogo man e puodho man Makpela, machiegni gi Mamre, mane Ibrahim ongʼiewo kaka kar yiko kaachiel gi puodhono koa kuom Efron ja-Hiti.
english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

kikuyu: Joab ne jatend jolweny Israel duto; ka Benaya wuod Jehoyada to ne otelo ne jolwenj jo-Kereth kod jo-Peleth.
english: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

kikuyu: Enobed gi teko ewi mwandu duto kaka dhahabu gi fedha, kod mwandu duto mag Misri, kendo jo-Libya gi jo-Kush bende noluore.
english: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.

kikuyu: Ute man Jerusalem kod mago mag ruodhi Juda nodwany mana machal gi ute man Tofeth, mane giwangʼoe ubani ewi tado mag udi ne gik mochwe mae kor polo kendo olo misango miolo piny ne nyiseche manono.’ ”
english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

kikuyu: mano bende e kaka ongo yiengo ode mondo nyithinde owuogi, koyaro bwombene mondo okawgi kendo otingʼ-gi.
english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

kikuyu: Ka mirimb owadu oserumo kuomi kendo wiye osewil gi gima ne itimone, to abiro oroni wach mondo iduog ia kuno. Ere gima omiyo yawuota ariyo ditho odiechiengʼ achiel?
english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

kikuyu: kowacho niya, “Weuru richo, nikech pinyruodh polo ni machiegni.”
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

kikuyu: Kik uwe ma ok uparo gigo madiera kod mowinjore gi pak. Gimoro amora mane apuonjou, kendo uyudo kuoma, mane uwinjo kawacho, kata atimo, to tigouru; ka utimo kamano to Nyasach kwe nobed kodu.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Ber romo gi ondiek madhako moma nyithinde, moloyo romo gi ngʼat mofuwo ei fupe.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

kikuyu: Bende nitiere gima ngʼato nyalo wacho ni ma en gima nyien? Ooyo ok gima nyien, nimar nyalo bedo ni gino nosetimore chon kane pok onywolwa.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

kikuyu: Joma ochayo ji osekunyona buche mondo apodhie, gitimo gima chikni okwedo.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nosetimo tije duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

kikuyu: Bed mamor gi chiegi mihero e ndalo duto mar ngimani maonge tiende ma Nyasaye osemiyi e piny e ndalogi duto maonge tiendgi, nimar mano ema niyudi kuom chandruokni duto e piny ka.
english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

kikuyu: Kane Samla otho, Shaul ja-Rehoboth man but aora nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To apenjo kama: Donge gisewinjo wach? Chutho, gisewinjo, nikech, “Dwondgi osedhi kuonde duto e piny, wechegi osechopo nyaka e tunge piny.”
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

kikuyu: Yesu nopenje niya, “Nyingi ngʼa?” Nodwoko niya, “Wan oganda” nikech jochiende mangʼeny nosedonjo kuome.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

kikuyu: Ka ogol chilo kuom fedha, to jatheth koro nigi gimoro mar theth;
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

kikuyu: “Eka unungʼe ni An, Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, adak e Sayun, goda maler. Jerusalem nobed kama ler, ogendini mamoko ok nochak omonje kendo.
english: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.

kikuyu: Eka negiwacho niya, “Biuru wager dala maduongʼ man-gi ohinga mabor machopo nyaka e polo mondo omi walos nyingwa kendo kik wabed moke e kor piny.”
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un joma ni e twech duto ma aseriembo koa Jerusalem nyaka Babulon.
english: Hear therefore the LORD’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

kikuyu: Nyar Misri nomi wichkuot, kendo nochiwe ne jogo moa yo nyandwat.”
english: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”

kikuyu: Balaam nowacho ne malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Asetimo richo. Ne ok angʼeyo nine ichungʼ e wangʼ yo mondo igengʼna. Koro ka ok imor, to abiro dok dala.”
english: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

kikuyu: nikech kuom Kristo Yesu Chik mar Roho mar ngima osegonye kuom Chik mar richo kod tho.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

kikuyu: Omiyo sirni duto nobed aboro, to rachungi duto mag fedha nobed apar gauchiel ka siro ka siro otingʼo rachungi ariyo ariyo.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: kuom ji alufu apar gauchiel (16,000), pok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne gin ji piero adek gariyo (32).
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

kikuyu: Hagar ochungʼ kar Got Sinai mantie e piny jo-Arabu, kendo godno chalo gi dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem nikech osiko e tich misumba gi nyithinde nyaka kawuono.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi Farao ruodh Misri. Abiro turo bedege ariyo duto, bade ma pod ngima gi bade mosetur, kendo abiro miyo ligangla lwar koa e lwete.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

kikuyu: Kar rombgi ne gin ji alufu mia auchiel gadek mia abich gi piero abich (603,550).
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Anagol kuomgi koko mar ilo kod mor, dwond miaha kod mar wuowi madwaro kendo, koko mar kite rego kod ler mar taya.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

kikuyu: Mogik, roho marach nobiro mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mowacho ni, ‘Abiro hoye.’
english: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ne nitie mon ariyo mane nyi dhako achiel.
english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

kikuyu: To dobedo maber ka an kodu sani mondo awuo kodu wangʼ gi wangʼ eka uwinj dwonda maber, nimar chunya chandore ahinya nikech un.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nowachne ni Joab oseringo modhi e hemb Jehova Nyasaye kendo ni ne en but kendo mar misango. Eka Solomon nochiko Benaya wuod Jehoyada niya, “Dhiyo mondo inege.”
