english: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to the LORD’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”

kikuyu: Lamo mar Daudi. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iwinj kwayona makare; chik iti ne ywakna, chik iti ne lemona, lamona ok aa e dhok mawuondo ji.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

kikuyu: Siro ka siro borne nobed fut apar gabich to lachne nobed fut ariyo gi nus,
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye ne ok omiye rieko kata paro mar pogo gima ber.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

kikuyu: Ngʼato yudo mor e dwoko mowinjore, to mano ber manade kuom wach mochopo e sa midware.
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

kikuyu: “Ibrahim nodwoke ni, ‘Gin kod Musa gi Jonabi, owinjore giwinjgi.’
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

kikuyu: E kindeno Maria noikore mowuok mapiyo kodhi e piny motimo gode mar Judea,
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

kikuyu: Chokruokni duto noyie mondo otim mano nikech mano nonenore makare ni ji duto.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

kikuyu: Bende unupidh mzabibu e gode matindo mag Samaria; jopur nopidhgi, kendo ginibed mamor gi olembegi.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.

kikuyu: Neuru, apaka mar Jehova Nyasaye nomwomre gi mirima, ka kalausi mafuyo e wiye joma timbegi richo.
english: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gariyo mar loch Joram wuod Ahab ma ruodh Israel, Ahazia wuod Jehoram ruodh Juda nobedo e loch.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Nyamin nyathino nochungʼ gichien mondo one ane gima biro timore ni nyathino.
english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

kikuyu: Mana gisano pasia mar hekalu noyiech e diere tir, chakre malo nyaka piny. Piny noyiengni kendo lwendni nobarore.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

kikuyu: to ne alingʼ kane awinjo weche mag jasigu mondo jongʼadne rieko kik ngʼe gima aparo, mi giwach niya, “Lwetwa ema oseloyo, Jehova Nyasaye ok osetimo gimoro.”
english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

kikuyu: Saka oime gi tipone; kendo omburi motwi e tie aora olwore.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

kikuyu: Gibiro bironi gi gig lweny, gi farese maywayo geche to gi oganda maratipo; gibiro kawo ruothegi mondo giked kodi ka gilwori giketi diere, ka gitingʼo kuodi madongo gi matindo, kendo ka girwako ogute mag lweny. Abiro chiwi e lwetgi mondo okumi, kendo gibiro kumi kaluwore gi chikgi giwegi.
english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

kikuyu: Kendo nomedo bedo gi teko ahinya, nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ne ni kode.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Abimelek nodhi Thebez mine olwore kendo omonje.
english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

kikuyu: ne atingʼo wangʼa kendo e nyima kanyo naneno ngʼato morwako law mayom, kendo notweyo kamba molos gi dhahabu malerie mogik e nungone.
english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Aseherou. “Un to upenjo ni, ‘Ere kaka iseherowa?’ “Donge Esau ne en owadgi Jakobo?” Jehova Nyasaye wacho. “To kata kamano asehero Jakobo
english: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the LORD, “Yet I loved Jacob;

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona ni:
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ka wadu odhier kendo ochiwore mondo ingʼiewe, to kik ikete otini ka misumba.
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

kikuyu: kendo nikech Jehova Nyasaye nohere, nomiyo Nathan janabi wach ni mondo ochake ni Jedidia.
english: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD’s sake.

kikuyu: Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon,
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

kikuyu: kaachiel gi gwenge duto mokiewo kodgi mag dak nyaka chopi Baalath. Magi ne miechgi mag dak. Kendo negindiko nonro margi:
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

kikuyu: Tonde mag tho nondhoga morida kendo obadho mar tho nochika tir.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nodwok tongʼno chien nyaka Rama modhi nyaka e dala maduongʼ mar Turo mochiel gohinga, mogomo kochiko Hosa koluwo dho nam e gwengʼ mar Akzib,
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

kikuyu: Kinde mosekadho machiegni, ne ikwayo weruok kendo ne itimo gima nikare e nyim wangʼa: Un duto ne uyie weyo oweteu thuolo. Bende ne utimo singruok e nyima e ot motingʼo Nyinga.
english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;

kikuyu: Mad wangʼi rang hekaluni otieno kod odiechiengʼ, kama niwacho niya, ‘Nyinga nobed kanyo,’ mondo iwinji lemo ma jatichni lamo kochomo odni.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

kikuyu: Bethania ne chiegni gi Jerusalem madirom kar kilomita adek,
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Dhi ir oganda mondo ipwodhgi kawuono gi kiny. Ketgi giluok lepgi
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kata obedo ni kuom Kristo ne anyalo bedo gi chir mar chiki mondo itim gima onego itim,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

kikuyu: Kane Tou ruodh Hamath nowinjo ni Daudi noloyo jolweny duto mag Hadadezer ruodh Zoba,
english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

kikuyu: To Saulo nobaye gi tongʼ mondo onege. Eka Jonathan nongʼeyo ni kare wuon-gi dwaro nego Daudi.
english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

kikuyu: To kane ok giyudogi, ne giywayo Jason kod jowete moko e nyim jotend dalano. Negigoyo koko kagiwacho niya, “Jok mosekelo chandruok e piny kuonde duto koro osechopo ka,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

kikuyu: Jaherana en mara kendo an bende an mare; omiyo omenyo e dier ondanyo.
english: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

kikuyu: Yiende madongo e puothi gin olembe mongʼinore, molembegi beyo, kendo mit kaka olemb hena kod nad.
english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,

kikuyu: Ka giparo ni ne en ei oganda margi, negiwuotho moromo ndalo achiel eka negichako manye e dier wedegi kod osiepe.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Abishai gi jodonge duto niya, “Ka wuoda, manywolo ema dwaro tieko ngimana, to kare ja-Benjamin-ni ditimna marach maromo nade! Wereuru kode odhi nyime gi kwongʼ nimar Jehova Nyasaye osenyise mondo otim kamano.
english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD has invited him.

kikuyu: Nyasaye Maler penjo niya, “En ngʼa madupima-go? Koso en ngʼa madirom koda?”
english: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

kikuyu: bangʼe nokelo wiye koketo e san. Ne ochiwe ne nyakono, mi nyakono nochiwe ni min mare.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

kikuyu: Abram ne ja-higni piero aboro gauchiel kane Hagar onywolone Ishmael.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mane Saulo oore mondo otim, Daudi ne timo maber ahinya kuom mano Saulo nomiye rangʼiny mamalo e lweny. Ma nomiyo ji duto mor nyaka jotend lweny mag Saulo bende.
english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

kikuyu: Un gi nyiseche manono mangʼeny mana kaka dalau, yaye Juda; bende kendo mar misango museiko mudwaro wangʼone nyasaye manono mar wichkuot miluongo ni Baal ngʼeny mana ka yore mag Jerusalem.’
english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’

kikuyu: To Petro nochako leronegi tiend gik moko duto mane osetimore, e yo mawinjore maler, kowacho niya,
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

kikuyu: Ginibi ire ka gitetni ka winy moa Misri, ka akuche moa Asuria. Anami gibed e miechgi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Nyithindgi nochal kaka e ndalo machon, kendo anagur anywolagi motegno, mi anakum jogo duto ma thirogi.
english: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo kaka ijara, kaka ikuodo wiya kendo kaka aneno wichkuot; wasika duto ochoma tir.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

kikuyu: Kendo osemiyo Bazalel, wuod Uri, ma wuod Hur, maa e dhood Juda kaachiel gi Oholiab wuod Ahisamak maa e dhood Dan rieko mar puonjo jomoko.
english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Jaherani olal kune, yaye jaber mogik e dier nyiri mabeyo? Jaherani ne oluwo kanye, mondo wakonyi manye?
english: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?

kikuyu: kendo uchiw lita achiel gi nus mar divai kaka misango miolo piny. Kamano e kaka unuchiwne Jehova Nyasaye misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nokulore piny auma kendo jo-Juda duto kod Jerusalem nogoyo chonggi piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka gilame.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni dala ma ageno dhiye en mana liel kende, kata kapo ni apedho kitandana e mudho,
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Shem nosenywolo Arfaksad, nodak higni mia abich mi onywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Faresene nobed mangʼeny miwuoro mi buru ma tiendegi dhwolo ka giringo noumi. Ohinga magi noyiengni kowinjo koko mag farese mag lweny gi geche man-gi tiende ariyo mag lweny kod geche moum wigi man-gi tiende angʼwen, chiengʼ ma enodonj gie dhorangeyeni kaka ji donjo e dala maduongʼ ma ohinga mare osenyon mopiel piny.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

kikuyu: Higa ka higa min ne twangʼone law matin kendo terone e kinde mane ojadhi gi chwore ka gidhi timo misango mar higa ka higa.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Musa kod Harun noseweyo Farao, Musa noywak ni Jehova Nyasaye nikech ogwende mane osekelo kuom Farao.
english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Kwauru Jehova Nyasaye mondo omiu koth kinde komo; nikech Jehova Nyasaye ema miyo polo dudo. En ema ochiwo koth mondo ochwe ni ji kod yiende mag bungu.
english: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

kikuyu: Mano mane okwongo wuok ne kwar, kendo dende duto ne chalo motimo yier; kuom mano negichake ni Esau.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, mirima mager nomako Nebukadneza gi Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego kendo chunye nokethore kodgi. Nogolo chik mondo ochwak mach maliet moloyo lietne mapile nyadibiriyo,
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.

kikuyu: To ka itamori chiwori, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osefwenyona:
english: But if you refuse to go out, this is the word that the LORD has shown me:

kikuyu: “ ‘E sawo ka sawo kod nyasi ka nyasi moyiedhi, chiwo mar cham nyaka bed debe achiel gi rwath, debe achiel gi im, to kuom nyirombe, ngʼato nyalo chiwo kaka osengʼado e chunye, kaachiel gi kube achiel mar mo kuom debe ka debe.
english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kikuyu: Emomiyo chunya mor kendo lewa yot; ringra bende nobed gi geno,
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

kikuyu: Sa mane Jeremia nokan e laru mar jolweny, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone niya:
english: Now the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

kikuyu: Abiro kelo kuomgi achaya kendo joma ok dwar gi pinjeruodhi duto manie piny, ma wangʼo ich kendo itiyo godo kaka ranyisi, gima ibwogogo ji kendo ikwongʼogo, ka moro amora ma aterogie.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel nochoko jonabi kanyakla maromo ji mia angʼwen mopenjogi niya, “Bende wanyalo dhi kedo gi jo-Ramoth Gilead koso kik adhi?” Negidwoke niya, “Dhiuru nikech Nyasaye nochiwe e lwet ruoth.”
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

kikuyu: nogoyo yiendegi mag mzabibu gi ngʼowu piny kendo nolwero yiende mane ni e pinygi.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Yunani duto nochako toyo mirimbgi kuom Sosthene, jaduongʼ sinagogi, mi gichako goye e nyim jobura; kendo Galio ne ok odewogi kata matin.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

kikuyu: “To an gi neno maduongʼ moloyo mar Johana, nimar tich mane Wuora omiya mondo achopi, kendo makoro atimo sani-ni, nyiso ni Wuora ema noora.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano yawuot Jakobo notimo mana kaka nochikogi:
english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

kikuyu: Nyasaye nomiyo Paulo otimo honni madongo,
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

kikuyu: Nobed mana ka tado makelo tipo ka chiengʼ rieny kendo ka kama ji ringo tonyie ka bwok ne koth kod ahiti maduongʼ.
english: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

kikuyu: Ngʼama ohero ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼama ochayo ngimane e pinyni biro rite nyaka chop oyud ngima mochwere.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

kikuyu: Jo-Efraim ibiro toyo ka bura oloyogi, nikech giketo chunygi mar luwo nyiseche manono.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Nongʼiewi maonge chudo moro, omiyo ibiro wari ma ok ochulie pesa.”
english: For the LORD says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”

kikuyu: To ei kanisa, Nyasaye oseketo ji man-gi mich mopogore opogore e tichne: Mokwongo, joote, mar ariyo, jonabi, to mar adek, jopuonj, eka joma timo honni, kaeto joma omi teko mar chango joma tuo, kod jokony ji, kod joma otelo ni ji, to mogik, joma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

kikuyu: Negiwacho, “Biuru, wangʼad rieko mar hinyo Jeremia; nimar puonj mar chik mikelo gi jadolo ok nolal, kata ngʼado rieko moa kuom joma riek, kata weche moa ir jonabi. Omiyo biuru, wahangne wach kendo kik wachik itwa ne gimoro amora mowacho.”
english: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”

kikuyu: Obiro kwerou ratiro kapo ni udew wangʼ ji.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru e chunyu ni kaka ngʼato kumo wuode, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu bende koro kumou.
english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

kikuyu: Ne aneno gima chalo gi kom duongʼ molos gi kidi ma nengone tek miluongo ni safir ka ni ewi kama oyarore mane oumo kerubi.
english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

kikuyu: Ne waherou gihera matut momiyo ne wamor, ok mana mar pogo kodu Injili mar Nyasaye kende, to koda ka ngimawa bende, nikech ne wagenou gi genruok maduongʼ.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

kikuyu: Un joma ogwedhi ka ji mon kodu, ka gikwedou kendo giyanyou, kendo giketho nyingu, nikech Wuod Dhano.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

kikuyu: En bende noluwo timbe mag od Ahab nimar min mare nojiwe mondo otim timbe maricho.
english: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Reuben ma en wuowi makayo mar Israel: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, achiel ka achiel, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo moko, Feliks nobiro gi chiege Drusila, mane en nyar jo-Yahudi. Nooro wach mondo oluongne Paulo, mi Paulo noyalone kuom wach yie kuom Kristo Yesu kolingʼ mos owinje.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kuonde mane opog-gi ne gin: Zora, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

kikuyu: En kikombe mar mer kod kuyo, machalo mana gi kikombe mar masira kod kethruok, ma Samaria nyaminu nomethoe.
english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

kikuyu: Ruoth ma jasunga onge gi rieko, to ngʼatno mamon gi gik moyud e yo marach biro dak amingʼa.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

kikuyu: “Jogi dhogi omoko, gionge gima ginyalo dwoko; weche orumonegi.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokecho koda nikech un, kendo ne okwongʼoreni ok anangʼad aora Jordan mondo adonji e piny maber ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou ka girkeni.
english: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;

kikuyu: Eka dwol moro noa e boche polo, kawacho niya, “Ma e Wuoda, maseyiero; winjeuru.”
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

kikuyu: ka giwachonegi niya, “Wachuru ni, ‘Jopuonjrene nobiro gotieno mi okwale sa mane wanindo.’
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

kikuyu: “Ka gik ma awachogo miriambo, to en ngʼa manyalo nyiso maler ni ariambo, ma dimi wechega bed gik manono?”
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

kikuyu: Nineve to obiro ywero, gi ohula maduongʼ motiek chuth; obiro lawo joma kwede nyaka e mudho mandiwa.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

kikuyu: Ka jaricho otho, to genone duto tho kode, gigo duto mane ogeno kuom tekone bedo nono.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

kikuyu: Nyasachwa, donge niriembo joma nodak e pinyni ka jo-Israel neno mimiyo nyikwa Ibrahim osiepni pinyni nyaka chiengʼ?
english: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

kikuyu: Abiro keyo ringre jo-Israel e nyim nyisechigi manono, kendo abiro keyo chokeu e alwora mag kendeu mag misango.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

kikuyu: Kane owinjo ma, Yesu nowachone Jairo niya, “Kik iluor, bed gi yie kendo obiro chango.”
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

kikuyu: Omiyo noringo odhiyo motelo kendo noidho yadh ngʼowu mondo onene, nikech Yesu ne biro kalo kanyo.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

kikuyu: Kama onge rwedhi, dipo bedo nono, to kama rwath nitiere keyo mangʼeny bedoe.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

kikuyu: To waseneno bende e Ndiko motelo ka Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.”
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Ne en gi nyamin mane iluongo ni Maria, mane obet piny, e tiend Ruoth kowinjo gima owacho.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

kikuyu: Ruodhgi motelo nigi en malaika mar bur matut maonge gikone ma nyinge miluongego gi dho jo-Hibrania en Abadon, to gi dho jo-Yunani en Apoluon (tiende ni Ngʼat maketho gik moko).
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

kikuyu: Kaka soko olo pige oko, e kaka en bende oolo timbene mamono. Lweny kod kethruok mor e iye; tuone kod adhondene osiko e nyima.
english: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.

kikuyu: To koro, kik chunyu chandre kendo kik ucharu nine uusa ka nikech Nyasaye noora motelonu mondo ares ngimau.”
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼno ji nobi iri koa Asuria kod mier madongo mag Misri, koa chakre Misri nyaka Yufrate koa bath nam koni nyaka bath nam komachielo, kendo koa got koni nyaka got komachielo.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

kikuyu: “Un joga en angʼo ma asetimonu? Asemiyou tingʼ mapek e yo mane? Dwokauru ane.
english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

kikuyu: to koa kuom oganda Gad neginwangʼo Ramoth man Gilead, Mahanaim,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: to ne afwenyo ni gigo duto Nyasaye ema timo. Omiyo onge ngʼama ongʼeyo gigo matimore e piny. Kata dabed ni oketo chunye manade mar ngʼeyo tiendgi, to ok onyal ngʼeyo tiendgi. Bende kata ngʼama riek par ni ongʼeyo, to ok onyal winjo tiendgi maber.
english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noneno kaka richo dhano ogundho e piny kendo kaka paro duto mag chunye ne mana timo richo seche duto.
english: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

kikuyu: Neuru, asechako kelo masira kuom dala maduongʼ mondikie Nyinga, to adiera bende unyalo tony ne kum? Ok unutonyne kum nimar akelo ligangla kuom jogo modak e piny, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.’
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of Armies.”’

kikuyu: Nimar ungʼeyo ni kane owaru kuom ngimau manono mane kwereu machon owenu mondo ulu, to ne ok owaru gi gik makethore kaka fedha kata dhahabu,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

kikuyu: kendo an-gi geno kuom Nyasaye machalre gi jogi, ni nitie chier moikne joma beyo kod joma richo.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

kikuyu: To Yesu nongʼeyo gima negiparo eka nowacho ni ngʼatno mane lwete otal niya,“Aa malo kendo chungi e nyim ji duto.” Kamano noa malo mi ochungo kanyono.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

kikuyu: mondo ojare, mi ngʼudh olawo kuome kendo chwade mi nyaka ginege. To bangʼ ndalo adek obiro chier.”
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Omiyo koro sani kaw gigi mag lweny kaka atungʼ kod asere kendo idhi e thim ikelna ring le.
english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowachone niya, “Koro nyisa duongʼni.”
english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo gigi nobed mogak, kendo nyaka olwok lepe kendo olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Cham mag higa makadho manie decheu noromu chamo nyaka chop kinde ma ugologie oko mondo uyud thuolo mar rwako cham manyien.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

kikuyu: Mier ma umiyo jo-Lawi koa kuom piny ma jo-Israel okawo kaka pok margi nyaka pog matindo tindo kaka pok mar dhoot ka dhoot: Kawuru mier mangʼeny kuom dhoot man-gi mangʼeny, to kawuru manok kuom jogo man-gi manok.”
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

kikuyu: Rit puodho ma ji keyoe, kendo lu bangʼ joma nyiri. Asenyiso joma chwo ni kik gimuli. Kendo sa asaya ma riyo oloyie to dhi imodhi e dopige ma jogi osepongʼo gi pi.”
english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

kikuyu: Yesu nochiko jachiendno, mi nowuok oa kuom wuowino, kendo nochango kochakore sano.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni wiya owil kodi, yaye Jerusalem, to mad lweta ma korachwich wiye wil gi tichne.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu chiegni chopo Jeriko, ngʼat moro ma muofu noyudo obet e bath yo kakwecho.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Jomoko wacho ni in Johana ja-Batiso, to jomoko ni in Elija, to jomoko bende ni in Jeremia, kata achiel kuom jonabi.”
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Magi e romb ji mane oikore ne kedo mane obiro ir Daudi Hebron mondo okaw pinyruodh Saulo mane omiye mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho:
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Bende noiko yiend sida madongo ma ok kwan nikech jo-Sidon gi jo-Turo nokelone Daudi yiende mangʼeny mag sida.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

kikuyu: Enoka, mane odak e tiengʼ mar abiriyo bangʼ Adam, nokoro wach kuom jogi kowacho niya, “Neuru Ruoth biro gi oganda mangʼongo mar jomaler tara gi gana kuom tara gi gana
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

kikuyu: Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye wecheni emomiyo dhano ngima; chunya yudo ngima kuom wecheni. Iseduogona ngimana mi koro iyiena mondo adagi.
english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.

kikuyu: Ei masiche kod twech isebedo machiegni kode, iseriembogi mabor, mana ka gima yamo mager moa yo wuok chiengʼ ema terogi.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu onene konindo kanyo, kendo kane onyise ni osebedo kochal kamano kuom kinde marabora, nopenje niya, “Bende idwaro ni ochangi?”
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

kikuyu: Daudi nomako geche lweny alufu achiel gi joidh farese alufu abiriyo, to gi jolweny mawuotho gi tiendgi alufu piero ariyo. Nongʼado odond farese duto makmana farese mia achiel kuomgi ema noweyo.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

kikuyu: Chwo duto ma oseketho winjruokna kendo pod ok ochopo winjruok mane giloso e nyima, nakawgi ka nyaroya mane gingʼado nyadiriyo kendo giwuotho e kind lemogo.
english: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:

kikuyu: Nikech hero pesa e chakruok mar kit richo duto. Jomoko ma chunygi osegedo e yore mag yudo pesa oseweyo yie mi gichwowo chunygi giwegi gi masiche mathoth.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

kikuyu: Analawgi gi ligangla, kech kod masira kendo anami gibed joma bwogo gwenge duto manie piny kendo gir kwongʼ kod bwok, gima ok onego mi luor kendo ma jaricho, e dier ogendini duto mane aseriembogie.”
english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,

kikuyu: Kech ne kaye kendo nogombo chiemo mondo ocham, to kane pod iloso chiemo, ayula wangʼ notere.
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka rachungigo nolosi: Nosirgi gi bao koa piny nyaka malo.
english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mane ochungʼ e raidhi kaywak matek ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi ne gin, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebania, Buni, Sherebia, Bani kod Kenani.
english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Azaria wuod Hoshaya gi Johanan wuod Karea kod chwo ma jo-jendeke duto nowachone Jeremia niya, “Iriambo! Jehova Nyasaye Nyasachwa pok oori mondo iwachnwa ni, ‘Kik udhi Misri mondo udag kuno.’
english: then Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely. The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You shall not go into Egypt to live there;’

kikuyu: To e wiye malo nokete kite ma nengogi tek mopa kaka owinjore kendo noriwie bape sida.
english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Nyasach jo-Hibrania oseromo kodwa. Omiyo koro yie iwe wadhi e thim kama kawo e wuodh ndalo adek mondo wachiw misengini ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, nono to dipo ka okelonwa masiche kata tho.”
english: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”

kikuyu: Eka Boaz nolando ne jodongo gi ji duto kowacho niya, “Kawuono udoko joneno ka angʼiewo kuom Naomi mwandu duto mag Elimelek gi Kilion kod Malon.
english: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.

kikuyu: Sirnige noloso gi fedha, to pinyne noloso gi dhahabu, kombene ne olicho gi nanga maralik, dier iye to nyi Jerusalem noumo gihera mogundho.
english: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Kata obedo ni atimo nenda awuon to nenda pod en mana adier nimar angʼeyo kuma ne aaye gi kuma adhiye. Un to ukia kuma aaye kata kuma adhiye.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Angʼo momiyo uywakna? Nyis jo-Israel mondo odhi nyime giwuoth.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

kikuyu: Rwath gi diel mane otimgo misengini mag golo richo, kendo ma rembgi noseter ei Kama Ler Moloyo mar pwodho richo, nyaka gol ring-gi gi piendegi kod wen mag-gi oko mar kambi, mondo owangʼ-gi pep.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

kikuyu: Jakobo nohero Rael, kendo nowacho ni Laban niya, “Abiro tiyoni kuom higni abiriyo kuom Rael nyari matin.”
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

kikuyu: Omiyo yawuotgi mane onywol bangʼe ka gin e thim ema ne Joshua otero nyangu. Ne pod ok otergi nyangu nikech ne oyudo kapod giwuotho e thim.
english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

kikuyu: Negilokona ngʼegi ma ok wengegi; kata obedo ni apuonjogi kendo amedo puonjogi, ne ok ginyal chiko itgi kata luwo puonjna.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi to ne gin: Jeshua, Binui, Kadmiel, Sherebia, Juda, kod Matania ma bende notelo ne weche mag goyo erokamano kaachiel gi jotich kode.
english: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, biro kelo tuo kuom jolwenj Asuria marateke; kendo tuo norew ringregi ka mach.
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

kikuyu: Roho Maler bende wuoyonwa kuom wechegi. Mokwongo owacho niya:
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

kikuyu: Eka owadgi mane otwe usi e ngʼut lwete nowuok mi nochake nying ni Zera.
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

kikuyu: to kata kamano utamoru biro ira mondo uyud ngima.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Pamuru lweteu, un ogendini duto; Pakuru Nyasaye ka ukok matek gi mor.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

kikuyu: Aserni ok mi oringi; orujre chalone mana ka chungʼ bel.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat marieyo ja-ajara luongo mana wichkuot, ngʼat makwero ngʼat marach yudo mana ayany.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

kikuyu: Gima dhano dwaro en hera ma ok rum, ber bedo jachan moloyo bedo ja-miriambo.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

kikuyu: Kendo pinje duto nobiro Misri mondo ongʼiew chiemo kuom Josef, nikech kech ne ngʼeny ahinya e piny mangima.
english: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

kikuyu: To Paulo nodwoke niya, “Ok an janeko, Ruoth Festo. Gima awacho en adier kendo winjore maber.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

kikuyu: nikech ka waserwakore kode, to ok bi yudwa duk.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

kikuyu: Oparo singruokne nyaka chiengʼ, weche mane osingo e tienge tara,
english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: Bedo e bwo bor polono kendo ngʼado nam makwarno ema nokwan ka batiso mane omiyo gibetie achiel gi Musa.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: Kik giwe chiemogo machop okinyi bende kik gitur choke rombono. E kinde ma gitimo nyasi mar Pasaka nyaka gine ni giluwo chike duto.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

kikuyu: “Eka jaduongʼ nowachone jatichne ni, ‘Wuogi idhiyo oko e akek yore makalo e kind mier kendo luong ji duto mondo gidonji, eka oda opongʼ.
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nooro Nathan ir Daudi. Kane ochopo ire nowachone niya, “Ne nitie ji ariyo moko e dala moro; achiel ne jamoko to machielo nodhier.
english: The LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

kikuyu: Nyaka ubed motangʼ kurito buche, weche, chike kod puonj duto mane omiyou. Kik ulam nyiseche mamoko.
english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

kikuyu: “Udo kwadho bwombene gi mor, to ok onyal huyo moloyo magungu kod nyamnaha.
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano jadolo noliergi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo; kaachiel gi agoko kod em mane olier nimar gin gik mopwodhi kendo gin mek jadolo. Bangʼ timo kamano, ja-Nazir koro nyalo mana madho divai.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

kikuyu: Kaonge ngʼama oyie rwakou kata winjo wecheu, to tengʼuru buru momoko e tiendeu sa ma uwuok e odno kata e dalano.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

kikuyu: Azaria nonywolo Amaria, to Amaria nonywolo Ahitub,
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: koparo e chunye niya, “Kata ka anyalo mulo mana riak lawe to abiro chango.”
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Odiechiengno Jehova Nyasaye biro chielo joma odak Jerusalem mondo joma nyap mogik e diergi ochal gi Daudi, kendo joka Daudi nochal kaka Nyasaye, ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye otelonegi.
english: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “To kata bende e ndalogo, ok anatieku chuth.
english: “But even in those days,” says the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.

kikuyu: Achiegni olo mirimba mager kuomu kendo abiro toyo mirimba kuomu. Abiro ngʼadonu bura kaluwore gi yoreu kendo abiro chulou kaluwore gi timbeu duto mamono.
english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

kikuyu: Nimar wan e bwo chik mar kar dak ruoth kendo ok en gima ber mondo wane ka ruoth ichayo, waoro wachni mondo onyis ruoth,
english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

kikuyu: Zekaria wuod Meshelemia ne jarit rangach madonjo e Hemb Romo.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ezra noelo kitabuno kendo ji duto ne nyalo nene nikech nochungʼ kama otingʼore gi malo moyombogi; to kane oele, ji duto nochungʼ malo.
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

kikuyu: Teko mar jolweny e miech Israel norumo, manyaka an Debora nabiro, ma abedo ka min ji e piny Israel.
english: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.

kikuyu: Omiyo negipogo piny mane gi dhi wuothoe, ka Ahab ochomo konchiel to Obadia ochomo komachielo.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

kikuyu: Aywagi malit, Jonathan omera; ne ageni ahinya. Herani koda ne lich miwuoro, moloyo hera mar mon.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama noloyi e ndalo duto mar ngimani. Kaka ne an kod Musa, bende e kaka abiro bedo kodi; ok anaweyi kata jwangʼi.
english: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

kikuyu: Obadho osemako ombongʼne; kendo oride matek ma ok onyal bwodho.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

kikuyu: Kik ijwangʼ osiepni kod osiep wuonu, to kik idhi e od owadu ka chandruok omaki, ber dhi ir jabuti machiegni moloyo owadu man mabor.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

kikuyu: Ne awacho ni, ‘Oseriemba e wangʼi; to kata kamano, pod abiro siko ka angʼiyo hekalu mari maler.’
english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

kikuyu: Kendo Daudi nomedo bedo gi teko ahinya, nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ne ni kode.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

kikuyu: Kendo Abisalom nomedo wacho niya, “Ka dine yiera mondo abed jangʼad bura e piny, to ngʼato angʼata man-gi ywak kata wach moro, nyalo biro ira kendo anyalo neno ni ongʼadne bura mowinjore.”
english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

kikuyu: nikech ne omiyo piny obet ewi nembe kendo noguro misene ewi pige.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

kikuyu: To ka wageno gima pod waongego to warito gino gi kinda.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

kikuyu: Un joma timo gik maricho, uketho chenro joma odhier, to Jehova Nyasaye e kar pondo margi.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼiye kendo nowachone niya, “Mano kaka en gima tek mondo jomoko odonji e pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: kendo kanyo ema Ibrahim nowachonegi niya, “Sara en nyaminwa.” Eka Abimelek ruodh Gerar nooro joote moomone Sara kendo nokawe kaka chiege.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

kikuyu: Igi nowangʼ gi Jeremia kendo negikete ogoye kendo otweye e od Jonathan ma jagoro, mane giloso obedo od twech.
english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

kikuyu: Eka Farao nogolo chik ne joge mondo ogol Abram, chiege gi gige duto kendo gikowogi oko mar pinyno.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

kikuyu: ma dimi odag nyaka chiengʼ kendo kik odhi e liel.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Joshua noluongo jo-Israel gi dhoutgi, kendo Juda noyier.
english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

kikuyu: Weche mag dho ngʼato tut ka nam, to soko mar rieko en aora mabubni kamol.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato omiyo wadgi fedha kata mwandu mondo okanne kendo okwalgi e od wadgino, to ka omak jakuogno, to nyaka chul nyadiriyo.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Kik uwuondru uwegi, kuparo ni, ‘Jo-Babulon gadiera biro weyowa.’ Ok giniweu ngangʼ!
english: “The LORD says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.

kikuyu: Nomedo wachona ni, Daniel, kik iluor. Odiechiengʼ mane ichake keto chunyi mar winjo tiend wachni, kendo kane ibolori e nyim Nyasachi, ema wechegi ne owinjie, kendo koro asebiro mondo akelni dwoko margi.
english: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi nigi thuolo kinde duto mar waro utegi manie miechgi.
english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

kikuyu: “Neuru, aoro malaika nyimu mondo oritu e yo kendo mondo okelu kama aseikonu.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

kikuyu: Abiro dhialo Jehova Nyasaye malich gi dhoga; abiro pake e dier oganda maduongʼ.
english: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

kikuyu: ee, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho kuom gigo mane odongʼ e od Jehova Nyasaye kendo e kar dak mar ruodh Juda kod e Jerusalem:
english: yes, the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in the LORD’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

kikuyu: kendo mondo uher Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kuwinjo wechene kendo kuketo chunyu kuome. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye e ngimau, kendo obiro miyou higni mangʼeny e piny mane osesingore ne kwereu Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo.
english: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nochierowa gi Kristo, momiyo wabet kode e duongʼ mar polo ei Kristo Yesu,
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Mar Daudi. Ngʼayi onge e chunya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wangʼa bende ok tek; chunya ok chandre gi gik madongo, kata gi weche matek modhiera ngʼeyo.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

kikuyu: Bende walamo kamano mondo udag e ngima ma Ruoth morgo, ka umiye mor e yore duto, kendo unyago olemo mag timbe mabeyo bende ka umedo bedo gi ngʼeyo Nyasaye.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

kikuyu: “Nitie gik moko adek mateto piny, to kuom gik moko angʼwen piny ok nyal yiego:
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

kikuyu: “To bende Nyasaye nyalo dak e piny kod ji? Kata polo malo kata polo mabor ok nyal romi, to koro hekalu mageroni to diromi nade!
english: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

kikuyu: To ok anyal hedhora mar wacho gimoro amora, makmana gigo ma Kristo osetimo kotiyo koda kuom loko joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo oluor Nyasaye, kuom wechena gi timbena,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

kikuyu: Odwoko ruodhi piny kendo omiyo jotelo duto mag pinyni bet kanono.
english: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Angʼo mondiki e chik? Isome nade?”
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

kikuyu: Jadolo nochiwgi ka wangʼogi ewi kendo mar misango, mondo obed misango miwangʼo gi mach ni Jehova Nyasaye, nikech en misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Hur ne onywolo Uri, to Uri ne onywolo Bezalel.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

kikuyu: Ka koro ne gichiegni chopo Jerusalem, bangʼ chopo Bethfage manie Got Zeituni, Yesu nooro jopuonjrene ariyo,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

kikuyu: ni ne uketho ketho malich kane uora ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo uwacho ni, ‘Lamnwa Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa; nyiswa gik moko duto mowacho kendo wanatim kamano.’
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to the LORD our God; and according to all that the LORD our God says, so declare to us, and we will do it.’

kikuyu: An ema ne achweyo piny kendo ne achweyo dhano e iye. Ne achweyo polo malach gi lweta awuon, kendo an ema ne aketo gik moko duto manie kor polo.
english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

kikuyu: Mad nyithinde dongʼ kiye kendo chiege dongʼ dhako ma chwore otho.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ne ok owinjo Balaam mine omiyo kwongʼno olokore gweth ne un nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oherou.
english: Nevertheless the LORD your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.

kikuyu: En jahawi ngʼat mawinja, marito pile e dhoutena korito e dhorangaya.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

kikuyu: Ne onge konyruok mane Onesimo keloni to sani koro okelo konyruok maduongʼ ne in kaachiel kod an bende.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

kikuyu: Ji nowuok odhi ire koa Jerusalem gi Judea duto koda ka gwengʼ Jordan duto.
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

kikuyu: “Piyo piyo nono noyieyo pi piny mi owacho ni, ‘Modhi kendo abiro miyo ngamia magi bende pi.’ Kuom mano namodho, kendo ngamia bende nomodho.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

kikuyu: Otingʼo joma odhier malo kogolo piny e lowo; adier, ogolo joma ochando e pidh buru,
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

kikuyu: Godhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, jopuonjre nochokore kanyakla, kendo ne giloro dhoudi nikech negiluoro jo-Yahudi, Yesu nobiro mochungʼ e diergi kendo nowachonegi niya, “Kwe obed kodu!”
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni ringreu en hekalu mar Roho Maler modak eiu kendo ma Nyasaye osechiwonu? Ok un mau uwegi;
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

kikuyu: An Paulo jaote Kristo Yesu kaluwore gi Chik Nyasaye ma Jawarwa, kod Kristo Yesu, ma en genowa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

kikuyu: Kik wawuondre kendwa wawegi, ka wasiko mana ka wakwinyore kendo wagombo gige jowadwa.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

kikuyu: Neye kaka mach osewuok e polo motieko jotend jolweny ariyo motelona kod ji mane gin-go duto. To koro sani yie ibedie gi ngʼwono ne ngimana!”
english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

kikuyu: Wach mowach e kinde mowinjore, chalo gi olemo mar dhahabu moketie tawo molos gi fedha.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

kikuyu: Miuru ji duto gik makorgi monego umigi kaka: Joma onego chul osuru; chuluru osuru; joma juogo chuluru pesa jwok; joma onego uluor, miuru luor, kendo joma onego umi duongʼ, miuru duongʼ.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

kikuyu: “Ne kaka oger pidhe madongo but dala maduongʼ mondo gimonje kendo gikawe. Nikech ligangla, kech kod masiche, dala maduongʼ nochiwne jo-Babulon ma monje. Gima ne iwacho osetimore kaka koro inene.
english: “Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.

kikuyu: Magi e weche Amos mane en achiel kuom jokwath mane odak Tekoa. Wechegi ne oneno kuom Israel higni ariyo kane piny pok oyiengni, kendo e kindeno Uzia ema ne ruodh Juda, to Jeroboam ma wuod Joash to ne ruodh Israel.
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

kikuyu: Kane jolweny koro chiegni donjo gi Paulo kama gidakie, nokwayo jatendgi kowacho niya, “Yiena mondo awachni wach moro.” Jatend jolweny nodwoke kapenje niya, “Kare ingʼeyo dho jo-Yunani?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

kikuyu: Ka an gi mich mar koro wach, kendo ka angʼeyo tiend weche matek duto modhiero ji ngʼeyo, kendo an gi rieko duto, kata ka an gi yie maduongʼ manyalo golo gode kuonde ma gintie, to ka aonge gihera; to ok an gimoro.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

kikuyu: kendo ngʼato angʼata ma ok kaw msalape mondo oluwa ok owinjore koda.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat wuod Parua norito Isakar;
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

kikuyu: mane ogwelogi e chiwo misengini ne nyisechegi. Ji nochiemo moyiengʼ kendo negipodho auma ka gilamo nyisechegi.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

kikuyu: Iye nowangʼ bende gi osiepe Ayub adek nikech negisiko mana ka gingʼado ne Ayub bura, to kata obedo nine oonge ketho.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

kikuyu: Lerno rieny ei mudho, to mudho pok oime.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi joloch mane nigi dhahabu, kendo mane opongʼo utegi gi fedha.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

kikuyu: Kane Azaria jadolo maduongʼ gi jodolo duto norange, negineno ni en kod dhoho e lela wangʼe mine gigole oko mapiyo. To en owuon bende noreto mapiyo mondo owuogi nikech Jehova Nyasaye nosechwade.
english: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because the LORD had struck him.

kikuyu: to ka Nyasaye nongʼado bura ni Sodom gi Gomora mine owangʼo joma odakie miergo molokore buru, kendo mi oketogi ranyisi mar gima biro timore ne joma ochayo Nyasaye;
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

kikuyu: Jo-Juda duto nobiro kaachiel mondo gikwa Jehova Nyasaye kony, adier negia e mier mag Juda duto mondo gidwar wangʼe.
english: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from the LORD. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD.

kikuyu: Obal, Abimael, gi Sheba
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: Ginitim kamano nikech ok gingʼeyo Wuora kata An.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo mar loch Jeroboam ruodh Israel, Asa nobedo ruodh Juda,
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny temo mondo oyud pwoch kuom ruoth, to ngʼato ka ngʼato bedo osiep ngʼat machiwo mich.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

kikuyu: Kane Rehoboam ochopo Jerusalem nochoko dhood Juda gi dhood Benjamin, chwo maromo alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro kendo gidhi giked gi jo-Israel mondo gidwok loch ni Rehoboam.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth owinjo weche dhakono noyiecho lepe. Wachni notimore ka ruoth ne wuotho ewi ohinga, mi ji nongʼiye, moneno korwako pien gugru ei lepe.
english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

kikuyu: To kuom adiera uhero jowete duto man e miech Makedonia duto. Kata kamano wakwayou, jowetewa, mondo umed timo kamano moloyo mano.
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Angʼeyo mirimbe to oonge tiende, kendo ngʼayi mage ok nyal gimoro.
english: I know his wrath,” says the LORD, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

kikuyu: Negichikone obadho e Jerusalem mi oringo odhi Lakish, to negioro ji bangʼe Lakish ma onege kuno.
english: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nogoyo jo-Beth Shemesh moko, monego ji piero abiriyo nikech negingʼiyo ii Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ji noywak malit nikech sand mane Jehova Nyasaye osekelonegi,
english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into the LORD’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter.

kikuyu: Moloyo mano, jochiende nowuok oa kuom ji mangʼeny, ka goyo koko niya, “In e Wuod Nyasaye!” To nokwerogi kendo ne ok oyiene jochiendego mondo owuo nikech negingʼeyo ni en e Kristo.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

kikuyu: Gehazi notelonigi moriwo ludhno e lela wangʼ nyathi, to ne ok chunye odwogo. Omiyo Gehazi nodok ir Elisha mowachone niya, “Wuowi pok ochier.”
english: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

kikuyu: Eka wengegi noyawore kendo negingʼeye, to nolal mowuok oa e wangʼ-gi.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok dwar wadgi mobutone kokiye kendo mi otho bangʼe oringo kodhi e mier madongo mag tonygi,
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Ne awacho ni abiro keyogi kendo nying-gi ok nopar e kind ogendini,
english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi machwo ma jo-higni piero adek kata moloyo kanyo nokwan, ne gin ji alufu piero adek gaboro.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

kikuyu: Debora nowachone niya, “Mano kare, abiro dhi kodi. To nikech yo ma itimoe gini duongʼ, ok nobed mari, nimar Jehova Nyasaye nochiw Sisera ne dhako.” Omiyo Debora nodhi gi Barak nyaka Kedesh,
english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

kikuyu: Wan to ok dwapakre mokalo tongʼwa, en tongʼ ma Nyasaye owuon ema noketonwa kaluwore gi tichne, kendo un bende un ei tongʼno.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

kikuyu: “Un gode, winjuru wach ma Jehova Nyasaye nigo kodu, chikuru itu un mise mochwere mag piny. Nikech Jehova Nyasaye nigi wach kod joge; en gi bura gi jo-Israel.
english: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

kikuyu: Obiro neno makne kapod ndalone oromo, kendo bedene ok bi siko ka ngʼich.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowacho niya, “Yie iwe Abishag nyar Shunam mondo okend gi owadu Adonija.”
english: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”

kikuyu: Ok asewuoyo kama opondo, kata kama otimo mudho; ok asewachone nyikwa Jakobo ni, ‘Manyauru kayiem nono.’ An, Jehova Nyasaye, awacho adiera; awacho gima kare.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

kikuyu: Kane joote odwogo ir ruoth nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo udwogo?”
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

kikuyu: Huluru duongʼne e kind ogendini kendo landuru tijene miwuoro ne ji duto.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Koro Timotheo osedwogo koa iru, kendo osekelonwa weche mabeyo kuom yieu kod herau. Osenyisowa kaka usiko uparowa gi paro mabeyo kendo ni un bende ugombo nenowa mana kaka wan bende wagombo nenou.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ni chikeni nikare, kendo angʼeyo ni chwat misechwadago nikare.
english: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

kikuyu: Zakur, Sherebia, Shebania,
english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

kikuyu: Beth Makaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biro kod Sharaim. Magi ne miechgi nyaka chop kinde loch Daudi.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

kikuyu: Gin gi dhogi, to kata kamano, ok ginyal wuoyo, gin gi wenge, to ok ginyal neno.
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ne nitie kanyo ma nyinge Zakayo; ne en jasol osuru maduongʼ kendo ne en ja-mwandu.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

kikuyu: “To ka pod uwacho ni, ‘Yore mag Ruoth Nyasaye ok nikare.’ To winjuru, yaye dhood Israel: Bende yorena ok nikare adier? Donge yoreu ema ok nikare?
english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

kikuyu: To dichwo mosengʼado wach e pache owuon, kendo manyalo chiko dwache maonge ngʼama ochune, koseneno e chunye ni ok odwar nyuomo nyakono, en bende otimo maber.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Moab nobedo e bwo loch Israel, kendo piny nobedo gi kwe kuom higni piero aboro.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

kikuyu: kama “ ‘kute machamo ji ok thoe, kendo mach bende ok thoe.’
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: ka ondiko mwandune ne yawuote kik okaw ratiro mar wuowi makayo omi wuod dhako moherono.
english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ywak mi ywaknego Sodom gi Gomora duongʼ kendo richogi ngʼeny,
english: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni ariyo, kane jongʼad yie romb Abisalom ni Baal Hazor machiegni gi tongʼ Efraim, noluongo yawuot ruoth duto mondo obi kanyo.
english: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

kikuyu: Pokne en chwat kod wichkuot kendo nobed gi wichkuot ma ok norum.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

kikuyu: Weche mabeyo mawuok e dho ngʼato miyo obedo gi gik mabeyo, adiera, tich mar lwete kelone konyruok.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

kikuyu: Ka debed ni ok waseketho kinde, dine wasedhi ma waduogo diriyo.”
english: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”

kikuyu: Osegolo ruodhi e kombegi to osetingʼo malo joma muol.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

kikuyu: Nokedo gi chir moloyo jo-Amalek, moreso jo-Israel oa e lwet joma nosebet ka yako gigegi.
english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

kikuyu: Gigi duto nobednu makwero kendo ngʼato angʼata ma omulogi ka gisetho nobed mogak nyaka chop seche mag odhiambo.
english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: To kuom bungu maliel, Musa nonyiso bende ni joma otho chier, nimar oluongo Ruoth Nyasaye ni, ‘Nyasach Ibrahim, kendo Nyasach Isaka kod Nyasach Jakobo.’
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

kikuyu: mane otamore winjo Nyasaye chon gi lala kane Nyasaye orito amingʼa e kinde mane Nowa hondhoe yie. Ji manok kende maromo ji aboro, ema ne okwo kokalo e pi e yieno.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

kikuyu: eka iniyud yie rombe milosgo lewni, kendo iningʼiew lowo gi pesa miyudo kuom diek.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kikuyu: Piny ok nyal chayou, to an to piny ochaya nikech ahulo ni gik motimo richo.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

kikuyu: Eka thuol mangʼongono ne okecho gi dhakono, nodhi mondo oked gi nyithind dhakono modongʼ, morito chike Nyasaye kendo osiko motegno kahulo wach Yesu.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

kikuyu: Okiyo ji kokichore ka sibuor mopondo; okichore mar mako joma ok nyal mondo ohinygi, omako joma ok nyal kendo oywayogi oko gi tonde mar meko.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

kikuyu: To ngʼato ka ngʼato maluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye noresi!’”
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

kikuyu: lela wangʼ achiel mochomo yiend othith konchiel ne en lela wangʼ dhano, to lela wangʼ machielo mochomo yiend othith komachielo ne en lela wangʼ sibuor. Mano e kaka hekalu duto nogor.
english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

kikuyu: Omiyo nyi Zelofehad notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosemiyo Musa chik.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:

kikuyu: Nikech chiengʼ maduongʼ mar mirimb Nyasaye osechopo, to en ngʼama nyalo chungʼ mondo osire.”
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

kikuyu: Bende jo-Rumi nogoya gi ludhe nyadidek, kendo ne gichiela gi kite dichiel. Yie ne obarore koda e nam nyadidek, kendo chiengʼ moro ne ariyo e dier nam otieno godiechiengʼ.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne awuoyo gi ji gokinyi, to godhiambono chiega notho. Kinyne gokinyi ne atimo kaka ne osechika mondo atim.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

kikuyu: Negituro chumbe modol odol gi tindogi kod nyundogi.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

kikuyu: Nopenjo Harun niya, “Angʼo mane jogi otimoni momiyo irwakogi e richo maduongʼ kamano?”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

kikuyu: Elisha nodwoke niya, “Dhi iwachne ni, ‘Kuom adier obiro chango.’ To kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye osenyisa ni obiro tho bangʼe.”
english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die.”

kikuyu: Nowacho kamano nikech jogi ne wuoyo kawacho niya, “En gi jachien marach.”
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat matiyo e puothe biro bedo gi chiemo mogundho, to ngʼat mabayo abaya biro bedo jachan mochwere.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

kikuyu: Nimar nitie joneno adek, ma gin:
english: For there are three who testify:

kikuyu: Joma ochier e chier mokwongoni gin joma ogwedhi kendo mopwodhi. Tho mar ariyo onge gi teko kuomgi, to ginibed jodolo mag Nyasaye kod mag Kristo kendo giniloch kode kuom higni alufu achiel.
english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

kikuyu: Teko mar kethruok chopo tijgi ei dala maduongʼ, mecho gi wuond osiko e yorene.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

kikuyu: Obiro loko lewgi mi gogi gin giwegi mi otiekgi chuth; ji duto monenogi biro kino wigi gi wuoro.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

kikuyu: Ne giwangʼo iye gi kuondegi motingʼore malo, kendo ne gichiewo nyiego mare gi nyisechegi mane giloso.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

kikuyu: “Mach nowuok Heshbon, en mach makakni moa e dala maduongʼ mar Sihon. Nowangʼo Ar man Moab, ma gin jokanyo mag kuonde motingʼore malo mag Arnon.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

kikuyu: Mach nyaka sik kaliel e kendo mar misango ma ok tho.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

kikuyu: “Bende en gima ber adier ka un uwegi udakie uteu mugero mabeyo, to hekalu marani to omukore machal kama?”
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

kikuyu: Bende noloso gik moko ariyo machalo agulni mag mula mondo oketi ewi sirni. Bor mar moro ka moro ne romo fut apar gauchiel.
english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

kikuyu: nyikwa Nebo, ji piero abich gariyo (52),
english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

kikuyu: kod mor pwodhruok gi ubani madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mar Kama Ler. “Nyaka gilose mana kaka nachiki.”
