english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

kikuyu: Eka Abimelek nobiro ire koa Gerar, ka gin gi Ahuzath jangʼadne rieko kod Fikol ma jatend jolwenje.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

kikuyu: “Asewinjo weche machal kamago mathoth; un duto un johocho ma chunygi odhier mogik!
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

kikuyu: ka en koda kuonde duto kendo ka lerne ne menyona kuonde motimo mudho mane awuothe!
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

kikuyu: kwajiwou kendo wahoyou kendo wasiemou mondo kit ngimau mapile obed malongʼo ne Nyasaye moseluongou e pinyruodhe kod duongʼ mare.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nochiwe ni Jehova Nyasaye mondo opwodhgo dhakono, kendo dhakono nodok maler kuom rembe mosechwer. “ ‘Magi e chike momako dhako monywolo nyathi ma wuowi kata ma nyako.
english: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

kikuyu: Jamni duto mag Kedar nochokni, imbe mag Nebayoth nobed mitimogo misango; ginibed gigo mitimonago misango e kendona mar misango, mi duongʼ maler mar hekalu mara nenre.
english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

kikuyu: Nopuonjo e sinagokegi, kendo ji duto nopake.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

kikuyu: adier asegeroni hekalu marahuma kama inidagie nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo ir jopuonjre mamoko, negineno oganda maduongʼ kolworogi kendo ka jopuonj Chik mino kodgi wach.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

kikuyu: “E odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar abiriyo nobednu Chiengʼ Pwodhruok. Beduru gi chokruok maler ka uriyo kech, kendo uchiw ni Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka Daudi nowinjo mano nooro Joab gi jolweny duto ma jokedo.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

kikuyu: ma Jehova Nyasaye osekawo ka oganda mar jo-Israel neno en piny man-gi lek maber mar pidho jamni kendo ungʼeyo ni wan jotichu wan jopidh jamni.
english: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Wer mower kaluwore gi Gitith. Mar Asaf. Weruru matek gi mor ne Nyasaye mamiyowa teko, gouru koko matek ne Nyasach Jakobo!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

kikuyu: Ne uuso jo-Juda gi Jerusalem ne jo-Yunani, eka utergi mabor gi pinygi mane onywolgie.
english: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.

kikuyu: Magi e nying nyithindo mane onywolo ka en Jerusalem: Shamua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kor wach kiwacho kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech negimonjo pinyu ma giketho kuonde duto mage mine udongʼ maonge nyalo e kind ogendini mamoko, kane gijarou kendo giwuoyo kuomu marach,
english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone Daniel niya, “Adier, Nyasachi en Nyasach nyiseche, kendo en Ruoth mar ruodhi, kendo en Jal maelo tiend midhierni, nikech ne in gi nyalo mar elona tiend midhieroni.”
english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

kikuyu: Petro nomedo wachonegi niya, “Un jo-Israel, winjuru wachni: Yesu ja-Nazareth ne Nyasaye ochungo e dieru kaka ngʼat mowinjore miyo luor. Nyasaye notimo honni gi gik malich miwuoro kod ranyisi madongo e dieru kokalo kuome, mana kaka un uwegi ungʼeyo maber.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

kikuyu: Joka Josef nochal gi rwath makayo, tungene nochal mana ka tung jowi manie thim, ma obiro chuowogo ogendini moriembgi nyaka tunge piny duto. Tungego gin ji alufu apar mag Efraim kod ji alufu apar mag jo-Manase.
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno matemo reso ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼatno mowito ngimane, nores ngimane.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kikuyu: Nowa ne nigi yawuowi adek: Shem, Ham kod Jafeth.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Piny Jazer, mier matindo duto mag Gilead kod nus mar jo-Amon mochopo Aroer machiegni gi Raba;
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

kikuyu: Girkeni mane Musa omiyo nus mar dhood Manase, tiende ni, nus mar nyikwa Manase, kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola.
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

kikuyu: to Jal ma Nyasaye nochiero oa kuom joma otho to ringre ne ok otowo.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

kikuyu: mi Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dhiyo kendo isiem ji mondo kik girire ni gidwaro neno Jehova Nyasaye nimar thothgi nyalo tho.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

kikuyu: Eka Mika noketo ja-Lawino kendo wuowino nobedo jadolone kendo nodak e ode.
english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro chiwou kaka gima oyaki ni ogendini. Abiro ngʼado karu oko e dier ogendini kendo abiro tiekou mi ulal ua e piny. Abiro kethou, kendo ubiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼno nduru ma ji nogo Jerusalem nobed malich, mana ka nduch Hadad Rimon e paw Megido.
english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

kikuyu: Obiro chomo ohinga magi gi lodi mage madongo mag muko gik moko, mi omuk kuondegi motingʼore gi malo gi gige mag lweny.
english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech wecheu mag miriambo kod weche mukoro mag wuond, akwedou.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Nokok gi dwol maduongʼ ni, ‘Tongʼ yien-no oko kendo lwer bedene kod obokene kendo iwit olembene mabor. Le duto modak e tipone kod winy mogedo e bedene mondo oringi.
english: He cried aloud and said this: ‘Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches! Shake off its leaves and scatter its fruit! Let the animals get away from under it and the birds from its branches.

kikuyu: To hekalu mane owuoyo kuome ne en ringre.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo ngʼatno niya, “Angʼo midwaro mondo atimni?” To muofuno nodwoke niya, “Japuonj, adwaro ni mondo anen.”
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: okwayo Nyasaye kolamo kar ngʼama chielo mana kaka ngʼato nyalo kwechone osiepne.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

kikuyu: Nikech Chik duto ichopo kare mana gi chik achiel mawacho niya, “Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.”
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kamano e kaka dhood Israel biro chamo chiemo mogak e dier ogendini kuma abiro terogie twech.”
english: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

kikuyu: kendo ni nyaka giyal wachni mi gilande e miechgi matindo kod e Jerusalem niya, “Wuoguru udhi e pinje mag gode kendo ukel bede moaye yadh zeituni kod yiende mag bungu mag zeituni, kendo koa e yiend madat, kor yiend othith kod yiende man-gi tipo, mondo losgo kambi,” mana kaka ondiki.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

kikuyu: (Ma ne en bangʼ ka Ruoth Jehoyakin kod min ruoth, jotelo mag agola kod jotend Juda gi Jerusalem, jopecho gi jogoro osedhi e twech koa Jerusalem.)
english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),

kikuyu: Eka Satan notere nyaka dala maduongʼ maler, kendo nomiyo ochungo e osuch hekalu malo mogik.
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

kikuyu: Kinyne Nyasaye nochiwo thuolo ne roho marach mobiro gi teko modonjo kuom Saulo. Noyudo okoro wach e ode, ka Daudi to ne goyo nyatiti kaka ne ojagoyo pile. Saulo ne nigi tongʼ e lwete
english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

kikuyu: ‘Kornelio, lemoni kod timbene mag ngʼwono mikonyogo joma odhier osechopo e nyim Nyasaye, omiyo osepari.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Abner nongʼiyo chien mopenjo niya, “Mano in, Asahel?” Modwoko niya, “Ee en an.”
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

kikuyu: Magi e yawuowi mane Lea onywolo ne Jakobo e piny mar Padan Aram, ka ok okwan Dina nyare. Yawuote kod nyige duto ne piero adek gadek.
english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

kikuyu: Mane kuom gigi duto mokia ni lwet Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo ma?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

kikuyu: Kinyne bangʼ Pasaka, mana godiechiengno, negichamo bath nyak mar piny kaka, makati ma ok oketie thowi gi chamb abula.
english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

kikuyu: Zedekia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gachiel kane obedo ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kuom higni apar gachiel kodak Jerusalem.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nyiero mar ngʼama ofuwo onge tiende omiyo ochalo mana gi kudho mararni e mach e bwo agulu. Ma bende onge tiende.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto nobiro Hebron ir Daudi ma giwacho niya, “Wan ogandani kendo wan remo achiel.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: Yesu nowuok modhi malo e bath got kendo nogwelo joma ne odwaro mondo odhi kode, mi jogo nodhi kode.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

kikuyu: to yie to koro nosechopo kama ochwalore koa e dho nam, kendo apaka ne tage koni gi koni, nikech yamo ne kedo kodgi.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

kikuyu: Debora, ma japit Rebeka notho kendo noyike e tiend yiend ober machiegni gi Bethel. Kuom mano nochak kanyo ni Allon Bakuth.
english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

kikuyu: Isaka nobwok matek ahinya kendo owacho niya, “To kara macha ne en ngʼa, mane onego le kendo okelona? Nende achamo ringʼono kapok ibiro kendo agwedhe; kendo kuom adier asegwedhe.”
english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Ne nitiere lweny ma ok rum e kind Rehoboam gi Jeroboam.
english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

kikuyu: Wuoguru Babulon, ringuru ua ir jo-Babulon! Landuru wachni kendo unyis ji duto ka ugoyo koko gimor. Landuru wachni e tungʼ piny niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osereso jotichne ma joka Jakobo.”
english: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!”

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye! Resa, yaye Nyasacha! Tur chok lemb wasika duto; Muk leke joma timbegi richo.
english: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Koro ere gima udwaro? Udwaro ni mondo abi iru katingʼo boka, koso abi gihera kod chuny mamuol?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

kikuyu: Fweny mane aneno ne chalo gi fweny mamoko mane oyudo aseneno kane obiro ketho dala maduongʼ kendo ka fweny mane aseneno e bath Aora Kebar, kendo ne apodho piny auma.
english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

kikuyu: Aserni mabitho mondo ochwo chunje mag wasik ruoth; ogendini mondo opodh piny e bwoyi.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

kikuyu: Nikech ne owinjo dwond tungʼ to ok odewo, rembe nobed e wiye owuon. To ka dine owinj siem, to dine oreso ngimane.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

kikuyu: Bidhruok mar joma kare telonegi, to joma ok jo-adiera kethore gi timbegi mag achach.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

kikuyu: Negikelo jogi mi joote oyieyo lwetgi kuomgi kendo olamonegi.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

kikuyu: Chom tongʼ ma dhoge bith mar kedo ibwog-go joma lawa. Wuo gi chunya kiwachone niya, “An e warruokni.”
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Ywak mar luoro winjore, en bwok malich, to ok kwe.
english: For the LORD says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.

kikuyu: Ka ok mano to en angʼo mane udhi mondo une? Ne udhi neno ngʼat morwakore gi lewni mabeyo koso? Ooyo, jogo marwakore gi lewni mabeyo iyudo mana e ute ruodhi.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik uparru kuwacho ni, ‘Wabiro chamo angʼo?’ Kata ni, ‘Wabiro madho angʼo?’ Kata ni, ‘Wabiro rwako angʼo?’
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, negichiwo misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile, misango mar Dwe Manyien kod sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel gi mago mokel kaka chiwo mar hera ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noluongo Ziba, ma jatich Saulo mowachone niya, “Amiyo nyakwar ruodhi gik moko duto mane mag Saulo gi joode.
english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

kikuyu: Rehoboam nodwoko niya, “Dhi uduog ira bangʼ ndalo adek.” Bangʼe negia ma gidhi.
english: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

kikuyu: “Keluru cham mabeyo mokwongo nyaknu e lowo e od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. “Kik uted nyadiel ma pod dhodho cha min.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: To ka uyudo sand nikech un jo-Kristo to kik wiyi kuodi, to gone Nyasaye erokamano nikech iluongou gi nyingno.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

kikuyu: Makmana piny Goshen kende ema pe ok ochwee, kama piny ma jo-Israel nodakie.
english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Daudi nowacho niya, “Ngʼato angʼata madwaro loyo jo-Jebus nyaka kadh e otuchi ma pi kadhogo eka dochop kuom rangʼonde gi muofni, ma gin jowasik Daudi.” Mano ema omiyo nowach ni muofni gi rongʼonde ok nodonj e dala ruoth.
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Paulo nochungʼ motingʼo bade, kowacho niya, “Un jo-Israel kod joma ok jo-Yahudi moluoro Nyasaye, winjauru!
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

kikuyu: Ji duto moseweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ok gimany Jehova Nyasaye kata mana penje wach.”
english: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.

kikuyu: Ne gilwora koni gi koni, to ne atiekogi e nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

kikuyu: gi Rakal; gi jogo mane ni e mier matindo mag jo-Jeramel gi jo-Keni,
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

kikuyu: Nomako bad ngʼatno, mi okonye aa malo, kendo gikanyo tiend ngʼatno gi ombongʼne noyudo teko.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Smurna kama: Magi e weche mag Jal Mokwongo kendo Mogik, Jal mane otho kendo ochier.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

kikuyu: Eka jodolo nokelo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kama ne olosne ei kama ler mar lemo mar hekalu ma en Kama Ler Moloyo mi gikete e bwomb kerubi.
english: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

kikuyu: Magi e nying jo-Israel mane odhi e piny Misri gi Jakobo, moro ka moro gi joode:
english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “Iwacho kare, Japuonj. In kare kiwacho ni Nyasaye en achiel maonge moro machielo makmana En.
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

kikuyu: Achalo wendo ne owetena an kaka jamwa ne yawuot minwa;
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

kikuyu: Wach Ruoth nolandore koa kuomu mochopo ok mana Makedonia gi Akaya kende: To sani koro yie ma un-go kuom Nyasaye oselandore mongʼere kuonde duto. Omiyo wan koro onge gima wanyalo wacho kuome,
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

kikuyu: Un nyaka koro urit chikena gi buchena kendo umak-gi, mi uluwgi duto, eka piny mamiyou mondo udagieno ok nongʼogu oko.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

kikuyu: Nyathi moro amora ma wuowi mokwongo ma ja-Israel bed ni en dhano kata chiayo, en mara. Kane anego kayo duto man Misri, ne awalogi gibedo maga.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

kikuyu: Amazia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo norito Jerusalem kuom higni piero ariyo gochiko. Min mare ne nyinge Jehoadin nyar Jerusalem.
english: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Koro sani adwaro dhi kuma ji duto manie piny dhiyoe. Ungʼeyo malongʼo gi chunyu duto ni onge singo moro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nomiyou ma pod ok otimo. Singo duto osetimo maonge modongʼ.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

kikuyu: An to, nikech kechni maduongʼ, abiro donjo e odi; abiro kulora gi luor ka achomo hekalu mari maler.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

kikuyu: koridore yo podho chiengʼ nyaka e tongʼ jo-Jaflet mochopo nyaka e holo mar Beth Horon kendo nyaka Gezer, mogik e nam.
english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

kikuyu: sani onene e yo, to bangʼ sa matin en kuonde chokruok, kendo e kuonde mopondo duto oyudore.
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

kikuyu: Ngʼama choko kuthe konyore gi gima olos gi nyinyo kata gi ragwar, kendo wangʼogi kama ochokgie.
english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”

kikuyu: Inidag amingʼa mitho kapod itegno, mana ka cham mokaa e kinde mowinjore.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

kikuyu: Shaul nonywolo Shalum, Shalum nonywolo Mibsam, to Mibsam nonywolo Mishma.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowacho ni Joab gi ji duto mane ni kode niya, “Yiechuru lepu kendo rwakreuru gi lep ywak kendo wuothuru e nyim Abner ka uywak.” Ruoth Daudi owuon to nowuotho kaluwo joma otingʼo ringre Abner.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, idak e dier joma jongʼanyo. Gin gi wenge mondo ginen-go to ok ginen, kendo gin gi itgi mondo giwinjgo, to ok giwinj wach, nikech gin joma jongʼanyo.
english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

kikuyu: Anenogi ka achungʼ ewi kite mabeyo; kendo arangogi gi ewi gode. Aneno oganda modak kar kendgi ma ok oseriwore gi ogendini mamoko.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

kikuyu: Ma e kar yweyona mochwere manyaka chiengʼ, kae ema abiro betie kom lochna, nimar asehere,
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, Jehova Nyasaye e nyinge mongʼerego!
english: even the LORD, the God of Armies. The LORD is his name of renown!

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Ruoth noyiero ji piero abiriyo gariyo mamoko, kendo noorogi ariyo, ariyo mondo otel nyime e mier duto kod kamoro amora mane obiro dhiyoe.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

kikuyu: Nimar kaka polo ni malo moyombo piny, e kaka herane duongʼ ne joma omiye luor;
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

kikuyu: “Ne, anaor thuol man-gi kwiri e dieru, thuonde mager ma ok bo, kendo gini kau.” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ma e chenro mar wuodh jo-Israel e kinde mane gia Misri kopog-gi e migepe mopogore opogore kendo kotelnegi gi Musa kod Harun.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Abisalom kod ji duto mag Israel nowacho niya, “Rieko mar Hushai ja-Arki ber moloyo mar Ahithofel.” Nimar Jehova Nyasaye noramo ni nyaka oroch rieko maber mane Ahithofel ongʼado mondo okelni Abisalom masira.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil on Absalom.

kikuyu: Nyasaye oseidho malo ka ji pake gi mor. Jehova Nyasaye osetingʼ malo ka dwond turumbete ywak.
english: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye biro tieli piny matieki chuth nyaka chiengʼ; obiro yudhi mi oyiechi oko e hembi; obiro pudhi mi ogoli e piny joma ngima. Sela
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Solomon nokwongʼore gi nying Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Mad Nyasaye kweda ka Adonija ok otho nikech kwayoni.
english: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

kikuyu: Kanyo abiro dwokone puothe mar mzabibu, Kendo analos holo mar Akor obed dhood geno. Kanyo nowerie mana kaka nower kapod otin, mana ka chiengʼ mane owuok koa Misri.”
english: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ajuogani ne otwere but ruodh chulano miluongo ni Sergio Paulo, mane en ngʼat mariek, kendo kaka nodwaro winjo Wach Nyasaye, nooro wach mondo oluongne Barnaba gi Saulo.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

kikuyu: Nongʼado iye gi bap sida ka bor mopog gigo romo fut piero adek kochomo yo ka tok hekalu chakre tiend ot nyaka wi tado mondo olos kama ler mar lemo maiye miluongo ni Kama Ler Moloyo.
english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

kikuyu: kuom Dibon, Nebo kod Beth Diblathaim,
english: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nyalo pari ka osetho. En ngʼa madi paki gi ei liel?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

kikuyu: Giko osechopo! Giko osechopo! Osechopo mondo otieki. Osechopo adier!
english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

kikuyu: Res Israel, yaye Nyasaye, kuom chandruok mage duto!
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehoash ruodh Israel nomonje. Jehoash kod Amazia ruodh Juda ne joromo e lweny e dala mar Beth Shemesh man Juda.
english: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

kikuyu: Nongʼicho moneno ruoth kochungʼ e bath siro mar dhoot. Jotelo gi jogo turumbete nochungʼ e bath ruoth kendo ji duto mag pinyno ne mor kendo negigoyo turumbete, to jower magoyo thumbe notelo ni wende pak. Eka Athalia noyiecho lepe kakok niya, “Andhoga! Andhoga!”
english: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

kikuyu: Pak obed ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwerewa, moseketo e chuny ruoth mondo luor obed ne od Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem e yo machalo kama
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem;

kikuyu: Koa e got momanyore gi Beth Horon mantiere yo milambo, tongʼno nogomo kochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar godno, mogik Kiriath Baal (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim), ma en dala jo-Juda. Mano e tongʼ-gi ma yo podho chiengʼ.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

kikuyu: Abiro oro tuoche malandore kuome, kendo abiro miyo remo mol e wangʼ yorene mag dala. Joma onegi biro podho e iye ka ligangla olwore koni gi koni. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Lawi mane ochako tich ne gin: koa kuom joka Kohath, Mahath wuod Amasai kod Joel wuod Azaria; koa kuom Merari, Kish wuod Abdi kod Azaria wuod Jehalelel; koa kuom joka Gershon, Joa wuod Zima kod Eden wuod Joa;
english: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

kikuyu: machalo gi wuon kisera mothinyore oko kawuok e ode mar mor, kendo mana ka jangʼwech mongirore moil moikore ni chako ngʼwech.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

kikuyu: Ji nohum kane gineno ka momni wuoyo, pudhe ngima, rongʼonde wuotho, kendo muofni neno, kendo negipako Nyasach Israel.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

kikuyu: kendo nyaka uchame e kama ler mar lemo nikech en pokni kaachiel gi yawuoti. Ma en pok mogol kuom misengini miwangʼo gi mach ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech kamano e kaka nochika.
english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.

kikuyu: Asuria ok nyal resowa, bende ok wana idhi faresegi mag lweny. Ok wanachak wawach kendo ni, ‘Nyisechewa’ ne gik mwaloso gi lwetwa wawegi, nimar kuomi, ema, nyithi kiye yude kech.”
english: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima anatimne pinyni kod joma odak ka, Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Anami dala maduongʼni chal gi Tofeth.
english: This is what I will do to this place,” says the LORD, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.

kikuyu: To kata mana wan, angʼo ma dimi wachom masira seche duto?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Un joma winjo wechegi mane jonabi mane nitie e kinde mane iketo mise mar od Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owuoyoe, koro beduru mondo hekalu oger.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

kikuyu: Abiro jwangʼo jogo modongʼ ma gin girkeni mag tich lweta kendo chiwogi e lwet wasikgi. Ibiro kwalgi mi yakgi gi wasikgi duto,
english: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

kikuyu: Gimoro kendo maseyudo en ni Nyasaye nochweyo ji duto momiyo rieko, makmana ni dhano osebaro ka dwaro gik mangʼeny.”
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

kikuyu: To gingʼanyone Nyasaye kagiwacho niya, ‘Wewa mos!’ Waonge gi gombo moro amora mar ngʼeyo yoreni.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

kikuyu: Kane owach ne Joshua ni ruodhi abichgo nopondo e rogo mar Makeda,
english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

kikuyu: Ahira wuod Enan, ma jatend joka Naftali, nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar apar gariyo.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

kikuyu: Jal mochayo Chikno nobi kaluwore gi dwaro mar Satan ka en gi teko duto mar timo honni gi ranyisi mag miriambo,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

kikuyu: Bende nomi jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad piny ma yo podho chiengʼ mar Jordan man Araba nyaka Kinereth mochopo dho Nam mar Araba (ma tiende ni Nam Chumbi), man e bwo gode mag Pisga.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

kikuyu: kod Elkana gi Ishia gi Azarel gi Joezer kod Jashobeam ja-Kora,
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel malaike nobiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Satan bende nobiro kodgi.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.

kikuyu: Los yiend siala kendo ibawgi gi dhahabu.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Nona kendo itema, yaye Jehova Nyasaye nonie chunya gi pacha;
english: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

kikuyu: Anagur singruokna manyaka chiengʼ e kinda kodi gi nyikwayi kod tienge mabiro, mi anabed Nyasachi kendo Nyasach nyikwayi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Ritreuru! Beduru motangʼ ne kit wuoro duto; ngima mar dhano ok bedi nikech mwandu mathoth ma en-go.”
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Ka in wuod Nyasaye to chikri piny. Nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Obiro miyo malaika mage chik nikech in, kendo gibiro tingʼi malo e lwetgi, mondo kik ichwany tiendi e kidi.’”
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: koa e dhood Gad, ne en Geuel wuod Maki.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jopuonj chik moko nowacho kendgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼatni yanyo Nyasaye!”
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye sik kaparo richo mane wuonegi otimo; kendo mad richo min kik ruchi.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

kikuyu: Kaka Roho Maler nosegengʼogi ni kik giyal Injili e piny Asia, Paulo gi lange nowuotho e gwengʼ Frugia gi Galatia.
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

kikuyu: To kiny kar sa maka ma, abiro oro jodonga mondo omany odi mar ruoth kaachiel gi ut jodongi. Gibiro kawo gimoro amora mikwano kaka gima berni.’ ”
english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

kikuyu: Kinde duto wawuotho ka watingʼo tho mar Yesu e ringrewa, mondo eka ngima mar Yesu onere e ringrewa.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

kikuyu: Jadolo moa e anywola Harun nyaka dhi gi jo-Lawi sa ma gikawo achiel kuom apar, to jo-Lawi nyaka kel achiel kuom apar mar achiel kuom aparno e kuonde keno mag od Nyasachwa.
english: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

kikuyu: Kata kamano chik iti ni lamo jatichni gi kwayone mar ngʼwono, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha. Winji ywak gi lemo ma jatichni lamo e nyimi kawuono.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

kikuyu: To usebedo joma timbegi mono moloyo wuoneu. Ne kaka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu luwo timbe manono mag chuny kar mondo gilwora.
english: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ka ber ne ruoth kendo ka ayudo ngʼwono e wangʼi kendo kiparo ni en gima ber timo kendo ka imor koda, to yie mondo igol chik mondiki maketho mano mane Haman wuod Hamedatha, ja-Agag oketo mondo otiek jo-Yahudi e gwenge duto ma ruoth orito.
english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka Musa nolando ni jo-Israel sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

kikuyu: Osiepna in ja-adiera kuom gik mitimo ni jowete kata obedo ni gin joma welo kuomi.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

kikuyu: Makmana ji alufu apar gangʼwen gi mia abiriyo (14,700) nosetho nikech masichego, komedore gi jogo mane osetho nikech Kora.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

kikuyu: E higani ka ngʼato ongʼiewo lop wadgi to kik wuond moro bedie kindgi.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

kikuyu: Kane obiro koa Jerusalem mondo orom ne ruoth, ruoth nopenjo Mefibosheth niya, “Angʼo mane omoni dhi koda?”
english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

kikuyu: To in dongʼ koda ka mondo amiyi chike gi buche duto manyaka ipuonjgi giriti e piny mamiyogi mondo gidagie.”
english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ruodhi mag joma ok jo-Yahudi rito jogegi gi angʼenge kendo jotendgi madongo luongore giwegi ni johawi.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

kikuyu: Benjamin kod Hashub noloso kama omanyore gi odgi; e dirgi Azaria wuod Maseya, ma wuod Anania, nogedo kama omanyore gi ode.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kik imed sudo machiegni, to lony wuoche e tiendi, nikech kama ichungoeni en Kama Ler.”
english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”

kikuyu: Abiro wacho kenda niya, “Jehova Nyasaye e pokna, omiyo abiro geno kuome.”
english: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw chiwo mar cham mar golo chich koa e lwet dhakono, mi nofwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo okele e kendo mar misango.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jogo nosayo Yesu mondo oa e gwengʼ-gi.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

kikuyu: Ka noyudo odonjo e dala moro, ji apar man-gi dhoho noromo kode. Negichungo mabor
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

kikuyu: Kendo Jakobo nodwoko Farao niya, “Higni ma asewuothogo e piny gin higni mia achiel kod piero adek. Gisebedo manok kendo matek kendo ok ginyal romo gi higni mane wuora odak godo e piny.”
english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

kikuyu: to dhier biro monji ka janjore kendo chan ka jalweny momanore.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

kikuyu: kendo aserni mage olwora koni gi koni. Gisechwoya mi iya oo piny e lowo, to eka pod ok okecha.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kikuyu: mor zeituni miolo e taya mondo okel ler, gik mangʼwe ngʼar milosogo mor pwodhruok kod ubani mangʼwe ngʼar;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: To nodwokowa kowacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo uywak kendo unego chunya? An aikora ok mana ni twech kende, to kata ni tho e Jerusalem kuno, nikech nying Ruoth Yesu.”
english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kod Harun niya, “Nikech ne ok uketo genou kuoma chuth mondo umiya duongʼ kaka ngʼama ler e nyim jo-Israel, ok unuter ogandani e piny ma amiyogi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

kikuyu: Dise apar gariyo mag dhahabu mane opongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar pekgi noromo shekel apar moro ka moro, kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo. Dise duto mag dhahabu pekgi noromo shekel mia achiel gi piero ariyo.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

kikuyu: E kindeno koko maduongʼ nowuok kuom wach luwo Yor Kristo.
english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

kikuyu: Bende gi chalo gi lum ma yamo yiengo, kata gi mihudhi ma yamo tero?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

kikuyu: Gima ne aluoro ema koro osemaka; gima ne aluoro mogik e ngimana ema koro osetimorena.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

kikuyu: Zerubabel ne en wuon Abihud, to Abihud ne en wuon Eliakim. Eliakim ne en wuon Azor,
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Bende ngʼato kuomu nyalo moko taya bangʼe to oume gi bakul kata okete e bwo kitanda? Donge okete ewi rachungi taya?
english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Laodikia kama: Magi e weche moa kuom Jal miluongo ni Amin, Jal ma ja-adiera kendo janeno ma Ja-ratiro, Jalno ma jaloch kuom chwech duto mag Nyasaye.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

kikuyu: Yawuot Ibrahim ne gin: Isaka gi Ishmael.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

kikuyu: kudho notwi kuonde duto, puodho duto noim gi buya, to ohinga mar kidi nomukore.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nochokore molwore, kendo negiwachone niya, “Pod ibiro weyowa e mudho nyaka karangʼo? Ka in e Kristo to nyiswa maler.”
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

kikuyu: Kane gimedo dhi nyime gipenje, noa malo mowachonegi niya, “Ngʼato kuomu mapok otimo richo ema okuong goye gi kidi.”
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

kikuyu: “Omiyo Ibrahim nodar oweyo piny jo-Kaldea mi odhi odak e piny Haran. Bangʼ tho wuon-gi, Nyasaye nooro Ibrahim e piny makoro udakieni.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

kikuyu: Nomiyo Elasa wuod Shafan kod Gemaria wuod Hilkia baruwa, jogo mane Zedekia ruodh Juda nooro Babulon ir Ruoth Nebukadneza. Kawacho niya:
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

kikuyu: Negilokore ochode e piny Misri, kendo negichako chodo kapod gin nyiri matindo. Thundegi ne omul kendo ringregi mane pod silili ne odwany e pinyno.
english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.

kikuyu: to ka bor polo ne ok otingʼore malo ne ok gichak wuoth nyaka chop odiechiengʼ motingʼore.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

kikuyu: Ne ichiwo koth mogundho, yaye Nyasaye; ne idwogo chuny girkeni mari mane ojony.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

kikuyu: To odiechiengʼno unugo tungʼ kulando chokruok maler, kendo kik uti tijeu mapile. Maeni en chik momakou kaachiel gi nyikwau kamoro amora manudagie.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

kikuyu: E kinde mabirogo Jakobo nogurre motegno, Israel nobed ka bad yath madongo kendo thiewo, kendo enonyag olemo mopongʼo piny.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

kikuyu: Ketgi duto e lwet Harun gi yawuote kendo ofwagi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachone jonon piny ariyogo niya, “Dhiuru e od Rahab kendo ukele kaachiel gi joodgi duto, kaluwore gi singruok mane uketo kode.”
english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”

kikuyu: To ka en-gi kama lit molokore mamarmar e bondone kata e thur wiye, to en tuo malandore moa e wiye kata e thur wiye.
english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

kikuyu: Ne entie kapok gimoro amora nobetie, kendo kuome ema gik moko duto oriwore.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

kikuyu: Nyaka ochul kar rombono moloyo nyadingʼwen, nikech ne otimo gima chalo kama, ka chunye onge gi kech.”
english: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

kikuyu: Giduto gin joma terore, giore ka kendo, ma jated makati oweyo chwaloe mach nyaka otiek dwelo mi makati kuodi moromo tedo.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

kikuyu: Omiyo ogandago nogole oko mar kambi kendo negichiele gi kite motho, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: To ka udwanyo pinyno, to ngʼeuru ni onyalo ngʼogou oko mar oganda mane okwongonu dake kane gidwanye.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

kikuyu: Ne ogolo chik mi oneg Jakobo owad gi Johana gi ligangla.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

kikuyu: to nyaka uneg jogo duto modak e dalano gi ligangla. Neg-giuru duto kaachiel gi jambgi.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mana ka chikegi olal e wangʼa, e kaka nyikwa Israel nowe bedo oganda e nyima.”
english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says the LORD, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”

kikuyu: To ka oonge gi owete, to ipog owete gi wuonene girkeni mare.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

kikuyu: To Judas, mane oyudo ondhoge, nongʼeyo kanyo, nikech Yesu ne thoro romo gi jopuonjrene kanyo.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi noduogo e Holo mar Besor kama ji mia ariyo mane ool mane ok nyal dhi kode nodongʼie. Negibiro mondo girom ni Daudi gi ji mane ni kode. Ka Daudi gi joge nosudo machiegni nomosogi.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

kikuyu: Onego uchame e miechu uwuon. Joma ok ler gi jomaler nyalo chame mana kaka gichamo mwanda kata nyakech.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Darius nochiwo chik, kendo neginono e kuonde kano gik machon e kar keno man Babulon.
english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.

kikuyu: Kinyne kar odiechiengʼ tir, kane jootego chiegni chopo e dala mar Jopa, Petro noidho malo ewi tado mondo olem.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

kikuyu: Ogendini nowinj wichkuot momaki; ywakni nopongʼ piny. Jolweny nochwanyre kuom moro ka moro; giduto ginipodhi kanyakla.”
english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jatije nogole oko moloro dhoot matek bangʼe. Noyudo nyakono orwako law molos maber manyilni mane itwangʼo ni nyiri ngili ma nyi joka ruoth.
english: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

kikuyu: To ka umewo mokalo e gik moko duto ma un-go, kaka: yie maru, gi losou, gi ngʼeyou, gi ikruok maru mar konyo, kod hera muherowago; koro wadwaro ni tij ngʼwononi mar chiwo bende utimie maber moloyo.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

kikuyu: Koro unyalo yie koda nine ok abedonu tingʼ mapek. To pod unyalo wacho ni ne akonyora gi rieka maricho mondo amau lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

kikuyu: kata jodolo, ma jo-Lawi, bende ok nobed maonge gi ngʼato machungʼ e nyima seche duto mar chiwo misengini miwangʼo pep, ka giwangʼo misengini mag cham kendo chiwo misengini.’ ”
english: The Levitical priests won’t lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”

kikuyu: Eka Ahimaz nowuoyo gi ruoth kowacho niya, “Gik moko dhi maber!” Nopodho piny auma e nyim ruoth ka wangʼe ochomo piny mi owacho niya, “Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi! Osechiwo e lwet ruodha ma en ruoth jogo mosepiem kode.”
english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is the LORD your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

kikuyu: Aore duto manie bwo lowo, ne miyo yien-go dongo, nikech ne gitero pi, kama yien-go opidhie; kendo negikeyo pi, ne yiende duto mopidh e bunguno.
english: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.

kikuyu: Kanyo ema ne giyudoe Adoni-Bezek kendo negikedo kode, mi giloyo jo-Kanaan gi jo-Perizi.
english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

kikuyu: Ne anindo, to chunya ne neno. Lingʼ uwinji! Jaherana dwongʼo kowacho niya, “Yaye jaherana, yawna kendo winja maber, yaye jaherana mamuol mana ka akuru. Tho opongʼo wiya, kendo yie wiya opongʼ gi ngʼich mar otieno.”
english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”

kikuyu: “Or wachni ne joma ni e twech duto: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom Shemaya ja-Nehelam: Nikech Shemaya osekoronu, kata obedo ni ne ok aore, kendo osemiyo uyie gi miriambo,
english: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘The LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”

kikuyu: gionge paro, gionge yie, gionge hera, kendo gionge kech.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

kikuyu: Yawuot Izhar ne gin: Kora, Nefeg kod Zikri.
english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ji ariyo ma nying-gi Eldad kod Medad, mane osekwan kaachiel gi jodongo piero abiriyo-ka nodongʼ e kambi. To kata kane ok gidhi e Hemb Romo kamano, Roho nobiro kuomgi mi gikoro wach e kambi.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

kikuyu: Hekalu marwa maler, kendo man-gi duongʼ mane kwerewa opakie, osewangʼ gi mach, kendo mwanduwa duto osekethore.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ochopo kanyo, nongʼiyo malo kendo nowachone niya, “Omiyo Zakayo, nolor piny piyo. Tinendeni nyaka abed e odi.”
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

kikuyu: “Koro lamnwa Jehova Nyasaye nikech Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon monjowa. Sa moro Jehova Nyasaye nyalo timonwa honni mana kaka osetimonwa e kinde mosekalo mondo omi oa kuomwa.”
english: “Please inquire of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”

kikuyu: “Wuora, adwaro ni joma isemiya obed koda kama antie, kendo ni gine duongʼna, ma en duongʼno misemiya nikech ne ihera kapok nochwe piny.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Isakar, ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero auchiel angʼwen gi mia adek (64,300).
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: “Bor mar dala maduongʼno duto nobed kilomita ochiko. “Kendo chakre ndalono nying dala maduongʼno noluong ni: Jehova Nyasaye nika.”
english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘The LORD is there.’

kikuyu: Iro dhwolore kawuok e ume mana ka iro mawuok e bethe agulu michwako gi ma tiangʼ.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

kikuyu: Gikanyono ne gikwanyo kite mondo gichielgo Yesu, to nopondonigi, mopusore oa e laru mar hekalu.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

kikuyu: Nimar kuom ngʼwono mosemiya, awacho ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ni: Kik ipar ni iduongʼ moloyo kaka ichal to ket pachi kare eka ingʼad buchi kaluwore gi kar rom yie ma Nyasaye osepogoni.
english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

kikuyu: Eka noluongo jotend askeche ariyo momiyogi chik niya, “Ikuru jolweny mia ariyo, gi mamoko piero abiriyo moidho farese kod mia ariyo motingʼo tonge mondo oikre mar dhi Kaisaria kawuono sa adek mar otieno.
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

kikuyu: to eka pod ibwoga gi lek magalagala kendo imiya luoro gi fweny mayoreyore,
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho niya, “Chiengʼno wende ma iwero e hekalu nolokre mag ywak, ka ringre joma otho opie kuonde duto, kendo piny to olingʼ thi!”
english: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord GOD. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.

kikuyu: Kane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye osetho, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua wuod Nun, jakony Musa niya,
english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

kikuyu: (To pewe kod mier molworo dala maduongʼ nomi Kaleb wuod Jefune.)
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: kendo ka un kod nyithindu udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ka uchiwo ne luor kod chunyu duto gi ngimau duto ma achikou kawuono,
english: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Un gi mondu usenyiso gi timbeu gik mane usingoru ka uwacho ni, ‘Nyaka wachop singruok mane waketo mar wangʼo ubani kendo chiwo misango miolo piny ne Ruoth ma Dhako mar Polo.’ “Dhiuru nyime, kendo utim gima ne usingo! Rituru singruoku!
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.” “‘Establish then your vows, and perform your vows.’

kikuyu: “Kiny kar sa ma kama abiro oro ngʼato moa e piny Benjamin. Wire mondo otel ne joga ma jo-Israel, enores joga e lwet jo-Filistia. Asekecho joga nimar ywakgi osechopona.”
english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

kikuyu: Ma e kaka ne onego odhi ir ruoth: Gimoro amora modwaro lichorego kodhi e od ruoth ne imiye koa e od mon.
english: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.

kikuyu: Sara nomako ich kendo nonywolone Ibrahim wuowi ka Ibrahim hike oniangʼ, mana e kinde mane Nyasaye osingore.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

kikuyu: Nowacho kama, “Nimar bede notingʼ malo e nyim kom duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye. Kendo Jehova Nyasaye noked gi jo-Amalek e tienge duto.”
english: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

kikuyu: Ne itelone jogi ka rombe ka gin e lwet Musa gi Harun.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Donge ok en tichna mondo angʼad bura ne joma ok jo-Kristo? Donge joma osebedo e kanyakla mar joma oyie ema onego ungʼadnigi bura?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

kikuyu: omiyo nooro ji mondo odhi omake. To kane gineno oganda jonabi ka koro wach ka gin gi Samuel kochungʼ kanyo kaka jatendgi Roho mar Nyasaye nomako joote Saulo ma gin bende negichako koro.
english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

kikuyu: Eka negigure. Ne gipogore lepe, ka gigoyo ombulu mondo gingʼe gima ngʼato ka ngʼato onego okaw.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

kikuyu: Eka Joshua kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Libna koa Makeda mi omonje.
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

kikuyu: Elija nodhi mochungʼ e nyim ji mowachonegi niya, “Nyaka karangʼo ma ubiro digni e kind paro ariyo? Ka Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye, luweuru, to ka Baal en nyasaye luweuru.” To ji ne olingʼ thi.
english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

kikuyu: Eka ok wanachak walokre waweyi; konywa wabed mangima, kendo wabiro pako nyingi.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

kikuyu: Kendo noketogi e od twech kama jatend askeche mar od twech notweyoe Josef.
english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka nobedi chiengʼ giko piny. Malaike nobi kendo nopog joma timbegi richo gi joma kare,
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

kikuyu: mawacho niya, “Abiro ngʼado oko tunge joma timbegi richo duto, to tunge joma kare to ibiro tingʼ malo.”
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye olocho nyaka chiengʼ yaye Sayun, Nyasachi olocho nyaka tienge duto mabiro. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Askeche nodwoko niya, “Onge ngʼama osewuoyo kaka ngʼatni nyaka nene.”
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Nikech un duto usedoko chuoth fedha, abiro chokou kaachiel nyaka Jerusalem.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ngʼama oyie kuoma nigi ngima mochwere.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

kikuyu: Jogo madwaro nyisore kuom gik maokogo to temo chunou ni nyaka teru nyangu. To gimomiyo gitimo ma en mana ni mondo gitony e sand mochomogi nikech wach msalap Kristo.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kikuyu: Jotend dhout Israel duto nokawo keregi e chokruok mar jo-Nyasaye, jolweny alufu mia angʼwen man-gi ligangla.
english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata motingʼo ring chiayogo motho nyaka luok lepe kendo nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo. Nikech le ma kamago gin le mogak.
english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E ndalogo, sa nogono, jo-Israel gi jo-Juda nodhi kaachiel ka pi wangʼ-gi chwer, ka gidwaro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: “In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Aa malo; wadhi.” To ne onge dwoko. Bangʼe ngʼatni noyieye e pundene kendo ne giwuok mondo gidog.
english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

kikuyu: Ne en gima ber mondo ayud chandruok mondo eka apuonjra chikeni.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

kikuyu: Eka Asa noyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike kodgi e dala Daudi wuon mare. Kendo Jehoshafat wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Abiro medo kar kwan mar ji kod mar jamni modak e dieru, kendo gibiro medore mi gidok mathoth mokalo akwana. Abiro miyo ji gedo kuomu kaka chon, kendo abiro miyo unyaa moloyo kaka chon. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: En dhako ma wangʼe tek kendo maonge wichkuot, tiendene susni ma ok obed e ot;
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni bangʼe achien ka nodwaro mondo wuon mare ogwedhe to ne okwede. Noywak malit gi pi wangʼe mondo oyud gwethni to mano ok ne nyal loko paro mar wuon-gi kata matin.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

kikuyu: Beduru e odno, ka uchamo kendo umadho gimoro amora ma gimiyou, nimar jatich owinjore gi pokne. Kik uwuothi ka ua e ot ka ot.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

kikuyu: Onge tiende mondo andiknu kendo kuom kony monego oor ni jo-Nyasaye.
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

kikuyu: Gichiwo misengni mokelna kendo gichamo ring misenginigo, to Jehova Nyasaye ok mor kodgi. Omiyo sani obiro paro anjawo ma gitimo kendo enokumgi kuom richogi. Ginidogi Misri.
english: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

kikuyu: Jotich moa e dala maduongʼ ma pure noa e oganda mar Israel.
english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

kikuyu: Joma kare biro bedo mamor kichulonigi kuor, ka giniluok tiendegi e remb joma timbegi richo.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

kikuyu: Chiewuru, un orutu gi nyatiti! Abiro chiewo kogwen.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: To ka udwaro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kanyo, to unuyude ka umanye gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto.
english: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Nyithinda mageno, kik uyie ngʼato wuondu. Ngʼat matimo gima kare en ngʼama kare, mana kaka en bende en ngʼama kare.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

kikuyu: Ne gikwayo ruoth niya, “To kuom ngʼat mane onegowa kendo mane ochano yo mar hinyowa momiyo waserumo kendo wabedo maonge kar dak kamoro amora e Israel,
english: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

kikuyu: Un uwegi useneno gigo ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni ogendinigi duto nikech un; ne en Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ema nokedonu.
english: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.

kikuyu: Lop Reuben ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Efraim, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

kikuyu: Bende negiyudo mo moleny gi chak mag dhok kod mar nyirombe kod diek, kod imbe machwe mowuok Bashan kod mo mar cha ngano. Ne gimadho divai mochiek maber mar mzabibu.
english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

kikuyu: Bende onyalo mino wach gi weche maonge tiendgi, kata gi mbekni maonge gi konyruok?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oseturo ludh joma timbegi mono, ludh loch mar jotelo,
english: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

kikuyu: Obiro chalo gi yiend mzabibu motengʼ olembene mapok ochiek piny mana ka yiend zeituni ma maupege two kendo lwar piny.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kikuyu: “Chikuru itu uwinja mondo olernu tiend wach; we anyisu gik ma aseneno,
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

kikuyu: Pok mowinjore jodolo kaw kuom misango mar rwath kod rombo ma ji ochiwo gin lemo mar bat, ring lemb kod chino.
english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

kikuyu: Kiny upangru ka udhi irgi. Gibiro biro ka gitwenyo got ka giluwo Holo mar Ziz kendo ubiro yudogi e giko piny mar kamotuo mar Jeruel.
english: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

kikuyu: Welo mamoko nochako penjore kendgi giwegi kawacho niya, “Mani en ngʼa maweyo ne ji richogi?”
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

kikuyu: Jo-Gaza noliel wigi manyiso ni gin gi kuyo; kendo jo-Ashkelon noket malingʼ thii. Yaye un joma otony manie pewe, unungʼadru nyaka kara angʼo?
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

kikuyu: Ngʼato monyiso wich teko ne jangʼad bura kata ne jadolo ma ochungʼ kanyo kachiwo weche Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nyaka negi kendo nyaka ugol tim mamono e dier jo-Israel.
english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

kikuyu: “Donge usewinjo ni an ema ne achano chon mondo gigo otimre? Ne achanogi chon to koro amiyo gitimore, kendo an ema ne achano mondo imuk mier madongo mochiel motegno mondo olokre pidhe mag kite.
english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

kikuyu: Ondiek malich mane inenono, yande nitie, to tinde oonge kendo obiro wuok oa e bur matut maonge gikone ka odhiyo e kar kethruokne. Ji duto modak e piny, ma nyingegi ok ondiki e kitap ngima nyaka aa chakruok mar piny nowuor ka gineno ondiek malichno, nikech yande entie to tinde oonge, to nochak oduogi kendo.
english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Tim gima nikare kendo mowinjore. Res ngʼatno e lwet ngʼama thire, ngʼatno mosemaye. Kik itim marach kata tugo lweny gi jadak, kiye kata mon ma chwogi otho, kendo kik ichwer remo maonge gi wach ka eri.
english: The LORD says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

kikuyu: Musa nowinjo jaduongʼne mi notimo gik moko duto mane owacho.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

kikuyu: ka urito odiechiengʼ mar Nyasaye, kendo ka utemo beru mondo ochop piyo. Odiechiengʼno polo nowangʼ mi nokethe, kendo chwech mag polo noleny kawangʼ.
english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

kikuyu: Tunge piny duto biro paro miduog ir Jehova Nyasaye, kendo dhout ogendini duto biro kulore e nyime,
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono nodhi ir chwore kendo owachone niya, “Ngʼat Nyasaye nobiro ira. Nochalo malaika mar Nyasaye, nolich ahinya. Ne ok apenje kuma ne oaye, kendo kata nyinge ne ok onyisa.
english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;

kikuyu: To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ibed mabor koda. In e tekra, bi piyo mondo ikonya.
english: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

kikuyu: to tich jagedo ka jagedo nonenre kaka chal, nikech tich ngʼato nongʼere malongʼo Chiengʼ Ngʼado Bura. Chiengʼno, nofweny tich mar ngʼato ka ngʼato gi mach, nikech mach ema notemgo tich mane ngʼato ka ngʼato otiyo.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno unukwa Wuoro e nyinga. Ok awach ni an ema nakwa Wuoro karu.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

kikuyu: Kane Hezron osetho e Kaleb Efratha, Abija chi Hezron nonywolone Ashur wuon Tekoa.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

kikuyu: to timne mana kaka ne odwa timo ne owadgi kendo nyaka ugol tim marachno e dieru.
english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Noloso sirni madongo ariyo mag mula moro ka moro borne madhi malo romo fut piero ariyo gauchiel to alworane romo fut apar gauchiel.
english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
