kikuyu: Elisha nochungʼ mowuotho e odno koni gi koni kendo ochako dok moriere kuome e kitanda. Nyathino nogir nyadibiriyo mi wengene noyawore.
english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

kikuyu: “To waseloko loch margi; Heshbon osetieki duto nyaka ochopo Dibon. Wasemukogi nyaka chopi Nofa, modhi nyaka Medeba.”
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ ka Harun gi yawuote osetieko umo gik maler mitiyogo kod gik maler duto mamoko, kendo ka kambi oseikore mar wuok, to jo-Kohath koro nyaka bi mondo oti tij tingʼo. Kik gimul gik maler, nimar ka gitimo kamano to ginitho. Jo-Kohath nyaka tingʼ gigo mantiere ei Hemb Romo.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel bende nochoki momigi gige konyruok, ne giwuok mondo girom kodgi. Jo-Israel nogoyo kambi momanyore kodgi machalo gi kweth ariyo mag diek, ka jo-Aram to nokwako pewe.
english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

kikuyu: Enosh nonywolo Kenan kane en ja-higni piero ochiko.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

kikuyu: Kane Isaka osedak kuno kuom kinde mangʼeny, Abimelek ruodh jo-Filistia nongʼicho gie dirisa moneno ka Isaka gi Rebeka chiege jotugo.
english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

kikuyu: E ndalo giko got mogerie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed gi teko e kind gode duto molwore, kendo ibiro tingʼe malo moyombo gode duto kendo ogendini duto nobi ma pongʼe.
english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

kikuyu: Weche mag loch Asa kar, chakruokgi nyaka gikogi, ondikgi e kitap ruodhi mag Juda kod Israel.
english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Ruodh Asuria nokelo ji koa Babulon, Kutha, Ava, Hamath kod Sefarvaim moketogi gidak e miech Samaria mondo gikaw kar jo-Israel. Negikawo Samaria ma gidak e mieche duto.
english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

kikuyu: Ne isungorina kendo ne iwuoyo marach kuoma ka ok iritori, kendo ne awinjo gik moko duto mane iwacho.
english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

kikuyu: to kane pod anono wechegi, to ne ayudo ni kuom ji alufu achiel, dichwo achiel kende ema nyalo bedo gi rieko, to dhako to onge mariek kata achiel.
english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

kikuyu: Kik igomb od wadu. Kik igomb chi wadu kata jatije ma wuowi kata jatije ma nyako, kata rwadhe kata pundane kata gire moro amora.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane wasegoyonegi oriti, ne wasiayo yie mi wakwangʼ e dier nam tir nyaka chula mar Kos. Kinyne ne watundo e chula mar Rodos, kendo kane waa kanyo, to ne wadhi mi wachopo Patara.
english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

kikuyu: Emomiyo paruru ahinya maber kaka uwinjo. Ngʼat man-go nomedne mi nobed gi gik mogundho; to ngʼat ma ongego kata mano moparo ni en-go nomaye.”
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

kikuyu: Daudi riyo noloyo mowacho niya, “Yaye, mad ne ngʼato kelnae pi soko man but ranga Bethlehem mondo amodhi!”
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

kikuyu: Lep Johana nochwe gi yie ngamia, kendo notweyo kamba mar pien e nungone. Chiembe ne gin bonyo gi mor kich mag bungu.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ima wadu e yor wuond kata kik imaye gire. “ ‘Kik itamri chulo ngʼato kuom tich motiyoni kendo nyaka ichule mana godiechiengno.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

kikuyu: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mefath,
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

kikuyu: Kuom mano ngʼatno nodonjo e ot kendo misike mane ngamia otingʼo nogol kuomgi. Nomigi lum kod chiembgi mi nokelo pi ne jatich Ibrahim kod joge mondo olwokgo tiendegi.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi gode maboyo duto gi gode matindo duto motingʼore malo,
english: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

kikuyu: To ka ne agoyo uwi mondo okonya, noweya gi nangane, kendo oringo owuok oko.”
english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Nyaka nene pok nowinji ngʼat moyawo wangʼ ngʼat mane onywol ka en muofu.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

kikuyu: Negichopo Bethsaida, kendo jomoko nokelo ne Yesu muofu moro mi gikwayo mondo omule.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Efraim wuod Josef, en Kemuel wuod Shiftan;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

kikuyu: Bende negitamore timo ngʼwono ni joka Jerub-Baal (mano en Gideon) kuom gigo mabeyo duto mane osetimonigi.
english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

kikuyu: mi nogolo jo-Israel koluwo diere tir, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Abiathar nonyiso Daudi ni Saulo osenego jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noluongo jodongo duto mag Juda kod Jerusalem.
english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bor kerubi ka kerubi madhi malo ne romo fut apar gauchiel.
english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

kikuyu: nodhi e agola mar jagoro mane ni e kar dak ruoth, kama ne jotelo nobetie: Elishama ma jagoro, Delaya wuod Shemaya, Elnathan wuod Akbor, Gemaria wuod Shafan, Zedekia wuod Hanania, kod jotelo mamoko duto.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

kikuyu: Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Nende aleko lek, kendo onge ngʼama nyalo loko tiende. To asewinjo ka iwacho ni ka iwinjo lek to inyalo loko tiend lek moro amora.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

kikuyu: Ikelo mudho mi piny lokre otieno, kendo le mag bungu duto lak oko.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

kikuyu: To kaka ok unyal timo mani matin-ni, angʼo momiyo uparoru kuom gik mamoko?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

kikuyu: Jakobo nowacho ne Rebeka min mare niya, “Esau omera en ngʼat ma rayier an to an gi del mapoth
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo Koso donge usewinjo? Pok owachnu nyaka aa chakruok? Koso pok wachno odonjonu nyaka ne chwe pinyni.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

kikuyu: “Gima osetimorenwa en nikech timbewa mamono kod kethowa ma ok odhi kare, to kata kamano, Nyasachwa, ne ok ikumowa moromore gi richowago, to niweyo jowa otony, mi wabedo thuolo kaka koroni.
english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

kikuyu: To Kaleb nowacho niya, “Anachiw nyara Aksa mondo okendi gi ngʼatno manoked ma kaw Kiriath Sefa.”
english: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

kikuyu: E kinde ma keyo podi ma mzabibu osemoyo kendo ma olembgi osechiek, enongʼadgi oko kod ratongʼ kendo enongʼad bedene molawore.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

kikuyu: Kane piny oyawore, jangʼad bura nooro askechene ir jarit od twech komiye chik niya, “Weuru jogo thuolo oa odhi.”
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

kikuyu: Dhakono mane ineno en e dala maduongʼ man-gi loch kuom ruodhi mag piny.”
english: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

kikuyu: un dhood joka Lawi, pakuru Jehova Nyasaye; pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un ji duto moluore.
english: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Kamane gibuore gotieno, achiel kuomgi nogonyo gunde mondo omi pundane chiemo, kendo noneno pesane ka otwe e dho ogunde.
english: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

kikuyu: Mwandu kelo osiepe mangʼeny, to osiep ngʼat ma jachan ringe.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

kikuyu: Rwak ludhego ei ratege mantie e bethe Sandug Muma mondo otingʼego.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notiyone Jehova Nyasaye e ndalo duto mag ngima Joshua kod jodongo mane osedak higni moloye, kendo mane nigi lony kuom gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni jo-Israel.
english: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowegi mondo otemgo jo-Israel kendo ongʼego ka ginyalo rito chike mane omiyo kweregi kokalo kuom Musa.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Lut noloro dhoot mowuok odhi irgi,
english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

kikuyu: mi openjo niya, “Ere jal mosenywol mondo obed ruodh jo-Yahudi? Ne waneno sulwene yo wuok chiengʼ kendo wasebiro mondo walame.”
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

kikuyu: Dhi ir Farao gokinyi ka odhi e aora. Rite e bath aora Nael mondo irom kode, bende kaw luth mane olokore thuol cha e lweti.
english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

kikuyu: Jogo mane wasika kayiem nono nomanya ka winyo.
english: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

kikuyu: Koa kuom Kish, noyier wuod Kish miluongo ni Jeramel.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Kuom Nyasaye ma apako wachne, in Jehova Nyasaye ema apako wachne,
english: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

kikuyu: Farao noluongo Musa gi Harun mapiyo nono mi owachonegi niya, “Asetimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kaachiel gi nyimu bende,
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokawo chiege kod yawuote, mi oketogi e punda kendo nochako wuoth mar dok Misri. Bende nokawo ludh Nyasaye e lwete.
english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.

kikuyu: joka Dan mane oikore ni kedo ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gaboro gi mia auchiel (28,600);
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya nowachone Hezekia niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama:
english: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Mzabibu osetwo kendo ngʼowu osener, olemo mongʼinore, gi othidhe kod mapera kaachiel gi yiende duto mag puodho osetwo. Adier mor mar dhano bende oserumo.
english: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.

kikuyu: Awacho ni Nyasaye ma lwandana niya, “Angʼo momiyo wiyi osewil koda? Angʼo momiyo asiko gi kuyo ka jawasigu sanda?”
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

kikuyu: Aseketonu ranyisi mondo utim kaka asetimonu.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu wachonu kawuono mondo urit buchene kod chikene; ritgiuru ka uluwogi gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto.
english: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Ji duto man koda ooroni mos. Mosnwa joma oherowa kuom yie. Ngʼwono obed kodu uduto.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: “Kik uwe Hezekia wuondu kowachonu ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye biro resowa.’ Bende nyaka nene nyasach piny moro amora osereso ogandane e lwet ruodh Asuria?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

kikuyu: “En noluwe gi ngʼat moro ma timbene richo ma ok owinjore bedo ruoth. Ngʼatni nomonj pinyruoth kinde ma jopiny paro ni gin gi kwe kendo enokaw pinyno kokonyore gi weche ma miriambo.
english: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, pod abiro paro singruok mane atimo kodi kane pod itin, kendo abiro guro singruok mosiko kodi.
english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

kikuyu: Asewuoyo kodu mana kuom gik manie pinyni, to utamoru yie; koro ubiro yie nade ka awuoyo kuom gik manie polo?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

kikuyu: Donjuru e rangeyene kugoyo erokamano bende biuru e laru mare kupake. Goneuru erokamano kendo pakuru nyinge.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: Aketo chunya e lweti; resa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye mar adiera.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

kikuyu: Jezebel jaode to nowachone niya, “Bende e kaka onego itimri to in e ruoth mar Israel? Aa malo kendo ichiem! Bed mamor. Abiro miyi puoth mzabibu mar Naboth ja-Jezreel.”
english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

kikuyu: mano ema notimre ne ngʼat ma kamano nikech othiano ni Nyasaye kendo opiem gi Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

kikuyu: To ka oyude, okete e goke komor
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

kikuyu: Kochopo odhiambo, kibaji nogogi apoya nono! To kapok piny oru, to ginilal nono! Ma e pok mar joma mayowa, kendo en e pok mar joma yakowa.
english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Wuogi e nyimwa, in nibiro ka kaka jadak kendo koro idwaro ketori kaka jangʼad bura!” Wabiro timoni marach moloyogi, omiyo ne gidhiro Lut giteko mondo gi muk dhoot.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

kikuyu: Eka negichopo Elim, kama ne nitie sokni apar gariyo kod yiende mag othidhe piero abiriyo mine gibworo kanyo machiegni gi pi.
english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

kikuyu: Omiyo akwayou ni mondo uwuothi kuom Roho, eka ok ubi timo gik ma ringreu dwaro.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

kikuyu: Enosh notho ka en ja-higni mia ochiko gabich.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Ji ne wuotho awuotha e mier kamanyo pi modho, kendo ne ok ginyal yudo pi moromogi, to kata kuom mago duto pod utamoru duogo ira,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: kendo ne gilosonegi kilemba motwangʼ gi law mayom mar katana gi ogute kaachiel gi sirwaru maiye,
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

kikuyu: Un joneno mag gigi,
english: You are witnesses of these things.

kikuyu: to wuode makayo ne en Abdon, kiluwe gi Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone mowachone niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,

kikuyu: Eka nochomo yo podho chiengʼ kendo opime gi gir pimo mi noromo fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

kikuyu: To Johana bende ne batiso ji Ainon machiegni gi Salim, nikech pi ne ngʼeny kanyo, kendo ji nosiko ka biro ire mondo obatisgi.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

kikuyu: To kaka koro Epafrodito osekelona kony manyocha uorego, koro aseyudo mich moroma, kendo mokalo dwarona. Mich mumiyagi dungʼ tik mamit mana ka misango ma Nyasaye oyiego kendo mamore.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

kikuyu: “Ka udonjo e piny Kanaan, ma amiyou kaka girkeni maru, mi akelo gimoro marach mamiyo kor ot pur,
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel noluongo achiel kuom jodonge mowachone niya, “Dhi piyo iom Mikaya wuod Imla.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

kikuyu: Piny Kanaan duto makoro udakieni anamiyi kaachiel gi nyikwayi mondo obed girkeni manyaka chiengʼ kendo anabed Nyasachgi.”
english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

kikuyu: Mier matindo mag jo-Lawi e piny mane jo-Israel okawo ne gin piero angʼwen gaboro giduto, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Ka ok unyal miya dwoko, to nyaka umiya kandhe piero adek gi lewni mabeyo bende piero adek. Negiwachone niya, “Nyiswa ngero mari mondo wawinji.”
english: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.” They said to him, “Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Jadolo nyaka ritre, kendo kik osud machiegni gi ringre ngʼama otho ma dimi obed mogak. To kapo ni ngʼama othono en wuon mare kata min mare, kata wuode kata nyare, kata owadgi kata nyamin mapok odhi tedo, to oyiene mondo obed mogak.
english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

kikuyu: Wan duto wanyalo chiemo kendo metho, kendo wabed mamor e tijewa. Ma en mich moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Mirimb Nyasaye koro fwenyore koa e polo kuom ji duto motamore lame, kendo matimo richo ka gigengʼo adiera gi timbegi maricho.
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

kikuyu: kipimo siro ka siro maromre gi nyawadgi. Los sirni duto mag Hemb Romo machalre.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Nikech nyinge maduongʼ, Jehova Nyasaye ok nojwangʼ joge, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne mor mar timou joge owuon.
english: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased the LORD to make you a people for himself.

kikuyu: Ka ineno punda mar nyawadu kata rwadhe kopodho e yo, to kik ichal ngʼama ok oneno, to kony wuon-gi mondo ochunge oa malo.
english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

kikuyu: Nikech kata ka barupa mane andikonu nomiyo ukuyo, to ok anyal timonu mos. Kata kamano ne atimo mos, nikech aneno ni barupano nomiyou chuny lit, to mana matin nono.
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

kikuyu: Ne iyudo ka en ngʼat ma ja-adiera e nyimi, kendo ne iloso kode singruok ni inimi nyikwaye piny jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Perizi, jo-Jebus, kod jo-Girgash. Iserito singruok marino nikech in ja-ratiro.
english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

kikuyu: “Japuonjre ok duongʼ moloyo japuonjne, kata jatich bende ok duongʼ moloyo ngʼama ruodhe motiyone.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

kikuyu: Hezekia notho moyweyo kaka kwerene kendo noyike e got kama liete nyikwa Daudi ne nitiere. Jo-Juda duto kod joma ne nitie Jerusalem nomiye duongʼ kane otho kendo Manase wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To in, wuod dhano, gibiro tweyi gi ngoche, kendo gibiro ridi matek ma ok inyal wuok mondo idhi ir jou.
english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

kikuyu: Kaka wanyalo ngʼeyo pogruok manie kind nyithind Nyasaye gi nyithind Satan ema: Ngʼat ma ok tim gima kare kendo ma ok ohero owadgi ok en nyathi Nyasaye.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

kikuyu: Winjuru! Jorito mau mondo okog matek; giduto gikok nikech gimor. Ka Jehova Nyasaye noduog Sayun, to ginine lochne ayanga.
english: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion.

kikuyu: Bangʼe to okecho ka thuol kendo oketo kwiri kaka fu.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho gigi duto ne oganda gi ngeche; ne ok owachonegi gimoro amora ma ok okonyore gi ngero.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

kikuyu: Eka ruodh Sodom, ruodh Gomora, ruodh Adma, ruodh Zeboim kod ruodh Bela (ma tiende ni Zoar) nowuok kendo oikore kedo moriedo jolwenjgi e Holo mar Sidim,
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

kikuyu: Beduru gi winjruok ngʼato gi ngʼato, mondo umi Kristo duongʼ.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

kikuyu: Anami mon ma chwogi otho mag-gi bedo mathoth moloyo kwoyo manie dho nam. E odiechiengʼ tir anakel ngʼama nego mana rowere; kendo apoya nono anakelnegi lit kod bwok maduongʼ.
english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya “Bole piny kanyo.” Musa nobole piny e lowo kendo nolokore thuol mi Musa noringe.
english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.

kikuyu: Kuom mago mopogne jolweny mano kedo, goluru ni Jehova Nyasaye achiel kuom mia abich bed ni gin ji, dhok, punde, rombe kata diek.
english: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

kikuyu: Negikawo ringre Yesu mi giwiro gi modhigo bangʼe giboye gi lewni marep-rep molir olir, kaka chik jo-Yahudi mar yiko ngʼato dwaro.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

kikuyu: iye nowangʼ kodgi. Nochiwogi e lwet jo-Filistia kod jo-Amon,
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: To resri ibed thuolo, mana kaka mwanda mayombo jadwar, kata kaka winyo matony e obadho mar jamak winy.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin duto mane otho odiechiengno ne gin jolweny marahuma alufu apar gaboro.
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

kikuyu: Wachore ni Nyasaye kano kum monego okumgo ngʼato ne yawuote. An to awacho ni ber moloyo ka Nyasaye okumo jaketho owuon, mondo eka ngʼama oketho opuonjre.
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

kikuyu: Biuru wawer gimor ne Jehova Nyasaye; wagouru koko matek ne lwanda mar warruokwa.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

kikuyu: oseketo ji duto modak e piny ngima e lweti, kaachiel gi le mag bungu kod winy mafuyo e kor polo. Kendo kamoro amora ma gidakie, oseketi jatelo mag-gi duto. Omiyo koro in e wich mar kido mane ilekono.
english: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.

kikuyu: kata bor, kata tut, kata gima ochwe moro amora, ok nyal pogowa gihera mar Nyasaye mane ei Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: “Manase ruodh Juda osetimo timbe makwero. Osetimo richo moloyo jo-Amor mane otelo nyime mi omiyo jo-Juda odonjo e richo mag nyisechene.
english: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

kikuyu: Noor wach mondo oland ne jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem ni mondo gikelne Jehova Nyasaye osuru mane Musa jatich Nyasaye ochiko jo-Israel e thim.
english: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

kikuyu: to bangʼ kosengʼiyore maber to owuok odhi adhiya mi wiye wil gi kite gisano.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka koro oganda maduongʼ mar joneno opie molworowa ka bor polo kama, to wan bende wawituru gimoro amora ma watingʼo manyalo duodowa e wuoth, kaachiel gi richo mora amora manyalo duodowa e ngimawa, koro waringuru matek ma ok waol e ngʼwech moseketwae.
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

kikuyu: Timbe mamoko mag loch Jeroboam kaka lwenje mane okedo kod kaka nobedo e loch ondiki e kitepe mag rapar mag ruodhi mag Israel.
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: ataro dine odinonwa, ee, kodh yamo dine oywerowa,
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Olemb joma kare en yadh ngima, to ngʼatno ma reso chunje riek.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

kikuyu: “Anachiw Zedekia ruodh Juda kod jotende ne wasike madwaro ngimagi, ne jolwenj ruodh Babulon, mosengʼanyo oa kuomu.
english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.

kikuyu: Kaka amedo puonjora chikeni makare e kaka abiro dhi nyime gi paki gi chuny moriere tir.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

kikuyu: Timbe mamono mag ngʼama jaricho obedone obadho mamake, tonde mag richone tweye matek.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

kikuyu: Eka Nebukadneza nowacho niya, “Opak Nyasach Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego nikech en ema oseoro malaikane mi oreso jotichne! Negigeno kuome mi gidagi luwo chikna kendo ne giyie wito ngimagi kar tiyona kata lamo nyasaye moro machielo ma ok Nyasachgi giwegi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God.

kikuyu: Negia malo kendo negidok piyo Jerusalem. Kuno negiyudo ji apar gachielgo gi jogo mane ni kodgi, ka gichokore kaachiel,
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mon-gi ngʼama chwako jaketho kata kumo ngʼat maonge ketho.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: En to nowacho niya, “Ruodha, in iwuon ema ne isingorina an jatichni e nying Jehova Nyasaye Nyasachi ni, ‘Solomon wuodi enobed ruoth bangʼa kendo enobed e kom duongʼ mara.’
english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

kikuyu: Kane gimake, negidhiyo kode ka gitere ei od jadolo maduongʼ. Petro noluwogi gichien.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

kikuyu: Chokuru jokedo mau, yaye dala maduongʼ mar jokedo, nikech wasikwa osegonwa agengʼa. Gibiro goyo lemb ruodh jo-Israel gi luth.
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

kikuyu: Nikech nangʼado wach e chunya ni kik angʼe gimoro amora machielo makmana Yesu Kristo kod gur mare.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

kikuyu: Ibrahim kod wuode Ishmael noter nyangu odiechiengno.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

kikuyu: Nokawo Kite mag Rapar moketo ei Sanduk Muma; norwako ludhe e chumbe molworore mag Sanduk eka noyieyo raum e wiye.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

kikuyu: Mad ji paki, yaye Nyasaye; mad ji duto opaki.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Ben-Hadad noyie gi ruoth Asa kendo nooro jotende mag lweny mondo omonj mier matindo mag Israel. Noloyo Ijon gi Dan gi Abel Beth Maaka kod Kinereth duto kaachiel gi Naftali.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngero machon wacho ni, ‘Joma timo timbe maricho ema timbe maricho wuok kuomgi’ omiyo ok abi keto lweta kuomi.
english: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo e od Jairo, ne ok oyie ni ngʼato moro amora mondo odonj kode makmana Petro, Johana gi Jakobo kod wuon nyathi gi min mare.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

kikuyu: Ne onge lweny kendo nyaka higa mar piero adek gabich mar loch Asa.
english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

kikuyu: Chunguru wadhi! Jandhokna osechopo!”
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Chik nochiw kokalo kuom Musa, to ngʼwono kod adiera, to Yesu Kristo ema nokelo.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Modekai ne en ngʼama duongʼ e dala ruoth; humbe nolandore e gwenge duto kendo tekone ne osiko medore ameda.
english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

kikuyu: nikech Ruoth Nyasaye ok nyal jwangʼo ngʼato nyaka chiengʼ.
english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

kikuyu: Chakre ndalo mag Johana ja-Batiso nyaka sani, pinyruodh polo osebedo ka idonje githuon, kendo joma thuondi ema kawe.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

kikuyu: kata obedo ni Nyasaye nosewachone motelo niya, “wuodi Isaka ema kothi duto nowuogie.”
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

kikuyu: Ne en kod pith mag jamni kod pith mag dhok kod jotich mangʼeny mi nyiego nomako jo-Filistia kode.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

kikuyu: Kendo e ndalo Zerubabel gi Nehemia, jo-Israel duto nochako kelo pok mapile pile ni jower kod jorit dhorangeye. Bende negiketo tenge pok ni jo-Lawi mamoko, to jo-Lawi bende nomiyo nyikwa Harun pokgi.
english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.

kikuyu: Yaye joga, rwakuru lepu mag ywak kendo ngʼielreuru e buru; gouru nduru ka udengo malit mana ka ngʼama ywago wuode achiel kende, nimar apoya nono jaketh gik moko biro podho kuomwa.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

kikuyu: Omiyo ayudo chikni katiyo: Ni ka adwaro timo gima ber, to apo ka rach bende ni koda.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

kikuyu: Joma odak Maroth chunygi chandore ka nigi rem mapek ka girito kony, nikech masira osebiro koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye mochopo nyaka dhoranga Jerusalem.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Uparo nade? Ka ngʼato nigi rombe mia achiel, to achiel kuomgi olal, donge ngʼatno diwe piero ochiko gochikogo mi odhi omany achiel molalno?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Abiro timo mana gino ma isekwayo nimar amor kodi kendo angʼeyi gi nyingi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

kikuyu: Kik uyie ngʼato wuondu gi weche manono, nikech gik ma kamago ema miyo Nyasaye olo mirimbe kuom joma ok winj wachne.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Ok watem pwoyorenu, to wamiyou gima unyalo sungorugo kuomwa, mondo uyud gima unyalo dwokogo joma sungore nikech timbegi ma oko mineno, to ok nikech gima ni e chunygi.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

kikuyu: Omiyo koth chue ewi gode koa e dalane manie polo; piny nyago olembe moromo nikech tijene.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

kikuyu: To an ok oseelna tiend midhieroni nikech ariek moloyo ji mamoko mangima, to oseelnago mondo in, yaye ruoth, ingʼe tiende, kendo mondo ingʼe gima nobiro e pachi.
english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

kikuyu: Koro jo-Sodom ne gin joma okethore kendo matimo richo mag wangʼ teko e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Lea nowacho niya, “Amor manade! Mon biro luonga ni jahawi.” Omiyo nochake ni Asher.
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

kikuyu: Notelo ni Daudi ka gilor mwalo, kendo ne giyudogi ka gike e pap, ka gichiemo kendo metho ka gin gimor maduongʼ nikech gik mane gipeyo e piny jo-Filistia gi piny Juda ne thoth ahinya.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

kikuyu: kendo ginibedi ler mae kor polo mondo gi chiw ler e piny.” Kendo nobedo kamano.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Nimar kokecho kodi mochwadi to en bende ema ochako othiedho kuonde mohinyorego.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

kikuyu: Mapiyo piyo kochako locho, nonego jood Jeroboam duto. Ne ok oweyo ni Jeroboam kata ngʼato achiel mayweyo to notiekogi kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye mane omiyo jatichne Ahija ja-Shilo;
english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

kikuyu: Nyaka aa chakruok mar piny, gik ma ok ne mag Nyasaye, kaka tekone mochwere gi kite, osenenore malongʼo ka gifwenyore e gik mosechweyo, mondo omi dhano kik wuondre ni kiagi.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

kikuyu: kendo nomiyogi piny jogo kaka girkeni, kaka girkeni ne joge ma gin jo-Israel.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

kikuyu: “Hekalu ma anager nobed maduongʼ nikech Nyasachwa duongʼ moloyo nyiseche mamoko duto.
english: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

kikuyu: Hushai nodwoko Abisalom niya, “Rieko ma Ahithofel ongʼado kawuononi ok ber.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Azmaveth, ji piero angʼwen gariyo (42),
english: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni apar gauchiel kane odoko ruoth, kendo nobedo ruoth kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero abich gariyo. Min mare ne nyinge Jekolia, ma nyar Jerusalem.
english: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Neuru, abiro miyo Jerusalem bedo gima bwogo ji duto modak machiegni kode. Juda ibiro goyone agengʼa, kaachiel gi Jerusalem.
english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Joma otony modongʼ noringi kadhi ei gode. Ginichur ka akuche modak ei holo, giduto giniywagi, nikech richogi.
english: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

kikuyu: To Yesu nosiemogi matek ni kik ginyis ngʼato moro amora gima nosetimore, bangʼe nonyisogi ni mondo gimi nyakono gimoro ocham.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: In ema aketo genona kuomi, yaye Nyasacha. Kik iwe ane wichkuot, bende kik iwe wasika loya.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

kikuyu: Ngʼama omingʼ ok nyal ngʼeyo, joma ofuwo ok winj tiend wachno,
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

kikuyu: Awachonu Adier e nyim Nyasaye ni weche ma andikonugi ok gin miriambo.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kohath ne gin: Amram, Izhar, Hebron kod Uziel.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Nangʼicho mi naneno kodh yamo kabiro koa yo nyandwat. Nobiro gi bor polo mangʼongo gi mil polo mapiachore kendo maler maduongʼ olworo koni gi koni. Chuny majno ne chalo gi chuma maliet,
english: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno anawuog oko mondo atiek pinje duto mamonjo Jerusalem.
english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To tinde ka ok uriwru gi joma kamago e oowruok mar ngima monjawni, to giwuoro kendo giyanyou.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

kikuyu: Koa kuom jo-Amram, gi joka Izhar gi joka Hebron kod joka Uziel noyier,
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

kikuyu: Baal-Hanan ja-Geder to norito yiend zeituni gi yiende ngʼowu mane ni e bwo gode e yo podho chiengʼ, Joash nochungʼne kano mo zeituni.
english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

kikuyu: Neye kaka wasika osemedore kendo kaka gichaya gi chunygi duto!
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

kikuyu: to kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye en ngʼama kare; osegola e badho mar joma timbegi richo.”
english: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ibrahim ne ja-higni piero ochiko gochiko kane otere nyangu,
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Onge dala maduongʼ moro amora mane otimo winjruok gi jo-Israel makmana jo-Hivi modak Gibeon. Joma odongʼ duto negikedogo.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

kikuyu: to obiro dhi mi oriwre gi tiengʼ machon mar kwerene, ma ok nyal neno ler mar wangʼ chiengʼ kendo.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

kikuyu: “Bende ka ulamo, to kik uchal gi joma wuondore, nimar gihero lamo ka gichungʼ ei sinagoke, kendo e akek yore mondo ji onegi. Awachonu adier ni giseyudo pokgi duto.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka hembe magi ber neno, yaye Jakobo, kuondeni mag dak, yaye Israel!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

kikuyu: Bende an gi teko mar konyora kenda ka koro giga duto osegol kuoma?
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

kikuyu: Kane joote man Jerusalem owinjo ni jo-Samaria noserwako wach Nyasaye, negioro Petro gi Johana irgi.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

kikuyu: To kata ka ochuno ni nyaka une sand kuom gima kare mutimo, to un joma ogwedhi. “Kik uluor gik ma giluoro, kendo kata bwok kik ubwogi.”
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

kikuyu: To winji, lwet Ruoth Nyasaye koro kedo kodi. Ibiro bedo muofu, kendo kuom kinde moromo ok ibi neno ler mar chiengʼ gi wangʼi.” Gikanyono mudho mandiwa nobiro moimo wangʼe, mi nochako tangni komulo gik moko gi lwete ka gi kacha, mondo oyudie ngʼato mane nyalo mako bade kataye.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

kikuyu: To kuom chier mar joma otho, donge usesomo gima Nyasaye nowachonu ni,
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

kikuyu: Kane oneno ka timneno nomoro jo-Yahudi, nodhi nyime momako Petro bende. Mano notimore e ndalo Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Ludhegi ne boyo ahinya ma gikogi ne inyalo ne koa e nyim Kama Ler e nyim kama ler mar lemo, to ne ok ginen gi oko mar Kama Ler kendo pod gin kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto mane nitie e holo noneno ka jolweny oseringo, kendo ni Saulo gi yawuote bende nosetho, negijwangʼo miechgi ma giringo. Kendo jo-Filistia nobiro modak e miechgigo.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Emomiyo gouru oriti ne jo-Meresheth Gath, ok nochak ochungʼ kendo. Dala maduongʼ mar Akzib osewuondo ruodhi mag Israel.
english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye konyogi kendo resogi oresogi e lwet joma timbegi richo, kendo owarogi, nikech gipondo kuome.
english: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

kikuyu: Kendo noluongu ni jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye, kendo noluongu ni jotich Nyasachwa. Unucham mwandu mag pinje kendo unungʼaru gi sunga kuom mwandugigo.
english: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

kikuyu: Onge kata mana ngʼato achiel kuomgi ma ol kata machwanyore, bende onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomgi ma nindo tero, bende onge moro ma okanda ombekni e nungone kata ma tond wuochene ochot.
english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, awachoni niya, “In Nyasacha.” Omiyo yie iwinja, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, winj ywak ma aywaknigo mondo ikecha.
english: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

kikuyu: kuom ngʼeyo, utene maiye ipongʼo gi gik moko ma ok yudo yot kod mwandu mabeyo.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma itero e Hema, jo-Lawi ema nyaka gole oko, kendo kamoro amora midhi gure Hema, jo-Lawi ema nyaka gure. Ngʼato angʼata mosudo machiegni kode nyaka negi.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka higni angʼwen noserumo, Abisalom nowachone ruoth niya, “Yiena mondo adhi Hebron kendo achop singruok moro mane atimo gi Jehova Nyasaye.
english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.

kikuyu: Ne en dwe mar ochiko kendo ruoth nobet ei ot mar oyo mach e kinde mar chwiri.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

kikuyu: Opato ema urwaki, to kik utingʼ kata law machielo miloko.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

kikuyu: Kendo Daudi nongʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osegure kaka ruodh Israel kendo ni osetingʼ pinyruodhe malo nikech joge Israel.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Higa ka higa ngʼatni ne wuok e dalane kodhi lemo kendo timo misango ne Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e Shilo, kuma Hofni gi Finehas, yawuot Eli ariyo, ne jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.

kikuyu: Pile ka pile Modekai ne wuotho e dala kanyo machiegni gi koma ochiel ni mon mondo ongʼe kaka Esta dhi kod gik mane timorene.
english: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.

kikuyu: In ema imiyo tacha siko kaliel, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; Nyasacha loko mudho mouma doko ler.
english: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

kikuyu: Ka omor ka polo, to pige manie polo wuo; omiyo boche polo dhwolore koa e giko piny. Ooro mil polo gi koth kendo okelo yamo koa e kuondege mag keno.
english: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Biuru uneye gik ma Nyasaye osetimo; bi uneye kaka gik motimo ne dhano dongo!
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ungʼicho gi nyiego, yaye gode mojuothore, angʼo momiyo nyiego omakou gi got kama Nyasaye oyiero mondo ogurie lochne, kama Jehova Nyasaye owuon biro dakie nyaka chiengʼ?
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Dan: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Shem nonywolo: Elam, Ashur, Arfaksad, Lud kod Aram.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

kikuyu: Gin gi Saulo gi jo-Israel duto e holo mar Ela, ka gikedo gi jo-Filistia.”
english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

kikuyu: Haran notho e dalagi miluongo ni Ur manie piny Kaldea kane Tera wuon mare pod ngima.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

kikuyu: Tongʼ pinyno nochopo nyaka Tabor, Shahazuma gi Beth Shemesh, mi ogik nyaka aora Jordan. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gauchiel.
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Chenro ok chopi nikech onge puonj makare, to ka giyudo jongʼad rieko mangʼeny to gichopo.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

kikuyu: kata gimoro amora mane okwongʼoree gi miriambo. Nyaka ochul gigo duto mi omedie achiel kuom abich mar nengogi kendo mondo ochiwgi duto ne wuon-gi chiengʼ mochiwoe misango mipwodhego e kethoneno.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye ongʼeyo ni sa ma unuchame wengeu noyepi kendo unubed machal gi Nyasaye, kungʼeyo ber gi rach.”
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, onge ngʼama noket kare e nyime kuom timo gik ma Chik owacho, to kuom Chik ema dhano ngʼeyoe kethone.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Ruoth Solomon nohero nyi pinje mamoko mangʼeny; mane omedo bangʼ nyar Farao kaka nyi jo-Moab gi jo-Amon gi jo-Edom gi jo-Sidon kod nyi jo-Hiti.
english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

kikuyu: Nochako nyathi ma wuowino ni Ikabod kowacho niya, “Duongʼ oseweyo Israel, nikech negikawo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye kod tho mar kwar mare gi mar chwore.”
english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

kikuyu: Bende ioro mor polo e yoregi ma giluwo? Bende digiduoki kagiwacho ni, ‘Eri wan ka’?
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

kikuyu: Piny ma yande otwo nolokre dago, kendo achiya nowuog e lowo motwo. Lum, odundu kod togo nodongi kama ondiegi yande odakie.
english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

kikuyu: Abiro kiro pi maler kuomu mi udok jomaler; abiro pwodhou kuom timbeu mamono kendo kuom nyisecheu duto mopa.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jo-Yahudi mangʼeny mane obiro hoyo chuny Maria, kendo ma noneno gima Yesu notimo, noyie kuome.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

kikuyu: “To sani, yaye Nyasachwa, en angʼo ma wanyalo wacho bangʼ ma? Nimar ok waseluoro chike
english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

kikuyu: “Kik iyie kawo asoya, nikech asoya dino wenge jogo maneno kendo omiyo ngʼat makare bedo ngʼama rach.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

kikuyu: Kane jolweny odwogo e kambi, jodong Israel nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye oseweyo jo-Filistia oloyowa kawuononi? Waomuru Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye man Shilo, mondo odhi kodwa kendo oreswa e lwet wasikwa.”
english: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has the LORD defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

kikuyu: Mikaya nowachone niya, “Kidwogo kingima, to kara ok asewuoyo gi dho Jehova Nyasaye.” Bangʼe nomedo wacho niya, “Winjuru wechena un ji duto!”
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

kikuyu: Unubed gi yawuowi kod nyiri to ok unuritgi nimar notergi e twech e pinje mamoko.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

kikuyu: Wuowi mofuwo kelone wuon mare masira, to dhako maralep chalo gi kodh ajiki.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

kikuyu: Daudi owuon wacho maler e Kitabu mar Zaburi niya, “ ‘Ruoth Nyasaye nowachone Ruodha ni, “Bed e bada korachwich,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

kikuyu: Mano kaka unune malit un jo-Asuria, luth ma agoyogo ji ka akecho, en e luth ma akumogo ji ka mirima omaka!
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

kikuyu: En ewi ringruok, ma en kanisa, kendo en ema nokwongo chier koa kuom joma otho mondo obed gi loch kuom gik moko duto.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

kikuyu: kendo norito piny kuom higni adek kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Maaka ma nyar Uriel ja-Gibea. Ne nitiere lweny e kind Abija kod Jeroboam.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

kikuyu: Joma ochando nobedie e pinyu ndalo duto. Kuom mano achikou mondo ubed gi chuny ma thuolo kuom oweteu, joma odhier kod joma ochando e pinyu.
english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

kikuyu: Enoluong-gi ni Oganda Maler, ma Jehova Nyasaye Osewalo; kendo noluongi ni Dala Midwaro Gwedho ma en Dala Maduongʼ Ma Ok Nochak Ojwangʼ.
english: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

kikuyu: To koro ere jonabi mane okoroni ni, ‘Ruodh jo-Babulon ok nomonj pinyu kata in?’
english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo penjogi niya, “To un to? Uwacho ni An ngʼa?” Petro nodwoke niya, “In e Kristo.”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

kikuyu: to jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik ne manyo yo moro malingʼ-lingʼ ma ditiek-go Yesu, nikech negiluoro oganda.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

kikuyu: Onge nyiri mane ber e piny ngima ka nyi Ayub, kendo wuon-gi nopogonegi girkeni mage maromre gi owetegi.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

kikuyu: Un ne ok uyiera, an ema nayierou kendo aketou mondo udhi unyag olemo, ma en olemo masiko. Eka Wuora biro miyou gimoro amora mukwayo e nyinga.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi duto mane nitiere e dala maduongʼ malerno ne romo ji mia ariyo gi piero aboro gangʼwen (284).
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

kikuyu: E ndalono mane Joshua odhi kendo otieko jo-Anak moa e piny gode, ema bende notieke joma odak, Hebron, Debir kod Anab, mago moa e pinje gode mag Juda, to gi moa e pinje gode mag Israel. Joshua notiekogi duto kod miechgi.
english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye ogolo chik negibet e kambi, kendo kane ochako ogolo chik to negichako wuoth. Negirito weche Jehova Nyasaye, kaluwore gi chik mane ochiwo kokalo kuom Musa.
english: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: mi openjogi niya, “Bende ne uyudo Roho Maler chiengʼ mane uyie kuom Yesu?” Negidwoke niya, “Ooyo, kata mana winjo pok wawinjo ni nitie gimoro ni Roho Maler.”
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Awacho mano mondo akuodgo wiu. Bende dibed ni onge ngʼato e dieru kata achiel mariek manyalo ngʼado bura weche man e kind joma oyie?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

kikuyu: Jehu nowachone Bidkar jatend gechene mag lweny niya, “Kawe ibole e puodho mane mar Naboth ja-Jezreel. Par kaka in kod an ne wariembo gechewa kanyachiel bangʼ Ahab ma wuon-gi kane Jehova Nyasaye okoro wachni kuome kama:
english: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden on him:

kikuyu: Magi e joma nobiro ir Daudi Ziklag kane Saulo wuod Kish oseriembe e nyime (jogi ne gin achiel kuom jolweny mane okonye e lweny;
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo pwodh kendo mar misango kendo kete obed maler. Eka kendo mar misango biro bedo maler moloyo kendo gimoro amora morere kuome nobed maler.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nigi ich wangʼ kod ogendini duto; mirimbe ochomo jolweny mag-gi duto. Obiro tiekogi duto, mi nochiwgi mondo otiekgi.
english: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

kikuyu: To kane oyudo ji duto nindo, jasike nobiro mopidho buya e dier ngano, bangʼe to odhi.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

kikuyu: Kane Samuel owinjo weche duto mane ji owacho, ne onyiso Jehova Nyasaye wechego mana kaka ne gikwayo.
english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mani ne achiewo kendo ne angʼiyo alworana. To nindo mara nobedona mamit.
english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

kikuyu: To kane gipimogi gi gir pimo mar omer, ngʼat mane ochoko mangʼeny ok ne nigi mangʼeny bende ngʼat mane ochoko matin ok ne nigi matin ahinya. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nochoko mana mangʼeny moromo gi dwarone.
english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

kikuyu: Ngʼatni nyalo bedo owad gi wuon, kata wuod wuon kata mana watne moro amora e anywolane. To en bende kobedo ja-mwandu to onyalo warore owuon.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

kikuyu: Filipo nodwoke niya, “Kata chudo mar ngʼato mar dweche aboro ok dingʼiewgo makati moromo, ma ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom jogi duto nyalo yudo kata matin!”
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

kikuyu: Pak Jehova Nyasaye, yaye chunya, kendo kik wiyi wil gi konyruok mochiwo,
english: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

kikuyu: Yaw wengena mondo eka ane gik mabeyo miwuoro manie chikeni.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

kikuyu: To kuom gode matindo ma yande ipuro gi kwer, to ok unudhie kendo nikech luoro mar pedo mogawore kod kuthe, to ginibed kuonde ma dhok gi rombe kwayoe.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

kikuyu: “Omiyo ritreuru nikech ok ungʼeyo sa ma wuon ot nyalo biroe: kata nobi odhiambo kata chuny otieno, kata kogwen, kata ka piny yawore.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

kikuyu: Jaherana nowuoyo kendo nowachona niya, “Aa malo jaherana, bi wadhiyo, yaye jaber.
english: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

kikuyu: “Winjuru ma, yaye un joka Jakobo, miluongo ni jo-Israel kendo ma koth Juda, un ma ukwongʼoru gi nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo un muluongo nying Nyasach Israel, to ok e yo madiera kata makare;
english: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—

kikuyu: To in, yaye Nyasaye, ineno chandruok gi kuyo, ikawogi kaka mari kendo itingʼogi e lweti. Ngʼat ma ok nyal; chiwore ne in; in e jakony mar joma onge wuonegi.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

kikuyu: Eka Delila nowachone Samson niya, “Isekawa ngʼama ofuwo; ne iwuonda. Bi mondo koro inyisa kaka inyalo tweyi.”
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”

kikuyu: Nimar joma nok modongʼ nowuog Jerusalem kendo oganda mar joma otony nowuogi koa e Got Sayun. Jehova Nyasaye Maratego notim ma kuom tekone owuon.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. The LORD’s zeal will perform this.

kikuyu: Mana kaka oyundi mafuyo kata ka opija maringo e kaka kwongʼ maonge gimomiyo kadho akadha.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

kikuyu: Adier, onge gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto nyalo timo e dala ma ok ofwenyo, ne jotichne ma jonabi.
english: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne gigwelo jowetegi mane ni e yie machielo mondo obi okonygi, to kane gibiro to negipongʼo yiedhi ariyogo ma gichako nimo.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

kikuyu: Nomedo wachonegi niya, “Pi mokwal mit, chiemo michamo apanda ema nigi ndhandhu moloyo!”
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

kikuyu: to in ema imiyowa loch ewi wasikwa, imiyo joma kedo kodwa neno wichkuot.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

kikuyu: Jodolo, jo-Lawi, jorit dhorangeye, jower kod jotij hekalu, kaachiel gi jomoko kod jo-Israel mamoko, nodak mana e miechgi. Kane dwe mar abiriyo ochopo kendo jo-Israel noyudo osedak e miechgi,
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

kikuyu: Kane Modekai obet e dhoranga ruoth kaka nojabet, Bigthana gi Teresh, ariyo kuom jotend ruoth mane rito rangach, nokecho kendo negichano mondo gineg ruoth Ahasuerus.
english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: Jal manyiso wechegi duto wacho niya, “Ee, abiro mapiyo.” Amin! Bi, Ruoth Yesu.
english: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

kikuyu: Ka tije duto mane ruoth Solomon osetimo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye noserumo, nokelo gik mane Daudi wuon-gi osewalo kaka fedha gi dhahabu kod gik mitimogo lemo kendo noketogi e od keno mar hekalu Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Humb Yesu ne olandore piyo piyo e gwenge duto molworo Galili.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Dishon, Ezer kod Dishan. Magi ema ne jodong jo-Hori, kaluwore gi dhoutgi e piny mar Seir.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

kikuyu: Kama gimoro othoe ema achudhe chokore.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

kikuyu: E kindeno anakum jogo mane osandi, anakony rongʼonde kendo anachok joga mane oke e pinje. Abiro miyogi pak gi huma e piny ka piny mane okuodie wigi.
english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

kikuyu: Eka nonyiso ngʼatno mondo owach ne Modekai niya,
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

kikuyu: Maria ma aa Magdala kod Maria min Joses noneno kama nopiele Yesu.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kikuyu: Abiro pongʼo gode magi gi ringre joma otho, joma ligangla onego biro podho ewi godeni matindo, kaachiel gi holni kod kuonde rogo duto.
english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

kikuyu: Haman nowuok kanyo kamor kendo ka chunye opongʼ gi ilo. To kane oneno Modekai e dhoranga ruoth ka ok ochungʼ ne kata nyiso luor e nyime, mirima nomake nikech Modekai.
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi mangʼeny ma mbesena ne aloyo kuom lony e kit lemo marwa, kendo ne aketo chunya mar rito chike duto mag kwerena.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik ne Hilkia jadolo maduongʼ, gi jodolo maluwe kod jorit dhoot mondo ogol oko gik moko duto mopa milamogo Baal gi siro mar Ashera kod kit gik moko manie kor polo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ne owangʼogi e bath Jerusalem e paw aora Kidron mi otero buchgi Bethel.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of the LORD’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

kikuyu: Tahath nonywolo Zabad bangʼe Zabad nonywolo Shuthela. Yawuot Efraim moko ne gin Ezer kod Elead mane onegi gi jo-Gath ma jopinyno kane gidhi peyo jambgi.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseyierogi kod nyikwagi kagiwuok e dhoutu duto mondo gichungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka gitiyone kinde duto.
english: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the LORD’s name, him and his sons forever.

kikuyu: kendo negisiko ka gidhi ire sa ka sa kagiwachone niya, “Ruodh jo-Yahudi, mondo omi duongʼ!” Negisiko ka githalo lembe.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

kikuyu: Jorieko moko mag Epikurio kod Stoiko nochako mino kode wach. Moko kuomgi nopenjo niya, “Angʼo ma jawach thoreni temo wacho?” To moko nowacho niya, “Chal ka gima oyalo kuom nyiseche moko ma welo.” Negiwacho kamano nikech Paulo ne yalo kuom Yesu kendo kuom chier.
english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Satan niya, “Ia kanye?” Satan nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Asebedo ka abayo abaya e piny, kendo alworora koni gi koni.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Kore tek ka lwanda, kendo otek mana ka pongʼ rego.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

kikuyu: Owuoyo gi ji e lek, kata e fweny gotieno seche ma dhano ni e nindo matut, ka giyweyo e otendnigi;
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

kikuyu: Anadiri oko kod miyo mane onywoli e piny machielo, kama onge ngʼama nonywole kuomu, kendo kanyo ema uduto unuthoe.
english: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nebukadneza noloso kido moro mar dhahabu ma borne noromo fut piero aboro gaboro gi nus, to lachne ne en fut apar, kendo nochunge e paw Dura e piny Babulon.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

kikuyu: Ere nyiseche mag Hamath gi Arpad? Ere nyiseche mag Sefarvaim? Bende ne gireso Samaria e lweta?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye oneno ni negibolore kamano, wach mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Shemaya niya, “Nikech gisebolore e nyima ok anatiekgi to abiro resogi bangʼ ndalo manok. Mirimba ok nool Jerusalem koa e lwet Shishak.
english: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

kikuyu: punda mar thim mongʼiyo gi kama otwo, ma ngʼweyo yamo kodwaro thuondi; en ngʼa madigengʼe? Onge thuon manyalo thagore ka dware nikech yude yot ka kinde miringo kode ochopo.
english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

kikuyu: jodologi ne onegi, kendo mondegi ne ywak otamo.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

kikuyu: Isemiyo wabedo ka yugi kendo ka owuoyo e kind ogendini.
english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno noa modhi onyiso jo-Yahudi ni Yesu ema nochange.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko Gad niya, “An-gi chuny lit ahinya. Ber mondo alwar e lwet Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ngʼwonone duongʼ, to kik iweya alwar e lwet ji.”
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”
