kikuyu: “To Ruoth nodwokgi ni, ‘Awachonu adier ni, gimoro amora mane utimo ne achiel kuom owetenagi matinie mogik, ne utimona.’
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

kikuyu: Bende wanyalo kawo yiedhi madongo kaka ranyisi. Kata obedo ni gidongo miwuoro kendo iriembogi gi yembe man-gi teko madongo, to pod ichikogi mana gi ngai matin nono mi gichom kamoro amora ma jakwangʼ yie dwaro ni gidhiye.
english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

kikuyu: Nooro Musa jatichne, gi Harun, ngʼat mane oseyiero.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: nikech ondiki niya, “Beduru maler nikech aler.”
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼanyone, oganda mar joler kod misengni mitimo pile ka pile noket e lwete. Gimoro amora mane otimo ne odhi maber, kendo adiera nojwangʼ.
english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

kikuyu: Yawuot Musa, ngʼat Nyasaye, to nokwan kaka achiel kuom dhood jo-Lawi.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

kikuyu: Omiyo jogo duto notongʼo bede yath mi giluwo bangʼ Abimelek. Negichano yiendego e kor ot mar hekaluno gi oko eka ne gimoko mach kuom ji ei dalano. Omiyo ji duto mane nitiere kama oger motingʼore gi malo mar Shekem notho, chwo kod mon madirom ji alufu achiel.
english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero ariyo gadek mar loch Joash wuod Ahazia ruodh Juda, Jehoahaz wuod Jehu nobedo ruodh Israel ka en Samaria kendo nobedo e ruoth kuom higni apar gabiriyo.
english: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

kikuyu: Yesu ne wuoyo kuom tho Lazaro, to jopuonjrene to ne paro ni oloso mana kuom nindo mapile.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachone jo-Israel niya, “Biuru kae kendo uchik itu ne weche Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: Mbithe moa e bungu kethe, kendo le mag bungu chame.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

kikuyu: Eka chokruokno nomiyo jolweny alufu apar gariyo chik mondo gidhi Jabesh Gilead kendo gineg joma odak kanyo machwo, kaachiel gi mon gi nyithindo.
english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

kikuyu: Ka kinde mag Pasaka mar jo-Yahudi ne chiegni chopo, Yesu nodhi Jerusalem.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Notere ir ruoth Ahasuerus e ot ma ruoth dakie e dwe mar apar miluongo ni Tebeth, e hike mar abiriyo mar lochne.
english: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

kikuyu: En mana kaka ondiki e kitap Janabi Isaya niya, “Abiro oro jaotena otel e nyimi, obiro losoni yo.”
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

kikuyu: “Unune malit un joma olony e chik, nikech usemayo ji rayaw mar dhood rieko. Un uwegi pok udonjo kendo joma donjo bende usegengʼonegi.”
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

kikuyu: Koso wadwaro miyo Ruoth mirima? Waparo ni watek moloye?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

kikuyu: “Dine atho ei minwa, kata dine obwoga ka inywola?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, en mana Sara chiegi ema nonywolni wuowi, kendo iniluong nyinge ni Isaka. Anaket singruokna kode kaka singruok manyaka chiengʼ ne nyikwaye.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nochopo e dala moro e piny Samaria miluongo ni Sukar, mane ni machiegni gi puodho mane Jakobo omiyo Josef wuode.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

kikuyu: Jogi nokawo pinyno modakie kendo nichiwo ne joma odhier gik ma gilando, kigolo kuom mwanduni mogundho, yaye Nyasaye.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

kikuyu: Kuom wach nyiri ma ok okendi to awacho kama: Aonge gi chik moa kuom Ruoth, to achiwo pacha kaka ngʼat ma wechene inyalo geno kuom ngʼwono mar Ruoth.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

kikuyu: Bende nomuko agola mane otiyogo chiengʼ Sabato kod rangach ma oko mane odonjogo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, nikech winjruok marach e kindgi gi ruodh Asuria.
english: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to the LORD’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Kane ruodhi mag nyako ma jatichno oneno kaka ohandgi mane giyudogo pesa orumo, negimako Paulo gi Sila mi giywayogi oko nyaka chuny chiro mondo jotelo oyalgi.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

kikuyu: Anami ogendini maroteke moriwore moa yo nyandwat obi omonj Babulon. Ginikaw keregi mondo gimonje, kendo koa yo nyandwat enomake. Aserni mag-gi nochal gi jolweny molony, ma ok duogi gi lwetgi nono.”
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

kikuyu: Halohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

kikuyu: To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, timna maber nikech nyingi; konya nikech ber mar herani.
english: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

kikuyu: Omiyo nokadho e piny got mar Efraim kod alwora mar Shalisha, to ok ne giyudogi. Negidhiyo ma gichopo e gwenge mag Shaalim, to punde ne onge kuondego. Eka nokadho e piny Benjamin, to ne ok giyudogi.
english: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

kikuyu: Josunga ok nyal chungʼ e nyimi; imon gi ji duto matimo gik maricho.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Yawuot Hebron ne gin: Kora, Tapua, Rekem kod Shema.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

kikuyu: Noyiero mondo osandre gi jo-Nyasaye moloyo dak e mor mar richo marumo piyo nono.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

kikuyu: Gik momako tiendegigo ne dongo mamiyo ji hum, kendo kargi angʼwen negipongʼ gi wenge e bethegi alwora koni gi koni.
english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano malaika mar auchiel nogoyo turumbetene, mi nawinjo dwol moa e tunge mag kendo mar misango mar dhahabu manie nyim Nyasaye.
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

kikuyu: Winja, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; winj gima joma donjona wacho!
english: Give heed to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

kikuyu: to kik iyie olok pachi kata winjo wachne. Kik itimne ngʼwono moro amora kendo kik iluwe kata pande.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

kikuyu: to ka udagi kendo ungʼanyo to ligangla notieku.” Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, yier jo-Lawi mondo obed jorit Hemb Romo mar Rapar kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye. Gin ema nyaka gitingʼ Hemb Romo gi gige; kendo girite maber ka gilwore kod hembegi koni gi koni.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

kikuyu: Ka anyalo wuoyonu kaka nyithinda, to awachonu ni, un bende yawnwauru chunyu malach!
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nono joma kare, to joma timbegi richo kod joma ohero mahundu, to chunye ochayo.
english: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

kikuyu: Chwore imiyo luor e dhoranga dala maduongʼ, kama obedoe e dier jodongo mag gwengʼ.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

kikuyu: kendo nowachonegi niya, “Ooyo jowadwa, kik utim tim makweroni!
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

kikuyu: Simon Petro nodwoke niya, “In e Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye Mangima.”
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: To nyiseche manono, jatheth nyalo loso kendo jatheth nyalo bawe gi dhahabu, mi olosne thiwni mar fedha.
english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane okor kuom Damaski: “Neuru, Damaski ok nochak obed dala maduongʼ, to obiro bedo pidhe mag gik mokethi.
english: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

kikuyu: Paruru gik mosekadho, gigo mane otimore chon, An e Nyasaye kendo onge moro machielo, bende An e Nyasaye kendo onge moro machalo koda.
english: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamon gi owadgi to ni e mudho, kendo mudho nogo ema owuothoe, kokia kuma odhiye, nikech mudho odino wangʼe.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nogologi oko eka openjogi niya, “Jodongo, atim angʼo mondo owara?”
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

kikuyu: gi rwedhi ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe mahikgi oromo higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Magi e misengini mane Shelumiel wuod Zurishadai ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: En gima kwero mondo Nyasaye otim gima ok owinjore; kendo mondo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ongʼad bura ma ok nikare.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

kikuyu: Eka Roho Maler notelo ne Yesu nyaka e thim mondo Satan oteme.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

kikuyu: Kik ugen gimoro un jopur, denguru un jopidh mzabibu, beduru mokuyo nikech ngano gi shairi, nikech cham mochiek manie puothe okethore.
english: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.

kikuyu: Jarito noluongo ruoth monyise. To ruoth nowacho niya, “Ka en kende to nyaka bed ni en gi wach maber.” Kendo ngʼatno nomedo sudo machiegni koringo.
english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

kikuyu: Paulo nodwoke niya, “Sani achungʼ iyala gi Buch Kaisar, kendo ka ema owinjore ongʼadnae bura. Onge gima rach ma asetimo ne jo-Yahudi, kata in bende ingʼeyo wachno maber.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

kikuyu: ochano richo kod miriambo ei chunye, kinde duto okelo miero.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

kikuyu: Koro apenjo niya, Ne Nyasaye okwedo jogo koso? Ooyo, ok kamano ngangʼ! An awuon an ja-Israel ma nyakwar Ibrahim, kendo ma ja-dhood Benjamin.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: To ji mia abich kuom jo-Simeon, ka otelnigi gi Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya kod Uziel, ma yawuot Ishi ne omonjo piny got Seir.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

kikuyu: “Dala kata gwengʼ moro amora mudonje to manyuru ngʼato mowinjore modak kanyo, kendo beduru e ode nyaka chop chiengʼ ma ua.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ok dwara omiyo osegoyo denda gi tuoche magalagala ka en gi mirima kendo kokayona lake, ka wasika to juolona wangʼ-gi ka gisin koda.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

kikuyu: Tongʼ-gi ma yo milambo nochakore e giko mar Nam Chumbi ma yo milambo,
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

kikuyu: Bende ne aneno e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ ranyisi mar rieko mane omora ahinya:
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

kikuyu: Lwar en osimbo mar duongʼ to iyude gi ngʼat man-gi ngima makare.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowuok kendo nomako kibwe mia adek motweyogi gi iwgi ariyo ariyo. Bangʼe notweyo mach e yiw kibwego,
english: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the middle between every two tails.

kikuyu: Achien mogik dhakono bende notho.
english: After them all, the woman died.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne angʼiyogi mondo apudhgi kendo kethogi, mondo awitgi oko ka atiekogi kendo kelonegi chandruok, anaritgi mondo agergi kendo pidhogi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jadolo mowir kendo mowal moketi kar wuon mare ema notimnu pwodhruokni, kendo nyaka orwak lep dolo mag katana maber,
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Yesu, para chiengʼ mibire gi pinyruodhi.”
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno kothgi nongʼere e Israel kaka koth joma ne olony wuochegi.
english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

kikuyu: To nyaka umak Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu motegno, mana kaka usebedo ka utimo.”
english: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

kikuyu: To joma ngima, kende ema nyalo goyoni erokamano, mana kaka atimo kawuononi; wuone bende nyiso nyithindgi adiera mari.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

kikuyu: En angʼo momiyo umiya penjo? Penjuru joma osebedo ka winja. Gin gingʼeyo maber gima nawacho.”
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

kikuyu: To jotend jo-Lawi ne gin: Hashabia, Sherebia, Jeshua wuod Kadmiel, kod jotich kaachiel kodgi, mane ochungʼ ka ngʼiyore ka gipako Nyasaye kendo gidwokone erokamano ka jomoko omo wer to jomoko olo mana kaka Daudi ngʼat Nyasaye nondiko.
english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.

kikuyu: Osepudh oda mi owit mabor mana kaka igolo kiru mar jakwath. Ngimana osengʼad machiek mana kaka jatwengʼo dolo usi mabed machiek kendo asandora pile ka pile, odiechiengʼ kod otieno.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

kikuyu: Noba nomonjo Kenath kod mier molwore kendo nochake nyinge owuon miluongo ni Noba.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

kikuyu: Obiro duogo ngimani kendo obiro riti ndalo ma iti. Nikech chi wuodi moheri kendo maberni moloyo yawuowi abiriyo, ema osenywole.”
english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”

kikuyu: gin jogo machiwo neno mar miriambo mondo omi ngʼato onere ni jaketho, kendo mawuondo jangʼad bura mi omi ngʼat maonge ketho tamie adierane.
english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko niya, “Angʼo machandou koda un yawuot Zeruya? Kawuono usedoko jowasika! Bende onego neg ngʼato e Israel kawuono? Donge angʼeyo ni an ruoth e Israel kawuono?”
english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa kod Eliazar jadolo notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oyundi ariyo donge ingʼiewo otonglo achiel? To kata kamano kata achiel kuomgi ok nyal lwar piny e lowo ka ok Wuonu ema oyie.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

kikuyu: “Biuru mondo wadog ir Jehova Nyasaye. Osekidhowa matindo tindo to obiro changowa; osehinyowa to obiro tweyo adhondewa.
english: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

kikuyu: Eka negimiye lemo ka lemo mar chiayo mar misango miwangʼo pep kaachiel gi wich kendo owangʼogi e kendo mar misango.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

kikuyu: Bende, gigo mag dhahabu gi fedha mag od Nyasaye, mane Nebukadneza okawo koa e hekalu mar Jerusalem mi okelo Babulon, nyaka duog kargi e hekalu man Jerusalem; nyaka duog-gi e kar keno e od Nyasaye.
english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.

kikuyu: Ka abiro bayou gi asernina motingʼo tho kendo maketho gik moko, to abiro dirogi mondo atieku. Abiro kelo, kendo abiro medo kelo kech kendo abiro gengʼo chiemo mondo kik chopnu Jerusalem.
english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

kikuyu: Bende gik moko duto manowal gi Samuel janen kod Saulo wuod Kish, Abner wuod Ner kod Joab wuod Zeruya kaachiel gi gik mamoko duto manowal norit gi Shelomith kod wedene.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

kikuyu: kosetieko chike kod dwarone duto e ringre. Notimo kamano mondo ochwe dhano achiel manyien kuome owuon, kar ji ariyogo, mondo okelgo kwe,
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

kikuyu: joma ywak onego bedi ka joma ok ywagi; joma mor onego odag ka joma ok nigi mor; joma ngʼiewo gimoro onego odag ka gima gik ma gingʼiewogo ok mag-gi,
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ma e gima abiro timonu un jo-Israel, to nikech abiro timonu kama, koro ikreuru mondo urom gi Nyasachu, yaye Israel.”
english: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat minyalo geno gi gima tin, inyalo gene bende gi gik mangʼeny, to ngʼat ma ok ja-adiera gi gima tin bende ok nyal bedo ja-adiera gi gik mangʼeny.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai moko mane ni kode nowinje kowacho kamano mi openje niya, “Iwacho angʼono? Kare wan bende wan muofni?”
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

kikuyu: Kane owuotho odhi, ji nopedho lepgi e yo.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

kikuyu: “Kete omer, nimar osetamore winjo Jehova Nyasaye. We Moab odwanyre e ngʼokne; we obed gima ijaro.
english: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.

kikuyu: Maria nodwoko niya, “An jatich Ruoth, onego timre kaka iwacho.” Eka malaika noweye.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

kikuyu: Kata e kinde mane ogendini ne lamo Jehova Nyasaye, to negisiko mana ka gitiyone nyisechegi manono. Nyithindgi kod nyikwagi pod osiko katimo timbe mane kweregi timo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: So these nations feared the LORD, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ikechwa; nimar chunywa dwari. Miwae teko okinyi ka okinyi, kendo bednwa kar resruok, e kinde mag chandruok.
english: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

kikuyu: Nikech wachni kendo nikech malaike, dhako mondo oum wiye kaka ranyisi ni en e bwo loch.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

kikuyu: Ka ji jaro jowetegi kendo ikwayo Jehova Nyasaye ni, ‘Resgi!’ to Jehova biro reso joma ijarogo.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, isemiya pok makora kod okombena; iserita maber gi giga duto.
english: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

kikuyu: Josef nodhi monyiso Farao niya, “Wuora kod owetene osebiro koa e piny Kanaan kod kwethgi kod dhogi kod gik moko duto ma gin-go kendo koro gidak e piny Goshen.”
english: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

kikuyu: Chakre kawuono kadhi nyime ji abich ma joot achiel biro pogore, ji adek odok kon achiel to ji ariyo bende nodog komachielo.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

kikuyu: Jogo mane otelo e nyim Yesu gi jopuonjrene, kod mago mane odongʼ chien, ne goyo koko niya, “Hosana!” “Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

kikuyu: Jomoko olo dhahabu piny koa ei okepegi kendo pimo fedha e ratil; bangʼe gichulo jatheth, mondo olesnegigo nyasaye, kendo gikulore piny mi gilame.
english: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.

kikuyu: ‘Winj wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ruodh Juda, un joma bet e kom duongʼ Daudi, in, jotendi kod jogi madonjo gie dhorangeyegi.
english: ‘Hear the LORD’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

kikuyu: Nyaka awuo eka abed gi kwe; omiyo nyaka adwoki.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

kikuyu: bende wan gi Ruoth achiel, yie achiel, gi batiso achiel;
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel osetimo richo, kendo giseketho singruokna mane achikogi mondo giriti. Gisekawo bath gik moko mane owal, gisekwalo, giseriambo, kendo gisekawo gigo mokwer ma giriwo gi gig-gi giwegi.
english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Abiro lwenyo yiend othith; nyaka amak olembe gi lweta.” Mad thundeni chal gi olemb, mzabibu mochokore kanyachiel, to tik mar muchi chal gi olemo mayom,
english: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples.

kikuyu: Nimar en jatich Nyasaye moketo mondo okonyi. To ka itimo marach, to bed abeda maluor nikech ok otingʼ ligangla kayiem! En jatich Nyasaye machulo kuor gi mirima kokumo ngʼama timo marach.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

kikuyu: Kane Gideon ofwenyo ni ne en malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye, nowacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto! Aseneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye wangʼ gi wangʼ!”
english: Gideon saw that he was the LORD’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord GOD! Because I have seen the LORD’s angel face to face!”

kikuyu: Nimar ne afwenyo ni rieko mangʼeny kelo kuyo; kendo ngʼeyo mangʼeny medo mana chuny lit.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

kikuyu: To ne nitie jokwadh rombe manodak oko e lek machiegni kanyo, ka girito jambgi gotieno.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

kikuyu: Gilal nono ka lek ma ngʼato oleko gokinyi, omiyo e kinde ma ia malo, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, to ok ibi dewogi mana ka kido maonge.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

kikuyu: E kindeno kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye nobedi e dier piny Misri kendo kidi mar rapar mar Jehova Nyasaye noket e tongʼne.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

kikuyu: “Donge dhano nigi tich matek e piny? Donge ndalone chalo gi ndalo mag ngʼat mondiki kuom kinde machwok?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

kikuyu: E kindeno, ka jo-Benjamin noa Gibea mondo oked kodgi, negichako ginego kendo jo-Israel alufu apar gaboro, ma duto ne nigi ligangla.
english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

kikuyu: Neginego Hamor gi Shekem wuode, eka negigolo Dina e od Shekem mi giago.
english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom Sidon; kor wach kuome
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

kikuyu: Nyaminu maduongʼ ne en Samaria, mane odak gi nyige yo Nyandwat; to nyaminu matin, mane odak gi nyige yo milambo, ne en Sodom.
english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

kikuyu: To ji moa e ogendini duto gi dhoudi, kod dhok duto ma ji wacho gi pinje duto, norang ringregi kuom ndalo adek gi nus, kendo ok giniyie mondo oyikgi.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

kikuyu: Ne aketho teko mar joma thiro ji mi agologi e lwet joma dwaro hinyogi.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

kikuyu: kendo nowachone niya, “Ringi inyis wuowi matin cha ni, ‘Jerusalem biro bedo dala ma ok ochiel gi ohinga nikech ji kod jamni mabiro dak e iye biro bedo mangʼeny mohinge.
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

kikuyu: Hadid, Zeboim kod Nebalat,
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

kikuyu: Ne giwuoyo kendgi kuom wachni, kagiwacho niya, “Owuoyo kamano nikech ne ok watingʼo makati kata achiel.”
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

kikuyu: To ka en adier ni isedwanyori, mi ngʼato oterore kodi, kingʼeyo ni in chi ngʼato,”
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

kikuyu: Ishmael nomako jogo mane odongʼ duto ei Mizpa mane gin nyi ruoth kaachiel gi jogo duto mane odongʼ kanyo, jogo mane Nebuzaradan jatend lweny mar piny noketo Gedalia wuod Ahikam mondo oriti. Ishmael wuod Nethania nomakogi kendo negichako ka gingʼado gidhi loka Amon.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Laini manie bund iye bitho ka balatago motore, kendo koluwo kama otimo chwodho to dongʼ ka kar dino ngano.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

kikuyu: Kik uyie weche maricho wuogi e dhou, to mana weche mabeyo manyalo konyo kuom gero ji kaluwore gi dwarogi mondo wecheu okony joma winjo.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

kikuyu: tula matin, gi osou, gi tula maduongʼ,
english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

kikuyu: Nolutoga umano e sufuria, kata aguch ringʼo gi agulni mamoko mag tedo kendo jadolo ne kawo ringʼo moro amora ma uma ochwoyo. Mano e kaka negitimo ni jo-Israel duto mane biro Shilo.
english: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.

kikuyu: eka joma ni Judea oring odhi ewi gode.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

kikuyu: Omiyo nodhi mokulore bute kendo nochiko midhusi mondo oa kendo midhusi noweye. Nochungo oa malo mapiyo kendo nochako miyogi chiemo.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

kikuyu: Idagi ji duto mabaro weyo chikeni, nimar wuondruok ma giwuondorego en kayiem.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

kikuyu: Weuru kiye mau; anares ngimagi. Mondu duto ma chwogi otho, bende nyalo keto geno mag-gi kuoma.”
english: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”

kikuyu: Joab nowacho niya, “Ka jo-Aram dwaro loya, to ubi ukonya, to ka diponi jo-Amon tek moloyi, to anabi akonyi.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

kikuyu: to en giratiro mondo oware bangʼ ka osengʼiewe. Achiel kuom wedene nyalo ware.
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

kikuyu: to gi adiera nongʼad bura ne joma odhier, kendo kuom bura makare enongʼad wach, mowinjore ni joma ochando manie piny. Dhoge ema nobed luth mogoyogo piny, bende wach moa e dhoge ema noneg-go joma timbegi mono.
english: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

kikuyu: Joka Lawi ne gin: Shemaya wuod Hashub, wuod Azrikam, wuod Hashabia ja-Merari;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

kikuyu: To Adam to ne owachone niya, “Nikech ne iwinjo chiegi kendo ichamo olemb yath mane akweri ni, ‘Kik icham olembe,’ “Okwongʼ lowo nikech in, kuom tich matek, ibiro chiemo koa kuom lowo, ndalo duto mag ngimani.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Nochako ogoyonegi ngero machielo niya, “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi thowi mane dhako moro okawo kendo oruwo ei mogo mangʼeny mi bangʼe okuodo mogono.”
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Lela wangʼ ruoth nojowore, kendo nobwok matek, mi chongene notuomore, kendo fuond embene nonyosore.
english: Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and his knees struck one against another.

kikuyu: Otienono, mad olal e mudho mandiwa; kik obed kaka achiel kuom odiechienge mag higa, kendo kik kwane kaka achiel kuom odiechienge mag dwe.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro dhiyo, abiro konyi e wuoyo bende abiro puonji gima onego iwachi.”
english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ ka Kenan noseyuolo Mahalalel nodak higni mia aboro kod piero angʼwen kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

kikuyu: Kuom mano, negruok gi ligangla ok norum e odi, nikech ne ichaya mi ikawo chi Uria ja-Hiti mobedo mari iwuon.’
english: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

kikuyu: Iseguro loch jogi ma jo-Israel kaka jogi iwuon nyaka chiengʼ to in yaye Jehova Nyasaye isebedo Nyasachgi.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

kikuyu: Donge rieko luongo? Donge ngʼeyo tiend wach tingʼo dwonde ka goyo koko?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

kikuyu: Yawuot Naftali ne gin: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer kod Shilem.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

kikuyu: Kristo, kaluwore gi dwarone, osemiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa ngʼwono.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kikuyu: nimar ne gingʼanyo giweyo weche Nyasaye kendo ne gichayo rieko mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

kikuyu: Nyi ruodhi ni e kanyakla mag mondi moluor; mikach ruoth ni e bathi korachwich korwakore gi dhahabu mogol Ofir.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Kik iwe nindo ohingi, kata ayula wangʼ oteri.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

kikuyu: Kar yudo wichkuot to joga noyud pok nyadiriyo, kendo kar yudo achaya to ginibed mamor gi pokgi; kuom mano giniyud pok nyadiriyo e pinygi, kendo mor mochwere nobed margi.
english: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

kikuyu: Jokwath moko nobiro mondo oriembgi, to Musa noa malo moresogi kendo nomiyo jambgi pi omodho.
english: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

kikuyu: Negimor gi wachno, mi gisingore ni gibiro miye pesa. Omiyo nochako manyo kinde maber mar kete e lwetgi.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

kikuyu: Nyaka ubed gi gige pimo mowinjore kendo makare mondo udagi amingʼa e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Harun noket lwetene duto ewi diendno mangima, kohulo richo kod ngʼanyo mar jo-Israel, tiende ni richogi duto kendo enowe richogo duto ewi diendno. Eka enomiye ngʼatno moseyier ne tijno mondo okaw diendno oter e pap.
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

kikuyu: Kendo ka awachone ngʼama timbene richo ni, ‘Ibiro tho ma ok itony,’ to ka olokore oweyo richone motimo gima adier kendo makare,
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

kikuyu: Ojwangʼo nyithinde ma pod yom, ka gima ok gin mage owuon; to bende ok odew rem mane owinjo konywologi;
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

kikuyu: Ne imiya ngima kendo ne itimona ngʼwono, kendo isebedo ka irito chunya kuom duongʼni maler.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

kikuyu: Nogero mier kendo ne en kod rombe mangʼeny kod kweth mag dhok nikech Nyasaye nogwedhe kod mwandu mangʼeny.
english: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

kikuyu: To koro Ruoth, winj siem ma gisiemowago, kendo mi jotichni teko mondo ohul wachni gi teko moloyo.
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

kikuyu: “Gimoro ruoth gi timbegi marichogo, yawuot ruoth bende gimiyo mor gi miriambo.
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

kikuyu: Kuom higni mangʼeny ne ihori kodgi. Kuom Roho mari ne ipuonjori kodgi kokalo kuom jonabi magi. Kata kamano, ne ok gichiko itgi malongʼo, omiyo ne ichiwogi ne joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

kikuyu: An awuon abiro kedo kodi ka iya owangʼ kendo ka an gi mirima mager.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Ibiro pando wangʼi nyaka chiengʼ koso? Mirimbi biro liel ka mach nyaka karangʼo?
english: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

kikuyu: Wachni nolandore mochopo e it kanisa mane ni Jerusalem, omiyo negioro Barnaba e dala Antiokia.
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wachone jokwath makwayo joga: “Nikech usekeyo romba kendo uriembogi kendo ok useritogi, anakumu kuom timbe mamono musetimo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼama Nyasaye onywolo ok dhi nyime katimo richo, nikech kit Nyasaye osiko kuome. Ok onyal timo richo onywole kuom Nyasaye.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

kikuyu: Anadhur ringri modongʼ motop ewi gode kendo apongʼo holni gi chokeni.
english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

kikuyu: Jopinje mamoko nochak oger ohinga maru kendo ruodhigi nobed jotichu. Kata obedo nine akumogi gi mirima, to kuom ngʼwonona koro abiro nyiso kechna mangʼeny.
english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo, joma notwe notimo nyasi mar Pasaka.
english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

kikuyu: Nikech an aneno ni ka angima, to angima nikech Kristo, to ka atho to en ohala.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Aseweyonegi richogi mana kaka ne ikwayo.
english: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

kikuyu: Kane Uzia osedoko motegno, sungruokne nomiyo opodho. Noweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache mi nodonjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo owangʼ ubani e kendo mar misango mar ubani.
english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

kikuyu: “To pok mar dhoudi mamoko duto modongʼ nochal kama: “Benjamin noyud lowo kochakore yo podho chiengʼ nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

kikuyu: Mi mondo makaa maliel mager oolre kuomgi, ee, ne ni odirgi e mach, kata e thidhna ma nimo ji, ma ok ginyal wuokie kendo.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo giko mari bedo marach miwuoro, kendo ok nochak oneni kendo. Ji nomanyi, to ok nochak oyudi kendo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.”
english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: Norwakone law akor, moketo ombulu miluongo ni Urim gi Thumim e law akorno.
english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

kikuyu: To e ote mar ariyo, Josef nohulore ni owetene, mi Farao koro nongʼeyo jo-dalagi Josef.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Bende nogero od sirni ma borne romo fut piero aboro gariyo to lachne romo fut piero angʼwen gochiko. Ne en gi agola man-gi sirni e nyime.
english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

kikuyu: eka otere ne yawuot Harun ma jodolo. Jadolo nokaw mogo mayom moru gi sanja achiel kaachiel gi ubani duto kendo nowangʼe kaka pok mar rapar ewi kendo mar misango, ma en misango miwangʼo pep, madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne ma Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka oike, to oonge gi duongʼ, to ichiere ka en gi duongʼ, to bende iyike ka onyap, to ichiere ka en gi teko,
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

kikuyu: nyikwa Azgad, ji alufu achiel mia ariyo gi piero ariyo gariyo (1,222),
english: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

kikuyu: Wach gima biro timore kendo yange e lela mondo mi gilalre kanyakla. En ngʼa mane ofwenyo wachni chon kendo mane owacho chon ni obiro timore? Donge ne en an, Jehova Nyasaye? Kendo onge Nyasaye moro makmana an, Nyasaye makare kendo ma Jawar; onge moro amora makmana an.
english: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.

kikuyu: Gima wasebedo ka watemo wacho en ma: Wan gi Jadolo Maduongʼ mobet piny e bat korachwich mar Kom Duongʼ mar Nyasaye Maduongʼ manie polo,
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

kikuyu: Kane Saulo pod wuoyo gi jadolo, to mahu mane ni e kambi jo-Filistia ne medore ameda. Omiyo Saulo nowachone jadolo niya, “Gol lweti ewi Sandug Muma.”
english: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”

kikuyu: Kendo notimo gik maricho e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka kwerene notimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

kikuyu: “Ogwedh pinyruoth mabiro mar Daudi kwarwa!” “Hosana manie polo malo!”
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: Kendo jopinje mamoko mane oseyie kuom Jehova Nyasaye katiyone kohero nyinge, kendo kalame, jogo duto marito chiengʼ Sabato ma ok odwanye kendo morito singruokna,
english: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,

kikuyu: Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye un jotelo mag Sodom, chikuru itu ne chike mag Nyasachwa un oganda man Gomora!
english: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ka dine bed ni isiko iparo richo, ma ji timo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, to en ngʼa ma dichungʼ e nyimi ka ok bura oloyo?
english: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

kikuyu: To Ayub pod ok omino koda wach, omiyo ok abi dwoke kaka usebedo ka uduokeno.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

kikuyu: kendo ne gilosonegi ludhe abich man-gi ramaki. Ne giumo wi ludhego kod ratege molworogi gi dhahabu, to rachungi abich mirwako ewi sirnigo nolos gi mula.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

kikuyu: To bende nomiyo piny ongoro odoko yewni mag pi, kendo lowo motwo nolokore sokni mamol;
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

kikuyu: Ruoth mariek riembo joma timbegi richo; okumogi ma ok okechogi.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

kikuyu: Anto Nyasaye biro reso chunya mi ogola e liel adier, obiro kawa mi odhi koda ire. Sela
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth madhako mar Sheba owinjo humb Solomon, nobiro Jerusalem mondo ruoth oteme gi penj matek. Nobiro gi ji kod gik moko mangʼeny kaka ngamia motingʼo gik mangʼwe ngʼar, dhahabu mangʼeny, kaachiel gi kite ma nengogi tek. Nobiro ir Solomon ma owuoyo kode kuom gima noparo.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

kikuyu: Ka nonenogi, nowacho niya, “Dhiuru, unyisru uwegi ni jodolo.” To kane gidhi, negipwodhore.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

kikuyu: Mago mofuwo nokawo techegi to ne ok gitingʼo mafuta kata matin gidhigo.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

kikuyu: Ludhego noso e nyangeyego mondo gibedi e bath kendo mar misangono kitingʼego.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye owinjo gi ite, iye nowangʼ ahinya, mi mach mare notuk kuom joka Jakobo, kendo mirimbe mager nobiro kuom jo-Israel,
english: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

kikuyu: Daniel, Ginethon, Baruk,
english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

kikuyu: Tiend wechegi opondo, nikech mon ariyogi ochungʼ kar singruok ariyo. Singruok achiel oa Got Sinai, kendo onywolo nyithindo monego obed wasumbini: Ma en Hagar.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

kikuyu: “Ooyo! Ne watimo kamano nikech chiengʼ moro nyikwawa nyalo wachone nyikwau ni, ‘En angʼo ma wanyalo timo gi Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

kikuyu: Ji duto matimo richo, ka ok ongʼeyo chik nolal nono kata obedo ni gikia chik kamano, to ji duto matimo richo ka gin e bwo Chik nongʼadnigi bura gi Chikno.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

kikuyu: Eka nodonjo e hekalu kendo noriembo oko joma ne uso gik moko.
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano los techene abiriyo kendo iketgi ewi rachungi mondo giliel ka gimenyo nyime.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nooro joote mi giringo e hema kendo ne giyudogi mana kaka gin, kopandgi e hembe, ka fedha ema oket piny mogik.
english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

kikuyu: e kaka dhano nindo piny kendo ok ochak ochungʼ; ok ochak onen kendo bende ok nochiewe e nindoneno.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

kikuyu: Eka Debora nowachone Barak niya, “Dhiyo! Ma e odiechiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo Sisera e lweti. Donge Jehova Nyasaye osedhi nyimi?” Omiyo Barak nodhi e Got Tabor, kiluwe gi ji alufu apar.
english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ ma awuoyo kuomeno biro bedo ma ok olewo. Mae odiechiengʼ ma asebedo ka awuoyo kuome. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema osewacho.
english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord GOD. “This is the day about which I have spoken.

kikuyu: to chiengʼ mar abiriyo en Sabato ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Chiengʼno ok unutim tich moro amora, bed ni un kata yawuotu kata nyiu kata jotiju machwo kata jotiju mamon kata jambu kata jodak manie dieru.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye, Jal Maler, Jachwech Israel kendo Ruodhu.”
english: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nowachone jatend jolweny kod jolweny duto niya, “Ka jogi ok osiko kodwa ei yie ka, to ok ubi tony.”
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

kikuyu: Enoluonga, kendo anadwoke; anabed kode e chandruok, adier, anakonye kendo anamiye duongʼ.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

kikuyu: Yaye, jo-Israel, winjuru buche kod chike ma amiyou, luwgi mondo udagi kendo mondo ukaw piny ma Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu miyou.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.

kikuyu: Dho ngʼat makare hulo rieko kendo lewe wacho gima ratiro.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

kikuyu: To joricho chalo gi nam moduwore, ma ok nyal bedo gi kwe, ma apaka mage gingore kendo kelo chwodho.
english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.

kikuyu: To gokinyi Daudi nondiko ne Joab baruwa moorogo Uria mondo oter.
english: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

kikuyu: kendo chakre Heshbon nyaka Ramath Mizpa gi Betonim, kendo kochakore Mahanaim nyaka piny Debir;
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

kikuyu: Gima rieko nyalo timo ne ngʼato duongʼ moloyo gima jotelo apar nyalo timo ne dala maduongʼ.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

kikuyu: Kane oyawo burno, iro nowuokie machalo gi ich mach maduongʼ. Iro moa e burno noimo chiengʼ kod boche polo molokore maratengʼ.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane jo-Israel yiko ngʼato, negipo ka gineno wasigu kabiro, mi negibolo ringre ngʼatno e bur mane oike Elisha. Kane ringre ngʼatno olwar e choke Elisha, nopo ka chunye odwogo mochungʼ gi tiendene.
english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

kikuyu: Wuod Apaim ne en: Ishi mane wuon Sheshan. To Sheshan ne wuon Alai.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

kikuyu: Nyaka uket pogruok e kind le michamo gi ma ok cham, kendo e kind winy michamo to gi ma ok cham. Kik udok mogak nikech le moro amora kata winyo kata gimoro amora mamol e lowo ma gin gik masewalo tenge nochido.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi osiepe mangʼeny nyalo chopo e kethruok to nitie osiep moro masiko buti machiegni maloyo owadu.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

kikuyu: Ketgi mondo gibedi jongʼad bura ni oganda kinde duto, to buche matek kende ema ginyalo keloni. Buche mayot ginyalo ngʼado giwegi, nimar mano biro miyo tingʼ ma in-go bedo mayot, nimar gibiro lawe kodi.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

kikuyu: Joka Reuben, joka Gad kod nus mar dhood joka Manase ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen gangʼwen mia abiriyo gi piero auchiel (44,760) mane oyikore ni lweny. Jolweny molony mane nyalo tiyo gi gige lweny machalo kuodi, ligangla kod atungʼ, nomi tiegruok ne lweny.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

kikuyu: Maria nodhi monyiso jogo mane ni kode, jogo mane ywak kendo jogo mane dengo.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

kikuyu: Nimar ne amiyogi weche mane imiya kendo ne girwakogi. Gisengʼeyo gadier ni ne aa iri, kendo giseyie ni ne iora.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Kelnagiuru ane ka.”
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

kikuyu: Ahiezer wuod Amishadai, ma jatend joka Dan, nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar apar.
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan,

kikuyu: Kane oyudo odhi koidho pundane e hoho manie got, to nyime kanyo noneno Daudi gi joge kalor e got biro kochome kendo noromo kodgi.
english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

kikuyu: to chunyu biro donjo e sunga ma wiu nowil kod Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou Misri, e piny mane unie wasumbini.
english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

kikuyu: “Nyisgi ma: ‘Nyiseche manonogi, mane ok ochweyo polo gi piny, nolal nono e piny kendo e bwo polo.’ ”
english: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”

kikuyu: “Ayub wacho ni, ‘Aonge ketho, to Nyasaye otamore timona maber.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nochiko jotichne niya, “Wuouru gi Daudi lingʼ-lingʼ kendo wachneuru ni, ‘Winji, ruoth mor kodi kendo jotije duto bende oheri koro bed ore.’ ”
english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”

kikuyu: Koro e odiechiengʼ nogono ji ariyo kuomgi ne dhiyo e dala miluongo ni Emau, kama dirom kilomita apar gangʼwen koa Jerusalem.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ok nyal ngʼiewe gi dhahabu mokuny Ofir, kata gi kite ma nengogi tek kaka Oniks kata Safir.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

kikuyu: Kinyne Paulo nokawo jogo mi nopwodhore kaachiel kodgi, eka nodonjo e hekalu mondo onyisgi chiengʼ ma pwodhruokno norume, kod odiechiengʼ ma notimnie misango ni ngʼato ka ngʼato.
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

kikuyu: Sira eka ananwangʼ konyruok; abiro siko ka ahero chikeni.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

kikuyu: “Harun nochokre gi joge. Ok enodonji e piny mamiyo jo-Israel, nikech un ji ariyogi nungʼanyo ne chikena e pige mag Meriba.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

kikuyu: “Los pasia mar law mayom momin mar range marambulu, maralik kod marakwaro, moketie kido mar malaika mar kerubi mondo ogorie gi jagoro molony.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Joga duto ma joketho ibiro nego gi ligangla, kata mana mago mawacho ni, ‘Masira ok noyudwa kata chopo kuomwa.’
english: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’

kikuyu: “Kaw boche im, gi boche mag sembe gi boche mogawo jamb-ich gi boche moimo chuny gi nyiroke ariyo kod boche mogawogi kaachiel gi bam ma korachwich (ma e im miwalogo jodolo).
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

kikuyu: Anakel ligangla, kech kod masira kuomgi nyaka tiekgi e piny mane amiyogi kod wuonegi.’ ”
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”

kikuyu: Mano e giko jogo duto mohero yudo gimoro moyud e yo marach; gino kawo ngima jogo moyude.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

kikuyu: Kaw kit le duto maler michamo machwo abiriyo kod mamon abiriyo kod kit le duto mochido ma ok cham machwo ariyo kod mamon ariyo,
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

kikuyu: Kar sa auchiel mar odiechiengʼ, mudho nobiro moimo piny duto nyaka sa ochiko.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen e dwe mar auchiel e higa mar ariyo mar loch Ruoth Darius.
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

kikuyu: Kane Athalia owinjo koko mar joma ne ringo kendo pako ruoth, nodhi irgi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Mana ka tere mar dhahabu manie um anguro, e kaka dhako ma jaber maonge rieko chalo.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

kikuyu: to yie mondo iwinjgi gie polo kendo iwene jotichni ma jo-Israel richogi. Puonjgi yo makare mar dak kendo iornegi koth e piny mane imiyo jogi kaka girkeni margi.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

kikuyu: Kaka nyithindo mawinjo wach, kik ulu kit gombo maricho mane uluwo chon kane pod udak e kia.
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

kikuyu: Gima donjo e dho ngʼato ok mi odok mogak, to mana gima wuok koa e dhoge ema miyo odoko mogak.”
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

kikuyu: Ere mayot wacho ne ja-athany kuom weche ariyogi, ni ‘richoni oweni,’ koso ni, ‘Aa malo ikaw pieni mondo iwuothi’?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

kikuyu: Ranyisi misetimo thoth, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha. Gigo mane ichanonwa onge ngʼama nyalo kwanoni; ka dine bed ni wanyalo wuoyo kuomgi; to dine gibedo mangʼeny ma ok wanyal wacho.
english: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nogwedho Farao kendo owuok modhi.
english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

kikuyu: E dala motingʼore malo kendo ober neno omiyo piny duto bedo mamor. Got Sayun chalo gi kama otingʼore malo mar Zafon, ma en dala maduongʼ mar Ruoth Maduongʼ.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Nikech ne en odiechieng jo-Yahudi mar ikruok ne Sabato, kendo nikech bur mar ik ne ni machiegni, negiiko Yesu kanyo.
english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

kikuyu: Koko mar dengo iwinjo koa Sayun: ‘Mano kaka otiekowa! Mano kaka wichkuot marwa duongʼ! Nyaka waa e pinywa nikech utewa osemuki.’ ”
english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’”

kikuyu: Eka thuondi adekgi nomwomo oganda lweny mar jo-Filistia ma gitwomo pi koa e soko manie but rangaj Bethlehem mi gikelone Daudi pi, to nodagi modho pigno, kendo noole piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek nigi teko maduongʼ; to ngʼat man-gi ngʼeyo medo teko;
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

kikuyu: Neuru ni wecheu obed mangʼwon man-gi ndhandhu kinde duto, mondo ungʼe kaka dudwoki ngʼato angʼata wach e yo mowinjore.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

kikuyu: Jakony kanisa nyaka bed ngʼatno man-gi dhako achiel kende kendo mopuonjo nyithinde gi joode duto maber.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

kikuyu: Jatichni nitie ka e kind oganda miseyiero, oganda maduongʼ kendo mathoth mokalo akwana.
english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni wan ema wabiro ngʼado bura ne malaike? Koro gige pinyni to donge wanyalo ngʼadone bura moloyo!
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye gero Jerusalem kendo; ochoko jo-Israel mane otwe.
english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

kikuyu: to Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho chiengʼ mar adek, momiyo onene.
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

kikuyu: Omiyo koro hera moherougo osemedore moloyo, koparo kaka un duto ne uwinjo wachwa, kendo kaka ne urwake kumiye luoro maduongʼ.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mae Jadolo nokaw achiel kuom nyiimbego kendo nochiwe kaachiel gi mo kaka misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho bende nochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano kuom ndalo mogwarore, to achien Paulo nosin kode, mi nolokore ochiko jachiendno niya, “Achiki e nying Yesu Kristo ni aa kuome!” Jachiendno noa kuom nyakono mana gisano.
english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo pod aparo tiend wachni, to apoya nono nywok moro man-gi tunge mabitho motwi e kind wengene nobiro koa yo podho chiengʼ kowuotho e piny ngima ma tiendene ok nyon lowo.
english: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

kikuyu: Jower nenie bwo chik mar ruoth, ma ema ne tijgi mapile.
english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo gima osetimore e piny Judea duto, kochakore Galili, bangʼ batiso mane Johana oyalo;
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Wer, yaye in dhako ma migumba, in ma ok inywol nyithindo; wer matek, ka igoyo koko gi ilo, in mane muoch ok okayi; nimar dhako ma migumba nobed gi nyithindo, mangʼeny moloyo dhako man-gi dichwo.
english: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ruodhi mag piny ne ok oyie, kata ji mag piny bende ne ok oyie, ni wasigu kod jolweny nyalo donjo e dhorangeye mag Jerusalem.
english: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato nyalo wuotho e mirni mar mach maliel, ma ok tiendene owangʼ?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

kikuyu: Yawuot Isakar ne gin: Tola, Pua, Jashub kod Shimron. Yawuot Isakar duto ne gin yawuowi angʼwen.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno malaika maratego kalando gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Ere ngʼama owinjore gonyo kidogi mondo oel kitabuni?”
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

kikuyu: Nokelo gige dhahabu gi fedha kod mula e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ma en owuon gi wuon mare nosepwodho.
english: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

kikuyu: Parie ni ne ichweya koa kuom lowo. Koro sani, diduoka kendo e lowo adier?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

kikuyu: “Ringuru uwuog Babulon; ayeuru e piny jo-Babulon, kendo uchal gi diek motelone jamni.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

kikuyu: Chik iti! Wach biro niya, tungni maduongʼ koa e piny man yo nyandwat! Anami dala mag Juda odongʼ nono, kama ondiegi ema odakie.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

kikuyu: Gisano Yesu nochiko jopuonjrene mondo odonji e yie kendo gitel nyime gingʼad gidhi loka nam e dala mar Bethsaida, ka en to ne pod odongʼ chien kogonyo oganda.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

kikuyu: Kane Musa oorogi mondo gidhi ginon piny Kanaan, nowachonegi niya, “Luwuru Negev kendo udhi nyaka piny manie got.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

kikuyu: nikech ne giwinjogi ka giwuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore kendo ka gipako Nyasaye. Eka Petro nowuoyo kawacho niya,
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

kikuyu: “Nyasaye osemiyo abedo ngʼama ji duto goyo ngero kendo ma ka ji oneno to ngʼudho kuome olawo.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

kikuyu: Gibiro nangʼo lowo ka thuol, ka le malak gi bund-igi e buru. Gibiro wuok ka gia e kuondegi mag pondo ka gitetni. Gibiro lokore gidok ir Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa, ka giluor kendo un bende gibiro luorou.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osewacho kawuononi ni un joge, kendo mwandune mogeno kaka nosingorenu kendo ni nyaka urit chikene duto.
english: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

kikuyu: Luoro kod kihondko nomak le duto manie piny kod winy ma huyo e kor polo, gik moko duto mamol e lowo kod rech duto modak e nam nikech ochiwgi duto e lwetu.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

kikuyu: Tekone duto kaka ngʼama pod tin biro dhi kode e bur.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

kikuyu: negikadho Ranga Efraim, Ranga Jeshana, Ranga Rech, Kama Otingʼore gi Malo mar Hananel kod Kama Otingʼore gi Malo ma Mia Achiel nyaka ochopo Ranga Rombe. Negichungo e Ranga Od jarito.
english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.

kikuyu: To ka Paulo nodhi nyime kawuoyo kuom ngima maler gi ritruok kod chiengʼ bura mabiro, Feliks nobedo maluor mowacho niya, “Mano oromo! Koro inyalo aa. Ka adwari kendo, to abiro luongi.”
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

kikuyu: Ne oyudo osepidhe e lowo maber kendo ma pi ngʼenyie mondo bedene othiew, onyag olemo, kendo obed yiend mzabibu maber.’
english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

kikuyu: “Kel rwadh-cha yo ka nyim Hemb Romo kendo Harun gi yawuote noyie lwetgi e wiye.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat mokwongo nobiro kendo nowacho ni, ‘Ruoth, silingʼ alufu achiel, osenywolo silinge alufu apar moko.’
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

kikuyu: Chunya onyosore, ndalona ongʼad machiek, kendo thona ema chiegni koda.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

kikuyu: Kapo ni wachni ochopo e it ruoth, to wangʼeyo gima wabiro timone, mondo kik uyud chandruok moro amora.”
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

kikuyu: Wuouru kendo timuru gik mutimo kaka joma ibiro ngʼadnigi bura gi Chik achielno mamiyo ji bedo thuolo,
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

kikuyu: Nikech hera kod adiera ema omiyo richo otimne misango, kuom luoro Jehova Nyasaye miyo ngʼato kwedo richo.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

kikuyu: To Nahash ja-Amon nodwoko niya, “Abiro timo winjruok kodu mana ka uyie ni agolo wengeu ma korachwich kuom ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo akuodgo wi Israel duto.”
english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

kikuyu: Nyithindo choko yien, wuone moko mach, to mon dwalo mogo mondo gilos godo makati ne Ruoth ma Dhako mar Polo. Gichiwo misango miolo piny ne nyiseche manono mondo ochwanya ma mi iya wangʼ.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

kikuyu: Nimar anawenegi timbegi maricho, kendo ok anachak apar richogi kendo.”
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne achiwo chik ne jo-Lawi mondo opwodhre kendo gidhi girit rangeye mondo gimi chiengʼ Sabato obed maler. Yaye Nyasacha, para ema bende, kendo itimna ngʼwono kaluwore gi herani maduongʼ.
english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

kikuyu: “Eka gini aa kanyo mi gidonji e kum mochwere, to joma kare e ngima mochwere.”
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

kikuyu: To Lut ma bende ne wuotho kod Abram neni kod jamni matindo mathoth, gi kweth mag dhok kod hembe.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

kikuyu: Nyaka chil kawuono jo-Edom pod ongʼanyo ne jo-Juda. Jo-Libna bende nongʼanyo e ndalono.
english: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

kikuyu: en ema ne ochweyo chunje ji duto, kendo onono gik moko duto ma gitimo.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

kikuyu: “Osepoga gi owetena monywolago; kendo jogo mosiepena bende oseringo oweya.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
