kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Ibrahim nokawo chiemo kod puga mar pi kendo nomiyo Hagar. Noketonegi e goke kendo ogole odhi gi wuode. Hagar nowuok modhi kendo nobayo abaya e thim mar Bersheba.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

kikuyu: Nyaka ochungʼ e nyim jadolo Eliazar, mabiro ngʼadone rieko kopenjo Urim e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kogolo chik, to en kod oganda jo-Israel duto nowuog oko, kendo kogolo chik to gibiro donjo iye.”
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

kikuyu: Kane kwerewa oyudo Hemani, ne gitingʼe ka Joshua otelonegi, nyaka negichopo kode e piny ogendini mane Nyasaye oseriembo mondo owenegi. Hemani ne gibedogo nyaka chop kinde mag Daudi.
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

kikuyu: To ngʼatno nowuotho kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ kotingʼo gir pimo e lwete noketo kido mopimo kama borne oromo fut alufu achiel gi mia abich, bangʼe to notelona ka ayoro pi kama tutne ne chopo e ofunj tielo.
english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochako oluongo niya, “Samuel!” Eka Samuel nochungʼ modhi ir Eli mowachone niya, “Era ee, nikech ne iluonga.” Eli nowachone niya, “Wuoda, an ne ok aluongi dog inindi.”
english: The LORD called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

kikuyu: Kendo jo-Lawi notiyo tijegi mag Hemb Romo gi Kama Ler kotelnegi gi jowetegi ma gin nyikwa Harun mondo giti e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Yawuot Mika ne gin: Pithon, Melek, Tarea kod Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Imiya okumbani mar loch; ikulori piny mondo imi abed maduongʼ.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

kikuyu: “Kane parone odwogone, nowacho ni, ‘Jotij wuonwa adi man-gi chiemo moromogi, madongʼ, to an to kech chama monego atho!
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro luoruru Jehova Nyasaye kendo beduru joratiro kinde duto kutiyone. Wituru oko nyiseche manono mag kwereu mane gilamo yo Aora Yufrate kod e piny Misri, mondo uti ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo gidagi e lowo mongʼere kuom cham mochiego, kendo kech mager momako pinygi ok nochak ochamgi. Bende ok ginichak gine achaya mar ogendini mamoko.
english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

kikuyu: Ma nomiyo mwandu Jakobo omedore piyo ahinya kendo nobedogi kweth mag jamni mangʼeny gi jotich mamon, machwo, kod ngamia gi punde.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

kikuyu: bende noloso rachungi gi karechegi;
english: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

kikuyu: To nodwoke niya, “Iwuoyo ka dhako mofuwo. Diwayie mana gi ber kende ma aa kuom Nyasaye to ok chandruok?” Kuom magi duto, Ayub ne ok otimo richo e gimoro amora mane owacho.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

kikuyu: “Nimar kane Daudi osetimo dwaro Nyasaye e ndalone, to notho moike kama noyike kwerene, mi ringre notowo,
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

kikuyu: To nomedo wachonegi niya, “Unua mwalo e piny, an to aa malo e polo. Un jopinyni, to an ok an japinyni.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Kane aorou maonge ofuku mar pesa, kata sanduku kod wuoche, ne uchando gimoro koso?” Negidwoko niya, “Onge.”
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

kikuyu: Yesu notimo gik mangʼeny mamoko. Ka dine ndikgi duto moro ka moro kuomgi, to an gi ratiro ni kata mana piny ngima ok doromo kano kitepe duto ma dine ondiki.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

kikuyu: Ok owe joricho kangima, to omiyo joma ithiro ratiro margi.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

kikuyu: Wachni ochwere, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; ochungʼ mogurore e polo.
english: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

kikuyu: Ka koro wan gi jadolo maduongʼ morito od Nyasaye kamano,
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

kikuyu: Ne gibawo sirnigo gi dhahabu kendo negiloso ratege mag dhahabu mondo omak raidhi miriwogo. Bende ne gibawo raidhigo gi dhahabu.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Koso ukia, owetena, nikech awuoyo gi joma ongʼeyo chik, ni chik otweyo ngʼato mana ka pod ongima?
english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

kikuyu: E dwe mar Nisan e higa mar piero ariyo mar loch Ruoth Artaksases, kane okelne divai, ne akawo divai mi amiyo ruoth. Ne pok abedo ka an gi kuyo e nyime nyaka nene;
english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

kikuyu: Ruwgi kaka thiwni mag dhahabu,
english: You shall make settings of gold,

kikuyu: Kane piny oru, Jakobo nofwenyo mana ni en Lea! Omiyo nopenjo Laban niya, “Angʼo momiyo isetimona kama? Donge natiyoni mondo imiya Rael? To angʼo momiyo isewuonda?”
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

kikuyu: Nenruok mag gik mangimago ne chalo gi mach mar makaa kata toje maliel. Mach ne wuok e nyim gik mangimago karingo koni gi koni, ne en mach mangʼangʼni kendo polo bende ne mil e iye.
english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu dhi nyime koa kanyo ne oneno ngʼato ma nyinge Mathayo kobet piny e od jasol osuru. Nowachone niya, “Luwa,” mi Mathayo noa malo kendo noluwe.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

kikuyu: E buch jomaler Nyasaye oluor gi luor maduongʼ; olich moloyo chwech duto molwore.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

kikuyu: Wiye cham abiriyo mothogo nomwonyo wiye cham abiriyo machwe ka. Eka Farao nochiewo, moyudo ni en mana lek.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

kikuyu: Omiyo chunya chandore e iya, ee, chunya obwok.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isetingʼo badi malo, to ok gine. We mondo gine geno ma in-go, kuom jogi mi giyud wichkuot, kendo mad mach mokan ne wasiki wangʼ-gi duto.
english: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego oseketo odiechieng mahu gi koko kod masira e Holo mar Fweny, en odiechiengʼ mar muko ohinga kendo nduru nowuog malit kochomo ewi gode.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

kikuyu: Wuoda, kik wiyi wil kod puonjna to ket chikena osik e chunyi,
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

kikuyu: To nodwokgi niya, “Nikech jogi ne ojwangʼo singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi mane otimo kodgi kogologi e piny Misri.
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

kikuyu: “Kaw kwan dhout oganda mar jo-Israel duto kaluwore gi gwengegi kod anywolagi, kindiko nying joma chwo duto moro ka moro.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

kikuyu: Kata kamano, e kindeno, ji mangʼeny kuom jotelo bende noyie kuome. To nikech negiluoro jo-Farisai, ne ok ginyal hulo yie margi e lela nimar negiluor ni dipo ka oriembgi e sinagogi.
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ngʼama kwongʼore gi nying kendo mar misango ok kwongʼre mana gi kama ler kende, to okwongʼore koda ka gi gik moko duto manie iye.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

kikuyu: An Simon Petro, misumba kendo jaote mar Yesu Kristo, Andikonu un joma oseyudo yie ma nengone tek marom gi yiewa nimar Nyasachwa kod Jawarwa Yesu Kristo ema nomiyowago kuom adierane:
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Gikuotho kendo gijimbo wach, ginono okangʼ ka okangʼ ma agoyo, ka gidwaro kawo ngimana.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

kikuyu: “Chon gi lala ne ituro jok magi kendo ichodo rateke motweyigo; kiwacho ni, ‘Ok anatini!’ Adier, ewi gode matindo duto kendo e bwo yiende motimo otiep, ninindo piny ka jachode.
english: “For long ago I broke off your yoke, and burst your bonds. You said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

kikuyu: To kuom chier mane Nyasaye ochierego oa kuom joma otho, mondo kik otow, to ondikie kama: “ ‘Anamiu gweth maler kendo madier, mane asingone Daudi.’
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

kikuyu: Ne ok oyie mondo ngʼato osandgi; nokwero ruodhi kowachonegi niya,
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: To ka ok uwe ni ji richogi to wuonu manie polo ok bi weyonu richou.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

kikuyu: Gibiro yako mwandugi kendo ginikaw gigi mag ohala; gibiro muko ohinga magi mi gigo piny, kendo gibiro ketho utegi mabeyo mi gidir kitegi, gi bepegi, gi matafare motore-otore e nam.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowachone joritne mane ni bute niya, “Lokreuru mondo uneg jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye, nikech gisedok jokor Daudi. Negingʼeyo ni oringo to negitamore nyisa.” To jodong ruoth ne ok oyie mondo gineg jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka nokela nyaka e laru ma oko mar hekalu. Kanyo ne aneno agola moko moger, kod yo momwon motegno mane olosi molworo laru duto. Agolago noriedo e bath yo momwon motegnono, kendo ne gin piero adek.
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

kikuyu: Abiro siko kaparo timbe Jehova Nyasaye; ee, abiro paro kuom honni magi machon gi lala.
english: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kikuyu: Eka Solomon nochungʼ e nyim kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye e nyim oganda duto mar jo-Israel kendo norieyo bedene kochomo malo.
english: He stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

kikuyu: Kik ikwanwa kaka joketho, nikech richo mag wuonewa; mad kechni bi romnwa piyo, nimar osedwokwa piny marach.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

kikuyu: (nikech gima olemo mar ler nyago otingʼo gik mabeyo duto, gi gik makare kod gik ma adier),
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

kikuyu: Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Obed-Edom. Gin kaachiel gi yawuotgi to gi wedegi ne gin joma niginyalo kendo maroteke kuom tich. Koriw nyikwa Obed-Edom duto to ne gin ji piero auchiel gariyo.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

kikuyu: Unucham ring yawuotu kod nyiwu.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ka oganda mar jo-Israel ne pod odak e pinygi giwegi, ne gidwanye gi yoregi kod timbegi mamono. Timbegi ne ogak kaka gak mar dhako e nyima e kinde ma oneno malo.
english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

kikuyu: Chiemo moro amora minyalo cham moole pi moaye aguluno nobed mogak, kendo gimoro amora mimadho mowuok ei aguluno nobed mogak.
english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Gisingore ni jogo ni gibiro miyogi thuolo to gin giwegi gin wasumbini mag richo makelo kethruok nikech dhano en misumba gimoro amora moloyo ngimane.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

kikuyu: Ere kaka dadog ir wuora ka wuowini ok ni koda? Ooyo! Kik iwe ane chandruok ma dimak wuora.”
english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

kikuyu: Mor kod ilo norum chuth e puotheu mag olemo kendo onge wer mano wer kata koko manogo e puotheu mag mzabibu; bende onge ngʼato angʼata manochak obi mzabibu e kuonde mag bicho, nimar asetieko mahu mar mor ma un-go.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

kikuyu: Achiki e nyim Nyasaye kendo e nyim Kristo Yesu, kaachiel gi malaika moyier, ni mondo ilu puonjgi adimba ma ok idewo wangʼ ngʼato kendo ma ok idok kor ngʼato angʼata.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

kikuyu: Dhako mariek gero ode, to dhako mofuwo muko ode gi lwete owuon.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

kikuyu: Joma komo kodhi kaywak biro keyo ka wero wende mor.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

kikuyu: Koro an gi kwayo achiel madwaro kwayo. Ka iyie to kik itama.” Bathsheba nowachone niya, “Wachi.”
english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”

kikuyu: Kane ji duto mane ochokore kanyo mondo obed joneno mar wachno noneno gima notimore, negigoyo korgi kendo negidok miechgi.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno godhiambo Yesu nowacho ne jopuonjrene niya, “Wadhiuru loka nam komachielo.”
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo ni ji duto ma noa e piny Asia oseweya, koda ka Fugelo gi Hermogene.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

kikuyu: ok nochwanyre kata chunye bende ok nonyosre, nyaka okel adiera e piny duto. Pinje duto manie chula mag dier nam biro keto genogi kuom chikene.”
english: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ruodh jo-Amon ne ok odewo ote mane joote Jeftha okelone.
english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

kikuyu: Koso en angʼo ma ngʼato dichiw mondo owil gi ngimane?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: Kane Jeftha odwogo dalane man Mizpa, noneno mana nyare kamiel kabiro romone! Ne en gi nyako achiel kende maonge wuowi kata nyako moro machielo.
english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Asewinjo gima jonabi makoro e nyinga gi miriambo wacho. Giwacho ni, ‘Ne aleko! Ne aleko!’
english: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

kikuyu: nikech Adam ema nokwong chwe eka bangʼe Hawa.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

kikuyu: Kane jaote ochopo ne owacho ne Jehu niya, “Gisekelo wiye yawuot ruoth.” Eka Jehu nogolo chik niya, “Dhurgiuru pidhe ariyo e dhoranga dala maduongʼ nyaka piny yawre.”
english: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

kikuyu: Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

kikuyu: Girkeni mag-gi nochiw kuom goyo ombulu ni dhoudi ochiko gi nus, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko kokalo kuom Musa.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

kikuyu: kendo turumbete nomedo ywak matek. Eka Musa nowuoyo kendo Nyasaye nodwoke.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye enokel piny moro moa mabor, ma en piny mantie e giko piny, machal gi ongo mafuyo, gin oganda ma dhogi ok unuwinji,
english: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

kikuyu: mondo ucham ring ruodhi, gi ring jotend lweny kod ring joma rateke, gi ring farese kod joithgi kaachiel gi ring ji duto, joma ni thuolo gi wasumbini, jomatindo gi jomadongo.”
english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

kikuyu: Neuru Jehova Nyasaye biro ketho piny, mi odongʼ nono, obiro loko kit piny kendo keyo jogo modakie.
english: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

kikuyu: Gisechulo pesa mane nitiere e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo gisechiwogi e lwet jotich kod jotend hekalu.”
english: They have emptied out the money that was found in the LORD’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”

kikuyu: Eka inikwan kuonde matienda onyono to ok inisik kinona mondo ikwan richo ka richo matimo.
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

kikuyu: Kane Baal-Hanan otho, Hadad nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Pau, kendo chiege niluongo ni Mehetabel nyar Matred ma nyar Me-Zahab.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe, e higa mar apar gachiel, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Noketo okumbini kod tonge e miechgi duto kendo nomiyo gibedo motegno. Kuom mano jo-Juda kod jo-Benjamin ne joge.
english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

kikuyu: Nobedo gi kar ngʼado bura e bwo Yadh Othith mar Debora mantiere kind Rama kod Bethel manie piny gode mar Efraim, kendo jo-Israel ne biro ire kanyo mondo ongʼadnegi bura.
english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

kikuyu: To Zadok jadolo gi Benaya wuod Jehoyada gi Nathan janabi gi Shimei gi Rei gi jarit Daudi ne ok oriwore gi Adonija.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

kikuyu: To koro ere gima omiyo nyaka watho? Mach malichni biro tiekowa kendo wabiro tho ma ok wawinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kendo.
english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

kikuyu: “Nikech ngʼwono mari mathoth ne ok ijwangʼogi e thim. Godiechiengʼ, bor polo nodhi nyime ka telonegi e yo, to gotieno mach makakni nomedo menyonegi kama giluwo.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

kikuyu: nikech richo mane otimo, kotimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo kowuotho e yore Jeroboam kendo e richo mane otimo, kod mago mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Jodolo mag jo-Yahudi duto chungʼ odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ mondo otim tich dolo, ka ginuoyo mana misango ma ok nyal golo richo.
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

kikuyu: Asewachonu kawuono, to pod ok uluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom gigo duto mane oora mondo anyisu.
english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed the LORD your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Ka uparo ni kawuononi usetimo gima kare kendo mowinjore ni Jerub-Baal kod joode, to mad Abimelek bed mamor kodu kendo un bende ubed mamor kode!
english: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

kikuyu: Daudi nochwogo wend ywak miywagogo Saulo gi wuode Jonathan,
english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

kikuyu: Eka nokela nyaka e laru maiye man yo wuok chiengʼ, kendo nopimo rangach midonjogo, pimne ne romre gi pim mar rangeye mamoko duto.
english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

kikuyu: Chiel laru mar Hemb Romo, ma en Hemb Lemo maler chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: kendo noneno malaike ariyo morwako lewni marochere, kobet piny kama ringre Yesu nopielie, ka moro ni yo ka wiye, to machielo ni yo ka tiende.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

kikuyu: Jatich ma nyako nonene kobedo kanyo kama mach lielie. Nodhi machiegni kode morange matut kendo nowacho niya, “Ngʼatni ne ni kode.”
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

kikuyu: Kinyne Johana ne ni kanyo kendo gi jopuonjrene ariyo.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

kikuyu: Nimar ne agombo timbe joma ochayo ji kane aneno kaka joma timbegi richo dhi maber.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ruodh Tapua, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Hefer, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

kikuyu: Ruodh Eglon, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Gezer, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Laban ja-Aram gotieno e lek mi owachone niya, “Ne ni ok iwachone Jakobo gimoro amora, maber kata marach.”
english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

kikuyu: ‘E higa mar abiriyo ka higa mar abiriyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka we ja-Hibrania wadgi thuolo ma osebedo katiyone. Bangʼ ka osetiyone kuom higni auchiel, nyaka iweye thuolo.’ Wuoneu, kata kamano, ne ok owinja kata luoro chikna.
english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne jo-Gad kod jo-Reuben niya, “Bende jou nyalo dhi e lweny ka un to udongʼ ka?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka nitie winjruok marach moro amora e kind ji, to jodolo nyaka bed jongʼad bura kendo nyaka gilos wachno kaluwore gi buchena. Nyaka girit chikena gi yorena morito nyasi maga moyiedhi duto, kendo nyaka girit Sabato maga kaka odiechienge maler.
english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jowetena, gomburu bedo johul wach, to kik utam ji wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore.
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

kikuyu: Tekone nomedore mochopo nyaka e kor polo, kendo nowito sulwe moko e piny mi onyonogi.
english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona, “Kik ilam mondo jogi odhi maber.
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.

kikuyu: Yawuot Nadab ne gin: Seled kod Apaim. Seled notho maonge nyithindo.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek kane pod gin kod rem, yawuot Jakobo ariyo, Simeon kod Lawi mowete Dina, nokawo gigegi mag lweny mi gidonjo e dala jogo apoya kendo ginego joma chwo duto.
english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

kikuyu: Kane pundano oneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye kochungʼ e chuny yo kotingʼo ligangla e lwete, nobaro oko mar yo modhi e puodho. Balaam nogoye mondo oduog e wangʼ yo.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

kikuyu: Donge Boaz, misebedo ka ibet gi jotichne ma nyiri, en anywolawa? Kawuono gotieno wangʼ nopiedh shairi kar dino.
english: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.

kikuyu: Ne abedo wuon jochan; kendo ne akawo chandruok joma welo.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Magi e nyinge thuondi mag Daudi: Jashobeam ma ja-Hakmon mane jatelo mar thuondi, nonego ji mia adek dichiel.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

kikuyu: Yesu Kristo e Jal mane obiro gi pi kod remo. Ne ok obiro gi pi kende, to nobiro gi pi kod remo. Roho Maler wacho ni ma en adieri, nikech Roho en e adiera.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

kikuyu: E piny got mar Efraim nomigi Shekem (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo) kod Gezer,
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Joote nodhi e dala ka dala e piny Efraim gi Manase duto nyaka ochopo Zebulun to ji nocharogi kendo nyierogi.
english: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo orango Daudi e sa mane odhi rado gi ja-Filistia, nopenjo Abner mane jatend jolweny niya, “Abner wuowini en wuod ngʼa?” Abner nodwoko niya “Yaye ruoth, akwongʼora e nyimi ni ok angʼeye.”
english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”

kikuyu: Nyithinda mahero, awinjo rem mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo, ka agombo mondo Kristo onywol eiu.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

kikuyu: Nikech oparo ketho duto moseketho kendo olokore owegi, obiro bedo mangima kuom adier; ok obi tho.
english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

kikuyu: Chwora ok nitiere dala; osedhiyo e wuoth mabor.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar jumano nyaka ubed gi chokruok mowal kendo kik uti tich moro amora mutiyo pile.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato kuomu dwaro kwedo ma, to ongʼe ni waonge gi tim mopogore gi mwapuonjoni, kendo kata kanise duto mag Nyasaye ongego.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno mad lokre mudho; mad Nyasaye man malo kik dewe; mad ler moro amora kik rieny kuome.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

kikuyu: kod Ziza wuod Shifi, ma wuod Alon, ma wuod Jedaya, wuod Shimri, wuod Shemaya.
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

kikuyu: Mad odag amingʼa! Mad kelne dhahabu moa Sheba. Mad ji duto sik ka lamone kendo ka gwedhe odiechiengʼ duto.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

kikuyu: Giwacho ni, ‘Donge kinde mag gero udi osechopo machiegni? Dala maduongʼni en agulu mitede, to wan to wan ringʼo!’
english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

kikuyu: Omiyo anadhi ir jotelo kendo awuo kodgi; adiera gingʼeyo yor Jehova Nyasaye, kod dwaro mar Nyasachgi.” To gi chuny achiel gin bende negituro jok, kendo gichodo rateke.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of the LORD, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

kikuyu: Eka ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kiyie to kik iwewa watho kuom kawo ngima ngʼatni. Kik ikwanwa kaka joketho kuom nego ngʼama onge ketho, nimar in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isetimo dwaroni.”
english: Therefore they cried to the LORD, and said, “We beg you, LORD, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, LORD, have done as it pleased you.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwond “Kik iketh gik moko.” Miktam mar Daudi. Kane oringone Saulo mi opondo e rogo. Kecha, yaye Nyasaye, yie ikecha nikech kuomi ema chunya yudoe kar pondo. Abiro pondo e bwo tipo mar bwombeni nyaka chop apaka mager rum.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

kikuyu: Jomoko e chokruokno nokok kawacho gimoro achiel to jomoko ne wacho gimachielo makoro jatend lweny ne ok nyal ngʼeyo malongʼo gima notimore nikech koko, omiyo nogolo chik mondo oter Paulo kama askeche odakie.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

kikuyu: Luok rochruokna duto oko kendo pwodha kuom richona.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

kikuyu: Ka pod otin, to chune ni nyaka otim gik ma joritne gi jorit mwandu wuon dwaro mondo otim, korito kinde mane wuon-gi ochano mondo jotijego oket mwandu duto e lwete.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

kikuyu: “Chik iti maber, Ayub, kendo winj gik manyisi; lingʼ mos, nimar abiro medo wuoyo.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

kikuyu: Kane Nyarombo noketho kido mar adek, ne awinjo gima ngima mar adek kawacho niya, “Bi!” Ne angʼicho to e nyima kanyo ne nitie faras maratengʼ! Ngʼat moidhe ne otingʼo ratil e lwete.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

kikuyu: Nokawo kido mopa mane oloso moketo e hekalu mar Nyasaye mane oyudo Nyasaye osewuoyoe ne Daudi kod wuode Solomon niya, “Aseyiero hekaluni gi Jerusalem e kind ogendini duto mag Israel, kendo abiro keto Nyinga kanyo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

kikuyu: To awachonu ni chiengʼ ngʼado bura weche nobed maberber ne Sodom moloyou.”
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

kikuyu: Chike misendiko nikare, inyalo genogi chuth.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

kikuyu: “Kechauru, yaye osiepena, kechauru, nikech lwet Nyasaye osetieka.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

kikuyu: Lop Efraim ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Manase, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

kikuyu: Magi e jodolo kod jo-Lawi mane odwogo gi Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel kod Jeshua: Seraya, Jeremia, Ezra,
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

kikuyu: Ka urito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ma amiyou kawuononi, to unuyud gweth.
english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;

kikuyu: Nooro joote ir Abimelek, mowacho niya, “Gaal wuod Ebed kod owetena osebiro Shekem kendo gidwaro mondo dala maduongʼ omonji.
english: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.

kikuyu: “Kwan joka Gershon kaluwore gi anywolagi kod dhoutgi.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

kikuyu: Eka nodwoke niya, “Ee, Ruoth, ayie ni in e Kristo ma Wuod Nyasaye, ma nonego obi e piny.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Mwanda mar Okinyi.” Zaburi mar Daudi. Nyasacha, Nyasacha, iweya nangʼo? Angʼo momiyo in mabor koda ma ok inyal resa? In mabor ma ok inyal winjo weche mag churna mondo iresa?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

kikuyu: magoyo erokamano ni Wuoro ka un gi mor. En ema osewalou tenge mondo uyud gweth mag jomaler e pinyruodh ler.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kikuyu: Magi e chike kod buche mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiwo kokalo kuom Musa mondo omi jo-Israel e pewe mag Moab e bath Aora Jordan kama omanyore gi Jeriko.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye tim ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ngʼwono mondo ubed gi kwe kod mor e kend ma ubiro donjoe.” Eka nogonegi oriti, kendo ne giywak malit,
english: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.

kikuyu: To misenginigo gin mana gik maparo ne ji richogi higa ka higa,
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka nyar jadolo olokore ochot, to nyakoni okuodo wi wuon-gi, omiyo nyaka wangʼe gi mach.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Koa dhood Zebulun ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa dhood Josef ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), kendo dhood Benjamin ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000).
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

kikuyu: Pinyno notingʼo Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idala kod Bethlehem. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gariyo.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Kinde duto mane gineno ka pesa opongʼo sanduku, jagoro maka ruoth kod jadolo maduongʼ ne biro kwano pesa mane okel e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ketogi e mifuke.
english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Nowachone jo-Israel niya, “E ndalo mabiro ka nyikwau nopenj wuoneu ni, ‘Kitegi nyiso angʼo?’
english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

kikuyu: Nofweny nigi ni tich mane gitiyo ne ok giti nigin giwegi, to negitiyo mana ne un kane giwuoyo kuom gik makoro osenyisu gi joma oseyalonu Injili kuom teko mar Roho Maler moa e polo. Kata malaike bende gombo mondo one.
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

kikuyu: Ruth nowacho niya, “Mad amed yudo ngʼwono e nyim wangʼi, yaye ruodha. Isehoya kendo isewuoyo gi ngʼwono ne jatichni; kata obedo ni an dhano adhana ma ok nyal pim kata gi achiel kuom jotijegi ma nyiri.”
english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”

kikuyu: To jogi wuoyo marach ka giyanyo nyaka gik ma ok giwinj tiendgi. Gichalo le maonge rieko, mager, maonge paro, mane ochwe mana mondo omaki oyangʼ. Jogi biro lal nono mana ka le mag bungu.
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

kikuyu: “Wachne Zerubabel ma jatend Juda ni, ‘Abiro yiengo polo gi piny.
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: Olemb tim makare nobed kwe; to tim makare nokel horuok gi chir nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Elija mowachone niya,
english: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,

kikuyu: “Ngʼat magero dalane gi remo kendo guro dala maduongʼ gi gige mecho enone malit!
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

kikuyu: Negikendo nyi ogendinigo bangʼe negichiwo nyigi mondo okend gi yawuot pinjego kendo negilamo nyisechegi.
english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

kikuyu: To joote nofwenyo gima negichano timo, omiyo negiringo gidhi Lustra gi Derbe, mier mag Lukaonia, kendo e mier molworogi,
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Koa kuom jower: Eliashib. Koa kuom jorit dhorangach: Shalum, Telem gi Uri.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gadek ne mar Shubael gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kane Reuben odok e bugo mane owit e Josef kendo oyudo ni Josef onge kanyo, noyiecho lepe.
english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nowuoro ka gipenjo niya, “Rieko machalo kama ngʼatni oyudo kanye to ok osomo?”
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

kikuyu: To kuom weche mawasewuoyoe to ipar, nimar Jehova Nyasaye en janeno e kindwa nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD is between you and me forever.”

kikuyu: Otienono Ruoth Yesu nobiro mochungʼ but Paulo mowachone niya, “Bed mana gi chir! Mana kaka isetimo nenda ei Jerusalem, e kaka nyaka itime e Rumi bende.”
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

kikuyu: Negiwachone, “Bed piny, kiyie, kendo isomnwago.” Omiyo Baruk nosomonegi.
english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.

kikuyu: Modekai nondiko gi teko mar ruoth Ahasuerus mokete sei gi tere mar ruoth bangʼe nooro barupego gi jongʼwech maringo matek koidho farese mag ruoth.
english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

kikuyu: E puothe duto mag mzabibu ywak nobedie, nikech abiro biro mondo amiu kum,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: “Omiyo gige thim kod ondiegi nodag kanyo, kendo kanyo tula nodagie. Onge gima nobedie kendo onge ngʼama nochak odagie e tienge duto.”
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano boche polo nobiro apoya moumogi, kendo dwol moro moa e boche polo nowacho niya, “Ma en Wuoda mahero, winjeuru!”
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nopenjo niya, “Pinyruoth Nyasaye chalo nade? Angʼo ma dapimego?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

kikuyu: Daudi nokawo wi ja-Filistia mokelo Jerusalem, to gige lweny mag ja-Filistia notero e hembe owuon.
english: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.

kikuyu: Oganda nopenje niya, “Kara en angʼo monego watim?”
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

kikuyu: Kite ne chalo gi mil polo, kendo lepe ne rachar ka pe.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

kikuyu: Ok ayie mondo dhako opuonj ji kata obed gi teko ewi ngʼama dichwo; nyaka olingʼ mos,
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mapando sigu manie chunye, dhoge nigi miriambo, to ngʼatno ma jakwoth ofuwo.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

kikuyu: Bende ne asingoranegi e thim nine ok abi kelogi nyaka e piny mane asemiyogi, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich, kendo en piny maber moloyo pinje duto
english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,

kikuyu: Giduto mudho mandiwa chalnegi okinyi; giloso osiep gi masiche mayudore e mudho mandiwa.
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato onge gi kidogi e ngimane to en ngʼama neno machiegni kendo ma muofu nimar wiye osewil ni ne osepwodhe oweyo richoge machon.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Dan gi jo-Yunani moa Uzal bende nongʼiewo mwandugi mag ohala. Ne giwilo kodi nyinyo mothedhi, gi yedhe maloso chiemo mamit kod modhi miwirruokgo.
english: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.

kikuyu: Malkija, ma en achiel kuom jotheth, nogedo nyaka e od jotij hekalu kod jo-ohala, kama omanyore gi Dhoranga Nonro mi ochopo nyaka kama ohinga ogomogo.
english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

kikuyu: Asewinjo ni chuny mar nyiseche maler ni kuomi, kendo ni in gi rieko matut, ngʼeyo kod rieko mokalo apima.
english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ladan ne gin: Jehiel wuode makayo, kiluwe gi Zetham kod Joel, giduto ne gin ji adek.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

kikuyu: Pogri kod mbekni manono mag piny nikech jok moketo chunygi e gik ma kamago medo bedo mabor moloyo gi Nyasaye.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

kikuyu: mi ojako chuny yien-no mane pod dongo, kendo ne otingʼe odhi kode mabor nyaka e piny moro ma jo-ohala madongo, odakie kendo nopidhe e dala maduongʼ mar jo-ohalago.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

kikuyu: Ji duto modak e piny nogo siboi kuom thogi, ka gimor kendo gimiyore chiwo, nikech jonabi ariyogo nosebedo kasando ji modak e piny.
english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Negiwuok kanyo mi gigo kambi e bath aora Arnon, ma en thim molawore nyaka e piny jo-Amor. Arnon en kiewo mar Moab, mantiere e kind Moab kod jo-Amor.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

kikuyu: Shimei ne nigi yawuowi apar gauchiel kod nyiri auchiel, owetene to ne onge gi nyithindo mangʼeny omiyo anywolagi duto ne ok obedo oganda maduongʼ kaka jo-Juda.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Jolweny duto mag Babulon mane ichiko gi jatend jolweny marito ruoth ne omuko ohinga duto moluoro Jerusalem.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

kikuyu: Mi jogi momew ochal gi Oreb kod Zeb mi ruodhigi duto chal gi Zeba kod Zalmuna,
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

kikuyu: Koro to wan e lweti. Timnwauru gimoro amora muneno ni ber kendo longʼonu.”
english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

kikuyu: Ka idonjo e puoth olemo mar wadu, inyalo chamo olemb mzabibu duto ma idwaro, to kik itingʼ moko ei okapu idhigo.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

kikuyu: Abiro keto od Ahab chal gi od Jeroboam wuod Nebat kendo ochal kaka od Baasha wuod Ahija.
english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

kikuyu: E kindeno Yesu nobiro koa Nazareth, e piny Galili mi Johana nobatise e aora Jordan.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

kikuyu: To ngʼat mawacho ni ongʼeye to ok tim gima odwaro en ja-miriambo kendo adiera onge e chunye.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Mosna joma oyie duto man kuom Kristo Yesu. Jowete man koda ka ooronu mos.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

kikuyu: To koro useweyo Nyasachu, ma resou e masicheu gi chandruoku. Ma usewacho ni, ‘Ooyo miwa ruodhwa.’ Omiyo sani suduru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kuchanoru e ogandau kod e dhoutu.”
english: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.”

kikuyu: Losne singʼenge mar mula kendo ilos nyange mag mula kendo iketgi achiel achiel e kondene angʼwen-go.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

kikuyu: Jotichni ok mi kata mana lum, to eka pod inyisowa kama: ‘Losuru matafare!’ Jotichni igoyo, to jogi ema nigi ketho.”
english: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”

kikuyu: Ruodh jatijno nokeche mi owene gopeno kendo ogonye odhi.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

kikuyu: Jadolo mowal to nokaw remo moko mag rwadhno kendo nokel ei Hemb Romo.
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Owadu biro chier.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo ma piny biro siko kotwo kendo lum motwi e lege ner? Nikech joma odak e iye timbegi mono, le kod winy osetho. Kata kamano, jogo wacho, “Ok none gima timorenwa.”
english: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”

kikuyu: Gikanyono jo-Jerusalem moko nochako penjo niya, “Donge ma e ngʼat mane gidwaro nego cha?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Debora kod Barak wuod Abinoam nowero wendni:
english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

kikuyu: Onge tim jwok manyalo mako joka Jakobo, kendo timbe ndagla ok nyal mako Israel. Ibiro goyo ngero kuom joka Jakobo ma Israel ni, ‘Ne gima Nyasaye osetimo!’
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

kikuyu: Beth Lebaoth kod Sharuhen. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gadek.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Juda ema ne tek moloyo owetene kendo ruoth nowuok kuome, to duongʼ mar kayo ne mar Josef.
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

kikuyu: Koa kuom Izhar noyier Shelomoth; koa kuom yawuot Shelomoth noyier Jahath.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

kikuyu: Josef nochako wuode makayo ni Manase kendo nowacho niya, “Ma en nikech Nyasaye osemiyo wiya owil gi chandruokna duto kod jood wuora duto.”
english: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

kikuyu: Nowacho wechegi Kapernaum kane oyudo opuonjo ei sinagogi.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

kikuyu: Eka nyipeche ma jo-Israel nodhi modonjo ir Farao kagiwacho niya, “Ere gima omiyo isetimone jotichni kama?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

kikuyu: Ka aparo ni kitandana biro hoya kendo ni piendena mayom biro dwoko chandruokna chien,
english: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

kikuyu: Ludhe mitingʼogo mesano nolos gi yiend siala kendo nobawgi gi dhahabu.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

kikuyu: Magi duto ne gin yawuot Heman jakor wach ne ruoth mane Nyasaye omiye kaluwore gi singruok ni nobiro tingʼe malo. Nyasaye nomiyo Heman yawuowi apar gangʼwen kod nyiri adek.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Rie badi mondo imake gi yo ka iwe.” Kuom Mano Musa norieyo bade kendo nomake gi yo ka iwe mi nochako olokore luth e lwete.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.

kikuyu: En gi nying moro mondik e kandhone kendo e bamne ni: Jaloch mar joloch kendo Ruoth mar ruodhi.
english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

kikuyu: kendo koro nodok dala, koidho gache kendo kosomo kitap Janabi Isaya.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

kikuyu: Nikech asebiro mondo aketh kind “ ‘ngʼato gi wuon mare, nyako gi min mare, chi wuowi gi dagi,
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

kikuyu: Mana kaka gode olworo Jerusalem, e kaka Jehova Nyasaye olworo joge chakre, tinende kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: to nyisgi ni, ‘Ne asayo ruoth mondo kik oora adog e od Jonathan mondo atho kanyo.’ ”
english: then you shall tell them, ‘I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.’”

kikuyu: To ka utamoru winjo Jehova Nyasaye, mi ungʼanyone chikene, to enokumu kaka ne okumo kwereu.
english: But if you will not listen to the LORD’s voice, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then the LORD’s hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

kikuyu: An Juda ma misumba Yesu Kristo, kendo ma owadgi Jakobo, Andiko ni joma oseluongi, ma Nyasaye Wuoro ohero, kendo ma Yesu Kristo orito:
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: nikech giseterore kendo remo ni e lwetgi. Negiterore gi nyisechegi manono; ne gichiwonegi koda ka nyithindgi mane ginywolona, kaka chiembgi.
english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

kikuyu: Ne afwenyora ne Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo kaka Nyasaye Maratego, to ne ok afwenyoranegi gi nyinga ma ungʼeyago ma en Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Kane Jehova Nyasaye odwogo joma otwe Sayun, to ne ochalonwa mana lek.
english: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata madichwo ma jaodgi jodolo oyiene chamo misangono, nikech en gima ler moloyo.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Kuom wach Jehova Nyasaye achiel kuom yawuot jonabi nowacho ni wadgi niya, “Goya gi gir lwenji mitingʼo,” to ngʼatno notamore.
english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

kikuyu: Wuon ngʼat makare nigi mor maduongʼ; ngʼatno man-gi wuowi mariek obedo mamor kode.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

kikuyu: Gipiago lewgi ka ligangla kendo gichimo wechegi ka asere motimo sum.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

kikuyu: “Joma otwere kalamo nyiseche manono, jwangʼo ngʼwono mado bedo margi.
english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

kikuyu: Ibiro kawo gik mangima duto, machwo kod mamon mondo gidonji kodi ei yie kendo iritgi gibed mangima.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai kod jopuonj chik ne dwaro yo ma digiyudgo ketho kuom Yesu. Kuom mano ne gingʼiyogo machiegni, mondo gine ka dochang ngʼatno chiengʼ Sabato.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

kikuyu: Ubiro dak e piny mane amiyo kwereu; unubed joga to anabed Nyasachu.
english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wach Jehova Nyasaye biro chalonegi mana ka wach awacha mar joma omer niya: Tim ma, tim macha, kendo tim ma, tim macha, matin ka, matin kacha, mamiyo gikwangʼ koni gi koni mi gipodhi kendo gihinyre ma makgi e obadho.
english: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

kikuyu: En jalweny mane machulo pokne kende ka en e lweny? En japur mane ma ok cham olemo mowuok e puothe mar mzabibu? Koso jakwath mane makwayo jamni, to ok omadhi cha jamnigo?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

kikuyu: Negimedo penjore kendgi niya, “Ere gima oparo kowacho ni, ‘Kinde matin?’ Ok wangʼeyo gima owacho.”
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nowinj wachno mabed giluoro, to onge ngʼato kuomu kendo manotim gima rachno kendo.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

kikuyu: Jehu nowachone niya, “Bi mondo idhi koda mondo ineye kaka achiwora tiyone Jehova Nyasaye.” Eka negidhi kode koidho gache.
english: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Abiro keto giko mar oganda maduongʼ mar jo-Misri ka atiyo gi lwet Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Notimo gik mamono e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, kane oluwo timbe maricho mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel odonje kendo ne ok olokore weyo gigo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

kikuyu: “Kinde duto ma Harun donjo e Kama Ler, notingʼ nying yawuot Israel e kore kondikgi e law akor mar ngʼado bura mondo obed kaka Rapar mochwere e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: eka nokete e bur manyien mane osekunyo ariwa e kor lwanda, eka nongʼielo kidi maduongʼ mi oumogo dho liendno bangʼe owuok odhi.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

kikuyu: e kinde oro to gichungʼ ma ok ringi, kendo lal nono e yoregi kinde ma piny liet.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

kikuyu: En wendo Simon ma janyongʼ piende ma ode ni e dho nam.”
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

kikuyu: Bi imonje gi kuma bor. Yiech deche mage; choke ka pith mar cham. Tieke chuth, kendo kik obed gi ngʼato moro amora motony.
english: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.

kikuyu: Ka ungʼanyo uweyo Jehova Nyasaye mi utiyo ne nyiseche manono, to obiro lokore mi okelnu thagruok kendo enotieku duto, kata obedo ni ne osedoko jakoru kamano.”
english: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

kikuyu: Nimar Israel gi Juda pod ok ojwangʼgi Nyasachgi, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, kata obedo ni pinygi opongʼ gi ketho e nyim Jalno Maler mar Israel.
english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by the LORD of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nowacho niya, “Un uwegi usebedo joneno magu kuom yiero mondo uti ne Jehova Nyasaye.” Negidwoko niya, “Ee, wan joneno.”
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

kikuyu: Magi e weche mag singruok mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa mondo omi jo-Israel otim kane gin Moab, kaachiel gi singruok mane osetimo kodgi Horeb.
english: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

kikuyu: to Jehova Nyasaye mon gi joma timo gik maricho, kendo omiyo wich wil kodgi e piny.
english: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Mazia, Bilgai kod Shemaya. Magi ema ne jodolo.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

kikuyu: Wachuru e dier ogendini niya, “Jehova Nyasaye olocho.” Piny osegur motegno, ok nyal yienge; obiro ngʼado ne ji bura maonge dewo wangʼ.
english: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Juda ema kidi mar gero kor ot kod sigingi migurogo hema nowuogie. Kuome ema atungʼ mar lweny, kod jotelo duto nowuogie.
english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

kikuyu: Giidho ka giluwo yo madhi Luhith, gi ywak malit ka gidhi; e yo maridore kadhi Horonaim kendo ywak malit mar kethruok winjore.
english: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

kikuyu: Mirima malich ne omako Daudi gi ngʼatno mowachone Nathan niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni ngʼat mane otimo kama owinjore otho!
english: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jogo ok ongʼeyo timo tim makare kendo utegi madongogi opongʼ mana gi gik moyaki.”
english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

kikuyu: Mogono ok onego ru gi thowi; nikech asemiyogigo kaka migapgi kuom misengini michiwona miwangʼo gi mach. En gima ler ka misango mar golo richo kod misango mar pwodhruok e ketho.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

kikuyu: To ok mano kende, to kata wan wawegi ma wan gi olemo mokwongo nyak mag Roho, wachur gie iwa ka pod warito gi siso maduongʼ mondo olokwa yawuot od Nyasaye, chiengʼ ma ringruok nowar.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

kikuyu: Eka Pilato nopenje niya, “Donge iwinjo neno ma jogi donjonigoni?”
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

kikuyu: Ngʼato achiel miyo ji ma ok odewo, to bende pod mwandu medorene moloyo, to ngʼat machielo kungo mokadhore, to ochopo mana e chan.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka usekonyo joma onge teko! Mano kaka usereso joma yomyom!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

kikuyu: Daudi nobedo ruodh jo-Israel duto kotimo maber kendo makare ni joge duto.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yiedhi madongo moa Tarshish ema ne mwandugi mag ohala. Ne ichalo gi yiedhi manie nam motingʼore mapek.
english: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Mar yawuot Kora. Kaluwore gi dwond alamoth. Wer. Nyasaye e kar pondowa kendo tekowa, en e kar konyruok man kodwa seche duto.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Elifaz ja-Teman, Bildad ja-Shua kod Zofar ja-Namath notimo gimane Jehova Nyasaye okonegi; kendo Jehova Nyasaye norwako lamb Ayub.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

kikuyu: Ooyo, Wuoro owuon oherou nikech usehera kendo useyie ni ne aa ka Nyasaye.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

kikuyu: Ka bedegi osetwo to gimukore oko kendo mon modogi michwakgi. Nimar gin ogendini maonge winjo; omiyo Jachwechgi onge gi miwafu kuomgi, kendo Jachwech ok nyisgi ngʼwono moro amora.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

kikuyu: Nondik wechegi moketgi kaka chik e pinje duto mondo oland ne ogendini gi dhout pinje mondo obed moikore ne chiengʼno.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

kikuyu: Rebeka eri; kawe mondo udhi, kendo obed chi wuod ruodhi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osechiko.”
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the LORD has spoken.”

kikuyu: Ka jaricho dhiyo nyime maber, e kaka richo bende medore, to joma kare biro neno podho margi.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

kikuyu: “Iparo ni in e ngʼat mane okuong nywol e piny? Koso ne intie kapok Nyasaye ochweyo gode?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

kikuyu: Emomiyo, awachoni ni richone mathoth osewene, nikech nonyiso hera mathoth. To ngʼat mowene richo manok, herane bende tin.”
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Gad mondo onyis Daudi odhi malo kar dino cham ma Arauna ja-Jebus mondo oger kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo ma ubiro dhi nyime ka udewo wangʼ joma ok timbegi nikare kendo kudewo wangʼ joma timbegi richo? Sela
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

kikuyu: e laini mar angʼwen chanie kite kaka krisolit gi oniks kod jaspa. Kidigo duto mondo ochan kaka thiwni mag dhahabu.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

kikuyu: koneuru joma nigi chuny mool ni, “Beduru motegno kendo kik uluor; nimar Nyasachu biro biro, mondo ochul kuor ne wasiku, kaka owinjore kendo oresu.”
english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruodh polo, to gin ok osemigi.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye en achiel kende kendo obiro keto kare joma oter nyangu kuom yie, mana kaka otimo ne joma ok oter nyangu bende e yor yie achielno.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

kikuyu: Jorit rangeye nogoyo koko kowinjo wach maberno mi wachno notundo ne joka ruoth.
english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Israel pinje duto mane osingore ni enomi kweregi, kendo ne gikawogi mi gidakie.
english: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

kikuyu: Winj siem, yaye Jerusalem, ka ok kamano to abiro weyi, mi awe pinyi nono, ma ngʼato angʼata ok nyal dak e iye.”
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼato kawo tongʼ e od winyo, e kaka lweta oseyudo kuma mwandu mag pinje nitie; mana kaka ji choko tongʼ modongʼ kendgi, e kaka ne achoko pinje duto, maonge mano mane nyalo kwadho bwombe, kata ngʼamo dhoge mondo oywagi.’ ”
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

kikuyu: gi Aijalon kod Gath Rimon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Kaka koro ne waseketho seche mathoth, to kwangʼ bende bedo marach, kendo kinde mag Sap Tweyo Chiemo bende nosekadho, Paulo nongʼado rieko ni jokwangʼ kowacho niya,
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

kikuyu: Donge kwethgi, gi gigegi kod jambgi duto biro bedo mawa? Omiyo ka wayie timo kamano eka giniyie dak kodwa.”
english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

kikuyu: Jolweny nokawo rombe gi dhok kuom gik moyaki, gigo mabeyo nowal ne Nyasaye mondo otimnego Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi misango Gilgal.”
english: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal.”

kikuyu: mor gi ilo kuondego, dwond miaha kod wuon kisera, kod dwond jogo makelo chiwo mar goyo erokamano ne od Jehova Nyasaye. Negiwacho niya, “ ‘ “Goneuru Jehova Nyasaye Maratego erokamano, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ber; herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.” Nimar anaduog gweth ne piny mane gin-go chon,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Armies, for the LORD is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into the LORD’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo e Dhoranga Benjamin, jatend jorito, ma nyinge en Irija wuod Shelemia, ma wuod Hanania, nomake kendo owacho niya, “Nenore ni iweyowa idokne jo-Babulon!”
english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”

kikuyu: Ne omako thuol mangʼongono tiende ni thuol machon, ma en Jachien kata Satan matek, kendo notweye kuom higni alufu achiel.
english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

kikuyu: Nowuoyo, mi bonyo nosieko, ongogo mokalo akwana;
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke kapenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo iluonga ni ngʼama ber? Onge ngʼama ber makmana Nyasaye kende.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

kikuyu: Aluongo Nyasaye mondo obed janeno mara, ka anyisou ni ne ok aduogo Korintho mana mondo omi kik akelnu kuyo.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye otimnu ngʼwonone gi adierane makare, kata an bende abiro timonu tim ngʼwonono machal kamano nikech ma musetimo.
english: Now may the LORD show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

kikuyu: Ashdod gi Gaza kod miechgi mochopo nyaka Wadi manie tongʼ-gi gi Misri, kendo koluwo nyaka dho Nam Maduongʼ bende ne margi.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

kikuyu: Analos singruok manyaka chiengʼ kodgi: Ok anawe timonegi maber, kendo anamigi giluora, mondo omi kik gilokre giweya.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa mosejiwo ngʼat maa yo wuok chiengʼ, kaluonge kuom tim makare mondo otim tichne? Ochiwo ogendini e lwete kendo oloyo Ruodhi e nyime. Otiekogi gi liganglane ma gichal gi buru kendo okeyogi gi asere mana ka mihudhwe ma yamo tero.
english: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

kikuyu: kapod warito geno mogwedhi ma en fwenyruok man-gi duongʼ mar Nyasacha maduongʼ kod Jawarwa, Yesu Kristo,
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato riambo ne nyawadgi; dhogi mohero jaro ji wuoyo gi wuond.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

kikuyu: To ne angʼwononegi ma ok atimo kamano mondo nyinga kik kethre e kind ogendini mane oneno kagolo jo-Israel e piny Misri.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

kikuyu: Rieko osegero ode, osechungo sirnige abiriyo.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

kikuyu: kendo kik ichwak ngʼato e bura nikech odhier.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

kikuyu: E kinde mamoko lweny nowuok Gezer e kindgi gi jo-Filistia. E ndalogo Sibekai ma ja-Hushath nonego Sipai mane en achiel kuom nyikwa Refai omiyo nolo jo-Filistia.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
