kikuyu: Lwet jonenogo ema onego okuong ogoye motho, bangʼe eka joma moko nogoye. Nyaka ugol tim marachno oa e dieru.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nopenjo niya, “En misango machal nade mar pwodhruok e ketho monego wakowne?” Negidwoko niya, “Dhahabu abich molos machal gi buche gi dhahabu abich molos machal gi oyieyo ma kwan-gi rom gi ruodhi mag jo-Filistia, nikech masich tuo nomakou kaachiel gi ruodhiu.
english: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

kikuyu: To jomaler manie piny, to gin kaka joma nigi duongʼ ma ahero gi chunya duto.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

kikuyu: Kendo angʼeyo ni ngʼatni noter e paradiso to ok angʼeyo ni gino notimore adier kata nine en mana fweny, to Nyasaye kende ema ongʼeyo.
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

kikuyu: Omiyo nogero hekalu motieko koume gi yiende kod bepe Sida.
english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

kikuyu: “To ka ungʼanyo mi uriworu kod jogo motony manie pinyni modongʼ e dieru kendo unywomoru kodgi,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kaw gik madum mangʼwe ngʼar kaka duogo, sare, mieny kod ubani maler, kendo pekgi nyaka bed maromre,
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

kikuyu: Joma ni mabor kodi biro lal nono kendo ibiro tieko ji duto ma ok jo-adiera ne in.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

kikuyu: Abiro kelo pi mar nam e piny mondo oketh gik mangima modak e bwo polo, gimoro amora man kod muya mar ngima e iye. Gimoro amora mae piny biro tho.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Hezekia nobedo matuo kendo nohewore. Janabi Isaya wuod Amoz nodhi ire mowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Los weche mag dalani maber nikech ndaloni mar tho ochopo kendo ok inichangi.”
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

kikuyu: “To ne ok gidewe, kendo moro ka moro kuomgi nowuok oweye odhi, moro ne odhi e puothe, to machielo nodhi e ohande.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

kikuyu: ka dipo ni awacho ne kethruok ni, ‘In e wuonwa,’ kendo aluongo kudni ni, ‘minwa,’ kata ni, ‘nyamera,’
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni e piem mar ngʼwech jongʼwech, duto ringo, to ngʼato achiel kende ema yudo mich? Omiyo ringuru e yo madimi uyud mich.
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Magi duto manie ndiko ne ayudo kuom lwet Jehova Nyasaye mane ni kuoma, kendo nomiya winjo matut kuom chenro mar gedo.”
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

kikuyu: Nyaka ikel jo-Lawi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, mondo jo-Israel nyaka oyie lwetgi kuomgi.
english: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

kikuyu: “Ka chiayo mokwalno oyudego kangima bed ni en rwath kata punda kata rombo, nyaka ochul nyadiriyo.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: “Lep Harun mopwodhi mag dolo nyaka dongʼ ni yawuote gi nyikwaye bangʼ thone mondo mi owirgi gi mo kiketogi kaka jodolo.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nodhi ire ma onyodhe. Kane Isaka owinjo tik lepe, nogwedhe kendo owachone niya, “Ee, tik mar wuoda dungʼ mamit machalo gi tik mar puodho, ma Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho.
english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

kikuyu: Ogandani en tiengʼ makoch kendo mobam, ma timbegi maricho nyiso, ni koro ok gin mag Nyasaye.
english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech isewacho ni, Ogendini ariyogi gi pinjegi biro bedo mawa kendo wabiro kawogi, kata obedo ni an Jehova Nyasaye ne antie,
english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,

kikuyu: Mi jatichni obed mamor, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, nimar in ema aketo genona kuomi.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo wacho niya, “Sibuor ni e wangʼ yo, sibuor mager bayo e yore mag dala!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

kikuyu: To ngʼato ka ngʼato maluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye noresi; nikech ewi got Sayun kendo ei Jerusalem resruok nobedie, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osewacho, e dier joma otony ma Jehova Nyasaye oluongo.”
english: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the remnant, those whom the LORD calls.

kikuyu: Ka dine ok abiro mi awuoyo kodgi, to dine ok buch richo oloyogi. To koro, onge wach ma ginyalo umogo richogi.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya nowacho niya, “To un joka Daudi, koro winjuru! Chand muchandogo ji pok oromou? Koso pod udwaro chando Nyasacha bende?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

kikuyu: Jowetena, pod ok akwanra kaka ngʼat moseyudo gino, to gimoro achiel matimo en ni wiya wil gi gik mosekadho, to ahawo gik manyime,
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Aseneno jogi kendo gin joma tokgi tek.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto modak e gwengʼno nogoye gi kite motho. Nyaka ugol tim marachni e dieru kendo jo-Israel duto kowinjo wachno nobed maluor.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

kikuyu: Abiro dhi nyime ka apakora kata obedo ni pakruok ma apakorago ok kony gimoro. To koro awuoyo kuom lek gi fweny mane Ruoth omiya.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar ochiko, e dwe mar ochiko ne en Abiezer ja-Anathoth ma ja-Benjamin. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Gisedok e richo mag kweregi, mane otamore winjo wechega. Giseluwo bangʼ nyiseche manono mondo gitinegi. Od Israel gi od Juda giduto oseketho singruok mane atimo gi kweregi.
english: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

kikuyu: Losne thiwni ariyo mag dhahabu kendo itwegi e riak law agoko.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: “Ka dine bed ni ok ongʼad ndalogo machiek to onge ngʼama dine otony, to nikech wach joma oyier, ndalogo ibiro ngʼado machiek.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

kikuyu: Bangʼe kane Senakerib ruodh Asuria kod jolweny mage duto ne ogoyo agengʼa Lakish, nooro jotend lweny mage Jerusalem mondo owach ne Hezekia ruodh Juda kod jo-Juda duto mane ni kanyo kowacho niya,
english: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: Koth nochwe maduongʼ, aore nopongʼ mogingore, kendo yamo nokudho matek mogoyo odno; to kata kamano ne ok opodho, nikech mise mare ne ni e lwanda.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nodhi moyalo ne chunje manie twech,
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye ne owuok mi odhi onego ji alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro gabich e kambi mar jo-Asuria. Kane ji ochiewo gokinyi negiyudo mana ringre joma otho!
english: Then the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

kikuyu: To nikech jatichna Kaleb nigi chuny mopogore kod mag-gi kendo ma luwa gi chunye duto, abiro tere e piny mane odhiyoeno, kendo nyikwaye nokaw pinyno kaka girkeni margi.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

kikuyu: duto negiketo ewi agoko, eka Harun nowangʼogie kendo mar misango.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

kikuyu: To anamiye sulwe mar okinyi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

kikuyu: Akwayo Yudia gi Suntuke mondo giwinjre kuom Ruoth.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

kikuyu: mondo omi onyisi yore mopondo mag rieko, nimar rieko madier nigi rachne gi berne. To ngʼe ni Nyasaye wiye osewil kata mana gi richogi moko.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

kikuyu: ogwendene to norwakoe mula mothedhi, kendo noliero tongʼ mar mula e ngʼeye.
english: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

kikuyu: Hemb Romo, Sandug Rapar mar pwodhruok gi raumne, kod gik moko duto mag hema kaka:
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano, ka usechiemo ma uyiengʼ, ka usegero ute mabeyo ma udakie
english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kaw jotend jogi duto, neg-gi kendo dhurgi e lela e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, mondo omi mirimb Jehova Nyasaye owuog kuom Israel.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

kikuyu: Koso angʼo mane omono panda ei liel ka nyathi monywol kosetho, kata ka nyathi mayom mane ok oneno ler mar odiechiengʼ?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

kikuyu: Omiyo Manase gi Efraim, ma nyikwa Josef, noyudo girkeni mag-gi.
english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

kikuyu: Jo-Daudi nowichore mi odok. Kane gichopo, neginyiso Daudi weche duto.
english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

kikuyu: “Unyalo neno un uwegi, kaachiel gi Benjamin owadwa bende, ni adier an Josef ema awuoyo kodu.
english: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osedar Hebron, Daudi nokendo monde kaachiel kod mon mamoko Jerusalem kendo nonywolone yawuowi gi nyiri mangʼeny.
english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Ma e kaka onego pogi pinyni kaka girkeni ni ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel, ka joka Josef to yudo nyadiriyo.
english: The Lord GOD says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

kikuyu: Nyasach kwerewa nochiero Yesu oa kuom joma otho, en e Yesu mane unego ka uguro e msalaba.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu wacho wechegi dhako moro maneni ei ogandano nowacho matek niya, “Ogwedh miyo mane onywoli kendo odhodhi.”
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

kikuyu: Nyaka oneg winyo achiel ei dapi motingʼo pi soko,
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Saulo osetho, Daudi noduogo koa e lweny mane oloyoe jo-Amalek mi nonindo Ziklag ndalo ariyo.
english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

kikuyu: Nikodemo, jal manoyudo osedhi ir Yesu motelo, kendo mane en achiel kuomgi, nopenjo niya,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

kikuyu: Pinje nowinjo humbe kendo ne gikunyone bur mi onyumore. Ne giywaye gi nyororo mi gitere nyaka e piny Misri.
english: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Koro twe kalatas mondikie wechego motegno kendo chan chikego e nyim jopuonjrena.
english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

kikuyu: Kik utingʼ ofuku mar pesa, kata ofuku mar wuoth, kata mana opato, kendo kik umos ngʼato e yo.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

kikuyu: To ungʼeyo ni Kristo nobiro mondo ogol richowa. Ungʼeyo bende ni richo onge kuome.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

kikuyu: Wayie gi nend dhano, to nend Nyasaye ema duongʼ moloyo nikech en neno ma Nyasaye owuon osewacho kuom Wuode.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno ji nowach ni Jerusalem niya, “Kik iluor, yaye Sayun, kik iwe badi obed mobengni.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

kikuyu: Kute duto mafuyo e kweth kik ucham nimar gin gik makwero.
english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Nikech chandruok maniyudi ka wasiki okeloni ka in e twech, nucham nyaka nyithindu munywolo, ma gin ringre yawuotu kod nyiu ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

kikuyu: Joana chi Chuza, mane jatelo e od Herode gi Susana kod mon mamoko mathoth. Mon-gi nekonyogi ka gichiwonegi gigegi giwegi.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

kikuyu: Kik chunyu jogi kata bedo maluor ka wach mofwongʼ owinjore e piny; wach mofwongʼ achiel biro higani, machielo noluwe, wach mofwongʼ mar masira e piny, kendo mar jatelo ma ok dwar, jatelo machielo.
english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ohero rangeye mag Sayun, moloyo kuonde dak duto mag Jakobo.
english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

kikuyu: Mikaya nodhi nyime kawacho niya, “Kuom mano winj wach Jehova Nyasaye: Naneno Jehova Nyasaye kobet e kom duongʼne gi jopolo duto kochungʼ molwore, e bade korachwich kendo e bade koracham.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word. I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

kikuyu: Nochakore Aroer koluwore gi holo mar Arnon, kendo koluwore gi dalano manie dier holono, mi oriwo gode duto mag Medeba mochopo nyaka Dibon,
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ukelona misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag cham, to ok anayiego; bende kata obedo ni ukelona misengini mag lalruok to ok abi yiego.
english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma yoregi ler, mawuotho koluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye.
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Notelo ne Israel kuom higni piero ariyo gadek; eka notho, kendo noyike Shamir.
english: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

kikuyu: Kik iluor kuom sand ma ibiro yudo machiegni. Adier, anyisou ni Jachien biro tweyo jomoko kuomu e od twech mondo otemugo kendo ubiro yudo sandruok kuom ndalo apar. Bed ja-adiera nyaka kar tho mi anamiyi osimbo mar ngima.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

kikuyu: Nodwokou piny momiyo kech okayou, eka bangʼe nomiyou manna mondo ucham ma en chiemo mane pok uneno ma kata mana kwereu bende ne pok oneno. Notimonu kamano mondo opuonjugo ni dhano ok bed mangima nikech chiemo kende to nikech wach ka wach moa e dho Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, kane uluonga to abiro ma ok adagi. To koro nyisaneuru, en angʼo momiyo ne uluonga?”
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

kikuyu: Aore mag Edom nobar okak, lopene nolokre lot maliet mawengʼo, kendo pinye nowangʼ duto!
english: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni ka uchiworu ni ngʼato mondo uwinje kaka wasumbini to un wasumbini mag jal muwinjono, bed ni un wasumbini mag richo, makelo tho, kata mag winjo wach, makelo tim makare.
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

kikuyu: eka Israel nowacho ne Josef niya, “Kaka ingʼeyo ni oweteni kwayo jamni machiegni gi Shekem; koro bi mondo aori irgi.” Josef nodwoke niya, “Mano ber.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: to nyiimbe abiriyogo, to ichiw gi mogo mayom maromo kilo achiel moru gi mo.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: ka ichiko iti ni weche mag rieko kendo kiketo chunyi mondo iwinj tiend weche,
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

kikuyu: To mago duto maonge gi thuokgi kata kalagakla ok onego ucham nimar kuomu gin gik mogak.
english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Kik iriemba buti bende kik igol Roho Maler mari kuoma.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

kikuyu: Ayawo dhoga kendo agamo yweyo, ka agombo chikeni.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo nodhi momonjo joma odak Debir (machon ne iluongo ni Kiriath Sefa).
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

kikuyu: Eka okwerogi kokecho kendo obwogogi kopongʼ gi mirima mager, kowacho niya,
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

kikuyu: To mwandu mawan-goni watingʼo e agulni mag lowo, mondo oyangre ni teko maduongʼ mawan-goni oa kuom Nyasaye, to ok oa kuomwa wawegi.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

kikuyu: Dhorangeyene osegore piny molal ei lowo, oseturo lodi mage kendo kethogi. Ruodhe gi jodonge oke e kind ogendini, chik onge koro, to jonabi mage koro ok yud fweny moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma kamano owinjo weche mag singruok mi omiyore gweth kende kendo owacho e chunye niya, “Onge gima biro tima kata obedo ni asetimo mana giga awuon maparo.” Magi duto nokel masira ne pinje mag pi to gi kuonde motwo.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

kikuyu: to bende akecho ahinya gi ogendini modak kodhialore. Mokwongo ne akecho mana matin, to koro gisemiyo chandruok omedo doko malit moloyo.’
english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

kikuyu: Kendo chwo duto mane ni e od Ibrahim, kaachiel gi monywol e ode kata ma ongʼiewo, bende noter nyangu kode.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

kikuyu: Jo-Hiti nodwoko Ibrahim niya,
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: Emomiyo sibuor moa e bungu nomonjgi, ondiek moa e thim nokidhgi, kwach noliwgi but miechgi mondo okidh matindo tindo, ngʼato angʼata manohedhre wuok oko, nimar ngʼanyo margi duongʼ kendo gisebaro nyadi mangʼeny.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

kikuyu: Eka iwachne ni, ‘Magi gin mag jatichni Jakobo. Gin mich ma oor ne ruodha Esau, Jakobo bende biro bangʼwa.’ ”
english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

kikuyu: jogi ne joma beyo gi lala mane ok owinjore dak e pinyni. Negibayo abaya e thimbe kod gode ka gidak e bwo lwendni gi buche.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

kikuyu: Kik nyiego maki gi joricho bende kik iyie chunyi gomb bedo e chokruok margi;
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Moab oneno ka lweny loye, ne odhi gi ji mia abiriyo man kod ligangla, kotemo muomogo ruodh Edom mondo otony; to ne otamogi.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

kikuyu: Nobed maber ne jotije ma ruodhgi noyud ka oikore kata ka obiro e arita mar ariyo kata mar adek gotieno.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

kikuyu: Nokawo dhahabu gi fedha duto kod gik moko duto mane oyudo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod mwandu duto mane ni e od ruoth, bende nokawo. Ji moko mano mako e lweny, bangʼe nodok e piny Samaria.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

kikuyu: Gola oko e obadho mopondo mochikna nikech in e kar pondona.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

kikuyu: Obiro keloni wach mabiro miyo iyud warruok, in kaachiel gi joodi duto.’
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

kikuyu: E kinde duto ma en ja-Nazir, ok onego ocham gimoro amora mowuok kuom olemb mzabibu, bed ni en kothe kata opokone.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo awachonu ni, kik uparru kuom ngimau, kata kuom gik ma ubiro chamo kata madho; kata kuom dendu kata gik ma ubiro rwako. Donge ngima duongʼ moloyo chiemo, koso del donge duongʼ moloyo lewni?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Keluru rech moko kuom mago ma usemako.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi nyasaye ma wendo e dieru, kendo kik ukulru ne nyasaye ma ukia.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gilor gia ewi got, Yesu nowuoyo negi kowacho niya, “Kik uwach ne ngʼato angʼata gima useneno, nyaka chop kinde ma Wuod Dhano nochier koa kuom joma otho.”
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama timbene richo biro nene mi iye wangʼ, obiro mwodo lekene kendo obiro chiyore morum; gik ma ngʼama timbene richo gombo ni otimrene ok bi timorene ngangʼ.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “An e Nyasach kwereni, Nyasach Ibrahim gi Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo.” Kane Musa owinjo wachno to nopando wangʼe, nikech noluoro rango wangʼ Nyasaye.
english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Lamek, Methusela nodak higni mia abiriyo gi piero aboro gariyo kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: kendo moserieyo lwete maber mar ngʼwono ne an e nyim ruoth kod jongʼadne rieko kod jotend ruoth maroteke mondo omiya luor. Nikech lwet Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha neni kuoma, ne abedo gi chir mi achoko jotelo duto moa Israel mondo odhi koda.
english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to the LORD my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.

kikuyu: Onge pok mar Israel maa e dhoodni to dhi e dhoot machielo, nimar ja-Israel moro ka moro norit lowo mane oyudo koa kuom kwerene.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

kikuyu: Ja-Kenturo nodwoko kawacho niya, “Ruoth, ok awinjora ibi idonji ei oda. To wach mana wach kende, to jatichna biro chango.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Abiro keto jakwath achiel maritogi, ma en jatichna Daudi, kendo enoritgi maber mi enobed jakwadhgi.
english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

kikuyu: “Koro adhi ir Ngʼat mane oora, to onge ngʼato kuomu mapenja ni, ‘Idhi kanye?’
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

kikuyu: “Kendo kik idonj e ot mantiere nyasi ma ibed piny mondo ichiem kendo metho.
english: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”

kikuyu: mosebayo yo moweyo adiera. Giseweyo adiera ka gipuonjo ni chier osetimore, kendo giketho yie mar ji moko.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye ne odagi jo-Israel duto; nokumogi mi oketegi e lwet joyeko nyaka ne ogologi chutho e wangʼe.
english: The LORD rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Ladan mane gin joka Gershon ma anywola mar Ladan kendo mane jotelo mag dhout Ladan ja-Gershon ne gin Jehiel,
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto oseyawo pacha kendo ok asetamore winjo wachne; bende ok asedok chien.
english: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

kikuyu: To an dawach angʼo? Osewuoyo koda mi en owuon osetimona ma, abiro wuotho kadembora e ngimana duto nikech lit manie chunya.
english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

kikuyu: Koro sa osechopo ma ingʼadone piny bura, kendo sani ema ruodh pinyni noriemb oko.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Kel oganda mar jo-mahundu mondo omonj-gi kendo oyakgi.
english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.

kikuyu: Hezekia notho moyweyo kaka kwerene kendo Manase wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Yesu nodhi kodgi. Kane oyudo ok en mabor gi ot, jaduongʼ lweny nooro osiepene mondo owachne niya, “Ruoth, kik ichandri, nikech ok awinjora ibi idonji ei oda.
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Jakobo ogwedho yawuot Josef, moro ka moro, sa ma nochiegni tho kendo nolemo koyiengore e ludhe mar wuoth.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

kikuyu: Bende, dwaruru kwe kod mwandu mar dala maduongʼ ma aseterou e twech. Lamuru Jehova Nyasaye, ndalono nikech kodhi maber to un bende unudhi maber.”
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to the LORD for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

kikuyu: Musa nowachonegi niya, “Mano ema ucham kawuono nikech kawuono en Sabato ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ok unuyud chiemo munyalo kwanyo kawuono.
english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.

kikuyu: Gilead en dala machwo ma jo-mahundu odakie, en dala mosechwerie remb ji.
english: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.

kikuyu: “Dhi mondo inyis Hezekia ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Daudi kwaru wacho: Asewinjo lemoni kendo aseneno pi wangʼi; omiyo abiro medi ngima moromo higni apar gabich.
english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nochako obiro ni Zekaria niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Waa Bethlehem e piny Juda ka wadhi e chuny piny manie piny gode mag Efraim kuma adakie. Asebedo Bethlehem e piny Juda kendo koro adok e od Jehova Nyasaye. Onge ngʼama oserwaka e ode.
english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to the LORD’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

kikuyu: Jabez noywagorene Nyasach Israel, “Yaye, yie igwedha mondo pinyruodha omedre! Mad lweti obed koda kendo orita mondo kik gima rach ohinya kendo abedi maonge rem.” To Nyasaye notimone mana kaka ne okwayono.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

kikuyu: jo-Bethlehem kod Netofa, ji mia achiel gi piero aboro gaboro (188),
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

kikuyu: To Roho owuon timo neno kaachiel gi chunywa ni wan nyithind Nyasaye.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

kikuyu: Bangʼ timo winjruok kode, nokaw loch kokonyore gi weche mag miriambo kendo kokonyore gi ji matin nono.
english: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo goyo apedha ni joma onge nyalo kendo omakogi e otegu mage mosechiko.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

kikuyu: to ngʼat ma sungore mondo osungre kama: ni ongʼeya, kendo owinja, ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, matimo ngʼwono, kendo mangʼado bura mar adier, kendo matimo gik makare e piny, nikech magi ema amorgo,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Farao noluongo Musa mi owachone niya, “Dhiuru, ulam Jehova Nyasaye. Mondu kod nyithindu nyalo dhi kodu; makmana dhou gi jambu ema nyaka dongʼ.”
english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

kikuyu: To un muluoro nyinga, tekona nopilre kuomu ka wangʼ chiengʼ makelo ler mi changu gi bwombene. Kendo unuwuog oko ka ulengʼoru gi ilo ka nyiroye moyawnegi dho abila.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko Nyasaye notemo Ibrahim. Noluonge niya, “Ibrahim!” Eka nodwoke niya, “Eri an ka.”
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: asetimo gima kare kendo madier, omiyo kik iweya e lwet joma sanda.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

kikuyu: Ne akawo chudo e kanisa mondo atinugo mana ka gima amayogi.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo e gwenge mag Zuf, Saulo nowachone jatich mane ni kode niya, “Bi wadogi, dipo ka wuora oweyo paro punde kendo mochako mana parowa.”
english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”

kikuyu: mondo gitieg jo-Nyasaye duto obed molony kuom tiyo tich Kristo, eka ringre Kristo ogerre,
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

kikuyu: Bende ne aneno dhakono komer gi remb jomaler mag Nyasaye, remb jogo mane ohulo ni Yesu e Ruoth. Kane anene ne awuoro ahinya.
english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, mane uora ire mondo aterne kwayou, wacho:
english: and said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:

kikuyu: “Ka jogi Israel olo e lweny gi jowasikgi nikech gisekethoni, to bangʼe gilokore mi gipako nyingi, ka gilamo kendo gikwayo e hekaluni,
english: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

kikuyu: Kendo ngʼato angʼata ma ok otingʼo msalape mondo oluwa ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nopwodh chunyu kod chuny nyikwau mondo uhere gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto mondo udagi amingʼa.
english: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

kikuyu: To jogo mane oneno gima notimore nonyiso ji gik moko duto mane osetimore ne ngʼat mane nigi jochiende kendo ne anguro bende.
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

kikuyu: Otienono Jakobo nochungʼ mokawo monde ariyo, jotichne mamon ariyo kod yawuote apar gachiel kendo negikadho aora mar Jabok.
english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

kikuyu: Bolruok kod luoro Jehova Nyasaye kelo mwandu gi luor kod dak amingʼa.
english: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

kikuyu: Kik umor, yaye Israel; bende kik ubed gi ilo kaka ogendini mamoko. Nimar ok usebedo jo-adiera ne Nyasachu; usehero chudo mar ochot michulougo, e kuonde dino cham.
english: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.

kikuyu: “Parie kaka teko Nyasaye duongʼ en e japuonj maberie moloyo?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

kikuyu: Ojaro jojaro masungore to ochiwo ngʼwono ni joma obolore.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye ngima! Pak obed ne Lwandana! Duongʼ obed ni Nyasaye, ma Lwanda kendo ma Jawarna.
english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

kikuyu: Omiyo nyisgiuru ni Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni abiro timonu mana gigo mane awinjo kuwacho:
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka nochalo ka bor polo oume godiechiengʼ to gotieno ochalo ka mach.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

kikuyu: To kinyne gokinyi wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Sokoni mondo ogwedhi, kendo ibed mamor gi chiegi mane ikendo ka in wuowi.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

kikuyu: Yaye in dala ma mahu opongʼo, yaye dala maduongʼ ma koko gi mor kod ilo opongʼo? Jogi mane otho ok noneg gi ligangla to bende ne ok githo e lweny.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

kikuyu: Mondo jadolo opwodh odno, nyaka okaw winy ariyo, yiend sida moko gi usi makwar kod owino.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kikuyu: Eka oganda nooro jomoko mondo odhi Shilo kendo negidwogo gi Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, mobedo e kind kerubi. Kendo yawuot Eli ariyo ma gin Hofni gi Finehas nobiro gi Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Nyasaye.
english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nowachone Solomon niya, “Bed motegno kendo gichir kendo tim tijni. Kik ibed maluor kendo kik chunyi nyosre nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha nobed kodi. Ok enojwangʼi bende ok noweyi nyaka itiek tije mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.

kikuyu: To ka kama ilnino omedore e del bangʼ ka oseland ni oler,
english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

kikuyu: Ok ginihiny kata ketho gimoro e godena duto maler, nimar rieko mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼ piny, mana ka pi mopongʼo nam.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

kikuyu: Ongʼere in e ot moro amora maduongʼ nitie gige tedo molos gi dhahabu kata fedha, to bende nitie moko molosi gi bao kata lowo. Mokwongogo itiyogo tije mogen, to mokogo itiyogo tich aticha.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye olocho kendo orwakore gi duongʼ, Jehova Nyasaye orwakore gi duongʼ, kendo omanore gi teko. Piny ochungʼ mongirore; onge ngʼama nyalo yienge.
english: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Nokela kama ni thuolo; noresa nikech nomor koda.
english: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, joma ne nigi chandruok ok nochak obed gikuyo kendo. E ndalo mosekadho Nyasaye nomiyo piny Zebulun gi piny Naftali odoko pinje michayo, to e ndalo mabiro Jehova Nyasaye notingʼ malo Galili mar ogendini man yo nam modak e tiend aora Jordan:
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka pinyruodhe nosegurore maber, nonego jotelo mane onego wuon mare mane ruoth.
english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

kikuyu: Nying maber longʼo moloyo mo mangʼwe ngʼar, kendo odiechieng tho ber moloyo odiechieng nywol.
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

kikuyu: Nochwado kor ot yo ka iye gi bepe sida chakre tiend ot nyaka yiend tado, bende noloso dier ot gi yiend bap Saipras.
english: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

kikuyu: “Weuru ji duto mangʼeyogi tin obi kae!” Owacho ni jogo maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura.
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Josia nomuko kendo oketho kuonde duto motingʼore gi malo mitimoe misengini mane ruodhi mag Israel ogero e miech Samaria mane omiyo Jehova Nyasaye mirima mana kaka notimo Bethel.
english: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

kikuyu: Thuol nowacho ne dhako niya, “Adier ok unutho.
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

kikuyu: Nikech ne en-gi geche chuma mia ochiko kendo notiyo jo-Israel gachuna kuom higni piero ariyo, ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo oresgi.
english: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

kikuyu: Jogo duto moriwore gi joma osekwan ma jo-higni piero ariyo kadhi nyime nyaka kel chiwono ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: kowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e dala man nyimu cha kendo udhi yudo mapiyo kanyna moro motwe kuno ka nyathine ni bute kanyo; gonygiuru mondo ukelnagi.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

kikuyu: Noromre duto ka borne gi lachne romo bat achiel kendo nobane nyadiriyo.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

kikuyu: An to dabed nade? Wichkuot machal kama dater kanye? To in to? Dibed machal kaka achiel kuom joricho mofuwo e Israel. Kiyie to wuo gi ruoth; ok obi tamore mondo kik ikenda.”
english: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

kikuyu: “Ndalo mar ngimana dhiyo mapiyo moloyo masind jachwe usi, kendo orumo piyo maonge geno.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni ungʼado rieko kuom gik mudwaro timo to ibiro thirgi; bende kata dabed ni uchano gima udwaro timo to ok notimre, nikech Nyasaye nikodwa.
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

kikuyu: Ji alufu angʼwen, to noket jorit rangeye, kendo ji alufu angʼwen mamoko, to noket jopak Jehova Nyasaye gi thumbe ma asechiwo nikech tijni.”
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

kikuyu: Bende negiloso tonde piero abich e riak pasia achiel kendo tonde piero abich mamoko e riak pasia komachielo ka tonde moliergo pasiago omanyore.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

kikuyu: Yawuotgi ariyo ma gin Ahimaz wuod Zadok gi Jonathan wuod Abiathar bende ni kanyo kodgi. Orgi ira gi gimoro amora miwinjo.”
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

kikuyu: Petro nodwoke niya, “Wan waseweyo gik moko duto mondo waluwi! Kara en angʼo mwabiro yudo?”
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel, ma gin jodolo, jo-Lawi kod joma moko mane oa e twech notimo nyasi mar gwedho od Nyasaye gi ilo.
english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

kikuyu: Kane joote otundo Gibea dalagi Saulo mi ginyiso ji wechego, giduto ne giywak matek.
english: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

kikuyu: Joma jo-adiera ema abiro keto wengena kuomgi; gin ema abiro yie dak kodgi; ngʼat ma wuodhe oriere tir ema biro tiyona.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

kikuyu: Eka Jethro, jaduongʼ Musa, nokelo misango miwangʼo pep kod misengni mamoko bende ne Nyasaye, kendo Harun nobiro kod jodongo duto mag jo-Israel mondo gichiem gi jaduongʼ Musa e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

kikuyu: Nowachone Eli niya, “Aringo ka awuok kar lweny mana kawuononi.” Eli nopenjo niya, “Angʼo motimore wuoda?”
english: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”

kikuyu: Neuru koro Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, biro tieko mich kod kony mikelo ne Jerusalem kod Juda. Notiek kit chiemo duto kod pi
english: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

kikuyu: giniwer e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nimar obiro, adier obiro mondo ongʼad ne piny bura. Obiro ngʼado ne piny bura e yo makare, ee, obiro yalo ji gi adierane.
english: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

kikuyu: Ket Sandug Muma e iye kendo igengʼe gi pasia.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

kikuyu: Asingorane ni en kod nyikwaye ginibed jodolo maga nyaka chiengʼ, nikech ne en jasinani kuom miyo Nyasache duongʼ kendo negichiwo misango mar pwodho jo-Israel e richo.”
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: mana kaka Wuod Dhano ne ok obiro mondo ji otine, to nobiro mondo otine ji, kendo mondo ochiw ngimane obed gima iwarogo ji mangʼeny.”
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: To ne awacho ni, “Asetiyo matek kayiem nono; aseketho tekra kayiem nono. Kata kamano pokna ni e lwet Jehova Nyasaye kendo michna Nyasacha ema nigo.”
english: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”

kikuyu: Magi duto nokendo nyi joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo moko kuomgi nonywolo nyithindo gi mon-gi.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

kikuyu: Gode leny nono ka odok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, gileny nono e nyim Ruoth piny duto.
english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasaye noketo gima pogo pi mamalo gi pi ma piny. Kendo nobedo kamano.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

kikuyu: To kik uneg-gi, yaye Ruoth ma okumbana nikech joga dipoka wigi owil. Mi giba abaya koni gi koni gi tekoni, kendo mi gidog piny.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Wabiro duogonugi kendo ok wabi chunou mondo umedwa gimoro amora kuomgi. Wabiro timo kaka uwachono.” Bangʼe ne aluongo jodolo mi giketo joka ruoth kod jotelo okwongʼore ni gibiro timo kaka gisesingore.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

kikuyu: chutho richo ne ni e piny kane pok Chik obetie. To richo ok kwan kaka richo ka Chik onge.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

kikuyu: Loch Jeroboam ne ok ochako obedo motegno e kinde Abija. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nogoye motho.
english: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died.

kikuyu: Bende ne ochoko jodongo duto mag jo-Israel kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

kikuyu: Timotheo wuoda, amiyi Chikni kaluwore gi weche mane okor kuomi chon. Ti kod chikni mondo iked lweny maber,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

kikuyu: Kama ochiel motegno nojwangʼ, dala maduongʼ nodongʼ gunda; kama ochiel motegno mag siro lweny kod kar ngʼicho nodongʼ kama punda bukore, kod kar kwadh jamni,
english: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,

kikuyu: kata obedo ni Yesu owuon ne ok batiso ji, to jopuonjrene ema ne timo kamano.
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

kikuyu: Kane onenogi anena nii to nogombogi matek mooro joote irgi nyaka Kaldea.
english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Farao nopenjo jodonge niya, “Bende wanyalo yudo ngʼato moro machal gi ngʼatni, ma Roho mar Nyasaye ni kuome?”
english: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

kikuyu: Kik utim winjruok kodgi kata kod nyisechegi.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

kikuyu: En ngʼa machalo gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, Jal mobet e kom loch kuma bor,
english: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

kikuyu: to abiro oro koth e pinyu e ndalo mowinjore e ndalo oro kod ndalo chwiri, mondo uyud cham, gi mzabibu kod mo.
english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

kikuyu: Changuru joma tuo, chieruru joma otho, pwodhuru joma nigi dhoho, riemburu jochiende. Kaka useyudo wachni nono, un bende chiwuru nono.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

kikuyu: Pek mar stadi mag dhahabu mane okwayo ne oromo shekel alufu achiel gi mia abiriyo, ka ok okwano bangli, odeyo kod nengni maralik mirwako gi ruodhi mag Midian kata nyoroche mane ni e ngʼut ngamia margi.
english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

kikuyu: Jowetena, daher mondo ungʼe adiera kuom mich mag Roho mondo kik ubed maonge ngʼeyo.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

kikuyu: Nikech nongʼeyo ngʼat mane biro ndhoge, mano emomiyo nowachonegi ni ok giler giduto.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

kikuyu: Kuyo ma ngʼato bedogo e yo ma Nyasaye dwaro kelone lokruok mar weyo richo kod warruok maonge ywago angʼe, to kuyo mar piny kelone mana tho.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

kikuyu: Nimar ne ok onega e ich, ka ii minwa bedo kaka bur miika, noyawre nyaka chiengʼ.
english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nowachone Jehoshafat niya, “Abiro rwako lewni moko ka wadhi e lweny mondo kik gifwenya, in to rwak arwaka lepi mag ruoth.” Omiyo ruodh Israel norwako lewni ma ok nyal fwenyego kendo nodhi e lweny.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

kikuyu: “Kendo anami joka Daudi kod joma odak Jerusalem chuny mar ngʼwono gi kwayo. Giniket geno margi kuoma, an mane gichwowo, kendo giniywage mana kaka ngʼato ywago wuode ma miderma.
english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

kikuyu: to jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen-go ne podho e nyim ngʼat mobet e kom duongʼ ka gilamo Jal Mantie nyaka chiengʼ. Negibolo osimbegi e nyim kom duongʼ kagiwacho niya:
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

kikuyu: Dala ka dala ne wanegoe ji duto modakie, kaka chwo, mon kod nyithindo mana kaka ne watimo ne Sihon ruodh Heshbon.
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

kikuyu: “Ruodhno notim gimoro amora mohero. Enodhialre kendo enotingʼre malo moyombo nyasaye moro amora, kendo enowach gik mapok owinji kuom Nyasaye mar nyiseche. Enobed gi loch nyaka kinde mar mirima mager rum, nikech gik mosechan nyaka timre.
english: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.

kikuyu: mi ochako goyo jotich wetene, kendo owere ne chiemo gi metho kaachiel gi jomer,
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ogendini penjo niya, “Nyasachgino ere?”
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

kikuyu: To Yesu ne ok odwoke kata wach achiel. Omiyo jopuonjre nobiro ire mojiwe niya, “Riembe odhi, nikech osiko kogoyo koko bangʼwa.”
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

kikuyu: “Bath lop jodologo ema nongʼadne jo-Lawi kaka pok margi; ma borne norom kilomita apar gariyo, to lachne nobed kilomita abich; lopno borne duto nobed kilomita apar gariyo gi nus, to lachne nobed kilomita abich.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

kikuyu: “Gikanyono bangʼ chandruok maduongʼ mag ndalono, “ ‘wangʼ chiengʼ noimre, kendo dwe ok norieny; sulwe nolwar koa e polo, kendo chwech mag polo noyiengni.’
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

kikuyu: Ji duto nodhi e hekalu mar Baal kendo negimuke. Negitoyo matindo tindo kende mag misango kaachiel gi nyisechene manono kendo neginego Matan jadolo mar Baal e nyim kendegi mag misango.
english: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

kikuyu: kuom mano jo-Misri nobembo jo-Israel gi tich mapek mar wasumbini.
english: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,

kikuyu: Kuom mano Hamor gi wuode Shekem nodhi e dhoranga dalagi mondo giwuo gi jothurgi.
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

kikuyu: E kindeno Daudi nopondo e rogo kendo jo-Filistia to nochokore Bethlehem.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

kikuyu: To dhano donge lich moloyo rombo nyadi mangʼeny! Kuom mano, chik oyie mondo otim maber chiengʼ Sabato.”
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, mirima nomako Jehova Nyasaye gi jo-Israel kendo nowacho niya, “Nikech ogandani osejwangʼo singruok mane aketo gi kweregi kendo ok gisewinja,
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

kikuyu: En kony mane ma dhano yudo kuom Nyasaye man malo, girkeni mane ma Jehova Nyasaye Maratego man malo miye?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

kikuyu: Pakeuru nikech tijene mosetimo kuom tekone maduongʼ; kendo nikech duongʼne moyombo duto.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

kikuyu: Nikech oseresowa waa e loch mar mudho mi okelowa e pinyruoth mar Wuode mohero,
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

kikuyu: Koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Bende wanyalo wacho ni joma ok jo-Yahudi mane ok otemo matek mondo oyud ngima ema koro oseyudo ngima makare nogo miyudo kuom yie;
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

kikuyu: To ne ok aneno hekalu ei dalano, nikech Ruoth Nyasaye Maratego kod Nyarombo ema obedo hekalu mare.
english: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

kikuyu: to kar timo mano to ne wadoko mamuol e dieru mana kaka min nyithindo rito nyithinde ma pod tindo.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

kikuyu: Isaka nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo ubiro ira to ne ok udwara mi uriemba?”
english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

kikuyu: To un bende un e kanyakla achiel gi jogo moseluongi mondo ubed jo-Yesu Kristo.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: kendo ka ngʼato dwaro yalo kodi mondo okaw lawi mar akor to wene kotini bende.
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

kikuyu: nyikwa Zakai, ji mia abiriyo gi piero auchiel (760),
english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

kikuyu: Ne akele ne jopuonjreni mondo gichange, to ne otamogi.”
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

kikuyu: To ngʼeuru ni chuny manie i dhano, ma en much Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ema miyo dhano winjo tiend weche.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

kikuyu: kod jotich kaachiel kodgi, mane jotend dhoutgi. Giduto ne gin ji mia ariyo gi piero angʼwen gariyo (242). Joma moko ne gin, Amashsai wuod Azarel, wuod Azai, wuod Meshilemoth, wuod Imer,
english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Ngʼad yiende kendo iger pidhe mondo wamonj Jerusalem. Dala maduongʼni nyaka kum; nikech opongʼ gi joma hinyo jowadgi.
english: For the LORD of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.

kikuyu: Eliazar nonywolo Finehas, to Finehas nonywolo Abishua,
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

kikuyu: kendo nikech akawo bucheni duto ni nikare, omiyo achayo yo moro amora marach.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia noweyo nyisechegi kanyo kendo Daudi nochiwo chik mondo wangʼ-gi gi mach.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka ndalo mane onego wabedgo kodgi norumo, ne wawuok kendo wadhi nyime gi wuodhwa. Jopuonjre duto, kaachiel gi mondegi kod nyithindgi, ne okowowa nyaka oko mar dalano, kendo kane wachopo e dho nam, to ne wagoyo chongwa piny mi walemo.
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nowacho niya, “Kelna Agag ruodh jo-Amalek.” Omiyo Agag nobiro ire ka en gi chir koparo e chunye niya, “Lit mar tho osekadho.”
english: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

kikuyu: Eka naluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye, ne aywakne niya, “Resa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye!”
english: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

kikuyu: To bende enobed odiechieng turumbete kod sigich mar lweny nowinjre e mier madongo mochiel motegno, kod ute mabeyo mag rito dala.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

kikuyu: Githiedho adhonde mag joga mana ka gima ok en gima lich. Giwacho niya, ‘Kwe, kwe,’ kata mana ka kwe onge.
english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.

kikuyu: Kane jodong Ruoth Hezekia nobiro ir Isaya,
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

kikuyu: Gibiro ka gin gi geno mar yudo pi, to ka gichopo kanyo to giyudo ni pi ma gineno onge, mi chunygi nyosre.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

kikuyu: Kane Farao owinjo wachno notemo mondo oneg Musa, kata kamano Musa noringo modhi odak e piny Midian, mi obet e bath soko moro.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

kikuyu: Pinyruodhi en pinyruoth mochwere, kendo lochni osiko nyaka tienge duto. Jehova Nyasaye chopo singruok mage duto kendo ohero ji duto mosechweyo.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

kikuyu: To nam ne medo mana gingore, omiyo negipenje niya, “Watimni angʼo mondo nam okwenwa?”
english: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.

kikuyu: Ka gichako loth, unyalo neno uwegi kendo ungʼeyo ni ndalo oro chiegni.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

kikuyu: E dwe achiel nariembo jokwath adekgo. Ne gijoga kendo ne asin kodgi
english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye makare, to kata kamano ne angʼanyo ne chikene. Winjuru, un ji duto; kendo neeuru kaka achandora. Yawuota gi nyiga osemaki moter e twech.
english: “The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.

kikuyu: Eka Amnon nosin mojok kode ahinya. Chutho, nosin mojok kode moloyo kaka ne ohere. Amnon nowachone niya, “Chungi kendo wuog idhi!”
english: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

kikuyu: mi ji madirom piero adek gauchiel nonegi. Ne giriembo jo-Israel koa e dhoranga dala maduongʼ nyaka kama nitiere kite mopa kendo neginegogi e holo. Mano nomiyo kihondko nogoyogi ma gipodho.
english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

kikuyu: Anaelu duge mi aum wengeu mondo omi wichkuot mau onere,
english: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nochako wuoyo kodgi gi ngeche mopogore opogore kama: “Ngʼat moro ne opidho mzabibu e puothe. Nochiele gi ohinga, mi okunyo bugo mibiyoe olemo mochiek, kendo ogero ne osuch ngʼicho. Eka ne oketo puothe mar mzabibuno e lwet jopur moko bangʼe nowuok odhi e wuoth moro mabor.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

kikuyu: E sa ma ne ichakoe lemo, ema nodwoki, omiyo asebiro mondo anyisigo, nikech in ngʼat moher ahinya. Kuom mano, koro chik iti mondo iwinj tiend fwenyno:
english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.

kikuyu: Emomiyo koro kik uyie mondo richo obed gi loch e ringreu matho ka uchopo gombone maricho.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

kikuyu: Gigi duto, yaye ruoth, Arauna ema osechiwo ne ruoth.” Arauna nomedo wachone niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi yie kodi.”
english: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”

kikuyu: Asegolo chik ne pinje duto manie bwo lochna ni mondo ji duto oluor Nyasach Daniel kendo omiye duongʼ.
english: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end.

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ moro amora iyiero e kind oganda kendo iwale mondo obedo jachungʼ mar oganda kuom weche ma wuoyo kuom Nyasaye, mondo ochiw mich gi misengini migologo richo.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

kikuyu: Kane gisebet kodgi kuom ndalo moromo, owete nokowogi mondo gidhi gi kwe, kendo gidogi ir joma noorogi. [
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

kikuyu: Nyasaye mondo omed Jafeth; Jafeth mondo odag e hembe mag Shem, kendo Kanaan obed misumbane.”
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

kikuyu: Nogoyo koko gi dwol maduongʼ mogik niya, “Yesu Wuod Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, angʼo milaro koda? Kuongʼri ne Nyasaye ni ok ibi sanda!”
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

kikuyu: To donge usepenjoe joma osedak amingʼa? Pod ok uyudo konyruok kuom weche ma gisebedo ka ginyisou,
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

kikuyu: Wasumbini, winjuru ruodhiu mondikou e piny-ka kumiyogi duongʼ gi luor, kendo kutiyo gi chuny ma thuolo, mana ka gima uwinjo Kristo.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

kikuyu: Adier, isemiye gweth mochwere kendo isemiyo obedo mamor gi mor moa kuomi.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

kikuyu: Kane gibiro ir Yesu negisaye chutho niya, “Ngʼatni owinjore mondo itimne maber,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

kikuyu: To jotich matiyone ruoth nowachone niya, “Owinjore mondo odwar ne ruoth nyiri man-gi chia mapok ongʼeyo chwo.
english: Then the king’s servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.

kikuyu: To kuom chier mar joma otho, donge usesomo e kitap Musa kama ondikie wach bungu maliel, kaka Nyasaye nowachone niya, ‘An Nyasach Ibrahim, Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo?’
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

kikuyu: Kane achungʼ e nyim bura, onge ngʼama nodok jakora, to ji duto noweya. Mad Nyasaye kik ket richoni e wigi!
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

kikuyu: Mogik, kik ngʼato angʼata koro kelna chandruok, nimar ringra opongʼ gi mbelni ma aseyudo kaka jaote Yesu.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kikuyu: “Ok anadonji e oda, kata dhi e kitandana,
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

kikuyu: Bende ji duto gin joote? Bende ji duto gin jonabi? Bende ji duto gin jopuonj? Bende ji duto timo honni?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

kikuyu: Nikech oganda maduongʼ mane olwore, nonyiso jopuonjrene mondo oikne yie moro matin mondo kik ji thungʼe.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

kikuyu: Wadwokone Nyasaye erokamano kinde duto nikech un duto, kwaluongo nyingu e lemo magwa.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

kikuyu: Yud yweyo, yaye chunya, kuom Nyasaye kende; genona aa mana kuome.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kikuyu: Ka ji nosomo baruwano negidoko mamor nikech weche mane ni e iye nojiwogi maber.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

kikuyu: kendo kuom ringruok achielni oriwgo ogendini ariyogi gi Nyasaye kuom msalaba mane oketho sigu mane ni e kindgi.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

kikuyu: Kendo une ni uwacho ni, ‘Jatichni Jakobo biro bangʼwa.’ ” Nikech noparo niya, “Obiro hoye gi mich ma ooroneni kendo ka oneno to ponono obiro rwaka.”
english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

kikuyu: Aseloso kar Sandug Muma, moketie singruok mane Jehova Nyasaye otimo kod kwerewa kane ogologi Misri.”
english: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye en Ruodh piny duto, werneuru zaburi mar pak.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

kikuyu: to roho moro amora makwedo Yesu ok en Roho mar Nyasaye. Chuny ma kamano en mar Jasik Kristo ma usewinjo ni onego bi kendo makoro ni e piny kata sani.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

kikuyu: Ber bedo ngʼama tin modhier mariek moloyo ruoth moti mofuwo ma ok ongʼeyo kaka ikawo siem.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nochako wuoth gi Joshua jakonyne, kendo Musa nodhi malo e got mar Nyasaye.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kode; notimone kech kendo nomiyo oyudo ngʼwono e nyim jorit joma ne otwe.
english: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-go nomedne mi nobed gi gik mogundho; to ngʼat ma ongego kata mano ma en-go nomaye.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai nochako ngʼur kagiwachone Yesu niya, “Neye, angʼo momiyo jopuonjreni timo gima chik ok oyiego chiengʼ Sabato?”
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato osero nyako mapok osingi ne kend kendo oriwore kode nyaka ochul gir keny kendo nyakono nobed chiege.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek jotelo nowuotho e kuonde kambi duto,
english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

kikuyu: Sunga nywolo mana dhawo, to rieko iyudo kuom jogo moyie puonj.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

kikuyu: Wachneuru ni, ‘Idag amingʼa! Ngimani bende obed maonge tuoche in kaachiel gi odi! Kendo gigi duto obed gi ngima maber!
english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

kikuyu: Rael nowacho ni wuon-gi niya, “Yaye ruodha, kik mirima maki koda ni atamora chungʼ e nyimi nikech an e kindena mag neno malo.” Kuom mano Laban nomanyo nyisechenego to ne ok oyudo.
english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nokel rumbi mar iro ne ji godiechiengʼ kendo ligek mach mangʼangʼni gotieno e Got Sayun. Duongʼni nobed ka yath maduongʼ makelo tipo.
english: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.

kikuyu: To noluongo nyathi moro matin mi okete ochungʼ e diergi.
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

kikuyu: Oyaro polo man yo nyandwat mi oumgo kama ninono; kendo oliero piny ewi gima onge.
