english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

kikuyu: “Eka nowachone jotije ni, ‘Nyasi mar arus koro oikore, to joma naluongo ne ok owinjore gi luong mane aluongogigo.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono noweyo dapige kanyo, kendo nowuok odok dala mi owachone ji niya,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

kikuyu: “Ongʼere ni ngʼama osehinyore ok nyal monj kendo, to oywak mana ni mondo okonye e chandruokne.
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

kikuyu: Bangʼ tweyo chiemo kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ kod otieno, kech nochako kaye.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

kikuyu: Gin ema noketgi yawuot Nyasaye; gin ema nomigi duongʼ mar Nyasaye gi muma, gi chik, gi lemo, kod singruok.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka usetho to unuwegi ni yawuotu kaka girkeni kendo ginibed wasumbini mag-gi nyaka chiengʼ, makmana ni jo-Israel weteu to kik usandi.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

kikuyu: Weche mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Hezekia kod timbene mabeyo ondiki e fweny mar janabi Isaya wuod Amoz e kitap ruodhi mag Juda kod Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek kawo dala ngʼat maratego kendo omuko dhorangeye matek magiketoe genogi.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo niya, “Bende nitie ngʼato angʼata modongʼ e dhood Saulo manyalo timo ne tim ngʼwono nikech Jonathan?”
english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nogwedhogi mi owachonegi niya, “Nywolreuru kendo kwanu omedre; pongʼuru piny kendo urite. Beduru gi teko ewi rech ma e nam kod winy mae kor polo kendo ewi gik mangima duto mawuotho ewi lowo.”
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

kikuyu: To udi moger e mier ma ok ochiel gi ohinga nokwan mana kaka ikwano lowo. Ginto gin gik minyalo waro, maka ochopo higa mar piero abich to nyaka dwokgi e lwet wegi.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne odhi kar dino cham, kendo notimo gik moko duto mane wuon odgi onyise mondo otim.
english: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.

kikuyu: Ma e neno mane Johana otimo ka jo-Yahudi modak Jerusalem nooro jodolo gi jo-Lawi mondo openje ni ne en ngʼa.
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

kikuyu: Dendgi nochako tetni kanyo kendo negibedo gi rem machalo gi muoch ma kayo dhako.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe Jakobo nooro joote ir Sihon ruodh jo-Amor mane ruoth Heshbon, kendo mi nowachone ni, ‘Yie iwewa wakalie pinyu wadhi e karwa owuon.’
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai moko moyie kuom Kristo nochungʼ mowacho niya, “Joma ok jo-Yahudi nyaka ter nyangu kendo nyaka gilu chike Musa.”
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo koro watimuru sawo, ok gi thowi machon mar himruok kod timbe maricho, to watime gi makati ma ok oketie thowi, ma en makati mar wuotho e ler kod adiera.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Naftali, kaw Ahira wuod Enan.”
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

kikuyu: mi adok Jerusalem. To ma ne omiyo afwenyo gima rach mane Eliashib nosetimo kuom miyo Tobia kar dak e od Nyasaye.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

kikuyu: Gibiro bedo mier mag tony kua e nyim ngʼama dwaro chulo kuor, mondo omi ngʼat miparo kuome ni oneko kik negi kapok oyale e nyim oganda.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

kikuyu: Maluk, Harim kod Baana.
english: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo mondo inyis jatichna Daudi niya, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: In ok nigerna ot mondo adagie.
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel Yesu nowuok modhi e bath got moro mondo olem kendo nobedo otieno duto kolamo Nyasaye.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

kikuyu: mondo chunya owerni kendo kik olingʼ. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, abiro goyoni erokamano nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

kikuyu: To Ishmael wuod Nethania kod joge aboro notony oa ir Johanan mi giringo gidhi ir jo-Amon.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi ruoth Hezekia nochoko jodongo mag dala maduongʼ kaachiel kendo negidhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: “Nodwoke ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma asebedo ka awuotho e nyime biro ori gi malaikane kendo obiro gwedho wuodhi, mondo mi iyudne wuoda nyako moa kuom anywolana kendo e od wuora.
english: He said to me, ‘The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

kikuyu: Kane osewacho ma, nonyisogi lwetene gi tiendene,
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

kikuyu: “Ne atieko jomoko kuomu mana kaka ne atieko Sodom gi Gomora, kendo ne uchalo mana gi yien moyudh kawangʼ e mach, to kata kuom mago duto pod ne utamoru duoga ira,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Nyithinde chungo kendo luonge ni en ngʼat mogwedhi, chwore bende pake, kawacho niya,
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka jo-Midian noloo gi jo-Israel kendo ne ok gichako gitugo lweny moro kendo. E kinde ma Gideon ne pod ngima, pinyno nobedo gi kwe kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

kikuyu: To wawuoyo kaka joma Nyasaye owuon ema opwodho kendo oyiego kaka jorit Injili. Ok watem mondo wabed malongʼo ne dhano, to wadwaro ni wabed malongʼo mana ne Nyasaye ma nono chunjewa.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

kikuyu: “Penj ji duto manie piny, kaachiel gi jodolo ni, ‘Kane utweyo chiemo kendo uywak e dwe mar abich gi mar abiriyo kuom higni piero abiriyo mokalogo duto, bende an ema ne utweyona chiemo adier?
english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

kikuyu: Chik Jehova Nyasaye longʼo chuth, odwogo chuny. Buche mag Jehova Nyasaye gin adiera, gimiyo joma riekogi tin bedo mariek.
english: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

kikuyu: Ka dine arie bada mi agoyi gi tuo moro kaachiel gi jogi, to dikoro asetieki e wangʼ piny.
english: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “Nyasaye mondo okweda, ka ok itho in Jonathan.”
english: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”

kikuyu: Biuru, kendo wadhi mondo wapog dhogi mondo kik giwinjre dhok ngʼato gi ngʼato.”
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ka atiyo matek kuom tekone matiyo kuoma.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Dan, kaw Ahiezer wuod Amishadai;
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maber golo gik mabeyo mawuok kuom ber mokano e chunye, to ngʼat marach golo gik maricho mawuok kuom rach mokano e chunye. Nimar gik mopongʼo chuny ngʼato ema wuok e dho ngʼato.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

kikuyu: To iniwachi niya, “Mano kaka nasin gi puonj mar rieko! Mano kaka chunya nokwedo siem mane omiya kuom gik mane atimo ma ok nikare!
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

kikuyu: Kik ipandna wangʼi sa ma chunya lit. Chikna iti; ka aluongi to dwoka mapiyo.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Abiro miyo duongʼna duto kadho e nyimi kendo abiro hulo nyinga ma en Jehova Nyasaye e nyimi. Anakech ngʼama adwaro kecho kendo anangʼwon-ne ngʼama adwaro ngʼwonone.”
english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

kikuyu: Noluwo timbe mag od Ahab kendo notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka od Ahab nosetimo, nimar ne gin wede e kendgi gi jood Ahab.
english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

kikuyu: Fuonde matindo wamiyo rit mamalo moloyo, kendo fuonde ma wakawo ni richo warwako maber moloyo.
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

kikuyu: Duongʼ olworo ruoth madhako koni gi koni e kar dakne; law abola mare oton-oton gi dhahabu.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kikuyu: Joma odhier ubiro bedogo kinde duto, kendo unyalo konyogi sa asaya muhero. To an ok ubi siko ka un koda ndalo duto.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

kikuyu: Kane bor polo osiko koumo kar lemo kuom thuolo malach, jo-Israel norito buche Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok giwuok.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.

kikuyu: Aa malo mondo irieny nikech lerni osechopo, kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye oserieny kuomi.
english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!

kikuyu: Nyasaye owuon, ma Wuon kwe mondo opwodhu mi udok maler chuth e yore duto. Mad orit ngimau gi chunyu gi ringreu duto mi ubed maonge ketho moro amora chiengʼ ma Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo noduogie.
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: kendo Josia ne en wuon Jekonia gi owetene, e kinde mag twech e piny Babulon.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

kikuyu: Yangʼ imno kendo ikaw rembe moko mi imien e it Harun ma korachwich kod it yawuote ma korachwich kod lith lwetgi mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiendegi ma korachwich, to remo modongʼ to ikir e bath kendo mar misango moluoro.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: To iwachne niya, “Ne wan wasumb Farao e piny Misri, to Jehova Nyasaye ne ogolowa Misri gi teko maduongʼ.
english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

kikuyu: Omiyo nodwokone min mare fedha, kendo min-gi nokawo fedha ma pekne romo kilo ariyo gi nus mi ochiwogi ne jatheth, mane olosogi e kido mar nyasaye milamo. Kendo noketgi e od Mika.
english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

kikuyu: Abiro timoni misango mar erokamano kendo abiro luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Mar Jeduthun. Zaburi mar Daudi. Chunya yudo yweyo kuom Nyasaye kende; warruok aa kuome.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka ikwana kaka ngʼama ni kodi e achiel kuom yie to rwake mana kaka dirwaka.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

kikuyu: To ka mano marumo nobiro gi duongʼ kamano to kara koro mano masiko nyaka bed gi duongʼ mangʼongo moloyo!
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

kikuyu: To kuom Wuowi to owuoye niya, “Lochni nosik nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Nyasaye, kendo tim makare ema nobed kaka ludh loch e pinyruodhi.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

kikuyu: Nodhi moromo kod Asa mowachone niya, “Chikuru itu mondo uwinja, in Asa gi jo-Juda duto kod jo-Benjamin. Jehova Nyasaye nikodu ka un bende un kode, kudware to ununwangʼe, to kujwangʼe to en bende nojwangʼu.
english: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

kikuyu: En owuon ema noyaro polo kendo en ema nonyono apaka madongo mag nam.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

kikuyu: Dishon, Ezer, kod Dishan. Yawuot Seir gi, mane odak Edom ema ne jodong jo-Hori.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka ne olo jo-Israel chiengʼno, jo-Juda nolocho nikech negigeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Bende negitelone chwo duto, mon kod nyithindo gi nyi ruoth mane Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny noseweyo gi Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, kod Jeremia janabi kod Baruk wuod Neria.
english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

kikuyu: Emomiyo nyonuru piny motegno, kutweyo nungou gi kamba mar adiera, kendo kurwako tim makare ka gige lweny mag akor,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

kikuyu: Noketo chunye kuom Nyasaye e ndalo mag Zekaria, ngʼat ma nopuonje luoro Nyasaye. E ndalo duto mane odwaro Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasaye nomiye gweth.
english: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.

kikuyu: Kodhi moko nolwar e kind kudho, to ka kudhogo nodongo, ne githungʼo chamgo mi gimonogi nyak.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

kikuyu: Luoro mar Jehova Nyasaye nomako pinyruodhi mag pinje molworo Juda, omiyo ne ok gitugo lweny kod Jehoshafat.
english: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

kikuyu: Koro luong jonabi duto mag Baal, jodonge duto kod jodolone duto. Kik yudi ni ngʼato kuomgi onge nikech adhi timo nyasi mar misango maduongʼ ne Baal. Ngʼato angʼata ma ok ochopo e nyasino to ok nobed mangima.” To Jehu ne wuondore nimar ne odwaro kaka doneg jodong Baal duto.
english: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

kikuyu: Jeftha notelo ne jo-Israel kuom higni auchiel. Bangʼe Jeftha ma ja-Gilead notho, mi noyike e dalane man Gilead.
english: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato okawore moketore e duongʼ ma oongego, to ngʼatno wuondore owuon.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Kuomi ema aseponde, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik iwe ayud wichkuot; gola e chandruok nikech timni makare.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

kikuyu: to kara chiega otine dichwo machielo, kendo chwo mamoko oterre kode.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

kikuyu: E piny duto Injilini koro nyago olemo kendo landore, mana kaka osetimo e dieru nyaka chakre odiechiengʼ ma nuwinjoe kendo ungʼeyo ngʼwono mar Nyasaye e adierane duto.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

kikuyu: Negichiemo giduto mi giyiengʼ. Bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo moromo okepe abiriyo.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Tiengʼ ma timbene richo kendo mamono manyo ranyisi mar hono, to ok bi miye moro amora makmana ranyisi mar Jona.” Eka Yesu nowuok odhi oweyogi.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

kikuyu: To ne ok giyudo ketho moro amora kuome, kata obedo ni jonend miriambo mangʼeny nobiro nyime. Achien mogik, ariyo nobiro nyime,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

kikuyu: To nyaka une ni giloso matafare ma kwan-gi romre gi mano ma gisebedo ka giloso, kik uwe kwan-go dog chien. Gin jonyawo, emomiyo gigoyo koko ni, ‘Yie iwewa wadhi kendo wachiw misango ni Nyasachwa.’
english: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom dweche abiriyo, oganda mar Israel nobed modich ka ikogi mondo eka gipwodh piny.
english: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

kikuyu: Jonathan nodwoke niya, “Onge. Ok ibi tho! Winji, wuonwa ok tim gimoro amora, bedni oduongʼ kata otin, ma ok onyisa. Angʼo madimi opandna wachni? Ok en kamano!”
english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar mar mogo mayom moru gi mo; im to chiw gi kilo abiriyo;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

kikuyu: Kamano olele bende inyalo mako gi lwedo, to iyude kodak e ute ruoth.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

kikuyu: Omiyo kane Joab olworo dala maduongʼno mondo gimaki, noketo Uria kama ongʼeyo ni wasigu mager kendo tek nitie.
english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

kikuyu: Jahath ema ne kayo, Ziza ne luwe, to Jeush kod Beria nokwan kaka dhoot achiel moriwgi e tich achiel nikech yawuotgi ne nok.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

kikuyu: To abiro rito oda mondo kik wasigu mabayo monje, Jasand ji ok nochak obed gi loch ewi joga kendo, nikech koro an e jaritgi.
english: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

kikuyu: Goliath nochungʼ mokok ne jolweny mag Israel niya, “Angʼo momiyo ubiro kendo uriedo ne lweny? Donge an ja-Filistia, to un, donge un jotich Saulo? Yieruru ngʼato mondo olor obi kama antieni.
english: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mowinjore odonji e laru maiye mar kama ler mar lemo mondo oti tij dolo e kama ler mar lemo, to nyaka ochiw misango mar golo richo ni en owuon, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo kodu wangʼ gi wangʼ gi ei mach ewi godno.
english: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: Nowuoyo kode modembore kendo nomiye kom duongʼ moloyo ruodhi mamoko mane ni kode e twech Babulon.
english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

kikuyu: Pinje mokwongo mag pinyruodhe ne gin Babulon, Erek, Akad kod Kalne e piny Shinar.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

kikuyu: Nimar e ndalo mane pok pi opongʼo piny, ji ne chiemo kendo metho, bende negi kendo kendo ikendogi, nyaka nochopo odiechiengʼ mane Nowa odonjo e yie,
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

kikuyu: Ndalogi onego par kendo riti e tienge duto mag dhoudi, e gwenge, kendo e mier madongo duto. Kendo ndalo Purim-gi mondo orit nyaka chiengʼ ma ok jo-Yahudi oweyo ma ok otimoe nyasi, bende wich kik wil kodgi e kind nyikwau.
english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho ni jatingʼne gige lweny niya, “Wuodh liganglani mondo inega, nono to joma ok oter nyangigi biro nega kendo yanya.” To jatingʼne gige lweny ne luoro omako kendo ne ok onyal timo kamano, omiyo Saulo nokawo liganglane owuon mochwoworego.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Winy manyaka ukwer kendo kik ucham e magi: Ongo, achuth gi olith
english: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

kikuyu: Adonija noloso gi Joab wuod Zeruya kod Abiathar jadolo mine gimiye lwedo.
english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

kikuyu: Chuny ma weche donjone yudo ngʼeyo; to it mariek dwaro mondo weche odonjne.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

kikuyu: Ginibuk wigi gi buru ka gigoyo nduru niya, “ ‘Mano kaka lit! Mano kaka lit, yaye dala maduongʼ, kama ji duto mane nigi yiedhi e nam, nobedo joma omewo nikech mwandune. Mano kaka osekethe kendo otieke chutho mana kuom sa achiel kende!’
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

kikuyu: Nochako kanyo ni Bethel to kinde mokwongo nying dalano niluongo ni Luz.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

kikuyu: Chul kuor ne jobutwa nyadibiriyo kigoyo bembegi. Kuom ayany ma gisediro kuomi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

kikuyu: tiende ni, nyikwagi mane odongʼ e piny ma jo-Israel ne ok otieko, Solomon nolokogi wasumbini michuno mondo oti githuon, kaka obet nyaka chil kawuono,
english: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Isaka ogwedho Jakobo gi Esau konyiso kaka ngimagi mabiro ne biro chalo.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ne oora mana ne rombe molal mag Israel kende.”
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Eka giduto negibiro kendo gisayo Daudi mondo ochamie gimoro kar odiechiengʼ, to Daudi nosekwongʼore kowacho niya, “Mad Nyasaye ngʼadna bura kata obedo ni en malit manade ka dipo ni abilo chiemo kata chamo chiemo moro amora ka chiengʼ pok opodho.”
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

kikuyu: To ondiek malichno gi tunge apargo mane ineno biro bedo mager kod dhakono ma jachode. Ginihinye kagitieke kendo weye duk; ginicham ringre, kendo giniwangʼe duto gi mach.
english: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

kikuyu: Ka gidhi gi kweth dhogi kaachiel gi chiachgi mondo gitim misengni ni Jehova Nyasaye, to ok giniyude nikech osewuok moa kuomgi.
english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

kikuyu: To ji duto nolingʼ thi maonge ngʼama dwoko nimar ruoth Hezekia nosegolo chik niya, “Kik udwoke.”
english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

kikuyu: To negidwoko wach ne malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane ochungʼ e dier yiend kuth ochwoga, kagiwacho niya, “Wasewuotho e piny koni gi koni mi wayudo ka piny ngima yweyo kendo nigi kwe.”
english: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

kikuyu: Wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye rito ngʼeyo; to orundo weche mag jogo ma ok jo-adiera.
english: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Jodolo nodonjo e kama ler mar lemo mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo gipwodhe kendo negikelo e laru gimoro amora mochido mane ginwangʼo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, eka jo-Lawi notingʼogi ka terogi oko nyaka e Holo mar Kidron.
english: The priests went into the inner part of the LORD’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the LORD’s temple into the court of the LORD’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: Kendo Ruth nyar Moab nowachone Naomi niya, “Yiena mondo adhi e puothe mondo ahul cham ma jokeyo oweyo, e puoth ngʼato angʼata manyalo timona ngʼwono.” Naomi nowachone niya, “Dhi adhiya, nyara.”
english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ma en Jal ma choko jo-Israel duto, mane oter e twech wacho niya, “Pod abiro choko jomoko makel irgi, kaweyo mago mosechoki.”
english: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”

kikuyu: “Gik moko angʼwen matindo ni e piny, to kata kamano giriek moloyo.
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

kikuyu: Roho mwaseyudo ok en roho mar piny, to en Roho moa kuom Nyasaye, mamiyo wangʼeyo mich ma Nyasaye osemiyowa.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

kikuyu: Kik koro ulu kit ngima pinyni, to lokreuru ka parou doko manyien pile, eka unubed gi nyalo mar pimo kendo ngʼeyo dwach Nyasaye, ma en dwache maber, mowinjore kendo malongʼo chuth.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

kikuyu: Kane gibiro ir Jakobo wuon-gi e piny Kanaan, neginyise duto mane osetimorenegi. Negiwacho niya,
english: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama nitiere e tiengʼ mobamni manone piny maberni mane asingora ni nami kweregi,
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

kikuyu: Kindeno noluongo ji apar gariyo ire, mi oorogi ji ariyo ariyo, kendo omiyogi teko kuom jochiende maricho.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

kikuyu: to lwetena pok otimo tim mahundu kata dichiel kendo alamo Nyasaye gi chuny maler.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

kikuyu: Agolni mag rangeye molworo laru maiye lachne ne en fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus, to tutne ne en fut abiriyo gi nus.
english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

kikuyu: utamo joma odhier e adieragi kendo umayo joga ma ochando gik ma onego giyudi, omiyo umayo mon ma chwogi otho kendo uyako gige nyithind kiye.
english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

kikuyu: to abiro kelo joma oa e pinje moko mondo omonji, gin pinje mager ahinya, kendo gibiro gi ligangla mi gitiekgo mwanduni duto ma iseyudo kuom riekoni kendo misungorigo.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.

kikuyu: Ne iuso jogi nono maonge ohala mane iyudo kuom usogi.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

kikuyu: Dhakoni nosechandore miwuoro e lwet jothieth mathoth kendo nosetieko mwandu duto mane en-go to ne ok oyudo resruok. Kar chango to tuone nosiko ka medore.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

kikuyu: Chwad jasunga mondo joma ngʼeyogi tin opuonjre; kwer ngʼat man-gi rieko, to obiro medo fwenyo tiend weche.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

kikuyu: Nongʼiyo malo e polo, kendo noomo chunye kowacho niya, “Efatha!” (tiende ni, “Yawri!”)
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

kikuyu: Ne onego ruodh Ai mi oliere gi tol e yath kama noriyoe nyaka odhiambo. Kane ochopo odhiambo, Joshua nogolo chik mondo ogol ringre oko e yath kendo lware piny e dhoranga dala maduongʼ. Nodhur kuome kite mangʼeny ma pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

kikuyu: Ludhego nyaka siki ei rategego mag sanduku; ok owinjore golgi.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

kikuyu: To alami, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, e kinde ma iikori mar konya; kuom herani maduongʼ, yaye Nyasaye, dwoka gi resruok mari mar adier.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

kikuyu: To nodwoko wuon mare ni, ‘Neye, hignigi duto asebedo katiyoni ka misumba kendo aserito chikeni. To eka pok imiyoa kata mana nyadiel mondo ayangʼ, abedgo mamor kod osiepena.
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

kikuyu: kendo gimako ruoth. Ne gitere Ribla ir ruodh Babulon, kendo kanyo ema nongʼadne buch twech.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nochok lwangʼni kawuok e aore mag Misri kendo notug kich koa e piny Asuria.
english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

kikuyu: Kobedo ni pod ok udwogo ira kata bangʼ timonu magi duto, kendo udhi mana nyime gi wich teko,
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: Amon ne ja-higni piero ariyo gariyo kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni ariyo.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Koro Sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi, miluongo ni Pasaka, ne chiegni,
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

kikuyu: Dho joma kare kelo rieko, to lep mar richo nongʼad oko.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo oganda Israel duto chwo gi mon, ngʼato ka ngʼato, makati gi olembe mongʼin. Kendo ji duto nodok miechgi.
english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

kikuyu: Kane giidho got matin-no ka gichomo dalano negiromo gi nyiri moko kadhi umbo pi kendo ne gipenjogi niya, “Bende ngʼat makoro nika?”
english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

kikuyu: Ka idonjo e puoth cham mar wadu, to inyalo jako wiye cham gi lweti, kendo kik ika cham mochungʼ.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

kikuyu: Yiend ngʼowu golo olembene mokwongo; thiepe mag mzabibu keyo tikgi mamit. Aa malo ibi, jaherana; bi mondo wadhiyo, yaye jaber.”
english: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

kikuyu: “Winjuru, yaye joga, mondo awuo kodu, yaye jo-Israel, chiknauru itu mondo atim neno ma akwedougo: An Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

kikuyu: Kane malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye ne ok ochako ofwenyore ne Manoa gi chiege, Manoa nofwenyo ni ne en malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But the LORD’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was the LORD’s angel.

kikuyu: Ka Abisalom ne pod ngima nokawo siro mochungo e Holo mar Ruoth kaka rapar mare owuon nimar noparo niya, “Aonge wuowi manyalo tingʼo wiya malo kata ma dichaka.” Nochako sirono nyinge owuon, mi oluonge ni Rapar mar Abisalom nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

kikuyu: Eka joma ne ongʼeye kane onene ka okoro gi jonabi, negipenjore kendgi niya, “Ma to en angʼo matimore ne wuod Kish? Saulo bende en achiel kuom jonabi?”
english: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

kikuyu: Chutho, moko odok chien mi koro giluwo Satan.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

kikuyu: nikech richo duto mane Baasha kod wuode Ela nosetimo kendo mane gimiyo Israel otimo, omiyo ne giwangʼo ii Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, ka gimiye mirima gi nyiseche manono.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Daudi nokwayogi gi chuny makare kendo notelonegi, gi lwedo mongʼith.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Jehu gi Jehonadab wuod Rekab nodhi ei hekalu mar Baal. Jehu nowachone jodong Baal duto niya, “Neuru ni onge jatich Jehova Nyasaye moro amora kodu ka makmana jodong Baal.”
english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, negiriembogi oko mar buch Sanhedrin, eka bangʼe ne gikuotho e kindgi giwegi niya,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye. En ema nochweyowa, kendo wan mage; wan joge, kendo wan rombene mokwayo.
english: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ji duto ok nyal rwako wachno, makmana joma osemi nyalo mar timo kamano.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

kikuyu: “Wuonu nomiyowa tingʼ mapek, to koro yie iket tingʼ mapekno kod tij achunano obednwa mayot, to wabiro tiyoni.”
english: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

kikuyu: Ka Modekai noseduogo e dhoranga ruoth. Haman to noreto kadok e ode, ka chunye opongʼ gi lit,
english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

kikuyu: Parie kaka isepuonjo ji mangʼeny, kendo isejiwo joma chunygi onyosore.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

kikuyu: To ka Sabato nochopo nochako puonjo ei sinagogi. Ji mangʼeny mane owinje nohum nono, ka gipenjore ni, “Ngʼatni ogolo gigi kure? Koso rieko manade mosemiyeni, momiyo otimo koda ka honni?
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

kikuyu: To ja-Samaria moro mane dhi wuoth nochopo kama ne ngʼatno nitie, kendo ka nonene, nokeche.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Winjuru! Anakel kuom Juda kod ji duto modak Jerusalem kit masira moro amora mahero. Ne awuoyo kodgi, to ne ok giwinja; ne aluongogi, to ne ok gidwoka.’ ”
english: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼat miluongo ni Yesu noloso chwodho moro bangʼe oketo chwodhono e wengena. Nonyisa ni adhi Siloam aluok wangʼa, kendo ne adhi mi aluoko wangʼa, bangʼe ne aneno.”
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

kikuyu: Kik ukel misengini maonge tich e nyima! Tik ubanino dungʼna marach, kendo sewni mutimo ka dwe opor, gi mag Sabato kata e chokruoge duto ok amorgo.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.

kikuyu: Ok aori ir joma wacho dhok mikia kata ma dhogi tek, to iori ir dhood Israel.
english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

kikuyu: To un, jowetena, ok un e mudho ma dimi odiechiengʼno pou mana kaka jakuo poyo ji.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

kikuyu: To bende ka ukawo nyigi moko mondo obed mond yawuotu mi nyigigo odwanyore kendgi gi nyisechegigo, to gibiro miyo yawuotu timo kamano.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

kikuyu: Kuom weche mamoko mag loch Rehoboam, kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitap rapar mag ruodhi mag Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma ngʼat mochido omulo nobed mochido, kendo ngʼato angʼata momule nobed mochido nyaka chop odhiambo.”
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

kikuyu: Gingʼeya mana kaka Wuora ongʼeya kendo angʼeyo Wuoro, kendo achiwo ngimana ne rombe.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nowacho niya, “Chokuru jo-Israel duto Mizpa, anto abiro lemo ka akwayonu Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD for you.”

kikuyu: Mathayo, Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Simon mane iluongo ni ja-Zilote,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni awacho kamano, to dine andhogo nyithindi.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

kikuyu: “Koro chunya chandore, to en angʼo ma dawachi? Dawach ni, ‘Wuora, resa e sa machalo kama?’ Ooyo, ok onyal timo kamano nikech ma e gima omiyo ne abiro e kindeni.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

kikuyu: To kane gisemoko mach e chuny laru kendo gisebedo piny kaachiel, Petro nobedo kodgi.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

kikuyu: Gisano sano jo-Benjamin nochoko joma nigi ligangla alufu piero ariyo gauchiel koa e miechgi, koriw gi joma oyier mia abiriyo modak Gibea.
english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

kikuyu: Miwa odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ chiembwa mapile pile.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko Gad niya, “An-gi chuny lit ahinya. Ber mondo alwar e lwet Jehova Nyasaye nikech ngʼwonone duongʼ, to kik iweya mondo alwar e lwet ji.”
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

kikuyu: nimar jogi ne osechwero remb jogi maler, gi jonabi mane onegi, to koro isemiyo gimadho remo mana kaka owinjore kodgi.”
english: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Hanun nomako joote Daudi molielogi, ma ongʼado lepgi koa e dier ngʼegi nyaka e nungogi kadhi piny, bangʼe to oriembogi.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

kikuyu: Nikech en dwaro Nyasaye mondo timbeu mabeyo okuod wi joma ofuwo mohero weche manono.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, awacho kama: Winjauru; an bende koro adwaro nyisou gima angʼeyo.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

kikuyu: Josia nokelo jodolo duto moa e miech Juda kendo noketho kuonde motingʼore gi malo mane jodologo wangʼoe ubani chakre Geba nyaka Bersheba. Ne omuko gik mochwe mag lemo e dhorangeye kaachiel gi mago mane ni e dhoranga Joshua, jatend dala maduongʼ, mane nitie e bat koracham kidonjo e dala.
english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

kikuyu: Eka Jonathan nowachone Daudi niya, “Kiny en Sawo mar dwe manyien kendo kiny nongʼere ni ionge nikech komi nobed nono.
english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

kikuyu: Ne ogero kende mag misengini e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho niya, “Ei Jerusalem ka ema naketie nyinga.”
english: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Beduru jokwath mag kweth Nyasaye moseketo e lwetu mondo uriti. Ritgiuru kaka jorit, ok nikech ngʼato ochunou, to nikech chunyu ohero, kaka Nyasaye dwaro ni utim. Kik ubed jokwath mondo uyudie ohala, to timuru kamano nikech uhero.
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

kikuyu: Masiche adekgo mag mach, yiro kod pilni mag mach mane wuok e dho faresego nonego achiel kuom adek mar kwan ji duto.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

kikuyu: Bende pe mag Lebanon rumo ngangʼ koa kuondege maridore motimo lwendni? Bende pige mangʼich mokwe mamol, koa kuonde maboyo dwono?
english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

kikuyu: It yien-no ne beyo, bende olembene ne ogundho, kendo gik moko duto ne yudo chiembgi kuome. Tipone ema ne le mag bungu duto oloso kuonde dak mag-gi, kendo winy mafuyo e kor polo nodak e bedene. Gik mangima duto ne yudo chiembgi kuome.
english: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

kikuyu: Ne oketo wer manyien e dhoga, en wer mipakogo Nyasachwa. Ji mangʼeny biro neno mi gibed maluor kendo gibiro keto genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo, to ne omiye jochungʼ piero adek.
english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼat ma konyruokne en Nyasach Jakobo, ngʼat ma genone ni kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

kikuyu: “Aoroni Huram-Abi ngʼat man-gi lony maduongʼ
english: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

kikuyu: Chiew, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye! Inindo nangʼo? Yaw wangʼi inen! Kik ikwedwa nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

kikuyu: Jatend lweny mar Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Gol wuoche manie tiendi, nikech kama ichungoeni en Kama Ler.” Omiyo Joshua notimo kamano.
english: The prince of the LORD’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.

kikuyu: Yie ikechwa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ikechwa, nikech osechawa gi kinda.
english: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

kikuyu: Ne ok owacho kamano nikech nohero jodhier, to nikech ne en jakuo. Kaka jakeno mar pesa, nothoro konyore gi pesa ma nokanogo.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

kikuyu: Ka uwuok dhi monjo dala maduongʼno, to penjuru jo-dalano ka gidwaro timo kodu winjruok mar kwe.
english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

kikuyu: Lweteni duto ariyo olony e timo richo. Jatelo dwaro mich githuon, jangʼad bura kawo asoya, jogi maroteke chuno ji gi timo gigegi magidwaro, giduto kaachiel giwinjore e wachni.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

kikuyu: In kaachiel gi yawuoti kik umadh kongʼo kata gima mero ji e kinde ma udhi e Hemb Romo, nono to ubiro tho. Mano en chik momako nyikwau nyaka tiengʼ mabiro.
english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Oonge ka; osechier! Paruru gima ne owachonu, kane pod en kodu Galili:
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

kikuyu: Kuom mano bor polo mar Jehova Nyasaye ne nitie ewi Hemb Romo godiechiengʼ, to mach ne nitie ei bor polono gotieno e nyim jo-Israel duto e wuodhegi.
english: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Atingʼo wangʼa ka arango gode, ere kuma konyruokna biro aye?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

kikuyu: e ngima maler kod tim makare e nyime ndalowa duto.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

kikuyu: To Rehoboam nodagi rieko mane jodongo ongʼadone kendo nopimo wach gi mbesene mane odongogo kendo ne tiyone.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

kikuyu: Elisha nowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma atiyone, ni ka dine bed ni ok ageno Jehoshafat ruodh Juda, to dine ok ayudo thuolo mar wuoyo kodi kata dewi
english: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

kikuyu: Ne oweyo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwerene kendo ok ne owuotho e yore Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and he abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of the LORD.

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ mondo kik ujwangʼ kod jo-Lawi modak e dieru e ndalo duto ma udak e pinyni.
english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

kikuyu: Jambwa duto bende nyaka dhi kodwa; kendo onge moro amora madongʼ chien. Moko kuomgi nyaka watigo e lamo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, nikech kapok wachopo kuno to ok wabi ngʼeyo ni mane monego watigo kuom lamo Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve the LORD our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve the LORD, until we come there.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nondiko jotich lwedo mar achuna e piny Israel duto maromo joma chwo alufu piero adek (30,000).
english: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

kikuyu: Negipuonjo joka Jakobo chikeni kendo jo-Israel bende negipuonjo wecheni. Ne giwangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kendo negitimoni misengini miwangʼo pep ewi kendo mar misango.
english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

kikuyu: Ka jadak moro manie dieru kata wendo oyudo mwandu mi obedo jamoko, to wadu moro to obedo modhier, mi ongʼiewe gi jadak modak e dieru kata anywola jadakno,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

kikuyu: Omiyo noluongo achiel kuom jotich kendo nopenje ni en angʼo matimore.
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

kikuyu: to kata kamano jo-Juda bende ne ok orito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi. Negiluwo mana timbe mane jo-Israel osiekogo.
english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

kikuyu: To ajuoke mag Misri notimo mana gik machal kamano gi tijegi mag ajuoke mi chuny Farao nomedo doko matek; ne ok onyal winjo wach Musa kod Harun mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho.
english: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ka udonjo e piny ma ateroue,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

kikuyu: kendo gigo duto mane otimone ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor man yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, ma gin Sihon ruodh Heshbon kod Og ruodh Bashan, mane odak Ashtaroth.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka nopimo bethene angʼwen duto kanyo. Bethenego ne nigi ohinga molwore duto, ma borne gi lachne ne oromo fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich maromre, mondo opog kind kama ler gi kama oriwo ji duto.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

kikuyu: Bakbakar, Heresh, Galal kod Matania wuod Mika, wuod Zikri, wuod Asaf,
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

kikuyu: Ne, Nying Jehova Nyasaye aa kuma bor, ka en-gi mirima mager machalo gi iro mopongʼo bor polo; dhoge opongʼ gi mirima mangʼeny, kendo lewe en mach mawengʼo.
english: Behold, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.

kikuyu: Pwodhuru lewni duto kaachiel gi gimoro amora molos gi pien, molos gi yie diel kata mago molos gi bao.”
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

kikuyu: Nyaka ochiw chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar gachiel ne rwath ka rwath, kendo kilo apar gachiel ne im ka im, kaachiel gi mo maromo lita adek gi nus kuom kilo apar gachiel mar cham ka cham.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kikuyu: Kane Musa osesomo ne ji weche duto mag chik mi ji duto owinjo, nokawo remb nyiroye gi diek, kaachiel gi pi, gi usi marakwaro kod obino, mi okiro e Kitap Chik, kendo okiro kuom ji duto, kokirogi gi yie rombo malando gi obino.
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

kikuyu: “To kata kamano, donge joricho manok ema tho piyo? Donge ji matin kuomgi kende ema masira mako; ma en masira ma mirimb Nyasaye ema okelo?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

kikuyu: Ziklag, Madmana, Sansana,
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako otimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kuom higni abiriyo nochiwogi e lwet jo-Midian.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

kikuyu: Donge Jehova Nyasaye dibed mamor ka akelone imbe alufe gi alufe, kata ka kelone moo mamol ka aora? Dachiw nyathina makayo eka wena kethona, koso nyodo mar ringra eka wena richona?
english: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

kikuyu: Noloso thiwni kendo oketogi ewi sirnigo. Bende noloso gik mongʼinore ongʼinore mia achiel mag mula kendo nolierogi e thiwnigo.
english: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

kikuyu: An nyako ma dichol kendo ma jaber, yaye nyi Jerusalem, an dichol mana ka hembe mag Kedar, kendo mana ka pasia molier e hembe Solomon.
english: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, aonge gi wach malongʼo ma anyalo ndiko ni Agripa kuome. Emomiyo asekele e nyimu uduto ka, to moloyo e nyimi, in Ruoth Agripa, mondo ka wasenone eka wayud wach ma dwandik kuome.
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

kikuyu: Eka jatend lweny nochungʼ moluongo matek gi dho jo-Hibrania niya, “Winjuru wach moa kuom ruoth maduongʼ, ma en ruodh Asuria!
english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Joma oluoro Nyasaye bende osetieki morumo e piny; ja-ratiro onge kata mana achiel modongʼ. Ji duto pondo karito mondo ochwer remo, moro ka moro manyo nyawadgi mondo odwodi.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

kikuyu: kochakore e mise mare man piny nyaka e ndiri michake gedo ne en fut adek kadhi malo kendo lachne en fut achiel gi nus, kendo koa e ndiri matin nyaka ndiri maduongʼ en fut achiel kadhi malo kendo lachne en fut achiel gi nus.
english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

kikuyu: mar adek ne Harim, to mar angʼwen ne Seorim,
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

kikuyu: Eka Elija nowachonegi niya, “An kende ema adongʼ kuom jonabi mag Jehova Nyasaye to Baal nigi jonabi mia angʼwen kod piero abich.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

kikuyu: Kido mag nyisechegi nyaka uwangʼ e mach. Kik ugomb fedha kod dhahabu ma gin-go, bende kik ukawgi. Ka utimo kamano, to ginibednu obadho nimar gigo gin gigo makwero ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Yawuot Pedaya ne gin: Zerubabel kod Shimei. Yawuot Zerubabel ne gin: Meshulam kod Hanania, to Shelomith ne nyamin-gi.
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

kikuyu: Udigo duto chakre oko nyaka laru maduongʼ kendo chakre mise nyaka yiendambewa noger gi kite ma nengogi tek mopa iye gi oko kendo nongʼadgi mowinjore kaka idwaro.
english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

kikuyu: Iwacho ni Nyasaye ok winj wecheni ka iwacho ni ok inene, kata obedo ni isetero kwayoni e nyime, kendo pod irite mondo odwoki.
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

kikuyu: Musa nobedo gi Jehova Nyasaye kuno kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno, ka ok ocham makati kata modho pi. Kendo nondiko weche mag singruokgi e kite mopa miluongi ni Chike Apar.
english: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

kikuyu: “Med dhiyo nyime gi timbegi mag jwok kod timbegi mangʼeny mag ajuoke, misebedo kitimo nyaka ia e nyathi; mondo waneane ka digikonyi kata dibwog ji.
english: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu wuotho e dieru e kambi ka ritou kendo mondo ochiw wasiku e lwetu. Kambi maru nyaka bed maler mondo kik one gima rach ma oweu.
english: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

kikuyu: Tim kamano mar konyo chuny ngʼatno, to ok nikech konyruokni. Ere gima omiyo paro manie chuny ngʼat machielo ema mona timo gima aneno ni an gi thuolo mar timo?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

kikuyu: “Uparo ni Jehova Nyasaye ne ok ongʼeyo wach misengini ma un gi kwereu, kod ruodhiu gi jotendu kaachiel gi jopinyu duto ne otimo e miech Juda kendo e yore mag Jerusalem? Koso uparo ni wiye osewil kodgi.
english: “The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t the LORD remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?

kikuyu: Eka notho moyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike e dala Daudi wuon-gi. Rehoboam wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Shobal wuon Kiriath Jearim ne gin, Haroe mane nus jo-Manahath,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼat monwangʼa oyudo ngima kendo oyudo ngʼwono kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

kikuyu: “Koso uparoru ne wach lewni nangʼo? Neyeuru kaka ondanyo mag pap dongo. Ok ginyagre gi tich kata gi chwecho.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

kikuyu: Gode noleny e bwoye kendo holni nobarore kapogore koni gi koni, mana ka odok mobolie mach, kendo mana ka pi maburore koa ewi thur.
english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

kikuyu: Magi e nying yawuot Gershon: Libni kod Shimei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho ni Amasa niya, “Luong jo-Juda mondo obi ira bangʼ ndalo adek, to in bende ibi ka.”
english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

kikuyu: To ne angʼicho, mi naneno bor polo marachar e nyima, to ewi bor polono ne nitie ngʼama obetie “machalo gi wuod dhano.” Nosidho osimbo mar dhahabu e wiye, kendo ne otingʼo pala mabith mar keyo e lwete.
english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

kikuyu: Ka jopuonjre apar mamoko nowinjo wachno, to ne gisin gi jowete ariyogo.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

kikuyu: “Ka Israel ne pod nyathi, ne ahere, kendo ne aluongo wuoda ka agolo Misri.
english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ka kido mantiere e piene en rachar to ok onenre ni odonjo ei ringʼo kendo yier manie iye pok olokore rachar, to jadolo nyaka ket ngʼat man-gi tuono kar kende kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni an kare, to pod ikwana mana ni an ja-miriambo; kata obedo ni aonge ketho, to asere mare osechwoya, moweya gi adhola ma ok thiedhre!’
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

kikuyu: Daudi bende nodhi gi joma ne ni kode ka moro ka moro nigi joode, kendo negidak Hebron gi dalane.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

kikuyu: E yo machalo kama ema un bende ubiro chiwoe chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye koa kuom achiel kuom apar duto muyudo koa kuom jo-Israel. E achiel kuom apargo, nyaka ichiw pok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne Harun, jadolo.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give the LORD’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Ka agonyogi gidhi thuchegi ka gidenyo kama to ginyalo podho e yo, nikech moko kuomgi oa mabor.”
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

kikuyu: To bende ne ok odonjo e polo mondo ochiwre kaka misango higa ka higa, kaka jadolo maduongʼ donjo Kama Ler Moloyo higa ka higa mondo otim misango gi remo ma ok mare owuon.
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

kikuyu: “Wuo gi Harun kendo iwachne kama: ‘Ka iketo teyni abiriyo kuonde mowinjore, to nyaka ler margi meny nyim rachung taya.’ ”
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nigi bura kuom jo-Juda; enokum Jakobo kaluwore gi yorene; kendo enochule kaluwore gi timbene.
english: The LORD also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

kikuyu: nyaka aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Puonj makoro amiyou sani to ok anyal pakoue, nikech kinde duto ma uchokoru kaachiel to chokruoku kelo mana rach kar kelo ber.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

kikuyu: Nitie mich mag Roho mopogore opogore, to Roho achiel ema chiwogi.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

kikuyu: En odiechiengʼ mar mudho kod kuyo, kendo en odiechieng mar rumbi kod mudho mandiwa. Ochalo gi piny moyawore ma lerne rieny e kor gode; oganda mangʼongo kendo maratego mar jolweny biro, mane pok one nyaka nene, kendo ok nochak one ndalo mabiro nyaka chiengʼ.
english: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.

kikuyu: Un joga parieuru kaka Balak ruodh jo-Moab nongʼado rieko, kendo kaka Balaam wuod Beor nodwoko. Parieuru wuoth mane uago Shitim nyaka Gilgal, mondo mi ungʼe timbe makare mag Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”

kikuyu: To in Timotheo, rit maber gima oseketi e lweti maber mondo iriti. Pogri gi mbekni manono mag piny gi gwenyo wach ma ji okawo ni rieko to ok gin rieko.
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

kikuyu: Negiketho miech Moab kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato ne odiro kidi e puothe duto mabeyo nyaka kite nopongʼogi. Negidino sokni duto kendo negitingʼo yiende duto mabeyo. Kir Hareseth kendo ema ne odongʼ gi kitene kochungʼ, to ji man-gi orujre noluore mi omonje bende.
english: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

kikuyu: “Sa nochopo ma jakwechono notho kendo malaika notingʼe, otere e bath Ibrahim. Jamoko bende notho kendo noyike.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

kikuyu: Jotije Josia nokelo ringre gi geche lweny koa Megido nyaka Jerusalem mine giike e liende owuon kendo jopinyno nokawo Jehoahaz wuod Josia mi giwire kendo mokete obedo ruoth kar wuon mare.
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

kikuyu: Kik uketh buch japiny moro, kata mar nyathi kich kata mako law dhako ma chwore otho kaka gir singo.
english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

kikuyu: “Kuom kinde manok asejwangʼi, to koro abiro duogi ira gi kech mangʼeny.
english: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.

kikuyu: Bende ka joot achiel opogore to odno nyaka podhi.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

kikuyu: oganda duto mar Israel nochokore Shilo mondo gidhi giked kodgi.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

kikuyu: Isaya to wuoyo gi chir niya, “Ne oyuda gi joma ne ok omanya. Ne afwenyora ne joma ne ok openja.”
english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

kikuyu: Ok owinjore ne tich lowo kata mana pidh owuoyo, omiyo ipuke oko. “Ngʼat man-gi it mar winjo wach mondo owinji.”
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Aseneno ni jogo duto mane odak kendo owuotho e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ noluwo bangʼ ngʼama tin, mane okawo kom ruoth.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Hemb Romo kod kar dak mar jo-Lawi noket e dier kambe mamoko. Ginichanre mana kaka kuondegi mag bworo ochanore ka jomoko ka jomoko ni kargi giwegi.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

kikuyu: Eka ruodh Asuria nomiyogi chik kama: “Kaw achiel kuom jodolo mane igolo itero e twech Samaria mondo odog odag kuno kendo opuonj jogo gima nyasach pinyno dwaro.”
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato owaro achiel kuom apar mar gige, to nyaka omedie achiel ewi abich mar nengogi.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

kikuyu: Ne oyiere kapok ochwe piny, to ne ofwenynwago e ndalogi mogik nikech un.
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat mane ni e ot nodwoke ni, ‘We chanda. Dhoot oselor, kendo nyithinda ni koda e kitanda. Ok anyal chungo kendo miyi gimoro amora.’
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

kikuyu: Ok onyal nyago gimoro mapongʼo lwet jakeyo, kata ma jachoko nyalo tingʼo e bade.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ebed-Melek nokawo jogo kendo odhigo e agola manie bwo kar keno mar dala ruoth. Ne okawo lewni moyiech kod lewni moti kanyo kendo nolorogi piny gi tol ne Jeremia ei bur.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

kikuyu: to onyisogi gik magisetimo; kendo ni giseketho ka ok gidewo.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Zefania wuod Kushi, ma wuod Gedalia, ma wuod Amaria, ma wuod Hezekia e kinde loch Josia wuod Amon ruodh Juda.
english: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

kikuyu: Wenwa richowa, nimar wan bende waweyone ji duto matimonwa marach. Kendo kik iwe wadonj e tem.’ ”
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

kikuyu: Teko mane faresego nigo ne ni e dhogi kendo e iwgi nikech iwgi mane nigi wigi ne chalo gi thuonde man-gi wiye ma gikechogo ka gihinyogo ji.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

kikuyu: Donge lweta ema osechweyo gigi duto momiyo gibedo mangima?” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho. “Ma e ngʼat ma ayiego ma en ngʼat ma hore kendo man-gi chuny motur, kendo ngʼama oluoro wachna.
english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye oseketo e chunygi mondo gitim gima odwaro ka gimiyo ondiek lochgi mondo olochi, nyaka wach Nyasaye chopi.
english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

kikuyu: Notimo misango e godno kendo noluongo wedene e nyasino. Bangʼ kane gisechiemo, ne ginindo kanyo.
english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

kikuyu: Ich wangʼ nego ngʼama ofuwo, kendo nyiego tieko ngʼama omingʼ.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

kikuyu: Eka Abner nowachone niya, “Bar korachwich kata koracham; mak achiel kuom yawuowigo mondo imaye gige mag lweny.” To Asahel notamore weyo lawe.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

kikuyu: Salu, Amok, Hilkia kod Jedaya. Magi ema ne jotend jodolo kod jotich kaachiel kodgi e ndalo Jeshua.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

kikuyu: To ka jo-Israel nowinjo ni negisegero kendo mar misango e tongʼ Kanaan kama iluongo ni Geliloth but aora Jordan yo kor jo-Israel,
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kata e kindeno mane wuowino ne biro, jachien nogoye piny mi nogwecho marach. To Yesu nochiko jachien marachno mi nochango wuowino, kendo nochiwe ne wuon mare.
