english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

kikuyu: Kendo ka kinde machielo alando ni piny kata pinyruoth onego ger kendo gur motegno,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,

kikuyu: To Johana notemo tame, kawacho niya, “Ibiro ira nade to an ema adwaro mondo ibatisa?”
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

kikuyu: Changuru joma tuo man kanyo kendo wachnegiuru ni, ‘Pinyruoth Nyasaye osekayo machiegni kodu.’
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Kendo kinyne Jehova Nyasaye notimo kamano. Jamni duto mag jo-Misri notho, to onge jamb ja-Israel kata achiel mane otho.
english: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

kikuyu: Ket mesa oko mar pasiano koma ochomo yo nyandwat mar Hemb Romo kendo ket rachungi taya kochomore kode e yo milambo mar Hemb Romo.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

kikuyu: mondo ji duto ongʼe gik madongo mitimo kod duongʼ mangʼongo mar pinyruodhi.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

kikuyu: Gikanyono wend Adonija duto nochungʼ malo gi bwok kendo ne gike.
english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

kikuyu: Ira wuod Ikesh ma ja-Tekoa, Abiezer ma ja-Anathoth,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

kikuyu: mane ogol Jerusalem gi Nebukadneza ruoth Babulon, ma gin e joma ne oter e twech kaachiel gi Jehoyakin ruodh Juda.
english: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

kikuyu: Ji ma timbegi richo ketho kiewo; kendo gikwayo jamni ma gisekwalo.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

kikuyu: Asekunyo sokni e pinje mamoko, mi amodho pige man kuno. Asemiyo aore duto mag Misri bende oduono ka anyonogi gi tienda.”
english: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”

kikuyu: Kendo nuwachona niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa osenyisowa duongʼne kod tekone kendo wasewinjo dwonde koa e mach. Kawuononi koro wasefwenyo ni ngʼato nyalo bedo abeda mangima kata obedo ni Nyasaye owuoyo kode.
english: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

kikuyu: Dhi ir Ruoth Daudi kendo penje niya, “Ruodha, donge nisingorina an jatichni kiwacho ni, ‘Adier Solomon wuodi biro bedo ruoth bangʼa kendo obiro bedo e kom duongʼ mara? Ka en kamano, to ere kaka koro Adonija osebedo ruoth?’
english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

kikuyu: Kamano ne giwuok ma gidhiyo e gwengʼ ka gwengʼ, ka giyalo Injili kendo gichango ji kuonde duto.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

kikuyu: Rawera ma ja-Lawi moa Bethlehem e piny Juda, mane osebedo kodak gi anywola jo-Juda,
english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.

kikuyu: Samuel nochiew okinyi mangʼich kendo nodhi romo gi Saulo, mi nowachne niya, “Saulo osedhi Karmel. Kanyo osechungoe rapar mimiyego duongʼ kuno kendo osewuok kuno olor kodhi Gilgal.”
english: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nolor ewi Got Sinai mi oluongo Musa nyaka ewi godno. Omiyo Musa noidho e got
english: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

kikuyu: ‘Wangima nikech En, kendo wawuotho nikech En, kendo wantie nikech En.’ En mana kaka jowendu moko osewacho ni, ‘Wan bende wan kothe.’
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

kikuyu: Hera ok tim gima rach ni wadgi. Kuom mano, hera ema ochopo chike duto.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

kikuyu: Omiyo jombetrego nopenje niya, “Japuonj, wangʼeyo ni iwacho kendo ipuonjo yor Nyasaye kaluwore gi adierane.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Abiro kedo kodgi. Anagol nyinge oko gi joge motony gi nyithinde kod nyikwaye kuom jo-Babulon.”
english: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne imiyogi pinyni mane isesingone kweregi, piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Kik iwe timo maber ni jogo mowinjorego, ka in kod nyalo mar timo kamano.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

kikuyu: Koro noyudo ka Gaal wuod Ebed nodar gi owetene odhi Shekem, kendo jopinyno noketo yie margi kuome.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Israel nowuok kod gige duto, kendo kane ochopo Bersheba, notimo misango ne Nyasach Isaka wuon-gi.
english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona kama: “Wuod dhano, donge inyalo ngʼado bura ni Ohola gi Oholiba? Ka inyalo timo kamano to chomgi tir gi timbegi mamonogo,
english: The LORD said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

kikuyu: Kendo ngʼato angʼata morwako nyathi machal kama e nyinga to an ema orwaka.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

kikuyu: Nowuotho koda e dier chokego koni gi koni, komako lweta, kendo naneno choke madongo mangʼeny motamore akwana, kanie dier holono; ne gin choke motwo kururu.
english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

kikuyu: Negidhi Kapernaum, to kane Sabato ochopo, Yesu nodonjo e sinagogi mi ochako puonjo.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

kikuyu: To mokwongo nyaka one masiche mangʼeny, kendo tiengʼni nodage.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

kikuyu: Kar romb chwo duto kochakore ja-dwe achiel kata moloyo dwe achiel mane okwan ne romo ji alufu auchiel mia ariyo (6,200).
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Piny maber bende enomonji. Pinje mangʼeny nopodhi, makmana piny Edom gi Moab kod jotend Amon ema noresi e lwete.
english: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Pogreuru gi ketho duto musetimo, kendo beduru gi chuny manyien kod paro malongʼo. Udwaro ni utho nangʼo, yaye dhood Israel?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

kikuyu: To koro inyisa mondo adhi ir ruodha mondo anyise ni, ‘Elija ni ka.’
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

kikuyu: Kethogi mar chwero remo mapok aweyonegi, abiro weyonegi.”
english: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for the LORD dwells in Zion.”

kikuyu: “Kaw kitabu kendo indikie weche duto ma asewacho kuom Israel gi Juda kod ogendini mamoko duto kochakore kinde mane achako wuoyo kodi e ndalo loch Josia nyaka sani.
english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

kikuyu: Noluongo jopuonjrene apar gariyo ire, mi omiyogi teko mondo giriemb jochiende kuom ji, kendo gichang kit midekre gi tuoche duto.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata manyalo hedhore mar kwinye. Koro en ngʼa madihedhre chungʼ e nyima?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

kikuyu: Kendo ka warito chikegi adimba ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa miyowa kaka osechikowa, mano nobednwa kaka tim makare.”
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”

kikuyu: nyaka aa nene onge ngʼama osewinjo, kendo onge it mosewinjo, bende onge wangʼ moseneno Nyasaye moro amora ma ok in, moserito joge mogeno kuome.
english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

kikuyu: Ka idagi weyo joga mondo odhi, to abiro kelo masira mar ogwende e pinyni duto.
english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

kikuyu: To ka ji openjo ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa osetimonwa ma?’ Wachnegiuru ni, ‘Kaka usejwangʼa kendo usetiyone nyiseche mag pinje mamoko ei pinyu uwegi, omiyo koro ubiro tiyone ogendini mamoko ei piny ma ok maru.’
english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

kikuyu: “Piny joma otho tetni, kendo ji duto man kuno luoro malich omako.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

kikuyu: Nokelo gige dhahabu gi fedha kod mula e hekalu mar Nyasaye ma en owuon gi wuon mare nosepwodho.
english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

kikuyu: Kinde moko ne iwuoyo e yor fweny, mine iwacho ne jogi ma jo-adiera niya, “Asesidho teko kuom jalweny, asemiyo wuowi moro matin duongʼ e dier ji.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Musa noyie mondo dichwo ondik barup weruok mar ketho keny eka oriembe.”
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

kikuyu: Jopuonjre Johana nonyise gigi duto. Noluongo ji ariyo kuomgi,
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Kiriath Baal (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim), kod Raba. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo ariyo.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Kambi adekgi nogoyo turumbete kendo gitoyo njagi. Ka gimako toje gi lwetgi koracham kendo ka gitingʼo turumbete mane onego gi goo gi lwetgi korachwich, ne gikok niya, “Ligangla en mar Jehova Nyasaye kod Gideon!”
english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!”

kikuyu: Noa kuno modhi nyaka Bersheba,
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

kikuyu: Abishai owadgi Joab ne jatend thuondi adekgi. Ne otingʼo tonge mi onego ji mia adek, mano ema nomiyo obedo ngʼat marahuma ka thuondi adekgi.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai nowuok modhi kendo negichako chano kaka digineg Yesu.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: To Zipora nokawo pala modingli mi ongʼadogo pien mantie e dho duongʼ wuode kendo nokawo pien-no momulogo tiend Musa. Nowacho niya, “Adier ibedona wuon kisera mar remo.”
english: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”

kikuyu: To kik uluorgi; paruru malongʼo gima ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu otimone Farao gi piny e Misri duto.
english: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

kikuyu: Emomiyo awacho niya, “Chia mara oserumo kod gigo mane ageno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo kamano; mine giriembogi oko mar kambi. Negitimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

kikuyu: ka ok girito buchena kendo ka chikena otamogi luwo,
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

kikuyu: Gima anyisou kama opondo, wuouru kuome e ler; kendo gima akuodhonu e tie itu, huluru matek ewi udi.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

kikuyu: Eka ne gibawe gi dhahabu maler kendo gilworo bethene gi dhahabu.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Neginywolo nyako ma nyinge Shera, mane ogero Mwalo gi Malo mar Beth Horon kaachiel gi Uzen Shera.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat moro miluongo ni Anania nobiro mondo onena. Ne en ngʼat morito Chik Nyasaye gi chunye duto kendo ma jo-Yahudi duto modak e dalano nomiye luor.
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

kikuyu: Abiro kelo masira kuomi. Abiro tieko nyikwayi kendo abiro ngʼado oko nyathi moro amora ma wuowi ma chogo moa dhood Ahab e piny Israel; bed ni gin wasumbini kata ok gin wasumbini.
english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Joab nodhi ei ot ir ruoth mowacho niya, “Kawuononi isekuodo wi jogi duto, ma osereso ngimani, ngima yawuoti gi nyigi to gi ngima mondi to gi mondi mamoko.
english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, ‘Nimar kaka okanda itweyo e nungo dhano, omiyo ne atweyo od Israel duto kod od Juda duto kuoma, mondo gibed joga miluongo gi nyinga, ma kelona pak kod duongʼ. To kata kamano negitamore winja.’
english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says the LORD; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’

kikuyu: Kane gibedo e mesa gichiemo, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni janabi moticha mane odwogo chien.
english: As they sat at the table, the LORD’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

kikuyu: To ka Roho mar adiera, osebiro, to enopuonju adiera duto. Ok enobed janeno kuome owuon, to nowachnu mana gik mosebedo kowinjo kendo obiro nyisou gik mabiro timore bangʼe.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe nolemo kendo mi polo noyawore mi koth ochwe kendo mi piny nochiego cham.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

kikuyu: To koro udwaro keto chwo kod mond Juda gi Jerusalem wasumbiniu. Donge un bende un joketho kuom timo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu?
english: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against the LORD your God?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon ni abiro kume nikech ne ok orito singruokna kod winjruok mane atimo kode.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

kikuyu: Midian nonywolo Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida kod Elda. Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Ketura.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

kikuyu: Kane gidhi yo wuok chiengʼ, negiyudo pap moro e piny Shinar mine gidak kanyo.
english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

kikuyu: Kik ucham gimoro amora malak gi bund-igi kata mawuotho gi tiende angʼwen kata man-gi tiende mathoth nikech gin gik makwero.
english: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

kikuyu: Obiro herou, gwedhou kendo miyo unyaa mangʼeny, obiro gwedho nyithindo munywolo, cham manie puotheu, decheu, divai manyien, mo, nyiroye ma dhou onywolo kod nyithi jambu e piny mane osingore ne kwereu ni nomigi.
english: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

kikuyu: Wuowi matin-no nowachone niya, “Mago duto aserito. En angʼo machielo ma pod aremo?”
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

kikuyu: To min chi Simon nonindo e kitanda, ka tuo mar midhusi onure. Joma nenikanyo nonyiso Yesu wachno piyo piyo.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

kikuyu: Ok gichak gichiw misengini ne jochiende ma gisebedo ka gidwanyorego. Koro ma en chik momakou nyaka chiengʼ kaachiel gi tienge mabiro.’
english: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

kikuyu: Ahimaz nonywolo Azaria, to Azaria nonywolo Johanan,
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

kikuyu: To dhako ma chwore otho mohero mor mar piny, osetho kata obedo ni pod ongima.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moyiengʼ ok dwar mor kich, to ngʼatno modenyo kata mana gima kech mitne.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

kikuyu: Daudi nolamo Nyasaye mondo kik nyathi tho. Notweyo chiemo kendo nodhi e ode mi onindo piny e lowo otieno ka otieno.
english: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

kikuyu: To negichako penjoree gin giwegi ni en ngʼatno kuomgi manyalo biro timo ma.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe Musa nochungo yawuot Harun, kendo nomieno remo e itgi ma korachwich gi lith lwetgi mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiendegi mathuon ma korachwich. Remo modongʼ to ne okiro e bath kendo mar misango moluoro.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto mane nitiere nochamo Pasaka e ndalono kendo negitimo Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

kikuyu: ne achikonu ita adimba kinde mane uwuoyo, to onge ngʼato kuomu moseyudo Ayub gi ketho; kendo onge ngʼato kuomu mosedwoko weche Ayub.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

kikuyu: Onge gimoro amora ma Misri nyalo timo maber, bedni en jatelo kata ngʼama otelne, obed bad othith kata odundu.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

kikuyu: Musa nonyiso jo-Israel gigo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochike.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed gi jo-Nyasaye. Amin.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.

kikuyu: Kane owinjo humb Yesu, nobiro gi yo katoke ei oganda kendo nomulo riak lawe,
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

kikuyu: Noluongo kanyo ni Shiba (tiende ni kar singruok) nyaka chil kawuono dalano osebed kiluongo ni Bersheba.
english: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

kikuyu: Kane jogo owuok mondo odhi, Ibrahim nowuok kodgi ka kowogi ka gichomo Sodom.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

kikuyu: Kuno unulamie gik ma dhano oloso gi lwetgi, ma gin nyiseche molos gi bao kata gi kite mopa, gin gik ma ok nyal neno, winjo, chiemo kata winjo tik gimoro.
english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare ireso kuom chandruok, to chandruok biro mana ni jaricho.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

kikuyu: To ka oonge gi nyako, to ipog owetene girkeni mare.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

kikuyu: “Sud machiegni koda mondo iwinj wachni: “Pok apandonu gimoro nyaka ne achak wuoyo kodu; kendo e kinde mane magi timore, ne antie.” To koro Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto oseora, gi Roho mare.
english: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.

kikuyu: Gouru milome e kuonde mochiel motegno mag Ashdod kaachiel gi Misri: “Chokreuru kanyakla e gode molworo Samaria, mondo uneye timbe mamono matimore e dalano, kendo kaka isando ji kuno.”
english: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowuoyo kode kawacho ni, ‘Nyikwayi nobed jodak e piny moro ma ok margi, kendo nolokgi wasumbini mi nosandgi malit kuom higni mia angʼwen.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

kikuyu: Nyasaye notingʼe malo mokete e bade owuon ma korachwich, kaka Ruoth kendo Jawar, mondo omi jo-Israel olokre owe richogi.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

kikuyu: Jogo duto ema ne nyikwa Kaleb. Yawuot Hur wuod Efratha makayo ne gin: Shobal wuon Kiriath Jearim,
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

kikuyu: Beduru gi chir kendo motegno. Kik uluorgi kendo kik gimi chunyu nyosre, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro dhi kodu; ok enoweu kata jwangʼou.”
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye, “Waseketho e nyimi, ka waweyo Nyasachwa kendo watiyone nyiseche mag Baal.”
english: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

kikuyu: Adier, iniyud mor kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego kendo inichom wangʼi kuom Nyasaye.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

kikuyu: To koro wanyalo wacho angʼo kuom gima Ibrahim ma kwarwa; nofwenyo kuom wachni?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

kikuyu: Nopenja niya, “Wuod dhano, bende ineno gini?” Eka notelona modwoka nyaka e bath aora.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.

kikuyu: Magi e migepe mag jorit rangeye mane gin nyikwa Kora kod Merari.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gichano timoni marach kendo giloso chenro maricho, to ok ginyal loyo;
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj Chik gi jo-Farisai, un muwuondorugi! Uyako ute mon ma chwogi otho, kendo ulamo lemo moyware mondo unyisrugo ni ji kaka ulony e lamo. Omiyo ibiro kumou malit moloyo.]
english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

kikuyu: Mago mane oa kuom jodolo ne gin: nyikwa Hobaya, Hakoz kod Barzilai (ngʼatno mane okendo nyar Barzilai ma ja-Gilead to kendo ne iluonge gi nyingno).
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

kikuyu: Nochako omako ich, kendo ochako onywolo wuowi. Nowacho niya, “Koro chwora biro padore kuoma nikech asenywolone yawuowi adek.” Omiyo nochake ni Lawi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

kikuyu: Ka en kamano, to ubiro timoru nade ka unune Wuod Dhano kadok kuma ne oae!
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

kikuyu: Joab nowacho ni ngʼat mane onyise wachno niya, “Angʼo! Inene? Angʼo ma nomoni chwowe molwar piny kanyo? To damiyi shekel apar mag fedha gi okanda mar jolweny.”
english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

kikuyu: nyaka ne adonjo kama ler mar lemo mar Nyasaye; eka nawinjo kaka gikogi nobedi.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai mane ohero pesa nowinjo magi duto kendo neginyiero kagijaro Yesu.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kata kamano, anamigi ngima kendo chang; anachang joga kendo anami gibed gi mor kuom kwe mathoth kod rit mogundho.
english: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

kikuyu: Ok unuduogie piny ma ugombo duogoeni.”
english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech nyaka aa chon isebedo ka imako sadha gi jo-Israel kendo nikech ne ichiwogi ne ligangla e kinde mane masira omakogi, kendo kane gin e chuny kum margi,
english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

kikuyu: Wasetimo richo mana kaka kwerewa bende notimo; wasetimo marach kendo wasetimo gik mamono.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Nopenjo jolweny kod Abner wuod Ner niya, “Bende unyalo dwoka, Abner?” Abner nodwoke niya, “In ngʼa maluongo ruoth?”
english: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

kikuyu: Chikeni e girkeni mara manyaka chiengʼ; gin e mor mar chunya.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

kikuyu: Ne angʼiyo gode madongo kendo negiyiengni, to gode matindo duto ne rundore koni gi koni.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

kikuyu: Ruoth nigi mon piero auchiel gi mon mamoko piero aboro, kod nyiri mapok ongʼeyo chwo mokadho akwana.
english: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

kikuyu: Ne abiro iru gi nyawo kod luoro, kendo ka denda duto tetni.
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

kikuyu: Jehu notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo ne oike e piny Samaria mi Jehoahaz wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Eka thuondi adekgo nomwomo kama jolwenj jo-Filistia nochanore mi gitwomo pi e soko mane nitie but ranga Bethlehem kendo giterone Daudi. To notamore modho pigno, to kar modhe to noologo piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.

kikuyu: Mad wuonu gi minu bed mamor; mad minu mane onywoli bed gi ilo.
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

kikuyu: An e makati mobiro e piny koa e polo. Kwereu nochamo manna kendo ne githo, to ngʼat mochamo makatini, to biro bedo mangima nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

kikuyu: To nyisgi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Anami ji duto modak e pinyni njawre gi mer, kaachiel gi ruodhi mobet e kom duongʼ mar Daudi, jodolo, jonabi kod jogo duto modak Jerusalem.
english: Then tell them, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

kikuyu: (Jo-Emi osebedo ka odak kanyo, ma gin joma rateke, mangʼeny kendo ma roboche mana ka jo-Anak.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ndach kamnie maleny nono, kendo mana kaka nyathi monywol kosetho, mad kik gine wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

kikuyu: Osekwano kendo ongʼeyo kar romb sulwe duto kendo oluongo moro ka moro kuomgi gi nyinge.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

kikuyu: Samson notelo ne Israel kuom higni piero ariyo e ndalo mag jo-Filistia.
english: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jo-Israel ne ok owangʼo dala maduongʼ moro amora moger e gode mag-gi matindo makmana Hazor ma Joshua nowangʼo.
english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

kikuyu: Ahab noyweyo gi kwerene, kendo Ahazia wuode nokawo lochne kaka ruoth.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Wechegi osekonyo joma opodho; kendo isejiwo joma tekogi orumo.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: En Nyasacha ma jahera kendo en ohingana, bende en kar pondona kendo en jakonyna. En okumbana ma agengʼorago, kendo en ema oloyona joma ni e bwoya.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

kikuyu: Eka Farao noluongo Musa kod Harun mowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru utim misango ni Nyasachu e piny Misri ka.”
english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “En ngʼa ma oketi ruoth kendo jangʼadnwa bura? Iparo mar nega kaka nyoro inego ja-Misri cha?” Ka Musa nowinjo kamano, kibaji nogoye mobedo maluor koparo niya, “Gima nyoro atimo nyaka bed ni osengʼere.”
english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”

kikuyu: To chiengʼono muchiewoe cham mifwayo to nyaka uchiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye gi nyaim ma pod hike achiel kendo maonge songa mondo timgo misango miwangʼo pep,
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo maber ni bangʼ ka asea, ondiegi mangemo biro monjou, kendo ok giniwe kweth Nyasaye ngangʼ.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Filistia osekawo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye ne gigole Ebeneza mi gitere Ashdod.
english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

kikuyu: Pige mag aora biro dwono, kendo kuonde ma pi luwo biro two ma bar okak.
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

kikuyu: Hezekia ema ne ogengʼo thidhna matin mar Gihon kobaro pige mondo oluw bath Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi yo podho chiengʼ. Tije duto mane lwete omulo nodhi maber.
english: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

kikuyu: Negiriwo pasia abich obedo gimoro achiel kendo auchiel modongʼ bende negiriwo kamano.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

kikuyu: “Kuonde lemo duto mag joka Isaka ibiro kethi kendo kuonde maler duto mag Israel ibiro kethi; kendo anabi gi ligangla mondo aked gi dhood Jeroboam.”
english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”

kikuyu: Koro owetena, onge tiende ndikonu kuom ndalo kata sa ma gigo notimre,
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi motundo ir ngʼat Nyasaye e got Karmel. Kane onene gichien kobiro, ngʼat Nyasaye ne okone jatichne ma Gehazi niya, “Ne! Chi Shunam cha biro!
english: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.

kikuyu: Petro nolokore moneno japuonjre mane Yesu ohero kaluwogi. (Ma e ngʼat mane otenore kuom Yesu kane gilworo mesa gichamo chiemb odhiambo, mi openje niya, “Ruoth, en ngʼa madwaro ndhogi?”)
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

kikuyu: Eka negilosone hemano raum mar pien rombe molok gi range makwar kendo negiume gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nam.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Amin! Mad Jehova Nyasaye tim kamano! Mad Jehova Nyasaye chop singruok mar weche misekoro kuom kelo gige od Jehova Nyasaye kod joma notwe duto kae koa Babulon.
english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the LORD do so. May the LORD perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.

kikuyu: Kane pok otieko lemo, Rebeka notucho kotingʼo dapige e goke. Ne en nyar Bethuel wuod Milka, mane chi Nahor owadgi Ibrahim.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

kikuyu: Nolokore motenore kuom Yesu mopenje niya, “Ruoth, en ngʼa?”
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

kikuyu: Negikawo dala maduongʼno, ruodhe kod mier matindo mokiewo kode mi ginegogi. Ji duto mane odak kanyo negitieko chuth kendo onge joma notony. Negitimone Debir kod ruodhe mana kaka negitimone Libna gi ruodhe, to gi Hebron.
english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

kikuyu: Maharai ma ja-Netofath, Heled wuod Baana ja-Netofath,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

kikuyu: “Wuonwa notho e thim. Ne ok en achiel kuom jolup Kora, mane okwedo Jehova Nyasaye, to notho nikech richone owuon kendo ne ok onywolo yawuowi.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho ne Ibrahim niya, “In kaachiel gi nyikwayi kod tienge mabiro nyaka rit singruokna.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rituru Sabato maga kendo kama ler mar lemo mara nyaka umi luor mowinjore. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.

kikuyu: To ka udonjo e dala moro to ok orwaku, dhiuru e akek yore kendo uwach niya,
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

kikuyu: En ngʼa kuomu ma parruok moparorego nyalo miyo omed bedo mangima kata mana kuom sa achiel kende?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ok abi time e kindeni, nikech Daudi wuonu. To abiro poge e kinde wuodi.
english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye riti, Jehova Nyasaye e tipo moumi gi yo badi korachwich;
english: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

kikuyu: Ka udar kama ujote, to Harun kod yawuote nyaka donji ei hema mi gigol pasia kendo giumgo Sandug Muma.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

kikuyu: E sa ma pacha noduogeno, duongʼna gi lichna bende noduogna mondo pinyruodha ochak obed gi duongʼ. Jongʼadna rieko kod jodonga nomanya, kendo nochak oketa e lochna mi nabedo gi duongʼ moloyo kaka nachalo chon.
english: At the same time my understanding returned to me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and brightness returned to me. My counselors and my lords sought me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent greatness was added to me.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Gibeon, Rama, Beeroth,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

kikuyu: Omiyo bangʼe Ibrahim noyudo gima Nyasaye nosingore ni nomiye bangʼ rito gi kinda.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

kikuyu: Mi Harun kod yawuote pesa miwarogo jo-Israel momedore.”
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

kikuyu: “Ka jachien marach owuok kuom ngʼato, owuotho kuonde motwo koni gi koni komanyo kama doyudie yweyo, to ok oyudi. Eka owacho ni, ‘Abiro dok e ot mane aaye.’
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

kikuyu: Koro Josef noseter Misri. Potifa ma ja-Misri mane en achiel kuom jatend Farao, kendo jaduongʼ od ruoth nongʼiewe kuom jo-Ishmael mane okele kanyo.
english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

kikuyu: “To ngʼat mawinjo wechena to ok riti, to an ok angʼadne bura, nikech ne ok abiro mondo angʼadne piny bura, to nabiro mondo ares piny.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

kikuyu: Jo-dhood Harun mondo owach niya, “Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: To chi Lut nolokore mongʼiyo chien, kendo nolokore siro mar chumbi.
english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro gurou kaka joge maler, mana kaka ne owacho ka okwongʼore, ka urito chike mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo uwuotho e yorene.
english: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Nikech chandruok mokalo akwana olwora; richona osejuka kendo ok anyal neno. Gingʼeny moloyo yie wiya, kendo chunya onyosore gie iya.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

kikuyu: to chwore mar ariyono bende ojok kode, mondiko barup weruok momiye, kendo oriembe, kata ka chwore mar ariyono otho,
english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

kikuyu: en ema otiyo e kama ler mar lemo, ma en Hemb Romo madier ma Ruoth ema oguro, to ok dhano.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni joma timbegi richo orida gi tonde, to wiya ok bi wil gi chikeni.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Arfaksad nonywolo Shela, to Shela nonywolo Eber.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Magi e migepe mag yawuot Harun. Yawuot Harun ne gin: Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: dwond joma wer koa kuonde mamon umboe pi; ka giwero timbe makare mag Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ka gipako timbe makare mag jolweny mage mager man Israel. “Bangʼ mano oganda Jehova Nyasaye nodhi e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ.
english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the LORD’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then the LORD’s people went down to the gates.

kikuyu: To ji nolamo thuol mangʼongono nikech nosemiyo ondiek malichno tekone owuon kendo negilamo ondiek malichno ka gipenjo niya. “En ngʼa machal gi ondiek malich?” Ere ngʼato manyalo kedo kode?
english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

kikuyu: Kane onyis Saulo ni Daudi oseringo odhi Gath, ne ok ochako omanye.
english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

kikuyu: Kane Farao owinjo kamano nooro wach mondo okelne Josef, kendo nokel Josef mapiyo nono koa e od twech. Kane Josef oselielo yie wiye kendo oloko lepe, nobiro e nyim Farao.
english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Jo-Asher bende ne ok oriembo joma ne odak Ako, Sidon, Alab, Akzib, Helba, Afek, kod Rehob,
english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

kikuyu: Bangʼe tongʼno nochomo yo wuok chiengʼ mochopo nyaka Beth Dagon koluwo Zebulun gi Holo mar Ifta El, kochomo yo nyandwat nyaka Beth Emek gi Neyel kokalo e bath Kabul.
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

kikuyu: kanyalore to an bende nochiera aa kuom joma otho.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Eka Delila nowachone Samson niya, “Nyaka sani, isebedo ka ikawa ka ngʼama ofuwo kendo isewuonda. Nyisa kaka inyalo tweyi.” Nodwoko niya, “Ka ikado yie wiya gi usi mar chwecho kendo miride gi pino, to anabed manyap machal gi ngʼato angʼata.” Omiyo kane onindo Delila nokado yie wiye nyadibiriyo, kotwangʼe matek gi usi mar chwecho
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”

kikuyu: Mondo omi ires jo-Israel makayo ji mia ariyo piero adek gabiriyo ma kwan-gi ohewo kwan midwaro mar jo-Lawi,
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

kikuyu: Giduto negipenjo niya, “Kara in e Wuod Nyasaye?” Nodwoko niya, “Un kare kuwacho ni An e en!”
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

kikuyu: Oganda moro osemonjo pinya, en oganda maratego kendo gingʼeny mokadho akwana; en gi leke mag sibuor madichwo, leke mager mag sibuor madhako.
english: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bethel kod Ai, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gadek (123),
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Farao ne mor ahinya gi Hadad, omiyo nokawo nyamin Tapenes ma en ruoth madhako kendo ma jaod Farao mondo obed chiege.
english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

kikuyu: Kane osegologi, noidho modhi e bath got malo, mobet kar kende mondo olem. Kane piny chiegni imore, ne en kanyo kende,
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Donge ne asenyisou, to ok uyie. Udwaro winje kendo nangʼo? Koso un bende udwaro doko jopuonjrene?”
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwokogi kager. Notamore tiyo gi rieko mane jodongo ongʼadone,
english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

kikuyu: Koth Harun moro amora matuo mar dhoho nogore kuome kata man-gi tuo machwer, ok onego cham chiemo mowal mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye kapok opwodhe. Enobed ngʼama ogak ka omulo gima orere kuom ngʼama otho kata orere kuom ngʼama kothe mar dichwo owuok,
english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

kikuyu: Nokete ruodh Gilead, Ashuri gi Jezreel, to gi Efraim gi Benjamin kod Israel duto.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

kikuyu: To jogo nowachone Joshua niya, “Wabiro tiyone Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kendo wanamiye luor.”
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

kikuyu: mar apar gochiko ne Pethahia, to mar piero ariyo ne Jehezkel,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

kikuyu: Gilidho ka ginindo piny mana ka sibuor madichwo, bende mana ka sibuor madhako maonge ngʼama nyalo chiewo? “Mad joma ogwedhi gwedhi to joma kwongʼi mondo okwongʼ!”
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni oyud ni en adier ni nyakono ne ok oyudo gi gige ringre,
english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, owinjore ji duto moluoro Nyasaye olami kapod inyalo yudi; adier ka pige madongo otugore, to ok gibi chopo ire,
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

kikuyu: An gi teko machal gi teko kidi koso? Bende ringra olos gi nyinyo?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

kikuyu: Mad jagope moro mak gige duto ma en-go kendo mad joma welo oyak mwandu duto moseloso.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

kikuyu: Noa kanyo modhi e piny gode ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar Bethel kendo nogero hembe e kind Bethel man yo podho chiengʼ to gi Ai man yo wuok chiengʼ. Kanyo nogeroe kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye kanyo.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Gigi duto notimorenigi kaka ranyisi, kendo nondiknwagi mondo gibednwa siem, wan ma wadak e ndalo ma giko piny chiegnini.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osechano muko ohinga molworo Nyar Sayun. Oserieyo rapim kendo ne ok ogengʼo lwete mondo kik okethe. Nomiyo chiel ma oko mar dala kod ohinga oyiengni, giduto kaachiel ne gimukore mi gigore piny.
english: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ka kindeno ochopo to inibed gi paro marach.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

kikuyu: Nus mar pok mar jo-Israel mane Musa ogolo kuom joma nodhi e lweny ne chalo kama:
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

kikuyu: Mapiyo piyo kane Daudi odwogo koa nego ja-Filistia, Abner nokawe motere e nyim Saulo, kapod Daudi otingʼo wi ja-Filistia.
english: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

kikuyu: Nitie ringruok achiel kod Roho achiel, mana kaka ne un e geno achiel kane oluongu,
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

kikuyu: nikech gin giwegi giwuoyo kuom kit rwak mane urwakowago. Ginyiso ji kaka nulokoru ubedo jo-Nyasaye, kuweyo nyiseche manono, mondo uti ne Nyasaye mangima kendo madiera;
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

kikuyu: Chiw cham moa e nyak mokwongo mar lopi kendo ichiwe kaka misango moa e laru mar dino cham.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

kikuyu: Marangʼo pod ok imako Jeremia moa Anathoth, ma ketore ni janabi e dieru?
english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,

kikuyu: Kane anyalo medo bedo mangima e ringruok, to mano nyiso ni abiro medo tiyo tich makelo ohala. To koro dayier angʼo? Ok angʼeyo gima dayier!
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

kikuyu: To anane wangʼi ka ngimana nikare; ka achiewo, abiro romo ka aneno kiti kaka ichal.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

kikuyu: Eka jowa moko nodhi e liel to negiyudo mana kaka mon-go ne owacho, to en ok ne ginene.”
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek ka Festo nosedonjo e loch, noa Kaisaria modhi nyaka Jerusalem,
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

kikuyu: Zibeon nonywolo: Aiya, kod Ana. (Ma e Ana mane ofwenyo thidhna mar pi maliet e thim kane oyudo okwayo punde wuon mare Zibeon.)
english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

kikuyu: Koa yo milambo nobedie migepe mag Reuben kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi. Jatend dhood Reuben ne en Elizur wuod Shedeur.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Koro wakwayou, jowetewa, mondo uchiw luor ni jogo matiyo tich Ruoth matek e dieru ma gin jotendu kendo jopuonju kuom Ruoth.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

kikuyu: Nyalo bedo ni iwinjo maber ka ahinyora; kendo ka ikwedo tich lweti, to timbe joricho to mori?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

kikuyu: Eka Jehoyada gi ji kod ruoth nosingore ni ginibed jo-Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the LORD’s people.

kikuyu: Kane Ezra lemo kendo hulo richo, koywak kendo kongʼielore piny e nyim od Nyasaye, oganda maduongʼ mar jo-Israel; chwo, mon kod nyithindo nochokore kolwore. Gin bende ne giywak malit.
english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko Farao niya, “Aweyoni mondo iket kinde mowinjore alemnie kod jodongi gi jogi mondo in kod joodi ogol ogwende kuomu, to mago manie aora Nael to nodongʼ.”
english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno odongʼ gunda, kama yande ji odakie ojwangʼ ka thim; nyiroye nokwa kanyo bende kanyo ema gini nindie kagiselwero bede yien magitieko.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni kamoro amora ma noyalie Injilini e kind ogendini duto mag piny, gima dhakoni otimo bende nohul, kiparego.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat matero ngʼat moriere tir e yo mar richo biro podho e obetone owuon, to ngʼat ma ok cha biro yudo pok maber.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

kikuyu: Ka iriek, riekoni nomiyi ohala, ka ijajaro, to in iwuon ema ibiro hinyori.
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

kikuyu: Asa ne nigi jolweny ma jo-Juda alufu mia adek moritore gi kuodi madongo kod tonge, kod jo-Benjamin alufu mia ariyo gi piero aboro manoritore gi okumba gi atungʼ. Magi duto ne gin jolweny mathuondi mager.
english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Omiyo anabi irgi ka sibuor, kendo ka kwach abiro buto negi e bath yo.
english: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.

kikuyu: Jo-mwandu duto manie piny biro chiemo kendo lemo; ji duto madhi piny e lowo biro kulore e nyime, jogo ma ok nyal siko kangima.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

kikuyu: Jared notho kane en ja-higni mia ochiko gi piero auchiel gariyo.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

kikuyu: Ne nitiere dhoudi midonjogo e ute matindo mane ni e alwora hekalugo mane ngʼado kama owe thuolono, achiel ne ni yo nyandwat, to machielo ne ni yo milambo; kendo lach mar kama ne owe thuolo, mane ndiri olworo koni gi koni, ne oromo fut abiriyo gi nus e alworane duto.
english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

kikuyu: Janabi nowachone yawuote niya, “Gawnauru punda kendo negitimo kamano.”
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

kikuyu: Jodolo mane jotend anywolagi ne kwan-gi romo ji alufu achiel gi mia abiriyo kod piero auchiel (1,760). Ne gin joma niginyalo kendo molony e tij Od Nyasaye.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Kuom mano kane jo-ohala ma jo-Midian ochopo machiegni, owete Josef noywaye oko e bugo kendo nouse kuom shekel piero ariyo mar fedha ne jo-Ishmaelgo, mane otere Misri.
english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

kikuyu: Nogoyonegi ngero kama: “Neuru yadh ngʼowu kod yien duto.
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

kikuyu: Irito piny kendo iolone pi, imiyo obedo momew moromo chuth. Aore mag Nyasaye opongʼ gi pi mamiyo ji bedo gi cham, nimar kamano e kaka ne ichano chon.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth owinjo weche mag Chik, noyiecho lepe.
english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Eliazar wuod Harun bende notho kendo noyike Gibea, kama nopogne wuode Finehas e piny gode mag Efraim.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ginibet bungu mare, kata obedo ni oyugno kamano. Gingʼeny moloyo dede, ok nyal kwan-gi.
english: They will cut down her forest,” says the LORD, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

kikuyu: Dhood Zebulun noluwogi. Jatend dhood Zebulun ne en Eliab wuod Helon.
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: Otieno duto kane an e kitandana, ne amanyo ngʼat ma chunya ohero; ne amanye to ne ok ayude.
english: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

kikuyu: Kane owinjo ni en Yesu ja-Nazareth, nochako kok niya, “Yesu, Wuod Daudi, yie ikecha!”
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ onogo, Herode gi Pilato nobedo osiepe, to motelone odiechiengni ne gin wasigu.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ne onge chiemo e piny duto nikech kech ne ger; piny Misri kaachiel gi piny Kanaan nobedo gi dhier malich.
english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

kikuyu: Musa gi Harun kod oganda jo-Israel duto notimone jo-Lawi gigo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, kaw tawo mar nyinyo mondo ichungi kaka ohinga mar nyinyo e kindi gi dala, eka ilokri ichom wangʼi kuome. Ibiro gone agengʼa, to adwaro ni ipim kaka ibiro goyone agengʼa, kaka ranyisi ni dhood Israel.
english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Ibiro dak e piny Goshen kendo machiegni koda; ma en in gi nyithindi, nyikwayi, jambi, dhogi kod gik moko duto ma in-go.
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

kikuyu: Kanyo ema omanye chiembe kendo wengene nyalo nene gi kuma bor.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

kikuyu: Umor ka umonjo jo-Lo Debir ka upakoru niya, “Donge ne waloyo jo-Karnaim gi tekowa wawegi?”
english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’

kikuyu: Dwond Jehova Nyasaye yiengo piny motimo ongoro; Jehova Nyasaye yiengo ongoro mar Kadesh.
english: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

kikuyu: Houru chuny joga, hogiuru, Nyasachu wacho kamano.
english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

kikuyu: Hemba okethi; tonde mitweyego duto ochodi. Yawuota oweya kendo ok gin koda; onge ngʼama odongʼ manyalo gurona hemba kata gerona kambi.
english: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.

kikuyu: Luor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo mondo iluw chikene kod buchene ma amiyi kawuono.”
english: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

kikuyu: Ibiro madhe mi ilungʼe pep; ibiro goye piny motere matindo tindo, kendo obiro yiecho thundeni. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema osewacho kamano.
english: You will even drink it and drain it out. You will gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear your breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ne owiri kaka malaika ma jarit miluongo ni kerubi, nikech mano e gima ne achanoni, mondo ibedi. Ne idak e got maler mar Nyasaye; kendo ne iwuotho e kind kite maliet ka mach.
english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.

kikuyu: Pim chiemo moromo achiel kuom abich mar kilo mibiro chamo odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, kendo chiem mana kiluwo chenro mar chiemo miloso.
english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ochako wuoth dhi, ngʼat moro noringo obiro ire mogoyo chonge piny e nyime. Ngʼatni noloso kode kapenje niya, “Japuonj maber, en angʼo monego atim mondo eka ayud ngima mochwere kaka girkeni mara?”
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: ne en gi Oholiab wuod Ahisamak ma ja-dhood Dan ma jatich lwedo kendo jagoro kendo jatwangʼ lewni marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro.)
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

kikuyu: Donge nodonjo e od Nyasaye, kendo en kaachiel gi joma ne ni kode, negichamo makati ma nosepwodhi moket tenge, ma chik ne ok oyienegi mondo gitim, makmana jodolo kende
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

kikuyu: Nyithindu ne ok oneno gima Jehova Nyasaye notimonu e thim nyaka ne uchopo kama untiereni.
english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

kikuyu: “Ok ochiem e gode milame nyiseche mamoko kata rango nyiseche mag dhood Israel. Ok odwanyre gi chi nyawadgi
english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,

kikuyu: Masiche moluwore osemaki ma en kethruok kod tieki; kech kod ligangla, en ngʼa madihoyi kata duogo chunyi.
english: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?

kikuyu: “Yaye Israel, jogi moluor oriere piny konegi e gode maboyo. Mano kaka roteke osepodho.
english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ kendo lamuru mondo kik udonj e tem. Chuny oikore makmana ringruok ema nyap.”
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: To Paulo nowachone askechego niya, “Ne gichwadowa e lela ka ok gikwongo giyalowa, mi giterowa e od twech kata obedo ni wan jo-Rumi. To koro sani gidwaro golowa e od twech nangʼo lingʼ-lingʼ? Ooyo, gibi abiya mondo gin giwegi ema gigolwa.”
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

kikuyu: Gin oganda maonge rieko, kendo gionge paro mar fwenyo gimoro.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

kikuyu: nyaka chop abi mi ateru e piny machal gi pinyu, ma en piny machiego cham gi divai manyien, piny mopongʼ gi makati kod mzabibu.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

kikuyu: Azmaveth wuod Adiel ne jarit kuonde keno mar ruoth. Jonathan wuod Uzia ne rito kuonde mag keno mag gwenge molwore, e mier madongo kod matindo, kendo e miech lweny mochiel gi ohinga.
english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

kikuyu: e kaka an bende osemiya dweche maonge ohala kod otieno mopongʼ gi chandruok.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

kikuyu: kendo noyie chutho ni Nyasaye ne niginyalo mar timo gima nosesingore ni notim.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

kikuyu: (Noyudo ka Farao ruodh Misri nosekedo mokawo Gezer. Nowangʼe monego jo-Kanaan mane odakie momiye kaka mich mar arus ni nyare mane chi Solomon.
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

kikuyu: Negiwalo dala maduongʼno ni Jehova Nyasaye ma giketho gimoro amora kendo ginego gi ligangla ngʼato angʼata madichwo kata madhako, jomatindo kata joma oti, dhok gi rombe kod punde.
english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Saulo gi jo-Israel to nochokore mine gibworo e Holo mar Ela kendo negichanore mondo girad gi jo-Filistia.
english: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maratego e dieru nodok manyap, kendo tekone nowuog mana ka pilni, kendo gigo duto nowangʼ pep maonge ngʼama nyalo nego majno.
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

kikuyu: Eka Joshua noluongo jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Kawuono abiro tingʼi malo e wangʼ jo-Israel duto, eka ginyalo ngʼeyo ni An kodi mana kaka ne an gi Musa.
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar nyasi ruodhwa yawuot ruoth madho divai mamer, mi riw lwetgi gi jo-ajara.
english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

kikuyu: Ka imiyogi chiemo, to gichamo; ka iyawonegi lweti, to giyiengʼ gi gik mabeyo;
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kikuyu: To koro Adonija osebedo ruoth, kendo in, ruodha ok ingʼeyo.
english: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

kikuyu: “Dwondgi chalo liete mapok oum; lewgi olony e wacho miriambo.” “Kwiri mar thuond fu ni e lewgi.”
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

kikuyu: Norieyo lwete mondo okaw sigingi mar hema, ka lwete korachwich nokawogo twor. Nogoyo Sisera, motoyo wiye, kendo nopowo lela wangʼe.
english: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.

kikuyu: Omiyo Harun norieyo lwete ewi pige mag Misri, kendo ogwende nowuok mopongʼo pinyno.
english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼama oyie moro odak gi mon ma chwogi otho e dalane, onego okonygi en owuon mondo kik kanisa bed gi tingʼ mapek mar ritogi, eka kanisa okony mon ma chwogi otho mamoko man kendgi chuth maonge ngʼama nyalo konyogi.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Mano e yo ma wangʼeyogo ni wachungʼ e adiera, kendo mabiro miyo chunywa bed gi chir e nyim Nyasaye
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

kikuyu: Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon noyiero Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan mondo otel ne ji mane odongʼ Juda.
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

kikuyu: Ibneia wuod Jeroham; Ela wuod Uzi, wuod Mikri kod Meshulam wuod Shefatia, wuod Reuel, wuod Ibnija.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: Yawuot Reuel ne gin: Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

kikuyu: Raparni biro bedonu kaka ranyisi e lwetu kendo e lela wangʼu ni chik Jehova Nyasaye nyaka bed e dhou kinde duto, Jehova Nyasaye nogolou e piny Misri gi lwete maratego.
english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the LORD has brought you out of Egypt.

kikuyu: To koro awuoyo kodu un joma ok jo-Yahudi. Kaka an Jaote ne joma ok jo-Yahudi, amiyo tichna duongʼ,
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

kikuyu: Koro ka atimo gima ok adwar timo, to koro an ok ema atime, to richo modak e iya ema time.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Ka un, ma un joricho kamano, ungʼeyo miyo mich mabeyo ne nyithindu, koro Wuonu manie polo donge nyalo chiwo Roho Maler ne joma okwaye.”
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

kikuyu: Kosewacho kamano to nokawo nyathi matin mokete ochungʼ e nyim ji duto. Nomako lwet nyathino, kowachonegi niya,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

kikuyu: Solomon wuod Daudi nogurore motegno e pinye nikech Jehova Nyasaye Nyasache ne ni kode kendo ne okete obedo ngʼama duongʼ miwuoro.
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

kikuyu: Jaricho ywayogi ka makogi gi olowu, kendo omakogi gi gogo, kochokogi gi obadho mochiko, kendo obedo mamor kuom lupo.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

kikuyu: Chiwuru luor mowinjore ne ji duto. Heruru jowete duto mowar. Luoruru Nyasaye. Miuru ruoth mar piny luor.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

kikuyu: to gin negichungʼ kar tiendgi e dier puodhono ka girite kendo ginego jo-Filistia mi Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi loch maduongʼ.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

kikuyu: Ka kamano, to angʼo momiyo ka un gi wach e dieru, to uyiero jongʼad bura ma jopiny ma kwan-gi onge ei kanisa.
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

kikuyu: Yangʼuru nyiromb Pasaka kendo pwodhreuru mondo ukony joweteu timo gima Jehova Nyasaye nochiko gi dho Musa mondo utim.”
english: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the LORD’s word by Moses.”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Abimelek e lek gotieno kendo owachone niya, “Dine ber ka itho nikech dhako ma ikawono; en chi ngʼato.”
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Kane janabi Nathan obiro ire bangʼ ka Daudi noseterore gi Bathsheba. Kecha, yaye Nyasaye, kaluwore gi herani ma ok rem; gol kethona duto oko kuom ngʼwononi maduongʼ.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

kikuyu: kod un gode gi thuche gi yiende manyago olembe gi yiende mag sida duto;
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

kikuyu: Darius noneno ni en gima ber mondo oyier jotelo mia achiel gi piero ariyo mondo okonye rito pinyruodhe duto.
english: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

kikuyu: E kindeno ne akwayo Jehova Nyasaye niya,
english: I begged GOD at that time, saying,

kikuyu: to uwe nyiri duto mapok ongʼeyo chwo.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

kikuyu: Yesu norieyo bade momulo ngʼatno. Nowachone niya, “Ayie. Pwodhri!” Gikanyono dhoho noa kuome.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uloro pinyruodh polo mondo kik ji odonje. Un uwegi ok udonji, to joma temo mondo odonji bende ugengʼonegi. [
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kuno, negichoko kanisa kaachiel mi ginyisogi gik moko duto ma Nyasaye nosetimo ka otiyo kodgi, kendo kaka noseyawo dhoot mar yie mondo joma ok jo-Yahudi oyud warruok.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne okaw ngʼato moro moa e dhood joka ruoth kendo noloso kode winjruok e yor kwongʼruok. Nomako bende joma idewo mag pinyno mi odhigo,
english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

kikuyu: Chwouru adiera ne un uwegi, kaa-uru olemo mar hera ma ok rum, kendo baruru lopu mapok opur, nimar en kinde mar manyo Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka chop ool tim makare kuomu.
english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Gideon niya, “Kuom ji mia adek mane ogado pi gi lwetgi, anaresu kendo achiw jo-Midian e lwetu. We ji mamoko odhi, ka moro ka moro dok dalane.”
english: The LORD said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”
