kikuyu: To kane owinjo kuom jatend jolweny ni ne en kamano, nochiwo ringre Yesu ne Josef.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

kikuyu: Nodhi kuno mondo okwane kod Maria, mane osingore mondo okendi, kendo nogeno yudo nyathi.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

kikuyu: Nikech chandruok mwayudo matindo kendo makadho piyo biro kelonwa duongʼ mosiko kendo moloyo chandruogego duto.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

kikuyu: Ne gitemo mana mar bwogowa, kagiwacho niya, “Lwetgi biro bedo mayom yom, kendo ok gibi tieko tijni.” To ne alemo niya, “Yie imi lweta obed gi teko koro.”
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

kikuyu: “Akwanora kaka ngʼat mogwedhi, Ruoth Agripa, kuom yudo thuolo mar chungʼ e nyimi kawuono, mondo awuo kuom weche duto ma jo-Yahudi osedonjonago.
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

kikuyu: oywak kogoyo koko e akerkeke mag yore motimo koko, owuoyo e dhorangeye mag mier madongo kopenjo niya,
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

kikuyu: Kane gisekalo Amfipoli gi Apolonia, ne gitundo Thesalonika, kuma ne nitie sinagogi moro mar jo-Yahudi.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne nigi jo-Juda. Negikawo piny gode, to ne ok ginyal riembo joma ne odak e piny pewe, nikech ne gin-gi geche mag chuma.
english: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

kikuyu: to ngʼeuru ni ligangla ma uluoro nomaku, kendo kech mabwogou noluu nyaka Misri, kendo kanyo ema unuthoe.
english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro, beduru gadieri kuom ma: Nonegu gi ligangla, kech kod masira kuma udwaro dhiye mondo udagie.”
english: Now therefore know certainly that you will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live.”

kikuyu: Ka awacho ne ngʼama timbene richo ni, ‘Yaye ngʼama rach, ibiro tho ma ok itony,’ to itamori wuoyo kode mondo igole e yorene maricho, to ngʼat ma timbene richono biro tho nikech richone, to anaket rembe e wiyi.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jotich jadolo maduongʼ mane en wat ngʼat mane Petro ongʼado ite cha, nochome tir, kapenje niya, “Donge nende aneni kode e puoth Zeituni?”
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

kikuyu: Eka Esau notingʼo wangʼe malo moneno mon kod nyithindo. Nopenjo niya, “Magi gin ngʼa gini man kodigi?” Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Gin nyithindo ma Nyasaye osemiyo jatichni kuom ngʼwonone.”
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

kikuyu: To Uria nonindo e dhorangach mar dala gi jotich mamoko mag ruoth to ne ok olor odhi e ode.
english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

kikuyu: Israel duto biro ywage mi ike. En kende e jaka Jeroboam mibiro iki, nikech en kende ema en e od Jeroboam ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel oseyudoe gimoro maber.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

kikuyu: Eka Petro noparo wach mane oyudo Yesu osewachone niya, “Kapok thuon gweno okok, to wangʼ inikweda nyadidek.” To nowuok odhiyo oko kendo noywak malit.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Okange mag ngʼato ichiko gi Jehova Nyasaye. Ere kaka ngʼato nyalo ngʼeyo yore owuon?
english: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

kikuyu: Abiro wer ne Jehova Nyasaye, nikech osebedo ka otimona maber.
english: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano oganda noyweyo chiengʼ mar abiriyo.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni e limbena mokwongo tuo mane atuogo ema nomiyo ayudo thuolo mar yalonu Injili.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

kikuyu: Magi e ruodhi mane orito piny Edom kane jo-Israel ne pod onge kod ruodhi:
english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ok ginichak giger udi kae to jomoko nono ema dakie, kata pidho cham to jomoko nono ema biro chamo. Mana kaka yath dak amingʼa, e kaka joga nodagi, joga mayiero none mor kuom gik ma lwetgi oseloso.
english: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.

kikuyu: Ruoth nomiyo giwangʼo lowo mane gisechweyo e paw Jordan man e kind Sukoth gi Zarethan.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

kikuyu: Joshua wuod Nun, mane jakony Musa chakre tin-ne, nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ruodha, kwergi!”
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

kikuyu: Nochako oketo kido machielo, mopimo kama borne oromo fut alufu achiel gi mia abich, kendo notelona ka ayoro pi kama tutne ne chopo ewi chonga. Nochako opimo kama machielo, ma borne romo fut alufu achiel gi mia abich kendo notelona ka ayoro pi kama tutne ne chopo e nungona.
english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

kikuyu: Kane Musa owinjo wachno, noringo odhi Midian, kama nodakie kaka japiny moro mi onywolo yawuowi ariyo.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

kikuyu: Kane thoo omako kambi gotieno, to manna bende ne lwar piny.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

kikuyu: Gin guogi ma dhogi mit kendo ok giyiengʼ. Gin jokwath maonge winjo; giduto gibaro ka giluwo yoregi giwegi, kendo moro ka moro dwaro gima kelone ohala ne en owuon.
english: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

kikuyu: thuondi maroteke kod jolweny, gi jongʼad bura gi jonabi gi jokor wach kod jodongo,
english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ duto odwaro mangʼeny, to ngʼat makare chiwo maonge giko.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

kikuyu: Joshua nokawogi koa Kadesh Barnea nyaka Gaza kendo koa e gwenge duto ma Goshen nyaka Gibeon.
english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne yawuot Abihail wuod Huri, ma wuod Jaroa, wuod Gilead, wuod Mikael, wuod Jeshishai, wuod Jado, wuod Buz.
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

kikuyu: Roho mar Nyasaye ema nochweya, kendo Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema miya ngima.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

kikuyu: Ne adhawonegi mi akwongʼogi. Ne agoyo chwo moko mi apudho yie wigi. Ne aketogi gikwongʼore e nying Nyasaye mi giwacho niya, “Kik uwe nyiu kend gi yawuotgi, kata nyigi bende kik kend gi yawuotu, to un bende kik ukend nyigi.
english: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

kikuyu: Kane gisekelo jootego, negiterogi e nyim jobuch Sanhedrin mondo jadolo maduongʼ onon-giane.
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

kikuyu: To malaika nowachonegi niya, “Kik uluor. Akelonu wach maber mar mor maduongʼ mabiro bedo ni ji duto.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

kikuyu: Kamano bende dhako malemo kata makoro e chokruok, ka ok otweyo kitamba okuodo wi chwore, nikech onge pogruok e kinde gi dhako moliel yie wiye.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi nowuok e gode mag Efraim, ogandagi nodak Amalek, kendo joma noa Benjamin noluwo bangʼu. Jotend lweny noa Makir nobiro, kendo joma noa Zebulun notingʼo ludh jatend lweny.
english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.

kikuyu: Maua osechako thiewo e puothe; kinde mag wer osechopo, ndalo ma akuch oduglani werie mamit koro winjore e gwengʼwa.
english: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

kikuyu: kendo mana ka liet manie piny motimo ongoro. Isetieko koko mar jopinje mamoko mana kaka tipo mar bor polo gengʼo liet, e kaka wend jonjore osechung.
english: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Farisai nokwede kagiwacho niya, “Itimo mana nendi iwuon, omiyo ok wanyal yie ni gik miwacho gin adier.”
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

kikuyu: Ji biro wachonu ni, ‘En kucha!’ Kata ni, ‘En ka!’ Kik uring udhi bangʼ-gi.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

kikuyu: To ne ok gichiko itgi kata winja; ne ok gilokore gia e timbegi mamono kata weyo wangʼo ubani ne nyiseche manono.
english: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.

kikuyu: Chiwo duto mowal ma jo-Israel kelo gin mek jadolo.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nondiko gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osewachone. Kinyne gokinyi ne ochiewo mi ogero kendo mar misango e tiend got kendo ochungo kite apar gariyo mochungʼ kar ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel.
english: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Miaha en mar wuon kisera. Jachungʼ mar wuon kisera nyaka chik ite ne wuon kisera kendo winje; opongʼ gi mor kowinjo dwond wuon kisera kawuoyo. An ema an gi mor machal kamano, kendo mornano koro oromo chuth.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

kikuyu: Emomiyo nyise ni aloso singruok mar kwe kode.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

kikuyu: Kendo nokwongʼore gi nying Jal mangima nyaka chiengʼ, Jal mane ochweyo polo gik moko duto manie iye, gi piny gi gik moko duto manie iye, kod nam gi gik moko duto manie iye kowacho niya, “Deko moro ok nochak obedie ngangʼ!”
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne thuol niya, “Nikech isetimo ma, “Okwongʼi moloyo le duto kendo gige buya duto! Ibiro lak gi bund iyi kendo ibiro chamo buru, ndalo duto mag ngimani.
english: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ji mathoth manowuok e piny Efraim gi Manase gi Isakar kod Zebulun ne ok opwodhore, to kata kamano negichamo Pasaka ka ok giluwo gima nondiki. To Hezekia nolamonigi kawacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye mangʼwon owene ngʼato angʼata,
english: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good LORD pardon everyone

kikuyu: Kendo kane atiyo e dieru, to ne ok amiyo ngʼato angʼata tingʼ mapek e kinde mane an gi dwaro moro amora, nikech owete moa Makedonia nokelona gik moko duto mag konyruok mane achando. Asetemo matek mondo kik amiu tingʼ mapek e yo moro amora, kendo pod abiro medo timo kamano.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

kikuyu: Ne en gima kare mondo Nyasaye manochweyo kendo morito gik moko duto oket jachak warruok margi kare chuth e yor sandruok, mondo eka okel nyithi Nyasaye duto oyud pok mar duongʼne.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

kikuyu: To mo moko manie pat lwete, nowir kuonde mane oseminie remb misango mar pwodhruok e ketho kaka dho it ma korachwich mar ngʼama ipwodhono gi lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich, kod lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Chi Gilead mahie bende nonywolone yawuowi, kendo kane gisebedo madongo, ne giriembo Jeftha. Negiwachone niya, “Ok iniyud girkeni moro amora e dalawa ka, nikech in wuod dhako machielo.”
english: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”

kikuyu: “Gigi duto asenyisou kapod an kodu.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Bi ira, in kaachiel gi Harun, Nadab, Abihu kod jodongo piero abiriyo mag Israel. Un to unudongʼ kulemo mochwalore matin,
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

kikuyu: Jongʼad bura nyaka non wachno malongʼo, to ka janeno oyud ni ja-miriambo kochiwo neno maonge adier ewi owadgi,
english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

kikuyu: Aonge gi ngʼato machielo machal kode, ma oikore konyou gi chunye duto e chandruok moro amora ma un-go.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jogo duto matim makwerogo noyud e ngimagi, ginto nyaka golgi oko ei ogandagi.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

kikuyu: Ogendini biro keto genogi e nyinge.”
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo jotend migepe mag jolweny mia achiel tonge kod kuodi kod okumba mano mane mag Ruoth Daudi mane nitie e hekalu mar Nyasaye.
english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼato angʼata mochiemo kendo ometho, ma ok odewo ni gin ringre Ruoth, kelo bura kuome owuon.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

kikuyu: “Bende isewinjo ngero ma ji osiko kawacho e piny Israel niya, “ ‘Wuone osechamo olemo manumu, to nyithindo ema lekegi tho?’
english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ kendo ritreuru, nikech ok ungʼeyo sa manotimre.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

kikuyu: to gokinyi to uwacho ni, ‘Kodh yamo maduongʼ wangʼ nochwe nikech polo mamarmar kendo dudo.’ Ulony kuom rango chal mar polo, to ok unyal ngʼeyo ranyisi mag kit ndalo.
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

kikuyu: “Jowadwa, aneno ni ka wawuok ka, to wuodhwani biro bedo marach kendo yiewani kaachiel gi gik motingʼo biro kethore kendo wan bende wanyalo tho.”
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

kikuyu: Oseywayo atungʼe mar kedo gi joge mana ka gima gin wasike. Kaka jasigu neko, osenego jogo duto mane nenore mabeyo e wangʼ, kendo oseolo mirimbe oko ka mach kuom hemb Nyar Sayun.
english: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.

kikuyu: Magi e jotend dhoudi kod jogo mane obiro koda koa Babulon e kinde loch Ruoth Artaksases:
english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

kikuyu: Nyasaye nodwoko Solomon niya, “Nikech ma e gima chunyi dwaro kendo ne ok ikwaya mwandu kata duongʼ kata pak, kata tho mar wasiki, kata kwayo mondo idag amingʼa, to isekwayo rieko kod ngʼeyo kaka dirit ogandana ma aseketi ibedo e ruoth,
english: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka nonre mokwongo, kapok ochamo makati kata ometho e kikombe.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

kikuyu: Kata mana sani ngʼat ma keyo ichulo pokne, kendo ochoko olembe mochiek ne ngima mochwere, mondo omi jachwoyo, kaachiel gi jakeyo, obed mamor kanyakla.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

kikuyu: eka dine awuoyo ka ok aluore, to kaka weche chal sani, ok anyal timo kamano.”
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

kikuyu: Nonyis jo-Gaza niya, “Samson nitiere kae!” Omiyo negilworo kanyo kendo gibuto ka girite otieno duto e dhoranga dala maduongʼ. Ne ok gisudo otienono, kagiwacho niya, “Kochopo kogwen to wabiro nege.”
english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne okelonigi ruodh jo-Babulon mane onego yawuotgi matindo gi ligangla e kama ler mar lemo kendo ne ok okecho wuowi kata nyako, ngʼat motegno kata jaduongʼ moti. Nyasaye nochiwogi duto e lwet Nebukadneza.
english: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adongʼ kenda, ka angʼiyo fweny maduongʼni; tekra norumo, lela wangʼa notwo ka gima atho, kendo nanyosora marumo.
english: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.

kikuyu: Kane onyiso wuon-gi kaachiel gi owetene, wuon-gi nokwede kendo owachone niya, “Ma en lek manade manyoro ilekoni? Iparo ni minu kod an kod oweteni nyalo biro kuloreni mondo omiyi duongʼ?”
english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

kikuyu: To Yesu nolingʼ alingʼa kendo ma ok odwoke, mi Pilato nohum nono.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

kikuyu: Kik uketh tich hekaluni mar Nyasaye. We jatend jo-Yahudi kod jodong jo-Yahudi oger od Nyasaye e kare.
english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

kikuyu: Kik ipar richo mane atimo kapod an rawere kod yorena mobam; para kaluwore gi herani, nikech iber, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

kikuyu: Ne gitemo Nyasaye ka gingʼeyo, kuom kete mondo omigi chiemo mane gigombo.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Ogendinigi wacho ni, ‘Kinde pok ochopo monego gerne Nyasaye hekalu mare.’ ”
english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”

kikuyu: Ma e chenro mar tienge nyikwa Adam. Ka Nyasaye nochweyo dhano, nochweye e kite owuon.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

kikuyu: Neuru, en gach Solomon, kikowe gi jolweny piero auchiel, ma gin jo-Israel maroteke,
english: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Dan, ne en Amiel wuod Gemali;
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

kikuyu: Bende negiloso bethene molwore ma lachne romo gi pat lwedo achiel kendo ne gichweyo bethenego gi dhahabu.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

kikuyu: Koro Hiram ruodh Turo nooro joote ir Daudi ka gitingʼo sirni mag yiend sida, kaachiel gi jogedo mag kite kod jopa bao mondo gigerne dala ruoth.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

kikuyu: Muofni gi rongʼonde nobiro ire e hekalu kendo nochangogi.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

kikuyu: Kuom nyiseche duto mag pinjegi, en mane mosereso pinye e lweta? To koro ere kaka uparo ni Jehova Nyasaye nyalo reso Jerusalem e lweta?”
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

kikuyu: Bende alamonu mondo chunyu maiye oyawre mondo ungʼe tiend geno ma oseluongoue, ma gin girkeni mogundho mokano ni joma oyie,
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

kikuyu: Magi e chike mane Jehova Nyasaye owachone chokruok gi dwol maduongʼ e got koa e mach, rumbi kod mudho mandiwa kendo ne ok omedo gimoro. Eka ne ondikogi e kite ariyo mopa mi omiyagi.
english: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

kikuyu: Joritou chalo det bonyo, jotendu to chalo gi det bonyo mochokore mathoth kabiro, kendo piyo e kor ot ka piny ngʼich, to ka chiengʼ owuok to gihuyo gidhi kuma mabor maonge ngʼama ongʼeyo.
english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike, mi nonego jo-Filistia kochakore Gibeon nyaka Gezer.
english: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osechiwona kaluwore gi timna makare, osechiwona kaluwore gi ler mar lwetena e nyime.
english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kikuyu: kendo noneno dhok abiriyo mabeyo machwe kawuok ei aora kakwayo e kind odundu.
english: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

kikuyu: Koro ngʼato ok nochak opuonj jabathe, kata nyawadgi kowacho ni, ‘Ngʼe Jehova Nyasaye,’ nikech giduto giningʼeya, kochakore ngʼat matinie moloyo nyaka ngʼat maduongʼie moloyo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Nimar anawenegi timbegi maricho kendo ok anachak apar richogi kendo.”
english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says the LORD, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”

kikuyu: Napenjo niya, “En angʼo?” To nodwoka niya, “En atonga mar pimo mopongʼ gi richo mag ji e piny ngima.”
english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Gideon wuod Joash noduogo koa e lweny koluwo yor Heres.
english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mochwere manyaka chiengʼ. Ji duto mondo owach niya, “Amin!” Opak Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: An Paulo, ma jatich Nyasaye kendo ma jaote Yesu Kristo ema andikonu baruwani. Nyasaye ne oora mondo ajiw yie mar joma Nyasaye oyiero obed motegno, kendo mondo apuonjgi adiera mamiyo giluoro Nyasaye,
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: mamiyo iyudo rieko kod ritruok makare, kendo winjo tiend weche matut;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

kikuyu: Nomiyogi chik machal kama: “Kik utingʼ gimoro ka udhi e wuoth makmana ludh wuoth. Makati, kata ofuku kata pesa mikano e ofuku kik utingʼ.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

kikuyu: To jogi wigi wil mar oyiem ni chon gi lala wach Nyasaye nomiyo polo obedo kendo piny ne ochwe koa kuom pi kendo pi ema nochweyego.
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

kikuyu: Ka cham osechiek to gikanyono wuon puodho kawo pand keyo mondo okayego.”
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

kikuyu: Kony Solomon wuoda osik kogeno kuomi gi chunye duto mondo orit chikeni gi dwaroni kod gima iwacho kendo mondo otim gik moko duto kaluwore gi chenro mar gedo malichni ma asechiworane.”
english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

kikuyu: Kiwinjo ka wi omburi yiengni, iwuog mapiyo nikech mano biro nyiso ni Jehova Nyasaye osetelo e nyimi mondo otiek jolweny mag jo-Filistia.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: To ka nyar jadolo chwore otho, kata ka owere gi chwore kapok onywol mi odok dalagi mondo odag kanyo ka nyako mapok okendi, to oyiene chamo chiemb wuon mare. Makmana ni ngʼat ma ok jadolo, to kik cham chiemono.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “To donge Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ni kodu? To donge osemiyou kwe e alworau duto? Nimar osechiwo joma odak e pinyni e lweta ma pinyni koro nitie e bwo loch Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi joge.
english: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo timbeni gi tichni matek kod kinda mari. Angʼeyo ni isetiyo matek kendo isetimo kinda. Angʼeyo ni imon gi joma timo timbe mamono. Angʼeyo ni isetemo joma luongore ni joote, to ok gin joote, ma iyudo ni gin jo-miriambo.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

kikuyu: “Aseketi rapim mipimogo chumbe to joga kama ikunye chumbe, mondo mi ingʼi kendo ipim yoregi.
english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

kikuyu: Kane wachopo Makedonia, ne ok wayudo thuolo mar yweyo. Ne wayudo chandruok mathoth ka wasigu olworowa koni gi koni; ka chunywa bende opongʼ gi luoro.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

kikuyu: An atimo nenda awuon, to ngʼama chielo matimo nenda en Wuoro mane oora.”
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

kikuyu: Nikech chikegi gin taya, to puonjni en ler, kendo kwer mikwerogo ngʼato kuom gima otimo marach kelo mana ngima,
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

kikuyu: Negiwuok Jotbatha mi gibworo Abrona.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

kikuyu: Gima kamano notimore nyadidek, eka sukano nokaw modwoki e polo kendo.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

kikuyu: To anakum piny ma noketgi wasumbini, bangʼe giniwuogi gia e pinyno mi gibi gilama kae.’
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

kikuyu: Ere oganda machal gi jogi Israel? Bende nitiere oganda moro mane Nyasache osedhi moreso ka gin wasumbini milokogi jogi? Donge isemiyo nyingi duongʼ kuom timbe madongo kendo malich, nimar iseriembo ogendini mamoko e nyim jogi mane ireso kigolo Misri?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko wuod dhakoni ma wuon odno ne tuo, nomedo bedo marach ahinya to bangʼe notho.
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno ringo tony nikech en mana jatich kendo ngima rombe ok obadhe.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

kikuyu: Nikech Kristo ne ok oora mondo abatis ji, to noora mondo ayal Injili, ok gi weche mamit mag rieko dhano, nono to dipo ka msalap Kristo obedo tekone.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

kikuyu: Kane gibiro ir Yesu, negineno ngʼat ma yande jochiende mangʼeny sandono kobet piny kanyo korwakore maber kendo pache nikare mi luoro nomakogi.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: to ngʼama osekendo, to pache omoko e weche pinyni, kaka onyalo timo gik mamiyo chiege mor.
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Winj gima giwachoni kendo imigi ruoth.” Eka Samuel nowachone jo-Israel niya, “Koro ngʼato ka ngʼato odog e miechgi.”
english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed kodu un duto.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Negiloso sirni piero ariyo migerogo bath Hemb Romo mochomo yo milambo,
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

kikuyu: Eka Abner ne ooro joote mage moko ir Daudi mondo owach kama: “Mani en piny ngʼa? Los winjruok koda kendo abiro konyi kakelo Israel duto kuomi.”
english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

kikuyu: Azmaveth ja-Beharum, Eliaba ja-Shalbon,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

kikuyu: Kuom mano abiro kuodo wi joma tiyo ei hekalu mau, kendo abiro jwangʼo Jakobo mondo otieki, mi Israel yud wichkuot.”
english: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”

kikuyu: Paulo nosechano mondo okwangʼ kodhi ma ok oluwo Efeso, nikech ne ok odwar kawo thuolo malach e piny Asia. Nodwaro mondo ochop Jerusalem piyo, kapok chiengʼ Pentekost ochopo.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

kikuyu: Dhialuru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kendo lameuru, e tiend kome mobetie nikech oler.
english: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Magi e joge mane tiyo ne ruoth ka ok okwan jolweny mane oketo e mier madongo mochiel motegno gohinga e piny Juda duto.
english: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

kikuyu: To jonabi mag miriambo bende ne nitie e kind oganda Nyasaye e ndalo machon, mana kaka jopuonj mag miriambo bende biro bedo e dieru. Gibiro kelonu puonj mag miriambo lingʼ-lingʼ mondo giketh ji, ka gikwedo nyaka Ruoth Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto mane owarogi kendo mano nomi gitiekre kendgi piyo piyo nono!
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

kikuyu: Ruodh Libna, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Adulam, ngʼato achiel
english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye noyangre maler mi jo-Misri ngʼeye, kendo e kindeno giniyie kuom Jehova Nyasaye. Gibiro lame ka gitimone misengini kod chiwo mag cham; ka gisingore ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo gichopo singruokno.
english: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nyalo bedo ni oa e twech kata odhier, to bangʼe obedo ruoth e pinygi.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka Naomi noduogo koa Moab, ka Ruth nyar Moab, ma chi wuode, ni kode. Negichopo Bethlehem ka kinde mikaye shairi chakore.
english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

kikuyu: Joricho man Sayun, kihondko osemako; kibaji ogoyo joma okia nyasaye, mi gisepenjore kendgi niya, “En ngʼa kuomwa manyalo dak kod mach mawengʼo magerni? Koso en ngʼa kuomwa manyalo dak kod mach maliel maonge gikone?”
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

kikuyu: Ne gingʼulo kuome olawo kendo negikawo odundu gigoyogo wiye anwoya anwoya.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

kikuyu: In Nyar Babulon Mangili bed piny e buru; bed piny e lowo kionge loch in nyar jo-Babulon. Ok nochak oluongi ni nyako ma dende yom kendo ma jaber.
english: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.

kikuyu: Waluonguru Jehova Nyasaye; wadhiuru nyime gi luongo nyinge. Mana kaka chiengʼ wuok, e kaka obiro wuok; enobi irwa mana ka kodh chwiri, mana ka koth mabiro bangʼ chwiri mamiyo lowo bedo mangʼich.”
english: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

kikuyu: Ji duto mane odongʼ e pinyno koa kuom jo-Amor gi jo-Hiti kod jo-Perizi gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus (ogendinigi ne ok jo-Israel),
english: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

kikuyu: “Kuom mano abiro kawo chamba ka osechiek, gi divaina manyien ka oseikore. Bende anakaw yie rombona gi pambana mitwangʼo godo lewni mane onego oum-go duge.
english: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

kikuyu: kendo ngʼato angʼata madwaro bedo ngʼat mokwongo nyaka bed misumba ji duto.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

kikuyu: To ngʼat machiemo ka nigi kiawa e chunye bura oloyo kapo ochiemo nikech ok ochiem kuom yie; to gik moko duto motim ka ok oa kuom yie en richo.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye biro maye mwandune mi oketh tekone ma en-go e nam, kendo ibiro tieke gi mach.
english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

kikuyu: Negie kaka luoro dwaro negogi, nikech Nyasaye nitie e chokruok mar joma kare.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

kikuyu: nowachonegi niya, “Kauru jotich ruoth kodu kendo keturu Solomon wuoda e punda awuon kendo tereuru Gihon.
english: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

kikuyu: Goyo ombulu tieko larruok kendo thego joma roteke.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

kikuyu: Wuod Ethan ne en: Azaria.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

kikuyu: Timbe Josia ne longʼo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kendo nowuotho e yore duto mag Daudi kwar-gi ma ok olokore kongʼiyo korachwich kata koracham.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: to e higa mar abiriyo weuru puothe onind ma ok opur kendo ma ok okomie cham. Eka joma odhier mantie e kind jou nyalo yudo chiemo, kendo le mag thim nyalo chamo gima giweyo. Timuru kamano bende ne puotheu mag mzabibu kod zeituni.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

kikuyu: kendo mowachonegi niya, “Angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou pinyni kendo mano osemiyo luoro omako ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa, omiyo joma odak e pinyni kihondko osemako nikech un.
english: She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

kikuyu: Jokim, jo-Kozeba kod Joash gi Saraf mane jatend Moab kod Jashubi Leham. Weche mondikgi noyud koa e kitepe mag ndalo machon.
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

kikuyu: Or mil polo, mondo ike wasigu; dir aserni magi, mondo itiekgi.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

kikuyu: E nyim udi mag joritogo moro ka moro, ne nitie ohinga moro machiek ma borne kadhi malo noromo fut achiel gi nus, to udigo, moro ka moro, ne romre e borgi gi lachgi, fut ochiko ochiko.
english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

kikuyu: Bangʼe anami pigene chak dok maler kendo anami aorene mol mayom, maonge gima gengʼe. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.’
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Rie badi kochomo polo mondo mudho olandre e piny Misri; ma en mudho mandiwa.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

kikuyu: Nikech aserni magi osechwoya, kendo lweti osebet kuoma.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

kikuyu: Bangʼ winjo mano, nobatisgi e nying Ruoth Yesu.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: koa e nyikwa Uziel, ne gin ji mia achiel gi apar gariyo kotelnegi gi Aminadab.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: to koro ngʼeuru chuth ni mae e kaka abiro timonu: Anapou gi masira kod tho marach, gi tuo mayuyo wangʼ gi tuo mamiyo del dhe. Cham ma upidho ok nokonyu kata matin nikech jowasiku ema nochamgi.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

kikuyu: to pe manie wi gode lokore oula kendo mogingore gi pi mamol,
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

kikuyu: E kindeno jo-Beth Shemesh ne kayo ngano e holo, kane gitingʼo wangʼ-gi malo mi gineno Sandug Muma, negimor ka ginene.
english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

kikuyu: Kane olor piny koa e bath got malo, oganda maduongʼ ne luwo bangʼe.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

kikuyu: to anywola Kiriath Jearim ne gin: jo-Ithri, jo-Puthi, jo-Shumath kod Mishrai. Kuomgi ema ne jo-Zorath gi jo-Eshtaol owuokie.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

kikuyu: Jarmuth kod En Ganim, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Donge uwacho ni, ‘Odongʼ dweche angʼwen to ndalo keyo chopo’? Awachonu ni utingʼ wengeu malo urang puothe! Gisechiek giromo keyo.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

kikuyu: Eka ne achako ariera piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno; ne ok achiemo kata modho pi, nikech richo duto mane utimo, ka utimo gik mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ka ujimbo mirimbe.
english: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni e ngʼado bura mar jadolo oneno ni kanyo olokore kendo yier maratengʼ oseti kanyo, to mano nyiso ni osechango. Ngʼatno osedoko maler kendo jadolo nolande ni oler.
english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: Kane abwonjo kodgi to ne amako dhogi; kendo ler mane rieny koa e lela wangʼa, ne morogi ahinya.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

kikuyu: Yesu nokwero Petro kowachone niya, “Dwok liganglani e olalo! Idwaro mona metho e okombe ma Wuora osemiya nangʼo?”
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

kikuyu: Iseketo richowa e nyimi, ee, richowa ma watimo lingʼ-lingʼ ineno seche duto.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Ma e kwongʼ madhi e piny duto; nikech mana kaka owacho e bathe konchiel, jokwoge duto ibiro negi kendo kaluwore gi gima owacho e bathe komachielo, joma kwongʼore gi miriambo, bende ibiro negi.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jo-Asuria ibiro tieki gi ligangla ma ok oa e lwet dhano; nimar ligangla ma ok oa e lwedo biro tiekogi. Giniring lweny nikech ligangla, mi yawuotgi ma jolweny nolokgi wasumbini maketgi e tij achuna.
english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: To kuom le duto mawuotho gi tiende angʼwen, mago mawuotho kanyono piny gi kokegi nobednu mogak, kendo ngʼato angʼata momulo ring-gi nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Anyisou ni dichwo moro amora moketho keny gi chiege, makmana ne wach chode, mi okendo dhako machielo, to otimo richo mar terruok.”
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Samaria kod ruodhige nolew gi malo mana ka bad yien malewo gi malo ewi pi.
english: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.

kikuyu: Iro nowuok e ume; mach mangʼangʼni nowuokie dhoge, mirni maliel maliet bende nowuok kuome.
english: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

kikuyu: Abiro pogou gi joma osiko kedo koda kendo ngʼanyona, kata obedo ni abiro gologi oko e piny ma gidake sani, to ok ginidonj e piny Israel. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: to nyakono nokel e dhood wuon mare kendo joma chwo ma gwengʼno nochiele gi kite motho, nikech otimo gima rach e kind jo-Israel kodoko jachode e od wuon. Tim marachno nyaka ugol e dieru.
english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nongʼeyo e chunye ni Nyasaye ne nyalo chiero joma otho, kendo chutho nodwokne Isaka mana ka ngʼat mosechier oa kuom joma otho.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane osiemo ni koth maduongʼ kod mor polo kama onego giluw,
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

kikuyu: Ojaber ka mwanda, kendo olongʼo ka nyakech, thundene mad romi kinde duto, mad herane omaki moloyo.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

kikuyu: Naomi ne nigi watne moro ma jadala gi chwore, mane wuok e anywola joka Elimelek, mane nyinge Boaz. Boaz ne en ngʼama idewo momi luor.
english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

kikuyu: Los ramaki mag dhahabu kod sirni abich mag yiend siala mobaw gi dhahabu. Bende ilosi rachungi mag mula abich ni sirnigo.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

kikuyu: Eliab wuod Helon, ma jatend jo-Zebulun nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar adek.
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Petro nokan e od twech, to kanisa to ne lamone Nyasaye ahinya.
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka uyie mondo aik ngʼata, to winjauru kendo ukwana Efron wuod Zohar
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

kikuyu: Emomiyo eri koro aoronu jonabi gi joma riek kod jopuonj. Moko kuomgi ubiro nego kendo ubiro guro; moko ubiro rodho e sinagokeu kendo ubiro lawogi e dala ka dala.
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

kikuyu: Nyaka ubedi e dho Hemb Romo odiechiengʼ gotieno kuom ndalo abiriyo ka utimo gima Jehova Nyasaye dwaro, mondo kik utho nikech mano e gima Jehova Nyasaye osechika mondo awachnu.”
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

kikuyu: “To kuom jadak ma ok achiel kuom jogi Israel moa e piny mabor nikech nyingi maduongʼ kendo lweti maratego kod badi marabora moriere, ka gibiro ma gilemo ka gichomo hekaluni,
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

kikuyu: Tukiko to aseoro Efeso.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

kikuyu: Los ludhe mag yiend siala ni kendo mar misangono kendo ibawgi gi mula.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

kikuyu: Nyithinde nobed joma roteke e piny; ee, koth joma ngimagi oriere tir ibiro gwedhi.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

kikuyu: Ok apando timni makare e chunya; to awuoyo kuom adierani gi warruokni. Ok apando herani gi adierani ni chokruok maduongʼ.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kikuyu: “Kapo ni asewuotho e yor miriambo kata ka tienda osereto kadhi wuondo ngʼato,
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

kikuyu: Timbe mahundu mar joricho biro terogi mabor magilal; nimar gidagi timo gima kare.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mar aboro kane kinde monego otere nyangu ochopo nomiye nying ni Yesu, nyingno mane malaika osemiye kapok omak ichne.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

kikuyu: Oganda nyaka res janekno kuom owad gi ngʼat monegi mi gidwoke e dala mar tony mane oringo odhiye. Enodag kanyo nyaka chop jadolo mane owir gi mo maler tho.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno ginirut kuome mana ka mor mar ataro. Kendo ka ngʼato ongʼiyo pinyno to none mudho gi kuyo; kata mana ler mar chiengʼ boche polo noum.
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

kikuyu: mondo kik ubed jo-mibadhi ka uloso nyisecheu uwegi, kata kido moro amora mochwe ka dichwo kata ka dhako,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

kikuyu: Abiro bedo ka sibuor ni Efraim, kaka sibuor malich ni Juda. Abiro kidhogi matindo tindo bangʼe to abiro weyogi. Anatingʼ-gi matergi mabor, maonge ngʼama nyalo resogi.
english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: “Kik ubed gi nyiseche mamoko e nyima.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

kikuyu: Nogoyo machiemo koni gi koni, kendo kane ok oneno ngʼato, nonego ja-Misrino mi oike ei kuoyo.
english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

kikuyu: Jotelo moko mag jo-Israel nobilo chiemb jogo ka ok gipenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from the LORD’s mouth.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nodwoke niya, “Donge wan kare ka wawacho ni in ja-Samaria kendo ni in gi jachien?”
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

kikuyu: Jakobo nochungo siro mar kidi kanyono mane Nyasaye owuoyoe kode, kendo noolo ewi sirono misango miolo piny bende noolo misango mar mo ewi siro.
english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

kikuyu: Donjuru e buche manie kind lwendni, ponduru e buche manie lowo ka luoro omakou nikech, duongʼ malich mar Jehova Nyasaye kod tekone!
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye noloko pache mine ok okelone joge masira mane osewacho.
english: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

kikuyu: Ka dwol mar joidh farese kod jo-asere owinji, to dala ka dala golo aputh njiri. Moko dhi e bunge modinore; moko idho dhi ewi lwendni. Mier duto ji odarie; onge ngʼama odak eigi.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka migepe ariyo mar jowergo nosedwoko erokamano ni Nyasaye; negikawo keregi e od Nyasaye, eka an bende kamano kaachiel gi nus mar jotelo,
english: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;

kikuyu: Gibiro ka giger ka jokedo; gilwenyo ohinga ka jolweny. Gipangore wangʼ achiel ka gichanore, ma ok gilok yorgi.
english: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.

kikuyu: nikech angʼeyo ni achiegni weyo kiruni mana kaka Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo osenyisa maler.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

kikuyu: Olembe mokwongo duto moa e puodho ma gikelone Jehova Nyasaye nobed mari. Ngʼato angʼata mantiere e odi mopwodhore maler nyalo chame.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

kikuyu: Eka chwo abich mane obiro nono piny Laish nowachone owetegi niya, “Bende ungʼeyo ni achiel kuom udigi nigi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, nyiseche moko manono, kod kido mobaw gi fedha mag nyiseche manono? Koro ungʼeyo gima onego utim.”
english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”

kikuyu: Aseyiero kendo pwodho hekaluni mondo nyinga obedie nyaka chiengʼ, wengena kod chunya nobed kanyo kinde duto.
english: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehoyada noketo jorit mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye e bwo jodolo mane gin jo-dhood Lawi mane Daudi omiyo tij hekalu mondo gichiw misengini miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye kaka ondikgi e Chik Musa ka gimor kod wer kaka Daudi ne ochikogi.
english: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the LORD’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in the LORD’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Zebulun, ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero auchiel gi mia abich (60,500).
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Keturu parruok duto ma un-go kuome nikech oparou.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

kikuyu: “Wuo kod jo-Israel kendo inyisgi kama: ‘Ka dichwo kata dhako dwaro chiwo singruok makende, ma en singruok makende ne Jehova Nyasaye kaka ja-Nazir,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

kikuyu: Koro wan maweseyie wadonjo e yweyono, mana kaka Nyasaye osewacho niya, “Omiyo mirima nomaka kodgi, mi nasingora ka akwongʼora ni, ‘Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.’ ” Nyasaye nowuoyo kama kata obedo ni nosetieko tije chon chakre kinde manochweyo piny.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Kaka Barak ne sudo machiegni, Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo Sisera, jolweny mage kod gechene gi kihondko kendo Sisera nojwangʼo gache mi oringo gi tiende.
english: The LORD confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni chon ne awuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye kendo ne asando joma oyie ka akwiny, to nokecha nikech natimo gigo kuom kia kendo kuom bedo maonge yie.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

kikuyu: ma gin jokor wach mag Israel mane okoro wach ni jo-Jerusalem kendo mane nenone fweny mag kwe, ka kwe mane ginenono to ne onge, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.” ’
english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Los ratege ariyo mag dhahabu kendo ichomgi e konde ariyo mamoko mag law akor gi yo ka iye e riak law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Ne joma osetimo kinda kuom timo maber, ka gidwaro duongʼ kod luor, kod gik ma ok tho, enomi ngima mochwere.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

kikuyu: nyaka chop aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

kikuyu: Nimar en kaachiel gi joma ne en-go duto nowuoro nikech rech mane gimako.
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

kikuyu: To gik moko duto mafuyo kod mago man-gi tiende angʼwen, nobednu gik makwero.
english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

kikuyu: Kane gikwaye, to nokelonegi aluru kendo noyiengʼogi gi makati mar polo.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

kikuyu: Yaye jarang ji-ni, kata bed ni asetimo richo, to en angʼo ma asetimoni? Angʼo momiyo an ema inena? Koso dibed ni asebedoni tingʼ mapek mohingi?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

kikuyu: Nying ngʼatno ne Elimelek, to nying chiege ne Naomi, kendo nying yawuote ariyogo ne gin Malon gi Kilion. Ne gin jo-Efrath moa Bethlehem e piny Juda. Kendo negidhi e piny Moab mi gidak kuno.
english: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni aonge richo kata achiel, to ok dadwoke; anyalo mana ywagora ne jangʼadna bura mondo okecha.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho kuom ute manie dala maduongʼni kod kuonde dak mar ruodh Juda ma osemuki mondo tigo kaka pidhe kod ligangla
english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:

kikuyu: Bende inyalo gol kuome bao malosgo gimoro minyalo tigo? Bende inyalo los kode gig mocho?
english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

kikuyu: bende igol lepe mane omakego. Bangʼ ka osedak e odi kuom dwe achiel koywago wuon gi min, eka idhi ire mondo ibed chwore kendo en bende obed chiegi.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

kikuyu: Ka ok uluwo chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mi ulokoru uweyo yore ma amiyou kawuono, kendo ka uluwo nyiseche mamoko ma ok usengʼeyo, to unuyud kwongʼ.
english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

kikuyu: Kendo Daudi nongʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osegure kaka ruodh Israel kendo osetingʼo pinyruodhe malo mana nikech joge Israel.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: jatend lweny morito ji piero abich gi joma ogen, jongʼad rieko, jopecho molony kod joma olony e wach.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

kikuyu: To kata kamano waikore mar manore gi gige lweny kendo dhi gi jo-Israel wetewa e piny mane osingnegi. To mokwongo nyaka wager ne mondwa gi nyithindwa mier madongo mochiel motegno mondo ogengʼ-gi kuom wasigu.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano biro oro malaikane, kendo gibiro golo gimoro amora manie pinyruodhe makelo richo kod ji duto matimo gik maricho.
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Joab gi jo-Kereth gi jo-Peleth kod jolweny mathuondi duto nowuok kotelnegi gi Abishai. Ne giwuok Jerusalem mondo gilaw Sheba wuod Bikri.
english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

kikuyu: Gimoro achiel ma Jehova Nyasaye onego ngʼwon-ne jatichne ema: Ruodha pod biro donjo e od Rimon nyasaye mondo olem kuno, koyiengore e bada. Obiro kulore e od Rimon kendo an bende abiro kulora kode, to Jehova Nyasaye mondo owena kuom timo kamano.”
english: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”

kikuyu: kawacho niya, “Donge ne idhi e od joma ok jo-Yahudi mi ichiemo kodgi.”
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ ok nobed lerni mar odiechiengʼ kata mana ler mar dwe ok nomenyi, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ema nobed ler mari kendo Nyasachi ema nobed duongʼ mari.
english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

kikuyu: Mano kaka inine malit, yaye Moab! Jo-Kemosh otieki; yawuoti oter e twech, kendo nyigi oket wasumbini.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

kikuyu: “Kik iyany Nyasaye kata kwongʼo jatend jou.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehoshafat ruodh Juda notimo winjruok kod Ahazia ruodh Israel manongʼadne bura nikech timbene maricho.
english: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.

kikuyu: Onge gimoro kata achiel, kuom gik moko duto mane Nyasaye ochweyo, mopondone. Gik moko duto oyawore kendo oelore e nyim tong wangʼ Jal ma wan duto, ngʼato ka ngʼato, nyaka wabi wachungʼ e nyime kwahulo gik moko duto ma wasetimo.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno noduoga nyaka e rangach ma oko mar kama ler mar lemo, mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ, kendo ne olore.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

kikuyu: Isaka notingʼo dwonde mopenjo wuon-gi Ibrahim niya, “Wuora?” Ibrahim nodwoke niya, “En angʼo wuoda?” Eka Isaka nopenje niya, “Mach kod yien nikae, to ere nyaim mar misango miwangʼo pep?”
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

kikuyu: Kendo nyikwayi moko mowuok e ringri kendo rembi iwuon noter e twech mi nolokgi wasumbini mabwoch e od ruoth mar ruodh Babulon.”
english: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

kikuyu: To ji nodagi winjo Samuel mi negiwacho niya, “Ngangʼ! Wan to wadwaro ruoth mondo oritwa.
english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

kikuyu: Ok osengʼeyo adier ni an ema ne amiye cham, divai manyien kod mo, an bende ema ne adhiale gi fedha gi dhahabu mangʼenygo mane gitiyo nego Baal.
english: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.

kikuyu: kata ka chiayo moro e piny kata ka winyo mafuyo e kor polo,
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

kikuyu: Jeremia nowachone Zedekia niya, “Ka adwoki, donge ibiro nega? Kata ka anangʼadni rieko, bende iniwinja.”
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”

kikuyu: Un duto ngʼato ka ngʼato useneno ma gi wangʼu koro weche manonogi to uwacho nangʼo?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

kikuyu: Dine anyise sigand ngimana kaka chalo; kendo dine adhi e nyime kaka ruoth.
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

kikuyu: nywok kaka misango mar golo richo;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: Wuoda, miya chunyi, kendo ket wengegi orit yorena,
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

kikuyu: Neni urito chiayogo nyaka odiechiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe, eka oganda jo-Israel duto noyangʼ-gi ka chiengʼ wuok.
english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

kikuyu: Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ, nimar Jehova Nyasaye en Jehova Nyasaye ma Lwanda nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

kikuyu: Yor adiera biro yudore kendo ne joma kare, kendo joma oriere gie chunygi biro luwe.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

kikuyu: Roho ema chiwo ngima; to dhano ok nyal gimoro. Weche ma asewachonu gin mag Roho kod ngima.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

kikuyu: Nikech mana kaka asebedo ka anyisou motelo kendo koro anyisou ka pi wangʼa chwer, ji mangʼeny ngimagi omiyo gibedo jowasik msalap Kristo.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

kikuyu: Donge ubiro mana kawo gima Kemosh ma nyasachu omiyou? Kamano bende, gimoro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa omiyowa, wabiro kawo.
english: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever the LORD our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.

kikuyu: to anangʼad Israel oko e piny ma asemiyogi kendo anakwed hekaluni ma asewalo ni Nyinga. Israel koro nobed mana wach ngero kendo gir achaya e kind ogendini duto.
english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

kikuyu: Gibiro loso nyasi mar ber ni mogundho kendo gibiro wer gi mor kuom timbeni makare.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

kikuyu: To ngʼat Nyasaye moro nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Ruoth momi luor, kik iyie mondo jolweny ma jo-Israel dhi kodi nimar Jehova Nyasaye ok ni kod jo-Israel ma jo-Efraim-gi.
english: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowuok oko mar rogo mi oluongo Saulo, “Ruodha ma ruoth!” Kane Saulo ongʼiyo chien, Daudi nokulore piny monindo auma ka wangʼe ochiko piny.
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

kikuyu: Miya monda kod nyithinda ma asebedo ka atiyonigo kendo weya adhi. Ingʼeyo tichna ma asetiyonigo.”
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

kikuyu: Eka Jonathan nomiyo wuowino gige mag lweny mowachone niya, “Dhiyo idwokgi dala.”
english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”

kikuyu: Neuru, odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye biro, en odiechiengʼ malich man-gi mirima kod kum mager, mabiro weyo piny gunda, kendo joricho manie iye.
english: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane odak e dala Efraim, kaluwore gi migepe mag-gi noromo ji alufu mia achiel gaboro gi mia achiel (108,100). Gin ema ne giwuok mar adek.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone Thoma niya, “Ket lith lweti kae kendo nee lwetena. Chor lweti kuoma bangʼe iketi e ngʼetna. We bedo ngʼama riwo gi kiawa, bed ngʼama nigi yie!”
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

kikuyu: Gima ingʼadogo otambi kod kama otambino betie nyaka los gi dhahabu maler.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

kikuyu: Ne odagi hembe mag Josef, bende ne ok oyiero dhood joka Efraim,
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

kikuyu: To ne wawachone ni, ‘Ok wanyal dhi. Wanyalo mana dhi ka owadwa matin dhi kodwa. Ok wanyal neno wangʼ ngʼatno makmana ka owadwa matin ni kodwa.’
english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro riti mondo gimoro amora kik ohinyi.
english: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

kikuyu: Kata kamano mise mongirore mar Nyasaye ochungʼ motegno kendo ondikie ndiko ma ok ruchre mawacho niya, “Ruoth ongʼeyo joge,” kendo niya, “Ngʼato ka ngʼato maluongo nying Ruoth nyaka pogre gi timbe maricho.”
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

kikuyu: Nyasaye ngʼwana gi ngʼuta kuom chandruok mangʼeny ma asebedogo kendo tuo noketho denda, machalo mana gi nanga morido ngʼuta matek.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

kikuyu: To negidwoke niya, “Ngʼatno nopenjowa ahinya kuomwa wawegi kendo kuom joodwa. Nopenjowa ni, ‘Bende wuonu pod ngima? Bende un gi owadu machielo?’ Ne wadwoke mana gik mane openjowa. Ere kaka dine wangʼe ni obiro wachonwa ni, ‘Dhi ukel owaduno ka’?”
english: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nochako ogero kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo notimo misango mar lalruok kod chiwo mag erokamano kuome kowachone Juda mondo otine Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel.
english: He built up the LORD’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Beduru moluor un mon maparo nodak e ngima maber; beduru mokuyo, un nyiri maparo nodak gi kwe! Lonyreuru duge kendo utwe piende gugru enungou.
english: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mokwongo keto wachne nenore ni en kare, nyaka ngʼat machielo bi maket penjo ne wachneno.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

kikuyu: E kindego jodong ruoth nongʼado rieko ni ruodh Aram nongʼadone rieko kagiwachone niya, “nyisechegi gin nyiseche gode, mano emomiyo ne gin gi teko moloyowa; to ka wakedo kodgi e pewe to adier wabiro bedo matek maloyogi.
english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

kikuyu: Oyaro pe ka yie rombo kendo okeyo ongʼwengʼo ka buru.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kikuyu: “Magi e chike marito ngʼama tuo e kinde mag nyasi mag pwodhruok kokele e nyim jadolo:
english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

kikuyu: Nomiye teko mondo omi gima ket mar ondiek malich mokwongo muya, mondo owuo kendo one ni jogo duto mane otamore lamo gima ketno onegi.
english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

kikuyu: Maria nopenjo malaika niya, “Mani biro bedo nadi, to pod an nyako mapok ongʼeyo dichwo?”
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokecho ahinya gi Amazia kendo noorone janabi manowachone niya, “Angʼo momiyo igeno kuom nyiseche mag jogi mane ok nyal reso jogi giwegi e lweti?”
