english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

kikuyu: Piny Manase nochakore Asher nyaka Mikmethath mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Shekem. Tongʼno nochakore yo milambo mokawo nyaka joma odak En Tapua.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

kikuyu: Musa noketo kendo mar misango molos gi dhahabu ei Hemb Romo e nyim pasia
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

kikuyu: Ka sechege mag nindo ochopo to ngʼe kama odhi nindoe. Bangʼ mano, ele gi yo ka tiende kendo inind kanyo. Bangʼe obiro nyisi gima onego itim.”
english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”

kikuyu: Malaika nowacho niya, “Ma en richo.” Omiyo nodhiro dhakono kodwoko ei atonga mi noumo dho atongano gi raum mapekno.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

kikuyu: Omiyo parie bor mar kuma iseaye ka ipodho! Lokri iwe richo mondo itim gik mane itimo mokwongo. To ka ok ilokori to abiro biro mi agol tachi kare.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

kikuyu: En ngʼat mogwedhi jal ma ok chwanyre mabar nikech an.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: “Amiyo jo-Lawi achiel kuom apar duto mantiere e Israel kaka girkeni margi ka achulogigo kuom tich ma gitiyo e Hemb Romo.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu okelou e piny mane osingore ne kwereu, ma Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo ni nomiu. En piny maduongʼ, man-gi mier madongo mane ok ugero,
english: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

kikuyu: Meshobab, Jamlek, Josha wuod Amazia,
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

kikuyu: Mana kaka dwe por kendo podho kendo machielo por, bende mana kaka chiengʼ Sabato nyaka chiengʼ Sabato machielo e kaka ji duto biro bedo kendo kulore e nyima,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To koro akwayou ni umed bedo gi chir, nikech kata ngʼat achiel kuomu ok bi tho, makmana yie kende ema biro kethore.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

kikuyu: Neuru gima kit kuyo mar Nyasaye osenyago e ngimau: osemiyo udoko joma otangʼ mak badhre ni loso weche manie dieru. Koro usin gi timbe mamono; uluoro donjo e richo; uhera kendo ugombo mondo amed konyou e wachno kendo uikoru kumo joma oketho. Koro usepwodhoru udoko maler e wach mane otimore e dieru.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhi nyara. Tim maber makoro itimoni duongʼ moloyo mano manyocha isenyiso chon: Ok iseringo bangʼ yawuowi ma pod tindo, bed ni gin jomoko kata jochan.
english: He said, “You are blessed by the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.

kikuyu: E higa mar ariyo mar loch Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz ruodh Israel, Amazia wuod Joash ruodh Juda nobedo ruoth.
english: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma jachwech polo gi piny, ogwedhu gie Sayun.
english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Daudi ochopo neginyiso Nabal wach ote Daudi, eka negirito.
english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo jo-Israel okalo Nam Makwar mana ka gima gikalo lowo motwo. Jo-Misri to ka notemo timo kamano to ne ginimo giduto.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

kikuyu: Gik ma chunya dwaro duto ongʼereni maber, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; chur ma achurgo ok opondoni.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Misengini duto mag cham ma uchiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye nyaka bed ma ok oketie thowi, nimar misango ma uwangʼo gi mach ni Jehova Nyasaye kik ketie mor kich kata thowi.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo gimoro mogak, bedni en dhano kata le, kata gimoro amora makwero, eka bangʼe ochamo ring misango mar lalruok mochiw ni Jehova Nyasaye, en bende nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandagi.’ ”
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: Kane osechwadgi marach, norwakgi e od twech mi omi jarit od twech chik mondo oritgi motegno.
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

kikuyu: Joote notimo honni gi ranyisi mathoth e dier ji, to joma oyie kuom Kristo duto ne chokore gi chuny achiel e Agoch Solomon.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, e kaka Josef ma Ja-Lawi modak Saipras, mane joote ochako ni Barnaba (ma tiende ni “Ngʼat ma jiwo ji”),
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

kikuyu: To ruodh Israel nodwoke niya, “Mana kaka iwacho ruodha jaloch, An kaachiel gi mwanduna duto wan magi.”
english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

kikuyu: Kik igol kidi mar kiewo machon, kata ima nyithindo maonge wuone puothegi;
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

kikuyu: Kane jo-Filistia owinjo ni jo-Israel nosechokore Mizpa, ruodhi mag jo-Filistia nobiro mondo omonjgi. To kane jo-Israel owinjo wachno, luoro nomakogi.
english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

kikuyu: “Ginitho gi tuoche maricho richo. Ok nogo nduchgi kata ik bende ok noikgi, to ginichal ka owuoyo manie lowo. Ligangla kod kech noneg-gi, to ringregi nobed chiemb winy mafuyo e kor polo kod le manie piny.”
english: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano, chwo gi mon mangʼeny nomedo yie kuom Ruoth, kendo mago manoyie nomedore e kwan joma noseyie kuom Kristo.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

kikuyu: Petro nogologi oko duto, bangʼe nogoyo chonge piny molamo. Eka nowichore mochomo dhako mothono, kowacho niya, “Tabitha, aa malo!” Dhakono noyawo wengene, kendo kane oneno Petro, to nobet piny.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

kikuyu: Jodong Farao nowachone niya, “Ngʼatni nobednwa obadho nyaka karangʼo? We ogandani odhi mondo mi gidhi gilam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi. Dibed ni pok ifwenyo ni Misri kethore?”
english: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve the LORD, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E ndalogo, e sechego, nomany ketho Israel, to onge manoyudi, kendo ne richo Juda, to onge manoyudi, nimar anangʼwon-ne jogo mane odongʼ mane aweyo.”
english: In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

kikuyu: Omiyo Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Bangʼ ka useguro Wuod Dhano eka unungʼe ni an ngʼama asebedo ka anyisou ni an, kendo ni onge gima atimo kenda, to awacho mana gik ma Wuora opuonja.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

kikuyu: Anami nyikwayi bed mangʼeny ka sulwe mae polo kendo abiro miyogi pinyni duto, kendo kokadho kuom nyikwayi, ogendini duto mag pinyni nogwedhi.
english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

kikuyu: Omiyo negimake mi gidire oko mar puoth mzabibu kendo neginege.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye, ngʼat Nyasaye nobiro koa Juda modhi Bethel e kinde mane Jeroboam ochungʼ e but kendo mar misango mondo ochiw misango.
english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ tero remb jamni nyaka Kama Ler Moloyo mondo ochiw kaka misango mar golo richo ka ringregi iwangʼo oko mar kambi.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

kikuyu: mondo okaw tich mar bedo jaote mane Judas ojwangʼo oweyo kane odhi kare mane ochanne.”
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

kikuyu: Bi, mondo watim singruok, in kod an, kendo we obed kaka ranyisi e kindwa kodi.”
english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: kokadho kuom Hezron, ne gin joka Hezron; kokadho kuom Karmi, ne gin joka Karmi.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

kikuyu: “Ne awalo yawuotu mondo obed jonabi, to moko e dieru naketo mondo obed jo-Nazir. Donge mano en adier, yaye jo-Israel?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane dhakono obiro ir Saulo moneno kaka nobwok malich, nowacho niya, “Ne, jatichni madhako osetimo gima ne ichike. Ne akawo ngimana ka nono kane atimo gima ne iwacho ni atim.
english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

kikuyu: eka aduog ji duto iri. Ka ngʼat midwaro ngimaneni otho; to ji duto noduog maonge ngʼama nohinyre.”
english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

kikuyu: Namiyo pinje oyiengni kane giwinjo mor mar podho mare, chiengʼ mane atere e liel kaachiel gi joma otho. Eka yiende duto mag Eden, ma gin yiende mabeyo mogik mag Lebanon gin yiende duto mane pi oromo maber, chunygi noduogo e piny mamwalo.
english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Yaye Jerusalem, luok timbe mamono manie chunyu mondo iresri. Nyaka karangʼo mi ibiro kano timbe richo e pachi?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

kikuyu: Bor mar bwomb kerubi ne en mita ochiko. Bwomb kerubi achiel ne romo fut aboro kendo nomulo kor hekalu to eka bwombe machielo ma borne bende ne fut aboro nomulo bwomb kerubi machielo.
english: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

kikuyu: Koa e polo, sulwe nokedo, koa kama gichakore negikedo gi Sisera.
english: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.

kikuyu: Kane Musa ochopo machiegni gi kambi koa e tiend got noneno ji kamiel e nyim nyaroya, kendo iye nowangʼ mi nodiro kite mopa mane ni e lwete piny ma gitore matindo tindo.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

kikuyu: Mahalalel notho kane en ja-higni mia aboro gi piero ochiko gabich.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Ogandago biro chielogi gi kite kendo gibiro negogi gi ligangla mag-gi; gibiro nego yawuotgi gi nyigi, kendo gibiro wangʼo utegi.
english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

kikuyu: Jakobo wuon-gi nowachonegi niya, “Usemaya nyithinda. Josef onge, kendo Simeon bende onge, kendo koro Benjamin bende udwaro maya. Gik moko duto ok nikare koda!”
english: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Abram noduogo koseloyo Kedorlaomer kod ruodhi mane oriwore kode, ruodh Sodom nobiro mondo orom kode ei Holo mar Shave (ma tiende ni Holo mar Ruoth).
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

kikuyu: Dhano chalo gi muya nono kendo ndalone chalo gi tipo makadho piyo.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ngʼato otimo richo gi wangʼ matek, bed ni en japinyno kata japiny moro, to ojaro Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ngʼat makamano onego ogol oko e dier jogi.
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

kikuyu: “Ma e kaka jo-Lawi biro tiyo: Joma chwo mahikgi piero ariyo gabich kata moloyo kanyo nobi mondo obed achiel kuom jotich e Hemb Romo,
english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

kikuyu: nikech e kindego ema ne jo-Yahudi otony e lwet wasikgi kendo e dweno ema kuyo margi nolokore mor kendo ywakgi ne olokore nyiero. Kindego nyaka bed kinde mag timo nyasi mag mor ka gioro mich mag chiemo ne jowetegi kendo mich moko bende ne jomoko modhier.
english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro ka berne ruoth, to mondo nonro otim e kar keno mag gik machon mar Babulon mondo ne ka Ruoth Sairas nochiwo chik mondo oger manyien od Nyasaye e Jerusalem. Eka ruoth mondo oornwa kaka ongʼado wachni.
english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma nyangetane otore kata ma duongʼne ongʼad oko kik donj e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly.

kikuyu: Wasewinjo kaka jomoko noa kuomwa ka wan to ne ok waorogi, mi gichandou ka githago chunyu gi weche mane giwacho.
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

kikuyu: Kane gisetieko chiemo, Yesu nopenjo Simon Petro niya, “Simon wuod Johana, bende ihera adier moloyo jogi?” Nodwoke niya, “Ee, Ruoth, ingʼeyo ni aheri.” Yesu nowachone niya, “Kare pidh nyiromba.”
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo ochiewo oa e nindo, noparo niya, “Adier Jehova Nyasaye nika kendo ne ok angʼeyo.”
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

kikuyu: E bwo bwombe kerubi ne aneno gik machalo gi lwedo mag dhano.
english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

kikuyu: Mesha ruodh Moab ne japith rombe, kendo ne ojagolo osuru ne ruodh Israel maromo nyirombe alufu mia achiel kod yie imbe maromo alufu mia achiel.
english: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

kikuyu: To koro kuom weche mane upenja e barupu, anyalo wacho ni ber mondo ngʼato kik okendi.
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

kikuyu: Joka Merari kuom anywola ka anywola to nopog mier apar gariyo koa kuom oganda Reuben, Gad kod Zebulun.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

kikuyu: “Mogik yiende duto nowachone kudho ni, ‘Bi mondo ibed ruodhwa.’
english: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

kikuyu: to gima onego ungʼe kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto ema: Kuom nying Yesu Kristo ja-Nazareth mane uguro un uwegi, to Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho ema omiyo ngʼatni ochungʼ e dieru kangima chuth.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

kikuyu: E dwe mar auchiel, Nyasaye nooro malaika Gabriel mondo odhi Nazareth, e dala mar Galili;
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

kikuyu: Ka udhi kedo gi wasiku kendo uneno farese, geche mag lweny kod jolweny motegno moloyou, to kik gimiu luoro nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou e piny Misri nobed kodu.
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gabich mar loch Asa, Baasha ruodh Israel nodhi kedo kod Juda kendo nochielo Rama motegno mondo ogengʼ ni ngʼato angʼata kik wuogi kata donji e piny Asa ruodh Juda.
english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

kikuyu: To ongʼere ni dhano ok siki e piny, kata obed gi mwandu mathoth machal nade, to otho mana kaka le bende tho.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Eka noloso kido mar malaika ariyo miluongo ni kerubi gi dhahabu mothedhi.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

kikuyu: Mana kaka gisebedo ka gitimo chakre ndalo mane agologi e piny Misri nyaka koroni, kagiweya kendo gitiyo ni nyiseche mamoko, ema koro in bende gitimoni.
english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora ma lihudu nochungʼ e boche polo, ananene kendo napar singruok mosiko e kind Nyasaye kod gik mangima duto manie piny kaka kitgi obet.”
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Eka negiwuok gia Bethel. Kane gisedhi mochwalore gi Efrath, muoch nochako kayo Rael kendo nochandore ahinya.
english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Chiwneuru Jehova Nyasaye, yaye un malaike, chiwneuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kod teko.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Petro nodwoko niya, “Kata ka ji duto oringo oweyi to an ok abi weyi.”
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

kikuyu: Omiyo negimedo kok matek mi gingʼolore gi ligangla kod tonge, kaka ne en timgi nyaka rembgi nomol.
english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

kikuyu: Sirni momako agola mare nochomo laru ma oko; sirnige nogorie yiende mag othidhe oko gi iye, kendo raidhi mi idho eka ichop kanyo ne gin aboro.
english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

kikuyu: “Ne wawinjo jali kawacho ni, ‘Abiro muko hekalu ma dhano ogeroni eka bangʼ ndalo adek to, abiro gero machielo ma ok olos gi lwet dhano.’ ”
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

kikuyu: Dhoranga Rech noger kendo gi yawuot Hasena. Negichungo sirni mage, kendo negirwako dhoute gi radedi kod lodi mage.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: Andikonu un nyithindo mageno nikech ungʼeyo Wuoro. Andikonu un wuone, nikech ungʼeyo Jalno mane nitie nyaka aa chakruok. Andikonu un jomatindo, nikech utegno, kendo wach Nyasaye odak e chunyu, kendo useloyo ngʼama rach.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

kikuyu: Shelemia, Nathan, Adaya,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

kikuyu: Ne en kama kuom higni piero ariyo kane an e odi. Ne atiyoni kuom higni apar gangʼwen ne nyigi ariyo, kendo higni auchiel ne jambi, kendo ne imaya pokna nyadipar.
english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni obiro kete jarit mwandune duto.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Wachni nochwanyo chuny ruodh Aram. Noluongo jodonge mowachonegi niya, “Bende unyalo wachona ngʼat ma jakorwa makonyo ruodh Israel?”
english: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

kikuyu: Abiro wachone joma odak nyandwat ni, ‘Wegi gidhi!’ Kendo ni joma odak milambo ni, ‘Kik ugengʼ-gi.’ Keluru yawuota moa mabor kaachiel gi nyiga koa e tunge piny,
english: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘Bangʼ ka usedonjo e piny mamiyouni kaka kar dak
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni un jongʼanyo ma wigi tek. Kaka usebedo ka ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye kapod angima kendo an kodu, to koro unungʼany marom nade bangʼ kasetho.
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi nooronegi wach kokalo kuom jootene kinde ka kinde nikech nokecho joge kod kar dakne.
english: The LORD, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

kikuyu: Kiyale to mi mondo oyude gi ketho, kendo kata lemo molamo onego onyis kethone.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni moko nodhi Samaria limo Ahab. Ahab noyangʼone kaachiel gi joma ne ni kode rombe mangʼeny kod dhok, kendo nokwaye ni mondo oked gi jo-Ramoth Gilead.
english: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

kikuyu: Bam mane osechiw kod agoko mane oselier nyaka kel kaachiel gi boche mag misengini miwangʼo gi mach nobed misango mifwayo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Ma nobed pokni mapile pile in kaachiel gi nyithindi kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko.”
english: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”

kikuyu: Mi awinj tiend gik ma chikegi puonjo; eka abiro paro matut kuom timbegi miwuoro.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye ongʼad oko lep duto ma jaro ji kod lep duto masungore;
english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Gideon gi joge mia adek nool kamano, negimedo lawo ruodhi mag Midian mi gingʼado aora Jordan.
english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

kikuyu: Petro gi joote mamoko nodwokogi niya, “Nyaka wawinj mana Nyasaye kende, to ok dhano!
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

kikuyu: Bangʼ aa Troa, ne wakwangʼo yie kwachomo Samothraki kendo kinyne ne wadhi nyime nyaka Neapoli.
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

kikuyu: Sa ma idhi yike to ji duto kowe, kendo lowo lwar kuome mos.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

kikuyu: to kuom nyiimbe apar gangʼwen-ka, to uchiw kilo adek.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

kikuyu: Piny osedwany gi jok modakie, giseketho chike, gisetamore rito buchene, kendo giseketho winjruok manyaka nene.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

kikuyu: E sa ma ngʼato ka ngʼato nokawo kare ka gilworo kambi, jo-Midian duto noringo, kendo negiringo ka giywak.
english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Kik iketh gik moko.” Miktam mar Daudi. Kane Saulo ooro ji mondo ocher od Daudi mondo onege. Resa e lwet wasika, yaye Nyasaye; Rit ngimana kuom joma ogar koda.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye otieko wuoyo gi Musa ewi Got Sinai nomiye kite ariyo mopa mag rapar mane gin kite mopa ariyo ma Nyasaye nondikoe gi lwete owuon.
english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyaka jadolo ndik kwongʼ-gi e Kitabu bangʼe olingʼ-gi ei pi makechno.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Gibiro wito fedha mag-gi e wangʼ yore, kendo dhahabu mag-gi biro lokore nigi gima ogak. Fedha gi dhahabu mag-gi ok bi resogi, e odiechiengʼ mar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye. Gigo ok notieknegi kech kata migi giyiengʼ, nikech gigo osemiyo gidonjo e richo.
english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

kikuyu: Abiro riembo oko ogendini bende abiro yaro tongʼ mar pinyu kendo onge ngʼat manobed gi gombo kuom pinyu e kinde ma udhi ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ngʼato ka ngʼato nyadidek e higa.
english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.

kikuyu: Elisha nopenjo ruodh Israel niya, “Angʼo madikelwa kaachiel?” Dhiuru ir jonabi mag wuonu kod minu. Ruodh Israel nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, Jehova Nyasaye ema osekelowa wan ruodhi adek kanyakla mondo ochiw-wa e lwet jo-Moab.”
english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

kikuyu: Wach maberno emomiyo isanda kendo itweya ka ngʼat matimo richo. To wach Nyasaye ok otwe.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ogowo loka, noneno oganda maduongʼ, nokechogi nikech ne gichal kaka rombe maonge gi jakwath. Omiyo nochako puonjogi gik mangʼeny.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

kikuyu: Pesa mane okel e hekalu ne ok otigo kuom loso tewni mag fedha gi gik mingʼadogo otambi mar teyni, kod tewni, kod bakunde mag kiro remo, kaachiel gi turumbete kod gik moko duto mag dhahabu gi fedha mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye,
english: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;

kikuyu: Polo gin magi, kendo piny bende en mari. In ema ne imiyo piny obetie kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

kikuyu: Nikech iwuoyo kuoma marach kendo wechegi maricho osechopo e ita, abiro keto chuma e umi kod mbedona e dhogi, kendo abiro miyo idog gi yo mane ibirogo.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

kikuyu: To gin jomage manowinjo mi ongʼanyone? Donge ne gin ji duto mane Musa otelonegi kogolo Misri?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, resa e lwet joma kamago gi lweti, resa e lwet jopinyni ma pokgi ni e pinyni. Itieko kech ma joma ihero nigo; yawuotgi nigi chiemo mangʼeny, kendo gikano mwandu ne nyithindgi.
english: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

kikuyu: Mano e gima nomiyo jo-Yahudi omaka e laru mar hekalu kendo negitemo mondo ginega.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, Luwauru ka ungʼiyo kendo ka achopo but hema, to timuru mana kaka atimo.
english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Kinde biro, ma dala maduongʼ ibiro gerona kendo, kochakore Kar Ngʼicho Motingʼore gi Malo mar Hananel nyaka e Dhoranga Kona.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the city will be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dweno nyaka ulos sawo; kuom ndalo abiriyo chamuru makati motedi ma ok oketie thowi.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: Kane Apolo ni Korintho, Paulo nowuotho e gwenge mamalo, nyaka nochopo Efeso. Kuno noyude jopuonjre moko,
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

kikuyu: Meletia ja-Gibeon gi Jadon ja-Meronoth kod jo-Gibeon gi jo-Mizpa nogedo e dir jo-Tekoa kendo ne gin e gwenge mane nitie e bwo loch mar ruoth mar piny man loka aora Yufrate.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

kikuyu: Nogole oko mowachone niya, “Rang polo malo kendo kwan sulwe ka dipo ni inyalo kwanogi.” Eka nowachone niya, “Omiyo mano e kaka nyikwayi nobedi.”
english: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

kikuyu: Mad chwak michwakago oa kuomi; mad wengeni nee gima kare.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

kikuyu: Kik ucham chiemo motimgo misango ne nyiseche manono, kik ucham remo; kik ucham ring jamni mode bende kik uterru. Ka uritoru kuom gigo duto, to unudhi nyime maber. Oritiuru.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

kikuyu: To bende in kod jomoko maluwo puonj mag jo-Nikolao.
english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero rieko miyo wuon mare mor, to ngʼat momako osiep kod jachode ketho mwandune.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

kikuyu: Ne onge ngʼat moro machielo machalo gi Ahab, mane ochiwore ni timo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kijiwe e timo kamano gi jaode Jezebel.
english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jo-Kristo man Babulon, ma Nyasaye oyiero kaachiel kodu, okowonu mos. Wuoda Mariko bende omosou.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

kikuyu: Tingʼuru banderane e ohinga mag Babulon! Med jolweny mamoko kijiwogi, ket jorito keregi, ikreuru mar monjogi! Jehova Nyasaye nodhi nyime gi chenro mare, buche moketo mondo otimre ni jo-Babulon.
english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for the LORD has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

kikuyu: Ne kuom nyingi kik ijarwa; kik ijwangʼ kom duongʼ mari malich. Par singruok mari kodwa kendo kik ikethe.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Boluru gogo mau yo bat korachwich mar yie, to ubiro mako rech.” Kane gitimo kamano, ywayo gogo nyaka ei yie notamogi, nikech rech ne ngʼeny mohewogi ywayo.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

kikuyu: To nomako lwet nyathi manyakono mi owachone niya, “Talitha koum!” (tiende ni, “Nyako matin, anyisi ni aa malo!”)
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

kikuyu: mondo kik obed gima ongʼere ne ji ni itweyo chiemo, to Wuonu ma ok ne kende ema ongʼe. Eka Wuonu maneno gima otim lingʼ-lingʼ nomiyi pokni.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Yahudi nowachone niya, “Ranyisi mar hono mane minyalo nyisowa mondo osir teko mitimogo gigi?”
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

kikuyu: Naaman nokone niya, “Ka idagi, to we mondo an jatichni miya lowo moromo kenje ariyo tingʼo, nikech chakre kawuono ok abi timo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango moro amora ne nyasaye moro makmana Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo ji duto nowuotho kaluwo bangʼe ka gigoyo asili kendo gimor mathoth mi piny noyiengni.
english: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

kikuyu: negiparo mondo giwuonde. Negidhi kaka jogo man-gi punde motingʼo ogunde moti gi piende divai moti kendo obaw.
english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

kikuyu: Eka jadolo maduongʼ gi joge, mane gin jokanyo mar buch jo-Sadukai, nyiego nomako.
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

kikuyu: Wach ni bungu man yo milambo kama: Winj wach Jehova Nyasaye. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Achiegni moko mach kuomi, kendo obiro tieko yiendegi duto, manumu kaachiel gi motwo. Mach mabebni ok nonegi, kendo ji duto kochakore milambo nyaka nyandwat, majni norew wengegi.
english: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear the LORD’s word: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

kikuyu: Negingʼado wiye oko kendo ne gilonyo gige mag lweny, bangʼe negioro joote e piny jo-Filistia duto ka gioro wach mondo oter wach e hekalu mag nyisechegi kendo ni jopinygi.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: Ei konde angʼwen mag laru ma oko ne nitie laru ma oko mopondo, ma borgi noromo fut piero auchiel, to lachgi oromo fut piero angʼwen gabich. Laru ka laru mane ni e ii konde angʼwen-go ne romre.
english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa nodwok wach man kuome owuon ni Nyasaye.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo terene mane oyudo osegolo kuom Haman, mi nomiyo Modekai. Kendo Esta nokete mondo orit mwandu mane mag Haman.
english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

kikuyu: Dhakono nomako ich kendo kane ochopo higa machielo e kinde machal kamano, nonywolo wuowi mana kaka Elisha nowachone.
english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

kikuyu: Ne chandruokna mondo ikonya, nimar pok wiya owil gi chikni.
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Johanan mar aboro, Elzabad mar ochiko,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno notelona motera yo nyandwat nyaka e laru ma oko kendo nokela nyaka e ute matindo mongʼiyore gi laru mar hekalu kendo mongʼiyore gi ohinga ma oko man yo nyandwat.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

kikuyu: Joma odak Sayun wacho niya, “Mad masira ma gisekelonwa bed kuom Babulon.” Jerusalem wacho niya, “Mad rembwa bed ewi joma odak Babulon.”
english: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.

kikuyu: Abiro keyo lwete mi kwak nam, kendo lwete ma korachwich biro kwako aore.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Juda omonjogi, Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi e lwetgi kendo neginego ji alufu apar Bezek.
english: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

kikuyu: Ogolo chik to nam mi nam tuo, kendo aore duto dwono. Lege mabeyo mag Bashan gi Karmel tuo, kendo yiende mag Lebanon bende ner.
english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

kikuyu: Duogna mor ma warruokni kelo kendo mi abed gi chuny mohero timo dwaroni, mondo chuny makamano orita.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

kikuyu: Zadok jadolo nokawo tungʼ mar mo e Hema Maler mi nowiro Solomon. Eka negigoyo turumbete kendo ji duto nogoyo koko niya, “Ruoth Solomon mondo odag amingʼa!”
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

kikuyu: Magi e yawuowi mane Rael onywolone Jakobo. Giduto ne gin ji apar gangʼwen.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nodhi e ode mar ruoth Samaria ka chunye orumo kendo ka iye owangʼ kod mirima.
english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

kikuyu: Negichako kanyo ni Dan bangʼ kwargi Dan, mane wuod Israel; kata obedo ni dala maduongʼno ne iluongo chon ni Laish.
english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

kikuyu: Abisalom nowachone Ahithofel niya, “Ngʼadnwae rieko. En angʼo monego watim?”
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima onego utimnegi: Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo, tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera kendo wangʼuru kido mag-gi milamo e mach.
english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

kikuyu: Amiyou chik, un nyi Jerusalem ni ka uyudo jaherana, to ubiro nyise nangʼo? Nyiseuru ni hera ma aherego odwaro nega?
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.

kikuyu: omiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Achiegni kumo jo-Filistia, kendo abiro ngʼado kar jo-Kereth oko mi atiek jogi modongʼ e dho nam.
english: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

kikuyu: Kane oganda mane ni kanyo oneno gima Paulo otimo, ne gikok gi dho jo-Lukaonia niya, “Nyiseche osekawo kit dhano mi obiro irwa ka!”
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

kikuyu: nowachone Hazael niya, “Kaw mich mondo idhi iromnego ngʼat Nyasaye. Kone openj Jehova Nyasaye ni, ‘Bende abiro chango kuom tuoni?’ ”
english: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

kikuyu: “ ‘Magi e chike mag misengini mag cham: Yawuot Harun nochiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye e nyim kendo mar misango.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

kikuyu: Nikech negiweyo rito chike Jehova Nyasaye, Shishak ruodh Misri nomonjo Jerusalem e higa mar abich mar loch Ruoth Rehoboam.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okendo dhako, to bangʼe oyudo ni ok ohere nikech osetimo gimoro ma ok nikare, onyalo ndikone barup weruok mar ketho keny, kendo oriembe oa e ode.
english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasaye ne itemowa ni in iwuon; ne ipwodhowa ka fedha.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo apar mar mogo mayom moruw gi mo; im to uchiw gi kilo abiriyo;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Koro chungi mondo ingʼad Holo mar Zered.” Omiyo ne wangʼado holono.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosemiyou rieko mar wuoyo kamano? Koso en paro mane ma un-go momiyo wechego wuok e dhou?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

kikuyu: nimar ngʼanyo chal gi richo mar jwok, to tok teko chalo gi richo mar lamo nyiseche manono. Nikech isedagi wach Jehova Nyasaye En bende osedagi ni kik ibed ruoth.”
english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected the LORD’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka arungu kata ligangla; kata asere mabith, e kaka ngʼatno machiwo neno ma ok adiera kuom ngʼat ma gidakgo machiegni.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo noyudo ka jotend lweny obet kanyakla. Nowachone jatend lweny niya, “An-gi wach moro madwaro wachoni.” Jehu nopenje niya, “En ngʼa kuomwa ka midwaro losogo?” Nodwoke niya, “En mana in, jatend lweny.”
english: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

kikuyu: Solomon nobedo ruodh jo-Israel duto ka en Jerusalem kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

kikuyu: Obiro wuoyo gi ji kari kendo obiro bedo kaka dhogi bende ibiro bedone kaka Nyasaye.
english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

kikuyu: Eka noluonga kowachona niya, “Mago madhiyo nyandwatgo osemiyo chunya olendo gi piny ma yo nyandwatno.”
english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

kikuyu: Kane Farao oweyo ogandano odhi, Nyasaye ne ok oweyogi giluwo yo mangʼado e piny jo-Filistia, kata obedo ni yorno ne ngʼado machiegni. Nimar Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ka jogi oromo gi lweny, to ginyalo loko pachgi mi gidog e piny Misri.”
english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

kikuyu: Gouru nduru un joma odak e mier moluoro chiro, johala mau madongo duto ibiro yweyo oko, kendo ji duto maloko ohand pesa notiek pep.
english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne gijuko buch kendo mi gichungʼ e nyim Farao. Musa nokiro buru e kor yamo kendo buche malokore adhola nogore kuom ji kod jamni.
english: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

kikuyu: Abiro chiki kendo abiro puonji e yo monego ilu; adier abiro ngʼadoni rieko kendo abiro rangi maber.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

kikuyu: Ooyo, ja-Yahudi mar adier en ngʼato ma ja-Yahudi gi e chunye kendo tero nyangu mar adier bende en mar chuny, mano en tich Roho to ok mar rito Chik. Ngʼat ma kamano ok yud pak kuom ji, to oyudo pak kuom Nyasaye.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

kikuyu: Piny mane opog ne Josef nochakore Aora Jordan man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jeriko, koluwo i thim mochopo e gode man Bethel.
english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

kikuyu: ema notelo ne jotich kendo negingʼiyo jotich mag tije mopogore opogore. Jo-Lawi moko ne jogoro gi jopuonj chike kod jorit dhoudi.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo mabiro nenoe kedo machalo kama, kendo winjo dwond turumbete?
english: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

kikuyu: Ne ogure ne Jakobo kaka chik, kendo nogure ni Israel kaka singruok mochwere, kowacho ni,
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: Gionge gi pek moro amora kendo dendgi ber kendo otegno.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

kikuyu: gibiro tingʼi malo e lwetgi, mondo kik ichwany tiendi e kidi.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

kikuyu: ma gin nyiseche mag ogendini mokiewo kodu, bed ni gin machiegni kata mabor, kochakore e bath piny konchiel nyaka komachielo);
english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

kikuyu: Kaponi osetimoni marach, kata ka en-gi gopi moro to kwan-gi e wiya.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

kikuyu: Wuod Jonathan ne en: Merib-Baal mane wuon Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Giduto gidhi kamoro achiel; giduto gia e lowo, kendo giduto gidok e lowo.
english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

kikuyu: Kane ji oneno ni Musa osedeko ewi got, negichokore ma gilworo Harun kendo giwachone niya, “Bi mondo ilosnwa nyiseche ma biro dhi nyimwa, nimar ok wangʼeyo gima osetimore ne Musa mane ogolowa ka waa e piny Misri.”
english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

kikuyu: Koro nyiswa ane, iparo nade? Bende en gima kare mondo wagol osuru ne Kaisar, koso ok owinjore?”
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Laban nochiwo Bilha jatichne ma nyako ne Rael nyare kaka jatichne.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

kikuyu: To dag kode kaka jatich michulo kata kaka wendo modak kodi, kendo obiro tiyoni nyaka chop higa mar piero abich.
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

kikuyu: Kane Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, ne oyudo ka Mikal nyar Saulo ne ngʼicho gie dirisa. To ka noneno Ruoth Daudi kamiel kendo tugo komor, nochaye gie chunye.
english: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

kikuyu: Ka agoyo turumbete kaachiel jogo duto ma an-go, eka un joma uselworo kambi bende ugo turumbete ka ukok niya, “Wakedo ni Jehova Nyasaye kod Gideon.”
english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko Rekab gi owadgi ma Baana yawuot Rimon ja-Beeroth niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, moseresa e masiche duto,
english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

kikuyu: Eka Josef nokowo owetene modhi, kendo kane koro giwuok gidhi nowachonegi niya, “Kik udhaw kendu e wangʼ yo!”
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, ne agolo chik mondo watwe chiemo e dho aora Ahava ka wahore wawegi e nyim Nyasachwa kendo wakwaye wuoth maber ni wan gi nyithindwa, gi giwa duto.
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne wajiwo Tito, kaka en ema nochako tijni e dieru, mondo odhi kode nyime nyaka chop otiek tij ngʼwonono.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

kikuyu: Eka napenjo niya, “Idhi kanye?” Nodwoka niya, “Adhi pimo Jerusalem mondo angʼe lachne gi borne.”
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Ne, abiro pwodhogi kendo temogi, nimar en angʼo machielo manyalo timo, nikech richo mar joga?
english: Therefore the LORD of Armies says, “Behold, I will melt them and test them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

kikuyu: “Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel wacho ni, ‘Ne asingora ni odi kod od wuonu nobed jotichna nyaka chiengʼ.’ To koro Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Ma ok anatim! Joma miya duongʼ ema abiro miyo duongʼ, to joma ochaya ok nobed gimoro.
english: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now the LORD says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.

kikuyu: “Unutimna nyasi mar sawo nyadidek e higa.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ngʼat moro marahuma nodhi e piny mabor mondo oyiere ruoth eka bangʼe oduogi.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

kikuyu: Ishmael nonywolo Nebayoth wuode makayo, Kedar, Adbel, Mibsam,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

kikuyu: “Winjuru, un ruodhi! Chikuru itu, un jotelo! Abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye ka awerne; anachuog ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wer.
english: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to the LORD. I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne, kawuononi ayieri ewi ogendini kod pinjeruodhi mondo ipudhi kendo iyiechi, mondo ikethi kendo ilok loch, mondo iger kendo ipudhi.”
english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

kikuyu: Dhood Dan ema ne ochako wuoth mogik e bwo bandechgi kotelnegi gi Ahiezer wuod Amishadai.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nogolowa Misri giteko mangʼongo korieyo bade, gi ranyisi kod honni madongo.
english: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

kikuyu: To jo-Misri gin mana dhano ma ok Nyasaye; bende faresegi gin mana ringʼo ma ok roho. Ka Jehova Nyasaye norie bade mar kum, jogo machiwo kony nochwanyre, kendo jogo mikonyo nopodh piny; giduto ginilal nono.
english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ohero tim makare kod ratiro; piny duto opongʼ gi herane ma ok rem.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

kikuyu: Lotan nonywolo: Hori kod Homam. Timna ne en nyamin Lotan.
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

kikuyu: Kodhi moko nolwar kuonde motimo lwendni, ma lowo operoree, mine gitwi piyo piyo nikech lowo ne thany thany.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

kikuyu: Nikech nongʼiyo nyime kogeno dala machielo man-gi mise motegno, ma jagedone en Nyasaye owuon.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

kikuyu: Ununwangʼa kendo anaduogu ka ua e twech. Anachoku ka ua e pinje duto kod kuonde ma asekeyoue kendo anaduogu kama ne uae ka aterou e twech,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will be found by you,” says the LORD, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says the LORD. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

kikuyu: koa e dhood Isakar, ne en Igal wuod Josef;
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

kikuyu: “Dhiuru upenj Jehova Nyasaye gima biro timorena, kendo ni oganda kod jo-Juda duto kaluwore gi gik mondiki e kitabu mwaseyudoni. Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye maliel ka mach osechomowa nikech kwerewa ok oseluoro weche mawuok e kitabuni; kendo ok gisetimo timbe moluwore gi gik moko duto mondiki kuomwa.”
english: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ok ti kod kede kuom chwado wuode, omon kod wuode, to ngʼat mohere bedo motangʼ mondo orieye.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

kikuyu: E kindeno Abija wuod Jeroboam nobedo matuo,
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

kikuyu: Notieko ndalo piero angʼwen nikech mano e kaka kitundu molos gi yath idwaro mondo otieki. Jo-Misri noywage kuom ndalo piero abiriyo.
english: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Polo e koma mar duongʼ, to piny e raten tienda. Koro ere kama dugerna e ot? To kar yweyo mara nobed kanye?
english: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

kikuyu: Eka nomiya rapim machalo gi luth mar pimo; kendo nowachona niya, “Aa malo idhiyo ipim hekalu mar Nyasaye kod kendo mar misango, kendo ikwan joma lemo kanyo!
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

kikuyu: Nyiswa herani ma ok rem, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo mi wayud resruok mari.
english: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane oa Misri noseter nyangu, makmana joma nonywol e thim ka gisea Misri ema ne pod ok oter nyangu.
english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

kikuyu: Chiwneuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ mowinjore gi nyinge; lamuru Jehova Nyasaye e dier lerne maduongʼ.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Chwo duto mahikgi piero adek nyaka piero adek gabich mane obiro chiwo kony e tich mar Hemb Romo,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: e dhood Benjamin, en Elidad wuod Kislon;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

kikuyu: omiyo nodok Jezreel mondo ochangi kuom hinyruok manoyudo Ramoth ka nokedo gi Hazael ruodh Aram. Eka Ahazia wuod Jehoram ruodh Juda nodhi Jezreel mondo one Joram wuod Ahab nikech nohinye.
english: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo humba, ne giwinja; jopinje mamoko nobiro motwere kuoma.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

kikuyu: To kata kamano kane anono duto mane lweta osetiyo kod gino mane asenyagora mondo ayudi, gik moko duto ne onge tiendgi, mana kalawo bangʼ yamo; onge ohala mane ayudo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

kikuyu: Ber mondo japuonjre obed machal gi japuonjne, kendo ka jatich obedo machal gi ruodhe. Ka oseluong jatend ot ni Belzebub, koro jokanyo mag ode to ibiro luong kamano marom nade!
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

kikuyu: To adiera en ni Kristo osechier oa kuom joma otho. Chierneno en kaka gir singo manyiso ni joma osetho e liel bende ibiro chiero.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Kristono e mwalando ne ji duto ka wasiemogi kendo wapuonjogi rieko duto, mondo water ji duto e nyim Kristo ka ler chutho.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Rieko machal kamano ok oa e polo, to en mar piny kendo ok okony chuny dhano, en rieko jachien.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

kikuyu: Abiro terou e thim mag ogendini kendo kuno ema anangʼadnue bura e wangʼu kuneno.
english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-adiera ok riambi, to janeno ma hango wach wacho mana miriambo.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

kikuyu: Puothe mag Heshbon ner, kaachiel gi mzabibu mag Sibma. Jotelo mag ogendini oseketho divai mane berie moloyo, mane ndalo moro ochopo nyaka Jazer, kendo olandore nyaka kar ongoro. Bedene nolawore malach mochopo nyaka nam.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

kikuyu: Dhano en mana tipo makadho kata ka owuotho koni gi koni, orikni gi tijene mapile kayiem; ochoko mwandu mathoth ka ok ongʼeyo ngʼama obiro weyonegi.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

kikuyu: To ji duto nodwoko riat niya, “Rembe mondo obed e wiwa gi nyithindwa!”
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

kikuyu: Nikech ne aluoro kethruok ma Nyasaye nyalo kelona nikech luoro mane aluorogo duongʼne, omiyo ne ok anyal timo gik ma kamago.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

kikuyu: Noduog ringre kotingʼ gi faras kendo noyike but kwerene e Dala Maduongʼ mar Juda.
english: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

kikuyu: Kik ibar kidhiyo korachwich kata koracham; rit tiendi mondo kik idonji e richo.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

kikuyu: “To jatijno nogoyo chonge piny e nyime, moywagorene ni, ‘Yie ihorina mos, abiro chuli gopino duto.’
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

kikuyu: Mwandu moyud motelo e yo mayot ok bi bedo konyruok e kinde machien.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye tingʼo joma obolore malo to joma timbegi richo to ochwado piny e lowo.
english: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

kikuyu: Adam notho ka en ja-higni mia ochiko gi piero adek.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel nochoko jonabi kanyakla maromo ji mia angʼwen, mopenjogi niya, “Bende anyalo dhi kedo gi jo-Ramoth Gilead, koso kik adhi?” Negidwoke niya “Dhiyo nikech Jehova Nyasaye nochiwe e lwet ruoth.”
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

kikuyu: Wuod Jediael ne en: Bilhan. Yawuot Bilhan ne gin: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenana, Zethan, Tarshish kod Ahishahar.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka pog mich moko tenge, kaluwore gi yuto mare mondo ka abiro to onge mich mibiro chok kendo.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

kikuyu: Wiya nokuot mar kwayo ruodh jolweny kod joriemb farese mondo ogengʼwa kuom wasikwa manie yo, nikech ne wasenyiso ruoth niya, “Lwet Nyasachwa mar ngʼwono nitie kuom ji duto moketo genogi kuome, to mirimbe mager ni kuom jogo mojwangʼe.”
english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

kikuyu: “Dengi, yaye Heshbon, nimar Ai okethi! Ywaguru, yaye joma odak Raba! Rwakuru lepu mag ywak kendo uywagi; ringuru koni gi koni, e alwora mar dala, nimar Molek noter e twech, kaachiel gi jodolo mage kod jotelo mage.
english: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

kikuyu: Bende togo nyalo dongo marabora kama thidhna ongee? Koso odundu bende nyalo dongo maber kama pi onge?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

kikuyu: An awuon ema anarit rombena kendo anami ginind piny ka giyweyo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “To anyisi ni pachino obam, nikech Nyasaye duongʼ moloyo dhano.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

kikuyu: Goda maduongʼ manie piny kod mwanduni gi nyak magi duto anami wasiki, kaachiel gi kuonde magi motingʼore gi malo, nikech richo manie pinyu duto.
english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

kikuyu: Dhahabu gi fedha itemo gi mach, to dhano itemo gi pak moyudo.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, owetena kik ubwogi ka jopiny mon kodu.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Dwok liganglani e olalo, nimar ji duto ma wuodho ligangla notho gi ligangla.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

kikuyu: Onge gimoro amora e piny ngima minyalo pimo kode, kendo onge gima oluoro.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

kikuyu: Mana kaka pi dwono e nam kata kaka dier aora pi duone mi two,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

kikuyu: “Los Hemb Romo gi pasia apar mar law mayom momin man-gi rangi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro ka ogorie kido mar malaika mar kerubi gi jagoro molony.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: “To ka jopur puodhogo noneno wuod wuon puodho, negiwacho e kindgi giwegi ni, ‘Ma e jacham girkeni. Biuru mondo wanege mondo girkeni odongʼnwa.’
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

kikuyu: Koso nitie ngʼato manyalo ngʼeyo pach ngʼat machielo? Donge chuny ngʼato owuon ema ongʼeyo gima ni e iye? Kamano bende e kaka onge ngʼat mongʼeyo pach Nyasaye makmana Roho mar Nyasaye.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Noleronigi tiendgi kendo nomiyo gingʼeyo gadiera ni Kristo ne nyaka sandi eka bangʼe ochier oa kuom joma otho. Nowachonegi niya, “Yesu ma ayalonuni e Kristo.”
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jo-Juda nowacho niya, “Pidhe mag kuonde momukore ngʼeny, to teko joma gologi odok chien, omiyo koro ok wanyal dhi nyime gigero ohinga.”
english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

kikuyu: In mikelo wach maber ne Sayun, dhi ewi got malo. In mikelo wach maber ne Jerusalem, tingʼ dwondi malo ka ikok matek, tingʼ dwondi malo, kik ibed maluor; wach ne mier mag Juda niya, “Eri Nyasachu nika!”
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

kikuyu: Kik ucham gimoro ma uyudo ka osetho kende. Unyalo miye japiny moro amora manie miechu mondo ochame kata unyalo uso ne japiny moro, nikech un oganda mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Kutedo nyadiel to kik uole cha min.
english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: “Magi e nyinge joma chwo monego pogu pinyni kaka pok maru: Eliazar jadolo kod Joshua wuod Nun.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Chik machon-no koro osegol oko nikech onyap kendo oonge gi teko
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Monj piny Merathaim kod jogo modak Pekod. Lawgi, neg-gi kendo utiekgi duto. Timuru gimoro amora masechikou.
english: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says the LORD, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Aneno ni paro ma wuonu nigo koda ok en paro mane en-go mokwongo, kata kamano Nyasach wuora osebedo koda.
english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

kikuyu: Udwaro ni ubed gi gik moko, to ok uyudgi. Uneko kendo ugombo gige ji, to ok unyal yudo gik mudwarogo. Udhawo kendo ugoru e kindu ngʼato gi ngʼato. Ok uyud gik mudwaro nikech ok ukwa Nyasaye.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

kikuyu: Jogi nomanyo nonro mar anywolagi, to ne ok ginyal yudogi, omiyo nowegi oko mar joka jodolo kaka joma ochido.
english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

kikuyu: Ka Nyarombo noketho kido mar angʼwen, nawinjo dwond gima ngima mar angʼwen kaluongo niya, “Bi!”
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Eka janabi Shemaya nobiro ir Rehoboam kod jotelo mag Juda mano chokore Jerusalem nimar luoro nomakogi nikech Shishak kendo nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ‘Useweya omiyo an bende koro aweyou e lwet Shishak.’ ”
english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “The LORD says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

kikuyu: Mana kaka miyo hoyo nyathine, e kaka abiro hoyou; kendo noho chunyu e Jerusalem.”
english: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: En kaachiel gi joode duto ne gin joma odimbore kendo moluoro Nyasaye. Ne okonyo joma odhier kendo olamo Nyasaye pile.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ka rwadhno osebedo gi kido mar chwopo kendo wuon-gi osesiem to ok osetweye e dipo mi onego dichwo kata dhako, rwadhno nyaka go gi kite kendo wuon-gi bende nyaka negi.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato matimo richo ok dwar ler, kendo ok odwar donjo ei ler, nikech oluor ni dipo ka timbene ongʼere.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

kikuyu: Abiro hulo chenro mag Jehova Nyasaye ma ok lokre: Nowachona niya, “In wuoda; kawuono asedoko wuonu.
english: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

kikuyu: Nimar in ema isebedo genona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, in ema isebedo kimiya chir nyaka ae tin-na.
english: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

kikuyu: Nehemia wuod Azbuk, mane jatend dir gwengʼ Beth Zur, nogedo e dir Zalum mochopo nyaka kama omanyore gi liend Daudi mochopo nyaka yawo mokuny kod od jolweny.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

kikuyu: Jauso ok bi dwokne lowo kaponi pod gingima giduto. Nikech wach mokor kuom oganda duto ok bi loki. Onge kata ngʼato achiel mabiro reso ngimagi nikech richogi.
english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

kikuyu: mondo ngʼato angʼata monego nyawadgi kobothne kendo ok dwarone nyalo biro kanyo mi oyud konyruok koa e lwet ngʼama dwaro chulone kuor.
english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowachone ja-athanyno niya, “Wuoda, richoni oweni.”
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata mane nyalo hedhore mondo oriwre kodgi, kata obedo ni ji ne omiyogi luor malich kamano.
