english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Penjieuru ogendini: En ngʼa mosewinjo gima chalo kama? Gima lich mokadho osetim gi Nyako Ngili ma en Israel.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “Ask now among the nations, ‘Who has heard such things?’ The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

kikuyu: To negiwachone ka gijiwe niya, “Bed kodwa ka, nimar koro odhiambo chiegni, odiechiengʼ koro dhi rumo.” Omiyo nodhi mondo obed kodgi.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

kikuyu: Abiro biro piyo. Omiyo mak matek gima in-go mondo kik ngʼato mayi osimboni.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

kikuyu: Dhood Manase notelnegi gi Gamaliel wuod Pedazur,
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osengʼado nam gi yie mi odok loka machielo, oganda maduongʼ nolwore.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

kikuyu: To ka uwachona niya, “Wan waketo genowa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa,” to donge en ema kuondene motingʼore malo kod kendene mag misango Hezekia nogolo kowachone jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem niya, “Nyaka ulam mana e nyim kendoni e Jerusalem?”
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?

kikuyu: Ji duto parogi ok ti kendo gionge ngʼeyo; jotheth duto wigi kuot gi nyisechegi manono ma githedho. Kido mage moloso gin gik manono; gionge muya eigi.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

kikuyu: Pakeuru kugoyo turumbete, kendo kugoyo nyatiti gi asili,
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

kikuyu: ne aparo ni, ‘Koro jo-Filistia biro monja Gilgal, ka pod ok apenjo kendo pod ok akwayo Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonya.’ Omiyo ne aneno ni ochuna ni nyaka achiw misango miwangʼo pep.”
english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of the LORD.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

kikuyu: Wasika duto wigi biro kuot kendo gibiro hum nono; gibiro dok chien apoya nono gi wichkuot.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi tongʼ jo-Manase ne nitiere Beth Shan, Tanak, Megido kod Dor, kaachiel gi miechgi matindo. Joka Josef wuod Israel ne odakie miergi.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

kikuyu: Magi ne nyikwa Rafa ja-Gath mane Daudi gi joge onego.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Nochal mana ka jakeyo mabeto cham choko kamoro achiel bangʼe okayogi gi lwete mana kaka jahulo, hulo cham e Holo mar Refaim.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: “Abiro tieko kothu, nikech un; abiro mieno wen mag chiayo mutimonago misengni e nyasi mau e pat wengeu kendo anariembu kubakoru gi wen kamano.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Abimelek noluongo Isaka mopenje niya, “Kwerie ka dhakoni ok chiegi! Angʼo ma omiyo niwacho, ‘Ni en nyaminu’?” Isaka nodwoke niya, “Nikech ne aparo ni anyalo wito ngimana nikech en.”
english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

kikuyu: Bende ineno gima gitimo e mier mag Juda kod yore mag Jerusalem?
english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka chier mar joma otho biro chalo. Ringruok ma iyiko en gima tow, to ichiere ka en gima ok tow.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

kikuyu: Ka gidhi, to abiro bolo goka kuomgi; analwargi piny ka winy mafuyo malo. Ka anenogi ka gichokore kanyakla, to anamakgi duto.
english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

kikuyu: Ochango joma chunygi tuo kendo othiedho adhondegi.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

kikuyu: Kane wuode Isaka nigi ndalo aboro, Ibrahim notere nyangu kaka Nyasaye nochike.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

kikuyu: “Kaw kamba mane ingʼiewo kendo itweyo e nungoni, kendo idhi Perath mi ipande kanyo e bur manie kind lwanda.”
english: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”

kikuyu: To negichako gidwoke kendo niya, “Ruoth mondo onyis jotichne lek moseleko, eka wabiro nyise tiende.”
english: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

kikuyu: Ee Wuora, nimar mano ema ne berni kotimore.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata momulo ngʼato ma dende chwerno nyaka luok lepe kod dende, kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Nikech initim winjruok gi kite manie lowo, kendo le mag bungu nobed kodi gi kwe.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

kikuyu: Penj-gi ni, ‘Uparo ni oheru moloyo joma moko? Dhiuru e bur mondo un bende uriwru gi jogo mane osetho chon.’
english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

kikuyu: Jehu biro nego ngʼato angʼata motony e ligangla mar Hazael kendo Elisha biro nego ngʼato angʼata motony e ligangla Jehu.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

kikuyu: An gi weche mangʼeny monego andikni, to ok adwar ndikonigi e baruwani. Kar timo kamano to ageno limi mondo awuo kodi wangʼ gi wangʼ eka mor marwa norom chuth.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Omiyo dhano nodwok piny kendo ogendini duto nogol tekogi, kendo timbe jonjore notieki.
english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

kikuyu: “Bende wabiro kelo e kar keno mar od Nyasaye gik machalo kaka; chiembwa mokwongo mar lowo, chiwo mar chambwa, olembe mar yiendwa duto kod divai manyien; chiembwa mokwongo mar lowo, chiwo mar chambwa, olembe mag yiendwa duto kod divai manyien gi mo ni jodolo. Kendo wabiro kelo achiel kuom apar mag chambwa ni jo-Lawi, nikech gin ema oyienigi choko achiel kuom apar e mier duto ma watiyoe.
english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo machiegni gi kama yo kadhogo e tiend Got Zeituni, oganda maduongʼ mar jopuonjre nochako pako Nyasaye gi ilo kod dwol maduongʼ kuom honni duto mane giseneno niya,
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

kikuyu: Bangʼe yiende manie bungu nower, giniwer gi mor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nikech obiro ngʼadone piny bura.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

kikuyu: Ruoth Arad ma ja-Kanaan, mane odak Negev mar Kanaan, nowinjo ni jo-Israel biro.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Manase biro chamo Efraim kendo Efraim nocham Manase; giduto ginibed wasik Juda. Kata ka magi duto osetimore, to mirimbe pod ok orumo kuomgi kendo pod odhi nyime mana gikumogi.
english: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: En angʼo manyalo pogowa gihera mar Kristo? Dobed masira, koso chandruok, koso sand, koso kech, koso duk, koso gima rach, koso ligangla?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

kikuyu: Adiera chutho nitie joma ni chien mogik ma nobed mokwongo, to joma okwongo nobed chien mogik.”
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel ne adhi e od Shemaya wuod Delaya, ma wuod Mehetabel, mane olorne ei dalane. Nowacho niya, “We warom e od Nyasaye, ei hekalu, kendo mondo walor dhout hekalu, nikech gibiro negi gotienoni.”
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

kikuyu: Negibedo kanyo kuom ndalo mogwarore, omiyo Festo nopimo ne ruoth Agripa wach Paulo, kowachone niya, “Nitie ngʼat moro ka ma Feliks noweyo kotwe e od twech.
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

kikuyu: Ibiro ngʼogo mano matin mane ichamo kendo ibiro bedo ni iketho kindeni kuom pwoch mipuoyego.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

kikuyu: Chon nowuotho motegno, to tinde oywayo wuoth, riekone owuon ema omiyo opodho.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

kikuyu: nikech gisetimo richo e wangʼa kendo gisechwanya chakre chiengʼ mane kweregi oa Misri nyaka chil kawuono.”
english: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

kikuyu: To kata kamano Daudi noloyogi mokawo ohinga mar Sayun, ma en Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

kikuyu: pakeuru kugoyo oyieke kendo umiel, ee, pakeuru gi gita kod oporo,
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi chiayo nikech mano miyo ibedo mogak. Dhako bende kik yie mondo chiayo oterre kode, nikech mano en gima kwero.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

kikuyu: Ka jogi odhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem mondo gichiw misengini, to chunygi biro dok ni ruodhgi, ma en Rehoboam ruodh Juda. Gibiro nega mi gidog ni Ruoth Rehoboam.”
english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

kikuyu: Sani koro gimwomore kuoma nikech Nyasaye osetieko tekrena kendo ogoya gi masira.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ja-Lawi moro kane ochopo kanyo monene nokadho gi komachielo.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Opak Jehova Nyasaye! Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, yaye un jotichne, pakuru nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Ne ok onego uchungʼ e akek yore, ka ugengʼone jogegi maringo, kendo ne ok onego uchiw jogegi motony e lwet wasikgi chiengʼ chandruokgi.
english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

kikuyu: Miech jo-Babulon nodongʼ gunda, kama otwo kendo piny motimo ongoro, piny maonge ngʼama odakie, kama onge ngʼama kalo e iye.
english: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane okelo wach nodwoko niya, “Israel nolo gi jo-Filistia, kendo jolweny otho mangʼeny. Koda ka yawuoti ariyo, Hofni gi Finehas osetho, to Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye okaw modhi.”
english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

kikuyu: Usenego ji mangʼeny e dala maduongʼni mi upongʼo yorene gi ringre joma otho.
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Ok aorogi. Gikoro miriambo e nyinga. Emomiyo, anariembu kendo unulal nono, un kaachiel gi jonabi ma koronu.’ ”
english: For I have not sent them,” says the LORD, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

kikuyu: Nosewach e muma chon ni Nyasaye noket joma ok jo-Yahudi kare kuom yie kendo nolando Injili motelo ni Ibrahim niya, “Ogendini duto nogwedhi nikech in.”
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech ne ibedo gi gombo mi ilonyori duk michiwo ringre ka dhako ma jachode ni joherani, kendo ni nyisecheni mamono makwero, bende ne inego nyithindi ka misango ni nyisechegi manonogo,
english: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Gomer oseweyo dhodho Lo-Ruhama, nonywolo nyathi machielo ma wuowi.
english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

kikuyu: Berni otoyo ruoth; miye duongʼ, nikech en ruodhi.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

kikuyu: Ji moko kuomgi to nopenjore niya, “Jal ma yande oyawo wangʼ muofuni, donge nyocha onyalo gengʼo tho Lazaro?”
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

kikuyu: Magi e weche Daudi mogik: Weche mag Daudi wuod Jesse, weche ngʼat motingʼ malo gi Ngʼat Mamalo Mogik, ngʼat mowir gi Nyasach Jakobo, jawer wende mag Israel.
english: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

kikuyu: Eka negichako wuoth kendo luoro mar Jehova Nyasaye nomako mier duto mane okiewo kodgi maonge ngʼama nolawo bangʼ-gi.
english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

kikuyu: Omiyo jongʼad rieko bedo gi wichkuot kendo omiyo jongʼad bura doko joma ofuwo.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

kikuyu: Kuom mano koro onge pogruok e kind ja-Yahudi, kata ja-Yunani; wasumbini kata joma ni thuolo, chwo kata mon. Un duto koro un gimoro achiel ei Kristo Yesu.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ligangla notiek jonabi mage mag miriambo! Ginibed joma ofuwo. Ligangla notiek jolweny mage! Luoro maduongʼ nomakgi.
english: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.

kikuyu: To kuom timbene mamono osengʼanyo oweyo chikena gi yorena moloyo ogendini gi pinje mamoko molwore. Osedagi chikena kendo oweyo luwo yorena.
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

kikuyu: to anami udag kae, e piny mane amiyo kwereu mondo odagie manyaka chiengʼ.
english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato moro, kane Yesu odhi chiemo e od ja-Farisai moro marahuma, nobedo kane ingʼiye ahinya.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

kikuyu: Abiro tieko wendegi mag kokogo kendo thumbe duto migoyo mag nyatiti ok nochak owinji kendo.
english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

kikuyu: E chwiri maluwe Ben-Hadad nochoko jo-Aram modhi Afek mondo oked gi Israel.
english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

kikuyu: Osekelou kod jo-Lawi weteu duto bute, to koro sani utemo bedo jodolo bende.
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

kikuyu: Jotichne ne odhi Karmel mowachone Abigael niya, “Daudi oseorowa iri mondo wateri ire idhi ibed chiege.”
english: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”

kikuyu: Ahishar ma jatend od ruoth; Adoniram wuod Abda ma jatend tij achune.
english: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: To angʼadoni rieko mondo ibi ingʼiew kuoma dhahabu mopwodhi gi mach mondo ibed jamoko. Ngʼiew lewni marochere kuoma mondo irwakrigo oumni dugi makeloni wichkuot. Ngʼiew yath kuoma mondo ithiedh-go wangʼi mondo inen.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

kikuyu: Eka abiro goyo atungʼ mari manie lweti koracham gi asernigi manie lweti korachwich mi lwar piny.
english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

kikuyu: kendo ka ogandano mane asiemo olokore oweyo timbegi maricho, eka analok pacha mi ok anakelnegi masira mane asechano.
english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “ ‘Nikech onge ngʼama osemiyowa tich nyaka chakre okinyi.’ “Nowachonegi ni, ‘Un bende dhiuru uti e puotha mar mzabibu.’
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

kikuyu: Kata kamano, anto ok anyal ketho ni Jehova Nyasaye kuom weyo ma ok alemonu. To abiro puonjou yo maber kendo makare.
english: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

kikuyu: mar adek ne nigi marochere, to mar angʼwen ne nigi marangʼeye, kendo giduto ne gin gi teko mathoth.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

kikuyu: koa kuom jo-Lawi notelnigi gi Hashabia wuod Kemuel; koa kuom joka Harun: Zadok notelonegi;
english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

kikuyu: Chiwuru misengini mowinjore kendo genuru kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ji onego okwanwa kaka jotich Kristo, kendo kaka jorit weche mopondo mag Nyasaye.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

kikuyu: “Usewinjo ni ne owach ni, ‘Kik iterri.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

kikuyu: Kik ibut ka ngʼat marach mondo iketh od ngʼat makare, kik iyak dalane,
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

kikuyu: Ji duto modak e piny biro lamo ondiek malichno. Gin e joma nying-gi ok ondiki e kitabu mar ngima mar Nyarombo mane onegi chakre chwech piny.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

kikuyu: To Naboth nodwoke niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok dibed mamor kade amiyi puodho ma en mwandu kwerena.”
english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May the LORD forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ngʼiyo ji duto gie polo, mondo oneye ka bende nitie moro kuomgi ma nigi winjo, kata ka bende nitie moro kuomgi mamanyo Nyasaye.
english: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

kikuyu: Ok nyal ngʼiewe gi dhahabu maler mogik kendo nengone ok nyal pim gi fedha.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

kikuyu: Koro ma e sunga marwa: Chunywa miyowa ratiro ni wasedak e pinyni, to moloyo e winjruok marwa kodu, ka waluoro Nyasaye kendo ka wawuotho e ler mar adier. Ok wasedak kamano nikech waluwo rieko mar pinyni, to nikech ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

kikuyu: Mad lweti bed kuom ngʼat mobet e bathi korachwich, ma en wuod dhano misemiyo teko in iwuon.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Ne achako tije madongo kaka: Ne agero ute ne an awuon kendo apidho mzabibu e puothe.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

kikuyu: Ruodh Jarmuth, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Lakish, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

kikuyu: to onego girwakre gi timbe mabeyo mowinjore gi mon mawacho ni oluoro Nyasaye.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

kikuyu: Yor jasamuoyo olor gi kuthe, to yor ngʼat moriere tir en yo malach.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Anabed kodi, kendo ibiro nego jo-Midian duto.”
english: The LORD said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

kikuyu: Kata ka jolweny ogoyona agengʼa koni gi koni, to chunya ok bi luor; kata ka lweny otugorena, to pod abiro mana bedo gi chir.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

kikuyu: To kane askeche ochopo e od twech, ne ok giyudo jopuonjre kuno. Kuom mano negidwoko wach niya,
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

kikuyu: Roho mar Nyasaye nolor kuom Azaria wuod Oded.
english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

kikuyu: Nikech ka ngʼat man-gi yie mayomyomno oneni, in miwacho ni in gi yie motegno, kichiemo e hekalu mar nyiseche manono, donge mano nyalo ywaye mi ocham chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone niya, “Bed ka kawuono kiny naweyi idog.” Omiyo Uria noriyo Jerusalem chiengʼno gi kinyne.
english: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

kikuyu: Achomo wangʼa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ndalo duto, nikech en kende ema obiro golo tiendena mobadho omako.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

kikuyu: To ranyisigi noluw joma oyie: E nyinga giniriemb jochiende; giniwuo gi dhok manyien;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: Ok amiu chik kuom wachni, to anyisou kaka joma oikore konyo tich Nyasaye mondo atemgo herau ka bende en hera madier.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

kikuyu: Negigolo kende mag misango miwangʼoe liswa mane nitie Jerusalem kaachiel gi kende mag misango miwangʼoe ubani mi giwitogi e Holo mar Kidron.
english: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: Shimei wuod Gera, ja-Benjamin moa Bahurim, noreto kolor piny kaachiel gi jo-Juda mondo girom ni Ruoth Daudi.
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

kikuyu: Kendo ka gipuonjore maber yore mag joga kendo gikwongʼore gi nyinga, kagiwacho ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima,’ mana kaka negipuonjo joga mondo okwongʼre ne Baal, eka gibiro dak e dier joga.
english: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As the LORD lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Rael nosenywolo Josef, Jakobo nowacho ne Laban, “We adhi mondo adogi thurwa.
english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

kikuyu: Joma onego chul gin jopa bepe, jogedo kod jopa kidi. Bende konegi gingʼiew bao kod kite mopa milosogo kuonde mokethore ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

kikuyu: En misango mar pwodhruok e ketho; nikech osetimo marach e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kendo ne aneno ni tich matek duto kod ohala ma ngʼato yudo kuom tije timore mana nikech nyiego ma ngʼato nigo mar loyo nyawadgi. Ma bende onge tiende, ochalo gi lawo bangʼ yamo.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

kikuyu: E ndalono Menahem nowuok koa Tirza mondo modhi monjo Tifsa gi ji duto mane nitie e dala maduongʼ gi mier mokiewo kode nimar nodagi yawo rangeyene. Noriembo Tifsa mobaro iye mon ma yach duto.
english: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

kikuyu: watimo kamano nikech wasewinjo yie ma un-go kuom Kristo Yesu, kendo hera ma uherogo joma oyie duto,
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Eka Shafan nokawo kitabuno motere ni ruoth mowachone niya, “Jodongi tiyo tije duto mane osemigi.
english: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.

kikuyu: To kinyne nokawo nanga mapek mobudo e pi, mi oumo wangʼ ruoth mothungʼe nyaka otho. Eka Hazael nobedo ruoth kare.
english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kane odongʼ kende, jopuonjrene apar gariyo gi jomoko mane ni bute nopenje tiend ngechego.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

kikuyu: Ka turumbete mar ariyo oywak, to dhoudi mantie yo milambo nyaka chak wuoth. Ywak mar turumbeteno ema nobed ranyisi mar chako wuoth.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mane owinjo wachni ne owuoro ahinya, kapenjo niya, “Nyathini biro bedo machal nade?” Nimar lwet Ruoth ne ni kode.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

kikuyu: In kendi ema onego oluori. Koso en ngʼa manyalo chungʼ e nyimi ka mirima omaki?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ket jarit e dhoga; ketna jarit mondo okonya umo dhoga.
english: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi yo milambo; yal wach kuom jo-milambo kendo ikor wach kuom bungu manie piny milambo.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

kikuyu: Nyithindgi dongo maber mi bed gi keregi e diergi kendo nyikwagi bende nyaa ka pod gingima.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

kikuyu: Ne olos hema ma opog iye ariyo. Kama ikwongo donjoe ne iluongo ni Kama Ler, kendo kanyo noketie rachung taya gi mesa moketie makati miketo e nyim Nyasaye pile.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

kikuyu: Yaye ruodh jo-Asuria, jotendu nindo otero; ruodhi mau onindo piny mondo giywe. Jogi to okere ewi gode maonge ngʼama nyalo chokogi.
english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

kikuyu: to kane gidonjo e iye, ne ok giyudo ringre Ruoth Yesu.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Boche mogingore oime, omiyo ok onyal nenowa seche mowuotho koni gi koni e kor polo.’
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato ochano kendo onego ngʼat machielo kuom wangʼ teko, to goleuru oko mabor gi kar kendona mar misango kendo negeuru.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane odhi e dhoranga dala noyie gi Hamor kod Shekem wuode kendo chwo duto mane ni e dalano noter nyangu.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Kapok nembe kobetie, nonywola kata ka sokni mopongʼ gi pi ne onge.
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

kikuyu: To achien jo-Israel nokwayo mondo omigi ruoth, mi Nyasaye nomiyogi Saulo wuod Kish, ma ja-dhood Benjamin. Saulo nobedo ruodh pinyno kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

kikuyu: Kenan, Mahalalel. Mahalalel nonywolo Jared,
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

kikuyu: Nimar ok atim gima ber ma adwaro mondo atim to asiko atimo mana gima rach.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

kikuyu: Samson nodhi Timna kendo noneno nyako ma pod tin ma nyar jo-Filistia.
english: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Paruru wachni kendo kik wiu wil kaka ne ujimbo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye e thim. Kochakore chiengʼ mane uwuok Misri ma uchopo ka, usebedo mana ka ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

kikuyu: To jo-Kaftor mane oa Kaftor noriembo jo-Avi mabor nyaka e gwenge mag Gaza, mi koro gidak kanyo.)
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

kikuyu: “ ‘Losuru nyoroche, nikech piny opongʼ gi remo mosechwer, kendo dala maduongʼ opongʼ gi mahundu.
english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar angʼwen chiwuru rwedhi apar, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Koro ok wanachak wabed kaka nyithindo mayom yom, ma bagni koni gi koni nikech yamb puonj mayoreyore, ma dhano molal siekogo mondo giwuondwago kendo gigolwago oko e yie madiera.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

kikuyu: Eka chunya nobed mamor kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo anabed gimor kuom warruokne.
english: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

kikuyu: Wachni en wach madiera. Kendo adwaro ni ijiw wechegi mondo joma oseketo genogi kuom Nyasaye otangʼ mondo gichiwre mar timo gik mabeyo. Gigi gin gik malongʼo chuth, kendo kelo konyruok ne ji duto.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nochweyo dhano gi lowo kendo nokudho muya mar ngima ei ume, mi dhano nobedo mangima.
english: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

kikuyu: Onge jalweny ma dwodore gi weche mag dala nimar odwaro mondo obed malongʼo kowinjo jatende ma chike.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

kikuyu: E sechego jopuonjrene noduogo, kendo ne giwuoro kane giyude kowuoyo gi dhako. To onge ngʼama nopenjo niya, “Angʼo midwaro kuom dhakoni?” kata niya, “Iwuoyo kode nangʼo?”
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jonathan nokwongʼore gi joka Daudi, kowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye mondo ongʼad bura ne wasik Daudi.”
english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “The LORD will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

kikuyu: Wachneuru ruodh Juda, mane oorou mondo upenja gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel wacho kaluwore gi weche musewinjo.
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,

kikuyu: Isako itwa gi puonj manyien mapok wawinjo, omiyo wadwaro ngʼeyo tiendgi.”
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka oseluok law mopurno, jadolo nyaka none, kendo kapok lawno oloko kite obedo ni pok olandore, en gima ogak. Nyaka wangʼe gi mach kata obedo ni kama opurno ni yo ka oko kata yo ka iye.
english: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

kikuyu: Dok ne ngʼato kayiem ka oketho ok ber, to ngʼato biro timo marach mana ni mondo oyud asoya matin.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

kikuyu: To donge wan duto wan gi Wuoro achiel? Donge Nyasaye achiel ema nochweyowa? Kare en angʼo momiyo waketho singruok mar wuonewa, ka waonge gi winjruok e kindwa ngʼato gi ngʼato?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

kikuyu: Ok ber chamo mor kich mathoth, kata ok en gima longʼo mondo ngʼato odwar luor monego miye owuon.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

kikuyu: Wan gi kendo mar misango ma jodolo ma pod tiyo e Hema Maler ok oyienegi chamo misengini motimie.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

kikuyu: Eka Paulo noa e sinagogi modhi e ot moro mane okiewo machiegni gi sinagogi. Wuon odno ne iluongo ni Titio Justo, kendo ne en ngʼat moluoro Nyasaye.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

kikuyu: Yesuni ne ochiw e lwetu kaluwore gi chenro mar Nyasaye kod ngʼeyone mongirore, makmana un kukonyoru gi joma timbegi richo, ne unege ka ugure gi musmal e msalaba.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

kikuyu: Paruru chi Lut!
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nogwedho odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo mi owale obedo maler, nimar odiechiengno ema noyweyoe bangʼ tieko duto.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

kikuyu: To ka nosegony chokruok mondo odhiyo, jo-Yahudi mangʼeny gi ji ma nolokore oluwo din jo-Yahudi noluwo Paulo gi Barnaba, kendo negimedo wuoyo kodgi ka gijiwogi mondo gimed dhi nyime e ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

kikuyu: Pinje Gilead modongʼ duto kod Bashan, pinyruodh Og, ne amiyo nus mar dhood jo-Manase. (E gwenge duto mag Argob man Bashan, nosebedo kiluongo ni piny jo-Refai.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Negilamo nyiseche manono, kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye nowachonegi niya, “Kik utim kamano.”
english: and they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”

kikuyu: Eka jogi, ma gin rombegi mikwayo, biro paki nyaka chiengʼ, kendo wabiro nyiso pakni, koa e tiengʼ moro nyaka tiengʼ machielo.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirone kawacho niya, “Ngʼatni ok nobed jacham girkeni magi, to wuowi ma owuok e ringri iwuon ema nobed jacham girkeni magi.”
english: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

kikuyu: Ne ochayo singruok kuom ketho winjruok. Nikech ne ok orito singruok mane osetimo, ok enotonyne kum.
english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

kikuyu: Enogo kuomgi koko matek ma ok oweyonigi thuolo, kolawogi matek gi tekone maduongʼ.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

kikuyu: kendo koa e Got Hor nyaka Lebo Hamath. Eka tongʼno nodhi nyaka Zedad,
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo gangʼwen mar dweno, jo-Israel nochokore kanyakla, ka gitweyo chiemo kendo ka girwako pien gugru ka gibuko wiyegi gi buru.
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

kikuyu: “To un kik uyie oluongu ni, ‘Rabi,’ nimar un gi Ruoth achiel kende, to un duto un owete.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nolor e bor polo mi owuoyo kode, kendo nokawo teko moko mane osemiye mi omiyo jodongo piero abiriyogo. Kane Roho odonjo kuomgi, ne gikoro wach, to bangʼ mano ne ok gichako gitimo kamano kendo.
english: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

kikuyu: Wayieruru kendwa gima nikare; wapuonjreuru kaachiel kuom gima ber.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

kikuyu: Wuoda, rit wechena kendo ipand chikena e chunyi.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie owete moko abiriyo. Wuowi makayo nokendo dhako, to notho ka ok onywolo nyathi.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

kikuyu: Mad ywakna chopi e nyimi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; mi abed gi winjo kaluwore gi wachni.
english: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

kikuyu: Jayalo wacho niya, “Ngima en gima nono! Chutho en gima nono! Gik moko duto onge tiendgi!”
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

kikuyu: Isemiyo tungena odoko ma roboche ka tunge jowi; oseol kuoma modhi maliw.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Yie mondo kidwogo e duongʼni maler to iket achiel kuomwa obed e badi korachwich to machielo e badi koracham.”
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye en chiengʼ kendo en okumba; Jehova Nyasaye chiwo ngʼwono gi duongʼ; ok otuon joma wuodhgi oriere tir gimoro amora maber.
english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ka ilokori iweyo richoni, anaduogi mondo itina; ka iwacho weche mowinjore, ma ok manono, to ni inibed ngʼat ma wuoyo e loya. We jogi oduog ira, to in kik idog irgi.
english: Therefore the LORD says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.

kikuyu: Donge Hezekia owuon nomuko kuonde motingʼore mar lemo kod kende mag misango mag nyasayeni kowachone jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem ni, ‘Nyaka ulam e nyim kendo mar misango achiel kendo unuwangʼ misango mau e wiye’?
english: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

kikuyu: Ok othir ngʼato angʼata to odwoko gima osingne kar hola momiyo ngʼato Ok omaa ngʼato gire githuon, to omiyo joma odenyo chiemo kendo ochiwo lewni ne joma ni duk.
english: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

kikuyu: Jaoteno nowachone Daudi niya, “Jogo nochako loyowa mi giwuok e pap mondo giked kodwa to ne wariembogi ma wadwokogi chien nyaka e dhoranga dala maduongʼ.
english: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

kikuyu: “Bende negioro joote mondo odhi oluong chwo moa e piny mabor mi jogo nobiro. Eka mon ariyogo noluokore mi owiro wangʼ-gi kendo olichore gi gik ma nengogi tek.
english: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,

kikuyu: To ka ok uchiko itu, anaywagi apanda nikech sunga magu; wengena noywagi malit, ka gipongʼ gi pi wangʼ, nikech rombe mag Jehova Nyasaye noter e twech.
english: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.

kikuyu: Timbeu manono osemedore, molokore gima ingʼadonugo bura. Onge ngʼama ibiro we kuom ji, kata kuom ogandano, kata mwandu, kata gimoro amora maber notieki.
english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

kikuyu: Kane iya owangʼ, kendo chunya winjo lit,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

kikuyu: Omiyo noa malo gotieno mi okawo nyathi gi min mare kendo nowuok modhi Misri,
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

kikuyu: Aparo nyingi gotieno, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo abiro rito chikni.
english: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

kikuyu: Piny mantiere e dho nam kama jo-Kereth odakie biro bedo kar jokwath kendo kama ogerie abich rombe.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

kikuyu: “Nyako ngili biro mako ich minywol wuowi, mi nigiluonge ni Imanuel” (tiende ni, “Nyasaye ni kodwa”).
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi chi wadgi ma gidakgo, to jochode ariyogo nyaka neg-gi duto.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Ka gigi mag ohala ne ikwangʼo e nembe to ne pinje mangʼeny obedo mamor, imiyo ruodhi mangʼeny mag pinje odoko jomoko gi mwandugi mathoth kod gigi mag ohala.
english: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.

kikuyu: Kane odwogo to ne onyiso wuon-gi gi min-gi niya, “Aseneno nyar jo-Filistia modak Timna; omiyo koro kelnagouru obed chiega.”
english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife.”

kikuyu: Ywak osemiyo wangʼa olokore makwar, kendo wangʼa osiko neno mana mudho;
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

kikuyu: “Kuonde mag kwath molworo mier ma umiyo jo-Lawi nopim maromo fut alufu achiel mia angʼwen gi piero abiriyo gauchiel koa e kor ohinga.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

kikuyu: Winjuru wachni, un jotelo mag dhood Jakobo, un jotelo mag dhood Israel, un ma usin gadiera kendo uriambo,
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

kikuyu: Asaf ne jatendgi, Zekaria jalupne, kiluwogi kod Jeyel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Matithia, Eliab, Benaya, Obed-Edom gi Jeyel mane jogo orutu gi nyatiti ka Asaf to ne dwongʼo ongengʼo
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

kikuyu: Nobedo ruodh Israel duto higni piero angʼwen, higni abiriyo ne en Hebron, to higni piero adek gadek ne en Jerusalem.
english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “We luor, yaye in ngʼat ma Nyasaye ogeno ahinya. Bed gi kwe! Yud teko sani, bed motegno.” Ne ayudo teko e sa mane owuoyoe kodano, kendo nawacho niya, “Ruodha, wuo awuoya, nikech koro iseduogona teko.”
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

kikuyu: Ywaguru ka ukuyo ka dhako ma pod tin ma orwakore gi law kuyo, ka oywago chwore mane ohange.
english: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!

kikuyu: Jatheth ema keto chuma e mach mi chwakre bangʼe ogoye gi nyundo, kolosogo nyasaye manono, kendo oloso gi tekone duto. Bangʼ mano obedo modenyo kendo mool; bende obedo monyosore kendo riyo loye.
english: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru malongʼo ni onge ngʼat ma terore, kata ma timbene richo, kata ma jawuoro, to ngʼat matimo gigi lamo nyiseche manono, omiyo ok noyud gweth mar pinyruoth Kristo gi Nyasaye.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mane onywolie, pendi ne ok ongʼadi, kata luok ne ok olwoki gi pi mondo ibed maler, to bende ne ok owiri gi chumbi kendo ne ok oboyi gi lewni.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gochiko mar loch Asa, tuo nogoye gi e tiende, kendo kata obedo ni tuoneno ne lich to e tuoneno ne ok omanyo kony ir Jehova Nyasaye to mana kuom jothieth.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek the LORD, but just the physicians.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua noluongo ji apar gariyo mane oseyiero koa kuom jo-Israel, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot,
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

kikuyu: We ipuonjri rieko kuom joma chon mondo iyud rieko kod ngʼeyo mane gin-go?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

kikuyu: Useweyo Chike Nyasaye mi koro umako mana puonj ma kwereu machon noweyonu.”
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Ibrahim ochiwo wuode ma Isaka kaka misango kane Nyasaye oteme mondo otim kamano. Jal mane oyudo singruokno noikore mar chiwo wuode achiel makende,
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

kikuyu: To Ruoth Solomon ibiro gwedhi kendo kom loch mar Daudi biro siko kogurore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before the LORD forever.”

kikuyu: Jonadab nowachone ruoth niya, “Ne yawuot ruoth osechopo ka; otimore mana kaka jatichni nowacho.”
english: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

kikuyu: Wiye chalo dhahabu maler, yie wiye beyo kendo boyo, bende yie wiyego ratengʼ ka yie agak.
english: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.

kikuyu: Waduto wasebedo ka jok mogak, kendo timbewa duto mabeyo chalo mana gi lewni mochido; waduto wasener mana ka it oboke, kendo richowa mamono kwadhowa oko mabor mana ka yamo.
english: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

kikuyu: Owetene ne nyiego omako kode, to wuon-gi to ne okano wechego e chunye.
english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye notimonegi ngʼwono, kech kod miwafu koparo singruok mane otimo gi Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo. To nyaka chil kawuono Jehova Nyasaye pok obedo gi paro mar tiekogi kata riembogi e wangʼe.
english: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gabiriyo mar loch Peka wuod Remalia, Ahaz wuod Jotham ruodh Juda nobedo ruoth.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: To jo-Israel nojiwore kendgi giwegi kendo negichako giriedo jolwenjgi kaka negisetimo chiengʼ mokwongo.
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

kikuyu: Mad nyithinde lokre jokwecho mabayo abaya; mad riembgi gia koda ka e miechgi mosekethore.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye nooronegi jonabi mondo odwokgi ire kendo osiemgi malit, to ne gidagi winjo.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to the LORD, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

kikuyu: Negibiro ka gitetni; kendo ka chunygi ool, ka gia kuondegi mag pondo.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

kikuyu: Inilame kendo enowinji, kendo inichop singruok duto mane itimo.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye puonjo dhano rieko, to bedo mamuol kelo luor.
english: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma ema nobednu ranyisi ni anakumu kaeni, mondo omi ungʼe ni gima asechano timonu notimre.’
english: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’

kikuyu: Yesu nokwere matek niya, “Lingʼ thi! Wuogi ia kuome!” Eka jachien nogoyo ngʼatno piny e nyimgi duto kendo nowuok ma ok ohinye.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

kikuyu: “Ngʼatno manotem tony nikech masira nolwar e bur matut, ngʼatno manotem kawuok ei bur matut, nomak gi obadho; nimar anakel magi kuom Moab e higa mar kum,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka osiepe Ayub adek mane gin Elifaz ja-Teman gi Bildad ja-Shua kod Zofar Ja-Namath nowinjo chandruok duto mane en-go, ne giwuok ka gia e miechgi kendo ne giwinjore mondo girom kaachiel mondo gidhi gitimne mos kendo gihoye.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

kikuyu: Koko nolandore e dala duto kendo negimako Gayo gi Aristarko ma jo-Makedonia mane jowuodh Paulo kendo ne gimwomore kuomgi ka gichiko pawgi mar tugo.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

kikuyu: Bedene auchiel nochwogore gi e kore ka adek nitie konchiel kendo adek nitie komachielo.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

kikuyu: “Los laru ne Hemb Romono. Yo milambo mar laruno borne norom mita piero angʼwen gauchiel kendo onego obed gi pasia momin molos gi law mayom,
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

kikuyu: “To un musejwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye kendo wiu osewil kod goda maler, un mupedho mesa mar misengini, kendo uloso sewni ne nyiseche manono.
english: “But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

kikuyu: To kane giywakne Jehova Nyasaye, nochiwonegi jakony, ma en Othniel wuod Kenaz, owadgi Kaleb matin, mane oresogi.
english: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

kikuyu: Enoket ogut ngʼwono e wiyi kendo nosidhni osimbo mar duongʼ.”
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

kikuyu: mor kich gi chak mopoto, rombe, cha dhiangʼ mopoto mongʼin ni Daudi gi joge mondo ocham. Nimar negiwacho niya, “Jogi osebedo mool kendo riyo ohewogi e thim.”
english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ngʼato ma ok orwako pinyruoth Nyasaye kaka nyathi matin ok nodonji ngangʼ.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Naftali: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: kod le mager gi jamni duto gi le matindo gi winy mafuyo,
english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

kikuyu: Chiw nyarombo achiel gokinyi to machielo godhiambo,
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

kikuyu: nimar ji biro winjo humb nyingi maduongʼ gi mar lweti maratego kod badi marabora moriere, ka gibiro ma gilemo ka gichomo hekaluni
english: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

kikuyu: Ka jaricho oketi e teko mondo otel, ji dhiyo kar pondo; to ka jaricho otho joma kare dhiyo nyime.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

kikuyu: “Gima jogi luongo ni andhoga Kik uluong ni andhoga; bende kik iluor gik ma giluoro kendo kik gibwogi.
english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

kikuyu: Ok abi wuoyo kodu amingʼa nimar ruodh pinyni biro, to oonge gi teko kuoma.
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

kikuyu: Kar romb dhood Asher ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen gachiel gi mia abich (41,500).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Geruru kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ma en kendo mar misango molos gi kite. Kitego kik paa gi chuma.
english: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato kuomu tuo, to onego oluong jodong kanisa mondo olamne kendo owire gi mo e nying Ruoth.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

kikuyu: To awachonu ni chiengʼ ngʼado bura weche nobed maberber ne Turo gi Sidon moloyou.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nowachone niya, “Ere kaka inyalo wacho ni ihera to ok inyal nyisa kuma tekoni ae? Ma koro en mar adek ma iseketa ka ngʼama ofuwo kendo pod ok inyisa kuma tekoni ae.”
english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”

kikuyu: Keila, Akzib kod Maresha. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo ochiko.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Un to uwacho ni ka ngʼato owacho ne wuon kata ne min ni, ‘Kony moro amora ma dine uyudo koa kuoma koro en Koban’ (tiende ni, mich mowal ne Nyasaye),
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

kikuyu: Koro Musa nohero kawo Hema kendo gure oko mar Kambi mochwalore matin koluonge ni “Hemb Romo.” Ngʼato angʼata mane dwaro penjo Jehova Nyasaye wach ne dhi e Hemb Romo oko mar kambi.
english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

kikuyu: En ngʼa moseyie wach ma walando, koso en ngʼa ma Jehova Nyasaye osenyiso tekone?
english: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nobwok omiyo nokwayo Jehova Nyasaye kendo nochiko jo-Juda duto mondo otwe chiemo.
english: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek the LORD. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

kikuyu: nikech timbe maricho magisetimo. Negimiya mirima ma iya owangʼ kuom wangʼo ubani kendo lamo nyiseche manono ma gin kata un kata wuoneu ne ok ongʼeyo.
english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

kikuyu: Dendwa owre mana ka mach nikech tuo ma kech kelonwa.
english: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

kikuyu: chwore nodhi ire mondo olombe gi wach oduogi. Ne en-gi jatichne kod punde ariyo. Notere nyaka e od wuon mare, kendo ka wuon mare nonene, norwake gi mor.
english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

kikuyu: Piny mane omi Efraim kaka girkenino bende notingʼo mier moko mane ni e gwengʼ Manase.
english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi kod joge nochiewo gokinyi mangʼich ma gidok e piny jo-Filistia, ka jo-Filistia to dhi Jezreel.
english: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

kikuyu: Obiro moko mach kuom hekalu mag nyiseche mag Misri; enowangʼ hekalu mag-gi kendo enoter nyisechigi e twech. Kaka jakwath tweyo lepe e nungone, e kaka notwe Misri kuome owuon kendo noa kanyo ma ok ohinyore.
english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

kikuyu: Kuom adier, yaye Nyasaye, isedwoka piny mogik, isetieko joga duto pep.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

kikuyu: Dwache maricho mopando e chunye omiyo osungore; jowuoche ema ogwedho to Jehova Nyasaye to ochayo.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka oganda mar jo-Israel duto noa e nyim Musa,
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

kikuyu: Oseketo gik moko duto obedo maber e kindegi. Oseketo ngima mochwere e chuny ji; kata kamano ok ginyal paro matut gima Nyasaye osetimono aa chakruok nyaka giko.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

kikuyu: Negikawo Yesu gitero ir jadolo maduongʼ mi jodolo madongo duto gi jodongo kaachiel gi jopuonj chik nochokore kaachiel.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

kikuyu: Odongʼ kinde matin to piny ok bi nena kendo. Un to pod ubiro nena, kendo ubiro bedo mangima nikech angima.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

kikuyu: Jogi e joma ne ok odwanyore gi mon, to ne giritore maler. Giluwo bangʼ Nyarombo kamoro amora modhiye. Nongʼiewgi kigologi kuom ji migichalo kaka olembe mokwongo chiek michiwo ni Nyasaye kod Nyarombo.
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bigvai, Uthai kod Zakur, kaachiel kodgi ji piero abiriyo.
english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

kikuyu: Dwok ngʼat mofuwo koluwore gi fupe, dipo ka obiro nenore e wangʼe owuon ni oriek.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Ka chiayo mane osingono obedo mogak ma ok nyal timgo misango ni Jehova Nyasaye, to chiayono chuno ni nyaka kele e nyim jadolo,
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

kikuyu: “Nikech timbegi mag anjawo e Gilgal, ne ok aherogi kanyo. Nikech timbegi mag richo, abiro riembgi oko e oda. Ok anachak ahergi; jotendgi duto gin joma timbegi richo.
english: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.

kikuyu: Yawuot Nearia ne gin: Elioenai, Hizkia kod Azrikam; giduto ne gin yawuowi adek.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

kikuyu: Sa moro amora mane gidonjo e Hemb Romo kata kane gidhi machiegni gi kendo mar misango to ne gilwoko lwetgi gi tiendegi mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ji ne chiemo kendo metho, chwo ne kendo bende nyiri ne ikendo nyaka nochopo odiechiengʼ mane Nowa odonjo e yie. Eka pi mar ataro nobiro motieko ji duto.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: Mokwongo nowacho niya, “Misengini kod chiwo, kata misengini miwangʼo pep kod chiwo migologo richo ne ok idwar kendo ne ok imor kodgi.” Kata obedo ni chik ne dwaro ni otimgi kamano.
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

kikuyu: nikech nopuonjo jopuonjrene. Nowachonegi niya, “Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi keti e lwet ji. Gibiro nege, to bangʼ ndalo adek obiro chier.”
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Ka nangʼicho oko gie dirisa mar oda,
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

kikuyu: mondo yoreni ongʼere e piny, kendo ogendini duto oyud warruokne.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

kikuyu: “ ‘Chakre odiechiengʼ moluwo Sabato, mane ukeloe mich mar cham moyiedhi, to nyaka ukwan ma une ni oromo jumbe abiriyo.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

kikuyu: To koro, nyara, kik ibed maluor. Abiro timoni gimoro amora mikwayo. Jo-dalawa duto ongʼeyo ni in dhako ma kite ber.
english: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.

kikuyu: Omiyo negimiyo jo-Benjamin chik, kagiwacho niya, “Dhiuru kendo upondi e puothe mzabibu
english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

kikuyu: ka kindeno nochopi nochano mondo oket gik moko duto manie polo gi piny e bwo loch achiel, ma en Kristo.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kikuyu: Pwodhreuru ubed maler nikech An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Ka omako pige to oro mako piny; to koweyogi thuolo to giketho piny.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

kikuyu: Garago gi gik mongʼinore kolemogo nokikore e riak lawno alwora mondo orwake kitimo tich dolo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Omiyo nodwoko ruoth niya, “Ngʼama ruoth morgo mar miyo duongʼ,
english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowachone niya, “An Nyasaye ma Nyasach wuonu. Kik iluor dhi Misri, nikech anami ibedi oganda maduongʼ kuno.
english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi malaika mane loso koda gi weche mangʼwon kod weche mag hoch.
english: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano noriembogi gia e od bura.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

kikuyu: Anakaw jo-Juda modongʼ mane oramo ni nyaka dhi Misri mondo gidak kanyo. Giduto ginirum Misri; noneg-gi gi ligangla kata ginitho nikech kech. Kochakore ngʼat matin nyaka ngʼat maduongʼ, noneg-gi gi ligangla kata gi kech. Ginibed gir kwongʼ kod bwok, joma ongʼadnegi bura kendo mijaro.
english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.

kikuyu: Jogo malawowa nikodwa machiegni; waol kendo waonge yweyo.
english: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

kikuyu: Ka nowinjo ma, nobedo mokuyo ahinya, nikech ne en ngʼat man-gi mwandu mathoth ahinya.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

kikuyu: Jaherana rieny kendo rapudo, oloyo chwo alufu apar.
english: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.

kikuyu: Jo-Misri nokwayo jo-Israel mondo owuog owe pinygi piyo kagiwacho niya, “Ka ok uwuok to waduto wabiro tho!”
english: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

kikuyu: Eka muya nokudho wangʼa, mi yier denda duto nojuol.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar aboro, e dwe mar aboro ne en Sibekai ja-Hushath ma ja-Zera. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye! Mano kaka en gima ber wero wende pak ne Nyasachwa, mano kaka en gima longʼo kendo mowinjore mondo ji opake!
english: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho to piny mane miyo nolokore kama otwo; dalane duto nokethi e nyim mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mager.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of the LORD, before his fierce anger.

kikuyu: Roho gi miaha wacho niya, “Bi!” To ngʼat mowinjo, bende owach niya, “Bi!” Ngʼama riyo oloyo, mondo obi, kendo ngʼat mohero, mondo obi oyud pi ngima mochiw nono.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

kikuyu: To mogik, jowetena, keturu pachu kuom gik moko duto madiera kendo mowinjore kaka: weche malongʼo kod weche maler, weche makare, kod weche mabeyo, weche mangʼwon kod weche mipuoyo.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

kikuyu: Bende miaha diwiye wil gi gik molichorego, kata nyako midhi kendo gi lepe mag kisera? Joga to wigi osewil koda, odiechienge ma ok kwan.
english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

kikuyu: Wenge makoro nena sani ok nochak onena kendo, gibiro dwara to ok gininena.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

kikuyu: Negidhawo gi Musa kagiwacho niya, “Mad ne bed ni watho e kinde mane owetewa otho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye!
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!

kikuyu: Penj ane sani gik mane timore chon, ndalo mane pok onywolu, kochakore e ndalo mane Nyasaye ochweyo dhano e piny; penj ane koa e bath polo konchiel nyaka komachielo. Bende gima duongʼ kama osetimore kata gima chal kama osewinji?
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

kikuyu: En ema obiro gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kolocho e kom duongʼ mare. Enobed jadolo e kom duongʼne, kendo ginibed gi winjruok e kindgi ji ariyogo.’
english: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

kikuyu: Ere oganda machielo ma ogen man kod nyasachgi machiegni e yo ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa chiegnigo kodwa e yo moro amora ma walame?
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehoshafat gi joge nodhi mondo giyak mwandu kendo neginwangʼo gige lweny mangʼeny kod lewni kod gik moko ma nengogi tek mangʼeny ma ok neginyal tingʼo duto. Gik miyako ne ngʼeny ahinya mane otieko ndalo adek mondo giyakgi duto.
english: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

kikuyu: Mano kaka tijeni dongo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mano kaka pachi tut miwuoro!
english: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jakobo nodhi Misri, kuno ema kwerewa duto kaachiel gi en nothoe.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼno ok inichak ine wichkuot kaluwore gi timbe maricho mane itimona, nikech abiro golo josunga mamor gi sungagi e dala maduongʼni. Ok inichak isungri kendo, e goda maler.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

kikuyu: Pi ma aa e dapigeni biro pongʼ mao oko; kendo kothgi nochal gi pi mabubni. “Ruodhgi nobed gi teko moloyo Agag; pinyruodhgi notingʼ malo.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

kikuyu: Kik uluor ruodh Babulon, makoro uluoro. Kik uluore, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, nimar an kodu kendo anaresu ua e lwetene.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says the LORD, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

kikuyu: Eka nyar Farao nodhi e aora Nael mondo olwokre, ka jotichne to ne wuotho e geng aora. Nyar Farao noneno oserano ka ni e kind odundu, mine ooro jatichne ma nyako mondo ogeme.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar adek, arus moro ne nitie Kana, e piny Galili. Min Yesu ne ni kanyo,
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Nyara yieni osechangi. Dhi gi kwe kendo chandruokni mondo orum chuth.”
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

kikuyu: Jehoshafat notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike but kwerene e dala maduongʼ mar Daudi wuon-gi. Kendo Jehoram wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
