english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ji nosandre kendgi giwegi, ka ngʼato sando mana wadgi owuon bende jogo modak mokiewo nosandre kendgi giwegi. Jomatindo notug lweny gi jomadongo, kendo ji ajiya nocha joma ogen.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

kikuyu: “Wangʼ e taya mar ringri. Ka wengeni neno maber to ringri duto opongʼ gi ler.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wan e joote mag Kristo, kendo Nyasaye owuon ema wuoyo kodu kokalo kuomwa. Wakwayou ka wachungʼ kar Kristo, mondo uwinjru kod Nyasaye.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

kikuyu: Makir ne okawo dhako koa kuom jo-Hup kod Shup. Nyamin Makir ne iluongo ni Maaka. Watne machielo ne ochak Zelofehad mane onywolo nyiri kende.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

kikuyu: Eka nochiwo otene niya, “Yaye, en ngʼa manyalo bedo mangima ka Nyasaye otimo ma?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

kikuyu: Asiko aneno anena, achalo gi winyo man kende ewi osuri.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

kikuyu: Asir nonywolo Elkana, Elkana nonywolo Ebiasaf, Ebiasaf nonywolo Asir,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: Eka dhakoni nopenje niya, “En ngʼa ma idwaro mondo agolni?” Nowachne niya, “Golna Samuel.”
english: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato wiye kuot koda kod wechena e kind tiengʼ mobam kendo matimo richoni, to Wuod Dhano bende wiye nokuod kode chiengʼ manoduogi gi duongʼ mar Wuoro, kaachiel gi Malaike maler.”
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

kikuyu: Nogwedhu ka udonjo e dala kendo ka uwuok.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

kikuyu: Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Kawuru nywok maonge songa mondo utimgo misango mar golo richo, to nyaroya gi nyarombo mahikgi achiel kendo maonge songa mondo uchiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Musa noywak ni Jehova Nyasaye niya, “En angʼo mowinjore atim kod jogi? Gichiegni kata mana goya gi kite.”
english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Harun noyangʼo chiayo mar misango miwangʼo pep. Yawuote nogamone remo kendo nokiro e bethe duto mag kendo mar misango.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

kikuyu: Onindo piny ei saka kendo opondo e dier odundu motwi e thidhna.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

kikuyu: En ohala manade mane uyudo e kindeno kuom gik makoro miyou wichkuotgi? Giko mar gigo en tho!
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

kikuyu: Nimar kama ji ariyo kata adek ochokoree e nyinga to an kodgi kanyo.”
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

kikuyu: Rieko odak e chuny ngʼat ma weche donjone, to kata mana e dier joma ofuwo omiyo ingʼeye.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo Jakobo wuode chiemo molos mamit kod kuon mane osetedo.
english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo pok janabi moro owuok e Israel maromo gi Musa ngʼat mane Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo wangʼ gi wangʼ.
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Timna ngʼwono makende. Nimar isemiya puodho man Negev, miya bende thidhna mar pi.” Omiyo Kaleb nomiye thidhna ma malo kod mamwalo.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye ne ok ooro Wuode e piny mondo ongʼad ne piny bura, to noore mondo ores piny.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

kikuyu: To jokanyo mag pinyruoth to nodir oko e mudho mandiwa, kama ji nobed gi ywagruok malich ka gimwodo lekegi.”
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Filipo nodhi monyiso Andrea wachno; eka Andrea kod Filipo nodhi ir Yesu ma ginyise wachno.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

kikuyu: Nying Jehova Nyasaye en ohinga maratego, ngʼat makare ringo ma pond kanyo kendo yud resruok.
english: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mawinjo awinja wach to ok tim gima wach owacho, chalo gi ngʼama ngʼiyo lela wangʼe e rangʼi,
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

kikuyu: Beduru mamon gi timbe maricho, to heruru timbe mabeyo; ngʼaduru bura makare e ute buche. Ka utimo kamano, to dipo ka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego nyalo timo ngʼwono ni joka Josef mane otony oa e twech.
english: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

kikuyu: “Kane oyudo pod aparo kuom tungego, ne aneno tungʼ moro matin kawuok e kind tunge mamokogo; tungʼno nomuko tunge adek mane ni kanyo chon mondo omi odongi. Tungʼni ne nigi wenge machalo gi wenge dhano kod dhok ma wuoyo gi sunga.
english: “I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking arrogantly.

kikuyu: Koro ka urito chike mamiyou adimba kawuono, ka uhero Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo tiyone gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto,
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

kikuyu: Ayaroni lwetena; chunya gombi mana kaka lowo motwo gombo koth. Sela
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

kikuyu: Marangʼo jogi ongʼanyo oa? Angʼo momiyo Jerusalem siko ringo? Gimoko kuom miriambo; gitamore duogo.
english: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ onogo ja-Benjamin moro noringo koa e lweny modhi Shilo, lepe ne oyiech kendo wiye notimo buru.
english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

kikuyu: Kane Petro onene, nopenjo niya, “Ruoth, to en to?”
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka Nyasaye nomiyogi mana mich achielno ma wan bende nomiyowa kane wayie kuom Ruoth Yesu Kristo, koro an to an ngʼa ma dine agengʼ tich Nyasaye!”
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

kikuyu: Yaye, mad med ameda temo Ayub nyaka giko nikech aduokane chalo aduoka ngʼama timbene richo.
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

kikuyu: Ne oketho olembegi mag mzabibu gi pe, kod yiendegi mag ngʼowu gi yamo mangʼich.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

kikuyu: Kendo kane Jehova Nyasaye ogolou Kadesh Barnea nowacho niya, “Dhiuru mondo ukaw piny ma asemiyou.” To ne ungʼanyo ne chike mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ne ok ugeno kuome kata miye luor.
english: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

kikuyu: Nikech fwenyni rito kinde moketi; owuoyo kuom ndalo giko, kendo ok nobed miriambo. Kata obedo ni onyalo deko kapok ochopo, rite arita, adier obiro chopo ma ok odeko.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

kikuyu: Kude mag nam kod mise mag piny noelore, kane Jehova Nyasaye okwerogi kokudho gi much ume.
english: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato osesingore ne nyako moro nokendo ma ok okende? Onego odog dala nikech dipoka otho e lweny ma ngʼat machielo ema kend nyakono.”
english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

kikuyu: Jadolo moro mar jo-Midian ne nigi nyiri abiriyo, negibiro tuomo pi ka giolo e karaya mondo jamb wuon-gi omodhi.
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

kikuyu: Kuom ich wangʼ mare ne amiyou ruoth kendo e mirimba ne agole oko.
english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Menahem, gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge odikgi e kitepe weche mag ruodhi Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: nyikwa Harim, ji mia adek gi piero ariyo (320),
english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

kikuyu: Kendo ka gipenji ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo ichur?’ To iniwachnegi ni, ‘Nikech wach moro mabiro timore. Bende nyisgi ni e kindeno kihondko nomakgi kendo bedegi nowengni, mi chir ma gin-go nolal nono kendo chongegi notetni.’ Kindeno osechopo kendo gigo biro timore ma ok orem, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.”
english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: “ ‘To chiengʼno ok anahon lwangʼni e piny Goshen kama joga odakie, mi iningʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye kare anie pinyni.
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen kuomgi noket jorit tich e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, to ji alufu auchiel kuomgi to noket jotelo kod jongʼad bura.
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

kikuyu: Ji duto noyie timo kamano, makmana Jonathan wuod Asahel gi Jazeya wuod Tikva, koriwe lwedo gi Meshulam kod Shabethai ja-Lawi, ema notamore.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

kikuyu: Daudi nooro migepe adek mag jolweny: mokwongo notelne gi Joab, mar ariyo notelne gi Abishai ma owadgi Joab wuod Zeruya, mar adek notelne gi Itai ja-Giti. To ruoth nowachone migepego niya, “An bende nyaka adhi kodu.”
english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

kikuyu: Weuru tiyo ni chiemo marumo, to tiuru ni chiemo masiko nyaka chop uyud ngima mochwere, ma Wuod Dhano biro miyou. Nyasaye Wuoro oseketo kido mare kuome manyiso ni oyie kode.”
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

kikuyu: Ji duto nochau nikech an, to ngʼat ma ochungʼ motegno nyaka giko ema noresi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Giyako ute mon ma chwogi otho kendo gilamo lamo moyware mondo ginyisrego ni ji kaka gilony e lamo. Joma kamagi ibiro kum malit moloyo.”
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: To koro aseyiero Jerusalem mondo obed kama Nyinga betie kendo aseyiero Daudi mondo otel ni joga Israel.’
english: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

kikuyu: to min-gi nowuoyo kendo owacho niya, “Ooyo! Ibiro luonge ni Johana.”
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

kikuyu: Nyakono ne ber ahinya kendo norito ruoth kotiyone to kata kamano ruoth ne ok oriwore kode kaka dhako.
english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo dhako niya, “Ma en angʼo ma isetimo?” Dhako nodwoke niya, “Thuol nowuonda, mi achamo olemo.”
english: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

kikuyu: To ka gik moko duto ohul e lela to gi yangore maler nikech ler ema miyo ineno gik moko duto.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

kikuyu: Obiro nywolo wuowi, kendo nyaka imiye nying ni Yesu, nikech obiro waro joge kogolo e richo.”
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

kikuyu: Joma ochayo ji jara ma ok obadhogi to kata kamano ok alokra awe chikeni.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

kikuyu: Ji nowuoth kadawo kochakore nyandwat e dho nam achiel nyaka dho nam machielo kendo ginidigni chakre yo nyandwat nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ, ka gimanyo kama digiyudie wach Jehova Nyasaye, to ok giniyudi kata matin.
english: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD’s word, and will not find it.

kikuyu: “Uywak ni, ‘Yaye ligangla mar Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro yweyo nyaka karangʼo? Dog ei olaloni; chungʼ kendo ilingʼ thi.’
english: “‘You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’

kikuyu: “Ma to en ngʼa ma umo riekona gi weche mofuwo?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

kikuyu: Jo-Israel mondo obed mamor gi jachwechgi; ee, jo-Sayun mondo obed mamor gi Ruodhgi.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

kikuyu: Ngʼuti chalo gi osuch Daudi, mochungʼ tir gi chia; kuode alufu achiel oliero kuome, ma kargi duto gin kuodi mag jokedo.
english: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.

kikuyu: Nochoko jonabi kod jo-Lawi kanyakla achiel kowachonegi niya, Dhiuru e miech Juda kendo usol pesa ma jo-Israel owinjore ogol higa ka higa mondo walosgo hekalu mar Nyasachu. Neuru ni utimo mano mapiyo. To jo-Lawi ne ok otimo mapiyo.
english: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

kikuyu: Joma oketo genogi kuome rieny; ok gi bi neno wichkuot.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi ne gin: nyikwa Jeshua (mowuok e dhood Kadmiel kokalo kuom Hodavia), ji piero abiriyo gangʼwen (74).
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

kikuyu: “Wal jo-Lawi e kind jo-Israel mamoko kendo pwodhgi gibed maler.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

kikuyu: Omiyo we nyithindgi kech oka; bolgi e teko mar ligangla. We mondegi obed maonge nyithindo kendo mon ma chwogi otho; mad chwogi negi, rowere mag-gi negi gi ligangla e kedo.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joab ne odhi ir ruoth mowachone niya, “Isetimo angʼoni? Ne, Abner ne obiro iri, to angʼo momiyo iweye odhi? Koro osedhi!
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

kikuyu: Juda bende noked Jerusalem. Mwandu mag pinje duto molworo dalano nochoki, ma gin dhahabu, fedha kod lewni mogundho.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Wuoro nigi teko mar miyo ji ngima, e kaka osemiyo Wuowi bende teko mar timo kamano.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

kikuyu: Kane aluongo to ne idwoka, kendo ne imiyo abedo gi chir kod chuny motegno.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

kikuyu: Joma nochokore duto mane oa Juda kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi kod joma nochokore koa Israel kaachiel gi jodak mane odak Israel kod mane odak Juda ne mor gi ilo.
english: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Magi ema nobed chike miluwo kitimo misengini miwangʼo pep kod remo mikiro ewi kendo mar misango e kinde migere:
english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

kikuyu: Eka Jehu noywayo atungʼ modiro asere kendo ochwoyo kind ngʼede Joram. Asere nopowo dho chunye molwar piny oa ewi gache.
english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

kikuyu: negikawo jolweny mag-gi duto mi gidhi mondo giked gi Ishmael wuod Nethania. Ne gijuke but pi maduongʼ man Gibeon.
english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

kikuyu: Gilead nodongʼ loka Jordan. To angʼo momiyo Dan nogalore but meli? Asher to nodongʼ e dho nam mi gidak e dho wedhe kuma yiedhi gowe.
english: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.

kikuyu: Kanyo ema winy geroe utegi, winj nyamnaha nigi utegi ewi yiende mag obudo.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

kikuyu: Ruoth gi jodonge ne mor gi rieko mane ongʼadni, eka ruoth notimo kaka Memukan nowacho.
english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

kikuyu: Me Jarkon kod Rakon, to gi kama omanyore gi Jopa.
english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

kikuyu: Nimar Jal ma Nyasaye oseoro wacho weche Nyasaye, nikech Nyasaye chiwo Rohone mogundho ma ok ongʼwonyo lwete.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

kikuyu: “Nitie jogo makwongʼo wuonegi kendo ok gwedh minegi;
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

kikuyu: To koro uselokoru kendo usedwanyo nyinga; uduto usekawo wasumbini machwo kod mamon mane useweyo thuolo mondo gidhi kama gidwaro. Usechunogi mondo gibed wasumbini magu kendo.
english: but you turned and profaned my name, and every man caused his servant and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return. You brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.’”

kikuyu: “Bende dhano nyalo turo chuma, chuma moa yo nyandwat kata mula?
english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?

kikuyu: Negidonjo e ot kane oyudo onindo e kitandane e ode kor nindo. Bangʼ kane gisechwowe ma ginege, negingʼado wiye oko. Negikawo wiye ma gidhigo kendo negiwuotho otieno duto ka giluwo yor Araba.
english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

kikuyu: Kar romb joma chwo mane ni kanyo ne dirom alufu angʼwen. To ka nosegonyogi,
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

kikuyu: Abishua nonywolo Buki, to Buki nonywolo Uzi,
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye ochako miyo Hosea wachne monego owachi, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dhiyo ikend dhako ma jachode kendo inywol kode nyithindo mag dwanyruokne, nikech piny oseketho kotimo richo mar chode marachie moloyo mi giseweyo Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”

kikuyu: Karangʼo mane waneni ka ituo kata ka in e od twech mi walimi?’
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

kikuyu: Yaye Jahochna e lit, chunya ool.
english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

kikuyu: wenge mag sunga, lep mariambo, lwedo machwero remo maonge ketho,
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

kikuyu: Ohula maduongʼ biro yweyo ode mi dhigo, adier, pi maringo matek biro tere chiengʼ ma Nyasaye noolie mirimbe mager.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Eka chuma gi lowo, gi nyinyo, gi fedha gi dhahabu notore mongʼinjore matindo tindo, kendo negilokore machal gi mihudhi molwar kar dino cham e ndalo oro. Yamo nobiro moywerogi oko duto, maonge kata buru matin mane odongʼ. To Lwanda mane otuomo kido mochweno nolokore got marangʼongo kendo nopongʼo piny duto.
english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

kikuyu: nyikwa Rama kod Geba, ji mia auchiel gi piero ariyo gachiel (621),
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

kikuyu: Elishama wuod Amihud, ma jatend joka Efraim nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo.
english: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,

kikuyu: To ochunore ni yie nyaka moki e chula moro.”
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

kikuyu: Kane chik ruoth kod lendone osetim, nyiri mangʼeny ne okel e dala mochiel mar Susa e od mon mi oketgi e lwet Hegai mondo oritgi. Esta bende ne okel moter e dala ruoth mokete kaachiel gi mon-go ka Hegai ritogi.
english: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

kikuyu: e kinde ma lowo dok kuom lowo, to chuny dok ir Nyasaye mane ochweye.
english: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

kikuyu: Ka ukelona chiayo ma muofni kaka misango, donge mano rach? Ka uchiwo misango mar chiayo mongʼol kata matuo, donge mano rach? Temaneuru uchiwgi ne ruodhu! Bende dobed mamor kodu? Kata bende doyie kodu?” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi noresgi chiengʼno mana kaka jakwath reso jambe. Ginirieny e pinye ka kite ma nengogi tek mikete osimbo mar duongʼ mondo omil.
english: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye mamiyo ji kinda kendo ma jiwo ji, omi ubed gi chuny achiel e kindu uwegi, kendo kuluwo Kristo Yesu,
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: “Wadhi mondo wamonj Juda, wakidhe matindo tindo kendo wapoge e kindwa wawegi bangʼe waket wuod Tabel obed ruodhe.”
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Ham ne gin: Kush, Mizraim, Put kod Kanaan.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka lela wangʼe ne chalo. Bwombegi noyarore kochomo malo, to moro ka moro ne nigi bwombe ariyo, kendo bwomb ka bwomb nomakore gi bwomb gima ochwe machielo e bathe koni gi koni, kod bwombe ariyo mamoko moumogo dende.
english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

kikuyu: Ne an jatich molony mobedo bute. Napongʼ gi mor mogundho odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ kamor e nyime kinde duto,
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

kikuyu: Duongʼ kod pak nitiere e nyime; teko kod mor nitiere kar dakne.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

kikuyu: “To koro sani jatichni wacho ni, ‘Mad wach ruodha kelna kwe, nimar ruodha ma en ruoth chal gi malaika mar Nyasaye manono ber gi rach. Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi bed kodi.’ ”
english: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”

kikuyu: Musa noluongo jo-Israel duto mowachonegi niya, Useneno gi wangʼu gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye otimo Misri ne Farao, jodonge duto, to gi pinyno.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

kikuyu: Kane dwe mar abiriyo ochopo kendo jo-Israel nosechako dak e miechgi, negichokore kaka joka ngʼato achiel e Jerusalem.
english: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ne ok gingʼeyo ni ne owuoyonegi kuom Wuoro.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

kikuyu: Kane gineno ka Yesu kalo machiegni, nowacho niya, “Neuru, Jalcha e Nyarombo mar Nyasaye!”
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodwoke niya, “Bende inyalo chiwo ngimani nikech an adier? Anyisi ni kapok thuon gweno okok, wangʼ inikweda nyadidek!
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

kikuyu: Jogi nodwok erokamano ka giwer kendo ka gikok gi mor. Anamed kwan mag-gi, kendo ok ginidog chien; mi anamigi duongʼ, kendo ok nokawgi matin.
english: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo adek Farao biro gonyi kendo dwoki e tiji, kendo ibiro keto kikombe Farao e lwete mana kaka yande kitimo kane in jatingʼ divai mare.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

kikuyu: Iseneno kaka ne gichulona kuor, kod timbe mamono mane gichano timona.
english: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

kikuyu: To ne Jezebel guogi ema nocham ringre e puodho manie paw Jezreel kendo onge ngʼama noyike.’ ” Bangʼ mano noyawo dhoot moringo odhi.
english: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jodonge nodwoko niya, “Yier jomoko odhi e dala maduongʼ mondo okaw farese abich modongʼ kanyo. Ngima joidh faresego biro chalo mana gi ngima jo-Israel mowe ka; adier, gibiro chalo mana gi jo-Israel ma kech kayogi. Kuom mano waorgi mondo gidhi ginon gima timore.”
english: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

kikuyu: Ruoth, ma nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Anami jodonge kod jogo mariek mer, jotendgi, jodong-gi kod jolweny bende; gininindi nyaka chiengʼ kendo ok ginichiew.”
english: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Bed mabor gi yorno, kik iwuothie, to wichri kendo iluw yori iwuon.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

kikuyu: “To in wuod dhano, kor wach kendo ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kuom jo-Amon gi ayenjegi: “ ‘Ligangla, yaye ligangla, osewuodhi oko, opiage kendo oyweye maler komil ka polo mondo oneki!
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

kikuyu: Bangʼ Ehud, Shamgar wuod Anath nobiro, en ema ne onego jo-Filistia mia auchiel gi bidhi. En bende noreso jo-Israel.
english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

kikuyu: chuny machano chenro maricho, tiende maringo kadhi e richo,
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

kikuyu: To pod ne igoyowa agoya mimiyo ondiegi olawowa; kendo ne iumowa gi mudho mandiwa.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Yaye akucha manie buche manie kor lwanda; kuonde mopondo manie kor gode, yie aneye wangʼi, kendo yie awinjie dwondi; nimar dwondi mit, kendo wangʼi ber neno.
english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

kikuyu: Ngʼaduru bura makare ne joma ok nyal kod nyithi kiye, kendo konyuru joma odhier kod joma ok nyal konyore kendgi.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Ondanyo mar Singruok.” Mar Asaf. Zaburi. Chiknwa iti, yaye Jakwadh jo-Israel, in mitelo ne Josef ka kweth mar dhok. In mibet e kom loch e kind kerubi, koro rieny ane
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

kikuyu: Adiera nobedie e piny motwo, mi tim makare nodag e puodho mamiyo.
english: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, negimanyi e kinde mane ginie chandruok; kendo kane ikumogi ne gionge gi teko mar lemo.
english: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

kikuyu: Kuom misango mar cham moro amora ma jadolo ogolo nyaka wangʼ pep kendo kik chamgi.”
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

kikuyu: Magi ne jo-chwe agulni mane odak Netaim kod Gedera, kendo negidak kanyo ka negitiyone ruoth.
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

kikuyu: “Babulon nyaka podhi nikech jo-Israel mane onegi, mana kaka ji duto, mosenegi e piny osepodho nikech Babulon.
english: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

kikuyu: To ne ok giwinjo tiend wachni. Ne opandorenegi, momiyo ne ok gingʼeyo tiende, kendo negiluor mar penje mondo gingʼe tiende.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

kikuyu: Johana nyiso gigo duto mane oneno e fweny ma en wach Nyasaye kod weche duto mane Yesu Kristo owacho.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

kikuyu: E kinde mane igolo Tamar oko, noorone kwar mare wach niya, “Wuon banglini gi tonde kod ludhni ema nomiya ich rang ane ka inyalo yudo wuon-gi.”
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

kikuyu: Kaponi teko ema iwuoyoe, to otek ndi, kendo kata ka adiera ema ilose, to en ngʼa manyalo chune mondo obi onyis wach kuome.
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

kikuyu: joka Gibeon, ji piero ochiko gabich (95),
english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

kikuyu: Kane piny oseyawore, jokwangʼ ne ok ongʼeyo piny mane gintie, to negineno mbita moro motimo kwoyo; mi giparo mondo gichom yie kuno mondo kanyalore to gimoki bute.
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

kikuyu: Unubed gi chiemo mathoth, ma uchamo nyaka unuyiengʼ, kendo unupak nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, mosetimonu timbe miwuoro. Wi joga ok nochak okuod kendo.
english: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.

kikuyu: To ngʼat manono adimba Chik malongʼo mar Nyasaye mamiyo dhano bedo thuolo, komedo timo kamano kinde ka kinde, ma ok wiye owil gi gima osewinjo, to osiko otimo gima Chik owacho, ibiro gwedhe e gimoro amora motimo.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

kikuyu: joma odak e mudho oseneno ler maduongʼ; jogo modak e piny ma tipo mar tho oumo, ler oserienynegi.”
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

kikuyu: Wuoguru, yaye farese! Yaye, un joriemb geche, riembgiuru matek! Dhiuru nyime, yaye un jolweny machwo moa Kush, gi Put motingʼo okumbini, kaachiel gi chwo Lidia maywayo atungʼ.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

kikuyu: Ne apenjora niya, “E ndalo mag ber mar ngimana, bende onego bed ni akalo e rangeye mag tho kendo hikena modongʼ duto gol kuoma?”
english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

kikuyu: Eka ne awachone niya, “Nyaka idag koda kuom ndalo mathoth; nyaka iwe timbegi mag chode kata riwori gi ngʼato, to abiro dak kodi.”
english: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ ka ungʼeyo ni jasiku, ma en Satan, bayo kuonde duto mana ka sibuor maruto, komanyo ngʼama dongam.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

kikuyu: Nimar an gi ratiro chuth ni tho kata ngima, kata malaike, kata jochiende, gik matimore ndalogi kata mabiro timore, kata teko mag polo,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata manodonji e odno e kinde ma pod olore nobed ngʼama ogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Noketo rachungi taya ei Hemb Romo kochomo yo nyandwat mar oko mar laru,
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne awachonegi niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Jorit rangeye ne gin: Shalum, Akub, Talmon, Ahiman kod owetegi; Shalum jatendgi
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Nyaka karangʼo ma anaketi mondo ikwongʼrina gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ni iwacho adiera ma ok miriambo?”
english: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

kikuyu: “Ma emomiyo aywak kendo pi wangʼa mol e lemba. Onge ngʼat machiegni koda ma dihoya, bende onge ngʼat ma dikwe chunya. Nyithinda odongʼ kiye nikech wasigu oselocho.”
english: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”

kikuyu: Makmana, ngʼato ka ngʼato notho nikech richone owuon; ngʼato angʼata mochano olemo ma wach-wach, lake owuon ema notho.”
english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

kikuyu: “Wangʼe osiko karango timbe ji; oneno okangʼ kokangʼ ma gigoyo.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

kikuyu: Ka turumbete achiel kende ema oywak, to jotelo mag oganda, jo-Israel nyaka chokre e nyimi.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi osetieko wuoyo gi Saulo, chuny Daudi nowinjore gi mar Jonathan gi Daudi mine ohere mana kaka oherore owuon.
english: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

kikuyu: Nimar wenge Jehova Nyasaye ngʼiyo piny duto koni gi koni mondo ojiw joma chunygi oyie kuome chutho. Isetimo gima ofuwo omiyo chakre sani ibiro bedo gi lweny.”
english: For the LORD’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

kikuyu: kendo lokruok gi weyo ne ji richogi ibiro yalo e nyinge ne ogendini duto, chakre Jerusalem.
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kane oganda jo-Israel duto ochungʼ kanyo, ruoth nolokore mogwedhogi.
english: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mosudo machiegni gi hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye biro tho. Dibed ni wan duto wabiro tho?”
english: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

kikuyu: nimar ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi morome.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne jotije niya, “Dongʼuru kae gi punda ka an kod Isaka wadhi kucha. Wadhi lemo kendo eka wabiro duogo iru.”
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

kikuyu: Donge kethruok en mar joma timbegi mono, kendo masira mar joricho?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

kikuyu: Ruodh jatijno nobi e odiechiengʼ ma ok opar ni dobie, kendo e sa ma ok ongʼeyo.
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

kikuyu: Josia notoyo kite milamo kendo ongʼado siro mar Ashera mi oumo kuondego gi choke ji.
english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

kikuyu: “To ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘In jatich ma kite rach kendo ma jasamuoyoni. Kare ne ingʼeyo ni akeyo kama ne ok akome kendo ni achoko kama ne ok aludoe kodhi?
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Rwakne kilemba e wiye kendo itwene san mopamorecha e lela wangʼe kaka osimbo maler.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

kikuyu: Lekeni tar mana ka kweth mag rombe mowuok kar luok. Moro ka moro wuotho gi nyithinde ma rude kendo onge moro man kende.
english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.

kikuyu: Jogo mane ji oyiego kaka sirni, ma gin; Jakobo, Petro kod Johana, noriwa lwedo kaachiel gi Barnaba kane gineno ngʼwono mane omiya. Ne giyie mondo wadhi wayal ni joma ok jo-Yahudi, ka gin to gidhi ir jo-Yahudi.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

kikuyu: Pi nopongʼo piny kuom ndalo mia achiel kod piero abich.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

kikuyu: Bedena duto ma ok nyag olemo ongʼado oko, to bede duto manyago olemo olwero mondo omed nyak moloyo.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

kikuyu: to ji ariyo ma laroregi nyaka chungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka jodolo kod jongʼad bura manie tich e kindeno nitie.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

kikuyu: Ma e kaka herawa nyaka nyisre chuth mondo chiengʼ ngʼado bura wabed gi chir nikech e ngima mar pinyni wachal kode.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

kikuyu: “Losne law akor thiwni mag dhahabu maler mokadi ka tol.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma wuoyo kuome owuon timo kamano mondo oyud duongʼ en owuon, to ngʼat matiyo mondo Nyasaye mane oore ema oyud duongʼ, en ja-adiera, kendo onge miriambo moro amora kuome.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

kikuyu: Koro an, Ruoth Artaksases, achiwo chik ni kuonde keno duto mag Yufrate ochiw gi chia gimoro amora ma Ezra jadolo, japuonj Chik mar Nyasach polo, nyalo kwayou, kaka
english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,

kikuyu: Ebed-Melek ja-Kush nowacho ne Jeremia niya, “Ket lewni mokengoregi kod lewni moti e yuothi mondo kik tol ridhi.” Jeremia notimo kamano,
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.

kikuyu: Eka negidwoko Joshua niya, “Gimoro amora misechikowa wabiro timo, kendo kamoro amora mi iorowae wabiro dhiyoe.
english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

kikuyu: Owete man kuno nosewinjo wach birowa, omiyo ne giwuotho mi gichweyo nyaka Chiro mar Apio, to moko noromonwa kama iluongo ni Tres Tabernae, tiende ni ute adek mag bworo. Kane Paulo oneno jogi, nogoyo ne Nyasaye erokamano, kendo noyudo jip mi chunye noduogo.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

kikuyu: Kochakore e tiendu nyaka ewiu onge kama ngima, kendo upongʼ gi adhonde, kuonde moriemo, kod kuonde moridhore mapok oketie yath, mapok otwe kata wiroe yath.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno nobed odiechieng mirima, enobed odiechieng mwodo lak kod rem malit, bende enobed odiechieng chandruok gi kethruok, enobed odiechiengʼ mopongʼ gi boche polo moimore, kendo odiechiengʼ mopongʼ gi rumbi kod mudho.
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

kikuyu: Yawuoti osepodho, giriere piny e yore mana ka mwanda mogengʼne ei obadho. Giyudo kum mager moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo chwat mar Nyasache.
english: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the LORD’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mane ondiki e ndalo loch Jehoahaz gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Chi Abishur ne iluongo ni Abihail mane onywolone Aban kod Molid.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

kikuyu: mamiyo nam doko matek ka kidi, kendo mamiyo nam doko matek ka lwanda?
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

kikuyu: Magi e weche, buche kod chike mane Musa omiyogi kane giwuok Misri,
english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

kikuyu: Nokwayo niya, “Yiena mondo adhi nikech joodwa timo misango e dala kendo owadwa nochika matek ni nyaka achop kuno. Koro akwayi ni yie ingʼwon-na mondo adhi ane owetena. Mano ema omiyo ok osebiro e mesa ruoth.”
english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

kikuyu: Ka Enok ne ja-higni piero auchiel gabich, nonywolo Methusela.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

kikuyu: To choke Josef, mane jo-Israel nobiro godo koa Misri, noiki Shekem e pinyno mane Jakobo ongʼiewo fedha mia achiel koa kuom yawuot Hamor, ma wuon Shekem. Ma nobedo kaka pok mar nyikwa Josef.
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

kikuyu: “ ‘Koro dhi sani kama iluongo ni Shilo kama ne akwongo alosoe kar dak mar Nyinga, kendo mondo ine gima ne atimone nikech timbe mamono mag joga Israel.
english: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, osiepena mageno, ka pod urito odiechiengʼno to temuru matek kaka unyalo mondo ubed jomaler maonge ketho e nyim Nyasaye, kendo beduru gi kwe kode.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

kikuyu: Abiro miyi kifungu mag pinyruodh polo; kendo gimoro amora mitweyo e piny-ka notwe e polo bende, kendo gimoro amora migonyo e piny-ka nogony e polo bende.”
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

kikuyu: Enowach niya, “Nyisecheugo nikanye, lwanda mane udwaro yudo resruok kuome,
english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

kikuyu: “Mana kaka ndalo mane ua Misri, abiro nyisogi timbena madongo miwuoro.”
english: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

kikuyu: “Un koth jorichogi, koro ubiro ira, kuchungʼ kar kwereu kendo umiyo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye medore kuom Israel.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

kikuyu: Mi dhogi mawacho miriambo mondo olingʼ; nikech sungagi kod chuny marach ma gin-go, omiyo giwuoyo gi wich teko kuom joma kare.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

kikuyu: Anadag e diergi nyaka chiengʼ ka giweyo timbegi mag chode kendo lamo nyiseche motho mag ruodhigi.
english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

kikuyu: Yesu nowuok kanyo kotingʼo msalape owuon nyaka kar Hanga Wich (miluongo gi dho jo-Hibrania ni Golgotha).
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

kikuyu: Kama idonjogo e ute mapiny ne ni yo wuok chiengʼ, ka ngʼato donjo eigi koa e laru ma oko.
english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

kikuyu: Nikech jomoko mane osendik kuomgi chon ni bura oloyo osedonjo e dieru lingʼ-lingʼ. Gin joma kia Nyasaye, maloko ngʼwono mar Nyasachwa dokonegi thuolo mar timo richo, kendo gidagi Ruodhwa achiel kende ma en Yesu Kristo.
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jakobo nodhi Sukoth, kama nogeroe dalane kendo oloso dipo ne kweth mage mag jamni. Mano ema omiyo iluongo kanyo ni Sukoth (tiende ni abilni).
english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

kikuyu: Ne iresa e ywaruok gi ji. Ne iketa jatend ogendini; joma ne ok angʼeyo chon notiyona.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

kikuyu: nodhi kedo gi Bera ruodh Sodom, Birsha ruodh Gomora, Shinab ruodh Adma, Shemeber ruodh Zeboim kod ruodh Bela (ma tiende ni Zoar).
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako otimo timbe mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwet jo-Filistia kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ler mondo obedie e kor polo mondo opog odiechiengʼ gi otieno, kendo gibed kaka ranyisi mag lokruok ndalo kod odiechienge, kod higni,
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “An bende abiro penjou penjo. Nyisauru:
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

kikuyu: To jo-Midian nouso Josef e piny Misri ne Potifa, achiel kuom jotich mag Farao, jaduongʼ jorit od ruoth.
english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

kikuyu: ka ogol ngʼat marach e nyim ruoth, eka kom ruodhe ibiro guro motegno e tim makare.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo oneno Rael, nyar Laban ner mare kod romb Laban, nodhi mongʼielo kidi oko e dho soko kendo omiyo romb ner mare omodho.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo mano, nowacho niya, “Tuono ok en mar tho, to mano otimore mana ni mondo Nyasaye oyud duongʼ, kendo mondo Wuod Nyasaye oyud duongʼ kuome.”
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

kikuyu: To un ema ne uneno giwengeu gik madongo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye otimo.
english: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD’s great work which he did.

kikuyu: To ka ochiewgi, analosnigi nyasi mi gimer, mondo gikog gi mor; eka ginindi nyaka chiengʼ ma ok ginichiew,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Tongʼu man yo podho chiengʼ nobed Nam Mediterania. Ma ema nobed tongʼu man yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

kikuyu: Kinde ma gibiro dengo kendo giywagi to ginichuogni wer ma giywagigo kama: “Bende nitie kama osekethi kaka Turo ma en dala ma nembe olworo?”
english: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’

kikuyu: Mor oserumo e chunywa; miendwa oselokore ywak.
english: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

kikuyu: Tangʼ mondo chandruok kik dwoki e richo.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

kikuyu: Kik iyie gi kwayogino nikech ji moloyo piero angʼwen kuomgi osebutone. Gisekwongʼore ni ok ginicham kata madho gimoro kapok ginege. Kata sani giseikore, girito mana mondo iyie gi kwayogino.”
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni gipondo ewi got Karmel, to kata mana kuno anadwargi mi amakgi. To kata dabed ni gipondona e bwo nam piny, to kata mana kuno anachik thuol mikagi.
english: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Aramo chuth ni nyaka akel masira kuomu kendo atiek Juda duto.
english: “Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

kikuyu: Pethahia wuod Meshezabel, ma en achiel kuom nyikwa Zera wuod Juda, ne en jaote ruoth e weche duto monego ji ongʼe.
english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

kikuyu: Un duto un nyithind Nyasaye nikech uyie kuom Kristo Yesu,
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼ moro achiel kane adhi Damaski, ne an gi teko kod wach moa kuom jodolo madongo.
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo koro Polo malo ok nyal miyou koth kata matin, kendo piny osiko mana kotwo ma ok nyal nyago gimoro.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

kikuyu: Negichiwo yawuotgi kod nyigi kaka misango e mach. Negitimo timbe ajuoke kod mag nyakalondo ma gichiwore mar timo gik mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma gimiye mirima.
english: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

kikuyu: pek mar rachungi mag teyni kod techegi molos gi dhahabu, kaachiel gi pek mar rachungi mar taya ka taya gi techene, pek fedha mar rachungi mar taya ka taya gi techene molos kod fedha mana kaka moro ka moro owinjore gi tije;
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jotend jorit pinje, kaachiel gi jodongo, nodhi ir ruoth ma giwachone niya, “Yaye ruoth Darius, mad idag amingʼa!
english: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Akwedi, yaye Turo, kendo abiro kelo pinje mathoth mondo oked kodi, mana ka nam madhwolo apakane.
english: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma iye owangʼ kelo masira, to ngʼat makecho piyo timo richo mathoth.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

kikuyu: “Aseneno lit malich mondo aikne od Jehova Nyasaye dhahabu ma pekne romo tan alufu adek mia abiriyo gi piero abich kaachiel gi fedha ma pekne romo tan alufu piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich kaachiel gi mula kod nyinyo ma pekgi okadho apima kod yiende gi kite. In bende inyalo medo moko.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

kikuyu: Ok onyal weya aywe to otimona mana gik mamiyo chunya bedo malit.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

kikuyu: Ka wasik Juda gi Benjamin nowinjo ni joma notwe ne gero hekalu ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel,
english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to the LORD, the God of Israel,

kikuyu: Kendo Abimelek nowacho niya, “Pinya duto ni e lweti; dag kamoro amora ma ihero.”
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

kikuyu: kod mich mabeyo duto mag piny to gi gik moko duto manie iye gi ngʼwono mar ngʼat modak e bungu maliel. Gwethgi duto obedi ewi joka Josef, ngʼat mane oyier kuom owetene.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

kikuyu: Eka chuny ruoth nogombo neno Abisalom, nimar chunye nosea e wach tho mar Amnon.
english: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.

kikuyu: Ne gitego loch Juda kendo kuom higni adek negimiyo Rehoboam wuod Solomon obedo motegno ka giwuotho e yor Daudi kod Solomon e kindeno.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

kikuyu: Ne uluwo kitwa kod kit Ruoth; kendo kata obedo ni ne usandoru malit, to nurwako wach mane oyalnu gi mor ma Roho Maler kelo.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Ruoth nooro dwoko kama: Ne Rehum jatend lweny, Shimshai jagoro kod jogi mamoko ma utiyogo kanyakla modak Samaria gi kuonde mopogore e loka mar Aora Yufrate. Amosou.
english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.

kikuyu: Kinyne kane oyudo gia Bethania, kech ne kayo Yesu.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Ne ok onego udonj e dhorangeye mag joga chiengʼ mane masira omakogi, kata ngʼiyogi gachaya e thagruokgi, kata kawo mwandugi, e chiengʼ thagruokgi gi chiengʼ masichegi.
english: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka e kia maru ok urito chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa,
english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—

kikuyu: Pogruok machielo mwaneno en ni e kit dolo machon, jodolo ne ngʼeny nikech tho nomonogi dhi nyime gi tich dolo;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

kikuyu: Kuom mano watimuru ne Nyasaye misango mar pak ndalo duto ka wan kuom Yesu. Pak makamano en olemo mawuok e dhowa ka hulo nyinge.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

kikuyu: Mana kaka notimore e ndalo mag Nowa e kaka nobedi chiengʼ ma Wuod Dhano nobi.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: “Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Ugero mi umwon liete jonabi kendo ugoro maber liete joma kare.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

kikuyu: “Eka ibiro wuok kanyo midhi nyaka yath maduongʼ man Tabor. Ji adek mawuotho kadhi Bethel ir Nyasaye norom kodi kanyo. Achiel kuomgi biro biro kotingʼo nyidiek adek, to machielo biro tingʼo makati adek, to machielo to otingʼo ndede mar divai.
english: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Kane owuondore ni in janeko e nyim Abimelek, mane oriembe mi oa odhi. Abiro miyo Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kinde duto; dhoga biro siko kapake.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

kikuyu: Kendo ne aloso puothe mamoko kod puothe mopidhie yiende mar yweyo mi apidho kit olembe mopogore opogore eigi.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

kikuyu: Eka nokelo oganda mar Benjamin nyime, kaluwore gi dhoot ka dhoot, mine oyier dhood Matri. Mogik ne oyier Saulo wuod Kish. To kane gidware, to ne ok oyude.
english: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

kikuyu: Ne aneno ka gidonjo Ayath, mi gikalo dier Migron; kendo negikawo gigegi Mikmash.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

kikuyu: Un jomatindo bende chiwuru luor ni jomadongo. Rwakreuru gi muolo e kindu ngʼato gi ngʼato, nikech Muma wacho niya, “Nyasaye osin gi josunga to ochiwo ngʼwono ne joma muol.”
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: En obadho ne ngʼato masingo gimoro ka ok oparo, to achien eka oparo singruokne.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

kikuyu: Koro Ruoth Herode nowinjo gik moko duto matimore, to noparore, nikech ji moko ne wacho ni Johana osechier oa kuom joma otho.
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

kikuyu: Ka masiche mangʼeny kod chandruok otimorenegi, to wendni nobed janeno e kinda kodgi, nimar wachni nyikwagi wigi ok nowilgo. Angʼeyo gima giikore mar timo, kata kane pok akelogi e piny mane asingonegi kakwongʼora.”
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Joshua nowachone Akan niya, “Wuoda, mi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel duongʼ gi pak. Nyisa gima isetimo kendo kik ipanda.”
english: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”

kikuyu: Eka nodhi Kapernaum, dala manie Galili, kendo chiengʼ Sabato nochako puonjo ji.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

kikuyu: Omiyo nyaka wakony joma kamago, mondo wati kaachiel kodgi e tij adiera.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

kikuyu: Gik ma mony mar bonyo oweyo, bonyo madongo osechamo; gik ma bonyo madongo oweyo bonyo matindo osechamo, gik ma bonyo matindo oweyo bonyo mamoko nochamo.
english: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jodolo ok oyienegi kendo nyako mochot kata nyako mosewere gi chwore, nikech jodolo nyaka bed maler e nyim Nyasachgi.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

kikuyu: Ginitim agengʼa ne miechu madongo duto nyaka kuonde mochiel motingʼore gi malo ma uketo genou kuomgi lwar. Ginikethi mier madongo e piny duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼato ka ngʼato mokwayo imiyo, ngʼato madwaro nwangʼo kendo ngʼama dwongʼo, noyawne dhoot.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ahab nooro wach e Israel duto mi nochoko jonabi ewi Got Karmel.
english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

kikuyu: Senakerib noyudo wach ni Tirhaka, ja-Kush ruodh Misri obiro monje. Kuom mano, nooro joote ir Hezekia kowacho kama:
english: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

kikuyu: Obiro bedo ngʼama kwiny ka kanyna mapok obo; nobed mamon gi ji duto, kendo ji duto bende nobed mamon kode, mi nodag komon gi owetene duto.”
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

kikuyu: Eka Jonathan nowachone Daudi niya, “Gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, abiro wuoyo gi wuora e sa maka ma orucha! Ka en gi paro maber kuomi, to donge abiro anyisi?
english: Jonathan said to David, “By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

kikuyu: Lemnwauru alema. Wangʼeyo malongʼo ni waonge wach gi ngʼato kendo wadwaro ni ngimawa obed mobidhore e yore duto.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

kikuyu: to wach mantie e kindgi ibiro losi kuom kwongʼruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne wadgino nine ok omulo mwandu wadgi. Wuon chiayono nyaka yie gi wachno, kendo onge chudo manochiw.
english: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Jehova Nyasaye osewacho ne Musa niya, “Pod abiro kelo masira achiel kuom Farao gi jo-Misri. Bangʼ masirano, obiro weyou mondo uwuog kae udhi, to ka otimo kamano, to obiro mana riembou chutho.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.

kikuyu: yieruru achiel kuom yawuot ruoth mowinjore kendo ukete obed e loch wuon-gi. Bangʼ mano ikreuru mondo uked ne dhood ruodhu.”
english: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Simeon ne gin: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar kod Shaul mane en wuod nyar ja-Kanaan. Mago e joka Simeon.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako wuoth koa Rameses e odiechiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dwe mokwongo, ma en odiechiengʼ mokwongo bangʼ Pasaka. Negiwuok ayanga ka jo-Misri nenogi to ne ok gidewo,
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

kikuyu: Un joma nindo e kitendini mokedi gi lak liech, kendo utaroru e kombeu madongo, kuchamo nyirombe mayom ma jambu onywolo, kod nyirwethu machwe mopidh maber.
english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,

kikuyu: mar abich ne en Shefatia wuod Abital; to mar auchiel ne en Ithream wuod chiege miluongo ni Egla.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

kikuyu: Eka ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi e chandruokgino, mi noresogi e pekgino.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Abiro ngʼadoni buch kum mikumogo mon machodo kendo machwero remo, kendo abiro chuli kuor mar remo mar mirimba gi nyieka mager.
english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

kikuyu: Miechu mochiel motegno duto nochal mana gi yiende mag ngʼowu, machiego olemo mokwongo; ka oyieng-gi to olembgi lwar e dho jochiemo.
english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro chiwo piny ni joga Israel, abiro gurogi mondo gibed gi pinygi giwegi mondo kik chandgi kendo. Jomahundu ok nochak osandgi kendo kaka negitimonegi mokwongo,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

kikuyu: Nimar lwanda margi ok en Lwandawa mana kaka jasikwa osewacho.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

kikuyu: Kapok okadho ndalo adek Farao biro golie od twech, kendo obiro ngʼado wiyi oko manolieri e yath kendo winy biro chamo ringri.”
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

kikuyu: mibiro ngʼiewogo makati miketo e nyim Nyasaye pile, gi misango mar cham mitimo pile, gi misengini miwangʼo pep, kod misengini mamoko mitimo chiengʼ Sabato, kod mago mitimo ka dwe opor kod ndalo mag sewni moyier kendo ni tich misengini mamoko kod misengini mag golo richo jo-Israel kaachiel gi tije duto mag od Nyasachwa.
english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

kikuyu: Koso pok usomo e Chik ni chiengʼ Sabato, jodolo manie hekalu doko mogak odiechiengʼno, to ok kwan-gi kaka joketho?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

kikuyu: pasiani nolierie sirni piero ariyo gi rachungi piero ariyo mag mula, kod ramaki mag fedha kod rangʼaw miriwogo sirnigo.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

kikuyu: An Paulo gi Sila kod Timotheo, Wandikonu un kanisa mar jo-Thesalonika, man kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo:
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Ne oike Moab, e holo mochomore gi Beth Peor, to nyaka chil kawuono onge ngʼama ongʼeyo kama liende nitie.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

kikuyu: Bende ok en loka nam, madimi upenj niya, “En ngʼa madingʼad loka nam mondo oomnwago kendo opuonjwa eka warite?”
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

kikuyu: Lamo mar ngʼat mawinjo marach kendo machiwo ywakne e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; yie irwak lamona ma akwayigo kony.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kora ne gin: Asir, Elkana kod Abiasaf. Magi ema ne dhout joka Kora.
english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni jotelo chokorena kendo giyanya, to jatichni pod biro mana paro matut kuom chikeni.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

kikuyu: Kane an e fweny kamano, Nyasaye notera nyaka e piny Israel mi nochunga ewi got moro mabor ahinya. To e bath godno ma yo milambo ne aneno ute moger machalo dala maduongʼ.
english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

kikuyu: Eliel, Obed kod Jasiel ja-Mezoba.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado ne jou bura makare, obiro kelo adiera ne jou masandore.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Mano ber. Kik uluor. Nyasaye ma Nyasach wuonu, osedwokonu pesau e gundeu; to pesa mane ungʼiewgo cham ira, an godo.” Eka ne okelonegi Simeon.
english: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

kikuyu: Hero Nyasaye en luoro chikene, to chikene ok tek rito
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

kikuyu: mi ngʼwon-ne kowacho ni, ‘Weyeuru kik utere e kar tho, nikech oseyudo yor resruok.’
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

kikuyu: “To angʼeyo kama idakie, bende angʼeyo sa ma idonjo kata sa ma iwuok, kata kaka iwuoyo marach kuoma.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

kikuyu: Enoket lwete ewi chiayono, kendo enoyangʼe kama itimoe misango miwangʼo pep e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. En misango mar golo richo.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Abiro keyo jo-Misri e dier ogendini bende anami gikeree e kind pinje.
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ber; pakuru nyinge gi wende pak nimar timo kamano en gima ber.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

kikuyu: Daudi ne en wuod ja-Efrath miluongo ni Jesse mane oa Bethlehem e piny Juda. Jesse ne nigi yawuowi aboro to e ndalo Saulo ne en ngʼat moti ma hike ngʼeny.
english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.

kikuyu: Nodok ir owetene mowachonegi niya, “Rawera cha onge kacha! Koro anyalo timo angʼo?”
