english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

kikuyu: Ginibedni ngima maber, ka tigo maber mitweyo e ngʼuti.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

kikuyu: Ma e chir ma wan-go ka wadhi e nyim Nyasaye ni ka wakwaye gimoro mowinjore gi dwache to owinjowa.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

kikuyu: Omiyo chakre chiengʼno kadhi nyime negichano kaka ginyalo nego Yesu.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

kikuyu: Ka usegolone Jehova Nyasaye gik mabeyo moloyo kamano, to ok unubed joketho kuom wachno, kendo ok nobed ni udwanyo gik maler ma jo-Israel ochiwo kendo ok ubi tho.’ ”
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

kikuyu: Noketo kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep machiegni gi dhood Hemb Romo mi nochiwoe misengni miwangʼo gi chiwo mag cham kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: nimar joma ne omakowa nokwayowa wende kane wan kanyo, joma nesandowa nochunowa ni wawernegi wende mor; negiwachonwa niya, “Wernwauru achiel kuom wende Sayun!”
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

kikuyu: “Odiechiengno anami jotend Juda chal gi agulu manie mach mangʼangʼni, kendo ka pilni mach manie kind cham mochiek. Gibiro tieko ji duto modak e alworagi koni gi koni, to Jerusalem to biro dongʼ kare kaka en, ka ji odakie.
english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ka piny oseyawore kendo rumbi oserumo, eka abiro dhi ewi got kuma gik madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar yudoree kendo nyaka ewi gode matindo miwangʼoe ubani.
english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.

kikuyu: Jonabi koro miriambo, jodolo tiyo gi tekogi giwegi, kendo joga ohero mana gik ma kamago. To en angʼo ma ibiro timo e ndalo mogik?
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

kikuyu: Le oseketi e tiend yiende, kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.”
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ temo yore duto, jogi nowacho niya, “Ok wabi yudo wach moro amora ma wanyalo ketogo ketho kuom Daniel, makmana ka en gima omulo chik Nyasache.”
english: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Isakar ne gin ji alufu piero abich gangʼwen gi mia angʼwen (54,400).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼat machulo kuor kuom remo mochwer siko kaparo; ok owe mak odewo ywak joma hinyore.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye miyo sokni olo pi e bugni ka gimol e kind gode.
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, amiyo jo-Lawi kaka girkeni margi achiel kuom apar ma jo-Israel ochiwo kaka misango ne Jehova Nyasaye. Mano emomiyo ne awacho kama kuomgi: ‘Ok giniyud girkeni e dier jo-Israel.’ ”
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Kata kamano ruoth notamo Joab omiyo Joab nowuok modhi e piny jo-Israel duto, bangʼe noduogo Jerusalem.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Negingʼado tonde motwego nanga mi gibolo e nam bangʼe gingʼado tonde mane omakgo ngai. Bangʼ mano negichungo tanga yo ka wi yie, bangʼe gisiayo yie ka gichomo dho wath.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

kikuyu: Ler mar ngʼat makare rieny maler, to taya mar ngʼat marach inego.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

kikuyu: Ne atiekogi chuth, mane ok ginyal chungʼ; negipodho e tienda.
english: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

kikuyu: To bende Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro miyo kihondko omakgi ma kata ngʼato pond e dieru manade to ok notony.
english: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi lewni mochwe mag tij dolo mitiyogo e kama ler mar lemo ma gin lewni mag Harun jadolo kod lep yawuote ka gitiyogo kaka jodolo.”
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano joma roteke nomiyi duongʼ; mier madongo mag ogendini ma jonjore biro miyi luor.
english: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno jo-Sadukai, mawacho ni chier onge, nobiro ire gi penjo moro.
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Lokreuru koro, ngʼato ka ngʼato, uwe yoreu mamono kod timbeu maricho, kendo unyalo dak e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyou kod wuoneu nyaka chiengʼ.
english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho, Dhi ir jakeno mar od ruoth miluongo ni Shebna mondo iwachne niya,
english: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

kikuyu: Negimiyo nyiego omake gi nyisechegigo, kendo iye nowangʼ-gi timbegi mamono mag lamo nyiseche manono.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

kikuyu: “Abiro resogi kuom teko mar piny joma otho kendo anakonygi kuom tho. In tho, ere masicheni duto, kata in piny joma otho, ere kethruokni? “Ok anakeche,
english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.

kikuyu: To ngʼat mane oyudo talanta achiel nowuok odhi mokunyo bur ei lowo, kendo oyiko pesa ruodhe kanyo.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

kikuyu: Joote gi jodongo noketo bura mondo giwuo kuom wachno,
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

kikuyu: Nikech ndalo koro osechopo mingʼadoe bura ni jood Nyasaye. To ka wan ema ochakore kodwa kamano to uparo ni joma ok luw Injili mar Nyasaye to biro neno malit machal nadi?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

kikuyu: chutho, divai momadho ndhoge; en jasunga kendo osiko otimo gik maricho ma ok ool. Nikech owuor ka liel mamuonyo ji kendo kaka tho ok rom e kaka en bende ok orom, ochoko ogendini duto mondo obi ire, kendo omako ji duto wasumbini.
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

kikuyu: To jo-Yahudi mamoko ne nyiego omako; omiyo negidhi gichoko acheje moko mane bayo e chiro kanyo, eka negichoko oganda maduongʼ mar joma achejego, kendo negichako lweny e dalano. Ne gimwomore e od Jason, ka gimanyo Paulo gi Sila, mondo gigolgi oko ni oganda.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

kikuyu: Nikech en Nyasaye mane minyalo pimo gi Jehova Nyasaye? Koso en ngʼa ma en Lwanda, ka ok Nyasachwa?
english: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye noseweyo Saulo kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo thuolo mondo roho marach othage.
english: Now the LORD’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech usepamo lweteu kendo usegoyo tiendeu piny, kuhimo piny Israel gie chunyu kendo umor ka gineno malit,
english: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye ngʼadne Abner bura, kata obed ni en bura matek machalo nade, ka diponi ok atimone Daudi gima Jehova Nyasaye nokwongʼore ka singone,
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as the LORD has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

kikuyu: “Kaw fedha gi dhahabu kuom Heldai, Tobija kod Jedaya, ma gin joma osechopo koa e twech Babulon. Dhiyo odiechiengʼ ma gidonjoeno, e od Josia wuod Zefania.
english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

kikuyu: ka ionge gi yo kaka dichul, nono to wuon gowino nyalo kawo kitandani.
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich kod nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Elishama wuod Amihud ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Jodolo chalo mana gi jomecho ma pondo ne ji e dir yo, ka girito ngʼat makadho mondo gima. Gineko e yo madhi Shekem, gitimo timbe mahundu makwodo wich.
english: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.

kikuyu: Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, nokwongʼore kosingorenegi kaachiel gi jogo mane ni kodgi kawacho niya, “Kik uluor tiyone jo-Babulon. Daguru e pinyni kendo uti ne ruodh Babulon, to unudhi maber.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.

kikuyu: Kuom kinde mangʼeny nyaka kawuononi, pok ujwangʼo oweteu, to usetimo tich mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu omiyou.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Koko mar lweny ni e piny, koko mar kethruok maduongʼ!
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

kikuyu: Eka pinje noriworene momonje, pinje duto mane oa e gwenge molwore. Ne gikunyone bur mi onyumore.
english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

kikuyu: En ema noseresowa e dho tho malich kamano kendo obiro resowa. Kuome waseketoe genowa ni pod obiro resowa,
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

kikuyu: To kata mana e kindeni Farao nomedo bedo gi tok teko kendo ne ok onyal weyo jo-Israel mondo odhi.
english: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.

kikuyu: Kuom Kedar gi pinyruodhi mag Hazor, mane Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon omonjo: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Chungʼuru malo, kendo umonj Keda, mi utiek joma aa yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, The LORD says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

kikuyu: Nikech ongʼeyo timbegi oloko loch mag-gi gotieno mi otiekgi chuth.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

kikuyu: mapuonjou adiera gi weche migeno, mondo ichiw dwoko mowinjore ne ngʼat mane oori?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

kikuyu: Kane Musa odhi kendo onyiso oganda weche duto kod chike Jehova Nyasaye, negidwoko gi dwol achiel niya, “Gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osewacho wabiro timo.”
english: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

kikuyu: An e dier sibuoche; anindo e dier le mager mangemo, joma lekegi chalo tonge gi aserni, ma lewgi chalo ligangla mabitho.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

kikuyu: Owetena neuru ni ubedo motangʼ mondo kik ngʼato kuomu bed gi chuny marach motamore yie mamiyo oweyo Nyasaye mangima.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

kikuyu: Bende nomiye teko mondo oked gi jomaler mag Nyasaye kendo ologi, kendo nomiye loch kuom dhoudi duto, gi ogendini kod dhok duto miwacho gi pinje duto.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

kikuyu: To kilo piero ariyo negitiyogo kuom loso ramaki mag sirni kendo bawo wi sirnigo kod loso rangʼepegi.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

kikuyu: To koro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel yie mondo wach mane isingo ni jatichni Daudi wuora otimre mana kaka ne isingo.
english: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

kikuyu: Ka chiwo en misango miwangʼo pep mar dhiangʼ, to nyaka obed mana mano madichwo maonge songa. Nyaka to ochiwe e dho Hemb Romo mondo omi Jehova Nyasaye oyie kode.
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: Biuru uneye tije Jehova Nyasaye, bi uneye kethruok mosekelo e piny.
english: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone niya, “Kidhi koda to idhi bedona tingʼ mapek.
english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

kikuyu: kaachiel gi Nebo kod Baal Meon (nyingegi noduog oloki achien) kod Sibma. Mier madongo mane gigero negimiyo nying mamoko.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

kikuyu: Osenyiso Jakobo wachne, ee, osenyiso Israel chikene gi buchene.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼe noluongo wuode Solomon mochike ni mondo oger ot ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo sokono nochaki ni Beer-Lahai-Roi; kendo pod entiere nyaka chil kawuono, e kind Kadesh kod Bered.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

kikuyu: An asebiro e nying Wuora, to utamoru rwaka; to ka ngʼato machielo nobi e nyinge owuon to ubiro rwake arwaka.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼ mar aboro nyaka okel nyiimbe ariyo kod rombo sibini ma jo-higa achiel. Jamnigo duto nyaka bed maonge songa kendo nyaka kelgi kaachiel gi mogo mayom moromo kilo apar moru gi mo mondo timgo misango mar cham kod mo maliw moromo nus lita.
english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

kikuyu: “ ‘To kaponi odhiro wadgi ma ok gimonrego kata kochiele gi gimoro kobothne
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

kikuyu: “Ngʼat morwakou orwaka, kendo ngʼama orwaka, orwako jal ma noora.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

kikuyu: “Osetieku yaye Israel, nikech ok udwara, ok udwar jakonyu.
english: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

kikuyu: To e sechego noyudo otingʼ ngʼat moro maputh kitero e ranga hekalu miluongo ni Malongʼo, kama ne ojaketee pile pile, mondo okwa kony kuom joma donjo ei hekalu.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

kikuyu: Eka ne angʼicho, kendo nawinjo dwond malaike mangʼeny ma kwan-gi ne romo gana gi gana kendo tara gi tara. Negilworo kom duongʼ kaachiel gi gik mangimago kod Jodongo.
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

kikuyu: Kane owach ne Daudi niya, “Ne jo-Filistia kedo gi jo-Keila kendo giyako gik man e laru mar dino cham,”
english: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe noluwo Holo mar Ben Hinom, kochomo pewe ma milambo mar dala maduongʼ mar jo-Jebus (tiende ni, Jerusalem). Koa kanyo noidho nyaka ewi got man yo podho chiengʼ mar Holo mar Hinom e giko mar Holo mar Refaim mantiere yo nyandwat.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

kikuyu: Lach ute matindo mane oger e alwora mar hekalugo duto ne medore ka dhi malo. Kuom mano, ot ka ot mane ni ewi wadgi ne duongʼ moloyo mano mane olwore e wiye. Ne nitie raidhi modhi malo koa e dier ot mapiny mogik nyaka dier ot mamalo mogik. Raidhini ne okalo e dier ot madiere.
english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon kata jo-Moab kata achiel kuom nyikwaye ok onego odonj e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye nyaka e tiengʼ mar apar,
english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into the LORD’s assembly forever,

kikuyu: Ne ajiwo Tito mondo obi iru, kendo ne aore gi owadwa machielo mondo obi kode. Dibed Tito owuon nomayou giu? Donge an gi Tito ne watiyo e dieru ka wan gi chuny machalre kendo ka waluwo yo machalre?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

kikuyu: Negiloso lep dolo momin gi law mayom marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro ma itiyogo e kama ler mar lemo. Bende negiloso lewni mopwodhi ne Harun kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Bende nyaka ingʼe ni ionge gi teko mar chuno ji golo osuru, kata chiwo kata chudo ewi jadolo, jo-Lawi, jower, jorit rangach, jatij hekalu moro amora kata jotich mamoko e odni mar Nyasaye.
english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo kane Jona osedonjo e dier dalano, nogoyo milome kowacho niya, “Odongʼ ndalo piero angʼwen kende to itieko Nineve duto.”
english: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

kikuyu: Jokwath kod jambgi noked kode; ginigur hembegi molwore, ka moro ka moro rito kare owuon.”
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”

kikuyu: “Kwan jo-Kohath ma gin bad jo-Lawi kaluwore gi gwengegi kod dhoutgi.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Abel otimo misango maber ne Nyasaye moloyo misango mar Kain. Yieneno nomiyo Nyasaye oyie kode kaka ngʼama kare, nikech Nyasaye owuon norwako misangoneno. Abel pod wuoyo nyaka chil kawuono nikech yie mane en-gono, kata obedo ni nosetho.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Lawi, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Nimiyo nyikwa Lawi ombulu miluongo ni Thumim gi Urim mondo gingʼego dwaroni nikech gin joma tiyoni gadiera. Ne imiyogi tembe kama iluongo ni Masa kendo sokni mag Meriba mi inwangʼo ni gin jo-adiera.
english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

kikuyu: Okelone mana ber, ok hinyruok ndalo duto mar ngimane.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

kikuyu: Mad rembgi obedi ewi Joab gi nyikwaye nyaka chiengʼ. To kuom Daudi gi nyikwaye gi ode kod kuom lochne, mad kwe Jehova Nyasaye obedie nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from the LORD.”

kikuyu: Mikaya nodhi nyime kawacho niya, “Kuom mano winj wach Jehova Nyasaye: Naneno Jehova Nyasaye kobet e kom duongʼne gi jopolo duto ochungo e bathe korachwich gi koracham.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

kikuyu: mirima mager mar Nyasaye nogore kuomgi, mi nomiyo jogi maroteke otho, kendo nopielo yawuot Israel ma pod tindo piny.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Ruth nyar Moab nowacho niya, “Bende nowacho ni, ‘Bed kaachiel gi jotichna ma nyiri nyaka chop gitiek kayo chamba duto.’ ”
english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

kikuyu: Kane jatingʼ gige lweny oneno ka Saulo osetho en bende nokawo liganglane mochwoworego motho kode.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi pur mamako nanga gi mamako kor ot,
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

kikuyu: “Koro chik momakou nyaka chiengʼ ema: Pwodhruok kuom richo duto mag jo-Israel nyaka tim dichiel e higa.” Kendo notim kamano mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nongʼado bura kama, “Miuru dhako mokwongono nyathi mangima, kik unege nimar en e min-gi.”
english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

kikuyu: To jogi wigi tek kendo chunygi bor koda omiyo gisebaro mi giweya.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

kikuyu: Paulo nolor piny mi nokwako wuowino. Bangʼe nowacho ni ji niya, “Kik uluor. Ongima!”
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

kikuyu: kata kik gikwal gigegi, to ginyisre ni gin joma inyalo geno e weche duto mondo omi e yore duto gimi puonj mar Nyasaye Jawarwa oywa ji.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

kikuyu: ma dhogi opongʼ gi miriambo kendo ma lwetgi ma korachwich opongʼ gi wuondruok.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Eka wanamonje kamoro amora minyalo yude kendo wanapodh kuome mana ka thoo momoko e lum maonge ngʼato kuomgi kata achiel manowe kangima.
english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

kikuyu: Bangʼe kane gisea e sinagogi negidhi kaachiel gi Jakobo kod Johana e dalagi Simon gi Andrea.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

kikuyu: Eka Jehoyada kod yawuote nogolo wuod ruoth oko mi osidhone osimbo mar loch kendo negimiye kitap chik mi gikete ruoth. Ne giwire ka gigoyo koko niya, “Ruoth mondo odag amingʼa!”
english: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

kikuyu: Unune malit un joma osiko katimo richo ka umede gi miriambo, kod timbe anjawo,
english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, ngʼi yo nyandwat.” Ne angʼiyo kuno, kendo ei kar donjo man yo nyandwat mar rangach michopogo e kendo mar misango, ne aneno kido mar nyasaye manono ma Nyasaye mon-go.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

kikuyu: Ne ochoko bende nyikwa Harun kod jo-Lawi kanyakla.
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

kikuyu: Asiko kakwayo mondo Nyasach Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, Wuon duongʼ duto omiu Roho Maler mamiyou rieko kendo mafwenyonu tiend gik mopondo mondo ungʼeye maber.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

kikuyu: Ka adiera onenore, to joma timbegi nikare bedo mamor to joma timbegi richo to yudo bwok.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: nikech ibiro miyo gilok dier ngʼegi ka ibiro dimbogi gi atungʼ moywa.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

kikuyu: Nyako maduongʼ nonywolo wuowi, kendo nochake ni Moab, en e kwar jo-Moab ma kawuono.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

kikuyu: Wuouru ngʼato gi ngʼato kod weche mag zaburi kwero wende kitabu kod wende chuny. Weruru kendo denduru Ruoth e chunyu
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Pahath-Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaya, Maseya, Matania, Bezalel, Binui gi Manase.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

kikuyu: Ndalo moko Nyasaye kelo rumbi e piny mondo okumgo ji, to ndalo moko okelo koth mondo onyisgo herane.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobedi kaka osimbo mar duongʼ maber ne joge manok modongʼ.
english: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,

kikuyu: To ruoth nokawo Armoni gi Mefibosheth ma yawuot Rizpa nyar Aiya mane onywolo ni Saulo, to gi yawuowi abich ma Merab nyar Saulo nonywolo ni Adriel wuod Barzilai, ma ja-Mehola.
english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

kikuyu: Ashan, Juta kod Beth Shemesh to gi kuondegi mag kwath.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Yaye, Ruoth Nyasaye, mad ichik iti ne lamo mar jatichnini kendo bende ni lamo mag jotichni man-gi ilo mar miyo nyingi luor. Mi jatichni odhi maber ka inyise ngʼwono e nyim ngʼatni.” Ne an jatingʼ divai mar ruoth.
english: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.

kikuyu: To Rebeka nochiko ite ka Isaka wuoyo gi wuode Esau. Kane Esau osewuok odhi e thim mondo odhi oneg le kendo okel,
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

kikuyu: To kinde duto ne odokga Rama, kuma dalane ne nitie, kanyo bende ne ongʼadoe bura ne jo-Israel. Ne ogero kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kanyo.
english: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to the LORD there.

kikuyu: Lem mondo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi onyiswa kuma wanyalo dhiyoe kendo gima wanyalo timo.”
english: that the LORD your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”

kikuyu: Nosomo chikego matek ayanga chakre okinyi nyaka odiechiengʼ tir e nyim chwo, mon kod joma moko mane nyalo winjo tiend chikego kochungʼ momanyore gi laru mar ka miluongo ni Dhoranga Pi. Kendo ji duto nochiko itgi malongʼo ne gik mondikie Kitabu mar Chik.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

kikuyu: Ne adhawone jodong Juda mi apenjogi niya, “Ma en gima rach manade mutimo chiengʼ Sabato?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

kikuyu: Eka Asa nokawo fedha gi dhahabu e kuonde keno mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi mago manokano e ode moorogi ne Ben-Hadad ruodh Aram manodak Damaski.
english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

kikuyu: To ne asiemogi kawacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo unindo oko machiegni gi ohinga?” Ka uchako utimo ma, to abiro makou. Chakre godiechiengno ne ok gichako gidwogo chiengʼ Sabato.
english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Ngʼwononi duongʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; rit ngimana kaluwore gi chikeni.
english: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Negirado ka moro ka moro mako wadgi gi wiye eka ochwoyo ngʼetne gi ligangla; eka giduto negiruombore piny. Omiyo nochak kar lwenyno mane ni Gibeon ni Helkath Hazurim ma tiende ni paw ligangla.
english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

kikuyu: Kane joma otingʼo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ogoyo ondamo auchiel, notimo misango gi rwath gi nyaroya machwe.
english: When those who bore the LORD’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

kikuyu: Kane odak e thim mar Paran, min mare noyudone nyako mokendo koa e piny Misri.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka joma rateke osetho e lweny! Jonathan onindo konegi e godeu maboyo.
english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ka un gi yie matin marom gi koth karadali, to unyalo wacho ne yadh ngʼowuni ni, ‘Pudhri ia mondo ipithri e nam,’ to dine owinjou motimo kamano.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

kikuyu: Eka Farao noluongo Musa gi Harun. Nowachonegi niya, “Koro aseketho. Jehova Nyasaye ni kare, to an kaachiel gi joga wasetimo richo.
english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

kikuyu: Donge noyudo pak mathoth moloyo thuondi adekgo? Nobedo jatendgi kata obedo nine ok en achiel kuomgi.
english: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

kikuyu: to donge ne ogwedha gi chunye nikech ne atwangʼone lewni maliet gi yie rombena.
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

kikuyu: Anto anyisou ni kik utam ngʼat marach timo gima odwaro timo. Ka ngʼato othalo lembi ma korachwich to lokne komachielo bende,
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

kikuyu: Kendo negiterore kode. Mana kaka chwo terore gi ochode e kaka negiterore gi mon mokethorego, ma gin Ohola gi Oholiba.
english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

kikuyu: Ka dine Jehova Nyasaye ok omiya kony, to dikoro asedhi dak e piny ma ji olingʼe thi.
english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

kikuyu: Ne gitedo makati ma ok oketie thowi gi mogo modwal mane giago e piny Misri. Ne ok oketie thowi nikech ne oriembgi gia e piny Misri apoya kendo ne ok giyudo thuolo kata mar tedo chiemo mane ginyalo chamo e kor yo.
english: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.

kikuyu: Ruodh jo-Misri nogole e loch Jerusalem kendo nochuno jo-Juda mondo ochiw osuru mar fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen kod dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo piero adek gangʼwen.
english: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

kikuyu: Bende abiro ketone nyathina makayo, ma en Jal motingʼ malo moloyo ruodhi duto mag piny.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Sulwe duto manie polo noleny nono, polo noban mana ka kalatas, gik moko duto manie polo malo nolwar, mana ka it mzabibu moner, kata ka olemb ngʼowu ma kundi ochwowo.
english: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

kikuyu: Ndalogo jo-Israel ne onge gi ruoth. Kendo e ndalogo joka Dan ne manyo kargi giwegi ma ginyalo dakie, nikech ne pod ok giyudo kar dak e dhout jo-Israel.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Ber pondo kuom Jehova Nyasaye moloyo geno kuom ruodhi.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

kikuyu: Wachni otingʼo puonj maduongʼ mopondo to kata kamano awuoyo kuom Kristo gi Kanisa.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

kikuyu: Achien Yesu nofwenyore ni joote apar gachiel kane oyudo gichiemo; noseyogi nikech yie mane giongego, kendo nikech chunygi ne tek mane ok ginyal yie jogo mane osenene bangʼ kane osechier.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

kikuyu: Kethogi nobed e wigi giwegi, jakor wach nokwan ni jaketho mana kaka ngʼama odhi ire mondo okorne wach bende jaketho.
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

kikuyu: Nikech ne uchando chuny joma kare gi miriambou, ka an to ne ok amiyogi kuyo, kendo nikech ne ujiwo joma timbegi richo mondo kik gilokre giwe timbegi maricho eka gires ngimagi,
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

kikuyu: Ok onyal bedo gi thuolo mar nono kit ngimane e ndalo mosekadho, nikech Nyasaye okete modich gi mor mathoth e chunye.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

kikuyu: Abiro riembo ruodh Ashdod kaachiel gi ngʼat motingʼo ludh Jehova Nyasaye man Ashkelon. Abiro kumo dala mar Ekron, kendo abiro nego jo-Filistia duto modongʼ,” Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo jadolo nyaka non ngʼatno, to ka tuono landore e dende, to jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ogak; nikech en tuo malandore mar del.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

kikuyu: Gichalo sibuor ma nigi kech mar mako le, mana ka sibuor maduongʼ mopondo kokichore.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

kikuyu: Ne gikok matek niya, “Gure!”
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Abiro paro mos kuom tijeni duto, abiro paro matut kuom timbeni madongo duto.”
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kikuyu: Ma e chik mokwongo kendo maduongʼ mogik.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

kikuyu: Aseneno gi wangʼa kaka joga chandore malit e piny Misri. Asewinjo kaka gichur omiyo asebiro mondo agonygi gibed thuolo; koro bi mondo aori idogi Misri!’
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

kikuyu: Eka jotelo duto kod ji duto nowachone jodolo gi jonabi niya, “Ngʼatni ok onego ngʼadne buch tho! Osewuoyonwa e nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.”
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”

kikuyu: Hulda jadolo madhako nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel wacho: Nyisuru ngʼatno mane oorou ira niya,
english: She said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

kikuyu: Mana kaka Muma wacho niya, “Ngʼato angʼata moyie kuome ok none wichkuot.”
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: nikech gikelo ngima ni jogo moyudogo kendo gin gi ngima maber ne ringre dhano duto.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

kikuyu: Giduto negichamo chiemb chuny machalre
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

kikuyu: Weuru gimi nying Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo giland pakne e pinje manie chula.
english: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.

kikuyu: “Ka isetimo tim fuwo ma imiyori duongʼ kendi, kata ka isechano richo, to um dhogi gi lweti!
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

kikuyu: Gima angʼeyo en mana gima Roho Maler nyisa e chunya ni sand kod twech orita e dala ka dala ma adhiye.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

kikuyu: Sa mane Jehu osetieko misango miwangʼo pep, ne ogolo chikne jorit gi jotelo kama: “Donjuru kendo uneg-gi, kendo kik uwe moro otony.” Omiyo neginegogi gi ligangla. Jorit kod jotelogo nowito ringregi oko kendo negidonjo nyaka ei agola mar hekalu mar Baal.
english: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

kikuyu: Kapo ni un ok wuonu kumu kaka okumo nyithinde mamoko duto, to mano nyiso ni un kimirwa kendo ok un nyithinde mahie.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

kikuyu: Kik ibed mabor koda, nikech chandruok ni koda machiegni, kendo onge ngʼama nyalo konya.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

kikuyu: Eka ne alor kaa e got mi aketo kite mopa mag chikego e sanduku mane aseloso mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne osechiko kendo gin kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.

kikuyu: Petro nodhi nyime kawacho niya, “Ondik e Kitap Zaburi kama: “ ‘Mad miechgi dongʼ gunda; ngʼato angʼata kik yiene dag e iye,’ kendo ondik niya, “ ‘Mad ngʼat machielo kaw tije.’
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

kikuyu: To koro sani beduru motegno kendo ma jochir, nimar Saulo ruodhu osetho, kendo dhood Juda osewira abed ruodhgi.”
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro Roho omiyo nyalo mar wuoyo gi rieko, ngʼat machielo Rohono omiyo tiend ngʼeyo weche matut.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

kikuyu: To Yesu noluongogi duto kaachiel mowachonegi niya, “Ungʼeyo ni jotelo mag joma ok jo-Yahudi rito jogegi gi angʼenge, kendo jotendgi madongo tiyogi githuon,
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Kendo wach Samuel nochopo ne jo-Israel duto. Noyudo jo-Israel odhi kedo gi jo-Filistia. Jo-Israel ne ogo kambi Ebeneza to jo-Filistia to nogo kambi Afek.
english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nopenjo niya, “En ngʼa manie laru?” Noyudo ka koro eka Haman donjo e laru ma oko mar dala ruoth mondo owuo gi ruoth kuom wach mar nego Modekai kolier e gima noselosone.
english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

kikuyu: Tim makare mar joma kare maonge ketho loso yoregi moriere, to joricho podho nikech richogi.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

kikuyu: Kane aketo pacha mondo angʼe rieko kendo mondo anon tich matek mar dhano e piny-ka ka nindo ok tere odiechiengʼ gotieno,
english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

kikuyu: To bangʼe ne aneno malaika moro kochungʼe wangʼ chiengʼ, nogoyo koko gi dwol maduongʼ ne winy duto mane huyo e kor polo niya, “Biuru, uchokru kaachiel e kar sawo maduongʼ mar Nyasaye,
english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

kikuyu: Ne aparo e chunya niya, “Bi sani, abiro temi gi gik ma moro wangʼ mondo afwenyie gima ber.” To mano bende ne ayudo kaonge tiende.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

kikuyu: kendo nomiyo jo-Merari geche angʼwen kod rwedhi mabwoch aboro, kaluwore gi tijgi. Giduto ne gin e bwo loch Ithamar ma wuod Harun jadolo.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Ruoth nooro Jehudi mondo okel kitabuno, kendo Jehudi nokele koa kode ei od Elishama jagoro kendo nosomene ruoth kod jotelo duto kochungʼ e bathe.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼatno hike chakore piero auchiel kadhi malo, to nochul shekel apar gabich ka en dichwo, to ka en dhako to noware gi shekel apar.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Nyaka yawuowi matindo bende jara; kendo ka ginena, to ginyiera.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moriwore gi joma osekwan nyaka chiw nus shekel kaluwore gi kweno mar shekel manie kama ler mar lemo, ma pekne romo kilo auchiel. Nus shekel mochiwo nobed mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Johana nodwokogi gi weche mag Isaya Janabi niya, “An e ngʼat makok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo moriere tir ne Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

kikuyu: Nikech lweny mane utimone owadu Jakobo unubed gi wichkuot; mi nokethu nyaka chiengʼ.
english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

kikuyu: Kane wasekwangʼ wangʼado ataro mar nam, machiegni kod Kilikia gi Pamfilia, ne wagowo e dho wadh Mura, e piny Lukia.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

kikuyu: Ginyalo nenore gioko ni rieko ni eigi ka gilemo gi lamo mar paro mar dhano, kendo kuom dembruok ma oko, kod sando ringruok, to chutho gionge ohala nikech ok ginyal konyo ngʼato gengʼo gombo mag ringruok.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

kikuyu: To e ndalo mag Artaksases ruodh Pasia, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabel kod joge mamoko moriwore godo ne ondiko baruwa ne Artaksases. Baruwani nondiki e kit ndiko mar jo-Aram kendo gi dho jo-Aram.
english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi mor un jo-Filistia duto ni luth mane ogougo osetur, nimar koa kuom thuondno nonywol thuond rachier ma kothe nobed gi kwiri marach.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

kikuyu: Ne uneno kod wengeu tem malich, honni madongo tekone kod bat morie mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ogolougo oko. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro timo mano bende ne oganda makoro uluoro.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowachonegi niya, “Ka utimo kamano ma umanoru gi gige lweny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

kikuyu: To nodwoko niya, “Ok en gima kare kawo chiemb nyithindo mondo idir ne guogi.”
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Remono nobed kido mar ranyisi makende manyiso kuma udakie kendo ka aneno remogo to anakadhu. Masiche ma agoyogo piny Misri ok nomaku.
english: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Jehu nodonjo e dalano mochiemo kendo ometho. Eka nowachonegi niya, “Kawuru dhako mokwongʼno udhi uyiki, nimar ne en nyar ruoth.”
english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nikare kendo en adier; en ja-adiera e gik moko duto motimo.
english: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

kikuyu: Nyaka ne gidag mana e aore modwono, kendo ei rogo mag lwendni.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

kikuyu: Solomon nongʼiewo geche mag lweny kod farese; ne en gi geche mag lweny alufu achiel mia angʼwen kod farese alufu apar gariyo mane oketo e mier madongo mag geche lweny to moko bende noketo Jerusalem kama nodake.
english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, chakre odiechiengʼ mane wawinjo kuomu pok waweyo ma ok walamonu ka wakwayo Nyasaye mondo opongʼu gi ngʼeyo dwarone, ka un gi rieko duto mar chuny kod winjo ma Roho Maler chiwo.
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

kikuyu: Kik ucham remo, to pukgiuru piny mana ka pi.
english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

kikuyu: Koa ewi got, tongʼno nochiko yo thidhna mag pige mag Neftoa, mowuok koa e mier matindo mag Got Efron kendo modhi nyaka Baala (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim).
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

kikuyu: Lop dhood Zebulun ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Isakar kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

kikuyu: Neuru ni onge ngʼato kuomu ma jachode, kata ngʼama ochayo Nyasaye kaka Esau ma wach chiemo michamo dichiel nomiyo owilo duongʼne kaka wuowi makayo.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

kikuyu: werneuru ne Jal mariembo gechene e kor polo malo manyaka nene, Jal mamor gi dwol maduongʼ.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

kikuyu: Winj dwonda kaluwore gi herani; rit ngimana, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kaluwore gi chikeni.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: kendo iwachnegi, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: Anaketh pinyni kod dala maduongʼni mana kaka aguch jachwecho itoyo mi ok nyal los kendo. Giniyik joma otho ei Tofeth ma thuolo nobed maonge.
english: and shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

kikuyu: Chuny en jawuond moloyo gik moko duto kendo ok nyal thiedhe. En ngʼa manyalo ngʼeye?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?

kikuyu: “Eka enowachne joma ni e bade koracham ni, ‘Auru buta, un joma okwongʼ-gi, mondo udonji ei mach manyaka chiengʼ mane olosi ne Jachien gi malaikege.
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

kikuyu: lamo nyiseche manono, jwok, sigu, dhawo, nyiego, mirima, ichlit, miero; pogruok e kanyakla,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nowacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼatni dwadhi kune ma ok wanyal yudee? Dibed ni odwaro dhi kuma jowa odakie ka gikere e dier jo-Yunani mondo opuonj jo-Yunani?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

kikuyu: Mad nyinge sik nyaka chiengʼ kendo mad odhi nyime ka wangʼ chiengʼ. Ogendini duto ibiro gwedhi gi gweth moa kuomi kendo gibiro luongi ni ngʼat mogwedhi.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

kikuyu: Eka nyamin nyathino nopenjo nyar Farao niya, “Bende anyalo dhi mondo aluongni achiel kuom mond jo-Hibrania mondo opirni nyathini.”
english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

kikuyu: Musa gi Harun ne gin jodolo mage e dier jodolo mamoko, Samuel ne en achiel kuom joma ne luongo nyinge; negiluongo Jehova Nyasaye kendo nodwokogi.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

kikuyu: odwogo chunya. Otaya e yore mag tim makare mondo nyinge oyud duongʼ.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: anachiwgi ne wasikgi madwaro ngimagi. Ringregi motho nobed chiemb winy mafuyo e kor polo kod le manie piny.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Rapim mar shekel nyaka bed marom gi rapim 20 mag gera. Shekel piero ariyo koriw gi shekel piero ariyo gabich kendo oriwe shekel apar gabich romo mina achiel.
english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

kikuyu: Ka usekawo dala maduongʼno, to uwangʼe gi mach. Timuru gima Jehova Nyasaye osechiko kendo nyaka une ni utimo gik ma achikou.”
english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to the LORD’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”

kikuyu: To sa nogono mane giwuok gilor e yie, ji nofwenyo ni Yesu obiro.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

kikuyu: kata ka obedo ni odhi maber kamano e kind owetene. Yamb yor wuok chiengʼ moa ir Jehova Nyasaye nobi, kakudho koa e piny motwo, ma pigene mag sokni mamol nodwon, kod yewni mokuny bende nodwon. Mwandune manie dechege noyaki duto.
english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of the LORD coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nosando Farao gi joode gi tuoche madongo nikech Sarai chi Abram.
english: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

kikuyu: nikech ka dine bed ni alony e wuondo ji to Jachwechna ditieka piyo nono.
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

kikuyu: to nyaka piny moyugno manie got bende. Beteuru nyaka kuma unyalo, to obiro bedo maru; kata obedo ni jo-Kanaan nigi geche nyinyo kendo gi tegno, pod unyalo riembogi.”
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka kaw tape owuon ma mach ni e yie kendo oketie ubani mangʼwe ngʼar madirom mia ariyo gi piero abich mi uchiwe e nyim Jehova Nyasaye in kaachiel gi Harun.”
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

kikuyu: Adwokone Nyasaye erokamano ma atiyone gi paro maler maonge bura, mana kaka kwerena bende notiyone, ka apari odiechiengʼ gotieno e lemona mapile.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane okor kuom le mag Negev: Kokadho e piny mar chandruok kod masira, motingʼo sibuoche machwo to gi mamon bende kama thuonde mag bungu kod thuonde maringo piyo odakie, jootegi tingʼo mwandugi e ngʼe punde kendo girkeni mag-gi otingʼ e kuom ngamia, kiterone oganda maonge ohala,
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

kikuyu: Tim makare biro telo nyime kendo biro loso yo ne okangene.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

kikuyu: An e Alfa gi Omega, tiende ni Jal Mokwongo kendo Mogik kendo An e Chakruok gi Giko.
english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

kikuyu: Ohinyo denda kinde ka kinde; kendo omonja ka jalweny ma chunye okethore.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

kikuyu: Kane gigole oko, negimako Simon ma ja-Kurene, mane obiro ka oa e gwengʼ moro, kendo negiyieyo msalaba kuome mondo otingʼe koluwo bangʼ Yesu.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

kikuyu: “Daudi wuora noketo e chunye mondo oger hekalu moluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: nimar joma timbegi richo gi jo-miriambo osemonja gi wechegi; gisewuoyo kuomwa marach, adier gisewacho miriambo kuoma.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

kikuyu: To ka unutamru winja ma ok urito chikenago duto,
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

kikuyu: Wach janeno achiel kende ok nyal mi ngʼadne ngʼato bura kuom ketho moro kata richo moro motimo. To wach mantie e kind ji nyaka ngʼere malongʼo ka nitiere joneno ariyo kata adek.
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

kikuyu: “Jatichni ma wuonwa nowachonwa ni, ‘Ungʼeyo ni chiega nonywolona yawuowi ariyo.
english: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne olosonegi nyasi maduongʼ kendo kane gisetieko chiemo kod metho, ne oorogi ma gidok ir ruodhgi. Kuom oganda lweny mag Aram noweyo monjo piny Israel.
english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

kikuyu: Efraim oselwora gi miriambo, od jo-Israel en kar wuond. Juda ok winj Nyasaye; adier ok giwinj Jal Maler ma ja-adiera.
english: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.

kikuyu: Emomiyo Sayun ibiro pur ka puodho, Jerusalem biro dongʼ gunda, got matin mogerie hekalu nobed ka bungu motwere moyugno.
english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.

kikuyu: Obiro chulo ngʼato ka ngʼato mana moromore gi timbene, obiro kumo wasike duto gi mirima mager kendo obiro kumo joma odakie dho nembe.
english: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

kikuyu: Jopinje moko monja; acheje kawo ngimana, gin joma ok dew Nyasaye. Sela
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

kikuyu: Yesu notiyo gi ngeroni to ne ok giwinjo tiend gima nonyisogi.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

kikuyu: Noywak odiechienge abiriyo duto mar nyasi. Omiyo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo nonyise, nikech nosiko mana kokase. Bangʼe nonyiso joge tiend ngerono.
english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

kikuyu: E kindeno chiwo noter e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Maratego koa kuom oganda ma roboche, kendo ma dendgi poth, moluor kuonde duto, oganda ma tokgi tek mawacho dhok mopogore kendo ma pinygi aore opogo. Chiwogi nokel ewi Got Sayun kama Nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nitie.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.

kikuyu: Mirimb ruoth en jaote mar tho, to ngʼat mariek biro hoye.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

kikuyu: Abiro resi e lwet jou kendo kuom joma ok jo-Yahudi. Aori irgi
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

kikuyu: Makmana, ruoth nomiyo Jeramel, ma wuod ruoth, Seraya wuod Azriel gi Shelemia wuod Abdil chik, mondo omak Baruk jandiko kod Jeremia janabi. To Jehova Nyasaye nosepandogi.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but the LORD hid them.

kikuyu: Omiyo atemo matek ndalo duto mondo kinda gi Nyasaye kod ji duto obed maber maonge bura.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

kikuyu: Ibiro wacho niya, “Gigoya, to ok ahinyra! Gigoya, to ok awinji! Karangʼo ma abiro chiewoe mondo adog ameth kendo?”
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

kikuyu: Omiyo boche wuok koa e tungʼ piny koni gi koni, kendo ooro mil polo ka koth chue, bende okelo yamo kogolo e utege mokanogie.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Kane angʼingo makati abich mondo ji alufu abich ocham, ne uchoko ngʼinjo mopongʼo okepe adi?” Negidwoke niya, “Apar gariyo.”
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

kikuyu: “Eka Ruoth nowachona ni, ‘Wuogi idhiyo, nikech abiro ori kuma bor ir joma ok jo-Yahudi.’ ”
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

kikuyu: Nikech iriek bende in gi winjo matut, isekano mwandu mathoth mana ne in iwuon, bende isechoko fedha gi dhahabu mangʼeny, mi ikanogi e dereni mag keno.
english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.

kikuyu: Eka tongʼno nodhi nyime koluwo Jordan kendo nogigi e Nam Chumbi. “ ‘Magi ema nobed tongʼ pinyu koni gi koni.’ ”
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

kikuyu: Wasikwa bende nowacho niya, “Ka pod ok gi ngʼeyo kata ka pod ok gi nenowa, to wabiro poree e diergi kendo wabiro negogi mi wachung tich.”
english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

kikuyu: “Kuom ji adekgi ere miparo ni ne en wadgi ngʼat mane opodho e lwet jomechogo?”
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

kikuyu: Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka aseloko pinyno gunda nikech gik mamono duto magisetimo.’
english: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

kikuyu: Israel nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ukelona chandruogni ka unyiso ngʼatno ni un kod owadu moro?”
english: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

kikuyu: kendo jodolo ne ok nyal tiyo tijegi nikech bor polo nimar duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo hekalu.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Kuom mano onyalo waro chuth joma kadho kuome kasudo ir Nyasaye, nikech ongima nyaka chiengʼ mondo okwanegi Nyasaye.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

kikuyu: Eka Petro nochako wuoyo kowacho niya, “Sani koro ayie adier ni Nyasaye chiwo ni ji duto mana machalre ka ok odewo wangʼ ngʼato,
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

kikuyu: Gibiro gero udi mi gidagie kendo gibiro pidho mzabibu mi gicham olembgi.
english: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

kikuyu: Negitokone chiembe kende, owetene kendgi, kendo jo-Misri mane chiemo kode bende nomi chiembgi kendgi, nikech jo-Misri ne ok nyal chiemo gi jo-Hibrania, nimar mano en gima kwero ne jo-Misri.
english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Piny othonegi mudho kata mana ka chiengʼ rieny, gibagni odiechiengʼ tir mana ka gima en otieno.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

kikuyu: Moro ka moro kuom gik mangimago ne nigi bwombe auchiel kendo ne gin gi wenge mathoth molworo dendgi nyaka e bwo bwombegi. Odiechiengʼ gi otieno duto negisiko kagiwacho niya,
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

kikuyu: Ok nokwe odiechiengʼ gotieno; iro mare nodum kanyo nyaka chiengʼ. Koa e tiengʼ moro nyaka machielo nodongʼ gunda; onge ngʼat manochak oluwe kendo.
english: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

kikuyu: to kane ginene kowuotho ewi pi, negiparo ni en jachien. Omiyo ne gibuok mi gikok matek,
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

kikuyu: “Awachonu adier ni gimoro amora mutweyo e piny-ka notwe e polo bende, kendo gimoro amora mugonyo e piny-ka nogony e polo bende.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, wuo gi jodong Israel kendo iwachnegi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho, Bende unyalo biro ira adier mondo upenja wach? Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon ni ok abi yienu upenja wach, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’

kikuyu: To kik ucham ringʼo ma pod nigi remo kuome.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

kikuyu: kosiemogi ni kik gihul ni en ngʼa.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ja-mirima nyaka yud kum, kendo ka ikonye, to chuno ni nyaka itim kamano kendo.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nodhi mwalo e piny motimo ongoro e Zif, nodhi gi joge alufu adek, jo-Israel moyier, mondo odwar Daudi kuno.
english: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

kikuyu: Kata mana jotichna machwo gi mamon, bende, naol Roho Maler mara kuomgi ndalono.
english: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.

kikuyu: Par nine un wasumbini e piny Misri kendo luwuru chikegi adimba.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora mane Nyasaye okumogie, to ne gimanye mine gilokore ka gidware gi siso.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

kikuyu: Omiyo, osiepega mageno, ka chunywa ok ngʼadnwa bura to wan gi chir e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

kikuyu: to kata kuno bende lweti biro telonae, kendo lweti ma korachwich biro maka motegno.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

kikuyu: Sungruok mar jo-Israel nyiso rachgi; jo-Israel kaachiel gi Efraim podho e richogi; kendo jo-Juda bende podho kodgi.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

kikuyu: Chutho chandruok duto maseyudo okelona mana kony. Nikech herani mogundho iseresa e kethruok; bende isewito richona duto kadiengʼeyi.
english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

kikuyu: “Paruru chike mane Musa jatich mar Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou, kowacho ni: ‘Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kar yweyo kendo osechiwonu pinyni.’
english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

kikuyu: Anabed jasik ngʼatno kendo anangʼad nyinge oko kuom ogandane; kuom chiwo nyathine ni nyasaye manono miluongo ni Molek, osedwanyo kama ler mar lemo, kendo osechayo nyinga maler.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

kikuyu: Miktam mar Daudi. Rita maber, yaye Nyasaye nikech in e kar pondona.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Chutho, un e duongʼwa gi morwa!
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano anaduog gweth mag Moab e ndalo mabiro,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho. Ma e giko mar ngʼadone Moab bura.
english: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

kikuyu: to kare beduru gi paro achiel, gihera achiel kod chuny achiel mondo umi chunya opongʼ gi mor.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

kikuyu: kendo Ahab noseluongo Obadia mane otelo ne dala ruoth maduongʼ. Obadia ne en ngʼat man-gi yie motegno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly;

kikuyu: to kane ok oweyo ma ok okumo koda ka piny machon, e kinde mane omiyo pi oyweyo joma ochayo Nyasaye, to Nowa mane yalo mondo ji otim timbe makare kaachiel gi ji abiriyo mamoko, to ne oreso;
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

kikuyu: Kawe moko matin kuom gigo mondo ireg mayom kendo iketie Sandug Muma manie nyim Hemb Romo, kama abiro romoe kodu, kendo nobednu maler moloyo.
english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kaw Joshua wuod Nun, ngʼat man-gi Roho, kendo yie lweti kuome.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

kikuyu: Damaski osebedo maonge teko, osea gi ngʼwech, kendo achiedh-nade osemake; lit gi rem osemake, kaka rem mar dhako mamuoch kayo.
english: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ket ranyisi mar ligangla kar yore ariyo ma ruodh Babulon biro luwo gi jolwenje, ranyisigo nyaka chakre e piny Babulon. Ket ranyisi moro e akerkeke yorego ma siemo dala maduongʼ.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

kikuyu: Gie ii moro ka moro mar laru angʼwen-go ne nitie ndiri mar kidi, ma bwoye piny ne ogerie kuonde mikudhe mach e alwora duto.
english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jal molony e chik nodwoke niya, “Japuonj, ka iwuoyo kamano wan bende iyanyowa.”
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Mukuru hekaluni, to abiro gere kendo bangʼ ndalo adek.”
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

kikuyu: “To ka giketho e nyimi, nimar onge ngʼato kata achiel ma ok jaketho mi ikecho kodgi, kendo ichiwogi e lwet wasikgi mondo otergi e twech e piny wasikgigo, kuma bor kata machiegni;
english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

kikuyu: Hezekia nopenjo jodolo kod jo-Lawi wach pidhego,
english: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

kikuyu: To in, Pashur, kod jogo duto modak e odi noteru e twech Babulon. Kanyo unuthoe kendo noyiku, in kod osiepeni duto mane isekoronegi miriambo.’ ”
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jokwath:
english: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:

kikuyu: Omiyo Solomon nobedo e kom loch Jehova Nyasaye kaka ruoth kar Daudi wuon mare. Ne en gi gweth kendo jo-Israel nomiye luor.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

kikuyu: Mana kaka dala maduongʼ ma ohingane omukore mogore piny e kaka ngʼatno ma ok nyal ritore owuon.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

kikuyu: Thoma (ma bende iluongo ni Didimas), ma en achiel kuom jopuonjre apar gariyo, ne ok ni kodgi e kinde mane Yesu ofwenyorenigi.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

kikuyu: kod Bela wuod Azaz, ma wuod Shema, wuod Joel. Negidak e gwengʼ kochakore Aroer nyaka Nebo kod Baal Meon.
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

kikuyu: Eka Pilato nokete e lwetgi mondo gigure, kendo jolweny nokawo Yesu modhigo.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

kikuyu: “Sani koro ngimana rumo mos mos; kendo chandruok omaka.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Ka okadho buta to ok anyal nene; ka odhi nyima to ok anyal yange.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

kikuyu: Giduto gisebaro giweyo yo; giduto gisekethore; onge ngʼama timo maber, onge kata achiel.
