english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Jokuo turo udi gotieno, to kochopo odiechiengʼ to gipondo; nimar ok gidwar neno ler.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

kikuyu: To bangʼ kane osesom Ndiko moko mowuok e Chike Musa gi Jonabi, jotend sinagogi nooro wach ni Paulo gi joma ne en-go kagiwacho niya, “Owetewa, ka un gi wach ma udwaro jiwogo ji, to un thuolo mar timo mano.”
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

kikuyu: “Ma e jatichna ma aseyiero, Jal ma ahero ma chunya morgo. Abiro keto Roho Maler mara kuome, kendo obiro lando adiera ne ogendini.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

kikuyu: Enobed odiechiengʼ ma kite yore, maonge gi odiechiengʼ kata otieno. En odiechiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye kende ema ongʼeyo kore. Sa monego piny imre ema ler mar chiengʼ nobedie.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

kikuyu: E odiechiengno, bangʼ ka jo-Israel noseloyo jo-Filistia ne gilawogi koa Mikmash nyaka Aijalon kendo ne giol ahinya.
english: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

kikuyu: Ngʼat mopidho ngʼowu biro chamo olembe, to ngʼatno marito ruodhe ibiro miyo luor.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

kikuyu: To bende waoro owadwa moro kode, mongʼere e kanisni duto nikech tije mar lando Injili.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar apar gariyo e dwe mokwongo ne wawuok ka waa e aora mar Ahava mondo wadhi Jerusalem. Lwet Nyasachwa ne ni kuomwa, nogengʼonwa wasigu gi jonjore mane ni e wangʼ yo.
english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

kikuyu: Eka Elifaz ja-Teman nodwoke kama:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: Azel ne nigi yawuowi auchiel kendo magi e nying-gi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Shearia, Obadia kod Hanan. Magi duto ne yawuot Azel.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Eka Joshua noluongo jo-Gibeon kendo owachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo ne uwuondowa ka uwacho ni, ‘Wadak mochwalore kodu,’ to kuom adier udak mana butwa?
english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

kikuyu: Isemiyo dhano obedo machalo gi rech manie nam, mana kaka gik mochwe modak e nam maonge jatendgi.
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

kikuyu: “ ‘To abiro reso ngima moko kuomgi, nikech jomoko kuomu biro tony ne ligangla, ka ibiro keyou e dier pinje gi ogendini.
english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo an Paulo asedoko misumba Kristo Yesu nikech un joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

kikuyu: “Dhiyo mondo inyisgi gidogi e hema mag-gi.
english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

kikuyu: Napenjo malaika mane loso koda niya, “Gitero atongano kanye?”
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

kikuyu: Negidhi nyime kendo gikedo gi jo-Kanaan modak Hebron (machon ne iluongo ni Kiriath Arba) kendo negiloyo Sheshai, Ahiman kod Talmai.
english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel niya, ‘Kuom le duto manie piny, magi ema unyalo chamo:
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

kikuyu: kadiemo wangʼ ka tungʼ mogik noywagi. Nikech ka turumbete noywagi to jomane osetho nochier gi ringruok ma ok tow, to wan to nolokwa ahucha.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

kikuyu: “Ka dibed ni achiel kuomu dwaro gero ot. Donge obiro bedo piny mokwongo mondo okwan nengone mondo one ka en gi pesa moromo mar tieke?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

kikuyu: Koro Naaman ne en jatend to jolweny mar ruodh Aram. Ne en ngʼat ma ruodhe ogeno kendo morgo, nikech kokalo kuome Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Aram oloyo lweny. Ne en jalweny molony kendo ma jachir, to kata kamano ne en ja-dhoho.
english: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Chiegi nyaka tim gigo duto ma asenyise.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

kikuyu: Yawuot Rael ne gin: Josef kod Benjamin.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato dwar mana gik makonye en owuon, to ngʼato mondo odwar gima konyo jowadgi bende.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

kikuyu: Jopuonj chik kod jodolo madongo nochako manyo yo mane ginyalo makego mapiyo, nikech negingʼeyo ni ogetogi kod ngeroni. To negiluoro ji.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Ibrahim owinjo luong Nyasaye mi owuok odhi e piny mokia, mane biro bedo mare bangʼe achien. Nowuok awuoka modhi kata obedo ni nokia kuma nodhiye kamano.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Biuru machiegni mondo wapor wach, kata obedo ni richou kwar manade to ibiro luoki magibed matar ka pe, bende kata bed ni gikwar malich to nobed marachar ka pamba.
english: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

kikuyu: Kendo ndikuru weche duto mag chikni mochanore e kite ma usechungono.”
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo un bende kaka udwaro mondo ubed gi mich mag Roho, temuru matek moloyo mondo unwangʼ mich mago magero kanisa.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

kikuyu: Joab noneno ni wasigu ni yo ka nyime gi yo katoke, omiyo noyiero jolweny mabeyo moloyo ei Israel, moketogi mondo giked gi jo-Aram.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: “Wuora, ka iyie, to gol kikombeni oa kuoma, to ok dwarona, to mari ema otimre.”
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

kikuyu: kata ji ok nowach ni, ‘Eri go,’ kata ni, ‘Ee cha go cha,’ nikech pinyruodh Nyasaye ni eiu.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo beduru mamor un polo, kod joma odak e iye! To mano kaka nobed malit ne piny gi nam, nikech Jachien oselor obiro iru! En gi mirima mager nikech ongʼeyo ni ndalo matin kende ema odongʼne.”
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

kikuyu: Weche mag mor chalo gi mor kich gimit ne chuny kendo gikelo ngima ni choke.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

kikuyu: mowachonegi niya, “Usetimo gigo duto mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye ochiko, kendo bende useluora e gigo duto mane achikou.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

kikuyu: Gikanyono nochungo ka ji duto nene modhiyo dala kopako Nyasaye.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

kikuyu: Tunge angʼwen mane okaw kar mano mane omuk oko ochungʼ kar pinjeruodhi angʼwen mabiro chakore e pinye to ok bi bedo gi teko marom gi mare.
english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

kikuyu: Donge ne onyisa ni ma nyaminwa; kendo donge Sara ema nowachona ni ma owadwa? Asetimo ma giparo malongʼo kod lwedo maler.”
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

kikuyu: “Negiwacho ni, ‘Jaduongʼ donge en-gi silingʼ alufu apar.’
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar abich chiwuru rwedhi ochiko, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Jotichna nower, kamor opongʼo chunygi, to unuywagi ka lit opongʼo chunyu, kendo unudengi ka chunyu otur.
english: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. “Jogi osesanda malit nyaka aa e tin-na,” Israel mondo owach niya;
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Kuom mano japuonj chik moro ka moro mosetiegi kuom wach pinyruodh polo chalo gi wuon ot magolo kuom gik mokano e deche, mwandu machon gi manyien.”
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma anyalo wuoyogo kendo miyo siemni? En ngʼa manyalo winja? Itgi odino omiyo ok ginyal winjo wach. Wach Jehova Nyasaye chwanyogi; ok gine gima ber kuome.
english: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the LORD’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

kikuyu: Jogo mane oor motelo nodhi kendo negiyude mana kaka nosenyisogi
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

kikuyu: Ngʼama notem ringo kowinjo mahu mar masira nolwar e bur, kendo ngʼama notem wuok e burno nolwar e obadho. Dhorangeye mag polo noyawre, kendo mise mag piny noyiengni.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

kikuyu: Kik icham chiemb jagwondo, kik igomb chiembe mamit,
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

kikuyu: to ber mondo kuthe odongi kar ngano kendo buya odongi e puothano kar shairi.” Weche Ayub orumo gi ka.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Ngʼato angʼata morwako nyathi matin-ni e nyinga orwaka, to ngʼama orwaka, orwako jal mane oora. Nimar ngʼat matin mogik kuomu duto en ngʼama duongʼ moloyo.”
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

kikuyu: (kaka nowacho gi dho jonabige maler mag ndalo machon),
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

kikuyu: Kendo noywak matek ma jo-Misri nowinje, kendo jood Farao bende nowinjo wachno.
english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni an chien kendo ji ochaya, to wiya ok nyal wil gi bucheni.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

kikuyu: Ezra-ni noduogo koa Babulon. Ne en japuonj man-gi lony mathoth kuom Chik Musa, ma Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nochiwo. Ruoth nomiye gimoro amora mano kwayo, nimar lwet Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasache ne ni kuome.
english: this Ezra went up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to the LORD his God’s hand on him.

kikuyu: Bende ja-Kush nyalo loko kit piene kata kwach nyalo loko kido man kuome? Kamano bende ok inyal timo maber, in ngʼatno mongʼiyo gi timbe maricho.
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

kikuyu: E kindeno yo maduongʼ nobedi koa Misri nyaka Asuria. Jo-Asuria nodhi Misri kendo jo-Misri bende nodhi Asuria. Jo-Misri kod jo-Asuria nolam kaachiel.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

kikuyu: Laban nowacho niya, “Pidhni en janeno e kinda kodi kawuono!” Mano emomiyo iluonge ni Galeed.
english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

kikuyu: Eka Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz noduogo mier mane oyudo Ben-Hadad wuod Hazael nosemayo Jehoahaz wuon mare e lweny. Jehoash noloyo Ben-Hadad nyadidek e lweny mine odwoko miergo duto e lwet jo-Israel.
english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

kikuyu: “To ne, wachno osiko kondiki e nyima ni: Ok analingʼ to abiro chulo kuor adimba; abiro chulo kuor kuneno,
english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

kikuyu: An e dhorangach; ma ngʼato angʼata mokadho kuoma nokwo kendo nodonj iye mi owuog oko kendo oyud kar kwath maber.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

kikuyu: Adier usewinjo kaka Nyasaye nomiya tijni mar ngʼwono nikech un,
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

kikuyu: Koro Ahab nonyiso Jezebel mago duto mane Elija nosetimo kendo kaka nosenego jonabi gi ligangla,
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kenaz ne gin: Othniel kod Seraya. Yawuot Othniel ne gin: Hahath kod Meonothai.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Jokor Misri nopodhi kendo tekone mosungorego norem. Chakre Migdol nyaka Aswan Ginipodhi duto e dho ligangla manie diergi, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “‘The LORD says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Aluor ni ka abiro iru kuno to anyalo yudou ka ok uchal kaka adwaro ni uchal, kendo un bende unyalo yudo ka apogora gi kaka udwaro ni abedi. Aluor ni anyalo yudo ka nitie dhawo gi nyiego, gi mirima, gi pogruok, gi ajara, gi kuoth, gi sunga kod koko e dieru.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye osereso Daudi e lwet wasike duto kod e lwet Saulo, Daudi nowerne Jehova Nyasaye kopake gi weche mag wendni.
english: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

kikuyu: E dala manie piny gode, mago mantie e tie gode man yo podho chiengʼ kod mago man Negev, mantiere e gwenge mag Benjamin, e mier molworo Jerusalem kod dala mag Juda, rombe nokal kendo e lwet ngʼatno ma kwanogi,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne agolou e loch jo-Misri kendo aresou e lwet joma ne sandou. Ne ariembogi gia e nyimu kendo amiyou pinygi.
english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

kikuyu: “ ‘ “Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya: Kapo ni piny kata gwengʼ moro amora ok noti ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon kata kulo wiye e bwo jok mare, to anakum pinyno gi ligangla, kech kod masira, nyaka ane ni atieke gi lwete.
english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says the LORD, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

kikuyu: “Giketo lewgi moikore ka atungʼ, mondo gidirgo miriambo; to dhigi maber e piny ok nikech giwacho adiera. Gitimo richo bangʼ moro ka moro; ok gidewa.” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ubiro kedo kodwa?” Negidwokogi niya, “Wabiro mako Samson, mondo watimne kaka otimonwa.”
english: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego en ngʼa machalo kodi? In Jehova Nyasaye iratego kendo adierani olwori.
english: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

kikuyu: Negimor kendo ne giyie miye pesa.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

kikuyu: Joma wer gi dhogi otelo eka joma wer ka goyo thumbe luwogi, nyiri magoyo oyieke bende ni kodgi machiegni.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto notimo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa gi Harun,
english: All the children of Israel did so. As the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

kikuyu: Bende e Jerusalem, Jehoshafat noketo jo-Lawi, jodolo kaachiel gi jotend anywola moko mag jo-Israel mondo ongʼad bura e nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo gikel kwe e tungni. Kendo negidak Jerusalem.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for the LORD and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To ka jakuo ok oyudi, wuon ot nyaka chopi e nyim jongʼad bura mondo gifweny ka dipo ni lwete omulo mwandu nyawadgi
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

kikuyu: To ka oganda moro amora ok dwar chiko ite, to anapudhe chuth mi atieke,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ma notimore nikech un ji ariyogi ne uweya e nyim jo-Israel kar pi mar Meriba Kadesh man e piny ongoro mar Zin kendo nikech ne ok urito nyinga maler e kind jo-Israel.
english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: To nodhi nyime kowachone Josef wechego odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, to notamore riwore kode kata bedo bute.
english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Esau nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Waikreuru mondo wadhi kanyakla.”
english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

kikuyu: Adwaro mondo ikwongʼrina gi nying Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach polo kod piny ni ok ibi yudone wuoda dhako koa kuom nyi Kanaan ma an jadak e kindgini,
english: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

kikuyu: Kane gisedhi mochwolore gi od Mika, jogo mane odak machiegni gi Mika noluong kanyakla kendo negilawo jo-Dan.
english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.

kikuyu: To ka ok onyal waro lopeno, to lopno nosik e lwet ngʼat mane ongʼiewocha nyaka chop higa mar piero abich. To kochopo higa mar morno to nowe lowo odogni wuon mare machon, kendo wuon-gi nokawe.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: E sechego jo-Israel nowuok kanyo ma gidok e miechgi kendo e dhoutgi ka ngʼato ka ngʼato dok e lope owuon.
english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nyalo bedo gi yie mar chamo chiemo moro amora, to ngʼat machielo ma yiene yomyom chamo mana alot kende.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Wuora osiko katiyo tichne nyaka kawuono, kendo an bende atiyo mana kamano.”
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

kikuyu: Misango mar jaricho ok ber, onyalo bedo marach maromo nade ka ochiwe gi paro marach!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

kikuyu: Timbe mamoko mag loch Zimri gi ngʼanyo mane obedogo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag rapar mag ruodhi Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: To koa kuom nus oganda Manase jo-Israel nochiwo Aner kod Biliam, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath ne anywola dhout Kohath mane odongʼ.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

kikuyu: Jangʼwech ka jangʼwech madhi e piem ritore e yore duto. Gitimo kamano mondo giyud osimbo ma ok siki; wan to waritore mondo wayud osimbo mabiro siko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

kikuyu: wuod Amzi, wuod Bani, wuod Shemer,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

kikuyu: Oywak matek e bath dhorangeye midonjogo e dala maduongʼ,
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

kikuyu: Iro nodum koa e otuchi mag ume; mach mangʼangʼni nodhuolore kawuok e dhoge, kendo makaa maliel mager nobebni kawuok kuome.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni aonge kodu kuno e ringruok, to ngʼeuru ni an kodu kuom chuny. An to asengʼadone ngʼat matimo tim marachno bura, mana ka gima ne an kodu kuno.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

kikuyu: Ngʼama nena, neno Jal mane oora.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

kikuyu: kendo ka ok uwinjo weche mag jotichna ma jonabi, maseoronu pile ka pile (kata kamano pod ok uwinjo),
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—

kikuyu: Timbe mahundu ok nochak owinji e pinyu, tuo kata kethruok moro marach ok nochak owinji machiegni gi tongʼ magu, to iniluong ohinga magi ni Warruok kendo dhorangeyeni ni Pak.
english: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

kikuyu: jogo ma paro giwegi ni giler to ok osepwodhgi kuom kethruokgi;
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

kikuyu: Kane jonon pinygo ne pok odhi nindo, dhakoni noidho modhi ewi tado,
english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

kikuyu: Ka giromo dwe achiel, nyaka iwargi e nengo mar wero ma en shekel abich mar fedha, kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ma pekne romo gera piero ariyo.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

kikuyu: Kane pod gin ji manok e kar rombgi, ne ginok ahinya kendo ne gin welo e pinyno,
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone joma nobiro makego niya, “Uwuokna oko mondo umaka ka utingʼo ligengni kod arunge mana ka gima an jatend koko mar jo-jendeke nangʼo?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

kikuyu: Kik ineki.
english: “You shall not murder.

kikuyu: In kod Harun mondo ukwan jo-Israel kuketogi e migepegi, ma mago jo-higni piero ariyo kadhi nyime nyalo tiyo e lweny.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

kikuyu: Koro jotend oganda nodak Jerusalem, kendo joma nodongʼ nogoyo ombulu ka giyiero achiel kuom ji apar mondo odag Jerusalem, dala maduongʼ maler, to ji ochiko mane odongʼ, to nowe e miechgi.
english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar lochne nooro jotelo mage kaka Ben-Hail, Obadia, Zekaria, Nethanel gi Mikaya mondo opuonj e mier mag Juda.
english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

kikuyu: Abiro wichi mi aket olowu e dandi kendo agoli oko kaachiel gi jolweny magi duto, gi faresegi, gi joriemb faresegi momanore gi gigegi mag lweny, kod oganda mag lweny maduongʼ momanore gi kuodi madongo kod matindo, ka giduto gimilo liganglagi.
english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

kikuyu: Temuru duto munyalo mondo urit achiel mar Roho ka usiko e kwe moriwou kaachiel.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

kikuyu: Yesu ema Ndiko owuoyo kuome kawacho niya, “ ‘Kidi ma un jogedo nudagi ema koro osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot.’
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

kikuyu: Samson nowachonegi niya, “Koro an-gi ratiro mar kedo gi jo-Filistia; ma kata koro atimonegi marach to aonge gi ketho.”
english: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”

kikuyu: Gisedonjo matut e timbe mag miganga mana ka ndalo mag Gibea. Nyasaye nopar timbegi mamono kendo enokumgi e richogi.
english: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.

kikuyu: Ne ok gidaro jo-Kanaan mane odak Gezer. Nyaka chil kawuono jo-Kanaan pod odak gi jo-Efraim ka gitiyonegi kaka wasumbinigi.
english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

kikuyu: Koro neuru ma e ruoth ma useyiero, mane ukwayo; omiyo Jehova Nyasaye oseketo ruoth mondo oritu.
english: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, the LORD has set a king over you.

kikuyu: Koro Amnon ne nigi osiepne miluongo ni Jonadab wuod Shimea, ma owadgi Daudi. Jonadab ne en ngʼat ma riekone richo.
english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

kikuyu: Oganda ma ok ingʼeyo nocham gik mitiyo matek gi luchi e puotheni kendo onge gima initim makmana tingʼ mapek kod achune e ndalou duto.
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

kikuyu: Shefatia wuod Matan, Gedalia wuod Pashur, Jehukal wuod Shelemia, kod Pashur wuod Malkija nowinjo gima Jeremia ne nyiso ji duto sa mane owacho ni,
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wuoyo, ja-Farisai moro norwake mondo gichiem kode, omiyo nodonjo ei ot kendo nobedo kodgi e mesa.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Nying Jehova Nyasaye mondo opaki, sani kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Omiyo nochiwo chik ni joge, mine ginegogi. Negingʼado lwetgi gi tiendgi mine giliero ringregi e dho yawo man Hebron. Negikawo wi Ish-Boseth ma giyiko e liend Abner e Hebron.
english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

kikuyu: Got Sinai noyiengni e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Nyarwa, iywago angʼo?” Nowachonegi niya, “Gisekawo Ruodha gidhigo, to akia kama giketee.”
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

kikuyu: Ka uwinjo ywak mar tungʼ, asili, nyagweru, nyatiti, orutu kod kit thumbe mayoreyore, mi upodho piny auma kendo ulamo kido maseloso, to mano ber. To ka ok upodho piny auma mi ulame, to ibiro diru e mach makakni. Koso uparo ni nitie nyasaye moro manyalo resou e lweta?”
english: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands?”

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, wach ni Farao ruodh Misri kaachiel gi ogandane mag lweny kama: En ngʼa ma inyalo pim kodi?
english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Awachoni adier ni onge ngʼama nyalo donjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye ka ok onywole gi pi kod Roho Maler.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: jogo ma wangʼ-gi tek masungore, manenogi richo;
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

kikuyu: Koro magi e joma noa e gwenge manoduogo koa e twech Babulon, kuma Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon noterogie. Negidwogo Jerusalem kod Juda, ka moro ka moro dok e dalane owuon,
english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

kikuyu: Bethe ndiri mamalo duto romre ma borne gi lachne en fut piero ariyo gachiel moro ka moro. Raidhi kendono oger kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ.”
english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

kikuyu: to dhano adhana to en angʼo momiyo ipare, wuod dhano to en angʼo momiyo iketo pachi kuome?
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Gisegero kuonde motingʼore malo mar Tofeth e Holo mar Ben Hinom mondo gi wangʼ yawuotgi kod nyigi e mach ma en gima ne ok achiko, kata ne ok odonjo e pacha.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

kikuyu: Samuel nosetho kendo Israel duto noywage mine giike e dalane man Rama. Saulo noseriembo ajuoke, gi jo-nyakalondo oa e piny.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

kikuyu: Guogi biro chamo joka Baasha motho e mier madongo, kendo winy mae kor polo biro chamo mago motho e pewe.
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

kikuyu: Adiera in Nyasaye modak apanda, yaye Nyasaye kendo Jawar mar Israel.
english: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”

kikuyu: “Abiro tieko dhano kaachiel gi le, bende abiro tieko winy mafuyo e kor polo, kaachiel gi rech manie nam. Jomaricho biro pie pidhe pidhe, e ndalo manatiek dhano e wangʼ piny,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowuok kendo nonyiso ji gima Jehova Nyasaye nowacho. Nokelo jodong-gi piero abiriyo ma gichokore kanyakla kendo noketogi duto gichungʼ ka gilworo Hemb Romo.
english: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to piny mane igolowa biro wacho ni, ‘Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne ok nyal kawogi matergi e piny mane osesingonegi kendo nikech ne ok oherogi, to Jehova Nyasaye osetero joge e thim mondo otho kuno nikech osin kodgi.’
english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

kikuyu: nomiyogi pinje mag ogendini, kendo gik ma jomoko nono nochandore ka loso nodoko girkeni magi,
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

kikuyu: Wach donjona moloyo jodongo machon nimar arito chikeni.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

kikuyu: Osendiki ni: ‘Ne okwane kod joketho’; kendo awachonu ni wachni nyaka timrena. Ee, gino mondik kuoma koro chiegni timore.”
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Kane Kora osechoko joge duto mondo okwedgo Musa gi Harun e dhoranga Hemb Romo, duongʼ Jehova Nyasaye ne onyisore ayanga ne oganda mane ochokore duto.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. The LORD’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

kikuyu: Nochiwore kaka ochot ne jo-Asuria duto mosomo kendo ne odwanyore gi nyiseche manono duto mag ngʼato angʼata mane chunye gombo.
english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.

kikuyu: “Gol ngʼat moseyanyano oko mar kambi. Ji duto mane nitie koyenyo mondo giket lwetgi e wiye kendo kanyakla mar jo-Israel duto okaw kite ochielego.”
english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

kikuyu: Kuom kinde marabora jo-Israel ne onge gi Nyasaye ma adier kaachiel gi jadolo mane nyalo puonjogi kendo ne gionge gi chik.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

kikuyu: Ok nochak oluong ngʼat mofuwo ni ngʼat malongʼo, kata ngʼat ma ja-miganga ni ngʼat ma ogen.
english: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

kikuyu: Pi wangʼ Yesu nochwer.
english: Jesus wept.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo kendo inyis Hanania, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Iseturo jok mar bao, to e kar mano enoketni jok mar chuma.
english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘The LORD says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata momulo ringre ngʼama otho biro bedo mochido kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: Kawuru Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo uket e gari, keturu Sanduku machielo bute mondo uketie gik molos gi dhahabu muterone kaka misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho, kendo uweye odhi,
english: and take the LORD’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye nokwongo chweya kaka tichne mokwongo motelo ni tijene machon.
english: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: Hanamel wuod Shalum ma wuod owadgi wuonu nobi iri kendo nowach ni, ‘Ngʼiew lopa man Anathoth, nikech kaka watna machiegni koda en ratiro mari kendo tiji mondo ingʼiewe.’
english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Israel nodag kende gi kwe; bende nyithind Jakobo norit maber, e piny ma cham nitie kod divai manyien, kama thoo moa e polo lwarie gokinyi.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nondiko chikegi mi omiyogi jodolo, ma yawuot Lawi, mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok Jehova Nyasaye. Jodong Israel bende nomi chikego.
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: To Elisha nowachone niya, “Donge chunya ne ni kodi kane ngʼatno olor e gache duogo romo kodi? Bende en sa ma ikawoe pesa, kata law, kata zeituni, kata mzabibu, kata chiayo, kata dhok, kata jotich machwo, kata ma nyiri?
english: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

kikuyu: Joka Gershon, kuom anywola ka anywola nopog mier apar gadek koa kuom oganda mar Isakar, Asher kod Naftali, kendo koa e nus mar dhout oganda Manase manodak Bashan.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Ka wuod Jesse pod ngima e pinyni to in kata pinyruodhi ok nyal gurore. Koro or wach mondo okelnago nikech nyaka otho!”
english: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”

kikuyu: Kawuononi Jehova Nyasaye biro keti e lweta, abiro goyi piny mi angʼad ngʼuti. Kawuono abiro miyo winy mae kor polo gi le man e thim ringre jolweny mag jo-Filistia, kendo piny mangima biro ngʼeyo ni nitie Nyasaye ei Israel.
english: Today, the LORD will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

kikuyu: Teko Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kuoma, kendo ne ogola oko kuom teko mar Roho mare mi otera e dier holo moro; kama choke opongʼo.
english: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

kikuyu: jadolo nyaka non adholano, to ka onenore ni odholore kendo yier manie iye ratongʼ kendo ongelore, jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ogak; nikech en kama ilni, ma en tuo malandore e wich kata e tik.
english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

kikuyu: Rwakuru ngʼama yie mare yomyom ma ok umino kode wach kuom weche ma pod en-go gi kiawa.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

kikuyu: En angʼo ma ngʼama riek nigo moloyo ngʼama ofuwo? En ohala mane ma ngʼama ofuwo yudo kuom ngʼeyo kaka dodimbre e nyim joma moko?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

kikuyu: Tho oseidho gie dirisni magwa kendo osedonjo kuondewa mochiel motegno gohinga; osengʼado nyithindo oko e yore kendo rowere e kuonde budho mag galamoro.
english: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

kikuyu: Ne giridho tiendene gi arungu mochuoye chuma, kendo ne giridho ngʼute gi chumbe,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

kikuyu: Nikech gima notimoreni, ji duto chakre jochan nyaka joma omewo, to gi jotend jolweny duto, noringo modhi Misri nikech negiluoro jo-Babulon.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Kane Abigael oneno Daudi nolor piyo koa e pundane mane oidho mine mokulore e nyim Daudi nyaka e lowo.
english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

kikuyu: Ka Musa norieyo ludhe kochomo polo, Jehova Nyasaye nooro mor polo gi pe kendo polo nomil koni gi koni, kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye noolo pe e piny Misri.
english: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Yaye jo-Kush, un bende liganglana biro negou.”
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

kikuyu: Nowacho ni jatichne niya, “Dhiyo mondo ingʼi yo ka nam.” Kendo nodhi mongʼiyo. Noduogo mowacho niya, “Ok aneno gimoro kanyo.” Elija nowachone nyadibiriyo niya, “Dogi mondo ingʼi.”
english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ibrahim nochako kanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Jachiwo kendo nyaka chil kawuono iwacho niya, “E God Jehova Nyasaye ema nochiwe.”
english: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”

kikuyu: Kane gichako wer kendo pake, Jehova Nyasaye norundogi ma jo-Amon kod jo-Moab kaachiel gi jo-Got Seir manomonjo Juda nochako kedo kendgi giwegi mi nologi.
english: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni un koth Ibrahim, kata kamano udwaro nega, nikech udagi miyo Wachna thuolo e chunyu.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

kikuyu: odiechiengʼ mane onyiso e lela honni mage e piny Misri kane otimo ranyisino e gwengʼ mar Zoan.
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

kikuyu: jo-Sidon, jo-Amalek kod jo-Maon nothirou kendo ne uywakna mondo akonyu, donge ne aresou ma ua e lwetgi?
english: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno nokela kakalo koda kar donjo man e dir rangach midonjogo e ute maler mowal mochomo nyandwat, mane gin mag jodolo, kendo nonyisa kamoro mane nitie yo ka tungʼ mogik mare.
english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

kikuyu: Koro ne en kar sa auchiel mar odiechiengʼ, mudho nobiro moimo piny duto nyaka sa ochiko,
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Uparo ni batiso mar Johana noa e polo koso noa kuom dhano?”
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

kikuyu: Nobawo kerubigo gi dhahabu.
english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

kikuyu: To kochopo godhiambo ma bangʼe kinyne ngʼatno ne biroe ira, bad Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kuoma, kendo ne oyawo dhoga ka ngʼatno ne pok ochopo ira gokinyi. Omiyo dhoga ne oyawore kendo koro ne ok alingʼ mak awuoyo.
english: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

kikuyu: Par ne ji mondo ochiw luor ne jotelo. Nyisgi mondo giwinj chik kendo mondo gibed moikore ne timo gimoro amora maber,
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

kikuyu: Kata kamano, e higa mokwongo mar Sairas ruodh Babulon, Ruoth Sairas nochiwo chik mondo odni mar Nyasaye oger manyien.
english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

kikuyu: Eka negiwacho kendgi giwegi niya, “Ok watim gima kare. Ma en odiechiengʼ mar wach maber, to eka walingʼ-go mana kendwa. Ka warito ma piny oyawore, to wabiro yudo kum. Kuom mano wadhiuru sani sani mondo water wachni ni joka ruoth.”
english: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

kikuyu: To ka ok urito chikegi, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, akwongʼora an owuon ni kar dak ruodhni nolal nono.’ ”
english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says the LORD, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”

kikuyu: Kaponi udhi e dala moro to ok orwaku kata ka jo-dalano otamore winjo wachu, to mondo utengʼ buch tiendeu bangʼe ua kanyo. Mano nobednigi ranyisi ni bura oseloyogi.”
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

kikuyu: Osiepna, alamo ni mondo ibed gi ngima maber, kendo ni mondo gik moko duto odhini maber, mana kaka chunyi dhi maber.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

kikuyu: “Asher nobed gi chiemo mamit; nobed gi chiemo moromo ruoth chamo.
english: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

kikuyu: mondo kik gibed e bwo loch ngʼat mokia Nyasaye, kendo machiko ni ji obadho.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia kama:
english: Therefore the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Jachien marachno noyuko ngʼatno mi ogoyo koko gi dwol ma liyore, bangʼe oa oweye.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

kikuyu: Ji duto nochungʼ mowuoyo gi dwol achiel niya, “Onge ngʼato kuomwa ka mabiro dhi dala. Ooyo, onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomwa madok e ode.
english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

kikuyu: To ruoth to biro bedo moil kuom Nyasaye; ji duto masingore e nying Nyasaye biro pake, to dho jo-miriambo ibiro um mi lingʼ.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

kikuyu: Kane Maria owinjo mano, noa malo piyo piyo mi odhi ire.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato omiyo wadgi punda kata rwath kata rombo kata chiayo moro amora mondo oritne maber to chiayono otho kata ohinyore kata okwal,
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth ne ok odewo kwayo mar ji, nimar Nyasaye ema nomiyo mano otimore mondo ochop wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho gi dho Ahija ja-Shilo ne Jeroboam wuod Nebat.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

kikuyu: Noluwo nyasaye madhako mar jo-Sidon miluongo ni Ashtoreth kod nyasach dwanyruok mar jo-Amon miluongo ni Molek.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

kikuyu: Ka weche ngʼeny, to richo ok nyal bare ma ok obetie, to ngʼat marito lewe oriek.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Chiengʼno soko moro noyaw ni joka Daudi gi joma odak Jerusalem, soko ma nopwodhgi kuom richogi duto gi gak ma gigakgo.”
english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane olemo e hekalu mar Nisrok nyasache, yawuote miluongo ni Adramelek gi Shareza nonege gi ligangla, bangʼe negiringo gidhi e piny Ararat. Kendo Esarhadon wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Makir wuod Manase nodhi Gilead, moloyo dalano mi giriembo jo-Amor mane oyudo odak kanyo.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

kikuyu: Hezekia nolokore kongʼiyo kor ot mi olamo Jehova Nyasaye kama.
english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Johana nowacho ne oganda mane biro mondo obatisgi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “En kik wayieche. Wagouru ombulu e dierwa mondo wangʼe ngʼama kawe.” Mano notimore mondo Ndiko ochop kare manowacho niya, “Ne gipogore lepa e kindgi giwegi kendo gigoyo ombulu ne nangana.” Mano e kaka ne jolwenygo notimo.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

kikuyu: Joshua nowacho niya, “Yawuru dho rogono kendo ugol ruodhi abichgo oko mi ukelgi ira.”
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

kikuyu: Unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka anati e dieru nikech nyinga, to ok nikech yoreu maricho kod timbeu mobam, yaye dhood Israel, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ndalo biro ma anapidhe od Israel kod od Juda gi koth ji kod mar le.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

kikuyu: kendo nonano kodgi e thim kuom higni piero angʼwen, kata obedo ni timbegi ne richo kamano.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Simeon kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Nemuel, joka Nemuel; koa kuom Jamin, joka Jamin; koa kuom Jakin, joka Jakin;
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

kikuyu: Kane oyudo pod en e yo odok dalane, jotichne noromone gi wach ni wuode koro ngima.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

kikuyu: Tekoni duto osedok piny nyaka ei liel, kaachiel gi thumbe ma yande iwinjo; kudni e pieni minindoe kendo e ongedi ma iumorigo.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

kikuyu: Eka nooro joote mondo otel nyime odhi e dala jo-Samaria mondo oikne gik moko;
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, “E ndalona mag kech abiro dwoko kwayoni, chutho ne akonyi e odiechiengʼ mar warruok; abiro riti mi ami ibed ngʼama kelo winjruok e kinda gi ji mondo ires piny, mi ipog ji kuonde ma yande odongʼ gunda,
english: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokone Harun gi yawuote niya, “Teduru ringʼono e dho Hemb Romo, kendo kanyo ema uchame gi makati manie okapu kama nitie gik mipwodhogo jodolo ne tich, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochika, kawacho ni, ‘Harun gi yawuote ema nyaka cham ringʼono.’
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

kikuyu: Joma muol gin joma ogwedhi nimar piny nobed girkeni margi.
english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

kikuyu: kendo mad idag amingʼa nyaka ine nyithind nyithindi, Israel mondo obed gi kwe!
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

kikuyu: nyarwath achiel, im achiel kod nyaim achiel ma hike achiel, nochiw misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Ka Herode nofwenyo ni Ajuokego nosewuonde, iye nowangʼ matek, kendo nogolo chik mondo onegi nyithindo ma yawuowi duto modak Bethlehem gi mier molwore, mane hikgi ariyo kadok chien, kaluwore gi sa mane Ajuokego onyise.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

kikuyu: Eka Balak nooro jotelo mamoko mangʼeny moloyo kendo mongirore moloyo mokwongo ka.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

kikuyu: nimar un oganda mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Kuom ogendini manie wangʼ piny, Jehova Nyasaye oseyierou mondo ubed mwandune mogeno.
english: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

kikuyu: kendo kuom piny joga, piny mopongʼ gi kuthe kod pedo, ee, ywaguru udi ma yande mor opongʼo kendo kuom dala maduongʼ mar mor gi ilo masani odongʼ nono.
english: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek oluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo okwedo richo, to ngʼama ofuwo wiye tek kendo omuomore.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

kikuyu: To kane giseidho yie, yamo nokwe mos.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

kikuyu: Ka urito adimba chike duto ma amiyou mondo uluw mi uhero Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ka uwuotho e yorene kendo ka urito wechene,
english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruodh jo-Misri nogolo chik mondo mond jo-Hibrania ma jocholo miluongo ni Shifra kod Pua niya,
english: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,

kikuyu: “Nyis ogendini kendo go milome ne Jerusalem niya, ‘Jolweny mager biro iru kawuok e piny mabor, ka gigoyo koko mar agengʼa mar lweny kuom mier madongo mag Juda.
english: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

kikuyu: kod Sandug Muma gi ludhene gi raum mar kar pwodhruok;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kikuyu: Ngʼat machielo mwaoro kodgi en owadwa mwasetemo mwaneno ni en ngʼama ochiwore ni tije mangʼeny, to sani koro ochiwore moloyo nikech gen mogenougo.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

kikuyu: E kindeno, an Daniel, noyudo akuyo kuom jumbe adek,
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

kikuyu: Kik udew wangʼ ka ungʼado bura, winj ngʼat matin kod maduongʼ mana machal. Kik uluor wangʼ ngʼato nimar bura makare en mar Nyasaye. Kelnauru bura moro amora matek ma ok unyal kendo abiro winjo.
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

kikuyu: Kuom lopno, ma borne gi lachne en fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich maromre noket tenge mondo gerie kama ler mar lemo, kendo nowe thuolo alwora ma hekaluno maromo fut piero abiriyo gabich.
english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

kikuyu: Med ndalo mar ngima ruoth, mede higni e tienge mangʼeny.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

kikuyu: “Malit ochomou, jotelo ma muofnigi! Uwacho ni, ‘Ka ngʼato okwongʼore gi nying hekalu to onge wach, to ni ka ngʼato okwongʼore gi nying dhahabu mar hekalu to kwongʼruokneno otweye.’
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Jokel kwe machwoyo koth kwe kayo tim makare.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

kikuyu: “Nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Achiegni chiwi e lwet joma ichayo, kendo e lwet jomane ilokori iweyo ka in-gi mirima.
english: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Barnaba nodhi Tarso mondo omany Saulo,
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

kikuyu: Hezekia norwako joote gi mor mi onyisogi gik duto mane nitiere utege mag keno kaka fedha, dhahabu, gik mangʼwe ngʼar kod modhi ma nengogi tek kaachiel gi kar kenone mar gige lweny duto kod gik moko duto mane yudore kuom mwandune. Onge gimoro amora mane odongʼ e ode kata e pinye duto mane ok onyisogi.
english: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

kikuyu: Ma osebedo timna, nimar asebedo ka arito yoreni.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Ka ngʼato otweya moridore gi tonde manyien mapok otiyo, to abiro bedo manyap machal gi ngʼato angʼata.”
english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”

kikuyu: Eka Petro nochungʼ malo, kaachiel gi jopuonjre apar gachiel mamoko, motingʼo dwonde kowuoyo gi jogo niya, “Un jo-Yahudi wetena, kaachiel kod ji duto modak Jerusalem, weuru anyisu tiend wachni. Chikuru itu maber mondo uwinj gima awacho.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

kikuyu: To ka inyalo bedo motangʼ kiluora, Jehova Nyasaye owacho, kendo onge misigo mikadhogo dhoranga dala maduongʼni chiengʼ Sabato, to irito chiengʼ Sabato maler ma ok itimo tich moro chiengʼno,
english: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says the LORD, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

kikuyu: Omiyo Hiram nooro yiedhi kikwangʼogi kod jotende owuon, jogo molony kuom tich nam. Jogi kaachiel gi joge Solomon nokwangʼ nyaka Ofir ma gikelo dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu apar gabiriyo kendo negikele ne Ruoth Solomon.
english: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodhi Gibeon mondo ochiw misengini nimar kanyo e kama notingʼore malo moloyo ahinya kendo Solomon nochiwo misengini miwangʼo pep alufu achiel e kendo mar misangono.
english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

kikuyu: Eka unupar yoreu kod timbeu maricho, kendo unucharu kendu nikech richou kod timbeu mamonogo.
english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

kikuyu: Dwond Nyasaye mor e yo miwuoro; otimo gik madongo moyombo parowa.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

kikuyu: Osemiyo adak ei mudho kaka jogo mane osetho chon.
english: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

kikuyu: Nowangʼ boche duto ewi kendo mar misango kaka nowangʼo mo mar misango mar lalruok. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodh ketho mar ngʼatno kendo nowene richone.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Ne aketo Shelemia jadolo, Zadok jandiko, kod ja-Lawi ma nyinge Pedaya kaka jachungʼ mar ute keno kendo ne aketo Hanan wuod Zakur, wuod Matania jalupgi, nikech jogi nokwan ka jo-ratiro. Nomigi tich mar pogo gigo mokel ne owetegi.
english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo iwach ni Daudi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Aketo weche adek e nyimi, yier achiel kuomgi monego atimni.’ ”
english: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

kikuyu: Mier matindo man yo podho chiengʼ ma nopogne dhood Juda man Negev kaachiel gi mago mogo tongʼ gi Edom ne gin: Kabzel, Eder, Jagur,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

kikuyu: Pok mar ochiko ne mar Matania gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Mar Daudi. Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye ma en Lwandana, pakeuru en motego lwetena ne lweny, kendo en momiyo lith lwetena bedo mongʼith e kedo.
english: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

kikuyu: Koro an ja-higni piero aboro. Bende anyalo pogo gima ber kod gima rach? Bende jatichni diwinj ndhath gima ochamo kod momadho? Bende pod dawinj dwond chwo gi mon ma jower? Angʼo ma dimi jatichni dimed tingʼ matin ni ruodha ma en ruoth?
english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato osingore ni obiro chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye chiayo minyalo timgo misango, to gima ochiwono nobed mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.

kikuyu: To ka utimo maber ni joma timonu maber, to en ohala mane ma uyudo? Kata mana joricho timo kamano.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ndalo biro ma cham biro bedo mangʼeny, ibiro golo pur ka ji pod keyo, kendo mzabibu nonyagi mathoth, kendo gibiro keto kodhi ka ji pod loso divai. Yiend mzabibu mangʼeny maber nonyag mathoth e gode duto mi unubed gi divai mangʼeny.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.

kikuyu: Nyar Turo biro biro gi mich, joma nigi mwandu biro dwaro kony kuomi.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka dhakono osepwodhore kuom chwerneno, to nyaka okwan ndalo abiriyo, eka koro obiro bedo maler.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

kikuyu: To kane owinjo ni Arkelao nobet e loch e piny Judea kar wuon-gi ma Herode, noluoro dok kuno. Kaka nosesieme e lek, noloko wuoth modhi e gwengʼ mar Galili,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

kikuyu: Udigo ne mag gorofe adek, ma udi piero adek adek kuomgi ni e gorofa ka gorofa. Kia malo, to lach mar kor udi mag hekalu ne dongo mi bath udigo konchiel norenjore ewi ohinga, mondo yien moriw masirogi kik pow kor udi mag hekalu.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

kikuyu: Kech negogi e kor minegi, ka jogo mohiny e lweny e yore mag dala maduongʼ, mi gipodhi, omiyo gipenjo minegi niya, “Ere chiemo kod divai?”
english: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Winjruok mondo obedie kindi koda mana kaka nobedo e kind wuonwa gi wuonu. Aoroni mich mag fedha gi dhahabu, koro keth winjruok mantie e kindi gi Baasha ruodh Israel mondo mi owe kedo koda.”
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osesingore niya, “Ndalo biro chopo ma wasigu noywau gi olope kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu, nochal mana ka rech ma olowu omako.
english: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.

kikuyu: “Joma nigi winjo nyiso pachgi joma riek mawinja wachona ni,
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, luonguru nyinge; landuru ne ogendini duto gima osetimo.
english: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Ne imiya teko mar kedo lweny; ne imiyo jomamon koda kulore e nyima.
english: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

kikuyu: To jogo mane ni e otgo noywayo Lut mi odwoko e ot kendo giloro dhoot.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

kikuyu: To ka nochamo dwond Petro, nodoko mamor ahinya mi noringo odok ei ot kapok oyawone. Nonyiso jogo mane ni e ot kopongʼ gimor niya, “Petro ni e dhoot!”
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai gi jopuonj Chik moko ma noa Jerusalem nochokore but Yesu
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Lam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo en kende ema itine.’”
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Chi Samson nomi osiepne mane jachungʼne kokendo.
english: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.

kikuyu: Abiro kumo joma chunygi otwere kuom kido mag-gi maricho kod nyisechegi manono. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: “Ogoli e masiche kendo oteri kama onge chandruok mondo omiyi kwe gi chiemo mogundho.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

kikuyu: Ok ohol ji gige mondo oyudie ohala, kata ohala mokadho tongʼ ok okaw. Ok oyie mondo lwete otim gima rach kendo ongʼado bura maber e kind ji ka ok odew wangʼ.
english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,

kikuyu: Koa kuom oganda jodolo ne gin: Jedaya, Jehokarib, Jakin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

kikuyu: Eka Isaka nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Sud machiegni mondo mi amuli, wuoda, mondo mi angʼe adier ka in wuoda Esau koso.”
english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

kikuyu: Ji moko kuomgi to nodhi ir jo-Farisai monyisogi gima Yesu nosetimo.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

kikuyu: Mier matindogi moro ka moro ne nigi legegi mag kwath e alworagi, kendo ma ne en adiera ne mier matindogi duto.
english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho ni Barzilai niya, “Ngʼad aora koda mondo ibi idag koda Jerusalem, kendo abiro miyi gik mikonyorigo duto.”
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: “Usewinjo ni nowachi ni, ‘Wangʼ kar wangʼ kendo lak kar lak.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼeyo ni jopuonjrene ne ngʼur kuom wachni, omiyo nowachonegi niya, “Dibed ni wachni ochwanyou?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

kikuyu: Un to uwacho ni ka ngʼato owacho ne wuon kata ne min ni, ‘Kony moro amora ma dine uyudo koa kuoma en mich mowal ne Nyasaye,’
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

kikuyu: bende abiro yiengo ogendini duto, ma ginikel mwandugi duto, kendo abiro pongʼo hekaluni gi duongʼ.’ An Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema awacho kamano.
english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata moketho achiel kuom chike matindoe mogik kuom Chikegi, kendo mopuonjo joma moko mondo otim kamano, nokaw kaka ngʼat matinie mogik e pinyruodh polo, to ngʼato angʼata maluwo kendo puonjo ji chikegi nokaw kaka ngʼama duongʼ e pinyruodh polo.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: To Chiengʼ mokwongo mar juma ne wachokore mondo wacham Sap Ruoth. Paulo nopuonjo ji nyaka odiwuor nikech nochano mar aa kinyne gokinyi.
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

kikuyu: Eka nawinjo ngʼato kaluongo koa yo aora Ulai niya, “Gabriel, nyis ngʼatni tiend fweny mosenenono.”
english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”

kikuyu: eka mondo ogony ji duto ma luoro mar tho oloko wasumbini.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

kikuyu: Chon ne upogoru gi Nyasaye, kendo ne un wasike kuom pachu nikech timbe maricho mane utimo.
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

kikuyu: Gol jachwoyo oko e Babulon, kod jakeyo gi pande mar keyo. Nikech ligangla mar ngʼama thiro ji we ngʼato ka ngʼato odog ir joge, we ngʼato ka ngʼato oringi odhi e pinye owuon.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro miyou janabi machal koda kowuok e dier oweteu, nyaka uwinje.
english: The LORD your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

kikuyu: Nyaka ichiw nyarwath ma pod tin kaka misango mar golo richo ni jodolo; ma gin jo-Lawi, mowuok e anywola joka Zadok, en ema ne osudo buta machiegni mondo otina, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Asesingora an awuon, kendo dhoga osewacho gi ratiro duto wach ma ok bi kethi ni: Ji duto nogo chong-gi piny e nyima; kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nosingre gi nyinga.
english: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.

kikuyu: To ndalo biro ma wuon kisera nogol e kindgi, kendo ndalono ema ginitwe chiemo.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

kikuyu: Kik thowi moro amora yud kuomu kata e pinyu kuom ndalo abiriyo. Kik uwe ringʼo moro amora motimgo misango odhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mokwongo nindi nyaka kiny.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Nyarwa, yie koda; ndalo biro ma ok unulam Wuoro ewi godni kata ei Jerusalem.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

kikuyu: Mika, Rehob, Hashabia,
english: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,

kikuyu: Thundeni chalo gi nyithi mwanda ariyo maromre adier gichalo gi nyithind mwanda ma rude, makwayo e kind ondanyo.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.

kikuyu: onge ngʼato angʼata kuomgi manone pinyno makmana Kaleb wuod Jefune ma ja-Kenizi kod Joshua wuod Nun, nimar negiluwo bangʼ Jehova Nyasaye gi chunygi duto.’
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
