kikuyu: Wer, yaye nyar Sayun, go koko matek, yaye Israel! Bed mamor kendo moil gi chunyi duto, yaye nyar Jerusalem!
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Inicham chiembi mana kuom luchi, nyaka idog e lowo nikech kanyo ema ne ogolie, nimar in lowo kendo lowo ema nidogie.”
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

kikuyu: “Ka kech kata dera omako piny, kata ka abach omako cham ewi dongo kata ka bonyo kata kungu kata ka jowasigu olworo miechgi madongo kata ka midekre kata tuo omakogi,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar angʼwen, neginyiso chi Samson niya, “Hoo chwori mondo onyiswa tiend ngerono, ka ok kamano, to wabiro wangʼi kaachiel gi od wuonu duto nyaka utho. Ne iluongowa kae mondo imawa?”
english: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”

kikuyu: Sungau ok ber. Donge ungʼeyo ni thowi matin kende oromo kuodo mogo modwal duto?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye noyawo wenge Balaam, mi noneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye kochungʼ e wangʼ yo korieyo ligangla mare. Omiyo nokulore piny kendo nopodho auma e lowo.
english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

kikuyu: E kinde mane giwuoyo gi Farao, Musa ne ja-higni piero aboro to Harun to ne ja-higni piero aboro gadek.
english: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Ndalo biro ma anatiekie tekoni kod teko mar od wuonu, mi ok noyudi ngʼato angʼata moti e dhoodu.
english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

kikuyu: Ne ageno yudo mor kod ler; to rach kod mudho ema nobirona.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

kikuyu: Chunya omoko kuomi; lweti ma korachwich orita.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

kikuyu: Mi Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi duongʼ ka pod ok okelo mudho, kapok tiendeni ochwanyore, e gode matindo motimo mudho. Ugombo ler, to enoloke mudho mandiwa mi oloke kuyo malich.
english: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi noluongo achiel kuom joge mowachone niya, “Dhi inege!” Omiyo ngʼatno nochwowe motho.
english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

kikuyu: moluwo rieko mbesene mowacho niya, “Wuonwa nomiyou tingʼ mapek, an to abiro miyou tingʼ mapek moloyo. Wuonwa nochwadou gi boka an to abiro chwadou malit ka thomoni makecho.”
english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

kikuyu: To e odiechiengno negichiwo misango maduongʼ ka gimor nikech Nyasaye ne osemiyogi mor maduongʼ. Mon kod nyithindo bende ne mor. Koko mar mor mane ni e Jerusalem ne inyalo winjo gi kuma bor.
english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.

kikuyu: kod Hashabia, kanyakla gi Jeshaya ma nyikwa Merari, kod owetene gi yawuot owetene, ji piero ariyo.
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

kikuyu: Negisiko giromo pile ka pile e laru mar hekalu, kendo ne gingʼingo makati e miechgi, ka gichiemo kaachiel gi chuny mamor.
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo kit kokoni, ji mangʼeny nochokore kanyakla, ka gihum nono, nikech ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi ne winjo ka jogo wacho dhogi.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

kikuyu: Mirima nomako Farao gi jotichge ariyogo, ma gin jotend jagam divai kod jatend joma tedo makati.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

kikuyu: Nyis joma nigi mwandu e pinyni mondo kik gibed jongʼayi bende kik giket genogi kuom mwandu mabiro leny nono to giket genogi kuom Nyasaye mamiyowa gik moko duto mabup mondo wabedgo mamor.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

kikuyu: Mana kaka Muma wacho niya, “Neuru, aketo kidi e Sayun, en kidi moyier kendo ma nengone tek moriwo kor ot, to ngʼat mogeno kuome ok none wichkuot.”
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni ngʼatni ok noa kuom Nyasaye, to ok dine otimo gimoro.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Naftali, en Pedahel wuod Amihud.”
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Rimon Perez mi gibworo Libna.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

kikuyu: “Edom ni kuno, kaachiel gi ruodhi mage kod yawuot ruodhi mage. Kata obedo ni gin gi teko mangʼeny, to koro opielgi kaachiel gi joma ligangla onego. Opielgi piny gi joma ok oter nyangu, giriere piny e dier joma ridore kochomo bur matut.
english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

kikuyu: E kinde moko, Daudi noloyo jo-Filistia ma gibedo e bwo lochne kendo nokawo Gath to gi mier matindo molwore koa kuom jo-Filistia.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: To ruoth nohero gonyo ne oganda ngʼat achiel motwe e kinde mag sawo mar Pasaka.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora midwaro kaka nyirwedhi, imbe, nyiimbe mar misango miwangʼo pep ne Nyasach polo, kod ngano, chumbi, divai gi mo, kaka okwa gi jodolo man Jerusalem nyaka migi pile ma ok olewo,
english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

kikuyu: “ ‘Lieluru yie wiyeu oko kendo uwitgi; ywaguru e kuonde motingʼore malo motwo, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osekwedo kendo osejwangʼo tiengʼni mantiere e bwo mirimbe.
english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

kikuyu: Misango miwangʼo pep ma ruodh piny okelo ni Jehova Nyasaye chiengʼ Sabato nyaka bed nyirombe auchiel kod im achiel maonge songa kargi ariyogo.
english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

kikuyu: “Ilosnegi sirweche matindo mar law katana mondo giumgo dug-gi, chakre nungogi nyaka thochgi.
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

kikuyu: kendo oketogi gibet kaachiel gi ruodhi, mi kwan-gi kaachiel gi jotend jogi.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

kikuyu: Biuru, chamuru chiemba kendo madhuru divai ma aseruwo.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mar abiriyo, ne gichiewo kogwen mi gilworo dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo e yo machalre gi mamoko ka. Chiengʼno kende ema negilworo dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo.
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

kikuyu: To mondo ungʼe ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo.” Yesu nowachone ja-athanyno niya, “Awachoni ni aa malo, kaw pieni mondo idhi dala.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Harun ne ja-higni mia achiel gi piero ariyo gadek eka ne otho e Got Hor.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Jodong Farao-go ma noluoro wach Jehova Nyasaye noreto mondo okel wasumbinigi kaachiel gi jambgi e kar tony.
english: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

kikuyu: Babulon ma en piny maber moloyo pinjeruodhi duto, kendo ma jo-Babulon sungerego, Nyasaye nokethi mana kaka noketho Sodom gi Gomora.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

kikuyu: Ruoth nochungʼ malo otienono mowachone jodonge niya “Abiro nyisou gima jo-Aram osetimonwa. Gingʼeyo ni kech omakowa, omiyo giringo gia e kambigi ka gidhi pondo e bungu, ka giparo ni, ‘Jogi biro wuok oko kendo wabiro dhi ma wakawgi duto ka gingima miwadonji e dala maduongʼ.’ ”
english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ngʼato ka ngʼata mongʼeyo gima ber monego otim, to ok otimo, doko jaricho.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

kikuyu: Sibuoche nyalo ool kendo kech nyalo kayogi, to joma manyo Jehova Nyasaye ok ochando gima ber moro amora.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

kikuyu: Wachne nyithind Israel kama: Ka dhako omako ich ma onywolo nyathi ma wuowi, to enobed mogak bangʼ ndalo abiriyo, machalre kaka obedo mogak e ndalone mar neno malo.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Chiwo mag cham kod misango miolo piny orumo e od Jehova Nyasaye. Jodolo ywak joma tiyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ywak.
english: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.

kikuyu: It mawinjo gi wangʼ maneno, Jehova Nyasaye ema osechweyo gik moko ariyogo.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

kikuyu: Doguru kuondeu mochiel motegno, yaye joma otwe man-gi geno; nimar kata sani alando ni abiro dwokonu mwandu magu mane oyaki nyadiriyo.
english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye oneno kosudo machiegni mondo one ane, Nyasaye noluonge gi e dier bungu niya, “Musa! Musa!” Eka Musa nodwoke niya, “An ka.”
english: When the LORD saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: “Ne ngʼatno mochido, ket buru moko moa e misango mar pwodhruok kendo uruw gi pi maler mi uol e wigi.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

kikuyu: Kane ndalo abiriyo mag pwodhruok chiegni rumo, jo-Yahudi moko moa e piny Asia noneno Paulo ei hekalu. Ne githuwo ji duto kode mi gimake,
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

kikuyu: Nyasaye noloso gik moko ariyo madongo makelo ler; ler maduongʼ ne rito odiechiengʼ, to ler matin ne rito otieno. Sulwe bende noloso.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

kikuyu: Rangach midonjogo kod agola mage ne nigi otuchi madiny molworogi machalre gi otuchi mane oriedo e rangeye mamoko. Borne ne oromo fut piero abiriyo gabich kendo lachne en fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus.
english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

kikuyu: Kupono olembeu mag mzabibu, to kik upon-gi duto, bende mago molwar piny kik ukwany. Mago weuru ni joma odhier kod jodak manie dieru. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Bende nochwogo okumbni matindo mia adek mobaw gi dhahabu, okumba ka okumba nobaw gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo ariyo. Magi duto ruoth noketo e ode manogero e Bungu mag Lebanon.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Jamni gi kweth duto kod le mager mag bungu,
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Kane ni polo malo inyalo pim kendo mise mar piny inyalo many, eka anakwed nyikwa Israel nikech gigo duto magisetimo,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: The LORD says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼato angʼata matingʼore malo nodwok piny, to ngʼat madwokore piny notingʼ malo.”
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Abiro nego ruodh Moab kaachiel gi jotend pinyno duto,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ere konyruok ma ngʼato yudo ka owacho ni en gi yie to oonge gi tim? Bende yie machal kamano nyalo rese?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

kikuyu: Farao nodwoke niya, “Obed kiny.” Musa nodwoke niya, “We obed mana kaka isewachono mondo ingʼe ni onge ngʼat machal kod Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.
english: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Nimar olwenda biro chamogi duto ka law; kendo kudni nochamgi mana ka yie rombe. To adiera mara nosiki manyaka chiengʼ, kendo resruok makelo ok norum e kind tienge gi tienge.
english: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”

kikuyu: “Nikech dich modigo joma ok nyal kod chur ma joma ochando churgo, koro abiro aa malo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Abiro ritogi e lwet joma sandogi.”
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

kikuyu: Lier kete misendikogo e nyim wengegi
english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

kikuyu: Eka Esta nodwoko niya, Kwayona gi dwarona ema:
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato yudo kum to ok onyal winjo maber nikech owinjo rem. To bangʼ kosekum ngʼato to opuonjore mi ngimane nyag olemo mar tim makare kod kwe.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Ruodh ruodhi: Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: to kawuononi osengʼanyo ni jood wuora, munego yawuote piero abiriyo ewi lwanda achiel, kendo uketo Abimelek, mane wuod jatichne ma nyako mobedo ruoth ewi jo-Shekem nikech en owadu.
english: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

kikuyu: Koro, ka uwinja chuth mi urito singruokna, to kuom ogendini duto ubiro bedo mwanduna awuon. Kata obedo ni piny duto en mara,
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

kikuyu: Ndikuru kuomgi weche duto manie chike ka usengʼado ma uchopo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu nosingonu.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

kikuyu: Kane Uria obiro ire, Daudi nopenje ngima Joab gi mar jolweny to gi kaka lweny bende dhi.
english: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.

kikuyu: to ji mane nikanyo ne ok orwake, nikech nodhi Jerusalem.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Pien motingʼie asere tuomore e bathe kama oliere, kaachiel gi tongʼ mamil kod bidhi.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

kikuyu: Nochako openje kendo mar ariyo niya, “Simon wuod Johana, bende ihera adier?” Nodwoke niya, “Ee, Ruoth, ingʼeyo ni aheri.” Yesu nowachone niya, “Kare rit romba.”
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

kikuyu: Mwanduni gi gik milokogo ohala, gi gik mikano; gi jogi makedoni e pi, gi jokwangʼ magi, gi jogi mahondhoni yiedhi; gi jo-ohala magi, gi jolweny magi duto kod ji duto moidho yieno, biro nimo e chuny nam e odiechiengʼ ma yieno nobarre.
english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto noneno ni ruoth nodagi winjo wachgi, negidwoko ruoth niya, “Wat mane moriwowa kod Daudi, angʼo moriwowa gi wuod Jesse? Doguru e hembeu, yaye jo-Israel! Rituru dhoutu uwegi, yaye oganda Daudi!” Kuom mano jo-Israel duto nodok e miechgi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

kikuyu: Ketura nonywolone Ibrahim, Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak kod Shua.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

kikuyu: Kata ka gode biro yiengni, kendo gode matindo ibiro muki, to herana kuomu mosiko ok noyiengi, bende singruokna mar kwe ok nogol,” Jehova Nyasaye man-gi kech kuomu owacho.
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.

kikuyu: Joshua nowacho niya, “Koro wituru nyiseche manono manie dieru mondo uchiw chunyu ni tiyo ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.”
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano kane Josef ochopo ir owetene ne gilonyo kandhone mane olos gi law maber kendo ma nengone tek,
english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye orangu maber kendo omiu kwe.’
english: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

kikuyu: Ngʼat man kuom Kristo ok sik katimo richo. Ngʼat mosiko katimo richo pok onene kendo okiaye.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nochikore malo mi ochako wuoth. Bangʼe nodhi kodgi ei laru mar hekalu, kowuotho kendo kochikore kendo kopako Nyasaye.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

kikuyu: Wangʼ teko mar ngʼama janjore nothir kendo sunga mag ji nodwok piny; Jehova Nyasaye kende ema notingʼ nyinge malo odiechiengno.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.

kikuyu: Eka nawinjo ka gik mangima duto manie polo kendo e piny kod e bwo piny, kendo e nam, kendo gigo duto mochwe modak eigi, kawer niya: “Pak gi duongʼ kod loch obed ni Jal mobet e kom duongʼ gi Nyarombo manyaka chiengʼ!”
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne giwuok kendo neginono pinyno kochakore Thim mar Zin nyaka Rehob, kagichomo Lebo Hamath.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

kikuyu: Chiw chik mondo jambu kaachiel gi gimoro amora ma un-go e pap okel kar tony, nikech pe biro chwer kuom ngʼato angʼata kata le moro amora ma pod ni oko ma ok odonjo e kar tony mi githo.’ ”
english: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni kar romono bor kodi ma ok inyal tero achiel kuom apar mari ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi osegwedhigo (nikech kama Jehova Nyasaye oyiero ne Nyinge bor kodi),
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which the LORD your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,

kikuyu: Kawa idhi koda, waret piyo waa kae! Ruoth mondo odhi koda nyaka ei ode maiye. Osiepe Wail kendo chunywa mor kodi; wabiro pako herani moloyo divai. Nyako Gitimo gima kare ka gipuoyi!
english: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.

kikuyu: Kane ongʼiyo jopuonjrene, nowacho niya, “Ogwedhu un jogo modhier, nimar pinyruoth Nyasaye en maru.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

kikuyu: Kanisa machokore e odgi bende mosnauru. Mosnauru Epaineto, osiepna mageno, ma en ema nokwongo bedo ja-Kristo e piny Asia.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ mar Efraim en Samaria, kendo jatend Samaria en mana wuod Remalia. Omiyo ka ok ichungʼ motegno e yie mari, to ok inichung ngangʼ.’ ”
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

kikuyu: Eka nowachone ngʼatno niya, “Rie lweti,” mi norieye, kendo lwete nochango chuth, mana kaka komachielo.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

kikuyu: Bed motangʼ kik ngʼato wuondi gi mwandu, kendo kik iyie ngʼato omiyi asoya mathoth mi iwe Nyasaye.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

kikuyu: Eka Nathan nopenjo Bathsheba min Solomon niya, “Bende isewinjo ni Adonija wuod Hagith osedoko Ruoth ka Daudi ruodhwa ok ongʼeyo?
english: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

kikuyu: Nyasaye nokumo bende jo-Shekem kuom timbegi mamono. Kwongʼ mane Jotham wuod Jerub-Baal okwongʼogigo nochopo kare.
english: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

kikuyu: To ka gima kamano ok oromo e nyim wangʼi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, to isewuoyo kuom gik mabiro timore e od jatichni kinde mabiro. Bende ma e kaka itiyo gi dhano, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto?
english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!

kikuyu: “Wasewinjo sunga mar Moab, sungane mokadhore gi miriambo, sunga mare gi jendeke mare kod ngʼayi mar chunye.”
english: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Yesu nochako owachonegi niya, “Adier, adier, awachonu ni an e dhoranga rombe.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

kikuyu: Wabiro losoni thiwni mag dhahabu, kod tigo mag fedha.
english: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

kikuyu: Dhoga biro wacho weche mag rieko, weche moa e chunya biro miyo ji winjo tiend weche.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

kikuyu: Koso dibed ni Nyasaye en Nyasach jo-Yahudi kendgi? Donge en Nyasach joma ok jo-Yahudi bende? Ee, en mar ogendini mamoko bende,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi, Ibrahim nomondo kama ne ochungʼie nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

kikuyu: Koro un kod ruoth kaka jatendu. Anto aseti ma wiya oti lwar, kendo yawuota un-go ka. Asebedo jatendu chakre tin-na nyaka sani.
english: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Abiro kelo masira e pinyni kendo kuom joma odakie, kaluwore gi gik moko duto ma ruodh Juda osesomo mondiki e kitabuni.
english: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.

kikuyu: Daudi gi joge nodhi monego jo-Filistia mia ariyo. Nokelo ringregi (ma en pien duongʼ-gi) kendo nochiwo kar kwan-ka duto mondo omi obed or ruoth. Eka Saulo nomiye Mikal nyare mi okendo.
english: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: kendo nokawo gwenge mag Araba man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan, mochopo nyaka Nam mar Araba mantiere e tiend gode mag Pisga.
english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

kikuyu: Ok angʼeyo kama Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nyalo tingʼi ma terie bangʼ kasedhi. Ka adhi ma anyiso Ahab mi ok oyudi to obiro nega. To an jatichni aselamo Jehova Nyasaye ae tin-na.
english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni jogi otho mana kaka ji duto nyalo tho, to kare Jehova Nyasaye ne ok oora.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.

kikuyu: Nyasaye notimo ma mondo ji obed gi chuny madware kendo mondo kanyalore to gichop kuma entie, mi giyude, kata obedo ni ok en mabor kodwa.
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

kikuyu: Koro pod irito angʼo? Aa malo mondo obatisi, mondo olwokni richoni, kiluongo nying Ruoth Yesu.’
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

kikuyu: to amor ni nyocha otho ka aonge kuno, mondo eka uyie. Kata kamano, wawuog wadhiuru ire.”
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

kikuyu: To Yesu nosiemogi matek ni kik gihul ni en ngʼa.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne udak Kadesh kuom kinde mangʼeny, adier kuom kinde mangʼeny ne udak kuno.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

kikuyu: Kane Simon Petro oneno mani, nopodho e tiend Yesu, mowacho niya, “Dhiyo ia ira Ruoth, an ngʼat ma jaricho!”
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

kikuyu: Sechego noyudo Yesu nindo ewi raten man kachien yie. Jopuonjre nochiewe kagiwachone niya, “Japuonj, donge litni ka watho?”
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

kikuyu: Chon ne ok un ji, to koro un jo-Nyasaye, chon ne pok okechu, to koro osekechu.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

kikuyu: To kuom gik moko duto mag loch Manase, to gi mago duto mane otimo, koriwo nyaka richo mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag weche mag ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: To mana le mag thim ema nodag kanyo, kibwe nopongʼ utegi; tula bende nodag kanyo kendo nywok nolengʼre kanyo.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

kikuyu: Oganda duto mag jo-Israel kod jopinje mamoko manie dieru nowenegi richogi, nikech ji duto notimo richo ka ok gingʼeyo.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

kikuyu: To erokamano ni Nyasaye. Omiyowa loch kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo!
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ere kaka koro uparo ni unyalo loyo achiel kuom jotend jolweny matinie moloyo mag ruodha ka uketo genou mana kuom jolwenj Misri gi faresegi?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

kikuyu: To donge nuriembo jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye ma yawuot Harun kaachiel gi jo-Lawi kendo ne uyiero jodolo magu kaka jopinje mamoko timo? Ngʼato angʼata mobiro opwodhore gi nyarwath kod imbe abiriyo nyalo bedo jadolo mar gik ma ok nyiseche.
english: Haven’t you driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

kikuyu: Ka mano e kaka idwaro tiyo koda, to nega sani, to ka dipo ni ikecha, to yie iwe miya chandruok ma kama.”
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

kikuyu: Ogandano nochungʼ gichien ka Musa to ne ochomo bor polo kama Nyasaye ne nitie.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

kikuyu: Eka jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai nochoko buch jo-Sanhedrin, kendo negipenjore niya, “Watim angʼo? Ngʼatni medo timo timbe honni mangʼeny moloyo.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

kikuyu: Donge it ema pimo kit weche mana kaka lep bende pimo mit chiemo?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dog gi yo mane ibirogo kendo idhi e thim mar Damaski. Ka ichopo kuno, to wir Hazael mondo obed ruodh Aram.
english: The LORD said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

kikuyu: Ne oruto e dier sibuoche, nikech koro nosedoko sibuor maratego. Nopuonjore mako le kendo nodoko jacham ji.
english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ataro mangʼongono, Nowa nodak higni mia adek gi piero abich.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

kikuyu: Negikedo gi jo-Hagri, jo-Jetur, jo-Nafish kod jo-Nodab.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nochwogo kuodi madongo mia ariyo mag dhahabu kendo kuot ka kuot nochwog gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo adek gi nus.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

kikuyu: Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye! Yaye chunya, pak Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

kikuyu: Kendo, “Anabed Wuonu, to unubed yawuota gi nyiga, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.”
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny noweyo wuowino modhi, kosieme niya, “Kik inyis ngʼato ni isenyisa wachni.”
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nosenyiso jodonge niya, “Donge ungʼeyo ni Ramoth Gilead en marwa to onge gima watimo mondo wakawe kuom ruodh Aram?”
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

kikuyu: mane omiyo abedo kodgi mamon kendo mane omiyo aterogi e piny wasikgi, eka bangʼe chunygi ma ok oyie kaka adwaro nobolre, mi giniyud kum kuom richogi,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nomiyo jo-Israel wach machalo kama kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye omiye: “Gima dhood nyikwa Josef wacho nikare.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

kikuyu: Adoraim, Lakish, Azeka,
english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

kikuyu: Kane oseketo lwete kuomgi, nomedo dhi nyime koa kanyo.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye rango joma obolore kata obedo ni en malo to josunga to ongʼeyo kata kapod gin gichien.
english: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado bura ne ogendini, mi opiel joma otho achana-achana kotieko jotelo duto mag piny.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

kikuyu: ngʼat manomak nyithindi mayom mi gogi piny e lwendni en jahawi.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

kikuyu: Ponono ngʼato osekelo chuny lit, an ok ema osekelona chuny litno, to osekele mana ni un, ka ok adwar jimbo wachno.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowuoyo kowacho niya,
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo jotend migepe mag jolweny tonge kod kuodi, mane mag ruoth Daudi kendo mane okan e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Un gi lony mathoth mar keto Chike Nyasaye tenge mondo urit puonju uwegi!
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼe ne aluoki gi pi kendo ne arudho remo mane omieni mi awiri gi mo.
english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro e dier oganda noluongo matek niya, “Japuonj akwayi, range wuodani, nikech en nyathina achiel kende.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

kikuyu: Eka Maria nokawo mo mangʼwe ngʼar kendo ma nengone tek, manyalo romo nus lita, mowirogo tiende Yesu, bangʼe oyweyo tiendene gi yie wiye. Mi ot nopongʼ gi tik mangʼwe ngʼar mar mono.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo, ne gilamonegi mondo giyud Roho Maler,
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

kikuyu: Kowuru mosna ni jowete man Laodikia, kendo ni Numfa gi kanisa man e ode.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

kikuyu: Magi e nyinge thuondi mag Daudi: Josheb-Bashebeth ja-Takemon, ne thuon kuom thuondi adek; nokawo tongʼe monegogo ji mia aboro e lweny dichiel.
english: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

kikuyu: Ne achako aneno gimoro maonge tiende e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ:
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

kikuyu: Opudho asereno mondo owuog oko gi yo ka die ngʼeye, ka lew asere mabithno to osechwoyo adundone. Kihondko biro biro kuome,
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

kikuyu: Mad tho neg wasika apoya, mad liel mwonygi ngili kapod gingima, nikech richo olokogi kar dakne.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

kikuyu: Kane oseweyo oganda mi odonjo e ot, jopuonjrene nopenje tiend ngerono mane onyisogi.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

kikuyu: ka umedo konyowa gi lemo maru. Mano nomi ji mangʼeny nodwokne Nyasaye erokamano kuom gweth momiyowa, kodwoko lemo mag ji mangʼeny.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

kikuyu: Chandruok mokelo gaje en owuon; timbene mag mahundu dwogone e wiye owuon.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

kikuyu: Nokawo jogo mane otony e nek mag ligangla noterogi e twech Babulon kendo olokogi wasumbinige kod mag yawuote nyaka ochopo ndalo mane jo-Pasia okawe loch.
english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Parane! Luonguru mon madengo mondo obi; to moloyo mago man-gi lony mamalo e ywak.
english: The LORD of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come.

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Dan, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: “To ka misumba owacho ni, ‘Ahero ruodha kod chiega gi nyithinda kendo ok adwar bedo thuolo,’
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

kikuyu: Idwokowa gi timbe madongo makare, yaye Nyasaye ma Jawarwa, yaye geno mar piny koni gi koni kendo mar nembe man maboyo mogik,
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

kikuyu: “Un joma odak e piny nyar Babulon ringuru utony udhi Sayun!”
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

kikuyu: Kuom ranyisi, dhako mokendi Chik otweyo gi chwore mana ka chwore pod ngima; to ka chwore otho, to ogonye e chik mar kend.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

kikuyu: Nodwoka niya, “Richo mar dhood Israel gi dhood Juda duongʼ mokalo apima; piny opongʼ gi remo michwero kendo dala maduongʼ opongʼ gi timbe mobam. Giwacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼo piny kendo; Jehova Nyasaye ok ne gik matimore.’
english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’

kikuyu: kiweyo jotijegi machwo kod mamon mane gin ji alufu abiriyo mia adek gi piero adek gabiriyo (7,337); kendo ne gin gi jower machwo kod mamon maromo ji mia ariyo gi piero angʼwen gabich (245).
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

kikuyu: Ka piny ma ukawoni odwanyore, to biuru e piny Jehova Nyasaye, kama ogurie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo mondo udag kodwa e pinyni. To kik ukwed Jehova Nyasaye kata mana wan bende ka ugero kendo mar misango ne un uwegi, makmana kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kende.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than the LORD our God’s altar.

kikuyu: To kuom ji mamoko modongʼ (chutho ok Ruoth, to an ema awachonegi) kama: Ka owadwa moro ma ja-Kristo nigi dhako ma ok oyie, kendo dhakono oyie dak kode, to kik oriembe.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

kikuyu: Ma e girkeni mane Musa ochiwo kane en e paw Moab nyaka loka aora Jordan, yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jeriko.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

kikuyu: Nitie chwo modak kodi matimo tim mamono ka giterore gi monde ji, nyaka mond yawuotgi kendo gi nyiminegi hie, ma nyathi wuon mare.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

kikuyu: Bende wasebiro gi pesa moko mondo wangʼiew godo chiemo. Ok wangʼeyo ngʼama noketo pesa e gundewa.”
english: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

kikuyu: ginimak thuonde gi lwetgi, kendo ginimodhi kwiri mager, to ok ginihinyre ngangʼ, giniket lwetgi kuom joma tuo, to jotuo nobed mangima.”
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

kikuyu: Kik ichiw kit ubani moro amora e kendono mar misango kata misango miwangʼo pep kata chiwo mar cham kendo kik ichiw misango miolo piny.
english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

kikuyu: Mil polo mare menyo piny; piny neno kendo yiengni.
english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

kikuyu: Lamuru Jehova Nyasaye kaka Ngʼama Ler man-gi duongʼ mangʼongo; beduru maluor ahinya e nyime, un piny duto.
english: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Chiengʼno anami Gog kar yiko e piny Israel, e holo ma jowuoth madhiyo wuok chiengʼ luwo ka gichomo Nam Maduongʼ. Enolor yor jowuoth, nikech Gog gi ogandane duto noiki kanyo. Omiyo noluonge ni Holo mar Hamon Gog.
english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

kikuyu: Maarath, Beth Anoth kod Eltekon. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo auchiel.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Ne omiyo aore olokore kuonde motwo, sokni mamol nolokore ongoro,
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

kikuyu: Neni uketo tenge achiel kuom apar mag giu ma puotheu onyago.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ne igeno kuom berni, kendo ne ikonyori gi huma mari mondo ibedgo ochot. Ne ilokori ochot mochiwore ni ngʼato angʼata makadho machiegni kendo berni nodoko mare.
english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

kikuyu: Ok en gima owinjore ne ruodhi, yaye Lemuel, mondo ruodhi omadh math makech, kata jotelo ogomb kongʼo gi chunygi duto,
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

kikuyu: nikech ginyiso ni gima Chik dwaro ondiki e chunygi, kendo kata chunygi giwegi bende bedo joneno ni mano en adier, kendo pachgi seche moko ngʼadonegi bura kaka joketho, to seche moko pwoyogi.)
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

kikuyu: kowacho niya, “Aluongou, yaye un ji, aluongou un ji duto manie piny.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Aram bende ne oloko kodi nikech gik mane iloso mangʼeny. Gin ne giwilo kodi tarkus, gi lewni maralik, gi lewni mochwe gi lwedo, gi lewni ma nengogi tek kaka korol gi rubi. Ne giwilo kodi gigi ka gin to gikawo gigi mag ohala.
english: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo maduongʼ nopenjo Stefano niya, “Weche modonjnigogi bende gin adier?”
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

kikuyu: Pok mar angʼwen nomi dhood Isakar kaluwore gi anywola margi.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

kikuyu: Kar romb joma nochiemo duto ne gin chwo alufu abich, ka ok okwan mon gi nyithindo.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: makmana ne awachone ruoth niya, “Mad ruoth dag amingʼa! Dabed gi mor nade ka dala maduongʼ mane kwerena oyikie omukore, kendo dhorangeyene osewangʼ gi mach.”
english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mane entierego koro onge e hembe; nikech mach mager osewangʼo kar dakne.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

kikuyu: Bi, jaherana, bi wadhi waba ei gwengʼ, kendo wanind oko e bunge.
english: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.

kikuyu: “Yaye, jo-Turo gi jo-Sidon, kod joma odak e gwenge mag Filistia, ulawa nangʼo? Koso uchulona kuor nikech gimoro masetimo? Ka uchulona kuor to abiro dwoko timbeu e wiwu uwegi kuom gima usetimo moruyore kendo mapiyo.
english: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.

kikuyu: rachungi teyni molos gi dhahabu mopwodhi (abich korachwich kendo abich koracham e nyim kama ler mar lemo); maupe molosi mag dhahabu gi teyni gi ramaki;
english: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

kikuyu: mar auchiel ne en Ithream ma wuod chi Daudi miluongo ni Egla. Jogi duto Daudi nonywolo ka en Hebron.
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

kikuyu: Pogeuru kaka girkeni ni dhoudi ochikogo, kaachiel gi nus joka Manase.”
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Jerusalem kod dala duto mag Juda, ruodhi mag-gi kod jotende, mondo okethi kendo obed gima bwogo ji kendo gibed maonge luor kendo gima okwongʼ, mana kaka gin kawuono;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

kikuyu: Kik itamri kumo nyathi; nimar chwat ok nyal nege.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

kikuyu: Bende nitiere nyasaye moro mosegolo oganda kuom oganda machielo moselok wasumbini? Koso bende nitiere moro mosetemo timo timbe madongogi gi ranyisi, honni gi lweny kendo gi teko maduongʼ kod bat morie kaka Jehova Nyasaye notimonu e piny Misri e wangʼu kuneno.
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

kikuyu: Nogolo nyiseche manono ma welo kod kido mar nyasaye manono mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi kende mag misango miwangʼoe liswa duto mane ogero e got mar hekalu kod Jerusalem kendo nowitogi oko mar dala maduongʼ.
english: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of the LORD’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the LORD’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

kikuyu: mondo omi bedona kodu kendo omedu mor moloyo kuom Kristo Yesu nikech an.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno maler nokaw owino, gilute e pi kendo gikuo pi e hema kod e gik moko duto molosgo ii hekalu gi ji man kanyo. Bende nyaka okwo pi kuom ngʼato angʼata mabed ni osemulo chok ngʼama osetho kata liel kata ngʼato ma osenegi kata ngʼato motho athoya.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

kikuyu: Nokawo jodong dalano mi okawo pedo kod matata mokumogo jo-Sukoth.
english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

kikuyu: maluwe ne en Jehohanan mane jatend jolweny alufu mia ariyo gi piero aboro (280,000);
english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

kikuyu: Noluongo jatingʼne gik lweny mapiyo mowachone niya, “Wuodh liganglani kendo inega, mondo kik giwach ni, ‘Dhako ema nonege.’ ” Omiyo jatichne nowuodho ligangla mochwowego kendo otho.
english: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

kikuyu: Asemiyou loch mondo unyon thuonde gi thomoni kendo uloo teko duto mag jasigu bende onge gima nohinyu.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

kikuyu: Sisera nochoko kanyakla gechene mag chuma mia ochiko kod chwo duto kode, koa Harosheth Hagoyim nyaka e Aora Kishon.
english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye en Nyasachwa manyaka chiengʼ obiro bedo jaritwa nyaka chop giko ndalowa e piny.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Wer gi ilo ne Jakobo; kog matek ne jotelo madongo mag ogendini. Onego pak magu owinjre, kendo uwachi niya, ‘Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, res jogi, jo-Israel mane otony.’
english: For the LORD says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’

kikuyu: Daudi nokelo choke Saulo gi mag wuode Jonathan koa kuno, kod choke mag joma ne oneg mowe oko nochokgi kamoro achiel.
english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ miwuoro kendo owinjore gi pak, onge ngʼama nyalo yango duongʼne.
english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Kendo Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye notho Moab mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho.
english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Ginidongʼ gunda, e kind pinje modongʼ gunda, kendo miechgi madongo nokethre e kind mier madongo mokethore.
english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.

kikuyu: Jaherana en mara kendo an mare; odongo maber e dier ondanyo.
english: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

kikuyu: Noyudo Jehova Nyasaye osewuoyo gi Musa e piny Midian kowachone niya, “Dog Misri, nikech jogo duto mane dwaro negi osetho.”
english: The LORD said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”

kikuyu: Chutho, kata mana yie wiu duto osekwan mongʼe kar rombgi. Kik uluor, nikech uloyo oyundi nyadi mangʼeny.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: “Tel nyima idhi Gilgal. Chutho abiro lor ka abiro iri mondo atim misango miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag lalruok, to nyaka ine ni irita kuom ndalo abiriyo mondo abi anyisi gima onego itim.”
english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

kikuyu: Jo-Kanaan gi jopinyni mamoko biro winjo kuom wachni kendo gibiro monjowa mi gitiekwa e pinyni. Angʼo ma nitim mondo ires nyingi maduongʼni?”
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”

kikuyu: nokelo joma odenyo mondo odag kuondego, kendo negigero dala kama neginyalo dakie.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: En kende ema en lwandana kendo warruokna; en e ohingana; onge gima biro bwoga.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noketo kit yien duto mondo onyagi ewi lowo, ne gin yiende malombo wangʼ kendo mag chiemo. E dier puodho ne nitie yath machiwo ngima kendo yath mamiyo ngʼato ngʼeyo ber gi rach.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

kikuyu: Joab wuod Zeruya nongʼeyo ni chuny ruoth gombo Abisalom.
english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

kikuyu: “Lingʼuru e nyima, un pinje mag chula e dier nam! Weuru ogendini obed motegno! Wegiuru gisud machiegni mondo giwuo; kendo warom kaachiel kama ingʼadoe bura.
english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

kikuyu: Roho nopongʼa mana gisano mi aneno kom duongʼ e polo ka ngʼato obetie.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

kikuyu: kendo nyaka okel ni Jehova Nyasaye rombo kata diel madhako kaka misango mar golo richo kuom ketho mosetimo; bangʼe jadolo nopwodhnego kethoneno.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

kikuyu: Chunya gwecho, tekra orumo; wengena otimo mudho.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

kikuyu: Ne wamedo kwangʼ gi thagruok ka waluwo bath nam mine wachopo kamoro miluongo ni Mbita Mokwe, but dala mar Lasea.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

kikuyu: Kendo gimoro amora midwaro mar hekalu mar Nyasachi ma inyalo bedo gi thuolo mar chiwo, inyalo chiwe koa e keno ma ka ruoth.
english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.

kikuyu: Daudi nodwoko niya, “Tongʼ mar ruoth eri ni ka. Or achiel kuom yawuowi obi oome.
english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

kikuyu: “To kata kamano gichalo buoyo moyienyo ewi pi malo; lopegi okwongʼ, maonge ngʼama rawo e puothegi mag mzabibu mi yudie olemo.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

kikuyu: E kindeno ogendini duto manie piny ne wacho dhok achiel kod weche machal.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

kikuyu: Eka Zofar ja-Namath nodwoko ni,
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

kikuyu: maluwe ne en Amasia wuod Zikri mane ochiwore kende owuon ne tij Jehova Nyasaye kendo notelo ne ji alufu mia ariyo (200,000).
english: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ka ngʼato owacho ne godni ni, ‘Dhiyo mondo inyumri e nam,’ ma ok obedo gi kiawa e chunye kata matin, to oyie ni gima owachono biro timore, to gima odwarono notimre kamano.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

kikuyu: dhako moro nobiro ire gi chupa mar alabasta, mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar kendo ma nengone tek, kendo noole duto e wiye sa ma nobet kochiemo e mesa.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

kikuyu: Kendo Samuel nowachone jo-Israel duto niya, “Ka udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye gi chunyu duto, to goluru nyiseche mag jopinje mamoko ma un-go kod mag Ashtoreth, to chiwreuru ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo en kende ema utine, mi noresu kogolou e lwet jo-Filistia.”
english: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to the LORD, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano ring idhi kuno piyo, nikech ok anyal timo gimoro nyaka ichop kuno.” (Mano ema omiyo noluong dalano ni Zoar.)
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

kikuyu: “Kama e kaka pinyno nopogi: “Bathe mochomo yo nyandwat nokaw kochakore Nam maduongʼ mar Mediterania koluwo bath yo mar Hethlon kendo kokalo Lebo Hamath nyaka Zedad,
english: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

kikuyu: Shobal nonywolo Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo kod Onam. Zibeon nonywolo Aiya kod Ana.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

kikuyu: Ka jatichni owacho niya, “Ok adwar weyi,” nikech oheri kod jo-dalani duto kendo owinjo maber ka odak kodu,
english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

kikuyu: Kane jo-Gerar openje kuom chiege, nowachonegi niya, “En nyamera, nikech noluoro wachonegi ni en chiega. Nowachonegi kamano nikech noparo ni jo-Gerar nyalo nege nikech Rebeka ne en dhako ma jaber.”
english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

kikuyu: “Mad Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach chunje duto mag dhano, oyier jatelo manyalo rito ogandani
english: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

kikuyu: Juda ne en wuon Perez gi Zera, ma min-gi ne en Tamar, Perez ne en wuon Hezron, Hezron ne en wuon Ram,
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ka anachok jo-Israel ka agologi oko e dier ogendini kuonde ma gikiree, to ananyisra kaka ngʼama ler manie e diergi e kind ogendinigo. Eka ginidag e pinygi giwegi, piny mane amiyo Jakobo jatichna.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

kikuyu: Tim makare gi adiera e mise mag lochni; hera gi ber otelo e nyimi.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

kikuyu: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

kikuyu: Kinyne Johana noneno Yesu kabiro ire, mi nowacho niya, “Neuru, Jalcha e Nyarombo mar Nyasaye, magolo richo mar piny!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

kikuyu: Jo-Efraim nochoko jolweny mage, ma gidhi Zafon kendo giwachone Jeftha niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ne idhi kedo gi jo-Amon ma ok iluongowa mondo wadhi kodi? Wadhi wangʼo odi ka in e iye.”
english: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Japuonj, Musa nonyisowa ni ka ngʼato otho ka oonge gi nyithindo to owadgi nyaka kend dhako ma chwore othono mondo onywolnego nyithindo.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: to pinygi mane ni e holo notingʼo Beth Haram, Beth Nimra, Sukoth, Zafon kod bath piny Sihon ruodh Heshbon modongʼ (pinygino neni yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan kendo Jordan nyaka Nam Kinereth nodoko tongʼ mare).
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

kikuyu: Abiro wuoyo kuom chikeni e nyim ruodhi kendo wiya ok bi kuot,
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

kikuyu: Dhahabu nitie, kendo kite ma nengogi tek bende nitie mogundho, to dhok mawacho weche mag ngʼeyo gin kaka mula mabeyo mayudo tek.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

kikuyu: To iwe laru ma oko manie nyim hekalu kik ipime, nikech osemiye joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo gibiro nyone gi tiendegi ka giketho dala maler kuom dweche piero angʼwen gariyo.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Daniel nomedo dhi maber e ndalo loch mar Darius kendo e ndalo loch mar Sairas ja-Pasia.
english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

kikuyu: An Jakobo, ma jatich Nyasaye kendo jatich Ruoth Yesu Kristo, Andikonu, un dhoudi apar gariyo mokere e pinje duto: Amosou.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

kikuyu: Daher mar nyisi ni jo-Yahudi nomako ngʼatni kendo negidwaro nege, to ne aoro jolweny mondo okonye, nikech ne ayudo wach ni en ja-Rumi.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni tiyone Jehova Nyasaye ok miu mor, to kawuononi yier aneuru ngʼama ubiro tiyone, kata ka en nyiseche manono mane kwereu tiyone e Aora Yufrate, kata en nyiseche manono mag jo-Amor, modak e pinygi. Makmana an gi jooda duto, wabiro tiyone Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo ni Yesu ngima, kendo ni Maria nosenene ne ok giyie.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

kikuyu: ojiw chunyu kendo omiu teko e yore duto kendo e weche mabeyo.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

kikuyu: “Koro chik momakou nyaka chiengʼ ema: E odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar abiriyo higa ka higa, un nyithind Israel, kaachiel gi jopinje mamoko modak kodu, nyaka ubed gilamo mar tweyo chiemo kendo kik uti tich moro amora,
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

kikuyu: Mi Saulo notemo loko nenruokne korwako lewni mopogore opogore, eka en gi ji ariyo moko negidhi ir dhako ma ja-nyakalondo gotieno. Nowacho niya, “Penjna wach kuom chuny ngʼat motho kendo ikelna ngʼatno mabiro nyisi nyinge.”
english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

kikuyu: ma kata mana malaike man-gi teko gi duongʼ moloyogi ok nyal wuoyo marach kuom chwechgo e nyim Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ngʼwono itimone joricho, to ok gipuonjore tim makare; kata mana e piny joma kare gidhi nyime mana ka gitimo richo, ka ok gichiwo luor ne duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.

kikuyu: Jotelo ne ok ongʼeyo kuma ne adhiyoe, kata gima ne atimo, nikech ne pod ok awacho gimoro ne jo-Yahudi kata jodolo kata joka ruoth kata jotelo kata joma moko mane biro tiyo tijno.
english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

kikuyu: Marangʼo ne ok iketo pesanano e od keno, mondo kane aduogo, to ne anyalo kawe gi ohande.’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

kikuyu: To uwacho kendu ni, ‘Mano tingʼ mapek manade!’ kendo utwenyo umu ka ujare,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho. “Ka ukelo jamni mohinyore, ma rangʼonde kata matuo kendo uchiwogi kaka misango, bende darwak gik moa e lwetu adier?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says the LORD of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Anatiek sunga mar wich teko ma un-go, kendo anami polo rieny ka chuma, kendo piny mwalo nodog matek ka mula.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

kikuyu: Jakobo nonindo kanyo, kendo kuom gik mane en-go ne oyiero mich ne owadgi Esau kaka:
english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

kikuyu: Omiyo, e gik moko duto, timuru ne joweteu gik ma duher mondo gin bende gitimnu, nikech mano e tiend Chik gi Jonabi.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

kikuyu: Pi bende ibiro modho mana mopim, nus lita odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, kiluwo chenro miloso mar modho.
english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

kikuyu: E seche mane ruoth odwogo koa e puodho mar dala ruoth kane odonjo e ot mane itimoe nyasi, noyudo ka Haman osenindo e kom maduongʼ mane Esta obetie. Ruoth nowuoyo matek ka obwok mowacho niya, “Odwaro kata mana mako mikacha e wangʼa kaneno?” Kane ruoth pok otieko wuoyo, ne giumo wangʼ Haman.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

kikuyu: Ka owaduno ok odak machiegni kodi kaw chiayono iter dalani nyaka chop obi odware, eka mondo imiye.
english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ok oketo odiechieng ngʼado bura mondo ongʼere? Angʼo momiyo joma ongʼeyo geno odiechiengno to ok ginyal nene?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

kikuyu: Kamoro amora mudakie, miechugo ibiro keth chuth kendo ibiro muki kuonde motingʼore malo, mondo kendeu mag misango keth chuth mi tieki, kendo nyisecheu manono muki mi rum, kendeu muwangʼoe ubani bende ibiro muki, kaachiel gi gimoro amora museloso.
english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

kikuyu: “Jotich duto molony mantie e kindu nyaka bi mondo olos gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osechiko kaka:
english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:

kikuyu: Isaya bende nowuoyo kuom jo-Israel kawacho niya, “Kata bed ni nyithind Israel ngʼeny ka kwoyo manie dho nam, to ji manok kuomu kende ema noresi.
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

kikuyu: Mikloth ne en wuon Shimeam. Gin bende negidak but wedegi man Jerusalem.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Joka Mishma ne gin: Hamuel nonywolo Zakur, Zakur nonywolo Shimei.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

kikuyu: Kendo “ngʼata makare nobed mangima kuom yie. Bende ok amor, gi ngʼat ma yiene dok chien.”
english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

kikuyu: “Chunguru Kama Ler gi jo-Lawi moko e kind migepe matindo mag anywola mar joweteu mamoko.
english: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

kikuyu: Winy mafuyo e kor polo ogero utegi e bath pigego, kendo giwer ewi yiende.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

kikuyu: Omiyo lum loth ne jamni, kod cham ma dhano doyo, mamiyo chiemo yudore e piny;
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho kuom Ahab wuod Kolaya kod Zedekia wuod Maseya, ma koronu miriambo e nyinga: “Anachiwgi ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, kendo enoneg-gi e nyimu ka uneno.
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.

kikuyu: bende nyaka ndalo ma Jehova Nyasaye oriemboe ji duto mabor ma piny odongʼ malich ka gunda.
english: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

kikuyu: Lea nochako omako ich kendo nonywolone Jakobo wuowi mar auchiel.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Isaka noluongo Jakobo mogwedhe kendo osieme konyise niya, “Kik ikend nyar jo-Kanaan.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Gik mamiyo ji donjo e richo ochunore ni nyaka bedie, to okwongʼ ngʼatno makelo gigo.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

kikuyu: Kamano tije Jehova Nyasaye duto mar Sap Pasaka kod mar timo misengini miwangʼo pep e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye notim chiengʼono, kaka ruoth Josia nochiko.
english: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the LORD’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

kikuyu: To Musa noluongogi; omiyo Harun kod jodongo duto mag oganda Israel noduogo ire mi owuoyo kodgi.
english: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

kikuyu: Weuru kecho gi mirima gi ich wangʼ gi gwandruok gi himruok gi ketho nying kod himruok duto.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

kikuyu: Magi duto timore mondo okonyu, mondo kaka ngʼwono medo chopo ni ji mangʼeny moloyo, e kaka ji mangʼeny dwoko erokamano ni Nyasaye, mondo Nyasaye oyud duongʼ.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi Wuowi nigi ngima; to ngʼat maonge gi Wuod Nyasaye onge gi ngima.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

kikuyu: Eka nowuoyo kodgi mar adek kowacho niya, “Nangʼo? Ere gima rach ma ngʼatni osetimo? Onge gima aseyudo kuome moromo gi kum mar tho. Omiyo abiro kume kendo bangʼe agonye odhi.”
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Mad weche mawuok e dhoga, kod paro manie chunya, obed malongʼo e nyimi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, Lwandana kendo Jawarna.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

kikuyu: Bangʼe eka malaika nonyisa aora mar pi mar ngima, marieny maler ahinya, kendo mamol kawuok e kom duongʼ mar loch mar Nyasaye gi mar Nyarombo,
english: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

kikuyu: Magi e gik mangima mane aseneno e bwo Nyasaye mar Israel e bath Aora Kebar, kendo koro nayango ni gin kerubi.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

kikuyu: Nimar mach kod ligangla ema Jehova Nyasaye noyalgo ji duto, kendo joma Jehova Nyasaye nonegi nobed mangʼeny.
english: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.

kikuyu: Chunje ji ywak ni Ruoth Nyasaye. Yaye ohinga mar Nyar Sayun, we pi wangʼi omol ka aora, odiechiengʼ gotieno; kik iywe kata matin, kendo pi wangʼi kik chogi.
