english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Zebulun, kaw Eliab wuod Helon.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Ne, ok adwari, yaye janjore, nimar odiechiengi osechopo, kinde mari mar kum.
english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

kikuyu: Donge in ema isedagiwa, yaye Nyasaye, kendo tinde ok idhi gi jolwenjwa e lweny?
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

kikuyu: Kik iole e dend ji bende kik ilos mo moro amora machal kaka olos mono. En gima owal kendo nyaka ikawe kaka gima owal.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: Eka ne walamo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwerewa kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo ywakwa mi oneno chandruokwa, tich matek kod achune.
english: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

kikuyu: Nyasaye odak e iye omiyo ok obi podho; Nyasaye biro konye ka piny oyawore.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Weche Jeremia wuod Hilkia, achiel kuom jodolo man Anathoth e piny Benjamin.
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

kikuyu: nono to ngʼat moro mowinji biro keti e wichkuot; mi huma mari marach ok nogiki.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

kikuyu: Salmon ne en wuon Boaz, Boaz ne en wuon Obed,
english: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nowachone Jehoshafat niya, “Abiro rwako lewni moko ka wadhi e lweny mondo kik gifwenya, in to rwak arwaka lepi mag ruoth.” Omiyo ruodh Israel norwako lewni ma ok nyal fwenyego kendo nodhi e lweny.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maonge gi rieko ema keto gir singo ne jabute.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Keturu tich obed matekie moloyo ni jogi mondo gisiki ka gitiyo kendo kik uchik itu ne miriambogi.”
english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi nobedo joma ofuwo nikech yoregi mobam kendo negineno thagruok nikech timbegi mamono.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

kikuyu: Ruoth Rehoboam nogurore motegno Jerusalem kendo nodhi nyime kaka ruoth. Ne en ja-higni piero angʼwen gachiel kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higni apar gabiriyo ka en Jerusalem dala maduongʼ mane Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero kuom dhout jo-Israel duto mondo Nyinge obedie. Min mare ne nyinge Naama ma nyar jo-Amon.
english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

kikuyu: “Dweni ema biro bedonu dwe mokwongo, ma en dwe mokwongo mar hiku.
english: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

kikuyu: Eka Joab nodhi ir Abisalom e ode mowachone niya, “Angʼo momiyo jotiji owangʼo puotha?”
english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

kikuyu: En Jal mabiro bangʼa, ma ok awinjora gonyo tond wuochene.”
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne gichayo pinye ma jaber; nikech ne ok giyie singruokne ni en adier.
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano to mondo omien remo moko e tunge kendo mar misango manie nyim Jehova Nyasaye ei Hemb Romo. To remo modongʼ nopuki e tiend kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep manie dho Hemb Romo.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye miye kido mana kaka en ema osechano, kendo kodhi ka kodhi omiyo kite owuon.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mon kod dhok mariambo, to omor gi jogo ma jo-adiera.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro ok un wasumbini, to un nyithind ot, to nikech un nyithind ot, Nyasaye osemiyo wadoko jocham girkeni.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

kikuyu: Koma odok yo nyandwat mar laruno nobed maromo fut mia achiel piero abich gachiel kendo nobed gi sirni piero ariyo gi rachungi piero ariyo mag mula man-gi ramaki kod rangʼaw miriwogo kor sirni molos gi fedha.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: kendo mikebe moro amora maonge raum moumego nobed mochido.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyithindo ma Jehova Nyasaye biro miyi kuom dhakoni ma pod tin-ni, mad odi bi chal gi mar Perez mane Tamar onywolo ne Juda.”
english: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which the LORD will give you by this young woman.”

kikuyu: E siwandhano ne nitie pasia marachar gi marambulu molier kotwe gi tonde momin gi lewni marochere gi maralik kolier e bonje mar fedha manotwe e sirni mapakni. Kombego nolos gi dhahabu gi fedha kendo siwandhano nobug gi kite mopogore opogore ma nengogi tek ma kitgi opogore opogore.
english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

kikuyu: Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi mamiyo Nam gingore mi apaka wuo, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge.
english: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. the LORD of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: “Lweti ema nochweya. Ibiro lokori koda kendo mondo itieka?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto oseweyo luwo chikeni, kendo giseluwo yoregi giwegi, mi gidagi luori. “Kuom mano kwongʼ kod ngʼado bura mane osingi mondiki e kitap Chik Musa, ma jatich Nyasaye, oseol kuomwa, nikech wasetimo richo e nyimi.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

kikuyu: Nyar Sayun odongʼ ka kiru manie e puoth mzabibu, kata ka abila e puoth budho kendo ka dala maduongʼ ma wasigu omonjo.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho kamano, nolokore ongʼiyo ngʼeye, kendo noneno Yesu kochungʼ kanyo, to ne ok ongʼeyo ni en Yesu.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: Noloso kendo mar misango mar mula ma borne gi lachne romo fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus, to borne modhi malo romo fut apar gabich.
english: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

kikuyu: Negipuonjo e piny Juda duto ka gitingʼo Kitap Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gilworore e miech Juda duto kendo ka gipuonjo ji.
english: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

kikuyu: Ogeno kuom Nyasaye; Nyasaye koro okonye ane sani ka odware adier, nimar ne owachoga ni, ‘An Wuod Nyasaye,’ ”
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

kikuyu: Adam nodwoke niya, “Dhako mane imiya ema nomiya olemo moko moa e yien-no kendo achamo.”
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

kikuyu: To lwet ngʼat ma biro ndhoga chiemo koda.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

kikuyu: Isegeno kuom timbeni mamono kendo isewacho e chunyi ni, ‘Onge ngʼama nena.’ Ngʼeyoni gi riekoni osewuondi kiwacho e chunyi ni, ‘An kenda ema antie, onge machielo.’
english: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’

kikuyu: Ka ochuna ni nyaka apakra, to abiro pakora, kuom gik manyiso nyawona.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

kikuyu: Gin gi it, to ok ginyal winjo wach, kendo gin gi um, to ok ginyal ngʼwecho.
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

kikuyu: to gingʼe ni jo-Israel osechako lweny. Jo-Benjamin nosechako nego jo-Israel (madirom piero adek), kendo negiwacho niya, “Waseloyogi mana kaka ne waloyogi e lweny mokwongo.”
english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

kikuyu: Kik ichal gi farese kata gi punda, maonge gi rieko, manyaka chiki mana ka otwe dhoge kendo iywayo gi kamba, nono to ok gibi buti.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

kikuyu: Eka Lea nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osedhiala gi mich ma nyangafu. Koro chwora biro gena nikech asenywolone yawuowi auchiel.” Omiyo nachake ni Zebulun.
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

kikuyu: To jadolo nodwoko Daudi niya, “Aonge gi makati moro amora makmana nitiere moko mowal ka, ginyalo tiyo kode mana ka giseritore ma ok gibedo e achiel gi mon.”
english: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, osiepena mageno, mana kaka usebedo kuwinjo wachna kinde duto, ok mana ka antie kodu, to koro moloyo ka aonge, dhiuru nyime ka urito warruoku mondo ochop kare, kupongʼ gi luoro kod bolruok,
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo odhiambo ne odhi kuno to kochopo okinyi, to noduogo e od mon komachielo mirito gi Shashgaz, ma en bende ne en bwoch mane ruoth oketo mondo orit monde. Ne ok onyal dok ir ruoth makmana ka ruoth ne mor kode moluonge gi nyinge.
english: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

kikuyu: to dhoga ok nowach gimoro marach, kendo lewa ok nowach miriambo.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

kikuyu: Winj ywakna mondo ikecha e sa ma aluongi mondo ikonya, e sa ma atingʼo bedena malo kochomo Kari Maler Moloyo.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

kikuyu: Nodar kanyo modhi kendo odhi okunyo soko machielo, kendo onge ngʼama nolaro kode. Nochake ni Rehoboth (tiende ni thuolo moromowa), kowacho niya, “Koro Jehova Nyasaye osemiyowa thuolo kendo wabiro medore e piny.”
english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

kikuyu: Ruoth ok odeko kuom chopo singruokne, kaka jomoko paro. Un ema oweyonu thuolo mondo ulokru, nikech ohore mos ka odwaro ni kik ngʼato lal kata achiel, to odwaro mondo ji duto olokre owe richogi.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

kikuyu: Mogik, roho marach nobiro mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mowacho ni, ‘Abiro hoye.’ ” Jehova Nyasaye nopenje niya, “Ere kaka ibiro hoye?”
english: A spirit came out, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “The LORD said to him, ‘How?’

kikuyu: Ketho duto gin richo, to nitie richo ma ok ter ji e tho.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

kikuyu: To e higa mar apar gaboro mar ruoth Josia, Pasaka machalo kama notimne Jehova Nyasaye e Jerusalem.
english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mangima machwo kod mamon nodonjo ei yie mana kaka Nyasaye nochiko Nowa. Eka Jehova Nyasaye noloronegi ei yie.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

kikuyu: Yud duongʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kuom tekoni maduongʼ; wabiro wer kendo pako nyalo mari.
english: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

kikuyu: kuom wacho adiera, kendo kuom teko mar Nyasaye. Watimo gigi duto ka watingʼo gige lweny mag ngima makare e lwetwa korachwich gi koracham;
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

kikuyu: Gwedhuru joma sandou; gwedhgiuru agwedha, kik ukwongʼ-gi.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

kikuyu: Kik ium gigo magisetimo ma ok odhi kare kata iruch richogi e nyim wangʼi, nimar gisediro ayenje e wangʼ jogedo.
english: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

kikuyu: Kuom higni piero angʼwen iya nowangʼ gi tiengʼno; kendo nawacho niya, “Gin joma chunygi ohero rwenyo, kendo pok gingʼeyo yorena.”
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

kikuyu: Waseloso kendo pwodho gik moko duto mane ruoth Ahaz ne ogolo oko nikech noweyo luwo Nyasaye kane en ruoth, kendo oseketgi e nyim kendo mar misango miwangʼo mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before the LORD’s altar.”

kikuyu: Efraim geno gima onge, olawo yamb wuok chiengʼ odiechiengʼ duto, kendo omedo miriambo kod gero. Oketo winjruok gi Asuria kendo ooro mor zeituni ne jo-Misri.
english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

kikuyu: Migepe duto mag jolweny mane nigi Joab nobiro molworo Sheba ka en Abel Beth Maaka. Negigoyo agengʼa ne dala maduongʼno kendo ka gichungʼ e agengʼa molworo ohinga. To e kindeno mane gitwomo ohinganano mondo gimuke,
english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi moidho gache mar lweny moringo odhi Jezreel nikech Joram ne ni kuno kendo Ahazia ruodh Juda bende noyudo ni kuno kaka wendone.
english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomedo fwenyore e Shilo kendo kanyo ne ofwenyore owuon ne Samuel kuom wachne.
english: The LORD appeared again in Shiloh; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye oselonyo mabor tekre Juda, kendo e kindeno ne umanyo, gige lweny manie Od Ruoth manie Bungu.
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

kikuyu: Osimbo ibiro mi Heldai, Tobija, Jedaya kod Hen wuod Zefania kaka gir rapar ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.

kikuyu: Yud rieko kod ngʼeyo matut, wiyi kik wil kod wechena kata weyogi.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Joka Merari noyier mondo orit sirni mag kama ler mar lemo, yiend reru, sirni mamoko, mise, kaachiel gi gige duto kod gik moko duto mitiyogo kanyo,
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

kikuyu: To ka koro yie osebiro, to koro ok wan e bwo chik.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

kikuyu: “Ere kaka diwachi ni, ‘Ok adwanyora; pod ok aringo aluwo bangʼ Baal?’ Par kaka ne itimori e holo; par gima isetimo. In ngamia ma nyako ma rikni maringo ka gi kacha,
english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways,

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar Ishmael wuod Ibrahim mane Hagar jatich Sara ma nyar Misri onywolone.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

kikuyu: Ketho ma asekethogo oima mana ka lodi mapek mohinga tingʼo.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

kikuyu: “Anakeu ka mihudhwe miriembo gi yamb kalausi.
english: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Yesu nowuok modhiyo e Got Zeituni kaka notimo pile, kendo jopuonjrene noluwe.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

kikuyu: to yie mondo iwinj lemogi gi kwayogi gie polo kama idakie kendo ikonygi.
english: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

kikuyu: Bangʼ seche adek, chiege bende nobiro kanyo, kokia gima nosetimore ne chwore.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

kikuyu: Kik utimru ruodhi ewi joma oketi e lwetu mondo uriti, to bedne giuru ranyisi maber.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

kikuyu: Oyiero yie rombe kod tworo kendo otiyo matek gi lwete.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

kikuyu: Kanyo Jehova Nyasaye biro bedonwa Jal Maratego. Kanyo nochalnwa ka aore kod mago matindo. Yiedhi man-gi tanga ok nokwangʼ kanyo, meli maduongʼ ok nokwangʼ e aore.
english: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Ahaz nogolo chik ne Uria jadolo niya, “E kendo manyien maduongʼni ema nyaka itimie misango miwangʼo pep mar okinyi, misango mar cham mar odhiambo, misango miwangʼo pep mar ruoth, kod misango mar cham mar ruoth kaachiel gi misango pep mar ji duto modak e pinyno, kod misangogi mag cham kod misango miolo piny. Kir remo mag misengini duto miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko ewi kendo mar misangono. To abiro tiyo gi kendo mar misango molos gi mula mondo angʼe gima kare monego atim.”
english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

kikuyu: Kanyo ema kombe loch mag ngʼado bura nitie gin kombe loch mag jood Daudi.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

kikuyu: Omiyo kwe bedo e tongʼ pinyu kendo oromou gi ngano mabeyoe mogik.
english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mar aboro nyaka okel akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ne jadolo e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Apoya nono, kapok angʼeyo, gombona notingʼa motera nyaka dier geche joka ruoth.
english: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.

kikuyu: Onego ngʼato kik timne ngʼwono kata kecho nyithinde modongʼ kiye.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

kikuyu: To gigo unyalo chiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mar cham mokwongo, makmana kik uwangʼ-gi e kendo mar misango kaka iwangʼo misango madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

kikuyu: Nyaka one ni ochiwone wuowi maduongʼ ma wuod dhako ma ok oherocha pok nyadiriyo mar gige duto. Wuowino en e ranyisi mokwongo mar tekre wuon. Ratiro mar wuowi makayo en mare.
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

kikuyu: Kane dwol osewuoyo, negiyudo ni Yesu ni kende. Jopuonjre nokano wachni e kindgi giwegi kendo ne ok ginyiso ngʼato angʼata kuom gik mane giseneno.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Ka piny chayou, to ngʼeuru ni an ema ne gichaya mokwongo.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon nokelo osuru ne Uzia kendo humbe nolandore nyaka e tongʼ-gi kod jo-Misri nimar nosedoko ngʼama duongʼ ahinya.
english: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

kikuyu: Bangʼ Sabato, kogwen mar odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria machielo nodhi limo liel.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

kikuyu: Isechiko atungʼ mari, kendo iluongo mondo omedi aserni mangʼeny. Sela Ipogo piny gi aore,
english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

kikuyu: kosaye niya, “Nyara matin tuo dwa tho, yie ibi mondo iket lweti kuome mondo ochangi odok mangima.”
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

kikuyu: “Duongʼ obed ni Nyasaye e polo malo kendo kwe obed e piny ne ji ma Nyasaye oyiero.”
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kikuyu: Kendo noketogi duto e od twech kuom ndalo adek.
english: He put them all together into custody for three days.

kikuyu: To analony Esau duk; anael kuondege malingʼ-lingʼ, mondo omi kik opondi. Nyithinde, wedene gi jomodak bute nolal nono, kendo ok nochak obed chutho.
english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.

kikuyu: rwath matin achiel, im achiel kod nyaim achiel ma hike achiel, nochiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: “Awachonu adier ni, tiengʼni ok norum ngangʼ kapok gigi duto otimore.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Eka joma otony moa e pinje duto mosemonjo Jerusalem nodhi e got zeituni higa ka higa mondo olam Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, kendo mondo gitim Sawo mar Kiche.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Ngʼama ngʼwon ma holo ji gige gi chuny maler biro neno ber ngʼat matiyo tijene gi adiera.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

kikuyu: “Kane oyudo pod angʼicho, “kombe mag loch ne oketi kanyo Kendo Ngʼat Machon Manyaka nene nobet e kome. Lepe ne tar ka pe, yie wiye ne rachar ka yier rombe. Kom duongʼ mare ne chalo mach maliel kendo tiendene nosiko kotimo mach maliel aliela.
english: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

kikuyu: Utege matindo mag rito, gi ohinga mage mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko kod agola mare ne romre gi mamoko duto kuom pim. Rangach midonjogo kod agola mare ne nigi dirisni molwore duto. Borne ne en fut piero abiriyo gabich to lachne ne en fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

kikuyu: Idak gi joma terore gi mond wuonegi; kendo joma riwore gi mon mantiere e kindegi mag neno malo kendo mogak.
english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.

kikuyu: kuom geno yudo ngima mochwere, mane Nyasaye, ma ok riambi osesingore chon ni nomiwa.
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

kikuyu: Hodia, Hashum, Bezai,
english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

kikuyu: Kane Samuel oseti noketo yawuote mondo obed jongʼad bura e Israel.
english: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

kikuyu: nyikwa Pashur, ji alufu achiel mia ariyo gi piero angʼwen gabiriyo (1,247),
english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

kikuyu: “Ne okuodhna wach moro mos, to ne awinje mana marach rach.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

kikuyu: Abiro kawou kaka joga awuon, bende abiro bedo Nyasachu eka ubiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, manogolou ka uwuok e bwo tich matek mar jo-Misri.
english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka oliel yie dende duto kaka yie wiye, gi yie tike kod yie wangʼe, kaachiel gi yie dende mamoko duto. Bangʼe nyaka olwok lepe kendo olwokre gi pi, eka koro nobed ngʼama opwodhore chuth.
english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

kikuyu: kuma negidonjo ei yie, kendo ne gisiayo yieno mi gingʼado nam nyaka Kapernaum. Sechego piny koro noselil, to Yesu ne pok obiro irgi.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

kikuyu: “Namiye singruokna ma en singruok mar ngima kod kwe. Singruokni ne dwaro ni mondo omiya luor, kendo notimo kamano; nochungʼ e nyima koluoro nyinga.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

kikuyu: Nomedo wachona niya, “Wuod dhano, cham gima ni e nyimi, cham weche mondikie kalatasni, bangʼe idhi iwuo gi dhood Israel.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato achiel opodho, to osiepne nyalo konye mondo ochungʼ malo. To atimo mos ne ngʼatno ma opodho piny to oonge gi ngʼat makonye mondo ochungʼ malo!
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne akawo ringre chiegano, mi apogee matindo tindo kendo aoro lembe ne dhoudi duto mag Israel kaka girkeni, nikech jogi notimo tim machachni kendo mar anjawo e piny Israel.
english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, un ok chiku gi kido mar richo, to Roho ema chikou, ka en adier ni Roho mar Nyasaye odak eiu. Kendo ka ngʼato onge gi Roho mar Kristo ok en ngʼat Kristo.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

kikuyu: To abiro chungo Jadolona awuon ma en ngʼat ma ja-adiera, manotim gik moko duto man e chunya kod pacha. Abiro guro ode matek, kendo obiro tiyo ndalo duto e nyim ngʼata ma awiro.
english: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ji nochiewo kinyne kogwen mochiwo misango miwangʼo pep kendo negichiwo misango mag lalruok. Bangʼe negibedo piny mondo gichiem kendo gimethi kendo negia malo mondo gimiel miende dwanyruok.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

kikuyu: Muma to wacho angʼo kuom wachni? Owacho niya, “Riemb dhako ma misumbani kod wuode nimar wuod dhako ma misumbani ok nobed jacham girkeni kaachiel gi wuod dhako ma ni thuoloni.”
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

kikuyu: ‘Joma oa Misri opongʼo wangʼ piny. Koro bi kendo ikwongʼnagi. Dibed ni bangʼe anyalo kedo kodgi mi ariembgi.’ ”
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

kikuyu: An gi mor maduongʼ kuom Ruoth ni uchako upara kendo. Adier, usebedo kupara makmana ni nyocha pok uyudo thuolo mar nyisa herau.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

kikuyu: kaka Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, gi Og ruodh Bashan, kod ruodhi duto mag Kanaan,
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

kikuyu: Giniyud pok mar richo, kar richo magisetimo. Giwinjo maber ka gichopo gombo duto mag ringregi ratiro e nyim ji. Ka gidwanyore kendo gichopo gombogi maricho e chokruogeu mag sawo to gichalo mbelni kod gik motop.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ogwedho jabute e lela gokinyi mangʼich, to ochalo mana gi ngʼama kwongʼe.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

kikuyu: Oyawo bade ne joma jochan kendo otero lwete ne jogo mochando.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

kikuyu: Misumba mariek biro bedo gi loch kuom wuowi makwodo wich, kendo obiro yudo pok mar girkeni machal mana gi owetene.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

kikuyu: Gichula rach kar ber, kendo giweyo chunya kochwanyore.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye notimo mano. Kweth mag lwangʼni mopoto noolore e od Farao, kendo ei ut jodonge bende piny Misri duto ne lwangʼnigo oketho.
english: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

kikuyu: Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Podho Chiengʼ to gi rangach miluongo ni Shaleketh man e yo mamalo nolwar ne Shupim kod Hosa. Arita duto noket machalre.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo mar dwe mar abich e higa mar apar gochiko mar loch Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, Nebuzaradan jatend jolweny marito ruoth, ma en achiel kuom jodong ruodh Babulon nobiro Jerusalem.
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Daudi noyudo osetelo ne Israel kuom higni piero angʼwen, ka higni abiriyo ne en Hebron to higni piero adek gadek ka en Jerusalem.
english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ gotieno gilwenyo kor ohinga mare; himruok gi ayany ni e iye.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

kikuyu: Noloko aoregi remo mi koro ne ok ginyal modho pi moa e aoregi.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

kikuyu: To mana kaka ondiki ni: “Joma ne pok onyis wach kuome none kendo jogo mapok owinjo kuome nowinj tiend wach.”
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

kikuyu: Lokri iranga mondo ikecha, kaka ijatimo ndalo duto ne joma ohero nyingi.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

kikuyu: Magi e buche kod chike manyaka une ni uluwo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwereu, osemiyou mondo ukaw obed maru ka pod udak e pinyni.
english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

kikuyu: To Petro nosingore koramo niya, “Kata ka ochuno ni nyaka atho kodi, to ok abi kwedi ngangʼ.” Jopuonjre mamoko duto bende nowuoyo machalre gi Petro.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

kikuyu: Ruoth mondo omi herau omedre kendo olandre e kindu ngʼato gi ngʼato, kaachiel kod ji duto, mana kaka hera mwaherougo bende olandore.
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

kikuyu: to gi joma ni Horma, Bor Ashan gi Athak
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ok nyal gerore motegno kuom richo, to ngʼat makare ok nyal pudhi.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

kikuyu: “Yaye nyi Israel, ywaguru Saulo, mane orwakou gi lewni makwar kendo marep-rep, mane oduso lepu gi gik molos gi dhahabu.
english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

kikuyu: Elishama, Beliada kod Elifelet.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Puodho en piny, to kodhi maber ochungʼ kar yawuot pinyruoth. Buya gin yawuot ngʼat marach,
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

kikuyu: Kane wayudo ni ok onyal loko pache, to ne waweyo wachno, mi wawacho niya, “Ruoth Nyasaye mondo otim dwarone.”
english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

kikuyu: To ewi got mar Sayun tony nobedie, mi enobed kama ler, kendo od Jakobo nokaw girkeni mage.
english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

kikuyu: “Mi jo-Israel chik mondo oriemb ngʼato angʼata man-gi tuo mar del kata man-gi tuo magolo tutu kata ngʼat ma ok ler nikech osemulo ringre ngʼama otho.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

kikuyu: Nyiego nomakogi gi Musa e kambi, kendo gi Harun, jatich mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

kikuyu: Ruodhi mag Tarshish kod mag dho nembe man maboyo biro miye gik moko, kendo ruodhi mag Sheba gi mag Seba biro kelone mich.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

kikuyu: Jowetena, riwreuru gi ji mamoko kungʼiyo maber joma kit wuodh ngimagi chal gi ranyisi mane uneno kuomwa.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

kikuyu: Ne nitie rangach midonjogo e laru ma iye mochomore gi rangach man yo nyandwat, machalre gi machielo mane ni koma ochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Ne opimo bor manie kindgi moyudo ka en fut mia achiel gi piero abich.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

kikuyu: Gin to ginilal nono in to isiko manyaka chiengʼ; giduto giniti mana kaka law ti. Ibiro lokogi kaka iloko law kendo ibiro witgi.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

kikuyu: “Kawuru kereu e alwora mar Babulon, un duto maywayo atungʼ. Bayeuru gi asere! Kik uwe asere moro amora, nimar osetimo richo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

kikuyu: Nus mar gik mane ope mane omi joma ne odhi kedo e lweny ne gin: rombe alufu mia adek gi piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich (337,500),
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

kikuyu: kendo nobed mar jambu gi le manie pinyu. Gimoro amora ma piny ochiego inyalo cham.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

kikuyu: Gima adwaro en ni mondo gibed gi chuny motegno kendo giriwre e hera, eka ginibed gi mwandu mar ngʼeyo tiend weche mar adier. Ka gitimo kamano, to giningʼe ma lingʼ-lingʼ mar Nyasaye ma en Kristo,
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Awachonu adier ni ka un gi yie ma uonge gi kiawa, to ok unyal mana timo gima ne otim ne ngʼowuni, to unyalo bende wacho ne godni ni, ‘Dhiyo mondo inyumri e nam,’ kendo notimre kamano.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

kikuyu: Chutho, ok wahomb ji gi weche mag miriambo kata gi weche mowuok e paro mochido. Bende ok wan gi paro malingʼ-lingʼ mar wito ji.
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

kikuyu: Eka Hagai nowacho niya, “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni: Mano bende e kaka jo-Israel kod gik moko duto ma giwachona ei hekaluni ogak.’
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni ringruok duto en mana wangʼ kende, dowinj wach nadi? Kata ka dine ringruok duto bed mana it kende, ere kaka dongʼwe gik moko?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: To bende un jo-Filipi uwegi ungʼeyo ni kane aa Makedonia e ndalo mokwongo mane ayalonue Injili, to ne onge kanisa mane okonya e chiwo moro amora, makmana un;
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

kikuyu: Gin e joma noluwo puonj Balaam kendo gin ema negimiyo oganda mar jo-Israel oweyo Jehova Nyasaye kuom gima notimore Peor, mane omiyo masira onego jo-Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

kikuyu: negifwenyo ni en e ngʼat mane jabedo kakwecho e dhoranga hekalu miluongo ni Malongʼo, omiyo ne giwuoro kendo dhogi nomoko kuom gima notimorene.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

kikuyu: Tarik apar gabiriyo mar dwe mar ariyo noyudo ka Nowa ja-higni mia auchiel kendo sokni duto manie nam mangʼongo manie bwo piny nomuoch kendo dirisni mag polo noyawore.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

kikuyu: Abiro goyo erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech en ngʼama kare kendo abiro wero wend pak ne nying Jehova Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.
english: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

kikuyu: Kane osewacho kamano eka ne gikwaye mondo odonj irgi ei yie. Kendo gikanyono yie nogowo e dho nam kama negidhiye.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

kikuyu: Kuno, jomoko nokelone ngʼat moro mane ite odino kendo mane ok nyal wuoyo kata matin. Jogi nokwayo Yesu mondo oket lwete kuome.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Wer. Pak riti e dala mar Sayun, yaye Nyasaye, wabiro rito singruokwa duto.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gariyo, tarik apar gachiel mar dwe, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ngʼama riek mondo omak wechegi maber, kendo opar matut kuom hera maduongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

kikuyu: Chenroni ne berne ruoth kod joma nochokore.
english: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.

kikuyu: Giniwach niya, “Lopni ma yande okethi mowe nono koro osedoko machal gi puoth Eden, kendo mier madongo mane omuki kendo okethi molokore gunda tinde ochiel motegno kendo ji odakie.”
english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

kikuyu: Beduru gi rieko kuom joma odak e dieru kutiyo gi thuolo muyudo e yo maber.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

kikuyu: Nikech ji mangʼeny ei oganda ne pod ok opwodhore, nochuno jo-Lawi mondo oyangʼ nyirombe mag Sap Pasaka ni jogo duto mane ok ler kendo ne ok nyal chiwo nyirombegi ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Asa nochiwo chik ni Juda duto maonge ngʼato angʼata mane owe oko, negikawo kite duto kod yiende mane Baasha osebedo katiyogo Rama kendo notiyo kodgi kanyo. Asa notiyo kodgi kuom gero Geba e piny Benjamin kod Mizpa bende.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

kikuyu: Hekalu ne iye opongʼ gi iro moa e duongʼ maler mar Nyasaye kod tekone. To onge ngʼama ne nyalo donjo ei hekalu kapok masiche abiriyo mag malaike abiriyogo orumo.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

kikuyu: Joka Jakobo modongʼ nobed e dier ogendini mangʼeny, mana ka thoo moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye kata ka ngʼidho ma omoko e lum, malal apoya nono ne dhano bende ok nyal rito dhano.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.

kikuyu: Magi e nying joka Lawi kaluwore gi anywolagi: Gershon, Kohath gi Merari. (Lawi nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek gabiriyo.)
english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

kikuyu: Ruoth Jehoyakim, kata kamano, nooro Elnathan wuod Akbor nyaka Misri, kaachiel gi chwo mamoko.
english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.

kikuyu: Dak kode kuno mondi nyaka mirimb owadu dog chien.
english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

kikuyu: Donge jogo machano marach lal nono? To jogo machano gima ber yudo hera kendo imiyogi luor.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

kikuyu: “Pak obed ne Ruoth Nyasach Israel; nikech osebiro kendo osereso joge.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

kikuyu: Iparo ni ilich maloyo Balak wuod Zipor, ma ruodh Moab? Bende nodhawo gi Israel kata kedo kodgi?
english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

kikuyu: Kare wach pok odonjonu? Donge uparo makati abich mane opidho ji alufu abich, kod kar romb okepe mane uchoko?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

kikuyu: “Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye nikech jotelo mag Israel okawo loch, kendo ji giwegi ochiwore mar luwogi!
english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD!

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase noweyo jo-Israel Shilo mantiere Kanaan, mondo gidogi Gilead, pinygi giwegi, mane giyudo kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye kokalo kuom Musa.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Jokor wach nodwoko ruoth niya, “Onge dhano moro amora e piny manyalo timo gima ruoth penjoni! Bende onge ruoth moro amora, bed ni oduongʼ kendo en gi nyalo machal nadi, mosepenjo ajwoga, ja-nyakalondo kata jakor wach moro amora gima chalo kamano.
english: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.

kikuyu: Ka ji osetony oweyo kethruok mar piny, nikech ngʼeyo Ruodhwa kendo Jawarwa Yesu Kristo, eka bangʼe gichako giduodore e kethruok mi kethruok omakogi kendo, to ngimagi machien bedo marach moloyo ngimagi mokwongo.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

kikuyu: Nonywola ka gode madongo ne pok obedo kuonde ma gintie, bende ka gode matindo ne pod onge,
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik udwany piny mudakie. Chwero remo dwanyo piny, kendo pwodhruok ok nyal tim ne piny modwany kuom chwero remo, makmana kokadho kuom remb ngʼatno mane ochwero remo.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

kikuyu: Eka Daniel nodwoko ruoth niya, “Inyalo bedo abeda gi michnigo mondo ikonyrigo iwuon, kendo poknigo bende inyalo anyala miyo ngʼat machielo. Kata kamano, abiro somo ne ruoth ndikoni kendo abiro nyise tiende.
english: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

kikuyu: Kendo Shekem nowacho ni wuon mare Hamor niya, “Nyuomna nyakoni obed chiega.”
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ndalo biro ma abiro chopo singruokna mar ngʼwono mane aloso gi od Israel kod gi od Juda,’ Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi kama: Ka ungʼado Jordan mi udonjo Kanaan,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: We ane nyisecheni manonogo okonyi sa ma inie chandruok! Yamo mafuto biro yweyogi oko duto, kata mana muya matin nono nokudhgi matergi mabor. To ngʼama oloka kar pondone nokaw piny, mi goda maler nobed mwandune.”
english: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”

kikuyu: Ne! Otenga nofu kochomo malo kendo piny koyaro bwombene ewi Bozra. E odiechiengno chunje jolweny mag Edom nochal gi chuny dhako mamuoch kayo.
english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

kikuyu: Kendo mano e gima notimore. Gideon nochiewo gokinyi mangʼich; nobiyo pien-no ma thoo owuok madirom bakul achiel.
english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

kikuyu: Jehoash notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike Samaria gi ruodhi Israel kendo Jeroboam wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: kendo nowacho e nyim ji duto niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Mana e yo machalre gima ema anagolie jok mar Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon mane oketo e ngʼut ogendini kapok higni ariyo orumo.’ ” Bangʼ wacho ma, janabi Jeremia nochungo modhi.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “The LORD says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

kikuyu: To mano mar Roho ok ema kuongi, to mar ringruok ema kuongo, eka bangʼe mar Roho.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

kikuyu: kod ruodhi mag piny gi ogendini duto; kod un jotelo gi joloch duto mag piny,
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

kikuyu: Owacho ne pe ni, ‘Lwar piny,’ kendo ne nyidho matin ni, ‘Lokri koth maduongʼ.’
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

kikuyu: Kata mana nyithindgi paro kendegi mag misango miwangʼoe liswa, kod sirni mag Ashera mantie bath yiende motimo otiep, kendo e gode matindo motingʼore gi malo.
english: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills.

kikuyu: “Injili ma wanyisou ema: Gima Nyasaye nosingo ne kwerewa
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo kelo gima ler kogolo kuom gima ochido? Onge kata achiel!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

kikuyu: Kane Joram oneno Jehu nopenje niya, “Ibiro e yor kwe koso?” Jehu nodwoke niya, “Ere kaka kwe nyalo betie kapod Jezebel minu dhi nyime gi lamo nyiseche manono kod timo timbe jwok?”
english: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

kikuyu: negichamo gimoro amora mane loth e pinygi koda ka chambgi mane gipidho e puothegi.
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

kikuyu: Negirwako gige lweny mag akor machalo gi akor mar nyinyo, to bwombegi ne goyo koko mana ka farese mangʼeny kendo ka geche miywayo kadhi e lweny.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

kikuyu: Nowachone Seraya, “Ka ichopo Babulon, ne ni isomo wechegi mondo owinji.
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

kikuyu: Aseketo wechena e dhogi kendo aumi gi tipo mar lweta, an ema ne ayaro polo maketo kare, mi aketo mise mar piny kendo awachone jo-Sayun ni, ‘Un e joga.’ ”
english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

kikuyu: “Nikech jogi osedagi, pi mamol mamuol kawuok Shilo, kendo gi mor mana gi Rezin kod wuod Remalia,
english: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

kikuyu: In iwuorori ni iseloyo jo-Edom kendo koro iwuoyo marach kisungori. To ber mondo ibed mana e dala. Angʼo momiyo imanyo lweny mabiro tieki kaachiel gi jo-Juda duto?”
english: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”

kikuyu: Mirimba nosik kuom pinyni kendo ok norum nikech gisejwangʼa ka giwangʼo ubani ne nyiseche manono kendo ka gimiya mirima kuom lamo nyiseche mopa gi lwedo.’
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’

kikuyu: Mi mondo okinyi oromna gi herani ma ok rem, nimar aketo genona kuomi. Nyisa yo monego alu nimar aketo chunya duto kuomi.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

kikuyu: Miriam kod Harun nochako wuoyo marach kuom Musa nikech jaode ma nyar jo-Kush, nimar ne onywomo nyar Kush.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

kikuyu: Ka uwinjo ywak mar tungʼ, asili, nyagweru, nyatiti, orutu kod kit thumbe mayoreyore, to nyaka upodhi piny auma kendo ulam kido mar dhahabu ma ruoth Nebukadneza osechungoni.
english: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

kikuyu: Dhako moro amora molony e twengʼo kod chwecho nokelo law marambulu, maralik kod marakwaro.
english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kikuyu: “Usedigni bangʼ kinde mangʼeny kulwororu e pinyni, omiyo wuothuru kuchomo yor nyandwat.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

kikuyu: Aore mondo opam lwetgi, gode mondo ower kaachiel ka gimor;
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni anyalo kwanogi, to dine giloyo kuoyo gi ngʼeny. Sa ma achiew to ayudo ni pod an mana kodi.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

kikuyu: Elija ne en dhano mana kaka wan. Nolemo koketo chunye mondo kik koth chue, mi koth ne ok ochwe e piny kuom higni adek gi nus.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

kikuyu: Nikech ongʼere malongʼo ni Ruodhwa noa e dhood Juda, ma en dhoot ma Musa ne ok owacho gimoro kuom jodolo.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

kikuyu: kendo oyie otoya matindo tindo mi onega chuth.
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

kikuyu: Wiye ok tek, ok odwar mare kende, iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo ok omak sadha.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

kikuyu: To gi e kindeno, Abisalom gi jo-Israel nobiro Jerusalem to Ahithofel ne ni kode.
english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

kikuyu: Dhakono wuodhe ne ok ber, omiyo noweyo ngʼatno modok dalagi e od wuon mare Bethlehem e piny Juda. Bangʼ kane osebedo kuno kuom dweche angʼwen,
english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

kikuyu: Ol mirimbi kuom ogendini ma ok ongʼeyi, kuom ji ma ok luong nyingi. Nimar gisetieko Jakobo; gisetieke chuth kendo giseketho dalane.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

kikuyu: Eka Abishai wuod Zeruya nowachone ruoth niya, “Guok mothoni to kwongʼo ruodha nangʼo? We adhi angʼad ngʼute oko.”
english: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”

kikuyu: “Pinje mondo owakre, gichom Holo mar Jehoshafat, nikech anabed kanyo mondo angʼad bura ne pinje duto moa koni gi koni.
english: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

kikuyu: Otingʼo jachan malo kogolo e buru kendo otingʼo ngʼama odhier malo kogolo e ipidh yugi; omiyo gibedo kaachiel gi yawuot ruodhi bende omiyo gibedoe kombe moyiedhi. “Nimar mise mag piny gin mag Jehova Nyasaye, kanyo ema oserenjoe piny ngima.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s. He has set the world on them.

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ podho, ji nokelo ne Yesu ji duto mane nigi tuoche mopogore opogore, kendo noketo lwetene kuom moro ka moro, mochangogi.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

kikuyu: to ok apar ni an chien ahinya moloyo “joote” moko ma uparo ni dongogo!
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

kikuyu: Neginego jo-Amalek mane otony odongʼ kendo pod gidak kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

kikuyu: Anarwake gi law mar duongʼ kendo anatwe okanda e nungone mi anamiye loch mari. Enobed wuon joma odak Jerusalem kod Juda.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Winjeuru kaka nende aleko:
english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

kikuyu: nyikwa Finehas, Gershom; nyikwa Ithamar, Daniel; nyikwa Daudi, Hatush
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

kikuyu: To ka wuodini, moseketho gigegi gi mon ma jochode ka obiro dala, to iyangʼone nyarwath machwe!’
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

kikuyu: Ngʼat madonjo koluwo dhorangach e jakwadh rombe.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

kikuyu: kopodho moweyo yie margi, to ok nyal konygi mi gilokre kendo, nikech gikelo chandruok kuomgi giwegi kuom guro Wuod Nyasaye e msalaba nyadiriyo, ka gimiyo ji chaye ratiro.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

kikuyu: Timbe mamono e chiembgi ma gichamo, to timbe ja-mahundu e divai ma gimadho.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

kikuyu: Ka dichwo kata dhako nigi kido marachar e dende,
english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

kikuyu: Bende noloso agulni gi opewni kod tewni mag kiro remo. Kamano Huram notieko tich duto mane otimo ne Ruoth Solomon e hekalu mar Nyasaye. Ne gin:
english: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

kikuyu: To jatich Ruoth ok owinjore bed makwiny, to onego obed mangʼwon gi ji duto kendo onego obed japuonj molony ma hore mos.
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

kikuyu: Eka jo-Babulon nodwogi kendo ginimonj dala maduongʼni; ginikawe kendo wangʼe pep.’
english: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.”’

kikuyu: E kindeno gibiro luongo Jerusalem ni Kom Loch mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ogendini duto nochokre ei Jerusalem mondo omi nying Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ. Ok ginichak gitim tim wich teko, bende ok ginibed gi chuny mar timo richo.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The LORD’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the LORD’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

kikuyu: Chiayo moyud kotho kende kata ma ondiegi onego kik gicham bore to boreno inyalo tigo e yo moro amora.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

kikuyu: Luor miluorogo Nyasaye dak koro miyi chir koso ngimani moriere dak koro miyi geno?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

kikuyu: Nobedo muofu kuom ndalo adek, kendo ne ok ochiemo kata madho gimoro.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nochiwgi e lwetu, kowito riekogi nyaka ginirum duto.
english: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

kikuyu: Un jo-Israel nyaka udagi e kiche kuom ndalo abiriyo,
english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

kikuyu: To koro in dhano adhanani mingʼado bura ni joma timo gik ma in bende itimo, iparo ni Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ni jogo to in to itony?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

kikuyu: Bende jodong ruoth duto osebiro mondo opwo ruodhwa Daudi kagiwacho ni, ‘Mad Nyasachi ket nying Solomon bed gi huma moloyo mari kendo kom ruodhe dok maduongʼ moloyo mari!’ Kendo ruoth nokulore e kitandane kamiye duongʼ
english: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

kikuyu: Sirni ariyo, agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni; thiwni ariyo mane okedgo gik machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni;
english: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

kikuyu: Nikech ringruok ok olos gi fuoni achiel, to olose gi fuonde mangʼeny.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo Jerusalem gi oganda maduongʼ, ngamia motingʼo gik mangʼwe ngʼar, dhahabu mogundho kod kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek nobiro ir Solomon kendo owuoyo kode kuom gik moko duto mane nitie e pache.
english: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

kikuyu: An osiep ji duto moluori, jogo duto moluwo yoreni.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Aonge wichkuot kuom Injilini, nikech en e teko mar Nyasaye makelo ni ngʼato angʼata moyie warruok, mokwongo ni jo-Yahudi, eka bangʼe ni joma ok jo-Yahudi bende.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

kikuyu: To kuom tamruok mari kod chunyi midagi loko, ikuno mirima mager, ne in iwuon ne odiechieng mirimb Nyasaye, ma buche makare noelie.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

kikuyu: Bende nowacho niya, “Kel ane nanga mibakorigono ipedhnago piny kae.” Kane Ruth osetimo kamano, Boaz noolo gorogoro auchiel mag shairi morieyo e wiye. Bangʼ mano ne oa, modok dalagi.
english: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo e tongʼ piny Musia, ne gitemo mondo gidonj e piny Bithinia, to Roho mar Yesu ne ok oyienigi timo mano.
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ji choko fedha, mula, chuma kod nyinyo mopogore opogore e karaya mondo olenygi gi mach mager e kendo, e kaka abiro chokou ka iya owangʼ kendo ka an gi mirima mager mi aketu ei dala maduongʼ kendo atieku kanyo.
english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.

kikuyu: To un wasumbini winjuru ruodhiu kendo migiuru luor. Kik uluor mana ruodhi mabeyo ma ok kwiny kodu, to luoruru koda mago makwiny kodu.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

kikuyu: Weuru kuonde motimo ongoro gi miechgi mondo ogo koko; kendo weuru joma odak e gwenge mag Kedar obed mamor. Weuru joma odak Sela ower gi mor, ka gikok ewi got malo.
english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

kikuyu: Ne wakwangʼ waa kanyo nyaka wachopo Sirakusa, kendo kuno ne wabede kuom ndalo adek.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

kikuyu: ne ogwedhogi, kendo negidoko ji mangʼeny ahinya, bende ne ok oyie mondo jambgi odog piny.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

kikuyu: Wach ni in nyamera, mondo mi gitimna maber kendo ngimana obedie nikech in.”
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

kikuyu: piny biro bedo girkeni mar joma Jehova Nyasaye ogwedho, to joma okwongʼo ibiro ngʼad kargi oko.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Eka ogendini modongʼ molworou nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asegero gik mane omuki, kendo an ema asechako akomo puothe mane odongʼ mbora. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuoyo kamano, kendo abiro timo gima awacho.’
english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

kikuyu: Kane ochopo mi oneno kaka ngʼwono Nyasaye ne tiyo kuom jogo, nomor ahinya, kendo nojiwogi duto mondo gisiki kuom Ruoth gadiera kendo gi chunygi duto.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

kikuyu: Ere kaka dhano difweny rieko? Otut moyombowa, kendo otek modhierowa winjo.
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

kikuyu: “Harun nyaka chiw rwath mondo otimgo misango mar golo richone owuon kopwodhorego kaachiel gi joode, kendo noyangʼ rwadhno mondo obed kaka misango mar golo richone owuon.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

kikuyu: To e dieru kik winjre ni nitie terruok kata kit dwanyruok moro amora, kata wuoro, nikech gik ma kamago ok owinjore jomaler moluwo Nyasaye otim.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

kikuyu: Tim kamano bende ne pundane, kata lawe kata gire moro amora molal kendo kik ichal ngʼama ok oneno.
english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne ok gichiko itgi kata winja; tokgi ne tek ta ma ok ginyal winjo wach kata winjo puonj.
english: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

kikuyu: Chula ka chula nolal nono kendo gode duto bende nolal kamano.
english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

kikuyu: In iwuon ema asekethoni kendo asetimo richo e nyim wangʼi, mano omiyo in kare ka iwuoyo kendo iwacho adiera ka ingʼadona bura.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

kikuyu: Solomon noorone Hiram ruodh Turo wach niya, “Orna yiend sida kaka ne iorone wuora Daudi sida mane ogerogo ode mar dak.
english: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

kikuyu: Mich mar Nyasaye ok chal gi timo richo. Nikech ka ji mangʼeny notho nikech timo richo mar ngʼat achiel, to nobedo maber manade ka ngʼwono mar Nyasaye kod mich manobiro kuom ngʼwono mar ngʼat achielno, ma en Yesu Kristo, nochiw mogundho ni ji mangʼeny.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

kikuyu: Nogero dalano kolwore gi ohinga, to Joab to noloso kuonde mamoko mag dala mane okethore.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi mochungʼ e nyim Elisha ruodhe. Elisha openje niya, “Gehazi, ia kanye?” En to nodwoke ni, Jatichni ne ok odhi kamoro.
english: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”

kikuyu: mondo irit Chikni ma ok iketho bende ma ok irem nyaka chop Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo fwenyre
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Koro Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nosechiwo chike kuom Jeremia kokalo kuom Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny mar piny kowacho ni:
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: E kindeno Ahazia wuod Ahab nowacho ni Jehoshafat niya, “Yie iwe joga okwangʼ gi jogi, to Jehoshafat nodagi.”
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

kikuyu: We mondo giketgi e lwet joma otelo ne gedo mar hekalu, kendo mondo jogi ochul joma loso kuonde momukore mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of the LORD’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in the LORD’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “An Jehova Nyasaye mangima akwongʼora ni kata ne bed ni in Jehoyakin wuod Jehoyakim ruodh Juda, ni in e tere manie lweta ma korachwich, to pod dawuodhi oko.
english: “As I live,” says the LORD, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.

kikuyu: Joka Reuben nogero Heshbon, Eleale kod Kiriathaim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: mane ochoko kogolo e pinje, kochakore wuok chiengʼ gi podho chiengʼ, nyaka nyandwat gi milambo.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

kikuyu: Ne oyale angʼaya kendo nongʼadne bura molal kode. To en ngʼa manyalo wuoyo kuom gunde? Nimar nogole e piny joma ngima, kendo nolal kode nikech richo mag jowa.
english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

kikuyu: Mano bende kaka lep en fuoni matin nono e dend dhano, to onyalo sungore miwuoro. Parie kaka pilni mach matin nono nyalo moko mach mi wangʼ bungu maduongʼ!
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

kikuyu: Mano e hono mar ariyo mane Yesu otimo, ka nodonjo Galili koa Judea.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

kikuyu: “Dhi mondo inyis Hezekia ma jatend joga ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Daudi kwaru wacho: Asewinjo lemoni kendo aseneno pi wangʼi omiyo abiro changi. E odiechiengʼ mar adek kochakore sani, ibiro dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Giniked gi Nyarombo, to Nyarombo nologi nikech en e Jaloch mar joloch, kendo Ruoth mar ruodhi, to jogo mane obed kode, gin joge moluongi, joma oyier gi jogo maluwe gadiera.”
english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

kikuyu: Aora mamiyo puodho bedo mangʼich ne mol koa Eden; kendo koa kanyo to aorano ne pogore nyadingʼwen.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

kikuyu: Rituru chike ma amiyou kawuono. Abiro riembo oko e nyimu jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus.
english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

kikuyu: “Koro ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Angʼo momiyo ukelo masira malich kuomu ka uweyo chwo gi mon, rawere gi nyithindo mayom, makoro onge joma otony koa kuom jo-Juda?
english: “Therefore now the LORD, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the middle of Judah, to leave yourselves no one remaining,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto ne ochan nying-gi e ndiko mar nonro mar anywolagi e kitap ruodhi mag Israel. Oganda mar Juda ne oter e twech Babulon nikech ne ok gibedo jo-ratiro.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

kikuyu: moro amora mochwe kata motwangʼ, pien moro amora kata gimoro amora molos gi pien
english: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

kikuyu: To joma muol piny biro bedo margi kendo gibiro winjo maber ka gin gi kwe maduongʼ.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
