kikuyu: Piny joma otho ok opondo ne Nyasaye; kendo onge gima nyalo mone nene.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

kikuyu: Koro oruru wach piyo piyo mondo unyis Daudi ni, ‘Kik inindi e dho wath manie thim; to nyaka ingʼadi idhi loka machielo nono to ruoth gi joma ni kode notieki.’ ”
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

kikuyu: “Kane ingʼicho, yaye ruoth, to ne ineno e nyimi kido moro maduongʼ marieny kendo malich kineno.
english: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne Harun niya, “Kaw nyarwath mondo itimgo misango mar golo richo kendo ikaw im mondo itimgo misango miwangʼo pep, jamnigo nyaka bed maonge songa kendo ichiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ebed-Melek nowuok oa e kar dak ruoth kendo owachone ni,
english: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

kikuyu: Eka askeche moko nopenje niya, “To en angʼo mowinjore watim.” Nodwokogi niya, “Kik uma ngʼato pesa githuon kata donjo ne ji gi miriambo to misara maru muyudo mondo oromu.”
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

kikuyu: Yesu nokecho ngʼatno morieyo bade momule, kowacho niya, “Ayie, pwodhri!”
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

kikuyu: Jehoyakin ruodh Juda, min mare, jotende jodonge kod jongʼadne rieko duto nochiwore e lwet ruodh Babulon. Jehoyakin noket e twech e higa mar aboro mar Loch ruodh Babulon.
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

kikuyu: Anakete motegno e oda kendo kuom pinyruodhe nyaka chiengʼ, lochne nogur motegno manyaka chiengʼ.’ ”
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

kikuyu: Nyasaye en ngʼama kare omiyo obiro kumo joma sandou,
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachone jo-Juda kod Jerusalem: “Pururu puotheu mag mbora kendo kik ukom e kind kuthe.
english: For the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

kikuyu: Kane Nyasaye ooro Jatichne, to noore mokwongo ne un, mondo ogwedhu, ka oloko ngʼato ka ngʼato weyo yorene maricho.”
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

kikuyu: Kaka guok dok e ngʼokne mosengʼogo e kaka ngʼat mofuwo nwoyo fupe.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo joma lamo Satan, maluongore ni gin jo-Yahudi to ok gin. Jogi gin jomiriambo. Abiro chunogi mondo gipodhi e tiendu eka gingʼe ni aherou.
english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

kikuyu: Koro dhiyo. Aori ir Farao mondo igol joga ma jo-Israel e piny Misri.”
english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Kendo Jeftha nokwongʼore ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ka inichiw jo-Amon e lweta,
english: Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

kikuyu: Otamo lwete mondo kik otim richo kendo ok okaw asoya kata ohala mokalo tongʼ. Orito chikena kendo oluwo buchena. Ok obi tho nikech richo wuon mare to obiro bedo mangima kuom adier.
english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

kikuyu: Eka jodongo manie dala machiegni kod ringre ngʼatno nokaw nyaroya mapok otiyo, kata mapok otwe e jok,
english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

kikuyu: E ndalo ma Herode ne ruodh Judea, ne nitie jadolo ma nyinge Zekaria, ma ne en achiel kuom oganda jodolo mag Abija; chiege Elizabeth bende ne nyar dhood Harun.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Jachwoyo gi jaol pi nigi thoro machalre, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi noyud pokne kaluwore gi tichne.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ucham ringʼo motimo remo. “ ‘Kik ukor wach kata kik ubed ajuoke mag nyakalondo.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni, “Kata sani, dwoguru ira gi chunyu duto, ka uriyo kech kendo uywak kendo udengo.”
english: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”

kikuyu: E ndalo kayo ngano, Reuben nodhi e puothe kendo noyudo olembe mag mandrake, mi nokelo ne Lea min mare. Rael nowacho ne Lea niya, “Kiyie to miya olemb mandrake ma wuodi Reuben okelonino.”
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

kikuyu: Beduru joma oyie kawo nyawo mar jowadgi kendo ka weyo ni nyawadgi kethone. Weneuru ji richogi kaka Ruoth bende noweyonu richou.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

kikuyu: Negichopo Kapernaum, kendo ka koro ne en e ot, nopenjogi niya, “Wach angʼo mane ugoyoe mbaka e yo?”
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

kikuyu: kane gin e holo machiegni gi Beth Peor man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan, e piny Sihon ruodh jo-Amor mane nigi loch Heshbon kendo ne oloye gi Musa kod jo-Israel kane giwuok Misri.
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Mi wasika olingʼ thi, nikech herani ma ok rem; tiek joma kedo koda duto nimar an jatichni.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

kikuyu: mi nowachone niya, “Nyaka karangʼo mibiro siko kimer?” We metho.
english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Musa nokawogi e lwetgi kendo nowangʼogi kaachiel gi misango miwangʼo pep e kendo mar misango kaka misango miwalogo jodolo. En misango miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ahaz ne wuon Jada, Jada ne wuon Alemeth, Azmaveth kod Zimri ne wuon Moza.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Jaduongʼ ne wabiro ka mokwongo ngʼiewo cham.
english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoko niya. “Ok kamano ngangʼ!” Eka nomulo it ngʼatno kendo nochange.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

kikuyu: kapok aloso ne Jehova Nyasaye kare, kapok ayudo ne Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo kar dak.”
english: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato oromo gi nyako ma osetimo winjruok gi ngʼato mar kend mi omake githuon moterore kode, ngʼatno ema nyaka negi.
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ei masichena naluongo Jehova Nyasaye kendo nodwoka. Ei bur matut ne aywak mondo ikonya mane iwinjo ywakna.
english: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

kikuyu: Kik uwuog e dho Hemb Romo kuom ndalo abiriyo, nyaka kinde ma iwalougo rum nikech walou biro kawo ndalo abiriyo.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye chiegni gi joma chunygi otur kendo oreso joma chunygi muol.
english: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

kikuyu: Ibiro miyo duongʼ ma an-go medore kendo ibiro chako ihoya kendo.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

kikuyu: Ndiko dichop kare nade mawacho ni gigo nyaka timre kaka gitimore sani?”
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

kikuyu: Ka odich otiyo yo nyandwat, to ok anene; to ka olokore ochomo yo milambo to kuno bende ok anyal nene.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

kikuyu: Teguru bede mayom yom, rieuru chong monyosore;
english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: To odiechieng Ruoth nobi apoya mana kaka jakuo. Polo noleny nono ka mor matek kendo gik mochwe manie kor polo nowangʼ mi keth chuth, to piny gi gik moko duto manie iye nolal nono.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

kikuyu: “Yaye polo bed mamor kuom kethne. Un jomaler mag Nyasaye gi joote kod jonabi, beduru mamor! Nyasaye osengʼadone bura kendo kume nikech timbe mane otimonu.”
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

kikuyu: nowacho ni Nathan janabi niya, “Koro anto adak e od ruoth moger gi yiend sida, to Sandug muma mar Nyasaye to osiko e hema.”
english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

kikuyu: To kata Tito, mane ni koda, ne ochun mondo oter nyangu, kata obedo ni ne en ja-Yunani.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

kikuyu: Wachne dhood Israel ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho: Achiegni ketho kara maler mar lemo ma en kama sungau nitie, momako wengeu, kendo muhero gi lala. Yawuotu gi nyiu muweyo chien biro podho e dho ligangla.
english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

kikuyu: “Kata kapo ni aoro dera e pinyno kendo aolo mirimba kuome, ka anego ji gi le duto modakie,
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

kikuyu: “En angʼo midwaro timo kodwa, Yesu ja-Nazareth? Isebiro mondo itiekwa koso? Angʼeyo ngʼama in, in Ngʼat Maler Mar Nyasaye!”
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Min Jakobo nonyise niya, “Wuoda, we mondo kwongʼno omaka, in to tim mana gima awacho; dhiyo kendo ikelnagi.”
english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

kikuyu: Nogolo kido mar farese mane ruodhi mag Juda oseketone wangʼ chiengʼ e dhoranga hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ne gin e laru mantie machiegni gi od jatelo ma nyinge Nathan-Melek. Bangʼ mano Josia nowangʼo geche mane itiyogo kuom lamo wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of the LORD’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

kikuyu: Gikanyono Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa, Harun kod Miriam niya, “Wuoguru oko e Hemb Romo karu ji adekgo.” Omiyo giduto ne giwuok oko.
english: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

kikuyu: nimar en okumba mar joma kare kendo orito yor joge ma jo-adiera.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

kikuyu: Solomon nochiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye misengini miwangʼo pep e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye mane ogero e nyim agola,
english: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,

kikuyu: Kuom mano ogandano nongʼur ne Musa kawacho niya, “Wabiro modho angʼo?”
english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

kikuyu: Kane gisechokore kanyakla Mizpa ne giumbo pi mi gipuko e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Odiechiengno negitweyo chiemo ka gihulo richo kagiwacho niya, “Waseketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.” Kendo Samuel nobedo jatend Israel e piny Mizpa.
english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against the LORD.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

kikuyu: Abram nokelone magi duto, nongʼadogi diriyo moro ka moro kendo okelo nusegi moro ka moro omanyore gi wadgi, to kata kamano, winy ne ok ongʼado.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

kikuyu: Abram koro nosebedo ja-mwandu ahinya mar jamni gi fedha kod dhahabu.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano asemiyo ojari kendo okuod wiyi e nyim ji duto, nikech ok iseluwo yorega to isedewo wangʼ ji e yore mag chik.”
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Mano ber. Abiro loso winjruok e kinda kodi. To gimoro achiel madwaro kuomi en; kik ibi e nyima ka ok ikelo Mikal nyar Saulo chiengʼ ma ibiro nena.”
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

kikuyu: Daguru e ngima maber e kind jopiny makia Nyasaye mondo kata ka gihangonu ni un joketho to gine mana timbeu mabeyo mi gimi Nyasaye duongʼ chiengʼ ma obiro ngʼadoe bura.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

kikuyu: Jotend oganda ne gin: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zatu, Bani,
english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

kikuyu: Nokwayowa ni, ‘Yienauru ahul kendo achok cham modongʼ e dier tiangʼ moseka ma jokeyo oweyo bangʼ-gi.’ Nodonjo e puodho kendo koro osetiyo ma ok oywe, chakre okinyi nyaka sani, makmana kuom thuolo matin mane oyweyogo ei kiru.”
english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”

kikuyu: Omiyo nowachone niya, “Owadwa, magi to mier machal nadi misemiya?” Kendo nochako kanyo ni Piny Kabul, nying ma pod iluongego nyaka chil kawuono.
english: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

kikuyu: Eka Joab noduogo koa lawo Abner mi ochoko joge duto kanyakla. Ji apar gochiko mag Daudi ne onge ka ok okwan Asahel.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth Rehoboam nochwogo okumbni mag nyinyo mondo oket kar mane okawgo kendo nomiyo jotelo mag jorit mane rito rangach midonjogo e dala ruoth.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko niya, “Bangʼ kinde matin ka asewuok, to abiro lamoni Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kiny lwangʼni nowe Farao, jodonge kod joge. Makmana ni Farao kik chak riambi kotamo jo-Israel dhi timo misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Abiro timo singruok mar kwe kodgi, kendo abiro golo le mager e piny mondo giyud thuolo mar dak e piny motwo kendo ginindi ei bunge kaonge gima giluoro.
english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano noneno dhok abiriyo mamoko maricho modhero kowuok ei aora Nael, kendo kochungʼ e bath mago mabeyo.
english: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik mondo odir jogi e mach mapiyo, kendo liet mar mach kende ema ne onego jolweny mane otero Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego,
english: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

kikuyu: Rebeka bende norango malo moneno Isaka. Nolor piny koa ewi ngamia
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

kikuyu: Ka umiyo Jehova Nyasaye luor kendo kutiyone, ka uwinjo chikne kendo ok ungʼanyone chikene, un kaachiel gi ruodhu ma ritou mi uluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, to mano ber.
english: If you will fear the LORD, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: kendo ne giyanyo Nyasach polo nikech rem mane gin-go gi adhondegi; to kata kamano negitamore lokore weyo richo mane gisetimo.
english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osechungo lochne e polo, kendo lochne orito ji duto.
english: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

kikuyu: Paulo nodonjo e sinagogi mi opuonjo ji gi chir kuom dweche adek. Notemo wuoyo kodgi konyisogi adiera man kuom pinyruodh Nyasaye.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye ne ok oluongowa mondo wadag e ngima mar dwanyruok, to ne oluongowa mondo wadag e ngima maler.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

kikuyu: Kik ichan hinyo jabathi, modak machiegni kodi gi kwe.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

kikuyu: Bende onge kata mana ngʼato achiel kuomgi mabiro neno piny mane asingone kweregi ka akwongʼora. Ngʼato angʼata ma osenyisa achaya ok none pinyno.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth Jeroboam owinjo kaka ngʼat Nyasayeno noywak kokwongʼo kendo mar misango man Bethel norieyo bade kowuok e kendo mar misango kowacho niya, “Makeuru!” To bade mane orieyono kochomo ngʼat Nyasayeno notal mane ok onyal dole.
english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

kikuyu: Andikonu wechegi, un joma oyie kuom nying Wuod Nyasaye, mondo ungʼe ni un gi ngima mochwere.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

kikuyu: Joma ruodhigo wuok e anywola mar jotelo gin johawi kendo ruodhigigo chiemo e sa mowinjore, mondo giyud teko to ok mondo gimer.
english: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

kikuyu: Bende kik wangʼur, kaka moko kuomgi notimo, mi malaika mar tho nonegogi.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

kikuyu: Thoth ji mane ni kanyo nokwere kendo nowachone ni olingʼ thi, to nomedo goyo koko niya, “Wuod Daudi, yie ikecha!”
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Ruoth Herode nowinjo wechegi, nikech nying Yesu koro noselandore mongʼere malach. Jomoko ne wacho kuom Yesu niya, “Johana Ja-batiso osechier oa kuom joma otho, kendo mano emomiyo teko mar timo honni ni e ngimane.”
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

kikuyu: Jou abich nobed gi teko mar riembo ji mia achiel, kendo jou mia achiel nobed gi teko mar riembo ji gana apar, kendo ununeg wasiku.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako timo timbe mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, kendo nikech timno, Jehova Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwet Eglon ruodh Moab.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno ema ne Daudi omiyo Asaf kod jowetene zaburini mar goyo erokamano ni Jehova Nyasaye kama:
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth Darius nondiko chikno mogoyoe sei mar ruoth.
english: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

kikuyu: Josia nonego jodolo duto mag nyiseche milamo kuonde motingʼore gi malo mowangʼogi e kende mag misengini. Bangʼ mano nodok Jerusalem.
english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Abija nochungo e Got Zemaraim e piny gode mag Efraim kowacho niya, “Winjauru in Jeroboam kod jo-Israel duto!
english: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nyaka ket lwete ewi misango mar dherno, kendo oyangʼe e dho Hemb Romo. Eka jodolo ma yawuot Harun nokaw remo, kendo ginikire e bathe kendo mar misango koni gi koni.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Giduto negichiemo mi giyiengʼ, kendo bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo okepe apar gariyo mopongʼ.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Tingʼuru wengeu malo kendo ungʼi polo: En ngʼa manochweyo gigi duto? Donge en ema nomiyo sulwe manie kor polo obetie kokelogi achiel kachiel, koluongo moro ka moro gi nyinge. Onge moro kuomgi molal nikech tekone duongʼ kod nyalone.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.

kikuyu: Negiwuoyo kuom wachni e kindgi giwegi kendo giwacho niya, “Ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa e polo,’ to obiro penjowa ni, ‘Ka en kamano to angʼo momiyo nutamoru yie kuome?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Yieruru jomoko kuomu mondo ka biro to andiknegi barupe mapwodhogigo mondo giter mich muchokogo Jerusalem.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Omiyo negigolo ruodhi abichgo oko mi gikelogi, ne gin ruodh Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish kod Eglon.
english: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Aram osea ne giweyo ka gihinyo Joash malit. Eka jodonge noriworene nikech nek mane onegogo wuod Jehoyada jadolo mi neginege e kitandane. Omiyo notho kendo ne giike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi to ok kar yiko ruodhi.
english: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

kikuyu: (Pinyno bende ne okwan kaka piny jo-Refai mane osebedo kodak kuno, to jo-Amon to ne luongogi ni jo-Zamzumi.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

kikuyu: Ere Jal mane otelonegi nyaka kuonde matut?” Mana ka faras mangʼado thim, ne ok gichwanyore;
english: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

kikuyu: To Mikaya nowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni, anyalo mana nyise gima Jehova Nyasaye owachona.”
english: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”

kikuyu: Nimar abiro miyou weche gi rieko maonge wasiku kata achiel ma biro tamore kata kwero wachuno.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

kikuyu: Israel ne en mzabibu malandore; ne onyago olembene owuon. Ka olembene ne medore, nomedo gero kende mag misango; kendo ka pinye ne medo mewo, to nomedo loso kido milamo.
english: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.

kikuyu: Wangʼ-gi nyiso ni gin joricho kendo richogi oyangore e lela mana ka richo mane ni Sodom, bende gionge gi wichkuot. Yaye, mano kaka ginine malit nikech gisekelo masira kuomgi giwegi.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

kikuyu: To wasigu biro lawo Israel nikech gisekwedo gima ber.
english: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.

kikuyu: Ka ruodhi noriwo teko kanyakla, kane giwuokne oko kaachiel,
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni asekeyogi e dier ogendini, to gibiro para ka gin e pinje maboyogo. Gin kaachiel gi nyithindgi gibiro bedo mangima, kendo gibiro duogo.
english: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

kikuyu: Adiera mari ochwere e tienge duto; mana kaka ne iguro piny mi piny osiko.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

kikuyu: Kanisa mane ni Antiokia notingʼo jonabi gi jopuonj. Ne gin Barnaba gi Simeon miluongo ni Ratengʼ, gi Lukio ja-Kurene, gi Saulo kod Manaen mane odongo gi Herode ma ruoth.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

kikuyu: Noyaro bedene madongo nyaka e Nam Mediterania kendo noloth mochweyo nyaka e Aora Yufrate.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Yaye, tiengʼ maonge gi yie ni, anabed kodu nyaka karangʼo? Keluru ane wuowino.”
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

kikuyu: Nochako wuoyo gi chir e sinagogi, to ka Priskila gi Akula nowinje, ne giluonge e dalagi mine gimedo lerone tiend weche moko kuom yor Nyasaye.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Amazia ne ok odewo, omiyo Jehoash ruodh Israel nomonje. Jehoash kod Amazia ruodh Juda ne joromo e lweny e dala mar Beth Shemesh man Juda.
english: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

kikuyu: Weche mamoko mag loch Zekaria ondiki e kitepe weche mag ruodhi Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Awuoro ahinya kaka uselokoru piyo piyo nono, mi uweyo Jal mane oluongou kuom ngʼwono mar Kristo, kendo koro uluwo Injili mopogore gi mane opuonju,
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

kikuyu: Panda ne chenro maricho mag joma richo, panda ne koko ma oganda matimo marach goyo.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

kikuyu: To e higa mokwongo mar Darius Ja-Median, ne achungʼ motegno mondo akonye kendo arite.)
english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

kikuyu: Omiyo chakre sani koro ok wangʼe ngʼato e yo mapiny ngʼeyogo ji. Kata obedo ni kinde moko ne wangʼeyo Kristo e yo makamano, tinde ok watim kamano kendo.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

kikuyu: kod nyiroke kaachiel gi boche mogawe gi man but oguro kendo inigol jwala mabor manie wi chuny kod nyiroke.
english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

kikuyu: Ka gimadhe, ginibagni kendo ginilokre jonekni nikech ligangla ma abiro oro e kindgi.”
english: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Abisalom obiro e od dhakoni, negipenje niya, “Ere Ahimaz gi Jonathan?” Dhakono nodwoko niya, “Ne gisengʼado aora.” Jogi nodwero to ne ok giyudo ngʼato, mine gidok Jerusalem.
english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Ukoso nikech ukia Ndiko kata teko Nyasaye.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne Jehova Nyasaye ni,
english: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Enolaw bangʼ jochodenego to ok nomakgi; enomanygi to ok noyudgi. Bangʼe to enowachi niya, Abiro dokne chwora mokwongo, nimar ndalono ne awinjo maber moloyo sani.
english: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’

kikuyu: Joshua ne ok owe siemo Ai gi tongʼ mane otingʼo e lwete nyaka Israel notieko ji duto mane odak Ai.
english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

kikuyu: Onge odiechiengʼ machal gi ma manosebetie ma Jehova Nyasaye nowinje kwayo mar dhano. Adier, adier Jehova Nyasaye ne kedo ni jo-Israel!
english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD listened to the voice of a man; for the LORD fought for Israel.

kikuyu: Kata mana jotichna machwo gi mamon, bende naol Roho Maler mara kuomgi ndalono, mi ginikor wach.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nooro jatend jolweny machielo gi jolweny piero abich ir Elija. Jatelono nowachone Elija niya, ngʼat Nyasaye, ruoth wacho ni yie mondo ilor piyo.
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

kikuyu: Nidwogo chien mi ichamo makati kendo imodho pi kama nowachoni ni kik ichiemie kata modhoe pi. Omiyo ringri ok enoyiki e kar yiko mar kwereni.’ ”
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

kikuyu: Abiro chopo singruokga ma asetimo ne Jehova Nyasaye e nyim ji duto,
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,

kikuyu: Nonyisogi niya, “Paruru malongʼo gima utimo, nikech ok ungʼad bura gi nying dhano to ungʼado e nying Jehova Nyasaye man kodu e seche mungʼadoe bura.
english: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for the LORD; and he is with you in the judgment.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Asher: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone Akish niya, “Ka aseyudo ngʼwono e wangʼi, to miya kamoro e achiel kuom mier matindo manie piny, mondo mi adag kuno. Angʼo momiyo jatichni didag kodi e dala maduongʼ mar ruoth?”
english: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”

kikuyu: Uwinjo, ne arito mondi kane uwuoyo, ne achiko ita ne wecheu mukwano ni nigi rieko; kinde mane umanyo weche monego uwachi,
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowachone niya, “An Nyasaye Maratego, nywolri kendo imedri. Ogendini kod dhout ogendini noa kuomi kendo ruodhi nowuog kuomi.
english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

kikuyu: Yath ka yath ma ok nyag olemo maber itongʼo igoyo piny kendo iwito e mach.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

kikuyu: Ne ichiwo Roho mari maber mondo opuonjgi. Ne ok ituonogi manna, kendo ne imiyogi pi kuom riyo mane oloyogi.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ne ia gi ngʼwech, yaye nam? Yaye Jordan, ne idar iweyonegi piny nangʼo?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

kikuyu: Kane gitingʼo wengegi, ne ok gineno ngʼato makmana Yesu kende.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oserieyo bade e nam kendo osemiyo pinyruodhi tetni, bende osegolo chik ne Foenikia mondo otiek gik ma gineno kuomgi.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “To ndalo biro, ma anagoye koko mar lweny mondo oked gi Raba mar jo-Amon; enobed pith mar kethruok, kendo gwenge molworogi nowangʼ. Eka Israel noriemb jogo mane oriembogi,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno anabed gi mirima kodgi mi ajwangʼ-gi, abiro pandonegi wangʼa kendo enotiekgi. Gik mamono kendo maricho notimrenegi kendo odiechiengno ginipenjre ni, ‘Donge masiragi osebiro nikech Nyasachwa ok nikodwa?’
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e wuon polo kata polo man malo manade kaachiel gi piny kod gik moko duto manie iye.
english: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

kikuyu: E dala maduongʼno ngʼat moro modhier man-gi rieko nodakie, kendo noreso dala maduongʼno gi riekoneno. To onge ngʼama noparo ngʼama odhierno.
english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni nitie ngʼato manyalo bedo jathek e kinda gi Nyasaye, kata ngʼato manyalo ngʼado bura e kinda kode,
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

kikuyu: Giniwuoth e piny koni gi koni ka gimenyo, to ka ngʼato kuomgi oneno chok dhano; to enochung ranyisi moro bute, mondo jokuny liete onene maber kendo oike e Holo mar Hamon Gog.
english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

kikuyu: Koro singrina gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ni ok ningʼad nyikwaya kata rucho nyinga oko e od wuora.”
english: Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

kikuyu: Omiyo dhakono nodhi moloro dhoot ka en kaachiel gi yawuote. Negigemone agulni kendo en to nosiko kopongʼogi gi mo.
english: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

kikuyu: Nomiyo moro ka moro kuomgi law manyien to Benjamin nomiyo fedha mapekgi oromo kilo mia adek kod lewni mopogore opogore abich.
english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

kikuyu: Magi e kar romb gik moko duto mane otigo kigero Hemb Romo, ma en Hema mar singruok kaka nokwan-gi gi chik mane Musa ogolo ne jo-Lawi kotelnegi gi Ithamar wuod Harun jadolo.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Daniel nodwoko niya, “Onge ngʼama riek moro amora, kata jakor wach kata ajwoga kata ja-nyakalondo manyalo nyiso ruoth tiend midhiero mosepenjoni,
english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane obirone Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye e kinde loch Jehoyakim wuod Josia ma ruodh Juda:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

kikuyu: To bende kata kane ongʼadu kuom yiend Zeituni moti e bungu, ochomu e kor yadh Zeituni mopidhi, ma en gima ok timre pile e yo mayot to donge en gima yot moloyo mondo gin bede yath hie odog ochomgi e kor yadh Zeituni ma margi giwegi.
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

kikuyu: “To enodwokgi ni, ‘Awachonu adier ni, gimoro amora mane ok utimo ne achiel kuom jomatindogi, ne ok utimo ne an.’
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

kikuyu: Kuonde mag kwath ne tin mane ok nyal romogi ka gidak kanyakla, nimar mwandu mane gin-go nomedore mane ok ginyal dak kaachiel.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

kikuyu: Ji piero abiriyogo noduogo kod ilo mi giwacho niya, “Ruoth, nyaka jochiende bende winjowa ka wagologi e nyingi.”
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jomoko kuomgi ne ok odewo wach Musa, negikano moko nyaka okinyi, to negiyudo ka kudni opongʼo chiemono kendo negichako dungʼ. Kuom mano Musa ne iye owangʼ kodgi.
english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

kikuyu: Ka Zedekia ruodh Juda kod jolweny duto nonenogi, negiringo giwuok e dala maduongʼno gotieno ka gikalo e rangach man e kind ohinga ariyo man but puoth ruoth, kendo ka gichomo Araba.
english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

kikuyu: Chiengʼni kik utim tijeu mapile, to chiwuru misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel gi jo-Juda nosudo machiegni negigiyo sigich lweny mi gilawo jo-Filistia nyaka gichopi kama idonjogo Gath nyaka rangeye mag Ekron. Ringre jogi motho nokeyore e yo madhi Sharaim nyaka Gath gi Ekron.
english: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.

kikuyu: Kaachiel kodgi ne gin Heman gi Jeduthun kod joma moko manoyier kendo oluong gi nyingegi mondo gi dwokne Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, “nikech herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.”
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kik iwach niya, “Abiro timone mana kaka osetimona; abiro chulo ngʼatno mana kaka notimona.”
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

kikuyu: kod jogo ma jatich kaachiel kodgi kaka: Shebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanan,
english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

kikuyu: Nathaniel nopenje niya, “Bende gima ber moro amora nyalo aa Nazareth adier?” Filipo nodwoke niya, “Bi mondo ine.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

kikuyu: nikech ukedo lweny nogo mane unena kakedo e kinde mokalo, kendo ma pod uwinjo ni akedo.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

kikuyu: Anamigi chuny ma ok parre, kendo anaket chuny manyien eigi; abiro golo kuomgi chuny matek ka lwanda kendo anachwenegi chuny manyien.
english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

kikuyu: Kane oganda oneno mil polo gi mor polo kendo owinjo ywak turumbete mi gineno ka got otimo iro, luoro nomakogi. Negisudo gichien
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

kikuyu: Koma odok yo nyandwat mar laruno nobed maromo mita piero angʼwen gauchiel kendo nobed gi pasia mongʼaw e sirni piero ariyo kendo morwak e rachungi piero ariyo mag mula; ramaki kod rangʼaw miriwogo kor sirni molos gi fedha.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat wuod Asa nodoko ruodh Juda e higa mar angʼwen mar Ahab ruodh Israel.
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

kikuyu: Yaye Lebanon, yaw dhorangeyeni, mondo mach owangʼ yiendeni mag sida!
english: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero abiriyo gabich
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

kikuyu: Reswa kendo konywa gi lweti ma korachwich mondo joma ihero ogol e chandruok.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowacho ni yadhno niya, “Ngʼato kik chak cham olemo mowuok kuomi kendo.” Jopuonjrene nowinje kowacho kamano.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ne ok giyudo ketho moro kuome ma dine mi nege, ne gikwayo Pilato mondo ochiwe mondo onege.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

kikuyu: uringo kudhi Misri ka ok upenja, umanyo kony kuom Farao mondo oresu, kendo ugengʼoru e tipo mar Misri kaka karu mar pondo.
english: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

kikuyu: to wuon burno nyaka chul kuom lalno; kendo nyaka ochul wuon gigi kendo jamni mothogo nobed mage.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

kikuyu: Kane gigwedho od Nyasaye negichiwo rwedhi mia achiel, imbe mia ariyo, nyithi rombe machwo mia angʼwen to kaka misango mar golo richo ne Israel, negichiwo diek apar gariyo machwo, moro ka moro ni dhout Israel.
english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: An to nadwoke niya, “Jaduongʼ in ema ingʼeyo, an ok angʼeyo.” Eka nowachona niya, “Jogi e joma owuok koa e sand mager; giselwoko kandhegi matar gi remb Nyarombo.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

kikuyu: Dhiuru, un joga, donjuru e uteu kendo loruru dhoutu, ponduru kuom ndalo matin nyaka ndalo mar mirimbe kal.
english: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

kikuyu: Omiyo Yesu nowuok modhi kode. Oganda maduongʼ ne luwo bangʼ Yesu kothungʼe koni gi koni.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

kikuyu: Noketo jongʼad bura e piny, e mier duto madongo mag Juda mochiel gohinga.
english: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

kikuyu: Eka anawach gie chunya niya, “Chunya in-gi gik mangʼeny mabeyo misekano moromi kuom higni mangʼeny. Koro ywe, chiem, methi kendo bed mamor.” ’
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

kikuyu: To koro, yaye Nyasach Israel, yie wach mane isingo ni jatichni Daudi wuora otimre mana kaka ne isingo.
english: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

kikuyu: wuod Joanan, wuod Resa, wuod Zerubabel, wuod Shealtiel, wuod Ner,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

kikuyu: Anaidh malo moyombo boche polo; kendo anachal gi Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo.”
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

kikuyu: Yien-no nodongo maduongʼ kendo motegno, kendo wiye nochopo nyaka e polo, to bende ne inyalo nene e tungʼ piny koni gi koni.
english: The tree grew and was strong. Its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth.

kikuyu: Nikech awinjo ayany mangʼeny ma ji yanyago, kihondko olwora koni gi koni; gikuodho kaka digitimna marach kendo gichano mar kawo ngimana.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

kikuyu: e kinde mane mirima mabebni ka mach omakogi kodwa, to dine gimwonyowa ngili;
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

kikuyu: “To wuowi maduongʼ mirima nomako, kendo notamore donjo e ot. Omiyo wuon mare nowuok oko odhiyo ire kendo nosaye mondo odonji.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

kikuyu: Osetera e od budho mare, kendo herane oliero e wiya ka bendera.
english: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

kikuyu: To Balaam nodwoko jotij Balak niya, “Kata ne bed ni Balak ne omiya kar dakne mopongʼ gi fedha gi dhahabu, to ok anyal timo gimoro amora maduongʼ kata matin makalo chik mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

kikuyu: Adam nochako chiege ni Hawa nikech nobiro bedo min ji duto.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

kikuyu: To Yesu notame kawachone niya, “Dog dala ir joodi mondo inyisgi gik madongo ma Ruoth osetimoni, kendo kaka osekechi gi kech maduongʼ.”
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

kikuyu: En odiechiengʼ ma Ruoth noduogie mondo joge maler omiye duongʼ kendo joma oyie duto omiye luor. Un bende unubed achiel kuom jogo, nikech ne uyie wach mane wakelonu.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

kikuyu: Iseumori gi boche polo mondo lemo moro amora kik chop iri.
english: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nooro wach ni Jesse, kowacho niya, “Yie mondo Daudi obed jatija, nikech amor kode.”
english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nochiko jotend Israel duto mondo okony wuode Solomon.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

kikuyu: Omiyo Wach Nyasaye nomedo landore, kendo kwan jopuonjre mane ni Jerusalem nomedore ahinya, kendo ji mangʼeny kuom jodolo nolokore moluwo yieno.
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

kikuyu: to ibiro dhi thurwa kendo ir wedena mondo iyudne wuoda Isaka dhako.”
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

kikuyu: Gokinyi mangʼich, jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda gi jopuonj Chik, kaachiel gi jobuch Sanhedrin ne joriwo paro kuom gima nowinjore gitim. Negitweyo Yesu mi gitere e nyim Pilato.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

kikuyu: Kik utem Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kaka ne uteme ka un Masa.
english: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai kod jogo molony e chik nodagi dwaro mar Nyasaye kuomgi giwegi, nikech ne pok obatisgi gi Johana.)
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

kikuyu: jonon pinygo noneno ngʼato ka wuok e dala maduongʼ kendo negiwachone niya, “Kinyiswa e yo midonjogo e dala cha to ok wabi yie mondo gimoro otimi.”
english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

kikuyu: Hiram ruodh Turo nodwoko Solomon gi baruwa kowacho: “Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ohero joge oseketi idoko ruodhgi.”
english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

kikuyu: E sa mane gilwore mar abiriyo ka jodolo ne pod goyo turumbete matek, Joshua nochiko ji kawacho niya, “Koguru matek, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou dala maduongʼni!
english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for the LORD has given you the city!

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Wasigu biro monjou maketh kuondeu mochiel motegno, kendo giyak mwandu magu.”
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

kikuyu: “Kata obedo ni richo mitne e dhoge mopando moko e lembe,
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Israel duto, asechiwo jo-Lawi kaka mich ne Harun gi yawuote mondo giti tij lemo e Hemb Romo e lo jo-Israel kendo mondo gikelnegi resruok kuom masira manyalo mako jo-Israel ka gisudo machiegni gi kama ler mar lemo.”
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Chuny Farao pod tek, odagi weyo joga mondo odhi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, joma odak e dala momukore e piny Israel wacho ni, ‘Ibrahim ne en mana ngʼat achiel kende, to kata kamano nokawo piny. To wan wangʼeny, omiyo koro osemiwa pinyni kaka girkeni.’
english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

kikuyu: Kik bedni matek weyo misumbani thuolo nimar higni auchiel mosebedo oromo chudo nyadiriyo maromre kod ngʼatno ma biro tiyoni ndalo. Kitimo kamano to Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi nogwedh gik moko duto mitimo.
english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.

kikuyu: ‘Ka gima rach ogore kuomwa, bed ni en kum gi ligangla kata dera mar tho kata kech, to wabiro chungʼ e nyimi e hekaluni miluongo gi Nyingi kendo wanaywagreni nikech masirani, kendo iniwinjwa mi ireswa.’
english: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

kikuyu: Wayie kendo wangʼeyo ni in e Ngʼama Ler mar Nyasaye.”
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Ka un joma kare, weuru achiel kuomu odongʼ ka, to joma odongʼ to odhiyo kendo oter cham ne joodu makoro chandore ka.
english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

kikuyu: Negineno malich nikech chan gi kech mane gin-go kendo ne gidangʼni koni gi koni gotieno e piny motwo, kendo e piny mokethore modongʼ gunda.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

kikuyu: Jokwath onge rieko to bende ok gipenj Jehova Nyasaye wach; mano emomiyo ok gidhi nyime maber kendo rombe mag-gi duto oke.
english: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo manok Yesu nochako odwogo e dala mar Kapernaum, kendo ji nowinjo ni osebiro dala.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisengʼado aora Jordan, negibuoro machiegni gi Aroer, man yo milambo mar dala manie geng holo, eka negikadho Gad ma gidhi nyaka Jazer.
english: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo joge onya ahinya; nomiyo gibedo mathoth ma wasikgi ne ok nyal nyalogi,
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

kikuyu: Saulo nopenjo niya, “In ngʼa, Ruoth?” Nodwoke niya, “An Yesu ma isando.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: Unupidh cham to ok unukagi; ubiro biyo zeituni to ok unukonyru gi modhigi un uwegi, bende ubiro biyo mzabibu to ok unumadh divai mag-gi.
english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe ka Harun osetieko pwodho Kama Ler Moloyo gi Hemb Romo kod kendo mar misango, to nokel diel mangima.
english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

kikuyu: To ka ok usebedo jo-adiera gi mwandu ngʼat machielo, en ngʼat mane madimiu mwandu ma maru uwegi?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

kikuyu: Ruoth wuoyo kaka chik mar Nyasaye dwaro, to dhoge ok onego ndhog bura makare.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

kikuyu: wakuyo, to wasiko wamor amora, wadhier, to wamiyo ji mathoth bedo jo-mwandu, wanenore ka gima waonge gimoro, to kare wan ema wan gi gik moko duto.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. In ema aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Lwandana; kik itamri winjo ywakna. Nikech ka isiko ilingʼ alingʼa, to abiro chalo gi joma osedhi e bur.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: e kaka in bende ilawgi gi ahiti maduongʼ kendo ibwog-gi gi yambi makudho matek.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: To negisiko gikwaye mondo kik ochikgi gidhiyo e Bur Matut Maonge Gikone.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

kikuyu: Masiche malich ogoye gi kihondko, gigi duto omake, mana ka ruoth moikore mar dhi e lweny,
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

kikuyu: E kindeno Israel ne onge ruoth; kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato ne timo kaka ohero.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

kikuyu: “ ‘Anakaw nyak mag-gi. Onge olemo manobedi e mzabibu. Onge olemb ngʼowu manobedi ewi yath, kendo itgi noner. Gima asemiyogi nomagi.’ ” An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kamano.
english: “‘I will utterly consume them, says the LORD. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”

kikuyu: Kuom nyikwa jodolo, magi ema nokendo nyi joma ok jo-Yahudi. Koa e nyikwa Jeshua wuod Jozadak, kod owetene: Maseya, Eliezer, Jarib gi Gedalia.
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

kikuyu: Koro e yo kane odhiyo Jerusalem, Yesu nowuotho e kind Samaria gi Galili.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

kikuyu: Chak wuoth idhi Padan Aram, e od Bethuel ma kwaru. Kend achiel kuom nyi Laban ma neru.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

kikuyu: Anagwedh jogo ma gwedhi kendo anakwongʼ jogo makwongʼi, kendo ogendini duto manie piny nogwedhi nikech in.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

kikuyu: Anageru kendo to bende enogeru, yaye Israel ma nyako ngili. Bende unugo nyiduongeu kendo, mi udhi oko ma umiel gi ilo.
english: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi, mane iluongo ni Agaba nochungʼ mokoro wach kuom Roho, ni kech marach ne biro landore mi kwak piny Rumi duto. Kejni nobet e kinde loch Klaudio.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo ochwoyo kodhi, kodhi moko nolwar e dir yo, kendo winy nobiro mochamogi duto.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

kikuyu: Noresa e lwet jasika maratego, kuom jowasika, mane tek moloya.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

kikuyu: “Napenjo ni, ‘In ngʼa, Ruoth?’ “To nodwoka ni, ‘An Yesu ja-Nazareth, ma isando.’
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

kikuyu: Kuom mano, singruok biro kuom yie eka obedo kuom ngʼwono, kendo nyikwa Ibrahim duto oyud singruokno, to ok ni joma rito chik kende to nyaka joma nigi yie machal gi mar Ibrahim, nikech en e wuonwa duto.
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno moyudo rieko ohero chunye owuon, to ngʼat mohero winjo wach dhi maber.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

kikuyu: Omiyo Naaman nowuok modhi gi farese kod geche mag lweny nyaka e dhood Elisha.
english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Merari kaluwore gi anywola margi, noyudo mier matindo apar gariyo koa e dhood Reuben, Gad kod Zebulun.
english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

kikuyu: “Wachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Ka ji opodho mogore piny donge gia malo? Ka ngʼato oa, donge odwogo?
english: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?

kikuyu: Ka ikonya to anyalo loyo jolweny momonja; ka an gi Nyasacha to anyalo lwenyo ohinga.
english: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

kikuyu: To Barak nodhi nyime gi lawo geche kod jolweny ma ochopo Harosheth Hagoyim. Oganda lweny duto mar Sisera noneg gi ligangla; kendo onge ngʼama notony.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

kikuyu: Ka oganda noneno gima notimore, negipongʼ gi luoro; kendo negipako Nyasaye, ma nosechiwo teko machal kamano ne ji.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

kikuyu: Ndiko machielo bende wacho niya, “Giniket geno margi kuom Jal mane gichwowo gi tongʼ.”
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Lea kod nyithinde nobiro mopodho auma e nyime. Josef gi Rael bende nochopo mopodho auma e nyime.
english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Ma e kum ma ibiro kumogo jo-Misri kod ogendini mamoko ma ok odhi Jerusalem mondo otim Sawo mar Kiche.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Ka ibiro to ikelna lawa mane odongʼ kuom Karpo e dala mar Troa, kod kitepena, to moloyo mago molos gi pien.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

kikuyu: To wangʼ ring rwadhno gi piene kaachiel gi wen oko mar kambi. En misango mar golo richo.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasach nyiseche kendo Ruoth mar ruodhi; Nyasaye maduongʼ malich kendo ratego, ma ok dew wangʼ ngʼato kata kawo asoya.
english: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Yaye, tiengʼ maonge yie kendo mobamni, to nyaka karangʼo ma dabed kodu kendo chandra kodu.” Kel ane wuodi ka.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

kikuyu: “Eka ngʼat mane nigi talanta achiel nobiro, mowacho ni, ‘Ruoth, ne angʼeyo ni in ngʼat makoch, ma keyo kama ne ok ichwoye, kendo ma choko kama ne ok aludoe kodhi.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Onge gima odongʼne makoro onyalo yako; mwandune ok bi siko.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato usne wadgi lowo chuth, nikech lowo en mara, un to un mana joma amiyo lowo kaka wenda kendo jodak.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

kikuyu: Kuom higni piero ariyo gadek, kochakore e higa mar apar gadek mar Josia wuod Amon ruodh Juda nyaka kawuononi, wach Jehova Nyasaye osebirona kendo asewuoyonu pile ka pile, to pod ok uchiko itu.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the LORD’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

kikuyu: Kane Solomon otieko lemo, mach nolwar koa e polo mowangʼo misango miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo hekalu.
english: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the LORD’s glory filled the house.

kikuyu: E tienge duto mabiro nyaka ugol misangoni ne Jehova Nyasaye koa e nyak mokwongo mar lopi.
english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.

kikuyu: kod kio, gi lewni mabeyo gi lewni miliero e ngʼut kod mago miumogo wangʼ.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nobiro koa Teman, Nyasaye Maler moa e got mar Paran. Sela Duongʼne noumo polo, kendo pakne nopongʼo piny.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

kikuyu: Ruodh pinyno nyaka tim kaka ji duto mamoko timo; nyaka odonji ka gidonjo kendo owuogi kagiwuok.
english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

kikuyu: Kane Asa owinjo wechegi to gi koro mar janabi Azaria wuod Oded, notimo chir mogolo nyiseche manono e piny Juda kod Benjamin duto kod mier duto manokawo e gode matindo mag Efraim. Noloso kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye mane okethore mane nitie e nyim agola mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.

kikuyu: (Hermon iluongo ni Sirion gi jo-Sidon, to jo-Amor luonge ni Senir).
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

kikuyu: Eka mondo mi giket genogi kuom Nyasaye kendo kik wigi wil gi gik mosetimo, to mondo girit chikene.
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Kane pod gin e lwanda maduongʼ man Gibeon, Amasa nobiro romo kodgi. Joab norwako lepe mag lweny kendo notweyo okanda e nungone mosoyoe ligangla man e olalo. Kane osudo nyime, ligangla nolwar koa e olalo.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano joote gi jodongo kod kanisa, nongʼado wach mondo giyier jomoko kuomgi gior Antiokia kaachiel gi Paulo kod Barnaba. Ne giyiero Judas ma niluongo ni Barsaba gi Sila, mane gin jotelo e dier owete.
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

kikuyu: To ne atony, kane oketa ei osera, mi olora piny kakadho e otuchi manie kor ohinga.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

kikuyu: Weche mane jonabi okoro bende siro wachni mana kaka ondiki niya,
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

kikuyu: Eka nochopo chiengʼ Makati ma ok oketie Thowi, ma nyarombo mar Pasaka onego negie.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

kikuyu: Sulwe nolwar koa e polo, kendo chwech mag polo noyiengni!’
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Nikech ne owuoyo mi piny nobetie, nogolo chik mi ochungʼ mongirore.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Chiwo mowal mar ngʼato ka ngʼato en mare owuon, ka osechiwe ne jadolo nobed mar jadolo.’ ”
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

kikuyu: Ket chumbi kuom Moab, nimar enotieke; miechgi nodongʼ gunda, maonge ngʼama nodagi eigi.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth mar Nyandwat nomonj bath pinyruoth mar Milambo, to noloye moriembe nyaka e pinye owuon.
english: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

kikuyu: Kik dhogi bed mayot kata kik irikni e chunyi kiwacho, wach moro amora e nyim Nyasaye. Nyasaye ni e polo to in to in e piny, omiyo wechegi onego bed manok.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

kikuyu: jo-Jebus, jo-Amor, jo-Girgash,
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

kikuyu: Gino nochwanyo Ibrahim ahinya nikech wachno neni kuom wuode.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

kikuyu: Nalutora nyaka e tiend gode mag nam kendo piny nouma chuth nyaka chiengʼ. To nigola oko kangima e bur matut, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasacha.
english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.

kikuyu: Lamuru mondo Jerusalem obed gi kwe. Lamuru niya, “Mad joma oheri bed gi kwe.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

kikuyu: Kaw kit chiemo duto monego cham kendo ikan-gi kaka chiembi kod mag-gi.”
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

kikuyu: Bende noketo jorit dhoudi e rangeye mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo ngʼato angʼata ma ok ler kik donji.
english: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of the LORD’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

kikuyu: jo-Arvad, jo-Zemar kod jo-Hamath. (Bangʼe anywola mar jo-Kanaan noke e piny,
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

kikuyu: Jaziz ja-Hagri nochungʼne kweth rombe. Magi duto ne jotelo mane orito mwandu mag Ruoth Daudi.
english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

kikuyu: To ja-Farisai kane oneno ni Yesu ne ok okwongo ologo motelone chiemo, nowuoro.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

kikuyu: Kik iyie ni jogo osungre ni gisenyala, joma obedo wasika maonge gima omiyo; iyie joma ochaya maonge gimoro sigre gi wengegi mar timona marach.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

kikuyu: kendo pi maringo matek dine odhi kodwa.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik uluor, nikech uloyo oyundi nyadi mangʼeny.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: Jeroboam nogero kuonde mitimoe misango mane ni kuonde motingʼore kendo noyiero jodolo kuom ogendini mopogore opogore kata obedo ni ne ok gin jo-Lawi.
english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Musa gi Harun niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni giseusore kendgi e kind ogendini, abiro chokogi kaachiel. Gibiro lal nono kendo enosandgi e bwo loch mar ruoth maratego.
english: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.

kikuyu: “Misri en nyaroya maber neno, to kalabugo birone koa yo nyandwat.
english: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.

kikuyu: Nyaka bed ni usewinjo kaka ne achal kane pod aluwo kit lemo mar jo-Yahudi, kaka ne asando kanisa mar Nyasaye gi gero mokalo apima, kendo ne atemo mondo atieke chuth.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

kikuyu: “Ma e tiend wechegi, moro ka moro: “Mene: Nyasaye osekwano ndaloni mag loch kendo osekele e gikone.
english: “This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.

kikuyu: wuod Kainan, wuod Arfaksad, wuod Shem, wuod Nowa, wuod Lamek,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

kikuyu: Ka awinjo dwond wasika, kendo ka joma timbegi richo okwarona wengegi, nikech gimiyo abedo gi thagruok kendo giyanya ka gin gi mirima.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

kikuyu: Mosreuru, uduto ngʼato gi ngʼato, gi yogruok maler. Kanise duto mag Kristo omosou.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

kikuyu: Ngʼama ochaya, ochayo Wuora bende.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyaka yo nyandwat manie pewe mar Ekron kendo ogomo kochiko Shikeron, mi okalo nyaka Got Baala kendo ochopo Jabnel. Tongʼno nochopo nyaka e nam.
english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

kikuyu: e nyim ketego. Kendo neginywolo nyithindo ma kitgi rabok kod mago ma angʼech gi mago maratengʼ.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato dipuonju Injili machielo mopogore gi mano mane wapuonjou, bed ni en wan, kata malaika moro moa e polo, to mondo okwongʼe nyaka chiengʼ.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Eka naneno malaike abiriyo mochungo e nyim Nyasaye, kendo nomigi turumbete abiriyo.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

kikuyu: To moloyo duto, rit chunyi, nikech en e soko mar ngima.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
