kikuyu: Chunya nodoko maliet e iya kendo kane amedo paro matut, to nomedo bedo malit; eka ne atingʼo dhoga mi awuoyo:
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

kikuyu: Kane Musa osetieko gero hekalu, nogwedhe, kendo owale gi gik moko duto manie iye. Bende nogwedho kendo owalo kar kendo mar misango kod gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono.
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Aonge gi jachien. Wuora ema amiyo duongʼ to un to uchaya.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

kikuyu: Neguru jomadongo gi jomatindo, jotich ma nyiri gi ma yawuowi, mon kod nyithindo, to kik umul ngʼato angʼata man-gi kido e lela wangʼe. Chakuru timo kamano e kara maler mar lemo.” Kuom mano negichako gi jodongo mane ni e nyim hekalu.
english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

kikuyu: Dipo nine ukwana jaketho nikech ne adwokora piny, mondo eka atingʼu malo, kane ayalonu Injili mar Nyasaye ma ok adwaro chudo koa kuomu?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ nolokre mudho to dwe nolokre remo, kapok odiechiengʼ maduongʼ kendo malich mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.

kikuyu: Mani nobednu ranyisi: Ubiro yudo nyathi ma obo gi nengni ka onindo ei sanduku mar chiemb dhok.”
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

kikuyu: Negingʼado bura mondo giland wachni e Israel duto kochakore Bersheba nyaka Dan kagiluongo ji mondo gibi Jerusalem otim Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel nikech ne pok otime gi ji mangʼeny kaka ondiki.
english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

kikuyu: “Kik uchak umi jo-Israel lum magilosogo matafare; to nyaka une ni giomo lum kendgi giwegi.
english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

kikuyu: Nikech Kristo ne ok odonjo kama ler mar lemo ma lwet dhano ema oloso, ma en mana kido mar Kama Ler hie, to nodonjo e polo wuon, kama koro ochungʼnwa e nyim Nyasaye.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

kikuyu: Kane gisengʼado loka komachielo negichopo Genesaret, mi gigowo kanyo.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

kikuyu: Harun nodwoke niya, “Kik ibed gi ich wangʼ ruodha nimar ingʼeyo kaka chuny jogi osiko kopongʼ gi richo.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

kikuyu: Eka ja-Kush nochopo mowacho niya, “Ruodha ma en ruoth, winj wach maber! Jehova Nyasaye oseresi kawuononi e lwet joma piem kodi duto.”
english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

kikuyu: nikech herani osiko kanie chunya kinde duto, kendo asiko kawuotho e adierani.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

kikuyu: Timuru Sawo mar kiche kuom ndalo abiriyo ka usechoko cham moa kar dino bangʼ keyo kod divai mobi.
english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mochamo ringra kendo omadho remba nigi ngima mochwere, kendo abiro chiere chiengʼ giko piny.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Eka ji nowach niya, “Kara en adier ni joma kare pod yudo pok; kara nitie Nyasaye mangʼado bura ne piny.”
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

kikuyu: Joga biro ywayogi kagologi Lebanon nyaka e nam, kendo abiro kwangʼogi gi yie e nam nyaka kama iniwachi. Kanyo abiro pogogi kendo inyalo kawogi. To nyaka itim dwarona ka ichiwo chiemo moromo jooda ma joka ruoth duto.”
english: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

kikuyu: En ngʼat mane e dieru mikwano ni riek kendo ni winjo tiend weche? Ngʼat ma kamano mondo onyis riekone kuom kit ngimane maber kendo kuom timbe motimo gi muolo mawuok kuom rieko ma en-go.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone jatich niya, “Mano ber, bi wadhi.” Omiyo negiwuok ma gidhi e dala kama ngʼat Nyasaye nodakie.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.

kikuyu: Koro yienwa mondo wawach gima okelowa iri, kapok wakethoni seche mangʼeny.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

kikuyu: Kapo ngʼato openjou ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo ugonye?’ Udwoke ni, ‘Ruoth dware.’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne giluto tol motwene kidi e pi, mi giyudo ni tut pigno romo fut mia achiel gi piero ariyo. Bangʼ mano negichako gipime mi ginwangʼo ni en fut piero ochiko.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “An gi sigu kodu. Abiro wangʼo gecheu mag lweny gi mach mawuog iro kendo ligangla biro tieko sibuoche matindo maroteke. Kata ringregi motho ok anawenu e piny. Dwond jooteu ok nowinj kendo.”
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

kikuyu: to iwinji gi e polo kendo itim kaka owinjore. Ngʼad bura e kind jotichni, kikumo joketho kendo iket richogi e wigi bende joma onge ketho iket kare kaluwore gi timgi makare.
english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

kikuyu: Kik icha ruoth kata mana e pachi, kata kwongʼo ja-mwandu kor kachiena, nikech winyo mafuyo e yamo nyalo kawo wecheni, kendo winyo ma fuyono nyalo terone gima iwacho.
english: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro keyou e dier ogendini kendo ji manok kuomu ema notony e kind pinje ma Jehova Nyasaye noterue.
english: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo obed mana kaka ne en kane Nyasaye oluonge.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

kikuyu: Enochung hembene mag lochne e kind nembe e tie got maler ma jaber. Kata kamano gikone nochopi, kendo onge ngʼama nokonye.
english: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiwo jo-Amor ni jo-Israel, Joshua nowachone Jehova Nyasaye e nyim jo-Israel niya, “Yaye wangʼ chiengʼ, chungʼ kar tiendi ewi Gibeon, to in dwe, chungʼ mana ewi holo mar Aijalon.”
english: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

kikuyu: Tinde ere ruodh Hamath, ruodh Arpad, gi ruodh dala maduongʼ mar Sefarvaim, kata ruodh Hena kod Iva?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

kikuyu: Nopodho e tiende, mogore piny; kendo kanyo ema nothoe. Adier, nopodho e tiende, mogore piny; kendo kama nopodhoeno, ema nogore piny motho.
english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nosiru. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mana kaka osechikou, biro kelo luoro kod kibaji e piny duto kamoro amora ma udhiyoe.
english: No man will be able to stand before you. The LORD your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno ma ja-adiera ibiro rito maonge hinyruok, to ngʼatno ma yorene richo biro podho apoya nono.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

kikuyu: to adier, dine gibedo mapek moloyo kwoyo mathoth manie dho nam, mano emomiyo wechena osebedo ka yombore.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

kikuyu: Ngʼat machayo ngʼama timbene richo mokalo tongʼ, to miyo joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ, Ngʼat marito singruok motimo kata bed ni timo kamano hinye,
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata matimo gik ma kamagi mono gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo nikech timbe mamonogi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro riembo ogendini e nyimu.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD. Because of these abominations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

kikuyu: Jogo duto kaachiel gi wedegi ne nigi tiegruok kod lony kuom goyo thum ne Jehova Nyasaye, giduto ne gin ji mia ariyo gi piero aboro gaboro.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho ni Musa niya, “Nyis jo-Israel kama, ‘Un oganda ma tokgi tek. Ka anyalo dhi kodu kata matin, to anyalo tiekou. Koro goluru oko gik mulichogo dendu eka anane gima anyalo timo kodu.’ ”
english: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

kikuyu: wuod Elkana, wuod Joel, wuod Azaria, wuod Zefania,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

kikuyu: To in, Ezra, kaluwore gi rieko matut mar Nyasachi, ma in godo, yier jongʼad bura matindo kod jongʼad bura madongo mondo ongʼad bura gadiera ne jo-Yufrate duto, ma gin joma ongʼeyo chike Nyasachi. Kendo nyaka ipuonj ngʼato angʼata mokia chikego.
english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.

kikuyu: Kamano Joshua noreso Rahab, dhako ma ochot, kaachiel gi anywolane nikech en ema nopando jonon piny mane Joshua ooro Jeriko kendo Rahab nodak e dier jo-Israel nyaka chil kawuono.
english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

kikuyu: Ludh duongʼ ok noa e lwet Juda kata odunga mar teko ok noa e tiende, nyaka wuon loch ma biro rito ogendini duto chopi kendo luor mar ogendini nobed kuome.
english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.

kikuyu: Ka uchulo Jehova Nyasaye chiwo ma upwodhorugo, jo-mwandu kik kel mangʼeny moloyo midwaro, to jachan bende kik kel matin moremo kar midwaro.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.

kikuyu: Koa kuom joka Gershon, ne gin: Ladan kod Shimei.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

kikuyu: Eka achudhe nopiyo e ringʼogo, to Abram noriembogi.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

kikuyu: Kendo ne wadwoke ni, ‘Wan kod wuonwa to oti, kendo nitie wuowi matin mane onywolo ka oti. Owadgi wuowino ne osetho kendo en e wuod min-gi kende modongʼ, kendo wuon-gi ohere.’
english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

kikuyu: To achiel kuomgi notongʼo jatij jadolo maduongʼ mi ochodo ite ma korachwich oko.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

kikuyu: Negikawo mwandugi duto, mondgi duto, nyithindgi duto kod gik moko duto mane ni e udi.
english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

kikuyu: kata ka en gi mirima mi ogoye adhongʼ motho, to ngʼatno nonegi; nimar en janek. Owad gi ngʼat monegno noneg janekno koromo kode.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo nyaka waket chunywa kuom mako weche duto mwasewinjo mondo kik waba yo.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

kikuyu: Nochako omako ich, monywolo wuowi moro. Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osemiya wuowi machielo nimar nowinjo ka chwora ok ohera.” Omiyo nochake ni Simeon.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro chwako joge, kendo obiro kecho jotichne.
english: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

kikuyu: Kendo nowachone niya, “An e Jehova Nyasaye manogoloi Ur piny jo-Kaldea mondo amiyigo obed girkeni mari.”
english: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

kikuyu: Kane gichopo machiegni gi Jebus e kinde mag angʼich welo, jatich nowachone ruodhe niya, “Bi, mondo waywe e dala maduongʼ mar Jebus kendo wanind kanyo.”
english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

kikuyu: Ne owuok odhi kendo, mar ariyo, kendo nolamo niya, “Wuora, ka ok nyalre mondo ogol okombeni makmana ka amadhe to dwaroni mondo otimre.”
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

kikuyu: To ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa kuom dhano,’ to waluoro ji nimar giduto gikawo ni Johana ne en janabi.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

kikuyu: Ogandano nodwoke niya, “Wasewinjo e chik ni Kristo biro siko nyaka chiengʼ, ka en kamano, to ikelo wacho nade ni, ‘Wuod Dhano nyaka bi tingʼ malo’? ‘Wuod Dhano’ miwuoyo kuomeno to en ngʼa?”
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

kikuyu: Kinde mane oganda oneno bor polono kochungʼ e dho Hema gin bende negichungʼ mi gilam ka ngʼato ka ngʼato nitie e dho Hembe.
english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

kikuyu: Kapod nowuoyo gi ruoth, Nathan janabi nochopo.
english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

kikuyu: Yawuot Kohath ne gin: Amram, Izhar, Hebron kod Uziel, giduto ne gin ji angʼwen.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

kikuyu: Un thuolo mar chamo ringʼo mongʼiew e chiro ma ok ubedo gi penjo mathoth e chunyu
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

kikuyu: to yie iwinji gie polo lamogi kod kwayogi kendo konygi.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

kikuyu: Kane pod oyudo owuoyo kodgi, Rael nochopo gi romb wuon-gi nikech en ema nokwayogi.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

kikuyu: Kik uyie richo lou, to louru richo gi tim maber.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth ongʼado odhi loka Gilgal, Kimham nongʼado kode. Jolweny duto mag Juda gi nus mar jolweny mag Israel nokowo ruoth kuno.
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

kikuyu: Biye gin chwech ma tekregi tin, to kata kamano gikano chiembgi e ndalo oro;
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

kikuyu: To e ndalono ja-kiragi moro ma nyinge Barabas, ne ni e od twech, kaachiel gi jojiemo mamoko manotwe kuom wach nek kod pingo loch.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

kikuyu: Jehoahaz nonindo moyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike Samaria kendo wuode ma Jehoash nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kapok nyathino odongo mongʼeyo luongo ‘wuonwa’ kata ‘minwa,’ to mwandu duto mag Damaski kaachiel gi gik moyaki mag Samaria notingʼ gi ruodh Asuria.”
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: Ka masira oneko apoya, to pek ma ngʼat makare oyudo ok obadhe.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Hashmona mi gibworo Moseroth.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

kikuyu: Tije motimo gi lwetene nikare kendo beyo kendo buchene duto inyalo geno.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nyalo wacho niya, “Oyiena timo gimoro amora madwaro,” to gik moko duto ma watimo ok kelnwa konyruok. Bende ngʼato nyalo medo wacho niya, “Oyiena timo gimoro amora madwaro,” to ok anyal yie gimoro loka misumbane.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

kikuyu: To dhout jo-Kohath kik donji nikech dipo ka gigoyo wangʼ-gi kuom gik maler mi githo.”
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

kikuyu: Negiwachone Nyasaye ni, ‘Wewa mos!’ En angʼo ma Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nyalo timonwa?
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

kikuyu: Ka otwe ji gi nyiroro, kendo ka oridgi matek gi tonde mag masiche,
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

kikuyu: Jorito mag Israel muofni, giduto gionge rieko; gichalo mana gi guogi mamuol, ma ok nyal giyo; kendo riere piny mi lek, nikech gihero nindo.
english: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

kikuyu: Bende en ema nonego ja-Misri marabet. Kata nobedo ni ja-Misrino ne nigi tongʼ e lwete, Benaya nodhi kedo kode kotingʼo arungu. Noyudho tongʼ e lwet ja-Misrino monege gi tonge owuon.
english: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

kikuyu: Eka yawuot ruodhi duto mag pinje manie dho nam nowuog e kombegi mag loch kendo ginilony lepgi mag loch gi lepgi motwangʼ gi usi mabeyo beyo. Ginibed piny ka gihum nono kendo ka gisiko gitetni, nikech umako dhogi.
english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

kikuyu: Donge en gima ongʼere ne ji duto ni wich maboyo en wichkuot ni dichwo?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: Omiyo koro ok gin ji ariyo, to gin ringruok achiel. Kuom mano, gima Nyasaye oseriwo kaachiel kik dhano moro amora pogi.”
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

kikuyu: Kuom oganda mag Benjamin to ne omi Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth kod Anathoth, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath. Mier mane opog ne anywola Kohath ne gin apar gadek koriwore.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

kikuyu: To ne ok anyal chiko ita ne Balaam, omiyo nogwedhou mogundho, mi nagolou oko e lwete.
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

kikuyu: Eka malaikano nowachona niya, “Ndik kama: Jogo gin joma ogwedhi moluongi e kisera mar Nyarombo!” Bangʼe nomedo wacho niya, “Magi gin weche ma adier mag Nyasaye.”
english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

kikuyu: Gi bungu norom gondiegi kuno, kendo diek mag bungu noywagne jowetegi; kanyo bende gik malich mag otieno noyud kar yweyo.
english: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

kikuyu: Ka koro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyo oweteu kwe kaka ne osesingo, doguru e miechu e piny mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou e bath aora Jordan kocha.
english: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowalo jongʼad bura, mane okonyogi e lwet joma sandogi.
english: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

kikuyu: Bende ne en gi jatich madhako mane odak Shekem, mane onywolone wuowi miluongo ni Abimelek.
english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne wuoyo gi Gehazi jatich ngʼat Nyasaye, kowachone niya, “Nyisa e honni madongo ma Elisha osetimo.”
english: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat makare oloyo, nitie mor maduongʼ, to ka ngʼat marach omi teko mondo otel, ji ringo dhiyo kar pondo.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata maluongo nyingi, kata matemo mondo opadre kuomi, nimar isepandonwa wangʼi kendo ijwangʼowa mabor nikech richo magwa.
english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Dhi ir Farao, nikech asemiyo chunye kaachiel gi chunje jodonge odoko matek mondo mi atim honnigi mag ranyisina e kindgi;
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Daudi nodonjo e hema mobet piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mowacho niya, “An to an ngʼa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, to jooda to gin ngʼa gini momiyo isetimona gigi duto?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

kikuyu: Kuom yie Nyasaye oserito jogo gi tekone nyaka chop warruok moseiki mondo ofweny chiengʼ giko.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Sayun moruru, beduru moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, nikech osemiyou koth mar chwiri e yo makare, asemiyou ngʼidho mogundho, moriwo kodh chwiri kod kodh opon, mana kaka chon.
english: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.

kikuyu: Yoreni ler, yaye Nyasaye. En nyasaye mane maduongʼ kaka Nyasachwa?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

kikuyu: Eka ne ooro farese, geche lweny kod jolweny motegno kuno. Negidhi kuno gotieno ma gilworo dala maduongʼno.
english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo Ahimelek ja-Hiti gi Abishai wuod Zeruya, mowadgi Joab niya, “Ngʼama biro dhi koda mwalo e kambi ir Saulo?” Abishai nowacho niya, “Abiro dhi kodi.”
english: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”

kikuyu: Ka Kristo ne nyalo timo kamano, to mano ne nyalo chune ni otho nyadi mangʼeny nyaka aa chakruok piny. To koro osefwenyore dichiel kendo mogik e ndalo mogikni mondo ochiw ringre owuon kaka misango magolo richo.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

kikuyu: To joge mane odongʼ to noketo e bwo owadgi Abishai kendo nochomogi kuom jo-Amon.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Kik ukulrunegi piny; bende kik ulamgi; nimar An, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, An Nyasaye ma janyiego, kendo akumo nyithindo nikech richo mar wuonegi chakre tiengʼ mar adek nyaka tiengʼ mar angʼwen mar jogo mamon koda,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

kikuyu: Omiyo beduru motangʼ mondo uher Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Mikaya nowachone niya, “Kidwogo kingima, to kara ok asewuoyo gi dho Jehova Nyasaye.” Bangʼe nomedo wacho niya, “Winjuru wechena, un ji duto!”
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

kikuyu: Gichoko chiemb jamni kendo gihulo mzabibu e puothe joricho.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

kikuyu: To achiel kuom joma nochungʼ machiegni nowuodho liganglane kendo notongʼo jatij jadolo maduongʼ mi ochodo ite oko.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nowachonwa ka en Horeb niya, “Isedak mangʼeny ahinya e godni.
english: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

kikuyu: Luor wuonu gi minu mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechikou, mondo udagi amingʼa kendo mondo udhi maber e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Ne aneno ni ber mondo aket wachni e nyimi kendo aket parono e nyim joma obedo kagi kendo e nyim jodongo mag jowa, mondo ingʼiewe. Ka inyalo ware to ware, to ka ok inyal timo kamano to nyisa mondo angʼe. Nikech onge ngʼama chielo man-gi ratiro mar timo kamano makmana in kende, kendo an ema aluwi.” Nowacho niya, “Abiro ngʼiewo puodhono.”
english: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.” He said, “I will redeem it.”

kikuyu: Ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye kendo gigoyone erokamano ne giwerne kama: “Jehova Nyasaye ber; kendo hera mare ne jo-Israel osiko nyaka chiengʼ.” To ji duto nogoyo koko matek mar Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye, nikech mise mar od Jehova Nyasaye noketi.
english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to the LORD, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the LORD’s house had been laid.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ne omoro Jehova Nyasaye mondo omiu gweth kendo ubed mangʼeny, e kaka obiro bedo gi mor ka oranou kendo otiekou. Notieku e piny ma udonjoe mondo ukaw.
english: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

kikuyu: Jo-Efraim biro doko joma roteke kendo chunygi biro bedo mamor mana ka joma omadho divai. Nyithindgi biro neno gino mi gibed mamor; chunygi biro bedo mamor kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.

kikuyu: Misango mar Nyasaye en chuny motur, chuny motur kendo mamuol, ok itamri, yaye Nyasaye.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mochwowo timbe richo kayo thagruok, to ludhe mar mirima ibiro ketho.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, andikonu chik manyien kendo adierane nenore kuom Kristo kaachiel kodu, nikech mudho aa to ler mar adier koro rieny.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

kikuyu: “Nikech korka chik to ne asetho kuom chik mondo eka abed mangima ne Nyasaye.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

kikuyu: Negitimo winjruok gi Jehova Nyasaye ka gikok gi dwol maduongʼ, ka gigoyo koko gi turumbete kod tungʼ.
english: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

kikuyu: Mano kaka herani miya mor, yaye osiepna, ma ahero; mano kaka herani kelo mor mangʼeny moloyo divai, kendo ngʼwe ngʼar moloyo modhi mamoko duto!
english: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices!

kikuyu: Jonywolne nohum, to nomiyogi chik ni kik ginyis ngʼato moro amora gima nosetimore.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

kikuyu: Kane wasechopo kama koro ne wanyalo nenogo Saipras, ka waluwo yo modok milambo mare, ne wakwangʼ kwachomo Siria, mine wagowo Turo kama ne idhi lorie gik mane yiewa otingʼo.
english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

kikuyu: To Lut nowachonegi niya, “Ooyo, Ruodha, asayou!
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

kikuyu: Piny duto mondo oluor Jehova Nyasaye; ji duto manie e piny mondo okulrene.
english: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

kikuyu: Nehemia nowacho niya, “Dhiuru kendo ubed moil ka uchamo chiemo moyier kod math mamit, bangʼe uor moko ne joma onge gi gima gichamo. Odiechiengni owalne Ruodhwa. Kik ubed gi kuyo, nikech mor mar Jehova Nyasaye e tekou.”
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

kikuyu: Ne gitemo make kendo, to nopusore e lwetgi.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

kikuyu: Kaka joma ok oluoro Nyasaye chayo ji, ne gijara ka gichano timona marach, ne gikayona lekegi.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

kikuyu: Negimako bende jotelo ariyo mag jo-Midian, Oreb kod Zeb. Neginego Oreb e lwanda mar Oreb, kod Zeb e kar biyo divai mar Zeb. Negilawo jo-Midian kendo gikelo wiye Oreb kod Zeb ni Gideon, kama ne entie but aora Jordan.
english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Tiendene chalo gi sirni mag kit ombo mochungʼ e mise mag dhahabu maler. Onenore ka got mar Lebanon, kendo ongʼongʼore ka bepe sida mag Lebanon.
english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

kikuyu: Obiro nyisou ot malach molos malo, moseiki. Kanyo ema ulosie ikruok duto.”
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

kikuyu: kata wuo gi piny, to obiro puonji, kata inyalo yiene rech manie i nam mondo gipuonji.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

kikuyu: to ngʼatno mane ogocho ok nomok e wachno ka machielono ochungo mi owuotho oko gi ludhe; to kata kamano, nyaka ochul ngʼat mohinyoreno kuom thuolone mokethore kendo one ni ochango chutho.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

kikuyu: Onge gima mora moloyo winjo ni nyithinda wuotho e adiera.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

kikuyu: Gik moko ne dhi kode maber e gimoro amora mane otimo nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kode.
english: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

kikuyu: Ngʼato moro nopenjo niya, “Ruoth, en mana ji manok ema biro kwo?” Nowachonigi niya,
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

kikuyu: Lop dhood Gad ema nogo tongʼ gi Zebulun kochakore wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

kikuyu: To kata kamano pod abiro ketogi jorit mag tijega mag hekalu kod tije duto monego otim e iye.
english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

kikuyu: Janabi nopenjo niya, “Angʼo mane gineno e odi?” Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Giseneno gik moko duto manie oda. Onge gimoro amora modongʼ e mwanduna mane ok anyisogi.”
english: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

kikuyu: Aseneno gima lich e od Israel. Kanyo Efraim osechiwore ne chode kendo Israel osedwanyore.
english: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.

kikuyu: Ma e jal mane ondik kuome niya, “ ‘Abiro oro jaotena mondo otel e nyimi, obiro losoni yori kapok ibiro.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Eka janabi Isaya noluongo Jehova Nyasaye kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo tipo odok chien ondamo apar e kar raidhi mar Ahaz.
english: Isaiah the prophet cried to the LORD; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.

kikuyu: Japuonjre ok duongʼ moloyo japuonjne, to ngʼato ka ngʼato motiegi chuth biro bedo machal gi japuonjne.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

kikuyu: Ji nochiemo moyiengʼ. Bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo moromo okepe abiriyo.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: “To yadh zeituni nodwoko niya, ‘Ere kaka dawe mo miyudo kuom olembena kendo mitiyogo kuom miyo nyiseche kod ji duongʼ mondo abed ruodhu?’
english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye oseriembo e nyimu oganda maduongʼ kendo maratego; kendo nyaka odiechiengni onge ngʼama oseloyou.
english: “For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro ja-Farisai achiel moro noluongo Yesu mondo ochiem kode nodhi e od ja-Farisai mobedo but mesa.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni adieri ibiro bet ruoth kendo pinyruodh Israel nodhi nyime maber e bwo lochni.
english: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

kikuyu: To ka oa kuom Nyasaye, to ok ubi nyalo gengʼogi, nono to dipo ka unwangʼo ni ukedo mana gi Nyasaye!”
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

kikuyu: Moro ka moro kuomgi ne nigi lela wenge angʼwen gi bwombe angʼwen, kendo e bwo bwombegi ne nitie gima chalo gi lwete dhano.
english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Keluru achiel kuom apar duto e od keno, mondo chiemo obed e oda. Tema uruane mondo une-ane ka donge dayawnu dirise mag dhorangeye polo mi aolnu gweth mogundho ma ok unyal yudo thuolo kama dukanie.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

kikuyu: ka uloyo pinyno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, eka unuduogi kendo unubedi maonge ketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi Israel. Kendo pinyni biro bedo pok maru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ubiro chiwo luor ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo mako chikene duto ma amiyou kawuono.
english: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nowuok moweyo joburago.
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

kikuyu: Ruodh Misri nooro wach mi nogonye jatend ji nogonye thuolo.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

kikuyu: Daudi noluongo jotend Israel duto mondo ochokre Jerusalem. Noluongo jotend dhoudi gi jotend migepe mag jotich ruoth, jotelo morito migepe mag jolweny alufe gi migepe mag jolweny miche, to gi jotelo morito mwandu duto kod jamni mag ruoth gi mag yawuote kaachiel gi jotelo matiyo e dala ruoth, joma roteke to gi jolweny mathuondi.
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To Johana nosebedo ka kwero Herode kawachone niya, “Chik ok oyieni mondo ibed gi chi owadu.”
english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

kikuyu: En angʼo ma aneno? Kihondko ogoyogi, kendo giringo ka gia kar lweny nikech thuondi mag-gi mag lweny oselo. Giringo ka luoro omakogi ma ok gingʼi ngʼegi, kendo gin-gi luoro malich koni gi koni,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: ka ipando wangʼi, to githagore; ka igolo muchi kuomgi, to githo kendo gidok e lowo.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

kikuyu: Joga oramo chuth mondo oweya. Kata giluong Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, to ok notingʼ-gi malo e yo moro amora.
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

kikuyu: Keluru jogo man-gi wenge to ok nyal neno, to bende gin gi it to ok giwinj wach.
english: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

kikuyu: Kata bedni higa mar abiriyo chiegni chopo to kik ubed gi ich lit mutamru olo owadu man-gi dwaro. Ka mano otimore, to owaduno nyalo mako bura e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mi ubed joketho.
english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to the LORD against you, and it be sin to you.

kikuyu: to ne un uduto mane usiko kupadoru kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu pod ungima nyaka chil kawuono.
english: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.

kikuyu: Kwan chwo duto mahikgi chakore piero adek nyaka piero abich mabiro tiyo e Hemb Romo.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Dwaruru Jehova Nyasaye eka unubed mangima, nono to obiro tieko joka Josef ka mach mawengʼo, en mach mabiro wangʼo jo-Bethel maonge ngʼama nyalo nego.
english: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

kikuyu: Negitamore winji kendo ne ok giparo honni mane itimo e diergi. Tokgi nobedo matek kendo e ngʼanyo margino ne giyiero jatelo mondo gidog gibed wasumbini. To in Nyasaye maweyone ji richogi, ma jangʼwono kendo maneno ne ji lit, iyi bende ok wangʼ piyo kendo hera mari ogundho.
english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo kaka boche oliero e kor polo, gik miwuoro mag Jal ma riekone tut mogik?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Juda mane Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon otero e twech, magi joma noduogo Jerusalem gi Juda, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato dok e dalagi.
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

kikuyu: Ringruok nywolo mana ringruok, to Roho nywolo roho.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, neuru ni urito gima ne ukwongo winjo nyaka aa chakruok. Ka usiko ukano gima ne uwinjo mokwongo, to ubiro siko e winjruok gi Wuowi kod Wuoro.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

kikuyu: “Yier ji apar gariyo e kind jogi, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot,
english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

kikuyu: Koro jotend jo-Filistia nochokore mondo gitim misango maduongʼ ne Dagon ma nyasachgi, negitimo nyasi kagiwacho niya, “Nyasachwa osechiwo Samson ma jasikwa e lwetwa.”
english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”

kikuyu: Eka Naomi nowachone mond yawuote ariyo niya, “Doguru, ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu, nyaka ute mineu. Mad Jehova Nyasaye timnu ngʼwono, mana kaka usetimo ne chwou mosetho kendo ne an bende.
english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May the LORD deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

kikuyu: Pogreuru gi timbe maricho duto.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

kikuyu: Chiemo moyud e yo ma ok kare mit ne ngʼato, to achien omuodore mana ka kuoyo.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

kikuyu: “To ka diponi ni en jachan kendo ok onyal yudo gigi, to nyaka okel nyaim kaka misango mar pwodhruok e ketho michiwo mondo pwodhego kaachiel gi mogo mayom madirom gorogoro ariyo moruw gi mo mondo timgo misango mar cham kod mo maliw moromo nus lita,
english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

kikuyu: Nikech an, amiyo yawuot ruodhi loch kod joka ruodhi duto marito pinje.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kod Josef kendo nogwedhe, kendo nodak e od ruodhe ma ja-Misri.
english: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

kikuyu: Eka joma kare norieny kaka wangʼ chiengʼ ei pinyruoth mar Wuon-gi. Ngʼat man-gi ite to mondo owinji.
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, nyar Shua ma chi Juda notho. Kane Juda osetieko weche mag liel, nodhi nyaka Timna ir joma ne lielo yie rombege kendo nodhi gi Hira ja-Adulam ma osiepne.
english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

kikuyu: Ne apidhou gi chak, to ok gi chiemo motegno nikech ne pok ubedo moikore ni chamo chiemo motegno. Kata sani pok uikorune.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

kikuyu: Mi gilal nono ka pi mamol; ka giywayo atungegi to mi asernigi obed madik.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

kikuyu: Nibiro machiegni kane aluongi kendo ne iwachona niya, “Kik iluor ngangʼ.”
english: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Ruodh Misri noketo Eliakim owadgi Jehoahaz ruodh Juda kod Jerusalem kendo noloko nying Eliakim ni Jehoyakim. Neko nokawo Jehoahaz owadgi Eliakim mi otero e twech Misri.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼiyo jogo gi mirima kendo ka chunye lit ahinya nikech chunygi ne tek. Nowacho ni jal ma lwete otalno niya, “Rie lweti,” mi norieyo lwete kendo lwete nochango chuth.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro wuondore ni en ja-mwandu, to adiera oonge gimoro; to ngʼat machielo wuondore ni en jachan, to adiera en gi mwandu mangʼeny.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

kikuyu: Omiyo pogruok nobedo e kind ji nikech wach Yesu.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ula ne gin: Ara, Haniel kod Rizia.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

kikuyu: Nimar ibiro medori malach kichomo bat korachwich kendo kidhi bat koracham; ogandani noma ogendini pinjegi mi dagie e mier madongo makoro owe gundini.
english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.

kikuyu: Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye kugoyone erokamano, weruru wer mamit ne Nyasachwa kugoyo nyatiti.
english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

kikuyu: Nimar dho jachode wacho weche mamit ka mor kich, kendo wuoyone yom maloyo moo;
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

kikuyu: To lamuru kuom Roho kinde duto gi kit lamo duto, kendo ka ukwayo. Ka un gima e paro, to beduru mokichore kusiko ukwayo kinde duto ni jomaler duto.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

kikuyu: To kane malaika orieyo bade mondo oketh Jerusalem, chuny Jehova Nyasaye ne lit nikech masirano mi nowacho ni malaika mane nego ji niya, “Oromo! Dwok lweti piny.” Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noyudo ochungʼ e kar dino cham mar Arauna ja-Jebus.
english: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne otere e twech, piny ma ok mare ma obedo misumba jomoko. Nyithinde ne ongʼad migepe matindo tindo e dho yore mag dalane. Ne ogo ombulu kuom jotende ma ruodhi, kendo joge madongo duto ne otwe gi nyororo.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

kikuyu: E sa onogo nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e got mondo joma lawou kik yudu. Ponduru kuno kuom ndalo adek nyaka giduogi; eka udhi nyime giwuodhu.”
english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

kikuyu: Nyalo bedo ni ok alony kuom wuoyo, to kata kamano rieko to an-go. Wasebedo ka waleronu wechegi kinde ka kinde.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni moko, ginibed pinjeruodhi mawinjore. Nyar ruoth mar Milambo nodhi ir ruoth mar Nyandwat mondo olos winjruok, to winjruogno ok nobedo amingʼa, kendo en bende, gi tekone, ok nosiki. E ndalono ruoth mar milambo nochiw nyare, kaachiel gi joritne ruoth kod jotichne ma nyako.
english: At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement, but she will not retain the strength of her arm. He will also not stand, nor will his arm; but she will be given up, with those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokawo nyaroya mane giseloso mi owangʼe e mach kendo norege mayom kaka mogo mi noruwe gi pi momiyo jo-Israel mondo omodhi.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji mangʼeny nowuok mondo giromne, nikech negisewinjo ni en ema yande otimo honono.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

kikuyu: Sibuor, en ratego moloyo kuom le duto, kendo onge gimoro moluoro,
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

kikuyu: To kuom gik mamoko duto mane Ahaz otimo e ndalo lochne, donge ondikgi e kitap weche ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Tangani nolos gi nanga maber mochwe gi usi moa Misri kendo mano ema nobedo bandechi; tandaruwa moumigo nokiko rambulu gi ralik, moa e dho nembe mag Elisha.
english: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.

kikuyu: Adier, adier awachonu, ni ubiro goyo nduru kendo ubiro ywak ka piny to winjo maber. Kuyo to ubiro kuyo, to kata kamano kuyo maru biro lokore mor achien.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

kikuyu: Ngʼama biro winjo wachu? Pok mar joma nodongʼ karito gigewa biro bedo marom gi pok ngʼat mane odhi e lweny. Ji duto biro yudo maromre.”
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

kikuyu: Wan duto wachwanyore e yore mangʼeny. Ka weche ma ngʼato wacho ok mi obed jaketho to en ngʼat malongʼo kendo onyalo chiko ringre duto mondo owinje.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

kikuyu: to onge gimoro amora marach ma notimreni, kendo onge masira ma nosud machiegni gi odi.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

kikuyu: To ka en kuom ngʼwono, to mano nyiso ni koro ok yude kuom tim, nono to ngʼwono koro ok dibed ngʼwono adier.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

kikuyu: Musa kod Harun gi Nadab kod Abihu kaachiel gi jodong Israel piero abiriyo nodhi e got
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

kikuyu: To nowuoro kaka jogo ne onge gi yie. Bangʼ mano Yesu nomedo dhi nyime gipuonjo e gwengʼ ka gwengʼ
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

kikuyu: Arito bucheni gi chikeni, nimar yorega duto ongʼereni maber.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

kikuyu: Kik ijwangʼ rieko to obiro bedoni ragengʼ; here, to obiro ritoi.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

kikuyu: Jodolo nyaka tangʼ mondo kik giketh chiwo maler ma jo-Israel osewalo ni Jehova Nyasaye,
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

kikuyu: Moza ne wuon Binea, Binea ne wuon Refaya, Refaya ne wuon Eliasa, Eliasa ne wuon Azel.
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Eka japuonjre ma Yesu nohero nowacho ni Petro niya, “En Ruoth!” Sa nogono ma Simon Petro nowinje kowacho niya, “En Ruoth,” notweyo lawe mar abola e nungone, nimar noyudo osegole oko mi nochikore ei pi.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

kikuyu: Negipenjore ngʼato gi ngʼato niya, “Donge ne chunywa mor kane owuoyo kodwa e yo kendo konyisowa tiend Ndiko?”
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

kikuyu: E kindeno, ji ne rito Zekaria kendo negiwuoro ni angʼo momiyo osebedo amingʼa ei hekalu.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

kikuyu: owete Yesu nowachone niya, “Wuog ka idhi Judea mondo jopuonjreni one honni mitimo.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

kikuyu: “Nyaka gipedh mesa manie Nyim Nyasaye gi kitamba marambulu, bangʼe giket sende e wiye, gi dise kod bakunde, gi njage mar chiwo misango miolo piny; bende gine ni makati man kanyo seche duto kik rum.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

kikuyu: Ka ok kamano to wegi gibi ira mondo abed kar pondogi; we mondo gilos kwe e kinda kodgi, ee, we gilos winjruok koda.”
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama noneno ka gigo timore ema ochiwo nenoni kendo nende en adier. Ongʼeyo ni owacho adiera, kendo ohulo wechegi mondo un bende uyie.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bigvai, ji alufu ariyo gi piero auchiel gabiriyo (2,067),
english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

kikuyu: Jalweny ka jalweny noyako mana gima orome.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Abishai niya, “Koro Sheba wuod Bikri biro hinyowa moloyo kaka Abisalom notimo. Kaw jolwenj ruodhi mondo ilawe, ka ok kamano to onyalo yudo mier madongo mochiel mi odonjie kendo olalnwa.”
english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

kikuyu: Ji nobed koherore kendgi kendo kohero pesa. Ginibed josunga, jongʼayi, joma yanyo ji, joma ok winj jonywolgi, joma ok go erokamano, kendo joma ok ler,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nowuoro wechegego. To Yesu nomedo wuoyo kodgi kawacho niya, “Nyithindo, mano kaka en gima tek mondo ngʼato odonji e pinyruoth Nyasaye!
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: “Mondeu duto kod nyithindu nokelne jo-Babulon. Un uwegi ok unutony e lwetgi to enomaku gi ruodh Babulon; kendo dala maduongʼni nowangʼ mapodhi.”
english: They will bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans. You won’t escape out of their hand, but will be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. You will cause this city to be burned with fire.’”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ notuchne ka okadho Peniel kendo nowuotho kolingʼo nikech bamne nowil.
english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

kikuyu: Shalum ne wuon Jekamia, to Jekamia ne wuon Elishama.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wasuduru but kom duongʼ mar ngʼwono ka wan gi chir, mondo wayud kech gi ngʼwono e sa mwadware kony.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne giweyo Rebeka odhi kaachiel gi nyako mane opire kod jatich Ibrahim gi joge.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

kikuyu: Giwire gi fedha gi dhahabu; giriwe motegno gi musmal ka gigoye gi nyundo, mondo kik oyiengni.
english: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.

kikuyu: nikech ma en odiechiengʼ manotimnue pwodhruok mondo ubed maler, eka unubed maler kuom richou duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

kikuyu: Godiechiengʼ ne itelonegi gi bor polo, to gotieno to ne itelonegi gi mach makakni mondo omigi ler e wangʼ yo kama ne giwuothoe.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

kikuyu: ka gipuonjo ji mondo oluw timbe magalagala ma chikwa odagi mondo wan jo-Rumi wayiego kata waluw.”
english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

kikuyu: Jo-Juda modongʼ biro chalo gi yath matero tiendene piny kendo nyago olemo e bedene.
english: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo Zora kod Eshtaol, owetegi nopenjogi niya, “Ne uyudo gik moko chalo nade kuno?”
english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”

kikuyu: “Bangʼ higni piero angʼwen, malaika nofwenyore ni Musa ei ligek mach maliel e bungu manie thim but Got Sinai.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

kikuyu: “Chikuru itu mondo uwinj wechena; yie utimna ngʼwono mondo uwinja.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo holo ji gik moko to ok chul, to joma kare to chiwo gi ngʼwono;
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

kikuyu: Ne nitie udi adek adek mag jorito e bath ei dhorangach man yo wuok chiengʼ. Bathe udigo ne romre koni gi koni, kendo lach kor ot mane opogogi ne romre duto koni gi koni.
english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

kikuyu: Solomon ne nigi jotingʼo alufu piero abiriyo (70,000) kod jopa kidi ewi got ji alufu piero aboro (80,000),
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

kikuyu: Kane Daudi odok dala mondo ogwedh joode, Mikal nyar Saulo nowuok mondo oromne mowachone niya, “Mano kaka ruodh Israel nomiyore duongʼ kawuono koelore duk e nyim wasumbini ma nyiri mag jotije mana kaka dhano adhana nyalo timo!”
english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

kikuyu: Wuowino nodwoke niya, “Jo-Yahudi osewinjore mondo okwayi kiny iternegi Paulo e nyim jobuch Sanhedrin ka giwuondore ni gidwaro medo nono wachne maber.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

kikuyu: Ywaguru niya, “Reswa aa Nyasaye ma Jawarwa, chokwa kendo reswa kuom ogendini, mondo mi wadwok erokamano ne nyingi maler kendo wabed mamor kwapaki.”
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

kikuyu: Anami wasikgi mwandu duto mar dala maduongʼni gige duto moloso, gige duto ma nengogi tek kod mwandu duto mokan mag ruodhi Juda. Ginikawgi kaka gima opee mi notingʼ-gi ka iterogi Babulon.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi ji duto mane ni kode nowuok mongʼado aora Jordan. Kane piny yawore to ne onge ngʼat modongʼ kapok ongʼado Jordan.
english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ka dichwo oriembo chiege kendo chiege odhi moweye mi okende gi dichwo machielo, bende dodog ir dhakoni kendo? Donge pinyni dibed mochido chuth? To isedak kaka ochot man-gi johera mangʼeny bende koro diduog ira?
english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ayie kawo wichkuot muketo kuomano; nikech wan ne ok wanyal timo gik ma jogo timo, nikech wanyap! To ka ngʼato nyalo hedhore mar pakore kuom gimoro amora; awuoyo kaka ngʼama ofuwo, to an bende anyalo pakora mana kaka gin.
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

kikuyu: Jogi nomanyo nonro mar anywolagi to ne ok ginyal yudogi, omiyo nowegi oko mar joka jodolo kaka joma ochido.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

kikuyu: Noyie tho chiengʼ mane onego ja-Filistia. Jehova Nyasaye nokelo loch maduongʼ ne jo-Israel duto, ne ineno mine imor. Angʼo madimi itim marach ni ngʼama onge ketho ka Daudi kinege maonge gima omiyo?”
english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

kikuyu: Ne oywaya oko e bur motimo otodo, ne ogola e chwodho gi thidhna. Ne oketo tiendena e lwanda kendo nomiya kama otegno mondo achungie.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

kikuyu: Wuonewa mag piny-ka ne kumowa mana kuom kinde matin kaka giparo ni bernegi, to Nyasaye to kumowa mondo okonywa, kodwaro ni mondo wadok maler mana kaka en bende oler.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

kikuyu: Unupidh mzabibu e puotheu ma ukagi to ok unumadh olemo mochwer kuomgi kata choko olembgigo nikech kute nochamgi.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

kikuyu: Ka ji ariyo dhawo kae to chi ngʼat achiel kuomgi obiro konyo chwore, mi omake gi duongʼne,
english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

kikuyu: Lwet Jehova Nyasaye ne mon kodgi nyaka ne otiekogi duto e kambi.
english: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

kikuyu: Enok nodak kuom higni mia adek gi piero auchiel gabich.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

kikuyu: Omiyo, ne adoko jakwadh rombe mane oiki ne yengʼo, to moloyo, rombe mago mane isando. Eka nakawo ludhe ariyo, ma achiel kuomgi nachako ni Ngʼwono, to machielo nachako ni Riwruok, kendo nadoko jakwadh rombego.
english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi rech mi rechno nongʼogo Jona oko e dho wath kama otwo.
english: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

kikuyu: Owad gi wuon Saulo nowachone niya, “Nyisa gima Samuel nowachonu.”
english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

kikuyu: omiyo koth chue ne ji koa e boche polo.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ni e hekalu mare maler; Jehova Nyasaye ni e kom duongʼ mare manie polo. Orango timbe yawuot ji; wengene nonogi matut.
english: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ok unuchak ubed gi mor kod ilo, yaye Nyar Sidon Mangili ma osekethi! “Kata bed mana ni ungʼado nam ma udhi Saipras to kuno bende ok unuyudie yweyo.”
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

kikuyu: Kik uyiene ngʼato angʼata mondo odonj e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye makmana jodolo kod jo-Lawi mopwodhi kendo tiyo odiechiengʼno, to ji mamoko duto to orit tije ma Jehova Nyasaye osemiyogi mondo gitim.
english: But let no one come into the LORD’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow the LORD’s instructions.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhu kendo oritu;
english: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.

kikuyu: Noluwo timbe ruodhi mag Israel kendo nothedho kido milamogo Baal.
english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jehalelel ne gin: Zif, Zifa, Tiria kod Asarel.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

kikuyu: nimar en e Nyasachwa kendo wan e joge mokwayo, wan e jambe morito. Kawuono ka uwinjo dwonde,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

kikuyu: Gitimo misango ewi gode maboyo kendo gitimo Sewni kuonde motingʼore gi malo, e tiend yiend ober, gi omburi kod yiende mamoko madongo dongo kendo boyo, kama otimo tipo maber. Emomiyo nyiu lokore ochode to mond yawuotu to donjo e chode.
english: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

kikuyu: Chikeni miyo abedo mariek moloyo wasika, nimar gisiko gin koda seche duto.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

kikuyu: Kendo jodong ogandano nowacho niya, “Ka oseneg mond Benjamin, ere kaka wabiro miyo jogi mane otony mon?”
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noloyo jo-Juda kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato noringo kochomo dalane.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Asewuoyo ka an gi nyiego maliel ka mach kuom ogendini mamoko duto, kendo kuom piny Edom duto, nikech negiloko pinya margi, kendo ne giyako lege mage, ka chunygi opongʼ gi mor.’
english: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

kikuyu: “Winjuru. Nyaka umonj dala maduongʼno gi yo katoke. Kik udhi mabor ahinya. Un duto nyaka uikru.
english: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

kikuyu: Nyis Harun gi yawuote ni nyaka giritre ahinya ka gitiyo gi mich maler ma nyithind Israel kelona mar chiwo, nono to dipo ka gichayo nyinga. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Negidhi ma gilando wach ji mondo olokre owe richo.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno nochako omula kendo mi omiya teko.
english: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Rangach mar laru maiye mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka sik kolor kuom ndalo auchiel mitiye, to chiengʼ Sabato kod chiengʼ Dwe Mowuok Manyien nyaka yawe.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

kikuyu: Elija nowacho ni jonabi mag Baal niya, “Yieruru achiel kuom rwedhigo kendo loseuru mokwongo nikech ungʼeny ahinya. Luonguru nying nyasachu to kik umok mach.”
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

kikuyu: nopenje niya, “Ka ok in Kristo, kata Elija, kata janabi, to angʼo momiyo ibatiso ji?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

kikuyu: Kwedreuru chuth gi timbe mag mudho maonge ohala kendo hulgiuru e lela.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

kikuyu: Nochwado i hekalu kod yiend saipras kendo ne omuone kod dhahabu maler moketogi gi othidhe kod thiwni.
english: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

kikuyu: En mana ngʼat ma lwete ler kendo chunye bende ler, ngʼat ma ok lam nyiseche ma dhano oloso, kata kwongʼre gi miriambo.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

kikuyu: Ne gidenyo kendo riyo noloyogi, chunygi noa.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

kikuyu: Otingʼo kuonde matut duto mag piny e lwete, kendo wi gode ma roboche bende mage.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

kikuyu: Ka dichwo oterore gi dichwo wadgi. Giduto ji ariyogi gitimo gima kwero kendo giduto nyaka neg-gi to rembgi nobedi e wigi giwegi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Eka ji ariyogo nowacho, gino mane otimore e yo, kendo kaka negingʼeyo Yesu ka nongʼingo makati.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

kikuyu: “E yo machal kamano, koro achano mar timo maber kendo ni Jerusalem kod Juda, omiyo kik uluor.
english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

kikuyu: “Nyasaye osekelo ni jo-Israel Jawar ma en Yesu, koa e koth Daudi, mana kaka nosingore ni notim.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

kikuyu: Abiro rito chikeni ndalo duto, manyaka chiengʼ.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ne amiyi tigo ma nengogi tek kaka: Bangli e bedeni kod tigo ne aliero e ngʼuti,
english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

kikuyu: Abiro oro masiche mondo otel nyimu kendo masichego noriemb jo-Hivi, jo-Kanaan kod jo-Hiti.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi, chiengʼ mane ochuno jo-Yahudi mondo oyangʼ nyarombo mar Pasaka, jopuonjre Yesu nopenje niya, “Idwaro mondo wadhi waikni kama ichame Pasaka kanye?”
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: kendo enotiek tho chuth. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro yweyo pi wangʼ ji duto; mi nogol ajara kuom joge e piny duto. Jehova Nyasaye ema osewacho.
english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka aseweyonu richou kuom gik moko duto musetimo, to ubiro paro kendo wiu biro kuot, kendo ok unuchak uwuo kendo nikech unuyie ni ok unyal, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.’ ”
english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Kar kwan jo-Lawi machwo ma ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero ariyo gadek (23,000). Ne ok okwan-gi gi jo-Israel mamoko nikech ne ok opog-gi lowo.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, nyaka karangʼo mibiro lingʼ mak ikecho Jerusalem gi mier mag Juda misebedo kikechogo kuom higni piero abiriyogi?”
english: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

kikuyu: Ngamia mag-gi noyaki kendo kweth mag dhogi nope. Anake joge mantie kuma bor e tunge piny kendo anakelnegi masira koa koni gi koni,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
