english: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Koa kuom yawuot Mushi noyier Mali, Eder kod Jerimoth. Magi e jo-Lawi mane oyier kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: “To kata kamano, koro angʼeyo ni gik mane ni e pachi e magi:
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

kikuyu: Kar romb joma nochiemo duto ne gin alufu angʼwen, ka ok okwan mon gi nyithindo.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: “Los sirni mochungʼ mag yiend siala ne Hemb Romo.
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Isakar, en Paltiel wuod Azan;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye en gima ber, mosiko nyaka chiengʼ. Buche mag Jehova Nyasaye gin adier kendo gin kare kargi giduto.
english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo asandora kama. To wiya ok kuodi, nikech angʼeyo Jal ma aseyie kuome, kendo angʼeyo chutho ni onyalo rito ngimana gi chunya ma asechiwone nyaka ndalo nogono.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

kikuyu: Kata kamano ka omake, to nyaka ochul nyadibiriyo, kata obedo ni en nengo mapek kuome makawo mwandu mag ode duto.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

kikuyu: Magi e chike mag misango mar lalruok ma ngʼato nyalo chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik mondo neg-gi Ribla kanyo, e piny jo-Hamath. Omiyo Juda noter e twech mabor gi pinye owuon.
english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

kikuyu: Kik gigi mi ubed mogak. Kik gik ma kamago mi ubed mogak kata mochido.
english: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

kikuyu: Joka Elkana ne gin: Elkana nonywolo Amasai, Amasai nonywolo Ahimoth,
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

kikuyu: Kik iketh tich Nyasaye nikech wach chiemo. Chiemo duto ler, to ok ber mondo ngʼato ocham gimoro amora mamiyo ngʼat machielo podho.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

kikuyu: Anto adhier kendo achando, mad Ruoth Nyasaye parae. In e jakonyna kendo jawarna; in e Nyasacha, kik ideki.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

kikuyu: kendo nodaro joma nodak kanyo moketogi e tich mar tiyogi musmende, kod tindo mag chuma kod ledhi. Daudi notimo mano ne mier duto mag jo-Amon. Bangʼe Daudi gi jolweny mage duto nodok Jerusalem.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Abiro keyou e kind ogendini, anagol ligangla mi alawu. Pinyu nodongʼ gunda, kendo miechu madongo nokethi chuth.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne okalo nyaka Azmon mi ochopo nyaka Wadi manie piny Misri kendo ochopo nyaka e dho Nam Mediterania. Ma e giko tongʼne ma yo milambo.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

kikuyu: “Owetena, ma nyikwa Ibrahim, kod un joma ok jo-Yahudi moluoro Nyasaye, wan ema oseornwa wach warruokni.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

kikuyu: Maskil mar Asaf. Angʼo momiyo isedagiwa nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Nyasaye? Angʼo momiyo mirimbi dhwolore ka iro kochomo rombe mag lek mari iwuon?
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

kikuyu: Negipeyo jamni mag jo-Hagri, ngamia alufu piero abich (50,000), rombe alufu mia ariyo gi piero abich (250,000), to gi punde alufu ariyo (2,000). To bende negimako ji alufu mia achiel (100,000) ma gitero e twech,
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jomoko nodhi mondo ochok chiemo chiengʼ mar abiriyo, to ne ok giyudo.
english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

kikuyu: Gichano timo ne ji marach kagiwacho niya, “Waseloso chenro malongʼo chuth!” Kuom adier, pach dhano gi chunye opando riekni maricho miwuoro.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie jatich mane tiyo e od Saulo ma nyinge Ziba. Ne giluonge mondo obi e nyim Daudi mi ruoth nopenje niya, “In e Ziba?” Nodwoko niya, “Ee, en an jatichni.”
english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

kikuyu: Mirimbi tiekowa kendo kecho mikechogo kodwa bwogowa.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nodwoke niya, “Ere kuma dwayudie makati e dier thim manyalo pidho oganda maduongʼ machal kama?”
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

kikuyu: to orwako japiny moro amora moluore kendo timo dwarone, ma ok odewo oganda moaye!
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

kikuyu: Wend shigaion mane Daudi owero ne Jehova Nyasaye kuom Kush ja-Benjamin. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha, in e kar pondona; Resa kendo igola e lwet joma lawa duto,
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

kikuyu: Ka ok ongʼeyo ni mano chi wuode Juda nodhi ire kamane obetie bath yo kendo owachone niya, “Koro bi mondo wabed kodi e achiel.” To Tamar nopenje niya, “Ibiro miya angʼo ka wabedo kodi e achiel?”
english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

kikuyu: Osiepwa mwageno ma Luka jathiethwa kod Dema jomosou.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

kikuyu: Wuoda, chik iti malongʼo ne gima awacho, chik iti maber ne wechena.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

kikuyu: Donge oneno yorena kendo okwano okangena?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

kikuyu: Kawuononi e dala mar Daudi, osenywolnu Jawar; en Kristo Ruoth.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo wachonegi niya, “Adier, adier, awachonu ni ngʼama ok donji e abich rombe koluwo dhorangach, to odonjo koluwo yo machielo, en jakuo kendo jamecho.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

kikuyu: Ondiki e kitap chik niya, “Anakonyra gi joma wacho dhok mayoreyore kendo gi dho joma welo, abiro wuoyo gi jogi to kata kamano ok giniwinja, Jehova Nyasaye ema wacho kamano.”
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Eka negitweyo kitego e lep akor mag law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod mondo gibed kaka kite mag rapar ne nyithind Israel kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼat mikumo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma en ngʼama ipuonjo koa e chikeni;
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

kikuyu: Kane gisengʼado aorano, Elija nopenjo Elisha niya, “Wachane gima idwaro mondo atimni kapok okawa?” Elisha nodwoke niya, “We mondo ayud teko ma in-go nyadiriyo.”
english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

kikuyu: Jochologo nodwoko Farao niya, “Mond jo-Hibrania ok chal gi mond jo-Misri, gin giteko kendo ginywol kapok jocholo ochopo irgi.”
english: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”

kikuyu: koro remb Kristo to nyalo pwodho ji e yo malich machal nade! Nochiwore ne Nyasaye kuom Roho mosiko kaka misango maonge songa, omiyo rembe biro luoko chunywa maiye mi wawe timbe motho, mondo wati ne Nyasaye mangima!
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma dipim gi Nyasaye? Koso en kido mane madiwach ni chal kode?
english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

kikuyu: Kik iwe giwach e chunygi niya, “Ero, otimorene mana kaka ne wadwaro.” Kata giwach niya, “Koro wasemuonye ngili.”
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

kikuyu: To Samuel nowachone niya, “Marangʼo awinjo ywak rombe gi dhok e ita?”
english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

kikuyu: Johana nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, ne waneno ngʼato ka golo jochiende e nyingi kendo ne watemo tame, nikech ok en achiel kuomwa.”
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

kikuyu: Ne achoko fedha gi dhahabu, kod girkeni mag ruodhi gi gwenge. Ne abedo bende gi jower machwo kod mamon, kendo gi mon duto mane nyalo moro chuny dichwo.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

kikuyu: Oganda jo-Israel duto nochako wuoth kawuok e thim mar Sin, ka giwuotho ka gi kacha mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochikogi. Ne gibworo Refidim, to ne onge pi mane ji nyalo modho.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Wengena ne oneno timbegi duto; ok gipondona, bende richogo ok opondona.
english: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.

kikuyu: To ka wuon chiayono dwaro waro chiacheno, to nyaka omed achiel ewi abich mar nengone.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

kikuyu: Kane Sanbalat owinjo ni wasechako gero ohinga, iye nowangʼ kendo mirima nomake. Ne ojaro jo-Yahudi,
english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

kikuyu: Nikech nyaka wan duto wabi wachungʼ e nyim kom bura mar Kristo, mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato oyud gima owinjore gi gik mane otimo kapod en ringruok kata gin gik mabeyo, kata maricho.
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

kikuyu: Isaya bende wacho niya, “Nyakwar Jesse nobi, en ema nowuogi mondo otel ni joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo ogendini nogen kuome.”
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

kikuyu: “Wachnegi ni: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Ndede duto mag divai onego opongʼ gi divai.’ To kagiwacho ni, ‘Donge wangʼeyo ni ndede mag divai onego pongʼ gi divai?’
english: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhi gie Sayun, ndalo duto mag ngimani; mad ineye gi wangʼi ka Jerusalem dhi maber,
english: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

kikuyu: abiro teri e piny joma otho, mondo idag kuno gi joma nosetho chon. Abiro miyo idagi e piny manie bwo lowono, kibudho e bur matut e kind gik machon mokethore mi ok inichak iduog e piny joma ngima.
english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Kaw fedha gi dhahabu ilosgo osimbo mondo isidh ewi Joshua wuod Jehozadak, jadolo maduongʼ.
english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

kikuyu: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

kikuyu: “Abiro tieko gik moko duto mantie e piny mi lal nono,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ne en e loch kuom higni abiriyo gi dweche auchiel ka en ruodh Juda kodak Hebron kendo ne en ruodh Israel gi Juda kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gadek.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wechego ne aneno malaika machielo kalor piny aa e polo. Ne en gi teko maduongʼ, kendo lerne ne menyo piny.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

kikuyu: Nikech ka un gi kit timbego mogundho, to gibiro gengʼou mondo kik ubed joma nono ma ok nyag olemo e ngʼeyo ma un-go kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ubiro podho e lak ligangla, kendo abiro kelonu chandruok e tongʼ ka tongʼ mar Israel. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Koro piny ne onge kido kendo ne onge gimoro amora e iye. Mudho mandiwa noimo ataro mangʼongo kendo Roho mar Nyasaye ne wuotho ewi atarono.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Ka ji wachonu ni manyuru rieko kuom ajuoke gi jo-nyakalondo madhum kendo jajni, to donge dhano onego penj wach kuom Nyasaye? Angʼo momiyo upenjo joma otho wach mar joma ngima?
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

kikuyu: Abiro keto pogruok e kind joga kod jogi. Hononi kiny notimre kiny.’ ”
english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo owuotho ka ochiegni chopo Damaski, nopo ka ler moa e polo omenye molwore.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

kikuyu: Anywolana duto ne ok onego gen gimoro moa kuom ruodha ma en ruoth makmana tho, to ne imiyo jatichni obet kod jogo machiemo e mesani. En ratiro mane ma an-go madimi amed keto kwayona ni ruoth?”
english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

kikuyu: Negiluongore moro ka moro kagiwacho ni: “Maler, Maler, Maler en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego; piny duto opongʼ gi duongʼne.”
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

kikuyu: To onge wach! Gima duongʼ en ni wach Kristo ilando e yore duto; kata gi chuny marach, kata maber, kendo mano medo miya mor moloyo. Ee, kendo pod abiro medo bedo mamor,
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

kikuyu: To ewi ngasno gi malo Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼie kawacho niya, “An Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach wuonu Ibrahim kendo Nyasach Isaka. Piny minindoeni abiro miyi gi nyikwayi.
english: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, asendikonu kuom weche moko ka an gi chir mana mondo aparnugi, kendo kuom ngʼwono ma Nyasaye omiya,
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi gik moko mane Daudi otimo chakre kinde mane en ruoth nyaka giko; ondikgi e kitepe mag jonabi Samuel, Nathan kod Gad,
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

kikuyu: Alemoni ni mondo iland yie ma in-go motegno, mondo eka ibed gi ngʼeyo matut kuom gik mabeyo duto ma wan-go ei Kristo.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ifdeya kod Penuel ne gin yawuot Shashak.
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

kikuyu: Ka Jehudi nosesomo laini adek kata angʼwen mar kitabuno, ruoth nongʼadogi gi pala mabith kendo owitogi e kar hoyo mach, nyaka kitabuno duto nowangʼ e mach.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “E en kaka iwachono. To awachonu un duto ni e ndalo mabiro unune Wuod Dhano kobet e bat korachwich mar Jal Maratego kendo kolor oa e boche polo.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni en adier ni an watni, to nitie watni mahie moro machielo ma jakori moloya.
english: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.

kikuyu: Bezer, Hod, Shama, Shilsha, Ithran kod Beera.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Fwenyno biro kawo ndalo alufu ariyo mia adek odiechiengʼ gotieno; eka kama ler mar lemo nopwodhi kendo.”
english: He said to me, “To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”

kikuyu: Pod gitamore weyo timbegigo nyaka chil kawuono. Ok gilam Jehova Nyasaye kata rito buchene, wechene, chikene kod puonj ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo nyikwa Jakobo, ma bangʼe noloko nyinge ni Israel.
english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear the LORD, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

kikuyu: Omiyo nodok moyudo Balak kochungʼ but misangone, ka en-gi jodong Moab. Balak nopenje niya, “Angʼo mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho?”
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

kikuyu: Ne onge jotheth e piny Israel mangima nikech jo-Filistia nosewacho niya, “Ka kamano to jo-Hibrania biro loso ligengini kod tonge!”
english: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Neuru, piny pod chon, sa michokoe jamni podi. Weuru rombe omodhi bangʼe uduokgi e lek.”
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

kikuyu: Tonde mag tho norida, lit mar liel nochopona, kendo chandruok gi chuny lit noloya.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

kikuyu: Dibedi ni odni, ma iluongogo Nyinga, osebedonu kar pondo mar jomecho? To neuru arange! An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kamano.
english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To aluor ni kaka thuol nowuondo Hawa gi miriambone mariek, e kaka un bende inyalo wuondu mi uwe hero Kristo gi chunyu duto.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

kikuyu: Ywak iwinjo e kuonde motingʼore motimo ongoro, en kuyo gi secho mar jo-Israel, nikech gisejwangʼo yoregi, kendo wigi osewil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Kinde duto gingʼwon kendo giholo ji gigegi nono; nyithindgi ibiro gwedhi.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo bor gi lach mar rangach mochomo yo nyandwat, midonjogo e laru ma oko.
english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

kikuyu: Weche mowacho to yom ka mo mabuo, to lweny to ni e chunye; wechege yomo del moloyo mor wirruok, to kara gin mana ligangla mosewuodh oko.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nokee e piny Misri duto ka gichoko lum.
english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

kikuyu: Noyudo asepwoyou ne Tito, kendo koro ok usekuodo wiya. To mana gik moko duto mwasebedo ka wawachonu gin adiera e kaka pwoch mane wapwoyou ne Tito kuomu bende osedoko gima adier.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

kikuyu: Pile ka pile ne giwuoyo kode, to nodagi timo kaka chik dwaro. Omiyo neginyiso Haman wachno mondo one anena kaka tim Modekai-ni inyalo yiego nimar nosewachonegi ni en ja-Yahudi.
english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

kikuyu: Gisebedo joma ok jo-adiera ni Jehova Nyasaye; ginywolo nyithindo ma kimirwa. Sewni ma gitimo ka dwe owuok biro tiekogi kaachiel gi puothegi.
english: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

kikuyu: Nokawo boche gi boche mag sembe, kod boche duto mogawo jamb-ich gi boche moimo chuny gi nyiroke ariyo kod boche mogawogi, kaachiel gi bam ma korachwich.
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni piero ariyo gadek ka ruoth Joash osebedo e loch; jodolo ne pok oloso kuonde momukore ei hekalu.
english: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

kikuyu: Ka wuowi matin-no nowinjo mano, noa ka chunye lit, nikech ne en-gi mwandu mathoth ahinya.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: Eka Naomi nokawo nyathino mi noriwe e tiende, kendo ne orite.
english: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.

kikuyu: Ma e gima bura osengʼado: Ler osebiro e piny, to ji nohero mudho moloyo ler, nikech timbegi ne richo.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo godhiambo, Yesu nobet kachiemo kaachiel gi jopuonjre apar gariyogo.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

kikuyu: Kik ibed giluoro mar masira ma ditimreni apoya nono kata kethruok mamako jogo maricho,
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

kikuyu: Ibrahim nowalo rombe ma sibini abiriyo mag kwethge,
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

kikuyu: Jo-Zebulun bende ne ok oriembo jo-Kanaan mane odak Kitron kata Nahahol, mane odongʼ e diergi; to ne gilokogi wasumbinigi.
english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Gad: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Daudi wuora ni, ‘Nitimo maber mondo ibed gi wach gero hekalu ni nyinga e chunyi.
english: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

kikuyu: Jowetena, mad ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo rit chunyu. Amin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

kikuyu: Jehoyakin ne ja-higni apar gaboro kane odoko ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kuom dweche adek kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Nehushta nyar Elnathan, ma aa Jerusalem.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To kane oneno ka ji adekgo osewuoyo mi wechegi orumo, to mirima nomake.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo pod usiko kudwaro kum? Angʼo momiyo usiko kungʼanyo? Wiyeu opongʼ gi adhonde kendo chunyu opongʼ gi lit.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

kikuyu: Enoresi ka in e masiche mar auchiel; to adier, ok enoweyi ichopi e masiche mar abiriyo.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

kikuyu: kendo owad gi ngʼat mane onegocha oyude oko mar dala mar tony, to onyalo nege ma ok obedo gi richo mar nek.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

kikuyu: ma gin gigo ma joma wasika wacho kuoma kendo kuodhago lingʼ-lingʼ odiechiengʼ duto.
english: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo utimo timbegi? Awinjo kuom ji duto timbeu marichogi.
english: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.

kikuyu: Eka jarito noneno ngʼat machielo karingo, kendo noluongo jarit dhorangach mowachone niya, “Ne ngʼat machielo bende ringo biro ka en kende!” To ruoth nowacho niya, “En bende nyaka bed ni okelo wach maber.”
english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The king said, “He also brings news.”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ringre dhano en achiel, to en gi fuonde mathoth, to bende kata obedo ni en gi fuonde mathoth, pod en mana ringruok achiel. Ma e kaka Kristo bende chalo.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo owinjore gi pak; onego omiye luor moloyo nyiseche mamoko duto.
english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: To koro jowetewa wadwaro ni ungʼe gima ngʼwono mar Nyasaye osetimo ni kanisa man Makedonia.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

kikuyu: “Biuru uneye ngʼama osenyisa gik moko duto ma asetimo. Donge jalni dibed Kristo?”
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

kikuyu: Pilato nopenjo Yesu niya, “In e ruodh jo-Yahudi?” To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ee, en kaka iwachono.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

kikuyu: “Kata kapo ni aoro le mager e pinyno mi giweye maonge nyithindo, mi pinyno olokore thim motwo ma dhano ok nyal kadhoe nikech le magergo,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

kikuyu: E sa onogo, Ayub noa malo mi oyiecho lepe kendo olielo yie wiye. Eka nopodho piny auma kolemo,
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

kikuyu: Nimar joma wuondore ni gin Kristo to ok gin kod joma wuondore ni gin jonabi to ok gin nothinyre mi tim ranyisi kod honni madongo mondo giwuondgo koda ka joma oyier, ka dipo mano ditimre.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Negikele ir Yesu, ma gipedho lepgi e diengʼe nyathi kanyna kendo negiketo Yesu kuome.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

kikuyu: kendo ne achiwo baruwani ne Baruk wuod Neria, wuod Maseya, e nyim omera Hanamel kod joneno mane ogo seyi e barup winjruok kod jo-Yahudi mane obet e agola mar jarito.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

kikuyu: Ndalo biro chopo adier ma gik moko duto manie odi kod gik moko mane kwereni osekano nyaka chil kawuono, noter Babulon. Onge gimoro amora mane odongʼ, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Abiro keto leche kuomu kendo abiro miyo ringʼo gi pien um dendu kendo abiro kudho much ngima kuomu mi unudok mangima. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

kikuyu: Mana kaka Muma wacho niya, “Ngʼato angʼata mohero ngima kendo ni gigeno kuom ndalo mabiro mabeyo, nyaka ogengʼ lewe kik wuo marach kendo ogengʼ dhoge kuom wacho miriambo.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

kikuyu: kendo ka uluwo adimba chike duto ma amiyou kawuono mondo uher Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mi uwuotho e yorene ndalo duto, to nyaka umed yiero mier adek madongo kuom mago.
english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mane otelnigi gi Rehum wuod Bani ema ne otiyo e dir Nehemia. Hashabia mane jatend dir gwengʼ Keila nogedo e dir Rehum wuod Bani kochungʼ ni jogwengʼ-gi.
english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

kikuyu: Omri noyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike Samaria, kendo Ahab wuode nokawo lochne kaka ruoth.
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Jonathan nowacho ni Daudi niya, “Gimoro amora midwaro ni atim abiro timoni.”
english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

kikuyu: Omiyo waneno ni ne ok ginyal donjo nikech negitamore yie.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

kikuyu: Mad joma ogeno kuomi kik ne wichkuot nikech an, yaye Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego; mad joma manyi kik ne wichkuot nikech an, yaye Nyasach Israel.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ruoth nooro jariemb faras mar ariyo. Kane ochopo irgi nowachonegi niya, “Ruodha penjo kama: ‘Bende ubiro e yor kwe?’ ” Jehu nodwoke niya, “Kwe to obadhi e angʼo? Luw bangʼa.”
english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

kikuyu: “Kane pok atieko lemo e chunya, Rebeka nochopo ka otingʼo dapi e goke. Nolor e soko mondo otuom pi kendo nawachone ni, ‘Yaye miyae pi amodhi.’
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

kikuyu: nyaka chop Roho ol kuomwa koa malo, kendo piny motwo nolokre kuonde mamiyo, mi kuonde mamiyo nonenre ka bungu.
english: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

kikuyu: Jogo oowre gi gombo, gichalo farese moyiengʼ, ma gombo ohewo ka moro, ka moro kuomgi gombo mana chi ngʼat machielo.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

kikuyu: Nikech koro uyudo thoro mar yie maru, ma en warruok mar chunyu.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

kikuyu: Balaam nodwoke niya, “Donge ne anyisi ni nyaka atim mana gima Jehova Nyasaye onyisa?”
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

kikuyu: Ne okawa motera kuno, kendo ne aneno ngʼato ma kite chalo gi mula; ne ochungʼ e dhorangach kotingʼo fut molos gi law mayom kod odundu mar pimo e lwete.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

kikuyu: Noloso Beth Horon Mamalo kod Beth Horon Mamwalo kaka mier madongo mochiel gohinga motegno kendo oketnegi rangeye miloro gi lodi.
english: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

kikuyu: To kuom mano Yesu Kristo nokecha an mane an jaricho ewi joricho duto, mondo onyis ngʼwonone maduongʼ maonge giko kuoma. Nodwaro mondo abed ranyisi, ne joma biro yie kuome mondo oyud ngima mochwere.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

kikuyu: Omiyo chik nowuok mondo onegi joma riek duto, kendo noor ji mondo omany Daniel gi osiepene, mondo gin bende oneg-gi.
english: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

kikuyu: Yesu noa malo kendo nopenje niya, “Nyarwa, eregi? Onge ngʼama odongʼ ma pod donjoni?”
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

kikuyu: Abiro tho e pinyni, ok anangʼad aora Jordan, to un uchiegni ngʼado mondo udhi ukaw kereu e piny maberno.
english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

kikuyu: Hazar Shual, Bersheba, Biziothia,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

kikuyu: Nopenje mar adek niya, “Simon wuod Johana, bende ihera?” Petro nokuyo nikech Yesu nopenje mar adek niya, “Bende ihera?” Nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, in ingʼeyo gik moko duto; ingʼeyo ni aheri.” Yesu nowachone niya, “Kare pidh romba.
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

kikuyu: Fuongʼo wach ketho genruok; omiyo tangʼ ni ngʼato ma wuoyo mathoth.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

kikuyu: Kanyo e kama ogendini idho dhiye, ogendini mag Jehova Nyasaye dhi kuno, mondo opak nying Jehova Nyasaye ka giluwo chike mane omi Israel.
english: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Nogwedh atongeu gi dakuondeu duto.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

kikuyu: Jalno ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maduongʼ mar Israel ok riambi bende ok olok pache; nimar ok en dhano mondo olok pache.”
english: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Musa noyieneu mondo uketh keny gi mondu nikech chunyu matek. To ok ne en kamano nyaka aa chakruok.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

kikuyu: Ne omiyou manna ma uchamo e thim gimane kwereu ne ok ongʼeyo, mondo omi ubed ka uboloru kendo ka otemou mondo giko udhi maber.
english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

kikuyu: Ubiro chamo ring joma roteke kendo ubiro madho remb yawuot ruodhi mag piny, mana ka gima gin imbe gi nyithi rombe, kata diek gi rwedhi, ma gin chiayo machwe duto moa Bashan.
english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

kikuyu: To giko joma kamago en kethruok nikech igi e nyasachgi, kendo gik ma gimiyorego duongʼ ema kelonigi wichkuot, ka pachgi otwere gige pinyni.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wuotho e yore mag chikeni ema warito, nyingi kod duongʼ mari ema chunywa dwaro.
english: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

kikuyu: To jopuonj Chik moko manoyudo obet ei ot kanyo nochako penjore e chunygi ni,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

kikuyu: E kinde ma pod ongʼicho nyaroyano nyaka wangʼ piende, ringe, rembe kod wen.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni nobed maberber ne Sodom gi Gomora chiengʼ ngʼado bura moloyo dalano.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

kikuyu: Piny Misri biro dongʼ gunda mokethore maonge tich. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye. “ ‘Nikech ne iwacho niya, “Aora Nael en mara; ma aloso gi lweta awuon,”
english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD. “‘“Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’

kikuyu: to ok birone kende ema nojiwowa, to hoch mane uhoyego bende nojiwowa. Nonyisowa kaka un gi siso mar nena, kendo kaka un gi kuyo maduongʼ, kendo kaka chunyu omoko nikech wachna, ma mago duto nomiya amor moloyo.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

kikuyu: Ka ruodh piny donjo to nyaka odonji gie agola mar rangach, kendo kowuok to nyaka owuog koluwo kanyono.
english: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

kikuyu: Adier, Jehova Nyasaye osetimonwa gik madongo, omiyo wamor mokalo.
english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

kikuyu: Nokwayo pi modho, to nomiye chak; nokelone chak mopwo e bakul moromo ruoth chiemoe.
english: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

kikuyu: “ ‘Odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe ka dwe, chiwne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep mar nyirwedhi ariyo, im achiel kod nyiimbe abiriyo moromo higa achiel, duto maonge songa.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, mana kaka Roho Maler wacho niya, “Kawuono ka uwinjo dwonde,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Wuod dhano, ma en kama kom duongʼ mara nitie, kendo en e raten mar tienda. Ma e kama abiro dakie e dier jo-Israel nyaka chiengʼ. Jo-dhood Israel, ruodhigi kaachiel gi ogandani duto ok nochak okel wichkuot ni nyinga maler kendo kuom timbegi mag chode, kod nyiseche motho mag ruodhi mag-gi manie kuonde motingʼore mag-gi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

kikuyu: Neuru, kawuono aketo e nyimu ngima kod mwandu, tho kod kethruok.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

kikuyu: Ne jodongo man e dieru akwayou kaka jaduongʼ wadu mane janeno kaka Kristo sandore, kendo kaka achiel kuom joma biro yudo duongʼ mabiro fwenyore achien:
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

kikuyu: Bedna lwanda mar pondo, ma anyalo ringo adhiye seche duto; gol chik mondo iresa, nimar in e lwandana kendo ohingana.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo thowi moro amora kik yud e uteu, kendo ngʼato angʼata mochamo gimoro amora moketie thowi nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom oganda jo-Israel, bed ni en japiny moro kata ja-Israel.
english: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

kikuyu: Kinde machon Nyasaye nowuoyo gi kwerewa e yore mangʼeny kendo mopogore opogore, kokalo kuom jonabi,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

kikuyu: Ndiko to wacho nangʼo? “Ibrahim noyie kuom Nyasaye, kendo mano nomiyo Nyasaye okwane kaka ngʼama kare.”
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ni Harun niya, “Nyis oganda jo-Israel duto ni, ‘Biuru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nimar osewinjo ngʼur ma ungʼurgo.’ ”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

kikuyu: En bende nohewo jo-Asuria gi gombo; kaachiel gi jotendgi, jolweny momanore gi gige kedo, kendo moidho farese; giduto en gin yawuowi maber neno.
english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.

kikuyu: kendo kata chiemb ngʼato ne ok wachamo ma ok wachulo. To ne watiyo odiechiengʼ gotieno, ka watiyo gi lwetewa kendo ka watiyo tich matek mondo kik wami ngʼato moro amora kuomu tingʼ mapek.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo nyiso Nyasaye yore monego oluw, kata manyalo kwere ni, ‘Isetimo marach’?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

kikuyu: Kik ukaw ohala moro amora kuome, to daguru kode kuluoro Nyasachu.
english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

kikuyu: Biuru nyithinda kendo winjauru. Abiro puonjou luoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: kiny sa machal kama anaor pe malich mapok none e piny Misri, nyaka nene.
english: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

kikuyu: Ngʼat marach imako mana gi wuoyone maricho, to ngʼat makare tony ne chandruok.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero angʼwen e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar apar gachiel, Musa ne owacho ne jo-Israel gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochike mondo owachnegi.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno, kata obedo ni ne aikora ahinya mondo andiknu kuom wach warruok ma wan duto wan-go, naneno ni ber koro andiknu mondo ajiwu uked matek kuom wach yie mane ochiwne jomaler dichiel kendo mogik.
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

kikuyu: E nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kanyo ema un kod jou duto unuchiemie gi mor e gik moko duto ma lwetu timo, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osegwedhou.
english: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

kikuyu: Kane Akish openje niya, “Tinde ne idhi monjo kanye?” Daudi to ne jawacho niya, “Aa monjo Negev e piny Juda, kata ni Negev mar Jeramel kata ni Negev mar jo-Keni.”
english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

kikuyu: “Tiendegi reto kadhi chwero remo;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

kikuyu: Wuod dhako ma misumbano nonywol kuom dwaro mar dhano, to wuod dhako ma thuolo nonywol kuom singruok.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

kikuyu: Dhiyo ewi got Pisga mondo ine piny koa wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ kendo koa nyandwat nyaka milambo. Rang piny gi wengeni owuon, nimar ok iningʼad aora Jordan.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

kikuyu: To bende, Wuoro ok ngʼad bura ne ngʼato, to oseketo teko mar ngʼado bura e lwet Wuowi,
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

kikuyu: Gimono jochan yudo adiera kendo gimiyo jomodhier ringo pondo.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nokewu e pinje duto, koa e tungʼ piny konchiel nyaka machielo. Kanyo unulamie nyiseche mamoko, ma gin nyiseche mopa mag yiende kod kite ma un uwegi kod ka kwereu ne ok ongʼeyo.
english: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo aketo chunya ni nyaka un bende ayalnu Injili, un ma un Rumi.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

kikuyu: Ritreuru mondo une ni onge ngʼato kuomu molal kendo oweyo ngʼwono mar Nyasaye, kendo kik uwe sigu moro bedi e kindu manyalo ketho ji mangʼeny.
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

kikuyu: jo-Bethlehem, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gadek (123),
english: The children of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Magi e nying yawuot Israel (ma tiende ni Jakobo kod nyikwaye) mane odhi Misri. Reuben ema ne wuod Jakobo makayo.
english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, koro winji gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Kochakore sani to chiegi biro bedo jachode e dala mar Samaria, kendo yawuoti kod nyigi, to koro ibiro negi gi ligangla. Lopi ibiro kawo kendo pogi, in iwuon, to initho e piny moro nono mabor gi ka, kendo jo-Israel nodar, mi tergi e twech!’ ”
english: Therefore the LORD says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

kikuyu: Mana kaka nyithindo mayom, beduru gi siso gi chak mayom mar chuny mondo kumadhe to omi udongi e yor warruok,
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

kikuyu: Eka Isaka notho kendo noluwo kwerene ka oti kendo hike ngʼeny. Kendo yawuot Esau kod Jakobo noyike.
english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

kikuyu: Bende aseketo jo-Lawi duto obedo e lo yawuowi makayo e Israel.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Adwaro ni ungʼe ni gigi duto ok atim nikech un, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho. Yaye dhood Israel, neuru wichkuot kuom timbeu mamono!
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka jadolo notimne pwodhruok kuom richo mosetimo kendo nowene. Mana kaka chiwo mag cham, chiwo mamoko nobed mag jadolo.’ ”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

kikuyu: Ne unego wuon ngima, to Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho. Wan wawegi wan joneno kuom wachni.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

kikuyu: To Laban nowachone niya, “Kapo ni ayudo ngʼwono e wangʼi to yie imed dak koda ka. Asefwenyo ma lingʼ-lingʼ ni Jehova Nyasaye osegwedha nikech in.”
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.”

kikuyu: Nomiyo giringo e kor gode manie piny kendo nomiyogi chiemo kod olembe manie puothe. Ne opidhogi mor kich mawuok e lwanda kod modhi mogol e lwanda.
english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

kikuyu: Kane agulnigo duto osepongʼ ne owachone achiel kuom yawuote niya, “Kelna machielo.” Nodwoke niya, “Onge agulu moro makoro odongʼ.” E sa nogono mo noweyo chwer.
english: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, tinde ere herani maduongʼ machon, hera mane isingori kuom adierani, ni initim ne Daudi?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

kikuyu: Ka inyalo konyo wadu kawuono, to kik iwachne niya, “Dogi iduog bangʼe kiny, eka akonyi.”
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

kikuyu: Mwandu gi luor ni kuoma, mwandu mochwere kod mewo.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

kikuyu: Eka rongʼonde nolengʼre ka nyakech kendo momni nokog gi mor. Pi nobubni kowuok e thim, kendo oula nomol kar ongoro.
english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

kikuyu: Wuon odno nowuok oko mi owachonegi niya, “Ooyo, osiepena, kik utim tim mamonono. Nimar ngʼatni en wendona, kik utim gima rachno.
english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

kikuyu: E higa ka higa in kod joodi onego uchamgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kama en owuon noyier.
english: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

kikuyu: Ok abed piny gi joma wuondore bende ok ariwra gi jo-miriambo.
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

kikuyu: To ne, asemiyo obedo janeno e kind ogendini, kendo asekete obedo jatelo mar ogendini.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

kikuyu: Makmana mondeu, nyithindu kod jambu (angʼeyo ni un gi jamni mangʼeny), mondo odag e dalane ma asemiyou,
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

kikuyu: To koro, ne odi oweni kodongʼ gunda. Awachoni ni, ok ininena kendo nyaka chop chiengʼ ma iniwach ni, ‘Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye.’”
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Osetimo timbe madongo gi bade; okeyo jogo masungore e parogi maiye.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

kikuyu: E konde ariyogi noriw chakre e tiende nyaka e wiye malo kendo sirnigo noriw machalre.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro joga biro dhi e twech nikech bedo maonge winjo; jotendgi kech biro nego, Kendo oganda modongʼ to riyo ema biro nego.
english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

kikuyu: Odhiambono, aluru nobiro moimo kambi kendo gokinyi ne nitie thoo momoko koluoro kambi.
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Koro chikuru itu mondo usiem nyikwa Jakobo.
english: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyarombo mobedo e kom loch mar Nyasaye nobed jakwadhgi; notelnigi koterogi e sokni mag pi ngima, to Nyasaye noywe pi wangʼ-gi duto.”
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

kikuyu: Okwongʼu un joma yiengʼ maber e kindeni, nimar unudeny. Okwongʼu un jogo manyiero sani, nimar ubiro kuyo kendo ywak.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

kikuyu: To agulu mane ichweyo gi lowo nokethore e lwete; omiyo jachwechno nochweye agulu machielo, kochweye maber kaka ne odwaro.
english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

kikuyu: bakul achiel mar dhahabu ma pekne ne en shekel apar, mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

kikuyu: To ka Ruoth ngʼadonwa bura to orieyowa mondo kik bura lowa kaachiel gi jopinyni.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

kikuyu: kowacho niya, “Duongʼ odogne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach ruodha Ibrahim, ma ok oseweyo nyiso adierane gi ngʼwonone ne ruodha. To an, Jehova Nyasaye osetelona e wuoth nyaka e od wede ruodha.”
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

kikuyu: Nimar ere dhano mosewinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye mangima kawuoyo koa e mach, kaka wasewinjo to pod wantie.
english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

kikuyu: Ruoth nomedo wachone Shimei niya, “Ingʼeyo e chunyi richo duto mane itimone wuonwa Daudi. Koro Jehova Nyasaye biro chuli kuom richo duto mane itimo.
english: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore the LORD will return your wickedness on your own head.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato orito chike Nyasaye to hera moherogo Nyasaye nenore kuome ratiro. To ma e kaka wanyalo bedo gi adiera ni wan ei Nyasaye:
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

kikuyu: nikech uwacho ni udwaro mondo ubed gi ratiro ka Kristo ema miya teko mar wuoyo adier. En ok onyap kotiyo kodu, to otiyo gi teko e dieru.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

kikuyu: Emomiyo koro amor ka aneno masiche nikech un, ka ringra chopo gik mane orem kuom masiche mane Kristo oneno nikech ringre Kristo owuon, ma en kanisa.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mane opwodhgi, Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo chik ni jo-Israel mondo omigi ma kaka pokgi mapile ne tienge mabiro.
english: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

kikuyu: to uwinj wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye joma otony modongʼ mag Juda. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Ka uramo ni nyaka udhi Misri kendo udhi udak kanyo,
english: now therefore hear the LORD’s word, O remnant of Judah! The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,

kikuyu: Hezekia nolokore kongʼiyo kor ot mi olamo Jehova Nyasaye kama,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,

kikuyu: Yaye piny, weuru luor; bed mamor kendo moil, adiera Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gik madongo.
english: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things.

kikuyu: Kaka koro osekawa ni an jaketho, angʼo ma dimi pod anyagra nono?
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

kikuyu: Yaw dhorangeye mondo oganda makare odonji, oganda morito yie.
english: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

kikuyu: Abiro wuoyo kuom ngʼwono mar Jehova Nyasaye, kuom timbene madongo mowinjore gi pak, kaluwore gi gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimonwa. Ee, gik mangʼeny duto mosetimo ne oganda Israel, kaluwore gi kech mare kod timbene mag ngʼwono duto.
english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Ibiro kwongʼou ka un e dala kata ka un oko.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

kikuyu: kendo cham biro nyak e piny, kaachiel gi divai manyien kod mo zeituni, mi giduto ginyag Jezreel.
english: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.

kikuyu: Jogo mane kelo chiwo mar dhahabu kata fedha kata mula nokelogi kaka chiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo ngʼato angʼata mane nigi yiend siala ne tich moro amora nokelo.
english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

kikuyu: Sibuoche ruto ka gimanyo chiemo; gimanyo chiembgi kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

kikuyu: Ka uloko yoreu gi timbeu adier kendo ungʼadone ngʼato ka ngʼato bura makare,
english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

kikuyu: To kane othiano ni jo-Israel, Jonathan wuod Shimea ma owadgi Daudi nonege.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

kikuyu: Mor polo miyo wangʼeyo ni koth maduongʼ chiegni chue, kendo koda ka jamni ongʼeyo ni koth ma kamano biro chue.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

kikuyu: Ibiro ndhogu kata mana gi jonywolu kod oweteu, wedeu gi osiepeu, kendo gibiro nego jomoko kuomu.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

kikuyu: Ne, koro eri achungo e bath sokoni, ka jatich ma nyako obiro omo pi kendo awachone niya, “Yaye miyae pi amodhi,”
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

kikuyu: rwath matin achiel, im achiel kod nyaim achiel matin ma hike achiel, nochiw misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: mane ochiworenwa mondo oreswa wawe timbe maricho kendo mondo opwodh ne en owuon joma owinjore bedo joge, moikore timo gik mabeyo.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

kikuyu: “Eka nowachona ni, ‘Nyasach kwerewa oseyieri mondo ingʼe dwarone kendo ine Jatichne Makare, kendo iwinj dwonde kowuoyo kodi.
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

kikuyu: Binui wuod Henadad nochako ogero migawo moro e dir Azaria, chakre e od Azaria nyaka kama otingʼore ma ohinga ogomogo.
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ gotieno walamo Nyasaye gi chunywa duto mondo olosnwa thuolo mar nenou kendo wangʼ gi wangʼ, mondo wabi wapongʼnu kuonde morem e yie maru.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

kikuyu: To Daudi nowachone ne Saulo niya, “Anto an ngʼa kata anywolana kata dhood gi wuora gin angʼo e Israel ma dimi abed or ruoth?”
english: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”

kikuyu: Ka Arfaksad ne ja-higni piero adek gabich nonywolo Shela.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Galatia, mofuwogi! En ngʼa moseirou? Un mane onyisu wach tho mar Yesu Kristo maler mana ka gima ne unene gi wangʼu kigure!
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

kikuyu: Omiyo Samuel nodok gi Saulo, kendo Saulo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped the LORD.

kikuyu: Nikech nomaka githuon ka igola e piny jo-Hibrania, kendo kata mana kaonge gima rach ma asetimo manyalo miyo abedie od twech ka.”
english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Zedekia nowacho niya, “En e lwetu. Onge gima ruoth nyalo timo mondo okwed wachu.”
english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”

kikuyu: Nomiyo winyogo olwar piny nyaka ei kambi mine gilworo hembegi duto koni gi koni.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

kikuyu: To kanyono ei sinagogi ne nitie ngʼat moro mane nigi jachien marach. Ngʼatni noywak matek kowacho niya,
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

kikuyu: Wach mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro nyadiriyo ni janabi Hagai chiengʼ tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen mar dweno:
english: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

kikuyu: Abiro olo mirimba mager kuomi kendo abiro olo mirimba maliel ka mach kuomi; bende abiro e lwet jo-mahundu, ma gin joma olony e ketho gik moko.
english: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.

kikuyu: Musa kod Eliazar jadolo nowuoyo kod jo-Israel e pewe mag Moab mantiere e loka Jordan kod Jeriko mowachonegi niya,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Nyiego nomako pinje mag ogendini, to koro mirimbi osechopo. Kinde osechopo mar ngʼado bura ni joma otho, kendo chiwo mich ni jotichni ma jonabi, gi jogi maler kod jogo moluoro nyingi, jomatindo gi jomadongo. Kendo tieko jogo maketho piny.”
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Joram nolokore moa gi ngʼwech kokok ne Ahazia niya, “Ja-andhoga Ahazia!”
english: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

kikuyu: Ne aritou e piny motwo, maliel ka mach.
english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane jochiende owuok kuome, nosaye mondo oyie odhi kode, to Yesu notame, kawachone niya,
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

kikuyu: An to achalo yiend zeituni madongo maber e od Nyasaye; ageno kuom hera ma ok rem mar Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

kikuyu: To negilingʼ thi. Eka nokawo ngʼatno, nochange kendo noweye odhi.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

kikuyu: Ka sunga biro, eka wichkuot bende biro, to muolo biro kod rieko.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

kikuyu: Josunga ma wengegi tek monja, yaye Nyasaye; migawo mar joma ok kech ngʼato dwaro tieko ngimana, joma ok dew kata in.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

kikuyu: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, to gi Vaizatha,
english: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

kikuyu: ‘Notergi Babulon kendo kanyo ginidongʼ nyaka odiechiengʼ ma anabi kawogie. Eka anadwog-gi kendo aketgi kae.’ ” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says the LORD; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”

kikuyu: Mad Nyasach Ibrahim, kod Nahor, gi Nyasach kwereni obed jangʼad bura e kindwa.” Omiyo Jakobo notimo kwongʼruok e nying Nyasach Isaka wuon-gi.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama, “E odiechiengno anachok rongʼonde, gi joma oter e twech kod joma asekelo negi lit.
english: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

kikuyu: to ka dipo ni ngʼato owinjo dwond tungʼ, to ok odewo siemno, mi ligangla obiro monege, to rembe nobed e wiye owuon.
english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

kikuyu: Wach Ruoth Nyasaye nolandore e gwengʼno duto.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

kikuyu: Roho Maler nonyisa ni kik adeki ma ok adhi kodgi. Jowete auchielgi bende nodhi koda, mine wadonjo e od Kornelio.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama timbene richo moro amora mane ochune mondo ogolne osuru; onge ngʼama timbene richo moro amora ma nosande.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: To an donge dakech Nineve dala maduongʼ man kod ji alufu mia achiel kod piero ariyo ma ok nyal pogo lwetgi ma korachwich gi ma koracham kaachiel kod jambgi mangʼeny?”
english: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”

kikuyu: Eka Josef nongʼiewo nanga marep-rep, mi noloro ringre piny moboye gi nanga marep-rep eka nokete e bur mane osekunyo ariwa e kor lwanda. Bangʼe nongʼielo kidi mi oumogo dho liendno.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nyundo mar piny ngima otur kendo obarore! Mano kaka Babulon odongʼ, gunda e dier pinje!
english: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

kikuyu: “Ikuru okumba magu, madongo kod matindo, kendo uwuog udhi e kedo!
english: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

kikuyu: Kuom mano negimiyo wuon-gi kongʼo momer gotieno kendo nyako matin nodonjo ma oriwore kode. Kendo ne ok ongʼeyo seche mane nyare matin-no ochako kata otieko riwore kode.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

kikuyu: Johana owuon ne ok en ler nogo, to nobiro mana kaka janeno mar lerno.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik igomb terori gi chi owadgi wuonu nikech en minu, kendo mano kelo wichkuot ne wuonuno.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nomiyo ruoth madhako mar Sheba gik moko duto mane chunye dwaro kendo mane okwayo; kendo nomiye gik moko mangʼeny moloyo gik mane okelone. Eka nowuok mi odok e pinye kaachiel gi jotije.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

kikuyu: To mane onywolne kod chiege ma Hushim, ne gin Abitub kod Elpal.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: nopuonja kowacho niya, “Mak matek wechena gi chunyi duto, rit chikena eka inibed mangima.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

kikuyu: “ ‘Koro paruru anena gima biro timore chakre kawuono, kane pok uchako gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye to ne ochalo nade?
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nochoro Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego e telo mamalo e piny Babulon.
english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

kikuyu: Jakobo nodak Misri kuom higni apar gabiriyo kendo ndalo hike duto noromo higni mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gabiriyo.
english: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Hemb Romo nochungi chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo e higa mar ariyo.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

kikuyu: “An bende mor ma kamano miyo chunya bwok kendo ridore.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Nyinge maler nigi duongʼ; chuny joma manyo Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed mamor.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Nangʼicho to ne aneno faras marabuor e nyima! Ngʼat moidhe niluongo ni Tho, to piny joma otho ne luwo bangʼe machiegni. Ne omigi teko kuom bath piny moromo achiel kuom angʼwen mondo gimi lweny kata kech kata dera kata tuoche kata ondiegi maricho mag bungu mondo gineg ji.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

kikuyu: Koro Adonija ma min-gi niluongo ni Hagith noyiedhore mowacho niya, “Abiro bedo ruoth.” Omiyo noiko geche kod farese kod joidh farese piero abich mondo oring e nyime.
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

kikuyu: Andikoni in Timotheo wuoda mar adier kuom yie: Ngʼwono gi kech kod kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro gi Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa obed kodu.
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: “To nodwoko ni, ‘Ok abi dhi.’ Kata kamano bangʼe achien noloko pache mi odhi.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

kikuyu: to ka watimo kinda, to wanalochi kode bende; to ka wakwede, to en bende nokwedwa;
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

kikuyu: Kane pod giwuoro wachni, apoyo nono ji ariyo morwakore gi lewni mangʼangʼni ka mil polo nochungo butgi.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

kikuyu: “Kik uthir dhako ma chwore otho kata nyathi kich.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

kikuyu: Asekano wachni ei chunya mondo kik akethi e nyimi.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

kikuyu: We wami wuonwa kongʼo omadhi kendo ka osemer, to wariwre kode kendo wanywol nyithindo mondo kik ogandawa lal.”
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Lor piny idog ir jogi mane igolo kawuok e piny Misri nikech gisekethore”
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

kikuyu: Eka Josef nowacho ne owetene niya, “Koro achiegni tho. To Nyasaye biro resou kendo golou e pinyni mi oteru e piny mane osingore ka okwongʼore ne Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo.”
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

kikuyu: to luoro Nyasaye to medeuru ngʼwono mar owete; to ngʼwono mar owete to medeuru hera.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

kikuyu: Eka Musa noluongo jodong Israel duto mowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato oyier nyarombo kata nyadiel ne joode kendo uyangʼ-gi ka utimogo Pasaka.
english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.

kikuyu: Kik ikaw chunya kaachiel gi joricho, kik ikaw ngimana kod joma ohero chwero remo,
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

kikuyu: Jorito noromo koda kane giwuotho gotieno e alwora mar dala. Ne gigoya marach ma gihinya; kendo jorito marichogo, ne omaya lawa!
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.

kikuyu: To Maria nowacho niya, “Chunya opako Ruoth
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
