kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye mane ogolou Misri gi teko mangʼongo korieyo lwete, en ema nyaka ulame. En ema onego ukulrune kendo en ema uchiwne misengini.
english: but you shall fear the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

kikuyu: Poguru giu gi jo-Nyasaye mochando. Beduru joma ohero rwako welo.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

kikuyu: Asedoko jatich mar kanyakla mar joma oyie kaluwore gi ote mane Nyasaye oorago iru mondo ayalnu wechene duto,
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

kikuyu: Abiro paki gi nyatiti nikech adiera mari, yaye Nyasaye; abiro weroni wend pak gi orutu, yaye Nyasaye Maler mar Israel.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: ma gin joma osiko mana ka miya mirima e wangʼa awuon, ka gitimo misengini e puothe, kendo giwangʼo ubani e kendo molos gi matafare;
english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

kikuyu: Eka nomiyo ruoth dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu angʼwen mia abich, gi gik mangʼeny mangʼwe ngʼar kaachiel gi kite ma nengogi tek. Ne ok ochak okel kendo gik mangʼeny mangʼwe ngʼar marom gi mago mane ruoth madhako mar Sheba nomiyo Ruoth Solomon.
english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

kikuyu: Debora, janabi madhako, ma chi Lapidoth, notelo ne jo-Israel e kindeno.
english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

kikuyu: Kamano jo-Israel nokelo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gigoyo sigalagala gi tunge im, gi turumbete kod ongengʼo kendo ka gigoyo orutu kod nyatiti.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi nyaka ei kama ler mar lemo mi nopimo sirni mag rangach midonjogo, siro ka siro lachne ne en fut adek. Lach mar rangach midonjogo ne en fut ochiko, kendo lach mar ohinga mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko, mane olworo bathe koni gi koni ne romo fut apar gi nus.
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

kikuyu: Ahimelek nopenjone wach kuom Jehova Nyasaye, nomiye chiemo bende gi ligangla mar Goliath ja-Filistia.”
english: He inquired of the LORD for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

kikuyu: Anagwedhgi kamano nikech Ibrahim noluora kendo norito dwarona, chikena, buchena kod wechena.”
english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

kikuyu: Chunygi nodoko malit ahinya, kendo negichako wachone moro ka moro niya, “Ruoth, dobed an koso?”
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

kikuyu: Abiro reto kendo ok abi deko mar rito chikeni.
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodonjo e ot mogoyo chonge e tiend Elisha mi okulore nyaka e lowo. Bangʼ mano nokawo wuode mi odhi.
english: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

kikuyu: mondo kik Satan lowa gi riekone, nikech wangʼeyo chenro mage.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

kikuyu: Eka nooro wach e piny Israel duto mi jodong Baal duto nobiro; kendo onge kata mana ngʼato achiel mane odongʼ. Negipongʼo ii hekaluno duto koni gi koni.
english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ti kode ka iwirogo Hemb Romo, Sandug Muma mar Singruok,
english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

kikuyu: Nyasaye noketo chuny marach e kind Abimelek kod jo-Shekem mi gidhawo kode kendo gingʼanyone.
english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

kikuyu: Nochako oketo kido machielo mopimo kama borne oromo fut alufu achiel gi mia abich, to koro pigno nolokore aora mane ok anyal kadho nikech pigno nopongʼ kendo notut makoro ne anyalo mana goe abal. Koro en aora mane onge ngʼama nyalo kalo.
english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama wach donjone, onge ngʼama dwaro Nyasaye.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

kikuyu: Nyasach kwe biro miyo unyon Satan gi tiendu. Ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Joote biro biro koa Misri; Kush bende biro bolore ne Nyasaye.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

kikuyu: Asin kendo ajok gi miriambo, to ahero chikni.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Lebanon nobini, yien mabeyo duto mag obudo kod saipras nokelni, mondo olosgo kara maler mar lemo kendo abiro miyo kar yweyo mar tienda duongʼ.
english: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

kikuyu: Eka Simon Petro, mane oyudo nigi ligangla, nowuodho liganglane kendo notongʼo jatij jadolo maduongʼ mi ochodo ite ma korachwich, kendo nying jatijno ne en Malko.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noketho chike kod dwarone mane okwedowa kendo ne opogowa. Ne ogole oko mi ogure e msalaba.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

kikuyu: Eka ji mia auchiel moa e dhood joka Dan, mane oikore ne lweny, nowuok oa Zora kod Eshtaol.
english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

kikuyu: Jower bende nokel kanyakla koa e gwenge machiegni gi Jerusalem kaka miech jo-Netofath,
english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;

kikuyu: Pok mokwongo mar Asaf nodhine Josef gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo, Pok mar ariyo ne mar Gedalia gi wedene kod yawuote, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

kikuyu: An to pacha neno ni dhako ma chwore otho nyalo neno maber moloyo ka ok ochak onywome, kendo awacho mano ka aparo ni an-gi Roho mar Nyasaye.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osechier oa kuom joma otho, jopuonjrene noparo gima nowachono. Omiyo ne giyie kuom Ndiko kod weche mane Yesu osewacho.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

kikuyu: Nothonwa mondo kata ka wangima kata ka watho to wadag kode.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

kikuyu: Arito Jehova Nyasaye, chunya rite kendo aketo genona kuom wachne.
english: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka kwar mare Daudi notimo.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka le moyienu chamo otho, to ngʼato angʼata momule nobed mogak nyaka chop seche mag odhiambo.
english: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼ Jehova Nyasaye okayo machiegni ne ogendini duto, bende kaka isetimo e kaka notimni, timbeni nodwogi e wiyi iwuon.
english: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

kikuyu: Isemiye gima chunye gombo kendo pok idagi timone kwayone. Sela
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Ne ibiro mondo ires jogi, mondo iwar ngʼatno mowal. Ne inyono jatend piny richo, ne ilonye duk koa e tiende piny nyaka e wiye. Sela
english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, ka ayudo ngʼwono e nyim wangʼi, to yie idhi kodwa. Kata obedo ni jogi gin joma tokgi tek kamano, to wenwa kuom timbewa mamono kod richowa kendo kwan-wa kaka mwanduni.”
english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowacho ni Jonathan niya, “Wachna gima isetimo.” Jonathan nowachone niya, “Ne abilo mor kich matin mane ni e dho ludha. Koro ochuno ni nyaka atho?”
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”

kikuyu: Nokawo jotend migepe mag jolweny mia achiel-ka, jood ruoth, jotend ji kaachiel gi jopinyno duto kendo negigolo ruoth oko mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Negidhi e od ruoth ka giluwo Rangach Mamalo kendo giketo ruoth e kom duongʼne.
english: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the LORD’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

kikuyu: Noyalo kuom pinyruoth Nyasaye gichir ma ok ngʼato ogengʼe, kopuonjo ji kuom Ruoth Yesu Kristo.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

kikuyu: Aseketou e dho ligangla, kendo un duto unugo chongu kar nek; nimar ne aluongou, to onge ngʼama ne odwoko, ne awuoyo kodu to onge ngʼama nowinjo. Ne utimo timbe mamono e nyima, kendo uyiero mana gik mamorou.”
english: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni wagero kendowa mar misango owuon mondo waa ir Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo wachiw misango miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mar cham, kata ni wachiw misango mar lalruok kuome, to mad Jehova Nyasaye kumwa kaka joma osetimo richo.
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let the LORD himself require it.

kikuyu: Kuom nyiseche duto mag pinjegi, en mane mosereso pinye e lweta? To koro ere kaka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo reso Jerusalem e lweta?”
english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

kikuyu: “E kinde ma lochgi chiegni rumo, jongʼanyo notim timbe maricho mogik, ruoth moro nobi ma wangʼe tek kendo matimo gik maricho.
english: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding riddles, will stand up.

kikuyu: Yamo futo kochiko yo milambo kendo okudho kochiko yo nyandwat; odhi kolworore, ndalo duto koduogo kare mapile.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

kikuyu: Mad ochal nanga moumogo dende duto, kata kamba motweyego nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

kikuyu: Kaw remb rwadhno moko kendo iwirie tunge kendo mar misango gi lith lweti to modongʼ to ipuk e bwo kendo mar misangono.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Ewi raum kanyo e kind kerubi ariyo manie wi Sandug Muma, ema abiro romoe kodi kendo kanyo ema namiyie chikena mondo iterne jo-Israel.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Nikech yor waro dhano tek ahinya, maonge nengo madichul marom,
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

kikuyu: “E kindeno, noyudo ka wuowi maduongʼ ni e puodho. Kane obiro machiegni gi ot nowinjo wer gi miel.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno kik uyie roho duto, to temgiuru mondo ufwenygi ka bende gia kuom Nyasaye nikech jonabi mag miriambo mathoth osebiro e piny koni gi koni.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

kikuyu: kod kuonde mopie mag holo matut, kendo diny mochiko kar tich mar Ar kendo manie e kiewo mar Moab.”
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

kikuyu: Yesu ne kit Nyasaye nyaka aa chakruok, to ne ok okwano bedo marom gi Nyasaye ka gima nyaka lar,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

kikuyu: Ber mar wangʼ wuondo ji, to chia bende rumo; to dhako moluoro Jehova Nyasaye yudo pak.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

kikuyu: Kik iyie mondo mon ma chwogi otho ma pod tindo ndik nying-gi kama indikoe nying mon ma chwogi otho. Nikech ka ringregi ohewogi gi gombo to giweyo Kristo ka gimanyo chwo mondo okendgi.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

kikuyu: An, kata owetena kata joga kata jorit mane ni koda ne ok ogolo lepgi; moro ka moro notingʼo liganglane mar lweny, kata mana ka wadhi tuomo pi.
english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

kikuyu: Eka mondo udhi mapiyo unyis jopuonjrene ni, ‘Osechier oa kuom joma otho kendo otelo e nyimu odhi Galili. Kuno ema ubiro nenee.’ Ero koro asenyisou.”
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

kikuyu: Asekedo lweny maber, aseringo mi atieko ngʼwech, aserito yie marwa,
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho niya, “Koro winji wuod Ahitub.” Nodwoke niya, “Ruodha awinjo.”
english: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”

kikuyu: Timbene ne richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka kwerene notimo, kendo ne ok oweyo richo mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka dhako chwer ndalo mogwarore e kinde ma ok one malo, kata ka ochwer mokadho ndalo ma ojanene malo, to enobed mogak kuom ndalo duto ma pod ochwerieno mana machalre kaka ndalone monenoe malo.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye mor gi yor ngʼato, to omiyo yorene bedo mopie;
english: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

kikuyu: tula, nyatawo gi okok kod kit olith duto
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

kikuyu: Kuom mano jowetena, kane abiro iru to ne ok abiro gi weche mamit kata gi rieko kayalonu matut wach ma lingʼ-lingʼ mar Nyasaye.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

kikuyu: Ji ok cha jakuo kokwalo chiemo mondo ogaago kech kodenyo.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

kikuyu: Jehu nowachonegi niya, “Diruru dhakono piny!” Omiyo negidire piny ma rembe moko okirore e kor ohinga ka farase nyone piny.
english: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

kikuyu: To awachonu adier ni ka oyude to obedo mamor kuom rombo achielno, moloyo kuom piero ochiko gochiko mane ok olal.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

kikuyu: Fweny mane jonabi magi oneno ne ok adiera, to gin mana miriambo lilo, ne ok ginyisi richoni mondo omi kik teri e twech. To fweny mane ginyisi ne gin mana weche mag miriambo kendo ma wito ji.
english: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “En ngʼa manonyisi ni in duk? Dibed ni isechamo olemb yien mane akweri ni kik icham?”
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

kikuyu: Joma osetiyo maber yudo nying maber kendo gibedo gi chir e yie margi kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Dalano ok dwar chiengʼ kata dwe mondo orienyne, nikech duongʼ Nyasaye ema miye ler, kendo Nyarombo e tache.
english: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

kikuyu: Wadak kuom yie to ok kuom gik mwaneno.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

kikuyu: Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mager nobiro kuom jo-Israel ma nojwangʼogi e lwet jo-Kushan-Rishathaim ruodh Aram-Naharaim, ma jo-Israel nobedo wasumbinigi kuom higni aboro.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni richo kod yanyo Nyasaye ma dhano osetimo nowenegi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Nyasaye nochiew ka gima oa e nindo, mana kaka ngʼato chiewo, bangʼ madho divai mangʼeny.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

kikuyu: Kane okwayo, Jehova Nyasaye noneno bolruokne mowinjo ywakne omiyo nodwoge Jerusalem e pinyruodhe; bangʼe Manase nongʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye.
english: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God.

kikuyu: “Chik jo-Israel kiwachonegi kama: Ka usedonjo e piny Kanaan, ma en piny manomiu kaka poku, tongʼne nochal kama:
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar adek Ibrahim notingʼo wangʼe moneno kanyo gi kuma bor.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

kikuyu: to yie iwinji gie polo kama idakie. Wenegi richogi kendo tim ne ngʼato ka ngʼato gima owinjore gi gik motimo nikech ingʼeyo chunygi (nikech in kendi ema ingʼeyo chuny dhano),
english: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

kikuyu: Un usedoko maler nikech wach ma asewachonu.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

kikuyu: Tienda osesiko e yoreni; tiendena pok okier.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Daudi nomedo kendo mon mamoko Jerusalem kendo nonywolo yawuowi gi nyiri mangʼeny.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Farisai nopenje kaka nokelo neno. To ngʼatno nodwokogi niya, “Nende oketo chwodho e wengena, bangʼe aluoko mi koro aneno.”
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata kuom joge manie dieru, mad Nyasache bed kode, mondo odhi Jerusalem man Juda mi oger hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, Nyasaye man Jerusalem.
english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Eka wuon nyako kod min nokel gima nyiso ni en kod ringre ne jodongo e ranga dala.
english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

kikuyu: Joshua notimonigi kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko. Nongʼado odond tiend farese kendo nowangʼo gechegi.
english: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ne ok anyal wuoyo kodu kaka joma nigi Roho, to mana kaka jopiny ma pod mana nyithindo mayom kuom Kristo.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

kikuyu: To malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Elija ja-Tishbi niya, “Dhiyo mondo irom gi joote mag ruodh Samaria mondo ipenjgi ni, ‘Nyasaye onge e Israel ka koso mamiyo upenjo Baal-Zebub ma nyasach jo-Ekron wach?’
english: But the LORD’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

kikuyu: “ ‘Eka joma odak e mier matindo mag Israel nowuog oko mi giti gi gigegi mag lweny kaka yien mitedogo, kendo giniwangʼ okumbni madongo gi matindo, kuode kod aserni, arunge mag lweny kod tonge. Kuom higni abiriyo giniti kodgi kuom chwako mach.
english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

kikuyu: Achayo chokruok mar joma timo gik maricho kendo ok ayie bet piny gi joricho.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

kikuyu: Bed ni wuon-gi kata min-gi kata owadgi kata nyamin-gi ema otho, to ok onego obed mogak, nikech ranyisi mar bedo ngʼat mowal ne Nyasaye ni e wiye.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

kikuyu: Nochiwo siem ne kanyakla mar oganda niya, “Suduru mabor gi hembe jogo ma timbegi richo! Kik umul girgi moro amora, ka ok kamano to ubiro lal nono nikech richo mag-gi.”
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

kikuyu: Gibiro moko e kind kuthe kendo gibiro mer gi divai mag-gi, bende ibiro wangʼ-gi ka lum motwo.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

kikuyu: To koro osedwoki piny e bur matut nyaka e piny joma otho.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.

kikuyu: E sa ma jachiendno donjo kuome to goye piny, buoyo wuok e dhoge, kendo omuodo lake mi dende tal. Ne akwayo jopuonjreni mondo oriemb jachiendni oko to ne otamogi.”
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

kikuyu: Eka nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Cham ochiek mathoth to jotich nok.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisegole, Jehova Nyasaye nokelo chandruok ne dala maduongʼno momiyo luoro malich omakogi. Ne ogoyo jomatindo gi jomadongo mar dala maduongʼno gi tuo buche.
english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, the LORD’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

kikuyu: Chiwuru misango miwangʼo pep mag nyirwedhi ariyo, im achiel gi nyirombe abiriyo mahikgi en achiel kaka gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

kikuyu: Eka ji duto manodak e dalano nowuok oko mondo girom gi Yesu. To kane ginene, negiywagorene mondo oa e gwengʼ-gi.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

kikuyu: In to ibet e kom lochni nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; humbi osiko e tienge duto.
english: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

kikuyu: Apenjo kendo ni: Dibed ni negipodho ma ok nyal resgi koso? Ok kamano ngangʼ! To nikech ketho mag-gi, warruok koro osebiro ne joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo omi Israel obed gi nyiego.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

kikuyu: To Sabato ka Sabato, ne opuonjo ji e sinagogi, kotemo loko jo-Yahudi gi jo-Yunani.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Lweny ne nitie e kind Rehoboam gi Jeroboam e kinde duto mar ngima Abija.
english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

kikuyu: mondo yieu kik gurre kuom rieko dhano, to ogurre mana kuom teko Nyasaye.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

kikuyu: Negikawo pinye gi piny Og ruodh Bashan, mane gin gi ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor man loka yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan.
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho niya, “Kelna ligangla.” Omiyo negikelone ruoth ligangla.
english: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

kikuyu: nobiro ir Nowa kendo nodonjo kodgi ei yie mana kaka Nyasaye nochike.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

kikuyu: Ne awacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kecha; changa, nikech aseketho e nyimi.”
english: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

kikuyu: Chikno biro puonji kuom gima ler kod gima ogak. Magi e chike mag tuoche malandore e del kod mag gik mopur.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

kikuyu: Negikelo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye mi gikete kare ei hema mane Daudi osegurone, kendo Daudi notimo misango miwangʼo pep gi misengini mag lalruok michiwo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu chiemo e od Lawi, josol osuru mangʼeny kod joricho mangʼeny ne chiemo kode kaachiel gi jopuonjrene, nimar jogo mane luwo bangʼe ne ngʼeny.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Moab notieki kaka oganda nikech ne otamore winjo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD.

kikuyu: Nikech waduto wan jotich kaachiel kod Nyasaye; un to un puoth Nyasaye kendo ot ma Nyasaye gero.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

kikuyu: Isaya nowachonegi niya, “Nyisuru ruodhu ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Kik ibed maluor kuom weche misewinjo, wechego ma ruodh Asuria oseyanyago.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

kikuyu: Chunygi chalo gi kendo, gidhi ire ka gisechano timo timbe mochido. Gombogi liet ka maa otieno, kochopo okinyi to omuoch ka mach maliel.
english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

kikuyu: Alokora gima bwogo ji mangʼeny to kata kamano in e kar pondo mara motegno.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

kikuyu: Ne giketone kite mag oniks e yo michanogo dhahabu kendo negikedogi kaka ikedo kido ka gindiko nying yawuot Israel kuome.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, Nyasaye ne ok omor gi ji mangʼeny kuomgi, kendo ringregi nodongʼ e thim.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Gima omiyo ne aweyi Krete ne en ni mondo irie gik moko mane odongʼ kapok atieko, kendo mondo iyier jodong kanisa e dala ka dala, kaka ne achiki ni itim.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

kikuyu: Koro sani waonge gi ndhandhu mar chiemo; kendo ok wane gimoro amora makmana manna-gi!”
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

kikuyu: Mad lewa moki e danda ka dipo ni ok apari, ka dipo ni ok aketo chunya kuomi, yaye Jerusalem, morna maduongʼ mogik.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

kikuyu: To noyudo jadolo moro wuotho koluwo, yorno, to kane oneno ngʼatno, nobaro moluwo bath yo komachielo.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Abisalom nonywolo yawuowi adek gi nyako achiel. Nyare ne iluongo ni Tamar, kendo nodongo nyako ma jaber.
english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

kikuyu: Timuru kinda kuom lemo, kurito gi paro moyawore, kendo kugoyo erokamano ni Nyasaye.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechano mar timo ma, en ngʼa manyalo gengʼe? Oserieyo bade, to en ngʼa manyalo tame?
english: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

kikuyu: Bende ubiro aa kanyo gi lweteu ka uketo ewiu, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osedagi joma ugeno kuomgi; ok ginikonyu.”
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won’t prosper with them.

kikuyu: Muofni neno, rongʼonde wuotho, jogo man-gi dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo wach, joma otho ichiero, kendo Injili iyalo ne joma odhier.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Dhiuru ir oganda kendo unyisgi ni, ‘Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu mondo okelna dhogene kod rombege, kendo oneg-gi ka mi uchamgi. Kik utim richo ne Jehova Nyasaye kuom chamo ringʼo motimo remo.’ ” Omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato ne okelo rwadhe otienono mine giyangʼogi kanyo.
english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against the LORD in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

kikuyu: E thuoloni weche mwangʼeyo tin, to bende wakoro bath wach, ma mago mabiro chopo kare tin,
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wende miwero gi asili. Zaburi Mar Daudi. Chik iti mondo iwinj wechena, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, para kuom pek manie chunya.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

kikuyu: to ji duto notemo mondo omule, nikech teko ne aa kuome mochangogi duto.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

kikuyu: Yie ichik iti kendo iyaw wangʼi mondo iwinj lemo ma jatichni lamo odiechiengʼ gotieno ne jotichni, ma gin jo-Israel. Ahulo richowa ma wan jo-Israel, kaachiel gi an kod od wuora wasetimoni;
english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

kikuyu: Kik ihangne ngʼato wach maonge gima omiyo, kaonge gima rach mosetimoni.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

kikuyu: Osegol Chik ni dala maduongʼ nyaka maki ma ter e piny ma wendo. Wasumbinigi ma nyiri ywagore ka akuche kendo ka gidwongʼo korgi.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

kikuyu: Wangʼe nobed makwar moloyo divai kendo lake nobed matar ka chak.
english: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

kikuyu: Ne iterowa e od twech kendo ne iketo lodi mapek e dier ngʼewa.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

kikuyu: Daudi nokawo kuodi molos gi dhahabu mane otingʼ gi jotend lweny mag Hadadezer mi okelogi Jerusalem.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ywag jo-Misri ma oganda maduongʼ, kendo iwitgi e piny joma otho kendo gibed kuno gi ogendini mamoko maroteke.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Yawuot Mushi ne gin: Mali, Eder kod Jerimoth, giduto ne gin ji adek.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

kikuyu: Heber nonywolo Jaflet gi Shomer gi Hotham gi nyamin-gi Shua.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nogolo chik ni Ashpenaz, ma jatelo maduongʼ mar jotij od ngʼado bura mondo okelne jo-Israel moko mogen mane oa e anywola joka ruoth,
english: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

kikuyu: Tiuru gi rapim ma ok riambi kendo mapimo gimoro makare. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mane ogolou e piny Misri.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Pi mondo opongʼ gi gik mangima, kendo winy mondo ofu ewi piny e kor polo.”
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

kikuyu: To adwaro mondo ungʼe ni Kristo ewi dichwo ka dichwo, kendo ni dichwo ewi dhako, to Nyasaye ewi Kristo.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

kikuyu: Sayun nowinjo wachno mi obedo moil, miech Juda bende nobedo mamor, nikech bucheni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo duto mag ruodh Babulon nobiro kendo obet e Dhorangach Madiere: Negal-Shareza ma ja-Samgar, Nebo-Sasekim jatelo maduongʼ, Negal-Shareza jatelo mamalo maduongʼ kod jotelo mamoko duto mag ruodh Babulon.
english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Nowacho kendo niya, “En yo mane ma wanyalo pimogo pinyruoth Nyasaye, kata en ngero mane manyalo nyisowa kite?
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “E dala moro ne nitie jangʼad bura mane ok oluoro Nyasaye kata ok odewo ji.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

kikuyu: Giseriambo kuom Jehova Nyasaye; kagiwacho, “Onge gima obiro timo! Ok wanahinyre; ok wanane ligangla kata kech.
english: They have denied the LORD, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone niya, “Nyara, yieni osechangi. Dhi gi kwe.”
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Wachne ni, ‘Bed motangʼ, hori kendo kik iluor. Kik chunyi nyosre nikech osiki ariyo mag mach motimo iro, machal gi mirima mager mar Rezin kod Aram to gi mar wuod Remalia.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

kikuyu: Kik ulu kit puonj moro amora mayoreyore manyalo golou e yor adiera, nikech ngʼwono Nyasaye ema onego ojiw chunywa to ok puonj motenore kuom weche mag chiemo ma ok kel kony moro amora ni joma chamogi.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Simon Petro pod ochungʼ oyo mach, negipenje niya, “Idagi ni ok in achiel kuom jopuonjrene, koso iyie?” Nodagi kowacho niya, “Ooyo, ok an.”
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Nooro Sandug Muma e twech, mi duongʼne maler nodhi e lwet wasigu.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho mine aneno tiende angʼwen e bath kerubi, ka moro ka moro ni e bath kerubigo. Tiendego ne mil ka kite ma nengogi tek.
english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

kikuyu: Chiega ok dwar winjo tikna; kendo kata mana owetena bende ok dwar sudo buta machiegni.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

kikuyu: ka dhou kod jambu omedore, fedha kod dhahabu bende omedore ma gik ma un-godo duto omedore
english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “En achiel kuomu ji apar gariyo, ngʼat machiemo koda e tawo achiel.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne anyisou magi duto chon, kapok negitimore, to ne asewachonugi, mondo omi kik uwach niya, ‘Nyisechena manono ema otimo magi; kido mopa mara kod nyasacha mar mula ema oselerona ma?’
english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’

kikuyu: Aijalon to gi Gath Rimon, kaachiel gi kuonde kweth.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Anaket koma mar duongʼ ei Elam, kendo atiek ruodhe kod jotende.”
english: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kaka ikumo jadak e kaka ikumo ja-Israel. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Jomoko nobiro kotingʼo ja-athany e par kendo negitemo mondo gitere ei ot mondo gikele e nyim Yesu.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

kikuyu: “Gilandore ka holni, mana ka puothe mantiere e bath aora, mana ka mane-mane ma Jehova Nyasaye opidho, bende mana ka yiend sida mopidh but pi.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nolawogi kendo nohinyo jo-farese kod jo-geche mi nonego jo-Aram mangʼeny.
english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

kikuyu: Notimo timbe mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok oweyo timbe mag richo mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo; nodhi nyime kotimogi.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osegoya modwa nega, to kata kamano pok oweyo tho onega.
english: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

kikuyu: “Unune malit nikech ugero, kendo umwono liete jonabi, to kwereu ema nonegogi.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

kikuyu: Nikech wadak kuom Roho, wasikuru mana ka wawuotho kuom Roho.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

kikuyu: Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka anaduogu e piny Israel, piny mane asingora kakwongʼora ni anami kwereu.
english: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

kikuyu: Bathsheba nowachone niya, “An-gi kwayo matin madwaro kwayo to yie kik itama.” Ruoth to nodwoke niya, “Kwaye akwaya minwa nimar ok anatami.”
english: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ukayo cham manie puotheu, to kik ugol cham duto nyaka manie giko puodho, kata kik uhul nyaka cham modongʼ.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

kikuyu: Onge gima ber ma dhano nyalo timo moloyo chiemo kod metho mi oyud mor e tije. Ma bende, aneno ni oa mana e lwet Nyasaye.
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

kikuyu: Apwodhora nikech gin, mondo omi gin bende gipwodhreni gi adiera.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

kikuyu: negineno mi gibuok; kendo negiringo gia ka luoro omakogi.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

kikuyu: Jo-Nineve biro chungʼ e bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadnegi bura kaka joketho; nimar gin ne giweyo richo kane giwinjo yalo mar Jona, to sani koro nitie ngʼato maduongʼ moloyo Jona.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: to ne odwoka niya, “Ngʼwonona mamiyi oromi, nikech kama nyawo nitie ema tekona tiyoe moloyo.” Emomiyo, abiro medo pakora gi ilo kuom nyawona, eka teko mar Kristo osik kuoma.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye ne ok otieko od Daudi nikech noparo singruok mane otimo kode. Nosesingore ne Daudi gi ogandane ni ginibed e loch nyaka chiengʼ.
english: However the LORD would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

kikuyu: Luoro nomako Adonija nikech Solomon, omiyo nodhi momako tunge mag kendo mar misango.
english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Wachne jo-Israel niya, Ka ngʼato okwongʼo Nyasache, to oyud kum moromo gi kethono,
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: Kinyne, kane gibiro gilor gia e got, oganda maduongʼ noromone.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

kikuyu: Divai mobi manyien notuwo kendo mzabibu biro ner, ji duto mamiyo ji mor nobed gi chuny lit.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

kikuyu: Bende pi mamit gi pi makech nyalo wuok e soko achiel?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ok we ngʼat makare obed gi kech, to oketho gombo mar joricho.
english: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

kikuyu: Nodiro asernige mokeyo wasigu, mor polo gi mil polo noriembogi.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

kikuyu: Kendo Josef nomiyo yawuot Israel okwongʼore kendo owachonegi niya, “Nyasaye biro resou, kendo nyaka une ni ukawo chokena ka udhigo.”
english: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

kikuyu: To bende, kuom adier en nyaminwa, ma nyar wuora, to minewa ema opogore; kendo ne akende obedo chiega.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo ni wuonu gi joge gin jolweny, bende gin joma ger mana ka ondiek moma nyithinde. Bende nyaka ingʼe ni wuonu en jalweny mongʼith; ok obi nindo kama jolweny nindoe.
english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

kikuyu: Ananeg jogo modak e dala maduongʼni, chwo kaachiel gi le kendo masira malich noneg-gi.
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.

kikuyu: Nongʼiewu gi nengo matek, omiyo kik ubed wasumbini mag ji.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

kikuyu: Idak gi joma oyie kawo asoya mondo gichwer remo; umayo ji kendo ukawo ohala malangʼ kuom gik muholo ji; kendo kuom wuochu mokalo tongʼ, uwuondo joweteu kumayogi marach. Kendo wiu osewil koda, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema asewacho kamano.
english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Seche moko bor polo ne ni kanyo chakre odhiambo nyaka okinyi kende, to kane oyawore gokinyi to negichako wuoth. Bed ni en odiechiengʼ kata otieno, to e kinde ma bor polo noyawore, negichako wuoth.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

kikuyu: Ahaz nooro joote mondo okone Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh Asuria kowacho niya, “An jatichni kendo anie e bwo lochni. Bi mondo iresa e lwet ruodh Aram kendo e lwet ruodh Israel mosemonja.”
english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

kikuyu: kuom mano, adagi kaachiel gi aoregi, kendo abiro loko piny Misri kama okethore, motwo kendo maonge tich, chakre Migdol nyaka Aswan, machop nyaka tongʼne gi Kush.
english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.

kikuyu: Jadolo nojuk mogo mayom sanja gi mo kaachiel gi ubani mi oriwgi gi misango mar cham, kendo nowangʼ sanja ma ojukono kaka rapar e kendo mar misango mondo odungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kik iter tiendi pile e od jabuti, dhiyo kuno pile, biro miyo ochayi.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

kikuyu: Dhiuru ir jodolo magin jo-Lawi kendo kuom jangʼad bura manie tich sano. Nonuru wach kuomgi kendo gini ngʼadnu bura.
english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “To ne jobatha duto ma timbegi mono mamayo joga Israel girkeni mane amiyogi, anapudhgi e pinjegi kendo anagol od Juda e diergi.
english: The LORD says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

kikuyu: Jotelo mag Senakerib nomedo wuoyo marach kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo kuom jatichne Hezekia.
english: His servants spoke yet more against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.

kikuyu: Kik ngʼato wuondu. Ngʼeuru niya, “Bedo e lalruok kod joma richo ketho timbe mabeyo.”
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, inine mana pinyno gi kuma bor ok inidonjie e piny ma amiyo jo-Israel.”
english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Ewi mago duto ma asechiwo ne hekalu mar Nyasacha achako agolo mwanduna awuon mag dhahabu kod mag fedha ne hekalu mar Nyasacha. To bende asechiwo moloyo mago ne hekalu malerni gik machalo kaka:
english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

kikuyu: Eka Satan notere kama otingʼore malo kendo ka diemo wangʼ nono nonyise pinjeruodhi duto mag piny.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka Uzia wuon mare nosetimo.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

kikuyu: Negitoyo kidi milamo kendo gimuko hekalu mar Baal kendo kanyo ji osebedo katiyogo kaka choo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

kikuyu: Jatichni biro ngʼado Jordan modhi gi ruoth mochwalore matin, to en angʼo momiyo ruoth dimiya chiwo machal kama?
english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ne owachone jo-Israelgo ni nyaka githo e thim, kendo onge kata ngʼata achiel kuomgi mane otony makmana Kaleb wuod Jefune kod Joshua wuod Nun.
english: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Ne giriwore kaachiel e lamo Baal mar jo-Peor, kendo negichamo misango michiwone nyiseche motho;
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nonywolo Jehoram, Jehoram nonywolo Ahazia, Ahazia nonywolo Joash,
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

kikuyu: To ka ajuoke notemo mondo gin bende gihon kikun kuom tichgi mochido, to ne ok ginyal, kendo kikun nopor kuom ji gi jamni.
english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

kikuyu: Kik udwany piny mudakie gi remo kod kama adakie, nimar an, Jehova Nyasaye, adak e kind jo-Israel.’ ”
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane odak e dala Juda, kaluwore gi migepegi, ne romo ji alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro gauchiel gi mia angʼwen (186,400). Gin e joma biro wuok motelo.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachone ji niya, “Ok unyal tiyone Jehova Nyasaye. En Nyasaye maler, en Nyasaye ma janyiego. Ok obi wenu kuom wich teko maru kod richo mutimo.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

kikuyu: Nikech in ema isebedo kar pondona, isebedona ohinga motegno maponde ne jasigu.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

kikuyu: Chik mar Nyasache ni e chunye; omiyo tiendene ok kier.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

kikuyu: Uparo ni kumno ne yot ma pod udhi nyime mana ne ngʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye? “ ‘Ka dipo ni pod ukwedo Jehova Nyasaye kawuono, to kiny iye biro wangʼ gi jo-Israel duto.
english: that you must turn away today from following the LORD? It will be, since you rebel today against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Benjamin kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Bela, joka Bela; koa kuom Ashbel, joka Ashbel; koa kuom Ahiram, joka Ahiram;
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

kikuyu: “Dhogi opongʼ gi kwongʼ kod weche makech.”
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

kikuyu: Bende Musa nowachonegi niya, “Ubiro ngʼeyo ni ne en Jehova Nyasaye ka omiyou ringʼo mondo ucham godhiambo kendo gi Makati duto ma udwaro gokinyi nimar osewinjo ngʼur ma ungʼurnego. Wan to wan ngʼa? Ok wan ema ungʼurnwa to ungʼurne mana Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”

kikuyu: Ka jogedo noketo mise mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, jodolo korwako lepgi mag dolo ka gin gi turumbete, kod jo-Lawi (ma yawuot Asaf) ka gin-gi ongengʼo, nokawo keregi mondo gipak Jehova Nyasaye, kaka nochan gi Daudi ruodh Israel.
english: When the builders laid the foundation of the LORD’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

kikuyu: Un polo man malo mogik, pakeuru, kaachiel gi un, pige manie bwo polo.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

kikuyu: “To in, wuod dhano, chiengʼ ma anamagie ohinga margi, gi morgi kod duongʼ-gi; bende anamagi gima wengegi omokeno, kendo ma chunygi ohero gi lala; kaachiel gi yawuotgi kod nyigi.
english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

kikuyu: Yier jomariek man-gi winjo kod joma nigi luor mowuok e dhoudi duto kendo naketgi jotendu.”
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

kikuyu: Jogi duto noromo ji alufu piero angʼwen gariyo mia adek gi piero auchiel (42,360),
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

kikuyu: Hazor, Rama kod Gitaim,
english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

kikuyu: mondo oresgi e tho kendo oritgi gibed mangima e ndalo mag kech.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Koro en angʼo ma dapimgo tiengʼ ma kawuononi? Gichalo gi angʼo?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyis Harun owadu ni kik thor donjo e Kama Ler Moloyo manie nyim Sandug Muma miluongo ni kar ngʼwono, nono to enotho, nikech afwenyora gi e bor polo manie ewi raum.
english: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nooro malaika mane onego jolweny gi jochungʼ kod jotelo e kambi mar ruodh Asuria, omiyo nowuok modok e pinye gi wichkuot. Kane odhi e kar lemo mar nyasache, yawuote moko nonege kod ligangla.
english: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osekwongʼore gi nyinge owuon: Adier anakelnu ji mangʼeny, ka bonyo, kendo ginikog gi ilo nikech loch molowugo.
english: The LORD of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’

kikuyu: Giwachone jokor wach ni, “Kik une fweny moro amora kendo!” To ne jonabi, “Kik uchak unyiswa fweny moro amora makare!” Kornwauru mana weche mamorowa mag wuondruok.
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

kikuyu: Asernigi bith bende atungegi duto oywa motegno, kendo faresegi ombongʼ tiendgi ojingʼ, tiend gechegi winyore ka kalausi.
english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Amazia ne ok odewo, nimar ne en dwaro Nyasaye mondo ochiwe e lwet Jehoash nikech negiluwo nyiseche mag Edom.
english: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

kikuyu: Ma e dala maduongʼ mane odak gi kwe, kendo kogalore. Ne owacho e chunye niya, “An e kende kendo onge ngʼama ipimo koda.” To mano kaka koro odongʼ gunda, kama le mag bungu yweyoe. Ji duto makadho bute wuoro ka tangʼo lwetgi.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

kikuyu: Ruoth gi jodonge kod joma nochokore Jerusalem nowinjore ni gitim Sap Pasaka e dwe mar ariyo.
english: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

kikuyu: Ok wadwar ni ngʼato oyud ketho moro amora e tichwa, omiyo watemo mondo kik wachwany ngʼato.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

kikuyu: Un ne udwaro mondo utimna marach, to Nyasaye nodwaro mondo obed gima ber; mondo oresgo ngima ji mangʼeny, makoro ngima mana nikech wachno.
english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Chiw pok mar fedha piero adekgo mane giparo ni ema oromo gi jachwe agulni!” Omiyo nakawo fedha piero adekgo mi amiyo jachwe agulni e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Rwath ka rwath nyaka chiw gi misango miolo piny mar divai maromo lita angʼwen; im to chiw gi lita achiel mar divai; to nyaim ka nyaim, to chiw gi lita achiel mar divai. Ma en misango miwangʼo pep mar dwe ka dwe ma onego chiw e higa mangima sa moro amora ma dwe manyien opor.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nochako oduoga e rangach midonjogo e hekalu, kendo naneno pi kamol e bwo kama idonjogo ei hekalu kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ (nikech hekalu noger kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ). Pigno ne mol koridore mwalo kokadho yo milambo mar hekalu, ma bende ni yo milambo mar kendo mar misango.
english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

kikuyu: Pinje ma ubiro kawo winjo rieko mag ajuoke nyakalondo, to un Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ok oyienu timo kamano.
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you so to do.

kikuyu: to bedo e bada ma korachwich kata ma koracham ok an ema achiw. Kuondego gin mag jogo mane oiknegi chon.”
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

kikuyu: Harun gi yawuote nyaka cham ring imno kaachiel gi makati manie okapu e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “ ‘Magi e chike mag le gi mag winy, kod gik mangima mamol ei pi, kod mago malak ewi lowo.
english: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

kikuyu: Orna kechni mondo abed mangima, nimar chikni e morna.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Hera kod adiera miyo ruoth bedo gi kwe, nikech hera, lochne bedo motegno.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

kikuyu: Chikeni lich miwuoro; emomiyo aritogi.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Kinde biro ma anami Daudi Bad Yath makare, Ruoth manobed gi loch mar rieko kendo tim gima kare kendo ratiro e piny.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ kinde marabora ruodh jotijgo noduogo kendo nogoyo kodgi kwano.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

kikuyu: Okumo joricho e lela nikech timbegi maricho kama ji duto nyalo nenogie,
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

kikuyu: Adier, dine arwake e goka, dine asidhe ka osimbo.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

kikuyu: Wanyiso ruoth ni ka dala maduongʼni oger kendo ohingage ochungi, to onge gima ibiro dongʼ godo e loka mar Aora Yufrate.
english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

kikuyu: Eka nool ubani mangʼwe ngʼarno e majno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo ich ubanino oim raum mar Sandug Rapar mondo kik otho.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

kikuyu: Ma to en ngʼa mabiro apoya ka piny madwa ru? Adier, ober ka dwe kendo ongʼangʼni ka wangʼ chiengʼ, bende ochanore ka sulwe moriedo.
english: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?

kikuyu: “Zebulun nodag e dho nam kama yiedhi gowe, kendo tongʼ mare nodhi nyaka Sidon.
english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

kikuyu: Omiyo kanyo noluongi ni Kibroth Hatava, nikech kanyo ema ne giyikoe joma ne wuoch ringʼo omako.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

kikuyu: Daudi nodhi moromo nigi kendo nowachonegi niya, “Ka ubiro ira gi kwe mondo ukonya, to aikora mondo ariwra kodu, to ka ubiro mondo undhoga ne wasika kata obedo ni lweta onge remo, to Nyasach kwerewa ema obed jangʼadnu bura.”
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

kikuyu: Eka naturo ludha machielo miluongo ni riwruok, mi wat manie kind Juda gi Israel nokethore.
english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Neuru jalek lek cha biro!
english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Asewinjo lamo kod kwayo mitimo e nyima; asewalo hekalu misegero, mondo Nyinga obedie nyaka chiengʼ. Wangʼa kod chunya nobed kanyo kinde duto.
english: The LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nooro janek piyo piyo kendo nomiyo janekno chik mondo odhi okelne wi Johana Ja-batiso. Ngʼatno nodhi mongʼado wi Johana e od twech kama ne entie,
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

kikuyu: To aselamoni, Simon, ni yieni kik lal. To ka iselokori ma idwogo, ijiw joweteni.”
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruoth Solomon nochiwo chik ne Benaya wuod Jehoyada, mi nonego Adonija.
english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

kikuyu: Nimar gik moko duto oa kuome, kendo gintie nikech en, kendo gin mage duto. Duongʼ obed mare nyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Nikech ongʼere ne ji duto ni joma riek tho, mana kaka joma ofuwo gi joma omingʼ, bende tho mi giwe mwandu ne joma moko.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

kikuyu: To jo-Israel duto ok oserwako Injilini. Nimar Isaya nowacho niya, “Ruoth, en ngʼa moseyie wach mwalando?”
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

kikuyu: Kane gibiro ir Yesu mi giyudo nine osetho, ne ok gituro tiendene.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

kikuyu: To in ema ne igola e ich; ne ichweya mondo agen kuomi kata kane pod adhodho thund minwa.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar abich noolo tape ewi kom duongʼ mar ondiek malichno, to pinyruodhe nolokore mudho. Ji nokayo lewgi nikech rem malit mane gin-go
english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno Yesu nowuok e ot mi nobet e dho nam.
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

kikuyu: Laban nodwoke niya, “Ok en timwa mondo nyako matin okuong odhi tedo ne nyako maduongʼ.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

kikuyu: Otienono oganda duto mag gwengʼ notingʼo dwondgi malo mi giywak matek.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

kikuyu: In to nyaka isik kimako weche misepuonjori kendo mingʼeyo ni adier chuth, nikech ingʼeyo kit ngima joma nopuonji,
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

kikuyu: Negirwako ludhego ei nyangeyego mondo gibedi e bath kendo mar misangono kitingʼego, bende ne gitucho bugo e chunye mondo owe iye thuolo ka gitiyo gi bao mayom.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

kikuyu: “Mano e giko wechego. An, Daniel, wechego nochando chunya, mi nabuok kuom gik mane aneno, to kata kamano ne ok awachone ngʼato wechego.”
english: “Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”

kikuyu: Ne wamiyo jodongo penjo ka wapenjogi niya, “En ngʼa momiyou thuolo mar gero hekaluni kendo loso iye?”
english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

kikuyu: Bende Nebukadneza nokawo gige lemo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye moketogi e hekalu mare e piny Babulon.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of the LORD’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

kikuyu: Mogik, japuonjre machielo, mane okwongo chopo e bur yikno, bende nodonjo ei bur mi noneno kendo noyie.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

kikuyu: Eka Elihu wuod Barakel ja-Buz nowacho kama: “An atin kuom higni, kendo un joma dongona; mano emomiyo naluor, kendo ne ok an gichir mar nyisou gima angʼeyo.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

kikuyu: Ngʼii e kitap Jehova Nyasaye kendo isom: Onge moro kuomgi kata achiel manobed maonge, kendo moro ka moro nobed gi nyawadgi. Nimar osegolo chik gi dhoge owuon, kendo Roho mare ema nochokgi kanyakla.
english: Search in the book of the LORD, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

kikuyu: Ruodh Milambo nodog e pinye owuon ka en gi mwandu mathoth, to enoket chunye mar kedo gi singruok maler. Enotimne singruok maler gima en ema ohero eka nodog e pinygi.
english: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

kikuyu: “To nodagi. Kar timo kamano to noa kanyo mi oloso wach mondo orwak ngʼatno e od twech nyaka chop ochul gowino.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

kikuyu: ‘Ondiegi angʼwen malichgo gin pinjeruodhi angʼwen mabiro bet e piny e ndalo mabiro.
english: ‘These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who will arise out of the earth.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma komulo piny, to piny leny, kendo ji duto modak e piny ywak. Piny duto tingʼore malo, bangʼe to opie ka aora Nael man Misri!
english: For the Lord, the GOD of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nodok ir Jehova Nyasaye mowacho niya, “Yaye, mano kaka jogi osetimo richo malich, ma giseloso nyisechegi mag dhahabu.
english: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

kikuyu: Wuoguru, wuoguru, auru kanyo! Kik umul gima ochido! Wuoguru kuome mondo ubed maler, un mutingʼo gik ler mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry the LORD’s vessels.

kikuyu: “Wuo kod Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel, ma en jatend Juda kaachiel gi Joshua wuod Jehozadak ma jadolo maduongʼ kod joma notony moa e twech. Penjgi niya,
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

kikuyu: Nowachone ogandago mondo obed piny e lum.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

kikuyu: Koa kuom yawuot Jeduthun noyier: Gedalia gi Zeri gi Jeshaya gi Shimei gi Hashabia kod Matithia. Giduto ne gin ji auchiel kendo notelnegi kod wuon-gi Jeduthun mane koro ka goyone Jehova Nyasaye erokamano kendo pake gi nyatiti.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo wachno, nowachone niya, “Pod iremo gimoro achiel. Lok mwanduni duto ma in-go pesa, mondo ipog joma odhier, eka inibed gi mwandu mokan e polo. Bangʼ timo kamano to bi mondo iluwa.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Notimo honni madongo ma kata mana mach nomiyo lor oa e polo, kabiro e piny ka ji duto neno.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

kikuyu: kendo ngʼato angʼata momulo gima ngʼatno osebetie nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo, kendo ngʼato angʼata mokawo gigo nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Isetimo maber ahinya. In jatich maber kendo ma ja-adiera! Isebedo ja-adiera gi gik matin nono, omiyo koro abiro keti jarit gik mangʼeny. Bi idonji e mor mar ruodhi!’
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo ok nyal yudo dwarone, to jakinda maratego ongʼeyo ber gige.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona, “Jonabigo koro miriambo e nyinga. Pok aorogi, kata walogi kata wuoyo kodgi. Ginyisou fweny manono, gikoro weche manono gilamo nyiseche manono kod pachgi giwegi morundore.
english: Then the LORD said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

kikuyu: “Yor Nyasaye en yo malongʼo; wach Jehova Nyasaye onge ketho. En okumba ni jogo duto mopondo kuome.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oketho hekalu mar Nyasaye, to Nyasaye biro tieke, nikech hekalu mar Nyasaye ler, to un e hekaluno.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

kikuyu: Chokuru chiemo kuom ndalo auchiel, nimar odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo ma en Sabato ok nonwangʼ chiemono.”
english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

kikuyu: Kane Gehazi ochopo e got, ne okawo michgi kuom jotichgo mokanogi e ot. Bangʼ mano nomiyo jogo thuolo mondo odhiyo kendo negidhi.
english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

kikuyu: Nyaka gicham chiwogo mane otimnegigo pwodhruok kiwalogi kaka jodolo. To onge ngʼat machielo moyiene chamo chiemono nikech gin gik mopwodhi.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

kikuyu: En bende obiro ritou mondo ubed motegno nyaka giko, mondo omi ubed maonge bura chiengʼ mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: “Penj ane tiengʼ mosekalo mondo ingʼe gik mane kweregi opuonjore,
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

kikuyu: Gigoyo chonggi piny ka ginywol, kendo muoch makayogi rumo bangʼ mano.
