english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

kikuyu: To moloyo mago duto, owetena, ka usingoru e wach moro to kik ukwongʼru. Kik ukwongʼru gi polo kata gi piny kata gi gimoro amora machielo. Kar timo kamano to “Ee” maru mondo obed mana ee, kendo “Ooyo” maru bende obed mana ooyo, nono to buch Nyasaye biro loyou.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

kikuyu: kendo onge dhako ma iye no-oo piny, kata manobed migumba e pinyu. Abiro miyou ngima moromo chuth.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

kikuyu: En kaachiel gi jolweny mage, ma gin joma mirimbgi ger moloyo ogendini duto, nokel mondo otiek ji e pinyno. Giniked gi jo-Misri kendo piny nopongʼ gi joma onegi.
english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato ochiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye misango mar lalruok mogolo e kweth jambe bed ni en rwath kata roya to nyaka obed maonge songa.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

kikuyu: An to abiro siko ka alando wachni nyaka chiengʼ kendo abiro wero wende pak ne Nyasach Jakobo,
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Joma ohero chwero remo mon kod jogo modimbore, kendo gidwaro yo mar nego joma jo-ratiro.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

kikuyu: Kane odwa tho, mon mane chole nowachone niya, “Kik iluor nikech isenywolo wuowi.” To ne ok odwokogi kata dewogi.
english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya; “Wuod dhano, aori ir jo-Israel. Aori ir oganda ma jongʼanyo. Gin kaachiel gi kweregi gisebedo ka gingʼanyona nyaka kawuono.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

kikuyu: nimar chunjegi chano timo mamono to dhogi wacho mana gik makelo chandruok.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

kikuyu: Luoro nomako ji duto ka joote ne timo honni gi ranyisi mangʼeny.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

kikuyu: Eka mach mar Jehova Nyasaye nolwar kendo nowangʼo misango gi yien gi kite kod lowo notwoyo pi mane nitie e bugo.
english: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Pwodhreuru ka uikoru ne kiny ma ubiro chamoe ringʼo; nimar Jehova Nyasaye osewinjo ywak maru niya, “Mad dibed ni nitie kama wanyalo yudoe ringʼo mwachamo! Ne wawinjo maber e piny Misri!” Omiyo koro Jehova Nyasaye nomiu ringʼo, ma ubiro chamo.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

kikuyu: Kaka jodolo medore, e kaka gimedo timo richo e nyima; gisewilo duongʼ margi gi gima kelo wichkuot.
english: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Naftali, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Dhood Naftali oum gi ngʼwono mangʼeny mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo otingʼo gweth mare, ginikaw piny mantie yo milambo mar nam.”
english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

kikuyu: Mondo omi yawuot Harun oyud duongʼ kod luor, losnigi lewni mag akor, okanda kod kilemba.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: nikech ne gijwangʼe kendo gitiyone Baal kod jo-Ashtoreth.
english: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

kikuyu: Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Ngʼama dine nyis Ibrahim ni Sara didhodh nyathi? To koro asenywolone wuowi ka en ngʼama oti.”
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

kikuyu: “Nodwoko ni, ‘Koro akwayoi, wuora, or Lazaro odhi od wuora,
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo gi jobuch Sanhedrin duto ne manyo ketho mane ginyalo donjonego Yesu mondo gingʼadne buch tho, to ne ok giyudo ketho moro amora kuome.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

kikuyu: To rieko moa e polo ok chal kamano. Mokwongo oler, kendo ohero kwe, odembore, owinjo wach, opongʼ gi kech kod olembe mabeyo, ok odew wangʼ, kendo oonge miganga.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Lweny machielo nochako owuok Gath, kama ne nitie ngʼat marabet mane nigi lith lwedo auchiel gi lith tielo auchiel koni gi koni, lith lwetene gi mag tiendene koriw to ne romo piero ariyo gangʼwen. En bende ne en nyakwar Rafa.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

kikuyu: To onge ngʼato kata achiel mane nyalo dwoke kata wach achiel, kendo chakre chiengʼno kadhi nyime, onge ngʼato kata achiel manohedhore penje penjo moro kendo.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

kikuyu: Herani gi ngʼwononi nyien okinyi kokinyi, kendo adiera mari duongʼ.
english: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ ahinya kaka udak, kik udag ka joma ofuwo, to daguru ka joma riek,
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

kikuyu: Rieko donge yudore e dier joma osedak amingʼa? Koso dak amingʼa donge kelo winjo tiend weche maber?
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

kikuyu: Hembe mag jomecho onge ngʼama monjo, kendo joma jaro Nyasaye winjo maber, mana ka joma otingʼo nyasachgi e lwetgi.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abich mar dwe mar apar, e higa mar apar gariyo, ngʼat moro mane oyudo otony koa Jerusalem nobiro ira kendo owacho niya, “Dala maduongʼ osepodho!”
english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ma e remo mar singruok ma Nyasaye osechikou mondo uriti.”
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

kikuyu: jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, jo-Refai,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

kikuyu: Bangʼe to owe nyako molombo wangʼ ruoth obed mikach ruoth kar Vashti.” Paroni ne ber ne ruoth mi notimo kamano.
english: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

kikuyu: Farao nowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye bed kodu ka dipo ni aweyou udhi gi mondu kod nyithindu! Nenore ni udwaro kelo chandruok!
english: He said to them, “The LORD be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

kikuyu: Ageno nenoi mapiyo, eka wanawuo wangʼ gi wangʼ.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

kikuyu: kaachiel rachungi mag laru kod mag dhorangach kod sigingigi mag Hemb Romo kod laru molwore.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

kikuyu: Kuom mano un owetena, un koro un nyithind singruok mana kaka Isaka.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi Azaria, Ezra, Meshulam,
english: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

kikuyu: Noluwo timbe mag ruodhi Israel, mana kaka jood Ahab notimo, nimar nokendo nyar Ahab. Notimo timbe mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo unindo? Auru malo kendo ulam mondo kik udonj e tem.”
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Ohinga mar Babulon mangʼongo nolwar piny kendo dhorangeye mage maboyo nomoke mach; ji chandore kayiem nono, tich matek mar jotich en mana ramoki mach.”
english: The LORD of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

kikuyu: Musa notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nonyise.
english: Moses did so. As the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: “Loch Polo nobed machal gi ngʼat moro ma kane owuok odhi e wuoth to noluongo jotichne mi oketo mwandune e lwetgi.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

kikuyu: Saulo nochiko ite ne wach Jonathan mi okwongʼore kowacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni Daudi ok nonegi.”
english: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.”

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato ogoyo wangʼ misumba madichwo kata madhako ma wangʼeno okethore, to nyaka owene misumbaneno thuolo kaka chudo mar wangʼeno.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

kikuyu: Owacho ni jogo maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura niya, “Weuru ji duto mangʼeyogi tin obi kae!”
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Omiyo Chik nomi teko mondo oritwa nyaka chop Kristo bi, mondo eka ketwa kare kuom yie.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

kikuyu: Hembegi gi jambgi nokaw; kar dak margi nowal oko, kaachiel gi mwandugi duto kod ngamia. Ji nogonegi koko ni, ‘Masira maduongʼ koni gi koni!’ ”
english: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

kikuyu: nikech ngʼat ma Nyasaye onywolo loyo piny. Loch ma waloyogo piny en yie.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

kikuyu: Kaluru, kaluru dhorangach! Losuru yo ne joga. Buguru, buguru yore! Goluru kite. Tingʼuru bandera malo mondo pinje one.
english: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noloyo jo-Benjamin e nyim Israel kendo odiechiengno jo-Israel nonego jo-Benjamin alufu piero gabich gi mia achiel man-gi ligangla.
english: The LORD struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

kikuyu: “Kik sand jadak kata loke misumba, nikech ne un jodak Misri.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny osebedo ka chano weche mane otimore e dierwa,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

kikuyu: Eka negiloso tonde milierogo pasia e riak pasia man-gi range marambulu kendo negitimo kamano e riak pasia matungʼ komachielo.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: To ne ok ayie gi weche mane giwacho nyaka nabiro maneno gi wangʼa awuon. Adier kata nus mar duongʼ riekoni ne ok onyisa; iriek moloyo humbi manyocha awinjo.
english: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

kikuyu: Daher mondo uwuo gi dhok mayoreyore uduto, to moloyo mano, ni mondo uhul wach. Ngʼat ma hulo wach duongʼ moloyo ngʼat ma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore makmana ka nitie ngʼat manyalo loko tiend wach modhumono, mondo kanisni duto oyud konyruok.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

kikuyu: mondo omi Kristo osiki e chunyu kuom yie. Alamo bende ni ka usiko kuome kendo udongo e herane,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

kikuyu: Androniko kod Junias, ma wedena, kendo mane ni koda e od twech, bende mosnauru. Ji ariyogi gin joma oluor e kind Joote, kendo ne gikwongona yie kuom Kristo.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

kikuyu: Jolweny mondiki chal gi nyiroye machwe. Gin bende ginilokre kendo giring kanyakla, ok giniriti, nimar odiechiengʼ mar masira biro kuomgi, kinde margi mar kum.
english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

kikuyu: Omiyo Delila nokawo tonde manyien mi otweyego. Kane osepando jomoko ei ot kanyo, noluonge kowacho niya, “Samson, jo-Filistia osebiro monji!” To nochodo tondego mana ka gima gin usi.
english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.

kikuyu: To bende, ka turumbete ok ogo gi dwol mongʼere, ngʼama diikre ni lweny?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

kikuyu: Bende negigolo jochiende mathoth kuom ji kendo ne giolo mo kuom joma tuo mathoth mi gichangogi.
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

kikuyu: Kane wachopo Jerusalem, jowete norwakowa gi mor.
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

kikuyu: Noyiero jo-Lawi moko mondo oti e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, mondo olem kendo ogo erokamano ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

kikuyu: Ingʼeyo nadi, in dhako, kata inyalo miyo chwori yudo warruok? Koso, ingʼeyo nade, in dichwo, ni chiegi nyalo yudo warruok nikech in?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama luwo ngʼatni makmana oganda mokia chik, gin joma okwongʼ!”
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

kikuyu: “Ruodhi gi jolweny dar gi ngʼwech; ji pogo gik moyaki e kambi.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

kikuyu: To onge ngʼama ne nyalo hedhore wuoyo kuome e lela nikech negiluoro jo-Yahudi.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ja-Kristo moro mane oyudhi moter e polo mar adek, higni apar gangʼwen mokadho. Akia kata notere kuno e ringruok kata nodhi gi chunye, to Nyasaye ema ongʼeyo.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

kikuyu: “Magi e ogandago, ka ochan moro ka moro gi nyinge: “E tongʼ pinyno ma yo nyandwat, Dan noyud lowo kochakore e yo moa Hethlon nyaka Lebo Hamath; nyaka dala mar Hazar Enan motundo nyaka e piny manie kind Damaski kod Hamath. Lopgino nochakre yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

kikuyu: eka achien mogik, ne ofwenyorena apoya an bende, mana ka nyathi mobwogi.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kikuyu: Eka Balak nobedo gi mirima mager gi Balaam. Noriwo lwetene kanyakla mi owachone niya, “Ne aomi mondo ikwongʼna wasika, to isemana gwedhogi ndalo adekgi.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

kikuyu: Piyo piyo nono jo-Israel nobiro ir ruoth mi giwachone niya, “Angʼo manomiyo owetewa ma jo-Juda, kelo ruoth lingʼ-lingʼ gi joode loka aora Jordan, kaachiel gi joge duto?”
english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

kikuyu: Kik ipandna wangʼi, kik iriemb jatichni ka mirima omaki, in ema isebedo jakonyna. Kik ikweda bende kik ijwangʼa, yaye Nyasaye Jawarna.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

kikuyu: giwacho ni ji mamoko niya, ‘Bed mabor koda; kik isud buta, nimar aler moloyi!’ Joma kamago gin mana iro mawuok e uma kendo ka mach maliel ma ok tho odiechiengʼ duto.
english: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

kikuyu: Eka nopenje niya, “In nyar ngʼa? Yie inyisa bende dwayudie kar nindo dalau?”
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano chunjego nochoko ruodhigo kanyakla kama iluongo gi dho jo-Hibrania ni Armagedon.
english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

kikuyu: moseweyo chwore mane okende konyako, kendo oketho singruok mane otimo e nyim Nyasaye.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

kikuyu: Ginibed mamon kodi kendo gibiro kawo gimoro amora ma isetiyone e ngimani duto. Gibiro weyi duk nono li, kendo wichkuot mar chodeni ibiro el e lela.
english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona, “Koa yo nyandwat masira ibiro ol kuom jogo duto modak e piny.
english: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo chuny Farao ma ruodh Misri odoko matek, mi nolawo jo-Israel mane wuotho ka gin gi chir.
english: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.

kikuyu: Bangʼ podho chiengʼ, ngʼatno nobed maler, kendo bangʼ mano oyiene mondo ocham chiwogo nikech en chiembe.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

kikuyu: Jomoko kuom jo-Yahudi ne wach oywayo kendo ne giyie mi giluwo Paulo gi Sila, mana kaka jo-Yunani moluoro Nyasaye mathoth kaachiel gi mon moko mongʼere bende noyie.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

kikuyu: Elija nokawo kite apar gariyo, ka moro ka moro ochungʼ ni dhood Israel mane owuok kuom Jakobo, mane Jehova Nyasaye owachonegi niya, “Nyingi nobed Israel.”
english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

kikuyu: Joma hulo wach kik bed mokalo ji ariyo kata adek, kendo ka giwuoyo, to ji mamoko onon mos ka bende weche magiwacho owinjore.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

kikuyu: nimar ngʼato angʼata ma ok mon kodwa en jakorwa.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

kikuyu: Ne en kendo matimo honni madongo, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: “Ka ok uketho odiechiengʼ mar Sabato, kendo utimo dwarou e odiechienga maler, ka uwacho ni Sabato en chiengʼ mor, kendo mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye kumiye luor, ma ok utimo gik ma un ema udwaro, kendo ka uweyo wecheu manono,
english: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of the LORD honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,

kikuyu: Bende gin ema negidoko jodongo mane otelo ni tije duto mag Solomon, duto jodongo mia abich gi piero abich kaka nyipeche mag joma ne tiyo.
english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Israel ibiro jwangʼ nyaka kinde ma dhako man-gi ich nonywolie nyathi, kendo owetene mamoko nodwogi mi riwre gi jo-Israel.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Iyie ni nitiere Nyasaye achiel. Mano ber ahinya! To ngʼe ni kata mana jochiende bende yiegino miyo gitetni ka giluor.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

kikuyu: kendo ongʼad kite duto gi payo bao kendo mondo otim kit tije, duto mag lwedo.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

kikuyu: (To ka ngʼato ok nyal rito ode owuon, to ere kaka dorit kanisa Nyasaye?)
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

kikuyu: kata gero udi mondo wadagie kata bedo gi puothe mzabibu, kod puothe mag cham.
english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;

kikuyu: Nyasach wuonuno ma en Nyasaye Maratego, mondo ogwedhi gi gweth mag polo gi gweth mag nyak mag lowo, gi gweth mag nyithindo.
english: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

kikuyu: Ok gingʼeyo yo makelo kwe, onge tim makare e yoregi. Giseloko yorego obedo yore mogondore ogondore, kendo ngʼato angʼata mawuotho e yorego ok noyud kwe.
english: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

kikuyu: Ne en gi wuowi miluongo ni Saulo, ne en rawera ma jaber e kind jo-Israel bende ne en rabora ma ji moko ne rem mana e goke.
english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

kikuyu: Magi duto bende oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma jangʼad rieko mowinjore, kendo ma parone ber ahinya.
english: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

kikuyu: Girkeni mar dhood Simeon nopognegi koa kuom pok mar jo-Juda, nikech pok mar Juda ne duongʼ mohewogi. Omiyo dhood Simeon noyudo pok margi koa e piny Juda.
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

kikuyu: Negigolo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye e od Abinadab ka otingʼe e gari manyien, to Uza gi Ahio ema ne chiko garino.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

kikuyu: kendo ka ok umayo jadak, kiye kata mon ma chwogi otho kendo ok uchwero remb joma onge ketho, kendo ka ok uluwo bangʼ nyiseche manono ma dihinyu un uwegi,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

kikuyu: Ok abi dewo wangʼ ngʼato bende ok abi wuondo ngʼato;
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

kikuyu: Kendo ka gidwogo iri gi chunygi duto kod ngimagi duto, e piny wasikgi mane otweyogieno, kendo gilami ka gichomo pinygi mane imiyo kweregi, kod dala mane iyiero, gi hekalu ma asegero ni nyingi;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

kikuyu: Jeremia nochako wuok e dala maduongʼ mondo odhi e gwengʼ Benjamin mondo oyud pokne e dier joma ni kanyo.
english: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e wach ma Jal Maler mar Israel wacho: “Nikech isedagi winjo oteni, mi iserwako chuny mar sando ji kendo iseyiengori e timbe mag miganga,
english: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,

kikuyu: Yawuote kod nyige duto nobiro mondo ohoye, to notamore ahoya. Nowacho niya, “Ooyo, abiro ywago wuoda nyaka atho aluw bangʼe.” Kuom mano wuon-gi noywage.
english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

kikuyu: Edom gi Moab gi jo-Amon gi jo-Filistia, gi Amalek. E kaka nowalo bende gik mane oyaki mag Hadadezer wuod Rehob, ma ruodh Zoba.
english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat moro nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “Japuonj, en angʼo maber monego atim mondo eka ayud ngima mochwere?”
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nooro jo-Babulon, jo-Aram, jo-Moab kod jo-Amon mondo omonj ruoth Jehoyakim. Ne oorogi mondo otiek Juda, kaluwore gi wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kokalo kuom jotichne ma jonabi.
english: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Musa nowachonegi niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye osechiko mondo otim.”
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”

kikuyu: to Farao ok nowinju. Omiyo anasand jo-Misri gi masiche madongo kakumogi malich mi anagol joga ma jo-Israel e piny Misri.
english: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

kikuyu: Mon-go nobwok kendo negikulore ka wigi ochomo piny, to nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo umanyo ngʼat mangima e kind joma otho?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

kikuyu: Magi e chike mag gik mopur man kuom law pamba kata law kaki mochwe kata motwangʼ kata pien moro amora mondo ongʼe ni gigak kata ok gigak.
english: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro nonyisogi ratiro niya, “Lazaro otho,
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

kikuyu: To initim angʼo chiengʼ ngʼado bura, ka masira nowuog kuma bor? To en ngʼa manuring udhi ire mondo okonyu? Mwandu magu to unuwe kanye?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, boche polo nobiro apoya moumogi, kendo negiluor kane bor polono noumogi.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

kikuyu: Inipiedhgi to yamo nokegi kendo kalausi notergi mabor. To inibed mamor nikech Jehova Nyasaye, kendo inibed gi ilo nikech Nyasaye Maler mar Israel.
english: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Jokwath nengʼielo kidi kane jamni osechokore kanyo mondo gimodhi. Bangʼ ka jamni duto osemodho, to ne gingʼielo kidino mondo odog oum dho soko.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

kikuyu: Ruoth mondo omi chunyu omed hero Nyasaye kendo ubed gi kinda machalo mane Kristo ne gigo.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kaw bao moro mopa mondo indikie wechegi ni, ‘Mar jo-Juda gi dhout Israel mamoko mawinjore kode.’ Eka ikaw bao mopa machielo kendo indikie wechegi, ‘Mar Josef (ma en mar Efraim) kod dhout Israel mamoko duto mawinjore kode.’
english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

kikuyu: Ruodh Tanak, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Megido, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

kikuyu: Kar seche moko mag odhiambo Jopuonjre apar gariyo nobiro ire kendo negiwachone niya, “We ogandani owuogi mondo gidhi e mier machiegni kod gwenge mondo giyud chiemo kod kuonde nindo, nikech wan e thim.”
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

kikuyu: To Muma wacho ratiro ni piny duto ni e twech mar richo omiyo joma oyie kuom Yesu Kristo kende ema yudo gino mane Nyasaye osingo.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

kikuyu: To ka ok olwoko lepe kendo ok olwokore, to nyaka oyud kum kuom kethone.’ ”
english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

kikuyu: “Koro par ane: En ngʼa mosekum maonge ketho? Koso joma kare mage minyalo tieki?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

kikuyu: Chiengʼ nogono ngʼat Nyasayeno nochiwo ranyisi: “Ma e ranyisi ma Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo: Kendo mar misango biro barore diere ariyo kendo buru man kuome biro pukore oko.”
english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “Jotichna nochiem, to unudeny; jotichna nomethi, to unuwinj riyo; jotichna nobed gimor, to unune wichkuot.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowacho niya, “Kik utame nikech onge ngʼat manyalo timo hono e nyinga manyalo loko pache bangʼ thuolo manok mi owach gimoro marach kuoma,
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata monego chiayo nyaka chul chiayo, to ngʼato angʼata monego nyawadgi nyaka negi.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

kikuyu: Ka uyudo chandruok to beduru modhil nikech mano e yo ma Nyasaye puonjougo kaka nyithinde. Bende nitie nyathi ma wuon ok nyal kumo?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

kikuyu: Luoro nomakowa ni dipo ka watwomo lwanda. Omiyo negibolo nanga angʼwen yo kachien yie, eka gilemo mondo piny oyawre.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ema miya teko kendo omiyo yora bedo mokwe.
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

kikuyu: Eka lweny nochakore e polo. Mikael gi malaike mage nokedo gi thuol malichno, to thuol mangʼongono gi malaike mage bende nokedo kodgi.
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Saulo niya, “Kik chuny ji nyosre nikech ja-Filistiani; jatichni biro dhi mondo oked kode.”
english: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, e kinde duto mwayudoe thuolo, to ber mondo watim maber ni ji duto, to moloyo ni kanyakla mar joma oyie.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

kikuyu: Nyaka imin usi e konde angʼwen mar lawi mar abola.
english: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre nowuok odhi oko kendo oyalo kuonde duto, to Ruoth notiyo kodgi kendo nosiro wachne gi honni mane oluwore kod yalo.]
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

kikuyu: Nimar e odiechiengno ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nowiti nyiseche mag fedha kod dhahabu, ma lwetu motimo richo oseloso.
english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

kikuyu: Daudi nokecho nikech mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye nomwomore kuom Uza, omiyo nochak kanyo ni Perez Uza, nying ma pod iluongogo kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

kikuyu: Negiloso ludhego gi yiend siala mi gibawe gi mula
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

kikuyu: Eka ji nowuok modhi oyako kambi jo-Aram. Kuom mano nengo gorogoro achiel mar mogo ne en silingʼ achiel to mogo mar shairi gorogoro ariyo nongʼiew silingʼ achiel mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho.
english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Negiwuoyo kuom wachni e kindgi giwegi kendo giwacho niya, “Ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa e polo,’ to obiro penjowa ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo nutamoru yie kuome?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

kikuyu: Abiro timoni misango gi chiwo mar hera; abiro pako nyingi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech nyingi ber.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel owinjo bura mane ruoth ongʼado, negimiyo ruoth duongʼ nikech negineno ne en-gi rieko moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.

kikuyu: Nimar awachonu, ok anamadh olemb mzabibu kendo nyaka chop pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

kikuyu: Hera ma in-go osemiya mor maduongʼ kendo osejiwa, nikech in, owadwa mahero, isedwogo chunje jomaler.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mokwongo nobed chokruok maler ma kik uti tijeu mapile.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Weche duto manie Muma oa kuom much Nyasaye kendo konyo kuom puonjo ji, kendo kuom kwero gik maricho, kendo kuom rieyo ji, kendo kuom tiego ji mondo ji obed joma kare,
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

kikuyu: Winjruok mane ma hekalu mar Nyasaye nigo gi nyiseche manono? Nikech wan e hekalu mar Nyasaye mangima! Mana kaka Nyasaye owuon osewacho niya: “Abiro dak eigi kendo abiro wuotho e diergi, kendo abiro bedo Nyasachgi to ginibed joga.”
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

kikuyu: Kane bor polo owalore oa ewi Hemb Romo, Miriam noa malo ka dende obawore gi dhoho mobedo marachar ka pe. Harun nolokore mongʼiye kendo noneno ka en-gi dhoho,
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

kikuyu: Jogo duto nowuoro kendo negipenjore niya, “Ma puonj manade? Kuom teko maduongʼ kod loch, ochiko koda ka jochiende kendo giwuok.”
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

kikuyu: to Jehova Nyasaye ok bi weyogi e lwetgi kata yie bura logi sa ma iyalogi.
english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

kikuyu: An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu; luwuru buchena kendo rituru chikena maber.
english: I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nawinjo kar kwan joma ne oketnegi kido, ne gin ji alufu mia achiel gi piero angʼwen gangʼwen (144,000) mowuok e dhout Israel duto.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

kikuyu: kata ka olwaro kidi manyalo nege kuome motho; to ne ok en jasike kendo noonge gi paro mar hinye,
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

kikuyu: Nyasaye ok gengʼ mirimbe kendo nyaka jolwenj Rahab bende noloyo mopodho e tiende.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

kikuyu: Negiwachone Joshua niya, “Wan jotichu.” To Joshua nopenjogi niya, “Un ngʼa gini to bende ua kanye?”
english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”

kikuyu: “Kowna bende yiend sida gi saipras gi algumo mag Lebanon nimar angʼeyo ni jotiji olony e ngʼado yiende kanyo. Jotijena biro tiyo kanyakla kod jotijegi
english: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

kikuyu: Kama oseweye richo, koro misango mar golo richo onge gi tich.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

kikuyu: Nam maduongʼ ema cham mag Shihor ngʼado, mwandu mokaa kowuok Nael ema osebedo girkeni mar Turo, kendo osebedo kar ohala mar ogendini.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar ochiko e dwe mar angʼwen kech mane ni e dala maduongʼno nomedore makoro ne onge chiemo mane ji nyalo chamo.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

kikuyu: Kinde matin nono to joma timbegi richo ok nobedie; kata obedo ni unumanygi to ok unuyudgi.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho mondo okel Haman piyo, mondo mi watim gima Esta okwayo. Omiyo ruoth kod Haman ne odhi e nyasi mane Esta oseloso.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ, angʼeyo adier ni Ruoth Nyasachwa duongʼ moloyo nyiseche duto.
english: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

kikuyu: Emomiyo koro abiro tiyo kodgi gi mirima. Ok abi timonegi tim ngʼwono kendo ok abi weyo mak akumogi. Kata obedo ni gilama matek manade, to ok anadewgi ngangʼ!”
english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

kikuyu: Nyalo bedo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi biro winjo weche duto mag Rabshake jatend lweny, ma jatende ma ruodh Asuria oseoro mondo oyany Nyasaye mangima, kendo obiro kwere kuom weche mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osewinjo kowacho. Kuom mano, in Isaya, lamne ji mane otony ma pod ngima.”
english: It may be the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

kikuyu: Kane ochopo kinde mane onego ter yawuowigo ir ruoth, jatelo maduongʼ nokelogi e nyim Nebukadneza.
english: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Ka wach nobiro ne Sanbalat, Tobia, Geshem ma ja-Arabu kod wasikwa mamoko modongʼ nine wagero ohinga kendo ne onge kamoro amora mane otuch, kata obedo ni e sechego ne pod ok aguro dhorangach.
english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

kikuyu: Sheba nokadho e dier dhout Israel duto mochopo nyaka Abel Beth Maaka, bende nokadho e gwenge jo-Beri duto, kendo jogo nochokore kaachiel mondo oluwe.
english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

kikuyu: “Kik iketh buch jou modhier.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Awinjo riyo. Kiyie to miya pi amodhi.” Noyawo chupa mar chak, momiye omadho, bangʼe oume kendo.
english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

kikuyu: Yawnwauru chunyu. Pok watimo ni ngʼato marach kendo pok waketho ni ngʼato, bende pok wakonyore gi yore mag miriambo.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

kikuyu: Lut nochopo Zoar gokinyi kar onyango.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

kikuyu: Piny mane opog ni dhood Juda gi ombulu, kaluwore gi anywola margi, nochopo nyaka e gwenge mag Edom, kendo nyaka yo milambo e thim mar Zin.
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

kikuyu: wan to wangʼeyo ni nitie Nyasaye achiel kende, ma en Wuoro. En ema gik moko duto noa kuome, kendo nomiyowa ngima. Bende nitie Ruoth achiel kende ma en Yesu Kristo. En ema nomiyo gik moko duto obetie kendo en ema omiyowa ngima.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

kikuyu: Pok mar abiriyo nomi dhood Dan, kaluwore gi anywola margi.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

kikuyu: Negichako dhuro pidhego chakre dwe mar adek kendo negitieko dhurogi e dwe mar abiriyo.
english: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Chakre ndalo mane Amazia oweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye, negichikone obadho e Jerusalem mi oringo odhi Lakish, to negioro ji bangʼe Lakish ma onege kuno.
english: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

kikuyu: Kuom mano paro mag chunje mangʼeny ibiro fwenyo. To ligangla biro chwoyo chunyi in iwuon bende.”
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

kikuyu: Winj lamona, yaye Nyasaye; chik iti ne weche mawuok e dhoga.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: to nyaka ugol ji ariyogo e dhorangach mar dala oko kendo chielgi gi kite ma githo. Nyakono nogo gi kite nikech ne en e gwengʼ to ok ogoyo koko mondo okonye, kendo ngʼatno nochiel nikech odwanyo chi ngʼato. Tim marachno nyaka ugol e dieru.
english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Ne atimonegi maromre gi dwanyruokgi kod timbegi mamono mi alokonegi ngʼeya.
english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

kikuyu: Napenjo malaika mane loso koda niya, “Magi gin angʼo, ruodha?”
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

kikuyu: Omiyo mi jatichni chuny mariek mondo otel ne jogi kendo mar pogo ber gi rach. Nimar en ngʼa manyalo telo ni oganda maduongʼ machalo kama?”
english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ere kaka welo mag wuon kisera ditwe chiemo adier ka pod en kodgi?” Chutho, ok ginyal tweyo chiemo kapod gin kode.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

kikuyu: wuod Simeon, wuod Juda, wuod Josef, wuod Jonam, wuod Eliakim,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

kikuyu: Yawuot Juda ma Er kod Onan notho Kanaan.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo inyisgi ni: ‘Ka ngʼato ochiwo singo makende ni obiro chiwo ngʼato ni Jehova Nyasaye, eka bangʼe oyudo ni ok onyal chopo singruokneno, to nengo monego wargo ngʼatno ema:
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,

kikuyu: koa kuom Asriel, joka Asriel; koa kuom Shekem, joka Shekem;
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek wiye ok wil gi tho, to ngʼat mofuwo paro mana mor pile.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

kikuyu: pek mar dhahabu maler milosogo uma, bakunde mag kiro pi kod njage; pek mar dhahabu mar tawo ka tawo molos gi dhahabu kod pek mar fedha mar tawo ka tawo molos gi fedha;
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

kikuyu: E odunga mar Lawi ndike nying Harun, nimar nyaka bedi odunga achiel mar jatelo mar dhoot ka dhoot.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: kane pod anie lamo, Gabriel, ngʼat mane oyudo aseneno e fweny motelo, nobiro ira ka huyo matek kar seche mitime misengni mag odhiambo.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

kikuyu: Ne ginur kuoma ka kich, to ne githo ka mach ma wangʼo kudho; mine atiekogi e nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ok okawo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye mondo odhigo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, to nobaro otere e od Obed-Edom ja-Giti.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata madichwo, mane ok oter nyangu e ringruok, nogol oko kuom jogi; nikech oseketho singruokna.”
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, ji nowuok Hazeroth kendo negigoyo kambi e Thim mar Paran.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: Chutho ok ane gimoro ma aketho, to mano ok onyisa ni aonge ketho. To Ruoth ema ngʼadona bura.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

kikuyu: Ka wangʼi ma korachwich miyo itimo richo to lodhe oko kendo iwite. Ber moloyo ka iwito fuon-ni achiel mar ringri moloyo ka ringri duto owiti e gehena.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: ka gilando niya “Jehova Nyasaye oriere tir; en e Lwandana, kendo onge richo moro amora kuome.”
english: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato wacho ni ohero Nyasaye to omon gi wadgi to en ja-miriambo; nikech ngʼama ok ohero wadgi, moseneno gi wangʼe, ok nyal hero Nyasaye mapok oneno.
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

kikuyu: Nowachona ni, “Bende ineno gima timoreni, wuod dhano? Ibiro neno gik mochido moloyo ma.”
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jowetena, ka uchokoru kaachiel mondo uchiem, to ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo orit nyawadgi.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

kikuyu: E nyim ute matindogo ne nitie yo miluwo gi yo ka iye ma lachne ne en fut apar gabich, to borne ne en fut mia achiel gi piero abich. Dhoudi midonjogo e utego nochomo yo nyandwat.
english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

kikuyu: Yie iduogi, yie iduogi, yaye nyar jo-Shulam; yie iduogi, yie iduogi, mondo waneni! Wuowi Ere gima omiyo ungʼiyo nyar jo-Shulam kamano, mana ka gima omielo miend Mahanaim?
english: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?

kikuyu: Ka dipo odirwa ei mach makakni, to Nyasaye mwatiyone nigi teko mar resowa, kendo obiro resowa kogolowa e lweti, yaye ruoth.
english: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

kikuyu: Ket raumno ewi Sandug Muma, bangʼe iket kite mopa ariyo mar chike ma abiro miyi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

kikuyu: joma kare piny biro bedo margi kendo gibiro dak e piny nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo koro onge bura kuom joma oyie kuom Kristo Yesu,
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Dhood Juda ema biro dhi mokwongo; nimar asechiwo pinyno e lwetgi.”
english: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

kikuyu: Wabiro kawo chwo apar kuom chwo mia achiel moa e dhout Israel, kendo chwo mia achiel kuom ji alufu achiel, kendo alufu achiel kuom ji alufu apar, mondo ochiwre ne konyo jolweny. Bangʼ, ka jolweny osechopo Gibea man Benjamin, ginyalo kedo kodgi kaluwore gi tim marach mane gisetimone Israel.”
english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”

kikuyu: Kendo magi e gik mane ooro ni wuon-gi: punde apar motingʼo gik mabeyo mag Misri kod punde apar mamon motingʼo cham kod makati kod chiemo mane onyalo konyorego e wuoth ka obiro Misri.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

kikuyu: Giwachone yien ni, ‘In wuonwa,’ kendo ne kidi ni, ‘In ema ne inywola.’ Giselokona ngʼegi to ok wengegi, to sa ma gin e thagruok, giwacho niya, ‘Bi kendo ireswa!’
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’

kikuyu: Ruodhno nowuondo jowa mosando kwereu malit, ka ochunogi mondo giwit nyithindgi oko mondo otho.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

kikuyu: “Wasikwa duto wuoyo kuomwa marach gi ajara.
english: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ okethore modongʼ gunda, kendo dhoudi duto olor.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo Lakish ne jo-Israel, to Joshua to ne okawe e odiechiengʼ mar ariyo. Dala maduongʼno kod ji duto modak kanyo nonego gi ligangla, mana kaka ne otimone Libna.
english: The LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

kikuyu: Menahem notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo Pekahia wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ne oluongo chwore mi owachone niya, “Yie ior achiel kuom jotich okelna punda mondo adhigo ir ngʼat Nyasaye mapiyo kaka nyalore eka aduog piyo.”
english: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

kikuyu: Negikawo jongʼad rieko michulo mondo okwedgi kendo orund chenro mag-gi e ndalono duto mar loch Sairas ruodh Pasia kendo nyaka ndalo loch mar Darius ruodh Pasia.
english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

kikuyu: Ka utingʼo bedeu malo kulemo to anapandnu wangʼa, kendo kata ulem machal nade to ok anadwoku. Lweteu osechwero remo mangʼeny!
english: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

kikuyu: Omiyo miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ un joma odak e chula mag nam man yo wuok chiengʼ; tingʼuru nying Jehova Nyasaye malo, ma en Nyasach Israel,
english: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

kikuyu: Omiyo Hiram nooro joge ma jokwangʼ mane ongʼeyo nam mondo oti e yiedhi mag Solomon kaachiel gi joge Solomon.
english: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

kikuyu: Wasebedo gi ich, muoch osekayowa malit to ne wanywolo mana yamo. Ok wasekelo warruok e piny, bende pod ok wanywolo ji e piny.
english: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

kikuyu: Nikech ne ok utiyo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi ilo kod mor e ndalo mane un gi mwandu,
english: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

kikuyu: to kik icham olemb yath mamiyo ngʼato ngʼeyo ber gi rach, nimar chiengʼ ma inichame to initho.”
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

kikuyu: e nyim joma ne giriworego kod jolweny mag jo-Samaria, mowachonegi niya, “En angʼo ma jo-Yahudi manyapgi timo ka? Bende gibiro chako gero ohingano? Bende gibiro chiwo misango? Bende gibiro tieke godiechiengʼ achiel? Bende gibiro miyo kitegi bedo mangima ka gia e pith mag yugigo, kaka owangʼ-gi malichni?”
english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

kikuyu: kendo uchiwone Jehova Nyasaye misengini miwangʼo pep koa kuom kweth mag dhok kata mag jamni, kaka gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye bed ni gin misengini miwangʼo pep, chiwo mar hera, chiwo mag kwongʼruok kata mago mag nyasi.
english: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—

kikuyu: Kane Zekaria onene, ne obwok kendo luoro nomake.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

kikuyu: E dala mochiel mar Susa ne nitie ja-Yahudi moro ma ja-dhood Benjamin ma nyinge Modekai wuod Jair, ma wuod Shimei, wuod Kish,
english: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,

kikuyu: kendo gibed gi teko mar golo jochiende kuom ji.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

kikuyu: Ne ok oyie mondo ngʼato osandgi, nokwero ruodhi kowachonegi niya,
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: Kane aneno ni ok unyal konya, nakawo ngimana e lweta mi angʼado adhi mondo aked gi jo-Amon, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiya loch kuomgi. Koro, angʼoma omiyo ubiro kawuono mondo uked koda?
english: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”

kikuyu: Naaman nodhi ir ruodhe mowachone gima jatich ma nyar jo-Israel owacho.
english: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”

kikuyu: Kane Joshua osewuoyo gi ji, jodolo abiriyo mane otingʼo turumbete abiriyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nowuotho ka gigoyo turumbete, kendo Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne luwo bangʼ-gi.
english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of the LORD’s covenant followed them.

kikuyu: To ngʼe malongʼo ni kinde mag chandruok nobedie e ndalo giko.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

kikuyu: To janabi mahedhore wacho wach moro amora e nyinga ma ok anyise ni mondo owachi kata janabi ma wuoyo e nying nyiseche mamoko nyaka negi.
english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

kikuyu: Kido mar sibuoche apar gariyo nochungi e kuonde auchiel minyono kiidho kidhi e kom duongʼ ka moro ka moro ochungi e giko raidh auchiel koni gi koni. Onge pinyruoth moro amora manoseloso kom ruoth machalo kama.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

kikuyu: Anabed kodi kendo anaresi,’ Jehova Nyasaye wacho. ‘Kata obedo ni atieko chuth ogendini duto ma akeyou e diergi, ok anatieki chuth. Anakumu ka angʼadonu bura makare; ok anaweu ma ok akumou.’
english: For I am with you, says the LORD, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

kikuyu: Jarit od twech nokawo chikno matek mi noketogi ei od twech maiye, kotweyo tiendegi e kind lodi mag yien.
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

kikuyu: to ruodhe nyaka tere e nyim jongʼad bura. Notere e dhoot kata e siro mar dhoot kendo notuch ite gi riwi. Bangʼe obiro bedo misumbane nyaka chiengʼ.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

kikuyu: Nono to, ka jo-Makedoniagi obiro koda moyudo ka ok uikoru, wiwa dikuodi, ka ok awuoyo kuom wichkuot ma un bende duyudi, nikech geno maduongʼ ma waseketo kuomu.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

kikuyu: Gol oko kit gik mangima duto man kodi kaka winy, le kod gik moko duto mamol e lowo mondo ginywolre e piny kendo ginyaa kendo kwan-gi omedre e piny.”
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: moneno Nyasach Israel. E bwo tiend Nyasaye ne nitie gima chalo gi laru molos gi kit ombo, marieny ka polo.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

kikuyu: Omiyo dhano nodwok piny kendo ogendini mangʼeny noma teko, kuom mano ok nowenegi.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe noloso kareche apar mag luoko kendo noketo abich yo milambo to abich yo nyandwat. Karechego ema ne ilwokoe gik mane itiyogo kuom misengini miwangʼo pep to Karaya Maduongʼ to ne jodolo lwokoree.
english: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

kikuyu: nimar gin tawo mag joma otimo richo ewi ngimagi giwegi. Los tawono moriere kendo iketgi ewi kendo mar misango, nimar nochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo gisebedo maler. We gibed ranyisi ne jo-Israel.”
english: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kata ka nenore ni olingʼ, to en ngʼa ma dingʼadne bura? Koso kopando wangʼe, to en ngʼa ma dinene? To kata kamano en ema orito ogendini
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

kikuyu: Winjwa, yaye Nyasachwa, nimar osejarwa. Mad idwok ayenjegi e wigi giwegi. Mad ichiwgi kaka wasumbini e piny mabor ka joma oter e twech.
english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ngʼato terre gi dhako moluongo ni watne. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Abiro diri oko e lowo kendo abiro boli e dier pap malach. Abiro chiko winy duto manie kor polo mondo onur kuomi, kendo le mager duto mag piny biro chami mi giyiengʼ.
english: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, osiepena mageno, ringuru ua kuom nyiseche manono.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

kikuyu: Simon (mane omiyo nying ni Petro); gi owadgi Andrea, Jakobo, Johana, Filipo, Bartholomayo,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo chiw rwedhi abiriyo, imbe ariyo kod nyiimbe apar gangʼwen ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Masira nobi ewi masira, kendo weche mifwongʼo mabwogo ji nowinji kuonde duto. Ginitem mondo giyud fweny moa kuom janabi, gi puonj mag chike moa kuom jadolo, kod rieko ma jodongo ngʼado, to mago duto nobed maonge.
english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

kikuyu: Agola mare nochomo laru ma oko, sirnige ne ogorie yiend othidhe, kendo raidhi mi idho eka ichop kanyo ne gin aboro.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

kikuyu: Ka idhi gi ngʼama odonjoni e nyim jangʼad bura, tem matek mondo iwuo kode kendo uwinjru kapod un e yo, nono to obiro ywayi koteri ir jangʼad bura, to jangʼad bura biro keti e lwet askari, to askari biro boli e od twech.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

kikuyu: Kane Ruoth Hezekia owinjo wachno, noyiecho lepe morwako pien gugru mi odhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Mano biro timore mana ka udhi nyime e yieu, kendo kuchungʼ motegno ma ok uyiengni uweyo geno mar Injili. Ma e Injili mane uwinjo, kendo makoro oseyal ni chwech duto e bwo polo, kendo ma an Paulo asebedo ka atiyone.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

kikuyu: Ngʼata angʼata motingʼo ring chiayo mothono nyaka luok lepe, kendo en bende obiro bedo mogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Negiloso nyasi maduongʼ Bethania ne Yesu. Maritha ne miyo welo chiemo, to Lazaro to nobet kachiemo kaachiel gi joma nobet kolworo mesa.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

kikuyu: “Ka iholo pesa ni achiel kuom joga ma jachan mantie e dieru, to kik uchal gi ji mamoko ma holo ji pesa kendo kik ukaw ohala kuomgi.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

kikuyu: Kamano Solomon notimo sawo e kindeno kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto mane ni kode chokruok maduongʼ miwuoro kotingʼo joma oa Lebo Hamath nyaka Wadi man Misri. Negitimo nyasino e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kuom ndalo abiriyo kendo gichak gimedo ndalo abiriyo mamoko duto ne gin ndalo apar gangʼwen.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

kikuyu: Oganda mane ni kanyo manowinjo dwolno nowacho ni polo ema nomor, to ji mamoko to nowacho ni malaika ema nowuoyo kode.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

kikuyu: nimar mwandu ok sik mochwere, to osimbo mar loch ok nobed ne tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

kikuyu: Yawuot Juda ne gin: Er, Onan kod Shela. Yawuowi adekgi nonywolo gi nyar jo-Kanaan mane nyar Shua. (Timbe Er ma kach Juda ne richo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nonege.)
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kik iluore, nimar asechiwe e lweti, en kaachiel gi jolweny mage duto kod pinye. Timne kaka ne itimone Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, mane obedo gi loch e piny Heshbon.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: to kata kamano pod abiro bedo gi ilo kuom Jehova Nyasaye, kendo abiro bedo mamor kuom Nyasaye ma Jawarna.
english: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

kikuyu: Ne aparo e chunya niya, “Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ni jo-ratiro kaachiel gi joma richo, nikech gimoro ka gimoro ni kod sane.”
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

kikuyu: Ngimau nopongʼ gi olemo mag timbe makare maa kuom Yesu Kristo mondo Nyasaye oyud duongʼ kod pak.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel nyar Lut maduongʼ nowacho ne nyamin matin niya, “Wuonwa koro oseti, kendo onge ngʼama nyalo kendowa kaka chik mar piny duto dwaro.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

kikuyu: to kik chunyu bed mapek kaka ne utimo Meriba, kata kaka ne utimo chiengʼ cha Masa manie thim,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Ma e wach ma Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho kuom Moab.
english: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, wuod dhano, kor wach kendo ipam lweti kanyakla. We ligangla mondo oneg ji nyadiriyo kata nyadidek. En ligangla mar nek, adier en ligangla mar nek maduongʼ, moluorogi.
english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.

kikuyu: Gari mokwongo ne nigi farese masilwende, to mar ariyo ne nigi marotenge;
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

kikuyu: Awachonu ni ooyo! To ka ok ulokoru uweyo richou un bende ubiro mana tho.”
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano Manase nomiyo jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem oweyo Jehova Nyasaye mi gimedo timo timbe maricho moloyo ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye otieko e nyim jo-Israel.
english: Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: to ne ok ogwelo Nathan janabi, Benaya jarit ruoth kata Solomon owadgi.
english: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

kikuyu: To dhiuru upuonjru tiend wachni, ‘Gima adwaro en ni ukech joweteu, to ok ni uchiwna misango.’Nimar ok ne abiro mondo aluong joma kare, to nabiro mondo aluong joricho.”
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: “Wachne jo-Israel ni, ‘Magi e chike mabiro mako ngʼato ka odonjo e richo ka ok ongʼeyo kendo otimo gima chik Jehova Nyasaye okwero:
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

kikuyu: Naneno fweny gotieno ka ngʼat moro moidho faras ma silwal opore e nyima. Ne ochungʼ e dier yiend kuth ochwoga, e holo moro. Yo ka diengʼeye ne nitie farese masilwende, marobuore kod marochere.
english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

kikuyu: Ket chunyi ne puonj to iti ne weche mag ngʼeyo.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Ooyo ruodha, winja, amiyi puodho, kendo amiyi bur man kanyo. Amiyigo e nyim jowagi duto mondo iyikie ngʼati motho.”
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: mondo wamuonygi ngili ka bur liel mana ka joma omwony mangima gi bur;
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ka ojuk ngʼato katimo richo, to un joma nigi Roho onego uduoge gi chuny mamuol, kuritoru uwegi mondo kik udonj e tem.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

kikuyu: E nyim yore duto mag dala, ne igeroe kuonde motingʼore gi malo ma ilame nyisecheni mine injawo berni, kane ichiwo dendi ne ngʼato angʼata mane kadho buti nikech ringri nomedo oowre ni terruok.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, koro winj wach Jehova Nyasaye. Iwacho niya, “ ‘Kik ikor wach kuom jo-Israel, kendo ni kik iwach weche manono kuom joka Isaka.’
english: Now therefore listen to the LORD’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’

kikuyu: Ne agoyogi adunya ka buru ma yamo tero, ne achodhogi oko ka chwodho mag yore mag dala.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Timbene nigi duongʼ kod luor, kendo timne makare osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Bela wuod Beor nobedo ruodh Edom. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Dinhaba.
english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kik ijwangʼa; kik ibed mabor koda, yaye Nyasacha.
english: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Chiengʼno ruoth kod jotelo chunygi biro aa, jodolo nobed gi luoro maduongʼ, kendo jonabi nobed gi bwok maduongʼ.”
english: “It will happen at that day,” says the LORD, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”

kikuyu: Mo modongʼ e pat lwet jadolo, nyaka ool ewi ngʼat mipwodhono. Mano e kaka notimne pwodhruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.

kikuyu: Joka Josef to nodwoko niya, “Piny godeno ok oromowa, kendo jo-Kanaan duto modak e pawno nigi geche mag lweny ma tiendgi otimo nyinyo, kendo mago modak Beth Shan gi mier molwore kaachiel gi holo mar Jezreel bende nigi gechego.”
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Achiegni goli e pinyni. Mana e higani idhi tho, nikech iseyalo ngʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo to Nyasaye wachonegi ni: “Ngʼa momiyou thuolo mar olo chikena kata mondo ukaw singruok maga kaka mau?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

kikuyu: Kethou uwegi nomi nomau girkeni mane amiyou. Anami ubed wasumb wasiku e piny ma ok ungʼeyo, nimar usemedo mirimba, kendo enowangʼ nyaka chiengʼ.”
