english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jo-Lawi to ok noyud pok e dieru, nikech tichgi mar dolo ne Jehova Nyasaye e girkeni margi. To Gad, Reuben kod nus mar dhood Manase, to oseyudo girkeni margi e bath aora Jordan ma yo wuok chiengʼ nikech Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosemiyogi.”
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka ruoth nosedonjo e ode mar ruoth kendo Jehova Nyasaye nosemiye kwe e kinde gi wasike duto mane olwore,
english: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

kikuyu: Ngʼato moyie kuom Wuowi nigi ngima mochwere, to ngʼat modagi Wuowi ok none ngimano, nimar mirimb Nyasaye osiko kuome.”
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

kikuyu: nikech ne aluoro ogandana ahinya kendo ne aluor ni anywolana ne nyalo sin koda mine alingʼ, kendo ne ok anyal wuok oko.
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

kikuyu: ooyo, kama uchungʼie ok en kama iwinjoe koko mar turumbete maywak, kod dwol ma wuoyo to ok ne, ma joma nowinjo wechene noywagore ni kik ochak owuo kodgi kendo,
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

kikuyu: To kane oseriembo jachiendno kuome, ngʼat ma ne momo nowuoyo. Oganda nohum mowacho niya, “Gima chalo kama pok ne one e Israel nyaka nene.”
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu obet ewi Got Zeituni Jopuonjre nobiro ire mopenje lingʼ-lingʼ niya, “Wachnwa ane, gigi biro timore karangʼo, kendo angʼo mabiro bedo ranyisi mar bironi kod mar giko mar ndalo?”
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

kikuyu: Aore man Damaski ma gin Abana kod Farpar, donge beyo moloyo aore mag Israel? Donge ne anyalo lwokora e aorego mi achangi?” Omiyo nodok ka iye owangʼ.
english: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho ni jo-Yahudi manoyie kuome niya, “Ka usiko kumako puonjna, eka un jopuonjrena adier.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

kikuyu: mar piero ariyo gachiel ne Jakin, to mar piero ariyo gariyo ne Gamul,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

kikuyu: Anyisou wechegi mondo kik ngʼato owuondu gi weche manono maywayo ji.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

kikuyu: To nopenje niya, “Ochalo nadi?” Nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ moti morwako law abola ema wuok.” Eka Saulo nongʼeyo ni en Samuel, mi nokulore nyaka e lowo monindo piny e lowo auma.
english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.

kikuyu: Ahaz notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike kodgi e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Kendo Hezekia ma wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “Juda ywak, mieche madongo winjo lit; gidengo ne piny, kendo ywak winjore koa Jerusalem.
english: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.

kikuyu: Kata mana Herode bende ok oyude gi ketho, nimar osedwoke irwa; unyalo neno, ni ok osetimo gimoro mowinjore kod tho.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ moro nobedie ma jorit noywagi e gode matindo mag Efraim niya, ‘Biuru wadhi Sayun, ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.’ ”
english: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to the LORD our God.’”

kikuyu: Ka ichopo kanyo, to imany Jehu wuod Jehoshafat, ma wuod Nimshi. Dhi ire igole oko e kind ji kendo itere nyaka ei ot kar kende.
english: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

kikuyu: mondo ngʼato angʼata kik ngʼiew kata loko gimoro amora, makmana ka en gi kidono ma en nying ondiek malichno kata namba mochungʼ kar nyingno.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

kikuyu: Jo-Shup gi jo-Hup ne gin joka Ir, to jo-Hush to ne gin joka Aher.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim noa malo e but ringre chiege kendo owuoyo gi jo-Hiti kowachonegi niya,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An kodu mana kuom kinde matin kende, bangʼe to abiro dok ir Jal mane oora.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni nitie jomoko mochungʼ buta ka ma ok nobil tho kapok gineno pinyruoth Nyasaye ka biro gi teko.”
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, wengewa nojony, ka warango gima dikonywa; to oganda mane wageno kuome ni nyalo konyowa ne ok nyal konyowa.
english: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

kikuyu: Kuom mano owetena, ok wan nyithind dhako ma misumba, to wan koth dhako man thuolo.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Daniel noseloko lekno, Belshazar nogolo chik mondo orwak ne Daniel law maralik, oket ne thiwni mar dhahabu e ngʼute, kendo nokete jalup ruoth mar adek e pinyruoth duto.
english: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

kikuyu: Enorie bade kuomu un joma odak yo nyandwat, kendo notiek Asuria, bende dala mar Nineve nodongʼ gunda mi nobed motwo ka piny motimo ongoro.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

kikuyu: Omiyo nodok moyudo Balak kochungʼ but misango mane osechiwo ka en gi jodong Moab duto.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: E kindeno iniwach niya, “Gone Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, luong nyinge kendo landuru ni ji duto gik ma osetimo, ka uhulo ni nyinge nigi duongʼ moloyo.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

kikuyu: “Ma en odiechiengʼ manyaka upar ne tiengeu duto mabiro kendo nyaka urite ka sawo mochwere ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

kikuyu: Adwokone Nyasaye erokamano nikech awuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore moloyo un duto,
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

kikuyu: Ne adoko mamor kane Stefano gi Fortunato kod Akaiko ne obiro ira, nikech ne gichopona gima ne aremo mane onego un uwegi umiya.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

kikuyu: nyikwa Lod, Hadid kod Ono, ji mia abiriyo gi piero ariyo gabich (725),
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ondiko e kite mopagi weche mane ondikoe mokwongo, mane gin Chike Apar, mane owuoyogo kodu e got gi ei mach, e chiengʼ chokruok maler. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nomiyagi.
english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

kikuyu: chunya ma iye nobed mamor ka lewi wacho gima nikare.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nochikowa, ne wachako wuoth ka wawuok Horeb kendo ne wachomo pinje mag gode mar jo-Amor, kwakalo e dier bungu malich ma useneno kendo ne wachopo Kadesh Barnea.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: E kindeno Marduk-Baladan wuod Baladan ruodh Babulon nooro joote ir Hezekia gi barupe kod mich nikech ne osewinjo tuone.
english: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

kikuyu: to abiro kumogi mi wasumbini mag-gi giwegi pegi. Eka unungʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema oseora.”
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.

kikuyu: Kamano japecho jiwo jatheth, kendo ngʼat matiyo gi nyundo, jiwo ngʼatno magoyo musmal, konyiso jawengʼo gi mach niya, “Iriwo nyinyono maber.” Ngʼat machielo to guro nyasacheno motegno mondo kik lwar piny.
english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ni ngima dhano ok en mare owuon; ok en mar dhano mondo ochik yorene.
english: LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

kikuyu: Baruwa mar chik ruoth ne onego chak tich chiengʼ tarik apar gadek dwe mar apar gariyo miluongo ni Adar. Chiengʼ ma jowasik jo-Yahudi nogeno logie, wach nolokore mi jo-Yahudi ema koro noloyo jogo mane ochayogigo.
english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto, jopinje mamoko kod jopinyno machalre, ka gin gi jodong-gi, gi jotendgi kod jongʼad bura nochungʼ e bath Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye koni gi koni, ka gimanyore gi jo-Lawi ma gin jodolo. Nus mar jo-Israel nochungʼ kochomo got Gerizim, to nus mar jo-Israel mamoko nochungʼ kochomo got Ebal mana kaka Musa ma jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko chon kane ochiwo nonro mar gwedho jo-Israel.
english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the LORD’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.

kikuyu: “Ma e jatichna masemiyo teko, en e ngʼat ma aseyiero, kendo ma chunya morgo, abiro keto Roho mara Maler kendo obiro kelo adiera ne ogendini.
english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

kikuyu: nikech ondiki niya, “Abiro ketho rieko joma riek; kendo ngʼeyo mar joma riek abiro keyo nono.”
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

kikuyu: In gi yawuoti kod jotiji ubiro purone kendo ukel cham mondo nyakwar ruodhi obed gi chiemo to Mefibosheth, nyakwar ruodhi, to biro chiemo e mesana pile.” Ziba ne nigi yawuowi apar gabich gi jotich piero ariyo.
english: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

kikuyu: Beth Nimra kod Beth Haran, kendo negigero dipo ne jambgi.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

kikuyu: Yiero otama e kind gik mabeyo ariyogi: Chunya gombo ni atho mondo adhi abed gi Kristo, kendo mano en gima ber moloyo,
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye en soko mar ngima, ma reso ngʼato e obadho mag tho.
english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Samuel ne onyiso jatedo niya, “Kel lemo mar ringʼo mane amiyi, mane anyisi ni iket tenge.”
english: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”

kikuyu: Anachiwgi ne jogo madwaro ngimagi, ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon gi jotende. To kata kamano ji nodhi nyime dak Misri kaka chon,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Elija nowachone Elisha niya, dongʼ kae, nimar Jehova Nyasaye oora Jeriko. To ne odwoke niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kod nyingi iwuon ni ok anaweyi.” Omiyo giduto negidhi Jeriko.
english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

kikuyu: Noluongo matek niya, “Yesu, Wuod Daudi, yie ikecha!”
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Ogendini duto michweyo biro lami kapodho e nyimi, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye; bende gibiro miyo nyingi duongʼ.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

kikuyu: Mondo wan bende wabed machal gi ogendini mamoko, ka wan gi ruoth matelo nyimwa ka wadhi e lweny.”
english: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

kikuyu: Lut notingʼo wangʼe moneno paw Jordan duto ka nitie gi pi maber mana ka puoth Jehova Nyasaye, machalo gi piny Misri kochiko Zoar. (Mano notimore kane pok Jehova Nyasaye oketho Sodom kod Gomora.)
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

kikuyu: Eka unungʼe ni An ema aseoronu siemni mondo singruokna kod jo-Lawi odhi nyime,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: to ka weche duto nochop kare, to mago morem nogiki.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

kikuyu: An Paulo, jaote mar Kristo Yesu kuom dwaro mar Nyasaye; kod owadwa Timotheo, Ne kanisa Nyasaye man Korintho, kaachiel gi jomaler duto man Akaya:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

kikuyu: Eka nogwedho Josef mowachone niya, “Mad Nyasaye ma wuonena Ibrahim kod Isaka nowuothogo, Nyasaye ma osebedo jakwadh ngimana nyaka ndaloni,
english: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

kikuyu: Wabiuru e nyime gi erokamano kendo wami nyinge duongʼ ka wawer kendo wakok gi mor.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

kikuyu: Chik iti kendo iwinj dwonda, keturu chunyu mondo uwinj weche mawacho.
english: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

kikuyu: isedoko jaketho nikech remo misechwero, kendo isedoko mogak nikech nyiseche miseloso. Isemiyo ndaloni odoko machwok, kendo giko mar ndalo midakgo e piny osechopo. Kuom mano, abiro miyo idoko gima ogendini mamoko jaro kendo abiro miyo pinje duto nyieri.
english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

kikuyu: Jadolo notim misango mar golo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi imno kuom pwodho ngʼatno e kethone, eka richo mosetimo nowene.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

kikuyu: Ywaguru kendo denguru; un jokwath; ngʼielreuru e buru, un jokwadh rombe. Nimar sa mar negou osechopo; unupodhi kendo ungʼinjru matindo tindo, ka agulu molos mongʼith.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.

kikuyu: Nopenjo kendo niya, “Angʼo ma dapimgo pinyruoth Nyasaye?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Tengʼuru lweteu kendo gouru tiendeu piny kuywagoru niya, “Mano lit manade!” Nikech gik maricho gi mamono duto mag jo-dhood Israel, nikech gibiro podho e dho ligangla, gi kech kod tuoche.
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

kikuyu: In to isiko ichalri mana kaka in, kendo hiki ok norum.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

kikuyu: Ne ok inyal kata luongo nying nyameru ma Sodom gi nyinge e kinde mane sunga omaki,
english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

kikuyu: Okinyi mangʼich, odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma ka chiengʼ osewuok, negichako wuoth mar dhi kar liel,
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

kikuyu: To koro Elimelek ma chwor Naomi notho, mi nodongʼ gi yawuote ariyo.
english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.

kikuyu: Pak kod kwongʼ wuok e dhok achielno! Jowetena, gima kamano ok onego otimre.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

kikuyu: lachne ne romo fut apar, to lach mar sirnine ariyogo ne romo fut adek. Agola mar dhorangach midonjogo nochomo hekalu.
english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye owuoyo gi Musa e piny Misri,
english: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

kikuyu: Kata mana jo-Samaria to ne ok otimo kata mana nus mar richo ma usetimoni. Usetimo gik mamono mathoth mohingogi, kendo usemiyo nyimineu onenore ka gima gin joma kare nikech gik musetimogi duto.
english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

kikuyu: Beduru mamor kendo moil, nikech poku duongʼ e polo, nimar jonabi mane okwongonu bende negisando mana kamano.”
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

kikuyu: “Or jomoko odhi onon piny Kanaan, ma onego ami jo-Israel. Koa e dhoot ka dhoot manie oganda inior achiel kuom jotendgi.”
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

kikuyu: Gitweyo misigo mapek kendo giyieyo e goke ji, to gin giwegi to ok giikore kata mar mulo misigogo gi lith lwetgi.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

kikuyu: To Yesu nowacho niya, “Weuru nyithindo matindo obi ira, kendo kik utamgi, nikech pinyruodh polo en mar ji machal ka magi.”
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

kikuyu: Okwongʼa, an ngʼat ma timbene mono! To kata ka aonge ketho, to pod ok anyal bedo thuolo, nimar wichkuot ma an-go osemiyo alal ei masichena.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

kikuyu: Jaode ma Zeresh gi osiepene duto nongʼadone rieko niya, “Gur yath ma borne oromo fut piero abiriyo gabich mi liere ji, kendo ikwa ruoth gokinyi mondo oneg Modekai kolier kanyo. Eka mondo idhi uchiem gi ruoth ka imor.” Parono nomoro Haman, mi nogero gima inegogo ji koliergi.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye biro ngʼado joma ogen kod ji ajia mag Israel, othith kod odundu e odiechiengʼ achiel;
english: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

kikuyu: “Abiro kedone dala maduongʼni kendo rese, nikech nyinga kod nying Daudi jatichna!”
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

kikuyu: Or lerni kod adierani, orgi mondo gitelna; yie mondo gikela nyaka godi maler, nyaka kama idakie.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kikuyu: Mano kaka herani ma ok rum nengone tek, yaye Nyasaye! Joma idewo kaachiel gi joma ni piny yudo kar pondo margi e bwo tipo mar bwombeni.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane ni e kwan mar jolweny mathuondi piero adek ne gin: Asahel owadgi Joab, Elhanan wuod Dodo ma ja-Bethlehem,
english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Onge ogendini ma ok oter nyangu gie chunygi kata kuom ringregi moyie negidonjo kara maler mar lemo, kata obed ni gin oganda ma oko modak e dier jo-Israel.
english: The Lord GOD says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Ne nitie jamoko moro mane rwako lewni mokikore kod lewni mayom ma nengogi tek, kendo nodak e ngima mamalo mar mor ndalo duto.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

kikuyu: Kik idhaw gi ngʼama duongʼ gi dwol makwiny, to wuo kode mamuol giluor mana ka wuonu monywoli. Kaw yawuowi matindo ka oweteni,
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

kikuyu: kendo kuno jodolo madongo gi jotend jo-Yahudi nokel e nyime mi giwacho ketho mane gidonjonego Paulo.
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

kikuyu: Bor mar agola mane ni e nyim hekalu ne romo fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus maromre gi lach mar hekalu kendo borne modhi malo ne romo fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus. Nobawo iye gi dhahabu maler.
english: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

kikuyu: Ka awacho niya, “Mudho biro ima adier kendo ler biro lokorena otieno,”
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda nobiro Hebron, kendo ne giwiro Daudi obedo ruodh dhood Juda kanyo. Kane onyis Daudi ni jo-Jabesh Gilead ema ne oiko Saulo,
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeftha noluongo jo-Gilead duto mi gikedo gi jo-Efraim. Jo-Gilead nonegogi nikech jo-Efraim nosewacho niya, “Un jo-Gilead un mana jonjore mane oa Efraim gi Manase.”
english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Kane Harun kod jo-Israel duto oneno ka lela wangʼ Musa rieny, negiluoro biro bute machiegni.
english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Lawi nochungʼ koikore gi thumbe mag Daudi to jodolo noikore kod turumbete.
english: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye miyo jodhier yudo adieragi, kendo oneno ni ongʼad bura kare ne joma ochando.
english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

kikuyu: Nyasachwa en Nyasaye ma waro ji; tony e tho aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ma Wuon Loch.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

kikuyu: To nikech nyinga, ne atimo gimane nyalo miyo kik yanye e nyim ogendini mane oneno ka agologi e diergi.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

kikuyu: “Awachonu adier ni nitie jomoko mochungʼ buta ka ma ok nokal e tho kapok gineno Wuod Dhano kabiro gi pinyruodhe.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo ichalo gi ngʼat mobuok, kata ka jalweny maonge gi teko ma dokonygo ngʼato? In e dierwa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo iluongowa kod nyingi; kik ijwangʼwa!
english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, LORD, are in the middle of us, and we are called by your name. Don’t leave us.

kikuyu: Dhiuru loka e dho nembe mag Kitim kendo ungʼigi kaka gichalo, bende oruru ji Kedar mondo ginon maber; mondo gine anena ka gima chal kama nosebetie:
english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Cham ochiek mathoth, to jotich nok kuom mano kwauru Ruodh keyo mondo oor jotich odhi e puothe mar keyo.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Filistia nolo mine ok gichako gimonjo piny jo-Israel kendo. E kinde duto mane Samuel pod ngima, lwet Jehova Nyasaye nosando jo-Filistia.
english: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. The LORD’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

kikuyu: Poguru pinyno e kugoyo ombulu e kindu, kaluwore gi dhoutu. Dhoot maduongʼ opog lowo maduongʼ, to dhoot matin opog lowo matin. Gimoro amora mopogne dhoutu gombulu nobed margi. Pog-gi kaluwore gi dhout kweregi.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato nyap, to kor ode nyaka mukre marieny; to ngʼato ma budho abudha ma ok ti gi lwete, to ode nyaka chwer.
english: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.

kikuyu: Kik iwinjgi. Tine ruodh Babulon, to inibed mangima. Angʼo momiyo dala maduongʼni nyaka kethi?
english: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼado bura makare koro bor kodwa, kendo tim makare ok chop irwa. Wagombo ler, to mudho ema waneno; kendo wadwaro mondo piny oru, to mudho mandiwa ema wawuothoe.
english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

kikuyu: Tongʼ mar pinygi nochakore Aroer man but holo mar Arnon, kendo koa e dalano mantiere e dier holono nyaka Medeba,
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

kikuyu: Kendo kane ngʼatno oa malo mondo odhi, jaduongʼne nosaye, omiyo nonindo kanyo otienono.
english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

kikuyu: Joshua nowacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ere gima omiyo isekelo jogi loka mar aora Jordan mana ni mondo ichiwgi e lwet jo-Amor mondo itiekgi? Mad ne gik mane wan-go loka cha romwa kendo wasik kuno!
english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord GOD, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehoram nodhi Zair gi gechene duto mag lweny. Jo-Edom nolwore kaachiel gi gechene mag lweny, to nochiewo gotieno momwomogi; ka jolweny mage to noringo modok dala.
english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

kikuyu: Ka igero ot manyien, to nyaka iriw ragengʼ molworo gama mondo kik ikel chwero remo e odi ka ngʼato olwar e tat odi.
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

kikuyu: Omiyo negioro joote ir Jeroboam mi en kaachiel gi oganda duto mar Israel nodhi ir Rehoboam mi giwachone niya,
english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

kikuyu: kendo kane giyude to negiwachone niya, “Ji duto manyi.”
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

kikuyu: To un, osiepena mageno, gerreuru e yie maru maler, kendo lemuru ka un ei Roho Maler.
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ndiko mondik ewi msalaba manyiso kethone niya: Ma en Ruodh Jo-Yahudi.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Neuru lwetena gi tiendena. En an awuon! Mulauru kendo neuru; jachien onge ringruok kata choke, to an to uneno ka an-go.”
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Daudi nodonjo e hema mobet piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mowacho niya, “An to an ngʼa? Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, jooda to gin angʼo, momiyo isetimona gigi duto?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye notingʼa malo mi nokela nyaka ei agola maiye, kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo hekalu.
english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the house.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo idho wi got mar Jehova Nyasaye? En ngʼa manyalo chungʼ e ode maler?
english: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

kikuyu: Nochiko joma nodak Jerusalem mondo ochiw ni jodolo gi jo-Lawi pokgi mondo mi gichiwre gi chunygi duto ne Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: “Beduru motangʼ mondo kik utim timbeu makare e nyim ji, mondo eka gineu. Kutimo kamano to ok ubi yudo pok moa kuom Wuonu manie polo.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: nimar dala maduongʼ mar Aram en Damaski, to jatend Damaski en Rezin. Kuom higni piero auchiel gabich Efraim notieki ma kare nolal nono.
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

kikuyu: To kane ochopo kogwen kinyne, Nyasaye ne omiyo kudni ochwoyo otanglono, mi notwo.
english: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.

kikuyu: E sa ma ibiro chopoe, to ibiro miyo gichal gi kendo mar mach mager. Jehova Nyasaye biro mwonyogi kuom mirimbe mager, kendo mach mare biro tiekogi.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo ariyo obiro duogo chunywa to e odiechiengʼ mar adek obiro resowa, mondo omi wadag kode.
english: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.

kikuyu: “Eka napenjo ni, ‘Atim angʼo, Ruoth.’ “To Ruoth nodwoka ni, ‘Aa malo mondo idonji Damaski. Kuno ema ibiro nyisi gik moko duto moseyieri mondo itim.’
english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

kikuyu: Ginindo duk gotieno nikech gionge lewni; gionge gimoro amora ma ginyalo umorego ka koyo ngʼich.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

kikuyu: Bende ne umiyo Jehova Nyasaye mirima ka un Tabera, Masa, kod Kibroth Hatava.
english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.

kikuyu: To moloyo mano, wadoko joneno mariambo kuom Nyasaye nikech wasebedo ka wanyiso ji ni Nyasaye ema ne osechiero Kristo oa kuom joma otho. To kara ne ok ochiere ka en adier ni joma otho ok chier?
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

kikuyu: Joka Joel ne gin: Joel nonywolo Shemaya, Shemaya nonywolo Gog, Gog nonywolo Shimei,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

kikuyu: Paroni nomoro joma oyie kuom Kristo duto kanyakla, omiyo ne giyiero Stefano, ngʼat mopongʼ gi yie kendo gi Roho Maler, gi Filipo, kod Prokoro, gi Nikanor, gi Timon, gi Parmenas, kod Nikolao ja-Antiokia, ngʼat mane olokore oluwo din jo-Yahudi.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

kikuyu: Fupe nenore anena kata kowuotho e yo, kendo ji duto manene ongʼeyo ni ofuwo.
english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

kikuyu: Kane Finehas wuod Eliazar, ma wuod Harun jadolo, noneno ma, nowuok e chokruokno, mokawo tongʼ e lwete,
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kikuyu: Eka Zedekia nowachone Jeremia niya, “Kik iwe ngʼato ongʼe twak-wani, ka ok kamano to inyalo tho.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano rang jogo ma sungore, kendo iol mirimbi mager kuomgi mondo omi gibolre.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

kikuyu: E kindeno, jo-Yahudi mangʼeny nofwenyo ni Yesu ne nitie kanyo mi negibiro, ok nikech en, to nikech negidwaro neno Lazaro, manoyudo osechiero oa kuom joma otho.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nokonyogi kuom jo-Israel ma ok ginegogi.
english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

kikuyu: kod Resen, dala maduongʼ, man e kind Nineve kod Kala.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

kikuyu: Jou alufu achiel noringi ka ngʼato achiel obwogogi; bende jou noring duto ka ji abich obwogogi, mi unudongʼ kar kendu, mana ka yiend bandera mochwo ewi got malo kata ka law bandera mafwadhore ewi got.”
english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oyie mi wadgi ongʼiewo ode mar dak manie dala mochiel motegno gi ohinga, to oyiene mana mar ware ka higa achiel pok orumo nyaka ne ngʼiewe. Higano mangima en gi thuolo mar ware.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

kikuyu: To kuom ngʼat matimo ma, kata bed ni en ngʼama nade, Jehova Nyasaye mad ngʼad kare oko e hembe mag Jakobo, kata bed ni okelo misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: The LORD will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Nikech kata bed ni ngʼato oter nyangu kata ok otere ok lich, to gima dwarore en ni ochwe ngʼato chwech manyien.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

kikuyu: Mad tiend joma sungore kik nyona, kata lwet joma timbegi richo gola kama antie.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

kikuyu: Luwo chikeni mora mana kaka ngʼato bedo mamor kuom mwandu duto.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

kikuyu: “Edom nobed gima bwogo ji; jogo duto makalo bute nohum nono, kendo gininyiere ka gineno adhondene duto.”
english: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

kikuyu: Ma en odiechiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye oseloso; wamoruru kendo wail e iye.
english: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ onogono Musa nochiko oganda kowachonegi niya,
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

kikuyu: Jeftha nooro joote mondo odog ir ruodh jo-Amon,
english: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Mano kaka gik michweyo ngʼeny, yaye Jehova Nyasaye! Ne ichweyogi duto gi rieko miwuoro; piny opongʼ gi gik michweyo.
english: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

kikuyu: Kaka un gi gik mogundho e kindeni, ber mondo ukony jogo mochando mondo gin bende gibi gikonyu ka gin-go mogundho. Kamano otimore to ubiro bedo gi konyruok maromre,
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

kikuyu: Melkizedek-ni ne ok en nyakwar Lawi, to kata kamano Ibrahim jal mane Nyasaye omiyo singruok nochiwone achiel kuom apar kuom gik mane opeyo, kendo nogwedhe.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

kikuyu: Jal mabiro ngʼadona bura ni koda. Kare koro en ngʼa manyalo donjona? Owuogane oko koro! En ngʼa modonjona? Owuogane okwera.
english: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.

kikuyu: Koa yo podho chiengʼ nobedie migepe mag Efraim kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi. Jatend dhoodno ne en Elishama wuod Amihud.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nomiyo jo-Lawi miechgi kod kuondegi mag kwath.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: eka ubed jomaler kendo maonge wach gi ngʼato. Mano nomi ubed nyithind Nyasaye ma wach moro amora marach ok ogajo kudak e kind tiengʼ mobamni kendo matimo richo. Ler maru nyaka rieny ka sulwe manie kor polo e kind tiengʼni,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

kikuyu: Ogendini nobi, e lerni, kendo ruodhi nobi koneno lerni mar okinyi.
english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

kikuyu: Gimachielo magisetimona ema: Gisedwanyo kara maler mar lemo kendo giseketho Sabato maga e odiechiengʼ achiel machalre.
english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel duto chakre Dan nyaka Bersheba, kaachiel gi joma oa e piny jo-Gilead nowuok kaka oganda achiel ma gichokore Mizpa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to the LORD at Mizpah.

kikuyu: Kodhi moko nolwar e kind kudho, to kudhogo nodongo, mine githungʼo chamgo.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone niya, “Kata nobedo ni inenori ka ngʼama tin kamano, to donge ne ibedo jatelo mar dhout Israel? Jehova Nyasaye ne owiri mondo ibed ruodh Israel.
english: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel;

kikuyu: “Akuyo nikech ne aketo Saulo obedo ruoth, nikech oseweyo luwa, kendo ok otimo kaka ne achike.” Samuel nochandore kendo noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye otieno mangima.
english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to the LORD all night.

kikuyu: Magi to gin angʼo mafuyo ka boche polo, kata ka akuche maduogo e utegi?
english: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

kikuyu: Gin bende negigoyo ombulu mana kaka jowetegi ma nyikwa Harun notimo e nyim Ruoth Daudi kod Zadok, Ahimelek kaachiel gi jotelo mag anywola mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi. Jomadongo notimnegi mana machalre gi jomatindo.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

kikuyu: To ka awacho. “Ok analuonge kata wuoyo kendo e nyinge,” wachne chalo mach e chunya, mana ka mach marewo chokega. Aol gi tingʼe e chunya; adier, ok anyal.
english: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negiwuok Misri kendo gibiro Kanaan ir Jakobo wuon-gi.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata mohero wuon-gi kata min-gi moloya ok owinjore koda. Kamano bende, ngʼato angʼata mohero wuode kata nyare moloya ok owinjore koda;
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Negimako joote mi giterogi e od twech.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone Joab kaachiel gi jotend jolweny niya, “Dhiuru kendo ukwan jo-Israel kochakore Bersheba nyaka chop Dan, bangʼe to inyisa kar rombgi mondo mi angʼe ni gin ji adi.”
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

kikuyu: Negiyudo ka kidi mane odin-go dho liel kosengʼiel oko,
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo loso nyasaye mar bao kod mar chuma ma ok nyal miye ohala?
english: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?

kikuyu: Rowere ma jotend lweny mag gwenge nowuok e dala ka jolweny luwo bangʼ-gi,
english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

kikuyu: Eka ne wakalo Seir kama jowetewa ma nyikwa Esau nodakie. Bangʼe ne waa Araba kwachomo Elath kod Ezion Geber mi wawuotho kwachomo thim Moab.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

kikuyu: To kodongʼ gi higni manok mondo ochop e higa mar piero abich, to noware gi chudo ma piny.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nodhi monimo e aora Jordan nyadibiriyo mana kaka ngʼat Nyasaye nowachone kendo dende nochango mobedo mapoth ka mar wuowi ma rawera.
english: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ipako kaluwore gi riekone, to jogo man-gi paro mobam ichayo.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼat machiemo koda e tawo achiel biro ndhoga.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

kikuyu: Nyaka ipwodhgi mondo gibed maler moloyo kendo gimoro amora morere kuomgi nobed maler.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

kikuyu: kendo giniwach niya, “Lwetwa ne ok osechwero remoni kata wangʼwa ne ok oneno ka otimore.
english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko wach nowuok momako puoth mzabibu mar Naboth ja-Jezreel, puoth mzabibuno ne nitie Jezreel, machiegni gi dala ruoth maduongʼ mar Ahab ma ruodh Samaria.
english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

kikuyu: Josef nowachone niya, “Ma e tiend lek mane ilekono. Bede yadh mzabibu adekgo nyiso ndalo adek.
english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

kikuyu: Tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo, kane oyudo achungʼ e geng aora maduongʼ ma Tigris,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mani maki gi gigo mowal notieki gi mach, kaachiel gi gige duto, nikech oseketho singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo osetimo gima mono e piny Israel!’ ”
english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed the LORD’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

kikuyu: Omiyo negipenje niya, “Wachnwa ane ni en angʼo mokelonwa chandruokgi duto? En tich mane mitiyo? In japiny mane? To iwuok e oganda mane?”
english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ odongʼ ka oruombore piny kendo dhorangeye mage otur matindo tindo.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

kikuyu: Simon Petro nowachonegi niya, “Adok lupo” kendo negiwachone niya, “Wan bende wadok kodi.” Omiyo negiwuok gidhi kendo negidonjo ei yie. To otienono duto onge gima negimako.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

kikuyu: nono to jomoko nono ema inimi tekreni maber moloyo kendo higni magi norum e lwet joma ger,
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

kikuyu: Nying yawuot Harun ne gin Nadab ma wuowi makayo kod Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Kedemoth kod Mefath, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Dhakoni ne en nyar jo-Yunani monywol Foinike e piny Siria. Nobiro ir Yesu mohombe mondo oriemb jachien oa kuom nyare.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

kikuyu: Dhakono nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, yie imiyae pigno mondo riyo kik chak loya, kendo kik asik ka achandora gi biro ka pile pile mondo aom pi.”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

kikuyu: Kerubigo moro ka moro ne nigi lela wenge angʼwen: Lela wangʼ achiel ne mar kerubi, mar ariyo ne lela wangʼ dhano, mar adek ne lela wangʼ sibuor, to mar angʼwen ne lela wangʼ ongo.
english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

kikuyu: Yaye tekona, in ema angʼiyi, in e kar pondona, yaye Nyasaye,
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

kikuyu: “Gibiro chiemo to ok giniyiengʼ; gibiro chodo to ok gini nywolre, nikech giseweyo Jehova Nyasaye, mondo gichiwre
english: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.

kikuyu: Nyasaye keto joma odongʼ kendgi e udi kendo otelo ne joma otwe kower; to joma ohero ngʼanyo to dak e piny ma chiengʼ otwoyo kururu.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

kikuyu: Kel yawuote kendo irwaknegi kandho moro ka moro.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Owara kapok gimoro ohinya kuom lweny ma ji goyago, kata obedo ni ji mangʼeny kweda.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

kikuyu: Ahitub nonywolo Zadok, to Zadok nonywolo Ahimaz.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

kikuyu: Kane jodong Israel duto osebiro Hebron ir Ruoth Daudi notimo kodgi winjruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ne giwiro Daudi mondo obed ruodh Israel.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye un joma jaro ji ma, jotend ogandani modak Jerusalem.
english: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

kikuyu: Ngʼat moluoro Jehova Nyasaye nigi ohinga motegno, kendo nyithinde noyud kar pondo.
english: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

kikuyu: Eka Jesse noketo Shama mondo okadhi, to Samuel nowacho niya, “Kata mana ngʼatni bende Jehova Nyasaye ok oyiero.”
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”

kikuyu: Wuon gi min nyathi nowuoro wach mane owach kuome.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

kikuyu: wecheni obed weche mowinjore ma ngʼato ok nyal chayo ni gin weche mofuwo mondo joma ok oyie kodi wigi okuodi nikech gionge gimoro amora marach ma ginyalo wacho kuomwa.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

kikuyu: Avim, Para, Ofra,
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

kikuyu: Kane gichopo, negidhi nyaka kama negidakie, ei ot man malo ewi gorofa. Joma ne ni kanyo ne gin: Petro gi Johana, Jakobo gi Andrea; Filipo gi Thoma, Bartholomayo gi Mathayo, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, gi Simon ja-Zilote, kod Judas wuod Jakobo.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

kikuyu: Onge ja-Israel madichwo kata madhako manobed jachode ei hekalu.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

kikuyu: To keluru wasikago ka mane ok dwar mondo abed ruodhigi mondo uneg-gi e nyima.’ ”
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

kikuyu: Kane onene, noyiecho lepe mi oywak niya, “Yaye Nyara! Isemiya abedo modhier kendo gi thagruok, nikech ne asesingora ne Jehova Nyasaye ma ok anyal ketho.”
english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I can’t go back.”

kikuyu: Elija nodwoke niya, “Ok asekelo chandruok e Israel. To in gi odi ema isejwangʼo chike Jehova Nyasaye mi iluwo Baal.
english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

kikuyu: kod jolupne, ma gin Gabai kod Salai. Giduto ne gin ji mia ochiko gi piero ariyo gaboro (928).
english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: To isewachona ni, ‘Adier abiro miyo inyaa kendo abiro miyo nyikwayi bedo mathoth ka kuoyo man e dho nam, ma ok nyal kwan.’ ”
english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

kikuyu: To ka ok utimo kamano, to mad mach wuog kuom Abimelek mi wangʼu duto, un jo-Shekem kod Beth Milo, kendo mach mondo owuog kuomu mi owangʼ Abimelek!”
english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

kikuyu: Kendo an awuon abiro bedone ohinga mar mach molwore kendo abiro bedone duongʼ maler e diere,’ ” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

kikuyu: Kinde duto ka alemonu, to alemonu gi mor,
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

kikuyu: Mishmana ngʼat mar angʼwen, Jeremia mar abich,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

kikuyu: Solomon to nodwoko niya, “Ka timbene onyisore ni en ngʼat makare kata mana yie wiye ok enolwar e lowo; to ka richo oyudi kuome to enotho.”
english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

kikuyu: Mana ka sibuor mabiro koa e bungu moyugno mar Jordan, nyaka kar kwath man-gi lum, e kaka anariemb Babulon oa e pinye kadiemo wangʼ. En ngʼa mowal manyalo yiero ne ma? En ngʼa machalo koda kendo manyalo chungʼ koda? Koso jakwath mane manyalo chungʼ koda?”
english: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”

kikuyu: Ka ukwongʼoru ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, to kik ubadhru chule, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro bandhou wachno ma ubed joketho.
english: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi chi wuodi nikech en maru, ok oyieni mondo itim kamano.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

kikuyu: Omiyo chiengʼ lweny onge jalweny moro amora mane nigi Saulo kod Jonathan mane nigi ligangla kata tongʼ e lwete; makmana Saulo gi Jonathan kende ema ne ni kod ligangla gi tongʼ.
english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

kikuyu: Onge singruok moro amora mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo jo-Israel mane ok otimonegi; moro ka moro nochopo kaka nowacho.
english: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

kikuyu: Joma notony noringo kochomo lwanda Rimon, to jo-Israel nonego ji alufu abich kuomgi e yo. Negidhi nyime ka giluwo bangʼ jo-Benjamin nyaka Gidom ma ginego ji alufu ariyo mamoko.
english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

kikuyu: In bende imondo chiewo chon kendo ineno nyaka sa molewo, kinyagori gi tich matek mondo iyud chiemo minyalo chamo; nimar Nyasaye miyo joge mohero nindo mokwe.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

kikuyu: E kindeno Abimelek kod Fikol jatend jolweny mar Abimelek nowacho ne Ibrahim niya, “Nyasaye ni kodi e gimoro amora mitimo.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

kikuyu: Chuny ka chuny ongʼeyo litne owuon, to onge ngʼato machielo manyalo bedo e mor ma en-go.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

kikuyu: Gera, Shefufan kod Huram.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

kikuyu: Jogo maloso lewni nobed gi parruok, kendo jogo mayudo misara nobed gi chuny mool.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

kikuyu: “kata ni, ‘En ngʼa mabiro lor ei bur?’ ” (tiende ni, mondo ogol Kristo oa kuom joma otho).
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

kikuyu: mana kaka nochiwgi ne wan kod jogo motelo mane gin joneno wangʼ gi wangʼ kendo jotich wachni.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

kikuyu: Jamoko ne nigi rombe mangʼeny gi dhok,
english: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

kikuyu: “ ‘Gimoro amora manonindie e kinde moneno malo nobed mogak, kendo gimoro amora manobedie nobed mogak.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: waseketho e nyimi adier kendo ok waseluoro chike kod puonj mane imiyo jatichni Musa.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

kikuyu: Abram nowuotho e piny mochopo Shekem e tiend yath maduongʼ mar More. E kindego jo-Kanaan nodak e pinyno.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

kikuyu: “Los kandho mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi law marambulu,
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

kikuyu: Wan to polo e thurwa, kendo warito Jawarwa Ruoth Yesu Kristo gi geno mondo obi oomwa.
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ma e jal mane ondik kuome niya, “ ‘Abiro oro jaotena mondo otel e nyimi, obiro losoni yori kapok ibiro.’
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Kane osewacho mano, nokawo makati mi ogoyo ni Nyasaye erokamano e nyimgi giduto. Eka nongʼingo makatino mochako chiemo.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

kikuyu: Jo-Pathrus, jo-Kaslu (ma jo-Filistia nowuok kuomgi) kod jo-Kaftor.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: Eka Musa noluongo Bezalel gi Oholiab kod jotich duto molony mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo rieko gi nyalo kendo mane oyie biro mondo oti.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

kikuyu: Ka asekelogi e piny ma opongʼ gi chak kod mor kich, ma en piny mane asingora kakwongʼora ne kweregi, kendo ka gisemetho ma gibedo gi mor, to ginidogi ir nyiseche mamoko ma gilamgi, kagiweya kendo ketho singruokna.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka none, to ka tuono olandore e dende duto, to enowach ni ngʼatno ler. Nikech dende duto oselokore rachar, en ngʼat maler.
english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyaka usiem jo-Israel kuom gik mamiyo ji bedo mogak, mondo kik gidwany kar dakna maler manie kindgi, manyalo kelonegi tho ka gigak.’ ”
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

kikuyu: Negimonjo Juda magi kedo kode kendo negipeyo gik moko duto mane nitie e od ruoth kaachiel gi yawuote kod monde. Onge wuode mane odongʼ makmana wuode ma chogo miluongo ni Ahazia.
english: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

kikuyu: Adam nobedo e achiel gi chiege Hawa kendo nomako ich mi nonywolo Kain mowacho niya, “Kuom ngʼwono mar Jehova Nyasaye asenywolo wuowi.”
english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

kikuyu: Ne omigi Hebron ei Juda kaachiel gi kuonde kwath molwore.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

kikuyu: “Ka kech kata dera omako piny kata ka abach omako cham kata tuo ewi dongo, kata ka bonyo kata kungu, kata ka jowasigu olworo miechgi madongo, kata ka midekre kata tuo omakogi,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

kikuyu: Shimei nonywolo Mika, Mika nonywolo Reaya, Reaya nonywolo Baal,
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

kikuyu: Mier madongo-go gin magi: Bezer manie pinje gode motwo, mano ne jo-Reuben; Ramoth ei Gilead, obed kar jo-Gad; kendo Golan ei Bashan obed mar jo-Manase.
english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

kikuyu: Ne andiko negi gik mangʼeny mag chikena, to ne gikawogi kaka gigo ma welo kuomgi.
english: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni ok en nikech timu makare emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou piny maberni mondo ukaw, nimar kadier to un joma tokgi tek.
english: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

kikuyu: “To kaponi wuowini nigi wuode moro maneno richo duto ma wuon-gi timo, to kata obedo ni osenenogi; to en to pod ok otimo gik ma kamago:
english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

kikuyu: Solomon notimo winjruok gi Farao ruodh Misri mi nokendo nyare. Nokele e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi nyaka notieko gero ode owuon mar loch kod od Jehova Nyasaye mar lemo gi ohinga molworo Jerusalem.
english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, the LORD’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Wachneno nomiyo jo-Yahudi openjore niya, “Dibed ni ngʼatni dwaro dere? Dipo mano emomiyo owacho ni, ‘Kuma adhiye ok unyal bire?’ ”
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Ma e kar kwan joka Merari duto. Musa kod Harun nokwanogi kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiwo kokalo kuom Musa.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: kendo niya, “Kama ne owachnegi ni, ‘Ok un joga,’ kanyo ema ibiro luongogi ni ‘yawuot Nyasaye mangima.’ ”
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

kikuyu: Bende ne achako aparo niya, “Nyasaye temo dhano mondo gine ni gichalo gi le.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

kikuyu: Okinyi ka okinyi ngʼato ka ngʼato ne choko moromo gi dwarone to ka chiengʼ nobedo makech to chiemono ne oleny.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

kikuyu: Kama inithoe ema anathoe kendo kuno ema noyikae. Mad Jehova Nyasaye timna marach, kendo otimna marach ahinya, kapo ni gimoro amora opoga kodi ma ok mana tho kende!”
english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

kikuyu: Ne gikunyo yawo e kind ohinga ariyogo ne pi mawuok e soko machon, to ne ok upenjo Jal mane olose, kata miyo Jalno mane ochane luor.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

kikuyu: Nimar kindego chandruok maduongʼ nobedi maonge machielo minyalo pimogo aa chakruok piny nyaka sani, kendo onge chandruok moro mibiro pimo kode kendo.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

kikuyu: To Saulo gi jolweny noweyo Agag kod rombe mabeyo, gi dhok, gi nyiroye machwe gi nyirombe kod gimoro amora maber. Magi to ne ok giyie mondo oketh duto, to gimoro amora mane gichayo gi mago mayom yom to negitieko pep.
english: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma tekregi ni kuomi jogo moketo chunygi e luwo yori maler.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

kikuyu: Noorogi mondo gi dhi Lebanon dwe ka dwe ka gitiyo e migawo mar ji alufu apar (10,000) e dwe, omiyo negitieko dwe achiel Lebanon to dweche ariyo gitieko dala. Adoniram ema ne otelo e tich lwedo matek mar achunano.
english: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Anyalo timo gik moko duto kuom Kristo mamiya teko.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

kikuyu: ngʼat mane omiyo piny duto odongʼ gunda, mane otieko miechgi madongo, kendo mane ok nyal gonyo joma osetweyo odog thuchegi?”
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

kikuyu: Kik iluorgi, nimar an kodi kendo abiro resoi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ohinga mar dala maduongʼno nomuki kendo jolweny duto noringo ka tony gotieno ka gikalo e rangach man e kind ohinga ariyo man but puoth ruoth, kata obedo ni jo-Babulon nolworo dala maduongʼno kamano. Negiringo ka gichomo Araba,
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

kikuyu: Abich kuomgi nofuwo, to abich ne riek.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

kikuyu: Ji kunyo kite ma nengogi tek kuonde matut mogik kendo motimo mudho, omenyo nyaka ei buche maboyo miwuoro, nyaka kuonde molil ti, mondo onwangʼie kite mabeyo.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

kikuyu: “Enoked gi ruodh milambo, ka en gi oganda maduongʼ mar jolweny. To ruoth mar milambo bende notug lweny ka en gi jolweny maratipo kendo ma tekregi ngʼeny, kata kamano ok enonyal sire nikech jolwenyge moko nondhoge.
english: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

kikuyu: Negichungʼ kanyo kendo ne gisomo Kitabu mar Chik mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi kuom seche adek, kendo ne gihulo richogi ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi kuom seche adek mamoko.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.

kikuyu: to dhi e dala wuora kendo ir anywolana kendo iyudne nyako ne wuoda.’
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

kikuyu: Negia e odno, kendo sa mane gidhi negiwuoyo kendgi kagiwacho niya, “Onge gima ngʼatni timo marach mowinjore gi tho kata tere e od twech.”
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

kikuyu: Winjuru kaka nduru wuok e dala maduongʼ, kendo winjuru kaka kokono wuok e hekalu! Ma en dwond Jehova Nyasaye kochulogo kuor ne wasike moromo gi timbegi.
english: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya,“Ondiki ni, ‘Oda nobed od lamo;’to un to useloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

kikuyu: Mad ogwedhi kod nyikwayi kaka nogwedho Ibrahim mondo ikaw piny makoro idakieni kaka jadak, ma en piny mane Nyasaye omiyo Ibrahim.”
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

kikuyu: to Isaka namiyo Jakobo kod Esau. Ne awalo piny Seir manie got ne Esau, to Jakobo gi nyithinde nodhi Misri.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

kikuyu: Abiro biro e hekalu mari gi misango miwangʼo pep kendo abiro chopo kwongʼruok masetimo kodi.
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato mane nyalo neno wadgi kata wuok oko kuom ndalo adek, kata kamano piny Israel to ne nigi ler kama negidakie.
english: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

kikuyu: Kik ubed gi rapim ariyo e okapu magu mamoro pek to moro yot.
english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

kikuyu: Koro ka atimo gik ma ok adwar, to mano nyiso ni Chik ber.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

kikuyu: Ka ok oware ka higa pok orumo, to odno mantiere ei ohinga mochiel motegnono mar dala maduongʼ nosik mana kobedo mar ngʼat mane ongʼiewecha, kaachiel gi nyikwaye kod kothe duto nyaka chiengʼ. Kata kochopo higa mar piero abich to ok nodwoke e lwet wuon machon.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: Ka inego jogi duto dichiel, to oganda mabiro winjo wach machalo kama kuomi biro wacho niya,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

kikuyu: to ka kodhigo gin mosebudi e pi, mi gimoro amora motho olwarie, to nobed mogak.
english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Kendo koro Jehova Nyasaye osemiyo otimore; osetimo kaka ne owacho ni obiro timo. Magi duto notimore nikech nutimo richo ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok gitimo dwaro mare.
english: and the LORD has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho kamano, pogruok nowuok e kind joburago, ka jo-Farisai kwedore gi jo-Sadukai.
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

kikuyu: Eka negiwachone Jeremia, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye bed ja-adiera kendo janeno makare kuomwa ka dipo ni timbewa ok oluwore gi gimoro ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ooroi godo irwa.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which the LORD your God sends you to tell us.

kikuyu: Yie iwinj pwodhruok ma jogi Israel ma isereso yaye Jehova Nyasaye kendo kik ikaw jogi kaka joketho mochwero remo maonge ketho.” Kamano ginipwodhre kuom richo mar chwero remono.
english: Forgive, LORD, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

kikuyu: Ka ji apar odongʼ kata e ot achiel, to gin bende gibiro tho.
english: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.

kikuyu: Kaneno magi to apuodora ka rem rama e ringra, rem rama mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo; kibaji goya kuom gik mawinjo kendo midhiero omaka kuom gik ma aneno.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

kikuyu: Eka Filipo noringo odhi nyaka but garino mi owinjo ka ngʼatno somo kitap Janabi Isaya. Filipo nopenje niya, “Bende iwinjo tiend gima isomono?”
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

kikuyu: To ok anamaye pinyruoth duto, to abiro miye dhoot achiel nikech Daudi jatichna kendo nikech Jerusalem, ma aseyiero.”
english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

kikuyu: Isaka ma nohero ring le nohero Esau to Rebeka nohero Jakobo.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

kikuyu: Nyathi ma wuowi mokwong nywolo ema notingʼ kar nying wuon mare mane otho mondo kik nyinge lal nono e dier oganda jo-Israel.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

kikuyu: Magi e joka Ehud mane jotend dhoudi mane odak Geba, to ne odargi otergi Manahath.
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

kikuyu: Ka jotelo owinjo nine awuoyo kodi, kendo gibiro iri ma giwacho, ‘Nyiswa gima ne iwachone ruoth kendo gima ruoth nowachoni; kik ipandwa ka ok kamano to wabiro negi,’
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

kikuyu: Kuonde duto masewuothoe gi jo-Israel duto, bende asewachoe ni jotendgi mane aketo jokwadh joga niya, “Angʼo momiyo pok ugerona ot mar yiend sida?” ’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
