kikuyu: Yesu nochiewo mokwero yamo. Nochiko apaka kowachone niya, “Kwe! Lingʼ thi!” Gikanyono yamo nokwe mi piny olingʼ thi.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Ochayo ruodhi kendo omayo roteke gigegi mag lweny.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

kikuyu: Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye nosiko kuno gi jood Obed-Edom e ode kuom dweche adek kendo Jehova Nyasaye nogwedho gimoro amora e ode mane en-go.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

kikuyu: Ogendini mangʼeny nobi kawacho niya, “Biuru wadhi e got mar Jehova Nyasaye, e od Nyasach Jakobo. Enopuonjwa wechene mondo wawuothie e yorene.” Chik nowuog Sayun, kendo wach Jehova Nyasaye nowuog koa Jerusalem.
english: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ok aromo dwokora kodi omiyo mano ema omiyo alingʼ.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Joel wuod Pethuel.
english: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni Musa ok ema nomiyou makati moa e polo, to Wuora ema nomiyou makati mar adier moa e polo.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

kikuyu: “Koro Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel rit singruok mane itimo gi jatichni Daudi wuora kiwachone niya, ‘Ok inibed maonge gi ngʼato mobedo e kom loch e nyima e piny Israel, to mana ka yawuoti otimo tim makare e nyima mana kaka isetimo.’
english: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

kikuyu: To nikech ji mathoth ne biro irgi kendo aa ma ok giwenegi thuolo kata mar chiemo, Yesu nowacho ni jopuonjrene niya, “Wawuoguru ka mondo wadhi kamoro mopondo ma ji ongee mondo waywe kuno.”
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

kikuyu: Usedak e piny-ka kudhialoru e ngima mamalo, usebedo jowuoro mudoko machwe to koro chiengʼ yengʼo osechopo.
english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye oseketowa joma kare; biuru, we wawache ei Sayun, gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa osetimo.’
english: ‘The LORD has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.’

kikuyu: Ka yien onge to mach tho; ka kuoth onge dhawo rumo.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

kikuyu: kendo imi joge ngʼeyo wach mar warruok kuom weruok mar richogi,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

kikuyu: Ichweye mapiny ne malaike to koro isesidhone osimbo mar duongʼ kod luor;
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Yor ngʼat mofuwo nenorene ni nikare, to ngʼat makare chiko ite ne puonj.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jadolo nokel dhakono mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.

kikuyu: Gik makamagi osetimorenu mondo one ane ka un gi yie mar adier. To Kata mana dhahabu manyalo kethore bende ipwodho gi mach. Omiyo yie maru ma nengone tek moloyo dhahabu, nyaka tem mondo ongʼego ka en yie mar adier. Eka unuyud pak kod gi duongʼ kod luor, chiengʼ ma Yesu Kristo ofwenyore.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ne oyiera kaka jahul wach kendo kaka jaote. Awacho adier, ok ariambi, kendo an japuonj wach yie madier ne joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

kikuyu: Weuru sungoru ni un gi teko, kendo kuwuoyo kududo ngʼutu.’ ”
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

kikuyu: Onge kama jakwath noring dhiye, jokwadh rombe bende onge kama nopondie.
english: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.

kikuyu: Ndikgiuru ewi dhoutu kendo e rangeyeu,
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nonyise niya, “Kelna roya bwongʼ, diel kod im mahikgi adek, adek kaachiel gi akuch odugla kod nyathi akuru.”
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

kikuyu: Hanania wuod Shelemia, kod Hanun, wuod Zalaf mar auchiel, nogero migawo machielo e dir Shemaya. Meshulam wuod Berekia nogero ohinga e dir jogo, kama omanyore gi ode.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko ni jo-Israel wechegi, to kata kamano ne ok giwinje nimar chunygi nonyosore nikech tich mapek mar bedo wasumbini.
english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

kikuyu: Nikech gigi, Nyasaye biro olo mirimbe kuom joma ok winj wachne.
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: koluongo jogo makadho, madhi e yoregi.
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

kikuyu: Nikech yore mobam mag bayo mag jogo mangʼeyogi tin noneg-gi, kendo bedo ma ok odewo gimoro mar joma ofuwo notiekgi.
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nomedo wachone Ibrahim niya, “Koro ok inichak iluong Sarai chiegi ni Sarai, to iniluonge ni Sara.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

kikuyu: Johana notimo neno kuome. Nokok matek kowacho niya, “Ma e Jal mane awuoyo kuome kane awachonu ni, ‘Jal mabiro bangʼa oloya mabor nikech ne entie kapok ne abetie.’ ”
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

kikuyu: fedhago ema nochok kane ngʼato ka ngʼato mane okwan ogolo nus shekel kaluwore gi rapim mar kama ler mar lemo nimar kar romb joma nokwan machwo mahikgi oromo piero ariyo kadhi nyime ne gin ji alufu mia auchiel gadek mia abich gi piero abich (603,550).
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko goyo ngechegi, nowuok kanyo odhi nyime.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Ok kamano, ka ngʼato onegi, nochul ne kuor nyadibiriyo moloyo.” Eka Jehova Nyasaye noketo ranyisi kuom Kain mondo ngʼato moromo kode kik nege.
english: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

kikuyu: En kata jorit mage kata jopinyno ne ok owinjo weche mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kokalo kuom janabi Jeremia.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to the LORD’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

kikuyu: Jonabi mamoko duto bende ne koro wach mana machal kamano. Negiwacho niya, “Monj jo-Ramoth Gilead kendo ilogi, nikech Jehova Nyasaye enokete e lwet ruoth.”
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

kikuyu: Kendo nogero laru maiye gi kite mopa molwore nyadidek kaachiel gi laini achiel mar bap yiend sida.
english: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

kikuyu: Kendo jo-Misri nongʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye e kinde ma anakumgi ka agolo jo-Israel kuomgi.”
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

kikuyu: mar abich ne Malkija, to mar auchiel ne Mijamin,
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nokawo jotelo moko gi jolweny mi oringo odhi kodgi nyaka kuma ne oganda ochokore. Kane jokokogo oneno jatend lweny gi jolweny mane ni kode, ne giweyo goyo Paulo.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

kikuyu: to nonywolo nyathine makayo, ma wuowi. Ne oboye gi nanga kendo nokete e sanduku mar chiemb dhok, nikech ne onge thuolo e od welo.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

kikuyu: Nochako ooro jatich machielo, to ngʼatni bende negigoyo kendo timo ne tim wichkuot, ka giriembe gi lwete nono.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Ok oyiene jadolo madho divai seche modonjo e laru maiye.
english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

kikuyu: Dwol moro wacho niya, “Tingʼ dwondi iywagi.” To ne apenjo niya, “Ere gima aywago?” “Dhano duto chalo gi lum, kendo bergi duto chalo mana gi maua manie pap.
english: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye Maratego gwedhi kendo inyaa mi kwanu medre nyaka ubed oganda mathoth.
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

kikuyu: Kane Paulo osetieko wacho wechegi, nogoyo chonge piny kaachiel kodgi duto mi nolemo.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

kikuyu: Mon-go nomedo wacho niya, “Kane wawangʼo ubani ne Ruoth ma Dhako mar Polo kendo chiwone misango miolo piny, donge chwowa nongʼeyo nine waloso kek machalo gi kite kendo wachiwone misango miolo piny?”
english: The women said, “When we burned incense to the queen of the sky and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”

kikuyu: Kapo ni tich dolo mar jo-Lawi nikech chik mane omi jo-Israel notenore kuome ne nyalo miyo dhano doko makare chuth, to koro ere gimomiyo ne pod nitie dwaro mondo oyud jadolo machielo koluwo kit Melkizedek? Angʼo momiyo ne nyaka jadolo mopogore gi Harun yudre?
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

kikuyu: Eka Saulo gi joge nochokore mi gidhi e lweny. Negiyudo ka jo-Filistia pachgi ok ti, kendo gingʼadore gi ligangla kendgi giwegi.
english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

kikuyu: Ka jogo mane nigi Ishmael omako noneno Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny mane ni kode, negimor.
english: Now when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodhi malo koa ei dala maduongʼ kendo nochungʼ ewi got man yo wuok chiengʼ mar dalano.
english: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

kikuyu: To koro ne nitie ja-Benjamin machach ma nyinge Sheba wuod Bikri. Nogoyo turumbete kokok kowacho niya, “Waonge wat moro gi joka Daudi, kata gima oriwowa gi wuod Jesse! Yaye, ja-Israel moro ka moro odog e hembe!”
english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

kikuyu: Yawuot Jada owadgi Shamai ne gin: Jetha kod Jonathan. Jetha notho kaonge nyithindo.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

kikuyu: Neye kaka omiyo mil polo menyo kor polo duto, ka chuny nam to dongʼ kotimo mudho.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

kikuyu: Le mag thim ma gin ondiegi kod tula miya duongʼ, nikech asemiyogi pi e piny motimo ongoro kendo aseketo aore kuonde mojwangʼ, mondo joga mayiero oyud pi modho,
english: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho ni Mikal niya, “Ne atime e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, mane oyiera kar yiero wuonu kata ngʼato moa e dhoode kane oketa mondo atel ni oganda Jehova Nyasaye ma en Israel, abiro tugo kamiel e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oganda duto mar Israel nowuok Kadesh mi gibiro Got Hor.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Moko kuom jo-Farisaigo nowacho niya, “Ngʼatni ok oa kuom Nyasaye, nimar ok orito Sabato.” Ji mamoko to nopenjo niya, “Ere kaka ngʼama jaricho nyalo timo tim hono machal kama?” Omiyo ne gipogore e kindgi giwegi.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

kikuyu: Gik mitiyogo e mesano mane olosi gi dhahabu maler ne gin, sende, bakunde, tewni kod agulnine mitiyogo kuom chiwo misengini miolo piny.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Anywola jo-Shuham duto kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero auchiel gangʼwen mia angʼwen (64,400).
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Atweyo chiemo nyadiriyo e juma ka juma, kendo achiwo achiel kuom apar mar gigo duto manwangʼo.’
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

kikuyu: Ne akwayo jopuonjreni mondo oriembe oko, to ne otamogi.”
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

kikuyu: Kendo ne awachonegi niya, “Abiro kawo pinygi kendo abiro miyougo kaka girkeni, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.” An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mosepogou gi ogendini mamoko.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, angʼo momiyo idaga kendo ipandona wangʼi?
english: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Un to uneno nangʼo? Ere kaka dwadwok jogi mawacho ni, ‘Dwok chien tingʼ mapek mane wuonu oketo kuomwa’?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

kikuyu: “ ‘In dhako ma jachodeni! Igeno chwo mamoko moloyo chwori iwuon!
english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

kikuyu: Ruoth onego ngʼe nine wadhi e gwengʼ mar Juda, e hekalu mar Nyasaye maduongʼ. Ji gedo gi kite madongo kendo giketo bepe e kore. Tich tiyore e yo modimbore kendo odhi nyime mapiyo e bwo telo margi.
english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ mochiel nolal nono koa Efraim nyaka kom loch man Damaski; jo-Aram manok modongʼ tekogi norum mana kaka mar jo-Israel norumo,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Yie kethoni kende nikech isengʼanyone Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, isekayo timbegi mag ngʼwono mana ne nyiseche manono e bwo yiende motimo otiep, kendo pod ok iluora,’ ” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against the LORD your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To ka ok iore, to ok wabi dhi, nikech ngʼatno nowachonwa ni, ‘Ok abi chak awuo kodu ka ok ubiro gi owadu.’ ”
english: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

kikuyu: Wiyi osewil gi Nyasachi ma jaresni; adier ok iseparo Lwanda ma en ohingani. Kuom mano kata ka ipidho cham mabeyo kendo ipidho mzabibu migolo e pinje ma oko,
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane Yesu lemo kama opondo kendo ne en gi jopuonjrene, nopenjogi niya, “Oganda wacho ni An ngʼa?”
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

kikuyu: Ruodh Jeriko, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Ai (machiegni gi Bethel), ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

kikuyu: Dhood Simeon nodag butgi. Jatend dhood Simeon ne en Shelumiel wuod Zurishadai.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, Yesu nodhi Jerusalem e Sap jo-Yahudi.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo tucho piene kod wiye gi bidhi michwoyogo rech?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

kikuyu: Ji alufu achiel nyalo podho e bathi, ee, ji alufu apar nyalo riere e badi korachwich, to in onge moro ma nochop buti.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

kikuyu: An Paulo koro akwayou kuom muolo kod ngʼwono mar Kristo mondo uwinja. An ma usebedo kuwacho ni amuol ka an kodu, to ager ka an mabor kodu!
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

kikuyu: “Piny none malit nikech gik mamiyo ji donjo e richo! Ochuno ni gik makamagi nyaka bedie, to okwongʼ ngʼatno makelo gigo!
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noolo thuonde man-gi kwiri mager kuomgi; negikayo ji kendo jo-Israel mathoth notho.
english: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

kikuyu: Ringreu modongʼ ema nobed chiemb winy manie kor polo gi ondiegi manie thim, kendo onge ngʼato angʼata manogolgi kuomu.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

kikuyu: Nyasachwa, donge dingʼadnegi bura? Wan to waonge kod teko ma wanyalo kedogo kod oganda lweny maduongʼni ma monjowani. Wan ok wangʼeyo gima dwatim, genowa waketo kuomi.”
english: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

kikuyu: Wuowino ne ok ongʼeyo gimoro amora mane timore, makmana Jonathan gi Daudi kende ema nongʼeyo.
english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

kikuyu: Eka negidhi ir Joshua e kambi man Gilgal mi giwachone Joshua kod jo-Israel niya, “Wawuok e piny mabor, omiyo yie watim kodu winjruok.”
english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nogero kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye, mano e chiengʼ mokwongo mane otime ma.
english: Saul built an altar to the LORD. This was the first altar that he built to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny duto notelo ne jo-Juda duto mane otony mi odwogo mondo odag e piny Juda koa e pinje duto mane okegie.
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

kikuyu: to adier, onge ngʼama wendo mosenindo oko e laru, nikech dho oda nosiko koyaw ne jawuoth.
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

kikuyu: Kendo kuom Jezebel Jehova Nyasaye nowacho kama, guogi biro kidho Jezebel e tie ohinga mar Jezreel.
english: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

kikuyu: in mane imiyo nembe olingʼ, wuo mar apaka margi, kod koko mag ogendini.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

kikuyu: Ochungʼ e kuonde motingʼore e bath yo, e akerkeke mag yore.
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

kikuyu: Kane Finehas jadolo kod jotend gwengʼ, ma gin jotend anywola mar jo-Israel, nowinjo gima Reuben, Gad kod Manase nowacho, negibedo gi mor.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

kikuyu: Jeyel wuon Gibeon ne odak Gibeon. Jaode niluongo ni Maaka,
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

kikuyu: Kane onon wachno moyud ni en adieri, jotelo ariyogo nolier e yath. Magi duto ne ondiki e kitap weche mag ruodhi mana ka ruoth neno.
english: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.

kikuyu: Kobedo ni pod ok udwogo ira kata bangʼ timonu magi duto, kendo udhi mana nyime gi wich teko,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel mane ni e kambi nowinjo ni Zimri osemonjo ruoth mi onege, negiketo ni Omri ma jatend jolweny, mondo obedo ruoth mar Israel mana gi chiengʼno.
english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

kikuyu: “Ndalona ringo mapiyo moloyo jangʼwech; girumo piyo ka gionge mor kata matin.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

kikuyu: Bade ma koracham oteno wiya, to bade ma korachwich okwaka.
english: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

kikuyu: Jakobo owuon notelo nyimgi mi opodho auma nyadibiriyo e nyim Esau owadgi.
english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

kikuyu: nyikwa Jora, ji mia achiel gi apar gariyo (112),
english: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel oneno ngʼatno, to giduto ne giringe ka giluor ahinya.
english: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified.

kikuyu: Nochako omako ich kendo onywolo wuowi kendo nochake ni Onan.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

kikuyu: Mano kaka mich ma Nyasaye oseolo kuomwa kuom ngʼwonone ogundho.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

kikuyu: To nikech wan jo-odiechiengʼ, wabeduru gi ritruok ka warwakore gi yie kod hera kaka law akor mar lweny; kendo gi geno mar warruok kaka ogut lweny.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

kikuyu: Idh-uru udhi e gode mondo ukel yien ugernago ot manyalo morgo, kama duongʼna maler nyalo nenoree,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: nus mar kek molos gi olemb ngʼowu to gi kek molos gi resin. Nochiemo ma chunye noduogo nikech noyudo pok ochiemo kata modho pi kuom odiechienge adek gi otieno bende.
english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

kikuyu: Joshua nondiko chik Musa e kitego e nyim jo-Israel.
english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne atiegogi ma amiyo gibedo motegno to gichano gik maricho kuoma.
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

kikuyu: Joma kare neno masira to pod gimor amora, to joma pok otimo gimoro amora marach jarogi, kagiwacho niya,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nodhi kuno gi monde ariyo, Ahinoam nyar Jezreel gi Abigael ma dhako ma chwore otho mane jaod Nabal ja-Karmel.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

kikuyu: to dhakono nyaka ngʼad lwete, kendo kik timne ngʼwono.
english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoko niya, “Osiepna, tim gima nokeli.” Eka jogo nochorore nyime mi ondhiyo Yesu, kendo negimake.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: “Kaw thumi ilworgo dala maduongʼ, yaye nyako ma jachode makoro wich osewilgo, go thumino mamit, wer wende mangʼeny mondo kanyalore to opari.”
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya nowachone Hezekia niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kama:
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Armies:

kikuyu: Shimei wuod Ela norito Benjamin;
english: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

kikuyu: Nikech usewangʼo ubani kendo usetimo richo ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo pod ok uluore kata luwo chikene kata puonj mage kod dwaro mage, masirani osebiro kuomu, mana kaka unene sani.”
english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”

kikuyu: Gibiro nyiso ji kuom duongʼ mar pinyruodhi kendo gibiro wuoyo kuom tekoni,
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

kikuyu: E kindeno Samuel ne pod ok ongʼeyo Jehova Nyasaye nikech wach Jehova Nyasaye ne pok ofwenyorene.
english: Now Samuel didn’t yet know the LORD, neither was the LORD’s word yet revealed to him.

kikuyu: “Jatijno mongʼeyo dwaro mar ruodhe to ok otem timo gima ruodhe dwaro nochwad mangʼeny.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

kikuyu: to in mudho ok timni mudho kendo otieno rienyni ka odiechiengʼ, nimar mudho chaloni ler.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

kikuyu: Dhiuru uneye Kalne, mi uchop nyaka Hamath, eka bangʼe ulor udhi nyaka Gath manie piny jo-Filistia. Uparo ni pinjego ber moloyo pinjeu? Koso uparo ni nitiere piny maduongʼ moloyo pinyu?
english: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato omiyo misumbane gik moko duto chakre ka en rawera, obiro kelo kuyo e gikone.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

kikuyu: Johana nodwokogi duto niya, “An abatisou gi pi. To ngʼato moro biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma ok awinjora gonyo tond wuochene. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

kikuyu: To kaka Yesu nongʼeyo pachgino, nowachonegi niya, “Uchando dhakoni nangʼo? Osetimona gima ber miwuoro.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar aboro negibiro mondo giter nyathi nyangu kendo negidwaro chake nying wuon-gi Zekaria,
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

kikuyu: Jodhohogo nodhi nyaka dho kambi ma gidonjo e achiel kuom hembego. Negichamo chiemo kendo gimetho bangʼe gitingʼo fedha, dhahabu kod lewni mine gidhi gipandogi. Negidwogo kendo mi gidonjo e hema machielo, ma gikawo gik moko kanyo kendo gidok gipando.
english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

kikuyu: Ka dhako osudo machiegni gi chiayo mondo oterre kode, giduto nyaka neg-gi kendo rembgi obed e wigi giwegi.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

kikuyu: to ka joga miluongo gi nyinga obolore ka lemo kendo manyo wangʼa, ka giweyo yoregi maricho, eka nawinj gie polo, mi nawenegi richogi kendo nares pinygi.
english: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

kikuyu: Hazael nopenjo niya, “Ere kaka jatichni marom gi guok aguoka nyalo timo gik ma kama?” Elisha nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osenyisa ni ibiro bedo ruodh jo-Aram.”
english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

kikuyu: Asenath nyar Potifera, jadolo mar On nonywolone Josef Manase kod Efraim e piny Misri.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

kikuyu: Yawuot Hebron ne gin: Jeria mane wuowi makayo, Amaria mar ariyo, Jahaziel mar adek gi Jekameam mar angʼwen.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: “Wangʼ ma jaro wuoro, ma dagi winjo wach miyo, ibiro lodho oko kod agak manie holo, ibiro chamgi gi achudhe.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

kikuyu: Ka Moab ochopo kuonde hembko mag misengini, to ochandore achanda nono; to kata ka odonjo e kare mar lemo, to en mana kayiem nono.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gabich mar loch Kaisar Teberio, kane Pontio Pilato ne ruodh Judea, to Herode ne ruodh Galili, kendo Filipo owadgi ne ruodh Iturea gi Trakoniti, to Lusania ne ruodh Abilen,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

kikuyu: To gimoro amora ma piny nochiegnu e hik Sabato nobed mar chiembu, chiemb jotichu machwo gi mamon kaachiel gi jotichu mamoko, kod welo molimou kuma udakie kuom ndalo machwok,
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

kikuyu: Ruodh Horma, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Arad, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

kikuyu: Oganda mane otelo nyime kod mago mane odongʼ chien nekok ni, “Hosana ne Wuod Daudi!” “Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye!” “Hosana manie polo malo!”
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: To ka ngʼatno hike chakre abich nyaka piero ariyo, to noware gi shekel piero ariyo ka en dichwo, to ka en dhako to noware gi shekel apar.
english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: “Wachne Rehoboam wuod Solomon ruodh Juda kaachiel gi dhood Juda kod dhood Benjamin gi oganda duto ni,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

kikuyu: Abigael ne ok oketho seche. Nokawo makati mia ariyo, ndede ariyo mar divai, rombe abich moyangʼ gi chamb aloda madirom kilo piero adek gabiriyo, olemb raisin mongʼin maromo mia achiel, gi olemb ngʼowu molos mopamore moromo mia ariyo, eka noketogi e punde.
english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

kikuyu: Yesu ema nochiw mondo otho nikech richowa kendo nochiere mondo oketwa kare.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

kikuyu: Ubiro manya, to ok unuyuda, kendo kama antie ok unyal bire.”
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

kikuyu: Negimiye rech matin moro motedi
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

kikuyu: Kane en ja-higni apar gariyo, negidhiyo e Sawono kaluwore kod timgi.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

kikuyu: Koro jodolo madongo gi jopuonj Chik nochako manyo yo mane ginyalo makego nikech negingʼeyo ni ogetogi kod ngeroni. To negiluoro oganda, omiyo ne giweye mi gingʼwel gia kanyo.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma orito chikene kendo ma manye gi chunygi duto.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

kikuyu: Nikech singruok mane omi Ibrahim ni piny nobed mare, ne ok obirone kata ne kothe kuom chik, to nobiro kuom tim makare mar yie.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

kikuyu: Uziel wuod Harhaya mane en achiel kuom jotheth, nogedo e dir jogo kendo; to Hanania, mane en achiel kuom jolos gik mangʼwe ngʼar, nogedo mokiewo gi Uziel ka gigero ohinga mar Jerusalem nyaka kama ohinga lachgo.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

kikuyu: To nikech un, Jehova Nyasaye ne okecho koda kendo ne ok onyal chiko ite ne wechena. Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Mano oromo, kik ichak iwuo koda kuom wachno.
english: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, konindo aninda, to obiro mana chiewo.”
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

kikuyu: Negilosone dhoranga Hemb Romo law mayom momin mar range marambulu, maralik kod marakwaro, ma en tich jachwecho molony;
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

kikuyu: To ne ogolowa kuno kokelowa e piny mane osingore ne kwerewa kokwongʼore ni nomiwa.
english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

kikuyu: Timuru gima nikare e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mondo udhi maber e yoreu, mi udonji kendo kaw piny maber mane Jehova Nyasaye osingore ne kwereu kokwongʼore,
english: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: wuod Methusela, wuod Enoka, wuod Jared, wuod Mahalalel, wuod Kenan,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

kikuyu: Eka Elihu nowacho kama:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: Bangʼ dweche ariyo, nodok ir wuon mare kendo wuon-gi notimo mana kaka nosesingore. Ne en nyako ngili. Kochakore e ndalono, jo-Israel noketo chik ni
english: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel

kikuyu: E higa mar abiriyo Jehoyada nonyiso tekone. Ne otimo winjruok kod jotend migepe mag jolweny mia achiel magin Azaria wuod Jeroham gi Ishmael wuod Jehohanan gi Azaria wuod Obed gi Maseya wuod Adaya kaachiel gi Elishafat wuod Zikri.
english: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

kikuyu: Bangʼe chielne laru alwora pasia bangʼe ilier pasia moro mondo ogengʼ dhoranga laru.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

kikuyu: Nokedo gi pinje abiriyo mag jo-Kanaan moloyogi, mi opogo lopgi ni joge kaka girkeni.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

kikuyu: Bende ne nitie kata mana chwo materore kuonde lemo e pinyno, ne nitie kendo ji notimo timbe dwanyruok mag ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye oriembo oko e nyim jo-Israel.
english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Abdon wuod Hillel notho, kendo noyike Pirathon man Efraim, e piny got mar jo-Amalek.
english: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu noyude e hekalu mowachone niya, “Winji, koro isedoko mangima. We richo, nono to gimoro marach moloyo biro timoreni.”
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

kikuyu: Ruodh duongʼni en ngʼa? Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, En e Ruodh Duongʼ. Sela
english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nobed malit ne dala mopongʼ gi remo, dala mopongʼ gi miriambo, dala mopongʼ gi gige mecho, kendo dala mopongʼ gi gik moyaki mosiko ka chando ji!
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

kikuyu: An owuon ema napuonjo Efraim wuotho, ka amakogi gi bedegi, to ne ok gifwenyo ni ne en An mane ochangogi.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.

kikuyu: Koro ywak jo-Israel osechopona, kendo aseneno kaka jo-Misri sandogi.
english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

kikuyu: to jasigu ma komogi en Jachien. Keyo en giko piny, to jokeyo gin malaike.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

kikuyu: Bende onyalo goyone jatichneno erokamano nikech notimo gima nowachone notim?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

kikuyu: Moko nolwar ewi lwanda mine gitwi kendo ne gitwo nikech ne gionge kod ngʼich.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata manyalo ponono kochamo chiemo mowal kokia ni en gima ochiw ni Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka ochul jadolo ka omedo gi achiel kuom abich mar nengo mar gima ochamo cha.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

kikuyu: Nowacho bende niya, “Ma e kaka pinyruoth Nyasaye chalo. Ngʼato chwoyo kodhi e lowo.
english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

kikuyu: Bende enoresi kuom dhako ma jachode, kuom dhako mabayo gi wechege maywayo ji,
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nochako oyworo ni lweny e holo mar Refaim;
english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye nogo ji gi kihondko maduongʼ. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nomak wadgi mondo ogorego.
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Nimar kane itimo gik madongo mane ok wapar, ne ilor piny ma gode ne oyiengni e nyimi,
english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

kikuyu: To Sihon ruodh Heshbon ne otamowa kadho e pinygi nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nosemiye wich teko, kendo chunye odoko matek mondo ochiwe e lwetu mana kaka osetimo.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

kikuyu: Yorene dhi maber kinde duto, okawore omiyo chikeni ni mabor moyombe; ojaro wasike duto.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

kikuyu: E odiechiengno abiro ketho atungʼ mar pinyruodh Israel e Holo mar Jezreel.”
english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

kikuyu: Yaye dhood jo-Israel, genuru kuom Jehova Nyasaye, En e konyruokgi kendo okumbagi.
english: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Gigegi mitingʼoe asere chalo gi liel ma dhoge oyawore; giduto gin jolweny maroteke.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

kikuyu: To nowachone niya, “Owadu nobiro mowuonda mi okawo gwethni.”
english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

kikuyu: Jo-Gad nogero mier madongo motegno kaka Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

kikuyu: Notimo ma kuom Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa, kaluwore gi dwarone mane osechano chakre chon ni notim.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: “Lingʼuru kendo weyauru awuo; mondo gima dwaro timorenano otimre.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

kikuyu: Rapim ma ok nikare gi pimo ma ok kare, Jehova Nyasaye mon kodgi duto.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Tedna ringʼo mamit mana kaka ahero cha kendo ikelna mondo acham mondo mi amiyi gwethna kapok atho.”
english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

kikuyu: nikech noparo singruok mane otimo kodgi kendo noloko chunye nikech herane maduongʼ.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Kuom mano joma timbegi richo ok nolo bura, adier, joricho ok nobedi e kanyakla mar joma kare,
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Ka joma otho ochier to ok ginikendi kata kend ok nokendgi ngangʼ, to ginichal gi malaike manie polo.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

kikuyu: To iro mar mach mar sandgino dhi malo nyaka chiengʼ. Jogo malamo ondiek malich kod gima ket kode, kata jogo mondik negi kido mar nyinge, ok noyud yweyo odiechiengʼ kata otieno.”
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

kikuyu: Kendo unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ok useluwo buchena kata rito chikena, to useluwo mana yore mag ogendini molworou.
english: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Elisha nodhi Damaski moyudo ka Ben-Hadad ruodh Aram tuo. Kane onyis ruoth ni ngʼat Nyasaye osebiro mochopo ka,
english: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

kikuyu: Kane gimedo dhi nyime, negichopo kama pi moro ne nitie. Ja-Ethiopia nowachone Filipo niya, “Pi eri, angʼo ma dimona yudo batiso?” [
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

kikuyu: Omiyo kit olemo ma ginyago ema ubiro ngʼeyogigo.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

kikuyu: Mon mangʼeny bende ne ni kanyo, ka ngʼicho gichien. Negisebedo ka giluwo bangʼ Yesu koa Galili ka gichiwone gik monego okonyrego.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Dhiyo, inyis herani ni chiegi kendo, kata obedo ni ohere gi ngʼama chielo, kendo en jachode. Here kaka Nyasaye ohero jo-Israel, kata obedo ni gisebaro ka gihero nyiseche moko kendo gihero chiwonigi misengini mag mzabibu motwo.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

kikuyu: To dwesni nowuok kochiko Beth Shemesh tir, negiluwo yo ka gidhi to giywak, ne ok gibaro korachwich kata koracham. Ruodhi mag jo-Filistia ne luwogi nyaka negichopo e tongʼ man Beth Shemesh.
english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

kikuyu: Odi gi pinyruodhi nosik nyaka chiengʼ e nyima kendo lochni nogurre nyaka chiengʼ.’ ”
english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

kikuyu: Joma ochecho akwero ni, ‘Weuru sungoru,’ to joma timbegi richo to okwero niya, ‘Weuru tingʼo tungeu malo.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

kikuyu: Omiyo, neuru, ni ler manie iu ok en mudho.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Ich wangʼ mara kod mirimba nool kaeni, kuom dhano kod le, kuom yiende manie puothe kod kuom olembe mag lowo, kendo nowangʼ ma ok nyal neg majno.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”

kikuyu: Koro Abiathar wuod Ahimelek nosebiro gi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod e kinde mane oringo kodhi ir Daudi Keila.
english: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼat ma Ruoth pako ema ji yiego, to ngʼat mapakore kende onge rieko.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

kikuyu: Ka iyudo mor kich, to cham mana moromo, mathoth ahinya, nyalo miyo ingʼogi.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

kikuyu: “Nyaka ikaw tich mar rito kama ler mar lemo kod kendo mar misango, mondo mi masira kik lwar kuom jo-Israel kendo.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

kikuyu: To ne ok gingʼeyo ni Josef owinjo gima giwacho nikech Josef noketo ngʼama lokone wach.
english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

kikuyu: to Kain kod misango mare to ne ok oyiego. Kuom mano Kain mirima nomako kendo wangʼe nojuol.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

kikuyu: Nikech kinde biro ma ubiro wacho ni, ‘Ogwedhu, un mon ma ok onywol kod thunde ma ok nodhodhi!’
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

kikuyu: Ngʼwono gi kech kod kwe, moa kuom Nyasaye Wuoro kod Yesu Kristo wuode, biro bedo kodwa e adiera kod hera.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Abiro wer nikech herani gi berni; in ema abiro weroni wend pak, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye osekonya e kindego duto, omiyo koro ahulo wechegi machalre, ni ji ajia kod joma ogen. Onge gima awacho mopogore gi mago mane jonabi kod Musa jowacho ni notimre.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

kikuyu: Ne owarowa kuom rembe koweyonwa richowa koluwore gi ngʼwonone mathoth.
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

kikuyu: Yesu nochungʼ mowacho niya, “Luongeuru obi ira ka.” Omiyo negiluongo muofuno ka gikone niya, “Bed gichir! Aa malo! Oluongi.”
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi to ne omi tich mar rito gik miberogo ot to gi gik mamoko duto mowal mane itiyogo e kama ler mar lemo kaachiel gi mogo kod divai, gi mo, gi ubani kod gik moko mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

kikuyu: Nomonjogi gi mirima ahinya mi onego ji mangʼeny kuomgi. Bangʼe nodhi modak e rogo mar lwanda man Etam.
english: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamedo mwandu gi ohala ma malangʼ choko mwandu ne ngʼat machielo, mabiro bedo mangʼwon gi jochan.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka joma rateke osetho! Kendo gigegi mag lweny osetieki!”
english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Mad gidwog jo-Israel modongʼ kaka jochok olemb mzabibu; ngʼauru bedeu e bede yath, mana kaka ngʼama pono olemo.”
english: The LORD of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

kikuyu: Joma timo singruok kwongʼore gi nying joma oloyogi gi duongʼ, kendo kwongʼruok ma gitimo golo kiawa moro amora e kind joma otimo winjruokgo.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

kikuyu: Petro nowachone Yesu niya, “Rabi, bedowa kaeni en gima ber. We mondo wager hembe adek kae; achiel mari, achiel mar Musa, to machielo mar Elija.”
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Yo wuok chiengʼ, ma en kilomita ariyo, rangeye adek nobedie, ma gin: rangaj Josef, rangaj Benjamin gi rangaj Dan.
english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

kikuyu: “Eka kech maduongʼ nomako piny Misri gi Kanaan kendo nokelo chandruok maduongʼ e piny ma kata kwerewa ne ok nyal yudo chiemo.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

kikuyu: “Ne iwachona ni, ‘Koro chik iti mondo iwinj gima awacho; abiro penji penjo, kendo ibiro dwoka.’
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

kikuyu: Bende negikawo agulni, opawo, gir ngʼado otambi mar taya, tewni mikwoyogo remo, bakunde kod gik moko duto molos gi mula mane itiyogo e hekalu.
english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

kikuyu: Noyudo Yesu osewacho ne jachien marachno niya, “Aa kuom ngʼatni!”
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

kikuyu: Kane jotelo mariembo geche lweny noneno Jehoshafat negiwacho e chunygi niya, “Adier ma en ruodh Israel.” Omiyo negilokore mondo giked kode, to kane Jehoshafat oywak,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

kikuyu: Nikech ka usiko uchamo makatini kendo umadho kikombeni, to unyiso tho mar Ruoth nyaka chop oduogi.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

kikuyu: To kata otin kamano to kosekome to odongo mi obed maduongʼ moloyo yiende mag puodho duto. Bedene yarore madongo mi winy mafuyo e kor polo biro ywe e tipone.”
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

kikuyu: Gik mopondo duto ni e lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, to gik mofwenynwa gin magwa kod nyithindwa nyaka chiengʼ, mondo mi walu weche duto mondiki e kitabuni.
english: The secret things belong to the LORD our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

kikuyu: Pinyni kaachiel gi gombo duto kadho, to ngʼat matimo dwach Nyasaye nobed mangima nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

kikuyu: Gin bende ema kwerewa madongo noa kuomgi, kendo kata mana Kristo, kuom anywolane kaka dhano, bende oa kuomgi; En ma en Nyasaye kuom duto, kendo mipako nyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: “Anto awachonu un joma winja kama: Heruru wasiku, timuru maber ni jomamon kodu.
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

kikuyu: Abiro pidhi kanyo, nikech pod nitiere higni abich mag kech mabiro. To ka ok kamano, in kod joodi duto kod giwu duto ubiro chanduru.’
english: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

kikuyu: Gidiro weche mag wich teko; joma timbegi richo duto opongʼ gi sunga.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

kikuyu: Berne ne chalo kawuok chiengʼ; kendo ler ne mil ka wuok e lwete, kama tekone opandie.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

kikuyu: Nobed maber ni jotich ma ruodhgi noyud karito e kinde modwogo. Awachonu adiera ni norwakre gi lawe mondo omigi chiemo, nomi gibed e mesa mi nobi mopognegi chiemo.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

kikuyu: To ruoth nodwoko Arauna niya, “Ooyo, nyaka achuli. Ok abi timo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha misango miwangʼo pep gi gik mayudo nono.” Omiyo Daudi nochulo fedha madirom nus kilo kongʼiewogo laru mar dino kaachiel gi rwedhi.
english: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

kikuyu: jotelogi duto nooro Jehudi wuod Nethania, ma wuod Shelemia, wuod Kushi, mondo owach ne Baruk niya, “Kel kitabu ma isesomone ji kendo ibi.” Omiyo Baruk wuod Neria nodhi irgi gi kitabuno e lwete.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

kikuyu: Abisalom ne ok owacho gimoro maber kata marach ni Amnon; to nosin kod Amnon nikech ne osekuodo wi Tamar nyamin-gi.
english: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

kikuyu: Musa noluongo ogendini mag jo-Israel duto kanyakla mi owachonegi niya, “Gik ma Jehova Nyasaye ochikou mondo utim e magi:
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nooro joote ir Jesse kawacho niya, “Orna wuodi Daudi makwayo rombe.”
english: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

kikuyu: Ok oluoro weche makelo kuyo nikech chunye otegno kendo ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, magi e joma chano timbe maricho kendo mangʼado riekni maricho e dalani.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

kikuyu: Kane ochopo godhiambo, Yesu nochopo, ka en kod jopuonjrene apar gariyo.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

kikuyu: Wasekwedo timbe malingʼ-lingʼ mag miriambo makwodo wich, ok wakonyre gi wuond, bende ok wagaj wach Nyasaye, to wawuotho e ler mar adiera kendo wachiwore ni ji duto, mondo chunygi orwakwa e nyim Nyasaye.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Ibiro kwongʼou ka udonjo kendo kuwuok.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mangima mane ni e piny kaka winy, jamni, le mag bungu, gik mamol duto e piny kod ji duto notho.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

kikuyu: Weche mane ondiki kuom yawuote gi weche mane jonabi okoro kuome kaachiel gi kaka noloso hekalu mar Nyasaye ondiki e kitap weche mag ndalo mar ruodhi. Kendo Amazia wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “Eka inyisgi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Methi, mer kendo ngʼogi, mi ipodh piny ma ok inyal chungo malo kendo nikech ligangla ma anaor e dieru.’
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’

kikuyu: To ngʼat machielo to tho ka chunye opongʼ gi lit, ma ok oneno ber moro amora e ngimane duto.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

kikuyu: E ndalo mane Jerusalem ni e chandruok kod chuny lit, noparo mwandune duto mane en-go e ndalo machon. Wasike nojare kendo onyiero kuom thagruok mage.
english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.

kikuyu: Ne ioro ranyisi mag honni kod gik miwuoro ne Farao, kendo kuom jotende duto kod jopinyni duto, nimar ne ingʼeyo kaka jo-Misri ne tiyo jowa githuon. Ne iloso nyingi, ma pod en kamano nyaka chil kawuono.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kendo kawacho niya,
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: gi Og ruodh Bashan, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kane jopiny mane nitie e bwo loch Hadadezer oneno ni jo-Israel oseloyogi negiloso kwe kod Daudi mi gibedo e bwo lochgi. Omiyo jo-Aram ne ok ochako oyie konyo jo-Amon kendo.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

kikuyu: Kane pod janabino wuoyo, ruoth nowachone niya, “Bende waseketi jangʼad rieko ne ruoth? Lingʼ thi! Koso idwaro tho?” Omiyo janabi nolingʼ, to bangʼe nowacho niya, “Angʼeyo ni Nyasaye osechano ni mondo otieki nikech gima isetimo kendo ok isewinjo puonjna.”
english: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

kikuyu: to nowachonegi niya, “Ne ukelo ngʼatni ira kaka jal mamiyo ji goyo koko ka gidagi, winjo chik. Asenone e nyimu to ok aseyudo gima dimi odonjne.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

kikuyu: Pak odog ne Ruoth, ma en Nyasaye ma Jawarwa, Nyasaye matingʼonwa pekwa ndalo duto. Sela
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Got Shefa mi gibworo Harada.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

kikuyu: Kendo mano e gima ne otimorene, nimar ji nomwomore gie dhorangach monyone mi otho.
english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

kikuyu: Ngʼat achiel neno ni odiechiengʼ moro ler mohingo machielo; ngʼat machielo to okaw odiechienge duto ni romre. Ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo obed gi ratiro e pache owuon.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

kikuyu: Kik ipidh kothe ariyo e puoth mzabibu, kitimo kamano, to gik motwi kata ochiek kanyo duto nobed mogak kendo ginidongʼ ei kama ler mar lemo.
english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Nopenjo Amnon niya, “Yaye wuod ruoth, angʼo momiyo inenori mokuyo pile ka pile? Ok diwachna gima timi?” Amnon nodwoke niya, “Ahero Tamar ma nyamin owadwa Abisalom.”
english: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”

kikuyu: Ne ochungʼ kendo noyiengo piny, ne ongʼicho mi ogendini otetni. Gode machon nomukore kendo gode matindo manyaka nene bende nopodho. Yorene osiko manyaka chiengʼ.
english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

kikuyu: Yath maber ok nyal nyago olemo marach, kendo yath marach ok nyal nyago olemo maber.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

kikuyu: To Ahaz nowacho niya, “Ok abi kwayo to bende ok abi temo Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Azgad, ji alufu ariyo mia adek gi piero ariyo gariyo (2,322),
english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

kikuyu: To kata mana sani an gi jodolo alufu abiriyo e piny Israel duto mapok okulore ne Baal, kendo ma pod olame ka nyodhe.”
english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisechamo cham duto mane gia godo Misri, wuon-gi nowachonegi niya, “Doguru mondo udhi ungʼiewnwae chiemo moko.”
english: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

kikuyu: Umed nyanywok achiel mar chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Ne aparo kuom ndalo machon, higni machon gi lala;
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

kikuyu: Lwedo moro nomula, mi nomiyo tiendena gi bedena ochako tetni.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

kikuyu: Koro odno nyaka muki, kendo kitene gi yiendene, kod lope duto nyaka ter e tok pacho mondo owitgi kama ok ler.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

kikuyu: To jolweny duto ne odonjo ei bungu to ne nitie mor kich piny.
english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

kikuyu: Kendo oseketho nying jatichni ni ruodha ma en ruoth. Ruodha ma en ruoth chal ka malaika mar Nyasaye; omiyo tim atima gima ineno ni berni.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

kikuyu: Bende herane ma ok rem dirum chuth adier? Bende singruokne nyalo bare ma ok ochopo nyaka chiengʼ?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

kikuyu: Koko wuok koa Dan, ka goyo milome mar masira koa e gode matindo mag Efraim.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi chi owadu nikech mano nyalo kelo wichkuot ne owaduno.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Joma ne rito angurogo noringo oa mine gidhi e dala mi ginyiso ji gima notimoreno, kaachiel gi gima noyudo osetimore ne joma ne nigi jochiende.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

kikuyu: Kush gi Put, gi Lidia gi Arabia duto; kod Libya gi jopiny singruok bende nopodhi e dho ligangla kaachiel gi Misri.
english: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”

kikuyu: Ubiro bedo kod yien zeituni e pinyu to ok unukonyru gi moe nikech zeituni nolwar piny.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

kikuyu: Zora, Aijalon, kod Hebron. Magi ne mier mochiel gohinga motegno e piny Juda kod Benjamin.
english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

kikuyu: Adwaro ni unyisa wach achielni kende: Bende ne uyudo Roho Maler kuom rito Chik koso nikech nuyie wach mane uwinjo?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Kuom mano negipenje niya, “Kara en hono mane ma idwaro timo mondo wane eka wayie kuomi? Angʼo mibiro timonwa?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kikuyu: Bende jo-Keila nochiwane? To bende Saulo biro biro ka kaka jatichni osewinjo? Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, nyis jatichni.” Eka Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Obiro biro.”
english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? LORD, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” The LORD said, “He will come down.”

kikuyu: “Dan nobed jangʼad bura ne joge mana kaka achiel kuom oganda Israel.
english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: To ka aparo kaka pi wangʼi ne chwer to chunya gombo neni ahinya mondo abed gi mor mogundho.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

kikuyu: “Kwer minu, kwere, nikech ok en jaoda, kendo ok an chwore. Onego owe wangʼ maneno mar chode kendo gi yorene mag dwanyruok.
english: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

kikuyu: Nying maber oloyo bedo gi mwandu mathoth; bedo gi pwoch ber moloyo fedha gi dhahabu.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

kikuyu: Duongʼ maler mane olworeno ne chalo gi lihudu manie boche polo e odiechieng koth. Ma e kaka nenruok mar kit duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ne chalo. Kane anene, napodho ka lela wangʼa ochomo piny, kendo nawinjo dwond ngʼat ma wuoyo.
english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

kikuyu: Ka farese Farao gi gecheni kod joidh faresene ne odhi e nam, Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo pi nam odok e wangʼe mi oimogi, to jo-Israel nongʼado nam kawuotho ewi lowo motwo.
english: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

kikuyu: gi rachungi mar taya molos gi dhahabu maler gi gigene duto kaka techene gi mo milielgo;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

kikuyu: Bwok maduongʼ nomako jolweny mane ni e kambi gi mago mane ni e paw lweny, kata mana mago mane ni e kambi matindo tindo kendo piny duto noyiengni. Ne en kihondko moor gi Nyasaye.
english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

kikuyu: Tongʼno nodhi nyaka Debir koa e Holo mar Akor mi ogomo kochiko nyandwat nyaka Gilgal, mangʼiyore gi Pass mar Adumim mantiere yo milambo mar holono. Nodhi nyime koluwo dho aora mar En Shemesh mochopo nyaka En Rogel.
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye bed jangʼad buchwa mondo opog wach e kindwa. Mad onon wach makare kendo otingʼa malo; mad ochwaka kendo oresa e lweti.”
english: May the LORD therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”

kikuyu: Mad chur ma joma otwe churgo chopi e nyimi; rit ngima joma osengʼad nigi buch tho, gi teko mar badi.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

kikuyu: Winjuru wachni jowetena mageno: Donge Nyasaye oseyiero joma piny kwano ni odhier mondo obed joma omew e yie margi kendo mondo ocham mwandu mag pinyruoth mosesingo ni joma ohere?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

kikuyu: Winji lamo mar jatichni kaachiel gi jogi Israel ka gilamo ka gichomo odni. Winji gi e polo kar dakni kendo kiwinjo to iwenwa richowa.
english: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

kikuyu: Tim ma kamano nomi ringri bedo gi ngima kendo nobed chiemo ne chunyi.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

kikuyu: Hana to nomiyo nyadiriyo nikech nohere, kendo Jehova Nyasaye noloro iye mane ok onyal nywol.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ja-Misri moro noresowa e lwet jokwath, mi otuomonwa pi kendo omiyo jamni pi omodho.”
english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mochamo ringra kendo omadho remba siko kuoma, to an bende asiko kuome.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

kikuyu: Nikech wangʼeyo ni ka kiru mwadakieni okethi, to wan gi ot ma Nyasaye osegeronwa e polo, ma en ot mosiko, ma lwet dhano ok ogero.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

kikuyu: Bangʼ-gi ne achako aneno wi cham abiriyo motho kendo yamb oro otwoyo.
english: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

kikuyu: jopinje mamoko duto modak kanyo gi; ruodhi duto mar piny Uz; ruodhi duto mag jo-Filistia (mago mag Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron kod jogo mane odongʼ Ashdod);
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

kikuyu: Eka Musa nodok ir Jehova Nyasaye mowachone niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, en angʼo momiyo isekelo chandruok ni ogandani? Koso ma emomiyo ni ora?
english: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

kikuyu: Petro nowachone niya, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo osechangi; aa malo iban pieni.” Ainea noa malo mana gisano.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

kikuyu: Kik uchul kuoro, osiepena, to weuru thuolo ne mirimb Ruoth Nyasaye, nimar ondiki niya, “An ema nachul kuor; abiro chulo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Pakeuru, un malaikane duto, pakeuru, un jopolo duto.
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

kikuyu: Ngʼama ok ohera ok nyal timo gima apuonjo. Weche muwinjogi ok gin maga awuon, to gin mag Wuora mane oora.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

kikuyu: Dhoho mar Naaman biro gore kuomi kendo kuom kothi ndalo duto.” Kuom mano Gehazi nowuok e wangʼ Elisha ka dhoho omako dende duto marachar ka pe.
english: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni isemiyo aneno chandruok mathoth kendo malit, to pod ibiro miyo abed mangima kendo. Ibiro gola e bur matut mi achak abed gi duongʼ.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomi ubed jotelo to ok joma itelonegi. Ka urito chike ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kawuononi kendo uluwogi adimba, to kinde duto unubed jotelo to ok joma itelonegi.
