english: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Kik iketh gik moko.” Miktam mar Daudi. Un jotelo, bende uwuoyo gi adiera? Bende ungʼado bura moriere tir e dier ji?
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon nochiewo moyudo ni ne en mana lek. Nodok Jerusalem mochungʼ e nyim Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo nochiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mag lalruok. Eka notimo nyasi ni joge duto manie dala mar ruoth.
english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

kikuyu: To Gideon nokonegi niya, “Ok anabed jatendu, kata wuoda bende ok nobed jatendu. Jehova Nyasaye ema biro bedo jatendu.”
english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.”

kikuyu: nikech ne ok girito chikena gi buchena kendo ne ok girito Sabato maga, ka chunygi osiko kagombo nyiseche manono mag kweregi.
english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

kikuyu: Ne idak e Eden, e puoth Nyasaye; ne irwakori gi kite mopogore opogore ma nengogi tek kaka: rubi, gi topaz, gi emerald, gi krisolit, gi oniks kod jaspa, gi safir, gi tarkus kod beril. Gigi duto ne owir manyilni gi dhahabu kendo ne olosnigi e kinde mane ochweyie.
english: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.

kikuyu: To odiechiengʼ mar ochiko e dwe mar angʼwen e higa mar apar gachiel mar loch Zedekia, ohinga mar dala maduongʼno nomuki.
english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

kikuyu: Anachulgi nyadiriyo kuom timbegi mamono kod richo mag-gi, nikech gisenjawo pinya kod gigi mopa maonge ngima kendo gisepongʼo girkeni mara gi nyisechegi manono maonge tich.”
english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”

kikuyu: Kik uket siro mar Ashera moro amora e bath kendo mar misango ma ugerone Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu,
english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

kikuyu: Nyaka ikaw thoth bath chiwo duto maler ma ok owangʼ e mach. Koa kuom mich duto ma gikelona kaka chiwo maler moloyo, bedni en chiwo mar cham, kata mar misango mar golo richo kata mar pwodhruok, pokno en mari kod yawuoti.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

kikuyu: Giseolo remo e alwora mar Jerusalem ka pi, kendo koro onge ngʼama nyalo yiko joma otho.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

kikuyu: Ruodhe nodwoke niya, “Ooyo. Ok wanadhi e dala maduongʼ mar jodak, ma joge ok jo-Israel. Wabiro dhi nyaka wachop Gibea.”
english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ chandruokne duto enone ler mar ngima kendo noyud mor e chunye; kuom riekone, jatichna makare nongʼad bura makare ne ji mangʼeny kendo notingʼ richogi.
english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

kikuyu: Rituru mondo okel pi matin, mondo uluokgo tiendu eka uywe e tiend yien-ni.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato othalo lembi konchiel, to lokne komachielo bende. Ka ngʼato okawo kotini, kik itame kawo lawi mar akor.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Joshua nosomo weche mag chik ma gin, gweth gi kwongʼ mana kaka ondikgi e Kitap Chik mar Musa.
english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo ohinga mar hekalu; ne olach moromo fut ochiko, kendo udi mag jorito manie bath hekalu koni gi koni ne romo fut auchiel moro ka moro.
english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

kikuyu: Eka Petro norwako jootego kaka wende. Kinyne Petro nowuok gi jootego, kendo jowete moko moa Jopa bende nodhi kodgi.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

kikuyu: Eka kinde mar Sawo mar Puodho hekalu nochopo Jerusalem. Ne en ndalo chwiri
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To ka nitie joot matin ma nyarombo achiel ohingo, to nyaka giriwre e nyarombo achiel gi joot machiegni kodgi, bangʼ ka gisekawo kwan joma ni kanyo. Nyaka ongʼe kar nyirombe madwarore kaluwore gi gima ngʼato ka ngʼato biro chamo.
english: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

kikuyu: Kanyo negimiyo Yesu divai ma oru gi kedhno mondo omadhi, to bangʼ bile, nodagi madhe.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nobiro koa Baal-Shalisha, mokelo ne ngʼat Nyasaye makati piero ariyo mag shairi mane otedi gi cham mokwongo oka, kaachiel gi kothe mokwongo. Elisha nowacho niya, “Migi ji mondo ochamgi.”
english: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

kikuyu: Rituru yorena kod chikena, nimar ngʼat moluwogi nobed mangima kuomgi. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Chiengʼno, ywak noywagre koa e rangach miluongo ni Dhoranga Rech, nduru noa e bath dala koma nyien, kendo koko nogore matek koa e gode.
english: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

kikuyu: Koro nenore malongʼo ni ngʼato doko ngʼat makare kuom gima otimo, to ok kuom yie kende.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

kikuyu: Kik ibed ngʼat mariek ahinya kata ngʼat mongʼeyo ahinya, nimar inyalo tiekori kendi iwuon.
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

kikuyu: Jehoram notho moyweyo gi kwerene e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, kendo wuode ma Ahazia nobedo ruoth bangʼe.
english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kendo geno marwa kuomu ogurore motegno; nikech wangʼeyo ni kaka uyudo sand kodwa e kaka uyudo hoch kodwa.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

kikuyu: Mokwongo jopuonjrene ne ok owinjo tiend gigi duto, to achien, bangʼ ka Yesu nosemi duongʼ eka negifwenyo ni wechegi nosendiki kuome chon, kendo ni gigo notimore nikech en.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodwoko niya, “Dhako, in gi yie maduongʼ ndi! Kwayoni osechopi.” Kendo nyare nochango kochakore sano.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo wabedo gi geno mangima mar yudo mwandu mosiko ma okanonu e polo malo kuma ok onyal kethore kata lalie.
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

kikuyu: Shem nonywolo Elam, Ashur, Arfaksad, Lud kod Aram. Aram nonywolo Uz, Hul, Gether kod Meshek.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Lawi mamoko e magi: Koa kuom yawuot Amram noyier Shubael; koa kuom yawuot Shubael noyier Jedeya.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Josef nofwenyo owetene, gin to ne ok gifwenye.
english: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: Sayun tingʼo bedene malo kaywak, to onge ngʼama nyalo hoye. Jehova Nyasaye oseketo chik ni Jakobo, ni jogo modak bute, mondo obed wasike; Jerusalem osebedo gima ochido e diergi.
english: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. The LORD has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

kikuyu: Jomoko nobiro monyiso Jehoshafat niya, “Oganda lweny maduongʼ moa Edom bironi koa e loka Nam kocha. Gisechopo Hazazon Tamar” (tiende ni, En Gedi).
english: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

kikuyu: Pok mokwongo nodhine jo-Kohath kaluwore gi anywola margi. Jo-Lawi mane nyikwa Harun jadolo nopog mier matindo apar gadek koa e dhout Juda, Simeon kod Benjamin.
english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Adwokone Nyasacha erokamano seche duto ma aparoue.
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

kikuyu: Lamek notho kane ja-higni mia abiriyo gi piero abiriyo gabiriyo.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

kikuyu: mi noluwo bangʼ ngʼat Nyasayeno. Noyude kobet e tiend yiend ober mopenje niya, “In e ngʼat Nyasaye mane oa Juda?” Nodwoke niya, “Ee en an.”
english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona niya, “Dhiyo mondo itelne ji e yo mondo ukaw piny mane asesingora ni kweregi ni anamigi.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

kikuyu: Joriemb geche gi Farese bende nodhi kode. Ne en gi oganda maduongʼ.
english: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.

kikuyu: Nimar nitiere sa mowinjore kod chenro miluwo e gimoro amora, kata kamano dhier mar dhano pek moloye.
english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

kikuyu: Naketo wangʼa ka aneno kaka imno ringo kochomo yo podho chiengʼ, gi yo nyandwat kod yo milambo. Onge le moro amora mane nyalo sire, kata mane nyalo resore kuom tekone. Notimo kaka en ema ohero, kendo nodoko rahuma.
english: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

kikuyu: Yaye, ubiro chayo duongʼ ka ukuodo wiya nyaka karangʼo? Ubiro hero gik manono kendo luwo nyiseche manono nyaka karangʼo? Sela
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

kikuyu: Ere tiend ubani mangʼwe ngʼar moa kuom Sheba kata niangʼ ma milimili moa e piny mabor? Chiwo magu mag misengini miwangʼo pep ok ayiego; misango magu ok mora.”
english: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”

kikuyu: Kane wawinjo wachno, to kihondko nomakowa kendo chir duto mane ngʼato angʼata nigo norumo nikech un, kendo nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasaye manie polo malo kendo e piny mwalo.
english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

kikuyu: Ka ichoko ji kanyakla, to ywak turumbetego nyaka pogre.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre apar mamoko nowinjo wachno, ne gisin gi Jakobo gi Johana.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenje niya, “Ia kanye?” Nodwoke niya, “Atony kawuok e kambi mar jo-Israel.”
english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”

kikuyu: kendo ichok oganda duto e dho Hemb Romo.”
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

kikuyu: Nopenje penjo mangʼeny, to Yesu ok nodwoko.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “En ngʼama abiro miyo makatini bangʼ ka aselute e kado.” Eka, bangʼ luto makati e kado, nomiye Judas Iskariot wuod Simon.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

kikuyu: Kamano bende onego ijiw yawuowi matindo mondo oritre.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ok adwar ni ubed kukia, ni asedwaro kuom ndalo mathoth mondo abi iru, to timo kamano osetama nyaka kawuononi, mondo an bende ati tich maber e dieru mana kaka asetimo e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Abiro ywak kendo dengo ne gode bende anaywag lege motwo, mosedongʼ nono, kendo onge gima wuothoe, bende ywak mar jamni ok winjie. Winy mafuyo e kor polo oseringo, kendo le osedhi.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ka dine bed ni Nyasaye en Wuoru, dine uhera, nimar ne aa ir Nyasaye kendo koro an ka, ok asebiro kenda awuon, to en ema noora.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

kikuyu: nyikwa Nebo moko, ji piero abich gariyo (52),
english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

kikuyu: Nabedo ngʼat ma ji duto nyiero, ne gijara gi wer pile ka pile.
english: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

kikuyu: Eka nolokore ir jopuonjrene kendo nowachonegi kar kendgi niya, “Ogwedh wenge maneno gik munenogi.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

kikuyu: To kane achiel kuomgi ne tongʼo yien, leye nolwar e pi. Noywak niya, “Yaye ruodha, korka ne en le mokwa!”
english: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

kikuyu: Kendo Musa gi Harun kod yawuote notiyo kode kaluoko lwetegi gi tiendegi.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ngʼat modhier ok onego bedi e dieru, nikech piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kod jou mondo ukaw kaka girkeni obiro gwedho,
english: However there will be no poor with you (for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

kikuyu: Oseoranwa wachni Babulon: Enobed kinde marabora. Emomiyo geruru udi kendo udagie eigi; pidhuru puothe kendo ucham gigo ma ginyago.’ ”
english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”

kikuyu: Asepedho kitandana gi suke mokikokiko moa Misri.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

kikuyu: Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny duto ma pod ne nitiere e piny ma tambarare nodhi Mizpa ir Gedalia
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

kikuyu: To kuom Jehova Nyasaye, nyikwa Israel duto noyudi ka joma nikare kendo man-gi duongʼ.
english: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!

kikuyu: Kendo mano nomiyo gimiyo Nyasaye duongʼ nikech an.
english: So they glorified God in me.

kikuyu: Ringra gi chunya duto, biro hulo kawacho niya, “En ngʼa machalo kodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.” Ireso joma odhier e lwet joma nigi teko moloyogi, Adier, ikonyo joma odhier gi jochan kuom joma mayogi.
english: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

kikuyu: Obiro lokore buru mayom e piny Misri duto kendo buche malokore adhola biro gore kuom ji kaachiel gi jamni e piny duto.”
english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ikwongʼ ngʼama ite odino, kata kik iket gimoro e nyim muofu monyalo chwanyoree, luoruru Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Ngʼato angʼata modak e dala maduongʼni noneg gi ligangla, kech kata masira, to ngʼato angʼata manodhi ir jo-Babulon nobed mangima. Notony gi ngimane; mi nobed mangima.’
english: “The LORD says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

kikuyu: Mula mane ogolo e sirni ariyo, gi Karaya Maduongʼ kod rwedhi apar gariyo mag mula e bwoye kod rachungi minyalo tingʼ mane Ruoth Solomon olosone hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ne pek ma ok nyal pim.
english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for the LORD’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ok adwari, yaye got maduongʼ maketho, un joma ketho piny ngima. Anarie bada kuomu, anadhiru piny kua e geng got, kendo ami ubed ka got mowangʼ.”
english: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says the LORD, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

kikuyu: to yieruru mier moko mondo obed miechu mag tony, ma ngʼat monego ngʼato kobothne nyalo ringo dhiye.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Mad oorni kony moa kare maler mar lemo kendo omiyi kony moa Sayun.
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

kikuyu: “Wachnegi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: ‘Bende obiro dongo maber adier? Donge ibiro pudhe mi lwer olembene mi otwo? Kata otem loth kendo to obiro mana ner. Ok obi dwaro ngʼat maratego kata ji mangʼeny mondo opudhe oko gi tiendene.
english: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼich mar pe e kinde mar keyo, e kaka jaote ma ja-adiera chalo ne ngʼat moore, omoro chuny ruodhe.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

kikuyu: Wan duto ma wan gi yie motegno onego wapar kuom gigi. To ka pachu opogore gi mano e yo moro, to Nyasaye biro leronu.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

kikuyu: To ka kidono ok lokre kendo ok landre, to jadolo nowach ni oler nikech en mana mbala moa e bur.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: Eka Balaam nohulo ote moa kuom Nyasaye kama: “Balak ruodh Moab manie piny gode man yo wuok chiengʼ nooma Aram. Nowacho ni, ‘Bi mondo ikwongʼna Jakobo; bi mondo ikwedna jo-Israel.’
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

kikuyu: Jeremia mar apar, to Makbanai mar apar gachiel.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

kikuyu: To Yesu nolingʼ alingʼa thi ma ok odwoke. Jadolo maduongʼ nochako openje niya, “In e Kristo ma Wuod Nyasaye Mangima koso?”
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

kikuyu: Bath aorano mar adek iluongo ni Tigris; en omol koluwo yo wuok chiengʼ mar Ashur. To bath aorano mar angʼwen iluongo ni Yufrate.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

kikuyu: Bed motegno kendo gi chir mogundho. Bed motangʼ mondo iluor chike duto mane jatichna Musa omiyi; kik ilokri korachwich kata koracham kiweyo chikegi, mano nomi ibed gi hawi kamoro amora midhiye.
english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nowachone Nathan niya, “Asekethone Jehova Nyasaye.” Nathan nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye oseweyoni richoni. Ok ibi tho.
english: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan said to David, “The LORD also has put away your sin. You will not die.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ok anamadh olemb mzabibu kendo nyaka chop odiechiengʼno ma anamadhee kendo manyien e pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo, wuodi dhi bedo mangima.” Ngʼatno norwako wach mane Yesu owachoneno, mi noa odhi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kikuyu: To koro osetimonu winjruok e kindu kode kuom tho Kristo e ringruok, mondo oteru e nyime kuler ka uonge gi songa kuomu kata ketho.
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Pak obed ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mosetimo gi lwete gima ne osingo gi dhoge owuon ni Daudi wuonwa.
english: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

kikuyu: bende ni mondo aland ni ma e higa mar ngʼwono mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

kikuyu: Kitimo maber donge diyieni? To ka itimo marach to richo okichore e dhoodi, kendo ogomboni mondo okawi, to in nyaka iloye.”
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osegolo chik, kendo obiro muko udi madongo malokre pidhe, to udi matindo obiro toyo matindo tindo.
english: “For, behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.

kikuyu: E ndalo mane jongʼad bura ni e loch, kech ne nitie e piny, kendo ngʼat moro moa Bethlehem e piny Juda, kaachiel gi chiege kod yawuote ariyo, nodhi mondo odag e piny Moab kuom kinde moko.
english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Neuru, aneno polo koyawore kendo ka Wuod Dhano ochungʼ e bad Nyasaye korachwich.”
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

kikuyu: Gima aneno miyo chunya kuyo nikech gik matimore ne mon duto mar dalawa maduongʼ.
english: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

kikuyu: kendo mondo udagi amingʼa e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osingo ne kwereu ni nomigi kod nyikwagi ma en piny maber mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.
english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ne ok oneno wangʼ chiengʼ kamano, kata ngʼeyo gimoro amora, to en gi kwe moloyo ngʼat
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

kikuyu: Nimar joga osehiny, an bende ahinyora; aywak kendo luoro omaka.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Ne oyiero ji apar gariyo, mane oketo tenge kaka joote, mondo gibed kode eka mondo oorgi gidhi giyal Injili
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

kikuyu: Eka Abram nochako wuoth kendo odhi nyime giwuoth kochomo Negev.
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni aonge richo kata achiel, to dhoga pod biro mana ndhoga. Kata dabed ni aonge rach moro amora, to dhoga pod biro miyo inena kaka jaketho.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

kikuyu: Kuom mwandu duto ma aseiko ne gero hekalu mar Nyasacha ma gin dhahabu kuom tije madwaro dhahabu, gi fedha kuom tije mag fedha, gi mula kuom tije mag mula, gi nyinyo kuom tije mag nyinyo, kaachiel gi yiende kuom tije mag yiende kod oniks milosogo ot, gi kite ma kitgi opogore opogore gi kite duto mabeyo kod kite mag ombo. Magi duto aseiko mangʼeny.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

kikuyu: Kane Maria ochopo kama Yesu ne nitie monene gi wangʼe, nopodho e tiende mowachone niya, “Ruoth, ka dinyocha bed ni in ka to owadwa dine ok otho.”
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

kikuyu: To kilamo to donji e odi maiye, ilor dhoot eka ilam Wuonu ma ok ne. Eka Wuonu maneno gima otim lingʼ-lingʼ nomiyi pokni.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: Kar sa apar gachiel bende nowuok oko, kendo nochako oyudo mana ka jomoko pod ochungʼ achungʼa kanyo. Nopenjogi ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo usebedo ka uchungʼ achungʼa ka odiechiengʼ duto maonge gima utim?’ ”
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

kikuyu: Mokwongo awinjo ni ka uchokoru kaachiel kaka kanisa, to nitie pogruok e kindu, kendo anyalo yie ni wachno en adier.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

kikuyu: to jolupne nokawe mokete e okapu, eka gilore piny kokalo e otuchi moro manie kor ohinga mar dala.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

kikuyu: Nikech ka ngʼato wacho niya, “An ngʼat Paulo,” to ngʼat machielo to oramo niya, “An ngʼat Apolo,” to donge koro un ji ajia?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

kikuyu: Abiro keto chuny jo-Misri doko matek mondo gilaw bangʼ-gi nyaka ei nam. Kendo abiro yudo duongʼ kuom Farao kaachiel gi jolweny gi geche lwenje kod joidh faresene.
english: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

kikuyu: To eka nowacho kendo niya, “Eri an ka, asebiro mondo atim dwaroni.” Omiyo waneno kaka oketho yo machon mar chiwo chiayo ka misango to okelo yo manyien ma ngʼato chiwoe ngimane owuon.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

kikuyu: Norito Samuel kuom ndalo abiriyo kaka Samuel nosechiko, to Samuel ne ok obiro Gilgal kendo joma ne nigi Saulo nochako ke.
english: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

kikuyu: joka Benjamin, ma gin jo-dhoodgi Saulo ne gin ji alufu adek (3,000) ma thothgi nosebedo koyie gi od Saulo nyaka kindeno;
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne mirima omako gi Musa mowachone niya, “Donge owadu Harun ma ja-Lawi nitie? Angʼeyo ni onyalo wuoyo maber. Osechako wuoth obiro romoni bende chunye biro bedo mamor ka oneni.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

kikuyu: mondo onyis kech ne kwerewa, kendo opar singruokne maler,
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Miwero gi gig wer man-gi tondegi. Zaburi mar Daudi. Ka aluongi to yie idwoka, yaye Nyasacha makare. Konya e lit momako chunya; yie ikecha kendo iwinj lamona.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

kikuyu: mano emomiyo abiro choko joherani duto mosemiyi mor, moriwo ji duto mane ihero nyaka mane ichayo. Abiro chokogi kendo abiro ketogi mondo gilwori koni gi koni, bangʼe to alonyi duk e nyimgi duto, kendo ginine dugi.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

kikuyu: Kane gichiegni chopo Jerusalem, ka gin e miech Bethfage kod Bethania manie Got Zeituni, Yesu nooro jopuonjrene ariyo
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: Jodong ruoth nodwoke niya, “Jotiji to oikore mar timo gimoro amora ma ruodhwa ma en ruoth oyiero.”
english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

kikuyu: wuod Shama ja-Harar, gi Ahiam wuod Sharar ma ja-Harar,
english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

kikuyu: Joma lawo nyiseche mamoko kuyo margi biro medore. Misengini magi mag remo ok abi olo oko kendo kata nying-gi ok abi hulo gi dhoga.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

kikuyu: E tok ohinga mar rangach midonjogo, man but raidhi rangach midonjogo man yo nyandwat ne nitie mesni ariyo, kendo e bath raidhi koni gi koni bende ne nitie mesni ariyo.
english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

kikuyu: Ne en-gi yawuowi piero adek kod nyiri piero adek. Nochiwo nyige monywom gi joma oko ma ok anywolane, to ne yawuote nokelonegi mon matindo obedo mondegi koa oko mar anywolane. Ibzan notelo ne Israel kuom higni abiriyo.
english: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.

kikuyu: Aora Jordan koro notimo ataro kuonde duto nyaka ndalo mag keyo. Omiyo ka jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nochopo e aora Jordan mi tiendegi omulo geng aora,
english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

kikuyu: “Ruoth machielo manokaw kare noor jasol osuru ir ji mondo pinye obed gi mwandu marahuma. To kata kamano, notieke, bangʼ higni manok, to ok gi mirima kata e lweny.
english: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.

kikuyu: Wuonwa noketo kuomu tingʼ mapek; an to abiro medo pekne moloyo. Wuonwa nochwadou gi boka, an to abiro chwadou malit makecho ka thomoni.’ ”
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

kikuyu: Bangʼe malaika mar auchiel noolo tape e aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate, mi pige noduono mondo yo olosre ni ruodhi mane biro koa yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

kikuyu: Gima igeno mobudho miyo chuny bedo matuo, to gima igeno motimore en yath mar ngima.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

kikuyu: Kendo nokano gik moko mangʼeny e miech Juda. Noketo e Jerusalem jolweny man kod lony mangʼeny e lweny.
english: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi mwandu mathoth to onge winjo, chalo gi le ma otho.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jodolo to nyaka rit chikena mondo kik gibed joketho mi githo kuom richono. An e Jehova Nyasaye mapwodhogi.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

kikuyu: ma gin chike mane Musa omiyowa, mondo obed mwandu mag joka Jakobo.
english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

kikuyu: Eka nosiemo jopuonjrene ni kik ginyis ngʼato angʼata ni ne en Kristo.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

kikuyu: to koro geno mara ni kune? En ngʼa manyalo neno geno moro amora ma an-go?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

kikuyu: Eka jodongo kaachiel gi ji duto mane ni e rangach nowacho niya, “Wan joneno. Mad Jehova Nyasaye mi dhako mabiro e dalani ochal gi Rael gi Lea, ma nochungo dhood Israel, kargi ji ariyo. Mad ibed ngʼat maduongʼ ei Efratha kendo ibed ngʼat marahuma ei Bethlehem.
english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

kikuyu: nogure mi osiki nyaka chiengʼ kaka dwe, ma en ranyisi madier e kor polo.” Sela
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni jodolo mag kuonde lemo motingʼore gi malo ne ok ti e kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem, to ne oyienegi mana chamo makati ma ok oketie thowi gi jodolo wetegi mamoko.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to the LORD’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

kikuyu: Noketo kerubigo ei ot matin mar hekalu maiye ka bwombegi oyarore. Bwomb kerubi achiel nomulo kor ot konchiel, ka bwombe machielo nemulo kor ot komachielo, kendo bwombegi nemulore e chuny ot.
english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

kikuyu: Nyasaye oseketo piny e lwet joma timbegi richo, bende omiyo jongʼad bura duto bedo muofni. To ka ok en ema notimo kamano, to ngʼatno mane otimo mano?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

kikuyu: Negikelone pesa mamingli, bangʼe nopenjogi niya, “Kido man kuomeni en mag ngʼa? To weche mondikiegi to gin mar ngʼa?” Negidwoke niya, “Gin mag Kaisar.”
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Kane ikudho muchi kende, to nam noimogi. Ne ginimo ka chuma e apaka maduongʼ.
english: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

kikuyu: Kik ibed gi tim ngʼwono, to chul ngʼato ngima kar ngima, wangʼ kar wangʼ, lak kar lak, lwedo kar lwedo, kendo tielo kar tielo.
english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

kikuyu: Daudi nodhi Mahanaim, to Abisalom nongʼado aora Jordan kod jo-Israel duto.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengno joote nodhi koa ira e yiedhi mondo obwog jo-Kush modak kodhialore. Achiedh-nade nomakgi chiengʼ mikethoe Misri, nikech gino biro timore adier.
english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”

kikuyu: mondo ores joma Chik otweyo, eka mondo wadok nyithind Nyasaye machamo mwandune.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kikuyu: Mano notimore mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho Janabi Isaya niya, “Nokawo nyawo marwa kendo notingʼo tuochewa.”
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

kikuyu: To kapok chiege nonywolo nyithindo marudego, kendo kapok negitimo gimoro maber kata marach, mondo chenro mar Nyasaye ochop kare
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

kikuyu: To jochan to noreso e thagruokgi, kendo nomiyo joutegi onya ka rombe.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

kikuyu: E lweny machielo gi jo-Filistia, Elhanan wuod Jair nonego Lami ma owadgi Goliath ja-Giti mane ni kod tongʼ ma bonde romo gi lodi.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma muofu makmana jotichna, kendo ma ite odino ka jaote maoro? Koso en ngʼa ma muofu maloyo ngʼat mochiworena, kata ma muofu maloyo jatich Jehova Nyasaye?
english: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as the LORD’s servant?

kikuyu: To ka uholo mana joma un gi adier ni biro dwokonu, en ohala manade ma uyudo? Kata mana joricho holo mana joricho ka gigeno ni ibiro chulogi duto.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

kikuyu: Ka ubiro ir Jalno ma en Kidi mangima mane jogedo odagi, to en ema Nyasaye noyiere kendo omiye duongʼ.
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

kikuyu: Ji angʼwen-gi mane nyikwa Rafa ma ja-Gath, nonegi gi Daudi kod joge.
english: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Omiyo negiluongo ruodhi duto mag jo-Filistia ma gipenjogi niya, “Watim angʼo gi Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel?” Mine gidwoko niya, “Kawuru Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel uter Gath.” Kamano negigolo Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

kikuyu: Gima negiwachono nonenore maber ne Hamor kod wuode Shekem.
english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

kikuyu: Rieko ber moloyo gige lweny, to jaricho achiel ketho gik mabeyo mangʼeny.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

kikuyu: Kik ukendru kodgi. Kik uchiw nyiu ni yawuotgi kata kik yawuotu okend nyigi,
english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

kikuyu: “Bende nitiere ngʼama nyalo ngʼadone Nyasaye rieko, ka en owuon ema ongʼado bura nyaka ne joma ni malo mogik?
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

kikuyu: Gima lit maseneno katimore e piny en ni mwandu mopandi inyo mana wuon,
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

kikuyu: Samuel nolero ne ji chike mag bedo ruoth. Nondikogi e kitabu mokano e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Eka Samuel ne ogonyo ji mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato odog e dalane.
english: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the LORD. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

kikuyu: Hodia, Bani kod Beninu.
english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

kikuyu: Nobiro e abila mar rombe man but yo; to kanyo ne nitie rogo, to Saulo nodonjo e rogono mondo olosre. Daudi gi joge bende ne osedonjo ei rogono.
english: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

kikuyu: To nodhi mana nyaka e dhoranga ruoth nikech ne ok oyiene ngʼat morwako pien gugru mondo odonji.
english: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

kikuyu: Mano nochopo ndiko ma nondiki chon niya, “Nokwane e oganda joma richo.”]
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

kikuyu: “Koponi nitie japiny moro modak e dieru modwaro timo ne Jehova Nyasaye Pasaka, to en kaachiel gi joge machwo nyaka tergi nyangu, eka onyalo riwore kodu e timo sawoni bangʼe nokwane kaka achiel kuom jo-Israel. Onge ngʼato angʼata madichwo ma ok oter nyangu ma oyiene chamo sawo mar Pasakani.
english: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

kikuyu: Donge puodhono ne en mari kane pok iloke pesa? Kata kane iseloke pesa, donge ne inyalo konyori gi pesago kaka ihero? En angʼo manomiyo iparo mondo itim gima kamano? Nyasaye ema isewuondo, to ok dhano!”
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro riembo ogendinigo kuomu matin tin mana ka uneno. Ok noyienu mondo utiekgi dichiel nimar dipo ka ondiegi onywolore mangʼeny mathagu.
english: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

kikuyu: Koro kech ne pod ger ahinya e piny.
english: The famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Eka Paulo nowachone niya, “Nyasaye biro goyi, in kor ot mobuk matarni! Owinjore ingʼadna bura kaluwore gi Chik, to in iwuon ema iketho chik ka iwacho ni jogi mondo ogoya!”
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

kikuyu: To ka gitamore winje, to ligangla biro tiekogi, kendo gibiro tho ka gionge rieko.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

kikuyu: kata mwandu molal nikech chandruok moro, maonge gima ginyalo weyo ni nyithindgi ndalo mabiro.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama oketo genone kuomi manyalo neno wichkuot, to joma timo timbe maricho ema biro neno wichkuot.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼama dwaro reso ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼatno mowito ngimane nikech an kendo nikech Injili nores ngimane.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

kikuyu: To kik ubed moil ni jochiende winjou, to beduru moil ni nyingu ondiki e polo.”
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

kikuyu: nikech nochiwo ngimane mi poth otho nikech tich Kristo, koketo ngimane e chandruok mondo okonya gi kony ma un uwegi ne ok unyal konyago.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

kikuyu: Andikonu un nyithinda mageno nikech osewenu richou, kuom nying Yesu.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: Ma e chiwo mapile mowangʼ mopwodhi e Got Sinai kaka gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye, en misango miwangʼo pep mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: E sa mane igwedho ohinga mar Jerusalem, jo-Lawi nowal oa kama negidakie mine okelgi Jerusalem mondo gitim nyasi gi mor mogundho gi wende mag erokamano kendo ka gigoyo ongengʼo, nyatiti kod orutu.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

kikuyu: Nyithindu nobed jokwath e pinyni kuom higni piero angʼwen, ka giyudo thagruok nikech bedou maonge gi ratiro, nyaka ane ni ringre ngʼama ogik odongʼ e thim.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

kikuyu: To ne ok waweyonegi thuolo kata matin, mondo eka adiera mar Injili kik lalnu.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa manyalo gerone hekalu, ka kata polo malo kata polo mabor moloyo ok nyal romi? An to an ngʼa mondo agerne hekalu makmana gero kama iwangʼoe misengini e nyime?
english: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

kikuyu: Jodongo piero abiriyo mag dhood Israel nochungʼ e nyimgi, kendo Jazania wuod Shafan nochungʼ kodgi kanyo. Moro ka moro kuomgi notingʼo san miwangʼe ubani e lwete, kendo ubani ne dhwolo iro madungʼ tik kochomo malo.
english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ikuru pachu ne tich. Beduru mos kendo keturu genou duto kuom ngʼwono mibiro miu ka Yesu Kristo ofwenyore.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Azaria notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike machiegni kodgi e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, kendo Jotham wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Donge jodolo ma gin Zadok gi Abiathar jodhi bedo kodi kuno? Wachnegi gimoro amora miwinjo e dala ruoth.
english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

kikuyu: makmana kama enoyier ne nyinge owuon. Kanyo ema nyaka utime misango mar Pasaka godhiambo, ka chiengʼ dhi podho kuparogo odiechiengʼ mane uwuokie Misri.
english: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: mi Daudi nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach ni, “Bende dalaw joma osepeyowagi. Bende dajukgi?” Nodwoke niya, “Lawgi. Chutho inijukgi mi inires jogi duto.”
english: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

kikuyu: Wuowi ma chogo nowacho ni wuon mare ni, ‘Wuora, pogna mwanduna makora.’ Omiyo mano nopogo yawuote ariyogo mwandune.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

kikuyu: Petro noparo mowachoni Yesu niya, “Rabi! Ne yadh ngʼowu manyo ikwongʼo osetwo!”
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

kikuyu: Onyalo weyogi mi gipar ni gin gi kwe, to wangʼe osiko rangogi kinde duto.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

kikuyu: Tofeth noseiki nyaka aa chon; noseik ne ruoth. Kare mar kendo osekuny matut kendo malach, kodhurie yiende mangʼeny gi mach maduongʼ; kendo much Jehova Nyasaye, machalo mach makakni ema moke.
english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. The LORD’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

kikuyu: Odunga mar ngʼat mayiero biro loth, kendo abiro tieko chuth ngʼur ma jo-Israel ngʼurnigo maonge giko.”
english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Nebukadneza nochungʼ malo ka dhoge omoko kendo nopenjo jongʼad rieko mage niya, “Donge ji adek ema ne watweyo mi wadiro e mach?” Negidwoke niya, “En kamano, yaye ruodh.”
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste. He spoke and said to his counselors, “Didn’t we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire?” They answered the king, “True, O king.”

kikuyu: Orito nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho kendo ohero jodak komiyogi chiemo kod lewni.
english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

kikuyu: To kanuru mwandu magu e polo kama olwenda kata nyal ok kethie gik moko kendo jokuo ok turie ma kwelie,
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

kikuyu: ka anyiso hera ne ji gana gi gana kendo aweyo ni ji timbegi maricho, wich teko kod richo. To kata kamano, ok akwan joricho kaka joma kare; to akumo nyithindo gi nyikwayo nyaka tiengʼ mar adek kod mar angʼwen nikech richo kweregi.
english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

kikuyu: Ma e kaka wangʼeyo ni wahero nyithind Nyasaye: Ka wahero Nyasaye kendo wamako chikene.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Kane oyanye to ne ok oyenyo, kata kane isande to ne ok okwongʼo joma ne sande. Kar timo kamano to noketo genone kuom Jal ma jangʼad bura ma kare.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

kikuyu: Fedha gi dhahabu duto, kod gigo molos gi mula kod molos gi nyinyo owal ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyaka tergi kar keno mare.”
english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD. They shall come into the LORD’s treasury.”

kikuyu: Ok agomb rwath moro amora moa e kundeu kata diek moa e abilni magu,
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Jehova Nyasaye ne ok otieko jo-Juda nikech noparo Daudi jatichne. Nosesingore ne Daudi gi ogandane ni ginibed e loch nyaka chiengʼ.
english: However, the LORD would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

kikuyu: kod pasia mag laru, gi sirnine kod rachungigi, kod pasia moumo kar donjo mar laru; loye mag laru gi tonde motwegigo, gi gik moko duto mar kar lemo ma en Hemb Romo;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: “To e dhoranga laruno, ketie pasia mar law mayom momin ma borne romo mita ochiko kendo man-gi rangi marambulu gi maralik kod makwar duto molos gi jachwecho molony koketgi ewi sirni angʼwen man-gi rachungi angʼwen.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka nyarombo gi chiwo mar cham kod mo ibiro chiwo okinyi kokinyi seche duto michiwoe misango miwangʼo pep.
english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

kikuyu: Kane gisegure, to ne gipogore lepe ka gigoyo ombulu.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

kikuyu: Ne okwongʼore kane osingore ne Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ne okwongʼore ne Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo kama:
english: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

kikuyu: Eka ruoth moro maratego nobi, manobed jatelo man-gi teko maduongʼ kendo notim gimoro amora mohero.
english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka asechopo wuodhani, kendo ka aseneno ni giyudo olemoni, to abiro dhi Spania, kendo anaraw alimu kakadho.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

kikuyu: Gibiro pongʼo uteni gi ut jodongi kod mag jo-Misri duto; enobed gimoro ma wuoneu kata kwereu pok noneno chakre odiechiengʼ mane gichako dak e pinyni nyaka sani.’ ” Eka Musa nolokore mowuok e nyim Farao.
english: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Omiyo gol wangʼi kuome kendo weye mos, mondo ochamie luche gi mor kaka ngʼama ondiki timo.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro wangʼeyo kendo wageno kuom hera ma Nyasaye oherowago. Nyasaye en hera. Ngʼato mosiko e hera osiko kuom Nyasaye, kendo Nyasaye bende odak kuome.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

kikuyu: Oseiko ringe kendo oloso divai mare moru mamit, bende osepedho mesa mare.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: Eka joma odongʼ ne biro luwo bangʼ-gi ka jomoko omako mberni, to moko omako bepe mane owuok e yie mane osebarore. Kamano e kaka ne wachopo e lowo motwo waduto ka wangima.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi wach Ruoth owuon, wanyisou ni wan ma Ruoth noyudwa ka pod wangima chiengʼ ma nobie, ok wanakwong dhi kapok okaw joma osetho.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Kamano janabino nokawo ringre ngʼat Nyasayeno mokete e ngʼe punda kendo nodwoge e dalane mondo oywage kendo oike.
english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

kikuyu: Tunge apar gin ruodhi apar mabiro wuok e pinyruodhni. To bangʼ e ruoth moro biro wuok, mopogore gi mago motelo, kendo enolo adekgo.
english: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different from the former, and he will put down three kings.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chwog wend ywak ni Farao ruodh Misri, kendo wachne ni: “ ‘Ichalo ka sibuor e kind ogendini, ichalo gi thuol malich mantie e chuny nembe madongo, ka imuomo aoreni ka ithacho pi gi tiendeni, kendo ka iduwo pige mag aore magi.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.’”

kikuyu: Nosande kichwade malit to ne ok otingʼo dhoge; notere kar thone mana ka rombo mitero kar yengʼo, kendo nolingʼ ka rombo manie lwet joma ngʼado yiere, omiyo en bende ne ok otingʼo dhoge.
english: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nodok malit ne mon ma yach kod mago madhodho nyithindo e ndalogo!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

kikuyu: Bende gengʼ jatichni kuom richo mag wich teko; mad kik gibed gi loch kuoma. Eka anabed maonge ketho, anabed ka aonge gi ketho chik moro maduongʼ.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

kikuyu: “Koro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasacha, iseketo jatichni ruoth kar wuonwa Daudi. To an mana rawera kendo ok angʼeyo kaka onego atim tichna.
english: Now, LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

kikuyu: “E sa nogo ji adek mane oor ira koa Kaisaria nobiro mochopo e ot mane antie.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

kikuyu: To ka achiel kuom wede joma othogo obiro mondo okaw wadgi mondo owangʼ, to nopenj ngʼat motonyno niya, “Bende ngʼato ni kodi kanyo?” Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “ooyo,” kendo nowachne niya, “Lingʼ thi nikech ok onego waluong nying Jehova Nyasaye ka.”
english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention the LORD’s name.’

kikuyu: Weche mamoko duto mag ndalo loch Jotham, kaachiel gi lwenje mane okedo kod gik moko duto mane otimo, ondiki e kitap ruodhi mag Israel kod Juda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi nyithindu kod mondu, to gi jopinje mamoko modak e kembeu kabaronu yien kendo umbonu pi.
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

kikuyu: Donge lek mabeyo oromou kwaye? Bende en gima kare mondo unyon lek mau mamoko gi tiendeu? Donge pi maler momiu mar modho oromou? Bende en gima kare mondo uchid pi mamoko gi tiendeu?
english: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi Jonathan nodhi oko e kargi mar romo gi Daudi. Ne en-gi wuowi matin,
english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

kikuyu: nyikwa Shefatia, Zebadia wuod Mikael, kaachiel kode ji piero aboro;
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bende ne ikawo yawuoti gi nyigi mane inywolona mi ichiwogi kaka misango ni nyisechegi. Timbegi mag chode ne ok oromi?
english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

kikuyu: Kane oyudo giwuotho e yo, ngʼat moro nowachone niya, “Abiro luwi kamoro amora midhiye.”
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

kikuyu: Nimar noyudo Yesu osechiko jachien marachno mondo owuog kuom ngʼatno. Kuom kinde mangʼeny nomake, to kata nosetwe lwetene, gi tiendene gi nyororo, kendo okete e bwo jarit, nosebedo kochodo nyororo kendo jochiende ne riembe nyaka e thim.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

kikuyu: Eka joma ni machiegni kodgi nowuok mondo onyos chuny jo-Juda kendo gibed maluor mar dhi nyime gi gedo.
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengʼ mar aboro chok oganda kanyakla kendo kik uti tije mapile.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Joab nowachone niya, “In ok niter wach kawuono. Inyalo mana tero wach chiengʼ machielo, nikech wuod ruoth otho.”
english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

kikuyu: Chungʼ malo; wachni ni e lweti. Wabiro konyi; omiyo jiwri kendo itime.”
english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

kikuyu: Kane gineno sulweno, negibedo moil.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

kikuyu: To ka wuora nigi chuny mar hinyi, to aweyo ma ok anyisi kendo konyi mondo itony idhi gi kwe, to mondo Jehova Nyasaye ochwada malit. Mad Jehova Nyasaye obed kodi mana kaka osebedo gi wuora.
english: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.

kikuyu: Nokawo dhahabu gi fedha duto kod gik moko duto mane oyudo e hekalu mar Nyasaye mane Obed-Edom orito kaachiel gi keno mar ruoth kod ji moko mano mako e lweny, bangʼe nodok e piny Samaria.
english: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, mirimba mager nool oko; mine olandore kobebni e dala mag Juda kod yore mag Jerusalem kendo moketogi gibed gundini mokethore kaka gin kawuono.
english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.’

kikuyu: Donge isewinjo, ruodha gima natimo kane Jezebel nego jonabi mag Jehova Nyasaye? Napando jonabi mia achiel mag Jehova Nyasaye e buche mag pondo ariyo, ka apogogi piero abich abich mi amiyogi chiemo gi pi.
english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

kikuyu: Kendo ka omuko lak misumba madichwo kata madhako, to nyaka owene misumbaneno thuolo kaka chudo mar lakeno.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

kikuyu: Ne imiyo gingʼeyo Sabato-ni maler mi imiyogi chike, kod buche kokalo kuom jatichni Musa.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

kikuyu: to yieruru kendo uket tenge mier madongo adek man e dier pinyno ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou mondo ukaw.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess.

kikuyu: “ ‘Minu ne chalo gi yiend mzabibu e puothi mar mzabibu mopidhi but pi; ne onyak maber kendo nopongʼ gi bedene nikech pi mane ngʼeny.
english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

kikuyu: Uzia nogero kuonde maboyo mag ngʼicho Jerusalem e Dhorangach miluongo ni Ranga Kama Ohinga Ogomogo gi Ranga Holo kod e giko ohinga kendo nogerogi motegno.
english: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

kikuyu: Jehu nochungʼ malo modhi kode ei ot. Bangʼ mano janabino noolo mo ewi Jehu kowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wacho: ‘Asewali mondo ibed ruodh Israel ma gin jo-Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

kikuyu: Ne orieny gi ler mar duongʼ Nyasaye, to lerne ne rieny ka kidi ma nengone tek, kaka jaspa maler ahinya.
english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

kikuyu: Ruoth Hezekia gi jodonge nochiko jo-Lawi mondo opak Jehova Nyasaye gi wende mag Daudi kod Asaf janen. Omiyo ne giwero wende pak ka gimor kendo ka gimiye duongʼ.
english: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

kikuyu: To ne ok adwar timo gimoro amora ka ok in ema iyie, mondo tim ngʼwono moro amora mitimo kik bed gima ochun, to obed gima itimo nikech ihero.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

kikuyu: Koro Jehoshafat nohondho yiedhi mag ohala mondo odhi Ofir oom dhahabu to kata kamano ne ok gikwangʼ nikech ne gikethore kama iluongo ni Ezion Geber.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, an bende kaka asenono tiend wechegi malongʼo nyaka aa chakruok, en gima ber bende mondo andikni e yo mochanore maler, in moluor Theofilo,
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

kikuyu: Ruoth nowuoyo kodgi, kendo ne ok oyudo ngʼama ne nyalo romo gi Daniel, Hanania, Mishael kod Azaria, omiyo yawuowi angʼwen-go nochako tiyo ne ruoth.
english: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.

kikuyu: Zadok bende ne ni kanyo to gi jo-Lawi duto mane ni kode notingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Nyasaye. Negiketo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Nyasaye piny, eka Abiathar nochiwo misengini nyaka ji duto notieko wuok e dala maduongʼ.
english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

kikuyu: “To negikwerogi ni, ‘Ooyo, sa moro mafuta ma wan-go ok nyal romowa kaachiel kodu. Gima ber en ni dhiuru ir joma uso mafuta mondo ungʼiew maru kuomgi.’
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

kikuyu: Negiloso bepeni duto gi yiende mabeyo moa Senir; ne gikaw bepe mag sida moa Lebanon mondo gilosnigo tanga mar yie?
english: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

kikuyu: To neuru koro opuonjo e lela, to onge ngʼama wachone gimoro. Koso dibed ni jodongwa oseyie ni en Kristo?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

kikuyu: kendo jatend budho nobilo pi mane koro oselokore divai. Ne ok ofwenyo kuma ne ogolee, kata obedo ni jotich mane otuomo pi to nongʼeyo. Eka noluongo wuon kisera tenge,
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

kikuyu: E kaka un duto un ringre Kristo, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu en fuon mar ringruogno.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

kikuyu: Enone malit ngʼat mawachone yien ni, ‘Bed mangima!’ Kata ni kite maonge ngima ni, ‘Chiew!’ Bende gik ma kamago dingʼadnu rieko? Kata obedo ni obawgi gi dhahabu gi fedha; to gionge gi ngima nikech gin gik motho.”
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar ariyo e higa mar ariyo Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa e Hemb Romo e Thim mar Sinai ka jo-Israel nosewuok Misri. Nowachone niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: nikech ungʼeyo ni tem mitemogo yieu miyo ubedo jokinda.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

kikuyu: Pilato nodwoke niya, “Iparo ni an bende an ja-Yahudi? Jou owuon gi jodolou madongo ema oketi e lweta. Nyisa, en angʼo misetimo?”
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

kikuyu: Ne atiekogi, mane ok ginyal chungʼ; negipodho e tienda.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

kikuyu: En angʼo mitimo, yaye ngʼama osetiekni? Angʼo momiyo irwakori gi law marakwaro kendo idusori gi gige dhahabu? Angʼo momiyo ibuko wangʼi gi rangi. Idusori kayiem nono. Johera magi jari; gidwaro mana ngimani.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moyie kuom Wuod Nyasaye nigi nenoni e chunye, to ngʼama ok oyie kuome miyo Nyasaye doko ja-miriambo, nikech odagi yie gima Nyasaye osewacho kaka janeno kuom Wuode.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Ben-Geber norito Ramoth Gilead (kod kuonde dak mag Jair wuod Manase man Gilead kaachiel gi piny mar Argob manie Bashan kod mieche madongo piero auchiel molwor gi ohinga motegno kendo nigi lodi mag rangeye mag mula);
english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

kikuyu: Divai margi en kwiri mar thuonde, kwiri mager mar thuond rachier.
english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, gigo duto mane akwano chon ka ohala tinde akwano ka gik manono nikech Kristo.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

kikuyu: To bende, ok dwapakre mokalo tongʼwa kuom tich ma jomoko nono ema timo. To genowa en ni, kaka yie maru medo gerore, e kaka tongʼwa mar lando Injili biro medo yarore,
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

kikuyu: Yesu noa e sinagogi kendo nodhi e dala Simon. Koro min chi Simon ne nigi tuo midhusi matek, kendo ne gikwayo Yesu mondo okonye.
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano kuchiwo kony ne joma ochando to kik uland gima utimo gi turumbete, kaka joma wuondore timo ei sinagoke kendo e yore manie kind mier, mondo ji omigi luor. Awachonu adier ni giseyudo pokgi duto.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: nikech en ngʼat ma pache nyadiriyo kendo ma timbene duto yomyom.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo ipenjo nyinga? En nying modhiero ngʼeyo.”
english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”

kikuyu: Neye kaka gibutona ka girita e yo! Joma kwiny chano kaka digihinya, to an onge gima rach kata richo masetimo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

kikuyu: Nowangʼo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kar dak ruoth kod udi duto man Jerusalem. Bende nowangʼo udi duto moger mabeyo.
english: He burned the LORD’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisedhi e puothe kendo gipono mzabibu mi gikelogi kuonde bicho, negitimo nyasi e hekalu mar nyasachgi. E sa mane gichiemo kendo metho, ne gikwongʼo Abimelek.
english: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

kikuyu: Jotend ogendini ne weyo wuoyo, kendo negilingʼ thi ka giumo dhogi.
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

kikuyu: Chame kaka gima ler moloyo; chwo duto nochame. Nyaka ikawe kaka gima ler.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: To magi duto ok miya mor kapod aneno ja-Yahudi ma Modekai kobet e dhoranga ruoth.”
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

kikuyu: “Kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel noyiera kuom anywolana mondo abed ruodh Israel manyaka chiengʼ. Noyiero Juda jatelo, to koa e dhood Juda noyiero anywolana, to kuom yawuot wuora duto, notimo ngʼwono mondo oketa ruodh Israel duto.
english: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim notho koluwo kwerene ka en gi higni mathoth ka en ngʼama oti kendo hike ngʼeny.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Musa kod jodong Israel duto ne ochiko oganda niya, “Rituru chikegi ma amiyou kawuono
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

kikuyu: Omiyo negiwalo tenge Kedesh man Galili e piny Naftali manie got, gi Shekem e piny Efraim manie got kod Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), e piny Juda ma bende ni e got.
