english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

kikuyu: Tedeuru gi mo e tawo, eka ukele koseruwore maber, kendo chiwe kongʼinjore matindo tindo, kendo otimgo misango mar cham madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka noloro ringre piny moboye gi nanga marep-rep eka nokete e bur mane osekunyo ariwa e kor lwanda, mano mane pok oyikie ngʼato
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

kikuyu: Ne gitemo saye mondo otimnegi ngʼwono owe Paulo odogi Jerusalem nikech negichano butone mondo ginege gie yo kodhi.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Abrona mi gibworo Ezion Geber.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: San ka san mar fedha pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kendo bakul ka bakul mar kwoyo pi pekne ne en shekel piero abiriyo. Dise duto mag fedha pekgi noromo shekel alufu ariyo gi mia angʼwen (2,400), kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

kikuyu: Adam nobedoe achiel gi chiege, kendo chiege nonywolo wuowi mi nochake ni Seth, mowacho niya, “Nyasaye osemiya nyathi machielo kar Abel mane Kain onego.”
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

kikuyu: Eka negitingʼo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye mi gitero ei hekalu mar Dagon kendo negikete bath Dagon.
english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Malaika mar angʼwen noolo tape e wangʼ chiengʼ, mi wangʼ chiengʼ nomi teko mar wangʼo ji ka mach mager.
english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, Nyasach jo-Israel, wacho: Lok yoreu kod timbeu, to anami udagi kaye.
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

kikuyu: To bende, ka Nyasaye kelo Wuode makayo e piny to owacho niya, “Malaike duto mag Nyasaye mondo olame.”
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

kikuyu: e kinde ma en kaachiel gi dhood Israel duto, nokelo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye gi mahu ka igoyo tungʼ.
english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Nikech lwet Nyasachwa mar ngʼwono ne ni kuomwa, ne gikelonwa Sherebia, ngʼatno man-gi nyalo, koa e nyikwa Mali wuod Lawi, wuod Israel, kod yawuot Sherebia gi owetene, ji apar gaboro;
english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

kikuyu: Omiyo Modekai nodhi motimo duto mane Esta ochiko mondo otim.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

kikuyu: Magi e chike kuom tuoche malandore mag del, kod tuoche mailo del,
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

kikuyu: Harif, Anathoth, Nebai,
english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,

kikuyu: to koro unyalo wacho angʼo kuom Jal ma Wuoro nowalo kaka Ngʼate owuon mi ooro e piny? Ka kamano, to angʼo momiyo udonjona gi ketho mar yanyo Nyasaye, nikech nende awacho ni, ‘An Wuod Nyasaye’?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

kikuyu: Adaya wuod Jeroham, wuod Pashur, wuod Malkija kod Maasai wuod Adiel, wuod Jazera, wuod Meshulam, wuod Meshilemith, wuod Imer.
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noloso kom loch maduongʼ ma iye obaw gi lak liech kendo ngʼeye obaw gi dhahabu mopwodhi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

kikuyu: Yaye nyar Babulon, in mochanni kethruok, ngʼama nochuli kuom gima isetimonwa en jahawi,
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kikuyu: bende niya, “En e kidi machwanyo ji kendo lwanda mamiyo gipodho.” Gichwanyore nikech gitamore winjo wach mane Nyasaye owalonegi.
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

kikuyu: Koa odiechiengno Saulo nokawo Daudi kendo ne ok ochako odok dalagi ir wuon-gi.
english: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼatno nowinjo wachno, nomieno wangʼe, moa kanyo ka chunye lit, nikech ne en-gi mwandu mathoth ahinya.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: to neuru ni uyiero ruoth ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ema ochiwo, kendo nyaka obed achiel kuom oweteu, kik uket ngʼat machielo, ma ok en ja-Israel wadu.
english: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

kikuyu: Ne ok aneno kata achiel kuom joote mamoko, makmana Jakobo ma owadgi Ruoth.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

kikuyu: nimar Johana nosebedo ka kwere kawachone niya, “Chik ok oyieni mondo ibed kode.”
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

kikuyu: Anto abiro siko ka an gi geno; abiro paki kendo abiro medo paki.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

kikuyu: Abiro loko Raba pap ma ngamia kwaye to Amon kama rombe yweye. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Negisewinjo mana wach niya, “Ngʼat ma yande sandowa bende tinde yalo kuom yie ma notemo ketho e kinde mosekalo.”
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

kikuyu: Abisalom nowacho ni Joab niya, “Ne, naoroni wach kawacho ni, ‘Bi mondo aori ir ruoth mondo ipenje kama: “Angʼo momiyo nabiro kawuok Geshur? Dine ber kane pod an kuno!” ’ Sani koro adwaro dhi neno ruoth, to ka an gi ketho moro, to mondo onega.”
english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

kikuyu: Nyasaye biro ngʼulo mwandu mane omwonyo oko; obiro miyo ongʼogogi oko ka chiemo mocham.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato kuomu ochando rieko to okwa Nyasaye, ma jachiwo maber ne ji duto kendo nomiye maonge kiawa.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

kikuyu: Luoro nomako Daudi chiengʼno nikech Jehova Nyasaye, mopenjo niya, “Ere kaka Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye dikel ira?”
english: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”

kikuyu: ote mar ngʼat mawinjo weche Nyasaye, ngʼat maneno fweny moa kuom Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼat mopodho piny auma, kendo ma wengene oyawore.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: Kamano bende Malaika mar adek noolo tape e aore gi sokni mag pi kendo pigegi ne olokore remo.
english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Isakar kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: mondo iyaw wenge muofni, kendo igol joma oketi e od twech, kendo igony joma otwe mobetie mudho.
english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

kikuyu: Asechiko ita malongʼo, to ok giwach gima adier. Onge ngʼama lokore weyo kuom timbegi mamono, kopenjo niya, “En angʼo ma asetimo?” Moro ka moro luwo yore owuon ka faras madhi e lweny.
english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo piero angʼwen ja-Filistiano ne wuok okinyi godhiambo konyisore.
english: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

kikuyu: Ka uchungo motegno to ubiro reso ngimau.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

kikuyu: Eka Joab nowachone ja-Kush niya, “Dhiyo mondo inyis ruoth gima ineno.” Ja-Kush nokulore piny e nyim Joab bangʼe noringo modhi.
english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Harim: Eliezer, Ishija, Malkija, Shemaya, Shimeon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

kikuyu: Kendo Abija notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Asa wuode nobedo ruoth kare kendo e kinde mar lochne ne nitiere kwe kuom higni apar.
english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

kikuyu: Eka min-gi nowachone jotich niya, “Timuru gimoro amora monyisou.”
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno morito dhoge orito ngimane, to ngʼatno ma wuoyo karodho wach biro dhiyo e kethruok.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

kikuyu: Eka negiwacho niya, “We waluong nyako mondo wapenje kuom wachni.”
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

kikuyu: Kane pod gibedo gi mor e kindgi giwegi, jomoko ma timbegi mono mag dala maduongʼno nolworo odno. Negigoyo dhoot ka gikok ne jaduongʼ ma wuon odno niya, “Gol oko ngʼatno mane obiro e odi mondo waterre kode.”
english: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”

kikuyu: Timuru sawoni ni Jehova Nyasaye kuom ndalo abiriyo higa ka higa. Mae en chik momakou gi nyikwau nyaka chiengʼ. Paruru ni kochopo dwe mar abiriyo to nyaka ubed gi sawoni.
english: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Ndalo dhano nosekwan chon; isechano kar romb dwechene, kendo iseketo gikone ma ok onyal kalo.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

kikuyu: Mino wach nochakore e kind jopuonjre Johana moko gi ja-Yahudi moro kuom wach mar pwodhruok.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

kikuyu: kod maupe mag dhahabu gi teyni kod ramekni (ne gin dhahabu duto);
english: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

kikuyu: Jo-Dan nodwoko niya, “We dwokori kodwa, ka ok kamano, to joma igi wangʼ moingo tekregi biro monji, bangʼe in kod joodi ibiro negi.”
english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

kikuyu: Singruokno ok nochal gi mano mane atimo gi kweregi, kane amako lwetgi mi atelonegi kagologi e piny Misri, nikech ne ok giluwo singruokna ma natimo kodgi omiyo an bende ne alokora aweyogi, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka abiro to abiro nyiso ji e lela gik motimo; kaka ohangonwa weche maricho. To bende otamore rwako jowete mobiro, kendo otamo joma dwaro timo kamano, bende oriembo jogo mondo oa e kanisa.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

kikuyu: Emomiyo an jayalo awacho niya, “Ngima en gima nono! Gik moko duto onge tiendgi!”
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”

kikuyu: E kinde mar loch Ruoth Josia, Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Bende iseneno gima Israel ma ok ja-ratiro otimo? Osedhi ewi gode duto matindo maboyo kendo e bwo yiende duto motimo otiep mi osechodo kanyo.
english: Moreover, the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

kikuyu: Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi, nikech kata obedo nine aterogi e twech e dier ogendini, to abiro chokogi kaachiel e pinygi giwegi, ma ok aweyo moro kuomgi chien.
english: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

kikuyu: To nyathino nodongo kendo nobedo motegno; nopongʼ kod rieko, kendo ngʼwono mar Nyasaye ne ni kuome.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

kikuyu: Wach mawuok e dho ngʼato ema miyo ngʼato yiengʼ; keyo mar dhoge ema miyo oyiengʼ.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

kikuyu: Joma ne odhi gi Paulo notere nyaka Athene, bangʼe negidok Berea mi ginyiso Sila gi Timotheo yo mane ginyalo chopogo ir Paulo mapiyo.
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruoth Rehoboam nochwogo okumbni mag nyinyo mondo oket kar mane okawgo kendo nomiyo jotelo mag jorit mane rito rangach midonjogo e dala ruoth.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

kikuyu: “Kane pod aparo lek mane aleko, to ne jaote mar Nyasaye obiro ka olor oa e polo.
english: “I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a holy watcher came down from the sky.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Japuonj, gigi biro timore karangʼo? To angʼo mabiro bedo ranyisi ni gichiegni timore?”
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

kikuyu: Nodhi e piny duto molworo Jordan, koyalo batiso mar weyo richo mondo mi owenegi richo.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

kikuyu: Lachne ne romo bat achiel morie to dhoge ne chalo gi dho kikombe, mana ka ondanyo mathiewo. Notingʼo pi manyalo romo lita alufu adek.
english: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

kikuyu: Ne apogo pinyruoth koa e od Daudi mi amiyi, to ok isebedo kaka jatichna Daudi mane orito chikena kendo noluwa gi chunye duto kotimo mana gima kare e nyima.
english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik utime timbe manyalo miyo nyiu bed jochode, nikech mano nyalo kethonu piny makel richo mangʼeny.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa motemo puonjo? To koso en ngʼa ma otemo yarone tiend wachne? Ne nyithindo mogolie chak, koso ne joma koro eka ogolie thuno?
english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

kikuyu: “Joga osetimo richo ariyo: Gisejwangʼa, an thidhna mar pi ngima, kendo gisekunyo degnigi giwegi, degni mobarore kendo ma ok nyal tingʼo pi.
english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.

kikuyu: Malaika noa e polo nofwenyorene kendo nomiye teko.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

kikuyu: To kata kamano nitie mor kod ilo, kaachiel gi yangʼo dhok kod rombe, chamo ringʼo kod madho divai! Giwacho niya, “We wachiem kendo wamethi nikech kiny wanatho!”
english: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

kikuyu: Amam, Shema, Molada,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

kikuyu: Bangʼ gigi duto, e kinde mar loch Artaksases ruodh Pasia, Ezra wuod Seraya, ma wuod Azaria, ma wuod Hilkia,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: Los sirni auchiel ne bathe mochwalore mochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar Hemb Romo,
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

kikuyu: Sa oromo mondo koro itim gimoro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech iketho chikni.
english: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

kikuyu: To ji mangʼeny masani okwongo nobed chien mogik, kendo joma sani ni chien mogik, nobed mokwongo.”
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

kikuyu: Jadolono ok oyiene donjo e ot ma ngʼato othoe. Kik obed mogak kata bedni ngʼatno en wuon mare kata min mare,
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

kikuyu: Omiyo iniluong Jehova Nyasaye kendo nodwoki; iniywagne mondo okonyi kendo nokoni ni: Eri antie. “Ka uweyo sando ji kendo uweyo achaya kod weche mag oyiem,
english: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

kikuyu: Nyikwa Isakar kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Tola, joka Tola; koa kuom Pua, joka Pua;
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Aseketi ibedo wuon ogendini mangʼeny.” En wuonwa e nyim wangʼ Nyasaye mane oyie kuome, Nyasaye machiwo ngima ni joma otho kendo maluongo gik maonge mana ka gima gintie.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

kikuyu: To ruoth nowachone niya, “Nyaka odhi e ode owuon; kendo kik obi buta.” Omiyo Abisalom nodhi e ode owuon kendo ne ok osudo machiegni gi ruoth.
english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

kikuyu: Kelneuru Jehova Nyasaye chiwo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mar misango miwangʼo pep mar rwath achiel, im achiel kod nyiimbe abiriyo ma jo-higa achiel, ma duto onge songa.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Maria nodak gi Elizabeth kuom dweche madirom adek eka nodok thurgi.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

kikuyu: Iro noimo Got Sinai nikech Jehova Nyasaye nolor kanyo ei mach. Iro ne dhwolore kawuok ewi godno mana ka iro mawuok e kendo, mi got duto noyiengni,
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

kikuyu: Mano kaka Nyasaye duongʼ, adier oduongʼ mokalo ngʼeyo kendo kata hike ok wanyal kwano.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Kuyo ber moloyo nyiero, nikech wangʼ man-gi lit berne chuny.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa obed kodwa mana kaka nobedo gi kwerewa, mad kik owewa kata jwangʼowa.
english: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

kikuyu: Un to, ne ok ungʼeyo Kristo e yo machal kamano.
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

kikuyu: Ne ok uchamo makati kata madho divai kata gima mero ji ne atimo mano mondo ungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia ni,
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: To Ruoth nodwoko niya, “Kare jatich ma ja-adiera kendo ma jatelo mariek en ngʼa, ma ruodhe omiyo tich mar rito jotije ka miyogi chiembgi e sa mowinjore?
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

kikuyu: To kata kamano ok unyal gimoro kendo gik mutimo onge tich; bende ngʼat makwanou ka nyisechene en raura ka un.
english: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

kikuyu: Bende dawe sa ma dhako nywolie chopi mak amiye teko mar nywol?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Bende dadin ich kochopo sa mar chiwo nyathi?” Nyasachi owacho.
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

kikuyu: Sa moro nyalo bet ni uparo ni watemo pwoyorenu kuom wuoyonu kama. Ooyo, wawuoyo e nyim Nyasaye mana kaka jo-Kristo. Osiepewa mwageno, ngʼeuru ni gik moko duto ma watimo en ni mondo wajiu.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

kikuyu: To jal mawinjo wechena to ok otimgi chalo gi ngʼat mane ogero ot ewi lowo maonge gi mise. E kindeno ma apaka mogingore nogoyo odno, nogore piny kendo nokethore chuth.”
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

kikuyu: Mano kaka jogi mor manade! En mor manade ne jotendi mosiko kachungʼ e nyimi kendo winjo riekoni!
english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

kikuyu: To ka oluongi e nyasi moro mar kisera kamoro to bed mana e kom man chien moloyo, mondo ka ngʼat moluongino obiro to obiro wachoni ni, ‘Osiepna, sudi malo nyime kama berni!’ Kamano iniyud luor e nyim welo weteni duto.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “In ligangla, chiew mondo ichadh jakwadha, adier, chadh ngʼat matiyona! Go jakwath mi rombe oke, nimar abiro kumo joma pod yomyom.”
english: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says the LORD of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Nahor, Serug nodak higni mia ariyo kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: nikech gibiro ner mapiyo mana kaka lum ner; gibiro tho mi gilal nono mapiyo mana kaka yiende mangʼich.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

kikuyu: Reuben ne en wuod Israel makayo, to kane oterore gi chi wuon mare, to duongʼ mar ngʼat makayo nomi yawuot Josef ma wuod Israel, omiyo nyinge ne ok nyal wuok mokwongo ka indiko nying nyikwa Israel kaluwore gi chik mar kayo.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

kikuyu: Gima ngima mokwongo ne chalo gi sibuor, mar ariyo ne chalo gi nyarwath, mar adek ne lela wangʼe chalo gi mar dhano, to mar angʼwen ne chalo gi ongo mafuyo.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Ruoth Nyasaye osetimona ma. E ndalogi osenyiso ngʼwonone kuoma kendo ogolona wichkuot e kind ji.”
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

kikuyu: Magi e chenro mar tich achuna mane Ruoth Solomon ondiko mondo ogergo hekalu ni Jehova Nyasaye, gi dala ruoth, gi kuonde ohula, kod ohinga mar Jerusalem, gi mier madongo mag Hazor gi Megido kod Gezer.
english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

kikuyu: Chi ngʼatno nokawo gimoro ma oumogo soko bangʼe ne omoyo cham e wiye. To onge ngʼama nofwenyo sokono.
english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

kikuyu: Uwacho niya, ‘Dak koro wane od ruodheno, hembe mane joma richo odakiego koro ere?’
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

kikuyu: nogole e tij rito rombe mokele mondo okwa joge ma nyikwa Jakobo, mondo okwa Israel girkeni mare.
english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

kikuyu: Kitego duto nondikie nying yawuot Israel apar gariyo, ka okedgi kaka kido ka moro ka moro ochungʼ ne nying dhout Israel apar gariyogo.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Ji duto nowuoro kendo negichiwo pak ni Nyasaye. Negiwuoro ahinya kendo negiwacho niya, “Waseneno gik malich kawuono.”
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Hathak nowuok modhi ir Modekai e paw dala maduongʼ mane ni e nyim dhoranga ruoth.
english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.

kikuyu: To bende, kaka negiparo ni ngʼeyo Nyasaye ok lich, Nyasaye nojwangʼogi mondo gidhi adhiya nyime ka pachgi obam, mondo gitim, gik ma ok onego otim.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ok uriembo joma odak e pinyno, to joma uweyo modongʼ biro bedonu ka cha bondo e wangʼu kendo ka kudho machwoyo dendu koni gi koni. Ginimiu chandruok e piny ma ubiro dakieno.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

kikuyu: To machiegni kanyo ne nitie degi auchiel mag pi, mane gin kaka degi ma jo-Yahudi ne tiyogo kuom logo e yor pwodhruok, ma moro ka moro ne tingʼo pi madirom depe ariyo kata adek.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma ok winje, to nongʼad kare oko chuth e kind ogandane.’
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda nowachone jo-Simeon mowetegi niya, “Biuru kodwa e gwengʼ mosepogwa, mondo waked gi jo-Kanaan. Wan bende wabiro dhi kodu e maru.” Omiyo jo-Simeon nodhi kodgi.
english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

kikuyu: Chon ni luongo Hebron ni Kiriath Arba kaluwore gi Arba, mane jatelo maduongʼ e dier jo-Anak. Bangʼe pinyno nobedo gi kwe.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Darius nondiko ne ogendini duto, gi pinje duto kod ji duto mawacho dhok mopogore opogore e piny duto kama: “Mad Nyasaye med gwedhou ahinya!”
english: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages who dwell in all the earth: “Peace be multiplied to you.

kikuyu: E kinde motelo kane Daudi kedo gi Edom, Joab mane jatend lweny mane odhi mondo oyik joma otho, nonego chwo duto mantie e Edom.
english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uchandoru, kendo angʼo momiyo chich ni e parou?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

kikuyu: Ne angʼiyo koni gi koni to ne ok aneno ngʼama konya, omiyo lweta awuon ema ne ochiwo warruok; kendo mirimba awuon ema ne orita.
english: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

kikuyu: Gikanyono, joma nowinjo gima nowachono nochako wuok achiel kaachiel, chakre jomadongo nyaka nyithindo mi dhakono ema nodongʼ kende kochungʼ but Yesu.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

kikuyu: kendo ok enomi ngʼato angʼata ringre nyathineno ma en owuon ochamo nikech mano kende e gima nodongʼ bangʼ ka wasigu osemonjo miechu.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

kikuyu: Kane adhi e got mondo akaw chike mane ondiki e kite mopa, chike mag singruok mane Jehova Nyasaye otimo kodu, ne abet e got odiechienge piero angʼwen kod otieno piero angʼwen; kendo ne ok achiemo kata modho pi.
english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

kikuyu: Obadia wuod Shemaya, wuod Galal, wuod Jeduthun; kod Berekia wuod Asa, wuod Elkana mane odak e mier matindo mag jo-Netofath.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

kikuyu: E nyim hekalu noloso sirni ariyo ma borgi ne romo fut piero abich gariyo gi nus koriw kendo noum wi moro ka moro gi gima borne romo fut aboro.
english: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

kikuyu: Ei atonga mamalo ne nitie chiemo duto motedi ni Farao, to winy ne chamogi ei atonga mamalono.”
english: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

kikuyu: E odiechiengno Joshua noketo singruok ne jogo, kendo kane gin Shekem nomiyogi chike monego gilu.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno masomo weche mokorgi en jahawi kendo ogwedh jogo mawinjo wechegi kendo kano weche mondikgi e chunygi, nikech kinde ma gigi biro timoree chiegni.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

kikuyu: Timbe Josia ne longʼo e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kendo nowuotho e yore duto mag Daudi kwar-gi, ma ok olokore kongʼiyo korachwich kata koracham.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: Negichokore pidhe pidhe kendo negipongʼo piny.
english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

kikuyu: Kokalo kuom jooteni usegango weche mag ayany kuom Ruoth Nyasaye. Bende usewacho niya, ‘Gi gechena mangʼeny mag lweny, aseidho gode maboyo mag Lebanon mi achopo ewi got mabor moloyo. Asetongʼo yiendene mag sida maboyo kendo mabeyo. Asechopo nyaka e chuny bungu ma iye mogik kuma yien odiche.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

kikuyu: Solomon nobawo ii hekalu gi dhahabu lilo kendo nomedo thiwni mag dhahabu e nyim kama ler mar lemo.
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

kikuyu: E kindeno mier madongo abich mag Misri nowuo gi dho jo-Kanaan kendo ginikwongʼre ni ginitine Jehova Nyasaye Maratego. Achiel kuomgi noluongi ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Kethruok.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

kikuyu: Esau nonywolo Elifaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam kod Kora.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Abiro lworo Juda mana kaka adolo atungʼ mara, kendo anaket Efraim obed asere. Asekawo yawuoti, yaye Sayun, ma alokogi ligangla ma akedogo gi jo-Yunani, kendo abiro loki ligangla mar kedo.
english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne Josef niya, “Kwongʼrina.” Eka Josef nokwongʼorene, kendo Israel nolemo koyiengore e ludhe mar wuoth.
english: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

kikuyu: Kata ka dipo ni ngʼato achiel inyalo loyo, to ji ariyo nyalo gengʼo jasigu. Tol mokad nyadidek ok chodo yot.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

kikuyu: Dog jakora mondo iresa, rit ngimana kaluwore gi singruokni.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

kikuyu: Tim gigi gi chunyi duto, kichiwori chuth mar neno ni gitimore mondo ji duto one kaka imedo dhi nyime maber e yore duto.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ngʼat moro ne wuotho koa Jerusalem ka oridore Jeriko, kendo nopo kopodho e lwet jomecho. Ne gilonyo lepe, gigoye, kendo giweye kochiegni tho.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado bura e kind ogendini kendo nokel kwe e kind ogendini mangʼeny. Ginithedh ligengligi olokre kwe mag pur kendo tongegi ginithedhi olokre pende keyo. Onge piny mano kedi gi nyawadgi gi ligangla bende ok ginichak gipuonjre ne lweny kendo.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

kikuyu: Neginyiso joote mane obiro niya, “Wachneuru jo-Jabesh Gilead ni, ‘E sa ma chiengʼ oore, enoresu.’ ” Kane joote odwoko ne jo-Jabesh wachni negimor.
english: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

kikuyu: Nyis oganda ni chwo kaachiel gi mon mondo omi jobathgi gik molos gi fedha kod dhahabu.”
english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

kikuyu: To Jehoshafat nopenjo niya, “Donge nitie janabi mar Jehova Nyasaye ka ma dwapenj wach?”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?”

kikuyu: “Ka utweyo chiemo to kik unen malich kaka joma wuondore timo, nimar gimieno wengegi mondo ginyis ni gitweyo chiemo. Awachonu adier ni giseyudo pokgi duto.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: paruru Ibrahim wuonu kod Sara mane onywolou. Ne en mana ngʼat achiel kende kane aluonge kendo nagwedhe mi aloke oganda maduongʼ.
english: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.

kikuyu: Mana kaka jakwath choko rombene moke ka en kodgi, e kaka abiro choke rombena. E odiechiengʼ achiel moro motimo rumbi gi mudho, abiro resogi ka agologi kuonde duto mane gikee.
english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

kikuyu: Ji nokawo wuowino motere dala kongima, kendo chunygi noyudo hoch maduongʼ.
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

kikuyu: Herode kane oneno Yesu, nodoko mamor ahinya, nikech kuom kinde mabor nosedwaro mondo onene. Kuom gik mane owinjo kuome, nogeno nene kotimo honni moko.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

kikuyu: To Yesu ne thoro dhiyo kuonde thim ma enie kende mondo olem.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

kikuyu: Adwokone Nyasacha erokamano kinde duto kuomu, nikech ngʼwonone mosemiyou kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: To nyaka ukel owadu ma chogo ira, mondo omi angʼe ni uwacho adieri kendo mondo owaduni kik tho.” Kendo negitimo kamano.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

kikuyu: Lum ner kendo maua tuo mi lwar piny ka much Jehova Nyasaye okudhogi. Chutho dhano chalo mana gi lum.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

kikuyu: Jotelo mag Zoan gin ji mofuwo, kendo jongʼad rieko mag Farao chiwo paro manono. Ere kaka iwacho ne Farao niya, “An achiel kuom jorieko, ma nopuonjore kuom ruodhi machon?”
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

kikuyu: Dhoot ka dhoot ne nigi pata ariyo, mane gin pata ariyo ma dhoudigo nolierie.
english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

kikuyu: Ginipenj yo madhi Sayun kendo gilok wengegi kochiko kuno. Ginibi kendo ginitwere kuom Jehova Nyasaye e singruok mochwere, ma wich ok nowil godo.
english: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

kikuyu: Kane oyudo onywol, lwet nyathi achiel nowuok oko; kuom mano jacholo nokawo usi makwar kendo otweyo e ngʼut lwedono ka owacho niya, “Ma ema ne okwongo owuok.”
english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wacho: Abiro kelo masira maduongʼ Jerusalem kod Juda, ma it ji duto mowinjo biro sakni.
english: therefore the LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mokor kuom Turo: Ywaguru, yaye yiedhi mag Tarshish! Nimar Turo osekethi, kendo oweye maonge ot kata dho wath! Wach osechoponegi koa e piny Saipras.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

kikuyu: To koro tich mar Roho dibed gi duongʼ machalo nadi?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona: “Dhi kendo ichungʼ e dhorangach miluongo ni dhoranga ji, kama ruodhi mag Juda donjogo kendo wuok godo oko; chungʼ bende e rangeye duto mag Jerusalem.
english: The LORD said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ji wacho gik madongo kuomi, yaye dala maduongʼ mar Nyasaye: Sela
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich gi nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Abidan wuod Gideoni ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: En angʼo ma itimo ka, kendo en ngʼa manomiyi thuolo mar kunyo buri ka, momiyo iloso bur kama otingʼore, kendo iloso kari maber mar yweyo e kind lwanda?
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada jatend jolweny. Zadok kod Abiathar ma jodolo;
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

kikuyu: Kaka ne ok giyie gi puonjna kendo gidagi siem mara,
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

kikuyu: Aolo gi dhoga chike duto mowuok e dhogi.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

kikuyu: Ruodh Babulon osewinjo humbgi; kendo bedene onge gi teko. Rem malich osemake, ka rem mar dhako mamuoch kayo.
english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

kikuyu: kendo chiwe e kendo mar misango kaachiel gi misango mar cham mitimonego pwodhruok eka enobed maler.
english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

kikuyu: Ne giywak mondo okonygi, to ne onge ngʼama ne nyalo resogi; ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye, to ne ok odwokogi.
english: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

kikuyu: Kane jogo makwayo angurogo noneno gima nosetimore, negiringo mi gidhi gitero wach ne ji duto modak e dala kendo e gwengʼno.
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ka jo-Israel ema ok nyal winja, en angʼo manyalo miyo Farao winja mi dewa nimar an radwal?”
english: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

kikuyu: Ka uchokoru kanyakla, to nenore ni ok ucham Sap Ruoth;
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

kikuyu: Barupenego duto ondiko machalre, kowuoyo kuom wechegi. Barupene otingʼo weche moko ma tiendgi tek ma joma kia kaachiel gi jo-hubagabaga gwenyo, mana kaka gigwenyo Ndiko mamoko bende, to timgino biro kelonegi chandruok.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nodhi koa Gilgal nyaka Bokim kendo nowacho niya, “Ne agolou e piny Misri mi aterou nyaka e piny mane asingo ni anami kwereu, ka awachonegi ni ok anaketh singruokna kodu,
english: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

kikuyu: Harim, Meremoth, Obadia,
english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

kikuyu: omiyo abiro darou mi ateru e piny twech mabor mayombo Damaski,” Jehova Nyasaye, ma nyinge en Nyasaye Maratego, ema owacho.
english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ ma anatieki mi aum kor polo to sulwe ok norieny; kendo wangʼ chiengʼ gi boche polo ok nobedie bende dwe ok norieny.
english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.

kikuyu: Anto aywakni mondo ikonya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; lamona chopo e nyimi gokinyi.
english: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

kikuyu: “Asewinjo ngʼur mar jo-Israel. Nyisgi kama, ‘Ka piny yuso ubiro chamo ringʼo kendo gokinyi ubiro chamo Makati muyiengʼ. Eka ubiro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Ok mana joma ongʼeyo Chik ema nikare e nyim Nyasaye, to makmana jogo matimo gima chik dwaro ema ibiro keto kare.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

kikuyu: Ruodh Jeriko nonyisi niya, “Ngʼe ni jo-Israel moko osebiro ka gotienoni mondo onon pinywa.”
english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

kikuyu: Ngʼe bende ne rieko mit ni chunyi; ka iyude, nitie geno mar ndalo mabiro kuomi, to genoni ok nongʼad oko.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: In-gi bat maratego, lweti bende otegno, kendo lweti ma korachwich nigi duongʼ.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

kikuyu: Chunya winjo malit. Nyaka karangʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka karangʼo?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

kikuyu: Nikech opidhgi e od Jehova Nyasaye, gibiro loth e agolni mag Nyasachwa.
english: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

kikuyu: Girkeni mane Musa omiyo dhood Gad kaluwore gi anywola margi e magi:
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

kikuyu: Eka wasika biro gomo dok ka aluongo kony moa kuomi. Mano ema abiro ngʼeyogo ni Nyasaye en jakora.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

kikuyu: Kane Mikaya ochopo, ruoth nopenje niya, “Bende wanyalo dhi mondo waked gi jo-Ramoth Gilead, koso kik wadhi?” Nodwoke niya, “Ked kodgi kendo iyud loch nimar Jehova Nyasaye osechiwe e lwet ruoth.”
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ma yande kwalo nyaka koro we kuo chuth, to nyaka oti tich gi lwete owuon mondo okonyrego kendo okony bende joma moko mochando.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

kikuyu: Gikanyono dhoge noyawore kendo lewe nogonyore, mi nochako wuoyo, kopako Nyasaye.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu olokore monene, nowachone niya, “Bed motegno nyara, nikech yieni osechangi.” Kendo dhakono nochango chakre sano.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Nyasaye, yie ichange!”
english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

kikuyu: Noduog ringre kotingʼ gi faras kendo noyike Jerusalem but kwerene e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

kikuyu: Eka Amos nodwoko Amazia niya, “An ok an janabi, to bende ok an kata nyathi janabi. Anto an mana jakwath kendo jarit ngʼowu.
english: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;

kikuyu: Negiiko choke Saulo gi mag Jonathan ma wuode e liend Kish wuon Saulo, e Zela e piny Benjamin kendo negitimo gik moko duto ma ruoth nochiko. Bangʼ mano Nyasaye nodwoko lemo mane ilamo ni piny.
english: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

kikuyu: Res jogo mitero kar tho; mak jogo mawuotho ka tangni dhiyo kar yengʼo.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

kikuyu: Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye ne okaw, yawuot Eli ariyo Hofni gi Finehas ne onegi.
english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

kikuyu: Un to fwenyruokni duto nochalnu mana ka gima nono, mana ka kitabu modin gi duogo. To ka imiyo ngʼato manyalo somo, miwachone niya, “Yie isom kitabuni,” to obiro dwoko niya, “Ok anyal some nikech odine gi duogo.”
english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ibwon owadu gi chunyi. Nyis wadu kethone e wangʼe, mondo kik iriwri kode e richone.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

kikuyu: Omiyo giduto ji ariyogo ne giwuok e lela mondo jo-Filistia manie kambigi onegi. Eka jo-Filistia nowacho niya, “Neuru! Jo-Hibrania mol kawuok ae buche mane gipondoe.”
english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano anyisou ni gimoro amora mukwayo kulamo, beduru gi yie ni useyude mi nobed maru adier.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

kikuyu: Piny moa yo nyandwat nomonje kendo pinye nodongʼ gunda. Onge ngʼama nodag e iye; ji kaachiel gi le noringi.”
english: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.

kikuyu: Ringruok duto ok chalre. Dhano nigi kit ringruok moro, to le nigi machielo, winy bende nigi machielo, kendo rech bende nigi machielo.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

kikuyu: kit tula moro amora, gi okok, kata kit olith duto,
english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

kikuyu: Eka Musa noweyo Farao mi gidhi oko mar dala. Noyaro bade ni Jehova Nyasaye, mi mor polo kod pe norumo kendo koth bende ne ok ochwe e piny.
english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni chik dwaro ni mondo nyikwa Lawi ma gin joma tiyo tij dolo ema ochoki achiel kuom apar kuom ogandagi, ma gin owetegi, kata obedo ni owetegigo bende gin nyikwa Ibrahim.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

kikuyu: “To ka uneno ‘gima kwero makelo kethruok’kochungʼ kama ok onego obedie, to dwarore ni jasomo owinj tiend wachni maber, eka joma ni Judea oring odhi ewi gode.
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Zebulun: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Gik mamoko duto mane otimo e ndalo lochne kod gik manotimo duto koa kar chakruokgi nyaka gikogi ondikie kitap ruodhi mag Juda kod Israel.
english: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Mana kaka lak marach kata tielo mongʼol e kaka keto geno kuom jogo ma ok jo-adiera e kinde mag chandruok.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

kikuyu: To an jatichni gi Zadok jadolo gi Benaya wuod Jehoyada gi jatichni Solomon ne ok ogwelo.
english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodak e piny Misri kuom higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek.
english: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

kikuyu: Ka gidwaro mondo olernigi tiend wach moro, to gipenj chwogi giwegi dala, nikech en wichkuot ka dhako wuoyo e kanisa.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

kikuyu: Ka un joma kare to bedou makare miye angʼo, koso en angʼo muchiwone?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ogowo loka, noneno oganda maduongʼ, nokechogi kendo nochango jogo duto mane tuo.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

kikuyu: To Jona noringo oa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kochomo Tarshish. Ne olor modhi Jopa, kumane oyudoe yie mane dhi e dho wadhno. Bangʼ chulo nengo wuoth noidho mokwangʼ kodhiyo Tarshish mondo oring oa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma ja-Israel kata jadak manie dieru mochamo gima otho kende, kata mondiek onego nyaka luok lepe kende olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo, eka bangʼe nobed maler.
english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

kikuyu: Negibedo e kom molos maber kendo mayom, gi mesa mopedhi maber kama nuketoe ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kaachiel gi modhi mangʼwe ngʼar mane onego bed mara.
english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jakobo gi Johana, mane gin yawuot Zebedi, nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Japuonj, wadwaro mondo itimnwa gimoro amora mwakwayi.”
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

kikuyu: nomedo wacho ni, ‘Kuom mano, dichwo nowe wuon kod min kendo nopadre gi chiege, mi ji ariyogo nodok ringruok achiel?’
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Jalno makelo Resruok nobi Sayun, mondo ores nyikwa Jakobo moseweyo richogi.”
english: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Ezion Geber mi gibworo Kadesh, mantiere e Thim mar Zin.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

kikuyu: Nikech kaka tho noa kuom ngʼat achiel e kaka chier mar joma otho bende osebiro koa kuom ngʼat achiel.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

kikuyu: Dhiuru mondo udwar lumbu kamoro amora ma unyalo yude, to ngʼeuru ni tiju to ok nodwok chien kata matin.’ ”
english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, yie iti gi rieko ma angʼadoni, yaye ruoth: Lokri iwe richoni itim gima kare, kendo we timbeni maricho ibed mangʼwon ne joma ithiro. Kitimo kamano, to dipo ka omedni ndalo mag ngima maber.”
english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.”

kikuyu: Rieko bor moyombo ngʼat mofuwo; e kar bura mar alap oonge gi gima onyalo wacho.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

kikuyu: (Og ruodh Bashan kende e ngʼama ne odongʼ e dier jomane otony kuom jo-Refai. Otandane ne olos gi nyinyo; borne ne oyombo fut apar gadek kendo lachne fut auchiel. Otandaneno pod ni Raba piny jo-Amon nyaka chil kawuono).
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Udi, puothe kod puothe mzabibu bende ibiro chak ngʼiew e pinyni.’
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.’

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo dwaro gimoro gi chunye duto to ok oyud gimoro, to jakinda yudo gik moko duto modwaro.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

kikuyu: Wiu nokuodi gi tiend yiende mag ober ma umorgo kutimoe misengini, kendo unubed gi kuyo kuom puothe museyiero mondo ulemie.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

kikuyu: Abiezer ma ja-Anathoth, Sibekai ma ja-Hushath,
english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Ibrahim noa malo kendo noiko pundane ne wuoth. Nodhi kod jotijene ariyo kaachiel gi Isaka wuode. Kane osengʼado yien moromo tiyogo e misango miwangʼo pep, nochako wuoth madhi kamane Nyasaye osenyise.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

kikuyu: Elizur wuod Shedeur, ma jatend joka Reuben nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar angʼwen.
english: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben,

kikuyu: To negilosone Harun kod yawuote kandho mar law mayom mar katana, ma en tij jatwengʼo molony,
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

kikuyu: Resa e dho sibuoche; resa e tunge jowi mager.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma terore mos ber moloyo jalweny, ngʼat makweyo mirimbe ber moloyo ngʼat mamonjo dala maduongʼ.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

kikuyu: Ngano to ne ok okethore nimar ne pok gimoyo.)
english: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.

kikuyu: Ol mirimbi kuom pinjeruodhi, adier ol mirimbi kuom ogendini ma ok luong nyingi;
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

kikuyu: Ka Daudi owuon luonge ni ‘Ruoth.’ Koro ere kaka onyalo bedo wuode kendo?” Oganda maduongʼ mane winje nopongʼ gi mor.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Magi ne gin pige mag Meriba, kama jo-Israel nongʼurie gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo mano e kama nonyisore owuon kaka ngʼama ler e kindgi.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka ruoth nosewangʼo kitabu mane otingʼo gik mane Baruk ondiko ka Jeremia somone, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel osingore kawacho kama, “Adiera, Moab biro chalo gi Sodom, to jo-Amon kaka Gomora, piny modongʼ gunda mojwangʼ motimo bunge. Joga modongʼ noyakgi; kendo oganda modongʼ nokaw pinygi.”
english: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

kikuyu: Jatelono nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, yie idhi koda kapok nyathina otho.”
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne in-gi gombo mar chode kane pod in nyako matin e kinde mane in Misri, kane chwo mulo dendi kendo rucho thundeni ma pod tindo.
english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ok orito wedene, to moloyo ka ok orito joode owuon, to osekwedo yie marwa, kendo orach moloyo japiny.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ginitine Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi kod Daudi ruodhgi, ma anamigi.
english: but they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

kikuyu: Tekone maduongʼ biro miyo ubed motegno, mondo ubed joma odhil matimo kinda e yore duto, kendo
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye ne obiro ne Jona wuod Amitai kama:
english: Now the LORD’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

kikuyu: To wiu kik wil gi gimoro achielni osiepena mageno: Ni kuom Ruoth odiechiengʼ achiel chalre gi higni alufu achiel, kendo higni alufu achiel chalre gi odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

kikuyu: Nopenja niya, “Bende ineno gima timoreni, wuod dhano? Bende en wach matin adier mondo jo-Juda odhi nyime gi gik mamono ma gitimo kaeni? Bende owinjore gipongʼ piny gi mahundu kendo gidhi nyime giwangʼo iya? Ne kaka gitwenyona umgi!
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

kikuyu: “ ‘Omiyo unubed joga, kendo anabed Nyasachu.’ ”
english: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, jomoko nochako kedo kode. Jogi ne gin jokanyo mar oganda mane iluongo ni sinagogi mar wasumbini mogony. Ne gin jo-Yahudi modak Kurene, gi Aleksandria kod gwenge mag Kilikia kod Asia. Jogi nochako mino wach gi Stefano,
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema ne omiyo chunygi obedo matek mondo gitug lweny gi jo-Israel kendo mondo jo-Israel otiekgi chuth maonge ngʼwono mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
english: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ne giwachona kama, ‘Losnwa nyiseche mabiro telonwa, nimar ok wangʼeyo gima otimo ngʼat ma Musa-ni mane ogolowa e piny Misri.’
english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

kikuyu: Miya rieko kod ngʼeyo mondo atel ne ogandani nimar en ngʼa manyalo telo ni oganda maduongʼ machalo kama?”
english: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

kikuyu: Ok anabed gi paro mochido; bende kata paro mar timo richo ok anapar.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye odagi yore ngʼat marach, to ohero jogo matimo gik makare.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu donjo e yie, ngʼat mane jachien sando mane oyudo osechangono nosaye mondo oyie odhi kode.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nosiemo Israel kod Juda kokalo kuom jonabi mage kod jokor, kawacho niya, “Lokri iwe yoreni maricho, luw wechena, kod yorena kaluwore gi chikena duto mane amiyo kwereu mondo oriti kendo mane amiyou kowuok kuom jotichna ma jonabi.”
english: Yet the LORD testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

kikuyu: Baana wuod Hushai norito Asher kod Aloth.
english: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

kikuyu: kata obedo ni ingʼeyo maber ni aonge ketho kendo ni onge ngʼama nyalo resa e lweti?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

kikuyu: Od ngʼat mariek opongʼ kod chiemo gi moo moyier, to ngʼat mofuwo chamo gik moko duto ma en-go.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

kikuyu: E duongʼni nyisri ayanga kaka jalocho mochungʼ ni adiera gi muolo kod tim makare; lweti ma korachwich mondo onyis timbeni miwuoro.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

kikuyu: Kane Musa dhi e Hema to bor polo ne lor piny kendo siko e dhoot ka Jehova Nyasaye wuoyo gi Musa.
english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.

kikuyu: Farao nochako Josef ni Zafenath-Panea kendo nomiye Asenath nyar Potifera jadolo mar On (ma nyinge machielo en Eliopolis), mondo obed chiege. Kendo Josef nowuotho e piny Misri duto.
english: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Olocho nyaka chiengʼ gi teko ne, wengene ema rito ogendini. Omiyo kik jongʼanyo hedhre mar kedo kode. Sela
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

kikuyu: Jower ne gin: Nyikwa Asaf, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gaboro (128).
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: Osegura kaachiel gi Kristo, kendo an koro ok ema angima, to Kristo ema ngima kuoma. Ngima makoro angimago e ringra an-go mana kuom yie ma ayiego kuom Wuod Nyasaye, mane ohera kendo ochiwore owuon ni an.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

kikuyu: Elteke, Gibethon, Baalath,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne owuoyo gi Harun kowachone niya,
english: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mopodho kuom kidino notur matindo tindo, to ngʼatno ma kidino ogore kuome noregre ka buru.”
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

kikuyu: jahang wach mawacho miriambo kendo ngʼatno makelo miero e kind jowete.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

kikuyu: Tok teko mar jo-Israel bedonegi janeno ka ngʼadonegi bura, to kata magi duto timorene, to ok oduogi ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache, kata mana manye.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.

kikuyu: Hilkia nowachone Shafan jagoro niya, “Aseyudo Kitap Chik ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.” Nochiwe ni Shafan.
english: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie owete moko abiriyo. Wuowi makayo nokendo to bangʼe notho ka oonge nyithindo.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata ma omonjo wuon kata min nyaka negi.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: Pak odogne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi mosebedo mamor kodi moketi e kom loch mar Israel. Nikech hera mosiko mar Jehova Nyasaye ni jo-Israel oseketi ruoth mondo irit bura kendo ingʼade gadiera kod tim makare.”
english: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka jopinyno obiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e kinde mag sewni moyier, ngʼato angʼata modonjo koluwo rangach man yo nyandwat mondo olem nyaka wuog koluwo rangach man yo milambo; to ngʼato angʼata modonjo gi rangach ma yo milambo nyaka wuogi gi rangach ma yo nyandwat. Ok oyiene ngʼato angʼata dok koluwo rangach mane odonjogo, to ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka wuog oko koluwo rangach mangʼiyore gi mano mane odonjogo.
english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

kikuyu: Haman nomedo wacho niya, “To ok mano kende, an kenda ema Esta mikach ruoth oluonga mondo adhi gi ruoth e nyasine moloso, to kiny bende oseluonga mondo wadhi gi ruoth.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo ni ma e wach mane Nyasaye ooro ni jo-Israel, konyisogi Injili mar kwe kuom Yesu Kristo, ma en Ruodh ji duto.
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Asaf. Yaye Nyasaye, ogendini osemonjo girkeni mari; gisedwanyo hekalu mari maler, kendo giseketho Jerusalem modongʼ pidhe pidhe.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kikuyu: Kuom bath pasia momedore, nus pasia momedoreno enolier e tok Hemb Romo.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Dhiyo adhiya nyime gitimo timbe mabeyo, to bangʼe notimni ngʼwono.
english: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

kikuyu: Tongʼ ma yo milambo nochakore oko mar Kiriath Jearim mantiere yo podho chiengʼ, kendo tongʼno nochopo nyaka thidhna mar pi Neftoa.
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

kikuyu: “Nochako ooro jotich mamoko, kowacho ni, ‘Dhiuru unyis joma noluongi ni aseiko chiemba: Rwetha gi jamba machwe osenegi, kendo gik moko duto oikore. Omiyo biuru e nyasi mar arus.’
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

kikuyu: Owetegi modak e miechgi nyaka ne bi kinde ka kinde kakonyogi tich kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

kikuyu: Ere kaka dutim kamano to uchayo puonjna kendo udiro wechena katoku!
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

kikuyu: Pod ok udhi mondo udhi ulos ohinga mar Israel momukore mondo obed motegno mar kedo lweny e odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Jehova Nyasaye nonere ratiro koa malo ne joge kendo nochiel asere mare ka mil polo. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro goyo tungʼ mi odhi ka en ei ahiti moa yo milambo,
english: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

kikuyu: An gi weche mangʼeny monego andikni, to ok adwar ndikonigi e baruwani.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho ni ngʼat Nyasayeno niya, “Kwana Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo lamna mondo lweta odog kare.” Kamano ngʼat Nyasayeno nokwayone Jehova Nyasaye kendo lwet ruoth nodok kare kaka ne en.
english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.

kikuyu: Kane Farao ochopo machiegni kodgi, jo-Israel notingʼo wangʼ-gi mi gineno ka jo-Misri lawogi. Luoro nomakogi mi giywakne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane osetieko pesane duto, kech mager nowuok e pinyno duto, mi nodoko jachan machandore.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

kikuyu: Shefatia, Hatil, Pokereth-Hazebaim kod Amon.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Reuben nomi: Bezer, Jahaz,
english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Yesu nodok Galili gi teko mar Roho, kendo wachne nolandore e gwenge duto moluoro Galili.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

kikuyu: Jo-Anak gin joma roteke kendo roboche! Usewinjo kiwuoyo kuomgi kiwacho niya, “Ere joma dichungʼ e nyim jo-Anak?”
english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

kikuyu: Eka jokwangʼ duto nowuoyo e kindgi giwegi niya, “Bi wagouru ombulu mondo wangʼe ngʼama okelo masirani.” Negigoyo ombulu, mi ombulu nolwar kuom Jona.
