english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

kikuyu: ‘Jehonadab wuod Rekab nochiwo chik ne yawuote ni kik madh divai kendo chikni oseriti. Nyaka kawuononi pod ok gimadho divai, nikech girito chik kwargi. To asewuoyo kinde ka kinde, to kata kamano pod ok umiya luor.
english: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

kikuyu: Jeremia nowacho niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona:
english: Jeremiah said, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Harun niya, “An awuon aseketi jarit mar chiwo duto mokelna; chiwo maler duto ma jo-Israel omiya amiyi kod yawuoti kaka pok maru kendo mano ema unuyud pile.
english: The LORD spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

kikuyu: Joab nowachone Amasa niya, “Idhi nade owadwa?” Eka Joab nomako Amasa gi yie tike gi lwete ma korachwich ka gima odwaro mose gi nyoth.
english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

kikuyu: Nimar ka Nyasaye miyowa girkeni mana kuom mako Chik, to mano nyiso ni ok wayudgi kuom singruok. To Nyasaye, kuom ngʼwonone, nochiwo gwethne ni Ibrahim kuom singruok.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

kikuyu: kendo nowuog oko mondo owuond ogendini duto mag tunge angʼwen mag piny, ma gin Gog gi Magog, kendo nochokgi kaachiel mondo gidhi e lweny. To kar kwan-gi romre gi kwoyo manie dho nam.
english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

kikuyu: “Los rachungi mar taya gi dhahabu maler kendo ithedh tiende gi kore gi kikombege machalo maua gi thiepege kod obokege obed gimoro achiel kode.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Ne angʼiewo jotich machwo kod mamon kendo ne an gi jotije mamoko mane onywol e oda. Bende ne an gi kweth mangʼeny mag dhok kod rombe moloyo ngʼato angʼata mane okuongona bedo jatelo e Jerusalem.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Gin ginyalo kwongʼa to angʼeyo ni in ibiro gwedha; ka gimonja to ibiro kuodo wigi, to jatichni to biro bedo mamor.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

kikuyu: Nyaka gipedh nanga ewi gigi duto kendo giumgi gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe bangʼe giket sirni mitingʼego.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: kawacho niya, “Ma e gima Jeftha wacho: Jo-Israel ne ok okawo piny jo-Moab kata piny jo-Amon.
english: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Aywak ka rem ohewa nyaka piny ru, chokena otur mana ka gima sibuor ema oturo, isanda chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo.
english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

kikuyu: “Choknauru joga maler, mane otimo koda singruok e yor misango.”
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

kikuyu: Kuno newanwangʼe yie madhi Foinike, mine waidho kendo wachako kwangʼ.
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

kikuyu: “An e mzabibu, to un e bedene. Ka ngʼato osiko kuoma kendo an bende asiko kuome, to obiro nyago olemo mangʼeny, nimar onge gima unyalo timo ka upogoru koda.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

kikuyu: Kik imak osiep gi ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo; kik iriwri bende gi ngʼatno makecho piyo,
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

kikuyu: Ruodha nopenjo jotichne ni, ‘Bende un gi wuonu kata owadu?’
english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

kikuyu: Kendo nowachona niya, Wuod dhano, ket chunyi kendo iwinj weche ma awachoni maber.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Ne Jeduthun. Mar Asaf. Zaburi. Ne aywak ni Nyasaye mondo okonya, kendo ne aywak ni Nyasaye mondo owinja.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

kikuyu: Zaburi. Wer. Ne chiengʼ Sabato. Pako Jehova Nyasaye en gima ber kendo wero wende mapako nyingi bende ber, yaye Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

kikuyu: Ket jo-Lawi obedna kaka kayo e lo kayo duto mag jo-Israel, kendo kaw jamb jo-Lawi obed e lo kweth makayo mag jamb jo-Israel. An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Hanani, ma en achiel kuom owetena, nobiro koa Juda kaachiel gi joma moko, kendo ne apenjogi kuom jo-Yahudi mane otony, bende ne apenjogi kuom Jerusalem.
english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

kikuyu: E kindeno dwonde noyiengo piny, to koro sani osesingore niya, “Abiro chako yiengo piny kendo. To ok anayieng piny kende, to anayieng polo bende.”
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

kikuyu: Okinyi mangʼich Daudi noweyo rombe gi jokwath, notweyo misike mowuok odhi kaka Jesse nonyise. Nochopo e kambi ka jolweny wuok dhi e paw lweny, ka gigoyo koko kendo gigiyo sigich lweny.
english: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

kikuyu: Kweth mag bonyo noketh yiendu kod chambu duto e pinyu.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

kikuyu: Ka wakawo jo-Israel kaka ranyisi: Donge joma chamo gik mokete kendo mar misango bet e lalruok achiel gi kendo mar misangono?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

kikuyu: Magi e chike, buche kod weche ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ochika mondo apuonju kendo uritgi e piny ma ungʼado aora Jordan mondo ukaw.
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

kikuyu: Yawuot Zilpa jatich Lea madhako ne gin: Gad kod Asher. Magi ema ne yawuot Jakobo mane onywolone Padan Aram.
english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

kikuyu: To ligangla mabith wuok e dhoge ma ochwowogo ogendini manie pinje. Obiro locho koritogi gi ludh nyinyo. To enonyon-gi ka jabicho mar divai ka oolo mirimb Nyasaye Maratego kuomgi.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

kikuyu: Zadok wuod Imer nogedo kama omanyore gi ode. E dir Zadok, to Shemaya wuod Shekania, mane jarit Rangach mochiko yo wuok chiengʼ, ema nogedoe.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noduogo ire mar ariyo kendo nomule mowachone niya, “Chungi mondo ichiem nimar wuoth pod bor.”
english: The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye biro aa malo mana kaka notimo e Got Perazim, mirimbe nowuogi kaka ne otimore e Holo mar Gibeon, mondo oti tichne, tichne mayoreyore ma ji kia kendo timne mar wich teko.
english: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

kikuyu: Koro, chiengʼ chier dhakoni nobed chi ngʼa kuom ji abiriyogi, nikech ji abiriyogo nokende giduto?”
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

kikuyu: Pinyni nochakore Aroer koa e dier holo mar Arnon mochopo nyaka Got Siyon (tiende ni, Hermon),
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

kikuyu: “Eka nopenjo ngʼat mar ariyo ni, ‘In to, gopi oromo adi?’ “Nodwoke ni, ‘Gunia alufu achiel mag ngano.’ “Nowachone ni, ‘Kaw kitapini, indike ni mia aboro.’
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

kikuyu: Kuom teko Nyasaye nochiero Ruoth Yesu oa kuom joma otho kendo wan bende obiro chierowa.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

kikuyu: An Paulo, ma jaote mar Kristo Yesu kuom dwaro mar Nyasaye kaachiel gi Timotheo owadwa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

kikuyu: Jeramel ne nigi dhako machielo mane iluongo ni Atara, ne en min Onam.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene wigi nowil ma ok gitingʼo makati, makmana makati achiel kende ema ne gin-go e yie.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

kikuyu: Rekem, Irpil, Tarala,
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

kikuyu: Koro jo-Filistia nosebiro ma gimonjo holo mar Refaim,
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar loch mar ruoth Belshazar, an Daniel, naneno fweny, bangʼ fweny mane aseneno mokwongo.
english: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

kikuyu: jogo ma yoregi ogajore ogajore kendo gin jowuond e yoregi.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

kikuyu: Kamano bende Sodom gi Gomora, kaachiel gi mier molworogi ne jochiwore ne chode gi anjawo. Gin gibedo kaka ranyisi mar joma ikumo kiwangʼo e mach manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

kikuyu: To kuom weche moko mondiki e sigand loch Jehu, gik mane otimo, gima ne ochopo kare, donge ondikgi e kitabu motingʼo weche mag ruodhi jo-Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Kendo Ahaz nokawo fedha kod dhahabu mane oyudi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod kar keno mar od ruoth mine oorogi kaka mich ne ruodh Asuria.
english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: “Koro anyisou wachni chon kapok otimore mondo kotimore, to ubiro yie ni An e Kristo.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

kikuyu: Ubiro timo kaka asetimo. Ok ubi umo lela wengeu kata chamo chiemb liel.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

kikuyu: Yie en bedo gi adiera kuom gima wageno yudo kendo en bedo gi ratiro kuom gik ma ok wane.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

kikuyu: An gi chir maduongʼ kuomu; asungora matek nikech un! Kaparou to chunya yudo jip mathoth kendo e chandruokwa duto, chunya opongʼ gi mor mogundho.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

kikuyu: Isebedo kar pondo ne jochan, kar gengʼruok ne jodhier manie lit, kar bwok ka ahiti kudho, kendo kar tipo ka chiengʼ kech. Nimar muya mar janjore chalo mana ka ahiti makudho kochomo ohinga,
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

kikuyu: Enobed mise mar adier e ndalou, kar mwandu mar resruok gi rieko kod ngʼeyo; luoro Jehova Nyasaye e rayaw mar mwanduni.
english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.

kikuyu: We ngʼiya, mondo achak abed moil kendo kapok adar aweyo pinyni mi alal e wangʼ ji.
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni ngʼato owuok e odi modhi e yore mag mier, rembe enobed e wiye owuon; ok enobed wachwa. To ne ngʼatno manobed kodi ei ot, rembe nobedi e wiwa ka dipo ni lwedo moro nomule.
english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

kikuyu: Wach Nyasaye nomedo dhi nyime kendo nomedo landore.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

kikuyu: Eka anamiu jokwath ma chunygi chal koda, mabiro telonu gi rieko kod winjo.”
english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

kikuyu: Kendo Laban nochiwo Zilpa jatichne ma nyako ne nyare, Lea, mondo obed jatichne.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Ruoth Solomon noluongo jodong jo-Israel mondo odhi ire Jerusalem gi jodong dhoudi duto gi jotend anywola mag Israel mondo gikel Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye koa Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi miluongo ni Sayun.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

kikuyu: Jodongo kaachiel gi ji duto nodwoke kawacho niya, “Kik iwinje kata yie kik iyie gik modwaro.”
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Zalmona mi gibworo Punon.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

kikuyu: Bakbukia kod Uni, gi jotich kaachiel kodgi nochungʼ momanyore kodgi kuom tije duto.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.

kikuyu: Bende joma ne ni kod kite ma nengogi tek nochiwogi e kar keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka jaritgi en Jehiel ja-Gershon.
english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasaye nokumo Abimelek kuom timbe mamono mane otimo ne wuon mare kuom nego owetene piero abiriyo.
english: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

kikuyu: “Sani koro abiro diyou piny kama untie, mana ka cham mopongʼo gari mayiecho gari.
english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

kikuyu: Sa ma noyudo Petro obet oko e laru, jatich ma nyako moro nobiro ire mowachone niya, “In bende ne in gi Yesu ja-Galili.”
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

kikuyu: mi nowachonegi niya, “Owetena, Ndiko nyaka ne chop kare, mana kaka Roho Maler nohulo chon gi dho Daudi, kuom Judas mane otelo ni joma nomako Yesu.
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

kikuyu: Paruru joma ni e od twech mana ka gima un bende otweu kodgi. Joma isando bende paruru mana ka gima un bende isandou kodgi.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi ite mondo owinji.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: To moloyo ni mago duto, rwakreuru gihera, mariwo wechegi duto mi giwinjre kaka gimoro achiel.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni Demetrio gi jotheth wetene nigi wach gi ngʼato kuomgi, to ute yalo bura oyaw dhogi, kendo joyal bura bende nitie. Kuno ema ginyalo dhi donjo ni joma okethonigi.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ ni guogi ma gin joma timo timbe mamono kendo moramo ni ji nyaka ter nyangu.
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

kikuyu: Kane Abisalom timo misengini, nooro joote mondo oom Ahithofel ma ja-Gilon, jangʼad rieko ni Daudi mondo obi koa Gilo, ma dalagi. Omiyo tim mar ngʼanyo nomedo bedo gi teko, kendo ji mane luwo bangʼ Abisalom nosiko ka medore.
english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

kikuyu: “Yaye Ruodhwa kendo Nyasachwa, iwinjori yudo duongʼ gi pak kod teko, nimar nichweyo gik moko duto, kendo kuom dwaroni ne ochwegi, kendo gibedo mangima.”
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

kikuyu: Jatichni nosingore ne wuon-gi ni nodwok wuowino kangima. Ne awacho ni, ‘Ne akwongʼora ni ka ok aduogo wuowini iri kangima to anabed jaketho e nyimi ndalo duto mag ngimana!’
english: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

kikuyu: Dhahabu gi fedha ma un-go nyal osechamo, kendo nyal mochamogigo ema biro bedo joneno makwedou kaka joketho, kendo gibiro chamo ringreu ka mach. Usechoko mwandu e ndalo gikoni!
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

kikuyu: Kaka Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ne owuoyo koda kowachona niya, “Daniel, koro asebiro mondo amiyi ngʼeyo tiend fweny.
english: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

kikuyu: E kindeno jogo moneg gi Jehova Nyasaye nokere kuonde duto kochakore e giko piny konchiel nyaka komachielo. Ok noywag-gi kata chokogi kata ikogi, to ginichal gi owuoyo mokee piny.
english: The slain of the LORD will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka wapakore e tijwani to ok wakalo tongʼ nikech wan ema ne wakwongo kelonu Injili mar Kristo bangʼ wuotho wuoth marabora.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

kikuyu: Lep mar sunga ok owinjore ne ngʼama ofuwo, to en rach maromo nadi lep mariambo ne jaloch!
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

kikuyu: In kende e Jehova Nyasaye. Ne ichweyo polo nyaka polo man malo mogik, to gi gik moko duto manie iye, gi piny to gi gik moko duto man kuome, nembe kod gik moko duto manie igi. Ichiwo ngima ne gik moko duto, kendo jopolo pakoi.
english: You are the LORD, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

kikuyu: Mogik jowetena, beduru mamor kuom Ruoth! Aonge gi pek moro manyalo tama nwoyonu weche mane asendikonu motelo, nikech wechegi obedonu ohinga mar konyruok.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

kikuyu: Chik mane Esta ogolo nojiwo chike mag Purim, kendo nondikgi e kitabu.
english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

kikuyu: Jehoram ne ja-higni piero adek gariyo kane obedo ruoth, kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni aboro.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Chik kod Jonabi ne nigi teko nyaka chop ndalo mar Johana. Chakre kanyo, Injili mar pinyruoth Nyasaye osebedo kilando, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato riyore mondo odonjie.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

kikuyu: nyikwa Kiriath Jearim, Kefira kod Beeroth, ji mia abiriyo gi piero angʼwen gadek (743),
english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

kikuyu: Jomaler mondo oil kamiye duongʼ kendo giwer gimor ka gibet e kitandagi.
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Go dhok ne kit winy duto gi le mager duto, kiwachonegi ni, ‘Chokreuru duto kendo biuru kaachiel, kua kuonde duto ma untie, ne misango ma alosonu ma en misango maduongʼ manie gode mag Israel. Ubiro chamo ringʼo kendo ubiro madho remo kanyo.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

kikuyu: Ji nokuyo nikech Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo dhood Benjamin olal e kind dhout Israel.
english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Chandruok mamako ji gin ok yudgi kendo ok githagre kaka ji mamoko thagore.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

kikuyu: Geber wuod Uri norito Gilead (enie piny mane Sihon ruoth jo-Amor kod Og ruodh Bashan ne rito chon). En kende ema ne en jaduongʼ motelone gwengʼno.
english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

kikuyu: E ndalo mokadho Finehas wuod Eliazar ema ne jatend jorit rangach kendo Jehova Nyasaye nenikode.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

kikuyu: Yaye oganda ma joricho, koth ji mogangore gi timbe mamono, kanyakla mar joma timbegi richo, nyithindo mochiwore ne timbe acheje! Giseweyo Jehova Nyasaye; gisejaro Jal Maler mar Israel giselokone ngʼegi.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Lingʼ thi! Kik iwach gimoro amora. Dhi kodwa, kendo ibed wuonwa kendo jadolowa. Donge ber ka itiyone anywola kod dhoot Israel kaka jadolo moloyo mana tiyone jood ngʼato achiel?”
english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi mine girito liel ka giketo kido e kidi kendo negiketo jarito mondo orite.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

kikuyu: Kuonde ma yande pedo ema nitie, nonyag olemo mabeyo mag yiend obudo, kendo kar kudho ema ochwoga mamit nodongie. Mano nomi Jehova Nyasaye huma maduongʼ, to gi ranyisi manyaka chiengʼ ma ok nomuki.”
english: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for the LORD, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ma e ranyisi mar singruok ma atimo e kinda kodi kod gik mangima duto maun-go nyaka tiengʼ mabiro.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ne, anabed jakori kendo anakonyi e bura; anami nembe two kendo thidhna mage notwo.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

kikuyu: Kata mana janabi moro ma margi owuon osewacho niya, “Jo-Krete riambo kinde duto, gin ondiegi malich ma timbegi richo kendo gin jowuoro ma budho abudha.”
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Esau nodhi ir Ishmael mi okendo Mahalath nyamin Nebayoth mane nyar Ishmael wuod Ibrahim, mondo obed chiege ewi monde mane okwongo kendo.
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

kikuyu: Jatelo maduongʼ nomiyogi nying manyien machal kama: Daniel nochako ni Belteshazar; Hanania nochako ni Shadrak; Mishael nochako ni Meshak; to Azaria nochako ni Abednego.
english: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

kikuyu: Kapo ni asepando richona kaka dhano ohero timoga, kata ka akuot gi kethona e chunya,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

kikuyu: Eka Eliakim wuod Hilkia jatend od ruoth gi Shebna jagoro kod Joa wuod Asaf, jachan weche mag piny, nodhi ir Hezekia ka lepgi oyiech kendo negiwachone gima jatend lwenyno osewacho.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

kikuyu: E kindeno wabiro uso cham maricho e nengo maber, bangʼe wabiro ngʼiewo joma odhier e nengo marom, gi nengo mingʼiewogo pat pat mondo gibed wasumbini magwa.”
english: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”

kikuyu: Kata ka jo-Efraim nomanore gi gige lweny, to negiringo lweny.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Weche mawuok e dhoge richo kendo gin miriambo; oseweyo bedo mariek kod timo maber.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

kikuyu: To ka umoso mana oweteu kende to en angʼo mutimo moloyo joma moko? Donge kata jopiny bende timo kamano?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Ne asendikonu e barupa motelo ni kik ubedi e kanyakla mar joma terore.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

kikuyu: kendo obiro muomo piny Juda mi ochop koni gi koni kokadho e diere, kendo kopongʼ thich nyaka oulano nokwak pinyu duto, yaye Imanuel!”
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

kikuyu: To ka jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik noneno gik miwuoro mane otimo, kendo ka nyithindo kok ei hekalu niya, “Hosana ne Wuod Daudi,” chunygi nokethore.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

kikuyu: “Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye mosemiyo joge Israel kwe mana kaka nosingo. Onge kata mana wach achiel ma ok osechopo kuom gik moko duto mabeyo mane ochiwo kuom jatichne Musa.
english: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

kikuyu: Ne awacho ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “In e Ruodha; onge gima ber machielo ma an-go makmana in.”
english: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

kikuyu: An Paulo awuon ema andikonu mosni gi lweta awuon.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo bandha gope moro ni nyaka achule? Gik moko duto manie bwo polo gin maga.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne ok ginyal yie, mana kaka Isaya nowacho bende komachielo niya,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

kikuyu: Kata bed ni achiwo giga duto ma an-go ne jodhier, mi achiw ringra mondo owangʼ, to ka aonge gihera, to onge ohala mayudo.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Iye Abarim mi gibworo Dibon Gad.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

kikuyu: Dhahabu gi fedha itemo gi mach, to Jehova Nyasaye ema temo chuny.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

kikuyu: Mise ne oger gi kite madongo kendo ma nengogi tek maromo fut apar gabich kod fut apar gachiel gi nus.
english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto nochokore kanyakla ir Ruoth Solomon e kinde mag nyasi e dwe mar Ethanim, ma en dwe mar abiriyo.
english: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

kikuyu: Jodong gwengʼno, moro ka moro e dweye ne chiwo ni ruoth Solomon gi welo duto mane oluongo, maonge gimoro amora morem.
english: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

kikuyu: To negiwacho niya, “Kik watim kamano kinde nyasi, nono to ji ogomo.”
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

kikuyu: Lotan nonywolo Hori kod Homam. Timna ne en nyamin Lotan.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo dangʼo piende ma oko? Koso en ngʼa manyalo hoye mondo oket chuma e ume?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

kikuyu: We ngʼat moro ema opaki, to ok dhogi iwuon; ngʼato machielo, to ok lewi iwuon.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

kikuyu: “Chutho, jonabi duto, kochakore ndalo Samuel gi jonabi mane oluwo bangʼe kaachiel gi ji duto mane owuoyo, bende nokoro gik matinde timore ndaloni.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

kikuyu: Nyasacha nooro malaikane, momako dho sibuoche. Ok gisehinya, nikech noyud ka aonge ketho e nyime, to kata in, yaye ruoth, pok atimo gimoro amora marach e nyimi.
english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”

kikuyu: Kane Ahazia ruodh Juda oneno gima otimore noringo kotony gi yor Beth-Hagan. Jehu nolawe kakok niya, “En bende negeuru!” Ne gihinye ewi gache mar lweny koringo ochomo Gur man but Ibleam, to notony kodhi Megido kuma nothoe.
english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

kikuyu: To nowachona niya, “Donji e iye mondo ine gik maricho kendo makwero ma gitimo kanyo.”
english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

kikuyu: Eka ji duto noweye moringo odhi.
english: They all left him, and fled.

kikuyu: Chunya biro sungore kuom Jehova Nyasaye, joma nigi rem mondo owinji kendo obed mamor.
english: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jaro puonj biro yudo pokne, to ngʼat moluoro chik imiyo pok maber.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

kikuyu: To jatend lweny nodwokogi niya, “Uparo ni un kod ruodhu kendu ema ne ruodha oora iru mondo awachnu wechegi, to ok ne joma obedo ei ohinga; bende ungʼeyo ni jogo kaachiel gi un biro bangʼo chiethgi kendo madho lachgi?”
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

kikuyu: Umon gi gik mabeyo to uhero gik maricho; ukidho pien joga oko ka uyiecho ringʼo oko e chokegi.
english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

kikuyu: Ka ngʼatno ok owar e achiel kuom yorego, to en kaachiel gi nyithinde noweye thuolo e higa mar piero abich,
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

kikuyu: Obiro gologi e dich modigigo kendo e timbe mahundu, nimar okwano rembgi ka gima nengone tek.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

kikuyu: Gideon nodwoko niya, “Mago ne owetena, yawuot minwa owuon. Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni ka dine ingʼwononegi, to dine ok anegou.”
english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

kikuyu: Got Halak, machakore yo Seir, nyaka Baal Gad manie Holo mar Lebanon manie Got Hermon. Nomako ruodhigi duto mi onegogi.
english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

kikuyu: Kane Elisha ngʼat Nyasaye owinjo ni ruodh Israel oyiecho lepe, ne oorone wach kama, “Angʼo momiyo iseyiecho lepi? We ngʼatno obi ira kendo enongʼe ni nitie janabi e piny Israel.”
english: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼatno madwaro reso ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼatno mowito ngimane nikech an biro yude.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: Ne adwaro ngʼeyo gimomiyo ne gidonjone, omiyo ne atere e nyim jobuch jodong jo-Sanhedrin.
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

kikuyu: Noumogi gi boche polo kaka raum, kendo mach nochiwonegi ler gotieno.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

kikuyu: Koro awachonu niya, “Goluru chunyu oko e gik machon kendo weuru paro gik mosekadho.
english: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, ne giwangʼi kendo ket chunyi mondo ingʼe gik moko duto abiro nyisi, nikech mano emomiyo osekeli ka. Nyis jo-Israel gik moko duto mineno.”
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Mana kaka winyo mabayo moa e ode e kaka ngʼatno mabayo aa e dalane.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

kikuyu: Bende iwacho chutho ni in jatend muofni, kendo ni in e ler mar joma ni e mudho;
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, in Nyasaye! Wecheni ogen, kendo isesingo gik mabeyogi ni jatichni.
english: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

kikuyu: Kata ngʼat mofuwo ikwano ka ngʼat mariek ka olingʼ thi; kendo ka ngʼat mongʼeyo ka orito lewe.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Buya nyaka nyag e piny, kothe manyago cham kod yiende manyago olembe man-gi kuthe eigi kaka kitgi obet kendo nobedo kamano.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: kendo ji duto nohul ni Yesu Kristo en Ruoth, mondo Nyasaye Wuoro oyud duongʼ.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

kikuyu: Noloyo jo-Filistia chakre kuonde ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo nyaka dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno, mochopo nyaka Gaza gi mier mokiewo kode.
english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

kikuyu: Ok anayie nindo tera, kata ayula wangʼ lo wengena,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

kikuyu: Akish nowachone jotije niya, “Ngʼiuru ngʼatni en janeko! Angʼo momiyo ukele ira?
english: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye osetieko wuoyo kod Ibrahim, nowuok kendo Ibrahim nodok dala.
english: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ma e wach ma Jehova Nyasaye, mane oreso Ibrahim wachone od Jakobo ni, Jakobo ok none wichkuot kendo; bende ok ginichak ginenre mokuyo.
english: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

kikuyu: Negisiko ka gimanyo Yesu, kendo negipenjore ngʼato gi ngʼato, ka gichungʼ ei alwora mar hekalu niya, “Uparo nade? Donge obiro biro e sawoni koso ok obi biro?”
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

kikuyu: Nyathi maonge gi wuon iyudho oko e thuno; nyathi jadhier ma pod kwar imako kar gowi.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

kikuyu: Sunga ngʼato ema miyo opodho, to ngʼat ma chunye muol yudo pak.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

kikuyu: Ne ok ikonyo mon ma chwogi otho kendo nyithind kiye bende ne ithago.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni hekaluni koro nigi duongʼ, ji duto mabiro kadho bute nowuor kendo nohum ka gipenjo ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gima chalo kama ni pinyni kod hekaluni?’
english: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

kikuyu: to ok negiyudo ringre. Negidwogo kendo nyisowa ni negineno malaike moko mane ofwenyorenigi, manowacho ni ongima.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

kikuyu: Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

kikuyu: kethruok kod masira ni kamoro amora ma gidhiyoe,
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

kikuyu: Ne ok akeloni chiayo ma ondiek ochamo; to ne achulo chiayo mangima an awuon. Bende ne iketo ni achuli kuom gimoro amora mane okwal gotieno kata godiechiengʼ.
english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

kikuyu: Eka Gideon nodwoko niya, “Nikech gima uwacho, ka Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo Zeba gi Zalmuna e lweta, to abiro yuyo ringreu gi pedo kod matata.”
english: Gideon said, “Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

kikuyu: Yesu nochako owachonegi kendo niya, “Beduru gi kwe! Mana kaka Wuora oseora e kaka an bende aorou.”
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

kikuyu: Bepe mag sida manie puoth Nyasaye ne ok nyal pim kode, kata yiende mag obudo, ne onge gi bede madongo kaka mage; to bende onge yien moro amora makore poth moriere tir mane inyalo pim gi bedene, chutho, onge yath moro amora e puoth Nyasaye mane jaber moloye.
english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.

kikuyu: Ruoth noketonigi chiemo mar odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ moromogi kod kongʼo moa e mesane. Ne onego otieggi kuom higni adek bangʼe gichak tiyo ka ruoth.
english: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

kikuyu: kata gi piny, nimar en e raten tiende; kata gi Jerusalem, nikech en e dala maduongʼ mar Ruoth Maduongʼ.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Ne gin jongʼayi kendo negitimo gik mamono e nyima. Emomiyo ne ariembogi e nyima kaka useneno atimoni.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

kikuyu: nikech ok inijwangʼa ei liel, to bende ok niyie Ngʼati Maler ringre tow.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

kikuyu: Wer wende pak ne Jehova Nyasaye, mobet e kom lochne e Sayun; hul ni ogendini gik mosetimo.
english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

kikuyu: Emomiyo Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: “Achano kelo chandruok ne jogi maonge ngʼama notony. Ok unuchak uwuothi gi ngʼayi nikech enobed kinde mar masira.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.

kikuyu: Nooro kendo ngʼat mar adek, to ne gihinye ma giriembe oko.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kikuyu: ji duto nochokore kanyakla e laru manie e nyim kama iluongo ni Dhoranga Pi. Ne gikone Ezra, japuonj chik mondo okel Kitabu mar Chik mar Musa, ma Jehova Nyasaye ne osechiko jo-Israel.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

kikuyu: Teko mar dhano ema ni kode to wan to wan kod Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa makonyowa kendo kedonwa e lwenjewa.” Kendo ji nobedo gi chir kane giwinjo wach Hezekia ruodh Juda.
english: An arm of flesh is with him, but the LORD our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

kikuyu: Isaya nowachonegi niya, “Nyisuru ruodhu ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Kik ibed maluor kuom weche misewinjo, wechego ma ruodh Asuria oseyanyago.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

kikuyu: Giseringone ligangla, ne ligangla mowuodhi, ne atungʼ moywa kendo ne lweny mager.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

kikuyu: Dahero bedo kode ka mondo okonya kaeni kapod an e od twech nikech Injili.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

kikuyu: Weuru timbeu maricho; to upuonjru timbe mabeyo! Dwaruru tim makare, kendo jiwuru joma ithiro. Bende nyaka une ni nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho oyal buchegi e yo makare kare.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

kikuyu: mondo omi ji duto omany Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel gi ogendini duto miluongo gi nyinga, Ruoth Nyasaye mane omiyo,’
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

kikuyu: Kendo mad imiya baruwa ma aterone Asaf, ma jarit yiend bunge magi, mondo obi omiya sirni migerogo dhoranga dala maduongʼ mochomore gi hekalu kendo alosgo ohinga mar dala kod ot mabiro dakie?” To nikech lwet Nyasacha ma jangʼwono ne ni koda, ruoth noyie gi kwayona duto.
english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.

kikuyu: Nanwangʼo ni chikno, mane onego okel ngima, nolokore mokelo tho.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

kikuyu: To Nowa noyudo ngʼwono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Polo norieny ka mula ewiu, piny to nobed matek ka chuma.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

kikuyu: Inibed kingʼeyo ni nyithindi nobed mangʼeny, kendo nyikwayi nochal gi lum manie piny.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

kikuyu: To moko kuomgi nowacho niya, “Belzebub ruodh jochiende, ema ogologo jochiende.”
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka ngʼato ni kuom Kristo to en chwech manyien; gik machon osekadho, neuru, gik manyien osechopo!
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mawuotho gi ngʼama riek bedo mariek, to osiep joma ofuwo hinyore.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

kikuyu: (nikech chik ne ok nyal keto gimoro kare), kendo koro osekelnwa geno manyien maber moloyo chik machon-no, kendo kuom genono wasudo machiegni gi Nyasaye.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

kikuyu: Gilead en mara, Manase bende mara; Efraim en oguta mar lweny, to Juda en osimbona mar loch.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Miwa kony mondo walo wasikwa, nikech kony mar dhano onge tich.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: “Asedoko gima inyiero e dier osiepena, kata obedo ni an ngʼama kare kendo maonge ketho; to chon an ema ne Nyasaye winjo ywakna kendo dwoka!
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

kikuyu: Mad kwayona chopi e nyimi, resa kaluwore gi singruokni.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Wasigu ni oko gi ligangla; to tuoche kod kech ni e mier. Joma ni e gwengʼ noneg gi ligangla; to joma ni ei dala maduongʼ kech gi tuoche nonegi.
english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

kikuyu: Kane wuon mare osetho moike kaka kwerene, nochako ogero Elath moduoke ne jo-Juda.
english: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

kikuyu: Zedekia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gachiel kane obedo ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni apar gachiel. Min mare ne nyinge Hamutal nyar Jeremia; ma aa Libna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kikuyu: Yakuru fedha! Yakuru dhahabu! Mwandugi ngʼeny mokadho, gin mwandu mogol kuonde kenogi duto.
english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

kikuyu: Kuom kido duto mag winy, gi mag le, kod mag gik mamol e lowo ariyo ariyo nodonj kodi ei yie mondo ores ngimagi.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Johana nowuok e thim koyalo ni mondo ji oyud batiso kaka ranyisi ni giselokore gidwogo ir Nyasaye kendo oweyonegi richogi.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

kikuyu: Kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato moseweyo ode, kata owetene kata nyiminene, kata wuoro kata min, kata nyithindo, kata puothe nikech an, noyud gigo nyadi mia, kendo nocham ngima mochwere.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

kikuyu: E odiechiengno ne awachonu niya, “Un joma tekogi ohinga ma ok anyal tingʼo kenda.
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

kikuyu: Kudwaro nyiso ni uriek to mad koro ulingʼ alingʼa kar wuoyo!
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

kikuyu: An ema ne akwongo nyiso Sayun kawachone ni, ‘Ne, eri gin ka!’ Ne aoro jaote mondo oter wach maber Jerusalem.
english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Malaikano nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru uchungʼ ei hekalu mondo unyis ji weche duto kuom ngima manyien-ni.”
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

kikuyu: Jatichni osenego sibuor gi ondiek; ja-Filistia ma ok oter nyanguni, biro bedo achiel kuomgi nikech osejaro jolwenj Nyasaye mangima.
english: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”

kikuyu: Misango mare mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Ne ooro Eliakim ma jatend od ruoth, gi Shebna jagoro kod jodolo madongo ir janabi Isaya wuod Amoz ka giduto girwako piende gugru.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

kikuyu: kendo nooro agak kendo nosiko kohuyo koni gi koni nyaka pi notwo e piny.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

kikuyu: To nodwoko niya, “Neuru! Aneno ji angʼwen kawuotho koni gi koni e mach, ka gin thuolo kendo onge gima ohinyogi, kendo ngʼat mar angʼwen chalo gi wuod nyiseche.”
english: He answered, “Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed. The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.”

kikuyu: Nyaka wati tije mag Jal mane oora ka pod piny odiechiengʼ, nikech otieno biro maonge ngʼama nyalo tiyo.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

kikuyu: E odiechiengno Joshua nokawo Makeda. Notieko dala maduongʼno kod ruodhe gi ligangla kendo otieko ngʼato angʼata mane ni e iye. Onge ngʼama notony kanyo. Notimone ruodh Makeda mana kaka notimone ruodh Jeriko.
english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

kikuyu: nimar Nyasaye ok kel chandruok goyiem, kata mana kuyo ni nyithind ji.
english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

kikuyu: E kinde chakruok oro, e ndalo ma ruodhi thoro wuok kadhi kedo, Joab nowuok gi jolwenjgo momanore gi gige lweny. Ne omuko moketho piny jo-Amon bangʼe odhi Raba ma olwore gi jolweny, Daudi to nodongʼ Jerusalem. Joab nomonjo Raba moweyo kokethe chuth.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jakobo nochako kanyo ni Peniel (tiende ni wangʼ Nyasaye) kowacho niya, “Nikech aseneno Nyasaye wangʼ gi wangʼ kendo ngimana oresi.”
english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

kikuyu: Abner wuod Ner, kaachiel gi jo-Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo, nowuok Mahanaim mi gidhi Gibeon.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

kikuyu: Eka Balaam nodhi gi Balak nyaka Kiriath Huzoth.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Jodongo, yieru uraw e od jatichu mondo ulwok tiendeu kendo unindi eka kiny unyalo dhi gokinyi.” To negiwacho niya, “Ooyo, wabiro nindo mana e laru kae.”
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

kikuyu: To oganda mar jo-Israel mane oter e twech e piny Kanaan, nokaw pinyno nyaka chop Zarefath, kendo jo-Jerusalem manie twech, e piny Sefarad biro kawo miech Negev.
english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

kikuyu: Mad joma oluori dog jokora, kaachiel gi joma ongʼeyo bucheni.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

kikuyu: Negimuomore kuom gik moyaki, mine gikawo rombe, dhok, gi nyiroye, negiketogi piny migi yangʼogi kendo chamogi ka gitimo remo.
english: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.

kikuyu: Solomon nodwoko niya, “Isenyiso ngʼwono maduongʼ ni jatichni Daudi wuonwa nikech ne en ja-adiera kuomi kendo ne en ngʼama kare ma chunye odimbore. Bende pod inyise ngʼwono maduongʼno nyaka chil kawuono kendo isemiye wuowi mondo obedi e kome kawuononi.
english: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu nopenjo jogo niya, “Ere gima chikwa oyie mondo otim chiengʼ Sabato? Timo maber koso timo marach, reso ngima koso nego?” To jogo nolingʼ thi.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

kikuyu: Oseoro jotichne ma nyiri, kendo oluongo ji ka en kuonde motingʼore e dala maduongʼ.
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

kikuyu: kaponi adeko to ingʼe kaka ji onego owuothi e dier kanyakla mar jo-Nyasaye, ma en kanisa mar Nyasaye mangima, ma en e siro kendo mise mar adiera.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, okinyi mangʼich, mon-go notingʼo modhi mangʼwe ngʼar mane giseloso, ma gidhiyo e liel.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

kikuyu: Eka tho gi Piny Joma otho nowiti e ataro mar mach. Ataro mar mach en e tho mar ariyo.
english: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

kikuyu: Ochiewo aa e nindo ka pod piny mudho, ochiwo chiemo ne joode to moko omiyo nyiri matiyone.
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

kikuyu: Dwarona maduongʼ kod genona en ni ok anane wichkuot, to ni abiro bedo gi teko moromo mondo Kristo osik ka yudo duongʼ e ringra kaka pile, bed ni angima kata atho.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

kikuyu: Kik igen kuom mwandu moma ji kata isungri kuom gik mokwal; kata bed ni mwandugi medore to kik iket chunyi kuomgi.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo ochiw kaka chunye oyiero, ma ok oywago angʼe, kata nikech ochune, nimar Nyasaye ohero ngʼat ma chiwone ka mor.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nochoko jolwenjgi duto Afek, to jo-Israel to nojot but soko man Jezreel.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

kikuyu: Zeba gi Zalmuna nowacho niya, “Bi inegwa mana in iwuon nimar in e ngʼat maduongʼ maratego.” Omiyo Gideon nosudo machiegni kodgi monegogi, bangʼe nokawo pien mane ni e ngʼut ngamia mag-gi.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

kikuyu: Eka Menahem wuod Gadi nowuok koa Tirza modhi nyaka Samaria. Nomonjo Shalum wuod Jabesh ei Samaria monege kendo nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Wuon odgi nopenje niya, “Kawuono ne ihulo kanye? Ne itiyo kanye? Ogwedh ngʼat mane iyudo motimoni maberni!” Eka Ruth nonyiso wuon odgi kuom ngʼat mane otiyo e puothe chiengʼno. Nowacho niya, “Ngʼat mane atiyo e puothe kawono iluongo ni Boaz.”
english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, “The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo jo-Farisai ochokore kaachiel, Yesu nopenjogi niya,
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

kikuyu: Anaketh yiendene mag mzabibu gi yiend ngʼopene mane owacho ni ne chudone moa kuom joherane. Abiro ketogi bunge, kendo le mag bungu nokethgi.”
english: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.

kikuyu: nikech osiepna moro mane ni e wuoth osebiro lima to aonge gimoro ma anyalo keto e nyime mondo ocham.’
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

kikuyu: Bangʼe timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Jumbe ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom golo chiwo mar hera kupimo maromre gi gweth ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osegwedhougo.
english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo iwach ni Daudi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Aketo weche adek e nyimi. Yier achiel kuomgi monego atimni.’ ”
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

kikuyu: Kendo enolut lwete ei remono, mi okir moko nyadibiriyo e nyim pasia mar kama ler mar lemo mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Ogendini tieko tekone, to ok ofweny. Lwar okuorore e yie wiye, to ok ongʼeyo.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowachone Daudi niya, “Mad gwedhi wuoda Daudi; ibiro timo gik madongo adieri inilochi.” Bangʼ mano Daudi nodhi yore, to Saulo nodok dala.
english: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.

kikuyu: omiyo Jezebel nooro jaote ir Elija mondo owachne niya, “Mad nyiseche timna kata bedi ni en malit machalo nade ka kiny sa ma kama ok atimo ni ngimani machal gi achiel kuom jonabigo.”
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

kikuyu: “En mana kaka awachoni ni Nyasaye osenyiso Farao gima obiro timo.
english: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

kikuyu: Dechewa biro pongʼ gi kit mwandu duto. Rombewa biro medore gana gi gana, ee, gibiro bedo gana mathoth e lek magwa,
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

kikuyu: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoa,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, in ochot, winj wach Jehova Nyasaye!
english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear the LORD’s word:

kikuyu: Tarik achiel, dwe mar achiel, e higa mar piero ariyo gabiriyo, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirana kama:
english: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: To kit olemo ma ginyago ema ubiro ngʼeyogigo. Bende ji pono olemb mzabibu e yiend kudho, kata olemb ngʼowu kuom oriangʼ?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

kikuyu: Naaman, Ahija to gi Gera mane odarogi kendo ne en wuon Uza kod Ahihud.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne giwuok gidhi kama opondo ka gin kendgi giwegi e yie.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

kikuyu: Asa notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka Daudi wuon mare notimo.
english: Asa did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, as David his father did.

kikuyu: giduto gibiro monjou ne lweny. Jolwenjgi dhi nyime mana ka yamb piny motwo kendo gichoko joma otwe ka kwoyo.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

kikuyu: Nyipeche ma jo-Israel mane jotich Farao oyiero nigoyo kipenjogi niya, “En angʼo mosemonou loso matafare ndalo ariyogi kaka uloso pile?”
english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

kikuyu: Magi e ruodhi mane orito piny Edom kane jo-Israel ne pod onge kod ruodhi: Bela wuod Beor ma dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Dinhaba.
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

kikuyu: Kaw chudoni mondo idhi. An awuon ema ayiero mondo ami ngʼat mane ondiki achien mogik chudo maromre gi mari.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

kikuyu: Ndalona ni e lweti; resa e lwet wasika, kendo kuom joma lawa.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

kikuyu: “ ‘E odiechiengno, anakawi in Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel ma jatichna kendo anaketi ibed ruodh jogo, nikech in ema sani koro aseyieri.’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.”
english: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe to gikaw remo moko kendo giwirgo sirni mag dhoudi kod wi dhoudi.
english: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

kikuyu: Koro we walos singo e nyim Nyasachwa mondo oriemb mon-gi kod nyithindgi duto, kaluwore gi ngʼado rieko mar Ruoth Nyasachwa kod jogo moluoro chike mag Nyasachwa. We time kaluwore gi Chik.
english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

kikuyu: Kane Shishak ruodh jo-Misri omonjo Jerusalem, noyako mwandu hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi mwandu mag od ruoth. Nokawo gimoro amora kaachiel gi kuodi mag dhahabu mane Solomon ochuogo.
english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

kikuyu: Joma otegno to nyalo chamo chiemo motegno, nikech gisetiyo kodgi amingʼa mi gibedo gi lony mar fwenyo pogruok man e kind ber gi rach.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

kikuyu: Ji biro dar Gaza, kendo Ashkelon biro dongʼ gunda. Odiechiengʼ tir Ashdod ibiro weyo nono kendo Ekron ibiro pudh gi tiende.
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Agripa gi Ruoth Festo, nochungʼ kaachiel gi Bernike gi ji duto ma nobet kodgi.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

kikuyu: Sano sano nyakono nochungʼ malo mochako wuotho e dier ot (ne en ja-higni apar gariyo). Ji duto nohum nono kuom gima notimoreno.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

kikuyu: Eka Joab nodhi Geshur mi okelo Abisalom Jerusalem.
english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ne awinji e ndalona mag kech; chutho ne akonyi e odiechiengʼ mar warruok.” Awachonu ni, ma e sa mar Nyasaye mowinjore, ma e odiechieng warruok.
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

kikuyu: E higa mar ariyo mar loch Peka wuod Remalia ruodh Israel, Jotham wuod Uzia ruodh Juda nochako betie loch.
english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

kikuyu: Esau nokawo monde, yawuote, nyige kod joode duto kaachiel gi jambe duto kod mwandu duto mane oyudo Kanaan, kendo nodhi e piny moro mabor gi Jakobo owadgi.
english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

kikuyu: Nikech angʼeyo kethona duto kendo richona osiko e nyima.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasacha, para gi ngʼwono kuom gik masetimone jogi,
english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, koro chungʼ malo kendo idonj e kar yweyo,
english: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Musa niya, “Ka isetho to jogi biro dwanyore gi nyiseche mamoko manie piny ma udonjoe, kendo gibiro jwangʼa ma giwe singruok mane atimo kodgi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Koro abiro duogo Jakobo ka agole e twech kendo abiro bedo gi kech kuom jo-Israel duto; kendo ok nayie nyinga maler kethre.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Dwoguru ira, un joga maonge yie, nimar an e chworu. Abiro yierou ka ngʼato achiel oa e dala to ji ariyo koa e anywola mi akelu Sayun.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nochako birona kendo kopenjo niya, “En angʼo mineno?” Anto ne adwoke niya, “Aneno agulu mayienyo, kolokore oa yo nyandwat.”
english: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

kikuyu: mana ka ngʼama kech kayo to leko ni chiemo, to ka ochiewo to oyudo mana ka kech pod kaye, kendo mana kaka ngʼat ma riyo oloyo leko ni modho pi, to ka ochiewo to opodho mana piny ka riyo oloye. E kaka nobedi kuom ogendini mag pinje duto makedo gi Got Sayun.
english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

kikuyu: Igi nowangʼ kendo chunygi nokethore nikech jootego ne puonjo ji ni joma osetho biro chier kuom Yesu.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: kata jo-nyakalondo kata ajwoga kata ngʼat matiyo gi lang chunje maricho.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, Ibrahim noyudo wach niya, “Milka bende koro osenywolone owadu Nahor yawuowi ma gin:
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

kikuyu: kongʼado yo milambo mar Akrabim, modhi nyime nyaka Zin kendo ochopo yo milambo mar Kadesh Barnea. Eka nodhi nyaka Hazar Adar mi okal nyaka Azmon,
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

kikuyu: Asegeroni hekalu marahuma, kama inidagie nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo nool mo moko e pat lwete owuon ma koracham,
english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

kikuyu: En ngʼa man-gi masira? En ngʼa man-gi lit? En ngʼa man-gi lweny? En ngʼa man-gi ngʼur? En ngʼa man-gi adhonde ma ok owinjore? En ngʼa man-gi wangʼ makwar motimo remo?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

kikuyu: Beduru mangʼwon, mana kaka Wuonu ngʼwon.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

kikuyu: Jehoahaz ne ja-higni piero ariyo gadek kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom dweche adek.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare nigi ngima ma ok ocha; nyithinde nigi gweth bangʼe.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

kikuyu: In ma isungori nikech Chik ma in-go, dipo ikelo achaya ne Nyasaye kuom ketho Chik?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

kikuyu: Ka genowa kuom Kristo nigi tiende mana e ngimani kende, to kare wan joma odhierie moloyo ji duto.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

kikuyu: Notimo timbe maricho e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka wuon mare Manase nosetimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oneno wadgi katimo richo ma ok tere e tho, to owinjore olamne mondo Nyasaye omi ngʼatno ngima. Awuoyo kuom joma richogi ok tergi e tho. To nitie richo matero ji e tho; ma ok awach ni olamie Nyasaye.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

kikuyu: Rieko ber mana kaka girkeni, en gima ber kendo en ohala ne joma mangima.
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato moro amora dwaro hinyogi, to mach wuok e dhogi matieko wasikgi. Mano e kaka ngʼato moro amora madwaro hinyogi notho.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

kikuyu: Pile ka pile ne nitiere jo-Lawi auchiel marito rangach ma yo wuok chiengʼ, angʼwen e rangach ma yo nyandwat, angʼwen rangach ma yo milambo, to gi ariyo ariyo mane rito od keno.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

kikuyu: Mano e kar romb jogo mane oa e dhout anywola mar Gershon mane otiyo e Hemb Romo. Musa kod Harun nokwanogi kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.

kikuyu: To jalupni ma en Joshua wuod Nun ema nodonji e pinyno. Omiyo jiwe nikech en ema notelne jo-Israel duto ka kawo pinyno.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

kikuyu: luor wuonu gi minu,kendo her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.’”
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mofuwo yudo mor e timbe maricho, to ngʼat man-gi winjo bedo mamor kuom rieko.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

kikuyu: to keturu ngʼatni e lwet Satan mondo ringre mohero richono okethi, to chunye to mondo oresi chiengʼ biro Ruoth.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne gibano Hemb Romo, kendo joka Gershon kod joka Merari mane otingʼe, nochako wuoth.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

kikuyu: Mano to ngʼa mabiro koa e piny motimo ongoro koyiengore kuom jaherane? Nyako Ne achiewe e bwo yadh olemo mayom; kanyo ema ne minu omake ichni, kendo kanyo ema ngʼat mane muoch okayo nonywolie.
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

kikuyu: Un bende horeuru mos, kendo jiwuru chunyu, nikech Ruoth chiegni duogo.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Awachoni adier ni ok niwuog oko nyaka ichul faini duto monego ichul ma ok orem kata ndururu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
