kikuyu: Otieno mar apar gangʼwen ne pod watangni mana e dier Nam mangʼongo mar Mediterania. To kane ochopo odiwuor tir, to jokwangʼ ne paro ni gisechopo e lowo motwo.
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

kikuyu: Bi mondo ine ni Jehova Nyasaye ber; ngʼat ma pondo kuome ogwedhi.
english: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

kikuyu: Eka nokona niya, “Magi e ji ariyo mowir mondo otine Ruoth Nyasaye e piny ngima.”
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Timneuru Ai kod ruodhe mana kaka ne utimone Jeriko kod ruodhe, to wangʼni oyienu kawo gigo mane giyudo e yor mecho kaachiel gi jamni. Monjuru dala maduongʼno gi yo katoke.”
english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”

kikuyu: Winji, yaye piny: Akelo masira ne jogi, ma en olemo mar pachgi maricho, nikech gitamore winjo wechena, kendo gisedagi chikna.
english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

kikuyu: Gwedhuru joma kwongʼou lamuru ni joma sandou.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik uwe ngʼato ongʼadnu bura kuom gik muchamo kata mumadho, kata kuom weche mag sewni mag lemo, kata sewni mitimo ka dwe manyien owuok, kata chiengʼ Sabato.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

kikuyu: Emomiyo abiro mana kume to bangʼe aweye odhi.” [
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Nyaka karangʼo ma jasigu biro jarie, yaye Nyasaye? Ibiro yiene jasigu mondo oyany nyingi nyaka chiengʼ koso?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

kikuyu: Ithai wuod Ribai mawuok Gibea e piny Benjamin, Benaya ja-Pirathon,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

kikuyu: “To Ibrahim nodwoke ni, ‘Wuoda, parie ni e ndalo mar ngimani ne iyudo gik mabeyo, ka Lazaro to ne yudo gik maricho, to koroni oneno maber ka eri, to in inie rem malit.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: To abiro reso jomoko manok kuomgi e dho ligangla gi kech, kod masiche, mondo e pinje ma gidhiyego ginyis jogo timbegi duto mamono. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Ka Yesu nowinjo gima nosetimore, nowuok kanyo gi yie, ka en kende, modhi kama opondo ka gin kendgi giwegi. To kane oganda owinjo wachno, negia e mier machiegni mi giluwe ka giwuotho.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

kikuyu: “Yawuot Harun, ma gin jodolo, ema nogo turumbete. Ma en chik mosiko ne un kod tiengʼ mabiro.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho kendo ne Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mamayo wuon mare kendo riembo min mare en wuowi makelo wichkuot kod dwanyruok.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Joyarib ne en Matenai; koa e anywola Jedaya ne en Uzi;
english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

kikuyu: “Awacho niya, aa malo kaw pieni mondo idhi dala.”
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe negibiro Jeriko, to kane oyudo Yesu gi jopuonjrene kaachiel gi oganda maduongʼ aa e dalano, muofu moro miluongo ni Bartimayo (tiende ni “wuod Timayo”) nobet e bath yo ka okwecho.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

kikuyu: Nyakoni ne en jaber man-gi chia, mapok ongʼeyo dichwo! Nolor e soko, motwomo pi eka odwogo.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

kikuyu: Dhiyo, inyis Jeroboam ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel owacho, ‘Ne ayieri e kind ji duto mi aketi jatend joga Israel.
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

kikuyu: Gimoro amora morere e misangono nobed gima owal ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ka diponi remb misangono okirore e nanga, to nyaka lwoke e kama ler mar lemo.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

kikuyu: Koa kuom chiwo mar lalruok nyaka tim ne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep ma gin: boche moimo jamb-ich gi kuonde machiegni kode,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: Nonuru ane pinyno kaka chalo, mondo ungʼego ni joma odak kanyo gin thuondi koso ngoche, gingʼeny koso ginok?
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni wadak ei Nyasaye kendo en bende en eiwa, nikech osemiyowa Rohone.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kaw kendo ludheni mag kwath mondo ibed jakwath mofuwo.
english: The LORD said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

kikuyu: Kane dhako moa Tekoa odhi ir ruoth, nokulore nyaka e lowo auma mar miye luor, eka nowachone niya, “Konya, yaye ruoth!”
english: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

kikuyu: Jeroboam notho moyweyo gi kwerene, mane ruodhi mag Israel kendo Zekaria wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa mane ochoko nam kanyachiel moloro kuonde monyalo wuokgo kane obubni kowuok e bwo lowo?
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

kikuyu: Kapok agulni magi ochako winjo liet mach, bed ni en mach mabebni kata maliel mos, to joma timbegi richo ibiro ywe oko.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

kikuyu: kendo jo-Hori manie gode mag Seir, mane ochwe nyaka El-Paran machiegni gi piny motimo ongoro.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

kikuyu: ‘En ngʼa modongʼ e dieru mane oneno hekaluni kapod nigi duongʼne machon? Koro sani to uneno kochal nade? Donge ochalonu mana ka gima nono?’
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

kikuyu: Omiyo ne abiro mondo arom kodi, asemanyi to koro aseyudi!
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

kikuyu: Nitiere kit winjruok marach e kind jotelo manie pinyno machalo mana gi sibuor maruto to kidho le momako; ginego ji, gimayo ji mwandugi gi gig-gi mabeyo kendo gimiyo mon mangʼeny doko mon ma chwogi otho.
english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

kikuyu: Ne aorou mondo uka gima ne ok utiyone. Jomoko nono osetiyo tich matek moloyo, to un useyudo konyruok kuom tichgi matek.”
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruth nohulo e puodho nyaka odhiambo. Eka bangʼe notengʼo cham mar shairi mane osechoko, kendo ne oromo debe achiel.
english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

kikuyu: Aparo ni en gima ber mondo achiew pachu ka pod anie kiru mar ringruokni,
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

kikuyu: to nyaka giluok lwetgi gi tiendgi mondo kik githo. Mano nobedi chik mochwere momako Harun gi nyikwaye nyaka ni tienge duto mabiro.”
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Josef, ka koro nochiegni tho, nowuoyo kuom wuok mar jo-Israel ka gia piny Misri, mi nonyisogi gima nonego otim gi chokene.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

kikuyu: Eka nawacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto! Nyaka nene pok adwanyora kamano. Nyaka aa e tin-na pok achamo gima oyud kotho, kata ma le mag bungu okidho. Ringʼo mogak moro amora pok odonjo e dhoga nyaka nene.”
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

kikuyu: Kendo ji duto biro neno warruok mar Nyasaye.’ ”
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

kikuyu: Lemo mar Daudi. Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo dwoka, nimar adhier kendo achando.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

kikuyu: Ihero weche duto machwanyo ji, yaye in lep mohero wuondni!
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Adier ogendini chalo mana ka pi matin modongʼ e dapi; ee, gichalo mana ka buru momoko e ratil, opimo chula mag nembe e ratil mana ka buru mayom.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

kikuyu: Nowinjore kodgi ni nobiro chulogi dinari achiel ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom odiechiengʼno, eka noorogi e puothe mar mzabibu.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Un ema utimoru joma kare e wangʼ ji, to Nyasaye ongʼeyo chunyu. Gima okaw ni ber ahinya gi ji, kuom Nyasaye en gima kwero.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Ji nochungo ka ngʼicho, to jotelo mopogore opogore bende nojare. Negiwacho niya, “Ne oreso jomoko, koro oresre owuon ka en e Kristo mar Nyasaye, Jalno Moyier.”
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

kikuyu: Negikelone kanyna gi nyathi kanyna, kendo negiketo lepgi e ngʼegi, mi Yesu nobet kuomgi.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

kikuyu: Ne ok ungʼiewona gimoro amora mangʼwe ngʼar, bende ne ok udhila gi boche mag misengini. To richou kende ema ne tura, kendo ne uola mana gi kethou.
english: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼatno en jachan, to kik iwe gire mosingonino nindi e odi.
english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

kikuyu: Negineno tije Jehova Nyasaye, negineno tijene malich miwuoro manie kude.
english: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

kikuyu: Eka nawacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, giwuoyo kuoma kagiwacho ni, ‘Donge owuoyonwa mana gi ngeche?’ ”
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ kurito chike duto ma amiyou kawuononi, mondo omi ubed mangima kendo unyaa mi udonji e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye nosingore ni nomi kwereu.
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Saulo nosea lawo jo-Filistia, nowachne niya, “Daudi nitie e Thim En Gedi.”
english: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

kikuyu: Kane higano orumo, negidok ire e higa moluwo mano mi giwachone niya, “Ruoth ok wanyal wuondoreni nikech pesawa oserumo kendo jambwa bende osedoko magi, koro onge gima wanyalo miyi makmana ringrewa kod lopewa.
english: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

kikuyu: Un joma muofnigi! Mane maduongʼ: Chiwo koso kendo mar misango mamiyo chiwo bedo gima owal?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

kikuyu: Kendo niya, “Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye un joma ok jo-Yahudi duto, ee ji duto mondo odende,”
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

kikuyu: Zelek ja-Amon, Naharai ja-Beeroth mane jatingʼ gige lweny mag Joab wuod Zeruya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nobiro mochungʼ kanyo moluongo kaka nosebedo kotimo, “Samuel! Samuel!” Samuel nowachone niya, “Wuo nikech jatichni winjo.”
english: The LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

kikuyu: nimar e kinde mane oganda ongʼanyo e sokni mantiere e Thim mar Zin, un duto ne ok urito chikna kendo nyiso oganda ni an Ngʼama Ler.” (Magi ne sokni mag Meriba Kadesh, mantiere e Thim mar Zin.)
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

kikuyu: Eka Josef nowacho ne owetene kod jood wuon mare duto niya, “Abiro dhi mondo awuo gi Farao kendo abiro wachone ni, ‘Owetena kod jood wuora duto mane odak e piny Kanaan osebiro ira.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

kikuyu: Joma ywak gin joma ogwedhi, nimar ibiro hoyogi.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

kikuyu: mondo an bende awinjie maber gi mwandu mimiyo jogi miyiero, mondo ayudie mor mar ogandani, kendo amiyi duongʼ kaachiel gi girkeni mari.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

kikuyu: Ruodhi kane onena to ne wuoyo gi dwol mapiny kendo onge ngʼama ne nyalo winjo gima negiwacho.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

kikuyu: Isemiyo osiepena mane ni machiegni koda mogik oringa, kendo isemiyo koro achalonegi mana koko. Odinna ma ok anyal tony;
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nobed malit ne joma chano timo richo, ka giriere e kitendinigi! Gokinyi ka chiengʼ wuok to gichopo chenrogi nikech gin gi teko mar timo kamano.
english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

kikuyu: Kel Harun kod yawuote e dho Hemb Romo kendo ilwokgi gi pi.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Ginibedni kaka kondo michwowo e wiyi, kendo kaka thiwni miketo e ngʼuti mondo ineri maber.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

kikuyu: Kane Husham otho, Hadad wuod Bedad mane oloyo jo-Midian e piny jo-Moab nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Avith.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, Yesu nodhi nyaka loka machielo mar Nam Galili (tiende ni Nam Tiberia),
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata ma iyudo gi nyisechegi ok nokwo. E nyim jowagi, rang in iwuon giri moro amora madabedgo kendo ka iyudo to kaw.” To Jakobo ne ok ongʼeyo ni Rael nosekwalo nyisechego.
english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

kikuyu: “Tim ne Harun kod yawuote gik moko duto masechiki, ka ikawo ndalo abiriyo mondo iwalgi kaka jodolo.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

kikuyu: Ahiti biro koa kuma opandee, kendo koyo mangʼich bende yamo riembo mi ke.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

kikuyu: Ere ber ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare to ngimane to olalne?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

kikuyu: Nyar Farao nowachone niya, “Kaw nyathini mondo ipidhna bangʼe abiro chuli.” Omiyo dhakono nokawo nyathino kendo norite.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.

kikuyu: kibaji kod kihondko biro biro kuomgi. Kuom teko mar lweti gibiro lingʼ thi ka kidi, nyaka ogandani kadhi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka jogi mane ichweyo kadhi.
english: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, LORD, until the people you have purchased pass over.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Magi duto aserito nyaka aa rawera.”
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

kikuyu: Kane gisea e kama owal mi gidwogo e dala, Samuel nowuoyo gi Saulo ka gin kode ewi ode malo.
english: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Peka ruodh Israel, Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh Asuria nobiro mokawo Ijon, Abel Beth Maaka, Janoa, Kedesh kod Hazor. Noloyo Gilead kod Galili kaachiel gi piny Naftali duto, kendo oterogi e twech e piny Asuria.
english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

kikuyu: Kit lemo ma Nyasaye Wuonwa oyiego ni ler kendo onge ketho en mondo wakony nyithi kiye gi mon ma chwogi otho e chandruokgi, kendo mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato oritre kik timbe maricho mag piny ywaye.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

kikuyu: Kidi mane jogedo odagi koro osedoko kidi moriwo kor ot;
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi nyamin wuon, ngʼatni okuodo wi wuon mareno, omiyo nyaka giyud kum, kendo mondo oneg-gi ma nying-gi lal chuth e dier ogandagi.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

kikuyu: Ka misumba obiro mopondo iru kik udwoke ne ruodhe.
english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

kikuyu: Bende, ka ngʼat makare oweyo timbene mabeyo motimo richo, kendo ka aketo rachwany e nyime, to enotho. To nikech ne ok ikwere, enotho nikech richone owuon. Gik mabeyo mosetimo ok nopar, to rembe to naketi e wiyi.
english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

kikuyu: Kata mana sani koro osepondo e bur moro kata mana kamachielo; kipo ni en ema okwongo omonjo jogi, ngʼato angʼata mowinjo wachno biro wacho ni, ‘Oseneg jolweny mag Abisalom.’
english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

kikuyu: Naparo e chunya ni, ‘Higa ema mondo owuo; kendo dak amingʼa e piny ema mondo opuonj rieko!’
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

kikuyu: to e dir Zadok, jo-Tekoa ema nogedoe. To jodong-gi ne ok oyie tiyo tich mane ruoth omiyogi.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

kikuyu: E dir Pedaya, jo-Tekoa nogero kamachielo, kochakore gi kama otingʼore gi malo nyaka e ohinga mar Ofel.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

kikuyu: Bende nonyise pek mar dhahabu molosgo gige dhahabu monego tigo e tije mopogore opogore, to gi pek mar fedha molosgo gige fedha monego tigo tije mopogore opogore kaka:
english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ne joge kendo nobed gi kech ne jotichne koneno, ka tekogi orumo kendo onge manodongʼ obed misumba kata ngʼa man thuolo.
english: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘En ngʼa mabiro hoyo Ahab mondo oked gi jo-Ramoth Gilead kendo onege kuno?’ “To ngʼato ka ngʼato nochiwo pache.
english: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

kikuyu: To ngʼat mohero Nyasaye, to Nyasaye ongʼeyo.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

kikuyu: Negipenjore kendgi niya, “En ngʼa motimo ma?” Kane ginono matut, nowachnegi niya, “Gideon wuod Joash ema osetimo ma.”
english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”

kikuyu: otimo kamano mondo olok dhano owe timbene maricho kendo ogengʼ dhano kik sungre,
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

kikuyu: Eka gima Nyasaye nomiyo janabi Jeremia owacho nochopo kare:
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

kikuyu: To nikech jo-Amalek kod jo-Kanaan odak e kuonde mag holo, dwoguru kiny kendo udhi e thim mantiere e yo mochiko Nam Makwar.”
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ, kane koro osengʼeyo ni gik moko duto osetimore kaka dwarore, mondo Ndiko ochop kare, Yesu nowacho niya, “Riyo oloya.”
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

kikuyu: Omiyo chikuru itu maber! Weuru joweteu ma usemako odogi nimar mirima mager osemako Jehova Nyasaye nikech un.”
english: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of the LORD is on you.”

kikuyu: Bilha ma jatich Rael nochako omako ich kendo nonywolo ne Jakobo wuowi mar ariyo.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

kikuyu: Pok mar adek ne mar Zakur gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Donge koro giriere piny e dier jokedo mamoko ma ok oter nyangu mosepodho, ma osedhi e bur kaachiel gi gigegi mag lweny, kendo makoro osepiel wiyegi e liganglagi? Kum mar richogi koro omako nyaka chokegi, kata obedo ni mbi mag jolwenygi ne olandore e piny joma ngima duto.
english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Joga biro iri, kaka gihero timo, kendo gibet e nyimi mondo giwinj wecheni, to ok gitim gik miwachonegi. Gihulo gi dhogi kaka gin joma ochiwore ne Nyasaye, to chunygi to owuor ne gik mimayo ji.
english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda duto gi mondegi gi nyithindgi kod nyithindgi matindo nochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

kikuyu: Ewi got moro yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jerusalem, Solomon nogero kama otingʼore gi malo ni nyasach dwanyruok mar Moab miluongo ni Kemosh kod nyasach dwanyruok mar jo-Amon miluongo ni Molek.
english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Ne ibaro nam makwar ka gineno, mondo ne mi gikal kama otwo, makmana jogo mane lawogi ne inyumo e bwo nam, mana kaka kidi modir e ataro mar pi.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

kikuyu: to ok onego chwade del moloyo piero angʼwen. Ka ochwade moloyo mano, to wadu diyud wichkuot e wangʼe.
english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

kikuyu: Yawuowi gin gweth moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye, adier, nyithindo gin mich moa kuome.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

kikuyu: Yawuot Beria ne gin: Heber kod Malkiel nonywolo Birzaith,
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

kikuyu: “E kinde mane jamni mathuondi dwaro luwo jamni mamon, naleko ni nywogi duto mane oluwo jamni mamon ne gin mago man-gi kido marabok gi mago man-gi kido marangʼech kod mago man-gi kido mopogore opogore.
english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

kikuyu: Nimar in ema isegolo chunya e tho, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wengena bende isereso e ywak, kendo tiendena isegengʼo mondo kik okier,
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

kikuyu: Zikri thuon Efraim nonego Maseya wuod ruoth kod Azrikam jatelo mane ochungʼ ne od ruoth kod Elkana mane jalup ruoth.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

kikuyu: Ne alose malongʼo kendo mapichni gi bede mogundho, mi nodoko yath ma yedhe duto mag Eden, puoth Nyasaye timogo nyiego.
english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’

kikuyu: Eka jotelo nowach kendo niya, “Bende ngʼato nitie ka man-gi luoro kata ma chunye ool? Onego odog dala mondo owetene bende kik chunygi ool.”
english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

kikuyu: Kane jotij Saulo onyiso Daudi wechego nobedo mamor bedo or ruoth. Kane kinde moket pok orumo,
english: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nogolo chik niya, “Kawuru Mikaya kendo utere ir Amon jatend dala maduongʼ kendo ir Joash wuod ruoth,
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

kikuyu: Ne iluongo ka in e chandruok mi akonyi, ne adwoki gi ei boche polo, kendo ne atemi e tie pige mag Meriba. Sela
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

kikuyu: Ere ngʼat manyalo siro mirimbe? Koso en ngʼa manyalo siro mirimbe mager? Mirimbe mager oolo mana ka mach. Lwendni barore e nyime.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno noa malo mokawo piene mi nowuotho ayanga ka ji duto nene. Timni nomako dho ji duto mane ni kanyo mine gidendo Nyasaye kagiwacho niya, “Nyaka ne nywolwa pok waneno gima kama.”
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

kikuyu: Kane giseketo jodongo e kanisa ka kanisa, mi gilamonegi ka gitweyo chiemo, negiketogi e lwet Ruoth Yesu mane giseyie kuome.
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Dwol winjore Rama, ka goyo nduru, kendo ywak malich, Rael ywago nyithinde kendo odagi ni ok nyal hoye, nikech gisetho.”
english: The LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.”

kikuyu: Abiro chungʼ kara mar rito kendo abiro bedo ewi kuonde moger motingʼore mag rito. Abiro ngʼicho mondo ane gima obiro wachona, kendo kuom dwoko mabiro chiwo kuom ywagni.
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

kikuyu: Ayiuru buta, un duto ji matimo richo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osewinjo ywakna.
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

kikuyu: Magdiel kod Iram. Magi ema ne jodong Edom, kaluwore gi dakgi e piny mane gikawo kaka margi. Ma e chal Esau, kwar jo-Edom.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo noluongo yawuote mowachonegi niya, “Biuru machiegni mondo anyisu gima biro timorenu e ndalo mabiro.
english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

kikuyu: Kawuru tingʼ mag jowadu, nikech kutimo kamano eka uchopo chik Kristo.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kikuyu: Mad herani ma ok rem bina, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mad warruokni bina kaluwore gi singruokni.
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

kikuyu: “Ka dibed ni nitie achiel kuomu man-gi jatich mapurone kata makwayo rombe. Dowachne jatichne koa e puodho ni, ‘Bi koroni kendo ibed piny mondo ichiem’?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

kikuyu: kendo negikelo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye gi Hemb Romo kod gik moko duto maler mane ni e iye. Jodolo kod jo-Lawi notingʼogi,
english: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼat mochwoyo kata ngʼat moolo pi ok en gimoro, makmana Nyasaye, mamiyo gik moko dongo.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

kikuyu: Dwogwa iri, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye Maratego; mi wangʼi orienynwa, eka mondo wayud warruok.
english: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowacho niya, “Kelnauru gima itimogo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok.” Kendo Saulo nochiwo misango miwangʼo pep.
english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

kikuyu: Ne joma noketo genogi kuomgi giwegi maparo ni gin joma kare kendo mane ochayo ji mamoko duto, Yesu nogoyonegi ngero kama:
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

kikuyu: to iwinjgi gi e polo kendo iwe richo jogi Israel kendo iduog-gi e piny mane imiyogi kod kweregi.
english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo jadolo nyaka non kama ilnino, kendo ka pod ok omedore kendo odholore, to jadolo nowach ni ngʼatno ler. Ngʼatno nyaka luok lepe eka nobed maler.
english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

kikuyu: Jodong Edom kibaji biro goyo, bende jotend Moab biro tetni, to jo-Kanaan chunygi biro nyosore;
english: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

kikuyu: Mad olok chunywa ire, mondo wawuoth e yorene duto kendo wamak chikene gi puonjne kod buchene mane omiyo kwerewa.
english: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Ligangla mar ruodh Babulon biro lwar kuomi.
english: For the Lord GOD says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.

kikuyu: Nimar ondiki e chik Musa niya, “Kik utwe dho dhiangʼ kaywayo lodi ma idinogo cham.” Uparo ni wach rwedhi ema ne chando chuny Nyasaye koso?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

kikuyu: wasikgi ma noloko chunygi mondo ocha joge, kendo noketo chunye mar timo ne jotichne marach.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Musa nochungo thuol e thim, e kaka Wuod Dhano bende ibiro chungo,
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

kikuyu: Kik ihang wach ne wadu.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

kikuyu: Eka Balaam nohulo ote moa kuom Nyasaye kama: Aa malo, Balak, kendo ichik iti; winja, wuod Zipor.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

kikuyu: To ka oseluok law kata usi mochwe, kata law motwangʼ, kata pien ma chilono orumo, to nyaka chak lwoke kendo eka enobed maler.”
english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Gin mag Kaisar.” Eka nowachonegi niya, “Miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.”
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Samuel nodwoke niya, “Iparo ni Jehova Nyasaye mor gi chiwo kod misengini miwangʼo pep moloyo winjo dwonde? Winjo wach ber moloyo chiwo misango kendo chiko it ber moloyo boche imbe,
english: Samuel said, “Has the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the LORD’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.

kikuyu: Bende chir ma un-go sani biro siko, kata bedeu bende biro siko kotegno, chiengʼ ma anabi mondo akumu? An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kendo abiro timo kamano.
english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken it, and will do it.

kikuyu: Ka nyalore, to temuru mondo udag gi kwe gi ji duto.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

kikuyu: To joma johawi moloyogi duto, gin jogo ma pod ok onywol, ma pod ok oneno richo mitimo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

kikuyu: Emomiyo tiuru ka luoro mar Nyasaye ni kodu. Ritreuru ka ungʼado bura nimar kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa onge tim marach kata dewo wangʼ kata chulo asoya.”
english: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Modhi, ruodha” kendo mapiyo nono noloro dapi e lwete momiye pi omodho.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: ka moro ka moro kochom kuom nyawadgi ma kata mana muya ok nyal kadho e kindgi.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

kikuyu: To odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, kogwen, kane piny pod olil, Maria ma aa Magdala nodhi e liel, mi noneno ka kidi osengʼiel oko e dho lielno.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

kikuyu: Nogo ombulu kaluwore gi anywolagi, jomatindo gi jomadongo machalre mondo oyud jorit rangeye.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

kikuyu: nikech riwruok maru kodwa e tij lando Injili chakre odiechiengʼ mokwongo nyaka koroni,
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

kikuyu: Kane ongʼiyo malo, Yesu noneno ka jo-mwandu keto chiwogi e kar chiwo mar hekalu.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

kikuyu: E wiye malo malaike miluongoni serafi ochungʼe kamoro ka moro nigi bwombe auchiel ka bwombe ariyo giumogo wengegi, to bwombe ariyo mamako giumogo tiendegi, to bwombe ariyo modongʼ gihuyogo.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ja-adiera ibiro gwedho mangʼeny, to ngʼat madwaro gi teko bedo ja-mwandu ok notony ma ok okume.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Wer mower gi maskil. Ogwedh ngʼat ma kethone owene, kendo ma richone oseruchi.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nokelo rech marangʼongo mondo omwony Jona, kendo Jona nenie ei rechno kuom ndalo adek odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: The LORD prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

kikuyu: Wigi nowil gi wichkuot margi kod ketho duto mane gikethonago kane gidak gi kwe e pinygi kaonge ngʼama bwogogi.
english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid

kikuyu: Rachungi ka rachungi ne nigi ramaki angʼwen e kona ka kona molos koa e rachungi.
english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

kikuyu: Nochungʼ molingʼ thi, to ne ok anyal ngʼeyo ni en angʼo. Kido moro nobiro mochungʼ e nyim wangʼa, kendo nawinjo dwol moro machil, kawacho niya:
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “To gin bende ginidwok ni, ‘Ruoth, ne waneni karangʼo kidenyo, kata ka riyo oloyi, kata ka in wendo, kata kichando lewni, kata kituo, kata ka in e od twech, to ne ok wakonyi?’
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

kikuyu: Mad ngʼad ndalone dok manok; kendo mad ngʼat machielo kaw tije.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

kikuyu: Negineno gik machalo gi ligek mach, mane opiyo ewi ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo ji doko manok moloyo dhahabu mopwodhi, manok mana ka dhahabu ma aa Ofir.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Azarel, Shelemia, Shemaria,
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

kikuyu: ngamia mamon piero adek gi nyithindgi, dhok mamon piero angʼwen kod rwedhi apar, kod punde mamon piero ariyo kod punde machwo apar.
english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nodhi ire mochiewe, kagiwachone niya, “Ruoth, Ruoth, wabiro nimo!” Nochungo oa malo kendo nokwero yamo gi apaka mager mi ahiti nopie kendo gik moko duto nokwe.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noneno ni ler ber, kendo ne opogo ler kuom mudho.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

kikuyu: Eka ne wagoyonegi oriti, bangʼe wadonjo e yie, ka gin to gidok miechgi.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

kikuyu: Koro buche mane owitoe ringre chwo duto mane osenego kaachiel gi Gedalia ne en mano mane Ruoth Asa oloso kaka kar pondone kane okedo gi Baasha ruodh Israel. Ishmael wuod Nethania nopongʼe gi ringre joma otho.
english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (this was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

kikuyu: Ne ungʼur e hembeu ka uwacho niya, Jehova Nyasaye ok dwarwa, omiyo nogolowa e piny Misri mondo ochiw-wa e lwet jo-Amor mondo otiekwa.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

kikuyu: Jawasigu nosungore kawacho niya, “Abiro lawogi, abiro jukogi. Abiro pogo mwandugi; abiro yako gimoro amora. Abiro golo liganglana kendo lweta biro tiekogi.
english: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’

kikuyu: Mon ariyo noyudi karego e pongʼ lwedo; achiel nokaw to machielo nowe.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: To kaw yier moko matin itwe e riak lawi.
english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

kikuyu: Dishon nonywolo: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran kod Keran.
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

kikuyu: Dengi, yaye in rangach! Go nduru, yaye in dala maduongʼ! Beduru gi bwok maduongʼ, un jo-Filistia. Rumbi mar iro biro kowuok yo nyandwat kendo onge kata ngʼato achiel madigni kuomgi.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

kikuyu: Abiro pako timni makare kendo kuom pakni duto odiechiengʼ duto.
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

kikuyu: To kane giwuok e pi, Roho Maler mar Ruoth Nyasaye nokawo Filipo apoya, mi ja-Ethiopiano ne ok ochako onene kendo to nodhi e wuodhe kopongʼ gi mor.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

kikuyu: Negidok ma giwachone Jehu wachno, mane owacho niya, “Ma e wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kokadho kuom jatichne Elija ja-Tishbi: E puodho manie paw Jezreel guogi nokidh ringre Jezebel.
english: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat madwaro chulo kuor olawe, to kik gichiw ngʼatno modonjne, nikech ne onego nyawadgino ka ok ochano kendo ka oonge gi paro mar nege.
english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

kikuyu: Jotich Naaman nodhi ire mokwaye niya, “Wuonwa, kapo ni janabi dine okwayi mondo itim gik matek, donge dine itimogi? To koro ka owacho mana niya, ‘Dhi ilwokri mondo ichangi ibed mapoth’!”
english: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

kikuyu: Osechungonwa tungʼ mar warruok marwa, e od jatichne Daudi,
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

kikuyu: Bangʼe nawinjo dwol moro kawachona ni, ‘Petro, aa malo, mondo ineg gimoro kuom gigo icham.’
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

kikuyu: mi owachone niya, “Jotichni osekwano kar romb jolweny man e lwetwa, kendo onge kata achiel kuomgi molal.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

kikuyu: An Paulo, andikonu mosni gi lweta awuon. Kik wiu wil kod twechna e od twech. Ngʼwono obed kodu.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Ochal gi koth karadali ma en e kodhi matinie mogik mikomo e puodho.
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

kikuyu: Mosreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gi yogruok mar hera. Kwe mondo obed kodu un duto ma un kuom Kristo.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Abiro nego dhano duto masechweyo e wangʼ piny kaachiel gi le kod gik mamol duto kod winy mafuyo e kor polo nimar dine ber ka dine ok achweyogi.”
english: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

kikuyu: Gichomo liete mokuny nigi mana kaka rombe kendo tho biro lokogi chiembe. Joma ngimagi oriere tir biro loyogi ka piny oru, to dendgi biro towo e liete, ka gin mabor gi utegi madongo machalo ute ruodhi.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isejwangʼo jogi, jogi ma nyikwa Jakobo. Gipongʼ gi timbe mag mudho kod timbe mag jwok moa yo wuok chiengʼ, gitimo timbe jwok ka jo-Filistia, kendo gin e winjruok gi joma ok oyie.
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

kikuyu: Koro Saulo nowinjo ni osefweny kuma Daudi gi joge nitie. To Saulo noyudo obet piny e tiend yath moro ewi got man Gibea kotingʼo tongʼ e lwete kolwore gi jodonge.
english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

kikuyu: Zaburi. Wer mar gwedho hekalu. Zaburi mar Daudi. Abiro tingʼi malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ne igola e bur matut, kendo ne ok iyiene wasika mondo obed mamor kuoma.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi ni, ‘An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Negiloso tungʼ e konde angʼwen mag kendono, mondo omi tungego kod kendo mar misango obed gimoro achiel, kendo ne gimuono kendo mar misangono gi mula.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

kikuyu: Elishama, Eliada kod Elifelet.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Nyasaye mobet e kom loch nyaka chiengʼ, biro winjogi kendo biro goyogi: Sela jogo motamore loko yoregi kendo ma ok mi Nyasaye luor.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

kikuyu: Ne opimo dho ohinga mochomo ei rangach moyudo ni lachne en fut piero adek gauchiel. Pimono nochopo nyaka ewi agola momanyore gi laru.
english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni giriek dine gingʼeyo tiend gik matimore ma gifwenyo kaka giko margi biro bet.
english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

kikuyu: Onywolo tonge piny e lowo kendo oweyogi ewi kuoyo mondo giyud liet,
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

kikuyu: “To kwerewa notamore winjo wachne. Kar timo mano, to ne gikwede kendo chunygi nogombo dok Misri.
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

kikuyu: “Kuom herani ma ok rum, ibiro telone oganda ma isereso. Kuom tekoni ibiro telonegi nyaka kar dakni maler.
english: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

kikuyu: Kikombe Farao ne ni e lweta, kendo nakawo olembe mag mzabibu mi abiyogi e kikombe mar Farao kendo aketo kikombe e lwete.”
english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

kikuyu: Donge Ibrahim kwarwa ne Nyasaye okwano kaka ngʼama kare kuom gima notimo kane ochiwo wuode ma Isaka ewi kendo mar misango.
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyako kaachiel gi min-gi. Kik iterri gi nyakware ma ka wuode kata maka nyare, nikech gin wede dhakono. Mano en tim anjawo.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

kikuyu: Fuwo moro ngʼat maonge gi rieko, to ngʼat man-gi winjo wuotho moriere tir.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

kikuyu: Ka owete odak kanyakla kae to moro otho kaonge wuowi, to ngʼat moro nono ma ok ja-dalano ok onego kend chiegeno. Owadgi chwore hie ema mondo okawe okende mondo otimne gik moko duto ma yuoro onego otimne chi owadgi.
english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

kikuyu: Wuogi ka ikudho, in yamb nyandwat, bende in yamb milambo kudhi! Kudhi e puotha, mondo tikne okere malach. We jaherana koro obi odonji e puothe kendo obil olembene moyiedhi kendo mamit.
english: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.

kikuyu: Ket Makati miketo e nyima pile ewi mesano ndalo duto.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

kikuyu: To janabi motino nodwoke niya, “An bende an janabi mana kaka in. Kendo malaika nowuoyo koda gi wach Jehova Nyasaye kawachona ni, ‘Duog kode e odi mondo mi ochiem kendo omodh pi.’ ” To kata kamano nowuonde.
english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

kikuyu: Uparo ni batiso Johana noa e polo koso noa kuom dhano? Nyisaneuru!”
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

kikuyu: To aneno ni masiche mwaneno ndalogi tin ma ok dipim gi duongʼ mabiro fwenyorenwa.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

kikuyu: E ndalono abiro menyo Jerusalem gi teche ka akumo joma odak kanyo madhi nyime gi timo timbe maricho, ma gin joma chalo mana gi divai mawach; ka giparo ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye ok notim gimoro amora maber kata marach.’
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

kikuyu: Ginine malit jogo maparo timo gimoro amora mondo gipandgo timbegi ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma gin joma timo timbegi e mudho ka giparo niya, “Ere ngʼama nenowa? En ngʼa mabiro ngʼeyo?”
english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

kikuyu: Kane Naomi oneno kaka Ruth noketo chunye mar dhi kode, noweyo chune.
english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo, nonwangʼo Eli kobet e kome e dir yo, ka orito nimar luoro nomake nikech Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye. Kane ngʼatno odonjo e dala mowacho gima ne osetimore, ji duto mane ni ei dala nomuoch gi nduru.
english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

kikuyu: “Nyisgi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kama: ‘Oteni oor ne wuod ruoth man Jerusalem kod oganda mar dhood Israel duto man kanyo.’
english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

kikuyu: Eka wengegi noyepo kendo negifwenyo ni gin duge; kuom mano negikawo it ngʼowu kendo giumogo dugegi.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

kikuyu: koa kuom Shufam, joka Shufam; koa kuom Hufam, joka Hufam.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

kikuyu: Kitego ne gin tich Nyasaye; kendo ndiko mane ni kuomgi ne mar Nyasaye.
english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

kikuyu: Nathan nowachone niya, “Bende in ruodha isechiko ni Adonija biro bedo ruoth bangʼi kendo ni obiro bedo e kom duongʼ?
english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw yiende moko mag sida, owino gi usi marakwaro kendo owitgi kuom nyaroya ma wangʼno.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro temo matek mondo ane ni ka aseweyou to ubiro siko kuparo wechegi.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

kikuyu: Kik utingʼ kit pesa moro amora, kaka dhahabu kata fedha kata mula, e kambau mutweyo;
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

kikuyu: Gikidho jogi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; gidiyo girkeni mari.
english: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

kikuyu: E Got Hor machiegni gi tongʼ mar Edom, Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa gi Harun niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

kikuyu: Joma kare imenyonegi ler; joma oriere gie chunygi imiyo mor.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Nyaka chop odiechiengʼ mane Samuel othoe, ne ok ochako oneno Saulo kendo, kata obedo ni Samuel ne oywage kamano. Jehova Nyasaye ne okuyo nikech ne oketo Saulo obedo ruodh Israel.
english: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. The LORD grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi sirni mochungʼ molworo laru man-gi mise, sigingi mag hema kod tonde.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

kikuyu: Jowuoth moa Tema gi johala moa Sheba manyo aore mondo oyudie pi.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

kikuyu: Nokwano achaya miyudo nikech Kristo kaka gima duongʼ moloyo mwandu mag Misri, nikech nogeno yudo pokne bangʼe.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

kikuyu: Nathan nonyiso Daudi weche duto mane ofwenyne.
english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi dhako manie kindene mar neno malo.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

kikuyu: Nimar Nyasaye osemiyo ji duto obedo joma otamore winje mondo okech ji duto.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Wayie. Wabiro mana tweyi bangʼe wachiwi e lwetgi. Ok wananegi.” Omiyo ne gitweye gi tonde ariyo manyien ma gigole oko mar lwanda.
english: They spoke to him, saying, “No, but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands; but surely we will not kill you.” They bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka igoyo chongi piny ma ilama, to magi duto biro bedo magi.”
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

kikuyu: Eka abiro dwokora gi ngʼat ma timona anyali, nimar ageno kuom wachni.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

kikuyu: Ka nochopo odhiambo, nokelne ji mathoth mane nigi jochiende, kendo noriembo jochiendego oko gi wach, bende nochango ji duto mane tuo.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

kikuyu: “Kaluwore gi hekaluni migero, kiluwo puonjna kendo itimo weche mamiyi kendo kirito chikena, to abiro chopo singo mane amiyo Daudi wuonu.
english: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

kikuyu: Puonjno owinjore kod Injili man-gi duongʼ mar Nyasaye mogwedhi, mane oket e lweta.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

kikuyu: Awinjo ji mangʼeny kakwodho wach, “Bwok nitie koni gi koni! Wadonjneuru! Wadonjneuru!” Osiepena duto rito mondo dhoga okier, kagiwacho, “Sa moro inyalo wuonde; eka bangʼe wanapodh kuome kendo wanachul kuor kuome.”
english: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”

kikuyu: Onyalo wuondore ni oonge wuond, to timbene maricho biro nenore ratiro e nyim oganda.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

kikuyu: Wakend nyiu to un bende ukend nyiwa.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “An nyar Bethuel, ma wuod Nahor gi Milka.”
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

kikuyu: modhi malo nyaka Beth Hogla kendo odhi nyime yo nyandwat mar Beth Araba nyaka e kite mag Bohan ma wuod Reuben.
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

kikuyu: To dwol maduongʼ noa e polo kawacho niya, “In e Wuoda mahero. Chunya mor kodi.”
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo ringre ngʼama otho kendo ma ok opwodhore owuon ochido hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼatno nyaka gol oko mar Israel. Nikech pi mar pwodhruok pod ok okir kuome, ochido; kendo chidono odongʼ kuome.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo chako lal ae nywolgi; gin jo-jendeke kendo gin jo-miriambo aa nywolgi.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

kikuyu: Thundeni chalo gi nyithind mwanda ariyo, gichalo gi nyithind mwanda ma rude.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.

kikuyu: Omiyo wan bende wawuoguru wadhi ire oko mar kambi mondo wane achaya ma en bende noneno.
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

kikuyu: Aa malo kendo iwuothi e tungʼ piny koni gi koni, nikech amiyigo.”
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Nopenjo jatelo mane oa ka ruothno niya, “Angʼo momiyo ruoth nogolo chik mager kamano?” Eka Ariok nonyiso Daniel gima omiyo nogol chik ma kamano.
english: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo chike mag polo? Bende inyalo keto chike Nyasaye mondo orit piny?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

kikuyu: Ondingʼa rama gi rem malich; ringra onge gi ngima maber.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

kikuyu: Uparo ni Apolo to en ngʼa? Koso Paulo to en ngʼa? Gin mana jotich manomiyo uyie mana kaka Ruoth nomiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato tichne mondo otim.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

kikuyu: Onego gigo ne Jehova Nyasaye erokamano kuom herane ma ok rem kendo kuom timbene miwuoro motimo ne ji.
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nokawo balatago, mondo ogwonyrego kobet e buru.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

kikuyu: Bangʼ lokruok Saulo, kanisa man Judea gi Galili kod Samaria nobedo gi kwe maonge luoro. Roho Maler nokonyogi, mi gibedo motegno kendo kwan joma oyie kuom Kristo nomedore pile. Joma oyie kuom Kristo nodak koluoro Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: E piny Misri duto pe nogoyo gimoro amora mantie e pewe; obed ji kata le. Nogoyo gimoro amora matwi e puothe kendo nolwero it yiende duto.
english: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

kikuyu: Higa ka higa nolworore koa Bethel nyaka Gilgal gi Mizpa kongʼado bura ne jo-Israel kuonde duto.
english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde manok madirom higni ariyo, tuone nomedore ma nyimbiye nowuok oko omiyo notho ka en gi rem malich. Joge ne ok olosone mach mar magenga kaka nolosne kwerene.
english: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Kiyie bedo mangʼwon ne jogi kilombogi kendo kimiyogi dwoko mowinjore, to gibiro bedo jotichni ndalo duto.”
english: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe to iso kikombena mar mula ei ogund wuowi matin kaachiel gi pesa mar rundo.” Kendo jarit od Josef notimo kaka Josef nowachone.
english: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

kikuyu: Un to usungoru kendo upakoru! Ngʼeuru ni sunga ma kamano en richo.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

kikuyu: Kuom mano noringo gi mago mane en-go duto, kendo nongʼado Aora koluwo yo mochomo piny gode mag Gilead.
english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: To Petro nochako okwer kendo. Bangʼ kinde matin joma nochungʼ machiegni nowacho ne Petro niya, “adier in achiel kuomgi, nimar in ja-Galili.”
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

kikuyu: Mon-gi ema ne luwo Yesu koa Galili ka gichiwone gik monego okonyrego. Mon mamoko mathoth ma noluwe koa kode Jerusalem bende ne ni kanyo.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: gik mongʼinore mia angʼwen mag thiwni laini ariyo, moluwore (laini ariyo mag thiwni oketi e laini ariyo mag gik mongʼinore mane okedgo gik machalo agulni molos kaka tawo ewi sirni);
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

kikuyu: “Jo-Israel gi jo-Juda pok otimo gimoro makmana timbe mamono e nyim wangʼa chakre tin-gi; adiera, jo-Israel pok otimo gimoro makmana chwanya gi gik ma lwetgi oloso, Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Elifaz ja-Teman nopenjo niya,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Bi.” Eka Petro nowuok e yie kendo nochako wuotho ewi pi kochomo ir Yesu.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, oganda koganda noloso nyisechegi giwegi e miechgi mopogore opogore, kuonde mane gidakie, mi giketo nyiseche manono kuonde motingʼore mag lemo mane jo-Samaria oseloso.
english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

kikuyu: Ne gitweye gi nyororo mi giywaye oko kendo negikele ne ruodh Babulon. Ne gitere e od twech, mondo omi ruto mare kik winjre, kendo ewi gode mag Israel.
english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom tekona maduongʼ asechweyo piny gi joge kod le duto manie iye, kendo achiwo gigagi ne ngʼato angʼata mahero.
english: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.

kikuyu: E ndalo mar Daudi kod Asaf ema ne telone wende mag pak kod mag goyo erokamano ni Nyasaye nochakore.
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

kikuyu: Saulo notemo chwowe gi tongʼ mondo oriwe gi kor ot, to Daudi nolengʼe mi tongʼ nochwowo kor ot. Otienono Daudi notony maber modhi.
english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

kikuyu: To ka chiengʼ wuok to gidok e bungu; gidok kendo ginindo e gondegi.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

kikuyu: to Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom, Jeyel kod Azazia to nonego go nyatiti kaluwore gi chenro miluongo ni sheminith.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

kikuyu: Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai,
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

kikuyu: Joma notho e lweny ber moloyo jogo ma kech onego; kech chamogi ma gidhero nikech cham onge e puothe.
english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni Elnathan, Delaya kod Gemaria nokwero ruoth mondo kik wangʼ kitabuno, to ne ok onyal winjogi.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

kikuyu: Pilato nowachone niya, “Idagi wuoyo koda nangʼo? Bende ingʼeyo ni an gi teko ma anyalo gonyigo kata gurigo?”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

kikuyu: Ka omor ka polo, to pige manie polo wuo; omiyo boche polo dhwolore koa e giko piny. Ooro mil polo gi koth, kendo okelo yamo koa e kuondege mag keno.
english: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Mano kaka iber, jaherana! Yaye, mano kaka berni olomba! Kendo kitandawa bende yom ka lum mangʼich.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

kikuyu: keluru pi ne joma riyo oloyo, to un mudak Tema, keluru chiemo ne joma oseringo ka pondone lweny.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

kikuyu: Kane iya owangʼ gi joga to ne ajwangʼogi mi aweyogi ka gima ok gin ogandana awuon; ne achiwogi e lweti, kendo ne ok ikechogi. To bende ne iketo tingʼ mapek nyaka ne joma oti.
english: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowachona niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho ne Zerubabel: ‘Ok timre kuom nyalo kata kuom teko, to mana kuom Roho mara,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Magi duto nyiso ni buch Nyasaye nikare, nikech bangʼ neno sand kod tem to e giko nokwanu kaka joma owinjore yudo gweth mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi noloro Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi Sanduku manotingʼo gik molos gi dhahabu, mine giketogi ewi lwanda maduongʼ. Odiechiengʼno jo-Beth Shemesh nochiwo misango miwangʼo pep gi misengini mamoko ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The Levites took down the LORD’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.

kikuyu: Gima kamano kik timre! Kaka wan joma ne osetho kuom richo; ere kaka wanyalo dhi nyime kwadak e richo?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

kikuyu: Janabino noyudo ngʼat machielo mowachone niya, “Kiyie to goya.” Kamano ngʼatno nogoye mohinye.
english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ni piny ngima mapiyo piyo kendo dichiel.”
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

kikuyu: Kane Farao kuom wich teko mare otamore weyowa mondo wadhi, Jehova Nyasaye nonego nyithindo makayo duto mag dhano gi mag jamni, e piny Misri. Ma emomiyo atimo ne Jehova Nyasaye misango gi nyithind jamni machwo makayo, to wawaro yawuotwa kwachiwo gik moko kargi.’
english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

kikuyu: Ne udwoka niya, “Gima iparo mar timono nikare.”
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

kikuyu: Wachno nomiyo joote apar gariyo ochoko jopuonjre duto kanyakla, mi giwachonegi niya, “Ok ber mondo wajwangʼ tich mar yalo Wach Nyasaye mondo wapog chiemo.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde manok, ne nitie lweny machielo gi jo-Filistia e piny Gob. E kindeno Sibekai ma ja-Hushath nonego Saf, achiel kuom nyikwa Rafa.
english: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa ni,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Un joma ofuwo gi! Donge Jal mane ochweyo ngʼe gik moko, ema nochweyo koda igi bende?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

kikuyu: to jo-Israel nonyaa kendo gimedore ahinya mi gimedo bedo oganda mathoth moloyo mane gipongʼo pinyno duto.
english: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.

kikuyu: Chiw nyarombo machielo godhiambo kendo ichiwe kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny mana kaka chiwo mokwongo, ma en misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: koa kuom Shemida, joka Shemida; koa kuom Hefer, joka Hefer.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

kikuyu: Gima tin ma ngʼat makare nigo ber moloyo mwandu mathoth mag joma timbegi richo;
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

kikuyu: To jochan wiyi ok nowilgo ngangʼ kendo geno mar joma hinyore ok rum.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

kikuyu: To nikech koro indhem-ndhem, ok iliet bende ok ingʼich, abiro ngʼogi oko.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka ulamo to wachuru kama: “ ‘Wuonwa, nyingi mondo omi duongʼ, pinyruoth mari obi.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: Nikech loch kod teko mamalo mane omiye, ogendini duto, gi pinje duto, gi ji mawacho dhok mopogore opogore ne tetni e nyime kendo noluore. Joma ruoth ne dwaro ni onegi, ne onego; to joma ne odwaro ngʼwonone, nongʼwononegi; joma ne odwaro medo teko e loch, nomedo teko; kendo joma nodwaro lonyo e telo, nolonyo alonya.
english: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.

kikuyu: Aleksanda ma jatheth mula notimona malit ndi. Ruoth owuon nochule kuom gik mosetimo.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

kikuyu: kod tekone maduongʼ mokalo apima mosemiyowa wan joma oyie. Tekoneno nyiso tich mar tekre maduongʼ,
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
