kikuyu: Eka jo-Lawi moko, jo-Kohath kod jo-Kora nochungo mopako Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel gi dwol maduongʼ ahinya.
english: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo ir anywola mar Rekab kendo igwelgi mondo gibi e achiel kuom agola mar od Jehova Nyasaye kendo imigi divai gimadhi.”
english: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into the LORD’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”

kikuyu: Kendo gibiro nyiso jopinyni wachni. To bende gisewinjo ni in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, oseneni kitelonegi godiechiengʼ gi boche mag polo, to gotieno itelonegi gi pilni mar mach.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

kikuyu: Duto Nowa nodak kuom higni mia ochiko gi piero abich kendo bangʼe notho.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

kikuyu: Omiyo joote nodhi Israel gi Juda duto kaka ruoth nochiko ka gitingʼo barupe mane oa ir ruoth kod jodonge mondikie niya, “Jo-Israel dwoguru ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Israel mondo mi oduog iru un joma odongʼ mosetony e lwet ruodhi mag Asuria.
english: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

kikuyu: Mago duto osetimore mana mondo ochop gima ondiki e chikgi ni, ‘Ne gichaya kayiem nono.’
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Jo-Benjamin mane otony nyaka bed gi nyithindo mabiro chamo mwandugi mondo omi dhood Israel kik tieki.
english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

kikuyu: Negiketho mier matindo duto mokiewo gi Gerar nikech luoro moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye nomakogi. Ne giyako mier duto mane ni kanyo nikech ne nitiere gik moko mangʼeny kanyo.
english: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kaka singruok mar donjo kama entie mondo waywe pod nitie, wabeduru motangʼ mondo kik yud ngʼato kuomu ma nigi rem moro ma dimone donjo e yweyono.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

kikuyu: Abiro oro Malaika mondo otel e nyimu kendo obiro riembo jo-Kanaan gi jo-Amor gi jo-Hiti gi jo-Perizi gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus.
english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano, yiende nowachone ngʼowu ni, ‘Bi mondo ibed ruodhwa.’
english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

kikuyu: Koro aa sani sani mondo idhi dala! Ne awachoni ni abiro miyi chudo maber, to Jehova Nyasaye osetami yudo chudono.”
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

kikuyu: Naneno kaka hekalu ne nigi otuchi mag kor ot maboyo moger molwore duto, kendo otuchigo ema nobedo kaka mise mag ute matindo tindo mane ni e alwora hekalu. Borne modhi malo ne en fut ochiko, kendo wiye ne romre gi mise mag udi mane oger momakore gi hekaluno, to lachne ne romo fut abiriyo gi nus.
english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

kikuyu: Kamano janabi nowachone niya, “Wadhi dala mondo ichiem.”
english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

kikuyu: Kik ukel gimoro makwero e uteu, nimar un kod gima ukelono nokethi. Kik ubed gi gik machalo kamano nimar enokethgi.
english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

kikuyu: Ininind kionge gi luoro, kendo ji mangʼeny nomany konyruok kuomi.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachno, moko kuom joma ne ni kanyo nowacho niya, “Jalni en janabi adier.”
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

kikuyu: Kuom higni ariyo abiro duogo kae gik moko duto mag od Jehova Nyasaye mane Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon ogolo kae kendo otero Babulon.
english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ish-Boseth nogolo chik mondo ogole kuom Paltiel wuod Laish machuore.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

kikuyu: Nyasaye osewuoyo gie kare maler kowacho niya, “Abiro pogo Shekem ne ji, kendo abiro pimo ne ji Holo mar Sukoth.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Ka joma kare dhiyo nyime, ji mor, ka joricho ema otelo e loch ji ywak ka gichur.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

kikuyu: Lingʼuru kendo uwinj dwond Nyasaye kaka mor ka polo, kendo winjuru weche mawuok e dhoge.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Balak nochiwo misango mar dhok kod rombe, kendo nochiwo moko ne Balaam kod jodongo mane ni kode.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

kikuyu: Eka Farao nowacho niya, “Jonyawogi un mana jonyawo! Mano e gima omiyo usiko kuwacho ni, ‘Yie wadhi mondo wachiw misango ni Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’

kikuyu: Wegiuru aweya; gin jotecho ma muofni. Ongʼere ni ka ngʼama muofu otelo ne muofu wadgi to nyaka gilingʼre ei bugo giduto kargi ji ariyogo.”
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nobedo e bwo loch Eglon ruodh Moab kuom higni apar gaboro.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

kikuyu: Nimar jopiny ema chandore ka dwaro gigi duto; to bende Wuonu manie polo ongʼeyo ni udwaro gigi duto.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

kikuyu: Noluwe gi Jair ma ja-Gilead, ma notelo ne Israel kuom higni piero ariyo gariyo.
english: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

kikuyu: Berotha kod Sibraim (manie tongʼ mar Damaski kod Hamath), nyaka ochopi Hazer Hatikon, manie tongʼ mar Hauran.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

kikuyu: Nikech wachni, lwet ngʼato ka ngʼato ne jony, kendo kihondko nogo chuny ji duto ma aa.
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye ma jangʼad bura ema dwoko ngʼato piny, kendo tingʼo ngʼat machielo malo.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

kikuyu: Jotham nomedo bedo gi teko nikech ne owuotho maonge mibadhi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jodolo noyangʼogi mi gichiwo rembgi e kendo mar misango kaka misango mar golo richo mondo ochulgo richo mar jo-Israel duto nikech ruoth nochiko mondo ochiw misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar golo richo ne jo-Israel duto.
english: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

kikuyu: To joma timbegi richo biro lal nono: Wasik Jehova Nyasaye biro chalo gi ber mar thiepe manie pap, gibiro lal nono, adier gibiro lal nono kaka iro.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye noparo Nowa gi le mag bungu kod jamni mane ni kode ei yie, kendo notugo yamo mokudho e piny mi pi nochako dwono.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

kikuyu: Ka Adam nosedak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek, nonywolo wuowi machal kode, kendo nochake ni Seth.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

kikuyu: noket e Rangaj Ruoth e yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka chil kawuono. Magi ema ne jorit dhorangeye mag kuonde bworo mag jo-Lawi.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

kikuyu: “Un jo-Benjamin, ringuru utony! Ringuru ua Jerusalem! Gouru turumbete Tekoa! Keturu ranyisi ewi Beth Hakerem! Nimar masira aa yo nyandwat, kod kethruok malich.
english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo Abner niya, “Donge in ngʼama dichwo? To ere ngʼama chal kodi e Israel? Angʼo momiyo ne ok irito ruodhi ma en ruoth? Ngʼato nobiro mondo oneg ruodhi ma ruoth.
english: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach polo mane ogola thurwa e dala wuora kendo nowuoyo koda kotimo koda singruok ni, ‘To ne nyikwayi nami pinyni’ kendo en owuon ema obiro oro malaikane nyimi mondo mi iyudne wuoda dhako kuno.
english: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

kikuyu: “Eka yiende nowachone mzabibu ni, ‘Bi mondo ibed ruodhwa.’
english: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

kikuyu: kendo abich mamoko oketi e bathe komachielo kendo sirni abich modongʼ omak sirni mane omakgo katoke mochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar Hemb Romo.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

kikuyu: Kata mana jalweny ma jachir ma chunye chalo gi chuny sibuor, biro kirni ka luoro ohewe, nimar Israel duto ongʼeyo wuonu ni en jalweny kendo ni ji man kode gin jochir.
english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano mondo ji duto manie piny ongʼe ni lwet Jehova Nyasaye nigi teko kendo mondo omi uluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kinde duto.”
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear the LORD your God forever.’”

kikuyu: Ok awinjora koro oluonga ni wuodi; keta abed kaka achiel kuom jotichni.’
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

kikuyu: Ka Farao oluongou kendo openjou ni, ‘Utiyo angʼo?’
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

kikuyu: To ka kama olurono ok olandore e dende ka bangʼ ka osedhi ir jadolo mondo olande ni oler, to nyaka onyisre e nyim jadolo kendo.
english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

kikuyu: Joma ne awuothogo nomako bada kagitaya ka wachomo Damaski, nikech ler mangʼangʼni mane oserieny cha noseloka muofu.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

kikuyu: Wengena ool karango resruok mikelo, kendo kamanyo gima kare mane isingona.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

kikuyu: Koro walamo Nyasaye mondo kik utim gima rach, to ok walem kamano mondo wanyisgo ni wan joma kare, to mana ni mondo utim gik mabeyo kata obedo ni wachalo joma orem kamano.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

kikuyu: Kane giyude, negichako ngʼur gi wuon puodho,
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

kikuyu: To Israel norieyo bade ma korachwich moketo ewi Efraim wuowi ma chogo, kendo bade ma koracham ewi Manase kata obedo ni en ema ne en wuowi maduongʼ.
english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

kikuyu: Ero ngʼato biro koidho gach lweny miywayo gi farese. To ngʼatno nowacho niya, ‘Babulon osepodho, adier osepodho, adier osepodho, kendo nyisechene manono osetur matindo tindo!’ ”
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Joshua nochoko jolweny mage duto ka en kaachiel gi jodong Israel wuotho e nyimgi kadhi Ai.
english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

kikuyu: “Ma e yor dhako ma jachode: Ochiemo to bangʼe oyweyo dhoge, mi owach ni, ‘Ok asetimo gimoro marach.’
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

kikuyu: An Paulo, andikonu kaka jaote ma ok oor gi teko kata dwaro mar dhano, to mana gi teko mar Yesu Kristo gi Nyasaye Wuora mane ochiere oa kuom joma otho.
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyo kwan maru omedore ma kawuono ungʼeny mana ka sulwe manie kor polo.
english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: Nowachonigi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruoth Nyasaye. To joma moko, to iwuoyogo gi ngeche
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

kikuyu: Omiyo mon-go noa e liel ka gireto, ka giluor to bende ka gipongʼ gi mor, kendo negiringo gidhi mondo ginyis jopuonjrene.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “An awuon anachok romba modongʼ e pinje duto kuonde maseriembogie anadwog-gi legegi kama gibiro nyaa kendo kwan-gi nomedre.
english: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nochako obirona kendo, kawachona niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Nikech ka an ema amiyo ubedo mokuyo, to en ngʼa ma dimiya mor, ka ok mana un ma amiyou chuny lit?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

kikuyu: Ober moloyo kite ma nengogi tek; onge gimoro amora migombo ma dipim kode.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

kikuyu: Bende ne gitero chike mane ruoth ochiwo ni jotend gwenge kod jotend Yufrate, bangʼe negichiwo kony ni ji kod ni od Nyasaye.
english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, weche mane owinji koa yo Wuok chiengʼ gi yo Nyandwat nomiye luoro, kendo mano nomede mirima mondo omi onegi kendo otieki ji mangʼeny.
english: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

kikuyu: Jodongo mag Amon nowinjore monego ruoth e kar dakne.
english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

kikuyu: Kik obed mogak kuom mulo ringre joma otho ma gin wedene kuom kend.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka anatiek timbeni mag chode mane ichako kane pod in Misri. Ok inichak igomb dok e timbenigo, Misri bende ok inichak ipar kendo.
english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’

kikuyu: Onge gima rach manyalo biro ni ngʼat makare; to joricho ni kod thagruok mathoth.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

kikuyu: Nimar ere kaka dalingʼ alingʼa ka aneno masira mabiro ne ogandana? Kata ere kaka dalingʼ alingʼa ka aneno ka idwaro tiek joodwa.”
english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

kikuyu: Negiketo gige mag lweny e hekalu mar Ashtoreth kendo negitweyo ringre e kor ohinga man Beth Shan.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

kikuyu: Ka agoyo erokamano ni chiemo ma achamo, to angʼo momiyo ikwana ka jaketho ne gima agoyonee Nyasaye erokamano?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

kikuyu: Ka pesago ne osengʼe kwan-gi, ne gimiyogi nyipeche mane ochungʼ ne tich loso hekalu. Kanyo bende ema ne gigoloe pesa ma ichulo joma tiyo ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ma gin jogo randa, jogedo kod jopa kite.
english: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,

kikuyu: Jou machwo duto nyaka chopi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nyadidek e higa ka higa mondo otim sewni adekgo kama en owuon obiro yiero. Sewni adekgo gin Makati ma ok Oketie Thowi, Sawo mar Jumbe kod Sawo mar Kiche. Onge ngʼat manobi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi lwete nono.
english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty.

kikuyu: Satan nowachone niya, “Ka in Wuod Nyasaye adier, nyis kidini olokre kuon.”
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi ine okumbawa, yaye Nyasaye; rang ngʼati miwiro gi ngʼwono.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

kikuyu: Shekania, Rehum, Meremoth,
english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

kikuyu: Eka Musa noidho got mondo odhi owuo gi Nyasaye kendo Jehova Nyasaye noluonge gi ewi got mowachone kama: “Ma e gima iwachne od Jakobo to gi jo-Israel.
english: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

kikuyu: Kar dhahabu duto mane okel kawuok e misango mifwayo mane otigo e tich duto mar kama ler mar lemo ne romo kilo alufu achiel (1,000) kaluwore gi rapim mar kama ler mar lemo.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: “Ka onywol nyarombo, nyaroya kata nyadiel, to kik upoge gi min mare nyaka bangʼ ndalo abiriyo. Kochiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye bangʼ ndalo aboro kaka misango miwangʼo gi mach to Jehova Nyasaye noyie kode.
english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Rie badi e nam mondo pi oum jo-Misri gi gechegi kod joidh faresegi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”

kikuyu: Abiro kawo loch e lwet wuode kendo anamiyi dhoudi apar.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

kikuyu: Jeuz, Sakia kod Mirma. Magi ne yawuote mane otelo ne anywolagi.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Ma e fweny ma Nyasaye nomiyo Yesu Kristo mondo onyisgo jotichne gik manyaka timre mapiyo. Kristo nomiyo fwenyni ongʼere ka nooro malaikane mondo onyis Johana jatichne.
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

kikuyu: Ruodh jo-Aram nogolo chik ne jotende piero adek gariyo mariembo geche niya, “Kik uked gi ngʼato angʼata bed ni otin kata oduongʼ makmana ruodh Israel.”
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

kikuyu: Ma e wach mar adier: Ka wasetho kode, to wanabed mangima kode bende;
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

kikuyu: To jatich Ibrahim nowachonegi niya, “Kik ugengʼna, to weyauru adog ir ruodha, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho wuodha.”
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

kikuyu: Gara mag dhahabugo kod gik mongʼinore kolemogo nobed kokikore molworo riak law.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osebatise, en kaachiel gi joode duto, norwakowa e ode kowacho niya, “Ka ukwana kaka ngʼat moyie kuom Ruoth Yesu, to biuru mondo ubed wenda.” Nomedo sayowa kamano mine wadhi!
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

kikuyu: Ruodh jo-Amon nodwoko joote Jeftha niya, “Kane jo-Israel owuok Misri, negikawo pinya chakre aora Arnon nyaka aora Jabok mi gichopo nyaka aora Jordan, koro duognago gi kwe.”
english: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

kikuyu: kuom ngʼeyo mare ema nopogogo aore gi nembe, kendo nomiyo boche polo okelo thoo.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

kikuyu: Ageno ni ubiro bedo mangʼwon koda nikech adwaro wuoyo mofuwo matin, ma bende usebedo ka utimo.
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

kikuyu: To Jehosheba nyar ruoth Jehoram ma nyamin Ahazia, nokawo Joash wuod Ahazia mopande lingʼ-lingʼ mabor kod yawuot ruoth mane koro ochiegni negi. Nyakono nokawe kaachiel gi japite mopandogi e od Athalia mar nindo, omiyo ne ok onege.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

kikuyu: Mano notimre nikech ringruok matow nyaka rwakre gi ringruok ma ok tow, kendo ringruok mathoni nyaka rwakre gi ringruok ma ok tho.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

kikuyu: Adieri Ibrahim biro bedo oganda maduongʼ kendo maratego, kendo ogendini duto manie piny nogwedhi nikech en.
english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

kikuyu: Timuru gik moko duto gihera.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kikuyu: Nyaka opwodhre owuon gi pi chiengʼ mar adek kod chiengʼ mar abiriyo; eka obiro bedo maler. To ka ok opwodhore owuon chiengʼ mar adek gi chiengʼ mar abiriyo, to ok obi bedo maler.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

kikuyu: To kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu noyier miluongo e Nyinge, kanyo ema unukelie gik moko duto ma achikou, ma gin misango miwangʼo pep, kod misango magu, achiel kuom apar magu, mich moyiedhi kod chiwo mag mwandu mugeno musingoru ni ubiro kelo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: then it shall happen that to the place which the LORD your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Moab osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech ne giwangʼo choke mag ruodh Edom molokore buru,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;

kikuyu: jo-Gebal, jo-Amon kod jo-Amalek, jo-Filistia kaachiel gi joma odak Turo.
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

kikuyu: Un ero un gi gik moko duto mudwaro kendo usedoko jo-mwandu! Usebedo ruodhi, to wan uwewa oko! Mano kaka agombo ni ne ubed ruodhi adier mondo wan bende wabed ruodhi kaachiel kodu!
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai gi Jopuonj Chik ne ngʼur kawacho niya, “Ngʼatni rwako joricho kendo ochiemo kodgi.”
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

kikuyu: Kuno ema ngʼama ja-adiera teroe ywakne, kendo kuno ema jal mangʼadona bura diweyae thuolo.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

kikuyu: E higa mar abiriyo mar loch Jehu, Joash nobedo ruoth kendo nobedo e loch Jerusalem kuom higni piero angʼwen. Min mare ne iluongo ni Zibia; mane aa Bersheba.
english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

kikuyu: Pi nogingore kadok kare kendo noimo geche gi joidh farese gi jolweny Farao duto mane olawo jo-Israel nyaka e nam. Onge kata achiel kuomgi mane otony.
english: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

kikuyu: Abiro olonu gweth, kendo abiro miyo unywol mi ununyaa mathoth, kendo abiro chopo singruok duto mane atimo kodu.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikri, in kaachiel gi gigi mag lweny kod jolweny molwori mondo itelnegi kudhi e kedo.
english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

kikuyu: Abija kod joge nonegogi malich ahinya ma joma nohinyore kuom jo-Israel marateke moyier ne gin ji alufu mia abich.
english: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

kikuyu: Ok ginichak gimadh divai ka giwer, nikech kongʼo osebedo marach ne jomath.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne ok oor Elija ir moro kata achiel kuomgi, to makmana dhako ma chwore otho e dala mar Zarefath e gwengʼ Sidon.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

kikuyu: Kata mana sani ok ginyal nyisi maler kuom ketho ma gidonjonago iri.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

kikuyu: Omiyo negiluongo ruodhi duto mag jo-Filistia mi giwachonegi niya, “Goluru Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel; dwokeuru kare owuon, ka ok kamano to obiro negowa kaachiel gi jowa.” Nikech tho nosepongʼo dala maduongʼ gi kihondko; lwet Nyasaye nosandogi ahinya.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

kikuyu: Kwan joma chwo duto mahikgi piero adek nyaka piero abich mabiro konyo e tich mar Hemb Romo.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Bende nomuko ut jochode machwo mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ma en kama mon ne chweyoe pasia mag Ashera.
english: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

kikuyu: Eka noketo pasia e dho Hemb Romo.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Bende nongʼanyo ni ruoth Nebukadneza mane okete mokwongʼore gi nying Nyasaye. Ne toke obedo matek ta kendo chunye ne ok odewo mondo oduog ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abiriyo, negichako kelo chiwo mar misengini miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye, kata obedo ni mise mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ne pok ochaki.
english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD; but the foundation of the LORD’s temple was not yet laid.

kikuyu: Eka nonyisogi niya, “Koro tuomuru pi moko mondo ukaw uter ne jatend budho.” Negitimo kamano,
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nogolo chik ni jatend jolweny mondo orit Paulo, ka omiye thuolo moromo, kendo mondo kik otam osiepene miye kony moro amora mane onyalo dwaro.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

kikuyu: Malaika nodwoko niya, “An Gabriel, achungo e nyim Nyasaye, kendo oseora mondo awuo kodi kendo nyisi wach maberni.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

kikuyu: Josef nowachonegi niya, “En mana kaka ne awachonu: Un okwach kich!
english: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Timna ngʼwono makende. Nimar isemiya puodho man Negev, miya bende thidhna mar pi.” Omiyo Kaleb nomiye thidhna ma malo kod mamwalo.
english: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ni Elija ja-Tishbi, kawacho niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomor gie polo; dwond Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo nowinjore.
english: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Manase (ma en dhood Josef), ne en Gadi wuod Susi;
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

kikuyu: Ogwedhi in dhako moseyie ni gima Ruoth osewachone biro timore.”
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

kikuyu: gi olembe mabeyo duto ma chiengʼ nyalo miyo dongo kaachiel gi gik mabeyo duto mapichni;
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

kikuyu: “To eka upenjo ni, Angʼo momiyo wuowi ok kwan ka jaketho kuom ketho mar wuon?” Nikech wuowi osetimo gima adier kendo makare kendo nikech oseketo chunye mar rito buchena duto, obiro bedo mangima adier.
english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

kikuyu: Nowach ne Joab niya, “Ruoth dengo malit kaywago Abisalom.”
english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

kikuyu: Jogo mane rito Yesu nochako jare kendo goye.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

kikuyu: eka unubed moil kuom Jehova Nyasaye, mi oteru ewi piny kama otingʼore, bende nomiu chiemo kar mwandu mane osingore ne Jakobo kwaru.” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.

kikuyu: Masiche onure koni gi koni kendo okete ka gi ka.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

kikuyu: Tij jo-Lawi ne en konyo nyikwa Harun tiyo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Negirito laru, agulni mag od Nyasaye, luoko gik moko duto mopwodhi to gi timo tije mamoko e od Nyasaye.
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

kikuyu: Koguru matek kuwer gi mor, un jo-Sayun nimar Jal Maler mar Israel odak e dieru.”
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

kikuyu: Nikech useyako ogendini mangʼeny, joma odongʼ biro mayou. Nimar usechwero remb dhano, useketho pinje, mier madongo kod ji duto manie igi.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Pinygi nodongʼ gunda, mi enobedi gima inyiero manyaka chiengʼ; jogo duto makalo bute nobwogi kendo gini kin wigi.
english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.

kikuyu: Uparo ni achamo ring rwedhi kata ni amadho remb diek?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Wuonwa, isechiwo wachni ne Jehova Nyasaye. Timna mana kaka ne isesingori, nikech Jehova Nyasaye koro oseresi e lwet wasiki, ma jo-Amon.”
english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”

kikuyu: ‘Donge gipogo gik moyaki ka ngʼato ka ngʼato yudo nyako achiel kata ariyo, kendo imiyo Sisera lewni mabeyo kaachiel gi lewni mabeyo motwangʼ mongʼith, monego arwaki?’
english: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’

kikuyu: Kerubigo noyaro bwombegi ewi kama noketie Sandug Muma kendo ne giumo Sandug Muma gi ludhe mitingʼego.
english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

kikuyu: Kane pod giwinjo wachni, nodhi nyime kogoyonegi ngero, nikech nochiegni gi Jerusalem, kendo ji ne paro ni pinyruoth Nyasaye biro betie mapiyo.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

kikuyu: To ka Johana nokwero Ruoth Herode nikech wach Herodia, ma chi owadgi, kendo kuom gik mamoko maricho mane osetimo,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Rehoboam nonono jodongo manotiyo e bwo wuon-gi Solomon kapod ongima. Nopenjogi niya, “Ere kaka unyalo ngʼadona rieko mondo adwok jogi?”
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

kikuyu: Filipo noyudo Nathaniel mowachone niya, “Waseyudo ngʼat ma Musa nondiko kuome e kitap Chik, kendo ma jonabi bende nondiko kuome, ma en Yesu ja-Nazareth, ma wuod Josef.”
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

kikuyu: Piny ne oyawore mi nomwonyo Dathan; piny noiko oganda joka Abiram.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, jogo ne otemo kar nyalogi mondo gikwangʼ gidogi e dho wath. To ne ok ginyal, nimar nam nomedo gingore marach moloyo kaka ne en mokwongo.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

kikuyu: Wuod Palu ne en Eliab,
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

kikuyu: Wadwaro mondo ji kik ne rach moro e yo mwatiye tij mich mar ngʼwononi.
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Usewuoyo marach kuoma. “To upenjo ni, ‘En angʼo ma wasewacho kuomi?’
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says the LORD. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

kikuyu: Nyako maduongʼ ne nyinge Ohola, to nyamingi ne en Oholiba. Ne gin joga kendo neginywolo yawuowi gi nyiri. Ohola en Samaria to Oholiba en Jerusalem.
english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

kikuyu: Geruru yore kuno kendo upog piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou ka girkenino nyadidek, mondo ka ngʼato onego dhano to oring odhi otony kuno.
english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka gombo maricho osemako ich to onywolo richo; to richo kosedoko motegno to onywolo tho.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

kikuyu: Kawuono osedhi mi ochiwo misengini mathoth mag dhok gi nyiroye machwe kod rombe. Oseluongo yawuot ruoth duto gi jotend lweny kod Abiathar jadolo. E seche ma wawuoyoeni koro gichiemo kendo gimetho kode bende giwacho kama, ‘Ruoth Adonija mondo odag amingʼa!’
english: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

kikuyu: Kik igomb chiembe mamit, nimar chiemono en mar wuondruok.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

kikuyu: Piny nodongʼ gunda kendo nokethre chuth. Jehova Nyasaye ema osewacho wechegi.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Donge uketho nikech ukia Ndiko kata teko Nyasaye?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

kikuyu: Nying Jehova Nyasaye otingʼ malo, nimar odak e polo; obiro pongʼo Sayun gi tim makare kod adiera.
english: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

kikuyu: Koro an Nebukadneza, apako, adendo kendo amiyo Ruodh Polo duongʼ, nikech gik moko duto motimo nikare kendo yorene duto oriere tir. To joma wuotho ka sungore to odwoko piny.
english: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways justice; and those who walk in pride he is able to abase.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Chunguru e akek yore kendo urang wangʼ yore machon; penjuru kuma yo maber nitie, mondo uwuothie, kendo unuyud yweyo e chunyu. To ne uwacho ni, ‘Ok wanaluwe.’
english: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

kikuyu: Kitanda moro amora moninde e ndalo ma pod oneno malo nobed mogak mana kaka kitanda monindoe mapile kendo gimoro amora mobetie nobed mogak mana machal gi kinde monenoe malo.
english: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Daudi ne ok nyal dhiyo bute mondo openj Nyasaye nikech ne oluoro ligangla mar malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ngʼwon kendo timo maber; Nyasachwa opongʼ gi kech.
english: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nopodho auma; monyiero kowacho e chunye niya, “Bende ngʼama ja-higni mia achiel nyalo nywolo wuowi? Bende Sara ma ja-higni piero ochiko nyalo nywolo nyathi?”
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

kikuyu: Nikodemo nopenje niya, “Gigo nyalo timore kamano nade?”
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

kikuyu: E ngima manyien-ni, koro onge pogruok e kind ja-Yunani kod ja-Yahudi, onge ngʼama oter nyangu kata ngʼat ma ok oter nyangu, bende onge ngʼama ok osomo kata jamaranda, misumba kata ngʼama ni thuolo, to Kristo e moromo kendo en duto kuom duto.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

kikuyu: Mosna Priskila gi Akula, kod jood Onesiforo.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

kikuyu: Joote noduogo onyiso Yesu gik moko duto mane gisetimo kendo puonjo.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

kikuyu: Elkana jaode ne jawachone niya, “Hana, angʼo momiyo iywak? Angʼo momoni chiemo? Angʼo momiyo chunyi osin? Donge onego aloni yawuowi apar?”
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

kikuyu: Chambu mabeyo mogik duto mukwongo kayo kaachiel gi chiwo magu duto makende biro bedo mag jodolo. Chiemo mokwong tedo mag chambgi nomi jodolo eka ginigwedh miechu.
english: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

kikuyu: Chutho afuwo ahinya ma ok awinjora bedo dhano; ok an kod ngʼeyo tiend wach mar dhano.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

kikuyu: Solomon ne timo misango miwangʼo pep gi misango mar lalruok nyadidek e higa ewi kendo mar misango mane ogero ni Jehova Nyasaye bende nowangʼo ubani e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mi nochopo dwaro mar hekalu.
english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000) noikore ne lweny, kowuok e dhout Israel duto ka gigolo ji alufu achiel achiel (1,000).
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

kikuyu: Nimar lwetu otimo remo, kendo usemulo richo. Dhou osewacho miriambo kendo leu osehulo gik mamono.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

kikuyu: Eka nodok malo kuma ne entie mi ongʼwenyo makati mochamo. Bangʼe nodhi nyime gipuonjo nyaka piny oru, eka owuok.
english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

kikuyu: Nyithinde bende abiro nego, mi kanise biro ngʼeyo ni An ema angʼeyo chunje gi paro mag ji bende ni anapog ngʼato ka ngʼato kaka tichne chalo.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto nowinjo ni Jeroboam ne osedwogo, ne giorone jaote ma giluonge e chokruok, kendo gikete ruodh jo-Israel duto. Mana dhood Juda kende ema nodongʼ jo-adiera ni od Daudi.
english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Ehud nosetho, jo-Israel nochako otimo tim mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

kikuyu: Daudi gi jo-Israel duto nodhi Jerusalem (tiende ni, Jebus). Jo-Jebus mane odak kanyo
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

kikuyu: moger e mise achiel mar joote gi jonabi; ka Kristo Yesu owuon e rariw.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

kikuyu: Kane otiek chiwo misango ruoth kod jogo duto mane ni kode nogoyo chonggi piny ka gimiye duongʼ.
english: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

kikuyu: Daguru gi winjruok e kindu. Kik usungru, to beduru gi chuny mohero riwore gi joma ni e ngima mapiny. Kik ngʼato wuondre ni oriek moloyo ji mamoko.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

kikuyu: “Unubed joga maler. Kuom mano kik ucham ring chiayo mondiek onego; direuru ne guogi.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodhi e bath got kamoro mi nobet piny kanyo gi jopuonjrene.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Mirimbe maliel ka mach ni kuoma; kendo okwana kaka achiel kuom wasike.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Abram mi owachone niya, “Anami kothi pinyni.” Omiyo Abram nogero kendo mar misango kanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye mane osefwenyorene.
english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

kikuyu: Ka ok itimonwa kamano, to nyiso ni isedagiwa kendo in gi mirima kodwa ma ok nyal pim.
english: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mae Jadolo nokaw mo moko modongʼ e pat lwete, kendo wire e dho it ma korachwich mar ngʼat mipwodhono, gi lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich gi lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich, ewi kuonde mane omienie remb misango mar pwodhruok e ketho.
english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, donge wengeni manyo adiera? Ne igoyogi, to ne ok giwinjo rem; ne ikidhogi matindo tindo, to ne ok gilokore. Negimiyo wengegi obedo matek moloyo kidi mi gitamore hulo richogi.
english: O LORD, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

kikuyu: Gik mangimago ne ringo matek koni gi koni mana ka mil polo.
english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

kikuyu: Ma e richo mar od Jeroboam mane omiyo opodho kendo kelone kethruok e wangʼ piny.
english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Ne nitie jamoko moro, ma ngʼat mane rito mwandune ne odonjne ni ketho gige.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

kikuyu: Magi e dhahabu molos ka buche mane jo-Filistia oorone Jehova Nyasaye ka misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho ka moro ka moro ochungʼ kar Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath kod Ekron.
english: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to the LORD: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

kikuyu: Juda nofwenyo gigo, kendo owacho niya, “Dhakoni ja-adiera maloya, nikech ne ok amiye Shela wuoda mondo okende.” Kendo Juda ne ok ochako oriwore kode.
english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

kikuyu: Kane odwogo irgi kendo mar adek, nowachonegi niya, “Pod unindo aninda kendo uyweyo? Oromo! Sa osechopo. Neyeuru kaka indhogo Wuod Dhano kendo kaka ikete e lwet joricho.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Asetiyo matek gi lwetena, kendo asechandora malit, ka ok anindi kuom ndalo mangʼeny. Kech osechama, kendo riyo oseloya; kinde mathoth asebedo ka aonge gi chiemo moromo, bende asewuotho duk.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

kikuyu: Donge Efraim en wuoda makende, nyathi ma amor godo? Kata obedo ni awuoyoga kuome marach, to pod apare. Emomiyo chunya ywage,” an-gi kech kuome, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Jatich Ibrahim noringo kadhi romone mi owachone niya, “Akwayi, yie imiyae pi mondo amodhi.”
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

kikuyu: “Kapo ni asetuono jodhier gik magidwaro kata asemiyo wangʼ dhako ma chwore otho chandruok ojonyo,
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

kikuyu: “Ma en ngʼa magingore ka aora Nael kendo mana ka aore ma pigegi bubni?
english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

kikuyu: Unuriemb jowasiku duto e dieru kendo ununeg-gi.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Bangʼ medo siemo jootego, ne giweyogi gidhi. Ne ok ginyal yudo yo ma ginyalo kumogigo nikech ji duto ne miyo Nyasaye duongʼ kuom gima nosetimoreno,
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya,
english: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokawo remono mi okiro kuom ji kendo owacho niya, “Ma e remo mar singruok ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo kodu kaluwore gi wechegi duto.”
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

kikuyu: Ne adhi ir achiel kuom joma nochungʼ kanyo mi napenje tiend lek mane aseleko. “Omiyo nonyisa, tiend wechegi kowacho niya,
english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. “So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

kikuyu: Ne giwuotho mi gikadho piny Negev nyaka gichopo Hebron, kama Ahiman, Sheshai kod Talmai, ma nyikwa Anak nodakie. (Hebron noger higni abiriyo motelone Zoan manie piny Misri.)
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

kikuyu: To janabi nodwoke niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, ma atiyone, ni ok anakaw gimoro kuomi.” Kata obedo ni Naaman nomedo saye kamano, nodagi.
english: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

kikuyu: Eka nolokore mongʼiyo dhakono mowachone Simon, niya, “Ineno dhakoni? Nabiro odi. Ne ok imiya pi moro amora mondo alwokgo tiendena, to nolwoko tiendena gi pi wangʼe kendo noyweyogi gi yie wiye.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

kikuyu: Ne amiyo kibaji omakogi ma giringo e nyimu, kaachiel gi ruodhi jo-Amor ariyo. Ne ok utimo ma gi liganglau uwegi kod atungʼ.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma ariembogi ka aterogie, to jogo duto motony mar oganda marachni noher tho kar ngima, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho kamano.’
english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Kane kinde ochopo machiegni mondo Daudi otho, nosiemo Solomon wuode.
english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

kikuyu: Rituru dwe mar Abib kendo utim nyasi mar Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, nikech e dwe mar Abib nogolou e piny Misri gotieno.
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

kikuyu: Asepwodhou, to ok kaka ipwodho fedha, kendo asetemou gi masira mager ka mach.
english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

kikuyu: Chik iti kendo iwinj weche mag jomariek; ket chunyi ne gima apuonjo,
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osewacho ma, nonyisogi lwetene gi ngʼetne. Jopuonjre ne mor mokalo kane gineno Ruoth.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nobed malit ne jogo mariek e wengegi giwegi kendo kwano ni ongʼeyo gik moko duto.
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

kikuyu: Ndalo abiriyo norumo bangʼ ka Jehova Nyasaye nosechwado aora Nael.
english: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.

kikuyu: Noketo kido mar kerubi gi sibuor kod yiend othidhe e bethe rachungi kod bepe kamoro amora mane ni thuolo, gi kido mar maua e alworane duto.
english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

kikuyu: To ndalo biro ma wuon kisera nogol e kindgi, e ndalogo ginitwe chiemo.”
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

kikuyu: Ne onego kach jo-Misri duto, mana olemo mokwongo chiek mag dhano e hembe mag Ham.
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nogou gi tuo mar kahera, midhusi gi tuo akuodi kod gwonyo kendo obiro kelonu oro mi cham rochre ewi dongo; kendo gigo duto biro thagou nyaka urum chuth.
english: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochiwgi e lwetu to nyaka utimnegi gik moko duto ma asechikou.
english: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoke niya, “Mana kaka iwachono, ok anachak abi iri kendo.”
english: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”

kikuyu: Ket chunya mondo oher chikeni, to ok dwaro maga mag wuoro.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

kikuyu: Ne ni gibedo magi iwuon kendo kik iriwgi gi joma galagala.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

kikuyu: To kata ka boche ne pok owangʼ, jatich jadolo ne biroga ma wach ne ngʼama chiwo misango niya, “Mi jadolo ringʼo moko mondo obul nikech ok obi yie kawo ringʼo mosetedi kuomi makmana manumu.”
english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyisa giko mar ngimana bende nyisa kar romb ndalona; mondo abed ka angʼeyo ni ndalona kadho piyo.
english: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

kikuyu: Kendo Elija nowacho ni Ahab niya, “Dhi ichiem kendo imethi nikech nitie mor koth maduongʼ kawuono.”
english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

kikuyu: Weche duto mawuok e dhoga gin kare, onge moro kuomgi mobam kata modwanyore.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

kikuyu: Jeria ne nigi wedene alufu ariyo mia abiriyo mane gin joma olony kendo jotend anywola, omiyo Ruoth Daudi noketogi jotend jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus dhood jo-Manase e yore duto mag tich Nyasaye to gi tije mag ruoth.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

kikuyu: nyikwa Mikmash, ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gariyo (122),
english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

kikuyu: Ne, anakelgi ka gia e piny man yo nyandwat, kendo achokgi ka gia e tungʼ piny ka tungʼ piny duto. Dhano ma galamoro nodwogi motingʼo muofni kod rongʼonde, mine ma yach kod mamuoch kayo.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.

kikuyu: Tondegi mag meli obwodhore: Tanga ok otwe motegno, ok ginyal kwangʼ maber. Eka gik moyaki ibiro pogi kendo kata mana joma rongʼonde noyud pok.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Inyalo dhi.” Eka noweye modhi kuom dweche ariyo. En kaachiel gi nyiri mamoko nodhi ewi gode kendo ne giywak nikech ok bi kende.
english: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

kikuyu: To ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachoni: “Ee, joma otwe inyalo gol e lwet jolweny maroteke, kendo ngʼama omaki inyalo gamo e lwet joma kwiny; anaked gi jogo makedo kodu, kendo anares nyithindu.
english: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane giwuok e gode mag Abarim negibuoro e pewe mag Moab mokiewo gi Jordan momanyore gi Jeriko.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Josef ne ok nyal gengʼo mirima mane en-go e nyim joma ne tiyone. Kendo noywak matek niya, “Goluru ngʼato angʼata oko e nyima!” Kuom mano ne onge ngʼato angʼata mane nigi Josef kane ohulore ne owetene.
english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko, Abisalom nongʼiewo gari gi farese kendo ne en gi ji piero abich mane ringo e nyime.
english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

kikuyu: “Un kende ema aseyiero kuom ogendini duto manie piny; mano emomiyo abiro kumou kuom richou duto musetimo.”
english: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

kikuyu: To odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo gadek mar dwe mar abiriyo nomiyo ji thuolo mondo odog e miechgi ka gimor gi ilo e chunygi nikech gik mabeyo mane Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni Daudi gi Solomon kendo ni joge Israel.
english: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

kikuyu: “Ne agolo tingʼ mapek e gokgi, mi lwetgi nogony e tingʼo atonge.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

kikuyu: Gima odongʼ kuom lopno; motongʼ gi lowo maler mopwodhi, momakore kode nobed kilomita abich, bathe mochomo wuok chiengʼ kod kilomita abich, bathe mochomo yo podho chiengʼ. Gimoro amora machiek e dala maduongʼno ema nobed chiemb joma tiyo kanyo.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

kikuyu: Ma e Benaya mane achiel kuom thuondi piero adek madongo kendo en ema notelonegi. Wuode miluongo ni Amizabad notelo ne migape.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

kikuyu: Kane jodong Israel duto osechopo, jodolo nokawo Sandug Muma,
english: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼatni miluongo ni Sheshbaza nobiro mi oketo mise mar od Nyasaye e Jerusalem. Kochakore e odiechiengno nyaka sani pod igere to pod ok otieke.
english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro goyo Misri gi masiche, nogogi kendo bangʼe nochang-gi. Giniduogi ir Jehova Nyasaye, mi nowinj kwayogi kendo ochang-gi.
english: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

kikuyu: “Koso en ngʼa mosengʼeyo pach Jehova Nyasaye ma dingʼadne rieko?” Wan to wan gi pach Kristo.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

kikuyu: Omiyo kik uwe Hezekia wuondu kendo mi ulal kama. Kik uyie kode nikech onge nyasach oganda kata pinyruoth moro amora ma osereso joge e lweta kata e lwet kwerena. Omiyo ere kaka nyasachu noresu e lweta!”
english: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Pigni mol kochomo gwengʼ man yo wuok chiengʼ kendo odhi piny kokadho Araba nyaka e Nam Makwar. Ka oolo pige, to pi man kanyo thiwore doko maliw.
english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

kikuyu: Reuel nopenjo nyige niya, “En kanye? Marangʼo uweye? Luongeuru mondo oyud gimoro ocham.”
english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”

kikuyu: Dan nobed ka thuol man e dir yo, thuol man-gi kwiri mager e yo, ma kayo ombongʼ Faras mondo ngʼama oidhe ochwanyre magore piny gi kangʼeye.
english: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

kikuyu: Un mon, winjuru chwou, mana kaka owinjore kuom Ruoth.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

kikuyu: Puothe okethore, lowo otwo; cham okethore, divai manyien orumo, mo bende onge.
english: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

kikuyu: E dier otieno tir Jehova Nyasaye nonego nyithindo ma yawuowi makayo duto mag jo-Misri, kochakore gi kach ruoth Farao mane ni e kom duongʼ nyaka kach joma ni e od twech, kaachiel gi nyithindo makayo duto mag jamni.
english: At midnight, the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Kochopo odhiambo to uwacho ni ‘piny kiny nolendi nikech polo mamarmar,’
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

kikuyu: Dende nechalo gi kidi ma nengone tek miluongo ni krisolit, lela wangʼe ne chalo gi mil polo, to wengene ne mil ka mach makakni, bedene gi tiendene ne mil ka mula morudhi maler, kendo dwonde ne chalo gi dwond oganda maduongʼ.
english: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa mondo odhi ir Farao kendo onyise niya, Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “We joga odhi mondo gilama.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nokedo gi jo-Amalek kochakore Havila nyaka ochopo Shur to nyaka ochopo yo wuok chiengʼ mar Misri.
english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

kikuyu: To koro ungʼeyo gima pod omone fwenyore, ni nyaka obi mana e kinde moketne.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

kikuyu: ne okweyo ahiti mobet mos; kendo apaka nolingʼ thi.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

kikuyu: Nomedo dwoke niya, “ ‘Her Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi gi chunyi duto gi paroni duto, gi tekoni duto kendo gi riekoni duto;’ kendo ni, ‘Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.’”
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Musa ne oparo ni owetene ma jo-Israel ne nyalo neno ni Nyasaye ema notiyo kode mondo ogolgi e twech, to ne ok gineno kamano.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, jal mane ochweyi, ei minu, kendo mabiro konyi wacho: Kik ibed maluor, yaye Jakobo jatichna, in Jeshurun maseyiero.
english: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

kikuyu: Nyithindwa kod mondewa, rombwa kod dhowa biro dongʼ e miech Gilead ka.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

kikuyu: To nikech Daudi jatichna kod dala mar Jerusalem maseyiero e kind dhoudi duto mag Israel, obiro bedo gi dhoot achiel.
english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

kikuyu: Musa noa malo modhi ir Dathan kod Abiram, kendo jodong Israel noluwe.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

kikuyu: Wasigu masanda thoth adier, to kata kamano pok abaro aweyo chikeni.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Gershon, ne nitiere jo-Libni gi Shimei; mago ema ne joka Gershon.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane Nyasaye onyiso Isaya wuod Amoz e fweny kuom Babulon:
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

kikuyu: Kane oganda owinjo wachneno, negihum gi puonjne.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Pi wangʼ bubni kawuok e wengena, nimar chikni ok ji orito.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

kikuyu: “Anatiekgi ka rombe mitero kar yengʼo, ka imbe kod diek.
english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

kikuyu: E otienono chwo ma Gibea noluwo bangʼa ma gilworo ot, ka gin giparo mar nega. Negiterore gi chiega githuon, mi otho.
english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

kikuyu: Ma notimore nikech ne ok girito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi, to negiketho singruok mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye ochikogi. Kata kamano ne ok girito chikene kata timo dwarone.
english: because they didn’t obey the LORD their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

kikuyu: Paruru nine un wasumbini e piny Misri. Mano emomiyo achikou mondo utim kamano.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar Shem, Ham kod Jafeth ma yawuot Nowa ma bende nonywolo yawuowi bangʼ ataro mangʼongo.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

kikuyu: “Ka koro Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, oseriembo jo-Amor e nyim joge Israel, en thuolo mane ma in-go mar kawe?
english: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

kikuyu: Anaduog Juda kod Israel koa e twech kendo analosgi gibed kaka ne gin chon.
english: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first.

kikuyu: Ahaz ne ja-higni piero ariyo kane obedo ruoth kendo nobedo e loch kodak Jerusalem kuom higni apar gauchiel kodak Jerusalem. To timbene ne ok longʼo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kaka timbe Daudi kwar mare ne chalo.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, like David his father,

kikuyu: Nyithindo mane inywolo ka in e chandruok nowachni kiwinjo ni, Kaeni tin-nwa; dwarnwa kama lach mondo wadagie.
english: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

kikuyu: kendo negikelo joma ne omaki, gik mane ope kod mane oyaki ne Musa gi Eliazar ma jadolo kod oganda jo-Israel e kargi mar bworo mantiere e pewe Moab, man but Jordan loka mar Jeriko.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi gi joma nenikode nomako lepgi moyiecho.
english: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

kikuyu: To mano kaka Esau ibiro choko gigene kendo mwandune mopandi noyaki!
english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

kikuyu: Nikech joma timbegi mono ok oluoro Nyasaye, ok ginine maber kendo ngimagi nolal mana ka tipo.
english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

kikuyu: Ikelo joneno manyien mondo okweda kendo imedo bedo mager koda; jolweny magi monja mana ka apaka magingore.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

kikuyu: Ma e girkeni mar dhood Juda, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

kikuyu: Ne gipenjogi niya, “Bende ngʼatni e wuodu ma uwacho ni nonywol muofu? Obet nade ni koro onyalo neno?”
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

kikuyu: Eka abiro golo lweta kuomi mi inine mana ngʼeya, to wangʼa to ok nine.”
english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

kikuyu: Onego gipak nying Jehova Nyasaye gin duto, nimar nyinge kende ema nigi duongʼ; kendo duongʼne maler oyombo piny gi polo.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: E seche mag angʼich welo, e sa michiegoe dhoranga dala maduongʼ, jogi nowuok. Ok angʼeyo yo mane gidhiyoe. Ringuru bangʼ-gi piyo. Unyalo makogi.”
english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

kikuyu: Kwerewa nochamo manna e thim; mana kaka ondiki ni, ‘Nomiyogi chiemo moa e polo mondo gicham.’”
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

kikuyu: “Abiro oro kihondkona otel nyimu kendo anami piny ka piny ma uromogo bagni. Anami wasiku duto ringu.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kikuyu: Yawuowi abich mamoko mane Zerubabel onywolo ne gin: Hashuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia kod Jushab-Hesed.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Mogik, pinyruoth mar angʼwen matek ka chuma nobi, nikech chuma toyo kendo rego gimoro amora, to kaka chuma toyo gik moko matindo tindo, e kaka en bende obiro rego kendo toyo pinyruodhi mamoko duto.
english: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

kikuyu: mondo omi ogor kido mabeyo mag dhahabu gi fedha kod mula,
english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone jo-Israel duto niya, “Un chungʼuru konchiel ka an kod Jonathan wuoda to wachungʼ bathe komachielo.” Ji nodwoko niya, “Tim gima ineno ni berni.”
english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama ngimane oriere ler rienyne kata gotieno, ngʼat mangʼwon, ma kecho ji kendo makare.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, jatichni osewinjo gadiera ni Saulo chano biro Keila mondo oketh dala nikech an.
english: Then David said, “O LORD, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.

kikuyu: Ler mar Israel nolokre mach, Jal Maler margi nolokre mach mangʼangʼni; ei odiechiengʼ achiel kende nowangʼ motiek pep kuthe kod pedo mag ruodh Asuria.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo, Nyasacha, ni inono chuny ji kendo imor gi ngʼama timbene beyo. Asechiwo gigi duto gimor kod chuny makare. To bende aseneno kuom mor ma jogi man ka osechiworenigo.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo owinjo mano luoro kod kibaji nogoye mangʼeny mi nopogo jambe, gi dhoge kod ngamia e migepe ariyo.
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
