kikuyu: Ka ji duto nonene kowuotho kendo kopako Nyasaye,
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Paulo noa Athene modhi Korintho.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

kikuyu: Aseneno tingʼ mapek ma Nyasaye oseketo kuom ji.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: An Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou Misri. Ngʼamuru dhou malach mondo apongʼe.
english: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

kikuyu: E tiengʼ mar angʼwen nyikwayi nodwogi ka, nikech e ndalogo ema noyud ka richo jo-Amor osemedore moromo kum.”
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

kikuyu: Wach mokor kuom jo-Arabu: Un jo-Dedan ma jo-ohala mawuotho ka gi kacha ka bworo e thim jo-Arabu,
english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

kikuyu: Kane kerubigo dhi to tiendegi mane ni e bethegi bende ne dhi; kendo kane giyaro bwombegi mondo gihu, to tiendegi siko kodgi.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

kikuyu: Nikech Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye, mane wayalonu wachne, wan gi Sila gi Timotheo, ne ok en “ee” gi “ooyo” to osebedo “ee” kinde duto,
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

kikuyu: En ngʼa mabiro kela e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno? Ngʼa mabiro telona nyaka Edom?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane okor kuom Misri: To neuru, Jehova Nyasaye biro piyo piyo koa e boche polo kochomo Misri. Nyiseche mopa mag Misri kirni e nyime kendo jo-Misri dhi ka rumo.
english: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.

kikuyu: Iniwach niya, “Abiro monjo piny moro ma mier mantie ok ochiel, abiro goyo piny ma joma odakie ohero kwe kendo onge gima obadho, ma gin joma odak mak ochielo miechgi gi ohinga kendo ma ok lor dhorangeyegi gi thigo kata gi chumbe.
english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo mangʼeny, e higa mar adek, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Elija mowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo inyisri ni Ahab kendo abiro kelo koth e piny.”
english: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ne wakwangʼ mos gi thagruok kuom ndalo mangʼeny nikech kwangʼ ne rach, eka achien ne wachopo machiegni gi dho wadh Sinido. Kaka yamo koro nomedore ma ok wanyal chome tir, ne wakwangʼ kwagengʼore e bath Krete, mochomore gi sori mar Salmone.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

kikuyu: Negidhi Gilead kod gwenge mag Tatim Hodshi, mi gikadho nyaka Dan Jaan kendo negigomo ka gichiko Sidon.
english: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

kikuyu: Paruru ndalo mosekadho, parane weche mag tiengʼ mokadho. Penjuru wuonu, to obiro nyisou, bende penjuru jodongo, to gibiro leronu.
english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: Ka ipuonjo Jowete wechegi to ibiro bedo jatich maber mar Kristo Yesu, ka idongori e adiera mar yie gi puonj mabeyo miseluwo.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Sadukai mawacho ni chier onge nobiro ire gi penjo moro.
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo tim mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye; ne wigi owil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi mi gitiyone Baal kod Ashera.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Moseroth mi gibworo Bene Jaakan.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

kikuyu: “Malit ochomou, un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uwuotho alanda, kungʼado piny gi nembe mondo ulokie kata ngʼato achiel, to koselokore to umiyo obedo koth Gehena moloyou nyadiriyo.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo anindo e kitandana, ne aleko lek mane obwoga, omiyo ne abedo gi luoro ahinya.
english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

kikuyu: Daudi nochoko jo-Israel duto Jerusalem mondo gikel Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye kama ne oselosone.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo luto lwete malal ei tawo; onyap ahinya ma ok onyal gole oko moduoge e dhoge.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

kikuyu: (E kindeno ne achungʼ e kindu gi Jehova Nyasaye ka asomoneu wach Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ne uluoro mach kendo ne ok uidho got.) Eka nowacho niya,
english: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomedo wachone Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ duto gimino koda wach; kinde duto gichano kaka digihinya.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

kikuyu: Dier ngʼe nyangʼno nigi okumba mar kalagakla ma ok pogre;
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

kikuyu: kod gik mangima mane ni kodu kaka winy, jamni kod le mag bungu; kod mago duto mane owuok ei yie ma gin gik moko duto mangima modak e piny.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mane owinja ne loso maber kuoma, kendo joma nonena ne pwoya,
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

kikuyu: Lop dhood Isakar ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Simeon kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

kikuyu: Kendo kuom rachungi taya enobedie kikombe angʼwen molos machal gi maupe mag oyungu mathiewo kendo golo thuoke.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: Kik isand ja-Israel wadu kata matin, to iluor Nyasachi.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

kikuyu: E kinde mane Musa obuoro kamoro e kor yo, Jehova Nyasaye noromo kode kendo nochiegni nege.
english: On the way at a lodging place, the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him.

kikuyu: kod ute mag jodolo ne lachgi oromo fut piero adek kolworo hekalu duto.
english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

kikuyu: To kane oneno jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai ka biro kama ne obatisoe ji, nowachonegi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Jal mayawo yore modinore nodhi nyimgi kotelonegi. Ginimuom rangach mi gitony. Ruodhgi nokwong okadh kotelonegi. Jehova Nyasaye notelnegi.”
english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.

kikuyu: To in kaachiel gi yawuoti gi nyigi unyalo chamo agoko mane olier mifwayo kaachiel gi bam mane ochiw e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Chamgiuru kama owal ni Jehova Nyasaye, nimar osemiyigi in kaachiel gi nyithindo kaka pokni mar misango mar lalruok ne jo-Israel.
english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji abichgo noa mi gichopo Laish, kama negineno ka ji odak kanyo gi kwe, mana kaka jo-Sidon, maonge paro moro amora kata kibaji kendo negidak gi kwe. To nikech pinygi ne ok ochando gimoro amora, ne gin joma omewo. Bende, negidak mochwolore gi jo-Sidon kendo ne gionge gi osiep gi ngʼato angʼata.
english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.

kikuyu: kaachiel gichwero remo maonge ketho. Jehova Nyasaye ne ok oikore mar weyone richone nikech nosechwero remo maonge ketho mopongʼogo Jerusalem.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

kikuyu: mondo ji one kendo ongʼe, mondo gipar kendo gibed giwinjo, ni lwet Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo kamano, kendo ni Nyasaye Maler mar Israel ema osemiyo magi otimore.”
english: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

kikuyu: Kane iloso ni in iwuon kuonde motingʼore gi malo e akek yore duto mag dala kendo igero ni iwuon kuonde motingʼore mag lemo kamoro amora, to in ne ok ichalo gi ochot, nikech ne ok idwaro chudo moro amora.
english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

kikuyu: Rit chikni e ndalo mowal higa ka higa.
english: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

kikuyu: Yesu nogwelo jopuonjrene ire mokonegi niya, “Awachonu adier dhako ma chwore otho modhierni osegolo pesa mangʼeny e keno moloyo ji mamoko duto.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

kikuyu: Winji! Abiro goyo chunye gi kihondko ma kowinjo wach moro to noring odog e pinygi, to kuno ema nachiwe mondo onege gi ligangla.’ ”
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

kikuyu: Ji biro podho nikech gik malich matimore, ka luoro omakogi nikech gima biro timore e piny, nimar chwech mag polo noyiengni.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Ka jadolo oneno dende modholore, to nowach ni ogak. Dende modholoreno ogak; en gi tuo malandore.
english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka none, kendo ka kuonde malit olokore rachar, to jadolo noland ni ngʼama ogakno ler; eka enobed maler.
english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

kikuyu: Ubiro ketho tekreu kayiem nono, kuchwoyo cham nimar chambu ok nochiegi, kata yedheu bende ok nonyag olembe.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

kikuyu: In iluongori ni ja-Yahudi; kendo iyiengori kuom Chik, kendo ipakori in ngʼat Nyasaye.
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

kikuyu: Paulo notimo mano kuom higni ariyo, mi jo-Yahudi duto gi jo-Yunani manodak e piny Asia nowinjo wach Ruoth.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Musa nochiwo ne Harun kod yawuote pesa miwarogo jo-Israel momedore mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Donge aseywago joma ni e chandruok? Donge chunya bedo malit kaparo jodhier?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

kikuyu: To jomoko kuomgi nojarogi kawacho niya, “Jogi osemadho kongʼo mangʼeny momerogi.”
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

kikuyu: To duongʼ mar Nyasaye mar Israel nodar oa ewi kerubi kama ne osebetie, mi ohuyo modhi obet ewi kama idonjogo ei hekalu. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye noluongo ngʼat mane orwako law mayom-cha, mane otingʼo gir ndiko e bathe,
english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

kikuyu: To ka Nyasaye, mane owala mi oketa tenge kaka gir tichne kane pok onywola, kendo mane oluonga kuom ngʼwonone, nohero
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Asher kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Ne en-gi mon mia abiriyo monywol e ut ruodhi kod mon moketo mia adek, kendo mondego nowite.
english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

kikuyu: Orundore koni gi koni nimar en chiemb achudhe adier; ongʼeyo ni odiechieng mudho ni machiegni.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Itimo gigi gi teko mane, koso ngʼa momiyi teko mar timogi?”
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore gerore kende owuon, to ngʼat ma hulo wach moa kuom Nyasaye gero kanisa.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

kikuyu: Gigi notimore mondo Ndiko ochop kare kaka nondiki niya, “Onge kata choke achiel ma notur.”
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

kikuyu: “Kindeno ema nonywolie Musa, nyathi mane jaber e nyim Nyasaye kendo nopidhe e od wuon-gi kuom dweche adek.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

kikuyu: Uchungo ka mondo utim singruok gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, singruok ma Jehova Nyasaye timo kodu kawuononi gi kwongʼruok chopo kare,
english: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ei dala maduongʼno, ne nitie kama oger motegno motingʼore gi malo, kendo ji duto, chwo gi mon nodhi mopondo kanyo. Ne gilorore e iye mi giidho ewi kama oger motegnono.
english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho wechegi duto ka ji winjo, nodhi modonjo Kapernaum.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

kikuyu: To nyathino nodongo kendo nobedo motegno e chuny; bende nodak e thim nyaka nochopo chiengʼ mane onyisore ratiro e nyim Israel.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, waweuru ngʼado ne jowetewa bura. Kar timo kamano to temuru matek mondo kik ngʼato kuomu oket rachwany kata ragengʼ e yor nyawadgi.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi divai mamoro chuny dhano, gi mo mamiyo lela wangʼe leny, kod makati molerogo chunye.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho, mi ogonye oa e rem malit mar tho, nikech kata mana tho ne ok nyal loye.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel mondo owach niya, “Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Kerubigo noyaro bwombegi ewi kama noketie Sandug Muma gi ludhe mitingʼego.
english: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

kikuyu: Ere kaka uwuoyo kamano to ukia gima kiny notimre. Uparo ni ngimau en angʼo? Ngimau chalo mana ka ongʼwengʼo mineno sa matin kende to bangʼe lal nono.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

kikuyu: Yie kendo ikaw odiechiengni obed ei chunyi ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye e polo malo kendo e piny mwalo. Onge Nyasaye moro machielo.
english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

kikuyu: “Kaw achiel kuom imbego kendo Harun kaachiel gi yawuote noyie lwetgi e wiye.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Chike mamiyou kawuono onego bed e chunyu.
english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E ndalogo, kakwanu osemedore mangʼeny e piny, ji ok nochak owuo kawacho ni, ‘Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.’ Ok enodonji e parogi bende ok ginipare; ok nodware, kata moro ok nolosi kendo.
english: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of the LORD’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

kikuyu: Lew ngʼat mariek konyore gi rieko, to dho ngʼat mofuwo hulo gik mofuwo.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

kikuyu: “Wan wawegi nonywolwa jo-Yahudi to ok joma ok jo-Yahudi ma joricho,
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

kikuyu: kod Koz, mane wuon Anub, to gi Hazobeba kod anywola mar Aharhel wuod Harum.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

kikuyu: Kamano Ahab nochiko rowere ma jotend lweny mag gwenge maromo ji mia ariyo gi piero adek gariyo. Eka nochoko jo-Israel mamoko maromo ji alufu abiriyo koriwore.
english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

kikuyu: “Ma e wend ywak ma gibiro dengonego. Nyi ogendini biro dengo ka were; gibiro were ka giywago kode Misri gi ogandane duto, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Obiro ngʼado bura e kind ogendini kendo nokel kwe e kind pinje marateke man machiegni kod mago man mabor. Ginithedh ligengligi olokre kwe mag pur kendo tongegi ginithedhi olokre pende keyo. Onge piny mano kedi gi nyawadgi gi ligangla bende ok ginichak gipuonjre ne lweny kendo.
english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

kikuyu: Omiyo nomiye Bilha jatichne obedo chiege. Jakobo nobedo kode achiel,
english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

kikuyu: Jatichu oseyudo kech e wangʼu, kendo usenyisa ngʼwono maduongʼ kuom reso ngimana. To kata kamano ok anyal ringo nyaka e gode; nono to chandruogni ojuka mi anyalo atho.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

kikuyu: “ ‘Neuru odiechiengʼno! Odiechiengno koro osechopo! Chandruok osechopo, kum osedonjo, kendo sunga maru osenenore ratiro!
english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

kikuyu: E higa mar ochiko mar loch Hoshea, ruodh Asuria nokawo Samaria kendo nomako jo-Israel motero e twech Asuria. Nomiyogi kar dak Hala kod Gozan man but Aora Habor kaachiel gi mier mag Medes.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

kikuyu: Lembi ma iumo gi nanga chalo gi olemo mongʼinore mochiek makwar.
english: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

kikuyu: to Eliab wuod Helon notelo ne dhood Zebulun.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

kikuyu: Ne giwuotho mi gikwako piny duto, kendo negilworo kambi mar jo-Nyasaye, dala maduongʼ ma Nyasaye ohero. To mach ne oa e polo mobiro e piny kendo nowangʼogi motiekogi.
english: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

kikuyu: Eka naneno ondiek malich machielo kawuok ei piny. Ne en gi tunge ariyo machalo gi mar nyarombo, to nowuoyo kaka thuol mangʼongo wuoyo.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny maduongʼ nodhi ir Paulo mopenje niya, “Nyisa ane! In ja-Rumi?” Paulo nodwoke niya, “Ee, an ja-Rumi.”
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

kikuyu: Samuoyo kelo nindo matut, to ngʼat ma ja-mifwadhi bedo gi kech.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno nobednu Sabato mar yweyo, kendo nyaka une ni uriyo kech. Chakre odhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mar ochiko mar dwe nyaka kinyne godhiambo, nyaka urit Sabato maru.”
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

kikuyu: To kata ka dipo ni ok otimo kamano, to wadwaro ni mondo ingʼe, yaye ruoth, ni ok wabi tiyone nyisecheni kata lamo kido mar dhahabu misechungo.”
english: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”

kikuyu: Kane osetwe Johana e od twech, Yesu nodhi Galili, koyalo Injili mar Nyasaye.
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

kikuyu: Ogwetho koikore ne lweny; nikech ok onyal lingʼ mos ka turumbete oseywak.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gabiriyo ne mar Joshbekasha gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kik umedi kata ugol gimoro amora kuom chik ma amiyou, to rituru chike ma amiyou mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

kikuyu: Nyis jotich molony duto ma asemiyo rieko e yore machalo kamago ni mondo gilos ne Harun lewnigo mag pwodhruok mondo otinago kaka jadolo.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Joshua niya, “Ne, asechiwo Jeriko gi ruodhe e lweti, kaachiel gi jolweny mage.
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Eka inipenjri e chunyi ni, ‘En ngʼa mane onywolona jogi? Ne an gi kuyo kendo ne an migumba, ne otera e twech kendo ojwangʼa. En ngʼa manopidhogi? Ne adongʼ kenda, to jogi to oa kure?’ ”
english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”

kikuyu: kendo ogero ode moluore ewi pi. Oidho boche polo kaka gache mar lweny kendo yamo e ndike moriembo.
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Obiro bedo ni mor kod ilo, to ji mangʼeny nomor nikech nywolne,
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

kikuyu: Le oseketi e tiend yiende kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Bi ka abiro miyo winy ma e kor yamo ringi gi le man e thim.”
english: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”

kikuyu: Nyasach Israel nowuoyo; Lwanda mar Israel nowachona ni: Ka ngʼato otelo ni ji e yo makare, kendo ka olocho koluoro Nyasaye,
english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa gi Harun niya, “Magi e chike monego urit ka utimo Pasaka. “Jopinje mamoko kik chame.
english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

kikuyu: Ne achano mondo alimu kane anie wuodha adhi Makedonia, bende ne achano rawo iru ka aa kuno, mondo ayud kony kuomu e wuodha madhi Judea.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

kikuyu: Kamano bende kelnauru chiwo mitimogo misengini miwangʼo pile pile kuom ndalo abiriyo mondo chiemba odungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye; kendo nyaka ulose kumedo gi misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile kod misango miolo piny.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Jakobo nosea Padan Aram, nochopo maber e dala maduongʼ mar Shekem manie piny Kanaan kendo nodak momanyore gi dalano.
english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno duto lweny nomedo bedo mager kendo noten ruoth e gache komanyore gi jo-Aram. Remo mane chwer kawuok kama nohinyore nopongʼo i gari, kendo godhiambo notho.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nochiko mondo okele kigole Lo Debar e od Makir wuod Amiel.
english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

kikuyu: Kane Nyasaye owinjogi, iye nowangʼ ahinya, kendo nokwedo jo-Israel chuth.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

kikuyu: Ok gini ngʼi kende mag misango, kata kuom tije mag lwetgi, kendo ok ginibed gi luor ne sirni mag Ashera kata ne kende miwangʼoe ubani ma lwetgi oloso.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.

kikuyu: Jo-Amalek odak Negev; jo-Hiti, jo-Jebus kod jo-Amor odak e piny manie got; to jo-Kanaan odak machiegni gi dho nam e alwora mar Jordan.”
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Musa to nowachone niya, “Ka iyie to kik iwewa. In ema ingʼeyo kambi monego wadhi wadagie thimni, kendo in e wangʼwa.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

kikuyu: “Koro aketou e lwet Nyasaye, kendo kuom wach ngʼwonone, manyalo gerou, kendo manyalo miyo uyud gweth mosekan-nu kaachiel gi jomaler duto.
english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

kikuyu: Yawuot Juda ne gin: Er, Onan, Shela, Perez kod Zera (to Er kod Onan ne otho e piny Kanaan). Yawuot Perez ne gin: Hezron kod Hamul.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Negitimore marach mana ka ji mangʼawo leyegi malo ka gidwaro tongʼo yiende madongo dongo modongo modhigore.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Ok unyal kelo jogo ma umako kaeni, nimar kutimo kamano to wanabed joketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Koso udwaro medo richo ewi mago ma wasetimo? Richo ma wasetimo duongʼ moloyo kendo mirimbe mager ni kuom Israel.”
english: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against the LORD, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”

kikuyu: Ne ochako ogero kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo ma wuon mare Hezekia nomuko; to bende nogero kende mag misengini miwangʼoe liswa ne Baal kendo oloso siro milamo mar Ashera, mana kaka Ahab ruodh Israel notimo; bende nokulore kolamo gik moko duto mochwe man e kor polo.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

kikuyu: Eka Herode gi askechene nojare kendo nonyiere. Negirwake gi kandho marakido maber, negidwoke ir Pilato.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

kikuyu: To Maritha nodich gi tich mangʼeny mane nyaka tim. Nodhi ire mopenjo niya, “Ruoth, ok idewo ni nyaminwa oweya atiyo mana kenda nyise mondo okonya!”
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Ondanyo mar singruok.” Miktam mar Daudi. Mar puonjo. Kane okedo gi Aram-Naharaim kod Aram Zoba, kendo kane Joab odwogo mi onego jo-Edom alufu apar gariyo e Holo mar Chumbi. Yaye Nyasaye, isedagiwa mi imuomori kuomwa; isebedo ka ikecho kodwa, to koro loswa!
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. E dwol mar “Kik iketh gik moko.” Zaburi mar Asaf. Wer. Wagoyoni erokamano, yaye Nyasaye, wagoyoni erokamano nimar Nyingi ni machiegni, kendo ji lando timbeni miwuoro.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

kikuyu: “Ne ni ok inyiso ngʼato wachni. To dhiyo mondo inyisri ne jadolo kendo ichiw misengini ma Musa nochiko nikech pwodhruokni, mano nobed ranyisi ne gin.”
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar nyasi mar makati ma ok oketie Thowi, jopuonjre nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “Idwaro mondo wadhi waikni kama ichame Pasaka kanye?”
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Kane gisechopo weche duto mondiki kuome, ne gigole ewi yath mi gikete e liel.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

kikuyu: Beduru mangʼwon kendo gi kech ni joweteu, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato weyo ni nyawadgi richone, mana kaka un bende Nyasaye noweyonu richou kuom Kristo.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

kikuyu: Negidhi kama iluongo ni Gethsemane. Yesu nowacho ne jopuonjrene niya, “Beduru ka e kinde ma alamo.”
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

kikuyu: Mana kamano, awachonu e kaka mor e nyim malaika mag Nyasaye nobedie kuom jaricho achiel moweyo richo.”
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke kapenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo iluonga ni ngʼama ber? Onge ngʼama ber, makmana Nyasaye kende.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

kikuyu: Otienono Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Gideon niya, “Aa malo, dhiyo imonj kambi, nikech adhi chiwe e lweti.
english: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

kikuyu: Yaye in ligangla mabith neg ji koni gi koni, kendo ineg ji kamoro amora michomo.
english: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.

kikuyu: To apongʼ gi mirima mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ok anyal lingʼ kode. “Ole oko kuom nyithindo manie yore, kendo kuom yawuowi mochokore kanyakla; dichwo kaachiel gi dhako gini nomaki, kod joma oti, jogo mahikgi oniangʼ.
english: Therefore I am full of the LORD’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.

kikuyu: En dwaro Nyasaye mondo ubed jomaler. Nyasaye dwaro ni ubed mabor gi timbe mag terruok
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Dhano ok bed mangima nikech chiemo kende.’”
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

kikuyu: Eka ne gichak giluongogi mi gisiemogi ni kik giwuo kata puonjo e nying Yesu.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno maluwo tim makare kod hera yudo ngima, mwandu gi luor.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

kikuyu: Kapok ne Yesu obiro, Johana noyalo Injili ne jo-Israel duto mondo gilokre giwe richogi kendo giduto giyud batiso.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

kikuyu: ne En mane ogoyo ruodhi madongo piny, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Rieko Solomon ne duongʼ moloyo jorieko duto manie yo wuok chiengʼ, bende noduongʼ moloyo rieko duto mag Misri.
english: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

kikuyu: to ngʼeuru ni ngʼat modwoko jaricho mobayo yo oreso chunye kuom tho kendo omiyo owene richone mathoth.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: Ibiro tingʼo chandruok duto mosebironi nikech timbeni mamono kendo nikech timbeni moyombore, Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bende ne amiyogi Sabato maga kaka ranyisi e kinda kodgi, mondo omi gingʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema ne amiyo gibedo maler.
english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

kikuyu: Ka atiyo e dier joma onge chik, ne adoko machal kodgi (kata obedo ni chik Nyasaye ok oweya oko nikech an e bwo chik Kristo), eka alok joma onge chik.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

kikuyu: En ne ok okete jadolo kaluwore gi chike dhano kata anywola mowuokie, to nokete nikech teko mar ngima maonge gima nyalo ketho.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

kikuyu: Notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache kendo ne ok obolore e nyim Jeremia janabi mane nyise wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the LORD’s mouth.

kikuyu: Paruru gima ne jo-Amalek otimonu kane uwuok Misri.
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

kikuyu: Kane jaduongʼne oneno gik moko duto mane Musa timo ne oganda, nowacho ne kama, “En angʼo ma itimo ne ogandani? En angʼo momiyo in kendi ema ibedo kaka jangʼad bura, ka jogi olwori chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo?”
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

kikuyu: Un joma omiyo Jehova Nyasaye luor, keturu genou kuome, En e konyruokgi kendo okumbagi.
english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: nikech remb rwedhi gi diek ok nyal golo richo kata matin.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

kikuyu: Nikech koro ungʼeyo wechegi, nogwedhu kutiyo kodgi.”
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

kikuyu: Nus mar dhood jo-Manase ne ngʼeny mokadho; negidak e piny jo-Bashan nyaka Baal Hermon, gi Senir ma en Got Hermon.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en mach matieko gik mowangʼo kendo en Nyasaye ma janyiego.
english: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

kikuyu: Balak notimo kaka Balaam nonyise kendo nochiwo misango mar rwath kod im ewi kendo ka kendo mar misango.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼatno nokela koluwo koda rangach man yo nyandwat mochomo nyim hekalu tir. Nangʼicho, kendo naneno duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye kopongʼo hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, mi napodho piny auma.
english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house; so I fell on my face.

kikuyu: Odhiambo moro Daudi noa malo e kitandane mowuotho alwora mar wi tado mar ode ka en ewi tado noneno dhako moro kaluokore. To dhakono ne jaber ahinya,
english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

kikuyu: mi adwoko ruoth niya, “Ka berne ruoth kendo ka jatichni oyudo ngʼwono e wangʼe, to ber mondo oora e dala maduongʼ man Juda kama kwerena oikie mondo agere kendo.”
english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nongʼiyogi, kogeno yudo gimoro kuomgi.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

kikuyu: to wan wayalo Kristo mane ogur, ma en kidi machwanyo jo-Yahudi kendo en fuwo ni joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

kikuyu: To ka isiemo ngʼat ma timbene richo mondo owe yorenego, to ok otimo kamano, to obiro tho nikech richone, to in to inires ngimani.
english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

kikuyu: Jatelo ma ruoth ne yiengore e goke nowachone ngʼat Nyasaye niya, “Winji, kata ka Jehova Nyasaye nyalo yawo dhorangeye mag polo, bende manyalo timore adier?” Elisha nodwoke niya, “Ibiro neno ma gi wengeni iwuon, to ok inicham gimoro amora kuomgi!”
english: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

kikuyu: Giduto kar rombgi negipongʼ gi Roho Maler, mi gichako wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore kaka Roho nomiyogi teko mar wuoyo.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nopenjo niya, “En dhoot mane e kind dhout Israel duto mapok ochokore e nyim Jehova Nyasaye?” Nimar ne gisekwongʼore ni dhoot moro amora ma ok ochokore e piny Mizpa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka negi.
english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to the LORD?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to the LORD to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

kikuyu: Gibiro loyo piny jo-Asuria gi ligangla, piny jo-Nimrod ibiro loyo gi ligangla mowuodhi. Noresgi e lwet jo-Asuria ka nomonj pinywa, kendo ka nochopi e tongʼwa.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye bor gi ngʼat ma timbene richo, to owinjo lamo mar ngʼat makare.
english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

kikuyu: Wasumbini ema tinde otelonwa, kendo onge ngʼama resowa e lwetgi.
english: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema onego ikwan ka ngʼat maler, en ema onego umiye luor, kendo en ema onego kibaji mare goyi,
english: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

kikuyu: Kwereu duto mane odhi e piny Misri noromo ji piero abiriyo, to koro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyo unyaa mangʼeny mana ka sulwe manie kor polo.
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: E kindeno iniwach niya, “Anapaki, yaye Jehova Nyasaye. Kata obedo ni mirima nomaki koda to mirimbino, koro oserumo kendo isekweyo chunya.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

kikuyu: Nodwoko jatend jogam divai e tije, mondo omi ochak oket kikombe e lwet Farao,
english: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

kikuyu: Moab nokethi; nyithinde matindo noywagre.
english: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

kikuyu: Omiyo chi Jeroboam notimo kaka nonyise modhi e od Ahija man Shilo. Ahija ne muofu ma ok nyal neno, nikech ne oseti.
english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

kikuyu: Ruoth nomuko kuonde motingʼore gi malo mane ni yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jerusalem koma ochomo yo milambo mar Got Kethruok, mane Solomon ruodh Israel ogero ne Ashtoreth, nyasach makwero mar jo-Sidon, gi Kemosh nyasach jo-Moab kod Molek nyasaye manono mar jo-Amon.
english: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Isewacho ni, ‘Aler kendo aonge richo; ngimana ler kendo aonge ketho moro amora.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

kikuyu: To wachnegi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro kawo bap Josef, manie lwet Efraim, kod dhout Israel mamoko duto mawinjore kode, kendo abiro tude gi bap Juda, mi gidok bepe mopa achiel, kendo gibiro doko bepe mopa achiel e lweta.’
english: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

kikuyu: Achiel noket Bethel to machielo noket Dan.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

kikuyu: Dongʼ oko kendo we en ema odonjie ode ogol gima odwa singonino.
english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

kikuyu: kendo negichako neno. Yesu nosiemogi matek niya, “Neuru ni ngʼato ok ongʼeyo wachni.”
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

kikuyu: “Bangʼe initoo njageno ka jok midhigo neno,
english: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,

kikuyu: An ema nachul kuor, abiro chulo. Machiegnini tiendgi biro kier, odiechieng-gi mar masira osekayo machiegni kendo kethruok ochomogi.
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano kendo nongʼingogi. Eka nomiyogi jopuonjre mondo opog ji.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ndalo biro ma ji ok nowach kendo ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, manogolo jo-Israel Misri,’
english: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that they will no more say, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

kikuyu: Negikele to ka jachiendno noneno Yesu, nomiyo rawerano opodho kariere ka ja-ndulme mi nongʼielore e lowo amingʼa ka dhoge wuok buoyo.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ukeyo e puotheu, to kik uka nyaka cham manie giko puodho, kata kik uhul cham modongʼ, mago weuru ni joma odhier kod jodak. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: nimar ginimi yawuotu weya mitine nyiseche mamoko kendo mano dimi mirima mak Jehova Nyasaye mitieku mapiyo nono.
english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodiro suka mane oumorego kucha, mi ochikore ochungʼ gi tiende modhi ir Yesu.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye notingʼo Solomon malo e nyim jo-Israel kendo nomiye duongʼ moloyo ruodhi duto mane osebedo e Israel motelone.
english: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka ndalo ywak norumo, Daudi nowacho mondo okele e ode, mane obedo chiege monywolone nyathi ma wuowi. To gima Daudi notimo ne ok omoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.

kikuyu: Ji ne wuok gokinyi michok manna-go bangʼe giregogi e pongʼ lwedo kata yokogi e pany. Ne gitedogi e agulu kata dwalogi ka ngʼama dwalo makati. Bende ne gichalo gimoro molos gi mo zeituni.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nomiyo Isaka mwandune duto mane en-go.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, owinjore mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato owinj jorit loch, ok mana nikech inyalo yudo kum kende, to bende nikech chunyi neno ni mano ber.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

kikuyu: Kik umok mach e kar daku moro amora chiengʼ Sabato.”
english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano asesingora ni nyaka agolu e thagruok e piny Misri mi akelu e piny jo-Kanaan gi jo-Hiti gi jo-Amor gi jo-Perizi gi jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.’
english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’

kikuyu: Weruru matek gimor un duto, un kuonde mokethore mag Jerusalem, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osehoyo chuny joge, osereso Jerusalem.
english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To jogo duto mane ongʼeye, moriwo koda mon mane oluwe koa Galili, nochungo mochwalore ka gineno gigi.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

kikuyu: Eka Juda nowacho ne Israel wuon mare niya, “We wawuogi kendo adhi gi wuowini, mondo omi wan kod in kod nyithindwa kik kech negwa.
english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

kikuyu: Nodongʼ kopande kaachiel gi japite ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kuom higni auchiel e kinde loch Athalia.
english: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

kikuyu: Lemo mane Habakuk janabi olamo e dwond Shigionot ema:
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

kikuyu: Diponi awacho ni misango mochiwne nyiseche manono en gimoro kata ni nyasaye manono nigi tiende?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho ne ngʼat mane lwete otalno niya, “Chungi ane e nyim ji duto ka.”
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

kikuyu: Oselosne kar nindo e kind joma onegi, ka ogandane duto olworo liende. Gin duto ok otergi nyangu, kendo ligangla onegogi. Nikech mbi margi noselandore e piny joma ngima, gin bende koro wigi okuot kaachiel gi joma ridore kochomo bur matut; osepielgi kaachiel gi joma ne osenegi.
english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano, Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo ok dagi e udi ma dhano ogero, mana kaka janabi owacho niya,
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek rito weche mawuok e dhoge, kendo wechene mowinjore kelo puonj makare.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

kikuyu: kendo e yadh mzabibuno ne nitie bede adek. Kane ochako loth, nogolo thiepene kendo neginyago mzabibu mochiek mana gikanyono.
english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owachonegi niya, “An e En,” negigoyo okangʼ gidok chien mi gipodho piny.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nochokore kanyakla ma giriwore gibedo gimoro achiel ka gikedo gi dala maduongʼno.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

kikuyu: To ka jogwengʼno nofwenyo ni Yesu obiro, negioro wach e gwenge molworo kanyo duto. Ji nokelone joma ne tuo duto
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kikuyu: Israel mowachone Josef niya, “Ne ok apar mar neno wangʼi kendo to koro Nyasaye oseyiena maneno nyaka nyithindi bende.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

kikuyu: Donge ngimana modongʼ matin-ni chiegni rumo? Yie iweya mondo abedie gi yweyo matin,
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

kikuyu: Ruodh Ai kende ema negimako kangima kendo negitere ir Joshua.
english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.

kikuyu: Jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼ motegno e lowo motwo e dier aora Jordan, nyaka ogendini mag jo-Israel notieko kadho ka giwuotho e lowo motwo.
english: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, nawinjo gima chalo gi koko maduongʼ mar oganda ei polo kawacho niya, “Haleluya! Warruok gi duongʼ kod teko odog ne Nyasachwa,
english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

kikuyu: to kata kamano jatelono nowachone Daniel niya, “Aluoro ruodha nikech en ema ogolo chik ni mondo uchiem kendo umethi. Angʼo dimi inenri matin moloyo mbesini mamoko? Ka ok atimoni kamano, to onyalo nega.”
english: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Zedekia nooro wach mondo okelne janabi Jeremia kendo nokelnego e kar donjo mar adek mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ruoth nowachone niya, “Adhi penji gimoro. Kik ipanda wach.”
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in the LORD’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wuothi idhi e nyim oganda. Kaw jodong jo-Israel moko mondo odhi kodi kendo kaw luth mane ichwadogo aora Nael mondo idhigo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

kikuyu: Nitie yo manenore ne dhano ni nikare, to gikone otero mana ngʼato e tho.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Jogi notelo nyimwa mondo oritwa Troa.
english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

kikuyu: Eka notera nyaka yo milambo kendo naneno rangach mochomo kuno. Nopimo sirnigo kod agola mare, kendo ne giromre e pim kaka mamoko.
english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo Jehoyakim ruodh Juda e lwete, kaachiel gi gik moko mitiyogo e hekalu mar Nyasaye. Notingʼo gigi motero nyaka e hekalu mar nyasache, man Babulon, kendo noketogi ei od kano mwandu mar nyasache.
english: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Filistia owinjo ni Daudi osewir bedo ruodh jo-Israel, negiwuok kar rombgi, mondo gidware, to Daudi nowinjo wachno omiyo nowuok modhi kama ochiel motegno.
english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kaw kalatas maduongʼ kendo indik wachni gi kalam mongʼongʼore ni Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz, tiende ni yeko biro chako timore machiegni.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

kikuyu: To bende ewi mano, gibedo jo-samuoyo ma budho abudha, ka gibayo abaya e ute ji koni gi koni. Ok gibed mana jo-samuoyo ma budho abudha kende, to bende gibedo jokuoth ka gichuogore e weche ji mamoko kendo ka giwuoyo e weche ma ok onego giwuoye.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼama dende chwer ongʼulo olawo kuom ngʼama ler, ngʼatni nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: To Kaleb nowacho niya, “Anachiw nyara Aksa mondo okendi gi ngʼatno manoked ma kaw Kiriath Sefa.”
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

kikuyu: Obiro miyo timni makare rieny ka ler mar okinyi, kendo obiro miyo ratiro mari bed machalo gi wangʼ chiengʼ marieny odiechiengʼ tir.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nopodho auma molamo Jehova Nyasaye,
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.

kikuyu: Wan gihera nikech Nyasaye noherowa mokwongo.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

kikuyu: omiyo negimonjo piny Misri duto ma gipoto kamoro amora man thuolo e pinyno. Nyaka nene masira machal kamano mar bonyo ne pok obetie kendo ok nochak obedie kendo.
english: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

kikuyu: Nyisa yoreni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, puonja mondo aluwgi;
english: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

kikuyu: In bende tangʼne, nikech okwedo puonjwa gi tekre duto.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

kikuyu: Wuowi mariek miyo wuon mare mor, to ngʼat mofuwo chayo min mare.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

kikuyu: Kendo wangʼ yo nobedi kanyo, mi noluonge ni Wangʼ Yo Maler. Joma ok ler ok nowuothie, to nobedi wangʼ yo ma joma kare ema luwo, joma ofuwo ma joricho ok nowuothie.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.

kikuyu: “Odiechiengʼ maduongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye chiegni, adier ochiegni kendo obiro piyo. Chik iti! Ywagruok e odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye nobed malit, kendo jolweny bende nogo koko kanyo.
english: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

kikuyu: Awachonu ni adier magi duto biro timore ne tiengʼni.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

kikuyu: Ka kindeno ne pok ochopo, ne onge chudo mane ichulo ji kata jamni. Onge ngʼama ne nyalo timo tijene mapile gi kwe nikech jasike, nikech namiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato olokore jasik nyawadgi,
english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

kikuyu: “Ere ngʼama koro digengʼ jogi mondo kik obatisgi gi pi, ka gin bende giseyudo Roho Maler mana kaka waseyude?”
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato ok dwar kendo chi owadgi ma chwore othono, to dhakono mondo odhi ir jodongo e dhoranga dala kendo owach niya, “Owadgi chwora odagi ok onyal tingʼo kar owadgi ei Israel, odagi timona gima yuoro onego timne chi owadgi.”
english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar angʼwen ne gichiewo gokinyi ka giikore mar wuok, to jaduongʼne nowachone niya, “We iyud gimoro icham; eka idhi.”
english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima ruoth wacho: Kik uyie Hezekia wuondu nikech ok onyal resou!
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

kikuyu: Ka noneno Petro kaoyo mach, nodhi machiegni kode morange matut, bangʼe owachone niya, “In bende ne in gi ja-Nazareth miluongo ni Yesu.”
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Musa nokawo choke Josef ka nowuok nimar Josef noketo yawuot Israel osingore ka kwongʼore. Nowacho niya, “Nyasaye biro resou adier, bangʼe nyaka utingʼ chokena ka ua ka.”
english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

kikuyu: “Yaye dala maduongʼ misando, ma ahiti oyiecho maonge ngʼama hoyo, abiro geri gi kite motegno, kendo miseni anager gi gik mabeyo.
english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

kikuyu: Chik maduongʼ mar ariyo en ni, ‘Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon.’Onge chik maduongʼ moloyo magi.”
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

kikuyu: Kane Bela otho, Jobab wuod Zera mane ja-Bozra nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Roho Maler ne nyiso, kuom kit dolo maka ma, ni yo midonjogo Kama Ler Moloyo ne pok ofwenyore, e kinde duto ma hema machon ne pod ochungʼ!
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nodwoke niya, “Ok wachieli gi kite nikech honni madongo misetimo, to wachieli gi kite nikech iseyanyo Nyasaye. In mana dhano adhanani, ere kaka inyalo ketori ni in Nyasaye?”
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

kikuyu: Eka ji alufu adek moa Juda nodhi e rogo mar lwanda man Etam ma giwachone Samson niya, “Bende ingʼeyo ni wan e bwo loch jo-Filistia? Ma angʼo ma isetimonwani?” Nodwoko niya, “Ne atimonegi mana gima gisetimona.”
english: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam’s rock, and said to Samson, “Don’t you know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?” He said to them, “As they did to me, so I have done to them.”

kikuyu: Mad mesa mochan e nyimgi lokre obadho; kendo mad olokrenegi gir chulo kuor kod otegu.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

kikuyu: Jonywolne nowacho kamano nikech negiluoro jo-Yahudi, nimar noyudo jo-Yahudi osengʼado wach ni ngʼato angʼata ma nohul ni Yesu en Kristo ne ibiro riembi e sinagogi.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

kikuyu: Kane angʼiyo ne aneno ni usetimo ketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu; kendo useloso nyasaye mar kido ma olos ka nyaroya. Uselokoru piyo ma uweyo yo ma Jehova Nyasaye ne ochikou.
english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.

kikuyu: Ka luoro omaka to abiro geno kuomi.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

kikuyu: jo-Hivi, jo-Arki, jo-Sini,
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

kikuyu: Samuel noluongo oganda jo-Israel duto Mizpa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
english: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah;

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Jehonadab wuod Rekab ok nobed maonge gi ngʼama tiyone.’ ”
english: therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”

kikuyu: To jatich nodwoke kawachone niya, “Iwinjo, e dalano nitiere ngʼat Nyasaye moro marahuma kendo gik mowacho duto timore mana kaka owacho. Bi wadhi ire koro nikech onyalo nyisowa yo monego waluw.”
english: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”

kikuyu: Kuthe ema noyugno e utege madongo, aila kod pedo nobed ohingane. Enobed piny mojwangʼ ma ondiegi ema odakie kendo kuonde ma tula odakie.
english: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

kikuyu: to mana kaka antie an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni kata dine bed ni Nowa gi Daniel kod Ayub ni e iye, to ok digires kata mana ngima yawuotgi kata mar nyigi giwegi. Ginires mana ngimagi giwegi nikech timgi makare.
english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe negiloso laru. Yo milambo mar laruno borne ne romo fut mia achiel gi piero abich gachiel kendo ne en gi pasia momin molos gi law mayom,
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

kikuyu: “Abiro kumo jo-Juda kaachiel gi ji duto modak Jerusalem. Abiro tieko jo-Baal duto mane odongʼ ka, mi agol oko nying joma luwo nyiseche mopa kaachiel gi jodologi.
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

kikuyu: To en adier ni ok wanyal bedo maonge gi fuonde ringruok manenorenwa ni nyap.
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

kikuyu: ma wuod Amaria, ma wuod Azaria, ma wuod Merayoth,
english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

kikuyu: Chiegi nochal gi yiend mzabibu manyak maber e odi; nyithindi nochal gi chuny zeituni maloth e kinde ma gilworo mesa ka gichiemo.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho mano mondo onyisgo kit tho ma Petro ne biro miyogo Nyasaye duongʼ. Eka nowachone niya, “Luwa!”
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Otieno mokalo, malaika mar Nyasaye, ma an ngʼate, kendo ma atiyone, nochungʼ batha,
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

kikuyu: Joma ne wan-go bende noneno lerno, to ne ok giwinjo dwond ngʼat mane wuoyo kodano.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

kikuyu: Ji mane odak Jeriko nowachone Elisha niya, “Jaduongʼ neye kaka dalawani oger kama ber, makmana pige ema rach kendo lope ok miyo.”
english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

kikuyu: Ne alamo Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha kendo ne ahulo richona kama: “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye maduongʼ kendo malich, Nyasaye marito singruokne mar hera gi ji duto mohere kendo morito chikene,
english: I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Bangʼe Festo nowacho niya, “Ruoth Agripa kaachiel gi ji duto man kodwa ka, uneno ngʼatni! Jo-Yahudi duto osekwaya chakre Jerusalem nyaka Kaisaria ka gikok ni ok owinjore oweye obed mangima.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

kikuyu: Nywogno nomedo bedo gi teko, to kata obedo ni ne en ratego kamano, to tunge maduongʼno notur mi tunge angʼwen mamoko notwi kanyo kamoro ka moro siemo tunge angʼwen mag polo.
english: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

kikuyu: Nikech jatend jolweny maduongʼ ne dwaro ngʼeyo gimomiyo jo-Yahudi nedonjo ni Paulo, kinyne nogonye mogolo chik mondo jodolo madongo duto gi buch jodong jo-Sanhedrin orom. Eka nokelo Paulo mi ochunge e nyimgi mondo owuo.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehoyakin nolonyo lepe mag twech kendo e ndalo ngimane duto ne ochiemo pile pile e mesa ruoth.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.

kikuyu: En to nowacho niya, “Kata angʼo matimore, to nyaka aring adhi.” Omiyo Joab nowachone niya, “Ringi idhi.” Eka Ahimaz noringo odhi koluwo yor pap moyombo ja-Kush.
english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

kikuyu: tiende ni, chenro mopondono nolerna tiende kaka obet, mana kaka asendikonu gi weche manok.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

kikuyu: Ma e migawo mar chiwo miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye mane opogone Harun gi yawuote e odiechiengʼ mane owalgi mondo gitine Jehova Nyasaye kaka jodolo.
english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;

kikuyu: Beduru mamor kuom wachni, kata obedo ni sani pod uneno sand mopogore opogore kuom kinde matin.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nowacho niya, “Onge ngʼato machielo manyalo tingʼo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye makmana jo-Lawi nikech Jehova Nyasaye noyierogi mondo gitingʼ Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo gitine nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

kikuyu: to abiro keto pien rombo kar dino cham. Kapo ni pien rombono thoo omokoe, to lowo molwore odongʼ kotwo, eka anangʼe ni ibiro reso jo-Israel gi lweta kaka ne iwacho.”
english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

kikuyu: Isemedo ogandawa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isemedo ogandawa. Iseyudo duongʼ mana ne in iwuon; kendo isemedo tongʼ duto mar pinywa.
english: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

kikuyu: Angʼo ma in-go ka sani? Miya makati abich kata gimoro amora minyalo yudo.”
english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda nodhi ir Joshua Gilgal kendo Kaleb ma wuod Jefune ma ja-Kenizi nowachone niya, “Ingʼeyo gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Musa, ngʼat Nyasaye ka en Kadesh Barnea kuomi kod an.
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni onge gimoro kata achiel maber manie iya, tiende ni, kita mar richo. Nimar an-gi gombo mar timo gima ber to ok anyal time.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

kikuyu: Ruoth Ahasuerus noketo osuru e lochne duto nyaka e dho nembe man mabor.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Nyakono ne longʼo kendo noyudo ngʼwono e wangʼ Hegai. Nomiye modhi miwirruokgo gi chiemo mabeyo mana gisano. Nomiye nyiri abiriyo moyier moa e od ruoth bende ne ogole motere kama berie moloyo e od mon kanyo.
english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ndik gigo miseneno, gigo mantie kod gigo mabiro timore e kindego mabiro.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

kikuyu: Ji duto nowuoyo maber kuome kendo negiwuoro ahinya weche mag ngʼwono manowuok e dhoge. Negipenjo niya, “Donge ngʼatni en wuod Josef?”
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

kikuyu: To an ok uyie kuoma nikech awacho adiera!
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, beduru malongʼo chuth mana kaka Wuonu manie polo longʼo chuth.
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

kikuyu: Un to ok un kamano. Kar timo kamano, to ngʼato angʼata madwaro bedo maduongʼ e dieru nyaka bedi jatichu,
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: Kata mana kendo mar misango man Bethel, ma en kar lemo motingʼore gi malo mane olosgi Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo Israel otimo richo bende nomuko. Ne owangʼo kama otingʼore gi malono mi olokore buru bende nowangʼo siro mar Ashera.
english: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

kikuyu: Oruru wach odhi Sayun! Ringuru udhi kar pondo ma ok odeko! Nimar akelo masira koa yo nyandwat, kata kethruok malich.”
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano yier ji mondo odhi omany nyiri mabeyo e pinje duto manie bwo lochni, kendo gikelgi e dalani Susa mondo oketgi e lwet Hegai ma jatich ruoth mabwoch mane jarit mon; kendo mondo omigi modhi mag loso del mondo gibed maberie moloyo.
english: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women’s house, to the custody of Hegai the king’s eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;

kikuyu: Kendo ka iweye mondo odhi ka en thuolo, to kik igole odhi gi lwete nono.
english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

kikuyu: Gin to ginilal nono, In to isiko manyaka chiengʼ, giduto giniti mana kaka law ti.
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
