kikuyu: Nikech jomoko kuomu wacho niya, “Barupene nigi teko kendo wuoyo mager, to ka en kodwa to onenore ngʼama yomyom, kendo koyalo to wechene onge gi teko.”
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye kum Daudi malit ka dipo ni kiny piny orune ngʼato angʼata madichwo e dala maweyo kapod ngima!”
english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

kikuyu: Nyikwa Gershon nopog mier matindo apar gadek koa e anywola mar dhood Isakar, Asher, Naftali, to gi nus mar dhood Manase man Bashan.
english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

kikuyu: “Ka chunya ne dwaro aa ne apari Jehova Nyasaye, kendo lemona nochopo nyaka e hekalu mari maler.
english: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

kikuyu: Wuoda, rit chike wuonu kendo kik iwe puonj minu.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

kikuyu: Misri nokudhi ka thuol maringo ka jasigu masudo machiegni gi teko; giniked kode gi ledhi, mana ka chwo matongʼo yiende.”
english: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

kikuyu: Kane gibiro Geliloth but aora Jordan e piny Kanaan, jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nogero kendo mar misango machiegni gi aora Jordan.
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

kikuyu: Pi wangʼa biro chwer ma ok chogi, maonge ngʼama konyo,
english: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

kikuyu: Abiro guro jo-Israel e pinygi mane amiyogi, kendo onge ngʼama nochak ogolgi kendo,” Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi owacho.
english: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says the LORD your God.

kikuyu: “To bangʼ ka jatijno nosedhi, noyudo achiel kuom jotich wetene mane nigi gope moromo dinari mia achiel. Nomake matek mochako deye, kowachone ni, ‘Chula gopa ma in-go sani!’
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

kikuyu: Jomoko mawacho ni gin gi rieko ma kamano osebayo yo moweyo yie. Ngʼwono obed kodu un duto.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: E weche mag tuoche malandore mag del, neuru ni utimo kaka jodolo ma gin jo-Lawi opuonjou. Nyaka utim adimba gik moko duto ma anyisogi.
english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

kikuyu: Eka Hagai jaote mar Jehova Nyasaye, nowuoyo kod ji konyisogi weche mane Jehova Nyasaye omiye, kowacho niya, “An kodu,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Mise mar gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mane Solomon oketo ne en kama: borne ne romo fut piero aboro gaboro gi nus, lachne ne romo fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus kaluwore gi rapim machon.
english: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

kikuyu: Nopodho auma e tiend Yesu kendo nogoyone erokamano, to ngʼatno ne en ja-Samaria.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

kikuyu: Nogologi e mudho kendo e tipo mar tho kendo noturo nyoroche mane otuegigo.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

kikuyu: Eliakim wuod Hilkia ma jatend od ruoth, gi Shebna jagoro kod Joa wuod Asaf mane jachan weche, nodhi ire kanyo.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno malaika machielo maratego, kabiro lor aa e polo. Ne orwakore gi boche polo ka lihudu oumo wiye; wangʼe ne chalo gi wangʼ chiengʼ, kendo tiendene ne chalo gi sirni makakni ka mach.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

kikuyu: Bed mamor, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo iresa. Bi piyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo ikonya.
english: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo gima abiro timo, ma ka aweyo tich ka, to ji biro rwaka utegi!’
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Jomoko wacho ni in Johana Ja-batiso, to jomoko wacho ni in Elija, to jomoko bende wacho ni in achiel kuom jonabi machon.”
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, Anami ji duto tuomre ngʼato gi ngʼato, wuone kod yawuotgi machalre. Kechna gi herana kod ngʼwonona ok nomona tiekogi.’ ”
english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says the LORD: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”

kikuyu: Nyaka utiek ji duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu keto e lwetu. Kik ukechgi bende kik ulam nyisechegi, nimar mano nobednu obadho.
english: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

kikuyu: Polo ne ochwe kuom wach Jehova Nyasaye, i dwe gi nyinyo duto nochweyo gi much dhoge.
english: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Josia, Farao Neko ruodh Misri nodhi nyaka Aora Yufrate mondo okony ruodh Asuria kedo. Ruoth Josia nowuok mondo oked kode e paw lweny, to ruoth Neko norado kode monege e paw Megido.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

kikuyu: Kar romb misengini miwangʼo pep mane joma ochokore nokelo ne gin rwedhi piero abiriyo, kod imbe mia achiel gi nyiimbe mia ariyo magi duto nochiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Elishama nonywolo Nun, bangʼe Nun nonywolo Joshua.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

kikuyu: gi tula modak e thim gi mbusi gi achuth gi osou,
english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

kikuyu: makmana Nyasaye nosiemowa ni, ‘Kik ucham olemo mar yien man e dier puodhono, kendo kik umule nono to ubiro tho.’ ”
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

kikuyu: E ndalo mag lweny mane ni e kind dhood Saulo gi dhood Daudi, Abner nomedo bedo gi teko e dhood Saulo.
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Nikech gin, joma ni e twech duto moa Juda man Babulon noti gi kwongʼni kawacho ni: ‘Mad Jehova Nyasaye timnu mana kaka notimone Zedekia kod Ahab, mane ruodh Babulon owangʼo e mach.’
english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘The LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ka chi ngʼato ok obedo ja-adiera kendo ok obedo ja-ratiro
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro kelo masiche malich kuomu kaachiel gi nyikwau, tuoche maywayo dend ji kuom kinde mangʼeny.
english: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

kikuyu: “Ka eni ema abiro miyo tung moro donge ne Daudi kendo abiro chungo taya ne ngʼata mowir.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Dofka mi gibworo Alush.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

kikuyu: Kik iwe wiya kuodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech aseywakni ka alemo; to we joma timbegi richo oyud wichkuot kendo ginindi ka gilingʼ thi ei liel.
english: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano giniket gik michiemogo mag dolo e kar kendo mar misango, kaachiel gi gige chiedo, uma mar chwoyo ringʼo, opawo kod bakunde mikirogo remo. Nyaka gipedh raum mar piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe e wiye kendo giket sirni mitingʼego kuonde mowinjore.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: Okandane mochwe maber ne chalo kode kolose obedo gimoro achiel gi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod bende nyaka lose gi dhahabu kod law momin mayom man-gi range marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: to neuru ni uluwo chike duto kod buche ma amiyou kawuononi.
english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Donge nende anyisi ni kiyie to ibiro neno duongʼ mar Nyasaye?”
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

kikuyu: In midak e puothe mzabibu kaachiel gi osiepeni mabudhi, yie awinjie dwondi gie puodho kuno!
english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma ok oluoro wuon kata min.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Pasia ma borgi romo mita abiriyo nobed e dir rangach konchiel, ka pasiago ongʼaw ewi sirni adek man-gi rachungi adek;
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano ranyisi malich nonenore ei polo. Ne en dhako morwakore gi wangʼ chiengʼ. Dwe ne ni e bwo tiende, to wiye nosidhie osimbo mar sulwe apar gariyo.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

kikuyu: E kinde mane Musa pod odak Midian, Farao ruodh Misri notho. Jo-Israel ne ngʼur ahinya kuom tichgi mar wasumbini mi giywak malit, kendo ywakgi mondo oresgi e tich mar bedo misumba nochopo ir Nyasaye.
english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

kikuyu: Jonathan nowacho niya, “Bi wadhi kuma opondo.” Omiyo negidhi giduto.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

kikuyu: Adier, ne uwinjo kuome, kendo ne opuonju wachne, kaluwore gadiera man kuom Yesu.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nochwadgi gi del, mana kaka e kinde mane ogoyo jo-Midian, e lwanda mar Oreb; kendo enorie ludhe ewi pi mana kaka ne otimo Misri.
english: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

kikuyu: Bende uwacho ni, ‘Ka dine bed ni wangima e ndalo mag kwerewa, dine ok wariwore kodgi e chwero remb jonabi.’
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

kikuyu: Johana nodwoko niya, “Ngʼat man-gi sede ariyo owinjore chiw achiel okonygo nyawadgi ma ongego, kendo jalno man kod chiemo bende onego tim kamano.”
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

kikuyu: Kaka koro oseketwa kare kuom rembe, donge ibiro reswa chuth kendo moloyo e mirimb Nyasaye nikech En!
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ne ayiene mondo obwog piny joma ngima, to Farao gi joge duto biro riere piny e bur kaachiel gi joma ok oter nyangu, gi jogo duto ma onegi gi ligangla, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.”
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: machiwo chiemo ne chwech duto, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mar angʼwen negichokore e Holo mar Beraka kama ne gipakoe Jehova Nyasaye. Ma emomiyo iluonge ni Holo mar Beraka nyaka chil kawuono.
english: On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed the LORD. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.

kikuyu: Kuom mano wachni ok wendo kuomwa, ka jotich Satan bende oriedo mondo okwan kaka jotich mag tim makare. To e giko gibiro yudo kum mowinjore gi timbegi.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

kikuyu: Kendo abiro kelou e piny mane akwongʼora ka atingʼo bada malo ni anami Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo. Abiro miyougo kaka girkeni. An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Ibiro bedo janeno ni ji duto, kuom gima iseneno kendo isewinjo.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

kikuyu: Solomon ne nigi puoth mzabibu kama iluongo ni Baal Hamon; kendo ne oketo puotheno e lwet jopur. Moro ka moro kuomgi nonego chul Solomon kilo, apar gachiel gi nus mar fedha kuom olembene.
english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

kikuyu: Yesu nobiro mokawo makati omiyogi, kendo rech bende nomiyogi kamano.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nodhi motimo kaka Yesu nochikogi.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

kikuyu: Jogo manoa e dhout jo-Israel mane oketo chunygi kuom dwaro Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel, noluoro jo-Lawi nyaka Jerusalem mondo gitim misengini ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Jadolo nodhi oko mar kambi kendo nonon ngʼatno. Ka osechango kuom tuone malandore mar del,
english: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Joma bwoch, morito Sabato mara, mayiero timo gima miya mor, kendo morito singruokna,
english: For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

kikuyu: Ka lweti miyo idonjo e richo to ngʼade oko. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima ka ionge lweti moloyo kidhi gi lwetegi ariyo e gehena, [
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik wachal gi ji mamoko ma nindo, to wabeduru motangʼ ka wan gi ritruok.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

kikuyu: An ema ne achweyo ler kod mudho, akelo gweth kod masira bende; An, Jehova Nyasaye ema timo magi duto.
english: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.

kikuyu: “Gad to nomonj gi jomecho, to noriembgi kolawogi matek.
english: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

kikuyu: Kane otieko wuoyo, yawuot ruoth nochopo ka gigoyo nduru matek. Ruoth bende gi jotichne duto noywak malit ahinya.
english: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Kinde mokalo Nyasaye noweyo ogendini duto mondo oluw yoregi giwegi.
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, kendo Jehova Nyasaye mar kanyakla mar Israel wacho kama: “Anayud kwe kuom jok ma jara kendo nachul kuor ne wasika.
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.

kikuyu: Giduto nowegi ne achudhe mae gode kendo ne le mag bungu, winy nochamgi e ndalo mag oro duto, ka le mag bungu to chamogi e ndalo chwiri duto.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

kikuyu: To kaka ok uyie kuom gik mane ondiko, ere kaka ubiro yie kuom gik ma awacho?”
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoko jokor wach niya, “Ma e gima asengʼado e pacha ma ok anyal loko kama: Ka ok unyisa gima ne aleko, kendo ka ok unyisa tiende, to ibiro kidhu matindo tindo, kendo uteu biro lokore pidhe mag owuoyo.
english: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

kikuyu: Kane jogo weyo Yesu, Petro nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ en gima ber mondo wabed ka eri. We mondo wager kiru achiel mari, achiel mar Musa to machielo mar Elija.” (Ne ok ongʼeyo gino mane owacho.)
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

kikuyu: Jaherana osedhi e puothe, kama gik mangʼwe ngʼar dongoe, mondo omeny ei puothe kendo ochok ondanyo.
english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

kikuyu: ok anariemb oganda mane Joshua otho oweyo mondo oa e nyimgi.
english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

kikuyu: Pesa moyud e yo ma ok kare lal nono, to ngʼat makano pesa matin matin miyo omedore.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

kikuyu: Mosnauru Ampliato ma jaherana kuom Ruoth.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

kikuyu: kendo negichano mondo gimak Yesu e yo moro malingʼ-lingʼ mondo ginege.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

kikuyu: Nimar ne gihero pak moa kuom dhano moloyo pak moa kuom Nyasaye.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ ei agolni mag hekalu kendo ot ka ot ne ok gilingʼ ma ok gipuonjo kendo gihulo Injili ni Yesu e Kristo.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

kikuyu: Magi duto ne aneno, kane aketo pacha e gik moko duto mitimo e piny. Nitie kinde moro ma ngʼato sandoe jowetegi to en owuon ema ohinyore.
english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

kikuyu: Mano ema biro miyo ji duto ngʼeyo ni un jopuonjrena adier, ka uheroru ngʼato gi ngʼato.”
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

kikuyu: Pog ring imno lemo lemo kendo ilwok jamb-ich gi tiendene kichokogi kaachiel gi wich kod lemo mamoko.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

kikuyu: “Nimar pinyruodh polo chalo gi wuon puodho mane owuok gokinyi kogwen, mondo ondik ji mane biro tiyone e puothe mar mzabibu.
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar adek nogoyo turumbetene mi sulwe maduongʼ maliel ka toch nolwar oa e polo, nolwar kuom achiel mar adek mag aore, kendo kuom sokni duto.
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma onywol e kend ma ok nikare kata nyikwaye ok onego odonji e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye nyaka tiengʼ mar apar.
english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD’s assembly.

kikuyu: To kapo ni jatijno owacho e chunye owuon ni, ‘Ruodha, okawo ndalo mathoth kapok odwogo,’ mi ochako goyo jotich machwo gi mon kendo owere ne chiemo gi metho, kod mer.
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

kikuyu: Ka en adier ni umako chik mondik e Muma niya, “Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon,” to utimo maber.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho, “Ne, aketo kidi e Sayun, ma en kidi moyier, en kidi motegno, ma nengone tek, moriwo kor ot kendo man-gi mise mongirore; ma ngʼat moyie kuome ok nobam.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

kikuyu: Kinyne nogolo pesa mamingli mag fedha ariyo nomiyo jarit odno. Nowachone ni, ‘Rite to ka aduogo abiro chuli nengo ma imedo ritego!’
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

kikuyu: Yesu nopenje niya, “Gima ipenjano oa e pachi iwuon koso jomoko nono ema owachonigo kuoma?”
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

kikuyu: kendo negiwachonegi niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye neu mi ngʼadnu bura! Usemiyo wadoko gima dungʼ mangʼwe ni Farao kod jodonge kendo useketo ligangla e lwetgi mondo ginegwago.”
english: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato mariek timo gik moko kuom ngʼeyo, to ngʼat mofuwo nyiso mana fupe.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

kikuyu: Eka chi Jeroboam noa malo modhi Tirza. E kinde mane ochopo e laru mar dino cham, nyathino notho.
english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

kikuyu: “Dhi kendo igo milome ka Jerusalem winjo ni: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Aparo kaka ne ichiwori kane in rawera, ne ihera ka nyako moikore ne kend, ne iluwo bangʼa kama otimo ongoro, e piny ma ok purie.
english: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

kikuyu: koringo mondo odhi omonje kotingʼo kuot mapek kendo motegno.
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gima dine mi Ibrahim bed gi geno ne onge, ne pod oyie ayieya ni nobiro bedo “wuon ogendini mangʼeny,” mana kaka nosewachne niya, “kamano e kaka kothi nobedi.”
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

kikuyu: Giselokore mapiyo nono ka giweyo chike mane amiyogi kendo giseloso nyasaye maket gi nyaroya. Gisekulorene piny kendo gisechiwone misango mi giwacho niya, “Magi e nyisecheu mane ogolou e piny Misri, yaye Israel.”
english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Ne andikonu ka chunya chandore kendo lit; kendo pi wangʼa ne chwer mangʼeny, nikech ne ok adwar mondo ami ubed mokuyo, to ne adwaro mondo ungʼe kaka aherou, un duto, gihera matut.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

kikuyu: Le ringo pondo; gisiko e buchegi.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

kikuyu: Hilkia gi jogo mane ruoth ooro kaachiel kode nodhi ir Hulda janabi madhako mane chi Shalum wuod Tokhath, ma wuod Hasra jarit kar keno mar lep lemo. Nodak Jerusalem e gwengʼ mar ariyo.
english: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ne aketo jomoko e tok ohinga kuonde modok gi piny ma ginyalo nenogo wasigu ka aketogi dala ka dala, ka gin-gi ligengni, tonge kod atungʼ.
english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

kikuyu: Wan ok wapandonu herawa, to un ema upandonwa.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

kikuyu: Koro Eli mane oseti ahinya; nowinjo timbe duto mane yawuote timo ne jo-Israel kaka negiterore gi mon mane tiyo e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Dwol winjore Rama, en ywak gi nduru malich, Rael ywago nyithinde kendo odagi ni ok nyal hoye, nikech gisetho.”
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

kikuyu: Ket kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep e nyim dhood hekalu mar Hemb Romo;
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: To neuru kaka thuondige ywak malit e wangʼ yore; joote ma oseor mondo odwar kwe ywak malit.
english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

kikuyu: “Tij jo-Kohath e Hemb Romo en rito gik maler moloyo.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

kikuyu: Ne giyangʼo nyarombo mar Pasaka Chiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mar ariyo jodolo kod jo-Lawi noyudo wichkuot omiyo negipwodhore mi gikelo misengini miwangʼo pep e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bani, Shelomith wuod Josifia, kaachiel kode ji mia achiel gi piero auchiel;
english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

kikuyu: ka in jawuoro to dimbri nono to onyalo keto pala e dwondi.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisedonjo e dala maduongʼno, Elisha nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye yaw wangʼ jogi mondo ginen.” Eka Jehova Nyasaye noyawo wengegi kendo ka wengegi noyawore, to negiyudo ka gin Samaria.
english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “LORD, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

kikuyu: mondo owinj ywak joma otwe kendo ogony joma ongʼadnegi buch tho.”
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

kikuyu: Pinyruoth mari obi, dwaroni mondo otimre e piny kaka timore e polo.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane Jehova Nyasaye openjo mondo opuonje, koso en ngʼa mane onyise yo makare? En ngʼa ma nopuonje rieko koso en ngʼa mane onyise yor ngʼeyo?
english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

kikuyu: to mano kaka inibed ngʼama ogwedhi, ka ichwoyo chambi e bath aore duto, kendo ka iweyo jambi kod punde magi wuotho awuotha kaka ohero.
english: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.

kikuyu: Gauru farese, idhuru farese! Kawuru kereu kurwako oguteu mag lweny! Piaguru tongeu, rwakuru okumba mau!
english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

kikuyu: To chiwo duto mag cham mondo ituonie chumbi. Kik iwe mak ituone chumbi e misengini magi duto mag mogo kaka nisingori ni Nyasachi; mano emomiyo chumbi nyaka tuonie misengini duto mutimo.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo timbeni gi herani kod yie mari gi tiji mar konyo ji kod kindani. Kendo imedo tiyo maber moloyo kaka nitiyo mokwongo.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi matiyo ei hekalu nomi kama borne romo fut alufu piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich, to lachne romo fut alufu apar gabich kaka mwandugi, mondo gernigie ute ma gidakie.
english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo gichalo joma orundore e nyim jo-Israel, mine giloyogi gi loch maduongʼ e Gibeon. Jo-Israel nolawogi ka giluwo yo madhi Beth Horon mi ginegogi ma gichopo kodgi nyaka Azeka kod Makeda.
english: The LORD confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

kikuyu: kendo ne giyie. Kendo kane giwinjo ni Jehova Nyasaye oseneno chandruokgi kendo ni odwaro resogi, negikulore mi gilame.
english: The people believed, and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.

kikuyu: Pak mondo odogne Jehova Nyasaye, ma ok oseyie mondo gikidhwa gi lekegi.
english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo iwachone Nyasaye ni, ‘An giyie makare kendo aler e nyimi?’
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

kikuyu: Saulo nodhi e dala maduongʼ mar jo-Amalek koikore monjogi e holo.
english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

kikuyu: kendo itwe lak thiwnigo komachielo e laini ariyo mochan kaka dhahabu ka ochome e tond law akor kuom law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi yo ka nyime.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

kikuyu: Dipo ni asedoko jasiku nikech awachonu adiera?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

kikuyu: Jo-Reuben gi jo-Gad, mane nigi kweth mag rombe kod dhok, noneno ni piny Jazer kod piny Gilead ne nigi lek maber mar pidho jamni.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

kikuyu: Solomon ne nigi udi alufu angʼwen mag farese kod geche lweny kaachiel gi farese alufu apar gariyo manokano e mier madongo mag geche lweny to moko bende ne en-go Jerusalem.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nyalo wacho niya, “Oyiena timo gimoro amora mwadwaro,” to gik moko duto ma watimo ok kelnwa konyruok. Ngʼat machielo to wacho niya, “Oyiena timo gimoro amora madwaro,” to gik moko duto ma watimo ok kelnwa dongruok.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Odiechiengʼno iniluonga ni ‘chwora,’ to ok inichak iluonga ni ‘jatenda.’
english: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Nikech gisejwangʼo chikna, mane amiyogi; omiyo ok giseluora kata luwo chikna.
english: The LORD says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

kikuyu: Ka masira obiro, joricho itieko, to kata e tho ngʼat makare nigi kar pondo.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego biro gwedhogi kawacho niya, “Agwedho jo-Misri ma gin joga, jo-Asuria ma gin chwechna kod jo-Israel ma gin girkeni mara.”
english: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

kikuyu: joma osebilo ber mar Wach Nyasaye, mi ongʼeyo teko mar piny mabiro,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Abram niya, “Dar iwe pinyu gi jou kod joodu mondo idhi e piny ma abiro nyisi.
english: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Nikech ji osewacho wechegi, abiro keto wechega manie dhogi mach, to jogi nobed yien maliel.”
english: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

kikuyu: Jo-Gibeon nooro wach ni Joshua e kambi man Gilgal niya, “Kik ijwangʼ jotichgi. Bi irwa piyo mondo ireswa! Konywa nikech ruodhi jo-Amor duto moa e piny manie wi got oseriwore mondo omonjwa.”
english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Jetha ne gin: Jefune, Pispa kod Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

kikuyu: Pok mar abich nomi dhoot Asher kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

kikuyu: Dhako ka dhako nyaka kwa jabathe kod joma odakgo e ode mondo omiye gik molos gi fedha gi dhahabu kod lewni, ma unuket kuom yawuotu gi nyiu. Kuom mano unuyak gige jo-Misri.”
english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”

kikuyu: Tengʼ buru momaki oko; aa malo kendo ibed piny e kom duongʼ, yaye Jerusalem. Gony nyoroche motwe ngʼuti, yaye in Nyar Sayun manie twech.
english: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!

kikuyu: Nyasaye notimo ma mondo mahundu mane otimne yawuot Jerub-Baal piero abiriyo, kichwero rembgi, mondo ochul ewi Abimelek owadgi kendo ewi jo-Shekem, mane okonye nego owetene.
english: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

kikuyu: Werneuru Jehova Nyasaye, un joge maler; pakuru nyinge maler.
english: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

kikuyu: Jo-Dibon dhiyo e kargi mar lemo, gidhiyo e hembko mag-gi mondo giywagi; kendo jo-Moab goyo nduru nikech Nebo gi Medeba osekethi. Ngʼato ka ngʼato oliel wiye kod tike.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

kikuyu: Bethe lopni nobed maromre, kilomita apar gariyo gi nus koni gi koni. Iniket tenge bathe koma ler mopwodhi kaka mich makende, kaachiel gi lowo mogerie dala maduongʼ.
english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

kikuyu: Giduto negichiemo mi giyiengʼ chuth, kendo bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo okepe apar gariyo mopongʼ.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼat marito kendo machopo nyaka giko mar higni adek gi nus kata odiechienge alufu achiel mia adek gi piero adek gabich (1,335).
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mawuondo jabute ochiko obadho e tiende.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

kikuyu: To ruodh Misri nowachonegi niya, “Musa gi Harun, en angʼo momiyo ugolo ji kuom tijegi ma gitimo? Doguru e tiju!”
english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro kok niya: “Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru Nyasachwa yo moriere tir, e piny motimo ongoro e thim.
english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

kikuyu: nimar in bende ingʼeyo e chunyi ni kinde mangʼeny in iwuon isekwongʼo joma moko.
english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

kikuyu: nimar gisengamo Jakobo mi giketho gwengʼe.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

kikuyu: Eka jatend lweny nochungʼ moluongo matek gi dho jo-Hibrania niya, “Winjuru weche moa kuom ruoth maduongʼ ma en ruodh Asuria!
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

kikuyu: Nikech dhako mokendi onge gi teko kuom ringre owuon, to en mar chwore. Kamano bende, dichwo mokendo onge gi teko kuom ringre owuon, to en mar chiege bende.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

kikuyu: Ne opogo ring imno lemo ka lemo kendo nowangʼo wiye gi lemogo duto kod bochene.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

kikuyu: Ginichwanyre moluwore oluwore; giniluowre kuom jowetegi. Giniwachi ni, ‘Aa malo, wadog ir jowa wawegi; kendo e pinywa owuon, mabor gi ligangla mar joma thiro ji.’
english: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’

kikuyu: Nanene komonjo im gi tekre duto, kendo nochwoye momuko tungene duto ariyo. Im ne onge teko ma dimi ochungʼ e nyime kendo nywogno nogoye piny e lowo monyone piny, to onge ngʼama ne nyalo reso im mi gol e tekone.
english: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground and trampled on him. There was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.

kikuyu: Ezri wuod Kelub ne rito jotich mane tiyo e puodho.
english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne nitie jomoko mane onyiso Yesu wach jo-Galili ma Pilato ne oriwo rembgi kod misengini.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Ain, Rimon, Ether kod Ashan. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo angʼwen,
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

kikuyu: onge tiende mondo jo-Lawi osik katingʼo Hemb Romo kata gige lemo mitiyogo e iye.”
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ yike nowacho ni yawuote niya, “Katho to ikauru e bur kama oyikie ngʼat Nyasayeni; keturu chokena but chokene.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

kikuyu: To puothe mag lek mag joka Lawi ok nyal usi, nikech mano en mwandugi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachno, mirima nomakgi matek mi gimwomore kuome gi chuny achiel.
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

kikuyu: “Gimoro amora ma gitimo gitimo mondo ji one. Kuom ranyisi, giloso sanduku mag-gi motingʼo kwan mag ndiko mimako gi wich madongo dongo, kendo gikado riak lepgi maboyo boyo.
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

kikuyu: (Musa ne en ngʼama obolore, ngʼat mobolore moloyo ngʼato angʼata manie wangʼ piny.)
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata kuomu madichwo kata madhako ma en ajuok nyakalondo kata ma ajwoga moro amora, to ugo gi kite nyaka otho. Giduto nyaka ugogi gi kite kendo rembgi nobedi e wigi giwegi.
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

kikuyu: Jogo duto maloso nyiseche manono noyud wichkuot kod achaya; kendo giduto gininwangʼ wichkuot.
english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

kikuyu: “Biuru ira, un duto mujony kendo motingʼore mapek, mondo amiu yweyo.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

kikuyu: Obiro chwako joma odhier manie dier ji kendo obiro reso nyithind joma ochando; to thiro ji, to obiro tieko pep.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

kikuyu: Ka irango Sayun, dala maduongʼ mar sewniwa moyier; ibiro neno Jerusalem kama kwe nitie, hema ma ok bi muki; loje mage ok nopudhi, kata tondene ok nochodi.
english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

kikuyu: Kane Paulo oketo lwete kuomgi, Roho Maler nolor kuomgi, mine giwuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore kendo ne gikoro wach.
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, “Auru kuomgi kendo pogreuru kodgi, Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho. Kik umul gima ochido, eka anarwaku.”
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Awachonu adier ni ka ok ulokoru ma uchalo gi nyithindo matindo, to ok ubi donjo e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Wamor kodi, moluor Feliks, nikech ber duto misekelonwa, osemiyo wadak maber kuonde duto kendo e yore duto.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

kikuyu: Yesu nomedo wacho niya, “Ne nitie ngʼato moro mane nigi yawuowi ariyo.
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

kikuyu: nimar got Sayun, osejwangʼ modongʼ gunda ma ondiegi ema kwayoe.
english: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

kikuyu: Nimar wangʼeyo ni kaka Kristo nochier oa kuom joma otho, ok onyal tho kendo, nikech tho koro onge gi teko kuome.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

kikuyu: Yawuot Josia ne gin: Johanan wuode makayo, Jehoyakim mar ariyo, Zedekia mar adek, kod Shalum mar angʼwen.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

kikuyu: To bende, nyikwa Ibrahim duto ok gin kothe madier. To en mana kaka Nyasaye nonyiso Ibrahim niya, “Kuom wuodi Isaka ema kothi duto nowuogie.”
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama duongʼ mogik e dieru nobed jatichu.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano mondo, kuom gik moko ariyo, tiende ni singruok gi kwongʼruok, ma ok nyal lokore kendo ma ok nyal miyo Nyasaye bet ja-miriambo, wayud gweth mogundho, wan mwasetony koro wayudo jip motegno kwamako geno ma wan-go matek.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

kikuyu: Wuod Dan ne en Hushim.
english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

kikuyu: Ngʼat molocho anami obed siro e hekalu mar Nyasacha. Ok enochak owuog kanyo. Anandik nying Nyasacha kuome bende anandik nying dala mar Nyasacha ma en Jerusalem manyien, mabiro aa e polo kuom Nyasacha kendo abiro ndiko nyinga maler kuome.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

kikuyu: Ahithofel nodwoke niya, “Terri gi monde wuonu mamoko mane oweyo karito dala ruoth. Eka jo-Israel nowinj kaka isebedo mangʼwe e um wuonu, kendo ji duto man kodi nobed gi teko.”
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

kikuyu: Joge teko orumonegi, mi gibuok kendo gidongʼ gi wichkuot. Gichalo gi cham manie puodho, kata ka maua mangʼich mathiewo, kata ka lum madongo ewi tado, to ner kapok odongo.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

kikuyu: “Osewachi ni, ngʼato angʼata moketho keny gi chiege nyaka miye barup weruok mar ketho keny.
english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

kikuyu: To Jehosheba nyar ruoth Jehoram nokawo Joash wuod Ahazia kendo nokwale lingʼ-lingʼ kuom nyithi ruoth mane idwaro nego mopande e od nindo kaachiel gi japite. Nikech Jehosheba nyar ruoth Jehoram mane chi Jehoyada jadolo ne nyamin Ahazia, nopando nyathino ne Athalia mondo kik onege.
english: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.

kikuyu: Nolut lith lwete ei remono, mi nokire nyadibiriyo e nyim pasia mar kama ler mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil.

kikuyu: Nimar ochungʼ e bat korachwich mar ngʼat mochando, mondo ores ngimane kuom joma ngʼadone buch tho.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

kikuyu: “Gimoro amora mowal tenge koa e mich mag misango mifwayo mar jo-Israel bende nobed mari. Achiwo ma ne in kod yawuoti gi nyigi kaka pok maru mapile pile. Ngʼato angʼata mantiere e odi mopwodhore maler nyalo chame.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

kikuyu: Ma e kwan mar joma Nebukadneza notero e twech: e higa mar abiriyo, mane gin jo-Yahudi alufu adek gi piero adek;
english: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

kikuyu: “Ka mach omuoch mi olandore e bungu kendo owangʼo cham ma pod ochungʼ kata cham mobeti kata puodho duto, to ngʼatno mane omoko majno nyaka chul.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo mane orito migepe mag jolweny, jotelo mag alufe alufe kod jotelo mag miche miche, nodhi ir Musa
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

kikuyu: Jokwath nodok, ka gipako Nyasaye kendo miyo Nyasaye duongʼ kuom gik moko duto mane gisewinjo kendo neno, mana kaka nosenyisgi.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

kikuyu: Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo inyisgi ni: Ka gichopo e piny mabiro miyogi, to pinyno nyaka rit Sabato mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ok notony e masira, enochal gi yath ma mach owangʼo ite, kendo much Nyasaye biro keyo thiepene mi olal nono.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

kikuyu: Initho tho marach e lwet jopinje mamoko ma ok oter nyangu. Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.’ ”
english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Nindo nochako otere mi ochako oleko lek machielo ni noneno wiye abiriyo mag cham machwe kendo beyo kochiek e tiangʼ achiel.
english: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

kikuyu: Ne apidhoi kaka mzabibu mar kodhi, moyier makare kendo manyak. Kara ere kaka ne iweya mi idonjo e timbe moduwore, kendo ichalo gi mzabibu mar bungu.
english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

kikuyu: Joherana, ajiwou, kaka jowuoth kendo kaka welo e pinyni, mondo uwe gombo maricho mag ringruok makedo gi chunyu.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai moko ma noor,
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Pak mar Moab ok nobedi kendo; ji nochan kethruokne ei Heshbon kagiwacho kama: ‘Biuru, watiek pinyni.’ Yaye joma odak Madmen, un bende ligangla nolawu mulingʼ thii.
english: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.

kikuyu: Joma parogi bayo noyud rieko; kendo joma kwedo wach bende nopuonji.
english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

kikuyu: Kane owach ne Daudi ni Uria ne ok odhi ode, nopenje niya, “Donge isebudho oko, angʼo momoni dhi odi?”
english: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

kikuyu: Owadgi Mika mane oyier ne en Ishia, to kuom yawuot Ishia noyier Zekaria.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Edom osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech nolawo owadgi gi ligangla ka oonge gi ngʼwono, kendo ne osiko mana ka omako kode sadha,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;

kikuyu: Nodhi nyime kod wuoth koa Negev kobuoro e yo nyaka nochopo Bethel, kumane okwongo geroe hembe e kind Bethel kod Ai,
english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

kikuyu: Ka ok uchamo chiemogo to ubiro dhi maber kaachiel gi nyikwau, nikech mano utimo gima ber kendo malongʼo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Kendo nikech Jehova Nyasaye noloro iye mane ok onyal nywol, nyieke ne osiko mana kajare mondo owangʼ iye.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

kikuyu: Musa noyie mondo odag gi ngʼatno, mi Reuel nomiye nyare miluongo ni Zipora mondo obed chiege.
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Daudi nowacho ni chokruok duto niya, “Solomon wuoda ma Nyasaye oseyiero pod en rawera man-gi lony matin. To tijni en tich maduongʼ nikech ot malichni ok en mar dhano to en mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

kikuyu: Kar ndalo ma dirom aboro bangʼ ka Yesu nosewacho mani, nokawo Petro gi Johana kod Jakobo kaachiel kode kendo negidhiyo malo ewi got mondo gilam.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: Lela wangʼe ne chal kama: Kargi angʼwen moro ka moro ne nigi lela wangʼ mar dhano, to e bethegi korachwich, moro ka moro ne nigi lela wangʼ mar sibuor, to e bethegi koracham ne gin gi lela wangʼ mar rwath. Giduto ne gin gi lela wangʼ mar ongo.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

kikuyu: Enok nowuotho gi Nyasaye; bangʼe nobedo maonge, nikech Nyasaye nokawe.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

kikuyu: Kane Ish-Bosheth wuod Saulo owinjo ni Abner nosetho Hebron, chunye noa, kendo Israel duto luoro nomako.
english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

kikuyu: Neginwoyo wechego ne Daudi. To Daudi nowacho niya, “Uparo ni en wach mayot mar bedo or ruoth? An mana ngʼama odhier bende ok angʼera.”
english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, to achiel kuom askechego nochwowo ngʼet Yesu gi tongʼ, mi remo gi pi nochwer.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

kikuyu: Inibed kondo maber e lwet Jehova Nyasaye bende inibed osimb loch e lwet Nyasachi.
english: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ruoth kod Haman nodhi chiemo gi Esta ma mikache,
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

kikuyu: Resa e dicho ma ji diyogo jowetegi, mondo eka arit bucheni.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Kane onyis ruodh Misri ni jogo osedhi, Farao gi jodonge noloko pachgi kuom jo-Israel mi giwacho niya, “Angʼo ma wasetimoni? Waseweyo jo-Israel odhi kendo tije ma yande gitiyonwa orumo!”
english: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato noyieyo ogunde piny e ngʼe pundegi kendo ogonyo.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

kikuyu: Adam nowacho niya, “Ma koro en chogo mar choka kendo ringʼo mar ringra; ibiro luonge ni ‘dhako,’ nikech nogole koa kuom dichwo.”
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

kikuyu: Nikech ji mathoth pakore kaka jopiny pakore, an bende weuru apakra matin.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowuok Mizpa molawo jo-Filistia ma ginegogi e yo nyaka Beth-Kar.
english: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.

kikuyu: Kaka ilenyo fedha e kendo, e kaka un bende nolenyu kuom mach, kendo unungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema aseolo mirimba mager kuomu.’ ”
english: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.’”

kikuyu: Otimo neno kuom gik moseneno kendo owinjo, to onge ngʼama orwako nende.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma nonego Abimelek wuod Jerub-Besheth? Dhako donge ema nodiro pongʼ rego gi ewi ohinga, mine otho Thebez? Angʼo momiyo ne udhi machiegni ahinya gi ohinga?’ Kopenji penjoni, to wachne ni, ‘Jatichni Uria ja-Hiti bende otho.’ ”
english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

kikuyu: Mano kaka ginibed joma lombo ji kendo joma beyo! Cham gi divai nomi yawuotgi gi nyigi, bed gi del maber.
english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

kikuyu: “To koro sani, kuom kinde matin, Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa osebedo jangʼwono moweyonwa joma otony kendo omiyowa kama wanyalo dakie e kari maler mar lemo. Isedwogo chunywa, kendo iweyonwa thuolo mondo dendwa oduogi e twech ma wantiereni.
english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.

kikuyu: Joketh nyinga lawa odiechiengʼ duto; ji mangʼeny monja ka sunga omakogi.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi jodolo moko man-gi turumbete, kod Zekaria wuod Jonathan, wuod Shemaya, wuod Matania, wuod Mikaya, wuod Zakur, wuod Asaf,
english: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

kikuyu: Ka ungʼeya adier, to Wuora bende ubiro ngʼeyo. Chakre kawuononi ungʼeye kendo usenene.”
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nochako ngʼur kode nikech nowacho niya, “An e makati mobiro e piny koa e polo.”
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

kikuyu: Eka negiwachone niya, “Kiyie to penjnwa Nyasaye ka wuodhwa dhi bedo maber.”
english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye! Werneuru Jehova Nyasaye wer manyien, kendo dendeuru e chokruok mar jomaler.
english: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

kikuyu: Senakerib noyudo wach ni Tirhaka ja-Kush ruodh Misri obiro monje. Kane owinjo wachno, nooro joote ir Hezekia kowacho kama:
english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

kikuyu: Yawuot Simeon ne gin: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar kod Shaul mane wuod nyar Kanaan.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, nitiere kute moko ma unyalo chamo man-gi tiende angʼwen kod mago ma gichikorego.
english: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachonegi niya, “Kik uluor, kendo kik chunyu nyosre. Beduru motegno kendo gi chir. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye biro timo ne wasigu duto ma ubiro kedogo.”
english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

kikuyu: Negimonja e kinde mane an gi masira, to Jehova Nyasaye ema nokonya.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo dakaw kuona gi piga to gi ringa ma aseyangʼo ne jongʼadna yie rombe mondo ami joma akia kuma oaye?”
english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”

kikuyu: “Ndik ne malaika morito kanisa man Sarde kama: Magi e weche mag Jal motingʼo Roho abiriyo mag Nyasaye kod sulwe abiriyo. Angʼeyo timbeni; kendo kaka igeno ni in gi nying ni ingima to adiera isetho.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

kikuyu: kendo ji modak e dala maduongʼ machielo ni wach ni, ‘Wadhiuru riat mondo walam Jehova Nyasaye kendo wadwar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, an to eri asewuok adhi.’
english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies. I will go also.’

kikuyu: Ka jogo nosedhi, ji ariyogi nowuok e soko mi gidhi gitero ni ruoth Daudi wach. Negiwachone niya, “Wuogi ingʼad aora piyo, Ahithofel osengʼado rieko machal kama kuomi.”
english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

kikuyu: To jomoko ma acheje nowacho niya, “Ere kaka ngʼatni nyalo resowa?” Negi chaye mine ok gikelone mich. To Saulo nolingʼ mos.
english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

kikuyu: Nyithindi duto nopuonj gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo ginibed gi kwe maduongʼ.
english: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.

kikuyu: To koro kiyie, to wenegi richogi, to ka ok kamano, to ruch nyinga oko e kitabu misendikono.”
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

kikuyu: Eka Zerubabel ma wuod Shealtiel kod Joshua wuod Jehozadak, ma jadolo maduongʼ, kaachiel gi ji mamoko mane oa e twech, kane giwinjo weche Nyasaye gi weche mag janabi Hagai, kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne oore, luoro maduongʼ nomakogi e nyim Ruoth.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, achayora ahinya kendo ahulo richona ka bet piny kendo abukora gi buru.”
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

kikuyu: in ema anegogo jakwath gi rombe, in ema anegogo japur gi rwedhi, in ema anegogo ruodhi gi jotelo.”
english: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.

kikuyu: Un, wasumbini, luoruru ruodhiu mag pinyni e weche duto kendo kik utim kamano mana sa ma gichungʼ butu ka gingʼiyou kutiyo, ka gima udwaro morogi, to timuru kamano gi chuny ma thuolo kendo kuluoro Ruoth.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

kikuyu: eka dechegi nopongʼ gi cham mogundho kendo agulnigi nopongʼ gi divai manyien maonge kama ikanoe.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

kikuyu: Ee, rang joma sungore duto kendo, ikumgi kama gichungoeno mondo omi gibolre.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gaboro mar Azaria ruodh Juda, Zekaria wuod Jeroboam nobedo ruodh Israel ei Samaria kendo nobedo ruoth kuom dweche auchiel.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

kikuyu: Chokego noyar oko e nyim chiengʼ gi dwe kod sulwe duto manie polo mane gihero kendo tiyonegi ma bende negiluwo bangʼ-gi ka gipenjo rieko kendo lamogi. Ok nochokgi kata ikgi, to ginichal ka owuoyo manie lowo.
english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Jolweny mag Juda nomako ji alufu apar kangima mi negiterogi ewi lwanda moro kendo negidirogi piny ma githo kendo gitur matindo tindo.
english: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

kikuyu: Kane wasebet kodgi kuom ndalo moko, janabi ma nyinge Agaba nobiro irwa koa Judea.
english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

kikuyu: Eka nowuotho odhi nyime kama dirom fut adek kendo nobedo piny kanyo, mi nowacho e chunye niya, “Ok anyal rango nyathi katho.” Kendo kane obet machiegni kanyo, nyathi nochako ywak.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo lepi kwar mana ka lep ngʼama nyono olemb mzabibu kabiyo?
english: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

kikuyu: Jotelo duto nobiro ir Jeremia mi gipenje, kendo nonyisogi gik moko duto mane ruoth ochike mondo awachi. Omiyo onge gima negichako ginyise, nimar onge ngʼama nowinjo twakgi gi ruoth.
english: Then all the princes came to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they stopped speaking with him, for the matter was not perceived.

kikuyu: Nikech ok ginyal nindo nyaka gitim gima mono; ayula wangʼ bende ok nyal terogi kapok gimiyo ngʼato opodho.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

kikuyu: Negichano mondo girom gi Paulo odiechiengʼ moro achiel, kendo ji koro ne medo biro mangʼeny ir Paulo kama nodakie. Chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo, noleronigi tiend wach pinyruoth Nyasaye. Notimo kamano kotemo loko paro mane gin-go kuom Yesu, kokonyore gi weche mondiki e Chik Musa kod jonabi.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

kikuyu: Wawacho ni wan gi chir kendo dwaher moloyo weyo dak e ringruogni mondo wadag kaachiel gi Ruoth.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

kikuyu: To bende jotelo madongo duto mag jodolo kod ji nomedo bedo joma ok jo-ratiro, ka giluwo timbe mamono mag oganda kendo ne gichido hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mane osepwodho Jerusalem.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted the LORD’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ibiro siko kikecho nyaka karangʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye? Lokri, kech jatichni.
english: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro kedo kodi gi ligangla kendo abiro nego jogi gi jambgi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.

kikuyu: “Chik momako ngʼama otho e hema ema: Ngʼato angʼata modonjo ei hema kendo ngʼato angʼata mantiere e iye nobed mochido kuom ndalo abiriyo,
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: Owetene abiriyo kaluwore gi anywolagi ne gin: Mikael, Meshulam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia kod Eber.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

kikuyu: Un duto un nyithind ler, kendo un nyithind odiechiengʼ. Ok wan jo-otieno kata jo-mudho.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

kikuyu: to joma oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye tekregi nodwogi. Gibiro huyo mana ka ongo mafuyo gi bwombe; gibiro ringo to ok gibi bedo mool, bende gibiro wuotho to tekregi ok norum.
english: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Nyis ruodh Juda, mane oorou mondo unona ni, ‘Jolwenj Farao, mosewuok mondo okonyu, biro dok e pinygi giwegi, Misri.
english: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.

kikuyu: ka achiwo wende pak e dho jo-Israel man-gi kuyo. Kwe, kwe, ne jogo man machiegni kod man maboyo. Kendo abiro changogi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”

kikuyu: “Ger kendo mar misango gi yiend siala, ma borne madhi malo romo fut angʼwen gi nus, lachne kod borne mondo obed fut abiriyo gi nus maromre.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

kikuyu: Yesu nochiwore nikech richowa mondo ogonywa waa e kethruok mag ndalogi, kaluwore gi dwaro mar Nyasachwa kendo Wuonwa.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

kikuyu: Ndalo duto mag ngʼat mahinyore gin thagruok, to chuny mamor ni kod mor mosiko.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

kikuyu: Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; chik iti ne ywakna ma akwayigo kech.
english: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni richowa nyisowa ni wan joketho, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, tim gimoro nikech nyingi. Wasebaro waweyo yoreni; kendo wasetimo richo e nyimi.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, LORD; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.

kikuyu: Owacho kendo niya, “Moruru un joma ok jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi joge,”
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano koro ndikni wendni kendo ipuonj jo-Israel kaka iwere mondo wendno obednegi janeno e kinda kodgi.
english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ka asetimoni kamano to abiro boli e lwet joherani kendo gibiro muko thucheni kod kuondeni motingʼore gi malo milame nyisechegi. Gibiro lonyo lepi mi giweyi duk, kendo gibiro kawo kitegi ma nengogi tek mi giweyi duk.
english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni Jawarna nitie kendo ngima, kendo chiengʼ giko nochungʼ kongʼado bura ne piny.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moyie ni wechene gin adier, biro ngʼeyo malongʼo ni Nyasaye en ja-adiera.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

kikuyu: Neuru makati mwatingʼogi, ne giliet ka wachako wuoth, to koro sani gikethore.
english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

kikuyu: moro en dhako ma ok oher to okende eka mogik jatich ma nyako ma omayo dhako mondike dichwo.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Chungʼ e dhood hema. Ka ngʼato obiro kendo openji ni, ‘Bende ngʼato nitiere ka?’ To wachne ni, ‘Ooyo.’ ”
english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

kikuyu: Negikelo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye mi gikete ei hema mane Daudi ogurone, bangʼe negitimo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag lalruok e nyim Nyasaye.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

kikuyu: Un to un jogo moyier. Un jodolo ma joka Ruoth kendo un oganda maler mar Nyasaye mane oyiero mondo ohul tijene miwuoro, kane oluongou mi ua e mudho kendo udonjo e lerne miwuoro.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

kikuyu: Ngimana rem chamo kendo higni maga opongʼ gi chur; tekona rumo nikech lit ma an-go kendo chokena doko mayom yom.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel noneno fweny kar sa ochiko odhiambo. E fwenyno noneno malaika mar Nyasaye, mane obiro ire moluonge niya, “Kornelio!”
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

kikuyu: Eka chi Samson nodirore kuome, koywak, “Ok idwara! Ok ihera. Isemiyo joga ngero, to pod ok inyisa tiende.” Samson nodwoke niya, Wachni pod ok anyiso wuonwa kata minwa, “angʼo momiyo nyaka anyisi tiende?”
english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.” He said to her, “Behold, I haven’t told my father or my mother, so why should I tell you?”

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Opak Jehova Nyasaye, ma noresoi e lwet jo-Misri bende e lwet Farao kendo oreso oganda e lwet jo-Misri.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Uparo ni aonge gi joneko moromo momiyo ukelo ngʼatni e nyima? Ne ochuno ni nyaka ngʼatni bi e oda?”
english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
