kikuyu: To ne tiengʼ mabiro, kinde duto ma japiny moro kata ngʼato angʼata modak e kindu okelo misango molos gi mach kaka gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka otim mana kaka utimo.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona niya, “Kik umonj jo-Moab kata kwinyogi mondo gitug lweny kodu, nimar ok anamiu dir pinygi moro amora. Kanyo asemiyo joka Ar ma nyikwa Lut kaka girkeni margi.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: Ne otucho lwanda e thim kendo nomiyogi pi mogundho ka nembe;
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: Ishmael wuod Nethania noa Mizpa mondo orom kodgi, ka oywak e sache mane odhi. Kane oromo kodgi, nowachonegi niya, “Biuru ir Gedalia wuod Ahikam.”
english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”

kikuyu: Magi e dhout Israel apar gariyo duto kendo mae gima ne wuon-gi owachonegi kane ogwedhogi, ka omiyo moro ka moro gweth moromore kode.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

kikuyu: An Daniel, tekra norumo, kendo nabedo matuo kuom ndalo mangʼeny. Eka ne achungo malo, kendo adhi nyime gi tije ruoth. Fweny mane aneno nomako dhoga; kendo ne ok anyal winjo tiende maber.
english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jo-Israel nokawo mogo modwal mapok oketie thowi kendo negitingʼogi e gokgi e sufuriache ka giboyogi gi sukni.
english: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

kikuyu: Abiro yawo dhoga mondo awuo gi ngeche, ee, abiro hulo gik mopondo ma wuoyo kuom gik mane otimore chon gi lala.
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, joma onge gi thagruok chayo joma thagore, kendo podho mar joma thagore ok lichnigi.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

kikuyu: Bende useneno jotend jo-Farisai kata achiel moyie kuome?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

kikuyu: Jomoko nokelone ja-athany, konindo e pien. Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowachone ja-athanyno niya,“Wuoda, bed gi kwe e chunyi, richoni oweni.”
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Eka jotelo mag Israel, ma gin jotelo mag anywola ma bende ema jotend dhoudi mane ochungʼ ne jogo mane okwan, nochiwo misengini.
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

kikuyu: E kinde mane Ahaz wuod Jotham ma wuod Uzia, ne ruodh Juda, ruoth Rezin mar Aram to gi Peka wuod Remalia ruodh Israel nomonjo Jerusalem gi lweny, to ne ok ginyal loye.
english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Oboth mi gibworo Iye Abarim, mantiere e tongʼ piny Moab.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

kikuyu: mondo ndalo magu kod mag nyithindu omedre e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osingore ni nomi nyithindu, mondo obed maru nyaka chiengʼ.
english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma noa e twech notimo kaka nochan. Ezra jadolo noyiero chwo mane jotend dhoudi, achiel koa e migawo mar dhoot ka dhoot, kendo giduto noluongogi gi nying-gi. E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar apar negibedo piny mondo ginon wechegi,
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un malaikane duto, un joge maroteke matimo kaka odwaro, kendo matimo kaka owacho.
english: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

kikuyu: Puonj mag joma kamago biro landore ka adhola malandore. Achiel kuomgi gin Humenayo gi Fileto,
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

kikuyu: Bende nondiko jo-Israel mathuondi alufu mia achiel kochulo fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen.
english: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

kikuyu: Mon-go nomiyo Isaka kod Rebeka chuny lit.
english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

kikuyu: Isechano kethruok mar ogendini mangʼeny, ma osemiyo odi owuon wichkuot kendo iwito ngimani.
english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

kikuyu: ka an gi geno ni anyalo miyo ogandana awuon nyiego maki mi awar moko kuomgi.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

kikuyu: E ndalo loch Saulo, negikedo gi jo-Hagri mane giloyo ma gikawo kuondegi mag dak duto e piny machiegni gi Gilead.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

kikuyu: Losuru yore muluwo mondo oriere tir, eka tiendeu malit nochangi.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye e tekra kendo en e wenda; osedoko warruok mara.
english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negibet piny kanyo ka girite.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

kikuyu: To ka jogo nodonjo negiyudo gima opa e kitanda, to yo ka wiye to oketie yie diek.
english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

kikuyu: Ler ber kendo omiyo wangʼ neno maber.
english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny mane osetho nochier ka moko kuomgi chier e ngima mochwere, to moko kuomgi nochier e wichkuot kod achaya mochwere.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

kikuyu: To nobed maber gi jogo makumo joma oketho, kendo gweth mogundho nobed kodgi.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

kikuyu: to e dier rachungi teynigo ne nitie ngʼato machalo gi wuod dhano morwakore gi kandho mochopo nyaka e tiende piny, kendo kotweyo kore gi okanda mar dhahabu.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

kikuyu: “To obiro dwoko ni, ‘Ok angʼeyou, kata kuma uae akia. Ayiuru kuoma un jorichogi!’
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

kikuyu: nikech ngʼama tiyo ne Kristo e yo machal kama ema longʼo ne Nyasaye, kendo ngʼat ma kamano ema ji oyiego.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

kikuyu: Kata bed nine ojwangʼu e piny mabor ahinya e bwo polo ka, koa kuno Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro chokou mi duogu uduto.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni chikeni ok ema miya mor, to dikoro aselal nono nikech masichena.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

kikuyu: Pok joma kare kelonegi ngima, to mwandu ma joricho yudo kelonegi kum.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ne chalo gi mach maliel ewi got ne jo-Israel.
english: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ber bedo gi matin kod tim makare, moloyo mangʼeny kod tim ma ok kare.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

kikuyu: Negiloso okanda ariyo mag gok mitweyogo law efodno e kondene gi yo ka nyime kod yo kangʼeye.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

kikuyu: Chutho, mano kaka weche Nyasaye odhiero ngʼeyo kendo nigi duongʼ miwuoro: Kristo nobiro e ringruok, kendo Roho nonyiso ratiro ni oonge ketho, malaike ne onene, kendo wachne ne oyal e kind ogendini, ji ne oyie kuome e piny ngima, kendo ne otere malo e duongʼ mar Nyasaye.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

kikuyu: “Bende dinyal dwaro chiemo ni sibuor madhako kendo ipidh sibuoche modenyo,
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

kikuyu: Eka nochako sayo Yesu mondo kik oriembgi gia e gwengʼno.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

kikuyu: Nikech ne gikia ngima makare ma aa kuom Nyasaye, gisetemo keto margi giwegi, ka gidagi rwako yor Nyasaye moketogo ji kare.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: En bende noloso chiemo mamit kendo nokelo ne wuon mare. Eka Esau nowacho ne wuon mare niya, “Wuora, aa malo ibed piny mondo mi icham ringʼo malosoni kendo igwedha.”
english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

kikuyu: Par kechni maduongʼ gi herani, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech gisebedo ka gintie nyaka aa chon.
english: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

kikuyu: To nowacho niya, “Nyaka ayal Injilini mar pinyruoth Nyasaye e mier moko bende, nikech ma emomiyo noora.”
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni ruodha gik mabeyo duto manosingone mi okete jatend jo-Israel,
english: It will come to pass, when the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

kikuyu: Napenjo malaika mane wuoyo koda niya, “Magi gin angʼo?” Nodwoka niya, “Magi e tunge mane okeyo Juda, Israel kod Jerusalem.”
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Negiwacho ni Musa niya, “Ne onge kuonde yiko mane inyalo yikwae e piny Misri momiyo ikelowa e thim ka mondo wathoe? En angʼo ma isetimonwani kuom golowa e piny Misri?
english: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

kikuyu: Eka nomedo wuoyo kowacho niya, “Mano emomiyo ne anyisou ni onge ngʼama nyalo biro ira ka ok Wuora ema okele.”
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jodolo bedo gi wichkuot kendo omiyo joma keregi osengirore podho.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

kikuyu: Kendo Nyasaye nowuoyogi Israel e fweny gotieno kendo owachone niya, “Jakobo! Jakobo!” Nodwoke niya, “Antie.”
english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: nikech ne akonyo joma odhier mane ywak ka dwaro kony, kod joma onge wuonegi mane onge gi joma dikonygi.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom jonabi makoro e nyinga: Ne ok aorogi, kata bed ni giwacho niya, ‘Onge ligangla kata kech manobi e pinyni.’ Jonabi gogo-go notiek gi ligangla kod kech.
english: Therefore the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.

kikuyu: Kodhi molwar e dier kudho ochungo kar jogo mawinjo, to ka gidhiyo e yoregi, to parruok mar ngima, mwandu kod mor mar piny thungʼogi, ma ok gidong motegno.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

kikuyu: To kar sa apar kogwen, Yesu nobiro irgi, kowuotho ewi pi.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

kikuyu: Omiyo Tamar nodhi e od owadgi ma Amnon mane oyudo nindo. Nokawo mogo modwalo mi otedo makati koneno.
english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

kikuyu: Mwandu mar jomoko e ohinga mochiel motegno ma gigengʼorego, giparo ni en ohinga maonge ngʼama nyalo muko.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Nyasaye notimo gi Ibrahim singruok kowacho ni yawuowi nyaka ter nyangu. Kane Ibrahim onywolo wuode ma Isaka, notere nyangu bangʼ ndalo aboro kosenywole. Achien Isaka nonywolo Jakobo, kendo Jakobo bende nodoko wuon kwerewa apar gariyo.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

kikuyu: kendo pasia ma borgi romo mita abiriyo nobedi e dir rangach komachielo kongʼawgi e sirni adek man-gi rachungi adek.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Nying sulweno en, “Gima Kech,” kamano bende achiel kuom adek mar pi nolokore makech, kendo pige makechgo nomiyo ji mangʼeny otho.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

kikuyu: kuwachonegi wach Ngima, mondo ka chiengʼ ma Kristo obiroe, to abed mamor ni kara ne ok aringo kata tiyo matek e dieru kayiem nono.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

kikuyu: Gima hoya e chandruokna en ma: ni singruokni rito ngimana.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

kikuyu: Kik iwe gilal e wangʼi to kan-gi e chunyi;
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

kikuyu: Noketo rachungi abich yo milambo mar hekalu kendo abich noketo yo nyandwat. Noketo Nam yo milambo, e kona ma yo milambo mar wuok chiengʼ mar hekalu.
english: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.

kikuyu: Mon mane odak kanyo nowacho niya, “Naomi nigi wuowi.” Kendo negichake ni Obed. En ema ne en wuon Jesse ma wuon Daudi.
english: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

kikuyu: Ka Nyasaye ok nyal geno jotichne, ma kata malaika bende joketho e nyime,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

kikuyu: Dhakono nokano lawno nyaka chwore noduogo dala.
english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

kikuyu: Kendo ne giwero wer manyien, kagiwacho niya: “In ema iwinjori kawo kitabuni, kendo gonyo kido molorego, nikech in ema nonegi kendo rembi ne ingʼiewogo ji ni Nyasaye, koa e dhoudi duto, kendo mawacho dhok duto kod pinje duto.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka onone, kendo ka purno olandore e law, kata e njora mochwe kata motwangʼ, bedni itiyo kode e yo moro amora, to en pur maketho gik moko; kuom mano gima kamano ogak.
english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

kikuyu: Ka un ma un joricho kamano, ungʼeyo miyo mich mabeyo ne nyithindu, koro Wuonu manie polo donge nyalo chiwo ne joma okwaye mich mabeyo nyadi mangʼeny!
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

kikuyu: Wuoro ohero Wuowi, kendo oseketo gik moko duto e lwete.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

kikuyu: Koso an kod Barnaba ema nyaka wati eka wachiem?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye oumo alwora mar jogo momiye luor kendo oresogi.
english: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

kikuyu: Tim maber ne jatichni, eka abiro bedo mangima kendo abiro rito chikeni.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gachiel mar Joram wuod Ahab, Ahazia nobedo ruoth e piny Juda.
english: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

kikuyu: To wuonu osewuonda ka oloko chudona nyadipar. To kata kamano, Nyasaye ok oseweyo otimona marach.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

kikuyu: Piny mane amiyo Ibrahim kod Isaka bende abiro miyi kaachiel gi nyikwayi.”
english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

kikuyu: kod Hebron; to mago man e kuonde duto ma Daudi gi joge nosebedo kadhiye.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

kikuyu: Koa kuom jo-Lawi ne gin: Shemaya wuod Hashub, wuod Azrikam, wuod Hashabia, wuod Buni.
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

kikuyu: Beduru motegno kendo jiwuru chunyu, un duto mugeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

kikuyu: Ginichuognu wer moro ma giywagougo, kendo giniwachnu ni: “ ‘Mano kaka otieki malit, yaye dala maduongʼ mongʼere, ma jonam odakie! Ne in gi teko maduongʼ ewi nembe madongo, in kaachiel gi jogi; ne ikelo bwok maduongʼ ne ji duto modak kuno.
english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”

kikuyu: Ne en gi ohinga maduongʼ kendo mabor man-gi dhorangeye apar gariyo kendo man-gi malaike apar gariyo e dhorangeyego. Bende e dhorangeyego nondikie nying ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel.
english: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Musa kod jodolo ma gin jo-Lawi nowachone jo-Israel duto niya, “Lingʼuru, yaye Israel, bende chikuru itu! Koro usebedo jo-Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: “Israel chalo gi rombe mokee ma sibuor oseriembo. Mano mane okwongo kidhe ne en ruodh Asuria; mano mogik mane oturo chokege ne en Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon.”
english: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”

kikuyu: Achiel ne olal, kendo ne awacho niya, “Adier osekidhe matindo tindo.” Kendo pok achak anene.
english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth madhako mar Sheba oneno rieko duto mag Solomon kod ode mar dak, manosegero,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

kikuyu: Lamek nowachone monde ariyo-ka niya, “Ada kod Zila, winjauru, un monda winjuru wechena. Asenego ngʼato, nikech nogoya, wuowi matin nikech nohinya.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

kikuyu: Ichano timbe midwaro wuondogo ji, lewi bende chano gik modwaro hinyogo ji; kendo lewino chalo gi wembe mabith.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

kikuyu: “Abiro nyiso duongʼna e dier ogendini, kendo ogendini duto biro neno kum ma akumogigo kod chwat ma achwadogigo.
english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek keto rieko mondo otel, to wenge ngʼat mofuwo bayo nyaka giko piny.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Ne wadhi nyime gi wuodhwa ka waa Turo, nyaka ne wagowo Potolomai, kuma ne wamosoe jowete, kendo ne wabet kodgi kuom odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, winj gima Jehova Nyasaye osechano timo ne Babulon, gima oseramo ni nyaka otimne piny jo-Babulon: Nyithi rombe bende nokaw; enoketh chuth kuondegi mag kwath nikech gin.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

kikuyu: Siro ka siro borne ne romo fut piero ariyo gochiko kendo alwora mare ne romo fut apar gochiko; sirnigo norokore kendo moro ka moro kore ne romo gi lith lwedo angʼwen.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

kikuyu: To rieko ifwenyo adimba gi nyithinde duto.”
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, owetena maler kendo ma oseluongi gi luong mar polo, keturu pachu duto kuom Yesu, ma en jaote kendo jadolo Maduongʼ mar yie mwahulo.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

kikuyu: gi kit agak duto,
english: every raven of any kind,

kikuyu: Anami jotichni ma jongʼad yien gunde alufu piero angʼwen (40,000) mag ngano moregi, gi gunde alufu piero ariyo gariyo (20,000) mag shairi gi degi alufu angʼwen (4,000) mag divai kod depe alufu angʼwen (4,000) mag mo.”
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

kikuyu: Jaduongʼ lweny nowinjo humb Yesu, omiyo nooro jodongo mag jo-Yahudi ire, mondo gikwaye odhi ochang jatichne.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

kikuyu: Anachal mana ka thoo mar okinyi ne Israel; kendo nolodhi mana ka ondanyo, kendo tiende nokar mana ka yiend Lebanon;
english: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

kikuyu: to ngʼato angʼata moyanyo nying Jehova Nyasaye nyaka negi. Oganda duto nyaka chiele gi kite, bed ni en ja-Israel kata jadak, to koseyanyo nying Jehova Nyasaye to nyaka nege.
english: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

kikuyu: Kik uparru kuom gik maun-go e pinyu, nikech gik mabeyo mag Misri duto nobed mau.”
english: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”

kikuyu: (Ji duto, kata mana jasol osuru, kane giwinjo weche Yesu, ne giyie ni yor Nyasaye ni kare, nikech nosebatisgi gi Johana.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

kikuyu: Chakre e kindeno Israel nobedo motegno mine giloyo Jabin ruodh Kanaan.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

kikuyu: nikech richone osebiwore mochopo e polo malo, kendo Nyasaye koro oseparo timbene mamonogo.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

kikuyu: Ibiro podho e gode mag Israel, in kaachiel gi jokedo magi duto gi pinje duto ma jokori. Abiro chiwi kaka chiemo ne kit winy duto machamo ringʼo kod le mager.
english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Jatichni ma wuonwa pod ngima kendo odhi maber.” Kendo negikulorene ka gimiyogo duongʼ.
english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

kikuyu: To bende kochakore e higa mar piero ariyo mar loch Ruoth Artaksases, e ndalo mane oyiera jatelo e piny Juda, nyaka ochopo e hike mar piero adek gariyo, ma duto ne gin higni apar gariyo, an kod owetena ne ok wachamo chiemo mane opog ne jatelo.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

kikuyu: nooro wuode miluongo ni Joram ir Ruoth Daudi mondo omose kendo opake kuom loch moloyogo Hadadezer, manosebedo kakedo gi Tou. Joram nokelo gik molos gi fedha, dhahabu to gi mula.
english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Eka Musa notelo ni Israel kagiwuok e Nam Makwar kendo negidhi ei thim mar Shur. Kuom ndalo adek ne giwuotho e thim ma ok giyudo pi.
english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

kikuyu: Wengeni biro neno ruoth kober kendo iningʼi piny molandore malach.
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

kikuyu: “To kik iwar kayo ma rwath, rombo kata diel; nikech giler. Kir rembgi e kendo mar misango kendo iwangʼ mo mawuok kuomgi kaka misango miwangʼo gi mach, ma en gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Inibed mamor ka masira gi kech nitie kendo ok niluor le mager mag piny.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: “Nyasaye ok en dhano kaka an ma dahedhra dwokora kode, kata madimi wayal kode e od bura.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata mobet kama ngʼama dende chwer osebetie, nyaka luok lepe kendo luokre, kendo nosik kogak nyaka odhiambo.
english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: To ka ok ginyal ritore giwegi, to onego gikendi, kata okendgi nikech kend ber moloyo ka gombo wangʼo ngʼato ka mach.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

kikuyu: Koro noyudo owete Josef kwayo jamb wuon-gi machiegni gi Shekem,
english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

kikuyu: Kane pod awuoyo kendo alamo, ka ahulo richona kaachiel gi richo mag joga ma jo-Israel, kendo kane pod aketo kwayona ne Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha kuom gode maler, kendo
english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God—

kikuyu: Omiyo Farao noluongo Abram kendo nopenje niya, “Angʼo ma isetimonani? Ere gima omiyo ne ok inyisa ni Sarai en chiegi?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

kikuyu: Jogo nohum nono, kendo negipenjore niya, “Ma en ngʼat manade? Kata mana yembe gi apaka bende winje!”
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Chiemo mabeyo miyo ngʼato bedo mamor, kendo divai bende miyo ngʼato winjo maber, to pesa ema miyo ngʼato bedo gi gimoro amora modwaro.
english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

kikuyu: Jakobo nowuok Bersheba kendo nodhi Haran.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

kikuyu: To ne ginene kapod en mabor, kendo kane pok ochopo irgi, negichano mondo ginege.
english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

kikuyu: Nikech Musa nowacho ni, ‘Luor wuonu gi minu;’kendo ni, ‘Ngʼato angʼata mokwongʼo wuon kata min nyaka negi.’
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Oparo singruokne nyaka chiengʼ, weche mane osingo e tienge tara,
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: mano kaka dine atieko wasikgi piyo piyo kendo dine agoyo joma kedo kodgi gi lweta!
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato onwangʼo jasike, bende oweye odhi ma ok ohinye? Mad Jehova Nyasaye chuli mathoth kuom gima itimona kawuononi.
english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may the LORD reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

kikuyu: bende gilos rachungi taya kod gigene duto kaka techene gi mo milielgo;
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel kod Jehoshafat ruodh Juda noyudo orwako lepgi mag ruoth ka moro ka moro kuomgi obet e kom duongʼne e kar dino cham mantie e dhoranga Samaria, kendo ne gin kod jonabi duto mane koro e nyimgi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

kikuyu: Eka dhako mane wuode ngima nokecho wuode mowacho ni ruoth niya, “Kiyie ruodha, miye nyathino mangimano! Kik inege!” To dhako machielo nowacho niya, “An kata in ok noyud nyathino. Ngʼade nyadiriyo!”
english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo timo gik mofuwo, to ngʼat ma ja-miganga ji mon-go.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu ni Bethania e dala ngʼat moro miluongo ni Simon ja-dhoho,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

kikuyu: mane jotho Endor modoko owuoyo mar dhok e lowo.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

kikuyu: Abiro kwanou achiel achiel ka un e bwo lochna, kendo abiro miyo ubed joma orito singruokna.
english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone wat Ruth mahie niya, “Naomi ma yande odwogo koa Moab dwaro ngʼama ngʼiew puodho mane mar owadwa Elimelek.
english: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato dende okuot kata oluro kata en-gi mbala marieny e dende manyalo bedo tuo malandore mar del, nyaka kele ir Harun jadolo kata ir achiel kuom yawuote ma en jadolo.
english: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

kikuyu: Farao kaachiel gi jolwenje maroteke kod oganda maduongʼ makedone ok bi konye e lweny, kata bed ni ogero raidhi kod ohinga mar agengʼa chiengʼ ma nakethie ngima ji mangʼeny.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

kikuyu: Omako joma riek gi riekogi giwegi, kendo gimoro amora ma giparo timo ok timre.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

kikuyu: Kinyne, jotend jo-Yahudi gi jodongo kod jopuonj Chik noromo Jerusalem.
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ngʼato ochiwo rombo mondo otim-go misango mar golo richo, to nyaka obed mana rombo maonge songa.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

kikuyu: Mad ngʼatno chal gi mier mane Jehova Nyasaye owito oko maonge ngʼwono. Mad owinj dengo gokinyi kod ywak mar kedo e dier odiechiengʼ tir.
english: Let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,

kikuyu: En Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa owuon mane ogolowa gi kwerewa e piny Misri, e piny mane wan wasumbini, kendo motimo ranyisi madongo-go ka waneno. Ne oritowa e wuodhwa duto kendo e kind ogendini duto mane wakalo eigi.
english: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

kikuyu: To moloyo kanyo, kare onego atine ngʼa? Donge onego atine wuode? Mana kaka natiyo ni wuonu, e kaka in bende abiro tiyoni.”
english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

kikuyu: “Nodwoko ni, ‘Awachonu ni ngʼato ka ngʼato man-go nomedne mi nobed gi mogundho, to ngʼatno ma ongego, kata mano ma en-go nomaye.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

kikuyu: “Nyinga nobed marahuma e kind ogendini, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ. Kuonde duto giniwangʼ ubani mangʼwe ngʼar ni nyinga kendo ginikel chiwo mopwodhi maler, nimar nyinga nobed marahuma e kind ogendini duto,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joab nodhi ir ruoth mowachone wechegi. Eka ruoth noluongo Abisalom, mi nodonjo kendo nokulore auma piny e nyim ruoth. Ruoth nonyodho Abisalom.
english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

kikuyu: Gikanyono ngʼatno nochango, kendo nokawo piende mowuotho. Ma notimore chiengʼ Sabato,
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Isaka nomedo dak Gerar.
english: Isaac lived in Gerar.

kikuyu: Negichako gichopo Jerusalem kendo, to kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e laru mar hekalu, jodolo madongo gi jopuonj Chik, kaachiel gi jodongo nobiro ire.
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

kikuyu: Ka dine ni Nyasach wuora, Nyasach Ibrahim, kod luor mane Isaka nigo, ne ok ni koda, adier dine iriemba gi lweta nono. To Nyasaye oseneno chandruokna gi tich matek mar lweta, kendo nyo okweri otieno manyoro ni kik itimna gimoro marach.”
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

kikuyu: Harun gi yawuote nyaka neni teynigo osiko kaliel e nyim Jehova Nyasaye chakre odhiambo nyaka okinyi, ka gikete e Hemb Romo oko mar pasia mantiere e nyim Sandug Muma. Ma en chik mosiko nyaka chiengʼ ne jo-Israel nyaka ne tienge duto mabiro.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: kata ndikgi gi kalamb chuma, kata ne gorgi e lwanda kama ok ginyal ruchoree!
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼ nobarore mopogore nyadidek kendo mier madongo mag pinje ogendini nomukore mogore piny. Nyasaye noparo Babulon dala maduongʼ, mine omiye kikombe mopongʼ gi divai mar mirimbe mager.
english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

kikuyu: Abiro loki gunda nyaka chiengʼ, kendo miechi matindo ji ok nodagie. Eka iningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Timbe maricho biro nego ngʼama timbene rach, to jowasik joma kare, bura biro loyo.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Mano kaka ijaber, jaherana! Yaye, mano kaka ijaber! Wengeni neno mamuol ka akuru. Yie wiyi chalo gi kweth mag diek, malor koa e Got Gilead.
english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is as a flock of goats, that descend from Mount Gilead.

kikuyu: Unutim angʼo e odiechiengu mowal mar nyasi, kata ka odiechienge nyasi mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo?
english: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?

kikuyu: Kata kamano ji mangʼeny ma nonenogi kagiwuok nofwenyo gisano ni ne en gin, omiyo ne giwuok e mier mokiewo machiegni duto ka giringo e yor tielo magikwongo ne Yesu gi jopuonjrene kama negidhiye.
english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

kikuyu: Ruoth, parie kaka ji osechayo jatichni, parie kaka atingʼo e chunya ayenje mag ogendini duto,
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

kikuyu: “Koro kor wechegi duto kuomgi kendo wachnegi ni: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye noruti koa malo; nomor ka polo koa e kar dak mare maler, kendo oruti gi teko kuom pinye. Enokogi ka jogo ma biyo olemb mzabibu, kogoyo koko ne jogo modak e piny.
english: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘The LORD will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

kikuyu: e kaka wachna mawuok e dhoga, ok noduogna nono ka ok otiyo tije, to nyaka ochop dwarona, kendo otiek tijno mane omiyo aore.
english: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

kikuyu: “Donge jo-Israel chalo mana gi jo-Kush?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Donge an ema ne agolo jo-Israel koa Misri, jo-Filistia koa Kaftor, kendo jo-Aram koa Kir?
english: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says the LORD. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

kikuyu: Wasika dok chien; gichwanyore kendo gilal e nyimi.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

kikuyu: “Kik ukan mwandu ne un uwegi e piny kama olwenda gi nyal kethoe gik moko, kendo kama jokwoge turoe kendo kweloe.
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

kikuyu: Koro achiwo chik ni ja-Israel moro amora manie pinya, kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi, madwaro dhi Jerusalem kodi, nyalo dhi.
english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.

kikuyu: Abiro kumo jokoro maneno fweny mag miriambo kendo koro weche mag wuond. Ok ginibed e buch joga, kendo nying-gi ok nondiki e kitepe mar dhood Israel, bende ok ginidonji e piny Israel. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.
english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: Jogi monegi nowit oko, mi ringregi nodungʼ kendo rembgi nopongʼ gode.
english: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nopor kuomgi, kendo luoro nomako jo-Benjamin matek, nikech negifwenyo ni masira osechopo kuomgi.
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

kikuyu: Ne iweyone jogi kethogi kendo ne iumo richogi duto. Sela
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Abiro gure motegno kendo mongirore ka sigingi kendo enobed e kom duongʼ ne od wuon mare.
english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

kikuyu: Nonywomgi ei anywola mar nyikwa Manase wuod Josef, kendo pok margi nosiko e anywola gi wuon-gi kendo e dhood gi wuon-gi.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

kikuyu: Ruoth nomedo wacho ni Zadok jadolo niya, “Donge in janen? Dogi dala gi kwe, gi wuodi ma Ahimaz gi Jonathan wuod Abiathar. In kod Abiathar kawuru yawuotu ariyo udhigo.
english: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

kikuyu: To Chik nomedi mondo richo omedre. To kama richo nomedoree, ngʼwono nomedoree moloyo,
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

kikuyu: Pige noneni, yaye Nyasaye, pige noneni mi luoro omakogi, kendo kude matut notetni.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

kikuyu: Kata mana kit topaz mokuny Kush ok nyal pim kode; ok nyal ngʼiewe gi dhahabu malerie mogik.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

kikuyu: Eka Abisalom nowacho niya, “Kare ka kamano to we owadwa Amnon odhi kodwa.” To ruoth nopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo dodhi kodu?”
english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”

kikuyu: Kendo Jehu nowachone jarit kar keno mar lewni niya, “Keluru kandhe moromo jodong Baal duto.” Omiyo nokelo kandhe moromogi duto.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

kikuyu: nikech kuom misango achiel kende, omiyo joma opwodhi odoko joma longʼo mi gibedo joma kare chuth.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodongwa kod ji duto modak e pinywa nowachonwa kama, ‘Kawuru gik mudhiyo godo e wuoth, dhiuru kendo urom kodgi ma uwachnegi niya, “Wan jotiju, losuru kodwa winjruok.” ’
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

kikuyu: Owuoyo gi rieko kendo puonj mar adiera ni e lewe.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

kikuyu: Bende e nyim kom duongʼno ne nitie gimoro manenore ka nam machalo gi kio mar rangʼi, to orieny ka pi. E dier komno tir gi alworane ne nitie gik moko angʼwen mangima man-gi wenge mangʼeny yo ka nyimgi kod yo ka tokgi.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

kikuyu: Elisha nowacho niya, “Winjuru wach ma Jehova Nyasaye. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Kiny kar sa maka ma, nengo gorogoro achiel mar mogo ibiro ngʼiewo silingʼ achiel, kendo gorogoro ariyo mar mogo mar shairi bende nongʼiew silingʼ ariyo e dhoranga Samaria.”
english: Elisha said, “Hear the LORD’s word. The LORD says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

kikuyu: Ka ungʼiyo polo ma uneno chiengʼ, dwe kod sulwe karieny (ma gin gigo manyiso duongʼ mar polo), to kik gimak pachu mi ukulrunegi ka ulamo. Gin gigo ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyo jopinje duto manie piny bwo polo.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

kikuyu: ka an kuomgi kendo in kuoma. Mad giriwre gibed gimoro achiel mondo piny ongʼe ni ne iora, kendo ni iseherogi mana kaka isehera.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

kikuyu: Kare mano emomiyo uduto useriworuna? Onge ngʼato angʼata manyisa ka wuoda timo singruok gi wuod Jesse. Onge ngʼama dewo gima timorena kata manyisa ni wuoda osethuwo jatija mondo obutna ka rita kaka koro otimoni.”
english: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nogolo chik, kendo negikelo Daniel mi gibole e bur sibuoche, kendo ruoth nowachone Daniel niya, “Mad Nyasachi, mitiyone ndalo duto, konyi!”
english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.”

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi nojwangʼo kuondegi mag kweth kod mwandugi kendo negibiro Juda kod Jerusalem nikech Jeroboam gi yawuote noriembogi e tich kaka jodolo mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to the LORD.

kikuyu: Negipenje niya, “Japuonj, Musa nondikonwa ni ka ngʼato owadgi otho moweyo dhako ma pod onge gi nyithindo, to ngʼatno nyaka kend dhako ma chwore othono mondo onywolnego nyithindo.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth noluongo Shimei ire, mowachone niya, ger ot Jerusalem mondo idagie to kik iwuogi ni idhi kamoro amora.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.

kikuyu: Jopur osepuro diengʼeya kendo gisegore opara ma roboche,
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

kikuyu: Gero mar ruoth chalo gi sibuor maruto, to ka omor kodi to ochalo gi tho manie wi lum.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

kikuyu: Nebuzaradan jatend jolweny notero e twech joma nodongʼ e dala maduongʼno, kaachiel gi oganda mamoko kod joma noringo modhi ir ruodh Babulon mondo otony.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

kikuyu: kisiko e yie motegno ka chunyi ok ngʼadni bura kaka jaketho. Jomoko osedagi winjo bura ma chunygi ngʼadonegi kuom gik maricho ma gitimo, omiyo koro yiegi osenimo.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

kikuyu: Kendo humbi nolandore e pinje kuom ber mane ibergo, nikech duongʼ mane amiyi nomiyo berni oromo chuth, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ringre Jezebel nochal ka owuoyo moyar e pewe mag Jezreel, maonge ngʼama nyalo wacho ni ma Jezebel.”
english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ochiko Joshua wuod Nun niya, “Bed motegno kendo ma jachir, nimar inikel jo-Israel e piny mane asingoranegi kakwongʼora ni anamigi kendo an awuon nabed kodi.”
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

kikuyu: Nikech un gidwaro mar chiwo, to Nyasaye biro rwako chiwono kaluwore gi gik maun-go munyalo chiwo, to ok gik muongego.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi ir ruoth kendo ne giwuoyo kode kuom chik mane osegolo: Donge nyocha iketo chik mindiko piny ni kuom ndalo piero adek mabiro ngʼato angʼata molamo nyasaye kata dhano moro amora ma ok in, yaye ruoth, to ibiro bol e bur sibuoche? Ruoth nodwoko niya, “Chikno osiko mana kaka chike jo-Medes gi jo-Pasia, ma ok nyal loki.”
english: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: “Haven’t you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?” The king answered, “This thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

kikuyu: “Ngʼat man-gi dhoho nyaka rwak lewni moyiech, owe wiye nono, oum lend wangʼe gi piny kendo oywag kokok ni, ‘Ok aler! Ok aler!’
english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

kikuyu: kendo iwach ni, ‘Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ruodhi mag Juda kod jo-Jerusalem. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Winjuru! Anakel masira kae mano mi it ngʼato ka ngʼato mowinjo nosakni,
english: Say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

kikuyu: Omiyo Amnon nonindo kowuondore ni otuo. Kane ruoth obiro nene, Amnon nowachone niya, “Daher mondo nyamera ma Tamar obi olosna makati moro mopogore gi mapile kaneno, mondo mi achame kotingʼe e lwete.”
english: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”

kikuyu: Enoresi; ok nonegi gi ligangla to initony gi ngimani, nikech igeno kuoma,’ ” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says the LORD.’”

kikuyu: To nodagi wachno kendo nokwongʼore kowacho niya, “Ok angʼeyo ngʼatno!”
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

kikuyu: to e laini mar ariyo chanie kite kaka tarkus gi safir kod emerald;
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: Emomiyo rituru buchene kod chikene ma amiyou kawuono, mondo gik moko odhi maber kodu gi nyithindu kendo mondo udag amingʼa e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou e kinde duto e piny.
english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.

kikuyu: Aa malo, Aa malo! Jiw badi motegno, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; aa malo kendo ijiwri, mana kaka ne ijiwori chon e ndalo mokadho. Donge in ema nitieko ondiek nam miluongo ni Rahab, mingʼado matindo tindo?
english: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane obiro ir Othniel, nojiwe mondo okwa wuon mare puodho. Kane olor oa e pundane, Kaleb nopenje niya, “En angʼo midwaro ni mondo atimni?”
english: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

kikuyu: noyawonwa yo manyien kendo mangima kuom ringre owuon mondo wakadh pasia.
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nochako obirona.
english: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni remba iolo oko kaka remb chiayo mitimogo misango kuom chiwruok kod tich maru kuom yie, to pod amor amora kendo ail kaachiel kodu.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

kikuyu: Nikech ngʼat ma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore ok wuo gi ji, to owuoyo gi Nyasaye, nikech onge ngʼama winjo tiend gima owacho. Owacho weche mopondo modhiero ngʼeyo gi teko mar Roho.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Un joma olony e chik, bende chandruok ochomou nikech umiyo ji tingʼ mapek ma ok tingʼo yot ngangʼ, to un uwegi ok unyal konyogi tingʼogi kata mana gi lith lwetu.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Maluk ne en Jonathan; koa e anywola Shekania ne en Josef;
english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

kikuyu: Nikech jayalo ne riek, nopuonjo ji gik moko duto mane ongʼeyo. Noparo matut kendo omanyo mi ochano ngeche mangʼeny kaka owinjore.
english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

kikuyu: to inyalo loko mwandugo pesa mondo iter kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi biro yiero.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa mosengʼeyo pach Jehova Nyasaye? Kata en ngʼa mosebedone jangʼad rieko?”
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

kikuyu: Otienono, Paulo noneno fweny mar ja-Makedonia kochungʼ kendo saye niya, “Bi loka Makedonia mondo ikonywa.”
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

kikuyu: Adiera anachokgi duto gia e pinje duto kamane ariembogie gi ich wangʼ kod mirimba mager; anadwog-gi kae kendo awegi gidag gi kwe.
english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.

kikuyu: Uluoro ligangla, to liganglano ema abiro tiekougo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Jomoko osehangonwa wach kawacho ni wapuonjo niya, “Watimuru atima richo mondo eka ber obedie?” Joma kamago owinjore gi kum!
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

kikuyu: Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nomonje motweye gi rateke mag mula motere Babulon.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni ngʼato pod dhi nyime gi koro wach, to wuon gi min monywole nowachne ni, ‘Nyaka itho, nikech isewacho miriambo kikonyori gi nying Jehova Nyasaye.’ Ka ngʼato okoro wach, to jonywolne owuon ema nonege gi ligangla.
english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in the LORD’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

kikuyu: “Wach ka wach moa kuom Nyasaye en adier; Nyasaye en okumba ne jogo mopondo kuome.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: E ndalogo jorieko ma jo-Kaldea moko nosudo nyime kendo negikwedo jo-Yahudi.
english: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near and brought accusation against the Jews.

kikuyu: “Un yawuot Jakobo chokreuru buta kendo uchik itu; winjuru Israel wuonu.
english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

kikuyu: Jowetena, kik ubed nyithindo e pachu, to chaluru nyithindo mayom mana kuom gima rach kende, to e pachu beduru jomadongo.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

kikuyu: Nimar jopiny ema chandore ka dwaro gigi duto, to bende Wuonu ongʼeyo ni udwaro gigi duto.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mane ochiwo Jakobo mondo obed gima oyaki, kendo jo-Israel e lwet joyeko? Donge en Jehova Nyasaye ma wasetimo richo e nyime? Nimar ne ok ginyal luwo yorene; bende ne ok girito chikene.
english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ne ni kod wuowino kane odongo kendo nodak e thim mobedo jadwar molony.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

kikuyu: kiwer gi nyatiti matin ma tondene apar ka wer ridore gi nyatiti maduongʼ ber adier.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno, Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼ ewi Got Zeituni mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jerusalem. To Got mar Zeituni-no nopogre nyadiriyo chakre wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ milos holo maduongʼ. Nus mar godno nomukre kochomo yo nyandwat, to nus machielo ochomo yo milambo.
english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

kikuyu: “Kodhi notwi maber, mzabibu nonyag olembe, cham nochieg e piny, kendo polo nochiw tho margi. Abiro chiwo gigi duto kaka girkeni ni joma odongʼ kuom jogi.
english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

kikuyu: Tera nonywolo Abram (ma bangʼe noluongo ni Ibrahim).
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

kikuyu: Nikech gik moko duto ma Nyasaye ochweyo beyo, kendo ok owinjore wakwer chiemo moro amora ka wachame gi erokamano,
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Negidak ka girito Od Nyasaye nikech nyaka negirite; kendo gin ema negitingʼo rayaw ma iyawego pile gokinyi.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

kikuyu: Weuru jadolo ka jadolo oyud pesa koa kuom achiel kuom jokan pesa; pesano onego olosgo kamoro amora ma okethore ei hekalu.”
english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe jomoko nochungʼ modonjone gi miriambo kawacho niya,
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

kikuyu: Emomiyo anapaki e kind ogendini, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo anawer wende mapako nyingi.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

kikuyu: Saulo mane oyudo ni kanyo noyie gi nek mar Stefano. Kochakore chiengʼno kanisa man Jerusalem nochako yudo sand malit kendo giduto negiringo mi gikere e pinje mag Judea gi Samaria, makmana joote kende ema nodongʼ Jerusalem.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

kikuyu: Daudi noyudo osewacho niya, “Kara ne en gima nono ka athagora gi rito mwandu ngʼatni e thim, maonge kata mana gire mane olal. To osechula mana rach kar ber mane atimone.
english: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

kikuyu: Rie badi mondo ichangi jotuo kendo itim honni kod ranyisi madongo e nying Yesu, Jatichni Maler.”
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

kikuyu: Apuonji e yor rieko kendo anyisi yo makare.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

kikuyu: Nomiye kalatas mondikie weche mag tiekogi ma nondiki e dala mar Susa, mondo onyis Esta kendo olerne weche mondikgo, nowachone ni mondo okwaye mondo odhi e nyim ruoth kendo ohomb ruoth ongʼwon ne ogandane.
english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

kikuyu: Ginimonj jo-Filistia kagiwuok yo podho chiengʼ, kendo giniriwre ka giyako gige ji nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ. Ginikaw piny Edom kod Moab, Jo-Amon to nobed wasumbinigi.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

kikuyu: Bor mar agola mane nitie e nyim hekalu noywayo lach hekalu, moromo fut piero adek kendo notingʼore malo maromo fut apar gabich.
english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Awachoni ni ok nyadibiriyo to nyadi piero abiriyo nyadibiriyo.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

kikuyu: Eka unuluonga mi anabi kendo ulama, to anawinju.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

kikuyu: Mana gi sa mane otieko wacho gigi, lowo mane ni e bwo tiendgi nobarore,
english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

kikuyu: To kata negisewuoyo kamano, jogo ne pod dwaro mana timonegi misango.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

kikuyu: Laban nochako nying kanyo ni Jegar-Sahadutha; kendo Jakobo nochake ni Galeed.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

kikuyu: kendo yier chiayo mopugno mogik ei kweth. Chan yiende mabeyo e bwoye ni chokego; eka chwakeuru maber, mondo ochiegi maber nyak choke.
english: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”

kikuyu: to gimoro achiel kende ema dwarore. Maria oseyiero gima ber moloyo kendo ok nomaye ngangʼ.”
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ ne timo winjruok gi jogo modak e pinyno ma udhiyoe, nono to ginibednu obadho.
english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

kikuyu: Ka dine ok obedo malichna ka dine ngʼat ma ok dwara ema ogarna, to dine apondone.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Biuru uluwa, mondo kar ywayo rech to aketu ubed joywa ji.”
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gangʼwen mar loch Ruoth Hezekia, Senakerib ruodh Asuria nomonjo mier madongo duto mochiel motegno mag Juda mokawogi.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe gium nangani gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe, kendo giyar suka marambulu bangʼe giket sirni mitingʼego.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: Koriwore gi jogo mane onegi e lweny, jo-Israel nonego bende Balaam wuod Beor, mane ja-nyakalondo.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

kikuyu: Koro kwongʼrina e nyim Nyasaye kawuono ni ok nitimna gimoro marach kata ne nyithinda kata ne nyikwaya. Emomiyo koro timna ngʼwono kaachiel gi pinyni ma intie kaka jadak mana kaka an bende ne atimoni maber.”
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

kikuyu: “Iwuoyo kuom dala maduongʼni ni, ‘Gi ligangla, kech kod masiche enochiwe ne ruodh Babulon.’ To ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho:
english: Now therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano anatimnu gima ne achano mondo atimnegi.’ ”
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

kikuyu: Mier madongogi duto ne ochiel gi ohinga kod rangeye mag chumbe, to bende ne nitie mier moko matindo mangʼeny mane ok ochiel.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

kikuyu: Ka uweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye, to obiro jwangʼo ogandani duto e thim kendo un ema ubiro miyo jogi rum.”
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ni kanisa. Ngʼat molocho to tho mar ariyo ok notime gimoro kata matin.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

kikuyu: Usengʼado kawuono ni Jehova Nyasaye en e Nyasachu kendo ubiro wuotho e yorene kurito buchene, chikene kendo ubiro miye luor.
english: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

kikuyu: Kuom higni ariyo kech osebedo e piny, kendo kuom higni abich mabiro pur kata keyo ok nobedie.
english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

kikuyu: ‘Paruru ahinya kochakore kawuono tarik piero ariyo gangʼwen mar dwe mar ochiko, ma en odiechiengʼ mane oketie mise mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.

kikuyu: Mano kaka yawuot Sayun mabeyo, ma yande bergi ne romre gi pek mar dhahabu, tinde ipimo mana gi agulni mag lowo, ma en tich lwedo mar jachwe aguch lowo!
english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

kikuyu: “Eliazar wuod Harun, jadolo, nochungʼne mo mar taya, ubani mangʼwe ngʼar, chiwo mar cham michiwo kinde ka kinde, kod mor pwodhruok. Nyaka obed jarit mar kar lemo duto kod gik moko duto manie iye, kaachiel gi gik maler molosego kod gik moko duto mokan kanyo.”
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

kikuyu: Kata e kinde mar nyiero, chuny nyalo bedo gi lit, to mor nyalo gik e kuyo.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

kikuyu: Daudi kod dhood Israel duto ne miel gi tekregi duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka giwer gi thumbe gi nyatiti gi orutu gi oyieke gi kayamba gi nyiduonge.
english: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

kikuyu: gi jochode, kod chwo ma terore gi chwo wetegi gi joma timo ohand wasumbini gi jo-miriambo, kod joma kwongʼore kariambo chutho mondo gigweny adiera. Adier chik oket ne gimoro amora makedo gi puonj mar adier.
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

kikuyu: “Winjuru wach, yaye joga, to abiro siemou, abiro siemou ka uikoru mar winja, yaye Israel.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

kikuyu: Omiyo ne nitie sirni aboro gi rachungi mag fedha apar gauchiel mag fedha, ka siro ka siro otingʼo rachungi ariyo ariyo.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kik uparru kuom kiny, nikech kiny noparre kuome owuon. Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ nigi chandruokne morome.
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

kikuyu: Kodhi moko nolwar kuonde motimo lwendni, ma lowo operoree mine gitwi piyo piyo, nikech lowo ne thany thany.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

kikuyu: To ka jo-Yahudi nodagi wachno, ne ochuna ni nyaka akwa thuolo mondo abi oyala e buch Kaisar, to ne ok atimo mano nikech an gi wach moro gi jo-Yahudi wetena.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

kikuyu: Kuom mano paruru ni chon ne un joma ok jo-Yahudi kuom nywol kendo ne iluongou ni “joma ok oter nyangu” gi jogo maluongore ni “oter nyangu” (mano motim e ringruok gi lwet ji);
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo wuon rawerano niya, “Osebedo kochal kama kinde maromo nade?” To en nodwoke niya, “Osebedo kamano nyaka oa e tin-ne.
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

kikuyu: Ne ok ginyal make kuom gima nosewacho kanyo e nyim ji kendo ka giwuoro dwokone, negilingʼ thi.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

kikuyu: Yesu nochako puonjogi kowachonegi niya, “Donge ondiki ni: ‘Oda noluongi ni od lamo mar ogendini duto’?To un useloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wan gi chir pile, kendo wangʼeyo ni ka pod wadak e ringruogni, to wan mabor gi Ruoth.
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

kikuyu: Ka joma kare yudo pokgi e piny, to joma ok oluoro Nyasaye gi joricho diyud mangʼeny maromo nadi!
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

kikuyu: Gigombo puothe gi udi mag ji kendo gikawogi githuon. Giwuondo ngʼato ma gimaa dalane kendo kata anywolagi bende gimayo girkeni magi.
english: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

kikuyu: Duongʼ obed ni Nyasachwa kendo Wuonwa manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Kaluwore kod chik mane ogolo, kende liswa mag Baal nomuki; nomuko kende mag misango miwangʼoe ubani mane ochungʼ e wigi motoyogi matindo tindo, kendo nomuko sirni mag Ashera milamo, nyiseche manono kod kido milamo mongʼadogi matindo tindo. Magi nongʼinjo matindo tindo mokeyogi ewi liete mag jogo mane otimonegi liswa.
english: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

kikuyu: Kik ulos kido moro amora mopa kata chungo siro moro milamo bende kidi moro amora mopa kik yud e pinyu kukulorune kulame. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Kendo Mefibosheth nodak Jerusalem nikech ne ochiemo pile e mesa ruoth, to tiendene ariyo ne ongʼol.
english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

kikuyu: ogunde, nyakech, ngawo, diend bungu, abur, mwanda gi rombe manie gode.
english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

kikuyu: Bende nooro wach ni Jehoshafat ruodh Juda kowachone niya, “Ruodh Moab osengʼanyona. Bende diyie dhi koda mondo waked kodgi?” Nodwoko niya, “Abiro dhi kodi. An mana kaka in, joga gin kaka jogi, kendo faresena gin kaka faresegi.”
english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

kikuyu: Ji duto makwongʼore gi nying Ashima, ma nyasaye madhako mar Samaria, kata makwongʼore gi nyasach Dan, kendo gi nyasach Bersheba, nopodh chuth, ma ok ginichak gia malo.”
english: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Sabato oserumo, Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria min Jakobo kod Salome nokelo modhi mangʼwe ngʼar mondo giwirgo ringre Yesu.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
