kikuyu: Joka Gad mamoko bende noluwo Daudi e kar pondo mare e thim. Ne gin thuondi mager kendo negiikore ne lweny kendo neginyalo kedo gi tongʼ kod kuot. Wengegi ne ger ka wenge sibuoche kendo tiendgi ne yot ka tiend mwanda maringo e got.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

kikuyu: Ok abi tho, abiro bedo mangima; abiro bedo mangima modo ahul gik ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Jeremia bangʼ ka Zedekia noloso winjruok gi ji duto man Jerusalem mondo oland ni wasumbini owe thuolo.
english: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

kikuyu: Nokaw achiel kuom apar mag jambu kendo un uwegi unubed wasumbinige.
english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

kikuyu: Tiengʼ-gi mar adek ma ginywolo nyalo donjo e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.

kikuyu: nikech pok uchopoe kar yweyo, kendo yudo girkeni ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou.
english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uluor kamano, yaye un joma nigi yie matin?” Eka Yesu nochiewo mokwero yembe gi apaka, mi nam nolingʼ thi.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth kadho kanyo janabi noluonge mowachone niya, “Jatichni nodhi e chuny lweny, kendo ngʼato nobiro ira gi misumba momaki mowachona ni, ‘Rit ngʼatni kolal to ngimani biro chulo ngimane kata ibiro chulo fedha maromo kilo piero adek gangʼwen.’
english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

kikuyu: Kik ukawe kaka jasigu, to siemeuru asiema kaka owadu kuom Ruoth.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

kikuyu: “To in Bethlehem Efratha, kata obedo ni itin e dier dhout Juda, kuomi ema ngʼat manobedna jatend Israel nowuogie, ngʼat machakruok mare noa chon, kinde machon gi lala.”
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

kikuyu: Roho mar Kristo mane nikuomgi nonyisogi chon kuom masiche mane Kristo biro yudo kod duongʼ mane biro luwo masichego, omiyo ne gitemo manyo kinde mane gigo biro timoree kendo kaka negibiro timore.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

kikuyu: Winj ma, un jogo mofuwo kendo onge wigi, joma nigi wengegi to ok nen, joma nigi it to ok winj wach:
english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

kikuyu: “ ‘Bangʼ mano anaduogi kendo, mi ager kendo od Daudi mosepodho. Anachak ager kuondene momukore, mi alose obed maber,
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

kikuyu: E chakruok mar loch Sakses, ne gidonjone jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem.
english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: “Ma e Musa mane oyudo gisekwedo kagiwacho ni, ‘En ngʼa ma oketi ruoth kendo jangʼadnwa bura?’ Nyasaye owuon mane ofwenyorene e kit malaika mane oneno e bungu noore mondo obed jatendgi kendo jaresgi.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

kikuyu: To Naomi nokonegi niya, “Kik uluonga ni Naomi, to luongauru ni Mara (tiende ni Makech), nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osemiyo ngimana obedo makech miwuoro.
english: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

kikuyu: adier ginibed mangʼeny mana ka jamni mitimogo misango Jerusalem e kinde mag nyasi mitimo higa ka higa. Omiyo mier madongo mokethore biro pongʼ gi kweth mag ji. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Weche joma riek jiwo mondo omi giti; to wechego kochoki to chalo gi ludh jokwadh makwayo rombe kata musmal mogur matek. Nyasaye ma jakwadhwa achiel kende ema osechiwo wechego.
english: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nosechano mondo otiek Ahazia kodhi limo Joram. Kane Ahazia ochopo negidhi gi Joram mondo girom gi Jehu wuod Nimshi mane Jehova Nyasaye osewiro mondo otiek dhood Ahab.
english: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Manase; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero abich gariyo mia abiriyo (52,700).
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Kamano jogedo molony mag Solomon gi Hiram kod jo-Gibal nongʼado yien kendo oloso bepe kod kite mag gero hekalu.
english: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negiluongo Rebeka kendo gipenje niya, “Inyalo dhi gi ngʼatni?” Rebeka nodwokogi niya, “Abiro dhi.”
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo obutona mondo gitieka, to abiro bet mos ka aparo kuom chikeni.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jehu ne ok oritore kuom mako chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel gi chunye duto. Bende ne ok olokore e richo Jeroboam, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruoth Nyasaye biro kelo kuomgi oula mopongʼ mag Aora, ma en ruodh Asuria gi joge mag lweny. Pi Aora nopongʼ wengene ma nomuom gengene,
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

kikuyu: To Jehoash ruodh Israel nodwoko Amazia ruodh Juda gi ngero niya, “Kuth alii man Lebanon nooro wach ne yiend sida man Lebanon ni, ‘Yie ichiw nyari ne wuoda mondo okendi.’ To le moro mar bungu mowuok Lebanon nokadho kanyo monyono kuth aliino gi tiende.
english: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

kikuyu: Dhorangeyene ok nolor odiechiengʼ moro amora, to otieno bende ok nobedie ngangʼ.
english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

kikuyu: Jeremia nodwoke niya, “Ok ginichiwi.” Luor Jehova Nyasaye kitimo gima anyisi. Eka inine maber, kendo ngimani noweni.
english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, the LORD’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nyiso herane moherowago kama: Kane pod wan joricho, to Kristo nothonwa.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

kikuyu: Ji duto manie tich mar misumba onego omi jotendgi luor mowinjore kodgi mondo nying Nyasaye kod puonj mwapuonjo kik yany.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Kaka Jehova Nyasaye ne nigi ruodha ma jaloch, mad obed gi Solomon koketo lochne obedo maduongʼ moloyo loch ruodha Daudi Jaloch!”
english: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

kikuyu: In ngʼat makare, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo chikeni nikare.
english: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ngʼama timbene richo jaro Nyasaye? Angʼo momiyo owacho e chunye ni, “Ok obi keta piny mopenja gima asetimo?”
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

kikuyu: Negigoyo koko gi dwol achiel kagiwacho niya, “Neg ngʼatni! To gonynwa Barabas!”
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

kikuyu: “Ne anyisogi ni ok en kit jo-Rumi mondo ochiw ngʼato angʼata ne joma odonjone, kapok omiye thuolo mar wacho kore kuom weche modonjnego.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

kikuyu: Morne ok ni kuom teko farase kata kuom ogwand dhano;
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Juda olokore moneno nine imonjogi gi ka tokgi kod e nyimgi eka negiywagore ni Jehova Nyasaye. To jodolo bende nogoyo turumbete
english: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom malaike miluongo ni serafi nohuyo mochopo buta kotingʼo mach e lwete, mosegolo gi ramaki e kendo mar misango.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye ne mor gi Hana; kendo nomako ich monywolo yawuowi adek gi nyiri ariyo. To Samuel nodongo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before the LORD.

kikuyu: Nimar nosiko koloyo jo-Yahudi gi wach moketi e lela konyisogi ratiro kaka Ndiko wacho ni Yesu e Kristo.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kor wach kinyiso ji ni Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: “ ‘Ligangla, yaye ligangla mopiagi mabith kendo oywe maler,
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.

kikuyu: Elija nowachone Elisha niya, dongʼ kae; nimar Jehova Nyasaye oseora Bethel. To Elisha nowachone niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kod nyingi iwuon, ni ok anaweyi.” Omiyo giduto negidhi Bethel.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

kikuyu: Chikeni nikare nyaka chiengʼ, omiyo miya ngʼeyo mondo abed mangima.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

kikuyu: Mano notimore tarik apar gadek e dwe mar Adar, to tarik apar gangʼwen ne giyweyo ma giketo odiechiengno obedonegi odiechieng mor kod nyasi.
english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: Kik iyie ichiw ngima mar akuch oduglani ne le mager mag bungu; kik wiyi wil gi ngima jogi mathagore nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

kikuyu: Nikech oseresa kuom gik mathaga duto, mi omiyo wengena ongʼiyo wasika tir bangʼ loyogi.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth oketonegi chik negimuko kite madongo ma nengogi tek mag mise mag kite mopa mag hekalu.
english: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasaye nobiro monyiso ruodh Israel niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, nikech jo-Aram paro ni Jehova Nyasaye en nyasach gode to ok nyasach holni, abiro chiwo jolweny mangʼenygi e lweti kendo ibiro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “The LORD is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Ewi gode madongo mag Israel ema abiro pidhee, kendo obiro yaro bedene kendo obiro nyago olemo mi obed yiend sida maratipo. Kit winy mopogore opogore biro gero utegi kuome, kendo gibiro yudo kar dak gi kar yweyo e bedene.
english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

kikuyu: kendo noketo makati miketo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Jakobo nopenjo jokwath niya, “Owetena ua kanye?” Negidwoke niya, “Waa Haran.”
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

kikuyu: Kit nam ma nengone tek kod kit ombo marieny ok di wuo kuomgi nikech nengo rieko oyombo nengo kit rubi maratiglo.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kikuyu: Tim maber ne jatichni kaluwore gi wachni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

kikuyu: “To puonjreuru wachni kuom yiend ngʼowu. Mapiyo ka bedene chako loth kendo itgi chako wuok to ungʼeyo ni ndalo oro chiegni.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

kikuyu: Ka iloso wach manie kindi gi jabuti, to kik idhi ihul wach malingʼ-lingʼ mar ngʼato;
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

kikuyu: Ahi wuod Abdiel, wuod Guni ne en jatend anywolagi.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Eka ne osudo e kitanda ma oriere kuom wuowino, ka dhoge ochomo dhoge, wangʼe bende ochomo wangʼe kendo lwete kuom lwet nyathi. Kane oyudo oriere kuom nyathino, dend nyathino nochako yudo liet.
english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

kikuyu: Nochopo kinde ma jopuonjre Johana kod jo-Farisai tweyo chiemo. Jomoko nobiro mopenjo Yesu: “Ere kaka Jopuonjre mag Johana kod jopuonjre mag jo-Farisai jotweyo chiemo to jopuonjreni to chiemo achiema?”
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi nachungʼ mondo adhodh wuoda to nayudo kotho! To kane anone gi ler mar okinyi ne aneno ni ok en wuowi mane anywolo.”
english: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”

kikuyu: ka odwoko gige ji mane omako kuom gik mane ohologi, gi gik mane okwalo kendo koluwo buche machiwo ngima, kendo oweyo timo richo, to enobed mangima adier kendo ok enotho.
english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

kikuyu: Ruoth noketo Benaya wuod Jehoyada jatend lweny kar Joab mi noketo Zadok jadolo kar Abiathar jadolo.
english: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Dhiyo kendo iwachne jogi kama: “ ‘Ubiro siko kuwinjo weche miwacho to wach ok nodonjnu ngangʼ; ubiro siko kungʼicho, to ok unune gimoro.’
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

kikuyu: Eka Musa norieyo bade malo mi ochwado lwandano nyadiriyo gi odunga mare. Pi nobubni oko, kendo ogandago gi jambgi nomodho.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

kikuyu: Iseneno gik mangʼeny, to ok isedewo; iti to oyawore, to gima iwinjo ema onge.”
english: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka duogi mondo onon odno kendo. Kapo ni gima rach makelo purno olandore e odno, to mano nyiso ni en gima rach makelo kethruok, kuom mano odno en gima ogak.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

kikuyu: Muche ema nomiyo polo olendo; kendo lwete ema ne onegogo thuol mane oyudo ringo tony.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Manase noromo ji alufu piero adek gariyo gi mia ariyo (32,200).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Musa nonyiso jaduongʼne gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye notimone Farao kaachiel gi jo-Misri, nikech jo-Israel. Bende nonyise chandruok duto mane giseyudo e yo kendo kaka Jehova Nyasaye noseresogi.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

kikuyu: Kik udhi kuno, nikech Jehova Nyasaye oseweyou. Wasiku biro lou,
english: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osechuli kuom remo duto mane ichwero e dhood Saulo, ma isetiyo kar lochne. Jehova Nyasaye osemiyo wuodi Abisalom pinyruoth. Osetieki nikech in dhano mohero chwero remo.”
english: The LORD has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! The LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

kikuyu: Mikael, Ishpa kod Joha ne yawuot Beria.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

kikuyu: to ei majno ne nitie gimoro machalo gi gik mangima angʼwen. E nenruokgi ne gin gi kido machalo dhano,
english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

kikuyu: Otienono nonyis Daniel tiend midhierono e lek. Eka Daniel nopako Nyasach polo,
english: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Kendo ne aneno gimachielo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ: Kama adiera gi ngʼado bura makare onego bedie, to richo ema bedoe.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

kikuyu: Kiluor mar monjogi, to dhi e kambi gi jatichni Pura
english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jasunga kendo jawuorre “Jajaro” e nyinge; otingʼore malo ka osungore malich.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasacha, parie kaka gisedwanyo tij dolo gi singruok mar bedo jadolo kod mano mar jo-Lawi.
english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

kikuyu: Rwethu kod pundeu mapuro lowo nocham lumb ogada kod chiembgi moregi, mi keyo gi uma kod opawo.
english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

kikuyu: moko nodak Jeshua, Molada, Beth Pelet,
english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

kikuyu: Beth Araba, Zemaraim, Bethel,
english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

kikuyu: “Eka nowacho ni, ‘Ma e gima abiro timo. Abiro muko dechena kendo gero moko madongo, kendo abiro kano chamba duto gi gigena kanyo.
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

kikuyu: Nooro jokonyne moko ariyo, ma gin Timotheo gi Erasto, nyaka Makedonia, ka en to ne pod odongʼ e piny Asia kuom ndalo moko.
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

kikuyu: To kuom jo-Israel mamoko: Koa kuom nyikwa Parosh: Ramia, Izia, Malkija, Mijamin, Eliazar, Malkija gi Benaya.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

kikuyu: Kane jo-chulano oneno ka thuol oliero e lwet Paulo, ne giwuoyo kendgi kagiwacho niya, “Ngʼatni nyaka bed ni en janek, mano emomiyo kata obedo ni osetony e nam, to bura mar tho mongʼadne pod luwe.”
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

kikuyu: E kindeno ka ngʼato owachonu ni, ‘Ne, Kristo ni ka!’ kata ni, ‘Ne, En kucha!’ to kik uyie wachno.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: To miuru Kristo duongʼ ei chunyu kaka Ruoth Maler. Beduru moikore kinde duto mar dwoko ngʼato mopenjou gimomiyo un gi geno ma un-gono. To timuru kamano gi muolo kod luor.
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

kikuyu: Musa gi Harun nokawo nying joma nomigi,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: Zela, Haelef, jo-Jebus (tiende ni, Jerusalem), Gibea kod Kiriath. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gangʼwen. Magi e mier mane opog ni dhood Benjamin.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

kikuyu: Negiloko adiera mar Nyasaye odoko miriambo kendo negilamo ka gitiyo ni gik mochwe kar tiyo ni Nyasaye ma Jachwech, mipako nyaka chiengʼ Amin.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Kik ungʼadne ngʼato buch tho ka nitie mana janeno achiel kende, to ngʼadne ngʼato buch tho ka nitie joneno ariyo kata adek.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi ndiri mag-gi kod dirisni matindo tindo, gi lach mar kor udi mane ni e bethene kargi adekgo; gi gik moko duto kaachiel gi ndiri ne oum wigi gi bao. Dier ot gi ohinga mar ot mochopo nyaka gamb dirise, kod dirise bende ne oum kamano.
english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

kikuyu: Yawuot Musa ne gin: Gershom kod Eliezer.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

kikuyu: “Wuoro Makare, kata obedo ni piny ok ongʼeyi, an to angʼeyi, kendo jogi bende ongʼeyo ni ne iora.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano negibedo maonge luor mi gingʼanyoni; kendo wigi nowil kod chikeni. Neginego jonabi magi; mane osebedo ka puonjogi mondo gidwog iri; negitimo timbe maricho miwuoro.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa ewi Got Sinai niya,
english: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

kikuyu: To weche mawacho niya, “ne okwan nego,” ne ondiki ok ni en kende,
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

kikuyu: kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham moromo gorogoro achiel gi nus mar mogo mayom moruw gi mo mobi e olemb zeituni moromo lita achiel.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

kikuyu: Nonyiso joge niya, “Neuru, jo-Israel osenyaa moloyowa.
english: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.

kikuyu: Ne gisomo Kitabu mar Chik mar Nyasaye, ka gilero tiende kendo gichiwo tiend chik mondo ji owinj malongʼo gima isomo.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

kikuyu: Kaponi achiel kuom gik mothogo olwar kuom kodhi mipidho, to kodhigo nosik ka ler,
english: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

kikuyu: Kane ngʼatno oneno ni ok onyal goye piny, nomulo fuoni mar bamne, kuom mano chieke nowil.
english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

kikuyu: Eka ogendini mag pinje duto makedo gi Ariel, mamonjo kuondege motegno kendo lwore, biro chalo mana ka lek kata ka fweny mar otieno,
english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

kikuyu: Ne gin gi iwgi makecho kaka thomoni kecho, to e iwgigo ne gin gi teko mar sando kagikayogo ji kuom dweche abich.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

kikuyu: Bathsheba to ne odwoke niya, “Mano ber, abiro wuoyoni gi ruoth.”
english: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Saulo ne gin Jonathan, Ishvi, gi Malki-Shua. Nying nyare maduongʼ ne en Merab to nyako ma chogo ne nyinge Mikal.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

kikuyu: Dho jomariek lando ngʼeyo, to ngʼat mofuwo to wechene obam.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

kikuyu: Nokawo Petro gi Jakobo kod Johana modhigo, eka chunye nochako chandore kopongʼ gi paro mangʼeny.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

kikuyu: Pilato ne nigi milome moro ma nondiko bangʼe oguro ewi msalaba gimalo. Nondike niya: Ma en Yesu Ja-Nazareth, Ruodh Jo-Yahudi.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato angʼata manobi kodi kata manobed machiegni ewi got kata mana chiayo kod kweth mag dhok kik kwaa e alwora mar godno.”
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nopogo pinyno mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
english: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

kikuyu: Otienono duto Abner gi joge nowuotho ka gingʼado Araba. Negiyoro aora Jordan, negimedo dhi ka gikadho gwengʼ Bithron duto mi gichopo Mahanaim.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

kikuyu: Bed ni ingʼeyo maber kaka jambi chalo; bende rit maber kwethgi;
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

kikuyu: Nyikwa Dan kaluwore gi anywolagi ne gin: koa kuom Shulam, joka Shuham. Magi ema ne anywola mag Dan:
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

kikuyu: to yie mondo iwinji gie polo kama idakie kendo tim gimoro amora ma jadakno okwayi mondo ogendini duto mag piny ongʼe nyingi kendo oluori mana kaka jogi Israel kendo mondo gingʼe ni ot ma asegeroni luongo nyingi.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

kikuyu: Mano kaka Ruoth Nyasaye osekumo Nyar Sayun gi mirimbe motwere ka rumbi! Duongʼ mar Israel ma yande otundo nyaka e polo, osewito piny, bende kuom mirimbe ok oseparo ni en raten mar tiende.
english: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

kikuyu: Eka joma ne oluoro Nyasaye nowuoyo e kindgi giwegi, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiko ite mowinjogi. Nying joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo mamiyo nyinge duongʼ nondiki e kitabu moro e nyime.
english: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another; and the LORD listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ulaworu koda kaka Nyasaye lawa? Sando ringra pok oromou?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

kikuyu: Nikech onge ngʼama nyalo keto mise machielo mopogore gi mano moseketi, ma en Yesu Kristo.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Anami joma ool teko kendo joma chunygi onyosore anajiw.”
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owacho kamano, achiel kuom askeche mane ochungʼ bute nothalo lembe kawacho niya, “Kamano e kaka inyalo dwoko jadolo maduongʼ adier?”
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

kikuyu: Nyako matin bende nonywolo wuowi kendo nochake ni Ben-Ami; en e kwar jo-Amon.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

kikuyu: Donge ungʼeyo ni gimoro amora madonjo e dhok dhi nyaka e ich bangʼe owuok oko mar del?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjogi niya, “Kuom ji ariyogi, en ngʼa mudwaro mondo agonynu?” Negidwoke niya, “Barabas.”
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

kikuyu: Neye kaka wasika sanda, yaye Jehova Nyasaye! Kecha kendo tingʼa igola e dhorangeye mag tho,
english: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

kikuyu: Bende ma e yo ma ugoyonego Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, yaye joma ofuwo kendo maonge riekogi? Donge en wuonu mane ochweyou mi olosou?
english: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo wuodho liganglagi kendo gidolo atungegi, mondo gichiel joma odhier gi jochan piny, mondo gineg joma yoregi oriere tir.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

kikuyu: Kamano Israel duto ibiro war, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Jawar nobi koa Sayun; enoriemb richo oa kuom Jakobo.
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Juda noresi kendo Jerusalem nodag gi kwe. Ma e nying ma ibiro luongego: Jehova Nyasaye mamiyo wabedo jo-ratiro.’
english: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: The LORD our righteousness.”

kikuyu: Mamoko modongʼ to nomako jotichne mi osandogi kendo onegogi.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

kikuyu: Andikonu baruwa machwokni ka Sila, ma akwano kaka owadwa madier kuom Kristo, konya. Ajiwou kendo atimo neno ni ma e kaka ngʼwono madier mar Nyasaye chalo, omiyo chunguru motegno kuom ngʼwonono.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

kikuyu: ka yawuoti orito singruokna kod chike ma apuonjogi, eka yawuotgi nobedi, e lochni nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

kikuyu: Eka Jeshua wuod Jozadak kod jodolo wetene kod Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel gi jogo mane tiyo kode nochako gero kendo mar misango mar Nyasach Israel mondo time chiwo mar misango miwangʼo pep, kaluwore gi gima ondiki e Chike Musa, ngʼat Nyasaye.
english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

kikuyu: Samuel to ne tiyo, e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka en wuowi matin korwako law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

kikuyu: “Lwet Zerubabel oseketo mise mar hekaluni kendo lwetene ema biro tieke. Eka iningʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema oseora iri.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Azaria ne wuon Helez, Helez ne wuon Eliasa,
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

kikuyu: To koro kelnauru ngʼat magoyo nyatiti.” Kane oyudo ogoyo nyatiti teko mar Jehova Nyasaye ne obiro ir Elisha,
english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Hanania ne gin: Pelatia kod Jeshaya, gi yawuot Refaya ma joka Arnan, joka Obadia, kod joka Shekania.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

kikuyu: Joab nowacho niya, “Ka jo-Aram tek moloya, to ubi ukonya, to ka jo-Amon tek moloyou, to anabi mondo akonyi.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

kikuyu: Petro nowachone niya, “Wan waseweyo gik moko duto mondo waluwi.”
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano nochungʼ e dhoranga kambi mowacho niya, “Ngʼato angʼata man kor Jehova Nyasaye obi ira.” Kendo jo-Lawi duto nochungʼ e ngʼeye.
english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

kikuyu: Jediael wuod Shimri, gi Joha owadgi ma ja-Tizi,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

kikuyu: Nikech Sayun ok analingʼ, bende nikech Jerusalem ok anasik kalingʼ, nyaka timne makare rieny ka yawruok mar piny, kendo warruokne obed marieny ka mach makakni.
english: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.

kikuyu: Anakel kuom pinyno gik moko duto masewacho kuome, mago duto mondiki e kitabuni kendo okor gi Jeremia kuom ogendini duto.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

kikuyu: gi jodolo kaka, Eliakim, Maseya, Miniamin, Mikaya, Elioenai, Zekaria gi Hanania ka gin kod turumbete mag-gi.
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

kikuyu: Kama e kaka joma timbegi richo chalo, ok gidew gimoro amora kendo mwandugi osiko medore ameda.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

kikuyu: Nikech, kuom adier, ne oyie doko manyap kane igure, to koro ongima kuom teko Nyasaye. Mano e kaka wan bende wanyap ka wan kuome, to kuom teko Nyasaye wan roteke kwatiyo kodu.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

kikuyu: To Samuel nowacho niya, “Kaka liganglani osemiyo mon owe maonge nyithindo, e kaka minu nobed maonge nyathi e kind mon mamoko.” Eka Samuel nonego Agag e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, Gilgal.
english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

kikuyu: Mano ema omiyo joka Lawi ok yud pokgi e kind jowetegi; nimar Jehova Nyasaye e pokgi mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nowachonegi.)
english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

kikuyu: Petro nonyise koramo niya, “Ooyo, Ruoth, ok inyal luoko tiendena ngangʼ.” Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ka ok aluoko tiendi, to ok iwinjori bedo koda e kanyakla mar jopuonjrena.”
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

kikuyu: Abiro nyiso ratiro ni herani ogurore motegno nyaka chiengʼ; kendo ni ne iguro adierani e polo owuon.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

kikuyu: ne awuotho koni gi koni ka chunya lit, mana ka gima aywago osiepna kata owadwa. Ne akulo wiya ka an gi kuyo maduongʼ mana ka gima aywago minwa.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

kikuyu: Gisegero kuonde motingʼore gi malo ne Baal mondo giwangʼ yawuotgi e mach kaka chiwo ne Baal, gimoro mane ok achiko kata tuomo, bende ne onge e pacha.
english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

kikuyu: Ma e tich ma gibiro tiyo e Hemb Romo: ginitingʼ yiende moten-go kar lemo, fito mage, sirni kod mise,
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: Jogo ma ok rit chik pako ngʼat marach, to jogo marito chik dagi jogo maricho.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

kikuyu: Otieno motelone chiengʼ mane Herode chano goloe Petro oko mondo oyale, negikete onindo e kind askeche ariyo, ka otweye gi nyoroche ariyo, kendo ka askeche mamoko bende rite kochungʼ e dhood twech.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

kikuyu: makmana, chiengʼ mwadonjo e pinyni, to nyaka itwe tol makwarni e dirisa kama ilorowanie, kendo nyaka ikel wuonu gi minu, oweteni gi joodi duto ei odi.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

kikuyu: Eka noumo kitabuno, mi nochiwe ni jatich, kendo nobedo piny ka wenge ji duto e sinagogi ne ngʼiye matek,
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

kikuyu: Tich ma jodologo tiyo e kama ler mar lemo en mana kido gi tipo mar tij dolo manie polo. Mano emomiyo ka Musa ne dwaro chako gero Hemb Romo to Nyasaye nosieme kawachone niya, “Ne ni igero gik moko duto machal gi kido mane onyisi ewi got.”
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

kikuyu: “To joge nosin kode kendo negioro joote modhiyo ire mondo giwach ni, ‘Ok wadwar ngʼatni mondo obed ruodhwa.’
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

kikuyu: Bangʼe jadolo biro golo chik mondo winyo achiel onegi ei agulu motingʼo pi soko.
english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

kikuyu: Josef nokawo owetene abich kendo okelo e nyim Farao.
english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, wach ni piny ni, ‘In piny mapok oneno koth kata nyidho gi wangʼe e kinde mane akelo mirimba.’
english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’

kikuyu: Chwech duto rito gi geno chiengʼ ma nyithind Nyasaye nofwenyre.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

kikuyu: Injilini nosingo chon gi dho jonabi e Muma Maler;
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

kikuyu: To Ebed-Melek, ja-Kush, ma jatelo e kar dak ruoth, nowinjo nine giseketo Jeremia ei bur. Ka ruoth ne obet e Dhoranga Benjamin,
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),

kikuyu: kod joma ne tiyo kanyakla kodgi, mane gin joma roteke. Giduto ne gin ji mia achiel gi piero ariyo gaboro (128). Jatendgi maduongʼ ne en Zabdiel wuod Hagedolim.
english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

kikuyu: Nokawo gik mane omiyego monywaso kendo olosogo kido machalo gi mar nyaroya. Eka nowachonegi niya, “Magi e nyisecheu mane ogolou e piny Misri, yaye Israel.”
english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Negimiyo ngimagi odoko matek gi tije achuna mag nyono lowo mar matafare; e tijegi duto jo-Misri noketogi gi tich mapek mar wasumbini.
english: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.

kikuyu: Negimiyo ywak joma odhier ochopo malo e nyime, mine owinjo ywak jochan.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼeyo gima negiparo kendo nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uparo gigi e chunyu?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

kikuyu: “Kapo ni asetamo jotichna machwo gi mamon e adieragi kane gin koda gi wach,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

kikuyu: Rech manie aora Nael biro tho, kendo aora biro dungʼ, jo-Misri ok nomodh pigno.’ ”
english: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

kikuyu: Wach gima notimoreno nolandore e gwengʼno duto.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

kikuyu: Mano kaka mwandu mathoth kama osekethi motieki kuom sa achiel kende!’ “Jotend yiedhi duto, gi jowuoth duto mawuotho gi yiedhi kod jokwangʼ yiedhi gi jogo duto maloko ohala e nam, ginichungʼ gichien.
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

kikuyu: Kaka Yesu nongʼeyo pachgi, nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uyie mondo paro maricho obed e chunyu?
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

kikuyu: To tim kama: Gol ruodhi duto e telo ni lweny kendo wilgi gi jotelo mamoko.
english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

kikuyu: Joma odhier biro neno mi gibed mamor, un ma udwaro Nyasaye mad chunyu bed mangima!
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

kikuyu: Jolweny mage pangore kochoma gi tekregi duto; gigona agengʼa ka gidwaro kedo koda, kendo giguro hembegi e alwora mar dalana.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko Josef nowinjo wach ni wuon mare tuo, kuom mano nokawo yawuote ariyo Manase kod Efraim mondo odhi onene.
english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Kamano, Jakobo gi Johana ma yawuot Zebedi mane jotiyo gi Simon bende nowuoro. Eka Yesu nowachone Simon niya, “Kik iluor; chakre tinendeni ibiro bedo jaywa ji.”
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Arab, Duma, Eshan,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

kikuyu: Kane Ruth owinjo wechegi, nokulore piny e nyim Boaz. Nowuoyo kowuoro niya, “Angʼo momiyo aseyudo ngʼwono machal kama e nyim wangʼi, an japiny moro nono?”
english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

kikuyu: Omiyo nokelo Simon ir Yesu. Yesu nongʼiye tir mowachone niya, “In Simon wuod Johana, chiengʼ moro noluongi ni Kefa” (tiende ni Petro).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

kikuyu: Ket kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani molos gi dhahabu e nyim Sandug Muma kendo iket pasia e dhood Hemb Romo.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noluongi ni yadh zeituni madongo maber man-gi olemo moolo maber. To mor matek mar yamb auka enowangʼe ka mach, kendo bedene notur.
english: The LORD called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

kikuyu: Jehoyada mane en jatelo mar anywola mar joka Harun ne nigi ji alufu adek gi mia abiriyo (3,700),
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

kikuyu: “Wuogi e kanyakla mondo omi atiekgi chuth.” Kendo Musa gi Harun nopodho auma e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

kikuyu: To koro, ruodha, yie iwinja. We akel kwayona e nyimi: Kik idwoka e od Jonathan ma jagoro, ka ok kamano to abiro tho kanyo.”
english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.”

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo kodgi, Goliath mathuon jo-Filistia ma ja-Gath nowuok kuom jolweny kakok kawacho wechege mag ajara mapile kendo Daudi nowinje.
english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

kikuyu: Kane Obadia wuotho, Elija noromo kode. Obadia nonene mongʼeye kendo nokulore nyaka e lowo mowacho niya, “Bende en in adier Elija ruodha?”
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

kikuyu: Gik machalo agulni mane ni e wiye nolosi kaka ondanyo. Kamano tich sirnigo norumo.
english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

kikuyu: Kane Mefibosheth wuod Jonathan, ma wuod Saulo, obiro ir Daudi, nokulore piny komiye duongʼ. Daudi noluonge niya, “Mefibosheth!” Nodwoke niya, Ee, en an jatichni.
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

kikuyu: to aneno chik machielo katiyo e fuonde mag ringra makedo gi chik manie chunya, mamiyo abedo misumba Chik mar richo manie fuondena.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

kikuyu: To dhoot midonjogo ei kama ler mar lemo noloso gi yiend zeituni ma lachne dirom fut auchiel.
english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono nowacho ni Elija niya, “Koro angʼeyo adiera ni in ngʼat Nyasaye kendo ni wach Jehova Nyasaye mawuok e dhogi en adiera.”
english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”

kikuyu: “Ywak winjore koa Babulon, koko mar kethruok maduongʼ, koa e piny jo-Babulon.
english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

kikuyu: Kuom mano, bed motangʼ mondo thuolo ma in-go mar chiemo kata mar weyo chiemo kik lokre kidi mar chwanyruok ni joma yiegi yomyom.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

kikuyu: Dhok ma ja-adiera osiko manyaka chiengʼ, to lep mariambo bedo mana kuom kinde machwok.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

kikuyu: To wedene ma joka Eliezer noyier yawuote ma gin Rehabia, Jeshaya, Joram, Zikri kod Shelomith.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

kikuyu: Yawuot Bela ne gin: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimoth kod Iri, giduto yawuowi abichgo ne gin jotend anywolagi. E ndiko mar nonrogi mar nywol ne gin chwo ma jolweny maromo alufu piero ariyo gariyo gi piero adek gangʼwen (22,034).
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

kikuyu: Alamelek, Amad kod Mishal. To yo podho chiengʼ, tongʼ-gi nochopo Karmel gi Shihor Libnath.
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

kikuyu: ma oro jootene ka ngʼado nam gi yiedhi mohondhi gi oundho. Dhiuru, un joote ma tiendgi yot ir oganda ma roboche kendo ma dendgi poth, moluor kuonde duto, oganda ma tokgi tek mawacho dhok mopogore, kendo ma pinygi aore opogo migawo.
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

kikuyu: Min pe to en ngʼa? Min koyo maa e polo to en ngʼa,
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

kikuyu: Ibrahim kwaru ne mor koneno ndalona; adier, nonene mobedo mamor.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

kikuyu: Kik iywaya oko gi joricho, kod joma timo gik maricho, joma wuoyo gi jowetegi maber to opando sigu e chunygi.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Yesu nomedo wacho niya, “Ngʼat man-gi it mar winjo wach mondo owinji.”
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne akoro wach kaka ne ochika. To kane oyudo akoro wach kamano, to ne apo ka awinjo ka choke rwadore matek, kendo chokego nochako tudore, ka moro ka moro kuomgi chomore gi wadgi.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

kikuyu: Jopinje mamoko to unyalo nyiso mondo ochulu gope ma gin-go, to gowi moro amora ma ja-Israel wadu nigo to nyaka iwene.
english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

kikuyu: Emomiyo par malongʼo nikech Jehova Nyasaye oseyieri mondo igerne ot kaka kama ler mar lemo. Bed motegno kendo itim tich.”
english: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

kikuyu: Denda ool kendo tekra orumo chuth; achur nikech chunya lit.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo Daniel (ma bende ne iluongo ni Belteshazar) niya, “Bende inyalo nyisa tiend gima ne aneno e lekna?”
english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

kikuyu: Malkiram Pedaya, Shenazar, Jekamia, Hoshama kod Nedabia.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

kikuyu: Kuom Mano dhiuru e yore madongo mag dala uluong ngʼato angʼata muyudo mondo obi e nyasi.’
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

kikuyu: Nimar an kod ogandana osengʼiew-wa mondo otiekwa kendo onegwa nyaka warum chuth. Ka dabed ni ongʼiew-wa mondo wabed wasumbini machwo gi mamon kende, to dine alingʼ alingʼa, nikech mano ok en gima dine achandogo ruoth.”
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

kikuyu: ngʼat moro omiyo teko mar timo honni, moro omiyo teko mar hulo weche moa kuom Nyasaye, moro omiyo rieko mar fwenyo ma lingʼ-lingʼ mag chunje mopogore opogore, moro omiyo nyalo mar wuoyo gi dhok mayore, eka ngʼat moro to omiyo mich mar loko dhok mayoreyore.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

kikuyu: kendo noyudo Yesu nitie machiegni gi hekalu, kowuotho e agola mar Solomon.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: “An, rieko, wadak kaachiel gi ngʼado bura makare; an-gi ngʼeyo kod pogo tiend wach.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

kikuyu: Abner noluongo Joab matek kowacho niya, “Chuno ni ligangla biro neko nyaka chiengʼ koso? Donge ingʼeyo ni wachni biro kelo sigu? Biro kawo kinde maromo nade mondo ikwer jogi owe lawo owetegi?”
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

kikuyu: Nogwedhogi chiengʼno, kendo owachonegi niya, “Ka Israel dwaro gwedho ngʼato to nokonyre gi nyingu kowacho kama, ‘Mad Nyasaye gwedhi kaka osegwedho Efraim kod Manase.’ ” Kuom mano noketo Efraim obedo maduongʼ ne Manase.
english: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo e od Jachwe agulni, kendo kanyo anamiyie otena.”
english: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”

kikuyu: Kata wach achiel mowuok e dho jogi ok nyal gen; chunygi opongʼ gi kethruok. Dwondgi chalo gi liel mapok oum; lewgi olony e wacho miriambo.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

kikuyu: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaya, Amaria kod Shekania ne okonye gadiera ka gidak e miech jodolo, ka gipogo jodolo wetegi kaluwore gi migepegi, jomadongo gi jomatindo machal.
english: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

kikuyu: Emomiyo ei Kristo Yesu anyalo sungora kuom tichna matiyo ni Nyasaye.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

kikuyu: Elija nobano lawe mar abola kendo ochwadogo pi, pi nobarore kochomo korachwich gi koracham mi ji ariyogo nongʼado kama otwo kadhi komachielo.
english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi noyie mokawo gik mane osekelone mi owacho niya, “Dhi dala gi kwe. Asewinjo wecheni kendo aseyie gi kwayoni.”
english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

kikuyu: To mokwongo, dwaruru pinyruoth Nyasaye kod timne makare eka gigi duto bende nomiu kaachiel gi mago.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi jo-Yahudi nowuoyo e kindgi giwegi ka gikwongʼore ni ok ginichiem kata madho gimoro amora kapok ginego Paulo.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

kikuyu: Nadab wuod Jeroboam nobedo ruoth mar Israel e higa mar ariyo mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, kendo nobedo ruodh Israel kuom higni ariyo.
english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye timo maber ne ji duto; okecho ji duto mosechweyo.
english: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

kikuyu: Jo-Arvad kod jo-Helek nolworo ohingani koni gi koni karito; Jo-Gamad noidho wi uteu moger maboyo mag rito. Ne gingʼawo okumbnigi molworo ohinga magi; kendo negimiyo berni obedo malongʼo chuth.
english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.

kikuyu: Gitimo nyasigi gi kongʼo, gi nyatiti, gi orutu, gi oyieke kod asili, to ok gidewo gik ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo bende ok giluoro tij lwete.
english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ne aweye e lwet chotnego, mane gin jo-Asuria, ma gombone noketee.
english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

kikuyu: An mana wendo e piny omiyo kik ipandna chikeni.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

kikuyu: Piny notetni kendo oyiengni, mise mag polo noyiengni; negitetni nikech nokecho.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

kikuyu: Eka Musa iye nowangʼ matek mi owachone Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Kik iyie gi misengini mag-gi. Pod ok akawo kata mana punda achiel koa kuomgi, kata mana kethone ngʼato angʼata kuomgi.”
english: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

kikuyu: Yaye yiend obudo, go nduru, nimar yiend sida osepodho; kendo yiende maboyo mabeyo oselwar piny. Un yiend ober mag Bashan; go nduru, nimar bungu ma yien ngʼenyie osebet oko.
english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.

kikuyu: Magi duto notimore ne Jerusalem kod Juda nikech mirimb Jehova Nyasaye kendo giko to ne oriembogi oko e nyime. Koro Zedekia nongʼanyone ruodh Babulon modagi lochne.
english: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Ka piny ngʼich, oonge luoro ne joode, nikech giduto girwakore gi nengni mapichni.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

kikuyu: Saulo nowachone Mikal niya, “Angʼo momiyo iwuonda kama kiweyo jasika dhi matony?” Mikal nowachone niya, “Nowachona ni, ‘Weya adhi. Angʼo momiyo danegi.’ ”
english: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”

kikuyu: Balaam nowacho niya, “Gerna kende abiriyo mag misango ka, kendo ikna rwedhi abiriyo kod imbe abiriyo.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

kikuyu: Ne aywak niya, “mano kaka lit! Arumo chuth! Nimar an ngʼat ma dhoge wacho gik ma ok ler kendo adak e kind joma wechegi ochido, eka an to aseneno Ruoth, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego gi wangʼa awuon.”
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”

kikuyu: Koro wuoda, tim gima awachoni: Ring idhi Haran ir Laban owadwa.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

kikuyu: Emomiyo luwuru chikena kendo ritreuru ma kik uluw timbe makwero mane joma odak e pinyni otimo kapok ubiro, mondo kik ubed mogak. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: “Gima lich kendo mabwogo ji osetimore e piny:
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ngʼat moro noromo kodwa mowachonwa ni, ‘Doguru ir ruoth mane oorou mondo unyise ni Jehova Nyasaye owacho kama: “Nyasaye onge e Israel ka koso mamiyo upenjo Baal-Zebub ma nyasach jo-Ekron wach? Kuom mano ok inichungi e kitanda minindeni nyaka itho.” ’ ”
english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

kikuyu: Eka negiwinjo tiend wach ni kare ne ok owachnegi ni giritre kuom thowi mitedogo makati, to ni mondo giritre kuom puonj jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

kikuyu: To koro Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama; jal mane ochweya e ich mondo abed jatichne, mondo adwok joka Jakobo kuome kendo achok jo-Israel ire, nimar aseyudo duongʼ e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Nyasacha ema osebedo tekrena.
english: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.

kikuyu: “An Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach ogendini duto. Bende nitiere gima tekna?
english: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

kikuyu: Omiyo gol chik mondo orit liel nyaka chiengʼ mar adek. Nono to jopuonjrene nyalo biro mi kwal ringre mi giwach ne ji ni osechier oa kuom joma otho. Miriambo machien-ni dibed marach moloyo mokwongo.”
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Simon, an-gi gima adwaro wachoni.” Nowachone niya, “Wachna, japuonj.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

kikuyu: Ngʼama dichwo ma hike chakore piero ariyo nyaka piero auchiel, en to noware mana gi shekel piero abich mag fedha, ma gin shekel mitiyogo e kama ler mar lemo.
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Kinyne Yesu nongʼado e pache mondo oa odhi Galili. Kane oyudo Filipo, nowachone niya, “Luwa.”
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: “Bende wachiwore mar kelo nyak mokwongo mar chambwa kod olemo moro amora higa ka higa e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to the LORD’s house;

kikuyu: Koa e nus mar dhood Manase nomigi Tanak kod Gath Rimon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ariyo.
english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

kikuyu: Bende ineno ngʼato ma paro owuon ni oriek? Ngʼat mofuwo nitiere gi geno moloye.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negichiko dala mochiel gohinga mar Turo kod dala duto mag jo-Hivi kod mago mag jo-Kanaan. Mogik, negidhi Bersheba man Negev e piny Juda.
english: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

kikuyu: Kata kamano unyalo tongʼo yiende ma ok nyag olemo mondo uketgi ka ohinga mi ukaw dala maduongʼ ma ukedogono.
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

kikuyu: Mirimb Nyasaye nyalo lwar kuomu, ma olor ranga polo, mi koth bed maonge kendo puothe ok nochieg cham, ma uduto utho e piny maber ma Jehova Nyasaye miyou.
english: and the LORD’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.

kikuyu: Joshua nowachone jodolo niya, “Kawuru Sandug Muma mar singruok kendo utel kode e nyim ji.” Omiyo ne gikawe mi gidhi nyimgi.
english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

kikuyu: nimar noyudo ka Jehova Nyasaye osedino ii mon man e od Abimelek nikech Sara chi Ibrahim.
english: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

kikuyu: Kik ibed maluor, yaye Jakobo, kata obedo ni inenori ni iyomyom ka kudni kamano, yaye in Israel matin maonge ndhathe kik ibed maluor, nimar an awuon abiro konyi,” Jehova Nyasaye Maler mar Israel, ma Jawarni ema asewacho kamano.
english: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: “Hemb Romo kod hembene ma oko, gi raumne, gi ramakine, gi sirnine gi bepene miriwo kod sirni gi rachungigi,
english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

kikuyu: Nebuzaradan jatend jolweny notero e twech jomoko kuom joma odhier kod jogo mane odongʼ e dala maduongʼno, kaachiel gi jogo molony e tij lwedo kod joma noringo modhi ir ruodh Babulon mondo otony.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

kikuyu: Aywakni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; awachoni niya, “In e kar pondona, kendo in e pokna e piny joma ngima.”
english: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

kikuyu: to giniyud kony matin ka gipodho, kendo jomoko mangʼeny mawuondore nodonj lingʼ-lingʼ diergi.
english: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.

kikuyu: Ne ok ongʼeyo gima dowachi nikech luoro nogoyogi.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

kikuyu: Chakre odhiambo mar tarik apar gangʼwen nyaka odhiambo mar tarik piero ariyo gachiel mar dwe mokwongo nyaka ucham makati ma ok oketie thowi.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.

kikuyu: Ne owuotho e wangʼ yo makadho but od dhakono, kowuotho kochiko od dhakono,
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kikuyu: Bende negilosone law akor thiwni mokedi mag dhahabu maler machalo kaka tol.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde moko Daudi noloyo jo-Filistia ma gibedo e bwo lochne, kendo nokawo Metheg Ama mogolo e loch jo-Filistia.
english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: to un muyudo sand obiro miyou yweyo, kaachiel kodwa. Mano notimre chiengʼ ma Ruoth Yesu nofwenyre e mach makakni kolor oa e polo, kaachiel gi malaika mage maroteke.
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

kikuyu: Ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye kagiwacho niya, ‘Wasetimo richo, waseweyo Jehova Nyasaye mi watiyo ne nyiseche mag Baal gi Ashtoreth. To koro sani reswa e lwet wasikwa mi wanatini.’
english: They cried to the LORD, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

kikuyu: ne chalre gi dhoudi mag udi mane ni yo milambo. Ne nitie dhoot moro kama yo miwuothoe ochakore mane oringo e laini achiel gi ohinga machielo machal kode mane yawore kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Dhoodno ema ne idonjogo e utego.
english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

kikuyu: Gima ne litnegi ahinya ne en gima nowacho ni ne ok gibi nene kendo. Bangʼ mano ne gikowe ei yie.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto koro osewinji, omiyo koro ma e wach mogik: Luor Nyasaye kendo rit chikene nimar ma e tich mane omi dhano.
english: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

kikuyu: Ne ingʼinyo Rahab mana ka kitundu, kendo ne ikeyo wasiki gi badi maratego.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

kikuyu: Kane gigoyo koko bangʼ-gi, jo-Dan nolokore kendo owacho ne Mika niya, “En angʼo marach kodi momiyo ne ioro wach ne jowu mondo oked kodwa?”
english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”

kikuyu: Eka ji duto mane ni e kambi nokok ni Jonathan gi jatingʼne gi lwenje niya, “Biuru irwa mondo une gima wabiro timonu.” Omiyo Jonathan nowacho ni jatingʼ gi lwenje niya, “Idh iluwa Jehova Nyasaye oseketogi e lwet jo-Israel.”
english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kuom adier, mirima ma in-go gi ji, keloni pak, kendo miyo joma otony ne mirimbi ritore.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

kikuyu: Ndalo ka ndalo nopuonjo e hekalu. To jodolo madongo, jopuonj chik kod jotelo mag ji netemo mondo ginege.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

kikuyu: “Ngʼa madihedhre chayo odiechieng chako gik matindo? Ji nobed mamor ka gineno tond pimo ot e lwet Zerubabel. “Teyni abiriyogi ochungʼ kar wenge Jehova Nyasaye marango piny koni gi koni.”
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Orito rombene mana kaka jakwath: Ochoko nyirombene e bade, kendo oriwogi e kore kotelo maber ni rombe man-gi nyithindo.
english: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

kikuyu: Omiyo ka joma ok oter nyangu timo gik ma Chik dwaro, to donge inyalo kwan-gi kaka joma oter nyangu?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

kikuyu: In e tekona, omiyo abiro weroni wend pak; in e ohingana, yaye Nyasaye, in e Nyasacha ma jahera.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

kikuyu: “To negitamore winjo wechena; mi gingʼanyona kendo gidino parogi mondo kik giwinj wechena.
english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Isakar, kaw Nethanel wuod Zuar;
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Nikech En, koro uyie kuom Nyasaye, mane ochiere oa kuom joma otho mi omiye duongʼ mondo yie maru kod geno maru obed kuom Nyasaye.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

kikuyu: Ka uneno ma, to chunyu nobed gi mor, kendo dendu nobed maber mana ka lum matwi ndalo chwiri; lwet Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyre ne jotichne, to mirimbe to none kuom wasike.
english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

kikuyu: Nikech chuny dhano ema richo duto wuokie kaka: paro maricho, chode, kuo, nek, terruok,
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa, to ngʼatni to wakia kata mana kuma oaye.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ka Abigael nodhi ir Nabal ne en e ot kotimo Sawo maduongʼ ka mar ruoth. Ne omor ahinya bende ne omer. To ok nowachone gimoro nyaka piny noru.
english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

kikuyu: Oonge ka; osechier, mana kaka nowacho. Biuru une kama noninde.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

kikuyu: Eka Jehoahaz nokwayo Jehova Nyasaye kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowinje, nimar noneno kaka ruodh Aram ne sando jo-Israel malit.
english: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

kikuyu: kendo uwach ne jadolo manie tich e kindeno niya, “Asingora kawuono ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ni asebiro e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osingore ni kwerewa ni nomiwa.”
english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”

kikuyu: Ka gweth kata kwongʼ-gi ma aseketo e nyimu obironu kendo uketogi e chunyu kamoro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nokewu e kind pinje,
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

kikuyu: Joash notimo gima kare e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye e ndalo duto mane Jehoyada jadolo.
english: Joash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye osetimona mana maromre gi timna makare; osechula kaluwore gi tich lweta maler.
english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

kikuyu: To kuom wachni, ngʼato kik tim ni wadgi marach kata wuonde. Ruoth biro kumo joma timo timbe ma kamago mana kaka ne wasenyisou kendo siemou.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
