kikuyu: Nyaka winj oyundi oseloso kar dakne, kendo opija bende osegero ode, kama onyalo nywole nyithinde, but kendoni mar misango, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Ruodha kendo Nyasacha.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

kikuyu: Reswa kendo konywa gi lweti ma korachwich, mondo joma ihero ogol e chandruok.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo mangʼeny ibiro dwar ni imanri gi gigi mag lweny. E higni mabiro ibiro monjo piny moro ma ji osebedo kodakie gi kwe maonge lweny, ma en piny ma joge nochoki oter e gode mag Israel kogol e pinje mathoth ma yande chon okethi modongʼ nono. Ne ogolgi e dier ogendini kendo koro gidak gi kwe giduto.
english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

kikuyu: To eka Nyasaye to okawa ni an jaketho; kendo okwana kaka jasike.
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

kikuyu: Piny gi polo mondo opake, kaachiel gi nembe kod gik moko duto mawuothoe igi,
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka ngʼato opwodhi kuom gima chwer e dende, to nyaka oketre tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo mar nyasi mar pwodhruok; mi olwok lepe kod dende kendo obiro bedo mapoth.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto noneno ni ruoth nodagi winjo wachgi, negidwoko ruoth niya, “Wat mane moriwowa kod Daudi, angʼo moriwowa gi wuod Jesse? Doguru e hembeu, yaye jo-Israel! Rituru dhoutu uwegi, yaye oganda Daudi!” Kuom mano jo-Israel nodok e miechgi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenja niya, “En angʼo mineno, Jeremia?” Ne odwoko niya, “Aneno ngʼope. Mabeyo to beyo ahinya, to maricho to richo ahinya ma ok nyal cham.”
english: Then the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I said, “Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can’t be eaten.”

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Saulo nochamo dwond Daudi mowacho niya, “Mano en dwondi Daudi wuoda?” Daudi nodwoke niya, “Ee mano dwonda ruodha ma ruoth.”
english: Saul recognized David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”

kikuyu: Daudi ne ja-higni piero adek kane obedo ruoth, kendo nobedo e loch kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

kikuyu: Pok mar piero gangʼwen ne mar Romamti-Ezer gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

kikuyu: Ok oyienigi sudo buta machiegni mondo gitina kaka jodolo, kata mondo gibi machiegni gi gira moro amora maler, kata gi chiwo maga maler mogik. Nyaka gitingʼ wichkuot mar timbegi mamono.
english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

kikuyu: To abiro miyo jonenona ariyo morwakore gi lep gugru teko, kendo ginihul wach Nyasaye kuom ndalo alufu achiel gi mia ariyo kod piero auchiel.”
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi nokweyo jogo duto kawacho niya, “Kik chunyu chandre, nikech odiechiengni en odiechiengʼ mowal, bende kik ubed gi kuyo.”
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

kikuyu: Holniu mabeyo opongʼ gi geche mag lweny, kendo joidh farese osechielo rangeye mag dala maduongʼ.
english: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka uneno gigi duto timore to ngʼeuru ni kindeno chiegni, kendo mana ka gima en e dhoot.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

kikuyu: Eka nomulo wengegi kowacho niya, “Biro timorenu kuom yie ma un-go,”
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Jal Maler mar Israel ma jaresu wacho: “Nikech un, abiro oro ji Babulon mondo odhi oom jo-Babulon duto e twech, kotingʼ-gi e yiedhi mane gisungorego.
english: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

kikuyu: kod gima ingʼadogo otambi mar teyni molos gi dhahabu maler, gi tewni mag kiro remo, gi dise gi tawo mar ubani kod dhout hekalu mar dhahabu: dhoudi mar ot maiye gi Kama Ler Moloyo kaachiel gi dhoudi mag dier ot maduongʼ.
english: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho e kindeno niya, “Anabed Nyasach dhout Israel duto, kendo ginibed joga.”
english: “At that time,” says the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

kikuyu: “Yaye Nyasaye, nyisa gima idwaro. En ngʼa machielo mabiro rita?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

kikuyu: Kendo anakel lweny e dieru mondo achulgo kuor kuom ketho singruok mane atimo kodu, kendo kinde duto manuchokru e miechu to nagou gi tuoche kendo wasiku nomaku.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Ok anyal wacho gima Jehova Nyasaye ne ok onyisa?”
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

kikuyu: Nokwayo bao mar ndiko kendo ji duto nowuoro ka nondiko niya, “Nyinge en Johana.”
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

kikuyu: Isaka nomedo bedo gi mwandu ahinya kendo mwandune nomedore mobedo jamoko marahuma.
english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

kikuyu: Uzia ne ja-higni apar gauchiel kane odoko ruoth kendo nobedo ruoth kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero abich gariyo. Min mare ne nyinge Jekolia ma nyar Jerusalem.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Magi donge e weche mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kotiyo gi jonabi machon, e kinde mane Jerusalem gi mier molwore ne nigi kwe kendo dhi maber, bende e kinde ma Negev gi pinje manie tie gode ma yo podho chiengʼ ne pok ji odakie?’ ”
english: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny marito ruoth nomako Seraya jadolo maduongʼ, gi Zefania jadolo maluwe kod ji adek ma jorit dhoot hekalu moterogi e twech.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

kikuyu: Gijaro ji kendo giwuoyo ka gihimo ji, nikech gichayo ji gisiko gibwogo ji ni ji biro wuoro.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

kikuyu: mesa gi gigene duto mag tije, rachungi taya gi gigene duto mag tich, kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani,
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

kikuyu: Kane osebedo Antiokia kuom ndalo mogwarore, Paulo nowuok oa kanyo, mi nowuotho e gwenge duto mag piny Galatia gi Frugia, kojiwo jopuonjre duto.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowachone Gideon niya, “Bed jatendwa, in kaachiel gi wuodi kod nyakwari ma wuowi, nikech iseresowa e lwet jo-Midian.”
english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema daher mondo awuogo kendo mondo anyis Nyasaye gik mane chunya.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

kikuyu: to an bende nanyisu wich teko, mi anamiu kum moloyo nyadibiriyo nikech richou.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Ne omuko ohinga mag-gi motegno kendo noketho miechgi chuth. Piny kaachiel gi ji duto mane ni e iye luoro nomako kane giwinje koruto.
english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jagoro morito dalano nopieyo ji kawacho niya, “Un jo-Efeso, donge piny ngima ongʼeyo ni dala mar Efeso ema orito hekalu mar nyasaye marahuma miluongo ni Artemis, kaachiel gi kidone manolwar koa e polo?
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

kikuyu: Bangʼe achien, kane odhi mondo onywome, nolokore mondo one choke sibuor motho. E ringrene kanyo nopo koneno kich mochiek kochokore kuome,
english: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

kikuyu: Makatigo mondo odongʼ ni Harun gi yawuote, kendo nyaka gichamgi kama ler mar lemo, nikech en migawo mar pok maler moloyo ma gichiwo kinde ka kinde kaka misengini miwangʼo ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

kikuyu: Richo ma isetimo ema omiyo iwuoyo alanda kamano; kendo ilony e wacho miriambo.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

kikuyu: Jowetena, kaponi pod ayalo wach tero nyangu, to ere gima omiyo pod isanda kama? Ka kamano to kare puonj ma apuonjo mar msalaba dine ok okelo chwanyruok.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

kikuyu: To e kindeno janabi moro nobiro ir Ahab Ruodh Israel molando niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ‘Donge ineno jolweny mangʼenygi? Abiro chiwe e lweti kawuono kendo ibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Nimar chunygi ne ok omoko kuome, kendo ne ok gilu singruokne kuom adier.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

kikuyu: Jo-Babulon mamonjo dala maduongʼni nodonji kendo ginimok kuome mach; giniwangʼe pep, kaachiel gi udi kamane ji owangʼoe iya kuom wangʼo ubani ewi tedni ne Baal kendo kuom chiwo misango miolo piny ne nyiseche manono.
english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

kikuyu: Zeba gi Zalmuna, ma ruodhi ariyo mag Midian, noringo, to nolawogi mi omakogi, kendo makogino nokelo luoro maduongʼ ne jolwenjgi.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

kikuyu: Ka turumbete ariyogi oywak, to ogandagi mondo ochokre e nyimi e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ish-Boseth ok nohedhore wacho gimoro kendo ni Abner nikech noluore.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

kikuyu: Ka imor koda to puonja yoreni mondo angʼeyi kendo mondo asik ka amori. Par ni ogandani gin jogi.”
english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

kikuyu: Eka naparo niya, “Ma e kama abiro kwayoe kony: higni ma lwet Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo ma korachwich osetieko.
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

kikuyu: Ruoth nowuok kaachiel gi joode duto makmana monde mamoko apar ema ne oweyo karito dala ruoth.
english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

kikuyu: kendo wachne ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho ni Jerusalem: ‘Kweregi nonywol e piny Kanaan, kendo wuonu ne en ja-Amor, to minu ne ja-Hiti.
english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

kikuyu: Kane oketho kido mar abiriyo, polo nolingʼ thi kuom kinde ma dirom nus sa.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

kikuyu: Ber bedo dhano adhana, to in gi jatich, moloyo wuondori ni in ngʼato, to ionge chiemo.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Boaz nowachone Ruth niya, “Nyara, winj gima anyisi. Kik koro idhi ihul cham e puodho machielo kendo kik ia ka. Bed ka kod nyiri matiyona.
english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

kikuyu: In to osejwangʼi oko mar buri mana ka bad yath mojwangʼ; kendo ringri oum gi jogo mosenegi gi ligangla, jogo mowiti e bur motimo kite. Mana ka ringre joma otho minyono gi tielo,
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

kikuyu: Joab nooro wach ne Daudi konyise gik moko duto mosetimore e lweny.
english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

kikuyu: kamano jo-Asher nodhi nyime mana gidak gi jo-Kanaan kendo ne ok giriembogi.
english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

kikuyu: Nitiere gimoro machielo maonge tiende matimore e piny: joma kare mayudo gigo ma joma mono ema onego yudi, kod joma timbegi mono mayudo gigo monego joma kare ema yudi. Ma bende, awacho, ni onge tiende.
english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼeyo parogi mi nowachonegi niya, “Pinyruoth moro amora mopogore owuon nyaka kethre, kendo dala moro amora kata ot mantiere pogruok ok nyal chungʼ.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

kikuyu: Noneno ngʼat moro miluongo ni Anania e fweny ka obiro kendo noyieyo lwete kuome mondo ochak onen.”
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

kikuyu: Donge sani en ndalo mikayoe ngano? Abiro luongo Jehova Nyasaye mondo okel polo mamor gi koth. Eka ubiro ngʼeyo ni usetimo marach e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye kuom kwayou mane upenjogo ruoth.”
english: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to the LORD, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the LORD’s sight, in asking for a king.”

kikuyu: Giboyo moyombo polo, koro in to ditimie angʼo? Gitut moloyo bur liel; koro in to ditimie angʼo?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

kikuyu: Ka iu owangʼ to kik utim richo; seche ma uyweyo mos e kitandau, to nonuru chunyu ka ulingʼ mos, keturu chunyu mos ka unindo e kitandau. Sela
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ogendini chano timo marach kendo ji chano jiemo kayiem nono?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Aluor bende ni ka achako alimou, to timbeu nyalo miyo Nyasacha kuod wiya e nyimu, mi aywagi nikech ji mathoth kuomu mosetimo richo to otamore weyo timbegi maricho kaka, terruok kod anjawo.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

kikuyu: “Kik ikendi mondo kik inywol yawuowi kata nyiri ka.”
english: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”

kikuyu: E piny ka piny mane wach ruoth ochopoe, kuyo nomako jo-Yahudi, ka gitweyo chiemo, ka giywak kendo ka gidengo. Thothgi nonindo e piende gugru ka gibukore gi buru.
english: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Wengeni biro neno gik mayoreyore to pachi paro gik morundore.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

kikuyu: Nikech Jakobo jatichna, kendo nikech Israel mayiero, aseluongi gi nyingi kendo aseketo kuomi nonro mar luor, kata obedo ni ok iseyanga kamano.
english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ogedo e miseni kotiyo gi dhahabu kata gi fedha kata gi kite ma nengogi tek; kata gi bao, kata gi lum, kata gi saka,
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

kikuyu: Kata kamano aseyiero Oholiab wuod Ahisamak bende, maa e dhood Dan mondo okonye. “Bende asechiwo rieko ni jotich lwedo duto molony mondo olos gik moko duto masechiki kaka:
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

kikuyu: Tarik piero ariyo gachiel e dwe mar abiriyo, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kokalo kuom janabi Hagai kawacho niya:
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata mokawo nyawadgi githuon mi omiye ngʼat machielo kuom chudo kata bed ni pod opande e kindeno moyude gi ngʼatno, to nyaka nege.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Ngʼama iye okuot gi gik maricho kendo ma yach gi chandruok nywolo yamo nono.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

kikuyu: ‘Chakre ndalo mane agolo joga koa Misri pok ayiero dala maduongʼ e dhoot moro amora mar Israel mondo oger hekalu kanyo ni Nyinga, to aseyiero Daudi mondo otel ni joga Israel.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

kikuyu: to onyalo timo tich dolo e nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache mana kaka jo-Lawi mamoko matiyo kanyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before the LORD.

kikuyu: Musa to nomiyowa chik mondo wachiel mon ma kamago gi kite. In to iwacho angʼo kuom wachni?”
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

kikuyu: Wagerne ot moro ewi odwa ka mondo waketne kitanda, mesa, kom kod taya mondo oyweye e kinde duto ma obiro ka.”
english: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

kikuyu: Negiloso raidhi madiere mane ochakore tungʼ nyaka tungʼ e dier sirnigo.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

kikuyu: E kinde mar keyo nooro jatichne moro ir jopur puodho mondo gimiye olemo moko mane ochiek e puoth mzabibu. To jopur puodho nogoye kendo noriembe gi lwete nono.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: “Wir Harun gi yawuote kendo pwodhgi mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: “Yaye Israel, kata obedo ni utimo anjawo mar chode, kik umi Juda donj e timbego. “Kik udhi Gilgal; kik udhi Beth Aven. Kendo kik ukwongʼru kuwacho niya, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima!’
english: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’

kikuyu: Ka dine gibed e bwo lochna, to dine atieke, kendo dine awachone Abimelek ni, ‘Kel jolwenji duto mondo akedgo!’ ”
english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

kikuyu: Fweny mane Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto okelona ema: Ne aneno rumbi mar det bonyo monywol e chakruok mar opon ka cham mar ruoth osekaa.
english: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.

kikuyu: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

kikuyu: Kik okend dhako ma chwore otho, kata dhako mowere gi chwore, kata dhako mochot, makmana nyako ngili,
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo ok anyal lingʼ; abiro wacho lit manie chunya, abiro nyiso pek ma an-go e chunya nikech mirima ma an-go.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Eka ibiro dhi e yoreni gi kwe kendo tiendi ok nochwanyre;
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

kikuyu: Jehiel, Azazia, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakia, Mahath kod Benaya ne jotelo e bwo Konania kod Shimei owadgi. Jogi duto notiyo kaluwore gi tich mane ruoth Hezekia kod Azaria mane jatelo morito hekalu mar Nyasaye omiyogi.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Uwuoyo kuom dala maduongʼni niya, “Osedongʼ nono chuth, maonge ji kata jamni modakie.” Kata obedo ni mier mag Juda kod yore mag Jerusalem odongʼ nono kamano, maonge ji kata jamni modakie, to ubiro chako winjo,
english: The LORD says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’

kikuyu: Jonathan to ne ok owinjo ni wuon ne ose kwero ji gi kwongʼ, omiyo nochwowo pedni mar kich gi luth mane ni e lwete. Notingʼo lwete malo motero mor kich e dhoge mi chunye ne odwogo.
english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

kikuyu: To winjuru, un joma omingʼ e dier ji; un joma ofuwogi, ubiro bedo mariek karangʼo?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

kikuyu: to iwinji gi e polo kendo itim kaka owinjore. Ngʼad bura e kind jotichni kikumo joketho kendo iket richogi e wigi bende joma onge ketho iket kare kaluwore gi timgi makare.
english: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

kikuyu: Ji ywak kagoyonegi koko niya, “Dhiuru kucha! Ok uler!” Mabor kucha, mabor kucha! Kik umulwa! Ka giringo giaa kendo gibayo abaya, ji mag ogendini wacho ni, “Ok ginyal dak kodwa kendo.”
english: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”

kikuyu: Jogo duto mane Ishmael omako Mizpa nolokore modhi ir Johanan wuod Karea.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

kikuyu: Ja-Lawi miluongo ni Matithia, wuod Shalum ja-Kora makayo, ema ne omi tij tedo makati mar chiwo.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

kikuyu: Nimar wengena oseneno warruokni,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

kikuyu: E sechego Yesu nowacho niya, “Apakoi Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

kikuyu: To ruodh Asuria nofwenyo ni Hoshea ne en andhoga, nimar nooro ji ir Osorkon ruodh Misri, bende ne ok ochiw osuru ne ruodh Asuria kaka ne osebedo kotimo higa ka higa. Kuom mano Shalmaneser nomake mokete e od twech.
english: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

kikuyu: joka Bezai, ji mia adek gi piero ariyo gangʼwen (324),
english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chik mar Jehova Nyasaye, Harun jadolo nodhi e Got Hor, kama nothoe odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abich, e higa mar piero angʼwen bangʼ wuok jo-Israel e piny Misri.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

kikuyu: Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ohero joma joratiro, kendo ok obi jwangʼo joge ma jo-adiera. Ibiro ritgi maber nyaka chiengʼ, to koth joma timbegi richo, ibiro ngʼad kargi oko;
english: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Mad lamona chop e nyimi; yie ilok iti ne kwayona.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

kikuyu: To nikech nyinga, noteru e nyim jotelo gi ruodhi kendo nubednegi kaka joneno kaachiel gi joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

kikuyu: Mad gik ma aparo e chunya omiye mor, seche duto ma amor kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

kikuyu: koa e dhood Naftali, ne en Nabi wuod Vofsi;
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nonego nyithindo makayo duto mane ni e pinygi, kodhi mokwongo duto mane gihango nywolo.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jadolo nochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mar pwodhruok e richo kod misango miwangʼo pep.
english: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

kikuyu: Pok adak e ot chakre ndalo mane agolo jo-Israel e piny Misri nyaka kawuono. Asebedo kawuotho e kuonde mogurie hema ka adar e kuonde dak mopogore.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

kikuyu: kuom mano koko mar lweny biro monjo jou, ma mi kuondeu mochiel motegno nomuki, mana kaka Shalman nomuko Beth Arbel e odiechieng lweny, kama mine kod nyithindgi nodhir mopodho.
english: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

kikuyu: kod Joela gi Zebadia yawuot Jeroham ja-Gedor.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

kikuyu: En to nodwoke niya, “Kik itim gima kama, owadwa. Kik ichuna. Gima kama ok onego timre e Israel! Kik itim tim marachni.
english: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

kikuyu: To Barzilai nodwoko ruoth niya, “Aseti, pod abiro dak higni adi, madimi adhi gi ruoth Jerusalem?
english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Mi gingʼe ni in, ma nyingi Jehova Nyasaye; ni in kendi e Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo kendo ni iloyo piny duto.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

kikuyu: “To ka ngʼat makare olokore oweyo timbene makare mi otimo richo kendo otimo gik mamono machalo gi mago ma ngʼat ma timbene richo timo, bende dobed mangima adier? Gik mabeyo mosetimo kata achiel ok nopar. Nikech timne mar bedo ngʼama ok ja-ratiro kendo nikech richo mosetimo, obiro tho.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

kikuyu: mar auchiel ne en Amiel, mar abiriyo ne en Isakar, to mar aboro ne en Peulethai. Nimar Nyasaye nosegwedho Obed-Edom.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

kikuyu: An awuon anadag Mizpa mondo achungʼ karu e nyim jo-Babulon mabiro irwa, to un onego uka olembe, divai, olembe mag ndalo oro gi mo, kendo uketgi e agulniu mag keno, kendo udag e dala ma usekawo.”
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

kikuyu: Kethuru kuonde duto manie gode, thuche kendo kuonde duto manie tipo yiende madongo mane ogendini makoro uriembo ne lamoe nyisechegi.
english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

kikuyu: Ka ngano nodongo moiko wiyegi to buya bende nochako limbo.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

kikuyu: Eka negidok dala kendo negiloso yath madum mamit gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar. To ne giyweyo Chiengʼ Sabato kaluwore kod luoro chik.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth odwogo koa Damaski mi oneno kendo mar misangono, to ne odhi mochiwo misango e wiye.
english: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

kikuyu: Atai nonywolo ne wuon Nathan, to Nathan ne wuon Zabad,
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

kikuyu: Nyasaye mane omiyo lwanda olokore pi mogudore, kendo mane omiyo lwanda matek olokore sokni mag pi.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

kikuyu: kendo Jason-ni ema oserwakogi e ode. Giduto gidagi luwo chike Kaisar, kagiwacho ni nitie ruoth machielo, miluongo ni Yesu.”
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Kane Samuel okelo ogendini duto mag Israel machiegni, to oganda mar Benjamin ema ne oyier.
english: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

kikuyu: Kuom thuolo mar ndalo adek joma chwo moa Juda kod Benjamin duto nochokore Jerusalem. To e odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo mar dwe mar ochiko, ji nobet e laru manie nyim od Nyasaye, ka gionge gi kwe nikech wachno kendo nikech koth ne goyogi.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

kikuyu: Tiengʼ ka tiengʼ biro kendo kadho, to piny to osiko mana kaka en.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

kikuyu: E fwenynano ne aneno ka an e ohinga mar rito dala mar Susa e gwengʼ mar Elam kendo ka an e bath aora mar Ulai.
english: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

kikuyu: Chokuru gik moyaki dalano kendo uketgi e laru mi uwangʼ-gi kaka misango miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Nyaka odongʼ gunda ma ok nochak ger.
english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, rwakuru joweteu mana kaka Kristo bende norwakou eka Nyasaye oyud pak.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mar apar gariyo, dwe mar apar, higa mar apar, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: To Sarai ne en migumba; nikech ne ok onywol.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

kikuyu: Ber bedo gi chuny mobolore e dier jochan, moloyo pogo gik moyaki gi josunga.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

kikuyu: To ka kata mana dwe ema ok rieny maler bende kata mana sulwe ok ler e wangʼe,
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

kikuyu: “Nyaka pog jo-Israel pinyni kaka girkeni kaluwore gi kar kwan-gi.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Shekem kod Beth Milo nochokore e bath yien maduongʼ mantie ewi Shekem mondo oket Abimelek kaka ruoth.
english: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

kikuyu: Ubiro chulogi fedha kuom chiemo ma uchamo kod pi ma umodho.’ ”
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

kikuyu: Ruoth isebedo maduongʼ kendo maratego; humbi osemedore mochopo e kor polo, kendo lochni ochweyo nyaka aa tungʼ piny koni gi koni.
english: it is you, O king, that have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.

kikuyu: Bende dibed ne amayoue giru moro kuom joma ne aoro iru?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

kikuyu: Ununegi gi wengeu uwegi kendo unuwachi ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye Duongʼ Moloyo kata gwenge mokiewo gi Israel!’ ”
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “The LORD is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

kikuyu: Daudi noketo ma obedo chik e Israel chakre chiengʼno nyaka chil kawuono.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

kikuyu: To kaponi isiemo ngʼat makare ni kik otim richo, mi ok otimo, to kuom adier, obiro bedo mangima nikech nowinjo siem, kendo in bende inires ngimani.
english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

kikuyu: Donge iyie ni An ei Wuora kendo Wuora ni e iya? Weche ma awachonu ok gin mana wechena awuon. Chutho, Wuora modak e iya ema timo tichne.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ok onyal chiwo nyarombo, to nokel akuche odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo ni Jehova Nyasaye kuom richo mosetimono. Kuom mano, akuru achiel notimnego misango mar golo richo, to machielo to notimnego misango miwangʼo pep.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kane pod giwuoyoe e wachni, Yesu owuon nochungo e diergi kendo wachonegi niya, “Kwe obed kodu.”
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Jo-Israel mane nitiere Jerusalem notimo Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi kuom ndalo abiriyo ka gimor gi-ilo maduongʼ ka jo-Lawi kod jodolo werne Jehova Nyasaye pile ka pile ka gigoyo thumbe mag pak mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo iketho adiera mara? Angʼo momiyo iketo rach kuoma mondo in inenri ka ngʼama ber?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

kikuyu: mane oyaro e nyima. E bathe koni gi koni ne ondikie weche mag ywagruok gi kuyo kod achiedh-nade.
english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mar Ruoth Yesu Kristo mondo obed kod chunyi.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho ni dhakono niya, “Kik ipandna dwoko e gima adwaro penji.” Dhakono nowacho niya, “Ruodha ma en ruoth owuo.”
english: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”

kikuyu: Kiyie to kik iwuog ka nyaka abi kendo akel misango mara mi achiwe e nyimi.” To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Abiro rito nyaka iduogi.”
english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”

kikuyu: Tijgi ne en rito Sandug Muma, mesa, rachungi mar taya, kende mag misengini, gige kama ler mar lemo mitiyogo tije dolo, pasia, kod gik moko duto mitiyogo tijego.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nochiko Benaya niya, “Tim kaka osewacho. Nege kendo yike mondo ipwodha kod od wuonwa kuom richo mar remo makare mane Joab ochwero.
english: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.

kikuyu: Jolweny mag Jehoahaz notieki makmana joidh farese piero abich, geche mag lweny apar kod jolweny mawuotho gi tiendgi alufu apar ema ne odongʼ, nikech ruodh Aram nosetieko mamoko duto kendo nomiyo gichalo mihudhwe.
english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo ne igola ei minwa? Kara mad ne atho kapok wangʼ moro amora onena.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo gigonyo nyathi kanynano, wuon nopenjogi, “Angʼo momiyo ugonyo nyathi kanyna?”
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

kikuyu: Nikech wach mane owacho kuluworegi wach Jehova Nyasaye kuom kendo mar misango man Bethel kendo kwongʼ mane okwongʼogo kuonde duto motingʼore malo mitimoe misango manie dala man Samaria biro chopo kare.”
english: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

kikuyu: Nodhi Misri gi yawuote gi nyige kod nyikwaye ma yawuowi kod ma nyiri.
english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

kikuyu: Kendo nonyodho owetene duto kendo noywak kokwakogi. Bangʼe owetene nowuoyo kode.
english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

kikuyu: Un joga, un e kweth jamba ma akwayo, kendo an e Nyasachu, an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.’ ”
english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: to yie mondo iwinji gie polo kama idakie kendo tim gimoro amora ma jadakno okwayi, mondo ogendini duto mag piny ongʼe nyingi kendo oluori mana kaka jogi Israel, kendo mondo gingʼe ni ot ma asegeroni luongo nyingi.
english: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Wer miwero gi thumbe man-gi waya. Maskil mar Daudi. Kane jo-Zif osedhi ir Saulo kendo onyise niya, “Donge Daudi ma imanyo opondo e gwengʼwa?” Resa gi nyingi, yaye Nyasaye; ngʼadna bura kare gi tekoni.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

kikuyu: Ne ukwedo Ngʼama Ler kendo makare, to ukwayo mondo ogonynu janek.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

kikuyu: kaachiel gi mier madongo mag kuonde kenone kod mier matindo mag gechene gi faresege kod gimoro amora mane chunye nyalo dwaro mondo oger e Jerusalem, kata e Lebanon, kendo e pinje duto mane enie gi loch.
english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

kikuyu: Mano bende emomiyo uchulo osuru, nikech jorit loch gin jotich Nyasaye, kendo gichiwore ne tijno seche duto.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

kikuyu: Boaz nodwoko niya, “Osenyisa gik moko duto misetimone wuon odu chakre chiengʼ mane chwori othoe; kaka niweyo wuonu gi minu gi thuru kendo nibiro mondo idag gi joma ne ok ingʼeyo chon.
english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

kikuyu: Gibiro ngʼeyo ni an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi ema ne agologi e piny Misri mondo omi adag kodgi. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: “Ma e tich ma joka Gershon biro timo ka gitiyo kendo ka gitingʼo misigo:
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ne tiengʼ duto mabiro nyaka umin usi e riak lepu ka usi moro ka moro olwor gi kido marambulu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, lochni osiko manyaka chiengʼ kendo ochwere e tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
english: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

kikuyu: Migepe ariyo mamoko modongʼ ma ok ti chiengʼ Sabato nyaka rit ruoth e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the LORD’s house around the king.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nowuok koa e Thim mar Sinai kendo ne giwuotho kuonde duto nyaka bor polo nopie e Thim mar Paran.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka misango motimo en mar kwongʼruok, chiwo mar hera, to misangono nyaka cham e odiechiengno mochiwe, to ka moro odongʼ to inyalo chame kinyne.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

kikuyu: Yawuot Mika ne gin: Pithon, Melek, Tarea kod Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Ji duto biro bedo maluor, gibiro hulo tije Nyasaye, kendo gibiro paro mos kuom gima osetimo.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

kikuyu: Nikech ok wayal wach kuomwa wawegi, to wayalo Yesu Kristo kaka Ruoth, to wan wawegi wan jotich magu kuom Yesu.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

kikuyu: nus mar joka Manase mane owal mondo obi kendo giket Daudi ruoth ne gin ji alufu apar gaboro (18,000);
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

kikuyu: Kik igomb chi wadu. Kik igomb od wadu kata lope kata jatije ma wuowi kata jatije ma nyako, kata rwadhe, kata pundane kata gire moro amora.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: To ne, Jehova Nyasaye biro kawuok kare mar dak mondo okum joma odak e piny kuom richogi. Piny noket ayanga remo mosechwer kuome, mi ok noum joge mosenegi.
english: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

kikuyu: Jo-Farisai nowinjo ni joma Yesu ne oseloko obedo jopuonjre, kendo obatiso ne ngʼeny moloyo jopuonjre Johana,
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

kikuyu: Awachonu ni obiro neno ni ongʼadnegi bura kare kendo mapiyo. Kata kamano, ka Wuod Dhano obiro, bende obiro yudo yie e piny?”
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

kikuyu: “Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo ichok odunga apar gariyo koa kuomgi, achiel ka achiel koa kuom jatelo moro ka moro mar dhoutgi. Ndik nying ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom odungane.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

kikuyu: kokwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi ne romo ji alufu adek gi mia ariyo (3,200).
english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Emomiyo wan jogowi, owetena, ok ne kido mar richo, to ni mondo wadag kaka odwaro.
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

kikuyu: Parieuru duongʼ mane en-go. Kata mana Ibrahim nomiye achiel kuom apar mar gik ma nopeyo!
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

kikuyu: Yiend saipras kod sida mag Lebanon bende mor kodu kawacho ni: “Koro onge ngʼama nochak otongʼwa nikech osetieku.”
english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

kikuyu: Jo-Edom bende nomonjo jo-Juda kendo negimako ji mangʼeny.
english: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

kikuyu: Ne awachone niya, “Belteshazar ajwoga moloyo ajuoke duto, angʼeyo ni chuny mar nyiseche maler ni kuomi, kendo onge midhiero moro amora matek manyalo tami. Lekna ema, loknago.
english: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

kikuyu: Eka Elija nowachone niya, “Dongʼ kae; nimar Jehova Nyasaye oora Jordan.” Eka nodwoke niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kod nyingi iwuon ni ok anaweyi.” Omiyo giduto negidhi adhiya.
english: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

kikuyu: Mier matindogi apar kod legegi mag kwath nomi anywola jo-Kohath mane odongʼ.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo owinjo ni cham ne nitie Misri, nooro kwerewa kuno e ote mokwongo.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

kikuyu: Bathe konchiel nochomo koma nodongʼ nono ma borne ne romo fut piero adek molworo hekalu, to bathe komachielo nochomo koma omuon gi kite motegno mag laru ma oko. Odno noger kadhi malo udi adek.
english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

kikuyu: Achayogi kendo aonge kodgi gi tich adier akwanogi kaka wasika.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

kikuyu: Jangʼicho noduogo wach ne Joram niya, “Osechopo irgi, to ok ane koduogo. Jariemb gari cha chalo mana gi Jehu wuod Nimshi, kendo oriembo mana ka janeko.”
english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

kikuyu: Ji nodhi Bethel, kama ne gibetie e nyim Nyasaye nyaka odhiambo, ka gitingʼo dwondgi kendo ka giywak malit.
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

kikuyu: Bangʼ dweche apar gariyo, kane ruoth wuotho ewi ode mamalo e piny Babulon,
english: At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nodhi malo kaluwore gi wach mane Gad osewachone kuom nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Iserito singruokni mane itimo gi jatichni Daudi wuora ne isingori gi dhogi kendo isechopo singruokno gi lweti mana kaka en kawuononi.
english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

kikuyu: To nitie gik moko adek mosiko, ma gin: yie, geno, kod hera, to maduongʼ moloyo kuomgi en hera.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi ne rito gigo mane itiyogo ei hekalu, ne gikwanogi kane okelgi kar keno kendo kogolgi.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

kikuyu: Bawe gi dhahabu maler oko gi iye kendo nochwene ndiga mar dhahabu mothedhi molwore.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: makmana kaponi ngʼat ma othoni en watne manie ot kaka min kata wuon kata wuode kata nyare kata owadgi,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

kikuyu: Ruoth mar Nyandwat nochok jolweny mamoko, ma nobed monj maduongʼ moloyo mano mokwongo; kendo bangʼ higni mamoko, enomonje gi jolweny mathoth man-gi gige lweny motegno.
english: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with abundant supplies.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ondhogo osiepne mondo oyud mwandu to gima otimono nyaka dongʼ ewi nyithinde.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

kikuyu: Beduru kurito kinde duto, kendo lemuru mondo utony ne gigo duto mabiro timore, kendo mondo uchungʼ e nyim Wuod Dhano.”
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato obwono wadgi gi chunye kata odiro gimoro kuome kongʼeyo motho,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel duto mane nitie e holo to gi mago mane nitie loka aora Jordan noneno ka jolwenj Israel oseringo kendo ni Saulo gi yawuote bende osetho, negijwangʼo miechgi ma giringo. Kendo jo-Filistia nobiro modak e miechgigo.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Ne ineno masira malich mane akelo kuom Jerusalem kod kuom dala duto mag Juda. Kawuono gidongʼ gunda kendo okethgi,
english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. Behold, today they are a desolation, and no man dwells in them,

kikuyu: “Iparo ni Nyasaye kwedi kendo kumi nikech in ngʼama kare?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

kikuyu: Josef nowachonegi niya, “Ma en angʼo ma usetimoni? Donge ungʼeyo ni ngʼato kaka an nyalo fwenyo gimoro gi yor koro?”
english: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

kikuyu: An gi geno kuom Ruoth Yesu mar oro Timotheo iru machiegni, mondo omi chunya oduogi ka ayudo wach moa kuomu.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

kikuyu: Eka jotichne mamon kod nyithindgi nochopo mopodho auma e nyime.
english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne owuoyonu kokalo ei mach. Ne uwinjo dwol kawuok ei mach, to ne ok uneno ngʼat mane wuoyono, to makmana dwol kende ema nuwinjo.
english: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

kikuyu: Ero, asenyisou chon kapok kindeno ochopo.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

kikuyu: Donge punda nyalo mana ywak ka oonge lum mocham, kata rwath nyalo ywak kaonge chiemo?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

kikuyu: Koro ok achak aluongu ni wasumbini nikech misumba ok ongʼeyo gima ruodhe timo; to aluongou ni osiepena nimar asenyisou gik moko duto mane apuonjora kuom Wuora.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

kikuyu: Piny motwo nopur, ka joma kadho e diergi neno, kendo ok nowegi ginind mbora.
english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

kikuyu: thuon gweno magar ka dwaro gwere gi wadgi, nywok, kod ruoth gi oganda mar lweny moluoro bute.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

kikuyu: Lwedo manyap miyo ngʼato bedo jachan, to lwedo ma jakinda kelo mwandu.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

kikuyu: Chiemo maboth bende inyalo cham ka ok oketie chumbi, koso mit mane miyudo ei nyai tongʼ marachar?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Luwauru, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo Moab, jasiku, e lwetu.” Omiyo ne giluwe kendo negikawo bath aora Jordan mane ochiko yo Moab, maonge ngʼama ne nyalo pondo mondo okadh aora Jordan.
english: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

kikuyu: Dwokne lawe mar abolano kapok chiengʼ opodho mondo oyud gima oumorego. Eka enogoni erokamano kendo nokwan gino kaka ranyisi mar tim makare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Ote mane omi janabi Habakuk.
english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisengʼado loka nam, jopuonjre wigi nowil ma ok otingʼo makati.
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

kikuyu: Donge ne Kristo nyaka yud masichegi eka bangʼe nodonji e duongʼ ma Nyasaye ne oseikone?”
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo ir Joshua, negiwachone niya, “Ji duto ok onego dhi kedo gi jo-Ai. To or ji alufu ariyo kata adek mondo odhi okawe kendo kik oket ji obed mool nikech nitiere mana ji manok kuno.”
english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”

kikuyu: Ee, negiketo chunygi obedo matek ta mana ka kidi, kendo ne gidagi winjo chik kata weche ma Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nooronigi kuom Roho kokonyore gi jonabi machon. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nokecho ahinya.
english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ere kaka Satan diked gi pinyruodhe owuon, ka opogore kende owuon to ok dochungʼ, kendo mano ema dibed giko lochne.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

kikuyu: E nying Ruoth Yesu Kristo, wachiko kendo wasiemo joma kamago mondo gibed mos kendo giti matek mondo giyud yo ma gikonyorego.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

kikuyu: Gilead en mara, Manase bende mara, Efraim en oguta mar lweny, to Juda en osimbona mar loch.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Ka en kamano to marangʼo Musa nochiko ni dichwo mondo omi chiege barup weruok mar ketho keny eka oriembe?”
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

kikuyu: Magi e joma notiyo kaachiel gi yawuotgi: Koa kuom jo-Kohath ne gin: Heman jago thum, ma wuod Joel, ma wuod Samuel,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Ngʼat mofuwo wacho e chunye niya, “Nyasaye onge.” Gin joma okethore, timbegi richo mokalo tongʼ, onge kata ngʼato achiel matimo maber.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noloso dhako koa kuom ngʼet mane ogolo kuom Adam kendo nokele ni Adam.
english: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ere kaka inyalo wacho niya, “Wariek, nimar wan gi chik mar Jehova Nyasaye,” ka gadiera kalamb miriambo mar jondiko osetiyo kode e yor miriambo?
english: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and the LORD’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.

kikuyu: Wach mar adier mowinjore ji oyiego chuth en ni Kristo Yesu nobiro e piny mondo owar joricho, to an e jaricho marachie moloyo joricho duto.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

kikuyu: Magi duto notimore nikech jo-Israel notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi, mane ogologi e piny Misri e bwo loch Farao ruodh Misri. Negilamo nyiseche mamoko
english: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

kikuyu: Kodhi moko nolwar e kind kudho, to ka kudhogo nodongo kod cham to ne githungʼo chamgo.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

kikuyu: Jo-Heshbon kod jo-Eleale ywak, kendo ywakgi winjore nyaka Jahaz. Kuom mano jolweny mag jo-Moab ywak kendo kihondko omakogi.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

kikuyu: “To in kaw ngano gi shairi gi oganda kod ngʼor gi bel kod mariwa. Ketgi e dag keno kendo ti kodgi kuom losoni makati. Cham makatino kuom ndalo mia adek gi piero ochiko mibiro bedo kinindo gi bathi konchiel.
english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

kikuyu: “Beduru motegno kendo gi chir. Kik ubed gi luoro kata kik chunyu tho nikech ruodh Asuria kod jolweny mangʼeny man kode nimar wan gi teko maduongʼ moloye.
english: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

kikuyu: Bende onge ngʼama olo divai manyien e piende moti mag tingʼo divai. Ka otimo kamano, divai manyien nyalo yiecho piend divaino mi divai pukre kendo piend divai biro kethore.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

kikuyu: To tarik apar gabich mar dweno en Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyaka ucham makati motedi ma ok oketie thowi kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Ngʼeyo tiend wachni dwaro kinda kod dhil mar joma rito chike mag Nyasaye, kendo osiko koyie kuom Yesu.
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

kikuyu: Nikech rieko mar pinyni en fuwo e nyim Nyasaye kaka ondiki niya, “Omako joma riek gi riekogi giwegi”;
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

kikuyu: Pe nochwe kendo polo nomil koni gi koni. Ne en masich pe marachie moloyo nyaka piny Misri ne chakre.
english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

kikuyu: “To weche duto misewacho asewinjo maber.
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Kereth modak e dho nam, mano kaka unune malit, yaye Kanaan, piny jo-Filistia, Jehova Nyasaye nikodu gi wach kama: “Abiro tieko chuth kendo onge ngʼama nodongʼ.”
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

kikuyu: Eka negia malo mokwan-gi mi giromo ji apar gi ariyo ma jo-Benjamin ma ruodhgi ne en Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo, to gi apar gariyo mag Daudi.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

kikuyu: Kendo okawo ohala mokalo tongʼ. Ngʼat ma kamano, bende nyalo bedo mangima adier? Ok onyal! Nikech osetimo gik mamonogi duto, ibiro nege mak olewo kendo rembe biro bet e wiye owuon.
english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kapo ni ok giyie gi wachni kata kuom ranyisi mokwongo, to ginyalo yie mar ariyo.
english: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mane nigi talanta abich nokelo talanta abich mamoko ewi mane omiye, kendo nowachone ruodhe ni, ‘Ruoth, ne imiya talanta abich, to neye, aseloso abich mamoko e wiye.’
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: Bende negilosone gin giwegi kuonde motingʼore, kite milamo kod yiende mag Ashera ewi gode maboyo kendo e bwo yiende motarore.
english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

kikuyu: To ji duto nobiro e hekalu chon gokinyi mondo giwinje.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

kikuyu: Yawuot Reuel ne gin: Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza. Magi ema ne nyikwa Basemath chi Esau.
english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Bor margi oyombo bor mar piny kendo lach margi oloyo lach mar nam.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

kikuyu: Ma e baruwa machalre gi mane mane Ruoth Artaksases omiyo Ezra jadolo kendo japuonj, ngʼatno mosomo weche maluwore gi chike kod buche Jehova Nyasaye ne Israel:
english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of the LORD’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:

kikuyu: Kane waa kanyo to ne wasiayo yie e nam kendo, to nikech yamo mager ne kudho kochomowa tir, ne waluwo bath chula mar Saipras koma ogengʼore gi yamo.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

kikuyu: “Abiro kwano Rahab gi Babulon e kanyakla mar joma ongʼeya, nyaka Filistia bende, kod Turo, kaachiel gi Kush kendo abiro wacho ni, ‘Ngʼatni nonywol ei Sayun.’ ”
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo nasingora ne dhood Eli ni, ‘Richogi ok nyal pwodh gi misango kata chiwo.’ ”
english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo yo midhigo kuma mil polo riadore, kata yo ma yembe mag wuok chiengʼ wuokie kikeyo e piny?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

kikuyu: Kik uhole pesa mondo uyudie ohala, kendo kik ukaw ohala kuom chiemo ma uhole.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

kikuyu: Paruru nine un wasumbini e piny Misri to Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu noresou. Mano emomiyo amiyou chikni kawuono.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

kikuyu: Ma e baruwa mane janabi Jeremia ooro koa Jerusalem ne jodongo mane otony e dier jotwech kod ne jodolo, jonabi kod ji mamoko duto mane Nebukadneza notero e twech koa Jerusalem nyaka Babulon.
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

kikuyu: joka Harif, ji mia achiel gi apar gariyo (112),
english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: Gimomiyo awuoyo kamano kodgi gi ngeche en ni mondo: “Kik ginee kata obedo ni gineno; kik gingʼe tiend wach kata obedo ni giwinjo.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

kikuyu: Weche mag kuoth chalo gi chiemo mamit; gidhiyo e chuny dhano ma iye.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

kikuyu: omiyo ruodh Asuria biro sembo jo-Misri kod jo-Kush ma osemako duto, jomatindo kod jomadongo. Giniwuoth duge gi tiendegi nono, ka siandagi neno, mi mano nobed wichkuot ni jo-Misri.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nochwogo kuodi madongo mia ariyo mag dhahabu kendo kuot ka kuot nochwog gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo adek gi nus.
english: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwokgi kowacho niya, “Abiro miyou cham gi divai manyien kod mo zeituni, moromo yiengʼou chuth; ok anachak ami ubed jogo michayo e dier ogendini.
english: The LORD answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno, maa koro en barupa mar ariyo ma andikonu. Asendikonugi giduto kargi ariyo mondo aparnu kendo achiew pachu obed moyawore.
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

kikuyu: Noriembo jochode machwo mane ni kuonde motingʼore mag lemo mane otony e ndalo mag loch wuon-gi Asa.
english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo hekalu; manoyudo ni borne oromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich, kendo laru mare kod odno kaachiel gi ohinga mage bende noromo fut mia achiel gi piero abich.
english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

kikuyu: nono to gibiro kidha kaka sibuor kidho gik moko. Kendo gibiro yiecha matindo tindo maonge ngʼama diresa e lwetgi.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Ne oloyonwa ogendini mi gibet e bwowa, ji nopodho piny e tiendewa.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

kikuyu: Gima ngʼat marach oluoro biro loye; to gima ngʼat makare dwaro ibiro miye.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

kikuyu: To jotend lweny mag jo-Filistia nopenjo niya, “Jo-Hibraniagi to timo angʼo ka?” Akish nodwoko niya, “Ma, donge en Daudi, mane jatelo mar Saulo ma ruodh Israel? Osedak koda mokadho higa, to chakre chiengʼ mane oweyo Saulo nyaka chil kawuono, pok aneno rach moro kuome.”
english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”

kikuyu: Kik luongu kata ni, Japuonj, nimar un gi Japuonj achiel, ma en Kristo.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

kikuyu: Girkeni mane Musa omiyo dhood Reuben kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola e magi:
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

kikuyu: Yogreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gi mos mar jo-Nyasaye.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Wasiki duto wuoyo marach kuomi; gijari ka gikayo lekegi kagiwacho niya, “Wasetieke chuth. Ma e ndalo mane wasebedo ka warito; adier, osechopo ma wanene.”
english: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”

kikuyu: Kwerewa notimo richo, to koro gionge, to wan ema ikumowa kargi.
english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

kikuyu: Notamre pogonegi kata mana bieche owuon bangʼ nywol, nimar oparo mondo ochamgi lingʼ-lingʼ e ndalo ma wasiku nogonu agengʼa ka masira olworo miechu madongo.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

kikuyu: Bende isemiyo dho liganglane obedo madik kendo ok isekonye e kedo.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

kikuyu: Ka ma ne pok otimore, to Eliashib jodolo noseketi jarit kuonde keno mag od Nyasachwa. To ne en osiep Tobia machiegni ahinya,
english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ne Kora kod jolupne duto niya, “Kochopo gokinyi Jehova Nyasaye noyier joma oyie kuome kendo maler, kendo norwak ngʼatno obi bute.
english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka onego uchame: Ka utweyo okanda enungou, ka urwako wuoche e tiendu kendo umako luth e lwetu; nyaka une ni uchame piyo nikech en sawo mar Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Eri an kaachiel gi nyithindo ma Jehova Nyasaye osemiya. Wan e ranyisi kod honni e piny Israel koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego modak e got mar Sayun.
english: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nosingore ne Saulo. Eka Saulo nodok dala, to Daudi gi joge nodhi e kargi mar pondo.
english: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

kikuyu: Jo-Hibrania mane oyudo konyo jo-Filistia kedo mane ni kodgi e kambi, nodok ir jo-Israel mane nigi Saulo gi Jonathan.
english: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

kikuyu: Penj jotiji iwuon kendo gibiro nyisi. Omiyo tim tim ngʼwono ne yawuota ma aorogo kaka wabiro e kinde mag mor. Yie imi wasumbinigi gi wuodi Daudi gimoro amora minyalo miyogi.’ ”
english: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”

kikuyu: Kane Daudi odwogo dalane Jerusalem, nokawo monde apar mamoko mane oweyo mondo orit dalane, mine oketogi e ot moro miritogie. Nomiyogi gik ma gikonyorego, to ne ok oriwore kodgi. Nolornegi e ot nyaka ne githo, ka gidak ka mon ma chwogi otho.
