english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

kikuyu: Adier wanatim gik moko duto mane wawacho ni wanatim: Wanawangʼ ubani ne Ruoth ma Dhako mar Polo kendo wanamiye misango miolo piny mana kaka wan kod wuonewa, ruodhiwa kod jotendwa notimo e dala mag Juda kod yore mag Jerusalem. E kindeno ne wan gi chiemo mathoth kendo ne wamewo kendo ne onge hinyruok moro amora kuomwa.
english: But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Ehud nosechiwo chudo, nooro jogo mane okelo chudo mondo odogi.
english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

kikuyu: To ininywol wuowi manobed ngʼat mohero kwe maonge tungni, kendo anami obed gi kwe kuom jowasike molwore. Enochake ni Solomon, mi anakelni jo-Israel kwe e ndalo lochne.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata makuodho nyawadgi lingʼ-lingʼ abiro kwero mi lingʼ; ngʼato angʼata ma wangʼe tek kendo ma sungore gie chunye, ok anyal betgo amingʼa.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

kikuyu: Musa lero kuom ngima makare maa kuom Chik kama: “Ngʼat moluwo chikegi nobed mangima kuomgi.”
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo ok wabi luor, kata bed ni piny okethore kendo gode mukore e chuny nam,
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

kikuyu: Abiro miyo jo-Juda ngʼiewo yawuotu, gin to giniusgi ne jo-Sabea, ma en piny mabor miwuoro,” Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for the LORD has spoken it.”

kikuyu: “Koro wuoda, Jehova Nyasaye obed kodi, kendo mad ogwedhi mondo mi iger od Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi kaka nosewacho ni initim.
english: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

kikuyu: Unune malit un joma chiewo gokinyi kulawo kuonde kongʼo, un ma ubudho kuneno nyaka chuny otieno ka umer maonge rieko.
english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

kikuyu: “Chik jo-Israel mondo gikelni mo maliw mar zeituni mobi mondo omi teyni osik kaliel ma ok otho.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Emomiyo beduru joma obolore e bwo bad Nyasaye man-gi teko eka enotingʼu malo e kinde mowinjore.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Kik iwach ni, ‘An mana nyathi.’ Nyaka idhi ir ji duto maori irgi kendo iwach gimoro amora ma achiki.
english: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

kikuyu: “Ngʼeuru malongʼo ni An e Nyasaye kendo onge nyasaye machielo makmana An. An ema anego ji kendo An ema achiwo ngima, bende An ema ahinyo kendo achango. Omiyo onge ngʼama nyalo reso ngʼato e lweta.
english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

kikuyu: Pakuru Nyasachwa, yaye ogendini, neuru ni pak mipakego ji duto owinjo;
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

kikuyu: Ngʼat mofuwo nyiso mirimbe mapiyo, to ngʼat mariek mwonyo ayany.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

kikuyu: Bende ok oyienigi kendo mon ma chwogi otho, kata mon moweyo chwogi. Ginyalo kendo mana nyiri masilili mag jo-Israel, kata dhako ma chwore otho ma chwore ne jadolo.
english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi joge nodhi Keila, mokedo gi jo-Filistia kendo opeyo jambgi. Nonego jo-Filistia mangʼeny mine oreso jo-Keila.
english: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

kikuyu: Piny duto kuloreni; giweroni wende pak; giwero wende pak ka gipako nyingi.” Sela
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

kikuyu: Mana kaka wasebedo gi kido mar dhano mochwe gi lowo, e kaka wabiro chalo gi kido mar dhano moa e polo.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

kikuyu: nimar dhako ma jachode en bur matut, to dhako mabayo en soko madiny.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ayub wuoyo ka ngʼama ofuwo; maonge rieko.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

kikuyu: Ranyisi mar hono mokwongoni Yesu notimo e dala Kana e piny Galili. Nonyiso duongʼne kuom timne, kendo jopuonjrene noyie kuome.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

kikuyu: “Ma ema nobedni ranyisi, yaye Hezekia: “E higa mokwongoni unucham gik matwi kendgi kendo e higa mar ariyo unucham orowe moloth bangʼ keyo e higa mokwongono. To e higa mar adek, unuchwo kodhi kendo unuka cham, bende unupidh mzabibu mi ucham olembegi.
english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

kikuyu: Winyo mag agakgo nokelone kuon gi ringʼo okinyi godhiambo to nomodho e sokono.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

kikuyu: Omiyo Israel nodak e piny jo-Amor.
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

kikuyu: Yawuot Shimon ne gin: Amnon, Rina, Ben-Hanan kod Tilon. Nyikwa Ishi ne gin: Zoheth kod Ben-Zoheth.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

kikuyu: Ne onyalo ngʼado yiend sida kata yiend ober. Oweye mondo odongi e kind yiende mamoko e bungu, kata ne onyalo pidho yiende mamoko mi koth mi yiendego odongi.
english: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.

kikuyu: To kane oyudo gichiemo, nowacho niya, “Awachonu adier ni achiel kuomu biro ndhoga.”
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Magi e ruodhi mag pinje mane jo-Israel oloyo kendo mane gikawo gwengegi ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, kochakore e holo mar Arnon nyaka e Got Hermon, moriwo nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ mar Araba.
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

kikuyu: milok buru bed matek malos gogni?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

kikuyu: To kata mana jolweny mathuondi moloyo noring duge chiengʼno,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka Satan riembo Satan to mano nyiso ni en gi pogruok kende owuon. Koro ere kaka pinyruodhe nyalo chungo?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

kikuyu: Oganda duto mar jo-Israel nyaka tim sawoni.
english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Amon oneno jo-Aram karingo gin bende negiringo e nyim owadgi ma Abishai mi gidhi ei dala maduongʼ. Eka Joab nodok Jerusalem.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bende, kaw yier moko kuom yier modongʼ mondo iwiti e mach kendo iwangʼ-gi mi girum. Mach moro biro landore koa kanyo nyaka dhood Israel duto.
english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

kikuyu: “Kik uluor un kweth matin, nikech Wuonu mor mar miyou pinyruoth.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

kikuyu: Yawuoti biro kawo kar wuonegi; ibiro ketogi ruodhi e piny duto koni gi koni.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Kik uluorgi, nikech kiny sa machalo kama abiro chiwogi duto ne jo-Israel mi gineg-gi. Nyaka ungʼad odond tiend faresegi kendo uwangʼ gechegi.”
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

kikuyu: Asechako nimo e chwodho matut, kama onge lowo motegno ma ngʼato nyalo chungʼie. Asechopo e chuny pi kama tut, kendo apaka olwora oketa diere.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, weuru jogi mos! Gonygiuru gidhi! Nikech kapo ni chenrogi kata timbegigi oa kuom dhano, to ok gibi dhi nyime.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

kikuyu: Biuru mondo wause ne jo-Ishmael kendo kik waket lwetwa kuome; nikech en owadwa, ringrewa kendo rembwa.” Owetege noyie giwachno.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

kikuyu: kata tuoche maricho maliwo ji e mudho, kata tho matieko ngima ji e dier odiechiengʼ tir.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

kikuyu: Chutho, ichalonegi mana ngʼama wero wende hera gi dwol mamit kendo mongʼeyo goyo thum maber, nikech giwinjo wecheni to ok gitimgi.
english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

kikuyu: Aluongo Jehova Nyasaye, en mowinjore gi pak, kendo oresa e lwet wasika.
english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

kikuyu: Negiloso singʼenge ne kendo mar misango gi mula mondo oketi e bwoye nyaka chopi e kore gi yo ka malo
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

kikuyu: Ritgiuru ka utangʼ nyaka chop upimgi e agola mar od Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem e nyim jodolo motelo gi jo-Lawi kod jotend anywola mag Israel.”
english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of the LORD’s house.”

kikuyu: to chutho pod ok ayiene dhoga mondo otim richo ka aluongo kwongʼ e ngimane.
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

kikuyu: Kik ichiwne Jehova Nyasaye chiayo mopwodi kata moroo. Kik utim tim maka ma e pinyu,
english: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

kikuyu: Pasakani notim e higa mar apar gaboro mar loch Josia.
english: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

kikuyu: Chakre sa auchiel mar odiechiengʼ nyaka sa ochiko, mudho nobiro moimo piny duto.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Kitabuno noyud kondikie ni Modekai ema nofwenyo kaka Bigthana gi Teresh, jotelo mane rito dhoranga ruoth, nosechano mondo oneg ruoth Ahasuerus.
english: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: To bende onge ngʼama ochayo dende owuon. Ngʼato ka ngʼato pidho dende kendo rite maber, mana kaka Kristo bende timo ne Kanisa,
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

kikuyu: Kane Samuel obiro ire, Saulo nowachone niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye gwedhi! Asetimo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochika.”
english: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by the LORD! I have performed the commandment of the LORD.”

kikuyu: kendo ji adekgo notwe motegno kanyakla modirgi ei mach makakni.
english: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

kikuyu: Segub ne onywolo Jair, mane orito mier piero ariyo gadek man Gilead.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: To jogo nogoyo koko kawacho niya, “Mano dwond Nyasaye, ok en dwond dhano!”
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

kikuyu: Kane Israel oneno yawuot Josef nopenjo niya, “Magi ngʼa gini?”
english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

kikuyu: ‘Akwayi mondo iwene owetegi richogi kod gima mono mane gitimoni.’ Kuom mano yie iwenwa timbewa duto ma wasetimoni nikech wan jotich Nyasach wuonu.” To kane Josef owinjo wechego, pi wangʼe noton.
english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

kikuyu: “Ka jou openji ni, ‘Donge inyalo nyiswae tiend wachni?’
english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

kikuyu: To Jehoshafat bende nowachone ruodh Israel niya, “Mokwongo penj ane Jehova Nyasaye wachni.”
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”

kikuyu: omiyo an bende abiro yieronegi masiche mondo omakgi kendo abiro kelo kuomgi gik ma giluoro. Nimar kane aluongo, to onge ngʼat mane odwoka, kendo kane awuoyo, to onge ngʼat mane owinjo. Negitimo timbe mamono e nyima, kendo ne giyiero mana gik mamorogi.”
english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jakobo nokawo kidi mochunge ka siro.
english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

kikuyu: Gitingʼe malo ma gikete e gokgi; eka gikete e kare monego obedie kendo kanyo ema osikoe. Kama oketeno ok onyal chorore. Kata bed ni ngʼato nyalo ywagorene to ok onyal dwoko; bende ok onyal rese e chandruokne.
english: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.

kikuyu: Wengegi rango mon mana gigombo mar terruok kendo richo mitnegi ma ok giwe. Giywayo mon ma yiegi yomyom mondo gitimgo richo kendo gipongʼ gi wuoro. Jogi gin joma okwongʼ adier!
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

kikuyu: To joma ohero margi kendo ma ok luw adiera, to luwo mana timbe ma ok kare, norom gi mirimb Nyasaye mager.
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

kikuyu: Kata mana nyathi ingʼeyo gi timbene, omiyo ingʼeyo ka kite obidhore kata ni kare.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nowachone niya, “Ruoth, ayie,” kendo nolame.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye noneno kaka jo-Israel thagore mi wachno ne odonjo e chunye.
english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.

kikuyu: Ka Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon kod jolweny mage duto gi pinjeruodhi duto gi ji duto mane ni e gwengʼ mane orito ne kedo gi Jerusalem kod dala mane olwore duto, wachni nobiro ne Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

kikuyu: Iparo ni iber moloyo Thebes mane oger e tiend aora mar Nael, ka olwore gi pi? Aorano ema ne otene kaka ohinga molwore, pige to ne obedone ohinga motegno.
english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, dhood Israel osedoko chuoth fedha e nyima; giduto gin kaka gik maonge tich modongʼ bangʼ lenyo mula, kata nyinyo, kata fedha, kata chuma, kata kendo miwangʼoe gigo. Giduto gin mana chwodho mag fedha.
english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama ne nyalo resogi nikech negidak mochwolore gi Sidon kendo ne onge watgi moro amora kanyo. Dala maduongʼno ne nitie e holo man but Beth Rehob. Jo-Dan nochako gero dala maduongʼno kendo negidak kanyo.
english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jowetewa, yie ma un-go osejiwowa e chandruok duto kaachiel gi masiche ma waneno.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

kikuyu: Nimar Wuod Dhano nodwogi e duongʼ mar Wuon mare kaachiel gi malaikege, kendo chiengʼno enomi ngʼato ka ngʼato pokne kaluwore gi gima osetimo.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

kikuyu: Chunygi opongʼ gi miriambo kendo koro nyaka gitingʼ mana kum marom kodgi. Jehova Nyasaye nomuk kendegi mag misango kendo kitegi ma gilamo bende nokethi.
english: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.

kikuyu: Puonja ngʼeyo gi paro maber, nimar ayie kuom chikeni.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

kikuyu: Mi mondo gingʼe ni achal kama nikech lweti, mi gingʼe ni lweti ema osetime, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne ilichori gi fedha kod dhahabu, kendo lepi nolosi gi usi mayom gi usi mapek ma nengone tek kod nanga mogorie gik mabeyo. Chiembi to ne mogo moreg mayom gi mor kich kod mor zeituni. Ne imedo bedo dhako ma jaber manomiyo ibedo ruoth madhako.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

kikuyu: Oloso raum ne kitandane, orwakore gi lewni marep-rep maralik ma nengogi tek.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Naftali, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Koro sokni manie bwo lowo kod dirise mag ataro moa e polo nolor, kendo koth moa e polo nochok.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa ma unyalo pimago kata ma unyalo kwano ni rom koda? Koso ere ngʼama dichal koda ma dwapimrego?
english: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?

kikuyu: Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo ruodha lawo jatichne? Angʼo masetimo, rach mane madimi abed jaketho?
english: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?

kikuyu: “To in wuoda Solomon, par Nyasach wuonu kendo ichiwri mondo itine gi chunyi duto kendo imiye paroni duto nikech Jehova Nyasaye nono chuny ji duto kendo ongʼeyo paro duto mopondo. Kidware, to iniyude, to kiweye, to enojwangʼi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

kikuyu: E kindeno ruoth Herode nomako jo-Kristo moko, kendo nochano mar negogi.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

kikuyu: ma wuod Shalum, ma wuod Zadok, ma wuod Ahitub,
english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

kikuyu: To Petro gi Johana ne ongʼiyo wangʼe tir, mi Petro owachone niya, “Ngʼiwa ane!”
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

kikuyu: nooro wach mondo ogol Jeremia oa e laru mar jarito. Ne gitere ir Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, mondo odwoke dalane. Omiyo nodongʼ e dier jogi owuon.
english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.

kikuyu: Chunya wuoyo kuomi kawacho niya, “Many wangʼ Nyasaye ka ilemo!” Wangʼi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ema abiro manyo.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, onge ngʼama chalo kodi kendo onge Nyasaye moro makmana in, mana kaka wasewinjo gi itwa wawegi.
english: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda: “Ok giniywage ni: ‘Yaye, owadwa! Yaye, nyamera!’ Ok giniywage ni: ‘Yaye, jatenda! Yaye, duongʼ mari!’
english: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo mangʼeny, ne ok wanyal neno wangʼ chiengʼ kata sulwe, kendo yamo nomedo kudho matek mi geno duto mane oyudo wan-go ni dipo koreswa norumo chuth.
english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

kikuyu: Omiyo Zadok gi Abiathar nodwoko Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye Jerusalem ma gibet kanyo.”
english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

kikuyu: Bangʼ masirano Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa kod Eliazar wuod Harun jadolo niya,
english: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

kikuyu: Nyalo bedo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi biro winjo weche Rabshake jatend lweny, ma jatende ma ruodh Asuria oseoro mondo oyany Nyasaye mangima, kendo obiro kwere kuom weche mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osewinjo kowacho. Kuom mano, in Isaya, lamne ji mane otony ma pod ngima.”
english: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

kikuyu: Rieko iyudo e dho jogo mongʼeyo tiend wach, to luth en mar ngʼe ngʼatno maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Eka Anania nodhi e odno modonjo nyaka e iye. Noyieyo lwete kuom Saulo kowachone niya, “Owadwa Saulo, Ruoth, ma en Yesu manyocha ofwenyoreni ka in e yo ibiro ka, oseora iri mondo ichak inen kendo mondo ipongʼ gi Roho Maler.”
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Negibiro ka gitetni; kendo ka chunygi ool, ka gia kuondegi mag pondo.
english: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo auchiel, Yesu nokawo Petro gi Jakobo kod Johana mi notelo mi gidhi ewi got malo, kama ne ginie kendgi maonge ngʼato. Kane gin kuno, kite nolokore ka gineno,
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

kikuyu: Mano kaka ahero yoreni! Rit ngimana e timni makare.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

kikuyu: jogi mane okelo wach marachni kuom pinyno noneg-gi gi masira e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

kikuyu: Sungawa ni kuom Nyasaye odiechiengʼ duto, kendo wabiro pako nyingi nyaka chiengʼ. Sela
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ochiwo chiayo mondo otim-go misango mar lalruok ni Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka ochiw chiayo madhako kata madichwo maonge songa.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowuog oko kendo noked gi pinjego, kaka okedo e sa lweny.
english: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

kikuyu: ma min-gi ne nyar Dan to wuon-gi ne ja-Turo. Ne otiegore e tije dhahabu, kod fedha, mula kod nyinyo, kidi kod yien, kendo kuom loso lewni maralik gi marambulu gi marakwaro to gi law katana maber. En kod lony mangʼeny kuom kit goro duto kendo loso kido moro amora momiye. Enoti gi jotijegi molony kaachiel gi mag ruodha Daudi wuonu.
english: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

kikuyu: Eka noketo ketego ei karaya kama ne jamnigo modhoe, mondo omi ka jamnigo modho to gineno ketego ei pi. E kindego ema thuondi ne luwogie,
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ngʼat monyuomo nyako mangilino otimo maber, to ngʼat ma ok onywome otimo maber moloyo.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nokawo nyarombo ma pod dhoth mi ochiwo ka misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye. Noywak ni Jehova Nyasaye e lo jo-Israel, mi Jehova Nyasaye ne odwoke.
english: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to the LORD. Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.

kikuyu: “Awachonu, ngʼato angʼata mohulo ni ongʼeya e nyim ji, Wuod Dhano biro hulo ni angʼeye e nyim malaike mag Nyasaye.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ogendini ariyo ni e iyi, kendo ogendini ariyogo biro pogore; oganda moro biro bedo motegno moloyo machielo kendo wuowi maduongʼ noti ne wuowi matin.”
english: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

kikuyu: Magi e weche mane Musa owacho ne jo-Israel duto e piny motwo man wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan, mano man Araba mochomore gi Suf e kind Paran kod Tofel; Laban, Hazeroth kod Dizahab.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye en Ruoth mochwere manyaka chiengʼ; ogendini biro lal nono e pinye.
english: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

kikuyu: Eka giniwachi, “Waonge ruoth nikech watamore miyo Jehova Nyasaye luor. To kata kane wan gi ruoth, to dotimonwa angʼo?”
english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear the LORD; and the king, what can he do for us?”

kikuyu: “Donge Nyasaye odak e polo malo? Donge en malo moyombo nyaka sulwe man malo mogik?
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

kikuyu: Chutho, ne wawinjo e chunywa ka gima nosengʼadnwa buch tho. To magi notimorenwa mondo waket genowa kuom Nyasaye ma chiero joma otho, to ok kuomwa wawegi.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

kikuyu: “Yaye, mad ne ngʼato kuomu lor dhoudi mag hekalu, mondo kik umok mach manono e kendona mar misango! Ok amor kodu ngangʼ, kendo ok anakaw chiwo moro amora moa e lwetu,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osewacho.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

kikuyu: Kane ogowo Kaisaria, nodhi mi omoso kanisa, eka bangʼe nodhi Antiokia.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

kikuyu: Nyithinda mageno, un to un nyithind Nyasaye kendo useloyo jonabi mag miriambogo, nikech Jal manie iu duongʼ moloyo Jal manie piny.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

kikuyu: nikech Roho Maler ne pok obiro kuom ngʼato angʼata kuomgi, to nosebatisgi mana e nying Ruoth Yesu.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Negiluongo gode gi lwendini kagiwacho niya, “Podhuru kuomwa mondo uumwa kupandowa ni wangʼ Jal mobet e kom duongʼno, kendo ne mirimb Nyarombo!
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

kikuyu: Omiyo ne awacho niya, “Kik ikaw ngimana, yaye Nyasacha, kapod an e chuny ngima; in to isiko ingima nyaka tienge duto.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Juda, Benjamin, Shemaya, Jeremia,
english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

kikuyu: Ne otayogi kod bor polo godiechiengʼ kendo giler moa e mach otieno duto.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

kikuyu: Ne imiya teko mar kedo lweny; ne imiyo jomamon koda kulore e nyima.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo kod chiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka ubed gi chokruok mowal. Kik utim tich moro amora kuom odiechiengego makmana loso chiemo ma ji duto chamo; mano kende e gima unyalo timo.
english: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.

kikuyu: Siro ka siro borne ne romo fut piero ariyo gabiriyo. Mula mane ni e ewi siro ka siro ne romo fut angʼwen gi nus, kendo nokede gi gik mongʼinore ongʼinore molwore koni gi koni. Siro machielo man-gi gik mongʼinore ongʼinore, ne chal kod mokwongo.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Yesu nosegonyo oganda odhi, nodonjo e yie mi odhi e gwengʼ mar Magadan.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

kikuyu: Yesu noa kanyo koluwo tie Nam Galili. Eka noidho malo mobet piny e bath got.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Bangʼe napodho piny e tiende mondo alame. To nowachona niya, “Ngangʼ! Kik itim kamano! An bende an mana jatich wadu matiyo kodi kaachiel gi oweteni mahulo wach kuom Yesu gichir. Nyasaye kende ema owinjore ilam! Wach adieri man kuom Yesu ema miyo jonabi Roho mar koro wach mar Yesu.”
english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

kikuyu: To ngʼeuru ma maber ni ka dine wuon ot ngʼe ni kar sa adi ma jakuo biroe to dine ok oweyo ode otur gi jakuo.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne amiyou chik kawacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou pinyni mondo ukaw, to jolwenju duto machwo motegno moikore ne lweny nyaka kadh dhi loka e nyim oweteu ma jo-Israel.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Pod ok uwinjo tiend wach?”
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wuo kod jodolo ma yawuot Harun, kendo iwachnegi ni: ‘Kik jadolo tim gimoro ne ringre jadhodgi moro amora motho ma dimi obed mogak,
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

kikuyu: Ka ikonya to anyalo loyo jolweny momonja; ka an gi Nyasacha to anyalo lwenyo ohinga.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

kikuyu: Wasika duto kuodho wach kuoma kaachiel kaka ginyalo hinya, chunygi paro gik maricho mogik mondo ohinya, kagiwacho niya,
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: E kindeno, kane oganda mar ji mangʼeny maromo alufe ne osechokore, makoro ginyonore giwegi, Yesu nochako wuoyo mokwongo, ni jopuonjrene kowacho niya, “Beduru motangʼ ne thowi mar jo-Farisai, ma en wuondruok.
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

kikuyu: E ndalone joma kare biro dhi maber, kendo kwe biro bedo mogundho nyaka chop dwe lal nono.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

kikuyu: To kata kidhi ma ikedo gi chir e lweny, to Nyasaye nomi wasiki loyi, nikech Nyasayeno nigi teko mar konyi kata miyo wasiki loyi.”
english: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

kikuyu: Ji duto ma isechweyo biro paki, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; jogi maler duto biro dhiali.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

kikuyu: Nitiere kinde mar gimoro amora, kod thuolo mitimoe tich moro ka moro e bwo polo:
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyamin wuonu nikech en wayu.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

kikuyu: Zadok wuod Ahitub gi Ahimelek wuod Abiathar ne jodolo; Seraya ne jagoro;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Balaam kendo nomiyo Balaam ote kowachone niya, “Dog ir Balak kendo imiye wachni.”
english: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

kikuyu: kendo negitiyo kodgi kuom ngʼiewo puoth jachwe agulni, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochika,” nochopo kare.
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

kikuyu: Farao Neko noterogi e twech Ribla e piny Hamath mondo kik obed ruoth kodak Jerusalem kendo nochuno jo-Juda mondo ochiw osuru mar fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen kod dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo piero adek gangʼwen.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

kikuyu: Moko kuom gik mane ope e lweny nowal ne tij loso hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ringuru piyo uayi! Daguru e rogo matut, un joma odak Hazor. Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nigi paro marach kuomu; osechano timonu marach.
english: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says the LORD; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

kikuyu: Dwaro mar jasamuoyo biro bedo thone owuon; nikech lwetene odagi tich.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

kikuyu: “Dwoguru, un joma onge yie; abiro thiedhou kuom baro weyo yo.” “Ee, wabiro biro iri, nimar in Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.
english: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Ma e gima ruoth wacho: Kik uyie Hezekia wuondu nikech ok onyal resou e lweta.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu noluongo oganda ire kendo nowachonegi niya, “Chikuru itu, un duto, mondo uwinj tiend wachni.
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

kikuyu: Kata ka tuo oketho denda kamano, to e ringruogni anane Nyasaye.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kikuyu: Timne jatichni kaluwore gi herani, kendo puonja chikeni.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: “Wuonwa oseketo gik moko duto e lweta. To onge ngʼama ongʼeyo Wuowi makmana Wuoro kende, bende onge ngʼama ongʼeyo Wuoro makmana Wuowi kaachiel gi joma Wuowi oyiero mondo ofwenynegi.”
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

kikuyu: wasik ngʼato nobed joode owuon.’
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

kikuyu: Noriembe e dier ji kendo nomiye paro mar kit le bende nodak gi kenje mag thim kendo nochamo lum kaka dhok tho nomiye ngʼich, nyaka noyie ni Nyasaye Mamalo Mogik nigi teko ewi pinjeruodhi mag dhano kendo oketo ngʼato angʼata mohero e wigi.
english: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero owadgi to odak e ler, kendo ngʼama kamano onge obadho manyalo miyo ochwanyre.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

kikuyu: Giyako ute mon ma chwogi otho kendo gilamo lamo moyware mondo ginyisrego ni ji kaka gilony e lamo. Joma kamagi ibiro kum malit moloyo.”
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudi nowachone niya, “Pok ichopo kata higni piero abich, to Ibrahim to iseneno kanye!”
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

kikuyu: E kinde duto mane olielo yie wiye, nimar nojaliel wiye kinde ka kinde nikech yie wiye ne dongo piyo kendo bedone mapek, kane opime to ne oloyo kilo ariyo kopim gi rapim mar joka ruoth.
english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nowachone jo-Israel niya, “Ubiro rito nyaka karangʼo kapok uchako kawo mwandu mar piny mane Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach wuoneu, asemiyou?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

kikuyu: Ne otimo monyalo. Ne oolo mo mangʼwe ngʼarno e ringra chon mondo oikago ne ikna.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

kikuyu: Kane jodong Israel duto osechopo jo-Lawi nokawo Sandug Muma,
english: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

kikuyu: Neuru piny jo-Babulon, jogi makoro ikwano ka nono! Jo-Asuria osemiyo odongʼ kar le mag thim; kendo negigero kargi mar ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo, ka gilworo dala bende negimuko ohingane duto mi giweye gunda.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Petro gi Johana noyieyo lwetgi kuomgi mi giyudo Roho Maler.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kuyo onyoso chunya, omiyo meda teko kaluwore gi wachni.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

kikuyu: Ma e gima wabiro timonegi: ‘Wabiro wegi gidagi mondo kik mirima bi kuomwa nikech waketho kwongʼruok mane wasingonegi.’ ”
english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

kikuyu: Jehoash nonindo moyweyo gi kwerene kendo Jeroboam nobedo ruoth kare. Jehoash noiki e piny Samaria gi ruodhi mag Israel.
english: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Luoro mar Nyasaye nomako pinjeruodhi mag pinje kane giwinjo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nokedo gi wasik jo-Israel.
english: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

kikuyu: Tond pimo norie kochakore kanyo tir nyaka e got matin mar Gareb bangʼe ogomo kochiko Goa.
english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

kikuyu: Ka upako Nyasaye gi chunyu, to ere kaka ngʼato manie dieru ma ok winji dhougo digo niya, “Amin” bangʼ erokamano mugoyo, ka okia gima uwacho?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

kikuyu: Bende ne nitie ji mangʼeny e Israel mane nigi dhoho e kinde mar Elisha janabi to onge kata achiel mane opwodhi makmana Naaman ja-Siria kende.”
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

kikuyu: En ngʼa ma ujaro? En ngʼa mutingʼorene malo kendo kumilone leu? Donge un koth jonjore ma jo-miriambo?
english: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro miyowa gima ber adier kendo pinywa biro chiego chambe.
english: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

kikuyu: “En adier, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ni ruodhi mag Asuria osetieko ogendini mangʼenygi ma giweyo pinjegi gunda.
english: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Solomon obedo gi jasigu ma ne en Hadad ja-Edom mane owuok e dhood joka ruoth mar Edom.
english: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

kikuyu: Ket pek manie chunyi ne Jehova Nyasaye to obiro riti; ok obi weyo ngʼat makare podhi.
english: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

kikuyu: Omiyo nyikwa Harun nomi Hebron (ma en dala mar pondo), kod Libna, Jatir, Eshtemoa,
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ne, anakel chunje maketho Kuom Babulon gi jo-Leb Kamai.
english: The LORD says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

kikuyu: Nimar anyalo timo nendgi ni giramo mar tiyo ni Nyasaye, to kata kamano gionge gi ngʼeyo.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

kikuyu: Eka Adam kod chiege nowinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye kawuotho e puodho e seche mag angʼich welo kendo ne gipondo ne Jehova Nyasaye e kind yiende manie puodho.
english: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

kikuyu: Nyasaye achiel kendo Wuon ji duto, en moloyo duto kendo en ema otiyo kuom duto.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

kikuyu: Nimar pile ka pile gidwara, ginenore joma nigi chuny mar ngʼeyo yorena, mana ka gima gin oganda matimo gima kare, kendo mapok oweyo chike Nyasachgi. Gikwaya ngʼado bura makare, kendo ginenore joma dwaro ni Nyasaye osud machiegni kodgi.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye oseketho mier duto mag Jakobo ka ok odewo; nikech mirimbe osemuko kuonde mochiel motegno mag Nyar Juda. Nokuodo wi jopinyno gi jotende mi odwoko lochgi chien.
english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.

kikuyu: ka uchiwo luor ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo rito chikene kod buchene ma ondiki e kitabuni kendo udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi chunyu duto kod ngimani duto.
english: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Jadolo maduongʼ ma kamano ema nyalo konyowa nikech oler, oonge ketho, kendo chilo moro onge kuome. Bende Nyasaye osetingʼe mokete kar kende kopoge gi joricho, kendo osetingʼe malo kuma bor moyombo polo.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Onge lwanda mane kaw kuomi mar gero kona, kata kidi moro amora mar keto mise, nimar unudongʼ gunda nyaka chiengʼ.
english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane oganda owinjo yalo mar Filipo, kendo kane gineno honni mane otimo, negimedo chiko itgi mondo giwinj wechene.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom Farao ruodh Misri kendo ikor wach kuome kaachiel gi piny Misri duto.
english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma odhier bedo gi geno, to joma timbegi mono omiyo lingʼ thi.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

kikuyu: ote mar ngʼat mawinjo weche Nyasaye, ngʼat man-gi rieko moa kuom Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, ngʼat maneno fweny moa kuom Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼat moriere piny auma, kendo ma wengene oyawore.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: Kara in bende in gi wangʼ mar ringruok? Koso in bende ineno mana kaka dhano neno?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

kikuyu: To kata obedo kamano Jeroboam wuod Nebat jatelo mar Solomon wuod Daudi nongʼanyo ni ruodhe.
english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

kikuyu: Yesu nongʼeyo ni Wuoro noseketo gik moko duto e bwo tekone, kendo ni noa ka Nyasaye kendo nobiro dok ir Nyasaye;
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

kikuyu: An nam, koso an ondiek nam momiyo ogona agengʼa kama?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iketh nying jowadu koni gi koni e yor kuoth, kendo kik ihangne jowadu wach ma ok nikare. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo dhako ma migumba bedo gi ode mi obed miyo mamor man-gi nyithinde. Opak Jehova Nyasaye!
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Jakuo biro mana mondo okwal kendo oneki kendo oketh gik moko, An to asebiro mondo giyud ngima, kendo giyude mogundho.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Ngʼama paro joma ok nyal en jahawi; Jehova Nyasaye rese ka chandruok omake.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane Jakobo tedo ogira, Esau nodonjo koa e dwar kodenyo.
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

kikuyu: Ma e tiend fweny mar lwanda mane omuki e got moro, to ok gi lwet dhano ma en lwanda mane otoyo chuma gi nyinyo gi lowo, gi fedha gi dhahabu matindo tindo. Nyasaye maduongʼ osenyiso ruoth gima biro timore e ndalo mabiro. Lekni en adier, kendo lok molokego bende en adier chuth.
english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano nowachone niya, “Dhiyo kendo ineane ka oweteni dhi maber kod jamni, kendo iduogna wach.” Kamano nooro Josef koa e Holo mar Hebron. Kane Josef otundo Shekem,
english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi Gomer gi jokedo mage duto, kod Beth Togarma man tungʼ mar nyandwat gi jokedo mage duto magin pinje mangʼeny man kodi.
english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Omera en ngʼa moketa jangʼad bura kata jathek e kindu?”
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

kikuyu: Eka Musa noyangʼo imno, kendo nokawo remo mi okiro e bath kendo mar misango.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nokwongʼore kawacho niya, “Ka Nyasaye nobed koda kendo norita e wuodhani ma adhiye kendo miya chiemo ma achamo kod lewni ma arwako,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

kikuyu: Solomon nochiwo misango mag lalruok ni Jehova Nyasaye: kwan-gi ne romo dhok alufu piero ariyo gi ariyo kod rombe gi diek maromo alufu mia achiel gi piero ariyo. Kamano ruoth kod jo-Israel duto nowalo hekalu ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Nikech kuome waduto koro wan gi yo mwachopogo ir Wuoro, kuom Roho achiel.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane Elisha obiro, nodhi e ot mane oselosne cha, kendo nonindo koyweyo kanyo.
english: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

kikuyu: “To in, nyathina, ibiro luongi ni janabi mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo; nimar ibiro telo e nyim Ruoth mondo ilosne yo,
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

kikuyu: Kaka ne ok gidwar puonj kendo ok negiyiero luoro Jehova Nyasaye,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Kawuru pinyno mi udagie, nimar asemiyougo mondo obed maru.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

kikuyu: Bed mabor gi ngʼat mofuwo nimar ok iniyud ngʼeyo tiend wach e dhoge.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

kikuyu: Bath aorano mar ariyo iluongo ni Gihon; en omol koluwo piny Kush duto.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

kikuyu: To jowetegi moko ma jo-Lawi, kotelnegi gi Ahija, ne gin jorit kuonde keno mag od Nyasaye kod kuonde mikanoe gik mowal.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

kikuyu: Ndalo adek bangʼ kane giseloso winjruok gi jo-Gibeon, jo-Israel nowinjo ni jogo gin mana joma odak kodgi machiegni.
english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

kikuyu: Eka Abimelek nowacho ne Isaka niya, “Dar ia ira ka nikech in giteko moloyowa.”
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

kikuyu: Iywoyo dhano ilalgo nono ka nindo mar tho terogi; gichalo gi lum mangʼich mar okinyi,
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

kikuyu: to kuom adier, Nyasaye osechikona ite kendo osewinjo dwonda ka alame.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

kikuyu: To chokruok mar oganda duto nowuoyo e kindgi giwegi mondo gichielgi gi kite. Eka duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nothinyore ne jo-Israel duto e Hemb Romo.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Timbene ne richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye to ok kaka ruodhi Israel mane otelone notimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo nongʼado kodhi yo milambo mar pewe mag Luz (tiende ni, Bethel), modhi nyaka Ataroth Adar mantiere yo milambo mar Beth Horon Mamwalo.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

kikuyu: Negipenjore ka gihum kendo gidhier nono niya, “Gima timoreni to tiende angʼo?”
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo matin kende jogi ne orito kar dakni maler, to sani wasikwa osenyono moketho kari maler mar lemo.
english: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

kikuyu: Kik ukulrunegi piny; bende kik ulamgi, nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, an Nyasaye ma janyiego kendo akumo nyithindo nikech richo mar wuonegi chakre tiengʼ mar adek nyaka mar angʼwen mar jogo mamon koda,
english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nomonjogi mi onego ruodhigo kendo olierogi e yien abich. Nowegi ka giliero e yiendego nyaka odhiambo.
english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

kikuyu: Negiloso nyaroya Horeb, mine gilamo kido molos gi chuma.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: Odwoko piny joma otingʼore malo, odwoko dala maduongʼ mar ngʼayi piny, mi otoye matindo tindo ma olokre buru.
english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Makheloth mi gibworo Tahath.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

kikuyu: Nowuotho e piny Siria gi Kilikia kojiwo kanisni.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano, ne okete ruoth, kendo nodok dala. Kendo noluongo jotichne mane omiyo pesa, mondo oyud ni en ohala manade magiseyudo.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni onenore kaka odundu mayom yom to ok notur, kendo kata obedo ni oliel ka taya ma mirimiri to ok notho, nyaka chop otel ne adiera mi lochi.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa niya, “Donj ei yie, in kaachiel gi joodi, nikech aseyudo ni in ngʼat makare e kind ogandani.
english: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

kikuyu: Gigo duto mane itiyogo mane olosi gi dhahabu kod fedha noromo alufu abich kod mia angʼwen. Sheshbaza nobiro gi gigi duto e kinde mane joma ne otwe noa Babulon kadhi Jerusalem.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Dogi e pinyu ir oweteni kendo abiro bet kodi.”
english: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

kikuyu: Wer mamit moloyo wende moko nondiki gi ruoth Solomon.
english: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

kikuyu: Jotendu ongʼanyo kendo gin e kanyakla mar jokwoge, giduto gihero asoya, kendo gihero gik makonyogi giwegi. Ok giyal buche nyithind kiye kare, bende weche mamon ma chwogi otho okelo e nyimgi ok gidew.
english: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

kikuyu: Elisha nokone niya, “Dhi gi kwe.” Bangʼ ka Naaman nosewuotho mochwalore,
english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

kikuyu: Jaherana, apimi mana gi faras madhako motwe but achiel kuom geche Farao.
english: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

kikuyu: Eka iningʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye asewinjo weche mag achaya duto misewacho kuom gode mag Israel. Ne iwacho niya, “Oseketh dalagi chuth kendo osechiwonwagi mondo watiekgi.”
english: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ok oseweyowa maonge yo ma dwangʼeyego. Osenyisou ngʼwonone komiyou koth moa e polo, kendo komiyo cham chieknu e kinde mowinjore; osebedo komiyou chiemo mathoth kendo opongʼo chunyu gi mor.”
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

kikuyu: Onge pok mano kadhi koa e dhoodni kadhi e dhoot machielo, nimar ja-Israel moro amora nyaka rit lop kwerene.”
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Solomon nochiwo chik mondo ger hekalu ni Nying Jehova Nyasaye kod ode mar ruoth.
english: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Janes gi Jambre nokedo gi Musa e kaka jogi bende kedo gi adiera, gin joma pachgi osekethore kendo jogo ma osekwedi kaluwore gi yie.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

kikuyu: Noyudo chogo manyien mar lemb punda, nokawe kendo nonego ji alufu achiel.
english: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.

kikuyu: nikech ne githagou gi timbegi maricho mane gitimo Peor kendo kuom wach Kozbi ma nyar jatend Midian mane onegi ndalo mane yamb tho obiro nikech gima notimore Peor.”
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

kikuyu: Ji mia ariyo moa Jerusalem nobiro kod Abisalom. Ne oluong-gi kaka welo mi gidhi gichuny maler ka ok gingʼeyo gimoro amora madhi nyime.
english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel notimo kaka Joshua nochikogi. Negikawo kite apar gariyo koa e dier aora Jordan, kaluwore gi kwan mar dhout Israel, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nokone Joshua; kendo negitingʼogi nyaka kama negibuoroe, kanyo negiketogie piny.
english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

kikuyu: enobed girkeni mar koth jotichne, kendo joma ohero nyinge nodag kanyo.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

kikuyu: Kane jootego odwogo ir Jakobo negiwachone niya, “Ne wadhi ir owadu Esau kendo koro obiro mondo orom kodi, to ji mia angʼwen bende ni kode.”
english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

kikuyu: mondo omi kik onywol nyithindo mogak e kind ogandane. An e Jehova Nyasaye mamiyo obedo maler.’ ”
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

kikuyu: “Kata ka obedo ni Efraim nogero kende mangʼeny mag misango mar golo richo, kendegi osebedo mar timo richo.
english: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.

kikuyu: Gikanyono noidho pundane kendo nodhi ir Akish kane en Gath komanyo wasumbinige, omiyo Shimei nodhi moduogogi.
english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

kikuyu: Ne iterori gi jo-Misri, jo-libambani mane oowore ni chode, mine imedo miya mirima, nikech ringri ne omedo oowore ne terruok.
english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kor wach kuom jokoro mag Israel makoro sani. Wachne joma koro gik ma wigi omiyogi kama: ‘Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye!
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo asetemo ndalo mangʼeny mar biro iru to osetama.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

kikuyu: Ka dabed ni un ema uwinjo marach kaka awinjoni, to an bende anyalo wuoyo mana kaka uwuoyono; dikoro arogonu gi weche ma ok rum kendo dikoro akinonu wiya.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

kikuyu: “An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kik ikwal.
english: “You shall not steal.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka iduongʼ yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto! Onge ngʼama chalo kodi, kendo onge Nyasaye moro makmana in, kaka wasewinjo gi itwa wawegi?
english: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

kikuyu: kendo Oholibama nonywolo Jeush, Jalam kod Kora. Magi ema ne yawuot Esau, mane onywol Kanaan.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Jotham notugo lweny gi ruodh jo-Amon mi noloyogi. E higano jo-Amon nochule fedha ma pekne dirom kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen kod shairi kilo alufu ariyo gi mia ariyo kod thowi ma pekne ne romo kilo alufu ariyo gi mia ariyo. Jo-Amon nomedo kelone gik marom kamano e higa mar ariyo kod mar adek.
english: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

kikuyu: Abiro kok gi mor ka aweroni wend pak, nikech an ngʼat misewaro.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

kikuyu: Ka jodolo gi jo-Lawi nosepwodhore maler kaka chik dwaro, ne gipwodho ji, dhorangeye, to gi ohinga.
english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo jogo gi tuoche kuom lamo nyaroya mane Harun oloso.
english: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno kitabu mar Musa nosom ka ji winjo kendo noyud kondikie ni jo-Amon kata jo-Moab ok onego yienegi donjo e chokruok mar Nyasaye,
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

kikuyu: Bedo gi ngʼat mofuwo kaka wuowi kelo kuyo; onge mor ni wuoro ma wuon ngʼat mofuwo.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

kikuyu: “Anami Jerusalem obed gunda, kama ondiegi ema odakie; kendo anaketh mier mag Juda mondo ngʼato kik dag kanyo.”
english: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

kikuyu: Kane Saulo osetieko koro noidho mobet e kar lemo.
english: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ne ok gidewo chikego, to negisiko mana ka gitimo timbegi machon.
english: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nowacho niya, “Winji, kiny en Sawo mar Dwe manyien kendo nitie budho ma onego bed ni achiemo gi ruoth, to we adhi apondi oko nyaka chop odhiambo mar orucha.
english: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.

kikuyu: Gisiko ka giwachona ni, “Ere wach Jehova Nyasaye? Dak otimre sani!”
english: Behold, they ask me, “Where is the LORD’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”

kikuyu: Jogi nowachone adier niya, “Ngimau en ngimawa! Ka ok uwacho gino ma watimo, to wabiro bedo kodu gi ngʼwono kod ratiro e ndalo ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiwa pinyni.”
english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when the LORD gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

kikuyu: Eka Rael kod Lea nodwoke niya, “Bende pod wadongʼ gi pok moro amora e mwandu wuonwa?
english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

kikuyu: Emomiyo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye nowangʼo pinyni, kokelo kuomgi kwongʼ duto ma ondiki e kitabuni.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom wi ondiegno ne nenore ka gima ogo lero mar tho, to wiye mane ogo lerono nosechango. Ji duto manie piny nohum nono, kendo negiluwo bangʼ ondiegno.
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Kor wach ni yamo, in wuod dhano, kendo wachne ni, Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Kudhi kia e tunge angʼwen mag piny, kendo idonj kuom joma nosenegi mondo gidok mangima.”
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

kikuyu: Kar chak higa, jolweny mag Aram nobiro monjo Joash, negimonjo Juda kod Jerusalem kendo neginego jotendgi duto kendo mwandu mane giyako ne giorone ruodhgi Damaski.
english: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro wach ni jatichna Daudi niya, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kama: Ne agoli e lek kuma ne ikwayoe rombe mondo ibed jatend joga Israel.
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

kikuyu: Anakume gi nyithinde kod jogo marite nikech timbegi maricho; anakel kuomgi kod jogo modak Jerusalem gi jo-Juda kit masira moro amora mane asechanonegi, nikech gitamore winja.’ ”
english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”

kikuyu: Ler manie hembe oselokore mudho; kendo taya manie bathe osetho.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

kikuyu: Nimar in e duongʼgi gi tekogi, kendo isedhialo tungwa kuom ngʼwononi.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: To beduru mabor gi gigo mowene Jehova Nyasaye, mondo kik ukel kethruok ne un uwuon kuom gimoro amora kuomgi. Ka ok kamano to unumi kambi mar jo-Israel bed mar kethruok kendo ukel chandruok kuome.
english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa gi Harun nodhi ir Farao mi owachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Hibrania wacho: ‘Nyaka karangʼo ma ibiro tamori bolori e nyima? We joga odhi mondo gilama.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Wachni puonjo ni joma oyie gin nyithind Ibrahim.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

kikuyu: Ka gipenjou niya “Ruodhu mane osingore ni onego bed ni duogono to ere? Donge nyaka ne kwerewa tho gik moko osebedo mana machalre nyaka aa chakruok chwech piny!”
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

kikuyu: Hadadezer nooro wach mondo okel jo-Aram man loka Aora Yufrate kendo gidhi Helam ka Shobak ma en jatend jolweny mag Hadadezer, otelonegi.
english: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

kikuyu: kod raum mag pien rombo molok makwar gi raum mar piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe kod pasia migengʼego;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane obirone Jeremia koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye biro keto pogruok kuom jamb jo-Israel kod mago mag jo-Misri mi onge chiach ja-Israel moro amora ma biro tho.’ ”
english: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

kikuyu: E kinde ma chunya chandore e iya, to in ema ingʼeyo yor konyruokna. E bugo matut ma awuothoe ji osechikonae obadho.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

kikuyu: Meremoth wuod Uria, ma wuod Hakoz nogero migape e dirgi. Ngʼat mane ogedo e dir jo-Meremoth ne en Meshulam wuod Berekia, ma wuod Meshezabel. Zadok wuod Baana ema ne ogedo e dir Meshulam,
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

kikuyu: Koro kik imadh divai kata gimoro amora mamero ji kendo kik icham chiemo moro amora mogak,
english: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;

kikuyu: Ma e jal mane awuoyo kuome kane awacho ni, ‘Ngʼato mabiro bangʼa oloya mabor, nikech ne entie kapok ne abetie.’
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

kikuyu: nikech jo-Israel gin wasumbini maga. Gin wasumbini maga mane agolo e piny Misri. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Jeftha nodwoko niya, “Ka dipo ni udwoka mondo aked gi jo-Amon kendo Jehova Nyasaye omiyagi; bende anabed jatendu adier?”
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, will I be your head?”

kikuyu: Wawinjo ni jomoko kuomu budho abudha. Ok giti, tije jowetegi ema gikeloe weche manono.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

kikuyu: Nyakwar Jesse moro nowuogi mana ka bad yath maloth; Kuom tiende, Bade nonyag olemo.
english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

kikuyu: E tok pasia mar ariyo ne nitie hema miluongo ni Kama Ler Moloyo,
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

kikuyu: Dhood Kohath mamoko ne omi mier mag dak ei oganda Efraim.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye biro ma nopogie giu duto moyaki ka uneno.
english: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

kikuyu: “Ka inyiso jogi gigi duto to gipenji ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye osechikonwa masira malich ka ma? Angʼo ma wasetimo marach? Richo mane ma wasetimo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa?’
