english: It will happen, when you tell this people all these words, and they ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us?’ or ‘What is our iniquity?’ or ‘What is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’

kikuyu: Emomiyo chunya mor kendo lewa yot; ringra bende biro yweyo gi kwe,
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

kikuyu: Nyaka wadwokne Nyasaye erokamano kinde duto nikech un jowetewa kendo owinjore watim kamano nikech yie ma un-go medo bedo motegno, kendo hera muherorugo ngʼato gi ngʼato bende medore.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

kikuyu: Resa e lwet wasika, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nimar in e jaritna.
english: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

kikuyu: Negingʼiewo bepe kendo gipayo kite mondo olosgo kuonde mokethore e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo chulo gik moko duto mane dwarore mondo hekalu oduog kare.
english: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato ibiro pwodho gi mach.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

kikuyu: Timuru misango mar Pasaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi chiayo mawuok e kweth jambu kata e kweth dhou kama en owuon noyier miluongo e nyinge.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

kikuyu: Saulo gi wuode Jonathan kod ji mane ni kodgi nobet Gibea e piny Benjamin, to jo-Filistia nojot Mikmash.
english: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Nadab kod Abihu, notho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e kinde mane gichiwo misango ma ok opwodhi e Thim mar Sinai. Ne gionge yawuowi; omiyo Eliazar gi Ithamar kende ema nobedo jodolo e ndalo mane Harun wuon-gi pod ngima.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

kikuyu: Adier, Nyasaye e jakonyna; Ruoth owuon ema rita.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

kikuyu: Jal mane oora ni koda kendo pok oweya kenda, nimar atimo gik malongʼone kinde duto.”
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Winjuru! Adhi kelone dala maduongʼni kod gwenge molwore masiche duto mane alando kuomgi, nikech ne tokgi tek ta kendo ne ok ginyal winjo wechena.’ ”
english: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”

kikuyu: Enoywe pi wengegi duto. Tho kata ywak gi nduru kod rem ok nochak obedie kendo ngangʼ, nikech gik machon oserumo.”
english: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Mucha machiwo ngima ok nodag kuom dhano nyaka chiengʼ, nikech en ringruok matow, ndalone nobed higni mia achiel gi piero ariyo.”
english: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

kikuyu: Obiro sungore kokwedo gimoro amora miluongo ni Nyasaye kata gimoro amora milamo. Bende nohedhre bet kata ei hekalu mar Nyasaye kolandore owuon ni en Nyasaye.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

kikuyu: Mirima kwiny to gero pek moloyo, to en ngʼa manyalo chomore gi nyiego?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

kikuyu: Nyasaye bende notimo nende kuom wachno kotimo ranyisi gi timbe miwuoro kod honni mopogore opogore, kendo kuom chiwo mich mag Roho Maler mane opogo ni ji kaka en owuon odwaro.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

kikuyu: Jamoko nyalo paro owuon ni oriek, to jachan man-gi paro matut neno gik manie chuny jamokono.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

kikuyu: “Nimar parona ok e paroni bende yorena ok e yoreni,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: To kar timo kamano, ne gigombo piny maber moloyo mano mane giseweyo. Ne gigombo polo. Emomiyo Nyasaye wiye ok kuodi kiluonge ni Nyasachgi, nikech oseikonegi dala.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Benjamin nowuok mondo orom kodgi negiywayogi mabor gi dala maduongʼ. Negichako nego jo-Israel mana kaka negisetimo mokwongo, omiyo ji piero adek notho e pap kod e yore; ma achiel dhi Bethel, machielo to dhi Gibea.
english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

kikuyu: Lembe chalo gi apilo mokuogi magolo suya mamit. Pien dhoge chalo ondanyo, ma mo madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar tonie.
english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

kikuyu: Kara in bende ndaloni nok ka ndalo dhano, koso higni magi chalo gi mag dhano,
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

kikuyu: Eka Musa kod Harun nodhi e nyim Hemb Romo,
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Mano kaka ne gingʼanyone e thim nyadi mangʼeny kendo negimiye chuny lit e piny motwo!
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Kaw mor pwodhruok kiolo e wiye mondo ipwodhego.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

kikuyu: Eka ginibed gi mier ma ginyalo dakie kod lege mag kwath ne dhog-gi, rombegi kod jambgi mamoko duto.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Jehonadab wuod Rekab oserito chike mane kweregi omiyogi, to jogi pod ok omiya luor.’
english: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, Yesu nowuok odhi oko kendo noneno jasol osuru ma nyinge Lawi kobet e od jasol osuru. Yesu nowachone niya, “Luwa.”
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

kikuyu: “Ka dipo ngʼato nyalo wachone Nyasaye ni, ‘Aseketho to ok anachak atimne ngʼato marach.
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

kikuyu: Shalum wuod Jabesh nochano mar nego Zekaria. Nomonje e kind ji mi onege kendo nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “Simon, Simon, Satan osekwayo thuolo mondo opiedhi kaka ngano mipiedho.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

kikuyu: Ei hekaluno noketie bap sida mopa ka budho kod thiepene. Gik moko duto nolos gi yiend sida ma kata mana kidi ne ok nyal ne.
english: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jatend jogam Divai nonyiso Josef lek mane oleko. Nowachone niya, “E lekna nende aleko ni aneno yadh mzabibu e nyima,
english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

kikuyu: Beduru mamor pile;
english: Always rejoice.

kikuyu: Lweti ema nochweya; miya ngʼeyo mondo apuonjra chikeni.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

kikuyu: Kosetieko loso puothe donge ochwoyo kothe mopogore opogore kendo okiro kal? To donge opidho shairi kanyo kod ngano e bath puodho?
english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni onge gino maber ne ji moloyo bedo mamor kendo mondo gitim maber kapod gingima.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

kikuyu: Yawuot jaod Hodia, nyamin Naham ne gin: Keila ja-Garmi kod Eshtemoa ja-Maaka.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni, ngʼato ma ok orwako pinyruoth Nyasaye kaka nyathi matin ok nodonji ngangʼ.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Yawuot Izhar ne gin: Shelomith mane wuowi makayo.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

kikuyu: Malaika mane osebedo kawuoyo koda nochiewa, mana kaka ichiewo ngʼato ma nindo.
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

kikuyu: Negibayo ei thim koni gi koni ka gimanyo chiemo, kendo tiende yien maonge ndhandhu ema nobed chiembgi.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

kikuyu: Ji duto osewinjo kaka uwinjo wach kendo mano omiyo chunya opongʼ gi mor kuomu, to adwaro mondo ubed mariek korka timo gima ber, kendo ubed maonge wach korka timo gima rach.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

kikuyu: To koro, Wuora, miya duongʼ e nyimi machal gi duongʼ mane an-go kodi kane piny pok obetie.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

kikuyu: Pok mar abiriyo ne mar Jesarela gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Yawuot Shemida ne gin: Ahian, Shekem, Liki kod Aniam.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

kikuyu: Enokel achiel kuom moro ka moro kaka misango mochiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye, nikech en mar jadolo makiro remb misengini mag lalruok.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Eli makoro wengene ne osechako imore kendo ne ok onyal neno maber, noyudo nindo e kare mapile.
english: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

kikuyu: To isechungo bandech loch ni joma oluori mondo oumgi ka oywanegi atungʼ. Sela
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Omiyo waparo kuom honni mage; nikech Jehova Nyasaye ngʼwon kendo okecho ji.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

kikuyu: Bethuel nonywolo Rebeka. Yawuowi aborogo ema Milka nonywolone Nahor owadgi Ibrahim.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

kikuyu: Kendo kanyo bedie mamor gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, in kaachiel gi yawuoti kod nyigi, jotichni ma yawuowi kod ma nyiri, jo-Lawi manie miechu, maonge gi pok kata girkeni ma mekgi giwegi.
english: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

kikuyu: Mana ka ngʼat ma lonyo law midongʼ duk e ndalo ngʼich, kata kaka olo chumbi e adhola, e kaka ngʼat ma wero wende ne chuny mool.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

kikuyu: Nimar un oganda mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseyierou kuom ogendini duto manie piny mondo ubed joge, joge owuon mogeno.
english: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Gima pogo pi mondo obedie mondo opog pi gi pige.”
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

kikuyu: Wuoda, ere gima omiyo jachode dikaw paroni? Ere gima omiyo chie ngʼato nono dilombi?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

kikuyu: “Ruoth, ma en Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo noketo Nebukadneza wuonu e loch kendo nomiye teko, duongʼ kod huma.
english: “To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.

kikuyu: Polo gi piny norum to wechena ok norum ngangʼ.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: In kod oweteni ma jo-Yahudi unyalo timo gima uneno ka ber gi fedha gi dhahabu modongʼ, kaluwore gi dwaro mar Nyasachi.
english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.

kikuyu: Koro tich duto mar Hemb Romo norumo. Jo-Israel notimo gik moko duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

kikuyu: Yiende mopidhi biro nyago olembgi kendo lowo biro chiego cham; kendo ji biro dak gi kwe e pinygi e kinde ma anaturie jok mag chuma manie ngʼutgi, kendo ma anaresgie kagolo e lwet joma nolokogi wasumbini, ema giningʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

kikuyu: Kane ngʼato obiro mi onyiso Daudi gima osetimore ne joge, ne ooro joote mondo oromnegi nikech ne giyudo wichkuot malich. Ruoth nowacho niya, “Beduru Jeriko nyaka yie tiku dongi eka bangʼe uduogi.”
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

kikuyu: Nyasaye ok en dhano, mondo omi oriambi, kata ok en wuod dhano, mondo omi olok pache. Bende onyalo wuoyo to ok otim kaka owacho? Bende onyalo chiwo singo, to ok ochop singruokno?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

kikuyu: To chiengʼ motelone biro mar Saulo, noyudo ka Jehova Nyasaye osefwenyo ma ne Samuel.
english: Now the LORD had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone dhakono niya, “Yieni oseresi; dhi gi kwe.”
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Ka ok donyal, to obiro oro joote ka pod jal machielo pod ni kuma bor, mondo onyise ni odwaro mondo giwinjre e yor kwe.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

kikuyu: Eka jotend anywola gi jotelo mag dhout Israel, gi jotend migepe mag jolweny alufe to gi jotend migepe mag jolweny miche kaachiel gi jotelo mochungʼne tije ruoth nochiwore mamor.
english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre owinjo wachno, thothgi nowacho niya, “Ma en puonj matek manade. En ngʼa manyalo yie gi puonjni?”
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nonyiso hera moherowago kama: Ne ooro Wuode ma miderma e piny mondo wabed mangima kuome.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

kikuyu: Yaye un oganda maonge wichkuotni, chokreuru kaachiel, chokreuru kaachiel,
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

kikuyu: Kochakore Hebron, Kaleb noriembo jo-Anak adek, ma gin Sheshai, Ahiman kod Talmai ma gin nyikwa Anak.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

kikuyu: Wan to warito gik ma Nyasaye osesingonwa, ma en polo manyien gi piny manyien, kama timbe makare ema noyudre.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

kikuyu: Abisalom noseketo Amasa mondo otel ni jolweny kar Joab. Amasa ne wuod ngʼat moro miluongo ni Jetha, ja-Israel mane okendo Abigael, nyar Nahash mane nyamin Zeruya ma min Joab.
english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

kikuyu: Ka dine bed ni un mag pinyni, to piny dine oherou kaka joge owuon. Piny mon kodu nikech aseyierou, omiyo koro ok un mar pinyni.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Herode nosetho, malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore ne Josef e lek ka en Misri kuno,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: kendo negisaye mondo oyie joma ne tuogo omulie kata mana riak lawe kende, kendo ji duto mane omule nochango.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka sawono norumo, ka jonywolne nedok dala, wuowi Yesu nodongʼ chien Jerusalem, to ne ok gingʼeyo mani.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

kikuyu: Ngima gimoro amora mochwe ni e lwete kaachiel gi much dhano duto.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

kikuyu: Ne imiyo wasika oringo kadhi, mine atieko joma ok dwara.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

kikuyu: Magi duto ne gin joka Asher, jotend anywola, ji ma oyiedhi, jolweny mathuondi kendo jotelo mabeyo. Kar romb jomane oikore dhiyo e lweny, ka ondikgi ginonrogi mar anywolagi ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gi auchiel (26,000).
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

kikuyu: omiyo chiengʼ ok nochami godiechiengʼ kendo dwe ok notimi gimoro gotieno.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Kuom adiera, Elija nyaka kuong bi mondo olos gik moko duto odok kare. Koro to ere gimomiyo ondiki ni Wuod Dhano nyaka yud sand mathoth mi ji kwede?
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

kikuyu: Eka Musa gi Harun noduogo ir Farao. Farao nowachonegi niya, “Dhi, ulam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, makmana ni en ngʼa gini madhi kodu?”
english: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve the LORD your God; but who are those who will go?”

kikuyu: Ne aa malo mondo ayawne jaherana, kendo lwetena ne ton mo mangʼwe ngʼar ma nengone tek. Morno ma nengone tek mane ni e lith lweta nomieno pata mar dhoot.
english: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.

kikuyu: Kaw law ngʼat mochungʼne ngʼat mokia kaka singo; mak gino mosingorego, ka otimo kamano ni dhako majabayo.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

kikuyu: Ji duto makadho buti pamo ni lwetegi; gijari kendo gikino wigi kuom gigo mosetimorene Nyar Jerusalem, ka gipenjore niya, “Bende ma e dala maduongʼ ma yande ongʼere ni dala maler, kendo mor mar piny mangima?”
english: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata kuomu mohero ngima kendo nigi geno kuom ndalo mabiro mangʼeny mabeyo,
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

kikuyu: Koro ma e paro ma an-go kuom wachni: Sani koro ber mondo utiek tich mane uchako higa mokalo. Un ema ne uchako tijni mokwongo, ok nukwongo chako choko kende, to nukwongo bedo gi dwaro mar chiwo giu bende.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

kikuyu: Negikedo gi Midian, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa, kendo neginego chwo duto.
english: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

kikuyu: To nikech in, tho ochomowa odiechiengʼ duto; ikwanowa kaka rombo mitero kar yengʼo.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

kikuyu: Jadolo notim pwodhoruok ne oganda duto mag jo-Israel, kendo nowenegi richogi, nimar ne ok gingʼeyo gima negitimo kendo gisekelone Jehova Nyasaye misango mowangʼ pep kuom ketho margi kod misango mar golo richo.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata ma yanyo Roho Maler ok nowene richone ngangʼ, nikech oseketho ketho mochwere.”
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

kikuyu: Magi e ngeche mamoko mag Solomon, mane jo-Hezekia ruodh Juda ondiko.
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kikuyu: Kik ibed mariek e pachi iwuon to luor Jehova Nyasaye eka inilo richo.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

kikuyu: To nyaka ne wabed mamor kendo bed moil, nikech owaduni yande otho to koro ongima, kendo yande olal to koro oyude!’ ”
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

kikuyu: Ring jamnigo gin magu, mana kaka misango mifwayo mar agoko kod em korachwich bende maru.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ni Ruoth Daudi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho od Obed-Edom gi gige duto nikech Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye.” Omiyo Daudi nolor mwalo kodhi e od Obed-Edom mondo oom Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye, mine okele e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi gi mor.
english: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.

kikuyu: Chuma ikunyo koa e lowo, kendo mula ilenyo kigolo kuom kite.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

kikuyu: Kane Baal-Hanan wuod Akbor otho, Hadad nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Pau, kendo chiege niluongo ni Mehetabel nyar Matred, ma nyar Me-Zahab.
english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

kikuyu: “Rituru wechegi kaka chike mochwere nyaka ne tienge mabiro.
english: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

kikuyu: Bangʼ juma achiel, jopuonjre ne ni ei ot kendo, to chiengʼno Thoma ne ni kodgi. Kata obedo ni dhoudi nolor, Yesu nobiro mochungʼ e diergi momosogi niya, “Okweuru!”
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Isenyiso jogi kinde mag chandruok mapek; isemiyowa kongʼo mamiyo wakwangʼ.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

kikuyu: Eka bor polo noumo Hemb Romo kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nopongʼo Hemb Romono.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Omiyo negibiro ir Musa gi Eliazar jadolo kod jotend oganda mar jo-Israel, mi giwachonegi niya,
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Turo osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech gisemako ogendini duto mi giterogi e twech e piny Edom, ma ok girito winjruok mar osiep mane gitimo kodgi,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;

kikuyu: Ji ariyogo nowacho ni Lut niya, “Bende in gi ngʼato moro kae kaka chwo nyigi, yawuoti kata nyigi, kata ngʼat moro amora e dala maduongʼni ma watni? Golgi oko kae,
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

kikuyu: Gol wengegi kuoma; nikech giberna. Yie wiyi chalo kweth mag diek, malor koa e got Gilead.
english: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.

kikuyu: Nyithindgi madhoth nochwad piny e wangʼ-gi ka gineno, utegi noyaki, kendo mondegi nomak githuon.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma nyinge Daniel ni, ma ruoth ne luongo ni Belteshazar, noyud ni nigi rieko, ngʼeyo kod winjo, kaachiel gi nyalo mar loko lekgi, nyiso tiend weche ma tiendgi tek kendo konyo e weche matek machando ji. Luong Daniel, kendo obiro huloni tiend ndikono.
english: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”

kikuyu: Kaw nyathi kendo itingʼe, nikech anami nyikwaye obed oganda maduongʼ.”
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

kikuyu: Osetimo misengini mathoth mag dhok gi nyiroye machwe gi rombe kendo oseluongo yawuot ruoth duto gi Abiathar jadolo gi jatend jolweny to ok oseluongo Solomon jatichni.
english: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

kikuyu: Fweny: Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye mosechano kumogo piny Hadrak kaachiel gi jo-Damaski, nikech piny duto en mar Nyasaye kaachiel gi jo-Israel,
english: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—

kikuyu: to machielo nochako ni Eliezer nimar nowacho niya, “Nyasach wuonwa ema ne jakonyna, ne oresa kane Farao dwaro nega gi ligangla.”
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

kikuyu: Nikech, kiwacho adier, to Nyasaye owuoyo gi ji pile e yore mopogore opogore, kata obedo ni dhano sa moro ok nyal winjo tiend wechene.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

kikuyu: Chi Kanaan moro mane odak machiegni gi kanyo nobiro ire kaywagore niya, “Ruoth, Wuod Daudi, kecha! Nyara nigi jachien marach kendo osandore malit.”
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

kikuyu: kod meli mangʼeny duto mag ohala gi yiedhi molos mabeyo.
english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

kikuyu: Un joma goyo thum kaka Daudi nogoyo kendo uchuogo wende mag nyatiti.
english: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

kikuyu: kod nyiri alufu piero adek gariyo (32,000) mane pok ongʼeyo chwo.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero dhawo ohero richo; ngʼat mogero ohinga mabor kelo mana hinyruok.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Filistia nomake, mi gilodho wengene oko kendo ne gitere nyaka Gaza. Eka ne gitweye gi nyoroche mag mula, mi gikete jarego e od twech.
english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nobedo gi duongʼ moloyo malaike mana kaka nying mane omiye bende nigi duongʼ moloyo malaika.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Pod ubiro bedo gi ler kuom ndalo manok. Wuothuru kapod un gi ler; ka mudho pok ojukou. Ngʼama wuotho e mudho okia kuma odhiye.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

kikuyu: Nikech ode tero ji e tho to yorene tero ji e piny joma otho.
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo laruno mi oyudo ni bethene duto ne romre, ka gin gi fut mia achiel gi piero abich moro ka moro borne gi lachne. Kendo mar misango ne ni e nyim hekaluno.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

kikuyu: Jehoyakim notho moyweyo gi kwerene, kendo Jehoyakin wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ruodhe ne mirima omako kode mi nochiwe e lwet jo-jela mondo orodhe maonge kech, nyaka chop ochul gowi duto mane en-go.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

kikuyu: Ma en misango miwangʼo pep Sabato ka Sabato, komedi ewi chiwo mapile mar misango miwangʼo pep kod misango miolo piny.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Ne arwaki gi lewni mogorie gik mabeyo kendo ne arwakoni wuoche akada mayom. Ne arwakoni law mayom kendo ne aumi gi lewni ma nengogi tek.
english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

kikuyu: “To ka in iwuon kata yawuoti olokore moweya kendo ok oluwo chikena kod buchena ma asemiyi mi odhi olamo nyiseche moko kendo otiyonigi,
english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

kikuyu: Winja kendo idwoka. Pacha chanda kendo chunya onge gi kwe
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

kikuyu: Kuom mano, nikech Yesu ne chango ji chiengʼ Sabato, jo-Yahudi nosande.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nowachona niya, “Kik ilingʼ mak ihulo weche mokor manie kitabuni, nikech kindeno ma gigo onego timre chiegni.
english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

kikuyu: Kata ngʼat manie puodho kik dog dala mondo okaw kode.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

kikuyu: Kane Lea ofwenyo ni ok onyal nywolo nyithindo kendo nokawo Zilpa jatichne ma nyako, nomiye Jakobo mondo okawe kaka chiege.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mangima mane odak e lowo motwo kendo mayweyo gi ume notho.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachona: Abiro lingʼ thi kendo nangʼichi gie kar dakna mana, kaka piny kwe mos ka chiengʼ liet kendo kaka rumbi mar tho moko ndalo keyo.
english: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat Nyasaye nopenje niya, Ne olwar gi kanye? Kane onyise kama ne olwarie, Elisha nongʼado luth, monyume kanyo kendo wi le nolewore.
english: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

kikuyu: Oselwero it mzabibu maga, kendo ketho yiende ngʼopega. Osepoko potgi mi owitogi kucho, kendo oweyo bedegi kodongʼ rachere.
english: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nochako dwoko kwan mar jo-Israel piny, Hazael noloyo jo-Israel e pinjegi duto,
english: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

kikuyu: Kapo ni wiu owil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ma uluwo nyiseche moko, ulamo kendo ukulorunegi, to akwongʼora kawuononi ni notieku maonge kiawa.
english: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

kikuyu: Chamuru makati ma ok oketie thowi kuom ndalo abiriyogo; gimoro amora man-gi thowi kik yudi e kindu kata e pinyu duto.
english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

kikuyu: Ne oyudo kido mar nyangu achien kaka ranyisi mar bedo ngʼama kare, ma noseyudo motelo kuom yie kapok otere nyangu. Kuom mano, en kwar ji duto moyie to ok oter nyangu, mondo joma kamago bende obed joma kare.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

kikuyu: kod miero ma ok rum e kind joma pachgi osekethore kendo ma adiera oselalnigi. Giparo ni lamo Nyasaye en yor yudo mwandu.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

kikuyu: Modekai nowuok e nyim ruoth korwakore gi law marambulu mokikore gi rachar, osimbo mar duongʼ mar dhahabu, to gi kandho maralik molos law mayom. Kendo dala maduongʼ mar Susa notimo nyasi gi mor malich.
english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

kikuyu: Ne! Obiro ka boche polo, gechene mag lweny biro ka kalausi, farese mage ringo matek moloyo ongo. Kagiwacho niya, mano kaka wan gi lit!
english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

kikuyu: Eka negipenjo niya, “En dhoot Israel mane mane ok ochokore e piny Mizpa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye?” Negifwenyo ni onge ngʼama noa Jabesh Gilead manobiro mochokore e chokruokno.
english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to the LORD to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

kikuyu: Abiro paki pile ka pile kendo abiro tingʼo nyingi malo mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Sheva ne jagoro; to Zadok gi Abiathar ne jodolo.
english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

kikuyu: Judas Iskariot, ma en achiel kuom jopuonjre Yesu kendo mane biro ndhoge bangʼe, nokwero tim mane dhakono otimo, kowacho niya,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

kikuyu: Chieleuru gi kite nyaka otho, nimar otemo golou kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou Misri e piny mane unie wasumbini.
english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Nimar ji mangʼeny nobi e nyinga ka hedhore ni, ‘An e Kristo,’ kendo giniwuond ji mangʼeny.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi, kar seche mitimoe misango, pi nobiro koa yo Edom kendo gwengʼno notimo pi lilo.
english: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

kikuyu: jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Girgash, kod jo-Jebus.”
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

kikuyu: mondo obed kaka ranyisi e dieru. E ndalo mabiro, ka nyithindu openjou ni, ‘Kitegi nyiso angʼo?’
english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iwinj dwonda. Chik iti ne ywakna ma aywaknigo mondo ikecha.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Ka uwinjo maber gima owacho kendo utimo gik moko duto mawacho, to abiro bedo jasik jowasiku kendo anakwed jogo makwedou.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

kikuyu: Holni manie bwo nembe noelore kendo mise mag piny nowe nono, kane ikwerogi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kane teko mar muya mowuok e otuchi mag umi ogoyogi.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

kikuyu: Ma e gima hera en: ok ni wan ema ne wahero Nyasaye, to Nyasaye ema noherowa mokwongo mi nooro Wuode kaka misango mar richowa.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeremia janabi nowachone jo-Juda duto kod jogo duto modak Jerusalem niya:
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

kikuyu: Nyasaye mane ochulo kuor kara kendo oloyo ogendini e bwoya;
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel notimo kaka Musa ne ochikogi kendo ne gikwayo jo-Misri lewni kod gik molos gi fedha kod dhahabu.
english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

kikuyu: Mwandu jomariek e osimbo margi, to fup joma ofuwo nyago mana fuwo.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

kikuyu: kendo nowachone niya, “Ji mangʼeny kuongo kelo divai maber eka bangʼe gikelo divai maboth ka welo osemetho momer to in to ne ikano divai maber mogik nyaka sani.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: Kane ochiegni donjo Misri, nowacho ne Sarai chiege niya, “Angʼeyo kaka in dhako ma jaber.
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

kikuyu: Awachonu kamano koa e pacha awuon, to ok kaka chik dwaro.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

kikuyu: Ket ringʼo mosengʼadi matindo tindo e iye, ringʼo machwe duto; ma gin em gi bat. Pongʼe gi choke machwe duto;
english: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.

kikuyu: kane ogolo chik ne koth kendo ogoro yor mil polo,
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

kikuyu: “Jotelo duto mag ruoth to gi ji duto moa e gwenge mag pinyruoth, ongʼeyo ni onge ngʼato angʼata madichwo kata ma dhako manyalo donjo ir ruoth e laru maiye ka ok ruoth ema oluonge to oket chik achiel kende ni nyaka nege. Makmana ka ruoth orieyo ludhe mar dhahabu kochomo ngʼatno eka ok nonege. Koro to osekawo ndalo piero adek kapok ruoth oluonga.”
english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

kikuyu: Eka Abimelek nowacho niya, “Ma en angʼo ma itimonwa ni? Ka dipo ni ngʼatwa moro dine oseriwore gi chiegi, donge dikelonwa richo maduongʼ.”
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

kikuyu: Eka Thoma, ma bende iluongo ni Didimas, nowachone jopuonjre mamoko niya, “Wan bende wadhiuru mondo kata ka en tho, to watho kode.”
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

kikuyu: en kaachiel gi joge duto negidhi e Got Zalmon. Abimelek nokawo le mi otongʼogo bad yath moro, mi notingʼe e goke. Nochiwo chik ne joma nenikode niya, “Uneno gima atimoni! Timuru kamano piyo!”
english: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

kikuyu: Ringreu nolwar mana e thimni; ngʼato angʼata kuomu ma hike piero ariyo ka dhi nyime mane okwan e ndalo kweno kendo mosengʼur koda.
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

kikuyu: Eka Balaam noneno Amalek kendo nowachone ote mar Nyasaye kama: “Amalek ema ne okwongo kuom ogendini, to gikone ibiro tieke.”
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Gima awachonu ema, awacho ni ji duto ni, ‘Nenuru!’ ”
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

kikuyu: Yie mane en-gono ema nomiyo odhi odak e piny ma wendo, mane osingne. Nodak e hema mana kaka Isaka kod Jakobo bende ne jodak, mi gidoko weg singruok kaachiel kode.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

kikuyu: Eka nokela e laru maiye mar od Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kanyo, gie kama idonjogo e hekalu, e kind kendo mar misango gi kama owe yo mikadhe, ne nitie ji madirom piero ariyo gabich. Negiloko dier ngʼegi ni hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ka wengegi ochomo yo wuok chiengʼ, negikulore ne wangʼ chiengʼ man yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

kikuyu: Wach Nyasaye kuom Nineve. Kitap fweny mar Nahum ja-Elkosh.
english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

kikuyu: Koro kuparo ni un ema ne wach Nyasaye ochakore kuomu? Koso ugalo ni un kendu ema wach osechoponu?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kikuyu: ma wuod Abishua, ma wuod Finehas, ma wuod Eliazar, ma wuod Harun jadolo maduongʼ;
english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

kikuyu: Eka mondo gikaw lawno gi faras mondo gimi jatelo mogen, kendo girwak ngʼat ma ruoth morgo mar miyo duongʼ, ka gitelo e nyim faras motingʼe e yore mag dala maduongʼ, kendo ka gigoyo milome e nyime ni, ‘Ma e kaka itimo ne ngʼama ruoth morgo mar miyo duongʼ!’ ”
english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

kikuyu: nokelo gige nindo gi bakunde to gi gik mochwe gi lowo. Bende negikelo ngano gi shairi, mogo gi cham molodi, oganda gi ngʼor,
english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

kikuyu: Bi wadhi, jaherana, kendo chal gi mwanda kata le, mamoko manie thim mochungʼ ewi gode mopongʼ gi yedhe madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!

kikuyu: Bende noloso rachungi apar mag mula minyalo dhir; ka moro ka moro romo fut auchiel gi nus e bor madhi malo to lachne to romo fut abich.
english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

kikuyu: Kamano bende noloso thike angʼwen mag yiend zeituni molosogo dhoot mar ot maduongʼ.
english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

kikuyu: Ibiro tieko kothgi mi rum e piny, kendo nyithindgi biro rumo e dier ji.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Kendo ruoth nooro jatend jolweny mar adek kaachiel gi jolweny mage piero abich. Ngʼat mar adekno nodhi mogoyo chonge piny e nyim Elija kokwaye niya, “Ngʼat Nyasaye, yie ibedie gi ngʼwono ne ngimana to gi ngima mar ji piero abich ma an-gogi, an jatichni!
english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

kikuyu: Donge richo mane watimo Peor oromo? Nyaka chil kawuono kum mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyowa pok orumo!
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD,

kikuyu: e kaka ngʼato mawuondo jabute kowacho niya, “Ne angeri angera!”
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

kikuyu: to ibiro yweye molal nono mana ka buru; joma yande ongʼeye nopenj ni, ‘Kare tinde erego?’
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

kikuyu: Mon-go nowuok moringo oa e liel kanyo ka gitetni kendo dhogi omoko, ne ok giwachone ngʼato gimoro amora e yo nikech negiluor. [
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka gigi duto osetimorenu mi ubedo gi chuny mool, eka unuduog ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kendo uluore.
english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.

kikuyu: Tarik abich dwe mar auchiel higa mar auchiel, kane abet e oda ka jodongo mag Juda nobet e nyima, teko mar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto nobiro kuoma.
english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.

kikuyu: Singruokgi notimne Ibrahim kod kothe. Ndiko ok owacho gi nyikwaye, tiende ni ji mangʼeny, to mana ni notime gi “kothi” ma en Kristo.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma Musa ne oseoro mondo odhi onon pinyno, mi odwogo kendo omiyo oganda duto ma timbegi richogi ongʼur kode kaluwore gi wach marach mane gikelo kuom pinyno;
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

kikuyu: Jodongo mag ode nochungʼ bathe mondo gichunge owe nindo piny e lowo, to notamore, kendo ne ok onyal chamo chiemo moro amora.
english: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

kikuyu: Kuom mano kwongʼ osetieko piny kendo joma odakie nyaka yud kum kuom richogi. Omiyo joma odak e piny osewangʼ mi manok ema odongʼ.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

kikuyu: Kane Balak wuod Zipor, ma ruodh Moab, ne ikore mondo oked gi Israel, nooro Balaam wuod Beor mondo okwongʼu.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

kikuyu: Amanyi gi chunya duto; omiyo kik iwe abar awe chikeni.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Jehozadak nodar kane Jehova Nyasaye otiyo gi Nebukadneza motero Juda gi Jerusalem e twech.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto manie gwengʼ Gerasi duto nokwayo Yesu mondo odar odhi owegi, nikech luoro maduongʼ nomakogi. Omiyo nodonjo ei yie kendo noa kanyo.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno onge ngʼato manobedie ewi tat ot, man-gi gige ei ot, manolor mondo ogolgi. Machalre gi mano, onge ngʼato manie puodho manodog dala ne gimoro amora.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

kikuyu: Initelnigi kod ludhi mar nyinyo; kendo initogi matindo tindo ka agulu.”
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

kikuyu: Yesu noywak matek bangʼe chunye nochot.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

kikuyu: Negidwokogi niya, “Biuru mondo wamonjgi! Waseneno ka piny cha ber ahinya. Donge udhi timo gimoro? Kik udeki ma ok udhi kuno kendo ukaw pinyno.
english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

kikuyu: Negidhi ir Eliazar jadolo kod Joshua wuod Nun, to gi jotelo mi giwachonegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa mondo opognwa girkeni e dier owetewa.” Omiyo Joshua nomiyogi girkeni kaachiel gi owete wuonegi, kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

kikuyu: Daudi luonge ni ‘Ruoth.’ Ere kaka onyalo bedo wuode kendo?”
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendo mar misango los gi mula. Gigo ne gin agulni ma ijowogo buru, opawo, bakunde mikirogo remo, gi uma michiwogo ringʼo kod tegni mag mach.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Ne gin gi farese mia abiriyo gi piero adek gauchiel (736), kanyna mia ariyo gi piero angʼwen gabich (245),
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

kikuyu: Yaye unune malit un joma gombo mondo odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye ochopi! En angʼo momiyo ugombo odiechiengno mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo ochopi? Enobed chiengʼ mudho to ok chiengʼ ler!
english: “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.

kikuyu: Koa dhood Simeon ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa dhood Lawi ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000), Koa dhood Isakar ji alufu apar gariyo (12,000),
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Ne aluoro mirima kod kum mager mar Jehova Nyasaye, nimar mirima nomake ahinya mar tiekou. To kata kamano nowinjo ywakna kendo.
english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.

kikuyu: “Chumbi ber, to ka ndhathe orumo to ere kaka dichak imi obed gi ndhathe kendo? Beduru ka ndhath chumbi un uwegi, kendo beduru gi kwe ngʼato gi ngʼato.”
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

kikuyu: “Onge yath maber manyago olemo maricho, kata yath marach manyago olemo maber.
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi nochiwo gigi ne Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka ne osetimo gi fedha kod dhahabu manokawo kuom ogendini duto: jo-Edom kod jo-Moab, jo-Amon kod jo-Filistia to gi jo-Amalek.
english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

kikuyu: Ka moko kuom joma nochungʼ machiegni nowinjo mano, negiwacho niya, “Winjuru, oluongo Elija.”
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano, chik iti ne gima adwaro wachonu ka uwinjo kendo ka ji duto winjo:
english: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

kikuyu: Kata mana joma chunou mondo teru nyangu bende ok rit chik. Un to gichunou mondo giyud thuolo mar sungore nikech gima otim e ringre.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

kikuyu: Ok obi weyo tiendi kier, Jal ma riti ok bi nur;
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

kikuyu: kendo ne ofwenyore mokwongo ne Petro, bangʼe nofwenyore ne joote apar gariyo.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

kikuyu: To kawuru giu mowal kod gimoro amora ma usesingoru kukwongʼoru ni unuchiw kendo udhi kama Jehova Nyasaye noyier.
english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, piny nyaka ngʼe ni ahero Wuora kendo ni atimo mana gima Wuora osechika mondo atim. “Kuom mano, chunguru mondo wadhi.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

kikuyu: Bangʼ tho Ahab, jo-Moab nongʼanyo ne Israel.
english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

kikuyu: Ok awach ni aselocho kata ni asebedo ngʼat makare, to atemo matek mondo achop gima omiyo Kristo Yesu nomaka.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Jeremia nochwogo wend ywak ni Josia kendo jower duto machwo gi mamon pod wero wendno ka giparogo Josia nyaka chil kawuono. Gino oselokore tim jo-Israel kendo wendno ondik e kitap Ywagruok.
english: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

kikuyu: Un kod jouteu duto unyalo chamo bathe moko kamoro amora, nimar en pok maru ne tich mutiyo e Hemb Romo.
english: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Jatelo maduongʼ mar jo-Lawi man Jerusalem ne en Uzi wuod Bani, wuod Hashabia, wuod Matania, wuod Mika. Uzi ne en achiel kuom nyikwa Asaf, ma ne gin jower, nikech tich mar od Nyasaye.
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Wechegi ok gin weche manono to gin e ngimau. Kurito wechegi to gibiro miyo udag amingʼa e piny mubiro kawo ka usengʼado aora Jordan.”
english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi chiayo, ngʼatni nyaka nege, to chiayono bende nyaka negi.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

kikuyu: Kik uluw timbe oganda mudak e diergi madhi riembonu oko-gi. Nikech gigi mane gitimo nomiyo aol kodgi.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

kikuyu: Kendo uchiw rwath kod im kaka misango mar lalruok kaachiel gi misango mar cham moruw gi mo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nikech tinendeni Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyrenu.’ ”
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho: “ ‘Okwongʼ dala maduongʼ machwero remo! An bende abiro chanone yiende modhi malo.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

kikuyu: Para kendo idwoka, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha. Chiw ler ne wengena, nono to dipo ka nindo otera mi atho;
english: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

kikuyu: Ketgi ei adita kendo ikel gigo, kaachiel gi nyarwath kod imbe ariyo-ka.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Joshua nochoko dhout Israel duto kama iluongo ni Shekem. Noluongo jodongo, jotelo, jongʼad bura kod jotelo mamoko mag Israel mi gidhi e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Jabesh Gilead nowinjo gik moko duto mane jo-Filistia osetimo ni Saulo,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, abiro mayi ngʼat ma chunyi ohero ahinya apoya nono. Kik ingʼur, kik iywagi bende pi wangʼi kik chwer.
english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

kikuyu: Osiep wuondo osiep, kendo onge ngʼama wacho adiera. Gisepuonjo lewgi wacho miriambo; kendo gisedonjo matut e richo ma ok ginyal wuokie.
english: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Joma pwodhore kendo bedo maler mondo odhiye puothe, kamoro ka moro luwo wadgi kendo chamo ring anguro, oyieyo kod gik moko duto makwero norum duto dichiel.
english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Rieya, Jehova Nyasaye, to mana gi bura makare ma ok e ich wangʼ, ka ok kamano to ditieka chuth.
english: LORD, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

kikuyu: Negitweyo thiwni ariyogo mag dhahabu e ratege mantie e riak law akor,
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Koro ka tich mane okelo tho, mane ondike kite mopa, ne obiro gi duongʼ mondo omi jo-Israel kik ngʼi wangʼ Musa tir nikech duongʼne kata obedo ni duongʼno ne dhi ka rumo kamano.
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

kikuyu: Ageno ni ubiro yudo ni pok warem e penj.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

kikuyu: To negisiko gikwaye nyaka nojok, makoro ne ok onyal tamore, mine owachonegi niya, “Koro orgiuru.” Negioro ji piero abich mane omenyo kuom ndalo adek, to ne ok giyude.
english: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

kikuyu: wuon gi min nyaka kawe mitere ir jodongo e ranga dalagi.
english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

kikuyu: “An to an ngʼa, kata joga to gin ngʼa gini, mamiyo nyaka wachiw gi chuny achiel ka ma? Gik moko duto aa kuomi, kendo wasemiyi mana gima oa e lweti
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

kikuyu: Eka jodir aserni nobayo jotichni gi ewi ohinga, kendo jotich ruoth moko nonegi. Uria ja-Hiti ma jatichni bende ginego.”
english: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

kikuyu: To bende en kwar joma oter nyangu, ma ok oter mana nyangu kende, to maluwo kit yie ma kwarwa Ibrahim ne nigo kane pok otere nyangu.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Bonyogo ne chalo gi farese moikore ni lweny. E wigi negirwako gik machalo gi osimbo mag dhahabu, to lend wangʼ-gi ne chalo gi lela wangʼ dhano.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

kikuyu: Achalo gi tula mar bungu, achalo gi tula modak e gunda.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar aboro nyaka okaw akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo mondo okelgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo kendo ochiwgi ne jadolo.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

kikuyu: Rehoboam nonywomo Mahalath mane nyar wuod Daudi miluongo ni Jerimoth kendo min mare ne en Abihail ma nyar Eliab wuod Jesse.
english: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: nus mar pok mar oganda ne gin rombe alufu mia adek gi piero adek gabiriyo gi mia abich (337,500),
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

kikuyu: Kane jatend lweny osemiye thuolo mondo owuo, Paulo nochungʼ e raidhi, motingʼo ni ji bade mondo gilingʼ. Kane giselingʼ nowuoyo kodgi gi dho jo-Hibrania kowacho niya:
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

kikuyu: Kuom weche duto mane ruoth ochiko jodolo kod jo-Lawi ne onge moro amora mane giweyo kata mana weche mag keno.
english: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

kikuyu: Kane ogolo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom joka Zabdi, to Akan wuod Karmi, ma wuod Zimri, ma wuod Zera mar dhood Juda ema noyier.
english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Migiuru gimoro gicham un uwegi.” Negidwoko niya, “Wan mana gi makati abich gi rech ariyo kende, makmana ka wanyalo dhi mondo wangʼiew chiemo ne ogandani duto.”
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

kikuyu: kendo makulore piny mondo ongʼi polo gi piny?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

kikuyu: Ehud norieyo bade koracham, mi owuodho ligangla koa e bamne korachwich kendo ochwoyo ii ruoth.
english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye noluongo Musa mowuoyo kode gie Hemb Romo. Nowachone niya,
english: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: thuondigi duto nowuok mowuotho otieno duto ka gidhi Beth Shan. Negigonyo ringre Saulo gi yawuote e kor ohinga mar Beth Shan ma negikelogi Jabesh, kuma ne giwangʼogie.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

kikuyu: Bangʼ Ibzan, Elon ja-Zebulun notelo ne Israel kuom higni apar.
english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro sani, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kaw ngimana oa e piny nikech ber katho moloyo dongʼ kangima.”
english: Therefore now, LORD, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

kikuyu: Chwat ka chwat ma Jehova Nyasaye nochwadgigo gi ludhe mar kum kokedo kodgi malit, nomi jo-Nyasaye bed mamor ka gigoyo oyieke kod nyatiti.
english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which the LORD will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

kikuyu: Nyaka owangʼ ubani kendo e seche momokoe teyni godhiambo mondo ubanigo owangʼ kinde duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka ne tienge mabiro.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Ruodh Josef nomako Josef mokete e od twech, kamane ikanoe joma otwe mag ruoth. To kane Josef ni e od twech,
english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

kikuyu: Nikech hekalu mari man Jerusalem ruodhi biro keloni mich.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyis Harun kama: ‘Rie ludhi mondo ichwadgo buru ma e lowo,’ kendo buru ma e lowo mar piny Misri duto biro lokore kikun.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Kane kinde mar tho Israel ochopo machiegni, noluongo Josef wuode kendo owachone niya, “Ka itimona ngʼwono, to yie iket lweti e kind ema kendo ikwongʼrina ni nikecha kendo ibedna ja-adiera. Kik iika e piny Misri
english: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

kikuyu: “Ka nyako ma rawera ma pod odak e od wuon mare osingore ne Jehova Nyasaye kata okwongʼore mar timo gimoro
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar adek gokinyi, polo nomil kamor, ka boche polo okwako wi got kendo turumbete noywag matek, ma ji duto mane ni e kambi notetni.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

kikuyu: Dibed ni ne in misumba kane Nyasaye oluongi? Kik mano chandi, makmana kapo ni inyalo yudo yor bedo thuolo, to tim kamano moloyo.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

kikuyu: (Barabas noket e od twech nikech wach koko mane otimore e dala maduongʼ, kendo nikech nek.)
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

kikuyu: Jo-Galatia, yande uringo ngʼwech maber, en ngʼa moseduodou motamou luwo adiera?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

kikuyu: mi amonje kapod ool kendo onyosore. Anami kihondko malich make mi ji duto man kode ring weye. Daneg mana ruoth kende
english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka non kama burno ne nitie kendo ka onenore ni odholore ahinya kendo yier manie iye oselokore rachar, to jadolo noland ni ngʼatno ogak. En tuo malandore mar del ma osewuok kama bur ne netie.
english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

kikuyu: Kane jatend jorit hekalu gi jodolo madongo owinjo wachni, ne gidhier nono, ka giparore kuom gima wachni ne nyalo kelo.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

kikuyu: kendo nobedo ruoth Jerusalem kuom higni piero angʼwen gachiel. Dagi niluongo ni Maaka nyar Abishalom.
english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

kikuyu: Dhakono nowacho niya, “Angʼeyo ni in Mesia” (miluongo ni Kristo) “mane onego bi kendo ka obiro, to enonyiswa tiend weche duto.”
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

kikuyu: Nodongo e nyime mana ka chuny yath mayom matwi; kendo mana ka tiend yath madongo kaa e lowo motwo. Ne oonge gi chia kata duongʼ moro mane nyalo lombo wangʼwa kuome, kendo onge gima ne nenore kuome maber mane nyalo miyo wahere.
english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

kikuyu: To bangʼ higni piero abiriyo Jehova Nyasaye biro kecho Turo mirese. To bangʼe nodogi e tije machon mar chode kendo notim timbene machon mag chode gi pinjeruodhi duto mag piny ngima.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik utit yie wiu kata kik utit yie tiku.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano wachne dhood Israel ni, Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Lokreuru! Wereuru gi nyisecheu muloso kendo kwedreuru gi timbeu mamono duto!
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

kikuyu: Kuom mano e sa mane giwinjoe ywak mar tungʼ, asili, nyagweru, nyatiti, orutu kod kit thumbe mayoreyore, ogendini duto, pinje kod ji duto moa e dhoudi mopogore opogore ne olamo kido mar dhahabu ma ruoth Nebukadneza nochungo.
english: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokel kuomu kit tuoche duto ma ok ondiki e kitabuni mar chik nyaka chop tieku chuth.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

kikuyu: “Odiechiengʼno divai manyien nochwer kawuok ewi gode; kendo chak nomol kawuok ewi thuche, holo mag pi nopongʼ chuth. Soko nomol koa e od Jehova Nyasaye kendo pi moaye sokono biro mol e holo mar Shitim.
english: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.

kikuyu: Jotend jo-Filistia nodhi ir Delila mi owachone niya, “Tem ane ka inyalo hoye mondo onyisi kuma tekone ae kendo ingʼe kaka wanyalo loye mondo mi watweye kendo sande. Wabiro miyi fedha ma pekne romo kilo apar gadek ngʼato ka ngʼato.”
english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”

kikuyu: Negitimo misango ne jochiende ma ok gin Nyasaye, ma gin nyiseche mane ok gingʼeyo; nyiseche mana mosieko, kendo nyiseche ma kwereu ne ok oluoro.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

kikuyu: Koro ne onge pi mane ogandani nyalo modho, kendo ji nochokore mondo okwed Musa gi Harun.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Kata iparo ni iriek ka nyasaye kamano,
english: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,

kikuyu: Petro nowuotho kochomo ot kod Kornelio, ka giwuoyo, to kane ochopo ei ot, nonwangʼo ka ji mangʼeny ochokore rite.
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

kikuyu: Ka adhi nindo to piny ok runa piyo kendo aparora ni abiro aa malo sa adi? Piny budhona kapok oru, kendo apuodora koni gi koni nyaka okinyi.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

kikuyu: E sa ma jodolo madongo gi jotendgi nonene, negigoyo koko matek niya, “Gure! Gure!” To Pilato nowachonegi niya, “Kaweuru un uwegi udhi ugure. An ok ayudo ketho moro amora kuome minyalo ngʼadonego bura.”
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: Petro nodwoko niya, “Ooyo Ruoth! Ne pok achamo gimoro amora makwero kata mochido nyaka nene.”
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

kikuyu: Weya adogi mondo adhi atho e dalawa but kama noyikie wuonwa gi minwa. To jatichni miluongo ni Kimham nika. Yiene mondo ongʼad odhi gi ruodha ma en ruoth loka. Timne gimoro amora mihero.”
english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

kikuyu: Eka Josef nogolo nyithindogo e chong Israel kendo nokulore nyaka e lowo.
english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne aluor mine adhi kendo ne apando talanta-ni ei lowo. Girino eri kawe.’
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

kikuyu: E piny motimo ongoro bende nogeroe kuonde motingʼore mag siro lweny kendo nokunyo yewni mangʼeny nikech ne en kod jamni mangʼeny e tie gode kod e piny pap. Bende ne en kod joma ne tiyone e puothe kod puothene mag mzabibu manie gode kaachiel gi kuonde momew nikech nohero pur.
