english: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

kikuyu: Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: Abiro keto Roho mara kuomu mi udok mangima, kendo abiro miyo udag e pinyu uwegi. Eka unungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuoyo kendo asetimo kamano. Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.’ ”
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Eka ne omiyogi chiemogo, negichamo ma giweyo moko kodongʼ kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Omiyo e higa mar ochiko mar loch Zedekia, e odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar apar, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nodhi gi jolweny mage duto momonjo Jerusalem. Negilworo dala maduongʼno kendo ne gigoyone agengʼa koni gi koni.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

kikuyu: Yesu noa kanyo modhi e gwengʼ mar Judea man loka aora Jordan. Oganda maduongʼ nochako obiro ire, kendo nopuonjogi kaka nojatimo kinde duto.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “E kinde mane jo-Misri, jo-Amor, jo-Amon, jo-Filistia,
english: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

kikuyu: kendo idhi e Holo mar Ben Hinom, mantiere machiegni gi kar donjo mar Dhoranga Potshad. Go milome kanyo mar weche manyisi,
english: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ka idok Misri nyaka ine ni itimo e nyim Farao honni duto ma asemiyi teko mondo itim. Makmana abiro miyo chuny Farao doko matek ma ok onyal weyo jo-Israel mondo oa.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.

kikuyu: Eka nochako kwongʼore mowachonegi koramo niya, “Ok angʼeyo ngʼatno adier!” To mana gisano thuon gweno moro nokok.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka Kristo nobiro e piny to nowacho niya, “Misengini kod chiwo ok ema ne idwaro, to ringruok ema ne iikona;
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

kikuyu: Muya mawuok e umi nomiyo pige ogingore malo. Apaka mar pi nogingore mochungʼ ka kor ot; pige man kuonde matut nochokore e chuny nam.”
english: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.

kikuyu: Koro nyisauru kuyie timo ngʼwono kod adieri ne ruodha; to ka ok kamano to nyisa mondo mi angʼe kuma achomo.”
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

kikuyu: Koro doguru e tich, ok nomiu lum moro amora, to nyaka ulos matafare ma kar kwan-gi rom gi ma usebedo kuloso pile.”
english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

kikuyu: mamiyo ibedo mabor gi dhako mandhaga kaachiel gi lep mayom mar dhako mabayo.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

kikuyu: Bende ma dibed gimoro malingʼ-lingʼ ma ruodha osetimo ka ok onyiso jotichne ngʼama onego bed e kom loch mar ruodha bangʼe?”
english: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro rite kendo biro miyo obed mangima; Jehova Nyasaye biro gwedhe e piny, kendo ok obi jwangʼe e lwet wasike.
english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

kikuyu: Kaka cham dongʼ e puodho bangʼ hulo, e kaka olembe mag zeituni nodongʼ e yath kosepon, olembe ariyo kata adek nyalo dongʼ ewi bede yath mamalo kendo olembe angʼwen kata abich nyalo dongʼ e bedene monyaa,” Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel ema owacho.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi kanyo ma gidonjo e od ja-Lawi ma wuowi mane ni ka Mika kendo gimose.
english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu otingʼo wangʼe noneno oganda maduongʼ kabiro ire, mowachone Filipo niya, “Ere kuma wanyalo ngʼiewe makati ni jogi mondo gicham?”
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

kikuyu: Nikech Wuod Dhano en Ruodh Sabato.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Wachiwuru chunywa kendo watingʼ bedewa malo e nyim Nyasaye manie polo, kawawacho niya,
english: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

kikuyu: E kinde mane giywak, jo-Israel duto mane ni machiegni kodgi noringo, kaywak niya, “Wan bende piny dhi mwonyowa!”
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

kikuyu: Jakobo noringo modhi e piny mar Aram; Israel notiyo mondo oyud dhako, kendo nochulo nengo mare kokwayo rombe.
english: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.

kikuyu: To Shimei nodwoko ruoth niya, “Gima iwacho ber, jatichni biro timo kaka ruodhe osewacho.” Shimei nodak Jerusalem kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

kikuyu: nyikwa Magbish, ji mia achiel gi piero abich gauchiel (156),
english: The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

kikuyu: Ne ooro ranyisi gi honni mage e dieru, yaye Misri, noorogi kuom Farao kaachiel gi jotichne duto.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

kikuyu: Bangʼe negidhi ir ruoth Hezekia kagiwachone niya, “Wasepwodho hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye duto kaachiel gi kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono kod mesa makati mopwodhi kod gigene duto.
english: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all the LORD’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.

kikuyu: Kane onwangʼo gimadho divai, ruoth nochako openjo Esta niya, “Koro angʼo midwaro kwayo? Ibiro miyigo. En angʼo mikwayo? Kata obed nus mar pinya to oyieni mondo ikawe.”
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nodok mochopo nyaka Jordan. Nonwangʼo ka jo-Juda osebiro Gilgal mondo gidhi giromne ruoth kendo gingʼad kode aora Jordan.
english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo pod gichomo wengegi e polo, ka gingʼiyo kaka odhi, apoya nono, negipo ka ji ariyo morwako lewni marochere ochungʼ bathgi.
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

kikuyu: Rang piny gie polo ka in e komi mar duongʼ, maler kendo man-gi teko? Ere hera matut gi teko misebedogo kodwa cha? Ngʼwono kod hoch mari isetuonowa.
english: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

kikuyu: Kara koro dhiuru mana nyime gi chopo okangʼ mar richo mane kwereu ochako!
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo mangʼeny Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Dhi sani Perath kendo ikaw kamba mane anyisi ni ipand kanyo.”
english: After many days, the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”

kikuyu: “Nyasaye mane ochweyo piny kaachiel gi gik moko duto manie iye en Ruodh polo gi piny, kendo ok odak ei hekalu ma oger gi lwet dhano,
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

kikuyu: Koa yo wuok chiengʼ nakel winyo mager, koa e piny mabor anakel ngʼato machopo dwarona. Gima asewacho nyaka chop kare, gima asechano ema abiro timo.
english: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.

kikuyu: Nikech nying Kristo ema nomiyo giwuok gidhi adhiya, ka ok giyie kawo mich moro amora kuom jopiny.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Yawuot Uziel ne gin: Mishael, Elzafan kod Sithri.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

kikuyu: Donge ibiro ngʼadonegi bura? Donge ibiro ngʼadonegi bura, wuod dhano? Ka en kamano, to mi gingʼe timbe mamono mag kweregi
english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

kikuyu: To nitie jo-Yahudi moko ma iseketo jorit e migepe mopogore opogore e piny Babulon ma gin Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego, motamore timo gima iwacho, yaye ruoth. Gin ok giti ne nyisechegi, to bende ok gilam kido mar dhahabu misechungo.”
english: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, and don’t worship the golden image which you have set up.”

kikuyu: Ne opidho achiel kuom nyithinde mi odoko sibuor maratego. Ne opuonjore mako le kendo odoko jacham ji.
english: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

kikuyu: Nimar chandruok opongʼo chunya kendo ngimana sudo machiegni gi liel.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye, nimar ober; herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: To nodhi nyime koyalo e sinagoke mag Judea.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

kikuyu: “Ne wayudo ka dhout od twech olor matek, kendo ka jorito ochungʼ e dhoudi; to kane wayawo dhoudigo, to ne ok wayudo ngʼato ei od twech.”
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

kikuyu: To e kinde, ma malaika mar abiriyono nogo turumbetene, eka wach mopondo mar Nyasaye nochopi, mana kaka nonyiso jotichne ma jonabi.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Omiyo noketogi gi tich matek mohewogi mine gigore piny kendo onge ngʼama ne nyalo konyogi.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

kikuyu: In ema wenge ji duto ngʼiyi, kendo imiyogi chiembgi e kinde mowinjore.
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Eka wasika none gima otimore mi ginipongʼ gi wichkuot, gin mane giwacho niya, “Ere Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachino?” Wangʼa none koselogi; kata mana sani ibiro nyon-gi piny, mana kaka chwodho inyono e yore manie dala.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Seche ma joma ochaya kendo yanya dirona weche, nikech jasigu oramo ni nyaka ochul kuor.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata madichwo ma jaodgi jodolo oyiene chame, to nyaka chame mana e kama ler mar lemo mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye, nikech en gima ler moloyo.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Weche duto mag ruoth gi tekone kod timbene madongo kaachiel gi duongʼ mane omiyo Modekai ondiki e kitabu mag loch mag ruodhi Media gi Pasia.
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

kikuyu: kendo norito piny kuom higni adek kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Maaka nyar Abishalom.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

kikuyu: Pi wangʼa mol ka aora nikech joga osenegi.
english: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

kikuyu: Bende wadwokone Nyasaye erokamano kinde duto nikech kane wakelonu Wach Nyasaye, to nuwinje murwake, ok ka wach dhano, to nurwake ka Wach Nyasaye adier mana kaka en. Wachno koro chopo dwaro Nyasaye e ngimau, un joma oyie.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

kikuyu: Jowetena, Nyasaye noluongou mondo ubed thuolo. To kik uti gi thuolo ma un-go mondo utim timbe maricho ma ringreu gombo timo. Kar timo kamano, to ngʼato ka ngʼato onego kony nyawadgi kuom hera.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka en nyarwath ema utimogo ne Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep, kata misango mar sawo, kaka singruok mowal kata chiwo mar lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye,
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,

kikuyu: Eka Memukan nodwoko wach e nyim ruoth gi jotelo niya, “Vashti mikach ruoth osetimo tim marach ne jotelo gi ji duto man e gwenge man e bwo loch ruoth Ahasuerus.
english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat koro ne nigi mwandu mangʼeny kod huma malach, bende notimo winjruok gi Ahab kuom kend.
english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu dhi Jerusalem, nokawo jopuonjre apar gariyo otero tenge kendo nowachonegi niya,
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

kikuyu: Omiyo jatijeno noketo lwete e kind em ruodhe Ibrahim kendo notimo singruok kode e wachni.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

kikuyu: Ok en gima yot mondo ngʼato otho ni ngʼat makare; dipo nono ngʼato ditho ni ngʼat maber.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

kikuyu: Nyakwar Harun moro amora madichwo nyalo chame. Ma en migapgi mapile pile mar misengini miwangʼo ne Jehova Nyasaye gi mach kuom tiengʼ ka tiengʼ mabiro. Gimoro amora morere kuome nodok maler.’ ”
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

kikuyu: Tiende angʼwen-go ne nitie e bwo bepego kendo kama tielogo ne lworore notudi e rachungi.
english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

kikuyu: kendo ka oganda duto nowinjo ni Harun osetho, to jo-Israel noywage kuom ndalo piero adek.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

kikuyu: “Napenje ni, ‘In nyar ngʼa?’ “En to nodwoka ni, ‘An nyar Bethuel, wuod Nahor gi Milka.’ “Eka ne aketo tere e ume gi bangli e lwete,
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

kikuyu: “Kwauru to nomiu; dwaruru to unuyudi; kendo dwongʼuru to noyawnu dhoot.
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

kikuyu: Laban nowacho niya, “Ber mondo amiyi godo moloyo chiwe ni jomoko. Koro dag mana koda ka.”
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ goyone oganda oriti, noidho modhi e bath got malo mondo olem.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: To ngʼat mogen loso weche mabeyo kendo kuom timbe makare miyo ochungʼ motegno.
english: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.

kikuyu: mondo chiwo mari obed malingʼ-lingʼ. Eka Wuonu maneno gima ochiw lingʼ-lingʼ nomiyi pokni.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: Joma ne ok otho to tuo buche nomako kendo ywak mar dala maduongʼno nochopo nyaka e polo.
english: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

kikuyu: Omiyo nowachone jo-Peniel niya, “Ka aduogo gi loch, to abiro muko bath ohinga moger motingʼore gi malo.”
english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nopenjo niya, “Jaduongʼ, Wuod Dhano to en ngʼa? Nyisago mondo ayie kuome.”
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni joma timbegi richo nyalo timo richo mathoth, to pod ginyalo dak kuom kinde mangʼeny, to gima angʼeyo en ni joma oluoro Nyasaye to biro dhi maber e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

kikuyu: nikech richo mane Jeroboam otimo kendo mane omiyo Israel otimo, kendo nikech nomiyo Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel obedo gi mirima.
english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.

kikuyu: Kaw wechegi kendo uduog ir Jehova Nyasaye! Wachne kama: “Wenwa richowa duto, kendo yie irwakwa gi ngʼwono, mi wanapaki gi dhowa.
english: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

kikuyu: E dhorangaye noketie jakwecho miluongoni Lazaro, ma adhonde nopongʼo dende
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

kikuyu: kendo ngʼama ngima moyie kuoma ok notho ngangʼ. Bende iyie gi wachni?”
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

kikuyu: Jolweny magi, yaye Teman, biro bedo kod bwok kendo ji duto modak, e gode mag Esau ibiro negi.
english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

kikuyu: kendo nowacho ne Musa niya, “Yaye, ruodha, kik iwe wachul gowi mar richo kata obedo ni wasetimo gima ofuwoni.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jafeth ne gin: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek kod Tiras.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: To e ngʼwono mari makende ne ok itiekogi chuth bende ne ok ijwangʼogi, nikech in Nyasaye ma jangʼwono kendo makecho joge.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

kikuyu: Nodwoko kowacho niya, “Nikech un gi yie matin nono. Awachonu adier ni ka un gi yie matin marom gi koth karadali to unyalo wacho ne godni ni, ‘Wuogi ia ka idhi kacha,’ kendo dowuogi modhi. Onge gima nyalo tamou. [
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

kikuyu: Jerusalem osetimo richo madongo omiyo koro osebedo mochido. Ji duto mane omiye luor koro ochaye, nimar giseneno duge; kendo koro oywak kochur nikech wiye kuot.
english: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negibet kode piny e lowo kuom ndalo abiriyo odiechiengʼ gotieno. Onge ngʼama nowachone wach moro amora, nikech negineno ka chandruok mane en-go ne pek moloyo.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

kikuyu: Kik ukel sitadi mar jachode madhako kata madichwo e od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mondo ochul nengo mar kwongʼruok nimar gik moko ariyogo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mon godo.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Ne gilonyo lepe kendo ne girwakone kandho makwar,
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

kikuyu: Noyudo ka koro Isaka oa Beer-Lahai-Roi, nikech noyudo odak Negev.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

kikuyu: Magi duto gin mana tipo mag gik mane onego obi, to adiera wuon yudore kuom Kristo.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

kikuyu: Pendi ogomo ka wend agwata, ma divai moru maber ok rumie. Nungoni chalo pidh ngano mochok kaachiel, ma ondanyo olworo koni gi koni.
english: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.

kikuyu: Jodolo kaachiel gi jo-Lawi manodak kuonde mopogore opogore mag jo-Israel noriwe lwedo.
english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

kikuyu: Noluongo jonabi kod jo-Lawi mondo ochokre e laru ma yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

kikuyu: To ka joote Paulo gi Barnaba nowinjo wachno, ne giyiecho lepgi mi giringo matek ka gichomo ogandano, ka gikok niya,
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

kikuyu: To jowasiki mangʼeny nochal gi buru mayom, kendo oganda mager nochal gi mihudhwe ma yamo tero. Apoya nono, ka diemo wangʼ,
english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

kikuyu: Abiro timo kodi singruok mar kend e yo mar adiera, kendo ibiro yie kuom Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.

kikuyu: Jotich Isaka nokunyo holo kendo negiyudo soko man-gi pi machwer maliw.
english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼato mongʼeyo odiechiengno kata sa, obed malaike manie polo kata Wuowi, makmana Wuoro kende.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka jogi bende chalo. Lek ma gileko dwanyo ringregi kendo jogi odagi teko ma Ruoth nigo kendo giwuoyo marach kuom joma nigi duongʼ e polo.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

kikuyu: To kaka Yesu nongʼeyo gik moko duto mane biro timorene, nowuok oko mopenjogi niya, “En ngʼa mudwaro?”
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

kikuyu: To koro owetewa, kuom wach biro mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo kendo kaka ibiro chokowa kanyakla mondo waromne,
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

kikuyu: Ibiro bedo gi chak mangʼeny mar diek ma ibiro pidhorigo gi joodi kendo pidho nyiri matiyoni.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

kikuyu: “ ‘To ka ngʼat monekono owuok oko mar dala mar tony mane odhiyoe,
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

kikuyu: E higano kik uka orowe kata kik upon mzabibu monyak kendgi e yien mane ok uloso, nikech en higa ma piny yweyoe.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

kikuyu: Kane wawinjo wachno, wan kaachiel gi ji duto, ne wasayo Paulo mondo kik odhi Jerusalem.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jotham nonindo moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Kendo Ahaz ma wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, oweteni, ma gin oweteni mahie kendo ma wedeni moa e rembu kod dhood Israel duto, ema jo-Jerusalem osewuoyo kuomgi kawacho ni, ‘Gisedhi mabor gi Jehova Nyasaye, kendo lopni osemiwa kaka girkeni marwa.’
english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

kikuyu: Dhako to ne owachone niya, “Anamedni rem malich e kindeni mag nywol; adier ininywol nyithindo gi rem. Dwaroni nobed mana kuom chwori bende enobed gi teko kuomi.”
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

kikuyu: Twegi e lith lweti kendo ndikgi e chunyi maiye.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Daudi nopogogi e migepe kaluwore kaka nopognigi tich kikonye gi Zadok ma nyakwar Eliazar kod Ahimelek ma nyakwar Ithamar.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

kikuyu: Bende ka dhako nigi dichwo ma ok oyie, to dichwono oyie dak kode kaka chiege, to kik oweye.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowacho ni dhakoni niya, “Dhi dala, kendo abiro golo chik e wachnino.”
english: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

kikuyu: Abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye mangʼadona rieko; kata gotieno chunya puonja.
english: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Ruodhwa, mano kaka nyingi nigi duongʼ e piny duto!
english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

kikuyu: Jakobo nodwoko Laban niya, “Ne aluor nikech nyo aparo ni dipo ka imaya nyigi githuon.
english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Juda duto nokawo Uzia mane ja-higni apar gauchiel kendo negikete ruoth kar wuon mare Amazia.
english: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo koro ruodha, Jehova Nyasaye oseriti mondo kik ichwer remo kendo mondo kik ichul kuor gi lweti to akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kendo gi in iwuon ni mad wasiki kod ji duto machano timoni marach ochal gi Nabal.
english: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD lives and as your soul lives, since the LORD has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.

kikuyu: Ngʼat molocho bende norwakre gi lewni marochere kaka gin, bende ok naruch nyinge e kitap ngima, to abiro hulo nyinge e nyim Wuora gi Malaike mage.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho ni Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Donge an ema nagolo chik mondo okwan joma nyalo dhi e lweny? An ma an jakwath ema asetimo richo kendo aseketho. Magi to gin mana rombe, angʼo magiseketho? Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha, akwayi ni an ema ikuma kaachiel gi joga to kik iwe masira odongʼ kuom jogi.”
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo obadho oluori moketi diere kendo masira mabiro apoya ochomi.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye nokawo lowo ma ochweyogo le mae thim kod winy duto mafuyo e kor polo. Eka nokelogi ne Adam mondo ochakgi nying kendo nying mane Adam omiyo gik mangimago ema nobedo nying-gi.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

kikuyu: Johala kod joma hono gik mopogore opogore nobiro dichiel kata diriyo mobuoro but Jerusalem.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

kikuyu: Jatingʼ gige lwenje nodwoke niya, “Tim atima gima ni e chunyi nikech an chunya gi pacha ni kodi.”
english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

kikuyu: Eka loch, gi teko kod duongʼ mag pinjeruodhi manie bwo polo noket e lwet jo-Nyasaye, ma gin jo-Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo. Pinyruodhe nobed pinyruoth mochwere, kendo ruodhi duto nolame kendo miye luor.’
english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’

kikuyu: To un bende nyaka utim nenda, nimar usebedo koda nyaka ne achak lando Injilini.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

kikuyu: mondo kik winjruok bed maonge e ringruok; to mondo fuon ka fuon orit nyawadgi kaka dwarore.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

kikuyu: gi tere mag lwedo gi mag um,
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

kikuyu: Ne gilose kaka ichano dhahabu kod chumbe molworore ariyo mag dhahabu mi gitweyo chumbe molwororego e riak law mar law akor.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Omiyo Zakayo nolor mapiyo kendo norwake gi mor e ode.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osechier oa kuom joma otho, ne ok onene gi ji duto, makmana joneno ma Nyasaye noseyiero, ma gin wan mane wachiemo kendo wametho kode.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

kikuyu: Inichan kendo nyako mihero, to ngʼat moro nono ema nokawe mabed kode. Iniger ot to ok inidagie, kendo inipidh mzabibu to ok inicham gik monyak kuomgi.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nokawo gwengʼno duto kaachiel gi piny manie got ma en Negev, e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, to gi kuonde mag pewe kaachiel gi ruodhigi duto. Onge joma notony. Notieko jogo duto mangima, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nosechiko.
english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded.

kikuyu: To bangʼ ka higni alufu achiel oserumo, Satan nogony mobed thuolo koa e bur mane otweye,
english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

kikuyu: kendo abiro kumo jo-Moab gi kum. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
english: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Abiro ketho kido mopa mau kod kite mulamo manie dieru. Ok unuchak ukulru piny ne gik ma lwetu oloso.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobirona, kawacho niya,
english: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Anabed mamon kode mi akete kaka ranyisi misiemogo joma ochaya. Abiro ngʼado kare oko e dier joga. Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Bethe kendo mar misango duto koni gi koni romre: borne gi lachne en fut apar gaboro.
english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Ne, aketo kidi machwanyo ji e Sayun kendo lwanda mamiyo gipodho, kendo ngʼat moyie kuome ok none wichkuot.”
english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Ne ochiewo gokinyi kendo nochungʼ e bath yo mochiko dhoranga dala maduongʼ. E kinde duto mane ngʼato angʼata obiro man-gi wach modwaro mondo ruoth ongʼadnee rieko, Abisalom ne luonge kapenje niya, “Ia e dala mane?” To nodwoke niya, “Jatichni oa e achiel kuom dhout Israel.”
english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

kikuyu: Kendo nogor kerubi gi yiende mag othith e dhoudi mag hekalu ma oko, machal gi mago mane ni e kor udi, kendo ne nitie sandug bao molier e gama mar hekalu.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

kikuyu: En ngʼatno e dieru moluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo mako weche jatichne? Weuru ngʼat mawuotho e mudho kaonge ler ogen kuom nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo osud machiegni gi Nyasache.
english: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.

kikuyu: Ne uterone ruoth Molek mo zeituni kod modhi moko mangʼwe ngʼar. Ne uoro jombetre mau e piny mabor; to gikone ne utundo mana e tho owuon!
english: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Udwaro ni atimnu angʼo?”
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ligangla notiek jo-Babulon! Notiek jogo modak Babulon kendo notiek jotende kod joge mariek!
english: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says the LORD, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ne jo-Israel niya, “Winjuru, Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero Bezalel wuod Uri, ma wuod Hur, maa e dhood Juda,
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: Yawuowi matindo mag Heliopolis gi Bubastis notieki gi ligangla, kendo mier madongo nomaki ma ter e twech.
english: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.

kikuyu: nikech kindeno noyudo ka Lawi pok onywol, to kata kamano wanyalo wacho nine en ei ringre Ibrahim kwar mare kane Melkizedek oromo gi Ibrahim.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

kikuyu: Ok onyal tony mowuogi e mudho; nikech okane ne ligangla.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nodhi nyime gi yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Gath Hefer kod Eth Kazin; bangʼe nowuok oko e Rimon mi ogomo yo Nea.
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

kikuyu: Ok en gima owinjore mondo ngʼat mofuwo odagi e ber, to en gima rach machalo nadi ka misumba ema omi loch kuom yawuot ruoth!
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

kikuyu: Agoyonu erokamano nikech usiko upara e yore duto, kendo nikech umako puonj duto mane amiyou.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

kikuyu: nikech ngʼato angʼata mosetho osegony kuom richo.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

kikuyu: kendo nogwedho Abram kowacho niya, “Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, Jachwech polo kod piny ogwedhi, in Abram.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

kikuyu: wuod Joshua, wuod Eliezer, wuod Jorim, wuod Mathat, wuod Lawi,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

kikuyu: Nikech joma timbegi richo osechako ywayo atungegi; gisechano asernigi e tonde mag atungʼ, mondo gichielgo joma jo-adiera e chunygi.
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Kinyne, Musa nobet e kome mondo obed jangʼad bura ne ogandano, kendo negichungʼ ka gilwore chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

kikuyu: “Winjuru ngero machielo. Ne nitie wuon puodho moro mane opidho mzabibu e puothe. Nochiele gi ohinga, mi okunyo bugo mibiyoe olemo mochiek e iye, kendo ogero ne osuch ngʼicho. Eka ne oketo puothe mar mzabibuno e lwet jopur moko, bangʼe nowuok odhi e wuoth moro mabor.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Ka udonjo e piny ma ruoth ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, mi ukawe kendo udakie ma uwacho niya, “We waket ruodhwa mana kaka ogendini moluorowa,”
english: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

kikuyu: Piny noyuso kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar angʼwen.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

kikuyu: oreso ngimani kogolo e bur matut kendo osidhi gihera kod kech,
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

kikuyu: ka dine bed ni Jehova Nyasaye ok jakorwa kane ji omonjowa,
english: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

kikuyu: Kuom mano jiwreuru kendo gerreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato mana kaka utimono.
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nowacho ne Simeon gi Lawi niya, “Usekelona chandruok maduongʼ ka umiya nying marach e kind jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi, ma weg pinyni. Wan ji manok, kendo kagiriworenwa mondo giked kodwa e lweny, to an kod oda ibiro tieka.”
english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

kikuyu: Eka nogo milome e Juda kod Jerusalem ni jogo duto mane oa e twech mondo ochokre Jerusalem.
english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

kikuyu: Nimar onge pogruok e kind jo-Yahudi gi joma ok jo-Yahudi; Ruoth Yesu en Ruoth machalre ni ji duto, kendo en gi mwandu mogundho mopogo ni ji duto maluongo nyinge,
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

kikuyu: Bende asekwayoue mondo umiyae kony moro mugolo kuom mwandu mondo akonyrago,
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

kikuyu: Sa moro ginikel kwayogi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo giduto gilokre giwe yoregi mamono, nimar ich wangʼ gi mirima mikelone jogi gi Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ.”
english: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will each return from his evil way; for the LORD has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”

kikuyu: Kane Shela ja-higni piero adek, nonywolo Eber.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: “Neuru ni ok uchayo achiel kuom jomatindogi. Nimar anyisou ni malaikegi manie polo osiko ka ngʼiyo wangʼ Wuora manie polo. [
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Chokuru ji kanyakla, pwodhuru chokruok mar oganda, chokuru jodongo kaachiel, keluru nyithindo kaachiel, koda nyithindo madhodho thuno. Wuowi monyombo machiegni mondo owuogi oa e ode, kendo miaha mondo owuogi oa kachiena.
english: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.

kikuyu: To en nochako kwongʼore mowachonegi koramo niya, “Ok angʼeyo ngʼat muwuoyo kuomeno.”
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

kikuyu: Oonge gi nyithinde kata nyikwaye e dier ogandane, kata ngʼama nodongʼ kama yande odakie.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

kikuyu: Gotieno Abram nopogo jotichnego e migepe mondo omonj ruodhigo kendo negiriembogi mi gilawogi nyaka Hoba, ma yo nyandwat mar Damaski.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

kikuyu: Omiyo odiechiengno Musa nokwongʼorena ni, ‘E pinyno matiendi osenyono biro bedo girkeni magi kendo gi nyithindi nyaka chiengʼ, nikech useluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha gi chunyu duto.’
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’

kikuyu: Mad ruch kargi oko e kitap joma ngima kendo kik kwan-gi kaachiel gi joma kare.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

kikuyu: Bende koa e dhood Dan nomigi Elteke, Gibethon,
english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Kane wasechopo e lowo motwo ka wangima, ne wayudo ni chulano iluongo ni Malta.
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

kikuyu: Abiro oro kech malit e diergi, gi kute machamo piny kod masira, gi ondiegi mangemo mag bungu gi thuonde man-gi kwiri mager mamol e lowo.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maluwe ne en Eliazar wuod Dodai ma ja-Ahohi. Kaka achiel kuom thuondi adek, ne en gi Daudi kane gijaro jo-Filistia mano chokore Pas Damim ne lweny. Eka jolwenj Israel noringo,
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

kikuyu: Yawuot Zera ne gin: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol kod Darda, ma gin yawuowi abich koriwore duto.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

kikuyu: Emomiyo aikora mar miyou gik moko duto ma an-go, koda ka ngimana bende, mondo akonyu. Ka an aherou malach kamano, koro un onego uhera matin adier?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

kikuyu: Farao nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wuogi ia e nyima! Ne ni ok ichako ibiro e nyima kendo! Nimar odiechiengʼ ma inine wangʼa kendo to ibiro tho!”
english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

kikuyu: mondo mi, “ ‘gisik ka gingʼicho to ok ginine gimoro, kendo gisik ka giwinjo weche miwacho to wach ok nodonjnegi; nimar dipo ka gilokore mi owenegi richogi!’”
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

kikuyu: Mor polo mari nowinji ei yamo mager, mil polo mari nomenyo piny duto, kendo piny notetni kendo oyiengni.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

kikuyu: Nyako moro amora ma oyudo pok mar lowo kaka girkeni e dhood Israel moro amora nyaka nyuom gi ngʼato moa e dhood wuon mare, mondo omi ja-Israel moro amora oyud pok mar wuon mare.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

kikuyu: Negilworo dalano amingʼa ma kech maduongʼ mane omako Samaria nomedore ma wi punda ne ingʼiewo gi fedha ma pekne romo kilo achiel, to ondongʼ mar owuoch akuru ningʼiewo gi fedha ma pekne romo achiel kuom apar mar kilo.
english: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka jadolo mowal oketho mi omiyo joga obedo mogak, to ochune ni nyaka ochiw ni Jehova Nyasaye nyarwath maonge songa kendo otim-go misango mar golo richo, ne richo mosetimono.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Negirwako weche Gamaliel, omiyo negiluongo joote irgi mi gigolo chik mondo ochwadgi. Eka negisiemogi matek ni kik giwuo kuom nying Yesu, bangʼe ne giweyogi gidhi.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

kikuyu: Joshua nodwokogi niya, “To ka usenyaa ahinya kamano kendo piny gode mag Efraim koro tinnu, kare koro dhiuru e bungu manie piny jo-Perizi kod jo-Refai mondo ubet kanyo obed maru.”
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

kikuyu: Askeche bende nobiro mojare. Negimiye kongʼo makech
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

kikuyu: To Zerubabel, Jeshua kod jotend anywola duto mag Israel nodwokogi niya, “Ok un e achiel kodwa e gero hekalu ne Nyasachwa. Wan kendwa wabiro gedo ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mana kaka Ruoth Sairas, ma ruodh Pasia, nochikowa.”
english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

kikuyu: Kik uchame gi makati moketie thowi, to kuom ndalo abiriyo cham makati motedi ma ok oketie thowi, makati mar lit, nikech ne uwuok Misri apoya nono; mondo ndalo duto mag ngimau ubed kuparo ndalo mane uwuok Misri.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Ji nochamo makati mar malaike, kendo nooronegi kit chiemo duto mane ginyalo chamo.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

kikuyu: Kendo kanyo ema ne anyisue gik moko duto mane onego utim.
english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

kikuyu: Mano kaka odiechiengʼno nobed malich! Onge manochal kode. Enobed kinde mag chandruok ne Jakobo, to norese.’ ”
english: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it! It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.

kikuyu: Ndik ywak ma aywakgo kwan pi wangʼa machwer e kitapi, donge iketogi e kitabu mari?
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

kikuyu: Nyikwa Delaya, Tobia kod Nekoda noromo ji mia auchiel gi piero abich gariyo (652).
english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno anapand wangʼa nikech timbegi mamono ma gisebedo ka gitimo mar lamo nyiseche mamoko.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

kikuyu: Otimo gik madongo miwuoro ma rieko dhano ok chopie honni mage thoth ma ok nyal kwan.
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

kikuyu: To ka Kristo pok ochier, to yie maru en nono; kendo pod ulal alala e richou.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

kikuyu: Bende dima jolweny maroteke gik ma giseyako, koso dires joma otwe e lwet ngʼama kwiny?
english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno oganda maduongʼ kolwore, nogolo chik mondo gingʼad nam gidhi loka nam komachielo.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

kikuyu: To in nyiergi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, go siboi ne ogendinigo duto.
english: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kikuyu: Polo biro bedo janeno kuom timbene mamono duto; to piny nongʼadne bura.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

kikuyu: Kar mula anakelni dhahabu kendo fedha kar nyinyo. Kar yien anakel mula kendo nyinyo kar kite. Kwe ema nobed jaritni kendo tim makare ema notelni.
english: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

kikuyu: Abiro loko odi kaka mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat gi kaka mar Baasha wuod Ahija nikech isemiya mirima kendo isemiyo Israel otimo richo.”
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu omedo tongʼ mar pinyu, kaka nosingore kokwongʼore ni kwereu, ni obiro miyou pinyni duto kaka nosingorenegi,
english: If the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

kikuyu: Koro Elisha nowachone dhako mane ochiero wuode niya, “Wuogi idhi mabor gi joodi kuma inyalo dake bangʼ ndalo moko, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osekelo kech ma biro tieko higni abiriyo.”
english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for the LORD has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

kikuyu: E gik moko duto noluwo yore Asa wuon mare kendo ne ok oweyogi, nimar notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. To kata kamano kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo ne ok omuki kendo ji nodhi nyime mana gi chiwo misengini kendo wangʼo ubani.
english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane opuonjo, jo-Farisai gi jopuonj chik, mane oa e mier duto mag Galili gi Judea kod Jerusalem, nobedo kanyono, to teko mar Ruoth ne ni kode mondo ochang jotuo.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

kikuyu: “Anawangʼ ohingini mag Damaski; notiek kuonde mochiel motegno mag Ben-Hadad.”
english: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”

kikuyu: Ka Daniel nowinjo tiend gima ne timore, nodhi nyaka e nyim ruoth mokwaye mondo omede thuolo, eka obed gi nyalo mar lokone tiend lekne.
english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

kikuyu: mana kaka mach wangʼo yugi kendo yienyo pi, lor piny mondo wasiki ongʼe ni intie, kendo imi ogendini otetni e nyimi!
english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

kikuyu: Wuode manokaw kare kaka jadolo mowal ema nolos misangono. Nyaka wangʼe pep nimar en migawo mapile pile mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ji ne manyowa kamoro amora mawaluwo, omiyo ne ok wanyal wuotho e wangʼ yorewa. Luoro nomakowa nikech ndalowa nosechopo machiegni kendo thowa ne osekayo.
english: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne angʼicho mi aneno dhoot moyaw e polo. To dwol machalo gi turumbete mane asewinjo mokwongo kawuoyo koda cha nowachona niya, “Bi malo ka mondo anyisi gik mabiro timore bangʼ wechegi.”
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

kikuyu: to lwet Jehova Nyasaye biro kelo tho ne jamni mantiere lek kaka fareseni kod pundeni, ngamia magi kaachiel gi dhogi, rombegi kod dieki.
english: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

kikuyu: Yawuot Javan ne gin: Elisha, Tarshish, jo-Kitim kod jo-Rodan.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

kikuyu: Zadok, ma en wuowi mathuon ne nigi jotelo piero ariyo gariyo moa e anywolane;
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa norieyo bade kochomo polo kendo mudho mandiwa nokwako piny Misri duto kuom ndalo adek.
english: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

kikuyu: En ema mwandu duto mag rieko kod ngʼeyo Nyasaye opando kuome.
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat moyud giketho onego chwadi, to jangʼad bura nowachne mondo onind piny ochwade maromre gi kethoneno,
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

kikuyu: ma e ngʼama nodagi kuonde motingʼore gi malo, ma kare mar pondo nobedi got mochiel gohinga motegno. Chiembe ibiro chiw, kendo pi ok nodwon-ne.
english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

kikuyu: Petro nowachone Yesu niya, “Ruoth, bedowa kae en gima ber. Ka iyiena to abiro gero kiru adek kae; achiel mari, achiel mar Musa to machielo mar Elija.”
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Eka odok kendo oomo jochiende abiriyo mamoko maricho moloye, kendo gibiro gidonj mi gidag kanyo. Bangʼe achien ngima ngʼatno bedo marach moloyo kaka nochal mokwongo. Kamano e kaka biro timore ne tiengʼ marachni.”
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

kikuyu: En owuon notingʼo richowa e ringre kane otho e msalaba mondo eka wan wadok joma otho ne richo, to wabed mangima ne timbe makare; kuom moriemo mage ema osechangu.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

kikuyu: Obiro biro gi Onesimo owadwa ma ja-adiera ma jathuru. Gibiro nyisou weche duto matimore ka.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

kikuyu: Jayalo nomenyo mana mondo oyud weche makare, kendo gima nondiko noriere tir kendo adiera.
english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

kikuyu: Bed mabor gi dhako ma kamano, kendo kik idhi machiegni gi dhoode,
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

kikuyu: Achalo gi oguyo ne jo-Efraim, achalo gima otop ne jo-Juda.
english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

kikuyu: Jonywolne ne ok ongʼeyo ni ma en dwaro Jehova Nyasaye, mondo omi giyud thuolo mar kedo gi jo-Filistia; nimar e kindeno jo-Israel ne ni e bwo lochgi.
english: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of the LORD; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

kikuyu: Negiwalo mago mane mag misengini miwangʼo pep ma gimiyo migepe matindo tindo mag ariyo mar anywola mar ji mondo gichiwgi ni Jehova Nyasaye kaka ondiki e kitap Musa. Kamano bende e kaka negitimo kod dhok.
english: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Asaf. Nyasaye osekawo kare e dier chokruok maduongʼ, ongʼado bura e kind “nyiseche.”
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Juda kaluwore gi anywola margi ne gin: koa kuom Shela, joka Shela; koa kuom Perez, joka Perez; koa kuom Zera, joka Zera.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

kikuyu: Chiwnegi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, en angʼo ma dimigi? Migi mana iye magore piny kendo thunde motwo.
english: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel Josef nodhi e od ruodhe mondo otim tije kaka pile kendo ne onge jatich moro amora e ot.
english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

kikuyu: negimiyo nyiego omaka gi gima ok Nyasaye kendo gichwanya kod kido milamo manono. Anami nyiego makgi gi joma ok onego kwan ka ji; anami mirima makgi gi piny maonge winjo.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

kikuyu: Eka ja-Filistiano nowacho niya, “Kawuononi athiano ne jolweny mag Israel! Miyauru ngʼato mondo wakedgo.”
english: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi ir malaikano, mi akwaye mondo omiya kitabu matin-no. To nowachona niya, “Kawe, mondo ichame. Obiro bedo makech e iyi, to e dhogi nobed mamit ka mor kich.”
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

kikuyu: Jakobo nobedoe achiel gi Rael bende kendo nohero Rael moloyo Lea. Kendo notiyone Laban higni abiriyo moko kendo.
english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

kikuyu: “ ‘Omiyo mayeuru talanta-no mondo umi jalno man-gi talanta apar.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ji mangʼeny nochokore mopongʼo ot mane entie maonge kama ilwaroe kata mana kede, koda ka dhoot oko, to Yesu nopuonjogi Wach.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

kikuyu: momiyo achiel kuom adek mar gik mangima manie nam notho, kendo achiel kuom adek mar yiedhi manie nam nokethi.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

kikuyu: “Ero udok e miechu gi mwandu mangʼeny kaka kweth mar jamni mathoth, fedha, dhahabu, mula gi nyinyo, kod lewni mangʼeny kendo neuru ni upogone oweteu gigo mane upeyo kuom wasiku.”
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

kikuyu: Zera ja-Kush nomonjogi kod jolweny mangʼeny kaachiel gi geche mag lweny mia adek manobiro nyaka Maresha.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

kikuyu: E kindeno kuonde duto ma yande nitie mzabibu mangʼeny, maromo pesa mangʼeny nolokre pedo kod kuthe.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

kikuyu: “Beduru motangʼ gosiepeu; kik uket genou kuom oweteu. Nimar oweteu duto jo-miriambo, kendo osiep moro amora jakwoth.
english: “Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer.

kikuyu: Jatend lweny nowachonegi niya, “Wachneuru Hezekia kama: “ ‘Ma e gima ruoth maduongʼ ma ruodh Asuria wacho: En kama nade miketoe genoni momiyo in-gi chir kama?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An bende ok abi nyisou kuma agole teko ma atimogo gigi.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Chuma chalone lum kendo nyinyo chalone yien mosetop.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

kikuyu: Mad chandruok lwor joma ketho nyinga mi ketgi diere; tiekgi, nikech in ja-adiera.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

kikuyu: Otieno gi odiechiengʼ duto ngʼatni ne wuotho e kind liete kendo e gode man machiegni koywagore matek kendo kongʼolore gi kite.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

kikuyu: Kaponi achiel kuom legi otho kendo molwar kuom gimoro amora mwakonyorego pile, to gino koro nobed mogak, bedni en gima olos gi yien, kata en law, kata pien kata ogunia. Gino koro nyaka nyum ei pi kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop seche mag odhiambo, eka bangʼe nobed maler.
english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

kikuyu: Wabiro loyo lweny ka Nyasaye nikodwa, kendo obiro nyono wasikwa piny.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Kaka asechiwo yadh mzabibu e dier yiende mag bungu modoko gima ichwakogo mach, e kaka abiro timo ne joma odak Jerusalem.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: To kuom Israel to owacho niya, “Odiechiengʼ duto aserieyo bedena ne oganda ma ok winj wach kendo ma wigi tek.”
english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ayweyo e lum mangʼich, otelona e aore mokwe,
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo bedo mangima nyaka chiengʼ mak oneno tho? Koso en ngʼa manyalo resore owuon e teko mar liel? Sela
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nogero ohinga ma oko mar Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Gihon manie holo nyaka ochopo kar donjo mar Ranga Rech kendo nolworo got Ofel mogere modhi malo ahinya. Noketo jotend lweny e mier madongo duto mag Juda mochiel motegno gi ohinga.
english: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, jochologo noluoro Nyasaye kendo ne ok gitimo gima ruodh jo-Misri nonyisogi mondo gitim, mine ok ginego nyithindo ma yawuowi.
english: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye kok matek e nyim jolweny mage; jolweny mage ok nyal kwan, joma winje gin joma roteke. Odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ; kendo olich mokadho. En ngʼa manyalo siro odiechiengno?
english: The LORD thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of the LORD is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?

kikuyu: Ne odwaro neno ni Yesu en ngʼa, to nikech ne en nyadundo ne ok onyal, nikech oganda ne ngʼeny.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

kikuyu: “Awachonu adier ni nitie jomoko mochungʼ buta ka ma ok nokal e tho kapok gineno pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Gima ne jo-Israel oneno ne lich mokadho mi Musa nowacho niya, “Luoro omaka.”
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

kikuyu: Kaka un gi buche e kindu kamano, nyiso ni un joma oserem chuth. Kar donjo ne wadu e buch jopiny, to ok iyie otimni atima marach? Ok iweye owuondi awuonda?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

kikuyu: Ka wachwoyo kodhi mar chuny e dieru, to ere rachne ka wakayo kuomu gik mwakonyorego?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Josia nongʼiyo koni gi koni kendo kane oneno liete mane ni e kor godno, nogolo chik mondo ogol choke e lietego kendo owangʼ-gi e kendo mar misango kikethego kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye mane ngʼat Nyasaye okoro chon.
english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the LORD’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

kikuyu: To ka wengeni richo to ringri duto biro pongʼ gi mudho. Omiyo ka ler manie iyi en mudho, to mano kaka en mudho maduongʼ miwuoro!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

kikuyu: kata joma ochungʼ e nyimgi mondo owach ane ketho mane oyudago kane otera e nyim buch Sanhedrin,
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

kikuyu: Rwedhi mangʼeny olwora; rwedhi maroteke moa Bashan olwora koni gi koni.
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

kikuyu: Ne aywak mana ka opija kata ka ongo-wangʼ kendo adengo mana ka akuru. Wengena ne otho bo kane arango polo. An gi chandruok, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, bi iresa!”
english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

kikuyu: Eka Elisha nokone niya, “Luonge.” Omiyo noluonge mochungʼ e wangʼ dhoot.
english: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

kikuyu: To gima nodongʼ kuom chiwo mari mar cham nobed mar Harun gi yawuote, en gima ler moloyo nikech ogole kuom misango miwangʼo gi mach ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: “An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou piny Misri, ka uwuok e piny mane unie wasumbini.
english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Enokaw puotheu mabeyo moloyo gi puotheu mag olembe mag mzabibu gi zeituni mi enomi jotichne.
english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

kikuyu: Jodonge mane onege ne gin Jozabad wuod Shimeath kod Jehozabad wuod Shomer. Notho moike kod kwerene e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi kendo Amazia wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ewi mago duto tingʼuru yie maru ka okumba mugengʼogo aserni makakni ka mach moa kuom ngʼat marach.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

kikuyu: kendo ne oike, bangʼe ochiere oa kuom joma otho chiengʼ mar adek kaluwore gi Ndiko,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Ma e giko mag lamo mag Daudi Wuod Jesse.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Kane otelonegi e thim, to riyo ne ok oloyogi; ee, nomiyo pi owuoknegi e lwanda ka bubni kane obaro lwanda.
english: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.

kikuyu: Ngʼato nochun achiel kuom owetene manie dala wuon-gi kowacho niya, “In ema in-gi lep loch, koro telnwa; kendo ibed gi teko ewi pinywa mokethoreni.”
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

kikuyu: Jotelogo noketo ne Jason gi joge mamoko nengo mar singruok ni ok ginichak gikel koko kendo, bangʼe ne giweyogi gidhi.
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

kikuyu: Ka ikawo law wadu kaka gir singo, to duoknego kapok chiengʼ opodho,
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

kikuyu: Isewinjo wechegi, rang-gi ane duto. Donge ibiro yie kodgi? “Kochakore sani abiro nyisi gik manyien, gik mopondo mapok ingʼeyo.
english: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano wach ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro chokou kagolou e pinje ma osekeyoue, kendo abiro dwogonu piny Israel.’
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

kikuyu: Jakim, Zikri Zabdi,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

kikuyu: Kuom mano ka Nyasaye noketho mier mag pap, noparo Ibrahim kendo nogolo Lut oko mar masirano mane oketho mier mane odakie.
english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

kikuyu: Nokwanyo law mar abola mane olwar koa kuom Elija mi odok kendo ochungʼ e bath aora Jordan.
english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

kikuyu: Ngʼat morwakore gi law mayom mane ni e chuny pi aorano, notingʼo lwete korachwich kod lwete koracham malo kochomo polo, kendo ne awinje kokwongʼore gi Nying Jal Mangima Manyaka Chiengʼ; kowacho niya, “Odongʼ kinde maromo higni adek gi nus kendo ka sand misandogo jo-Nyasaye oserumo to noyud ka gigi duto osetimore.”
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.

kikuyu: Ma e wach Jehova Nyasaye mane omiyo Jeremia e wach oro:
english: This is the LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

kikuyu: Oganda jo-Israel nyaka bed gi chike machalre ne tiengʼ mabiro kod jopinje mamoko; ma en singo mochwere ne tiengʼ mabiro. Un kod jopinje mamoko nubed machalre e nyim Jehova Nyasaye:
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo negidhi. “Nochako owuok oko kar sa auchiel gi sa ochiko kendo notimo kaka notimo mokwongo.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

kikuyu: dhako moro mariek mane ni e dala maduongʼno nokok matek kowacho niya, “Winjuru! Nyisuru Joab obi ka mondo alos kode.”
english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi nochak odok e hekalu, kama ji duto nochokore kolwore, kendo nobet piny mopuonjogi.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

kikuyu: “Eka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nochiwo Sihon kod joge duto e lwet jo-Israel, kendo negiloyogi. Jo-Israel nokawo puothe jo-Amor mane odak e pinyno,
english: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro oro mach mi owangʼ ohinga mag Gaza mochiel motegno.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.

kikuyu: Negiringo ma giome, kane ochungʼ e dier oganda to ne obor ma ji moko ne gik mana e goke.
english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

kikuyu: Omiyo nalokora kendo alor kaa e got mane oyudo wangʼ. Kite mopa ariyo motingʼo winjruok ne nitie e lweta.
english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

kikuyu: Ginywako ne joma kare kendo gingʼadone joma onge ketho buch tho.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

kikuyu: “Winja ruodha; nengo lowono oromo kilo angʼwen gi nus mar fedha. To en angʼo mathagowa; ik ngʼati.”
