english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye miyi koth moa e polo kod piny ma omewo kod cham mogundho, kod divai manyien.
english: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Emomiyo awachonu ni kik uparru kuom ngimau, kata kuom gik ma ubiro chamo, kata kuom dendu, kata gik ma ubiro rwako.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

kikuyu: Dhood Isakar nodag butgi. Jatend dhood Isakar ne en Nethanel wuod Zuar.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Makmana pod uwacho, yaye dhood Israel, ni, ‘Yore Ruoth Nyasaye ok nikare!’ To abiro ngʼado bura ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu kaluwore gi yorene owuon.”
english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Juda osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech gisetamore rito chike Jehova Nyasaye kod buchene, kendo osewuondgi mi gisebaro giluwo bangʼ nyiseche manono mag kweregi,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;

kikuyu: Kendo Finehas wuod Eliazar ma jadolo, nowachone Reuben, Gad kod Manase niya, “Kawuono wangʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye nikodwa, nikech ok usetimo gima Jehova Nyasaye okwero. Kuom mano usereso jo-Israel kuom kum mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD’s hand.”

kikuyu: Ibrahim notingʼo wangʼe mopo koneno im komoko gitungene e bungu. Nodhi mokawo im kendo ochiwo kaka misango miwangʼo pep kar wuode.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ema nodhi kodu mondo okednu kuom wasiku mondo omiu loch.”
english: for the LORD your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

kikuyu: Eka Jesse nokawo punda mokawo makati oketo e ngʼeye, ndede mar divai kod nyadiel mi nooro Daudi ma wuode oterone Saulo.
english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

kikuyu: Nopenja niya, “En angʼo mineno?” Ne adwoke niya, “Kalatas mafuyo e kor yamo, ma borne oromo fut piero ochiko gaboro, to lachne fut piero angʼwen gochiko.”
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

kikuyu: gi joma ni Aroer, Sifmoth gi Eshtemoa,
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel nosudo machiegni gi jo-Benjamin e odiechiengʼ mar ariyo.
english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye noloko kudho mar yamo mi yamb podho chiengʼ nokudho matek, bende yamono nochoko bonyo duto mi otero e Nam Makwar. Onge bonyo moro amora mane odongʼ e piny Misri.
english: The LORD sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

kikuyu: Wenda gi jotichna ma nyiri kwana kaka ngʼat ma gikia; kendo ginena kaka japiny moro.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

kikuyu: kendo ka chunygi olokore e piny mane otergi e twech kendo giweyo richogi kendo gikwayi e piny wasikgi mane otweyogi kagiwacho niya, ‘Wasetimo richo kendo waseketho bende wasetimo mamono;’
english: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

kikuyu: nimar, “Ngʼato ka ngʼato maluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye noresi.”
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe anaduognu jongʼad bura makare kaka ne timore e ndalo machon, kendo jongʼad rieko mane nitie aa chakruok. Eka noluongu ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Tim Makare, Dala Maduongʼ Madiera Nitie.”
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

kikuyu: Elisha noneno mi noywak niya, “Yaye Wuora, aneno geche mag Israel kod joidh farese mag-gi.” Elisha ne ok ochako oneno Elija kendo nokawo lepe owuon moyiecho.
english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

kikuyu: Donge iseketo chiel molwore en kaachiel gi ode kod gik moko duto ma en-go? Donge isegwedho tich lwete, momiyo jambe gi kwethne olak e pinyno duto?
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

kikuyu: Daudi noreso gik moko duto mane jo-Amalek osepeyo kaachiel gi monde ariyo.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

kikuyu: Notimo misengini kendo owangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar e kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo, ewi gode matindo kendo e bwo yiende motimo otiep.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

kikuyu: Jomatindo nyalo bedo mool mi nyosre, kendo yawuowi nyalo chwanyore mi podhi,
english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

kikuyu: Bende koro iniwach ni, “An nyasaye,” ka joma biro negigo ochomi tir? Inibed dhano adhana matho, ma ok nyasaye, e lwet joma negi.
english: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.

kikuyu: Musa noluongo jo-Israel duto ma owachonegi kama: Yaye, jo-Israel winjuru buche kod chike ma awachonu kawuono. Puonjreuru wechego kendo une ni umakogi.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Awachoni adiera, tinendeni ibiro bedo koda e Paradiso.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

kikuyu: Kaka ngʼama ni ei Ruoth Yesu, angʼeyo malongʼo ni onge chiemo ma ok ler kende owuon. To ka ngʼato okawo gimoro ni ok ler, to gino dokone ma ok ler ne en owuon.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

kikuyu: nimar jo-Amalek kod jo-Kanaan noked kodu kuno. Nikech useweyo Jehova Nyasaye, ok enodhi kodu kendo nonegu gi ligangla.”
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”

kikuyu: Bende noluwo puonjgi kane oriwore gi Joram wuod Ahab ruodh Israel mondo giked kod Hazael ruodh Aram e piny Ramoth Gilead. Jo-Aram nohinyo Joram;
english: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ee, ok ahero jonabi ma milo lewgi giwegi kagiwacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye owacho.’ ”
english: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Kagologi gia e twech, joma ni e piny Juda kod dalagi noti gi wechegi kendo ni: ‘Jehova Nyasaye ogwedhu, yaye kar dak maler, yaye got mowal.’
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘The LORD bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’

kikuyu: “Kapo ni wan mwaseyie kuom Kristo mondo oketwa kare ema pod yudore ni wan joricho, to mano dinyis ni Kristo jiwo richo e ngimawa koso? Ok kamano ngangʼ!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

kikuyu: to kata kamano, kowinjo much pi, to oloth, mana ka yien mochako dongo.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato oluongou e nyasi mar kisera to kik ibed e kom moyiedhi, nimar dipo ka ngʼato moro mogen moloyoi oluongi bende.
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

kikuyu: Simon owuon bende noyie, bangʼe noyudo batiso, kendo nosiko koluwo bangʼ Filipo kamoro amora mane odhiye, kowuoro ranyisi madongo kod honni ma noneno ka Filipo timo.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

kikuyu: kendo negiluongo jogwengʼno duto kanyakla e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar ariyo. Ji nonyiso nonro margi kaluwore gi gwengegi kod anywola mag-gi, kendo joma hikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime nondik nying-gi, moro ka moro,
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone niya, “Kaw aserni kendo ruoth nokawo asernigo.” Elisha nokone niya, “Chwo asernigo piny, mine otimo kamano nyadidek bangʼe oweyo.”
english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

kikuyu: Wach nochopo ne Saulo niya, “Daudi ni Nayoth e gwengʼ Rama”
english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”

kikuyu: Baruk nodwoko niya, “En kamano, nowachona wechegi duto to nandikogi, kendo ne andiko gi wino e kitabu.”
english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”

kikuyu: Ne iriembogi gi mahu mana ka gima gin jokwoge.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

kikuyu: We mondo timbegi mamono ochop e nyimi; kendo timnegi, mana kaka isetimona kuom richona duto. An gi pek mangʼeny kendo chunya onyosore.
english: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

kikuyu: Yangʼe kendo ikaw rembe ikir e bethe kendo mar misango koni gi koni.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

kikuyu: “Winjauru, yaye joka Jakobo in Israel ma aseluongo: An e en; an ema okwongo kendo an ema ogik.
english: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.

kikuyu: Wasikgi nothirogi kendo negiketogi e bwo tekogi.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato oelo dho bur kata okunyo moro kendo oweyo dhoge nono mi rwadh pur kata punda onyumoree,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

kikuyu: Omiyo e odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abiriyo, Ezra jadolo nokelo chik e nyim kanyakla mar ji, mane otingʼo chwo kod mon kod jogo duto mane nyalo winjo tiend chike.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

kikuyu: Kane onyis Daudi gima Rizpa nyar Aiya mane en achiel kuom mond Saulo mamoko, nosetimo,
english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi nyaka rangach mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Noidho raidhi mi opimo lach baw mar rangach midonjogo. Nonwangʼo ka lachne ne en fut apar.
english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

kikuyu: kendo Nyasaye ema aketo genona kuome; omiyo ok abi bedo maluor. Dhano adhana to nyalo timona angʼo?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Kendo dhawo nowuok e kind jakwadh Abram kod jokwadh Lut. E kindeno jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi ne pod odak e pinyno.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka udonjo e pinyno kendo upidho kit yiend olemo moro amora to ukwan olembene ka gik makwero. Kuom higni adek kik umul olembego kendo kik uchamgi.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nikech richo adek ma jo-Amon osetimo, kata richo angʼwen, omiyo ok abi weyo ma ok akumogi. Nikech gisenego mine ma yach mag Gilead mondo omi giyar tongʼ mag lopegi,
english: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Bwe nigi buchegi kendo winy mafuyo e kor yamo nigi utegi, to Wuod Dhano onge gi kamoro amora monyalo kete wiye.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Eka Paulo gi Barnaba nomedo wuoyo gi chir kagiwacho niya, “Ne bernwa mondo un ema wayalnu Wach Nyasaye mokwongo. To nikech udage kendo nikech ok ukwanoru ka joma owinjore yudo ngima mochwere, koro waweyou mondo wayal wachni ni joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

kikuyu: To ajuoke bende notimo mana kamano gi tijegi mochido kendo negimiyo ogwende owuok e piny Misri.
english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Magi e nyithindo mane Zilpa, jatich mane Laban omiyo nyare Lea onywolo ne Jakobo. Giduto ne gin nyithindo apar gauchiel.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Nyasaye okwero ni mondo kik atim ma! Bende anyalo modho remb jogi mane odhi ome ka gichiwo ngimagi ne wasigu?” Daudi ne ok nyal modho pigno nikech negichiwo ngimagi mondo mi gikelne pi. Gik ma kamago ema ne thuondigi otimo.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kikuyu: usebiro ir Yesu ma en jathek mar singruok manyien, bende usebiro gi remo mokir ma wuoyo kuom gik mabeyo moloyo remb Abel.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

kikuyu: Jehoash ruodh Israel nomako Amazia wuod Joash ma wuod Ahazia, ruodh Juda e Beth Shemesh. Bangʼe Jehoash nokele Jerusalem kendo nomuko ohinga mar Jerusalem chakre e Dhoranga Efraim nyaka kama ohinga ogomogo, bor kama ne omuko ne romo fut mia abich gi piero ochiko gachiel.
english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

kikuyu: Ere kaka anyalo kwongʼo joma Nyasaye pok okwongʼo? Ere kaka anyalo kwedo joma Jehova Nyasaye pok okwedo?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

kikuyu: to oganda nokel thek e kind janekno kod owadgi ngʼat monegi kaluwore gi chik.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

kikuyu: “To in bende, Farao, ibiro turi mi irieri piny kaachiel gi joma ok oter nyangu, kendo gi joma ligangla onego.
english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼatno ma Jehova Nyasaye ok kwan-ne richone, kendo ma wuondruok onge e chunye.
english: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

kikuyu: Ngʼadna bura makare, yaye Nyasaye, kendo chwaka e kind joma ok ongʼeyo Nyasaye; resa e lwet joma wuondore gi joma timbegi richo.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

kikuyu: Nowachone ngʼat machielo niya, “Luwa.” To ngʼatno nodwoko niya, “Ruoth, yiena adhi ayik wuonwa mondi.”
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Gima omiyo lek nobiro ne Farao nyadiriyo en nikech Nyasaye osechano ratiro mar timo kamano. Kendo Nyasaye biro chope mapiyo.
english: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

kikuyu: Yieruru ji adek koa e dhoot ka dhoot. Abiro oorogi mondo gidhi ginon pinyno kendo gindik malongʼo kuom pinyno, kaluwore gi pok mar ngʼato ka ngʼato. Bangʼe, to gidwog ira.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

kikuyu: Donge piny duto ni e lweti? Ber wapogre, kidhi koracham to adhi korachwich; to kidhi korachwich to adhi koracham.”
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

kikuyu: Moloyo mano abiro miyi nyaka mago ma ok ikwayo kaka mwandu kod duongʼ mondo e kinde mag ngimani ok inibed gi ngʼat maromo kodi e kind ruodhi.
english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

kikuyu: Yie koda ka awacho ni an ei Wuora kendo Wuora ni e iya; to ka ok kamano, to yie kuom ranyisi gi honni ma asebedo ka atimo.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

kikuyu: Omiyo negikawo rwath mane omigi mi gilose. Eka negiluongo nying Baal chakre okinyi nyaka odiechiengʼ tir ka gikok niya, “Yaye Baal, dwokwa!” To ne onge dwoko, onge ngʼama nodwoko. Kendo ne gimiel ka gilworo kendo mar misango mane giseloso.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

kikuyu: kendo mane ogolo jo-Israel oko kuomgi, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kane chunye chiegni chot nochako wuodeno ni Ben-Oni. To wuon mare to nochake ni Benjamin.
english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

kikuyu: Daudi riyo noloyo mowacho niya, “Yaye mad ne ngʼato kelnae pi soko man but ranga Bethlehem mondo amodhi!”
english: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

kikuyu: Koa kuom oganda jo-Israel nyaka okaw nywogi ariyo kaka misango mar golo richo kod im mar misango miwangʼo pep.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kitego duto nondikie nying yawuot Israel apar gariyo, ka okedgi kaka kido ka moro ka moro ochungʼ ne nying dhout Israel apar gariyogo.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Balaam nodwoko Balak niya, “Donge ne anyiso joote mane ioro ira niya,
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

kikuyu: Mano timore nikech wan chwech Nyasaye, manochweyo kuom Kristo Yesu mondo otim timbe mabeyo, ma Nyasaye owuon ema nosechano chon mondo watim.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

kikuyu: An Paulo gi Timotheo ma wasumb Kristo Yesu, Wandikonu un jomaler duto mag Kristo Yesu man Filipi, kaachiel gi jokwadh jo-Kristo duto gi jokonygi:
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

kikuyu: “Mad ne ipanda ei liel mondo ne abed maonge nyaka chop mirimbi rum, bangʼe to iket kinde ma ibiro parae kendo!
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

kikuyu: “Tunge apargo mane ineno, gin ruodhi apar mapok oyudo pinyruoth to ibiro miyogi teko mar locho kuom sa achiel kende, kaka ruodhi kaachiel gi ondiek malichno.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

kikuyu: To bende pod usungoru asunga! Donge onego bed ni upongʼ gi kuyo mondo ugol oko ngʼat matimo kamano e dieru?
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

kikuyu: To nokwerogo, kowacho niya, “Dhako, ok angʼeye!”
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

kikuyu: Eka ne oikne geche mar jolweny, bangʼe nokawo jolweny mage.
english: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

kikuyu: Abiro kulora piny ka achomo hekalu mari maler kendo abiro pako nyingi, nikech herani kod adierani, nimar isetingʼo nyingi kod Wachni malo moyombo gik moko duto.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

kikuyu: Nopo koneno soko ei pap kod kweth adek mag rombe konindo machiegni kanyo nikech kwethgo ne modho e sokono. To kidi mane nitie e dho sokono ne duongʼ.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

kikuyu: nowachone niya, “Kiny nawinj wachni ka joma odonjoni ochopo ka.” Eka nogolo chik mondo okan Paulo maber e od bura mane ni e dala Herode.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo negidhi nyime nyaka Beer, ma en soko kama Jehova Nyasaye nonyisoe Musa niya, “Chok ji obed kanyakla kendo abiro miyogi pi.”
english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

kikuyu: To owinjore wandiknegi mondo wanyisgi ni kik gicham chiemo motimgo misango ne nyiseche manono, kik giterre, kik gicham ring jamni mode kendo kik gicham remo.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo podho chiengʼ ywak nowinjore e kind jolweny niya, ngʼato ka ngʼato odog e gwengʼ-gi kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato odog e pinygi.
english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

kikuyu: An-gi rem kendo awinjo marach e chunya; mad warruokni rita, yaye Nyasaye.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

kikuyu: Aywakni, yie ikonya, eka abiro rito chikeni.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Kawauru ubola e nam, eka obiro kwe. Angʼeyo ni kethona emomiyo ahiti maduongʼni osebiro kuomu.”
english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

kikuyu: En owuon ne en kodgi e chokruok mane ni e thim, kaachiel gi kwerewa kod malaika mane owuoyo kode e Got Sinai; kendo ne omiye weche mangima makoro wawinjogi.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

kikuyu: Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo tim maber. Eka inidag e piny kendo inichiem gi mor e lek maber.
english: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

kikuyu: Oreso joma odhier e dho tho; kendo oresogi e lwet joma roteke.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

kikuyu: To gini dwoke ni, ‘Onge tiende. Wanadhi nyime gi chenro magwa wawegi; ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa noluw mana timbe mamono mar chunye marach.’ ”
english: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”

kikuyu: to anyiso hera ni tienge gana gi gana mar jogo mohera kendo morito chikena.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mago ema nobednu chike mosiko e tienge duto, kamoro amora ma unudagie.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Nitie mana kwongʼ, miriambo kod nek, kuo gi chode; kendo giketho singruok duto, kendo chwero remo timore monwore.
english: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nowachone Jehoshafat niya, “Donge nawachoni ni ok okorna gik mabeyo, to okoro mana gik maricho?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

kikuyu: Kane dhakono oneno Samuel noywak gi dwol maduongʼ mowachone Saulo niya, “Angʼo momiyo isewuonda? In Saulo!”
english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

kikuyu: Jakobo noduogo dala ir wuon-gi Isaka Mamre machiegni gi Kiriath Arba (ma tiende ni Hebron), kumane Ibrahim kod Isaka odakie.
english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

kikuyu: Magi e jotelo mane odak Jerusalem mamoko ne gin jo-Israel, jodolo, jo-Lawi, jotij hekalu kod nyikwa jotij Solomon manodak e mier matindo mag Juda, ka moro ka moro e kare owuon e mier matindo mopogore opogore.
english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro kane gisetieko chiemo kod metho kane gin Shilo, Hana nochungʼ malo. Sano noyudo ka Eli ma jadolo obet e kom but dhood hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.

kikuyu: Ka gima ne ngʼato ogero notony ma ok owangʼ e mach, to noyud michne.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo pondo karito joma kare ka gidwaro tieko ngimagi;
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

kikuyu: Musa notimo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone: Negidhi e Got Hor ka oganda duto neno.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

kikuyu: aringo matek mondo achopi mondo omi ayud pokna mane Nyasaye oluongane kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: “Mano ok adiera!” Jeremia nowachone. “Ok aringi adogne jo-Babulon.” To Irija ne ok nyal winje; kuom mano, nomako Jeremia kendo okele ir jotelo.
english: Then Jeremiah said, “That is false! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans.” But he didn’t listen to him; so Irijah seized Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

kikuyu: Bed mokuyo kendo ilingʼ thi, in nyar Babulon; nimar ok nochak oluong ni ruoth madhako mar pinje.
english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.

kikuyu: Kik iwach niya, “Abiro chulo kuor kuom rachni motimna!” Bed kirito Jehova Nyasaye to obiro resi.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

kikuyu: E otieno nogo nyaka gicham ringʼo mobul kaachiel gi alode makech kod makati ma ok oketie thowi.
english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

kikuyu: ginibed andhoke, joma mwomore, josunga, joma ohero mor moloyo Nyasaye,
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

kikuyu: kaachiel gi mon moko mane osegol kuomgi jochiende kendo ochang tuochegi kaka Maria (mane iluongo ni Magdala) mane jochiende abiriyo osewuok kuome;
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

kikuyu: Kik ubed rachwany ni jo-Yahudi, kata ni jo-Yunani, kata ni kanisa Nyasaye,
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

kikuyu: In kare kinde duto, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, sa moro amora makelo bucha e nyimi. To kata kamano we mondo awuoye kodi kuom ngʼado bura mari makare: Ere gima omiyo yore mag joma timbegi mono dhi maber? Angʼo momiyo jogo maonge yie odak maber?
english: You are righteous, LORD, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?

kikuyu: Kochopo giko mar odiechiengegi, kochakore e odiechiengʼ mar aboro, jodolo nyaka chiw misengini magu miwangʼo pep kod misengini magu mag lalruok ewi kendo mar misango. Bangʼe eka anayie kodu, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.”
english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord GOD.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorene gotieno mowacho niya, “Asewinjo lemoni kendo aseyiero hekalu ka kaka kara mitimoe misengini.
english: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

kikuyu: To joma ne luwo Omri ne onyisore ni gin giteko moloyo mago mag Tibni wuod Ginath. Kamano Tibni notho to Omri nodoko ruoth.
english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano mondo kik ngʼato osungre e nyime.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

kikuyu: Ruoth ma joge ngʼeny ema yudo duongʼ, to ruoth maonge jogo morito to podho.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

kikuyu: Abiro rito kama iyoroe aora e thim nyaka ayud wach moa iri kinyisago gima dhi nyime.
english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

kikuyu: Nyithindu munywolo nokwongʼ, kaachiel gi chambu, gi nyiroye mag dhou kod nyithi jambu.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

kikuyu: To ok mano kende, kanisa noyiere mondo odhi kodwa e wuodhwa mar tero chiwo. Tijno watimo mondo wami Ruoth owuon duongʼ kendo mondo ji ongʼe ni waikore konyo.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

kikuyu: Ket ngʼat marach mondo oked kod jasika; we jadonj ne ji mondo ochungʼ kode e bura.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

kikuyu: Yaye dhood joka Harun, genuru kuom Jehova Nyasaye, En e konyruokgi kendo okumbagi.
english: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ochwoyo kuom ringruok, noka kethruok, to ngʼat ma ochwoyo kuom Roho, noka ngima mochwere.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye noketo chuny Farao obedo matek kendo ne ok oyie mondo owegi gidhi.
english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

kikuyu: Gin liel, ich ma ok onywol, lowo ma pi ok rom, kata mach ma ok wach ni, ‘Oromo!’
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Nyiswa ni en teko mane ma itimogo gigi. En ngʼa momiyi teko ma in-goni?”
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

kikuyu: “Moruru gi Jerusalem kendo bed mamor kode, un duto muhere; beduru gi ilo maduongʼ, un duto man-gi kuyo nikech en.
english: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

kikuyu: Ne waneno gi wengewa kaka Jehova Nyasaye notimo honni kod ranyisi madongo ne jo-Misri kod Farao gi ode duto.
english: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

kikuyu: Jo-Madmena ringo; un jo-Gebim ringuru upondi.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

kikuyu: Omiyo un bende beduru abeda mamor mana kaka an bende amor.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

kikuyu: Abiro nyise masiche duto monego one nikech nyinga.”
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

kikuyu: mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato moyie kuome obed gi ngima mochwere.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Nodagi mowacho niya, “Ok nachiem.” To joge noriwore gi dhakono kamedo kwaye, mi nowinjogi. Noa malo e lowo mobet e kom.
english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

kikuyu: Dhoot maduongʼ imi lowo maduongʼ to dhoot matin to imi lowo matin; dhoot ka dhoot mondo oyud pok maromre gi kar kwan-gi.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kikuyu: Nikech pinyruoth Nyasaye ok otenore mana kuom weche miwacho gidhok, to otenore kuom teko maduongʼ.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni chiengʼ ma nolokie gik moko duto manyien, ka Wuod Dhano nobed e kom lochne man-gi duongʼ, un musebedo ka uluwa bende unubed e kombe mag loch apar gariyo, kungʼado bura ne ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Kaka ich wangʼ mara kod mirimba aseolo kuom jogo modak Jerusalem, e kaka mirimba ibiro olo kuomu ka udhi Misri. Inibed gir kwongʼ kendo mabwogo ji, gima ingʼadogo bura kendo gir ajara; ok unuchak une kaeni kendo.’
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you, when you enter into Egypt; and you will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you will see this place no more.’

kikuyu: kama iluongo ni Shilo ei Kanaan mi giwachonegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye nochiko kokalo kuom Musa ni mondo imiwa dalano mondo wadagie, kod kuonde ma jambwa nyalo kwayoe.”
english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne wachopo Jerusalem, kama ne wayweyoe kuom ndalo adek.
english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

kikuyu: Her Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi gi chunyi duto kendo gi paroni duto, gi riekoni duto, kendo gi tekoni duto.’
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

kikuyu: Osiepena mahero, kik uluor ka uyudo sand mawangʼou ka mach kuparo ni gimoro magalagala ema timorenu.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

kikuyu: Kane ogolo jo-Israel owuok e dhood Daudi negikawo Jeroboam wuod Nebat obedo ruodhgi. Jeroboam nowuondo jo-Israel mowuok oweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye, momiyo gitimo richo mamono.
english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

kikuyu: E kinde Ahab, Hiel ja-Bethel nochako gero Jeriko kendo. Noketo misene mi wuode makayo miluongo ni Abiram notho kendo kane oguro dhorangeye to wuode ma chogo miluongo ni Segub bende notho, mana kaka wach Jehova Nyasaye mane owacho gi dho Joshua wuod Nun.
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Eka Mikal nokawo gima opa mopiele e kitanda, moume gi law, bangʼe oketo yie diek moko e wiye.
english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

kikuyu: Omiyo Akish noluongo Daudi mowachone niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, ni isebedo ngʼat migeno kendo daher mondo ibed achiel kuom jolweny maga. Chakre chiengʼ mane ibiroe ira nyaka chil kawuono, pok aneno ketho moro kuomi, kata kamano jotend jo-Filistia ok oyie kodi.
english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As the LORD lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

kikuyu: Abimelek wuod Jerub-Baal nodhi ir owete gi min-gi man Shekem mowuoyo gi owete gi min-gi kod jo-dhood gi min mare duto, kowachonegi niya,
english: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Ngʼadna bura makare, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech e ngimana duto asedak ka aonge ketho; aseketo genona kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma ok adigni.
english: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

kikuyu: Alando tim makare e chokruok maduongʼ; ok aumo dhoga, mana kaka ingʼeyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

kikuyu: Kane gin e yo gidhi, negiromo gi ja-Kurene moro miluongo ni Simon, kendo ne gichune mondo otingʼ msalaba.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

kikuyu: to ka idware ka fedha kendo imanye ka mwandu mopandi,
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

kikuyu: kendo odiechiengʼ mar apar gabiriyo mar dwe mar abiriyo yie nobiro mochungʼ ewi gode mag Ararat.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato achiel kuom jou ogak nikech kothe mar nyodo owuok apoya koleko, to nyaka owuogi oko mar kambi mondo obed kuno.
english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

kikuyu: Omiyo notere e pap mar Zofim mantiere ewi Got Pisga, kendo kanyo nogero kende mag misango abiriyo mi nochiwo misango mar rwath kod im ewi kendo ka kendo.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nosiemo Joshua kawachone niya:
english: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Mana kaka polo manyien machweyo gi piny manyien nosiki e nyima, e kaka nyingi kod nying nyikwayi nosiki.
english: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeftha nodhi gi jodong Gilead, kendo ji nokete obedo jatelo kendo jatend lweny. Kendo nonwoyo wechegi duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kama iluongo ni Mizpa.
english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.

kikuyu: Kapo ni asesando nyithind kiye moko, nikech an gi teko kama ingʼadoe bura,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ kinde manok, chi ruodh Josef norange kagombe kendo nowachone niya, “Bi e kitanda ka mondo iriwri koda.”
english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma lweti oyudo mondo otim, time gi tekri duto, nimar ei bur, kama ibiro idhiyoe, onge tich kata loso chenro kata ngʼeyo kata rieko.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane gisewuok Refidim, negidonjo thim Sinai, kendo Israel nojot e nyim got e thimno.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

kikuyu: En kaachiel gi joma chalo kode noyud wichkuot; kendo jopechogo gin mana dhano adhana. Wegiuru gichokre giduto mondo gichoma tir ane; ka ok giniyud wichkuot maduongʼ.
english: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

kikuyu: Ute kod mwandu gin girkeni miyudo kuom jonywol, to dhako mariek aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

kikuyu: kendo udag e ngima mar hera kaka Kristo ne oherowa mi ochiworenwa kaka chiwo kendo misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamit ni Nyasaye.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel to nokawo jamni gi mwandu mane giyako mar dala maduongʼno mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Joshua.
english: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to the LORD’s word which he commanded Joshua.

kikuyu: Asesingora dichiel kendo mogik kuom ler mara, kendo ok abi riambo ne Daudi,
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo niya, “En ngʼa momula?” Kane giduto gikwero, Petro nowacho niya, “Ruoth, ok ineye kaka ji olwori kendo othungʼi.”
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Dwoko mane ma onego omi joote mag pinyno? “Jehova Nyasaye oseguro Sayun, kendo kuome ema joge man-gi lit noyudie resruok.”
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

kikuyu: “Ngʼato angʼata man oko momulo ngʼatno mane onegi gi ligangla kata ngʼat motho kende, kata ngʼatno momulo chok dhano, kata liel, nobedi mochido kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: Mogik, Daniel nobiro e nyima kendo ne anyise leknano. (Daniel iluongo gi nying nyasacha ni Belteshazar, kendo chuny mar nyiseche maler ni kuome.)
english: But at last, Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,

kikuyu: Wuoda, rit ngʼado bura makare kod pogo tiend wach, kik iwe gilalni.
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

kikuyu: Ka uyie to unuyud gimoro amora mukwayo kulamo.”
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

kikuyu: Nikech nitie Nyasaye achiel kende gi ngʼat achiel ma jathek e kind Nyasaye gi dhano, en e Kristo Yesu mane obiro e kido mar dhano.
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Bangʼ mae gibiro hulo richogi gi richo kweregi mane omiyo giweya kaachiel gi richo mane omiyo gibedo wasika,
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

kikuyu: Sirni mag polo yiengni kendo kokwerogi to gilingʼ thi.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

kikuyu: Omiyo gimoro amora ma iyie e chunyi kuom wechegi ni ber keti obedni malingʼ-lingʼ e kindi gi Nyasaye. Ogwedh ngʼatno ma chunye ok ngʼadne bura kuom gima oparo ni ber.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

kikuyu: Ne giwuok e liete, kendo bangʼ chier mar Yesu, negidonjo ei Dala Maler kendo ne gifwenyore ne ji mangʼeny.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

kikuyu: Dhout jo-Gershon nonego dag yo podho chiengʼ mar kama ler.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

kikuyu: Nimar Ndiko wacho niya, “Dhano duto chalo gi lum kendo duongʼ ma gin-go chalo mana gi maua manie pap; lum ner kendo maua two mi lwar piny,
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

kikuyu: Biuru un le manie thim, biuru mondo utiek gik moko un le mag bungu duto!
english: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa gi yawuote niya,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

kikuyu: “ ‘Japiny moro modak kodu madwaro timo nyasi mar Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye nyaka tim kamano kaluwore gi chikene kod buchene. Nyaka ubed gi chike machalre ne japiny moro kod ngʼat monywol e gwengʼno.’ ”
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

kikuyu: Seraya wuod Hilkia, ma wuod Meshulam, ma wuod Zadok, ma wuod Merayoth, ma wuod Ahitub, mane en jatelo morito od nyasaye,
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

kikuyu: Le duto kod gik moko duto mamol e lowo kod winy duto; gimoro amora mawuotho e piny, nowuok ei yie moro ka moro kaka kitgi obet.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

kikuyu: Ne wayudo jopuonjre kuno, kendo ne wabet kodgi kuom ndalo abiriyo. Kaka Roho Maler notelonigi, neginyiso Paulo ni kik odhi Jerusalem.
english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oseywae oko mogole e hembe kama ne odakie gi kwe, motere nyaka e nyim ruodh chandruok.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “An awuon abiro dhi kodi kendo kwe mara nobed kodi.”
english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni uikoru konyo, kendo asepwoyou ni jo-Makedonia, ka anyisogi ni owete man Akaya osebedo moikore konyo chakre higa mokalo kendo ramo maru osejiwo thothgi.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

kikuyu: Abiro tweyi gi tonde ma ok inyal lokori koni gi koni, nyaka chop itieki ndalogi mag goyo agengʼa.
english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

kikuyu: Kwa jogi gi ludh odunga mari, kweth mag girkeni magi, modak kendgi ei bungu, e dier puothe momewo. Wegi gichiem Bashan gi Gilead mana kaka ndalo machon.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo chiwuru ni Jehova Nyasaye misengini miwangʼo pep, eka chiengʼ mar aboro to ubedi gi chokruok maler kendo chiengʼno uchiwni Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep. En chokruok mitiekogo nyasi, omiyo kik uti tijeu mapile.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ger gi jaricho to ogeno joma kare.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye! Pakuru Nyasaye e kare maler mar lemo; pakeuru ei polo mare mar nyalo.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

kikuyu: Omiyo nyaka uwinjgi kendo utim gik moko duto ma ginyisou. Kata kamano kik utim gik ma giyalo nikech ok gitim gik ma giyalo.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

kikuyu: E higa mar mia angʼwen gi piero aboro bangʼ ka jo-Israel osewuok Misri, e higa mar angʼwen mar loch Solomon kuom Israel e dwe mar Ziv, dwe mar ariyo nochako gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: “Koro, wuod dhano, kaw ligangla mabith kendo iti kode kaka wembe mar jaliedo, mondo iliel kode yie wiyi kod yie tiki. Bangʼe ikaw rapim ipimie yiergo kendo ipog-gi nyadidek.
english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo lach mar rangach kochakore ewi ohinga mar achiel kuom ute matindo tindogo, man yo ka tok ot, nyaka chop ewi ohinga momanyore kode, monwangʼo ni oromo fut piero ariyo gabich gi nus, kochakore ewi tat ot achiel nyaka machielo.
english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Chutho aseneno thagruok mar joga e piny Misri. Asewinjo ywakgi nikech joma chunogi e tich mar wasumbini kendo angʼeyo thagruokgi.
english: The LORD said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

kikuyu: Ne achiwo chik kendo nonro notim, kendo noyud ni dala maduongʼni nigi sigana mabor mar ngʼanyone ruodhi kendo en kar wich teko kod wacho weche mag wich teko.
english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

kikuyu: Wenge ma yande nene ok nochak onene; kendo kama nodakie ok nochak onene.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

kikuyu: Kane Saulo ofwenyo ni Jehova Nyasaye nigi Daudi kendo ni Mikal nyare ohero Daudi.
english: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

kikuyu: Paruru wachni: Ngʼat mochwoyo kodhi manok kayo cham manok, to ngʼat mochwoyo kothe mangʼeny kayo cham mangʼeny.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

kikuyu: Nyikwagi nongʼere e kind ogendini kendo nyithindgi nomi luor e kind ji. Ji duto monenogi nongʼe ni gin oganda ma Jehova Nyasaye ogwedho.”
english: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”

kikuyu: “To okwongʼu un jo-mwandu, nimar useyudo poku.
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

kikuyu: Wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Chunya ochungʼ mongirore, yaye Nyasaye; abiro paki gi wer kendo abiro loso mamit gi chunya duto.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

kikuyu: Abiro oro kech kendo abiro olo ondiegi mager kuomu, kendo gigi biro miyo udongʼ migumba. Tuoche mosieko kod chwero remo yweyou pep, kendo abiro kelo ligangla mondo oked kodu. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho.”
english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”

kikuyu: To Nyasaye biro bayogi gi aserni; apoya nono, ibiro puodgi piny.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

kikuyu: Zanoa, Adulam kod miechgi, Lakish kod puothegi, bende joma moko nodak Azeka kod gwenge mokiewo kode. Omiyo negidak kochakore Bersheba nyaka e Holo mar Hinom.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nowinjo nyathi kaywak kendo malaika mar Nyasaye noluongo Hagar gie polo kendo owachone niya, “Angʼo marach, Hagar? Kik iluor; Nyasaye osewinjo nyathi kaywak kama onindeno.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Gi gig wer man-gi tondegi. Zaburi mar Asaf. Wer. Nyasaye en rahuma e piny Juda, kendo nyinge duongʼ e piny Israel.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ne oganda niya, “Ikreuru ne odiechiengʼ mar adek kendo kik ngʼato riwre gi chiege.”
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

kikuyu: Obiro kecho joma ok nyal gi joma ochando kendo obiro reso ngima joma ochando.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

kikuyu: Jo-Hibrania moko nongʼado aora Jordan modhi e piny Gad gi Gilead. Saulo to nodongʼ Gilgal, to jolwenje mane ni kode ne tetni ka luoro omakogi.
english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

kikuyu: Kane pod akoro wach kamano, Pelatia wuod Benaya notho. Eka napodho piny auma kendo aywak gi dwol maduongʼ kawacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, bende ditiek pep jo-Israel mane otony kamano adier?”
english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar fedha mar kwoyo pi ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Mago nokel ka giluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka misango mar cham;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: omiyo koro an gichir malongʼo ni Jal mane ochako tich maberno e chunyu biro dhi kode nyime nyaka chop orum e odiechieng Kristo Yesu.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: to ka apenjou, bende ok ubi dwoko.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu pod puonjo ei laru mar hekalu, nokok matek kowacho niya, “Ee, ungʼeya, kendo ungʼeyo kuma aaye. Ok an ka gi dwarona awuon, to Jal ma noora en ja-adiera. Un ukiaye,
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Rit mwandu maber mosemiyi, kirite gi teko mar Roho Maler modak kuomwa.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

kikuyu: mi chwore owinjo wachni to ok owachone gimoro kendo ok okwere, to kwongʼruokno nyaka siki.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Eka noweyo oganda mi odonjo e ot. Jopuonjrene nobiro ire kawacho niya, “Nyiswae tiend ngech buya manie puodho.”
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

kikuyu: Nikech wasigu olwora mangʼeny, joma odak koda koro ochaya gi chunygi; alich kata mana ni osiepena kendo joma onena e wangʼ yo ringa.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

kikuyu: Abiro muko dhoranga Damaski, kendo abiro riembo joma odak e Holo mar Aven, kaachiel gi ngʼat motingʼo ludh Jehova Nyasaye man Beth Eden. Jo-Aram ibiro dar miter mabor e twech e piny Kir,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom ji ariyo-ka nopenjo ngʼat mane orwako law mayom mane oyudo ochungʼ ewi pi ei aora niya, “Gik malichgi biro kawo kinde marom nadi mondo gitimre?”
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

kikuyu: To gengʼruok mawuok kuom Farao nobednu wichkuot, kendo tipo mar Misri nokelnu masira.
english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

kikuyu: Josol osuru bende nobiro ire mondo obatisgi. Negipenje niya, “Japuonj. En angʼo mowinjore watim?”
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

kikuyu: koa kuom joka Juda, kaw Nashon wuod Aminadab;
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: kendo moa kuom Yesu Kristo, ma janeno mar adier ma ok lokre, jal mane okwongo chier oa kuom joma otho, jaloch mar ruodhi manie piny. Ne Jal moherowa kendo mosegonyowa kuom richowa gi rembe,
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

kikuyu: Jehoyada nooro jotelo morito migepe mag jolweny mia achiel-ka, ma bende ne gin jotend jolweny kowachonegi niya, “Keleuru e dierwa kendo neguru ngʼato angʼata maluwe.” Nimar jadolo nosewacho niya, “Kik dhakono donj ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in the LORD’s house.”

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nochako luongo Ibrahim gie polo,
english: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

kikuyu: Nyasacha wacho niya, “Onge kwe ne joricho.”
english: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

kikuyu: Yesuni ema Nyasaye osechiero oa kuom joma otho, kendo wan wawegi wan joneno kuom wachno.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

kikuyu: Kik uluw nyiseche mamoko ma gin nyiseche joma odak e dieru;
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

kikuyu: Wer. Zaburi mar yawuot Kora. Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ adier, kendo owinjore chuth gi pak, e dala maduongʼ mar Nyasachwa, ma en gode maler.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

kikuyu: “Ne jo-adiera, ibedonegi ja-adiera, to ni joma onge ketho, to ibedonegi maonge ketho,
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Chon kane pod ukia Nyasaye, ne un wasumbini mag gik ma ok onego kwan kaka nyiseche.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

kikuyu: To ka ochiwo nyarombo, to nyaka ochiwe e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;

kikuyu: Abiro hulo nyingi ne owetena; abiro paki e nyim chokruok.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

kikuyu: Enobed ranyisi e kinda kod jo-Israel nyaka chiengʼ nimar kuom ndalo auchiel Jehova Nyasaye nochweyo polo gi piny kendo e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo noweyo tich moyweyo.’ ”
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

kikuyu: kendo luongauru e kinde ma un e chandruok; to abiro resou e chandruokugo, eka ubiro miya duongʼ.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: Nonyisowa kaka ne oseneno malaika kofwenyore e ode mowachone ni, ‘Or jomoko Jopa mondo oluongni Simon miluongo ni Petro.
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

kikuyu: E sa ma turumbete mia adekgo nogoo, Jehova Nyasaye noketo ji duto mane ni e kambi ochako kedo e kindgi giwegi ka ginegore gi ligangla. Jolweny noringo odhi Beth Shitta kochiko Zerera mochopo nyaka e tongʼ mar Abel Mehola man but Tabath.
english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

kikuyu: To koro kara atim angʼo? Abiro lamo gi chunya, to bende abiro lamo gi pacha, abiro wer gi chunya, to bende abiro wer gi pacha.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto nobiro kanyakla ir ruoth e ndalo Sawo matimore dwe mar abiriyo.
english: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Eka nogoyo ngero kowacho niya, “Ngʼat moro ne nigi yadh ngʼowu mopidho e puothe, to nodhi mondo omany olemo kuome, to ok noyudo mora amora.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

kikuyu: To ere kaka digiyal wach kuome ka ok oorgi? Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Mano kaka en gima ber neno tiend joote makelo wach maber!”
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

kikuyu: Negidwoko niya, “Pok iwuondowa kata thirowa. Bende pok ikawo gimoro amora moa e lwet ngʼato.”
english: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

kikuyu: ne awuok gotieno kod jomoko manok. Ne pod ok anyiso ngʼato angʼata gima Nyasacha noketo e chunya mondo atimne Jerusalem. Ne onge kweth mag farese mane an godo makmana mano mane aidho.
english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka gidonjo e dhorangeye mag laru ma iye, to nyaka girwak lewni marep-rep. Ok oyienegi rwako lewni mapek molos gi yie rombe ka gitiyo e dhorangeye mag laru ma iye, kata ei hekalu.
english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

kikuyu: kod Mikloth mane wuon Shimea. Gin bende negidak machiegni gi wedegi Jerusalem.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: To kane jatend jolweny mane ochungʼ e nyim Yesu ne owinjo kaka oywak bangʼe oneno kaka otho, nowacho niya, “En adier chuth ni jali ne en Wuod Nyasaye!”
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Holono duto mopongʼ gi ringre joma otho kendo kama ipuke buru, kod kuonde duto mokuny duto, nodhi e Holo mar Kidron man yo wuok chiengʼ mochopo nyaka e kona ma Dhoranga Faras, nobed maler ne Jehova Nyasaye. Dala maduongʼni ok nomuki kata kethi.”
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to the LORD. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”

kikuyu: Eka Petro nowachone niya, “Fedha gi dhahabu aongego, to gima an-go ema amiyi. E nying Yesu Kristo ja-Nazareth, chungi iwuothi.”
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

kikuyu: kendo kik umiye yweyo nyaka chop olos Jerusalem mi omi obed dala marahuma mipako e piny ngima.
english: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka mwanda ma jodwar lawo, kod rombe maonge jakwath, e kaka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi biro dok ir joodgi owuon kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nodog e pinygi.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

kikuyu: Kik iriwri gi jogo ma madho kongʼo mangʼeny kata jowuoro mohero ringʼo,
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

kikuyu: Omiyo koro we angʼadni rieko kaka inyalo konyo ngimani kod ngima Solomon wuodi.”
english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

kikuyu: “Beduru motegno ahinya; beduru motangʼ mondo ulu mago duto mondikie Kitabu mar Chik mar Musa, ma ok udok yo korachwich kata koracham.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

kikuyu: Roho nopongʼa kendo malaikano notingʼa motera malo ewi got mabor, mi nonyisa Jerusalem, ma en Dala Maduongʼ Maler, kalor piny aa e polo ir Nyasaye.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

kikuyu: Owetewa ma Ruoth ohero, onego wadwokne Nyasaye erokamano kinde duto ka waparou nikech Nyasaye noyierou nyaka aa chakruok mondo owaru komiyo ngimau doko maler kuom teko mar Roho Maler kaachiel gi yie muyiego kuom adiera.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

kikuyu: Nowangʼ boche duto kendo nowangʼ-gi ewi kendo mar misango mana kaka iwangʼo mo mar rombo mar lalruok, kendo jadolo nowangʼ bochego ewi misengini miwangʼo ni Jehova Nyasaye gi mach. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodh ketho mar ngʼatno kendo nowene richone.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Israel nongʼanyo ni joka Daudi nyaka chil kawuono.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negiketo yiedhigi oko e dho wath, negiweyo gik moko duto kendo ne giluwe.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

kikuyu: Eka nawacho ni, ‘Eri an ka, yaye Nyasaye, asebiro timo dwaroni, mana kaka ondiki kuoma e Muma.’ ”
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

kikuyu: Kane jo-Filistia openje niya, “En ngʼa motimo ma?” To nodwokgi niya, “En Samson, ma or ja-Timna, nikech chiege nomaye momi osiepne.” Omiyo jo-Filistia nodhi mowangʼo dhakono gi wuon-gi mi githo.
english: Then the Philistines said, “Who has done this?” They said, “Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion.” The Philistines came up, and burned her and her father with fire.

kikuyu: To taya mar Nyasaye ne pok otho, Samuel bende ne nindo ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kama Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye ne nitie.
english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in the LORD’s temple where God’s ark was,

kikuyu: wasetimo richo kendo wasetimo marach. Wasetimo timbe maricho kendo wasengʼanyo; waselokore waweyo yoreni gi chikeni.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

kikuyu: Jowetena, ok adwar ni mondo ukia kaka kwerewa nowuotho e bwo bor polo, to kendo giduto negingʼado Nam Makwar.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

kikuyu: Nikech chuny jogi osedinore; gisedino itgi, kendo gisemiyo wengegi. Nono to dipo ka wengegi oneno, kendo itgi owinjo wach, mi chunygi ofwenyo tiend weche, kendo gidwog ira mi achang-gi!’”
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

kikuyu: bangʼe negiwachone Yesu niya, “Japuonj, dhakoni nende omaki rando ka terore.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

kikuyu: Bad Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kuoma kanyo, kendo nowachona niya, “Aa malo mondo idhi e pap, kendo abiro wuoyo kodi kuno.”
english: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

kikuyu: Ka iwuotho, to ok inikier bende ka iringo, to ok inichwanyri.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

kikuyu: Yor chikeni ema aringe, nimar isegonyo chunya.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

kikuyu: kendo odhi nyime nyaka e nam. Bende kochakore Mikmethath mantiere yo nyandwat ne ogondore kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Tanath Shilo, mochopo nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ mar Janoa.
english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

kikuyu: Inine malit in ngʼat mawachone wuon-gi ni, ‘Angʼo minywoloni?’ Kata ne min-gi ni, ‘En angʼo maninywoloni?’
english: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”

kikuyu: Donge otimoni kamano nikech timbegi kod richo misetimo ngʼeny?
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

kikuyu: Paruru ni ne un wasumbini e piny Misri kendo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nogolou kuno gi teko maduongʼ korieyo bade. Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechikou mondo urit chiengʼ Sabato.
english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Nimar Ndiko owacho niya, “Kik utwe dho dhiangʼ kaywayo lodi ma idinogo cham,” kendo niya, “Jatich ber gi chudo kuom tije motiyo.”
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

kikuyu: kendo negimake. Ne gitere Ribla ir ruodh Babulon e piny Hamath, kama nongʼadone bura.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

kikuyu: tiende ni, nyikwagi mane odongʼ e piny, ma jo-Israel ne ok otieko; Solomon nolokogi wasumbini michuno mondo oti githuon, kaka obet nyaka chil kawuono.
english: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

kikuyu: Chunye sudo machiegni gi bur matut, kendo ngimane yware machiegni gi joma osetho.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

kikuyu: Kuom mano kik wiyi kuodi kuom timo nend Ruodhwa kata nenda an Jatichne motwe. To kuom teko mar Nyasaye yie mondo osandi koda nikech Injili,
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

kikuyu: To ngʼat ma hulo wach, wuoyo gi ji mondo ogergi, ojiwgi kendo oduog chunygi.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

kikuyu: Ginidag kanyo gi kwe kendo giniger udi kendo ginipidh mzabibu e puothegi; ginidag gi kwe ka akumo pinje molworogi duto mane jarogi. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.’ ”
english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, dichwo malemo kata makoro e chokruok koumo wiye ochayo Kristo.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

kikuyu: Ok adwari, in Jerusalem, un jogo modak ewi holoni, e got mar mesa motimo lwanda, Jehova Nyasaye owacho; un ma uwacho niya, “En ngʼa manyalo kwedowa? En ngʼa manyalo donjo kar pondowa?”
english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain,’ says the LORD. ‘You that say, “Who would come down against us?” or, “Who would enter into our homes?”

kikuyu: Joka Merari ne gin: Mali gi Mushi. Magi ema ne anywola jo-Lawi, kaluwore gi dhoutgi.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ en mari, kendo otieno bende mari, bende ne iguro wangʼ chiengʼ gi dwe keregi.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

kikuyu: Kane jatingʼ gige lweny oneno ka Saulo osetho en bende nokawo liganglane mochwoworego motho kode.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

kikuyu: Negibiro ir Johana mi giwachone niya, “Rabi, jal manyocha ni kodi loka Jordan, ma en Jal mane iwuoyo kuome cha, parie ni en bende tinde obatiso ji, kendo ji duto dhi ire.”
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
