kikuyu: Bangʼ ka dweche adek nosekalo, ne waidho yie moro mane osebedo karito kanyo e ndalo chwiri. Ne en yie ja-Aleksandria mane oket ne kido mag nyiseche ariyo ma rude, miluongo ni, Kasta gi Poluko.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

kikuyu: Kite angʼwen-go ne chalre duto; moro ka moro kuomgi ne chalo gi tielo mochungʼ ariwa ewi tiend wadgi.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

kikuyu: Mach nodhuolore e nyime, mana ka aora mamol! Ji gana gi gana ne tiyone; kendo ji tara gi tara nochungʼ e nyime. Bangʼe noel kitepe eka bura nochakore.
english: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him. Thousands of thousands ministered to him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The judgment was set. The books were opened.

kikuyu: Noyudo Yesu pok odonjo ei dalano; to ne pod ochungʼ oko kama Maritha noromonee.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

kikuyu: Eka negigoyo koko kendo niya, “Haleluya! Iro moa kuome kowangʼ nodum mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.”
english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

kikuyu: To ne ok giyie weche mon-go, nikech wechegi ne nenore koyuma.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Notimo richo duto mane wuon otimo kendo chunye ne ok ochiwore chuth ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache, kaka chuny Daudi kwargi ne en.
english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

kikuyu: Nodwoke niya, “Japuonj, magi duto aserito nyaka aa tin-na.”
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

kikuyu: Kendo bonyo nowuok e yirono mopiyo e piny, to nomigi teko machalo gi teko thomoni manie piny.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

kikuyu: “Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ahero adiera, amon gi mecho kod timbe mamono. Kuom adiera mara abiro miyogi pok kendo anatim kodgi singruok mosiko.
english: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

kikuyu: nimar Jal Maratego osetimona gik madongo, Nyinge ler.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

kikuyu: To ne ok omiye girkeni moro e pinyni, kata lowo matin moromo tielo nyono. Nyasaye nosingorene ni en kaachiel gi nyikwaye mane biro aa bangʼe ne biro kawo lopni, kata obedo ni Ibrahim ne onge gi nyathi e kindeno.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kikuyu: To kata mana gin bende wechegi ne ok chalre.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

kikuyu: ka alando pakni gi dwol maduongʼ, kendo anyiso timbeni duto miwuoro.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

kikuyu: Ka waweye odhi nyime kama, to ji duto biro yie kuome, kendo kamano otimore to jo-Rumi biro biro mi kaw karwa ka, kaachiel gi pinywa bende.”
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

kikuyu: Giwacho niya, “Biuru watiekgi mi girum pep kaka oganda, mondo nying mar Israel kik chak par kendo.”
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

kikuyu: To bed mamor kendo gi ilo manyaka chiengʼ, gi gik ma abiro chweyo, nimar abiro chweyo Jerusalem obed dala makelo mor, kendo joma odakie obed gi ilo.
english: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.

kikuyu: Chunyu mondo oter nyangu, kendo weuru wich teko.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye achiel mane tiyo gi Petro e yalone kaka jaote e kind jo-Yahudi ema bende ne tiyo koda kaka jaote ni joma ok jo-Yahudi.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo wacho niya, “Aserito chunya maler; aler kendo aonge richo?”
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

kikuyu: E kinde ka kinda mane Daudi omonjo pinjego ne ok oweyo dichwo kata dhako kangima, to noyako rombe, dhok, punde, gi ngamia gi lewni. Eka nodok ir Akish.
english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel noluongo Jehova Nyasaye, kendo mana gi odiechiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye nokelo mor polo gi koth. Omiyo ji duto nochungʼ ka luoro omakogi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kod Samuel.
english: So Samuel called to the LORD, and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

kikuyu: Pinygi nochakore Mahanaim, mokwako piny Og ruodh Bashan duto kod kuonde dak duto mag Jair man Bashan, to gi mier matindo piero auchiel,
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

kikuyu: Eka nopimo bor gi lach mar kama ler mar lemo; mi noyudo ni en fut piero adek maromre moro ka moro, kopime ariwa mar giko kama ler ma oko. Nowachona niya, “Ma e Kama Ler Moloyo.”
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

kikuyu: to jomoko to nokelo law marambulu, kata maralik, kata marakwaro, kata yie diek, kata piende rombe molok makwar, kata piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe.
english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

kikuyu: E Ribla ruodh Babulon nonego yawuot Zedekia koneno; bende nonego jotelo duto mag Juda.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

kikuyu: wuod Mali, wuod Mushi, wuod Merari, wuod Lawi.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Ka wuowino nochopo kama asech Jonathan ne olwarie, Jonathan noluonge gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Donge asere ni nyimi kanyo?”
english: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

kikuyu: Lep bende en mach kendo piny mopongʼ gi richo e kind fuonde duto mag ringruok. Oketho ringruok duto ka omoko mach mawangʼo ngima dhano duto mi chop en owuon bende wangʼe e Gehena.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nigi duongʼ moyombo ogendini duto, kendo duongʼne maler oyombo polo.
english: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

kikuyu: Nitie otuchi matindo tindo e kor ot ma oko mag udigo duto, kendo e kor ot ma iye manie kind udi. E kor udi ma yo ka iye momanyore gi yo mokadho e kind udigo, nogorie yiend othidhe.
english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

kikuyu: bende ok tine gi lwet dhano ka gima odwaro gimoro kuom dhano nikech en owuon ema ochiwo ne dhano, ngima gi muya mi yweyo kod gik moko duto.
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moro ma nyinge Demetrio, mane jathedh fedha, ne loso kido mag hekalu mar nyasaye madhako miluongo ni Artemis, kendo tichneno ne kelo ohala maduongʼ ni jotheth wetene.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

kikuyu: Nikech osebedo kowacho ni, ‘Onge ohala ma dhano yudo, ka otemo matek mondo otim gima ber ne Nyasaye!’
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

kikuyu: Eka jo-Farisai nowuok odhi mondo gilos wach kaka ginyalo ndhoge gi wechene owuon.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

kikuyu: Jarichono chalo gi yath ma tiendene otwo ei lowo, kendo bedene oner.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

kikuyu: E lweny machielo gi jo-Filistia e piny Gob Elhanan wuod Jare-Oregim ma ja-Bethlehem nonego Goliath, ja-Giti ma bond tonge chalo lodi.
english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

kikuyu: To Paulo nokok matek kawacho niya, “Kik ihinyri! Wantie waduto!”
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jotichne ma nyiri mariek nodwoke; kawuoyo kende kama:
english: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,

kikuyu: Notimo misengini kendo owangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar e kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo, ewi gode matindo kendo e bwo yiende motimo otiep.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

kikuyu: “Bende isedonjo e dere mokanie pe madongo kata neno dere mag pe matindo,
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

kikuyu: nowacho niya, “Okwongʼ Kanaan! Enobed misumba, e bwo wasumbini mag owetene.”
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

kikuyu: Koro Samuel notho, kendo Israel duto nochokore moywage; mine giike e dalane Rama. Bangʼe Daudi nowuok molor piny e Thim Paran.
english: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: Ooyo, ok kamano kata matin! Nyasaye nyaka bed ja-adiera, to ji duto jo-miriambo, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Mondo ibedi kare ka iwuoyo kendo ilochi ka ingʼadona bura.”
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

kikuyu: “Wabiro kelo yawuotwa makayo kod dhowa gi rombwa mokwong nywol ni jodolo matiyo e od Nyasachwa mana kaka ondik e Chik.
english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

kikuyu: gode ne oneni ma otetni giluoro; oula nomwomo karidore. Kude matut bende mor matek; apaka ne tingʼore malo.
english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich negisingore ka gikwongʼore ngʼato gi ngʼato. Eka Isaka nogonyogi ma gidhi gi kwe.
english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

kikuyu: To ka isiemo ngʼat ma timbene richo to odagi lokore mondo owe timbene maricho, to ngʼatno notho nikech richone, to in inires ngimani.
english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe kawgi oko e lwetgi kendo iwangʼ-gi e kendo mar misango kaachiel gi misango miwangʼo pep kaka misango madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma en misango miwangʼone Jehova Nyasaye gi mach.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro kelogi mi gidonji kendo ibiro miyo gibedi ewi godi mar girkeni, ma en kama ne iloso kaka kar dakni, kendo kama ler mar lemo mane iloso gi lweti, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye.
english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

kikuyu: Ahitino nomako yie motame muomo yamono, omiyo ne waweyo mondo yamo olok yie oterwa atera kuma okudho kochomo.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

kikuyu: Eka Herode noluongo ajuokego lingʼ-lingʼ, kendo ne ononogi, mi neginyise kinde nogono mane sulwe onenore.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

kikuyu: E sa ma ne utimo gigi duto, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, ne awuoyo kodu anwoya, to ne ok uchiko itu; ne aluongou, to ne ok udwoka.
english: Now, because you have done all these works,” says the LORD, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata man-gi songa kik sud machiegni gi Nyasaye, obed ni en muofu kata rangʼol, kata ma dende kamoro otimo mbala,
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jawuoro thoro kelo miero, to ngʼat mogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye biro dhiyo maber.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

kikuyu: Shefatia, Hatil, Pokereth-Hazebaim kod Ami.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

kikuyu: kod jotich kaachiel kode kaka: Shemaya, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Juda kod Hanani ka gin-gi thumbe migoyo mane olos gi Daudi ka giluwo kor ohinga mi gikadho ewi od Daudi ngʼat Nyasaye. Ezra ma jandiko notelonegi.
english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

kikuyu: To ka inyalo ter nyathi nyangu chiengʼ Sabato, mondo kik uketh Chik Musa, anto iu wangʼ koda nangʼo ka achango ringre dhano duto chiengʼ Sabato?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

kikuyu: Enongʼade matindo tindo mi okete kaachiel gi joma wuondore, kama ywagruok gi mwodo lak nobedie.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: ‘Kik udhi utug lweny gi oweteu ma jo-Israel. Doguru e miechu ngʼato ka ngʼato, nimar ma osetimore nikech an.’ ” Omiyo negiwinjo wach Jehova Nyasaye mi gidok e miechgi ma ok gidhi kedo kod Jeroboam.
english: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

kikuyu: Neguru nyirwedhi mage duto; we gidhi e kar yengʼo! Mano kaka gininee malit! Nimar odiechiengʼ osechopo, kinde monego kumgi.
english: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.

kikuyu: E kinde mar keyo nooro jatichne moro ir jopur puodho mondo oomne olembe moko mane ochiek e puoth mzabibu.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Jo-Samaria mangʼeny moa e dalano noyie kuom Yesu nikech neno mane dhakono otimonigi kowacho niya, “Ne onyisa gik moko duto ma asetimo.”
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

kikuyu: Daudi nopenjo kendo niya, “Jo-Keila biro chiwa kaachiel gi joga ne Saulo.” To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Gibiro timo kamano.”
english: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” The LORD said, “They will deliver you up.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nonyiso Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Kane ayudo Israel ne ochalo mana kayudo olemb mzabibu e piny motwo, kane aneno kwereu, ne chalo mana ka gima aneno olemo monyak mokwongo mar ngʼowu. To kane gibiro Baal Peor, negichiwore lamo nyiseche manono makwodo wich, kendo negibedo modwanyore mana ka gima ne giherono.
english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.

kikuyu: Un jomer, chiewuru kendo ywaguru! Gouru nduru, un duto ma jomath mag divai; gouru nduru nikech divai manyien, nikech oseyudhe ogole e dhou.
english: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noyudo Hagar machiegni gi soko e thim; ne en soko manie bath yo madhi Shur.
english: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi nowacho niya, “Ruodha, dhakoni gi an wadak e ot chiel. Ne ayudo nyathi kane en koda e ot.
english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nochako otimo timbe mamono e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye. Negitiyone Baal gi Ashtoreth, kod nyiseche mag jo-Aram, gi nyiseche mag jo-Sidon, nyiseche mag jo-Moab, nyiseche mag jo-Amon kod nyiseche mag jo-Filistia. Bende nikech jo-Israel nojwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye mi ok gitiyone,
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.

kikuyu: Ne gichiewo ka piny yawore, eka Samuel noluongo Saulo ewi ot, kowachone niya, “Ikri abiro gonyi mondo ichak wuodhi.” Kane Saulo oseikore, en kod Samuel ne giwuok oko.
english: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni giseneno malit mokalo pimo, kendo gidhier ahinya kamano, to mago osemiyo gimedo bedo mamor moloyo, kendo chiwogi mar ngʼwono osemedore mokalo pimo.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

kikuyu: Hezekia noyudo osepenjo Isaya niya, “Ere gima biro bedona ranyisi ni Jehova Nyasaye biro changa kendo ni abiro dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye e odiechiengʼ mar adek kochakore kawuono?”
english: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I will go up to the LORD’s house the third day?”

kikuyu: “Ka jakuo ojuk kakwelo kendo ogoye mi otho, ngʼatno mogoye remo ok nodongʼ e wiye kuom remo mochwer;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

kikuyu: Kendo negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Onego wayier jatelo mondo wadog Misri.”
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

kikuyu: Ritri kik ibed gi mirima kendo lokri iwe ich wangʼ kik ibed gi ich wangʼ nikech okelo mana rach.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kama: ‘Nikech usemiyo richou onenore kuom kethou mutimo, kendo ka unyiso richou oyanga kuom gik mutimo; omiyo koro ibiro teru e twech kaka wasumbini.
english: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

kikuyu: Bende osenyisi dhorangaye mag tho? Koso bende iseneno dhorangeye mag tipo mag tho?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

kikuyu: Nikech ne an-gi ratiro kuom wachni, ne achano mar limou mokwongo mondo ne uyud gweth manyadiriyo.
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

kikuyu: Owetena, ajiwou kuom Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, kendo kuom hera mar Roho, mondo uriwru koda e nyagruokna, kulamona Nyasaye.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

kikuyu: Omiyo tangʼuru, mondo gik mane jonabi okoro kik timrenu. Ne gikoro niya:
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

kikuyu: Ywak nobedie piny Misri duto, ma en ywak moloyo moro amora mosebedo kata mabiro bedo.
english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jeroboam ne dhi oko mar Jerusalem kendo Ahija janabi moa Shilo noromo kode e yo korwako law manyien: Kargi ji ariyogo ne gin kendgi oko mar dala,
english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

kikuyu: Nomiye luor maduongʼ moloyo thuondi piero adekgo, to kata kamano ne ok en achiel kuom thuondi adekgo madongo. Daudi nokete jatend jolweny mane rite.
english: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

kikuyu: To an gi ratiro kuom wachni: ni pod abiro neno ber Jehova Nyasaye, e piny joma ngima.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: ringreni ok noiki kaka noik ruodhi mamoko nimar iseketho piny kendo isenego jogi. Nyithi joma timbegi mono ok nochak oluong nyingegi kendo.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

kikuyu: kendo mondo urit biro mar Wuode koa e polo. Wuodeno mane ochiero oa kuom joma otho en Yesu, Jal ma resowa e mirimb Nyasaye mabiro.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

kikuyu: Iloko gik moko ataro, mana ka gima jachwech bende chal gi lowo mochweyo! Bende gima ochwe nyalo wachone jachwechne niya, “Ne ok ichweya?” Koso agulu bende nyalo wachone jachwechne niya, “Onge gima ingʼeyo?”
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

kikuyu: Owetena ok adwar ni ubed ka ukia tiend wach mopondoni, adwaro ni uwinj tiend wach mopondoni mondo kik ukawru ni uriek moloyo kaka uchal: Jo-Israel moko konchiel osemi chunygi odoko matek nyaka chop kar kwan mowinjore mar joma ok jo-Yahudi odonji.
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

kikuyu: To ruoth nowachone niya, “Chungʼ e bathe ka kendo iriti.” Omiyo nosudo bathe mochungʼ kanyo.
english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

kikuyu: Paruru gik miwuoro mosetimo, honni mage kod buche mosengʼado,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: kuom punde alufu piero adek gi mia abich (30,500), pok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne gin punde piero auchiel gachiel (61);
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

kikuyu: “Ka aloro polo ni koth kik chuwe kata ka keto bonyo mondo ocham piny kata aoro dera marach mar tho ne joga,
english: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Angʼeyo ni ka ok uneno honni gi ranyisi, to ok ubi yie.”
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

kikuyu: “Abiro chokou un duto ma ok orem, yaye joka Jakobo; abiro kelo jo-Israel modongʼ kaachiel ma ok orem. Anakelgi kaachiel ka rombe manie abila, kendo kaka jamni manie lek. Kanyo nopongʼ gi ji.
english: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.

kikuyu: Eka jaote nokok matek niya, “Ma e gima ochiku mondo utim, yaye ogendini, gi pinje kod ji moa e dhoudi mopogore opogore.
english: Then the herald cried aloud, “To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages,

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nousogi ne Jabin, ruodh Kanaan, ma loch mare neni Hazor. Jatend jolweny mage ne en Sisera, manodak Harosheth Hagoyim.
english: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Daudi ema ne wuowi matin kuomgi. Yawuowi adek madongo noluwo bangʼ Saulo,
english: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.

kikuyu: Abram nodak e piny Kanaan, to Lut nodak e kind mier madongo manie paw Jordan kendo nogero hembene machiegni gi Sodom.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

kikuyu: Ok ginyal yie dak kodwa mondo wabed oganda achiel kodgi makmana ka chwo duto oter nyangu mana kaka gin.
english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier kama: Kuom jogo duto mamon onywolo, onge ngʼama osewuok e dier ji maduongʼ moloyo Johana ja-Batiso; kata kamano ngʼatno matinie moloyo e pinyruodh polo duongʼ moloye.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noruti koa Sayun kendo nomor koa Jerusalem. Piny gi Polo noyiengni; to Jehova Nyasaye nobed kar pondo mar joge; nobed ragengʼ ne jo-Israel.
english: The LORD will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Negidonjo e ot maiye ka gima gidwaro kawo ngʼatno kendo, negichwowo bund iye. Eka Rekab gi owadgi ma Baana nopusore modhi.
english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

kikuyu: Eka Farao nomedo wacho niya, “Neuru, ogandani koro osenyaa momedore to pod udwaro chungogi e tich.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”

kikuyu: Judas gi Sila, mane gin jonabi, nomedo wuoyo gi owete ka gijiwogi kendo gitegogi e yie.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko lemo, nowuok gi jopuonjrene, mine gingʼado holo mar Kidron. Loka mar holono ne nitie puodho moro mane nigi yiende mag Zeituni, kendo Yesu nodonjo kanyo kaachiel gi jopuonjrene.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo ipandonwa wangʼi momiyo wiyi owil kod pek ma wan-go kod chandruokwa?
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

kikuyu: Eka jodong dala noluong ngʼatno mondo owuo kode. To kapod odagi kowacho niya, “Ok adwar kende,”
english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

kikuyu: Ma e chakruok mar Injili mar Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

kikuyu: Jotende gin sibuoche maruto, to ruodhige chalo gi ondiegi mawuotho gotieno, ma ok we gimoro amora miyudi gokinyi.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane ni kama gikadhoe noywak matek ka jogo duto kadho. Ruoth bende ne ongʼado Holo mar Kidron kendo ji duto nowuotho kochomo yo thim.
english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo ruodha yie iorna ngano gi shairi kod mo zeituni kod divai mane isingo.
english: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

kikuyu: Timbe duto mag loch Baasha gi gik mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: “Nyaka oyangʼ diel mitimogo misango mar golo richo ni oganda jo-Israel, mi noter rembe ei kama ogengʼ gi pasia, kendo nokir remono ewi raum mar misango, kendo e nyim raumno bende, mana kaka nokiro remb rwadh-cha.
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Eka nogolo wenge Zedekia oko, notweye gi rateke mag mula kendo notere Babulon, kama ne okete e od twech nyaka chiengʼ mano thoe.
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

kikuyu: Kethoga ibiro ket ei ofuku mi din ma ok yawre, kendo inium richona.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye obet e kom loch mare ewi ataro; Jehova Nyasaye obet e kom loch kaka Ruoth nyaka chiengʼ.
english: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: “Kata obedo ni gingʼeny kendo gin gi joma konyogi, ibiro ngʼad kargi oko mi gilal nono. Kata obedo ni asesandi, yaye Juda, ok anachak sandi kendo.
english: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

kikuyu: To Hadad, mane pod rawera matin, noringo odhi Misri gi jodong Edom moko, mane osetiyo ni wuon-gi.
english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye mane owacho niya, “Ler mondo orieny koa e mudho” ema osemiyo lerne omenyo chunywa, momiyowa ler mar ngʼeyo duongʼ Nyasaye mineno kuom Yesu Kristo.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Kata kamano, ndalo biro, ma dhano ok nochak owachi ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, manogolo jo-Israel Misri,’
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that it will no more be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

kikuyu: e dhood Simeon, en Shemuel wuod Amihud;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Kane oneno ruoth madhako miluongo ni Esta ma mikache kochungʼ e laru, nomor kode mi otingʼone ludhe mar dhahabu mane ni e lwete. Omiyo Esta nodhi momulo wi luth.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

kikuyu: Eka nolemo niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach ruodha Ibrahim, gwedha kawuono, kendo nyis ngʼwononi ne ruodha Ibrahim.
english: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

kikuyu: “To in, yaye dhood Israel, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Dhiuru uti ne nyisecheu, un duto ngʼato gi ngʼato! To gikone ni ubiro luora kendo ok unumi nyinga maler kethre kuom chiwo mich ni nyisecheu manono.
english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord GOD says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

kikuyu: Magi e joma nobiro koa e mier mag Tel Mela, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Adon kod Imer, to ne ok ginyal nyiso malongʼo ni anywolagi ne gin nyikwa Israel.
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

kikuyu: Timbe mamoko mag loch Omri gi gik mabeyo mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitap rapar mar ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: To piny noyiengni matek, nimar malaika mar Ruoth nolor piny koa e polo, mi nodhi nyaka e liel mongʼielo kidi oko e dho liel kendo obetie.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

kikuyu: to ne alawe kendo agoye mi amaye rombo kagolo e dhoge. Kane ochikore ira, ne amake gi yie dende mi agoye kendo anege.
english: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

kikuyu: We ruodhwa ochik jotichne man kagi mondo odwar ngʼat manyalo goyo nyatiti. Obiro goye e kindeno ma roho marach ma Nyasaye omiyo thuolo obiro kuomi to iniwinj maber.”
english: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

kikuyu: Omiyo winjuru, yaye un ogendini; ranguru malongʼo, yaye un joneno, gima biro timore negi.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyime kowachonegi niya, “asewinjo ni nitie cham e piny Misri. Dhiuru kuno kendo ungʼiewnwa cham, mondo mi wabed mangima kendo kech kik negwa.”
english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

kikuyu: “Chikuru itu maber ni gino madwaro nyisou: Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi keti e lwet ji.”
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

kikuyu: To Abram nowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, en angʼo ma dimiya to pod asiko ka aonge nyathi kendo jacham mwanduna en mana Eliezer ja-Damaski?”
english: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

kikuyu: Kendo Hiram nomedo wacho niya, “Pak odogne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel mane ochweyo polo gi piny! Osemiyo Ruoth Daudi wuowi mariek, mongʼeyo fwono tiend weche kendo fwenyo gik moko, en ema noger hekalu ne Jehova Nyasaye to gi od ruoth modakie owuon.
english: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

kikuyu: Eka owacho ni, ‘Abiro dok e ot mane aaye.’ Ka ochopo to oyudo ka odno iye ninono, koyweye maler kendo ochan maber.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

kikuyu: Ochike gi otegu mopandi ei lowo kendo oket ne obadho e yo moluwo.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

kikuyu: To kaka nodwaro mondo onenre ngʼat mariek, nomedo penjo Yesu niya, “Nyawadwa to en ngʼa?”
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

kikuyu: moseketo chunye mondo oluw Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwerene kata obedo ni ok oler kaluwore gi chike mag kama ler mar lemo.”
english: who sets his heart to seek God, the LORD, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

kikuyu: Solomon bende ne nigi jotelo apar gariyo mane orito pinje manie Israel duto kendo ne choko gik moko ne ruoth kod joge. Moro ka moro kuomgi ne kelo chiemo kuom dwe achiel e higa.
english: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osemiye pi modho, nowachone niya, “Abiro dhi umbo pi ne ngamia magi bende, nyaka gitiek modho.”
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

kikuyu: mi nosingorene, e yor kwongʼruok ni obiro miye gimoro amora mokwaye.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

kikuyu: Chilo ma en-go omienore e lepe, ne ok odewo gima biro timorene bangʼe. Nopodho malich miwuoro, to onge ngʼama ne nyalo hoye. Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, neye chandruok ma an-go, nimar wasigu oseloyo.
english: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, LORD, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”

kikuyu: Ka jasiki odenyo, to miye chiemo ocham; ka riyo oloye, miye pi omodhi.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

kikuyu: Twe thiwni ariyogo mag dhahabu e ratege mantie e riak law akor,
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: E sechego noyudo jo-Yahudi mathoth moluoro Nyasaye ni Jerusalem. Jogi noa e pinje duto manie bwo polo.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

kikuyu: Norito bangʼ ndalo abiriyo moko kendo nooro akuru koa ei yie.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

kikuyu: to ngʼato angʼata momodho pi mamiye ok nochak owinj riyo. Chutho, pi ma anamiye nodok soko mar pi e iye, mosiko ka bubni nyaka chop e ngima mochwere.”
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yesu nooro Petro gi Johana, kowacho niya, “Dhiuru mondo ulosnwa Pasaka mondo wabi wacham.”
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

kikuyu: Eka Saulo norwako Daudi gi lawe owuon. Norwakone koti mar lweny kendo nosidhone ogudu mar mula e wiye.
english: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

kikuyu: Achikou e nying Ruoth mondo une ni osom baruwani ne jowete duto.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodong jo-Yahudi nodhi nyime gi gedo kendo odhi maber e bwo yalo mar Hagai janabi gi Zekaria, nyakwar Ido. Negitieko gero hekalu kaluwore gi chik mar Nyasach Israel kod chike Sairas, Darius gi Artaksases, ruodhi Pasia.
english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo nyaka Gilead kendo imany yath, yaye Nyar Misri Mangili. To kata obedo ni imedo manyo yedhe to imenyo kayiem kendo ok inichangi.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye owuon ema osemiyo un kod wan wachungʼ motegno kuom Kristo. En ema osewirowa,
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Pok ne usomo gima Daudi notimo chiengʼ ma en kaachiel gi jogo mane ni kode ka kech ne kayogi?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Rie badi e piny Misri mondo bonyo opoti e piny kendo mondo ocham gimoro amora matwi e puothe gi gimoro amora ma pe oweyo.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

kikuyu: Kane Joshua ooro ji koa Jeriko mondo odhi Ai, mantiere but Beth Aven yo podho chiengʼ mar Bethel nokonegi niya, “Dhiuru kendo utim nonro ma lingʼ-lingʼ mar gwengʼno.” Omiyo jogo nodhi mi ginono Ai lingʼ-lingʼ.
english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The men went up and spied out Ai.

kikuyu: giket e lwet joote eka joote ne pogo pesago kaka ne ngʼato ka ngʼato dwaro.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Ne aweyogi thuolo mondo chiwo mane gigolo omi gidok mogak; ma en misango mar nyithindgi duto makayo, mondo omi kihondko omakgi eka gingʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye!
english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.”’

kikuyu: Chutho ok osewinjo kata mana ngʼeyo, nimar nyaka aa chon itu ne pok oyaw. To bende angʼeyo ni un gi mwandu kendo un oganda ma jopiem nyaka aa nywolu.
english: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.

kikuyu: kendo mondo ungʼe gima miyo Ruoth mor.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

kikuyu: E kinde mag keyo, adek kuom thuondi piero adek madongo nobiro ir Daudi e rogo man Adulam, ka jolweny mag jo-Filistia to nojot e Holo mar Refaim.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech abiro golou oko e dier ogendini; chokou kagolou e pinje duto mi aduogu kendo e lopu uwegi.
english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima ne asingorae kodu kane uwuok e piny Misri. Kendo Roho mara nikodu kinde duto. Kik ubed maluor.’
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

kikuyu: Zilpa ma jatich Lea nonywolo ne Jakobo wuowi.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

kikuyu: “Ji duto ma luonga ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth,’ ok nodonji e pinyruodh polo, to mana ngʼama timo dwaro mar Wuora manie polo ema nodonji.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: “Dwond ywak mag-gi winjore koa Heshbon nyaka Eleale gi Jahaz, koa Zoar nyaka chop Horonaim gi Eglath Shelishiya, nimar kata pige mag Nimrim bende osetwo.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.

kikuyu: Jal mane oloso polo gi riekone, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Noimo geche Farao kod jolwenje ei Nam Makwar. Jodong Farao mogen duto noimo e nam makwar.
english: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon nomiyo ruoth madhako mar Sheba gik moko duto mane chunye dwaro kendo mane okwayo, ewi gigo duto mane osemiye mag keno mar ruoth. Eka nowuok mi odok e pinye kaachiel gi jotije.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

kikuyu: Satan nodwoko niya, “Dhano nyalo yie weyo gimoro amora ma en-go mana ni mondo obed mangima.
english: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osedhi, jotich nobiro kendo oyudo ka dhoudi manie agola mamalo olor. Negiwacho niya, “Nyaka bed ni okonyore e agola ma iye mar ot.”
english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

kikuyu: Joma roteke tho apoya e dier otieno; inegogi mi gilal nono, kendo igologi e dier ji, to ok gi lwet dhano.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

kikuyu: Nyis jo-Israel kama, ‘Ma ema nobed mor pwodhruok maler ne tienge duto mabiro.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Nyasaye modak kare kama ler. En wuoro ne joma onge gi wuonegi kendo en jachwak mon ma chwogi otho.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

kikuyu: Ageno ni ungʼeyo yo madhi kuma adhiye.”
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Zedekia nochiwo chik mondo Jeremia oket e laru jarito kendo miye makati koa e yore mag jolos makati odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, nyaka makati duto man e dala maduongʼno norumo.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

kikuyu: Dho ngʼat makare konyo ji mangʼeny, to ngʼat mofuwo tho nikech rem mar ngʼeyo ngʼado bura.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

kikuyu: mondo kaka richo nobedo gi loch mokelo tho, e kaka ngʼwono bende obedie gi loch kuom tim makare, makelo ngima mochwere kuom Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Ligangla mochwoego ok time gimoro, bedni en tongʼ mabor, tongʼ machiek, kata bidhi.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

kikuyu: Piyo piyo nono kane gisegologi oko, achiel kuom malaikago nowacho niya, “Ring utony ne ngimau! Kik ungʼi chien, kendo kik uchung kamoro amora e pap; tonyuru udhi e gode nono, to ubiro lal!”
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

kikuyu: Enomuk kuonde mochiel motegno maonge ngʼama nyalo muko, kotiyo gi teko mar nyasaye moro ma ji okia kendo enochiw mich madongo ne jomo okawe nolich. Jogo enoketi jotelo mag ji mangʼeny kendo enopognegi lowo mar dwokonegi erokamano.
english: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.

kikuyu: Konya kendo gola e lwet jopinje mamoko, ma dhogi opongʼ gi miriambo kendo ma lwetgi ma korachwich opongʼ gi wuondruok.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Eka Elisha nokone Gehazi niya, “Ngʼwan lepi, kaw ludha kendo ichak wuoth. Kik imos ngʼato angʼata miromogo e yo. Kichopo to iriw ludhani e lela wangʼ nyathi.”
english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

kikuyu: To Juda nowachone niya, “Ngʼat cha nosiemowa matek ni, ‘Ok nachak awuo kodu ka ok ubiro gi owadu.’
english: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Wuod Dhano en Ruodh Sabato.”
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: kendo ogendini duto manie piny nogwedhi kokalo e kothi, nikech isewinjo wachna.”
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

kikuyu: Joshua nochiewo gokinyi mangʼich kinyne kendo jodolo nokawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the LORD’s ark.

kikuyu: Mach biro wangʼou kanyo, ligangla biro ngʼadou matindo tindo, mitieku mana ka dede mar bonyo momonjo piny. Medreuru ameda mana ka dede, medreuru ka det bonyo!
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

kikuyu: Chunyu ne sandore kaachiel gi joma otwe nikech Kristo, kendo numor kimayou giu githuon nikech nungʼeyo ni un uwegi un gi mwandu mabeyo moloyo kendo mosiko.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nangʼicho mi awinjo ongo mafuyo e kor polo kaywak matek niya, “Lit! Lit! Lit ni joma odak e piny, nikech turumbete modongʼ ma malaike adek biro goyo!”
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

kikuyu: Noluongogi niya, “Jowadwa, bende unie gi rech moro?” Negidwoke niya, “Ooyo.”
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

kikuyu: Eka Amazia jadolo mar Bethel nooro wach ne Jeroboam ma ruodh Israel niya, “Amos, koro piem kodi ei Israel, kendo wechene biro ketho piny.
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.

kikuyu: Sunga kelo masira, chuny mar ngʼayi kelo chwanyruok.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

kikuyu: Joma ongʼeyo ngʼwech sani koro ok bi tony, joma rateke abiro keto bedo mool, bende nyaka jalweny manenore ni ger ok bi konyo ngimane.
english: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.

kikuyu: To ka gik moko duto otimoreni maber, ipara kendo itimna ngʼwono; iwuona gi Farao mondo ogola e od twech.
english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokelo rwath mane ibiro timgo misango mar golo richo, Harun kod yawuote noyie lwetgi e wiye.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

kikuyu: Mad duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye sik nyaka chiengʼ; mad Jehova Nyasaye bed mamor gi gik mane ochweyo.
english: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

kikuyu: Kendo negigwedho Rebeka kagiwachone niya, “Nyathiwa, bed min ji gana gi gana; mad nyikwayi medre ma kaw mier madongo mag wasikgi.”
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

kikuyu: Chakre kindeno kadhi nyime Yesu nochako nyiso jopuonjrene ni ne ochuno ni nyaka odhi Jerusalem kendo osandre e yore mangʼeny e lwet jodong oganda gi jodolo madongo kod jopuonj chik, bende nyaka nonege kendo chiengʼ mar adek nochiere obed mangima.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

kikuyu: Kane ji owinjo gik mane osetimo, ji mangʼeny nobiro ire koa Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea kod gwenge molworo Jordan, Turo kod Sidon.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

kikuyu: Unucham gigo kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yiero, in kaachiel gi yawuoti kod nyigi, jotichgi machwo kod ma nyiri, gi jo-Lawi manie miechu, kendo nyaka ubed mamor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom gik moko duto ma lwetu timo.
english: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand to.

kikuyu: Ne en nyakwar Perez kendo en ema ne en jatelo maduongʼ motelone jotend lweny mag dwe mokwongo.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

kikuyu: Eka Rebeka nokawo lewni mabeyo mag Esau wuode maduongʼ mane oyudo en-go e ot kendo ne orwako ne Jakobo wuode matin.
english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

kikuyu: e kaka ei Kristo, waloso ringruok achiel, kata obedo ni wangʼeny, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa ni e achiel gi jowetene mamoko duto.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

kikuyu: “Odiechiengno anami tungʼ moro dongi e dhood Israel, kendo anayaw dhogi e diergi. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: To abet mos kendo chunya okwe; mana ka nyathi ma pod dhoth molingʼ mos e bad min, ee, kaka nyathi ma kamano lingʼ mos, e kaka chunya bende olingʼ mos e iya.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

kikuyu: Kama wantiereni nitie jo-Parthia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia, Judea, Kapadokia, Ponto, Asia,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora ma bor polo ne oa ewi Hema, jo-Israel ne chako wuoth; to e kinde ma bor polo nopiyo ewi Hema, jo-Israel ne goyo kambi.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

kikuyu: Nikech kane pod wan wasik Nyasaye to ne oketowa osiepene kuom tho mar Wuode, koro kaka wasebedo osiepene donge ibiro reswa moloyo nikech ngimane!
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

kikuyu: “ ‘Tarik apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo, nyaka upar chiengʼ Pasaka, ma en nyasi makawo ndalo abiriyo, kendo e kindeno ruodh piny nyaka cham makati ma ok oketie thowi.
english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

kikuyu: Chwou notiek gi ligangla kendo jolweny magu norum e lweny.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

kikuyu: Keturu genou kuom ler kapod un kode, mondo mi ubed nyithind ler.” Kane Yesu osetieko wuoyo kodgi, to nowuok owegi kendo nopondonigi.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

kikuyu: Eka Musa noluongo Joshua ma owuoyone e nyim jo-Israel duto niya, “Bed motegno kendo ma jachir, nimar nyaka idhi gi jogi e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osingore ne kweregi ni nomigi kendo nyaka ipog-gi kaka girkeni margi.
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

kikuyu: jo-Filistia noluongo jodolo gi ajuoke mi giwacho niya, “Wabiro timo angʼo gi Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye? Nyiswauru kaka onego wadwoke kare.”
english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the LORD’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni gikunyo bur matut mi gichopo nyaka e piny joma otho, to kata mana kuno abiro chopoe mi agolgi oko. Kata dabed ni giidho mi gichopo e polo, to kata kuno abiro chopoe mi aduog-gi piny.
english: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.

kikuyu: to mokwongo, abiro nyisi gima ondiki e Kitabu mar Adiera. (Onge ngʼama osebedo ka konya kedo kod ruodhigo makmana Mikael malaika ma jarit piny.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.

kikuyu: Ritgiuru maber, nimar mano ema biro nyiso riekou gi ngʼeyou ni ogendini mamoko mabiro winjo buchegi duto wach niya, “Adier, onge oganda mariek kendo man-gi ngʼeyo koganda maduongʼni.”
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

kikuyu: Lochne gi kwe mare nobed maonge giko. Enobed e kom loch mar Daudi kendo e pinyruodhe, bende enogure motegno ka orite gi adiera kod tim makare, chakre kawuono nyaka chiengʼ. Jehova Nyasaye Maratego notim ma kuom tekone owuon.
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

kikuyu: Nathan nodwoko ruoth niya, “Gimoro amora manie pachi, to dhi nyime mondo itim, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ni kodi.”
english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”

kikuyu: kod gombo; mer, dwanyruok, gi timbe mamoko mobam machal gi mago. To asiemou kaka nasiemou kinde motelo, ni joma timo timbe ma kamagi ok noyud gweth mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Chiemba en timo dwach Jal mane oora kendo tieko tichne.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo kama iluongo ni kar Hanga Wich, negigure kanyo, kaachiel gi joketho, ka ngʼato achiel nitie e bathe korachwich, to ngʼat machielo e bathe koracham.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

kikuyu: Helez ja-Palti, gi Ira wuod Ikesh ma ja-Tekoa,
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

kikuyu: Ne ok owarowa nikech tim moro makare mane wasetimo, to ne owarowa mana nikech ngʼwonone owuon. Nowarowa gi luok mane Roho Maler okelonwago ngima manyien kod nywol manyien.
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Eka Musa nochungo laru molworo Hemb Romo kod kendo mar misango mi noketo pasia e dhoranga laru. Omiyo Musa notieko tich.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

kikuyu: Adwaro ni mondo ubed maonge gi kit parruok moro amora. Dichwo ma ok okendo, weche Ruoth ema omako, kaka onyalo siko kotimo gik mamoro Ruoth,
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

kikuyu: Ne andiko ni kanisa, to Diotrefes, mohero ketore mondo obed jatelo, ne ok oyie kodwa.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

kikuyu: Ka kamano to mad ne iket pesana e od keno kama nonyalo medoree kende, mondo kane aduogo to ayude gi ohande.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

kikuyu: “Ka ingʼiewo ja-Hibrania ma misumba, to enotini kuom higni auchiel. To e higa mar abiriyo, enobed thuolo, ka ok ochulo gimoro.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

kikuyu: Kum wuodi, nikech mano e kama geno nitie; kik ibed e winjruok kuom gima nyalo kelone tho.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo iseweyo chunyi oteri mabor, mi ibedo gi wangʼ teko,
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

kikuyu: Koa kanyo Yesu nochako puonjogi ni Wuod Dhano nyaka yud sand mangʼeny kendo ibiro kwede gi jodong oganda gi jodolo madongo kod jopuonj chik, bende nyaka nonege kendo chiengʼ mar adek nochier kendo.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

kikuyu: Enobed e chuny jangʼad bura mowinjore kendo enojiw jolwenjeu makedo, e dhorangeyeu obed gichir kendo olochi.
english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

kikuyu: Eka nochiwo chik ne ji niya, “Dhiuru nyime! Lworuru dala maduongʼ, ka jolweny momanore gi gige lweny otelo e nyim Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before the LORD’s ark.”

kikuyu: Kane oa malo mondo ochak hulo, Boaz nomiyo joge chik niya, “Kata kapo ni ochoko kogolo kuom cham mapok oka, to kik uchande.
english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.

kikuyu: E seche mane gichiewo gokinyi mangʼich, chiengʼ ne rieny kendo ler mar chiengʼ ne nenore ewi pi. Jo-Moab mane ni loka machielo, ne pigno nenorenegi makwar ka remo.
english: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Koro ibiro neno gino ma abiro timo ne Farao: Nikech bada man-gi teko, obiro weyogi mondo gidhi; kendo nikech tekona maduongʼ obiro riembogi mi gia e pinye.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowachone Zadok niya, “Dwok Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye e dala maduongʼ. Ka Jehova Nyasaye okecha, to enoduoga ka kendo enomi ane Sandug Muma kod kar dak Nyasaye kendo.
english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in the LORD’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

kikuyu: In to in machiegni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo chikeni duto gin adier.
english: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

kikuyu: Jo-Gad kod jo-Reuben nodwoko niya, “Jotichni biro timo kaka Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

kikuyu: Eka jotend anywola mar Juda kod Benjamin, gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi, ngʼato angʼata ma Nyasaye nomulo chunye, noikore dhi kendo gero od Jehova Nyasaye man Jerusalem.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni chakruok mari ne rachrach, ndaloni mabiro nyime biro bedo malich miwuoro.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Saulo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel niya, “En angʼo momiyo pod ok idwoko jatichni kawuono? Ka dipo ni iyudo ketho moro kuoma kata kuom wuoda Jonathan, to chiw ombulu miluongo ni Urim, to ka dipo ni jo-Israel ema oketho, ni chiw ombulu miluongo ni Thumim.” Omiyo Saulo gi Jonathan ema noyier gi ombulu, to jo-Israel nowe.
english: Therefore Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.

kikuyu: Magi e joma Musa gi Harun kod jotend Israel apar gariyo nokwano, ka moro ka moro ochungʼ ne anywolane.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: Ahaz ne wuon Jehoada, Jehoada ne wuon Alemeth, Azmaveth kod Zimri, to Zimri ne wuon Moza.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Ochiwo chiemo ne joma omiye luor, kendo oparo singruok mare nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

kikuyu: mar piero ariyo gadek ne Delaya to mar piero ariyo gangʼwen ne Mazia.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

kikuyu: Daudi ne oweyo Asaf kod jotich kaachiel kode e nyim Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo giti kanyo ndalo duto mana kaka ne dwarore pile ka pile kendo odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ.
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

kikuyu: To bende, kaka Daniel nokwaye, ruoth noyiero Shadrak, Meshak gi Abednego kaka jotend gwenge mag Babulon, to Daniel owuon to nodongʼ mana katiyo e dala ruoth.
english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.

kikuyu: Kata jo-Efraim bende ne ok oriembo jo-Kanaan modak Gezer, to jo-Kanaan ne odhi nyime gidak e diergi.
english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Abiro oro masiche angʼwen mopogore opogore, ma gin ligangla mar nek kod guogi maywayo gi mabor gi winy mafuyo e kor polo gi ondiegi mag bungu mondo okidhgi kendo tiekogi.
english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says the LORD: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

kikuyu: “Bende ne achako aneno fweny moro gotieno mi aneno ngʼat moro machalo wuod dhano kalor biro e boche polo, kodhi ir Nyasaye Maratego kendo notelne nyaka e nyime.
english: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okethone ngʼat machielo to Nyasaye nyalo thegogi; to ka koro ngʼato oketho ne Jehova Nyasaye, en ngʼa mabiro kwayone?” Kata kamano yawuotego ne ok owinjo siem wuon-gi nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne osechano mondo oneg-gi.
english: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD intended to kill them.

kikuyu: Nimar nowacho ni, ‘Chakre ndalo mane agolo joga koa Misri, pok ayiero dala maduongʼ e dhoot moro amora mar Israel mondo oger hekalu kanyo ni Nyinga, to aseyiero Daudi mondo otel ni joga Israel.’
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno kik ngʼato kuomu mul tich moro amora nikech en Chiengʼ Pwodhruok, migolonue richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nigi teko e odni moloya. Ruodha ok osetama gimoro amora manie odni makmana in, nikech in chiege. Koro ere kaka anyalo timo tim richo kendo makwero ma Nyasaye odagi?”
english: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

kikuyu: Adier awachonu ni ne nitie mon ma chwogi otho mangʼeny e Israel e kinde mar Elija, kane polo olor kuom higni adek gi nus kendo ne nitie kech mager e piny kuonde duto.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto mangima mane ni e piny notho duto; dhano, jamni gi le, gik moko duto mamol e lowo kod winy mafuyo e kor polo notiek e piny. Nowa kende ema nodongʼ kod joma ne ni kode e yie.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Chiew okinyi mangʼich, idhi ir Farao kendo inyise kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Hibrania wacho: We joga odhi olama.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo piero angʼwen negidwogo ka gia nono pinyno.
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

kikuyu: “Omiyo ritreuru nikech ok ungʼeyo chiengʼ ma Ruodhu nobie.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

kikuyu: Wangʼi e taya mar ringri, ka wengegi neno maber, to ringri duto opongʼ gi ler. To ka giricho, ringri bende mudho opongʼo.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

kikuyu: Eka joma ne otwe mane odwogo koa e twech nochiwo misango mar misengini miwangʼo pep ni Nyasach Israel mane gin, rwedhi apar gariyo ne jo-Israel duto, imbe piero ochiko gauchiel, nyithi rombe machwo piero abiriyo gabiriyo, to gi nywogi apar gariyo kaka misango mar golo richo. Magi duto ne gin misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Malkija wuod Harim kod Hashub wuod Pahath-Moab nochako ogero migawo machielo kaachiel gi kama otingʼore gi malo mar ngʼicho mar Kendo.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa nyaka tim gik mamoro nyawadgi, ka en gi paro maber mar gere.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

kikuyu: E Gibeon kanyo ema Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ni Solomon gotieno e lek kendo Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Kwa gimoro amora midwaro ni mondo amiyi.”
english: In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

kikuyu: Eka Simeon nogwedhogi kendo nowachone Maria, min mare niya, “Nyathini oketi mondo okel podho piny gichungʼ malo mar ji mangʼeny e Israel, kendo obed ranyisi mibiro wuo kuome marach.
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

kikuyu: Daudi ne ochako okelo jo-Israel kamoro achiel, chwo moyier, maromo alufu piero adek.
english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

kikuyu: Ne, asendiko nyingi ei lweta kendo isiko ka ineno anena e wangʼa.
english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

kikuyu: “Nikech un gi ilo kendo umor, un joma ketho girkeni maga, nikech uchwe ka nyaroya machamo lum kendo ugiro ka farese,
english: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jeftha nooro joote ir ruodh jo-Amon kapenje niya, “En angʼo milaro kodwa, momiyo idwaro kedo kodwa?”
english: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye osewacho ne Ayub wechegi, nowachone Elifaz ja-Teman niya, “Iya owangʼ kodi kaachiel gi osiepegi ariyo, nikech ok usewacho weche ma adieri kuoma, kaka jatichna Ayub osewacho.
english: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

kikuyu: Winji nyara, bed mos, kendo chik iti: Gol pachi kuom jou kaachiel gi jood wuonu monywoli.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

kikuyu: Eka notero lwete kendo okawo pala mondo oneg-go wuode.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

kikuyu: Solomon nodwoko penjone duto; nimar onge gima ne tek mane ruoth ok nyal lerone.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

kikuyu: Koro Esau nofwenyo ni Isaka osegwedho Jakobo kendo oseore Padan Aram mondo odhi okend kuno. Nowinjo bende ni kane Isaka gwedho Jakobo, nochike niya, “Kik ikend nyar jo-Kanaan.”
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

kikuyu: Omiyo Hebron osebedo mar Kaleb wuod Jefune ma ja-Kenizi nyaka aa chiengʼno, nikech noluwo Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, gi chunye duto.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

kikuyu: Kik ikwer ngʼat ma jaro ji, nikech mano biro miyo obedo mamon kodi, kirieyo ngʼat mariek, to obiro heri.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

kikuyu: Negiluwo piny Pisidia mi gichopo Pamfilia,
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

kikuyu: Eka nogola oko kawuok gie rangach man yo nyandwat kendo notelona kawuok oko nyaka rangach ma oko mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ, kendo pi ne mol kawuok yo milambo.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

kikuyu: “Bed motegno kendo gi chir; nikech ibiro telone jogi nyaka e piny mar girkeni mane akwongʼora ni kweregi ni namigi.
english: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

kikuyu: Migawo mar dhood Juda ne romo ji alufu piero abich gangʼwen gi mia angʼwen (74,600).
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Yawuot Elioenai ne gin: Hodavia, Eliashib, Pelaya, Akub, Johanan, Delaya kod Anani, giduto gin yawuowi abiriyo.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

kikuyu: Magi e jotelo mag thuondi mag Daudi, gin, kaachiel gi jo-Israel negisiro lochne mobet gi teko ma ji oyie kode e pinygi duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingore.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

kikuyu: Masira maduongʼ gi bur matut kod otegu ritou, yaye jo-Moab,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Satan noweye, kendo malaike nobiro motiyone.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

kikuyu: Negia e ogendini mane Jehova Nyasaye okwero jo-Israel kawacho niya, “Kik ukendru kodgi, nikech adier ginilok chunyu ma uluw nyisechegi.” Kata kamano, Solomon nomoko kuomgi gihera.
