english: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

kikuyu: Noseloso raidhi mar mula ma borne gi lachne romo fut aboro to borne kadhi malo en fut abich mokete e dier laru ma oko. Ne ochungʼ e raidhino mi ogoyo chonge piny e nyim oganda duto mar jo-Israel kendo norieyo bedene kochomo polo.
english: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

kikuyu: “Efraim riwore gi ogendini, kendo ochalo gi makati ma ok okuot.
english: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ka ringruok matow oserwakore gi mano ma ok tow, kendo mano matho oserwakore gi mano ma ok tho, eka wach mondiki nochop kare, niya, “Tho oselo motiek chuth.”
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

kikuyu: Loch machiengʼno nolokore ywak ni jolweny, nikech migepe mag jolweny, nowinjo kiwacho niya, “Ruoth okuyo nikech tho wuode.”
english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

kikuyu: Kindeno Saulo ne pod siemo jopuonjre mag Ruoth, kochano mar negogi. Nodhi ir jadolo maduongʼ
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

kikuyu: Koro omiyo Jehova Nyasaye biro chwado jogi, yawuoti kod mondi kod gimoro amora miluongo ni mari, noyud chwat malit.
english: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

kikuyu: Nodongʼ kopande ei hekalu mar Nyasaye kuom higni auchiel e kinde loch Athalia.
english: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

kikuyu: Chakre kawuono jo-Israel ok onego dhi machiegni gi Hemb Romo, ka ok kamano to ibiro kumogi kuom richo mag-gi kendo gibiro tho.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo dala, nokawo pala mokengogo chiege, fuoni ka fuoni migepe apar gariyo mi oorogi e gwenge duto mag Israel.
english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Nyaka karangʼo ma anaketi mondo ikwongʼrina gi nying Jehova Nyasaye ni iwacho adiera ma ok miriambo?”
english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

kikuyu: Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye nomedore kuomgi, kendo no-aa oweyogi.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nokelo Saulo gi jatije kar budho moketogi gibet e kom manyime kuom ji duto mane oluongo mane nyalo romo ji piero adek.
english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

kikuyu: Eka Joab gi jolweny mane ni kode nodhi mondo oked gi jo-Aram kendo negiringo e nyimgi.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

kikuyu: Ondiki e kitepe Jonabi ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye nopuonj ji duto.’Emomiyo ngʼat mosewinjo wach Wuoro, kod mosemako puonj mare, biro ira.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

kikuyu: Jowuoth baro weyo yoregi ma giluwo; gidhi nyaka piny motwo mi githo kuno.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

kikuyu: Eka ikaw boche duto mogawo jamb-ich gi moumo chuny gi nyiroke ariyo kod boche mogawogi kendo iwangʼ-gi e kendo mar misango
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda duto nomor kod singruokno nikech negisingore gi chunygi duto. Negimanyo Nyasaye gi chuny achiel kendo negiyude. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi kwe kuonde duto.
english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.

kikuyu: Kinyne kane jo-Filistia obiro mondo oyak gige joma otho, negiyudo Saulo gi yawuote adek kotho e Got Gilboa.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: onge gige lweny molosi ne in mano hinyi, kendo inilo buche duto modonjnie. Ma e pok ma jotich Jehova Nyasaye yudo, kendo ma bende e gweth ma asemiyou,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kitimo duto machiki kendo iwuotho e yorena mitimo gima kare e nyima kirito buchena kod chikena, kaka Daudi jatichna notimo, to abiro bedo kodi. Abiro geroni anywola mosiko kaka nagero ni Daudi kendo anamiyi Israel.
english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, Jehova Nyasaye wacho ni, ‘Abiro duogo Jerusalem mi akeche, mi oda nochak oger kanyo; kendo tol mipimogo ibiro rie e alwora mar Jerusalem,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

kikuyu: Saulo noloso kambine but yo man e got Hakila momanyore gi Jeshimon, Daudi to ni kama otwo ma otimo ongoro. Kane oneno ni Saulo noseluwe kuno,
english: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

kikuyu: Rwakuru joweteu ma ok ungʼur.
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

kikuyu: Nimar nongʼeyo ni ich lit ema nomiyo jodolo madongo noketo Yesu e lwete.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye rito joma chunygi obolore; kane an-gi chando maduongʼ to ne oresa.
english: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

kikuyu: ka gimiyogi chike niya, “Ka uneno ka Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, otingʼ gi jodolo, ma jo-Lawi, to nyaka uwuog oko e kuonde muchungʼie mondo uluwe.
english: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

kikuyu: Nyisaeuru pesa mamingli mitiyogo kuom golo osuru.” Negikelone dinari,
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

kikuyu: Dwoko mane Yesu odwokono nomiyo wachno olandore e kind jowete ni japuonjreno ok bi tho ngangʼ, to Yesu to nowacho mana niya, “Ka adwaro ni osik kongima nyaka aduogi, to mano chandi nangʼo?”
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

kikuyu: Donge wan gi ratiro mondo omiwa chiemo gi math?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

kikuyu: Wigi owil koda mana ka gima ne asetho chon bende koro achalo mana gi agulu motore.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

kikuyu: kendo mondo kik sand mwayudo mi chunyu aa. Ungʼeyo maber ni kaka jo-Kristo nyaka wayud sand.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

kikuyu: Roho Maler nofwenyone ni ok obi tho kapok oneno Kristo ma Ruoth Nyasaye biro oro.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

kikuyu: Kochakore gie tongʼ Tapua nodhi yo podho chiengʼ nyaka Kana Tavain kendo ogik e nam. Ma ema ne girkeni mar dhood Efraim, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

kikuyu: Daudi noparo niya, “Abiro timo maber ni Hanun wuod Nahash, mana kaka wuon-gi bende notimona tim ngʼwono.” Omiyo Daudi nooro joote mondo odhi ogone mos makende kuom tho mar wuon-gi. Kane joote Daudi ochopo e piny jo-Amon,
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Kik uchal kodgi, nikech Wuonu ongʼeyo gik muchando kata kapok ukwaye.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

kikuyu: Saulo nomedo luore, kendo nosiko ka en jasike e ndalo duto mag ngimane.
english: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.

kikuyu: To kane ngʼwono kod hera mar Nyasaye ma Jawarwa ofwenyore to nowarowa.
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

kikuyu: Ne oyiero Daudi jatichne, kendo nogole e abich rombe;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: Azaria nonywolo Seraya, to Seraya nonywolo Jehozadak.
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

kikuyu: Nimar osenywolnwa nyathi, adier osemiwa wuowi, kendo loch nobedi e lwete. Noluong nyinge ni Jabura Mahono, Nyasaye Maratego, Wuoro Manyaka Chiengʼ kendo Ruodh Kwe.
english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi gitith. Zaburi mar Yawuot Kora. Mano kaka hekalu mari ber miwuoro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni an e ngʼama tinie moloyo jo-Nyasaye duto to ngʼwononi nomiya mondo ayal ne joma ok jo-Yahudi mwandu ma ok rum mar Kristo;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

kikuyu: Kendo anaket sigu e kindi gi dhako, kendo e kind kothe gi kothi; en noto wiyi, to in to nika ofunj tiende.”
english: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

kikuyu: To angʼeyo ni kata mana sani Nyasaye biro miyi gimoro amora mikwaye.”
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kaka un jo-Nyasaye moyiero, maler kendo mogeno, rwakreuru gi kech, gi miwafu, gi bolruok, gi muolo, kod kinda.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

kikuyu: Bedo gi winjo kelo luor, to yor ngʼato ma ok ja-adier tek.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

kikuyu: To koro wangʼeyo ni buch Nyasaye ne joma timo gik ma kamago oluwore gi adiera.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

kikuyu: Riyo mar dwaro warruokni oloyo chunya, kata kamano aseketo genona e wachni.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Anyisou ni ok anamadh olemb mzabibuni kendo, chakre kawuono nyaka chop odiechiengʼno ma anamadhee manyien, kaachiel kodu, e pinyruoth mar Wuora.”
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Nikech ungʼeyo puonj mane wamiyou kuom teko mar Ruoth Yesu.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Mano kaka unune malit, jogo madhi dwaro kony Misri, moketo genogi kuom farese, kendo moketo genogi kuom geche mag lweny mangʼeny magiywayo, kendo kuom teko maduongʼ ma joidh faresegi nigo, to ok uketo genou kuom Jal Maler mar Israel, kata dwaro kony kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek the LORD!

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Duongʼ oseweyo Israel, nimar Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye osekaw.”
english: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”

kikuyu: Kik ugen kuom weche mag miriambo ka uwacho niya, “Ma en hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye!”
english: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’

kikuyu: To ne ok gingʼeyo gima ne owachonegi.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

kikuyu: kendo koa kuom jotich kaachiel kodgi, joka Merari kochungʼ e bade koracham ne gin: Ethan wuod Kishi, wuod Abdi, wuod Maluk,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

kikuyu: Asa nodhi mondo orom kode kendo negikawo kuondegi mag lweny e Holo mar Zefatha man but Maresha.
english: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

kikuyu: nikech ngʼwono mamuol mar Nyasachwa, ma chiengʼ mawuok biro kelonwa koa e polo,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

kikuyu: noriwore gi owetegi ma joka ruoth mi gikwongʼore giduto kendo negikwongʼore ni ginilu Chike Nyasaye, mane ochiwo kokalo kuom Musa jatichne kendo ginirit chike duto gi yore duto kod puonj mag Jehova Nyasaye Ruodhwa.
english: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

kikuyu: En e achiel gi joma timbegi richo; kendo oriwore gi joricho.
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

kikuyu: To ne ok oriwore kode nyaka bangʼ kane osenywolo nyathi ma wuowi kendo nomiye nying ni Yesu.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

kikuyu: E kindeno jo-Yahudi mamoko mane ni e gwenge mag pinyruoth bende nochokore mondo gisir kendo gigengʼ wasigu. Neginego ji moromo alufu piero abiriyo gabich, to ne ok giyako girgi moro amora.
english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: kendo koa kuom nyikwa Beria ne gin: joka Heber; kod joka Malkiel.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noyiene ogandago mondo odongʼ, kendo ne ok oriembogi kata chiwogi e lwet Joshua.
english: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

kikuyu: Magi e chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa kaluwore gidak manie kind dichwo gi dhako, kendo e kind wuoro gi nyare ma pod tin modak e odgi.
english: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

kikuyu: To jo-Lawi kaka, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneya, Sherebia, Hodia, Shebania kod Pethahia nowacho niya, “Chungʼuru malo mondo upak Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mantiere mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.” “Ogwedh nyingi man-gi duongʼ, kendo mad tingʼe malo moloyo gweth kod pak duto.
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik usar dendu kuywago ngʼama otho, kendo kik usar kido moro amora e dendu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: (Tworo gi shairi nokethore chuth, nimar noyudo ka shairi oseketo wangʼe, to tworo nosethiewo.
english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

kikuyu: Kendo bangʼ ndalo abiriyo pi mar ataro nobiro e piny.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jonabi mane odak Jeriko nodhi ir Elisha mopenje niya, bende ingʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye wangʼ nokaw ruodhi kawuono? Ee angʼeyo, to lingʼuru gi wachno.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

kikuyu: Jorit rangach ne gin: nyikwa joka Shalum, Ater, Talmon, Akub, Hatita kod Shobai, ji mia achiel gi piero adek gaboro (138).
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ogendini mamoko duto nyalo wuotho e nying nyisechegi, wan to wabiro wuotho e nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jasunga dagi puonj, ok odwar mondo ongʼadne rieko gi jomariek.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

kikuyu: Harun nokaw diel ma ombulu oyiero kaka mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo otimgo misango mar golo richo.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.

kikuyu: “Angʼo madatimni Efraim? Angʼo ma datim kodi, in Juda? Herani chalo gi ongʼwengʼo mar okinyi, kata gi thoo mar okinyi malal nono ka nyango tegno.
english: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nomedo wachone niya, “Kik isin koda, to weya aweya awuo. To ka dipo ni ji piero adek ema oyudi e dalano?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Ok nakethi ka ayudo ji piero adek maonge ketho kanyo.”
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

kikuyu: Ne oele mi oyudo nyathi. Nyathino ne ywak, kendo nokeche mowacho niya, “Ma en achiel kuom nyithind jo-Hibrania.”
english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

kikuyu: Singri ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi, kendo chop singruokgo; bende jopinje duto mokiewo kodi, okel mich ne Jal monego ji luor.
english: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

kikuyu: (Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Misri otimo ngʼwono ne jo-Israel, kendo Musa owuon nomi luor gi jodong Farao e piny Misri kaachiel gi jo-Misri.)
english: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

kikuyu: Kane oguro teko mar yamo kendo opimo giko nembe,
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

kikuyu: To farese gi joithgi mane aneno e fwenynano ne chalo kama: Joma noidhogi norwakore gi akor mag nyinyo makwar ka mach, kendo marambulu molil, kod ratongʼ gweno. Wi faresego ne chalo gi wi sibuoche, to mach gi yiro kod pilni mach ne wuok e dhogi.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

kikuyu: Ngʼat marach dwodore e obadho mar richone owuon, to ngʼat makare nyalo wer mobed mamor.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

kikuyu: Kata ka ubaro korachwich kata koracham, itu to nowinj dwol mawuok ka ngʼeu, kawacho niya, “Ma e yo; luweuru.”
english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo kwayo mar Hezekia mochango jogo.
english: The LORD listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

kikuyu: Wuowi moro matin mane ni duk, mane orwako law abola, noyudo luwo bangʼ Yesu. Kane gi liwe mi gimake, nopusore nigi,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “E kindeni machalo kama, abiro daro ji modak e pinyni; anakel sandruok kuomgi mondo mi omakgi.”
english: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo utiyo gi pesa kungʼiewo gik ma ok chiemo kendo utiyo matek gi luchi ne gima ok yiengʼu. Winjuru, ee winjauru kendo ucham gima ber, mi unubed gi mwandu mar chuny.
english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

kikuyu: Bedene chalo gi luth mar dhahabu, mokedi gi kite ma nengongi tek. Dende chalo gi lak liech moywe maler, mokedi gi kit safir.
english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.

kikuyu: Demetrio noluongo jotheth wetene duto, kod jotich mamoko ma tijgi ne chal gi margi, mi owachonegi niya, “Yawa, ungʼeyo ni tijwani kelonwa ohala maduongʼ.
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

kikuyu: En ngʼa monego aluor ka ndalo mag richo obiro, ka jo-miriambo ma timbegi richo olwora.
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

kikuyu: Kuom mano, noluong jondiko mag ruoth chiengʼ tarik piero ariyo gadek dwe mar adek miluongo ni Sivan. Negindiko weche duto mane Modekai ochiko ne ondiki ne jo-Yahudi, askeche, jotelo, kod joka ruoth modak e pinje mia achiel gi piero ariyo gabiriyo kochakore e piny India nyaka chop Kush. Chikegi nondiki e dhok mar piny ka piny kata mana mar jo-Yahudi bende nondiki e dhogi giwegi.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

kikuyu: Kuom ratiro mara abiro tingʼo Sairas malo kama: Anami yorene duto oriere tir. Enochak oger dala maduongʼ kendo omi joga manoter e twech obed thuolo, to ok en yor chudo kata yudo mich moro amora, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.”
english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: En ngʼat mane mariek? Obiro fwenyo tiend gigi. En ngʼat mane manyalo fwenyo tiend wechegi? Obiro ngʼeyogi. Yore mag Jehova Nyasaye nikare, joma nikare ema wuothoe, to joma jendeke to chwanyore.
english: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

kikuyu: “Naftali to en mwanda mogony, ma nywolo nyithindo mabeyo.
english: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

kikuyu: To mier mamoko kod gwenge mane jo-Juda odakie ne gin Kiriath Arba kod gwenge mokiewo kodgi, Dibon kod gwenge mokiewo kodgi, Jekabzil kod mier mokiewo kode,
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

kikuyu: mane omanore gi atungʼ mikedogo, kendo neginyalo diro asere kata orujre gi badgi korachwich kata koracham, bende ne gin wede Saulo koa e oganda mar Benjamin):
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: “Riekoni bende nyalo miyo ongo ringi mi oyar bwombene kochomo yo milambo?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

kikuyu: Kane pod en Jerusalem e Sap Pasaka, ji mangʼeny noneno ranyisi mag honni mane otimo mine giyie kuom nyinge.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

kikuyu: Wuora mosemiyagi duongʼ moloyo duto, kendo onge ngʼama nyalo kawogi mi golgi e lwet Wuora.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

kikuyu: To nikech oonge gi tiendene, obet kuom kinde machwok kende. Ka chandruok gi sand obiro nikech Wach Nyasaye, to opodho piyo piyo nono.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

kikuyu: To ka dipo, ni sa ma jadolo nonene oyudo kaonge yier marachar kuome, to bende ok odholore kendo oselal, to jadolo nyaka kete tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

kikuyu: Kane dhakono ongʼeyo e chunye gima nosetimorene, nobiro mopodho e tiend Yesu kotetni gi luoro kendo nonyise adier man kuome duto.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

kikuyu: Pok mar joka Benjamin, notimne anywola ka anywola. Kuonde mane opognigo ne ni e kind Juda gi Josef.
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokawo kikombe, mi ogoyo erokamano bangʼe omiyogi eka negimetho koa e kikombeno giduto.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

kikuyu: To joge to nogolo oko mana ka kweth, kendo notelonegi ka rombe koyoro kodgi thim.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

kikuyu: To nikech ne udaga kane aluongo kendo onge ngʼama nodewa kane adwaro konyou,
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

kikuyu: Heled wuod Baana ma ja-Netofath, Ithai wuod Ribai mawuok Gibea e piny Benjamin,
english: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

kikuyu: Ket yoreni kuom Jehova Nyasaye; ket genoni kuome eka obiro timo kama:
english: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

kikuyu: Kobiro, to rwakeuru gi mor maduongʼ kaka owadu kuom Ruoth, kendo neuru ni umiyo joma chalo kode kamano duongʼ,
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa gi Harun nowacho ne jo-Israel duto kama: “Godhiambo ubiro ngʼeyo ni ne en Jehova Nyasaye ema noresou Misri,
english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kelou e piny maber, piny man-gi aore kod pi maber, man-gi thidhna mamol e holo koa e gode;
english: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

kikuyu: Wach nobiro ne Jeremia koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye bangʼ ka Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny mar piny nosegonye Rama. Noyudo ka Jeremia otwe gi nyororo e dier joma nomak duto mane oa Jerusalem kod Juda mane oter e twech Babulon.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.

kikuyu: Anto ageno kuom herani mosiko; chunya oil kuom warruok mari.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

kikuyu: mana kaka ondiki niya, “Ngʼat mane ochoko mangʼeny ok ne nigi mangʼeny bende ngʼat mane ochoko matin, ok ne nigi matin ahinya.”
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

kikuyu: Yawuote ne loso nyasi e utegi, ka moro ka moro kuomgi ni godiechienge kendo ne luongo nyiminegi adek mondo ochiem kendo ometh kodgi e nyasigigo.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

kikuyu: Omiyo noa malo kendo nodhi ir wuon mare. “To kane pod en kuma bor, wuon mare nonene, kendo kopongʼ gi kech kuome, noringo kodhiyo ir wuode, nokwake gi bade kendo nonyodhe.
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

kikuyu: Kuom yie, Enoka nokaw kangima omiyo ne ok oneno tho, nolal nono e wangʼ ji nikech Nyasaye nosekawe. Nyasaye kwane kaka ngʼat malongʼo kane pok okawe.
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

kikuyu: Apaki nikech ne ichweya mongʼith kendo malich miwuoro; tijeni misetimo lich, kendo angʼeyo mano maber.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

kikuyu: Daudi nopako Jehova Nyasaye e nyim riwruok mar ji duto kowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwarwa Israel, duongʼ odogni ndalo duto, manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ne ok giyie dhi e pinyno, kendo ne gingʼanyo mi gidagi winjo chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Nomedo wacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Shem mondo opaki! Kanaan obed misumba Shem.
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Amon oneno ka gisechido chuny Daudi, Hanun kod jo-Amon nooro fedha madirom kilo alufu piero adek mondo giholgo geche gi joriembgi kuom jo-Aram-Naharaim, jo-Aram Maaka kod jo-Zoba.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye norieyo bade kendo omulo dhoga mi owachona niya, “Koro, aseketo wechega e dhogi.
english: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

kikuyu: Kowacho niya, “Achiegni dhi kuma ji duto manie piny dhiye.” Omiyo bed motegno kendo jiwri ka dichwo,
english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

kikuyu: To joka Reuben, gi joka Gad kod nus mar dhood joka Manase, Joshua nowachonegi niya,
english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel wacho niya, “Amon gi weruok mantiere e kind dichwo gi chiege kendo amon gi dichwo matimo gima chalo kamano ni chiege,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho. Kuom mano, ritreuru e chunyu kendo kik uketh singruok.
english: One who hates and divorces”, says the LORD, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says the LORD of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

kikuyu: Hezekia nojiwo jo-Lawi duto mane ongʼeyo tich mar tiyo ne Jehova Nyasaye. Kuom ndalo abiriyo negichamo chiemo mane opognigi kendo negitimo misango mar lalruok kagipako Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of the LORD. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Dhano to ndalone chalo gi lum, oloth piyo ka maua mopidhi;
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

kikuyu: Ma e gima ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu siko wachone osiepne kata watne: ‘Dwoko Jehova Nyasaye en angʼo?’ kata, ‘En angʼo ma Jehova Nyasaye wacho?’
english: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has the LORD answered?’ and, ‘What has the LORD said?’

kikuyu: Kik ijwangʼa ne dwach wasika, nikech joneno mag miriambo oramona matek, ka gichano mar hinya.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato nigi it mar winjo wach to mondo owinji.”
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Kamano bende, chwo onego oher mondgi mana kaka gihero dendgi giwegi. Ngʼat mohero chiege oherore owuon.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nomiye makati mowal nikech ne onge makati moro amora makmana makati moket e Nyim Jehova Nyasaye migolo oko chiengʼ miketo makati maliet kargi.
english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before the LORD, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

kikuyu: Ruodh Aram nodwoko niya, “Dhi ma ok ilewo. Abiro oro baruwa ne ruodh Israel.” Omiyo Naaman nowuok mokawo mich mar fedha ma pekne romo kilo mia adek gi piero angʼwen, dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo piero abiriyo kod lewni motwe nyadipar.
english: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

kikuyu: Sa asaya ma ngʼato obiro nena, to owuondore ni owuoyo kuoma maber, to ei chunye to ofwambo weche, mondo okethgo nyinga eka oa odhi kendo okeyo wechego ne ji.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

kikuyu: Nyaka uher jodak manie dieru nimar un bende ne un jodak e piny Misri.
english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-jar ji ochayo adiera, to dho ngʼat ma timbene richo golo mana richo.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

kikuyu: kodhi nyime nyaka Zifron mi ogik Hazar Enan. Ma ema nobed tongʼu man yo nyandwat.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

kikuyu: Daudi nopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo ne ok iluor mar tingʼo badi kinego ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir?”
english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”

kikuyu: Eka ilosi ramaki piero abich mag dhahabu kendo ti kodgi kuom riwo pasia ariyogo kanyakla mondo omi Hemb Romo obed gimoro achiel.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

kikuyu: “Bed mos, kendo ngʼe ni an Nyasaye; ogendini biro miya duongʼ; piny duto biro miya duongʼ.”
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

kikuyu: mana kaka utege matindo mag rito, gi ohinga mage mochwore e kor ohinga ma oko kod agola mare, kendo ne en gi dirisni moriedo kolwore duto. Borne noromo fut piero abiriyo gabich to lachne ne en fut piero adek gabiriyo gi nus.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

kikuyu: Donge usesomo Ndiko mawacho niya, “ ‘Kidi mane jogedo odagi osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot;
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

kikuyu: Lela wengegi ne nigi kido machal gi mago mane oyudo aseneno e bath Aora Kebar, ka moro ka moro ochomo nyime tir.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nolor e bor polo; mochungʼ e dho Hemb Romo kendo noluongo Harun gi Miriam. Kane gibiro kargi ji ariyogo,
english: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

kikuyu: Omiyo Isaka nodar kanyo modhi e Holo mar Gerar kendo nodak kanyo.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

kikuyu: To boche mag rwadhno kod imno kaka sembe, gi boche mogawo jamb-ich gi nyiroke kaachiel gi jwala mabor manie wi chuny,
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

kikuyu: “Chiengʼ ma abiro kumoe nyithi Israel kuom richogi, bende e ndalo ma abiro kethoe kende mag misango miwangʼoe liswa man Bethel, kendo anangʼad tunge kendego mag misango mi ginipodh piny.
english: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

kikuyu: Nyaka jo-Asuria bende oseriwore kodgi mondo oriw lwetgi ne nyikwa Lut. Sela
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Filistia nodino sokni mane wasumbini Ibrahim wuon Isaka okunyo.
english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

kikuyu: Josef nokano cham mathoth mana ka kuoyo mane dho nam; ne githoth mane ok onyal kwano nikech negikadho akwana.
english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro chiwo Misri e lwet Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, kendo obiro tingʼo mwandune odhigo. Obiro yako kendo oketho pinyno kaka chudo mar jolweny mage.
english: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.

kikuyu: Jonabi mage to umo timbegi gi fweny mag miriambo kod gagi mag wuond. Giwacho ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho,’ ka Jehova Nyasaye to pok owuoyo.
english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “En ketho mane mane wuoneu oyudo kuoma, momiyo ne gibaro mabor koda? Negiluwo bangʼ nyiseche manono mi gibedo manono gin giwegi.
english: The LORD says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become worthless?

kikuyu: Kane Daudi owinjo ni Saulo chano yor yude nowachone Abiathar jadolo niya, “Kel law akor mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.”
english: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”

kikuyu: Noolo mor pwodhruok moko ewi Harun, kowire kendo kopwodhe ne tich dolo.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

kikuyu: donge mano nyiso ni useketo kiewo e dieru un uwegi, ka ubedo jongʼad bura ma pachgi richo?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

kikuyu: e chwat, e twech, e koko, e tich matek ma ok wanindi, gi riyo kech;
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

kikuyu: Asiko aketo Jehova Nyasaye e nyima ndalo duto. Nikech ka entie e lweta korachwich, to onge gima nyalo yienga.
english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Kane Reu ja-higni piero adek gariyo nonywolo Serug.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

kikuyu: Gikoro miriambo gi nyinga. Ok aorogi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka Kain nowacho ne owadgi Abel niya, “Wadhi waba e pap oko.” To kane gin e pap, Kain nogoyo owadgi ma Abel mi onege.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

kikuyu: To weche mamoko mag loch Amazia kar chakruokgi nyaka gikogi donge ondikgi e kitap ruodhi mag Juda kod Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

kikuyu: “Ne tienge duto, misango miwangʼo pep ni nyaka chiw ndalo duto e dhoranga Hemb Romo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kanyo ema abiro romoe kodu kendo wuoyoe kodu;
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

kikuyu: Ok odwok ji ka giywakne nikech wich teko mar joricho.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kikuyu: To nikech ne pod gineno ka ngʼat mane osechangi ochungʼ e diergi kanyo, onge gima neginyalo wacho mondo gikwed gima nosetimoreno.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye owuon biro dhi nyimu kendo nobed kodu, ok noweu kata jwangʼou. Kik ubed maluor, bende kik chuny nyosre.”
english: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

kikuyu: Jolwenj Babulon oseweyo kedo; gidongʼ e kuondegi mochiel motegno mag lweny. Tekogi orumo; gisebedo ka mon. Kuondegi mag dak osemoke mach; lodi mage mag rangeye otur.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel mamoko, kaachiel gi jodolo kod jo-Lawi, ne ni e mier matindo mag Juda, ka moro ka moro odak e lop anywolane.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

kikuyu: Kuom weche mag loch Rehoboam aa chakruokgi nyaka gikogi, donge ondikgi e kitap Shemaya janabi kod mar Ido janen mandiko nonro mag ji? Ne nitiere lweny ma ok rum e kind Rehoboam gi Jeroboam.
english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

kikuyu: Ondiegi mager pok nowuotho kuondego, kendo kata sibuor pok oruto kuno.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

kikuyu: Musa nowacho ne oganda niya, “Kik ubed maluor. Nyasaye osebiro mondo otemu mondo omi usik kuluore kendo mondo kik utim richo.”
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

kikuyu: To kapo ni moko kuomgi ne onge gi yie, to bende bedogi maonge yie nyalo ketho adiera mar Nyasaye?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

kikuyu: To jopuonjrene nodwoke niya, “Rabi, ere kaka didog kuno to nyocha eka jo-Yahudi dwaro goyi gi kite?”
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

kikuyu: Ji mathoth e dier ogandano pod noyie mana kuome. Negiwacho niya, “Ka Kristo miwachono obiro, bende notim honni mangʼeny moloyo ngʼatni adier?”
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Jakobo nokawo kidi mane otenogo wiye kendo nochunge ka siro mi oolo mo e wiye.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato odino ite ne ywak mar jachan, en owuon bende obiro ywak to ok nodwoke.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

kikuyu: “To nodwokogi ni, ‘Awachonu adier ni akiau.’
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

kikuyu: Chikegi omiu mondo un, nyithindu kod nyikwau oluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e ndalo duto mag ngimau kurito buchene gi chikene ma amiyou mondo omi udag amingʼa gi mor.
english: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat mayudo mwandu gi yore ma ok owinjore none malit kendo ogero ode kama otingʼore gi malo, mondo otony ne kethruok!
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

kikuyu: Lach mar ohinga ma oko mar ute matindo tindo mane ni e alwora hekalugo noromo fut abiriyo gi nus. Kama owe thuolo mane ni e kind ute matindo mane ni e alwora hekalu
english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

kikuyu: Ne gin joma nono maonge nying, omiyo noriembgi gia e piny.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo maber ni kane wayalonu to ne ok wakonyore gi weche malombou mondo wawuondgo wangʼu, kendo Nyasaye en janeno marwa ni ne ok wapando gombo malingʼ-lingʼ e chunywa mondo wamau gigeu!
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

kikuyu: Eka Petro nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “Ruoth, owinjore awe ne owadwa ndalo adi kokethona? Nyaka ndalo abiriyo koso?”
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

kikuyu: Kata kamano Finehas nochungʼ kargi kendo noywagore ne Nyasaye, mi masirano ne ok otiekogi.
english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, kor wach kuom gode mag Israel, kendo wachnegi ni, ‘Yaye gode mag Israel, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Ira ja-Ithri, Gareb ja-Ithri,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

kikuyu: Nimar Ndiko wacho ne Farao niya, “Natingʼi malo mana ne wachni, ni mondo anyis tekona kuomi kendo mondo nyinga olandi e piny duto.”
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

kikuyu: Abiro muko sirni mag nyasachu ma Ashera mi agol kuomu kendo abiro ketho miechu madongo chuth.
english: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo kendo inyis Ebed-Melek ja-Kush, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Achiegni timo gik mane awacho ni natim ne dala maduongʼni, ka akelo ne masiche to ok kwe. E kindeno notimgi ka ineno.
english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu pod wuoyo, jomoko nobiro moa e od Jairo ma jatend sinagogi. Negiwachone Jairo niya, “Nyari osetho, angʼo momiyo pod ichando Japuonj?”
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma dhogi owacho nyaka itim, nimar ne ukwongʼoru kendu ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi dhou uwegi.
english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

kikuyu: “Ne! Abiro piyo! Atingʼo michna, to abiro miyo ngʼato ka ngʼato kaluwore kod gima osetimo.
english: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

kikuyu: Ka iholo ja-Israel wadu gimoro amora, to kik iyie idhi kode e ode kodwaro chiwoni gir singo.
english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

kikuyu: nyikwa Bethel kod Ai, ji mia ariyo gi piero ariyo gadek (223),
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Sirni mag dhoudi ma bethene ariyo momanyore romre; noketi adek adek nyime ka gimanyore.
english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mane ogolou e piny Misri, mondo kik ubed wasumb jo-Misri kendo ne aturo lodi mane otwenu mi koro sani uwuotho tir.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

kikuyu: Wasewinjo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo pi Nam Makwar oduono kane uwuok e piny Misri, kendo gima ne utimone Sihon kod Og, ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor modak yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, mane uketho chuth.
english: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

kikuyu: to kinda kelo kido maber to kido maber kelo geno.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

kikuyu: Kuno nonwangʼo ja-Yahudi moro mane onywol Ponto miluongo ni Akula. Ngʼatno noyudo odar oa Italia gi chiege Priskila, nikech ruoth Klaudio nosegolo chik mondo jo-Yahudi duto odar oa Rumi. Paulo nodhi limogi,
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

kikuyu: Negiwuok Harada mi gibworo Makheloth.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni Jehova Nyasaye mor kodwa, to obiro telonwa nyaka e pinyno, piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich, kendo obiro miyowa pinyno.
english: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Satan nodwoko niya, “Iparo ni Ayub oluoro Nyasaye kaonge gima omiyo?
english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

kikuyu: kata kik owuogi koa kama ler mar lemo mar Nyasache, kata miyo kanyo bedo mogak, nikech en ngʼama owal kendo owir gi mor pwodhruok mar Nyasache. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Od ngʼat makare otingʼo mwandu maduongʼ, to pok mar joricho kelo nigi chandruok.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

kikuyu: Los tungʼ e konde angʼwen mag kendono, mondo omi tungego kod kendo mar misango obed gimoro achiel ka kendono omuon wiye gi mula.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

kikuyu: Omiyo negitugo mirimb ji kaachiel gi jodong oganda kod jopuonj chik. Negimako Stefano mi gikele e nyim buch Sanhedrin.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

kikuyu: mae ema biro miyo nyikwau nopar kaka namiyo jo-Israel odak e kiche kinde mane agologi e piny Misri. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Jopinje mamoko modak e pinyu nonyaa mamedre moloyou, to un to unubed manok.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nowacho ne Ibrahim niya, “Kik chunyi bed gi chwanyruok nikech wuodi Ishmael kod jatichni madhako, Hagar. Winj gimoro amora ma Sara jaodi wachoni; nikech kuom wuodi Isaka ema kothi duto nowuogie.
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka Sheshak nomaki, sunga mar piny ngima norum! Mano kaka Babulon nobedi gima lich makelo bwok e kind ogendini!
english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

kikuyu: Otweyo tiendena gi nyororo; kendo obedo korango yorena duto.’
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

kikuyu: “ ‘Omiyo kochakore e odiechiengʼ mar apar gabich mar dwe mar abiriyo bangʼ keyo to nyaka utim Sap Jehova Nyasaye kuom ndalo abiriyo. Chiengʼ mokwongo en odiechiengʼ mowal mar yweyo, kendo chiengʼ mar aboro bende en kamano.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

kikuyu: Aore duto mol kadhi ei nam, to kata kamano nam ok pongʼ. To kuma aorego oaye, kanyo ema gidwogoe.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni iwacho ni, ‘Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye,’ to ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ne itiyo gi weche ka iwacho ni, ‘Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye,’ kata obedoni ne awachonu ni kik uwach ni, ‘Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: Although you say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ therefore the LORD says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from the LORD,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from the LORD,”

kikuyu: Jorit wasumbini ne kasogi kawachonegi niya, “Tiekuru tich momiu odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, mana machal kaka ne utimo kane un gi lum.”
english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

kikuyu: “Emomiyo koro sani, yaye Nyasachwa, in e Nyasaye maduongʼ, Nyasaye nyakalaga kendo Nyasaye Maratego bende in e Nyasaye marito singruokne mar hera. Kik ikaw chandruok mwanenogi mayot; chandruokgi osebiro kuomwa, kuom ruodhi magwa kod jotendwa, kuom jodolo magwa kod jonabi, kuom kwerewa kod jogi duto, kochakore ndalo loch mag ruodhi jo-Asuria nyaka kawuono.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

kikuyu: Omiyo nopenjo Jehoshafat, “Ibiro dhi konya kedo gi jo-Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshafat nodwoko ruodh Israel niya, “Wan joka ngʼato achiel, joga gin jogi, faresena gin fareseni.”
english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

kikuyu: Negibiro kaka oganda achiel mochokore mondo giked gi Musa kod Harun kendo negiwachonegi niya, “Usetimo mokalo tongʼ! Oganda duto ler, ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi, kendo Jehova Nyasaye ni kodgi. En angʼo momiyo koro uketoru malo moloyo oganda mar Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”

kikuyu: Jaherana chalona gi mo mane-mane mobo matin ma nengone tek, mantie e kind thundena.
english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

kikuyu: Adier, chon waduto ne wachal kodgi, ka watimo gik mangima mar dhano dwaro, kendo waluwo gombo kod paro mag ringruok. Wan bende, e kitwa, mana kaka ji mamoko, ne wan e bwo mirima.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

kikuyu: Kik ulokru uluw nyiseche manono. Ok ginyal konyou, bende ok ginyal resou nikech gin gik manono.
english: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.

kikuyu: Giniwach ne jodongo niya, “Wuodwani wiye tek kendo ja-jendeke, ok owinjwa, en janjore kendo jakongʼo.”
english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

kikuyu: Pok mar piero ariyo ne mar Eliatha gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Ka kinde mag Pasaka mar jo-Yahudi ne chiegni chopo, ji mangʼeny moa e gwenge mopogore opogore nodhi Jerusalem mondo gipwodhre kapok Pasaka ochopo.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

kikuyu: Petro nomedo siemogi gi weche mamoko mathoth; komedo jiwogi kowacho niya, “Tonyuru ua kuom tiengʼ mokethoreni.”
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, e weche ariyogi kik iher moro moloyo machielo, nikech ngʼat moluoro Nyasaye ema dhi maber.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Uparo ni jo-Galili-gi ne joricho moloyo jo-Galili mamoko nikech negisandore kamano?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

kikuyu: To jamni kod gik moyaki mane oa e miechgi mane wakawo ne wadhi godo.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

kikuyu: To kane gitingʼo wangʼ-gi, negineno ka kidi mangʼongono nosengʼiel oko.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

kikuyu: “Josef en mzabibu manyago olemo mopidh e bath thidhna, ma bedene ogawore e kor ot.
english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

kikuyu: Omiyo beduru motangʼ kutimo gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ochikou, ka ok udok korachwich kata koracham.
english: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: Kuoth ketho genruok, to ngʼat ma ja-ratiro rito wach malingʼ-lingʼ.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

kikuyu: Kaka Melkizedek ne onge gi wuon kata min kata anywolane bende ne oonge gi chakruokne kata gikone, En kaka Wuod Nyasaye, kendo tij dolo mare osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

kikuyu: Eka ne giyiero geche lweny ariyo gi faresegi kendo ruoth noorogi luwo bangʼ jolweny mag Aram. Nowachone joriemb gechego niya, “Dhiuru mondo unon-ane gima osetimore.”
english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

kikuyu: Koro aa malo ka dichwo; mondo idwoka weche, madwaro penjigi.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

kikuyu: Paulo nomosogi, eka nonyisogi weche duto kuom gik mane Nyasaye osetimo e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi e tichne mar lando Injili.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Musa kod Harun ne odhi ir Farao mi gitimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochikogi. Harun nodiro ludhe piny e nyim Farao kod jodonge mi nolokore thuol.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye wachona niya, “Mana kaka ja-otongʼo kwano hike achiel ma tije rumogo e kaka duongʼ mar Kedar norum.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

kikuyu: Jomoko nobiro kokelone ja-athany ka ji angʼwen otingʼe.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

kikuyu: Bende isekwedo Juda chuth? Dibed ni ichayo Sayun? Angʼo momiyo isehinyowa ma ok wanyal chango? Ne wageno kwe to onge ber mosebiro, kinde mar chang to nitie mana thagruok.
english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Simeon: Chwo duto mahikgi piero ariyo kadhi nyime moromo tiyo e lweny nondik nying-gi, achiel kaachiel, kaluwore gi nonro mar dhoodgi kod anywolagi.
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: E lwete ma korachwich notingʼo sulwe abiriyo, bende ligangla mabith ma dhoge ariyo ne wuok e dhoge. Lela wangʼe ne rieny ka chiengʼ marieny mangʼangʼni.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

kikuyu: To Solomon nokawo higni apar gadek mondo otiek gero ode.
english: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

kikuyu: Mad ogendini obed mamor kendo ower gi ilo, nikech irito ji gi ratiro, kendo itayo ogendini mag piny. Sela
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

kikuyu: E nyim Nyasaye kendo e nyim Kristo Yesu mabiro ngʼado bura ni joma ngima gi joma otho, kendo mabiro duogo, gi pinyruodhe, amiyi chik kama:
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

kikuyu: jo-Yahudi nokawo wachno ka margi mondo obed timgi ne gin giwegi to gi nyikwagi mabiro to gi ji duto madwaro riwore kodgi ni nyaka rit ndalo ariyogo higa ka higa, e yo moketi kendo e kinde moseketi.
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

kikuyu: Pilato noluongo jodolo madongo kaachiel, jotelo kod ji duto,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

kikuyu: Donge tinde okwanowa mana kaka jomoko nono? Ok en mana ni osechiwowa kende, to osechano nyaka mwandu duto mane okendwa.
english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

kikuyu: nikech “Nyasachwa en mach matieko gik mowangʼo chuth.”
english: for our God is a consuming fire.

kikuyu: Mano kaka dhahabu osewito berne, dhahabu maberie moloyo obedo marach! Kite maler okere e akerkeke mag yore duto.
english: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

kikuyu: To nikech koro osetho, angʼo dimi atwe chiemo? Bende daduoge obed mangima? An ema abiro dhi ire to en ok onyal duogo ira.”
english: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

kikuyu: Ne ok odok chien e yie, kata obedo ni ringre owuon ne chal gima otho, nikech hike ne romo kar mia achiel, kendo kata ni Sara ne en migumba ma kindene mar nywol nosekadho.
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

kikuyu: Obiro bedo maduongʼ kendo noluonge ni Wuod Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, Ruoth Nyasaye biro miye kom loch mar kwar mare, Daudi.
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

kikuyu: Nahash ja-Amon nodhi malo momonjo Jabesh Gilead. Eka joma chwo man Jabesh Gilead nowachone niya, “Tim winjruok kodwa to wabiro bedo wasumbini magi.”
english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”

kikuyu: Kamano nowacho ni jogo mane oor niya, “Doguru kendo unyis Johana gik ma useneno kendo winjo: Muofni neno, rongʼonde wuotho, jogo man-gi dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo wach, joma otho ichiero, kendo Injili iyalo ne joma odhier.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ok dibedo gi teko moro amora kuoma ka dine bed ni ok omiyigo koa malo. Kuom mano ngʼama noketa e lweti nigi ketho maduongʼ moloyo richo misetimo.”
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi nooro wachni ne Zadok gi Abiathar, ma jodolo kama: “Penjuru jodong Juda ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo dudongʼ chien kuom dwoko ruoth dalane, nimar weche mane iwacho e Israel duto osechopo ni ruoth e kar dakne?
english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

kikuyu: Uza nonywolo Shimea, Shimea nonywolo Hagia, to Hagia nonywolo Asaya.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

kikuyu: Notimo timbe maricho e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka wuon mare notimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

kikuyu: “Keturu ranyisi mag yore; keturu gik matayo ji. Paruru yore moriere, yorno miluwo. Duogi, yaye Israel ma nyako ngili, duogi e dalau.
english: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.

kikuyu: Negikuyo ka giywak kendo ka giriyo kech nyaka ochopo odhiambo, ka giywago Saulo gi wuode Jonathan, to gi jolweny mag Jehova Nyasaye to gi jo-Israel, nikech ne oseneg-gi gi ligangla.
english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

kikuyu: Malaikano mane owuoyo koda, ne nigi luth mar rapim molos gi dhahabu mipimogo dalano, gi dhorangeyene kod ohingane.
english: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

kikuyu: “Abiro miyo ubed ka gunda mojwangʼ kendo gima ocha e dier ogendini mokiewo kodu, ma joma kalo wuoro kendo gone siboi.
english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

kikuyu: Pok agombo fedha kata dhahabu kata law ngʼato.
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

kikuyu: Kane Sap Pasaka okayo machiegni, Yesu nongʼeyo ni sane osechopo mar wuok e pinyni mondo odog ir Wuoro. Kaka nosehero joge owuon mane ni e pinyni, koro noikore nyisogi herane matut mogik.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu odonjo e gwengʼ mar Kaisaria man Filipi, nopenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Uwinjo ji wacho ni Wuod Dhano en ngʼa?”
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adhi mi apande Perath, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nonyisa.
english: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

kikuyu: Ruodh Asuria nomonjo pinyno duto, mochopo nyaka Samaria kendo nogoyone agengʼa kuom higni adek.
english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

kikuyu: Nowacho bende niya “Ok inyal neno wangʼa, nimar onge ngʼama nyalo nena mi dok mangima.”
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

kikuyu: Ne gidhira gichien kendo ne achiegni podho, to Jehova Nyasaye nokonya.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

kikuyu: wer kuom soko mane rawera matin okunyo, mano mane joka ruoth okunyo; joka ruoth molony e chike kendo man-gi odunga.” Eka negiwuok e thimno ka gidhi Matana,
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

kikuyu: Eber nonywolo yawuowi ariyo: wuode makayo nochako ni Peleg, nikech e ndalono ema nopogie piny, owadgi to ne nyinge Joktan.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Enoyangʼ nyaimno e kama ler mar lemo ma bende iyangʼoe misango mar golo richo kaachiel gi misango miwangʼo pep. Mana kaka misango mar golo richo en mar jadolo, misango mar pwodhruok e ketho bende en mar jadolo nikech en gima ler moloyo.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehu nonego ji duto man Jezreel mane odongʼ e od Ahab, kaachiel gi jotende duto, osiepene kod jodolo mage duto, maonge ngʼama noweyo kangima.
english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

kikuyu: “Ka kinde mosechan ochopo, enomonj piny Milambo kendo, to koro gima notimre nopogre gi mano mane osetimore mokwongo.
english: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Yahudi nowacho niya, “Neyeuru kaka nohere!”
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

kikuyu: Unulal nono e kind ogendini, kendo wasiku notieku.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

kikuyu: Nyasini ginitim chiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mar ariyo e seche mag odhiambo. Ginicham nyarombo, kaachiel gi makati ma ok oketie thowi kod alode makech.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

kikuyu: “To kuom mano ma uneno kani, ndalo biro biro maonge kidi kata achiel mabiro dongʼ kochungʼ ewi wadgi, moro ka moro biro redhore piny.”
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye oseyiera mondo abed mare owuon; kendo Jehova Nyasaye winja, ka aluonge.
english: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

kikuyu: Ahimoth nonywolo Elkana, Elkana nonywolo Zofai, Zofai nonywolo Nahath,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

kikuyu: Omiyo nohulone gik moko duto kowachone niya, “Onge wembe mosekadho e wiya nikech asebedo ja-Nazir ma Nyasaye nowalo nyaka aa nywolna. Ka yie wiya oliel, to tekra biro rumo, kendo abiro bedo manyap machal gi ngʼato angʼata.”
english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”

kikuyu: Musa ne oyudo puonjruok e kit rieko duto mag jo-Misri, kendo ne en ratego e kit wuoyone kod timbene.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro yawuota, winjauru; gin johawi jogo morito yorena.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

kikuyu: Un jo-Israel, pakuru Jehova Nyasaye; un dhood joka Harun, pakuru Jehova Nyasaye;
english: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: tiekgi gi mirimbi mager, tiekgi mi kargi lal nono, eka biro ngʼere e tungʼ piny koni gi koni ni Nyasaye nigi loch kuom joka Jakobo. Sela
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo owachi niya, “Kawuono ka uwinjo dwonde, to kik chunyu bed mapek, kaka ne utimo e ndalo mane ungʼanyo.”
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

kikuyu: Daudi ne chunye ool nikech jogo ne wacho ni mondo ochiele gi kite; ka moro ka moro ne winjo lit nikech yawuote gi nyige. Daudi to noyudo teko moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.

kikuyu: Zaburi Mar Daudi. Aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ibi ira piyo. Yie iwinj dwonda ka aluongi.
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

kikuyu: Ka udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye eka joweteu gi nyithindu notimnegi ngʼwono mi nowegi giduogi e pinygi kod joma noterogi e twech nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en jangʼwono kendo en gihera maduongʼ omiyo ok noloknu ngʼeye ka udwogo ire.”
english: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

kikuyu: mine oorogi ir Ruoth mondo gipenje niya, “In e jalno mane onego obi koso warit ngʼat machielo?”
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Boaz nopenjo nyapara mar tich mane rito jokeyogo niya, “Dhako ma pod tin cha en mar ngʼa?”
english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nolor piny ir ji monyisogi gik mane Jehova Nyasaye owachone.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

kikuyu: bende nomiyo aore obubni kawuok e lwanda kama obarore mi pi nomol piny mana ka aora.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

kikuyu: Otiyo tijene gi teko duto; kendo oratego e tije motiyo.
english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼado bura makare ogol oko kendo tim makare ni mabor kodwa, adiera onge e yore matindo kendo tim makare ni kuma bor.
english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato angʼata nigi tuo malandore mar del, to nyaka kele ir jadolo.
