english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

kikuyu: Karaya mar Nam gi rwedhi apar gariyo manie e bwoye;
english: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie dala maduongʼ mane nitie gi ji manok e iye. To ruoth moro maratego nobiro molwore kendo omonje.
english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno mochoko buch nyaroyano nyaka luok lepe bende, to en bende nobed mochido nyaka chop odhiambo. Ma nobedi chik mosiko ne jo-Israel kaachiel gi jopinje mamoko modak kodgi.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

kikuyu: Jakobo nooro joote nyime ir owadgi Esau e piny Seir, gwengʼ mar Edom.
english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

kikuyu: Gima osetimorenigi chopo adiera mar ngero mawacho niya, “Guok dok e ngʼokne mosengʼogo” kendo niya, “Anguro moseluoki odok ngʼielore e chwodho.”
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

kikuyu: Weche mag ndalo loch Manase kaachiel gi kwayo mane okwayogo Nyasache, kod weche mane jonen nowachone kuom nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel ondiki e kitepe mag ruodhi Israel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Pigno en ranyisi mar batiso makoro warou sani, batiso ok en golo chilo kuom ringruok, to en singruok motim ne Nyasaye gi chuny maler. Owarou kuom chier mar Yesu Kristo,
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro gi nying Jehova Nyasaye. Wagwedhi gie od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Kwan-gi kaka joketho, yaye Nyasaye! Ket obadho ma giketo ne ji ogajgi gin giwegi. Riembgi nikech richogi mathoth, nimar gisengʼanyoni.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

kikuyu: Nomiyo oidho gach ruoth mar ariyo mar loch, kendo joritne nogoyo koko nyime kawacho niya, “Yawneuru e yo!” Kuom mano Josef noket jatend piny Misri duto.
english: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ne iloko ywakna modoko miel; ne igolo lawa mar kuyo mi irwakona law mor,
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

kikuyu: agulni gi opewni kod ojiko mar uma michwoyogo ringʼo to gi gik mamoko matiyo kodgi. Huram-Abi noloso ne Ruoth Solomon gik moko duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye gi mula mopwodhi.
english: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.

kikuyu: Ne igolo mzabibu moro e piny Misri, kendo ne iriembo ogendini mi ipidhe kargi.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, an jatichni adier; an jatichni, ma wuod jatichni ma nyako; isegonya mi igola e nyorochena.
english: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

kikuyu: Chunygi tek kendo ok dew gimoro amora; to an to chikni miya mor.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

kikuyu: “Bende dhano nyalo mayo Nyasaye? To kata kamano, umaya. “Umedo penjo ni, ‘Kare ere kaka wamayi?’ “Umaya kuom chiwo mar achiel kuom apar kod chiwo mamoko.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

kikuyu: Negibwok kendo negiluor, ka giparo ni gineno jachien.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

kikuyu: To kendo mar misango mar mula mane Bezalel wuod Uri ma wuod Hur noloso ne ni Gibeon e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo Solomon kod oganda duto nolamo Nyasaye kanyo.
english: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

kikuyu: To in, yaye Nyasaye, ibiro dwoko joma timbegi richo piny nyaka ei bur ma gitow; joma joricho machwero remo ok bi bet mangima kata moromo nus ndalogi. An to ageno kuomi.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

kikuyu: to iwinjgi gi e polo kendo iwe richo jogi Israel kendo iduog-gi e piny mane imiyo kweregi.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

kikuyu: Iseluwo yor nyameru; emomiyo abiro keto kikombene e lweti.
english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

kikuyu: Magi ema nobed lemo ma Harun gi yawuote yudo kuom jo-Israel. En e chiwo ma jo-Israel nochiw ni Jehova Nyasaye kawuok e misengini mag lalruok.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Hezekia ne ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel. Ne onge ngʼama osechalo kode e dier ruodhi duto mag Juda, bedni negisebedo e loch chon kata bangʼe.
english: He trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.

kikuyu: kendo iwachnegi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: E odiechiengʼ mane ayieroe Israel, ne asingora ni dhood joka Jakobo kendo ne afwenyoranegi e piny Misri. Ne asingoranegi ka awachonegi niya, “An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.”
english: Tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am the LORD your God;’

kikuyu: Eka negigoyo ombulu, kendo ombulu nolwar kuom Mathias. Omiyo nomede kuom joote apar gachiel mamoko.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

kikuyu: Beria nonywolo Refa, to Refa nonywolo Reshef Reshef nonywolo Tela, Tela nonywolo Tahan,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

kikuyu: kendo en ema nobed kare maler; to ne jo-Israel kod jo-Juda, enobed kidi machwanyo ji kendo lwanda mamiyo gipodho. Chutho enobed obadho ma jo-Jerusalem nomokie.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

kikuyu: Koro Hiram ruodh Turo nooro joote ir Daudi ka gitingʼo sirni mag yiend sida gi jopa bao kod jogedo mag kite, kendo negigero dala ruoth ni Daudi.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

kikuyu: Apwoyo kata obedoni onyamo kambula kamano, to ombongʼ tiende ok opogore, chik ok oyienu mondo uchamgi nikech gin gik makwero.
english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik ichiw nyathini moro amora ni nyasaye manono miluongo ni Molek, nimar ok onego iketh nying Nyasaye. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: kendo kiny umok mach kod gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼatno ma Jehova Nyasaye oyiero ema nobed ngʼama ler. Un jo-Lawi usekalo tongʼ!”
english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

kikuyu: Omiyo ne akawo kite mopa mane ni e lweta mi adiro piny ma gitore matindo tindo e nyimu.
english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

kikuyu: Akwayou mondo urwake kuom Ruoth, kaka onego tim ni jomaler, kendo mondo umiye gimoro amora ma dodwar kuomu, nimar osebedo kokonyo ji mangʼeny, nyaka an bende.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni wasekalo waa e tho miwadonjo e ngima, nikech wahero owetewa. Ngʼama ok ohero owadgi osiko e tho.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wachne dhood Israel kama: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Un bende ubiro dwanyoru kaka kwereu notimo ka gilamo nyisechegi manono?
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?

kikuyu: Sanbalat kod Geshem noorona wach kama: “Bi mondo warom e achiel kuom mier mantiere e holo mar Ono.” To ma ne en mana riekogi mar hinya;
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

kikuyu: To Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Wuoda ok nyal dhi kuno kodu; owadgi osetho kendo en kende ema odongʼ, ka gimoro marach otimorene e wuodhno, to ubiro miyo atho gi kuyo.”
english: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”

kikuyu: Hanun kod jo-Zanoa nogero Dhoranga Holo ni girwako dhoute gi radedi kod lodi mage, to bende negigero ohinga maborno dirom fut alufu achiel mia angʼwen gi piero abiriyo gauchiel nyaka gichopo e Dhoranga Owuoyo.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

kikuyu: Gimoro achiel kende ema akwayo Jehova Nyasaye, ma e gima adwaro moloyo; ni mondo adag e od Jehova Nyasaye ndalo duto mag ngimana, mondo achom wangʼa kuom ber mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo amanye e hekalu mare.
english: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

kikuyu: Daudi owuon to ne ok oidho odhi e polo, to en ema nowacho niya, “ ‘Ruoth nowachone Ruodha ni, “Bed e bada korachwich,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

kikuyu: Weche moko duto mag loch Solomon kaka mago mane otimo gi rieko mane onyiso donge ondikgi e kitap timbe mag Solomon?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Useneno un uwegi ni asewuoyo kodu ka aa e polo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

kikuyu: “Ma e dwaro mar chik ma Jehova Nyasaye osechiko: Nyis jo-Israel mondo okel nyaroya ma silwal maonge songa kata ma ok ongʼol kendo mapok otwe e jok.
english: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Gima ichamo nowuok kuom jocham ji; gima mit nowuok kuom ratego.” Kuom ndalo adek ne ok ginyal chiwo dwoko.
english: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-adiera chiwo neno mobidhore, to janeno ma hango wach wacho miriambo.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kikuyu: “Ruoth Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, kaka ne isesingo, koro we jatichni odhi gi kwe.
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

kikuyu: Kane owacho mani, jogo duto mane kwede wigi nokuot. To ji mamoko nomor kod gik moko duto miwuoro mane otimo.
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

kikuyu: Noriwo nyaka Gilead, gwenge jo-Geshur kod jo-Maaka, Got Hermon duto, kod Bashan duto, mochopo nyaka Saleka,
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

kikuyu: Iseyiengo piny mi ibare diere ariyo, Los kuondene mosebarore, nikech oyiengni.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nokaw remo moko mar misango mar golo richo gi lith lwete kendo nomiene tunge kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, eka remo duto modongʼ to nopukie tiend kendo mar misango miwangʼo.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Anatim kamano mondo aduog chunje jo-Israel duto moseweya kadhi lamo nyisechegi manono.’
english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

kikuyu: nyikwa Pahath-Moab, Elihoyanai wuod Zerahia, kaachiel kode ji mia ariyo;
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

kikuyu: Eka jogo duto mane oluoro wach Nyasach Israel nochokore buta nikech gima rach mane joma odwogo koa e twech Babulon otimo. Kendo ne abedo kanyo ka an-gi bwok malich nyaka ochopo sa misango mar odhiambo.
english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

kikuyu: Maria nochungʼ oko e dho bur kaywak. Kane oyudo oywak, nokulore mongʼiyo i bur,
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

kikuyu: Noyudo jo-Bethel ooro Shareza gi Regem-Melek, kod jogi moko, mondo okwa Jehova Nyasaye gweth,
english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,

kikuyu: Nongʼiyo mwalo yo Sodom gi Gomora, kod pewege duto kendo noneno iro maduongʼ koa e pinyno, mana ka iro mar mach maduongʼ.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, un kod jobuch Sanhedrin kwauru jatend jolweny maduongʼ mondo okelnugo e nyimu, ka uwuondoru ni udwaro medo nono wachne maber. Waikore mar nege kapok ochopo ka.”
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

kikuyu: Ne en koko mag bwombe gik mangima mane fwadhore kuom moro gi wadgi kod koko mar tiendegi mane ni bathgi; koko maduongʼ malich.
english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

kikuyu: Koro par ane wach kendo ne gima inyalo timo, nikech chandruok dhi biro ne ruodhwa gi joge duto. Nikech en ngʼat ma achach maonge ngʼama nyalo wuoyo kode.”
english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

kikuyu: Eka Isaya janabi nodhi ir ruoth Hezekia mopenje niya, “Angʼo mane jogo owacho kendo negia kanye?” Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Negia e piny mabor miluongo ni Babulon.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Kuom yawuowi ariyogi, mane manotimo gima wuon-gi ne dwaro?” Negidwoke niya, “Wuowi mokwongo.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni josol osuru gi jochode kuongonu donjo e pinyruodh Nyasaye.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

kikuyu: To e higa mar abich, unyalo chamo olembege. Kuom mano keyo magu nomedre. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Eka noduogo ir jopuonjrene mowachonegi niya, “Pod unindo aninda kendo uyweyo? Neuru, sa osechopo, kendo Wuod Dhano koro indhogo ka ikete e lwet joricho.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Kuomgi ema wach mokor mar Isaya chopo kare kowacho niya, “ ‘Ubiro siko kuwinjo weche miwacho to wach ok nodonjnu ngangʼ; Ubiro siko kungʼicho to ok unune gimoro.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

kikuyu: Osiepena mageno ok dwara; jogo mane chunya ohero bende ok dwara.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, lweti ma korachwich ne nigi teko maduongʼ. Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye lweti ma korachwich ema isetiekogo wasigu.
english: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.

kikuyu: Kinyne kogwen, Yesu nochungʼ e dho nam, to jopuonjre ne ok ongʼeye.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: “Mi jo-Israel chikni kiwachonegi kama: ‘Kelnauru chiwo mitimonago misengini miwangʼo pep mondo obed chiemba madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar e kinde mowinjore.’
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

kikuyu: mondo nyingi obed maduongʼ nyaka chiengʼ. Eka ji biro wacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye Maratego en Nyasach jo-Israel!’ Kendo dhood jatichni Daudi nogurre e nyimi.
english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

kikuyu: Ifta, Ashna, Nezib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka pinyruodhe nosegurore maber, nonego jotelo mane onego wuon mare mane ruoth.
english: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.

kikuyu: Kane ji pod ni e Sawo, Yesu nodonjo nyaka e laru mar hekalu mochako puonjo ji.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo ichiwo ngima ne joma winjo malit, kod ngima ne joma chunygi lit,
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

kikuyu: Negiloso rachung tayano kod gigene duto gi dhahabu maler maromo kilo piero adek gangʼwen.
english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

kikuyu: “Ruoth nopako jarit gige ma ok kareno nikech notiyo gi rieke. Nimar jopinyni ongʼeyo tiyo mariek gi jowadgi moloyo jogo mawuotho e ler.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomi lou e nyim wasiku. Unumonjgi ka un e achiel, to unuring-gi kuke e migepe abiriyo, kendo unubed gima wichkuot ne ogendini duto manie piny.
english: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

kikuyu: To ok unuwuogi kurikni kata ka uringo; nimar Jehova Nyasaye notel nyimu, ee Nyasach Israel bende nodongʼnu chien.
english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

kikuyu: Kendo kuom remb ngimau to anachul kuor. Anachul kuor ne le duto kendo ne ngʼato ka ngʼato anachul kuor nikech ngima wadgi.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano unupar mar rito chikena duto kendo nowalu tenge ne Nyasachu.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

kikuyu: To ne ok gichiko itgi kata winja; kuom mano, negiluwo mana timbegi mag jendeke mag chunjegi maricho. Omiyo nakelo kuomgi kwongʼ duto mag singruok mane achikogi mondo gilu to ne ok girito.’ ”
english: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”

kikuyu: Kane wan Mileto, Paulo nooro wach Efeso mondo oluongne jodong kanisa.
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

kikuyu: Anabed gi mor kuom timonegi maber kendo adiera anaketgi e pinyni gi chunya duto kod parona duto.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

kikuyu: Tim maber, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ni jogo moriere gie chunygi.
english: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

kikuyu: Pok mar piero ariyo gadek ne mar Mahazioth gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ne ogandano niya, “Paruru odiechiengni, chiengʼ mane uwuokie piny Misri, piny mane ubedoe wasumbini, nikech Jehova Nyasaye nogolou e pinyno gi lwedo maratego. Kik ucham gimoro amora moketie thowi.
english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

kikuyu: Kendo giduto ne giwuoro duongʼ mar Nyasaye. Kane ji duto wuoro kuom gigo duto ma Yesu notimo, nowachone jopuonjrene niya,
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Bangʼ dwaro rieko, ruoth noloso nyiroye ariyo mag dhahabu. Nowacho ni ji niya, “Ok en gima yot mondo udhi Jerusalem. Nyisecheu nika mane ogolou kua Misri, yaye Israel.”
english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

kikuyu: Dwogwa iri, yaye Nyasaye; mi wangʼi orienynwa, eka mondo wayud warruok.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Yaye, mad ne abed gi kar nindo michulo ne jowuoth e piny ongoro, mondo omi awe joga kendo adhi mabor kodgi; nimar giduto gin jochode, kanyakla mar joma onge adiera.
english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

kikuyu: Pasia duto mag dhorangach nolos gi law mayom momin marambulu gi maralik kod makwar molos gi jatwengʼo molony. Borne ne romo fut piero adek kendo kaka pasia mag laru borne ne romo fut aboro,
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

kikuyu: Anaketh kuondeu motingʼore gi malo, kendo anamuki kendeu muwangʼoe ubani. Anaket ringreu motho kuom nyiseche manono kendo anajwangʼu chuth.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi, kane oneno ni osechange, nodok ir Yesu, kopako Nyasaye gi dwol maduongʼ.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Mogik, neuru ni un duto un gi chuny achiel kod paro achiel, kuheroru kaka owete, kendo beduru mamuol kendo mangʼwon.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

kikuyu: Yudnwauru rwedhi ariyo. We giyier moro kendgi obed margi, gingʼadgi lemo lemo mi giketgi ewi yien to kik gimok mach kuome. An bende anaik rwath machielo makete ewi yien to ok anamok mach kuome.
english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

kikuyu: Ngʼwono mondo obed kodu un duto.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Orito weche mag ode to ok ocham chiemb mifwadhi.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

kikuyu: Chan uru makatigi laini ariyo e mesa maler molos gi dhahabu mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo e laini ka laini obed gi auchiel.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye nochiere oa kuom joma otho,
english: But God raised him from the dead,

kikuyu: Gipakore ni gin jo-Hibrania? An bende an ja-Hibrania. Gipakore ni gin jo-Israel? An bende an ja-Israel. Gipakore ni gin nyikwa Ibrahim? An bende an nyakwar Ibrahim.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu owinjo mano, nowachonegi niya, “Joma ngima ok ema dwar jathieth makmana joma tuo.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Iseguro piny e mise mage; ma ok onyal yiengni kata matin.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

kikuyu: Jorit dhoranga hekalu ne gin: Nyikwa Shalum, Ater, Talmon, Akub, Hatita kod Shobai, ji mia achiel gi piero adek gochiko (139).
english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

kikuyu: Kendo kaponi uhero mar rwako wachni to ngʼeuru ni en e Elija mane onego obi.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

kikuyu: Musa noluongo Mishael gi Elzafan yawuot Uziel ma en owadgi wuon Harun, mowachonegi niya, “Biuru ka mondo utingʼ ringre oweteu ugol oko mar kambi oa e dho kama ler mar lemo.”
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

kikuyu: Kendo jodolo nowuok oko e aora kotingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye. Kadiemo wangʼ kapok giketo tiendegi e lowo motwo, to pige mag aora Jordan noduogo e wangʼe mi ochako mol mogingore kaka chon.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

kikuyu: Wandikonu un kanisa mar Nyasaye man Korintho, ma un joma osepwodhi ei Kristo Yesu, kendo moseluongi mondo obed jomaler kaachiel gi ji mamoko duto man kamoro amora maluongo nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, ma en Ruodhgi kendo Ruodhwa:
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

kikuyu: Ochamo lumbe motwi ewi got, kuonde ma le mager ema kwayoe.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Nikech an radwal, en angʼo manyalo miyo Farao winja?”
english: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye e jakwadha, ok anachand gimoro.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma jachul kuor, yaye Nyasaye ma jachul kuor, nyis lerni.
english: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

kikuyu: Omiyo ananyis mirimba mager kuom ohinga kod joma ne owire gi lowo marachar. Abiro wachonu ni, “Ohinga oselal nono kaachiel gi jomane owire gi lowo marachar,
english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

kikuyu: Abiro telo e nyimi kendo abiro pieyo gode madongo mogangore; anamuk dhorangeye mag nyinyo kendo anangʼad ndigni mag dhorangeye mag chuma.
english: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.

kikuyu: Wuon Kisera nokawo sa mathoth kapok obiro, omiyo wengegi nobedo mapek kargi duto mi nindo noterogi.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

kikuyu: Jogo mane lawowa ne ringo mapiyo maloyo ongo mafuyo e kor polo; negilawowa e kor gode madongo kendo negibutonwa e thim.
english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Japuonjrene machielo, ma nyinge Andrea, mane en owadgi Simon Petro nowachone niya,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, wuod dhano, kor wach ni Gog niya: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Odiechiengno, ka joga ma jo-Israel odak gi kwe, donge mano dibedie maberni?
english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?

kikuyu: To dhano inywolo ei chandruok, mana kaka pilni mach dhwolore kadhi malo.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

kikuyu: Modh pi moa e dapigi iwuon, pi mamol moa e sokoni iwuon.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

kikuyu: kendo enopwodhi Kama Ler Moloyo kaachiel gi Hemb Romo kod kendo mar misango, eka enopwodh jodolo kaachiel gi oganda jo-Israel.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

kikuyu: Ka pod Harun ne wuoyo ni oganda jo-Israel duto, negingʼiyo yo thim kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ne othinyore e boche polo.
english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.

kikuyu: To gik moko duto manie nam gi aore maonge gi thuokgi kata kalagakla, bed nigimol kata gin achiel kuom gik mangima modak ei pi nyaka ukwer.
english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

kikuyu: Temuru gik moko duto, kendo rituru weche mabeyo kuomgi.
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

kikuyu: Bende giwe keto chunygi e sigendini manono gi sigendini mag nonro mag anywola ma ok rum. Gik ma kamagi medo mana mbaka makelo miero kar gero tich Nyasaye, ma gerore kuom yie.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

kikuyu: Ne akunyo yewni ma pi gudore mondo yiendego oyud pi.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

kikuyu: Gingirore kendo ok gilokre mochwere manyaka chiengʼ, nikech osetimgi gi adiera kendo moriere.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

kikuyu: Nikech ji duto dwaro mana gik makonyogi giwegi, to ok mag Yesu Kristo.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi obiro Mahanaim, Shobi wuod Nahash maa Raba e piny jo-Amon, gi Makir wuod Amiel maa Lo Debar, gi Barzilai ma ja-Gilead maa Rogelim,
english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

kikuyu: Wan to ne wakwangʼ ka waa Filipi, bangʼ Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi, to bangʼ ndalo abich ne wachopo irgi Troa, kuma ne wabetie kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Jakobo nodongʼ kende, kendo ngʼato noi kode otieno duto nyaka okinyi.
english: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

kikuyu: Nyasaye rieny gie Sayun, dala ma berne longʼo chuth.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

kikuyu: kendo gisebedo machwe kendo dendgi leny. Timbegi mamono onge giko; ok gikony nyithi kiye mondo olo bura, bende ok gikony joma odhier e ratiro mag-gi,
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

kikuyu: “Nyasaye e wuon rieko gi teko; ngʼado rieko gi winjo tiend weche gin mage.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

kikuyu: Omiyo ja-Lawino, ma chwor dhako mane onegi, nowacho niya, “Ne adhi Gibea man Benjamin kaachiel gi chiega mondo wabuor kanyo.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noyiero gik ma piny ochayo kendo manono mondo otiekgo gik ma jopiny kwano ni lich.
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

kikuyu: Jo-Israel mamoko, kaachiel gi jodolo, jo-Lawi, jower, jorit rangach kod jotij hekalu, bende nobiro Jerusalem e higa mar abiriyo mar Ruoth Artaksases.
english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

kikuyu: Ilokona kiti kendo ibedo mager koda; isanda gi badi maratego.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “To ne ok uwinja, kendo usechwanya gi gik ma lwetu oseloso, kendo usekelo hinyruok kuomu uwegi.”
english: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says the LORD, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”

kikuyu: “Ka onyalo biro sani mi otweyi e od twech kendo ochok bura mayali, en ngʼa ma disire?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

kikuyu: Ondiek nodag kaachiel gi nyirombe, kwach nonind kaachiel gi diel, nyaroya kod sibuor nokwa kaachiel, kendo nyathi matin nokwagi.
english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

kikuyu: Bende ne achiwo thuolo mar chiwo mar yien e seche mowal, kendo bende ne olembe mokwongo. Yaye Nyasacha, para gi ngʼwono.
english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

kikuyu: Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye; bed motegno ka in gi chir, kendo rit kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

kikuyu: Nokawo gino momulogo dhoga mi owacho niya, “Ne, koro asemulo lewi, mi kethoni oseweni kendo richoni osepwodhi.”
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

kikuyu: Nitiere kikombe mopongʼ gi divai mochiek e lwet Jehova Nyasaye en kikombe mopongʼ gi divai mokik gi apilo, Nyasaye ole oko, to joma timbegi richo duto manie piny madhe duto pep nyaka ngʼiende.
english: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

kikuyu: wuod Jesse, wuod Obed, wuod Boaz, wuod Salmon, wuod Nashon,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

kikuyu: Ka Nowa ne ja-higni mia abich nonywolo Shem, Ham kod Jafeth.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho gigi, noa Galili kendo nodhi nyaka e gwengʼ mar Judea man loka aora Jordan.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Kik iweye ochal gi nyathi mobwogi ma aa ei min-gi ka en-gi ringruok mokethore.”
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

kikuyu: Ne okelo kech e piny kendo noketho yore duto mane giyudogo chiemo;
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Risa mi gibworo Kehelatha.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Mar Daudi. Ka dine bed ni Jehova Nyasaye ok jakorwa, jo-Israel mondo owach kamano,
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

kikuyu: “Joma chwo duto nobi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto nyadidek e higa.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ziklag, Mekona kod gwenge mokiewo kode,
english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

kikuyu: Mad ngʼwono mar Ruoth Nyasachwa obed kodwa; yie igurnwa tich mar lwetwa, ee gurnwa tich mar lwetwa.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

kikuyu: Ka rwath ochwowo dichwo kata dhako ma misumba, to wuon rwadhno nyaka chul ruodh misumbano fedha ma pekne romo nus kilo, kendo rwadhno nyaka negi.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

kikuyu: Yore joma timo richo opongʼ gi kudho kod obadho; to ngʼat morito chunye obedo mabor kodgi.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nodhi mochungʼ kamoro ma yo dinygo e kind puothe ariyo mag mzabibu kama ochiel gohinga koni gi koni.
english: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

kikuyu: To kane gikwayo niya, “Miwa ruoth mondo otelnwa,” kwayoni ok ne omoro Samuel, omiyo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.

kikuyu: Chikni oketi mondo omi jo-Israel okelne Jehova Nyasaye misengini makoro gitimo e pewe. Nyaka gikelgi ne jadolo manochiwgi e dho Hemb Romo kaka misango mar lalruok.
english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.

kikuyu: koa e anywola Hilkia ne en Hashabia; koa e anywola Jedaya ne en Nethanel.
english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

kikuyu: Joktan nonywolo Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, gi Jera,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: Ket chunyi kuom somo Ndiko ne ji e lela, kendo kuom jiwo ji kendo puonjo ji nyaka chopi abi.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

kikuyu: Uzia mane oyudo ka oikore gi tap mach e lwete mondo owangʼ ubani nokecho. Kane mirima omake kod jodolo, dhoho nolandore e lela wangʼe e nyim jodolo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye but kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani.
english: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in the LORD’s house, beside the altar of incense.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma nokwongʼre kata ma notamre mar hulo wach moro mosewinjo kata moseneno, en bende nobed jaketho, kendo nyaka kume mi ochul.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: To bende mich Nyasaye opogore gi gima richo mar ngʼat achiel nokelo. Bura nobiro nikech richo mar ngʼato achielno mokele kum, to richo mar ji mangʼeny nokelo ngʼwono mane omiyo ji duto obedoe e winjruok gi Nyasaye.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro Sara noneno ka Ishmael mane Hagar nyar Misri onywolo ne Ibrahim ka jotugo gi Isaka kendo jare.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

kikuyu: Abiro paro matut kuom chikeni kendo abiro tego wengena e yoreni.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

kikuyu: Anab, Eshtemo, Anim,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

kikuyu: Jotendgi ne ler marieny moloyo pe kendo rachar maloyo chak, dendgi ne pichni moloyo mo; kendo nenruok margi ne chalo gi kidi ma nengone tek.
english: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.

kikuyu: Otingʼo bandera malo ne ogendini moa mabor, kendo ogoyo tungʼ koluongo jogo moa e tunge piny. Gibiro mapiyo piyo ka giringo matek.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

kikuyu: ka gichopo kum mane ondik kuomgi chon. Ma e duongʼ mar joge maler duto. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: nimar an-gi owetena abich. Odhiyo osiemgi, mondo kik gin bende gibi e kar sand malitni.’
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

kikuyu: Timbene ne richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Ndalo lochne duto ne ok oweyo timbe maricho mar Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Aywakni ka an e chuny bur matut, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

kikuyu: Malaika nowachone joma nochungʼ e nyime niya, “Goluru lepe mochido oko.” Eka nowacho ni Joshua niya, “Ne kaka, asegolo richoni, kendo koro abiro rwaki gi lewni mapichni.”
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

kikuyu: Nyiego mar jo-Efraim norum bende jowasik Juda notieki; kendo jo-Efraim ok nochak obed gi nyiego gi jo-Juda, kata jo-Juda ok nobed gi ich wangʼ kod jo-Efraim.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

kikuyu: to kara joma moko ema ocham gik mochiek e puotha, kendo chamba mondo opudh oko.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: Ngʼat moneko chunye chandore enobed gi kuyo nyaka otho; omiyo kik ngʼato konye.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Awachonu adier ni en gima tek mondo jamoko odonji e pinyruodh polo.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

kikuyu: Kata kamano kuonde motingʼore gi malo, ne ok omuki kendo ji nodhi nyime mana gi chiwo misengini kendo wangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kanyo. Jotham nogero kendo Rangach Mamalo mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: kiweyo jotijegi machwo kod mamon mane gin ji alufu abiriyo mia adek gi piero adek gabiriyo (7,337); kendo ne gin gi jower machwo kod mamon maromo ji mia ariyo (200).
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

kikuyu: Gima ruoth penjono tek ma ok nyalre. Onge ngʼama nyalo lero tiende ni ruoth, makmana nyiseche, to gin ok gidag gi ji.”
english: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mokwongo ka Nowa ne ja-higni mia auchiel gachiel, pi noduono e piny. Eka Nowa noelo wi yie kendo noneno ni piny osetwo.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

kikuyu: Masira gi chandruok malit nobedi ni ji duto matimo richo, mokwongo ni jo-Yahudi, eka bangʼe ni joma ok jo-Yahudi bende;
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: maluwe ne en Jehozabad mane ni kod ji alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro (180,000) moikore ne lweny.
english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

kikuyu: “Koro sani chungʼuru kar tiendu mondo une hono maduongʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye timo mana ka uneno!
english: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

kikuyu: “Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Keyo mar cham mane ukwongo komo e puotheu. “Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Keyo e giko higa, ka uchoko chambu koa e puotheu.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

kikuyu: Bangʼe achien Judas ja-Galili nothinyore e kinde mane ikwanoe ji, mi notelo ni oganda moro matin mane kwedo loch. En bende ne onege, mi jolupne olal nono.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Pasia apar gachielgo duto ne romre ka bor moro ka moro romo fut piero angʼwen gabich to lachgi romo fut auchiel.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Ne gingʼur ei hembegi kendo ne ok gitimo gik ma Jehova Nyasaye nochikogi.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

kikuyu: To ka Roho ema otelonu, to koro ok un e bwo Chik.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo mag Juda nowachi e chunygi ni, ‘Jo-Jerusalem gin roteke nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego en Nyasachgi.’
english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’

kikuyu: kaachiel gi nyipeche alufu adek gi mia adek (3,300) mane ochungʼ ne tich.
english: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

kikuyu: Aa malo, kendo chungi mondo ikonya! Kedna, yaye Nyasacha kendo Ruodha.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

kikuyu: Jo-Israel noywakna niya, ‘Yaye Nyasachwa, wayangi!’
english: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’

kikuyu: E weche duto mag bedo gi rwath, e yo ma ok owinjore kata punda kata rombo kata law, kata gimoro amora molal ma ngʼato diwachie ni, ‘Ma en mara,’ jogo duto nyaka kel wechegigo e nyim jongʼad bura. Ngʼat ma jongʼad bura oyudo ni nigi ketho, nyaka chul wadgino nyadiriyo.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

kikuyu: Otieno ok nobedie kendo ngangʼ bende ok ginidwar ler mar taya kata ler mar chiengʼ, nikech Ruoth Nyasaye ema nomigi ler. To ginibed gi loch nyaka chiengʼ.
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

kikuyu: Anaket kikombe e lwet joma sandou mane wacho ni, “Nind piny mondo wawuoth kuomi. Kendo niloko die ngʼeyi ka yo miwuothoe.”
english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”

kikuyu: “Emomiyo beduru motangʼ, nikech ok ungʼeyo odiechiengʼ kata sa.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

kikuyu: omiyo e kech, e riyo, e duk, kod dhier unutine wasiku ma Jehova Nyasaye oseoronu. Enoket jok mar mula mapek e ngʼutu nyaka chop otieku.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

kikuyu: Ti kode kaluwore gi riekoni, to kik iwe lwar mantie e wiye dhi e bur gi kwe.
english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

kikuyu: Kinyne Agripa kod Bernike nobiro gi dhialruok maduongʼ ka gidonjo e od bura. Negidonjo kaachiel gi jodong jolweny madongo kod jodong dalano mamoko mogen. Eka Festo nogolo chik mondo okel Paulo e nyimgi, mi nokele.
english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

kikuyu: rwath matin achiel, im achiel kod nyaim matin achiel ma hike achiel, nochiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “To ka higni piero abiriyo orumo, anakum ruodh Babulon kod pinye, piny jo-Babulon, nikech ketho mag-gi, kendo anakethe nyaka chiengʼ.
english: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says the LORD, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo ungʼadona bura? To un duto usengʼanyona,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: kendo piny noyawo dhoge mi omwonyogi, gi joodgi duto kod joka Kora duto kod mwandugi duto.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

kikuyu: Nimar chunyi ema iyiego mi keti kare kendo dhogi ema ihulogo mi iyud warruok.
english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Ka dipo ngʼato kuomu nigi osiepne to odhi dier otieno mi owachone ni, ‘Osiepna holae makati adek,
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

kikuyu: “Kuom jonabi mag Samaria ne aneno gino mawangʼo ich: Ne gikoro e nying Baal kendo ma gimiyo joga Israel obayo yo.
english: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

kikuyu: Ma notimre e piny ngima e kind ogendini mana kaka ipono olemb zeituni e yath kata mana kaka olemo manok, mag mzabibu dongʼne johulo e yath kosepon.
english: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

kikuyu: Ginego dhako ma chwore otho gi jadak; gideyo ngʼama onge gi wuon.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

kikuyu: To kara michna en angʼo? En ni mondo ayal Injili maonge gima ochula, mondo kik akonyra gi ratiro ma an-go e tich mar lando Injili.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

kikuyu: udi mopongʼ kod gik moko duto mabeyo, mane ok uloso, sokni ma ne ok ukunyo kod puothe mag mzabibu gi yiend zeituni mane ok upidho. Ka usechiemo muyiengʼ
english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

kikuyu: Un to uumo adiera gi miriambo; uchalo jothieth ma ok nyal thiedho tuo!
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

kikuyu: Wuod Ulam ne en: Bedan. Magi ne yawuot Gilead ma wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Bangʼe kaseoro Artemas kata Tukiko iri, to item matek mondo ibi ira piyo Nikopoli, nikech asechano mar bet kuno kinde chwiri.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

kikuyu: Chunjegi odinore matek, kendo dhogi wuoyo gi wich teko.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

kikuyu: Abiro tieko od Ahab duto. Abiro tieko chwo manie od Ahab e piny Israel bedni gin wasumbini kata joma ni thuolo.
english: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

kikuyu: Ne akonegi bende kuom Nyasacha ma jangʼwono mane ni koda kod gima ruoth nowachona. Ne gidwoka niya, “Wachakuru gedo kendo.” Omiyo negichako tich maberni.
english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato ka ngʼato nokelo Shairi gi lum e kuondegi mag keno ne farese maywa geche kod farese mamoko.
english: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.

kikuyu: Kane ngʼatni ochopo irwa, nokawo okanda mar Paulo motweyogo bedene gi tiendene owuon, kendo owacho niya, “Roho Maler wacho kama: ‘Mana kaka atweyorani e kaka jo-Yahudi man Jerusalem biro tweyo wuon okandani mi gichiwe e lwet joma ok jo-Yahudi.’ ”
english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

kikuyu: Bed ka otienoni kende, to kiny gokinyi, kapo ni odwaro timoni gima owinjore otimni kaka watne mahie, to ber. To ka ok ohero mar timo kamano, to akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, abiro timoni kamano. Nind aninda ka nyaka okinyi.”
english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as the LORD lives. Lie down until the morning.”

kikuyu: “Nowacho ni, ‘Ooyo wuonwa Ibrahim, to ka ngʼato oa kuom joma otho modhi irgi, to gibiro weyo richo.’
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

kikuyu: To Abel nokelo ringʼo machwe koa kuom achiel mag jambe makayo. Jehova Nyasaye noyie gi Abel kod misango mare,
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni dhakono ok odwanyore kendo ok ochido, nokete thuolo mi ochak onywol nyithindo kendo.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

kikuyu: Ok wabi pandogi ne nyithindgi; to wabiro hulogi ne tiengʼ mabiro timbe mipako mag Jehova Nyasaye, gi tekone kod gik miwuoro mosetimo.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

kikuyu: Kane yie pok obiro, Chik notweyowa waduto, kendo noloronwa yor konyruok, nyaka kinde ma yor yie nofwenyore.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel wacho: Dhiuru nyime, meduru chiwo magu mag misengini miwangʼo pep e misengini magu mamoko kendo ucham ringʼogo un uwegi!
english: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.

kikuyu: Kane Belshazar madho divai, nogolo chik mondo okel e nyime tewni mag dhahabu kod mag fedha ma Nebukadneza kwargi nogolo e hekalu mane nitie Jerusalem, mondo ruoth kaachiel gi jodonge gi monde kod jotichne ma nyiri mane oloko monde omethgo.
english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him, that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko Gideon niya, “Pod nitie ji mangʼeny ahinya. Kawgi itergi e pi, kendo abiro miyogi penj kuno. Ka awacho ni, ‘Ma biro dhi kodi,’ to obiro dhi; to ka awacho ni, ‘Ma ok bi dhi kodi,’ to ok obi dhi.”
english: The LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

kikuyu: Kane osengʼeyo gima notimorene, nodhi nyaka od Maria min Johana, ma niluongo bende ni Mariko, kendo kanyo ji nochokore mangʼeny ka gilamo Nyasaye.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho gigi, oganda nowuoro puonjne,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kikuyu: Jodolo gi jo-Lawi nochungʼ mondo ogwedh ji, kendo Nyasaye nowinjogi nikech lembgi nochopo e polo kar dakne maler.
english: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

kikuyu: Jonathan gi Ahimaz ne ni En Rogel. Nyako moro ma jatich ne onego ternegi wach, to gin ne giterone ruoth Daudi nikech ne ok gidwar ni ngʼato onegi ka gidonjo e dala maduongʼno.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

kikuyu: “Chiengʼno “nyiri mabeyo kod yawuowi maroteke nopodh piny ni kech riyo.
english: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye chiwo pok ne ngʼato ka ngʼato moromore gi ratiche gi timne makare. Kawuono Jehova Nyasaye nochiwi e lweta to ne ok anyal keto lweta kuom ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir.
english: The LORD will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because the LORD delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.

kikuyu: Yawuot Shela wuod Juda ne gin: Er ma wuon Leka, Laada ma wuon Maresha kod jo-anywola maloso lewni Beth Ashbea;
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

kikuyu: Machalre gi mano, wuonu manie polo ok dwar ni kata achiel kuom jomatindogi olal.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, dhood Israel wacho ni, Fweny moneno gin mag higni mathoth ma pod biro nyime, kendo okoro weche mag higni manyime.
english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

kikuyu: Boaz nonywolo Obed, to Obed nonywolo Jesse.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

kikuyu: E kindeno jopuonjre nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “En ngʼa maduongʼ moloyo e pinyruodh polo?”
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

kikuyu: Jopuonj Chik kod jo-Farisai nokelo dhako moro mane onwangʼ ka terore. Negikete ochungʼ e nyim joma ne ni kanyo duto,
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

kikuyu: Esau nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Asayi miya ogira makwarno adenyo!” (Mano emomiyo bende iluonge ni Edom.)
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

kikuyu: Jadolo nokaw cham moko mondo oru gi mo kendo enowangʼ-gi kaachiel gi ubani kaka rapar, nikech en misango miwangʼo ni Jehova Nyasaye gi mach.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Miwa kawuono chiembwa mapile pile.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

kikuyu: Nimar onge gima nyalo tamo Nyasaye.”
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

kikuyu: kendo iywag kiwacho niya, “ ‘Mano kaka minu ne en sibuor madhako malich e dier sibuoche! Ne onindo e dier sibuoche matindo kendo ne opidho nyithinde.
english: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.

kikuyu: To mad ji duto madwari bed moil kendo mamor kuomi; mad joma ohero warruok mari osik kawacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo oyud duongʼ!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

kikuyu: Jehu janen ma wuod Hanani nodhi mondo orom kode kendo nonyiso ruoth niya, “Bende dikony joricho kendo iher jogo mochayo Jehova Nyasaye? Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye ni kuomi nikech isetimo ma.
english: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, wrath is on you from before the LORD.

kikuyu: Hera ok rum. To kama nitiere weche mikoro, weche mikoro norum; kama nitiere wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore, dhok mayoreyore norum; kama nitiere ngʼeyo; ngʼeyo bende nokadhi.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

kikuyu: To ei agola mag hekalu, noyudo ka ji hono dhok gi rombe kod akuche, kendo jomoko to nobet olworo mesni ka giwilo pesa.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

kikuyu: ka ungʼeyo ni obiro miyou mich chiengʼ ma nobi mondo opog ni joge girkeni kaka pokgi mokano nigi. En Ruoth Kristo ema utiyone.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

kikuyu: “Guogi biro chamo joka Ahab motho e mier madongo kendo winy mae kor polo biro chamo mago motho e pewe.”
english: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

kikuyu: Arauna nopenje niya, “Angʼo mokelo ruodha ma en ruoth ir jatichne?” Daudi nodwoke niya, “Abiro ngʼiewo laru mar dino cham, mondo agerie kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye, eka tho manego ji orum.”
english: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

kikuyu: To en, kane min osejiwe motelo, nowacho niya, “Miya wi Johana ja-Batiso e san-ni.”
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Ne giwachona niya, “Jogo mane otony oa e twech kendo modwogo e gwengʼni nigi chandruok malich to gi wichkuot. Ohinga mar Jerusalem osemukore kendo dhorangeyege osewangʼ gi mach.”
english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

kikuyu: But kama newantiereno ne nitie puothe madongo mag ruodh chulano miluongo ni Publio. Ruodhno norwakowa, moritowa maber kaka wende kuom ndalo adek.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

kikuyu: Andhoga mar fuwo en richo, to ji mon kod ja-jar ji.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

kikuyu: Kapo upenjo niya, “Angʼo ma wabiro chamo e higa mar abiriyo ka ok wachwoyo, kata ka ok wakeyo?”
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowacho ne jo-Israel niya, “Yieruru jou moko mondo odhi oked gi jo-Midian kendo gitiek mirimb Jehova Nyasaye kuomgi.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

kikuyu: Dhoge opongʼ gi miriambo kod weche mag kwongʼ; chandruok gi weche maricho ni e bwo lewe.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

kikuyu: Momedore ni mano, mon moko man kodwa nende obwogowa gi wach. Negidhiyo e liel okinyi mangʼich
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

kikuyu: Ere kaka unyalo yie ka urwako pak ma joweteu pakougo, to ok utem matek mondo uyud pak moa kuom Nyasaye ma achiel kende?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye oseoro wach ni okecho gi joka Jakobo, kendo wachno osechopo ne jo-Israel.
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

kikuyu: ‘Jehova Nyasaye ok kech piyo, to en gihera mogundho kendo oweyo ne ji richogi kendo ongʼwono ne joma ongʼanyo. To kata kamano, joma oketho ok nyal we ma ok okum; okumo nyithindo kuom richo mag wuonegi nyaka tiengʼ mar adek kata nyaka tiengʼ mar angʼwen.’
english: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

kikuyu: Ok abi kawo gimoro to mana ma joga osechamo kod pok ma joga kaka Aner, Eshkol kod Mamre onego oyudi. Onego giyud pokgi.”
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

kikuyu: Tiuru ne Jehova Nyasaye gi luoro kendo moruru e nyime gi luoro.
english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Mano ber, kwayonino bende abiro rwako; kendo ok naketh dala miwachono.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane Musa osewinjo mae to ne oneno ni Harun ni kare.
english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

kikuyu: Kata kamano kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag wangʼo misengini ne ok omuki, kendo ji nodhi nyime mana gi chiwo misengini kod wangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar kanyo.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho, “Bangʼ ka osemiya duongʼ kendo oseora mondo arad gi pinje mosepeyou, kendo mondo anyisgi ni ngʼato angʼata momulou osoko mana tong wangʼ Nyasaye,
english: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

kikuyu: Eka Amazia noriembo jolweny mane oa Efraim mine gidok e miechgi ka igi owangʼ kendo gikecho malich gi Juda.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu okelou e piny ma udhi donjoe mondo ukaw obed maru, mi oriembonu ogendini mangʼeny kaka jo-Hiti, jo-Girgash, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus, ma gin pinje abiriyo madongo kendo maroteke moloyou.
english: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

kikuyu: Ijamuomri ka pi aora, to ok inibed gi duongʼ, nikech isedonjori, gi kitanda wuonu ma ichido.
english: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

kikuyu: Kuom yawuot Merari: noyier Jazia: to kuom yawuot Jazia noyier Beno, Shoham, Zakur kod Ibri.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

kikuyu: “Beduru motangʼ, nono chunyu biro bedo monyosore gi pek, mer kod parruok mar ngima to ndalono nochopnu apoya kaka obadho.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

kikuyu: Osepiela ei lowo piny; omiyo rit ngimana kaluwore gi wachni.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

kikuyu: kagiwacho ni, ‘Jali nochako gedo to ok onyal tieko.’
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

kikuyu: Ngʼeyo ma an-go agolo kuma bor; kendo koro adwaro nyiso kaka Jachwechna timo gik makare.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

kikuyu: Kane aparo ni adhi maber, ne awacho niya, “Onge gima biro bwoga.”
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mar abiriyo nyathi notho, jotij Daudi ne luor nyise ni nyathi osetho, nikech negiparo niya, “Kane nyathi pod ngima, ne wawuoyo gi Daudi to ne ok owinjowa. Koro to wadhi wacho ne nangʼo ka nyathi osetho? Onyalo timo gimoro marach.”
english: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

kikuyu: Ngʼat mangʼwon biro bedo gi mwandu; to ngʼat makweyo chuny ji ibiro kwe chunye bende.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

kikuyu: “Kik ulos nyiseche mothedhi mag mula mondo ulam.
english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka kaw remo moko kuom misengini mag golo richo kendo oketi e sirni mag dhood hekalu, kendo e konde angʼwen mag gama mamalo mar kendo mar misango, kendo ewi sirni mar rangach midonjogo e laru maiye.
english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

kikuyu: Chikgi mondo gitim maber, ka gipongʼ gi mwandu mag timbe mabeyo kendo gibed mangʼwon ka giikore pogo mwandugi ne ji mochando gik ma gin-go.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone niya, “Angʼo ma dimi imed wuoyo? Asemiyou chik ni in kod Ziba upogru puothe.”
english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

kikuyu: kendo uritane. Ka nyiri moa Shilo owuok oko mondo gibi e nyasi, to ringuru uwuogi mapiyo kua e puothe mzabibu mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato oyud dhako kuom nyirigo mondo udog-go e piny jo-Benjamin.
english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Wan pok wakethonu, to un koro utimonwa marach kuom kedo kodwa. Mad uwe Jehova Nyasaye, ma jangʼad bura ongʼad burano odiechiengʼ ma kawuononi e kind jo-Israel gi jo-Amon.”
english: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

kikuyu: omiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro kumo Edom mi aneg ji duto kod le modak e pinyno. Abiro loke gunda, kendo chakre Teman nyaka Dedan gibiro podho e dho ligangla.
english: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

kikuyu: Yaye od Daudi, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Ngʼad bura makare okinyi ka okinyi; kony ngʼatno ma imayo e lwet joma thire, ka ok kamano to mirimba noolre oko, kendo liel ka mach nikech timbe mamono misetimo nowangʼ, maonge ngʼama nyalo kweye.
english: House of David, the LORD says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

kikuyu: Negigolo Uria Misri kendo gitere ne Ruoth Jehoyakim, mane omiyo onege gi ligangla kendo dende owiti e kar yiko mar ji ajiya.)
english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Bani: Madai, Amram, Uel,
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

kikuyu: Hekalu ma oko ne nigi sirni mag dhoot ma borgi gi lachgi romre, kendo mago mag dhoot midonjogo e Kama Ler Moloyo bende ne chalo kamano.
english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

kikuyu: Kama noyudo ngʼatno somo ndiko kama wacho ni: “Notere kar thone mana ka rombo mitero kar yengʼo, kendo nolingʼ ka nyarombo manie lwet ngʼama ngʼado yiere, omiyo en bende ne ok otingʼo dhoge.
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Bende in-gi adiera ni onyalo tingʼoni cham misekayo mokelni dala mi okelgi kar dino?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

kikuyu: mondo omi joka Lawi (maonge pok kata girkeni ma owalnegi), to gi jodak, nyithind kiye kod mon ma chwogi otho modak e miechu obi ochiem mayiengʼ kendo mondo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ogwedhu e gik moko duto ma lwetu timo.
english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

kikuyu: Kendo Jakobo noneno ni pach Laban ok nikode kaka chon.
english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

kikuyu: Nikech ndalo biro chopo ma ji ok nodwar chiko itgi ni puonj mar adier to giniluw puonj mamit mar dwachgi giwegi kendo ginichok jopuonj mathoth mondo onyisgi gik ma itgi masakni gombo winjo.
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi kwe, mana kaka ne osesingore ni enomi kweregi. Onge wasikgi moro amora mane omonjogi; kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo wasikgi duto e lwetgi.
