english: The LORD gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

kikuyu: Kwerewa ne lemo ewi godni, to un jo-Yahudi to uwacho ka uramo ni Jerusalem ema nyaka walamie.”
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni ne atuo kamano, to ne ok uchaya, kendo ne ok ujara. Kar timo kamano, to ne urwaka gi luor mana ka gima ne urwako malaika mar Nyasaye; chutho ne urwaka mana ka gima ne an Kristo Yesu owuon.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Emomiyo, osiepena mageno, kaka koro usengʼeyo wachni, ritreuru mondo kik ywau gi kethruok mag jomaricho mi ulwar ua kama ber muchungʼie.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

kikuyu: Nikech kata obedo ni wadak e pinyni, to ok wakedi kaka jopiny kedo.
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

kikuyu: Eka Eliakim, Shebna kod Joa nowachone jatend lweny niya, “Yie iwuo gi jotichni gi dho jo-Aram nimar wawinjo dhokno. We wuoyo kodwa gi dho jo-Hibrania nikech joma ni e ohinga nyalo winjo gik miwachonwa.”
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

kikuyu: Noloko pigegi remo, mi nomiyo rechgi otho.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Un e jotend anywola mar jo-Lawi, un kaachiel gi joweteu ma jo-Lawi nyaka upwodhru mondo uom Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel mondo ukele kama aseikone.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

kikuyu: Kane oolo mo mangʼwe ngʼarno e ringra, notimo kamano mondo oikago ne ik.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

kikuyu: Parie kaka jasigu osejari, yaye Jehova Nyasaye. Parie kaka joma onge rieko osechayo nyingi.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

kikuyu: Gideon nowachone Nyasaye niya, “Ka inires jo-Israel kokalo kuoma kaka ne isingo,
english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

kikuyu: Gol wangʼa oko kuom gik manono; rit ngimana kaluwore gi wachni.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

kikuyu: Humbe rumo e piny; kendo onge ngʼama nochak opare.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

kikuyu: Ne aluongo osiepena, to ne gindhoga. Jodolo maga gi jodonga notho e dala maduongʼ, kane gimanyo chiemo mondo gibed mangima.
english: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat moro moa e anywolane biro wuok mondo okaw kare. Enomonj jolweny mag ruoth mar Nyandwat mi odonji nyaka e ohingane mochiel motegno kendo obiro kedo kodgi mi ologi.
english: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.

kikuyu: Nikech wasigu mwakedogo ok gin dhano, to wakedo gi jotelo, kod ruodhi mag piny motimo mudhoni, kaachiel gi lang chuny maricho modak e kor polo.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

kikuyu: “Anamiyi piny Kanaan kaka girkeni mari.”
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Nyasaye ma Jawarwa ema nohulo wachne malongʼo e ndalo mane en owuon oketo, kendo nogolo chik ni an ema onego miya tich mar lando wachneno.
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

kikuyu: To ngʼato ka ngʼato nodhi e dalagi owuon mondo ondik nyinge.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ndik wachni e kitap ndiko kaka gima ibiro par bende nyaka ine ni Joshua owinje, nimar abiro tieko jo-Amalek duto e piny ka.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

kikuyu: Duoknegiuru puothegi, puothegi mag mzabibu, puothegi mag zeituni kod utegi, kaachiel gi hola midwoko gohala ma gin achiel ewi mia achiel mar pesa gi cham, gi divai manyien kod mo.”
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

kikuyu: koa e dhood Juda, ne en Kaleb wuod Jefune;
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne gitero Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye Ekron. Kane Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye nidonjogo Ekron, jo-Ekron noywak kawacho niya, “Gisekelo Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel kuomwa mondo onegwa kaachiel gi jowa.”
english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Musa nokawo boche duto mogawo jamb-ich gi moumo chuny gi nyiroke ariyo kod boche mogawogi mi nowangʼogi e kendo mar misango.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

kikuyu: Joma oyie duto ooronu mos, moloyo to jood Kaisar.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

kikuyu: In janyawo, dhi ir biye; mondo ineye kendo ipar yoregi, mondo ibed mariek!
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nodak e dala mochiel gi ohinga moluonge ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

kikuyu: Achayo joma pachgi ariyo, to ahero chikni.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

kikuyu: Aketo wachni e yo ma dhano nyalo winjo nikech uyomyom kaka dhano. Mana kaka yande chon ne uchiwo fuonde ringreu doko wasumb timbe mochido, kendo ne richo mosiko medore ameda, e kaka koro owinjore uchiw fuonde ringreu obed wasumbini mag timbe makare makelo ngima maler.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

kikuyu: En adier ni iseloyo jo-Edom kendo koro iwuoyo marach. Bed mamor kuom lochnino, to kik iwuogi e dala! Angʼo momiyo imanyo lweny mabiro tieki kaachiel gi jo-Juda duto?”
english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano gol chik mondo ongʼadna Sida mag Lebanon. Jotichna biro tiyo kaachiel gi jotichni, bende abiro chulo jogi chudo moro amora miketo. Ingʼeyo ni waonge gi ngʼat ma olony e goyo yien piny kaka jo-Sidon.”
english: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

kikuyu: nyikwa Bezai, ji mia adek gi piero adek gadek (323)
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: Oganda maduongʼ noluwe, kendo nochangogi kuno.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjogi niya, “En ngʼat machal nade mane obiro moromo kodu kendo onyisou wechegi?”
english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

kikuyu: Eka jogo duto nodhi ir ruoth mi giwacho niya, “Yaye ruoth, ngʼe ni kaluwore gi chik jo-Medes gi jo-Pasia, to onge chik ma ruoth osegolo manyalo lokore.”
english: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, “Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.”

kikuyu: Eka negimedo penjo wach kuom Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ngʼatni bende osebiro ka koso?” Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, “Ee, osepondo e kind misike.”
english: Therefore they asked of the LORD further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” The LORD answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Odiechiengʼ ma anapwodhie kuom richoni duto, anami ji odagi e miechi kendo, kendo kuonde momukore magi nochak oger.
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

kikuyu: “Ka chwo magore ogoyo dhako man-gi ich kendo onywol ka kinde nywol pok ochopo to onge hinyruok moro malich, ngʼat motimo marachno nyaka gol chudo moro amora ma chwor dhakono okwayo kendo jangʼad bura oyiego.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

kikuyu: ngʼat ma ok ohero kongʼo, ngʼat ma ok ger, bende owinjore obed ngʼat mamuol, ma ok ohero dhawo kendo ma ok ohero pesa.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

kikuyu: Ka gigi chako timore, chunguru kendo tingʼuru wiwu malo, nikech ndalou mag warruok chiegni.”
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

kikuyu: Ka uchopo kuno, to unuyud jogo ma ok oikore ne lweny kendo gi piny malach ma Nyasaye oseketo e lwetu, piny maonge gima ochando kendo man-gi gik moko duto.”
english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: wabiro yudo gik moko duto mabeyo ma nengogi tek, mi wapongʼ utewa gi gik moyaki.
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

kikuyu: Bende e kinde ma ngʼato angʼata nobiro ire mondo okulre e nyime, Abisalom ne mako lwet ngʼatno kendo nyodhe.
english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

kikuyu: To Yesu nolingʼ alingʼa ma ok odwoke kata wach achiel mane odonjnego, kendo mano nomiyo ruoth owuoro ahinya.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

kikuyu: nikech kata kinde mane an Thesalonika ne uorona kony nyadi mangʼeny e kinde mane an gi dwaro.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

kikuyu: Ikgi duto e lowo; mondo ji kik negi kendo.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

kikuyu: Donge koro eka iwachona kama: Wuonwa, osiepna chakre tin-na,
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

kikuyu: Kane ogendini duto otieko ngʼado aora Jordan, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: Omiyo yawuot Israel notimo kamano. Josef nomiyogi geche miywayo gi punde, mana kaka Farao nowachone kendo en bende nomiyogi gik mane ginyalo konyore godo e yo.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

kikuyu: Mano ema omiyo nyaka chil kawuono jodolo mag Dagon kata mana ngʼama donjo e hekalu mar Dagon e Ashdod ok nyon ndiri.
english: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Satan niya, “Jehova Nyasaye okweri, Satan! Jehova Nyasaye moseyiero Jerusalem okweri! Donge ngʼatni chalo mana ka yien maliel moyudh oko e mach?”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ-gi dhok abiriyo mamoko maricho kendo odhero nowuok. Ne pok anenoe dhok maricho kendo modhero kamano e piny Misri duto.
english: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

kikuyu: Ka urito buchena kendo urito chikena,
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

kikuyu: Wachno nomiyo koko ochakore ei Jerusalem duto, kendo ji moa koni gi koni nobiro karingo. Negimako Paulo mi giywaye gigole ei hekalu, bangʼe giloro dhorangeye duto.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

kikuyu: To Samson nonindo kanyo nyaka dier otieno. Eka no-aa malo kendo nomako ranga dalano kaachiel gi sirnine ariyo mopudhogi kod gik moko duto. Notingʼogi e goke mi oterogi ewi got momanyore gi Hebron.
english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

kikuyu: Kane gisetimo kamano, negimako rech mangʼeny makoro tonde ne chako yiech.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

kikuyu: Kinyne kogwen kane oyudo en e yo odok Jerusalem, kech ne kaye.
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Nyaka inege kendo lweti owuon ema okuong tere e tho. Bangʼe lwet ji moko duto bende otim kamano.
english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

kikuyu: Bende ne en gi yawuowi abiriyo gi nyiri adek.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Mana kaka pi mangʼich chalo ne chuny mool, e kaka wach maber moa e piny mabor chalo.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

kikuyu: Bende Nyasaye nokete jadolo maduongʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: dhok alufu piero abiriyo gariyo (72,000),
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: Omiyo pod aparonu wechegi, kata obedo ni ungʼeyogi kendo uguroru motegno e adiera makoro un-go.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

kikuyu: Ok asepuonjora rieko, kata ngʼeyo mar Nyasaye, ma en Jal Maler Moloyo, bende aongego.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

kikuyu: joma chano chenro maricho e chunygi kendo gitugo lweny pile pile.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

kikuyu: Lokuru chunyu, to ok lepu. Dwoguru ir Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu, nikech ongʼwon kendo okecho ji, iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo ojahera, bende chunye lendo kuom kelo ne ji masira kata chwat.
english: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

kikuyu: Noyiero joma riek kuom jo-Israel duto mi noketogi jotelo mag ji alufu alufu, mia mia, piero abich abich, kod apar apar.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: Omiyo gibiro lamonu Nyasaye, ka chunygi otwere kodu, kuom ngʼwono mogundho ma Nyasaye osemiyou.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ubiro ngʼeyo yo mudhiyoe, nikech ne pok uluwo yorni nyaka nene. Makmana, beduru mochwalore gi sandugno, madirom fut alufu ariyo mia ochiko gi piero abich gadek; kendo kik usud machiegni kode.”
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho niya, “Ma e kaka ubiro ngʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye ema noora mondo atim gigi duto kendo ni ne ok en pacha awuon:
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

kikuyu: kendo magi e nyithindo mane onywolne Jerusalem kuno: Shamua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon. Nyithindo angʼwen-gi nonywolo gi Bathsheba nyar Amiel.
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

kikuyu: To kuom Roho Maler nonyis ratiro ni en Wuod Nyasaye, nikech teko mane ochierego koa kuom joma otho, ma en Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

kikuyu: Unune malit un joma osetieko ji, to pok otieku! Unune malit un joma osendhogo ji, to un pok ondhogu! Ka uweyo tieko ji to notieku; bende ka uweyo ndhogo ji to nondhogu.
english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

kikuyu: Festo nodwokogi niya, “Paulo otwe Kaisaria, kendo an awuon abiro dhi ire kuno mapiyo,
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

kikuyu: Jodongo moko mag piny nosudo nyime e lela kendo owachone chokruok mangima mar ji ni,
english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

kikuyu: Nyasaye ema miya teko kendo omiyo yora bedo mokwe.
english: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

kikuyu: Opondo ne wenge gik mangima duto, kendo opande koda kane winy mafuyo e kor polo.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

kikuyu: kendo ne aketo tere e umi, gi sitadi e iti koni gi koni, bangʼe to ne asidhoni osimbo ma jaber e wiyi.
english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

kikuyu: Eka negichopo kama iluongo ni Golgotha (tiende ni “Hanga Wich”).
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

kikuyu: Jomaricho bedo resruok mar joma kare; to jogo ma ok jo-adiera ne joma oriere tir.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

kikuyu: Teruru chiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye kuom gik moko duto ma un-go. Ngʼato angʼata ma chunye oyie nyaka kel ne Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mag: “dhahabu, fedha kod mula;
english: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼama kare olokore oweyo timbene makare mi otimo richo to timneno ema biro nege. Obiro tho nikech richo mosetimono.
english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu wuok aa ei pi, noneno polo kayawore kendo ka Roho Maler lor mondo opi kuome e kido mar akuru.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

kikuyu: To koro oseketho nyinge kowacho ni, ‘Ne ok ayudo nyari gi ringre.’ To ma e gima nyiso ni nyara ne oyud gi gige ringre.” Bangʼe jonywolne noyar law e nyim jodong gwengʼ,
english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

kikuyu: Tem matek mondo ichop ira-ka kapok ndalo chwiri ochopo. Yubulo ooroni mos. Pude gi Lino kod Klaudia, kaachiel gi jowete duto bende jomosi.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

kikuyu: Kane Samuel ochako wuoth mondo odhi, Saulo nomako riak lawe, mi oyiech.
english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

kikuyu: Ka usiko e iya kendo wechena osiko eiu, to unyalo kwayo gimoro amora ma chunyu gombo mi nomiu.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

kikuyu: Jogo mane osebedo kopondo nodonjo Gibea apoya nono, ka gikere koni gi koni ma ginego ji duto mane ni e dala maduongʼno gi ligangla.
english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Timbeu maricho hinyo mana dhano machal kodu, kendo timbeu makare bedo konyruok mana ne yawuot ji.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene moko ne wuoyo kuom hekalu kawuoro kaka olose gi kite mabeyo kod mich mochiw ni Nyasaye. To Yesu nowacho niya,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

kikuyu: Ma en gima ochuno jo-Israel; chik ma Nyasach Jakobo nogolo.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yesu nokonegi niya, “Dwolno ne ok obiro mondo okonya, to nobiro mondo okonyu.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

kikuyu: gi tula matin, tula maduongʼ gi tula marachar,
english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

kikuyu: To bende ka ichungʼ ilemo, to in-gi wach moro e kindi gi ngʼato, to nyaka iwene richone, eka mondo Wuonu manie polo bende oyie weyoni richoni. [
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

kikuyu: eka inyalo bedo thuolo kionge gi wichkuot kendo ibiro chungʼ motegno ka ionge luoro.
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

kikuyu: Isemiyo gibedo oganda mag pinyruodhi kendo jodolo mondo giti ne Nyasachwa, kendo ginibed joloch e piny.”
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, onge ngʼama ongʼeyo sa ma kindene chopoe: Mana kaka rech imako gi gogo, kata winy imako gi wino, e kaka dhano moko e obadho mar richo ka ok ongʼeyo.
english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ok an Nyasaye mantie machiegni kende, to an Nyasaye man mabor bende.”
english: “Am I a God at hand,” says the LORD, “and not a God afar off?

kikuyu: kendo moro ma moro nonego jadhape. Gikanyono jo-Aram noringo ka jo-Israel lawogi. To Ben-Hadad ruodh jo-Aram notony koidho farase kod joidh faresene mamoko.
english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e Nyasaye! Kendo isesingo gik mabeyogi ni jatichni.
english: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

kikuyu: mane rwako lewni marambulu gi jotendgi kod jotend jolweny, ma giduto ne gin yawuowi matindo mabeyo moidho farese.
english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.

kikuyu: Ne gikawe odiechiengʼ nogono mi ginego ji duto kendo giketho gimoro amora mangima manie iye, mana kaka negisetimone Lakish.
english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

kikuyu: Zila bende nonywolo wuowi ma nyinge Jubal-Kain, mane jatheth chumbe duto mag mula kod nyinyo. Nyamin Tubal-Kain nyinge ne Naama.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

kikuyu: Nikodemo nopenje niya, “Ere kaka inyalo nywol ngʼato kosebedo ngʼama duongʼ? Adier, bende dochak odog ei min mare mi chak nywole kendo!”
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

kikuyu: Janim, Beth Tapua, Afeka,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

kikuyu: We mondo atiekgi duto mondo agol nying-gi oko e wangʼ piny kae. Abiro miyo idok oganda maratego kendo mangʼeny moloyogi.”
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

kikuyu: Koro tinde opidhe e piny motimo ongoro, ma en piny motwo kendo man-gi riyo.
english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kode, kendo ne odhi maber e gik moko duto mane otimo. Nongʼanyone ruodh Asuria kendo ne ok otiyone.
english: The LORD was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato manowinje nowuoro ngʼeyone kod dwokoge.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ndalo biro ma anakumie joma oter nyangu e ringruok kende
english: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:

kikuyu: Isaka nopidho cham e pinyno kendo Jehova Nyasaye nogwedhe e higano moyudo cham moloyo manochwoyo nyadi mia achiel.
english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.

kikuyu: Dwarore ni umed timo kinda kuom timo dwaro Nyasaye, eka unwangʼ gik mosesingore ni nomiu.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

kikuyu: Kane giwuok kanyo negidhi nyime gi wuoth mi gigo kambi Holo mar Zered.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

kikuyu: Omiyo lokri iwe timni marachni, kendo ilam Ruoth Nyasaye, dipo ka oweyoni richoni kuom bedo gi paro marachno e chunyi.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

kikuyu: Bende tungʼ mar lweny nyalo ywak e dala ma ok omiyo ji otetni? Koso ere gima nyalo timore e dala ma ok Jehova Nyasaye ema oyie mondo otimre?
english: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?

kikuyu: Un chwo, heruru mondu, kendo kik ubednegi mager.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

kikuyu: To Joab gi Abishai nolawo Abner, kendo ka chiengʼ ne podho, negichopo e got Ama, machiegni gi Gia e yo mochiko thim mar Gibeon.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

kikuyu: Harun gi yawuote noluok tiendegi kod lwetegi gi pi mogol e iye.
english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

kikuyu: Jodongo nowach ne jolweny niya, “Bende ngʼato osegero ot manyien ma oweyo odno kapok orwako? Onego odog dala nikech dipo ka otho e lweny ma ngʼat machielo ema orwako odno.
english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

kikuyu: Gima chalo agulu mar mula mane ni e ewi achiel kuom sirni borne kadhi malo ne romo fut aboro kendo nokede gi gik mongʼinore ongʼinore molwore koni gi koni. Siro machielo man-gi gik mongʼinore ongʼinore, ne chal kod mokwongo.
english: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

kikuyu: kendo oyuda kuome, mondo kik anenra ni aloso yora awuon mar bet makare e nyim Nyasaye nikech mako Chik, to adwaro ni mano otimrena mana nikech ayie kuom Kristo. Bedo kare e yorni aa kuom Nyasaye kendo wayude kuom yie.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

kikuyu: Ka wangima to wangima ni Ruoth; kendo ka watho to bende watho ne Ruoth.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

kikuyu: Eka Laban nowachone niya, “In ringra awuon kendo remba.” Kane Jakobo ne osedak kod Laban kuom dwe achiel,
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

kikuyu: Arfaksad nonywolo Shela, to Shela nonywolo Eber.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: to moro ka moro kuomgi ne nigi lela wangʼ angʼwen, kod bwombe angʼwen.
english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

kikuyu: An jagop jo-Yunani gi joma ok jo-Yunani, kendo mar joma riek kod joma ofuwo.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno oseweyo tudruok gi wich ma en e kama ringruok duto otude kendo omoke ka omake gi fuonini kod leche kaachiel, kendo gidongo kaka Nyasaye dwaro ni gidongi.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

kikuyu: “Neuru, anaornu janabi Elija kapod odiechiengʼ maduongʼ kendo malich mar Jehova Nyasaye obiro.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.

kikuyu: Shalabin, Aijalon, Ithla,
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

kikuyu: Obiro chiko tiende joge maler to joricho to nolal ei mudho. “Ngʼato ok lochi mana nikech teko;
english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.

kikuyu: Baasha noyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike Tirza. Kendo Ela wuode nokawo lochne kaka ruoth.
english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruoth manyien mane ok ongʼeyo wach Josef nobedo e loch e piny Misri.
english: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.

kikuyu: Omiyo asebiro mondo alerni tiend gima biro timore ne jou, nimar fweny misenenono wuoyo kuom gik mabiro timore e ndalo mabiro.
english: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”

kikuyu: Kendo nogoyonegi ngero moro ni: “Puoth ngʼat moro ma jamoko nochiek maber.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

kikuyu: Ngʼat maonge gi rieko jaro jabathe, to ngʼat man-gi winjo rito lewe.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho niya, “Ka in iwuon ok idhi kodwa, to kik igolwa ka.
english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

kikuyu: Chikene duto ni e nyima; pok alokora aweyo buchene.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

kikuyu: Yesu noneno kaka jopuonjrene ne chandore gi chiko yie, nikech yamo ne kedo kodgi. To kar sa apar kogwen, Yesu nobiro irgi kowuotho ewi pi. Kochopo irgi to nochalo ka gima odwa kalo akala odhi,
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

kikuyu: Kane gikwangʼ, nindo notere. Eka ahiti mangʼongo notugore e nam, koro yieno ne opongʼ gi pi kendo ne gin e chandruok maduongʼ.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

kikuyu: Mad jodolo magi rwakre gi tim makare, kendo mad jogi maler wer gi mor.’ ”
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

kikuyu: Iseketo ndalona obedo machiek ka bad dhano; kar romb higni maga ok gimoro e nyimi, ngima dhano ka dhano en mana muya nono. Sela
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, ne aneno kombe mag loch, ma joma ne obetie nosemi teko mar ngʼado bura. Bende ne aneno chuny joma ne osengʼad wiyegi nikech wach yie margi motegno mane gihulo kuom Yesu kendo wach Nyasaye mane gilando. Jogi ne ok olamo ondiek malichno kata gima ket kode kendo kido mare ne ok oket e lela wengegi kata lwetegi. Negidoko mangima kendo negilocho gi Kristo kuom higni alufu achiel.
english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

kikuyu: Othiro joma odhier gi joma ochando. Omayo ji gigegi githuon. Ok odwok gik mane omako koholo ji gowi. Ogeno nyiseche mag dhano. Otimo gik makwero. Oholo ji gige mondo oyudie ohala
english: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

kikuyu: Ka ji nowinjo chikni, negigolo oko jogo duto ma welo kuom jo-Israel.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

kikuyu: E kinde ma pinje moko mag pinyruoth nobed kagalo ni gidhi maber, enomonjgi, kendo enolochi e yo ma wuonege kata kwerege ne pok olochogo. Enopog gik momayo ji githuon, gi gik moyako kod mwandu duto ne jolupne. Enochan bende mar loko loje mag kuonde mochiel motegno, to notim kamano kuom kinde matin kende.
english: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.

kikuyu: Resa e lwet joma timbegi richo, yaye Nyasacha, gola kuom richo gi joma kwiny momaka matek.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

kikuyu: “Wan; jodolo, gi jo-Lawi kaachiel gi ji mamoko wasegoyo ombulu mondo wayier chiengʼ ma dala ka dala biro chiwoe yien miwangʼogo misengini ewi kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa e kinde moketi higa ka higa, mana kaka ondiki e Chik.
english: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on the LORD our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;

kikuyu: Mano osetimore nikech ogendini e pinje duto osemadho divai makech mar terruokne. Ruodhi mag piny oseterore kode, kendo jo-ohala mag piny bende osedoko jo-mwandu nikech ohala mangimane mamalo osekelonegi.”
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

kikuyu: Magi e joma ne okwan gi Musa kod Eliazar jadolo e kinde mane okwan jo-Israel e paw Moab mantiere e loka Jordan koa Jeriko.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Joshua nowacho niya, “Angʼo momiyo isekelo masira machal kama kuomwa? In bende Jehova Nyasaye biro keloni masira.” Bangʼe jo-Israel duto nochielo Akan kod joge gi kite, kendo ne giwangʼe kaachiel gi joge.
english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? The LORD will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

kikuyu: Mantiere sani nosebedo, kendo mano mabiro bedo nosebedo chon; kendo Nyasaye biro kelo gik machon e kar ngʼado bura.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

kikuyu: Ayiuru buta, un jorichogi, mondo arit chike mag Nyasacha!
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

kikuyu: Ibiro wuoyo kode mi iket weche e dhoge; abiro konyou un ji ariyo mondo uwuo bende abiro puonjou gima onego utim.
english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni ibiro tera nyaka e tho, nyaka kama ochan ne joma ngima duto.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

kikuyu: To Baruk wuod Neria thuyi kodwa mondo ichiw-wa ne jo-Babulon, mondo ginegwa kata terowa e twech Babulon.”
english: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon.”

kikuyu: (“ ‘Magi e sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye manyaka ulandi ni gin e chokruok maler michiwone Jehova Nyasaye gi mach kaka misengini miwangʼo pep, gi misengini mag cham gi misengini miolo piny kendo moro ka moro nigi odiechienge mowinjore.
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

kikuyu: To wuon-gi nonindo e kitanda nikech notuo, ka en gi midhusi, kendo nodiewo. Paulo nodonjo kama noninde mondo onene, to bangʼ koselamone, noketo lwete kuome mochange.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

kikuyu: Mad joma donjona lal nono ka wigi okuot; mad joma dwaro hinya, obed gi achaya kod wichkuot koni gi koni.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

kikuyu: kata kapo ni asechamo kuona kenda, ma ok apoge ne nyithind kiye,
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

kikuyu: En gima lich miwuoro ka ngʼato olwar e lwet Nyasaye mangima!
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

kikuyu: Gonya e twech ma antie, mondo apak nyingi. Eka joma kare biro chokore buta nikech ber misetimona.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

kikuyu: To ngʼat moro noywayo atungʼ mare modiro asere ma nochwowo ruodh Israel e kind law lweny mane orwako. Ruoth nonyiso jariemb gari niya, “Lok garini mondo igola ka, nimar ahinyora marach.”
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

kikuyu: Kipwodhogi, to itim kama: Kwo pi mipwodhogigo kuomgi; bangʼe giliel yie dendgi duto kendo giluok lepgi, eka gibed joma opwodhi.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

kikuyu: Kik ulam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e yo ma gilamogo nyiseche manono.
english: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Nyithinde nyaka dwok gik mane okwalo kuom jodhier, adier nyithinde nyaka dwok mwandu mane omayo ji.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

kikuyu: E kindeno Bad Yath mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed maber kendo man-gi duongʼ, kendo olemo mar piny nobed mor kod duongʼ ne jo-Israel motony.
english: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

kikuyu: Kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa, Harun noketo manna e nyim Sandug Muma mondo mi okane.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

kikuyu: Aorou mondo udhi mana kaka rombe madhi e dier ondiegi. Kuom mano, beduru mariek ka thuonde, kendo mamuol ka akuche.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

kikuyu: Winj wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye od Jakobo, un dhoudi duto mag dhood Israel.
english: Hear the LORD’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

kikuyu: chakre aora Jordan kochomo yo wuok chiengʼ kaachiel gi pinje duto mag Gilead (ma gin gwenge mag Gad, Reuben kod Manase), kendo chakre Aroer manie bath aora Arnon kokadho Gilead nyaka Bashan.
english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

kikuyu: Ininyon sibuor gi thuond fu; adier ininyon sibuor maratego gi thuol maduongʼ man-gi kwiri marach.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

kikuyu: Nathaniel nopenje niya, “Ingʼeya nade?” Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ne aneni sa ma ne in e tiend ngʼowu, kane pok Filipo oluongi.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

kikuyu: Iwe yamo tero ka yiend sida; kendo leche manie bembene omoko kuome maber.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

kikuyu: Eka jorit wasumbini kod nyipeche ne odhi mowachone jo-Israel niya, “Ma e gima Farao wacho, ‘Ok abi miyou lum kendo.
english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

kikuyu: Jodong Gilead nodwoko niya, “Jehova Nyasaye obed janeno marwa; adier wabiro timo kaka iwachono.”
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”

kikuyu: “An ok adwar mondo dhano omiya duongʼ;
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

kikuyu: Ne aparo mondo atim gimoro ne nyinga maler, ma dhood Israel nosedwanyo e dier ogendini kuonde mane gidhiye.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

kikuyu: Sunga manie chunyu osewuondou, un mudak e kind lwendni, kendo ugero miechu kuonde motingʼore, un ma uwacho kendu niya, ‘En ngʼa manyalo dwokowa piny?’
english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

kikuyu: Baruk wuod Zabai bende nochiwore mochako gero migawo moro chakre kama ohinga ogomogo nyaka dhood Eliashib ma jadolo maduongʼ.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

kikuyu: gi nyiroke ariyo kod bor man kuomgi man but oguche kod jwala mabor manie wi chuny nogol oko kaachiel gi nyiroke.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Winjauru un joma ongʼeyo tim makare, un oganda mondiko chikena e chunyu: Kik uluor weche midiro mag dhano kata luoro ayany mag ji.
english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.

kikuyu: “Kendo magi e nying-gi: “e dhood Juda, en Kaleb wuod Jefune;
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny bende ne jimbone wach ka giketo ketho mag miriambo e wiye, to wechegi ne ok chalre.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

kikuyu: Harun noliero agoko kod bam korachwich e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango miliero kendo ifwayo mana kaka Musa nochiko.
english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

kikuyu: kendo nokok gi dwol maduongʼ machalo ka sibuor maruto. Bangʼ kosekok kamano to polo abiriyo nomor.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

kikuyu: Bangʼ winjo wachgino, negitingʼo dwondgi malo kaachiel ka gilamo Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, in ema nichweyo polo gi piny gi nam kod gik moko duto manie igi.
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: Eka Zebul nowachone niya, “Ere thoro wach maru koro, un mane uwacho ni, ‘Abimelek en ngʼa manyaka wabed mana e bwo lochne?’ Donge magi e joma ne ichayo? Koro wuoguru mondo uked kodgi!”
english: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

kikuyu: Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowacho niya, “Osiepa, richoni oweni.”
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: kendo ok gingʼeyo yo makelo kwe.”
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

kikuyu: Elija nodwoke niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, matiyone, ni adier kawuononi nyaka adhi e nyim Ahab.”
english: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

kikuyu: Parnauru gik mane otimore chon, mondo wapim wechego kanyakla; kendo wachuru ane gik manyiso ni uonge gi ketho.
english: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.

kikuyu: Nitie aora moro ma pige kelo mor e dala Nyasaye, e dala maler kama Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo odakie.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi ni e thim, nowinjo ni Nabal ngʼado yie rombe.
english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

kikuyu: mondo omi olok chuny ngʼatno kik dhi e piny joma otho, eka ler mar ngima omed rieny kuome.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

kikuyu: Eka negiloso ramaki piero abich mag dhahabu kendo negitiyo kodgi kuom riwo pasia ariyogo kanyakla mondo omi Hemb Romo obed gimoro achiel.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

kikuyu: kendo owachone niya, “Bende ingʼeyo ni Baalis ruodh jo-Amon oseoro Ishmael wuod Nethania mondo okaw ngimani?” To Gedalia wuod Ahikam ne ok oyie gi wachgino.
english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Ji nowuoro puonjne, nikech nopuonjo ka ngʼat man-gi teko, to ok ka Jopuonj Chik.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye winjie wachni: En ngʼa misetimone gima lit machal kama? Bende mon dicham nyithindgi ma giserito maber kama? Koso jodolo gi jonabi dinegi e kama ler mar lemo mar Ruoth Nyasaye adier?
english: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

kikuyu: Jotich Saulo nowachone niya, “Ngʼe ni roho marach machandini, Nyasaye ema ochiwone thuolo.
english: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni yadh ngʼowu ok nyal thiewo bende kata obedo ni onge olemo ewi yadh zeituni, kata obedo ni yadh mzabibu ok nyag olemo bende kata obedo ni puothe ok nyag cham, kendo kata obedo ni rombe orumo e abila mi dhok bende orumo duto e dipo,
english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

kikuyu: Ne apimo gigo duto gi rieko ka aketo chunya mondo abed mariek, to ne ayudo ka ok anyal.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

kikuyu: Koro kawuru jatich manonono udhir oko e mudho, kama ywagruok gi mwodo lak nobedie.’
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

kikuyu: Ma e tich ma dhood Merari onego ti e Hemb Romo kotelnegi gi Ithamar wuod Harun jadolo.”
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

kikuyu: bende ka iyanyowa, to wadwoko gi weche mangʼwon. Nyaka koroni wasedoko machal gi yugi mag piny; wachalo gik mowit oko ni onge tich!
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

kikuyu: Eka nokelo Sandug Muma ei Hemb Romo mogengʼe gi pasia kendo nogengʼo Sandug Muma kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoko kowacho niya, “Beduru gi yie kuom Nyasaye.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachno, ne giweyo Petro mos mi gipako Nyasaye, kagiwacho niya, “Kara en adier ni Nyasaye osemiyo joma ok jo-Yahudi thuolo mondo gin bende gilokre giyud ngima.”
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Daudi wuora niya, ‘Nitimo maber mondo ibed gi wach gero hekalu ni nyinga e chunyi.
english: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

kikuyu: Magi ema ne nyikwa Lawi kochan-gi kaluwore gi anywolagi mane gin jotelo mag anywola mana kaka nondik nying-gi kendo kokwan-gi ngʼato ka ngʼato, mane gin jotich mahikgi piero ariyo kata moloyo kanyo mane tiyo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: E sechego ka Roho Maler nomiyo Yesu opongʼ gi ilo, nowacho niya, “Apakoi, Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo. Ee, Wuora, nimar mano ema ne berni kotimore.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

kikuyu: Aseneno yorene to kata kamano abiro change; abiro nyise yo kendo aho chunye;
english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

kikuyu: Ibrahim ne ja-higni mia achiel kane onywol Isaka wuode.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

kikuyu: “Koro asayi, we jatichni odongʼ ka kaka misumba ruoth kar wuowini kendo iwe wuowini odogi gowetene.
english: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

kikuyu: Harun nyaka kel jo-Lawi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo koa kuom jo-Israel, mondo omi gibed moikore ne tij Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.

kikuyu: To kata ka daher mar pakora, to ok dikawa ni afuwo, nikech gik ma dimi apakra gin adier. To ok abi pakora, nikech ok adwar ni ngʼato okawa ni an ngʼama lich moloyo gik moseneno ka atimo, kata mosewinjo ka awacho.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

kikuyu: Yesu nowinjo ni ne oseriemb ngʼatno oko, omiyo kane oyude, nopenje niya, “Bende iyie kuom Wuod Dhano?”
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

kikuyu: Onge pogruok e kind jamoko kod jachan: Nikech Jehova Nyasaye e Jachwechgi duto.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

kikuyu: Pien denda lokore maratengʼ to ok nikech chiengʼ marieny matek; achungʼ e dier chokruok, kendo aywak mondo okonya.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

kikuyu: “Inipog pinyni ni ngʼato ka ngʼata kuomu kaluwore gi oganda ka oganda mar Israel.
english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Migepegi mag jorit rangeye kokadho kuom jotendgi madongo ne nigi pok mar tiyo ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka wedegi bende notimo.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: “To wigi nowil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi; omiyo nojwangʼogi e lwet Sisera, jatend lweny mar Hazor, kendo e lwet jo-Filistia gi ruodh Moab mane okedo kodgi.
english: But they forgot the LORD their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

kikuyu: Rieko duto mosengʼadni osemana tieki! Koro we jokorgigo obi, jogo makoro wach dwe ka dwe karango sulwe, weyane giresi e gik mabiro timoreni.
english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.

kikuyu: To nikech nyinga, ne atimo gima ne nyalo miyo kik yanye e nyim ogendini mane gidak e diergi, kendo mane ongʼeyo ni ne asefwenyora ni jo-Israel kane agologi e piny Misri.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: kendo e kinde ka kinde manochiw misengini miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye e odiechienge mag Sabato, kendo e Sawo mar Dwe manyien kendo e kinde mag sewni moyier. Nonego giti e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kinde ka kinde kaluwore gi kwan-gi kod yo mowinjore mane ochan-negi.
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

kikuyu: kagiwacho niya, “Ka in e ruodh jo-Yahudi, to kara resri kendi ane.”
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

kikuyu: To Musa nodwoko Nyasaye niya, “An to an ngʼa, ma dadhi ir Farao kendo golo jo-Israel e piny Misri?”
english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”

kikuyu: Rituru buchena kendo une ni uluwo chikena, eka mondo udag gi kwe e pinyno.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruth nonindo gi yo ka tiende nyaka huyuhuyu piny, to nochiewo ka pod ngʼato ok nyal ngʼeyo wadgi. Boaz nowachone niya, “Kik iwe ngʼato ngʼe ni dhako moro nobiro kar dino cham ka.”
english: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”

kikuyu: Omiyo rwakuru lepu mag ywak, ywaguru kendo denguru, nimar mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mager pod ok oweyowa.
english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of the LORD hasn’t turned back from us.

kikuyu: To ok ginidhi mabor nikech fupgi biro nenore ni ji duto mana kaka notimore ni jogo.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

kikuyu: Manase notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike e ode mar ruoth. Amon wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To bende asewinjo ngʼur, mar jo-Israel ma jo-Misri oseloko wasumbinigi mi aparo singruokna.
english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

kikuyu: “E kinde mabiro, ka wuodi nopenji ni, ‘Ma to nyiso angʼo?’ To nyise ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye nogolowa e piny Misri gi lwete maratego kama ne wabede wasumbini.
english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Anaket mana yawuowi obed jotendgi, to rawere matindo noritgi.
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

kikuyu: Ka isandou kamoro, to daruru kanyo udhi kamachielo. Awachonu adier ni ok unutiek dhi e mier duto mag Israel kapok Wuod Dhano obiro.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

kikuyu: To jomaler mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo ema biro rito pinjego kendo ginibed gi loch nyaka chiengʼ.’
english: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’

kikuyu: Ne wathungʼ gi nyiero kendo dhowa nopongʼ gi wende mor. Eka nowachore e dier ogendini niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osetimonegi gik madongo.”
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

kikuyu: Kawuru owadu kendo udhi ir ngʼatno piyo.
english: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.

kikuyu: Jodong kanisa morito weche mag kanisa onego yud pok margi nyadiriyo, to moloyo jodongo ma tichgi en yalo kod puonjo wach Nyasaye.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

kikuyu: mana kaka Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko jo-Israel. Nogere kaluwore gi gima nondiki e kitap Chik mar Musa niya, Kendo mar misango moger gi kite ma ok opa, gi gir nyinyo. Ewi kendono ema negichiwone Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok.
english: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings.

kikuyu: to kane waywakne Jehova Nyasaye, nowinjo ywakwa kendo nooro malaika mi ogolowa waa Misri. “Koro wan Kadesh ka, ma en dala mantiere but piny ma irito.
english: When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

kikuyu: E kindeno ruoth Ahasuerus norito loch Kodak e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno mar Susa,
english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

kikuyu: Omiyo Esta ma mikach ruoth ma nyar Abihail kod Modekai ma ja-Yahudi, nondiko gi teko kod chir mondo ojiw baruwa mar ariyo kuom wach Purim.
english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

kikuyu: To chakre Musa gi Jonabi duto, noleronigi konyisogi gino mane owachi kuome e ndiko duto.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

kikuyu: Negihum kendo giwuoro, mi gipenjo niya, “Donge joma wuoyogi duto gin jo-Galili?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

kikuyu: Gima otimorenuno ok oa kuom Jal mane oluongou.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

kikuyu: Yawuoti kod nyigi noter e pinje mamoko, kendo inimanygi gi wengeni odiechiengʼ duto kionge gi teko mar resogi.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenje niya, “Angʼo machandi?” Nowacho niya, “Chutho, an dhako ma chwore otho; chwora nosetho.
english: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

kikuyu: Luka kende ema ni koda ka. Kaw Mariko mondo ibigo ira, nikech okonya maber e kuom lando Injili.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

kikuyu: Obiro muko piny kuondeu mochiel motegno motingʼore gi malo mi oketgi piny, enotergi e lowo ma gilokre buru.
english: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

kikuyu: Nitie tije mopogore opogore, to Ruoth achiel ema itiyone.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

kikuyu: “E chandruokna ne aluongo Jehova Nyasaye kendo naluongo Nyasacha. Nowinjo dwonda ka en e hekalu mare kendo ywakna nochopo e ite.
english: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye osedagi kendone mar misango kendo jwangʼo kare maler mar lemo. Osechiwo ohinga mag kuonde mag dak e lwet wasigu; gisegoyo koko e od Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka ne itimo e odiechiengʼ mar sawo moyier.
english: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in the LORD’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

kikuyu: kuom mano, abiro oro mach mi wangʼ Teman, kendo enowangʼ ohinga mochiel motegno mag Bozra.”
english: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”

kikuyu: Jomoko osebaro oweyo magi mi gidonjo e mbekni mag oyuma maonge tiendgi.
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

kikuyu: kendo iseketo gik moko duto e bwo tiende.” Ka Nyasaye noketo gik moko duto e bwo lochne to onge gima noweyo oko. To kata kamano sani pod ok wane ka gik moko duto ni e bwo lochne.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech remo mane ochwero ni kuome: ne oole e lwanda nono; ne ok oole e lowo, kama buru ne nyalo ume.
english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi ochopo ewi got kuma ji ne lamoe Nyasaye chon, Hushai ja-Arki ne ni kanyo mondo orom kode, lawe ne oyiech kendo buru ne ni e wiye.
english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

kikuyu: Adam kod chiege ne niduge, to ne gionge wichkuot.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato motimo tim mamono onegi mi ringre ongʼaw e yien,
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

kikuyu: Eka unuwachi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu niya, “Wuonwa ne en ja-Aram mane bayo kendo ne odhi Misri gi ji moko manok modak kuno mi obedo oganda maduongʼ, maratego kendo mangʼeny.
english: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

kikuyu: Ne alor mwalo nyaka e puoth mananas, mondo ane kaka gidongo e holo, kendo mondo ane ka mzabibu osechako golo maua kata ka olemo mongʼinore osechako chiek makwar.
english: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ochikowa mondo warit buchene duto kendo waluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa mondo wadhi maber ndalo duto mag ngimawa, mana kaka timorenwa kawuononi.
english: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokwano nyithindo makayo duto mag jo-Israel, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye ne oriembo ogendini duto e nyimwa, kaachiel gi jo-Amor, mane odak e pinyno. Wan bende wabiro tiyone Jehova Nyasaye, nikech en e Nyasachwa.”
english: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye biro wuotho e piny Misri duto mondo oneg jo-Misri, to obiro neno remo ewi reru kod e bath dhoutu kendo nokal dhoudigo, ok noyie ne janek mondo odonj e uteu mondo onegu.
english: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

kikuyu: To kata kamano omiyowa ngʼwono maduongʼ moloyo, mano emomiyo Muma wacho niya, “Nyasaye osin gi josunga, to ochiwo ngʼwono ne joma muol.”
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “E Bethlehem manie piny Judea, nikech janabi nondiko kama:
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

kikuyu: Kendo ne ikawo lepi mogorie gik mabeyo mi irwakonegi kendo ne iketo moya gi ubanina e nyimgi.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

kikuyu: To Asahel nodagi weyo lawe; mi Abner nochwowo ii Asahel gi tongʼ mi tongʼ nowuok yo ka ngʼee Asahel. Nogore piny kanyo mi otho gisano. Kendo ji duto nochungʼ ka gichopo kama Asahel nogore piny motho.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

kikuyu: To jomatindo mane uwacho ni biro ter e twech, ma gin nyithindo ma ok ongʼeyo pogo ber kod rach, gin ema ginidonji e pinyno. Anamigi pinyno kendo ginikawe mi gidagie.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

kikuyu: Tonde mag liel ne orida kendo odhoga matek; obadho mag tho ne ochoma tir.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

kikuyu: yie imiwa nyikwaye machwo abiriyo mondo onegi kendo owegi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e Gibea e dala Saulo ma en ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye moyier.” Omiyo ruoth nowacho niya, “Abiro miyougi.”
english: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”

kikuyu: Wichkuot mara osiko neno e wangʼa odiechiengʼ duto, kendo lela wangʼa wichkuot oumo.
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

kikuyu: Adwaro bende ni mon orwakre gi lewni mowinjore ka gibidhore kendo giritore maber, to rwakruokgi kik bed mana mar kado wich kata mar dhahabu kata mar rwako tigo ma nengone tek kata lewni ma nengogi tek,
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

kikuyu: Samuel nodwoke niya, “An e janen. Tel nyima idhi kama owal maler nimar kawuono ibiro chiemo koda kendo kiny gokinyi abiro weyi idhi kendo ananyisi mago duto man e chunyi.
english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

kikuyu: Kuonde ma pi luwo nodungʼ marach; bede aore mag Misri nodwon mi two. Odundu kod se biro ner,
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

kikuyu: To kane awinjo ni jo-Yahudi chano mar nege lingʼ-lingʼ, to ne aore iri mapiyo. Bende ne agolo chik mondo joma odonjone obi iri mondo ginyisi gimomiyo gidonjone.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

kikuyu: Ochur seche duto mowinjo ka turumbete ywak! Owinjo tik lweny gi kuma bor, kendo koko mar jochik lweny kod mano mar lweny owinjo chon.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

kikuyu: Mano nyiso bende ni jo-Kristo mosetho bende olal.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

kikuyu: Jabez ne ngʼat marahuma moloyo owetene. Min-gi nochake Jabez, kowacho niya, “Ne anywole gi rem.”
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

kikuyu: Negikendo nyi Moab, ma achiel ne nyinge Orpa, to machielo Ruth. Kane gisedak kuno kuom kinde madirom higni apar,
english: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

kikuyu: Pok mar auchiel ne mar Bukia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Eka jo-Farisai moko gi jopuonj chik nowachone niya, “Japuonj wadwaro neno hono mitimo kaka ranyisi.”
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

kikuyu: Kendo Abija notho kaka kwerene kendo noyike e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Asa wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Ka duongʼna kadho to abiro pandi e rogo mar lwanda kendo abiro umi gi lweta nyaka chop akadhi.
english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

kikuyu: Omiyo ka wawacho ni wan e winjruok kode to pod wawuotho e mudho to wariambo kendo ok wawuothi e adiera.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka wasewacho e kaka achako awacho kendo: Ka ngʼato koro yalonu Injili ma opogore gi mane urwako, to Nyasaye mondo okwongʼe nyaka chiengʼ!
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Negikawo Abisalom ma giwito e bugo maduongʼ manie bungu, mi gibiwo kite madongo dongo kuome. E kindeno jo-Israel duto noringo modhi e miechgi.
english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar apar gariyo, e higa mar apar gariyo, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kawacho niya:
english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Angʼo kendo ma damed wacho? Thuolo ditama mar wuoyonu kuom Gideon, gi Barak, gi Samson, gi Jeftha, gi Daudi, gi Samuel, kod Jonabi mamoko.
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

kikuyu: Ka ichwado nyathi kendo ikwere eka ikonye bedo mariek to nyathi ma owe aweya kelo wichkuot ne min mare.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

kikuyu: Filipo, mana kaka Andrea gi Petro, ne aa e dala mar Bethsaida.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Yahudi nochako mino wach e kindgi giwegi, kagiwacho niya, “Ere kaka ngʼatni nyalo miyowa ringre mondo wacham?”
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ni kodi, en gi teko mar reso ji. Obiro bedo gi mor maduongʼ kuomi, kendo obiro kweyo chunyi gi herane, bende obiro wer ka omor gi ilo kuomi.”
english: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

kikuyu: kendo pasia mamoko ma borgi romo fut piero ariyo gadek ne nitie e bath rangach komachielo kongʼawgi e sirni adek man-gi rachungi adek.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo gi jobuch Sanhedrin duto ne manyo nend miriambo moro mane ginyalo donjonego Yesu mondo gingʼadne buch tho.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

kikuyu: Negiketo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye e gari manyien mine gigole e od Abinadab, mane ni ewi got. Uza gi Ahio, ma gin yawuot Abinadab, ema ne chiko gari manyien
english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

kikuyu: Solomon nokwano jodak duto man Israel bangʼ kwan mane wuon mare Daudi nosekwano kendo noyudo ni gin ji alufu mia achiel gi piero abich gadek gi mia auchiel (153,600).
english: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Omiyo Delila nowachone Samson niya, “Nyisa ane kuma tekoni ae kendo kaka inyalo maki mi tweyi.”
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”

kikuyu: Ber dak e thim motwo moloyo dak gi dhako ma jadhawo kendo ma ja-mirima.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

kikuyu: To kane Laban owinjo wach mar Jakobo, wuod nyamin noringo mondo odhi oromne. Nokwake kendo omose gimor mi orwake dalane kendo Jakobo nonyise gik moko duto.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

kikuyu: Ofwenyo gik matut kendo mopondo; ongʼeyo gima opondo e mudho, kendo ler odak kode.
english: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

kikuyu: Wasika molwora ngʼeny; joma ochaya maonge gima omiyo thoth mokalo akwana.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nooro jaote mondo odhi okele, mi dhakono nobiro ire kendo noterore kode. Ma noyudo ka koro eka otieko kindene mar neno malo kendo nosepwodhore. Bangʼ mano Bathsheba nodok dala.
english: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

kikuyu: Tingʼ wangʼi malo kingʼiyo koni gi koni: Gik moko duto ochokore kendo gibiro iri; yawuoti biro koa mabor kendo nyigi ikelo kotingʼ e bat.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech ne ok iparo ndalo mane pod itin, to ne iwangʼo iya gi gigi duto, omiyo abiro kumi, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho. Donge timbegi duto mamono ne imedo gi dwanyruok?
english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼni duto, to gi gik moko duto manie iye nyaka wene Jehova Nyasaye. Makmana Rahab, mochot, to gi jogo duto manie ode ema nongʼwon-ne, nikech nopando joma ne waoro mane obiro nono piny.
