english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to the LORD. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osesingore gi lwete ma korachwich kendo gi bade maratego ni, “Ok nachak ayie wasiku kaw chambu micham, jopinje mamoko bende ok nochak omadh divai manyien, ma usetiyone matek;
english: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

kikuyu: Koro in bende iselokori ngʼama ok nyal konyo; kineno gimoro mabwogo ji to luoro maki.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

kikuyu: Chiwo mag cham kod misango miolo piny nyaka keti kaka chik dwaro maromre gi rwedhigo, imbego kod nyiimbego.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: To kuom chiwo mar hera unyalo chiwo rwath kata rombo man-gi songa, to chiwogi ok noyiego kuom timo misango mar singruok.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

kikuyu: “To kapo ni gima rach makelo pur ochako othinyore e odno kendo bangʼ ka kitego osegol oko mi ochwer kor odno kendo omuon,
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

kikuyu: “Kochopo chiengʼ mar aboro nyaka okel gigo duto ne jadolo mondo opwodhi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osegolo chik kuomi, in Nineve, kowacho niya: “Ok inibed gi nyikwayi mabiro tingʼo nyingi. Abiro tieko nyisecheu manono mopa kaachiel gi mochwe gi lowo manie uteu mag lemo. Abiro kunyonu bur miyikoue nikech un joma timbegi richo.”
english: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

kikuyu: To wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye neno jogo momiye luor, orango joma geno margi ni kuom herane ma ok rem,
english: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

kikuyu: To Petro nodwoke niya, “Mad pesagigo lal kodi nono, nikech chunyi wuondi ni inyalo ngʼiewo mich Nyasaye gi pesa!
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

kikuyu: To kane ok ginyal chopo ir Yesu nikech oganda maduongʼ mane ni kode, ne gitucho wi tado mochomore gi kama Yesu ne nitie tir mi giloro ja-athanyno konindo e par nyaka nochopo e nyim Yesu.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

kikuyu: Eka Israel nower wendni: “Yaye soko, bubni oko! Werne soko,
english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,

kikuyu: Aluoko lwetena kanyisogo ni aonge ketho, kendo aluoro kendoni mar misango, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo osebedo kiluongo kanyo ni puoth remo nyaka kawuono.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

kikuyu: Eka Hushai ja-Arki, mosiep Daudi nodhi ir Abisalom mowachone niya, “Ruoth mondo odag amingʼa! Ruoth mondo odag amingʼa!”
english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

kikuyu: Timuru ma mondo remo maonge ketho kik chwer e pinyu, ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni mondo kik ubed joketho kuom chwero remo.
english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

kikuyu: Kamano bende e kaka yath maber nyago olemo maber, to yath marach nyago olemo marach.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

kikuyu: ma nowarowa kendo noluongowa mondo wadag e ngima maler. Mano ok nikech wasetimone gimoro maber to nikech dwarone owuon kuom ngʼwonone. Ne omiyowa ngʼwononi kuom Kristo Yesu kane piny pok obetie,
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

kikuyu: Omiyo ruodh Israel noluongo achiel kuom jodonge mowachone niya, “Dhi piyo iom Mikaya wuod Imla.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

kikuyu: Ne awachonu kamano to ne ok unyal winjo. Ne ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye mi ok uluwo chikene, kendo gi wich teko maru ne uwuotho ka udhi e piny mar gode.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Iya nyawni ma ok rum; kendo ndalo mag chandruok ema ochoma.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Arad ma ja-Kanaan, mane odak Negev, nowinjo ni Israel ne wuotho e yo kochiko Atharim, nomonjo jo-Israel mi omako moko.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

kikuyu: Eka Shafan ma jagoro nodhi ir ruoth mowachone niya, “Jodongi osechulo pesa mane nitiere e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo gisechiwogi e lwet jotich kod jotend hekalu.”
english: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of the LORD’s house.”

kikuyu: Gima ogeno kuome en gima nono; kendo gima oyiengoree chalo mbui mar otiengʼ-otiengʼ.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

kikuyu: nimar jaricho onge gi geno mar ndalo mabiro, kendo taya mar ngʼat marach ibiro nego.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

kikuyu: To ne ok giwinjo tiend gimane onyisogi, to bende negiluor mar penje mondo gingʼe tiende.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyaka karangʼo ma joma timbegi richo, nyaka karangʼo ma joma timbegi richo biro goyo siboi?
english: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

kikuyu: mesa gi gigene mag tich, gi rachungi taya gi gigene mag tich, gi kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani,
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nopenjogi niya, “Ongima?” Negidwoke niya, “Ee, ongima, kendo mabiro gi rombe cha en Rael ma nyare.”
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Etham, mi gidok chien Pi Hahiroth, man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Baal Zefon, mi gibworo but Migdol.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

kikuyu: Singruokna manyaka iriti, in kaachiel gi nyikwayi ema: Ngʼato ka ngʼata madichwo e kindu nyaka ter nyangu.
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

kikuyu: E ndalo Joyakim, jodolo mane jotend dhoudi ne gin: koa e anywola Seraya ne en Meraya; koa e anywola Jeremia ne en Hanania;
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

kikuyu: Asechandora moloyo; omiyo rit ngimana, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kaluwore gi wachni.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Ok en wachu mar ngʼeyo ndalo kata kinde ma Wuoro oseketo gi tekone owuon.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ne en Wuod Nyasaye to nopuonjore winjo chik Nyasaye nikech sandruok ma noneno,
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

kikuyu: Kaka ungʼeyo maber ni joma ohore mos e chandruok ema ikwano ni ogwedhi bende usewinjo kuom horuok mar Ayub, kendo ungʼeyo gima Ruoth notimone achien. Ruoth nigi kech kod ngʼwono mathoth.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

kikuyu: Anami jodolo gik mathoth mongundho, kendo joga nopongʼ, gi chiwo mara mabup,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Solomon nodok Jerusalem koa kamotingʼore gi malo man Gibeon, e nyim Hemb Romo. Kendo notiyo tich ruoth Israel.
english: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

kikuyu: Ogendini nowuothi e lerne, kendo ruodhi mag pinje nokel duongʼ-gi e iye.
english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

kikuyu: Kwayo machielo ma an-go en ni mondo ilosna kar nindo, nikech an-gi geno ni ibiro gonya mana kaka usebedo kulamo.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

kikuyu: Duongʼ kod pak nitiere e nyime; teko kod duongʼ nitiere e kare maler mar lemo.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: (Ee, jood Stefano bende ne abatiso, to ok apar ni ne abatiso ngʼat machielo mokalo mano.)
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

kikuyu: Nyaka ochiw chiwo mar cham debe achiel kaachiel gi rwath michiwego, kod debe achiel machielo gi im, to kuom nyarombo ka nyarombo onyalo kelo cham mangʼeny kaka en owuon ema ohero. Kuom debe ka debe mar cham, to onyalo kelo mo zeituni moromo lita angʼwen.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

kikuyu: Mier auchielgo nobed kuonde tony ne jo-Israel, jodak kod ngʼato angʼata modak kodgi, mondo omi ngʼato angʼata monego ngʼat machielo kobothne nyalo ringo dhiye.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Kane oyudowa Asos, nodonjo kodwa e yie, mi wadhi nyaka Mitulene.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

kikuyu: Jal mamiyo ji bedo maler, kaachiel gi ji duto moseloki odoko jomaler, gin nyithind ngʼat achiel. Kuom mano Yesu ok oluor mar luongogi ni owetene,
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka winj joma nigi teko mar loch, nimar onge loch mantie, makmana mano ma Nyasaye ema oketo. Joma ni e loch duto Nyasaye ema oketo.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

kikuyu: Kendo beduru mamor e kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu noyier ni Nyinge kaka kar romo, in gi yawuoti kod nyigi, jotichni machwo gi mamon, jo-Lawi man e miechu, jodak, nyithind kiye, kod mon ma chwogi otho modak e dieru.
english: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

kikuyu: “Ka udonjo e ot to wachuru mokwongo ni, ‘Kwe obedi e odni.’
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

kikuyu: Chop singruok mari ne jatichni, mondo ji oluori.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma odhierni noluongo Jehova Nyasaye, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowinje; ne orese mogole e chandruokne duto.
english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Eka naneno malaika kalor koa e polo, kotingʼo rayaw mar bur matut maonge gikone kod nyororo maduongʼ e lwete.
english: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

kikuyu: “ ‘To gima timore ne yawuoti ariyo ma gin Hofni gi Finehas nobedni ranyisi kendo gibiro tho odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

kikuyu: Omiyo nodhi kode e ode mi opidho pundege. Bangʼ kane giselwoko tiendegi, nomigi gima ginyalo chamo kendo madho.
english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

kikuyu: “Nyaka une ni utimo gik moko duto ma asenyisou. Kik uluong nying nyiseche mamoko; bende kik uwe winjgi kata mana e dhou.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo ohinga mag Jeriko opodho piny, bangʼ ka jo-Israel nosewuotho ka lwore kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

kikuyu: E giko higni piero ariyo e kinde mane Solomon ogeroe udi ariyogi ma gin hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kod dala maduongʼ mar ruoth,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the LORD’s house and the king’s house

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ka jo-Samaria nobiro ir Yesu, negisaye mondo omed bet kodgi, mi nobet kodgi kuom ndalo ariyo.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

kikuyu: Tem matek mondo ichiwri ne Nyasaye kaka jatich molony ma wiye ok kuodi kendo mapuonjo Wach mar adiera e yo makare.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

kikuyu: Bed mamor kuom Jehova Nyasaye eka obiro miyi gik moko duto ma chunyi dwaro.
english: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

kikuyu: Ne giwuoyo kendgi kuom wachni kagiwacho niya, “Owuoyo kamano nikech waonge gi makati.”
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

kikuyu: Kuom joka Josef, Musa nowuoyo kama, Mad Jehova Nyasaye gwedh tich lwetgi kamiyogo koth koa e polo malo, kaachiel gi pi manie bwo lowo,
english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

kikuyu: Dwaro mare ne en ni koro onyis kit rieko mar Nyasaye ni joloch gi weg teko manie polo, kokadho kuom kanisa.
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nochiko mondo mano otimre ma chikno nogol e Susa, mine giliero ringre yawuot Haman apar-ka e yath.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

kikuyu: mi nowangʼo ubani madum mangʼwe ngʼar kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Chutho, ochunore ni ngʼato angʼata madwaro dak e ngima maler moluoro Nyasaye ka en e achiel gi Kristo Yesu, nyaka ne sand,
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

kikuyu: Rehum ma jatend lweny kod Shimshai ma jagoro, kanyakla gi jogo mamoko mane gitiyogo, ma gin jongʼad bura kod jotelo motelone joma oa Tripolis, Pasia, Erek, Babulon kod jo-Elam moa Susa,
english: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Nimar pok giwinjo wechena, ma gin weche mane aoronegi kuom jotichna ma jonabi. To kata mana un joma ne oter e twech pok uwinja,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: because they have not listened to my words,” says the LORD, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jodolo kod jo-Lawi noyudo fedha gi dhahabu kod gik mowal mane osepim pekgi mondo ter e od Nyasachwa e Jerusalem.
english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

kikuyu: Wabiro kok gimor ka ilocho kendo wabiro tingʼo bendechwa malo e nying Nyasachwa. Mad Jehova Nyasaye chiw gik moko duto mikwaye.
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

kikuyu: Jalno ma en Pok mar Jakobo ok chal kodgi, nimar en e Jachwech mar gik moko duto, kaachiel gi dhood girkeni mare, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: Kane jatend jolweny gi joma ne ni kode mane rito Yesu noneno yiengni mar piny kod gik moko duto mane oyudo osetimore, luoro nomakogi matek, kendo negiwacho ka giwuoro niya, “Adier, ngʼatni ne en Wuod Nyasaye!”
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: kendo onge gima negingʼeyo kuom gima ne biro timore nyaka pi nobiro moywerogi duto. Kamano e kaka nobedi e biro Wuod Dhano.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Gin gi dhogi, to kata kamano ok ginyal wuoyo, gin gi wenge to ok ginyal neno gimoro.
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

kikuyu: Ka fuon achiel mar ringruok winjo lit, to fuonde ringruok mamoko duto winjo kode; ka fuon moro yudo pak, to mamoko duto bende bedo mamor kaachiel kode.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

kikuyu: ma en puodho ma Ibrahim nongʼiewo kuom jo-Hiti. Kanyo ema Ibrahim gi Sara chiege noyikie.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

kikuyu: nimar anywola mag dhood Reuben, dhood Gad, kod nus mar dhood Manase oseyudo pok margi.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

kikuyu: In ema imiyo ochikore ka bonyo, kobwogo ji gi giro mar sunga?
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato owinjo wach mar pinyruoth to ok owinjo tiende, ngʼat marach biro kendo yudho gima okom e chunye mi dhigo. Mano e kodhi mane ochwoyo e dir yo.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

kikuyu: Solomon nobedo ruodh jo-Israel duto ka en Jerusalem kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

kikuyu: Joka Jakobo modongʼ nobed e dier ogendini, ginibed e dier ji mayoreyore, mana ka sibuor e dier le mag bungu, kata ka sibuor matin e dier rombe, makidho kendo nyulo kokadho, maonge ngʼama nyalo resogi.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Ne amiyo Israel maonge gi yie baruwa mar weruok kendo mi ariembe nikech timbene duto mag chode. Kata kamano ne aneno ka nyamin-gi ma Juda maonge ratiro ne ok oluor; en bende nodhi kendo ochodo.
english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

kikuyu: Ne amanyo to ok aneno ngʼato, onge ngʼato kuomgi manyalo puonjo, bende onge ngʼato e diergi manyalo dwoko penjona.
english: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro chwako buchgi, kendo tieko ngima joma tieko ngimagi.
english: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

kikuyu: Ka obiro, nopuonj piny mondo ongʼe tiend richo, tim makare kod kum mabiro.
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

kikuyu: To kodhi moko to nolwar e lowo maber, mine gitwi kendo gichiego cham. Neginyago cham, moko nyadi piero adek, moko nyadi piero auchiel, kendo moko nyadi mia achiel.”
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma aorano molie to kit gik mangima duto biro dakie. Rech biro bedo mangʼeny nikech pigni mol kanyo kendo miyo pi motimo chumbi bedo maliw, omiyo kamoro amora ma aorano okale, gimoro amora biro dakie.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

kikuyu: “Asehulo nyingi ni joma ne imiya e piny. Ne gin jogi, to ne imiyagi, kendo koro girito wachni.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Ji duto moluoro Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ngimagi oriere gie chunygi.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

kikuyu: Pok mar ariyo nobiro ne dhood Simeon, kaluwore gi anywola margi. Girkeni margi ne nitiere e piny jo-Juda.
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Joab nokelo ne Daudi kar kwan jolweny kama: Kuom jo-Israel ne nitie ji tara achiel gi alufu mia achiel mane nyalo tingʼo ligangla koriwore gi jo-Juda alufu mia angʼwen gi piero abiriyo.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

kikuyu: To Efraim osemiye obedo mager mobedo gi mirima; Ruodhe nowe timbene maricho mag chwero remo e wiye, kendo nochule kuom ngʼanyone.
english: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.

kikuyu: Ka aseduogogi ka agologi e dier ogendini, kendo ka asechokogi gia e pinje mag wasikgi, to ananyisranegi kaka ngʼama ler ka ogendini mathoth neno.
english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo timuru sawo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu e kama Jehova Nyasaye owuon noyier. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro gwedhou e keyo magu duto kendo e tij lweteu duto, mi moru nobed moromo.
english: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

kikuyu: gi Baalath kod Tadmor manie thim e pinye,
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Nonyisogi gik moko duto mane osetimore, eka noorogi nyaka Jopa.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

kikuyu: eka anagur lochni mar ruoth kaka ne asingorane Daudi wuonu, kane awachone ni, ‘Ok inibed maonge ngʼato marito jo-Israel kaka ruoth.’
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

kikuyu: Inibed gima mono miyanyo kendo ijaro e kind ogendini duto kuma Jehova Nyasaye noterue.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.

kikuyu: To ji nowachone Saulo niya, “Bende Jonathan ditho to en ema osekelo konyruok maduongʼ kama e Israel? Ok nyalre! Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni kata yie wiye achiel ok nolwar piny nikech Jehova Nyasaye ema okonye timo ma.” Kamano ji noreso Jonathan kendo ne ok onege.
english: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As the LORD lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.

kikuyu: To Ruoth Daudi nodwoko Arauna niya, “Ooyo, nyaka achuli nengone duto mowinjore kode.” Ok anayie ngangʼ kawo ne Jehova Nyasaye giri nono kata timo misango miwangʼo pep ma ok achuloe gimoro.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

kikuyu: Walemo ni mondo nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo oyud duongʼ kuomu, kendo mondo un bende uyud duongʼ kuome. Mano mondo otimrenu kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasachwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kane Nyasaye oneno gik mane gitimo ka giweyo timbegi maricho, nokechogi mi koro ne ok okelonigi masiche duto mane osewacho ni obiro kelo nigi.
english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

kikuyu: Filipo nopo kochopo e dala mar Azoto, kendo nowuotho koni gi koni, koyalo Injili e mier duto nyaka nochopo Kaisaria.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

kikuyu: Donge nyiminene duto ni kodwa ka? To koro ngʼatni ogolo gigi duto kanye?”
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

kikuyu: To kuom gik moko duto mag loch Amon gi gik mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitepe mag ruodhi Juda?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Nochako wuodeno ni Josef kendo owacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye meda wuowi machielo.”
english: She named him Joseph, saying, “May the LORD add another son to me.”

kikuyu: Ka chiengʼ Pentekost nochopo, noyudo ka gichokore kanyachiel giduto.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

kikuyu: E pinyu kamoro amora mudakie, nyaka uyie mondo puodho mane oseusi mondo owar.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo unego chuny jo-Israel mondo kik dhi e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye osemiyogi?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

kikuyu: Lochne nolandre kuom pinje mangʼeny kendo kata mana Misri ok notony e lwete.
english: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.

kikuyu: Eka Johanan wuod Karea kod jotend lweny duto mane ni kode nokawo joma notony duto mane oa Mizpa, ma noreso e lwet Ishmael wuod Nethania bangʼ kane osenego Gedalia wuod Ahikam; mane gin jolweny, mon, nyithindo kod jodongo mane obirogo koa Gibeon.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.

kikuyu: Kata hikgi oniangʼ to pod gininyag mana olemo, kendo ginisik ka ginyien kendo gingʼich,
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

kikuyu: En e misango magolo richowa, to ok marwa kende, to nyaka richo mar piny ngima.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

kikuyu: Aseneno richo machielo e piny, kendo obedo sandruok ahinya ni dhano:
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

kikuyu: Ma e kaka chenro mar jo-Israel nobet kane gichako wuoth.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

kikuyu: Ka ulosona kendo mar misango mar kite, to kik ugere gi kite mopa, nimar ubiro miyo kendono bedo mogak ka utiyoe gi gige payo kite.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

kikuyu: Winjuru wachni, un mond Samaria machwe ka dwesni ma Bashan, un mon masando jochan, un muthago joma odhier, kendo uwachone chwou niya, “Kelnwa gik ma wanyalo madho!”
english: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”

kikuyu: “Okelone dhano tuo kendo opongʼo dende gi rem mondo rieyego.
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noloso lewni mag pien ne Adam kod chiege kendo noumogi.
english: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

kikuyu: Rwak puonj mowuok e dhoge kendo kan wechene e chunyi.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

kikuyu: nimar gisejwangʼa mi giseketo ka obedo mar nyiseche mamoko, gisewangʼo misengini e iye ne nyiseche ma gin kata wuonegi kata ruodhi mag Juda ne ok ongʼeyo, kendo gisepongʼo kae gi remb joma onge ketho.
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

kikuyu: Ka sa ochiko noromo Yesu noywak gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (ma tiende ni, “Nyasacha, Nyasacha, iweya nangʼo?”).
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Kane pod amedo ngʼicho to tungʼni notugo lweny gi jomaler mi oloyogi,
english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,

kikuyu: gi akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo kaka onyalo yudo. Winyo achiel nobed mar timo misango mar golo richo, to machielo nobed mar timo misango miwangʼo pep.
english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

kikuyu: gi rwedhi mabwoch ariyo, imbe abich, nywogi abich gi nyiimbe abich ma jo-higa achiel, nochiw kaka misango mar lalruok. Mago e misengini mane Pagiel wuod Okran ochiwo.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Bende inyalo miyo wend wuon kisera otwe chiemo ka pod en kodgi?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

kikuyu: Yor ngʼat moriere tir kwedore gi richo; ngʼat manono yorene orito ngimane!
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Sairas ruodh Pasia wacho: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach polo, osemiya pinjeruodhi duto manie piny kendo oseyiera mondo agerne hekalu e Jerusalem manie piny Juda.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

kikuyu: “Kaw im machielo kendo Harun gi yawuote noyie lwetgi e wiye.
english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Yaye piny, piny, piny, winj wach Jehova Nyasaye!
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear the LORD’s word!

kikuyu: Jorito ne luoro omako ahinya konene, mine gikirni, kendo negidoko machal gi joma otho.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Elam: Matania, Zekaria, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth gi Elija.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

kikuyu: Anywola mar jo-Kohath mar dhood Lawi mane odongʼ nopog mier matindo koa e dhood Efraim.
english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: To koro, kuom Kristo Yesu, un ma yande un mabor, koro osekelu machiegni kuom remb Kristo.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

kikuyu: Jonathan nowuoyo maber kuom Daudi ne Saulo, wuon mare, mowachone niya, “Ruoth kik itim marach ne jatichni Daudi; pok otimoni marach, to osemana konyi ahinya.
english: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

kikuyu: Nikech gin gik makwero, kik ucham ring-gi bende kik umul motho kendgi.
english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

kikuyu: An ema amiyo ruodhi locho kendo joloch loso chike makare.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

kikuyu: Abiro chiko ita ne ngero moro; abiro nyiso tiend midhiero mara ka agoyo nyatitina:
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

kikuyu: E kindeno jogo modak e dho namni nowach ni, ‘Neuru gima osetimore ne joma waketo genowa kuomgi, joma ne waringo kuomgi mondo okonywa kendo oreswa e lwet ruodh Asuria! To koro, ere kaka wanatony?’ ”
english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

kikuyu: “En angʼo ma dapimgo tiengʼni? Gichalo nyithindo mobet e chirni kendo maluongo jowetegi kagiwacho niya,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

kikuyu: “Dhiyo mondo inyis jatichna Daudi niya, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: In ema digerna ot mondo adagie?
english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

kikuyu: To jo-Israel nowachone Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Wasetimo richo. Timnwa gimoro amora miparo ni berni, to kiyie to reswa sani.”
english: The children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

kikuyu: Abiro miyo piny doko kama otwo nikech ok gisebedo jo-ratiro, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.”
english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, kuom ndalo abiriyogo duto mag sawo, nyaka ochiw rwedhi abiriyo gi imbe abiriyo maonge songa, kaka misango miwangʼo pep ni Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel gi nywok kaka misango mar golo richo.
english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Pok ne usomo gima Daudi notimo ka kech kaye kaachiel gi joma ne ni kode ka kech ne kayogi kendo ne gionge gi gima digicham?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

kikuyu: Mier mane giyudo e thim ne gin: Beth Araba, Midin, Sekaka,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

kikuyu: Nooro baruwa moketoe sei mare ni pinjeruodhi duto, moro ka moro nondikne gi dhogi giwegi kanyisogi malongʼo e dhok ma giwinjo ni chwo duto obed gi teko mar rito miechgi gi joma odak e miechgigo.
english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

kikuyu: kendo ka lewni mopur, kata pien, kata mochwe kata mano motwangʼ, kata gir pien moro amora, mano maratiglo kata marakwaro, en pur malandore kendo nyaka nyis jadolo.
english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo, Samuel noneno Eliab moparo niya, “Adier ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowiro eri ochungʼ ka e nyime.”
english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.”

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho: An awuon ema amon kodi, Jerusalem, kendo abiro miyi kum ka ogendini duto neno.
english: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Ka inyalo ketho singruokna modiechiengʼ kod singruokna motieno, mondo omi odiechiengʼ kod otieno kik bi e sechegi mowinjore,
english: “The LORD says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time,

kikuyu: Abisalom notimo kama ni jo-Israel duto mane biro ir ruoth mondo ongʼadnigi bura, kendo noywayogo chuny jo-Israel.
english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

kikuyu: Mad Ruoth Nyasaye okech jood Onesiforo nikech nosiko kokonyo chunya kendo wiye ne ok okuot koda kata kane an e od twech.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

kikuyu: Humta, Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), kod Zior. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo ochiko.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: ‘Abiro kumo jo-Amalek kuom gima negitimo ni jo-Israel kaka ne gigengʼonegi e kinde mane gia Misri.
english: The LORD of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nimar joma ngima ongʼeyo ni gibiro tho, to joma osetho ok ongʼeyo gimoro amora; gionge gi mich moro machielo, kendo wich wil kodgi ma ok nyal pargi.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

kikuyu: Abiro chiwo Moab kaachiel gi jo-Amon ne joma aa yo Wuok chiengʼ kaka girkeni margi, mondo omi jo-Amon ok nopar kendo e dier ogendini;
english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

kikuyu: Paruru kuome, en ma notimo kinda ka joricho kedo kode, mondo kik ujogi mi chunyu aa.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

kikuyu: Jogo ne otiyo tijno gadiera. E tijno notelnigi kod jo-Lawi mane gin Jahath kod Obadia mane gin nyikwa Merari, kendo Zekaria gi Meshulam mane nyikwa Kohath. Jo-Lawi, ma gin jogo duto mane olony kuom goyo thumbe
english: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

kikuyu: Nimar ka urito chikegi maber, eka ruodhi mabet e kom duongʼ mar Daudi nondonji gi e dhorangeye mag kar dak ruoth, ka giriembo geche kendo giidho farese, ka gin gi jotendgi kod jogegi.
english: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.

kikuyu: To ka ruoth mongʼieweno chunye ok mor kode; to ruodheno noweye mondo oware. Oonge gi thuolo mar use ne jopinje mamoko, nikech oseketho singruokne kode.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

kikuyu: Osedwokwa piny nyaka e buru, dendwa omoko piny e lowo.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

kikuyu: Kwerewa nodhi Misri, kendo negidak kuno kuom higni mathoth. Jo-Misri nosandowa kod wuonewa,
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ombongʼ tiend anguro opogore ariyo kamano, to ok onyam kambula; chik ok oyienu mondo uchamgi nikech gin gik makwero.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Malaika mokwongo nogoyo turumbetene, to pe gi mach mokikore gi remo ema ne owuok, kendo nopuk e piny. To bath piny moromo achiel kuom adek nowangʼ, kendo achiel kuom adek mar yien bende maromo kamano nowangʼ gi lum mangʼich duto nowangʼ.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

kikuyu: To donge jogopeu biro poyou? Donge gibiro chiewo ma gimi utetni? Eka unubed wasumbinigi.
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

kikuyu: Piny to nodongʼ gunda nikech joma odakie osea, kendo obiro nindo ka ok opure mondo ochulgo Sabato duto mane ok oyweyoe. Giniyud kum kuom richogi nikech ne gichayo chikena kod buchena.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

kikuyu: Kuom Misri: Ma e ote ne jolwenj Farao Neko ruodh Misri, mane oloo Karkemish e Aora mar Yufrate gi Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon e higa mar angʼwen mar Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda:
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

kikuyu: Yesu noa e hekalu, kendo kane oyudo owuotho odhi, jopuonjrene nobiro ire mondo onyise kaka gedo mag hekalu lich.
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi kendo yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Beth Hogla mi owuok koa yo nyandwat mar dho Nam Chumbi, kama aora Jordan ochakore godo mantiere yo milambo. Mano e tongʼ-gi ma yo milambo.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

kikuyu: Musa kod Harun gi yawuote nonego dagi yo wuok chiengʼ mar Hemb Romo. Tijgi ne en rito kama ler mar lemo e lo jo-Israel. Ngʼato angʼata mane osudo machiegni gi kama ler mar lemo nyaka ne negi.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwokogi niya, “Mano en wach miwuoro! Ukia kuma oaye to en ema noyawo wengena?
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

kikuyu: To kata katemo mondo abed thuolo to idwara mana ka sibuor, kendo isiko mana kiloya gi tekoni maduongʼ.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

kikuyu: Kane thoo oserumo, gik marochere mongʼinore ongʼinore momoko ewi lowo nonenore.
english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

kikuyu: Kuom wach nogo ema omiyo polo gi piny masani okan ni mach. Okan-gi nyaka chop odiechiengʼno ma joma ochayo Nyasaye nongʼadnigi bura mi notiekgi chuth.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

kikuyu: Elifaz wuod Esau bende ne nigi jatich madhako miluongo ni Timna mane onywolone Amalek. Magi ema ne nyikwa Ada chi Esau.
english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Ka en jiwo ji, to mondo ojiw ji; ka en chiwo ne joma ochando, to mondo ochiw gi ngʼwono; ka en telo, to mondo orit ji gi kinda; ka en kecho ji, to mondo otime komor.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

kikuyu: To ka onyise kit richo ma osetimo to nyaka okel diel maonge songa mondo otimnego misango kuom ketho chik.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

kikuyu: kendo nooro ngʼato otelonegi, ngʼatno ne en Josef mane oloki kaka misumba.
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼato mamoko taya to okete kama opondo, kata oume gi bakul. Kar timo kamano to okete ewi rachungi taya mondo jogo madonjo one ler.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

kikuyu: Kendo ne awachonegi niya, “Neuru ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu owito kido manono ma usechomo wengeu kuomgi kendo kik udok mogak kuom lamo nyiseche manono mag Misri. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.”
english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’

kikuyu: Mana kaka owacho e Hosea niya: “Joma ne ok joga, abiro luongo ni jaherana kendo jal mane ok oher abiro luongo ni moher,”
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

kikuyu: Noywak ne ngʼat Nyasaye mane oa Juda mowacho niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Isedagi winjo wach Jehova Nyasaye kendo ok iserito chik mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi omiyi.
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,

kikuyu: Kaka nondiki e kitabu mar weche mag Isaya janabi niya: “Ngʼat moro kok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yore moriere tir.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

kikuyu: kuom timo kinda, naketo chunya mar sando kanisa, kuom rito chik ne an ngʼama ler, maonge ketho.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma achach yorene richo, osiko ka chunye chano mana timo richo, kotieko jodhier gi miriambo kata obedo ni ywak mar joma ni e chandruok nikare.
english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

kikuyu: Uma, Afek kod Rehob. Giduto ne gin mier matindo kod gwenge piero ariyo gariyo.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Yesu noneno ka gidwaro penje tiend wachno, omiyo nowachonegi niya, “Dibed ni upenjoru e kindu tiend gima ne awachonu ni, ‘Odongʼ ndalo matin to ok ubi nena, to bangʼe matin achien ubiro nena?’
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

kikuyu: Omiyo Haman nokawo law gi faras. Norwako ne Modekai lawno mokete oidho faras ka otelo nyime owuotho kode e yore mag dala maduongʼ ka owacho gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Ma e kaka itimo ne ngʼat ma ruoth morgo mar miyo duongʼ!”
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

kikuyu: Eka noringo odhi ir Eli mowacho niya, “Era ee; nikech ne iluonga.” To Eli nowachone niya, “Ne ok aluongi dog inindi.” Omiyo nodok monindo.
english: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.

kikuyu: Pek dhahabu mane Solomon yudo higa ka higa ne nyalo romo kilo alufu piero ariyo gabich,
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye kende ema ne otelonegi; kaonge nyiseche mag pinje mamoko mane ni kodgi.
english: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

kikuyu: Koro osiepena mageno, nikech wan gi singruokgi, wapwodhreuru kuom gik moko duto machido ringruok gi chuny mondo wadok jomaler chuth nikech waluoro Nyasaye.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

kikuyu: Emomiyo wachnegi ni, ‘Ma en oganda mapok omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache luor kata ok giwinj puonj. Adiera oselalnigi; kendo osea e dhogi.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’

kikuyu: Ooyo, gima timoreni en mana gima Janabi Joel nokoro chon kowacho ni,
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

kikuyu: Ayub nochako wuoyo kendo mowacho niya,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: Kinyne kogwen ka piny pod olil, Yesu nochiewo mowuok e ot kama noninde. Nowuok modhi kar kende kama ochwalore, mi nolemo kuno.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negibedo e achiel gi chiege kendo, mine omako ich ma onywolo wuowi. Ne ochake ni Beria nikech ode noseyudo masira.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda ema ne okwongo wuok ka gin e bwo bandechgi, kotelnegi gi Nashon wuod Aminadab.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Awachoni, Petro, kapok thuon gweno okok kawuono, ibiro kweda nyadidek ni ok ingʼeya.”
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

kikuyu: E sa onogo ema ne Hezekia ruodh Juda ne ogolo oko dhahabu mane obawogo dhoudi kod sirni mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo nomiyogi ruodh Asuria.
english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the LORD’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye to ok gi chunye duto.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

kikuyu: Jatend yie nolor piny ire mowachone niya, “Mara angʼo in to inindo? Aa malo mondo iywagne nyasachi! Dipo ka oparowa, mondo kik watho.”
english: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”

kikuyu: To joma nowalogo bende ema noluongo; kendo joma noluongo noketo kare to joma noketo kare nomiyo duongʼ bende.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

kikuyu: momiyo wiwu owil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Jachwechu, Jal mane oyaro polo kendo oketo mise mar piny, momiyo udak gi kihondko pile, nikech kum muyudo kuom ngʼama sandou, kendo oikore mar tiekou. Jal masandouno, ere gima geroneno ditim?
english: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?

kikuyu: Mad joma dwaro ngimana yud wichkuot kendo pachgi lal; mad ji duto ma gombona hinyruok dog kuma giaye ka giyudo achaya.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

kikuyu: Dayud ringʼo madirom jogi kanye? Gisiko ka giywakna ni, ‘Miwa ringʼo mondo wacham!’
english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

kikuyu: Eka Gaal wuod Ebed nowacho niya, “Abimelek to en ngʼa, kendo Shekem bende en ngʼa, manyaka wabed e bwo lochne? Donge en wuod Jerub-Baal, to jalupne donge en Zebul? Tiuru ne jo-Hamor, ma wuon Shekem! Koro ere gima omiyo dwatine Abimelek?
english: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

kikuyu: Nikech loch en mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo en ema olocho ewi ogendini.
english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

kikuyu: Koro dala maduongʼ ne lach kendo iye ne nigi thuolo, to ne nitiere ji manok e iye, kendo udi bende ne pod ok pok ochak ger.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

kikuyu: “Ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye; koro mondo Jehova Nyasaye okonye ane. Koro mondo orese ane, nikech chunye mor kode.”
english: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne omiya kite ariyo ma ondiki gi lwet Nyasaye. Kuomgi ne ondiki e chike duto mane Jehova Nyasaye owachonu koa e mach mawuok e got, e odiechieng chokruok.
english: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

kikuyu: Ma e gima kwereu notimo kane aorogi kane wan Kadesh Barnea mondo gidhi ginon pinyno.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Yaye Nyasaye ma apako, kik ilingʼ,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ok jahera dwaro mana gige ok owinj puonj moro amora.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuome giteko mane oyiecho sibuor koni gi koni gi lwete nono mana kaka onyalo yiecho nyadiel. To ne ok onyiso wuon mare kata min mare gima ne osetimo.
english: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.

kikuyu: Zaburi Mar Daudi. Jehova Nyasaye, en ngʼa manyalo siko kari maler milamie? En ngʼa manyalo dak e godi maler?
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

kikuyu: Nyasaye owuon mongʼeyo chuny ji, nonyiso ni oyie kodgi, ka nomiyogi Roho Maler, mana kaka wan bende nosemiyowa.
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

kikuyu: E lweny mukedoe gi richo, pok ukedo mi rembu ochwer piny.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

kikuyu: Daudi noloyo jo-Moab bende. Noketogi ma ginindo piny eka nopimogi gi tol. Kano pimogi diriyo to mago ninego to mane opim mar adek ne iweyo kangima. Omiyo jo-Moab nobedo e bwo loch Daudi kendo negigolone osuru.
english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: An awuon ema abiro kawo chuny maloth ewi midimidi mar yadh sida mi achak apidhe. Abiro chodo chunye ma pod yom e wiye malo mogik mi apidhi ewi got moro mabor moyombo gode.
english: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ok oyienigi lielo yie wigi kata weyo yie wigi dongo maboyo, to nyaka gine ni yier wiyegi obusi maber.
english: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

kikuyu: Nyathino nodongo kendo chiengʼ moro achiel nodhi ir wuon, mane nigi jokeyo.
english: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

kikuyu: Kendo mon duto mane chunygi oyie kendo olony e twengʼo nokelo yie diek.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ne agologi e piny Misri mi akelogi e piny motimo ongoro.
english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni kuoma, nikech Jehova Nyasaye osewira, mondo aland wach maber ne joma odhier. Oseora mondo akwe chuny jok modakie lit, kendo mondo aland ne joma otwe ni gin thuolo, bende mondo ahul ne joma otwe modakie mudho ni koro osegonygi.
english: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

kikuyu: Kaka ungʼeyo, godegi ni yo podho chiengʼ mar holo mar Jordan kama jo-Kanaan odakie. Gin gode mantiere Araba but Gilgal kama yiende madongo mag More nitie.
english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

kikuyu: Negiloso pasia apar gachiel mag yie diek ne hema mondo oumgo Hemb Romo.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Tiend gima awacho chal kama: Ngʼat moro kuomu wacho niya, “An ngʼat Paulo,” to ngʼat machielo to wacho niya, “An ngʼat Apolo,” machielo bende oramo niya, “An ngʼat Kefa,” to moro wacho niya, “An ngʼat Kristo.”
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

kikuyu: Kiketho ne owadu to duoge iri tek mana kadonjo e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno; to larruok chalo gi dhorangeye mag dala modin gi lodi.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kata kamano winj singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye, yaye Zedekia ruodh Juda. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuomi: Ok enonegi gi ligangla;
english: “Yet hear the LORD’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah. The LORD says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.

kikuyu: Jodongo mag nyar Sayun, obedo piny kolingʼ thi, gisebuko wiyegi gi buru kendo girwako piende gugru. Nyi Jerusalem osekulo wiyegi piny.
english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Pok ne usomo gima Daudi notimo kaachiel gi jogo mane ni kode ka kech ne kayogi?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

kikuyu: Lit mochomo joma timbegi richo ngʼeny, to hera ma ok rum mar Jehova Nyasaye, olworo ngʼat mogeno kuome.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

kikuyu: Magi e weche Nehemia wuod Hakalia: E dwe mar Kislev e higa mar piero ariyo, kane pod antiere kama ochiel gi ohinga motegno mar Susa,
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace,

kikuyu: Kane nyako moro amora pok oyudo thuolo mar dhi ir ruoth Ahasuerus, nimiye dweche apar gariyo mane owirore gi modhi maloso del mane oket ni mon-go mondo owirrego, dweche auchiel mokwongo ne imiyogi mo molos gi mane-mane mondo giwirrego, to dweche auchiel mamoko ne giwirore gi modhi moko mangʼwe ngʼar.
english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).

kikuyu: Ber mondo kik isingri, moloyo singori, bangʼe ok ichopo singoni.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

kikuyu: Ka ok mano, to en angʼo mane udhi mondo une? Ne udhi neno ngʼat morwakore gi lewni mabeyo koso? Ooyo, jogo marwakore gi lewni ma nengogi tek kendo madhialore gi gik mabeyo ni e ute ruodhi.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

kikuyu: Nyisgi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro tieko ngeroni, kendo ji ok nochak ogoe kendo e piny Israel. Wachnegi ni, ‘Ndalo okayo machiegni ma fweny duto biro timoree.’
english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene noparo gima nondiki niya, “Hera matut ma aherogo odi tieka.”
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, ne nitie mil polo makakni, koriadore kod mor polo gi yiengni malich mar piny. Piny noyiengni matek mapok oyiengni kamano nyaka aa chwech dhano. Adiera chutho ne en yiengni mar piny, marachie moloyo.
english: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

kikuyu: Elija nodwoke niya, ka an ngʼat Nyasaye, to mach mondo oa e polo kendo otieki kaachiel gi jolweny magi piero abich! Eka mach noa e polo mowangʼo jatend jolwenyno kod joge piero abich duto.
english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

kikuyu: Abiro kawe mi achiwe ni jopinje mamoko kaka gik mope, kendo kaka gik moyaki, nachiwe ne joma timbegi mono modak e piny, kendo gini dwanye.
english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

kikuyu: Koro anachiw pinjeu ne jatichna Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon; anami kata le mag bungu winje.
english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

kikuyu: Un joma odak Shafir kadhuru ka un duge kod wichkuot. Jogo modak Zanaan ok nowuog oko. Beth Ezel ni e kuyo nikech gima orite osemaye.
english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

kikuyu: Nowuoyo, mi pumbi mag lwangʼni nosieko, kendo kikun nopongʼo pinygi.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

kikuyu: Sani to koro eri iyudo kum maromre gi joricho; nimar kum kod adiera oketi diere.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

kikuyu: “Wuog oko ei yie, in kaachiel gi chiegi, kod yawuoti kod mond yawuoti.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Daudi wuod Jesse ne ruoth mar jo-Israel duto.
english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

kikuyu: To Abisalom nohombe, omiyo noyiene mi gidhi gi Amnon to gi yawuot ruoth mamoko.
english: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

kikuyu: Yesu nosiemogi kawachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ kendo ritreuru maber kuom thowi mar jo-Farisai gi mar Herode.”
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

kikuyu: Kane richowa turowa, iweyonwa kethowa.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Norwako law ma rayier, kendo notweyo okanda mar pien e nungone.” Eka ruoth nowacho niya, “Mano ne en Elija ja-Tishbi.”
english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

kikuyu: Ne osiko kogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye mi ok noweyo luwe; kendo ne orito chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa.
english: For he joined with the LORD. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ka Nyasaye notimo singruok gi Ibrahim to nokwongʼore gi nyinge owuon, nikech ne onge ngʼat maduongʼ mohinge monyalo kwongʼore gi nyinge,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

kikuyu: To koro isedagiwa kendo isedwokowa piny; tinde ok idhi e kedo gi jolwenjwa.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

kikuyu: “ ‘To jodolo ma jo-Lawi kendo ma nyikwa Zadok mane otiyo tijegi gi adiera e kara maler mar lemo kane jo-Israel obaro oweya, oyienigi sudo buta machiegni mondo giti e nyima. Ginyalo chungʼ e nyima ka gichiwo misengini mag boche gi remo, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: to bende ok ginitho kendo ngangʼ, nimar gichalo gi malaike. Gin nyithind Nyasaye, nikech gin nyithind chierno.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

kikuyu: Kinyne gokinyi kihondko maduongʼ nomako jolweny mane oket mondo orite e od twech. Negipenjore niya, “Angʼo ma dibed nosetimore ni Petro?”
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

kikuyu: Nobed mana machal gi ngʼat mowuok e dalane odhi wuoth moro mabor, moweyo jotichne e tich mar rito gige, kosemiyo moro ka moro kuomgi gima onego otim, kendo koseketo jarito mondo orit dhoot.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

kikuyu: Josef nogore kuom wuon-gi kendo noywak kuome monyodhe.
english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

kikuyu: To malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noluonge gie polo niya, “Ibrahim! Ibrahim!” Eka nodwoke niya, “Eri an ka.”
english: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Kecha, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech an e chandruok; wengena ojony nikech ywak, kendo chunya gi ringra bende nigi lit.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

kikuyu: Omiyo negimake mi ginege eka bangʼe to gidire oko mar puoth mzabibu.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Kendeu mag misango ibiro kethi kendo kendeu miwangʼoe ubani ibiro muki, bende abiro keto ringre jo-Israel motho e nyim nyisecheu manono.
english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

kikuyu: To ewi mago nitie Sabato mag Jehova Nyasaye gi chiwo mamoko to gi gimoro amora misesingori kaachiel gi chiwo mar hera michiwo ni Jehova Nyasaye.)
english: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka ikelo chiwo mar cham motedie kendo, nyaka obed kek molosi gi mogo mayom ma ok oketie thowi modwal gi mo kata chapat mowir gi mo.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne ok gilokore giweyo richo mane ni e od Jeroboam, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo, to negidhi nyime mana gi timbegi. Kendo siro mar nyasaye madhako miluongo ni Ashera nosiko kochungʼ Samaria.
english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

kikuyu: Magi duto ne ondiki e nonro margi mar nywol e ndalo loch Jotham ruodh Juda kod Jeroboam ruodh Israel.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

kikuyu: Janjore nochwanyre kendo podhi kendo onge ngʼama nochunge malo; anamok mach e dalane manowangʼ jogo duto man machiegni kode.”
english: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”

kikuyu: Jadolo nowangʼ gigi duto ewi kendo mar misango kaka chiemo, ma en chiwo miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar. Boche duto gin mag Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho kokalo kuom jotichne ma jonabi niya,
english: The LORD spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nowuok kendo ne gibworo chakre dala mar Juda nyaka Lehi.
english: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

kikuyu: E higa mar adek mar loch Sairas ruodh Pasia, nonyis Daniel (ma bende iluongo ni Belteshazar) tiend fwenyno mane oseneno. Wachno ne en adier, kendo ne en kuom lweny moro maduongʼ! Tiend wachno nobirone e fweny.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the message was true, even a great warfare. He understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.

kikuyu: Ngʼat machal kamano bende inyalo dewo? Bende dikele e nyimi adier mondo iyale?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

kikuyu: Enokaw achiel kuom apar mag chambu gi olembeu mi nomigi jotende gi jotije.
english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

kikuyu: Bed motangʼ mondo kik ijwangʼ wachni. Angʼo momiyo wach manyalo kelo hinyruok nyaa, mi lochwa kethre?
english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai to nowacho niya, “Ogolo jochiende gi teko mar ruodh jochiende.”
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ne utimo maber kuom konya e chandruokna.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

kikuyu: Kuom mano kaka koro wan gi Jadolo Maduongʼ mosedhi nyaka e polo, ma en Yesu Wuod Nyasaye, wamakuru yie mwahulo matek.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

kikuyu: Nikech ka ngʼato orito chik duto to opodho e Chik moro achiel kende to odoko jaketho mana ka gima oketho chik duto.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

kikuyu: Eka Jehu nochoko ji duto kanyakla mowachonegi niya, “Ahab ne otiyone Baal mana matin, to Jehu biro tiyone mangʼeny.
english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

kikuyu: Ne alamo kakwayo nyathini kendo Jehova Nyasaye osedwoka kendo omiya gima ne akwaye.
english: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him.

kikuyu: Ok anaher nyithinde, nikech gin nyithindo mane oyud e yor chode.
english: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.

kikuyu: Kuome bende ema noyierowae mondo wabed jocham girkeni; kaluwore gi chenrone motimogo gik moko duto moluwore gi dwarone,
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

kikuyu: Angʼeyo kama idakie. En kama kom duongʼ mar Satan nitie to kata kamano isebedo kirito nyinga ahinya. Bende ne ok ikwedo yie miyiego kuoma, kata mana e kinde mane Antipa janeno mara mar adier onegi e dalau kama Satan odakie.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

kikuyu: Zimri nodonjo e ot mogoye kendo onege e higa mar piero ariyo gabiriyo mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, kendo nokawo lochne kaka ruoth.
english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Asiko aparo chikeni mosebedo ka nitie nyaka nene, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ayudo hoch kuomgi.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

kikuyu: Jakobo nodhi nyime gi wuodhe, kendo malaike mag Nyasaye noromo kode.
english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

kikuyu: Joga malama kendo moke e pinje loka aore mag Kush, nobi kakelona mich.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

kikuyu: To beduru motangʼ kurito puonj kod chike mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye omiyou kama: heruru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, wuothuru e yorene duto, luoruru chikene, padreuru kuome kendo tineuru gi ngimau duto.”
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

kikuyu: Oketho telo mar joma roteke ma ok oyalogi kendo oketo joma moko e telo kargi.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

kikuyu: To Naaman nowuok odhi ka iye owangʼ kowacho niya, “Ne aparo ni dowuog obi ira mi ochungʼ kendo oluong nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache, korieyo bade kama tuo nitie mondo ochang dhohona.
english: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

kikuyu: Ka Hezekia wacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa biro resowa e lwet ruodh Asuria,’ donge uparo ni owitou mondo kech gi riyo onegu?
english: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo kod Manase gi joge to ne ok gidewe.
english: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

kikuyu: “Nyaka gipedh nanga marambulu ewi kendo mar misango mar dhahabu bangʼe giume gi piende monyongʼ mayom mag le mag nembe kendo giket sirni mitingʼego kuonde mowinjore.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: To Barnaba nokawe motere ir joote. Nonyisogi kaka Saulo noseromo gi Ruoth kane oyudo en e wuodhe, kaka Ruoth nosewuoyo kode, kendo kaka Saulo noseyalo gi chir kuom nying Yesu e Damaski.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Omiyo yembe bedo kaka jootene, kendo jotichne kaka ligek mach.
