english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

kikuyu: Dana, Kiriath Sana (tiende ni, Debir),
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

kikuyu: adiera, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Anaor ligangla, kech kod masira kuomgi kendo analokgi ka ngʼope maricho ma ok nyal cham.
english: the LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kinde matin negidwogo ir Musa mi giwachone niya, “Dwaher gero dipo ne jambwa kod mier madongo mondo mondwa kod nyithindwa odagie.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

kikuyu: Eka ji duto nowachone Samuel niya, “Lam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi ni jotichni mondo kik watho, nimar wasemedo ewi richowa mamoko tim marach mar kwayo mondo miwa ruoth.”
english: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to the LORD your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo Jehova Nyasaye nonyise yien moro. Nobole ei pi mi pi obedo mamit. Kanyo ema Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogie buche kod chike kendo notemogi.
english: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

kikuyu: Chiwuru makati moketie thowi kaka misango mar dwoko erokamano, kendo landuru wach kusungoru, un jo-Israel kuom chiwo mar hera, nimar mano ema uwinjo ka morou ka usiko kutimo,” Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Nokulore piny ka okulo wiye piny auma mochopo e lowo mine owacho, “Jatichni madhako nika, oikore mar tiyonu kendo luoko tiend jotich ruodha.”
english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

kikuyu: Joma iwuoro to gi ji ajiya notho e pinyni. Ok noikgi kendo ok noywag-gi, bende onge ngʼama nongʼad dende kata lielo wiye nikech gin.
english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.

kikuyu: Chik en mana tipo mar gik mabeyo mabiro to ok en gigo hie. Kuom mano ok nyalre mondo misengini minuoyo higa ka higa oket joma sudo ir Nyasaye kalame obed makare chuth.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

kikuyu: Kaw ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot, ka moro ka moro otelo ne jog-gi mondo okonyi kweno.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno momako ngimane matek, ngimane biro lalne; to ngʼatno mowito ngimane, nikech an, biro yude.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: Onge gima gingʼeyo, onge gima giwinjo; wengegi omuon ti ma ok ginyal neno, kendo pachgi odinore ma ok ginyal winjo.
english: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

kikuyu: Omiyo ok otenore kuom dwaro kata tich mar ngʼato, to en kuom kech mar Nyasaye.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

kikuyu: Nyinge man-gi duongʼ mondo opaki nyaka chiengʼ kendo mad piny duto pongʼ gi duongʼne.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Kuom joma noa e dhood Juda ne gin: Daniel, Hanania, Mishael gi Azaria.
english: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

kikuyu: Modekai ne nigi nyamin, ma nyar owadgi wuon-gi ma nyinge ne Hadasa, mane opidho nikech ne en kich. Nyakoni ma bende ne ongʼere gi nying machielo ni Esta ne en jachia, kendo ne osekawe mobedo ka nyare, bangʼ tho wuon gi min.
english: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi nowalo gigi duto momiyo Jehova Nyasaye, mana kaka nosetimo gi fedha gi dhahabu mane oa kuom ogendini mane oloyo kaka:
english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

kikuyu: kendo nodak e thim kuno kuom ndalo piero angʼwen, ka Satan teme. E thim kuno Yesu nodak e kind le mag thim, to malaike ne tiyone.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

kikuyu: Josef pod ne ni e ot kane Juda kod owetene odonjo, kendo negipodho auma e nyime.
english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasaye ma jangʼwono ok enojwangʼu kata tiekou kata wiye wil kod singruok mane otimo gi kwereu kokwongʼore.
english: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

kikuyu: Nimar gin jogi kendo mwanduni mane igolo e piny Misri, kigologi kama mae kakni ka kama ithedhe nyinyo.
english: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “To un to uwacho ni an ngʼa?” Petro nodwoke niya, “In Kristo ma wuod Nyasaye.”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

kikuyu: “ ‘An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kamano. Sa osechopo mondo ati tija monego atim. Ok abi kechi; ok abi ngʼwononi, bende ok abi lokora. Ibiro ngʼadni bura kaluwore gi timbeni gi yoreni, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.’ ”
english: “‘“I, the LORD, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord GOD.’”

kikuyu: Eka Abimelek nokelo rombe gi dhok kod wasumbini mamon kod machwo kendo nomiyogi Ibrahim kendo Abimelek nodwokone Ibrahim Sara chiege.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

kikuyu: Kane Hiram ruodh Turo owinjo ni Solomon osewir mondo obed ruoth kar Daudi wuon-gi, nooro joote ire nikech nosebedo ka en osiepe kod Daudi.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

kikuyu: Mo modongʼ e pat lwet jadolo nyaka ool ewi ngʼat mipwodhono mondo otimnego pwodhruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

kikuyu: to chworeno nyaka tere ir jadolo bed ni dhakono osedwanyore adier kata chwore chich mana kode kayiem. Bende nyaka oter chiwo mar achiel kuom apar mar efa mar mogo mar shairi e lo jaode. Ok onego ool mo kuome kata keto gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kuome, nikech en chiwo mar cham mar ketho chich, tiende ni en chiwo mifwenyogo adiera.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

kikuyu: Uparo ni ne abiro mondo akel kwe e piny? Ooyo, to awachonu ni ne akelo mana pogruok.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, anami iywe gi kwereni kendo noiki gi kwe. Ok inine masiche mabiro kelone pinyni.’ ” Omiyo negidwoko wach ne ruoth.
english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.

kikuyu: To gikia pach Jehova Nyasaye. Ok giwinj chenrone, En ema ochokogi ka cham midino e dier ot.
english: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

kikuyu: Eka ji nokelone Yesu nyithindo matindo, mondo oyie lwete kuomgi, kendo olemnegi. To jopuonjre nokwero joma nokelogigo.
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne wakawo mier madongo mage duto. Onge kata mana dala maduongʼ kuom mier piero auchiel madongo mag-gi mane ok wakawo, tiende ni gwenge duto man Argob, ma en pinyruodh Og man Bashan.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: Mana kaka keto kidi e orujre e kaka miyo ngʼat mofuwo luor.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni tiengʼni ok norum ngangʼ kapok gigi duto otimore.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

kikuyu: Winjauru, un joma chunygi tek kendo mabor gi adiera.
english: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, mad ayud gima akwayo, mad Nyasaye chiwna gima ageno yudo,
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

kikuyu: “Kuoma to ma chalona mana gi ndalo mag Nowa kane akwongʼora ni pi mane oimo piny ok nochak obedie kendo. Omiyo koro asekwongʼora ni mirima ok nochak omaka kodu kendo, bende ok anachak adhawnu.
english: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

kikuyu: E higa mar angʼwen mar Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda, wachni nobiro ne Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Pok mar auchiel nomi dhood Naftali, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomgi ne paro ni Aleksanda ema oluongo burani nikech negineno ka jo-Yahudi chwale nyime mondo owuo gi ji. Aleksanda notingʼo bade mondo owuo gi ji.
english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Rie badi kochomo polo mondo pe ochwe e piny Misri duto; kochwe kuom ji, le kod gimoro amora madongo e puothe mag Misri.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: to kara bada ochodi olwar piny oa e goka, kendo mad ochodi olwar piny koa kama ochomoree.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

kikuyu: Mor zeituni bende nyaka uket tenge achiel kuom mia achiel muyudo kuom olemo ma yiendu onyago. Nyaka upim morno gi rapim mar bath (bath apar romre gi homer achiel, kendo gi rapim miluongo ni kor).
english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),

kikuyu: Eka nawinjo malaika moro kapenjo malaika wadgi niya, “Biro kawo kinde marom nadi mondo fwenyni ochop kare; ma en fweny man kuom misengini mitimo pile ka pile, gi ngʼanyo makelo kethruok, gi ketho kama ler mar lemo kod nyono oganda mar Jehova Nyasaye piny?”
english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”

kikuyu: Daudi noporo wach kod jotende, jotend lweny alufe kod jotend lweny miche.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

kikuyu: “ ‘Neuru, un joma obwono ji-gi, beduru morwenyo nyaka thou, nimar abiro timo gimoro e ndalou ma ok ubi yiego, kata ka ngʼato oleronu tiende.’”
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

kikuyu: Uketo chunyu mar rito odiechienge moyiedhi, kod dweche gi ndalo kod higni!
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

kikuyu: E kindeno jo-Farisai moko nobiro ir Yesu kendo nowachone niya, “Ai ka kendo dhiyo kamachielo nikech Herode dwaro negi.”
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

kikuyu: “Ere kaka inyalo wacho ni, ‘Wan jokedo, ji mathuondi maroteke e lweny’?”
english: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?

kikuyu: “Kik umul joga ma awiro; kik uhiny jonabi maga.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Giwuotho duk e gwengʼ nikech gionge lewni; gitingʼo ne ji chiemo to gin to kech negogi.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

kikuyu: Mano eka lowo nochiegnu cham kendo nuchiem ma uyiengʼ mi unudagi gi kwe.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

kikuyu: Ruodh pinyno ok oyiene kawo girkeni moro amora mar ji, komayogi mwandugi. Ruodhno nyaka pog yawuote maa mwandune owuon kaka girkeni mondo omi kik ngʼata moro amora opogi gi mwandune.’ ”
english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

kikuyu: In e pokna, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; asesingora ni abiro rito chikeni.
english: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

kikuyu: Wachni nomiyo Paulo gi Barnaba odhawo kodgi matek ka kwerogi kuom puonjgino. Omiyo noyier Paulo gi Barnaba, kaachiel gi joma oyie mamoko, mondo gidhi nyaka Jerusalem gine joote gi jodongo kuom wachno.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

kikuyu: Joma kare chiemo moromo kaka chunygi dwaro, to ii ngʼat marach nigi kech.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Asa nokelo jo-Juda duto kendo negikawo kite duto kod yiende mane Baasha osebedo katiyogo Rama kendo notiyo kodgi kuom gero Geba kod Mizpa.
english: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.

kikuyu: To ka jopuonjre nobiro molwore kama noninde, noa malo modok ei dalano. Kinyne ne giwuok gi Barnaba mi gidhi Derbe.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

kikuyu: gi joma moko mane Ashurbanipal, ngʼatno maduongʼ kendo moluor noriembo, mi omiyogi kar dak e dala maduongʼ mar Samaria kod kamachielo machiegni gi loka Aora Yufrate.
english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro ndiko e kitabu mindikoe nying ogendini kama: “Jali nonywol ei Sayun.” Sela
english: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

kikuyu: Nangʼo? Nikech ok aherou koso? Ooyo, kata Nyasaye bende ongʼeyo ni aherou.
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

kikuyu: To ne nitie ja-Hibrania moro matin kodwa, jatich jaduongʼ askeche. Ne wanyise lekwa, kendo nolokonwa tiendgi, ka omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato tiend lekne.
english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Kane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo ruodha chik mondo opog piny ne jo-Israel kigoyo ombulu, nomiyi chik mondo pok mag owadwa Zelofehad mi nyige.
english: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

kikuyu: Ka udhi kedo gi wasiku ma thirou e pinyu owuon, to nyaka ugo turumbete. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu noparu kendo noresu e lwet wasiku.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

kikuyu: Dhok abiriyo mabeyogo gin higni abiriyo, kendo wiye cham abiriyo mochiek mabeyogo bende gin higni abiriyo; giduto gin lek achiel kendo nyiso wach achiel.
english: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

kikuyu: To achien parruok kuom ngima mar pinyni gi wuond ma mwandu kelo kaachiel gi gombo mag pinyni ma gigombogo gik mathoth, thungʼo Wach mamone nyak.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Wuoguru oko, un nyi Sayun, wuoguru uneye Ruoth Solomon korwako osimbone mar loch, osimbo mar loch mane min mare osidhone, chiengʼ mane otimo arus, chiengʼno mane chunye oil.
english: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart.

kikuyu: To jogo thum ma Heman, Asaf kod Ethan nonego go ongengʼo mar mula,
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne ok oherou mi oyierou nikech ne ungʼeny moloyo ogendini mamoko, nimar un e oganda matinie moloyo,
english: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

kikuyu: to ok kuom tim, to kuom Nyasaye mayiero joge mane onyise niya, “Wuowi maduongʼ noti ne wuowi matin.”
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

kikuyu: Omiyo nowuotho e piny Galili duto, koyalo e sinagokegi kendo koriembo jochiende kuom ji.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

kikuyu: “Eka jogo mane owe nobiro ir ruodhi; oganda Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ira gi teko duto.
english: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. The LORD came down for me against the mighty.

kikuyu: We obed kar kende owuon kolingʼ, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osetweyone jokno.
english: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

kikuyu: Petro nodwoko niya, “Kuom jomoko.” Yesu nowachone niya, “Ka kamano to kare nyithindo ni thuolo.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

kikuyu: to ni wan bende, ma Nyasaye biro ketonwa tim makare, wan mwayie kuom Jal mane ochiero Yesu Ruodhwa oa kuom joma otho.
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

kikuyu: Beth Zur, Soko, Adulam,
english: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

kikuyu: To konyalo kedo koda monega, to wabiro bedo jotiju, to ka ahinge mi anege, to ubiro bedo jotijwa ma tiyonwa.”
english: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you will be our servants and serve us.”

kikuyu: Nikech ruoth ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye; kuom hera ma ok rum mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, ok obi yiengni.
english: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Luonge ni Lo-Ami nimar ok un joga, An bende ok An Nyasachu.
english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

kikuyu: Chutho, mano e gima natimo Jerusalem, kuma nayudoe teko koa kuom jodolo madongo, mine atero jomaler mathoth e od twech; kendo kane inegogi, to nagoyo ombucha, ka ayie gi nekgi.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

kikuyu: Koro wuod Saulo ne ni kod ji ariyo mane otelo ni jolweny mane dhi peyo. Achiel kuomgi ne nyinge Baana to machielo ne iluongo ni Rekab; ne gin yawuot Rimon ja-Beeroth, moa dhood Benjamin nikech Beeroth ne ikwano kaka achiel kuom jo-Benjamin,
english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

kikuyu: To jogi mosenindo kuom Jehova Nyasaye, nobed mangima, kendo ringregi nochier. In misiko e buru, chiew kendo igo koko gi mor. Thoo ma in-go chalo thoo mar okinyi, piny biro golo joma otho oko.
english: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Joka Gad-gi ne gin jotend jolweny, ma ngʼat matin kuomgi ne ipimo gi ji mia achiel, to maduongʼ kuomgi to ne ipimo gi ji alufu achiel (1,000).
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

kikuyu: Eka Solomon nowuoyo gi jo-Israel duto, magin jotend migepe mag jolweny alufu achiel kod jotend jolweny mag mia achiel, gi jongʼad bura, to gi jotelo duto man Israel, kaka jotend dhoudi.
english: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Ka koro Yesu nobedo piny, noluongo jopuonjrene apar gariyo ire mowachonegi niya, “Ka ngʼato dwaro ni mondo otel to nyaka odwokre chien mogik, mi obed jatij ji duto.”
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

kikuyu: Jolwenj mag Daudi noloyo jo-Israel kanyo, kendo ji mane otho ne ngʼeny maloyo ji alufu piero ariyo.
english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

kikuyu: Kiepena duto ochopo kuonde mabeyo; adier, girkeni maga duto moro wangʼ adier.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom jolweny nowachone niya, “Wuoru nokwero jolweny matek gi kwongʼ kowacho ni, ‘Okwongʼ ngʼama ochamo chiemo kawuono! Mano ema omiyo ji ool.’ ”
english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

kikuyu: Notimo kamano mondo ngʼwonone man-gi duongʼ mane ochiwo nono oyud pak, ma osemiyowa nono kuom Wuode mohero.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

kikuyu: tiende ni, pinyruodh Og duto man Bashan, ma bende nosebedo gi loch e Ashtaroth gi Edrei. (To bende nobedo achiel kuom jo-Refai mogik.) Musa noloyogi mi okawo pinygi.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

kikuyu: Omiyo joma ne ni ei yie nolame, kagiwacho niya, “In Wuod Nyasaye adier.”
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Joge moko nobayo abaya e thim motwo nikech ne gionge yo mar chopo e dala mane ginyalo dakie gi kwe.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

kikuyu: Ishmael nodak kuom higni mia achiel kod piero adek gabiriyo. Eka notho kendo oluwo kwerene.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ruoth Joash noluongo Jehoyada jadolo kod jonabi mamoko, mopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo ok ulos kuonde mane okethore e hekalu? Kik uchak ukaw pesa ir jokenou, to utergi ne joma onego olos kuonde momukore e hekalu.”
english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

kikuyu: Koso geno mane ma ngʼama ok ongʼeyo Nyasaye dibedgo ka ongʼad ndalone, kendo ka Nyasaye okawo ngimane?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

kikuyu: Nimar nochika gi wach Jehova Nyasaye ni, ‘Kik ichiem kata modho pi kata dok gi yo mane ibirogo.’ ”
english: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

kikuyu: Donge Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechiko ni tije ogendini maricho biro bedo ramok mach, ogendini tiyo ma ol kayiem nono?
english: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

kikuyu: Puonj jodongo mondo obed joma obidhore, ma ok ohero oyuma, kendo moritore, bende man-gi yie mar adier gihera kod kinda.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

kikuyu: Mara angʼo ne iwuonda ni Sarai en nyameru momiyo akawe mondo obed chiega? Chiegi eri, kawe mondo udhi.”
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

kikuyu: E kinde mamoko Nahash ruodh Amon notho mi wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora e gwenge kendo e mier madongo kuonde mane barup ruoth oterie, jo-Yahudi nobedo gi mor ahinya kane giyweyo kendo gitimo nyasi. Joma ok jo-Yahudi nobedo ka jo-Yahudi nikech luoro mar jo-Yahudi nomakogi.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

kikuyu: kuom ritruok maler, kuom ngʼeyo, kuom timo kinda, kuom ngʼwono, kuom Roho Maler gihera mar adier;
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

kikuyu: E sechego Joshua nolando kwongʼ makende niya, “Kwongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed kuom ngʼat manitem gero dala maduongʼ mar Jeriko kendo kama: “Koketo mise mare, to wuode makayo notho, to kochungo dhorangeyege; to wuode mogik notho.”
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before the LORD who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Jopuonjre Johana ne thoro tweyo chiemo kendo lamo, to bende jopuonjre mag jo-Farisai timo kamano, to jopuonjreni dhiyo mana nyime gi chiemo kendo metho.”
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

kikuyu: To Asher ne nigi nyako ma nyinge Sera.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

kikuyu: Askeche nokawo Yesu motero e laru mar od ruoth (tiende ni Paratori) kama ne ji romee, mine giluongo oganda mar askeche duto irgi.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

kikuyu: Tiendene osetere ei gogo kendo koro orundore e iye.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

kikuyu: Ne ikawo lep oweteni kaka gir singo miweyogi duk; eka mondo gichuli mwandu mane gikawo kuomi.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

kikuyu: Kane Musa osetieko somo weche mag wendni ne jo-Israel,
english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni jolweny mag Aram ne nok moloyo, Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo jo-Juda e lwetgi mana ka gima ne gin jolweny mangʼeny. Nikech Juda noweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi kendo nongʼadne Joash bura.
english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

kikuyu: “Nyisuru kendo landuru e dier ogendini, tingʼuru bandera kendo landuru; kik upand gimoro, to wachni, ‘Babulon nomaki; Bel wiye nokuodi, Marduk luoro nogo ngoga. Gige mopa nokuod wigi kendo nyisechegi manono nopongʼ gi luoro.’
english: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Musa niya, “Bende nitie gima nyalo tamo Jehova Nyasaye? Kawuononi ibiro ngʼeyo ka wechena gin adier kata ok adier.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

kikuyu: Adam nonywolo Seth, Enosh.
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye mane ogolou e piny Misri mondo abed Nyasachu, kuom mano beduru maler nikech an aler.
english: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

kikuyu: Negitweyo wangʼe kendo negiwachone githuon niya, “Hul ane! En ngʼa mogoyi?”
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

kikuyu: kendo nyocha osetemo mondo odwany hekalu, omiyo nyocha wamake [mondo wangʼadne bura kaluwore gi chikwa.
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar apar gariyo mar dwe mokwongo, ji noa e aora Jordan mi ochokore Gilgal e tongʼ ma yo podho chiengʼ mar Jeriko.
english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

kikuyu: Uparo ni berna ka jaricho otho? Donge en morna ka gilokore giweyo timbegi maricho mondo gibed mangima? Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ema owacho.
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

kikuyu: kod kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono, gi karaya kod rachungi mare,
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: To ka Kristo pok ochier, to wayalo kayiem, kendo yie maru bende onge tiende.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

kikuyu: Githoro wacho weche manono ka gikwongʼore gi miriambo, kendo giloso winjruok ma ok nyal konyogi; emomiyo buche mag larruok medore mana ka buya malandore e puothe mosepur.
english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ne mor mondo chikne obed gi teko kod duongʼ, mondo adiera mare olandre.
english: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ogendini onego owach ni, “Nyasachgino to ni kanye?” Mi ogendini ongʼe, ka waneno gi wangʼwa, ni ichulo kuor nikech remb jogi mosechwer.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

kikuyu: Wuodhi koro nenore maler, yaye Nyasaye, wuodh Nyasacha ma Ruodha nenore maler kodonjo kare maler.
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Igoyo ombulu mondo ongʼe gima ditim, to kuom ngʼado weche duto Jehova Nyasaye ema tieko.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Isemaka kaka jasiki, mi adhero ma adongʼ choke lilo, kendo mano miyo ji paro ni an jasiki.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

kikuyu: kod rachungi piero angʼwen mag fedha, ka siro ka siro otingʼo rachungi ariyo ariyo.
english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Daudi noringo Saulo mi odhi ir Akish ruoth Gath.
english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeftha noringo moa ir owetene kendo nodhi odak e piny Tob, kama jodwar mangʼeny nochokore bute mi giluwe.
english: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.

kikuyu: To Jal mobet e kom loch e polo to nyierogi anyiera, Ruoth goyonegi siboi.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

kikuyu: Joma kamago otamore yie nikech nyasach pinyni osedino pachgi mondo kik gine ler mar Injili manyiso duongʼ mar Kristo, ma en e kido mar Nyasaye.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

kikuyu: Isemiyo wadoko rachwany ne jobutwa, kendo wasikwa jarowa.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

kikuyu: E ndalono ne gin gi ngʼat motwe ma achach mane iluongo ni Barabas.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

kikuyu: To ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka kel mich maromre gi kaka Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhe.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you.

kikuyu: Bende kik ubed gi rapim ariyo e uteu mag pimo, ma moro duongʼ to moro tin.
english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

kikuyu: Eka Joab nogoyo turumbete mi jolweny noweyo lawo jo-Israel nikech Joab nokwerogi.
english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

kikuyu: Kane alingʼ to chokena ne ochiyore, kane achur odiechiengʼ duto ma ok aywe.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

kikuyu: Timbe mamono mag Efraim osekan, kendo richoge osendik e kitabu.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, un ruodhi, beduru mariek; tangʼuru un joloch mag piny.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

kikuyu: To chakre kawuono kadhiyo nyime, Wuod Dhano biro bet e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye Maratego.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nogou gi tuo mar neko kendo noloku muofni kendo joma orundore.
english: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

kikuyu: Jowetewa, lemnwauru.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Kik idonj e ot mantiere chiemb liel; kik iywagi bende kik ikechgi, nikech asegolo gwethna, herana kod ngʼwonona kuom jogi.
english: For the LORD says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says the LORD, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.

kikuyu: Mogik owetena, oritiuru. Beduru joma kare, winjuru wechena, beduru gi paro achiel, kendo beduru gi kwe. Eka Nyasach hera kod kwe nobed kodu.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Kane ginene ka pod gin mabor, ne ok ginyal ngʼeye. Negichako ywak matek, kendo ne giyiecho lepgi mi gibukore gi buru.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

kikuyu: Nikech ok wan gi jadolo maduongʼ ma ok nyal kechowa e nyawowa, to wan gi mano manyalo kechowa, to nikech en bende noteme gi kit tembe duto mwayudo, makmana ni en noonge gi richo.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko Musa niya, “Ka wuon-gi ne nyalo ngʼudho olawo e wangʼe, donge dine obedo gi wichkuot kuom ndalo abiriyo? Wale obed tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo; bangʼ mano inyalo duoge e kambi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

kikuyu: Ne oriwa kodi chakre chiengʼ mane onywolae; isebedo Nyasacha aa kinde mane an ei minwa.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

kikuyu: Ritri ka idhi e od Nyasaye. Dhi machiegni mondo ichik iti moloyo chiwo misengini ma joma ofuwo chiwo, jogo ma ok ongʼeyo ni gitimo marach.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

kikuyu: Kendo los sende, bakunde kaachiel gi agulnine kod tewnine mitiyogo kitimogo misengini miolo piny, to gigo duto nyaka losi gi dhahabu maler.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

kikuyu: Kik utim gima rach ne nyakono, onge richo motimo mowinjore gi tho. Wachni chalo kod ngʼat ma omonjo wadgi monego,
english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

kikuyu: In Nyasaye ma apondo kuome. Koro to ijwangʼa nangʼo? Angʼo momiyo nyaka asik ka akuyo, ka jawasigu sanda?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

kikuyu: “Kane aseduogo Jerusalem kendo kane oyudo alemo ei hekalu, nindo notera
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

kikuyu: Koa e nyikwa Benjamin ne gin: Salu wuod Meshulam, ma wuod Joed, ma wuod Pedaya, ma wuod Kolaya, ma wuod Maseya, ma wuod Ithiel, ma wuod Jeshaya,
english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

kikuyu: Ok wan, ok wan, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, to In ema nyingi oyud duongʼ, nikech herani kod adierani.
english: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

kikuyu: Achiegni luongo ji duto mag pinje ma yo nyandwat,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho. Ruodhigi biro biro kendo giniket kom duongʼ-gi e kar donjo mar dhorangeye Jerusalem; gibiro monjo ohingini duto molwore kendo monjo mier madongo duto mag Juda.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

kikuyu: Neuru ni utimo gik moko duto machikou, kendo kik umedie gimoro kata kik ugol.
english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

kikuyu: Lweny nobedo mager kama Saulo ne nitie kendo kane jodir asere ojuke, to ne gihinye.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Kar kwan jamni duto mane ochiw kaka misango mar lalruok noromo rwedhi mabwoch piero ariyo gangʼwen, imbe piero auchiel, nywogi piero auchiel kod nyiimbe piero auchiel ma jo-higa achiel. Magi e misengini mane ochiw e kendo mar misango kane osepwodhe.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nochako obirona kendo.
english: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.

kikuyu: Ahab nosewacho ne Obadia niya, “Dhi e piny duto e sokni kod holo duto. Dipo ka wayudo lum mondo farese kod kenje obed mangima mondo kik waneg chiachwa moro amora.”
english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

kikuyu: kendo Yesu gi jopuonjrene bende noluongi e arusno.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

kikuyu: Okwongʼ-gi, nikech gisebedo mabor koda! Kethruok ne gin, nikech gisekweda! Asedwaro mondo aduog-gi ira to giriambo kuoma.
english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

kikuyu: Koa kuom kayo mag jo-Israel nochoko fedha ma pekne en shekel alufu mia achiel mia adek gi piero auchiel gabich (1,365), kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

kikuyu: To ngʼeuru gadieri ni, ka unega, to unukel ketho kuom chwero remo maonge ketho kuomu uwegi kendo kuom dala maduongʼni gi jogo modak e iye, nimar adiera Jehova Nyasaye oseora iru mondo awachnu wechegi duto ka uwinjo gi itu.”
english: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”

kikuyu: Samuel nodwokogi niya, “Kik ubed maluor. Kata obedo ni usetimo tim marachni, koro kik ulokru uwe Jehova Nyasaye, to tineuru gi chunyu duto.
english: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi Nob, e dala mar jodolo kendo kanyo nonegoe chwo, mon, nyithindo nyaka madhoth, dhok, punde kod rombe. Magi duto nonego gi ligangla.
english: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Omiyo jotend piny bedo mofuwo; bangʼe to gibayo abaya ma girweny nono.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

kikuyu: To ka nyakono ok dwar biro kodi, eka inibed thuolo kuom singruok ma atimo kodini. Ne mana ni ok idwoko wuoda kuno.”
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

kikuyu: Yo podho chiengʼ ma en kilomita ariyo, rangeye adek nobedie, ma gin: rangaj Gad, rangaj Asher, gi rangaj Naftali.
english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

kikuyu: Ndalo mag Sabato kod Dwe Mowuok Manyien, jopinyno nyaka lem e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gie dhorangach midonjogo.
english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

kikuyu: Nolemo kowacho niya, “Abba,Wuora, gik moko duto nyalore kuomi. Gol kikombeni kuoma. To ok kaka adwaro to mana kaka in ema idwaro.”
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, jogi oseketo nyisechegi ma giloso giwegi e chunjegi kendo giseketo rachwany mamiyo ji podho e nyimgi. Bende owinjore koro ayienegi mondo gipenja wach adier?
english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

kikuyu: madwaro ni ji duto oyud warruok kendo ongʼe adiera.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: In bende riwri kodwa e wachni, kendo wanapog gigo duto mwayako.”
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

kikuyu: Kane ji duto winjo, Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Eka nodhi machiegni kendo nomulo sanduku mane otingʼe wuowi manotho, to jogo mane otingʼe nochungʼ. Nowachone, “Wuowi matin, awachoni, chungi aa malo!”
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

kikuyu: Saulo nowacho ni jatingʼne gige lweny niya, “Wuodh liganglani mondo inega nono to joma ok oter nyangigi biro nega kendo yanya.” To jatingʼne gige lweny ne luoro omako kendo ne ok onyal timo kamano, omiyo Saulo nokawo liganglane owuon mochwoworego.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Kendo gibiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ni ne ok awuo awuoya ni abiro kelo nigi masirani.
english: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

kikuyu: Nikech chunya nigi ratiro chutho ni pod onego akonyu, kendo angʼeyo chutho ni pod abiro bet kodu duto mondo ami umed geroru kendo ubed mamor e yie maru,
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

kikuyu: To kaka noparo bende ni Paulo ne nyalo miye asoya, nomedo orone wach kinde ka kinde mondo owuo kode, kogeno yudo gimoro.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

kikuyu: Nikech ugoyo joweteu matuo gi mba kendo utuomogi gi wiu, mi umiyogi gipogore gia e kweth kendo gikee,
english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

kikuyu: Kane Athalia owinjo koko mane jorito kod ji goyo, nodhi ir jogo mane ni e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD’s house;

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno Nowa gi yawuote, Shem, Ham, kod Jafeth, kaachiel gi chiege kod mond yawuote adek, nodonjo e yie.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

kikuyu: Mana ka tiend ngʼat mongʼol mawengni, e kaka ngero moa e dho ngʼat mofuwo.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: mondo eka onyisgo tienge duto mabiro mwandu mar ngʼwonone mokalo apima, ma wabiro yudo kuom kech mosekechowago kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Tiuru gi ratil makare gi gorogoro makare kod debe makare.
english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Ni ogendini mantie mane odongʼ kuom ji chakre ndalono to nyalo neno ni gima kama ok nyal timorena; to an bende dobedna gima ok nyalre?” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mokawo odiechiengʼ moro ni duongʼ moloyo machielo timo kamano mondo omi Ruoth duongʼ. Ngʼat machamo ringʼo bende chiemo kamiyo Ruoth duongʼ, nikech ogoyo erokamano ne Nyasaye. Kamano bende, ngʼat ma ok chiem bende ok chiem kuom miyo Ruoth duongʼ, kendo ogoyo erokamano ne Nyasaye.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

kikuyu: Ne giywak e bunge mana kondiegi kendo ne gilak ei bunge.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

kikuyu: Yesu nodonjo Jerusalem mi odhi nyaka ei hekalu. Nowuotho e iye monono gik moko duto motimore, to nikech sa ne koro olewo, nowuok gi jopuonjrene apar gariyo mi odhi Bethania.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

kikuyu: Ruoth nogolo chik kawacho niya, “Dhiuru mondo udwar kama entie mondo adhi aor ji omake.” Wach noduogo kama: “En Dothan.”
english: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

kikuyu: Ji moko ma timbegi mono noriwore kode mi negikwedo Rehoboam wuod Solomon kane pod en rawera mayom yom kendo ne ok otek monyalo sirogi.
english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

kikuyu: Hekalu ma oko gi Kama Ler Moloyo ne nigi dhoudi mayawore ariyo moro ka moro.
english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

kikuyu: Lowo e kama chiemo wuokie, to pinyne ibaroe lwendni gi mach.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno duto Abimelek nokedo matek gi dala maduongʼ manyaka okawe kendo onego joma nodak e iye. Eka noketho dalano kendo nokworo chumbi kuome duto.
english: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

kikuyu: To ma ok wigi nowil gi gik mane osetimo kendo ne ok girite mondo ongʼadnegi rieko.
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

kikuyu: Eka iniyud ngʼwono kod nying maber e nyim Nyasaye kod dhano.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

kikuyu: Saulo nokwongʼore gi nying Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni ok nokumi kuom timo ma.”
english: Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, “As the LORD lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

kikuyu: Ji ariyo, Musa gi Elija, nofwenyore e duongʼ maler, ka giwuoyo gi Yesu.
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

kikuyu: Bende ber inyalo chul gi tim marach? To kata kamano gisekunyona bugo. Par nine achungʼ e nyimi kendo awuoyo ka akwayonegi, mondo kik iol mirimbi kuomgi.
english: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth madhako mar Sheba owinjo humb Solomon kod winjruok manie kinde gi nying Jehova Nyasaye, nobiro mondo oteme gi penjo matek.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

kikuyu: Joma yie wigi otwi lwar kod joma hikgi ngʼeny moingo kata mana wuonu gin jokorwa.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

kikuyu: Omiyo Senakerib ruodh Asuria noweyo lweny moloro kambi kendo nodok Nineve kuma nodakie.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

kikuyu: En gima kare mondo apar kamano kuomu uduto nikech agenou e chunya; kata ka an e twech kata ka asiro adiera mar Injili kendo ajiwe to un uduto usebedo koda e achiel kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

kikuyu: Jogi noor gi baruwa mondiki kama: Wan joote gi jodongo, ma wan oweteu kuom Ruoth, Ne un joma ok jo-Yahudi moyie man Antiokia gi Siria kod Kilikia: Wamosou,
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

kikuyu: Jowetena, parieuru kaka nuchal kane Nyasaye oluongou. Ji mathoth kuomu ne ok joma riek, kipimou gi rieko dhano, bende ji mathoth kuomu ne ok joma rahuma kata joma oa e koth ruodhi.
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

kikuyu: Piyo piyo nono ka mosni nochopo e ita, nyathi manie iya notugo gi mor.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

kikuyu: “An awuon ne awacho niya, “ ‘Mano kaka dabed mamor ka akawou kaka yawuota kendo amiu piny mowinjore, girkeni maber mogik mar piny moro amora.’ Ne aparo ni unyalo luonga ni ‘Wuonwa,’ kendo ni ok unuwe luwa.
english: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’

kikuyu: omiyo koro ok ubi nego ji kata miyo ogandau dongʼ migumba, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ngʼat modagi siem nwangʼo dhier kod wichkuot, to ngʼato angʼata mawinjo kikwere to yudo duongʼ.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

kikuyu: Nogolo Israel, kogangore gi fedha kod dhahabu, kendo onge ngʼama nodongʼ chien kuom dhout Israel duto.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ji duto nodhi mondo gichiem kendo gimethi, gior bath chiemo kendo gitim nyasi gi ilo maduongʼ, nikech koro ne gisengʼeyo tiend weche mane osomnegi.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

kikuyu: Ket Joshua mondo okaw kari kijiwe kendo imiye teko, nimar en ema obiro telo ne jogi koterogi loka cha mondo gikaw piny ma ibiro nenono.”
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

kikuyu: Ka aywak kendo atweyo chiemo to pod nyaka ayud ayany;
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Yesu gi jopuonjrene koro wuok Jeriko, oganda maduongʼ noluwe.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

kikuyu: Nikech ka ok en Nyasaye, to en ngʼa manyalo chiemo kendo yudo mor?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

kikuyu: Magi ema ne nying joka Gershon: Libni gi Shimei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: “Puonja, eka analingʼ, nyisa kama asedhie marach.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

kikuyu: “Biuru un duto ma riyo oloyo, biuru mondo umodh pi, adier biuru un ma uonge pesa, mondo ungʼiew kendo uchiem! Biuru ungʼiew divai gi chak nono maonge chudo.
english: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

kikuyu: Ne ok owachonegi wach moro amora ma ok okonyore gi ngero. To ka thuolo noyudore mi odongʼ gi jopuonjrene kendgi to nonyisogi tiend weche duto.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

kikuyu: “Weuru siko ka uwuoyo gi sunga ahinya, kata weyo dhogi wuoyo gi ngʼayi, nikech Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye mongʼeyo nimar en ema onono timbe.
english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.

kikuyu: Eka Jeftha nowuok mondo odhi oked gi jo-Amon, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwete.
english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.

kikuyu: E kinde ma Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo nomiyo ogendini girkeni mag-gi, kendo kane opogo ogendinigo duto kuondegi mag dak, noketonegi tongʼ pinygi kaluwore gi kar romb kwan nyithind Israel.
english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: To kane gin e thagruok ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel ka gimanye mine giyude.
english: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

kikuyu: to ne giriwore kodgi kendo negiluwo timbegi.
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

kikuyu: to Israel mane otemo matek mondo oyud ngima makare motenore kuom Chik to pok oyude.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

kikuyu: Magi e yawuot Ham kuom dhoutgi, kod dhogi e pinjegi kod ogandagi.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

kikuyu: To kata obedo ni dala maduongʼ enochiw ne jo-Babulon, in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, wachona ni, ‘Ngʼiew puodhoni gi fedha kendo ngʼiepone mondo obed gi joneno.’ ”
english: You have said to me, Lord GOD, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

kikuyu: Konyri gi pesano ka ingʼiewogo gimoro ma ihero; obed ring dhiangʼ kata ring rombo, divai kata math moketo thowi kata gimoro amora ma chunyi digombi. Eka in kod joodi duto nuchiem kanyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu gi mor.
english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ham ne gin: Kush, Mizraim, Put kod Kanaan.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Magi e gik mamiyo ngʼato bedo ‘mogak.’ To chiemo gi lwedo ma ok olwoki ok mi odok ‘mogak.’ ”
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

kikuyu: Chutho, kane wan kodu to ne wasiko ka wanyisou ni nyaka sandwa, kendo e gima osetimorenwa, mana kaka ungʼeyo.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

kikuyu: E sa asaya mane jochiende oneno Yesu, negipodho piny e nyime ka giywagore niya, “In e Wuod Nyasaye.”
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Rebeka nowacho ne Jakobo wuode niya, “Nawinjo ka wuonu wacho ni owadu Esau niya,
english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Jehoyakin wuod Jehoyakim ruodh Juda kod jotelo, jopecho kod jogoro mag Juda ne oseter e twech koa Jerusalem nyaka Babulon gi Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, Jehova Nyasaye nonyisa kikepni ariyo mag ngʼope koketi e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before the LORD’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nochungʼ mokulore e nyim jo-Hiti.
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

kikuyu: in mane iloso gode gi tekoni iwuon kane imanori gi teko,
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

kikuyu: Jogi ne gin: Ahiezer ma jatendgi gi Joash owadgi ma yawuot Shema ja-Gibea, kod Jeziel gi Pelet yawuot Azmaveth; Beraka gi Jehu jo-Anathoth,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: “Kata kamano bangʼe, anaduog mwandu jo-Amon,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Hera margi, achaya margi kod nyiego margi noselal chon; ok ginichak gibed gi thuolo e gimoro amora matimore e piny.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

kikuyu: Ok wawach kamano nikech watemo bedo gi teko kuom yie maru, to watiyo kodu kaachiel mondo uchungʼ motegno e yie maru ka umor.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

kikuyu: Koro Ahimaz wuod Zadok nowacho niya, “We aring ater wachni ne ruoth ni Jehova Nyasaye oserese e lwet jowasike.”
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how the LORD has avenged him of his enemies.”

kikuyu: Bende od ruoth mane obiro dakie nogero e laru machielo e tok od bura to nogere mana machal gi od bura, Solomon bende noloso od dak machal kamano ni nyar Farao mane okendo.
english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

kikuyu: Chunguru bandera ewi got motwo kendo gouru koko, gwelgiuru mondo gidonj e dhorangeye joma ogen.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

kikuyu: Nikech Daudi notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne ok oweyo ma ok omako chik Jehova Nyasaye moro amora e ndalo ngimane duto makmana e wach Uria ja-Hiti.
english: because David did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

kikuyu: Ka Roho mar Jal mane ochiero Yesu oa kuom joma otho odak eiu, to En owuon mane ochiero Kristo oa kuom joma otho obiro chiwo ngima ni ringreu matho, nikech Roho modak eiu.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

kikuyu: “Joma odhier gie chunygi gin joma ogwedhi, nimar pinyruodh polo en margi.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Noumo wiye gi bap sida mokadho e sirni piero angʼwen gabich, e laini ka laini apar gabich.
english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

kikuyu: Nodwoko niya, “Ka udonjo e dala maduongʼ, ngʼato moro motingʼo dapi norom kodu. Luweuru nyaka ot modhiye,
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

kikuyu: Pinyno nobed gi chiemo mangʼeny, bende ok unuchand gimoro; en piny ma kite mayudore gin nyinyo kendo en piny ma mula unyalo kunyo e godene.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

kikuyu: Ne oketh winjruokno chiengʼno, kendo mano nomiyo joma ne isando mane ranga nongʼeyo ni ne en wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Kagiwuok oko mondo gidonji e laru ma oko kama ji nitie to nyaka gigol oko lewni mane girwako ka gitiyo, kendo nyaka giwegi e udi maler mowal, ka girwako lepgi mamoko, mondo kik gikel chandruok ni joma orere e lewnigo.
english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye wachona niya, “Dhiyo mondo iket jangʼicho mondo odwok wach kuom gik moneno.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

kikuyu: Eka jolweny mangʼeny mapiem kode notiek duto koneno gi wangʼe, kendo en kaachiel gi ruoth moro mar singruok notiekgi.
english: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi oseringo motony, ne odhi Rama ir Samuel mi onyise timbe duto ma Saulo osetimone. Eka en gi Samuel negidhi Nayoth ma gibet kuno.
english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

kikuyu: Joyada wuod Pasea kod Meshulam wuod Besodeya ne jogero Dhoranga Dala Machon. Negichungo sirni mage, mi girwako dhoute gi radedi kod lodi mage.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Onge ngʼato moro kuom wedeni man-gi nyingni.”
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

kikuyu: Ka gik moko dhini maber, to bed mamor, to ka chandruok omaki; to ngʼe ni Nyasaye ema oyie mondo gik moko ariyogo otimre. Emomiyo, dhano ok nyal fwenyo gimoro amora mabiro timorene e ndalo mabiro.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Israel alufu apar man-gi lony kuom lweny nomonjo Gibea gi e yo ka nyimgi. Lwenygi ne tek ma jo-Benjamin ne ok ofwenyo ni masira biro tiekogi.
english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

kikuyu: Emomiyo beduru motangʼ! Paruru kaka kuom higni adek ne ok aweyo mak asiemo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu odiechiengʼ gotieno, ka pi wangʼa chwer.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

kikuyu: Kata ka imiyo ngʼat makia somo miwachone niya, “Yie isomna kitabuni,” to obiro dwoko niya, “Ok angʼeyo somo.”
english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”

kikuyu: Magi duto ne gin yawuot Daudi, ka waweyo yawuote mane onywolo gi mondene mamoko. To Tamar ne nyamin-gi.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

kikuyu: Genowano osiro chunywa ka loch mogur motegno ma ok yiengni kendo ma gimoro ok nyal donje mi kethi. Odonjo nyaka ei kama ler mar lemo manie tok pasia,
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

kikuyu: kendo kokalo e loch Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda, kodhi nyaka e dwe mar abich mar higa mar apar gachiel mar Zedekia wuod Josia ruodh Juda, sa mane joma odak Jerusalem dhi e twech.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wuoguru gokinyi dhoot ka dhoot. Dhoot ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime anywola ka anywola, to anywola ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime dala ka dala, kendo dala ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime ngʼato ka ngʼato.
english: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which the LORD selects shall come near by families. The family which the LORD selects shall come near by households. The household which the LORD selects shall come near man by man.

kikuyu: Kendo koro osekan-na osimbo mar ngima makare, ma Ruoth, ma en jangʼad bura makare, biro sidhona e odiechiengʼno. Ok an kenda ema nomiyago, to nomi ji duto mosebedo ka geno dwoke.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, kaka wechegi gin adier chuth ma ngʼato ok nyal dagi, weuru goyo koko kendo kik utim tim moro ka ok uparo.
english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

kikuyu: Gimanore gi atungʼ kod tongʼ; giger kendo gionge ngʼwono. Gimor ka nam mogingore ka giriembo faresegi; gibiro ka ji mochanore komanore gi gige lweny mondo gimonju, yaye Nyar Babulon.
english: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

kikuyu: Gipodho piny giduto; ma ok ginyal kelo resruok ne joma lamogi, ka gin giwegi otergi e twech.
english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

kikuyu: Idonjona gi weche malit, moriw koda ka richo mane atimo kapod an rawera.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

kikuyu: Kaponi ochiwo lopeno e Higa mar Piero Abich, to nengone osiki mana kamano.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

kikuyu: E kindeno Israel nobed piny mar adek ka giriwore gi Misri kod Asuria mondo gibed gweth ne piny.
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

kikuyu: Ginichungʼ mabor ka giluoro sandne kendo ka giywak niya, “ ‘To mano kaka lit! To mano kaka lit! Yaye dala maduongʼ. Yaye Babulon, dala maduongʼ man-gi teko! Kethruokni osechoponi kuom sa achiel kende!’ ”
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

kikuyu: An awuon ne ok angʼeye, to gimomiyo ne abiro ka abatiso ji gi pi ne en mondo ofwenyre ni Israel.”
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

kikuyu: Rituru chunyu maler maonge bura, mondo timbeu mabeyo kuom Kristo okuod wi joma wuoyo kuomu marach.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

kikuyu: Kane an nyathi, ne awuoyo ka nyathi, ne aparo ka nyathi, kendo naneno ka nyathi, to koro kaka an ngʼama osebedo maduongʼ, yore mag nyithindo aseweyo chien.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

kikuyu: Misango mane okelo ne en san achiel mar fedha ma pekne ne en shekel mia achiel gi piero adek, kod bakul achiel mar kwoyo pi mar fedha ma pekne en shekel piero abiriyo. Magi nokel kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ka moro ka moro opongʼ gi mogo mayom moru gi mo kaka chiwo mar cham;
english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: To owacho nangʼo? “Wach ni machiegni kodu, en mana e dhou kendo e chunyu,” mano e wach yie mwalando.
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

kikuyu: Yal Wach kendo ikri mar timo mano kinde duto, kata ka piny rach kata ka piny ber, kirieyo ji, kikwero ji, kendo kijiwo ji gi kinda duto, kendo kipuonjo ji tiend wechegi adimba.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata ma onego ngʼato nyaka negi kaka janek mana ka nitie joneno manyalo wacho ni notimore kamano. To onge ngʼama inyalo negi kuom wach janeno achiel kende.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye owacho: Kik udhi utug lweny gi oweteu ma jo-Israel. Doguru e miechu, ngʼato ka ngʼato, nimar ma osetimore nikech an.’ ” Omiyo negiwinjo wach Jehova Nyasaye mi gidok e miechgi kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko.
english: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Yieruru kamoro ma udhi negoe yawuote nikech richo mag kweregi; ok onego giyud thuolo mar bedo gi loch e piny kendo gipongʼe gi miechgi madongo.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

kikuyu: Kinyne negitimone Jehova Nyasaye misango kendo negichiwone misengini miwangʼo pep mag rwedhi alufu achiel gi imbe alufu achiel to gi nyiimbe alufu achiel kaachiel gi misango miolo piny to gi misengini mamoko mangʼeny ne jo-Israel duto.
english: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

kikuyu: Atungʼ mara ok ageno kuome, liganglana bende ok mi alochi;
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato opuonjo gima opogore ma ok owinjore gi puonj ma adier mag Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo kendo mamiyo ji luoro Nyasaye,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi noliero Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye e gokgi gi ludhe, mana kaka Musa nochiko kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: E sechego neginego jo-Moab madirom alufu apar, jogo mongirore kendo maroteke; maonge ngʼama nopondo kata achiel.
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

kikuyu: Sani achiegni gero hekalu ni Nying Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha mondo achiwne kaka kar wangʼo ubani mangʼwe ngʼar e nyime. Hekaluni nobed kama iketoe makati mowal e nyime pile, kendo kama ichiwoe misengini miwangʼo pep mapile pile okinyi godhiambo. Misenginigi bende notim kinde Sabato kod ndalo ma dwe opor, kaachiel gi sewni moyier mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa. Ma en chik mochwere ni jo-Israel.
english: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

kikuyu: To kapok nyathino ongʼeyo pogo rach gi ber, to pinjeruodhi ariyo miluorogo notieki.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

kikuyu: To kane Filipo oyalo ne jogo Injili mar pinyruoth Nyasaye, kod nying Yesu Kristo, ne giyie, mi giyudo batiso giduto, chwo gi mon.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

kikuyu: Ne awachonu niya, ‘An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu; kik ulam nyiseche jo-Amor, makoro udak e pinygi.’ To pod ok udewo winja.”
english: I said to you, “I am the LORD your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi nochungʼ kolworo ruoth ka moro ka moro otingʼo gige lweny mage e lwete kendo ngʼato angʼata modonjo e hekalu nyaka negi, bende beduru machiegni gi ruoth kamoro amora modhiye.”
english: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”
