kikuyu: Bangʼe tongʼno nogomo kochiko yo podho chiengʼ chakre Baala nyaka Got Seir, koluwo yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Got Jearim (tiende ni, Kesalon), modhi nyime nyaka Beth Shemesh kendo ongʼado nyaka Timna.
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechano tieko sunga duto mar joma nigi duongʼ kendo obiro kuodo wi ji duto moluor ahinya e piny.
english: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

kikuyu: Kane gisetimo neno kendo yalo wach Ruoth, Petro gi Johana nodok Jerusalem, ka giyalo Injili e miech Samaria mangʼeny.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Bed gi ilo maduongʼ, yaye nyar Sayun! Kog matek, yaye Nyar Jerusalem! Ne, Ruodhi biro iri gi tim makare, kolocho, kobolore, kendo koidho kanyna, kanyna matin, adier en mana nyathi punda.
english: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Kehelatha mi gibworo e Got Shefa.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

kikuyu: “Kik utamru golo chiwo mowuok e decheu kata kuonde kenou. “Nyaka umiya yawuotu makayo.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

kikuyu: Kendo jangʼicho nokok niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasacha pile ka pile asebedo kar ngʼicho, kendo otieno asiko e kara mar tich.
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano iwinjo dwonde ka mor matek kendo omor gi dwol mar duongʼne. Ka dwonde ochako mor, to onge gima nyalo gengʼe.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

kikuyu: richoni nobini kaka ohinga mabor mobarore, matetni kendo ruombore piny matek dichiel.
english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

kikuyu: Ne otiyo gi rieko kuom keyo yawuote moko e piny jo-Juda kod Benjamin kendo e mier madongo mochiel. Nopogogi mwandu mangʼeny kendo nokendonigi mon mangʼeny.
english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.

kikuyu: Wengeni ler ma ok nyal ngʼiyo richo, ok inyal bedo mamor gi gima rach. To en angʼo momiyo koro ibedo mamor gi jo-andhoga? Angʼo momiyo ilingʼ alingʼa ka jomaricho, tieko joma kare moloyogi?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

kikuyu: Enotingʼe kitere Asuria kaka mich ne ruoth maduongʼ. Efraim noma duongʼne to Israel nokuod wiye nikech nyisechene molos gi bao.
english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.

kikuyu: Nowangʼo choke jodolo e kendegi mag misango omiyo nopwodho Juda kod Jerusalem.
english: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kik utwe dho dhiangʼ kaywayo lodi ma idinogo cham.
english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

kikuyu: wuod Zuf, wuod Elkana, wuod Mahath, wuod Amasai,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

kikuyu: Negigolo chik mondo okel Petro gi Johana e nyimgi, eka negichako penjogi niya, “En teko mane, kata nying ngʼa mane mutimogo gima utimoni?”
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

kikuyu: To koro nachiw kum malit machalo nadi ka joricho osenego ngʼat maonge ketho e ode owuon kendo e kitandane owuon? Donge owinjore mondo achulni kuor kuom remo ma usechwero, mondo ua e piny!”
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

kikuyu: Ka aparo kuom kaka achal, to angʼengʼ angʼengʼa; kendo denda duto tetni.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi dichwo wadu nikech mano en tim makwero.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

kikuyu: To neuru pok uchulo misach jotich mane otiyonu e puotheu kendo ywak mag jokeyogo osechopo e it Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

kikuyu: kendo oganda maduongʼ noluwe nikech ne giseneno honni mane osetimo kochango joma tuo.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

kikuyu: Moko kuomgi ne wacho niya, “Wan kod yawuotwa gi nyiwa wathoth mokalo; to mondo wachiem kendo wabed mangima, nyaka wabed kod cham.”
english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

kikuyu: Winj dwonda ka aluongo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; kecha kendo idwoka.
english: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Ka jogo ma ok owinjore omadh kikombe nyaka madhe, to angʼo momiyo ok anyal kumi? Ok initony ma ok okumi, to nyaka imadhe.”
english: For the LORD says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.

kikuyu: Amos wacho niya, “ ‘Jeroboam ibiro nego gi ligangla kendo nyithind Israel ibiro dar e pinygi, mi tergi e twech e piny mabor.’ ”
english: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

kikuyu: Nimar wach Nyasaye ngima kendo tiyo. Obith moloyo ligangla ma dhoge ariyo, kendo opowo chuny dhano nyaka iye mogik, nyaka kuma pach dhano gi chunye jorome, kaachiel gi fuoni gi ondhudho. Kuno ema oketoe bura ne paro kod dwaro malingʼ-lingʼ manie chuny dhano.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

kikuyu: kapok ne ochweyo piny kaachiel gi pewene kata mana lowo mar piny.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

kikuyu: Timotheo, mwatiyogo kaachiel okowonu mos; Lukio gi Jason kod Sosipatro ma wedena bende jomosou.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

kikuyu: Akish nodwoke niya, “Angʼeyo ni isebet ka iber e wangʼa mana ka malaika mar Nyasaye; to kata kamano jotend jolweny mag jo-Filistia osewacho ni, ‘Kik odhi kodwa e lweny.’
english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny wuoyo kuoma, kagiwacho ni, “Nyasaye ok bi rese.” Sela
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

kikuyu: nimar ji ariyogo biro kelonegi chandruok apoya nono, to en ngʼa ma dingʼe ni en chandruok manade ma ginyalo kelo?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

kikuyu: Los tonde piero abich e riak pasia achiel kendo tonde piero abich mamoko e riak pasia komachielo ka tonde moliergo pasiago omanyore.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata mokweda e nyim ji an bende nakwede e nyim Wuora manie polo.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higni apar gauchiel kodak Jerusalem.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nopenje niya, “Kare angʼo momiyo jopuonj chik wacho ni Elija nyaka bi mokwongo?”
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: To anadwoku kama: Anaolnu gweth mogundho e higa mar auchiel, kendo puotheu nochieg cham moromou chamo nyaka bangʼ higni adek.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

kikuyu: (Mano noyudo ka Yesu owuon nosewacho ni janabi ok mi duongʼ e pinygi owuon.)
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Wan jotichni, wan gi joma roteke piero abich. Yie mondo gidhi gimany ruodhi; sa moro dipo ka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye osetere malo ewi gode kata e holo.” Elisha nokwerogi niya, “Kik uorgi.”
english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

kikuyu: Gisiko giwachone jogo ma jara ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Unubed gi kwe.’ Kendo ne jogo maluwo timbe achach mag chunjegi wacho ni, ‘Onge gima biro hinyowa.’
english: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘The LORD has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’

kikuyu: An bende parae, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parae ka itimo ngʼwono ne jogi, bi ikonya ka iresogi,
english: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

kikuyu: Jo-Sadukai moko, mawacho ni chier onge, nobiro ir Yesu kod penjo moro.
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nochiko yawuote kowachonegi niya, “An koro achiegni tho mondo adhi ariwra gi jowetena, yikauru but kwerena e rogo man e puoth Efron ja-Hiti.
english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

kikuyu: Enotho kama gisetere e twech; ok enone pinyni kendo.”
english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”

kikuyu: Omiyo negidwoke niya, “In nonywoli e chuny richo, koro ere kaka inyalo bukori ni ipuonjowa!” Bangʼ mano negiriembe oko.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

kikuyu: Waruru nyodo mokwongo mar punda gi nyarombo, to ka ok unyal ware, to tururu ngʼute. Waruru yawuotu makayo. “Onge ngʼama onego obi e nyima gi lwete nono.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nodongʼ Ai kata Bethel mane ok olawo jo-Israel. Ne giweyo dala maduongʼ nono ka gilawo jo-Israel.
english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

kikuyu: Kaw Harun kod wuode Eliazar mondo itergi e Got Hor.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia janabi nonyiso Zedekia ruodh Juda gigo duto e Jerusalem,
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Pekahia notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ne ok olokore moweyo richo mag Jeroboam wuod Nebat, mane omiyo jo-Israel otimo.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: Nikech Edom notamore ni ok gikal e pinye, Israel nowere kodgi.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone Ruoth Zedekia niya, “En ketho mane ma asetimoni kata ne jotendi kata ne jogi, momiyo iketa e od twech?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

kikuyu: E seche mane dwondgi kok kamano, mise mag dhoudi ne yiengni kendo hekalu ne opongʼ kod iro.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

kikuyu: To kuom wach mar chamo chiemo motimgo misango ni nyiseche manono, to awachoe kama: Wangʼeyo ni “Nyasaye manono en gima nono e piny-ka,” kendo wangʼeyo ni “Onge Nyasaye moro makmana achiel.”
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

kikuyu: Eka yawuotwa biro chalo gi yiende mayudo pi maber, kendo nyiwa biro chalo gi sirni modol maber mondo olich dala ruoth.
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

kikuyu: Rit ngimana kendo iresa; kik iwe ane wichkuot, nikech in ema apondo kuomi.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo kowuoyonegi gi dho jo-Hibrania kamano, negilingʼ thi. Eka Paulo nowacho niya,
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

kikuyu: An ne achwoyo, to Apolo noolo pi, to Nyasaye ema nomiyo gidongo.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

kikuyu: “Los yien obed maber eka olembe biro bedo maber, kata ket yath obed marach kendo olembene biro bedo marach, nimar yath ingʼeyo gi kit olemo monyago.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

kikuyu: Ok abi yie neno gimoro amora mochido gi wengena. Achayo timbe joma chunygi richo; gik maricho ok adwar winjo kata gi ita.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

kikuyu: Ne wakawo dalane duto manie got mesa Gilead duto, kod Bashan duto chakre Saleka, Edrei, dalane mag pinyruodh Og man Bashan.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: Abishua nonywolo Buki, Buki nonywolo Uzi, Uzi nonywolo Zerahia,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

kikuyu: Winy ma ok onego ucham e magi: ongo, achuth, gi olit,
english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiu yweyo kuom chandruok gi masira kod twech malit,
english: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

kikuyu: to an bende nasik kodu gi wich teko gi mirimba mager, kendo anakumu moloyo nyadibiriyo gi mirimba mager nikech richou.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Negidwoko Joshua niya, “Jotichni notimo kamano nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi nochiko Musa jatichne mondo omiu pinyni duto kendo uneg ji duto modakie. Omiyo ne waluor nikech un, kendo mano ema nomiyo watimo kamano.
english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how the LORD your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro nyithinda mageno, sikuru kuome mondo ka ofwenyore to wabed gi chir kendo maonge wichkuot e nyime ka obiro.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

kikuyu: “Weche miwacho mathothgi bende nyalo kadho nono mak odwoki adier? Bende inyalo kwani kaka ngʼama kare adier, ngʼat ma wuoyo mangʼenyni?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

kikuyu: to asin gi Esau kendo aseketho godege, malokogi thim ma ondiegi odakie.”
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

kikuyu: eka abiro paro singruok mane atimo gi Jakobo kendo gi Isaka kendo gi Ibrahim, kendo anapar pinyu.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

kikuyu: Ne an ja-higni piero angʼwen kinde mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye noora ka aa Kadesh Barnea mondo anon pinyni, kendo naduogone wach kaka chunya noneno,
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

kikuyu: Asekwongʼora mi aketo sei ni abiro siko kaluwo chikeni makare.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo ok pur puothe e kinde mowinjore; omiyo e kinde mar keyo omanyo, to ok oyud gimoro.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

kikuyu: Biuru wakulrene ka walame, biuru wago chongwa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Jachwechwa;
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

kikuyu: Anyalo timo nende kaka otiyonu matek, un kaachiel gi jo-Laodikia kod jo-Hieropoli.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

kikuyu: To jodolo madongo mag jo-Yahudi nokwedo gima ne Pilato ondikono kagiwacho niya, “We ndiko ni ‘Ruodh jo-Yahudi,’ ndik ni, ngʼatni noketore ni en ruodh jo-Yahudi.”
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

kikuyu: To ngʼat moro modak e gwengʼno nomedo dwoko kopenjo niya, “Wuon-gi to en ngʼa?” Omiyo wachni nolokore ngero niya, “Saulo-ni bende en achiel kuom jonabi?”
english: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

kikuyu: Beduru motangʼ kendo neuru ni wiu ok owil gi gik museneno gi wangʼu kendo kik uwegi gia e chunyu ka pod ungima. Puonjuru nyithindu kod nyikwau wechegi.
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

kikuyu: Kawuru ogudu motegno mar warruok kod ligangla mar Roho ma en wach Nyasaye.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

kikuyu: Roho gi pi kod remo, kendo jonenogi winjore kuom wachni.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

kikuyu: To e kindeno ngʼatno nodwoki niya, “Ooyo ok dabed ruodhu, nimar aonge gi chiemo kata lewni e oda madimi uketa abed jatend ogandani.”
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

kikuyu: Ka gidagi loso kwe mi gichako kedo kodu, to tiekuru dala maduongʼno.
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

kikuyu: Ginineg-gi Babulon, kendo hinye ahinya e yorene.
english: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kane oneno ka genone ok ochopo, ka gik mane ogeno yudo oyombe, nokawo nyathine machielo, kendo nolose obedo sibuor maratego.
english: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Efraim kaluwore gi anywola margi e magi: koa kuom Shuthela, joka Shuthela; koa kuom Beker, joka Beker; koa kuom Tahan, joka Tahan.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

kikuyu: Ka aketho piny Misri mi olokore thim, kendo anego gik moko duto modak kuno, bende anego ji duto modak kuno, eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Abiro bedo gi mor gi Jerusalem kendo bedo gi ilo nikech joga; ywak kod koko mar nduru ok nochak owinji kuome kendo.
english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

kikuyu: Ruoth man-gi duongʼni to en ngʼa? En Jehova Nyasaye Maratego kendo manyalo duto, En Jehova Nyasaye maloyo lweny.
english: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

kikuyu: Negipenjo ka Simon miluongo ni Petro nodak kanyo.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye e tekona kendo okumbana; chunya ogeno kuome kendo en e konyruokna. Chunya nigi mor kendo abiro goyone erokamano gi wer.
english: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

kikuyu: Kane Josef ochiewo gokinyi, notimo gima malaika mar Ruoth nochike mondo otim, kendo nokawo Maria odhigo dala mobedo chiege.
english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

kikuyu: Ahab nowacho ni Elija niya, “Kamano iseyuda in jasika!” To Elija nodwoke niya, “Ee, aseyudi nikech isechiwori mar timo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Ranyisini biro miyo ingʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye: Abiro chwado pi aora Nael gi luth mantie e lwetani kendo pigno biro lokore remo.
english: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Yesu gi jopuonjrene nochopo Kapernaum, jochok osuru mar dirachma ariyo ariyo nobiro ir Petro mopenjo niya, “Donge Japuonju chulo osuch hekalu?”
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

kikuyu: Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

kikuyu: Chuny mongʼeyo pogo tiend weche dwaro ngʼeyo, to dho ngʼat mofuwo chamo fuwo.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye koro notingʼa malo mi ogola kanyo, kendo ne adhi ka iya owangʼ kendo chunya opongʼ gi mirima, ka lwedo maratego mar Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kuoma.
english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.

kikuyu: Kendo malaika mar angʼwen nogoyo turumbetene, mi achiel kuom adek mar chiengʼ gi achiel kuom adek mar dwe, kod mar sulwe, notimo mudho, to achiel kuom adek mar odiechiengʼ gi otieno bende notimo mudho.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma wuodhe oriere oluoro Jehova Nyasaye, to ngʼat ma yorene achach ochaye.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

kikuyu: Dhood Kohath nonego dagi yo milambo mar kama ler.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jafeth ne gin: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek kod Tiras.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Abisalom oseringo modhi Geshur, nobet kuno kuom higni adek.
english: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

kikuyu: To e higa mar adek Jehoshafat ruodh Juda nodhi neno ruodh Israel.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

kikuyu: Eka Roho nolor kuom Amasai mane jatend thuondi piero adekgi kowacho niya, “Wan jogi, yaye Daudi! Wan kodi, yaye wuod Jesse! Lochi, bed jaloch kendo joma konyi bende olochi, nikech Nyasachi biro konyi.” Eka Daudi norwakogi ma oketogi jotelo mag jopecho.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kikuyu: Gol lweti oko kuoma kendo iyie igolna masichegi mabwoga.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

kikuyu: Koro useyanya nyadipar kendo uonge gi wichkuot ka umonja.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

kikuyu: E kinde duto ma masira nobi enotieku; noyweu okinyi ka okinyi kendo odiechiengʼ gotieno.” Ka wachni nodonjne ji, to ginibed gi bwok maduongʼ.
english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

kikuyu: Judas nopusore piyo piyo nyaka ir Yesu, mowachone niya, “Rabi!” bangʼe to onyodhe.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Musa noselor e got modhi ir oganda, nopwodhogi mine gilwoko lepgi.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

kikuyu: Ruoth Agripa, bende iyie kuom jonabi? Angʼeyo ni iyie kuomgi.”
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato moro Yesu noyudo kadho e kind puothe mag ngano mochiek, kendo jopuonjrene nochako jako wi ngano moko mochiek mondo gicham.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo mon-go ne ni e yo dhi, moko kuom jorito nodhi e dala monyiso jodolo madongo gik moko duto mane osetimore.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

kikuyu: Chako dhawo chalo gimuko yawo, emomiyo we wach kapok dhawo owuok.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: To jomoko kuomgi ne ok obedo e nyasi mar Pasaka e odiechiengʼno nikech negibedo mogak bangʼ mulo ringre joma otho. Omiyo negibiro ir Musa kod Harun mana godiechiengno
english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

kikuyu: Punde mag bungu chungʼ ka kuonde motwo motingʼore gi malo, kendo gigamo yweyo ka ondiegi; wengegi ok nyal neno nimar onge kar kwath.”
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.

kikuyu: Omiyo Yesu nochungʼ kendo noluongogi ire, mopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mudwaro mondo atimnu?”
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Kane apidhogi ne giyiengʼ chuth; kane giseyiengʼ to sunga nomakogi; ma wigi owil koda.
english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, Jakobo nowuondo Laban ja-Aram ka ok onyise ni odok thurgi.
english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

kikuyu: Med nyiso herani ni joma ongʼeyi, med nyiso timni makare ne joma gie chunygi ni kare.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Neuru kaka pige gingore e yo nyandwat; ginibed ataro mopongʼ. Giniyieny e piny kod gimoro amora manie iye, mier gi jok modak eigi. Ji noywagi; jogo duto modak e piny nodengi.
english: The LORD says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

kikuyu: Zaburi. Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye wer manyien, nimar osetimo gik miwuoro; lwete korachwich gi bade maler osekelone warruok.
english: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, abiro ywak kendo dengo; abiro wuotho duk kod tienda nono. Anaywag ka ondiek manie thim kendo nadengi ka tula.
english: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko niya, “Ka asewuok oko mar dala, abiro yaro bada ka akwayo Jehova Nyasaye. Polo mamor biro rumo bende pe ok nochak ochwe kendo, mondo ingʼe ni piny en mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno anaketnegi singruok e kindgi gi le mag thim gi winy manie kor polo, gi chwech mamol e lowo, atungʼ gi ligangla to abiro turo, kendo lweny bende anatiek e piny, mondo gik moko duto obed gi kwe.
english: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.

kikuyu: Kora wuod Izhar, ma wuod Kohath, ma wuod Lawi, kod joka Reuben moko kaka Dathan gi Abiram, ma yawuot Eliab kod On wuod Peleth noriwore kaachiel
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, ne aluongi mondo ikonya kendo ne ichanga.
english: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny noluwe, motingʼo mon bende mane ywak ka goyo nduru nikech en.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

kikuyu: Mano kaka midhiero omaka malit! Chutho achalo ngʼat ma hulo e puoth mzabibu e ndalo oro. Onge olemb mzabibu mochokore ma dacham, ngʼope mokwongo chiek ma agombo bende onge.
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

kikuyu: Kawuono aseketi dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno, kendo gi siro mar chuma kod ohinga mar mula mondo ogengʼne piny ngima, ma gin ruodhi mag Juda, jotende, jodolo mage kod ji duto mag pinyno.
english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi noloyo ja-Filistiano gi orujre kod kidi; ka oonge gi ligangla e lwete nogoyo ja-Filistiano piny monege.
english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.

kikuyu: Koro wanyalo timo angʼo? Wangʼeyo ni gibiro ngʼeyo maonge kiawa ni isechopo ka,
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

kikuyu: Nimar Johana nobiro iru mondo onyisu yor tim makare, to ne ok uyie kuome, kata obedo ni josol osuru gi jochode to noyie kuome. Kendo kata bangʼ neno mano, pod ne udagi lokoru mondo uyie kuome.
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom mano, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho kama: Kuom mirimba mager abiro kelo yamb ahiti, kendo kuom mirimba abiro kelo koth maduongʼ kod pe mi oketh ohingano chuth.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

kikuyu: Kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye norito kwereu nimar noherogi mi bangʼe noyiero mana un, nyikwagi e dier ogendini mamoko duto mondo ubed joge mana kaka pod un nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

kikuyu: Osechiela gi ohinga ma ok anyal ringo madhi; kendo oseketa piny kotweya gi nyororo.
english: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo mudho olwori ma ok inyal neno kendo chandruok malich olwori.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

kikuyu: Koa e thim mar Kedemoth, ne aoro joote ne Sihon ma ruodh Heshbon kakwaye mondo kwe obedie kawachone niya,
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

kikuyu: koa e dhood Efraim, ne en Hoshea wuod Nun;
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom adek machielo maru nyaka rit dhoranga Sur. Kendo achiel kuom adek modongʼ nyaka rit alwora mar hekalu. Joritgo duto nyaka rit kar dak ruoth.
english: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

kikuyu: Ne en gi Nyasaye nyaka aa chakruok.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

kikuyu: kendo rituru bende chike mag jotelo ma gin joma ruoth owuon ema oketo mondo okum joma ketho to opwo joma timo maber.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

kikuyu: Nyis jo-dhood Israel ma jongʼanyogo kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Yaye dhood Israel, timbeu mamono oroma!
english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

kikuyu: Mi gichal gi buya mayot-yot, yaye Nyasacha, mi gichal gi mihudhwe ma yamo tero.
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, ne idwokogi; ne in Nyasaye maweyo richo ne jo-Israel, kata obedo ni ne ikumo timbegi mobam.
english: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

kikuyu: To Saulo nosekawo nyare ma Mikal, mane chi Daudi mi omiyo Paltiel wuod Laish mane ja-Galim.
english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

kikuyu: Eka owad gi wuon Saulo nopenjogi niya, “Ne pod un kanye?” Ne odwoko niya, “Ne wadwaro punde, to kane waneno ni gitamowa yudo eka wadhi ir Samuel.”
english: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

kikuyu: Nikech Wuod Dhano osebiro mondo owar joma olal.]
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone ji duto niya, “Bende uneno ngʼat ma Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero? Onge ngʼama chalo kode kuom ji duto.” Eka ji nokok niya, “Ruoth mondo odag amingʼa!”
english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”

kikuyu: Nikech nitie ji mangʼeny ma jongʼanyo, ma gin mana jothor wach kendo jowuond ji, to moloyo jogo moter nyangu ma gin jo-Yahudi moyie.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

kikuyu: Mano kaka hera ma Wuoro oherowago duongʼ kuom luongowa ni nyithind Nyasaye. Kendo mano e gima wan! Gimomiyo piny, ok ongʼeyowa en nikech piny ne ok ongʼeye.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

kikuyu: Omiyo wanyalo wacho ni ka Ibrahim nochiwo achiel kuom apar to mano nyiso ni kata mana Lawi nyakware ma en ngʼat mane onego yud pok mar achiel kuom apar bende nochiwo pokno,
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

kikuyu: Gimoro amora ma gima othono orere nobed mogak; ka orere kuom kendo kata kuom aguch kendo, to nyaka mukgi oko nikech gin gik mogak kendo nyaka kwan-gi kamano.
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

kikuyu: Bade ma koracham oteno wiya to bade ma korachwich okwaka.
english: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

kikuyu: E kindeno tingʼ mapek mane joga nigo nogol kuomgi, jok mag-gi nogol e ngʼutgi; kendo jok notur nikech gisebedo machwe.
english: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

kikuyu: Kendo ne giike e lope mane opogne mantiere Timnath Sera e piny gode mag Efraim, mantiere yo nyandwat mar Got Gash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, Ruoth Agripa, ne ok atamora timo kaka fweny moa e polo nonyisa.
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

kikuyu: Ne uneno gi wangʼu timbe madongo mane gin ranyisi gi honni.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

kikuyu: Omiyo Saulo noluongo joge duto makedo ne lweny, mondo gilor gidhi Keila kendo gigengʼ ne Daudi gi joge.
english: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

kikuyu: kendo Isaka ne ja-higni piero angʼwen kane okendo Rebeka nyar Bethuel ja-Aram mane odak e piny Padan Aram, kendo ma nyamin Laban.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar apar gariyo, e dwe mar apar gariyo ne en Heldai ja-Netofath koa e anywola mar Othniel. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nosiemogi ni kik ginyis ngʼato angʼata ngʼama en.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

kikuyu: Ka wasikwa duto nowinjo ma, ogendini molworowa luoro nomako kendo chunygi nobwok, nikech negifwenyo ni tijni notim gi teko mar Nyasachwa.
english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

kikuyu: Omiyo angʼeyo ni Ruoth pod biro resa kuom gimoro amora marach madwaro hinya nyaka chop atundi e pinyruodh polo. En ema mondo oyud duongʼ mosiko nyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, kane ongʼere ni rwadhno ne nigi kido mar chwopo, kendo wuon-gi ne osesiem to ne ok otweye, wuon-gi nyaka chul, chiayo kar chiayo kendo chiayo mothono nobed mare.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo koro wachne jo-Juda kod jogo modak Jerusalem, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Neuru! Aiko masira nikech un kendo achano chenro marach nikech un. Omiyo weuru yoreu maricho, ngʼato ka ngʼato, kendo ulok yoreu gi timbeu.’
english: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’

kikuyu: Konywa, yaye Nyasaye ma Jawarwa, nikech duongʼ mar nyingi; reswa kendo wenwa richowa, mondo nyingi oyud duongʼ.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

kikuyu: Angʼo mingʼeyo ma wan ok wangʼeyo? Paro matut mage ma in-go, ma wan waongego?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

kikuyu: mi giwachone Musa niya, “Wasebedo mogak nikech wamulo ringre joma otho, to en angʼo momiyo ditamwa chiwo misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kaka jo-Israel mamoko e kinde moketne?”
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

kikuyu: Pinygi nopogi kama: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaf,
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

kikuyu: Osechungo tung ne joge, tung mosekelo pak ne joge maler duto, joge ma jo-Israel, ma gin joma ni machiegni gi chunye. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nonyisa jotheth angʼwen.
english: The LORD showed me four craftsmen.

kikuyu: Kamano bende, bangʼ chiemo nokawo kikombe mi owacho niya, “Kikombeni en singruok manyien motim gi remba, mochwer nikech un.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

kikuyu: Ok oyiene wilo chiayono mondo oket moro kare, bedni orach kata ober, bende ok onyal wile gi gimoro amora. To kaponi otimo kamano, to nyaka ongʼe ni chiayono kod mokwongo giduto koro ginibed mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

kikuyu: “Koro, wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom nyi jou makoro weche ma giparo. Kor wach kuomgi,
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

kikuyu: Kane jatend jolweny duto kod jogi nowinjo ni ruodh Babulon oseyiero Gedalia kaka jatelo maduongʼ, negibiro ir Gedalia e dala miluongo ni Mizpa. Jogo ne gin Ishmael wuod Nethania, Johanan wuod Karea, Seraya wuod Tanhumeth ja-Netofath, Jazania ja-Maakath kod jogegi.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

kikuyu: Keluru makati ariyo mugolo e miechu kaka misango mifwayo, kendo ulosgi gi mogo mayom moromo kilo abiriyo moketie thowi, mondo uchiwgi ne Jehova Nyasaye kaka chiwo mar cham mokwongo.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

kikuyu: Angʼiyo kaka dakelnegi hinyruok, to ok kelonegi ber; nimar un jo-Yahudi man Misri nonegu gi ligangla kod kech nyaka tieku pep.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

kikuyu: gi kuonde moger malo mag jorito, kendo gi ohinga mochiel motegno,
english: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruoth manyien mane ok ongʼeyo wach Josef nobedo e loch e piny Misri.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

kikuyu: Nowacho ne wedene niya, “Chokuru kite moko.” Kuom mano negikawo kite kendo negichokogi pith mine gichiemo but pidhno.
english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi osegero ute e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, ne oloso kama Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye nyalo betie ma ogurone hema.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

kikuyu: “En ngʼa mane ogonyo kanyna e bungu? En ngʼa mane ogonyo tonde mane otweyego?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

kikuyu: Mana kaka asemako pinyruodhi mag nyiseche manono, ma gin pinyruoth ma kido ma gin-go ngʼeny moloyo mag Jerusalem gi Samaria.
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

kikuyu: paruru bende ni kindeno ne upogoru gi Kristo, kendo ne uonge e kanyakla mar jo-Israel, bende ne un welo kuom singruok mar winjruok, ne uonge kata gi geno kuom Nyasaye e pinyni.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

kikuyu: (Koro Uria wuod Shemaya moa Kiriath Jearim ne ngʼat machielo mane okoro e nying Jehova Nyasaye; nokoro mana gik machalre kuom dala maduongʼni kendo pinyni mana kaka Jeremia notimo.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in the LORD’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ ka osetiekgi chuth e nyimu, to beduru motangʼ kendo kik upenj weche mag nyisechegi ka uwacho niya, “Ere kaka ogendinigi ne tiyo ni nyisechegi? Wan bende wabiro timo kamano.”
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

kikuyu: Nochiwore owuon mondo ochul nengo mar waro ji duto. Kuom mano Nyasaye nokele kaka ranyisi e kinde mowinjore.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

kikuyu: Chokene otegno ka mula, kendo tiendene otegno ka chuma.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

kikuyu: “E ndalo mag Shamgar wuod Anath, kendo e ndalo Jael, yore nojwangʼ, mi jowuoth ne luwo yore matindo.
english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nokawo makati abiriyogo gi rechgo, kendo kane osegoyo erokamano, nongʼingogi bangʼe omiyogi jopuonjrene, mondo opog ji.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Aora Jordan ema nobedo tongʼ mar joka Reuben. Pinyno kaachiel gi mier matindo mokiewo kodgi nobedo girkeni mar joka Reuben.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone jodolo madongo, jotelo mag jorit hekalu, kod jodongo, mane obiro ire, niya, “An jatend koko mar jo-jendeke, momiyo ubiro ira gi ligengni kod arunge?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

kikuyu: Eka Shekania wuod Jehiel, achiel kuom nyikwa Elam, nowachone Ezra niya, “Ok wasebedo jo-ratiro ni Nyasachwa kuom kendo nyiri ma ok jo-Yahudi. To kata ka wasetimo kamano, to jo-Israel pod nigi geno.
english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

kikuyu: Nikech nitie makati achiel, koro wan ringruok achiel, kata obedo ni wangʼeny, nikech wan duto wachamo makati achielno.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

kikuyu: Gik ma Nyasaye okwedo ok nochak obedie. Kom duongʼ mar loch Nyasaye gi mar Nyarombo ema nobedie ei dalano, to jotichne notine.
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny nochokore Jerusalem e dwe mar ariyo mondo gitim Sap Makati ma ok oketie Thowi.
english: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, gima Nyasaye oseriwo kaachiel kik dhano moro amora pogi.”
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

kikuyu: kata mana kitembini kod lewni mane orere kuome noter ni jotuo, mine gichango kuom tuochegi kendo jochiende noa kuomgi.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

kikuyu: Joma nenore ni longʼo kuomgi; chalo gi kuth oriangʼ. Joma ikwano ni odimbore mogik eigi richo moloyo kuth chiedo. Odiechieng jorito mau osechopo, odiechiengʼ ma Nyasaye limoue. Ma e kinde ma ikeyoue.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

kikuyu: Kane gigo duto osetimore, Paulo nongʼado e chunye mondo odhi Jerusalem, kokadho Makedonia gi Akaya. Nowacho e chunye niya, “Bangʼ dhi Jerusalem, to nyaka alim Rumi bende.”
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

kikuyu: To nyaka ochiw rwadhno e dho Hemb Romo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye. Kendo oyie lwete e wiye mi oyangʼe e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before the LORD.

kikuyu: Laban nomedo wachone niya, “Nyisa pok monego amiyi kendo abiro chuligi.”
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

kikuyu: Aparo chandruokna, wuodhena ma ok nikare, kaachiel gi lit gi kuyo.
english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

kikuyu: Gin mana chiemo gi math kod tim pwothruok mopogore opogore, to magi gin mana tim ma oko matiyo mana nyaka ndalo ma chik manyien nochakie tich, kendo ne itiyo kodgi mana ka Nyasaye ne pok oloko gik moko odoko manyien.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

kikuyu: Magi e jotelo mag anywolagi: Yawuot Reuben ma kach Israel ne gin: Hanok, Palu, Hezron kod Karmi. Mago e jo-Reuben.
english: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negikelo jambgi ne Josef kendo nomiyogi chiemo kar farese, gi rombe gi diek gi dhok kod punde. Kendo e higano, nopidhogi gi chiemo kar jambgi duto.
english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

kikuyu: To ring rwadhno gi piene kaachiel gi wen, nogolo oko mar kambi mowangʼogi duto kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochike.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mano ok onyiso ni wach Nyasaye orem mak ochopo chenrone, nikech nyikwa Israel duto ok gin jo-Israel adier.
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

kikuyu: Ne otingʼe motere nyaka dala, kendo wuon odgi noneno kar romb cham mane ochoko. Bende Ruth noterone chiemo mane ochamo odongʼ.
english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.

kikuyu: Joma aori irgi gin joma wigi tek ma ok winj wach. Wachnegi kama: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho.’
english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’

kikuyu: nikech wadhi ketho dalani. Ywak ma iywak nego dalani osebedo malich e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo oseorowa mondo wakethe.”
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”

kikuyu: Joma lando Kristo ka gin-gi ich lit gi miero to timo kamano mondo oyud duongʼ, ka giparo niginyalo medona chandruok ka pod an e od twech.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Ruoth, yie ikech wuoda, nikech en-gi tuo mar ndulme kendo osandore malit. Kinde duto opodho piny e mach kata e pi.
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi gik moti mopidhie cham e bath aora Nael notwo ma bar okak kendo cham bende noner molal nono.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Kik ucham bor moro amora mar dhok, rombe, kata diek.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

kikuyu: Kik obed ngʼat moyudo warruok machiegni, nono to sunga nyalo make mi opodhi kendo bura loye kaka noloyo jachien.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

kikuyu: Achiel kuomgi, mane en ngʼat molony ahinya e chik noteme kapenje niya,
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

kikuyu: mi gichiwe ne joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo ojare, ochwade kendo ogure. To chiengʼ mar adek nochier mobed mangima kendo!”
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni chunyi mor koda, nimar jowasika ok loya.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma timbene richo ohero richo; jabute ok yud ngʼwono kuome.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel nowachone ji niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ema ne oyiero Musa gi Harun kendo nogolo kwereu koa e piny Misri.
english: Samuel said to the people, “It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Richogi mondo osiki e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, eka mondo ongʼad kargi oko chuth e piny.
english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano norwako ne Harun kandho, eka notweyone okanda e nungone, kendo norwakone law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, bangʼe notweyone law dolono miluongo ni efodno gi okandane motwangʼ maber.
english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

kikuyu: Ne wawinjo wachno Efratha, ee, ne wayude e puothe mag Jaar:
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

kikuyu: Kwereu nochamo manna e thim, to kata kamano ne githo.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

kikuyu: Kinde ka kinde malaika mar Ruoth ne lor mondo otug pi. Ngʼama nokwongo donjo e pigno sa ma otugoreno ne chango kuom kit tuo moro amora mane en-go].
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

kikuyu: To bed mangʼwon ni yawuot Barzilai ja-Gilead kendo we gibed achiel kuom joma chiemo e mesani. Negidok jokora kane aringo e nyim Abisalom owadu.
english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

kikuyu: Omiyo jogo nowuok modhi koluwo dier piny tir. Negindiko gigo duto mane giyudo e pinyno e kitabu, e dala ka dala, e migepe abiriyo kendo mi gidwogo ir Joshua e kambi man Shilo.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo, negitimo Nyasi mar Makati ma ok oketie thowi gi ilo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye nosepongʼogi gi ilo kuom loko pach ruodh Asuria, mondo omi nokonygi e tich manie od Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because the LORD had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.

kikuyu: Negitimo mano kendo ka Harun norieyo bade mane otingʼogo luth mi ochwado buru ma e lowo, kikun nopor kuom ji kod jamni. Buru ma e piny Misri duto nolokore kikun.
english: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Omiyo Zimri noketho od Baasha, kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye mane owacho ni Baasha kawuok kuom Jehu janabi
english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

kikuyu: Mad wangʼi rang hekaluni odiechiengʼ kod otieno, kama niwacho ni Nyingi nobedie. Yie iwinji lemo ma jatichni lamo kochomo odni.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

kikuyu: To ne awacho niya, “Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, jonabi osebedo kanyisogi ni, ‘Ok unune ligangla kata kech bende ok nokau. Adiera, anamiu kwe mochwere kaeni.’ ”
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”

kikuyu: Eka negichako gidonjore gi muofuno, mi gipenje niya, “In manende ochangi, to iwacho angʼo kuome?” Ngʼatno nodwokogi niya, “En janabi.”
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

kikuyu: Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Biuru walosuru matafare kendo wawangʼ-gi mochiek maber.” Negitiyo gi matafare kar kite kendo lowo kar simiti.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano gigerna kama ler mar lemo kendo anadag kodgi.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ka dipo ni amiyora duongʼ kenda, to duongʼna onge tich. Wuora, ma un bende uluongo ni Nyasachuno ema miya duongʼ.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

kikuyu: Josef nochoko pesa duto mane yudore e piny Misri kod piny Kanaan kuom cham mane gingʼiewo kuome kendo noterogi e od keno mar Farao.
english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Kwerewa ne ok jo-ratiro; omiyo negitimo richo e nyim wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa kane giweye. Ne gingʼanyone hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma giweyo luwe.
english: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in the LORD our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye timo gik makare kendo otimo maber ne joma isando duto.
english: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kikuyu: Petro notingʼo lwete malo mondo gilingʼ, eka nonyisogi yo mane Ruoth ogolego e od twech. Nowachonegi niya, “Nyisuru Jakobo gi jowete mamoko gima nosetimore.” Bangʼe noa kanyo modhi kamachielo.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

kikuyu: Negibiro kendo gikawo pinyno, to ne ok gilwori kata luwo chikeni; ne ok gitimo gik mane ichikogi mondo gitim. Omiyo ne ikelo kuomgi masichegi duto.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

kikuyu: Ka wadu moro dhier omako ma ouso lope, to nyaka wadgi moro tem matek kendo owarne lopeno.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

kikuyu: Mano kaka dhoge mit nyodho, kendo ober moloyo chwo mamoko. Mano e jaherana, mano e osiepna, yaye nyi Jerusalem.
english: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Maskil mar Ethan ja-Ezra. Abiro wer nyaka chiengʼ kuom hera maduongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye; abiro nyiso ji gi dhoga mi gingʼe kuom adierani e tienge duto.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Ondiegi angʼwen moko malich, ma moro ka moro opogore gi nyawadgi, nowuok koa e nam.
english: Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

kikuyu: To bende wiu kik wil gi timo timbe mabeyo kendo gipogone ji giu, nikech mago e kit misango ma Nyasaye morgo.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Filistia nokedo kendo, jo-Israel nolo mi ngʼato ka ngʼato noringo kadhi e hembe. Noneg ji mathoth ahinya! Noneg jolweny mag jo-Israel alufu piero adek.
english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

kikuyu: Tiendegi reto kadhi timo richo; giyot ahinya mondo gichwer remo maonge ketho. Paro manie chunygi gin paro maricho kendo kamoro amora ma gidhiyoe; masira gi chandruok ema dongʼie.
english: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

kikuyu: mi nochiwo pinygi kaka girkeni, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Tim makare rito ngʼat mobidhore, timbe maricho to tieko jaricho.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

kikuyu: Ok unyal madho kikombe Ruoth kaachiel gi kikombe jochiende bende; kendo ok unyal chiemo e mesa Ruoth, ka uchiemo e mesa jochiende bende.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

kikuyu: Koa kanyo ne giwuotho ka gidhi Gudgoda ma gichopo nyaka Jotbatha, piny aore.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

kikuyu: Oumo wangʼ dwe mopor, koyaro bochene mondo ogengʼe.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “Jo-Israel ithiro, kaachiel gi jo-Juda bende kamano. Joma ne omakogi nomakogi matek, ma ok nyal weyogi gidhi.
english: The LORD of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.

kikuyu: Ochode duto ichulo, to in to ichiwo mich ni joma terore kodi duto, kendo imiyogi asoya mondo gibi iri eka gichopni dwarogi maricho.
english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

kikuyu: Negipogo tijgi ka gigoyo ombulu, jomatindo gi jomadongo, jopuonj gi joma ipuonjo machalre.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

kikuyu: Nyasaye noora motelonu mondo arit kothu modongʼ e piny kendo mondo ores ngimau gi resruok maduongʼ.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nokelo wachgini e nyim Jehova Nyasaye
english: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro kaw jogi gotieno mondo upond e bungu kuritogi.
english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nomiyo Esau kuon gi ogich ngʼor. Nochiemo kendo ometho, eka ne ochungʼ mi odhi. Kuom mano Esau, nojwangʼo duongʼne mar nywol.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

kikuyu: “To kata awuo manade, to rem ma an-go medore ameda; to kata ka aweyo wuoyo to bende ok orum.
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

kikuyu: “Koro we anyisi fweny mabiro timore e piny Pasia: Ruodhi adek moko nobedie eka ruoth mar angʼwen nobi, ma nobed gi mwandu mathoth moloyo ruodhi mamoko duto. Bangʼ yudo duongʼ nikech mwandune, obiro thuwo ogendini gi jo-Yunani.
english: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona, kawacho niya,
english: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Eka Jakobo nolamo kawacho niya, “Yaye Nyasach kwara Ibrahim, Nyasach wuora Isaka, Jehova Nyasaye mane owachona ni, ‘Dogi thuru ir jou, kendo abiro miyo inyaa,’
english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

kikuyu: Negiwacho niya, “Ma e gima onego utim. Neg dichwo moro amora to gi nyako moro amora mosengʼeyo dichwo.”
english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

kikuyu: To joma ni e chandruok oreso e chandruokgi; owuoyo kodgi e kinde ma gin gi chandruok.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

kikuyu: In jasika kik inyiera kata obedoni asepodho to abiro chungʼ kendo! Kata obedo ni abet e mudho to Jehova Nyasaye biro doko lerna.
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

kikuyu: Moruru kendo beduru moil, yaye Nyar Edom, un jogo modak e piny Uz. To un bende, kikombeno ibiro miyou; kendo ubiro mer mi udongʼ duge.
english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.

kikuyu: Ok wadwar ni ubed jo-samuoyo to wadwaro ni ulu kit joma yudo gik mosingi nikech giyie kendo gitimo kinda.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro oro mach e piny Moab mondo owangʼ kuonde mochiel motegno mag Kerioth. Jo-Moab biro tho ei lweny mager, ka jolweny giyo sigich lweny kendo tungʼ ywak.
english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

kikuyu: Owacho bende kamachielo niya, “In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: koa kuom oganda Reuben modak loka Jordan, yo wuok chiengʼ momanyore gi Jeriko neginwangʼo Bezer e piny thim mar Jazer,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: (mana kaka nondiki e chik mar Ruoth Nyasaye niya, “Nyathi ka nyathi makayo ma wuowi nyaka wal ne Ruoth”),
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

kikuyu: Nikech nenorena ni onge tiende oro ngʼat motwe ka ok oyang maler kethone mokwongo.”
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

kikuyu: to wachno nyaka unon matut ahinya ka en adieri. Ka osenwangʼo kamano ni gima kwero osetimore e dieru,
english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

kikuyu: Un jotelo ma muofnigi! Ungʼudho kikun to ngamia to umuonyo!
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

kikuyu: ni ngʼama rach tony ka masira obiro kendo ni iresega chiengʼ mirima?
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

kikuyu: Un uwegi ukwanoru kaka joma riek, to pod urwako mana joma ofuwo gi riekougo!
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Maritha, Maritha, iparori kendo ithagori kuom gik mangʼeny kayiem,
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

kikuyu: Ngʼato Rohono miyo yie, to ngʼat machielo omiyo mich mar chango ji;
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: ‘Nyoro ne aneno remb Naboth gi remb yawuote kendo adiera abiro miyo gichul kuom chwero remo e puodho manie pap,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Kaweuru kendo ubole e puodhono kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to the LORD’s word.”

kikuyu: Koa yo podho chiengʼ, ji noluor nying Jehova Nyasaye, kendo koa yo wuok chiengʼ, oganda nomiye duongʼ. Nimar nobi ka pi mongingore ma much Jehova Nyasaye osekudho.
english: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.

kikuyu: Moko chalo kaka kodhi molwar e kind kudho.
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

kikuyu: To jachien ma kama ok nyal riembi ka ok ngʼato olamo matek kendo otweyo chiemo.]”
english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: Nitimo gino apanda, to an abiro timo ma odiechiengʼ alanga e nyim jo-Israel.’ ”
english: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko niya, “To kapo ni ok giyie kata winjo wachna mi giwacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye ne ok ofwenyoreni’?”
english: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, ndik tarigni piny, nikech ruodh Babulon oseluoro Jerusalem kawuononi.
english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Josef bende noa e dala mar Nazareth, e piny Galili modhiyo Judea nyaka Bethlehem e dala mar Daudi, nikech ne en achiel kuom joodgi kendo anywola gi Daudi.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

kikuyu: To ka otamore winji to kaw ngʼato achiel kata ji ariyo idhi iwuogo kode, mondo, wach moro mantie e kind ji nyaka ngʼere malongʼo ka nitiere joneno ariyo kata adek.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

kikuyu: Omiyo Gideon nogero ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo mar misango mi oluongo kanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye en Kwe. Kendono pod ni Ofra kuno e piny jo-Abiezer nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

kikuyu: Obiro modho e aora matin manie bath yo, emomiyo noyud teko mi otingʼ wiye.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

kikuyu: nooro joote mondo oluong Balaam wuod Beor, mane ni Pethor but Aora Yufrate, mantiere e piny mane onywole. Balak nowacho kama: “Ogandagi oa Misri; gipongʼo wangʼ piny kendo gidak machiegni koda.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

kikuyu: E kind pinjego ok unuyudie hoch kata yweyo ka ombongʼ tiendeu ool. Kuno Jehova Nyasaye nomiu paro maliw, wangʼ maneno ka ool gi dwaro to gi chuny machandore.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

kikuyu: Eka nomedo wacho niya, “An gi wach moro madwaro wachoni.” Nodwoko niya, “Inyalo wacho.”
english: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”

kikuyu: Nimar ne owuoyo, mi notugo ahiti mangʼongo ma nomiyo apaka ogingore.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

kikuyu: Kamano pinyruoth Jehoshafat ne nigi kwe nikech Nyasache nomiye yweyo kuonde duto.
english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, sa ma ichiemo kata imodho pigi to tetni ka gima kibaji ogoyi.
english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa noloso thuol mar mula mi okete ewi luth. Kane ngʼato thuol okayo mi bangʼe ongʼiyo thuond mulano to nochango.
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

kikuyu: Oluwo buchena, kendo orito chikena gadiera. Ngʼat ma kamano en ngʼat makare, omiyo enobed mangima adier, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto owacho.
english: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: We awinjie mor kod ilo; mi chokena misetoyo ochak obedie mamor.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

kikuyu: “Owetena, anyalo wachonu ka an gichir ni Daudi kwarwa notho mi noyike, kendo liende ni kodwa nyaka kawuono.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

kikuyu: Kaka yamo ma aa yo wuok chiengʼ, anakegi e nyim wasikgi; ananyisgi ngʼeya to ok wangʼa e kinde mar masichegi.”
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

kikuyu: nimar ber moloyo owachni niya, “Bi ka,” moloyo ka igoli e nyim jomadongo.
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: Jo-Gad kod jo-Reuben nowacho ne Musa niya, “Wan jotichni, wabiro timo gima ruodhwa osechikowa.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

kikuyu: Abiro nyiso ayanga timbeu makare kod tijeu, kendo ok ginikelnu konyruok.
english: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.

kikuyu: Donge kikombe mar gweth ma wagoyene Nyasaye erokamano ketowa e lalruok achiel e remb Kristo? Koso makati mwangʼingo donge ketowa e lalruok achiel, e ringre Kristo?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
