kikuyu: Omiyo Solomon nogero hekalu motieke.
english: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

kikuyu: Mad ruodha mondo kik odew ngʼat ma achach ma Nabal. Ochalo mana gi nyinge, nyinge tiende ni ngʼat mofuwo, kendo otimo tim fuwo kuonde duto. An to ne ok aneno joma ne ruodha ooro.
english: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.

kikuyu: to jadolo nyaka none, kendo ka ilni omedore e del, to onge tiende mondo jadolo omany yier maratongʼ, nimar ngʼatno ogak.
english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

kikuyu: “Higa ka higa wabiro kawo tingʼ mar kelo osuru madirom achiel kuom adek mar shekel ne tij od Nyasachwa,
english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:

kikuyu: Emomiyo par ane gik mane opuonji kendo mane isewinjo, makgi kendo lokri iwe richo. Ka ok ichiew to abiro biro apoya mana kaka jakuo ma ok ibi ngʼeyo sa ma anabiyee iri.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Parie Daudi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie Daudi gi chandruok duto moseneno.
english: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

kikuyu: Jwangʼuru miechu kendo udagi e kind lwendni, un joma odak Moab. Chaluru ka akuch odugla maloso ode e dho rogo.
english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

kikuyu: Jogwengʼ kod wedene nowinjo ni Ruoth Nyasaye osetimone kech maduongʼ mi gibedo kode e morne.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

kikuyu: Akan nodwoke niya, “En adier! Asetimone Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel richo. Ma e gima asetimo:
english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Lor piny piyo piyo ia e got, nikech jogi mane igolo oa e piny Misri oselokore jo-mibadhi. Giseweyo mapiyo gik mane achikogi, kendo giseloso nyiseche mag kido.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

kikuyu: Bangʼe ne adhi e gwenge mag Siria kod Kilikia.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joab nooro ngʼat moro Tekoa mi okelne dhako moro mariek koa kuno. Nowachone niya, “Wuondri ni ikuyo. Rwak lep ywak kendo kik iwirri gi mo del. Chal ka dhako mosebet ka ywago ngʼate motho kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
english: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

kikuyu: Unuwuog kuno gi mor kendo notelnu gi kwe, gode madongo gi matindo nower matek e nyime kendo yiende duto manie bungu nopam gi ilo.
english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.

kikuyu: Kaleb ma wuod Jefune nonywolo: Iru, Ela kod Naam. Ela nonywolo ne en Kenaz.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

kikuyu: koso angʼo momiyo isiko inone okinyi kokinyi kendo iteme sa ka sa?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

kikuyu: Nikech un uwegi ungʼeyo ni onego ulu ranyisi mar kit ngimawa. Ne ok wabudh abudha kane wan kodu,
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

kikuyu: En e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa; buchene ni e piny duto.
english: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Bende Hezekia ruodh Juda kata ngʼato angʼata man Juda nonegi? Donge Hezekia noluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo omanyo ngʼwono mare? Kendo donge Jehova Nyasaye noloko pache, mi omiyo ne ok okelo masira kuomgi? Wachiegni kelo masira malich kuomwa wawegi!”
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear the LORD, and entreat the favor of the LORD, and the LORD relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

kikuyu: Beduru motegno mondo waked gi chir ni jowa kendo ni mier madongo mag Nyasachwa. Jehova Nyasaye biro timo gima oneno ni ber e nyim wangʼe.”
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo irange, lwanda moro ne omuki, to ok gi lwet dhano. Lwandano notuomo kido mochweno gi yo ka tiendene mane olos gi chuma gi lowo, mi otoyogi matindo tindo.
english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

kikuyu: Dine obedo nigi maber moloyo ka dine ok gingʼeyo yor ngima makare, moloyo ngʼeyogo eka bangʼe gidok chien giweyo chik mane omigi.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

kikuyu: Kane ndalo ochopo mane Merab nyar Saulo onego omi Daudi, ne omiye Adriel ja-Mehola mondo okende.
english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo boye moluni opara tir? Bende onyalo puroni kuonde modongʼ bangʼi ma ok opurore maber?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

kikuyu: kendo mondo ubed gi rieko mar yiero mana timo gima ber kende. Kamano ngimau nobed maler kendo maonge bura, nyaka chop odiechieng Kristo.
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

kikuyu: kendo Abisalom mane wawiro mondo obed ruodhwa bende osetho e lweny. Mara angʼo ulingʼ alingʼa ma ok uwuo e wach mar duogo ruoth?”
english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

kikuyu: Mier mane ochiel gohinga ne gin: Zidin, Zer, Hamath, Rakath, Kinereth,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

kikuyu: “ ‘Koro ma e richo mane nyameru ma Sodom otimo. En kod nyige ne wigi tek kendo ne giyiengʼ ahinya ma ok gidew jomoko machandore. Ne ok gikonyo joma odhier gi joma ni gidwaro.
english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

kikuyu: Jaote nowuok modhi, kane ochopo nonyiso Daudi weche duto mane Joab oore mondo owachi.
english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Koro abiro aa malo, mondo anyisu duongʼna gi tekona.
english: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

kikuyu: Nodhi nyime chakre Bethel (tiende ni, Luz), mi ongʼado gwengʼ jo-Arki mantiere Ataroth,
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

kikuyu: To nyisgiuru ni, ‘Jo-Israel nongʼado aora Jordan kawuotho e lowo motwo.’
english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

kikuyu: Omiyo noyikwa kode e tho kuom batiso, mondo kaka Kristo nochier oa kuom joma otho kuom duongʼ mar Wuoro, e kaka wan bende onego wadagi e ngima manyien.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

kikuyu: Rachungi mag sirnigo nolos gi mula. Ramaki gi rangʼaw mag sirnigo nolos gi fedha, kendo nobaw wi sirnigo gi fedha; rangʼaw mag sirnigo duto mag laru nolos gi fedha.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

kikuyu: Omiyo Pilato nopenjo Yesu niya, “In ruodh jo-Yahudi koso?” Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ee, en kaka iwachono.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Eka Nowa nogero kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo nokawo le maler kod winy maler moko michamo, motimogo misango miwangʼo pep ewi kendono.
english: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

kikuyu: Mad pigni donj e iyi kendo omi iyi kirre kata omi ibwog nyathi ka kinde mar nywolne pok ochopo.” “ ‘Bangʼe dhakono nodwok kawacho niya, “Amin. Mad obed kamano.”
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Samuel kawacho niya,
english: Then the LORD’s word came to Samuel, saying,

kikuyu: Kane Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ochopo e kambi, jo-Israel duto nokok matek ma piny noyiengni.
english: When the ark of the LORD’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye nokony Jakobo e lwet wasike, kendo enoresgi e lwet jogo matek moloyogi.
english: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

kikuyu: To kata kamano rawera moro nonenogi mowacho ni Abisalom. Omiyo ji ariyogi nowuok piyo kendo negidhi Bahurim e od ngʼat moro. Ne en gi soko e laru mare, kendo negidonjo e iye.
english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

kikuyu: Abiro miyo wuod jatichni madhako bed oganda maduongʼ nikech en bende en rembi.”
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

kikuyu: Paruruane winy ma ok chwo cham to bende ok gikee, gionge gi kuonde keno kata dere; to Nyasaye pod pidhogi apidha. To un donge uber moloyo winy.
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

kikuyu: Kata kamano isebaro iweyo yo kendo puonjgi osemiyo ji mangʼeny ochwanyore; iseketho singruok mar jo-Lawi,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar Nowa. Nowa ne ngʼama kare, kendo malongʼo e kind oganda mane nitie kendo nowuotho gi Nyasaye.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

kikuyu: Chiw achiel gokinyi to machielo godhiambo.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

kikuyu: Un wuone, kik umi nyithindu chuny lit, nono to chunygi biro jok.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

kikuyu: ma chutho ok en Injili. Kuom adiera nitie jomoko marundo pachu ka gitemo mondo gilok Injili mar Kristo obed gimoro nono.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Los kido mar malaika mar kerubi achiel e giko raumno kendo malaika mar ariyo e giko komachielo; bende los kido mar malaika mar kerubigo e gimoro achiel gi raumno, e giko raumgo.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, bende iseneno gik ma jodong dhood Israel timo e mudho, ka ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi odich mana e abich nyasache? Giwacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye ok newa; nikech Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼo piny.’ ”
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Mar Daudi. Mano kaka en gima ber kendo malongʼo, ka jowete odak kanyakla gi kwe!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

kikuyu: Tich matek miyo ngʼato bedo gi duongʼ, to nyawo gikone en tich mar misumba.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

kikuyu: To ka gipenji ni, ‘Ere kama wanyalo dhiyoe?’ To nyisgi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Mago matho ochomo, tho nonegi; mago ma ligangla ochomo, noneg gi ligangla; to mago ma kech ochomo, kech nonegi; to mago ma twech ochomo, noter e twech.’ ”
english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’

kikuyu: To ma ok en adiera kuom jatichna Musa; nikech en ja-ratiro e oda duto.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

kikuyu: Negikawo jambgi kod mwandugi mane giseyudo e piny Kanaan, kendo Jakobo kod nyikwaye duto nodhi Misri.
english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

kikuyu: Kane Serug ja-higni piero adek, nonywolo Nahor.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Mana kaka jatichna Isaya oselonyore duk mowuotho gi tiende nono kuom higni adek, kobedo ranyisi kuom gima timore ne Misri kod Kush,
english: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

kikuyu: Puonj mar kwer konyo ngʼat mariek, moloyo chwat nyadi mia ni ngʼat mofuwo.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

kikuyu: Koa e nyikwa Pashur: Elioenai, Maseya, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad gi Elasa.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

kikuyu: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafish kod Kedema.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

kikuyu: kane oyudo ochwoyo, kodhi moko nolwar e dir yo, mi winy nobiro mochamogi duto.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

kikuyu: “Ma ema nobedni ranyisi, yaye Hezekia: “E higa mokwongoni, unucham gik matwi kendgi, kendo e higa mar ariyo unucham orowe moloth bangʼ keyo e higa mokwongono. To e higa mar adek unuchwo kodhi kendo unuka cham, bende unupidh mzabibu mi ucham olembegi.
english: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

kikuyu: Abiro timo singruok mar kwe kodgi, enobed singruok mochwere. Abiro gurogi motegno kendo abiro miyo kwan-gi medre, kendo abiro keto kara maler mar lemo e diergi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

kikuyu: Aywak matek ka alemo ni Jehova Nyasaye, kendo odwoka gie gode maler. Sela
english: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano, to ne gimino mana kode wach kuom kit lemogi kendo kuom ngʼat moro miluongo ni Yesu, mane osetho, to Paulo oramo ni ngʼatno ngima.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

kikuyu: “Awachonu adier ni ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wachna, kendo moyie kuom Jal mane oora, nigi ngima mochwere, kendo ok bi ngʼadne buch tho; to osengʼado oa e tho modonjo e ngima.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

kikuyu: Joma losogi nobed machal kodgi, kendo joma oketo genogi kuomgi bende biro chalo kodgi.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Sa moro amora ma awuoyo, aywak ka goyo milome mar lweny kod kethruok. Omiyo wach Jehova Nyasaye osekelona ayany kod wichkuot odiechiengʼ mangima.
english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because the LORD’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi nonyiso wuode Solomon kit gedo mar agoch hekalu, kaka onego gere, kuondege mag keno, utege mamalo, agolnige maiye kod kar timo misango.
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Horam ruodh Gezer nobiro mondo okony Lakish, to Joshua noloye kaachiel gi jolweny mage maonge ngʼama notony.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

kikuyu: Enodogi mana gi yo mane obirogo; kendo ok enodonj e dala maduongʼni, Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Wechego nochando chuny Maria ahinya, to nowuoro mos mane omosegono, ni tiende angʼo.
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

kikuyu: Abiro keto ji, ma gin joga Israel, mondo owuoth kuomu. Gibiro kawou, kendo ubiro bedo girkeni margi, kendo ok unuchak umagi nyithindgi.
english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, modak e kind kerubi, in kendi e Nyasaye mar pinjeruodhi duto manie piny, kendo in ema ne ichweyo polo gi piny.
english: “LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: koa kuom nyikwa Heman, Jehiel kod Shimei; koa kuom nyikwa Jeduthun, Shemaya kod Uziel.
english: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Janabi nodwoke niya, “Kik ubed maluor, nimar joma ni kodwa ngʼeny moloyo joma ni kodgi.”
english: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyasaye wacho kama: E ndalo giko anaol Roho Maler mara kuom ji duto. Yawuotu gi nyiu nokor wach, jou matindo none fweny, jodongu nolek lek.
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

kikuyu: Kane Jal Maratego okeyo ruodhi manie piny, to ne ochal mana gi pe molwar koa e kama otingʼore gi malo mar Zalmon.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

kikuyu: Ji duto osebaro, giduto gisedoko joma nono; onge ngʼama timo maber, onge kata achiel.”
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

kikuyu: “Kik ibed maluor, yaye Nyar Sayun; nee, ruodhi eri biro, koidho nyathi kanyna.”
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

kikuyu: E bwo bwombegi, e bethegi angʼwen, ne gin gi lwedo mag dhano. Kargi duto angʼwen ne gin gi lela wenge kod bwombe,
english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

kikuyu: to Petro to nodongʼ karito e dhoot oko. Japuonjre machielo ma jadolo maduongʼ nongʼeyono noduogo mowuoyo gi nyako mane rito welo madonjo mi nokawo Petro gidonjogo iye.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

kikuyu: Jodong gwengʼ oselier gi lwetegi e yien, to jomadongo ok osemi luor.
english: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

kikuyu: Bende negiloso bepe miriwo mag yiend siala ka abich oket ne sirni mantie bathe konchiel mar Hemb Romo,
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: Yie ema nomiyo Nowa owinjo siem mane Nyasaye osiemego kanyise gik mane biro timore mane pok oneno. Nowa nowinjo wach Nyasaye, kopongʼ gi luor, mi nohondho yie mondo otony kaachiel gi joode. Kuom yieneno, nongʼado ne piny bura, kendo nodoko achiel kuom joma Nyasaye oketo kare kuom yie.
english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

kikuyu: “Chungi e dhorangach mar od Jehova Nyasaye kendo kanyo land wachni: “ ‘Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jo-Juda duto madonjo gie dhorangeyegi mondo olam Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Guogi biro chamo joka Jeroboam motho e dala maduongʼ kendo winy mae kor polo biro chamo mago motho e pap. Jehova Nyasaye osewacho!’
english: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’

kikuyu: Ugeno kuom ligangla maru, utimo gik mamono, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ketho chi nyawadgi. Bende dukaw piny adier ka uchalo kamano?’
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

kikuyu: Owuok gie tungʼ polo konchiel, kendo olworore nyaka komachielo; onge gima opondo ne liet mare.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

kikuyu: To kuom joma ne chiemo kanyo, onge ngʼama nongʼeyo gimomiyo nowachone kamano.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

kikuyu: E kindeno Boaz nochopo koa Bethlehem, kendo nomoso jokeyo niya, “Jehova Nyasaye obed kodu!” Jokeyo bende nomose niya, “Jehova Nyasaye mondo ogwedhi.”
english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May the LORD be with you.” They answered him, “May the LORD bless you.”

kikuyu: mi nowachone giduol maduongʼ niya, “Chungʼ gi tiendi!” Gikanyono ngʼatno nochikore malo mochako wuoth.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

kikuyu: “Jogo gin joma ogwedhi ma oseluoko kandhogi maler, mondo omi gibed gi ratiro mar chamo olemb yath mar ngimano kendo gikadh ka gidonjo e dhorangeye mag dalano.
english: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho niya, “Iwacho ni, ‘Wuoda ngima kendo mari otho,’ kendo machielo wacho ni, ‘Ooyo, wuodi otho to mara ngima.’ ”
english: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”

kikuyu: Eka Joshua nogwedho Kaleb wuod Jefune mi omiye Hebron kaka girkeni mare.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

kikuyu: Kama iluwo kidonjo kanyo ne nigi raidhi abiriyo, kendo agola mare ne ngʼiyore kodgi tir. Ne ogor othidhe e kor ohinga moliero gi malo e bathe koni gi koni.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

kikuyu: Iselokori iweyo singruok mane itimo gi jatichni, kendo isechido osimbone ei buru.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

kikuyu: Jowetena, kik joma thoth kuomu ketre mar bedo jopuonj, nikech ungʼeyo ni wan mwapuonjo nongʼadnwa bura malit moloyo ji mamoko.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

kikuyu: Uthai wuod Amihud, wuod Omri, wuod Imri, wuod Bani, joka Perez ma wuod Juda.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

kikuyu: Bende ne wapenjogi nying-gi, mondo omi wandik nying jotendgi ne in.
english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorenwa chon, kawacho niya: “Aseherou gihera manyaka chiengʼ; aseomou gihera mar ngʼwono.
english: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

kikuyu: “Eka Harun nodonj ei Hemb Romo, kendo nolony lepe mag katana mane orwako e kinde mane odonjo e Kama Ler Moloyo kendo enowegi mana kanyo.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

kikuyu: Wuoda, ka iyie rwako wechena kendo kano chikena e chunyi;
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

kikuyu: Notiyo tich mane okete mondo otim gadiera, mana kaka Musa bende notiyo tichne gadiera e od Nyasaye gi chunye duto.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

kikuyu: Mad lweti ikre mar konya, nimar aseyiero bucheni.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

kikuyu: kuom kedo gi jo-Babulon: ‘Ginipongʼ-gi gi ringre joma otho mabiro nego gi ich wangʼ mara kod mirimba. Anapand wangʼa ne dala maduongʼni nikech timbegi duto mamono.
english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,

kikuyu: Saulo nodhi ir Samuel e dhorangach mopenje niya, “Kiyie to nyisa od janen?”
english: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa kod jodong Israel nodok e kambi.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka usendiko malongʼo kuom migepe abiriyo mar pinyno, to ukelnagiuru kae kendo abiro pogonugi gi ombulu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

kikuyu: “Un joma tokgi tek, chunyu bor gi Nyasaye kendo udagi winjo wachne! Uchal mana gi kwereu. Usiko utamo Roho Maler tiyo!
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

kikuyu: E ndalo chwiri ruoth Nebukadneza nooro wach mondo oome otere Babulon kaachiel gi gige lemo mabeyo mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo noketo owadgi wuon Jehoyakin, ma nyinge Zedekia mondo obed ruodh Juda kod Jerusalem.
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of the LORD’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mano ne en fwenyruok mar Yesu mar adek ni jopuonjrene bangʼ chier aa kuom joma otho.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: omiyo jo-Yahudi nowachone ngʼama nochangino niya, “Kawuono en chiengʼ Sabato, kendo chik ok oyieni tingʼo pieni.”
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

kikuyu: Kane Nyasaye mirima omako gi jo-Misri, to ne ogure kaka chik ne Josef. Ne awinjo dwol ma ok angʼeyo kuma oaye kawacho kama:
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Dhako nodwoko thuol niya, “Wanyalo chamo olembe mag yiende manie puodho duto,
english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

kikuyu: Farao noluongo jorieko kod ajuoke mag Misri mine gitimo gik machal gi mane Harun otimo ka gitiyo gi teko mag yedhegi mopondo.
english: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

kikuyu: Ka achiel kuom jogo mane ni kode e mesa nowinjo ma, nowachone Yesu niya, “Ogwedhi ngʼatno mabiro chiemo e nyasi mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: E kindeno Rezin ruodh Aram ne odwogo Elath e lwet Aram koriembo jo-Juda. Bangʼe jo-Edom nodonjo Elath kendo gidak kuno nyaka chil kawuono.
english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

kikuyu: Heman kod Jeduthun to ne tijgi en goyo turumbete kod ongengʼo kod goyo thumbe mamoko mag wend Nyasaye. Yawuot Jeduthun to ne rito rangach.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

kikuyu: Jo-Samaria nokum kuom richogi nikech gisengʼanyo ne Nyasachgi. Noneg-gi gi ligangla; nyithindgi matindo nochwad piny, to mondgi mapek nobar iyegi.”
english: Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”

kikuyu: Kane farese marotekego ne owuok, negidwaro mar dhi e tunge piny koni gi koni. Ne owachonegi niya, “Dhiuru uwuothi e piny koni gi koni!” Omiyo ne giwuok mi gidhi e piny koni gi koni.
english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata mawuotho e adiera donjo e ler, mondo onere maler ni gik motimo duto gin gik ma Nyasaye oyiego.”
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

kikuyu: An kod dhok kod punde, rombe gi diek, jotich machwo kod jotich mamon. Omiyo koro aoro oteni ne ruodha, mondo ayud ngʼwono e wangʼe.’ ”
english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo jo-Israel odak Shitim, chwo nochako terore gi monde jo-Moab,
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

kikuyu: Temuru matek mondo udag gi ji duto gi kwe, kendo mondo ngimau obed maler, nikech ka ngʼato onge gi ngima maler to ok none Ruoth.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

kikuyu: Eka negipenje niya, “Wuonuno nikanye?” Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ukiaya kendo Wuora bende ukia. Ka dine bed ni ungʼeya, to Wuora bende dine ungʼeyo.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

kikuyu: Noneno polo koyawore, kendo ka gimoro machalo gi suka malach moyar iloro piny ka omake gi kondene angʼwen.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

kikuyu: Kane an e chandruok, ne amanyo Ruoth Nyasaye; otieno duto ne arieyo bedena malo ma ok aol, kendo chunya nodagi hoch.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama odak Sayun manowachi niya, “Atuo,” kendo richo mag joma odak kanyo nowenegi.
english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

kikuyu: Ruoth oseoro Zadok jadolo, Nathan janabi, Benaya wuod Jehoyada, gi jo-Kereth kod jo-Peleth mi gikete obedo e punda ruoth,
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno ler kata koyo kata ngʼich ok nobedie.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

kikuyu: “Kel dhood jo-Lawi kendo ichiwgi e nyim jadolo Harun mondo gikonye tich.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

kikuyu: To negidwoke niya, “Wan gima wan-go ka en mana makati abich gi rech ariyo kende.”
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Achiegni chiwo dala maduongʼni ne jo-Babulon kendo ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, ma biro monje kendo kawe.
english: Therefore the LORD says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

kikuyu: eka ochiw Kanisa ne en owuon ka opichni kendo maonge chilo moro, kata jowruok, kata mbala, to obed maler kendo maonge songa kuome.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

kikuyu: Otienono malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye ne owuok mi odhi onego ji alufu mia achiel gi piero aboro gabich e kambi mar jo-Asuria. Kane ji ochiewo gokinyi negiyudo mana ringre joma otho.
english: That night, the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

kikuyu: Gima ne owuoyo kuome ne en Roho, mane joma oyie kuome biro yudo bangʼe. E kindeno Roho ne pok obiro, nikech Yesu ne pok omi duongʼ.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

kikuyu: Osemiyogi rieko mar tiyo tije machalo kaka pecho, goro, chweyo lewni marambulu, maralik, marakwaro kod lewni mayom, ma gin tich joma nigi lony.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

kikuyu: kane aketone tongʼ mage kendo achungone dhorangeye ka keto sirni mage kuonde mowinjore?
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

kikuyu: Un joma wuondoregi! Isaya ne ni kare kane okoro wach kuomu kama:
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

kikuyu: To ne joma osekendo gi joma osekendi achiwonegi chik (chutho ok an, to Ruoth) kama: Dhako kik were gi chwore.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

kikuyu: Enokelgi ne jadolo, eka jadolo nokwong ochiw winyo mar misango mar golo richo. Enomak wiye komino ngʼute, to ok nochode chuth,
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

kikuyu: To Petro nomedo dwongʼo dhoot, kendo kane giyawo dhoot mi ginene, to dhogi nomoko.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

kikuyu: Nochiwo chikegi ne Hilkia jadolo, Ahikam wuod Shafan, Akbor wuod Mikaya, Shafan jagoro kod Asaya jarit mar ruoth kowachonegi niya,
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

kikuyu: Ma e kaka unyalo ngʼeyo Roho mar Nyasaye: Roho ma hulo ni Yesu Kristo nobiro e ringruok en Roho moa kuom Nyasaye,
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

kikuyu: Seth notho ka en ja-higni mia ochiko gi apar gariyo.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

kikuyu: Lok gigi iyudgo pesa mondo imi joma odhier. Dwaruru ofuke magu mikane pesa ma ok yiechi ma en mwandu manie polo ma ok rum kuma jakuo ok chopie kata olwenda ok kethi.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

kikuyu: Okwongʼ, ogandau duto, nikech umaya.”
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

kikuyu: Jo-Amon bende nongʼado Jordan mondo oked gi jo-Juda, jo-Benjamin kod od Efraim; kendo Israel nenie thagruok malich.
english: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

kikuyu: Ked lweny maber mar yie, kendo mak matek wach ngima mochwere mane oluongine chiengʼ mane itimo neno maber e nyim joneno mathoth.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

kikuyu: jaote nobiro ir Saulo, mowacho niya, “Bi piyo! Jo-Filistia osebiro monjo piny.”
english: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Rithma mi gibworo Rimon Perez.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Amalek kod jo-Kanaan mane odak e piny got nolor mwalo mi omonjogi kendo neginegogi duto ma gichopo nyaka Horma.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa notimo kodwa singruok e got Horeb.
english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

kikuyu: Bangʼ timo kamano, noolo pi e karaya bangʼe ochako luoko tiend jopuonjrene, kendo noyweyo tiendegi gi taulo mane oyudo otweyo e nungone.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

kikuyu: To nowachone niya, “Abiro miyi loch mag pinjegi duto gi duongʼ-gi, nimar osemiyagi, kendo anyalo chiwogi ne ngʼato angʼata, madwaro.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

kikuyu: Ajara osechodo chunya kendo aonge gi kar kony. Ne amanyo joma hoya, to ne ok ayudo kata achiel.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

kikuyu: Eka Ben-Hadad nochako ooro ote machielo ni Ahab kowachone niya, “Mad nyiseche timna kata bedi ni en malit machalo nade, ka ok otieko Samaria pep molokore buru.”
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

kikuyu: Ka ja-Lawi odhiyo e dalau moro amora e Israel modakie, kendo obiro gi dembruok kama Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero,
english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which the LORD shall choose,

kikuyu: To nowachona ni, ‘Ibiro mako ich kendo ininywol wuowi. Omiyo koro, kik imadh divai kata gimoro amora mamero ji kendo kik icham chiemo moro amora mogak, nikech wuowino biro bedo ja-Nazir mar Nyasaye kochakore chiengʼ nywolne nyaka thone.’ ”
english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”

kikuyu: To kata kamano, Er wuod Juda maduongʼ ne ngʼama timbene richo ahinya e nyim Jehova Nyasaye; kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nonege.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.

kikuyu: Ka Ruoth Jehoyakim kod jotende duto nowinjo wechege, ruoth ne dwaro mondo onege. To Uria nowinjo ma kendo oringo ka luoro omake nyaka Misri.
english: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.

kikuyu: Ji modak Samaria luoro osemako nikech nyaroya molos gi dhahabu mar Beth Aven. Joge noywage, kamano bende e kaka jodologe malamo nyiseche manono noywage, mago mosebedo gi mor kuom berne nikech osegole kuomgi kitere e twech.
english: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.

kikuyu: Ka wechegi nobiro, ne achamogi; ne gin morna, kendo ilo mar chunya, nimar iluonga gi nyingi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD, God of Armies.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka jadolo osekelo dhakono mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, enogony yie wiye eka noket chiwo mifwenyogo adiera e lwete ma en chiwo mar cham mitiekogo chich. Jadolo to notingʼ pi mar muma mifwenyogo adiera e lwete owuon.
english: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

kikuyu: To kane achwanyora, negichokore kaachiel gi mor; joma ne monja nochokorena sa ma ok angʼeyo, negisiko ka giketho nyinga.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar abiriyo, e dwe mar abiriyo ne en Helez ja-Pelon ma ja-Efraim. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Nyaka ochul nengo mar gima ne ok ochiwo kaluwore gi chike maler, kendo bende omedi achiel kuom abich mar nengono kendo ochiwe duto ne jadolo, mabiro kawo imno kendo otimnego misango mar pwodhruok e ketho eka nowene richone.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Dhout Israel nooro ji e dhout Benjamin duto, kawacho niya, “Mano en tim marach manade mosetim e dieruni?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

kikuyu: Hera nyaka bed mar adier. Beduru mosin gi timbe maricho; padreuru kuom gik mabeyo.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

kikuyu: Koa e ndalo mar kwerewa nyaka chil kawuono, wasebedo joketho ahinya. Nikech richo ma wasetimo, ruodhi mag pinje mamoko osenegowa kaachiel gi ruodhiwa kod jodolo mag-wa kendo giseterowa e twech kendo yako gigewa, mi wasebedo gi wichkuot maduongʼ nyaka chil kawuono.
english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼato kuomgi manodongʼ, nikech anakel masira ne jo-Anathoth e higa manokumgie.’ ”
english: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”

kikuyu: Harun nyaka rwak lawno kotiyo tich dolo. Ywak garago nowinji kodonjo e Kama Ler e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo kowuok mondo kik otho.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.

kikuyu: Kane jodolo madongo gi jodongo odonjone, ne ok odwoko gimoro amora.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny mane oyie kuom Yesu nobiro mohulo richogi e lela.
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ok nowene ngʼatno richone, kendo mirimbe mager nowangʼ ngʼatno ka mach. Kwongʼ duto mondikie kitabuni nomake kendo Jehova Nyasaye noruch nyinge oko e bwo pinyni.
english: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.

kikuyu: Asebiro e puotha, yaye jaherana; asechoko ubani gi modhi madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, asechamo pednina kaachiel kod mor kich mara; kendo asemadho divaina kod chak. Osiepe Yaye osiepena, chiemuru kendo methuru; yaye joherana, methuru ma romu.
english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.

kikuyu: Gik mane oyudo kuom tichne matek obiro weyo kendo ok obi yudo thuolo mar bedo mamor kuom ohala mosechoko.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

kikuyu: Eka nodhi mi owuoyo gi nyakono, kendo nohere.
english: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.

kikuyu: Kik waterre kaka moko kuomgi notimo, mi ji alufu piero ariyo gadek kuomgi notho odiechiengʼ achiel.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

kikuyu: Eka nopenje niya, “Angʼo marach?” To nodwoke niya, “Dhakoni nowachona mondo agol wuoda mondo wacham kawuono to kiny en bende nogol wuode mondo wacham.”
english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

kikuyu: Muma wacho niya, “Ne ok otimo richo kata achiel, kendo onge miriambo mane owuok e dhoge.”
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

kikuyu: Eka ji nowachone Samuel niya, “Ngʼa gini mane penjo ni, ‘Bende Saulo dibed ruodhwa?’ Kelnwagi mondo waneg-gi.”
english: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Abram kane Lut osepogore kode niya, “Tingʼ wangʼi gi kuma in tiere kendo ingʼi yo nyandwat gi yo milambo, yo wuok chiengʼ kod yo podho chiengʼ.
english: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

kikuyu: “Eka jadolo notim misango mar golo richo mondo otimgo pwodhruok ne ngʼat midwa pwodho kuom gakne. Bangʼ mano jadolo noyangʼ chiayo mitimogo misango miwangʼo pep,
english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

kikuyu: mondo otelnegi e gik moko duto ma gitimo kendo oritgi kagiwuok kendo ka gidwogo dala mondo oganda Jehova Nyasaye kik chal gi rombe maonge jokwath.”
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

kikuyu: Babulon ne en kikombe mar dhahabu e lwet Jehova Nyasaye; nomiyo piny duto omer. Ogendini nomadho divai mare; emomiyo koro neko osemakogi.
english: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni pok unene to pod uhere ahera kendo kata obedo ni ok unene kata sani to pod uyie ayiea kuome kendo upongʼ gi mor maduongʼ.
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone joge niya, “Kawuru liganglau!” Omiyo negikawo liganglagi Daudi bende nokawo mare. Ji madirom mia angʼwen nodhi gi Daudi, to mia ariyo nodongʼ karito gigegi.
english: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

kikuyu: E yore, girwako pien gugru; to ewi udi kod laru maduongʼ, giduto giywak ka gidengo kendo gingʼielore e lowo.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

kikuyu: Ibiro bedo ja-adiera ne Jakobo kendo ibiro kecho Ibrahim, kaka ne isingori kikwongʼori ne kwerewa, e ndalo machon.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene nobiro ire mopenje niya, “Angʼo momiyo iwuoyo gi ji gi ngeche?”
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

kikuyu: Negiwuok Elim mi gibworo but Nam Makwar.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Ka dipo ni ne akedo gi le makwiny e dala Efeso mana nikech dwach dhano to ohala mane ma ayudo? Ka joma otho ok chier, to we wachiem kendo wamethi, nikech kiny wanatho.
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

kikuyu: Kamano owetena, un bende, usetho korka chik kuom ringre Kristo, mondo koro ubed jo-ngʼat machielo, ma en Jal mosechier oa kuom joma otho, mondo eka wanyag olemo ne Nyasaye.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

kikuyu: Gima wasewachono medo winjore ka jadolo machielo obiro machalo gi Melkizedek,
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

kikuyu: Enoket lwete ewi chiayono mitimogo misango mar golo richo, kendo enoyangʼe kama itimoe misango miwangʼo pep.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Giga duto gin magi, kendo gigi duto gin maga, kendo aseyudo duongʼ kuomgi.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

kikuyu: E kinde mag higni abiriyo mag yiengʼo, piny nochiek ahinya.
english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

kikuyu: to an to angʼeye nikech ne aa ire, kendo en ema noora.”
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

kikuyu: Yie mondo odak kama ohero e dieru kata e miechu. Kik ukete e tij achune.
english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

kikuyu: “Yie iwene jatichni kethone, nimar Jehova Nyasaye nyaka nomi dhood ruodha loch mosiko, nikech okedo lwenje mag Jehova Nyasaye. Kik iyie ketho moro oyud kuomi kapod ingima.
english: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the LORD’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.

kikuyu: Neuru, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro gi teko, kendo loch ni e lwete. Neuru, obiro gi pok mare, kendo pokne luwo bangʼe.
english: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

kikuyu: To Petro noluwo bangʼe gichien, nyaka notundo e laru mar jadolo maduongʼ. Nodonjo kendo nobet piny kod jorito mondo one ane gima ne biro timore.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

kikuyu: Kuom Yesu Kristo ma Jawarwa Nyasaye noolonwa Roho mogundho,
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

kikuyu: Yore madhiyo Sayun ywagore, nimar onge ngʼato mabiro e nyasi mag sewni moyier. Dhorangeye duto odongʼ nono maonge ji, jodologe ywak ka chur, jotichge ma nyiri okuyo, to en owuon en gi lit malich.
english: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

kikuyu: E kindeno noyudo ka Abner wuod Ner, jatend lwenj Saulo, osekawo Ish-Boseth wuod Saulo motere nyaka Mahanaim.
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro miyou gweth mogundho; ma gin nyithindo mangʼeny, jamni mathoth kod cham mogundho e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osingore kokwongʼore ni kwereu ni nomiu.
english: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

kikuyu: Joma nokwongo dak kendo e kuondegi giwegi kod miechgi ne gin jo-Israel moko, jodolo, jo-Lawi kod jotij hekalu.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

kikuyu: Ler duto marieny e polo anami lokreni mudho; anakel mudho mondo oum pinyi, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Jodolo madongo gi jopuonj mag chik nochungo kanyono, ka gidonjone mager ahinya.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

kikuyu: Kik uwach ni, ‘Ngʼatni riek motamo wangʼwa, Nyasaye ema mondo okwere, to ok dhano!’
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼato angʼata motamore winjo puonjni ok otamore winjo dhano, to otamore winjo Nyasaye owuon mamiyou Roho Maler.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ migeroe ohinga mare biro chopo, en odiechiengʼ manoyarie tongʼni.
english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

kikuyu: Andikonu kaachiel gi jowete duto man koda, Un kanisa mar jo-Galatia.
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

kikuyu: Jopuonjre notimo kamano kendo giduto negibedo piny.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

kikuyu: Joash nowachone jodolo niya, “Chokuru pesa duto mokel kaka chiwo mag pwodhruok e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye; pesa moyudi e kwano ji, pesa moyudi e singruok mar ngʼato e ngimane kod pesa ma ngʼato ochiwo kuom hero mare owuon.
english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,

kikuyu: Obiro chalo gi koth machwe e lum mongʼadi maber kendo gi kodh ajiki mamiyo piny ngʼich.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

kikuyu: Onge ruoth moro kata achiel mane odwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye kaluwore gi chike duto mag Musa gi chunye duto gi ngimane duto kod tekone duto machalo gi Josia.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

kikuyu: Koso ichayo ngʼwonone mogundho, ber mare kod horuokne? Donge ingʼeyo ni Nyasaye ngʼwononi mondo omiyi thuolo mar lokruok mondo iwe richo?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjo ja-Farisai kod joma olony e chik ni, “En gima owinjore gi chik mondo ochang ngʼato chiengʼ Sabato koso?”
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

kikuyu: To humb Yesu ne olandore e alwora duto kuonde mokiewo gi gwengʼ mane entie.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Negiloso pasiago gi law mayom momin mar range marambulu, maralik kod marakwaro moketie kido mar malaika mar kerubi kogorie gi jagoro molony.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Nimar ngʼato angʼata matimo dwaro mar Wuora manie polo e owadwa gi nyaminwa kod minwa.”
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Puonja yoreni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo eka awuothi e adierani; miya chuny ma ok ba koni gi koni, mondo omi aluor nyingi.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

kikuyu: Adiera, jogo duto moramo mondo odhi odag Misri noneg gi ligangla, kech kod masira maonge ngʼato angʼata ma notony e chandruok mabiro kelo kuomgi.’
english: So will it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence. None of them will remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.’

kikuyu: Yaye, mano kaka ahero chikni! Aparo kuome odiechiengʼ duto.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gaboro mar loch Jeroboam wuod Nebat, Abija nobedo ruodh Juda,
english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

kikuyu: kendo negiwacho ka giramo niya, “Ngʼatni nowacho ni, ‘Anyalo muko hekalu mar Nyasayeni mi achak agere kendo bangʼ ndalo adek.’ ”
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

kikuyu: Wan kaka jotich Nyasaye wanyisore e yore mangʼeny kaka: dhil maduongʼ, sandruok, chandruok kod masiche;
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

kikuyu: Koro chiengʼ chier dhakoni nobed chi ngʼa, nimar ji abiriyogo nokende?”
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Musa norieyo bade e nam kendo ka piny ne oyawore, to nonwangʼo ka pi osedok e wangʼe. Jo-Misri ne ringo kochomo dier nam, kendo Jehova Nyasaye noywerogi gi pi nyaka ei namno.
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

kikuyu: Negiwuoyo kendgi kuom gik moko duto mosetimore.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

kikuyu: To negidwoko niya, “Ok wamadh divai, nikech kwarwa Jehonadab wuod Rekab nomiyowa chikni: ‘Un kata nyikwau ok onego madh divai.
english: But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, neither you nor your children, forever.

kikuyu: to Yesu nochango ji mathoth mane nigi kit tuoche mayoreyore. Bende noriembo jochiende oa kuom ji, to ne ok oyiene jochiendego mondo owuo nikech negingʼeyo ni en ngʼa.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nodak e kind jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus.
english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

kikuyu: Omiyo noyangʼ rwedhigo mi jodolo nokawo remo mokiro e kendo mar misango, bangʼe ne giyangʼo imbe mine gikawo remo ma gikiro e kendo mar misango.
english: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

kikuyu: Koro ne gin e yo gidhi Jerusalem, ka Yesu otelo nyimgi kendo jopuonjre noyudo ohum nono, to joma ne luwogi ne luoro omako. Yesu nochako okawo jopuonjre apar gariyo otero tenge monyisogi gima ne dhi timorene.
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

kikuyu: Nimar kuoma ndalogi biro bedo mangʼeny, kendo rieko biro medo hiki.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

kikuyu: Wanyalo wacho ni Chik mane Nyasaye ochiwo ogwenyore gi singruok ma notimo gi joge koso? Ooyo, ok nyal bet kamano. Nimar kapo ni Chik mane ochiwno ne nyalo chiwo ngima to mano nyiso ni Chik ne nyalo miyo dhano bedo kare.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

kikuyu: Aa malo mondo ikonywa; reswa nikech herani ma ok rem.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar abich gokinyi, kane ochungo mondo odhi, jaduongʼne nowachone niya, “Bed mamor. Rit nyaka odhiambo!” Omiyo ji ariyogo nochiemo kanyakla.
english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel duto ne odhi e piny jo-Filistia mondo opiag kuegi, saruru, ledhi kod musmeno mar ngʼado lum.
english: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gima ne osechano; osechopo mano mane owacho, ma en gima nochiko chon. Osetieki ma ok odewo, kendo osemiyo wasigu goyoni siboi, komedogi teko.
english: The LORD has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

kikuyu: Nywok achiel chiwne Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mar pwodhruok kimedo gi misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile kod misango miolo piny michiwego.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Kik iyie gitony kata matin nikech richo mag-gi, dwok ogendini piny, yaye Nyasaye, gi mirimbi;
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

kikuyu: Gimalo ne nitie ndiko mondik mane nyiso kethone niya: Ma en Yesu, ma Ruodh Jo-Yahudi.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeremia nokawo kitabu machielo kendo omiye Baruk wuod Neria jandik muma, kendo kaka Jeremia ne ohulo, Baruk nondiko e kitabuno weche duto mar kitabu mane Jehoyakim ruodh Juda nosewangʼo e mach kendo weche mangʼeny machalre nomed kuomgi.
english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.

kikuyu: Yesu noa kanyo modhi dalagi kaachiel gi jopuonjrene.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Wuogi e kambi kendo iwuoth kichomo bungu man e gode mag jo-Amor, dhi e miech ji duto mokiewo gi Araba, jogo modak e gode, jogo modak e tie gode man yo podho chiengʼ, jogo modak Negev kod mago modak e dho nam, kaachiel gi jogo modak e piny Kanaan kod Lebanon, nyaka chop e aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: To odiechiengno en mar Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma en odiechiengʼ, ma ochuloe kuor ni wasike. Ligangla noneki nyaka owinj ni orome, kendo nyaka otiek riyo mare gi remo. Nimar Ruoth, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, nochiw misango e piny mantie yo nyandwat but Aora Yufrate.
english: For that day is of the Lord, GOD of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Adiera, ok ahero jogo makoro lek mag miriambo. Ginyisogi kendo giwito joga gi miriambo mag-gi maonge korgi gi atachgi, to ne ok aorogi kata yierogi. Ok gimi jogi ohala kata matin,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says the LORD, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Wuon Chik ma bende en Jangʼad bura en achiel kende. En ema onyalo reso kata nego ngʼato. In to in ngʼa mondo ingʼad ni nyawadu bura?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

kikuyu: Chwe chuny maler e iya, yaye Nyasaye, kendo los chuny motegno mosiko koluori iket e iya.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kikuyu: Ne iwaro jogi gi badi maratego, jogi ma nyikwa Jakobo gi Josef. Sela
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

kikuyu: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naama kod Makeda. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gauchiel.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Noyiero jodolo mage mag kuonde motingʼore kendo mondo odolne nyiseche manono manoloso e kit diel gi nyaroya.
english: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Maskil mar yawuot Kora. Yaye Nyasaye, wasewinjo gi itwa; kendo kwerewa osenyisowa, gik mane itimo e ndalogi, ndalo machon gi lala.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

kikuyu: Obiro chulogi nikech richogi kendo obiro tiekogi nikech timbegi maricho; Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa biro tiekogi.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

kikuyu: Chunywa ne pok oa moweyi; kendo tiendewa ne pok okier moweyo yori.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kikuyu: Kane chiengʼ osepodho, Joshua nogolo chik mondo olor ringregi e yiende mane oliergie kendo odirgi e rogo kama negisepondoe. Negidino dho rogono gi kite madongo, ma pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

kikuyu: To nokwergi ni kik giketh lum manie piny kata gimoro mangʼich kata yien, to ginyalo mana hinyo jogo maonge gi kido mar Nyasaye e lela wengegi.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

kikuyu: to ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuom ruoth mobet e kom duongʼ mar Daudi kod jogo duto modongʼ e dala maduongʼni, jopinyu mane ok odhi kodu e twech;
english: the LORD says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,

kikuyu: To Joab ne ok okwano jo-Lawi kod jo-Benjamin nikech nosin gi chik ruoth.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

kikuyu: Omiyo Adam nochako jamni duto nying, gi winy manie kor polo kod le duto manie thim. Kata kamano Adam ne onge gi jakony mowinjore kode.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

kikuyu: Nikech kwer misekwerogigo, yaye Nyasach Jakobo omiyo faras gi gari moywayo ochungʼ kar tiendegi.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno moyudo dhako onwangʼo gima ber kendo oyudo ngʼwono moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

kikuyu: Oganda mag ji mathoth moa e mier mokiewo gi Jerusalem bende nokelo jogi matuo gi joma jochiende sando, kendo jogo duto nochangi.
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

kikuyu: to Saulo nofwenyo wachno. Odiechiengʼ gotieno ne gibutone e rangeye mag dala maduongʼ mondo gimake apoya ginege,
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Obiro chwero mach maliel mager kod salfa kuom joma timbegi richo; yamo maliet ha matwoyo gik moko, biro kudhogi.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

kikuyu: Nyaka chakre ndalo kwereu uselokoru uweyo yorega, kendo pok uritogi. Dwoguru ira to anaduog iru.” “To upenjo ni, ‘Ere kaka dwaduog iri?’
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

kikuyu: To ne nitie dhako ma chwore otho moro e dalano manobedo kadhiyo ire pile giywakne kakwaye ni, ‘Yie ingʼadna bura e kinda gi ngʼat ma hinyani!’
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

kikuyu: Enoket rombe e bade korachwich, to diek e bade koracham.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

kikuyu: Jakobo nodwoke niya, “Kuong iusna duongʼni mar nywol.”
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

kikuyu: Mapiyo piyo ka Jezebel nowinjo ni Naboth osego gi kite motho, nonyiso Ahab niya, “Aa malo mondo ikaw puoth mzabibu mar Naboth ja-Jezreel, mane odagi usoni, ok ongima, osetho.”
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Samuel niya, “Ne adhi timo gimoro e Israel mabiro miyo ji duto mowinjo itgi nosakni.
english: The LORD said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

kikuyu: To Jakony, ma en Roho Maler, ma Wuora biro oro e nyinga, biro puonjou weche duto, kendo obiro paronu gik moko duto ma asenyisou.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

kikuyu: singruok mane okwongʼorego ne kwarwa Ibrahim:
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

kikuyu: Nitie gimoro achiel ma Nyasaye osewacho, chutho nitie gik moko ariyo ma asewinjo gi ita: ni in, yaye Nyasaye, in ratego,
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nokelo Jakobo wuon mare kendo okete e nyim Farao. Ka Jakobo nosegwedho Farao,
english: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

kikuyu: To Daudi nomedo wuotho ka twenyo got mar Zeituni kowuotho gi tiende nono, koumo wiye kendo oywak. Ji duto mane ni kode bende noumo wigi, to gin bende ne giywak ka gitwenyo got.
english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

kikuyu: ni ok initimnwa marach mana kaka wan bende ne ok watimoni marach to ne wariti maber mi wagoli gi kwe mondo idhi. To koro Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhi.”
english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Joma ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye chalo gi Got Sayun, ma ok nyal yiengi to osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

kikuyu: “Dwolno moa e polo nowuoyo koda kendo nyadiriyo kawachona ni, ‘Kik iluong gimoro amora ma Nyasaye osepwodho ni ok ler.’
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano mor mar tiende farese nowinji kachikore gi teko mangʼeny.
english: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.

kikuyu: Kik itim marach ni jatich mabiro tiyoni kata obed ja-Israel wadu kata japiny moro manie gwengʼu kata dalau.
english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

kikuyu: To ka chunyu odagi ma ok uchiwo luor kendo ka uwuok ma ukuloru ne nyiseche mamoko mi ulamogi,
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

kikuyu: nikech wengene okwako tungʼ piny gi tungʼ piny kendo oneno gimoro amora manie bwo polo.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

kikuyu: kendo ok odew ni gimoro kata le mar bungu nyalo nyonogi mi gitore.
english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nowuok Rameses kochomo Sukoth; ne gin ji madirom alufu mia auchiel ka ok okwan mon kod nyithindo.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

kikuyu: Ratege mag law akor nyaka twe e ratege mag law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi tol marambulu, kiriwe gi okanda manie nungone mondo law akor kik gonyre.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

kikuyu: Polo gi piny norum to wechena ok norum ngangʼ.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

kikuyu: Gibiro chamo misengini mag cham, misengini mag golo richo kod misengini mag pwodhruok; kendo gimoro amora manie piny Israel mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye nobed margi.
english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

kikuyu: “Kata kamano, kata obedo ni gin e piny wasikgi, to ka anawitgi kendo ok anajwangʼ-gi kata tiekogi chuth, mi aketh singruok mane atimo kodgi. An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Magi duto atimo nikech wach Injili, mondo an bende ayud gweth kuom Injilino.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

kikuyu: Kane kinde ochopo mar pwodhruok kaka Chik mar Musa nochopo, Josef gi Maria notere Jerusalem mondo gichiwe ne Ruoth Nyasaye
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

kikuyu: gi otenga kod kit otenga duto, gi okun-okun,
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

kikuyu: Ogendini duto nolwora koni gi koni, to ne atiekogi e nying Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Gari nobiro nyaka e puoth Joshua ma ja-Beth Shemesh, modhi mochungʼ but lwanda maduongʼ. Ji nobaro yiend gari mi gichiwo dwesnigo ka misango miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Nikech fup Nyasaye riek moloyo rieko dhano, kendo nyawo mare otegno moloyo teko dhano.
