english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua noketo winjruok mar kwe kodgi mondo oyienegi gidag kodgi, kendo jotelo ne opwodho ma ka gikwongʼore.
english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

kikuyu: ket yoreni duto kuome eka nomi yoregi oriere tir.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

kikuyu: Josia nogolo gik makwero mag nyiseche manono e piny jo-Israel duto kendo nomiyo ji duto modak e piny Israel otiyo ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachgi. E ndalo duto mag ngimane ji ne ok oweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi.
english: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

kikuyu: Ne oketho Tofeth mane ni e holo man Ben Hinom, mondo omi kik ngʼato ne ti kode kuom timo misango mar wuode kata nyare e mach ne Molek.
english: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

kikuyu: To koro un jogo duto ma jomok mach kendo moko mirni maliel, dhiuru mondo uwuothi e ler mar mach mumoko kata e ligek mach musemoko. Ma e gima udhi yudo e lweta: Ubiro rieru piny gi rem malit.
english: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.

kikuyu: Jo-Kush gi Jo-Misri e kama nonwangʼie teko ma ok rum; jo-Put gi jo-Libya ne gin pinje kuom moko mane konye.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

kikuyu: Joma ne oyude ka omodo yien nokele ir Musa gi Harun kod chokruok duto,
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Asher nomigi, Mishal, Abdon,
english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Eka wabiro miyou nyiwa kendo wan bende wabiro kawo nyiu. Wabiro dak kodu kendo wabiro bedo oganda achiel.
english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

kikuyu: Yesu noa kanyo modhi e gwengʼ mar Turo. Nodonjo e ot moro kendo ne ok odwar mondo ngʼato ongʼe ni en kanyo, kata kamano, bedone kanyo ne ok nyal tamo ji ngʼeyo.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Mad Jehova Nyasaye dwoki ka in e chandruok; mad nying Nyasach Jakobo riti.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

kikuyu: To kaka nomedo paro ndalo mane otin, kinde mane en ochot e piny Misri, e kaka nomedo donjo matut e chode.
english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ngʼato achiel biro lawo ji alufu achiel, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kedonu, mana kaka ne osingonu.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

kikuyu: Neye kuyo manie chunya kod rem ma an-go, kendo gol richona duto.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

kikuyu: Zanoa, En Ganim, Tapua, Enam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

kikuyu: Nonuru ane kaka piny ma gidakieno chalo, ka ober kata orach? Nonuru ane mier ma gidakie nichalo nade, ochielgi koso ok ochielgi?
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

kikuyu: Ibrahim nonyiso Abimelek chandruok mar soko mar pi ma jotich Abimelek nomaye githuon.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

kikuyu: Neuru, atimo gimoro manyien! Koro osechako timore, bende unene? Aloso yo e piny motimo ongoro kendo aketo aore kuonde mojwangʼ.
english: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

kikuyu: Onge gimoro amora mane olal bed ni en ngʼama tin kata ngʼama duongʼ, wuowi kata nyako, gik mane ope kata gik mane gikawo, Daudi nodwoko gik moko duto.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

kikuyu: Yawuot Lawi ne gin: Gershon, Kohath kod Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: To ka ok ichiwori ne jotend ruodh Babulon, dala maduongʼni nomi jo-Babulon kendo giniwangʼe; un uwegi ok unutony e lwetgi.’ ”
english: But if you will not go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you won’t escape out of their hand.’”

kikuyu: Kane gichokore kaachiel Galili, nowachonegi niya, “Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi keti e lwet ji.
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

kikuyu: Jomoko kuomu sunga omako, mana ka gima ok abi biro iru.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

kikuyu: Emomiyo horeuru mos, jowetena, nyaka chop Ruoth duogi. Neuru kaka japur rito puothe mondo onyagne cham mokonyorego, kendo kaka ohore mos korito kodh opon gi kodh chwiri.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

kikuyu: Koro parane ni onywomgi gi chwo moa e dhout jo-Israel mamoko; to pokgi nogol kuom pok mar kwerewa, mi med libamba mane onywomogi. Omiyo bath pok marwa nomawa.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

kikuyu: Richo gi ketho adi ma asetimo? Nyisa kethona gi richona.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

kikuyu: Abiro kelo nyikwa joka Jakobo kendo joka Juda, jogo manokaw godena; ee joga mogen ma jotichna nokaw pinyno mi gidagie.
english: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.

kikuyu: Aseketo lihudu mara e boche polo, kendo obiro bedo ranyisi mar singruok e kinda kod piny.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

kikuyu: Nyithindu manobi bangʼu to gi jopinje moa mabor none kit kwongʼ duto modonjo e piny kod tuoche mayoreyore ma Jehova Nyasaye osekelo kuomgi.
english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,

kikuyu: kod joma wacho ni joga niya, “Nyasaye mondo oreti, kendo otim gima odwaro timo, mondo wanene. We gima Jal Maler mar Israel dwaro timo otimre mondo wangʼeye.”
english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

kikuyu: Ngʼat madiemo wangʼe giwuond kelo kuyo, to ngʼat mofuwo ma wachne ngʼeny dhi e kethruok.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: to chiembe biro lokore makech gie iye; obiro lokore kwiri marach mag thuonde madongo manie iye.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

kikuyu: Jarha nokendo nyar Sheshan kendo nonywolone Atai.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

kikuyu: Gima aseneno en ni joma chwoyo richo gi chandruok kayo mana richo.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

kikuyu: Bangʼ tho Jehoyada, jotend jo-Juda nobiro mondo olim ruoth mi nowinjogi.
english: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.

kikuyu: Eka ne giyie gi singruok mage kendo ne gipake gi wer.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

kikuyu: Koro lingʼuru mondo uparane: Bende dichwo nyalo nywolo nyithindo? To kare angʼo momiyo aneno dichwo ka dichwo maratego, komako iye ka dhako mamuoch kayo, ka luoro omakogi ka joma chiegni tho?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?

kikuyu: mondo mi ousna bure man Makpela manie giko puothe. Kwayeuru mondo ousnago e nengo mowinjore mondo obed kara mar yiko.”
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Benaya nodonjo e Hemb Jehova Nyasaye kendo nowacho ni Joab niya, “Ruoth wacho ni, ‘Wuog oko!’ ” To nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, abiro mana tho ka.” Benaya nodwoko wach Joab ni ruoth.
english: Benaiah came to the LORD’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”

kikuyu: Kane dhano ochako medore e piny, kendo onywolonegi nyiri,
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

kikuyu: “Pacha chuna ni nyaka adwoki nikech gima iwacho chando chunya.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nodhi mondo otine japiny moro, mi ngʼatno nokete jakwa anguro.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

kikuyu: Omiyo ngʼat man-gi yie mayomyomni ma Kristo nothoneno koro kethore mana nikech rieko miwachogo ni iriek.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

kikuyu: Yawuot Zebulun ne gin: Sered, Elon kod Jalel.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

kikuyu: Kuom mano koro waweuru puonj michakogo ngʼeyo wach Kristo, to wadhiuru nyime mondo wadok joma otegno. Ok owinjore mondo wachak puonjou manyien weche michakogo bedo ja-Kristo, kaka lokruok weyo timbe matero ji e tho to gi yie kuom Nyasaye;
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

kikuyu: Ibrahim nodwoke niya, “Wuoda, Nyasaye owuon ema biro chiwo nyaim mar misango miwangʼo pep.” Bangʼ mano negidhi nyime giwuodhgi kanyakla.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

kikuyu: Ne ogero Kama Ler Moloyo kendo borne ne romo gi lach hekalu, borne gi lachne ne en fut piero ariyo gochiko gi nus. Ne omuono iye gi dhahabu maler ma pekne romo kilo alufu piero ariyo.
english: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

kikuyu: nyikwa Ater (kowuok e dhood Hezekia) ji piero ochiko gaboro (98),
english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

kikuyu: Eka Josef nochako oleko lek machielo, kendo nowacho ne owetene lekno. Nowachonegi niya, “Winjuru lek machielo manyoro aleko ni wangʼ chiengʼ gi dwe kod sulwe apar gachiel kulorena.”
english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

kikuyu: Ewi mago meduru nywok achiel kaka chiwo mar pwodhruok e richo, kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile mar cham kaachiel gi misango miolo piny.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Eka bangʼe Juda nooro osiepne ma ja-Adulam gi nyadiel mondo mi oduogne gige mane Tamar odhigodo, to osiepne ne ok oyudo Tamar.
english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

kikuyu: Omiyo negikawo Jeremia ma giketo e bur mar Malkija, wuod ruoth, mane nitiere e laru mar jarito. Ne giloro Jeremia gi tonde ei burno; ne onge pi e iye, chwodho ema ne nitie, kendo Jeremia nonimo ei chwodho.
english: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

kikuyu: Ne opuonju mondo uwe kit ngimau machon kendo ulony dhano machon makelo kethruok nikech gombo maricho mag wuond.
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

kikuyu: Ngʼwono kod kwe mogundho obed kodu kumedo ngʼeyo Nyasaye kod Yesu ma Ruodhwa.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

kikuyu: Ka noa kanyo, Yesu nodhi nyaka e gwengʼ mar Turo gi Sidon.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

kikuyu: Hazael nodhi romo kod Elisha kotingʼo mich mar mwandu motingʼ gi ngamia piero angʼwen ma gin gik mabeyo mag piny Damaski. Nodhi ir Elisha mochungʼ e nyime mowachone niya, “Wuodi ma Ben-Hadad ruodh Aram oora mondo apenji ka bende obiro chango kuom tuoni.”
english: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

kikuyu: Hezekia ne ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero ariyo gochiko. Min mare ne nyinge Abija nyar Zekaria.
english: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

kikuyu: Kane Arauna ogoyo wangʼe moneno ruoth gi joge kabiro ire, nowuok mokulore e nyim ruoth nyaka e lowo.
english: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Negigero kuonde motingʼore gi malo ne Baal e Holo mar Ben Hinom mondo gitim misango gi yawuotgi kod nyigi ne Molek, kata kamano ne ok amiyogi chik mar timo kamano, kata mano ne onge e pacha niginyalo timo gima mono kamano kendo gimi Juda tim richo.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”

kikuyu: Gin duto gin gi paro achiel kendo ginichiw tekogi kod lochgi ni ondiek malichno.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

kikuyu: Kaponi en chiayo mogak ma ok nyal timgo misango ni Jehova Nyasaye, to noware e nengo mogone, komedo achiel ewi abich mar nengone. Kaponi ok oware to nyaka ngʼiewe mana e nengo moketi.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

kikuyu: Musa gi Harun notimo honnigi duto e nyim Farao, to Jehova Nyasaye noketo chunye omedo bedo matek mine ok onyal weyo jo-Israel dhi koa e pinye.
english: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.

kikuyu: Koro miuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu duongʼ, kendo utim dwarone. Thegreuru gi joma ni butu kod mondeu mag dhoudi mamoko.”
english: Now therefore make confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

kikuyu: Ka japur puro puodho mondo okom to bende osiko ka opuro apura? Koso bende osiko ka obuso abusa?
english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

kikuyu: Kamano bende, ngʼat mane omi talanta ariyo noyudo ariyo ewi mane omiye.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

kikuyu: Kane gichako goye mondo ginege, wach nochopo ni jatend lweny mar jo-Rumi, ni dala Jerusalem duto otimo koko.
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachone Sairas, ngʼate moseyiero niya, “Asemako lweti ma korachwich, mondo ilo ogendini manie nyimi, kendo iketh teko mag ruodhi gigegi mag lweny, mondo iyaw dhoudi e nyime maonge dhorangeye mibiro lor.
english: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

kikuyu: To awachonu ni chiengʼ ngʼado bura ji duto biro dwoko wach kuom weche manono ma gisewacho ka ok giparo matut.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

kikuyu: Jodolo nokawo keregi kaachiel gi jo-Lawi ka goyo thumbe mag Jehova Nyasaye mane ruoth Daudi nolosone pako Jehova Nyasaye kendo mane itiyogo kane odwoko erokamano kowacho niya, “Herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.” Jodolo mane ochungʼ momanyore gi jo-Lawi ne goyo turumbete ka jo-Israel duto nochungʼ.
english: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to give thanks to the LORD, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

kikuyu: Gichano timo ne jogi marach lingʼ-lingʼ; giloso chenro maricho ne joma chunyi ohero.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

kikuyu: Notera nyangu chiengʼ mar aboro bangʼ nywolna kendo an ja-Israel gitiende monywol e dhood Benjamin, bende an ja-Hibrania ma wuod jo-Hibrania. Korka luwo Chik jo-Yahudi to ne an ja-Farisai,
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

kikuyu: Omiyo Kristo bende ne ok okawo duongʼ mar bedo jadolo maduongʼ kende owuon. To Nyasaye nowachone niya, “In Wuoda, kawuono asedoko Wuonu.”
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

kikuyu: Ungʼeyo kaka asetiyo ne wuonu gi tekra duto.
english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

kikuyu: Chutho, Herode gi Pontio Pilato noromo e dalani kod joma ok jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi jo-Israel mondo gilos yor hinyo Jatichni Maler ma isewiro, ma en Yesu.
english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

kikuyu: Nikech misach richo en tho, to mich mar Nyasaye en ngima mochwere kuom Kristo Yesu Ruodhwa.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Abiro paki kapod angima, kendo abiro tingʼo bedena malo e nyingi.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

kikuyu: Timuru gik moko duto e yo mowinjore kendo mochanore.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech ober; kendo herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: En ema noger ot ni nyinga kendo anagur lochne osik nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ok datim ma ngangʼ! Donge ma en remb joma nodhi ka ok odewo ngimagi?” Kendo Daudi ne ok omodho pigno. Mago e gik mane thuondi adekgo otimo.
english: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kikuyu: nikech mano nyalo miyo jasika wach niya, “Aseloye,” kendo wasika biro bedo mamor ka apodho.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

kikuyu: Ne watweyo cham manie puodho eka apoya nono wi cham mane asetweyo nochungʼ tir, ka wiye chambu olworo wi chamba kendo okulorene.”
english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

kikuyu: ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: Achiegni loko gige lweny manie lwetugo mondo ogou, magin mago mutiyogo mondo ukedgo gi ruodh Babulon kod jo-Babulon mantiere oko mar ohinga. Kendo anachokgi duto ei dala maduongʼni.
english: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

kikuyu: Kane Musa owinjo wachno, nopodho piny auma.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

kikuyu: Kane Musa odonjo e Hemb Romo mondo owuo gi Jehova Nyasaye, nowinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye kawuoyo kode koa e kind kerubi ariyo manie wi raum mar Sandug Muma mar Singruok. Kendo Musa nowuoyo kode.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato kuomu nigi chandruok, to onego olem. Ka ngʼato kuomu nigi mor, to onego ower wende pak.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

kikuyu: Ruoth nyaka ngʼeni, jo-Yahudi mane obiro irwa koa iri osedhi Jerusalem kendo gisechako gero dala maduongʼ mane ongʼanyo kendo ma timbene mono. Gisechako gero ohinga mane osemukore kendo to bende giloso mise mage.
english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre mane ni Antiokia nodongʼ kopongʼ gi mor kod Roho Maler.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Negiwacho kamano nikech jodolo madongo gi jo-Farisai ne osegolo chik ni ngʼato angʼata mongʼeyo kuma Yesu nitie nyaka ternegi wach mondo gidhi gimake.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

kikuyu: nikech ne ok giromonu e yo gi makati kod pi kane uwuok Misri, kendo negichulo Balaam wuod Beor modak Pethor manie Aram-Naharaim nengo mondo okwongʼu.
english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

kikuyu: Kata ka bed ni ne unyalo loyo jolwenj Babulon duto ma biro monjou kendo chwo mohiny kende ema odongʼ e hembegi, giniwuogi oko kendo giwangʼ dala maduongʼni.”
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”

kikuyu: Hera umo weche duto, osiko oyie ayieya, osiko ogeno agena, kendo osiko odhil adhila.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nying Jehova Nyasaye ibiro hul e Sayun, ibiro pake e Jerusalem,
english: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Thuma mar nyatiti olokore gir kuyo, kendo asili mara olokore gir dengo.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka tiengʼno duto noseyweyo kod kweregi, tiengʼ machielo nochako dongo, mane ok ongʼeyo Jehova Nyasaye kata gima nosetimone jo-Israel.
english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

kikuyu: eka isik kingʼeyo pogo tiend weche kendo dhogi norit rieko.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

kikuyu: Kapo ni Injili mwayalo ogengʼore, to ogengʼore mana ni joma olal.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

kikuyu: kawuru gik moko mokwongo nyak e puotheu e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kendo oketgi ei okapu. Bangʼe dhiuru kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yiero mondo nyinge obedie
english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

kikuyu: Daudi nodhi Nob ir Ahimelek jadolo. Ahimelek nokirni kane oromo kode mopenjo niya, “Angʼo momiyo in kendi? Angʼo momiyo ngʼato ok obiro kodi?”
english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka ohinga ne oseger kendo ne aserwako dhoudi kuonde mowinjore, ne ayiero jorit dhorangeye gi jower kod jo-Lawi.
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

kikuyu: Mad giwer kuom yore mag Jehova Nyasaye, nimar duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ngʼongo.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

kikuyu: Hezekia nochiko mondo otim misango miwangʼo pep e kendo mar misango. Kane chiwo misango ochakore, wer ne Jehova Nyasaye bende nochakore ka gigoyo turumbete kod thumbe mag Daudi ruodh Israel.
english: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the LORD’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

kikuyu: gi Ishmaya ja-Gibeon, ngʼat maratego kuom thuondi piero adek, ma bende ne en jatelo mar thuondi piero adek, kod Jeremia gi Jahaziel gi Johanan gi Jozabad ma ja-Gedera,
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

kikuyu: Kane obiro kapok okendo, to nodog kende; to kane obiro ka osekendo, to nodog gi chiegeno.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

kikuyu: Nogoyo ngeche alufu adek kendo wende mane owero noromo alufu achiel gi abich.
english: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

kikuyu: Abiro golo nyinge mag Baal oa e dhoge. Nying Baal ok nochak owuo kuomgi kendo.
english: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.

kikuyu: E higano mane Sargon ruodh Asuria nooro jatend lweny maduongʼ, nodhi Ashdod mi omonje kendo okawe,
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “Ma e gima Hezekia wacho: Odiechiengni en odiechieng kuyo, siem kod wichkuot machalo gi nyithindo ma ndalogi mar nywol osechopo to onge teko minywologigo.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

kikuyu: To Joash nodwoko oganda mager mane ni bute niya, “Un ema uwuoyo e lo Baal? Utemo rese? Ngʼato angʼata mokedone enonege gokinyi! Ka Baal en nyasaye, to onyalo resore kende owuon kuom ngʼama muko kendone mar misango.”
english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia nolawo Saulo gi yawuote matek ma neginego yawuote magin Jonathan, Abinadab kod Malki-Shua.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Kaachiel kuomgi olwar ei agulu, gik moko duto man ei aguluno nobed mogak, kendo nyaka uto aguluno.
english: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

kikuyu: Obiro tweyo pundane e kor mzabibu, enotue nyathi pundane e mzabibu moyier; kendo obiro luoko lepe gi divai makwar.
english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

kikuyu: Nopenjo niya, “Gik mage?” Negidwoko niya, “Kuom Yesu ma ja-Nazareth. Ne en janabi, maratego e wach gi tim e nyim Nyasaye kod ji duto.
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

kikuyu: Eka mondo waom Sandug Muma mar Nyasachwa ma wakel ka nikech ne ok wamanye e kinde loch Saulo.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: Omiyo in bende ok initony, in mingʼado bura ni ngʼat machielo, nikech gima ingʼadonego ngʼat machielo burano ema bura loyigo iwuon, nikech in mingʼado bura bende itimo gik machalre gi gima otimo.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth omiyo Paulo thuolo mondo owach kore, Paulo nodwoko niya, “Angʼeyo ni kuom higni mangʼeny isebedo jangʼad bura e pinywani, omiyo amor mar wuoyo e nyimi kuom wechegi.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

kikuyu: “Wachne kanyakla mar oganda kama: ‘Daruru uwuog machiegni gi hembe Kora, Dathan kod Abiram.’ ”
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

kikuyu: Eka Samson noywak ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, para! Yaye Nyasaye, duogna teko mana dichiel kende mondo achulgo kuor kuom jo-Filistia-gi kuom toko wengena ariyo oko.”
english: Samson called to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

kikuyu: Pakuru Nyasaye e dier chokruok maduongʼ; pakuru Jehova Nyasaye e dier chokruok mar jo-Israel.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

kikuyu: Omiyo koro dwoka ane kinyalo; kendo iikri maber mar choma tir.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

kikuyu: Awuoyo kodu kaka joma parogi nikare, omiyo paruru matut tiend wach ma awachonuno.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

kikuyu: mowachone niya, “Mad ruodha kik kwana ka jaketho. Kik ipar kaka jatichni notimo marach chiengʼ ma ruodha ma en ruoth nowuok Jerusalem. Mad ruoth wiye wil.
english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

kikuyu: “Kik iwuo marach kuom jatich ne ngʼat mondike nono to obiro kwongʼi, mi iyud chandruok.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

kikuyu: Ka wawacho ni pok watimo richo to wamiyo odoko ja-miriambo kendo wachne onge gi thuolo e ngimawa.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kute duto mafuyo kendo mawuotho gi tiende angʼwen nobednu gik makwero.
english: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

kikuyu: tiende ni, mondo un kod an wajiwre ngʼato gi ngʼato e yie marwa, ka ajiwou to un bende ujiwa.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

kikuyu: Bende joma timo timbe maricho dipuonjre adier? Gin joma kidho joga kaka ji chamo kuon; kendo gin joma ok luong Nyasaye mondo okonygi.
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

kikuyu: mad duongʼ makende, gi loch gi teko, kod nyalo odogne Nyasaye Jawarwa kuom Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa, e tienge duto, sani kendo nyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Juda nobed kama ji odakie nyaka chiengʼ kendo Jerusalem bende tienge gi tienge.
english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Balaam niya, “Dhiyo adhiya gi jogi, to iwach mana gima awachoni.” Omiyo Balaam nodhi gi jodong Balak.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

kikuyu: Koa kuom Mali noyier Eliazar mane ok onywolo yawuowi.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, jowetewa, chunguru motegno, kendo makuru matek puonj mane wapuonjou gi dhowa kata gi barupewa.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

kikuyu: Ka nitie joma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore, to ji ariyo kata adek ka ngʼeny kende ema mondo owuo, to mana e yo mochanore maber, ka moro ka moro wuoyo bangʼ wadgi, kendo ngʼato nyaka lok tiend weche ma giwachogo.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

kikuyu: Nikech joma richo ibiro ngʼad kargi oko, to joma oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye piny biro bedo margi.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

kikuyu: “Jal moa e polo malo duongʼ moloyo gik moko duto, to ngʼat monywol e piny en mar piny, kendo owuoyo kaka ngʼama onywol e piny. Jal moa e polo duongʼ moloyo gik moko duto.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

kikuyu: Saulo nodwoke niya, “Ne owachonwa malongʼo ni punde ne oseyudo.” To ne ok onyise gima Samuel ne owacho kuom wach bedo ruoth.
english: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.

kikuyu: Un jogo modak Lebanon, modak e ute bao mag sida moger gi malo, mano kaka unuywag malit ka rem ochopo kuomu, rem machalo gi mar dhako mamuoch kayo!”
english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

kikuyu: Eka nokawo gima notedoe mi omiye makati, to notamore chamo. Amnon nowachone niya, “Riemb jogi duto oko.” Omiyo ji duto nowuok oko oweye.
english: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

kikuyu: “Parane rawo, mane achweyo kaka ne achweyi kendo machamo lum kaka rwadh pur chamo.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

kikuyu: Musa kod Harun nowuok koa e chokruok kochiko dhoranga Hemb Romo mi gipodho auma, kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorenegi.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.

kikuyu: ne achando lewni, kendo ne urwaka; ne atuo kendo ne urita; ne an e od twech, kendo ne ubiro lima.’
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

kikuyu: To ka dipo ni ochiwo mich kuom girkeni mare ne achiel kuom jotichne, to jatichneno nyalo rite nyaka chop higa mar weye thuolo; bangʼ mano michno nyaka dwoki ni ruodh pinyno. Girkeni mar ruodh pinyno en mar yawuote kende; en pokgi.
english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

kikuyu: Kuom mano jogo nokawo mich kod pesa moromo rundo nyadiriyo, kod Benjamin bende. Negireto mapiyo nono ka gidhi Misri kendo negidhi ir Josef.
english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

kikuyu: Koro ka Yesu owuon nochako tichne ka hike dirom piero adek. Ne iparo nine en wuod Josef, wuod Heli
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

kikuyu: Bende kanyo nochak ni Mizpa (tiende ni kar ngʼicho), nikech Laban nowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye bed jarit e kinda kodi ka wan mabor.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jonabi piero abich nodhi mochungʼ gichien ka gingʼiyo kama Elija kod Elisha nochungʼie e dho aora Jordan.
english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato onyisi niya, “Chiemoni ne olosi mondo otimgo misango ne nyiseche manono,” to kik icham chiemono, nikech wach ma ngʼatno onyisino, kendo nikech wach mar chich ma in-go.
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni chikne ema kelo ngima mochwere. Kuom mano, gimoro amora ma awacho en mana gima Wuora onyisa mondo awachi.”
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

kikuyu: To nogony malaike angʼwen-go mane oseiki ni sa-no gi odiechiengno kod dweno gi higano, mondo gineg achiel kuom adek mar ji duto.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

kikuyu: In ema ne ichweyo dhanda maiye, adier, ne ingʼina maber gi ei minwa.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Kane pok gidhi mabor gi dala Josef nowacho ne jatichne niya, ring ilaw joka piyo, kendo ka imakogi, wachnegi niya, “Angʼo ma omiyo uchulo rach kar ber?
english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

kikuyu: “Kik uwe chunyu chandre. Yieuru kuom Nyasaye, to An bende yieuru kuoma.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni onenore kaka odundu mayom yom ok notur kendo kata obedo ni oliel ka taya ma mirimiri to ok notho. Enongʼad bura gadiera;
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Nying Nyasaye iyanyo e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi nikech un.”
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

kikuyu: nikech laweno kende ema oumorego. Ere gima donindie? Ka oywakna, to abiro winjo, nimar an Nyasaye ma jangʼwono.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

kikuyu: Puonj ngʼat mariek, to obiro bedo mariek moloyo, puonj ngʼat makare gimoro, to obiro medo puonjore.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

kikuyu: Eka Jeroboam nochielo ohinga motegno molworo Shekem e piny manie wi gode mag Efraim mi nodak kuno. Bangʼe noa kanyo modhi mogero Peniel.
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni gingʼeyo chik makare mar Nyasaye ni joma timo gik ma kamago owinjore gi tho, to gidhiyo adhiya nyime gi timogi, kendo bende gipwoyo joma timogi.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

kikuyu: Ne wageno kwe to onge ber mosebiro, bende ne wageno kinde mag chang, to ne nitie mana thagruok.
english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

kikuyu: Neuru kidi ma achungo e nyim Joshua! Nitie wenge abiriyo e kidi achielno, kendo abiro goro ndiko moro kuome, mi agol richo mar pinyni odiechiengʼ achiel.’
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

kikuyu: Ne ochako owuok odhi kendo molemo kaka mokwongo.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Koro gimedo timo richo, bende giloso nyisechegi mag fedha mondo gilam, ma gin kido molos gi rieko mangʼeny, magi duto gin tich jopa bepe. Wachore kuom jogi niya, “Gitimo misango gi dhano, kendo ginyodho kido molos mar nyaroya.”
english: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nowacho ni joge niya, “Donge ungʼeyo ni jatelo kendo ngʼat maduongʼ osetho e Israel kawuono?
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

kikuyu: Wechegi duto gin adier; kendo chikegi makare duto ochwere.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

kikuyu: Kidini nigi nengo matek mana ni un joma oyie. To kuom joma ok oyie to, “Kidi mane jogedo odagi koro osedoko kidi moriwo kor ot,”
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

kikuyu: Kik igomb mondo piny oyusi, mondo otim timbe mahundu.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

kikuyu: Oywak malit gotieno, pi wangʼe ridore e lembe. Kuom joherane duto, onge moro manyalo hoye. Osiepene duto osendhoge kendo gisebedo jowasike.
english: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.

kikuyu: “Ma e lek maseleko, an ruoth Nebukadneza awuon. Koro, Belteshazar, nyisa tiende, nikech onge ngʼato kata achiel e dier joma riek duto manie pinyruodha manyalo lokona tiende. To in inyalo, nikech chuny mar nyiseche maler ni kuomi.”
english: “This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo owuotho e dho Nam, noneno Lawi wuod Alfayo kobet piny e od jasol osuru. Yesu nowachone Lawi niya, “Luwa,” mi Lawi noa malo kendo noluwe.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

kikuyu: Ok giwuo gi kwe, to gichano wacho miriambo, kuom joma odak mos e piny.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

kikuyu: “Wena thuolo matin mondi to abiro nyisi ni nitie mathoth manyalo wacho kuom Nyasaye.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo to ok chal kamano kata matin! Gin gichalo gi mihudhi, ma yamo tero.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

kikuyu: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie kaka asewuotho e nyimi gi adiera kod chuny modimbore kendo asetimo gigo makare e nyim wangʼi.” Bangʼe Hezekia noywak malit.
english: “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Kuom mano nowacho niya, “An jatich Ibrahim.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ondiki bende ni, ‘Kik item Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi.’”
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

kikuyu: To kaka nongʼeyo gima negiwacho, Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Un joma nigi yie matin-gi, angʼo momiyo uwuoyo e kindu uwegi ni uonge gi makati?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

kikuyu: Noketo jo-Lawi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye momiyogi ongengʼo, gi nyatiti kod orutu kaluwore gi chik Daudi gi mar Gad janen mar ruoth kod mar Nathan janabi. Chikni nogol kod jonabi kowuok kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He set the Levites in the LORD’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from the LORD by his prophets.

kikuyu: kendo Jeroboam nowacho ni chiege niya, “Dhiyo, iwuondri mondo kik ngʼato fweny ni in chi Jeroboam, kendo dhi nyaka Shilo nimar Ahija janabi nikuro, en ema nonyisa ni anabed ruodh jogi.
english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

kikuyu: wuod Melki, wuod Adi, wuod Kosam, wuod Elmadam, wuod Er,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

kikuyu: Aora Jordan ne en tongʼ mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ. Ma e kaka nopog ni anywola mar Benjamin pinygi.
english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

kikuyu: E kinde ma ngʼatno gi dhakono kod jatichne nowuok mondo odhiyo, jaduongʼne nowachonegi niya, “Sa koro ngʼeny, omiyo ninduru ka nikech piny oseyuso. Ninduru kendo ubed mamor eka kiny gokinyi uchiew mondo udog thuru.”
english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

kikuyu: Gin kendgi ema onego gidonji e kara maler mar lemo; gin kendgi ema oyienigi sudo machiegni gi mesana mondo giti e nyima kendo gitim tijena.
english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo Kitabu mar Lweny mar Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Waheb mantiere Sufa kod holo mar aora Arnon,
english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

kikuyu: E kor ot molworo hekalu, e udi ma iye gi udi ma oko, nopayoe kido mar kerubi, gi mag yiend othidhe kod thiepe maupe.
english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

kikuyu: Jotend dhout Israel ne gin: koa kuom jo-Reuben: Eliezer wuod Zikri notelonegi, koa kuom jo-Simeon: Shefatia wuod Maaka notelonegi;
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

kikuyu: pakeuru kudiemo ongengʼo gi nyawadgi, ee, pakeuru ka ongengʼo gore.
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

kikuyu: Koro jo-Israel ne nigi kuyo nikech owetegi, ma jo-Benjamin. Negiwacho niya, “Kawuononi dhood Israel achiel olal.
english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

kikuyu: Isebedo ka ingʼiya mondo ineane ka atimo richo, to ok iseweya ma ok ikuma.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo, boche polo nobiro apoya moumogi, kendo dwol moro noa e boche polo kawacho niya, “Ma en Wuoda mahero kendo en ema chunya mor kode, winjeuru!”
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo jadolo nyaka none, bende ka oneno ni pod onge pogruok kendo pok olandore e del, to nyaka okete kar kende kuom ndalo abiriyo mamoko.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

kikuyu: Bende, Ahikam wuod Shafan noriwo Jeremia lwedo, kendo omiyo ne ok ochiwe e lwet jogo mondo onege.
english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Satan niya, “Dipo ka iseparo wach moro kuom jatichna Ayub? Onge ngʼato machielo e piny ngima machalo kode nikech olongʼo kendo ngʼama kare en ngʼat moluora kendo motangʼ ne richo.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nikare e yorene duto kendo ohero ji duto mosechweyo.
english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel nogolo mowito nyisechegi mag Baal gi mag Ashtoreth; mine gitiyo ne Jehova Nyasaye kende.
english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

kikuyu: Jasamuoyo wacho niya, “Sibuor ni oko!” Kata, “Ibiro nega e yore mag dala!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

kikuyu: Bende amiyogi pinje kaka piny jo-Keni, jo-Kenizi, jo-Kadmon,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

kikuyu: (Mano noyudo ka jopuonjrene osedhi Sukar mondo ongʼiew chiemo.)
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nodwoko niya:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Jakobo nowacho ne Josef, “Nyasaye Maratego nofwenyorena Luz e piny Kanaan, kendo kanyo ema nogwedha.
english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

kikuyu: Kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye mane omiyo Musa, ngʼato ka ngʼato nomi tije. Kuom mano nokwan-gi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Chiengʼono ruoth nopwodho dier laru mane nitie e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo kanyo nochiwoe misengini miwangʼo pep gi cham michiwo kod bor misango mar lalruok, nikech kendo mar misango mar mula mantie e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne tin ahinya mane ok nyal tingʼo misangogo duto, kaka misango miwangʼo pep gi mag cham kod mag sawo.
english: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno nolokre mudho ni dala mar Tapanhes, ka aturo jok mar jo-Misri; kendo kanyo ema tekone mosungorego nochop e giko. Ibiro ume gi boche polo, kendo mier mage matindo nomaki ma ter e twech.
english: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself, when I break the yokes of Egypt there. The pride of her power will cease in her. As for her, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.

kikuyu: Gin chunje mag jochiende matimo timbe honni kendo gidhi ir ruodhi duto mag piny ngima mondo gichokgi ni lweny ma nobedie chiengʼ maduongʼ mar Nyasaye Maratego.
english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

kikuyu: Kaka pi mopukore piny ma ok nyal tuom kendo, omiyo nyaka watho. To Nyasaye ok neg ngʼato; kar timo kamano, to oloso yore mondo ngʼat mane oriembi kik osiki ka en jasike.
english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

kikuyu: Nikech ot ka ot nigi ngʼat mogere, to Nyasaye ema ogero gik moko duto.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

kikuyu: Ringʼo kod makati modongʼ to nyaka une ni uwangʼo.
english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

kikuyu: Eka Abisalom nooro joote lingʼ-lingʼ e dhout Israel duto kowacho niya, “E sa moro amora ma unuwinj ka turumbete oywak, to wachuru ni, ‘Ruodh Hebron, en Abisalom.’ ”
english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

kikuyu: Lek duto jamni kwaye ka giwinjo maber kendo holni cham mochiek odhure; gikok gimor kendo giwer.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

kikuyu: Ne giwuoyo marach kuom Nyasach Jerusalem kaka ne giwuoyo kuom nyiseche molos gi lwedo mag ogendini mag piny.
english: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Johana ne ok opandonegi gimoro, to nohulonigi ka en thuolo niya, “Ok an Kristo.”
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

kikuyu: Bilha, Ezem, Tolad,
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

kikuyu: Nikech ma, piny opongʼ gi kuyo kendo ji modak e iye dhero kendo tho; ondiegi manie thim gi winy mafuyo e kor polo gi rech manie nembe tho.
english: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

kikuyu: Wengene liel ka mach makakni, to osimbo mangʼeny ni e wiye. En gi nying mondik kuome, maonge ngʼama ongʼeyo, makmana en owuon.
english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gariyo mar ruoth Ahasuerus, e dwe mokwongo, miluongo ni Nisan negigoyo ombulu (miluongo ni pur) e nyim Haman mondo giyier odiechiengʼ gi dwe. To ombulu nolwar e dwe mar apar gariyo dwe miluongo ni Adar.
english: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

kikuyu: Un to nyaka une ni uluoru Jehova Nyasaye, kendo utine gi adieri gi chunyu duto; parieuru gigo madongo mosetimonu.
english: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

kikuyu: Puothe nongʼiew gi fedha, kendo barupe lowo nogoye sei kendo nogosingo kendo nobedgi joneno e gwengʼ Benjamin, e mier molworo Jerusalem, e mier mag Juda kendo e mier manie piny mantiere got matin, mar tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ kendo e Negev, nikech anadwog-gi ka gia e twech, Jehova Nyasaye wacho.”
english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane jogo obiro ir Yesu, negiwachone niya, “Johana ja-Batiso noorowa iri mondo wapenj ni, ‘In e jalno mane onego obi, koso warit ngʼat machielo?’ ”
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

kikuyu: Nimar kit jogi kod timbegi onge tiende; gingʼado yien koa e bungu, bangʼe japecho paye gi koyo mare.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.

kikuyu: “Ne pod odongʼ gi ngʼat achiel mane koro onyalo oro: wuode owuon mane ohero gi lala. Ne oore mogik tik koparo ni, ‘Wuoda awuon to gibiro miyo luor.’
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: Kane Hushai osebiro ire, Abisalom nowacho niya, “Ma e rieko mane Ahithofel osengʼado. Owinjore watim kamano koso? To ka ok kamano to kare nyiswa ane kaka iparo.”
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

kikuyu: Eka Musa noketo tenge mier adek madongo man yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan,
english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

kikuyu: Eka ne awacho kuom ngʼat mane timbe chode osenurono ni, ‘Koro we giti kode kaka ochot, nikech mano e gima en.’
english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’

kikuyu: E kindeno Marduk-Baladan wuod Baladan ruodh Babulon nooro joote ir Hezekia gi barupe kod mich nikech yande nowinjo ni otuo to koro osechango.
english: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

kikuyu: Kane oseriemb ogandano oko, nodonjo mi okawo nyakono gi bade, kendo noa malo.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nyaka bed ngʼat mane nitie chakre ndalo Johana Ja-batiso nyaka odiechiengʼ mane okaw Yesu ogol e dierwa. Nimar achiel kuom jogi nyaka bed janeno kuom chierne kaachiel kodwa.”
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

kikuyu: Eka nyaka oket lwete ewi chiayono kendo oyangʼe e dho Hemb Romo. Yawuot Harun nokaw remo, kendo ginikire e bethe kendo mar misango koni gi koni.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Ma e wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kuom Babulon kod piny jo-Babulon kokalo kuom Jeremia janabi:
english: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

kikuyu: Kan-gi ka ipandogi e chunyi nyaka chiengʼ; twegi e ngʼuti motegno.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar piero ariyo mar dwe mar ariyo e higa mar ariyo, bor polo nowuok ewi Hemb Romo mar Sandug Muma mar Singruok.
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in e Wuonwa. Wan e lop chwech, to ine jachwechwa; kendo wan duto wan tich lweti.
english: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

kikuyu: Koro returu piyo udog ir wuora kendo uwachne ni, ‘Ma e gima Josef wuodi owacho: Nyasaye oseketa ruoth mar piny Misri duto. Bi ira; kendo kik ideki.
english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

kikuyu: Omiyo Uria jadolo nogero kendo mar misango kaluwore gi rieko duto mane ruoth Ahaz noorone koa Damaski mi notieko gere kapok ruoth Ahaz odwogo.
english: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

kikuyu: To chutho, noyudo ka osepando jogi ewi tado e bwo othith mane opedhi ewi tado kanyo.
english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

kikuyu: jo-Jebus, jo-Amor, jo-Girgash,
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

kikuyu: Mana kaka yiend olemo mayom manie dier yiende mamoko mag bungu, e kaka jaherana chalo e dier chwo matindo. Amor ka abet e tipone, kendo olembe milimili e dhoga.
english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

kikuyu: nikech wan to nyoro eka nonywolwa, kendo ok wangʼeyo gimoro, kendo ndalowa e pinyni chalo tipo.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

kikuyu: Jorit dhorangeye ne gin: Akub, Talmon kod jogo mane gitiyogo kanyakla e tij rito dhorangeye ne gin ji mia achiel gi piero abiriyo gariyo (172).
english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

kikuyu: Jodir asere nochielo ruoth Josia mi nowacho ni jotichne niya, “Golauru ka nimar asehinyora marach.”
english: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”

kikuyu: Kane pod owuoyo koda ka akulo wiya piny, nindo matut notera. Eka nomula mi ochunga malo.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.

kikuyu: “Jarit noparo kende owuon ni, ‘Abiro timo angʼo koro? Ruodha koro maya tija. Ok an ratego moromo ma dapur, to wiya kuot mondo akwechi.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo ni Chik en gir chuny; to an ngʼat ringruok, kendo richo osengʼiewa moloka misumbane.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

kikuyu: To ka oganda moro amora enokulre e bwo jok mar ruodh Babulon mi otine, to anami ogandano odongʼ e pinye owuon mondo opure kendo mondo odagi kanyo, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.” ’ ”
english: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says the LORD; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro sani Jehova Nyasaye oseketo roho mar miriambo e dho jonabigi duto. Jehova Nyasaye osengʼadoni buch masira.”
english: Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ka koth cham ok oiki e lowo motho, to osiko mana kodhi achiel kende. To ka otho, to onywolo kothe mangʼeny.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

kikuyu: Nyasaye ema pongʼo boche polo kod pi, kendo omono pek mar pigno yiecho bochego.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

kikuyu: Ma koro dhi bedo limbena mar adek malimo-ugo. Muma wacho niya, “Wach moro mantie e kind ji nyaka ngʼere malongʼo ka nitiere joneno ariyo kata adek.”
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama oseneno Nyasaye, to Wuowi ma Miderma machiegni gi Wuoro ema osemiyo wangʼeye.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

kikuyu: Kendo anyisi ni in Petro, kendo e lwandani ema abiro gere kanisana, kendo dhorangeye mag Gehena (tiende ni teko mar tho) ok noloye ngangʼ.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

kikuyu: Kendo kane oseketho teko gi loch duto, nomiyogi wichkuot e lela koloyogi gi teko mar msalaba.
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

kikuyu: Ooyo, wach ni machiegni kodu, en mana e dhou kendo e chunyu omiyo unyalo rite.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

kikuyu: Bende ne aneno timbe misandogo ji e pinyni, mi aneno joma isando kaywak to onge ngʼama ne nyalo hoyogi, nikech joma ne sandogi ne nigi teko moloyogi.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

kikuyu: Bende nyaka nene nyasach piny moro amora osereso ogandane e lwet ruodh Asuria?
english: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ maduongʼ mar yengʼo, ka kuonde ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo opodho, oula mag pige nomol ewi gode duto kod pidhe duto motingʼore malo.
english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

kikuyu: Puonj mar ngʼat mariek en soko mar ngima ma reso ngʼato e obadho mag tho.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Yawuot Zofa ne gin: Sua, Harnefa, Shual, Beri, Imra.
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

kikuyu: “Kuom ndalo auchiel unutim tijeu to odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo unuywe; kata mana e kinde mag pur kod keyo bende nyaka uywe.
english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

kikuyu: Eka nogonyonegi Barabas, to Yesu to nogolo chik mondo ochwadi bangʼe nokete e lwetgi mondo gigure.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

kikuyu: Kuom adiera Nyasaye e jaresna; anagen kuome kendo ok analuor. Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye owuon, e tekra kendo wenda; kendo osebedo resruokna.”
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

kikuyu: Jehoshafat nomedo bedo gi teko kendo nogero mier mochiel gohinga motegno kod mier mag keno e Juda.
english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

kikuyu: Ubiro loyo mier madongo mochiel motegno kod mier mamoko duto. Ubiro tongʼo yiende mabeyo duto, unudin sokni kendo unupongʼ puothe mabeyo gi kite.”
english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

kikuyu: Negichokore e pinyno kendo negiketho cham duto nyaka Gaza kendo onge gima ngima kaka rombe kata dhok kata punde mane giweyo e piny Israel.
english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

kikuyu: Wichkuot nomaki kar bedo gi pak. Koro en kindeni mar mer! Methi kendo dongʼ duk! Okombe moa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma korachwich bironi, kendo wichkuot biro umo duongʼ ma in-go.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

kikuyu: osechoponwa, wan nyithindgi, kuom chiero Yesu. Mana kaka ondiki e Zaburi mar ariyo niya, “ ‘In Wuoda; kawuono asedoko Wuonu.’
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nobed e bwo yiende owuon mar mzabibu kendo e bwo yiende owuon mar ngʼowu, kendo onge ngʼama nochak omigi luoro nikech Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osewacho.
english: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.

kikuyu: Bawe gi dhahabu maler kendo lwor bethene gi dhahabu.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Gikone, dhakoni bende notho.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

kikuyu: Ne nitie ngʼat moro e piny Maon mane nigi mwandu Karmel, ne en jamoko ahinya. Ne en gi diek alufu achiel gi rombe alufu adek, mane ongʼado yiegi e Karmel.
english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

kikuyu: Eka negiwachone mogik niya, “Kare, in ngʼa? Miwa dwoko mondo water ni joma ne oorowa. Iwacho angʼo kuomi in iwuon?”
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

kikuyu: To ka ok apogo dwond ngʼato, to achalone jamwa, kendo en bende ochalona jamwa.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Ka dine bed ni ok en jaketho, to dine ok wakele e nyimi ka.”
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nodok ir jopuonjrene monwangʼo ka ginindo. Nowachone Simon Petro niya, “Inindo? Rito otami kata kuom sa achiel kende?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

kikuyu: Ka yamb milambo makudho mos nochako kudho, negiparo ni ne giseyudo gima negidwaro kendo ni wuodhgi koro ber, omiyo negibolo nanga e pi mine gichako kwangʼ ka giluwo tiend dho nam mar Krete.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

kikuyu: to negiwachone ni mondo owach ni Shiboleth. To kane ok onyal luongo wachno maber, mi oluonge mana ni Siboleth, to negimake mi ginege e dho wath miyorogo aora Jordan. Jo-Efraim alufu piero angʼwen gariyo nonegi odiechiengno.
english: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

kikuyu: mar ariyo ne en Kileab wuod Abigael ma dhako mane chwore otho mane jaod Nabal ja-Karmel; mar adek ne en Abisalom wuod Maaka nyar Talmai ruodh Geshur;
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

kikuyu: Enobed mich makende mimiyogi, kogol kuom bath lowo maler mopwodhi, ma en kama ler moloyo momigi, mokiewo gi lop jo-Lawi.
english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

kikuyu: Ibiro riembi e dier ji kendo ibiro dak gi le mager; ibiro chamo lum kaka dhiangʼ, kendo thoo biro miyi ngʼich. Ma notimreni kuom higni abiriyo manyaka ingʼe ni Jal Man Malo Mogik nigi teko ewi pinjeruodhi duto, kendo ochiwogi ne ngʼato angʼata ma chunye ohero.
english: You will be driven from men and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You will be made to eat grass as oxen, and will be wet with the dew of the sky, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.

kikuyu: Yaye Efraim en angʼo ma datim gi nyiseche manonogi kendo? Anadwoke kendo rite, achalo gi obudo mangʼich, nyak mari aa kuoma.”
english: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”

kikuyu: Kaka Yesu nongʼeyo parogi, nokawo nyathi matin mokete ochungʼ bute.
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

kikuyu: Jogo duto ma ok noluw Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel, obed ngʼama tin kata maduongʼ, obed dichwo kata dhako nonegi.
english: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

kikuyu: Ka thuol okecho kapok oboye, to koro onge ohala mar ja-bocho.
english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

kikuyu: Yawuota, winjuru puonj mag wuonu; chikuru itu eka ubed gi ngʼeyo moloyo.
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

kikuyu: momiyo imanyo timbena maricho kendo isiko kimanyo richo moro amora ma an-go,
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Harun niya, “Dhiyo e thim mondo irom gi Musa.” Omiyo nodhi moromo gi Musa e got mar Nyasaye kendo nonyodhe.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.

kikuyu: Ji duto mondo olingʼ thi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nikech osewuok oa kar dakne maler.”
english: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

kikuyu: Kane oseluong Paulo odonjo iye, Tertulo nochako donjone e nyim Feliks kawacho niya, “Wasebedo ka wadak gi kwe e bwo lochni kuom kinde mangʼeny kendo paroni matut osekelo dongruok mathoth e pinywani.
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

kikuyu: Kata kamano giduto iyikogi machalre e lowo kendo kute nur kuomgi machalre.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

kikuyu: Kendo noyangʼ nyaim mitimogo misango mar pwodhruok e ketho, mi nokaw rembe moko, kendo nomien e dho it ngʼat mipwodhono ma korachwich, kod e lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich, kendo e lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich.
english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: Maluwogi ne en dhood Naftali. Jatend dhood Naftali ne en Ahira wuod Enan.
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: Ne ochoko pige mag nam gi tekre owuon; kendo kuom riekone ne otieko Rahab.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

kikuyu: To jo-Farisai gi jopuonj chik margi ne ngʼur ni jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo uchiemo kendo metho gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: In to in Nyasaye ma kecho kendo ngʼwon, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iyi ok wangʼ piyo, ipongʼ gihera kendo in ja-adiera.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

kikuyu: Ka ji ok orwakou, to utengʼ buch tiendeu sa ma uwuok e dalagi mondo obednegi ranyisi ni bura oseloyogi.”
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

kikuyu: Eka naneno malaika machielo kalor piny kowuok yo wuok chiengʼ, kotingʼo gima igoyogo kido mar Nyasaye mangima. Noluongo malaike angʼwen mane osemi teko mondo ohiny piny kod nam gi dwol maduongʼ.
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

kikuyu: Kik iwe wecheni iwuon teri e richo, nono to ibiro ywagori e nyim jadolo mar hekalu niya, “Singruok mane atimo kakwongʼora ne ok en adier. Angʼo ma dimi Nyasaye bed kodi gi mirima kuom gik misewacho mi oketh tich lweti?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

kikuyu: Eka Johanan wuod Karea nowachone Gedalia malingʼ-lingʼ ka en Mizpa niya, “Weya adhi kendo aneg Ishmael wuod Nethania, to onge ngʼama nongʼe. Angʼo momiyo odwaro kawo ngimani kendo omi jo-Yahudi duto mochokore buti oke kendo jo-Juda motony olal nono?”
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it.
