Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

kikuyu: Nimar joma nigi loch ok ked gi joma timo maber makmana gi joma timo marach. Donge idwaro ni joma ni e loch kik miyi luoro? Kara tim gik mabeyo eka ginipaki.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

kikuyu: Kinyne Musa noyudo jo-Israel ariyo ka dhawo. Notemo thegogi kowachonegi ni, ‘Joka ma, un owete; angʼo momiyo udwaro hinyoru kayiem?’
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

kikuyu: Kik ichik iti ni weche ma ji wacho, dipo ka iwinjo ka jatichni kwongʼi,
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

kikuyu: Kendo jope, gi nyirwedhi kod rwedhi madongo nopodh kodgi. Pinygi nopongʼ gi remo, kendo boche noum buru.
english: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel duto machwo gi mamon mane chunygi oyie nokelo ni Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mar hera ne tich duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa mondo otim.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.

kikuyu: Adwaro ngʼeyo Kristo kod teko miyudo kuom chierne kendo ayie riwora kode e sandne ka amedo bedo machal kode pile kuom thone,
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

kikuyu: Eka Saulo nowachone joma tiyone niya, “Dwarnauru dhako ma ja-nyakalondo, mondo adhi apenje wach.” Negidwoke niya, “Nitie moro Endor.”
english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ji duto nokawo sitadigi mi gikelogi ne Harun.
english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

kikuyu: E sechego Yesu nowachone ogandano niya, “Uwuokna oko mondo umaka ka utingʼo ligengni kod arunge mana ka gima an jatend koko mar jo-jendeke nangʼo? Pile ka pile an kodu e laru mag hekalu ka apuonjo, to ne ok umaka.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

kikuyu: Nikech herani maduongʼ chopo nyaka e polo; kendo adiera mari chopo nyaka ewi lwasi.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Kane obiro ir Simon Petro, Petro nowachone niya, “Ruoth, idwaro luoko tienda adier?”
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

kikuyu: Jonabi mage ketho chikena kendo dwanyo giga maler; ok gine pogruok manie kind gik maler gi gik mamoko; gipuonjo ni onge pogruok manie kind gik ma ok ler gi gik maler; kendo gidino wengegi ni rito Sabato maga, momiyo koro nyinga ok mi duongʼ e diergi.
english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.

kikuyu: Ka gia e chiro to ok ginyal chamo gimoro kapok gilwokore. Girito timbegi moko machon mathoth: kaka luoko okombe gi agulni, gi bakunde mag lowo gi birike.
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

kikuyu: Tinde ere ruodh Hamath, gi ruodh Arpad gi ruodh dala maduongʼ mar Sefarvaim, kata ruodh Hena kod Iva?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

kikuyu: Malaika mokwongo nodhi mopuko tape e piny, mi adhonde malich mangʼwe marach ne omako ji duto mane nigi kido mar ondiek malich kendo mane lamo gima ket kode.
english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

kikuyu: Kiriathaim, Sibma, Zereth Shahar mantiere e got manie holo,
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

kikuyu: omiyo noluongo jo-Israel duto kaachiel gi jodong-gi, jotelo, jongʼad bura kod jotelo mamoko kendo mi owachonegi niya, “Aseti kendo hika oseniangʼ.
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

kikuyu: Chik ma amiyou ema: Herreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi owinjo wachno nooro Joab gi jokedo mag lweny duto.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

kikuyu: “Awachonu ni ngʼatni, ma ok ngʼat machielono, nodhi dala ka en kare e nyim Nyasaye. Nimar ngʼato angʼato matingʼore malo kende nodwok piny, to ngʼat madwokore piny notingʼ malo.”
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Nebukadneza nopodho piny auma e nyim Daniel mi nomiye duongʼ kendo nogolo chik mondo otimne misango kendo oket ubani e nyime.
english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

kikuyu: To beduru gi paro ma ok yiengni mondo kik uparru motelo ni ere kaka ubiro dwoko wach.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

kikuyu: In jasamuoyo, nyaka karangʼo ma ibiro bedo kinindo aninda kanyo? Karangʼo mibiro chiewoe mondo ia e nindo?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywolo Peleg, Eber nodak kuom higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno polo manyien gi piny manyien. Polo mokwongo gi piny mokwongo noselal, to nam bende noselal kamano.
english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

kikuyu: to nyaka owe madho divai kod math mamoko moket e thowi kendo ok onego omadh kongʼo kata kongʼo moa kuom math mamoko moket e thowi. Ok onego omadh gimoro amora molos gi olemb mzabibu, kata chamo olemb mzabibu manumu kata motwo.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi ite mar winjo wach mondo owinji.”
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Ibiro gwedhou moloyo ogendini duto; onge ngʼato kuomu madichwo kata madhako ma ok nobed maonge nyathi, kata jambu manobed maonge nyithindo.
english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

kikuyu: Gilwora ka ataro odiechiengʼ duto; gisedinona chuth koni gi koni.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

kikuyu: Mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye ok nodog chien nyaka one ni ochopo dwaro mar chunye. E ndalo ma biro iniwinj tiend wachni.
english: The fierce anger of the LORD will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”

kikuyu: Boche polo ne oolo pi piny, kendo polo nomor e kor polo, ka asernigi mil koni gi koni.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kikuyu: Sirni ariyo, agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni; thiwni ariyo mane okedgo gik machalo agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni;
english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

kikuyu: Lwet Jehova Nyasaye nosando jo-Ashdod kod kuonde machiegni kodgi, noketo luoro kuomgi, bende nogoyogi gi tuo mar buche.
english: But the LORD’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

kikuyu: Gibiro pogore, wuoro nopogre gi wuode kendo wuowi bende nopogre gi wuon, miyo nopogre gi nyare to nyako bende nopogre gi min, dayo nopogre gi chi wuode, chi wuowi bende nopogre gi damare.”
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

kikuyu: To ongʼere ni misumba ok luong ni wuod dala, to wuod wuon dala ema iluongo kamano nyaka chiengʼ.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

kikuyu: bende mawachone nembe ni, ‘Dwon, kendo abiro miyo aocheni dwon,’
english: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Wer. Mad Nyasaye aa malo, mad wasike ke; mad joma kedo kode ring konene.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

kikuyu: Negidhi mi gilamo nyiseche moko nono ma gikulorenegi, nyiseche mane ok gingʼeyo, ma gin nyiseche mane ok imiyogi mondo gilam.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

kikuyu: Giselawa kuonde duto, mi koro gilwora, ka wengegi ochiek, mondo gidira piny.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

kikuyu: Gikadho ka yamo, ka gidhi kamoro machielo. To kata kamano gin joketho, nikech gikwano tekregi giwegi ka nyasachgi.”
english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nobiro irgi mowachonegi niya, “Teko duto manie polo kod manie piny osemiya.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

kikuyu: Nikech owetena gi osiepena modak e iyi, awacho niya, “Jerusalem mondo obed gi kwe.”
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Senakerib ruodh Asuria wacho: En kama nade miketoe genoni, momiyo isiko Jerusalem ka ogoni agengʼa?
english: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo matin kende, donge Lebanon nolok mana ka puodho momewo kendo puodho momewo nochal mana gi bungu?
english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

kikuyu: Mana kaka ringruok maonge muya otho, e kaka yie maonge tim bende otho.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

kikuyu: Oumo kor polo gi boche polo, kendo oromo piny gi koth, bende omiyo lum twi ewi thuche.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Ruoth nowacho ni Filipo niya, “Koro aa malo idhi yo milambo, kiluwo yo mongʼado i thim moa Jerusalem kadhi Gaza.”
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

kikuyu: “To koro yawuotgi jara ka giwer, makoro aselokora ngero ma gigoyo e kindgi.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

kikuyu: Eka Nathan nodimbo wach ne Daudi niya, “In e ngʼatno! Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel wacho: ‘Ne awiri mondo ibed ruoth Israel, ne agoli e lwet Saulo.
english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

kikuyu: Ne oresogi nyadi mangʼeny to kata kamano joge noketo chunygi ne ngʼanyo, mi richogi nochiwogi mi girumo.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ kane gisekadho giduto, eka jodolo bende nokadho modhi loka komachielo kotingʼo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka ji duto neno.
english: When all the people had completely crossed over, the LORD’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

kikuyu: Dhako madwaro nywolo nyathi nyaka muoch kaa nikech sane ochopo; to bangʼ nywolo nyathine, wiye wil gi muoch, nikech omor ni osenywolo dhano mangima e piny.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

kikuyu: Ne udwogo ma uywak e nyim Jehova Nyasaye to ne ok ochiko ite ne ywaku kendo ne ok owinjo kwayou.
english: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

kikuyu: Reuben, Simeon, Lawi, kod Juda;
english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

kikuyu: Kane onyis Solomon ni Shimei nowuok Jerusalem modhi nyaka Gath kendo odwogo,
english: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

kikuyu: E kindeno ne wakawo mieche duto, mi wanego, chwo, mon kod nyithindo duto, kendo onge ngʼama ne waweyo kangima.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

kikuyu: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel wacho, ‘Agulu mar mogo ok nodongʼ nono kendo puga mar mo ok notwo nyaka chop chiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye nokelie koth, e piny.’ ”
english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”

kikuyu: Kido mar malaika mar kerubigo noyaro bwombegi kochomo malo mondo giumgo raumno. Kerubigo nochungʼ momanyore ka ngʼiyore gi wi raumno.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: “Eka nowachona ni, ‘Sud ira ka mondo inega! Nikech awinjo rem malit to ngimana pod nitie.’
english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

kikuyu: Simon nodwoke niya, “Ruoth, wasetiyo matek otieno duto to ok wasemako gimoro. To nikech iwacho kamano, abiro chiko tonde.”
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

kikuyu: Wan gi weche mathoth ma wanyalo wacho kuom wach ma tiende tekni, to winjo maru ni chien.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

kikuyu: Joma orito chike Nyasaye ni kuome to en bende en kuomgi. To ma e kaka wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye odak eiwa: Wangʼeyo nikech Roho ma osemiyowa.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye tieko joma roteke gi tekone; kata obedo ni gin joma niginyalo to gionge gi ratiro ni gibiro bedo mangima.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki niya, “Gisepogo gigegi ne joma odhier, bergi osiko nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

kikuyu: ir nyako ngili, mane oseketo winjruok mar kend gi ngʼato ma nyinge Josef ma nyakwar Daudi. Nying nyakono mapok ongʼeyo dichwo ne en Maria.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

kikuyu: Singruok magi osetem maber chuth, omiyo jatichni oherogi.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

kikuyu: Napenjo niya, “Magi gin angʼo, yaye ruodha?” Malaika mane wuoyo koda nodwoka niya, “Abiro nyisi gima gin.”
english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

kikuyu: Ranguru Jehova Nyasaye gi tekone; dwaruru wangʼe kinde duto.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Donge Nyasaye ema wacho ne ruodhi ni, ‘Un joma nono,’ kendo owacho ne jo-mwandu ni, ‘Timbeu richo,’
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

kikuyu: nyikwa Ara, ji mia abiriyo gi piero abiriyo gabich (775),
english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: Joma ngʼeyogi tin nwangʼo fuwo, to jomariek irwako nigi ogut ngʼeyo.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

kikuyu: nikech gik mane osekel ne ngʼeny moloyo tieko tich duto mar gero kama ler mar lemo.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

kikuyu: Gima isetimo ok ber. Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima ni in kod jogi uwinjoru gi tho, nikech ne ok urito ruodhu ma ngʼat Jehova Nyasaye mowir. Ranguru anena, ere tongʼ mar ruoth gi puga mar pi mane nitiere machiegni gi wiye?”
english: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As the LORD lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the LORD’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”

kikuyu: To ngʼat maonge gi yie ok nyal bedo malongʼo ni Nyasaye, nikech ngʼato madwaro sudo ir Nyasaye nyaka yie ni entie kendo ni en-gi mich momiyo joma oketo chunygi ka dware.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

kikuyu: “Lowo modongʼ kolworo bath lowo maler mopwodhi koni gi koni kaachiel gi lowo mowe ni dala maduongʼ nobed mar ruoth. Lowo maler mopwodhi koa yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ nobedi kilomita apar gariyo gi nus maromre koni gi koni. Lope ariyogi duto borgi nobed maromre gi lope mopogne dhoot ka dhoot kendo ginibed mag ruoth. Lowo maler mopwodhi kaachiel gi kama ler mar lemo mar hekalu nobed e diergi tir.
english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

kikuyu: “Omiyo chunya ywagorene Moab ka asili; oywagore ka asili ne jo-Kir Hareseth. Mwandu mane giyudo oserumo.
english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma oterore gi chiayo.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: nikech aneno ka un kod ketho mangʼeny kendo richou sani okadho akwana, nikech usando joma ungʼeyo ni onge gi ketho, kendo uchamo asoya, to kata mana joma odhier manie dieru bende utamo mondo kik yud bura makare.
english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Johana ja-Batiso nobiro, koyalo e thim mar Judea,
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

kikuyu: Anto anyisou ni kik ukwongʼru kata matin: Kik ukwongʼru gi polo nimar en e kom loch mar Nyasaye;
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

kikuyu: Kane Jehova Nyasaye iye owangʼ ka en gi mirima mager, nogologi oko mi oterogi e piny moro ma pod gintiere nyaka chil kawuono.”
english: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

kikuyu: Un umon gi ngʼama odonjo ni jaketho, kendo usin gi ngʼat mawacho adiera.
english: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

kikuyu: Angʼo ma dimi awenu richou? Nyithindu osejwangʼa, kendo osekwongʼore gi nyiseche ma ok nyiseche. Asemiyogi gigo duto magidwaro, kata kamano giterore kendo gipongʼo ute ochode.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

kikuyu: Musa noketo odungago e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e Hema e nyim Sandug Rapar.
english: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

kikuyu: Omiyo wanyalo wacho gi chir niya, “Jehova Nyasaye e jakonyna omiyo ok analuor, ere gima dhano ditimna?”
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

kikuyu: Neuru Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, biro tieko wasike gi teko maduongʼ. Yiende ma yamo yiengo nongʼadi, to yiende maboyo nolwar piny.
english: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

kikuyu: Ma e chenro mabiro timore ne piny ngima; ma e bat moserie kuom ogendini duto.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

kikuyu: Ka richo biro, e kaka achaya biro, to wichkuot kelo duwruok.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

kikuyu: To gikanyo yie notuomo kuoyo mathany-thany momoko ti. Eka yo ka wiye nomako matek ma ok nyal yukni, kendo apaka nogoyo yo kachien yieno mi obarore matindo tindo.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat moro kok e thim niya, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yo moriere tir.’ ”
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

kikuyu: koa e nyikwa Elizafan, ne gin ji mia ariyo kotelnegi gi Shemaya,
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

kikuyu: Harun notimo kamano; noketo teyni kuonde mowinjore ka gimenyo nyim rachung taya, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: To ka dine wanonre wawegi mokwongo, to bura ok doloyowa.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

kikuyu: Eka Elisha nowachone niya, “Kaw atungʼ kod aserni moko,” kendo notimo kamano.
english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

kikuyu: Bor mar kendo mar misango koa ewi ndiri mare en fut auchiel, kendo tungene angʼwen ochomore kochomo malo koa e kendono.
english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

kikuyu: omiyo Daudi nopenjo Nyasaye kendo, to Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Kik ichomgi tir, to lwor gi yo ka ngʼegi kendo imonjgi kama omanyore gi omburi.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: Ma ne bangʼ kane oseloyo Sihon ruodh jo-Amor mane ruodh Heshbon kendo noloyo Og ruodh Bashan, ma bende nosebedo gi loch e piny Edrei gi Ashtaroth.
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

kikuyu: Onge chik Musa mane Joshua oweyo ma ok osomo ni kanyakla mar Israel duto, kaachiel gi mon, gi nyithindo, kod jopinje mamoko mane odak e diergi.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

kikuyu: Puonja timo dwaroni, nimar in e Nyasacha; mi mondo Roho mari maber, otelna e yo mopie.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

kikuyu: Bende gin-gi wichkuot kuom timbegi makwero? Ooyo, gionge wichkuot kata mana matin; ok gingʼeyo kata kaka ginyalo wuondore. Omiyo gibiro podho mana kaka joma moko mopodho; kendo ibiro dwokgi piny kakumogi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Ka tich ma ingʼadonego ji bura nigi duongʼ kamano, to tich, maketo ji kare, nyaka bed gi duongʼ moloyo!
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jawuoro kelo chandruok ne joode, to ngʼatno mamon gi asoya biro dak amingʼa.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Abishai wuod Zeruya nonego jo-Edom alufu apar gaboro e Holo mar Chumbi.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

kikuyu: To kuom joma ne odongʼ e dala maduongʼno, nomako jatelo mane ochungʼ ne jolweny, kod ji abiriyo ma jongʼad rieko ne ruoth. Bende nomako jagoro mane tichne en ndiko nying joma onego bed jolweny kod jodonge piero auchiel mane oyudi e dala maduongʼno.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Daudi nosedonjo e ode mar ruoth, nowacho ni Nathan janabi niya, “Koro anto adak e od ruoth moger gi yiend sida, to Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye to osiko e bwo hema.”
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”

kikuyu: Nikech ugeno kuom timbeu kod mwandu mau, un bende nomaku, kendo Kemosh noter e twech, kanyakla gi jodolo mage kod jotelo mage.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

kikuyu: Miuru ji duto makwayou, to ka ngʼato okawo giri moro, to kik idwar ni mondo oduoknigo.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

kikuyu: To ka nitie hinyruok marach to nyaka ukaw ngima kar ngima kendo
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

kikuyu: Ka Methusela ne ja-higni mia achiel gi piero aboro gabiriyo, nonywolo Lamek.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo kawuru olembe yien mabeyo gi bede othidhe, gi bede yien motimo otiep, gi omburi, kendo ubed mamor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

kikuyu: Ji ngʼamo dhogi ka gijara; Githalo lemba ka gisin koda, kendo ginur kuoma giduto ka giriwona.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Nikech dwokonino koro inyalo dhi. Jachien osewuok oweyo nyari.”
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

kikuyu: Un pinje, beduru mamor gi jogi, nimar obiro chulo kuor kuom remb jotichne; obiro chulo kuor ne wasike kendo nopwodh pinye kod joge.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

kikuyu: Unyono jochan piny mana ka buru kendo ok ungʼad bura makare, ne joma odhier. Wuowi gi wuon mare terore gi nyako achiel kendo udwanyo Nyinga Maler.
english: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.

kikuyu: to ok gisefwenyo ni aparo timbegi duto maricho. Richogi oduodogi, kendo ni e wangʼa ndalo duto.
english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

kikuyu: Kuom ndalo abiriyo, chiwuru ne Jehova Nyasaye misengini miwangʼo pep. Chiengʼ mar abiriyo beduru gi chokruok mar jomaler, kendo kik uti tich moro amora ma utiyo pile.’ ”
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

kikuyu: To Jakobo nowachone niya, “Kwongʼrina mokwongo.” Kuom mano Esau nokwongʼore ne Jakobo, ma ousone duongʼne mar nywol.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

kikuyu: E sechego ne awachone ji niya, “Ket ngʼato ka ngʼato kod jakonyne obed ei Jerusalem gotieno, mondo omi gibed jorito gotieno, to giti godiechiengʼ.”
english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

kikuyu: Dhoga opongʼ gi pakni, kendo asiko ahulo duongʼni maler odiechiengʼ duto.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

kikuyu: “Efraim chalo kaka akuch odugla mawuondo yot kendo mofuwo, giluongo Misri to gilokore gidhi Asuria.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

kikuyu: An awuon aseyiero jo-Lawi weteni koa kuom jo-Israel kaka chiwo ne un, mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye mondo oti e Hemb Romo.
english: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Lepi maboyo duto dungʼ tik mane-mane gi poda kod kasia; moa e ute ruodhi molichi gi lak liech. Wende mindito gi gig wer miyi mor.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

kikuyu: To Solomon ema ne ogero ne Nyasaye odno.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

kikuyu: Chutho iketogi kama poth-poth, kendo idwokogi piny mi gikethre.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

kikuyu: Nikech kuom Kristo Yesu onge pogruok bed ni ngʼato oter nyangu kata ok otere. Gimoro achiel kende madwarore en yie matiyo kuom hera.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

kikuyu: Jakobo nodwoko wuon mare niya, “An Esau wuodi makayo. Asetimo kaka ne inyisa. Yie ia malo ibed piny kendo icham ring le ma akeloni mondo mi igwedha.”
english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

kikuyu: Moko kuom joma riek noyud chandruok, mondo pwodhgi, ikgi kendo ketgi kare nyaka ndalo giko chopi, nikech chiengʼ giko nyaka bi ka kinde ochopo.
english: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.

kikuyu: Nopimo yo nyandwat, gi gir pimo mi noromo fut mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

kikuyu: Omiyo tiendena bedo mayot ka tiende mwanda; kendo en ema omiyo achungʼ kuonde man malo maboyo.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

kikuyu: Nyikwa Delaya, Tobia kod Nekoda, noromo ji mia auchiel gi piero angʼwen gariyo (642).
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

kikuyu: pasia mag laru molworo kar lemo kod kendo mar misango, pasia mar dhorangach, tonde kod gik moko duto mitiyogo kanyo. Joka Gershon nyaka ti tije duto madwarore mondo oti kanyo.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

kikuyu: koa kuom Ozni, joka Ozni; koa kuom Eri, joka Eri;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

kikuyu: Eka jotich joka ruoth mane ni e rangach nopenjo Modekai niya, “Angʼo momiyo idagi timo chik ma ruoth oketo?”
english: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

kikuyu: Wachni nolandore e Jopa duto, mi ji mangʼeny noyie kuom Ruoth.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

kikuyu: Ji nodwokgi ni, ‘Nikech negiweyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi manogologi e piny Misri mine gikawo nyiseche mamoko ka gilamogi kendo tiyonegi ma emomiyo osekelo masichegi duto kuomgi.’ ”
english: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ndalo piero angʼwen Nowa noyawo dirisa mane oloso ei yie,
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyaka utim Pasaka mar Jehova Nyasaye e odiechiengʼ mar apar gangʼwen mar dwe mokwongo.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: nyikwa Binui, ji mia auchiel gi piero angʼwen gaboro (648),
english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

kikuyu: Eka Ziba nowachone ruoth niya, “Jatiji biro timo gimoro amora ma ruodha ma ruoth ochiko jatichne mondo otim.” Omiyo Mefibosheth nochiemo e mesa Daudi mana kaka achiel kuom yawuot ruoth.
english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

kikuyu: Dhoudi mamoko bende noywag kar kendgi, ka mondgi bende ywak kamano.”
english: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

kikuyu: Kata ka okwayo rech to omiye thuol?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

kikuyu: To ka ogandano nochokore mar kwedo Musa kod Harun kendo gilokore ka gingʼiyo Hemb Romo, apoya nono boche polo noume kendo duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye noyangore.
english: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and the LORD’s glory appeared.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata momulo kitandono nyaka neni olwoko lepe, kaachiel gi dende, kendo enobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Donge dakumgi kuom ma?” Donge onego akel kum ne oganda machalo kama?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

kikuyu: An Paulo, jaote mar Kristo Yesu kuom dwaro mar Nyasaye, andikonu un jomaler man Efeso, jogo maluwo Yesu gi chunygi duto.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

kikuyu: Eka Abisalom ne odwoke niya, “Aneno ni wecheni beyo kendo gin adier; to makmana ni onge ngʼat ma ruoth oseketo mondo owinjne weche makamagi.”
english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ higni apar gangʼwen ne achako adok Jerusalem, ka wan gi Barnaba kendo Tito bende ne wadhigo.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

kikuyu: Kom duongʼno ne nigi raidhi mag kuonde minyono auchiel gi raten tielo mar dhahabu mane ochuog kuome. Bethene ariyo ne nigi bede miyienge bat, ka kido mar sibuor molosi ochungʼ e bath moro ka moro.
english: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

kikuyu: Joma timbegi richo osechikona obadho; to kata kamano pok abaro aweyo bucheni.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Gad, Musa nowuoyo kama: “Ogwedh ngʼat mayaro tongʼ Gad! Gad odak kanyo ka sibuor, koyiecho bat kata wi gima omako.
english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

kikuyu: wuod Hashabia, wuod Amazia, wuod Hilkia,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: Abiro timo gimoro amora mukwayo e nyinga, eka Wuowi omi Wuoro duongʼ.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

kikuyu: Nahath nonywolo Eliab, Eliab nonywolo Jeroham, Jehoram nonywolo Elkana, to Elkana nonywolo Samuel.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone jotend jo-Lawi mondo oyier jowetegi kaka jower mondo ower wende mag mor ka gigoyo thumbe machalo orutu, nyatiti gi ongengʼo.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

kikuyu: Noluong jo-Israel moa Naftali, Asher kod Manase, kendo negilawo jo-Midian.
english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

kikuyu: To wan ok wan jogo madok chien kendo lal, to wan jogo moyie kendo ma ireso.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

kikuyu: Jolweny nokado osimbo mar kudho, mi gisidhone kendo negiketo e wiye. Ne girwakone kandho makwar,
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

kikuyu: Otuchi mage minenogo gi agola mage kod othidhe mogor kuome ne pimgi romre gi mago manie rangach mochomo yo wuok chiengʼ. Kama iluwo kidonjogo kanyo ne nigi raidhi abiriyo, kendo agola mare nochomore kode tir.
english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima nyaka itim e kinde miwalogi mondo gitina kaka jodolo: Kaw nyarwath kod imbe ariyo maonge songa.
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

kikuyu: Daudi nopenje niya, “Bende inyalo tera ir jopechogi?” Nodwoke niya, “Kwongʼrina e nyim Nyasaye ni ok ninega kata dwoka e lwet ruodha, to abiro teri irgi.”
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

kikuyu: To Musa nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo utamoru winjo chik Jehova Nyasaye? Mano ok bi timore!
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?

kikuyu: To Azaria jadolo kod jodolo mamoko mag Jehova Nyasaye piero aboro ma jochir noluwe kuno.
english: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, who were valiant men.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nowachone niya, “Ka kamano e kaka wach chalo e kind dichwo gi dhako to ber moloyo ka ngʼato ok okendo.”
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo wachni, mirima mager nomakogi, kendo negidwaro nego joote.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

kikuyu: Bende onyalo bedo gi mor kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego? Bende doywagne Nyasaye seche duto?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Obiro nego joma achachgo gi nek marach bangʼe oketo puothe mar mzabibuno e lwet jopur mamoko, manyalo miye olembege, ka kinde keyo ogik.”
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

kikuyu: nimar jomer kod jowuoro bedo jochan, kendo nongʼno rwakogi gi lewni moti.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ok ketre e duongʼ mar bedo jadolo kende owuon, to Nyasaye ema nyaka luonge mana kaka noluongo Harun bende.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

kikuyu: Kane Farao oneno ka koth, pe gi mor polo orumo, to nomedo timo richo. Nomedo bedo gi chuny matek en kaachiel gi jodonge.
english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

kikuyu: Kane Jakobo owinjo wach ni Josef wuode obiro nene, nochukore mobet e kitandane.
english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

kikuyu: Rang piny gie polo, ma en kar dakni maler kendo igwedh jogi Israel kod piny ma isemiyowa kane isingori kikwongʼori ni kwerewa, ma en piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.”
english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

kikuyu: E bwo dhoge, nolwore gi kido apar mokedi mag rwedhi maromo fut achiel gi nus. Rwedhigo nolos koriedo e laini ariyo ka gimakore gi Namno.
english: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

kikuyu: Bende ginichwade ma gininege, to chiengʼ mar adek enochier kendo.”
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Wuod Dhano biro dhi mana kaka ne osechiki, to ngʼat mandhoge none malit.”
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

kikuyu: Enonyagni kit kuthe mopogore opogore kendo ibiro chamo alode manie thim.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo niya, “Bende wuowi ma Abisalom ngima?” Ahimaz nodwoke niya, “Ne aneno ka mutni nitie maduongʼ e sa ma Joab ne oro jatich ruoth kod an, jatichni, to ok angʼeyo gima ne timore.”
english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “When Joab sent the king’s servant, even me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I don’t know what it was.”

kikuyu: Ibrahim nopidho yien moro Bersheba, kendo kanyo noluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

kikuyu: kendo ne gitudore moro gi moro gi bwombegi. Moro ka moro ne huyo kochomo nyime tir; ne ok gilokre ka gidhi.
english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, kaw puga motingʼo mo iol e wiye kiwacho niya, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Asewali bedo ruodh Israel.’ Bangʼ timo ma to iyaw dhoot; kendo ring piyo, kik ideki!”
english: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘The LORD says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka ngʼato kuomu nigi rombo kendo rombono olwar ei bur chiengʼ Sabato, donge diywaye igole oko?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, chom wangʼi kuom Jerusalem kendo iyal wach kikwedo kama ler mar lemo. Kor wach kuom piny Israel,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

kikuyu: Keturu jongʼad bura kod jotend dhoutu e miechu duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou, to gibiro ngʼado ne jou bura makare.
english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

kikuyu: Koro wuogi oko mondo iho jogi. An gadiera e nying Jehova Nyasaye ni ka ok iwuok oko, to otieno ma kawuono onge kata mana ngʼato achiel ma biro bedo kodi. Mano nobedni masira maduongʼ moloyo masiche duto miseneno nyaka ia e nyathi.”
english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by the LORD, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

kikuyu: kendo gokinyi ubiro neno duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye, nikech osewinjo ngʼur ma ungʼurnego. Wan to wan ngʼa gini ma dimi ungʼurnwa?”
english: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

kikuyu: To an ahero mana nyako achiel kende, ma jaber ka akuru, en e nyar min kende, mohero malich. Jotich ma nyiri konene, to luonge ni nyako mogwedhi, to mond ruoth kod mon mamoko konene to pake.
english: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

kikuyu: Nikech chuny jogi osedinore; gisedino itgi, kendo gisemiyo wengegi. Nono to dipo ka wengegi oneno, kendo itgi owinjo wach; mi chunygi ofwenyo tiend weche, kendo gidwog ira mi achang-gi.’
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

kikuyu: To kapo ni tiendi ema teri e richo to ngʼade oko. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima kingʼol kar donjo e gehena gi tiende ariyo, [
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

kikuyu: Petro nopenje niya, “Ruoth, angʼo momiyo ok anyal luwi sani? Aikora chiwo ngimana nikech in.”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

kikuyu: To ka joodgi Yesu nowinjo wachni, negidhi ire mondo gigole kanyo githuon, kagiwacho niya, “Wiye obiro marach.”
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

kikuyu: “Nyasaye nyalo duto, to kata kamano ok ochayo ji; onyalo duto kendo chenro mage ok lokre.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

kikuyu: Bende nochiw okapu man-gi makati ma ok oketie thowi kod im kaka misango mar lalruok ne Jehova Nyasaye, kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Nimar hera moherowago duongʼ, kendo adierane osiko nyaka chiengʼ. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Omiyo Naomi gi chi wuode nomedo dhiyo nyaka negichopo Bethlehem. Kane gichopo Bethlehem, dala duto nobwok kane onene, kendo mon nopenjore kendgi niya, “Ma bende dibed Naomi adier?”
english: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”

kikuyu: Chokuru achiel kuom apar mar chambu, divai manyien kod mo, kaachiel gi nyithindo makayo mag kweth dhou kod kweth jambu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kama noyier mondo oluongie Nyinge mondo omi ubed joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ndalo duto.
english: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

kikuyu: kendo wechege ngʼeny maonge tiende. Onge ngʼama ongʼeyo gima biro timorene kiny, koro en ngʼa manyalo nyise gima biro timorene bangʼ thone?
english: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?

kikuyu: Kane Paulo pod rito Sila gi Timotheo Athene, chunye nosin kane oneno kaka jo-dalano noketo chunygi kuom lamo kido mag nyiseche manono.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

kikuyu: Kendo Josef nomako lwet nyithindo ariyogo, Efraim e bade korachwich kochomo bad Israel koracham, kendo Manase koracham kochomo bad Israel korachwich kendo nokelogi machiegni gi Israel.
english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

kikuyu: Emomiyo adwaro ni kamoro amora ma ji ochokoree ka lemo to chwo duto mondo otingʼ lwetgi maler malo ka gilemo, maonge mirima kata goyo mbaka.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

kikuyu: Negiloso gima opadore ka san gi dhahabu maler mondo obed osimbo maler mi gindiko kuome ni: Kama owal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

kikuyu: Rita, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, rita e lwet joma timbegi richo; konya e lwet jo-mahundu machano gajo tiendena.
english: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

kikuyu: Abiro paki gi chunya duto, yaye Ruoth Nyasacha, abiro miyo nyingi duongʼ nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

kikuyu: To puothe kod gwenge molworo dala maduongʼ ne gisemiyo Kaleb wuod Jefune kaka pok mare.
english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

kikuyu: An e kuon mar ngima.
english: I am the bread of life.

kikuyu: Kristo e kido mineno mar Nyasaye ma ok ne, kendo en e wuowi makayo mar Nyasaye man-gi duongʼ kuom chwech duto.
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne giwuok ka gia e got mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ne giwuotho kuom ndalo adek. Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye nodhi nyimgi e ndalo adekgo mondo oiknegi kama ginyalo yweyoe.
english: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

kikuyu: Eka enobare gi e bwombe, to ok nopoge chuth, kendo bangʼe jadolo nowangʼe ewi kendo mar misango, kokete ewi yien manie mach. Ma en misango miwangʼo pep, ma en misango miwangʼo gi mach, madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Lokri, iwe timo ne ji marach; par maber kendo, nikech an ngʼat makare.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

kikuyu: Meshulam, Abija, Mijamin,
english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

kikuyu: Nochoko chwo ire kendo nobedo jatend oganda kane Daudi tieko jolweny Zoba. Ogandago nodhi Damaski kuma negidakie mi giloche.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

kikuyu: Donge odiechiengno mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed odiechieng mudho mandiwa, molil maonge chiengʼ ler, kendo ma chiengʼ ok norienyie?
english: Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

kikuyu: Dhakono ne nigi nyarwath machwe e ode, mine oyangʼe mapiyo piyo. Nokawo mogo, modwalo motedogo makati ma ok oketie thowi.
english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

kikuyu: “Gouru koko matek, kendo kik udog chien. Tingʼuru dwondi malo mana ka turumbete. Nyisuru joga malongʼo ngʼanyo margi kendo richo mar od joka Jakobo nyisgiuru.
english: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

kikuyu: Adier, idwaro ni dhano obed ja-adiera gie chunye iye emomiyo ipuonja rieko gie chunya maiye mogik.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

kikuyu: E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye ne oketo tenge oganda joka Lawi mondo otingʼ Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye, mondo omi gichungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka gitiyo tijene kendo ka gigwedho e nying Jehova Nyasaye nyaka chil kawuono.
english: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

kikuyu: Nyikwayi nobed mangʼeny ka kwoyo, kendo unudag koa yo podho chiengʼ nyaka wuok chiengʼ, bende koa yo nyandwat nyaka yo milambo. Ogendini duto manie piny nogwedh kokadho kuomi kod nyikwayi.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

kikuyu: Utiyo gi dhou kuom timo richo kendo lewu oikore ne wuond.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

kikuyu: Ei kama ler mar lemo noloso malaika mar kerubi ariyo gi bap Zeituni ka moro ka moro borne madhi malo romo fut apar gabich.
english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

kikuyu: Bende kik ipenjri ni angʼo momiyo ndalo machon gik moko ne timore maber moloyo ndalogi? Mano en penjo mar ngʼat mofuwo.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

kikuyu: Piny nongʼamo dhoge mi omwonyogi kaachiel gi Kora, ma joma ne luwo bangʼe ji mia ariyo gi piero abich notho e mach. Jogi nobedo kaka ranyisi mar siemo ji.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

kikuyu: Asewinjo mana gi ita gima joma moko osewacho kuomi kende to sani koro aseneni gi wengena awuon.
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

kikuyu: Jochiendego nosayo Yesu kawacho niya, “Kigolowa kuom ji ariyogi to orwa wadonji ei kweth mag anguro.”
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

kikuyu: Eka Rael nowacho ne Jakobo niya, “Eri amiyi Bilha ma jatichna ma nyako. Kawe ibed kode e achiel mondo mi onywolna nyithindo mondo omi kokadho kuome an bende abed gi joga.”
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

kikuyu: Abimelek nolawe, kendo ji mane ohinyore kanyo ne ngʼeny mochopo nyaka e dhorangach.
english: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

kikuyu: Ka en adier ni joma otho ok chier, to mano nyiso ni kata Kristo bende pok ochier?
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: mi nomako ich monywolo nyathi ma wuowi. Ka noneno ni en nyathi ma jaber, nopande kuom dweche adek.
english: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

kikuyu: Eka Musa nowacho ne Harun niya, “Kaw tawo mar ubani mari kendo iket gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar e iye, kaachiel gi mach moa e kendo mar misango, kendo iret idhi e chokruokno mondo itimnegi misango mar pwodhruok e richo. Mirima osebiro koa ir Jehova Nyasaye; masiche osechakore.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD! The plague has begun.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano, asechako tiekou, kendo asechako kethou nikech richou.
english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

kikuyu: Tijegi duto, bedni en tingʼo kata tich moro amora nyaka tim ka Harun kod yawuote ema oteloe. Unupog-gi tich monego gitim.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo ngʼadonwa bura marach? Kristo Yesu ema ne otho, to bende ne ochiere odoko mangima mi koro obet e bat korachwich mar Nyasaye kendo okwayonwa.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato moro Yesu ne puonjo e achiel kuom sinagoke,
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Musa nowinjo ji duto moa e anywola ka anywola kaywak, ka moro ka moro ochungʼ e dho hembe. Jehova Nyasaye iye nomedo owangʼ kendo kihondko nomako Musa.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

kikuyu: Esta nowacho niya, “Jasadha ma jawasikwa en mana Haman ngʼat marach mobet butino.” Eka luoro maduongʼ nomako Haman e nyim ruoth gi mikache.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni en e kodhi matinie mogik kuom kotheu duto, to ka odongo to odoko yiend puodho maduongʼ moloyo yiende mag puodho duto, kendo winy mafuyo e kor polo biro kendo piyo e bedene.”
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

kikuyu: To ne nitie njagi motingʼo kongʼo makech kanyo, omiyo ne giluto siponj e iye bangʼe ne gichwoyo siponjno ewi kede moro mi gitere nyaka e dho Yesu.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

kikuyu: Elon, Timna, Ekron,
english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

kikuyu: Bangʼ Jeftha, Ibzan ja-Bethlehem notelo ne jo-Israel.
english: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

kikuyu: Ibrahim notingʼo wangʼe malo kendo noneno ji adek machwo kochungʼ bute. Kane onenogi, noringo matek koa e dho hema mondo oromnegi kendo nopodho piny auma e nyimgi.
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka winj joloch duto moketi mondo orit ji, nikech uhero Ruoth Yesu madwaro ni utim kamano. Rituru chike mag ruoth marito piny,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

kikuyu: Adiera gichalo mana tiangʼ, mach biro wangʼogi duto. Ok ginyal resore kata gin giwegi e teko mar mach. Kaonge makaa kata mach minyalo hoyo.
english: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.

kikuyu: “Gima nyaka ichiw e kendo mar misango pile ka pile ema: nyirombe ariyo mahikgi achiel achiel.
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

kikuyu: To owetene mamoko mag jo-Kohath ne omi tij keto makati e mesa chiengʼ Sabato ka Sabato.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

kikuyu: Un joma ok odewo odiechieng bura mabiro, to kata kamano timbeu medo mana kelonu chandruok!
english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Zeba gi Zalmuna neni Karkor kaachiel gi jolweny mage manyalo romo ji alufu apar gabich, ne gin jolweny mane odongʼ kuom jolweny mag wuok chiengʼ, to jolweny alufu mia achiel gi piero ariyo nonegi e lweny.
english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

kikuyu: gibiro tingʼi malo e lwetgi, mondo kik ichwany tiendi e kidi.’”
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: E kinde duto ma Roho mar Nyasaye nobiro kuom Saulo, Daudi to ne kawo nyatiti kendo goyo. Saulo ne yudo kwe; kendo nochako winjo maber, eka roho marach ne weye.
english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

kikuyu: Jolweny mia auchiel ma jo-Dan moikore ne lweny nochungʼ e dhorangach.
english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

kikuyu: “Norieyo bade ka en malo momaka, nogola ei pige matut.
english: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

kikuyu: Ka piny ne chiegni imore, jopuonjrene nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Ka en thim, kendo sa koro olewo. We ogandani owuogi mondo gidhi e mier kendo gingʼiew chiemo ne gin giwegi.”
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

kikuyu: Nikech Rehoboam nobolore, mirimb Jehova Nyasaye nowuok kuome kendo ne ok otieke chutho. To bende ne nitie gik moko mabeyo Juda.
english: When he humbled himself, the LORD’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

kikuyu: Negiwachone niya, “In koro iseti kendo yawuoti bende ok luw timbeni; omiyo koro yiernwa ruoth mondo otelnwa, machal gi mag ogendini mamoko mondo otelnwa.”
english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

kikuyu: Odiechiengno en Sabato mowal manyaka ubedie gi yweyo, kulemo kendo utweyo chiemo. Mano en chik momakou nyaka chiengʼ.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

kikuyu: Eka Jehu ne owuok kochomo yo Samaria. Kane ochopo kar jokwath miluongo ni Beth Eked,
english: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

kikuyu: Chikno nyaka landi e pinje duto kendo ne ogendini duto, mondo jo-Yahudi oikre ne chiengʼ chulo kuor ne wasikgi.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

kikuyu: Hera matut ma aherogo wachni tieka, nimar wasika ok dew wachni.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

kikuyu: Ere ngʼama osekwayou gigo ka ubiro e nyima, donge mano en dwanyo hekalu mara maler.
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

kikuyu: Omiyo ne amiyou piny mane ok utiyone kod mier madongo mane ok ugero; mi udak kanyo kendo uchamo olemb mzabibu kod zeituni ma bende ne ok upidho.’
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

kikuyu: abiro chopogi e lache mag od Jehova Nyasaye abiro timogi e iyi, yaye Jerusalem. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye!
english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: En ema aore, mondo odhi oked gi oganda mokia Nyasaye, achike mondo omonj joma miya mirima, mi oketh mwandugi kendo oyakgi, kendo onyon-gi piny mana ka chwodho minyono e wangʼ yore.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Kaka ne ayalo kwereu e thim mar piny Misri, e kaka abiro yalou, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: To awachonu ni Elija koro osebiro, kendo gisetimone gimoro amora mane gihero mana kaka ondiki kuome.”
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

kikuyu: mi giwuog oko; joma osetimo maber nochier mondo obed mangima, to joma osetimo gik maricho nochier mondo ongʼadnigi buch tho.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

kikuyu: E ndalono rieko mane Ahithofel ngʼado nechalo mana ka ngʼat mopenjo Nyasaye wach. Mano e kaka Daudi gi Abisalom ne okawo rieko ma Ahithofel ne chiwo.
english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

kikuyu: Jotelo sanda maonge gima omiyo, to kata kamano chunya oluoro wachni.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

kikuyu: mar angʼwen Nethanel, mar abich, Radai,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

kikuyu: Eka chwo duto mane ongʼeyo ni mondegi wangʼo ubani ne nyiseche manono, kaachiel gi mon duto mane ni kanyo, ne gin oganda mangʼeny, kod ji duto manodak e piny Misri Mamwalo kod Mamalo, nowachone Jeremia niya,
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye noluongo Adam mopenje niya, “In kanye?”
english: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

kikuyu: Chikuru itu mondo uwinja, un joma wacho niya, “Kawuono kata kiny wanadhi e dala ni, kata e dala cha, mondo wadag kuno higa achiel, mondo walok ohala kuno eka walos pesa.”
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

kikuyu: to owetena mane odhi koda nokelo wach mane onyoso chuny ji. To kata kamano, an to naluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha gi chunya duto.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Nebo: Jeyel, Matithia, Zabad, Zebina, Jadai, Joel gi Benaya.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

kikuyu: Ka ok osedewo wach jogo, Yesu nowachone jatend sinagogi niya, “Kik iluor, bed gi yie.”
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

kikuyu: Eka Balaam nohulo ote moa kuom Nyasaye kama: “Ote mar Balaam wuod Beor, ote mar ngʼat man-gi wangʼ maneno ler,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: Ogendini mangʼeny nobi kawacho niya, “Biuru wadhi e got mar Jehova Nyasaye, e od Nyasach Jakobo. Enopuonjwa wechene mondo wawuothie e yorene.” Chik nowuog Sayun, kendo wach Jehova Nyasaye nowuog koa Jerusalem.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ezekiel biro bedonu ranyisi; ubiro timo mana kaka osetimo. Ka mano otimore to ubiro ngʼeyo ni An e Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.’
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”

kikuyu: Koa kuom nyikwa Binui: Shimei,
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

kikuyu: Jarit notero jogo e od Josef, nomiyogi pi mondo giluokgo tiendgi kendo pundegi bende nomiyo chiemo.
english: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

kikuyu: Nobaro polo mobiro e piny; rumbi molil ti nonyono gi tiende.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

kikuyu: Kamano bende jokony e kanisa bende nyaka bed joma imiyo luor, joma odimbore, joma ok madh kongʼo kendo joma ok oowre gi yudo ohala e yo ma ok nikare.
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

kikuyu: Ogandano nobiro mokwayo Pilato mondo otimnegi kaka nojatimo higa ka higa.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

kikuyu: Lingʼuru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto; nikech odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye chiegni. Jehova Nyasaye oseloso misango, kendo osepwodho joma oseluongo.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

kikuyu: Wengena ool nikech lit ma an-go; ok ginen maber nikech wasika duto.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

kikuyu: Koro Gaal wuod Ebed nowuok oko kendo negichungʼ e dhoranga dala maduongʼ mana sa ma Abimelek gi jolweny mage nowuok e kuondegi mane giponde.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye miyo idak amingʼa, to higni mar ngʼat marach ingʼado bedo machwok.
english: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

kikuyu: Gilwore mana kaka Nyasaye dwaro, ka gidhi e wangʼ piny duto ka gitimo gima ochikogi.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare yudo pok maber kaluwore gi gik mowacho, to ngʼatno ma ok ja-adiera nigi gombo mar miero.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Hosea niya, “Chak nyathi nying ni Jezreel nikech achiegni kumo dhood Jehu kuom nek mane otimore Jezreel kendo adhi tieko pinyruoth mar Israel.
english: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

kikuyu: Kane pod giwuoyo kode, jotich ruoth mabwoch nochopo mapiyo mokawo Haman ka gitere mondo odhi e nyasi ma Esta noseloso.
english: While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

kikuyu: Koro nochune ni nyaka ogonynegi ngʼato achiel motwe higa ka higa chiengʼ Sawo mar Pasaka.]
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

kikuyu: Ne omiyo lewa obedo ka ligangla mabith, e bwo tipo mar lwete ne opanda; ne omiyo abedo ka asere moywe maler kendo ne opanda e olalone.
english: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.

kikuyu: “Chumbi ber, to ka ndhathe orumo, ere kaka dimiye obed gi ndhathe kendo?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

kikuyu: Ka wuowino onywomo dhako machielo, to nyaka omi dhako mokwongo chiemo, lewni kendo nyaka obed kode e achiel.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

kikuyu: Nebuzaradan ma jatend lweny mar piny nomako joma nodongʼ e dala maduongʼ moterogi e twech Babulon, kanyakla gi jogo mane osedhi ire, kod joma moko.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.

kikuyu: “Timuru nyasi mar sawo mar makati ma ok oketie thowi; kuom ndalo abiriyo chamuru Makati ma ok oketie thowi, kaka nachikou. Timuru ma e kinde moketi e dwe mar Abib, nimar mano e dwe mane uwuokgo e piny Misri. “Kik ngʼato bi e nyima gi lwete nono.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: Gweth mag wuoro dongo moloyo gweth mag gode madongo machon, kendo moloyo gik mabeyo duto mag gode mosiko. Gwethgi mondo obi ne Josef, ngʼat mane opog gi jowetene.
english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

kikuyu: kendo kuom oganda jo-Naftali neginwangʼo Kedesh ei Galili, Hamon kod Kiriathaim, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: kane oketo boche polo malo, kendo kane oketo sokni mag nembe mogurore motegno,
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

kikuyu: “Winjuru ma, un jodolo! Chikuru itu, un jo-Israel! Winjuru, yaye jood ruoth! Kumni obironu: Usebedo obadho e Mizpa, gogo mopedhi ewi Tabor.
english: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo suya madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kendo nowacho e chunye niya, “Ok anachak akwongʼ piny kendo nikech dhano, kata obedo ni paro ma aye chunye opongʼ gi richo nyaka aa e tin-ne. Bende ok anachak atiek gik mangima kendo kaka asetimoni.
english: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

kikuyu: Omiyo oganda mar ruodh pinyno nowuok piyo ka gilawogi e yo mochiko aora Jordan, kendo mana gisano ka jogo mane lawogi nosewuok oko, dhorangajno nolor.
english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

kikuyu: E ndalogi, joga oselokore wasik ji. Ulonyo oko lewni ma nengogi tek kuom joma kadho ka ok udewo, mana ka joma odwogo oa e lweny.
english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

kikuyu: Harun nyaka ne ni teynigo osiko kaliel oko mar pasia moumo Sandug Muma mar Hemb Romo manie nyim Jehova Nyasaye chakre odhiambo nyaka okinyi. Ma en chik mosiko nyaka chiengʼ ne tienge duto mabiro.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: To, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, in ma ingʼado bura gi ratiro kendo pimo chuny kod paro, yie ane mirimbi kuom jogi, nimar in ema aseketoni kwayona.
english: But, LORD of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

kikuyu: Ka Laban nojuko Jakobo noyudo ka oseguro hembe e piny gode mag Gilead kendo mi en bende gi wedene noguro hembe kanyo.
english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: Nikech ochot nyalo miyo ibed matin maromo gi nengo makati, to dhako ma jachode biro tieko ngimani.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

kikuyu: Koro ndalona mag bet e piny orumo, nimar abiro iri, to gin pod gin e piny. Yaye Wuoro Maler, ritgi gi teko mar nyingi mane imiya, mondo gibed achiel mana kaka wan kodi wan achiel.
