english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

kikuyu: Isepidhogi, kendo tiendegi osenyaa; gidongo kendo ginywolo olemo. Wechegi osiko e dhogi kinde duto to chunygi bor kodi.
english: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro, gol gombo duto oko e chunyi kendo kik iwe gombo mag ringruok thagi, nikech bedo rawera maratego bende onge tiende.
english: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.

kikuyu: Dugu biro neno kendo wichkuot maru nonenre e lela. Abiro chulo kuor; kendo onge ngʼama notony.
english: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”

kikuyu: Onge gimoro mopandi ma ok nofweny, kata malingʼ-lingʼ ma ok nongʼere.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: makmana nowaru gi remo ma nengone tek mar Kristo, ma en Nyarombo maonge songa moro amora.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

kikuyu: E kinde moro amora ma amiyo piny odudo kendo lihudu ochungʼ e boche polo,
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

kikuyu: “Dogi dala kendo inyis ji gik madongo ma Nyasaye osetimoni.” Omiyo ngʼatno nowuok odhi molando ne dala duto gik mangʼeny ma Yesu nosetimone.
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

kikuyu: Kamano bende ka wangʼi miyo itimo richo to lodhe oko kendo iwite mabor. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima gi wangʼ achiel kar bedo gi wenge ariyo to owiti e mach mar Gehena.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye e riekone nowacho niya, ‘Abiro oronegi jonabi gi joote, kendo moko kuomgi ne ginegi to moko ginisandi!’
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

kikuyu: “Winjauru! Japur moro nodhi chwoyo kodhi,
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Joash ne ja-higni abiriyo kane ochako bedo e loch.
english: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

kikuyu: Anatieki koko mar ilo gi mor kendo gi dwond miaha kod wuon kisera e dala Juda kod yore mag Jerusalem, nimar piny nodongʼ gunda.
english: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”

kikuyu: Hezekia ruodh Juda nochiwo ni joma nochokore rwedhi alufu achiel kod rombe gi diek alufu abiriyo, to jodonge nochiwonegi rwedhi alufu achiel kod rombe gi diek alufu apar. Jodolo mangʼeny ahinya nopwodhore.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

kikuyu: Odiechiengno duto kod otieno gi odiechiengʼ maluwe duto ji nowuok kendo nochoko aluru. Onge ngʼama nochoko aluru matin ne atonge apar. Bangʼe ne gimoyogi e kambi mondo gituo.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

kikuyu: Ne igolo jogi Israel oa Misri gi ranyisi kod honni, gi lweti maratego kod badi moyarore kod bwok malich.
english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

kikuyu: Isenyisa yor ngima; inipongʼa gi mor mogundho ka an e nyimi, kendo gi mor mosiko e badi korachwich.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

kikuyu: Abiro diro aserni adek e bathe kanyo, ka gima atemo lengʼo gimoro.
english: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

kikuyu: Ginibi kendo ginikogi gi ilo e kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag Sayun; ginibed gi ilo kuom chiwo mabup mar Jehova Nyasaye, ma gin cham, divai manyien kod mo, nyithi rombe kod dhok. Ginichal gi puodho moole pi maber, kendo ok ginibed gi kuyo kendo.
english: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of the LORD, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.

kikuyu: Wuoch duto mag lweny kaachiel gi lewni motimo remo mag jolweny, ibiro ter e mach, ginibedi ramoki mar mach.
english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

kikuyu: Abiro rwako jodolo mage gi warruok kendo jomaler modak e iye biro siko ka wero wende mor.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

kikuyu: Kane pundano oneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye, nonindo piny e tiend Balaam, kendo ii Balaam nowangʼ mi ochwade gi luth.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

kikuyu: Lieteni ni e buche matut duto kendo jolweny mage onindo piny kolworo liende. Ji duto mane osebedo ka bwogo ji e piny joma ngima osenegi, kendo koro oseneg-gi gi ligangla.
english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Ne awachone dala maduongʼ niya, ‘Adier ibiro luora, kendo ibiro yie gi puonjna!’ Ka itimo kamano, to kar dakni ok nongʼad oko, kendo ok anakume. Kata kamano, ne pod gi timo sinani mar timo gik maricho.”
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

kikuyu: Dwogwa iri kendo, yaye Nyasaye Jawarwa, kendo gol kecho mikechogo kodwa iter mabor.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno kitabu ma jal mane obet e kom duongʼ otingʼo e lwete ma korachwich, kitabuno ne ondiki iye koni gi koni kendo ne odine gi kido abiriyo motweye.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

kikuyu: “Ne afwenyora ne joma ne ok openja, bende ne oyuda gi joma ne ok omanya. To ne oganda mane ok luong nyinga, ne awachonegi ni, ‘Eri an, eri an.’
english: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.

kikuyu: Wuowi mar ariyo nokendo chi owadgi mane owadgi oweyono, to en bende notho kapok onywolo nyathi. Notimore kamano ni wuowi mar adek bende
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

kikuyu: E kinde mokalo Nyasaye ne ok odewo fuwo machal kamano, to koro sani osegolo chik ni ji duto kamoro amora mondo olokre owe richo.
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

kikuyu: Geruru mier madongo ne mondu gi nyithindu, kod dipo ne jambu, kendo nyaka utim kaka usesingoru.”
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

kikuyu: Koro od Josef nomonjo Bethel, kendo Jehova Nyasaye ne ni kode.
english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

kikuyu: Yaye od Jakobo, biuru mondo wawuoth e ler mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.

kikuyu: Uparo ni batiso mar Johana noa kanye. Noa e polo, koso noa kuom dhano?” Negiwuoyo kuom wachni e kindgi giwegi kendo giwacho niya, “Ka wawacho ni, ‘Noa e polo,’ to obiro penjowa ni, ‘ka en kamano to angʼo momiyo nutamoru yie kuome?’
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Eka negiloso ratege ariyo mag dhahabu mi gichomogi e riak tonde ariyo mag gok yo ka nyime mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod machiegni gi kama oriwego but nungone.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Daudi noweyo gigege gi jarit gik moko moringo odhi ir jolweny mi omoso owetene.
english: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Musa niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Mokiewo kode, Meremoth wuod Uria, ma wuod Hakoz, nochako gero migawo machielo e dir Barak kochakore e dhood Eliashib mochopo nyaka gikone.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ka dhakono osea e ode, mi obedo chi ngʼat machielo,
english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

kikuyu: Mana gisano Yesu nongʼeyo e chunye gima negipenjore e chunygi, omiyo nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uparo gigi e chunyu?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

kikuyu: Eka neginyiso jo-Amon niya, “Kiny wanachiwre e lwetu kendo unutimnwa gima uneno ni bernu.”
english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

kikuyu: An Paulo, misumba Yesu Kristo, mane oluongi mondo obed jaote, kendo nowala mondo ayal Injili mar Nyasaye.
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

kikuyu: Koro adok ir jowa, to kapok adhi to we anyisi gima jo-Israel biro timo, asiemi kuom gik ma jogi biro timo ne jogi e ndalo mabiro.”
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

kikuyu: Omiyo giwinje korieyogi kendo ochikogi ni gilokre giwe timbegi maricho.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

kikuyu: kapok adhi kuma ji ok dhiye miduogi, ma en piny motimo mudho gi tipo molil ti,
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

kikuyu: Rehoboam nodwoko niya, “Dhiuru kuom ndalo adek bangʼe dwoguru ira.” Bangʼe negia ma gidhi.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

kikuyu: To richo nokawo thuolo mane chik okelo mopidho kit gombo mayoreyore kuoma nimar ka chik onge to richo otho.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

kikuyu: Otimo gik madongo miwuoro mayombo pach dhano, honni mathoth ma ok kwanre.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Israel dak kuno, Reuben nodhi moterore gi Bilha jatich ma nyako mar wuon-gi mi Israel nowinjo wachno. Jakobo ne nigi yawuowi apar gariyo:
english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

kikuyu: Ruoth Nyasaye, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, osechano kelo masira mabiro tieko piny duto.
english: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

kikuyu: Tiendegi ne oriere tir, to pat tiendegi ne chalo ombongʼ nyaroya, kendo ngʼangʼni ka mula moywe maler.
english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

kikuyu: Jomariek nokuod wigi; ginibed gi luoro mangʼeny kendo enomakgi. Nimar gisedagi wach Jehova Nyasaye, en rieko manade ma gin godo?
english: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected the LORD’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?

kikuyu: Kamano janabi nowacho niya, “Nikech ok isewinjo dwond Jehova Nyasaye, mapiyo piyo kiwuok ka, to sibuor biro negi.” Kendo bangʼ ka ngʼatno nosea, sibuor noyude monege.
english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

kikuyu: Bangʼ ma, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Abram e fweny ni, “Abram, kik iluor. An e okumbani, kendo pokni maduongʼ moloyo.”
english: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

kikuyu: Kamano nochungʼ mi ochiemo kendo ometho. Kane osechiemo noyudo teko mowuotho ndalo piero angʼwen, odiechiengʼ gotieno nyaka Horeb, got mar Nyasaye.
english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

kikuyu: Dhako ok onego rwak lewni mag chwo, chwo bende kik rwak lewni mag mon, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ok dwar joma timo kamano.
english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, wayie gi timbewa mamono kod ketho mag wuonewa; adiera wasetimoni richo.
english: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua kaachiel gi jolweny mage mathuondi nowuok Gilgal mapiyo nono mondo odhi oresgi.
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Negimor mar timo ma, to chutho gin jogop jogo. Nimar owinjore mondo joma ok jo-Yahudi, moseyudo konyruok mar chuny mar jo-Yahudi opog negie mwandu mag pinyni.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

kikuyu: Jogi modak e mier ma ok ni e chula noneg gi ligangla; wasikigo nokuny buche mi giket pidhe mag lowo mogingore e bath ohingani, kendo ginimonji ka gigengʼore gi kuodi.
english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

kikuyu: Noloso laru mar jodolo kod laru maduongʼ gi dhout laru kendo nobawo dhoudigo gi mula.
english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

kikuyu: Omiyo kane gimedo lemo kendo gitweyo chiemo, ne gigwedhogi mi giweyogi gidhi.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

kikuyu: Kata kawuono pod ategno mana ka kinde mane Musa ooracha, kendo pod an-gi ilo mar dhi oko mondo akedi mana kaka ne an ndalo cha.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

kikuyu: Bangʼe chiw nywok achiel mitimogo misango mar golo richo, kaachiel gi nyiimbe ariyo ma jo-higa achiel mitimogo misango mar lalruok.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: Anagwedhe kendo anamiyi nyathi ma wuowi koa kuome. Anagwedhe mi nobed min ogendini; kendo ruodhi mag ogendini noa kuome.”
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

kikuyu: Yesu nowuok kendo nodhi kode, kaachiel gi jopuonjrene bende.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Weyeuru mos. Ne ochan chon ni owinjore okan mo mangʼwe ngʼarno nyaka chiengʼ yikna.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer e dwol mar “Ondanyo.” Mar Daudi. Resa, yaye Nyasaye, nikech pi oseima nyaka e ngʼuta.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

kikuyu: “Usewinjo ni ne owach ne joma chon ni, ‘Kik ineki,kendo ngʼato angʼata moneko ibiro ngʼadne bura.’
english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

kikuyu: Eka achiel kuom jonabi nowachone Elisha niya, “Donge ber idhi kodwa?” Elisha nodwoke niya, “Abiro dhi kodu.”
english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Ma en kamano mondo mi giyie ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi; Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo osefwenyoreni.”
english: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Ne arito Jehova Nyasaye ka ahora mos; ne odwogo ira mi owinjo ywakna.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

kikuyu: Ka Musa nowacho ne jo-Israel duto wachni kendo ne giywak gi lit ahinya.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

kikuyu: Chunya orewore kendo oner ka lum; wiya wil kata mana gi chamo chiemba.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

kikuyu: Kata kamano pod odwaro nyiso ngʼwono mare kuome; obiro mondo onyisu kech mare. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma ja-adiera. Jogo duto mogeno kuome ogwedhi.
english: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

kikuyu: Nodhi ire motweyo adhondene kooloe mo kod divai. Eka noketo ngʼatno e ngʼe pundane owuon kendo notere e od bworo kendo norite maber.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

kikuyu: Eka jodolo kod jonabi nowachone jotelo kod ji duto niya, “Ngʼatni onego ngʼadne buch nek nikech nokoro kuom dala maduongʼni. Usewinje gi itu uwegi!”
english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye nochweyo dhano e kite owuon, e kit Nyasaye nochweye; nochweyogi dichwo gi dhako.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

kikuyu: Kane Nyarombo noketho kido mar ariyo, ne awinjo gima ngima mar ariyo kaluongo niya, “Bi!”
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

kikuyu: Bangʼe Nehemia ma jatelo, Ezra jadolo kendo japuonj chik, kod jo-Lawi mane puonjo ji nowachonegi duto niya, “Odiechiengni owal ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. Kik uywagi kendo kik ugo nduru.” Nimar ji duto nosebedo ka goyo nduru kane gichiko itgi ka giwinjo weche manie Chik.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to the LORD your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Yesu koro ne ok wuothi e dier jo-Yahudi ka ji nene. Nopondo modhi e gwengʼ man but thim, e dala miluongo ni Efraim, kendo nobet kuno gi jopuonjrene.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Sa moro ginichik itgi kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato olokre owe yorene maricho. Eka analok pacha kendo ok anakel kuomgi masira mane achano nikech timbe maricho magisetimo.
english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”

kikuyu: Kanyakla mar jonabi nowachone Elisha niya, “Neye, kaka kama wadakie kodini tin.
english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye noketh Babulon; nomi koko olingʼ thi. Apaka mag wasigu nowuo ka pige mopongʼ; koko mar dwondgi nowinjre kendo.
english: For the LORD lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

kikuyu: Ne ok gitieko ogendini chutho kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechikogi,
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

kikuyu: Nochiwo ne Juda chik ni mondo omany Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kweregi kendo orit chikene kod buchene.
english: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

kikuyu: to kik usungru ne bede yath mamoko. To kapo ni utimo kamano, to paraneuru wachni: Ok un ema utingʼo tiend yath, to tiend yath ema otingʼou.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

kikuyu: Kuom laru mantie yo podho chiengʼ, angʼwen ne rito yo michopogo e laru to ariyo ne rito laruno.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

kikuyu: Kendo Israel nowacho niya, “Ayie ni Josef wuoda pod ngima. Abiro dhi mondo anene kapok atho.”
english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

kikuyu: Gipakore gi gin jotich Kristo? Ka awuoyo kamano, to achalo mana janeko. An awuon an jatich maber! Asetiyo matek; osetweya e od twech kuom kinde mangʼeny; osechwada; kendo asebedo machiegni gi tho moloyo ngʼato angʼata kuomgi.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

kikuyu: Joshua nokawo ji madirom alufu abich mooro yo podho chiengʼ mar Ai mondo opond e kind Bethel kod dala maduongʼno.
english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

kikuyu: Jadolo matimo misango miwangʼo pep ma ngʼato ochiwo nodongʼ gi pien chiayono kaka mare owuon.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

kikuyu: Daudi nowacho niya, “Wuoda Solomon pod rawera mayot kendo en gi ngʼeyo matin, to ot monego ogerne Jehova Nyasaye nyaka bed miwuoro kendo ma humbe gi berne onego onere e piny mangima. Omiyo nyaka aikne gige gedo.” Kuom mano, Daudi noiko gik moko mangʼeny kapok otho.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

kikuyu: Joma odak e dalano duto nowuok kadhi ire.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

kikuyu: Koro Daudi gi joge nodhi momonjo jo-Geshur, jo-Girzi, gi jo-Amalek. Kochakore chon jogi nodak e piny mochopo Shur nyaka Misri.
english: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Gideon niya, “In-gi ji mangʼeny ma ok anyal chiwo jo-Midian e lwetgi. Mondo kik jo-Israel sungrena ni tekogi ema oresogi,
english: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

kikuyu: To giseluwo mana timbegi mag wich teko; bende giseluwo bangʼ Baal, mana kaka wuonegi nopuonjogi.”
english: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo, gima ne atimone Shilo koro abiro timo ne ot miluongogo Nyinga, hekalu ma ugeno kuomeno, kama ne amiyou kod wuoneu.
english: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

kikuyu: Kane Jeroboam wuod Nebat nowinjo wachni (ne pod en Misri kuma noringo odhiye koa kuom ruoth Solomon), noduogo koa Misri.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

kikuyu: Nyiseche mane gilamo e magi: Ji mane oa Babulon noloso Sukoth-Benoth, ji mane oa Kutha noloso Nergal to ji mane oa Hamath noloso Ashima;
english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

kikuyu: Japuonjrene machielo nowachone niya, “Ruoth, yiena adhi ayik wuonwa mondi.”
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Yamo futo kochomo kuma ohero, kendo inyalo winje, to ok inyal nyiso kuma oaye kata kuma odhiye. Mano bende e gima timore ni ngʼato ka ngʼato monywol kuom Roho.”
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

kikuyu: Magi bende gin weche mag jomariek: Luoro wangʼ kuom ngʼado bura ok ber:
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

kikuyu: Yaye jo-Israel, keturu genou kuom Jehova Nyasaye, nimar Jehova Nyasaye nigi hera ma ok rem, kendo en ema owaro ji chuth.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Atingʼo wangʼa ka arango, in ma kom lochni ni e polo.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

kikuyu: Nyisgi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, wacho: ‘Okwongʼ ngʼatno ma ok oluoro gima singruokni dwaro,
english: and say to them, the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

kikuyu: Ka ruoth ongʼado bura ne jochan kod adiera, kom ruodhe biro bedo moritore ma ok hinyre.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

kikuyu: E higa mar angʼwen mar loch Hezekia, ma en higa mar abiriyo mar Hoshea wuod Ela ruodh Israel, Shalmaneser ruodh Asuria nomonjo Samaria kendo jolweny nolwore.
english: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.

kikuyu: Richo mag yawuowigi ne lich ahinya e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nikech ne gichayo gima ochiw ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men despised the LORD’s offering.

kikuyu: Kar bolori to isetingʼori malo mondo iked gi Ruodh polo. Isegolo chik mi okelni tewni kigolo e hekalu Mare, kendo in, kaachiel gi jodongi gi mondi kod jotichni ma nyiri miloko mondi, usemadho kodgi divai. Ne upako nyiseche mag fedha, gi dhahabu, gi mula, gi nyinyo, gi yien mopa kod kidi, ma ok nyal neno kata winjo kata ngʼeyo tiend gimoro. To Nyasaye motingʼo ngimani e lwete kaachiel gi yoregi duto, to ne idagi miyo luor.
english: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, or hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways.

kikuyu: “ ‘E thuoloni duto ma en e bwo singruok mar bedo tenge, wiye ok noliel gi wembe. Enorite maler ne Jehova Nyasaye nyaka ndalone mag kwongʼruok norum; kendo enopidh yie wiye maboyo.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

kikuyu: Kata bed ni awuoyo gi dhok mopogore opogore mag dhano kod mag malaike, to aonge gihera, to achalo mana ongengʼo maywak kata olangʼ migoyo.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

kikuyu: analuong ji duto moa yo nyandwat kod jatichna Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho, kendo giniked gi pinyni kod joma odakie kod ogendini molworogi duto. Anatiekgi chuth mi gibed gima bwogo ji kendo minyiero, kendo gima okethi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says the LORD, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

kikuyu: “Mon mangʼeny timo gik mabeyo, to in iloyogi duto.”
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne owachona niya,
english: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: Uoworu gi gombo manono ka un e tiend yiend ober kod yiende mamoko motimo otiep; kendo kanyo ema uwangʼoe nyithindu ka misengini e holni kendo e kuonde rogo.
english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

kikuyu: Kane oganda owinjo weche manyoso chunygo negichako ywak maonge ngʼama nolichore gi gimoro amora e dende.
english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ne nigi Joshua kendo humbe nolandore e pinyno duto.
english: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

kikuyu: Jopuonjrene dhogi nomoko, kendo ne gingʼiyore kendgi ka giparo ni en ngʼa kuomgi ma nowuoyo kuome.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

kikuyu: gin duto anakelgi e goda maler mi anamigi mor e oda mar lamo. Chiwo mag-gi mag misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko nayiego e kendona mar misango; kendo oda noluongi ni od lamo mar ogendini duto.”
english: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

kikuyu: Ka usetho gi Kristo mi ogonyou kuom timbe machon mag pinyni, to koro ere gima omiyo pod uwuotho ka jopiny? Angʼo momiyo pod umako chike mawacho niya,
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

kikuyu: Koro Israel nohero Josef moloyo yawuote mamoko, nikech en nyathi mane onywolne ka oseti, kendo nolosone law mar kandho maber.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

kikuyu: To nowachone niya, “Iparo ni kawo chwora en gima tin koso? Kendo pod idwaroe mandrake mag wuoda bende?” Rael nodwoke niya, “Mano ber, to kimiya mandrake mar wuodi to Jakobo wangʼ nonindo e odi kawuono otieno.”
english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

kikuyu: Wan joma odak gi kwe kendo ma jo-adiera e piny Israel ka. In to itemo mondo iketh dala maduongʼ man Israel. Angʼo momiyo idwaro tieko oganda Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”

kikuyu: Wan, kaachiel gi Roho Maler, ma Nyasaye miyo joma omiye luor wasebedo joneno kuom wechegi.”
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

kikuyu: Nyasaye nochiwe kaka misango mar golo richo, nikech yie kuom rembe. Ne otimo ma mondo onyis timne makare, nikech e kinde motelo, Nyasaye ne ok odewo richo mane ji osetimo nikech kechne.
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

kikuyu: Ruodh Asuria noyie momonjo Damaski kendo okawe. Nodaro joma odak Damaski motero e twech Kir, Rezin to ne onego.
english: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

kikuyu: Pak obed ni Nyasaye ma wuon Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, mosegwedhowa kod gweth duto mag chuny koa e polo kuom Kristo.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

kikuyu: Wangʼ jachode bende rito mondo piny oimre; oparo e chunye niya, ‘Onge ngʼat ma biro nena,’ kendo opando wangʼe mondo kik ngʼeye.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

kikuyu: kama nodonjo e dala Zekaria kendo nomoso Elizabeth.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Jonathan nogolo lawe mane orwako momiyo Daudi, nomiye lawe mar akor, gi liganglane bende, atungʼ gi okandane.
english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

kikuyu: Nyarombo ka nyarombo nokel gi misango miolo piny maromo divai lita achiel. Nyaka uol divaino ei kama ler mar lemo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

kikuyu: Ne ok ayude kuom dhano moro amora, to bende ne ok opuonjago. Yesu Kristo owuon ema nofwenyona wachno.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: To ka ariembo jochiende gi teko mar Roho Maler to kare pinyruoth Nyasaye osebironu.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

kikuyu: “Wan to Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasachwa kendo ok waseweye ngangʼ. Jodolo matiyone Jehova Nyasaye gin yawuot Harun kendo jo-Lawi konyogi e tijno.
english: “But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

kikuyu: Asebiro e piny kaka ler, mondo ngʼato angʼata moyie kuoma kik sik e mudho.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

kikuyu: Aselonyo lepa, koro idwaro ni achak arwakra kendo? Aselwoko tienda, koro idwaro ni achak anyon lowo kendo?
english: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?

kikuyu: To Yesu nomako bad wuowino mokonye aa malo mochungʼ.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

kikuyu: Kane jakwechono pod otwere kuom Petro gi Johana, ji duto nohum nono. Negibiro gingʼwech ir jootego nyaka kama iluongo ni Agoch Solomon.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

kikuyu: Mad jomariek chik itgi mondo owinji kendo gimedgi e puonjruokgi, to jogo mongʼeyo pogo tiend wach mad oyud gino ma chikogi,
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

kikuyu: Benaya wuod Jehoyada to ne jatend joka Kereth kod joka Peleth, to yawuot Daudi to ne gin jotelo madongo makonyo ruoth.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

kikuyu: kendo ilos sirni ariyo mibiro ketoe konde ariyo man yo tok Hemb Romo.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

kikuyu: Osegombo mondo oneu ahinya, kendo chunye chandore nikech nuwinjo ni notuo ahinya.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

kikuyu: Jogo nowuok kendo negiluwo yo madhi Sodom, to Jehova Nyasaye nodongʼ kochungʼ e nyim Ibrahim.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

kikuyu: En ohala mane ma dhano yudo kuom tije duto motiyo kendo mochandore godo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Tongʼ-gi nochakore Helef modhi nyaka kar yien maduongʼ man Zananim, koluwo Adami Nekeb gi Jabnel mochopo Lakum kendo gikone ne en aora Jordan.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

kikuyu: Kinyne Paulo kaachiel kodwa nodhi mondo one Jakobo kendo jodongo duto nochokore kodwa.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

kikuyu: Noleko ni oneno ngas konyono piny to wiye ochopo e polo kendo malaika mag Nyasaye ne luwe kadhi malo kendo lor piny.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

kikuyu: Kane ok giyude, negidok Jerusalem mondo gimanye.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

kikuyu: Karaya mar Nam gi rwedhi apar gariyo manie e bwoye;
english: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

kikuyu: Ma en ngʼa mabiro koa Bozra dala maduongʼ mar Edom korwako lewni makwar mochido? Ma en ngʼa morwakore gi law duongʼ, kowuotho gi sunga nikech teko ma en-go? En an Jehova Nyasaye ema awuoyo gi tim makare makelo warruok.
english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

kikuyu: Ibiro manyo wasikigo to ok iniyudgi. Chutho jogo makedo kodi ok nobed gimoro kata matin.”
english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.

kikuyu: Negiketo kedhno e chiemba kendo negimiya kong andwayo mondo otiekna riyo.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

kikuyu: Omiyo Abimelek kod jolweny mage duto nowuok gotieno, ne gipogore e migepe angʼwen mi gibuto mondo gimonj Shekem.
english: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

kikuyu: Omiyo nakawo joma otelo ne dhoutu, ma gin joma riek momi luor kendo naketogi mondo gibed loch kuomu kaka jotend oganda. Moko kuomgi naketo jotend ji alufu alufu, to moko jotend mia mia, to moko jotend ji piero abich abich, bangʼe moko jotend ji apar apar kendo moko naketo jotelo mopogore opogore e dhoutgi duto.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

kikuyu: mondo ingʼe adier mar gik mosepuonji.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

kikuyu: “Paruru matut kuom wachni, un joma wigi wil gi Nyasaye, nono to abiro kidhou matindo tindo, maonge ngʼama diresu:
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato wiye kuot koda kod wechena, Wuod Dhano bende wiye biro kuot kode ka obiro duogo e duongʼ mare kendo e duongʼ mar Wuoro kod mar malaike maler.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

kikuyu: E kindeno Ruoth Nyasaye nokonyre gi wembe mokwa tok Aora kocha ma en ruodh Asuria, mondo olielgo yie wiyeu, yie tiendeu kod yie tiku bende.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

kikuyu: Omiyo nodongo marabora ma oyombo yiende duto mag bungu; bedene madongo nomedo yarore kendo bedene matindo nodongo ma roboche, kendo noyarore nikech negiyudo pi moromogi.
english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.

kikuyu: Ji notiyone Jehova Nyasaye e ndalo duto mag ngima Joshua kod jodongo mane osedak higni moloye kendo mane oseneno gigo madongo ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni Israel.
english: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osetimona maber ka oluwore gi timna makare; osechiwona ka oluwore gi ler mar lwetena.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

kikuyu: Ma e japuonjre makoro timo neno kuom gigi kendo en bende ema nondikogi piny. Wangʼeyo ni nende en adier.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

kikuyu: Omiyo noloso del gi piende molir olir, kendo noriembo ji duto oko ei hekalu, kod rombe gi dhok bende. Nokeyo pesa mag jowil pesa, kendo noloko mesnigi ataro.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ngʼato ka ngʼato mamodho pigni riyo biro chako loye,
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kikuyu: Gisano ne giweyo gogo mag-gi gisano mi giluwe.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye rito jadak kendo okonyo nyathi kich gi dhako ma chwore otho, to yore mag ngʼama timbene richo to orocho.
english: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye odagi paro mar joricho, to jogo ma chunygi ler miye mor.
english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

kikuyu: Harun nokendo Elisheba nyar Aminadab ma bende nyamin Nashon, kendo nonywolone Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Bangʼ Elon, Abdon wuod Hillel, moa Pirathon, notelo ne Israel.
english: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

kikuyu: Donge fweny ma useneno en miriambo, kendo gik mukoro gin mag wuond ka uwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osewacho,” to an Jehova Nyasaye pok awacho gimoro?
english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”

kikuyu: Mad ywak winji koa e utegi ka ikelo joma dwaro monjogi apoya nono, nimar gisekunyona bugo mondo gimaka kendo giseketo obadho mondo gimak godo tienda.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.

kikuyu: Abiro chiwo lum ne jamni mau kendo unuchiem ma uyiengʼ.
english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

kikuyu: Wachni koler tiende to kelo ler, omiyo joma riekogi tin bedo gi winjo.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

kikuyu: Bed ni bor polo nosiko koumo kar lemo kuom ndalo ariyo, dwe achiel kata higa achiel, to jo-Israel ne siko e kambi kendo ne ok gichak wuoth; to ka bor polono ne oyawore, to negichako wuoth.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Joshua, kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto nokawo Akan ma nyakwar Zera, gi fedha, gi njora, gi dhahabu, yawuote kod nyige, dhok, punde kod rombe, hembe kod gigo duto ma en godo mi giterogi nyaka e holo mar Akor.
english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.

kikuyu: Pwodhruok ma otimore kawuononi kuomu e kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochika ni atimnu.
english: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Giniyud kum ma en lal manyaka chiengʼ, koriembogi oko e nyim Ruoth Nyasaye kendo mabor gi tekone man-gi duongʼ.
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jotich nodwoko niya, “Aseneno wuod Jesse moro ma ja-Bethlehem mongʼeyo goyo nyatiti. En ngʼat ma jachir bende en jalweny. Owuoyo maber kendo en jaber. To bende Jehova Nyasaye ni kode.”
english: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the LORD is with him.”

kikuyu: to Eliasaf wuod Dewel notelo ne dhood Gad.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

kikuyu: Kane Maritha owinjo ni Yesu biro, nowuok oko mondo oromne, ka Maria to nodongʼ ei ot.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

kikuyu: Ok akweru nikech wach misengini mutimona, kata nikech misango miwangʼo pep, mosiko ka nitie e nyima.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

kikuyu: To Yesu nongʼiyogi tir mi owachonegi niya, “Mano en gima ok nyalre kuom dhano, to ok kuom Nyasaye, nimar kuom Nyasaye to gik moko duto nyalore.”
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Wadhiuru Jordan mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato otongʼ yien kendo wagergo kama waduto wanyalo dakie.” Nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru.”
english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

kikuyu: Ngʼatni nyaka riti kaka jatich mondiki kendo ngʼat mane ongʼiewe ok oyiene mondo osande.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

kikuyu: To wuowi moro miluongo ni Yutiko nobet e dho dirisa, kendo nindo nomedo tere ka Paulo ne pod medo puonjo. Kane en e chuny nindo, nolwar gie dirisa koa e gorofa mar adek mi nokwanye piny mwalo kosetho.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

kikuyu: Gayo, moserwaka e ode, kaachiel gi kanisa duto, omosou. Erasto, jakeno maduongʼ mar dalani, kod owadwa Kwarto bende ooronu mos. [
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

kikuyu: Bende oseora mondo aland ni ma e higa mar ngʼwono mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo chiengʼ ma Nyasachwa biro chuloe kuor, kohoyo ji duto manie kuyo,
english: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

kikuyu: “Tuo marach osekete piny; ok obi aa malo kama oninde.”
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

kikuyu: Gouru erokamano ne Nyasach polo, Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Eka Adoni-Bezek nowacho niya, “Ruodhi piero abiriyo ma lith lwetegi mathuon kod lith tiendegi mathuon osengʼad oko osebedo ka chamo ngʼinjo e bwo mesana. Koro Nyasaye osechula kuom gigo mane atimonegi.” Negikele Jerusalem, kendo notho kanyo.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

kikuyu: nimar gibiro miyo ngimani dhi maber midag higni mangʼeny kendo ibed gi kwe kod mwandu.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

kikuyu: Koro wenge Israel ne ok nyal neno maber nikech hike noniangʼ. Kuom mano Josef nosudo nyithindo machiegni kendo Israel nokwakogi monyodhogi.
english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

kikuyu: Negiwuok Dibon Gad mi gibworo Almon Diblathaim.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

kikuyu: “En ngʼama ruodh Israel dwaro mondo onegi? Ilawo ngʼa? Guok motho koso kikun?
english: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

kikuyu: Eka Lawi noloso nyasi maduongʼ mar rwako Yesu e ode, oganda maduongʼ mar josol osuru kaachiel gi ji mamoko nobiro ne chiemo kodgi.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

kikuyu: To nowuok odhiyo oko kendo noywak malit.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: to ka yamo okudhe matin nono to kare orumo, kendo ok chak pare.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nolor koa ei boche kendo nochungʼ kanyo kod Musa kohulone nyinge mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Odiro pe mage e piny ka kit ombo. En ngʼa manyalo ngino sa ma odiro pe kamano?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

kikuyu: Kik watem Ruoth, kaka moko kuomgi notimo, mi thuonde nonegogi.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

kikuyu: Nikech ka chiengʼ rieny maliet to owangʼo maua kod thiepene kendo gilwar piny kendo berne rumo. Kamano bende e kaka ja-mwandu biro lal nono, kata mana kotiyo tijene.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

kikuyu: Ne otimo timbe duto mane wuon mare otimo, kendo nolamo kido duto mane wuon mare olamo kendo okulorenegi.
english: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

kikuyu: Negimako Petro gi Johana, to kaka piny koro ne dwaro yuso, negiketogi e od twech nyaka kinyne.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

kikuyu: Nimar kuome usebedo momew e yore duto kuom weche ma uwacho kod ngʼeyo ma un-go,
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

kikuyu: e kinde mane onenoe rieko mi opimo berne kaka chalo mi onwangʼo.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

kikuyu: Eka dwol moro nobiro koa ewi gima opedhore mane ni e wigi, kane oyudo gichungʼ to bwombegi ne lor piny.
english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mariek manyalo winjo tiend ma? En ngʼa mosetiegi gi Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyalo lero tiende? Angʼo momiyo piny osekethi modongʼ nono ka kama otwo maonge ngʼama nyalo luwo?
english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?

kikuyu: Jomoko chalo gi kodhi molwar e dir yo, kama ichwoyoe Wach. E sa nogo ma jogi owinjoe Wach to Satan biro mi magi Wach ma giwinjono.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

kikuyu: To ka chwore ok owacho gimoro kuom wachno odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, to nochop kwongʼruok mage kod singruok mage duto motwerego. Kwongʼruokgo nosiki nikech kane owinjogi to nolingʼ.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Kidwaro doko malongʼo chuth to dhiyo ius gigi duto mondo imi joma odhier eka inibed gi mwandu e polo. Bangʼ timo kamano to bi mondo iluwa.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

kikuyu: “To ka giketho e nyimi, nimar onge ngʼato kata achiel ma ok jaketho mi ikecho kodgi kendo ichiwogi e lwet wasigu mi giterogi e twech e piny mabor kata machiegni,
english: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato moro kuomu nigi wach moro gi wadgi, ere kaka doter wachno e nyim joma okia Nyasaye mondo ongʼad bucheno, kar kelo wachno e nyim jomaler?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

kikuyu: obiro gwedho joma oluoro Jehova Nyasaye, ji ajia kod joma igeno.
english: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

kikuyu: “Tangʼuru gi jonabi mag miriambo. Gibiro iru ka girwako lep rombe, to gin mana ondiegi mangemo gi eigi.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

kikuyu: Adwaro ni mondo upar weche mane jonabi maler okoro chon kod chik mane omiu koa kuom Ruodhwa kendo Jawarwa kokadho kuom joote magu.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

kikuyu: Eka ne achiwora ne winjo tiend rieko, ngʼeyo pogruok manie kind rieko, memruok kod fuwo, to ne afwenyo ni magi gin mana lawo bangʼ yamo mafuto.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Ka ihero Nyasaye gi chunyi duto gi riekoni duto gi tekoni duto, kendo kihero wadu kaka iherori iwuon to mano duongʼ moloyo misango miwangʼo pep gi misengini mamoko.”
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

kikuyu: Eka Pul ruodh Asuria nomonjo pinyno, mi Menahem nomiye fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia adek mondo Pul okonyego jiwo lochne obed motegno.
english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mangima kendo wuotho nobed chiembu. Mana kaka asemiyou alode, koro amiyou gik moko duto.”
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

kikuyu: Musa nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, ok asebedo ngʼat ma wuoyo kalewe yot chakre chon kata e sa misebedo ka iwuoyo kod misumbani. Lewa pek kendo aywayo wach.”
english: Moses said to the LORD, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

kikuyu: Kutimo mago eka ler ma un-go nonen ka ler mar okinyi kendo chang maru nobi mapiyo; bende timu makare notel nyimu kendo teko gi duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodongʼnu chien.
english: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nolor piny mondo one dala maduongʼ kod ohinga mabor mane dhano gero.
english: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo dwond Ruoth Nyasaye kapenjo niya, “Ere ngʼama abiro oro? Koso en ngʼa monego odhinwa?” Kendo ne adwoko niya, “Eri antie, ora!”
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

kikuyu: Tho mar nyithind Nyasaye en gima ber miwuoro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

kikuyu: Pi nogingore kendo omedore ahinya e piny kendo yie ne lewore ewi pi.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Owetena, kik uketh nying joweteu. Ngʼato angʼata ma wuoyo marach kuom nyawadgi kata mangʼado ni nyawadgi bura nyaka ngʼe ni Chik ema owuoyo kuome marach kendo ongʼadone bura. To ngʼat mangʼado ni Chik bura ok orito Chik nikech osedoko ngʼama ngʼadone bura.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

kikuyu: “Thuondegi! Kothe thuond fu-gi! Ubiro tony nade mak ongʼadnu buch Gehena?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

kikuyu: Ka ikadho ei pige matut, to anabed kodi; kendo ka ungʼado aore to ok giniteru. Ka uwuotho e mach mager to ok nowangʼu, kata mana mach makakni ok nowangʼu.
english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar adek Esta norwako lawe mar duongʼ kaka mikach ruoth mochungʼ e laru maiye mar dala ruoth, kama omanyore gi ot maduongʼ ma ruoth bedoe; Ruoth ne oyudo obedo e kome mar duongʼ e ot, kama omanyore gi dhoot.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

kikuyu: Donge un gi miechu munyalo chiemoe kendo methoe? Koso uchayo kanisa Nyasaye, momiyo ukuodo wi joma ochando? Angʼo ma dawachnu? Uparo ni dapaku kuom wachni? Ok kamano ngangʼ!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

kikuyu: “Nyasaye nogologi Misri; kendo gin gi teko machalo mar jowi. Gikidho oganda jowasikgi kendo gituro chokegi matindo tindo; kendo gichwowogi gi aserni mag-gi.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

kikuyu: Anatiek nyar Sayun, ma ber neno kendo ma dende yom.
english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Kuom nus mar pok jo-Israel kawuru achiel kuom piero abich, bed ni gin ji, dhok, punde, rombe, diek kata jamni mamoko. Chiwgi ne jo-Lawi ma tijgi en rito hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

kikuyu: Nayiero wuonu e kind dhout Israel mondo obed jadolona mondo oidh malo e kendona mar misango, mondo owangʼ ubani, kendo orwak law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod e nyima. Ne achako amiyo od wuonu misengini duto ma jo-Israel wangʼo gi mach.
english: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

kikuyu: Daudi nokawo kuodi molos gi dhahabu mane mag jotend lweny mar Hadadezer, mi okelogi Jerusalem.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: En ngʼa moloyo piny? Mana ngʼat moyie ni Yesu en Wuod Nyasaye.
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

kikuyu: Lep mariambo mon kod jogo mohinyo, to dhok mawuondo ji kelo kethruok.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

kikuyu: To kane jowete ofwenyo wachni, ne gigole kanyo mi gidhi kode nyaka Kaisaria, bangʼe giore nyaka Tarso.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

kikuyu: Nyi Zelofehad wuod Hefer, ma wuod Gilead, ma wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase, ne gin joka Manase wuod Josef. Nyirigo ne gin Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka kod Tirza. Negisudo machiegni gi
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Ywakgi winjore nyaka e tongʼ Moab, nduru margi chopo nyaka Eglaim, kendo dengo margi landore nyaka Beer Elim.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

kikuyu: “Enone malit ngʼat mamiyo jobathe math, ka omedogi ameda nyaka gimer, mondo one dug-gi.
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

kikuyu: Kendo malaika mar abiriyo bende noolo tape e yamo; eka dwol maduongʼ nowuok koa ei hekalu e nyim kom maduongʼ mar loch kawacho niya, “Osetimore!”
english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

kikuyu: Chikeni e morna; gin e jongʼad rieko maga.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

kikuyu: Anami odag amingʼa kendo ananyise warruokna.”
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

kikuyu: Eka Ruoth Daudi nowacho niya, “Luongna Bathsheba.” Kuom mano nobiro mochungʼ e nyime.
english: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

kikuyu: kaluwore gi nywolgi ka nying yawuowi auchiel ondikie kidi achiel, to auchiel modongʼ ondikie kidi machielo.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

kikuyu: Negiwuoro puonjne, nikech wechene ne nigi teko.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

kikuyu: Asir nonywolo Tahath, Tahath nonywolo Uriel, Uriel nonywolo Uzia, to Uzia nonywolo Shaul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

kikuyu: Abiro riera piny mi anind gi kwe, nikech in kendi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in ema imiyo adak gi kwe.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

kikuyu: “Mano kaka otieke! Mano kaka gidengo! Mano kaka Moab loko ngʼeye kopondo nikech wichkuot! Moab osebedo gir ajara, gima bwogo ji duto man bute.”
english: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”

kikuyu: Simon gi jowetene ne jodhi manye,
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

kikuyu: bende inyalo konye yaro polo, mi obed matek ka mula mothedhi?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

kikuyu: Hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mane Musa oloso e thim, kaachiel gi kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep e kindego ne pod nitiere e kar lemo man Gibeon.
english: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

kikuyu: Aywagora ne Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, Nyasaye machopona chenroge ema aywakne.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

kikuyu: Enokelne Jehova Nyasaye gi lwete owuon boche miwangʼo gi mach kaachiel gi agoke kendo enolier agokono kofwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Pilato nowachonegi niya, “Kaweuru un uwegi udhi ungʼadne bura kaka chiku dwaro.” To jo-Yahudi nodagi, kagiwacho niya, “Wan waonge gi teko mar ngʼado ne ngʼato buch tho.”
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

kikuyu: Ka ayalo kuom dwarona to ayudo mich, to ka ok kuom dwarona, to mano nyiso ni achopo ote mano mane omiya.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

kikuyu: Negilosone ratege molworore angʼwen mag dhahabu kendo ne gitweyogi e konde angʼwen mag mesa kama ne nitie tiendene.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

kikuyu: kuma oyombo loch duto gi teko gi telo gi nyalo kod nyinge duto minyalo chiw ok e ndaloni kende to kata e ndalo mabiro.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Daudi, jo-Lawi duto mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Nyasaye, jower kaachiel gi Kenania mane otelo ne jower norwakore gi aroche mag bafta. Daudi bende norwako law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

kikuyu: Wende jogo thum nyatiti gi jower, kod jogo asili gi jogo tungʼ, ok nowinj kuomi ngangʼ. Kata ja-ohala moro amora ok noyud kuomi ngangʼ, bende pongʼ marego ok nowinj kuomi ngangʼ.
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

kikuyu: Nowachone niya, “Ne an-gi adieri ni ok idware, omiyo ne amiye osiepni. Donge nyamin mare matin ber neno moloye? En ema koro ikawe.”
english: Her father said, “I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead.”

kikuyu: Kaka boche polo gi yamo maonge koth, e kaka ngʼat mawuorore gi mich ma ok dochiw.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

kikuyu: Ruodh Shimron Meron, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Akshaf, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

kikuyu: Omiyo, adwaro mondo ungʼe ni ngʼama Roho mar Nyasaye otelone ok nyal wacho niya, “Okwongʼ Yesu” to bende onge ngʼama nyalo wacho niya, “Yesu en Ruoth” ka ok Roho Maler ema otelone.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokawo kikombe mi ogoyo erokamano bangʼe omiyogi kowacho niya, “Madhuru gima ni e iye, un duto.
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

kikuyu: Ben-Hadad noyie gi Ruoth Asa kendo nooro jotende mag lweny mondo omonj mier madongo mag Israel. Negiloyo Ijon, gi Dan kod Abel Maim kaachiel gi mier mag madongo mag keno mag Naftali.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo wakalo e tiend chula moro matin miluongo ni Kauda, ne wabedo gi pek mar keto yie matin mar resruok kama ber, mondo kik okethre.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

kikuyu: Kik iyie gi ketho modonjnego jaduongʼ kanisa kaonge joneno ariyo kata adek.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Eka Ayub nodwoko ni,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Kiti kod timbegi iwuon osemiyo ma obiro kuomi. Ma en kum mari. Mano kaka olit! Mano kaka opowo nyaka e chuny!”
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

kikuyu: omiyo yie kodwa mondo itim kaka wanyisi. Nitie chwo angʼwen e dierwa ka mosetimo singruok.
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

kikuyu: Kane ochwalore nyime koa kanyo, noneno owete ariyo mamoko, Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana. Ne gin e yie kaachiel gi wuon-gi ma Zebedi, ka giloso gokegi. Yesu noluongogi,
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ochier kogwen, chiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, nofwenyore mokwongo ne Maria ma aa Magdala, mane ogolo jochiende abiriyo kuome.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

kikuyu: In ema ne iyawo sokni gi aore, kendo ne imiyo aore madongo ma ok dwon otwo.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

kikuyu: Manoa no-aa malo moluwo bangʼ chiege. Kane ochopo ir ngʼatno, nowacho niya, “In e ngʼama nowuoyo kod chiega?” Nodwoke niya, “Ee, en an.”
english: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”

kikuyu: Jakobo notingʼo wangʼe moneno Esau kabiro ka en gi ji mia angʼwen. Kuom mano nopogo nyithindo e kind Lea gi Rael kod jotichne mamon ariyo.
english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye, mosemiyo Nyinge olandore ka, lok ruoth moro amora kata joma tingʼo bedegi malo mondo olok chikni kata oketh hekaluni man Jerusalem. An, Darius asegolo chik, kendo chikni nyaka chopi ma ok orem.
english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nopenje tiend ngerono.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

kikuyu: Jopuonjre nodhi ire mochiewe, kagiwachone niya, “Ruoth, reswa! Wadhi nimo!”
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

kikuyu: Negitimo misango gi rwedhi abiriyo kod rombe abiriyo nikech Nyasaye nokonyo jo-Lawi manotingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

kikuyu: Anabed wuon-gi to enobed wuoda. Ka otimo marach, to anakume, ka achwade gi lwet dhano kendo noyud chwat koa kuom ji.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

kikuyu: Ngʼat mariek iye ok wangʼ piyo; oyudo duongʼ kuom weyo wach ma ok odewo ketho.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

kikuyu: Bangʼe negigomo ma giluwo yo madhi Bashan, kendo Og ruodh Bashan gi jolweny mage duto nowuok riat mokedo kodwa e lweny Edrei.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka onego time: Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka we gope ma ja-Israel wadgi nigo. Ok onego okaw chudo kuom ja-Israel kata wadgi nikech ndalo mar weyo gowi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye oselandi.
english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.

kikuyu: Kuom loch mane ichiwo, duongʼ mare duongʼ; isemiye huma gi luor.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

kikuyu: Negibiro ire mi giwachone niya, “Japuonj wangʼeyo ni in ngʼama ja-ratiro. Ji ok nyal ywayi maloki nikech ok iluoro wangʼ ngʼato, to ipuonjo mana yor Nyasaye kaluwore gi adierane. Koro nyiswa ane, bende en gima kare mondo wagol osuru ne Kaisar koso ok owinjore?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

kikuyu: Owadgi ma Abisalom nopenjo niya, “Dibedni owadu ma Amnon osebedo kodi e achiel? Koro sani lingʼ mos nyamera; en owadu. Kik wachni chand chunyi.” Kendo Tamar nodak gi Abisalom e ode, ka en dhako mokuyo.
english: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

kikuyu: Mano kaka tiendeni beyo kirwako pat pat, yaye nyar joka ruoth! Tiendeni pichni ka kite ma nengogi tek, ka gima jopecho molony ema opayo.
english: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Hezekia nobedo matuo kendo nohewore. Janabi Isaya wuod Amoz nodhi ire mowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Los weche mag dalani maber nikech ndaloni mar tho ochopo kendo ok inichangi.”
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma ok dew kum ochayore owuon, to ngʼat mawinjo kikwere medo winjo wach.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho ni Ahija niya, Chi Jeroboam biro penji kuom wuode, nimar otuo kendo nyaka imiye dwoko machalo kama kata kamacha. Kochopo to obiro wuondore ni en ngʼat machielo.
english: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

kikuyu: kinde mar kuyo kod kinde mar mor, kinde mar ywak kod kinde mar miel,
english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho bende niya, “Odongʼ ndalo matin to ok ubi nena, to bangʼe matin achien ubiro nena kendo.”
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

kikuyu: Chunoni agulu motedie ringʼo mar misango mar golo richo nyaka too; to ka aguch mula ema otedee, to nyaka rudhe maler mi bangʼe lawe gi pi.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

kikuyu: E sa ma ji paro ni piny okwe kendo weche beyo, ema masira nopogie kadiemo wangʼ, mana kaka muoch poyo dhako man-gi ich, bende ok ginitony.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

kikuyu: “Dhiyo mondo irom gi Ahab ruodh Israel molocho Samaria. Koro entie e puoth Naboth mar mzabibu mosedhiye mondo okaw obed mare.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

kikuyu: Omiyo koth chue e piny; kendo omiyo puothe bedo mangʼich.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

kikuyu: Zefania jadolo, kata kamano, nosomo baruwani ne Jeremia janabi.
english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech gimiyo joga lal, kagiwacho niya, “Kwe,” to kwe to onge, kendo nikech ka ji ogero kor ot mayom yom moro to giwire gi lowo marachar,
english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye Maratego! Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye Maratego! Ongʼeyo gik moko duto! Israel mondo ongʼe! Ka dipo ni ma notim e yor ngʼanyo, kata bedo maonge gi luor ne Jehova Nyasaye, to kik ingʼwon-nwa kawuono.
english: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against the LORD (don’t save us today),
