kikuyu: Nyise kama, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, Donge isenego ngʼato kendo mikawo mwandune?’ Wachne kendo ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho, Kama guogi nonangʼoe remb Naboth, bende e kama guogi biro nangʼoe rembi in iwuon, ee, mana in!’ ”
english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye kelo resruok maduongʼ ne ruoth moketo, onyiso hera mogundho ma ok rum ne ngʼate mowir, ni Daudi gi nyikwaye nyaka chiengʼ.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

kikuyu: Adier isewinjo gik ma ruodhi mag Asuria osetimo ni pinjeruodhi duto kotiekogi chuth. In to iparo ni ibiro tony?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?

kikuyu: “Joma yot ok nyal ringo kata joma otegno ok nyal tony. E yo nyandwat but Aora Yufrate gichwanyore kendo gipodho.
english: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye ne ni kod jodong jo-Yahudi, omiyo ne ok ochung-gi mondo giwe tich ka pod irito dwoko ma ruoth Darius ondiko gi lwete.
english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

kikuyu: Nochako owacho kendo niya, “Ibiro nenogi ka gitimo gik mochido moloyo misenenogo.”
english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

kikuyu: Kane gidwogo ir oganda, ngʼat moro nobiro ir Yesu mogoyo chonge piny e nyime.
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

kikuyu: ni joma timbegi mono osedonjo e miechgi ma osewuondo ji mangʼeny kuondego kawachonegi niya, “Wadhiuru walam nyiseche mamoko” (ma gin nyiseche ma ok usengʼeyo),
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

kikuyu: Donge Jehova Nyasaye oseketogi gibedo gimoro achiel? E ringruok kendo e chuny gin mage. To angʼo momiyo achiel? Nikech ne odwaro kodhi moluoro Nyasaye. Omiyo ritreuru e chunyu kendo kik ngʼato keth singruokne gi chiege mane oangorego.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo uluor kamano? Pod uonge mana gi yie?”
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

kikuyu: To kaka Yesu nongʼeyo chenro marach mane gin-go, nopenjogi niya, “Un joma wuondoregi, angʼo momiyo utema?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne ok onego yawuot jonekgo koluwo gima ondikie Kitap Chik mar Musa mane Jehova Nyasaye oketo mawacho niya, “Wuone ok nonegi nikech ketho mag nyithindgi, bende nyithindo kik negi nikech ketho mag wuonegi; to ngʼato ka ngʼato nonegi nikech richone owuon.”
english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

kikuyu: kod kendo mar misango molos gi mula kaachiel gi singʼengene man kod ludhene, gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e kendono; gi karaya molos gi mula, kod rachungine;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: jatelo mowuok e dhood Dan, en Buki wuod Jogli;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

kikuyu: Simeon nokawe moriwe e bade kendo nopako Nyasaye, kowacho niya,
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato ohulo ni Yesu en wuod Nyasaye, to Nyasaye odak e iye kendo en bende odak ei Nyasaye.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

kikuyu: Noluwo yore Asa wuon mare kendo ne ok oweyogi, nimar notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Kwer ondiek manie dier togo, kwer kweth mag rwedhi manie dier nyiroye mag ogendini. Mi okel sirni mangʼeny mag fedha ka wiye okuot. Ke ogendini mohero lweny.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

kikuyu: Omiyo Pilato nochako openje niya, “Dwokawa, donge ineno kaka gidonjoni gi ketho mangʼeny?”
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

kikuyu: Ne, asepuonjou buche kod chike kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha nochika, mondo uluw chikenego e piny mudhidonjoe kendo kawo.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Wuon mare Zekaria nopongʼ gi Roho Maler kendo nokoro wach kama:
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

kikuyu: Kuom mano Esau (ma tiende ni Edom) nodhi odak e piny gode man Seir.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone jo-Israel duto niya, “Asewinjo gik moko duto ma usewachona kendo koro asemiyou ruoth.
english: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

kikuyu: Enogol oswakone gi gik moko manie i oswakone mowitgi oko e bath kendo mar misango, yo wuok chiengʼ kama otimo buru.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

kikuyu: En angʼo momiyo jolweny magu opie piny? Ok ginyal chungʼ, nimar Jehova Nyasaye nolwargi piny.
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because the LORD pushed them.

kikuyu: Uketo chunyu kuom nono Muma nikech uparo ni unyalo yudo ngima mochwere kuomgi. Muma ema timo neno kuoma,
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

kikuyu: Obiro nyisou ot malach molos malo, kama osechanie kombe kendo oseiki; maber, kanyo ema uiknwa.”
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

kikuyu: Mad wigi kuodi nyaka chiengʼ kendo gisiki ka luoro omakogi; mad gilal nono ka gin gi wichkuot.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kikuyu: ka ok acham chiemo moro amora moa e od ruoth bende ringʼo kata divai ne ok donji e dhoga, kendo ne ok awirora gi mo moro amora nyaka jumbe adekgo norumo.
english: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

kikuyu: E nyim Nyasaye mamiyo gik moko duto ngima, kendo e nyim Kristo Yesu ma notimo neno maber kane owuoyo e nyim Pontio Pilato, achiki ni
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

kikuyu: Jerusalem oger ka dala ma ji odakie machiegni motenore.
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

kikuyu: Osegoyona agengʼa kendo lwora komiya abedo gi chuny malit kod olo.
english: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

kikuyu: e kanisa mar wuowi ma kayo, ma nyingegi ondik e polo. Usebiro ir Nyasaye, ma en jangʼad bura ni ji duto; bende usebiro ir chunje mag joma kare, makoro osedoko malongʼo chutho,
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

kikuyu: “ ‘Jo-Damaski notimo kodi ohala, ka giwilo kodi divai moa Helbon kod yie rombe moa Zahar nikech gik mane iloso mangʼeny, kendo nikech mwandu maduongʼ mag gigeni mag ohala.
english: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

kikuyu: “Dhiuru Bethel mondo utim richo; kendo dhiuru Gilgal mondo umed timoe richo. Keluru misengini magu okinyi kokinyi kendo keluru achiel kuom apar magu bangʼ higni adek ka higni adek.
english: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,

kikuyu: nimar Dema oseringo oweya modhi Thesalonika nikech nohero pinyni moloyo. Kreske to osedhi e piny Galatia, kendo Tito bende osedhi e piny Dalmatia.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

kikuyu: Nimar, mana kaka dhako nochwe koa kuom dichwo, e kaka dichwo bende inywolo gi dhako, to gik moko duto oa kuom Nyasaye.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

kikuyu: Abiro loko godena duto yore kendo anabug yorena madongo duto maber.
english: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.

kikuyu: To kata kamano nyaka adhi nyime kawuononi, gi kiny kod orucha nikech adiera, onge janabi manyalo tho oko mar Jerusalem!
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato oholo chiayo koa kuom wadgi kendo chiayono ohiny kata otho ka wuon-gi onge, nyaka ochul.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka eri ema nakethie chenro mag Juda kod Jerusalem. Anawe neg-gi gi ligangla e nyim wasikgi, e lwet jogo madwaro ngimagi, kendo anachiw ringregi kaka chiemo ne winy mafuyo e polo kod le manie piny.
english: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: “Ka uhero joma oherou kende, to en ohala mane muyudo? Kata mana joricho bende ohero mana joma oherogi.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro wuok oko ka thuon maratego, enobed gi mirima mager mana ka jalweny; kendo enokogi ka ogiyo sigich lweny, mi olo wasike.
english: The LORD will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

kikuyu: Kuno Juda noromo gi nyar Shua ja-Kanaan mokendo kendo oriwore kode.
english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

kikuyu: Obedo e dhoode, e kom kama otingʼore mar dala maduongʼ,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

kikuyu: Mirimb Jehova Nyasaye Maratego biro wangʼo piny, kendo ji ema nobed ramoki mar mach, kendo onge ngʼat mano ngʼwon-ne nyawadgi.
english: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

kikuyu: Nyaka chop piny yawre kendo tipo mag gik moko lal, duog ira, jaherana, mana kaka mwanda gi le mamoko ringo kadok e gode.
english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.

kikuyu: Jogi nowachone niya, “Kwongʼ ma isemiyo wakwongʼore godo ok otweyowa,
english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

kikuyu: Roho notelone motere ei hekalu. Kane jonywol okelo nyathigi ma Yesu mondo otimne gino ma Chik dwaro,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

kikuyu: jotelo mariembo geche lweny noneno ni ok en ruodh Israel mi negiweyo lawe.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

kikuyu: gi otenga kod kit otenga duto,
english: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

kikuyu: Ji duto nyaka kwan kend kaka gima ler kendo joma okendore nyaka rit singruok mar kend. Nikech Nyasaye biro kumo ngʼato angʼata ma jachode, gi joma timo timbe dwanyruok duto bed ni gin joma nyiri kata yawuowi.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

kikuyu: “Omiyo koro dhano rumo mos mos kaka gima otop, mana ka nanga ma olwenda ochamo.”
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

kikuyu: Kamoro amora ma jadak moro odakie e dier oganda jo-Israel moro amora ema inipogne girkeni mare,” Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ji duto ne oywak, ka gipodho kuome kendo ginyodhe.
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

kikuyu: Ne oloso gig teche mag dhahabu kaluwore gi kaka nochike kuom losogi kendo noketogi e hekalu ka abich oket yo milambo, to abich yo nyandwat.
english: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

kikuyu: Ne uchalo mana ka rombe morwenyo, to koro oseduogu e yo mondo ulu Jakwadhu kendo Jarit mar chunyu.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nochako obirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ma en gima nyiso kinde ma wadakieni, kendo ginyiso ni mich kod misango mane ichiwo ne ok nyal luoko chuny joma ne lemo e hemano mi gidok joma kare.
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni usengʼeyo wechegi duto to pod nyaka aparnu ni Ruoth noreso joge mogologi e piny Misri, to bangʼe achien nokumo joma ne ok oyie.
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

kikuyu: Gige mopa molamo ibiro toyo matindo tindo; kendo mich mag hekalu mochiwo ibiro wangʼ gi mach; abiro ketho kido mage molos duto. Nikech michgo nochoko koa e chudo mar ochot, omiyo koro ibiro ti kodgi kaka chudo mar ochot.”
english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

kikuyu: mi ginyiso Musa niya, “Ji kelo gik mangʼeny moloyo kar midwaro moloyo kuom tich mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko ni mondo otim.”
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma terore mos nigi winjo, to ngʼatno ma iye wangʼ piyo nyiso fupe.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

kikuyu: E kindeno miechgi madongo mochiel motegno, mane giweyo nikech jo-Israel, biro chalo gi kuonde mojwangʼ motimo bunge kod buya kendo giduto ginidongʼ gunda.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

kikuyu: Dhoga biro hulo timni makare, kod warruokni odiechiengʼ duto, kata obedo ni gingʼeny mohinga ngʼeyo.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

kikuyu: to mago bende gin richo manyaka bi kum, nikech ginyiso ni ok asebedo ja-ratiro ne Nyasaye man malo.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

kikuyu: Negichako wuoth ma gia ka nyithindgi matindo gi jambgi kod gigegi otelo e nyimgi.
english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Bwe nigi buchegi kendo winy mafuyo e kor yamo nigi utegi, to Wuod Dhano onge gi kamoro amora monyalo kete wiye.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma ok opodho piny auma mondo olam kidono to ibiro dir e mach makakni.”
english: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane dhakono oneno ni ok onyal aa ma ok ofwenyore, nobiro ka otetni kendo nopodho e tiend Yesu. Nohulo e nyim ji duto gimomiyo nomule kendo kaka nochango sano sano.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

kikuyu: “Kata dabed ni aonge gi ketho moro amora, to onge ber maneno, nikech ngimana en kayiem nono.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

kikuyu: Omiyo ok abi kechogi kata ngʼwononigi ma ok akumogi, to abiro kumogi kuom gik magisetimo.”
english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

kikuyu: Nikech Pilato ne dwaro gonyo Yesu, omiyo nochako owuoyo kosayogi kendo
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

kikuyu: ma ok norem mak oyudo nyadi mangʼeny marome e tiengʼni kendo e tiengʼ mabiro, noyud ngima mochwere.”
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

kikuyu: Eka nakawo kitabu matin-no manie lwet malaikano, mi achame, ne omit e dhoga ka mor kich to kane asechame nobedo makech e iya.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

kikuyu: “Neuru, abiro oro jaotena mabiro losona yo kapok abiro. Bangʼe, apoya nono Ruoth mudwarono nobi e hekalune; jaote mar singruok, ma ugombo, nobi,” Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Enok. Enok nonywolo Methusela, Lamek. Lamek nonywolo Nowa.
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

kikuyu: Wan to wan jo-Nyasaye omiyo joma ongʼeyo Nyasaye winjowa, to ngʼat ma ok ngʼat Nyasaye ok winjwa. Ma e yo mwangʼeyogo Roho mar adier gi Roho mar miriambo.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

kikuyu: Kuom joka Hebron, Jeria ema ne jatendgi kaluwore gi nonro mar anywolagi. E higa mar piero angʼwen mar loch Daudi nonon ndiko kendo noyud ni joma olony kuom nyikwa Hebron ne oa Jazer e piny Gilead.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

kikuyu: Nopenjogi niya, “Un to uneno nangʼo? Ere kaka dwadwok jogi mawacho ni, ‘Dwok chien tingʼ mapek mane wuonu oketo kuomwa’?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osemiyo warruokne ongʼere kendo osefwenyone ogendini timne makare.
english: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: oromo chunyi gi gik mabeyo momiyo tin-ni osiko nyien ka mar ongo.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

kikuyu: Meonothai nonywolo Ofra. Seraya nonywolo Joab mane wuon Ge Harashim. Kanyo niluongo ni Ge Harashim nikech joma nodak kanyo ne joma payo gik moko.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

kikuyu: to jodong gwengʼno nyaka ome maduoge ka gole e dala maduongʼno mondo gichiwe e lwet joma chulo kuor mondo onege.
english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

kikuyu: To kaonge ngʼato manyalo loko tiend wechego, to ngʼat ma wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore mondo olingʼ e kanisa, to owuo mana e chunye owuon kende gi Nyasaye.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

kikuyu: Jadolo notim pwodhruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne ngʼatno motimo richo ka ok ongʼeyo, kendo ka osetimne pwodhruok, nowene richo.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Ka jarit od twech nochiewo monwangʼo ka dhout od twech duto oyawore, nowuodho liganglane mondo onegrego, koparo ni joma otwe duto noseringo otony.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jaro jochan ochayo Jachwechgi; ngʼat mamor gi masira ok notony ne kum.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Ndalo biro chopo ma wasiki biro goyoni agengʼa kolwori, kendo kunyoni bur koni gi koni.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

kikuyu: Ka udonjo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni kendo ukawe ma udakie,
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

kikuyu: sa mane jolweny mar ruodh Babulon ne kedo gi Jerusalem kod mier madongo mamoko mag Juda mane pod odongʼ, ma gin Lakish kod Azeka. Magi kende e mier madongo mochiel motegno gohinga mane odongʼ e Juda.
english: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, wayalo rieko ni joma otegno, to ok rieko mag tiengʼni, kata mag ruodhi mandalogi, mabiro lal nono.
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

kikuyu: Kendo ka ipenjori iwuon, “Angʼo momiyo ma osetimorena?” En nikech richo mau mangʼeny omiyo dugu oseneno kendo dendu osekethore.
english: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mantiere nosemi nyinge chon, kendo gima dhano en bende nosengʼe; onge ngʼama nyalo piem gi ngʼama oloye gi teko.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

kikuyu: To gima timoreni osetimore kama mondo Ndiko mag jonabi ochopi.” Eka jopuonjre duto noweye moringo odhi.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

kikuyu: Nowachonegi niya, “Ka uchiko itu maber ne wach Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ma utimo gima kare e nyim wangʼe, ka urito chikene kendo umako buchene duto, to ok anakel kuomu tuo moro amora mane akelo ne jo-Misri, nimar an Jehova Nyasaye machangou.”
english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Yesu ja-Nazareth ema kadho.”
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

kikuyu: Mirimbi mager ogore kuoma mapek; isetamo wangʼa gi apaka magi duto. Sela
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

kikuyu: Ne amanyo Jehova Nyasaye ka alamo, kendo nodwoka; ne oresa e luoro duto ma an-go.
english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne chunye ochandore ahinya ka nowinjo kwayono, to nikech noyudo osesingore e yor kwongʼruok, kendo nikech wende mane ni e nyasineno, ne ok odwar tuono nyakono gima nosekwayo.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

kikuyu: Zaburi mar Daudi. Kik chunyi chandre nikech joma richo bende chunyi kik gomb gige joma timo gik maricho;
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Adonija gi welo duto mane ni kode nowinjo kokono kane gitieko nyasigi. Kane giwinjo ywak mar turumbete Joab nopenjo niya, “Tiend koko magore e dalano to en angʼo?”
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

kikuyu: Kuom mano ageno mar ore iru mapiyo bangʼ kasengʼeyo gima biro timorena ka.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nodok e ode kendo otienono duto ne ok ochiemo bende ne ok oyie mondo joma mielne obi e nyime bende nindo notamore tere.
english: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting. No musical instruments were brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.

kikuyu: Duongʼ obed ni Nyasaye ma Wuon Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, kendo ma Wuon ngʼwono kendo Nyasach Loch duto,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

kikuyu: Kane pundano oneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye, nosudo machiegni gohingano moreyo tiend Balaam gohingano. Omiyo nogoyo pundano kendo.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosechano kelo masirani kuom Turo, wuon loch, ma jo-ohala mage ogen, ma bende jongʼiewo mage ongʼere e piny duto?
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?

kikuyu: Rie yore tir monego iluw kendo luw mana yore motegno.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

kikuyu: In nyar minu adier, nikech minu nochayo chwore gi nyithinde; kendo ichal gi nyimineni adier, nikech nyimineni bende nochayo chwogi gi nyithindgi. Minu ne en ja-Hiti to wuonu ne en ja-Amor.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

kikuyu: Gibiro luwo Jehova Nyasaye, noruti ka sibuor. Kuruto, to nyithinde duto nobi ire katetni kagiwuok yo podho chiengʼ.
english: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

kikuyu: Kar romb jo-Lawi duto mane okwan kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye ogolo kokadho kuom Musa kod Harun kaluwore gi anywolagi ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gariyo (22,000), magi ne gin kaachiel gi nyithindo duto ma yawuowi kochakore ja-dwe achiel kadhi nyime.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

kikuyu: negibiro ir Gedalia e dala miluongo ni Mizpa. Jogo ne gin Ishmael wuod Nethania, Johanan gi Jonathan ma yawuot Karea, Seraya wuod Tanhumeth, yawuot Efai ma ja-Netofath, kod Jazania wuod ja-Maakath, kod jogi.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

kikuyu: Josef nokawo ringre Yesu moboye gi nanga maler marep-rep,
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

kikuyu: to yie iwinji lemogi gi kwayogi gie polo kar dakni kendo ikonygi. Kendo iwe ni jogi mosetimo richo e nyimi.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

kikuyu: To bangʼe yie wiye nochako twi mos mos.
english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

kikuyu: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “ ‘Anaduog mwandu mag hembe Jakobo kendo abed gi ngʼwono e kuondege mag dak; dala maduongʼ noger kendo e kuondege mano okethe, kendo kar dak ruoth noger e kare malongʼo.
english: The LORD says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.

kikuyu: “Ka Efraim noneno tuone, kendo Juda oneno adhondene, eka Efraim nodwaro kony kuom Asuria, kendo gikwayo kony ir ruoth maduongʼ. To ok onyal thiedhou, ok onyal thiedho adhondeu.
english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

kikuyu: “Mana kaka ipudho buya kendo iwangʼo e mach, e kaka biro bedo chiengʼ giko piny.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

kikuyu: To kaka ne en janabi, nongʼeyo ni Nyasaye nosesingore e yor kwongʼruok ni enoket achiel kuom nyikwaye e lochne.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, ‘Ndalo biro ma anaduog joga Israel kod Juda koa e twech kendo achokgi e piny mane amiyo kweregi mondo okaw,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho.”
english: For, behold, the days come,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says the LORD. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”

kikuyu: mane Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon ne ok okawo sa mane otero Jehoyakin wuod Jehoyakim ruodh Juda e twech kogole Jerusalem nyaka Babulon kaachiel gi joka ruoth moa Juda gi Jerusalem,
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

kikuyu: Ere oganda machal gi jogi Israel? Bende nitiere oganda moro e piny mane Nyasaye osedhi moreso mondo obed joge owuon kendo mosemiyogo nyinge ongʼere mi otimogo honni madongo kendo malich koriembo ogendini gi nyisechegi ka gia e nyim joge, mane oreso kogolo Misri?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

kikuyu: Magi imedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mar dwe ka dwe kod mago michiwo pile ka pile kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny mana kaka owinjore. Gin chiwo miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye, madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar mamoro Jehova Nyasaye.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Notimo gima kare e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, to ok kaka Daudi kwar mare notimo. Noluwo tim wuon mare Joash e gik moko duto.
english: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

kikuyu: nikech rieko ber moloyo kite ma nengogi tek, kendo gimoro amora madiher ok nyal romo kode.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

kikuyu: Nimar mana kaka Jona ne ni ei rech marangʼongo kuom ndalo adek odiechiengʼ gotieno, e kaka Wuod Dhano bende biro bedo ei chuny lowo kuom ndalo adek odiechiengʼ gotieno.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka Nyasaye ne dwaro lero tiend chenroge ma ok lokre ne joma yudo gweth mag singruok mage, noguro singruokneno gi kwongʼruok.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Koro wasefwenyo ratiro ni Jehova Nyasaye neni kodi, omiyo wadwaro mondo watim kodi winjruok kwakwongʼore. Yie watim winjruok kodi
english: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

kikuyu: Farao kaachiel gi jodonge kod jo-Misri duto nochiewo e dier otieno kendo ne nitie ywak maduongʼ e piny Misri, nikech ne onge ot moro amora e piny Misri mane ngʼato ok othoe.
english: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

kikuyu: Ruodh Israel nodwoke niya, “Nyise kama: ‘Ngʼat morwako lepe mag lweny ok onego go siboi ka ngʼat molonyo lepe mag lweny.’ ”
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

kikuyu: Ngʼat makare mon kod gima ok adiera, to joricho kelo wichkuot kod dwanyruok.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye mane oresa e kok sibuor gi kok ondiek biro resa e lwet ja-Filistiani.” Saulo nowachone Daudi niya, “Dhi kendo Jehova Nyasaye obed kodi.”
english: David said, “The LORD, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! The LORD will be with you.”

kikuyu: To magi ondiki mondo uyie ni Yesu e Kristo ma Wuod Nyasaye, kendo mondo ka uyie kamano, to ubed gi ngima e nyinge.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

kikuyu: “Nitie gik moko adek ma wuodhgi lich ka irango, chutho angʼwen maringo malich miwuoro.
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: Anyisi adier ni wawuoyo kuom gik mwangʼeyo, kendo watimo neno kuom gik mwaseneno; to un, to pod utamoru rwako neno marwa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

kikuyu: Nakadho but puoth jasamuoyo, kakadho but puoth olemb mzabibu mar ngʼat maonge gi rieko;
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

kikuyu: Negidwoko niya, “Ka udwoko Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel, to kik udwoke nono, nyaka une ni udwoke gi misango mar pwodhruok e ketho, eka nochangu, bende ubiro ngʼeyo gima omiyo lwete ok oseweyo sandou.”
english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

kikuyu: mana kaka nyikwa Esau mane odak Seir kod jo-Moab modak Ar ne jotimonwa, negiweyo wangʼado Jordan miwadonjo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa miyowa.”
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”

kikuyu: Kata kamano ne gingʼanyo mi gimiyo Roho Maler mare okuyo. Omiyo nolokore obedo jasikgi kendo en owuon ne okedo kodgi.
english: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

kikuyu: gi nyamnaha, gi ngʼangʼa, tula kod olik tiga.
english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochako ofwenyorene kendo mar ariyo mana kaka nosefwenyorene Gibeon.
english: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

kikuyu: Mad joma kwongʼo odiechienge okwongʼ odiechiengno, ma gin jogo molony gi luongo le manie nam miluongo ni Leviathan mawuogi.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

kikuyu: Dhood Reuben kod Gad nomiyo kendo mar misangono nying machalo kama: Ranyisi e Kindwa ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, malaika mar adek nobiro bangʼ-gi kowacho gi dwol maduongʼ niya, “Ka ngʼato angʼata olamo ondiek malich kod gima ket kode, kendo ondikne kido e lela wangʼe kata e lwete,
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

kikuyu: Omiyo Harun gi yawuote notimo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochikogi gi dwond Musa.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.

kikuyu: Paruru gima ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu otimo ne Miriam e yo kane uwuok e piny Misri.
english: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi kuonde duto, e mier matindo kod gwenge duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth, kendo kochango kit midekre gi tuoche duto.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: To Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nomonjo pinyni, ne wawacho ni, ‘Biuru, nyaka wadhi Jerusalem wapondne jolweny mag Babulon kod mag jo-Aram kapok gimakowa.’ Omiyo ne wadongʼ Jerusalem.”
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”

kikuyu: Abiro rito chikeni; omiyo kik ijwangʼa chuth.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

kikuyu: Wengena ool kamanyo singruokni; apenjora niya, “Ibiro hoya karangʼo?”
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

kikuyu: Lea nomako ich kendo nonywolo wuowi. Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye oseneno chandruokna, kendo koro chwora biro hera.” Omiyo nochake ni Reuben.
english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

kikuyu: Joma Wuoro omiya duto biro ira, kendo ngʼato angʼata mobiro ira ok anariembi ngangʼ.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

kikuyu: kama kwereu notemoae gi tem kendo negineno gima ne atimonegi kuom higni piero angʼwen.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Ndik fwenyni kendo iler tiende maber kama indike, mondo jaland wach oring katere.
english: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

kikuyu: Omiyo negichokogi, kendo negipongʼo okepe apar gariyo gi ngʼinjo ma noa e makati matindo abich mane olos gi shairi, mane joma nosechiemo oweyo.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

kikuyu: to dhako moro nolwaro kidi maduongʼ mar nyapongʼ ewi Abimelek mi obarore.
english: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

kikuyu: Eka tongʼno nodhi nyime yo milambo mochopo nyaka Kana Ravin. Ne nitiere mier matindo ma mek Efraim mane nitiere e dier mier matindo mag Manase, makmana tongʼ Manase ne nitiere yo nyandwat mar holo matut madiny kendo mogik e nam.
english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

kikuyu: dhok alufu piero adek gauchiel (36,000),
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: kochakore e Aora Shihor man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Misri nyaka e tongʼ Ekron man yo nyandwat, magi duto nokwan kaka jo-Kanaan. Kuonde mane jotelo abich mag Filistia orito ne gin, Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath kod Ekron; magi ne gin mag jo-Avi
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo losuru chokruok mowal kendo kik uti tich moro amora mutiyo pile.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: E kindeno Daudi nopondo e rogo kendo jo-Filistia to nochokore Bethlehem.
english: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Joshua nokone oganda Israel niya, “Pwodhreuru, nikech kiny Jehova Nyasaye biro timo gigo miwuoro e kindu.”
english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”

kikuyu: Abiro kawo remo oko e dhogi, nagol chiemo makwero e kind lekegi. Joma owe biro bedo jo-Nyasachwa; ginibed jotelo e piny Juda, kendo Ekron nochal gi jo-Jebus.
english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

kikuyu: to jamni mayom yom ne ok oket ochungʼ e nyim ketego. Omiyo jamni mayom yom ne gin mag Laban to mago motegno ne gin mag Jakobo.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo anapuonjgi kendo tinendeni anapuonjgi, tekona gi nyalona. Eka giningʼe ni nyinga en Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.”

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ moluwo mano negichopo Kaisaria, kuma Kornelio ne jorite kaachiel gi wedene kod osiepene mane oluongo.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

kikuyu: To pod ngʼat machielo moro nowacho niya, “Abiro luwi, Ruoth, to mokwongo, yiena adogi mondo adhi goyo oriti ni joodwa.”
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

kikuyu: Kane gichopo e Holo mar Eshkol, ne gitongʼo bad yath achiel motingʼo pumbi mar olemb mzabibu. Ji ariyo kuomgi notingʼe e luth kaachiel gi gik mongʼinore kod ngʼowu.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

kikuyu: E Isakar kod Asher, Manase ne nitie bende kod Beth Shan, Ibleam kod jo-Dor, Endor, Tanak kod Megido, kaachiel gi jogo mane odak machiegni kodgi, ngʼat mar adek e kwan-no ne en Nafoth.
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

kikuyu: “Ne amako koth mondo kik chue kane pod odongʼ dweche adek to piny chiek. Ne amiyo koth ochwe e mier moko, to ok e mier mamoko. Ne ochwe e puothe moko, to puothe mane ok ochweye, to ne wangʼ.
english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.

kikuyu: Ere ohala ma Jehova Nyasaye Maratego yudo kibedo ngʼat makare? Koso iparo ni ka yoregi oriere, to mano konye gangʼo?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

kikuyu: Kaw makati apar gi kek moko kod chupa mar mor kich kendo dhi ire. Obiro nyisi gima biro timore ni nyathino.”
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

kikuyu: Kanyo ema e oturoe aserni makakni, kaachiel gi okumbni gi ligengni, ma gin gig lweny. Sela
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

kikuyu: Jerub-Baal wuod Joash nodok dala.
english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

kikuyu: Kochakore e agola mar Gemaria wuod Shafan ma jagoro, mane nitiere e laru man malo e kar donjo mar Dhorangach Manyien mar hekalu, Baruk nosomone ji duto e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye weche Jeremia koa e kitabu.
english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in the LORD’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house, in the ears of all the people.

kikuyu: to ngʼato angʼata mani wuog e dalana mondo orom koda bangʼ ka aseloyo jo-Amon nobed mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo anachiwe kaka misango miwangʼo pep.”
english: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”

kikuyu: Ketgi e chuny nyithindu, wuo e wechego ka un e dala, ka uwuotho e bath yo, ka unindo kata ka uchungʼ.
english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

kikuyu: Ahithofel nowachone Abisalom niya, “Kane bed ni an in, to dine ayiero ji alufu apar gariyo kendo awuokgo otieno ma kawuononi mondo alaw Daudi;
english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

kikuyu: Ok abi luoro ji gana gi gana molwora mondo otimna marach.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

kikuyu: kik udhi Bethel, kendo kik udhi Gilgal, to bende kik ukadhi nyaka Bersheba, nimar jo-Gilgal duto ibiro daro matergi e twech, kendo Bethel biro mana lal nono.”
english: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mofuwo chiwore duto komwomore amwoma e mirimbe, to ngʼat mariek ritore ka ogare.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

kikuyu: To Nyasaye noyiero gima ofuwo mag piny mondo okuodgo wi joma riek. Nyasaye noyiero bende gik manyap mag piny mondo okuodgo wi joma rateke.
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

kikuyu: “ ‘Achiel kuom apar mar gik moko duto ma lowo onyago bedni gin cham, kata olembe duto gin mag Jehova Nyasaye, kendo gin gik maler mowalne.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Timbe mamoko mag loch Ela kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane otimo, donge ondikgi e kitap rapar mag ruodhi mag Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: To ka wangʼeyo ni owinjowa kwakwaye gimoro, to wangʼeyo ni waseyudo gima wakwayono.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny kuomgi nochwanyre mi gore piny kendo tur, nochiknegi obadho ma makgi.”
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

kikuyu: Vania, Meremoth, Eliashib,
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nyingi osiko nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, humbi ochwere e tienge duto.
english: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Chunguru wadhi! Jandhokna osechopo!”
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe achien kwan-gi nodok matin kendo ne odwokgi piny nikech sand gi masiche kod kuyo;
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

kikuyu: nodhi mokawo choke Saulo gi mag wuode Jonathan ka ogologi kuom oganda jo-Jabesh Gilead. Ne gisekawogi lingʼ-lingʼ koa e paw dala man Beth Shan, kuma jo-Filistia nolierogie bangʼ nego Saulo Gilboa.
english: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

kikuyu: Weche mane iwinjo ka apuonjo e nyim joneno mathoth keti e lwet joma inyalo geno, manyalo puonjo joma moko bende.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

kikuyu: Ywageuru, un jogo duto modak machiegni kode, un jogo duto mongʼeyo humbe; wachuru ni, ‘Mano kaka otur odunga mar loch maratego, mano kaka otur ludh duongʼ!’
english: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’

kikuyu: nimar ochalo mach marach mawengʼo manyalo tieko giga duto ma an-go.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth nopenjo Esta niya, “En angʼo? En angʼo midwaro kwayo? Kwa akwaya kata obed mana nus mar pinya, to ibiro miyi.”
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

kikuyu: kaachiel gi sirni molworo laru man-gi mise, sigingi mag hema, tonde, gi gik moko duto mitiyogo kanyo kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka mi gik monego otingʼ.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

kikuyu: Bangʼe kane nyirigo odok ir Reuel wuon-gi, nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo momiyo udwogo chon kawuono?”
english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

kikuyu: Eka negipenjo Baruk niya, “Nyiswane, ere kaka ne indiko gigi duto? Jeremia ema nosomoni eka indikogi koso?”
english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”

kikuyu: Nokawo mifukone mopongʼ gi pesa, kendo ok obi duogo dala nyaka bangʼ ndalo mogwarore.”
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

kikuyu: Frugia, Pamfilia, Misri kod gwenge mag Libya mokiewo gi Kurene; kaachiel gi welo moa Rumi, mane otingʼo jo-Yahudi kod joma moko molokore mondo oluw din jo-Yahudi.
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato man-gi genoni pwodhore owuon mondo osik koler mana kaka en bende oler.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

kikuyu: nikech nyare achiel kende, nyako madirom ja-higni apar gariyo, ne tho. Ka Yesu ne ni e yo, oganda maduongʼ nothungʼe mane gichiegni hinye.
english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

kikuyu: Jogo mane ni e wuoth gi Saulo nochungʼ kanyo ka dhogi omoko; nikech ne giwinjo dwol to ok gine ngʼato.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

kikuyu: Kete e bwo ndiri molworo kendo mar misango kendo ochopi nyaka e kor kendo mar misangono.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

kikuyu: “An bende miyaeuru teko ma un-goni mondo ngʼato angʼata ma ayieyo lweta kuome oyud Roho Maler.”
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Aloko polo doko maratengʼ ti mana ka gima aume gi pien gugru.
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”

kikuyu: Adwokone Nyasacha erokamano pile ka aluongo nyingi e lemona,
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ne andikonu kamano, mondo kane abiro iru to kik umiya kuyo un monego umiya mor. Nikech angʼeyo malongʼo chuth ni ka amor eka un duto bende umor.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

kikuyu: mi oterore gi dichwo moro, kendo timni opandore ne chwore ma ok ongʼere (nikech onge janeno mane onene kendo ne ok omake randoo),
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

kikuyu: Kane jodong Israel duto osebiro ir Ruoth Daudi e Hebron, notimo kodgi singruok e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kodgi e Hebron kanyo, kendo ne giwiro Daudi mondo obed ruodh Israel mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingore gi dho Samuel.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

kikuyu: Mosuru jotendu duto kaachiel gi jo-Nyasaye duto. Owete moa Italia ooronu mosgi.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

kikuyu: Gigi duto noketo e lwet Harun gi yawuote mondo gifwagi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo unuwer wende machalo gi wende mag nyasi mag sawo maler miwero gotieno; chunyu nobed gi mor mana ka ji mabedo gi mor ka goyo asili kadhi e got Jehova Nyasaye, ma en Lwanda mar Israel.
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne adonjo e iye, kendo ne angʼicho, mi aneno kit gik mamol duto kod le makwero kod nyiseche molosi mag dhood Israel, kogor e kor odni.
english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

kikuyu: Kik utuonru makmana ka uwinjoru e kindu uwegi mar timo mano kuom kinde machwok mondo uchiwru ni lamo. To bangʼ chiwruok ni lamo, to uchak uriwru kendo mondo kik Satan temu, nikech ok unyal ritoru.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

kikuyu: Ne awachonegi niya, “In kaachiel gi gigi owalu tenge ne Jehova Nyasaye. Fedha gi dhahabu gin chiwo mar hera ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwereu.
english: I said to them, “You are holy to the LORD, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.

kikuyu: Ma e jalno mane owuo kuome gi dho janabi Isaya niya, “Ngʼat moro kok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yore moriere tir.’ ”
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

kikuyu: “Ruoth ma milambo nobed maratego, to kata kamano achiel kuom jatend jolweny mage nobed maratego moloye, kendo enolo pinyruodhe owuon gi teko maduongʼ.
english: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

kikuyu: Jo-Amor nochoko jo-Dan kamoro achiel e piny gode, mane ok oyienigi mondo gibi mwalo e piny pewe.
english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

kikuyu: Kuom jo-Zebulun, Musa nowuoyoe kama: “Un jo-Zubulun, beduru mamor e seche muwuok kudhi oko, to un bende jo-Isakar beduru ei hembeu.
english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

kikuyu: To abiro timo singruokna kodi, kendo ibiro donjo e yie, in kaachiel gi yawuoti kod chiegi, kod mond yawuoti.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Kane giwuoyo kendo goyo mbaka kuom gigi e kindgi giwegi, Yesu owuon nobiro kendo nowuotho kodgi;
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

kikuyu: Gidiro asere kama giponde mondo gichwogo ngʼama onge ketho; gibaye gi asere apoya ka gionge luoro.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

kikuyu: Emomiyo koro anyisou ni ok anariembgi oko e nyimu; ginibed kuthe e ringreu kendo nyisechegi nobed tembe ne un.”
english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

kikuyu: Joma nok ma gin jolweny mag asere ma gin thuondi man Kedar ema notony. Jehova Nyasaye ma en Nyasach Israel osewacho.”
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Negirito ma wigi okuot, to kane ok oyawo dhout agola, negikawo kifungu kendo giyawogi. Kanyo negineno ruodhgi koriere e dier ot, kosetho.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

kikuyu: Misumba ok nyal kony kirieye mana gi wach kende; kata bed ni owinjo, to ok obi rwako.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

kikuyu: Eka Musa notelo ne oganda kawuok e kambi mondo orom gi Nyasaye, kendo negichungʼ e tiend got.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

kikuyu: Barak nobiro kolawo Sisera, kendo Jael nowuok mondo orom kode. Nowachone niya, “Bi, abiro nyisi ngʼat ma imanyo.” Omiyo nodhi kode, kendo kanyo Sisera nonindo gi sigingi kopowo iye kosetho.
english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

kikuyu: Nikech dhial museyudo kuom Kristo ok en mana mondo uyie kuome kende, to oseluongu bende mondo une masiche nikech en,
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Pinyruodha ok en mar pinyni. Ka dine bed ni en, to jotichna dine ogore mi gitamo jo-Yahudi maka. To koroni, pinyruodha aa kamachielo.”
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

kikuyu: Mae nonro Isaka wuod Ibrahim. Ibrahim nonywolo Isaka,
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

kikuyu: Kaka Nyasachwa en ja-adiera, wach ma wasebedo ka wawacho kodu ok en “Ee” gi “Ooyo.”
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osebedo e kom bura mondo ongʼad bura ne oganda.
english: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

kikuyu: Lowo ma mwonyo pi koth mochwe kuome kendo machiego cham manyalo konyo joma opure, ema yudo gweth Nyasaye.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

kikuyu: Eka Satan nokawe, motere nyaka ewi got moro mabor ahinya, kendo nosiemone pinjeruodhi mag piny gi duongʼ mane gin-go.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

kikuyu: (Jo-Athene duto kod jopinje mamoko mane odak kanyo nohero ketho sechegi kanyo ka gigoyo mbaka kendo giwinjo paro gi rieko manyien.)
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

kikuyu: Ruoth kod Jehoyada nochiwo pesa ne jogo mane timo tich mane dwarore mar loso hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Negindiko jogedo kod jopa bao kaachiel gi joma olony e tich nyinyo kod mula mondo olos hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the LORD’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore the LORD’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: To ka jangʼad bura notho, ji noduogo e timbe mangʼeny mag anjawo moloyo kata mago mag kweregi, ka giluwo bangʼ nyiseche mamoko kendo tiyonegi kendo ka gilamogi. Negitamore weyo timbegi mamono kod timbegi mag wich teko.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

kikuyu: Yawuot Samuel ne gin: Joel wuowi makayo, kod Abija, wuode mar ariyo.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

kikuyu: Tiuru gi chunyu duto, mana ka gima utiyo ni Ruoth, to ok ni dhano,
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

kikuyu: Noparo kaka ne gin mana dhano adhana machalo yamo makalo kendo ok chak duogi.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

kikuyu: Nodwokogi niya, “Isaya ne ni kare kane okoro wach kuomu un joma wuondoregi; mana kaka ondiki ni, “ ‘Jogi paka mana gi dhogi kende, to chunygi bor koda.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Thoma nodwoke niya, “Ruodha kendo Nyasacha!”
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

kikuyu: Kum mar joga duongʼ moloyo mano mar Sodom, mane lochne okethi mapiyo piyo nono maonge ngʼama nobiro mondo okonye.
english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

kikuyu: Pinyni mangima nobed piny mojwangʼ mokethore, kendo ogendinigi noti ne ruodh Babulon higni piero abiriyo.
english: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

kikuyu: Wasike ema tinde otelone, kendo wasikego dhi maber. Jehova Nyasaye osekelone chandruok nikech richone mangʼeny. Nyithinde oseter e twech, kendo gisebedo kaka joma omaki e nyim wasigu.
english: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.

kikuyu: Pe madongo dongo ma pek moro ka moro dirom kilo piero abich, noa e polo mogoyo ji. To ne giyanyo Nyasaye nikech masirano mar pe, nimar ne en masira marach moloyo!
english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nitie ndalo auchiel munyalo tiyoe tijeu; to chiengʼ mar abiriyo en odiechieng Sabato mar yweyo, ma en odiechiengʼ mowal mar chokruok. Ok oyienu timo gimoro amora, kamoro amora mudakie, nikech en Sabato mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Eka jatich nonyiso Isaka gik moko duto mane osetimo.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

kikuyu: Ket kendono mar misango e nyim pasia molier e nyim Sandug Muma man e nyim Sandug Raparno kama abiro romoe kodu.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo chuny Farao omedo bedo matek mine ok nonyal winjo wach Musa kod Harun, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho ne Musa.
english: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.

kikuyu: Ne aketonu jorito kendo awacho, ‘Chikuru itu ne turumbete!’ To ne uwacho, ‘Ok wanachik itwa.’
english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

kikuyu: kendo kitimo misango koluwore gi gima owachi e Chik mar Ruoth Nyasaye ni mondo ochiw: “akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo.”
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

kikuyu: Chikuru itu un dhood Israel mondo uwinjie wende ywak ma asechuogonu:
english: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

kikuyu: Ruodh Dor (man Nafoth Dor), ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Goyim man Gilgal, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

kikuyu: “Nyasaye nyalo timo gigi duto ne ngʼato angʼata nyadiriyo kata nyadidek,
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

kikuyu: Konya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, resa kaluwore gi herani.
english: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Bed motangʼ ma kik itingʼ misigo chiengʼ Sabato kata ikele kokalo e rangeye mag Jerusalem.
english: The LORD says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Hembe nitie Salem kar dakne ni Sayun.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kikuyu: Eka jodongo duto manie dala machiegni gi kama ringruokno nitie noluok lwetgi e nyaroyano ma ngʼute otur e holo,
english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

kikuyu: To ka magi duto ne dhi nyime, ne aonge Jerusalem, nimar e higa mar piero adek gariyo mar loch Artaksases ruodh Babulon ne asedok ir ruoth. Bangʼe ne akwaye thuolo
english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik udhi upenj wach kuom jo-nyakalondo kata kuom ajuoke mamoko, nikech timo kamano biro miyo ubedo mogak. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, nen maber, chik iti mos kendo ket chunyi mondo itim gik moko duto ma anyisi kuom chike duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ket chunyi mar yango yo midonjogo e hekalu kod yore duto miwuokgo kama ler mar lemo.
english: The LORD said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of the LORD’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Nying wuode makayo ne Joel to nying wuowi mar ariyo ne Abija, kendo negitiyo e Bersheba.
english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

kikuyu: To kuom ji duto ma Nyasaye oseluongo, bed ni gin jo-Yahudi kata jo-Yunani, Kristo en teko Nyasaye kendo en rieko Nyasaye.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

kikuyu: Negiringo giduto, to japuonjre machielono noyombo Petro, mi nokuongone chopo e liel.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

kikuyu: Eka ne jarit ochako menyo kochako gi wuowi maduongʼ kendo otieko gi wuowi matin kendo kikombe noyudi ei ogund Benjamin.
english: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni, onge ngʼato moseweyo dalane kata jaode kata owetene, kata jonywolne, kata nyithinde nikech pinyruoth Nyasaye
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

kikuyu: E kinde ka kinde kane jo-Lawi okelo sanduku ne jotend ruoth kendo kane gineno ni pesa ne nitiere mangʼeny, to jagoro mar joka ruoth kod jatelo margi kod jatij jadolo maduongʼ ne jobiro mondo okaw sanduku kendo kane giseloko gik manie sanduku negidwoke kare. Kamano e kaka negitimo pile ka pile kendo negichoko pesa mangʼeny mokalo.
english: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

kikuyu: Abram nodhi moomo gik moko duto mane joka odhigo kendo noreso Lut wuod owadgi kod mwandune duto kaachiel gi mon kod ji mamoko.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

kikuyu: Noloso gir lweny moro midirogo aserni gi kite madongo mane joma riek ofwenyo moketo kuonde maboyo mag ngʼicho kod kuonde ma ohinga ogomogo Jerusalem. Humbe nolandore mabor kendo malach nikech nokonye ahinya nyaka nobedo motegno miwuoro.
english: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

kikuyu: Omiyo koro kik uluor. Abiro ritou kaachiel gi nyithindu.” Kamano nokweyo chunygi kendo owuoyo kodgi gi muolo.
english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

kikuyu: E chakruok mar loch Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda, wachni nobiro koa ir Jehova Nyasaye:
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:

kikuyu: E kindeno Tatenai, ruodh Yufrate, kod Shetha-Bozenai gi joma gitiyogo kanyakla nodhi irgi kendo openjo niya, “En ngʼa mane omiyou thuolo mar gero hekaluni kendo loso iye?”
english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”

kikuyu: Iparo mar nega kaka nyoro inego ja-Misri cha?’
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

kikuyu: To nowuondo ji modakie piny, nikech honni mane omiye teko mondo otim e nyim ondiek malich mokwongo. Ne ogolo chik mondo gilosi gima ket ma imiyogo duongʼ ondiek malich mokwongo mane ohiny gi ligangla to ok otho.
english: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

kikuyu: ma tiende ni nyarwadhno duto, notingʼ kendo noter oko mar pacho kama ler ma en kama oket tenge ne puko buch kendo mar misango, kendo mondo owangʼe kanyo pep gi mach mar yien ewi pidh buruno.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

kikuyu: e kaka Kristo bende notimgo misango dichiel kende mondo ogol richo mag ji mangʼeny. To obiro fwenyore kendo mar ariyo, ok mondo ochak otingʼ richo ji kendo, to mondo okel warruok ni joma rite gi geno.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

kikuyu: Bende dotim kodi winjruok mondo ikawe obed misumbani nyaka chiengʼ?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

kikuyu: kendo nochungʼ e toke, but tiende, pi wangʼe nolwar e tiendene ma gitimo pi eka noyweyogi gi yie wiye, monyodhogi kendo noolo mo mangʼwe ngʼar kuomgi.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

kikuyu: Kane Petro gi Johana pod wuoyo gi ji, jodolo gi jatend jorit hekalu kod jo-Sadukai nobiro irgi.
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

kikuyu: Chwo kodhi mari gokinyi, to godhiambo kik iwe lweti bed maonge tich, nimar ok ingʼeyo kata gibiro twi, giduto maber.
english: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.

kikuyu: Jowetena, koro asewuoyo kodu ka akonyora gi nyinga kod nying Apolo kaka ranyisi mondo uyud konyruok, kupuonjoru kuomwa tiend wach mawacho niya, “Kik ukal weche mondiki.” Mano biro miyo ok udhial ngʼato moloyo nyawadgi.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

kikuyu: Nikech lamo molam kuom yie biro kelo chang ni jatuo, mi Ruoth mi oa malo. To ka osetimo richo to nowene.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ kane gisewuoyo amingʼa, Petro nochungʼ malo mowachonegi kama: “Owetewa, ungʼeyo kaka kinde mosekalo Nyasaye noyiero e dieru mondo joma ok jo-Yahudi owinj Injili mi giyie kuom Yesu, ka an awuon ema ayalonegi.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

kikuyu: Gibiro hulo timne makare, ne ji mapok onywol niya: “Jehova Nyasaye osewaro joge.”
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼato nowachone Saulo niya, “Neye kaka ji timo richo ni Jehova Nyasaye ka gichamo ringʼo motimo remo.” Eka nowacho niya, “Useketho yie. Ngʼielnauru kidi maduongʼno ukel ka.”
english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against the LORD, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”

kikuyu: Kik ubed joma ohero pesa, to gik ma un-go mondo oromu, nikech Nyasaye wacho niya, “Ok anaweu kata jwangʼ ok anajwangʼu”
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

kikuyu: Bed motangʼ mondo kik ichiw misango miwangʼo pep kamoro amora ma ihero.
english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

kikuyu: Obal, Abimael (kata Ebal), gi Sheba,
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: Anamigi chuny mar ngʼeya ni an Jehova Nyasaye. Ginibed joga kendo anabed Nyasachgi, nimar giniduog ira gi chunygi duto.’
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

kikuyu: Ka ugoyo agengʼa ne wasiku, keturu mabor gik ma olil.
english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

kikuyu: Thuondi maroteke biro nyiso jo-Misri gi jogo mane konyogi ni, ‘Gisebiro piny ei bur kendo koro giriere piny gi joma ne ok ongʼeyo Nyasaye, ma gin joma ne onegi gi ligangla.’
english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.
