kikuyu: To winj wach Jehova Nyasaye, un jo-Yahudi duto modak Misri: ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga maduongʼ,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ‘ni onge ngʼato angʼata moa Juda modak Misri manochak oluong nyinga kata kwongʼore niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto.”
english: “Therefore hear the LORD’s word, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by my great name,’ says the LORD, ‘that my name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord GOD lives.”

kikuyu: Eka naneno Nyarombo ka elo achiel kuom kido abiriyogo. Nawinjo dwond achiel kuom gik mangima angʼwen-go kaluongo gi dwol machalo ka mor polo, kawacho niya; “Bi!”
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Mad iyud gweth moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye, jachwech polo gi piny.
english: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Telna, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kuom adiera mari, nikech wasigu molwora, yie iriena yori tir e nyima.
english: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ji mane oketo genoni kuom jo-Kush, kendo tingʼore malo nikech jo-Misri nobed gi luoro kod wichkuot.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

kikuyu: Kane akuru odwogo ire godhiambo, notingʼo it yiend zeituni mangʼich mopon e dhoge. Mano nomiyo Nowa ongʼeyo ni koro pi oseduono e piny.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

kikuyu: Jo-Israel nomako mond jo-Midian kod nyithindo kendo ne giyako kweth mag jamni, dhok, kod gik moko duto mag jo-Midian.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

kikuyu: Koro negie nikech kata gibedo piny kata chungo to nyinga ema giwuoyoe kokalo kuom wendegi.
english: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

kikuyu: Nitie gik moko auchiel ma Jehova Nyasaye mon-go, chutho gin gik moko abiriyo ma ok more:
english: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: kagiwacho niya, “En adier! Ruoth osechier kendo osefwenyore ne Simon.”
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

kikuyu: chok shekel abich ne ngʼato ka ngʼato, kaluwore gi shekel mar kama ler mar lemo, ma pekne romo gera piero ariyo.
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato oterore gi chi wuon mare, to oseelo dug wuon-gi. Ji ariyogi nyaka neg-gi kendo rembgi nobedi e wigi giwegi.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Beduru motegno un jo-Filistia! Beduru gi chir kaka chwo ka ok kamano to udhi bedo wasumb jo-Hibrania mana kaka gisebedonu. Omiyo beduru jochir kendo ukedi!”
english: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”

kikuyu: Negikonyo Daudi kuom joma ne monje nikech giduto ne gin jolweny mathuondi, kendo ne gin jotelo mag lweny.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

kikuyu: Eka ne awinjo dwol maduongʼ kakok koa ei hekalu kawuoyo gi malaike abiriyogo kawachonegi niya, “Koro dhiuru, mondo upuk tewni abiriyo mopongʼ gi mirimb Nyasaye e piny.”
english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

kikuyu: Adier, Wuora dwaro ni mondo ji duto mogeno kuom Wuowi, kendo moyie kuome mondo obed gi ngima mochwere, kendo ochiergi chiengʼ giko piny.”
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

kikuyu: Ka Jehova Nyasaye ne ok nyal dhi nyime gineno timbeu mamono kod gigo magath mane utimo, pinyu nokwongʼ kendo odongʼ gunda maonge gima odakie, mana kaka en kawuono.
english: Thus the LORD could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.

kikuyu: Awachonu adier, ni ngʼato angʼata morwako ngʼama aoro, orwaka, kendo ngʼama orwaka orwako jal ma noora.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Abner ne owuoyo gi jodong Israel kowacho niya, “Kuom kinde moko usebedo ka udwaro keto Daudi obed ruodhu.”
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

kikuyu: to ukel rwath kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham maromo kilo ariyo mar mogo mayom moru gi nus mar lita mar mo.
english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

kikuyu: Kane baruwa ochopo jogi nokawo yawuot ruoth piero abiriyogo ma ginego. Negikawo wiyegi ma giketogi ei okapu kendo giterone Jehu e piny Jezreel.
english: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

kikuyu: To beduru mamor nikech uriworu kod Kristo e sandne, mondo unudok moil chuth chiengʼ ma duongʼne nofwenyre.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

kikuyu: Ne irwake gi gweth momew kendo nisidho osimbo mar dhahabu maler e wiye.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

kikuyu: omiyo Daudi nopenjo Nyasaye niya, “Bende anyalo dhi mondo amonj jo-Filistia? Bende iniketgi e lweta?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo, nikech abiro chiwogi e lweti.”
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

kikuyu: Kel jo-Lawi weteu koa e dhoutu mag anywola mondo oriwre kodi kendo gikonyu ka in kod yawuote tiyo e nyim Hema mar Sandug Rapar.
english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

kikuyu: “Nyathi ka nyathi madichwo makayo nyaka walna. Nyak mokwongo mar nyodo e kind jo-Israel en mara, bed ni en dhano kata chiayo.”
english: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”

kikuyu: Nikech iseresa e tho kendo isegengʼo tienda mi ok ochwanyore, mondo mi awuothi e nyim Nyasaye ma en e ler makelo ngima.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

kikuyu: Omiyo jarit od twech nowachone Paulo niya, “Jangʼad bura osegolo chik mondo ogonyu, in kaachiel gi Sila. Koro unyalo aa mondo udhi kendo dhiuru gi kwe.”
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

kikuyu: Asemiye Misri kaka mich kuom tichne, nikech en kod jolweny mage ne gitiyona, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Simon ma ja-Zilote gi Judas Iskariot mane ondhoge.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

kikuyu: Zerahia nonywolo Merayoth, Merayoth nonywolo Amaria, Amaria nonywolo Ahitub,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

kikuyu: E dwe mar ochiko e higa mar abich mar loch Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda, kinde mar tweyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nolandne ji duto manie Jerusalem kod jogo mane obiro koa e dala mag Juda.
english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Yesu nowachonegi niya, “An sechega pok ochopo, un to unyalo timo gigeu sa moro amora.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Ruodha ni: “Bed e bada ma korachwich, nyaka chop aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

kikuyu: Raidhi madiere noa tungʼ nyaka tungʼ e dier sirnigo.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

kikuyu: Eka negikawo kandho Josef, mi giyangʼo diel kendo ginyumo kandho Josef e remb diel.
english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

kikuyu: Nogolo kende mag misango mag pinje ma oko kaachiel gi kuonde motingʼore malo komuko kite milamo kendo ngʼado sirni mag Ashera.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

kikuyu: Yaye ruodha, yien mane ineno, mane odongo maduongʼ kendo motegno ma wiye ochopo e polo kendo nenore e piny ngima,
english: The tree that you saw, which grew and was strong, whose height reached to the sky and its sight to all the earth;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ni e badi ma korachwich obiro loyo ruodhi chiengʼ ma mirimbe otuk.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: “E kinde mag ruodhigo, Nyasach polo nochung pinyruoth moro ma ok nokethi nyaka chiengʼ, kendo ma ok nowene oganda machielo. Enoreg pinjeruodhigo duto nyaka okelgi e gikogi, to en owuon to nosik nyaka chiengʼ.”
english: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

kikuyu: Unyalo wacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osemiyowa jonabi ei Babulon,”
english: Because you have said, “The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”

kikuyu: Bende ingʼeyo gima Nyasaye biro timoni, bende ingʼeyo gik mochomi adier, yaye lep mawuondore?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

kikuyu: Notimo misango kochiwo nyithinde mondo owangʼ e mach e Holo mar Ben Hinom bende noiro ji kendo nogoyo gagi gi timo timbe jwok, kendo nopenjo josepe kod jo-nyakalondo. Notimo timbe maricho mangʼeny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nokecho.
english: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

kikuyu: Kuom mano negidhiyo mapiyo kendo negiyudo Maria gi Josef kod nyathi konindo e sanduku mar chiemb dhok.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

kikuyu: Gibiro lwar e chonggi mi gipodhi, to wan wabiro aa malo mi wachungʼ motegno.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

kikuyu: Ndalowa kadho piyo nikech mirimbi; hikwa rumo piyo gi chir.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

kikuyu: to an awuon ema nabed jasik ngʼatno gi dhoodgi duto. Kargi anangʼad oko kuom ogandagi, kaachiel gi jogo duto maluwe kendo madwanyore kalamo Molek.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

kikuyu: Ne oii gi malaika mi oloye; eka noywak kendo kwayo mondo otimne ngʼwono. Noyude Bethel kendo mowuoyo kode kanyo.
english: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gaboro ne mar Hanani gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Mano kaka isepodho kia e polo, yaye ratego, sulwe mar okinyi! Oseboli e piny in ma yande itieko ogendini.
english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

kikuyu: Ligangla notiek faresege gi gechene kod welo duto mane ondiko e lweny! Ginibed ka mon. Ligangla notiek kuondegi mag kano mwandu kendo nokwalgi!
english: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jopuonj chik nobiro moyudo ka gimino wach. Kane owinjo ka Yesu odwokogi kare, nopenje niya, “Kuom Chike duto mag Nyasaye, en mane maduongʼ moloyo chike moko duto?”
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

kikuyu: Kane owinjo wachno, Pilato nopenjo ka ngʼatni ne en ja-Galili.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

kikuyu: Oseturo denda duto motieka kendo opudho genona ka ngʼama pudho yien.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

kikuyu: joka Asher, ma gin jolweny molony kendo moikore ni kedo ne gin ji alufu piero angʼwen (40,000);
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

kikuyu: “Yaye jo-Juda modongʼ, Jehova Nyasaye osenyisou ni, ‘Kik udhi Misri.’ Beduru gadiera kuom ma: Asiemou kawuono
english: “The LORD has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.

kikuyu: Noketo jotichne mamon ariyo kod nyithindgi nyime, kiluwogi gi Lea kod nyithinde, to Rael gi Josef ema noketo chien.
english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

kikuyu: Kane Pilato oneno ni onge gima nonyalo timo, to ni mahu ema koro ne chakore, nokawo pi mi ologo e nyim ogandano, kowacho niya, “An aler kuom remb ngʼatni, en wachu!”
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

kikuyu: Eka noloso Nam mar mula moleny, molworore kaka karaya, ma lachne romo fut apar gabich to tutne romo fut aboro. Alworane duto ne romo fut piero angʼwen gangʼwen.
english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

kikuyu: Onge gima nodongʼ makmana kirni e nyim joma otwe kata podho e lwet janek. Kata ka magi duto osetimore, to mirimbe ok norum kuomgi, kendo pod odhi nyime mana gikumogi.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye noketo chuny Farao odoko matek kendo ne ok onyal weyo jo-Israel mondo odhi.
english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

kikuyu: Uzia notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike machiegni gi paw liete ruodhi nikech ji nowacho niya, “Ne en kod dhoho.” Kendo Jotham wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: To in Kapernaum, bende ibiro tingʼori malo nyaka polo koso? Ooyo, ibiro lwar piny nyaka piny joma otho. Ka dine bed ni honni mane otim e iyi ne otim ei Sodom to dikoro pod entie nyaka kawuono.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, “Ok an maru kata mar wasiku, to asebiro kaka jatend lweny mar Jehova Nyasaye.” Omiyo Joshua nopodho auma e nyime gi luor, mi openje niya, “En wach mane ma ruodha nigodo ni jatichne?”
english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of the LORD’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”

kikuyu: “Ji ariyo ne nigi gowi mar jahol pesa, moro. Achiel nenigigope mar silingʼ mia abich, to machielo piero abich.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

kikuyu: “Ne aparo e chunya ni, ‘Tho biro kawa mos ka adak maber e dalana, kendo ka hika mae pinyni oniangʼ,
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

kikuyu: Unyalo chamo winyo moro amora ma ok ler.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

kikuyu: Kane Athalia min Ahazia noneno ni wuode osetho, nodhi mondo otiek dala ruoth duto.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

kikuyu: In ngʼat mawuondoreni, mokwongo gol pilni maduongʼ mar yath manie wangʼi iwuon oko, eka ibiro neno maler mar golo ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼ wadu oko.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: Unyalo dak e dierwa; pinyni en maru dagieuru, timeuru ohala kendo uyudieuru giu uwegi.”
english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

kikuyu: Eka Isaya janabi nodhi ir Ruoth Hezekia mopenje niya, “Angʼo mane jogo owacho kendo negia kanye?” Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Negia e piny mabor, miluongo ni Babulon.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”

kikuyu: Eka thuol nongʼogo pi moa e dhoge mamol ka aora mondo oyuogo dhakono gi oula mamol ka apaka.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro gi dho janabi Jehu wuod Hanani ni Baasha kod ode, nikech richo duto mane osetimo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, komiye mirima gi gik moko mane osetimo, kendo kobedo machal gi od Jeroboam, kendo bende nikech mano nokethe.
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

kikuyu: Mirimba biro bedo mager kodu kendo abiro negou gi ligangla mondeu biro bedo monde liete kendo nyithindu biro bedo nyithi kiye.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

kikuyu: Donge onego umiya luor?” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Donge dutetni e nyim wangʼa? Ne aketo kuoyo obedo kiewo mar nam, ragengʼ manyaka chiengʼ ma ok onyal kalo. Apaka nyalo gingore, to ok ginyal kalo; ginyalo ruto, to ok ginyal kalo dhi loka kocha.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says the LORD; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, Jal Maler mar Israel wacho: “Warruok gi kwe nowuog kuom hulo richo, tekou nowuog kuom horuok kod genou kuoma, to kata onge gima usetimo kuom gigi duto.
english: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

kikuyu: To ka unyisa gima ne aleko kendo unyisa tiende, to ubiro yudo mich gi osimbo kod duongʼ malich. Omiyo nyisauru leknano kendo nyisauru tiende.”
english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua gi jolwenje duto nobiro momonjogi apoya e Sokni mag Merom mi gikedo kodgi,
english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro resa, kendo wanawer wende pak gi nyiduonge, ndalo duto mag ngimawa ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Ooyo, asando ringra mondo owinj wachna, mondo kik yud ni an awuon ok ayudo osimb loch, bangʼ yalo Injili ne ji mamoko.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye gero ute e polo kendo orenjo mise mag polo e piny, bangʼe oluongo pi nam mondo obi kendo oologi e piny, Jehova Nyasaye e nyinge.
english: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—the LORD is his name.

kikuyu: Musa kod Harun notimo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochikogi.
english: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.

kikuyu: “To ne, an ema ne achweyo jatheth mula, machwako chuma e mach, kendo loso gige lweny makare ne tijno. An ema asechweyo jaketh mabiro kelonegi chandruok;
english: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho to ne onge ji, winy duto manie kor polo nosefuyo molal.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

kikuyu: To unutony kuluwo holono, nikech enoyawre nyaka Azel. Unuring utony mana kaka ne uringo ka utony ne yiengni piny mane otimore ndalo loch Uzia ruodh Juda. Eka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha nobi, ka jomaler duto ni kode.
english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

kikuyu: Efraim biro bet gunda ka chiengʼ makumogie ochopo. Alando gima nyaka timre e kind dhout Israel.
english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

kikuyu: Nyaguru olemo manyiso ni uselokoru uweyo richo.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ichayo misangona kod chiwo ma asechiwoni kar dakna? Angʼo momiyo imiyo yawuoti duongʼ moloya ka uchiemo kendo ubedo machwe un uwegi kendo ka uyiero kuonde mabeyoe moloyo kuom chiwo ka chiwo ma joga Israel chiwo?’
english: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’

kikuyu: to kata dine bed ni ji adekgi ema bedie, Nowa, Daniel kod Ayub to digires mana ngimagi giwegi nikech timbegi makare, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ogolou Misri mondo obed Nyasachu. An Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.’ ”
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma terore gi nyamin kata nyar wuon kata nyar min mare.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Nyar Babulon chalo gi kar dino e seche minyone; kinde ma ikaye chiegni chopo.”
english: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”

kikuyu: To kuom jolwenygo duto mane oyier ne nitie ji mia abiriyo ma rochembe manyalo bayo orujre, ma moro ka moro ne nyalo bayo orujre ma goo yier wich ma ok obayo.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

kikuyu: Kendo nowachone dhano ni, ‘Luoro Ruoth Nyasaye kelo rieko, kendo ka idwaro bedo gi ngʼeyo to nyaka iwe richo!’ ”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

kikuyu: Giko to nyaka ni ginihul wach man kuomgi giwegi ni Jal moikore mar ngʼado bura ni joma ngima gi joma otho.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Ne nitie mon moko mane ngʼicho gichien. Moko kuomgi ne gin Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria min Jakobo matin, ma bende min Joses, kod Salome.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

kikuyu: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu. Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, un jotich duto mag Jehova Nyasaye, kendo matiyo gotieno e od Jehova Nyasaye.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

kikuyu: “Dhi ichok jo-Yahudi duto man Susa, mondo utwe chiemo kulemona. Kik uchiem kata metho kuom ndalo adek otieno gi odiechiengʼ. An gi nyiri matiyona bende wabiro tweyo chiemo kendo metho mana kaka un. Ka usetimo kamano, to abiro dhi ir ruoth, kata obedo ni chik ok oyie kamano. Ka ochuno ni nyaka atho, to anatho.”
english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

kikuyu: Kane oyudo jopuonjre Johana wuok mondo odogi, Yesu nochako wuoyo gi oganda kuom Johana kowacho niya, “Angʼo mane udhi mondo une e thim? Ne udhi neno odundu ma yamo tero koso?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Bangʼe inine ber kimako chike kod buche ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Musa ne jo-Israel. Bed motegno kendo gichir, kik iluor kata kik chunyi bed gi nyosruok.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

kikuyu: Meshelemia ne nigi yawuowi, wuowi makayo ne en Zekaria, mar ariyo ne en Jediael, mar adek ne en Zebadia, mar angʼwen ne en Jathniel,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

kikuyu: Ginyalo konyo owetegi e tije mag Hemb Romo, to gin giwegi ok onego gimul tich moro amora. Ma e kaka ibiro pogo tije ne jo-Lawi.”
english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

kikuyu: “An gi weche mangʼeny monego awachnu, to ok unyal winjo tiendgi sani.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

kikuyu: Winjauru un joga, chikuru itu un ogandana: Abiro golo chik kendo bucha makare nobed ler ne ogendini.
english: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.

kikuyu: To Jona nokecho ahinya makoro ne oonge gi mor e chunye.
english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

kikuyu: ka inindo, to ok inibed maluor, kendo ininind mayom nyaka piny ru.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

kikuyu: Arauna nowacho ne Daudi niya, “We ruodha ma en ruoth okawe kendo otim kode gima chunye dwaro mondo otimgo misango. Rwedhi mag timo misango miwangʼo pep kod yiend dino kaachiel gi jok minyalo tigo kaka yien nika.
english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

kikuyu: Kik iwe Kitabu mar Chikni oa e dhogi; par wechene matut odiechiengʼ kod otieno, mondo mi ibed motangʼ kitimo gik moko duto mondik e iye. Mano biro miyo ibedo gi hawi e gimoro amora mitimo.
english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

kikuyu: Yesu nokawo jopuonjre apar gariyo otero tenge kendo nowachonegi niya, “Eri wadhi nyaka Jerusalem, to gigo duto mane ondiki gi jonabi kuom Wuod Dhano ibiro timogi.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

kikuyu: Chakre e dier ot nyaka e nyim kama idonjogo ma oko, ne nitie kerubi kod yiend othith mopa molworo hekalu duto.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

kikuyu: Noyudo ka Rael osekawo nyisechego mopando e bwo kom ngamia mobetie. Laban nodwaro gik moko duto mane ni ei hema to ne ok oyudo gimoro.
english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu ochopo, to noyudo ka Lazaro osetieko ndalo angʼwen e bur.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nigi teko maduongʼ moloyo mor mar pige maroteke, en gi teko maduongʼ moloyo apaka ma tekregi ngʼeny, adier Jehova Nyasaye man malo nigi teko maduongʼ.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wachna nodag gi kwe kendo mayom, maonge luoro mar hinyruok.
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

kikuyu: kendo owuoyo kuom Sairas ni, ‘En jakwadha kendo enochop kare gigo duto madwaro; enowachne Jerusalem niya, “Mad gere kendo,” to ne hekalu ni, “Mad mise mare keti.” ’ ”
english: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane ogandani duto oseter nyangu, ne gidongʼ e kambi nyaka ne gichango.
english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

kikuyu: Kamano nangʼo? Nikech ne ok gidware kuom yie, to ne gidware ka giparo ni iyude kuom tim. Negichwanyore e kidi mar chwanyruok.
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

kikuyu: Ka higni abiriyo norumo noduogo koa e piny jo-Filistia modhi kwayo ruoth mondo odwokne ode kod lope.
english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Bende usewinjo tiend gigi duto?” Ne giyiene niya, “Ee.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Neye gima gitimonwa kuom biro mondo giriembwa e gima nimiyowa kaka girkeni marwa.
english: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

kikuyu: Eka malaika nomedo wachona ni, ‘Tingʼ wangʼi kendo ineye kaka nywogi duto maluwo diek gin rabok, angʼech kod ma dikiyo, nimar aseneno gik moko duto ma Laban osebedo katimoni.
english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

kikuyu: Joma odak kuonde maboyo oluoro timbeni miwuoro, imiyo ji werni gimor, kuma okinyi yaworee kendo odhiambo rumoe.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

kikuyu: Koro Jethro, jadolo mar Midian kendo jaduongʼ Musa, nowinjo gik moko duto mane Nyasaye osetimo ni Musa, kaachiel gi joge ma jo-Israel, bende kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosegolo jo-Israel kawuok e piny Misri.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne mor ahinya mi nogolo chik mondo ogol Daniel ei bur sibuoche. Kane ogol Daniel oko e bur sibuoche, to ne ok noyudi kama lit moro amora e dende, nikech nogeno kuom Nyasache kinde duto.
english: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

kikuyu: Ne gitero ngʼat machon ne muofuno ir jo-Farisai.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Bende ne osegero kuonde motingʼore malo mag lemo e gode matindo mag Juda kendo nomiyo jo-Jerusalem oweyo Nyasaye kendo omiyo jo-Juda bende orwenyo.
english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

kikuyu: Anami gicham ringre yawuotgi kod nyigi, kendo ginichamre kendgi e kinde marach ma wasikgi ogengʼonigi ka dwaro ngimagi.’
english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’

kikuyu: Eka noloso ludhe mag yiend siala mi obawogi gi dhahabu.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Oori gi ruoth kod jongʼadne rieko abiriyo mondo inon wach kaka Juda gi Jerusalem dhi kaluwore gi chik Nyasachi manie lweti.
english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

kikuyu: Ka jo-Yahudi manodak Thesalonika nowinjo ni Paulo ne yalo wach Nyasaye Berea, negidhi kuno bende, kendo negichoko oganda mondo ochak koko, ka giketho chuny ji.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

kikuyu: Ibiro geri e tim makare: Ok nichak ine tij achuna; kendo onge gima iniluor. Bwok maduongʼ ibiro ter mabor kode; kendo ok ginisud machiegni kodi.
english: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.

kikuyu: Anami Elam ongʼengʼ e nyim wasike, e nyim jogo madwaro tieko ngimagi; anakel masiche kuomgi, ma en mirimba mager,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho. “Analawgi gi ligangla manyaka atiekgi.”
english: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

kikuyu: Eka ne awachonu niya, “Usechopo e pinje mag gode mar jo-Amor ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa miyowa.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne asin gi ngima, nikech tich mitimo e bwo wangʼ chiengʼ ne pek mohewa. Magi duto onge tiendgi, gichalo gi lawo bangʼ yamo.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Yier puonjna kar fedha kendo ngʼeyo kar dhahabu mowal,
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

kikuyu: kendo Nebukadneza nowachonegi niya, “Bende en adier, Shadrak, Meshak kod Abednego, ni ok uti ne nyisechena kendo ok ulam kido mar dhahabu masechungo?
english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye e teko mar joge, en e ohinga mar resruok ni joge moyiero.
english: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

kikuyu: Resuru joma ok nyal kod joma ochando; golgiuru e lwet joma timbegi richo.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

kikuyu: Kamachielo bende owachoe niya, “Yaye Ruoth, kar chakruok ne iketo mise mag piny kendo polo bende gin tij lweti.
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Kane Jona ne ni ei rech, nolamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

kikuyu: to mamoko mangʼeny to neginego, nikech lweny ne mar Nyasaye. Pinyni nobedo margi nyaka ne otergi e twech.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

kikuyu: kendo iseyiero jonabi mondo okor wachni Jerusalem ni, ‘Nitiere ruoth e piny Juda!’ Koro wachni biro dwogone ruoth; omiyo bi, mondo wapim wachni.”
english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

kikuyu: Koro chiw chik ne jogi mondo giwe tich, mondo omi dala maduongʼni kik ger kendo nyaka an ema achiw chik.
english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

kikuyu: to gikone okech ka kedhno kendo obith ka ligangla ma dhoge ariyo.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

kikuyu: In e tacha, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Jehova Nyasaye loko mudho momaka bedo ler.
english: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼat ma janeko madiro pil mach kata aserni mager,
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi Roho nono gik moko duto, to en to onge ngʼama none.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

kikuyu: kata ka tiende kata bade ongʼol,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

kikuyu: To nodwoke niya, “Ineno ute madongo malichgi? Onge kidi kata achiel mabiro dongʼ kochungʼ ewi wadgi; gibiro redhore piny duto.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: An kod jogo duto man koda, to biro dhi nyime e dala maduongʼ, to ka jogo obiro mondo omonjwa kaka negitimo motelocha, to wabiro ringo waa irgi.
english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.

kikuyu: Ka Delila noneno nine osenyise gik moko duto, nooro wach ne jotend jo-Filistia niya, “Dwoguru dichiel; osenyisa gik moko duto.” Omiyo jotend jo-Filistia noduogo gi chudo e lwetgi.
english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.

kikuyu: Negidhi ir jodolo madongo gi jodongo mi giwachonegi niya, “Wasekwongʼore waduto ni ok wanacham kata madho gimoro kapok wanego Paulo.
english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

kikuyu: Ne ogoyo pinje mangʼeny piny, kendo ne onego ruodhi maroteke,
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

kikuyu: Koro ka ariembo jochiende gi teko mar Belzebub, to joma luwou to kara gologi gi teko mar ngʼa? Emomiyo, ginibed jongʼadnu bura.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nodak e dala mochiel gi ohinga moluonge ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Nogere kolwore gi ohinga motegno gi yo ka iye.
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

kikuyu: Omiyo Jakobo notiyone Laban higni abiriyo mondo oyud Rael, to hignigo nonenorene mana ka ndalo matin nikech hera manoherogo Rael.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

kikuyu: Apwoyonu nyaminwa Fibi, ma en jatich e kanisa man Kenkrea.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

kikuyu: ka gin kanyakla gi Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Relaya, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum kod Baana. Kar kwan mar nying jo-Israel machwo e magi.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat ma onego nyawadgi lingʼ-lingʼ.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Gionge tich, gin gik minyiero; ka ndalogi mar ngʼado bura ochopo, to ginilal nono.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nochano gi riekone ni piny ok nyal ngʼeyo Kristo gi riekone owuon, to nochano mana ni kuom fuwo mar wach mwalandoni ema owarogo joma oyie.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

kikuyu: Abiro budo lowo gi rembi mamol koa ewi gode, kendo holni biro pongʼ gi ringri.
english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.

kikuyu: Nying Jehova Nyasaye onego opaki, chakre kuma chiengʼ wuokie, nyaka kuma opodhoe.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

kikuyu: Kane Jehu odok ir jotend lweny wetene achiel kuomgi nopenje niya, “Bende weche duto beyo? To angʼo mane janekono obirone iri?” Jehu nodwokogi niya, “Ungʼeyo ngʼatno, to gi gik ma onyalo wacho.”
english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

kikuyu: Kinyne, ka Pashur nogonye e lodi, Jeremia nowachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok luongi ni Pashur, to oluongi ni Magor-Misabib.
english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

kikuyu: To mana kaka Jal moluongou ler, beduru maler e gimoro amora mutimo;
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

kikuyu: Nonywolone yawuowi magin Jeush, Shemaria kod Zaham.
english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

kikuyu: “Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

kikuyu: Dhako moro amora ma chwore otho ok nyal ndik nyinge kama indike nying mon ma chwogi otho ka hikgi ok oloyo higni piero auchiel, to bende nyaka bed ni ne osebedo ja-adiera e dakne gi chwore,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

kikuyu: Nonyisogi gima Mika nosetimone, kendo owacho niya, “Osekawa kaka jatije kendo an jadolo mare.”
english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

kikuyu: Wuod Harun manoket kare kaka jadolo kendo ma nobi e Hemb Romo mondo oti tij dolo e Kama Ler norwak lewnigo kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

kikuyu: Onego ngʼat makare ema ogoya, nikech mano chalo tim ngʼwono motimona; onego en ema okwera, nikech mano chalo mo mool e wiya; ok anyal dagi mondo ngʼama kare otimna kamano. To kata kamano obiro kwedo timbe joma richo e lemona;
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

kikuyu: Jokedo mage duto ma notony gi ngʼwech biro podho e lak ligangla, kendo joge modongʼ noke kuonde duto. Eka unungʼe ni an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewuoyo.
english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’

kikuyu: to Jehova Nyasaye biro riembo ogendinigi duto e nyimu, kendo ubiro kawo pinje madongo kendo maroteke moloyou.
english: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

kikuyu: Kapo ni moko kuom ogendini mag piny otamore dhi Jerusalem mondo olam Ruoth, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, to koth ok nochwenigi.
english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

kikuyu: “Kwanuru jogo mahikgi romo piero ariyo kadhi nyime, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.” Jo-Israel mane owuok Misri e magi:
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: To koro nadi? Gima Israel ne manyo gi tekrene duto ne ok onwangʼo, to joma oyier ema noyude. Joma moko duto chunygi nodoko matek,
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

kikuyu: Ezer nonywolo: Bilhan, Zavan kod Akan.
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

kikuyu: E ndalo mar chwiri, e kinde ma ruodhi dhi e lweny, Daudi nooro Joab gi joka ruoth to gi jolweny mag Israel duto. Negigoyo jo-Amon mi gitiekogi kendo negimako dala mar Raba. To Daudi nodongʼ e Jerusalem.
english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ka uwinjo ka pinje gore koni gi koni kod humbe mag lwenje to kik kibaji gou. Gik ma kamago nyaka timre, to giko piny to pod ni nyime.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Negiketo nyisechegi manono e ot ma Nyinga nitiere kendo ginjawe.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

kikuyu: Timna makare nobed janeno e ndalo mabiro kendo, e sa asaya ma ibiro rango pok ma isechula. Diel moro amora ma ok angʼech kata dibo kata nyarombo ma ok ratengʼ manoyud e kindgi nokwan ka gima okwal.”
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Chiew gokinyi ahinya mondo irom gi Farao ka odhi e aora Nael mondo inyise kama: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: We joga odhi mondo gilama.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Kane ruodh Israel kalo machiegni gi ohinga mar dala maduongʼno, dhako moro noywak malit kawacho niya, “Konya, ruodha!”
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

kikuyu: E yo kama otingʼore mar Efraim nomi Shekem (ma en dala maduongʼ mar tony ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko) kod Gezer,
english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: E higano mane Ruoth Uzia othoe, naneno Ruoth Nyasaye kobet e kom duongʼ motingʼore malo kendo omi luor, ka tiend lawe opongʼo hekalu.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

kikuyu: Wach mokor kuom piny Ongoro manie dho Nam: Mana kaka kalausi mager kudho koluwo piny man yo milambo, e kaka joma monjou biro wuok e piny motwo, piny masira.
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

kikuyu: Negidhi ir Hilkia jadolo maduongʼ mi gimiye pesa mane osekel e hekalu mar Nyasaye ma jo-Lawi ma jorit dhoudi nosechoko kuom jo-Manase gi jo-Efraim kod jo-Israel duto mane odongʼ gi jo-Juda gi jo-Benjamin kaachiel gi joma nodak Jerusalem.
english: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: E ndalo mane Yesu ngima e pinyni, nolamo kosayo Nyasaye mane nyalo rese e tho, koywak malit kendo ka pi wangʼe chwer, mi Nyasaye nowinjo ywakne nikech dembruokne.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

kikuyu: “Nodwoke ni, ‘Debe mia aboro mag mo.’ “Jarit tich nowachone ni, ‘Bed piny piyo piyo, ikaw kitapi indikie ni, mia angʼwen.’
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

kikuyu: Nikech aherogi, omiyo anapar singruok mane atimo gi kweregi, mane agolo e piny Misri mana kane ogendini neno mondo an Jehova Nyasaye abed Nyasachgi.”
english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “We joma otho oik jogegi motho, to in dhiyo kendo iland wach mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: To kuom gik ma joma moko timo, kaluwore gi wach mowuok e dhogi, an awuon asepogora gi yore jo-mahundu.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

kikuyu: En ngʼat mane otimo honni kod ranyisi mane Jehova Nyasaye oore mondo otim e piny Misri ne Farao kendo ne jodonge koda ka piny duto.
english: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

kikuyu: Nikech Yesu Kristo notimo dwaro Nyasaye, omiyo koro osepwodhwa e richo kuom ringre mane ochiwo kaka misango dichiel kende.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

kikuyu: Sewni mau mag lemo nolokre ywak mar tho, wendeu mag mor, to nolokre dengo. Uduto anami urwakru gi pien gugru ka ulielo wiyeu mapoth. Unuchal kod joma ywago wuodgi ma miderma, kendo odiechiengʼno nobed malit mapok ne kone e piny.”
english: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.

kikuyu: Jareswa, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge, en e Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Wich teko mar dhano ibiro dwoko piny kendo sunga mag ji nothir, mi Jehova Nyasaye kende ema notingʼ malo odiechiengno,
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

kikuyu: Ma emomiyo aneno ni gik moko duto chalre nikech okumo joma onge ketho kod joma timbegi richo machalre.
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

kikuyu: Puonj mane ayudo kuom Ruoth mi amiyou chal kama: Ruoth Yesu nokawo makati e otienono mane ondhogee,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato kuomu neno sand to kik bed nikech ojanek kata ojakuo, kata en ja-mahundu, kata ojaketre e weche ji.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

kikuyu: Wach nodoko dhano kendo nodak kodwa. Waseneno duongʼne, ma en duongʼ mar Wuowi ma Miderma, ma noa ka Wuoro kopongʼ gi ngʼwono kod adiera.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: aidha bende gin le man-gi teko matin, to giloso gondgi e kind kite,
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

kikuyu: E kinde manochopo irgi, nonuoyonegi wechegi.
english: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

kikuyu: Ruoth nopenjo niya, “En kidi mane manie dho liel maneno cha?” Jo-dala maduongʼno nodwoke niya, “Onyiso kar liend ngʼat Nyasaye mane oa Juda mane okoro gik mane itimo e kendo mar misango man Bethel.”
english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

kikuyu: Omiyo koro andikonu ok nikech ukia adiera, to nikech ungʼeye, kendo nikech ungʼeyo ni onge miriambo mawuok e adiera.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

kikuyu: To ngʼato angʼata mokweda e nyim ji en bende nokwede e nyim malaike mag Nyasaye.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

kikuyu: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ogendini manie piny, wachuru ni Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo en gi teko.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: To koro wangʼeyo ni gimoro amora ma Chik wacho, owacho ni joma ni e bwo chik, mondo ji duto olingʼ thi, kendo buch Nyasaye olo piny duto.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ni machiegni gi ji duto maluongo nyinge, to mana joma luongo nyinge e adiera.
english: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

kikuyu: Maluwe ne en Eliazar wuod Dodai ma ja-Ahohi, achiel kuom thuondi adek.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Geno mochopi en gima mit ne chuny, to joma ofuwo ok dwar aa e richo.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

kikuyu: Bende wir Jehu wuod Nimshi obed ruodh Israel, kendo iwir Elisha wuod Shafat ma ja-Abel Mehola mondo okaw kari kaka janabi.
english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

kikuyu: Anto anyisou ni ngʼato angʼata ma mirima omako gi nyawadgi ibiro ngʼadne bura. Bende, ngʼato angʼata mowachone nyawadgi ni, ‘Raka,’ ma tiende ni ifuwo, nyaka yal e buch jo-Sanhedrin. To ngʼato angʼata mowacho ni, ‘Ifuwo nade,’ biro neno chandruok mar mach mar Gehena.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

kikuyu: Ne en e piny, to kata obedo ni en ema nomiyo ochwe piny, to piny ne ok ongʼeye.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: “Kar sa adek nowuok oko mi noneno jomoko kochungʼ e chiro ka gibudho abudha.
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

kikuyu: Ka ukawo owadgi bende ma gimoro dhi ohinye, to di umi chunya chandruok ma atho ka an gi kuyo to aseti.’
english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

kikuyu: Ne angʼicho, kendo ne aneno gima kite chalo gi dhano. Chakre kama ne chalo nungone kadhi piny, nechalo mach, kite ne ler kendo rieny ka chuma mopiagi.
english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Nyasaye nogwedho jochologo, kendo jo-Israel nomedo nyaa mi odoko oganda maduongʼ.
english: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.

kikuyu: Nikech chiengʼ ma chandruok omaka obiro panda maber e kar dakne; obiro panda e kar pondo mar hembe maler kendo obiro keta malo ewi lwanda.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

kikuyu: Sidienje adek mag jolwenj jo-Filistia nowuok e kambi margi, migawo mokwongo nodhi momonjo jo-Ofra e piny Shual,
english: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

kikuyu: Kane kerubigo ochungʼ to tiendego bende ne chungʼ kodgi, nikech chuny gik mangimago ne ni ei tiendego.
english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

kikuyu: Achien thuolo nochopo mondo Herodia otim dwarone. Chiengʼ rapar mar nywol Herode nochopo, kendo ne oloso chiemo moyiedhi ne jotend ogandane madongo gi jotend jolweny mage kod jok midewo duto moa Galili.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

kikuyu: Eka Kaleb nokwero ji mondo olingʼ e nyim Musa kendo nowacho niya, “Wadhiuru kendo wakaw pinyno, nimar wanyalo kawe.”
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

kikuyu: E seche mane gimadho divai, negipako nyiseche mag dhahabu gi fedha gi mula gi nyinyo gi bao kod kidi.
english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, wat dhakono nowachone Boaz niya, “In, ema mondo ingʼiewe.” Kendo nolonyo wuochene.
english: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.

kikuyu: Kane osengʼad wach ni onego okwangʼwa wadhi Italia, Paulo kod joma otwe mamoko noketi e lwet jatend jolweny moro ma nyinge Julias. Ngʼatno ema ne jatend oganda lweny mane iluongo ni Jorit Dala Ruoth.
english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

kikuyu: Nyithindo ma ibiro nywolo bangʼ-gi ema nobed magi; to kar chamo girkeni, nokwan-gi mana kaka joka Efraim kod Manase.
english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

kikuyu: dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ nochak nying moluwore gi nying dhout Israel. Dhorangeye adek man yo nyandwat noluong ni rangaj Reuben, rangaj Juda kod rangaj Lawi.
english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

kikuyu: Eka enowe winyo mangima mondo ofu odogi e pap mar dala matin. Mae e kaka nopwodh ot kendo nobed maler.”
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

kikuyu: kachiwo mwandu ni jogo mohera kendo amiyo kuondegi mag keno bedo mopongʼ chutho.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

kikuyu: Siem ngʼat makelo pogruok dichiel, to kisesiemo ngʼat makelo pogruok diriyo to pogri kode chuth.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

kikuyu: Wich ka wich oliel kendo yie tik ka yie tik ongʼad oko; lwedo ka lwedo otongʼ oko kendo nungo ka nungo oum gi law ywak.
english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.

kikuyu: Ne awachonegi niya, “Dhorangeye ma Jerusalem ok yaw nyaka chiengʼ bed makech. Ka jorit rangach pod tiyo, to nyisgi gilor dhoudi kendo uchieg-gi gi lodi. Bende yieruru joma odak Jerusalem kaka jorit, jomoko uket machiegni gi kuondegi mag rito, to mamoko ubed machiegni gi utegi.”
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

kikuyu: “Donge ungʼeyo gima an kod kwerena osetimo ni ogendini mamoko duto mag pinje? Dak ne nyiseche pinjego duto resgi e lweta?
english: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

kikuyu: To ka Nyasaye ne ok oweyo ma ok okumo kata mana malaike mane oketho, to ne owitogi e gehena ma en mach ma ok tho, koketogi e mudho mandiwa ka girito kumgi;
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

kikuyu: Kik yud ngʼato kuomu matimo misango gi wuode kata nyare e kendo, kata matimo timbe nyakalondo, kata jwok, kata loko dhoch kata ido,
english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

kikuyu: Ngʼat marito chik en wuowi mariek, to bedo osiep jawuoro kelo wichkuot ne wuon mare.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ni kodwa; Nyasach Jakobo e ohingawa. Sela
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Negidhi nyime kagiwacho niya, “Wegi gidagi, mondo gibednwa jobar yien gi joumb pi ni jowa duto.” Omiyo jotelo norito singruok margi.
english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.

kikuyu: To Yesu nomedo dongo kobedo gi rieko kendo e ringruok, ka en gi ngʼwono gi Nyasaye kod ji.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

kikuyu: E kindeno, ja-Filistiano gi jatingʼ kuode, ne sudo machiegni gi Daudi.
english: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

kikuyu: To anaduog Israel e kare mar kwath kendo enokwa e Karmel kod Bashan; noyiengʼ e gode matindo mag Efraim gi Gilead.”
english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

kikuyu: Aseyiero yor adiera; kendo aseketo chunya e chikeni.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

kikuyu: Ok gituomre, moro ka moro pangore kochimo nyime tir. Gimuomo gik madigengʼ-gi ka ok giketho kaka gichanore.
english: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.

kikuyu: Bangʼ wacho mano, jo-Yahudi mane winje nowuok odhi, ka gigoyo mbaka matek e kindgi giwegi.]
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

kikuyu: ngʼat mane ok oyie kod dwaro gi timbegi. Noa e dala mar Judea mar Arimathaya kendo norito biro mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne nigi yiedhi mangʼeny mag ohala e nam kaachiel gi yiedhi mag jo-Hiram. Dichiel bangʼ higni adek ka higni adek negidwogo ka gitingʼo dhahabu gi fedha gi leke liech gi ongʼeche kod bimbe.
english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo dino wangʼe mi make, kata madi duode mi tuch ume?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

kikuyu: “En adier, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ni ruodhi mag Asuria osetieko ogendini mangʼenygi ma giweyo pinjegi gunda.
english: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

kikuyu: Ne ochiwo chambgi ne ongogo, chambgi mosechiek ne bonyo.
english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

kikuyu: Jaricho yudo ohala mar miriambo, to ngʼat machwoyo gima kare kayo pok mar adiera.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

kikuyu: Eka jopuonjre nobiro ire mopenje niya, “Bende ingʼeyo ni jo-Farisai ne ochwanyore kane giwinjo wachni?”
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

kikuyu: Negitweyo ratege mag law akorno kuom ratege mag law dolo miluongoni efod gi tol e yo nungone mondo law kik gonyre kuom law efod kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kochopo odiechiengʼ mar aboro to okaw akuch odugla ariyo kata nyithi akuru ariyo, kendo okelne jadolo e dho Hemb Romo.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ja-Lawi moro nokendo nyar ja-dhoodgi,
english: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.

kikuyu: Musa nochako puonjo weche mag chik koa yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jordan nyaka tongʼ Moab kowachona niya,
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, koro reswa e lwet Senakerib mondo pinjeruodhi duto manie piny ongʼe ni in kendi e Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasaye.”
english: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, LORD, are God alone.”

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Zebulun ne gin ji alufu piero abich gabiriyo gi mia angʼwen (57,400).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: E higa mar aboro mar lochne kane pod en rawera nochako luwo Nyasach Daudi kwar mare. E hike mar apar gariyo nochako pwodho Juda kod Jerusalem koketho kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo, gi sirni mag lemo mar Ashera, gi nyiseche mopa kod kido mothedhi.
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

kikuyu: In ema aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech mach osewangʼo pewe mag kwath, kendo ligek mach osewangʼo yiende duto manie pap.
english: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

kikuyu: Nyaka odag e dala maduongʼ kanyo machop chiengʼ bura e nyim kanyakla kendo nyaka chop chiengʼ ma jadolo maduongʼ marito kanyo tho. Bangʼeno onyalo dok e dalane owuon, ma en dalano mane oringo koaye.”
english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Kik uluor, en mana An.”
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: To ka Sanbalat, Tobia, jo-Arabu, jo-Amon kod jo-Ashdod nowinjo ni loso ohinga mar Jerusalem osedhi nyime to kendo ni kuonde motuch ne idino, igi nowangʼ ahinya.
english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

kikuyu: Chiwouno nokwan kaka cham moa kar dino kata kaka divai mimadho moa kar biyo divai.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

kikuyu: Kane en kodgi e mesa, nokawo makati, nogoyo erokamano, nongʼinge kendo nochako miyogi.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye parowa kendo obiro gwedhowa; obiro gwedho dhood Israel, obiro gwedho dhood joka Harun,
english: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

kikuyu: Malaika mar Nyasaye noluonga e lek ni, ‘Jakobo.’ Eka nadwoke ni, ‘An ka.’
english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

kikuyu: Ngʼeuru ni uchungʼ kama opogore gi kama jo-Israel nochungʼie. Ok uchungʼ e tie got minyalo mul gi lwedo kata kama mach kaknie kendo mudho mandiwa gi ongʼwengʼo oumo,
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

kikuyu: Un uwegi ungʼeyo, owetewa, ni limbe mane walimougo ne ok obedo kayiem nono.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

kikuyu: Abiro bedo kagologi matin tin e nyimu, nyaka chop umedru moromo kawo pinyno.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Un gi makati adi? Dhi ungʼi.” Kane gisekwano kar romb makati mane gin-go neginyiso Yesu niya, “Abich, gi rech ariyo.”
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

kikuyu: Kinyne Saulo nopogo joge e migepe adek; kane ochopo kogwen eka negidonjo e kambi mar jo-Amon mi ginegogi nyaka chiengʼ obet makech. Jogo mane otony ne oke maonge ji ariyo mane owe kawuotho kaachiel.
english: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

kikuyu: Eka Ehud nowuok gie otuchi manie wi tado; nochiego dhoudi manie agola mamalo mi olorogi.
english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

kikuyu: ‘An e Nyasach kwereni; ma Nyasach Ibrahim gi Isaka kod Jakobo.’ Omiyo Musa notetni ka luoro omake, kendo ne ok ohedhore ngʼiyo bunguno kendo.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

kikuyu: To nopenjogi niya, “Kare un bende wach pod ok donjnu? Donge ungʼeyo ni gima ni oko kodonjo ei dhano ok nyal miyo odok mogak?
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

kikuyu: Kuom mano, agolonu chik, un polo, mondo uyiengni malich, kuwuoro kendo kudhier nono,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Masira rita, osekunyna bugo kendo obadho osechikna, yaye un oganda modak e piny.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi owinjo ni Nabal osetho, nowacho niya, “Pak obed ne Jehova Nyasaye, mosechulo kuor kuom ajara mane Nabal ojarago. Osegengʼo jatichne mondo kik otim marach mi oseketo timbene maricho e wiye owuon.” Eka Daudi nooro wach ne Abigael, kopenje mondo obed chiege.
english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is the LORD, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. The LORD has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.

kikuyu: “To koro sani asebiro mondo awach ma ni ruodha ma en ruoth nikech ji osemiya luoro. Jatichni noparo ni, ‘Abiro wuoyo gi ruoth; kamoro dipo kotimo gima jatichne okwaye.
english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

kikuyu: Ndalogo jo-Israel ne onge gi ruoth. Koro ja-Lawi mane odak e chuny piny e gode mag Efraim nokendo nyako moro moa Bethlehem e piny Juda.
english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

kikuyu: nowacho niya, “Abiro gwedhi adier, kendo abiro miyi nyikwayo mangʼeny.”
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

kikuyu: Mapiyo bangʼ mano, Yesu nodhi e dala miluongo ni Nain, to jopuonjrene gi oganda maduongʼ bende nodhi kode.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye chuli kuom gima isetimo. Mad Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel, misebiro mondo ipondi e bwo bwombene, ogwedhi gi gweth mogundho.”
english: May the LORD repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

kikuyu: Yesu nogonyo ngʼatno piyo piyo mondo odhi kochike matek niya,
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

kikuyu: Omiyo notere ir jatend jolweny. Ne owachone niya, “Paulo ma otwecha ne oluonga ire mi okwaya mondo akel wuowini iri nikech, en-gi wach moro modwaro nyisi.”
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

kikuyu: Nimar kama e kaka Nyasaye noketo singruok: “Ka kinde moketi ochopo, to anaduogi kendo Sara noyud wuowi.”
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Kane pod an kodgi, to nachikogi kendo naritogi maber gi nying mane imiya. Onge kata achiel kuomgi moselal, makmana ngʼatno mane ochan ni nyaka lal mondo Ndiko ochop kare.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Koro tangʼuru kendo rituru kweth duto ma Roho Maler oketo e lwetu mondo uriti. Beduru jokwath mag Kanisa Nyasaye ma nongʼiewo gi rembe owuon.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

kikuyu: Jatelo mar abich e dwe mar abich ne en Shamhuth ma ja-Izra. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Solomon nonyiso herane ni Jehova Nyasaye kowuotho moluwore gi yore mag Daudi wuon-gi makmana ni notimo misengini kendo nowangʼo ubani kuonde motingʼore.
english: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

kikuyu: Jodir asere nolawe matek kokecho, ne gibaye gi asere ka igi owangʼ.
english: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Biuru uluwa, mondo kar ywayo rech to aketu ubed joywa ji.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Musa nowacho ne jongʼad bura mag Israel niya, “Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu nyaka neg jou machwo ma oseriwore e lamo Baal mar Peor.”
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
