kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Elija niya, “Lor idhi kode, kik iluore.” Omiyo Elija nolor modhi kode ir ruoth.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi notimo kaka Musa nochikogi kendo chiengʼno ji madirom alufu adek nonegi.
english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

kikuyu: Donge ma e okombe ma ruodha metho godo kendo otiyogo kuom koro wach? Gima utimoni en gima rach.”
english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

kikuyu: Ngʼatno nochul chudo moromo sekel mia achiel mar fedha mondo mi wuon nyako nikech ngʼatni osemiyo nyar Israel mangili nying marach. Nyakono nosik kode kaka chiege kendo ok noriembe nyaka chiengʼ.
english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

kikuyu: Eka nonyiso wuode maduongʼ miluongo ni Jetha niya, “Neg-gi!” To Jetha ne ok owuodho liganglane, nikech ne pod en rawera kendo noluor.
english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

kikuyu: Joote nowachone Ruoth niya, “Med yiewa!”
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

kikuyu: mondo jo-Israel okaw jo-Edom modongʼ kaka margi kod ogendini mamoko maluongo nyinga,” Jehova Nyasaye mabiro miyo gima kamano timore ema owacho.
english: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says the LORD who does this.

kikuyu: Neuru, nyisechegi duto gin gik manono! Timbegi duto onge tich, kendo kido ma gilamo chalo mana gi yamo kendo gin gik manono.”
english: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.

kikuyu: Eka Ehud nosudo ire kama nobetie kende e agola ma malo mar ode mar yweyo, mane ojabetie ndalo oro mi owacho niya, “Nyasaye oora iri.” Ka Ruoth noa malo e kome,
english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

kikuyu: Maupego kod bede yien-go duto gi rachungi taya nobed gimoro achiel mothedh gi dhahabu maler.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Abiro muko mieche matindo duto mi ilokri gunda. Eka iningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Midian nonywolo Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida kod Elda. Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Ketura.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

kikuyu: Koso kane uchiemo kendo umetho, donge nuchiemo kendo umetho mana ne un uwegi?
english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

kikuyu: “Winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ogendini, kendo landeuru e kuonde maboyo manie dho nembe: ‘Ngʼama nokeyo jo-Israel nochokgi, kendo enorit rombe kaka jakwath.’
english: “Hear the LORD’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: Tingʼ ludhi malo kendo irie badi ewi nam mondo ipog pige eka jo-Israel ongʼad nam kawuotho e lowo motwo.
english: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.

kikuyu: Kane gigowo e dho nam, negineno mach maliel ka ni kanyo ka oket rech e wiye, kod makati moko.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

kikuyu: “Koro winja, yaye Jakobo jatichna, in Israel maseyiero.
english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

kikuyu: Ka waketo ratege e dho farese mondo omi giwinjwa, to wanyalo chiko ringregi kamoro amora ma wadwaro.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

kikuyu: kendo Abimelek nopenjo Ibrahim niya, “Ere tiend rombe ma sibini abiriyo ma isewalogi?”
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

kikuyu: E kindeno, Juda noweyo owetene kendo nodhi odak gi ja-Adulam ma nyinge Hira.
english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

kikuyu: Mad Nyasaye Wuoro kod Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo omi jowete duto man kuom Kristo kwe, gihera kod yie.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Eka joma otony nopara, ka gin e pinje mibiro terogie twech, kaka gisechwanya gi chunjegi mandhaga mosebaro oweya kendo gi wengegi ma gisegombogo nyiseche mopa. Gibiro hum gi kitgi giwegi kuom gik maricho magisetimo kendo kuom timbegi mamono duto.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

kikuyu: Ooyo, ewi gigi duto wan joloch moloyo nikech Nyasaye mane oherowa.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

kikuyu: Kata ka ngʼato otingʼo gimoro molos gi yien e lwete, mi ogoyogo wadgi motho, en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Ngʼama timo richo ema biro tho. Wuowi ok bi kwan ni jaketho nikech ketho mar wuoro, kendo wuoro ok bi kwan ni jaketho nikech ketho mar wuode. Tim makare mar ngʼama kare ibiro ketne owuon kendo tim mamono mar ngʼama rach biro bedo mare owuon.
english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

kikuyu: Ma e chenro mar nying jo-Israel ma jotend anywola, jotend jolweny alufe kod jolweny miche to gi jotendgi; mane tiyone ruoth kaluwore kod tije duto mag migepe mag jolweny mane ni e tich dwe ka dwe kuom higa ngima. Migawo ka migawo notingʼo ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000).
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Mier mamoko ne gin: Libna, Ether, Ashan,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

kikuyu: to pesano notigo kuom chulo jotich mane loso kuonde mane omukore e hekalu.
english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.

kikuyu: Negichiwo mathoth moloyo kaka ne waparo! Mokwongo negichiwore ni Ruoth; eka bangʼe gichiwore ni wan bende, kaka Nyasaye dwaro.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

kikuyu: Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne janabi Jeremia niya:
english: Then the LORD’s word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: To onge ngʼato kuomgi mawachoe ni, ‘Nyasaye mane ochweya nikanye, Nyasaye mamiyo ji wende gotieno,
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

kikuyu: Kuom mano abiro miye pok e kind thuondi kendo enopog gik moyaki gi rateke, nikech ne ochiwo ngimane nyaka tho mine okwane kod joketho. Nimar notingʼo richo ji mangʼeny kendo nochungʼ kar joricho e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

kikuyu: Obiro keto kuomu tuoche duto mag Misri ma uluoro kendo ginibed kuomu.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

kikuyu: “Ne atieko jo-Amor mana ka gineno, kata obedo nine gin roboche ka yiend sida, kendo roteke ka yiend ober. Ne aketho olembene kod tiendene!
english: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okendo nyako kaachiel gi min-gi bende okendo, to ma en anjawo. Kargi ji adekgo nyaka wangʼ-gi kod mach, mondo tim marach kik dongʼ e dieru.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

kikuyu: Koro to ere bur sibuor kama ne gipidhoe nyithindgi, kama sibuor madichwo gi sibuor madhako nodhiye, ka nyithind sibuochego onge gi gima ginyalo luoro?
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

kikuyu: Koro or jomoko Jopa mondo odhi oom ngʼat moro ma nyinge Simon, miluongo ni Petro.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

kikuyu: Gima giwachonu kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yierono ema nyaka utim.
english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

kikuyu: Kuom kinde mangʼeny ne adhi e sinagogi ka sinagogi mondo akawgi akumgi, kendo natemo chunogi mondo giyany Nyasaye. Nikech chunya ne rach kodgi ni nyaka atiekgi, ne adhi nyaka e mier ma oko mondo asandgi.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

kikuyu: To ananyisgi e wangʼ-gi ni, ‘Akiau nyaka aa chakruok, ayeuru e nyima, un jorichogi!’
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

kikuyu: To ka wach marachno nochopo ne ruoth, noketo mondo ondik chike moko mamiyo chenro maricho mane Haman ochano ne jo-Yahudi odog ne en owuon, kendo ni oliergi e yath, en kaachiel gi yawuote.
english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

kikuyu: mondo atony e lwet joma richo ma lawa, mondo atony e lwet wasika ma dhano molwora.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

kikuyu: Eka ruoth Ahaz nodhi Damaski mondo orom gi Tiglath-Pilesa ruodh Asuria. Noneno kendo mar misango man Damaski mi ooro ni Uria jadolo goro kaka oger kendono, kondiko maler gik moko duto mogerego.
english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

kikuyu: Magi duto nobed mana chakruok mar muoch makecho.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: koa e tungʼ piny duto wawinjo wer mawer niya: “Duongʼ odongʼ ne Jal Makare.” To an ne awacho niya, “Aserumo chuth, aserumo chuth! Mano kaka aneno malit! Jandhoko ndhogo ji! Kuom timbe mag andhoga osendhogo ji!”
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

kikuyu: “Lowo mogoyo tongʼ gi Juda chakre wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ ema nobed migawo mowinjore ichiw kaka mich makende. Lachne nobed kilomita apar gariyo gi nus, to borne koa yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ, nobed maromre gi mano mipogone dhoot ka dhoot. E dier lowono tir e kama nogerie kama ler mar lemo.
english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

kikuyu: Wasiro wasikwa nikech in, waloyo joma kedo kodwa kuom nyingi.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

kikuyu: Warito Jehova Nyasaye gi geno; en e konyruokwa kendo okumbawa.
english: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni notamo Solomon e luwo nyiseche mamoko Solomon ne ok orito chik Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.

kikuyu: piny noyiengni matek apoya nono, mi mise mag od twech noyiengni. Gikanyono dhoudi duto mag od twech noyawore kendgi, mi nyoroche mane otwego jotwech nogonyore duto.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

kikuyu: Bende wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye tiyo maber ne jogo mohere, jogo moseluongi kaluwore gi dwarone.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

kikuyu: Yawuot Nowa adekgi ema oganda duto manie piny owuokie.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

kikuyu: Musa noorogi e lweny ji alufu achiel (1,000) e dhoot ka dhoot, ka gin gi Finehas wuod Eliazar, ma jadolo, mane otingʼo gik moa ei kama ler mar lemo kod turumbete michiwogo ranyisi.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

kikuyu: Waselokore gima kuodo wich ne jobutwa, joma ijaro kendo inyiero gi joma olworowa.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Ruoth Solomon noloso garino ne en owuon; nolose gi bepe moa Lebanon.
english: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Okinyi godhiambo gichiwone Jehova Nyasaye misengini miwangʼo pep kod gik mangʼwe ngʼar kendo giketo makati e mesa mopwodhi kendo gimoko teche moket e rachungi taya mar dhahabu godhiambo pile ka pile. Wan warito chike Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, un to useweye.
english: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God, but you have forsaken him.

kikuyu: Machalre kamano bende, ngʼato kuomu ma ok oweyo gige duto ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Bangʼ magi duto, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, bende pod inyalo mana jwangʼowa? Adier dilingʼ thi kikumowa mokadho apima?
english: Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?

kikuyu: mi anadogi maber e od wuora eka Jehova Nyasaye nobed Nyasacha,
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,

kikuyu: To ka iyalo ni Kristo osechier oa kuom joma otho, to angʼo momiyo jomoko kuomu wacho ni joma otho ok bi chier?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

kikuyu: Yaye, mad ne bed ni yorena ogurore e luwo chikeni!
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

kikuyu: Ne en ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higni apar gauchiel kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Jerusha nyar Zadok.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

kikuyu: Ngʼat makayo cham e kinde oro en wuowi mariek, to ngʼat ma nindo kinde keyo en wuowi makwodo wich.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kikuyu: Ji duto mochayo Sayun lo mi dog chien gi wichkuot.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne gike nikech ne onge jakwath, kendo kane gike kamano to negidoko chiemb ondiegi.
english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

kikuyu: Ne gisayowa ka giramo ni gin bende nyaka gichiw makorgi kuom konyo jo-Nyasaye.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

kikuyu: Abi-Albon ja-Arbath, gi Azmaveth ja-Barhum,
english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

kikuyu: Nikech in iber kendo iweyo richo, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye in gihera mangʼeny kuom joma luongi.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobirona kama:
english: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Kendo nowacho niya, “An-gi kwayo achiel, ni ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu omiya stadi kuom pok mag gik mane uyako.” Ne en kit jo-Ishmael mondo gilier stadi mar dhahabu e itgi.
english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

kikuyu: Ijaber e yore duto, jaherana; onge mbala moro amora e dendi.
english: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.

kikuyu: “Kata kapo ni aoro ligangla mondo oketh pinyno duto kendo anego jogi machwo kaachiel gi le ma gipidho,
english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

kikuyu: Jotich joka ruoth duto mane ni e rangach ne goyo chonggi piny ka gimiyo Haman duongʼ gi luor, nikech ruoth noseketo chik mondo otimne kamano. To Modekai to ne odagi goyone chonge piny kamiyego duongʼ.
english: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

kikuyu: Bi mondo inyodha gi dhogi, nikech herani kelo mor moloyo divai.
english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Farisai noneno mano, negiwachone niya, “Neye! Jopuonjreni timo gima chik ok oyie mondo gitim chiengʼ Sabato.”
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: E kindeno Hana nomako ich monywolo wuode. Nochake ni Samuel kowacho niya, “Nikech ne akwaye Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of the LORD.”

kikuyu: Nashon nonywolo Salmon, to Salmon nonywolo Boaz,
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo kamano, to joma ne dwaro chwade noa bute kendo jatend jolweny maduongʼ bende ne luoro omako, kane ofwenyo ni nosetweyo Paulo, to kara ne en ja-Rumi.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

kikuyu: Joma ne osiepeni duto wigi osewil kodi; kendo ok gidewi. Asegoyi mana ka jasigu kendo kumi mana ka ngʼama kwiny, nikech ketho mari duongʼ kendo richoni ngʼeny.
english: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

kikuyu: kendo giwacho niya, “In manyocha iwacho ni inyalo ketho hekalu mi ichak igere bangʼ ndalo adekni, koro resri kendi ane! Ka in wuod Nyasaye to wuog ane e msalaba ilor piny!”
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Ok iseketa e lwet jawasigu to iseguro tiendena kama lach.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

kikuyu: Ji ne madho divai gi kikombe mopogore opogore kendo divai ne ngʼeny mana ka mar ruoth adier nikech ne chunye ngʼwon.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

kikuyu: kendo Ruoth Solomon kod oganda jo-Israel duto mane ochokore molwore nochopo e nyim Sandug Muma; kendo negichiwo rombe kod dhok mangʼeny mane kwan-gi ok nyal ndiki kata kwan kaka misango.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

kikuyu: Onego gitingʼ nyinge malo e chokruok mar joge kendo gidende e buch jodongo.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

kikuyu: Bende ji loso nyisechegi giwegi? Ee, to ok gin nyiseche!”
english: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”

kikuyu: Ka orito chikena gi buchena ma ok obaro mana kaka iritogi sani, to anagur lochne nyaka chiengʼ.
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

kikuyu: Thoma nowachone niya, “Ruoth wakia kuma idhiye, koro ere kaka dwangʼe yo?”
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

kikuyu: Lopgi gi kar dakgi ne oriwo Bethel to gi mier matindo molwore kaachiel gi Naaran man yo wuok chiengʼ, Gezer kod mieche matindo yo podho chiengʼ kod Shekem to gi mieche matindo nyaka chop Aya to gi mieche.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye ok osedeko mar kelo masira kuomwa, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa nikare e gik moko duto motimo; kata obedo ni wasedagi winje kamano.
english: Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

kikuyu: Kik utim kaka watimo e ndaloni, ma ngʼato ka ngʼato timo mana gima oneno ni berne,
english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

kikuyu: Onego gi pak nyinge gi miel kendo giwerne mamit ka gigoyo oyieke gi nyatiti.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

kikuyu: kata ka omulo gimoro mamol manyalo miyo obed mogak, kata ngʼato angʼata mamiyo obedo mogak, bedni ogak manade.
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

kikuyu: Chiew, in chunya! Chiewuru un orutu gi nyatiti! Abiro chiewo kogwen.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: To ber maromo nade yudo rieko moloyo dhahabu, yiero ngʼeyo tiend wach moloyo fedha!
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

kikuyu: Zelofehad ma wuod Hefer, ma wuod Gilead, ma wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase, ne onge yawuowi makmana nyiri kende, ma nying-gi ne gin: Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka gi Tirza.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Joneno ariyogo e yiende ariyo mag zeituni, kod rachungi teyni ariyo mochungʼ e nyim kom Ruodh piny.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

kikuyu: Ngima ne ni kuome, kendo ngimano ne en ler ni ji.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

kikuyu: Omiyo jo-Israel duto nowinjo wach ni Saulo osemonjo kambi jo-Filistia kendo koro jo-Filistia oselo gi jo-Israel. Mine oluong ji mondo odhi ir Saulo Gilgal.
english: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

kikuyu: Negiwuotho ka gia Got Hor ka giluwo yo mochiko Nam Makwar, mondo giluor Edom. To ji chunygi nojok ka gin e yo;
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

kikuyu: Nimar ndalona rumo piyo ka iro; chokena rewni ka kit kendo maliet.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, nowachona: “Kaw e lweta kikombeni moole divai mopongʼ mar mirimba kendo iket ogendini duto ma aori kuomgi omadhe.
english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.

kikuyu: Onge tem museneno mopogore gi ma ji duto neno. Nyasaye rito singruokne, ok obi yie mondo otemu mohingo tekreu. To e sa ma itemoueno, obiro miyou yo munyalo tonygo mondo ubed gi teko mar timo sinani.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

kikuyu: Mana kaka nyingi, yaye Nyasaye, e kaka pakni bende chopo nyaka tungʼ piny; lweti ma korachwich opongʼ gi tim makare.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

kikuyu: “To sani koro Roho ochuna ni nyaka adhi Jerusalem, ka ok angʼeyo gima dhi timorena kuno.
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

kikuyu: Lweta owuon ema ne oketo mise mar piny kendo lweta ma korachwich ema ne oyaro polo, ka aluongogi to giwuok kadiemo wangʼ.
english: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.

kikuyu: Kaw law ngʼatno mochungʼne ngʼat mokia kaka singo; kawe ka okete singo kar dhako mabayo.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

kikuyu: Aora Kishon noywoyogi, aora ma hike ngʼeny, aora Kishon. Dhi nyime, chunya; bed motegno!
english: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

kikuyu: Sikuru kuheroru kaka owete.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

kikuyu: “Ute mag matafare osepodho, to wabiro gedo kendo kod kite mopa, bende kata obedo ni yiend ngʼowu osetongʼ to wabiro pidho yiend sida kargi.”
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

kikuyu: To noyudo japuonjre mane Yesu ohero, ne chiemo kobedo bute machiegni.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

kikuyu: To ka jo-Yahudi nodagi wachne mi ochako yanye, Paulo notengʼonigi lepe kosiemogi niya, “Rembu mondo odongʼ ewiu uwegi! An asetimo tichna kaka dwarore. Chakre kawuono abiro dhi lando Injili ne joma ok jo-Yahudi.”
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

kikuyu: Nowachone chiege niya, “Wabiro tho nikech waseneno Nyasaye gi wangʼwa!”
english: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”

kikuyu: Emomiyo akwayou, an ngʼat motwe nikech tich Ruoth, mondo udag dak mowinjore gi luong ma Nyasaye noluongoue.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

kikuyu: Lod gi Ono, kod e Holo mar Jopecho.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

kikuyu: Nyaka uket pogruok e kind gik mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye kod gik ma ok mowal, bende gik ma ok ler gi gik maler,
english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

kikuyu: Jal manobedo e kom duongʼ mar loch nowacho niya, “Neuru! Aloso gik moko duto bedo manyien!” Eka nowachona kendo niya, “Ndik ma, nikech wechegi gin migeno kendo gin adiera.”
english: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

kikuyu: “Kane Jakobo odonjo e piny Misri, ne giywakne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okonygi, kendo Jehova Nyasaye ne ooro Musa gi Harun, mane ogolo kwereu owuok oa Misri mi oketogi kama gidakieni.
english: “When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.

kikuyu: Gikanyono Roho Maler nokawo Yesu motere e thim,
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

kikuyu: Jotham ne ja-higni piero ariyo gabich kane odoko ruoth kendo norito piny kuom higni apar gauchiel kodak Jerusalem. Min mare ne nyinge Jerusha nyar Zadok.
english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

kikuyu: Bolreuru e nyim Wuowi, nono to dipo kokecho kodu mi dongʼad ndalou, motieku, nimar iye nyalo wangʼ kodu kadiemo wangʼ. Ji duto mogeno kuome gin joma ogwedhi.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Ka pi mane ni e puga norumo, noketo nyathi e tiend bungu.
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

kikuyu: “Nyaka karangʼo ma oganda ma timbegi richogi biro ngʼur koda? Asewinjo ngʼur mar jo-Israel ma jo-mibadhigi.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

kikuyu: Ruodhwa duongʼ kendo en gi teko kendo nyalo; ngʼeyone onge gikone.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

kikuyu: Koro jo-Israel ne ool ahinya odiechiengno, nikech Saulo ne oketogi ma gikwongʼore ka owacho niya, “Okwongʼ ngʼato angʼata machiemo ka piny pok oyuso, kapok achulo kuor ni wasika!” Omiyo onge ngʼama nobilo chiemo.
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

kikuyu: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata monego wadgi, en bende nyaka nege.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Kane Joshua owinjo koko mane ji goyo nowacho ne Musa niya, “Mahu mar lweny wuok e kambi.”
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

kikuyu: Wachomuru wangʼwa kuom Yesu, ma en jachak kendo jachop yie marwa. Nikech nogeno yudo mor mane oikne ni nonwangʼ achien, nochayo tho malit mar msalaba ka ok odewo wichkuot ma tho ma kamano kelo, kendo koro obet piny e bat korachwich mar kom duongʼ mar Nyasaye.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

kikuyu: Kik wawe mak wachokore kaachiel, kaka jomoko oseweyo timo, to wajiwreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato, kendo umed timo kamano to moloyo ka uneno ka Chiengʼ Ruoth medo sudo machiegni.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼato moro manie chokruokno omi wach moro mopondo mondo owachi, ngʼat mane oyudo dhi nyime gi wuoyo nyaka lingʼ mondi, eka owuo.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno lweny ne ger ahinya, kendo joma ne nigi Daudi noloyo Abner gi jo-Israel.
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

kikuyu: Negijwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi, mane ogologi e piny Misri. Negilamo nyiseche mopogore opogore mag ogendini mane odak e pinyno. Negimiyo Jehova Nyasaye mirima,
english: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.

kikuyu: kod Asaf jatich kaachiel gi Heman mane otiyo kochungʼ e bade korachwich. Asaf wuod Berekia, wuod Shimea,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

kikuyu: Pasia ma borgi romo fut piero ariyo gadek ne nitie e bath rangach konchiel ka pasiago ongʼaw ewi sirni adek man-gi rachungi adek,
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi ne gin: nyikwa Jeshua kod Kadmiel (mowuok e dhood Hodavia), ji piero abiriyo gangʼwen (74).
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

kikuyu: to nyisgiuru ni, ‘En misango mar Pasaka mitimo ni Jehova Nyasaye, nikech nokadho ut jo-Israel e piny Misri konego jo-Misri to oweyo miechwa.’ ” Eka ji nopodho auma molamo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of the LORD’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.

kikuyu: mana ka urito chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kendo urito buchene duto ma amiyou kawuono.
english: if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

kikuyu: To Abimelek nowacho niya, “Ok angʼeyo ngʼama osetimo mae. Ne ok inyisa, ma kawuono ema akwongo winje.”
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

kikuyu: Ere gima omiyo wiyi wil kodwa kinde duto? Ere gima omiyo ijwangʼowa kuom kinde malach kamano?
english: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

kikuyu: Kata mana malaike mane ok obedo kuondegi mag loch mane omigi, mago mane owuok oweyo keregi mane oketgie, gin bende osekanogi e mudho mandiwa, kotwegi gi nyoroche ma ok chodi nyaka chiengʼ, ka girito kum e odiechiengʼ maduongʼ.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

kikuyu: Winjuru weche jotendu kendo beduru e bwo lochgi. Girito chunyu odiechiengʼ gotieno kaka joma nyaka nyis Nyasaye kaka uchal. Winjgiuru, eka tich ma gitiyo okelnigi mor to ok pek, nikech ka umiyo tich obedonegi mapek to un ema uhinyoru.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

kikuyu: Eka Nyasaye nogwedho Nowa gi yawuote kowachonegi niya, “Nywolreuru kendo umedru mi upongʼ piny.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

kikuyu: Nimar Jehova Nyasaye e jangʼadnwa bura, Jehova Nyasaye e jaketonwa chik, kendo Jehova Nyasaye e ruodhwa; en ema obiro resowa.
english: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.

kikuyu: Eka negioro joote ne jo-Kiriath Jearim, kagiwacho niya, “Jo-Filistia osedwogo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye. Biuru mondo ukawe udhi kode.”
english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back the LORD’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”

kikuyu: To ka koro osegonyu kuom richo mi ubedo wasumbini mag Nyasaye, ohala muyudo kelo ngima maler ma gikone en ngima mochwere.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

kikuyu: “Kuom ndalo abiriyo nyaka chiw nywok pile ka pile kaka misango mar golo richo; bende nyaka ichiw nyarwath ma pod tin kod im mogol e kweth giduto kargi ariyogo nyaka bed maonge songa.
english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Benjamin; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero angʼwen gabich mia auchiel (45,600).
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Ber mondo one chandruok ma en owuon ema okelo; kendo mondo orom gi Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ber bedo gi matin ka iluoro Jehova Nyasaye moloyo mwandu mangʼeny kod koko.
english: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

kikuyu: Misengini kod chiwo ok ema ne idwaro to ita ema iseyawo; misengini miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mag golo richo ne ok idwaro.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

kikuyu: Kerubigo noyaro bwombegi kendo negichako huyo ka gidhi malo ka anenogi, kendo kane gidhi, tiendego bende ne dhi kodgi. Negidhi mi gichungʼ e dhorangach mar od Jehova Nyasaye man yo wuok chiengʼ, kendo duongʼ mar Nyasaye mar Israel ne ni e wigi malo.
english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato moyie ni Yesu e Kristo en nyathi Nyasaye, kendo ngʼama ohero Wuoro ohero nyathine bende.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

kikuyu: Nimar ok lichne kata ka otho moweyo joge ka giko ndalo mar ngimane ochopo.
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

kikuyu: Ka wasikwa nowinjo ni wasefwenyo chenro margi kendo ni Nyasaye ne oseketho parogi, ne wadok wate e gero ohinga, ngʼato ka ngʼato e tichne.
english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

kikuyu: Eka negidwogo chien kendo gidhi nyaka En Mishpat (ma tiende ni Kadesh), kendo negikawo piny jo-Amalek duto gi piny jo-Amor manodak Hazazon Tamar.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

kikuyu: Wasetimo richo kendo ngʼanyo, to ok iseweyonwa.
english: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

kikuyu: Inyalo kawo ohala kuom japiny moro to ok owadu ma ja-Israel mondo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ogwedhu e gimoro amora ma uketoe lwetu mar timo e piny mudhikawo mondo obed maru.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone Haman niya, “We golo pesani, to timne jogo gima in ema ihero.”
english: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye en sin gi richo; amon gi sunga kod ngʼayi, timbe maricho kod wuoyo mochido.
english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka puoyo chak kelo mo, kendo goyo um chwero remo, e kaka jiwo kecho kelo lweny.”
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

kikuyu: To bende awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moter nyangu nigi gowi mar chopo Chike Musa mamoko duto.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

kikuyu: Jatend jolweny nokawo wuowino komako bade, mi notere tenge eka openje niya, “En angʼo midwaro nyisa?”
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

kikuyu: Kar romb ji mane onegi ei ohinga mar Susa noter ne ruoth e odiechiengʼno.
english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano ne adwaro ngʼeyo tiend ngech ondiek mar angʼwen, ondiegno nopogore gi ondiegi mamoko kendo nomiyo ji luoro ahinya; ne en gi leke mag chuma kod kogno mag mula kendo nosiko kochiemo achiema kendo onyono gi tiende gimoro amora mane odongʼ piny.
english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

kikuyu: Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye osekecho gi joge; kendo oserieyo bade kuomgi monegogi. Gode yiengni kendo ringre joma otho odhurore e wangʼ yore ka yugi. To kata bed ni magi duto osetimore, to mirimbe pod ok okwe, nimar pod okecho kodgi.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Omiyo abiro sudo machiegni kodu mondo angʼadnu bura, anabi mapiyo mondo abed janeno ka kwedo ajuoke, jochode kod jogo makwongʼore kariambo, joma mayo jotijegi e yor chudo, jogo matimo marach ne mon ma chwogi otho kod nyithind kiye, kod jogo matamo jodak e adiera margi, nikech ok giluora.”
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Koro un joma odak Jerusalem to gi jogo modak Juda; ngʼadieuru bura e kinda kod puotha mar mzabibu.
english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Jerusalem, kanisa kaachiel gi joote kod jodongo norwakogi, kendo neginyisogi gik moko duto ma Nyasaye nosetimo, kotiyo kodgi.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

kikuyu: Magi e yawuowi mane Bilha, jatich mane Laban omiyo Rael nyare onywolone Jakobo. Giduto ne gin ji abiriyo.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata modagi winjo wachni kendo ok oluoro wecheni bende ok odewo chike mimiyogi, ibiro negi. Bed mana motegno kendo jachir!”
english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

kikuyu: Gode biro kelo mwandu ne ji, kendo thuche biro kelo olemb tim makare.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

kikuyu: “Biuru ira un joma oa e tungʼ piny gi tungʼ piny nimar unuyud resruok; nimar an Nyasaye, kendo onge moro amora.
english: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

kikuyu: Koro, yaye mon, winjuru wach Jehova Nyasaye; yawuru itu ne weche mawuok e dhoge. Puonjuru nyiu dengo; puonjreuru ywak uwegi.
english: Yet hear the LORD’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.

kikuyu: Daudi nokedo kodgi chakre yuso piny nyaka kinyne godhiambo. Kendo ne onge ngʼat mane otony modhi makmana yawuowi mia angʼwen mane oidho ngamia kende ema noringo otony.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼogi ma chunygi ool; gimiyo jo-Misri tangni e gik moko duto ma otimo, machal mana ka jakongʼo madwanyore kama ongʼokie.
english: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

kikuyu: mawacho niya, “Wabiro wuoyo kaka wahero; kendo onge ngʼama biro tamowa. Koso en ngʼa ma ruodhwa manyalo tamowa timo kamano?”
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

kikuyu: Ne ooro Eliakim ma jatend od ruoth, gi Shebna jagoro kod jodolo madongo ir janabi Isaya wuod Amoz ka giduto girwako piende gugru.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

kikuyu: Ka janabi moro kata ngʼat mokoro gik mabiro timore e lek otuch e dieru kendo ohulo wach moro mar hono kod ranyisi,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

kikuyu: to iketogi kare nono kuom ngʼwonone, nikech warruok ma nobiro kuom Kristo Yesu.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Dir yadhno ochwakogo chiemo, bathe mamoko omokogo mach mondo oo, eka dir yadhno konchiel otedogo makati. To bende bath yien achielno opayogo nyasaye molamo, kokulorene piny.
english: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.

kikuyu: To chiengʼ mane Yesu olose chwodho kendo ochango wangʼ muofuno ne en chiengʼ Sabato.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

kikuyu: Bangʼ higa achiel, un ma uparo nudak mokwe, kibaji nogou; cham ok nochiegi, kendo keyo mar mzabibu ok nobedie.
english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.

kikuyu: Joma ne kadho kanyo nojare ka giyanye ka gikino wiyegi kendo giwacho niya, “Oo! In manyocha iwacho ni inyalo ketho hekalu mi ichak igere bangʼ ndalo adekni,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

kikuyu: “E otienono abiro wuotho e piny Misri duto kendo naneg nyathi ka nyathi madichwo makayo mar dhano kod chiayo, bende nakum nyiseche duto mag jo-Misri, an Jehova Nyasaye ema awacho kamano.
english: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Omiyo in dhi e od Jehova Nyasaye chiengʼ lamo gi tweyo chiemo kendo isomne ji koa e kitabuni weche Jehova Nyasaye mane indiko sa mane awachoni to indiko. Somnegi ne jo-Juda duto ma biro koa e miechgi.
english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, the LORD’s words, in the ears of the people in the LORD’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

kikuyu: Nikech riwruok mar joma ok lem ok nyal nyago gimoro kendo mach biro wangʼo hembe mag joma ohero asoya mitiek pep.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

kikuyu: Magi e jo-Israel, mane okwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi. Jogo duto mane nitie kar dak, kaluwore gi migepe mag-gi noromo ji alufu mia auchiel gadek, mia abich gi piero abich (603,550).
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Asayou ni kik umi abi iru ka ager, kaka ajatimo ni jomoko maparo ni wadak e pinyni kaluwore gi dwaro piny.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni aluonge mi obiro ira, to ok ayie ni onyalo winjo wachna.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

kikuyu: “Wachne Hezekia ruodh Juda kama: Kik iyie nyasaye migeno kuomeno wuondi kowacho ni, ‘Jerusalem ok nochiw e lwet ruodh Asuria.’
english: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: wechegi ongʼere chon, ema owacho.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny wacho ni gin gihera ma adiera; to ngʼat ma ja-adiera, en ngʼa ma diyude?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

kikuyu: Ka Jeremia notieko nyiso ji weche duto mag Jehova Nyasaye Nyasachgi, ma gin gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ne oore mondo onyisgi,
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of the LORD their God, with which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

kikuyu: Eka chik ma ruoth ogolono nolandre pinye duto, kendo mon duto biro luoro chwogi, maonge modongʼ.”
english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

kikuyu: Ka puothe mangʼeny osengʼiew e pinyni ma uwacho ni, ‘En kama ninono, maonge ji kata le, nimar osechiwe ne jo-Babulon.’
english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’

kikuyu: To Yesu nowachonegi gisano niya, “Beduru gi chir! En mana An. Kik uluor.”
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: ne giwuotho e kind ogendini mopogore, ka gidhi e pinyruodhi mopogore opogore.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Gipiago lewgi mabith ka lew thuol kendo kwiri mar thuond fu ni e lewgi. Sela
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Ma e pok mar dhood Manase, kaka wuod Josef makayo, tiende ni, mar Makir, wuod Manase makayo. Makir ne kwar jo-Gilead, ma norwako Gilead gi Bashan nikech jo-Makir ne gin jolweny mongʼere.
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

kikuyu: Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye! Ogwedh ngʼama oluoro Jehova Nyasaye, kendo marito chikene gi mor.
english: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

kikuyu: Wach nobiro ne Jeremia koa ir Jehova Nyasaye kane Ruoth Zedekia noorone Pashur wuod Malkija kod jadolo Zefania wuod Maseya. Negiwacho:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoke niya, “Isedwoko kare, tim kamano, eka inibed mangima.”
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

kikuyu: Ji madirom alufu piero angʼwen mane moikore ni lweny mondo gikedi, nongʼado loka kocha e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka e pewe mag Jeriko.
english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before the LORD to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

kikuyu: Nona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo ingʼe chunya; tema, mondo ingʼe pacha.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

kikuyu: Okapu achiel ne nigi ngʼope mabeyo ahinya, kod mago mane osechiek chon; okapu machielo ne nigi ngʼope maricho, marach moloyo ma ok nyal cham.
english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

kikuyu: Hezekia nodwoke niya, “Wach Jehova Nyasaye misewacho ber.” Nodwoke kamano koparo niya, “Abiro bedo gi kwe kod rit makare e ndalo mar ngimana.”
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”

kikuyu: Omiyo puonjwa kwano ndalowa kare, mondo wabed gi chuny mariek.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

kikuyu: “Ka uneno Jerusalem olwor kod ogend lweny, ubiro ngʼeyo ni kindene mar kethruok chiegni.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

kikuyu: Ka mise iketho, to en angʼo ma joma kare ditim?”
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

kikuyu: Kar timo kamano to ngʼatni nochako lando wachno e sa nogo mane oa ir Yesu. Kuom mano Yesu koro ne ok nyal donjo ayanga e dala moro amora, to nodak mana oko kuonde ma ji ongee. To kata kamano ji ne pod biro ire koa kuonde duto.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

kikuyu: Ne gibawo wiye kod bethene duto kod tungene gi dhahabu maler bende nolosne ndiri mar dhahabu molwore.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Bende enokel misango mar lalruok mar goyo erokamano kaachiel gi makati moted gi thowi.
english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

kikuyu: Ka Higa mar Piero Abich mar jo-Israel ochopo (tiende ni Jubli), to nokaw girkeni mag-gi kigolo kuom gikeni mar dhoodgi kimedo e dhood joma onywomogi.”
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

kikuyu: Wangʼ chiengʼ ok nochak opodhi bende dwe ok nochak olal kendo; Jehova Nyasaye ema nobed lerni manyaka chiengʼ kendo ndalogi mag kuyo norum.
english: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni hekaluni koro nigi duongʼ, ji duto mabiro kadho bute nowuor kendo nohum ka gipenjo ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo Jehova Nyasaye osetimo gima chalo kama ni pinyni kod hekaluni?’
english: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

kikuyu: Jeftha nowachonegi niya, “Donge ne ok udwara mi uriembo e od wuora? En angʼo momiyo koro ubiro ira, ka un e thagruok?”
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”

kikuyu: Giduto giliet ka kendo, gikidho jotendgi. Ruodhigi bende gitieko, to onge ngʼato kuomgi maluonga.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

kikuyu: Ka ler mar odiechiengʼ rumo aruma nii, to janek aa malo kendo onego jochan gi jodhier; otimo kamano gotieno kolidho ka jakuo.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

kikuyu: To jodolo madongo nojiwo oganda mondo oyie gi dwarogi ni Pilato ogony mana Barabas.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

kikuyu: joka Efraim, ma gin jolweny mathuondi kendo mane rahuma e dhoodgi ne gin ji alufu piero ariyo gi mia aboro (20,800),
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Odheru mare mar piedho cham ni e lwete, kendo obiro yweyo maler kare mar dino cham, kochoko ngano mage okano e dero, to mihudhi to owangʼo gi mach ma ok nyal negi.”
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Eka Ibrahim nosudo machiegni kode kendo openjo niya, “Bende ditiek joma kare machal gi joma timbegi richo?
english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

kikuyu: “Kamoro dipo ka achiel kuom malaike gana gi gana mag Nyasaye ma paro ni ngʼato tich monego oti nyalo konye,
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

kikuyu: Bangʼe nodhi mondo omany Ahazia kendo joge nonwangʼe kopondo Samaria. Nokele ne Jehu mine onege. Ne giike kagiwacho niya, “Ne en wuod Jehoshafat manoluwo Jehova Nyasaye gi chunye duto.” Omiyo ne onge ngʼato moro amora motegno e od Ahazia mane nyalo rito piny.
english: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

kikuyu: yawuot Jehiel ne gin Zetham gi owadgi ma Joel. Gin ema ne gichungʼne keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: kata ngʼat manyalo golo kum mare kuoma, mondo omi masichene kik bwoga,
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

kikuyu: Eka nosiemone jopuonjrene kowacho niya, “Jogi e minwa gi owetena.
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Yaye Nyasacha, para kuom ma kendo kik wiyi wil gi gik masetimone odi gadiera gi tijeni duto.
english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

kikuyu: Anakum joma odak Misri gi ligangla, kech kod masira, mana kaka nakumo Jerusalem.
english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

kikuyu: Kane Judas osedhi, Yesu nowacho niya, “Wuod Dhano koro imiyo duongʼ sani kendo Nyasaye bende yudo duongʼ kuome.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

kikuyu: Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo kotiyo koda, wechene ne ni e dhoga.
english: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi joge nomedo wuotho kadhi nyime ka giluwo yo, ka Shimei bende ne wuotho e dir got mochimore kode ka odhi nyime gi kwongʼe to obaye gi kite kokiro gik mochido kuome.
english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

kikuyu: Abram nopodho auma e nyim Nyasaye kendo Nyasaye nowachone niya,
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

kikuyu: Chunye nokete kuom Dina nyar Jakobo omiyo nohere kendo nowuoyo kode gi ngʼwono mathoth.
english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

kikuyu: Yesu notimo ranyisi gi honni mamoko mangʼeny, ka jopuonjrene neno, ma ok ondiki e kitabuni.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

kikuyu: Abimelek nodongʼ Aruma, kendo Zebul noriembo Gaal kod owetene oko mar Shekem.
english: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

kikuyu: Omiyo Solomon nogolo Abiathar e tich dolo mar Jehova Nyasaye kochopogo wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho Shilo kuom od Eli.
english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD, that he might fulfill the LORD’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gaboro mar lochne, ruoth Josia nooro jagoro ma en Shafan wuod Azalia, ma wuod Meshulam, e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kowacho niya,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the LORD’s house, saying,

kikuyu: Ka piny koro noyuso, Yesu gi jopuonjre nowuok e dala maduongʼno mi gidhi e gwenge.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

kikuyu: to koro ere kaka dhano ma kudni akudani dichal e nyime?”
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

kikuyu: Ruoth nochwogo wend ywak ne Abner kama: “Yaye bende ne onego Abner tho mana kaka ngʼama ofuwo tho?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

kikuyu: Shobal nonywolo: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo kod Onam.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

kikuyu: Ngʼat machano gik maricho kuom Jehova Nyasaye wuok mana kuomi, yaye Nineve, en e ngʼat mamiyo ji donjo e ketho.
english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.

kikuyu: “Mano emomiyo pinyruodh polo chal gi ruoth mane dwaro nono kaka jotichne osetiyo gi pesane.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

kikuyu: Lweny nolandore mokwako piny, kendo joma notho chiengʼno e bungu ne ngʼeny moloyo joma noneg gi ligangla.
english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

kikuyu: Eka Israel nosingore ne Jehova Nyasaye kama: “Ka ichiwonwa jogi e lwetwa, to wabiro tieko miechgi madongo duto.”
english: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

kikuyu: Omiyo kut matut papni ka pi machwakore e dak kendo ouko nam ka mo machiek ei agulu.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

kikuyu: To en ngʼa manyalo siro chiengʼ biro mare? Koso en ngʼa manyalo chungʼ e nyime ka othinyore? Nimar enobed kaka mach mar jatheth kata sabund jaluoko malwoko maler.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

kikuyu: Koro, Nyasachwa, wadwokoni erokamano, kendo wapako nyingi maduongʼ.
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

kikuyu: Gweth mar Jehova Nyasaye kelo mwandu, kendo ok omed chandruok kuome.
english: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

kikuyu: Ma e Harun nogo kod Musa mane Jehova Nyasaye owachonegi niya, “Gol jo-Israel oa e piny Misri kaluwore gi dhoutgi”
english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

kikuyu: Eka Balaam noa malo mi odok dala kendo Balak bende nodhi e yore owuon.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

kikuyu: Mana kaka nyithind winy moketh odgi mafuyo koni gi koni, e kaka mond jo-Moab nodongʼ e kar otuodo manie Aora Arnon.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

kikuyu: Lingʼane, awinjo dwond jaherana kabiro! Kochikore ewi gode kobiro, kendo obiro kolengʼore ewi gode matindo.
english: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

kikuyu: mi nongʼad wi Johana ka en e od twech.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

kikuyu: En ngʼa, ma ok nyal luori aa Ruoth, ma ok nyal miyo nyingi duongʼ? Nikech in kendi ema iler, ogendini duto nobi e nyimi mondo olami, nimar timbeni makare osefwenyore ratiro.”
english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

kikuyu: kendo higni abiriyo mag kech nochakore, mana kaka Josef nosewacho. Ne nitie kech e pinje mamoko, to piny Misri duto ne nitie chiemo.
english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat mane nigi jachien-no nopor kuomgi mohewogi duto. Nogoyogi marach mi giringo gia e odno ka gin duge kendo dendgi chwer remo.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka chunywa ne chandore kaonge kwe ne waparo ni ber mondo wadongʼ kendwa Athene.
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

kikuyu: Jaherana chalona maua maber mothiewo, moa e puoth mzabibu man En Gedi.
english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

kikuyu: Nikodemo nobiro ir Yesu gotieno mowachone niya, “Rabi, wangʼeyo ni in japuonj moa ka Nyasaye, nimar onge ngʼama nyalo timo ranyisi mag honni mitimogi ka Nyasaye ok ni kode.”
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

kikuyu: To dhakono nobiro mogoyo chonge piny e nyime, kawacho niya, “Ruoth, yie ikonya.”
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech ji wachonu niya, “Unego ji kendo umayo ogandau nyithindgi,”
english: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

kikuyu: E sa nogono Yesu nochango ji mangʼeny mane nigi tuoche, midekre kod chunje maricho, kendo nomiyo muofni mangʼeny oneno.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

kikuyu: “Atunge mag jolweny osetur, to jogo mayom yom osemi teko.
english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

kikuyu: Mach manie kendo mar misango to nyaka sik kaliel. Jadolo nyaka med yien e kendono okinyi kokinyi kendo ochanie misango miwangʼo pep eka owangʼe boche mag misengini mag lalruok.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Isekete jatelo ewi tich lweti duto; iseketo gik moko duto e bwo tiende:
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

kikuyu: Kinyne nyako maduongʼ ne owacho ne nyako matin niya, “Otieno mokadho ne ariwora gi wuonwa. Omiyo we wamiye kongʼo kendo kawuono mi omer mondo idhi iriwri kode kendo wanywol nyithindo mondo kik ogandawa lal.”
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Gibiro chielo yawuowi matindo gi asere; ok giningʼwon-ne nyithindo madhoth, bende ok ginikech nyithindo matindo.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

kikuyu: “Giniwach niya, ‘Olembe ma yande igombo oserumoni. Mwandugi duto kod gik mabeyo malombo wangʼ oselal chutho, ok nibed kodgi kendo ngangʼ.’
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nongʼiyo gik moko duto mane osechweyo kendo noneno ni gibeyo ahinya. Piny noyuso kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar auchiel.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

kikuyu: Eka yawuowi nobiro moboyo ringre gi law, mine gikawe kendo tere oko mi giike.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

kikuyu: E ndalogo ji nodwar tho, to ok giniyude; ginigomb mondo githo to tho noring-gi aringa.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

kikuyu: omiyo Daudi nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “bende anyalo dhi mondo amonj jo-Filistia? Bende iniketgi e lweta?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo, nikech abiro chiwo jo-Filistia e lweti.”
english: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

kikuyu: “To kane uneno ka Nahash ruodh jo-Amon dwaro monjou, ne uwachona ni, ‘Nyaka wabed gi ruoth ma ritowa,’ kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ne en ruodhu.
english: “When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when the LORD your God was your king.

kikuyu: Mano kaka nodok malit ne mon ma yach kod mago madhodho nyithindo e ndalogo! Chandruok malit maduongʼ biro bedo e piny gi mirima kuom jogi.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

kikuyu: Jogo ma jo-Israel hie nopogore moa kuom jopinje mamoko. Negichungʼ ma gihulo richogi kod timbe mag anjawo mag kweregi.
english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

kikuyu: wuod Aminadab, wuod Arni, wuod Hezron, wuod Perez, wuod Juda,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel oduogi mondo gibuor machiegni gi Pi Hahiroth mantie e kind Migdol gi nam. Gibiro bworo machiegni gi nam, mochomore gi Baal Zefon.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

kikuyu: To Yesu nodwokogi kowacho niya, “Un uwegi migiuru gimoro gicham.” Gin to negidwoke ka gipenje niya, “Ere kaka dwadhi mwangʼiew makati ma nengone oromo chudo mar ngʼato mar dweche aboro mondo wapidhgo oganda machal kama?”
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

kikuyu: Abiro tieko jo-Asuria manie pinya, kendo ananyone piny ewi godena. Jok mage nogol kuom joga kendo tingʼne mapek nogol e gok-gi.”
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

kikuyu: wengena ok nen maber nikech kuyo ma an-go. Aluongi odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; achikoni lwetena.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

kikuyu: koa kuom jo-Dan: Azarel wuod Jeroham notelonegi. Magi ema ne jotelo mane otelo ne dhout Israel.
english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Jotend Juda chalo gi joma ochoro kite man e kiewo. Abiro olo mirimba kuomgi mana ka pi oula.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

kikuyu: Kata dabed ni ngʼato dwaro mino kode wach, to bende dhano diduok penjo achiel kuom penjoge alufu achiel.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mawinjo weche mirieyego wuotho e yo madhiyo e ngima, to ngʼat motamore kethone tero ji mamoko e yor lal.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

kikuyu: Jopinyno nodhi e hekalu mar Baal kendo negimuke piny. Negitoyo matindo tindo kendo mar misango kod nyiseche manono mi ginego Matan jadolo mar Baal e nyim kende mag misango. Bangʼ mano Jehoyada jadolo noketo joma rito hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: to Farao gi jolwenje to nomiyo Nam Makwar oywero; Herane osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ka itieko somo kitabuni, twe kidi kuome kendo idire Yufrate.
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

kikuyu: To ka misango miwangʼo pep michiwone Jehova Nyasaye gin mana winy, to koro nyaka okel mana akuch odugla kata nyathi akuru.
english: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

kikuyu: Ka oyiere ni wuode, to nyaka omiye duongʼ kaka nyare.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

kikuyu: Chal kamano kuomu un bende. Ka ok ukonyoru gi weche maliw ma ji duto winjo, to ngʼama biro ngʼeyo tiend gima uwacho? Wecheu biro lal nono mana ka yamo!
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

kikuyu: Ok abi yiene ngʼama ohero miriambo mondo odag e oda; ngʼat moro amora mawacho miriambo ok nochungʼ e nyima.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

kikuyu: “Ji ne chikona itgi ka geno konyruok mathoth, negirito rieko mawuok e dhoga ka gilingʼ mos.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

kikuyu: Jowetena, koro wanyalo wacho angʼo? Ka un e chokruok mar lemo, to yudore ni ngʼat moro nigi wer, to ngʼat machielo nigi puonj, to moro nigi fweny, to machielo dwaro wuoyo gi dhok mayoreyore kata loko tiend wach miwachono. To gigi duto nyaka tim e yo mochanore magero kanisa.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Oganda noked gi oganda machielo, kendo pinyruoth noked gi pinyruoth machielo.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Od Jakobo nobed mach kendo od Josef mach nokaknie, od Esau nobed chuk mach, mi ginimoke moliel pep, onge ngʼat ma notony koa e od Esau.” Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Yawuot Zeruya adek ne gin Joab, Abishai gi Asahel. Koro Asahel ne tiende yot e ngʼwech mana ka mwanda.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka rachung taya nolosi: Nolose gi dhahabu mothedhi chakre e bwoye nyaka wiye malo. Rachung taya nolosi mana kaka ranyisi mane Jehova Nyasaye osenyiso Musa.
english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.

kikuyu: Yawuot Jakobo nodwoko Shekem gi Hamor wuon mare ka giwuondore nikech Shekem nosedwanyo Dina nyamin-gi.
english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

kikuyu: Ngano nyaka regi mondo olos makati; omiyo ok dine amingʼa. Kata obedo ni oywayo gache mar dino kuome, to faresene ok rege.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

kikuyu: “Kawe kendo irite; kik ihinye to timne gimoro amora mokwayo.”
english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

kikuyu: To gi koko maduongʼ negiramo ka gidwaro ni nyaka gure, to koko margi nobedo mapek.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

kikuyu: Magi e joka Esau (ma tiende ni Edom).
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

kikuyu: kendo kik imi jachien thuolo mar loyi.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Isakar, nomigi, Kishion, Daberath,
english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
