kikuyu: Bende doti gi tekone maduongʼ mondo okweda? Ooyo, ok dochun weche kuoma ni an jaketho.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

kikuyu: ka jo-Israel duto obiro mochungʼ e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kama obiro yiero, nyaka usomnegi chikegi.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

kikuyu: Eka ji duto modak e piny none ni un joma oluong gi nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo gibiro luorou.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, wuod dhano, wachne jothuru ni, ‘Tim makare mar ngʼat makare ok bi rese ka odagi winjo wach, kendo ketho mar ngʼat ma timbene richo ok bi miyo opodhi ka olokore oweyogi. Ka ngʼat makare otimo richo to timbene makare mosetimogo ok nyal miyo obed mangima.’
english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

kikuyu: Kor ka wach punde mane olal ndalo adek mokadho to owe chandi nimar oseyudgi. Koso en ngʼa ma chuny jo-Israel duto dwaro ka ok en in gi od wuonu?”
english: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”

kikuyu: Isaya nodwoke niya, “Ranyisi ma Jehova Nyasaye biro timoni kuom chopo singruokne ema: Diher mondo tipo odhi nyime ondamo apar kata odog chien ondamo apar?”
english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

kikuyu: Gisenyiso kanisa hera ma in-go. Konygi e wuodhgi ka ikowogi e yo mowinjore ni Nyasaye.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

kikuyu: “Dhiuru e dala man nyimu cha, to ka udonjo e iye, to ubiro nwangʼo nyathi kanyna mapok ngʼato oidho nyaka nene kotwe kanyo. Gonyeuru kendo ukele ka.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

kikuyu: Negibiro e chirni magi duto, ka giwilo kodi nengni mabeyo beyo maralik mogorie kido mabeyo, kaachiel gi mukeka mar dier ot mogorie kido malombo wangʼ kod tonde mokadi motegno.
english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

kikuyu: Dendi odongo mana ka othith, to thundi to chalo mana ka olemo, mogudore kanyachiel.
english: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.

kikuyu: Lekeni tar mana ka kweth mag rombe makoro eka oliel yiegi kendo mowuok kar luok. Moro ka moro wuotho gi nyithinde ma rude, kendo onge moro man kende.
english: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Balaam otienono mowachone niya, “Nikech jogi obiro luongi, yie idhi kodgi, to kata kamano itim mana gima anyisi.”
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

kikuyu: ngʼanyo kendo ketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, loko ngʼewa ne Nyasachwa, chano timo tulo kendo paro weche mag miriambo ka chunywa opongʼ kod wuond.
english: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

kikuyu: Gima koro adwaro wachoni ok Ruoth ema oyiena mondo awachi, to awache e yor fuwo.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

kikuyu: Asetamo tiendena ni kik wuothi e yore maricho, mondo eka atim gima wachni ochiko.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kikuyu: Yesu, kopongʼ gi Roho Maler, noa Jordan, kendo notere gi Roho nyaka e thim,
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

kikuyu: Mana kaka range mangʼangʼni mowir e agulu mochwe chalo e kaka lep mager mar chuny mopongʼ gi richo.
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno malaika machielo ka huyo e kor polo. Ne en gi Injili mochwere mane olando ne ji duto modak e piny, nolando wachno ne pinje duto, gi dhoudi duto kod dhok duto gi ogendini duto.
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

kikuyu: Bende ma e dalau maduongʼ machon mane opongʼ gi mor kod ilo masani koro oke e pinje man kuonde maboyo.
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel ne nitie e thim, ngʼat moro noyud ka modo yien chiengʼ Sabato.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Natingʼo wangʼa mi aneno im moro man-gi tunge ariyo, kuchungʼ e bath aora kendo tungene ne boyo. Achiel kuom tungenego ne bor moloyo mano mane otwi achien.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram which had two horns stood before the river. The two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

kikuyu: Kit le duto gi winy mafuyo gi gik mamol kaachiel gi chwech Nyasaye duto manie nam, dhano nyalo boyo kendo oseboyo,
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

kikuyu: Ikwane kaka chwech maberie moloyo mar Nyasaye e kind le duto, kendo en mana Jachwechne kende ema nyalo chome gi ligangla.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

kikuyu: Balak nowacho ne Balaam niya, “Donge ne aoroni joote mondo ibi ira piyo? Angʼo ma nomoni biro ira? Koso iparo ni ok anyal chuli?”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

kikuyu: Notimo timbe maricho e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka wuon mare Manase nosetimo. Amon nolamo kendo timo liswa ne nyiseche duto manono mane Manase oseloso.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

kikuyu: Jowetena, asayou e nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, mondo un duto uwinjru ngʼato gi ngʼato. Kik pogruok moro amora bedi e kindu, to beduru kuriworu maonge pogruok, ka un gi dwaro achiel kod paro achiel.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

kikuyu: Dipo ka Jehova Nyasaye oneno midhiero ma an-go motimona ngʼwono kar kwongʼ mayudo kawuononi.”
english: It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me, and that the LORD will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

kikuyu: Nyaka girit malongʼo gige Hemb Romo duto, ka gichopo chike duto mag jo-Israel monego gitim e Hemb Romo.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Nyasaye nogologi Misri; tekogi chalo gi teko jowi.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kikuyu: Pok moro ka moro nyaka pog gi ombulu e kind dhoudi madongo gi matindo.”
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

kikuyu: Anachiw chik, Jehova Nyasaye wacho, kendo anadwog-gi e dala maduongʼni. Giniked kode, ginikawe kendo giwangʼe pep. Kendo anaketh dala mag Juda mondo kik ngʼato angʼata dag kanyo.”
english: Behold, I will command,” says the LORD, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

kikuyu: “Ere kaka anyalo jwangʼou, Efraim? Ere kaka dabolu Israel? Ere kaka datiu ka Adma? Ere kaka damiu ubed machal gi Zeboim? Ok anyal timonu kamano; nikech aseloko pacha kendo akechou.
english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

kikuyu: Kapo ni mano nyalo miyo wachal joneko, to obedo kamano nikech Nyasaye; to ka pachwa ni kare, to en kamano nikech un.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

kikuyu: Buluru misangono kendo uchame kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yiero. Bangʼe kochopo okinyi to doguru e hembeu.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

kikuyu: nimar en ngʼat mosiko paro nengo mochul. Owachoni niya, “Chiem kendo methi,” to chunye ok ni kodi.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

kikuyu: ne ichweyo ringra gi choke kod leche mi iumo chokena gi ringʼo kod pien?
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

kikuyu: Ruodh Afek, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Lasharon, ngʼato achiel,
english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

kikuyu: Negipenjore niya, “Bende Jehova Nyasaye osewuoyo kokalo kuom Musa kende? Donge osewuoyo kokalo kuomwa bende?” Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowinjo ma.
english: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato angʼata okawore ni en jalemo, to ok orito lewe motegno to owuondore kende, kendo lemone onge tiende.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

kikuyu: Eka dwolno nowuoyo kode kendo mar ariyo niya, “Kik iluong gimoro amora ma Nyasaye osepwodho ni ok ler.”
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ibrahim nokelo rombe kod dhok mi omiyogi Abimelek, kendo ji ariyogi notimo singruok.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

kikuyu: In ingʼeyo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; para kendo konya. Chul kuor ne joma sanda. Isenano koda omiyo kik iweya; par kaka osesanda kochaya nikech in.
english: LORD, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

kikuyu: Baw wiye kod bethene duto kod tungene gi dhahabu maler bende losne ndiri mar dhahabu molwore.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: achiel kuom jotij Ayub nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Noyudo ka wapuro gi rwedhi kendo punde ne kwayo machiegni kodwa,
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

kikuyu: Kane Anania owinjo wachno, nogore piny motho. Ji duto mane owinjo gima notimoreno ne luoro omako.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Neno mamor kelo mor ni chuny, to wach maber miyo choke bedo gi ngima.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

kikuyu: Wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye mondo orieny kuomu kendo omiu ngʼwono mogundho;
english: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

kikuyu: Kornelio nongʼiyo malaikano ka luoro omake, eka noyiene niya, “Iwacho nangʼo, Ruoth?” Malaika nodwoke niya, “Lemoni kod timbeni mag ngʼwono mikonyogo joma odhier osechopo e nyim Nyasaye kaka misango omiyo osepari.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

kikuyu: Nikech osejaro wach Jehova Nyasaye kendo oketho chikene, ngʼatno nyaka gol oko; kendo richo mare nodongʼ e wiye.’ ”
english: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

kikuyu: “ ‘Nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: “ ‘Okwongʼ dala maduongʼ michweroe remo, ma en agulu motimo chilo, agulu ma chinde ok bi rumo. Goluru ringʼo duto e iye achiel kachiel ma ok uweyo moro e iye kata matin.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is in it, and whose rust hasn’t gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece without casting lots for it.

kikuyu: Kar timo gima owinjore utim gi giga maler, to ne uketo jomoko nono mondo ema orit kara maler mar lemo.
english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

kikuyu: ni tingʼruok ma joma timbegi richo tingʼorego rumo piyo, kendo mor mar joma okia Nyasaye ok bed amingʼa.
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

kikuyu: Mana kaka ngʼama thoro diro aserni adira ema chalo gi ngʼat mandiko ngʼat mofuwo kata ngʼato angʼata moyudo e tich.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

kikuyu: Amako chikeni matek, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, omiyo kik iwe ane wichkuot.
english: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Kendo Jehova Nyasaye biro goyo Israel, mochal mana gi odundu ma yamo tero ewi pi. Obiro pudho Israel oko kogologi e piny maber mane omiyo kweregi mi okegi loka Aora nikech negimiyo Jehova Nyasaye mirima ka giloso ludhe mag Ashera.
english: For the LORD will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth owinjo wachno, chunye nochandore; moramo ni nyaka ores Daniel, kendo notimo duto mane onyalo odiechiengno duto chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo mondo okonye.
english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.

kikuyu: E higa mokwongo mar loch Sairas ruodh Pasia, mondo ochop singo mar wach Jehova Nyasaye mane Jeremia okoro, Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi chuny Sairas ruodh Pasia mondo ogol lendo e pinye duto koketo e ndiko kama:
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

kikuyu: to oganda nowinjo mano kendo ne giluwe. Norwakogi kendo nowuoyo kodgi kuom loch mar pinyruoth Nyasaye, kendo nochango jogo mane dwaro chang.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

kikuyu: Hilkia jadolo, Ahikam, Akbor, Shafan kod Asaya nodhi wuoyo gi Hulda janabi madhako, mane chi Shalum wuod Tikva, ma wuod Harhas, jarit kar keno mar lep lemo. Nodak Jerusalem, e gwengʼ mar ariyo.
english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

kikuyu: Mon bende onego owinj chwogi e weche duto, mana kaka kanisa bende winjo Kristo.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

kikuyu: ne onge buya mane osetwi e piny kendo ne onge yien mane osedongo nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne pok ooro koth e piny kendo ne onge dhano mawuotho ewi lowo,
english: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

kikuyu: Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ni kanisa. Ngʼat molocho abiro miyo manna moko mopandi. Bende abiro miye kidi marachar mondikie nying manyien maonge ngʼat mongʼeyo makmana ngʼat monwangʼe.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

kikuyu: Luoruru Jehova Nyasaye, un joge maler, nikech joma omiye luor ok chand gimoro amora.
english: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

kikuyu: Asebedo ka aonge ketho e nyime kendo aseritora mondo kik atim richo.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka none, kendo ka nitie kido marachar kama litni mi yier man kanyo olokore marachar, kendo kanyo onogo otimo adhola,
english: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

kikuyu: Yawuot Elpal ne gin: Eber, Misham, Shemed (mane ogero Ono kod Lod kaachiel gi mier molworogi),
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

kikuyu: Ji mangʼeny nobi e nyinga ka hedhore ni, ‘An e en,’ kendo giniwuond ji mangʼeny.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo dimi jo-Misri wuo gi ngʼayi kawacho ni, ‘Nogologi gi chuny marach mondo otiekgi ewi gode kendo mondo otiekgi e wangʼ piny?’ Kuom mano, we mirimbi mager, mondo ilok chunyi kik ikel kethruok ni jogi.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

kikuyu: Mika nopenje niya, “Ia kanye?” Nodwoke niya, “An ja-Lawi moa Bethlehem man Juda, kendo amanyo kama anyalo dakie.”
english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gariyo ne mar Hashabia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Ne owacho wechegi kane oyudo opuonjo e laru mar hekalu, but kama ji ne ketoe sadaka. To onge ngʼama nomake, nikech kindene ne pok ochopo.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Sap Pasaka mar jo-Yahudi koro nokayo machiegni.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

kikuyu: Ka ipuro lowo, to ok obi nyagoni cham. Ibiro bedo ngʼat maonge kar dak mabayo abaya e piny.”
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ilo gi mor orumo e puoth olembe kod puothe mag Moab. Asechungo chwer mar divai koa e kuonde mibiyogie; onge ngʼama nyonogi gi koko mar ilo. Kata obedo ni nitiere koko, ok gin koko mar ilo.
english: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.

kikuyu: Lek mane aneno kane anindo e kitandana ema: Ne aneno e nyima yien moro mochungʼ e chuny piny kendo yien-no ne bor ahinya.
english: These were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Yesu nochike mondo odhi pacho, kowachone niya, “Kik iraw e dala mar Bethsaida.”
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

kikuyu: Dwogwa iri, yaye Nyasaye Maratego; mi wangʼi orienynwa, eka mondo wayud warruok.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Nikech ringruok osiko ka dwaro timo mana gik ma Roho ok dwar, to Roho bende dwaro chopo gik ma ringruok ok dwar. Gik moko ariyogi osiko ok winjre kendo mano ema miyo ok utim gik mabeyo mugombo timo.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mathiro jochan mondo mwandune omedre kod ngʼat machiwo mich ne jomoko biro bedo jochan.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

kikuyu: Kanyo niluongo ni Holo mar Eshkol nikech negingʼado bad olemb mzabibu mochiek.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

kikuyu: To dhako moro ne ni kanyo mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo to onge ngʼat mane nyalo change.
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

kikuyu: Yawuot Jesse adek madongo noluwo Saulo e lweny. Wuowi maduongʼ ne en Eliab, mar ariyo ne Abinadab, to mar adek ne en Shama.
english: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

kikuyu: Ratege molwororego nobed machiegni gi bethe mesano mondo omak ludhego mitiyogo kuom tingʼo mesa.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Nyasi duto ma en-go anakethi: nyasi mar higa ka higa, mar dwe ka dwe, mar Sabato kod nyasi motimo juma ka juma.
english: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.

kikuyu: mi awacho niya, “Ok abi bedo jakwadhu. We joma tho otho, kendo we joma lal olal. Joma odongʼ to mondo ocham ringre jowetegi.”
english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

kikuyu: Negidhi e bur kagingima mi lowo uomogi kod mwandugi kendo negilal nono ei oganda Israel.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

kikuyu: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi mwandu mopandi e puodho, ma ngʼat moro nonwangʼo kendo nopando, eka noa kanyo kopongʼ gi mor kendo nodhi mouso gige duto mane en-go modwogo ongʼiewogo puodhono.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kikuyu: To mana jadolo maduongʼ kende ema noyiene donjo e hema maiye dichiel kende e higa, to nechune ni nyaka odonj iye kuno gi remo mane otimogo misango ne richone mokwongo eka bangʼe otimonego ji duto bende, mondo owenegi richo mane gitimo ka gikia.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

kikuyu: Jowetena, koro adwaro ni ungʼe, ni gik mosetimorena osemiyo Injili omedo landore.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kikuyu: Weuru yorni, wuoguru e ndarani kendo we bwogowa gi Jal Maler mar Israel.
english: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

kikuyu: Omiyo ka wan gi chiemo kod lewni to mago mondo oromwa.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

kikuyu: Eka dhakono nodhi ir ji gi riekone mane ongʼadono, kendo negingʼado wi Sheba wuod Bikri mi gidiro ni Joab. Omiyo nogoyo turumbete, mi joge no-aa mi giweyo dala maduongʼno kendo moro ka moro nodok e dalane. Joab to nodok Jerusalem ir ruoth.
english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

kikuyu: nikech Nyasaye ok dew wangʼ ji.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

kikuyu: Nogero kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag lemo e miech Juda duto mondo otim misango ne nyiseche mamoko kokwinyogo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi mondo owangʼ iye.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers, to anger.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Maskil mar yawuot Kora. Mana kaka mwanda gamo yweyo kamanyo kuonde ma pi nitie, e kaka chunya dwari, yaye Nyasaye.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

kikuyu: Dine amako badi, mi akeli nyaka e od minwa kama ne opuonjae. Dine amiyi divai moketie yedhe madungʼ tik mamit mondo imadhi; kendo dine amiyi olemo mongʼinore makwar.
english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

kikuyu: Dho dhako ma jachode en bur matut; ngʼatno manie bwo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye biro lingʼore e iye.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

kikuyu: Winjuru! Luong Jehova Nyasaye ne dala maduongʼ chutho luoro nyingi en rieko. “Yie kum momiyi kaachiel gi ngʼama ochiwe.
english: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

kikuyu: pige mane mol koa malo nochungʼ. Nogingore malo kaka pith, e dala miluongo ni Adam man but Zarethan. Pi mane mol kadhi e nam mar Araba (ma tiende ni Nam Chumbi) nochungʼ chuth, omiyo ji nongʼado modhi loka komachielo, momanyore gi Jeriko.
english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

kikuyu: Dhoudi ariyo gi nusgo oseyudo pokgi loka Aora Jordan man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jeriko.”
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

kikuyu: “Asebedo kodi koro higni piero ariyo, to rombi kata dieki pok obwogo bende achamo imi kata achiel.
english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

kikuyu: Ada nonywolo Jabal, mane wuon jokwath mane odak e hembe kendo ne nigi jamni.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

kikuyu: Nikech kwongʼruokni, Yesu koro oseguro winjruok manyien gi Nyasaye, ma en singruok maber moloyo machon.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

kikuyu: Gibiro luwo bangʼwa nyaka wawuondgi mi giwuog oko mar dala maduongʼ, mi giniwach e chunygi ni, ‘Ne, giringowa mana kaka ne giringowa motelo.’ Omiyo seche mwaringogino
english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,

kikuyu: Eka Adonija nomedo wacho niya, “Yie ikwa ruoth Solomon omiya Abishag nyar Shunam obed jaoda nikech angʼeyo ni ok obi tami.”
english: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

kikuyu: To in, in ngʼa yaye dhano, ma diduokri gi Nyasaye? “Gima ochwe bende nyalo wachone ngʼat mochweye ni, ‘Angʼo momiyo ne ichweya machal kama?’”
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

kikuyu: to mar abich ne sardonikso, mar auchiel ne sardius, eka mar abiriyo ne krusolith, to mar aboro ne berul, mar ochiko ne topaz, to mar apar ne kruskopraso, kendo mar apar gachiel ne jasinth, to mar apar gariyo ne amethusto.
english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

kikuyu: Mad ngʼwono gi kwe kod hera mogundho obed kodu.
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngʼato angʼata mochiwne Jehova Nyasaye mondo okum ok nyal war, to nyaka nege anega.
english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano, ne ool kadoni ne jonabigi, to kane gichako chiemo, ne giywak niya, “Yaye ngʼat Nyasaye, tho ni e agulu kendo ne ok ginyal chame!”
english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

kikuyu: Ok ni wan gi nyalo moro kuomwa wawegi mar tiyo tijni, to nyalowa aa kuom Nyasaye.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

kikuyu: Jodolo, ma yawuot joka Lawi nochungʼ nyime, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu oseyierogi mondo gitine kendo mondo gichiw gweth e nying Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo gingʼad buche mar larruok kod mag nek.
english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them the LORD your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in the LORD’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

kikuyu: “Anagol chik kendo abiro piedho jo-Israel, e kind ogendini duto, ka cham mipiedho e odheru, kendo kata wangʼ cham achiel ok nolwar piny.
english: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.

kikuyu: Koro dwokne Ibrahim chiege, nimar en janabi, kendo obiro lamoni mi ok initho. To ka ok idwoke, to bed gadiera ni in gi jogi duto ubiro tho.”
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

kikuyu: Anto anyisou ni ngʼato angʼata morango dhako gi gombo oseterore kode gi ei chunye.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

kikuyu: Resa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kuom dho joma riambo kendo kuom lew joma wuondore.
english: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Koso ukia ni ngʼat moriwore gi dhako ma jachode bedo kode e achiel kuom ringruok? Ndiko wacho niya, “Ji ariyogo nodok ringruok achiel.”
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Kata ka onega, to pod abiro keto genona kuome; omiyo pod abiro mana wacho wechena e nyime.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin nowinjo ni jo-Israel nosedhi nyaka Mizpa. Eka jo-Israel nowacho niya, “Nyiswane kaka gima lichni notimore.”
english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Musa ne oseriembo chiege ma Zipora, jaduongʼne Jethro norwake
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

kikuyu: Kane gidok e ot kendo, jopuonjre Yesu nopenje kuom wachni.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

kikuyu: Enokir remo moko gi lith lwete nyadibiriyo e kendo mar misango kendo nopwodhe e timbe mogak mag jo-Israel mi nobed maler.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Omiyo jodolo kod jo-Lawi nopwodhore mondo mi gikel Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach jo-Israel.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: “Gouru turumbete e dala mar Gibea, gouru abu e dala mar Rama. Gouru nduru mar lweny e dala mar Beth Aven; yaye, jo-Benjamin teluru.
english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

kikuyu: Makmana, ka dipo ni iwacho gino ma watimo, to inigonywa kuom kwongʼruok mane iketowa wakwongʼore godo.”
english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

kikuyu: “Kokelu e sinagogi, e nyim jodongo gi jotelo, to kik uparru kaka dudwok weche ma odonjnugo, kata gima duwachi,
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

kikuyu: Kanyo Jakobo nogero kendo mar misango kendo noluongo kanyo ni El Bethel, nikech kanyo ema ne Nyasaye ofwenyorene kane oringo owadgi.
english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

kikuyu: Apaki ndalo abiriyo e odiechiengʼ achiel kuom chikegi makare.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Joma ongʼanyo ni e tho malich. Abiro kumogi giduto.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.

kikuyu: Chik iti mos mondo iwinj wechena; kendo yie mondo iwinj gik ma awacho.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

kikuyu: To jogo nowachone niya, “In ok inyal dhi kodwa, nikech ka ochuno ni nyaka waringi, to ok gibi dewowa. Kata ka nuswa otho to ok gidhi dewo nikech in iromri gi ji alufu apar kuomwa. Omiyo ber ka in idongʼ mondo ikonywa gie dala maduongʼ ka.”
english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

kikuyu: To kaka ne osengʼeyo oganda ma Modekai ae, ne ochayo wach nego mana Modekai kende. Kar timo mano, Haman nodwaro yo monyalo tiekogo oganda gi Modekai duto, ma gin jo-Yahudi, e pinyruodh Ahasuerus duto.
english: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone, for they had made known to him Mordecai’s people. Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai’s people.

kikuyu: kod pek dhahabu mopwodhi molosgo kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani. Bende nonyise kaka onego olos gach lweny, ma en kerubi molos gi dhahabu moyaro bwombegi kendo oumo Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.

kikuyu: Omiyo Ruoth Joram noa Samaria mochoko jo-Israel duto.
english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

kikuyu: Chik iti mondo angʼadni rieko kendo Nyasaye obed kodi. Onego ibed jachungʼ jogi e nyim Nyasaye kendo iter larruokgi e nyime.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

kikuyu: To chiwuru gima ni e bakul ne joma odhier, eka gik moko duto biro bedonu maler.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

kikuyu: “Oganda duto mar Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Ere gima omiyo uketho winjruok maru gi Nyasach Israel? Ere gima omiyo ungʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye mi ugero kendo mar misango ni un uwegi e yor wangʼ teko?
english: “The whole congregation of the LORD says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against the LORD?

kikuyu: Jotham nonindo moyweyo gi kwerene kendo noyike kodgi e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, ma en dala maduongʼ mar wuon mare. Kendo Ahaz ma wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Kendo jopinyno nokawo Jehoahaz wuod Josia mokete obedo ruoth e Jerusalem kar wuon mare.
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: E ndalo duto mag Saulo ne nitie lweny malit ahinya e kinde gi jo-Filistia, kendo kinde ma Saulo noneno ngʼat maratego kata mathuon to ne okawe mondo obed jalwenje.
english: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.

kikuyu: Isaya nowacho kamano nikech noneno duongʼ maler mar Yesu kendo nowuoyo kuome.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

kikuyu: To nopenjogi niya, “Bende uneno gigi duto? Awachonu adier ni onge kidi kata achiel mabiro dongʼ kochungʼ ewi wadgi, gibiro redhore piny duto.”
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Negimiye shekel piero abiriyo mag fedha koa e hekalu mar Baal-Berith, mi Abimelek ongʼiewogo jomoko macheje kod jo-mahundu mane oluwe.
english: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

kikuyu: Emomiyo ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou kwe e piny mobiro miyou mondo ukaw kaka girkeni, to kik wiu wil ma ok utieko jo-Amalek duto.
english: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nokaw remo moko mar golo richo gi lith lwete mi nomiene e tunge kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, eka bangʼe remo duto modongʼ to nopuk e tiend kendo mar misango.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, pod aluoro aluora masira momaka nikech angʼeyo ni Nyasaye ok nyal kwana ka ngʼat maonge ketho.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nochiko ite ne kwayo Israel kendo nochiwo jo-Kanaan ne gin. Negitiekogi duto kod miechgi; omiyo kanyo negichako ni Horma.
english: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

kikuyu: Kik iwe obadho ma gisechikona maka, ee, resa kuom otegu ma joma timbegi richo ochikona.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: To negikecho kendo negichako wuoyo ngʼato gi ngʼato kuom gino ma digitim ni Yesu.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone niya, “Kawe.” Eka ngʼatno norieyo lwete mokawe.
english: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

kikuyu: Nyaka ikaw remb nyarwadhno moko kendo imien e tunge angʼwen mag kendo mar misango kendo e konde angʼwen mag ndiri mamalo kendo e alwora duto mag raten, mondo kuom timo kamano ipwodh kendo mar misango kendo obed maler.
english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

kikuyu: Kata kamano, ka buch tho oloki, moketne chudo, to nyaka ochul nengo moro amora moketne mondo oresgo ngimane.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “E ndalogo ji apar moa e dhoudi mopogore opogore kendo mawacho dhok mopogore opogore nomak riak law ja-Yahudi moro motegno kawacho ni, ‘Yie mondo wadhi kodu, nikech wasewinjo ni Nyasaye nikodu.’ ”
english: The LORD of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”

kikuyu: Ber ngʼat ma jachan ma wuodhe ok cha, moloyo ngʼat ma ja-mwandu ma yorene richo.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kikuyu: Ibiro kechowa kendo, ibiro nyono richowa e tiendi, kendo idir kethruokwa duto e bwo nam.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

kikuyu: Mana kaka Wuoro Mangima noora, kendo angima nikech Wuoro, e kaka ngʼama chamo ringra biro bedo mangima nikech an.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

kikuyu: Nimar gisando joma ihinyo kendo giwuoyo kuom lit mag joma ihinyo.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

kikuyu: Ere Jal mane ooro bade man-gi teko mondo obedie lwet Musa ma korachwich, mane obaro pi e nyimgi mondo nyinge oyud duongʼ mochwere?
english: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

kikuyu: Nus mar nyithindgi ne wacho dho Ashdod kata dho achiel kuom joma moko, to ne ok gi ngʼeyo dho Juda.
english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Benjamin nochungʼ bangʼ Abner. Negichokore e migepe kendo negiikore ne lweny ewi got.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

kikuyu: Daudi nochoko jo-Israel duto chakre Aora Shihor man Misri nyaka Lebo Hamath mondo giom Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye Kiriath Jearim.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: Koro asenyisou kapok mano otimore, mondo ka gigo otimore to uyie.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

kikuyu: Anamiyi ngima maber kendo anathiedh adhondeni,’ Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho, ‘nikech iluongi ni ngʼama owit oko, Sayun maonge ngʼama dewo.’
english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says the LORD, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”

kikuyu: E higa mar piero adek gachiel mar loch Asa ruodh Juda, Omri nobedo ruodh Israel, nobedo ruoth kuom higni apar gariyo, ka auchiel kuomgi en Tirza.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

kikuyu: Ne osekel joma riek gi jokor wach e nyima mondo gisom ndikoni kendo ginyisa tiende, to ne ok ginyal nyisa tiende.
english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

kikuyu: Nyaka gitine kaachiel gi oganda duto e nyim Hemb Romo ka gitiyo tije mag kama ler.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Yaye od Jakobo, inyalo wacho niya: “Bende Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye dikechi? Bende dotim gik ma kamago?” “Donge wechena timo maber ne ngʼatno ma yorene oriere?
english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

kikuyu: Bende, tim moro amora makwodo wich, kata wach mochido, kata angera mag oyuma ok owinjore kodu, makmana dwoko ne Nyasaye erokamano.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

kikuyu: Ji ariyogo nowuok modhi ka Roho Maler otelonegi. Ne gilor nyaka Seleukia, bangʼe gikwangʼ ka gia kanyo nyaka Saipras.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

kikuyu: E bethe bepe mosirogigo ne nitie kido mar sibuoche, kido mar rwedhi kod kido mar kerubi kendo ewi sirnigo bende. E wigi malo kendo e bwo sibuoche gi rwedhigo ne nitie gik machalo maua mothedhi.
english: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

kikuyu: Ka usengʼado aora Jordan, chunguru kitegi e Got Ebal mana kaka achikou kawuono ka uwirogi maber.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

kikuyu: To kuom wach hera ma jowete kuom Kristo onego oherrego to ok wane tiende ndikonue, nikech un uwegi Nyasaye osepuonjou mondo uherru ngʼato gi ngʼato.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

kikuyu: E kinde mane gineko, kane adongʼ kenda, ne apodho piny auma, mi aywagora niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, bende dineg mitiek pep oganda jo-Israel manok modongʼ e thuolo miolee mirimbi kuom Jerusalem?”
english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

kikuyu: Pinje biro winjo mi tetni, kihondko biro mako jo-Filistia.
english: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

kikuyu: Eka Laban nodonjo ei hemb Jakobo kendo ei hemb Lea kendo ei hemb jotichgi ariyo ma nyiri to ne ok oyudo gimoro. Bangʼ kane osea ei hemb Lea nodonjo ei hemb Rael.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

kikuyu: Higa ka higa jonywolne ne dhiyo Jerusalem e Sawo mar Pasaka.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

kikuyu: To donge an thuolo? Donge an jaote? Donge ne aneno Yesu Ruodhwa? Koso donge un olemo mar tichna kuom Ruoth?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Kik ngʼama riek sungre gi riekone kata ngʼama tek sungre gi tekone, kata ngʼama omewo sungre gi mwandu mage,
english: The LORD says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches.

kikuyu: Bangʼe unudwany nyisecheu manono mubawo gi fedha kod dhahabu; kendo unuwitgi ka ukwano gi ka gik ma ok ler, mi uwitgi ka nanga moywego remb nyodo, kuwachonegi niya, “Aiuru ira.”
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

kikuyu: Paulo ne dwaro kawe mondo dhi kode e wuodhe mar yalo Injili, omiyo ne otere nyangu, nikech jo-Yahudi mane odak kanyo nongʼeyo ni wuon-gi ne en ja-Yunani.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

kikuyu: Misengini mane jotend jo-Israel okelo e kinde mane ogwedh kendo mar misango e magi: sende mag fedha apar gariyo, bakunde mag fedha mag kwoyo pi apar gariyo kod dise mag dhahabu apar gariyo.
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

kikuyu: Ogwedh joma gigi gin adier kuomgi; kendo ogwedh jogo ma Nyasachgi en Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

kikuyu: Jaricho ringo kaonge ngʼama lawe, to joma kare jochir ka sibuor.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

kikuyu: En adier ni osiepni nyalo heri kinde duto, to owadu ema konyi e chandruok.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

kikuyu: Winj wuonu, nikech en ema nonywoli, kendo kik icha minu ka oti.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

kikuyu: Jorit rangeye ne nitie e bethe angʼwen ma gin: yo wuok chiengʼ, yo podho chiengʼ, yo nyandwat kod yo milambo.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

kikuyu: Ana nonywolo: Dishon, kod Oholibama nyar Ana.
english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

kikuyu: Yaye Ruoth, ibiro siko kirango gigi katimore nyaka karangʼo? Res ngimana kuom kethruok duto mag-gi. Akwayi ni ires ngimana ma nengone tek e lwet sibuochegi.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

kikuyu: Nogoyonegi ngeroni niya, “Ngʼat ma muofu bende nyalo telo ni ngʼama muofu machielo? Donge giduto ji ariyogo di gilingʼre ei bugo?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nochiw akuch oduglago kata nyithi akuru, ma ngʼat mipwodhono okelo kaka misango,
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

kikuyu: Dhoga biro wacho pak ne Jehova Nyasaye. Gik mangima duto mondo opak nyinge maler, nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
english: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

kikuyu: to gi Elioenai, Jakoba, Jeshohaya, Asaya, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaya,
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua kod jo-Israel notiekogi chuth makmana joma tin ema nodongʼ e miechgi madongo mochiel kod ohinga.
english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

kikuyu: Mosnauru Turfena gi Turfosa, ma gin mon matiyo matek ni Ruoth. Mosnauru osiepna Persi ma en dhako mosetiyo matek ni Ruoth.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Ashdod oneno gima ne timore, negiwacho niya, “Sandug Muma mar Nyasach jo-Israel kik bed kodwa ka, nikech lwete osesandowa kaachiel gi Dagon ma nyasachwa.”
english: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”

kikuyu: Eliezer wuod Dodavahu ma ja-Maresha nokoro wach marach kuom Jehoshafat kowacho niya, “Nikech isetimo winjruok kod Ahazia, Jehova Nyasaye biro ketho gigo ma iseloso.” Yiedhigo nobarore kendo ne ok ginyal kwangʼ mondo gitim ohala.
english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

kikuyu: Unutim machalre kamano bende e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo ne ngʼato angʼata motimo richo ka ok ochano, kata kuom kia, mondo upwodhgo hekalu.
english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

kikuyu: Kamano Saulo gi yawuote adek gi jatingʼne gige lweny kod joode duto notho kaachiel e odiechiengʼno.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

kikuyu: Rwak pak ma achiwoni gi dhoga ka ahero, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo puonja chikeni.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar ne mar Shimei gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Gimoro amora mowal tenge koa kuom misengini maler ma jo-Israel ochiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye, amiyoi gi yawuoti kod nyigi kaka pok maru mapile. En singruok ma ok rum e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne in kaachiel gi nyikwayi.”
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your offspring with you.”

kikuyu: Kuom adier, Nyasaye biro toyo wiye wasike, obiro mayo joma dhi nyime gi timo richo osimbo motimo yier ma girwako.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

kikuyu: Chwo duto mahikgi piero adek nyaka piero abich mane obiro tiyo e Hemb Romo
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: E kindeno, Jehova Nyasaye nokaw liganglane mabith, motegno kendo man-gi teko, mokumgo Leviathan, thuol malich mamol kendo monudore; motiek thuol malich mar nam.
english: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

kikuyu: Ngʼama ne chiegni tho nogwedha; kendo namiyo chuny dhako ma chwore otho duogo mi ower gi mor.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

kikuyu: Atimo singruokni ka akwongʼora kawuono, ok gi un kende
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

kikuyu: Nimar Jachwechni e chwori, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge midendego, Jal Maler mar Israel e Jaresni; iluonge ni Nyasach piny ngima.
english: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Chi Manoa nodhi piyo monyiso chwore niya, “Ngʼat mane obiro ira cha ni ka!”
english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”

kikuyu: Kuom magi duto, Ayub ne ok otimo richo kata kwano Nyasaye kaka jaketho.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwoko niya, “Awachoni adier ni otienoni, kapok thuon gweno okok, wangʼ inikweda nyadidek.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Ka wuonegi kata owetegi obiro donjo irwa, to wabiro wachonegi ni, ‘Timnwa ngʼwono kuom konyogi, nikech ne ok wayudonegi mon e kinde mag lweny, kendo un uonge gi wach, nikech un ne ok umiyogi nyiu.’ ”
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

kikuyu: To mago mane ok odew wach Jehova Nyasaye ne oweyo wasumbinigi gi jambgi e pap.
english: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi otieko wuoyo, Saulo nopenjo niya, “Mano en dwondi Daudi wuoda?” Eka noywak matek.
english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

kikuyu: Kane Nyasaye osetieko wuoyo kod Ibrahim, noweye modhi.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

kikuyu: Eka Israel nowacho ne Josef niya, “Koro achiegni tho, to Nyasaye biro bedo kodu kendo nodwoku e piny kwereu.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

kikuyu: “Ngʼeyo tiend wachni dwaro paro matut man-gi rieko. Wiye abiriyogo gin gode abiriyo ma dhakono obetie.
english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni negiwacho ni giriek, to negibedo joma ofuwo,
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

kikuyu: Ere kaka jaherani oloyo chwo mamoko, yaye jaber mogik e dier nyiri mabeyo duto? Ere kaka jaherani oloyo chwo mamoko, momiyo imiyowa chik ma kamano?
english: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?

kikuyu: Yiedhi mag Hiram nokelo dhahabu moa Ofir kendo negikelo koa kuro yiedhi madongo mag yiend almugo mangʼeny gi kite ma nengogi tek.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro yaro lochni chakre Sayun; ibiro bedo gi loch e dier wasiki.
english: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

kikuyu: Omiyo chiew! Mondo ijiw gima pod odongʼno kapok otho chuth, nimar timbeni ayudo korem e nyim Nyasaye.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

kikuyu: Ireso joma muol to joma wengegi tek idwoko piny.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

kikuyu: Ben-Hadad nowinjo oteno ka en kaachiel gi ruodhi ne metho e hembegi mi nochiko joge niya, “Ikreuru mondo umonjgi.” Omiyo negiikore mondo gimonj dalano maduongʼ.
english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

kikuyu: Hezekia kod ji duto nobedo mamor kod gima Nyasaye notimone joge, nikech notimo mapiyo.
english: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

kikuyu: Nikech gima dhano nyalo ngʼeyo kuom Nyasaye oyangorenigi maler, nikech Nyasaye oseelenigi.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

kikuyu: Ne aneno ohinga moro molworo kama hekalu nitie. Ngʼatno nokaw odundu mar pimo mane ni e lwete ma borne ne romo fut apar. Ne opimo ohinga, kendo lach kore gi borne ne romo fut apar moro ka moro.
english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

kikuyu: Omiyo kanyo noluong ni Tabera (tiende ni Kama Mach osewangʼo) nikech mach moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye nosewangʼo bath kambi konchiel e kindgi.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.

kikuyu: “Eka Jal machielo bende nowacho niya, ‘Eka aa kendo, omiyo ok anyal biro.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

kikuyu: “Magi e nying joma chwo mabiro konyi kweno: “koa kuom joka Reuben, kaw Elizur wuod Shedeur;
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Dhakono nowachone niya, “Jaduongʼ, ionge gi gima inyalo tuomogo pi, kendo sokoni bende tut. Pi ngimano to inyalo yud kanye?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

kikuyu: “Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni singruok ma anatim kodgi bangʼ ndalogo, abiro keto chikena e chunygi, kendo ndikogi e pachgi.”
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

kikuyu: Chutho onge ngʼat manyalo monjo od ngʼat maratego mi omaye gige odhigo ka ok otweyo ngʼatno mokwongo. Kosetimo kamano eka dohedhre mar yako gik moko e odno.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Omiyo jongʼad rieko mogen dhogi lingʼ thi kendo ogolo kuom jodongo rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend weche mopondo.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

kikuyu: Ne angʼiyo piny, ne en nono kendo noonge gi kido; kendo bende ne angʼiyo e polo, to ler ne onge.
english: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

kikuyu: Giparo ni lek ma ginyisore giwegi nomi ji wigi nowil gi nyinga, mana kaka wuonegi wigi nowil koda kaluwore gilamo mane gilamogo Baal.”
english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.

kikuyu: Omiyo jolweny nobiro moturo tiend ngʼat mokwongo ma nogur gi Yesu, kod tiende ngʼat machielo bende.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

kikuyu: gi Heshbon kaachiel gi mier matindo mantiere e pewe, kaka Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato obiro ira, to ok okwedo wuon-gi kod min-gi kod chiege gi nyithinde, owetene gi nyiminene ee, kata ngimane owuon ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Nyaka giriwre kodi kendo gikaw tich mar rito Hemb Romo kaachiel gi tije duto manie Hema, kendo onge ngʼat machielo moyiene biro machiegni gi kama intie.
english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

kikuyu: “Bangʼ mano, ne achako aneno ondiek mar adek mane chalo gi kwach. Ne en gi bwombe angʼwen e diengʼeye machalo gi bwombe winyo. Ondiegni ne nigi wiye angʼwen, kendo ne omiye teko mar bedo gi loch.
english: “After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird. The animal also had four heads; and dominion was given to it.

kikuyu: Asa nowacho ne jo-Juda niya, “Wageruru miechgi kendo waket ohinga molworogi man-gi kuonde maboyo mag ngʼicho gi rangeye kod lodi milorogi godo. Piny pod marwa nimar waseluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, newaluwe to en nomiyowa yweyo koni gi koni.” Omiyo negigedo kendo negidhi nyime maber.
english: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

kikuyu: Obiro kumi gi aserni mabitho mag jakedo, ee, obiro wangʼi gi maka maliel mager, mowangʼ gi yiend adugo.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

kikuyu: Wanyisou gima waseneno kendo winjo, mondo un bende ubed e achiel kodwa e lalruok. To lalruok marwa ni e kindwa gi Wuoro kod Wuode, Yesu Kristo.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ishmael wuod Nethania kod ji apar mane ni kode nochungʼ malo kendo onego Gedalia wuod Ahikam, ma wuod Shafan, gi ligangla, ma ginego ngʼatno ma ruodh Babulon noyiero kaka jatelo e pinyno.
english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato paro ni ok otim maber ne osiepne ma nyako mangili modwaro nyuomo, kendo ka nyakono hike koro medore, to dichwono oneno ni onego okende, to ber mondo okend nyakono. Oonge gi ketho kotimo kamano kendo onego gikendre.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

kikuyu: “In nyathi Satan, kendo ikedo gi gik mabeyo duto! Ipongʼ gi kit wuondruok duto gi yore mag wito ji. Iniwe timni mar loko adiera Ruoth Nyasaye doko miriambo karangʼo?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

kikuyu: Mich moro amora maber kendo malongʼo aa malo e polo, koa kuom Wuoro manochweyo ler marieny e polo, kendo ma ok lokre ka tipo ma osiko kalokore.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

kikuyu: E thim kanyo oganda jo-Israel duto nongʼur ne Musa gi Harun.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

kikuyu: Nimar kata Kristo bende ne ok otimo gik mamore en owuon, to mana kaka ondiki: “Ayany duto mag joma yanyi nolwar kuoma.”
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

kikuyu: “Omiyo noluongo jogope ruodhe achiel achiel. Nopenjo mokwongo ni, ‘In-gi gowi mar ruodha marom nadi?’
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

kikuyu: “Kamano e kaka nobedi e ndalo ma Wuod Dhano nofwenyre.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

kikuyu: kendo dhok abiriyo mabeyo kendo machwe nowuok ei aora ka gikwayo e kind odundu.
english: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

kikuyu: Omiyo Joshua nowangʼo Ai mi okete obedo pith mongingore mar kethruok kendo pod en kamano nyaka chil kawuono.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

kikuyu: To kapo ni oganda jo-Israel ok odewo wach ngʼat mochiwo achiel kuom nyithinde ne Molek, ma ok ginege,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

kikuyu: To malaika nowachone ni: “Kik ibed maluor, Zekaria; lamoni osewinji chiegi Elizabeth biro nywoloni wuowi, kendo inichake Johana.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nokok matek kawacho niya, “Ka ngʼato oyie kuoma, to an ok ema oyie kuoma kenda, to oyie kuom Jal mane oora bende.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

kikuyu: koa kuom Arodi, joka Arodi; koa kuom Areli, joka Areli.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

kikuyu: Ne gichwero remo maonge ketho, remb yawuotgi gi nyigi, mane gichiwo kaka misango ne kido mag nyiseche mag Kanaan, mi piny nogak nikech rembgi.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

kikuyu: Kane Bathsheba odhi ir Ruoth Solomon mondo owuo kuom Adonija, ruoth nochungʼ malo mokulorene eka nobet e kome mar duongʼ. Nokwayo mondo okel ni min-gi kom duongʼ eka nobet e bade korachwich.
english: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

kikuyu: nikech ne ok giromone jo-Israel gi chiemo kod pi, makmana to negichulo Balaam mondo okwongʼ-gi. (Kata kamano, Nyasachwa noloko kwongʼno obedo gweth.)
english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

kikuyu: Samson nowachonegi niya, “We agonue ngero moro. Ka unyalo miya dwoko bangʼ ndalo abiriyo mar nyasini, to anamiu kandhe piero adek gi lewni mabeyo bende piero adek.”
english: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;

kikuyu: Her Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi gi chunyi duto kendo gi ngimani duto kendo gi tekoni duto.
english: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane nyar Farao osewuok e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi modhi e dala mane Solomon ogerone, eka Solomon nogero ohinga molworo ode.
english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Farisai oneno mano, negipenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo japuonju chiemo gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Chunya opongʼ gi midhiero gi lit nyaka kar tho. Beduru ka kendo beduru ka urito kaachiel koda.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

kikuyu: Eka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nosudo nyime mi ochungʼ kama diny maonge thuolo mar lokruok, korachwich kata koracham.
english: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: “Mier auchiel ma umiyo jo-Lawi nobed mier mag tony, ma ngʼat moneko nyalo ringo mondo opondie. Ewi mago medgi mier piero angʼwen gariyo mamoko.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

kikuyu: Omiyo jopuonjre mamoko nokone niya, “Waseneno Ruoth!” To nowachonegi niya, “An to ka ok aneno lwete kuonde mane musmal ochwowo, mi aketo lith lweta kuondego, kendo asoyo lweta e ngʼetne, to ok abi yie wachno.”
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

kikuyu: Ne gin joma tekregi oserumo kendo manyap ma ok nyal timona gimoro amora.
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

kikuyu: Ne oriembo ogendini e nyimgi kendo nomiyogi lopgi kaka girkeni margi, mi nomiyo dhout Israel odak e miechgi giwegi.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Ne owuoyo kodgi e siro mar bor polo; negirito chikene gi buche mane omiyogi.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

kikuyu: wuod Serug, wuod Reu, wuod Peleg, wuod Eber, wuod Shela,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

kikuyu: Aa malo, yaye Nyasaye, ngʼadni piny bura, nimar ogendini duto gin girkeni magi.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Daudi noluongo Zadok kod Abiathar ma jodolo kod Uriel, Asaya, Joel, Shemaya, Eliel kod Aminadab ma ja-Lawi.
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

kikuyu: Un bende ne uwuotho e yoregi e ngimau machon mane udakie.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

kikuyu: Ruoth Nebukadneza notero jo-Jerusalem alufu apar e twech mane gin jodongo duto kod jolweny, gi joma olony e tich lwedo kod jogoro. Onge ngʼato mane odongʼ makmana joma odhier.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

kikuyu: Jo-Filistia noyaro ne lweny mondo orom gi jo-Israel, kendo lweny nolandore. Jo-Israel ne olo gi jo-Filistia mine ginego ji madirom alufu angʼwen e paw lweny.
english: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

kikuyu: Gik moko duto ne dhina maber, to koro osetieka; mi omaka gi ngʼuta kendo otura matindo tindo. Osechoma tir;
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

kikuyu: Musa jatichna osetho. Omiyo sani, in kod jogi duto, ikreuru mondo ungʼad Aora Jordan e piny makoro achiegni miyo jo-Israel.
english: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Abiro dwogogi kagologi e twech, mi aduokgi yo ka Malo mar Misri, e lop kweregi. Kanyo ginibedie mayom yom moloyo ogendini duto.
english: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

kikuyu: Kendo obiro bet ni: Kaka ji chalo e kaka jodolo bende chalo. To abiro kumogi kuom yoregigo, kendo anachulgi machal gi timbegi.
english: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno ruoth Ahasuerus nomiyo Esta mwandu mag Haman, jasik jo-Yahudi. Kendo Modekai nobiro e nyim ruoth, nimar Esta nosenyise ni en watne.
english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

kikuyu: Kane Sanbalat ma ja-Horon kod Tobia ja-Amon ma jatelo nowinjo ma, negibedo kod achiedh-nade ahinya ni ngʼato osebiro madwaro kelo dongruok ni jo-Israel.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura ni joma ni oko, omiyo riemburu jarichono oa e dieru.
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

kikuyu: Negipako Nyasaye gi wer ka gigoyo thum e nyim kar romo gi Nyasaye, e Hemb Romo nyaka Solomon notieko gero hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye Jerusalem. Negitiyo tijegi moluwore kod chike mane oketnegi.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: To gisano Saulo nogore moriere piny ka luoro omake nikech weche Samuel. Tekre norumo nikech ne pok ochiemo odiechiengʼ ngima gi otieno.
english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

kikuyu: Dwoka, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, dwoka mondo jogi ongʼe ni in Nyasaye, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ni iloko chunygi mondo oduog iri kendo.”
english: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

kikuyu: Un mon maparo ni odak e ngima maber, auru malo kendo uwinj wachna, un nyiri modak gi kwe, winjuru gima awacho!
english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

kikuyu: Eka Musa nokelo im mane ibiro timgo misango miwangʼo pep mar golo richo, kendo Harun kaachiel gi yawuote noyieyo lwetgi e wiye.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Gibiro wuoyo kuom duongʼni mangʼongo kendo marieny, to an abiro paro mos kuom tijeni miwuoro.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Samuel nonindo nyaka okinyi eka noyawo dhoudi mag od Jehova Nyasaye. Noluor wacho ne Eli fweny,
english: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the LORD’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

kikuyu: Bangʼe noketo kambi askeche e piny Edom duto, mi jo-Edom nobedo e bwo loch Daudi. Kamoro amora ma Daudi nodhiye Jehova Nyasaye nomiye loch.
english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Mad odiechiengno otim luoch kendo mudho mandiwa oime; boche polo mondo oume; kendo wangʼ chiengʼ otim mudho.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

kikuyu: Ji duto osebaro, giduto kaachiel gisedoko joma okethore; onge ngʼama timo maber, onge kata achiel.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
