kikuyu: “Farao owuon, kaachiel gi jolwenje duto biro nenogi kendo chunye nodwogi koneno ogandane duto mane onegi gi ligangla, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto osewacho.
english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Ne ok oyie mondo okaw Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye odhigo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Kar timo mano to nobaro motere e od Obed-Edom ja-Giti.
english: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Timbe mamoko mag loch Ahab kaachiel gi gik moko duto mane otimo, gi dala ruoth maduongʼ mane ogero mobawo gi lak liech kod mier mane ochielo gi ohinga, donge ondikgi e kitap rapar mar ruodhi Israel?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

kikuyu: Bende Gilead nigi anjawo? Joge gin joma nono! Bende gitimo misengini gi rwedhi, Gilgal? Kendegi mag misengini biro chalo, kaka kite modhurore e puodho mopur.
english: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

kikuyu: Ochalo gi ngʼat manogero ot, mane okunyo bur matut nyaka e lwanda kendo noketoe mise, kane koth ochwe ma pi opongʼo piny, apaka mogingore nogoyo odno to ne ok onyal yienge, nikech nogere motegno.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: To kelnauru omeru ma chogo mondo mi abed gadiera ni ok un okwach kich to un joma kare. Eka anaduoknu owadu kendo ulok ohala e pinyni.’ ”
english: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

kikuyu: Yesu nowachone niya, “Kawuono warruok osebiro e odni, nikech ngʼatni bende en nyakwar Ibrahim.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo Paulo gi Barnaba wuok e sinagogi, ji nokwayogi mondo gimed loso kuom wechegi chiengʼ Sabato moluwo mano.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

kikuyu: Nimar odiechiengʼ osechopo mondo otiek jo-Filistia duto, kendo gengʼo joma notony duto mane nyalo konyo Turo kod Sidon. Jehova Nyasaye ochiegni tieko jo-Filistia, jogo mane otony moa e dho nam mar Kaftor.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

kikuyu: Wuod dhano, aseketi jarito mar dhood Israel, omiyo winj wach ma awacho, kendo imigi siem ma amiyi.
english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

kikuyu: Ka Satan opogore kende owuon, ere kaka pinyruodhe nyalo chungo? Awacho kamano nikech uwacho ni ariembo jochiende gi teko Belzebub.
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

kikuyu: Yore osedongʼ nono, kendo onge jowuoth e yo. Winjruok osekethi mi joma nobedo joneno ok dew, kendo onge ngʼama omi luor.
english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

kikuyu: Ingʼeya sa ma abet piny nyaka sa ma aa malo; adier, ingʼeyo parona gi kuma bor.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

kikuyu: nimar un uwegi ok ema unuwuo, to Roho Maler mar Wuonu ema nowuo kokalo kuomu.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

kikuyu: Negiloso law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod gi dhahabu kod usi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro momin gi law mayom.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Kane pok ruoth otieko wuoyo, dwol noa e polo kawacho niya, “Yaye ruoth Nebukadneza gima biro timoreni en ni pinyruodhi osemayi.
english: While the word was in the king’s mouth, a voice came from the sky, saying, “O King Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken: ‘The kingdom has departed from you.

kikuyu: Elisha noduogo Gilgal kendo kech ne omako piny. Kane kanyakla mar jonabi obiro nene nowachone jatichne niya, “Ket agulu maduongʼ mondo ilos kado ne jowetegi.”
english: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Liete nomuoch moyawore kendo ringre jomaler mangʼeny mane osetho nochier modoko mangima.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

kikuyu: Miya rieko mondo eka arit chikeni kendo atim kaka owacho gi chunya duto.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo Solomon rieko mana kaka nosesingorene. Ne nitie winjruok mar kwe e kind Hiram kod Solomon kendo gin ji ariyogo negitimo singruok e kindgi.
english: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

kikuyu: Erasto nodongʼ Korintho to Trofimo to naweyo ka tuo Mileto.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

kikuyu: To negidwoko wuon-gi niya, “Bende en gima ber mondo timne nyaminwa tim marach mane otimne cha?”
english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

kikuyu: Jowete, ok wadwar mondo ubed ka ukia, kaka ne waneno masiche mapek e piny Asia. Ne oyie kuomwa masiche madongo kendo mapek moingowa tingʼo mine wajok gibedo mangima.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

kikuyu: Donge ne waduogonu kata mana pesa mane wayudo e ogundewa kane waa e piny Kanaan. Koro ere gima dimi wakwal fedha kata dhahabu e od ruodhi?
english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

kikuyu: Ruoth nowachone Esta ma mikache niya, “Jo-Yahudi osenego ji mia abich motieko gi yawuot Haman apar ei ohinga mar Susa kende. To koro kare gisetimo angʼo e gwenge man e pinyruoth? Sani to koro angʼo kendo midwaro mondo atimni? Kwayoni en angʼo? Mano bende ibiro miyi.”
english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

kikuyu: Adama, Rama, Hazor,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

kikuyu: Kane oyudo owuotho odhi, noneno ngʼat moro mane osebedo muofu nyaka aa nywolne.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyako mokendo nyaka bed nyako ngili.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

kikuyu: “Wuogi idhiyo e dala maduongʼ mar Nineve, mondo iyalne kisieme nikech timbene mamono osechopo e nyima.”
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

kikuyu: E kinde ma uchwoyo e higa mar aboro to unubed mana kapod uchamo cham machon nyaka chop ubed gi keyo e higa mar ochiko.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

kikuyu: makmana nitie Nyasaye moro e polo mafwenyo tiend midhierni. Osenyiso ruoth Nebukadneza gik mabiro timore ndalo mabiro. Lekni kod fweny duto mane obiro e pachi kane inindo e kitandani e magi:
english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:

kikuyu: olosu udok makare chuth, kutimo timbe mabeyo duto mondo eka utim dwarone. Mad oloswa mi wachal kaka odwaro, kuom Yesu Kristo, monego oyud duongʼ nyaka chiengʼ! Amin.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nonywolo owadgi miluongi ni Abel. Abel ne en jakwadh jamni to Kain ne en japur.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

kikuyu: “Angʼo momiyo ineno ngʼinjo mar buch yath manie wangʼ wadu to pilni maduongʼ mar yath manie wangʼi iwuon to ok idew?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Yawuot Jaflet ne gin: Pasak, Bimhal kod Ashvath. Magi ne yawuot Jaflet.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

kikuyu: Japur chwoyo kodhi ma en Wach.
english: The farmer sows the word.

kikuyu: Irido tiendena gi nyororo; kendo iluwo bangʼa e yorena maluwo duto, koketo kido e bwo tienda mondo onyis kamoro amora maluwo.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

kikuyu: kuom mano abiro moko mach e ohinga mag Raba kendo abiro wangʼo kuonde mochiel motegno mag dalano. Mahu nowinjre chiengʼ kedo kendo lweny nobed mager.
english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;

kikuyu: werneuru gi turumbete kod tung im maywak matek, koguru gi mor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Ruoth.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

kikuyu: Ma e richo mantiere kuom gimoro amora matimore e piny: Giko machalre choponegi duto. Kata kamano, chuny dhano opongʼ gi richo kendo nitie neko e pachgi e kinde ma gingima, to bangʼe to giriwore gi joma otho.
english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

kikuyu: Mad Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo owuon kod Nyasaye Wuonwa, ma noherowa momiyowa jip mosiko kod geno maber, kuom ngʼwonone,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

kikuyu: Chike mag Jehova Nyasaye nikare, gichiwo mor ne chuny. Chike mag Jehova Nyasaye rieny, gichiwo ler ne wangʼ.
english: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

kikuyu: An Daniel kenda ema naneno fwenyno joma ne ni koda to ne ok onene, kata kamano luoro maduongʼ nomakogi mi negitony gi ngʼwech mi gipondo.
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

kikuyu: To kane gichopo ei kar dino mar Kidon, Uza norieyo bade mondo osir Sandug Muma mane dhi podho nikech rwedhi mane ywayo gari notangni.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

kikuyu: To ubiro ngʼado loka Jordan mondo udagi e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka girkeni mi enomiu yweyo e lwet wasiku moluorou, mondo udagi gi kwe.
english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

kikuyu: kendo jopinje mamoko biro ira kobolore, ka awuoyo to giwinja kendo gitimo gima adwaro.
english: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

kikuyu: Maluwe ne en Shama wuod Agee ma ja-Harar. Kane jo-Filistia ochokore kama ne nitie puoth ngʼor, jo-Israel noringogi.
english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

kikuyu: Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi sheminith. Zaburi mar Daudi. Kony ji yaye Jehova Nyasaye, nikech joma oluoro Nyasaye koro onge; joma jo-adiera oserumo e dier ji.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

kikuyu: to Abidan wuod Gideoni notelo ne dhood Benjamin.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

kikuyu: To Lawi noa malo, moweyo gik moko duto kendo noluwe.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

kikuyu: Jomoko ne dwaro make, to onge ngʼama noketo lwete kuome.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

kikuyu: Oganda duto nodwoko kanyakla kawacho niya, “Wabiro timo gik moko duto ma Jehova Nyasaye ochiko.” Kuom mano Musa nodwoko wachgi ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kane Daudi osewuotho matin koa ewi got, noyudo Ziba jarit mwandu mag Mefibosheth, karite mondo oromne. Ne osembo punde bwora motingʼo makati mia ariyo, gi olemb mzabibu mongʼin mag makati mia achiel gi olemb ngʼowu mongʼin bende mia achiel kod divai mool e dende.
english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

kikuyu: Wanatongʼ yiend Lebanon moromo kaka idwaro kendo nwatwegi kanyakla ma wakwangʼ-gi e nam nyaka Jopa, eka iniomgi mitergi Jerusalem.”
english: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Bangʼe nokelo wiye koketo e san kendo nomi nyakono, mane otingʼe otere ne min mare.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

kikuyu: Nimar kitene beyo gi lala ne jotichni, kata mana buru madum kuome miyo ji keche.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Balak wuod Zipor noneno gigo duto mane jo-Israel osetimo ni jo-Amor,
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

kikuyu: To nee, Jehova Nyasaye biro gi mach, kendo gechene mag lweny chalo ka kalausi; obiro kelo mirimbe makakni, kendo chwat mare nopilre ka mach.
english: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

kikuyu: Kane Petro pod paro kuom fweny mane oneno, Roho Maler nowachone niya, “Simon, welo moko adek dwari.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye osegwedho ruodha ahinya kendo osebedo jamoko. Osemiye rombe kod dhok, fedha kod dhahabu, jotich machwo kod mamon gi ngamia kod punde.
english: The LORD has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. The LORD has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

kikuyu: Ligangla mar Jehova Nyasaye opongʼ gi remo, kendo boche ogawore kuome ma gin, remb rombe kod diek, kaachiel gi boche moa e nyiroke mag imbe. Nimar Jehova Nyasaye nigi misango Bozra kod nek ei Edom.
english: The LORD’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Yor ongo e kor polo, yor thuol e kor lwanda, yor yie ei nam mogingore kod yor ngʼama wuowi gi nyako.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

kikuyu: Agombo dak e hembi nyaka chiengʼ mondo apondie e raum mar bwombeni. Sela
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, jo-Israel chalo gi chokegi. Giwacho ni, ‘Chokewa otwo kendo genowa orumo; osengʼad karwa oko.’
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo en bende nyaka ochiw misango ni richone owuon, kaachiel gi richo mag oganda bende.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

kikuyu: Jotend Juda gi Jerusalem, jotelo mag agola, jodolo kod ji duto mag pinyni mane owuotho e kind lemo ariyogo,
english: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji adekgi noweyo dwokore gi Ayub, nikech noparo ni en ngʼama kare.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

kikuyu: mondo omi ogor kido mabeyo mag dhahabu gi fedha kod mula,
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

kikuyu: Humbe nolandore e piny Siria duto, kendo ji nokelone joma ne tuo gi kit tuoche mayoreyore gi joma ne nigi rem mapek gi joma ne nigi jochiende gi joma ne chunygi yudhore kod joma ne nigi athany, mi nochangogi.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

kikuyu: Ji ne luwe nikech kinde mathoth nosemako dho ji gi timbene mag jwok.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

kikuyu: Kapo ni en adier ni asebaro mabor, to mano obadhou gangʼo.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

kikuyu: Kwaru mokwongo notimo richo; kendo jotendu nongʼanyona.
english: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

kikuyu: Eka nowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru mondo udwany hekalu kendo pongʼuru laru mage gi ringre joma onegi. Dhiuru!” Omiyo ne giwuok mi gidhi kendo negichako nego ji e dalano duto.
english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

kikuyu: Pile ka pile an kodu e laru mag hekalu, to ne ok umaka. To mani en sau, sa ma mudho olocho.”
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

kikuyu: We amed bedo mangima mondo apaki, kendo mad chikeni okonya.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

kikuyu: Kata mana piny bende nobedo mogak, omiyo ne akumogi nikech richo mag-gi, kendo piny nongʼogo joma nodakie iye.
english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

kikuyu: Ruoth ne nigi yiedhi mangʼeny mag ohala mane jo-Hiram kwangʼ-go. Dichiel bangʼ higni adek ka higni adek negidwogo ka gitingʼo dhahabu gi fedha gi leke liech gi ongʼeche kod bimbe.
english: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

kikuyu: Omiyo tiendena bedo mayot ka tiende mwanda; kendo en ema omiyo achungʼ kuonde man malo maboyo.
english: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

kikuyu: Chi wuode, ma jaod Finehas, ne nigi ich mochiegni nywol. To kane owinjo wach ni Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye osekaw kendo ni kwar mare gi chwore osetho, muoch nochako kaye mi nonywol, kata kamano nywolne nobiro marach.
english: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.

kikuyu: Petro nowachone niya, “Wan waseweyo gik moko duto mane wan-go mondo waluwi!”
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

kikuyu: Fedha mothedhi ikelo koa Tarshish kendo dhahabu koa Ufaz. Gima japecho kod jatheth oseloso irwako gi lewni marambulu gi maralik, giduto olosgi gi jotich molony.
english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.

kikuyu: Omiyo Nyasacha noketo wachno e chunya mondo achok joka ruoth, jotelo, to gi oganda duto mondo ndik nying-gi dala ka dala. Ne ayudo kitabu mondikie nying joma nokwongo duogo. Ma e gima ne ayudo kondiki kanyo:
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

kikuyu: Jangʼwech achiel luwo bangʼ machielo kendo jaote luwo bangʼ jaote machielo, mondo olandne ruodh Babulon ni dalane maduongʼ mangima osemaki,
english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.

kikuyu: Wuon nyako nowach ne jodongo niya, “Ne achiwo nyara e kend ne ngʼatni to ok ohere.
english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

kikuyu: Kinde moro amora mane Musa odhi oko e Hema to ji duto ne wuok kendo chungʼ e dhoutgi mag hema ka gingʼiyo Musa nyaka chop odonji.
english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, ma en ngero manade ma ugoyo e piny Israel ni, ‘Ndalo dhi adhiya, to pok wasenene fweny moro amora kotimore?’
english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

kikuyu: Nyasachwa ni e polo; otimo gimoro amora mohero.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

kikuyu: Bende nobawo dier udi maiye gi ma oko gi dhahabu.
english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ne aneno ni ber mondo ajiw owetegi mondo olimu chon mondo utiek chenro duto mag chiwo mag ngʼwono mane usesingoru ni ubiro chiwo. Kamano, ka abiro to anayud ka chiwo maru mar ngʼwono oikore, kendo mano nonyis ni uchiwe gi ngʼwono, to ok kuom achuna.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

kikuyu: To kik ichak iwach kendo ni, ‘wach mar Jehova Nyasaye,’ nikech wach ngʼato ka ngʼato owuon ema bedone wach maber bangʼe ijaro weche Nyasaye mangima, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasachwa.
english: You will mention the message from the LORD no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of Armies, our God.

kikuyu: Negitingʼo ringre Asahel mi giike e liend wuon-gi e Bethlehem. Eka Joab gi joge nowuotho otieno duto mi gichopo Hebron ka piny yawore.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

kikuyu: Hana ne odwoke niya, Ok kamano ruodha. An mana dhako man-gi lit ahinya. Ok asebedo kamadho kongʼo kata gik mamero ji, to achiwo chunya ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.

kikuyu: Eka noketo lwetene kuome, to gikanyono noriere tir kendo nopako Nyasaye.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

kikuyu: “To ngʼat matero diend bungu e pap nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre; eka bangʼe to onyalo donjo ei kambi.
english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

kikuyu: Ne owite e Bur Matut Maonge gikone, kendo nolorone modinone e iye, mondo kik ochak owuond ogendini mag pinje ngangʼ nyaka higni alufu achielgo rum. To bangʼe nogonye mondo obed thuolo kuom kinde matin.
english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

kikuyu: Ne akeyogi e dier ogendini, kendo negidak e kind ogendini mopogore opogore. Ne angʼadonegi bura kaluwore gi yoregi kod timbegi mamono.
english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

kikuyu: Hezron ne en wuon Ram, Ram ne en wuon Aminadab,
english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,

kikuyu: “To sani koro gijara, kata obedo ni gin jomatindo ahinya kuoma, ma kata mana wuonegi ne ok anyal yienegi kata mana konyo guogi rito jamba.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

kikuyu: Nikech timbe maricho nomedre, hera mar ji mangʼeny nodok mangʼich,
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne joka Juda; ma kar kwan-gi ne romo ji alufu piero abiriyo gauchiel gi mia abich (76,500).
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Jadolo onego puonj joga pogruok manie kind gik maler mowal kod gik moko amoka moriwo ji duto, kendo nyaka ginyisgi kaka ginyalo pogo kind gik mochido gi gik mopwodhi.
english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne yawuot Etam: Jezreel, Ishma kod Idbash, to nyamin-gi niluongo ni Hazelelponi.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

kikuyu: Ma e gima notimore e ndalo loch Ahasuerus, e kinde mane orito pinje mia achiel gi piero ariyo gabiriyo chakre India nyaka Kush.
english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

kikuyu: Ka kindene mar tich norumo, nodok dala.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

kikuyu: Nikech kuyo kod ywak omona chiemo; kendo chur ma achurgo chalo gi oula mabubni.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

kikuyu: Nitie ngʼat moro e pinyruodhi ka ma chuny mar nyiseche maler ni kuome. E kinde mag loch wuonu, noyud ni en gi paro matut, gi ngʼeyo kod rieko machalo gi mago mag nyiseche. Ruoth Nebukadneza ma wuonu, nokete jatelo maduongʼ mar ajuoke, jokor wach, joma riek mag jo-Kaldea kod jo-nyakalondo.”
english: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father, light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king, Nebuchadnezzar, your father—yes, the king, your father—made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers,

kikuyu: Elisha notho moike. E ndalogo jolwenj Moab nohero monjo pinyno e ndalo mag chwiri.
english: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

kikuyu: Kata mana kawuononi mond jodong Pasia gi Media ma owinjo tim ma mikachi otimo biro mana timo ne jodong ruoth tim machal gi mano. Achaya gi ich wangʼ biro dhi nyime maonge gikone.
english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

kikuyu: Eka ngʼat moro machalo dhano nomulo dhoga, mi nayawo dhoga kendo nachako wuoyo. Ne awachone ngʼama nochungʼ e nyima niya, “Ruodha, chandruok oromo chunya nikech fweny ma aseneno, kendo anyosora marumo.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.

kikuyu: Ne gilonye duk, negikawo yawuote gi nyige gidhigo, kendo neginege gi ligangla. Nolokre ngero e kind mon wetene, kendo nonwangʼo kum mowinjore kode.
english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.

kikuyu: Ka achako agero gik mane amuko, to mano nyiso malongʼo ni an jaketh chik.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

kikuyu: un mutiyo e od Jehova Nyasaye, e laru mag od Nyasachwa.
english: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ, chakre odiechiengʼ mokwongo nyaka mogik, Ezra ne somo Kitap Chik mar Nyasaye. Negitimo nyasini kuom ndalo abiriyo, to chiengʼ mar aboro, kaluwore gi chik, ne nitiere chokruok mar kanyakla.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mar aboro Musa noluongo Harun gi yawuote kaachiel gi jodong Israel.
english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Ooyo wuoda.” Waduto ok onego wabi, wabiro miyi tingʼ mapek. Kata obedo ni Abisalom nomedo hombe, to pod nodagi dhi, makmana ne oyiene ni odhi nyime gi nyasino.
english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

kikuyu: Kik idwok ngʼat mofuwo machalre gi fupe, to dipo ka ibiro bedo machal kode.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

kikuyu: Jolweny duto noduogo ir Joshua e kambi man Makeda maonge hinyruok moro, kendo onge ngʼama nowuoyo marach kuom jo-Israel.
english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Bangʼe nochiwo chik kowacho niya, “Ngʼaduru nyathi mangimano e diere ariyo eka umi ngʼato ka ngʼato nus.”
english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

kikuyu: Eka Daudi nongʼado modhi loka machielo mochungʼ ewi got kuma bor; ne odhi mochwalore kodgi; ne nitie thuolo malach e kindgi.
english: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;

kikuyu: Eka Judas Iskariot, mane en achiel kuom jopuonjrene apar gariyo, nodhi ir jodolo madongo mondo ondhog Yesu oket e lwetgi.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo ni koda ka gik malongʼo chuth nigi gikogi, to chikeni onge gikogi.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

kikuyu: Ne nitie ngʼat moro ma ja-Farisai ma nyinge Nikodemo, ne en achiel kuom jobuch jo-Yahudi.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo nojuk chiwo mar cham mopongʼo lwete kaka chiwo mar rapar kendo nowangʼe ewi kendo mar misango; bangʼ mano, noket dhakono omodh pigno.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

kikuyu: Nondiko jotingʼ gik moko ji alufu piero abiriyo (70,000) gi jopa kite e got ji alufu piero aboro (80,000) kod nyipeche alufu adek gi mia auchiel (3,600).
english: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼno noketo jo-Gibeon obedo jobar yien gi joumb pi ni jo-Israel duto kendo ni tich kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye kama Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero. Kendo mano e gima gin nyaka chil kawuono.
english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for the LORD’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.

kikuyu: Dhako moro ma nyare matin ne nigi jachien marach ka nowinjo ni Yesu kanyo nodhi ire gisano mi ogoyo chonge piny e nyime.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

kikuyu: “To koro en angʼo manenoni? “Joga okaw nono maonge gima ochul kendo joma tiyogi koro goyonegi siboi,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho. “Kendo kinde duto giyanyo nyinga.
english: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says the LORD, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says the LORD, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

kikuyu: kod jotich kaachiel kodgi, mane dhi nyime kod tich mar hekalu. Giduto ne gin ji mia aboro gi piero ariyo gariyo (822). Ne nitiere bende Adaya wuod Jeroham, wuod Pelalia, wuod Amzi, wuod Zekaria, wuod Pashur, wuod Malkija,
english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

kikuyu: Bi, wadhi wayud mor mar hera nyaka piny ru, mondo wabed mamor ka wawinjo maber e hera!
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

kikuyu: “Ngʼat mane nigi talanta ariyo bende nobiro, mowacho ni, ‘Ruodh, ne imiya talanta ariyo, to neye, aseloso ariyo mamoko.’
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: Ka ndalo mag ywak noserumo, Josef nowuoyo gi jood Farao niya, “Ka unyalo timona ngʼwono, to nyisnauru Farao niya,
english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

kikuyu: Kar romb joka Simeon ne gin ji alufu piero abich gochiko gi mia adek (59,300).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Paulo nongʼiyo wach jobuch jo-Sanhedrin tir eka nowachonegi niya, “Owetena, asetimo tich mane Nyasaye omiya mondo atim gi chuny maler maonge ketho nyaka chil kawuono.”
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

kikuyu: Elkana chwore ne owachone niya, “Tim kaka ineno ni berni. Rit nyaka nyathi we dhoth kendo mad Jehova Nyasaye kende ema chop wachne.” Omiyo dhakoni nobet dala kodhodho wuode nyaka noweyo dhodhe.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may the LORD establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.

kikuyu: Ka Mahalalel ne ja-higni piero auchiel gabich, nonywolo Jared.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Piny mangima ibiro kethi, kata kamano ok nakethe chutho.
english: For the LORD says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.

kikuyu: Joma osiko timo richo nyaka kwer ratiro e nyim ji eka joma moko obed maluor.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

kikuyu: In ema iber moloyo chwo mamoko kendo dhogi owir gi ngʼwono, nikech Nyasaye osegwedhi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

kikuyu: Wach Kristo mondo odagi e chunyu gi nyak duto mokelo, kupuonjoru kendo usiemoru ngʼato gi ngʼato gi rieko duto, kendo kupako Nyasaye gi wende zaburi kwero wende kitabu kod wende chuny ka ugoyo ni Nyasaye erokamano e chunyu.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

kikuyu: Eka jatedo nokawo em gi sembe moketo e nyim Saulo. Samuel nowacho niya, “Ma e gima nokan-ni, cham, nikech nokan-nigo ne nyasini, chakre e kinde mane aluongoe welo.” Eka Saulo nochiemo gi Samuel chiengʼno.
english: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye, asewinjo humbi; achungʼ e nyimi ka an-gi luoro kuom gik misetimo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye. Mad itimgi kendo e kindewa, mi gingʼere e ndalowani; ka in gi mirima to mad ipar ngʼwono.
english: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

kikuyu: Jo-Benjamin, kata kamano, ne ok nyal loyo jo-Jebus, mane odak Jerusalem; nyaka kawuononi jo-Jebus pod odak kanyo gi jo-Benjamin.
english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

kikuyu: Bende kik uluong ngʼato angʼata e piny-ka ni ‘Baba,’ nimar un gi Wuoro achiel kende, kendo en e polo.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ngʼatno nyaka negi. Chokruok duto nyaka chiele gi kite e oko mar kambi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

kikuyu: Gik mamonogo kik yud e lwetu eka mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye norum, mi notimnu ngʼwono kendo ununyaa kaka nosingore ne kwereu.
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

kikuyu: Kendo ngʼato angʼata mowacho wach moro marach kuom Wuod Dhano nowene, to ngʼato angʼata ma yanyo Roho Maler ok nowene richone.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

kikuyu: To isewuotho e yore mag ruodhi mag Israel, omiyo isemiyo jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem oseweyo luwa mana kaka dhood Ahab notimo. Bende isenego oweteni monywoligo ma nyithind wuonu hie, joma ne ber moloyi.
english: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka non kama opurno kendo oket gik mopurgo tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

kikuyu: Ka Gideon nowinjo lekno kod kaka oloke, nopako Nyasaye. Nodok e kambi jo-Israel kendo owacho niya, “Chungʼuru malo! Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo jo-Midian e lwetu.”
english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

kikuyu: To joga wigi osewil koda, giwangʼo ubani ne nyiseche mopa manono, manomiyo gichwanyore e yoregi kendo e yore matindo machon. Giseketogi gi wuotho e yore matindo mogondore, kendo e yore ma ok opa.
english: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,

kikuyu: Wamiyo Nyasaye duongʼ kuom gik ma opando; to lero tiend weche en duongʼ ni ruodhi.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kikuyu: Isemiyo wadoko joma iyanyo e dier joma odak butwa, wan joma inyiero kendo ma ocha gi joma olworowa.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Isemaya osiepena gi joherana; mudho mandiwa ema koro odongʼ machiegni koda kaka osiepna.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ne ok gidewo wachno, mi gichako dhi malo e piny got, to Musa kata Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ne ok owuok e kambi.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

kikuyu: wuod Ethan, wuod Zima, wuod Shimei
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom chiwo mar kwongʼruok kod chiwo mar hera, losneuru Jehova Nyasaye sewni moyier kaka: misango miwangʼo pep, chiwo mag cham, misango miolo piny kod chiwo mag lalruok.’ ”
english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

kikuyu: Kaka lek biro ka nitie paro mathoth, e kaka weche mar ngʼama ofuwo bedo nikech weche mangʼeny.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

kikuyu: E Moab anatiek jogo matimo misengini e kuonde motingʼore gi malo, kendo ma wangʼo ubani ne nyisechegi,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

kikuyu: Joka Jakobo duto mane odhi Misri ne gin ji piero abiriyo koriwore gi yawuowi ariyo mane Josef onywolo Misri.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

kikuyu: “Joma chandore kendo joma odhier manyo pi, to ok gininwangʼ, omiyo dwondgi otwo nikech riyo ohingogi. To an Jehova Nyasaye abiro resogi; An, ma an Nyasach Israel ok anajwangʼ-gi.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Yahudi moko nobiro koa Antiokia kod Ikonio mi gisemo ji odoknigi. Negigoyo Paulo gi kite mi giywaye e lowo nyaka oko mar dala, ka giparo ni osetho.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

kikuyu: Barzilai ja-Gilead bende nobiro koa Rogelim mondo ongʼad Jordan gi ruoth kendo okowe oweye kodhi.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Nimar obiro konyo joma ochando maywagore, jogo modhier maonge gi jakony.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

kikuyu: Negitimo mano mi gioro Barnaba gi Saulo jotero konygigo ne jodong kanisa.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

kikuyu: Ne giwilo Duongʼ margi gi kido mar rwath machamo lum.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Jokedo magi biro bedo gi chuny moikore; gibiro riedo gokinyi kogwen gi duongʼ mamalo, kendo tekri nomedre odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ mana ka tho momoko e lum gokinyi.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

kikuyu: Yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Sibuoche maruto makidho le ma gisemako ongʼamo dhogi malach ka dwaro kidha.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

kikuyu: Kata jadir asere ok noyud thuolo mar ringo, kendo jangʼwech ma jalweny ok noresre, kaachiel gi jalweny moidho faras bende ok notony.
english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.

kikuyu: Ka jopuonjre noneno mano, ne gisin, mi giwacho niya, “Morni iketho malit kayiem nangʼo?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone jotelo duto kod ji duto niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ne oora mondo akor kuom odni kod dala maduongʼni gigo duto musewinjo.
english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

kikuyu: Ne iwacho e chunyi niya, “Abiro idho e polo; abiro guro lochna malo moyombo sulwe mag Nyasaye; kendo anabed e kom duongʼ, ewi got mar chokruok, mantiere malo mogik mar got maler.
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

kikuyu: “Chokreuru un duto mondo uwinji: Ere kata achiel kuom nyiseche manono mosehulo gima biro timore? Oganda ma osiep Jehova Nyasaye ema nokel kum mare kuom Babulon; mirimbe nobed kuom jo-Babulon.
english: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Chutho, jogi ne oa irwa to ne ok gin jowa. Nikech ka dine gin jowa to dine gisiko kodwa, nimar dhigino nyiso malongʼo ni onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomgi mane ngʼatwa.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Ne ni ok inyiso ngʼato wachni. To dhiyo mondo inyisri ne jadolo, kendo ichiw mich ma Musa nochiko, mondo obed ranyisi ne gin.”
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Nikech Wuod Dhano nobiro mondo omany kendo owar jogo manolal.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kikuyu: Gideon nooro joote e piny gode mag Efraim duto, kowacho, “Biuru uked kod jo-Midian kendo udhi nyimgi ma umak pige mag Jordan mochopo nyaka Beth Bara.” Omiyo jo-Efraim duto nowuok oko kendo negikawo pige mag Jordan mochopo Beth Bara.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

kikuyu: Timbene ne richoe moloyo koluwo bangʼ nyiseche mamoko, mana kaka jo-Amor mane Jehova Nyasaye oriembo e nyim jo-Israel.
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Paa kite ariyo machal gi mane okwongo ka kendo anandikie weche mane ni e kite mokwongo mane itoyo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, cham weche mamiyi mondik e kalatasni, mondo ipongʼ-go iyi.” Omiyo ne achame, kendo ne omit ka mor kich e dhoga.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki ni, “Nikech in, tho ochomowa odiechiengʼ duto; ikwanowa kaka rombo mitero kar yengʼo.”
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo mano, ne gitemo mondo gimake, to onge ngʼama notemo mule gi lwete, nikech kindene ne pok ochopo.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Donge ondiki e chiku ni, ‘Ne awacho ni un “nyiseche” ’?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

kikuyu: Moloyo mano, Solomon osebedo e kome mar ruoth.
english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywol Nowa, Lamek nodak higni mia abich gi piero ochiko gi abich kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri moko.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Tongʼu man yo nyandwat nochakre e dho Nam Mediterania nyaka e Got Hor
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: to kotimo tim marach e nyima kendo ok oluora, to anapar kendo kuom ber mane asechano mar timone.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.

kikuyu: Isakar, Zebulun kod Benjamin;
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

kikuyu: Ok en Nyasach joma otho, to en Nyasach joma ngima. Urwenyo mabor!”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano jaduongʼ mar od twech noketo Josef jatend joma otwe duto e od twech kendo Josef ema norito gik moko duto mane itimo kanyo.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosedhi e polo kendo olor piny? En ngʼa mosechoko yamo moketo ei lwete? En ngʼa mosechoko pi gi lawe kata mosepimo giko mar tungʼ piny? Nyinge to en ngʼa, koso wuode to nyinge ngʼa? Nyisa ane ka ingʼeyo!
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

kikuyu: Ruoth wacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼato achiel nobi machalo gi Tabor e dier gode, kata ka Got Karmel mantie but nam.
english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

kikuyu: Abiro kumo piny kuom timbene mamono, joricho kuom richogi. Abiro tieko wich teko ka mar josunga kendo abiro thiro sunga mar joma wangʼ-gi tek.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

kikuyu: Ka isepiem gi jogo mawuotho gi tielo ma gioli, to ere kaka inyalo piem gi farese? Ka ichwanyori e piny man-gi kwe, ere kaka inyalo wuotho e bungu man Jordan?
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

kikuyu: Landuru lemo gi riyo kech maler kendo luonguru chokruok maler. Chokuru jodongo kod ji duto modakie piny, mondo gibi e od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mondo giywagre ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.

kikuyu: achiel nochiw kaka misango mar golo richo, to machielo to notimgo misango miwangʼo pep, kaachiel gi misango mar cham. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodh ngʼatno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”

kikuyu: E kindeno ne nitiere ngʼato Jerusalem miluongo ni Simeon, ne en ngʼat makare kendo moluoro Nyasaye. Norito loch mar Israel, kendo Roho Maler neni kuome.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

kikuyu: Kinyne jo-Israel nowuok kendo ne gibworo but Gibea.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

kikuyu: Adiera lamo nyiseche mopa ewi gode matindo, kod gode madongo en wuond; adier kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa, ema warruok mar Israel yudore.
english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.

kikuyu: To ka chiengʼ nowuok, chamgo nowangʼ kendo nikech ne gionge tiendegi, ne gitwo.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: To ne ok ayie gigo mane giwacho nyaka nabiro maneno gi wangʼa awuon. Adier kata mana nus wechego ne ok onyisa; kuom rieko gi mwandu iloyo weche ma asewinjo.
english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruoth mar Nyandwat nobi mi noger kuonde goyo agengʼa kendo ginikaw dala moro mochiel motegno. Jokedo mag Milambo ok nobed gi teko mar sirogi, kata mana jolwenjgi mabeyo mogik ok nobed gi teko mar siro lweny.
english: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.

kikuyu: Daudi noyudo osekendo Ahinoam ma nyar Jezreel, to giduto ne gin mond Daudi.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

kikuyu: Kendo ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechiwo gi e lwetu mi uloyogi, to une ni utiekogi duto. Kik ulos winjruok kodgi bende kik utimnegi ngʼwono.
english: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokecho gi jo-Israel kendo nomiyo giwuotho alanda e thim kuom higni piero angʼwen, nyaka ogandani duto mane otimo marach e nyim Jehova Nyasaye notho.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro oronu kwongʼ, ngʼengʼ kod achaya e gimoro amora ma utimo, nyaka urum chuth makaru lal nono nikech richo ma usetimo ma ujwangʼe.
english: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

kikuyu: Kar romb dhood Benjamin ne gin ji alufu piero adek gabich gi mia angʼwen (35,400).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: kendo miyo idak e ngima moritore kendo mobidhore kitimo gima adiera kendo gima kare kendo mowinjore,
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kikuyu: Kane oketho kido mar abich, ne aneno chunje jomoko mane osenegi ka nitie e bwo kendo mar misango nikech Wach Nyasaye kendo nikech neno mane gisiko gihulo.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

kikuyu: To ka Sanbalat ma ja-Horon, Tobia ma jatend jo-Amon kod Geshem ma ja-Arabu nowinjo wach gedoni, ne gijarowa kendo buonowa ka gipenjo niya, “Angʼo ma utimoni? Dibed ni ungʼanyo ne ruoth?”
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

kikuyu: To Bangʼ yala, negidwaro weya, nikech negiyudo ni aonge gi ketho mowinjore gi tho.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

kikuyu: Jodonge nowinjore mondo ondhoge mi onege e Beth Milo, e yo madhi mwalo Sila.
english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

kikuyu: “Harun nyaka wangʼ ubani mangʼwe ngʼar e kendono mar misango okinyi kokinyi koiko teyni.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

kikuyu: Kata ka ochopo kinde ma ati kendo wiya oselokore lwar, to kik iweya, yaye Nyasaye, nyaka ahul tekoni ni tienge mabiro, kendo ahul timbeni madongo ni tienge duto mabiro.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya nowacho niya, “Swag ngʼowu.” Negitimo kamano mi gimuone kama ne bur okuodono, bangʼe nochango.
english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

kikuyu: En ema oketho mier mochiel motegno kendo omuko ohinga mag dala.
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel noa Gilgal modhi Gibea e piny Benjamin, kendo Saulo nokwano joma ne ni kode mine oyudo ni gin ji madirom mia auchiel.
english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

kikuyu: Manase nonywolo Amon, Amon nonywolo Josia.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye tiyo kodwa kaka tik mamit mar Kristo e kind joma iwaro kod joma lal.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

kikuyu: Nyasaye en Roho, omiyo joma lame nyaka lame e yo ma Roho dwaro kendo gadiera.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

kikuyu: Eka janabi nogolo kilemba mane ogengʼogo wangʼe mi ruodh jo-Israel nofwenye kaka achiel kuom jonabi.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

kikuyu: Chiwuru magi kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile gokinyi.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ruoth Nyasaye biro kelo adhonde ewi mond Sayun, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomi timbegi mamono nenre ratiro.”
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

kikuyu: “Ne akelonu tuoche mag buche machal gi mane akelo ni jo-Misri. Ne anego yawuotu mangʼeny kod ligangla kaachiel gi fareseu mag lweny. Bende ne amiyo tik marach mar joma otho othingʼou e kuondeu mag bworo, to kata kuom mago duto pod ne utamoru duoga ira,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo kawogi mi idwokgi kuondegi? Bende ingʼeyo yo midhigo miechgi?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ma ok agolo e tich mar kendona mar misango anawe mondo omi wengeu opongʼ gi pi wangʼ kendo mondo omi chunyu lit, to ogandani duto to notho kapod gin jomatindo.
english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

kikuyu: Baw sirnigo gi dhahabu kendo los ratege mag dhahabu mondo omak raidhi miriwogo. Bende baw raidhigo gi dhahabu.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Harun nodwokogi niya, “Kawuru sitadi mag dhahabu ma yawuotu kod nyiu orwako mondo ukelna.”
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

kikuyu: Joma norwako weche Petro ne obatisi, kendo chiengʼno ji alufu adek nomedore e kwan mar joma oyie kuom Kristo.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

kikuyu: Yesu nochopo kar liel ka chunye nigi kuyo maduongʼ moloyo. Ne en rogo, kendo noyie kidi e dhoge.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kikuyu: “Jatwengʼo molony ema nyaka los law akor mar ngʼado bura, kolose gi dhahabu gi usi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro kod law mayom mar katana kendo momin maber ka law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat ne ja-higni piero adek gabich kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gabich. Min mare ne nyinge Azuba nyar Shilhi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ mano nochako yalo Injili e sinagoke, kowacho ni Yesu en Wuod Nyasaye.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: gi ogwe gi kalagwena gi olele gi obongo-bongo kod ongʼongruok.
english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

kikuyu: Owacho, ‘Anagerne an owuon kar dak mara maduongʼ ka en-gi ute mamalo malach.’ Omiyo oloso dirisni malach kuome, olwore gi fito mar yiend sida, kendo obuke gi range marakwaro.
english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.

kikuyu: Negigolo gigo koa e hema, mi gikelogi ni Joshua kod jo-Israel duto kendo gipedhogi oko e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before the LORD.

kikuyu: Negiweyo chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi magiloso nyiseche ariyo molos e kido mar nyaroya kendo machalo gi siro mar Ashera. Negikulore ne nyisechegi giwegi ma gilamo Baal.
english: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

kikuyu: Neuru, apaka mar Jehova Nyasaye biro mwomore gi mirimbe, yamo mafuto malich ka futo e wiye joma timbegi mono.
english: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma ok oyie kuom Kristo ogweli e chiemo, kendo ihero dhi, to cham gimoro amora moketi e nyimi ma ok ichich gi penjo mathoth e chunyi.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

kikuyu: Kane Petro obiro Antiokia, ne akwere e wangʼe nikech kethone ne nenore ratiro.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata muweyone richone nowenegi, to ka ok uweyonegi, to ok nowenegi.”
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

kikuyu: Ahab nowachone Naboth niya, “Yie akaw puothi mar mzabibu alok puoth alot nikech ochiegni gi dalana maduongʼ. To kar puodhono abiro miyi puoth mzabibu maber moloyo, to bende ka ihero to anachuli gimoro amora midwaro.”
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

kikuyu: Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo minwa nopira e chonge kendo adhodho thunde?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kikuyu: Musa noneno ka ji osenjawni kendo kaka Harun noketogi mi gibedo joma wigi tek ma ijaro gi wasikgi.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo ngʼeyo kethone mopondo? Wena kethoga mopondo.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

kikuyu: Jowete duto man ka ooronu mos. Yogreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gi mos maler.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudigo ema nonego Ruoth Yesu kod jonabi mag-gi, kendo gin ema ne giriembowa oko. Ok gilongʼo ne Nyasaye kendo gimon gi ji duto,
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

kikuyu: ne romo ji alufu aboro mia abich gi piero aboro (8,580).
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gachiel ne mar Azarel gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: “Kik upar ni abiro donjonu e nyim Wuoro. Ngʼat madonjonu en Musa, ma useketo genou kuome.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo norwak lepe mayom mag dolo ma oko gi maiye, kendo nojow buru mar misango miwangʼo pep kogolo e kendo mar misango mi oolgi oko e bath kendono.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

kikuyu: Ahero Jehova Nyasaye nikech nowinjo kwayona; nowinjo ywakna kane adwaro kech.
english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nochako wuowi mane Sara onywolone ni Isaka.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo diwatho kendo lopewa bende kethore to ineno? Ngʼiewa-wa wabed wasumbinini kaachiel gi puothewa kuom chiemo mondo mi wan kaachiel gi puothewa wabed mag Farao. Miwa kodhi mipidho mondo kik watho kendo puothewa kik kethre.”
english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

kikuyu: mi chiengʼno ema Jehova Nyasaye nogolo jo-Israel e piny Misri kochan-gi e dhoutgi.
english: That same day, the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nogoyo nigi ngero ni:
english: He told them this parable:

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo kuma ngʼatni oaye nikech Kristo to kobiro, to onge ngʼama nongʼe kuma oaye.”
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar joka Esau ma kwar jo-Edom manodak e piny gode mar Seir.
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

kikuyu: To jomoko kuomgi chunygi nodoko matek, ne gidagi yie kendo negichako wuoyo marach kuom jo-Kristo e lela. Omiyo Paulo noweyogi, mi okawo jopuonjre odhigo e od puonjruok mar ngʼat ma nyinge Turano, kuma ne gitwakie pile.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

kikuyu: Tipo Nyasaye noimo gode duto, mana ka yiende sida ma odongo ma bedene olak.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

kikuyu: Ibiro gwedhou ka un e dala kata ka un oko.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

kikuyu: Jogi gin sokni maonge pi kendo gichalo gi ongʼwengʼo ma yamo tero. Gima okan nigi mudho mandiwa molil ti.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Zebulun kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: To Farao nodwokogi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye to en ngʼa, ma dimi awinj dwonde mi awe jo-Israel dhi? Ok angʼeyo Jehova Nyasaye kendo ok anawe jo-Israel dhi.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know the LORD, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

kikuyu: Miwa kony mondo walo wasikwa, nikech kony mar dhano onge tich.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth owinjo weche manie Kitap Chik, noyiecho lepe.
english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Eka jatend jolweny maduongʼ nowacho niya, “An awuon ne achulo pesa mangʼeny mondo abed ja-Rumi.” Paulo nodwoke niya, “An to ne onywola ja-Rumi.”
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

kikuyu: Ne adhi ka an-gi gik moko duto, to Jehova Nyasaye oseduoga ka an-gi lweta nono. Uluonga ni Naomi nangʼo? Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechwada kendo osekuma malit.”
english: I went out full, and the LORD has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

kikuyu: Miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ mowinjore gi nyinge. Keluru chiwo kendo ubi ire mondo. Ulam Jehova Nyasaye e lerne marieny mar berne.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Nikech, mana kaka wan e achiel gi Kristo e sandruok duto mane oneno, e kaka wan kode e hoch mochiwo.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kikuyu: Achiegni chako wuoyo; kendo weche duto manie chunya abiro wacho.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Bende ma e kit tweyo chiemo ma aseyiero, ma ngʼato hore mana odiechiengʼ achiel kende? Koso en mana ka ngʼama okuyo kokulo wiye ka odundu mayamo yuko kata ngʼama onindo e pien gugru kotimo buru? Bende mano e gima uluongo ni tweyo chiemo ma en odiechiengʼ mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

kikuyu: Mana kaka misumba ma gombo ni seche mag odhiambo ochop piyo, kata ka ngʼama ondiki marito chudo mare gi geno,
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama ler ka Jehova Nyasaye; kendo onge moro makmana in; onge Lwanda machal gi Nyasachwa.
english: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone Saulo niya, “Lingʼ thi! We mondo anyisi gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona otieno mokalo.” Saulo nodwoko niya, “Nyisawa.”
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

kikuyu: ma gin nyiseche mane ochamo gik machwe mag misengini mi omadho divai mag misengini michiwo? Koro giwuogi mondo gikonyi, kendo gimiyi kar resruok!
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

kikuyu: Bende ne nitie mesni angʼwen molos gi kite mopa mane owe ni misengini miwangʼo pep, ma moro ka moro borne ne romo fut ariyo gi nus, lachne ne en fut ariyo gi nus, to borne modhi malo ne en fut achiel gi nus. E wigi noketie gik miyangʼogo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

kikuyu: wuod Matathias, wuod Amos, wuod Nahum, wuod Esli, wuod Nagai,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

kikuyu: Kata kamano mon noyud resruok e yor nywolo nyithindo, ka gisiko e yie kod hera gi ngima maler kendo modimbore.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

kikuyu: Eka enokaw diek ariyo kendo ochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Jogi norwako wuoch moyiech kod lewni moti. Makati mane gin-go duto nokethore.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

kikuyu: Ma e ote mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Malaki mondo omi jo-Israel.
english: A revelation, the LORD’s word to Israel by Malachi.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodhi ir ngʼat Nyasaye mowachone gima osetimore. Eka ngʼat Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo ilok modhigo pesa kendo ichulgo gope ma in-go. In kod yawuoti unyalo konyoru gi mago modongʼ.”
english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

kikuyu: Ne owita nyaka ei chwodho, mi alokora buru.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼama ogeno kuomi ogwedhi.
english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Kristo e jathek mar singruok manyien, mamiyo joma oluongi yudo girkeni mosiko mosesingnegi, nikech koro osetho kargi kaka misango mamiyo gibedo thuolo kuom kethogi e bwo singruok mokwongo.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

kikuyu: ka udwoko erokamano kinde duto ni Nyasaye Wuoro kuom gik moko duto e nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

kikuyu: Joma ongʼeyo nyingi biro geno kuomi, nikech in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne pok ijwangʼo joma manyi.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe anapwodh dho oganda mondo giduto giluong nying Jehova Nyasaye, kendo gitine gi chuny achiel.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji duto nongʼado Jordan, to bangʼe ruoth bende nongʼado loka. Ruoth nonyodho Barzilai kendo nogwedhe, eka Barzilai nodok dalane.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

kikuyu: To kapo ni jatijno timbene richo, mit owacho e chunye owuon ni, Ruodha odeko oko ahinya,
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: Jotend ji mia achiel mane ni e migepe adekgo notimo mana kaka Jehoyada jadolo nochikogi. Jatend migawo ka migawo nokawo joge mane dhi tich chiengʼ Sabato to gi mago mane onego oywe, mi giduto negidhi ir Jehoyada jadolo.
english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

kikuyu: Eka malaikano nowachona niya, “Pigego mane ineno ma dhako ma jachode obedoe, gin ji gi ogendini mangʼeny kod dhout pinje gi joma wacho dhok mopogore opogore.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ruodha akwayi ni tel e nyim misumbani, to aluwi mos mos gi nyithindo kod jamni nyaka achop iri Seir.”
english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro rieyo bade maler ka ogendini duto neno, kendo tungʼ piny ka piny none warruok mar Nyasachwa.
english: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: gigo manotimo duto aa chakruokgi nyaka gikogi ondik e kitap ruodhi mag Israel kod Juda.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

kikuyu: Chakre kogwen nyaka odhiambo inyalo turgi matindo tindo ka ok ongʼeyo, kendo gilal nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kikuyu: “Neuru ni dhout jo-Kohath ok ogol oko kuom jo-Lawi,
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
